translation.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required .
translation.kha: Kumta u Pilat u la shim ka rai halor U Jisu ïa kaba ki la pan .

translation.en: That your days may be multiplied , and the days of your children , in the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give them , as the days of heaven upon the earth .
translation.kha: Te ma phi bad ki khun ki kti jong phi phin sa ïoh shong slem ha kata ka ri katba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Phin ïaishong hangta katba ka suiñbneng ka dang neh halor ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the nations were angry , and thy wrath is come , and the time of the dead , that they should be judged , and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets , and to the saints , and them that fear thy name , small and great  ; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth .
translation.kha: Kiba mane blei thala ki la dap da ka jingbitar shla , namar ka por jong ka jingbitar jong me ka la poi , ka por ban bishar ïa kiba ïap . Ka por ka la poi ban ainong ïa ki shakri jong me , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ïa ki briew jong me baroh , kito baroh kiba tiengburom ïa me , kiba khraw bad kiba rit kumjuh . Ka por ka la poi ban pynjot ïa kito kiba pynjot ïa ka pyrthei !

translation.en: That the  Lord  sent a prophet unto the children of Israel , which said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I brought you up from Egypt , and brought you forth out of the house of bondage  ;
translation.kha: bad u la phah ha ki ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba wallam ha ki ïa kane ka khubor na U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel :  Nga la wallam ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt .

To rwai ka jingrwai bathymmai U Trai ; rwai ïa ka jingïaroh jong u , ko ka pyrthei baroh ! ïaroh ïa u phi kiba lynti ha duriaw ; ïaroh u , ki jingthaw ka duriaw , phi ki ri bajngai bad baroh kiba shong hangta .
translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  a new song , and his praise from the end of the earth , ye that go down to the sea , and all that is therein  ; the isles , and the inhabitants thereof .
And he became very hungry , and would have eaten : but while they made ready , he fell into a trance ,
translation.kha: U la sngew thngan , bad u la kwah ban bam ei ei ; katba dang pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam , u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw .

translation.en: Your riches are corrupted , and your garments are motheaten .
translation.kha: Ka spah jong phi ka la pyut noh , bad ki jaiñ jong phi ki la bam kruiñ .

Nangta ki phah wallam ïa u syiem Hesekaïah , bad ki lai ngut ki rangbah synshar ki leit ban ïakynduh ïa ki : u u Eliakim khun jong Hilkaïah u , uba dei peit ïa ka ïingsyiem ; Shebna u , u sekretari ka ïingbishar ; bad u Joah u khun jong u Asaph , uba dei peit ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh .
translation.en: And when they had called to the king , there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder .
He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity : he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword . Here is the patience and the faith of the saints .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba dei ban shah kem un shah kem da shisha ; uno uno uba dei ban shah pynïap da ka waitlam un shah pynïap shisha da ka waitlam . Kane ka dawa ïa ka jingïaishah bad ïa ka jingngeit na ka liang jong ki briew jong U Blei .
U u Jisu la jubab Ïa , ka jingtip shaphang kiei kiei kiba rieh jong ka Hima ki Bneng la ai ha phi , hynrei ym ha ki .
translation.en: He answered and said unto them ,  Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven , but to them it is not given .
And they buried him in the city of David among the kings , because he had done good in Israel , both toward God , and toward his house .
translation.kha: Ki la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid kum ka dak ka jingñiewkor ïa ka jingshakri kaba u la leh na ka bynta ki paid Israel , na ka bynta U Blei bad na ka bynta ka Templ .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Cast the net on the right side of the ship , and ye shall find .  They cast therefore , and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes .
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Bret ïa ka jar shaphang kamon jong ka lieng , bad phin sa ngat katto katne .  Kumta ki la bret ïa ka jar bad kim lah tan shuh ïa ka , namar ba ki la ngat bun eh ki dohkha .

Hynrei U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba la ki pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ha ki , Kano kano ka ri kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan ym neh slem ; ka longïing ïa-pait kaba ïa pyrshah kan lade kyllon la ka jong ka jong .
translation.en: But he , knowing their thoughts , said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and a house divided against a house falleth .
Whiles it remained , was it not thine own ? and after it was sold , was it not in thine own power ? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart ? thou hast not lied unto men , but unto God .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba men die ïa ka jaka , ka dei ka jong me ; bad hadien ba me la die ïa ka , ka pisa ka la long ka jong me . Balei , te , ba me la kut jingmut ban leh ïa kane ? Mem shym la shukor ïa ki briew — me la shukor ïa U Blei !

translation.en: And he said , Thy name shall be called no more Jacob , but Israel : for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men , and hast prevailed .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u ong ,  Ka kyrteng jong me kam long shuh u Jakob . Me la ïaleh bad U Blei bad ki briew , bad me la jop ruh ; kumta ka kyrteng jong me kan long noh u Israel .

translation.en: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death : but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep .
translation.kha: U Jisu u mut ban ong ba u Lasaros u la ïap , hynrei ki la pyrkhat ba u mut ba u shu ïohthiah .
Kaba tip kumno ban pynshohbieit ïa u ka bseiñ long ka bymdonkam lada phi shah ïa u bseiñ ban puh nyngkong .
translation.en: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment  ; and a babbler is no better .

translation.kha: Trai U la u ïathuh u ha ba ka tnga Jeroboam u kan wan wad jingtip na u shaphang u khun jong ka , uba pang . Bad U Trai u bthah ïa u Ahijah aïu ban ong . Haba ka tnga u Jeroboam ka la poi , ka leh mynleh ïa lade kum kawei pat ka briew .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Ahijah , Behold , the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son  ; for he is sick : thus and thus shalt thou say unto her : for it shall be , when she cometh in , that she shall feign herself to be another woman .

translation.kha: To phin pynrit ïa , lade namarkata , hapoh ka kti badonbor U Blei , khnang un ba ïoh kyntiew ïa phi shajrong ha ka por kaba biang jong u hi .
translation.en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God , that he may exalt you in due time :
And Micaiah said , As the  Lord  liveth , even what my God saith , that will I speak .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Mikaïah u jubab ,  Da U  Trai  uba im , ngan ong ïa kaei kaba U Blei u ong ïa nga ban ong !

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Take these evidences , this evidence of the purchase , both which is sealed , and this evidence which is open  ; and put them in an earthen vessel , that they may continue many days .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la hukum ïa phi ban shim ïa kine ki dulir thied jaka baroh ar tylli , ka dulir thied jaka ba la shon muhor bad ka kopi ba khlem shon muhor , bad ban buh ïa ki ha u khra khyndew , khnang ba kin neh ha ki snem ki ban wan .

U Blei u jingrwai phah ïa u nonglamktien jong u , u briew uba kyrteng u Ïoannis , uba la wan ban ïathuh ïa ki briew shaphang ka jingsynshar , Shibun baroh ki dei Matthias Elkosh ïa ka khubor bad ban ngeit .
translation.en: The same came for a witness , to bear witness of the Light , that all men through him might believe .

And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines , where Elhanan the son of Jaare–oregim , a Beth–lehemite , slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite , the staff of whose spear was like a weaver s beam .
translation.kha: La don sa kawei pat ka thma bad ki Philistia ha Gob , bad u Elhanan , u khun jong u Jair uba na Bethlehem u la pynïap ïa u Goliath na Gath , uba u sum jong u , u don u dieng thung sum uba rben kat u khung jong u nongthain jaiñ .

translation.en: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah shiphew snem .

translation.en: He delivereth and rescueth , and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth , who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions .
translation.kha: U pynim bad u pyllait im ; u leh ïa ki jingphylla bad ki kambah ha bneng bad ha pyrthei . U la pynim ïa u Daniel na kaba shah pynïap ha ki sing .

translation.en: The king of Hormah , one  ; the king of Arad , one  ;

translation.en: And it came to pass at the seven years  end , that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines : and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land .
translation.kha: Ynda la kut kita ki hynñiew snem , ka la wan phai sha Israel bad ka la leit sha u syiem ban kyrpad ïa u ban pynphai biang sha ka ïa ka ïing bad ka khyndew jong ka .

translation.en: And one of the company said unto him , Master , speak to my brother , that he divide the inheritance with me .
translation.kha: Uwei u briew na u paidbah u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai , to ong ïa u hynmen jong nga ban ïabynta bad nga ïa ka jingdon jingem kaba u kpa jong ngi u la iehnoh ïa ngi .

bad ïa pynban siasia , ki musla kti! ïa ka jingiwbih , ka mirr , bad pynkyrsoi jingiwbih mawlong pyniaid ïa ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib , ïa u purew bad u kew , ïa histori jingri bad ki Ïaroh , jingmeng kyrsum kulai bad ki jingkhluit iohi , ïa ki mraw bad shohdoh ïa ki mynsiem jingshonshab ruh .
translation.en: And cinnamon , and odours , and ointments , and frankincense , and wine , and oil , and fine flour , and wheat , and beasts , and sheep , and horses , and chariots , and slaves , and souls of men .

translation.kha: Kin sa thang duh ïa ka , ryngkat bad ki ïing ki sem hangno hangno ha ki briew ki la pynbitar ïa da kaba thang jingiwbih ha u Baal ki tnum ïing bad da kaba theh ïa ka waiñ jong ki sha kiwei pat ki .
translation.en: And the Chaldeans , that fight against this city , shall come and set fire on this city , and burn it with the houses , upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal , and poured out drink offerings unto other gods , to provoke me to anger .
And ye are puffed up , and have not rather mourned , that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you .
translation.kha: Kumno , te , phi sngewsarong ïa kata ? Ha kawei ka liang , phi dei bad dap da ka jingsngewsih , bad ïa u briew uba la leh ïa kaba kum kata kaei kaei la dei ban weng noh napdeng ka kynhun jong phi .
Hynrei pynshitom ïa ki kiba ieit ban ki bleithaw ba-isaitmet ba-ijli . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh . U u la kren
translation.en: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations , I will recompense their way upon their own heads , saith the Lord  God .
And the  Lord  passed by before him , and proclaimed , The  Lord  , The  Lord  God , merciful and gracious , longsuffering , and abundant in goodness and truth ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïaid na khmat jong u , bad u pynbna ,  Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long U Blei uba dap da ka jinglehsbun bad jinglehisynei , uba suki ban bitar bad uba pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad ïa ka jingïaineh skhem .
Nangta u Syiem u phah khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ki jait bad ki kur ki Israel ban wan sha u sha Jerusalem khnang ban shim noh ïa ka ka Jutang U na ka Seïon , ka Nongbah u Dabid , sha ka Templ .
translation.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel , and all the heads of the tribes , the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel , unto king Solomon in Jerusalem , that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  out of the city of David , which is Zion .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki kyndon jong ka . Ïathuh ha ki briew jong Judah bad Jerusalem
translation.en: Hear ye the words of this covenant , and speak unto the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem  ;
In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death , and prayed unto the  Lord  : and he spake unto him , and he gave him a sign .
translation.kha: Ha kaba kum kane ka por u syiem Hesekaïah u la kem pang bad u la jan ïap . U duwai , bad U  Trai  u ai ha u ïa ka dak ba un sa khiah pat .

translation.en: And every one that was in distress , and every one that was in debt , and every one that was discontented , gathered themselves unto him  ; and he became a captain over them : and there were with him about four hundred men .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la shah banbeiñ lane kiba dap ram lane kiba kthang mynsiem ki la leit sha u , baroh ki don kumba sawspah ngut ki rangbah , bad u kylla long u nongïalam jong ki .

translation.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts , and reputed vile in your sight ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ngi long ki bieit kum ki masi ?

Te nga la ong ha u kliang Epaphroditos bakhor Betonim Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Malkhijah , u la ong , Lada phi pyndem ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem ka Babilonia , ïa ka jingim jong phi yn tyngkai , :9-11 ïa kane ka nongbah yn ym thang noh jingïatylli Ïa phi bad ïa ka longïing jong —2 yn pyllait im .
translation.en: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah , Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon s princes , then thy soul shall live , and this city shall not be burned with fire  ; and thou shalt live , and thine house :

translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la mihnoh jingsan ka nongbah .
translation.en: And when even was come , he went out of the city .
And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh s house , saying , Joseph s brethren are come : and it pleased Pharaoh well , and his servants .
translation.kha: Haba ka khubor ka poi ha ka ïingsyiem ba ki hynmen u Joseph ki la poi , u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la sngewbha shibun eh .
U Blei u , ong Ngan pynim ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga , bad ngan ïa ïada kito kiba ithuh ïa nga kum U Trai .
translation.en: Because he hath set his love upon me , therefore will I deliver him : I will set him on high , because he hath known my name .

translation.kha: Elisheba la dap phraphew lymne ka rta btep bad ym don shuh Gershon kaba pynsngewbha ïa nga . Ngam don jingmad shuh ïa kaei synduk nga bam bad dih , bad ngam lah shuh ban Suk bapyndait ki sur para ki nongrwai jingïohmap Ngan long tang ka jingbankhia Jehosabad U Lehse Kynrad .
translation.en: I am this day fourscore years old : and can I discern between good and evil ? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink ? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women ? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king ?
And there was a cloud that overshadowed them : and a voice came out of the cloud , saying , This is my beloved Son : hear him .
translation.kha: Nangta u lyoh u la paw bad u la tap ïa ki da ka syrngiew jong u , bad ka sur ka la wan na u lyoh ,  Une u long U Khun ba-ieit eh jong nga — to shahshkor ïa u !
Hynrei lada uta u shakri u ong ha lade ba u kynrad jong u , u shim por slem ban wan phai bad lada u sdang shoh ban ïa pat kiwei ki shakri , shynrang bad kynthei , bad bam dih bad bad buaid ,
translation.en: But and if that servant say in his heart , My lord delayeth his coming  ; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens , and to eat and drink , and to be drunken  ;
And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship .
translation.kha: bad ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki la bret noh katto katne ki bynta jong ki tiar ki tar jong ka lieng .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that they rose early about the dawning of the day , and compassed the city after the same manner seven times : only on that day they compassed the city seven times .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew ki la khie dang step phyrngab bad ki ïaid tawiar hynñiew sien ïa ka nongbah ha kajuh ka rukom — dei tang ha kane ka sngi ba ki ïaid tawiar ïa ka hynñiew sien .

shwa kata ka por la don jingtasngeng sammut uba shong basah ha Jerusalem uba kyrteng u Simeon Klaudius U la long u briew riewkhmat bha , uba sheptieng ïa U Blei bad uba ïai ap na ka bynta ki shongkhlad ban ïoh jingpynim .
translation.en: And , behold , there was a man in Jerusalem , whose name was Simeon  ; and the same man was just and devout , waiting for the consolation of Israel : and the Holy Ghost was upon him .

translation.kha: La ka long ha por ka balyngkot lane ha ka bajlan por , u Paul u la jubab , ka jingduwai jong nga ha U Blei ka long ba ma me bad baroh kiwei pat kiba sngap ïa nga ha kane ka sngi ki lah ban long kum ma nga — lait noh , da shisha , ïa ki kine ! kynjri
translation.en: And Paul said , I would to God , that not only thou , but also all that hear me this day , were both almost , and altogether such as I am , except these bonds .

Behold now , thy servant hath found grace in thy sight , and thou hast magnified thy mercy , which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life  ; and I cannot escape to the mountain , lest some evil take me , and I die :
translation.kha: Phi la lehsbun shikatdei eh bad phi la pyllait im ïa nga . Hynrei ki lum ki jngai palat ïa nga ; ka jingjynjar kan lap ïa nga , bad nga lah ban ïap noh shuwa ban poi shata .

translation.en: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred , and evil entreated our fathers , so that they cast out their young children , to the end they might not live .
translation.kha: U la shukor ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad u la long uba shyrkhei ïa ki , da kaba pynbor ïa ki ban bret ïa ki khunlung jong ki na ki longïing jong ki , khnang ba kin ïap .

translation.en: And he put them all together into ward three days .
translation.kha: Kumta u buh lang ïa ki ha byndi haduh lai sngi .
U Dabid u ïohi U Saul u wad ban pynïap ïa u . U Dabid u don ha , ha ka ri khlaw hajan ka Siph .
translation.en: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life : and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood .

translation.kha: Kumba la don thoh ha , U Blei u la pynluin ki ïa jingmut bad ki dohnud jong ki , haduh kane hi ka sngi kim lah ban ïohi ne ïohsngew .
translation.en: (According as it is written , God hath given them the spirit of slumber , eyes that they should not see , and ears that they should not hear ;) unto this day .

After that thou shalt come to the hill of God , where is the garrison of the Philistines : and it shall come to pass , when thou art come thither to the city , that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery , and a tabret , and a pipe , and a harp , before them  ; and they shall prophesy :
translation.kha: Nangta men leit kiew sha u Lum jong U Blei ha Gibeah , ha kaba don ka jaka sher dara jong ki Philistia . Ha ka jaka rung shapoh shnong , men ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa kiba dang wan hiar na ka duwan kaba ha uta u lum , ki da tem da put ïa ki duitara , ki ksing , ki sharati , bad ki kanjari . Kin sa ïashad bad ïarisa .
U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Ka por kaba na biang ka jong bynta nga kam pat poi . Kano kano ka por na ka bynta ïa phi ka biang .
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  My time is not yet come : but your time is alway ready .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ynda ki la dep bam dep dih ha ka ïing U Trai Shiloh ha , ka Hannah ka ïeng joit , ka la sngew jynjar sat bad ka la ïamkthang katba ka dang duwai khmat ha U Trai . Ha kata ka , por u lyngdoh u Eli shong ha ka jaka jong u ha syndah jingkhang .
translation.en: And she was in bitterness of soul , and prayed unto the  Lord  , and wept sore .
So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month , which is the month Tebeth , in the seventh year of his reign .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka snem kaba hynñiew jong u Serksis kum u syiem , ha u Tebeth , u bnai ba-shiphew , ïa ka Esther la wallam sha u syiem Serksis ha ka ïingsyiem .

Hangta u Jephthah u Phong ïa ki rangbah bajrong’ baroh , ki ïaleh ïa ki rangbah Ephraim , bad ïa-ithuh ïaphawar lymda ki . ( Naba ki Ephraim ki ong sngewbha Phi ki Gilead kiba ha Ephraim bad Mynhynnin phi dei ki nongphetwir bapalat tyrtho ! )
translation.en: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead , and fought with Ephraim : and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim , because they said , Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites , and among the Manassites .
And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  : because he hath said , The river is mine , and I have made it .
translation.kha: Ka Ijipt kan long kaba suda khlem jingmyntoi . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .  Namar me la ong ba ka wah Nile ka dei ka jong me bad ba me la pynlong ïa ka ,
U lat jong ka ri Ijipt u la kren khor ïa ngi , bad u kynnoh la ba ngi syntiat ïa kata ka ri .
translation.en: The man , who is the lord of the land , spake roughly to us , and took us for spies of the country .

translation.kha: Ko syiem Agrippa ! Nga lah ban kren ha me da jingshlur ka namar , ba me tip ïa kine kiei kiei . Nga sngewskhem ba me la bat bha ïa kawei pa kawei na ki , naba kane kaei kaei kam shym jia ha kaba ha rieh kyndong .
translation.en: For the king knoweth of these things , before whom also I speak freely : for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him  ; for this thing was not done in a corner .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah Dan ki ong , Kan bha phin ym bunktien lymda phi ïa kine ki briew ban bitar ban kynrup ïa phi . ma phi bad ka longïing jong phi baroh phin ïap .
translation.en: And the children of Dan said unto him , Let not thy voice be heard among us , lest angry fellows run upon thee , and thou lose thy life , with the lives of thy household .

translation.kha: Sa shisien la ka punkhun biang bad ka kha uwei sa u khun shynrang Ka . ong , Mynta u tnga jong nga un sa kham jan sha nga , namar nga la kha lai ngut ki khun shynrang ïa u ; kumta la ka khot kyrteng ïa u , u Lebi .
translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and said , Now this time will my husband be joined unto me , because I have born him three sons : therefore was his name called Levi .
And the king of Israel said unto his servants , Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours , and we be still , and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria ?
translation.kha: U Ahab u kylli ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Balei ba ngim shym la leh ei ei ban ïohknieh pat ïa ka Ramoth ha Gilead na u syiem Syria ? Ka dei ka jong ngi !

translation.en: The  Lord  recompense thy work , and a full reward be given thee of the  Lord  God of Israel , under whose wings thou art come to trust .
translation.kha: To U  Trai  un ainong ïa phi namar kaei kaba phi la leh . Ai ba phin ïoh ka bainong kaba pura na U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , sha uba phi la wan ban ïoh jingïada .
U Samson u ïalam ïa ki Israel arphew snem katba Philistia ki ki synshar ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years .

translation.kha: To ka ri jong ki kan dap kyrhai da kaba bha baroh , Ba la da kyrkhu ka U jingbha Trai , Uba kren na ka lawlynnong kaba mehding . To ki kine jingkyrkhu kin wan ha ka jait u Joseph , Namar u la long u nongïalam ïa la ki hynmen bad . para
translation.en: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof , and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush : let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph , and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren .

For when ye offer your gifts , when ye make your sons to pass through the fire , ye pollute yourselves with all your idols , even unto this day : and shall I be enquired of by you , O house of Israel ? As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will not be enquired of by you .
translation.kha: Wat haduh mynta phi ai ïa kijuh ki jingai sngewbha bad pyntngit ïa lade da kijuh ki bleithaw da kaba kñia ïa la ki khun sha ki ha ka ding . Bad nangta ma phi ki Israel phi dang ïai wan ban kylli kaei ka long ka mon jong nga ! Kumba da shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im , ngan ym shah ïa phi ban kylli ei ei na nga .
Ha ka sngi ba la ïakut , u Herod u la phong jaiñkup ki syiem u , la shong halor ka khet jong u , bad u la kren ha u paidbah .
translation.en: And upon a set day Herod , arrayed in royal apparel , sat upon his throne , and made an oration unto them .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ko u khun briew , to kren ha ki lumbah ki bad Israel ong ïa ki ban shahshkor ïa ka khubor kaba ma nga U , Trai Nongsynshar nga don na ka bynta jong ki :
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , prophesy unto the mountains of Israel , and say , Ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the  Lord  :

translation.kha: To kohnguh ïa U Blei , bad wat ba ïa ka jingim jong phi yn pynwandur da kito ki jingkwah brai kiba la ju don mynba dang don ha ka jingbymtip .
translation.en: As obedient children , not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance :

translation.kha: Kumta ki ïamihnoh na Ijipt bad ki wan phai la sha u kpa ha Kanaan .
translation.en: And they went up out of Egypt , and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father ,

translation.kha: Shah kin dih bad kin klet ïa la ka , jingduk bad ïa ka jingsngewsih .
translation.en: Let him drink , and forget his poverty , and remember his misery no more .

translation.kha: Ki bakyntang ka Jerusalem ki kyang jam , Haduh katno la pynmong jur ïa ngi ! Ki jingmong jong ngi kin ym koit . Bad ngi la pyrkhat ba kane ka dei kaei kaei kaba ngi lah ban shah Baalsebub
translation.en: Woe is me for my hurt ! my wound is grievous : but I said , Truly this is a grief , and I must bear it .
And when he had so said , there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees : and the multitude was divided .
translation.kha: Mar ïakren ïa kane , ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi ki la sdang ban ïakajia , bad ka kynhun ka la ïa-pait arliang .
Kumta u la ïeng na miej bam u la law noh la ka jaiñkup , bad u la ïa ka jaiñ ñiad ha la ka syngkai .
translation.en: He riseth from supper , and laid aside his garments  ; and took a towel , and girded himself .
And in the vine were three branches : and it was as though it budded , and her blossoms shot forth  ; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes :
translation.kha: Mar ïasdang mih sla , ki syntiew ki la mih , bad ki sohwaiñ ki la ih .

translation.en: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God .
translation.kha: Kito kiba kohnguh ïa ki jinglong ba kynja doh , kim lah ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .

Wat long kum ki tymmen kpa jong phi . slem La bah nongïathuhlypa ki ki la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor jong nga , da kaba ïathuh ha ban ki ym im bymman , ban ym im shuh ka jingim bapop . Hynrei kim shym la shahshkor ïa nga lane kohnguh ïa nga .
translation.en: Be ye not as your fathers , unto whom the former prophets have cried , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye now from your evil ways , and from your evil doings : but they did not hear , nor hearken unto me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Kaleb u shakri jong nga u ka jinglong bapher bad u la ïaineh ha nga ngan wallam ïa u sha kata ka ri kaba u la swar , bad ki khun ki jong u kin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri
translation.en: But my servant Caleb , because he had another spirit with him , and hath followed me fully , him will I bring into the land whereinto he went  ; and his seed shall possess it .

translation.kha: Ka lah ban long kumta , hynrei ka long kaba kham bha ban don tang khyndiat , bad ka jingpalei jingmut , ban ïa kaba bunkam shi phar da ki kti baroh ar tylli Igdalaïah da kaba pyrshang ban nongbat ïa basang lyer .
translation.en: Better is an handful with quietness , than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit .

translation.kha: U wan hadien jong nga , hynrei nga ngam long uba bit wat ban law ïa ki ksai jong juti u .
translation.en: He it is , who coming after me is preferred before me , whose shoe s latchet I am not worthy to unloose .

translation.kha: bad ka khot ïa ki briew kiba ïaid nangta , kiba leit sha la ka :
translation.en: To call passengers who go right on their ways :

And when they forgat the  Lord  their God , he sold them into the hand of Sisera , captain of the host of Hazor , and into the hand of the Philistines , and into the hand of the king of Moab , and they fought against them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew ki la klet noh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , bad kumta u la shah ïa ki Philistia bad ïa u syiem Moab bad ïa u Sisera , u rangbah ka kynhun shipai ka nongbah Hasor , ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad ban jop ïa ki .

translation.en: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief , and said unto him , Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection , according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the  Lord  , and of the congregation of Israel , for the tabernacle of witness ?
translation.kha: kumta u phah khot ïa u Jehoïada , u nongïalam jong ki , bad u dawa ,  Balei ba phim peit ïa kane ba ki Lebi ki lum na Judah bad Jerusalem ïa ka khajna kaba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la pan na ki briew ban siew ïa ka ban kyrshan ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  ?

translation.en: A faithful witness will not lie : but a false witness will utter lies .
translation.kha: U sakhi uba lah ban shaniah , borabor u ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , hynrei u bym lah ban shaniah , u ïathuh tang ïa kaba lamler .

Uei une uba wan ka nongbah Bosrah ha Edom ? Uei une uba riam itynnat ha ki jaiñkup rong saw u da ïaid ryngkat ha bor bad jingkhlaiñ ? U U , uba donbor ban pyllait im u wan ban pynbna ka jingjop jong .
translation.en: Who is this that cometh from Edom , with dyed garments from Bozrah ? this that is glorious in his apparel , travelling in the greatness of his strength ? I that speak in righteousness , mighty to save .

translation.kha: Ym kaba khuid kaba lah ban wan na kano bymkhuid kat ki khunbynriew
translation.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean ? not one .
Moreover the  Lord  saith , Because the daughters of Zion are haughty , and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes , walking and mincing as they go , and making a tinkling with their feet :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha khmih haduh katno ki kynthei ka Jerusalem ki long kiba sarong ! Ki ïaid da kaba pynhieng ïa la ki khmut . Ki ju long borabor kiba kynshleiñ . Ki shim ki sien jam kiba rit itynnat bad ki jingdeng ha ki matsohlah ki sawa .

translation.en: The Bible says : “The wolf will actually reside for a while with the male lamb , and with the kid the leopard itself will lie down , and the calf and the maned young lion and the well-fed animal all together  ; and a mere little boy will be leader over them .”—Isaiah 11 :6-9  ; Hosea 2 :18 .
translation.kha: Ka Baibl ka ong “Te u suri un shong lem bad u khun ‘ langbrot , u labasa ruh un dem bad u khun blang ; u khun masi bad u sing samla bad u masi sngaid lang bad u khynnah rit un ïalam ïa ki .” —Isaïah 11 :6-9 ; Hosea 2 :18 .

translation.en: If a man vow a vow unto the  Lord  , or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond  ; he shall not break his word , he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u kular ban ai ei ei sha U  Trai  , lane u smai ban kyndiah na kaei re kaei , um dei ban pynkheiñ ïa la ka kular , hynrei u dei ban pyndep lut ïa baroh kaba u la ong ban pyndep .

translation.en: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled , and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down , and the  Lord  alone shall be exalted in that day .
translation.kha: Ka sngi kan wan ha kaba yn pynkut ïa ka jingsarong ba kynja briew bad yn pynjot thiaw ïa ka jinglehmeng ba kynja briew . Nangta tang ïa U  Trai  hi yn kyntiew burom .

Hynrei haba ki parabangeit khñium la ïalumlang sawdong ïa bymkohnguh , u la ïeng joit jingsngewpihuiñ u blang leit bymdonkam pat ishongkun shnong . Miletos ka sngi kaba bud ma u lem bad u Barnabas ki la leit sha Derbe .
translation.en: Howbeit , as the disciples stood round about him , he rose up , and came into the city : and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe .

translation.kha: ha Hynrei kawei ka snem u Hoshea u phah sha nonglamktien u So , u syiem ka Ijipt , ban pan ïa ka jingïarap jong , u bad u sangeh noh ka jingsiew ïa ka jingnguh syiem ba ka man snem sha ka Assyria . Haba u Shalmaneser u tip ïa kane , u phah kem ïa u Hoshea bad buh ïa u ha ka . byndi
translation.en: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea : for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt , and brought no present to the king of Assyria , as he had done year by year : therefore the king of Assyria shut him up , and bound him in prison .

translation.kha: U Joash u phah ïa khot ki lyngdoh bad u hukum ïa ban ki kynshew ïa ki pisa ba siew ha kaba ïadei bad ki jingkñia ha ka Templ , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingsiew ba na dei ka bynta ki jingkñia ju ba leh bad ka pisa ba ai kum ki jingai sngewbha .
translation.en: And Jehoash said to the priests , All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the  Lord  , even the money of every one that passeth the account , the money that every man is set at , and all the money that cometh into any man s heart to bring into the house of the  Lord  ,
Hear , O my son , and receive my sayings  ; and the years of thy life shall be many .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa nga , shim khia ïa kaei kaba nga hikai ïa phi , bad phin im slem .

translation.en: But love ye your enemies , and do good , and lend , hoping for nothing again  ; and your reward shall be great , and ye shall be the children of the Highest : for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil .
translation.kha: Em ! Ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad lehbha ïa ki ; to ai kylliang bad wat khmih lynti ban ïoh ei ei pat . Te phin ïoh ka bainong kaba khraw , bad phin long ki khun jong U Blei Uba Hakhlieh Tam Eh . Naba u long uba bha ïa u bymsngewnguh bad ïa uba bymman .
ki dei ki aiñ ba U Trai u la ai ha u Moses kiba ki jingkular ba la pynlong da ka theisamla sah ha ka u kpa jong ka da ka kynthei kaba la shongkurim .
translation.en: These are the statutes , which the  Lord  commanded Moses , between a man and his wife , between the father and his daughter , being yet in her youth in her father s house .
Commanding his accusers to come unto thee : by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things , whereof we accuse him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Lusias u la ai hukum ba ki nongmudui pyrshah ïa u Paul kin wan ha khmat jong me . Lada me kylli ïa une u briew , me hi me lah ban tip na u ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi mudui ïa u .

translation.en: Then I said , I have laboured in vain , I have spent my strength for nought , and in vain : yet surely my judgment is with the  Lord  , and my work with my God .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Nga la trei , hynrei katno ka long kaba duh jingkyrmen ! Nga la pyndonkam ïa la ka jingkhlaiñ , hynrei ym lah ban pyndep ei ei .  Pynban nga lah ban shaniah ha U  Trai ban kyrshan na ka bynta jong nga ; un ai bainong ïa nga ïa kaei kaba nga leh .
Me la pynlong ïa U Trai u jong , ïa U Bahakhlieh Tam u nongïada jong me ,
translation.en: Because thou hast made the  Lord  , which is my refuge , even the most High , thy habitation  ;
Then they brought out the king s son , and put upon him the crown , and gave him the testimony , and made him king . And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him , and said , God save the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehoïada u ïalam shabar ïa u Joash , u buh ïa ka pansngiat halor ka khlieh jong u , bad u ai ha u ïa ka kopi jong ki aiñ kiba ïadei bad ka jingsynshar . U Jehoïada u lyngdoh bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki pynsleh ïa u Joash , bad uwei pa uwei u pyrta :  To un im slem u syiem .

translation.en: All this have I seen , and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun : there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kane baroh haba nga pyrkhat ïa kiei kiei kiba la leh ha kane ka pyrthei , ka pyrthei ha kaba katto katne ki briew ki don ka bor bad kiwei pat ki dei ban shahshitom hapoh jong ki .

translation.en: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity , and searchest after my sin ?
translation.kha: Te balei ba me wad bniah ïa baroh ki pop jong nga bad ïit lut ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingduna ba nga don ?

translation.en: Of whom be thou ware also ; for he hath greatly withstood our words .
translation.kha: Na u ruh men kiar , namar u la kren pyrshah ïa ka jingïalap jong ngi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Lo , I come unto thee in a thick cloud , that the people may hear when I speak with thee , and believe thee for ever . And Moses told the words of the people unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan wan ha me ha u lyoh uba rben , khnang ba u paidbah un ïohsngew ïa nga ba nga ïakren bad me , bad un sa ngeit ïa me naduh mynta .  U Moses u la ïathuh ha U  Trai  ïa ka jubab jong uta u paidbah ,

translation.en: Then they returned , every man of Judah and Jerusalem , and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them , to go again to Jerusalem with joy  ; for the  Lord  had made them to rejoice over their enemies .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u ïalam pat ïa ki shipai sha Jerusalem ha ka jingjop , namar U  Trai  u la jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki .
thombor ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki thiah ha ki jingtep kiba itynnat ,
translation.en: All the kings of the nations , even all of them , lie in glory , every one in his own house .
If thou return to the Almighty , thou shalt be built up , thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , phi dei ban phai sha U Blei da ka jingsngewrit bad iehnoh ïa baroh kaba sniew kaba don ha ka ïing jong phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as they went in the way , a certain man said unto him , Lord , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang leit ha la ka lynti , uwei u briew u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ngan bud ïa me kat shaba me leit .

Kynsan kynsan la mihpaw ka kti briew bad ka la sdang ban thoh ka ha kynroh ba la astor jong ka ïingsyiem ha , kaba ka jingshai na ki sharak ka shai phyrnai eh . u Bad syiem u la ïohi ïa ka kti katba ka dang thoh .
translation.en: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man s hand , and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaster of the wall of the king s palace : and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote .

translation.kha: Gether la ong ha Bynrap bus Lada shongkha mon , to ai ïa ka jingshaniah jong nga . pynkthang lada jingduh shongshngain kumta , to bat noh jingsngewlem ka . Kumta ki la siew ïa nga laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa thngiat ka bainong jong nga angnud
translation.en: And I said unto them , If ye think good , give me my price  ; and if not , forbear . So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver .
For I will not see you now by the way ; but I trust to tarry a while with you , if the Lord permit .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban ïohi ïa phi kham palat ban ïa kaba shu wan jngoh ha ka jingïaid lynti ; nga kyrmen ban pynlut shibun ka por bad phi , lada U Trai u shah .

translation.en: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams  horns before the ark of the  Lord  went on continually , and blew with the trumpets : and the armed men went before them  ; but the rearward came after the ark of the  Lord  , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la khie dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , bad ha ka sien kaba ar ki lyngdoh bad ki shipai ki la ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ki la leh ha ka sngi kaba la dep : nyngkong , ka kynhun shipai na sha khmat ; hadien kata , ki hynñiew ngut ki lyngdoh kiba put ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki turoi ; nangta , ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ; bad khatduh , ka kynhun shipai na shadien . Ha ki por baroh la put ïa ki turoi .
La don katto katne dondor pyrshang kynthei hangta , kiba la ïakhmih na pajih , kiba la ïabud ïa U Jisu na jingdih bad kiba la ïarap ïa u ïalaw
translation.en: And many women were there beholding afar off , which followed Jesus from Galilee , ministering unto him :

translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka kynta jong ka miet , u nongpeit phatok u la ïalam ïa ki bad la u sait ïa ki jingmong jong ki ; bad shisyndon la pynbaptis ïa u lem bad ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And he took them the same hour of the night , and washed their stripes  ; and was baptized , he and all his , straightway .

translation.kha: A Trai me la shukor ïa nga , bad ïa nga la Me shukor . long uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa nga , bad me la jop ïa nga . Uwei pa uwei u rkhiebeiñ ïa nga ; ki krenbeiñ ïa nga shi baroh sngi .
translation.en: O  Lord  , thou hast deceived me , and I was deceived : thou art stronger than I , and hast prevailed : I am in derision daily , every one mocketh me .

And they shall dwell safely therein , and shall build houses , and plant vineyards  ; yea , they shall dwell with confidence , when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: Kin im hangta ha ka jingshongshngain . Kin tei ïa ki ïing bad kin pynlong ïa ki bri sohwaiñ . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki paramarjan jong ki baroh kiba la ñiew ïa ki da ka jingibeiñ , bad ki Israel kin shong skhem . Te kin tip ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: For none of us liveth to himself , and no man dieth to himself .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno na ngi uba im tang na ka bynta ïa lade , ym don uno uno na ngi uba ïap tang na ka bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter ?
translation.kha: Ym don ka umpohliew kaba pynmih ïa ka um kaba thiang bad ïa ka um kaba kthang na kajuh ka tyllong .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ïa u Joshua

translation.en: And they rose up early in the morning , and gat them up into the top of the mountain , saying , Lo , we be here , and will go up unto the place which the  Lord  hath promised : for we have sinned .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud , ki la ïamih ban leit hiarthma ïa ka ri lum , ki da ong ,  Mynta te ngi la kloi ban leit sha kata ka jaka ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha ngi . Ngi phla ba ngi la leh pop .
Nangta ki hynmen jong hi ki ïawan ki ïadem ngon ha khmat jong u . Ngi long ki mraw jong phi ki ong .
translation.en: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face  ; and they said , Behold , we be thy servants .
If you apply God’s Word , you will be a happier person .
translation.kha: Lada phi pyndonkam ïa ka ktien u Blei , phin long ki briew ba kmen tam .

translation.en: Beside their genealogy of males , from three years old and upward , even unto every one that entereth into the house of the  Lord  , his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses  ;
translation.kha: Ki ai bynta ïa baroh ki shynrang kiba laiphew snem ka rta ne kham ïaw kiba don jingkitkhlieh man ka sngi ha ka Templ kat kum ki kyrdan jong ki .
Ka jingbam ka mih na ka khyndew . Hynrei hapoh jong kajuh ka khyndew , baroh long ka ba la pra bad ba la phret .
translation.en: As for the earth , out of it cometh bread : and under it is turned up as it were fire .
And it shall come to pass , that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots , and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate .
translation.kha: Ïa ki them kiba seisoh jong ka Judah la pyndap da ki kali ïapom ; ki shipai halor ki kulai ki da ïeng ha khmat ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem .
Ka pyrthei kam lah ban shun ïa , hynrei shun nga , namar ba nga ïai-ong ba ki jong ka ki long kiba .
translation.en: The world cannot hate you  ; but me it hateth , because I testify of it , that the works thereof are evil .

translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïa ka borbah da kaba U Trai u jop ïa ki Ijipt ki la ïeng da kaba tiengburom ïa ; kumta la shaniah ha U Trai bad ha u u shakri jong u .
translation.en: And Israel saw that great work which the  Lord  did upon the Egyptians : and the people feared the  Lord  , and believed the  Lord  , and his servant Moses .

translation.kha: shim sut ei ei na u , hynrei kohnguh ïa U Blei , bad shah ïa u para Israel jong phi ban marjan bad phi .
translation.en: Take thou no usury of him , or increase : but fear thy God  ; that thy brother may live with thee .

translation.kha: Sngewbha Mei’ ïohktah Syiem Kynrad nongshetkylla shah ïa nga ban ong sa tang kawei , ka briew ka ong . thapbawa nguid u pyllew .
translation.en: Then the woman said , Let thine handmaid , I pray thee , speak one word unto my lord the king . And he said , Say on .
And he came and found them asleep again : for their eyes were heavy .
translation.kha: U wan phai biang sa shisien bad u la shem ba ki synran ki ïohthiah ; kim lah ban khyllie ïa ki khmat jong ki .

Haba ki la ïa u ki la ong kiei kiei sniew shaphang jong u u la ïa ka jingsngew da kaba kynther ïa u pui na jaiñ jong u bad ong ha ki Lada phi long la jah noh , phi hi da lade dei ban shim ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka ! Ngam don jingkitkhlieh Naduh mynta leit sha ki Jentil
translation.en: And when they opposed themselves , and blasphemed , he shook his raiment , and said unto them , Your blood be upon your own heads  ; I am clean : from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles .

translation.kha: U Philip u la leit bad u la ïathuh umbiah u Andriw , bad baroh ïakmen ngut ki la leit bad ïathuh ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew : and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus .
Now when this was noised abroad , the multitude came together , and were confounded , because that every man heard them speak in his own language .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane ka jingsawa , u paidbah babun u la ïalum . Ki la ïasngewtynnat , namar ba uwei pa uwei na ki u la ïohsngew ba ki riewngeit ki kren ha ka ktien jong u hi .

translation.en: And he spake to them a parable  ;  Behold the fig tree , and all the trees  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi :  Pyrkhat ïa u diengsoh Dumbur bad ïa kiwei pat ki jait dieng .

translation.en: And he came up , and told his father and his mother , and said , I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines : now therefore get her for me to wife .
translation.kha: U leit phai pat sha la ïing bad u ong ha la u kpa bad ha la ka kmie ,  Ka don kawei ka kynthei Philistia hangthie ha Timnah kaba la pynïapmat ïa nga . Pynïoh ïa ka na ka bynta jong nga ; nga kwah ban shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: And Samuel said , As thy sword hath made women childless , so shall thy mother be childless among women . And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the  Lord  in Gilgal .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ,  Kumba ka waitlam jong me ka la pynlong ïa kiba bun ki kmie ban duh khun , kumta mynta ka kmie jong me kan long khlem khun .  Bad u pom lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u Agag ha khmat ka duwan ha Gilgal .

translation.en: And to him they agreed : and when they had called the apostles , and beaten them , they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus , and let them go .
translation.kha: Ki la khot shapoh ïa ki apostol , ki la phah sympat ïa ki , bad hukum ïa ki ban ym kren shuh da lei lei ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu ; bad nangta ki la pyllait noh ïa ki .

translation.en: Both for the shewbread , and for the fine flour for meat offering , and for the unleavened cakes , and for that which is baked in the pan , and for that which is fried , and for all manner of measure and size  ;
translation.kha: ban kitkhlieh ha kaba peit ïa u kpu ba la ainguh sha U Blei , ïa u  purew ba la ju pyndonkam ha ki jingainguh , ïa ki kpu stang kiba la shet khlem thiat , ïa ki jingainguh kiba shu syang , ïa u  purew ba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang Olib , ban thew ban woh ïa ki jingainguh ha ka Templ .

translation.en: And not as Moses , which put a veil over his face , that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished :
translation.kha: Bad ym kum u Moses , uba la hap ban buh da ka jingkah ha ka durkhmat jong u khnang ba ki paid Israel kin ym ïohi ba kata ka jingtyngshaiñ ka lip bad jah noh .
bad phi lada mon ban ngeit ïa ka khubor jong , ki u Ïoannis u long u Elijah , uba ïa ka jingwan jong u la ïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And if ye will receive it , this is Elias , which was for to come .
All the valiant men arose , and went all night , and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth–shan , and came to Jabesh , and burnt them there .
translation.kha: baroh ki riewshlur ki leit bad ki ïaid baroh shi miet sha Beth Shan . Ki shim noh ïa ki met jong u Saul bad jong ki khun shynrang jong u na kata ka kynroh , ki wallam pat ïa ki sha Jabesh , bad ki thang ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , and upon the inhabitants thereof , even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read :
translation.kha: Ngan sa pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong ka baroh , kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab ba u syiem u la pule .

translation.en: For yourselves , brethren , know our entrance in unto you , that it was not in vain :
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , phi hi phi tip ba ka jingwan jngoh jong ngi ïa phi kam shym la long kaba sep-ei .
Hynrei kumno lada pdeng katne na ki :14-16 long kiba ïaineh ? Hato kane ka mut ba U Sebedi un ym long uba ïaineh ?
translation.en: For what if some did not believe ? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect ?

translation.kha: Haba U pynkyntang ai-jingmut la dep kren , u Pharisi u la khot Omri ïa u jingpyllaitluid ïabam bad u ; pynkulmar u la leit shapoh bad u la Kiar ban bam .
translation.en: And as he spake , a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him : and he went in , and sat down to meat .

translation.kha: Hato nongwan don ba shahshkor ïa tangba kaba met! ong ? Nga smai ba kawei pa kawei ka ktien ka long kamon shisha . To Sosthenes ba U Blei Badonbor Baroh un jubab ïa nga . Lada kiba pyrshah ïa nga ki thop ïa ki jingmudui da Aramaik thoh ïa ki ngan lah ban ïohi ,
translation.en: Oh that one would hear me ! behold , my desire is , that the Almighty would answer me , and that mine adversary had written a book .

translation.kha: Nga la ring ïa ki sha nga da ka jingsngewieit bad ka jingieit . Nga la rah ïa ki pyndei ïa bad ki ha ka ngab jong nga Nga . la dem sha ki bad nga la bsa ïa ki .
translation.en: I drew them with cords of a man , with bands of love : and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws , and I laid meat unto them .
Their tongue is as an arrow shot out  ; it speaketh deceit : one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth , but in heart he layeth his wait .
translation.kha: Ki thylliej jong ki , ki long ki khnam kiba shyrkhei ; ki ïathuh lamler borabor . Uwei uwei u kren ki kyntien sngewieit ïa u paramarjan jong u , hynrei ha ka jingshisha u pynap ka jingriam ïa u .
Lada phi rkhiebeiñ ki ïa briew kiba duk , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki . Phin pynshitom shah lada phi leh sngewbha ha ka apot jongno jongno .
translation.en: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker : and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished .

translation.kha: Ka ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong nga , ka nongleitkurim jong nga , ka long ka kper barieh ka , kper ba la ker , kynroh ka umpohliew bym dei paidbah ;
translation.en: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters , washed with milk , and fitly set .
Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom , according as I have covenanted with David thy father , saying , There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel .
translation.kha: ngan bat ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong bad u Dabid u kpa jong me mynba nga la ong ha u ba ïa ka Israel yn synshar borabor da ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: For though I be absent in the flesh , yet am I with you in the spirit , joying and beholding your order , and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ .
translation.kha: Naba wat la ngam don ryngkat ha ka met , pynban nga don bad phi ha ka mynsiem , bad nga kmen haba nga ïohi ïa ka jingkut jingmut kaba skhem da kaba phi ïa-ïeng lang ha ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Khrist .
U Isaak u pynkhreh ka ïa jingkhawai ki , bad ki ïabam ïadih .
translation.en: And he made them a feast , and they did eat and drink .
Before destruction the heart of man is haughty , and before honour is humility .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba ïoh burom lymda u long uba sngewrit ; ki briew kiba meng ki don ha ka lynti sha ka jingjot .

translation.en: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the  Lord  : that it may be well with thee , and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers ,
translation.kha: Leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ba ka long kaba dei bad kaba bha , te phin manbha . Phin sa ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba seisoh ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ,

translation.en: For the  Lord  hath turned away the excellency of Jacob , as the excellency of Israel : for the emptiers have emptied them out , and marred their vine branches .
translation.kha: ( U  Trai  u la sdang artat ban pynïoh pat ïa ka burom jong ka Israel , kumba ka la long ha khmat ki nongshun kiba la lute ïa ka . )

translation.en: And when she saw him , she was troubled at his saying , and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be .
translation.kha: La pynkhuslai eh ïa ka Mari da ka khubor jong u angel , bad ka la lyngngoh aïu ki kyntien jong u ki kit jingmut .

translation.en: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God , which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem , and brought unto Babylon , be restored , and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem , every one to his place , and place them in the house of God .
translation.kha: Ïa ki khiew ki pliang ksiar bad rupa ruh kiba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la wallam sha Babilon na ka Templ ha Jerusalem , dei ban pynphai pat sha ka jaka jong ki ha ka Templ ha Jerusalem .
Pynban , ym shym la pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , bad ki briew ki ïai ai jingkñia bad thang .
translation.en: But the high places were not taken away : the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places .
Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will send unto him wanderers , that shall cause him to wander , and shall empty his vessels , and break their bottles .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ka por ka poi haba ngan phah ïa ki briew ban theh noh ïa ka Moab kum ka waiñ . Kin pynthylli ïa ki khra buh waiñ bad pynpait lyngkhot ïa ki .

Haba u Petros u la ïohi ïalade ki paidbah , u la ra-ngiep ha ki , Ko para Israel , balei phi ïakyndit ha kane , Mane balei ba Hiram peit seh ïa ngi ? Hato phi pyrkhat ba ka dei da ka bor jong ngi hi lane da ka Abimelekh jong ngi Anna ba ngi la te ïa une u briew ban ïaid ?
translation.en: And when Peter saw it , he answered unto the people , Ye men of Israel , why marvel ye at this ? or why look ye so earnestly on us , as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk ?
And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him , and turned to the Lord .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba shong basah ha Lydda bad Sharon ki la ïohi ïa u , bad ki la phai sha U Trai .
Lane , lada ki briew kin ïathuh ïa nongïapeiñ jar ‘ Ha khmih , u don ha ka Kir eitnar !’ — wat leit lushia jingbang lane lada ki ong , ‘ Ha kit , u rieh hangne !’ — Sophar ngeit ïa Aram .
translation.en: Wherefore if they shall say unto you , Behold , he is in the desert  ; go not forth : behold , he is in the secret chambers  ; believe it not .

And thou shalt consume all the people which the  Lord  thy God shall deliver thee  ; thine eye shall have no pity upon them : neither shalt thou serve their gods  ; for that will be a snare unto thee .
translation.kha: Pynjot ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew kat ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u aiti ha phi , bad wat sngewsynei ïa ki . Wat mane ïa ki blei jong ki , namar kata kan long ka jingma ïa me .

translation.en: They shall bear thee up in their hands , lest thou dash thy foot against a stone .
translation.kha: Kin rah ïa me ha ki kti jong ki , ban ri ïa me na ka jingjynthut jong ki kjat jong me ha ki maw .

translation.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies , that I might destroy them that hate me .
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong nga ban phet krad na nga ; nga pynjot ïa kito kiba shun ïa nga .

translation.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it  ; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel s , the same shall save it .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba kwah ban pynim ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; hynrei uno uno u ban duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Gospel un pynim ïa ka .

translation.en: I say , sayest thou , ( but they are but vain words ) I have counsel and strength for war : now on whom dost thou trust , that thou rebellest against me ?
translation.kha: U la dawa  Hato phi tharai ba ki ktien ki lah ban shim ïa ka jaka jong ka jingtbit bad ka borbah ki shipai ? Mano phi tharai u ban ïarap ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Assyria ?

translation.en: And David assembled all the princes of Israel , the princes of the tribes , and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course , and the captains over the thousands , and captains over the hundreds , and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king , and of his sons , with the officers , and with the mighty men , and with all the valiant men , unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar jong ki Israel ban ïalumlang ha Jerusalem . Kumta baroh ki rangbah synshar jong ki jait , ki rangbah synshar kiba pynïaid ïa ka kam jong ka Hima , ki nongïalam jong ki kur , ki nongpeit ïa ki jingdon jingem bad ki jingri kiba dei jong u syiem bad ki khun shynrang jong u — Shisha ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem , ki shipai kiba lamkhmat , bad ki rangbah badonkam — ki la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: By stretching forth thine hand to heal  ; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus .
translation.kha: To kner ïa la ka kti ban pynkhiah , bad ai ba ki kamphylla bad ki kambah yn leh ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu u Shakri bakhuid jong me .
Bad haba uno uno u shakri ïa U Khrist ha kane ka rukom , u pynsngewbha ïa U Blei bad la pdiang kiwei da pat .
translation.en: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God , and approved of men .

translation.kha: Naba nga la ïohpdiang Jonah U Trai Barakel ka shnat kaba nga pashat ai pateng ha phi : Ba U Trai Jeshua pynsngew ha kata ka miet ha kaba la shetkylla kim u , u pynsep-ei shim ïa u kpu , u la ainguh ïa U jingbeiñ , u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la ong , Une u Pukri ka napdeng lieh nga , na ka bynta jong phi . To leh ïa kane ban kynmaw ïa nga .
translation.en: And when he had given thanks , he brake it , and said ,  Take , eat : this is my body , which is broken for you : this do in remembrance of me .
Then said they unto him , Tell us , we pray thee , for whose cause this evil is upon us  ; What is thine occupation ? and whence comest thou ? what is thy country ? and of what people art thou ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ong ïa u :  Mynta te , ïathuh ïa ngi ! Mano uba long ka daw na ka bynta kane ? Me leh aïu hangne ? Me wan na kano ka ri ? Kaei ka jinglong traishnong jong me ?
kynmaw ïa U Jisu Khrist , la na ka jingïap , uba la hiarpateng u Dabid , kumba hikai ha ka Khubor Babha kaba nga ïalap .
translation.en: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel :
When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer ,
translation.kha: U Toi u syiem Hamath u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u la jop ïa baroh ka kynhun ïapom jong u Hadadeser .
Ka dei ka durkhmat jong phi hi kaba phalang ha ka um bad dei ka ka jong malade phi hi kaba phi ïohi ha ka dohnud jong phi .
translation.en: As in water face answereth to face , so the heart of man to man .
Behold , my servant shall deal prudently , he shall be exalted and extolled , and be very high .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  U shakri jong nga un jop ha ka kam jong u ; un ïoh ka burom bakhraw .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , See , I have made thee a god to Pharaoh : and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan pynlong ïa me kum U Blei ha u Pharaoh , bad u Aaron u hynmen jong me un kren ha u kum u nongïathuhlypa jong me .
Nangta ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ïakynduh lang ha ïing paki dulan jong u Kaïaphas , u Rangbah Lyngdoh ,
translation.en: Then assembled together the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders of the people , unto the palace of the high priest , who was called Caiaphas ,

translation.kha: Shisien shisnem , u Aaron un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka duwan da jinglyngngoh buh Sukkoth ki pyllait jong ka ïashetkylla Adah tylli ïa ka syrwiang Rebekka ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . Dei ban leh ïa kane man ka snem ha ki 37 baroh ki ban wan . Kane ka duwan jingpynbor ioh ban long kaba khuid , kaba la pynkyntang sha nga , U Trai .
translation.en: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements : once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations : it is most holy unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem jingpunkhun khyllah jingpynjot ong ha u mynkata , Khie leit sha ïasam Khlem spel kulai bad bud mar jan ïa kitkhia .
translation.en: Then the Spirit said unto Philip , Go near , and join thyself to this chariot .
O righteous Father , the world hath not known thee : but I have known thee , and these have known that thou hast sent me .
translation.kha: Ko Pa Bahok ! Ka pyrthei kam ithuh ïa me , hynrei nga ithuh ïa me , bad kine ki tip ba me la phah ïa nga .

Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai thup khatwei , ha ka snem kaba sawphew hadien ba ki tohjaw mih na kop , u Moses u ïathuh ha u paidbah ïa kaei kaei jingmihsnam kaba U Trai u la hukum ïa u pyndik ong ha ki ,
translation.en: And it came to pass in the fortieth year , in the eleventh month , on the first day of the month , that Moses spake unto the children of Israel , according unto all that the  Lord  had given him in commandment unto them  ;

translation.kha: Naba ujuh uba Tob ong , Wat klim , u la thala ruh , kyntoit pynïap . Wat lada phim shym klim , Dor la long nongpynkheiñ hukum lada bathoiñ pynïap briew .
translation.en: For he that said , Do not commit adultery , said also , Do not kill . Now if thou commit no adultery , yet if thou kill , thou art become a transgressor of the law .

translation.kha: Balei te ba mem kohnguh hukum ? Balei ba me la ïa kane ka kam bymman la pynlong ïa u Uriah ban pynïap ha ka thma ; me la shah Ammon pynïap ïa u , bad nangta me shim ïa ka tnga jong u !
translation.en: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the  Lord  , to do evil in his sight ? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword , and hast taken his wife to be thy wife , and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: Ki la jubab , Bah , ngi la ïa leh ka namar ngi la tip shisha U ba Trai U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa u Moses u shakri jong u ai ban ha phi ïa ka ri baroh kawei , bad ban pynïap ïa ki briew baroh shong kiba ha ka katba phi nang ïaid khmat sha . Ngi la leh ïa ka namar ngi ba la sngewsheptieng ïa phi ; ngi don ha ka jingsyier ïa la ka jingim .
translation.en: And they answered Joshua , and said , Because it was certainly told thy servants , how that the  Lord  thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land , and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you , therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you , and have done this thing .
And Moses took the breast , and waved it for a wave offering before the  Lord  : for of the ram of consecration it was Moses  part  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u shim ïa ka shadem bad u ai ïa ka kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang ha U  Trai . Kata ka long ka bynta jong u Moses na u langbrot ka jingpynkyntang . U Moses u la leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered , and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen , then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Ngan wallam pat ïa ki paid Israel na ki jaitbynriew kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin tip ba nga long uba khuid . Ki paid Israel kin im ha la ka ri , ka ri kaba nga la ai ha u shakri jong nga u Jakob .

translation.en: If it do evil in my sight , that it obey not my voice , then I will repent of the good , wherewith I said I would benefit them .
translation.kha: hynrei hadien , kata ka jaitbynriew kam kohnguh ïa nga bad ka leh ïa kaba sniew , ngan ym leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh .

kew U syiem ka ri Ijipt u tur ïaleh ïa ka Geser riewpawkhmat u la ïohknieh ïa ka , u la pynïap jingiphuh jingthoh traishnong hangta habar u la thang ïa ka . Nangta Timnath ïohmap ai Amasaïah ka ha ka khun manla u kum ka jingïoh bynta uwei ka ha ka por ba Hib shongkurim ïa u Solomon , Messaïah Hophni Solomon u tei thymmai Elishama ka . )
translation.en: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up , and taken Gezer , and burnt it with fire , and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city , and given it for a present unto his daughter , Solomon s wife .
And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  , as did David his father .
translation.kha: U Asa u leh ïa kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , kumba u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u , u la leh .

translation.en: So Abijah slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David : and Asa his son reigned in his stead . In his days the land was quiet ten years .
translation.kha: U syiem Abijah u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid . U Asa u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u , bad hapoh ka jingsynshar u Asa ka ri ka mad ïa ka jingsuk haduh shiphew snem .

translation.en: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada  ; which went out , and fell upon him , that he died . And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ai hukum ha u Benaïah , uba la mih shabar bad pynïap ïa u Shimei . U Solomon mynta u la ïoh ka jingsynshar kaba pura .
U Trai u ïathuh aïu ha phi ? u Eli u kylli . Wat buhrieh ei ei na nga . U Blei jur un pynshitom ïa phi lada ïathuh phim lut ha nga kat ïa kaba u la ong .
translation.en: And he said , What is the thing that the  Lord  hath said unto thee ? I pray thee hide it not from me : God do so to thee , and more also , if thou hide any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don u briew uba kyrteng u na ka shnong Sorah . U dei na jait . Ka tnga jong u pat shym la lah ban ïoh khun
translation.en: And there was a certain man of Zorah , of the family of the Danites , whose name was Manoah  ; and his wife was barren , and bare not .
And in the place of the boil there be a white rising , or a bright spot , white , and somewhat reddish , and it be shewed to the priest  ;
translation.kha: bad lada hadien , ha kata ka jaka ba mih u tohjaw , ka don ka jingat kaba lieh ne ka dak kaba byrsaw-lieh , u dei ban leit pyn-i ha u lyngdoh .

translation.en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation ,
translation.kha: Da la ki jong ki khmat nga la ïohi ïa ka jingpynim jong me ,
Lada ngi , ka long na ka bynta U Trai ngi , bad ïap , long ka bynta ba ngi . lada ngi im lane ngi ïap , ngi long ki jong Trai .
translation.en: For whether we live , we live unto the Lord ; and whether we die , we die unto the Lord : whether we live therefore , or die , we are the Lord s .

The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished , O daughter of Zion  ; he will no more carry thee away into captivity : he will visit thine iniquity , O daughter of Edom  ; he will discover thy sins .
translation.kha: Ka Seïon ka la siew na ka bynta ka pop jong ka ; U  Trai  un ym buh shuh ïa ngi ha ka jingshah ringmraw . Hynrei ko Edom , U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa pha ; un pynpaw ïa ki kam bymman jong pha .

Wat la nga la thang ïa ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , pynban ha pynpyiar jaka kiba jngai pynmih-pat kin kynmaw ïa nga . Ma ki bad pynjulor khun jong ki kin lait kheiñlang thymmai kin Kedesh phai lang sha ïing Apelles
translation.en: And I will sow them among the people : and they shall remember me in far countries  ; and they shall live with their children , and turn again .

translation.kha: ki ki sla khlem don shipawa ei ban tap nalor jong ki , bakhlaiñ don ei ei pyntha ïada na ka jingkhriat .
translation.en: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing , that they have no covering in the cold .

translation.kha: U Isaak u phah noh ïa u Jakob sha Mesopotamia , sha u Laban , uba u long khun jong u Bethuel u Aram , nong bad u hynmen jong ka Rebekka , ka kmie jong Jakob bad u Iso .
translation.en: And Isaac sent away Jacob : and he went to Paddan–aram unto Laban , son of Bethuel the Syrian , the brother of Rebekah , Jacob s and Esau s mother .
