translation.kha: Ka jingkhublei ïa u Ruphos , ba u la jied ia U Trai , bad ïa ka kmie jong u , bad jongnga .

translation.en: And he stood between the dead and the living  ; and the plague was stayed .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynsangeh ïa ka khlam bad u la shu ïeng hapdeng kiba im bad kiba ïap .

Men bakla ïohsngew aïu ki ïakren , bad nangta men ïoh ka jingshlur ban Aristarkhos ïaleh . Kumta u jylla bad u Purah u shakri jong u ki leit pyndum sha shaduh markhap jong ka jaka sher Rephah jong hun nongshun .
translation.en: And thou shalt hear what they say  ; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host . Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host .

translation.kha: U Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa u Tattenai Gibeah ka jingrwai pangnud ïa u syiem Josaïah . Ka Khmih ka rukom ha Israel na ka bynta ki nongrwai , kynthei bad shynrang , wanlam rwai ïa kane ka phangpdeng haba ki ïambriew namar jong u . La shem Ehud kane ka jingrwai ha ki jingrwai pangnud ba hati jingpyrkhat .
translation.en: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah : and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day , and made them an ordinance in Israel : and , behold , they are written in the lamentations .

translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong mihngi ka long bad ki nongai hukum jong ki Israel Emek Lem bad u paidbah uba tyrwa khanatang sngewbha da kaba kmen . Ïaroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: My heart is toward the governors of Israel , that offered themselves willingly among the people . Bless ye the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Jisu la mihnoh nangta bad u la leit narud Galilaïa . U kiew ïa lumrit bad u la shong .
translation.en: And Jesus departed from thence , and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee  ; and went up into a mountain , and sat down there .

And ye said , Behold , the  Lord  our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness , and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire : we have seen this day that God doth talk with man , and he liveth .
translation.kha: bad ki ïa-ong , ‘ U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la pynpaw ha ngi ïa ka jingkhraw bad ka burom jong u haba ngi ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren napdeng ka ding ! Mynta ka sngi ngi la ïohi ba u briew u dang lah hi ban im , wat la U Blei u la kren ha u .

translation.en: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day : wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day .
translation.kha: Kumta u Akhish u ai ha u ïa ka shnong Siklag , bad na kane ka daw ka Siklag ka long noh ka jong ki syiem Judah naduh kata ka por .

translation.en: ( As it is written , I have made thee a father of many nations , ) before him whom he believed , even God , who quickeneth the dead , and calleth those things which be not as though they were .
translation.kha: kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Nga la pynlong ïa me u kpa jong ki jaitbynriew babun .  Kumta ka jingkular ka long kaba bha ha khmat U Blei , ha uba u Abraham u la ngeit — U Blei uba wallam ïa kiba la ïap sha ka jingim bad uba ka hukum jong u ka pynlong ïa kaei ka bym shym la don .
Baroh ka long kaba khuid ha kito kiba long kiba khuid ha lade ; hynrei ym don kaba khuid ha kito kiba la bad , namar ba ki jingmut bad ki jingïatiplem jong ki long ba la pyntngit .
translation.en: Unto the pure all things are pure : but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure ; but even their mind and conscience is defiled .
For Herod feared John , knowing that he was a just man and an holy , and observed him  ; and when he heard him , he did many things , and heard him gladly .
translation.kha: U Herod u la sheptieng ïa u Ïoannis namar u la tip ba u Ïoannis u long u briew uba bha bad uba khuid , bad kumta u ju da ïa u . U ju sngewbha ban sngap ïa u , wat la u shitom jingmut shikatdei eh man ka por ba u ïohsngew ïa u .

translation.en: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him ? he that reproveth God , let him answer it .
translation.kha: Ko Job , me la kob ïa U Blei Badonbor Baroh ; hato men sangeh noh mynta , ne men jubab ?
U Trai un iehnoh ïa namar ba u la leh pop bad la ïalam ïa ki paid leh pop .
translation.en: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam , who did sin , and who made Israel to sin .

translation.kha: kumta u khot ïa ki ken baroh , ki tymmen ki san , jingïap une , pnah nongbishar , bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u paidbah , kyntiew u ong , Nga la tymmen Rumah lang Musri
translation.en: And Joshua called for all Israel , and for their elders , and for their heads , and for their judges , and for their officers , and said unto them , I am old and stricken in age :
And Moses took the blood , and sprinkled it on the people , and said , Behold the blood of the covenant , which the  Lord  hath made with you concerning all these words .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u shim ïa kata ka snam na ki dabor bad u synreit ïa ka ha uta u paidbah . U ong ,  Kane ka long ka snam kaba pynskhem ïa ka jutang kaba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad phi , mynba u ai ïa kine ki hukum baroh .
Ha ka snem khlup saw ba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka sngi kaba saw jong shiteng bangeit uba jingkordor ( jingailad bnai Kisleb ) , U Trai u la ai ka khubor ha nga kamar-tama
translation.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius , that the word of the  Lord  came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month , even in Chisleu  ;

translation.kha: Ngan ïa pynlong ki ban siew ar shah na ka bynta ki pop bad ka jingbymman jong ki , namar ki la pyntngit ïa ka jong ri nga da bleithaw ki ki bym don jingim kum ki metïap , bad ki la pyndap ïa ka da ki blei thala jong ki .
translation.en: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double  ; because they have defiled my land , they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things .

translation.kha: ïashang jingkheit dei ka sngi jong ka jingjop Hosah U Trai ; to ngin ïakmen , Dalmanutha ngin ïalehkmen !
translation.en: This is the day which the  Lord  hath made  ; we will rejoice and be glad in it .
And I have consumed them , and wounded them , that they could not arise : yea , they are fallen under my feet .
translation.kha: Nga shoh pynkyllon ïa ki , bad kim lah khie shuh ki thiah ha ka jingshahjop ha khmat jong nga .
Don kaei sa kaei kawei pat kaba nga la ïohi , ka nuksa kaba bha shaphang kumno ïa ka jingstad la ñiew ha kane ka . pyrthei
translation.en: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun , and it seemed great unto me :

translation.kha: U syiem Ijipt ha la ka jingbitar un leit sha ka kadlieng pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Syria bad jingkhangïit ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhraw jong u .
translation.en: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler , and shall come forth and fight with him , even with the king of the north : and he shall set forth a great multitude  ; but the multitude shall be given into his hand .

translation.kha: khapbrip kiba lait im jingïamai ïap ha ka jingpang , bad wat ki tnga jong ïitbniah kyrpang ym ïam na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki .
translation.en: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death : and his widows shall not weep .
And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly ; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba ai ha ngi ka jingsuk un pynlong ïa phi kiba khuid ha ki liang baroh bad un sumar ïa ka longrynïeng jong phi — ka mynsiem , ka jingim , bad ka met — kaba lait na kano kano ka jingbakla ha ka jingwan jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: If not , hearken unto me : hold thy peace , and I shall teach thee wisdom .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kam long kumta , to long jar jar bad shahshkor ïa nga , bad ngan hikai ïa phi kumno ba phi long uba stad .

translation.en: And these things give in charge , that they may be blameless .
translation.kha: To ai ha ki ïa kine ki jinghikai , khnang ba yn ym don ba wad daw ïa ki .

jingpynphai Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u jingkah , Phi hi da lade phi la ïohi ïa ka jingpynjot kaba nga la wanrah ha Jerusalem bad ha baroh kiwei ki nongbah ka jingotsher . Wat maïan ki dang sah ha ki jingjot , bad ym pynphong bynrap sah khlieh ki namar ki jingïakhih jong ki , ki la leh ïa kaba sniew bad ki la pynlong ïa nga ban bitar . Ki jingpynithuh jingkñia ha kiwei pat ki blei bad shakri ïa ki blei kiba ma ki hun ma phi ne ki bymlah tymmen jong phi kim ju mane .
translation.en: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger , in that they went to burn incense , and to serve other gods , whom they knew not , neither they , ye , nor your fathers .

And they shall hearken to thy voice : and thou shalt come , thou and the elders of Israel , unto the king of Egypt , and ye shall say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath met with us : and now let us go , we beseech thee , three days  journey into the wilderness , that we may sacrifice to the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga kin shahshkor ïa kaei kaba me ong ha ki . Nangta me dei ban leit bad ki nongïalam jong ki Israel sha u Pharaoh bad ong ha u , ‘ U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u la pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi . Mynta shah ïa ngi ban leit lai sngi lynti sha ka ri shyiap ban ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi .’
Joab u jubab , To U Trai un pynroi bun ïa ki paid Israel shispah shah ban ïa ki long mynta ! Syiem Kynrad baroh ki dei ki shakri phi . Balei phi kwah ban ïa bad pynkit pop ïa ka jaitbynriew baroh ?
translation.en: And Joab answered , The  Lord  make his people an hundred times so many more as they be : but , my lord the king , are they not all my lord s servants ? why then doth my lord require this thing ? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel ?
And when he came to him , behold , he stood by his burnt offering , and the princes of Moab with him . And Balak said unto him , What hath the  Lord  spoken ?
translation.kha: Kumta u la leit phai pat bad u la lap ïa u Balak ba u dang ïeng harud ka jingainguh thang jong u lem bad ki nongïalam ka Moab . U Balak u la kylli aïu U  Trai  u la ong ,
Haba ka la mynsngi , ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïashem lang , U Jisu wallam ha khmat ka
translation.en: And as soon as it was day , the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together , and led him into their council , saying ,

translation.kha: bapynjot Solomon u ïakhana kamet ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki nong Kanaan Kdew bym shym la shah pynïap ha ki Israel Markos ki knieh ïa ka ri jong Khisloth . Kine ïakajia kynthup ïa ki Amor , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Hib Nahor bad ki jlew , kiba ki khun ki ksiew mynnin ki , (sa dang long ki mraw haduh kane ka pynïapher .
translation.en: Their children that were left after them in the land , whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy , upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day .

translation.kha: Bad U Khrist hi u long ka lynti kaba yn ïohmap ïa ki pop jong ngi , bad ym tang ki jong ngi , hynrei ïa ki jong ki briew baroh .
translation.en: And he is the propitiation for our sins : and not for ours only , but also for the sins of the whole world .
And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel : and the people mourned greatly .
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la ïathuh ha ki Israel ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kren , ki ïamkthang .
Haba ki briew ki ong , kaei baroh ka jar jar bad ka shngain , te kynsan jingpynjot kan lynshop ki! Kan wan kyndit kum ki jingpang kiba wan ha ka briew kaba , briew kin ym lait phet .
translation.en: For when they shall say , Peace and safety ; then sudden destruction cometh upon them , as travail upon a woman with child ; and they shall not escape .
And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus , saying , Art thou he that should come ? or look we for another ?
translation.kha: bad u la phah ïa ki sha U Trai ban kylli ïa u ,  Hato me long uta uba u Ïoannis u la ong u ban sa wan , ne hato ngin khmih lynti ïa uwei pat ?

translation.en: Then saith he to Thomas ,  Reach hither thy finger , and behold my hands  ; and reach hither thy hand , and thrust it into my side : and be not faithless , but believing .
translation.kha: Te u la ong ha u Thomas ,  Buh ïa ka shynriah ti jong me hangne , bad peit ïa ki kti jong nga ; nangta kner ïa la ka kti bad buh ïa ka ha ka krung jong nga . Wat artatien shuh bad to ngeit !
Ym dei u angel , hynrei dei U Trai hi uba pyllait im ïa ki . Ha ka jingieit bad ka jingisynei pop! u pha u la pyllait ïa ki . U bajrong’ ju sumar ïa ki borabor ha Pharaoh por kiba mynshuwa kiwei
translation.en: In all their affliction he was afflicted , and the angel of his presence saved them : in his love and in his pity he redeemed them  ; and he bare them , and carried them all the days of old .

translation.kha: paidbah U u jubab , Da lei lei ngin ym iehnoh ïa U Trai ban shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei !
translation.en: And the people answered and said , God forbid that we should forsake the  Lord  , to serve other gods  ;
He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country : there shalt thou die , and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord s house .
translation.kha: Un shim ïa me kum ïa ka bol bad un kynting sha ka ri kaba kham khraw . Men ïap hangta hajan ki kali ïapom kiba me , me la sngewsarong . Me long ka jingjahburom ïa ka longïing jong u kynrad jong me .

translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee , and was baptized of John in Jordan .
translation.kha: Ym slem hadien , U Jisu u la wan na Nasareth kaba ha ka probins jong ka Galilaïa , bad la pynbaptis da u Ïoannis ha ka wah Jordan .
Napdeng jong ki , bymdonbor wan ki nongsynshar Bethbarah ki pynbaptis , bad ki rangbah ai hukum ki ban Shemuel ïa ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: Out of him came forth the corner , out of him the nail , out of him the battle bow , out of him every oppressor together .

translation.kha: jingsngewsih ka kham bha ban ka jingrkhie ; ka lah ban pynsngewsih ïa ka durkhmat jong phi , hynrei ka pynnep ïa ka jong phi .
translation.en: Sorrow is better than laughter : for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better .
The chariots shall rage in the streets , they shall justle one against another in the broad ways : they shall seem like torches , they shall run like the lightnings .
translation.kha: Ki kali ïapom ki tyngkhuh kulmar ha ki lynti bah , da kaba mareh shane shatai lyngba ki jaka paidbah ka nongbah . Ki thaba kum ki dongmusa bad ki stet kum ka leilieh .

translation.en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling , and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees .
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u jynthut , u tlot bad u lwait , ki ktien jong me ki kyrshan ïa u ban ïeng .

translation.en: Then came Jesus forth , wearing the crown of thorns , and the purple robe . And Pilate saith unto them , Behold the man !
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la mih shabar , da kaba phong ïa ka pansngiat shiah bad kup da ka jaiñkup kaba sawbthuh . U Pilat u la ong ha ki ,  Khmih ! hangne uta u briew !

Hadien kata , u la leit shaphang shathie sha ka ri lum ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Bethel u bad la pynïeng ïa ka dara hapdeng ka Bethel shaphang sepngi bad ka Ai shaphang mihngi . Hangta ruh u la tei ïa ka duwan bad la u mane ïa U . Trai
translation.en: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth–el , and pitched his tent , having Beth–el on the west , and Ai on the east : and there he builded an altar unto the  Lord  , and called upon the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha Ijipt ngi ju ïabam ki dohkha baroh kiba ngi kwah , bad ngim siew Rhesa ei . Kynmaw ïa ki sohkhia soskular ki pathaw bam-im , ki Namar , ki Abilene , bad ki rynsun ba ngi ju ïoh ban bam ?
translation.en: We remember the fish , which we did eat in Egypt freely  ; the cucumbers , and the melons , and the leeks , and the onions , and the garlick :
Believe me that I am in the Father , and the Father in me : or else believe me for the very works  sake .
translation.kha: To ngeit ïa nga haba nga ong ba nga long ha U Kpa bad U Kpa u long ha nga . Lymda kumta , to ngeit namar kiei kiei kiba nga leh .

translation.en: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice , saying ,  Eloi , Eloi , lama sabachthani ?  which is , being interpreted ,  My God , my God , why hast thou forsaken me ?
translation.kha: Ha ka por lai baje U Jisu u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ,   Eloi , Eloi , lema sabakhthani ?   kaba mut ,  A Blei jong nga , A Blei jong nga , balei ba me iehnoh ïa nga ?

jingpyntngen Ber Solomon u ai ïa ka bitar jong ka Sheba kat ïa kaba ka pan pyndiaw Uphas ïapkhlam paro nalor kaei jingbitar u la ai markylliang ha ka Hakhlieh ka bynta ki jingai sngewbha nongtrei” ka la wanrah ïa u . Nangta ma ka bad kino nongbud jong ka ki la leit phai sha ka nongwan Sheba .
translation.en: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked , beside that which she had brought unto the king . So she turned , and went away to her own land , she and her servants .
Ye who turn judgment to wormwood , and leave off righteousness in the earth ,
translation.kha: Phi long kiba la tim , phi kiba pynkyllaiñ ïa ka jingbishar hok bad kiba shukor ïa ki briew ban pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki !

U long kum briew uba , ha kaba tei ïa la ka , tih jylliew bad u la pynshong nongrim u mawsiang . Ka wah ka la bad ka la lynshop kata ka ïing hynrei kam lah ban pynkhih ïa ka , namar la shna bha ïa ka .
translation.en: He is like a man which built an house , and digged deep , and laid the foundation on a rock : and when the flood arose , the stream beat vehemently upon that house , and could not shake it : for it was founded upon a rock .

But now thy kingdom shall not continue : the  Lord  hath sought him a man after his own heart , and the  Lord  hath commanded him to be captain over his people , because thou hast not kept that which the  Lord  commanded thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ka jingsynshar jong phi kan ym bteng . Namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa u , U  Trai  un wad ïa u briew uba u kwah bad un thung ïa u ban long nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong u .

Ma nga , U Trai , U Blei ki Israel nga , maham ïa phi ban ym shah ïa lade ban shah shukor ha ki nongïathuhlypa kiba im hapdeng jong phi lane da kino kino kiwei pat kiba ba kam ki lah ban ïathuh lypa ka ïa lawei . ym Wat pynleit jingmut satia ïa ki jingphohsniew jong ki .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Let not your prophets and your diviners , that be in the midst of you , deceive you , neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed .

translation.kha: ‘ Wat lamler sakhi ïano ïano .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour .
How shall we escape , if we neglect so great salvation  ; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord , and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him  ;
translation.kha: Da kumno te ngin lait , lada ngi leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingpynim kaba khraw katta katta ? U Trai hi u la pynbna nyngkong ïa kane ka jingpynim , bad kita kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki pynshisha ha ngi ba ka long kaba shisha .
Ka la jia sa kawei pat ka Ethkasin ha kata ka ri , nalor kata kaba la jia ha ki sngi u Abraham . U Isaak u la bla sha u Abimelekh u bieit jong ki kitkhlieh , ha Gerar .
translation.en: And there was a famine in the land , beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham . And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar .

translation.kha: Ki la leit ban ïeng ha khmat u Moses , u lyngdoh ki , bad u paid baroh ha ka jaka rung sha ka Jingdon Ryngkat Trai , bad ki ,
translation.en: And they stood before Moses , and before Eleazar the priest , and before the princes and all the congregation , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , saying ,

translation.kha: Ïa kine kiei kiei jingpyndonburom ban sngewthuh ka-por kum ka jingringdur : Ki ar ngut ki dala ki jingmeng ïa Ïada ar tylli ki jutang ; kawei ïa kaba ki khun la kha ha shongkai jinglongmraw Nabynta long ka Hagar , bad ka ïeng na ka bynta ka jutang ba la pynlong jingpynkheiñ u lum Sinai .
translation.en: Which things are an allegory : for these are the two covenants ; the one from the mount Sinai , which gendereth to bondage , which is Agar .

translation.kha: don mano ha Israel uba pawnam ha jingbhabriew kat u Absalom um kano ka jingduna naduh khlieh haduh sla jat
translation.en: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty : from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him .
He saved others  ; himself he cannot save . If he be the King of Israel , let him now come down from the cross , and we will believe him .
translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa kiwei , hynrei um lah ban pynim ïa lade ! Hato um dei une u syiem ka Israel ? Lada u la hiar noh mynta na ka diengphna , ngin ngeit ha u !

translation.en: And David said unto Saul , Thy servant kept his father s sheep , and there came a lion , and a bear , and took a lamb out of the flock :
translation.kha: Syiem Kynrad ,  u Dabid u ong ,  Nga la ju sharai ïa ki langbrot i pa jong nga . Man ba u sing lane ka dngiem ki wan rong ïa u khunlangbrot ,

translation.en: And the four beasts said , Amen . And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ki la jubab ,  Amen !  Bad ki nongsharai balang ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane .
Katba phi nang bunktien katta , phi nang leh pop . Lada phi long uba stad phin sngap jar .
translation.en: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin : but he that refraineth his lips is wise .

I prayed therefore unto the  Lord  , and said , O Lord  God  , destroy not thy people and thine inheritance , which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness , which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand .
translation.kha: Bad nga la duwai , ‘ A  Trai  Nongsynshar , wat pynjot ïa la ki briew , ki briew kiba me la pyllait bad ïalam na Ijipt da ka jingkhlaiñ bad ka borbah jong me .
Naba ki ba bun phi ba la pynbaptis U Khrist , bad la pynkup ïa da U Khrist hi .
translation.en: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ .

translation.kha: U Trai u long uba khlaiñbor ha Seïon ; U long uba tam hakhlieh halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translation.en: The  Lord  is great in Zion  ; and he is high above all the people .

translation.kha: ka kaba ba u Belshassar u long syiem nga la ïohi ïa jingïohipaw kaba ar .
translation.en: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me , even unto me Daniel , after that which appeared unto me at the first .
And David s anger was greatly kindled against the man  ; and he said to Nathan , As the  Lord  liveth , the man that hath done this thing shall surely die :
translation.kha: U Dabid u bitar lep ïa u riewspah bad u ong ,  Nga smai ha U  Trai  uba im ba u briew uba la leh ïa kane u dei ban ïap !

translation.en: And Cain said unto the  Lord  , My punishment is greater than I can bear .
translation.kha: Bad u Kain u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Kane ka jingpynshitom ka long palat ïa kaba nga lah ban shah .

translation.en: If he will contend with him , he cannot answer him one of a thousand .
translation.kha: Da kumno uno uno u lah ban ïasaid bad u ? U lah ban kylli shihajar tylli ki jingkylli , ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban jubab .
Ka dei ka jingieit keiñ , ba phi dei ban ïabeh . To ba dohnud kan hir hir ïa jingai ba kynja mynsiem , khamtam ïa jingai ban pynbna ïa ka U Blei .
translation.en: Follow after charity , and desire spiritual gifts , but rather that ye may prophesy .

translation.en: And she said , Truth , Lord : yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters  table .

translation.en: When the wicked are multiplied , transgression increaseth : but the righteous shall see their fall .

translation.en: And he departed thence , and entered into a certain man s house , named Justus , one that worshipped God , whose house joined hard to the synagogue .

translation.en: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living , and kept close from the fowls of the air .

translation.en: And he taught , saying unto them ,  Is it not written , My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer ? but ye have made it a den of thieves .

And whosoever will not do the law of thy God , and the law of the king , let judgment be executed speedily upon him , whether it be unto death , or to banishment , or to confiscation of goods , or to imprisonment .

translation.en: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites , out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol , six hundred men appointed with weapons of war .

translation.kha: Korban’ la thoh lai hajar tylli ki proberb jingiap palat hajar tylli ki jingrwai .
translation.en: And he spake three thousand proverbs : and his songs were a thousand and five .

translation.kha: Katba dang phi khmih ïa ka , u maw uba khraw u la na lait ka synrang khlem don mano mano ba ktah ïa u , u la shoh ïa ka kjat nar bad jong dewbyrtha ka durbriew , bad u la pynkhynñiuh ïa ki .
translation.en: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands , which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay , and brake them to pieces .

translation.en: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest , and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight , and have made thee a great name , like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth .
And the sons of Zilpah , Leah s handmaid  ; Gad , and Asher : these are the sons of Jacob , which were born to him in Paddan–aram .

Kynmaw ruh ïa ki jingtynjuh kiba shyrkhei kiba phi la ïohi , da ki bad ki kamphylla , da ka borbah ka ksang ti kaba la kner da U Trai U Blei jong phi u pyllait ïa phi , kumta ruh un pynjot ïa kita jaitbynriew baroh ïa kiba phi sheptieng .
translation.en: The great temptations which thine eyes saw , and the signs , and the wonders , and the mighty hand , and the stretched out arm , whereby the  Lord  thy God brought thee out : so shall the  Lord  thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid .

translation.kha: Kumta ka jingïalang ka phah khat-ar hajar ngut ki rangbah bashlur tam lem bad ka hukum , Khie leit bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei ha Jabesh , kaba kynthup ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .
translation.en: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest , and commanded them , saying , Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead with the edge of the sword , with the women and the children .

translation.en: They shall be carried to Babylon , and there shall they be until the day that I visit them , saith the  Lord   ; then will I bring them up , and restore them to this place .

translation.en: Now therefore , O our God , hear the prayer of thy servant , and his supplications , and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate , for the Lord s sake .

translation.en: And as it is appointed unto men once to die , but after this the judgment :

u Nangta shim ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap ar tylli bad u buh ïa ki hapoh ka Synduk ka Jutang . U bsuh ïa ki dieng jingbah ki ha kyrwoh jong ka kata synduk bad u buh ïa ka jingtap halor jong ka .

translation.en: And he smote the men of Beth–shemesh , because they had looked into the ark of the  Lord  , even he smote of the people fifty thousand and threescore and ten men : and the people lamented , because the  Lord  had smitten many of the people with a great slaughter .

They shall die of grievous deaths  ; they shall not be lamented  ; neither shall they be buried  ; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth : and they shall be consumed by the sword , and by famine  ; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven , and for the beasts of the earth .

translation.en: But the men were very good unto us , and we were not hurt , neither missed we any thing , as long as we were conversant with them , when we were in the fields :
I am he that liveth , and was dead  ; and , behold , I am alive for evermore , Amen  ; and have the keys of hell and of death .
translation.kha: Nga long uta uba im ! Nga la ïap , hynrei mynta nga im junom la junom . Nga don ka bor halor ka jingïap bad ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: Therefore is the anger of the  Lord  kindled against his people , and he hath stretched forth his hand against them , and hath smitten them : and the hills did tremble , and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets . translation.en: For what man knoweth the things of a man , save the spirit of man which is in him ? even so the things of God knoweth no man , but the Spirit of God .

translation.en: And I scattered them among the heathen , and they were dispersed through the countries : according to their way and according to their doings I judged them .

translation.en: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord , and to all that were in his house .

translation.en: If so be they will hearken , and turn every man from his evil way , that I may repent me of the evil , which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings .

translation.en: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not , and if he be pleased to dwell with her , let her not leave him .

translation.en: ( Hebrews 11 :4–12 :1 ) Just as an individual may bear witness in court in behalf of an innocent person , we are determined to make known the truth about our God .

translation.en: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos , they came to Perga in Pamphylia : and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord  ; and a fierce king shall rule over them , saith the Lord , the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.en: Both the great and the small shall die in this land : they shall not be buried , neither shall men lament for them , nor cut themselves , nor make themselves bald for them :

translation.en: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and disperse them among the countries  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Balaam , Go with the men : but only the word that I shall speak unto thee , that thou shalt speak . So Balaam went with the princes of Balak .

translation.kha: Ka jingbhabriew ha ka briew ka bym don ka jingshemphang ka long kum ka sati ksiar ha ka khmut u sniang .

translation.en: For it came to pass , when Solomon was old , that his wives turned away his heart after other gods : and his heart was not perfect with the  Lord  his God , as was the heart of David his father .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri , and his treason that he wrought , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.en: But Zerubbabel , and Jeshua , and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel , said unto them , Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God  ; but we ourselves together will build unto the  Lord  God of Israel , as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us .

translation.en: And the  Lord  gave Solomon wisdom , as he promised him : and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon  ; and they two made a league together .

translation.en: What should I do ?

translation.en: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread , and a bottle of wine , and a kid , and sent them by David his son unto Saul .

translation.en: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him , they said , The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha . And they came to meet him , and bowed themselves to the ground before him .

translation.kha: U Abijah bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki thom ïa ki Israel da ka jingjop kaba khraw — shiteng ki na shipai bakynsai ka Israel la ki shah pynïap .
translation.en: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter : so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men .
