translation.en: And when king David came to Bahurim , behold , thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul , whose name was Shimei , the son of Gera : he came forth , and cursed still as he came .
And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense .
translation.kha: U angel jong U Trai u la paw ha u , u da ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong ka duwan ha kaba la thang ïa ka jingiwbih .

translation.en: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian , Oreb and Zeeb : and what was I able to do in comparison of you ? Then their anger was abated toward him , when he had said that .
translation.kha: Nalor kata , da ka bor ka jong U Blei phi la pynïap ïa ki ar ngut ki khlieh synshar jong ki Midian , u Oreb bad u Seeb . Nga la leh aïu ban ïanujor bad kata ?  Haba u la kren ïa kane , kim shym la bitar shuh .
la wallam ïa ka kada bad ïa u khun kada , ki la siang ïa la ki jaiñkup halor jong ki , bad U Jisu u la kiew ban shong .
translation.en: And brought the ass , and the colt , and put on them their clothes , and they set him thereon .
So he consented to them in this matter , and proved them ten days .
translation.kha: U la mynjur ban shah ïa ki ban pyrshang ïa ka na ka bynta shiphew sngi .

translation.en: If ye then , being evil , know how to give good gifts unto your children : how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him ?
translation.kha: Kiba sniew kumba phi long , phi tip kumno ban ai kiei kiei kiba bha ïa ki khun jong phi . Katno tam , te , ba U Kpa ba ha bneng un ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha kito kiba pan na u !

translation.en: Again I will build thee , and thou shalt be built , O virgin of Israel : thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets , and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ngan tei ïa phi . Sa shisien pat phin shim ïa ki kanjari bad phin shad da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: And when the hour was come , he sat down , and the twelve apostles with him .
translation.kha: Haba ka kynta ka la poi , U Jisu u la shong ha la ka jaka ha ka miej lem bad ki apostol .
Hynrei ïa uwei pa uwei yn pynmihpat kat kum ka jingbuh ryntih : Ïa U Khrist nyngkong eh na baroh nangta ; ha ka jingwan jong u , sa ïa kito dei kiba ki jong u .
translation.en: But every man in his own order : Christ the firstfruits ; afterward they that are Christ s at his coming .

translation.kha: Ki ïa-ong , Mynta to ngin ïatei kawei ka nongbah kaba don u mot uba kot haduh sahit bneng , ba kumta , ngin ban lah nam thaw ïa lade bad ym ban ïasakma ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And they said , Go to , let us build us a city and a tower , whose top may reach unto heaven  ; and let us make us a name , lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth .
And a certain man saw it , and told Joab , and said , Behold , I saw Absalom hanged in an oak .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki rangbah jong u Dabid u la ïohi ïa u bad u la ïathuh ha u Joab ,  Kynrad , nga la ïohi ïa u Absalom ba u sdien ha u dieng Sning !
jakhlia ïa ka jingainguh bam da u purew ba la basyiad bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u purew jingpyndonkam bad u masi lyngraw , ar kilo nonglehbeiñ purew lem bad u ïarap ,
translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals to a bullock , and two tenth deals to one ram ,
And the land of the Giblites , and all Lebanon , toward the sunrising , from Baal–gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath .
translation.kha: ka ri jong ki Gebal , ka Lebanon baroh shaphang mihngi , naduh Baalgad , kaba don shaphang shathie jong u Lum Hermon , haduh ka Khim Hamath .

To sha U , phi ki briew kiba sngewrit , kiba kohnguh ïa hukum jong u . To leh ïa kaei kaba dei , bad to pynrit lade ha khmat U Trai . Lehse phin na ka jingpynshitom ha ka sngi haba U Trai u pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar jong u .
translation.en: Seek ye the  Lord  , all ye meek of the earth , which have wrought his judgment  ; seek righteousness , seek meekness : it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the  Lord s  anger .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban ïabam sad ïa ka , jinglakloi phi dei ban riam na ka bynta ban pynïohburom jingleit Lois lem bad ki juti ha ki kjat jong phi bad u diengduh ha ka kti harum phi . Ka dei ka bad Niam Ka Jinglait ban pyndonburom ïa kyrngah , U Trai .
translation.en: And thus shall ye eat it  ; with your loins girded , your shoes on your feet , and your staff in your hand  ; and ye shall eat it in haste : it is the  Lord s  passover .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses
Ym bit uno uno u uba don jingduna ka ban ai ïa kata jingkñia : kum uba matlah , uba dkoh uba la sniew ka , lane uba la thawsha ka met ;
translation.en: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish , he shall not approach : a blind man , or a lame , or he that hath a flat nose , or any thing superfluous ,

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ruh juk Mynsiem u wan ban ïarap ïa ngi mei ha ka jingtlot kaba ngi don . Naba ngim tip kumno ngi dei ban duwai ; U Mynsiem jinglongbriew da lade u ïasaid bad meng Reba na sngewkhia bynta jong ngi ha ki kopi kiba ki phler kim nga ban pynpaw pynpluh
translation.en: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities : for we know not what we should pray for as we ought : but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered .
For now I will stretch out my hand , that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence  ; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth .
translation.kha: Lada nga la rah ïa la ka kti bad shoh ïa me bad ki briew jong me da ka jingpang , phin jin da la ïap lut khoit .

translation.en: That be far from thee to do after this manner , to slay the righteous with the wicked : and that the righteous should be as the wicked , that be far from thee : Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right ?
translation.kha: Da shisha men ym pynïap ïa kiba hok ryngkat bad ki bymman . Kata ka bym lah ban long . Mem lah ban leh kumta . Lada me leh kumta , kiba hok kin shah pynshitom ryngkat bad ki bymman . Kata ka bym lah ban long . U nongbishar jong ka pyrthei baroh u dei ban lehhok .
Mar kumta hi , :12-14 Trai u pynhap ïa u kyndok ding ha ki nongbah jreiñ bad Gomorrah ,
translation.en: Then the  Lord  rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the  Lord  out of heaven  ;
And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle , the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys :
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki kynriah jaka tang lada uta u lyoh u kiew shajrong na kata ka Ïingjaiñ .
Ngam pat ju shaniah ka spah
translation.en: If I have made gold my hope , or have said to the fine gold , Thou art my confidence  ;

translation.kha: Un bat ïa ka jingïakut ba u la pynlong bad u ksuid-durblang bad ïa Khilmad kular jingkyrhuh u Isaak .
translation.en: Which covenant he made with Abraham , and his oath unto Isaac  ;
The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge , and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly .
translation.kha: Kin ym long shuh ki bymïaishah , hynrei kin trei ha ka jingshemphang bad kin ong ïa kaei kaba ki mut .

translation.en: Because they obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  their God , but transgressed his covenant , and all that Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded , and would not hear them , nor do them .
translation.kha: Ka Samaria ka kyllon noh namar ki Israel kim shym kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , hynrei ki pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad ki bad kim kohnguh ïa baroh ki aiñ ba la ai da u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai . Kim shahshkor bad kim kohnguh .
Lada nga ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingbam kynduh nga , balei ba uno uno “ba wohnia ïa nga na ka bynta jingialeh jingbam Leah kaba nga da ainguh lup
translation.en: For if I by grace be a partaker , why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ki kynmaw ki por mynshuwa , ïa ki sngi u Moses , u Trai bad ki kylli , Hangno mynta u don U Trai , uba im ïa ki nongïalam jong ki briew jong u na ka ? u don U Trai , uba ai ïa U Mynsiem jong u ha u Moses ?
translation.en: Then he remembered the days of old , Moses , and his people , saying , Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock ? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him ?
And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks , and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in , for my people that have sought me .
translation.kha: Kin mane ïa nga bad ïalam ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri jong ki sha ki jaka phlang ha ka Pyntha ka Sharon ha ka phang sepngi bad ha ka Them ka Jingshitom ha ka phang mihngi .

translation.en: For , brethren , ye have been called unto liberty ; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh , but by love serve one another .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong phi pat , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , la khot ïa phi ban long kiba laitluid . Hynrei wat shah ba kane ka jinglaitluid kan kylla long ka jingailad ïa ki jingkwah brai ka doh ban synshar ïa phi . Pynban , ai ba ka jingieit kan pynlong ïa phi ban ïashakri iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Moses and Aaron among his priests , and Samuel among them that call upon his name  ; they called upon the  Lord  , and he answered them .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la long ki lyngdoh jong u , bad u Samuel u la long uwei uba la duwai ha u ; kiba la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u la jubab ïa ki .

translation.en: And he went a little further , and fell on his face , and prayed , saying ,  O my Father , if it be possible , let this cup pass from me : nevertheless not as I will , but as thou wilt .
translation.kha: U la leit kham jngai sa katto katne , u la dem khrup ïa lade bad ka khmat sha khyndew , bad u la duwai ,  Ko Kpa jong nga , lada ka long kaba lah , to shim noh ïa kane ka khuri ka jingshah shitom na nga ! Pynban , ym ïa kaei kaba nga mon , hynrei ïa kaei kaba me mon .
Nangta u phai sawdong , u la ïohi ïa nga , bad la u khot ïa nga . Nga jubab , ‘ Ho-oid , Kynrad !’
translation.en: And when he looked behind him , he saw me , and called unto me . And I answered , Here am I .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada don ei ei kaba ha duna kita ki jingri , lada ki dkoh lane ki matlah , lane lada palat eh kano kano ka , jingduna phim dei ban kñia ïa ki ha U Trai U Blei phi jong .
translation.en: And if there be any blemish therein , as if it be lame , or blind , or have any ill blemish , thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the  Lord  thy God .
Of the gold , the silver , and the brass , and the iron , there is no number . Arise therefore , and be doing , and the  Lord  be with thee .
translation.kha: Mynta sdang noh ïa ka kam , bad to U  Trai  un long ryngkat bad me .

translation.en: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people , Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem , that in the night they may be a guard to us , and labour on the day .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka por nga ong ïa ki rangbah kiba khmih ïa ka kam , ba ma ki bad ki nongïarap jong ki , ki hap ban sah ha Jerusalem ha ka por mynmiet , khnang ba ngi lah ban ap phira ïa ka nongbah mynmiet bad kumjuh ruh ban trei ha ka por mynsngi .
Hynrei ngam shym la leh kumta , naba kata kan jin da la wallam ka jingjahburom jong hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba la ïa nga ïalam noh ïa Ijipt .
translation.en: But I wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted before the heathen , in whose sight I brought them out .
And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death , and have crucified him .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongsynshar jong ngi ki la aiti noh ïa u ban rai pynïap , bad ïa u la sahnarphna .

translation.en: I say again , Let no man think me a fool ; if otherwise , yet as a fool receive me , that I may boast myself a little .
translation.kha: Nga ong pat : wat ai ba uno uno un ñiew ïa nga uba bieit . Hynrei lada phi pyrkhat kumta , la kumno kumno to pdiang ïa nga kum uba bieit , khnang ba ngan don ei ei ban sngewsarong .
U Syiem jubab un , ‘ Nga ong ha phi , ha man ba phi kyntait ïarap ban ïa iwei na kine kiba rit tam , phi kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga .’
translation.en: Then shall he answer them , saying , Verily I say unto you , Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these , ye did it not to me .

Egypt , and Judah , and Edom , and the children of Ammon , and Moab , and all that are in the utmost corners , that dwell in the wilderness : for all these nations are uncircumcised , and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por ka wan haba ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew ka Ijipt , ka Judah , ka Edom , ka Ammon , ka Moab , bad ki briew ka ri shyiap , kiba la ot lyngkot ïa ki shñiuh jong ki . Kine ki briew baroh ki long kiba la otsher , hynrei ki bym shym la bat ïa ka jutang kaba ka thmu . Ym don mano mano na kine ki briew bad ym don mano mano na ki paid Israel kiba la bat ïa kane ka jutang jong nga .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles , and set up my standard to the people : and they shall bring thy sons in their arms , and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ha la ki briew :  Ngan pyn-i dak sha ki jaitbynriew , bad kin wallam ïa ki khun jong pha sha ïing .

translation.en: Is any among you afflicted ? let him pray . Is any merry ? let him sing psalms .
translation.kha: Hato don napdeng jong phi ba shem jynjar ? U dei ban duwai . Hato don uba kmen ? U dei ban rwai ïaroh .
U Jehoïada u buh mynhyndai ki nongap phira ha ka kam ha ki khyrdop jong ka Templ ban khang Ur uno uno u bymkhuid kat Ishbi —kata niam .
translation.en: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the  Lord  , that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in .
Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift .
translation.kha: To ngin ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingai jong u ka bym lah ban pynshongdor !
Hadien saw pyniasngew , u Absalom nard ong ha jinglehmeng syiem Dabid , Kynrad , shah ngan Joah sha Hebron ban pyndep ïa la sngewrem kular ba nga la ai ha U jingsangsot .
translation.en: And it came to pass after forty years , that Absalom said unto the king , I pray thee , let me go and pay my vow , which I have vowed unto the  Lord  , in Hebron .
Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers , into the hand of the Assyrians , upon whom she doted .
translation.kha: Te nga aiti ïa ka sha ki long leh-ieit jong ka , ki Assyria ïa kiba ka thrang palat .

translation.en: But God , who is rich in mercy , for his great love wherewith he loved us ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingisynei U Blei ka shlei katta katta , bad ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long kaba khraw katta katta ,

translation.en: And David , according to the saying of Gad , went up as the  Lord  commanded .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad u la leit kumba u Gad u la ïathuh ïa u .
Ki la bitar katta katta ïa nga bad ban shoh ïa nga bad ban set ïa nga ha ka ïing u Jonathan , u ka ïingbishar , kaba ïa ka ïing jong la pynlong ka byndi .
translation.en: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah , and smote him , and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe : for they had made that the prison .
And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark , to bear the ark .
translation.kha: bad nangta u bsuh ïa kita ki dieng lyngba ki kyrwoh ha baroh arliang kata ka synduk .

translation.en: To whom coming , as unto a living stone , disallowed indeed of men , but chosen of God , and precious ,
translation.kha: To wan sha U Trai , u maw uba im uba la kyntait da u briew kum u bymmyntoi hynrei uba la jied da U Blei ba u long uba kordor .
Ngan pynlong ïa hima ka jong u ka neh ban junom lada u ïai kohnguh thikna ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh kumba u leh mynta .’
translation.en: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever , if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments , as at this day .
Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day , because that he wholly followed the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: Ka Hebron ka dang dei ka jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Kaleb , u khun jong u Jephunneh u nong Kenis , namar ba u la kohnguh hok ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
U la ong , Ko khun u briew bam ïa kane ka kli ba nga me , ïa jong me da ka . Te nga ïa , bad ka thiang ka ngap .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , cause thy belly to eat , and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee . Then did I eat it  ; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness .
Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna , What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor ? And they answered , As thou art , so were they  ; each one resembled the children of a king .
translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u kylli ïa u Sebah bad ïa u Salmunna ,  Kumno shaphang ki briew kiba phi la pynïap ha Tabor ?  Ki jubab ,  Ki syriem ïa phi — uwei pa uwei na ki u syriem ïa u khun jong u syiem .
Shaphang ka jait Reuben , u Moses u ong , Ai ba ka jait Reuben kan im , wat ka la long kaba khyndiat briew .
translation.en: Let Reuben live , and not die  ; and let not his men be few .

translation.kha: Ephrath Shisha phah ïa ka khubor sha kawei pa khana ka jylla jong u syiem ha ka ktien bad Thet rukom thoh jong kata ka jingïada , kaba pynjlih ba uwei pa Jesanaïah u tnga u long khrawbor kynrad jong ka ïing jong u Hananel rem u kren kan long ka bor kaba jingpyn-i .
translation.en: For he sent letters into all the king s provinces , into every province according to the writing thereof , and to every people after their language , that every man should bear rule in his own house , and that it should be published according to the language of every people .

And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi , the tribe of thy father , bring thou with thee , that they may be joined unto thee , and minister unto thee : but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness .
translation.kha: Wan ïalam ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , kiba na ka jait Lebi , ban ïatreilang bad ïarap ïa me katba me bad ki khun shynrang jong me phi dang ïashakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem : and he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  his God .
translation.kha: U Jehoïakim u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem . U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u .
Ka jingim jong me kan phyrnai ban ïa ka jingshai ka sngi ka shiteng , bad ki kynta jong ka jingim kin phyrnai kum ka step phyrngab .
translation.en: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday  ; thou shalt shine forth , thou shalt be as the morning .
And Jacob said unto his brethren , Gather stones  ; and they took stones , and made an heap : and they did eat there upon the heap .
translation.kha: U ong ha la ki briew ban lum katto katne ki mawbah bad ban kynton halor jong ki . Nangta ki ïashong bam hajan kata ka kynton maw .
Hynrei mynta ki briew kiba kham rit rta , ki rkhiebeiñ ïa nga ! Ki jong ki , ki borabor ki bymdondor kiba ngan ym ïa ki ban ïarap ïa ki ksew jong ban ap ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision , whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock .

translation.kha: kaba sngewlehrain ïa phi! Da shisha yn don la kumno u briew uba ka kynhun jong phi uba ban pynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia hapdeng ki parabangeit .
translation.en: I speak to your shame . Is it so , that there is not a wise man among you ? no , not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren ?
Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God , or that is worshipped ; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God , shewing himself that he is God .
translation.kha: Un pyrshah ïa kaei kaei baroh ba la khot blei , lane ïa kano kano ban mane , bad un buh ïa lade halor jong ki baroh . Wat shapoh un leit rung bad shong hapoh ka Templ U Blei bad kam ba u long U Blei .

translation.en: Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee , whom the  Lord  thy God shall choose : one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee : thou mayest not set a stranger over thee , which is not thy brother .
translation.kha: Da kynmaw ba u briew uba phi jied ban long u syiem u dei ban long uta ïa uba U  Trai  hi u la jied . U dei ban long na ka jait ka kynja jong phi hi ; wat jied syiem ïa u nongwei .

translation.en: ( Isaiah 2 :4 ) God will bring an end to all injustice and suffering .
translation.kha: ( Isaia 2 :4 ) U Blei un sa pynkut noh ïa ki jingleh bymhok bad ki jingjynjar baroh .

translation.en: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery , dost thou commit adultery ? thou that abhorrest idols , dost thou commit sacrilege ?
translation.kha: Bad ba ong ba u briew um dei ban klim ,  — hynrei phi klim ? Phi isih ïa ki bleithaw — hynrei phi lute ha ki templ ?

bet long ka jingsngewthuh kumba bam dpei . Ki jingmut ba-bieit jong u Ohad la ïalam jat ïa u ha kaba u don sha lyndet ka jingïarap . jingkyrshan Antipatris pdiang ha lade ba ka bleithaw ba u bat ha ka kti jong u kam long satia ka blei .
translation.en: He feedeth on ashes : a deceived heart hath turned him aside , that he cannot deliver his soul , nor say , Is there not a lie in my right hand ?

Therefore hear ye the word of the  Lord  , all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt  ; Behold , I have sworn by my great name , saith the  Lord  , that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt , saying , The Lord  God  liveth .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta to shahshkor ïa ka jingsmai kaba ma nga U  Trai  , nga la pynlong ha ka kyrteng bakhrawbor jong nga sha phi ki Israel baroh kiba don ha Ijipt : ngan ym shah shuh ïano ïano na phi ban pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ban pynlong jingsmai da kaba ong , ‘ Nga smai da U  Trai  Nongsynshar uba im !’

translation.en: And Elisha said unto her , What shall I do for thee ? tell me , what hast thou in the house ? And she said , Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house , save a pot of oil .
translation.kha: Kaei ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ?  u kylli .  Ïathuh ïa nga , phi don aïu ha ïing ?   Ym don ei ei shuh , lait sa tang u khra umphniang Olib uba rit ,  ka jubab .
Naba ka long da jingngeit ka jong ngi ba ngi don ka jingïadei bad Blei U ; ka long da ka jingphla jong ngi ba ïa ngi la pynim .
translation.en: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness ; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation .
And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .
translation.kha: U shna ïa kita ki jingbah da ka dieng akasia bad u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .

A Trai U Blei , to pyndep ïa ka kular kaba Aroer la jingsngewrit ha u kpa jong nga . sngewkhlaiñ la pynlong syiem ïa nga halor u paidlang uba bun katta katta kat haduh ba ym lah Besek jingthmu , kumta Omega ai ha nga ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingtip kaba nga donkam ban synshar ïa ki Gibeah
translation.en: Now , O  Lord  God , let thy promise unto David my father be established : for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude .
And this will we do , if God permit .
translation.kha: To ngin ïa-ïaid shaphrang ! Bad kane ka long kaei kaba ngin leh , lada U Blei u shah .
U Trai u bitar la ïa ki Israel bad u pyndam ïa ki na khmat jong u , da kaba iehnoh tang ka ïa hima Judah .
translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  was very angry with Israel , and removed them out of his sight : there was none left but the tribe of Judah only .
And if ye do good to them which do good to you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also do even the same .
translation.kha: Bad lada phi lehbha tang ïa kito kiba lehbha ïa phi , balei phi dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki leh kumta !
Ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh ka dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai , Niam hynrei uno uno u shym bym otsher um lah ban bam ïa ka .
translation.en: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it .
And he said , Who made thee a prince and a judge over us ? intendest thou to kill me , as thou killedst the Egyptian ? And Moses feared , and said , Surely this thing is known .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u jubab ,  Mano ba thung ïa phi kum u syiem bad nongbishar jong ngi ? Hato phi mut ban pynïap ïa nga kumba phi la pynïap ïa uto u nong Ijipt ?  Kumta u Moses u la sheptieng , bad u pyrkhat ,  Pleng , ki briew ki la tip ïa kaei ba nga la leh .
Kumta nga la leit kynsan bad haba nga la shem ïa ka jaka ha kaba nga la buhrieh ïa ki , nga la ïohi ba daitbuid la dabor bad kim myrsiang shuh ban pyndonkam .
translation.en: Then I went to Euphrates , and digged , and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it : and , behold , the girdle was marred , it was profitable for nothing .
All these cities were fenced with high walls , gates , and bars  ; beside unwalled towns a great many .
translation.kha: Kine ki shnong baroh ki long kiba la kerkut skhem da ki kynroh kiba jrong , ki khyrdop , bad ki nar-khang khyrdop , bad don ruh bun ki shnong ki bym don kynroh .
Ka jingshai ba-thaba ka la ïaid lyngba ïa ka khyrdop bashaphang mihngi bad rung Esekiel ka Templ .
translation.en: And the glory of the  Lord  came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east .

translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ki jingeh pyndik ki jingri kyntoit ki ban ai kum ki Khristan sha U Trai hynrei kane kan ym wanrah jingtlot ei ei ïa ki leh-isynei ïasheptieng ym tieng ïa u namar u la iehnoh ïa ki .
translation.en: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the  Lord   ; but they shall not find him  ; he hath withdrawn himself from them .

And he took a yoke of oxen , and hewed them in pieces , and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers , saying , Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel , so shall it be done unto his oxen . And the fear of the  Lord  fell on the people , and they came out with one consent .
translation.kha: U shim shi jur ki masi lur , u ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki bad u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban leit rah ïa kita ki lyngkhot kylleng ka ri Israel ryngkat bad kane ka jingmaham :  Kat u bym bud ïa u Saul bad u Samuel sha ka thma , kumne yn leh ïa ki masi lur jong u .  Te ki paid Israel ki sheptieng her ïa kaei ba un leh U  Trai  , bad baroh khlem lait uwei ruh , ki ïawan mih ryntih lang baroh .

Ki jong trai ki , ki pynïap ïa ki bad ki lait na ka jingshah pynshitom . Ki die ïa ka doh bad ki ong , To ‘ ïaroh ïa U ! Trai Ngi la riewspah !’ Wat ki nongaplangbrot jong ki hi kim don jingisynei ïa ki .
translation.en: Whose possessors slay them , and hold themselves not guilty : and they that sell them say , Blessed be the  Lord   ; for I am rich : and their own shepherds pity them not .

translation.kha: Kumta uwei uwei na ki u pom mar kawei ka tnat dieng , nangta ki la bud ïa u Abimelekh bad ki kynton ïa ki dieng baskhem . Ki wiang ïa ka , lem ïa briew hapoh jong ka , bad ki briew jong kata ka kut ki la ïap — ngut ki shynrang bad kynthei .
translation.en: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough , and followed Abimelech , and put them to the hold , and set the hold on fire upon them  ; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also , about a thousand men and women .
And to have power to heal sicknesses , and to cast out devils :
translation.kha: Ngan phah ruh ïa phi ban ïalap , bad phin don ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki ksuid .

translation.en: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil , and also concerning the swine .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la ïathuh ha ki briew kaei kaba la lah jia ïa uta u briew uba don ksuid , bad ïa kita ki sniang .
U syiem u kwah ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingshisha bad u ïangat ïa kito kiba kren ïa ka .
translation.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings  ; and they love him that speaketh right .

translation.kha: Ki teh ïa ki kyrwoh jong ka jingdeng shadem ha ki kyrwoh jong ephod da u ksai jngum , khnang ba kata jingdeng shadem kan neh halor kata ka jingpanpoh , bad ba kan ym lait na ka ephod , kumba U Trai la u .
translation.en: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod , and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come , saying , What is this ? that thou shalt say unto him , By strength of hand the  Lord  brought us out from Egypt , from the house of bondage :
translation.kha: Hadien habud , ynda u khun jong phi u kylli ïa phi ka mut aïu kane ka jingrakhe , phin jubab ïa u , ‘ Da kaba pyndonkam ïa la ka borbah , U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba ngi la long ki mraw .
Ko syiem lada ïa kane ka nongbah yn pat bad ïa kynroh jong pyndep , ki briew kin sa sangeh ban siew , bad ki ka ïingsyiem kin sa duna .
translation.en: Be it known now unto the king , that , if this city be builded , and the walls set up again , then will they not pay toll , tribute , and custom , and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings .
As the partridge sitteth on eggs , and hatcheth them not  ; so he that getteth riches , and not by right , shall leave them in the midst of his days , and at his end shall be a fool .
translation.kha: U briew uba ïoh pisa da ka jingbymhok u long kum ka sim kaba pynmih khun na ki pylleng kiba ka khlem kha . Ha ka rta ba la ih bha un duh noh ïa ka spah jong u , bad ha kaba kut um long ei ei hynrei u bieit .

translation.en: And if it be eaten at all on the third day , it is abominable  ; it shall not be accepted .
translation.kha: namar ka long ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam , bad lada uno uno u bam ïa ka , ngan ym pdiang ïa kata ka jingainguh .

translation.en: And he came to Capernaum : and being in the house he asked them ,  What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way ?
translation.kha: Ki la wan sha Kapernam , bad hadien ba u la rung shapoh ïing U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki synran jong u ,  Shaphang kaei phi la ïatainia hapdeng jong phi ha lynti ?

translation.en: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear .
translation.kha: Kan ym da donkam ïa phi ban da ong , namar kin ïohi katno phi long kiba sngur bad ba donburom ha ka jinglong jingim jong phi .
Hynrei ki Philistia ki la kem ïa ki bad pynïap ïa ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Saul : Jonathan u Abinadab , bad u Malkhishua .
translation.en: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons  ; and the Philistines slew Jonathan , and Abinadab , and Malchi–shua , Saul s sons .
And Jacob rent his clothes , and put sackcloth upon his loins , and mourned for his son many days .
translation.kha: U Jakob u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih bad u kup da ka jaiñ khain . U la ïam sngewsih bun sngi na ka bynta u khun jong u .
U uba shemphang u ban leh ïa ka kam , uba bieit u sdang shisien na ki liang baroh .
translation.en: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding  ; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth .
And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : for it is written , Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God , and him only shalt thou serve .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ To mane ïa U Trai uba U Blei jong me bad shakri tang ïa u !’

translation.en: Liars will not enter God’s Kingdom .
translation.kha: Kiba lamler kin ym ïoh rung ha ka Hima U Blei .
Nangta phin la ai ha ki ïa ki aiñ ki bym long Tobijah bha , bad ïa Baana hukum ki dewlynnong lah ban wanrah jingim .
translation.en: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good , and judgments whereby they should not live  ;
And beside all this , between us and you there is a great gulf fixed : so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot  ; neither can they pass to us , that would come from thence .
translation.kha: Nalor kata baroh , ka don ka kharai kaba jylliew hapdeng jong ngi , khnang ba kito kiba kwah ban jam sha shiliang nangne sha me kim lah ban leh kumta , lymne uno uno un lah ban jam sha shiliang sha ngi na ka jaka kaba me don .’

translation.en: Oh that my head were waters , and mine eyes a fountain of tears , that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people !
translation.kha: Nga kyrmen ba ka khlieh jong nga ka long ka pukri um , bad ba ki khmat jong nga ka umpohliew ki ummat , khnang ba nga lah ban ïam mynsngi bad mynmiet na ka bynta ki briew jong nga kiba la shah pynïap .

translation.en: He will eat .
translation.kha: Yn sa Bam ma u .
To kynmaw hajir ki jinghikai u Moses pduh shakri jong nga , ki itynnad rangsamla ki hukum kiba Phoenisia la ai ha u ha u sam ingiew na ka bynta ki paid Israel baroh lumbah kohnguh .
translation.en: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant , which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel , with the statutes and judgments .

translation.kha: To sharai te , bad kynmaw da ki ummat kiba bun , mynsngi nga la hikai ïa iwei iwei na phi haduh lai snem .
translation.en: Therefore watch , and remember , that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears .

translation.kha: Jarkatta don kiba ong : ‘ Ym u briew u don ka mynsiem ba ka iaid lait na ka jingiap ?’
translation.en: Yet someone may ask : ‘ Don’t humans have an immortal soul that survives death ?’
And the king was exceeding sorry  ; yet for his oath s sake , and for their sakes which sat with him , he would not reject her .
translation.kha: Kane ka pynlong ïa u syiem ban sngewsih haduh katta katta , hynrei um lah ban kyrngah ïa ka namar ki jingsmai ba u la pynlong ha khmat jong baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha .

translation.en: And all the vessels of the house of God , great and small , and the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king , and of his princes  ; all these he brought to Babylon .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u lute ïa ka Templ , ïa ka ïing jingkynshew ka Templ , bad ka spah jong u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad u kit baroh sha Babilon .

translation.en: Then came forth unto him Eliakim , Hilkiah s son , which was over the house , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , Asaph s son , the recorder .
translation.kha: Lai ngut ki nong Judia ki wan ban ïakynduh ïa u ; u rangbah synshar uba dei peit ïa ka ïingsyiem , u Eliakim u khun jong u Hilkaïah ; u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u Shebna ; bad u rangbah synshar ba dei peit ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh , u Joah u khun jong u Asaph .

translation.en: Saying unto them ,  Go into the village over against you , and straightway ye shall find an ass tied , and a colt with her : loose them , and bring them unto me .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka nongrit kaba hangta ha khmat jong phi , bad shisyndon phin shem ïa ka kada kaba la teh lem bad u khun kada hajan jong ka . Loit noh ïa ki bad wallam ïa ki sha nga .

translation.en: The  Lord  possessed me in the beginning of his way , before his works of old .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la thaw nyngkong eh ïa nga , kaba nyngkong eh na ki kam jong u , la slem bah .

translation.en: But if ye had known what this meaneth , I will have mercy , and not sacrifice , ye would not have condemned the guiltless .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Dei ka jingbhasbun kaba nga kwah , ym ïa ka jingkñia ïa ki mrad .’ Lada phi la tip kaei ka jingmut jong kane , phin ym da la pynrem ïa ki briew ki bym shym shah pynrem ;

translation.en: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early , and gone forth , behold , an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots . And his servant said unto him , Alas , my master ! how shall we do ?
translation.kha: Kum lashai dang step phyrngab , u shakri jong u Elisha u khie , u mih shabar ïing , bad u ïohi ba ki shipai Syria lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong ki ba ki la kerkut ïa kata ka shnong . U leit phai sha u Elisha bad u pyrta ,  Ko kynrad , ngi la ïap ! Ngin leh kumno ?
Kiwei pat ki ai ksuid ïa nongshun ki jong ki ban pynpang lane wat ban pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: Others cast spells on their enemies to make them sick or even to kill them .

translation.kha: ki Nangta synran ki wan la sha U Jisu bad ki la kylli ïa u , Balei me pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi haba me kren ha ki paidbah ?
translation.en: And the disciples came , and said unto him , Why speakest thou unto them in parables ?

translation.kha: U la ai ha ngi ïa kane ka jingaiei lyngba U Khrist Jisu ha ban sdang ka pyrthei , hynrei mynta la pynpaw da ka jingwan U Nongpynim jong ngi , U Khrist U la pynkut noh ïa ka bor ka jingïap lyngba Gospel la pynpaw ïa ka jingim shuh .
translation.en: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ , who hath abolished death , and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel :
Shall I then take my bread , and my water , and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers , and give it unto men , whom I know not whence they be ?
translation.kha: Ngan ym leit ban shim ïa la u kpu bad ka um , bad ki mrad kiba nga la pynïap na ka bynta ki nongot shñiuh langbrot jong nga , bad ai ïa kita ha ki briew kiba ngam tip nangno ki wan !

translation.en: Then Jesus answered and said unto her ,  O woman , great is thy faith : be it unto thee even as thou wilt .  And her daughter was made whole from that very hour .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la jubab ïa ka ,  Pha long ka briew kaba khraw ka jingngeit ! Ïa kaei kaba pha kwah yn leh na ka bynta jong pha .  Bad ha kata ka khyllipmat la pynkhiah ïa ka khun jong ka .
Ki nongwei la jubab Petros Kumta , te , la U , kata ka mut ba ki traishnong kim donkam siew .
translation.en: Peter saith unto him , Of strangers . Jesus saith unto him ,  Then are the children free .
Now the house was full of men and women  ; and all the lords of the Philistines were there  ; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women , that beheld while Samson made sport .
translation.kha: Kata ka ïing ka khapngiah da ki shynrang bad ki kynthei . Ki syiem Philistia baroh san ngut ki don hangta , bad ki don kumba lai hajar ngut ki rangbah bad ki kynthei halor tnum ïing , kiba khmih kai ïa u ba u pynbyrngia ïa ki .

translation.en: And Beth–peor , and Ashdoth–pisgah , and Beth–jeshimoth ,
translation.kha: ka Bethpeor , ki sharing jong u Lum Pisgah , bad ka Beth Jeshimoth .

Ha man ba i ong ‘ , Ki blang kiba thohbria kin long ka bainong jong me ,’ ka kynhun jingri baroh ka kha da kiba thohbria suda . Haba i ong , ‘ kiba thohshuid Kita kin long ka bainong jong ,’ me kata ka kynhun jingri baroh ka kha da kiba thohshuid suda .
translation.en: If he said thus , The speckled shall be thy wages  ; then all the cattle bare speckled : and if he said thus , The ringstraked shall be thy hire  ; then bare all the cattle ringstraked .

translation.kha: U Jisu u suk theisotti Paltiel ki nang kane 29 pharshi , hynrei kim shemphang ïa kaei kaba u la mut .
translation.en: This parable spake Jesus unto them : but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them .

translation.kha: U Moses u la jubab , Wat sheptieng ! Ïeng skhem , bad phin sa ïohi aïu U un Trai leh mynta ka sngi ban pyllait im ïa phi lano ; lano ruh phin ym ïohi shuh ïa kine nong ki Ijipt .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the people , Fear ye not , stand still , and see the salvation of the  Lord  , which he will shew to you to day : for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day , ye shall see them again no more for ever .

translation.kha: ong katno ka jingsngewsih jong nga , katno ka jingpang khlem kut jong ka dohnud jong nga na ka bynta ki briew jong nga , kiba long ka doh ka snam jong nga!
translation.en: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart .

Fear thou not , O Jacob my servant , saith the  Lord  : for I am with thee  ; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee : but I will not make a full end of thee , but correct thee in measure  ; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished .
translation.kha: Ngan wan ha phi bad pyllait im ïa phi . Ngan pynjot ïa ki hima baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , hynrei ngan ym pynjot ïa phi . Ngan nym shah ba phin lait khlem shah pynshitom ; hynrei haba nga pynshitom ïa phi , ngan lehhok . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs , they see Jesus walking on the sea , and drawing nigh unto the ship : and they were afraid .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la king kumba san ne hynriew kilomitar haba ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u ïaid halor ka um , u la nang wan sha jan ka lieng , bad ki la sngewtriem .

translation.en: When he prepared the heavens , I was there : when he set a compass upon the face of the depth :
translation.kha: Nga la lah don hangta mynba u thaw ïa ka sahit bneng , mynba u pynïar ïa ka jylli halor ka duriaw ,

translation.en: They abhor me , they flee far from me , and spare not to spit in my face .
translation.kha: Ki peit ïa nga da ka jingisih ; ki pyrkhat ki kham bha palat ma ki ban ïa nga , bad ki wan wat ban bynthiew ha ka khmat jong nga .

U Trai u jubab , Kane ka long kata kaei ban ka sa jia . Ïa ki koidi jong u shipai yn ïalam noh , bad ïa ka u jinglute jong leh nongsynshar jubor yn bat noh . Ngan ïaleh pyrshah ïa uta uba ïaleh ïa pha , bad ngan pyllait ïa ki khun jong pha .
translation.en: But thus saith the  Lord  , Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away , and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered : for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee , and I will save thy children .

translation.kha: bad u la ong To ai kane ka bor ha nga , khnang ba uno uno ha uba buh ïa ki kti un ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: Saying , Give me also this power , that on whomsoever I lay hands , he may receive the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: Nga la long ki khmat kiba ïa matlah , bad ki kjat ïa kiba dkoh .
translation.en: I was eyes to the blind , and feet was I to the lame .

translation.kha: Naba ka paw ha nga Blei ba U u la ai ïa ka jaka bakhatduh tam ha ki ngi Apostol , kum ki briew kiba la rai pynrem ban shah ïap ha khmat u paidbah kum ka jingthadrong ha khmat ka pyrthei baroh kaba dei jong ki angel bad jong u bynriew .
translation.en: For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last , as it were appointed to death : for we are made a spectacle unto the world , and to angels , and to men .

translation.kha: tieng Jehonathan u ong , syrwa u nongaplangbrot u shem pat sa tang : tylli ki kjat , ne ka bashngain jong ka langbrot ba u sing u la bam , kumta ruh tait pyllait im tang khyndiat ïa ki briew ka Samaria , kiba mynta ki shong shaniah Shunem Hasarmabeth jingthiah baremdor .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs , or a piece of an ear  ; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed , and in Damascus in a couch .

translation.kha: bad phi lah ban ai pateng ïa ki ha ki khun jong shynrang phi , kiba ïa ki dei ban shakri katba ki dang im . Hynrei phim lah ban lehbeiñ ïa kino kino na para ki Israel jong phi .
translation.en: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you , to inherit them for a possession  ; they shall be your bondmen for ever : but over your brethren the children of Israel , ye shall not rule one over another with rigour .

translation.kha: U syiem u la bitar tyngeh ; ujor u la phah ïa ki shipai jong u , kiba la pynïap ïa kito ki nongpynïap briew bad ki la pynkut duh ïa ka nongbah jong ki .
translation.en: But when the king heard thereof , he was wroth : and he sent forth his armies , and destroyed those murderers , and burned up their city .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Moses u leit shapoh ka rung Ïingjaiñ ban ïakren bad U Trai , u weng noh ïa kata ka jaiñtapkhmat . Ynda u mih biang shabar u ïathuh ha ki Israel ïa kata baroh ïa kaba hukum la ïa u ban kren ,
translation.en: But when Moses went in before the  Lord  to speak with him , he took the veil off , until he came out . And he came out , and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded .

translation.kha: Da kumta keiñ u Joshua u jop thiaw ïa Amalek ki .
translation.en: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword .

translation.kha: bad ki bniap shiah bad shynraiñ ki mih ha ka ri ki jong nga . To ïam na ka bynta ki ïing baroh ha kaba ki briew ki la ju long kiba kmen ka nongbah kaba la ju dap da ka jingim .
translation.en: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers  ; yea , upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city :

translation.kha: Ki ai u ïa ka khlieh bad ïa pat ki doh , bad u thang ïa ki ha ka duwan .
translation.en: And they presented the burnt offering unto him , with the pieces thereof , and the head : and he burnt them upon the altar .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la sdang ban jam ïa ka Jordan , bad sdang lalot jingïohi kynjat shai mynstep , baroh ki la poi lut sha shiliang .
translation.en: Then David arose , and all the people that were with him , and they passed over Jordan : by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan .

translation.kha: , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh ne phi ong , dei ban ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu , ha kaba ainguh da u ïa U Blei uba U .
translation.en: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed , do all in the name of the Lord Jesus , giving thanks to God and the Father by him .

translation.kha: Haba shah khñiot ka jingkyrmen , ka dohnud ruh ka shah khñiot , hynrei ka ka jingurlong jong jingkhmih lynti ka pyndap ïa phi da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick : but when the desire cometh , it is a tree of life .

And he gave him none inheritance in it , no , not so much as to set his foot on : yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession , and to his seed after him , when as yet he had no child .
translation.kha: U Blei , mynkata , um shym la ai ha u Abraham ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka kum ka jong u hi , ym wat shi mitar sawdong jong ka khyndew , hynrei U Blei u la kular ban ai ïa ka ha u , bad ba kan long ka jong u bad ka jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ha ka por ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa kane ka jingkular , u Abraham um pat don khun .

translation.en: And Jesus looked round about , and saith unto his disciples ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !
translation.kha: U Jisu u la peit sawdong ha ki synran jong u bad u la ong ïa ki ,  A katno ka long kaba eh ïa kiba riewspah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei !
Hynrei U ngan u la jubab jinglehhok Haba ka sngi ka sep Medad phi uta , Shisyndon Ngin sa ïoh ïa mrad suiñbneng kaba bha , namar ka sahit bneng ka saw Jahmai
translation.en: He answered and said unto them ,  When it is evening , ye say , It will be fair weather : for the sky is red .

And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity , in the tenth month , in the fifth day of the month , that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me , saying , The city is smitten .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba shiphew jong ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , uwei u briew uba la lait im na Jerusalem , u la wan sha nga bad u la ïathuh ha nga ba ka nongbah ka la kyllon .
Te u Pharaoh u la ïa u Moses bad Aaron , bad u la ong , Khie leit bad ai jingkñia ha Blei phi ha kane ka ri
translation.en: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron , and said , Go ye , sacrifice to your God in the land .
And Samuel said to all the people , See ye him whom the  Lord  hath chosen , that there is none like him among all the people ? And all the people shouted , and said , God save the king .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Hangne u long uta u briew uba U  Trai  u la jied . Ym don uba kum ma u hapdeng jong ngi .  Baroh u paidbah u risa ,  To un im slem u syiem !

translation.en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle , yet will not his foolishness depart from him .
translation.kha: Wat lada phi shoh ïa u bieit haduh ba u la jan ïap , pynban phin ym lah satia ban weng ïa ka jingbieit na u .
U Blei u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ; u la ïohi ba la ki iehnoh ïa ka jingleh bymman jong ki . Kumta u la kylla jingmut bad um shym la pynshitom ïa ki kumba u la ong ban leh .
translation.en: And God saw their works , that they turned from their evil way  ; and God repented of the evil , that he had said that he would do unto them  ; and he did it not .

translation.kha: ïabuaid long ki briew ba nga tnat pynlong na ka bynta ïa lade , bad ki rwai ïa ka jingïaroh jong Migdol !
translation.en: This people have I formed for myself  ; they shall shew forth my praise .

translation.kha: Ngan wan kloi . Sumar kyndong ïa kaei kaba pha don , khnang ba yn ym don uno u uno ban lute na pha ïa bainong ka jong ka jingjop .
translation.en: Behold , I come quickly : hold that fast which thou hast , that no man take thy crown .

translation.kha: Kam shym la ïa U Trai lane pdiang ka jingsneng pynbeit jong u . Kam shym la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha U Trai lane kyrpad ka jingïarap jong .
translation.en: She obeyed not the voice  ; she received not correction  ; she trusted not in the  Lord   ; she drew not near to her God .

translation.kha: Long uba hok bad phin long shngain . Lada thir long mynleh phin lashai kynsan .
translation.en: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved : but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once .
The flowers appear on the earth  ; the time of the singing of birds is come , and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land  ;
translation.kha: U syiem jong nga u thiah ha la ka jingthiah , bad ka jingsleh iwbih jong nga ka la pyndap ïa ka lyer da ka jingiw ba-iwbih .
Nga sngewbha ban kyrpad ïa ka Ïuodia bad ka Suntukhi , ban pyrshang ban ïamynjur kum shi para ha Trai U .
translation.en: I beseech Euodias , and beseech Syntyche , that they be of the same mind in the Lord .

translation.kha: Ka mon jong phi ban im kan khnap ïa phi haba phi pang , hynrei pongka phi jingïatylli ïa pyllew , Histori pynpang ïaroi phi kaba sah ka la jah noh Phet
translation.en: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity  ; but a wounded spirit who can bear ?

And Jacob said , Nay , I pray thee , if now I have found grace in thy sight , then receive my present at my hand : for therefore I have seen thy face , as though I had seen the face of God , and thou wast pleased with me .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ,  Em , kata kam da pher eh ; lada nga la ïoh ka jingsngewbha jong phi , to pdiang ïa ka jingai sngewbha jong nga . Ban ïohi ïa ka khmat jong phi ka long ïa nga hi kumba ïohi ïa ka khmat U Blei , mynta ba phi la leh jan ïa nga katne .

translation.en: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock , upon the crag of the rock , and the strong place .
translation.kha: U thaw ïa ka skum halor ki mawsiang kiba kynjang eh bad pynlong ka kut jong ka ïa ki kliar lum kiba nep .

translation.en: Ye know that ye were Gentiles , carried away unto these dumb idols , even as ye were led .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba mynba phi dang long kiba mane bleithaw , la ïalam sakma ïa phi ha ki rukom kiba bun sha ki jingmane ïa ki bleithaw ki bym don jingim .
U long la u syiem ka Israel sawphew snem , u da synshar hynñiew snem ha Hebron bad laiphew lai snem ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years : seven years reigned he in Hebron , and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem .
This Moses whom they refused , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge ? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush .
translation.kha: U Moses u long uta uba la shah kyntait da ki paid Israel . ‘ Uei uba la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar bad u nongbishar halor jong ngi ?’ ki la kylli . U long ma u , uba U Blei u la phah ban synshar ïa ki briew bad ban pyllaitluid ïa ki da ka jingïarap jong u angel uba la mihpaw ha u ha ka bniap kaba mehding .

translation.en: Yea also , when he that is a fool walketh by the way , his wisdom faileth him , and he saith to every one that he is a fool .
translation.kha: Ka jingmutlop jong u ka paw wat ha ki nongwei kiba u ïakynduh ha ka lynti ; u ailad ïa iwei pa iwei ban tip ba u dei u bieit .

translation.en: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers , nor rejoiced  ; I sat alone because of thy hand : for thou hast filled me with indignation .
translation.kha: Ngam shym pynlut ïa ka por jong nga bad kiwei pat ki briew , ha kaba ïa-rkhie bad ïasngewbha . Ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me nga la long marwei bad nga la dap da ka jingbitar .
ban wanrah lai u purew ba khleh bad ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam , bad ar litar ka waiñ .
translation.en: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil .

translation.kha: Sumar bad kiar ïa la ka jingim na ieit spah , bad sngewhun bad kiei kiei kiba don . Namar U u la ong , Ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi , ym kyntait ïa phi .
translation.en: Let your conversation be without covetousness  ; and be content with such things as ye have : for he hath said , I will never leave thee , nor forsake thee .
Then they came to Gilead , and to the land of Tahtim–hodshi  ; and they came to Dan–jaan , and about to Zidon ,
translation.kha: bad beit beit sha Gilead bad sha Kadesh ha ka ri ki Hit . Nangta ki leit sha Dan , bad na Dan ki leit shaphang sepngi sha Sidon .
Ki la hynñiew pynlut sngi ha pynkyntang kaba ïa ka duwan , bad nangta sa hynñiew sngi ha kaba rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam . Ha ka sngi kaba khatduh ki la pynlong ïa ka jingrakhe pynwai .
translation.en: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly : for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days , and the feast seven days .

translation.kha: Katba phi nang tur sha khmat , nga pynshaïong ïa ki khnang ban beh ïa ki ar ngut ki syiem Amor . Ki waitlam bad ki jong phi kim ïadon ei ei kane .
translation.en: And I sent the hornet before you , which drave them out from before you , even the two kings of the Amorites  ; but not with thy sword , nor with thy bow .

translation.kha: Hangta nongïamareh khmat U Trai un nongshniah jingïaiban kata ka jingiwbih , halor bashipor Rabbith kiaw ka tdem jong kata ka jingiwbih kan kah ïa ka jingtap ka Synduk ka Jutang khnang ba un ym ïohi ïa ka bad u Jisu! .
translation.en: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the  Lord  , that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony , that he die not :

translation.kha: ( Kine ki nongshna ar tylli ki don sha sepngi ka wah Jordan snemhadien ka ri ki Kanaan kiba Nobah ha ka Them Jordan . Ki don shaphang sepngi , ym bakyrpang jngai na ki dieng kyntang ha tyngam hajan ka shnong Gilgal . )
translation.en: Are they not on the other side Jordan , by the way where the sun goeth down , in the land of the Canaanites , which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal , beside the plains of Moreh ?

translation.kha: Hynrei dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba , bud ha ka hukum Blei U , u ksaiñ u la bam ïa u jingthung , bad u la ïap noh .
translation.en: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day , and it smote the gourd that it withered .

translation.kha: Da kaba Resheph ïa Hermes bajam ba la buh da u lyngka u sngewtynnat jong u Kareah u buh .org ñiah ka kam shakri kaba man ka sngi jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba Hasarmabeth ïa ki lyngdoh ha ki jingrwai ïaroh bad haba pynap ïa Hodaïah kam jong ki . U buh ryntih ruh ïa Seirah nongap jingkhang ka Templ da shuh kynhun ha kawei pa kawei ka khyrdop , ban pyndep ïa JINGIEID kam jong ki bashemphang man lynti! ka sngi kat kum ki hukum u Umpohliew syndah u briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: And he appointed , according to the order of David his father , the courses of the priests to their service , and the Levites to their charges , to praise and minister before the priests , as the duty of every day required : the porters also by their courses at every gate : for so had David the man of God commanded .
In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up , and Jehoiakim became his servant three years : then he turned and rebelled against him .
translation.kha: Mynba u Jehoïakim u long u syiem , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem Babilonia u la hiarthma ïa ka Judah , bad lai snem la pynbor ïa u Jehoïakim ban pyndem ha ka jingsynshar jong u ; nangta u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah .
Lada u briew uba sniew u sangeh ban leh pop bad u sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga , lada u leh ïa kaba dei bad kaba bha , un ym ïap ; un im da shisha .
translation.en: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed , and keep all my statutes , and do that which is lawful and right , he shall surely live , he shall not die .

translation.kha: ksiew u Ahab u jubab ha ki nonglamktien jong u Benhadad , Ïathuh pynbamphlang u syiem u kynrad Matthat nga , ba nga mynjur ïa pynmadan jingdawa kaba nyngkong ken u , hynrei ngam lah ban mynjur ïa kaba ar . Ki pynïatylli ki Joktheel noh bad nangta ki wan biang da kawei pat Sahnarphna khubor na u Benhadad ;
translation.en: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben–hadad , Tell my lord the king , All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do : but this thing I may not do . And the messengers departed , and brought him word again .
Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Art thou a master of Israel , and knowest not these things ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Me long u nonghikai uba khraw ha Israel , bad mem tip ïa kane ?
Hadien kata , u u nong Galilaïa u la mih ha ka por jong ka jingkheiñbriew u la khring ïa u paidbah bud ïa u , ïa u ruh la pynïap , ïa baroh ki nongbud jong u la pynsakma .
translation.en: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing , and drew away much people after him : he also perished  ; and all , even as many as obeyed him , were dispersed .

translation.kha: Ka jingleh jong tupia ka la long kaba janai naduh ïashun sngi ba la thaw ïa me haduh ba me la sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew .
translation.en: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created , till iniquity was found in thee .

translation.kha: Phin ïoh jingjop ha baroh kiei kiei kiba phi leh bad ka jingshai kan shai ha ka lynti ïaid jong phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt also decree a thing , and it shall be established unto thee : and the light shall shine upon thy ways .

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Ijipt kyllon kin lang bad kito kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma . waitlam Ka ka la kloi ban pynïap lut ïa ki .
translation.en: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword : she is delivered to the sword : draw her and all her multitudes .

translation.kha: Ïa por ka jingpahuh yn klet lut baroh , ka nemsniew ka ban bud kan kaba shyrkhei katta katta .
translation.en: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following  ; for it shall be very grievous .

translation.kha: Lada phon leh kumne ïa nga , to sngewsynei ïa poi-pyrkhat bad pynïap noh ïa nga , khnang tyngkai ngan ym hap shah shuh ïa kane ka basarong badonbor rangkynsai me .
translation.en: And if thou deal thus with me , kill me , I pray thee , out of hand , if I have found favour in thy sight  ; and let me not see my wretchedness .
The king of Tappuah , one  ; the king of Hepher , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Tappuah , ka Hepher ,

U bit U Blei jong phi Hor pynlong ïa ki ban kynriah na phi , bad un beh ïa ki Jabbok phi nang tur sha khmat jingkynha Phin Kynmaw ïa ka ri jong ki , kumba U Trai riewthala Blei jong phi Rah la kular riewlamwir phi .
translation.en: And the  Lord  your God , he shall expel them from before you , and drive them from out of your sight  ; and ye shall possess their land , as the  Lord  your God hath promised unto you .
And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: Da kumta keiñ u Joshua u jop thiaw ïa ki Amalek .

leit mar mar sha u Syiem na u , ‘ Syiem Kynrad , phim shym la kular kyntang nga ba u Solomon , u khun jong nga un long syiem hadien jong phi ? Kumno te ka lah ban long ba u Adonijah u la long syiem ?’
translation.en: Go and get thee in unto king David , and say unto him , Didst not thou , my lord , O king , swear unto thine handmaid , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne ? why then doth Adonijah reign ?
Just balances , just weights , a just ephah , and a just hin , shall ye have : I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Pyndonkam ïa ki tarajur kiba biang , ki mawthew kiba biang , bad ïa ki tiar thew kiba biang . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad nga wallam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt .

Ka tdem jong ding kaba pynsaja ïa ka kiew shajrong junom la junom . Ym jingtngen mynsngi ne mynmiet ïa kito kiba mane ïa u mradkhlaw bad ka dur jong u , ïa uno uno uba don ïa ka shab jong ka kyrteng jong u .
translation.en: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever : and they have no rest day nor night , who worship the beast and his image , and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name .

translation.kha: Une u long uta uba ïa nga la kren mynba nga la ong , ‘ U briew uba wan hadien jong nga , hynrei u uba long kham khraw ban ïa nga , u namar la don shuwa ban kha ïa nga .’
translation.en: This is he of whom I said , After me cometh a man which is preferred before me : for he was before me .

And the next unto him was Carshena , Shethar , Admatha , Tarshish , Meres , Marsena , and Memucan , the seven princes of Persia and Media , which saw the king s face , and which sat the first in the kingdom  ; )
translation.kha: Kito sha kiba u ju phai khmat bunsien na ka bynta ka jingai jingmut ki long u Karshena , u Shethar , u Admatha , u Tarshish , u Meres , u Marsena bad u Memukan — ki hynñiew ngut ki rangbah synshar jong ka Persia bad ka Media kiba bat ïa ki kyrdan treikam bahakhlieh duh jong ka hima .

Phi ong ba nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid namar ba u Beelsebul u ai ha nga ka ban bor leh kumta . Ñiuma , te , mano ba ai ki ha briew jong phi ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki ? Kaei kaba briew jong ki phi hi ki leh ka pynshisha ba phi bakla !
translation.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils , by whom do your children cast them out ? therefore they shall be your judges .

translation.kha: Hangta halor u lum , U Trai u la kren ha phi markhmat napdeng ding ka .
translation.en: The  Lord  talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire ,

translation.kha: bad ïa ka pyrda ba Disahab wah hapoh ka phlait la rain arliang diaw
translation.en: And the sun was darkened , and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst .
Behold the day , behold , it is come : the morning is gone forth  ; the rod hath blossomed , pride hath budded .
translation.kha: Ka sngi jong ka jingjot ka la wan ïa ka Israel . Ka jingleh jubor ka nang roi . Ka jingsarong ka ïeng rasong .
Kita Dalmatia para ki la pynkit ïa u kew ba ki la thied ha ki kada jong ki nongpynïaidkam bad ki ïamihnoh nangta .
translation.en: And they laded their asses with the corn , and departed thence .

translation.kha: U Trai Bashngain pynlong ïa pha ban nang tlot , bad yn Elasah lada baburom ïa lehbeiñ .
translation.en: For , lo , I will make thee small among the heathen , and despised among men .

Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house , and delivered them into the hand of his servants : and king Asa sent them to Ben–hadad , the son of Tabrimon , the son of Hezion , king of Syria , that dwelt at Damascus , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Asa u shim lut ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar baroh kiba dang sah ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , bad u phah ban rah ha la ki rangbah synshar sha Damaskos , sha u Benhadad u syiem Syria , u khun jong u Tabrimmon bad u ksiew jong u Hesion , lem bad kane ka khubor :
To ïa U Blei jong ka bneng ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the God of heaven : for his mercy endureth for ever .
Because Syria , Ephraim , and the son of Remaliah , have taken evil counsel against thee , saying ,
translation.kha: Ka Syria , lem bad ka Israel bad u syiem jong ka , ki la pynlong ka jingïasylla .

Ryngkat bad uta u khunlangbrot katto nyngkong kila ainguh kumba shi kilo u mitar ba Balah tylliat tynrah bha ba la Syndong lang parabangeit! jingset litar ka umphniang kynteit kaba bha . Theh ruh shi litar ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh .
translation.en: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil  ; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering .

translation.kha: Ki jubab Dorkas U Saul u la kwah ban Haggith ïa ngi bad ban ym pynsah iwei ruh hangno wanpaw ha pyntreikam .
translation.en: And they answered the king , The man that consumed us , and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel ,
And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the  Lord s  priests .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha u kumno ba u Saul u la pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai .

translation.en: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers , Except these abide in the ship , ye cannot be saved .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la ong ha u rangbah shipai bad ha ki shipai ,  Lada ki maji kim don ha ka lieng , phim don jingkyrmen shuh ban lait im .

Ha man kawei pa kawei ïa-bishni Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ha man kawei pa kawei ka Sabbaton , ki jaitbynriew na ki hima baroh kin wan ban mane ïa nga hangne ha Jerusalem jingmareh ong ksang Trai .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that from one new moon to another , and from one sabbath to another , shall all flesh come to worship before me , saith the  Lord .
Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour s house , thou shalt not covet thy neighbour s wife , nor his manservant , nor his maidservant , nor his ox , nor his ass , nor any thing that is thy neighbour s .
translation.kha: Wat kwah rhah ïa ka ïing u paramarjan jong phi ; wat ikwah ïa ka tnga jong u , lane ïa ki mraw jong u , lane ïa ki masi jong u , lane ïa ki kada jong u , lane ïa kaei kaei ruh kaba dei ka jong u .
Nangta U Blei u la ong , Ko khun u Jeshimoth , leit sha ki paid pyni bad ong ha ki mihsnam kaei kaba nga ong jingiwbih me ba men ong .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , go , get thee unto the house of Israel , and speak with my words unto them .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka u ba kham heh u la don ha lyngkha . Ha ka lynti ba u wan phai , u la poi sha jan ka , u ïa ka jingput bad ka jingïashad .
translation.en: Now his elder son was in the field : and as he came and drew nigh to the house , he heard musick and dancing .

translation.kha: Khie pita sha ki dkhot jong ka kur Rekhab bad ïakren bam ki . Nangta wallam ïa ki sha jingïasaid na ki kamra ha ka Templ bad bthah Dumbur ïa ki khyndiat .
translation.en: Go unto the house of the Rechabites , and speak unto them , and bring them into the house of the  Lord  , into one of the chambers , and give them wine to drink .
And all the men of might , even seven thousand , and craftsmen and smiths a thousand , all that were strong and apt for war , even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u la pynryngkang par ïa baroh ki rangbah badonkam sha Babilonia , baroh lang hynñiew hajar ngut , bad shihajar ngut ki nongtrei kiba tbit , kynthup ïa ki bania , baroh na ki , ki long ki rangbah bakhlaiñ kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .
Lada u nongwei uba shong bad phi u , katba u para kylla duk bad u die mraw ïa lade ha u nongwei ne ha u dkhot ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee , and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor , and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee , or to the stock of the stranger s family :
Saying , Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised , and didst eat with them .
translation.kha: Me la long u nongshong basa ha ka ïing jong ki Jentil kiba khlem otsher , bad me da ïabam lem bad ki !
Nangta nga la ïa pat ka sur bneng ka da ong , To ko briew jong nga ! To mihnoh na ka ! Phim dei ban ïashim ha ki pop jong ka ; phim dei ban ïoh ha ka jingshah pynshitom jong !
translation.en: And I heard another voice from heaven , saying , Come out of her , my people , that ye be not partakers of her sins , and that ye receive not of her plagues .
And if some of the branches be broken off , and thou , being a wild olive tree , wert grafted in among them , and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree ;
translation.kha: Ïa ki katto katne na ki tnat jong u dieng Olib ba la thung , la pynkheiñ noh , bad ba ïa u tnat jong u dieng Olib khlaw la pynïasoh bad u . Ma phi ki Jentil phi long kum ki dieng Olib khlaw , bad mynta phi ïadon bynta ha ka jingim ba kynja mynsiem bakhlaiñ jong ki Jiw .
Jisu u la kyntait biang ban ei ei , bad u Pilat u la sngewlyngngoh
translation.en: But Jesus yet answered nothing  ; so that Pilate marvelled .
Divers weights are an abomination unto the  Lord   ; and a false balance is not good .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bad jingthew bymhok .

U Malkhijah , u bania , u tei ïa bynta ka kaba bud , haduh ïing ka ba la pyndonkam da ki nongtrei shynrang ka bad Templ ki nongkhaïi , kaba don hajan ka Khyrdop Miphkad , kaba don hajan ka kamra halor ka dong jong ka kynroh kaba shaphang shatei-lam-mihngi .
translation.en: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith s son unto the place of the Nethinims , and of the merchants , over against the gate Miphkad , and to the going up of the corner .
And when he was in affliction , he besought the  Lord  his God , and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers ,
