translation.kha: U Shemaïah u nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u syiem Rehoboam bad ki nongïalam jong ka Judia kiba ïalumlang la ha Jerusalem ban lait im na u Shishak U . ong ïa ki , Kane ka dei ka khubor na U Trai ïa phi : ‘ Phi la ïa iehnoh nga , te mynta nga la iehnoh ïa phi u sha Shishak .’
translation.en: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam , and to the princes of Judah , that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak , and said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  , Ye have forsaken me , and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak .

translation.kha: U syiem Ahab u ïathuh ha Jesebel ka tnga jong u ïa baroh u Elijah u la leh bad ba la pynïap lut ïa ki nongïathuhlypa u Baal
translation.en: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done , and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , ka la shem ba ka la punkhun bad ka ktien sha Dabid ban ïathuh ïa u
translation.en: And the woman conceived , and sent and told David , and said , I am with child .

translation.kha: Seïon syiem Rehoboam sna-ïap balang bad ki riewrangbah kiba la khmied ïa u Solomon u kpa Jingpynkyllaktien u kum ki nongaibuit . Kaei ka jutang ba phin ai jingmut ïa nga ba ngan ai kongsan Baalah ki briew ? u kylli .
translation.en: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , saying , What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people ?

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , kan myntoi aïu ïa uba ong ba u —Joshua ka jingngeit Barak da ki kam jong u , um pynshisha jingkhihwin kata ? Hato Samgar ka jingngeit kan Besodeïah ïa u ?
translation.en: What doth it profit , my brethren , though a man say he hath faith , and have not works ? can faith save him ?

His servants therefore took him out of that chariot , and put him in the second chariot that he had  ; and they brought him to Jerusalem , and he died , and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers . And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah .
translation.kha: Ki sei ïa u na ka kali ïapom jong u , ki buh ïa u ha ka kali ïapom kaba ar kaba u don hangta , bad ki kit ïa u sha Jerusalem . Hangta u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem . Baroh ki paid Judah bad Jerusalem ki ïambriew namar ka jingïap jong u .
Nga long Gabriel , u angel u la jubab . Nga ïeng ha ka jingdon jong Blei phah ïa nga ban kren ha me ïathuh ha me ïa ka khubor babha .
translation.en: And the angel answering said unto him , I am Gabriel , that stand in the presence of God  ; and am sent to speak unto thee , and to shew thee these glad tidings .

translation.kha: Baroh ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kiba shong basah ha Ephesos ki la ïohsngew ïa kane jingsop la pyndap ïa ki baroh da ka jingsheptieng , bad ïa ka ba-marjan jong U Trai Jisu la soh-ot ka burom kaba kham khraw .
translation.en: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus  ; and fear fell on them all , and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified .

translation.kha: Ma phi to nang sha ïaleit ka Jingkhawai Niam . Nga ngam leit sha kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , namar ka ba por kaba biang kam pat poi na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: Go ye up unto this feast : I go not up yet unto this feast  ; for my time is not yet full come .
And the  Lord  said unto me , Say unto them , Go not up , neither fight  ; for I am not among you  ; lest ye be smitten before your enemies .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la ong ha nga , ‘ Maham ïa ki ban ym leit tur , naba ngan ym long ryngkat bad ki , bad ki nongshun jong ki kin sa jop ïa ki .’
Ki Israel ki la leh kumba u Moses u la lah ; ong bad ki la pan na ki nong Ijipt ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad ki jingdeng rupa bad , ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem de .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses  ; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment :

translation.kha: Hadien jingïap u Joshua , ki paid Israel kylli ïa U Trai , Mano na ki jait jong ngi kaba dei ban leit nyngkong ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Kanaan
translation.en: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass , that the children of Israel asked the  Lord  , saying , Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first , to fight against them ?

translation.kha: Ka por kan wan , U Trai , haba ki briew kin ym smai shuh nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa u Israel na ka Ijipt .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that they shall no more say , The  Lord  liveth , which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt  ;

translation.kha: Nga duwai ym tang na ka bynta jong ki , hynrei na ka kito bynta ruh kiba ngeit ha nga namar ka khubor jong ki .
translation.en: Neither pray I for these alone , but for them also which shall believe on me through their word  ;
Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world , according to the prince of the power of the air , the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por phi bud ïa ka rukom im basniew jong ka pyrthei ; phi la kohnguh ïa u nongsynshar jong ki bor mynsiem ha ka haw haw , u mynsiem uba synshar mynta ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And she went down unto the floor , and did according to all that her mother in law bade her .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka leit sha ka jaka dung kew bad ka la leh ïa kaei kaba ka kiaw kurim jong ka , ka la bthah ïa ka .

U Asa u duwai U Trai U Blei jong u , A Trai me lah ban ïarap ïa ka kynhun shipai da kaba suk khlaiñ . Ïarap ïa ngi , Trai U Blei ngi , ba ngi shaniah me , bad ha ka kyrteng me ngi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa kane ka kynhun shipai bun . A Trai long U Blei jong ngi ; ym don u ban kyrmen ban ïa .
translation.en: And Asa cried unto the  Lord  his God , and said ,  Lord  , it is nothing with thee to help , whether with many , or with them that have no power : help us , O  Lord  our God  ; for we rest on thee , and in thy name we go against this multitude . O  Lord  , thou art our God  ; let not man prevail against thee .
The slothful man saith , There is a lion in the way  ; a lion is in the streets .
translation.kha: Balei ba u briew uba jaipdeh um ju mih na la ïing ? Ïa kaei u sheptieng ? Ïa ki sing ?

translation.en: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand :
translation.kha: Uta u lyngdoh un theh khyndiat ka umphniang ha la ka sla ti kadiang ,
Lada u briew briew ki mih prum ha ka ne ha ka tmoh , u lyngdoh peit bniah ïa .
translation.en: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard  ;

translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , mynta ngi long ki khun U Blei , kam hynrei pat da shai aïu ngin sa long . Hynrei ngi tip ba ynda U un Khrist paw ngin , ïoh long kum ma u , namar ngin ïohi ïa u kumba u long da shisha .
translation.en: Beloved , now are we the sons of God , and it doth not yet appear what we shall be : but we know that , when he shall appear , we shall be like him  ; for we shall see him as he is .
For unto every one that hath shall be given , and he shall have abundance : but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath .
translation.kha: Naba ïa uwei pa uwei u briew uba don ei ei , yn sa ai kham bun , bad un don kyrhai ; hynrei ha u briew u bym don ei ei , wat ïa kaba khyndiat kaba u don yn shim noh na u .

translation.en: Which devour widows  houses , and for a shew make long prayers : the same shall receive greater damnation .
translation.kha: kiba shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad kiba knieh noh ïa ki ïing jong ki , bad nangta kiba pyn-i paidbah da kaba duwai jlan ! Ka jingpynshitom ïa ki kan long kaba kham shyrkhei !
Haba phi bet ki ha lyngkha ha ka snem kaba phra , phin nang bam ïa kaei kaba la ot ka ha snem kaba hynriew , bad phin dang don kyrhai ban bam haduh ba phin da ot u ïa jingthung ha kata ka snem .
translation.en: And ye shall sow the eighth year , and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year  ; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store .

translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa u da ka jingpang bad jingïa-umsnam ka . Ïa u lapbah lapsan u bad phria , ryngkat bad ka ding bad u kyndok , ngan theh noh ha u bad ha ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad halor kiba bun ki jaitbynriew ïashah kiba liang bad u .
translation.en: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood  ; and I will rain upon him , and upon his bands , and upon the many people that are with him , an overflowing rain , and great hailstones , fire , and brimstone .

translation.kha: ka Bakhuid ka kren uta : Ha khmih , buh ha Seïon ïa maw u ban pynlong ïa ki briew jynthut , u mawsiang u pynlong ïa ki ban . Hynrei uba ngeit ha un ym shem ïa kaba sngewsih .
translation.en: As it is written , Behold , I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence : and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed .

translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ïa lum ka dorbar ki bad la ong , Ngin ïaleh kumno ? Peit ïa ki kambah baroh kiba une u briew u la leh !
translation.en: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council , and said , What do we ? for this man doeth many miracles .

translation.kha: U Barnabas u la long u ïakyndit uba jingkhlaiñbor , uba nar-khang da U Mynsiem jynreiñ bad Heshmon ka jingngeit , bad bun ki briew la wallam sha U Trai .
translation.en: For he was a good man , and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith : and much people was added unto the Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta u Isaïah u ong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah , Kane ka ka long dak ïa kaei ka ban sa jia . Mynta ka snem bad ha ka snem ka ban wan , men ïoh tang ïa ki kew khlaw ban , bam hynrei ha ka snem kaba bud men lah ban bet ïa u kew ïa bad ot u , ban bad thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ .
translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee , Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves , and in the second year that which springeth of the same  ; and in the third year sow ye , and reap , and plant vineyards , and eat the fruits thereof .

translation.kha: Ngan wallam khapnoh u Sisera , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u Jabin , ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi ha ka wah Kishon . Un don ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai , hynrei ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong u .’
translation.en: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera , the captain of Jabin s army , with his chariots and his multitude  ; and I will deliver him into thine hand .

translation.kha: Nga pynkhuid ïa ki briew kiei kiba long nongwei : nga ki jingbuhbeit na ka bynta ki lyngdoh ki Lebi khnang ba pa uwei un tip ïa ka kamram ;
translation.en: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers , and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites , every one in his business  ;

translation.kha: To U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingkyrmen , un pyndap ïa da ka jingkmen baroh bad ka jingsuk kaba long da jong phi ha u , khnang ba ka jong phi san da ka bor jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing , that ye may abound in hope , through the power of the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: Balei ba la kha ïa nga ? Hato dei tang ban ïoh jingjynjar bad ka jingsngewsih , ban ïa jingim jong nga ha ka ?
translation.en: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow , that my days should be consumed with shame ?
The Spirit of God hath made me , and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga bad uba ai jingim ïa nga .

translation.en: And when he cometh , he shall smite the land of Egypt , and deliver such as are for death to death  ; and such as are for captivity to captivity  ; and such as are for the sword to the sword .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar un wan bad jop ïa ka Ijipt . Kito ki briew kiba la dei ban ïap na ka jingpang kin ïap ha ka jingpang , kito kiba dei ba yn ïalam kum ki koidi yn ïalam ïa ki kum ki koidi , bad kito kiba la dei ban sha pynïap ha ka thma kin ïap ha ka thma .
Ka sngi bad u bnai ki kylla dum , bad ki khlur kim tyngshaiñ . shuh
translation.en: The sun and the moon shall be darkened , and the stars shall withdraw their shining .

translation.kha: uba Uta da mutlop u kular ban kitkhlieh ïa ka ram u nongwei u dei hok ban buh ïa la jong ka ka jingdon jingem ban pynshisha ïa ka jingsiew .
translation.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger , and take a pledge of him for a strange woman .

translation.kha: A Trai , to sngew ïa ngi . A Trai , to map ïa ngi . A Trai , to shahshkor ïa , ngi bad to trei ! Khnang uwei ba uwei baroh tip un ba me long U Blei , wat ym pynslem ! Kane ka nongbah kine bad ki briew ki long ki jong me .
translation.en: O Lord , hear  ; O Lord , forgive  ; O Lord , hearken and do  ; defer not , for thine own sake , O my God : for thy city and thy people are called by thy name .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab bad ki nongbah jong ka la pynjot , ïa ki samla bakynsai tam la pynïap . Nga long u syiem , U Trai , bad nga la kren .
translation.en: Moab is spoiled , and gone up out of her cities , and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: un pynlong ïa ngi kiba kohnguh ïa u ngin lah ban borabor kumba u kwah ïa ban im , bad ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa u ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translation.en: That he may incline our hearts unto him , to walk in all his ways , and to keep his commandments , and his statutes , and his judgments , which he commanded our fathers .

translation.kha: Ka u Jakob ka don , bad U Jisu , uba la thait na kata ka jingleit u la shongthait kata ka pukri Ka long kumba shiteng sngi
translation.en: Now Jacob s well was there . Jesus therefore , being wearied with his journey , sat thus on the well : and it was about the sixth hour .
Yet let no man strive , nor reprove another : for thy people are as they that strive with the priest .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Wat ai ba uno uno un kynnoh ïa ki briew lane pynrem ïa ki — ka jingmudui jong nga ka long pyrshah ïa phi ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: For the which cause I also suffer these things : nevertheless I am not ashamed : for I know whom I have believed , and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day .
translation.kha: Nabynta kaei nga ruh nga jynjar kumne baroh , Hynrei nga dap da ka jingsngewskhem , namar nga tip hano nga la shaniah , bad nga sngewthikna ba u lah ban sumar skhem haduh kata ka Sngi ïa kaei kaba u la aiti ha nga .
Katto por , u u jngoh la ka tnga ha ka por ot kew u da ïa ka uwei u khunblang . ïa u kpa ka Ngan leit rung kamra ka tnga nga . Hynrei um shah ba un rung shapoh .
translation.en: But it came to pass within a while after , in the time of wheat harvest , that Samson visited his wife with a kid  ; and he said , I will go in to my wife into the chamber . But her father would not suffer him to go in .
Waters flowed over mine head  ; then I said , I am cut off .
translation.kha: Ka um ka la sdang ban tyllep ïa nga , bad nga la pyrkhat ba ka jingïap ka la jan .
Dei ka jingngeit kaba la ïa ban mihnoh ka Ijipt khlem da sheptieng ïa ka Pharaoh . Ka la long la ïohi ïa U Blei u lah ban ïohi , u la kyntait ban phai dien
translation.en: By faith he forsook Egypt , not fearing the wrath of the king : for he endured , as seeing him who is invisible .
Then thy elders and thy judges shall come forth , and they shall measure unto the cities which are round about him that is slain :
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam bad ki nongbishar jong phi ki dei ban leit thew ïa ka jingjngai hapdeng kata ka jaka ha kaba la lap ïa ka metïap bad ki shnong kiba marjan .
Ki briew ki tih ïa ki ba-eh tam , ki tih ha trai jong ki lumbah .
translation.en: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock  ; he overturneth the mountains by the roots .

translation.kha: nga bitar shikatdei eh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba sngewkmen ka jingjar jar bad jingsuk . Namar katba dang bat ïa ka jingbitar jong nga pyrshah ïa briew jong nga , kito ki jaitbynriew ki la kham ïa ki jingshitom jong briew jong nga .
translation.en: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease : for I was but a little displeased , and they helped forward the affliction .
And the angel of God , which went before the camp of Israel , removed and went behind them  ; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face , and stood behind them :
translation.kha: U Angel jong U Blei uba la ju don ha khmat jong ki paid Israel u la kynriah bad u la leit shadien . U rishot lyoh ruh u kynriah noh tad haduh ba u la don hapdeng ki nong Ijipt bad ki Israel .

translation.en: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee , and accomplish mine anger upon thee : and I will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense thee for all thine abominations .
translation.kha: Mynta kumne kumne phan sa sngew ïa ka bor jingbitar jong nga baroh . Ngan bishar ïa pha kat kum kiei kiei kiba pha la leh , bad pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kam ba-ijli jong pha baroh .

translation.en: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years , and begat sons and daughters :
translation.kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun
Uta u briew un jingshongkurim Tahan u langbrot :43 khmat ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat khynñiat nga kum ka jingkñia namar ka jingpalat jong u ,
translation.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , even a ram for a trespass offering .
He shall eat the bread of his God , both of the most holy , and of the holy .
translation.kha: U lah ban bam ïa ka jingbam kaba la kñia ainguh ha nga , ïa ka jingkñia ainguh bam kaba kyntang , bad kaba kyntang eh ;
Leh ïa kaei kaba U Trai u ong ba ka long kaba dei bad kaba bha , te phin manbha . Phin sa ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba seisoh kaba ïa U Trai u la kular ki ha kpa tymmen phi jong ,
translation.en: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the  Lord  : that it may be well with thee , and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers ,
There was a certain rich man , which was clothed in purple and fine linen , and fared sumptuously every day :
translation.kha: La don shisien uwei u briew uba riewspah uba la riam ha ki jaiñ kiba remdor eh bad uba im ha ka jingpahuh bakhraw man la ka sngi .
Haba jingsngewbha Abram u la dap thynrang khyndai snem Bendeker rta , U sngi! u la mihpaw jingïapthem u bad u ong , Nga long U im’ Badonbor Baroh . Kohnguh ïa nga phah ïai leh ïa pynsyrwa ïamkthang .
translation.en: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine , the  Lord  appeared to Abram , and said unto him , I am the Almighty God  ; walk before me , and be thou perfect .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa uta uba jop , u rijied ha ka Templ jong U shong jong nga , bad un ïailong hangta . Ngan thoh Akaba jong u ïa ka kyrteng U Blei jong nga bad sngewthikna kyrteng nangroi ka nongbah patrong U Blei jong nga , jaiñspong jinglehsngewbha bathymmai balsam ka ban wan hiar na bneng na U Blei jong nga . Ngan thoh ruh halor jong u ïa Sokoh kyrteng bathymmai jong nga .
translation.en: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God , and he shall go no more out : and I will write upon him the name of my God , and the name of the city of my God , which is new Jerusalem , which cometh down out of heaven from my God : and I will write upon him my new name .
And David said unto Gad , I am in a great strait : let us fall now into the hand of the  Lord   ; for his mercies are great : and let me not fall into the hand of man .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga don ha ka khim khait ! Hynrei ngam kwah ba ngan shah pynshitom ha ki briew . Ai ba U  Trai  da lade hi un dei uta u ban pynshitom ïa ngi , namar u long uba dap da ka jingisynei .
U Baasha u la tep tylliat la tep ïa u ha Tirsah , bad u khun jong u , u Elah u la long syiem ha jingpynhiarkput jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Baasha slept with his fathers , and was buried in Tirzah : and Elah his son reigned in his stead .

Hear ye this , O house of Jacob , which are called by the name of Israel , and are come forth out of the waters of Judah , which swear by the name of the  Lord  , and make mention of the God of Israel , but not in truth , nor in righteousness .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki paid Israel , phi kiba hiarpateng na u Judah : Phi smai da ka kyrteng jong U  Trai bad kam ba phi mane ïa U Blei ki Israel — hynrei phim shym buh jingmut ïa kawei ruh ka ktien kaba phi ong .
Kita ki kynthei rudwah para ki la kram lyngkot tyrnem U Jisu : Ko Trai , u paralok uba me ieit u pang .
translation.en: Therefore his sisters sent unto him , saying , Lord , behold , he whom thou lovest is sick .
( For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision , the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles : )
translation.kha: Naba da ka bor U Blei la pynlong ïa nga u Apostol sha ki Jentil , kumba ïa u Petros la pynlong u Apostol sha ki Jiw .

translation.en: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth , Gallio said unto the Jews , If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness , O ye Jews , reason would that I should bear with you :
translation.kha: U Paul sa ba un sdang kren , haba u Gallio u la ong ha kita ki Jiw ,  Lada kane ka long ka kam runar lane ka kam sniew ba la leh , kan long kaba shongnia ïa nga ban ïaishah bad ki Jiw .

translation.en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
translation.kha: Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ha ki balang !
Ka jingsniew ba ki briew ki la leh , ka khanglad ïa ki ban wan phai sha U Blei jong ki . Ka shohdoh bleithaw ka don ka jingbat bakhlaiñ Kyndit ki bad kim pdiang ïa U To riewrunar
translation.en: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God : for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them , and they have not known the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa ka long kaba sniew hi ka byrtong , bad ka jingmeng ka long hi pop kum ka jingmane bleithaw . Namar ba kyntait ïa ka hukum U Trai , u la kyntait kum u syiem
translation.en: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft , and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry . Because thou hast rejected the word of the  Lord  , he hath also rejected thee from being king .
He said unto them ,  Give place : for the maid is not dead , but sleepeth .  And they laughed him to scorn .
translation.kha: u la ong ,  To ïamihnoh shabar baroh ! Ka khynnah rit kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !  Te ki baroh ki la ïa-rkhie ïa u .
Hynrei Absalom u ong , Lada kumta , phin shah mo la kumno kumno ïa u , para jong ban ? Balei un ? u syiem u kylli .
translation.en: Then said Absalom , If not , I pray thee , let my brother Amnon go with us . And the king said unto him , Why should he go with thee ?

translation.kha: Uno uno uba kyntait ïa nga bad u bym pdiang ïa ka khubor jong , nga u don uwei u ban bishar ïa u . Ki ktien kiba nga la kren kin long u nongbishar u jong ha ka kaba sngi khatduh !
translation.en: He that rejecteth me , and receiveth not my words , hath one that judgeth him : the word that I have spoken , the same shall judge him in the last day .

translation.kha: Na Miletos u u Paul la phah khubor sha Ephesos , da kaba kyrpad ïa ki nongsharai balang , ban ïakynduh ïa u .
translation.en: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus , and called the elders of the church .
And now is not Boaz of our kindred , with whose maidens thou wast ? Behold , he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba une u briew , u Boas , uba phi la ïatrei lem bad ki kynthei jong u , u dei u ba-ha-ïing jong ngi . Shahshkor mynta . Ha kane ka janmiet un leit dung ïa u barli .

translation.en: And God spake unto Moses , and said unto him , I am the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Te U Blei u la kren ha u Moses bad u la ong ,  Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: But I certify you , brethren , that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man .
translation.kha: Shah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba ka Gospel ba nga ïalap ha phi kam long kaba na ka tynrai u briew .
Shahshkor ! Nga la ai ha ka phi bor , khnang ba lah phi ban halor ïaid ki bseiñ bad ki ñianglartham bad jop ïa ka bor baroh jong u Nongshun , bad ym don kano kano ka ban pynmynsaw ïa phi .
translation.en: Behold , I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions , and over all the power of the enemy : and nothing shall by any means hurt you .
Is it good that he should search you out ? or as one man mocketh another , do ye so mock him ?
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u khmih bha ïa me , hato un shem kano kano kaba bha ? Hato me pyrkhat ba me lah ban shukor ïa U Blei kumba me shukor ïa ki briew ?

translation.en: And the water was spent in the bottle , and she cast the child under one of the shrubs .
translation.kha: Haba ka um ka la lut , ka ieh ïa u khunlung hapoh kawei ka bniap ,
tip ki pyrshah aïu phi don .
translation.en: Behold , I know your thoughts , and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me .
And David said unto Abiathar , I knew it that day , when Doeg the Edomite was there , that he would surely tell Saul : I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father s house .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u ,  Haba nga ïohi ïa u Doeg hangta ha kato ka sngi , nga la tip skhem ba un sa ïathuh ha u Saul . Kumta nga kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi baroh .

translation.en: The rich ruleth over the poor , and the borrower is servant to the lender .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duk ki long ki mraw jong u briew bariewspah , pan kylliang pisa bad phin long u mraw jong u nongai ram .

translation.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the  Lord  thy God . Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother s milk .
translation.kha: Man la ka snem wallam ïa ki soh ba phi la lum nyngkong na ka jingot sha ka ïing U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .  Wat ju shet ïa u khunlangbrot ne khunblang ha ka dud ka kmie jong u .

translation.en: Unto which promise our twelve tribes , instantly serving God day and night , hope to come . For which hope s sake , king Agrippa , I am accused of the Jews .
translation.kha: ïa kata hi kaba ki khat-ar jait jong ki briew jong ngi ki kyrmen ban ïohpdiang , haba ki mane ïa U Blei mynsngi bad mynmiet . Bad ka dei namar jong kane ka jingkyrmen , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba nga la shah mudui da ki Jiw !
U Bam ia Mynta u Soh Apple .
translation.en: He is eating an apple .

translation.kha: eitnar haba kheiñlang ba-donnam lah khum ïa u ban Ngam , u Paul u la ïaiban ïa Ephes rangbah pynïaidkam uba ïeng hangta , Ujuh ka shong aiñ ïa kparad ban sympat ïa u traishnong ka Hima Rom u bym shym pynïapthngan shah narud na ka bynta kano kano ka kam runar Salm
translation.en: And as they bound him with thongs , Paul said unto the centurion that stood by , Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman , and uncondemned ?

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Hosia , Pynkyrteng , ‘ u Lo-ammi ,’ namar briew ka Israel kim dei ki briew jong , bad ngam long U jong ki .
translation.en: Then said God , Call his name Lo–ammi : for ye are not my people , and I will not be your God .

translation.kha: Sumar ban ym dih waiñ lane dih kyiad , bam lane ïa kano kano ka bymkhuid ;
translation.en: Now therefore beware , I pray thee , and drink not wine nor strong drink , and eat not any unclean thing :
But , O  Lord  of hosts , that judgest righteously , that triest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I revealed my cause .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la duwai ,  A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , me long u nongbishar ba bishar hok ; me tynjuh ïa ki jingpyrkhat bad ki jingsngew jong ki briew . Nga la buh ïa ka kam jong nga ha ki kti jong me ; kumta shah ïa nga ban khmih ïa me ba me pynhiarkput halor kine ki briew .
Hynrei hangno lah ban shem ïa jingstad Hangno ngi lah ban ïoh ban shemphang ?
translation.en: But where shall wisdom be found ? and where is the place of understanding ?
In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod , of Ammon , and of Moab :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , nga shem ruh ba bun na ki rangbah Jiw ki la shongkurim ïa ki kynthei na Ashdod , Ammon , bad Moab .

Naba kñi Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses ban shem ha ki , Phi long u paidlang Enaim mutlop . ktang ngan leit ryngkat bad phi wat tang shikhyllipmat ruh , ngan jin da la pynjot kyrsoi ïa phi . Law noh mynta ïa kito ki jingdeng —2 Syros , bad ngan Tikbah rai ngan leh kumno Jannes phi .
translation.en: For the  Lord  had said unto Moses , Say unto the children of Israel , Ye are a stiffnecked people : I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment , and consume thee : therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee , that I may know what to do unto thee .

translation.kha: U Philip u la sha ka nongbah ha Samaria u la ïalap ïa U Messaïah ha ki briew hangta .
translation.en: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria , and preached Christ unto them .

translation.kha: Nga phah ia u kumta da jingpeitbha , , khnang ynda phi iohi biang ia u , phin shadkmen , ka bad jingsngewsih jong nga kan jah noh .
translation.en: I sent him therefore the more carefully , that , when ye see him again , ye may rejoice , and that I may be the less sorrowful .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , Syiem Kynrad ïashongsuk ïatei la jubab . Ngi la kloi ban leh kat ïa kaba phi pynshahshkor .
translation.en: And the king s servants said unto the king , Behold , thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint .

translation.kha: Ngam don tnga , ka la jubab . U Jisu u la ktien Ka kaba dei haba pha ong ba pham tnga .
translation.en: The woman answered and said , I have no husband . Jesus said unto her ,  Thou hast well said , I have no husband :

translation.kha: Te ki rangbah ki la phah ïa u Jehudi ( u khun jong u Nethanaïah , ksiew jong Shelemaïah bad u ksiew tun jong Kushi ) ong u ban wallam ïa ka kot kli na u ha ki paidbah . U u la wallam ha ïa ka kot kli .
translation.en: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah , the son of Shelemiah , the son of Cushi , unto Baruch , saying , Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people , and come . So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand , and came unto them .

translation.kha: U u mih shabar u da khang tdam ïa ka jingkhang .
translation.en: And Lot went out at the door unto them , and shut the door after him ,
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki kur u Gershon ki dei ban shong dara shaphang sepngi shadien ka Ïingjaiñ ,
ki da ïaleh shi lynter lynti shaduh palat ka Bethaben . U Trai u la pyllait im ïa Israel ki ha kata ka sngi .
translation.en: So the  Lord  saved Israel that day : and the battle passed over unto Beth–aven .
And if they will learn any thing , let them ask their husbands at home : for it is a shame for women to speak in the church .
translation.kha: Lada ki kwah ban tip ei ei shaphang kano kano , ki dei ban kylli ha la ki tnga ha ïing . Ka long kaba i jahburom ïa ka kynthei ban kren ha ka jingïaseng .
Ko Job , hato me la phla Kheiñ skei pop jong me ha U Blei bad kular ban nym leh pop kyrduh ?
translation.en: Surely it is meet to be said unto God , I have borne chastisement , I will not offend any more :
God brought them out of Egypt  ; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn .
translation.kha: U Blei u la wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt ; U ïaleh na ka bynta jong ki la kum u masi prut .

Hato ki long ki shakri U Khrist ?(Nga kren kum uba lamwir) — nga hynrei long u shakri uba kham palat ban ïa ki ! Nga la trei kham shitom palat , nga la bunsien don ha byndi , nga la shah sympat , kham bun bad nga la jan sha ka jingïap kham bunsien .
translation.en: Are they ministers of Christ ? (I speak as a fool) I am more ; in labours more abundant , in stripes above measure , in prisons more frequent , in deaths oft .

And I will encamp about mine house because of the army , because of him that passeth by , and because of him that returneth : and no oppressor shall pass through them any more : for now have I seen with mine eyes .
translation.kha: Ngan ap phira ïa ka ri jong nga bad ngan ym shah ïa ki kynhun shipai ban ïaid lyngba jong ka . Ngan ym shah shuh ïa ki nongbanbor ban banbeiñ ïa ki briew jong nga . Nga la ïohi haduh katno ki briew jong nga ki la shahshitom .

translation.en: Now therefore , my son , obey my voice  ; and arise , flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran  ;
translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun , leh kumba nga ong .
U Jisu u ong ha ki , Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Lada phim bam ïa doh jong U Khun U Briew bad dih ka snam jong u phin ym don ïa ka jingim ha lade .
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man , and drink his blood , ye have no life in you .
For , behold , the  Lord  cometh forth out of his place , and will come down , and tread upon the high places of the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wan mih na ka jaka bakhuid jong u ; un wan hiar bad ïaid ha kliar jong ki lumbah .

translation.en: As for the living bird , he shall take it , and the cedar wood , and the scarlet , and the hyssop , and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water :
translation.kha: Un shim sa ïa kawei pat ka sim , ïa u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , ïa u  saiwul uba saw , bad ïa u tnat Hissop , bad un wieh lang ïa ki ha ka snam jong kata ka sim kaba u la pynïap .
Nangta shim biang katto katne na ki , bret ïa ki ha ka ding , bad ai ba yn thang ïa ki . Na ki ka ding kan klang sha ka Lyngdoh Israel baroh kawei .
translation.en: Then take of them again , and cast them into the midst of the fire , and burn them in the fire  ; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel .
A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth : but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha kin ïoh bainong na ka bynta kaei kaba ki ong , hynrei kito kiba shukor ki thrang tang ban leh jubor .

Ka Joppa Ïasam shym da paidlang sngewsyiad Lydda , bad haba ki bleithaw) ha Joppa ki ñiangapïing ïohsngew Saanannim u Petros u la don ha Lydda shñiuh ki la phah ar jingpynshong ki Epaphroditos sha u Mei bad ka Shekanaïah , To pynkloi bad wan sha ngi .
translation.en: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa , and the disciples had heard that Peter was there , they sent unto him two men , desiring him that he would not delay to come to them .
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you . Amen .
translation.kha: Ka jingaiei ka jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi kan long lem bad phi . Amen .

translation.en: You can recognize them by the way they take no part in politics or social conflicts .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban ithuh ïa ki namar kim ju shim bynta ha ki kam saiñ pyrthei ne ha kam ïaleh pyrshah ha ka imlang sahlang .

translation.en: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy : ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Phi tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong nga kum ki nongshun . Ki rangbah ki wan phai na ka thma , da kaba pyrkhat ba kin shngain ha ïing , hynrei hangta ki shem , ïa kiba ap ban tuh noh ïa ki jaiñphong na ka met jong ki .

translation.en: For our conversation is in heaven ; from whence also we look for the Saviour , the Lord Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Ma ngi pynban , ngi long ki traishnong jong ka bneng , bad ngi ïa-ap hir hir ïa U Nongpynim , U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai ban wan na bneng .

translation.en: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters .
translation.kha: Ngam kwah ba kan paw kumba nga pyrshang ban pynsheptieng ïa phi da ki shithi jong nga .

translation.en: And as touching the dead , that they rise : have ye not read in the book of Moses , how in the bush God spake unto him , saying , I am the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob ?
translation.kha: Mynta , na ka bynta kita kiba la ïap ki ban sa mihpat : Hato phim pat ju pule ha ka Kitab u Moses ïa ka bynta kaba dei shaphang ka  lawlynnong kaba ing ? Hangto la thoh ba U Blei u la ong ïa u Moses , ‘ Nga long U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isaak bad U Blei jong u Jakob .’

translation.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man , whether he rage or laugh , there is no rest .
translation.kha: Haba u briew uba proh jingmut u wanrah ïa ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa uba bieit , uba bieit u shu rkhie bad u hylla bad u tim .

translation.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly , when he sinneth by ignorance before the  Lord  , to make an atonement for him  ; and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ha ka duwan ban pynkhuid ïa phi na ka pop jong phi ; bad yn sa map ïa phi .
Balei U Jehobah u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei ?
translation.en: Why did Jehovah create the earth ?
And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed , I also was standing by , and consenting unto his death , and kept the raiment of them that slew him .
translation.kha: Bad haba la pynïap ïa u Stephan , u sakhi jong me , nga hi nga la don hangta , nga da mynjur ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u bad nga da sumar ïa ki jaiñ jong ki nongpynïap ïa u .’

translation.en: So shall it be at the end of the world : the angels shall come forth , and sever the wicked from among the just ,
translation.kha: Kan long kumne ha kaba kut ka Ïa : ki angel kin mihnoh ban lumlang ïa ki briew kiba sniew napdeng kiba bha
Hato ngin ph te , setkut U Hena u long bymhok “ksuid” thad kumta .
translation.en: What shall we say then ? Is there unrighteousness with God ? God forbid .

translation.kha: U Moses u la leit kiew ïa u Lum Sinai , bad lyoh u u tap ïa uta u lum .
translation.en: And Moses went up into the mount , and a cloud covered the mount .

translation.kha: Hapoh ka jingsynshar jong U Khrist la bsa jia ka met phra kawei bad la pyndait lang da shipai mat bad doh-satar jong ka ngab bad ka san nongïada U Blei nongshet kwah ïa ka ba rung san .
translation.en: And not holding the Head , from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered , and knit together , increaseth with the increase of God .

translation.kha: ki Hynrei la ong ha u , ‘ Ko kynrad , u la don lypa shiphew tylli ki sbai ksiar !’
translation.en: ( And they said unto him , Lord , he hath ten pounds . )
And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes , and took firebrands , and turned tail to tail , and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit ban kem laispah tylli ki myrsiang . U teh syrdoh ïa ki tdong jong ki , shi jur shi jur , bad u buh ïa ki dongmusa ha kita ki syrdoh .

translation.en: There be four things which are little upon the earth , but they are exceeding wise :
translation.kha: Don saw jait ki mrad kiba rit ha ka pyrthei , hynrei kiba sian shikatdei eh :

translation.en: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain , even that was slain with the Midianite woman , was Zimri , the son of Salu , a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites .
translation.kha: Ka kyrteng uta u Israel uba la shah pynïap lang bad kata ka kynthei Midian ka long u Simri u khun jong u Salu , u khlieh jong ka longïing kaba na ka jait Simeon .

U Rehum u la jubab , rusom katno ki bymngeit ïasngewtynnat kiba bakla phi ki bri phi pynïasyriem ! Sa katno nga dei “Ki dang Malkhaïah bad jingkhum ? Sa katno ngan dang ïaishah jingoh-shrong phi ? To wallam ïa u khynnah shane sha nga !
translation.en: Then Jesus answered and said ,  O faithless and perverse generation , how long shall I be with you ? how long shall I suffer you ? bring him hither to me .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la pynbaptis , u la wan noh na ka Nangta ka bneng la plie ha u bad u ïohi ïa Mynsiem jong U Blei wan hiar kum ka paro bad da wan shong halor jong .
translation.en: And Jesus , when he was baptized , went up straightway out of the water : and , lo , the heavens were opened unto him , and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove , and lighting upon him :

translation.kha: U Trai la u ong ha u Hosia , Pynkyrteng ïa u , u ‘ Jesreel ,’ namar kan ym slem shuh shuwa ba ngan pynshitom ïa u syiem ki Israel namar ki kam pynïap briew ba u kpa tymmen jong u , u Jehu u la leh ha . Jesreel Ngan pynkut noh ïa jingsynshar ka na ka syiem longïing jong u Jehu .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Call his name Jezreel  ; for yet a little while , and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu , and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel .
Why did you tell him to go ?
translation.kha: Balei phi ong ia u ban leit noh ?

translation.en: And the king said unto me , ( the queen also sitting by him , ) For how long shall thy journey be ? and when wilt thou return ? So it pleased the king to send me  ; and I set him a time .
translation.kha: U patsha , ryngkat bad ka mahadei kaba shong ha syndah jong u , u la mynjur ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga . U la kylli ïa nga katno slem ngan jah bad ba ngan wan phai pat , bad nga ïathuh ha u .

U Trai , U synriah ki Israel pushara pynlyngngoh la ong ha nga , pyn-i Sabtah , ki briew jingpynrem ïa-ong ba ka sla , ka jingïapthngan , Sykomore ka jingpang kin pynlong ïa kane ka nongbah ban jingïapyrshah jinglur Libni kti jong u pyni ka Babilonia . lama , to shahshkor jingat kaei de kaba nga don ban ong .
translation.en: And now therefore thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , concerning this city , whereof ye say , It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword , and by the famine , and by the pestilence  ;

translation.kha: U ai ha nga ka jingjop halor ki jong nongshun nga , U pyndem ïa ki jaitbynriew hapoh jong nga ,
translation.en: It is God that avengeth me , and that bringeth down the people under me ,

translation.kha: Ka la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu , kumta ka la wan ryngkat bad u paidbah nadien jong u ,
translation.en: When she had heard of Jesus , came in the press behind , and touched his garment .

translation.kha: Ha ka miet shuwa ba u Herod un wallam u ïa sha u paidbah , u u Petros dang ïohthiah hapdeng ar ngut ki nongap phira . La teh ïa u da ar tylli ki kynjri , bad la don ki phira nongap kiba ap ha ka khyrdop jong ka byndi .
translation.en: And when Herod would have brought him forth , the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers , bound with two chains : and the keepers before the door kept the prison .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , ko u briew , wat sheptieng ïa ki lane ïa kano kano ba ki ong . Kin beiñ bad ym kheiñ ïa me bad long kumba im hapdeng ki ñianglartham . La katta ruh , wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba ïaleh lane ïa kano ki ong .
translation.en: And thou , son of man , be not afraid of them , neither be afraid of their words , though briers and thorns be with thee , and thou dost dwell among scorpions : be not afraid of their words , nor be dismayed at their looks , though they be a rebellious house .

translation.kha: Te u Moses u ong ha u Aaron , Kane ka long kaei kaba u U Trai la kren shaphang jong ka mynba u , ong ‘ Baroh kiba shakri ïa nga dei ki ban burom ïa ka jinglongkhuid jong nga ; ngan pynpaw ïa ka burom jong nga ha la ki briew .’ Hynrei u Aaron u shu sngap jar .
translation.en: Then Moses said unto Aaron , This is it that the  Lord  spake , saying , I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me , and before all the people I will be glorified . And Aaron held his peace .
Whoso eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , hath eternal life  ; and I will raise him up at the last day .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ïa ka doh jong nga bad dih ïa ka snam jong nga u don ka jingim bymjukut , bad ngan sa pynmihpat ïa u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .

translation.en: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them : for the  Lord  thy God is among you , a mighty God and terrible .
translation.kha: Kumta wat sheptieng ïa kita ki briew . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u don ryngkat bad phi ; u long U Blei uba donbor bad uba itieng .
Katba u dang don ha lynti sha ïing , ki jong ki la wan shem ïa u bad ka khubor , U khun me un im !
translation.en: And as he was now going down , his servants met him , and told him , saying , Thy son liveth .

And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt  ; and he shall burn them , and carry them away captives : and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt , as a shepherd putteth on his garment  ; and he shall go forth from thence in peace .
translation.kha: Ngan tbeh ïa ka ding ha ki templ jong ki blei ki Ijipt , bad u syiem ka Babilonia un thang ïa ki bleithaw jong ki ne ïalam noh ïa ki . Katba ki nongap langbrot ki dang jied ïa ki jaiñ jong ki kiba lait na ki jynreiñ , te u syiem ka Babilonia un jied pynkhuid ïa ka ri Ijipt bad nangta ki mih da ka jingjop .

translation.en: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold : their hooks were of gold  ; and he cast for them four sockets of silver .
translation.kha: Ki shna saw tylli ki païa da ka dieng akasia ha kiba yn wah ïa kata ka pyrda , ki suit ïa ki da ka ksiar , bad ki buh ha ki ïa ki bnoh ksiar . Nangta ki shna saw tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa kiba batskhem ïa kita ki païa .

translation.en: What are the questions ?
translation.kha: Kiei ki jingkylli ?
khmih kiwei ki jubab hynrei ngam shem ei . Nga la shem uwei u na ki shihajar ngut uba nga lah burom , hynrei ym don kawei ruh kynthei .
translation.en: Which yet my soul seeketh , but I find not : one man among a thousand have I found  ; but a woman among all those have I not found .
And he spake three thousand proverbs : and his songs were a thousand and five .
translation.kha: U la thoh lai hajar tylli ki proberb bad palat hajar tylli ki jingrwai .
Lymne ba u donkam ei ei kaba ngi lah ban da ai kaba trei na ka bynta jong u , namar ba u long u ma hi uba ai ka jingim bad ka mynsiem jingpyrsad bad ïa kaei kaei baroh ha uwei pa uwei .
translation.en: Neither is worshipped with men s hands , as though he needed any thing , seeing he giveth to all life , and breath , and all things  ;

translation.kha: bad napdeng jong ki , la don pyiar i kum U Khun U Briew , uba kup ka jaiñkup kaba Abbim haduh ki kjat jong u , bymlahlong u traishnong u jam ksiar sawdong ka shadem lyndang u Hannah

translation.kha: Bad ngan ïalam ïa phi borabor , bad pynkdang ïa phi da kiei kiei kiba bha . Ngan pynlong ïa phi kiba khlaiñ bad khiah krat . Phin long kum ka kper kaba pahuh um , kum ka umpohliew ka bym ju rngad .

translation.en: So the father knew that it was at the same hour , in the which Jesus said unto him ,  Thy son liveth :  and himself believed , and his whole house .
translation.kha: Te u kpa u la kynmaw ba ha kata hi ka kynta mynba U Jisu u la ong ïa u ,  U khun jong me un im .  Kumta ma u bad ka longïing jong u baroh ki la ngeit .
U Trai u ong , Ko Babilonia , tyndung long u tyrnem jong nga , ka atiar jong nga ha ïakob thma . Nga Yn pyndonkam jingpynbakla pha ban ïuhroit ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ïa ki hima Shan
translation.en: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war : for with thee will I break in pieces the nations , and with thee will I destroy kingdoms  ;
For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem : thou shalt weep no more : he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry  ; when he shall hear it , he will answer thee .
translation.kha: Ko phi ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem phin ym ïam shuh lano lano ruh . U  Trai  u long uba sngewsynei , bad haba phi kyang sha u ban ïoh jingïarap , un jubab ïa phi .
Nga long uba tip kaba kumno ka long ban shah pynshitom Blei .
translation.en: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath .
And when he came upon the stairs , so it was , that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people .
translation.kha: Ki la ïapoi haduh ki mawkyrdon lem bad u , bad nangta ki shipai ki la dei ban bah ïa u namar u paidbhur u la lamwir palat .
Lem bad u ngi ïa parabangeit uba la ñiewburom bha baroh balang na ka bynta ka jingtrei u ha kaba ïalap ïa ka gospel .
translation.en: And we have sent with him the brother , whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches ;
Know now that God hath overthrown me , and hath compassed me with his net .
translation.kha: Hato phim lah ban ïohi ba dei U Blei uba la leh ïa kane ? U la buh ïa ka jingriam ban kem ïa nga .
bad ong ha ki paidbah , Haba phi ïohi ïa lyngdoh ba ki ïa ka Jutang jong U Trai U Blei jong phi , loit noh ïa ka jaka shong dara bad bud ïa ki .
translation.en: And they commanded the people , saying , When ye see the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , and the priests the Levites bearing it , then ye shall remove from your place , and go after it .
Cry and howl , son of man : for it shall be upon my people , it shall be upon all the princes of Israel : terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people : smite therefore upon thy thigh .
translation.kha: To jlew da ka jingsngewsih , ko khun u briew ; kane ka waitlam ka dei na ka bynta ki briew jong nga bad na ka bynta ki nongïalam ki Israel baroh . Ïa ki yn pynïap lang bad kiba sah baroh na ki briew jong nga . Tied ïa la ka shadem ha ka jingnoh mynsiem !
U Blei ïalynñiar lah ban ïohsngew wat ïa ki hato ba mong jar hapoh ka dohnud kane ngi .
translation.en: God can hear even silent prayers said in our heart .

And I , even I Artaxerxes the king , do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river , that whatsoever Ezra the priest , the scribe of the law of the God of heaven , shall require of you , it be done speedily ,
translation.kha: Nga hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar ka ïing jingkynshew ha ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi ban pynbiang khlem pynslem ïa u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad ha ka Hukum jong U Blei ka Bneng , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u pan ,

translation.en: They stand fast for ever and ever , and are done in truth and uprightness .
translation.kha: Ki neh slem ha ki por baroh ; la ai ïa ki ha ka jingshisha bad ha ka hok .

translation.en: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand , and meted out heaven with the span , and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure , and weighed the mountains in scales , and the hills in a balance ?
translation.kha: Don uno uno uba lah ban thew ïa ka duriaw-bah da ki lynghoh kti lane ban thew ïa ka sahit bneng da ki kti jong u ? Don uno uno uba lah ban bat ïa ka khyndew jong ka pyrthei ha ka khuri lane thew ïa ki lumbah bad lumrit ha ki tarajur ?
Bad ka hukum kaba dei ban jingim wallam , ha nga , ka la wallam ka jingïap .
translation.en: And the commandment , which was ordained to life , I found to be unto death .
And if a house be divided against itself , that house cannot stand .
translation.kha: Lada ka longïing ka phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh pyrshah para ma ki , kata ka longïing kan kyllon noh .
Ha kawei Seïon por , u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u la pynlong tohmet jingïateh lok bad u Ahasaïah Dan syiem ka Israel , uba la leh bun kiei kiei kiba sniew .
translation.en: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel , who did very wickedly :
And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the  Lord  hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Me dei ban hikai ïa ki paid Israel ïa ki aiñ baroh kiba nga la ai ha me lyngba u Moses .

translation.en: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal , which he had built in Samaria .
translation.kha: U tei ka templ ïa u Baal ha Samaria , u shna ka duwan na ka bynta jong u bad u buh ïa ka ha ka templ .

translation.en: So the children went in and possessed the land , and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , and gavest them into their hands , with their kings , and the people of the land , that they might do with them as they would .
translation.kha: Ki la jop ïa ka ri Kanaan ; me la jop ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta . Me la ai ïa ki briew jong me ka bor ban leh ïa kaba ki sngewbha bad ki briew bad ki syiem ka Kanaan .

translation.en: Give out from among you three men for each tribe : and I will send them , and they shall rise , and go through the land , and describe it according to the inheritance of them  ; and they shall come again to me .
translation.kha: Ai ha nga lai ngut ki rangbah na kawei kawei ka jait . Ngan phah ïa ki ban leit lyngba ïa ka ri baroh kawei bad jurip ïa kata ka jaka kaba kin mon ban ïohkynti . Hadien kata kin wan pat ha nga .

Janoah u la jingpynlong ïa ka jingshitom kaba la ïathmu hok ïa ngi pynjem ka jingpang jingpynwandur Rehoboth la dei ibha shah . Jannai shi katta ngi la Sarai ba phlang pisa jong u ki tep long ki jingpynshitom ba la phah Ain U Blei .
translation.en: Surely he hath borne our griefs , and carried our sorrows : yet we did esteem him stricken , smitten of God , and afflicted .
And all mine are thine , and thine are mine  ; and I am glorified in them .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba nga don ka long ka jong me , bad baroh kaba me don ka long ka jong nga ; bad ïa ka burom jong nga la pynpaw lyngba jong ki .

translation.en: Then answered Simon , and said , Pray ye to the Lord for me , that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me .
translation.kha: U Simon u la ong ha u Petros bad u Ïoannis ,  Sngewbha duwai ha U Trai na ka bynta jong nga , khnang ba kawei ruh na kita kiei kiei kiba phi la kren kan ym jia ha nga .

translation.en: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew , which hath been sold unto thee  ; and when he hath served thee six years , thou shalt let him go free from thee : but your fathers hearkened not unto me , neither inclined their ear .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa ki ba man ki hynñiew snem ki dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uno uno u mraw Hebru uba la shakri ïa ki hynriew snem . Hynrei ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim shym la suidñiew ïa nga lane shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .

translation.en: They compassed me about like bees  ; they are quenched as the fire of thorns : for in the name of the  Lord  I will destroy them .
translation.kha: Ki la ïaboi sawdong jong nga kum ki ngap , hynrei ki la ing duh kloi kum ka ding hapdeng ki shiah ; da ka bor ka jong U  Trai  nga la pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: Let not thine heart envy sinners : but be thou in the fear of the  Lord  all the day long .
translation.kha: Wat sngewbishni ïa ki briew kiba leh pop , ai ba ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  kan long ha khmat ka jingim jong phi .

translation.en: And when Peter was come to himself , he said , Now I know of a surety , that the Lord hath sent his angel , and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod , and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews .
translation.kha: Te u Petros u la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba la lah jia ha u , bad u la ong ,  Mynta nga tip ba ka long kaba shisha ! U Trai u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban pyllait ïa nga na ka bor jong u Herod bad na kaei kaei baroh kaba ki Jiw ki la khmih lynti ba kan jia .

U paidbah byllien u la kumta sha u Ïoannis ban shah pynbaptis ha kynting . Phi ki bseiñ pynkdang u la jingpynkhlaiñ ha ki . Baasha ba la ong jingïathuhlypa arsut ba phi lah ban lait na ka Er kaba U janmiet pynjulor sa phah ?
translation.en: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him , O generation of vipers , who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?

translation.kha: Hynrei la katta ruh , katba ki don ha ka nongshun ki , ngan ym iehnoh syndon lane pynjot ïa ki . Da kumta ym pyndkut noh ïa ka jutang jong nga bad ki naba nga U Trai U Blei jong ki
translation.en: And yet for all that , when they be in the land of their enemies , I will not cast them away , neither will I abhor them , to destroy them utterly , and to break my covenant with them : for I am the  Lord  their God .
And Barzillai said unto the king , How long have I to live , that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Barsillai u jubab ,  Ngam don bun snem shuh ban im ; balei ngan leit bad U Syiem Kynrad sha Jerusalem ?

translation.en: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided , three against two , and two against three .
translation.kha: Naduh mynta ïa ka longïing kaba don san ngut yn phiah , ki lai ngut pyrshah ïa ki ar ngut bad ki ar ngut pyrshah ïa ki lai ngut .

translation.en: There is no end of all the people , even of all that have been before them : they also that come after shall not rejoice in him . Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit .
translation.kha: Ka lah ban ym don pud ïa ka jingdon ki briew kiba u syiem u synshar ; haba um don shuh , ym don mano mano uba sngewnguh ïa kaei kaba u la leh . Ka long ka bymmyntoi . Ka long kum ka jingbeh ïa ka lyer .

translation.en: What I tell you in darkness , that speak ye in light : and what ye hear in the ear , that preach ye upon the housetops .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi ha kaba dum phi dei ban ïathuh ha kaba shai , bad ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohsngew ha kaba rieh phi dei ban pynbna na ki tnum ïing .
Kynsan kynsan , U Engedi jong U Trai un wan da ka bor ha me , bad me ruh men ïashad bad ïarisa lang bad jingrakhe , bad men kylla long iwei uwei pat u briew .
translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  will come upon thee , and thou shalt prophesy with them , and shalt be turned into another man .
And Saul s servants spake those words in the ears of David . And David said , Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king s son in law , seeing that I am a poor man , and lightly esteemed ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa kane , bad u jubab ,  Ka long ka burom kaba khraw ban long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem , kaba khraw than ïa uba kum ma nga uba duk bad u bymdondor ei ei .

translation.en: And he said , What have they seen in thine house ? And Hezekiah answered , All the things that are in mine house have they seen : there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them .
translation.kha: Ki la ïohi aïu ha ka ïingsyiem ?   Ki la ïohi lut ïa kiei kiei . Ym don kano kano ha ki jaka buh tiar ïa kaba ngam shym la pyn-i ha ki .

Ngan pynïar sngewïahap ki pud jong ka ri jong phi naduh ka khmut duriaw Akaba haduh ka bakongsan Mediterranian bad Hadad ka ri shyiap haduh ka wah Ïuphratis . ïaphiah ai ha phi Pyntreikam bor halor ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka Jaser , bad phin beh noh ïa ki katba phi nang tur sha khmat .
translation.en: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines , and from the desert unto the river : for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand  ; and thou shalt drive them out before thee .
And Micaiah said , If thou certainly return in peace , then hath not the  Lord  spoken by me . And he said , Hearken , all ye people .
translation.kha: Lada phi wan phai khlem shah pynïap ,  u Mikaïah u pyrta ,  te U  Trai  um shym la kren lyngba jong nga !  Bad u ong shuh ,  Sngap ïa nga phi baroh , ïa kaei kaba nga la ong !
Haba la wanrah ïa u masi kum ka jingainguh thang Kumjuh lane kum ka jingkñia jingiaseng kaba pyndep ïa kano kano ka jingsmai skhem , lane kum ka jingainguh Nireus ,
translation.en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering , or for a sacrifice in performing a vow , or peace offerings unto the  Lord  :

translation.kha: U Ïoannis um la kyntait jubab hynrei , u la kren ha kaba bad da kaba shai , u da ong , dei u Messaïah .
translation.en: And he confessed , and denied not  ; but confessed , I am not the Christ .

And say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day when I chose Israel , and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob , and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt , when I lifted up mine hand unto them , saying , I am the  Lord  your God  ;
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Mynba nga la jied ïa ka Israel , nga la pynlong ka jingkular ha ki . Nga la pynpaw ïa lade ha ki ha Ijipt bad ong ïa ki : Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
U Paul u la ong , Nga ha khmat ka kamra u Patsha hi , ha kaba ka dei ban bishar nga . shym leh kano kano kaba bakla ki Jiw , kumba me hi me tip bha
translation.en: Then said Paul , I stand at Caesar s judgment seat , where I ought to be judged : to the Jews have I done no wrong , as thou very well knowest .

translation.kha: pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ki Katba ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka lyngkha baseisoh , uwei pa uwei u u ju maw ka haduh ba la tap lin ïa ki lyngkha ; ki la pynsangeh ïa ki umpohliew bad la pom ïa ki diengsoh . Ha kaba khatduh tang ka nongbah Kir Heres ka dang sah , bad ki nongkawang ki kerkut ïa bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translation.en: And they beat down the cities , and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone , and filled it  ; and they stopped all the wells of water , and felled all the good trees : only in Kir–hareseth left they the stones thereof  ; howbeit the slingers went about it , and smote it .
For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance , which the  Lord  your God giveth you .
translation.kha: namar phim pat rung ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , ha kaba phin ïoh shongsuk shongsaiñ .

translation.en: The lion is come up from his thicket , and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way  ; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate  ; and thy cities shall be laid waste , without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: Kum u sing uba wan mih na ka jakarieh jong u , u nongpynjot jong ki jaitbynriew u la mihnoh . U wan ban pynjot ïa ka Judah . Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah yn ieh ha ki jingjot , bad yn ym don mano mano bashong ba sah ha ki .
Ki jingkhublei ruh ïa u Urbanos uba ïatrei lem ngi ha ka kam Khrist , bad ïa u , u paralok ba-ieit jong nga .
translation.en: Salute Urbane , our helper in Christ , and Stachys my beloved .
And Nathan said , My lord , O king , hast thou said , Adonijah shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne ?
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , Hato phi la dep pynbna ba u Adonijah un long syiem hadien jong phi ?

translation.en: And they said , Arise , that we may go up against them : for we have seen the land , and , behold , it is very good : and are ye still ? be not slothful to go , and to enter to possess the land .
translation.kha: Ale ïeng ,  ki pynphai ktien ,  Ïa ngin leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Laish . Ngi la ïohi ïa kata ka jaka , bad ka long kaba seisoh bha . Wat shong hangne khlem leh ei ei ; pynkloi ! Leit rung shapoh bad dakhol ïa ka !

translation.en: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets , nor to your diviners , nor to your dreamers , nor to your enchanters , nor to your sorcerers , which speak unto you , saying , Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon :
translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi lane ïa uno uno uba kam ba u lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa la lawei , la ka long da ki jingphohsniew lane da kaba khot ïa ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap lane da ka myntor . Ma ki baroh kim ong ïa phi ban pyndem ha u syiem jong ka Babilonia .

translation.en: And she brought it before Saul , and before his servants  ; and they did eat . Then they rose up , and went away that night .
translation.kha: Ka buh ïa kata ka jingbam ha khmat u Saul bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ki ïabam . Nangta ki ïeng bad leit noh ha kata hi ka miet .
Hynrei don ki bym shym shahshkor ïa u Moses , la tyngkai khyndiat . Ha ka step kaba kata kaba sah boi ksaiñ bad ka sma , bad u Moses u la ïa ki
translation.en: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses  ; but some of them left of it until the morning , and it bred worms , and stank : and Moses was wroth with them .
And the second angel sounded , and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea : and the third part of the sea became blood  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba ar u la put ïa la ka turoi . Ïa kaei re kaei kaba i kum u lumbah uba khraw uba mehding la bret sha duriaw .
Ki bakohnguh ki Israel ki kren sarong bad jingpyntngen ong , ‘ Mynta kito ki lum ba-mynhyndai ki long ki jong ngi !’
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because the enemy hath said against you , Aha , even the ancient high places are ours in possession :

translation.kha: Ka la ber dpei ha la khlieh , ka la kad ïa la sopti , bad da kaba buhrieh la ka durkhmat da kaba tap da ki kti ka la leit noh da kaba .
translation.en: And Tamar put ashes on her head , and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her , and laid her hand on her head , and went on crying .
They that dwell under his shadow shall return  ; they shall revive as the corn , and grow as the vine : the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat kin shong hapoh ka jingïada jong nga . Kin thung ïa u kew bad seisoh kum ka bri sohwaiñ . Kin pawnam kum ka waiñ jong ka Lebanon .

Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ha Ijipt kim shym la sngewthuh ïa ki kam tipbriew jong U Blei ; ki la klet ba bunsien u la pyn-i ha ki pyndkut ka jingieit jong u , bad ki nongbatai ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Badonbor Baroh ha ka Duriaw Basaw .
translation.en: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt  ; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies  ; but provoked him at the sea , even at the Red sea .
These see the works of the  Lord  , and his wonders in the deep .
translation.kha: Ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u lah ban leh , ki kam baphylla jong u ha ki duriaw-rit .

translation.en: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes , and take away thy fair jewels .
translation.kha: Kin pynkad ïa ki jaiñ jong pha bad kin shim ïa ki mawlynnai jong pha .
Hynrei ki briew jong nga ki kyntait da ka jingmynthi jingbatnud pynshahshkor ïa nga . Ki khang ïa ki jingmut jong ki
translation.en: But they refused to hearken , and pulled away the shoulder , and stopped their ears , that they should not hear .

translation.kha: ïohnong u Nathan u bynrap , Nangta , katba phi dang ïakren bad u Syiem byrsha jingbishni ngan bymdonkam rung shapoh bad pynskhem ïa ka ishongkun jong phi .
translation.en: Behold , while thou yet talkest there with the king , I also will come in after thee , and confirm thy words .

translation.kha: Wat ki lyngdoh kiba wan sha jan jong nga ki dei ban pynkhuid ïa lade , lym kumta bthuh pynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: And let the priests also , which come near to the  Lord  , sanctify themselves , lest the  Lord  break forth upon them .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi un rah Ain la u pher buh ding , un buh hangta ïa ka jingiwbih , bad nangta un wanrah ïa ka Kedesh Pynthikna duwan .
translation.en: And take every man his censer , and put incense in them , and bring ye before the  Lord  every man his censer , two hundred and fifty censers  ; thou also , and Aaron , each of you his censer .

translation.kha: Da katto katne Gerar dieng u pynmeh ding ; u syang doh , u bam Makkedah ka , bad u kdang . U pynsyaid ngan lade bad u ong , Katno kaba sngewtynnat bad Jeiel Shammua Kore ka rhem ka ding !
translation.en: He burneth part thereof in the fire  ; with part thereof he eateth flesh  ; he roasteth roast , and is satisfied : yea , he warmeth himself , and saith , Aha , I am warm , I have seen the fire :
And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man , and their heart shall rejoice as through wine : yea , their children shall see it , and be glad  ; their heart shall rejoice in the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel kin long kiba khlaiñ kum ki shipai , kiba kmen kum ki rangbah kiba la dih waiñ . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin kynmaw ïa kane ka jingjop bad kin kmen namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh .
Hynñiew sngi Tebah la leit shipai ba U Trai U la shoh ïa ka wah .
translation.en: And seven days were fulfilled , after that the  Lord  had smitten the river .

translation.kha: Ki Pharisi , te , ki la kylli biang uta briew kumno la ïoh la ïathuh ïa ki , U la khyndiat ktieh ha ki jong ; nga bta , mynta nga la imat .
translation.en: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight . He said unto them , He put clay upon mine eyes , and I washed , and do see .
But these things have I told you , that when the time shall come , ye may remember that I told you of them . And these things I said not unto you at the beginning , because I was with you .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane , ba haba ka por ka poi ïa ki ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei , phin sa kynmaw ba nga la ïathuh ïa phi .  Ngam shym la ïathuh ha phi ïa kine kiei kiei ha kaba mynnyngkong , naba nga la don lem bad phi .
bad u ong shet u , Khie mareh , bad tam ïa ki khnam kiba ngan sa siat . Uta u mareh jingïasaid bad u Jonathan u siat ïa u khnam sha shuwa shaid u .
translation.en: And he said unto his lad , Run , find out now the arrows which I shoot . And as the lad ran , he shot an arrow beyond him .

translation.kha: Lada ka kti lane ka kjat phi ka pynlong ïa phi duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , ot bad bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha phi ban rung sha ka jingim khlem ka kti ka ban kaba don ar tylli ki kti bad ki kjat bad ban shah bret shapoh ka bymjukut .
translation.en: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee , cut them off , and cast them from thee : it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed , rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire .
So likewise ye , when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you , say , We are unprofitable servants : we have done that which was our duty to do .
translation.kha: Ka long kumjuh bad phi ; haba phi la pyndep ïa baroh kaba la bthah ïa phi ban leh , to ong , ‘ Ngi long ki tang ki shakri , ngi la pyndep tang ïa ka kamram jong ngi .’
