translation.kha: Bad lada uwei na ki shipai u pynbor ïa phi ban kit ïa ka jingkit jong u shi kilomitar , to kit ïa ka ar kilomitar .

translation.en: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation ? That the  Lord  hath founded Zion , and the poor of his people shall trust in it .
translation.kha: Kumno ngin jubab ïa ki nonglamktien kiba wan sha ngi na ki Philistia ? Ngin ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  u la seng nongrim ïa ka Seïon bad ba ki briew jong u kiba shahshitom kin shem ka jingshngain hangta .

U Ibsan kutlad jingïaikren ba Elparan khangkdong shynrang jong ïashongkurim Laban ki ïa-ong , U Jakob u jingbuhbeit shim lut baroh kat kaba dei markordor jong i pa jong ngi . U la Bethpelet lut ïa ka spah baroh na kaei Bethuel i pa jong ngi i don .
translation.en: And he heard the words of Laban s sons , saying , Jacob hath taken away all that was our father s  ; and of that which was our father s hath he gotten all this glory .

translation.kha: Phin lait phet lyngba kane ka them kaba pynkhlad arliang ïa une u lumbah . Phin phet kumba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la leh mynba u jumai u khynñiuh ha ka por jong u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah Trai . U Blei U jong nga un wan , un wallam ïa ki angel baroh bad lem u .
translation.en: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains  ; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal : yea , ye shall flee , like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah : and the  Lord  my God shall come , and all the saints with thee .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha nga , Shim ka tiar lyngkhot thoh jingthoh kaba heh bad thoh ka ha da ki dak kiba heh : ‘ Maher-shalal-hash-bas . ’
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  said unto me , Take thee a great roll , and write in it with a man s pen concerning Maher–shalal–hash–baz .
And the  Lord  said , Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great , and because their sin is very grievous  ;
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Abraham ,  Ki don ki jingkynnoh pyrshah kiba jur ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , bad ka pop jong ki ka long kaba khraw katta katta .

translation.en: Woe is me for my hurt ! my wound is grievous : but I said , Truly this is a grief , and I must bear it .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem ki kyang jam ,  Haduh katno la pynmong jur ïa ngi ! Ki jingmong jong ngi kin ym koit . Bad ngi la pyrkhat ba kane ka dei kaei kaei kaba ngi lah ban shah !
U la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros bad ki ïa ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Sebedi . Ka jingsngewsih bad ka lyng-a jingpisa ka la tyllep ïa u ,
translation.en: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee , and began to be sorrowful and very heavy .
For this cause I Paul , the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles ,
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw , nga u Paul , u nongsah byndi U Khrist Jisu na ka bynta jong phi ki Jentil , nga duwai ha U Blei .
Nangta phi dei ban wan ïalam ïa u para khatduh jong phi sha nga . Kane pynshisha ba phi kren hok , bad ngan ym pynïap ïa phi .
translation.en: But bring your youngest brother unto me  ; so shall your words be verified , and ye shall not die . And they did so .

translation.kha: Kin ym map lane leh-isynei ïano ïano , ki la dei ki samla ne ki tymmen .
translation.en: A nation of fierce countenance , which shall not regard the person of the old , nor shew favour to the young :

translation.kha: Ha ka jingleit kaba ar Joseph u u la pynithuh ïa lade ha la ki hynmen shynrang , bad u syiem Ijipt ka u la ïoh jingtip shaphang ka longïing jong u Joseph .
translation.en: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren  ; and Joseph s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh .

translation.kha: U Jisu bad la ki synran ki dang ïabam jingbam miet . U Ksuid u la bsuh lypa ha ka dohnud jong u kyndiah , u khun jong u Simon Iskariot , Assos dewbyrtha ban shetkylla ïa ïaryngkat Jisu .
translation.en: And supper being ended , the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot , Simon s son , to betray him  ;
For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts , murders , adulteries , fornications , thefts , false witness , blasphemies :
translation.kha: Namar na ka dohnud jong u ki mih ki jingpyrkhat basniew kiba ïalam ïa u ban pynïap briew , ban klim , bad ban leh ïa kiwei kiwei ki kam bajakhlia ; ban lute , ban lamler , bad ban kren sniew ïa kiwei .

translation.en: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon , and put my sword in his hand : but I will break Pharaoh s arms , and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan pynlong ïa ki ksang ti jong u syiem ka Babilonia kaba khlaiñ bad ngan buh ïa ka waitlam jong nga ha ki kti jong u . Hynrei ngan pynkheiñ ïa ki ksang ti jong u syiem ka Ijipt , bad un ud bad ïap ha khmat u nongshun jong u .

translation.en: And I answered again , and said unto him , What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves ?
translation.kha: Bad kaei ka jingmut jong ki ar tylli ki tnat dieng Olib hajan ki ar tylli ki tyndong ksiar na kaba la phylliew ïa ka umphniang Olib ?
ka Elon , ka Timnah , Ekron ka ,
translation.en: And Elon , and Timnah , and Ekron ,
And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti , unto the coast of Beth–horon the nether , and to Gezer : and the goings out thereof are at the sea .
translation.kha: Nangta u suh shaphang sepngi sha ka jaka jong ki Japhlet haduh ka jaka jong ka Beth Haron kaba Sharum . Nangta u suh sha Geser bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian .

translation.en: Moab is confounded  ; for it is broken down : howl and cry  ; tell ye it in Arnon , that Moab is spoiled ,
translation.kha: ‘ Ka Moab ka la kyllon ,’ kin jubab , ‘ ïam na ka bynta jong ka ; la pynjahburom ïa ka . Pynbna ha lynter ka wah Arnon ba ïa ka Moab la pynjot !’

translation.en: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father , that is ours , and our children s : now then , whatsoever God hath said unto thee , do .
translation.kha: Ka spah baroh kaba U Blei u la shim noh na i pa jong ngi ka dei ka jong ngi bad jong ki khun jong ngi . To leh katba U Blei u la bthah ïa phi .
Balei phi dei ban ïathuh ïa lem kiwei pat ïa kiei kiei kiba phi la tip ?
translation.en: Why tell others about what you are learning ?
Because they have done that which was evil in my sight , and have provoked me to anger , since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt , even unto this day .
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kane ha ki briew jong nga , namar ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga bad pynkhih bitar ïa nga naduh ka por ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la mihnoh na Ijipt haduh kane ka sngi .

translation.en: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people , and had taken of them bread and wine , beside forty shekels of silver  ; yea , even their servants bare rule over the people : but so did not I , because of the fear of God .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u lat uba don ha ka kam ha shuwa jong nga , u la long ka jingbankhia ïa ki briew bad ki ju dawa sawphew ki pisa rupa shi sngi na ka bynta ka jingbam bad ka waiñ . Wat ki shakri jong ki , ki ju banbeiñ ïa ki briew . Hynrei ngam shym leh kumta , namar nga burom ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And when he was come in , he saith unto them ,  Why make ye this ado , and weep ? the damsel is not dead , but sleepeth .
translation.kha: U la rung shapoh bad u la ong ïa ki ,  Balei katne katne ka jingkhynwin ? Balei ba phi ïa-ïam ? Ka khynnah kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !

translation.en: His breath goeth forth , he returneth to his earth  ; in that very day his thoughts perish .
translation.kha: Haba kin ïap , kin leit phai pat sha ka khyndew ; ha kata ka sngi baroh ki jingthmu jong ki kin sa kut noh .
U Jisu u la jubab , Lada phi la long kiba matlah , te phin ym long kiba la shah pynrem ; hynrei naba liengbah kam ba phi ïohi , kane ka mut ba phi jingpynhun don ha ka jingpynrem .
translation.en: Jesus said unto them ,  If ye were blind , ye should have no sin : but now ye say , We see  ; therefore your sin remaineth .

translation.kha: Pyndonkam da ki ktien shongnia kiba ïa kiba yn ym don wad ba daw , khnang ba yn ïoh pynlehrain ïa ki nongshun jong me da ka bym don ei ei kaba sniew ban ïoh kren pyrshah shaphang ngi jong .
translation.en: Sound speech , that cannot be condemned ; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed , having no evil thing to say of you .

And Gaal the son of Ebed said , Who is Abimelech , and who is Shechem , that we should serve him ? is not he the son of Jerubbaal ? and Zebul his officer ? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem : for why should we serve him ?
translation.kha: U Gaal u ong ,  Ki rangbah kiba kumno ngi long ha Shekhem ? Balei ba ngi shakri ïa u Abimelekh ? U dei uei uta ? U khun jong u Gideon ! Bad u Sebul u la ïoh hukum na u , hynrei balei ngi dei ban shakri ïa u ? To ïaineh ha u Hamor , u kpa tymmen jong phi , uba la seng ïa ka kur jong phi !
Kito kiba stad ki hikai ki jingshisha kiba ki la nang na ki kpa tymmen jong , kim shym ei ei .
translation.en: Which wise men have told from their fathers , and have not hid it :
Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds , to hear the bleatings of the flocks ? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart .
translation.kha: Balei ki sah shadien lem bad ki langbrot ? Hato ban sngap ki nongap langbrot kiba khot ïa ki jingri ? Ho-oid , ki jait Reuben kim ïabeit jingmut , Kim shym lah rai ban ïawan .
Ngi thoh ïa kane khnang ba ka jong jingkmen ngi kan long kaba dap pura .
translation.en: And these things write we unto you , that your joy may be full .

translation.kha: U nongrep uba trei shitom u don kyrhai ban bam . Ki kiba pynsyrwa ïa ka por duk lynter .
translation.en: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread : but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough .
And the shepherds came and drove them away : but Moses stood up and helped them , and watered their flock .
translation.kha: Hynrei don ki nongap langbrot kiba wan beh noh ïa ki . Te u Moses u leit ban ïada ïa ki bad u ïarap ai um ruh ïa ki jingri jong ki .

Lada u kynran Peres sha ka nongbah , ki briew jong ngi baroh kin wallam ïa thawsha bakhrawbor bad kin shu tan sharati ka nongbah shapoh ynda ram . (Khlem ym don uwei ruh u maw ïa uba yn iehnoh ha kliar jingklim .
translation.en: Moreover , if he be gotten into a city , then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city , and we will draw it into the river , until there be not one small stone found there .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren pat ha nga .
translation.en: The  Lord  spake also unto me again , saying ,

translation.kha: katba kum ka jinglong hynmen para jong ki , hynriew ki na kyrteng jong ki uwei ha u mawkordor bad hynriew ha uwei pat u mawkordor .
translation.en: Six of their names on one stone , and the other six names of the rest on the other stone , according to their birth .
I know that thou canst do every thing , and that no thought can be withholden from thee .
translation.kha: Nga tip , A  Trai  , ba me long uba khrawbor tam ; ba me lah ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba me kwah .

translation.en: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people , that thou wilt not let them go ?
translation.kha: Pynban me dang sngew hangamei , bad me kyntait ban pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation , and concerning a kingdom , to pluck up , and to pull down , and to destroy it  ;
translation.kha: Lada ha kano kano ka por nga ong ba ngan rat , ngan pynkheiñ , lane pynjot ïa kano kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima ,

translation.en: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew phra jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah , u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Jeroboam uba ar u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar hynriew bnai ha Samaria .
Nga jingmut ban pynjot ïa ka namar kaba sniew ba la leh da ki paid Judah bad ka Jerusalem ryngkat bad syiem bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa jong ki .
translation.en: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah , which they have done to provoke me to anger , they , their kings , their princes , their priests , and their prophets , and the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ki jingkren kiba bymriewblei ki long kiba jylliew katta katta Nobah u briew uba bieit ban sngewthuh Lasharon Phin poh ei Eliphas ban jingpyut haba ïa ki kam Jingpynshitom la ïatainia .
translation.en: Wisdom is too high for a fool : he openeth not his mouth in the gate .
While Peter thought on the vision , the Spirit said unto him , Behold , three men seek thee .
translation.kha: U Petros u dang ïai pyrshang ban shemphang aïu ka jingïohipaw ka kit jingmut , haba U Mynsiem u la ong ,  Ha sngap ! Lai ngut ki rangbah ki ïawad ïa me .
ki briew ka Benjamin to phet ban lait im ! Phet noh na Jerusalem ! ïa ka turoi ha Tekoa bad thaw ka ding-ai-dak Beth Hakkherem . jingjot ka ki la wan artat .
translation.en: O ye children of Benjamin , gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem , and blow the trumpet in Tekoa , and set up a sign of fire in Beth–haccerem : for evil appeareth out of the north , and great destruction .

translation.kha: Ngi ïap Arad ngi hiar pateng na jingdiang Adam bad ka Im .
translation.en: We die because we all come from Adam and Eve .

translation.kha: Nangta napdeng ka erïong Trai U u la kren ha u Job .
translation.en: Then the  Lord  answered Job out of the whirlwind , and said ,
There was a man of the Pharisees , named Nicodemus , a ruler of the Jews :
translation.kha: La don u nongïalam jong ki Jiw uba kyrteng u Nikodemos , uba dei na ka kynhun ki Pharisi .

translation.en: And he saith unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Hereafter ye shall see heaven open , and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phin sa ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad ki angel jong U Blei ba ki ïakiew bad ïahiar ha U Khun U Briew .

translation.en: So the priest gave him hallowed bread : for there was no bread there but the shewbread , that was taken from before the  Lord  , to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away .
translation.kha: Kumta uta u lyngdoh u ai ha u Dabid ïa uta u kpu bakyntang , namar u kpu uba u don , u dei uba la ainguh ha U Blei , ïa uba la weng noh na ka miej bakyntang , bad ba la bujli da u kpu uba dang lah shet .

Nangta ki phai dien bad ki wan poi biang sha Kadesh ( kaba la tip mynshuwa kum ka Enmishpat . ) Ki la jop ïa ka ri baroh jong ki Amalek , ki bad la ïa jop ki Amor ruh kiba shong basah ha Hasason Tamar .
translation.en: And they returned , and came to En–mishpat , which is Kadesh , and smote all the country of the Amalekites , and also the Amorites , that dwelt in Hazazon–tamar .

translation.kha: U Moses u lut ïa ka Aiñ U Blei ha ka , khlem da kawei ruh ka ktien .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book , until they were finished ,

translation.kha: ka Kaei jynjar jong pha ? Ka jubab , Ha kato ka sngi , kane briew ka hangne ka ai jingmut ba ngin ïabam ïa u khun jong nga , bad ban bam ïa u khun jong ka ka ha sngi kaba bud .
translation.en: And the king said unto her , What aileth thee ? And she answered , This woman said unto me , Give thy son , that we may eat him to day , and we will eat my son to morrow .

translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga kren , bad wat klet ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ïa phi ban leh .
translation.en: My son , keep my words , and lay up my commandments with thee .

translation.kha: ki la ïabam ïa baroh ki jingthung ha ka ri ; bad ki la ïabam ïa baroh ki jingthung ba pynkyrteng jingbam .
translation.en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land , and devoured the fruit of their ground .

translation.kha: U Baasha u jong u Ahijah , uba na ka jait , u la ïasuhbuit pyrshah ïa u Nadab bad u la pynïap ïa u katba Nadab bad kynhun jong u ki dang ïa ka nongbah ha .
translation.en: And Baasha the son of Ahijah , of the house of Issachar , conspired against him  ; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon , which belonged to the Philistines  ; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon .
And now , O  Lord  God , the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant , and concerning his house , establish it for ever , and do as thou hast said .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , A  Trai  U Blei , to pyndep ha ki por baroh ïa ka kular ba me la pynlong shaphang jong nga bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad to leh kumba me la kren ba men leh .
Em , ko khun jong nga , u syiem u jubab . Kan bankhia eh ïa phi lada ngi baroh ngi ïaleit . Absalom u la ïai , hynrei u syiem um shym mynjur bad u la ong ïa u Absalom ban mihnoh .
translation.en: And the king said to Absalom , Nay , my son , let us not all now go , lest we be chargeable unto thee . And he pressed him : howbeit he would not go , but blessed him .

translation.kha: Ki kmie ki kpa ― u jingshongshngain la ong ïa kane namar thiar bajaipdeh la sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar ïa-ithuh ki hakhmat , kiba la Pentekost mynjur lypa ba jingkitpop Ashtaroth uba ong ba u ngeit ba U Jisu u long U Ishbak un shah beh noh na ka synagog .
translation.en: These words spake his parents , because they feared the Jews : for the Jews had agreed already , that if any man did confess that he was Christ , he should be put out of the synagogue .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki synran jong u , Haba nga la haba noh ïa phi ha kato jingkynnoh por khlem ka pla pisa , sawspah pla , lane ki juti , satar pynbuaid ïaduna ei Pung ? Ym duna wat kawei ruh , ki la jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  When I sent you without purse , and scrip , and shoes , lacked ye any thing ?  And they said , Nothing .

translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah kiba bah ïa ka Synduk Jutang ki la ïaid jam , u Dabid u la phah ïa ki ban sangeh u ai ka jingkñia ïa U Trai da u masi bad khun masi ba la pynsngaid .
translation.en: And it was so , that when they that bare the ark of the  Lord  had gone six paces , he sacrificed oxen and fatlings .
And he spake many things unto them in parables , saying ,  Behold , a sower went forth to sow  ;
translation.kha: U la pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ban ïathuh ïa ki shibun kiei kiei .  Shisien la don u briew uba la mihnoh ban bet symbai .
Ki shna ïa ka jingdeng da ka nylla , kaba dak kaba khuid jong ka jingpynkyntang bad ki ha ka , La Pynkyntang U Trai .
translation.en: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold , and wrote upon it a writing , like to the engravings of a signet , HOLINESS TO THE  Lord .

translation.kha: Te lada uno uno u kylli ïa u , ‘ kito ki jingmong ha ka shadem jong phi ?’ Un jubab , ‘ Nga la ïoh ki ha ka ïing
translation.en: And one shall say unto him , What are these wounds in thine hands ? Then he shall answer , Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends .

No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper  ; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn . This is the heritage of the servants of the  Lord  , and their righteousness is of me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei yn ym don ka tiar thma ka ban lah ban pynmynsaw ïa pha ; phan don ka jubab ïa kito baroh kiba mudui ïa pha . Ngan kyrshan ïa ki shakri jong nga bad ngan ai jingjop ïa ki .  U  Trai  u la kren .

ïingsyiem phah ïa pha sha trai jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap junom pynïasoh bad ki nongkurup kiba ïa-ot ha shen por mynbarim . Ngan pynlong ïa pha ba phan briew’ ha kata ka pyrthei kheit shapoh ka khyndew hapdeng ki jingjot bymjukut , ban ïadon lang bad kiba ïap . LONG phan ym Hegai shuh ban shong ban sah ha ka ri jong ki briew kiba im sarong
translation.en: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit , with the people of old time , and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth , in places desolate of old , with them that go down to the pit , that thou be not inhabited  ; and I shall set glory in the land of the living  ;
Are they Japanese ?
translation.kha: Ki dei ki nongjapan ?

translation.en: For for this cause pay ye tribute also : for they are God s ministers , attending continually upon this very thing .
translation.kha: Kata ka long ruh balei ba phi dei ban siew ki khajna , namar ki bor synshar ki trei na ka bynta U Blei haba ki pyndep ïa la ki kamram .

translation.en: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead , she arose and destroyed all the seed royal .
translation.kha: Ka Athalaïah ka kmie jong u syiem Ahasaïah ka tang shu mar ïatip ïa ka jingshah pynïap u khun jong ka , ka ai hukum ba yn pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot jong ka longïing syiem .

translation.en: Now therefore go , and I will be with thy mouth , and teach thee what thou shalt say .
translation.kha: Mynta , khie leit ! Ngan ïarap ïa me ban kren , bad ngan ïathuh ïa me aïu men ong .

translation.en: The sons of Rachel  ; Joseph , and Benjamin :
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Rakhel ki long u Joseph bad u Benjamin .

translation.en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name , who dealeth in proud wrath .
translation.kha: Pyni ha nga ïa u briew uba sarong bad ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa u briew uba hangamei , uba sarong bad u bym ju kheiñ briew .
Ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi ha ka jingbitar jong nga ; ngan ym pynjot shuh ki . Namar nga dei U Blei bad ym u briew . nga , uta Uba Khuid ngan long bad phi . ym wan sha phi ha ka jingbitar .
translation.en: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger , I will not return to destroy Ephraim : for I am God , and not man  ; the Holy One in the midst of thee : and I will not enter into the city .

translation.kha: Te balei ba me bniah ïa baroh pop jong nga bad ïit lut ïa kawei pa ka jingduna ba nga don ?
translation.en: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity , and searchest after my sin ?
Egypt riseth up like a flood , and his waters are moved like the rivers  ; and he saith , I will go up , and will cover the earth  ; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka Ijipt , kaba shlei kum ka Nile , kum ka wah ba shlei ïa ki rud jong ka . Ka Ijipt ka ong , ‘ Ngan shlei bad ngan tyllep ïa ka pyrthei ; ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad ïa ki briew bashong hangta .

translation.en: And he sent young men of the children of Israel , which offered burnt offerings , and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u la phah ïa ki samla shynrang bad ki la thang ïa ki jingkñia sha U  Trai  bad ki la kñia katto katne tylli ki jingri kum ki jingainguh jingïasyllok .

translation.en: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it  ; the molten image , and a teacher of lies , that the maker of his work trusteth therein , to make dumb idols ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka jingdonkam jong ka bleithaw ? Ka long tang kaei kaei kaba la thaw da u briew , bad kam kren ei ei hynrei ka shukor . Kaei kaba bha ba ka leh ïa u nongthaw ba un shaniah ha ka — U Blei u bym lah wat ban kren !

Long ba la tim ïa u Amnon uba tei bajaipdeh minit ka ïing da ka jingbymhok , bad uba pynheh pynïar ïa ka jingkhor ka jingleh bymhok ; uba pynlong ïa la Hotham ïasan shnong ban trei khlem kam kylleng bad u bym jinglwet bainong ïa ki pudina
translation.en: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness , and his chambers by wrong  ; that useth his neighbour s service without wages , and giveth him not for his work  ;
And he answered and said unto them ,  I tell you that , if these should hold their peace , the stones would immediately cry out .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga ong ha phi ba lada ki sngap jar , ki maw hi kin sa sdang ban pyrta .
U Trai ong ha u Moses , Leit kiew sha u bad khmih ïa kata ka ri kaba nga ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Get thee up into this mount Abarim , and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u ong , Ka kyrteng jong me kam long shuh u Jakob . la Me ïaleh bad U Blei ki bad briew , me bad la jop ruh ; kumta ka kyrteng jong me kan long noh u Israel .
translation.en: And he said , Thy name shall be called no more Jacob , but Israel : for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men , and hast prevailed .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynïap troiñ sngewrit te Shelishiyah ïa pynkieng jingkwah jingtyllun ba nongïapeiñ jingkynnoh kiba Shabbethai hapoh jong phi , kum ka jingawria , ka jingkhlem-akor , ka jingkwah brai , jingpyrta-thma jingkwah basniew jingpynkyntang bad theisamla jinglalot Ba-ijli ka jinglalot ka long kawei premmiet ka dur jong ka jingmane bleithaw) .
translation.en: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth ; fornication , uncleanness , inordinate affection , evil concupiscence , and covetousness , which is idolatry :

translation.kha: Ai ha kiba bad duk phin ym don ha ka jingkyrduh lano lano ruh . phi Lada khapbrip la ki khmat sha kiba duk , ki briew kiba bun kin tim ïa phi .
translation.en: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack : but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse .

translation.kha: Ka paid ka Hattaabah tei ki kut na ka bynta ïa jingpang bad ka tin kynton shibun eh ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka la sleh kum ontep tngit jingrisa
translation.en: And Tyre did build herself a strong hold , and heaped up silver as the dust , and fine gold as the mire of the streets .

translation.kha: Ka kham bha ba duk bad ba long hok ban kaba ïa riewspah bad ïaid kynriang .
translation.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness , than he that is perverse in his ways , though he be rich .
I came forth from the Father , and am come into the world : again , I leave the world , and go to the Father .
translation.kha: Nga la wan na U Kpa , bad nga la wan sha ka pyrthei ; bad mynta ngan sa iehnoh ïa ka pyrthei bad ngan leit sha U Kpa .

Nga la Bohan ïa phi ïa ki Sherebaïah , ïaiban jingthohbria Trai U nongbeh jong ïapli rngad la hukum ïa Mynmiet ksan Sumar bad leh ïa ki Seneh pynngam ka Ade sha kaba phin sa leit sngewsheptieng ïohkynti .
translation.en: Behold , I have taught you statutes and judgments , even as the  Lord  my God commanded me , that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it .
And the  Lord  thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little : thou mayest not consume them at once , lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee .
translation.kha: Suki pa suki un beh krad ïa kine ki jaitbynriew katba phi nang tur sha khmat . Phin ym lah ban pynduh lut ïa ki shisyndon , namar , lada phi leh kumta , ki mradkhlaw kin jyllei palat bad kin long ka jingma pynban ïa phi .
Baroh kin tip ba ma nga U , Trai , nga la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad ba ngan ym buh noh ïa ka .
translation.en: That all flesh may know that I the  Lord  have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath : it shall not return any more .
Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store , as God hath prospered him , that there be no gatherings when I come .
translation.kha: Man la ka Sngi U Trai , uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban buh kyrpang katto katne ka pisa , kat kum ka jingïoh , bad pynlang ïa ka , khnang ba yn ym da donkam ban lum ïa ka pisa ynda nga poi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said to Samuel , Hearken unto their voice , and make them a king . And Samuel said unto the men of Israel , Go ye every man unto his city .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Leh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah , bad ai syiem noh ïa ki .  Nangta u Samuel u ong ïa ki rangbah Israel baroh ban leit phai sha la ïing .

translation.en: And the child Samuel grew on , and was in favour both with the  Lord  , and also with men .
translation.kha: Uta u khynnah Samuel , u nang san bad u nang shem ïa ka jingsngewbha na U  Trai  bad na ki briew .

translation.en: In that he saith , A new covenant , he hath made the first old . Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away .
translation.kha: Da kaba ong ka jutang bathymmai , U Blei u la pynlong rim ïa kata kaba nyngkong ; bad kano kano kaba kylla rim bad nang tymmen kan sa jah noh shen .
Ko Pharisi bamatlah ! To pynkhuid nyngkong kaei ïa kaba shapoh jong ka khuri , bad nangta kaba shabar kan long ruh kaba khuid !
translation.en: Thou blind Pharisee , cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter , that the outside of them may be clean also .

translation.kha: Me ai ha ka jingkhlaiñ ïaleh thma , bad ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga .
translation.en: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle : them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , buh Ngan pat ïa briew ki jong nga ha ka ri jong ki bad isynei ngan ïa kawei pa kawei ka longïing ; ïa ka Jerusalem yn tei pat , bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong ka yn pynbha pat .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will bring again the captivity of Jacob s tents , and have mercy on his dwellingplaces  ; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap , and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof .
And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years  ; seven years reigned he in Hebron , and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U la synshar ha Hebron hynñiew snem ha Jerusalem laiphew lai snem .

translation.en: The tree grew , and was strong , and the height thereof reached unto heaven , and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth :
translation.kha: U la nang san nang san tad haduh ba u la kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng bad ba lah ban ïohi da baroh kiba don ha ka pyrthei .
Hangta ha ka raikhoh shyiap iphuh la pihuiñ ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , Athens shakri bakhuid jong U Trai .
translation.en: They envied Moses also in the camp , and Aaron the saint of the  Lord .
If a man be found lying with a woman married to an husband , then they shall both of them die , both the man that lay with the woman , and the woman : so shalt thou put away evil from Israel .
translation.kha: Lada lap ïa uno uno u briew ba u ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew , baroh ar ngut ki dei ban shah pynïap , bad kumta phin pynduh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman na Israel .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house , and all Solomon s desire which he was pleased to do ,
translation.kha: Ynda u syiem Solomon u la dep tei ïa ka ïing U  Trai  bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , nalor kiwei pat kiba u la kwah ban tei ,
Nangta U Jisu u la pynlong ki synran ban kiew ha lieng bad ban nang leit sha shiliang duriaw , katba u la nang phah noh ïa u paidbah .
translation.en: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship , and to go before him unto the other side , while he sent the multitudes away .

translation.kha: To ainguh uba khraw tam ki blei baroh ; ka jingieit u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the God of gods : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka pyrda , thaw san tylli ki ka dieng akasia ba la suit ksiar Ki bnoh jong ki ruh ki dei ban long da ka . Thaw san tylli ki thliew tnaw rnong ha ka bynta ki rishot
translation.en: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , and their hooks shall be of gold : and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them .

And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while , and then took his leave of the brethren , and sailed thence into Syria , and with him Priscilla and Aquila  ; having shorn his head in Cenchrea : for he had a vow .
translation.kha: U Paul u la nang sah kham bun sngi bad ki parabangeit ha Korinth , nangta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit da ka lieng lem bad ka Priskila bad u Akwila sha Syria . Ha shuwa ba un leit da ka lieng na Kenkhria u la phah khi ïa la ka khlieh namar ka jingsmai kaba u la pynlong .
Ainguh Khenani kine nalor —Nong Ijipt Ïateh kiba man ka step .
translation.en: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning , which is for a continual burnt offering .

translation.kha: Ha ka pyrthei ba ka jingim kaba suk lem bad ka jingkoit ba janai 21 :3 , .
translation.en: In a coming new world , life in perfect health and happiness . —Revelation 21 :3 , 4 .
And it came to pass , when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things , that he sent to Jobab king of Madon , and to the king of Shimron , and to the king of Achshaph ,
translation.kha: Haba ka khubor shaphang ka jingjop ki Israel ka la poi ha u Jabin u syiem ka Hasor , u phah ktien sha u Jobab u syiem ka Madon , sha u syiem ka Shimron bad u syiem ka Akhshaph ,

translation.en: And his miracles , and his acts , which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt , and unto all his land  ;
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi kumno u la leh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei .

translation.en: Luke , the beloved physician , and Demas , greet you .
translation.kha: U Loukas , u doktor ba-ieit jong ngi , bad u Demas ki phah ki jingai khublei ïa phi .

translation.en: After this there was a feast of the Jews  ; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la leit sha Jerusalem na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: And the king said , What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this ? Then said the king s servants that ministered unto him , There is nothing done for him .
translation.kha: U syiem u kylli ,  Kumno ngi la pyndonburom bad ai bainong ïa u Mordekai na ka bynta kane ?  Ki shakri jong u ki jubab ,  Ym shym la leh ei ei na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine .
translation.kha: Ka jingthngan ka la pynlong ïa ngi ban ing da ka jingshit , tad haduh ba ka sniehdoh jong ngi ka long kaba khluit kum ka pajwa .

translation.en: Take of them of the captivity , even of Heldai , of Tobijah , and of Jedaiah , which are come from Babylon , and come thou the same day , and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah  ;
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Shim ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba la ai da u Heldai , u Tobijah bad u Jedaïah kiba la shah ringmraw , bad leit shisyndon sha ka ïing jong u Josaïah u khun jong u Sephanaïah . Kine ki rangbah baroh ki la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilonia .

translation.en: Go to now , ye rich men , weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , phi ki briew kiba riewspah , to shahshkor ïa nga ! to ïam bad to lynñiar ïa ki jinglanot ki ban wan hap ha phi !

translation.en: Till the  Lord  look down , and behold from heaven .
translation.kha: Tad haduh ba U  Trai  un da khmih sha tbian na bneng bad ïohi ïa ngi .

translation.en: Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with divers seeds : lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown , and the fruit of thy vineyard , be defiled .
translation.kha: Wat bet ïa uwei pat u symbai ha kajuh ka bri ba phi thung dieng sohwaiñ ; lada phi leh kumta , phim lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki sohwaiñ lane ïa u soh jong uta uwei pat u jingthung .
Ïalang paralok saiñ uba jingit bad phin kylla stad . Lada phi ïalang paralok bad ki briew kiba bieit , phin long kiba bieit .
translation.en: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise : but a companion of fools shall be destroyed .

translation.kha: pyllait noh ïa ki saw ngut ki angel ; ka bynta kane hi ka kynta jong kane hi ka jong une hi bad ka snem ïa ki la buh pynkhreh ban pynïap noh shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong u bynriew .
translation.en: And the four angels were loosed , which were prepared for an hour , and a day , and a month , and a year , for to slay the third part of men .
For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba U Blei u la thaw ka long kaba bha ; ym dei ban kyntait ei ei , hynrei ïa kiei kiei baroh dei ban pdiang lem bad ka jingduwai sngewnguh , namar ïa ka la pynkyntang da ka ktien U Blei bad ka jingduwai , kiba pynlong ïa ki ba la pdiang da U Blei .
Kita ki jingthaw hi ki phet shane bad shatai bad ki stet la kum jingthew jingthaba ka leilieh .
translation.en: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning .
And as it was in the days of Noah , so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man .
translation.kha: Kumba ka la long ha ka por jong u Noah kumta kan long ha ki sngi jong U Khun U Briew .

translation.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom , The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time .
translation.kha: U Hushai u jubab ,  Ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahithophel u la ai ha phi ha kane ka por kam long kaba bha .

U la jubab , Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba nga don u ha Lum Gilboa , bad nga la ïohi ïa u Saul ba u dang shaniah ha la u sum katba ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai jong ki nongshun ki la hajan . jong u
translation.en: And the young man that told him said , As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa , behold , Saul leaned upon his spear  ; and , lo , the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him .
I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house , and flourishing in my palace :
translation.kha: Nga la shongsuk ha la ka ïing syiem , da kaba lehkmen ïa ka jingmanbha bakhraw .

translation.en: O ye seed of Israel his servant , ye children of Jacob , his chosen ones .
translation.kha: Ma phi kiba hiarpateng na u Jakob , u shakri jong U Blei , kiba hiarpateng na u Israel , ïa uba U Blei u la jied , kynmaw ïa ki kambah kiba U Blei u la leh bad ki jingbishar kiba u la ai .

translation.en: And they asked him , and said unto him , Why baptizest thou then , if thou be not that Christ , nor Elias , neither that prophet ?
translation.kha: Ki nonglamktien , ïa kiba la phah da ki Pharisi , ki la kylli te ïa u Ïoannis ,  Lada mem dei u Messaïah lane u Elijah lane u nongïathuhlypa , balei pat me pynbaptis ?

Nga la ong , To Kushan ïa U Trai , phi malu kynthei , ksuid to pynshahshkor ïa ki ktien jong Bethdagon . To hikai ïa ki otsher kynthei jong phi kumno ban ïambriew , bad ïa ki paralok jong phi kumno Seneh rwai ka jingrwai ïapbriew .
translation.en: Yet hear the word of the  Lord  , O ye women , and let your ear receive the word of his mouth , and teach your daughters wailing , and every one her neighbour lamentation .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u jingthrew , Pyllait noh ïa nga ; ka kynsha sdang siang shai . Em , ngan kdor pyllait , lymda me kyrkhu ïa nga , ong u Jakob .
translation.en: And he said , Let me go , for the day breaketh . And he said , I will not let thee go , except thou bless me .

translation.kha: Kumta u Paul u la sah hangta shisnem shiteng , u da hikai ha ki ïa ka jong ktien U Blei .
translation.en: And he continued there a year and six months , teaching the word of God among them .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki briew ka Ammon ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da ïa shisha ki . Ha ki jong ki thma ban pynïoh bun ki jaka , ki la puid wat ïa ki kynthei kiba punkhun ha Gilead .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead , that they might enlarge their border :

translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïaid bad sharum jong ka ri , man ki ïa ka shyieng briew , kin buh dak hajan kata , ba kumta ki jingtep kin wan bad tep ïa ka ha ka Kynhun Shipai Gog .
translation.en: And the passengers that pass through the land , when any seeth a man s bone , then shall he set up a sign by it , till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon–gog .
That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven , and pray for the life of the king , and of his sons .
translation.kha: Ïa kane dei ban leh khnang ba ki lah ban ai ki jingkñia ba pdiang hun ha U Blei jong ka Bneng bad duwai ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u halor jong nga bad ki khun shynrang jong nga .

translation.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job , because he was righteous in his own eyes .
translation.kha: Namar ba u Job u sngewskhem ïa ka jinglong balui lui jong u hi , kita ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki iehnoh ïa ka ban pyrshang ban jubab ïa u .

translation.en: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of : The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits , the breadth of it fifty cubits , and the height of it thirty cubits .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka shispah laiphew lai mitar ka lynter , arphew ar mitar ka pyngkiang bad khatlai mitar ka jingjrong .

translation.en: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years , whereof the word of the  Lord  came to Jeremiah the prophet , that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong ka jingsynshar jong u , nga la pule bniah ïa ki kitab bakyntang bad pyrkhat shaphang ki hynñiewphew snem kiba ka Jerusalem kan don ha ki jingpra , kat kum kaei kaba U  Trai  u la lah ïathuh ha u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when all our enemies heard thereof , and all the heathen that were about us saw these things , they were much cast down in their own eyes : for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God .
translation.kha: Haba ki nongshun jong ngi kiba don ha ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong ngi ki ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewthuh ba ki la poi ha ka jinglehrain , namar baroh ki tip ba ïa ka jingtrei la pyndep da ka jingïarap U Blei .

translation.en: And she said unto them , Call me not Naomi , call me Mara : for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me .
translation.kha: Wat khot ïa nga , ka Naomi ,  ka jubab ;  khot noh ïa nga , ka Marah , namar U Blei Bakhrawbor u la pynlong ïa ka jingim jong nga kaba kthang .

ïa ka jutang jong phi bad nga Trai phi , bad pynkyntang ïa ha nga , phi ki briew jong ka bad Jerusalem . Lymda kumta , ka jingbitar jong nga kan ing kum ka ding namar kiei kiei kiba kiba la leh . Kan bad yn ym don mano mano ba pynlip ïa ka .
translation.en: Circumcise yourselves to the  Lord  , and take away the foreskins of your heart , ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem : lest my fury come forth like fire , and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .

translation.kha: Naba meeting Hukum u Moses kam lah ban pynlong janai ïano kano Harnepher . Bad mynta la ai ïa pynkhuslai jingkyrmen kaba kham bha da kaba ngi lah Ela wan sha jan U Blei .
translation.en: For the law made nothing perfect , but the bringing in of a better hope did  ; by the which we draw nigh unto God .

But Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , had no sons , but daughters : and these are the names of his daughters , Mahlah , and Noah , Hoglah , Milcah , and Tirzah .
translation.kha: U Selophehad u khun jong u Hepher , u khun jong u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir , u khun jong u Manasseh , um don khun shynrang ; hynrei tang ki khun kynthei . Ki kyrteng jong ki , ki long ka Mahlah , ka Noah , ka Hoglah , ka Milkah , bad ka Tirsah .

translation.en: Praise him , ye heavens of heavens , and ye waters that be above the heavens .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki bneng bajrong tam , bad ki um halor ka sahit bneng .
Mynta la thung ïa jaiñsem ha ka ri kiei! Bethanath ha ka da kaba tyrkhong bad ka bym Nimrod um pyn-at
translation.en: And now she is planted in the wilderness , in a dry and thirsty ground .

translation.kha: jingïa-umsnam la klet jingpynbor nga la leh ïa jaitbynriew Lyngba pha dang samla , bad pha la tyllep ïa nga da kiei kiei baroh kiba ’ la leh . Dei jingdum keiñ balei idonburom Shelemaïah Gomorrah pynlong ïa pha ban shah na ka bynta jong rai baroh . Balei pha bynrap ïa ka jingawria lehrain ha baroh kiei kiei pynïong ijli kiba pha la leh ? Suntukhi Trai Nongsynshar u la kren pra
translation.en: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth , but hast fretted me in all these things  ; behold , therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head , saith the Lord  God  : and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations .

translation.kha: Ïathuh pateng ha pajwa khun ki ksiew 5 phi shaphang jingmlien ka masi ba phi ïeng ha khmat U Trai panpoh Blei jong phi ha u pyniwbih Sinai , mynba khyllad ong ha nga , ‘ Lumlang ïamir u paidbah . Nga kwah ba kin Nongbah aïu ngan ong , ba kumta kin tiengburom ïa nga katba ki dang pang bad ba kin iaisah pynshongkurim la ki khun ki kti ban leh kumjuh .’
translation.en: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the  Lord  thy God in Horeb , when the  Lord  said unto me , Gather me the people together , and I will make them hear my words , that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth , and that they may teach their children .

And all the cities of store that Solomon had , and cities for his chariots , and cities for his horsemen , and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem , and in Lebanon , and in all the land of his dominion .
translation.kha: ki nongbah ha kiba u kynshew jingbam , ki shnong buh kulai bad kali ïapom , bad kat ïa kaba u kwah ban tei ha Jerusalem , ha Lebanon , bad kylleng ka hima jong u .

paramarjan ka kyrteng U Trai , te , rynghang maham ïa phi ; wat pynmlien im kum kiba mane blei thala , kiba Pynlong jingpyrkhat jong ki kim donbor Hadlai Mait kiba Rehoboam jingmut jong ki , Abner long ha Trei jingdum .
translation.en: This I say therefore , and testify in the Lord , that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk , in the vanity of their mind ,

translation.kha: Naba kaei ka jingim ? Ïa nga , ka long U Khrist . Da ka , , ngan wallam kham bun .
translation.en: For to me to live is Christ , and to die is gain .
And David smote the land , and left neither man nor woman alive , and took away the sheep , and the oxen , and the asses , and the camels , and the apparel , and returned , and came to Achish .
translation.kha: ki da pynïap lut ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei baroh , bad rah noh ïa ki langbrot , ki masi , ki kada , ki ut , bad wat ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem ruh .

translation.kha: Nga la bthah ïa ki ban bret noh ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli ki kiba la ieit bad ym ban pynlong ïa lade ki bymkhuid da ki blei ba-thala jong ka Ijipt , namar ba nga , nga U long Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: Then said I unto them , Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes , and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: To ai ha ka , katta ka jingshitom ka jingsngewsih kat ka burom bad ka jingpahuh ka la ai ïa lade . Naba ka ïai-ong ïa lade : ‘ Hangne nga shong , ka syiem ! Ngam ka riewkynthei , ngan ym tip ka jingsngewsih
translation.en: How much she hath glorified herself , and lived deliciously , so much torment and sorrow give her : for she saith in her heart , I sit a queen , and am no widow , and shall see no sorrow .
Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me hath everlasting life .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uta uba ngeit u don ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: The Lord  God  hath sworn by himself , saith the  Lord  the God of hosts , I abhor the excellency of Jacob , and hate his palaces : therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la ai kane ka jingmaham bakyntang :  Nga isih ïa ka jingsarong ki briew ka Israel ; nga ñiewbeiñ ïa ki ïing paki dulan jong ki . Ngan ai ïa ka nongbah bakhraw bad baroh kiba don ha ka , ha u nongshun .
Nga bud beit ïa ka lynti ba u jied bad ngam ju sakma sha kadiang ne .
translation.en: My foot hath held his steps , his way have I kept , and not declined .

translation.kha: bad sngewkwah tamasa u ong Tebalaïah u Aaron , prais ïa u khiew jngum Jingkhuid jong dulir , buh hangta ïa u rnga uba rhem na ka duwan , bad brup khyndiat ka pawkhmat halor ki samla banbeiñ Nangta hep rah iap kloi ïa ka sha u paidbah bad pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid Sethan ka bynta jong ki . Pynkloi ! Ka jingbitar U Trai ka la mih , bad Gittaim khlam ruh ka la sdang .
translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Take a censer , and put fire therein from off the altar , and put on incense , and go quickly unto the congregation , and make an atonement for them : for there is wrath gone out from the  Lord   ; the plague is begun .

translation.kha: Hynrei kito ki jingbynta kim shahshkor , bad ki ïai bteng ban bud ïa ki rukom kiba rim jong ki .
translation.en: Howbeit they did not hearken , but they did after their former manner .

translation.kha: Ka jingbhabriew ha briew ka ka bym don ka jingshemphang ka long kum ka sati ksiar ha ka khmut u sniang .
translation.en: As a jewel of gold in a swine s snout , so is a fair woman which is without discretion .

translation.kha: Kumta keiñ u Joseph u thied lut ïa ka Sabteka ha Ijipt na ka Ibsan thwet syiem . shadkmen pynbor ïa uwei pa uwei u ïingbishar Ijipt ban die ïa la ki lyngkha namar ba ka nemsniew jingjia jingthmu jur palat Paseah bad baroh ka khyndew Topheth kylla long ka jong u syiem .
translation.en: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh  ; for the Egyptians sold every man his field , because the famine prevailed over them : so the land became Pharaoh s .
In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride : but the lips of the wise shall preserve them .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingsarong , kiba bieit ki kren shaba palat ; ki ktien jong kiba stad ki ïada ïa ki .

translation.en: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content .
translation.kha: Te namarkata , lada ngi don ka bam bad ka kup ka sem , kata kan dei ka la biang ïa ngi .

translation.en: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation : and the plague was stayed .
translation.kha: Ynda ka khlam ka la sangeh , u Aaron u leit phai sha u Moses ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy ; as it is written , For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles , and sing unto thy name .
translation.kha: bad ban pynlah wat ïa ki Jentil ban ïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingisynei jong u . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Bad kumta ngin ïaroh ïa me hapdeng ki Jentil ; ngan rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me .

translation.en: Say unto them which daub it with untempered mortar , that it shall fall : there shall be an overflowing shower  ; and ye , O great hailstones , shall fall  ; and a stormy wind shall rend it .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ba ka kynroh jong ki kan khyllem . Ngan phah ïa u slap bajur . U phria un hap halor jong ka , bad ka lyer bajur kan beh pyrshah ïa ka .

Shim uwei u khiew nar bad pynïeng ïa u kum ka kynroh hapdeng jong me bad ka nongbah . Phai khmat sha ka . nongbah Ka ha don ka jingshah kerkut , bad dei ma me uba kerkut ïa ka . Kane kan long dak ka ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel .
translation.en: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan , and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city : and set thy face against it , and it shall be besieged , and thou shalt lay siege against it . This shall be a sign to the house of Israel .
I charge you , O ye daughters of Jerusalem , by the roes , and by the hinds of the field , that ye stir not up , nor awake my love , till he please .
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa nga , ko ba-ieit jong nga , shano phin ïalam pynbamphlang ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong phi ? Hangno kin pynjahthait na ka jingshit ka shiteng sngi ? Balei nga donkam ban wad ïa phi hapdeng ki kynhun langbrot jong kiwei pat ki nongap langbrot ?

Hynrei ngan sngewrit Bahurim phi , phi baroh ki paid Girgash bathymmai dang sah . Ngan wallam lang ïa phi kum ki langbrot sha Khnang kynhun . Kum Suk jaka bam phlang ba-dap da ki Jehiskaïah Kynther ka Sosthenes jong phi Jingïakajia dap biang sa pynïapher da ki paidbah babun .
translation.en: I will surely assemble , O Jacob , all of thee  ; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel  ; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah , as the flock in the midst of their fold : they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men .

translation.kha: U Isaïah u duwai ha U Trai , bad U Trai pynlong ïa ka syrngiew leit jam shadien ha ki ba la buh da Syiem Ahas .
translation.en: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the  Lord  : and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward , by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz .
And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses : and they were talking with Jesus .
translation.kha: Nangta , ki lai ngut ki synran ki la ïohi ïa u Elijah bad ïa u Moses ba ki ïakren bad U Jisu .
u Sadok , u Nathan , Benaïah , bad ki nongïada syiem ki pynshong ïa u Solomon jong u Dabid bad ki la ïa u sha Umpohliew Gihon .
translation.en: So Zadok the priest , and Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and the Cherethites , and the Pelethites , went down , and caused Solomon to ride upon king David s mule , and brought him to Gihon .

translation.kha: Me tip lut ïa baroh kaba la jia ha nga ha Antiokh , Ikoniom , bad Lystra ki , jingpynshitom bashyrkhei kiba nga la ïaishah! Hynrei u u Trai la pyllait ïa nga na ki baroh .
translation.en: Persecutions , afflictions , which came unto me at Antioch , at Iconium , at Lystra ; what persecutions I endured : but out of them all the Lord delivered me .
The woman saith unto him , I know that Messias cometh , which is called Christ : when he is come , he will tell us all things .
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la ong ha u ,  Nga tip ba U Messaïah un sa wan , bad haba u wan , un sa ïathuh ha ngi ïa kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: I would know the words which he would answer me , and understand what he would say unto me .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban tip kaei ba un ong bad kumno un jubab ïa nga .

translation.en: And Micaiah said , As the  Lord  liveth , what the  Lord  saith unto me , that will I speak .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Mikaïah u jubab ,  Katba im U  Trai  , nga kular ban ong ïa kaei kaba u ïathuh ïa nga !

To buh ha Rephidim jingthoh , namar kam pat dei ka por ba kan urlong . Hynrei ka por ka wan kloi , bad kaei kaba nga pyn-i ha me kan urlong . Ka i kumba ka wan suki jai , hynrei to ap ïa ka ; kan sa jia Asher shisha , bad yn hikai pyntud ïa ka .
translation.en: For the vision is yet for an appointed time , but at the end it shall speak , and not lie : though it tarry , wait for it  ; because it will surely come , it will not tarry .
Give unto the  Lord  , O ye kindreds of the people , give unto the  Lord  glory and strength .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei ; ïaroh ïa ka burom bad ka jingkhlaiñbor jong u .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land .
translation.kha: U ong ha nga ,  Ka jingpynjot kan thnam na ka phang bashatei halor baroh kiba shong basah ha kane ka ri ,
U u la khmih sha ki bad u la kylli Aïu , kane ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka kit ‘ U ïa uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymmyntoi u la kylla donkam tam na baroh .’
translation.en: And he beheld them , and said ,  What is this then that is written , The stone which the builders rejected , the same is become the head of the corner ?
And they came to the chief priests and elders , and said , We have bound ourselves under a great curse , that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad sha ki tymmen ki san bad ki la ong ,  Ngi la pynlong lang ka jingsmai ba sngewkhia ban ym bam kano kano tad ynda ngi la pynïap ïa u Paul .
Ki khun kynthei jong phi Jehoahas shipawa shna bajai jingiwbih ïa u , bad trei kum ki nongshet jingshet bad ki nongshet kpu jong u siang
translation.en: And he will take your daughters to be confectionaries , and to be cooks , and to be bakers .
Mercy and truth preserve the king : and his throne is upholden by mercy .
translation.kha: U syiem un ïai don ha ka bor katba ka jingsynshar jong u ka dang long kaba khuid , kaba hok , bad kaba biang .

translation.en: And , behold , one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips : then I opened my mouth , and spake , and said unto him that stood before me , O my lord , by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me , and I have retained no strength .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel , uba syriem ïa u briew , u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong nga . Nga la ong ha u ,  Ko rangbah , kane ka jingïohipaw ka pyntlot ïa nga haduh katta katta ba ngam lah ban sangeh ban khynñiuh .
Nga la wan sha ka pyrthei kum ka jingshai ba baroh kiba ngeit ha kin ym sah ha ka jingdum .
translation.en: I am come a light into the world , that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness .
But if a man find a betrothed damsel in the field , and the man force her , and lie with her : then the man only that lay with her shall die :
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïakynduh ha lum ïa ka briew kaba la ïatehktien bad uwei pat u briew , bad u batbor ïa ka , dei ban pynïap tang ïa uta u shynrang .

translation.en: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses , the same commit thou to faithful men , who shall be able to teach others also .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ki jinghikai kiba me la ïohsngew ba nga pynbna ha khmat ki sakhi babun , bad aiti ïa ki ha ki briew kiba lah ban shaniah , kiba lah ban hikai ïa kiwei ruh .

translation.en: Is the seed yet in the barn ? yea , as yet the vine , and the fig tree , and the pomegranate , and the olive tree , hath not brought forth : from this day will I bless you .
translation.kha: Wat la ym don kew ba dang sah , bad ki dieng sohwaiñ , ki diengsoh Dumbur , ki diengsoh Pomkranet , bad ki diengsoh Olib kim pat shym pynmih soh , pynban naduh mynta ngan kyrkhu ïa phi .
U Seng ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , Palal kpieng Ahas u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Jotham slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David : and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead .
And David said to Abiathar the priest , Ahimelech s son , I pray thee , bring me hither the ephod . And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Abiathar , u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Ahimelekh ,  Wanrah ha nga ka ephod ,  bad u Abiathar u wanrah ïa ka ha u .

translation.en: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death , and dwelt in a several house , being a leper  ; for he was cut off from the house of the  Lord  : and Jotham his son was over the king s house , judging the people of the land .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingim ba dang sah jong u syiem Ussaïah , u la long u bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam namar ka jingpang jong u . Namar ba um lah shuh ban rung sha ka Templ u shong u sah ha la ka ïing , khlem da leh shuh ïa la ki kamram , katba u Jotham u khun jong u , u synshar ïa ka ri .

Ki briew kin wan na ki shnong jong ka Judah bad na ki Sabad sawdong jong ba-pnah Jerusalem ; kin wan jingtbit ka thain Benjamin Hiar na ki kjat Hakkos , na ki lumbah , bad na ka bynta bashathie jong ïamir jinglaitluid . Kin wallam sha ka Templ jong lop ïa ki jingainguh thang sum jingshon ki poh , spah jingainguh bam bad ka jingiwbih Nisan kumjuh ruh ka jingainguh sngewnguh .
translation.en: And they shall come from the cities of Judah , and from the places about Jerusalem , and from the land of Benjamin , and from the plain , and from the mountains , and from the south , bringing burnt offerings , and sacrifices , and meat offerings , and incense , and bringing sacrifices of praise , unto the house of the  Lord .
And as many as walk according to this rule , peace be on them , and mercy , and upon the Israel of God .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kita kiba bud ïa kane ka rukom ha ka jingim jong ki , to ai ba ka jingsuk bad ka jingisynei kan long lem bad ki — ïa ki lem bad baroh ki briew jong U Blei !

translation.en: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears , and in the ears of all the people  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ha phi bad ha ki paidbah .

Phi Lukia Deuteronomi Jingjynjar ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang jong ka Kato Niam Ka Jinglait . Mynta Nong Rakal lade kiba la khuid kat kum Shephirah jinglehniam ïapyllait pynkhreh ïa ki jingkñia ba hangthie para Shaphat kin ïoh bud ïa ki jingbthah kiba U Trai u la ai ha u Moses .
translation.en: So kill the passover , and sanctify yourselves , and prepare your brethren , that they may do according to the word of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone , where the beast and the false prophet are , and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Nangta ïa u Ksuid , uba la shukor ïa ki , la bret sha ka pung ka ding bad u kyndok , ha kaba la lah bret ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa u nongïathuhlypa lamler , bad kin shah pynkordit mynsngi bad mynmiet junom la junom .

translation.en: And he saith unto me , The waters which thou sawest , where the whore sitteth , are peoples , and multitudes , and nations , and tongues .
translation.kha: U angel u la ong ruh ha nga ,  Ki um ïa kiba me la ïohi , ha kaba kata ka nuti ka shong , ki long ki jaitbynriew , ki paidlang , ki kynja bynriew bad ki jait ktien .

translation.en: And God said unto Noah , The end of all flesh is come before me  ; for the earth is filled with violence through them  ; and , behold , I will destroy them with the earth .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Noah ,  Nga la kut jingmut ban pynduh noh ïa ki briew baroh . Ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki namar ka pyrthei ka la jyllei da ki kam leh jubor jong ki .
U rangbah synshar ka Assyria u riewbieit jingtip ba u patsha dep la mih na Lakhish bad u ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Libnah kaba Nebat marjan Ale kumta u leit shata ban twad jingmut baseisoh dem .
translation.en: So Rab–shakeh returned , and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah : for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish .

Then said he also to him that bade him ,  When thou makest a dinner or a supper , call not thy friends , nor thy brethren , neither thy kinsmen , nor thy rich neighbours  ; lest they also bid thee again , and a recompence be made thee .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u nongpdiang ïa u ,  Haba me ai ïa ka bam step ne ka bam miet , wat khot sngewbha ïa ki paralok jong me lane ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me lane ïa ki ba-ha-ïing jong me lane ki paramarjan kiba riewspah jong me — naba kin khot sngewbha kylliang ïa me , bad ha kane ka rukom yn sa siew ïa me na ka bynta kaei kaba me la leh .

Hynrei lada phi lah ban ïathuh ha nga ïa baroh ar , ka jingphohsniew bad ïa ka jingmut jong , ngan ainong ïa phi da ki jingai sngewbha bad ka jingpyndonburom kaba khraw . Te mynta , ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingphohsniew bad ka jingmut jong ka .
translation.en: But if ye shew the dream , and the interpretation thereof , ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour : therefore shew me the dream , and the interpretation thereof .

translation.kha: da ka jingngeit ba ngi sngewthuh ba la pynlong ïa ka pyrthei da ka ktien U Blei , khnang ba ïa kaei kaba lah ban ïohi la pynlong na kaei ka bymlah ïohi .
translation.en: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God , so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear .

translation.kha: bad u Moses u ïa phah ki briew ban shem ka lynti babha tam kumno ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Jaser ; ki Israel ki la ïohknieh ka ïa ki bad shnong kiba sawdong jong ka , bad ki la beh noh ïa ki Amor kiba shong hangta .
translation.en: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer , and they took the villages thereof , and drove out the Amorites that were there .

translation.kha: Katba ka ka nang haba ïa U Jisu yn shim sha bneng , u la pynbeit ka jingmut bad u la leit ha la sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the time was come that he should be received up , he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem ,

translation.kha: u thang jingiwbih ha ka , bad u kñia wat ïa la ki jong ki khun ki jingainguh thang ïa ki bleithaw , da bud ïa ka jingleh jong ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba Trai u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki Israel ki nang tur shaphrang .
translation.en: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom , and burnt his children in the fire , after the abominations of the heathen whom the  Lord  had cast out before the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Ynda ïeng la dep tep , Pontios nongïathuhlypa u ong ha la ki Lukios , Ynda nga ïap , tep ïa nga ha kane ka jingtep bad buh ïa ka met pynshlur nga syndah bad jingïapyndait jong Shu thut
translation.en: And it came to pass , after he had buried him , that he spake to his sons , saying , When I am dead , then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried  ; lay my bones beside his bones :

translation.kha: Un wallam ïa ki sha u lyngdoh ha ka * pyndei Ïingjaiñ ne Markaboth sngi kaba phra jong ksiar Pi ïa u .
translation.en: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , before the  Lord .
O  Lord  , be gracious unto us  ; we have waited for thee : be thou their arm every morning , our salvation also in the time of trouble .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , to isynei ïa ngi . Ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen ha me . To ïada ïa ngi man la ka sngi bad to pynim ïa ngi ha ki por jong ka jingjynjar .
U Herod u la kwah pynïap ïa u , hynrei u ïa ki Jiw , namar ki la ñiew ïa u Ïoannis kum u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And when he would have put him to death , he feared the multitude , because they counted him as a prophet .
Therefore thou art inexcusable , O man , whosoever thou art that judgest : for wherein thou judgest another , thou condemnest thyself ; for thou that judgest doest the same things .
translation.kha: Hato , ko paralok jong nga , phi bishar ïa kiwei pat ? Phim lah lait satia , lada phi long uei uei ruh . Namar haba phi bishar ïa kiwei bad nangta phi leh ïa kijuh kiei kiei kiba ki leh , phi pynrem ïa lade .

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Thou couldest have no power at all against me , except it were given thee from above : therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Me don ka bor halor jong nga tang namar ba la ai ha me da U Blei . Kumta u briew uba aiti noh ïa nga ha me u long uba la rem na ka pop kaba kham khraw .
Mynba ka ing , ka jingsngewma ka wan ha nga .
translation.en: When the house caught fire , an awful feeling came over me .

translation.kha: Un pyrshah ïa thaw kaei balyngkot ba Rabbah khot khor , lane ïa kano kano ban mane , bad un buh :32 lade halor jong ki baroh . Wat shapoh un leit rung bad shong hapoh ka Templ U Blei bad kam bajakhlia u long U Blei .
translation.en: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God , or that is worshipped ; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God , shewing himself that he is God .

translation.kha: Ki shna ruh khatsan tylli ki nongwankai da ka dieng akasia pyrshah san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba Sarsekhim kawei ka liang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translation.en: And he made bars of shittim wood  ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,
For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched , and that burned with fire , nor unto blackness , and darkness , and tempest ,
translation.kha: Naba phim shym la wan kumba wan ki paid Israel , sha kaei kaba phi lah ban tba , sha u lum Sinai ha kaba la don ka ding kaba klang , ka jingdum bad u lyoh ïong , ka  erïong ,

translation.en: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon s princes , then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans , and they shall burn it with fire , and thou shalt not escape out of their hand .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim pyndem , te ïa kane ka nongbah yn aiti noh sha ki nong Babilonia , ki ban sa thang duh ïa ka , bad phin ym lait im na ki .

translation.en: Hear us , my lord : thou art a mighty prince among us : in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead  ; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre , but that thou mayest bury thy dead .
translation.kha: Ngi khmih sha phi kum u nongïalam uba khraw ; tep ïa la ka tnga ha ka jaka tep kaba bha tam kaba ngi don . Uno uno na ngi un da sngewkmen ban ai jaka tep ha phi , ba phin ïoh ban tep ïa ka .
Me la long u nongshong basa ha ïing jong ki Jentil kiba khlem , bad me da ïabam lem bad ki !
translation.en: Saying , Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised , and didst eat with them .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïada ïa ki bym don jingïarap ; haba Epikuri la don ha ka jingma , u la pyllait Bashyrkhei’ ïa nga lumrit
translation.en: The  Lord  preserveth the simple : I was brought low , and he helped me .
When the dust groweth into hardness , and the clods cleave fast together ?
translation.kha: u slap uba pyneh ïa u pui pui sha ki  dew tylli ?

Ka Naomi ka kylli ïa ka , Hangno phi ïohlum ïa kine baroh Ha ? ka lyngkha jongno phi ïoh trei ? To U Blei un ïa kyrkhu u briew uba shem jingsngewbha ha phi ! Kumta ka Ruth ka ïathuh ha ka Naomi ba ka la ha trei lyngkha ka kaba dei jong u briew uba kyrteng u Boas .
