translation.kha: Sawphew snem U  Trai  u la ïalam ïa phi lyngba ka ri shyiap , hynrei ki jaiñkup jong phi kim shym man rim , bad ki juti jong phi kim shym jot .

translation.en: And she said , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he awoke out of his sleep , and said , I will go out as at other times before , and shake myself . And he wist not that the  Lord  was departed from him .
translation.kha: Nangta ka pyrta ,  Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan !  U khie joit bad u pyrkhat ,  Ngan pynsynjor bad pyllait war , kumba mynshuwa .  Um shym tip ba U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa u .
U la kad ka Duriaw basaw , ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translation.en: To him which divided the Red sea into parts : for his mercy endureth for ever :

translation.kha: U Solomon u la ieit ïa kiba bun ki nongwei Nalor ka khun u syiem ka ri Ijipt , u la shongkurim ruh ïa ki kynthei Hit bad ki Moab , Ammon , Edom bad Sidon .
translation.en: But king Solomon loved many strange women , together with the daughter of Pharaoh , women of the Moabites , Ammonites , Edomites , Zidonians , and Hittites  ;

translation.kha: bad kin bret ïa ki shapoh ka lawar ding baklang , ha kaba kin lynñiar bad bniat kyr-iat .
translation.en: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire : there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth .
And he spake of trees , from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall : he spake also of beasts , and of fowl , and of creeping things , and of fishes .
translation.kha: U kren shaphang ki dieng bad ki jingthung , naduh ki dieng Kedar Lebanon haduh u Hissop uba mih halor kynroh ; u la kren shaphang ki mrad , ki sim , ki bseiñ , bad ki dohkha .

translation.en: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one bullock  ; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one ram  ;
translation.kha: Kum ka jingainguh bam , wanrah u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw ; ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ;

translation.en: On that night could not the king sleep , and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles  ; and they were read before the king .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka miet u syiem um ïohthiah satia , kumta u hukum ban wanrah ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh jong ka hima bad ban pule ha u .

translation.en: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain , I will come to you : for I trust to see you in my journey , and to be brought on my way thitherward by you , if first I be somewhat filled with your company .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban ïakynduh ïa phi ha ka jingleit lynti artat jong nga sha Spain , bad ba phin ïarap ïa nga ha ka jingleit jong nga shata , hadien ba nga la sngewhun ban sah shipor ha ka jingwan khmih ïa phi .
Wat bishar ïa jongngi pat , pyngngad ba U Blei shatai ym bishar ïa phi ,
translation.en: Judge not , that ye be not judged .
According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world , that we should be holy and without blame before him in love :
translation.kha: Wat shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei , U Blei u la jied lypa ïa ngi ban long ki jong u ha U Khrist , khnang ba ngin ïoh long kiba khuid bad kiba khlem shah kynnoh pop ha khmat jong u .

Nangta ka leit ki sha briew ka jong nongbah lem bad ka jingthmu jong ka , ki bad la khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u Sheba bad bret ïa ka sha u Joab nalor ka kynroh . U la put ïa ka turoi kum ka dak ïa ki rangbah jong u ban iehnoh ïa nongbah ka , bad ki leit noh phai sha ïing . Bad u Joab u la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem sha u syiem .
translation.en: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom . And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri , and cast it out to Joab . And he blew a trumpet , and they retired from the city , every man to his tent . And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king .

translation.kha: Shna kawei ka dabor rnong , kaba ka jingpynshong jong ka dei ruh da ka rnong . Buh ïa ka hapdeng ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad pyndap um ka ïa .
translation.en: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass , and his foot also of brass , to wash withal : and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar , and thou shalt put water therein .

translation.kha: To phai noh na ki pop jong phi , u la ong , naba ka Hima ki bneng ka jan la !
translation.en: And saying , Repent ye : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand .
And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness .
translation.kha: bad haduh sawphew snem u la ïaishah bad ki ha ka ri shyiap .

Lada uno uno u wallam ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa phi bad rah ïa sha phi ka ïingbishar to , leh ïa kaba bha ban tam ïapynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia u bad ha shuwa ba phin poi sha ka ïingbishar . Lada leh phim kumta , un tan ïa phi ha khmat u nongbishar , u ban aiti ïa phi ha ki nongap phira , bad ïa phi yn buh ha ka byndi .
translation.en: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate , as thou art in the way , give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him  ; lest he hale thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and the officer cast thee into prison .
That we may buy the poor for silver , and the needy for a pair of shoes  ; yea , and sell the refuse of the wheat ?
translation.kha: Ngi lah ban die ïa u kew u bymdondor ha ka dor kaba heh . Ngin shem ïa u briew uba duk u bym lah siew ïa ki ram jong u , wat ym ïa ka dor jong shi jur ki juti , bad ngin thied ïa u kum u mraw .

translation.en: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things , yet he himself is judged of no man .
translation.kha: Pynban uno uno uba don U Mynsiem , u lah ban bishar ïa ka dor jong kiei kiei baroh , hynrei ym don uba lah ban bishar ïa u .

translation.en: And when they had nothing to pay , he frankly forgave them both . Tell me therefore , which of them will love him most ?
translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban siew pat sha u , kumta u la pyndam noh ïa ki ram jong ki baroh ar ngut . Uno na kine , te , u ban ieit kham bun ïa u ?

translation.en: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria , and were edified  ; and walking in the fear of the Lord , and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost , were multiplied .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka la long ba ka balang ha kylleng ka Judia , Galilaïa bad Samaria ka la ïoh shongsuk . Da ka jingïarap jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid la pynshaitbor ïa ka bad ka la nang san ha ka jingbun briew , haba ka ïaid ha ka jingsheptieng ïa U Trai .
Uwei ki jong u lane u kñi jong u lane u bakha jong u lane uwei ki kur jong , u lah ban thied biang ïa u ; la ïoh kynshew ban da biang u hi u lah thied ïa la ka jinglaitluid .
translation.en: Either his uncle , or his uncle s son , may redeem him , or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him  ; or if he be able , he may redeem himself .

translation.kha: para jong me u la wan pat sha ïing ,’ u shakri u la jubab , bad u jong me u la phah pynïap ïa u khun masi la pynsngaid bha namar u ïoh ïa u ha ka jingsuk bad ha jingkoit jingkhiah .’
translation.en: And he said unto him , Thy brother is come  ; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf , because he hath received him safe and sound .
And as he talked with him , he went in , and found many that were come together .
translation.kha: U Petros u la ïai kren ïa u Kornelios katba u dang leit shapoh ïing , ha kaba u la shem bun ki briew kiba la ïalumlang .
histori jingkyrmen ki paid Israel ki leit sha Bethel bad ki shong jingkhmih ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei haduh janmiet . Ha ka sur kaba jam bad ha ka pynher ki ïam sngewsih :
translation.en: And the people came to the house of God , and abode there till even before God , and lifted up their voices , and wept sore  ;

translation.kha: U nongsynshar uba khlem ka jingshemphang un long u nonglehbeiñ uba runar . Uta isih uba ïa ka jingbymhok un synshar slem .
translation.en: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor : but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days .
He hath filled the hungry with good things  ; and the rich he hath sent empty away .
translation.kha: U la pyndap ïa kiba thngan da kiei kiei kiba bha , bad u la phah noh thylli ïa kiba riewspah .
Ki dur khyllah kin paw ha ki khmat jong phi , bad phin ym lah ban pyrkhat ne shai .
translation.en: Thine eyes shall behold strange women , and thine heart shall utter perverse things .
Their quiver is as an open sepulchre , they are all mighty men .
translation.kha: Ki rang bahryntieh jong ki , ki long ki shipai bakhrawbor kiba pynïap khlem jingisynei .
teh Ngan ïa u thylliej jong me ba kumta men ym lah ban maham ïa kine ki riewïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth , that thou shalt be dumb , and shalt not be to them a reprover : for they are a rebellious house .

translation.kha: Katba u paidbah u dang ïeng hangta , u Syiem Solomon u khmat phai sha ki bad pan ka jingkyrkhu U Blei halor jong ki .
translation.en: And the king turned his face about , and blessed all the congregation of Israel : ( and all the congregation of Israel stood  ; )
Praise ye the  Lord . Praise ye the  Lord  from the heavens : praise him in the heights .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  na bneng , phi kiba im ha ki jaka bakynjang shajrong .
Man ba nga kren , nga hap ban kyang jam bad pyrta , Ka jingleh jubor ! Ka jingpynjot ! A Trai , ïa nga la rkhiebeiñ bad ibeiñ ha ki por khawai namar nga pynbna ïa ka khubor jong ïathied .
translation.en: For since I spake , I cried out , I cried violence and spoil  ; because the word of the  Lord  was made a reproach unto me , and a derision , daily .

translation.kha: U patsha , ryngkat bad ka mahadei kaba shong ha syndah jingbah u khiah u la mynjur ïa ka jingkyrpad jong bastad sawspah U la kylli ïa markhap katno slem ngan jah bad ba ngan wan phai balei , bad nga ïathuh jingtipbriew u .
translation.en: And the king said unto me , ( the queen also sitting by him , ) For how long shall thy journey be ? and when wilt thou return ? So it pleased the king to send me  ; and I set him a time .

And Isaiah said unto them , Thus shall ye say unto your master , Thus saith the  Lord  , Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard , wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh ha phi ban ym shah ba ki Assyria kin pynkhaw-eit ïa phi da ki jingkob jong ki ba um lah ban pyllait ïa phi .

translation.en: I lifted up mine eyes again , and looked , and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka jingïohipaw nga la ïohi ïa u briew uba don u ksai thew ha ka kti jong u .
Gur duriaw-rit khyndaiphew la niewkor Saw Sela jinglehsbun jong U Blei , u Adam bad ka Im ki la paila .
translation.en: Lacking appreciation for God’s kindness , Adam and Eve did disobey and were made to pay the prescribed penalty .

And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne , having put on their robes , in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria  ; and all the prophets prophesied before them .
translation.kha: Ki ar ngut ki syiem , kiba riam da ki jaiñphong syiem jong ki , ki dang ïashong ha la ki khet ha ka jaka shoh kew kaba habar ka khyrdop Samaria bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ki dang ïathuhlypa ha khmat jong ki .

translation.en: Egypt was glad when they departed : for the fear of them fell upon them .
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki la sheptieng ïa ki bad ki la kmen haba ki la mih .

Nga la ïohi ka jingïohipaw jong ki jingjia ba-ishyrkhei , ka jingïohipaw jingshetkylla bad ka jingpynjot . kynhun shipai jong Elam , to ïaleh ! Ko kynhun shipai jong ka Media , to kerkut ïa ki nongbah ! U Blei un pynkut ka jingshitom kaba la wanrah da ka Babilon .
translation.en: A grievous vision is declared unto me  ; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously , and the spoiler spoileth . Go up , O Elam : besiege , O Media  ; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease .

translation.kha: U tip ïa Aleksandria kaba u leh ! U phah ka jingjot . U phah ïa ki jingbyrngem ban pynshitom ïa ki nongtei kiba Nisan bad kito kiba ïada ïa ki .
translation.en: Yet he also is wise , and will bring evil , and will not call back his words : but will arise against the house of the evildoers , and against the help of them that work iniquity .
What will be the answer ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka ban dei ka Jubab ?

Ym don uno uno uba lah ban Seruïah bad rung shapoh Porsius ïing kaba skhem jong u briew bad rah noh ïa ki tiar ki tar lymda u teh nyngkong ïa u briew uba khlaiñ ; te un sa lah ban lute ïa ka ïing jong u .
translation.en: No man can enter into a strong man s house , and spoil his goods , except he will first bind the strong man  ; and then he will spoil his house .

translation.kha: Hynrei un ong biang , ‘ Ngam ithuh nangno ïawan . leit noh na nga , ki briew kiba !’
translation.en: But he shall say , I tell you , I know you not whence ye are  ; depart from me , all ye workers of iniquity .

translation.kha: Nangta ki leit sha ka jaka ba la khot Ki Pukri , ha kaba U Trai u la ong ha Moses u , Lumlang ïa ki briew , bad ai ngan um ïa ki .
translation.en: And from thence they went to Beer : that is the well whereof the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Gather the people together , and I will give them water .
By faith Moses , when he was come to years , refused to be called the son of Pharaoh s daughter  ;
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Moses , haba u la rangbah , ban kyntait ba yn khot ïa u , u khun jong ka khun u Pharaoh .
Ka jingbuh jingthoh ki ïa khun ki ksiew da ki longïing ki long arphew hajar arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta kam ka shipai .
translation.en: And the number of them , after their genealogy by their generations , heads of the house of their fathers , mighty men of valour , was twenty thousand and two hundred .

translation.kha: U Jair na ka jait Manasseh u la tur ïaleh bad ïohknieh katto ki shnong bad u la khot kyrteng ïa ki Ki shnong u Jair
translation.en: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof , and called them Havoth–jair .
Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un tim ïa u kew jong phi bad ïa ki jingbam ba phi khreh da u .

translation.en: And they gathered them together upon heaps : and the land stank .
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki la lum thup ïa ki shi jaka jaka haduh ba la iwtung lut ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: And he wrought evil in the sight of the  Lord   ; but not like his father , and like his mother : for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made .
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um da sniew eh kat u kpa jong u , lane kat ka Jesebel , ka kmie jong u ; u la pynkhyllem ïa ka dur kaba u kpa jong u , u la thaw na ka bynta ban mane ïa u Baal .

translation.en: After Armageddon , earth will be made into a paradise
translation.kha: Hadien ka Armagedon , yn sa pynlong ïa ka pyrthei ka Paradais

translation.en: And he sat down , and called the twelve , and saith unto them ,  If any man desire to be first , the same shall be last of all , and servant of all .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la shong , u la khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , bad u la ong ïa ki ,  Uno uno uba kwah ban long nyngkong u dei ban buh khatduh eh ïa lade bad u dei ban long u shakri ïa baroh .

translation.en: And David and his men went up , and invaded the Geshurites , and the Gezrites , and the Amalekites : for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land , as thou goest to Shur , even unto the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki ju leit hiarthma ïa ki briew jong ka Geshur , ki Girsi , bad ki Amalek , kiba la ju shong ha kata ka thain naduh mynhyndai . U ju leit lute ïa ka ri jong ki haduh Shur , baroh shi lynter lynti haduh ka ri Ijipt ,

translation.en: For he remembered his holy promise , and Abraham his servant .
translation.kha: U la kynmaw ïa ka jingkular bakyntang jong u ïa u Abraham u shakri jong u .

translation.en: Wherefore Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron , and unto Piram king of Jarmuth , and unto Japhia king of Lachish , and unto Debir king of Eglon , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta u Adonisedek u phah ïa kane ka khubor harum sha u Hoham u syiem ka Hebron , u Piram u syiem ka Jarmuth , u Japhia u syiem ka Lakhish , bad sha u Debir u syiem ka Eglon :
Ngan long U Kpa jong phi , bad phin long ki khun shynrang ki bad khun kynthei jong nga , ong U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: And will be a Father unto you , and ye shall be my sons and daughters , saith the Lord Almighty .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Petros u la wan sha Antiokh , nga la pyrshah ïa u ha kaba paw , namar ba u la bakla . shai
translation.en: But when Peter was come to Antioch , I withstood him to the face , because he was to be blamed .

translation.kha: Baroh kaba U Blei jingdonkam la thaw ka long kaba bha ; ym dei ban kyntait ei ei Jingdon hynrei ïa kiei kiei baroh dei ban pdiang lem bad ka jingduwai sngewnguh , namar ïa ka la pynkyntang da lybong ktien U Blei bad ka jingduwai sorkar kiba pynlong ïa ki ba la pdiang da U Blei .
translation.en: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer .
And Moses went up into the mount , and a cloud covered the mount .
translation.kha: U Moses u la leit kiew ïa u Lum Sinai , bad u lyoh u tap ïa uta u lum .

translation.en: And Enoch walked with God : and he was not  ; for God took him .
translation.kha: U la pynlut la ka jingim ha kaba ïasyllok bad U Blei , bad hadien kata u la jah noh , namar U Blei u la shim noh ïa u .

Ki set ïa ki shyntur jong ki sing , ki la pynlip ki ding kiba klang , ki la lait na kaba shah pynïap da ka waitlam . Ki la tlot hynrei ki la kylla long khlaiñ ; ki long kiba khlaiñbor ka thma bad ki la jop ïa ki kynhun nongwei .
translation.en: Quenched the violence of fire , escaped the edge of the sword , out of weakness were made strong , waxed valiant in fight , turned to flight the armies of the aliens .
Paul , a servant of Jesus Christ , called to be an apostle , separated unto the gospel of God ,
translation.kha: U Paul , u shakri jong U Jisu Khrist , u ba la shah khot u apostol bad ba la jied da U Blei ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha jong u .

translation.en: Thus did Moses : according to all that the  Lord  commanded him , so did he .
translation.kha: U Moses u leh ïa kata baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
lada ki tih ka lynti jong ki shapoh ka kiba ïap , kem ïa ki . Wat lada ki kiew bneng , ngan patan ïa ki shapoh .
translation.en: Though they dig into hell , thence shall mine hand take them  ; though they climb up to heaven , thence will I bring them down :

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw jong ka jingsynshar u Hesekaïah — kaba long ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar erïong Syiem Hoshea ha Israel — u Shalmaneser u patsha ka Assyria u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel bad kerkut ïa ka Samaria .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah , which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel , that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria , and besieged it .

And he smote them from Aroer , even till thou come to Minnith , even twenty cities , and unto the plain of the vineyards , with a very great slaughter . Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U jop thiaw da kaba pynïap ïa ki naduh Aroer haduh ka thain Minnith , baroh ki long arphew tylli ki nongbah , bad haduh Abel Keramim . Ka la don ka jingpynïap briew kaba jur , bad ki Ammon ki shahjop ha ki Israel .
Haba ki lyngdoh ki dang mih na ka Templ , kyndit kyndit la surok ïa ka da u lyoh nongsah
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the priests were come out of the holy place , that the cloud filled the house of the  Lord  ,
And it shall come to pass , that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee , and say , Nineveh is laid waste : who will bemoan her ? whence shall I seek comforters for thee ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiba ïohi ïa pha kin kynran dien . Kin ong , ‘ Ka Ninebeh ka don ha ki jingjot ! Mano ba don kano kano ka jingisynei ïa ka ? Mano ba kwah ban pyntngen ïa ka ?’
baroh arliang ki dei ban leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei ba yn bishar ïa ki da ki lyngdoh ki bad nongbishar kiba treikam ha kata por ka .
translation.en: Then both the men , between whom the controversy is , shall stand before the  Lord  , before the priests and the judges , which shall be in those days  ;

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u pynlong ka jingkhawai kaba khraw kum ka jinglehburom ïa ka Esther khot bad sngewbha ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar bad nongpynïaidkam . U la pynbna shuti ha ka hima baroh kawei bad ai ki sngewbha jingai kiba kum shongdor ïa u syiem .
translation.en: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants , even Esther s feast  ; and he made a release to the provinces , and gave gifts , according to the state of the king .
He shall pour the water out of his buckets , and his seed shall be in many waters , and his king shall be higher than Agag , and his kingdom shall be exalted .
translation.kha: Kin ïoh kyrhai u slap Bad kin thung ïa la u symbai ha ki lyngkha ba ïoh um bha . U syiem jong ki un kham khraw ïa u Agag , Bad ka bor synshar jong u kan ïar kylleng sawdong .
Bad ka jingsuk U paw Terah palat ïa ka jingshemphang briew baroh , kan ri jai jai ïa ki dohnud jong sngewkwah , pei ïa kyllut jingmut jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: And the peace of God , which passeth all understanding , shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus .
I tell you , in that night there shall be two men in one bed  ; the one shall be taken , and the other shall be left .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , nga ong ha phi , yn don ar ngut ki briew kiba thiah ha kajuh ka jingthiah : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shadien .

translation.en: And the man of God was wroth with him , and said , Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times  ; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it : whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynbitar ïa u Elisha , bad u ong ïa u syiem ,  Me la dei ban pduh san ne hynriew sien , bad nangta men jin da la jop pura halor ki Syria ; hynrei mynta men jop ïa ki tang lai sien .
Haba ka Bathsheba ka la ïohsngew ba u tnga jong u ka la shah pynïap , ka ïambriew na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead , she mourned for her husband .

translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ngan pynlong ïa ka Ammon ban manbha biang . Ma , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Da kaba ka ong jutang bathymmai , U Blei u la pynlong rim ïa kata kaba nyngkong ; bad kano kano kaba kylla rim bad nang tymmen sa kan jah noh shen .
translation.en: In that he saith , A new covenant , he hath made the first old . Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away .
And God heard their groaning , and God remembered his covenant with Abraham , with Isaac , and with Jacob .
translation.kha: Kata ka jingud jong ki ka kiew sha U Blei , uba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud jong ki bad kynmaw ïa la ka jutang bad u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob .

translation.kha: Ym kumta da shisha ! Pynban , phi ong ha u , ‘ To pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam miet jong nga , nangta to phong ïa ka jaiñ-da    jong me bad shakri ïa nga katba nga dang bam bad dih ; hadien kata me lah ban bam ïa ka jingbam jong me .’

translation.en: And when king Arad the Canaanite , which dwelt in the south , heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies  ; then he fought against Israel , and took some of them prisoners .

translation.en: And they shall comfort you , when ye see their ways and their doings : and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ka jingpang bashyrkhei ka par baroh kawei ka met jong u bad ka pynlong ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong u ban pyut .

translation.en: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation , and the charge of the holy place , and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren , in the service of the house of the  Lord .

translation.en: Therefore I make a decree , That every people , nation , and language , which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , shall be cut in pieces , and their houses shall be made a dunghill : because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort .

Ym don uno uno u blei uba lah ban pyllait im kumne .
Hato me ba-ishyrkhei ba me Jephunneh u briew uba nyngkong ba la kha napdeng u khunbynriew ? Hato me don hangta mynba U Seboiim u la thaw ïa ki ba-mynbarim ?
translation.en: Art thou the first man that was born ? or wast thou made before the hills ?

translation.kha: Ba ka jingaiei ka ïa ngi hikai ban iehnoh ïa ka rukom im bymriewblei bad ïa ki jingkwah brai ba kynja pyrthei , bad ban im da kaba synshar ïa lade , ban im , hok bad ban im riewblei ha kane ka pyrthei ,
translation.en: Teaching us that , denying ungodliness and worldly lusts , we should live soberly , righteously , and godly , in this present world ;

translation.en: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow  ; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself : neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself .

translation.en: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book , that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name , THE  Lord  THY GOD  ;

translation.en: And when he was come , the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about , and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul , which they could not prove .

translation.kha: Rabbi kner ïa la ka kti kamon , bad kada khyndew ka jrut proberb ki nongshun jong Hul .
translation.en: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand , the earth swallowed them .

An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me , and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings , and thy peace offerings , thy sheep , and thine oxen : in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee , and I will bless thee .

translation.en: And the king said unto Ziba , What meanest thou by these ? And Ziba said , The asses be for the king s household to ride on  ; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat  ; and the wine , that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink .
Shew me the tribute money .  And they brought unto him a penny .

translation.en: That he would grant you , according to the riches of his glory , to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man ;

translation.en: Said with a loud voice , Stand upright on thy feet . And he leaped and walked .
translation.kha: To ïeng beit ha la ki kjat jong me !  Uta u briew u la kynthih bad u la sdang ban ïaid kylleng .

translation.en: For unto which of the angels said he at any time , Thou art my Son , this day have I begotten thee ? And again , I will be to him a Father , and he shall be to me a Son ?
translation.kha: Namar U Blei um shym la ong ha uno uno na ki angel jong u ,  Me long u khun jong nga ; mynta ka sngi nga la long U Kpa jong me .  Lymne U Blei um shym la ong shaphang uno uno u angel ,  Ngan long U Kpa u jong u bad un long u khun jong nga .

translation.en: And after a while came unto him they that stood by , and said to Peter , Surely thou also art one of them  ; for thy speech bewrayeth thee .

translation.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother , and shall be joined unto his wife , and they two shall be one flesh .
For , behold , I am for you , and I will turn unto you , and ye shall be tilled and sown :
translation.kha: Nga don ha ka liang jong phi , bad ngan pynthikna ba yn lur biang ïa ka khyndew jong phi bad ïa ki symbai yn thung hangta .

translation.en: But even after that we had suffered before , and were shamefully entreated , as ye know , at Philippi , we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention .

translation.en: And they shall cover the face of the earth , that one cannot be able to see the earth : and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped , which remaineth unto you from the hail , and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field :

translation.en: And he passed over before them , and bowed himself to the ground seven times , until he came near to his brother .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la leit ha shuwa jong ki , u da nguh ngon haduh khyndew hynñiew sien katba u nang leit sha jan u hynmen jong u .

Lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Trai U Blei phi kiba nga ai phi ka sngi , lada phi ieit ïa u , lada phi kohnguh u , bad lada phi sumar ïa ki aiñ jong u , phin manbha bad phin long ruh ka jaitbynriew kaba bun paid . Trai U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa kata ka ri ba phin ïohkynti
translation.en: In that I command thee this day to love the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments , that thou mayest live and multiply : and the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it .
And the fourth row , a beryl , an onyx , and a jasper : they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings .

translation.en: For I will have respect unto you , and make you fruitful , and multiply you , and establish my covenant with you .

translation.en: And the sons of Javan  ; Elishah , and Tarshish , Kittim , and Dodanim .

translation.en: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field , keeping watch over their flock by night .

bad ka Leah ka ong Katno , nga long kaba kmen ! Mynta ki kynthei kin khot ïa nga kaba ; kmen kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Asher .

translation.en: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof , and darkness shall pursue his enemies .

translation.en: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : that the land , whither I bring you to dwell therein , spue you not out .

kaba pynshong nongrim ha jingkyrmen ïa ka jingim bymjukut . U Blei u bym ju shukor , u la kular ïa ngi ïa kane ka jingim naduh ,
translation.en: In hope of eternal life , which God , that cannot lie , promised before the world began ;

translation.en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest , and found mandrakes in the field , and brought them unto his mother Leah . Then Rachel said to Leah , Give me , I pray thee , of thy son s mandrakes .

translation.en: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul , and told the tidings in the ears of the people : and all the people lifted up their voices , and wept .

translation.en: It'd be about time to reply to his letter .

translation.en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision , whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock .

To ngin ïaroh ïa ra-ngiep jingsop , U Blei jong ki Israel ! U la wan ïa ka ban jingshonshab ïa ki briew khmih’ lngaid bad ban pyllaitluid ïa ki .
translation.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel  ; for he hath visited and redeemed his people ,

translation.en: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles , and made their minds evil affected against the brethren .

translation.en: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges , but they went a whoring after other gods , and bowed themselves unto them : they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in , obeying the commandments of the  Lord   ; but they did not so .

translation.en: Bless ,  Lord  , his substance , and accept the work of his hands : smite through the loins of them that rise against him , and of them that hate him , that they rise not again .

translation.en: And the scribe said unto him , Well , Master , thou hast said the truth : for there is one God  ; and there is none other but he :

translation.en: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom , Let me now choose out twelve thousand men , and I will arise and pursue after David this night :

translation.en: For he looked for a city which hath foundations , whose builder and maker is God .

translation.kha: Hangno ka don ka jingkyrmen jong nga ? Mano ba ïohi ïa nga ?
Mynta , kane baroh long ka ka nuksa ïa ngi , ban maham ïa ngi ban ym kwah brai ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew , kumba ki la leh , lymne mane ïa ki bleithaw kumba , don na ki kiba la leh kumta .
translation.en: Now these things were our examples , to the intent we should not lust after evil things , as they also lusted .

translation.kha: Ka kham kordor ban ïa ka ksiar , ban ïa u khiew lane ksiar ïa ka ïit babha tam .
translation.en: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it : and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold .
A time to get , and a time to lose  ; a time to keep , and a time to cast away  ;
translation.kha: U buh ka por ban shem bad ka por ban jah , ka por ban kynshew bad ka por ban bret noh ,

U Jisu u la ïa ong ki , Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phi pan . Hato phi lah ban dih na ka khuri jong ka kaba jingshahshitom nga dei ban dih ? Hato phi lah ban shah pynbaptis ha ka ba rukom ka dei ïa nga ban shah pynbaptis ?
translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  Ye know not what ye ask : can ye drink of the cup that I drink of ? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?
And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering , which is for himself , and make an atonement for himself , and for his house .
translation.kha: Un kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia ban map ïa ki pop jong u bad jong ka longïing jong u .
Ngan tur ïaleh ïa kine briew ki bymman bad pynshitom ngan ïa ki . Ki jaitbynriew kin ïalumlang pyrshah ïa ki , bad yn pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop kiba bun ki jong ki .
translation.en: It is in my desire that I should chastise them  ; and the people shall be gathered against them , when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga kular skhem ba kumba nga uba long im bad kumba ka jingdon jong nga ka dap ïa ka pyrthei baroh ,
translation.en: But as truly as I live , all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the  Lord .
And the man departed out of the city from Beth–lehem–judah to sojourn where he could find a place : and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah , as he journeyed .
translation.kha: U mihnoh na Bethlehem ban leit wad jaka shong shawei . Katba u dang don ha ka jingleit kumta , u wan poi ha ka ïing u Mikah kaba ha ri lum Ephraim .

translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee , Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves , and in the second year that which springeth of the same  ; and in the third year sow ye , and reap , and plant vineyards , and eat the fruits thereof .
translation.kha: Nangta u Isaïah u ong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ,  Kane ka long ka dak ïa kaei ka ban sa jia . Mynta ka snem bad ha ka snem ka ban wan , men ïoh tang ïa ki kew khlaw ban bam , hynrei ha ka snem kaba bud men lah ban bet ïa u kew bad ot ïa u , bad ban thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ .

translation.en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh : the Lord shall have them in derision .
translation.kha: Na ka khet jong u ha bneng U Trai u rkhie u rkhiebeiñ ïa ki jingthmu batlot jong ki .

Dang step “ka ha ka sngi kaba bud , slem shuwa ban shai , U Jisu Jingïap Jingkular ïeng bad mihnoh na ka ïing pynshaitbor U la mihnoh jingbymdon-burom ka shnong sha ka jaka bakynjah , hangta u Gob duwai Paseah
translation.en: And in the morning , rising up a great while before day , he went out , and departed into a solitary place , and there prayed .

translation.kha: Te u la ong ha u Thomas , Buh ïa ka shynriah ti jong me hangne , bad peit ïa ki kti nga jong ; nangta kner ïa la ka kti bad buh ïa ka ha ka krung jong nga . Wat artatien shuh bad to ngeit !
translation.en: Then saith he to Thomas ,  Reach hither thy finger , and behold my hands  ; and reach hither thy hand , and thrust it into my side : and be not faithless , but believing .

translation.kha: Uno uba Khun , u don ïa kane ka jingim ; uno uno bym U Khun , um don ka
translation.en: He that hath the Son hath life  ; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life .
And they answered and said unto him , Where , Lord ? And he said unto them ,  Wheresoever the body is , thither will the eagles be gathered together .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hangno , ko Trai ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hangno hangno ha kaba don ka metïap , ki pukni kin ïalum hangta .

translation.en: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty , or the lawful captive delivered ?
translation.kha: Hato pha lah ban shim noh ïa ka jinglute na u shipai ? Hato pha lah ban pyllait ïa ki koidi na u nongsynshar uba leh jubor ?
Hynrei ma me , ko u briew jong U Blei , to kiar na kine kiei kiei . To ïaleh ïa ka tyngeh hok , ka jingriewblei , ka jingngeit , ka jingieit , ka jingïaishah , bad ka jingjemnud .
translation.en: But thou , O man of God , flee these things ; and follow after righteousness , godliness , faith , love , patience , meekness .

And , behold , Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the  Lord   ; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael , the ruler of the house of Judah , for all the king s matters : also the Levites shall be officers before you . Deal courageously , and the  Lord  shall be with the good .
translation.kha: U Amaraïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , un don ïa ka bor kaba hakhlieh tam ha baroh ki kam niam , bad u Sebadaïah u khun jong u Ishmael , u lat ka Judah , un don ïa ka bor bahakhlieh duh ha baroh ki kam hima sima . Ki Lebi kin kitkhlieh ban peit halor ki jingpyntreikam ïa ki jingrai jong ki ïingbishar . Long shlur bad pyndep ïa kine ki jingbthah , bad to U  Trai  un long ha ka liang jong kiba leh ïa kaba dei !

translation.en: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth , and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers  ; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain , and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in :
translation.kha: La thaw ïa ka da uta uba shong halor ka khet jong u shajrong ka khyndew bad sha lyndet ka sahit bneng ; ki briew shapoh ki i rit tang kum ki dkhiew . U pynpyiar ïa ka suiñbneng kum ka pyrda , kum ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba yn shong .
Haba u la ïohi ïa u Hynñiewphew bad u Ïoannis ba ki soi Shahasumah pyrsa u .—Eklesiastis kyrpad ïa ki ban ai Hannathon ei ïa u Pyndap
translation.en: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms .
And Moses commanded them , saying , At the end of every seven years , in the solemnity of the year of release , in the feast of tabernacles ,
translation.kha: U hukum ïa ki ,  Man kaba kut ka hynñiew snem , ynda poi ka snem ban pyllait noh ïa ki jingkit ram baroh , pule jam ïa kane ka hukum ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .

translation.en: Therefore , brethren , we are debtors , not to the flesh , to live after the flesh .
translation.kha: Te kumta , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ngi don ka kamram kaba ngi dei ban leh , hynrei kam dei ïa ngi ban im kat kum ka jingkwah jong ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong ngi .

translation.en: And in her was found the blood of prophets , and of saints , and of all that were slain upon the earth .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Babilon la pynshitom namar ïa ka snam jong ki nongïathuhlypa bad jong ki briew jong U Blei la shem hapoh ka nongbah ; ho-oid , ka snam jong kito baroh kiba la shah pynïap ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Mr So-and-So is dead . Why would I bother going to his funeral since , I am certain , he won't come to mine ?
translation.kha: I bah ine-ine i lah iap . Balei ngan leit sha jingontep jong i haba nga lah thikna , in nym wan sha jingontep jongnga ?

translation.en: Then released he Barabbas unto them : and when he had scourged Jesus , he delivered him to be crucified .
translation.kha: Nangta u Pilat u la pyllait ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki ; bad hadien kata , u la phah sympat ïa U Jisu , u la aiti ïa u ban sahnarphna .
Kaei nga lah ban ai ïa U Trai namar ka jinglehbha jong baroh ïa nga ?
translation.en: What shall I render unto the  Lord  for all his benefits toward me ?

translation.kha: kumta nga la kyntait noh ïa u bad ai ha nongsynshar u nongwei . Un sa ainong ïa uta u dieng kaei ïa kaba u dei ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong u .
translation.en: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen  ; he shall surely deal with him : I have driven him out for his wickedness .

translation.kha: Ki la pyrta biang , To pynïap noh ïa u ! Pynïap noh u ïa ! Sahnarphna ïa u ! U Pilat u la kylli ïa ki , Phi kwah ïa nga ba ngan sahnarphna ïa u syiem jong phi ? Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki jubab la , U syiem uba ngi don u dei tang u Patsha !
translation.en: But they cried out , Away with him , away with him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them , Shall I crucify your King ? The chief priests answered , We have no king but Caesar .
So Joshua rose up early in the morning , and brought Israel by their tribes  ; and the tribe of Judah was taken :
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud u Joshua u wan ïalam ïa ki Israel sha khmat , shi jait shi jait , bad la kdew ïa ka jait Judah .
Haba phi ai pynsyaid ei ei ïano ïano , jing-jngai shane ban shim bynda da u mawtylliat kew jong u , namar kata ka long kumba phi shim bynda ïa ka tiar khreh bam kaba kyrshan ïa ka jingim jong u .
translation.en: No man shall take the nether or the upper millstone to pledge : for he taketh a man s life to pledge .
The heart knoweth his own bitterness  ; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy .
translation.kha: Ka jingkmen jong phi ka long ka jong phi hi ; ka jingkthang jong phi ka long ka jong phi hi . Ym don uba lah ban ïasam ïa ki bad phi .
U Abner u pyrta ïa u Joab , ngin hap ban ïaleh shi junom ? Hato mem ba kaba don ei ei hynrei tang ka ? ba-ha-ïing jong . Slem sa katno ha shuwa ba men hukum jong me ban sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa ?
translation.en: Then Abner called to Joab , and said , Shall the sword devour for ever ? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end ? how long shall it be then , ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren ?

translation.kha: Shuhshuh u suri u la khreh bad Suriel la leit bad ki . Haba u Meshillemoth poi dop-syntiew la khrew ïa u Nongpynim ka kamra sner haneng , ha kaba Peleth riewkynthei baroh ki la ïalum sawdong ïa saiñdur , ki da ïam bad pyn-i ïa ki sopti bad ki jaiñkup kiba ka Dorkas ka la jingring mynba ka dang im .
translation.en: Then Peter arose and went with them . When he was come , they brought him into the upper chamber : and all the widows stood by him weeping , and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made , while she was with them .

And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes , and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls ! Will ye hunt the souls of my people , and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you ?
translation.kha: bad ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ïa ki :  Ma phi ki kynthei phi long kiba la tim ! Phi suh ki jingteh kti myntor na ka bynta uwei uwei baroh bad phi thaw ki jaiñ teh khlieh myntor na ka bynta uwei uwei ban phong ha ki khlieh jong ki , khnang ba ki lah ban don ka bor halor ka jingim jong kiwei pat ki briew . Phi kwah ban don ka bor jong ka jingim bad jingïap halor ki briew jong nga bad ban pyndonkam ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi ïa lade hi .

Ki briew iwbih Judah ki don ka jingrwai kaba Isaiah rwai : jaiñ slipar tlot Jingpang ngi bah kseh jingkit jingmynsaw ; Don bun bah ka synrum ban pynkhuid . Kumno ngi lah khun tei ïa ka kynroh syn-iang ka sngi ?
translation.en: And Judah said , The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed , and there is much rubbish  ; so that we are not able to build the wall .
For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Judah  ; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba la tip bha ba ïa u la kha kum u dkhot jong ka jait Judah ; bad u Moses um shym kdew ïa kane ka jait haba u la kren shaphang ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  went further , and stood in a narrow place , where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u angel u leit sha khmat ; u ïeng ha ka jaka kaba khim ha kaba ym don jaka ban ïaid na baroh arliang .

translation.en: Shall not the land tremble for this , and every one mourn that dwelleth therein ? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood  ; and it shall be cast out and drowned , as by the flood of Egypt .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka khyndew kan khynñiuh , bad uwei pa uwei ha ka ri un long ha ka jinglanot . Ka ri baroh kawei kan khynñiuh ; kan kiew bad kan hiar kum ka wah Nile .
Ki jinglong jong ka pyrthei ki pynshisha ba ka Hima jong U Blei la jan .
translation.en: World conditions confirm that God’s Kingdom will soon come .

translation.kha: U la long u nongïathuhlypa kriah bad u la tip aïu U Blei u la kular ïa u : 5 Blei u la pynlong ka jingsmai ba un pynlong syiem ïa uwei na ki khun Omri ksiew bynthiew u Dabid , kumba u Gershon u la long .
translation.en: Therefore being a prophet , and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him , that of the fruit of his loins , according to the flesh , he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne  ;
Then they suborned men , which said , We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses , and against God .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la pynbam pisa ïa ki katto katne ki rangbah ban ong ,  Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u ba u da kren pyrshah ïa u Moses bad pyrshah ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve .
translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , U Jisu u la wan ryngkat bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synran .

translation.en: And shall come forth  ; they that have done good , unto the resurrection of life  ; and they that have done evil , unto the resurrection of damnation .
translation.kha: Wat sngewlyngngoh ha kane ; ba ka por kan wan haba baroh kiba ïap kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u bad kin mihnoh na ki jingtep jong ki : Kito kiba la leh ïa kaba bha kin mihpat bad kin im , bad kito kiba la leh ïa kaba sniew kin mihpat bad yn pynrem ïa ki .

translation.en: And the spirit cried , and rent him sore , and came out of him : and he was as one dead  ; insomuch that many said , He is dead .
translation.kha: U mynsiem bymkhuid u la lynñiar , u la pynring kyrthat jur ïa u khynnah , bad u la mihnoh . U khynnah u la i kum uba ïap , bad baroh ki la ïa-ong ,  U la ïap !

translation.en: Your mother shall be sore confounded  ; she that bare you shall be ashamed : behold , the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness , a dry land , and a desert .
translation.kha: hynrei ïa ka nongbah bakhraw kaba dei ka jong phi yn pynpoh bad pynjahburom . Ka Babilonia kan long ka hima kaba poh tam na baroh ; kan long kaba ryngkhiang bad ka ri shyiap bym don um satia .

translation.en: One Lord , one faith , one baptism ,
translation.kha: Don tang uwei U Trai , kawei ka jingngeit , kawei ka jingpynbaptis ;

translation.en: My face is foul with weeping , and on my eyelids is the shadow of death  ;
translation.kha: Nga la ïam haduh ba ka durkhmat jong nga ka la sawkyr-ang , bad ki khmat jong nga ki la sieb bad la paw syrngiew sawdong jong ki ,

translation.en: For the scripture saith , Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym ngat ha ka jingsngewsih .
Ngi sngewsarong ruh ïa ki jingshah shitom jong ngi , namar tip ngi ba ka jingshah shitom ka pynmih ïa ka jingïaishah ,
translation.en: And not only so , but we glory in tribulations also : knowing that tribulation worketh patience ;
For the  Lord  hath driven out from before you great nations and strong : but as for you , no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la beh noh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw bad badonbor katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , bad ym don mano mano ba la lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa phi .

translation.en: And they held their peace . And he took him , and healed him , and let him go  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym ong ei ei . U Jisu u la shim ïa uta u briew , U la pynkhiah ïa u , bad U la phah noh ïa u .
A Trai uba U Blei , uba long ka thymmei jong Jingrakhe jingim baroh , nga kyrpad dujok me leh-isynei thung ïa u syrwiang uba lah ban ïalam ïa u paidbah ,
translation.en: Let the  Lord  , the God of the spirits of all flesh , set a man over the congregation ,

translation.kha: Ko paid Israel jong nga , phi la shah shoh kumba shoh , kew hynrei mynta nga la pynbna ha phi ka ïa khubor babha ba nga ïohsngew la na U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel .
translation.en: O my threshing , and the corn of my floor : that which I have heard of the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , have I declared unto you .

translation.kha: Phi ale pynïap ïa na-ei Oded ïalam sha ka tieng , hynrei U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u kyllum jingiathuhlypa pyntriem — Bashngain ngi long ki Lah Loit Ïakynduhlang .
translation.en: And killed the Prince of life , whom God hath raised from the dead  ; whereof we are witnesses .
And he called the name of that place Kibroth–hattaavah : because there they buried the people that lusted .
translation.kha: Ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Kibroth Hattaabah ( kaba mut  ki Jingtep ka jingkwah rhah  ) , namar hangta ki la tep ïa ki briew kiba la kwah rhah ban bam doh .
Bad U Jisu u la da kaba , To shahshkor te , lada phi don shkor !
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
Again he said unto her , Stand in the door of the tent , and it shall be , when any man doth come and enquire of thee , and say , Is there any man here ? that thou shalt say , No .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ïa ka ,  Ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka dara , bad lada uno uno u wan bad kylli ïa phi la hangne don briew ne em , sa ong em .

translation.en: Then the chief captain came near , and took him , and commanded him to be bound with two chains  ; and demanded who he was , and what he had done .
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la leit sha u Paul , u la kem ïa u , bad u la hukum ban teh ïa u da ar tylli ki kynjri . Nangta u la kylli ,  Uei une u briew , bad u la leh aïu ?
jingpynskhem dei u nongïathuhlypa bashisha , riewbieit syiem Jehoshaphat u ong . Kumta bymlarkam lai ngut ki Krit ki la leit sha u Elisha .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat said , The word of the  Lord  is with him . So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him .

translation.kha: Ko Israel , long kum ka tnga ba dang kham samla ba la iehnoh da tnga jong bad sngew jynjar sat . Hynrei U Trai pat ïa pha u ong :
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit , and a wife of youth , when thou wast refused , saith thy God .
For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done .
translation.kha: Ki la ïalumlang ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ma me da ka bor bad ka mon jong me , me la lah thmu ba kan jia .
ïa-pyrkhat uno uno “phla pdiang sngewbha ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa uwei uba kum une u dabi pynteh u pdiang ïa nga .
translation.en: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me .

translation.kha: Shim ïa jinghikai kiba me la ïohsngew ba pynbna ha ki sakhi babun , bad aiti ïa ki ha ki briew kiba lah , kiba lah hikai ïa kiwei ruh .
translation.en: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses , the same commit thou to faithful men , who shall be able to teach others also .
But now our soul is dried away : there is nothing at all , beside this manna , before our eyes .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta te ka bor met ruh ngim don shuh . Ym don ei ei ban bam — thylli lait sa tang kane ka manna na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat !
U Trai u ong , Ngan thaw ïa ka khyndew bathymmai bad ïa ki bathymmai . Kiei kiei kiba mynshuwa ym kynmaw shuh .
translation.en: For , behold , I create new heavens and a new earth : and the former shall not be remembered , nor come into mind .
When he established the clouds above : when he strengthened the fountains of the deep :
translation.kha: mynba u buh ïa ki lyoh ha sahit bneng , mynba u seng ïa ki umpohliew ka duriaw-bah ,
Wat la u Asa um shym la lut ïa ki jaka mane blei thala baroh , u ïaineh U Trai katba u dang im .
translation.en: But the high places were not removed : nevertheless Asa s heart was perfect with the  Lord  all his days .
Who are they among all the gods of these lands , that have delivered their land out of my hand , that the  Lord  should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand ?
translation.kha: Mynno na ki blei baroh jong kine ki ri uba la ju pyllait ïa la ka ri na u patsha jong ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U  Trai  u lah ban pyllait ïa ka Jerusalem ?

translation.en: And Jacob said , Sell me this day thy birthright .
translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Ngan ai ïa ka lada phi ai shuwa ha nga ïa ki hok jong phi kum u khun nyngkong .
Ko , parabangeit to duwai lem na ka bynta jong ngi .
translation.en: Brethren , pray for us .

translation.kha: Ka jingïap kan wan kum u nonglamktien barunar ïa ki riewbymman kiba .
translation.en: An evil man seeketh only rebellion : therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him .

translation.kha: U angel u ïa u , Buh ka doh bad u kpu halor u mawsiang , bad theh ïa syrwa halor jong ki . U Gideon leh kumta .
translation.en: And the angel of God said unto him , Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes , and lay them upon this rock , and pour out the broth . And he did so .
Whose mouths must be stopped , who subvert whole houses , teaching things which they ought not , for filthy lucre s sake .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba donkam ban pynsngap jar ïa ka jingïathuh jong ki , namar ki pynkylla khongpong ïa ki longïing baroh da kaba hikai ïa kaei kaba kim dei ban hikai , bad baroh ka long ïa ka jingthmu basngewlehrain ban thaw pisa .

translation.en: But if not , let fire come out from Abimelech , and devour the men of Shechem , and the house of Millo  ; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem , and from the house of Millo , and devour Abimelech .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kam long kumta , ai ba ka ding kan mihnoh na u Abimelekh bad kan bam duh ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo . Ai ba ka ding kan mih na ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo bad kan thang duh ïa u Abimelekh .

translation.en: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him  ; for they feared the people .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la sheptieng ïa u paidbah , bad kumta ki la pyrshang ban wad lad ban pynïap ïa U Jisu ha kaba jar jar .

translation.en: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown ? would ye stay for them from having husbands ? nay , my daughters  ; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the  Lord  is gone out against me .
translation.kha: hato phi lah hi ban ap haduh ba kin da san ? Hato kane kan khanglad ïa phi na kaba shongkurim ïano ïano ? Em , ko khun kynthei jong nga , phi tip ba kata kam lah ban long . U  Trai  u la phai pyrshah ïa nga , bad nga sngewsih shikatdei eh ïa phi .

translation.en: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty , and drink the blood of the princes of the earth , of rams , of lambs , and of goats , of bullocks , all of them fatlings of Bashan .

translation.en: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me , and set me upon my feet , that I heard him that spake unto me .
translation.kha: Katba kata ka sur ka dang kren , U Mynsiem U Blei u la rung ha nga , bad u la pynïeng ïa nga , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa kata ka sur ba ka dang ïai kren ,

translation.en: Tell us , when shall these things be ? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled ?
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi lano kane kan sa long ,  ki la ong ,  bad to ïathuh ïa ngi kaei ka ban jia ban pyn-i ba ka por ka la poi na ka bynta kine kiei kiei baroh ban long .

translation.en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days , and his brethren came to comfort him .
translation.kha: U Ephraim u kpa jong ki u ïambriew na ka bynta jong ki bun sngi , bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u ki wan pyntngen ïa u .
Sumar bha , U Jisu u la maham ïa ki bad ïa na u jong ki Pharisi bad u thiat u Herod
translation.en: And he charged them , saying ,  Take heed , beware of the leaven of the Pharisees , and of the leaven of Herod .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba ar , kñia khat-ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot kiba shynrang shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka . jingduna
translation.en: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks , two rams , fourteen lambs of the first year without spot :

translation.kha: Hato , ko paralok jong nga , phi bishar ïa pat kiwei ? Phim lait lah satia , phi lada long uei uei ruh . Namar haba phi bishar ïa kiwei bad nangta phi leh ïa kijuh kiei kiei kiba ki leh , phi pynrem ïa lade .
translation.en: Therefore thou art inexcusable , O man , whosoever thou art that judgest : for wherein thou judgest another , thou condemnest thyself ; for thou that judgest doest the same things .

translation.kha: Ynda ngi nongtrei” kam Ynda ïa kata ka ri , nga donhok ha ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad ïa ka jaka kaba shatei na ka shnong Aroer hajan ka wah Arnon bad shiteng mynhynnin ka ri lum Gilead lem bad ki shnong jong ka .
translation.en: And this land , which we possessed at that time , from Aroer , which is by the river Arnon , and half mount Gilead , and the cities thereof , gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u u syiem la thung ïa u Mordekai ha ka kam synshar khadar .
translation.en: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time , then Mordecai sat in the king s gate .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha U mraw um kham khraw ïa u kynrad jong u bad u nonglamktien um long kham khraw ban ïa uta la ïa .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , The servant is not greater than his lord  ; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him .

translation.kha: Nangno ki mih ki thma bad ki jingïakajia jong phi ? Ki mih na ki jingkwah brai jong phi ïa ka jingsngewbha , kiba ïaleh jong phi .
translation.en: From whence come wars and fightings among you ? come they not hence , even of your lusts that war in your members ?
Salute Priscilla and Aquila , and the household of Onesiphorus .
translation.kha: ka jingai khublei ïa ka Priskila bad u Akwila bad ïa ka ïing u Onesiphoros .

translation.en: And I saw no temple therein : for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it .
translation.kha: Ngam shym ïohi ïa ka templ ha ka nongbah , namar ka templ jong ka , u long U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh bad U Khunlangbrot .

Nga tei ka Templ ban ai burom Nongleitkurim U Trai U Blei jong nga . Kan long ka jaka bakhuid ha kaba ki briew jong nga bad ma nga ngin mane Kyrpad u da bajam thang ki khnap da ki musla iwbih , bad ha kaba ngin ïai ai ki jingainguh ha u da u kpu Artakserksis , bad ha kaba khyndaispah ai ki jingainguh thang man khieshoh step bad janmiet , kumjuh ruh ha ki sngi Sabbaton , ki Jingrakhe Bnai Thymmai , bad kiwei pat ki sngi khuid ban ai Bethdagon ïa U Trai U Blei jong ngi . Hobab la hukum ïa ki Israel ban leh ïa kane junom la junom .
translation.en: Behold , I build an house to the name of the  Lord  my God , to dedicate it to him , and to burn before him sweet incense , and for the continual shewbread , and for the burnt offerings morning and evening , on the sabbaths , and on the new moons , and on the solemn feasts of the  Lord  our God . This is an ordinance for ever to Israel .

translation.kha: hynrei u Eleasar u la ïap khlem don khun shynrang ; u don ki khun kynthei . Ki khun kynthei jong u ki shongkurim ïa ki bakha jong ki , khun u Kish
translation.en: And Eleazar died , and had no sons , but daughters : and their brethren the sons of Kish took them .
And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead , and strengthened himself against Israel .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u long syiem hadien u Asa u kpa jong u , bad u la pynkhlaiñ ïa lade pyrshah ïa ka Israel .

translation.en: And when we came to Rome , the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard : but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him .
translation.kha: Ka jingim bathymmai ha U Khrist
U Trai u la hukum ïa ngi ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba Uriah la leh mynta ka sngi , khnang ban map Jerusalem’ ka pop jong Agabos .
translation.en: As he hath done this day , so the  Lord  hath commanded to do , to make an atonement for you .

translation.kha: Haba U Trai la ïohi haduh katno ka jingsniew jong uwei pa uwei briew ha ka pyrthei katno ki jingmut jingpyrkhat bymman jong ha ki ,
translation.en: And  God  saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth , and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually .

translation.kha: Ngam ap lah shuh , nga kwah ban kren . Ngam lah shuh ban kun ïa ki ktien .
translation.en: For I am full of matter , the spirit within me constraineth me .

translation.kha: Nga la matlah namar ka jingshai baphyrnai , bad kumta ki paralok jong nga ki la nga kti bad ki la ïa nga sha Damaskos .
translation.en: And when I could not see for the glory of that light , being led by the hand of them that were with me , I came into Damascus .
He that loveth his brother abideth in the light , and there is none occasion of stumbling in him .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ieit ïa la u hynmen u para u ïaid ha ka jingshai , bad kumta ym don kaei kaei ha u ka ban pynlong ïano ïano pat ban leh pop .

translation.en: Now when I passed by thee , and looked upon thee , behold , thy time was the time of love  ; and I spread my skirt over thee , and covered thy nakedness : yea , I sware unto thee , and entered into a covenant with thee , saith the Lord  God  , and thou becamest mine .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang ïaid lyngba biang , nga la ïohi ba ka por ka la poi ïa pha ban shoh jingieit . Nga la tap ïa ka jinglyngkhuit jong pha da ka jaiñ jynsur jong nga bad nga la kular ban ieit ïa pha . Ho-oid nga la pynlong ka jutang shongkurim bad pha , bad pha long ka jong nga .  Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong .
U long ma u , u ban tei ïa ka bad ïa ka burom kaba dei ïa un synshar ïa briew jong u . U lyngdoh un hajan ka khet jong , bad kin ïatreilang ha ka jingsuk bad .’
translation.en: Even he shall build the temple of the  Lord   ; and he shall bear the glory , and shall sit and rule upon his throne  ; and he shall be a priest upon his throne : and the counsel of peace shall be between them both .

translation.kha: Phi shaniah ha ki waitlam jong phi . Ki kam phi ki long kiba ijli . pa uwei u klim . Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ka ri ka dei ka jong phi ?
translation.en: Ye stand upon your sword , ye work abomination , and ye defile every one his neighbour s wife : and shall ye possess the land ?

translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko Amasaïah , U Trai u ong ïa me , ‘ Ka tnga jong me kan long ka nuti ha ki bah lynti bad , ïa ki khun jong me yn sa pynïap ha ka thma . Ïa ka khyndew jong yn me phiah bad sam kiwei ha pat ; bad me ïa lade men ïap ha ka ri bymngeit blei . Bad ki paid Israel da shisha kin shah ringmraw na la ka .’ ri
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city , and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword , and thy land shall be divided by line  ; and thou shalt die in a polluted land : and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land .
At my first answer no man stood with me , but all men forsook me : I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge .
translation.kha: Ym don ba kyrshan ïa nga haba nga ïasaid da ïa lade nyngkong eh ha khmat ki bor synshar ; baroh ki la iehnoh ïa nga . Nga duwai ba U Blei un ym thew pyrshah ïa ki !

translation.en: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Shechem , unto the plain of Moreh . And the Canaanite was then in the land .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka ri Kanaan , u Abram u ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri haduh ba un da poi ha u dieng kyntang jong u Moreh , ka jaka bakhuid ha Shekhem . ( Ha kata ka por , ki Kanaan ki dang don ha ka ri . )

translation.en: Entreat the  Lord  ( for it is enough ) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail  ; and I will let you go , and ye shall stay no longer .
translation.kha: To duwai ha U  Trai  ! Ngi la shah la biang ïa une u pyrthat bad u phria ! Nga kular ban pyllait ïa phi ; phim donkam ban dang sah shuh hangne .

Mynta , la don ka jingong kaba thikna ba ka don ka jingïaleh hapdeng jong phi shyrkhei haduh katta katta ba wat ki sngewrem ïa kata La ïathuh ïa nga ba uwei u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka meinah!
translation.en: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you , and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles , that one should have his father s wife .

translation.kha: u Petros u la kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U Jisu la lah ïathuh ha u : Shuwa ba syiar un kyn-ih , ong lai sien ba mem ithuh nga . U mihnoh bad u la ïamkthang .
translation.en: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus , which said unto him ,  Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And he went out , and wept bitterly .

translation.kha: Mynta ngan pynlong pawkhmat me haka mutlop bad Hymenaïos dohnud spoiñ ma wiang .
translation.en: Behold , I have made thy face strong against their faces , and thy forehead strong against their foreheads .

translation.kha: Ym tieng ei ei kaba jah Jinglait U Dabid u ïoh jingsotti ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei baroh kyrkhu ki briew jong u , Balah ïa download mar lute baroh ba Shatei Amalek ki la kit .
translation.en: And there was nothing lacking to them , neither small nor great , neither sons nor daughters , neither spoil , nor any thing that they had taken to them : David recovered all .
Then said I , Woe is me ! for I am undone  ; because I am a man of unclean lips , and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips : for mine eyes have seen the King , the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Ym don jingkyrmen ïa nga ! Nga long ba la tim namar kawei pa kawei ka kyntien kaba mih na ki rmiang shyntur jong nga ka long kaba pop , bad nga shong nga sah hapdeng ki briew kiba kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ka long kaba pop . Bad pynban , da la ki jong ki khmat nga la ïohi ïa U Syiem , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh , arm yourselves likewise with the same mind : for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Khrist u la shahshitom ha ka doh , phi ruh phi dei ban pynkhlaiñ ïa lade da kajuh ka jingpyrkhat kaba u la don ; namar uno uno uba shahshitom ha ka doh um ïakhleh shuh bad ka pop .

translation.en: The increase of his house shall depart , and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath .
translation.kha: Ïa ka spah jong u baroh yn pynjot ha ka jingshlei jong ka jingbitar U Blei .
Me u nongsynshar uba bymman bymkhuid bad jong ki Israel , ka sngi jong me , ka jong sngi ka jingpynshitom ba kut , ka wan .
translation.en: And thou , profane wicked prince of Israel , whose day is come , when iniquity shall have an end ,
When he had heard therefore that he was sick , he abode two days still in the same place where he was .
translation.kha: Pynban haba u la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor ba u Lasaros u la pang , U la nang sah sa ar sngi ha ka jaka kaba U la don .
Hynrei lada u mraw u pynbna ba u ieit ïa la :13-15 kynrad , ïa la ka tnga , du ïa la ki khun , bad kparad kwah ban ïoh laitluid ,
translation.en: And if the servant shall plainly say , I love my master , my wife , and my children  ; I will not go out free :
You are so beautiful .
translation.kha: Phi bhabriew bha .

Hynrei U Jisu u sim long u lyngdoh da ka jingsmai Pynphong U Blei u la ong ha u , U thapniang u Raamah pynlong thiang jingsmai jingpynshai bad un ym kylla shuh : ‘ Me , me long jingtyrwa lyngdoh junom .’
translation.en: ( For those priests were made without an oath  ; but this with an oath by him that said unto him , The Lord sware and will not repent , Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec : )

translation.kha: Wat ïa ki bad ki jaiñ-da kiba u la pyndonkam la leit lam sha kito kiba , bad ïa jingpang jong la noh , bad ki mynsiem bymman ki ju mihnoh ki
translation.en: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons , and the diseases departed from them , and the evil spirits went out of them .
Then said Martha unto Jesus , Lord , if thou hadst been here , my brother had not died .
translation.kha: Ka Martha ka la ong ïa U Jisu ,  Lada men jin da la don hangne , ko Trai , u para jong nga un ym jin da la ïap !

translation.en: For there are some eunuchs , which were so born from their mother s womb : and there are some eunuchs , which were made eunuchs of men : and there be eunuchs , which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven s sake . He that is able to receive it , let him receive it .
translation.kha: Naba don shibun ki daw baïapher balei ba ki briew kim lah ban shongkurim : katto katne , namar ba la kha ïa ki kumta ; kiwei pat , namar ba ki briew ki pynlong ïa ki kumta ; bad kiwei pat kim shongkurim na ka bynta ka Hima ki bneng . Ai ba uta uba lah ban pdiang ïa kane ka jinghikai un leh kumta .
Haba U Trai la ïohi ïa kane , u kren sa shisien u Shemaïah bad u ong ha u , Namar ba ki phla ïa la ki pop ngan ym pynjot ïa . Hynrei haba u Shishak u tur ïaleh , kin im .
translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that they humbled themselves , the word of the  Lord  came to Shemaiah , saying , They have humbled themselves  ; therefore I will not destroy them , but I will grant them some deliverance  ; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak .

translation.kha: Nga thngan , hynrei phim shym bsa nga , sliang , hynrei phim shym ai jingdih nga
translation.en: For I was an hungred , and ye gave me no meat : I was thirsty , and ye gave me no drink :
For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law : and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law ;
translation.kha: Ki Jentil kim don ka Hukum u Moses ; ki leh pop bad bakla lynti khlem ka Hukum . Ki Jiw ki don ka Hukum ; ki leh pop bad shah bishar da ka Hukum .

translation.en: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king s princes , which have heard of the deed of the queen . Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath .
translation.kha: Haba ki tnga jong ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem jong ka Persia bad Media kin ïohsngew shaphang ka jingleh jong ka mahadei kin ong ïa la ki tnga jong ki shaphang kata shuwa ba ka sngi kan kut . Ki kynthei ha kylleng sawdong kin ym burom shuh ïa la ki tnga , bad ki shynrang kin dap da ka jingbitar ïa la ki tnga .
U la kajuh ai ka hukum ïa uba ar , uba lai , bad ïa kita baroh kiba khmih ïa kita ki kynhun jingri , Phi dei ban ong kumne ha u Iso haba phi ïakynduh u ïa .
translation.en: And so commanded he the second , and the third , and all that followed the droves , saying , On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau , when ye find him .
And thou shalt take the other ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .
translation.kha: Shim ïa uta uwei pat u langbrot — u langbrot ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang — bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: Saying , Touch not mine anointed , and do my prophets no harm .
translation.kha: Wat pynmynsaw ïa ki shakri ba la jied jong nga ; wat ktah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga .

translation.en: And hath not eaten upon the mountains , neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel , neither hath defiled his neighbour s wife , neither hath come near to a menstruous woman ,
translation.kha: Um ju mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki Israel lane bam ïa ki jingkñia ba la ainguh ha ki jaka mane ba la mana . Um ju khroh pynbieit ïa ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew lane ïathiah shongkha bad ka kynthei ha ka por poi bnai jong ka .

translation.en: I decked thee also with ornaments , and I put bracelets upon thy hands , and a chain on thy neck .
translation.kha: Nga buh ki mawlynnai ha pha — ki khadu bad ki kpieng .
U Jisu bad la ki ki la leit da ka lieng sha ka thain Gadara kaba sha shiliang jong ka duriaw .
translation.en: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes , which is over against Galilee .

translation.kha: To ïam bad to kyang haba phi ïohsngew ïa . kane kiba Phi shong basah ha ki bynta ba ha trai jong ka nongbah , namar baroh ki nongkhaïi kin ïap !
translation.en: Howl , ye inhabitants of Maktesh , for all the merchant people are cut down  ; all they that bear silver are cut off .

translation.kha: U sngewlem u ïalam ïa marjan Israel hynriew snem . Hadien bakohnguh u la ïap bad la tep jingialam u ha manna jong u kaba Hamath phylliah .
translation.en: And Jephthah judged Israel six years . Then died Jephthah the Gileadite , and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead .

translation.kha: Dei kiba ïaroh ïa me , kumba nga ïaroh ïa me mynta . Ki kpa ki ïathuh ïa la ki katno me long uba ïaineh .
translation.en: The living , the living , he shall praise thee , as I do this day : the father to the children shall make known thy truth .

So Haman came in . And the king said unto him , What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour ? Now Haman thought in his heart , To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Haman u wan shapoh , bad u syiem u ong ha u ,  Don uba nga kwah eh ban lehburom . Kaei kaba ngan leh na ka bynta une u briew ?  U Haman u la pyrkhat ha lade ,  Mynta ïano u syiem u kwah eh ban pyndonburom ? Dei ïa nga keiñ .

translation.en: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart  ; and they defile the man .
translation.kha: Hynrei kiei kiei kiba mihnoh shabar na ka shyntur ki wan na ka dohnud , bad kine ki long kiei kiei kiba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u briew kat kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: And when he was come in , he did eat and drink , and said , Go , see now this cursed woman , and bury her : for she is a king s daughter .
translation.kha: u rung shapoh ïingsyiem , bad u bam jingbam . Hadien kata u ong ,  Shim ïa kato ka kynthei ba la shah tim , bad tep ïa ka ; naba ka dei ka khun jong u syiem .

translation.en: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace , and things wherewith one may edify another .
translation.kha: Te kumta , ngi dei borabor ban thmu ban leh ïa kita kiei kiei kiba wallam ka jingsuk bad kiba ïarap ban pynkhlaiñ iwei ïa iwei pat .
U Demas u la kham noh ha ki kam pyrthei bad u la iehnoh ïa nga , bad la u leit sha noh Thessaloni . U Kreskens u la leit sha Galatia ; u Titos sha Dalmatia .
translation.en: For Demas hath forsaken me , having loved this present world , and is departed unto Thessalonica ; Crescens to Galatia , Titus unto Dalmatia .

Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law , Remain a widow at thy father s house , till Shelah my son be grown : for he said , Lest peradventure he die also , as his brethren did . And Tamar went and dwelt in her father s house .
translation.kha: Nangta u Judah u ong ha ka Tamar ka pyrsa kurim jong u ,  Khie leit phai noh sha ka ïing u kpa jong pha bad to ïaisah riewkynthei tad haduh ba u Shelah u khun jong nga un da rangbah .  U ong kumta naba u sheptieng ïoh ba u Shelah un shah pynïap kum ki hynmen jong u . Kumta ka Tamar ka la leit phai noh sha la ïing .

translation.en: And Zacchaeus stood , and said unto the Lord  ; Behold , Lord , the half of my goods I give to the poor  ; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation , I restore him fourfold .
translation.kha: U Sakhaïos u la ïeng joit bad u la ong ha U Trai ,  To shahshkor , kynrad ! ngan ai shiteng na ki jingdon jingem jong nga ha kiba duk , bad lada nga la shukor ïano ïano , ngan siew pat ïa u sa saw shah .
Wat rah ïa kano kano ka ksiar , ka rupa , lane ka pisa ha tama ki pla jong phi ;
translation.en: Provide neither gold , nor silver , nor brass in your purses ,
Reprobate silver shall men call them , because the  Lord  hath rejected them .
translation.kha: Yn khot ïa ki , ka eitnar bymdondor , namar ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kyntait ïa ki .

U long ma u uba , la ïadon lem bad ki paid Israel haba ki la ïalumlang ka ha ri shyiap ; u la don lem hangta bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi lem bad u angel uba la kren ha u , ha u lum Sinai , bad u la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor ba-im ka jong U Blei ban ai pateng ha ngi .
translation.en: This is he , that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sinai , and with our fathers : who received the lively oracles to give unto us :

translation.kha: U khunbynriew mawkhang u dei sahkut ïohi ïa ka jingpynim ka jong U Blei !’
translation.en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God .
Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love ? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways .
translation.kha: Phi tip thikna kumno ban ïabeh nadien ki nongleh-ieit . Wat ki kynthei kiba sniew eh ki lah ban ïoh jinghikai na phi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Judah  ; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain  ; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley , because they had chariots of iron .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa ki paid Judah , bad ki la shim kynti ïa ka ri lum . Hynrei kim shym la kurup ïa ka Gasa , ka Ashkelon , lane ka Ekron lem bad ki jaka sawdong jong ki . Kine ki briew kiba shong basah harud duriaw ki don ïa ki kali ïapom da ka nar , bad kumta ki paid Judah kim shym la lah ban beh krad ïa ki .

translation.en: When the morning stars sang together , and all the sons of God shouted for joy ?
translation.kha: Hamar ka kynjat shai jong kata ka sngi , ki khlur ki ïarwai lang , bad baroh ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng ki risa da ka jingkmen .

U Jeroboam u syiem ki Israel phrang la tei kynroh ïa ka shnong Shekhem bakhynwin ha ri lum Ephraim bad u la sah hangta katto katne por . Nangta u la parabriew bad u tei kynroh sa ïa ka shnong Penuel .
translation.en: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim , and dwelt therein  ; and went out from thence , and built Penuel .

translation.kha: Nga thiah ha ka jingshahjop ha ka khyndew ; to pynkhie im biang ïa nga , kumba me la kular .
translation.en: My soul cleaveth unto the dust : quicken thou me according to thy word .
If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death , and those that are ready to be slain  ;
translation.kha: Wat pynslem ban pyllait ïa uno uno uba la jan shah rai pynrem bymhok .
