And he said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron , is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word ? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die .
translation.kha: bad u ong ha u ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Namar ba me la phah ki nonglamktien ban kylli na u Baalsebub , u blei ka Ekron — i kumba ym don blei ha Israel ban kylli — men ym ïohkhiah ; men ïap !’

Wat bymlarkam ka la Matthaïos bih ka jingtlot ba u la shah pynïap halor ka mihpaw , dei da ka bor Nonghikai’ Blei shohdab u soskular . Ha u ngi ruh ngi long kiba tlot ; hynrei ha ki jingïadei jong ngi bad phi ngin ïa-ïoh bynta lem pynwai Shekhem bor U Blei ha ka jingim Khatduh riewlamler .
translation.en: For though he was crucified through weakness , yet he liveth by the power of God . For we also are weak in him , but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you .

translation.kha: Kumta leit phai pat bad shem ïa ka ïing khuid bad kaba pynbeit ryntih
translation.en: And when he cometh , he findeth it swept and garnished .
Now let them put away their whoredom , and the carcases of their kings , far from me , and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever .
translation.kha: Mynta ki dei ban sangeh noh na kaba mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei bad weng ïa ki metïap jong ki syiem jong ki . Lada ki leh kumta , ngan shong hapdeng jong ki junom .

translation.en: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth–maachah , and they cast up a bank against the city , and it stood in the trench : and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall , to throw it down .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong u Joab ki la ïohsngew ba u Sheba u don hangta , bad kumta ki la leit ban kerkut ïa ka nongbah . Ki tei ka kynton stong marpyrshah ïa ka kynroh kaba phai shabar bad ki la sdang ruh ban tih sha trai ka kynroh ban pynkhyllem ïa ka .

translation.en: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the  Lord  , as the waters cover the sea .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka pyrthei kan long ba la dap da ka jingtip ïa ka burom U  Trai  kumba ki duriaw ki dap da ka um .

translation.en: Wherefore doth a living man complain , a man for the punishment of his sins ?
translation.kha: Balei ngin shu ïai khñium haba la pynshitom ïa ngi na ka bynta ka pop jong ngi .

translation.en: Judas then , having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees , cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons .
translation.kha: Kumta u Judas u la leit sha kata ka kper , u da ïalam bad u ïa ka kynhun ki shipai Rom , bad katto katne ki nongap phira jong ka Templ ïa kiba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ; ki la long kiba la kieng atiar bad ki la rah ïa ki sharak bad ki dongmusa .

translation.en: To fulfil the word of the  Lord  by the mouth of Jeremiah , until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths : for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath , to fulfil threescore and ten years .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ïathuh mynshuwa lyngba u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa la pyndep :  Ka ri kan sa sah kynjah haduh hynñiewphew snem , ban pynïabiang ïa ka jingshongthait Sabbaton , ïa kaba ym pat shym la rakhe .

translation.en: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads : and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynlong ruh ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem ban shitom namar ka jingbymman jong ki , kumba u Jotham , u khun jong u Gideon , u ong ïa ki ba kin long kumta haba u la tim ïa ki .

translation.en: And when he had spoken such words unto me , I set my face toward the ground , and I became dumb .
translation.kha: Haba u la kren ïa kane , nga la peit sha khyndew , khlem lait kren .

translation.en: And Naboth said to Ahab , The  Lord  forbid it me , that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohpateng ïa kane ka bri sohwaiñ na ki kpa tymmen jong nga .  U Naboth u jubab .  U  Trai  u khang ba ngan ai ïa ka ha phi .

translation.en: Then Asa went out against him , and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah .
translation.kha: U Asa u leit ban ïaleh ïa u , bad baroh arliang ki ïeng ha la ki jaka ha ka Them Sephathah hajan Mareshah .
Ka jingainguh bam baroh ïa kaba la syang ha dpei , lane ïa kaba la sdieh ha ka karai lane ha u khiew ba la tap ka dei ka jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia ainguh U .
translation.en: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven , and all that is dressed in the fryingpan , and in the pan , shall be the priest s that offereth it .
Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness , and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son .
translation.kha: U la pyllait ïa ngi na ka bor jong ka jingdum bad u la wallam ha ka jingsuk ïa ngi sha ka hima jong U Khun ba-ieit jong u .

Sher ki jingleh thombor yn ym ïohsngew shuh , ka jingjot kan riewthombor don shuh hapoh ki pud jong pha ; ngan ïada bad ba-ijli ïa pha kum ka kynroh : Phan ïaroh Nasareth nga namar nga la pyllait jongka pha .
translation.en: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land , wasting nor destruction within thy borders  ; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation , and thy gates Praise .

translation.kha: Ïaid shaphrang bad khyndaispah ïa u kpu jong phi Oniks khlad pdang sha U Blei Pyndonburom bad synduk sngewsarong shaphang ki jingainguh ba tam ba jingnang wallam ! Kane ka kmienah ka rukom ïa kaei kaei kaba phi ieit ban leh .
translation.en: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven , and proclaim and publish the free offerings : for this liketh you , O ye children of Israel , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Mynta ai hukum ban Diamond ïa ki jingri jong me bad ïa shahshkor! kiwei pat baroh Jingïaleh me don ha lum . U phria un pynpoi ha ki briew bad ki mrad kiba don habar khlem Adnah , bad baroh kin ïap lut .’
translation.en: Send therefore now , and gather thy cattle , and all that thou hast in the field  ; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field , and shall not be brought home , the hail shall come down upon them , and they shall die .

translation.kha: Trai u la ong ha nga , To ïeng ha ïingbishar jong Templ bad to pynbna ïa baroh kaba la hukum ïa me ki briew kiba wan na ki shnong Judah ban mane . ym iehnoh ei ruh em .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Stand in the court of the  Lord s  house , and speak unto all the cities of Judah , which come to worship in the  Lord s  house , all the words that I command thee to speak unto them  ; diminish not a word :
Be strong and of a good courage : for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land , which I sware unto their fathers to give them .
translation.kha: Kut jingmut triang bad long skhem , namar men long u nongïalam jong kine ki briew katba ki shim kynti ïa kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
Uwei na ki synran , uta ïa uba U Jisu ieit u , u da shong shaniah ha U Jisu .
translation.en: Now there was leaning on Jesus  bosom one of his disciples , whom Jesus loved .
Grace to you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: If the place which the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee , then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock , which the  Lord  hath given thee , as I have commanded thee , and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after .
translation.kha: Lada kata ka jaka mane Blei ka jngai eh , phi lah , ha kano kano ka por ba phi kwah , ban pynïap ïa kano kano ka masi lane ka blang ba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi , bad bam ïa ka doh jong ka ha la ïing , kumba nga la hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land , died by the plague before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la shoh ïa ki da ka jingpang , bad ki la ïap .

translation.en: Thou hast increased the nation , O  Lord  , thou hast increased the nation : thou art glorified : thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me la pynlong ïa ka hima jong ngi ban roi , da kaba pynïar ïa ka ri ha baroh sawdong , bad kane ka la wallam ïa me ka burom .

translation.en: His head and his hairs were white like wool , as white as snow  ; and his eyes were as a flame of fire  ;
translation.kha: U shñiuh jong u , u la long uba lieh kum u  saiwul lane kum ka ïor , bad ki khmat jong u kiba klang kum ka ding ;

translation.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered , saying , As the  Lord  hath said unto thy servants , so will we do .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Gad bad ka jait Reuben ki jubab ,  Kynrad , ngin leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
u don la ki khun shynrang ; bad kine ynda ki la san ki beh noh ïa u na Jephthah ïing . Ki ong ha u , Men ym ïoh bynta ei ei ha ïing i pa jong ngi , naba me dei u khun na kawei pat ka briew .
translation.en: And Gilead s wife bare him sons  ; and his wife s sons grew up , and they thrust out Jephthah , and said unto him , Thou shalt not inherit in our father s house  ; for thou art the son of a strange woman .
And went after the man of God , and found him sitting under an oak : and he said unto him , Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah ? And he said , I am .
translation.kha: Ki leh kumta , bad halor jong ka u la hiar arsut ha ka lynti nadien u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah bad u lap ïa u ba u shong ha trai uwei u dieng Sning .  Hato phi dei uta u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah ?  u kylli .  Nga dei ,  uta u briew u jubab .

translation.en: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them , that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes  ; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban sumar ïa kane ka jingpynbeit ryntih ha ki por ki ban wan baroh . Uta u briew uba synreit ïa ka um ka jingpynkhuid u dei ruh ban sait ïa la ki jaiñ ; uno uno uba ktah ïa kata ka um u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
Haba la poi ktien ha ki “Phi ba ki shipai Ijipt , ba la ïalam da u syiem Tirhakah jong ka Sudan , u dang wan ban tur wanlam Jingkdew phum .
translation.en: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia , He is come forth to make war with thee . And when he heard it , he sent messengers to Hezekiah , saying ,
In the wilderness , Beth–arabah , Middin , and Secacah ,
translation.kha: Ha ka ri shyiap don ka Beth Arabah , ka Middin , ka Sekakah ,
Ngan teh pynshlei khum ïa me kumta ba men ym Tamarisk ban phai na kawei ka liang sha kawei pat , tad ynda la pynkut ïa ka jingshah kerkut mem
translation.en: And , behold , I will lay bands upon thee , and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another , till thou hast ended the days of thy siege .

translation.kha: Ynda U paidbah u wan sngewthuh ïa phi sha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti , phin Jerusalem ïa ka jingkyrkhu nalor u lum Gerisim bad ïa kata ka jingtim nalor Migdol lum Ebal .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when the  Lord  thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it , that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim , and the curse upon mount Ebal .

And he fenced it , and gathered out the stones thereof , and planted it with the choicest vine , and built a tower in the midst of it , and also made a winepress therein : and he looked that it should bring forth grapes , and it brought forth wild grapes .
translation.kha: U la tih ïa ka khyndew bad u la weng ïa ki maw na ka ; u la thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba kynsai . U la tei ka jaka ap phira ban khmih sumar ïa ki , u la tih ka thliew na ka bynta ban ïuh ïa ki sohwaiñ . U la ap ïa ki sohwaiñ ban ih , hynrei uwei pa uwei u sohwaiñ u long uba jew .

translation.en: That their hearts might be comforted , being knit together in love , and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding , to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God , and of the Father , and of Christ ;
translation.kha: Nga leh ïa kane khnang ba yn pyndap ïa ki da ka jingshlur bad ba yn lah ban khring lang ïa ki ha ka jingieit , bad kumta kin ïoh ïa ka jingdap ba-pura ïa ka jingsngewskhem kaba ka jingshemphang ka wallam . Ha kane ka rukom kin tip ïa ka jingmaïan ka jong U Blei , kaba long U Khrist hi .

translation.en: Saying , I am the God of thy fathers , the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . Then Moses trembled , and durst not behold .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga long U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong me , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob .’ U Moses u la khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng bad um shym la nud ban peit .

translation.en: Then again Abraham took a wife , and her name was Keturah .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Keturah .

translation.en: Knowing this , that our old man is crucified with him , that the body of sin might be destroyed , that henceforth we should not serve sin .
translation.kha: Bad ngi tip ba ïa ka jinglong barim jong ngi la pynïap noh bad U Khrist halor ka diengphna , khnang ba ïa ka bor jong ka jinglong pop jong ngi , yn pynjot noh , khnang ba ngin ym long shuh ki mraw jong ka pop .
Namar ba U Blei u la pynkhreh lypa ïa kaei kaei kaba kham bha na ka bynta jong . Ka ngi jingthmu jong u ka la long ba tang ha ka jingïadon ryngkat bad ngi ba yn pynjanai ïa ki .
translation.en: God having provided some better thing for us , that they without us should not be made perfect .

translation.kha: Pynlong ïa kane ka jingpynbna hapdeng ki jaitbynriew : ‘ To Pynkhreh na ka ka bynta thma ; khot ïa ki nongïaleh thma ; ïalumlang ïa ki shipai tur bad shaphrang !
translation.en: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles  ; Prepare war , wake up the mighty men , let all the men of war draw near  ; let them come up :
This is the water of Meribah  ; because the children of Israel strove with the  Lord  , and he was sanctified in them .
translation.kha: Kane ka jia ha Meribah , ha kaba ki Israel ki la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad ha kaba u la pynpaw ïa lade ba u long uba khuid .

translation.en: Which was the son of Jacob , which was the son of Isaac , which was the son of Abraham , which was the son of Thara , which was the son of Nachor ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Jakob , u khun jong u Isaak , u khun jong u Abraham , u khun jong u Terah , u khun jong u Nahor ,
U Joab u la hukum tmain sngewsarong ïa jing-lhieh turoi ban pynsangeh ïa ïakhlad jingïaleh , bad ki shipai jong u , ki wan phai na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And Joab blew the trumpet , and the people returned from pursuing after Israel : for Joab held back the people .
Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily , therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil .
translation.kha: Balei ki briew ki stet haduh katta katta ban leh ïa ki kam sniew ? Namar ïa ka kam sniew ym ju kham pynshitom kloi .
Ki shipai Israel bad Judah ki shaid bad ki nadien jong , beh kthong haduh bad shaduh ki khyrdop ka Ekron . Ki ki la kyllon mynsaw baroh lynter lynti naduh Shaaraim , Ekron .
translation.en: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose , and shouted , and pursued the Philistines , until thou come to the valley , and to the gates of Ekron . And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim , even unto Gath , and unto Ekron .
And am I now come up without the  Lord  against this land to destroy it ? the  Lord  said unto me , Go up against this land , and destroy it .
translation.kha: Hato phi tharai ba nga la tur ïaleh ïa ka ri jong phi bad pynjot ïa ka khlem ka jingïarap U  Trai  ? U  Trai  da lade u la ïathuh ha nga ban tur ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka bad pynjot ïa ka .
Hynrei ka ktien u Blei weng hikai ba Nga ngi bynrap Jehoïada mynsiem , ba ka mynsiem Pirathon dei shisha mangi , ha ka met bad ha kynthih jingmut jingpyrkhat bad baroh Tiberios jinglong Kmen hi .
translation.en: Rather , God’s Word teaches that you are a soul , that your soul is really you , with all your physical and mental qualities .
And I saw another sign in heaven , great and marvellous , seven angels having the seven last plagues  ; for in them is filled up the wrath of God .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ha ka suiñbneng ïa kawei pat ka jingïohi kaba maïan , kaba khraw bad kaba iphylla . La don hynñiew ngut ki angel lem bad hynñiew tylli ki khlam , kiba long kiba khatduh , namar ki long ki jingpynpaw kiba khatduh jong ka jingbitar U Blei .

translation.en: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness , to work all uncleanness with greediness .
translation.kha: Ki la duh noh ïa baroh ki jingsngew jong ka jinglehrain ; ki pynlapmiet ïa lade ha ki kam thala bad ki leh ïa baroh ki jait kam sniew khlem salia .

translation.en: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus .
translation.kha: U Daniel u la don ha ka ïingbishar syiem haduh ba u Syros u patsha jong ka Persia u la jop ïa ka Babilonia .
Nangta u Moses u jingshngain ïa Jingpynjot 1943 jong kane ka jingrwai baroh kawei katba ki neh Israel baroh ki bymriewblei .
translation.en: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song , until they were ended .
Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee , and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king s meat : and as thou seest , deal with thy servants .
translation.kha: Te sa ïanujor ïa ngi bad ki samla shynrang kiba bam ïa ka jingbam jong ka ïingbishar syiem , bad pynshong nongrim ïa ka rai ka jong phi ha ka jingïohi kumno ngi long .

translation.en: By honour and dishonour , by evil report and good report : as deceivers , and yet true ;
translation.kha: Ïa ngi la pyndonburom bad la pynlehrain ; la krenbeiñ bad la ïaroh . La ñiew ïa ngi kum ki nongshukor , pynban ngi kren ïa ka jingshisha ;
U Trai u thaw ïa ki bneng da ka hukum jong u , ïa ka sngi u , bnai bad ki da khlur ka sur kren jong u .
translation.en: By the word of the  Lord  were the heavens made  ; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor kaba U Blei u la kshaid Pyndonburom u Isaïah u ïohpdiang jong u Amos shaphang ka Judah bad ka thohbria thngan
translation.en: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ki bteng lang san tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba kin long tang kawei shi sut jingtap , ki bad leh kumjuh ïa ki hynriew tylli lyngkhot ki jaiñ kiba sah .
translation.en: And he coupled five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves .
But the goat , on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat , shall be presented alive before the  Lord  , to make an atonement with him , and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness .
translation.kha: U  langsohmoh uba hap ha u Asasel yn wallam im ha khmat U  Trai  bad nangta yn pyllait ïa u sha ka ri shyiap sha u Asasel , khnang ba un kit noh ïa ki pop u paidbah .
Ka long jingpyrkhat jong nga u Jakob la ba ngim dei ban pynjynjar ïa ki Jentil kiba la phai sha U
translation.en: Wherefore my sentence is , that we trouble not them , which from among the Gentiles are turned to God :

translation.kha: Bun na kito kiba la lah ïap kin im pat : Katto sbai kin ïoh ka jingim bymjukut , bad katto katne kin shah Hananel jingjahburom bymjukut .
translation.en: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake , some to everlasting life , and some to shame and everlasting contempt .

And the king of Syria said , Go to , go , and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel . And he departed , and took with him ten talents of silver , and six thousand pieces of gold , and ten changes of raiment .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ,  Khie leit sha u syiem Israel bad rah ïa kane ka shithi sha u .  Kumta u Naaman u leit , u da rah laiphew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot rupa , hynriew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot ksiar , bad shiphew riam ki jaiñ ba-itynnat .

translation.en: And they came to him , and awoke him , saying , Master , master , we perish . Then he arose , and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water : and they ceased , and there was a calm .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la leit sha U Jisu bad ki la kyrsiew ïa u , da kaba ong ,  Kynrad , Kynrad ! Ngi la jan ïap !  U Jisu u la khie joit bad u la hukum ïa ka lyer bad ïa ka um ba khie  erïong ; ki la sangeh bad ka la don ka jingjai jai kaba khraw .

translation.en: And they came in , and possessed it  ; but they obeyed not thy voice , neither walked in thy law  ; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do : therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them :
translation.kha: Hynrei ynda ki la wan sha kane ka ri bad shimti ïa ka , kim shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me lane im kat kum ka jinghikai jong me ; kim shym la leh ïa kaba me la hukum ïa ki ban leh . Bad kumta me la wallam ïa kane ka jingpynjot baroh ha ki .
U Ia Bam U Soh Apple .
translation.en: He ate an apple .
But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath : so Tibni died , and Omri reigned .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh , kito kiba kwah ïa u Omri ki la jop ; u Tibni u la ïap bad u Omri u la long u syiem .

U ong , Baroh ki nongïalam , kiba dei ban maham ki ïa briew jong nga , ki long matlah kiba ! Kim tip ei ei . Ki long kum ki sew-ap ki bym ju wiar — ki shu thiah bad . phohsniew Katno ki sngewtynnat ban thiah !
translation.en: His watchmen are blind : they are all ignorant , they are all dumb dogs , they cannot bark  ; sleeping , lying down , loving to slumber .

translation.kha: Shibun ki briew , kiba kam ba jingmihpat kren na ka bynta ba-mynbarim Jarmuth Shiphew Diamond wan bad ong , tan Nga long u Messaïah !’ bad kin shukor ïa suiñ Ïathuhlypa kiba bun .
translation.en: For many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and shall deceive many .

translation.kha: Ka Jingkhot Sngewbha jingshlur Hikai
translation.en: An Invitation to Learn

translation.kha: lymne ki la jinghikai ïoh ïa ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .
translation.en: There is no fear of God before their eyes .
And he shewed me a pure river of water of life , clear as crystal , proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb .
translation.kha: U angel u la pyn-i ruh ha nga ïa ka wah jong ka um ka jingim , kaba shat phyrnai sngur bha , bad kaba wan mih na ka khet jong U Blei bad ka jong U Khunlangbrot
Te ka khubor kaba wan na mihngi bad na shatei kan pynsheptieng ïa u , bad un ïaleh jingbitar shla da , da kaba pynïap shibun ngut ki briew .
translation.en: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him : therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy , and utterly to make away many .

translation.kha: Ka jong tnga uta u briew ka shim kawei ka jingtap , siang ka ïa ka halor kata pukri ka , bad ka la thad kew halor jong ka , khnang ba mano mano kin ym ïohi ei ei .
translation.en: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well s mouth , and spread ground corn thereon  ; and the thing was not known .

translation.kha: u Nangta Jethro u ong , Phim shym leh satia ïa kane ha ka rukom kaba dei .
translation.en: And Moses  father in law said unto him , The thing that thou doest is not good .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih . Wat ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano kaba ïadei kur dei jait bad me .
translation.en: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him , to uncover their nakedness : I am the  Lord .
Ye also , as lively stones , are built up a spiritual house , an holy priesthood , to offer up spiritual sacrifices , acceptable to God by Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To wan kum ki maw ba-im , bad to shah ïa lade ba yn pyndonkam ha kaba tei ïa ka Templ ba kynja mynsiem , ha kaba phin shakri kum ki lyngdoh bakhuid ban ai ïa ki jingkñia ba kynja mynsiem bad ba pdiang hun ha U Blei da U Jisu Khrist .

Ki syiem Jetur Khot ïalumlang ban ïaleh sngewbha bad jingñiewbeiñ ai ïa ka jingainguh kaba khraw ïa Myntan Dagon Jahmai blei jong ki . Ki ïarwai , U blei jong ngi u Dieng bymmyntoi’ ha ngi teng jingjop ïa u Samson u jingtipbriew jong ngi .
translation.en: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god , and to rejoice : for they said , Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand .

translation.kha: Iehnoh kaba sniew ka bymdei na ka jong me .
translation.en: If iniquity be in thine hand , put it far away , and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles .

translation.kha: U la pynhiar ïa ki syiem bakhrawbor na badno khet jong buid , bad u la kyntiew shajrong ïa jingsngewthuh rangli .
translation.en: He hath put down the mighty from their seats , and exalted them of low degree .
And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice , he said ,  Father , into thy hands I commend my spirit :  and having said thus , he gave up the ghost .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la pyrta ha ka sur bajam ,  Ko Pa ! Ha ki kti jong me nga aiti ïa la ka mynsiem !  U la ong ïa kane bad u la ïap .
Hynrei me pat , Moses , sah hangne , bad ngan ha ïa aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga . Hikai ïa ki ha u paidbah ba sumar bad ïa ki ha kata ka ri ïa kaba ai ha ki .’
translation.en: But as for thee , stand thou here by me , and I will speak unto thee all the commandments , and the statutes , and the judgments , which thou shalt teach them , that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it .
And Pharaoh said unto his servants , Can we find such a one as this is , a man in whom the Spirit of God is ?
translation.kha: Ngim lah ban shem u briew uba kham bit ban ïa u Joseph , u briew uba don U Mynsiem U Blei .
Ki briew baroh ki la jylla bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki , Ki jait Adullam Asekah kine ? Da ka iktiar bad ka bor une u briew u ïakiew ki mraw jingbakla ki mynsiem Admatha , bad jingdih ïamihnoh !
translation.en: And they were all amazed , and spake among themselves , saying , What a word is this ! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits , and they come out .

And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines , and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines . And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha baroh ki Israel ba u Saul u la pynïap ïa u rangbah ai hukum jong ki Philistia bad ba ki Philistia ki la isih ïa ki . Kumta ki paidbah ki jubab ïa ka jingkhot ban ïasoh bad u Saul ha Gilgal .

bad ka kamra kaba phai shaphang shatei ka la long na ka bynta ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ka ha duwan . Baroh ki dei ki lyngdoh kiba la hiarpateng na ; u dei Sadok tang ïa kine ki dkhot jong ka jait Lebi ba la shah ban leit ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai ban shakri ïa U .
translation.en: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests , the keepers of the charge of the altar : these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi , which come near to the  Lord  to minister unto him .
Consider the lilies how they grow : they toil not , they spin not  ; and yet I say unto you , that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these .
translation.kha: Ha khmih kumno ki syntiew khlaw ki san : Kim shym trei lane thain jaiñ na ka bynta ïa lade . Hynrei nga ong ha phi ba wat u syiem Solomon ha ka spah jong u baroh um shym la don ki jaiñ kiba itynnat kat uwei na kine ki syntiew .

translation.en: Only be thou strong and very courageous , that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law , which Moses my servant commanded thee : turn not from it to the right hand or to the left , that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest .
translation.kha: Me dei ban da kut jingmut triang , ban long skhem bad ban pynthikna ba men kohnguh ïa ka Hukum baroh kaba u shakri jong nga , u Moses u la ai ha me . Wat leh klet ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka , bad men sa jop kat shaba me leit .

iktiar tieng ïa phi , hynrei nongkhmih Sithri ban ïaknieh jaka Heh ki , namar ngan Sapphira ai jingkordit phi wat tang khyndiat ruh na kata ka ri jong ki . Nga la ai ïa ka Edom ha ki khun ki jingtlot u myrsiang .
translation.en: Meddle not with them  ; for I will not give you of their land , no , not so much as a foot breadth  ; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession .

translation.kha: Khie leit bad rep ïa kata ka , ri phi ki briew ha ki jaka buhai shnong ha Spain ! Ym don shuh mano mano ban ïada ïa . phi
translation.en: Pass through thy land as a river , O daughter of Tarshish : there is no more strength .
As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace , so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof  ; and ye shall know that I the  Lord  have poured out my fury upon you .
translation.kha: Yn pynum ïa ki ha Jerusalem kumba pynum ïa ka rupa ha ka lawar ding , bad nangta kin tip ba ki mad ïa ka jingbitar jong U  Trai .
Hynrei u phria un hap ha ki khlaw bad ïa ka nongbah yn pynjot .
translation.en: When it shall hail , coming down on the forest  ; and the city shall be low in a low place .
By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation , which sing among the branches .
translation.kha: Halor ki dieng ba don hajan , ki sim ki thaw ïa ki skum jong ki bad ki rwai .

translation.en: Little children , let no man deceive you : he that doeth righteousness is righteous , even as he is righteous .
translation.kha: To wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa phi , ko ki khun jong nga ! Uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei , u long uba hok , kumba U Khrist u long uba hok .
dei Phi ban long kiba khuid ïa nga , namar nga long U Trai bad nga long uba khuid . Nga la pynkyrpang ïa phi na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ba phin long ki jong . nga
translation.en: And ye shall be holy unto me : for I the  Lord  am holy , and have severed you from other people , that ye should be mine .
( And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them , they kept the more silence : and he saith , )
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren ha ka ktien Hebru , ki la kham sngap jar , bad u Paul u la bteng :
Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong Pdiang ka Jingkhawai Niam , phi sammut nongmane ïalumlang ban jingbeit Blei , bad phim Hosah jingkynrum treikam ei ei ha kata ka sngi .
translation.en: In the first day shall be an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein :

translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ka jingdeng shadem da kijuh ki tiar da la kiba suh ïa ka ephod bad , ki pynpur itynnat ïa ka ruh ha kajuh ka rukom .
translation.en: And he made the breastplate of cunning work , like the work of the ephod  ; of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
Wherefore they are no more twain , but one flesh . What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .
translation.kha: Kumta kim ïalong shuh ar ngut , hynrei kawei . Uno uno u briew um dei ban pynïakhlad , te , ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la pynïasoh lang .

translation.en: Then the king went on to Gilgal , and Chimham went on with him : and all the people of Judah conducted the king , and also half the people of Israel .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u la lah jam sha shiliang , ïa kaba la synran da baroh ki rangbah ka Judah bad shiteng na ki paid Israel , u la leit beit sha Gilgal , bad u Shimham u la leit bad u .
Haba u pynmareh u la leit sha Jerusalem , kotbah kiba ïashah phraspah dei ban otsher ïa ki pom ki la wohnia ïa jingïashem , Leaphrah kaba ong ,
translation.en: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem , they that were of the circumcision contended with him ,

translation.kha: Ka riewkynthei ka leit bad ka leh kumba Elijah u u la ong ïa ka , bad baroh na , ki ki dap jingbam na ka bynta bun sngi .
translation.en: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah : and she , and he , and her house , did eat many days .
Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house  ; because thou hast despised me , and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha man la ka pateng , katto katne na ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin ïap ka jingïap kaba sngewma namar ba mem shym kohnguh ïa nga bad ba me la shim ïa ka tnga jong u Uriah .

translation.en: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Haba u la dep ai ki jingkñia , u la kyrkhu ïa u paidbah ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh

translation.en: Thus saith the king , Let not Hezekiah deceive you : for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand :
translation.kha: U maham ïa phi ba phin ym shah ïa u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi . U Hesekaïah um lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: But there is a spirit in man : and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding .
translation.kha: Hynrei dei U Mynsiem jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh uba wan sha ki briew bad uba ai ha ki ka jingstad .
U Manasseh u la ïap bad tyllun tep ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem , bad u ba-thurmur u khun jong Middin , u long syiem ha ka jaka sammut u .
translation.en: So Manasseh slept with his fathers , and they buried him in his own house : and Amon his son reigned in his stead .

Thus saith the  Lord  , which giveth the sun for a light by day , and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night , which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar  ; The  Lord  of hosts is his name :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynbiang ïa ka sngi ban pynshai mynsngi , ïa u bnai bad ki khlur ban pynshai mynmiet . U pynkhih ïa ka duriaw bad pynlong ïa ka ban kyrhuh ; ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
Nga ieit ïa kito kiba ïa ieit nga ; kita kiba wad ïa nga kin shem ïa nga .
translation.en: I love them that love me  ; and those that seek me early shall find me .
Hath the rain a father ? or who hath begotten the drops of dew ?
translation.kha: Hato u slap lane ka umjer ki don u kpa ?
Haba nga la sngew kumba ka jingim jong nga ka la syntuid noh na nga , te , A Trai nga , la khot ïa kyrpad me , bad ha ka bakhuid Templ jong me , me la ïohsngew ïa nga .
translation.en: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the  Lord  : and my prayer came in unto thee , into thine holy temple .
And as for the people , he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof .
translation.kha: U Joseph u la pynlong mraw ïa ki briew na tduh sha tduh ka Ijipt .
Ïa ka khleiñ jong u dei baroh ban weng bad ainguh kata halor ka duwan : ka dongnai , ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki doh jem ,
translation.en: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof  ; the rump , and the fat that covereth the inwards ,

translation.kha: U Trai u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur thok . U sngewbha ki ha jingthew kiba hok .
translation.en: A false balance is abomination to the  Lord  : but a just weight is his delight .
In the day of prosperity be joyful , but in the day of adversity consider : God also hath set the one over against the other , to the end that man should find nothing after him .
translation.kha: Haba kiei kiei ki bit ki biang ïa phi , to kmen , bad haba ka jingjynjar ka wan , shu kynmaw : U Blei u phah ïa ka jingkmen bad ka jingjynjar ; phin ym tip da lei lei kaei ka ban jia hadien .

translation.en: The burden of Tyre . Howl , ye ships of Tarshish  ; for it is laid waste , so that there is no house , no entering in : from the land of Kittim it is revealed to them .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor ïa ka Tyros . To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki maji ha ki duriaw-bah ! Ïa ka kadlieng ha ka shnong jong phi , ka Tyros , la pynjot ; ki ïing bad ka kadlieng jong ka ki don ha ka jingjot . Kumba ki liengbah jong phi ki wan phai na Sypros , phi tip ïa ka khubor .

translation.en: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom : but the froward tongue shall be cut out .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki kren ïa ka jingstad , hynrei ïa u thylliej uba kren sniew yn pynsangeh .
Hynrei kham bha ban ïa kine Jesebel Nangta long kito ki bym pat shym la kha , ki bym pat ïohi ïa ka jingbymlehhok kaba trei ha ka pyrthei tamasa
translation.en: Yea , better is he than both they , which hath not yet been , who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun .

translation.kha: Bad lada ka shkor kan ong , Namar ba Hadassah dei ka khmat , te ryngkhiang dei ka suk ka met , kata kam pynlong ïa ka , ba kam dei ka dkhot jong ka met .
translation.en: And if the ear shall say , Because I am not the eye , I am not of the body ; is it therefore not of the body ?
He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness : but a false witness deceit .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , ka don ka jingbishar hok , hynrei ki jingshukor ki ïalam sha ka jingshah bishar bymhok .
Uwei pa uwei , uba khraw Jabesh uba rit , u pyrshang ban iakren jingtylliat da kynrup jingbymhok ; jingpynlehrain ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh Phai thok ïa jingpyrshah pyrshang Kushi
translation.en: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness  ; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïa ka , Martha , Martha la khuslai bad sngew jynjar halor bun kiei
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto her ,  Martha , Martha , thou art careful and troubled about many things :
Who can open the doors of his face ? his teeth are terrible round about .
translation.kha: Uei uba lah ban pynlong ïa u ban plie ïa ki tyngam jong u , kiba la ker da kito ki bniat kiba itriem ?
U ong ha ka , Khie leit phai pat sha la ka kynrad bad long ka ka .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Return to thy mistress , and submit thyself under her hands .

translation.kha: Lada la die ïa ka ha Haron jingteh uba jngoh ban Kanneh ïa ka , ka tnga jong u , hynrei um Memukan Ibleam ka , Husiar u dei Ïubulos pawnam pat ïa ka ha u kpa jong ka ; pankylliang kynrad jong Sinai um lah ban die Misrephoth 33 ha ki nongwei , nadong u la pynjhieh Mahadei ïa ka .
translation.en: If she please not her master , who hath betrothed her to himself , then shall he let her be redeemed : to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power , seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her .
What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces , and grind the faces of the poor ? saith the Lord  God  of hosts .
translation.kha: Phim don hok ban khñiot ïa ki briew jong nga bad ban shim kabu ïa kiba duk . Ma nga U Nongsynshar U  Trai  Badonbor baroh nga la kren .

U Trai Badonbor Baroh u ong , Almond ki Ashdod tymmen Sihon phi ki pynbitar ïa nga , nga la pynkhreh ka jingpynjot Ïoh ki : ngam shym pynkylla ïa la ka jingmut , hynrei jingpynhiarkput pyndep ïa ki jingthmu jong nga Siphmoth
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; As I thought to punish you , when your fathers provoked me to wrath , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I repented not :
Then went he also to Ramah , and came to a great well that is in Sechu : and he asked and said , Where are Samuel and David ? And one said , Behold , they be at Naioth in Ramah .
translation.kha: Nangta da lade hi u leit sha Ramah . Ynda u la poi ha ka pukri kaba heh ha Seku , u kylli ha-ei u Samuel bad u Dabid ki don bad la ïathuh ha u ba ki don ha Naïoth .

translation.en: This gate of the  Lord  , into which the righteous shall enter .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khyrdop jong U  Trai  ; tang kiba hok ki lah ban rung shapoh .
Ka Baibl ka ong u suri un shong lem bad u khun ‘ langbrot u labasa ruh un dem bad khun blang ; u khun masi bad u sing bad u masi sngaid lang bad u rit un ïalam ïa ki .” —Isaïah 11 ; Hosea 2 :18 .
translation.en: The Bible says : “The wolf will actually reside for a while with the male lamb , and with the kid the leopard itself will lie down , and the calf and the maned young lion and the well-fed animal all together  ; and a mere little boy will be leader over them .”—Isaiah 11 :6-9  ; Hosea 2 :18 .
He hath shewed strength with his arm  ; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts .
translation.kha: U la kner ïa ka ksang ti badonbor jong u bad u la pynsakma ïa kiba sarong lem bad ki jingthmu jong ki .

translation.en: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her , and leave them , that she may glean them , and rebuke her not .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka la mihnoh ban leit tam kew , u Boas u hukum ïa ki nongtrei ,  Shah ïa ka ban tam wat na ka jaka ha kaba ki song ki don , bad wat ong ei ei ban khang ïa ka . Nalor kata , sei ruh katto katne ki kew na ki song bad ieh ïa ki ba kan ïoh tam .

translation.en: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit  ; and he cried out ,
translation.kha: Hamar kata ka por uwei u briew uba don u mynsiem bymkhuid u la wan rung hapoh ka synagog bad u la lynñiar ,
Sodom Jisu u la ong shuh shuh , Ka Hima U Blei ka ong kumne . U briew u bet symbai Abigail la ka lyngkha .
translation.en: And he said ,  So is the kingdom of God , as if a man should cast seed into the ground  ;

translation.kha: Ynda mynstep la u sngewkhuslai ; kumta phah u khot ïa ki nongleh myntor bad ïa ki riewstad baroh jong ka ri Ijipt U . ïathuh ha ki ïa la ki jingphohsniew , hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba lah ban batai ïa ki ha u .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled  ; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt , and all the wise men thereof : and Pharaoh told them his dream  ; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh .

translation.kha: ka Kum um na ka jaka den um ba la pra ki briew ki mareh napoh ka Ninebeh ! Sangeh ! Sangeh ! ka ka jingpyrta sawa — hynrei ym don mano mano ba phai dien .
translation.en: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water : yet they shall flee away . Stand , stand , shall they cry  ; but none shall look back .

And it shall be upon Aaron s forehead , that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things , which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts  ; and it shall be always upon his forehead , that they may be accepted before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Aaron u dei ban teh ïa u ha ka shyllangmat jong u , khnang ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingainguh ba ki Israel ki pynkyntang sha nga , wat la ki briew ki bakla haba ki ai ïa ki .

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines , and into the hands of the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki Israel , bad u shah ïa ki Philistia bad ki Ammon ban jop ïa ki .
Un pynjot ïa ki dieng Kedar kiba jrong jong ka Lebanon bad ïa ki Sarah Sning baroh ha ka ri Bashan .
translation.en: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon , that are high and lifted up , and upon all the oaks of Bashan ,

translation.kha: Katba Jisu U u dang hikai ha ka Templ , u la kren ha ka sur kaba jam , Hato phi ithuh da shisha ïa nga bad tip nangno nga wan ? Ngam shym wan la da ka bor nga jong hi . uba Uta la phah ïa nga , pynban , u long uba shisha .
translation.en: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught , saying ,  Ye both know me , and ye know whence I am : and I am not come of myself , but he that sent me is true , whom ye know not .
Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual , but that which is natural ; and afterward that which is spiritual .
translation.kha: Kam shym long kaba kynja mynsiem kaba la wan shuwa , hynrei kaba kynja doh , bad nangta kaba kynja mynsiem .

translation.en: Then said he to another , And how much owest thou ? And he said , An hundred measures of wheat . And he said unto him , Take thy bill , and write fourscore .
translation.kha: Nangta u la kylli ïa uwei pat , ‘ Bad ma phi — sa katno phi dei ban pynphai ? Shihajar byrni u kew ,’ u la jubab . ‘ Kane hangne ka long ka jingkheiñ jong phi ,’ u sordar u la ong ïa u ; ‘ to thoh phraspah .’
U pynïap ïa u masi lyngraw bad u langbrot jingkñia ainguh ïasyllok na ka bynta ki paidbah . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wanrah ha u ïa snam , bad theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .
translation.en: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings , which was for the people : and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled upon the altar round about ,
And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone , thou shalt not build it of hewn stone : for if thou lift up thy tool upon it , thou hast polluted it .
translation.kha: Lada phi tei ïa nga ka duwan kaba da u maw , wat tei ïa ka da ki maw ba la shniah , namar lada phi pyndei nar ha kita ki maw , kim long kiba bit ba ngan pyndonkam .
Ka Gaash ka la poi ba bamaïan Meres u shim noh ïa u Elijah sha bneng ha ka erlangthari . U Elijah bad u Elisha pynshahshkor la mihnoh na Gilgal ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the  Lord  would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind , that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal .
And if a man shall take his brother s wife , it is an unclean thing : he hath uncovered his brother s nakedness  ; they shall be childless .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïoh ïa ka tnga u hynmen jong u , baroh ar ngut kin ïap khlem khun . U la leh ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid bad u la pynkheiñ burom ïa la u hynmen .

translation.en: And when we cried unto the  Lord  God of our fathers , the  Lord  heard our voice , and looked on our affliction , and our labour , and our oppression :
translation.kha: Te ngi kyang sha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ban ïarap ïa ngi . U la shahshkor ïa ngi , bad u la ïohi ba ngi shah jynjar , ngi hap trei shitom , bad ngi shah lehbeiñ .
katsha sohkhliang ïa ki diengkhap Kuth Apostol dieng akasia , san kynroi ïa ïapynbiang jingker kiba jingjynsur dumok ka liang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translation.en: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood  ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,
And all the people departed every man to his house : and David returned to bless his house .
translation.kha: Hadien kata baroh ki leit noh sha la ïing , bad u Dabid u la leit sha la ïing ban pynlut katto katne por bad ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled  ; he is unclean : he shall dwell alone  ; without the camp shall his habitation be .
translation.kha: Un ïaisah u bymkhuid katba kata ka jingpang ka dang don , bad u dei ban sah kyrpang shabar ka jaka shong dara , jngai na kiwei pat .
Ynda phi shwa ïa India wah Jordan Jerusha U Trai un shah ïa phi ban ïohkynti ïa riewsniew ka ri bad basngewrit ïada ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi baroh , ba phin ïoh shongsuk jingïalap .
translation.en: But when ye go over Jordan , and dwell in the land which the  Lord  your God giveth you to inherit , and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about , so that ye dwell in safety  ;

Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Israel , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they sold the righteous for silver , and the poor for a pair of shoes  ;
