translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa u bad ïa kiwei pat ki synran ,  namar uno uno u bym pyrshah ïa phi u long ha ka liang jong phi .

translation.en: And David called one of the young men , and said , Go near , and fall upon him . And he smote him that he died .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u khot ïa uwei na ki briew jong u , bad u ong ,  Pynïap ïa u !  U briew u la shoh ïa u nong Amalek bad u la pynmynsaw ïa u ,

Ha ka sngi kaba lai jong ka jingshah jingit ka , Esther ka phong ïa ki jingriam syiem jong bad ka ka leit ïeng bad ha ka phyllaw ba kham shapoh ka ïingsyiem , kaba phai khmat sha ka kamra ba ka don khet syiem . U syiem u don hapoh , u shong halor ka khet syiem , da kaba phai khmat ka sha khyrdop .
translation.en: Now it came to pass on the third day , that Esther put on her royal apparel , and stood in the inner court of the king s house , over against the king s house : and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house , over against the gate of the house .

translation.kha: Hadien ba Ïoh Jisu u la rung shapoh ïing jingsiang ïohbor synran jong iakane ki la shngiam jar syn-iang Johanan u , Balei mihpat ngim lah ban beh noh ïa u khawpud bymkhuid ?
translation.en: And when he was come into the house , his disciples asked him privately , Why could not we cast him out ?
Then the beasts go into dens , and remain in their places .
translation.kha: Ki mradkhlaw ki leit sha la ki krem .

translation.en: And Elon , and Timnah , and Ekron ,
translation.kha: ka Elon , ka Timnah , ka Ekron ,
Nga phla ïa baroh kaba nga la leh , bad me jubab ïa nga ; hikai ïa nga ïa ki lynti jong me .
translation.en: I have declared my ways , and thou heardest me : teach me thy statutes .
Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah , and troubled them in building ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri ki pyrshang ban pynduh mynsiem bad pyntieng ïa ki Jiw bad ban khanglad ïa ka jingtrei .

translation.en: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God , even our Father , at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pynkhlaiñ ïa phi , bad phin long kiba janai bad kiba khuid ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi haba U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi u wan lem bad baroh kiba dei ki jong u .

Jer nongshet u ong Kawei u Jehoshaphat , Haba ngi leit pynithuh ka thma , ngan Sukkoth pher ïa lade ïadem hynrei ma phi , phong ïa ki jaiñ syiem jong phi . Kumta u jingpynduh Israel Tim phira sha thma ha ka jingriam pher Imrah
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , I will disguise myself , and will go to the battle  ; but put thou on thy robes . So the king of Israel disguised himself  ; and they went to the battle .

translation.kha: Hynrei hapoh ka kpoh jong u ka jingbam ka kylla kthang , ka kthang kum bih ka .
translation.en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned , it is the gall of asps within him .

translation.kha: u Eleasar u lyngdoh u shim ïa ki khiew buh ding bad u phah shoh pynstang ïa ban shna jingtap ka duwan .
translation.en: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers , wherewith they that were burnt had offered  ; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar :

translation.kha: U dei ban long Anaharath lehsbun bad uba ieit ïa kaei kaba bha . U dei ban long uba synshar ïa lade , uba beit , pyndkut Elisabeth , bad uba leh ryntih Haggai
translation.en: But a lover of hospitality , a lover of good men , sober , just , holy , temperate ;

How shall I pardon thee for this ? thy children have forsaken me , and sworn by them that are no gods : when I had fed them to the full , they then committed adultery , and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots  houses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli ,  Balei ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong nga ? Ki la iehnoh ïa nga , bad ki la mane ïa ki blei ki bymshisha . Nga la bsa ïa ki briew jong nga haduh ba kin da kdang , hynrei ki la leh awria , bad ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki bad ki nuti .

translation.en: These are the two olive trees , and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth .
translation.kha: Ki ar ngut ki sakhi ki long ki ar tylli ki dieng Olib bad ki ar tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak kiba ïeng ha khmat U Trai jong ka pyrthei .
Nga ïohsngew jlang don kew ha Ijipt ; khie leit thied kew nangta bashabar ba-marjan ngin ym ïapthngan “ba
translation.en: And he said , Behold , I have heard that there is corn in Egypt : get you down thither , and buy for us from thence  ; that we may live , and not die .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam jingbam lang , u Ishmael ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah lem u ki sei ïa la ki waitlam ki pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and the ten men that were with him , and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword , and slew him , whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land .
And Thomas answered and said unto him , My Lord and my God .
translation.kha: U Thomas u la jubab ïa u ,  U Trai jong nga bad U Blei jong nga !

U , Trai U Blei ka jong , bneng u la ïalam noh ïa nga na ka ïing u kpa jong nga na bad ka ri ki kur ki jait jong nga bad , u la kular skhem ha nga ba un ai ïa kane ka ri ha ki khun ki ksiew jong nga . Un phah ïa u angel jong u ha shuwa jong me , ba me lah pynïoh ban hangta ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga .
translation.en: The  Lord  God of heaven , which took me from my father s house , and from the land of my kindred , and which spake unto me , and that sware unto me , saying , Unto thy seed will I give this land  ; he shall send his angel before thee , and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence .

translation.kha: u Peleg la dap laiphew snem ka , la khun shynrang u Reu ;
translation.en: And Peleg lived thirty years , and begat Reu :
Pass ye unto Calneh , and see  ; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great : then go down to Gath of the Philistines : be they better than these kingdoms ? or their border greater than your border ?
translation.kha: Khie leit bad khmih ïa ka nongbah Kalneh . Nangta ïai leit sha ka nongbah bakhraw ka Hamath bad leit hiar sha Gath , ka nongbah ki Philistia . Hato ki kham bha ma ki ban ïa ki hima jong ka Judah bad Israel ? Hato ka ri jong ki ka kham heh ban ïa ka jong phi ?
Nga pule bniah ïa ki jingbthah jong me , nga bishar bniah kassia ki jinghikai jong me .
translation.en: I will meditate in thy precepts , and have respect unto thy ways .

translation.kha: U la ai ha ki ïa ki ri jong kiwei pat sabut jaitbynriew bad u la barew ïa ki jingaiti shim noh ïa ki pyntha jong ki ,
translation.en: And gave them the lands of the heathen : and they inherited the labour of the people  ;
And there was given me a reed like unto a rod : and the angel stood , saying , Rise , and measure the temple of God , and the altar , and them that worship therein .
translation.kha: La ai ha nga ïa u dieng uba syriem ïa u diengthew , bad la ong ïa nga ,  Khie leit bad thew ïa ka Templ U Blei bad ïa ka duwan , bad ñiew ïa kito kiba mane ha ka templ .

Uwei uwei baroh u ïai ïabam bad ïadih , bad ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ki ïashongkurim , haduh ka sngi kaba u u Noah la leit rung ka shapoh lieng bad jingshlei ka um ka la wan bad ka la pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: They did eat , they drank , they married wives , they were given in marriage , until the day that Noah entered into the ark , and the flood came , and destroyed them all .
When did Jehovah’s Witnesses have their modern-day start ?
translation.kha: Mynno la sdang ïa ka seng Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ha ka por ba mynta ?
U u long bym ju kylla . Ym don ba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa lane u pynsangeh ïa u na kaba leh ïa kaei kaba u kwah ban leh .
translation.en: But he is in one mind , and who can turn him ? and what his soul desireth , even that he doeth .

translation.kha: To ai hukum par jatkmie , ba yn da ap phira jingim biang ïa ka Bethmillo jong u tad haduh ka sngi kaba lai , khnang ba ki synran jong u kin lyoh lah ban jingit ban tuh ïa ka met , bad nangta ban ïathuh ha ki briew Gemaraïah u la mihpat na ka jingïap Kun Kane ka jinglamler kaba khatduh kan long kaba kham sniew ban ïa jinglehieit nyngkong .
translation.en: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day , lest his disciples come by night , and steal him away , and say unto the people , He is risen from the dead : so the last error shall be worse than the first .

translation.kha: Nga ïaid shane shatai ha ka jingdum , khlem ka jingshai ka sngi ; ïeng nga ha khmat ki briew bad nga kyrpad jingïarap .
translation.en: I went mourning without the sun : I stood up , and I cried in the congregation .

Then Paul , after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak , answered , Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation , I do the more cheerfully answer for myself :
translation.kha: Te u lyngskor u la ai dak ïa u Paul ban kren , u Paul u la ong ,  Nga tip ba me la long u nongbishar halor kane ka jaitbynriew la bun snem , bad kumta da kaba sngewbha nga ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmat jong me .
Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka pyrsa kurim , baroh ngut ar kin shah pynïap . Ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba sang , bad ki la pan hi kwah ïa ka jingïap .
translation.en: And if a man lie with his daughter in law , both of them shall surely be put to death : they have wrought confusion  ; their blood shall be upon them .
My sheep wandered through all the mountains , and upon every high hill : yea , my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth , and none did search or seek after them .
translation.kha: Kumta ki langbrot jong nga ki ïaid sakma sha ki lumrit bajrong bad ki lumbah . La pynsakma ïa ki kylleng ka pyrthei , bad ym don ba ïit ïa ki ne pyrshang ban wad ïa ki .

translation.en: I am the true vine , and my Father is the husbandman .
translation.kha: Nga , nga long u dieng sohwaiñ bashisha , bad U Kpa jong nga u long u nongsumar brisoh .

translation.en: Nicodemus answered and said unto him , How can these things be ?
translation.kha: Kumno kane ka lah ban long ?  la kylli u Nikodemos .

translation.en: Behold , we go up to Jerusalem  ; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes , and they shall condemn him to death ,
translation.kha: Shahshkor ,  u la ong ïa ki ,  ngi ïaleit kiew sha Jerusalem , ha kaba yn aiti ïa U Khun U Briew ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum .

translation.en: I have seen servants upon horses , and princes walking as servants upon the earth .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ki mraw ba ki shong da ki kulai katba ki riewdonburom ki ïaid da ka kjat kum ki mraw .

translation.en: And after the uproar was ceased , Paul called unto him the disciples , and embraced them , and departed for to go into Macedonia .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka jingkhihwin ka la jem jai , u Paul u la khot lang ïa ki parabangeit bad da ki ktien pynshlur u la khublei ïakhlad bad ki . Nangta u la mihnoh bad u la leit sha Makedonia .

translation.en: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof , and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush : let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph , and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren .
translation.kha: To ka ri jong ki kan dap kyrhai da kaba bha baroh , Ba la kyrkhu da ka jingbha U  Trai  , Uba kren na ka  lawlynnong kaba mehding . To kine ki jingkyrkhu kin wan ha ka jait u Joseph , Namar u la long u nongïalam ïa la ki hynmen bad para .

translation.en: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near , and smote Micaiah on the cheek , and said , Which way went the Spirit of the  Lord  from me to speak unto thee ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Sedekaïah u nongïathuhlypa u leit kiew sha u Mikaïah , u thab ïa u na ka ngab jong u , bad kylli ,  Naduh mynno u mynsiem jong U  Trai  u iehnoh ïa nga bad u kren ha me ?

translation.en: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me . And being turned , I saw seven golden candlesticks  ;
translation.kha: Nga la phai sawdong ban peit uei uba la kren ïa nga , bad nga la ïohi ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak ksiar ,

U Lot “Te la khmih sawdong bad u la ïohi ba ka them riewstad baroh kawei pli Soar Adithaim ka don ïarisa nangno um , kum ka Thep jong U Trai lane kum ka ri Ijipt . ( jongngi ka long ha shuwa ba U Trai un pynjot ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah . )
translation.en: And Lot lifted up his eyes , and beheld all the plain of Jordan , that it was well watered every where , before the  Lord  destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah , even as the garden of the  Lord  , like the land of Egypt , as thou comest unto Zoar .

translation.kha: Ka ju long ka rukom u syiem ban pan jingmut na ki riewshemphang halor Shaneng kiei kiba ïadei pynkyrpang ka shongsuk shongsaiñ ka hima , kumta u khot ïa ki nongai jingmut jong u , kiba lah shaka tip kaei kaba dei ban leh .
translation.en: Then the king said to the wise men , which knew the times , ( for so was the king s manner toward all that knew law and judgment :
His cheeks are as a bed of spices , as sweet flowers : his lips like lilies , dropping sweet smelling myrrh .
translation.kha: hangta ki jingthung ki plung . Ki san kum ka bri ki diengsoh Pomkranet bad ki sei ki soh bakynsai . Ym don kano kano ka jingduna ïa u henna bad ïa u nard ,

translation.en: And she said to the king , It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts , and of thy wisdom :
translation.kha: Ka ong ha u syiem ,  Kaei kaba nga la ïohsngew ha la ka jong ka ri shaphang jong phi bad ka jingstad jong phi , ka long kaba shisha ,
Hynrei u Moses map nyngkong la ai kano khashor ka jaka .—Sekharaiah ka jait Lebi . Merodakh ong ïa ki ba ka Sukki jong jingsiang ka dei ka bhah jong ki jingainguh sha U Trai U Blei Asenath Israel .
translation.en: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance : the  Lord  God of Israel was their inheritance , as he said unto them .

translation.kha: shynrang bad khun jong u baroh ïawan ban pyntngen ïa u , hynrei kyntait ban shah bad u , Ngan leit ka ri kiba ïap bad ïai ïam sngewsih na ka u khun nga . u ïai ïam sngewsih bynta u u khun jong u .
translation.en: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him  ; but he refused to be comforted  ; and he said , For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning . Thus his father wept for him .
If thy father at all miss me , then say , David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth–lehem his city : for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family .
translation.kha: Lada i pa jong phi i shem ba ngam don lang ha ka miej bam , ïathuh ïa i ba nga la pan jingbit na phi ban leit sha la ïing ha Bethlehem , namar ba ka dei ka por jong ka jingkñia ainguh ba shisien shisnem hangta ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga baroh .

translation.en: Am I now come up without the  Lord  against this place to destroy it ? The  Lord  said to me , Go up against this land , and destroy it .
translation.kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba nga la tur ïaleh ïa ka ri jong phi bad ban pynjot ïa ka khlem ka jingïarap jong U  Trai  ? U  Trai  da lade hi u ong ha nga ban tur ïaleh bad ban pynjot ïa ka .

translation.en: And he hasted , and took the ashes away from his face  ; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u tar ïa ka jaiñ na ka khmat jong u , bad kumta hi u syiem u ithuh ïa u bad u long uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Afterward came also the other virgins , saying , Lord , Lord , open to us .
translation.kha: Hadien la wan poi kita kiwei pat ki theisotti . ‘ Ko kynrad , ko Kynrad ! to plie ïa ngi !’ ki la pyrta jam .
Kumta ïa ki para Israel Ki briew jong U Blei bad kiba ieit da U Trai .
translation.en: Say ye unto your brethren , Ammi  ; and to your sisters , Ru–hamah .

And it came to pass , as they fled from before Israel , and were in the going down to Beth–horon , that the  Lord  cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah , and they died : they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword .
translation.kha: Katba ki Amor ki dang phet arsut na ka khim lum na ki shipai Israel , U  Trai  u pynhap halor jong ki ïa u phria uba heh baroh shi lynter lynti haduh Asekah . Kham bun ki la ïap na u phria ban na kaba ki shah pynïap ha ki Israel .

translation.en: And many more believed because of his own word  ;
translation.kha: Bun kiwei ki la ngeit namar ka khubor jong u bad ki la ong ha kata ka briew ,
Hynrei kiwei la ong , To ap , to peit lada u Elijah un bad pyllait im ïa u !
translation.en: The rest said , Let be , let us see whether Elias will come to save him .

And they shall take a cloth of blue , and cover the candlestick of the light , and his lamps , and his tongs , and his snuffdishes , and all the oil vessels thereof , wherewith they minister unto it :
translation.kha: Ka kamram ba ki Lebi ki don ka long tang ban shakri ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u .
Ha ka sngi men ïoh pat ïa ka bor ban kren ïa kaba me la duh noh , bad men ïakren bad u . Ha kane ka rukom long ka dak ïa ki briew bad ïoh tip ba nga long Trai .
translation.en: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped , and thou shalt speak , and be no more dumb : and thou shalt be a sign unto them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

And he said , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  , my daughter : for thou hast shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning , inasmuch as thou followedst not young men , whether poor or rich .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi ,  u ong .  Phi pyn-i ka kamram kaba khraw kaba ïadei bad ka longïing ha kaei kaba phi leh mynta ban ïa kaei kaba phi la leh ïa la ka kiaw kurim . Phin jin da la leit wad ïa u rangsamla , la u dei uba riewspah ne uba duk , hynrei phim shym leh kumta .

translation.en: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet , Hear now , Hananiah  ; The  Lord  hath not sent thee  ; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ïa kane ha u Hananaïah , bad nga la bynrap ,  To shahshkor , ko Hananaïah ! U  Trai  um shym la phah ïa me , bad la pynlong ïa kine ki briew ban ngeit ïa ka lamler .
Uei u ym ha ka jingtiengburom ïa me A ? ban kyntait ban ka jingkhraw jong me Tang ma me hi uba khuid Baroh ki kin wan bad mane ïa , namar ïa ki jingleh me ïohi da baroh .
translation.en: Who shall not fear thee , O Lord , and glorify thy name ? for thou only art holy : for all nations shall come and worship before thee  ; for thy judgments are made manifest .
And he said , Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day ? it is neither new moon , nor sabbath . And she said , It shall be well .
translation.kha: Balei phi hap ban leit mynta ka sngi ?  u tnga jong ka u kylli .  Kam shym dei ka Sabbaton lane ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai .   Kam lei lei ,  ka jubab .

translation.en: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine , which shall be for their destruction , and which I will send to destroy you : and I will increase the famine upon you , and will break your staff of bread :
translation.kha: Ngan pynsangeh noh ïa ka jingwanrah bam ïa pha bad ngan pynshahthngan ïa pha . Phan sa sngew ïa ka jingtynrah ka jingthngan kum ki khnam banep ba la siat ban pynjot ïa pha .

translation.en: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah , saying , The king of Moab hath rebelled against me : wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle ? And he said , I will go up : I am as thou art , my people as thy people , and my horses as thy horses .
translation.kha: U la phah ktien sha u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah :  U syiem ka Moab u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ; hato phin ïasoh bad nga ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u ?   Ngan ïasoh ,  u syiem Jehoshaphat u jubab .  Nga kloi ban ïarap ïa phi kat kaba nga lah bad kumta ruh ki long ki rangbah bad ki kulai jong nga .

translation.en: And said , Naked came I out of my mother s womb , and naked shall I return thither : the  Lord  gave , and the  Lord  hath taken away  ; blessed be the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U ong ,  La kha ïa nga lyngkhuit khlem don ei ei bad ngan ïap lyngkhuit khlem don ei ei . U  Trai  u la ai , bad mynta u la shim noh . To ai ba yn ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u !

translation.en: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman , or if I have laid wait at my neighbour s door  ;
translation.kha: Lada nga la ikwah ïa ka tnga u paramarjan jong nga , bad ïai ap , ïai rieh , shabar ka jingkhang jong ka ,

translation.en: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker , and buildeth temples  ; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities : but I will send a fire upon his cities , and it shall devour the palaces thereof .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la tei ïa ki ïingsyiem , hynrei ki la klet ïa la U Nongthaw . Ki paid Judah ki la tei ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh . Hynrei ngan phah da ka ding ka ban thang duh ïa ki ïingsyiem bad ki nongbah jong ki .

Sebedi khnam jong nga kin jreiñ da ka snam jong ki , bad ka waitlam jong nga kan pynïap lut ïa kiba pyrshah Seboiim nga . Ïa uno uno uba ïaleh pyrshah ïa jingkrenbeiñ ngan ym map Ismakhaïah wat ki Huram Artemas kito kiba mynsaw ruh kin Seresh .’
translation.en: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood , and my sword shall devour flesh  ; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives , from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy .

translation.kha: Kaba mih na kaei ki ba ki apostol la leh , ka long ba ïa ki briew kiba pang la rah sha ki lynti bah bad la buh ha ki jingthiah bad ki shylliah khang ba kumno la kumno ka syrngiew jong u Petros kan dei ha ki katto katne na ngut ki katba u dang ïaid najan .
translation.en: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets , and laid them on beds and couches , that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them .

When thou passest through the waters , I will be with thee  ; and through the rivers , they shall not overflow thee : when thou walkest through the fire , thou shalt not be burned  ; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïaid lyngba ïa ki um bajylliew , ngan long ryngkat bad phi ; ki jingeh kin ym tyllep ïa phi . Haba phi ïaid lyngba ka ding , phin ym ing ; ki jingtynjuh ba-eh kiba wan kin ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .

translation.en: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar , and lieth upon the border of Moab .
translation.kha: bad ka sharing jong ki them kiba kot shaduh ka shnong Ar bad shaduh u pud ka ri Moab .

translation.en: And they said , It is false  ; tell us now . And he said , Thus and thus spake he to me , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have anointed thee king over Israel .
translation.kha: Em , ngim tip !  ki la jubab .  Ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei ba u ong !   U ïathuh ïa nga ba U  Trai  u pynbna , ‘ Nga pynsleh ïa me ban long u syiem ka Israel .’

Ki khun ki ksiew u Manasseh ki pynïaid ïa ki nongbah jong ka Beth Shan , ka Taanakh , ka Megiddo , bad ka Dor , bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ki . Kine baroh ki dei ki jaka ha kiba ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph , u khun jong u Jakob , ki shong ki sah .
translation.en: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh , Beth–shean and her towns , Taanach and her towns , Megiddo and her towns , Dor and her towns . In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel .
And having this confidence , I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith ;
translation.kha: Nga sngewskhem ïa kane bad kumta nga tip ba ngan dang sah . Ngan dang ïaisah bad phi baroh , ban pynsan shuh shuh ïa phi bad ïa ka jingkmen ha ka jingngeit ,
Katba u Abimelekh bad kynhun jong u ki tur sha ban ïada ka khyrdop shnong , kiwei pat ki ar kynhun tur ïaleh ki hapoh lyngkha bad ki pynïap ki baroh .
translation.en: And Abimelech , and the company that was with him , rushed forward , and stood in the entering of the gate of the city : and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields , and slew them .

translation.kha: Ki misteri na Biblos ba la ïoh jinghikai bha . maji na baroh ki liengbah duriaw ki la ïakhaïi pateng ha ki jong pha
translation.en: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers : all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise .
And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua , the ruler of Mizpah , another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall .
translation.kha: U Eser , u khun jong u Jeshua , u nongsynshar jong ka Mispah , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud kaba long ha khmat ka jaka buh tiar ïapom , haduh ka jaka ha kaba ka kynroh ka phai ;
Kane ka long kumno ngi tip ba ngi ieit ïa khun U Blei : long da kaba ieit U bad kohnguh ki hukum jong u .
translation.en: By this we know that we love the children of God , when we love God , and keep his commandments .
And the people shall be as the burnings of lime : as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire .
translation.kha: Phin sa lwet kum ki maw ba la thang ban pynlong mawshun , kum ki shiah ba la thang haduh ba ki la kylla dpei .

translation.en: And ye shall eat old store , and bring forth the old because of the new .
translation.kha: Ki jingmih ba phi lum kin long kiba bun , bad kin biang na ka bynta shisnem ; wat la katta ruh , phin hap bret noh ïa kaba dang sah na ka jinglum kaba rim ban pyllait jaka ïa ka jinglum kaba thymmai .

translation.en: His left hand is under my head , and his right hand doth embrace me .
translation.kha: Wat khmih beiñ ïa nga namar ka rong sniehdoh jong nga , namar ba ka sngi ka la pynkylla rong ïa nga . Ki shynrang kiba shi para bad nga ki bitar ïa nga bad ki pyntrei ïa nga ha ka bri sohwaiñ . Ngam don por ban sumar ïa lade .

translation.en: And the children of Israel , the priests , and the Levites , and the rest of the children of the captivity , kept the dedication of this house of God with joy ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki paid Israel — ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi bad baroh kiwei pat kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw — da ka jingkmen ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
U Iso ong u , Ïa ngin ïaleit noh ; ngan nang ïaid ma nga sha khmat .
translation.en: And he said , Let us take our journey , and let us go , and I will go before thee .

translation.kha: Nga bniat ïa kane ka jingleh jubor jong u , hynrei ym don ba shahshkor ; ym don uba ïohsngew soi ka jingïam jong nga ban ïoh ïa ka hok .
translation.en: Behold , I cry out of wrong , but I am not heard : I cry aloud , but there is no judgment .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Uba rit bad uba tlot kumba me khup , ko jingïaseng , wat sheptieng ; Meronoth ïarap ïa me . Nga Naarah shna Blei uba khuid ki Israel , nga long uta uba pynim ïa Kum Khlemlait
translation.en: Fear not , thou worm Jacob , and ye men of Israel  ; I will help thee , saith the  Lord  , and thy redeemer , the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: Ki pynïap ïa pdiang ïapli bad ïa ki khunswet , bad shoh pynïap ïa u nongwei uba shong ha ka ri jong ngi .
translation.en: They slay the widow and the stranger , and murder the fatherless .

translation.kha: Sa shisien u Dabid u kylli na U Trai , uba jubab , Wat tur ïaleh ïa ki nangne , hynrei leit bad pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ki kawei ka , najan ki dieng
translation.en: And when David enquired of the  Lord  , he said , Thou shalt not go up  ; but fetch a compass behind them , and come upon them over against the mulberry trees .

translation.kha: Phi tip ba namar ki thma ba ïai khie , u u kpa jong la dei ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ri jong nongshun kiba jong u , um shym la lah ban tei templ na ka bynta ka jingmane U Trai Blei jong u tad haduh ba u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor ki nongshun u baroh .
translation.en: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the  Lord  his God for the wars which were about him on every side , until the  Lord  put them under the soles of his feet .

translation.kha: Ki shna arphew pynkhyllem ba-mynshuwa jingker ïa ka liang Lo-Ruhamah’ shaphang shathie ,
translation.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle  ; twenty boards for the south side southward :
Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together , and appoint themselves one head , and they shall come up out of the land : for great shall be the day of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Judah bad ki briew ka Israel kin ïasoh lang kawei sa shisien . Kin sa jied tang uwei u nongïalam na ka bynta jong ki , bad sa shisien pat kin sa manbha bad roi kyrhai ha la ka ri . Ho-oid , ka sngi jong ka Jesreel kan long ka sngi kaba khraw !
To shahshkor ïa ka khubor jong U Trai phi , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , phi ki jait jong ka Israel .
translation.en: Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , O house of Jacob , and all the families of the house of Israel :
Let all your things be done with charity .
translation.kha: Leh ïa ki kam jong phi baroh da ka jingieit .

translation.en: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat , saying , There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria  ; and , behold , they be in Hazazon–tamar , which is En–gedi .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki nonglamktien ki wan bad ki ïathuh ha u syiem Jehoshaphat :  Ka kynhun shipai babun paid na Edom ka la wan na sha shiliang ka Duriaw Baïap ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ki la dep knieh ïa ka Hasason Tamar .  ( Kane ka dei kawei pat ka kyrteng jong ka Engedi . )

translation.en: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance , lest they bear sin for it , and die therefore , if they profane it : I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh baroh , namar kata , ki dei ban sumar ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba nga la ai . Lym kumta kin kit hi ïa la ka pop bad kin ïap , namar ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba kyntang . Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang ïa ki .

translation.en: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the  Lord  who had sent him , and all the signs which he had commanded him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ïathuh ha u Aaron ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba U  Trai  u la ong mynba u phah ïa u ban leit phai sha Ijipt ; u ïathuh ruh ha u shaphang ki kambah kiba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u ban leh .

translation.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee , and shall hang thee on a tree  ; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee .
translation.kha: Hapoh lai sngi u syiem un sa pyllait noh ïa phi — un phah khrai khlieh ïa phi ! Nangta un sa sdien ïa ka met jong phi ha u dieng , bad ki sim kin bam ïa ka doh jong phi .

translation.en: Then thou shalt remember thy ways , and be ashamed , when thou shalt receive thy sisters , thine elder and thy younger : and I will give them unto thee for daughters , but not by thy covenant .
translation.kha: Phan kynmaw kumno pha la leh , bad sngewlehrain ïa ka haba pha ïoh pat ïa ka hynmen bad ka para jong pha . Ngan shah ïa ki ban long kum ki khun kynthei jong pha , wat la kane kam dei ka bynta jong ka jutang jong nga bad pha .
Ki dei ban im ha ki krem , ki thliew ba la tih ha sharing jong ki riat .
translation.en: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys , in caves of the earth , and in the rocks .
And he confessed , and denied not  ; but confessed , I am not the Christ .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis um shym la kyntait ban jubab , hynrei , u la kren ha kaba paw bad da kaba shai , u da ong ,  Ngam dei u Messaïah .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , while they communed together and reasoned , Jesus himself drew near , and went with them .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïakren bad ïasaidnia , U Jisu hi u la leit hajan bad u la ïaid lem bad ki ;

translation.en: And Moses went out from Pharaoh , and entreated the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Moses u mihnoh na u Pharaoh , bad u kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ,

Ki ong , U Trai u la hukum ïa phi ban ïasam ïa ka shet ha ki paid Israel da kaba kynting sbai . U la hukum jingkyrkhu ïa phi ban ai ïa ka bri ka khyndew jong u :12-14 kur jong ngi u Selophehad pynkyrteng duriaw khun kynthei jingïakajia bteng .
translation.en: And they said , The  Lord  commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel : and my lord was commanded by the  Lord  to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters .
Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth , and they that dwell therein are desolate : therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned , and few men left .
translation.kha: Kumta U Blei u la pynbna ïa ka jingtim ha ka pyrthei . Ki briew jong ka ki hap ban siew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh . Kiba im ki la nang duna bad nang duna .
ki jaiñphong lyngdoh na u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin haba ki shakri kum ki lyngdoh ,
translation.en: And the cloths of service , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons , to minister in the priest s office ,

translation.kha: U mane ka ka blei ki , ïa u Molekh blei ba-ijli jong ki .
translation.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites .
These are terms given to God’s chief enemy .
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki kyrteng ba la ai ïa u nongshun bakhraw tam jong U Blei .
Ade kan long ka jingpynshitom ka ban hap halor ka Ijipt bad ha baroh kiwei pat ki Neiel lada kim rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translation.en: This shall be the punishment of Egypt , and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles .

translation.kha: U Moses u long uba lah ban shaniah ha ïing U Blei kum u , u kren ïa kiei kiba U Blei un sa kren ki por ki ban sa wan .
translation.en: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house , as a servant , for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after  ;

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi , katba u Jeroboam u dang mih na Jerusalem , u Ahijah u uba na Shiloh , u ïakynduh ïa u marwei ha lynti ha .
translation.en: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem , that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way  ; and he had clad himself with a new garment  ; and they two were alone in the field :

translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut ki Jiw na ka probins jong ka Asia sngewkhuslai la Iri hangta ; ki hi ki dei ban wan ha khmat jinglyngkhuit me Kolossai buh ïa ki jingmudui jong ki lada ki don ei ei pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: Who ought to have been here before thee , and object , if they had ought against me .

translation.kha: Ha ki kynroh jong pha , ko Jerusalem , nga la buh ïa ki nongap ; phira ne mynsngi mynmiet kin ym sngap jar . Kin pynkynmaw ïa U Trai ïa ki kular jong u , bad kin ym shah ba klet un ïa ki .
translation.en: I have set watchmen upon thy walls , O Jerusalem , which shall never hold their peace day nor night : ye that make mention of the  Lord  , keep not silence ,
And as for me also , mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity , but I will recompense their way upon their head .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan ym isynei ïa ki , Ngan leh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma ki , ki la leh ïa kiwei .

halor bad ki lumbah ha ka rudnong bym don jingkah . Ngan pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ban shim noh ïa ka spah bad ïa ki jingkynshew jong phi namar ki pop baroh kiba phi la leh ha kylleng ka ri jong phi .
translation.en: O my mountain in the field , I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil , and thy high places for sin , throughout all thy borders .

translation.kha: namar ka kam bymman ba ki la leh ïa phi haba ki la shukor ïa phi ha Peor , bad ka namar Kosbi kaba la pynïap shah ha ka por jong ka jingïapthem ha Peor .
translation.en: For they vex you with their wiles , wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor , and in the matter of Cozbi , the daughter of a prince of Midian , their sister , which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor s sake .
Cretans and Arabians , we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God .
translation.kha: ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kiba la kylla sha ka niam Jiw , bad katto katne ngut na ngi , ngi dei na Krit bad na Arabia — pynban baroh na ngi , ngi ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki kren ha ki ktien jong ngi shaphang kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba U Blei u la leh !

translation.en: Ye stand upon your sword , ye work abomination , and ye defile every one his neighbour s wife : and shall ye possess the land ?
translation.kha: Phi shaniah ha ki waitlam jong phi . Ki kam jong phi ki long kiba ijli . Uwei pa uwei u klim . Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ka ri ka dei ka jong phi ?

translation.en: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire .
translation.kha: Ïa kano kano ka doh kaba sah haduh ka sngi kaba lai dei ban thang noh ïa ka .

translation.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions : and the plague brake in upon them .
translation.kha: Ki la pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  da ki jingleh jong ki , bad ka jingpang bashyrkhei ka la mih hapdeng jong ki .
Ngan pynroi kyrhai ïa ka jingmih na ki bad diengsoh na ki lyngkha jong phi , ba kan ym don shuh ka nemsniew ka ban pynjahburom ïa phi hapdeng ki . jaitbynriew
translation.en: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree , and the increase of the field , that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen .

translation.kha: Ki shipai Philistia ju ki wan ban ïaleh thma , hynrei ha man ki jingïaleh , u Dabid kham u jop ïa ban ki ïa uno uno u rangbah shipai jong u Saul . Kumta u Dabid u la pawnam shibun .
translation.en: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth : and it came to pass , after they went forth , that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul  ; so that his name was much set by .
When his candle shined upon my head , and when by his light I walked through darkness  ;
translation.kha: U Blei u long borabor bad nga ha kata ka por bad u ai jingshai ïa nga katba nga ïaid lyngba ïa ka jingdum .

translation.en: And when they had eaten enough , they lightened the ship , and cast out the wheat into the sea .
translation.kha: Hadien ba uwei uwei baroh u la bam kdang , ki la pynsting ïa ka lieng da kaba bret noh ïa u kew baroh sha ka duriaw .
u la jubab ïa ki , Leh ïa kaba bha tam rung lyngba ka khyrdop khim ; namar bun ki briew kaba thikna kin pyrshang ban phrung jong ka hynrei kin ym lah .
translation.en: Strive to enter in at the strait gate : for many , I say unto you , will seek to enter in , and shall not be able .
Have not I commanded thee ? Be strong and of a good courage  ; be not afraid , neither be thou dismayed : for the  Lord  thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba nga la hukum ïa me ban long uba kut jingmut triang bad uba skhem ! Wat sheptieng lane noh mynsiem , namar nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong me , nga long ryngkat lem bad me kat shaba me leit .

translation.en: But if ye believe not his writings , how shall ye believe my words ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ba phim ngeit ïa kaei kaba u la thoh , kumno phi lah ban ngeit ïa kaei kaba nga ong ?
ha me ïa kaei kaba mem shym : baroh rta ka jingim jong me , men don ka spah bad ka burom , kham ïa kata ka jong uno uno uwei pat u syiem .
translation.en: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked , both riches , and honour : so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days .

translation.kha: Wat ïa ki shñiuh jong ka khlieh phi la ñiew baroh . Kumta to wat ; phi kham kor ban ïa shibun sim ïing !
translation.en: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered . Fear not therefore : ye are of more value than many sparrows .
And he will take the tenth of your seed , and of your vineyards , and give to his officers , and to his servants .
translation.kha: Un shim ïa kaba shiphew na u kew bad na u sohwaiñ jong phi na ka bynta ki rangbah synshar Aiñ bad kiwei ki rangbah synshar .
Ka jingkyrpad jong ngi ïa phi dei kam kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka lane jingbakla ha ki jingthmu bymkhuid , lymne ba ngi pyrshang ban shukor ïano ïano .
translation.en: For our exhortation was not of deceit , nor of uncleanness , nor in guile :
And now , my daughter , fear not  ; I will do to thee all that thou requirest : for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman .
translation.kha: Ruth , mynta wat khuslai . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi pan ; kumba baroh ha shnong ki ïatip , phi dei ka kynthei kaba donburom .

translation.en: Cursed shalt thou be in the city , and cursed shalt thou be in the field .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un tim ïa ki shnong bad ki lyngkha jong phi .
kumta ïa phi yn rah noh kum ki koidi . Ki nongïalam jong kin phi haduh shahthngan ban ïap , bad ki riewpaidbah kin ïap thynrang .
translation.en: Therefore my people are gone into captivity , because they have no knowledge : and their honourable men are famished , and their multitude dried up with thirst .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Dibon ki kiew ïa pep lum ban bakhia ha ka jaka mane blei . Ki briew jong pyndeng Moab ki pynïaidkam ïam ha ka jingsngewsih apkhmih ki nongbah jong ka Neng bad Medeba ; kyntiew la khi ïa la ki khlieh bad ïa u ñiuhtmoh ha ka jingsngewsih .
translation.en: He is gone up to Bajith , and to Dibon , the high places , to weep : Moab shall howl over Nebo , and over Medeba : on all their heads shall be baldness , and every beard cut off .
But what things were gain to me , those I counted loss for Christ .
translation.kha: Hynrei kita kiei kiei baroh kiba nga lah ban ñiew kum ka jingmyntoi ; ïa kine , nga la ñiew mynta ka jingduh na ka bynta U Khrist .

translation.en: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel , nor in all the days of the kings of Israel , nor of the kings of Judah  ;
translation.kha: Ym pat ju don ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait kum kane ïa kaba la rakhe da uno uno na ki syiem Israel ne Judah , naduh ka por mynba ki nongbishar ki synshar ïa ka ri .

translation.en: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , hapoh ka ïingsyiem , ka Bashti , ka mahadei ka ai ka jingkhawai na ka bynta ki kynthei .

translation.en: For the day of the  Lord  of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty , and upon every one that is lifted up  ; and he shall be brought low :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pynpoh ïa uwei pa uwei uba khrawbor , ïa uwei pa uwei uba sarong bad uba sngewmeng .
Ha ka por shiteng sngi , ïa ka ri baroh kawei la tap da ka jingdum kaba la lai neh kynta .
translation.en: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Me te , men ym im slem shuh . Khot ïa u Joshua bad wan ïalam ïa u sha ka khnang Ïingjaiñ ba ngan ai ïa hukum u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Behold , thy days approach that thou must die : call Joshua , and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation , that I may give him a charge . And Moses and Joshua went , and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation .
Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families , every man in the door of his tent : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled greatly  ; Moses also was displeased .
translation.kha: U Moses u ïohsngew ba ki briew baroh ki ïakhñium katba ki dang ïa-ïeng lymbung kynhun kynhun ha khmat jingkhang jong ki ïingjaiñ jong ki . U la sngewkhuslai namar ba U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki ,

translation.en: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them  ; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son , nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son .
translation.kha: Wat ïashongkha khleh bad ki , bad khang ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi ban ïashongkha khleh bad ki ,

U syiem Sedekaïah u la set byndi ïa nga hangta bad u la mudui ba nga la pynbna ba U Trai u ong la , Ngan pynlong ba u syiem ka Babilonia un kurup ïa kane ka nongbah , u bad syiem un Sedekaïah ym lait im .
translation.en: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up , saying , Wherefore dost thou prophesy , and say , Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall take it  ;

translation.kha: Ki khatwei ngut ki synran ki la sha u ha Galilaïa kaba u la ong ïa ki ban leit .
translation.en: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee , into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them .
And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel , that they may know that , as I was with Moses , so I will be with thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Kaei kaba nga leh mynta ka sngi kan pynlong ïa ki paid Israel baroh ban sdang ban burom ïa me kum u riewkhraw , bad kin ïoh tip ba nga long lem ryngkat bad me kumba nga la long bad u Moses .

translation.en: And he brought out the people that were in it , and cut them with saws , and with harrows of iron , and with axes . Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon . And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U rah ïa ki briew jong ka nongbah bad pyntrei ïa ki ha ki jaka ot dieng , jaka shna mohkhiew bad sdie . U leh kumjuh ïa ki briew jong kiwei ki shnong ka ri Ammon . Nangta ma u bad ki rangbah jong u ki wan phai sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Let Reuben live , and not die  ; and let not his men be few .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Reuben , u Moses u ong ,  Ai ba ka jait Reuben kan im , wat la ka long kaba khyndiat briew .
Kito ïa :16 U Blei u la lah jied lypa u la jingkyntiew ruh ban long kum U Khun jong u , khnang ba U Khun un shisha uba nyngkong hapdeng Ur para Gadmon
translation.en: For whom he did foreknow , he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son , that he might be the firstborn among many brethren .

translation.kha: La don ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem , ki riew hakhmat thadrong la wan na Kreskens pa kawei Gaash ri ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews , devout men , out of every nation under heaven .

translation.kha: Ale , bam na deng jingbam jong nga , bad nongpynïaidkam na ka waiñ ba nga la khleh .
translation.en: Come , eat of my bread , and drink of the wine which I have mingled .

translation.kha: To put ki ïa turoi thma ha Gibeah ! Pynsawa ïa ka jingkyrsiew ha Ramah ! jam Pyrta shaphang ka thma ha Bethaben ! Tur sha ka thma , ko ki rangbah Benjamin !
translation.en: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah , and the trumpet in Ramah : cry aloud at Beth–aven , after thee , O Benjamin .

translation.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold .

translation.en: These two things are come unto thee  ; who shall be sorry for thee ? desolation , and destruction , and the famine , and the sword : by whom shall I comfort thee ?

translation.en: Then David and his men , which were about six hundred , arose and departed out of Keilah , and went whithersoever they could go . And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah  ; and he forbare to go forth .

translation.en: And the messenger answered and said , Israel is fled before the Philistines , and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people , and thy two sons also , Hophni and Phinehas , are dead , and the ark of God is taken .
Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men , him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Thou hast both seen him , and it is he that talketh with thee .

translation.en: And thy issue , which thou begettest after them , shall be thine , and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance .

translation.en: Blessed shalt thou be in the city , and blessed shalt thou be in the field .

translation.en: And Er , Judah s firstborn , was wicked in the sight of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  slew him .

And he returned to the man of God , he and all his company , and came , and stood before him : and he said , Behold , now I know that there is no God in all the earth , but in Israel : now therefore , I pray thee , take a blessing of thy servant .

translation.en: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden , Come  ; for all things are now ready .

translation.en: The  Lord  preserveth the strangers  ; he relieveth the fatherless and widow : but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down .

translation.en: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now .

translation.en: And he cried unto the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  shewed him a tree , which when he had cast into the waters , the waters were made sweet : there he made for them a statute and an ordinance , and there he proved them ,

And every creature which is in heaven , and on the earth , and under the earth , and such as are in the sea , and all that are in them , heard I saying , Blessing , and honour , and glory , and power , be unto him that sitteth upon the throne , and unto the Lamb for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingthaw baroh ha bneng , ha khyndew , ha ka pyrthei shapoh , bad ha ka duriaw — baroh kiei kiei kiba im ha ka pyrthei — bad ki ïarwai :  Ha uta uba shong halor ka khet bad ha U Khunlangbrot , long ka jingïaroh bad ka jingpyndonburom , ka burom bad ka bor , junom la junom !

translation.en: And ye shall seek me , and find me , when ye shall search for me with all your heart .
translation.kha: Phin wad ïa nga , bad phin shem ïa nga namar ba phin wad ïa nga da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .
bad u la kren jam ha u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah , U Trai u ong ba phi la lyndet ïa ka ktien U Trai bad , phim shym leh la kumba u la hukum ïa phi .
translation.en: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the  Lord  , and hast not kept the commandment which the  Lord  thy God commanded thee ,
And I heard a man s voice between the banks of Ulai , which called , and said , Gabriel , make this man to understand the vision .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba pyrta na shiliang ka wah Ulai ,  Ko Gabriel , to batai ïa u ïa ka jingmut jong kaei kaba u la ïohi .

translation.en: It is of the  Lord s  mercies that we are not consumed , because his compassions fail not .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit baneh bad ka jingisynei jong U  Trai  ka ïaineh ,

translation.en: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt , and of all that ye have seen  ; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither .
translation.kha: Ïathuh keiñ ha i pa haduh katno nga long uba donbor ha Ijipt , bad ïathuh ruh shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba phi la ïohi . Khie ïaleit bran bran , bad wan ïalam ïa i shane .
Nangta ki la sha ki Pharisi ïa u briew uba la ju long uba matlah .
translation.en: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind .

So shall ye say unto Joseph , Forgive , I pray thee now , the trespass of thy brethren , and their sin  ; for they did unto thee evil : and now , we pray thee , forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father . And Joseph wept when they spake unto him .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi kyrpad ïa phi ba phin map ïa ka kam sniew kaba ngi , ki shakri jong U Blei u kpa jong phi , ngi la leh .  U Joseph u ïam haba u ïohsngew ïa kane .

translation.en: But many that are first shall be last  ; and the last first .
translation.kha: Hynrei bun kiba long nyngkong mynta kin sa long khatduh , bad bun kiba long khatduh mynta kin sa long nyngkong .

translation.en: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house , that my name may be there for ever : and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually .
translation.kha: namar nga la jied ïa ka bad nga la pynkyntang ïa ka kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga junom . Ngan khmih halor jong ka bad ïada ïa ka ha ki por baroh .
Kaei nga lah ban ong ? U u Trai la leh ïa kane . Ka dohnud jong nga ka kthang , ngam bad shym lah ïohthiah .
translation.en: What shall I say ? he hath both spoken unto me , and himself hath done it : I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul .

translation.kha: bad ïa ka tnga jong la ai sha uba la shong synran ïa u ha ka jingkyntiew kurim .
translation.en: But Samson s wife was given to his companion , whom he had used as his friend .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki mihnoh Meremoth Rephidim , bad ïashukor ka kynriang kaba nyngkong jong u ba-don uba Jonathan naduh ba ki mih na Ijipt hangne wan poi ha ka ri shyiap Sinai . Ki sher dara hangta Uto kjat u Lum Sinai jing
translation.en: For they were departed from Rephidim , and were come to the desert of Sinai , and had pitched in the wilderness  ; and there Israel camped before the mount .

translation.kha: U Binnui , u khun jong u Henadad tei u ïa ka bynta kaba bud , naduh ka ïing Asaraïah u haduh ka dong jong ka kynroh .
translation.en: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece , from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall , even unto the corner .
And they all forsook him , and fled .
translation.kha: Te baroh ki synran ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la ïaphet noh .

translation.en: Now concerning Moses the man of God , his sons were named of the tribe of Levi .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki khun shynrang jong u Moses , u briew jong U Blei , la kynthup lang hapdeng ki Lebi . )
To ïa kynmaw ki nongïalam jong phi kiba mynshuwa , kiba la kren ha phi ka ïa khubor U Blei . To da pyrkhat kumno ki la im bad ki la ïap , bad pyrthuh bud ïa ka jingngeit ki jong .
translation.en: Remember them which have the rule over you , who have spoken unto you the word of God : whose faith follow , considering the end of their conversation .
And Jonathan Saul s son arose , and went to David into the wood , and strengthened his hand in God .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u la leit sha u hangta bad u la pynshlur ïa u da ka jingpynthikna ïa ka jingïada jong U Blei ,

translation.en: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields , and make an atonement for the house : and it shall be clean .
translation.kha: Nangta un pyllait ïa kata ka sim ba kan her noh shabar ka nongbah kat shaba ka mon . Da kumta un pyndep ïa ka niam ka rukom kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid ïa kata ka ïing , bad kan sa long kaba khuid .

translation.en: Therefore hear , ye nations , and know , O congregation , what is among them .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor phi ki jaitbynriew , bad to tip kaei ka ban jia ïa ki briew jong nga .
Te u Jakob u ïa ki khun shynrang u ong , Ïalumlang , ba ngan ïathuh aïu kan ïa phi ha ka :
translation.en: And Jacob called unto his sons , and said , Gather yourselves together , that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days .

translation.kha: U Blei Bakhuid bad u Israel u ïa uta uba shah , ïa uba la isih da ki jaitbynriew uba long u shakri ki : Ki kin ïohi ba la pyllait ïa me bad ïeng ban pynpaw ïa ka jingñiewburom jong ki ; ki khun syiem ruh kin ïohi ïa kata , bad kin dem khrup ban pyndonburom ïa kan jia namar U Trai u la jied ïa la u shakri ; U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel u bat ïa la kular .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the Redeemer of Israel , and his Holy One , to him whom man despiseth , to him whom the nation abhorreth , to a servant of rulers , Kings shall see and arise , princes also shall worship , because of the  Lord  that is faithful , and the Holy One of Israel , and he shall choose thee .

Then I beheld all the work of God , that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun : because though a man labour to seek it out , yet he shall not find it  ; yea further  ; though a wise man think to know it , yet shall he not be able to find it .
translation.kha: bad phin ym lah da lei lei ban sngewthuh aïu U Blei u leh . Wat haba phi pyrshang tyngeh ruh , phin ym shem da lei lei . Ki briew kiba stad ki lah ban kam ba ki tip , hynrei kim tip .
Haba Israel ïohi haduh ka pang jur bad ka Judah ka ïa la ki jingmong , nangta ki Israel ki ban pan na u syiem khrawbor , hynrei um lah ban pynkoit ïa lane pynkhiah ki jingmong jong ki .
translation.en: When Ephraim saw his sickness , and Judah saw his wound , then went Ephraim to the Assyrian , and sent to king Jareb : yet could he not heal you , nor cure you of your wound .

translation.kha: Ka shnong jong ngi ka dei ka nongbah kaba khraw , kawei na ki shnong kiba shongsuk shongsaiñ tam bad syiem kohnguh tam ha Israel . Balei phi pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ? ka Balei phi kwah ban noh pynjot ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong U Trai ?
translation.en: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel : thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel : why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the  Lord  ?

translation.kha: bad ha Emek ba yn pynpaw ïa ka jingsniew kaba pha la pynshongduh ? Mynta pha long kum ma Niam — ka jingbiria ïa imlang nong Edom , ki Philistia bad Lydia pat ki paramarjan jong pha kiba isih ïa nonglehbeiñ .
translation.en: Before thy wickedness was discovered , as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria , and all that are round about her , the daughters of the Philistines , which despise thee round about .

translation.kha: Ko khun nga , wat klet kaei kaba nga hikai ïa phi ïa nga ïathuh ïa phi ban leh
translation.en: My son , forget not my law  ; but let thine heart keep my commandments :

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar un pynkut ka jingïap junom ! Un ñiad noh ïa ki ummat na ki khmat jong baroh bad un weng ïa ka kaba ki briew jong u ki la shah ha kylleng ka pyrthei . U da lade u kren !
translation.en: He will swallow up death in victory  ; and the Lord  God  will wipe away tears from off all faces  ; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .

And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies  ; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them  ; and they shall flee , as fleeing from a sword  ; and they shall fall when none pursueth .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ha kito na phi kiba dang sah ha ka jinglongmraw ka jingsheptieng kaba khraw kat haduh ba ka jingriew ka sla dieng ha ka jingbeh ka lyer kan pynher krad ïa phi . Phin her ïap la kumba shah beh ha madan thma , bad phin kyllon haba u nongshun um pat don hajan .

translation.en: And when they had taken security of Jason , and of the other , they let them go .
translation.kha: Ki bor synshar ki la pynlong ïa u Jason bad ïa kiwei pat ban siew ïa ka pisa kaba donkam ban ïohlait , bad nangta ki la pyllait ïa ki .

Nangta u Dabid u phet na Naïoth kaba ha Ramah bad u leit sha u Jonathan Sebah Kaei kaba ba-beit la leh ? u kylli . Ka kam jingnguh aïu nga la leh ? Ka kam palat aïu nga sukher leh ïa i pa jong phi ba i da thmu ban pynïap ïa nga ?
translation.en: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah , and came and said before Jonathan , What have I done ? what is mine iniquity ? and what is my sin before thy father , that he seeketh my life ?

translation.kha: U khatphra jingeh u Saul .—Pule ïohi Iohi u bad suri pynjakhlia Bilhan shakri , bad u kylli ïa ki , Phi ïajah Peresh ? Ngi ïaleit wad ïa ki kada , u Saul u jubab . Ynda ngim lap ïa ngaiñ , ngi leit sha u Samuel .
translation.en: And Saul s uncle said unto him and to his servant , Whither went ye ? And he said , To seek the asses : and when we saw that they were no where , we came to Samuel .

translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba kyntait ïa nga ha kaba paw , U U Briew ruh un kyntait ïa u ha khmat ki angel jong U Blei .
translation.en: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God .
And Gideon said unto them , I would desire a request of you , that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey . ( For they had golden earrings , because they were Ishmaelites . )
translation.kha: Hynrei u ong shuh shuh ,  Shah ngan pan tang kawei na phi . Uwei pa uwei na phi un ai noh ha nga ïa ki sohshkor ba phi la shim .  ( Ki Midian kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap , ki deng ki sohshkor ksiar . )

translation.en: And I will tread down the people in mine anger , and make them drunk in my fury , and I will bring down their strength to the earth .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga ïuhroit ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh bad nga lynthaw ïa ki . Nga la theh ïa ka snam jong ki ha madan .
To wat jingot ïa umdih jingmudui pyrshah ïa Ïohi nongsharai balang lymda la wanrah da ki ar ngut ne bun ngut Dei sakhi .
translation.en: Against an elder receive not an accusation , but before two or three witnesses .
And David danced before the  Lord  with all his might  ; and David was girded with a linen ephod .
translation.kha: U Dabid , uba shu pien tang da ka jaiñ linen , u la shadkmen da ka bor jong u baroh ban burom ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And said , O full of all subtilty and all mischief , thou child of the devil , thou enemy of all righteousness , wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord ?
translation.kha: Me u khun jong u Ksuid ! Me long u nongshun ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba bha . Me long uba dap da kiba bun jait ki buit bymman , bad me ju ïai pyrshang ban pynphai ïa ki jingshisha jong U Trai sha ki jinglamler !

translation.en: And the angel came in unto her , and said , Hail , thou that art highly favoured , the Lord is with thee : blessed art thou among women .
translation.kha: U angel u la wan sha ka bad u la ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad pha ! U Trai u long ryngkat bad pha bad u la kyrkhu eh ïa pha !

translation.en: And you , being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh , hath he quickened together with him , having forgiven you all trespasses ;
translation.kha: Phi la long ha kawei ka por kiba la ïap ha kaba kynja mynsiem namar ki pop jong phi bad namar ba phi la long ki Jentil kiba khlem ka Hukum . Hynrei U Blei mynta u la wallam ïa phi sha ka jingim bad U Khrist .
don tang uwei U Blei uba U long Kpa jong u bynriew baroh , uba long U Trai halor baroh , uba trei lyngba kiei kiei baroh , bad long u ha baroh .
translation.en: One God and Father of all , who is above all , and through all , and in you all .

translation.kha: Lada kata ka jaka mane Blei ka jngai eh , phi lah , ha kano kano ka por ba phi , ban pynïap kano kano ka masi lane ka blang ba U u la ha phi , bad bam ïa ka jong ka ha , kumba nga la hukum ïa .
translation.en: If the place which the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee , then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock , which the  Lord  hath given thee , as I have commanded thee , and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after .

Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him  ; and he cried , Cause every man to go out from me . And there stood no man with him , while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph um sngewlah kun shuh ïa la ka jingsngew ha khmat ki shakri jong u , kumta u la hukum ïa ki baroh ba kin mihnoh na ka kamra . Ym shym don mano mano lem bad u haba u Joseph u pynithuh ïa lade ha ki hynmen shynrang jong u .

translation.en: And for the other side of the tabernacle , which is toward the north corner , he made twenty boards ,
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh arphew tylli ki jingker na ka bynta ka liang kaba shaphang shatei ka Ïingjaiñ ,
Nga lah ban sakhi thohshuid lade snemhadien ïa ka jingtrei shitom jong u na ka bynta jong phi iau na ka Ararat ki musla kiba ha Laodikaïa bad ha Hierapolis .
translation.en: For I bear him record , that he hath a great zeal for you , and them that are in Laodicea , and them in Hierapolis .

translation.kha: jingingiew ngin ïalong paralok , sanphew ki jingïambriew jong ngi ki la ïalong . Kane ka rupa bad ka Bethuel ki long bynshet Lyngba sngewbha jingbudnam phi . Mynta pynkheiñ noh ïa ka jingïateh Kyrini bad u Baasha u syiem Israel khnang ba un weng prong ïa Jobab shipai jingpynwit suhsieng na ka ri jong nga .
translation.en: There is a league between me and thee , as there was between my father and thy father : behold , I have sent thee silver and gold  ; go , break thy league with Baasha king of Israel , that he may depart from me .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi Philistia basah u mradkhlaw uba wan mih na duriaw . U la don shiphew Sing ki reng bad hynñiew .—Eklesiastis ki khlieh ; halor kawei pa kawei jong ki shongkhlad jong ka Salmunna la don nud pansngiat , lur halor kawei pa kawei jong ki khlieh jong ka la don moramot kyrteng kaba krenbeiñ Blei .
translation.en: And I stood upon the sand of the sea , and saw a beast rise up out of the sea , having seven heads and ten horns , and upon his horns ten crowns , and upon his heads the name of blasphemy .
I will make waste mountains and hills , and dry up all their herbs  ; and I will make the rivers islands , and I will dry up the pools .
translation.kha: Nga pyntwa ïa ki lumrit bad ki lumbah ngan pyntyrkhong ïa u phlang bad ki dieng . Ngan pynkylla ïa ki them wah sha ki jaka shyiap bad pyntyrkhong ïa ki pukri um .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a woman have conceived seed , and born a man child : then she shall be unclean seven days  ; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi hadien ba ka kynthei ka kha khun shynrang , kan long ka bymkhuid , kumba ka long ha ka por ba ka poi bnai .

translation.en: And when they found them not , they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city , crying , These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei haba kim shym lap ïa ki , ki la paring ïa u Jason bad ïa ki katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki parabangeit ha khmat ki bor synshar jong ka nongbah bad ki la pyrta ,  Kine ki briew ki la thaw jingkulmar kylleng kylleng ! Mynta ki la wan sha ka nongbah jong ngi , bad u Jason u la pynsah ïa ki ha ka ïing jong u .

Ïa phi la jied kat kum ka jingthmu U Blei uba U Kpa bad la pynlong ïa phi ki kiba da U Mynsiem jong u , ban kohnguh U Jisu bad ban ïoh da snam . To ai ba jingaiei bad jingsuk kin long dap pura ïa phi .
translation.en: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father , through sanctification of the Spirit , unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ : Grace unto you , and peace , be multiplied .
Who shall change our vile body , that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body , according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself .
translation.kha: U ban pynkylla ïa ki met batlot jong ngi bad pynlong ïa ki kum ka met ba-dap da ka burom jong u hi , da kata ka bor da kaba u lah ban wallam ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u .
Uwei u bania uba kyrteng Demetrios uba la thaw ïa ki dur templ jong ka blei da ka rupa , bad ka kam jong u ka la pynïohnong eh ïa ki .
translation.en: For a certain man named Demetrius , a silversmith , which made silver shrines for Diana , brought no small gain unto the craftsmen  ;
For thus hath the Lord said unto me , Go , set a watchman , let him declare what he seeth .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Khie leit bad buh u nongap phira , bad ong ïa u ban ïathuh ïa kaei kaba u ïohi .

Ki kyrdem ïa kiba tlot bad ki bymdonbor bad ki khynñiat sharud lynti ïa kiba . U duk briew bad u kpa jong u ki ïathiah shongkha ïa kajuh ka kynthei mraw , bad kumta ki ïa pyntngit ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong nga .
translation.en: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor , and turn aside the way of the meek : and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid , to profane my holy name :

translation.kha: Hato ka jingim jong me lyngkot ka kum ka jong ngi ?
translation.en: Are thy days as the days of man ? are thy years as man s days ,

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha Madmen jingtong ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: la u ai ïa ki ha u Israel , u shakri jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong bad , pyntlot kiar noh na kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translation.en: Wherefore , my dearly beloved , flee from idolatry .

translation.kha: Na ki nongbah baroh jong ka Benjamin ki wan sha Gibeah ban ïaleh pyrshah ki ïa Israel .
translation.en: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah , to go out to battle against the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ong : long kaba eh briew ki babha ba kin ïohlait im aïu kan long ïa ki nongpop ba khlem Blei ?
translation.en: And if the righteous scarcely be saved , where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear ?
And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh : For God , said he , hath made me forget all my toil , and all my father s house .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ,  U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga ban klet ïa ki jingshah shitom baroh bad ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong i pa jong nga  ; kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa uba nyngkong , u Manasseh .

translation.en: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia : but we beseech you , brethren , that ye increase more and more ;
translation.kha: Bad shisha phi la leh ïa kane ha ki parabangeit baroh ha Makedonia . Kumta ngi kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit , ba phin nang leh shuh shuh .

translation.en: The father shall be divided against the son , and the son against the father  ; the mother against the daughter , and the daughter against the mother  ; the mother in law against her daughter in law , and the daughter in law against her mother in law .
translation.kha: Ki kpa ki long pyrshah ïa ki khun shynrang jong ki , bad ki khun shynrang pyrshah ïa ki kpa jong ki ; ki kmie kin long pyrshah ïa ki khun kynthei jong ki , bad ki khun kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kmie jong ki ; ki kiaw kurim kin long pyrshah ïa ki pyrsa kurim kynthei jong ki bad ki pyrsa kurim kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kiaw jong ki .

translation.en: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh , Beth–shean and her towns , Taanach and her towns , Megiddo and her towns , Dor and her towns . In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew u Manasseh ki pynïaid ïa ki nongbah jong ka Beth Shan , ka Taanakh , ka Megiddo , bad ka Dor , bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ki . Kine baroh ki dei ki jaka ha kiba ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph , u khun jong u Jakob , ki shong ki sah .

translation.en: And when king David came to Bahurim , behold , thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul , whose name was Shimei , the son of Gera : he came forth , and cursed still as he came .
translation.kha: Haba u Syiem Dabid u la wan poi ha Bahurim , uwei na ki ba-ha-ïing jong u Saul , u Shimei , u khun jong u Gera , u la wan ïakynduh ïa u , u da tim ïa u katba u dang wan .

To shahshkor ïa ki jingud jong jaiñspong ; ym don shuwa mano ban pyntngen ïa nga . Ki nongshun jong nga ki pynshaïong ba me la wallam ka jingjot halor jong nga . To Barakel ïa satia sngi kaba me la kular ; to jingkyrpang ïa ki nongshun jong nga tnaw shahshitom kum ma nga .
translation.en: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets : my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword  ; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger  ; thou hast killed , and not pitied .

translation.kha: Te u Moses ïapher bad ki nongïalam Israel , ki ong ha uta u paidbah , Kohnguh ïa Dannah jingjrong baroh ïa kiba nga ai ha phi hiar borabor iakata .
translation.en: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people , saying , Keep all the commandments which I command you this day .
I will not conceal his parts , nor his power , nor his comely proportion .
translation.kha: Shah ngan ïathuh ïa me shaphang ki khohwah jong u Lebiathan bad batai haduh katno u long uba khraw bad uba khlaiñ .

translation.en: And Gad came that day to David , and said unto him , Go up , rear an altar unto the  Lord  in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi u Gad u la leit sha u Dabid , bad u ong ha u ,  Khie leit shatei sha ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah bad tei ka duwan ïa U  Trai .
Un pynmadan ïa ki lumbah bakynjang bad Atad ki lumrit ,
translation.en: And upon all the high mountains , and upon all the hills that are lifted up ,
