translation.en: When they have a matter , they come unto me  ; and I judge between one and another , and I do make them know the statutes of God , and his laws .
translation.kha: Haba don kano kano ka jingïakajia hapdeng ar ngut , ki wan sha nga , nga hap ban bishar bad rai mano na ki uba dei , bad nga ïathuh ha ki ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ U Blei ki ong .

translation.en: Above when he said , Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not , neither hadst pleasure therein  ; which are offered by the law  ;
translation.kha: Ha kaba nyngkong u la ong ,  Mem shym la mon lane mem shym la sngewbha ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki jingainguh lane ïa ki mrad ban thang ha ka duwan bad ïa ki jingkñia ïa ka ban kit noh ïa ki pop .  U la ong ïa kane wat haba ïa baroh ki jingkñia la ainguh kat kum ka Hukum .

translation.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants , Except your youngest brother come down with you , ye shall see my face no more .
translation.kha: Te phi ong , ‘ Lymda u para khatduh jong phi u wan lang bad phi , yn ym shah shuh ïa phi ban wan ha khmat jong nga .’

translation.en: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God  ; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you , and thereby many be defiled  ;
translation.kha: To sumar ban ym phai dien noh na ka jingaiei U Blei . Wat ai ba uno uno un long kum u jingthung uba kthang , uba san bad uba pynjynjar da ka bih jong u .

translation.en: His brethren therefore said unto him , Depart hence , and go into Judaea , that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest .
translation.kha: Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ka la jan , kumta ki para shynrang jong U Jisu ki la ong ïa u ,  To mihnoh na kane ka jaka bad leit sha Judia , ba ki nongbud jong me kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba me leh .

translation.en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name , there am I in the midst of them .
translation.kha: Namar haba ar lane lai ngut ki ïawanlang ha ka kyrteng jong nga , nga don hangta lem bad ki .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi , the son of Gedaliah , the son of Amariah , the son of Hizkiah , in the days of Josiah the son of Amon , king of Judah .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Sephanaïah ha ka por ba u Josaïah u khun jong u Ammon u long u syiem ka Judah . ( U Sephanaïah u la hiarpateng na u syiem Hesekaïah lyngba u Amaraïah , u Gedalaïah , bad u Kushi . )

translation.en: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans , and they that are thrust through in her streets .
translation.kha: Kin mynsaw bad kin ïap ha ki lynti bah jong ki nongbah jong ki .
Bad kumno shaphang ki hynñiew tylli ki na kpu ka bynta ki saw hajar ngut ki rangbah ? Katno shang phi la ïa-pyndap ?
translation.en: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand , and how many baskets ye took up ?

translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki wan sha ka liang u na Asa Ephraim , Manasseh , bad Simeon , bad ki shong ki sah ha ka hima jong u la , namar ki ïohi ba U Trai u long lem bad u . U Asa u phah khot ïa ki baroh bad ïa ki paid Judah bad Benjamin .
translation.en: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin , and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh , and out of Simeon : for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance , when they saw that the  Lord  his God was with him .

translation.kha: alos ka jingim Kha jinglehmeng sah jong u syiem Ussaïah , u la long wiar bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam namar ka jingpang jong u . mait ba um lah Shareser ban rung sha jingbymdon-burom Templ u khñium u sah ha jingkitkhlieh ka jingthmu gospel khlem da leh shuh ïa la ki jingsngewbiang , katba u Jotham u Besodeïah jong ngap , u synshar ïa Spain ri .
translation.en: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death , and dwelt in a several house , being a leper  ; for he was cut off from the house of the  Lord  : and Jotham his son was over the king s house , judging the people of the land .
Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good ?
translation.kha: Kaba bha bad kaba sniew kumjuh ki jia ha ka hukum jong u .

translation.en: And the next day we touched at Sidon . And Julius courteously entreated Paul , and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la poi ha Sidon . U Julius u la lehsbun ïa u Paul bad u la shah ïa u ban leit bad ïakynduh ïa la ki paralok , ba kin ai kat kaba u donkam .

translation.en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , saying , I am thy servant and thy son : come up , and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria , and out of the hand of the king of Israel , which rise up against me .
translation.kha: U Ahas u phah ïa ki rangbah sha u Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , ryngkat bad kane ka khubor :  Nga long u shakri baïaineh jong phi . To wan bad pyllait im ïa nga na ki syiem ka Syria bad Israel , kiba wan tur ïaleh ïa nga .
La pynnep ïa ka ban pynïap , la pynphyrnai ba kan thaba kum ka leilieh . Kan ym don ka jinglehkmen , ki naba briew jong nga ki leh la bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingmaham bad jingpynshitom baroh .
translation.en: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter  ; it is furbished that it may glitter : should we then make mirth ? it contemneth the rod of my son , as every tree .
But if ye be without chastisement , whereof all are partakers , then are ye bastards , and not sons .
translation.kha: Lada ïa phi ym shym la pynshitom , kumba shah ki khun jong u baroh , ka mut ba phim dei ki khun bashisha jong u , hynrei ki khun khlem kpa .

translation.en: Declaring the end from the beginning , and from ancient times the things that are not yet done , saying , My counsel shall stand , and I will do all my pleasure :
translation.kha: Naduh mynnyngkong nga la tip lypa ïa kaei ka ban mih ; la slem bah nga la ïathuh lypa ïa kaei ka ban jia . Nga la ong ba ki jingthmu jong nga kin ym duh da lei lei , ngan leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga thmu ban leh .
Nga la kyrpad u ban leit , bad la ïa uwei bad u . Hato lah ban ba u Titos u la kabu ïa phi ? Hato ma u bad ma nga ngim shym la kijuh hi ki leh ha rukom
translation.en: I desired Titus , and with him I sent a brother . Did Titus make a gain of you ? walked we not in the same spirit ? walked we not in the same steps ?

translation.kha: pynbtai u Aaron u kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia namar Armageddon pop na ka bynta ïa lade bad ka longïing snemhadien u ,
translation.en: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering , which is for himself , and shall make an atonement for himself , and for his house , and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself :
Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death , not regarding his life , to supply your lack of service toward me .
translation.kha: namar u la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim , bad u la jan ïap na ka bynta ka kam U Khrist , khnang ba un ai ïa nga ka jingïarap , kaba ma phi da lade phim lah ban ai .

translation.en: But why dost thou judge thy brother ? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother ? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ .
translation.kha: Ma phi te , kiba bam tang ki jhur — balei phi bishar ïa la u parabangeit ? Bad ma phi kiba bam ïa kiei kiei baroh — balei phi peitbeiñ ïa la u parabangeit ? Baroh na ngi , ngin hap ban ïeng ha khmat U Blei ban shah bishar da u .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , I will disguise myself , and enter into the battle  ; but put thou on thy robes . And the king of Israel disguised himself , and went into the battle .
translation.kha: U Ahab u ong ha u Jehoshaphat ,  Katba ngi dang leit sha ka thma , ngan riam pher ïa lade , hynrei phi riam ha ki jaiñphong syiem jong phi .  Kumta u syiem Israel u leit sha ka thma da jingriam pher .

Kumta u Ahab u khot ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kumba sawspah ngut na ki , bad u kylli ïa ki , Hato leit ngan ne em tur ban ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth Tur ? ïaleh ïa ka , ki jubab , U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop .
translation.en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together , about four hundred men , and said unto them , Shall I go against Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And they said , Go up  ; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king .

translation.kha: Ïa kane la kynmaw kum ka kam babha jong u naduh kata ka bad yn ïai kynmaw ha ki por baroh ki wan .
translation.en: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore .
Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works , when she had received the messengers , and had sent them out another way ?
translation.kha: Ka la long kumjuh ruh bad ka Rahab kaba long ka nuti . La pynksan ïa ka ha U Blei lyngba ki kam jong ka , mynba ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki Israel kiba la wan syntiat bad ïarap ïa ki ban lait phet na kawei pat ka lynti .

translation.en: And I will raise me up a faithful priest , that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind : and I will build him a sure house  ; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever .
translation.kha: Ngan jied ïa u lyngdoh u ban kohnguh ïa nga bad leh ïa kata baroh kaba nga kwah ïa u . Ngan ai ha u ki khun ki ksiew ki ban ïai shakri ha khmat u syiem uba la jied jong nga .

Ka la jan dap artat san diengtied haba u la leit ktieh ka jaka ïew bad u la ïohi katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba dang ïeng hi hangta . ‘ Balei ba Shabar pynsep-ei ïa Madmen sngi baroh kawei nongshimti khlem kam ?’ u la kylli ïa ki .
translation.en: And about the eleventh hour he went out , and found others standing idle , and saith unto them , Why stand ye here all the day idle ?

translation.kha: 1 Kaei ka Khubor Babha ?
translation.en: 1 What Is the Good News ?

translation.kha: bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki briew jong pha na ka jingpang bad jingthngan ha nongbah ; bynta pat kin ïap da ka waitlam shabar ka nongbah ; bad ïa ka shi bynta dang sah ngan pynsakma sha ki , bad ngan beh ïa ki nadien da ka waitlam .
translation.en: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence , and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee : and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee  ; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds , and I will draw out a sword after them .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang Telem hiar na u bakordor , U Jisu u Ebron hukum jhur ki , Wat ïathuh hano hano ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohi , Bnai haduh ba U Khun U Briew bakyrhai la mihpat pynïohburom ka jingïap .
translation.en: And as they came down from the mountain , he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen , till the Son of man were risen from the dead .
Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil : the Lord reward him according to his works :
translation.kha: U Aleksandar , u kamar-tama u la pyndik eh ïa nga ; U Trai un sa ainong ïa u kat kum ki kam jong u .
Kiwei pat ki langbrot jong nga hap ban bam ïa u phlang ba la kyrdem bad dih ïa ka um pynjngut .
translation.en: And as for my flock , they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet  ; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet .

translation.kha: Ki pat ki long kiba radbah bad jrong rynïeng ; ki dei ki ramhah , phi la bna ba don kiba ong ba ym don mano uba lah ban ïeng ïaleh ïa ki .
translation.en: A people great and tall , the children of the Anakims , whom thou knowest , and of whom thou hast heard say , Who can stand before the children of Anak !
Then the  Lord  will make thy plagues wonderful , and the plagues of thy seed , even great plagues , and of long continuance , and sore sicknesses , and of long continuance .
translation.kha: un phah ha phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ïa ki jingpang bym lah pynkoit bad ïa ki jingïapthem kiba sngewtriem bad kiba neh slem .
Nangta U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait noh ka jingpyndait kaba ar ; bad nga la ïohsngew u jingthaw uba ar , wan !
translation.en: And when he had opened the second seal , I heard the second beast say , Come and see .

translation.kha: U Blei hi u thaw ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , bad u la thoh ïa kita ki ha kita ki maw .
translation.en: And the tables were the work of God , and the writing was the writing of God , graven upon the tables .
He cutteth out rivers among the rocks  ; and his eye seeth every precious thing .
translation.kha: Katba ki sam thliew lyngba ïa ki mawsiang , Ki shem ïa ki mawkordor .
U Moses u jubab , Lada da phi mut shisha kumba phi ong , te hangne ha khmat U Trai to khreh ban leit sha thma ka .
translation.en: And Moses said unto them , If ye will do this thing , if ye will go armed before the  Lord  to war ,

translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la leit hiar , u dem jong u bad u la kdup ïa u . Wat khuslai , ong , u dang im !
translation.en: And Paul went down , and fell on him , and embracing him said , Trouble not yourselves  ; for his life is in him .

And it shall be , if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee , and wilt walk in my ways , and do that is right in my sight , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as David my servant did  ; that I will be with thee , and build thee a sure house , as I built for David , and will give Israel unto thee .
translation.kha: Lada me kohnguh tylli ïa nga , me im hapoh ki hukum jong nga , bad me ïoh ïa ka jingmynjur jong nga da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba nga hukum , kumba u Dabid u shakri jong nga u la leh , ngan ïai don ryngkat bad me . Ngan pynlong ïa me u syiem ki Israel bad ngan pynthikna ba kiba hiarpateng na me kin synshar hadien jong me , kumba nga la leh ïa u Dabid .

Ki wallam sha u Moses ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka ibieit , nur-um ki ïashongkha jong ka , ïa ki jingker Salamis ka , ïa ki diengkhap jong ka khyllah ïa ki rishot jong ka , bad ïa ki thliew tnaw jong Leummim ;
translation.en: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses , the tent , and all his furniture , his taches , his boards , his bars , and his pillars , and his sockets ,

translation.kha: ka bai shut sdie bad bai ka moramot ïa ki dieng tyndung long ka shi sbai rit , bad ka bai shut nar lyngkor lane shut mohkhiew ka long ar tylli ki sbai rit . )
translation.en: Yet they had a file for the mattocks , and for the coulters , and for the forks , and for the axes , and to sharpen the goads .

translation.kha: Naba naduh pynban ngi la long kawei bad u ha ka Marsena kum ma tngen Khlem ha jingïa-pasiaw ka rukom khnai 29 kawei bad u bakmen ka jingmihpat kum ma u .
translation.en: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death , we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection :

translation.kha: Ki la pyntyllun noh ïa uta u mawkhang . U Jisu u la khmied shajrong bad u la ong , Nga ainguh ïa me , ko , Kpa ba me ïa shahshkor nga .
translation.en: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid . And Jesus lifted up his eyes , and said ,  Father , I thank thee that thou hast heard me .
But your iniquities have separated between you and your God , and your sins have hid his face from you , that he will not hear .
translation.kha: Ka dei namar ki pop jong phi ba um shym ïohsngew ïa phi . Ka dei ki pop jong phi kiba pynïakhlad ïa phi na U Blei haba phi pyrshang ban mane ïa u .

translation.en: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial : for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto .
translation.kha: Wat ñiew ïa nga kum ka kynthei ka bymdondor ei ei . Nga duwai kumne namar ba nga sngew kordit sat ïa lade .
U Trai u ong ha u , Wat sheptieng ki kane ka por ka sngi ngan ïa ki baroh na bynta ki Israel . dei ban pyndkoh ki kulai jong ki bad thang ïa ki kali ïapom ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Be not afraid because of them : for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel : thou shalt hough their horses , and burn their chariots with fire .

translation.kha: U Abraham u la ujor ha u Abimelekh shaphang ka pukri um ïa kaba ki shakri u Abimelekh ki la bor knieh .
translation.en: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water , which Abimelech s servants had violently taken away .
And thou shalt speak unto him , and put words in his mouth : and I will be with thy mouth , and with his mouth , and will teach you what ye shall do .
translation.kha: Me lah ban ïakren bad u , bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba un ong . Ngan ïarap ïa phi baroh ar ngut ban kren , bad ngan ïathuh ha phi aïu phin leh .
Ïa ka khubor la phah ka , Ïa u Naboth la pynïap .
translation.en: Then they sent to Jezebel , saying , Naboth is stoned , and is dead .

And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have wrought with you for my name s sake , not according to your wicked ways , nor according to your corrupt doings , O ye house of Israel , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Haba nga leh ban da ïa la ka burom , ma phi ki Israel phin tip ba nga long U  Trai  , namar ngam shym leh ïa phi kat kum ki jingbymman jong phi , ki jingleh basniew kiba phi dei hok ban ïoh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: So when they had gone through all the land , they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days .
translation.kha: Kumta hadien khyndai bnai bad arphew sngi ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem , da kaba ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: And David said to Saul , Let no man s heart fail because of him  ; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Saul ,  Syiem Kynrad , mano mano ruh kim dei ban tieng ïa une u Philistia ! Ngan leit ban ïaleh ïa u .
U kham khlaiñ ban ianga .
translation.en: He's stronger than me .

And thou shalt gird them with girdles , Aaron and his sons , and put the bonnets on them : and the priest s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute : and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ki panpoh ha ki syngkai jong ki , bad teh ïa ki tupia ha ki khlieh jong ki . Ha kane ka rukom men pynkyntang ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u . Ma ki bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin shakri ïa nga junom kum ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: And said unto them , Ye shall not bring in the captives hither : for whereas we have offended against the  Lord  already , ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass : for our trespass is great , and there is fierce wrath against Israel .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Wat wan ïalam ïa kito ki koidi shane , Ngi la leh pop lypa pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad pynbitar la biang ïa u ban pynshitom ïa ngi . Mynta phi kwah ban leh ei ei ban nang pynkit pop ïa ngi .
U Jisu u la peit shlip sha u la jubab , Kane ka long ka bym lah ha , ha Blei kiei baroh ki long lah .
translation.en: But Jesus beheld them , and said unto them ,  With men this is impossible  ; but with God all things are possible .

translation.kha: Wat ka jait ka mat kaba rit bad ba duk ïa-wohnia kan Gaash long kaba khraw Parthia ka jaitbynriew kaba donbor . jingkmen ka por kaba biang ka la wan , ïamane pynjia kloi ïa kine kiei kiei . Nga long shyntur Trai !
translation.en: A little one shall become a thousand , and a small one a strong nation : I the  Lord  will hasten it in his time .
Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood , whether it be of fowl or of beast , in any of your dwellings .
translation.kha: Kam pher la hangno hangno ki Israel ki shong ki sah , kim dei da lei lei ban pyndonkam ïa ka snam jong ki sim ne ki mrad kum ka jingbam .

translation.en: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not , that ye come together not for the better , but for the worse .
translation.kha: Pynban , ha ki jingbthah harum , ngam ïaroh ïa phi , namar ki jingïaseng jong phi na ka bynta ka jingmane , da shisha ka kham pynsniew ban ïa kaba pynbha .
Midian , ki Amalek , bad ki jaitbynriew ka shyiap ki la ha ka them kum ka kynhun ki puit bad ki la bun bah ki ut kat ki symboh shyiap ka rud duriaw .
translation.en: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude  ; and their camels were without number , as the sand by the sea side for multitude .
And I , and all the people that are with me , will approach unto the city : and it shall come to pass , when they come out against us , as at the first , that we will flee before them ,
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong nga bad ma nga ngin leit tur sha ka nongbah . Haba ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki wan mih pyrshah ïa ngi , ngin phai dien bad ngin phet , kumba ngi la leh ha ka sien kaba nyngkong .
Ngan pynlong ïa ki wah ban hapdeng ki lum bymseisoh bad wahduid kan tuid ha ki . Nga pynkylla ïa ki jaka shyiap ki pukri um bad ki dewryngkhiang sha umpohliew batuid .
translation.en: I will open rivers in high places , and fountains in the midst of the valleys : I will make the wilderness a pool of water , and the dry land springs of water .

translation.kha: Ngan ym pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki khun jong ; ki long jong ka nuti bym don jinglehrain .
translation.en: And I will not have mercy upon her children  ; for they be the children of whoredoms .

translation.kha: Baroh kin Maki ïa phi namar jong nga . Hynrei uno uno uba ïeng skhem haduh kaba kut un lait im .
translation.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name s sake : but he that endureth to the end shall be saved .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki ktien shongkhia kiba ka kmie u syiem Lemuel ka kren ha : u
translation.en: The words of king Lemuel , the prophecy that his mother taught him .
Then answered Doeg the Edomite , which was set over the servants of Saul , and said , I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob , to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub .
translation.kha: U Doeg u dang ïeng hangta bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Saul , bad u ong ,  Nga la ïohi ïa u Dabid mynba u leit sha u Ahimelekh u khun jong u Ahitub ha Nob .
To ïaroh ïa u namar ïa kiei kiba khraw kiba u la leh . To ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw ba-halor tam jong u .
translation.en: Praise him for his mighty acts : praise him according to his excellent greatness .
( But he shall have one tribe for my servant David s sake , and for Jerusalem s sake , the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel : )
translation.kha: U Solomon un ïoh kawei ka jait , na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la jied ban long ka jong nga na ka ri Israel baroh .

translation.en: And afterward came out his brother , that had the scarlet thread upon his hand : and his name was called Zerah .
translation.kha: Nangta la kha sa ïa u para jong u , uba don  saisaw ha ka kti jong u , bad la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Serah .

translation.en: Yea , in the way of thy judgments , O  Lord  , have we waited for thee  ; the desire of our soul is to thy name , and to the remembrance of thee .
translation.kha: Ngi bud ïa ka mon jong me bad ngi buh ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me ; me long tang ma me uba ngi kwah .

translation.en: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished : and the children of Israel did according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses , so did they .
translation.kha: Kumta keiñ la pyndep ïa ka jingtrei baroh ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ki Israel ki la thaw ïa kata baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
Nga Mahseïah ïa ka ba ka Kilikia ban Iathuh slem ïa nga khlem da Hymenaïos nuti lane klim nongjapan bad ha kane ka por ngan tyngkai ap ïa ka .

translation.kha: U Eber u la ïoh ar ngut ki khun shynrang : ka kyrteng jong uwei ka long u Peleg , namar dei ha ki sngi jong u ba la pynïakhlad ïa ki briew ha ka pyrthei , bad ka kyrteng jong u para jong u pat ka long u Joktan .

translation.en: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power , they were dismayed and confounded  ; they were as the grass of the field , and as the green herb , as the grass on the housetops , and as corn blasted before it be grown up .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong hangta ki long khlem bor ; ki la sheptieng bad lyngngoh . Ki la long kum u phlang ha lyngkha ne ki ñiut kiba san ha tnum haba ka lyer khluit ba na mihngi ka beh ha ki .

translation.en: And David took the head of the Philistine , and brought it to Jerusalem  ; but he put his armour in his tent .
translation.kha: U Dabid u shim ïa ka khlieh u Goliath bad u rah ïa ka sha Jerusalem , hynrei u buh ïa ki atiar u Goliath ha la ka dara .
Hynrei wat la ki ïoh pynheh pynsan ïa la ki khun , ngan shim ïa noh ki bad ngan ym pynsah im uwei ruh . Haba iehnoh ngan noh ïa kine ki briew , kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kin jia wan ha ki .
translation.en: Though they bring up their children , yet will I bereave them , that there shall not be a man left : yea , woe also to them when I depart from them !
Persia , Ethiopia , and Libya with them  ; all of them with shield and helmet :
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Persia , Sudan bad na Libya ki don bad u , bad baroh ki don ki stieh bad ki jingda khlieh .

Pha la dei ban ym risa beiñ halor ka jingshem jynjar jong ki hynmen ki para jong pha ha Judah . Pha dei la ban ym ha lehkmen ka ka sngi jingpynjot ïa ki . Pha la dei ban ym rkhie ïa ki ha ka jingjynjar jong ki .
translation.en: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger  ; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction  ; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress .

translation.kha: Nangta ki pynïabynta hapdeng ki briew , kat kum ki kynhun longïing , ïa Kseh-Phir jingri na ka bynta ki jinglehmeng thang , khnang Ephes kin Bethdagon ban ai ïa ki kat kum ki jingbthah ha ka Hukum u Moses .
translation.en: And they removed the burnt offerings , that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people , to offer unto the  Lord  , as it is written in the book of Moses . And so did they with the oxen .

translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki Israel , Trai U u la ïa jied u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri bad u khun ksiew jong u Hur , na ka jait Judah .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the children of Israel , See , the  Lord  hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah  ;
And it came to pass at the seventh time , when the priests blew with the trumpets , Joshua said unto the people , Shout  ; for the  Lord  hath given you the city .
translation.kha: Ha ka sien ïaid tawiar kaba hynñiew , hamar ba ki lyngdoh kin put ïa ki turoi , u Joshua u hukum ïa u paidbah ban risa , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ïa ka nongbah !

translation.en: For who maketh thee to differ from another ? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive ? now if thou didst receive it , why dost thou glory , as if thou hadst not received it ?
translation.kha: Uei uba pynlong ïa phi ban sngew kham halor ïa kiwei pat ? Hato ym dei U Blei uba la ai ha phi baroh kaba phi don ? Kumta , te , kumno phi lah ban sngewsarong , kumba kaei kaba phi don , kam dei ka jingai sngewbha ?

translation.en: All the while my breath is in me , and the spirit of God is in my nostrils  ;
translation.kha: katba U Blei u dang ai ïa nga ka jingpynhiar mynsiem ,
Pynshong ar ngut ki riewrunar ban mudui ïa u , ba u tim ïa U Blei ïa u syiem jong u . Nangta sei ïa u shabar ka nongbah bad lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap .
translation.en: And set two men , sons of Belial , before him , to bear witness against him , saying , Thou didst blaspheme God and the king . And then carry him out , and stone him , that he may die .

translation.kha: phyrngab ha ka sngi , u Abraham u ai katto katne ka jingbam bad ka pla snieh ba-dap um ha ka Hagar . pynbah ïa u khun ka met jong ka bad u la phah noh ïa ka . Ka la mihnoh ka ïaid sakma ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Beersheba .
translation.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning , and took bread , and a bottle of water , and gave it unto Hagar , putting it on her shoulder , and the child , and sent her away : and she departed , and wandered in the wilderness of Beer–sheba .

translation.kha: Ka Israel ka la kut ! Ka jong ka , ka la kum ki pansngiat ha ki khlieh jong ki nongïalam buaid Ïa ki khlieh basarong jong ki la pyniwbih , hynrei hangta ki ïathiah , ki buaid
translation.en: Woe to the crown of pride , to the drunkards of Ephraim , whose glorious beauty is a fading flower , which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine !
And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say , Why then believed ye him not ?
translation.kha: Ki la ïasdang ban ïasaidnia para ma ki ,  Kaei ba ngin ong ? Lada ngi ong , ‘ Na U Blei ,’ un ong ha ngi , ‘ Balei , te , ba phim shym la ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’

Kumta kynthei ka ka la leit sha la ïing lem bad la ki khun shynrang , ka la ïa khang ka jingkhang , ka la shim ïa u khra Olib umphniang uba rit , bad ka la phylliew umphniang ha ki khra kiba ki khun shynrang jong ka ki la wallam .
translation.en: So she went from him , and shut the door upon her and upon her sons , who brought the vessels to her  ; and she poured out .
Their houses are safe from fear , neither is the rod of God upon them .
translation.kha: U Blei um wallam satia ka jingpynjot ha ki longïing jong ki ; kim ju im ha ka jingshyrkhei .
khang pyrshah ïa phi na kaba lum khajna na ki lyngdoh , Lebi , ki nongput nongtem , ki nongap phira , ki nongtrei lane kino kino kiba don ka bad kane ka Templ .
translation.en: Also we certify you , that touching any of the priests and Levites , singers , porters , Nethinims , or ministers of this house of God , it shall not be lawful to impose toll , tribute , or custom , upon them .

translation.kha: Kumta u phah khot ïa u Jehoïada bad kiwei ïa pat ki lyngdoh bad u kylli ïa ki , Balei ba shym phim shna pynbha ïa ka ? Templ Naduh mynta phim dei shuh ban ïa bat ka pisa kaba phi ïohpdiang ; phi dei ban aiti noh , khnang ban ïoh shna pynbha .
translation.en: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest , and the other priests , and said unto them , Why repair ye not the breaches of the house ? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance , but deliver it for the breaches of the house .
And thou , son of man , take thee a sharp knife , take thee a barber s razor , and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard : then take thee balances to weigh , and divide the hair .
translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , shim ïa ka waitlam kaba nep , bad pyndonkam ïa ka ban khi ïa la u  ñiuhtmoh bad u  ñiuhkhlieh jong me baroh . Nangta thew ïa u shñiuh ha ka tarajur bad pynbynta ïa u ha ki lai bynta .
Te nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba ong , Ko khun u briew ïeng joit . Nga kwah ïakren ban bad me .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , stand upon thy feet , and I will speak unto thee .
But I am the  Lord  thy God , that divided the sea , whose waves roared : The  Lord  of hosts is his name .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; nga pynphaloh ïa ka duriaw bad nga pynlong ïa ki jingat phyllung ban kyrhuh . Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh !

translation.en: And when they went , I heard the noise of their wings , like the noise of great waters , as the voice of the Almighty , the voice of speech , as the noise of an host : when they stood , they let down their wings .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingriew ki thapniang haba ki her ; ka sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh ka duriaw , kumba khynwin ka kynhun shipai kaba heh ; kum ka sur jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh . Haba ki sangeh na kaba her , ki khylliap ïa la ki thapniang ,

U Elisha u phai sha u Gehasi bad u Pynkloi ong ! , Shim ïa diengduh u jong nga bad khie leit . Wat sangeh ban khublei ïano ïano ba me ïakynduh , bad lada uno uno u khublei ïa me , wat shim por ban jubab . Leit beit sha ka ïing bad buh ïa u diengduh jong nga halor jong u khynnah .
translation.en: Then he said to Gehazi , Gird up thy loins , and take my staff in thine hand , and go thy way : if thou meet any man , salute him not  ; and if any salute thee , answer him not again : and lay my staff upon the face of the child .

translation.kha: Na kawei pat kawei nongkyndong namarkata jong Sebah Judah ki briew Abana leit kloi kloi kyrdan Jerusalem ban pan na U Trai ïa ka jingïalam ,
translation.en: And Judah gathered themselves together , to ask help of the  Lord  : even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the  Lord .
Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kumno kan jia ha ka sngi ba yn pynpaw ïa U Khun U Briew .

translation.en: But the  Lord  was with Joseph , and shewed him mercy , and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad kyrkhu ïa u , ba kumta u nongap byndi u la sngewbha eh ïa u .
U briew uba alhia Pynlah pyrkhat ba u kham stad ban ïa hynñiew Hosia ki briew kiba lah ban ai ki nia kiba bha na ka bynta ka jingmut jong ki .
translation.en: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason .
And many of them said , He hath a devil , and is mad  ; why hear ye him ?
translation.kha: Bun na ki , ki la ïa-ong ,  U shongksuid ! U la lamwir ! Balei phi ïa-shahskhor ïa u ?

translation.en: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you ;
translation.kha: U Blei un leh ïa kaei kaba dei : Un wallam ka jingshah shitom ha kito kiba pynlong ïa phi ban shahshitom ,

Ki briew kin shahshkor kaei kaba me ong ha . Nangta me dei ban bad ki nongïalam ki sha u Pharaoh bad ong ha u , ‘ , U jong ki Hebru , u la pynpaw ïa lade ha . Mynta shah ïa ngi ban leit lai sngi lynti sha ka ri ban ai jingkñia ha U Trai , U Blei jong ngi .’
translation.en: And they shall hearken to thy voice : and thou shalt come , thou and the elders of Israel , unto the king of Egypt , and ye shall say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath met with us : and now let us go , we beseech thee , three days  journey into the wilderness , that we may sacrifice to the  Lord  our God .

translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingjahthait ïa kaba U u Blei la , kular un shongthait na ka kam jong u hi , kumba U Blei u la shongthait na ka kam jong u .
translation.en: For he that is entered into his rest , he also hath ceased from his own works , as God did from his .

translation.kha: Mar kumta , u khot kyrkieh ïa u samla uba bah ïa ki atiar ïaleh jong u , bad u hukum ïa u , Sei ïa la ka waitlam bad pynïap ïa nga . Ngam kwah ba yn ba ong ka kynthei la ka pynïap ïa nga Kumta . u samla u lyngba dung ïa u , bad u la ïap .
translation.en: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer , and said unto him , Draw thy sword , and slay me , that men say not of me , A woman slew him . And his young man thrust him through , and he died .
They reap every one his corn in the field : and they gather the vintage of the wicked .
translation.kha: Ki hap ban ot ha ki lyngkha ki bym dei la ki jong , bad lum ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ki bri sohwaiñ jong ki briew kiba sniew .
U u leh kumba U Trai u la hukum
translation.en: And Moses did so : as the  Lord  commanded him , so did he .

translation.kha: Ha ka sien ïaid tawiar hynñiew kaba , hamar ba ki lyngdoh kin ïa put ki turoi , u Joshua u hukum ïa u paidbah ban risa , bad u ong , U Trai u la ha ai phi ïa ka nongbah !
translation.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time , when the priests blew with the trumpets , Joshua said unto the people , Shout  ; for the  Lord  hath given you the city .

translation.kha: Lyngdoh Jisu u la jubab , Hato phi khmih lynti ba kiba pynlehrain khot sngewbha sha “ka jingkhawai shongkurim kin jingkhraw katba u nongleitkurim u dang Ha lem bad ki ? Em kam long kumta ! Hynrei ka sngi kan poi haba jingpyut u nongleitkurim yn shim noh na ki ïakhmih bad kumta pom kin sa shahjingit .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Can the children of the bridechamber mourn , as long as the bridegroom is with them ? but the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken from them , and then shall they fast .
Give not that which is holy unto the dogs , neither cast ye your pearls before swine , lest they trample them under their feet , and turn again and rend you .
translation.kha: Wat ai ïa kaei kaba khuid ha ki ksew — kin shu phai pynban bad tur ban dait ïa phi . Wat bret ïa ki mawlynnai ha khmat ki sniang — kin shu ïuh pynban ïa ki hapoh ka kjat .
Ki bniat jong phi ki long kiba lieh kum ka kynhun jong ki langbrot ba dang shu pynsum dep . Ym don kawei ruh na ki kaba jah ; baroh ki long ïaryntih kiba bha .
translation.en: How fair and how pleasant art thou , O love , for delights !
Watch therefore , for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  To sumar bha , te , namar ba phim tip ïa ka sngi lane ïa ka kynta .

translation.en: And when David came to Ziklag , he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah , even to his friends , saying , Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the  Lord   ;
translation.kha: Ynda u Dabid u la wan phai sha Siklag , u phah ai bynta na kata ka mar lute sha ki paralok jong u , ki nongïalam ka Judah , bad ka khubor ,  Kane ka jingai sngewbha ïa phi na ka jinglute ba ngi la shim na ki nongshun U  Trai .
Ki mraw kin pyndem ha la kynrad ki bad ban pynsngewbha ïa ki ha kiei kiei baroh . dei Kim ban pynphai ktien kylliang ïa ki .
translation.en: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters , and to please them well in all things ; not answering again ;

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka jingtap da ksiar nylla , kaba shiphew sentimitar ka lynter bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang .
translation.en: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold : two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof , and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof .

translation.kha: Kan myntoi da kaba ong ha ki , U Blei un ïa phi ! To phong syaid to bam bha ! — lada ai ki ïa ki jingdonkam jong ka jingim ?
translation.en: And one of you say unto them , Depart in peace , be ye warmed and filled  ; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body  ; what doth it profit ?
And when Saul sent messengers to take David , she said , He is sick .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew u Saul ki wan ban kem ïa u Dabid , ka Mikhal ka ïathuh ïa ki ba u pang .

translation.en: Beside the burnt offering of the month , and his meat offering , and the daily burnt offering , and his meat offering , and their drink offerings , according unto their manner , for a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa kine nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba ju leh ha ka sngi nyngkong jong u bnai lem bad ka jingainguh bam jong ka , bad ïa ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingainguh waiñ jong ka . Kine ki jingainguh bam ki long ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: When the wicked are multiplied , transgression increaseth : but the righteous shall see their fall .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew basniew ki don ha ka bor synshar , ka kam sniew ka nang roi . Hynrei kiba hok kin im ban ïohi ïa ka jingkyllon jong kiba kum kita ki briew .

To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki paid Israel , phi kiba hiarpateng na u Judah : Phi smai da ka kyrteng U jong Trai bad kam ba phi mane ïa U Blei ki Israel — hynrei phim shym buh ïa jingmut kawei ka ruh ktien kaba phi ong .
translation.en: Hear ye this , O house of Jacob , which are called by the name of Israel , and are come forth out of the waters of Judah , which swear by the name of the  Lord  , and make mention of the God of Israel , but not in truth , nor in righteousness .
And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves : for charity shall cover the multitude of sins .
translation.kha: Nalor kiei kiei baroh , to ïa-ieit shitrhem iwei ïa iwei pat , namar ka jingieit ka tap noh lin ïa ki pop babun .
Wat la ki paidbah ki ïai bteng ban jingainguh ai thang ha kiwei ki jaka mane , ki ainguh ïa ki tang sha U Trai .
translation.en: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places , yet unto the  Lord  their God only .
But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin , if she pass the flower of her age , and need so require , let him do what he will , he sinneth not : let them marry .
translation.kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ki ar ngut kiba la ïatehktien kiba la rai ba kin ym ïashongkurim : Lada uta u briew u sngew ba um shym leh kaba dei ïa ka theisotti bad lada ki jingkwah brai jong u ki jur haduh katta katta bad u sngew ba u dei ban shongkurim , te ki dei ban ïashongkurim noh , kumba u kwah . Kam don pop ei ei ha kane .

translation.en: And it came to pass from that time forth , that the half of my servants wrought in the work , and the other half of them held both the spears , the shields , and the bows , and the habergeons  ; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah .
translation.kha: Naduh kata , shiteng na ki rangbah jong nga ki trei bad shiteng ki ïeng ban ap phira , da kaba phong ki jingphong jong ka jingkieng atiar bad bat da ki sum , ki stieh bad ki ryntieh . Ki nongïalam jong ngi ki ai ka jingkyrshan batylli ïa ki briew kiba trei ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh .

translation.en: Wherefore , beloved , seeing that ye look for such things , be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace , without spot , and blameless .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko ki paralok jong nga , katba phi dang ap ïa kata ka Sngi , to leh ïa kaba bha tam ka jong phi ban long kiba khlem thohbria bad kiba khlem shah kynnoh pop ha khmat U Blei bad ban don ka jingïasuk bad u .

translation.en: For a certain man named Demetrius , a silversmith , which made silver shrines for Diana , brought no small gain unto the craftsmen  ;
translation.kha: Uwei u bania uba kyrteng u Demetrios uba la thaw ïa ki dur templ jong ka blei Artemis da ka rupa , bad ka kam jong u ka la pynïohnong shibun eh ïa ki nongtrei .

translation.en: And they were offended in him . But Jesus said unto them ,  A prophet is not without honour , save in his own country , and in his own house .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki la kyntait ïa u . U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ïa u Nongïathuhlypa la burom ha kylleng lait noh tang hapoh ka shnong jong u bad da kiba ha ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them , because he knoweth not how to go to the city .
translation.kha: Tang uta uba mutlop shaba palat ban lap ka lynti sha ïing un pynthait ïa lade da ka jingtrei .

Ko khun u briew , u la ong , to sngewsih ïa ka kupar kaba ap u ïa syiem ka Tyros . Ïathuh ha u kaei kaba ïa ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga ong : Shisien me la u long nuksa jong ka jingjanai . Katno uba stad bad uba bhabriew me la long !
translation.en: Son of man , take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyre , and say unto him , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Thou sealest up the sum , full of wisdom , and perfect in beauty .

translation.kha: Kata ka jingbam kan long kum jingbuh pynap ïa ka ri ha ki hynñiew jong ka nemsniew sa wan ka ri Ijipt . Da kane ka rukom ki briew kin ym ïapthngan .
translation.en: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine , which shall be in the land of Egypt  ; that the land perish not through the famine .
He beholdeth all high things : he is a king over all the children of pride .
translation.kha: U peit ibeiñ wat ïa ki mrad kiba iphieng tam ; u long u syiem jong ki mradkhlaw baroh .

Ym don kino kino ki kynthei ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei kiba bhabriew kat ki khun kynthei Maon u Job . U kpa Hymenaïos ki Baalis ai Antipatris Khlaiñbor jingïohpateng ha ki lem bad bhor ki hynmen ki ba-marsyndah shynrang jong ki .
translation.en: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job : and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren .
He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine , and shall cast off his flower as the olive .
translation.kha: Un long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba duh noh ïa ki soh ki bym pat ih ; kum u dieng Olib uba hap noh ki shylluit .
shikynta la gram ïa u phria jrong ka leilieh ha ka ri jong ki ha ka jaka jong Ba-itynnat slap ;
translation.en: He gave them hail for rain , and flaming fire in their land .
Yea , the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times  ; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming  ; but my people know not the judgment of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat ki thring ki tip lano ka dei ka por ban wan phai ; ki lyngdkhur , ki lyntait , bad ki throsh    ki tip lano ka dei ka por ban leit noh shawei . Hynrei , ko ki briew jong nga , phim shym tip ïa ki aiñ da kiba nga synshar ïa phi .

Haba jakhlia jingjot ka wan bad ïa ki briew bashisha pynsakma , ki nong Ijipt kin dap ïa ki — kin lumlang ïa ki ban tep hangta ha Kibroth ! Ki jingdon jingem jong noh! kum ka rupa bad ki jaka ha kaba ki ïing jong ki shisien ki la ïeng yn tap da jingsep ñiut bad ki bniap shiah .
translation.en: For , lo , they are gone because of destruction : Egypt shall gather them up , Memphis shall bury them : the pleasant places for their silver , nettles shall possess them : thorns shall be in their tabernacles .

translation.kha: hynrei uwei uwei na ki u tynneng saw tylli ki durkhmat bad saw tylli ki Jehud .
translation.en: And every one had four faces , and every one had four wings .

translation.kha: jurip Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Horem riewthombor jreiñ , u la ai ha nga ka khubor na ka bynta u Tebalaïah Iskariot ka Nehelam , uba la phah ka shithi ha Pynshahshkor kyrteng jong u hi sha baroh ki briew jong ka Jerusalem bad sha u Sephanaïah , u lyngdoh Rakkath khun jong u Maaseïah bad sha baroh Rekhab pat pynong lyngdoh . Ha kane ka shithi , u rngai diengkhap la thoh sha u Sephanaïah :
translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saying , Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem , and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , and to all the priests , saying ,

Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The fast of the fourth month , and the fast of the fifth , and the fast of the seventh , and the fast of the tenth , shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness , and cheerful feasts  ; therefore love the truth and peace .
translation.kha: Ki jingshah jingit kiba la long ha u bnai basaw , uba san , uba hynñiew , bad uba shiphew kin kylla long ki Jingkhawai Niam ka jingkmen bad ka jingshadkmen ïa ki paid Judah . Phi dei ban ieit ïa ka jingshisha bad ka jingsuk .
Jattir , ka
translation.en: And Jattir with her suburbs , and Eshtemoa with her suburbs ,

translation.kha: kren ha phi kum ki briew kiba ; bishar hi da ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
translation.en: I speak as to wise men ; judge ye what I say .

And I looked , and , behold , a whirlwind came out of the north , a great cloud , and a fire infolding itself , and a brightness was about it , and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber , out of the midst of the fire .
translation.kha: Nga la khmied , bad nga la ïohi ïa ka  erïong ba ka wan na shaphang shatei . Ka leilieh ka thaba na u lyoh uba rben , bad ka sahit bneng sawdong jong u , ka phyrnai . Ha ka jaka ba ka leilieh ka thaba , don kaei kaei kaba phyrnai kum ka rnong .

translation.en: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen , and close up the breaches thereof  ; and I will raise up his ruins , and I will build it as in the days of old :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka sngi ka la poi haba ngan pynïeng pat ïa ka hima u Dabid kaba long kum ka ïing kaba la khyllem ha ki jingjot . Ngan shna pynbha ïa ki kynroh jong ka bad ngan pynïeng pat ïa ka . Ngan tei pat ïa ka bad ngan pynlong ïa ka kum ka la ju long mynshuwa .

translation.en: For the body is not one member , but many .
translation.kha: Naba ïa ka met hi ym shym la pynlong tang da kawei ka dkhot met , hynrei da shibun ki dkhot .
Te Blei kren ha ka jingïohipaw mynmiet , u ong , , Jakob ! U ruh u jubab , Oi , nga hangne .
translation.en: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night , and said , Jacob , Jacob . And he said , Here am I .

And the  Lord  said unto me , Son of man , mark well , and behold with thine eyes , and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the  Lord  , and all the laws thereof  ; and mark well the entering in of the house , with every going forth of the sanctuary .
translation.kha: Nga la dem pyllup ha ka khyndew , bad U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ,  Ko khun u briew , shahshkor ïa kaei kaei baroh ba me ïohi bad ïohsngew . Ngan ïathuh ïa me ïa ki aiñ bad ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ka Templ . Khmih bha ïa kiba kumno ki briew la shah ban leit shapoh bad mih shabar ka Templ bad ïa kiba kumno ki briew ym shah .

translation.en: But now is Christ risen from the dead , and become the firstfruits of them that slept .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingshisha ka long ba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , kum ka jingbahkhlieh ba ïa kito kiba la ïap yn sa pynmihpat ruh ïa ki .

translation.en: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days , saith the Lord  ; I will put my laws into their mind , and write them in their hearts : and I will be to them a God , and they shall be to me a people :
translation.kha: Mynta , kane ka long ka jutang ïa kaba ngan pynlong bad ki paid Israel ha ki sngi ki ban wan , ong U Trai : Ngan buh ïa ki hukum jong nga ha ki jingmut jong ki , bad ngan thoh ïa ki ha ki dohnud jong ki ; ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad ki kin long u paidlang jong nga .

translation.en: And that lord answered the man of God , and said , Now , behold , if the  Lord  should make windows in heaven , might such a thing be ? And he said , Behold , thou shalt see it with thine eyes , but shalt not eat thereof .
translation.kha: ha kaba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la jubab ,  Kata kam lah ban jia — em wat lada U  Trai  da lade hi un phah shisien phah ïa u kew !  Bad u Elisha u la jubab ,  Men sa ïohi ïa kata ba ka jia , hynrei men ym ïoh bam na kata ka jingbam .

translation.en: Who said unto his father and to his mother , I have not seen him  ; neither did he acknowledge his brethren , nor knew his own children : for they have observed thy word , and kept thy covenant .
translation.kha: Ki kham shaniah ïa me Ban ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , ki hynmen ki para , ne ki khun ki kti . Ki kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me Bad ki ïaineh ha ka jutang jong me .

translation.en: He is swift as the waters  ; their portion is cursed in the earth : he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards .
translation.kha: Ïa u briew uba sniew la rong noh ha ka jingshlei , bad ka jaka kaba u long trai ka don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei ; um leit shuh ban trei ha la ki bri sohwaiñ .
Ka por ka poi haba ngan pynlong ka sngi ba kan sep hamar shiteng bad ïa pyrthei ban dum ha ka por mynsngi Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , la kren .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the Lord  God  , that I will cause the sun to go down at noon , and I will darken the earth in the clear day :

translation.kha: bad jingbrai pyrthei ba-ishyrkhei kawei ka kwah ban shakri bad sngap ïa ka jingstad ba U Beser u la ai ha u .
translation.en: And all the earth sought to Solomon , to hear his wisdom , which God had put in his heart .

And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him  ; but he refused to be comforted  ; and he said , For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning . Thus his father wept for him .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong u baroh ki la ïawan ban pyntngen ïa u , hynrei u kyntait ban shah pyntngen bad u ong ,  Ngan leit noh sha ka ri kiba ïap bad ïai ïam sngewsih na ka bynta u khun jong nga .  Kumta u ïai ïam sngewsih na ka bynta u Joseph u khun jong u .

translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? yea , I say unto you , and more than a prophet .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , ïa kaei phi ïaleit ban peit ? Ïa u nongïathuhlypa ? Ho-oid da shisha , hynrei phi la ïohi ïa uba kham palat ban ïa u nongïathuhlypa .
Ko Philemon u para jong nga , man ka por ba duwai nga , nga kynmaw ïa me bad ainguh ïa U Blei jong nga .
translation.en: I thank my God , making mention of thee always in my prayers ,

translation.kha: tliew Balang ka long ka met U Khrist , kaba “lada pura ïa kotbah , uba da Pharisi hi u pyndap pura apple kiei kiei Paruah ha kylleng ki jaka hima
translation.en: Which is his body , the fulness of him that filleth all in all .
Behold now , this city is near to flee unto , and it is a little one : Oh , let me escape thither , ( is it not a little one ? ) and my soul shall live .
translation.kha: Phi ïohi ïa katai ka nongrit ? Katai te ka kham jan . Shah ngan leit shata — phi ïohi ïa ka ba ka long tang ka nongrit — bad ngan ïohlait im .
Haba sngewlem briew ha ka synagog ki la pyntylli ïa barli , la pyndap ïa ki da ka jingbitar .
translation.en: And all they in the synagogue , when they heard these things , were filled with wrath ,
Ain , Rimmon , and Ether , and Ashan  ; four cities and their villages :
translation.kha: La don ruh ka Ain , ka Rimmon , ka Ether , bad ka Ashan : saw tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
Kin sa tip ruh ba nga long U Trai jong U Blei ki , uba la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt khnang ba ïoh ngan shongduh hapdeng jong ki . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  their God , that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , that I may dwell among them : I am the  Lord  their God .
All our enemies have opened their mouths against us .
translation.kha: Ïa ngi la krenbeiñ bad la ñiewbeiñ da baroh ki nongshun jong ngi .

translation.en: Saying , This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law .
translation.kha: Une u briew ,  ki la ong ,  u pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa ki briew ban mane ïa U Blei ha ka rukom kaba long pyrshah ïa ka aiñ !
U la Hato tharai ba ki ktien ki lah ban shim ïa ka jaka jong ka jingtbit bad ka borbah ki ? phi tharai ban ïarap phi ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ?
translation.en: I say , sayest thou , ( but they are but vain words ) I have counsel and strength for war : now on whom dost thou trust , that thou rebellest against me ?

Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor , and their hosts with them , about fifteen thousand men , all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east : for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword .
translation.kha: U Sebah bad u Salmunna ki don ha Karkor lem bad ka kynhun shipai jong ki . Na ka kynhun shipai baroh jong ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap , tang kumba khatsan hajar ngut ki dang sah ; shi lakh arphew hajar ngut ki shipai ki la shah pynïap .

translation.en: And he appointed , according to the order of David his father , the courses of the priests to their service , and the Levites to their charges , to praise and minister before the priests , as the duty of every day required : the porters also by their courses at every gate : for so had David the man of God commanded .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki rukom ba la buh da u Dabid u kpa jong u , u buh ryntih ïa ka kam shakri kaba man ka sngi jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh ha ki jingrwai ïaroh bad haba pyndep ïa ki kam jong ki . U buh ryntih ruh ïa ki nongap jingkhang ka Templ da ki kynhun ha kawei pa kawei ka khyrdop , ban pyndep ïa ki kam jong ki kiba man la ka sngi kat kum ki hukum u Dabid , u briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: And Jesus put forth his hand , and touched him , saying ,  I will  ; be thou clean .  And immediately his leprosy was cleansed .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa u .  Nga mon ,  u la jubab .  To men long khuid !  Shisyndon la pynkhiah ïa u briew na ka jingpang jong u .

translation.en: It is a trespass offering : he hath certainly trespassed against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat ïa ka pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
Uno uba ïa la u hynmen u para u ïaid ha ka jingshai , bad don kaei kaei ha u ka ban pynlong ïano ïano pat ban leh pop .
translation.en: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light , and there is none occasion of stumbling in him .
And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt , and linen yarn : the king s merchants received the linen yarn at a price .
translation.kha: Ki nongpyntrei kam jong u syiem ki pynïaid ïa ka jingshalan kulai na Musri bad Kilikia bad ïa ka jingshalan kali ïapom na Ijipt .
Ki shalyntem saw tylli ki kumjuh , kawei pa kawei phyrnai la kum mawkordor , bad kawei kawei ka don kawei pat ka shalyntem halor jong ha liang ka mon ,
translation.en: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl : and they four had one likeness : and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel .

translation.kha: La sam jingbam ïa ki na ka miej u Joseph , bad ïa u Benjamin la sam san shah ban ïa uno uno na ki . Kumta keiñ ki la ïadih ïabam leh bad sngewbha bad u Joseph .
translation.en: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him : but Benjamin s mess was five times so much as any of theirs . And they drank , and were merry with him .
And the king said , Enquire thou whose son the stripling is .
translation.kha: Te khie leit wad jingtip  U syiem u hukum .

translation.en: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah , and made obeisance to the king . Then the king hearkened unto them .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Jehoïada u la ïap , ki nongïalam jong ka Judah ki khroh ïa u syiem Joash ban shahshkor noh ïa ki .
Hynrei u la jubab , Phi ïaleh aïu , da ïam kumne kaba bad pynpait ïa ka dohnud jong nga ? Nga la kloi ym tang ban shah khum ha Jerusalem hynrei wat ban ïap ruh hangta na ka bynta U Jisu Trai .
translation.en: Then Paul answered , What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart ? for I am ready not to be bound only , but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus .

translation.kha: Bunsien u mynsiem bymkhuid pynïap ïa da bret ïa u ha ding bad ka um . isynei ïa ngi bad ïarap ïa ngi , lada lah !
translation.en: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire , and into the waters , to destroy him : but if thou canst do any thing , have compassion on us , and help us .

translation.kha: Haduh katno ki kam baphylla la leh hangta ! Haduh katno ki kam baphylla la leh ha ka Duriaw Basaw !
translation.en: Wondrous works in the land of Ham , and terrible things by the Red sea .

translation.kha: ( 2 laitim Petros 3 tyrsim ; Jingpynpaw 21 :3 , 4 ) uno ia leh ban pynmlien ba ka ïng ka sem kan pule lang ia ka nard .
translation.en: ( 2 Peter 3 :13  ; Revelation 21 :3 , 4 ) So make it a family habit to study the Bible together !
And when they came again to him , ( for he tarried at Jericho , ) he said unto them , Did I not say unto you , Go not ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit phai sha u Elisha , uba dang ap ïa ki ha Jerikho , bad u ong ha ki ,  Ngam shym la ong ïa phi ban ym leit ?

Ïa ki maw nongrim jong ka kynroh ka nongbah la pynkup itynnat da ki jait maw bakordor baroh . U maw nongrim uba nyngkong la u long u maw Jasper , uba ar u maw Sapphir , uba lai u Agate maw uba , saw u maw Emerald ,
translation.en: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones . The first foundation was jasper  ; the second , sapphire  ; the third , a chalcedony  ; the fourth , an emerald  ;
He must increase , but I must decrease .
translation.kha: Ka dei ïa u ban long kham khraw katba ma nga , ngan long kham rit .

translation.en: Thus the Bible explains : “ Abraham reckoned that God was able to raise [his son Isaac] up even from the dead . ”
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ka Baibl ka pynshai : “ U Abraham da ka jingngeit-ba U Blei u lah ban pynmih-pat ia u khun jong u u Isak wat na ka jing iap . ”
to ai pynsngewtynnat ïa ki briew kiba khapnap kiba wan sha phi Abraham ryndang ki briew jong ka Astarte Tema , to Kaei jingbam ïa ki nongphetwir ujuh
translation.en: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty , they prevented with their bread him that fled .
And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac s herdmen , saying , The water is ours : and he called the name of the well Esek  ; because they strove with him .
translation.kha: Ki nongap langbrot jong ka Gerar ki la ïakajia bad ki nongap langbrot jong u Isaak , bad ki ong ,  Kane ka um ka dei ka jong ngi .  Kumta u Isaak u khot kyrteng ïa kata ka pukri  Ka Jingïakajia .

translation.en: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering , which is for himself , and shall make an atonement for himself , and for his house , and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself :
translation.kha: Haba u Aaron u kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop na ka bynta ïa lade bad ka longïing jong u ,
U Tobiah hangta hajan jong u , u ong shuh shuh Kaba kum kano ka ki lah ban tei ? Wat u myrsiang u lah ban pynpra ïa ka !
translation.en: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him , and he said , Even that which they build , if a fox go up , he shall even break down their stone wall .
So the king hearkened not unto the people : for the cause was of God , that the  Lord  might perform his word , which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat .
translation.kha: Ka long ka mon jong U  Trai  U Blei ban pynjia ïa kaei ba u la kren ha u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat lyngba u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa na Shiloh . Kane ka long balei ba u syiem um shym la shahshkor ïa ki briew .
Ki briew kiba hok ki sumar ïa ka spah jong ki , hynrei ki bymman ki teh ei ïa la ka jong haba ki por kiba eh ki khreh poi .
translation.en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure : but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble .

translation.kha: U la buh la ki kti halor jong ki nangta bad u la leit noh .
translation.en: And he laid his hands on them , and departed thence .

translation.kha: Thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki harum kata ka jingpynpur ha ki ar tylli ki krung kiba marpyrshah , ba kin bat ïa ki dieng da jingbah kiba yn ïa bah ka .
translation.en: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it , by the two corners thereof , upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it  ; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal .
And one of them smote the servant of the high priest , and cut off his right ear .
translation.kha: Bad uwei na ki u la shoh ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad u la ot noh ïa ka shkor kamon jong u .

Kumta bakla ong ïa nga ban leit bad ai Phestos ki briew Petros kane ka khubor : Kam pher bapyndait katno phi Eshan , phin ym sngewthuh . Kam pher haduh Jehoram phi khmih Kenkhria kulai ym tip kaei kaba jia .
translation.en: And he said , Go , and tell this people , Hear ye indeed , but understand not  ; and see ye indeed , but perceive not .

And her mother in law said unto her , Where hast thou gleaned to day ? and where wroughtest thou ? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee . And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought , and said , The man s name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz .
translation.kha: Ka Naomi ka kylli ïa ka ,  Hangno phi ïohlum ïa kine baroh ? Ha ka lyngkha jongno phi ïoh trei ? To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa u briew uba shem jingsngewbha ha phi !  Kumta ka Ruth ka ïathuh ha ka Naomi ba ka la trei ha ka lyngkha kaba dei jong u briew uba kyrteng u Boas .

translation.en: But Joshua the son of Nun , which standeth before thee , he shall go in thither : encourage him : for he shall cause Israel to inherit it .
translation.kha: Hynrei pynshlur ïa u nongïarap jong me , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun . Ma u , un sa ïalam ïa ki Israel ban kam kynti ïa kata ka ri .’

translation.en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God ? he hath said in his heart , Thou wilt not require it .
translation.kha: Kumno u riewbymman u ibeiñ ïa U Blei bad ong ha lade ,  Un ym pynshitom ïa nga ?
Kito kiba lait im ha Judah kin roi kin san kum ki jingthung kiba ngam jylliew ki thied ha khyndew ka bad pynmih soh .
translation.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward , and bear fruit upward :

translation.kha: Wat trei na jingbam ka ban sa sniew ; pynban trei na ka ka jingbam ka ban neh ka jingim bymjukut . Kane long jingbam kaba U U Briew un ha phi , namar ba uba U Kpa , u ban shonshab ha u .
translation.en: Labour not for the meat which perisheth , but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life , which the Son of man shall give unto you : for him hath God the Father sealed .

Therefore when thou doest thine alms , do not sound a trumpet before thee , as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets , that they may have glory of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
translation.kha: Kumta haba phi ai ei ei ha u briew uba kyrduh , wat pynsawa jam ïa ka , kumba ki riewarsap ki leh ha ki synagog bad ha ki lynti bah . Ki leh ïa ka khnang ba ki briew kin ïaroh ïa ki . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ba ki la da ïoh ka jingsiew ba-pura .

translation.en: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king , and of his seven counsellors , to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem , according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand  ;
translation.kha: Ma nga , bad ki hynñiew ngut ki nongai jingmut , ngi phah ïa phi ban wad jingtip ïa ki jinglong jingman ha Jerusalem bad Judah khnang ban ïohi kumno ïa ka Hukum U Blei jong me , ïa kaba la bynshet ha me , la kohnguh .
Ki pyrkhat ba :14 jingphohsniew ba ki Ibsan kin pynlong ïa pynum briew jong nga sngewtieng klet ïa nga Gibbethon Ether ki kpa jong ki , ki la Baïap ïa nga bad phai sha u Baal .
translation.en: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour , as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal .
This is my covenant , which ye shall keep , between me and you and thy seed after thee  ; Every man child among you shall be circumcised .
translation.kha: Ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ki dei ban mynjur ban otsher ïa uwei pa uwei u khunlung hapdeng jong phi .
Ha phi la ïa ka jingmaïan ka Hima U Blei , U Jisu u jubab . Hynrei kiwei , kiba long shabar ki ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei baroh lyngba ,
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God : but unto them that are without , all these things are done in parables :
Teaching us that , denying ungodliness and worldly lusts , we should live soberly , righteously , and godly , in this present world ;
translation.kha: Ba ka jingaiei ka hikai ïa ngi ban iehnoh ïa ka rukom im bymriewblei bad ïa ki jingkwah brai ba kynja pyrthei , bad ban im da kaba synshar ïa lade , ban im hok , bad ban im riewblei ha kane ka pyrthei ,

translation.en: When ye come together therefore into one place , this is not to eat the Lord s supper .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïaseng lang kum ka kynhun , kam dei ka Jingkhawai U Trai ba phi ïabam .

translation.en: Remember them which have the rule over you , who have spoken unto you the word of God : whose faith follow , considering the end of their conversation .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ki nongïalam jong phi kiba mynshuwa , kiba la kren ha phi ïa ka khubor U Blei . To da pyrkhat kumno ki la im bad ki la ïap , bad pyrthuh bud ïa ka jingngeit jong ki .
Ngan phah ïa jingteinam briew ban pynjot ïa ka . Ki baroh hebrew wanrah ïa la Isaak sdie , kin pynngat ïa ki dieng Kedar .—Isaiah itynnat bad jingïohthiah bret ïa shisien ha bud ding .
translation.en: And I will prepare destroyers against thee , every one with his weapons : and they shall cut down thy choice cedars , and cast them into the fire .

translation.kha: pynjahburom u Syiem Solomon bad ki paidbah baroh hangta ki kñia sti jingainguh ha U Trai .
translation.en: And the king , and all Israel with him , offered sacrifice before the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la Pynshlur ba un pyn-i Shammua ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad kynmaw ïa ka jutang bakyntang jong u shithi
translation.en: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers , and to remember his holy covenant  ;

translation.kha: Mynta ngam mut ïa jingïadie bymngeit kiba awria ne kiba lalot ne kiba long ki nongtuh ne kiba 10 ïa ki bleithaw . Hammoth lait na kine Babel dei ban Edom shisyndon na ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world , or with the covetous , or extortioners , or with idolaters ; for then must ye needs go out of the world .

translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kiba bun la ïalumlang ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ki ong , Ïa Jerusalem ban pynjot ! ïohi ïa kane ka nongbah ha ki jingjot !
translation.en: Now also many nations are gathered against thee , that say , Let her be defiled , and let our eye look upon Zion .

translation.kha: Balei ban pynlut pisa ha ka kaei bym ai jinghun ? Balei ban pynlut ïa bainong ka jong phi ban bad dang hap shahthngan hi ? To shahshkor ïa nga bad leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong , bad phin sngewtynnat ïa ka jingbam kaba bang tam na baroh .
translation.en: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread ? and your labour for that which satisfieth not ? hearken diligently unto me , and eat ye that which is good , and let your soul delight itself in fatness .

translation.kha: Ka la jia ba katba u dang syiem long ba U Trai u nyngkong phah ïa u Resin u syiem ka Syria bad u Pekah u syiem ka Israel ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah .
translation.en: In those days the  Lord  began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria , and Pekah the son of Remaliah .

translation.kha: Dei kata aiu balei ba la khot Ka Lyngkha Ka Snam Asaraïahu ong ka par .
translation.en: Wherefore that field was called , The field of blood , unto this day .
Ashdod with her towns and her villages , Gaza with her towns and her villages , unto the river of Egypt , and the great sea , and the border thereof :
translation.kha: Don ka Ashdod bad ka Gasa , lem bad ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , kiba kynjoh sha ka wahduid ha khappud jong ka Ijipt bad ka rud jong ka Duriaw Mediterranian .

translation.en: And they led Jesus away to the high priest : and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes .
translation.kha: Nangta , ïa U Jisu la ïalam sha ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh , ha kaba la ïalumlang ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki rangbah nongïalam bad ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum .

translation.en: She hath done what she could : she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying .
translation.kha: Ka la leh ïa kaei kaba ka la lah ban leh ; ka la theh ïa ka jingsleh iwbih halor ka met jong nga ban pynkhreh lypa shuwa ka por jong ka jingtep ïa ka met jong nga .

translation.en: And so it was , when Israel had sown , that the Midianites came up , and the Amalekites , and the children of the east , even they came up against them  ;

translation.en: For it is the life of all flesh  ; the blood of it is for the life thereof : therefore I said unto the children of Israel , Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh : for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof : whosoever eateth it shall be cut off .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u ong ha nga , ‘ Wat tieng ïa u . Ngan aiti u ïa , ïa ki briew jong u , bad ïa ka ri jong baroh u ha phi . Leh ïa u kumba phi la leh ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba synshar Heshbon ha .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Fear him not : for I will deliver him , and all his people , and his land , into thy hand  ; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .

U u la kren biang nga .
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.en: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach , because we trust in the living God , who is the Saviour of all men , specially of those that believe .

translation.en: I the  Lord  search the heart , I try the reins , even to give every man according to his ways , and according to the fruit of his doings .

translation.en: And they withstood Uzziah the king , and said unto him , It appertaineth not unto thee , Uzziah , to burn incense unto the  Lord  , but to the priests the sons of Aaron , that are consecrated to burn incense : go out of the sanctuary  ; for thou hast trespassed  ; neither shall it be for thine honour from the  Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Ko Ussaïah ! Phim don hok ban thang jingiwbih ha U  Trai . Dei tang ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ïa kiba la pynkyntang ban leh ïa kane . Khie mihnoh na kane ka jaka kyntang . Phi la pynsngewsih ïa U Trai U Blei , bad phin ym ïoh shuh ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u .

Nga la leh mynleh kum u bieit — hynrei la phi pynlong ïa nga ban leh kumta . Dei ma phi la kiba dei ban pynpaw ïa ka jingmynjur jong phi ïa . nga Naba wat lada ngam long ei ei , ngam shym duna ei ei na ki kita apostol kiba kham kyrpang jong phi .
translation.en: I am become a fool in glorying ; ye have compelled me : for I ought to have been commended of you : for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles , though I be nothing .

translation.kha: To sngap noh na ka jingïam jong phi bad to ñiad Massah duriaw ki ummat jong phi . jingïaishah kiba phi kshaid leh na ka bynta ki khun jong phi kin suba pyndap lehnoh-ei ; kin wan phai pat na ka ri u nongshun .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Refrain thy voice from weeping , and thine eyes from tears : for thy work shall be rewarded , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy .
For I am now ready to be offered , and the time of my departure is at hand .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong nga , ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban shah kñia ; ka por ka long mynta ïa nga ban iehnoh ïa kane ka jingim .

translation.en: Then I said unto them , What is the high place whereunto ye go ? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day .

translation.en: A light to lighten the Gentiles , and the glory of thy people Israel .

translation.en: Then David went over to the other side , and stood on the top of an hill afar off  ; a great space being between them :

translation.en: Sanctify yourselves therefore , and be ye holy : for I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.en: And when all the people saw it , they fell on their faces : and they said , The  Lord  , he is the God  ; the  Lord  , he is the God .

translation.en: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield , with the flattering of her lips she forced him .
