translation.kha: Haba u Ahab u ïohi ïa u Elijah , u ong  Me u nongshun jong nga , me la lap mo ïa nga ?   Ho-oid , nga la lap ,  u Elijah u jubab ,  Me la aiti lut ïa lade ban leh ïa kaei ka bymdei ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: And I will harden Pharaoh s heart , that he shall follow after them  ; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh , and upon all his host  ; that the Egyptians may know that I am the  Lord . And they did so .
translation.kha: Ngan pynmutlop ïa u , bad un sa wan thwet nadien jong phi ; bad kumta ka jingjop jong nga ïa u Pharaoh bad ka kynhun shipai jong u kan long ka burom ïa nga . Te ki nong Ijipt kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .  Ki Israel ki leh kumba la hukum ïa ki .

translation.en: Now ye Philippians know also , that in the beginning of the gospel , when I departed from Macedonia , no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving , but ye only .
translation.kha: Phi ki nong Philippi phi tip bha shibun ba haba nga la mihnoh na Makedonia ha ki sngi kiba sdang ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha , phi dei tang ma phi ka balang ban ïarap ïa nga ; phi dei tang ma phi kiba la shim bynta ha ki jingïoh bad jingduh jong nga .

Hynrei namar ki pop jinglyng-a ngi ïa u la pynmong , thring sympat namar ka jingbymman kaba ngi la leh . La pynkhiah pynthymmai jingpynduh da ka 31 kaba ïa-ieit la Mei , la pynkhiah ïa ngi da ki jingsympat kiba u la ïoh .
translation.en: But he was wounded for our transgressions , he was bruised for our iniquities : the chastisement of our peace was upon him  ; and with his stripes we are healed .

translation.kha: Ki dkhoh kin thaw ïa ki skum ki jong , kha kin pylleng bad pynmih ki khun , bad sumar ïa ki hangta . Ki pukni kin ïalum hangta , kiwei hadien kiwei pat .
translation.en: There shall the great owl make her nest , and lay , and hatch , and gather under her shadow : there shall the vultures also be gathered , every one with her mate .

translation.kha: u pukni hukum na me ban shna ïa la ka skum halor lumbah ?
translation.en: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command , and make her nest on high ?

translation.kha: Suk kata ka jaitbynriew Baanah U Blei Kiriathaim ka U mawkhang U Trai ; suk kita ki briew kiba u la jied patar histori ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translation.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the  Lord   ; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance .
For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews  religion , how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God , and wasted it :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew kumno ba nga la ju im mynba nga dang don ha ka niam Jiw , kumno nga la pynshitom beiñ khlem jingisynei ïa ka balang U Blei bad nga la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban pynduh noh ïa ka .

translation.en: My root was spread out by the waters , and the dew lay all night upon my branch .
translation.kha: Nga la long kum u dieng uba ki thied ki ïoh um borabor bad uba ki tnat ki jhieh da ki umjer .

translation.en: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee .
translation.kha: Kumta u la ïalap ha ki synagog ha kylleng ka ri .

translation.en: They shall lay hold on bow and spear  ; they are cruel , and have no mercy  ; their voice roareth like the sea  ; and they ride upon horses , set in array as men for war against thee , O daughter of Zion .
translation.kha: Ki la shim ïa la ki ryntieh bad ki waitlam ; ki long kiba runar bad ki bym don jingisynei . Ki sawa kum ka duriaw bakyrhuh , katba ki shong ha ki kulai jong ki . Ki la pynkhreh ïa ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem .
Bun sngi ngim shym lah ban ïohi ïa ka sngi lane ïa khlur ki , bad ka lyer ka la nang beh jur . Ha kaba khatduh la ngi duh jingkyrmen ïa ka ban lait im .
translation.en: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared , and no small tempest lay on us , all hope that we should be saved was then taken away .
Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain , and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second  ; that the loops may take hold one of another .
translation.kha: Buh sanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha ka jingkah kaba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli pat ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba khatduh ba la suh lang ha ka jingkah kaba ar . Pynphai marpyrshah ïa ki .

Hynrei u Moses u la ïasaid bad U Trai U Blei jong u , bad u la ong , Ko Trai balei , ba men bitar haduh katne ïa la ki jong ki , briew kiba me la pyllait na ka ri Ijipt da ka jingkhlaiñ bakhraw bad da bor ka ?
translation.en: And Moses besought the  Lord  his God , and said ,  Lord  , why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people , which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power , and with a mighty hand ?

translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba shong Jerusalem ki la shaphang kata , bad ki khot kyrteng ktien jong ki kata ka lyngkha Ka Akeldama , kaba mut Ka lyngkha ka snam . )
translation.en: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem  ; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue , Aceldama , that is to say , The field of blood .

translation.kha: Namar kaei kaba phi ngan aiti noh ïa phi sha ki kiwei ki jaitbynriew ïa phi bad pynjot ïa phi . Ngan pynjot lut ïa phi ba phin ym long shuh ka jaitbynriew lane ban don ka ri la ka jong . Te phin tip ba nga long Trai
translation.en: Behold , therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee , and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen  ; and I will cut thee off from the people , and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries : I will destroy thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la ka pyndonkam ïa bor synshar baïar jong u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u . U la pynbor ïa ka pyrthei ïa bad baroh kiba shong ha ka ban mane ïa u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong , uba ka jingmynsaw jong u ka la ïohkhiah .
translation.en: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him , and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast , whose deadly wound was healed .

And he put down the idolatrous priests , whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah , and in the places round about Jerusalem  ; them also that burned incense unto Baal , to the sun , and to the moon , and to the planets , and to all the host of heaven .
translation.kha: U weng noh na ka kam ïa ki lyngdoh kiba ki syiem Judah ki la pynkyntang ban ai jingkñia halor ki duwan ba-thala ha ki nongbah ka Judah bad ha ki jaka hajan Jerusalem ― ïa baroh ki lyngdoh kiba ai jingkñia sha u Baal , sha ka sngi , u bnai , ki metbneng , bad ki khlur .

translation.en: Behold also the ships , which though they be so great , and are driven of fierce winds , yet are they turned about with a very small helm , whithersoever the governor listeth .
translation.kha: Lane to pyrkhat ïa ka lieng kaba heh : La ka heh katno katno bad la pynïaid ïa ka da ki lyer bakhlaiñ , la ñiah ïa ka da u boitha uba rit eh , bad ka ïaid kat shaba u nongking lieng u mon ba kan leit .

Wat lada katto ki bym dei hok ban shah pynshitom ki dei ban dih na ka khuri jong kyr-iat jingpynshitom , hato phi Shimei ba ma phi phin lait Aristobulos khlem shah paitlieng ? Em , phi dei ban dih na kane ka khuri Kabul
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken  ; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished ? thou shalt not go unpunished , but thou shalt surely drink of it .
They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous , and condemn the innocent blood .
translation.kha: kiba ïasylla lang pyrshah ïa ki briew kiba bha bad rai pynrem ïa kiba lui lui sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: These are the sons of Bilhah , which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter , and she bare these unto Jacob : all the souls were seven .
translation.kha: Kine hynñiew ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u Jakob u ïoh na ka Bilhah kaba u Laban u ai ha ka Rakhel ka khun jong u ban long ka mraw jong ka .

translation.en: And upon her forehead was a name written , MYSTERY , BABYLON THE GREAT , THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH .
translation.kha: Ha ka shyllangmat jong ka , la thoh ïa ka kyrteng kaba don ka jingmut kaba rieh :  Ka Babilon Bakhraw , ka kmie jong ki nuti baroh bad kiba sakma baroh ha ka pyrthei .
Ka wan phai pat sha ka lieng , bad u Noah u kner ïa la ka kti , bad u rah ïa shapoh ka .
translation.en: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot , and she returned unto him into the ark , for the waters were on the face of the whole earth : then he put forth his hand , and took her , and pulled her in unto him into the ark .

translation.kha: Arubboth ka jingngeit kaba tait Daniel ïa ki kynroh ka Jerikho dih kyllon , hadien ba ki khun Israel ki la ïaid tawiar sawdong ïa ki kpoh hynñiew sngi nongsngap
translation.en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down , after they were compassed about seven days .

translation.kha: Uta U Nongïarap Mynsiem Bakhuid , ïa uba U Kpa un phah ka kyrteng jong nga hikai ïa ïa kiei baroh bad un pynkynmaw baroh kaba la ïathuh ha phi
translation.en: But the Comforter , which is the Holy Ghost , whom the Father will send in my name , he shall teach you all things , and bring all things to your remembrance , whatsoever I have said unto you .

translation.kha: Ki la sangeh ban ïa U Trai ki shakri ïa ki blei bad
translation.en: And they forsook the  Lord  , and served Baal and Ashtoreth .
Last of all the woman died also .
translation.kha: Khatduh na ki baroh , kata ka briew ka la ïap .

translation.en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold : the spear , the dart , nor the habergeon .
translation.kha: Ym don kano kano ka waitlam kaba lah ban pynmong ïa u ; Ym don sum ne khnam ne waitsum kaba lah ban pynmynsaw ïa u .

translation.en: And when they were come to him , he said unto them , Ye know , from the first day that I came into Asia , after what manner I have been with you at all seasons ,
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi , u la ong ha ki ,  Phi ïatip kumno ba nga la pynlut ïa ka por haba nga la don bad phi , naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong ba nga la poi ha ka probins jong ka Asia .
leit ban bad ong ha u Hananaïah : U Trai u la ong ba me lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor dieng , hynrei un bujli ïa ka da ka nar lyngkor .
translation.en: Go and tell Hananiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood  ; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron .
Who in the days of his flesh , when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death , and was heard in that he feared  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka jingim jong u ha kane ka pyrthei , U Jisu u la duwai bad khot kyrpad da kaba pyrta jam bad ïam ha khmat U Blei , uba lah ban pyllait ïa u na ka jingïap . Namar ba u long uba sngewrit bad aiti lut , U Blei u la shahshkor ïa u .

Nangta ngan pynlong ïa ki ksang Uriah Barsillai kada syiem ka Babilonia kaba khlaiñ bad ngan buh ïa ka Bohan ïohpang nga ha ki Elishaphat jong u . Hynrei ngan pynkheiñ ïa lano Absalom ti jong u syiem ka Ijipt , Neiel Jashar ud bad ïap ha khmat u nongshun jong u .
translation.en: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon , and put my sword in his hand : but I will break Pharaoh s arms , and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man .
The poor and the deceitful man meet together : the  Lord  lighteneth both their eyes .
translation.kha: U briew baduk bad u nongbanbeiñ jong u ki ïadon ïa kane kumjuh — U  Trai  u ai ïa ki khmat ha baroh ar ngut .
U u don hapdeng ka jingïaleh jur bha bad u la siat u khnam ha nongshun bad la mynsaw jur .
translation.en: And the battle went sore against Saul , and the archers hit him , and he was wounded of the archers .

translation.kha: metïap ka por ba u Jotham , u baklang Pyrkhat bad u Hesekaïah ki la long ki syiem ka shi , U Trai u la ai ïa shongneh ka khubor sngem u Mikah , iw Kibsaim ka shnong Moresheth Beer U Trai Pynmih la pynpaw ïaduna u bankhia phlangïap kine kiei basah baroh nongtrei” ka Samaria bad Kata pynkut .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Bad mynta ngi ngeit bad ngi tip ba me long shahskhor U Bakhuid Lehse la wan na U Blei .
translation.en: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ , the Son of the living God .
And his father Isaac said unto him , Come near now , and kiss me , my son .
translation.kha: Nangta u kpa jong u , u ong ha u ,  Ale kham hajan ko khun bad to doh ïa nga .
Hynrei lada uno uno na phi u duna ïa ka jingstad , dei u ban duwai ha Blei U , u ban ai ïa ka ha ; u namar U Blei u ai kylluid bad ai ei ïa baroh .
translation.en: If any of you lack wisdom , let him ask of God , that giveth to all men liberally , and upbraideth not  ; and it shall be given him .
Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the  Lord  in Jerusalem : and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerusalem ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  ; ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong ki pynïap ïa ki jingri na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam .
ïohi Im lei da lei ïa ka jingshai jong ka sngi lane tip kumno ka jingim ka long , hynrei la kumno kumno i la shem ka jingjahthait —
translation.en: Moreover he hath not seen the sun , nor known any thing : this hath more rest than the other .
And there came a voice to him ,  Rise , Peter  ; kill , and eat .
translation.kha: Ka sur ka la ong ha u ,  Ïeng joit , ko Petros ; to pynïap bad to bam !

translation.en: The  Lord  was ready to save me : therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me la pynkhiah ïa nga . Ngin tem ki duitara bad rwai ka jingïaroh ïa me , ngin rwai ïaroh ha ka Templ jong me katba ngi dang im .
Bad U Trai un pyllait im para nga na ka jingmynsaw 19 bad un ri pynim bad ïalam ïa Ainguh sha ka hima jong u ha bneng .
translation.en: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work , and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom : to whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .

translation.kha: ngiam syiem Solomon bad ki paid hati baroh ki ïalumlang ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ki kñia Menna da bun tawah ki langbrot bad hangtai masi thaba bun katta katta bym lah ñiew shuh distrik
translation.en: And king Solomon , and all the congregation of Israel , that were assembled unto him , were with him before the ark , sacrificing sheep and oxen , that could not be told nor numbered for multitude .
For the promise is unto you , and to your children , and to all that are afar off , even as many as the Lord our God shall call .
translation.kha: Naba ïa ka jingkular jong U Blei la pynlong ha phi bad ha ki khun jong phi , bad ha baroh kiba sha jngai — baroh kiba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u khot sha lade .
Naba ka jingthoh ka ong , Ym dei ban teh ïa shyntur masi haba me pyndonkam ïa u ban shoh kew bad u nongtrei u dei ban ïoh ïa la ka bainong .
translation.en: For the scripture saith , Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn . And ,  The labourer is worthy of his reward .

And it was so , when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court , that she obtained favour in his sight : and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand . So Esther drew near , and touched the top of the sceptre .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u ïohi ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei , ba ka ïeng habar , ka la ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong u , bad u pyn-i ïa ka ïa u diengsynshar ksiar . Nangta ka kiew shalor bad ka ktah ïa ka tduh uta u diengsynshar .

translation.en: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding , sit not down in the highest room  ; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him  ;
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u khot sngewbha ïa phi sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim , wat shong ha ki jaka bakyrpang . Ka lah ban jia ba uno uno uba kham donkam ban ïa phi u la shah khot sngewbha ,
Uno uno ne uei uba ktah ka doh jong uta u un mynsaw da ka bor jong jingkhuid jong ka . kano kano ka bynta jong jaiñkup snam na uta u jingkñia , dei ban sait ka ka jaka bakhuid
translation.en: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy : and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment , thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place .
And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof , by the two corners of it , upon the two sides thereof , to be places for the staves to bear it withal .
translation.kha: U thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki harum kata ka jingpynpur ha ki ar tylli ki krung kiba ïa-pyrshah , ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah da kiba yn bah ïa ka .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Unto what then were ye baptized ? And they said , Unto John s baptism .
translation.kha: Da kumta , te , kaba kumno ka jingpynbaptis phi la ïohpdiang ?   Ka jingpynbaptis u Ïoannis ,  ki la jubab .

La ibhabriew ha baroh ki Israel Abram u Saul u jaiñkup pynïap ïa u rangbah ai hukum jong ki Philistia Japheth kyrtong ki Philistia ki India bajngai ïa ki . Kumta ki paidbah pynjynjar jubab ïa ka jingkhot ban ïasnohkti print u Saul ha Lakhish .
translation.en: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines , and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines . And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal .

In the morning thou shalt say , Would God it were even ! and at even thou shalt say , Would God it were morning ! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear , and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see .
translation.kha: Ka shadem jong phi kan kyndeh da ka jingsheptieng kat ïa kaba phi ïohi . Man ka step phin kwah ba kan wan noh ka janmiet ; man ka janmiet pat phin kwah ba kan wan noh ka step .
Balei me uba khot bha ïa nga U ? Jisu u la kylli ïa u . Ym don uno uno uba bha lait tang U Blei .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? none is good , save one , that is , God .
If so be they will hearken , and turn every man from his evil way , that I may repent me of the evil , which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings .
translation.kha: Lehse ki briew kin shahshkor bad iehnoh ïa la ki lynti basniew . Lada ki leh kumta , te ngan kylla ïa la ka jingmut shaphang ka jingpynjot kaba nga la thmu ban wallam halor jong ki na ka bynta ki kam bymman jong ki .

translation.en: And he said , Behold now , my lords , turn in , I pray you , into your servant s house , and tarry all night , and wash your feet , and ye shall rise up early , and go on your ways . And they said , Nay  ; but we will abide in the street all night .
translation.kha: U dem ngon ha khmat jong ki , bad u ong ,  Ko rangbah , nga don hangne ban shakri ïa phi . Sngewbha wan sha ïing jong nga . Phi lah ban sait ïa la ki kjat , bad ban sahmiet ruh . Lashai phi lah ban khie dang step , bad bteng ïa la ka jingleit .  Hynrei ki jubab ,  Em , ngin sahmiet hangne ha ka jaka bakylluid jong ka nongbah .
Kata ka ri kriah phin sa Ulai kam dei kum ka ri Ijipt Jahas kaba phi shong mynshuwa . Hangta , tynneng phi bet ïa u jingïasylla , phi hap jinglui da trei pynkyrteng ban ai um ïa ki lyngkha kubur
translation.en: For the land , whither thou goest in to possess it , is not as the land of Egypt , from whence ye came out , where thou sowedst thy seed , and wateredst it with thy foot , as a garden of herbs :
For the cloud of the  Lord  was upon the tabernacle by day , and fire was on it by night , in the sight of all the house of Israel , throughout all their journeys .
translation.kha: Ha ki jingïaid lynti jong ki baroh shi lynter , ki lah ban ïohi mynsngi ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ha uta u lyoh halor ka Ïingjaiñ , bad mynmiet pat ha ka ding kaba meh halor jong ka .
Ym kynsai jingbuh speh Neiel ka jingdih waiñ ; u syiem u la ai hukum ïa ki shakri ka ïingsyiem ba baroh ki lah ban dih katba ki sngewkwah .
translation.en: And the drinking was according to the law  ; none did compel : for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house , that they should do according to every man s pleasure .
Also I say unto you , Whosoever shall confess me before men , him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God :
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba uno uno uba pynbna ha kaba paw ba u long u jong nga , U Khun U Briew un leh kumjuh ïa u ha khmat ki angel jong U Blei .

translation.en: While I was with them in the world , I kept them in thy name : those that thou gavest me I have kept , and none of them is lost , but the son of perdition  ; that the scripture might be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Mynba nga la don lem bad ki , nga la ri kyndong ïa ki da ka bor ka kyrteng jong me , ka kyrteng kaba me la ai ha nga . Nga la ïada ïa ki , bad ym don uwei ruh na ki uba la jah noh , lait tang u briew uba la dei ban jah — khnang ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha .
Ha kata tawah por , U Jisu u la leit kiew donkam u kum ban duwai bad dkhat pynlut baroh shi miet hangta da kaba duwai ha U Blei .
translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that he went out into a mountain to pray , and continued all night in prayer to God .
And though they say , The  Lord  liveth  ; surely they swear falsely .
translation.kha: Wat la phi kam ba phi mane ïa U  Trai  , phim shym mut kumba phi ong .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Take thy rod , and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt , upon their streams , upon their rivers , and upon their ponds , and upon all their pools of water , that they may become blood  ; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt , both in vessels of wood , and in vessels of stone .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ong ïa u Aaron ban shim ïa la u diengduh bad ban rah ïa u halor ki wah , ki nur-um , bad ki pukri um baroh ha ka ri Ijipt . Ka um kan kylla snam , bad ha ka ri baroh kawei kan don ka snam , wat ha ki khiew dieng bad ki khiew maw ruh .

translation.en: Then said all the trees unto the bramble , Come thou , and reign over us .
translation.kha: Kumta te ki dieng baroh ki ong ha u dieng shiah , ‘ Ale wan bad long u syiem jong ngi .’

translation.en: Whereas our substance is not cut down , but the remnant of them the fire consumeth .
translation.kha: Ïa kata baroh kaba ki bymman ki don la pynjot , bad ka ding ka thang duh ïa kano kano kaba dang sah .
Da shisha kynmaw ko parabangeit ngi , kumno ba ngi la minot bad trei shitom ! Ngi la trei bad mynmiet khnang ba ngin bankhia ïa phi haba ngi la ïalap ha ïa ka Khubor na U Blei .
translation.en: For ye remember , brethren , our labour and travail : for labouring night and day , because we would not be chargeable unto any of you , we preached unto you the gospel of God .

translation.kha: Um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade ha ka jingïap jong kito kiba ïalong ba-ha-ïing bad u na ka jingshongkurim
translation.en: But he shall not defile himself , being a chief man among his people , to profane himself .

translation.kha: Kaba pynrem ïa kiba lui lui lane kaba pynksan ïa ki bymman — baroh ar ki long ka jingijli ha U Trai .
translation.en: He that justifieth the wicked , and he that condemneth the just , even they both are abomination to the  Lord .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki na ka ïing jong me ha bneng , map ïa ki , bad ïarap ïa ki . Tang ma me hi uba ïa tip ki jingmut jong dohnud ka briew .
translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and forgive , and do , and give to every man according to his ways , whose heart thou knowest  ; ( for thou , even thou only , knowest the hearts of all the children of men  ; )
All things are lawful unto me , but all things are not expedient : all things are lawful for me , but I will not be brought under the power of any .
translation.kha: Don u ban ong ,  Nga lah ban leh ïa kano kano .  Ho-oid , hynrei ym baroh kiei kiei ki long kiba bha ïa phi . Nga lah ban ong ba nga lah ban leh ïa kano kano , hynrei ngan ym shah ïa kano kano ban pynlong ïa nga u mraw jong ka .
U Saul u bitar lep ïa Resen Jonathan hynñiew u ong ha u , Me u khun pongka ! Mynta nga tip ba me ïashah liang bad u Dabid bad me pynjahburom ïa lade bad Shi kato ka kmie jong me !
translation.en: Then Saul s anger was kindled against Jonathan , and he said unto him , Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman , do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion , and unto the confusion of thy mother s nakedness ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka kynti ka Hannah kam shym la leit Ka . ong ha la u tnga , Nga tang pyniehnoh shu buiñ ïa u , ngan wan ïalam u ïa sha ïing U Trai , bad hangta un shong baroh shi rta .
translation.en: But Hannah went not up  ; for she said unto her husband , I will not go up until the child be weaned , and then I will bring him , that he may appear before the  Lord  , and there abide for ever .

translation.kha: Kaei ka Silas — pha , ko Esther , ko mahadei ? u majistor u kylli . Ïathuh ïa nga pynher kaba pha kwah , bad ïakhublei Kamra ïa kata — wat beh ka long shiteng na ka hima Meshakh nga .
translation.en: Then said the king unto her , What wilt thou , queen Esther ? and what is thy request ? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom .

When one told me , saying , Behold , Saul is dead , thinking to have brought good tidings , I took hold of him , and slew him in Ziklag , who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings :
translation.kha: U nonglamktien uba la wan sha nga ha Siklag bad ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingïap u Saul , u la pyrkhat ba u la wallam ka khubor babha . Nga la kem ïa u , bad phah pynïap ïa u . Kata ka dei ka bainong ba nga la ai ha u na ka bynta kata ka khubor babha jong u !

Ha Bendeker sngi kaba oh men shim ïa u langsohmoh u bym don kano :4–12 ka jingduna Jehubbah ai ïa u jingstet ka jingkñia jingshong ka bynta ka pop . “katba pynkhuid ïa ka duwan da ka snam jong u Berakah kajuh ka rukom kumba me leh da u masi lyngraw .
translation.en: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering  ; and they shall cleanse the altar , as they did cleanse it with the bullock .

translation.kha: Nga pynshah da met sha kito kiba shoh ïa nga . Ngam shym pynsangeh ïa ki haba ki krenbeiñ haba patrong ïa ki shñiuh na u ñiuhtmoh jong nga bad bynthiew ka khmat jong nga
translation.en: I gave my back to the smiters , and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair : I hid not my face from shame and spitting .

translation.kha: Kumta u ISAIAH u ong , To , kam jingsuhsieng lei ! Haba U Trai u aiti ïa jingshonshab Sebah bad ïa u Salmunna ha nga , Hoham shoh pynspong pruh Kerkut ki shiah bad da ki shiah buid na ka ri shyiap pynjrong
translation.en: And Gideon said , Therefore when the  Lord  hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand , then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers .

translation.kha: Kumta ki shakri ki la sha ki lynti bah bad ki la ïalumlang ïa ki briew baroh ki lah ban ïashem kiba bha bad kiba sniew kumjuh , bad ïa ka kamra khawai shongkurim la pyndap da ki briew .
translation.en: So those servants went out into the highways , and gathered together all as many as they found , both bad and good : and the wedding was furnished with guests .
And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha , that is to say , a place of a skull ,
translation.kha: Ki la poi ha ka jaka ba la khot Golgotha , kaba mut  Ka jaka ka Maloi khlieh .

translation.en: Then they cried out with a loud voice , and stopped their ears , and ran upon him with one accord ,
translation.kha: Da ka jingpyrta bajam ki dkhot jong ka Dorbar ki la set ïa la ki shkor da la ki kti . Nangta baroh ki la tur sha u hangta hi , ki la bret ïa u shabar ka nongbah , bad ki la lynthem maw ïa u .

lum ïa u artatien sohwaiñ la lah thung sngi ka khunblang “ksuid” seisoh bad kaba biang bha ka um tamsneng kumta u lah ban sei ki sla bad ïakynduh ki sohwaiñ bad long diengsoh dieng sohwaiñ uba itynnat eh .
translation.en: It was planted in a good soil by great waters , that it might bring forth branches , and that it might bear fruit , that it might be a goodly vine .
Whose leaves were fair , and the fruit thereof much , and in it was meat for all  ; under which the beasts of the field dwelt , and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation :
translation.kha: Ki sla jong u ki la long kiba itynnat , bad u la don kyrhai ki soh ha u ban bsa ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Ki mradkhlaw ki la pynjahthait hapoh jong u , bad ki sim ki la thaw ïa ki skum jong ki ha ki tnat jong u .

Namar ba u Shekhem u la pynkheiñ burom ïa ka Dinah ka kubur jong ki , ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob leh la phai Shua Ethanim u Shekhem bad u Hamor jingker-ïada jingpynshisha jong u da ka buit shukor jingngeit
translation.en: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully , and said , because he had defiled Dinah their sister :

translation.kha: bad tylli ki kiba kumjuh ba yn lah ban lang ïa ki . kita ki jingker ki don kine ki .
translation.en: One board had two tenons , equally distant one from another : thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Ki kmie ki jingkylla jong u Haoid la kyndit haba ki la ïohi ïa u , bad ka kmie jong u ka la ong , Ko khun jong nga , balei me la leh ïa kane ha skum ? U kpa jong me bad ma nga ngi la imon shikatdei eh ha kaba pyrshang ban wad ïa me Abida
translation.en: And when they saw him , they were amazed : and his mother said unto him , Son , why hast thou thus dealt with us ? behold , thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing .

translation.kha: Hadien u Ibsan , u Elon uba na Sebulun u ïalam ïa ki Israel shiphew snem .
translation.en: And after him Elon , a Zebulunite , judged Israel  ; and he judged Israel ten years .
Then he said , I pray thee therefore , father , that thou wouldest send him to my father s house :
translation.kha: Uta u riewspah u la ong , ‘ Kumta nga kyrpad ïa me , ko kpa Abraham , to phah ïa u Lasaros sha ka ïing u kpa jong nga , ha kaba nga don san ngut ki hynmen ki para shynrang .

translation.en: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said , The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel . For the  Lord  had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel , to the intent that the  Lord  might bring evil upon Absalom .
translation.kha: U Absalom bad ki Israel baroh ki ong ,  Ka jingai jingmut jong u Hushai ka kham bha ban ïa ka jong u Ahithophel .  U  Trai  u la rai ban pynpulom ïa ka jingai jingmut babha ka jong u Ahithophel , khnang ba ka jingjot kan wan ha u Absalom .

translation.en: Be not afraid , ye beasts of the field : for the pastures of the wilderness do spring , for the tree beareth her fruit , the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength .
translation.kha: Ko ki mrad , wat sheptieng . Ki jaka phlang ki long kiba jyrngam ; ki dieng ki sei ïa la ki soh , bad don kyrhai ki soh Dumbur bad sohwaiñ .

translation.en: Then Jesse called Abinadab , and made him pass before Samuel . And he said , Neither hath the  Lord  chosen this .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jesse u khot ïa u Abinadab u khun jong u bad u wan ïalam ïa u sha u Samuel . Hynrei u Samuel u ong ,  Em , U  Trai  um shym la jied ïa une ruh .
Kata ka kynthei ka leit sha u , bad haba ka ïohi ba u la sheptieng , kumta ka ong ha u Sngewbha , kynrad , nga la ïa kheiñduh la ka da jingim kaba leh ïa kaei ba phi ong .
translation.en: And the woman came unto Saul , and saw that he was sore troubled , and said unto him , Behold , thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice , and I have put my life in my hand , and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me .
Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u syiem Darius u la soi ïa ka hukum .
bad ha ki lat , ïa kiba la thung da u ban ïa pynshitom ki nongkam bymman bad ban ïaroh ïa kita kiba leh babha .
translation.en: Or unto governors , as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers , and for the praise of them that do well .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrshang ban pynïoh myntoi ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka , hynrei uno uba duh noh ïa la ka na ka bynta jong un ïoh .
translation.en: He that findeth his life shall lose it : and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it .
His disciples say unto him , If the case of the man be so with his wife , it is not good to marry .
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u ki la ong ïa u ,  Lada ka long kumne hapdeng u briew bad la ka tnga , ka kham bha ban ym shongkurim .
bad un pyndonkam Onan kawei pa kawei ka jingshukor bymman ha kito ki ban sa jot noh . Kin jot noh namar ba ïalynñiar pdiang tat-dor bad ieit ïa jingbymdei jingshisha khnang TIMOTHI kin ïoh im .
translation.en: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish ; because they received not the love of the truth , that they might be saved .

Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the  Lord  , to do evil in his sight ? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword , and hast taken his wife to be thy wife , and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Balei te ba mem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga ? Balei ba me la leh ïa kane ka kam bymman ? Me la pynlong ïa u Uriah ban shah pynïap ha ka thma ; me la shah ïa ki Ammon ban pynïap ïa u , bad nangta me shim ïa ka tnga jong u !

pashait phai jingpynrem Gomer ud , ko ki Akkub ka Jerusalem , kum ka briew ka ban sa kha khun , naba mynta tmoh sa hap ban ieh ïa ka nongbah bad ban balyngkot ha rudnong . pyngngad dei ban leit sha Babilon , hynrei hangta U Trai un pyllait ïa phi na Mikaïah nongshun jong phi Musri
translation.en: Be in pain , and labour to bring forth , O daughter of Zion , like a woman in travail : for now shalt thou go forth out of the city , and thou shalt dwell in the field , and thou shalt go even to Babylon  ; there shalt thou be delivered  ; there the  Lord  shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies .
If any man come to me , and hate not his father , and mother , and wife , and children , and brethren , and sisters , yea , and his own life also , he cannot be my disciple .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba wan sha nga um lah ban long u synran jong nga lymda u ieit ïa nga kham palat ban ïa kaba u ieit ïa u kpa bad ka kmie jong u , ïa ka tnga bad ki khun jong u , ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang bad kynthei jong u , bad ïa lade kumjuh .

translation.en: But I say unto you , Swear not at all  ; neither by heaven  ; for it is God s throne :
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : wat pyndonkam ïa kano kano ka jingsmai haba phi pynlong ka jingkular . Wat smai da ka bneng , naba ka long ka khet jong U Blei ;
U Jehu u mih na Jesreel ban leit sha Samaria . Ha lynti , ha ka jaka ba-mynshuwa la khot Ka Jaka Sah ki Nongap Langbrot ,
translation.en: And he arose and departed , and came to Samaria . And as he was at the shearing house in the way ,
That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee , to cause thee to hear it with thine ears ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga leh ïa kane , uno uno uba lait na ka jingpynjot un wan bad un ïathuh ha phi shaphang jong ka .

translation.en: But the king spared Mephibosheth , the son of Jonathan the son of Saul , because of the  Lord s  oath that was between them , between David and Jonathan the son of Saul .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ka kular kaba kyntang kaba ma u bad u Jonathan ki la pynlong uwei ïa uwei pat , u Dabid u la pyllait ïa u Mephibosheth , u khun jong u Jonathan bad u ksiew jong u Saul .
Haei ken kata ka jingkyrkhu ka ba phi la ong Nga hi lah ban ong ba phin da la khlaw noh ïa la ki jong ki khmat , lah bad ban ai noh ki ha nga
translation.en: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of ? for I bear you record , that , if it had been possible , ye would have plucked out your own eyes , and have given them to me .

translation.kha: Baroh kiba don hangta ki la ïam bad ïam sngewsih na ka bynta khynnah ka . U Jisu u la ong , Wat ïam ; ka khynnah shym kam ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !
translation.en: And all wept , and bewailed her : but he said ,  Weep not  ; she is not dead , but sleepeth .
And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation : and all the congregation drew near and stood before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki wanlam sha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Moses u la hukum , bad ki paidbah baroh ki ïalumlang ban mane ïa U  Trai .
Une u long jingthaw u bathymmai uba U Blei , u Nongthaw jong u , u ïai pynthymmai ha ka dur jong u hi , khnang ban wallam ïa phi sha ka jingtip ba-pura shaphang u jong .
translation.en: And have put on the new man , which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him :
Now therefore send , and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel , and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty , and the prophets of the groves four hundred , which eat at Jezebel s table .
translation.kha: Mynta hukum ïa ki paid Israel baroh ban ïakynduh ïa nga ha u Lum Karmel . Wallam ruh sawspah sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal bad sawspah ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong ka blei Asherah kiba ïoh jingkyrshan na ka syiem Jesebel .

translation.en: For as a young man marrieth a virgin , so shall thy sons marry thee : and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride , so shall thy God rejoice over thee .
translation.kha: Kum u samla uba shim ïa ka theisotti kum ka nongleitkurim jong u , uta uba pynlong ïa pha un shongkurim ïa pha , kumba u nongleitkurim u shem sngewbha bad ka nongleitkurim jong u , kumta U Blei jong pha un shem sngewbha ïa pha .

translation.en: By lot was their inheritance , as the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses , for the nine tribes , and for the half tribe .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses , ïa ki jaka jong ki khyndai jait bad kawei ka shiteng jait ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la rai da kaba kynting sbai .

Ka la long kaba khriat , kumta ki shakri bad ki nongap phira ki thang la ding da u rnga bad ki la ïeng sawdong jong ka , pynsyaid ban ïa lade . Te u Petros u la leit shata bad u la bad ïa-ïeng ki , ban pynsyaid ïa lade .
translation.en: And the servants and officers stood there , who had made a fire of coals  ; for it was cold : and they warmed themselves : and Peter stood with them , and warmed himself .

translation.kha: U ba-itynnat u la bthah ïa nga ban jingjemnud ha ki briew , ïakhalai ïohnong , jingshahthngan Trai , Phareng la ong ba phi Ithlah ban kohnguh markhongpong nga da kaba bud ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la ai ha phi Khra-pait
translation.en: And thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; If ye will not hearken to me , to walk in my law , which I have set before you ,

Yea , all Israel have transgressed thy law , even by departing , that they might not obey thy voice  ; therefore the curse is poured upon us , and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God , because we have sinned against him .
translation.kha: Ki Israel baroh ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong me bad ki kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba me la ong . Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad kumta me la wallam ha ngi ïa ki jingtim kiba la thoh ha Ka Aiñ u Moses , u shakri jong me .

translation.en: So they cast him out of the vineyard , and killed him . What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki la bret ïa u shabar jong ka bri sohwaiñ bad ki la pynïap ïa u .  Kaei , te , ba u trai jong ka bri sohwaiñ un leh ïa ki nongshimwai ?  U Jisu u la kylli .
U Kareah jar ïa kito ki lah ban shaniah , bad u shim noh ïa ka Haba jong ki riewtymmen .
translation.en: He removeth away the speech of the trusty , and taketh away the understanding of the aged .

translation.kha: Kumta ngi phah ïa u parabangeit jong lem bad ki ; ngi la ïa bunsien bad ngi la shem ïa u ba u long borabor thrang ban ïarap . Bad mynta ba u la don haduh ïa ka jingshaniah ïa phi , u nang kham thrang shuh shuh ban ïarap .
translation.en: And we have sent with them our brother , whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things , but now much more diligent , upon the great confidence which I have in you .
And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians , and was mighty in words and in deeds .
translation.kha: La hikai ïa u ha ka jingstad baroh jong ki nong Ijipt bad u la long u briew uba khraw ha ki ktien bad ki kam .

translation.en: When Jesus heard it , he saith unto them ,  They that are whole have no need of the physician , but they that are sick : I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa ki bad u la jubab ,  Ki briew kiba khiah kim donkam ïa u nongpynkhiah , hynrei tang kito kiba pang . Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki briew kiba donburom , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .

translation.en: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat : for this is for your health : for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te , to bam khyndiat ka jingbam ; phi donkam ïa ka khnang ban im . Wat iwei i shñiuh na ka khlieh jong phi in ym hap noh .

U rangbah ai hukum u la leit sha kamon Paul , u la kem shrong u , bad u pyrkhing hukum ban teh ïa u da jingpynkhuslai tylli ki kynjri . Nangta u la kylli , Uei diengpynïeng Uei nongrahbor , bymdondor u la leh buhrieh ?
translation.en: Then the chief captain came near , and took him , and commanded him to be bound with two chains  ; and demanded who he was , and what he had done .
So Gehazi followed after Naaman . And when Naaman saw him running after him , he lighted down from the chariot to meet him , and said , Is all well ?
translation.kha: Kumta u leit mih hadien jong u Naaman . Haba u Naaman u la ïohi ïa u briew uba mareh hadien jong u , u la hiar na la ka kali ïapom ban ïashem ïa u , bad kylli ,  Don ei ei kaba pher ?

translation.en: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines , and from the desert unto the river : for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand  ; and thou shalt drive them out before thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïar ïa ki pud jong ka ri jong phi naduh ka khmut duriaw Akaba haduh ka duriaw Mediterranian bad naduh ka ri shyiap haduh ka wah Ïuphratis . Ngan ai ha phi ka bor halor ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka ri , bad phin beh noh ïa ki katba phi nang tur sha khmat .

Phi dei ban pynlut ha rudnong rukom kaba dei ïa kane ka pisa bad ban set ki masi kyrtong , ki langbrot shynrang , shok khunblang , jingkam kew bad ka waiñ bad ban ainguh ïa ki ha ka jingsam jong ka Templ ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks , rams , lambs , with their meat offerings and their drink offerings , and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem .
And when he had made an end of prophesying , he came to the high place .
translation.kha: Ynda u Saul u la dep kata ka jingïashad shongshit bad ka jingrisa , u leit kiew sha ka duwan kaba ha uta u lum .

translation.en: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ , who in presence am base among you , but being absent am bold toward you :
translation.kha: Nga u Paul , nga pynlong ka jingkyrpad ïa phi — ïa nga ïa kaba la ong ba nga long uba jemnud bad jai jai haba nga don bad phi , hynrei uba eh haba nga don jngai na phi .

translation.en: Give , and it shall be given unto you  ; good measure , pressed down , and shaken together , and running over , shall men give into your bosom . For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again .
translation.kha: Ai ha kiwei , bad U Blei un ai ha phi . Da shisha , phin ïohpdiang ka jingthew kaba dap biang , ka jingai basbun , kaba la theh ha ki kti jong phi — baroh kata kaba phi lah ban bat . Ka jingthew kaba phi pyndonkam na ka bynta kiwei ka long kata kaba U Blei un pyndonkam ïa phi .

translation.en: Labour not for the meat which perisheth , but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life , which the Son of man shall give unto you : for him hath God the Father sealed .
translation.kha: Wat trei na ka bynta ka jingbam ka ban sa sniew ; pynban , trei na ka bynta ka jingbam ka ban neh sha ka jingim bymjukut . Kane ka long ka jingbam kaba U Khun U Briew un ai ha phi , namar ba U Blei uba U Kpa , u la sngewbha ban shonshab ha u .
U Ammon lane u Moab — lane uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong ki haduh kaba shiphew pateng bynriew — ym ban dei kynthup hapdeng ki U briew Trai .
translation.en: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord   ; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the  Lord  for ever :
And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Behold , thou art with child , and shalt bear a son , and shalt call his name Ishmael  ; because the  Lord  hath heard thy affliction .
translation.kha: Phan sa ïoh khun shynrang , bad phan khot kyrteng ïa u , u Ishmael , namar U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud sngew jynjar jong pha .

yn Balei ym ong te , To ngin leh ïa kaba sniew khnang ba kaba bha kan mih ? Katto katne ngut ki briew , shisha , pynjahburom ki ïa nga da kaba pharep ïa nga da kaba ong ïa kane kaei kaei hi ! Kin shah pynrem , kumba ki dei ban shah .
translation.en: And not rather , (as we be slanderously reported , and as some affirm that we say) Let us do evil , that good may come ? whose damnation is just .
Then the priest of Jupiter , which was before their city , brought oxen and garlands unto the gates , and would have done sacrifice with the people .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh jong u blei Seus , uba ka templ jong u ka ïeng kham pajih shabar shnong , u la wallam ïa ki masi dab bad ki syntiew sha ka khyrdop , naba ma u bad ki paidbah ki la kwah ban ai ka jingkñia sha ki apostol .

translation.en: And ye shall be left few in number , whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude  ; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Wat la phi bun kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng , tang khyndiat eh na phi phin lait im , namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles : else the new wine doth burst the bottles , and the wine is spilled , and the bottles will be marred : but new wine must be put into new bottles .
translation.kha: Lymne ym don uno uno uba theh ïa ka waiñ thymmai ha ki lwa snieh barim , namar ka waiñ kan pynpdang ïa ki snieh , bad baroh ar , ka waiñ bad ki snieh kin sniew noh . Hynrei , ïa ka waiñ thymmai dei ban theh ha ki lwa snieh bathymmai .

translation.en: And I say unto you , That many shall come from the east and west , and shall sit down with Abraham , and Isaac , and Jacob , in the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba shibun kin ïawan na mihngi bad na sepngi bad kin ïashong lem bad u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob ha ka jingkhawai hapoh ka Hima ki bneng .

translation.en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung : they which have seen him shall say , Where is he ?
translation.kha: hynrei un shah pyrsad noh kum u pui pui . Kito kiba ju ithuh ïa u kin lyngngoh shano ba u la leit .
