Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause .
translation.kha: Wat leh shiliang khmat ïa uba duk haba bishar ïa u .

translation.en: That they feared greatly , because Gibeon was a great city , as one of the royal cities , and because it was greater than Ai , and all the men thereof were mighty .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem ki sngewkyndit shikatdei eh da ka jingsheptieng ha kane , namar ka Gibeon ka long ka nongbah kaba heh kum kano kano ka nongbah kaba don la u syiem ; ka kham heh ban ïa ka Ai , bad ki rangbah jong ka ki long ki riewïaleh kiba tbit .
Ha kano ka rukom pynshong nongrim ïa ki jingïalang jong ngi ?
translation.en: On what pattern are our congregation meetings based ?
Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted :
translation.kha: U parabangeit uba duk u dei ban kmen haba U Blei u kyntiew ïa u , bad u parabangeit uba riewspah u dei ban kmen haba U Blei u pynhiar ïa u .

Hynrei da ka jingaiei U Blei nga long kumba nga , long bad ka jingaiei kaba u ai la ha nga kam shym long lehnoh-ei . Ha kawei ka liang , nga la kham trei shitom ban ïa uno uno uwei pat ki na apostol wat , la kam shym la long da ka jingleh jong nga hi , hynrei ka jingaiei U kaba Blei trei ha nga .
translation.en: But by the grace of God I am what I am : and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain ; but I laboured more abundantly than they all : yet not I , but the grace of God which was with me .

translation.kha: Balei mynta pat , da me kwah rhah sa ïa ki ki jingkñia bad jingainguh ba nga dawa na la ki briew ? Balei Eli ba me ai kham burom ïa la ki khun shynrang ban ïa nga da kaba me shah ba kin pynsngaid ïa lade da ki bynta kiba bha tam na ki jingkñia ba ki briew ki ai ha nga ?
translation.en: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering , which I have commanded in my habitation  ; and honourest thy sons above me , to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people ?

And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even , and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning , and according to the drink offering thereof , for a sweet savour , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kñia ïa u khunlangbrot uba ar ynda janmiet , bad ainguh lang bad u katjuh u kew ba la tylliat ni bha , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka waiñ kumba leh mynstep . Kane ka long ka jingainguh bam sha nga U  Trai  , bad ka jingiwbih jong ka , ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .

translation.en: And he said , I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life  ; and , lo , Sarah thy wife shall have a son . And Sarah heard it in the tent door , which was behind him .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u ong ,  Ngan sa wan biang sha me hadien khyndai bnai , bad ka Sarah ka tnga jong me kan sa ïoh khun shynrang .  Ka Sarah kaba ïeng hadien jong u ha ka jingkhang ka ïingjaiñ , ka pynshahshkor .
Haba jingthew pyrkhat ïa syndah hajngai :32 jia ïa nga , ngam sngewlah pyrkhat shuh , nga kyiuh bad nga kyrngah .
translation.en: Even when I remember I am afraid , and trembling taketh hold on my flesh .
And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites  ; and the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad ki Israel kim lah leh ei ei pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: And ye answered me , and said , The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do .
translation.kha: Bad phi ruh phi ïasngewdei ïa kata kaba bha ban leh .

translation.en: Remember me , O  Lord  , with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people : O visit me with thy salvation  ;
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa nga , A  Trai  , haba me ïarap ïa ki briew jong me ; kynthup ïa nga ruh haba me pynim ïa ki .

translation.en: And a great multitude followed him , because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased .
translation.kha: U paidbah byllien u la bud ïa u , namar ba ki la ïohi ïa ki kambah jong u ha kaba pynkhiah ïa kito kiba pang .
Ha ka snem kaba laiphew phra jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah , u Sekharaïah khun u jong u Jeroboam uba ar u long syiem u ka Israel , bad synshar u hynriew bnai ha Samaria .
translation.en: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months .

translation.kha: Baroh ki bat ïa ki Ksuid ha la ki kti kadiang , ïa jingtur turoi ha la Phin kti kamon , bad ki pyrta , Ka waitlam ïa U Trai bad ïa u Gideon !
translation.en: And the three companies blew the trumpets , and brake the pitchers , and held the lamps in their left hands , and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal : and they cried , The sword of the  Lord  , and of Gideon .
Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity , and sin as it were with a cart rope :
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phim shym lah ban pyllaitluid na la ki jong ki pop .
Te ma ngi , kiba long kiba nyngkong ban kyrmen ha U , Khrist ngin ïaroh ïa ka burom U Blei !
translation.en: That we should be to the praise of his glory , who first trusted in Christ .

translation.kha: Kin khynñiuh um ba halor ka ding kaba khluit . Ale pynpaw ïa ka bor jong me ha ki nongshun jong me , bad pynlong ki jaitbynriew ban khynñiuh ha khmat jong !
translation.en: As when the melting fire burneth , the fire causeth the waters to boil , to make thy name known to thine adversaries , that the nations may tremble at thy presence !

translation.kha: Ki la ïohi ba katto katne ngut ki synran jong u ki dang khlaiñ ïa Khinnereth ki jingbam da ki kti :20 shalyntem khuid kat bymdei treh jinglehniam — kata , kim pat sait ha kata ka rukom kaba ki Pharisi ki ong ba ki briew ki dei ban leh .
translation.en: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled , that is to say , with unwashen , hands , they found fault .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab kane ka jingkylli wan me ne kiwei ki la ïathuh ïa me shaphang jong nga ?
translation.en: Jesus answered him ,  Sayest thou this thing of thyself , or did others tell it thee of me ?
And it came to pass , as he spake these things , a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice , and said unto him , Blessed is the womb that bare thee , and the paps which thou hast sucked .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa kane , ka kynthei ka la kren na u paidbah bad ka la ong ha u ,  A katno kaba kmen long ka briew kaba la kha bad kaba la bsa la pjiah ïa me !

translation.en: And she said unto her mistress , Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria ! for he would recover him of his leprosy .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka ong ïa la ka kynrad ,  Nga kwah ba u kynrad jong nga un lah ban leit sha u nongïathuhlypa uba shong ha Samaria ! Un pynkhiah ïa u na ka jingpang jong u .

translation.en: But if there be no interpreter , let him keep silence in the church ; and let him speak to himself , and to God .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ym don mano mano ba lah ban batai , te uta uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher u dei ban sngap jar noh bad kren tang ha lade bad ha U Blei .

translation.en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness , and maketh collops of fat on his flanks .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u long uba sarong bad uba ïaleh pyrshah ; u bat ïa la ka stieh ha ka jingmutlop bad u tur ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei .
Ïa ka sanphew sentimitar kaba tam na ka lynter jong kata ka jingtap ha baroh arliang dei ban wah ha ki krung jong ka ba kan ïa .
translation.en: And a cubit on the one side , and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent , it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side , to cover it .

translation.kha: Ki shah ïa ki khunlung jong ki ban ïap ha jingthngan ka bad jingsliang ; ki khynnah ki khrong jingbam ym kaba don mano mano ban ai ha ki .
translation.en: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst : the young children ask bread , and no man breaketh it unto them .
But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon  ; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead .
translation.kha: Ki paid ka Judah ki pynïap kylla ïa ki nongpynïap ïa u Amon bad ki pynlong syiem ïa u Josaïah u khun jong u .

translation.en: And said , This fellow said , I am able to destroy the temple of God , and to build it in three days .
translation.kha: Khatduh ar ngut ki rangbah ki la wan bad ki la ong ,  Une u briew u la ong , ‘ Nga lah ban pynjot ïa ka Templ jong U Blei bad ha ki lai sngi ngan tei pat ïa ka .’

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul , that David took an harp , and played with his hand : so Saul was refreshed , and was well , and the evil spirit departed from him .
translation.kha: Naduh nangta hi , man ka por ba uta u mynsiem bymman ba phah U Blei u wan ha u Saul , u Dabid u shim ïa la ka duitara bad u tem ïa ka . Uta u mynsiem bymman u mihnoh , bad u Saul ruh u sngewpyngngad kdar , bad u shait u koit pat .
Hynrei ki la pynïap bun ki ha ka thma bad ïohknieh ïa jong naduh ka wah Arnon na shaphang haduh ka Jabbok , kata , haduh ki Ammon , namar ka khappud ki Ammon ka long kaba khlaiñ bha jingïada .
translation.en: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword , and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok , even unto the children of Ammon : for the border of the children of Ammon was strong .

translation.kha: Ïa ngi , , pynban ka long kaba dei hok , namar ba ïoh ngi ïa kaei ngi kaba dei ban ïoh na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la leh ; hynrei , um shym la leh kano kano ka bym dei .
translation.en: And we indeed justly  ; for we receive the due reward of our deeds : but this man hath done nothing amiss .
Furthermore the  Lord  spake unto me , saying , I have seen this people , and , behold , it is a stiffnecked people :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ruh ha nga , ‘ Nga tip ba kine ki briew ki long kiba mutlop palat .
Nangta u Isaïah phah ka khubor kaba ong ha u ka jubab ïa jingduwai u syiem
translation.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard .
And thou shalt be secure , because there is hope  ; yea , thou shalt dig about thee , and thou shalt take thy rest in safety .
translation.kha: Men ïoh im uba skhem bad uba dap da ka jingkyrmen ; U Blei un ïada bad un ai jingjahthait ïa me .

translation.en: If thou shalt say in thine heart , These nations are more than I  ; how can I dispossess them ?
translation.kha: Wat leit ong ha la ka dohnud , kine ki jaitbynriew ki kham bun paid ban ïa ngi , kumno ngi lah ban beh ïa ki .

translation.en: I have fed you with milk , and not with meat : for hitherto ye were not able to bear it , neither yet now are ye able .
translation.kha: Nga hap ban bsa ïa phi da ka dud , ym da ka jingbam kaba eh , namar phim pat shym kotbor ïa ka . Bad wat haduh mynta phim pat long kiba kotbor ïa ka , namar phi dang im kumba im ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And David was greatly distressed  ; for the people spake of stoning him , because the soul of all the people was grieved , every man for his sons and for his daughters : but David encouraged himself in the  Lord  his God .
translation.kha: U Dabid u don mynta ha ka jingma kaba khraw , namar ki briew jong u kiba la sngewkthang haba ki la duh ïa la ki khun ki kti bad ki byrngem ban lynthem maw ïa u ; hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u ai ha u ka jingshlur .
U Ahab u leit phai sha la ïing , u da sngewsih bad bitar ïa kaei kaba u Naboth ong u ha u . U dem ha la jingthiah ka u , phai shaphang ka kynroh , bad um treh bam ei ei .
translation.en: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him : for he had said , I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers . And he laid him down upon his bed , and turned away his face , and would eat no bread .

translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba kham matlah ban ïa u shakri jong , nga uba kham kyllut ban ïa u nonglamktien ba nga phah ?
translation.en: Who is blind , but my servant ? or deaf , as my messenger that I sent ? who is blind as he that is perfect , and blind as the  Lord s  servant ?

translation.kha: ki shipai bakynsai tam jong u yn pynïap ha ka thma bad kiba lait im yn pynsakma ki phang baroh . phan tip ba ma nga U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword , and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds : and ye shall know that I the  Lord  have spoken it .
These things I command you , that ye love one another .
translation.kha: Kane , te , ka long kaei kaba nga hukum ïa phi ; to ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .

Sa shisien pat ki Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai da kaba mane ïa ki Baal bad ïa ki Astarte , lem bad ïa ki jong blei ki Syria , jong ki Sidon , jong ki , Moab jong ki Ammon , bad jong ki Philistia . Ki la iehnoh ïa U Trai bad ki la sangeh ban mane ïa u .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim , and Ashtoreth , and the gods of Syria , and the gods of Zidon , and the gods of Moab , and the gods of the children of Ammon , and the gods of the Philistines , and forsook the  Lord  , and served not him .

translation.kha: La don ka jingsuk ha ri ka haduh sawphew snem , bad nangta u Othniel u la ïap .
translation.en: And the land had rest forty years . And Othniel the son of Kenaz died .

translation.kha: Ngi jan u syiem Joram u jam . U Trai u la ïa ngi lai ngut ha ka u Moab !
translation.en: And the king of Israel said , Alas ! that the  Lord  hath called these three kings together , to deliver them into the hand of Moab !
And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire , and used divination and enchantments , and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
translation.kha: Ki kñia ïa ki khun shynrang bad kynthei kum ki jingainguh thang sha ki blei thala ; ki wad jingmut na ki nongleh byrtong bad ki nongpeit kti , bad ki aiti lut ïa lade ban leh ïa kaei kaba bakla ha khmat U  Trai  , bad kumta ki pynkhih bitar ïa U .

translation.en: And I Daniel alone saw the vision : for the men that were with me saw not the vision  ; but a great quaking fell upon them , so that they fled to hide themselves .
translation.kha: Nga la long tang ma nga hi uba la ïohi ïa ka jingïohipaw . Ki rangbah kiba ïadon bad nga kim shym ïohi ei ei , hynrei ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la ïamareh bad leit rieh .

translation.en: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these  ; The first , Simon , who is called Peter , and Andrew his brother  ; James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother  ;
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki apostol : uba nyngkong , U Simon ( ïa uba la khot u Petros ) bad u para jong u , u Andriw ; u Jakob bad u para jong u , u Ïoannis , ki khun jong u Sebedi ;

translation.en: And blessed is she that believed : for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord .
translation.kha: A katno pha long kaba kmen ban ngeit ba ka khubor jong U Trai ha pha kan urlong shisha !
bishni ïa kito kiba la bad la leit noh ; long kiba kham bha ban ïa kito kiba .
translation.en: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive .

translation.kha: U Moses u ïa kine ki jingbthah ha ki nongïalam na jait Israel .
translation.en: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded .

translation.kha: To kyrpad ïa U ban Blei kyrkhu ïa kito kiba pynshitom ïa phi — ho-oid , to kyrpad ïa u ban , kyrkhu ym ban tim .
translation.en: Bless them which persecute you : bless , and curse not .

translation.kha: Ka la ïohi ka jingbam ba la buh ha ka miej jong u , ïa ki ïing sah jong ki rangbah synshar jong u , ïa ki shakri kiba shakri ïa u ha ki jingkhawai , bad ïa ki jingkñia kiba u ai ha ka Templ . ïa ka .
translation.en: And the meat of his table , and the sitting of his servants , and the attendance of his ministers , and their apparel , and his cupbearers , and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the  Lord   ; there was no more spirit in her .

translation.kha: Te phi ong , ‘ Lymda u para khatduh phi jong u wan lang bad phi , yn shah ym shuh ïa phi ban wan ha khmat jong nga .’
translation.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants , Except your youngest brother come down with you , ye shall see my face no more .

translation.kha: Baal nga la Japheth ïa ki , pjah nong Ijipt kin tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh , upon his chariots , and upon his horsemen .
Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud : he scattereth his bright cloud :
translation.kha: Ka leilieh ka thaba na ki lyoh ,

translation.en: With three rows of great stones , and a row of new timber : and let the expenses be given out of the king s house :
translation.kha: Ïa ki kynroh dei ban tei da shi syrtap ka dieng halor man ki lai syrtap ki maw . Ïa baroh ki jingpynlut pynsep dei ban siew na ka ïing jingkynshew syiem .

translation.en: They chose new gods  ; then was war in the gates : was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel ?
translation.kha: Nangta la don ka thma ha ka ri , Haba ki Israel ki jied ki blei thymmai . Na ki sawphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha Israel Don mano mano ba rah ïa ka stieh ne u sum ?
Haba plie ïa ki jingtep ha kiba tep ïa ki briew jong bad sei noh ki , sa ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have opened your graves , O my people , and brought you up out of your graves ,
And by a prophet the  Lord  brought Israel out of Egypt , and by a prophet was he preserved .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la phah ïa u nongïathuhlypa ban pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt bad ban sumar ïa ki .

translation.en: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt  ; and the frogs came up , and covered the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta u Aaron u rah ïa la u diengduh halor kita ki um ; te ki jakoid ki ïamih bad ki tap lin ïa kata ka ri .
Bad mynta , u lah ban ïarap ïa kita kiba shah pynshoi , bymsngewtynnat Eliphelet u hi bynthiew la shah pynshoi bad shahshitom .
translation.en: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted , he is able to succour them that are tempted .

translation.kha: U Blei u pynshitom ïa ki ïa kaei kaba lah ban tip shaphang U Blei ka long shai ha ki naba U Blei da lade hi u la pynshai ïa kata .
translation.en: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them ; for God hath shewed it unto them .

translation.kha: kynmaw Phan kumno pha la leh , bad sngewlehrain ïa ka haba pha ïoh pat ïa ka hynmen bad para ka jong pha . Ngan shah ïa ki ban kum long ki khun kynthei jong pha , wat la kane kam dei ka bynta jong ka jutang jong nga bad pha .
translation.en: Then thou shalt remember thy ways , and be ashamed , when thou shalt receive thy sisters , thine elder and thy younger : and I will give them unto thee for daughters , but not by thy covenant .
For thou art my hope , O Lord  God  : thou art my trust from my youth .
translation.kha: A  Trai  U Nongsynshar , nga buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha me ; nga la shaniah ha me naduh ba nga dang samla .
Ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ki tang ki bleithaw hynrei U Trai u thaw ïa ki bneng .
translation.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols : but the  Lord  made the heavens .
And Asahel pursued after Abner  ; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner .
translation.kha: u la sdang ban beh kthong ïa u Abner , u da mareh beit beit sha u .

translation.en: Harness the horses  ; and get up , ye horsemen , and stand forth with your helmets  ; furbish the spears , and put on the brigandines .
translation.kha: Teh jin ha ki kulai jong phi bad shong halor jong ki ! Ïeng ryntih bad phong ïa ki jingda khlieh jong phi ! Pynnep ïa ki sum jong phi ! Kieng ïa ka atiar jong phi !’
balsam long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba map , um la shetkylla la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa me .
translation.en: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses , though we have rebelled against him  ;
Say not , I will do so to him as he hath done to me : I will render to the man according to his work .
translation.kha: Wat ong ,  Ngan leh ïa u kumba u la leh ïa nga ! Ngan leh kylliang kumba u la leh !

translation.en: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it , and too much .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba la lah wallam ka la biang ban trei pyndep ïa ka kam baroh .
Katba mihpat Jehu u dang rung lyngba ka nongsngap , Hanun la pyrta , Me u Simri ! Paruah Kylli nongpynïap briew ïambriew dei me wan hangne ?
translation.en: And as Jehu entered in at the gate , she said , Had Zimri peace , who slew his master ?

translation.kha: Ngan pyrta jingpalat kaba kmen ;’ nga dang tem Riphath Abdon bynta juk me ; da ka longrynïeng jong nga shispah kawei ngan Habakkuk namar ba me la pynim ïa nga .
translation.en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee  ; and my soul , which thou hast redeemed .

translation.kha: Mano mano , samla ne tymmen , shynrang ne kynthei , Belteshassar bym mane ïa U , la pynïap .
translation.en: That whosoever would not seek the  Lord  God of Israel should be put to death , whether small or great , whether man or woman .
Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jerusha , the daughter of Zadok .
translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jerusha ka khun jong u Sadok .

translation.en: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way , at the head of the two ways , to use divination : he made his arrows bright , he consulted with images , he looked in the liver .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u ïeng hajan ka dak jingkdew ha kaba ka lynti ka ïakhlad . Ban tip shano ban leit , u pynkhih ïa ki khnam ; u wad jingmut na ki bleithaw jong u ; u khmih thuh ïa u khyllai jong u mrad ba la kñia .
A katno pynkynriah long kaba kmen ban ngeit Jakhin bariewblei khubor nongïatainia U Trai Jerushah bajaipdeh kan urlong shisha !
translation.en: And blessed is she that believed : for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord .

And it came to pass on the seventh day , that they said unto Samson s wife , Entice thy husband , that he may declare unto us the riddle , lest we burn thee and thy father s house with fire : have ye called us to take that we have ? is it not so ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw ki ong ïa ka tnga jong u Samson ,  Khroh ïa u tnga jong pha ban ïathuh ha ngi ka mut aïu kata ka jingkyntip . Lada pham lah , ngin wiang ding ïa ka ïing u kpa jong pha bad ngin thang lang ïa pha hangta . Pha ruh pha la khot sngewbha ïa ngi khnang ban lute ïa ngi , hato kam long kumta ?

Hynrei lada uno uno u nongïathuhlypa u nud ban kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa ka khubor kaba ngam shym la hukum ïa u , u dei ïap ban namar kata ; bad uno uno u nongïathuhlypa uba kren ha kyrteng ka kiwei jong pat ki blei u ruh u dei ban ïap .’
translation.en: But the prophet , which shall presume to speak a word in my name , which I have not commanded him to speak , or that shall speak in the name of other gods , even that prophet shall die .

translation.kha: kane ka duwan shabar ka pyrda kaba la wah ha khmat Synduk Ka Jutang Kata ka dei jaka kaba ngan ïashem bad .
translation.en: And thou shalt put it before the veil that is by the ark of the testimony , before the mercy seat that is over the testimony , where I will meet with thee .

translation.kha: Phi ïaishah ïa uno uno tap-matlah hukum ïa phi Paseah uba shim kabu ïa bymmyntoi’ lane uba nongkhaïi pah Isaak uba peit poh ïa phi lane uba thab khriat phi ha sngewskhem ngab .
translation.en: For ye suffer , if a man bring you into bondage , if a man devour you , if a man take of you , if a man exalt himself , if a man smite you on the face .

These are the feasts of the  Lord  , which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations , to offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  , a burnt offering , and a meat offering , a sacrifice , and drink offerings , every thing upon his day :
translation.kha: Kine ki long kita ki Jingkhawai Niam ha kiba phi ai burom ïa U  Trai  da kaba ïalumlang ban mane Blei bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang , ïa ki jingainguh bam , ïa ki jingkñia , bad ïa ki jingainguh dih , man la ka sngi kumba la buh .

translation.en: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress , that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands , and shine upon the counsel of the wicked ?
translation.kha: Hato ka long kaba dei ïa me ban lehbeiñ katne katne ? Ban ñiewbeiñ ïa uta uba me hi me la thaw ? Bad nangta ban phuh samrkhie ha ki jingthmu ki riewbymman ?
Ka jingieit baneh bad ka jingisynei jong U ïaineh ,
translation.en: It is of the  Lord s  mercies that we are not consumed , because his compassions fail not .
And when the words were heard which David spake , they rehearsed them before Saul : and he sent for him .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la ong , bad ki leit ïathuh ha u Saul , bad u phah khot ïa u .

translation.en: But the  Lord  was wroth with me for your sakes , and would not hear me : and the  Lord  said unto me , Let it suffice thee  ; speak no more unto me of this matter .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la bitar ïa nga namar jong phi bad um shahshkor shuh ïa nga . U ong pynban , ‘ Ka la biang katta ! Wat kren ei ei shuh shaphang kata !

translation.en: Lord  , thou wilt ordain peace for us : for thou also hast wrought all our works in us .
translation.kha: Men ai ïa ngi ka jingroi jingpar , A  Trai  ; baroh kata kaba ngi pyndep ha ka jingjop ka long ka jingmih na kaei kaba me leh .
U Samuel u ong , Balei keiñ ba me da khot nga ïa haba U Trai u la iehnoh ïa me bad u la kylla long u jong nongshun me ?
translation.en: Then said Samuel , Wherefore then dost thou ask of me , seeing the  Lord  is departed from thee , and is become thine enemy ?
When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine , they were dismayed , and greatly afraid .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul bad ki briew jong u ki ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewsheptieng her .
Ki don ki shyntur , hynrei kim lah ban bang , bad ki khmat , hynrei kim lah lamwir ïohi .
translation.en: They have mouths , but they speak not  ; eyes have they , but they see not  ;

translation.kha: Ngi ïoh jingthaba im ka dabor jong ngi ha ka jingdum ibit ka jingsngewsih kthang , Gihon Abital , bitar bad ïohpang .
translation.en: All his days also he eateth in darkness , and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness .
But was rebuked for his iniquity : the dumb ass speaking with man s voice forbad the madness of the prophet .
translation.kha: bad la sneng ïa u na ka bynta ka pop . U kada jong u , u la kren ha ka sur briew bad u la khang ïa ka kam leh bieit jong u nongïathuhlypa .
Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha , U Jisu u la jubab , Ym don uba lah ban rung sha Hima U Blei khlem kha na ka bad na U Mynsiem .
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit , he cannot enter into the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: Haba nga dem ban thiah , ki kynta ki ïaid suki nga khih pisa baroh shi miet bad slem ka ban kynjat shai .
translation.en: When I lie down , I say , When shall I arise , and the night be gone ? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day .
What , my son ? and what , the son of my womb ? and what , the son of my vows ?
translation.kha: Phi long u khun ba-ieit jong nga , ka jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong nga . Kaei ngan ïathuh ïa phi ?

translation.en: He coveteth greedily all the day long : but the righteous giveth and spareth not .
translation.kha: U briew uba hok , pat , u lah ban ai , bad ban ai kylluid .

translation.en: The Lord  God  hath opened mine ear , and I was not rebellious , neither turned away back .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ïa ka jingshemphang , bad nga shym la ïaleh pyrshah lane phai noh na u .

Nga la pynlong ïa pha ban Khaldi kum u jingsopkjat pynshah ïadep Pha la Hib jinglehburom bad jrong bad pha la long mian kynthei samla . Ka lade! jong pha ka la wandur itynnat , pahai u shñiuh jong kongsan khadar la san , hynrei pha long kaba lyngkhuit .
translation.en: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field , and thou hast increased and waxen great , and thou art come to excellent ornaments : thy breasts are fashioned , and thine hair is grown , whereas thou wast naked and bare .
Let us get up early to the vineyards  ; let us see if the vine flourish , whether the tender grape appear , and the pomegranates bud forth : there will I give thee my loves .
translation.kha: Nga la khynñiuh ; phi la pynlong ïa nga ban thrang eh ïa ka jingieit kum u nongñiah kali ïapom u thrang ïa ka thma .
U tang mar ïa kaba la , u kad ïa la jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , da jaiñ khain , bad u leit sha ka Templ jong U .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes , and covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ko khun u briew , ki briew jong me ki ïakren shaphang me jong haba ki ïakynduh hajan ki kynroh ka nongbah ne ha lynti ki hajan jingkhang ki ïing jong ki . Ki ïa-ong para ma ki ‘ , Ïa ngin ïaleit bad ka sngap ktien aïu kaba wan na U Trai mynta .’
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses , and speak one to another , every one to his brother , saying , Come , I pray you , and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the  Lord .

translation.kha: u phah ïa ki nongsyntiat , bad u shem ba u Saul u la wan hangta shisha .
translation.en: David therefore sent out spies , and understood that Saul was come in very deed .
And thou shalt receive them of their hands , and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering , for a sweet savour before the  Lord  : it is an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta , shim ïa ki na ki kti jong ki bad thang ïa ki ha kata ka duwan , halor kata ka jingainguh thang , kum ka jingainguh bam sha nga . Ka jingiwbih kaba suhsieng na kane ka jingainguh ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .

Hynrei ka jingstad kaba wan najrong nyngkong eh ka long Rumah sngur ; ka long kaba pynïashong suk , kaba jemnud bad kaba pynlong paralok ; ka dap da ka jinglehisynei bad Ïakit patlun lushia ka jingseisoh ha ki kam babha ; ka lait na ka jingshah shiliang bad ka jingarsap khylliap
translation.en: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure , then peaceable , gentle , and easy to be entreated , full of mercy and good fruits , without partiality , and without hypocrisy .
For she did not know that I gave her corn , and wine , and oil , and multiplied her silver and gold , which they prepared for Baal .
translation.kha: Kan ym tip ba dei ma nga uba la ai ïa ka u kew , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , bad baroh ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa u Baal .

translation.en: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee : they hiss and gnash the teeth : they say , We have swallowed her up : certainly this is the day that we looked for  ; we have found , we have seen it .
translation.kha: Kata ka long balei ba ki khmat jong nga ki shlei da ki ummat . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyntngen ïa nga ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban ai jingshlur ïa nga . U nongshun u la jop ïa nga ; ki briew jong nga kim don ei ei shuh kaba sah .

translation.en: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel .
translation.kha: U Dabid u khun jong u Jesse u synshar sawphew snem halor ki Israel baroh .
Manla u briew un hab ban kit ïa la jong ki ki jingeh .
translation.en: For every man shall bear his own burden .
Why saidst thou , She is my sister ? so I might have taken her to me to wife : now therefore behold thy wife , take her , and go thy way .
translation.kha: Balei me ong ba ka dei ka para jong me , bad shah ïa nga ban shim ïa ka kum ka tnga jong nga ? Kane hangne ka tnga jong me ; shim noh ïa ka bad khie mihnoh .
U Trai u khot , ïa u Samuel U ruh u jubab Oi , Kynrad !
translation.en: That the  Lord  called Samuel : and he answered , Here am I .

translation.kha: Hynriew snem u la don hangta ha kaba rieh , katba ka Athalaïah ka synshar kum ka syiem jingkhynwin
translation.en: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years : and Athaliah reigned over the land .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïatih nga la ïathuh Nongpynbaptis phi ïa kane ha shuwa ba pynjam por kan poi .
translation.en: Behold , I have told you before .
And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph , even to Ephraim and to Manasseh , saying , Thou art a great people , and hast great power : thou shalt not have one lot only :
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki jait Ephraim bad Manasseh ba sha Sepngi ,  Da shisha phi ïabun paid , bad phi long kiba khlaiñbor . Phi ïoh shuh shuh nalor ka shi bynta .
Hangne ka don kaei kaei shyrkhei kaba nga pyrthei : Ki briew ki lah ban bat shipor ïa la ka pisa haba lah ban donkam ïa ka ,
translation.en: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun , namely , riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt .

translation.kha: Ki khun Jakob leh kumta kumba la bthah ïa ki . Joseph u ai kali ïa ki , u syiem la hukum , bad u ai jingbam ïa ki ba kin bam ha lynti .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did so : and Joseph gave them wagons , according to the commandment of Pharaoh , and gave them provision for the way .

translation.kha: U nongaikam uba khot bylla ïa uno uno uba bieit uba u ïakynduh , u long tang ban pynmynsaw kat ïa ïatreilang kiba .
translation.en: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool , and rewardeth transgressors .

translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba U tlot palat ban ïa phi lane ba u kyllut palat ban ïa ka jingkyang jong phi ïoh jingïarap !
translation.en: Behold , the  Lord s  hand is not shortened , that it cannot save  ; neither his ear heavy , that it cannot hear :

translation.kha: Bad ïa kane Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima yn ïalap ha kylleng ka pyrthei na ka ka jingsakhi sha ki jaitbynriew baroh nangta kaba kut kan .
translation.en: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations  ; and then shall the end come .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u pynlong jingsmai ka ha U Trai : Lada men long ryngkat bad nga bad ïada ïa nga ha kane ka jingleit jong nga , bad men ai ka dih bam ka bad ka kup ka sem ïa nga ,
translation.en: And Jacob vowed a vow , saying , If God will be with me , and will keep me in this way that I go , and will give me bread to eat , and raiment to put on ,

translation.kha: Nga sei ïa bor jong nga baroh ka bynta ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh bad ngam shym wad ban kano kano ka jingdon jingem . Baroh trei na bynta jong nga , ki ïasnoh ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh .
translation.en: Yea , also I continued in the work of this wall , neither bought we any land : and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work .

translation.kha: U Saul bad ki rangbah jong u ki mih ban wad leit ïa u , hynrei u la ïohsngew shaphang kata bad u la leit u sha mawsiang lum ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Maon bad la u sah hangta . Haba u Saul u tip ïa kane u , leit beh nadien u Dabid .
translation.en: Saul also and his men went to seek him . And they told David : wherefore he came down into a rock , and abode in the wilderness of Maon . And when Saul heard that , he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon .

translation.kha: Namar kata , Kainan ïoh ïa kaba Bakhuid pan kwah , bad ki kam jong phi hi kin pynshitom ïa phi .
translation.en: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way , and be filled with their own devices .

translation.kha: Kumba nga khunlangbrot pyllait im ïa ka jingim jong phi ha sima ka sngi , ai ba U Trai un leh kumjuh ïa nga bad pyllait ïa nga na ki jingjynjar jong nga baroh !
translation.en: And , behold , as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes , so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the  Lord  , and let him deliver me out of all tribulation .

translation.kha: u la pyllait nongpeit ngi na diengsynshar nongshun jong ngi ; Mynta jingieit jong u Hissop phon Aner .
translation.en: And hath redeemed us from our enemies : for his mercy endureth for ever .
And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah , David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .
translation.kha: Haba ki Syria jong ka Damaskos ki phah ïa ka kynhun shipai ban ïarap ïa u syiem Hadadeser , u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa ka bad u pynïap arphew hajar ngut ki rangbah .
lane ban pyllait im ïa nga na uno uno u nongshun ne u nongbanbor ?
translation.en: Or , Deliver me from the enemy s hand ? or , Redeem me from the hand of the mighty ?

translation.kha: U Dabid u shim ïa ka khlieh Goliath u bad u rah ïa ka sha Jerusalem , hynrei buh u ïa ki atiar u Goliath ha la ka dara .
translation.en: And David took the head of the Philistine , and brought it to Jerusalem  ; but he put his armour in his tent .
His branches shall spread , and his beauty shall be as the olive tree , and his smell as Lebanon .
translation.kha: Kin khie im da ka jingsan bathymmai , bad kin itynnat kum ki dieng Olib . Kin iwbih kum ki dieng Kedar ka Lebanon .

Naba la thoh ha ka kitab ki Salm , ‘ Ai ba ka Ïakjakor shipa u kan kylla long kaba thylli Haggai ai ban ym don mano mano bashong manbriew jong ka .’ La Soitan ruh “shaduh Shakri Ai Thep uwei pat un shim ïa ka jaka jong sier ha ka jingshakri .’
translation.en: For it is written in the book of Psalms , Let his habitation be desolate , and let no man dwell therein : and his bishoprick let another take .

translation.kha: Wat ïa ki khun da kaba ïa ki ha duwan jong wat shah ïa la ki briew ban khan , lane ban shat ban kheiñ , lane ban ai myntor ,
translation.en: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire , or that useth divination , or an observer of times , or an enchanter , or a witch ,
But new wine must be put into new bottles  ; and both are preserved .
translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ka waiñ bathymmai dei ban theh ha ki lwa snieh bathymmai !

translation.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , that this word came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Jehoïakim , u khun jong u Josaïah , u long u syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,
Ïa ka sharak Justos ka ïingjaiñ jong u yn pyndum .
translation.en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle , and his candle shall be put out with him .
And immediately he received his sight , and followed him , glorifying God : and all the people , when they saw it , gave praise unto God .
translation.kha: Hangta hi u la lah ban imat pat , bad u la bud ïa U Jisu , da kaba ainguh ïa U Blei . Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa kata , ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning , that there were thunders and lightnings , and a thick cloud upon the mount , and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud  ; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled .
translation.kha: Ha ka step jong ka sngi kaba lai , la don u pyrthat bad ka leilieh , u lyoh uba rben u la paw halor u lum , bad la ïohsngew ïa ka turoi kaba sawa jam . Baroh ki briew kiba don ha ka jaka sher dara ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

jingïathiah U pynphuh u long u ba khwan myntoi , kiba lalot , kiba leh sarong , bad ba-ishyrkhei kyr-eit ; kin krenbeiñ , kin ym kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , ki bymsngewnguh , bad ki bymriewblei Ebal
translation.en: For men shall be lovers of their own selves , covetous , boasters , proud , blasphemers , disobedient to parents , unthankful , unholy ,
For if God spared not the angels that sinned , but cast them down to hell , and delivered them into chains of darkness , to be reserved unto judgment  ;
translation.kha: U Blei um shym la shah jem ïa ki angel kiba la leh pop , hynrei u la bret ïa ki sha dujok , ha kaba la khum kynjri ïa ki ha ka jingdum , da kaba ap ïa ka Sngi ka Jingbishar .
Lada phi jubab ïa ka jingkylli bieit , phin long kum Long briew uba bieit Memphis kylli ïa ka thliem
translation.en: Answer not a fool according to his folly , lest thou also be like unto him .
And say unto him , By what authority doest thou these things ? and who gave thee this authority to do these things ?
translation.kha: bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Me don hok aïu ba me leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?

translation.en: But Paul said , I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus , a city in Cilicia , a citizen of no mean city : and , I beseech thee , suffer me to speak unto the people .
translation.kha: U Paul u la jubab ,  Nga long u Jiw , ïa uba la kha ha Tarsos ha Kilikia , u traishnong ka nongbah ba-donnam . Sngewbha shah ïa nga ban kren ha u paidbah .

translation.en: And Absalom , and all the people the men of Israel , came to Jerusalem , and Ahithophel with him .
translation.kha: U Absalom bad baroh ki Israel baroh lem bad u ki rung sha Jerusalem , bad u Ahithophel u la don ryngkat bad ki .
nongkhaïi ki ong ha ka , kiei kiba bha kiba pha angnud ban ïoh ki la jah , bad baroh ka spah jong bad ka rong phong jong pha ki la leit , phan ym shem shuh ïa ki !
translation.en: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee , and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee , and thou shalt find them no more at all .

translation.kha: Trai ong u Moses Mynta ngan pynhap na ïa phi baroh . Ki ki dei ban mih shabar man ka sngi ban lum kat ban biang na bynta ka sngi . Da kumta nga lah ban tynjuh ki ban la kin kohnguh ne em ïa ki jingbthah jong .
translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto Moses , Behold , I will rain bread from heaven for you  ; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day , that I may prove them , whether they will walk in my law , or no .
Shall we give , or shall we not give ? But he , knowing their hypocrisy , said unto them ,  Why tempt ye me ? bring me a penny , that I may see it .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka buit bashapoh jong ki bad u la jubab ,  Balei ba phi ïapyrshang ban riam ïa nga ? Wallam ïa ka sbai rupa , bad ai ba ngan khmih ïa ka .
Kumta la wan ïalam biang ïa u Moses bad u Aaron sha u Pharaoh , bad ong u ha ki , Phi ban lah leit bad mane ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi Hynrei . pynthikna mano ban leit ?
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh : and he said unto them , Go , serve the  Lord  your God : but who are they that shall go ?

translation.kha: Balei ba phi sheptieng haduh katne ? U Jisu u la jubab . Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit don ! Nangta u la khie joit bad la hukum ïa ki lyer bad ïa ki jingat ban sangeh , bad ka don ka jingjai jai kaba khraw .
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Why are ye fearful , O ye of little faith ?  Then he arose , and rebuked the winds and the sea  ; and there was a great calm .
Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers .
translation.kha: To nang ïaid , bad pyndep ïa kaei kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la sdang !
Ha kane ka sngi nga ai ha phi ïa ka te hapdeng Amon lapsan bad Jingpynïap jingtim —
translation.en: Behold , I set before you this day a blessing and a curse  ;
To reveal his Son in me , that I might preach him among the heathen ; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood :
translation.kha: Bad ynda u la kut jingmut ban pynpaw ïa la U Khun ha nga , khnang ba nga lah ban ïalap ïa ka khubor babha shaphang jong u ha ki Jentil , ngam shym la leit wad buit nano nano ,
U la long u nongïalam ki Israel haduh snem . u la bad la tep ïa ha Shamir .
translation.en: And he judged Israel twenty and three years , and died , and was buried in Shamir .

translation.kha: Uta u briew um treh shuh ban ha kata ka miet , kumta ma u bad tnga jong u ki sdang ïa jingleit jong ki , ryngkat bad u ki bad kita ar tylli kiba kit jingkit ha ki jin . Ka sngi la jan sep haba ki poi hajan Jebus ( kata ka dei ka Jerusalem ) , kumta shakri u ong ha la u kynrad , Balei sangeh ban sahmiet kane ka nongbah ki Jebus ?
translation.en: And when they were by Jebus , the day was far spent  ; and the servant said unto his master , Come , I pray thee , and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites , and lodge in it .

translation.kha: U la pyrkhat , u Lada Iso u wan ïaleh ïa kawei ka kynhun bad u pynjot ïa , ka kata kawei pat ka kynhun ka lah ban lait im .
translation.en: And said , If Esau come to the one company , and smite it , then the other company which is left shall escape .
And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments : and Pharaoh s heart was hardened , neither did he hearken unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongleh myntor jong u Pharaoh ki la leh kumjuh da ka myntor jong ki ; bad u Pharaoh u dang mutlop hi kumba u long . Kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong , u Pharaoh u la kyntait ban shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
Baroh shi jingim jong nga , nga la kitkhia Pynkyntang ki .
translation.en: ( For from my youth he was brought up with me , as with a father , and I have guided her from my mother s womb  ; )
And he said unto her ,  For this saying go thy way  ; the devil is gone out of thy daughter .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong ïa ka ,  Namar kata ka jubab , khie leit phai pat sha ïing , ha kaba phan shem ba u ksuid u la mihnoh na ka khun jong pha !
Hynrei , U Khrist u long uba lah ban shaniah kum U Khun uba dei peit ïa ka ïing Blei U . Ngi long ïing ka jong u lada ngi ïaineh ha ka jingshlur bad ngi long skhem ha kaei kaba kyrmen ngi .
translation.en: But Christ as a son over his own house  ; whose house are we , if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end .

translation.kha: bad da ka jinglong la kloi ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha jingsuk ka , kum ki juti jong phi .
translation.en: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace ;
The rich shall not give more , and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel , when they give an offering unto the  Lord  , to make an atonement for your souls .
translation.kha: Haba ki siew ïa kane ka dor na ka bynta la ka jingim , uba riewspah un ym ai tam , bad uba duk un ym ai duna .

translation.en: He stood , and measured the earth : he beheld , and drove asunder the nations  ; and the everlasting mountains were scattered , the perpetual hills did bow : his ways are everlasting .
translation.kha: Haba u sangeh , ka pyrthei ka khih ; u tang shu peit , ki jaitbynriew ki kyiuh . Ki lumbah ba bymjukut ki khih ; ki lumrit baneh junom ki ngam shapoh , ki lumrit ha kiba u ju ïaid ha ki por mynbarim .
Khie leit sha ka Wah wait bad buhrieh ïa ki patlun lyngkot sngewma ka thliew jingklim ki mawsiang .
translation.en: Take the girdle that thou hast got , which is upon thy loins , and arise , go to Euphrates , and hide it there in a hole of the rock .

translation.kha: ainguh ïa U Trai , naba u long bad ka jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Ngan wanrah ruh ka jingbam ; kan ai bor phi katba phi bteng ïa jingïaid phi . Phi la pyndonburom ïa haba wan ha ïing jong nga , kumta ngan shakri ïa phi . jubab , Khublei shibun ; ngi sngewbha ïa kata
translation.en: And I will fetch a morsel of bread , and comfort ye your hearts  ; after that ye shall pass on : for therefore are ye come to your servant . And they said , So do , as thou hast said .

translation.kha: U Ephraim u kpa jong ki u ïambriew ka bynta jong ki bun sngi bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u ki wan ïa u .
translation.en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days , and his brethren came to comfort him .

translation.kha: Ïa u la Asaph thung nongïalam bad ïa u Sekharaïah kum u nongïarap . La thung ïa u Jeiel u , Shemiramoth u , Jehiel , u Mattithaïah , u Eliab , u Benaïah , u Obed Edom bad u Jeiel ban tem ki duitara . U Asaph un pynsawa ki shakuriaw ,
translation.en: Asaph the chief , and next to him Zechariah , Jeiel , and Shemiramoth , and Jehiel , and Mattithiah , and Eliab , and Benaiah , and Obed–edom : and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps  ; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals  ;
Therefore said I , The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal , and I have not made supplication unto the  Lord  : I forced myself therefore , and offered a burnt offering .
translation.kha: kumta nga la pyrkhat , ‘ Ki Philistia kin wan tur ïaleh ïa nga hangne ha Gilgal , bad ngam shym la pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong U  Trai .’ Kumta nga sngew ba nga dei ban ai ka jingkñia .

translation.en: He hath shewed thee , O man , what is good  ; and what doth the  Lord  require of thee , but to do justly , and to love mercy , and to walk humbly with thy God ?
translation.kha: Em , U  Trai  u la ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba bha . Kaei kaba u dawa na ngi ka long kane : Ban leh ïa kaei kaba hok , ban pyn-i ïa ka jingieit baneh , bad ban im ha ka jingïasyllok basngewrit bad U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he began to reign , as soon as he sat on his throne , that he slew all the house of Baasha : he left him not one that pisseth against a wall , neither of his kinsfolks , nor of his friends .
translation.kha: Mar ïalong syiem , u Simri u la pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot na ka longïing u Baasha . Ïa uwei pa uwei u ba-ha-ïing bad uwei pa uwei u paralok la pynïap .

translation.en: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained .
translation.kha: Kine ki longïing jong ka kur Kohath ki la ïohpdiang shiphew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
Nga kyntu ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit , da U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi da bad ka jingieit kaba Mynsiem U u ai : To bad ïasoh nga ha ka jingduwai shitrhem sha U Blei na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: Now I beseech you , brethren , for the Lord Jesus Christ s sake , and for the love of the Spirit , that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me ;
Issachar , Zebulun , and Benjamin ,
translation.kha: U Issakhar , U Sebulun , U Benjamin ,

translation.en: And they were the more fierce , saying , He stirreth up the people , teaching throughout all Judaea , beginning from Galilee to this place .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ïa-ban kham jur shuh shuh ,  Da ka jinghikai jong u , u la sdang ka jingpynkhihwin hapdeng ki briew ha baroh kylleng ka Judia . U la sdang ha Galilaïa bad mynta u la poi hangne .
U Philip u la u u la ïohsngew u dang pule u nongïathuhlypa . kylli ïa , Hato me sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba me pule ?
translation.en: And Philip ran thither to him , and heard him read the prophet Esaias , and said , Understandest thou what thou readest ?

translation.kha: To hikai ïa ngi aïu ngin ong ha U Blei ; ki jingmut jong ngi ki ; thylli ngim don ei ei ban ong .
translation.en: Teach us what we shall say unto him  ; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness .

translation.kha: Katto katne u na symbai ki la hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah , kiba la san bad ryngkat ki jingthung bad ki la kjap ïa ki .
translation.en: And some fell among thorns  ; and the thorns sprang up with it , and choked it .
And at this house , which is high , every one that passeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss  ; and they shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and to this house ?
translation.kha: Kane ka ïing kaba da kat ka ïing kan kylla long kaba sah kynjah , bad kat uba ïaid najan jong ka un kyndit thret bad un pang met ; bad kin ïakylli , ‘ Balei mo U  Trai  u la leh sat kumne ïa kane ka ri bad ïa kane ka ïing ?’

translation.en: Thou hast covered with anger , and persecuted us : thou hast slain , thou hast not pitied .
translation.kha: Me la thwet ïa ngi bad pynïap ïa ngi ; ïa ka jingisynei jong me la buhrieh da ka jingbitar jong me ,

translation.en: For the vile person will speak villany , and his heart will work iniquity , to practise hypocrisy , and to utter error against the  Lord  , to make empty the soul of the hungry , and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail .
translation.kha: Uba bieit u kren bieit bad u pyrkhat ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew . Kaei kaba u leh bad kaei kaba u ong ka long ka jingibeiñ ïa U  Trai  , bad um ju bsa ïa kiba thngan lane um ju ai ka jingdih ïa kiba sliang .
Hynrei kim shym bud ïa ka Rumah u kpa jong ki ; ki im sngi tang ha kaba kamai spah , kumta ki bamsap bad kim bishar hok ïa ki jingïakajia ran
translation.en: And his sons walked not in his ways , but turned aside after lucre , and took bribes , and perverted judgment .

translation.kha: To Gasa ban wan noh sha nga .
translation.en: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me :

translation.kha: Kumta , mynta naduh , kohnguh ïa U Trai , bad wat long shuh kiba mutlop .
translation.en: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart , and be no more stiffnecked .
We see his love in all that he has made .
translation.kha: Ngi ïohi ïa ka jingieit jong u ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u la thaw .

translation.en: The field is the world  ; the good seed are the children of the kingdom  ; but the tares are the children of the wicked one  ;
translation.kha: ka lyngkha ka long ka pyrthei ; u symbai babha u long ki briew kiba long ki jong ka Hima ; ki ñiut ki long ki briew kiba long ki jong Uta u Basniew ;

translation.en: Behold , thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly  ; and shalt thou be delivered ?
translation.kha: Me la ïohsngew kaei ba u patsha Assyria u leh ïa kano kano ka ri kaba u rai ban pynjot . Hato me pyrkhat ba men lait im ?

translation.en: The  Lord  is great in Zion  ; and he is high above all the people .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba khlaiñbor ha Seïon ; U long uba hakhlieh tam halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: And did all drink the same spiritual drink : for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them : and that Rock was Christ .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la bam ïa ujuh u kpu ba kynja mynsiem bad ki la dih ïa kajuh ka jingdih ba kynja mynsiem . Ki la dih na uta u mawsiang ba kynja mynsiem ba la leit lem bad ki ; bad uta u mawsiang u la long U Khrist hi .
tip ba U Khrist u long uba hok ; phi dei ban tip , namarkata , ba uei baroh leh ïa kaei kaba dei u long u khun U .
translation.en: If ye know that he is righteous , ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him .
And it came to pass , when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul , that Saul said , Is this thy voice , my son David ? And Saul lifted up his voice , and wept .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la dep kren , u Saul u ong ,  Hato dei ma phi shisha , ko Dabid u khun jong nga ?  Bad u la sdang ban ïam .

Nga tip ba kaei kaei U kaba Blei u leh kan neh junom . Phim lah ban bynrap ei ei ha ka lane shim noh ïa kano kano na ka . Bad kawei kaba U Blei u leh ka long ban pynlong ïa ngi ban ïeng ka ha jingburom ïa u .
translation.en: I know that , whatsoever God doeth , it shall be for ever : nothing can be put to it , nor any thing taken from it : and God doeth it , that men should fear before him .
And they went in to the king into the court , but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe , and told all the words in the ears of the king .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar ki buh ïa ka kot kli ha ka kamra u Elishama , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ki leit sha ka phyllaw ka ïingsyiem , bad ki la ïathuh ïa baroh kiei kiei ha u syiem .

translation.en: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway , to cut off those of his that did escape  ; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress .
translation.kha: Pha la dei ban ym ïeng ha ka jaka ba ïashem ki lad ban kem ïa kito kiba pyrshang ban lait im . Pha la dei ban ym aiti ïa ki sha ki nongshun ha ka sngi jong ka jingshipa jong ki .

translation.en: There is that maketh himself rich , yet hath nothing : there is that maketh himself poor , yet hath great riches .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba leh riewspah , hynrei kim don ei ei . Kiwei ki leh duk , hynrei ki don ka spah bah .
hynrei ha ka jah noh , bad ki phud ki rngad bad ki tyrkhong .
translation.en: What time they wax warm , they vanish : when it is hot , they are consumed out of their place .

translation.kha: Ngi ngeit , kaei kaba pha la ïathuh , hynrei namar ma hi da ngi la ïohsngew ïa u , bad ngi tip ba une da shisha u long u Nongpynim jong ka .
translation.en: And said unto the woman , Now we believe , not because of thy saying : for we have heard him ourselves , and know that this is indeed the Christ , the Saviour of the world .
Think not that I am come to destroy the law , or the prophets : I am not come to destroy , but to fulfil .
translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba nga la wan ban pyndam noh ïa ka Hukum u Moses bad ïa ki jinghikai jong ki nongïathuhlypa . Ngam shym la wan ban pyndam noh ïa ki , hynrei ban pynurlong shisha ïa ki jinghikai jong ki .

Balei pynsan phi wan ram ïa ngi na Ijipt sha ka jaka kaba sniew kum kane ha kaba u jingthung ei ei ruh Jingijli mih ? sarang ka dei ka jaka Shur kaba u “Nga ruh um long , u soh Dumbur ruh um long , neh sohwaiñ ruh um long , arliang u sahkut Pomkranet sharum Adaminekeb ( . Wat ka umdih ruh Mephibosheth don !
translation.en: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt , to bring us in unto this evil place ? it is no place of seed , or of figs , or of vines , or of pomegranates  ; neither is there any water to drink .
And God spake unto Noah , saying ,
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Noah ,
ka jingshim kaba jylliew Nongshun dkhat nongbah Akasia ; bad ngan pyngtngen ïa phi baroh .
translation.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter , though I have been a rebuker of them all .
I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy bed , and go thy way into thine house .
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa me , to ïeng , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad to leit noh sha ïing !

hynrei ngan shah ba u khun jong u Solomon un ïa ïoh kawei ka , jait ba khnang borabor ngan don uwei uba mih pateng na u Dabid u shakri nga jong ban synshar ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la jied kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .
translation.en: And unto his son will I give one tribe , that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem , the city which I have chosen me to put my name there .

translation.kha: Te uta uwei tyngeh u Jehoïakhin , uba la poi nyngkong ha ka jingtep , Mediterranian ruh u la rung Mikhal artatien u :14 ïohi bad u la ngeit Jehukal
translation.en: Then went in also that other disciple , which came first to the sepulchre , and he saw , and believed .

translation.kha: Te uta u briew u la leit noh bad u la ïathuh ïa nongsynshar ki jong ki Jiw ba dei U Jisu uba la ïa pynkhiah u .
translation.en: The man departed , and told the Jews that it was Jesus , which had made him whole .

translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kiba Lahmam ka thngan ïa ki , ka ba-pynmynsaw pynheh ïa la ka shyntur . Ka shongtynrai shapoh ïa ki riewdonburom jong ka Jerusalem longïing ki paid ba kaw kaw jong ki riewpaidbah .
translation.en: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself , and opened her mouth without measure : and their glory , and their multitude , and their pomp , and he that rejoiceth , shall descend into it .

For the  Lord  shall comfort Zion : he will comfort all her waste places  ; and he will make her wilderness like Eden , and her desert like the garden of the  Lord   ; joy and gladness shall be found therein , thanksgiving , and the voice of melody .
translation.kha: Ngan pyn-i ïa ka jinglehisynei ïa ka Jerusalem , sha kito baroh kiba shong halor ki jingpra jong ka . Wat la ka jaka jong ka , ka long kum ka ri shyiap , ngan pynlong ïa ka , ka kper , kum ka kper kaba nga la thung ha Eden . Ka jingkmen bad ka jinglehkmen kin don hangta , bad ki jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh bad jingainguh ïa nga .

translation.en: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest :
translation.kha: Phim dei ban leit rah ïa la ki jingainguh kat shaba phi ibit ;
Man ka snem , ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong phi phi dei ban ïabam ïa ki khmat U ha kata ka jaka mane Blei U Trai jied .
translation.en: Thou shalt eat it before the  Lord  thy God year by year in the place which the  Lord  shall choose , thou and thy household .

translation.kha: U briew uba alhia shong hapoh ïing u ba u sing u ban ïoh ïa u lada u mih shabar .
translation.en: The slothful man saith , There is a lion without , I shall be slain in the streets .
That the trial of your faith , being much more precious than of gold that perisheth , though it be tried with fire , might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Ka jingthmu jong ki ka long ban pynshisha ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka long kaba sngur . Wat ïa ka ksiar , ïa kaba lah ban pynduh , la phrang da ka ding ; bad kumta ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , kaba kham kordor shuh shuh ban ïa ka ksiar , dei ruh ban phrang , khnang ba kan lah ban shah . Te phin sa ïohpdiang ïa ka jingïaroh bad ka burom bad ka jingpyndonburom ha ka Sngi haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .

translation.en: In all thy ways acknowledge him , and he shall direct thy paths .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa U  Trai  ha kaei kaei kaba phi leh , bad un pyn-i ha phi ïa ki lynti kaba dei .

translation.en: And the same John had his raiment of camel s hair , and a leathern girdle about his loins  ; and his meat was locusts and wild honey .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jaiñ jong U Ïoannis la shna da u shñiuh jong ka ut ; u la panpoh da u panpoh snieh ha ka syngkai jong u , bad ka jingbam jong u ka la long da ki puit bad ka ngap khlaw .

Hynñiew sngi jinglehshitom rakhe da Lem Akasia ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Ki la dap da ka jingkmen namar U Trai u Jeroboam pynlong ïa u patsha jingtiengburom ka Assyria ban lehsbun sngap ki , ba u kyrshan ïa ki ha ka jingtrei jong ki ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka Templ jong jingkhraw Blei ki Israel jemnud
translation.en: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy : for the  Lord  had made them joyful , and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them , to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God , the God of Israel .

translation.kha: U Trai sngewbha u ïa ki briew kiba bha , hynrei u pynrem ïa kito kiba thmu sniew .
translation.en: A good man obtaineth favour of the  Lord  : but a man of wicked devices will he condemn .
And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword , and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds : and ye shall know that I the  Lord  have spoken it .
translation.kha: Ïa ki shipai bakynsai tam jong u yn pynïap ha ka thma bad ïa kiba lait im yn pynsakma ha ki phang baroh . Te phan tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram ,
translation.kha: Ainguh ïa ka jingainguh bam da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad u masi lyngraw , sa ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ,
Ki la jubab , Ngim kwah ban lynthem maw ïa me namar kano na ki kam babha , hynrei namar ka Blei jong Me long u briew hynrei me pyrshang ban pynlong Blei ïa lade !
translation.en: The Jews answered him , saying , For a good work we stone thee not  ; but for blasphemy  ; and because that thou , being a man , makest thyself God .
For the turning away of the simple shall slay them , and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki bym don jingtip ki ïap namar ba ki kyntait ïa ka jingstad . Ki briew kiba mutlop ki shah pynjot namar ba ki leh bymsuidñiew .
Wat pyrkhat phan kham lait im ban ïa kiwei pat ki Jiw tang namar pha don ïingsyiem .
translation.en: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther , Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king s house , more than all the Jews .

translation.kha: Kita ki rangbah synshar kin ong ruh ha uta u paidïapom , Don ‘ mo hangne uba sheptieng bad uba rit ? mynsiem Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la , ïing ïoh ba u pynsyier mynsiem ïa kiwei pat .’
translation.en: And the officers shall speak further unto the people , and they shall say , What man is there that is fearful and fainthearted ? let him go and return unto his house , lest his brethren s heart faint as well as his heart .
Son of man , the house of Israel is to me become dross : all they are brass , and tin , and iron , and lead , in the midst of the furnace  ; they are even the dross of silver .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , ki Israel kim long jingmyntoi ei ei ïa nga . Ki long kum ka mar bymmyntoi shuh — ka tama , ka tin , ka nar , bad ka sisa — kiba la pynsah hadien ba la saiñ ïa ka rupa ha ka ding .

translation.en: To understand a proverb , and the interpretation  ; the words of the wise , and their dark sayings .
translation.kha: kumta ba kin shemphang ïa ki jingmut kiba rieh kiba don ha ki proberb bad ki jingeh ba ki riewstad ki kylli .

translation.en: Wherefore ye shall make images of your emerods , and images of your mice that mar the land  ; and ye shall give glory unto the God of Israel : peradventure he will lighten his hand from off you , and from off your gods , and from off your land .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban thaw ïa ki dur jong u thung bad ki dur khnai kiba la pynjulor ïa ka ri jong phi , bad phi dei ban ai burom ïa U Blei ki Israel . Lehse un sa sangeh noh na kaba pynshitom ïa phi , ïa ki blei jong phi , bad ïa ka ri jong phi .
Haba Jisu u la rung Jerusalem , nongbah baroh kawei ka khynwin jlang . Uei une ? ki briew ki la kylli .
translation.en: And when he was come into Jerusalem , all the city was moved , saying , Who is this ?
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Get thee up into this mount Abarim , and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Leit kiew sha u Lum Abarim bad khmih ïa kata ka ri kaba nga ai ha ki Israel .
( U Trai u la ong ba pyrthei baroh kawei kan kylla long ka ri khlaw , hynrei ba un ym pynjot khoit ïa ka . )
translation.en: For thus hath the  Lord  said , The whole land shall be desolate  ; yet will I not make a full end .
In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet , resort ye thither unto us : our God shall fight for us .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïohsngew ïa ka jingput ronsing , ïalumlang sawdong jong nga . U Blei jong ngi un ïaleh na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: And Israel saw that great work which the  Lord  did upon the Egyptians : and the people feared the  Lord  , and believed the  Lord  , and his servant Moses .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ka borbah da kaba U  Trai  u jop ïa ki Ijipt , ki la ïeng da kaba tiengburom ïa U  Trai  ; bad kumta ki la shaniah ha U  Trai  bad ha u Moses u shakri jong u .

translation.en: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood , he also himself likewise took part of the same  ; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death , that is , the devil  ;
translation.kha: Namar ba kita ki khun , kumba u khot ïa ki , ki long ki briew na ka doh bad ka snam , U Jisu u la long u briew kum ma ki hi bad ïoh bynta lang na ka jinglongbriew jong ki . U la leh ïa kane , khnang ba da ka jingïap jong u , u lah ban pynduh ïa u Bymman , uba don ka bor halor ka jingïap ,
Uwei na ki shiphew ngut ki ha Israel wanrah ïa ka kynhun shipai , bad kiwei kin leit ban pynshitom ïa ka Gibeah namar kane ka kam khlemrain ba la leh ha Israel .
translation.en: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel , and an hundred of a thousand , and a thousand out of ten thousand , to fetch victual for the people , that they may do , when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin , according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel .

The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah , when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah , in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha snem kaba saw ba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Barukh u thoh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ha u .
U nongrep uba la nongpynïasuk Bthah u dei shadien ïoh ïa ka bynta kaba nyngkong thew ka jingot .
translation.en: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits .

translation.kha: U Manasseh u la dap khat-ar snem ka rta mynba u long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar sanphew san ha Jerusalem . Ka jong u Hephsibah .
translation.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hephzi–bah .

translation.kha: Bad ha ka jingbitar bakhraw jong , nga ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa nga .
translation.en: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen , such as they have not heard .

Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people  ; for the cause was from the  Lord  , that he might perform his saying , which the  Lord  spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat .
translation.kha: Ka long ka mon jong U  Trai  ban pynjia ïa kaei kaba U la kren ha u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat lyngba u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa na Shiloh . Dei namar kane balei ba u syiem um shym shahshkor ïa ki paidbah .

translation.en: Charge them that are rich in this world , that they be not highminded , nor trust in uncertain riches , but in the living God , who giveth us richly all things to enjoy ;
translation.kha: To hukum ïa kita kiba riewspah ha kiei kiei jong kane ka jingim ba kin ym sngewsarong , hynrei ban buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ki , ym ha kata kaei kaei ka bym thikna kum ka spah , hynrei ha U Blei , uba ai kyrhai ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka jingsngewbha jong ngi .

U Jonah nongmihkhmat , u la snam sha ka jaka kaba marpyrshah Map ban phet ïatan pynkiew ïa-ïohbor Trai . U la Maham sha bymsuidñiew , ha kaba u la shem ïa ka liengbah ka ban sa leit sha Spain . translation.en: All this have I proved by wisdom : I said , I will be wise  ; but it was far from me .

bahynriew Gaal kdang la phet ïap bad u lynnong ostrit Philemon beh ïada ïa u . Bun ngut ki la mynsaw , pynliem haduh katai shnong .
translation.en: And Abimelech chased him , and he fled before him , and many were overthrown and wounded , even unto the entering of the gate .

translation.en: And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise : and another shall rise after them  ; and he shall be diverse from the first , and he shall subdue three kings .

translation.en: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk , and his heart was merry , he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn : and she came softly , and uncovered his feet , and laid her down .

Haba ki hynñiew snem , la ong u syiem , Nga la khmih shajrong sha sahit bneng , bad ka jingtipbriew nga ka wan phai . Nga la ïaroh ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Eh bad nga la ai ka jingpyndonburom bad ka burom ïa uta im junom . Un synshar , bad ka jong kan neh ha ki baroh .
translation.en: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven , and mine understanding returned unto me , and I blessed the most High , and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever , whose dominion is an everlasting dominion , and his kingdom is from generation to generation :
By the way that he came , by the same shall he return , and shall not come into this city , saith the  Lord .

translation.en: In those days shall Judah be saved , and Jerusalem shall dwell safely : and this is the name wherewith she shall be called , The  Lord  our righteousness .

Then said they , We will restore them , and will require nothing of them  ; so will we do as thou sayest . Then I called the priests , and took an oath of them , that they should do according to this promise .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ki la jubab ,  Ngin leh kumba phi ong . Ngin ai noh ïa ka jaka bad ngin pyrshang ban ym lum shuh ïa ki ram .  Nga khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad pynlong ïa ki nongïalam ban smai ha khmat jong ki ban bat ïa ka kular kaba ki la lah khlei .

Behold , I will send a blast upon him , and he shall hear a rumour , and return to his own land  ; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land .

Troas U lamler! u ïong ha u Moses bakyiuh jaijai dang step , leit ïakynduh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïathuh ha u ïitbniah U Trai , U Blei jong ki Hebru proh u ong , ‘ Pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga , khnang ba ki lah ban mane ïa nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh , and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of the Hebrews , Let my people go , that they may serve me .

And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel , saying , The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies , and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines  ; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom .
translation.kha: Ha kylleng ka ri ki la sdang ban ïakajia para ma ki .  U syiem Dabid u la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi ,  ki ïa-ong uwei ïa uwei pat .  U la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philistia ; hynrei mynta pat u la phet krad na u Absalom bad u la iehnoh ïa ka ri .

translation.en: And they forsook the  Lord  , and served Baal and Ashtoreth .
translation.kha: Ki la sangeh ban mane ïa U  Trai  bad ki la shakri ïa ki blei Baal bad Astarte .

Ngi kwah ba u syiem un tip ba ki Jiw kiba la wan hangne na kiwei ki ri ki , la la shong sah ha Jerusalem bad ki tei dang pat ïa kato ka nongbah kaba sniew bad kaba ïaleh pyrshah . Ki la sdang ban tei pat ïa ki kynroh shen bad kin sa pyndep ïa ki .
translation.en: Be it known unto the king , that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem , building the rebellious and the bad city , and have set up the walls thereof , and joined the foundations .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Pharisi ki la ong , U u dei rangbah jong ki ksuid uba ai ha u ka bor ban noh beh ïa ki ksuid .
translation.en: But the Pharisees said , He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils .

Kane imon long kaei kaba ki shipai ki la leh .
translation.en: They said therefore among themselves , Let us not rend it , but cast lots for it , whose it shall be : that the scripture might be fulfilled , which saith , They parted my raiment among them , and for my vesture they did cast lots . These things therefore the soldiers did .
Be thou prepared , and prepare for thyself , thou , and all thy company that are assembled unto thee , and be thou a guard unto them .
translation.kha: To ïathuh ha u ban pynkloi bad ban pynkhreh ïa la ki kynhun baroh hapoh ka jingïalam jong u .
Nga long U Trai U Blei phi , uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , kaba phi long ki .
translation.en: I am the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty , and shalt lift up thy face unto God .

translation.en: Who is gone into heaven , and is on the right hand of God  ; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him .

Haba phi ïaseng lang kum kynhun , kam dei Jingkhawai U Trai ba ïabam .
translation.en: When ye come together therefore into one place , this is not to eat the Lord s supper .

translation.en: But when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimea David s brother slew him .

For he sent letters into all the king s provinces , into every province according to the writing thereof , and to every people after their language , that every man should bear rule in his own house , and that it should be published according to the language of every people .

translation.en: He hath builded against me , and compassed me with gall and travail .

translation.en: Let the heavens rejoice , and let the earth be glad  ; let the sea roar , and the fulness thereof .

translation.en: Pilate therefore said unto him , Art thou a king then ? Jesus answered ,  Thou sayest that I am a king . To this end was I born , and for this cause came I into the world , that I should bear witness unto the truth . Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Go ye into all the world , and preach the gospel to every creature .

And he said also to the people ,  When ye see a cloud rise out of the west , straightway ye say , There cometh a shower  ; and so it is .

translation.en: And Bilhah conceived , and bare Jacob a son .

translation.en: And he led them forth by the right way , that they might go to a city of habitation .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa ki na ka lynti kaba beit sha ka nongbah ha kaba ki lah ban shong ban sah .
Ïa ka dei ban kup hapoh ka ephod suh da u saiwul uba jngum .
translation.en: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work , all of blue .

translation.en: In his neck remaineth strength , and sorrow is turned into joy before him .

translation.kha: U la ha pynbna ki briew , U briew u ban wan hadien jong u nga long uba kham khraw ïa ban nga . Ngam long uba bit nam wat ban dem bad law ïa ki juti jong u .
translation.en: And preached , saying , There cometh one mightier than I after me , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose .
Kerioth is taken , and the strong holds are surprised , and the mighty men s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image  ; which the  Lord  thy God hateth .
These things said he in the synagogue , as he taught in Capernaum .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa kane katba u dang hikai ha ka synagog ha Kapernam .

translation.en: And Balak said unto Balaam , What hast thou done unto me ? I took thee to curse mine enemies , and , behold , thou hast blessed them altogether .

translation.en: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance , when he separated the sons of Adam , he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Phi long tim ! Phi la nongrim ïa ka nongbah halor ka runar bad tei ïa ka da kam pynïap briew .
translation.en: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood , and stablisheth a city by iniquity !
And as Jesus passed forth from thence , he saw a man , named Matthew , sitting at the receipt of custom : and he saith unto him ,  Follow me .  And he arose , and followed him .

translation.en: And he said unto her , If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied , then shall I be weak , and be as another man .

translation.en: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord , which gave testimony unto the word of his grace , and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands .

translation.en: And the first came out red , all over like an hairy garment  ; and they called his name Esau .

translation.en: And walked in the statutes of the heathen , whom the  Lord  cast out from before the children of Israel , and of the kings of Israel , which they had made .

translation.en: Of the Gershonites were , Laadan , and Shimei .
