translation.en: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil , and canst not look on iniquity : wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously , and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he ?

Kynmaw aïu U Trai U Blei jong phi u la leh ïa Khnang Miriam mynba phi ïa-thngian na Ijipt .
translation.en: Remember what the  Lord  thy God did unto Miriam by the way , after that ye were come forth out of Egypt .

translation.en: Thomas saith unto him , Lord , we know not whither thou goest  ; and how can we know the way ?

translation.kha: Kane ruh ka kynthup ïa phi kiba ha Rom , ïa kiba U Blei u la khot ban long ki jong U Jisu Khrist .

translation.en: Jesus answered him ,  Sayest thou this thing of thyself , or did others tell it thee of me ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato kane ka jingkylli ka wan na me ne kiwei ki la ïathuh ïa me shaphang jong nga ?

translation.en: And I saw , and bare record that this is the Son of God .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kata ,  la ong U Ïoannis ,  bad nga ong ha phi ba une u dei U Khun U Blei .
U ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai , hynrei long kum kpa tymmen u , u syiem Dabid ; pynban , u leh ïa kaei kaba u Joash u kpa u , u la leh .
translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , yet not like David his father : he did according to all things as Joash his father did .

translation.kha: Ki la tim ïa u ki bad da , ong Me long u synran jong une u briew : Hynrei , ngi long ki synran u Moses .
translation.en: Then they reviled him , and said , Thou art his disciple  ; but we are Moses  disciples .
Behold , I cry out of wrong , but I am not heard : I cry aloud , but there is no judgment .
translation.kha: Nga pyrshah ïa kane ka jingleh jubor jong u , hynrei ym don ba shahshkor ; ym don uba ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam jong nga ban ïoh ïa ka hok .

Ki la jubab ïa u syiem lamwir ka ktien khot-sin , jingbankhia u parabangeit! Kynrad un Sakhar Gittaim ! larkam ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka jingphohsniew jong phi , bad ngin batai ïa ka bymsngewsynei phi jingphna
translation.en: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack , O king , live for ever : tell thy servants the dream , and we will shew the interpretation .

translation.kha: Man ka sngi bakhlem U pynroh u la hikai ha ka Templ . Ki Mei lyngdoh , ki nonghikai ka Hukum khatphra bad ki nongïalam jong ki paidbah ki la kwah ban pynïap ïa kyrshut ,
translation.en: And he taught daily in the temple . But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him ,
And a certain man lame from his mother s womb was carried , whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful , to ask alms of them that entered into the temple  ;
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka Khyrdop Ba-itynnat , kumba la ju khot ïa ka , la don u briew uba la dkoh baroh shi jingim . Man ka sngi la ju bah ïa u sha ka khyrdop ban khrong pisa na ki briew kiba leit shapoh ka Templ .
Ngi tip , ko syiem kynrad , haduh katno phi kwah ban kem ïa u ; kumta to sha ka ri bad ba ïohkem ïa u .
translation.en: Now therefore , O king , come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down  ; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king s hand .

translation.kha: U Mikaïah la ong ïa ki ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u la ïohsngew u Barukh u la pule ha ki paidbah .
translation.en: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard , when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people .
And he said unto them ,  That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  U Khun U Briew u long U Trai jong ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: ban ong ha ki Israel ,  Ka Jingkhawai Niam ki Ïingtrep ka sdang na ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew , bad ka neh hynñiew sngi .
U Jisu u tang mih na ka um , u ïohi ïa ka bneng ba plie bad U Mynsiem ba u wan hiar jong u ka paro .
translation.en: And straightway coming up out of the water , he saw the heavens opened , and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him :
And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues , and of evil spirits  ; and unto many that were blind he gave sight .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa kiba bun ki briew na ki jingshitom jong ki , ki jingpang jong ki , bad na ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad u la ai ka jingïohi pat ha kiba bun ki briew kiba matlah .

translation.en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins .
translation.kha: Namar ka snam ki masi kyrtong bad ki blang kan ym lah ban kit noh ïa ki pop .
U Trai u ong , Pynsawa ïa ka jingmaham ! Ki ki hiar shapoh ha ri jong nga kum ki pukni ! Ki briew jong nga ki la ïa ka jutang kaba la ïateh bad ki , ki la ïaleh ïa ka jong nga .
translation.en: Set the trumpet to thy mouth . He shall come as an eagle against the house of the  Lord  , because they have transgressed my covenant , and trespassed against my law .
And , behold , they cried out , saying , What have we to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of God ? art thou come hither to torment us before the time ?
translation.kha: Shisyndon ki la lynñiar ,  Me kwah aïu bad ngi , me U Khun jong U Blei ? Hato me la wan ban pynshitom ïa ngi ha shuwa ka por kaba dei ?

translation.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments .
translation.kha: Ha ka por shiteng synñia nga khie ban ïaroh ïa me namar ki jingbishar hok jong me .
U Jisu hadien u la mih paw ha ki synran jong jingpynhiar .
translation.en: Jesus later appeared to his apostles .

translation.kha: U Solomon lada la pyndonkam ïa kine ki dieng ha kaba shna jingker ha riewblei Templ bad Karmel ka ïingsyiem , bad Sumar kaba shna duitara bad jingtem ksai ïa ki nongput nongtem :20 Ki nongtih “Te dieng Kseh-Juniper kiba kynsai tam ïa kiba khlur wanrah pynkhynñiuh Israel , ym don shuh 25 kita ban dang lah ban ïohi biang . )
translation.en: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the  Lord  , and for the king s house , harps also and psalteries for singers : there came no such almug trees , nor were seen unto this day .

translation.kha: Haba ïa u khring ym pat shym la Othni , hynrei iktiar la Rhodes thri kum ban shu ong , ha ka met u jingïashad tymmen jong u , Jethro pynpang haba u Melkhisedek u la ïakynduh ïa u satang
translation.en: For he was yet in the loins of his father , when Melchisedec met him .

translation.kha: Kane ka la ïa pynmih ka jingïatainia kaba tyngeh hapdeng jong ki . Kumno une u u briew lah ban ai ha ngi ïa ka doh jong u ban bam ? ki la kylli .
translation.en: The Jews therefore strove among themselves , saying , How can this man give us his flesh to eat ?

translation.kha: Shisien noh sngi , ka iathuh ianga ba ka kwah miaw .
translation.en: One day , she told me that she wanted a pet cat .

translation.kha: Nangta u pynbna sha baroh jinglehkmen paid Israel , Lada phi ai ïa ka jingmynjur jong phi bad lada ka Ade ka mon Nobah Trai U Blei jong jingphohsniew , to ai ba ñiuhmat ïaphah nonglamktien sha kiwei pat ki para ri jong ngi bad sha khlup lyngdoh jingisynei ki Lebi ha ki shnong jong ki , bad ïathuh ïa ki ban ïalumlang hangne bad ngi .
translation.en: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel , If it seem good unto you , and that it be of the  Lord  our God , let us send abroad unto our brethren every where , that are left in all the land of Israel , and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs , that they may gather themselves unto us :
Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness :
translation.kha: ka jingkren jong ki ka dap da ki jingtim bakthang .

Kin ïaleh synrang ïa U Khunlangbrot ; hynrei U Khunlangbrot , Rakhe bad ki pynthikna jong u ïa kiba u Mithredath aïom , u burom jied , bad jingibieit ïaineh skhem , un jop ïa riewhok , namar ba u dei U Trai jong ki trai bad U Syiem khylliap ki syiem .
translation.en: These shall make war with the Lamb , and the Lamb shall overcome them : for he is Lord of lords , and King of kings : and they that are with him are called , and chosen , and faithful .

translation.kha: bad u la kyrpad rit ïa u khun rit jong nga ka pang jur . To sngewbha ban bad buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ka ba khiah bad ïoh im
translation.en: And besought him greatly , saying , My little daughter lieth at the point of death : I pray thee , come and lay thy hands on her , that she may be healed  ; and she shall live .

translation.kha: Ïa Maim mrad na ka bynta kane ka jingkñia sngewlwait ban pynïap khang ka bynta bashatei jong ka sngewmeng , ha kynsha ju pynïap ïa ki mrad ba la wallam ieit ki jingainguh thang , bad ïa ka snam jong jingkylluid dei ban Adithaim ha baroh sawdong jong ka duwan .
translation.en: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering : and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar .

translation.kha: To wan bad ïa u briew la ïathuh ïa nga ïa kiei kiei kiba nga la leh . Hato lah ban long U Messaïah
translation.en: Come , see a man , which told me all things that ever I did : is not this the Christ ?
And the earth shall hear the corn , and the wine , and the oil  ; and they shall hear Jezreel .
translation.kha: bad ka khyndew kan pynmih ïa u kew , bad ki sohwaiñ , bad ki soh Olib .

translation.en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron  ; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the  Lord  : and they anointed David king over Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta baroh ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la wan sha u Syiem Dabid ha Hebron . U la pynlong ïa jingïateh lok bakyntang bad ki , ki la pynsleh ïa u , bad u la long u syiem ki Israel .
Nangta pat ki la mihnoh bad sher dara ka liang kaba shatei ka Wah Arnon , ha ka ri khlaw kaba ïar shaduh khappud ri . Ka wah Arnon ka la ka pud hapdeng ka ri bad ki Amor . )
translation.en: From thence they removed , and pitched on the other side of Arnon , which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites : for Arnon is the border of Moab , between Moab and the Amorites .
Then said I , O Lord  God  , cease , I beseech thee : by whom shall Jacob arise ? for he is small .
translation.kha: Nangta nga ong ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , to keiñ noh ! Kumno ki briew jong me ki lah ban lait im ? Ki long kiba rit bad kiba tlot katta katta !

translation.en: Unto whom it was revealed , that not unto themselves , but unto us they did minister the things , which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven  ; which things the angels desire to look into .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynpaw ha kine ki nongïathuhlypa ba ka jingtrei jong ki kam shym la long na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong ki hi , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi , katba ki dang lah kren shaphang kito kiei kiei ïa kiba phi la ïohsngew mynta na ki nonglamktien kiba la pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha da ka bor U Mynsiem Bakhuid ba la phah na bneng . Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba wat ki angel ki thrang ban shemphang .
Me la long u nongshun baïaineh ka Israel bad me shah ba ki briew jong ka kin pynïap shah ha ka por ka jingjynjar jong ka , ka por jong jingshah ka pynshitom bakhatduh ki namar pop jong ka .
translation.en: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred , and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity , in the time that their iniquity had an end :
Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments , and stood before the angel .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la ïeng hangta , u da phong ki jaiñ bajakhlia .

translation.en: And I said , Let them set a fair mitre upon his head . So they set a fair mitre upon his head , and clothed him with garments . And the angel of the  Lord  stood by .
translation.kha: U la hukum ïa ki shakri ban pynspong ka jaiñspong bakhuid halor ka khlieh jong u Joshua . Ki la leh kumta , bad nangta ki la pynphong ki jaiñ thymmai ïa u katba u angel jong U  Trai  u dang ïeng hangta .

translation.en: And it was told David  ; and he gathered all Israel , and passed over Jordan , and came upon them , and set the battle in array against them . So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians , they fought with him .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kata , u lumlang ïa ki shipai Israel , u jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad u buh ïa ki ha ka jaka ba phai khmat ïa ki Syria .

la hukum ïa u ban shong ha madan . Nangta u la shim ïa ki hynñiew tylli kpu bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha la ki synran ban sam ha ki paidbah ; bad ki synran la leh kumta .
translation.en: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground : and he took the seven loaves , and gave thanks , and brake , and gave to his disciples to set before them  ; and they did set them before the people .
And the  Lord  , he it is that doth go before thee  ; he will be with thee , he will not fail thee , neither forsake thee : fear not , neither be dismayed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  hi un ïalam ïa me bad un don ryngkat bad me . Un ym ieh ïa me lane kyntait ïa me ; kumta wat syier bad wat sheptieng .

translation.en: Namely , Bezer in the wilderness , in the plain country , of the Reubenites  ; and Ramoth in Gilead , of the Gadites  ; and Golan in Bashan , of the Manassites .
translation.kha: Ïa kiba na ka jait Reuben , ka don ka shnong Beser ha kawei ka madan kaba halor lum ha ka ri shyiap ; ïa kiba na ka jait Gad , ka don ka Ramoth ha ri Gilead ; bad ïa kiba na ka jait Manasseh , ka don ka Golan ha ri Bashan .

translation.en: And Joash said unto all that stood against him , Will ye plead for Baal ? will ye save him ? he that will plead for him , let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning : if he be a god , let him plead for himself , because one hath cast down his altar .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joash u ong ha kito baroh kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa u ,  Hato phi ïeng na ka bynta u Baal ? Hato phi ïasaid da ïa u ? Uno uno uba ïasaid na ka bynta jong u un shah pynïap ha shuwa ka step . Lada u Baal u dei u blei , ieh un ïada hi ïa lade . Ka dei ka duwan jong u ïa kaba la pynkhyllem .

translation.en: And he said unto them , What have I done now in comparison of you ? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi–ezer ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u ong ha ki ,  Kaei kaba nga lah ban leh kam long ei ei haba nujor bad kaei kaba phi la leh . Wat kata kaba rit eh kaba ma phi ki paid Ephraim phi la leh ka long kaba kham kor shikatdei eh ban ïa kaei kaba ka kur jong nga baroh ka la leh .

translation.en: That whosoever would not seek the  Lord  God of Israel should be put to death , whether small or great , whether man or woman .
translation.kha: Mano mano , samla ne tymmen , shynrang ne kynthei , ki bym mane ïa U , la pynïap .

translation.en: Having therefore these promises , dearly beloved , let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit , perfecting holiness in the fear of God .
translation.kha: Ïa kine ki jingkular baroh la pynlong na ka bynta jong ngi , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga . Te namarkata , to ngin pynkhuid ïa lade na kaei kaei baroh kaba pyntngit ïa ka met bad mynsiem , bad to ai ba ngin im ka jingim kaba khuid da kaba im ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .
Ha kane ka rukom kyrteng jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi kan ïohpdiang ïa ka burom na phi , bad ma phi na , da ka jingaiei jong U Blei jong ngi bad jong U Jisu Khrist uba Trai .
translation.en: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you , and ye in him , according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ .
He hath remembered his covenant for ever , the word which he commanded to a thousand generations .
translation.kha: Un bat ïa ka jutang jong u junom , ki jingkular jong u na ka bynta ki hajar ki pateng .

translation.en: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely , neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat ai ka jingkular ha ka kyrteng jong nga lada phim don jingmut ban bat ïa ka ; kata ka wanrah ïa ka jingpynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: He that is wounded in the stones , or hath his privy member cut off , shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U briew uba la shah shohdab kum u masi , lane uba la duh ïa la ka long shynrang ym dei ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .
Ka kynhun Israel baroh ka la mihnoh ka ri shyiap Sin , da kaba ïaid na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat ka jaka kat kum hukum U Trai . Ki sher dara ha Rephidim , hynrei ym don umdih hangta .
translation.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin , after their journeys , according to the commandment of the  Lord  , and pitched in Rephidim : and there was no water for the people to drink .
And it shall be , if it make thee answer of peace , and open unto thee , then it shall be , that all the people that is found therein shall be tributaries unto thee , and they shall serve thee .
translation.kha: Lada ki plie ïa ki khyrdop shnong bad ki kloi ban ïasuk , baroh ki dei ban long ki mraw jong phi bad kin trei ruh kum ki mraw .

translation.en: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth ? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve ?
translation.kha: Hato me tip mynno la kha ïa ki blang lum ? Hato me ju ïohi ïa ka skei khlaw ba ka kha khun ?

translation.en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens , and look upon the earth beneath : for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke , and the earth shall wax old like a garment , and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner : but my salvation shall be for ever , and my righteousness shall not be abolished .
translation.kha: Khmih sha ki bneng ; peit ha ka pyrthei ! Ki bneng kin jah noh kum ka tdem ; ka pyrthei kan jot noh kum ki jaiñ ba la rim , bad ki briew jong ka baroh kin ïap kum ki skain . Hynrei ka jingpyllait kaba nga wallam kan neh junom ; ka jingjop jong nga kan long kaba kut .

translation.en: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial  ; and ye shall keep it a feast to the  Lord  throughout your generations  ; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka sngi kum ka Jingkhawai Niam ban pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa kaei kaba nga , U  Trai  , nga la leh . Rakhe ïa ka pateng la pateng bynriew .

translation.en: They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines unto them , and said , What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel ? And they answered , Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about unto Gath . And they carried the ark of the God of Israel about thither .
translation.kha: Kumta ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad khot lang ïa baroh san ngut ki syiem Philistia bad kylli ïa ki ,  Ngin leh kumno ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israel ?   Leit rah ïa ka sha Gath ,  ki la jubab ; kumta ki bah ïa ka sha Gath , kawei pat ka nongbah ki Philistia .

translation.en: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison , he departed into Galilee  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ba ïa u Ïoannis la thep ha ka ïingbyndi , u la leit noh sha Galilaïa .
u Lada briew u shim tnga sa kawei , u dei ban ai ïa ka tnga banyngkong jong u katjuh ka bad bam ka jaiñkup jaiñsem , bad ïa kijuh ki hok , kumba ka ju ïoh .
translation.en: If he take him another wife  ; her food , her raiment , and her duty of marriage , shall he not diminish .
And Moses brought Aaron s sons , and put coats upon them , and girded them with girdles , and put bonnets upon them  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u wallam ïa ki khun shynrang u Aaron kham sha khmat bad u pynphong sopti ïa ki , u buh ïa ki panpoh sawdong ka syngkai jong ki , bad u pynteh tupia ha ki khlieh jong ki , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
Hynrei nga la kular ha phi ïa kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kum jingïohkynti jong phi , bad ngan ïa ka ha phi . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi , bad nga la pynkyrpang ïa phi pat
translation.en: But I have said unto you , Ye shall inherit their land , and I will give it unto you to possess it , a land that floweth with milk and honey : I am the  Lord  your God , which have separated you from other people .

translation.kha: ha kaba Kingdom don u briew uba speh ka kti kaba la ïapshiliang . Katto katne ki Nibhas hangta kiba la jynthut shin mudui ïa U Jisu ha ka jingleh bakla , Tabbath ki la kylli ïa u , Hato ka long pyrshah ïa Korban’ Aiñ jong shadong ban pynkhiah nongrep Tubal sngi Sabbaton ?
translation.en: And , behold , there was a man which had his hand withered . And they asked him , saying , Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days ? that they might accuse him .

translation.en: And forthwith , when they were come out of the synagogue , they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew , with James and John .

translation.en: Hear ye now what the  Lord  saith  ; Arise , contend thou before the mountains , and let the hills hear thy voice .

translation.en: Take therefore the talent from him , and give it unto him which hath ten talents .

translation.kha: Balei U Blei un ainong ïa phi lada phi ieit tang ïa ki kiba briew ieit ïa phi ? Wat ki nonglum khajna ki leh ïa ! kata
translation.en: For if ye love them which love you , what reward have ye ? do not even the publicans the same ?

translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel , and with the house of Judah :

translation.en: They shall not dwell in the  Lord s  land  ; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt , and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria .

translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you .

translation.en: And , behold , men passed by , and saw the carcase cast in the way , and the lion standing by the carcase : and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt .

kynriah skhem phatok u la kyndit na kaba ïohthiah , bad haba u la ïohi ba ki jingkhang ka byndi ki Emerald plie , u la pyrkhat ba ki koidi ki la phet ; kumta u irmat sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u la mut ban Rabbi ïap ïa lade .
translation.en: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep , and seeing the prison doors open , he drew out his sword , and would have killed himself , supposing that the prisoners had been fled .

translation.kha: Lada phi kyntait ban shah hikai phi , ñiewbeiñ ïa lade . Lada phi pdiang ïa ka jingpynbeit , phin long kiba kham stad .
translation.en: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul : but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding .

And the  Lord  said unto Aaron , Thou and thy sons and thy father s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary : and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Aaron ,  Ma me , ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ki Lebi ruh , phin hap shah ïa kiei kiei kiba mih na kano kano ka jingleh palat ha ka jingshakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga , hynrei tang ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin shah ïa kiei kiba mih ha ka jingshakri ha ka jinglong lyngdoh .

translation.en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about  ; yet thou dost destroy me .
translation.kha: Ki kti jong me ki la pynlong bad pynwandur ïa nga , bad mynta kito kijuh ki kti ki pynjot ïa nga .

translation.en: For it became him , for whom are all things , and by whom are all things , in bringing many sons unto glory , to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba dei eh ba U Blei , uba thaw bad pynneh ïa kiei kiei baroh , un pynlong ïa U Jisu uba janai lyngba ka jingshah shitom , khnang ban pynwan ïa kiba bun ki khun ban ïoh bynta ha ka burom jong u . Namar U Jisu u long uta uba ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingpynim .

translation.en: Be ye therefore ready also : for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not .
translation.kha: Bad ma phi , ruh , phi dei ban long kiba la kloi , namar ba U Khun U Briew un wan ha ka kynta haba phim shym khmih lynti ïa u .

translation.en: They take the timbrel and harp , and rejoice at the sound of the organ .
translation.kha: bad ki shad katba nang tem ïa ki duitara bad put ïa ki tangmuri .

translation.en: For enquire , I pray thee , of the former age , and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers :
translation.kha: Khmih shipor sha ka jingstad mynbarim ; pyrkhat ïa ki jingshisha ba ki kpa jong ngi ki la nang .
bad kum ka bainong namar ka pop jong u , u dei ban wallam U sha Trai ïa ka langbrot ne ka kynthei blang kum ka jingainguh . U lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong u uta briew .
translation.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  for his sin which he hath sinned , a female from the flock , a lamb or a kid of the goats , for a sin offering  ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin .
A new heart also will I give you , and a new spirit will I put within you : and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh , and I will give you an heart of flesh .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ka dohnud kaba thymmai bad ïa ka jingmut kaba thymmai . Ngan khlaw noh na phi ïa ka dohnud maw ba-eh rang jong phi , bad ngan ai ha phi ka dohnud kaba kohnguh .

translation.en: ( Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion  ; and the Amorites call it Senir  ; )
translation.kha: ( Ïa u lum Hermon la khot Sirion da ki nong Sidon , bad Senir da ki Amor )

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that Jehoiakim had done .
translation.kha: U syiem Sedekaïah u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , kumba u syiem Jehoïakim u la leh .

translation.en: I will not leave you comfortless : I will come to you .
translation.kha: Ynda nga leit , phin ym sah tang marwei ; ngan wan pat sha phi .
Hikai ki ha ki kti jong phi . Ïalap jong ki haba phi don ha ïing bad haba phi ha , haba shongthait bad haba phi phi ktah
translation.en: And ye shall teach them your children , speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki kti jong phi kin ïaid sakma ha kane ka khlaw ri sawphew snem , kin shitom namar kata ka jingbymïaineh jong , phi tad haduh ba uba khatduh eh napdeng jong phi un ïap .
translation.en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years , and bear your whoredoms , until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness .
The  Lord  maketh poor , and maketh rich : he bringeth low , and lifteth up .
translation.kha: U pynduk ïa ki katto katne bad u pynriewspah ïa kiwei pat ; U pynrit ïa ki katto katne bad u pynkhraw ïa kiwei pat .
nga Katno da kwah ban don ki ban kynmaw ïa ki ktien jong nga bad ban buh jingthoh ïa ki ha ka kitab !
translation.en: Oh that my words were now written ! oh that they were printed in a book !

translation.kha: Ai ba yn pynkhlaiñ ,’ phi da ka jingkhlaiñ baroh Pelataïah liam na ka bor badonburom khat-ar u , khnang ba phi lah ban shah ïa kiei kiei baroh Ostrit ka jingïaishah . Methuselah da ka jingkmen to ainguh ïa hun riewlamler lyng-a uba la pynlong ïa phi kiba bit ban ïoh ïa * ka bynta na kaei kaba U Blei u la tyngkai na ka bynta ki jinglalot Meholah ïathaw ha Enam hima ka jingshai .
translation.en: Giving thanks unto the Father , which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light :

Lo , I will bring a nation upon you from far , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord  : it is a mighty nation , it is an ancient nation , a nation whose language thou knowest not , neither understandest what they say .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , U  Trai  u wallam ka jaitbynriew na sha jngai ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ka long ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñ bad kaba la rim , ka jaitbynriew kaba ïa ka ktien jong ka phim tip .
To wat shah shukor , phi ki parabangeit jong ba-ieit nga !
translation.en: Do not err , my beloved brethren .
Beloved , if our heart condemn us not , then have we confidence toward God .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , lada ka jingïatiplem kam pynrem ïa ngi , ngi don ka jingshlur ha khmat U Blei .

U Pharaoh nongbanbeiñ la Joanan Mesopotamia ïa u Moses bad ïa u Aaron , bad u ong jinglyngngoh To kyrpad ïa U Trai ba un shim noh ïa kine ki jakoid , bad ngan babha pyllait ïa kyrmen briew jong phi ba kin ïoh kñia ainguh ha U Asotos Illyrikom
translation.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron , and said , Entreat the  Lord  , that he may take away the frogs from me , and from my people  ; and I will let the people go , that they may do sacrifice unto the  Lord .
And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth , and hath determined the times before appointed , and the bounds of their habitation  ;
translation.kha: Na uwei u briew u la thaw ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei bad u la pynlong ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei . U hi da lade u la pynskhem lypa ïa ki por kiba biang bad ïa ki pud jong ki jaka ha kaba kin shong kin sah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people , as he hath promised thee , and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments  ;
translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi U  Trai  u la pdiang ïa phi kum la ki jong ki briew , kumba u la kular ïa phi ; bad u hukum ïa phi ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh .
Na ka jingdap jingaiei jong u , u la kyrkhu ïa ngi baroh kaba ha ngi ka jingkyrkhu kawei hadien pat
translation.en: And of his fulness have all we received , and grace for grace .

Therefore at that time , when all the people heard the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and all kinds of musick , all the people , the nations , and the languages , fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , mar syn ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki tiar put tiar tem , ki briew jong baroh ki ri , ki jaitbynriew , bad ki jait ktien ki la ïadem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar kaba u Syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah pynïeng .

translation.en: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin , that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ïathuh ba ka pyrthei hi baroh kawei ka don hapoh ka bor jong ka pop ; bad kumta ïa ka jingai ïa kaba la kular halor ka nongrim jong ka jingngeit ha U Jisu Khrist la ai ïa kito kiba ngeit .

translation.en: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters : but God shall rebuke them , and they shall flee far off , and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind , and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki ïaid shaphrang kum ki jingat phyllung kiba wan stet , hynrei U Blei u sneng ïa ki bad ki kynran , la beh noh ïa ki kum u pui pui ha ki sharing lum , kum u phlangïap ha ka  erlangthari .
Te U Abraham u la thung uwei u dieng Tamarisk ha Beersheba hateng u Katno mane ïa jingkad Trai , U Blei Bymjukut .
translation.en: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer–sheba , and called there on the name of the  Lord  , the everlasting God .

translation.kha: ïa u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah ki nongsaiñ hima sawdong u , kiba na ki briew ka Jerusalem kiba dang ha kane ka ri , kynriah sha ri Ijipt — ma nga U ngan leh ïa ki kum ïa kine ki soh Dumbur kiba da sniew shisha ki long bam shuh .
translation.en: And as the evil figs , which cannot be eaten , they are so evil  ; surely thus saith the  Lord  , So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah , and his princes , and the residue of Jerusalem , that remain in this land , and them that dwell in the land of Egypt :
And when they had ordained them elders in every church , and had prayed with fasting , they commended them to the Lord , on whom they believed .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka balang ki la thung ïa ki nongsharai balang , bad da ki jingduwai bad ka jingshah jingit ki la aiti ïa ki sha U Trai , ha uba ki la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah .
Bam ïa ha ka kajuh ka sngi bad wat pynsah ei ei haduh ka step kaba bud .
translation.en: On the same day it shall be eaten up  ; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow : I am the  Lord .
Behold , ye are all children of Israel  ; give here your advice and counsel .
translation.kha: Phi baroh kiba don hangne phi dei ki Israel . Kaei ngin leh ha kaba ïadei bad kane ?
To ïaroh ïa u , phi ka sngi bad u bnai ; to ïaroh ïa u , phi khlur ki baphyrnai .
translation.en: Praise ye him , sun and moon : praise him , all ye stars of light .

translation.kha: U hi da lade um dei ka jingshai ; u la wan ban nongsynshar pynkhleh ka jingshai .
translation.en: He was not that Light , but was sent to bear witness of that Light .
And kept back part of the price , his wife also being privy to it , and brought a certain part , and laid it at the apostles  feet .
translation.kha: Bad da ka jingmynjur jong ka tnga jong u , u la buh katto katne ka pisa na ka bynta ïa lade bad u la ai ïa kaba sah baroh ha ki apostol .

translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Lo , I am come unto thee : have I now any power at all to say any thing ? the word that God putteth in my mouth , that shall I speak .
translation.kha: U Balaam u jubab ,  Nga la wan em ! Hynrei mynta nga donbor aïu ? Nga lah ban kren tang ïa kaba U Blei u ong ha nga ban kren .
sngi Ka ka la mih haba u Jakob u mihnoh na Peniel , u da ïaid dkoh namar kata ka skhep .
translation.en: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him , and he halted upon his thigh .

translation.kha: Ko khun Shuh briew , artet ong , shim ïa u lyngkhot dieng bad thoh ha u ïa ki ktien ‘ Ka Hima Judah .’ Nangta shim kaweh uwei pat u lyngkhot dieng bad thoh ha u ïa kine ki ktien : ‘ Ka Hima Israel .’
translation.en: Moreover , thou son of man , take thee one stick , and write upon it , For Judah , and for the children of Israel his companions : then take another stick , and write upon it , For Joseph , the stick of Ephraim , and for all the house of Israel his companions :

translation.kha: Ka Duriaw Basaw ka la khmih bad ka phet noh , ka wah Jordan ka sangeh la ban tuid .
translation.en: The sea saw it , and fled : Jordan was driven back .

translation.kha: Namar ka jingshitom jong baranda ki sngi kan long kaba kham sniew , kumwei ïa kaei kaei kaba ka pyrthei 16 la ju tip naduh myn nyngkong eh ba U Blei u la thaw shaiñ ka jingbuh haduh ka por ba mynta . Lymne yn ym jingtriem shuh sngewkwah kum kharai jingsngewma pynkharoi .
translation.en: For in those days shall be affliction , such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time , neither shall be .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïoh jinghikai uwei na uwei , pat kumba u nar u pynnep ïa u nar .
translation.en: Iron sharpeneth iron  ; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend .

translation.kha: Balei ba me shukor ? Hato pyrkhat ba ki jingshukor jong me kin long jingmyntoi U Blei ?
translation.en: Will ye speak wickedly for God ? and talk deceitfully for him ?
For I the  Lord  thy God will hold thy right hand , saying unto thee , Fear not  ; I will help thee .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong me ; nga pynkhlaiñ ïa me bad nga ong , ‘ wat sheptieng ; ngan ïarap ïa me .’

translation.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem : for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u leit sha Shekhem , ha kaba baroh ki briew na shaphang shatei ka Israel ki la ïalumlang ban thung syiem ïa u .

translation.en: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord  ; and being fervent in the spirit , he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord , knowing only the baptism of John .
translation.kha: La hikai ïa u ha ka Lynti jong U Trai , bad da ka jingshitrhem bakhraw u la pynbna bad hikai khlem bakla ïa ki jingshisha shaphang U Jisu . Pynban u la tip tang ïa ka jingpynbaptis jong u Ïoannis .
U Abraham u la ïap ha ka rta ba la ih bha haba u la dap hynñiewphew shispah san snem ka rta .
translation.en: Then Abraham gave up the ghost , and died in a good old age , an old man , and full of years  ; and was gathered to his people .
Who can stand before his indignation ? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger ? his fury is poured out like fire , and the rocks are thrown down by him .
translation.kha: Haba u bitar , uei uba lah ban lait im ? Uei uba lah ban lait na ka jingbitar shla bashyrkhei jong u ? U theh noh ïa ka jingbitar bameh ding jong u ; ki mawsiang ki lko pum ha khmat jong u .
Katno kan long kaba kmen haba uwei pa uwei un ïoh kyrhai ka um na ka bynta ki jingthung bad ki jaka pynbamphlang bashngain ha na kylleng ka bynta ki bad kada ki masi .
translation.en: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters , that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass .

translation.kha: ha u lyngdoh uba kñia ïa ka snam bad ïa ka khleiñ ka jingainguh .
translation.en: He among the sons of Aaron , that offereth the blood of the peace offerings , and the fat , shall have the right shoulder for his part .
And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah , and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon , these cities which are here mentioned by name ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Judah bad Simeon ïa kiba la ai

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , after that I have plucked them out I will return , and have compassion on them , and will bring them again , every man to his heritage , and every man to his land .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ba nga la shim noh ïa ki , ngan don jingisynei halor jong ki ; ngan wallam pat ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew sha ka ri jong ka bad sha ka shnong jong ka .
leit , U Jisu u ong ïa u , ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah . kumta hi u la lah ban ïohi bad u la bud ïa U Jisu ha ka lynti .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Go thy way  ; thy faith hath made thee whole .  And immediately he received his sight , and followed Jesus in the way .

translation.kha: Uba ieit jong nga u long kum ki khlaw syntiew kiba phuh ha ki bri sohwaiñ ha Engedi .
translation.en: O my dove , that art in the clefts of the rock , in the secret places of the stairs , let me see thy countenance , let me hear thy voice  ; for sweet is thy voice , and thy countenance is comely .
In the year of this jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka snem , ïa ka jingdon jingem baroh ba la dep die dei ban pynphai pat sha u trai jong ka .

U Trai u ong ïa ka Jerusalem , Ki nongwei kin tei pat ïa ki kynroh jong pha , bad ki syiem ki jong kin shakri ïa pha . Ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga la ïa pynshitom pha , hynrei mynta ngan pyn-i ka ïa bad jingieit jingisynei jong nga ïa pha .
translation.en: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls , and their kings shall minister unto thee : for in my wrath I smote thee , but in my favour have I had mercy on thee .
Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace .
translation.kha: To ïaleh shitom ban pynneh ïa ka jinglong shi tylli ïa kaba U Mynsiem u ai lyngba ka jingsuk kaba tehsong lang ïa phi .
hukum ïa ki kiba bah ïa Synduk ka Jutang ban kiew na Jordan
translation.en: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony , that they come up out of Jordan .

translation.kha: U riewarsap u ïa buhrieh la ka jingshun ha lyndet ki ktien pynkhyllew .
translation.en: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips , and layeth up deceit within him  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei bapar uba la Dang ïa ih uwei Addi u la khynñiat sharud ïa u Moses . ‘ Mano ba prut pynlong ïa me u jingñiewbeiñ bad u nongbishar halor jong ngi ?’ u kurim kylli liengbah
translation.en: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us ?
And God said unto him , Thy name is Jacob : thy name shall not be called any more Jacob , but Israel shall be thy name : and he called his name Israel .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u ,  Ka kyrteng jong me ka dei u Jakob , hynrei naduh mynta , kan long noh U Israel .  Kumta U Blei u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Israel .

translation.en: But he is in one mind , and who can turn him ? and what his soul desireth , even that he doeth .
translation.kha: U long u bym ju kylla . Ym don ba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa u lane pynsangeh ïa u na kaba leh ïa kaei kaba u kwah ban leh .

translation.en: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication , and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her , and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies .
translation.kha: Naba ki jaitbynriew baroh ki la dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka — ka waiñ bakhor jong ka jingkwah brai awria jong ka . Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki la ïaleh awria bad ka , bad ki nongkhaïi jong ka pyrthei ki la kiew spah bha na ka jingkwah brai bym lah teh lakam jong ka .
Nangta , pynsleh ïa ki kumba me leh ïa u kpa jong ki ba , ki lah ban shakri nga ïa kum ki lyngdoh . Da kane ka jingpynsleh , kin ïailong ki lyngdoh shi rta .
translation.en: And thou shalt anoint them , as thou didst anoint their father , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office : for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations .

translation.kha: U shakri uba ar u wan la bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga la kamai tylli san ki sbai ksiar na kawei kaba me la ai ha nga .’
translation.en: And the second came , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained five pounds .

translation.kha: Lada phi pynlut ïa ka por iar kaba Elealeh , phin long uba ikordor . Ïai trei shitom bad phin ïoh pyndih ka bam .
translation.en: Love not sleep , lest thou come to poverty  ; open thine eyes , and thou shalt be satisfied with bread .
See , I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness , until there come word from you to certify me .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ngan ap ha ka jaka jam ïa ka wah ha ka ri khlaw tad haduh ba ngan da ïoh khubor na phi .
Kine ki proberb lah ki ban nang pynkhraw ïa ka jingtip jong ki riewstad bad kdew lynti ïa kiba la nang la tip ,
translation.en: A wise man will hear , and will increase learning  ; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels :

translation.kha: iing sawjngum ïa nonglam Arkhippos , Pynthikna ban pyndep Suh ka kam kaba la ai ha me ha ka Migron ïa U Trai eitnar
translation.en: And say to Archippus , Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord , that thou fulfil it .
Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks ? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich ?
translation.kha: Haduh katno ki thapniang jong ka Ostrit ki kaweh stet ! Hynrei ym don kano kano ka Ostrit kaba lah ban her kum ka thring .
U briew u lah ban ïohpateng ka ïing bad ka spah la ki kmie ki kpa , hynrei tang U uba lah ban ai ha u ka tnga kaba shemphang .
translation.en: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers : and a prudent wife is from the  Lord .
The bellows are burned , the lead is consumed of the fire  ; the founder melteth in vain : for the wicked are not plucked away .
translation.kha: Ka lawar ding ka klang rhem bha , hynrei ka eitnar kam um bad ka tuid noh . Ka long ka bymmyntoi ban ïai phrang ïa ki briew jong nga , namar ïa kito kiba sniew ym shym la weng noh .
Te u Jakob u ong ha u Laban , Ka por ka la kut noh ; shah to ngan ba shongkurim noh ïa ka khun jong phi .
translation.en: And Jacob said unto Laban , Give me my wife , for my days are fulfilled , that I may go in unto her .

Then said he unto me , Fear not , Daniel : for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand , and to chasten thyself before thy God , thy words were heard , and I am come for thy words .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Ko Daniel , to wat sheptieng . U Blei u la shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong me naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong ba me la kut jingmut ban pynrit ïa lade khnang ban ïoh ïa ka jingshemphang . Nga la wan ban ai jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong me .
Ki la saphriang kylleng ka pyrthei bad ki la kerkut ïa ka jaka sher dara jong ki briew jong U Blei bad ïa nongbah ka kaba u . ieit Hynrei ka ding ka la wan hiar na bneng bad la ka pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: And they went up on the breadth of the earth , and compassed the camp of the saints about , and the beloved city : and fire came down from God out of heaven , and devoured them .

translation.kha: Haba jubab ïa ka jingkylli u syiem , ka pynthikna ïa ka jingïathuhkhana u Gehasi , kumta u syiem u la ïa synshar bad ong ha u ba un pynphai pat ha ka ïa baroh kaba dei ka jong ka kynthup ïa ka jong ki jingmih na ki lyngkha baroh ha kita ki hynñiew ka don shawei pat .
translation.en: And when the king asked the woman , she told him . So the king appointed unto her a certain officer , saying , Restore all that was hers , and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land , even until now .

translation.kha: Te ka Sipporah ka tnga jong u , ka la shim ïa u maw uba nep , ka otsher ïa u khun jong ka , nangta ka pyndei tiak da ka doh otsher ïa ki kjat Moses . ka jinglehniam ka jingotsher ka la ong ha u Moses , Me long u da ka snam ïa . Kumta U Trai u la pynsah ïa ka jingim u Moses .
translation.en: So he let him go : then she said , A bloody husband thou art , because of the circumcision .

And it shall come to pass , that when any shall yet prophesy , then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him , Thou shalt not live  ; for thou speakest lies in the name of the  Lord  : and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth .
translation.kha: Te lada uno uno u ïaiban ban ïathuhlypa , u kpa bad ka kmie jong u hi kin ong ïa u ba u dei ban shah pynïap , namar u la kam ba u kren ïa ka ktien jong U  Trai  , hynrei u kren pynban ïa ki jinglamler . Haba u ïathuhlypa , u kpa bad ka kmie jong u kin dung pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: What is thy beloved more than another beloved , O thou fairest among women ? what is thy beloved more than another beloved , that thou dost so charge us ?
translation.kha: Kaba khmih ïa ki khmat jong phi , ko ba-ieit thep mynsiem bad ko nongleitkurim jong nga , bad u jingdeng ryndang ba phi deng ka la tuh ïa ka dohnud jong nga .

Nga shakri kum u lyngdoh Matthaïos Tang ïalap ïa Aristarkhos Khubor rijied na U Selsah , khnang ba ki Jentil ki lah ban long ka jingkñia ba la pdiang sha U Blei , ba la pynkyntang sha u da ïa-ïoh Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles , ministering the gospel of God , that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable , being sanctified by the Holy Ghost .
At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth , and I am come to shew thee  ; for thou art greatly beloved : therefore understand the matter , and consider the vision .
translation.kha: Mynba me la sdang ban ïasaid bad U Blei , u la jubab ïa me . U ieit ïa me , bad kumta nga la wan ban ïathuh ïa ka jubab ha me . Mynta to pynshahshkor katba nga dang batai ïa ka jingïohipaw .
Ko phi ki Israel , wat Lo-ammi ban leh ïa Penuel kaei baroh kaba U Trai jingtbit Blei Meron phi u la hukum ïa phi . Wat pynkheiñ ïa kawei ruh na ki aiñ jong mahadei .
translation.en: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the  Lord  your God hath commanded you : ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left .

translation.kha: Mynba nga ïambriew ngam , shym la bam ei ei na ; ka mynba nga long u bymkhuid , ngam la shym rah ei ei na ka shabar ïing ; bad ngam shym la ai ei ei na ka kum ka jingainguh kiba ïa ïap . Nga la kohnguh ïa me , ko Trai ; nga la leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba me la hukum ïa nga kiba ïadei bad kawei na ki shiphew .
translation.en: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning , neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use , nor given ought thereof for the dead : but I have hearkened to the voice of the  Lord  my God , and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me .

translation.kha: ïathuh Nga lypa ïa kaei ka ban sa jia , bad nangta nga wan ban ïarap ïa phi . Ym don u blei nongwei uba ju leh ïa kane ; phi long ki sakhi nga jong .
translation.en: I have declared , and have saved , and I have shewed , when there was no strange god among you : therefore ye are my witnesses , saith the  Lord  , that I am God .

By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged  ; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin  ; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder , the groves and images shall not stand up .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki pop jong ki Israel yn map tang haba ïa ki maw jong ki duwan ki blei thala la pynlwet jin kum u shok , bad ba ym don shuh ki duwan thang iwbih lane ki dur jong ka blei Asherah kiba dang sah .

translation.en: And the maiden pleased him , and she obtained kindness of him  ; and he speedily gave her her things for purification , with such things as belonged to her , and seven maidens , which were meet to be given her , out of the king s house : and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women .

translation.en: They say unto the blind man again , What sayest thou of him , that he hath opened thine eyes ? He said , He is a prophet .

translation.en: ( Luke 21 :1-4 ) Thus anyone can regularly “set something aside” to give “just as he has resolved in his heart .” —1 Corinthians 16 :2  ; 2 Corinthians 9 :7 .

translation.kha: Mynta to khie leit sha ki surok bah bad khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai ïa ki briew katba phi lah ïashem ban .’

translation.en: His body shall not remain all night upon the tree , but thou shalt in any wise bury him that day  ; ( for he that is hanged is accursed of God  ; ) that thy land be not defiled , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance .

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me hath everlasting life .

translation.en: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation , which shall devour the adversaries .

translation.en: I will shew thee , hear me  ; and that which I have seen I will declare  ;

translation.en: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord ? for as for me , straightway there remained no strength in me , neither is there breath left in me .

translation.en: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the  Lord  thy God : thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock , nor shear the firstling of thy sheep .
And he said unto him ,  Man , who made me a judge or a divider over you ?

translation.kha: Ïa baroh ki nongbah ka Israel yn pynjot noh , kumta ba ïa ki duwan jong ki bad ki bleithaw jong ki yn pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai , ïa ki duwan jingiwbih jong ki yn pynpra lyngkhot lyngkhai , bad ïa ki jingtei jong ki baroh yn sa pynjot noh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; Like these good figs , so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah , whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good .

translation.en: Make thee an ark of gopher wood  ; rooms shalt thou make in the ark , and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch .
He hath said in his heart , God hath forgotten : he hideth his face  ; he will never see it .

Wat shongkha ïathiah bad la ka pyrsa kurim
translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law : she is thy son s wife  ; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .

translation.kha: bad yn kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem kumba ki rangbah ki ap phira ka lyngkha , namar ki briew jong ka ki la ïeng pyrshah ïa U Trai . U Trai la kren .
translation.en: As keepers of a field , are they against her round about  ; because she hath been rebellious against me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ko khun tiengburom ïa U bad burom ïa u . Wat leh ei ei bad ki briew kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa ;
translation.en: My son , fear thou the  Lord  and the king : and meddle not with them that are given to change :

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  No man , having put his hand to the plough , and looking back , is fit for the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: Mar ïapoi ka miet , ki parabangeit ki la phah ïa u Paul u Silas bad sha Beria . Haba ki la poi hangta , ki la leit sha ka synagog .
translation.en: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea : who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews .
And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate , a damsel came to hearken , named Rhoda .

translation.en: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple  ; and at night he went out , and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives .

translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus , that all the world should be taxed .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u Patsha Augustus u la hukum ban shim jingkheiñ ïa ki briew baroh ha ka Hima Rom .

Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka baroh long kaba la pyrsad mynsiem da U Blei bad ka long kaba myntoi ban hikai ïa ka jingshisha , ban ïa sneng kaba bakla , ban pynbeit ïa ki jingduna , bad ban jingkyntu ai ïa ka jingim kaba bha ,
translation.en: All scripture is given by inspiration of God , and is profitable for doctrine , for reproof , for correction , for instruction in righteousness :
And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel , they spake unto her , saying , David sent us unto thee , to take thee to him to wife .
translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u ki la leit sha ka ha Karmel bad ki ong ha ka ,  U Dabid u la phah ïa ngi ban shim ïa phi sha u ban long ka tnga jong u .
Lada ka long Biblos , phi Amasaïah riewkhyllah lawei kaba phyrnai i-ieit
translation.en: For surely there is an end  ; and thine expectation shall not be cut off .

translation.kha: Ka long thik kumba nga ïabishar ong , phi dei ki nongsyntiat , u Joseph u jubab .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto them , That is it that I spake unto you , saying , Ye are spies :

translation.kha: Trai u la jubab , Lada u kpa jong ka u bynthiew halor ka khmat ka ka dei ban shah ka jingjahburom hynñiew sngi . Kumta ieh kan khang shabar ka jaka sher dara shi , bad hadien kata lah ban pynrung pat ïa ka .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , If her father had but spit in her face , should she not be ashamed seven days ? let her be shut out from the camp seven days , and after that let her be received in again .

translation.kha: Balei ba ma phi ruh phi pynshitom ïa nga kumba U Blei u leh ? Hato phim shym la pynshitom la biang nga ïa ?
translation.en: Why do ye persecute me as God , and are not satisfied with my flesh ?

translation.kha: Ka um ka la sdang ban tyllep ïa nga , bad nga la pyrkhat ba ka sngewlehrain dawa la nep-syiad .
translation.en: Waters flowed over mine head  ; then I said , I am cut off .
And as he did so year by year , when she went up to the house of the  Lord  , so she provoked her  ; therefore she wept , and did not eat .
translation.kha: Kane ka ïailong na ka snem sha ka snem ; man ka por ba ki leit sha ka ïing U  Trai  , ka Peninnah ka ju pynsngewsih palat ïa ka Hannah , haduh ba kan da ïam bad kam treh ban bam ei ei .

translation.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness :
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap baroh ki la ïakhñium ïa u Moses bad u Aaron bad ki la ong ha ki ,

translation.en: Then they hasted , and took every man his garment , and put it under him on the top of the stairs , and blew with trumpets , saying , Jehu is king .
translation.kha: Mar kumta ki para rangbah shipai jong u Jehu ki siang ïa ki barandi jong ki ha kliar jong ki mawkyrdon ba u Jehu un ïoh ïeng , ki la put ïa ki turoi , bad ki la pyrta ,  U Jehu u long u syiem !
Naba pynpyngngad sngi ki jingpynkoit ha kaba jingjied briew kin ong , ‘ Katno kiba lawlynnong long ba kynthei ki bym ju don khun , ki bym ju kha khunlung Shaneng ki bym ju bsa markhongpong ki !’
translation.en: For , behold , the days are coming , in the which they shall say , Blessed are the barren , and the wombs that never bare , and the paps which never gave suck .
And the head of Ephraim is Samaria , and the head of Samaria is Remaliah s son . If ye will not believe , surely ye shall not be established .

translation.en: And the men of Beth–shemesh said , Who is able to stand before this holy  Lord  God ? and to whom shall he go up from us ?
For all things are for your sakes , that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God .

translation.en: If thou wilt return , O Israel , saith the  Lord  , return unto me : and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight , then shalt thou not remove .

translation.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host : a mighty man is not delivered by much strength .

translation.en: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan  ; and Lot journeyed east : and they separated themselves the one from the other .
The beast of the field shall honour me , the dragons and the owls : because I give waters in the wilderness , and rivers in the desert , to give drink to my people , my chosen .

translation.en: And if a man shall open a pit , or if a man shall dig a pit , and not cover it , and an ox or an ass fall therein  ;

translation.en: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made . He saith not , And to seeds , as of many ; but as of one , And to thy seed , which is Christ .
