Uwei-pa-uwei u naki don kali .
translation.en: Each of them has his own car .

translation.kha: Kumba U Kpa da lade hi u long u tyllong jong ka jingim , ha kajuh ka rukom u la pynlong ïa Khun jong u long u ka jingim
translation.en: For as the Father hath life in himself  ; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself  ;
The memory of the just is blessed : but the name of the wicked shall rot .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew kiba bha yn ïai kynmaw kum ka jingkyrkhu ; hynrei ïa ki riewbymman yn klet noh .

translation.en: Hell and destruction are never full  ; so the eyes of man are never satisfied .
translation.kha: Ki jingkwah u briew ki long kum ka pyrthei kiba ïap — Ka don borabor ka jingkwah shuh shuh .

U Blei u la leh-isynei ïa nga khnang ba U Khrist Jisu un ïoh pynpaw ka jingïaishah slem jong u ha kaba ïadei bad nga , uba tam na kiba pop , ka nuksa ïa kito baroh ban sa ngeit ïa u hadien ïohpdiang ïa jingim .
translation.en: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy , that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering , for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting .

translation.kha: lem kine ki bad hukum : Rieh ha kawei ka liang jong ka nongbah , hynrei wat leit jngai than na ka ; long ba la khreh ban tur ïaleh .
translation.en: And he commanded them , saying , Behold , ye shall lie in wait against the city , even behind the city : go not very far from the city , but be ye all ready :

Get thee up into this mountain Abarim , unto mount Nebo , which is in the land of Moab , that is over against Jericho  ; and behold the land of Canaan , which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession :
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ki Lum Abarim kiba ha ka ri Moab marpyrshah ïa ka shnong Jerikho ; kiew ïa u Lum Nebo bad khmih ïa ka ri Kanaan ïa kaba ngan ai ha ki paid Israel .
U Joseph u shong u sah ha ka ri Ijipt bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem u jong kpa jong u ; u la ïap noh haba u la dap shispah snem shiphew ka rta .
translation.en: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt , he , and his father s house : and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years .
And Bilhah conceived , and bare Jacob a son .
translation.kha: Ka Bilhah ka la punkhun , bad ka kha khun shynrang ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: Be it known unto you all , and to all the people of Israel , that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth , whom ye crucified , whom God raised from the dead , even by him doth this man stand here before you whole .
translation.kha: te ma phi baroh phi dei ban tip , bad baroh ki paid Israel ki dei ban tip , ba une u briew u ïeng hangne ha khmat jong phi uba la khiah kran da ka bor jong ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist uba na Nasareth — ïa uba phi la sahnarphna bad ïa uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .

Hadien kata , u Dabid u rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai , u shong bad u sawkyr-ang , Ngam Jehud uba dei Meribah ïa kaei kaba me la Sngewbha leh na ka bynta pynbhabriew nga , ko Trai U Blei , lane Golan longïing jong Minnith .
translation.en: And David the king came and sat before the  Lord  , and said , Who am I , O  Lord  God , and what is mine house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa , u Haggai bad Sekharaïah u khun jong u Iddo , ki sdang ban kren ka kyrteng Blei ki Israel ha ki kiba shong basah ha Judah bad Jerusalem .
translation.en: Then the prophets , Haggai the prophet , and Zechariah the son of Iddo , prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel , even unto them .
And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies : but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth  ; for they proceed from evil to evil , and they know not me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki long borabor kiba kloi ban ïathuh lamler ; ka jingbymhok ha ka jaka jong ka jingshisha , ka synshar ïa ka ri . U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong nga ki leh ïa kawei kaba sniew hadien kawei pat bad kim shym pdiang ïa nga kum U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the  Lord   ; but they shall not find him  ; he hath withdrawn himself from them .
translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri jong ki ban ai kum ki jingkñia sha U  Trai  hynrei kane kan ym wanrah jingbha ei ei ïa ki . Kin ym shem ïa u namar u la iehnoh ïa ki .

Nangta ki paidbah ki leit sha ka u Baal bad ki ïa ka ; ki pynpra ïa ki duwan bad ïa bleithaw , bad ki pynïap ïa u Mattan , u lyngdoh jong u Baal , ha khmat ki . U Jehoïada u ïa ki nongap kiba dei treikam ha ka ,
translation.en: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal , and brake it down  ; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly , and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars . And the priest appointed officers over the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Wat ha shuwa ba kata ka por Khilion wan , ïa ki ri jong kito kiei ar ngut ki syiem kiba Kum pynshyrkhei ïa phi yn iehnoh .
translation.en: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil , and choose the good , the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings .

translation.kha: Kumta ka la punkhun bad kha khun shynrang . Ka ong , U Blei u la shim noh ïa ka jahburom jong nga da kaba ai khun shynrang ïa nga .
translation.en: And she conceived , and bare a son  ; and said , God hath taken away my reproach :
When I say , My bed shall comfort me , my couch shall ease my complaint  ;
translation.kha: Nga thiah bad pyrshang ban pynjahthait ; nga khmih ban ïohlait na ka jingpang jong nga .

Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba u ïa syiem um shahshkor ki , ki la pyrta , Long ba la ñiewbeiñ ïa u Dabid bad longïing ka jong u ! Ki la leh aïu na ka bynta jong ngi ? Ko ki rangbah Israel , ïa ngin leit noh sha ïing ! To ai ba u Rehoboam un khmih hi ïa lade !
translation.en: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them , the people answered the king , saying , What portion have we in David ? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse : to your tents , O Israel : now see to thine own house , David . So Israel departed unto their tents .
And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about , and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place :
translation.kha: Hadien kata , un phah khrud ïa ki kynroh baroh hapoh ïing , bad bret ïa kata ka khyndew shabar shnong ha ka jaka theh ñiut .

translation.en: Then answered the  Lord  unto Job out of the whirlwind , and said ,
translation.kha: Te napdeng ka  erïong , U  Trai  u la kren ha u Job sa shisien pat .

translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  was very angry with Israel , and removed them out of his sight : there was none left but the tribe of Judah only .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki Israel bad u pyndam ïa ki na khmat jong u , da kaba iehnoh tang ïa ka hima Judah .
Te nangta , phi don jingbam ei ei ? Ai ïa nga tylli ki kpu ne kano kano kaba phi don .
translation.en: Now therefore what is under thine hand ? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand , or what there is present .
Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob , and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel , and will be jealous for my holy name  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Hynrei mynta ngan sngewsynei ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ki briew ka Israel , bad ngan pynmanbha biang ïa ki . Ngan ïada ïa la ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga .
Ka jingim jong kiba duk ka don ha ka 37 borabor , hynrei Pomkranet briew kiba kmen ki suk mynsiem ha ka jingim borabor .
translation.en: All the days of the afflicted are evil : but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast .
Therefore let us keep the feast , not with old leaven , neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness ; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth .
translation.kha: To ngin rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam , te , ym da u kpu uba don u thiat uba rim jong ka pop bad ka jingbymman , hynrei da u kpu u bym don thiat , u kpu jong ka jingkhuid bad ka jingshisha .
Nga la smai da ka kyrteng jong nga — U Trai u kren ba ngan kyrkhu kyrhai ïa me . Namar me la ïa kane , bad mem la tyngkai ïa u marwei na nga ,
translation.en: And said , By myself have I sworn , saith the  Lord  , for because thou hast done this thing , and hast not withheld thy son , thine only son :
How forcible are right words ! but what doth your arguing reprove ?
translation.kha: Ki ktien hok ki long kiba lah ban pynngeit , hynrei phi kren khlem don jingmut .

translation.en: So Ahab slept with his fathers  ; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïap jong u , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: His scales are his pride , shut up together as with a close seal .
translation.kha: Ïa ka met jong u la shna da ki stieh ha ki laiñ , kiba la pynïadait lang bad kiba eh kum u maw .
Ka biang ! krung Dabid u la Shemaïah Ang Ruphos ïaid sha khmat ! Kumta u Ittai u Nyngkong ïaid sha khmat bad la ki rangbah jong u syrtap bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And David said to Ittai , Go and pass over . And Ittai the Gittite passed over , and all his men , and all the little ones that were with him .
Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul , both sure and stedfast , and which entereth into that within the veil  ;
translation.kha: Ngi don kane ka jingkyrmen kum u angkor ïa ki jingim jong ngi . Ka long kaba skhem bad kaba thikna , bad ka ïaid lyngba ka jingkah jong ka Templ ba kynja bneng shaduh ka kamra kaba kham shapoh .

translation.en: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature , and in favour with God and man .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la nang san ha ka met bad ha ka jingstad , da kaba ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha bad U Blei lem bad ki briew .

translation.en: But in this will we consent unto you : If ye will be as we be , that every male of you be circumcised  ;
translation.kha: Ngin mynjur tang ha kane : ba phin long kum ma ngi da kaba ki shynrang jong phi baroh kin shah otsher .

translation.en: Of a truth I say unto you , that he will make him ruler over all that he hath .
translation.kha: Da shisha , nga ong ha phi , u kynrad un buh ïa uta u shakri ban khmih ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u baroh .

translation.en: Or for a ram , thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil .
translation.kha: Haba la wanrah ïa u langbrot , ar kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad shi litar shiteng ka umphniang Olib dei ban ai kum ka jingainguh bam , lem bad shi litar shiteng ka waiñ .
U parabangeit uba u dei ban kmen haba U Blei u kyntiew ïa u , bad u parabangeit uba riewspah u dei ban kmen U Blei u ïa u .
translation.en: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted :
For I testify again to every man that is circumcised , that he is a debtor to do the whole law .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat nga maham ba uno uno u briew uba shah ïa lade ban otsher u pynbor ban kohnguh ïa ka Hukum baroh kawei .

translation.en: She came by bus yesterday .
translation.kha: Ka wan da ka bus mynnin .

translation.en: And Abner said unto David , I will arise and go , and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king , that they may make a league with thee , and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth . And David sent Abner away  ; and he went in peace .
translation.kha: U Abner u ong ha u Dabid ,  Ngan leit noh mynta , bad ngan pynwan ïa ki Israel baroh sha phi ko Syiem Bakhraw . Kin pdiang ïa phi kum u syiem , bad nangta phin ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi la kwah bad phin synshar halor ka ri baroh kawei .  U Dabid u ai ka jingkular jingshngain ïa u Abner bad u phah noh ïa u .
Ha sngi ka kaba arphew wei jong u bnai uba hynñiew ha kata kajuh ka , snem U Trai u la kren biang lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: In the seventh month , in the one and twentieth day of the month , came the word of the  Lord  by the prophet Haggai , saying ,

translation.kha: Yn ym u don ban pynwit ïa ka lynti jong phi lada phi ïaid kum uba stad , bad phin ym jynthut haba phi mareh .
translation.en: When thou goest , thy steps shall not be straitened  ; and when thou runnest , thou shalt not stumble .

translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u dem lai sien halor uta u khynnah bad u duwai , Trai Ko U Blei jong nga , pynwan ïa biang ka jingim ha une u khynnah !
translation.en: And he stretched himself upon the child three times , and cried unto the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  my God , I pray thee , let this child s soul come into him again .

translation.kha: Hynrei U u la shim ïa ka kam kum u nongaplangbrot bad u la hukum ïa nga ban wan bad ïathuhlypa ha ki briew jong u ki Israel .
translation.en: And the  Lord  took me as I followed the flock , and the  Lord  said unto me , Go , prophesy unto my people Israel .
When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people , there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree , and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei ka ban jia ha baroh ki jaitbynriew kylleng ka pyrthei . Kan long kum ka jingkut jong ka jingot , haba ïa ki soh Olib la dep tied pynhap na uwei pa uwei u dieng bad ba ïa ki sohwaiñ bakhatduh la kheit na ki dieng sohwaiñ .

translation.en: Howbeit in vain do they worship me , teaching for doctrines the commandments of men .
translation.kha: Ka long ka bymmyntoi ïa ki ban mane ïa nga , namar ki hikai ïa ki aiñ ba la thaw da ki briew kumba ki dei ki aiñ U Blei !’
U syiem Josaïah u khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong Judah ka bad Jerusalem ,
translation.en: And the king sent , and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem .
( But this spake he of the Spirit , which they that believe on him should receive : for the Holy Ghost was not yet given  ; because that Jesus was not yet glorified . )
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren ïa kane shaphang U Mynsiem , uba kito kiba la ngeit ha u kin ïohpdiang . Ha kata ka por ïa U Mynsiem ym pat shym la ai , namar ïa U Jisu ym pat shym la kyntiew sha ka burom .
Me pynshitom ïa ki briew , A bad ha ka jinglyng-a ki duwai ha me .
translation.en: Lord  , in trouble have they visited thee , they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them .
And David said unto Ahimelech , And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword ? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me , because the king s business required haste .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Ahimelekh ,  Hato phi don u sum ne ka waitlam ba phi lah ban ai ïa nga ? Ki hukum jong u syiem ki la pynlong ïa nga ban mih kyrkieh kumne haduh ba ngam don por ban leit shim ïa la ka waitlam lane ïa kano kano ka atiar .

Nangta u Dabid u la hukum ïa u paidbah , Ïaroh ïa U U Trai Blei jong phi ! Bad kiba la baroh ïalumlang ki la ïaroh ïa , U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad ki la pyndem la ki khlieh bad ai burom ïa U Trai bad ruh ïa u syiem .
translation.en: And David said to all the congregation , Now bless the  Lord  your God . And all the congregation blessed the  Lord  God of their fathers , and bowed down their heads , and worshipped the  Lord  , and the king .

translation.kha: Mano Kuth ai um ïa ka khyndew pynsaphriang tyrkhong bad kaba thynrang , jingïadie kumta u phlang u mih ?
translation.en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground  ; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth ?

translation.kha: Ym don u nongrep uba lur sah ïa lyngkha jong u bad uba pynkhreh ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingbet .
translation.en: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow ? doth he open and break the clods of his ground ?

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu la u jubab , Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Wat tynjuh ïa U Trai U Blei jong me .’
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  It is said , Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God .
Is this thing done by my lord the king , and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant , who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him ?
translation.kha: Hato u Syiem Kynrad u mynjur ïa kane baroh bad ym shym ïathuh wat ïa ki rangbah synshar jong phi mano ban long syiem hadien jong phi ?

translation.en: And they smote him on the head with a reed , and did spit upon him , and bowing their knees worshipped him .
translation.kha: Ki la shoh ïa u na ka khlieh da u dieng , ki la bynthiew ïa u , ki la dem khohsiew , bad ki la nguh ïa u .
Kaei kaba me kwah ïa nga leh ban na ka jong bynta me ? U Jisu u la kylli ïa u . Ko Nonghikai , uta u briew uba u matlah la jubab , Nga kwah ban ïoh imat biang .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  What wilt thou that I should do unto thee ?  The blind man said unto him , Lord , that I might receive my sight .
And he took the cup , and when he had given thanks , he gave it to them : and they all drank of it .
translation.kha: Nangta u shim ïa ka khuri , u la ainguh ha U Blei , bad u la ai ïa ka ha ki ; bad baroh ki la dih na ka .
Wad ïa u bania uba tbit ba un ohdur ha kita ki ar tylli ki mawkordor ïa ki kyrteng jong khun ki shynrang jong u Jakob bad ïa pynshong ki ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar .
translation.en: With the work of an engraver in stone , like the engravings of a signet , shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel : thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold .

translation.kha: Wat mut Sawdong nga la batlot ban wanrah ka jingsuk sha ka Khinnereth . Em , ngam shym la wanrah ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei ka waitlam .
translation.en: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth : I came not to send peace , but a sword .

translation.kha: Nga da kwah eh ba phin long kiba na lait ka jingkhuslai . briew U u bym shym shongkurim u pyrkhat ïa lade ha ka kam U Trai , namar u wad ban pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: But I would have you without carefulness . He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord , how he may please the Lord :

translation.kha: Ko Trai , shano men leit ? Petros u la kylli ïa u . Mem lah ban bud ïa nga mynta sha ba ngan sa leit , U Jisu u la jubab hynrei hadien men sa bud nga .
translation.en: Simon Peter said unto him , Lord , whither goest thou ? Jesus answered him ,  Whither I go , thou canst not follow me now  ; but thou shalt follow me afterwards .

translation.kha: Namar u ba syiem Ahas u la leh pop , U Trai U Blei jong u , u la shah ïa u ka syiem Syria ban jop ïa u bad ban ring koidi bun bah na ki sha Judia Damaskos . U Trai u la shah ruh ïa u Pekah u syiem ka Israel , u khun jong u Remalaïah ban , jop ïa u Ahas bad pynïap shi lakh arphew hajar ki Judia shipai kiba shlur bha tang hapoh shi sngi . U Trai U Blei jong ki tymmen kpa jong ki u la shah ïa kane jia ban , namar ki briew ka Judah ki la kyntait noh ïa . u
translation.en: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day , which were all valiant men  ; because they had forsaken the  Lord  God of their fathers .
And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  , and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings , and commanded Judah to serve the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: U tei pynbha ïa ka duwan ha kaba ïa U  Trai  la mane , bad u kñia ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok bad ki jingainguh thang ha ka . U hukum ïa ki paid Judah baroh ban mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
Nga la long tang ma nga hi la uba ïohi ka ïa jingïohipaw . Ki rangbah kiba ïadon bad nga kim shym ïohi ei ei , hynrei ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la ïamareh bad leit rieh .
translation.en: And I Daniel alone saw the vision : for the men that were with me saw not the vision  ; but a great quaking fell upon them , so that they fled to hide themselves .
Philip saith unto him , Lord , shew us the Father , and it sufficeth us .
translation.kha: U Philip u la ong ha u ,  Ko Kynrad , to pyn-i ha ngi ïa U Kpa ; kata ka long baroh kaba ngi donkam .

translation.en: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof , and spoons thereof , and covers thereof , and bowls thereof , to cover withal : of pure gold shalt thou make them .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki pliang , ki khiew bad ki khuri ban pyndonkam ha ka jingainguh dih . Ïa kine baroh dei ban thaw da ka ksiar nylla .

translation.en: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double  ; because they have defiled my land , they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban siew ar shah na ka bynta ki pop bad ka jingbymman jong ki , namar ki la pyntngit ïa ka ri jong nga da ki bleithaw ki bym don jingim kum ki metïap , bad ki la pyndap ïa ka da ki blei thala jong ki .

translation.en: ( Romans 6 :19  ; 12 :1  ; 2 Corinthians 7 :1 ) It can be very hard to give up these habits .
translation.kha: ( Rom 6 :19 ; 12 :1 ; 2 Korinth 7 :1 ) Ka lah ban long kaba eh ban iehnoh ïa kine ki jingmlien .

translation.en: Then Ananias answered , Lord , I have heard by many of this man , how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem :
translation.kha: U Ananias u la jubab ,  Ko Trai , bun ki briew ki la ïathuh ïa nga shaphang une u briew bad shaphang kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba u la leh ïa ki briew jong me ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: For I have five brethren  ; that he may testify unto them , lest they also come into this place of torment .
translation.kha: Shah ïa u ban leit bad maham ïa ki , khnang ba ma ki , la kumno kumno , kin ym wan sha kane ka jaka ka jingshitom .’

translation.en: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him , Behold , thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth , and of the dew of heaven from above  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u Isaak u ong ha u ,  Ym don umjer na bneng na ka bynta jong me , Ym don lyngkha baseisoh na ka bynta jong me .

translation.en: And some of them believed , and consorted with Paul and Silas  ; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude , and of the chief women not a few .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki , ki la sngewïahap bad ki la ïasoh bad u Paul bad u Silas ; kumta ruh ka la long ïa kiba bun ki kynthei kiba pawkhmat bad ka kynhun bah jong ki Grik kiba la mane ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the  Lord  : for they shall all know me , from the least of them unto the greatest of them , saith the  Lord  : for I will forgive their iniquity , and I will remember their sin no more .
translation.kha: Yn ym don uwei ruh na ki u ban hap hikai ïa la u para ri ban tip ïa U  Trai  , namar baroh kin tip ïa nga , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam . Ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad ngan ym kynmaw shuh ïa ki jingbakla jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: They are all adulterers , as an oven heated by the baker , who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough , until it be leavened .
translation.kha: Baroh ki long kiba shetkylla bad ki bym lah shaniah . Ka jingisih jong ki , ka ing suki kum ka ding ha ka tyndur , ka bym shym la pynkhih da u nongshet kpu haduh ba u  purew u lah long ban shet .
U briew uba bha u tip ïa ki hok jong kiba duk , hynrei ki briew basniew kim sngewthuh lah kum ïa kita kiei kiei .
translation.en: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor : but the wicked regardeth not to know it .

translation.kha: Uno uno u Israel khor uno uno u “Ki uba wan shong ryngkat hapdeng jong ki , uba Adonisedek ïa ka Nongbah thang lane ïa kano kano ka jingkñia kum ka jingainguh sha U Trai pynsmai Shemida lait tang ha jinglongbriew jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong Nadab Blei .
translation.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , to offer it unto the  Lord   ; even that man shall be cut off from among his people .

translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki . Haba ki la ïohi ïa ki lum bajrong bad ïa ki dieng bajyrngam , ki la ai jingkñia ha ki baroh . Sosipater la pynbitar ïa sdien da ki jingkñia kiba Susa Patmos Arni bad da Asaraïahu waiñ kaba ki bymïaineh wallam kum ki jingainguh .
translation.en: For when I had brought them into the land , for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them , then they saw every high hill , and all the thick trees , and they offered there their sacrifices , and there they presented the provocation of their offering : there also they made their sweet savour , and poured out there their drink offerings .

The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , after that Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah , when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah , which were carried away captive unto Babylon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga hadien ba u Nebusaradan , u rangbah shipai , u la lah pyllait ïa nga ha Ramah . Ïa nga la leit ïalam shata ha ki kynjri , ryngkat bad baroh kiwei pat ki briew na Jerusalem bad Judah ïa kiba la leit ïalam kum ki koidi sha Babilonia .

translation.en: Thou believest that there is one God  ; thou doest well : the devils also believe , and tremble .
translation.kha: Hato phi ngeit ba don tang uwei U Blei ? Kata ka bha ! Ki ksuid ruh ki ngeit — bad ki kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng !

translation.en: And it came to pass , after he had eaten bread , and after he had drunk , that he saddled for him the ass , to wit , for the prophet whom he had brought back .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la dep bam dep dih , u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u la teh jin ïa ka kada na ka bynta u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah , uba leit noh ha ka lynti .
Haba u Shekhem khun jong u Hamor u jait Hib , uba u khlieh jong kata ka thain , la ïohi ïa ka , u la shim ïa ka bad u la batbor ïa ka
translation.en: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite , prince of the country , saw her , he took her , and lay with her , and defiled her .

translation.kha: U pynbha ïa ka duwan kaba ïa U la mane , u kñia ki ïasyllok bad ki jingainguh thang ha ka . U ïa ki paid Judah baroh ban mane ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  , and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings , and commanded Judah to serve the  Lord  God of Israel .

translation.kha: Ynda ki jaitbynriew ki ïalumlang ngan , pynngat ïa me ha ka jar jong nga bad ngan shah ïa ki ban tan ïa ka jar ryngkew sha .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people  ; and they shall bring thee up in my net .

translation.kha: Lada phi ngeit , ïohpdiang phin ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan ha ka jingduwai .
translation.en: And all things , whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer , believing , ye shall receive .
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother s wife : it is thy brother s nakedness .
translation.kha: lane bad la ka hynmen kynsi ne ka para kynsi .

translation.en: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Hapdeng ki paid Israel yn ym don shuh ki jingïohipaw ba bakla lane ki jingïathuhlypa kiba ïalam bakla .

translation.en: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground : and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand , and on their left .
translation.kha: Ïa ki um la kad arliang , bad ki Israel ki ïaid lyngba ïa kata ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , katba kita ki um ki long kum ki kynroh ha baroh arliang .
Hadien jingpunkhun Khasi la jop ïa ka ri riewspah Kpa khain Israel baroh kawei ka la ïalumlang ha Abdon bad pynïeng shadem Phon Ïingjaiñ Baal-jong-ka-Jutang ïa-ban Shatei U Trai .
translation.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh , and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there . And the land was subdued before them .
Woe unto them ! for they have fled from me : destruction unto them ! because they have transgressed against me : though I have redeemed them , yet they have spoken lies against me .
translation.kha: A ki long kiba la tim ! Ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad ïeng pyrshah ïa nga . Ïa ki yn pynduh noh . Nga la kwah ban pyllait im ïa ki , hynrei ka jingmane jong ki ïa nga ka long kaba thala .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that the child died . And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead : for they said , Behold , while the child was yet alive , we spake unto him , and he would not hearken unto our voice : how will he then vex himself , if we tell him that the child is dead ?
translation.kha: Hadien shi taïew u khunlung u la ïap bad ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la sheptieng ban ïathuh ha u ïa ka khubor . Ki ong ,  Mynba i khunlung i dang im , u Dabid um ju jubab ïa ngi haba ngi kren ïa u . Kumno ngin lah ban ïathuh ïa u ba i khun jong u i la ïap ? U lah ban pynmynsaw ïa lade !

translation.en: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon , and bound him in fetters , to carry him to Babylon .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah , u kem ïa u Jehoïakim , bad u ïalam ïa u sha Babilonia da kaba khum ha ki kynjri .
Ha kata ka , nga la ïambriew haduh lai taïew .
translation.en: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks .

translation.kha: Ka ka la ïohi ba nga la pyllait tnga ïa ka Israel bad phah noh ïa namar ka la phai noh na nga bad ka la kylla long ka nuti . Hynrei ka , ka para bymïaineh jong Israel , kam shym sheptieng . ka ruh ka la kylla long ka nuti
translation.en: And I saw , when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away , and given her a bill of divorce  ; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not , but went and played the harlot also .

translation.kha: Phin sa ïohi ïa kane bad yn pyndap da jingkmen . Phin khynñiuh da ka jingsngewkmen . Ki spah jong ki jaitbynriew yn sha pha ; na shiliang ka duriaw ki spah jong kin wan .
translation.en: Then thou shalt see , and flow together , and thine heart shall fear , and be enlarged  ; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee , the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee .

translation.kha: Ki syiem ki sngewtynnat pynmihpatlada ki rangbah synshar kiba lah , hynrei ki pynshitom ïa kito kiba pynlehrain ïa ki sut
translation.en: The king s favour is toward a wise servant : but his wrath is against him that causeth shame .

translation.kha: Ngi la phai dien noh na me , hynrei shen ngi la kwah ban phai wan pat . Hadien ba me la pynshitom ïa ngi , ngi pyndem la ïa la ki khlieh ha ka jingsngewsih . Ngi la sngewlehrain bad jahburom , namar ngi la leh mynba pop ngi dang samla .’
translation.en: Surely after that I was turned , I repented  ; and after that I was instructed , I smote upon my thigh : I was ashamed , yea , even confounded , because I did bear the reproach of my youth .

translation.kha: Don na ki , kiba Susa bad jingsngewlem tnga u kpa jong ki . Don kiba pynbor ïa ki phalor ban ïathiah shongkha jingjrong ki ha ka por poi daym .
translation.en: In thee have they discovered their fathers  nakedness : in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution .
And the  Lord  said unto me , Cast it unto the potter : a goodly price that I was prised at of them . And I took the thirty pieces of silver , and cast them to the potter in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Buh ïa ka ha ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ .  Kumta nga la shim ïa ki laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa — ka jingkheiñ kaba khraw kaba ki la pyrkhat ba nga la shongdor — bad buh ïa ka ha ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ .
Pynïeng ïa u ha u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad u paidlang baroh , bad hangta ha khmat jong ki baroh to ba ma u un long u nongmih bujli me .
translation.en: And set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation  ; and give him a charge in their sight .

But the people answered , Thou shalt not go forth : for if we flee away , they will not care for us  ; neither if half of us die , will they care for us : but now thou art worth ten thousand of us : therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban leit lang bad ngi ,  ki la ong .  Kam don jingktah ei ei ïa u nongshun lada kiba sah na ngi ki phai dien bad phet lane lada shiteng na ngi ki la shah pynïap ; hynrei phi ïaryngkat dor bad shiphew hajar ngut na ngi . Kan kham bha lada phi shong hangne ha ka nongbah bad phah jingïarap ïa ngi .

translation.en: And he overtook them , and he spake unto them these same words .
translation.kha: Ynda uta u shakri u la lap ïa ki , u la kren ha ki ïa kijuh ki ktien .

translation.en: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may be before thee for ever : for thou blessest , O  Lord  , and it shall be blessed for ever .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , while Apollos was at Corinth , Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus : and finding certain disciples ,

translation.en: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received , how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures ;
Hadar , and Tema , Jetur , Naphish , and Kedemah :
translation.kha: u Hadad , u Tema , u Jetur , u Naphish , bad u Kedemah .

translation.en: And make straight paths for your feet , lest that which is lame be turned out of the way  ; but let it rather be healed .
translation.kha: Da ïaid ha ki lynti kiba beit , khnang ba ïa kata ka kjat kaba dkoh yn ym pynduhbor noh , hynrei pynban , yn pynkoit keiñ ïa ka .
U Blei jong ngi u don ha bneng ; u leh ïa kano kano kaba mon u .
translation.en: But our God is in the heavens : he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased .
For if our heart condemn us , God is greater than our heart , and knoweth all things .
translation.kha: Lada ka jingïatiplem jong ngi ka pynrem ïa ngi , ngi tip ba U Blei u kham khraw ban ïa ka jingïatiplem jong ngi bad ba u tip ïa kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch , whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon : he went and said thus unto him  ; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon : bring me in before the king , and I will shew unto the king the interpretation .
translation.kha: Kumta u Daniel u la leit sha u Ariokh , ïa uba u syiem u la lah hukum ban pynïap ïa ki nongai jingmut ïa u syiem . U la ong ha u ,  Wat pynïap ïa ki . Ïalam ïa nga sha u syiem , bad ngan ïathuh ha u aïu ka jingphohsniew jong u ka kit jingmut .
kata Ha ka por , u Abijah u khun jong u Syiem Jeroboam u kem pang .
translation.en: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick .

jingshet tar ïa ka suiñbneng bad u wan hiar ; bad u lyoh uba dum hapoh ki kjat jong u .
translation.en: He bowed the heavens also , and came down  ; and darkness was under his feet .
Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink , and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry .

U Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego ki la jubab , Ko Syiem Kynrad , ngin ym pyrshang ban ïasaid da ïa lade .
translation.en: Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , answered and said to the king , O Nebuchadnezzar , we are not careful to answer thee in this matter .
So there was a division among the people because of him .
translation.kha: Kumta ka la don ka jingïapait hapdeng u paidbah namar U Jisu .

translation.en: Yet a little while , and the world seeth me no more  ; but ye see me : because I live , ye shall live also .
translation.kha: Sa tang shipor ka pyrthei kan ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , hynrei phin ïohi ïa nga ; bad namar ba nga im , phi ruh phin ïoh im .

translation.en: And he hardened Pharaoh s heart , that he hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh , pynban , u la ïai mutlop bad kumba U  Trai  u la ong , u Pharaoh um shym shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
Hapoh lai sngi u syiem un sa pyllait noh ïa phi — phah khrai ïa ! Nangta un sa sdien ka met ha u dieng bad ki sim bam ïa ka doh jong phi .
translation.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee , and shall hang thee on a tree  ; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee .
I will fetch my knowledge from afar , and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker .
translation.kha: Ka jingtip jong nga ka long kaba ïar ; ngan pyndonkam ïa kaba nga tip ban pyn-i ba U Blei , u Nongthaw jong nga , u long uba hok .
jingsylla buh ïa u pud ba kim lah ban jam palat , ban pynlong ba-shiphew ki ba kin ym tap biang ïa ka pyrthei jinglehmeng
translation.en: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over  ; that they turn not again to cover the earth .
When the house caught fire , an awful feeling came over me .
translation.kha: Mynba ka ïng ka ing , ka jingsngewma ka wan ha nga .

translation.en: Behold , I come as a thief . Blessed is he that watcheth , and keepeth his garments , lest he walk naked , and they see his shame .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Nga wan kum u nongtuh ! Suk uta uba peitmat bad uba sumar ïa la ki jaiñkup , khnang ba un ym ïaid lyngkhuit kylleng bad shah pynlehrain ha khmat ki briew !
Kane ka mut ba ka jingïap ka trei hapoh jong ngi , , hynrei ka jingim ka trei hapoh jong phi .
translation.en: So then death worketh in us , but life in you .

Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely  ; he shall even restore it in the principal , and shall add the fifth part more thereto , and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth , in the day of his trespass offering .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u leh pop ha kano kano na kine , u dei ban siew pat ïa kata baroh kaba u la ïoh da ki lad bymdei . Ha kata ka sngi ba la lap ba u la leh pop , u dei ban pynphai pura sha u trai , lem bad arphew bynta na ka shispah .

translation.en: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho . And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Jerikho ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Sakkur , u khun jong u Imri u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .

translation.en: Acquaint now thyself with him , and be at peace : thereby good shall come unto thee .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko Job , ïasuk noh bad U Blei bad sangeh noh na kaba pynlong ïa u kum u nongshun ; lada phi leh kumta , te un sa kyrkhu ïa phi .
Ki lumbah ki khynñiuh ha khmat U Trai jong u Lum Sinai Ha khmat Trai , U ki Israel .
translation.en: The mountains melted from before the  Lord  , even that Sinai from before the  Lord  God of Israel .

translation.en: And the children of Reuben , and the children of Gad , and half the tribe of Manasseh , passed over armed before the children of Israel , as Moses spake unto them :
Neither let us tempt Christ , as some of them also tempted , and were destroyed of serpents .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban tynjuh ïa U Trai , kumba don na ki , kiba la leh kumta — bad la pynïap ïa ki da ki bseiñ .
Haba katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la ïalumlang , U Jisu u kylli ïa ki ,
translation.en: While the Pharisees were gathered together , Jesus asked them ,

translation.kha: U jait u Nebo lah ai kba ïa u paidbah mawkyrdon Nongïalam 8 uba ngan jingïadih u long uta uba shyrkhei kwah . To kem jingrisa biang !
translation.en: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he : hold him fast .

translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei Rohgah Mikaïah jingïabujli khun u Hali , na ka nongbah kyndiang . Jehoaddin thma ka la khie Milkah u Abijah bad u Jeroboam .
translation.en: He reigned three years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah . And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba U Trai leh ha kata sngi , ka la pynlong ïa paid Israel ban ñiew ïa u Joshua riewkhraw . Ki burom ïa shi lynter ka jingim jong u , kumba la burom ïa u .
translation.en: On that day the  Lord  magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel  ; and they feared him , as they feared Moses , all the days of his life .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ïai pynkynmaw ïa phi Ïaroh kine kiei kiei 31 wat la phi la tip lypa 37 phi ïeng skhem ha ka ïohkynti kaba phi la ïohpdiang .
translation.en: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things , though ye know them , and be established in the present truth .
But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women , and the chief men of the city , and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas , and expelled them out of their coasts .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki la pynkhih ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka nongbah bad ïa ki kynthei Jentil kiba don ha ki kyrdan kiba halor ha ka imlang ka sahlang kiba la mane ïa U Blei . translation.en: And Saul was very wroth , and the saying displeased him  ; and he said , They have ascribed unto David ten thousands , and to me they have ascribed but thousands : and what can he have more but the kingdom ?

translation.en: If thou prepare thine heart , and stretch out thine hands toward him  ;

translation.en: Who would not fear thee , O King of nations ? for to thee doth it appertain : forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations , and in all their kingdoms , there is none like unto thee .

translation.en: And in the morning , It will be foul weather to day : for the sky is red and lowring . O ye hypocrites , ye can discern the face of the sky  ; but can ye not discern the signs of the times ?

jingkhleh kali uba ïuhroit ïa nga , u shakri jong me , khnang ba ngan ïoh im , bad kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong me .
