translation.en: And I will break the pride of your power  ; and I will make your heaven as iron , and your earth as brass :
translation.kha: Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka jingsngewmeng jong phi ; yn ym don slap , bad ka khyndew jong phi kan tyrkhong bad eh kum u nar .
Ka Babilonia kynsan ka kyllon bad la pynjot noh ! To ïam namar ! dawai na ka bynta ki jingmong jong ka , bad lehse yn lah ban .
translation.en: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed : howl for her  ; take balm for her pain , if so be she may be healed .
And the rest of the acts of Zachariah , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Sekharaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
Ngi tip ïa kaei kaba Jingthoh ong ka long shisha ; U Blei u la khot ki ki blei , ki briew ha Blei u la ai ïa khubor jong u
translation.en: If he called them gods , unto whom the word of God came , and the scripture cannot be broken  ;

translation.kha: Un dei ma u mala u ban tei ka Plie ïa nga jingpynshoi bad ngan pynthikna ba ka longïing syiem jong u ïaphawar Barsillai .
translation.en: He shall build an house for my name , and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever .
So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet : for his God gave him rest round about .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jehoshaphat u synshar ha ka jingsuk , bad U Blei u ai ha u ka jingshongshngain ha ki liang baroh .
sleit Jisu u la jubab , Dei jingkhlaiñbor nga , ma nga keiñ uba ïakren bad pha .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  I that speak unto thee am he .
Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah , I prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la ai ïa ka dulir thied jaka ha u Barukh , nga la duwai ,
U Moses u la ong ha ki , Uno uno ruh um dei ban pynsah ïa tang ka wat khyndiat ruh na ka bynta kaba la shai .
translation.en: And Moses said , Let no man leave of it till the morning .
Turn again , my daughters , go your way  ; for I am too old to have an husband . If I should say , I have hope , if I should have an husband also to night , and should also bear sons  ;
translation.kha: Khie leit phai noh sha ïing , naba nga la tymmen ban shongkurim biang . Wat lada nga pyrkhat ba dang don jingkyrmen , bad kumta ban shongkurim ha kane ka miet bad ïoh khun shynrang ,

translation.en: For he took away the altars of the strange gods , and the high places , and brake down the images , and cut down the groves :
translation.kha: U weng noh ïa ki duwan nongwei bad ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , u pynpra ïa ki rishot maw bakyntang , bad u ot noh ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah .
Thiah U Baroh Shimiet .
translation.en: He slept the whole night .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba nga la hukum ïa me jingmanbha Manasseh uba kut jingmut triang bad uba skhem ! Wat sheptieng lane noh mynsiem , jingpynkhuid jingbynrap , U Trai U Blei Sadok me , nga long ryngkat lem bad Pynkloi kat shaba me leit .
translation.en: Have not I commanded thee ? Be strong and of a good courage  ; be not afraid , neither be thou dismayed : for the  Lord  thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest .
But be it so , I did not burden you : nevertheless , being crafty , I caught you with guile .
translation.kha: Phin mynjur , namarkata , ba ngam shym la long ka jingbankhia ïa phi . Hynrei don ki ban ong ba nga la long uba sianti , bad riam ïa phi da ki jingshukor .
Ko Kaiwan kynthei pynkitkhlieh to pyndem ha la ki Heshbon , kumba ha U Trai .
translation.en: Wives , submit yourselves unto your own husbands , as unto the Lord .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , nga phah tang sha ki langbrot ba la jah noh jong ki paid Israel .
translation.en: But he answered and said ,  I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel .
And they offered unto the  Lord  the same time , of the spoil which they had brought , seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  na ka jinglute kaba ki la wanrah biang : hynñiewspah tylli ki khlieh jong ki masi bad hynñiew hajar tylli ki langbrot .

translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian .
translation.kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Paul ,  Ha kane ka por balyngkot , hato me pyrkhat ba men pynlong Khristan ïa nga ?

translation.en: And I heard another out of the altar say , Even so , Lord God Almighty , true and righteous are thy judgments .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na ka duwan kaba ong ,  Ko Trai uba U Blei Badonbor Baroh ! Kaba shisha bad kaba hok ki long da shisha ki jingbishar jong me !
Hynrei u ong shuh shuh , Shah pan tang kawei na phi . Uwei pa na un ai ha nga ïa ki sohshkor phi la shim . ( Ki kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap , ki deng ki sohshkor ksiar )
translation.en: And Gideon said unto them , I would desire a request of you , that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey . ( For they had golden earrings , because they were Ishmaelites . )

translation.kha: ban pynïap ïa ki ïa ki kynthei , ban pynïap ïa kiba tymmen bad ïa kiba dang , ban pynïap ïa ki khynnah shynrang bad ki khynnah kynthei
translation.en: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman  ; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young  ; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid  ;

The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God , which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation  ; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels , and in the presence of the Lamb :
translation.kha: u hi da lade un dih ïa ka waiñ ka jong U Blei , ka waiñ ka jingbitar shla jong U , kaba u la theh noh ha ka bor jong ka baroh ha ka khuri ka jingbitar jong U ! Baroh kiba leh ïa kane kin shah pynsaja ha ka ding bad ha u kyndok ha khmat ki angel bakhuid bad ha khmat U Khunlangbrot .
La otsher ïa ki baroh ar Khisloth ha kajuh ka sngi ,
translation.en: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised , and Ishmael his son .

translation.kha: Haba ki jingbnoh Suk thiah ha ka step kaba bud shongneh ka sngi Shi la tyngshaiñ halor ka um theisotti da kaba pynlong kato ka ba thir saw kum lyngkhot snam .
translation.en: And they rose up early in the morning , and the sun shone upon the water , and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood :

translation.kha: song la ïap na ka bynta baroh , khnang ba kito kiba im kim nongkyllan shuh ban plied na ka bynta ïa lade , hynrei tang na jingthohbria Phet jong uta uba Shano ïap bad ba la pynmihpat na ka bynta dong ki .
translation.en: And that he died for all , that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves , but unto him which died for them , and rose again .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang don kham sha ki jngai la ïohi ïa u Job , hynrei kim shym ithuh ba dei ma u . Haba ki la ithuh , ki la sdang ban ïam bad lynñiar , kthang kad ki la ïa ki jaiñphong ha ka jingsngewsih bad ki kynting pui pui sha suiñ bad ha la ki khlieh .
translation.en: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off , and knew him not , they lifted up their voice , and wept  ; and they rent every one his mantle , and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven .
One of themselves , even a prophet of their own , said , The Cretans are alway liars , evil beasts , slow bellies .
translation.kha: Dei u nong Krit hi , uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa jong ki , uba la kren ïa ka jingshisha mynba u la ong ,  Ki nong Krit ki long borabor kiba lamler , ki riewkhlaw bymman , bad ki jlawnguid bajaipdeh .
Lada nga phah ïa ki sha ïing khlem ïa ki kin ïapler ki dang ïaid , namar katto katne ngut na ki ki la wan na ka lynti bajngai .
translation.en: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses , they will faint by the way : for divers of them came from far .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu hiar na ka lieng , u la ïohi ïa une u paidbah babun , bad ïa ka mynsiem jong u la da ka jingsngewsynei ïa ki , namar ki long kum langbrot khlem u nongsharai . Kumta u la sdang ban hikai kiei ïa ki .
translation.en: And Jesus , when he came out , saw much people , and was moved with compassion toward them , because they were as sheep not having a shepherd : and he began to teach them many things .

translation.kha: Ko hynmen ko para jong nga , nga dei ban kren shai shaphang U syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen bapawnam jong ngi . U la bad ïap la tep ïa u , bad ka jingtep jong u ka don hangne bad ngi haduh kane ka sngi .
translation.en: Men and brethren , let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David , that he is both dead and buried , and his sepulchre is with us unto this day .
And so , after he had patiently endured , he obtained the promise .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la ïaishah slem , bad kumta u la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .

translation.en: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary , to comfort them concerning their brother .
translation.kha: Ka Bethania ka jngai kumba lai kilomitar duna na Jerusalem , bad shibun ki nong Judia ki la wan ban peit ïa ka Martha bad ka Mari ban pyntngen ïa ki ha ka jingïap noh u para jong ki .

translation.en: Because thine heart was tender , and thou didst humble thyself before God , when thou heardest his words against this place , and against the inhabitants thereof , and humbledst thyself before me , and didst rend thy clothes , and weep before me  ; I have even heard thee also , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad to kylla-kaba-mut bad pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jong nga , da kaba kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad da kaba ïam , haba me ïohsngew kumno nga la byrngem ban pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong ka .

translation.en: In the seventh month , in the one and twentieth day of the month , came the word of the  Lord  by the prophet Haggai , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew wei jong u bnai uba hynñiew ha kata kajuh ka snem , U  Trai  u la kren biang lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: But of the times and the seasons , brethren , ye have no need that I write unto you .
translation.kha: Ym donkam ban thoh ha phi , ko parabangeit , shaphang ki por bad ki khep haba kine kiei kiei kin jia .
Dang step phyrngab ha step ka kaba bud u leit wad ïa u Saul . U ba ïohsngew u Saul u la leit ka sha nongrit Karmel , ha kaba u la tei mot ïa lade , bad nangta u la leit sha Gilgal .
translation.en: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning , it was told Samuel , saying , Saul came to Carmel , and , behold , he set him up a place , and is gone about , and passed on , and gone down to Gilgal .
So went Satan forth from the presence of the  Lord  , and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown .
translation.kha: Nangta u Soitan u mihnoh na khmat U  Trai  bad u pynsaja da ki tohjaw ha baroh shi rynïeng ka met jong u Job .

translation.en: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved , and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll : and all their host shall fall down , as the leaf falleth off from the vine , and as a falling fig from the fig tree .
translation.kha: Ka sngi , u bnai bad ki khlur kin lwet jin . Ka sahit bneng kan jah noh kum ka kitab ba la kli , bad ba ki khlur kin hap kum ki sla na u dieng sohwaiñ bad u dieng Dumbur .
Da ki kambah jingphylla kiba la pynsngewshyrkhei ïa ki nongshun jong ngi , me la ïa ka bor bad ka borbah jong me ban wallam ïa ki jong me ki Israel , na ka ri Ijipt
translation.en: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs , and with wonders , and with a strong hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with great terror  ;

translation.kha: A Blei , U Blei ngi long uba khraw Katno long uba shyrkhei bad uba donbor ! Me batskhem ki kular ka jingïateh jutang . ka por syiem Assyria banbeiñ ïa , wat haduh kane por , haduh katno ngi shahshitom ! Ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongïalam jong , ki lyngdoh nongïathuhlypa , ki kpa tymmen jong bad baroh ki briew jong ngi ki shitom . To kynmaw katno ngi la shahshitom !
translation.en: Now therefore , our God , the great , the mighty , and the terrible God , who keepest covenant and mercy , let not all the trouble seem little before thee , that hath come upon us , on our kings , on our princes , and on our priests , and on our prophets , and on our fathers , and on all thy people , since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day .
Then took they the body of Jesus , and wound it in linen clothes with the spices , as the manner of the Jews is to bury .
translation.kha: Kine ar ngut ki rangbah , ki la shim ïa ka met U Jisu bad ki la sop ïa ka da ki jaiñ linen lem bad ki musla kat kum ka rukom ki Jiw haba pynkhreh ïa ka met shuwa ban tep .

translation.en: Behold , the Lord will cast her out , and he will smite her power in the sea  ; and she shall be devoured with fire .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai un shim noh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ka don . Un kynting ïa ka spah jong ka sha ka duriaw , bad ïa ka nongbah yn thang haduh khyndew .
ai ki ngi sha baroh ki jong phi bad sha ki briew jong U Blei baroh parabangeit jong ngi na Italy ki ki jingkhublei jong phi .
translation.en: Salute all them that have the rule over you , and all the saints . They of Italy salute you .

translation.kha: Sidon u Karshena uba kheiñ Sheleph la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ïadem suiñ . Ka barew kaba jam ka la jingphet na ka Ittai kaba ha ka klop , ka da Raamah , Hierapolis pyndep !
translation.en: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air  ; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven , from the throne , saying , It is done .

And the  Lord  said unto Ahijah , Behold , the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son  ; for he is sick : thus and thus shalt thou say unto her : for it shall be , when she cometh in , that she shall feign herself to be another woman .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha u ba ka tnga u Jeroboam kan wan wad jingtip na u shaphang u khun jong ka , uba pang . Bad U  Trai  u bthah ïa u Ahijah aïu ban ong . Haba ka tnga u Jeroboam ka la poi , ka leh mynleh ïa lade kum kawei pat ka briew .
Ka Ostrit ka iehnoh ïa jingwallam ki pynkie ha tyrha ba ka jingshit hapoh ka khyndew kan pynsyaid ïa ki .
translation.en: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth , and warmeth them in dust ,

translation.kha: Bat synshar ïa la ka jingkhluit khlieh ; ka long jingbieit ka ban pynlang ïa ka jingbatnud .
translation.en: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry : for anger resteth in the bosom of fools .

And Festus said , King Agrippa , and all men which are here present with us , ye see this man , about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me , both at Jerusalem , and also here , crying that he ought not to live any longer .
translation.kha: U Phestos u la ong ,  Ko syiem Agrippa bad baroh kiba don hangne bad ngi : Phi ïohi ïa une u briew ïa uba ki Jiw baroh , kiba hangne bad ha Jerusalem , ki la wallam ki jingujor sha nga . Ki pyrta ba um dei shuh ban im .

translation.en: Now there were men lying in wait , abiding with her in the chamber . And she said unto him , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he brake the withs , as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire . So his strength was not known .
translation.kha: Ka la pynbeit ban don katto katne ki rangbah ha kawei pat ka kamra , kumta ka pyrta ,  Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan !  Hynrei u bthat ïa kita ki  saisiej kumba dkut u  saihon haba dei ding . Kumta kim shym tip satia ïa kaba rieh ka borbah jong u .

translation.en: But I have said unto you , Ye shall inherit their land , and I will give it unto you to possess it , a land that floweth with milk and honey : I am the  Lord  your God , which have separated you from other people .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la kular ha phi ïa kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kum ka jingïohkynti jong phi , bad ngan ai ïa ka ha phi . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad nga la pynkyrpang ïa phi na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
Kam pher katno sien uba hok u kyllon , borabor un khie pat ; hynrei ka jingjot ka pynjot ïa bymman ki .
translation.en: For a just man falleth seven times , and riseth up again : but the wicked shall fall into mischief .

translation.kha: Uno u uno bym don U Mynsiem , um lah ban ïohpdiang ïa ki kiba jingai wan na U Mynsiem U Blei . Kum uta u briew da shisha um sngewthuh ïa ki ; ki ka long jingbieit ha u , namar ïa dor ka jong ki lah ban bishar tang na ka nongrim kaba kynja mynsiem .
translation.en: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God : for they are foolishness unto him : neither can he know them , because they are spiritually discerned .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka khubor kam ngam jylliew hapoh ki jong , bad kim neh slem . Kumta haba ka lane jingeh ka jingpynshitom beiñ ka wan namar ka khubor , tang kumta hi ki phai dien noh .
translation.en: And have no root in themselves , and so endure but for a time : afterward , when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word s sake , immediately they are offended .

translation.kha: jingkhmih Jonah , ka mahadei ka jubab , Lada phi sngewbha , ko syiem , ban kyndeh ïa ka jingkyrpad kmienah jong nga , ka jingkwah jong nga ka long ba ngan lah ban im bad ba ki briew jong nga ruh kin Janoah .
translation.en: Then Esther the queen answered and said , If I have found favour in thy sight , O king , and if it please the king , let my life be given me at my petition , and my people at my request :

translation.kha: Me dei hikai ban ïa ki paid Israel ïa ki aiñ baroh kiba nga la ai ha me lyngba u Moses .
translation.en: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the  Lord  hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Silpah , ka mraw ka Leah , ki long u Gad bad u Asher . Ïa kine ki khun la kha ha Mesopotamia .
translation.en: And the sons of Zilpah , Leah s handmaid  ; Gad , and Asher : these are the sons of Jacob , which were born to him in Paddan–aram .

translation.kha: Lada yn kylli ngi ïa mynta shaphang ka kam babha ïa kaba la leh ha u briew uba dkoh bad kumno la pynkhiah ïa u ,
translation.en: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man , by what means he is made whole  ;

translation.kha: ( Ki Israel ki mihnoh na ki pukri ki nong Jaakan bad ki leit sha Moserah . u Hangta Aaron u la ïap , bad hangta ruh la ïa tep u , bad u Eleasar u khun jong u , u shim ïa ka jaka jong kum u u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Moserah : there Aaron died , and there he was buried  ; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest s office in his stead .

Now therefore , I pray thee , hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid , and let me set a morsel of bread before thee  ; and eat , that thou mayest have strength , when thou goest on thy way .
translation.kha: Mynta pat , sngewbha leh ïa kaba nga ong . Shah ngan wanrah bam ïa phi . Phi dei ban bam ba phin dup ïohbor ynda phi leit sha la ka jingleit .

translation.en: The name of the  Lord  is a strong tower : the righteous runneth into it , and is safe .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long kum ka kut baskhem , sha kaba kiba hok ki lah ban leit bad sngewshngain .

translation.en: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder , and upon thy seed for ever .
translation.kha: Kin long ka dak kaba sakhi ïa ka jingbishar U Blei ha phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi junom .

translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  stablished the kingdom in his hand  ; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents  ; and he had riches and honour in abundance .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa u Jehoshaphat ka jingsynshar baskhem halor ka hima Judah , bad baroh ki briew ki wallam ki jingai sngewbha , ba kumta u long uba riewspah bad ïoh ïa ka burom bakhraw .
Nga long Trai Blei phi ; nga pynphaloh ïa bad nga pynlong ïa ki jingat phyllung ban kyrhuh . Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long U Badonbor Baroh !
translation.en: But I am the  Lord  thy God , that divided the sea , whose waves roared : The  Lord  of hosts is his name .

translation.kha: U Joab u jubab Lada , me la ïa ïohi u , balei men shym pynïap ïa u ha shen ? Nga da lade hi ngan jin da ai la ha me shiphew tylli ki sbai rupa bad uwei u panpoh .
translation.en: And Joab said unto the man that told him , And , behold , thou sawest him , and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground ? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver , and a girdle .

translation.kha: U shna hynñiew tylli ki sharak na jingsleh bynta uta u Agrippa sharak , bad u thaw ruh ïa ki nap bad ki jingdiang jong u da ka ksiar barit .
translation.en: And he made his seven lamps , and his snuffers , and his snuffdishes , of pure gold .

translation.kha: Haba me sneng ïa ki um , ki phet ; phet ki noh haba ki ïohsngew ïa ka jingpyrta jong ka hukum jong me .
translation.en: At thy rebuke they fled  ; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away .

translation.kha: Kine harum ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba dei ban pateng la pateng . Ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew , ki Israel ki kiba shong bad ki , dei ban shahjingit bad ban ym trei ïa kano kano kam .
translation.en: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you : that in the seventh month , on the tenth day of the month , ye shall afflict your souls , and do no work at all , whether it be one of your own country , or a stranger that sojourneth among you :

Let us pass , I pray thee , through thy country : we will not pass through the fields , or through the vineyards , neither will we drink of the water of the wells : we will go by the king s high way , we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left , until we have passed thy borders .
translation.kha: Sngewbha shah ïa ngi ban ïaid lynti na ka hima jong phi . Ma ngi lem bad ki jingri jong ngi , ngin ym sakma na ka lynti ïaid lane leit sha ki lyngkha ne ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi , bad ngin ym dih um na ki pukri jong phi . Ngin ïaid na lynti bah haduh ba ngin da ïaid lait na ka hima jong phi .
Ynda nga pynjot ïa me , ngan Jingthoh ticket ka sahit bneng bad pyndum ïa ki katto-katne . ingiew sngi kan buhrieh sha lyndet ki lyoh , bad Hikai bnai un ym ai jingshai .
translation.en: And when I shall put thee out , I will cover the heaven , and make the stars thereof dark  ; I will cover the sun with a cloud , and the moon shall not give her light .
For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us : for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you ;
translation.kha: Phi hi phi tip bha ba phi dei ban leh ïa kaei kaba ngi la leh . Ngim shym la long kiba jaipdeh mynba ngi la don bad phi .

translation.en: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days , and keep the charge of the  Lord  , that ye die not : for so I am commanded .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban sah ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ miet la bad sngi haduh hynñiew sngi , ban leh ïa kata kaba U  Trai  u la hukum . Lada phim leh kumta , phin ïap . Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga .
Bad kumta ki briew ka Israel kin ïohknieh ïa kaei kaba dang sah jong ka ri Edom ïa bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba shisien ki long ki jong nga , ong U Trai u , ban pynlong ïa kane ban . jia
translation.en: That they may possess the remnant of Edom , and of all the heathen , which are called by my name , saith the  Lord  that doeth this .

In this thing the  Lord  pardon thy servant , that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there , and he leaneth on my hand , and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon : when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon , the  Lord  pardon thy servant in this thing .
translation.kha: Kumta nga kyrmen ba U  Trai  un map ïa nga haba nga synran ïa la u syiem sha ka templ u Rimmon , u blei Syria , bad mane ïa u . Da shisha U  Trai  un map ïa nga !

translation.en: But Jesus said ,  Forbid him not : for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name , that can lightly speak evil of me .
translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  namar ym don uba leh ïa ka kambah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , ba shen hadien un ong kiei kiei kiba sniew shaphang jong nga .

translation.en: You haven't even tried .
translation.kha: Phim pat pyrshang hi .

translation.en: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son : but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame .
translation.kha: U briew uba sngewthuh u lum ïa ki soh ha ka aïom kaba biang ; ka long kaba jahburom ban thiah thai ha ka por ka aïom ot .

Na ka bynta ka por baroh ka ban sa wan ïa kane ka jingkñia ainguh dei ban da leh uwei pa uwei u Lyngdoh uba hiarpateng na u u Aaron ban shakri kum u Rangbah Lyngdoh . Dei ba yn thang lut khoit ïa ka kum jingkñia ka sha U Trai .
translation.en: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it : it is a statute for ever unto the  Lord   ; it shall be wholly burnt .

translation.kha: Ka jong phi ka dei long borabor sngewbang bad kaba sngewtynnat bad phi dei ban tip kumno ban ai ka jubab kaba dei ha uwei uwei .
translation.en: Let your speech be always with grace , seasoned with salt , that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man .

translation.kha: U u Trai la ong ha nga , Buh ïa ka ha ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ . Kumta nga la shim ïa ki laiphew tylli sbai ki — rupa ka jingkheiñ kaba khraw kaba ki la pyrkhat ba nga la shongdor — bad buh ïa ka ha ka jong jingkynshew ka Templ .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Cast it unto the potter : a goodly price that I was prised at of them . And I took the thirty pieces of silver , and cast them to the potter in the house of the  Lord .
And he thought within himself , saying , What shall I do , because I have no room where to bestow my fruits ?
translation.kha: U la sdang ban pyrkhat ha lade , ‘ Ngam don hangno hangno ban buh ïa ki jingthung jong nga baroh . Aïu nga lah ban leh ?

Nangta u nongïathuhlypa u ong ha u syiem , Kane ka dei ka ktien U sharati : ‘ Namar ba me la Deborah ïa u briew ban lait phet ïa uba nga la hukum ban pynïap , men hap ban siew Maaseïah nongkhmih ka jingim , bad thalab (Nga kynhun shipai jong me yn pynjot namar ba jingsngap pyllait ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ban lait phet .’
translation.en: And he said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction , therefore thy life shall go for his life , and thy people for his people .

translation.kha: Ïa kata ka jaka la Myntan ka Kibroth Hattaabah ( pynmong mut ki Jingtep ka jingkwah rhah Matri tad namar hangta ki la Tebalaïah ïa Israel briew kiba la kwah Nebukhadnessar Aleksandria bam doh .
translation.en: And he called the name of that place Kibroth–hattaavah : because there they buried the people that lusted .
And Nathan departed unto his house . And the  Lord  struck the child that Uriah s wife bare unto David , and it was very sick .
translation.kha: Nangta u Nathan u leit phai noh sha ïing . U  Trai  u la pynngat ka jingshitom bajur ha u khunlung ba ka tnga u Uriah ka la ïoh na u Dabid .

translation.en: The people shall hear , and be afraid : sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Philistia .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew , bad ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng ; ïa ki Philistia la kynrup da ka jingsngewtriem .
Hynrei uno uno uba ïohsngew kine ïa ki ktien jong bad nga u bymkohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba bieit uba la tei ïa la ka ïing halor u shyiap .
translation.en: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them not , shall be likened unto a foolish man , which built his house upon the sand :
Who then is Paul , and who is Apollos , but ministers by whom ye believed , even as the Lord gave to every man ?
translation.kha: Haba kumta , uei u Apollos ? Bad uei u Paul ? Ngi dei tang ki shakri jong U Blei , kiba la ïalam ïa phi ban ngeit . Uwei pa uwei na ngi u trei ïa ka kam kaba U Trai u la ai ïa u ban leh :

translation.en: And David said unto Saul , Who am I ? and what is my life , or my father s family in Israel , that I should be son in law to the king ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga dei uei keiñ bad kaei ka longïing jong nga ba ngan ïoh long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem ?

translation.en: Go ye up unto this feast : I go not up yet unto this feast  ; for my time is not yet full come .
translation.kha: Ma phi to nang ïaleit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam . Nga ngam leit sha kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , namar ba ka por kaba biang kam pat poi na ka bynta jong nga .

Katba ki —Judah ïadih , u Belshassar u la ai hukum ban wallam ha ki khuri ksiar bad rupa jingbymïaid ha Shishak pliang kiba u Nebukhadnessar u kpa jong u , u la rah noh na ka Templ kaba Assos Jerusalem . U syiem u la phah shim hangne ki khnang nongtrei ma u , Shata rangbah donburom jong u , ki tnga phylla u , bad ki tnga kliar Reuben u ki lah ban dih na pynkhleh .
translation.en: Belshazzar , whiles he tasted the wine , commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem  ; that the king , and his princes , his wives , and his concubines , might drink therein .

Now it came to pass on the third day , that Esther put on her royal apparel , and stood in the inner court of the king s house , over against the king s house : and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house , over against the gate of the house .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai jong ka jingshah jingit , ka Esther ka phong ïa ki jingriam syiem jong ka bad ka leit bad ïeng ha ka phyllaw ba kham shapoh ka ïingsyiem , kaba phai khmat sha ka kamra ba don ka khet syiem . U syiem u don hapoh , u shong halor ka khet syiem , da kaba phai khmat sha ka khyrdop .
Kumno u Abraham , u kpa tymmen jong phi u la long uba la pynksan da U Blei ? la Ka long namar ki kam ki jong u mynba , u la aiti ïa u Isaak u jong khun u ha ka duwan .
translation.en: Was not Abraham our father justified by works , when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar ?
And Moses said unto Korah , Hear , I pray you , ye sons of Levi :
translation.kha: U Moses u la bteng ban kren ha u Korah ,  Da sngap bha , phi ki Lebi !
borabor lah ban jingjaw bashemphang bymjukut hynrei wat ngeit ïa u , namar ka dohnud jong u ka dap haduh rymmiang kuratia jingkynmaw jingisih .
translation.en: When he speaketh fair , believe him not : for there are seven abominations in his heart .

translation.kha: bad u Ahio u na ïaid khmat .
translation.en: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah , accompanying the ark of God : and Ahio went before the ark .
A people great , and many , and tall , as the Anakims  ; but the  Lord  destroyed them before them  ; and they succeeded them , and dwelt in their stead :
translation.kha: Ki long kiba jrong kat ki Anakim , kiba bun paid , bad kiba khlaiñ . Hynrei U  Trai  u la pynjot ïa ki baroh , kumta ki Ammon ki ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki bad ki shong hangta .

translation.en: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of ? for I bear you record , that , if it had been possible , ye would have plucked out your own eyes , and have given them to me .
translation.kha: Haei ken kata ka jingkyrkhu ka ba phi la ong ? Nga hi nga lah ban ong ba phin da la khlaw noh ïa la ki jong ki khmat , lada phi lah , bad ban ai noh ïa ki ha nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister s son , that he ran to meet him , and embraced him , and kissed him , and brought him to his house . And he told Laban all these things .
translation.kha: Ka leit bran bran ban ïathuh ha la u kpa ; bad haba u la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang u pyrsa jong u , u Jakob , mar mar u leit ban ïashem ïa u ; u la kdup bad u doh ïa u , bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ïing .

translation.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness , neither hath he covered the darkness from my face .
translation.kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la pynjot ïa ka jingshlur jong nga . Dei U Blei , ym ka jingdum , kata kaba pynlong ïa nga ban sheptieng — wat la ka jingdum ka la pynmatlah ïa nga .
tnga Ka jong u ka dei ka Ahinoam , ka khun jong u Ahimaas ; rangbah u ai hukum ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u , u dei u Abner , bakha u jong u , u khun jong u Ner u kñi jong u .
translation.en: And the name of Saul s wife was Ahinoam , the daughter of Ahimaaz : and the name of the captain of his host was Abner , the son of Ner , Saul s uncle .
Then measured he the porch of the gate , eight cubits  ; and the posts thereof , two cubits  ; and the porch of the gate was inward .
translation.kha: U la thew ïa kane ka kamra bad u la lap ba ka jylliew saw mitar shapoh . Ka pynlong ka tduh jong ka lynti rung kaba jan tam sha ka Templ bad sha bakut jong ka , ki kynroh ki rben shi mitar .
Ki la jam ïa ka Jordan bad la ki sher dara ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Aroer , ka nongbah kaba don hapdeng jong ka them , ha ka ri ki Gad . Na kata ka jaka la ki leit shatei shaphang sha Jaser ;
translation.en: And they passed over Jordan , and pitched in Aroer , on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad , and toward Jazer :
And Bath–sheba went in unto the king into the chamber : and the king was very old  ; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Bathsheba ka leit jngoh ïa u syiem ha ka kamra thiah jong u . U la tymmen bha , bad ka Abishag , ka samla kynthei na Shunem , ka sumar ïa u .

translation.en: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the  Lord  , and spake , saying , I will sing unto the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously : the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad ki Israel ki rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ha U  Trai  :  Ngan rwai ha U  Trai namar ka jingjop kaba khraw jong u ; sha duriaw u la bret ïa ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai .

translation.en: Haran , and Canneh , and Eden , the merchants of Sheba , Asshur , and Chilmad , were thy merchants .
translation.kha: Ki nongbah ka Haran , Kanneh , bad Eden , ki nongkhaïi ka Sheba , ki nongbah ka Asshur bad Khilmad — baroh ki ïakhaïi pateng bad pha .
Suit ïa ka da ka ksiar nylla na shapoh bad shabar , bad pynpur ka da ksiar ha ka rmiang jong ka baroh sawdong .
translation.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , within and without shalt thou overlay it , and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about .

translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ïa ki , naba ngan don lem bad me ïada ïa me . U Trai nga la kren !
translation.en: Be not afraid of their faces : for I am with thee to deliver thee , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Shibun ki briew ki la wan sha u . U Ïoannis um leh kambah mawria ei , ki la jingïakhaïi , hynrei kiei kiei baroh kiba ïohrung la phut pynkhlaiñ une Sah ïohknieh ka la pyllaitluid kaba shisha .
translation.en: And many resorted unto him , and said , John did no miracle : but all things that John spake of this man were true .

translation.kha: U Eli u la ïa kata ka jingsawa bad u , jingsawa aïu kata ? Uta u rangbah u leit kloi kloi u Eli ban ïathuh ha ïa kaba la jia baroh .
translation.en: And when Eli heard the noise of the crying , he said , What meaneth the noise of this tumult ? And the man came in hastily , and told Eli .

translation.kha: U Melkhisedek um shym la hiarpateng na u Lebi , hynrei u la lum ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na u Abraham bad u la kyrkhu u , u briew uba la ïohpdiang ïa ki U Blei .
translation.en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham , and blessed him that had the promises .
Give them , O  Lord  : what wilt thou give ? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngan kylli na phi ban leh ïa kine ki briew ? Pynlyngki ïa ki kynthei jong ki ! Pynlong ïa ki ba kin ym lah ban sumar ïa ki khunlung jong ki !

translation.en: Again in the ninth year , in the tenth month , in the tenth day of the month , the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba shiphew ha ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .
Ngim nud ban leit sha ki rudnong lane ïaid ha ki surok , namar ki nongshun ngi jong ki la kieng atiar bad ka jingshyrkhei ka don ha sawdong baroh jong ngi .
translation.en: Go not forth into the field , nor walk by the way  ; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingshisha ka long ba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , kum ka jingbahkhlieh ba ïa kito la kiba ïap yn sa pynmihpat ïa ruh ki .
translation.en: But now is Christ risen from the dead , and become the firstfruits of them that slept .
As the sin offering is , so is the trespass offering : there is one law for them : the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it .
translation.kha: Don tang kawei ka aiñ kaba ïadei lang ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat : ka doh ka dei jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia .
ïa u Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah : Nga la jan ban pynkhih ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew
translation.en: Speak to Zerubbabel , governor of Judah , saying , I will shake the heavens and the earth  ;
So the ark of the  Lord  compassed the city , going about it once : and they came into the camp , and lodged in the camp .
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa kane ka kynhun ki rangbah ban rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sawdong ka nongbah shisien . Nangta ki wan phai pat sha ka jaka shong dara bad ki sahmiet hangta .

translation.en: For the same cause also do ye joy , and rejoice with me .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , phi ruh phi dei ban shadkmen , bad ïasam bynta lem ïa ka jingkmen jong phi bad nga .

translation.en: Then Jesus turned , and saw them following , and saith unto them ,  What seek ye ?  They said unto him , Rabbi , ( which is to say , being interpreted , Master , ) where dwellest thou ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai , u la ïohi ïa ki ba ki bud ïa u , bad u la kylli ,  Phi ïawad aïu ?  Ki la jubab ïa u ,  Hangno me sah , ko Rabbi ?  ( Kane ka kyntien ka mut  U Nonghikai . )

translation.en: And he shall judge among the nations , and shall rebuke many people : and they shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruninghooks : nation shall not lift up sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .
translation.kha: Un bishar ïa ki jingkajia hapdeng ki jaitbynriew . Kin tied tyrnem ïa ki waitlam jong ki sha ki jinglur lyngkha bad ïa ki sum jong ki sha ki waitbnoh khyllad tnat . Ki jaitbynriew kin ym ïaleh thma shuh , kin ym pynkhreh thma shuh .

U Simeon u la kyrkhu ïa ki bad u la ong ha ka Mari , ka jong kmie u , Ïa une u khunlung la jied da Blei U na ka bynta ka jingpynjot bad ka jingpynim ïa bun kiba ha Israel . Un long ka dak na U Blei ïa kaba kiba bun briew ki kren kin pyrshah bad kumta un pynpaw ïa ki jingpyrkhat barieh jong ki .
translation.en: And Simeon blessed them , and said unto Mary his mother , Behold , this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel  ; and for a sign which shall be spoken against  ;

translation.kha: Nga ai-jingmut ia u Tom ba un ym pynlut por leh kato
translation.en: I advised Tom not to waste his time trying to do that .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ong , Nga ban pyn-i ïa ka jingneh jingïalong paralok ïa u Hanun , kumba u Nahash , u u , u la leh ïa nga . Kumta u Dabid u ki nonglamktien ban pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewlem jong u . Haba ki la ha Ammon ,
translation.en: Then said David , I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash , as his father shewed kindness unto me . And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father . And David s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: U Moses u jubab , Phi ïakwah ban shong ban sah katba hangne kiwei pat ki Israel kin leit sha ka thma ?
translation.en: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben , Shall your brethren go to war , and shall ye sit here ?
Which now of these three , thinkest thou , was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves ?
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Ha ka jingsngew jong me , uei na kine lai ngut uba la leh kum u paramarjan ïa u briew uba la shah tur ïaleh ha ki nonglute ?
Ri pynïap ïa ki jingri jong me ha ïasan ph ïadait jaka dih um . Hajan ym don shuh ki briew ne jingri ban Shibun pat kamut Krit um .
translation.en: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters  ; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more , nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them .
And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son , and she called his name Peresh  ; and the name of his brother was Sheresh  ; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem .
translation.kha: Ka Maakah , ka tnga u Makhir , ka kha ar ngut ki khun shynrang , kiba ka ai kyrteng ïa ki u Peresh bad u Sheresh . U Peresh u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Ulam bad u Rakem ,

translation.en: I wisdom dwell with prudence , and find out knowledge of witty inventions .
translation.kha: Nga long ka Jingstad , bad nga don ka bor sngewthuh ; nga don ka jingtip bad ka bor pyrkhat kaba khlaiñ .

Ha ka jinglalot jong ki , kine ki nonghikai kin balamler kamai da kaba ïathuh ïa phi ïa ki jingïathuhkhana ba shu thaw . kham La mynta slem U Nongbishar jong ki u la long uba la kloi , bad u Nongpynjot jong ki u la long u bym ju ïohthiah !
translation.en: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you : whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not , and their damnation slumbereth not .

translation.kha: Ka jingshongkurim shahskhor man ka por na ka bitar ka jingpynbha briew ïa ki kynthei ka neh shisnem — ki jingkhem kum da ka umphniang mirr na thab bynta hynriew bnai bad da ka umphniang balsam shadien hynriew bnai . Hadien kata , ïa kawei pa kawei ka samla yn ïalam kawei hadien kawei sha u syiem Serksis .
translation.en: Now when every maid s turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus , after that she had been twelve months , according to the manner of the women , ( for so were the days of their purifications accomplished , to wit , six months with oil of myrrh , and six months with sweet odours , and with other things for the purifying of the women  ; )

translation.kha: ngan phah ka ki kynroh ka Gasa , bad thang duh ki jong .
translation.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza , which shall devour the palaces thereof :

translation.kha: Bun ki nongsakhi bapawkhmat la shu sakhi Suit pyrshah ïa Pynrhem Jisu jingkdew hynrei ki jingïathuh jong ki Ishbi ïahap satia .
translation.en: For many bare false witness against him , but their witness agreed not together .

translation.kha: Khie mihnoh na Babilon , kiba laitluid ! Pyrta jam da ka jingkmen ïa ka khubor ; to pyntip ïa ka kylleng : U Trai u la pynim ki shakri jong Israel !
translation.en: Go ye forth of Babylon , flee ye from the Chaldeans , with a voice of singing declare ye , tell this , utter it even to the end of the earth  ; say ye , The  Lord  hath redeemed his servant Jacob .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka tnga Lot ka la bad ka la kylla long païa .
translation.en: But his wife looked back from behind him , and she became a pillar of salt .
Thus saith the  Lord  , your redeemer , the Holy One of Israel  ; For your sake I have sent to Babylon , and have brought down all their nobles , and the Chaldeans , whose cry is in the ships .
translation.kha: U Blei uba khuid ki Israel , U  Trai  uba pynim ïa phi u ong ,  Ban pynim ïa phi , ngan phah ïa ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ka Babilon ; ngan pynpait ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah , bad ki jingrisa jong ki briew jong ka kin kylla jingïam .

Haba nongtuh Dabid u la ïohi Khot ki ïakren pasiaw para pynkthang ki , u shikhyllipmat sngewthuh ba u khunlung u nongjapan ïap . Kumta ing kylli ïa ki , Hato Hangto khunlung u la ïap ? Ho-oid , u la ïap , ki la jubab .
translation.en: But when David saw that his servants whispered , David perceived that the child was dead : therefore David said unto his servants , Is the child dead ? And they said , He is dead .

translation.kha: Ha Kushan ka rukom phi ñiewbeiñ ïa Ai myntri jong U Blei , khnang mawkyrdon bud tliw la ka jong ka jinghikai .
translation.en: And honour not his father or his mother , he shall be free . Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition .

translation.kha: Da kumno uno uno kha lah ban ïasaid jingpynmynsaw u pyniar U lah ban kylli shihajar tylli ki jingkylli Eglath Shibun ym don mano mano ba lah ban jubab .
translation.en: If he will contend with him , he cannot answer him one of a thousand .

And Elisha came again to Gilgal : and there was a dearth in the land  ; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him : and he said unto his servant , Set on the great pot , and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets .
translation.kha: Shisien , haba la don ka  nemsniew ha kylleng ka ri , u Elisha u la leit phai sha Gilgal . Katba u dang hikai ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa , u la ong ïa u shakri jong u ban tiew ïa u khiew uba heh ha ding bad shet syrwa na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard , nor perceived by the ear , neither hath the eye seen , O God , beside thee , what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him .
translation.kha: Ym pat ju don ba ïohi lane ïohsngew ïa U Blei uba kum ma me , uba leh ïa kiba kum kita ki kam na ka bynta kito kiba ap kyrmen ha u .
Dohkha pynbynta ïa ki laispah tukri ki rangbah ha ki Asenath kynhun , bad u ai ha Bubastis uwei u briew kawei ka turoi bad uwei u khra uba don ka Joktan hapoh jong u .
translation.en: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies , and he put a trumpet in every man s hand , with empty pitchers , and lamps within the pitchers .

translation.kha: hynriew kilo ka kassia , ( ïa kiba la thew kat kum ka jingthew jong ka jaka kyntang ) . sa Bynrap saw ka litar umphniang Olib ,
translation.en: And of cassia five hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary , and of oil olive an hin :

translation.kha: Ki baroh ki khot u ïa , ‘ Mynta me la tlot kumba long ma ngi ! Me long uwei na ngi !
translation.en: All they shall speak and say unto thee , Art thou also become weak as we ? art thou become like unto us ?
So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour , and saith , Am not I in sport ?
translation.kha: U briew uba ïalam bakla ïano ïano bad nangta u kam ba u shu biria u long kum u briew uba lamwir uba ïalehkai bad ka tiar kaba pynïap .

translation.en: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour , neither rob him : the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning .
translation.kha: Wat shim kabu ïano ïano lane ban lute ïa u . Wat pynsah ïa ka bainong jong uno uno u briew uba phi la khot bylla , wat tang shi miet ruh .
U la ïohknieh ruh ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun masi ; ki briew jong u ñiah ïa kita ki jingri ha shuwa jong bad ki ong , Kane ka dei ka jong u Dabid
translation.en: And David took all the flocks and the herds , which they drave before those other cattle , and said , This is David s spoil .

translation.kha: Hadien u u Hesekaïah koit pat na ka jingpang jong u , u thoh ïa kane ka jingrwai ïaroh :
translation.en: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah , when he had been sick , and was recovered of his sickness :

translation.kha: Phi lah ban thikna ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar uwei pa uwei un ban hap ai jingkheiñ ïa kawei pa kawei kyntien ka ka bymmyntoi kaba u la kren .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That every idle word that men shall speak , they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment .
And when they came nigh to Jerusalem , unto Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount of Olives , he sendeth forth two of his disciples ,
translation.kha: Haba ki la jan poi ha Jerusalem , hajan ki shnong Bethphage bad Bethania , ki la wan sha u lum ki Olib . U Jisu u la nang phah ar ngut na ki synran ha shuwa jong u bad kine ki jingbthah :

translation.en: For thy waste and thy desolate places , and the land of thy destruction , shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants , and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ri jong pha la pynjot bad la iehnoh kynjah — hynrei mynta kan rit eh na ka bynta kito ki ban wan ban shong hangta . Bad ïa kito kiba la iehnoh ïa pha ha ka jingjot yn pynkynriah jngai na pha .
Ka pop bad ka jinglehrain ki ïaid . Pynjah noh ïa ka burom jong phi , bad phin ïa jingshah krenbeiñ ha ka jaka jong ka .
translation.en: When the wicked cometh , then cometh also contempt , and with ignominy reproach .

translation.kha: Kam ei ei satia la otsher ym shym la otsher , kaei kaba donkam ka long ban long u jingthaw uba thymmai .
translation.en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing , nor uncircumcision , but a new creature .
Be ye therefore merciful , as your Father also is merciful .
translation.kha: Long kiba sngewsynei kumba U Kpa jong phi u long uba sngewsynei .
Ka Templ ka long mynta joit ïoh burom shibun , hynrei kat phatok ïaid najan jong film un lyngngoh mynjur Jingtylli Assyria , ‘ Balei ba U Trai u la leh kumne ïa kane ka ri bad ïa kane ka Em’ ?’
translation.en: And this house , which is high , shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it  ; so that he shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and unto this house ?

translation.kha: Nga long U ïap uba don ha ki jaka baroh bad ym tang ha Anaharath ka jaka Mushi
translation.en: Am I a God at hand , saith the  Lord  , and not a God afar off ?
Asshur shall not save us  ; we will not ride upon horses : neither will we say any more to the work of our hands , Ye are our gods : for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy .
translation.kha: Ka Assyria kan ym lah da lei lei ban pyllait im ïa ngi , bad ki kulai thma kim lah ban ïada ïa ngi . Ngin ym ong shuh ha ki bleithaw jong ngi ba ki long U Blei jong ngi . A  Trai  , me pyn-i jingisynei ha kito ki bym don uno uno sha uba ki lah ban phai .
U Laban ïalute la pushara ban khap shñiuh ïa la ki jingjakhlia , Iddo ha ka por ba um don ka Rakhel mynba la tuh nongbet ki blei ïing slipar long ki jong pynsngewtynnat kpa jong ka Seir
translation.en: And Laban went to shear his sheep : and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father s .
Persecutions , afflictions , which came unto me at Antioch , at Iconium , at Lystra ; what persecutions I endured : but out of them all the Lord delivered me .
translation.kha: Me tip lut ïa baroh kaba la jia ha nga ha Antiokh , Ikoniom , bad Lystra , ki jingpynshitom bashyrkhei kiba nga la ïaishah! Hynrei u Trai u la pyllait ïa nga na ki baroh .

translation.en: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned twelve years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoshaphat , u syiem Judah , u Joram u khun jong u Ahab u la long u syiem ka Israel ; bad u la synshar khat-ar snem ha Samaria .
ngi ngi dang ïai shakri ïa U Trai U Blei jong ngi shym pat iehnoh u . Ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng u Aaron ki pyndep ïa ki jong ki , bad ki Lebi ïarap lem ïa ki .
translation.en: But as for us , the  Lord  is our God , and we have not forsaken him  ; and the priests , which minister unto the  Lord  , are the sons of Aaron , and the Levites wait upon their business :
Ye shall fall by the sword  ; I will judge you in the border of Israel  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad yn pynïap ïa phi ha ka thma ha ka ri jong phi hi . Te uwei pa uwei un tip ba nga long U  Trai .
Nga la wad shaphang mihngi keiñ! hynrei U Blei um don hangta ; ngam shym la shem ïa u haba nga wad shaphang ;’ .
translation.en: Behold , I go forward , but he is not there  ; and backward , but I cannot perceive him :

translation.kha: Phong ïa ki juti , hynrei wat rah sopti nalor kaba phi la phong .
translation.en: But be shod with sandals  ; and not put on two coats .
Doth not wisdom cry ? and understanding put forth her voice ?
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Ka jingstad ka pyrta jam . Ka jingshemphang ka kren jam .

translation.en: When thou dost lend thy brother any thing , thou shalt not go into his house to fetch his pledge .
translation.kha: Haba phi ai kylliang ei ei ïa uno uno u briew , wat leit rung sha ïing jong u ban shim ïa ka jaiñkup ban buh bynda ha phi ;

translation.en: And he spake a parable unto them , Can the blind lead the blind ? shall they not both fall into the ditch ?
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi : U briew uba matlah um lah ban ïalam ïa uwei pat ; lada u leh kumta , baroh ar ngut kin hap hapoh kharai .

translation.en: And while he yet spake , lo , Judas , one of the twelve , came , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and elders of the people .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang kren haba u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , u la wan poi . Ryngkat bad u , la don u paidbah babun uba la kieng atiar da ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , ïa kiba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san .

U syiem Hanun bad ki ki sngewthuh ba ki la ïa u Dabid u nongshun , ki siew laiphew saw hajar kilo rupa ban wai ki ïapom bad ki nongñiah kali ïapom na ka Mesopotamia bad na ki jylla Syria jong bad Sobah
translation.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David , Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia , and out of Syria–maacah , and out of Zobah .
The word which came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

kiei Baroh kiei kiba u syiem Asa u la leh , ki kam shlur jong u ki bad shnong kiba u la tei pynskhem , la buh jingthoh Ka ha Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah . Hynrei ha ka jinglong tymmen u la dkoh na ka jingpang kjat .
translation.en: The rest of all the acts of Asa , and all his might , and all that he did , and the cities which he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet .

translation.kha: Elijah U u la mihnoh bad shem ïa u Elisha ba u dang pynlur ïa shi jur ki masi dab ; la don khatwei jur ki masi dab kiba ha don ki ha lyngkor khmat jong u bad , u dang pynlur ïa kiba khatduh . U Elijah u la law noh ïa la ka barandi bad u la pynkup ha u Elisha .
translation.en: So he departed thence , and found Elisha the son of Shaphat , who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him , and he with the twelfth : and Elijah passed by him , and cast his mantle upon him .
Brethren , I speak after the manner of men ; Though it be but a man s covenant , yet if it be confirmed , no man disannulleth , or addeth thereto .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , ngan pyndonkam ïa ka nuksa kaba ju long man ka sngi : Haba ar ngut ki briew ki ïamynjur halor kano kano ka kam da kaba soi ïa ka soskular , ym don uno uno uba lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka lane pyndap ei ei ha ka .

Da ki jinglamler jong phi jingringdur kular pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki briew babha , kiba skum kwah ba kin sngewmong . Phi khang ïa ki briew basniew ban iehnoh ïa kaba bapyndait bad pyllait ïa ka jingim jong ki .
translation.en: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad , whom I have not made sad  ; and strengthened the hands of the wicked , that he should not return from his wicked way , by promising him life :

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka Edom ki la sngewshyrkhei ; ki rangbah bakhlaiñbor jong ka Moab ki sngewkyiuh ; ki briew ka Kanaan ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur jong ki .
translation.en: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed  ; the mighty men of Moab , trembling shall take hold upon them  ; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away .
Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war , by casting up mounts , and building forts , to cut off many persons :
translation.kha: Wat ka kynhun shipai kaba khlaiñ tam jong u syiem ka Ijipt kam lah ban ïarap ïa u ban ïaleh haba ki nong Ijipt ki tei ki jingtei khyndew bad tih ki kharai khnang ban pynïap bun ngut ki briew .

translation.en: But if ye will not hear it , my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride  ; and mine eye shall weep sore , and run down with tears , because the  Lord s  flock is carried away captive .
translation.kha: Lada phin ym shahshkor , ngan ïam ha kaba jar jar namar ka jingsarong jong phi ; ngan ïamkthang eh , bad ki ummat jong nga kin tuid namar ki briew jong U  Trai  ki la shah ring noh kum ki mraw .

translation.en: And he denied him , saying , Woman , I know him not .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la len ïa kata ,  Ko kynthei , ngam ju ithuh ïa u !
Mynta , thoh ïa longsyiem ka jingrwai . Hikai ïa ka jing iwbih Ainguh , khnang ba ka kan ïeng btuit Laish sakhi pyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: Now therefore write ye this song for you , and teach it the children of Israel : put it in their mouths , that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel .
And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground  ; who , when they have heard the word , immediately receive it with gladness  ;
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai kiba hap ha ka khyndew ba long maw . Ki tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki pdiang ïa ka da kaba kmen .

translation.en: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man , when he giveth of his seed unto Molech , and kill him not :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u paidbah u leh bymsuidñiew ïa kata kaba u la leh bad kim pynïap ïa u ,

Nangta ki la wan poi ha ka jaka ïa kaba la khot ka Marah hynrei , ka um hangta ka kaba long kthang haduh katta katta kim ba lah ban dih ïa ka . Dei na kata ka daw ba la khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Marah .
translation.en: And when they came to Marah , they could not drink of the waters of Marah , for they were bitter : therefore the name of it was called Marah .
One of his disciples , Andrew , Simon Peter s brother , saith unto him ,
translation.kha: Uwei pat na ki synran jong u , u Andriw , uba long u para jong u Simon Petros , u la ong ,
Ngan ïa bad ïa ki briew ka baroh , kumba la thoh ka ba u u la pule .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , and upon the inhabitants thereof , even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read :

translation.kha: Ngi wallam aïu ka ? Ym don ! Ngi ban rah aïu na ka pyrthei ? Ym don ei ei !
translation.en: For we brought nothing into this world , and it is certain we can carry nothing out .
Thou shalt make no covenant with them , nor with their gods .
translation.kha: Wat ïateh kano kano ka jutang bad ki lane bad ki blei jong ki .

translation.en: Ye have heard how I said unto you , I go away , and come again unto you . If ye loved me , ye would rejoice , because I said , I go unto the Father : for my Father is greater than I .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ïa nga ba nga ong ha phi , ‘ Ngan sa leit noh , hynrei ngan sa wan pat sha phi .’ Lada phi la ieit ïa nga , phin kmen namar ba ngan sa leit sha U Kpa ; naba u long kham khraw ban ïa nga .

translation.en: For there stood by me this night the angel of God , whose I am , and whom I serve ,
translation.kha: Namar mynhynne ka miet u angel jong U Blei ha uba nga long bad ïa uba nga mane u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,
Ka por ka poi haba ki lumbah ki twa bad ki baskhem mawsiang ki kynriah noh .
translation.en: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought , and the rock is removed out of his place .

translation.kha: Haba phi pang ñiangthohlieh , phi dei ban leh thik kumba ki lyngdoh Lebi ki ong ïa phi , bad bud ïa ki ïa kiba nga la ai ki .
translation.en: Take heed in the plague of leprosy , that thou observe diligently , and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you : as I commanded them , so ye shall observe to do .

translation.kha: U u la ai ruh ïa ki dur pynkhreh kiba ïadei bad ki jingpynbeit ryntih ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi bad pyndep ïa ki kamram ki , ban trei ïa ki kam jong ka Templ bad ban sumar ïa baroh ki khiew pliang jong ka Templ
translation.en: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites , and for all the work of the service of the house of the  Lord  , and for all the vessels of service in the house of the  Lord .
And at Taberah , and at Massah , and at Kibroth–hattaavah , ye provoked the  Lord  to wrath .
translation.kha: Phi la pynbitar ruh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi mynba phi don ha Taberah , ha Massah , bad ha Kibroth Hattaabah .

translation.en: Arab , and Dumah , and Eshean ,
translation.kha: Don ka Arab , ka Dumah , ka Eshan ,
baroh ngi tip , A Trai , ba ki patsha jong ka Assyria ki la pynjot ïa shibun ki hima , ki ki ri jong ban sah kynjah ,
translation.en: Of a truth ,  Lord  , the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands ,
And when the seven among four thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  And they said , Seven .
translation.kha: Bad haba nga la kdiah ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki saw hajar ngut ki briew ,  U Jisu u la kylli ,  katno tukri kiba da ki lyngkhot kpu ba sah tam kiba phi la ïalum ?   Hynñiew ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: And he dreamed , and behold a ladder set up on the earth , and the top of it reached to heaven : and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it .
translation.kha: U la phohsniew ba u ïohi ïa ka lynti mawkyrdon na khyndew sha bneng , bad ki angel kiba ïakiew ïahiar ha ka .
Bad U Trai u byrsaw-lieh Lah phrangsngi , Ngan nym buhrieh na u Abraham ïa kaei kaba ngan sa haw .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do  ;
And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices , which can never take away sins :
translation.kha: Man la u lyngdoh Jiw , u trei ïa la ka kam man ka sngi bad ai kijuh ki jingkñia man ka por ; hynrei kine ki jingkñia kim lah ban kit noh ïa ki pop .

translation.en: And he said , O my Lord , send , I pray thee , by the hand of him whom thou wilt send .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u jubab ,  Em , Kynrad , sngewbha phah noh dano dano .

translation.en: And Abram said to the king of Sodom , I have lift up mine hand unto the  Lord  , the most high God , the possessor of heaven and earth ,
translation.kha: U Abram u ong ,  Nga la smai ha khmat U  Trai  , U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh , u Nongthaw ïa ka bneng bad ïa ka khyndew , ba ngan ym bat ei ei ïa kaba dei ka jong me , wat ïa u  sai juti ruh .

dei Phi , da shisha , ban ïaineh ka ha nongrim kaba skhem bad thikna kaba , bad phim dei ban shah ïa lade ban shah pynkhynñiuh na ka jingkyrmen kaba phi la ïoh myn haba phi la ïohsngew ïa ka gospel . Ka dei na kane ka gospel ba ma nga u Paul nga , kylla la long u shakri — kane ka gospel kaba la ïalap ha uwei pa uwei ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled , and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel , which ye have heard , and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven ; whereof I Paul am made a minister ;

translation.kha: Ym u briew baroh khot ïa nga , ‘ , A u ïohrung shapoh Ka Hima ki bneng , tang kiba leh ïa kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng u kwah ïa ki ban leh .
translation.en: Not every one that saith unto me , Lord , Lord , shall enter into the kingdom of heaven  ; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven .
And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch , and the dust thereof into brimstone , and the land thereof shall become burning pitch .
translation.kha: Ki wah ka Edom kin kylla um bsiang , bad ka khyndew kan kylla kyndok . Ka ri baroh kawei kan ing kum ka bsiang .
Te ingiew lynti! Khrist la phiah ha ki kynhun ! Hato dei u Paul uba la ïap halor ka diengphna namar jong phi ? Hato la pynbaptis ïa phi kum ki synran jong u bakhraw! ?
translation.en: Is Christ divided ? was Paul crucified for you ? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul ?

And the woman said unto him , Behold , thou knowest what Saul hath done , how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits , and the wizards , out of the land : wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life , to cause me to die ?
translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka jubab ,  Da shisha , phi tip aïu u syiem Saul u la leh , kumno u la beh ïa ki nongai ksuid bad ki nongkren byrtong na Israel . Te balei phi riam ïa nga bad ba ngan shah pynïap ?

ïalam ïa ki ar shabar shnong bad lynthem maw ïa ki haduh ba da ïap . Kata ka briew ka dei ïap ba kam shym la kyang ban ïoh jingïarap , wat la ka don hapoh shnong , uta u shynrang pat u dei ban ïap namar u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka , bad phin ïa kane ka jingbymman napdeng jong phi .
translation.en: Then ye shall bring them both out unto the gate of that city , and ye shall stone them with stones that they die  ; the damsel , because she cried not , being in the city  ; and the man , because he hath humbled his neighbour s wife : so thou shalt put away evil from among you .

translation.kha: barhem Ioannis 17 :3 ) Hynrei , ïabeit ruh ki donkam ban ïohsngew ïa :24 khubor babha , khnang ba ma ki ruh kin ïoh lait im “lada
translation.en: ( John 17 :3 ) However , others also need to hear the good news so that they too can be saved .

translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba pyrkhat ba u long uba riewblei ? Lada um synshar ïa thylliej , ka jinglong riewblei u kam myntoi bad u shukor ïa .
translation.en: If any man among you seem to be religious , and bridleth not his tongue , but deceiveth his own heart , this man s religion is vain .
Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king , and stand not in the place of great men :
translation.kha: Haba phi ïeng ha khmat u syiem , wat pyrshang ban shon jur ïa u bad leh mynleh kum uba pawkhmat .

A ka kaba shyrkhei phi ki ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi Phi kiba arsap ! Phi khang ïa jingkhang sha ka ki bneng na khmat ki briew , hynrei ma da lade hi phim rung shapoh , lymne ba phi shapoh ïa pyrshang ban rung !
translation.en: But woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men : for ye neither go in yourselves , neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in .

translation.kha: Shi taïew hadien ki synran ki ïadon la lang biang hapoh ïing , bad u Thomas u la don lem bad . ki Ïa ki jingkhang la khang skhem , hynrei U Jisu u la bad wan u la ïeng hapdeng ki jong bad u la ong , To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad phi .
translation.en: And after eight days again his disciples were within , and Thomas with them : then came Jesus , the doors being shut , and stood in the midst , and said ,  Peace be unto you .
And be not conformed to this world : but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind , that ye may prove what is that good , and acceptable , and perfect , will of God .
translation.kha: To wat pynïasyriem ïa lade bad ki rukom jong kane ka pyrthei , hynrei to ai ba U Blei un pynkylla dur ïa kaba shapoh jong phi da ka jingpynkylla ïa ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi baroh . Te phin lah ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei — kaei kaba bha bad kaba pynsngewbha ïa u bad kaba janai .

translation.en: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither  ; because all the land shall become briers and thorns .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin behmrad hangta da ki ryntieh bad ki khnam . Ho-oid , ka ri baroh kawei kan dap da ki shynraiñ bad ki bniap shiah .

translation.en: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men ; and the weakness of God is stronger than men .
translation.kha: Naba kaei kaba i kum ka jingibieit U Blei ka long kaba kham stad ban ïa ka jingstad briew , bad kaei kaba i kumba ka long ka jingtlot U Blei ka long kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka bor briew .

translation.en: Sanctify the  Lord  of hosts himself  ; and let him be your fear , and let him be your dread .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga long uba khuid , nga long uta uba phi dei ban sheptieng .

U Blei un ai ha ngi ka , spah ka burom bad ka jingdon jingem , ho-oid baroh kaba ngi kwah , hynrei un ym ïa shah ngi ban ïoh lehkmen ïa ka . uwei Pynban pat u nongwei un ïoh lehkmen ïa ka . Ka long ka bymmyntoi , bad ka shu long bym ka dei .
translation.en: A man to whom God hath given riches , wealth , and honour , so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth , yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof , but a stranger eateth it : this is vanity , and it is an evil disease .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses bad u Aaron dem ki khrup ha khyndew bad ki ong , A Blei , me , me long ka thymmei ka jong jingim baroh . Haba uwei na ngi u pop leh , hato men shu bitar lep ïa ka kynhun baroh kawei ?
translation.en: And they fell upon their faces , and said , O God , the God of the spirits of all flesh , shall one man sin , and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation ?
And it shall be unto them for an inheritance : I am their inheritance : and ye shall give them no possession in Israel : I am their possession .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki don ka jinglong lyngdoh kum ka bynta jong ki ïa kaei kaba nga la ai ha Israel ban hiarpateng na kawei ka pateng sha kawei pat . Kin ym don jingdon jingem ha Israel ; nga long tang ma nga uba ki donkam .

translation.en: And then the  Lord s  wrath be kindled against you , and he shut up the heaven , that there be no rain , and that the land yield not her fruit  ; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the  Lord  giveth you .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , U  Trai  un khie bitar ïa phi . Un khang khop ïa u slap , bad ka khyndew jong phi kan tyrkhong eh ba ki jingthung kin ym mih shuh . Te phin sa ïap shen hangta , wat la kata ka khyndew kaba u ai ha phi ka long kaba seisoh .
Mynba u u long u syiem u Nebukhadnessar u syiem Babilonia u la hiarthma ïa ka Judah , bad lai snem pynbor u Jehoïakim ban pyndem ha ka jingsynshar jong u ; nangta u ïeng ïaleh .
translation.en: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up , and Jehoiakim became his servant three years : then he turned and rebelled against him .
