Sumar kynrad un kabu ïa u lyngkhot lyngkhai bad un pynlong ïa u ban ïoh bynta ïa ka Khenanaïah jong Josaïah riewarsap . Hangta ïashoh lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .
translation.en: And shall cut him asunder , and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .

translation.kha: To duwai ha U Blei ba phin ym hap phet ban noh ha ka por tlang lane ha ka sngi Sabbaton !
translation.en: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter , neither on the sabbath day :

translation.kha: U Babel uba pyndonkam wan sha nga ha pynshoi bad ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingïap u Saul , u eitnar Bteng ba u in wallam pyndon khubor babha . Nga la kem ïa u , bad phah pynïap mane u . Kata ka dei ka bainong ba nga la ai ha u na ka bynta kata ka khubor Khesalon jong 3 Mikhal
translation.en: When one told me , saying , Behold , Saul is dead , thinking to have brought good tidings , I took hold of him , and slew him in Ziklag , who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings :
And who , as I , shall call , and shall declare it , and set it in order for me , since I appointed the ancient people ? and the things that are coming , and shall come , let them shew unto them .
translation.kha: Hato don mano mano ba la leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ? Mano ba la ïathuh lypa ïa baroh ka ban sa jia naduh kaba mynnyngkong haduh kaba kut ka por ?
To kynmaw ba kine kiei kiei kin jia shuwa ba ki briew kiba dang mynta im , ki la ïap noh .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , that this generation shall not pass , till all these things be done .

translation.kha: Lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka kyntait ban leit bad mane ïa U Trai Baroh Badonbor kum u syiem , te u slap un ym hap ha ka ri jong . ki
translation.en: And it shall be , that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , even upon them shall be no rain .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Mikaïah u jubab Katba im U Trai , nga kular ban ong kaei u ïathuh ïa nga
translation.en: And Micaiah said , As the  Lord  liveth , what the  Lord  saith unto me , that will I speak .

translation.kha: Ka la don ka kaba jur shaphang jong hapdeng u paidbah . U long briew uba bha , kiba la ong Em , kiwei ki la ong , ïalam ki briew .
translation.en: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him : for some said , He is a good man : others said , Nay  ; but he deceiveth the people .
Again , he sent other servants more than the first : and they did unto them likewise .
translation.kha: Sa shisien uta u briew u la phah biang ïa kiwei pat ki mraw , kham bun ïa kaba nyngkong , bad ki nongshimwai ki la leh ïa ki ha kajuh ka rukom .
Me tip ba ngam shym leh pop , bad ba ym don uwei uba ruh lah ban pyllait im ïa nga na me .
translation.en: Thou knowest that I am not wicked  ; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand .
When Joab and all the host that was with him were come , they told Joab , saying , Abner the son of Ner came to the king , and he hath sent him away , and he is gone in peace .
translation.kha: Haba u Joab bad ki rangbah jong u ki la poi , la ïathuh ha u ba u Abner u la wan sha u syiem Dabid , bad ba u Dabid u la phah noh ïa u lem bad ka jingkular jingshngain .

translation.en: And when they bring you unto the synagogues , and unto magistrates , and powers , take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer , or what ye shall say :
translation.kha: Haba ki wallam ïa phi ban shah tian bishar ha ki synagog lane ha khmat ki lyngskor lane ki nongsynshar , wat sngewkhuslai shaphang kumno phin ïasaid da ïa lade lane ïa kaei phin kren .
Naba uno uno uba ai da khublei ka jingsuk , u kylla long uba ïatreilang ha ki kam sniew ba u leh .
translation.en: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds .

translation.kha: bad u Darius u nong Mid uba , ha kata ka por u don hynriewphew ar snem ka rta u , la knieh ïa ka bor syiem .
translation.en: And Darius the Median took the kingdom , being about threescore and two years old .

translation.kha: Ha ka ribon U kba , Sephanaïah dohkha uba heh u la nguid ïa u Jonah , bad u la don hapoh u dohkha lai sngi lai miet .
translation.en: Now the  Lord  had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah . And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights .

translation.kha: kitkhlieh Kine kin ïa Synduk ka ka Jutang , ïa ka miej , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak , ïa ki duwan , ïa ki khiew ki pliang ba ki lyngdoh ki pyndonkam ha ka Jaka Kyntang , bad ïa ka pyrda ha ka jingkhang sha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang . Tam Kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad kine tiar ki tar .
translation.en: As for the sons of Merari , thou shalt number them after their families , by the house of their fathers  ;
Then Philip opened his mouth , and began at the same scripture , and preached unto him Jesus .
translation.kha: Te u Philip u la sdang ban kren ; da kaba sdang na kane ka bynta jong ka Jingthoh Bakhuid , u la ïathuh ïa u ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu .

A to khmied sha motor sahit lama ! Mano jinghukum thaw ïa ki khlur ba phi ïohi ? Uta uba ïalam ïa ki shabar kum ka kynhun shipai , u kabu’ katno iakata don habar u khot ïa uwei uwei da ka kyrteng ! Goshen bor jong u ka khraw katta kiei — Ym don uwei na ki u ban jah noh .
translation.en: Lift up your eyes on high , and behold who hath created these things , that bringeth out their host by number : he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might , for that he is strong in power  ; not one faileth .

Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Ye have not hearkened unto me , in proclaiming liberty , every one to his brother , and every man to his neighbour : behold , I proclaim a liberty for you , saith the  Lord  , to the sword , to the pestilence , and to the famine  ; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong ba phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga : phim shym la ai ka jinglaitluid ïa la ki para Israel . Kumta te , ngan ai ha phi ïa ka jinglaitluid : ka jinglaitluid ban ïap da ka thma , ka jingpang , bad ka jingïapthngan . Ngan pynlong ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ban sngewshyrkhei ïa kaei kaba nga leh ïa phi .

translation.en: Wherefore be ye not unwise , but understanding what the will of the Lord is .
translation.kha: Wat long kiba bieit , hynrei , pyrshang ban wad ïa kaei kaba U Trai u kwah ïa phi ban leh .

translation.en: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman , which have committed that wicked thing , unto thy gates , even that man or that woman , and shalt stone them with stones , till they die .
translation.kha: Lada ka long kaba shisha ba kum kata ka kam bymman ka la jia ha Israel , ïalam ïa kita ki briew shabar ka khyrdop shnong bad lynthem maw ïa ki haduh ba kin da ïap .

translation.en: So the people went forth , and brought them , and made themselves booths , every one upon the roof of his house , and in their courts , and in the courts of the house of God , and in the street of the water gate , and in the street of the gate of Ephraim .
translation.kha: Kumta ki briew ki la ïoh ïa ki tnat bad shna ïa ki ïingtrep halor ki tnum ïing ba madan jong ki ïing jong ki , ha la ki jaka , ha ka phyllaw ka Templ , bad ha ki jaka paidbah basawdong hajan ka Khyrdop Um bad hajan ka Khyrdop Ephraim .

translation.en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler , and from the noisome pestilence .
translation.kha: Un ri sumar ïa me na ki jingma barieh baroh bad na ki jingpang bashyrkhei baroh .
wan phai da kaba ong ba ki la ka ïa ki angel kiba la ha ki ba u .
translation.en: And when they found not his body , they came , saying , that they had also seen a vision of angels , which said that he was alive .

translation.kha: phi leh kumta , ngan don ka daw ban sngewsarong ïa phi ha ka Sngi jong U , namar kan pyn-i ba baroh ka bad ka jingtrei jong nga kam shym long kaba lehnoh-ei .
translation.en: Holding forth the word of life ; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ , that I have not run in vain , neither laboured in vain .

Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar , and will set it  ; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one , and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent :
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan shim ïa ka kliar jong u dieng Kedar bajrong bad kdiah ïa i shylluit balung ; ngan thung ïa i halor u lum bakynjang ,
Kane la pynlong ïa U Trai ban bitar , kumta u phah u sha u Amasaïah . U nongïathuhlypa u la dawa , Balei ba phi mane ïa ki blei nongwei ki lah ban pyllait im ïa ki jong ki ka bor me ?
translation.en: Wherefore the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Amaziah , and he sent unto him a prophet , which said unto him , Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people , which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand ?

And I will purge out from among you the rebels , and them that transgress against me : I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn , and they shall not enter into the land of Israel : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan shim noh napdeng jong phi ïa kito kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah bad kiba dap da ka pop . Ngan shim noh ïa ki na ki ri ha kaba ki shong ki sah mynta , hynrei ngan ym shah ïa ki ban wan phai pat sha ka ri Israel . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

Ki paid Judah ki la leit ryngkat pynshlei ki paid Simeon , bad Shebat la jop ïa pynmyntoi Kanaan kiba shong ha ka ronsing Sephath . Ki la ïohlum jingsawa jingtim halor Humtah nongbah , ki la pynjot thiaw ïa ka , bad ki la Sarah ïaisah ïa ka , ka Hormah Jehukal
translation.en: And Judah went with Simeon his brother , and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath , and utterly destroyed it . And the name of the city was called Hormah .
And all went to be taxed , every one into his own city .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh , te , u la leit ban ai kyrteng ïa lade , uwei uwei sha la ka jong hi ka shnong .

translation.en: Either how canst thou say to thy brother , Brother , let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye , when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye ? Thou hypocrite , cast out first the beam out of thine own eye , and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother s eye .
translation.kha: Kumno phi lah ban ong ha u para jong phi , ‘ Ko para , sngewbha shah ïa nga ban sei ïa u thiat na ka khmat jong phi ,’ pynban phim lah ban ïohi ïa ka lyngkhot dieng ha la ka jong ka khmat ? Phi kiba arsap ! Nyngkong to shim noh ïa ka lyngkhot dieng na ka khmat jong phi , bad nangta phin lah ban ïohi shai ban sei ïa u thiat na ka khmat jong u para jong phi .
uwei kherub don saw tylli ki durkhmat . Ka khmat kaba nyngkong ka dei jong u masi kyrtong , kaba ar ka jong u briew , kaba lai ka jong u sing , kaba jong pukni .
translation.en: And every one had four faces : the first face was the face of a cherub , and the second face was the face of a man , and the third the face of a lion , and the fourth the face of an eagle .
And I will strengthen them in the  Lord   ; and they shall walk up and down in his name , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ki briew jong nga ; kin ïamane bad kohnguh ïa nga .  U  Trai  u la kren .

Ka jingim ki kynja ba-im baroh ka don ha ka snam , bad namar kata ba U u la hukum ba dei ban ïa baroh ka snam ha duwan ban weng noh ïa ki pop ki briew . Ka snam , kaba ka jingim , ka weng noh ïa ki pop .
translation.en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood : and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls : for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul .

translation.kha: Israel ki la ai ha jingïashoh Jakob ïa kita pynshisha blei nongwei baroh Ainias ker don , bad ruh ïa pynjai sohshkor ba ki deng . U Jakob jingshonshab Shibboleth khulom ki ha trai hiarthma Pungsum Sning Bnai Shekhem .
translation.en: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand , and all their earrings which were in their ears  ; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem .

translation.kha: Katno u siew ia phi ?
translation.en: How much did he pay you ?

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka shahjop u shakri uba la ïohpdiang shahjingit hajar tylli ki sepngi u la ïohnong sa Langbrot hajar kilomitar
translation.en: And likewise he that had received two , he also gained other two .
Keep yourselves in the love of God , looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life .
translation.kha: bad to ri ïa lade ha ka jingieit U Blei , da kaba ap khmih ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ha ka jingisynei jong u ban ai ha phi ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh ; but nourisheth and cherisheth it , even as the Lord the church :
translation.kha: ( Ym ju don uno uno uba isih ïa la ka jong ka met . Pynban , u bsa bad sumar ïa ka , kumba U Khrist ruh u leh ïa ka balang ;

translation.en: Which said unto God , Depart from us : and what can the Almighty do for them ?
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki briew kiba la kyntait ïa U Blei bad kiba ngeit ba um lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki .

translation.en: And Samuel took a sucking lamb , and offered it for a burnt offering wholly unto the  Lord  : and Samuel cried unto the  Lord  for Israel  ; and the  Lord  heard him .
translation.kha: U Samuel u pynïap uwei u khunlangbrot bad u thang tylli ïa u kum ka jingkñia ainguh ha U  Trai . Nangta u duwai ha U  Trai  ban ïarap ïa ki Israel , bad U  Trai  u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u .

translation.en: Who concerning the truth have erred , saying that the resurrection is past already ; and overthrow the faith of some .
translation.kha: Ki la iehnoh ïa ka lynti ka jingshisha bad pynkylla khongpong ïa ka jingngeit jong ki katto katne ki bangeit da kaba ong ba ka jingpynmihpat ïa ngi ka la dep jia .
Kumta u leit kem laispah tylli ki myrsiang . teh syrdoh ïa ki tdong jong ki , shi jur shi jur , bad u ïa ki dongmusa ha kita ki syrdoh .
translation.en: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes , and took firebrands , and turned tail to tail , and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails .
And he brought me to the north gate , and measured it according to these measures  ;
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop bashatei . U la thew ïa ka , bad ka la long katjuh ka jingheh kum kiwei pat .

translation.en: We have heard the fame thereof : our hands wax feeble : anguish hath taken hold of us , and pain , as of a woman in travail .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ,  ong ki briew ka Jerusalem ,  bad ki kti jong ngi ki noh kyrwep , la kem ïa ngi da ka jinglyng-a bad ka jingpang kum ka kynthei kaba suh kha .
Te kaei kaba Jeremaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la ong , ka urlong shisha : Ki la shim ïa ki laiphew tylli ki sbai , ka dor ki paid Israel ki la mynjur siew na ka bynta jong u ,
translation.en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet , saying , And they took the thirty pieces of silver , the price of him that was valued , whom they of the children of Israel did value  ;

And it was told the Gazites , saying , Samson is come hither . And they compassed him in , and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city , and were quiet all the night , saying , In the morning , when it is day , we shall kill him .
translation.kha: Ki nong Gasa ki shem ba u Samson u don hangta , kumta ki kerkut ïa kata ka jaka bad ki ap ïa u baroh shi miet ha khyrdop shnong . Ki ap jar jar baroh shi miet , da kaba pyrkhat ha lade ,  Ngin ap haduh ban da kynjat shai , ban nangta ngin sa pynïap ïa u .

Hamar nga jingthiah yn ñiad da Ebedmelekh jingkmen namar ka Jerusalem bad Iskariot briew jong Beneberak . jingnang yn ym don shuh ka jingïam Ithnan jingsiangthiah ym don Jehubbah ki ban khot kyrpad ban ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem , and joy in my people : and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her , nor the voice of crying .
For if the inheritance be of the law , it is no more of promise : but God gave it to Abraham by promise .
translation.kha: Naba lada ka jingai U Blei ka shong ha ka Hukum , te ka jingaiei kam shong shuh ha ka jingkular jong u . Pynban ka long namar ka jingkular jong u ba U Blei u la ai ïa kata ka jingai sngewbha ha u Abraham .

Te la jubab Moses , ngi leh pyrshah ïa U Trai . Hynrei mynta ngin leit tur , kumba U Trai U Blei jong ngi hukum ïa ngi .’ Nangta uwei pa uwei na phi u khreh ban ïaleh thma , u da tharai ba long kaba jem ban leit hiarthma ïa kata ka ri .
translation.en: Then ye answered and said unto me , We have sinned against the  Lord  , we will go up and fight , according to all that the  Lord  our God commanded us . And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war , ye were ready to go up into the hill .
And all the people came up after him , and the people piped with pipes , and rejoiced with great joy , so that the earth rent with the sound of them .
translation.kha: Nangta ki baroh ki la ïabud ïa u , da ka jingrisa jam bad put ïa ki sharati , da kaba pynmih ka jingsawa kaba jur kat ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka khyndew .

translation.en: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him , they said , The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha . And they came to meet him , and bowed themselves to the ground before him .
translation.kha: Ki sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa na Jerikho ki la ïohi ïa u bad ki ong ,  Ka bor u Elijah ka don ha u Elisha !  Ki la leit ban ïashem ïa u , ki la nguh ngon ha khmat jong u ,

translation.en: And they came , every one whose heart stirred him up , and every one whom his spirit made willing , and they brought the  Lord s  offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation , and for all his service , and for the holy garments .
translation.kha: bad baroh kiba mon ban leh kumta , ki wanrah ïa ka jingainguh sha U  Trai  ïa kaba yn pyndonkam ha kaba shna ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ki wallam kat ïa kaba donkam na ka bynta ka jingmane , bad na ka bynta ban thain ïa ki jaiñphong lyngdoh .

U la leh pop pyrshah ïa ruma Trai sngewmong hynrei um da sniew eh kat jingtbit kpa jong u ïasyriem lane kyntait ka Jesebel , ka kmie jong u pynjuh u la pynkhyllem ïa ka :23 kaba u kpa jong u , u la Jingrakhe na ka bynta ban em ïa u Baal .
translation.en: And he wrought evil in the sight of the  Lord   ; but not like his father , and like his mother : for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made .

translation.kha: Saul u ïathuh ha u Jonathan jong u bad ha ki synshar jong u ba u thmu ban pynïap ïa u Dabid . Hynrei u Jonathan u sngew jan eh ïa u Dabid ,
translation.en: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son , and to all his servants , that they should kill David .
Son of man , write thee the name of the day , even of this same day : the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to thoh ïa ka tarik mynta ka sngi , namar kane ka long ka sngi kaba u syiem ka Babilonia u sdang ïa ka jingkerkut ïa ka Jerusalem .
U Jakob u la khie dang step phyrngab u shim ïa uta u maw ïa uba u la syngkhlieh , bad u ïa u ban sah jingkynmaw . Nangta u theh ïa ka umphniang Olib halor jong ban pynkyntang ïa u Blei .
translation.en: And Jacob rose up early in the morning , and took the stone that he had put for his pillows , and set it up for a pillar , and poured oil upon the top of it .
And they sent and called him . So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba na ka jait bashaphang shatei ki phah khot ïa u ; bad baroh ki ïaleit lang sha u Rehoboam , bad ki ong ha u ,

translation.en: God is not a man , that he should lie  ; neither the son of man , that he should repent : hath he said , and shall he not do it ? or hath he spoken , and shall he not make it good ?
translation.kha: U Blei um long kum ki briew , kiba kren lamler ; Um long kum u briew uba kylla la ka jingmut . Kat kaba u kular , u pyndep ; U kren , bad la pyndep ïa kata .
Ho-oid , phi dei ban phai sha U Blei da ka jingsngewrit bad iehnoh kaba sniew kaba ha ka ïing jong .
translation.en: If thou return to the Almighty , thou shalt be built up , thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles .
As I live , saith the  Lord  , though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand , yet would I pluck thee thence  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u syiem Jehoïakhin , u khun jong u Jehoïakim u syiem ka Judah ,  Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei Uba im . Wat la me long kum ka sati muhor ha ka kti kamon jong nga , ngan weng noh ïa me ,

translation.en: And Jesus answering saith unto them ,  Have faith in God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  To don ka jingngeit ha U Blei .

translation.en: Gather the people , sanctify the congregation , assemble the elders , gather the children , and those that suck the breasts : let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber , and the bride out of her closet .
translation.kha: To ïalumlang ïa ki paidbah ; to pynkhreh ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingïalang bakyntang ; to wallam ki briew ba la tymmen ; to ïalumlang ïa ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ruh . Wat kito kiba dang shu dep shongkurim ki dei ban mihnoh na la ka kamra bad ban wan .
Kumta U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki baroh bad u la ong , jingpli Heth ba ki nongsynshar jong ki bymngeit jingieid ki donbor halor jong ki , bad ki nongïalam jingïaishah don ka Jingmyntoi ba-pura .
translation.en: But Jesus called them unto him , and said ,  Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them , and they that are great exercise authority upon them .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki hapdeng jong ka Jordan haduh ban da pyndep lut ïa kaei kaei U u la hukum u Joshua ban ong ban leh . dei kata kaba u Moses u hukum . U paidbah u la pynkloi shiliang wah .
translation.en: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan , until every thing was finished that the  Lord  commanded Joshua to speak unto the people , according to all that Moses commanded Joshua : and the people hasted and passed over .
Thou hast loved righteousness , and hated iniquity  ; therefore God , even thy God , hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows .
translation.kha: Me ieit ïa kaei kaba dei bad me isih ïa ka bymdei . Namarkata U Blei , U Blei jong me , u la jied ïa me bad u la ai ha me ïa ka jingkmen ka jingpyndonburom kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaba u ai ïa ki paralok jong me .
sngi kaba hynñiew ki la phyrngab bad ki ïaid tawiar hynñiew sien ïa ka nongbah kajuh ka rukom dei tang ha ka sngi ba ki tawiar ïa ka hynñiew sien .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that they rose early about the dawning of the day , and compassed the city after the same manner seven times : only on that day they compassed the city seven times .

translation.kha: U Ishbosheth u la sheptieng eh ïa u Abner kat haduh ba um nang ang wat tang shikyntien ruh .
translation.en: And he could not answer Abner a word again , because he feared him .

translation.kha: U phah Girsi u phria kum u mawria ; ym don junom pynjahburom ban shah jingtynjuh ka pynkmen ba u phah !

Associate yourselves , O ye people , and ye shall be broken in pieces  ; and give ear , all ye of far countries : gird yourselves , and ye shall be broken in pieces  ; gird yourselves , and ye shall be broken in pieces .
translation.kha: To ïalumlang ha ka jingsheptieng , phi ki jaitbynriew ! To shahshkor , phi ki bynta ba sha jngai jong ka pyrthei . Pynkhreh ban ïaleh , hynrei to sheptieng ! Ho-oid to pynkhreh , hynrei to sheptieng !
Ki Midian ki long riam jinglonghok khlaiñ ban ïa ki pyniphuh Khenaanah bad ki paid Israel ki rieh ïa lade Thung ngiah ha Horesh krem bad ha kiwei pat ki jaka bashngain kynïan ki lumrit .
translation.en: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel : and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains , and caves , and strong holds .
And David said to Abishai , Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom : take thou thy lord s servants , and pursue after him , lest he get him fenced cities , and escape us .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u ong ha u Abishai ,  U Sheba un kham pynjynjar ïa ngi ban ïa u Absalom . Shim ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad leit thwet ïa u , lym kumta u lah ban leit shong shnong ha ki shnong ba la ker kynroh , bad lait phet na ngi .

translation.en: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water , but hired Balaam against them , that he should curse them : howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing .
translation.kha: Kane ka long namar ki Amon bad ki Moab kim shym la ai jingbam bad um ïa ki Israel ha ka lynti ba ki mih na Ijipt . Pynban , ki la siew pisa sha u Balaam ban tim ïa ki Israel , hynrei U Blei jong ngi u la pynkylla long ïa ka jingtim sha ka jingkyrkhu .

Don ruh u Shimei , u khun u , ka Bahurim kaba ha Benjamin U la tim tyngeh ïa nga sngi kaba nga leit sha Mahanaim , hynrei haba u la ïakynduh ïa nga ha wah Jordan , nga ai u ka bakyntang ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ba ngan ym shah ban pynïap u .
translation.en: And , behold , thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera , a Benjamite of Bahurim , which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim : but he came down to meet me at Jordan , and I sware to him by the  Lord  , saying , I will not put thee to death with the sword .
Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering : they shall also prepare a young bullock , and a ram out of the flock , without blemish .
translation.kha: Man ka sngi na ka bynta hynñiew sngi men ai u  langsohmoh , u masi kyrtong , bad u langbrot kum ki jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . Baroh ki dei ban long khlem kino kino ki jingduna .
Kumta Daniel u u la leit sha u nongap phira uba u Ashpenas la u buh ban khmih ïa u bad ïa ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u .
translation.en: Then said Daniel to Melzar , whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah ,

translation.kha: Naba tang mar ïa ïohsngew Bikri ka jingkhublei jong pha , i khunlung hapoh jong nga i la kynthih da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: For , lo , as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears , the babe leaped in my womb for joy .
And now go to  ; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard : I will take away the hedge thereof , and it shall be eaten up  ; and break down the wall thereof , and it shall be trodden down :
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba ngan leh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ jong nga : Ngan weng noh ïa ka jingker baroh sawdong jong ka , ngan pynpra ïa ka kynroh kaba da ïa ka , ngan shah ïa ki mradkhlaw ban bam ïa ka bad ïuhroit ïa ka .

translation.en: But Peter said unto him , Although all shall be offended , yet will not I .
translation.kha: U Petros u la jubab ,  Ngan ym iehnoh ïa me , wat la baroh kiwei pat kin leh kumta !

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Azariah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Ussaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: And Jephthah judged Israel six years . Then died Jephthah the Gileadite , and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead .
translation.kha: U Jephthah u ïalam ïa ki Israel hynriew snem . Hadien kata u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha shnong jong u kaba ha Gilead .

translation.en: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her , and commended her before Pharaoh : and the woman was taken into Pharaoh s house .
translation.kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah synshar ki la ïohi ïa ka bad ki la ïathuh ha u syiem haduh katno ka la long kaba bhabriew ; kumta te ki la ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïing u syiem .
Uei uba na ka bynta jong nga ïa ki bymman ? Uei uba don ha ka liang jong pyrshah ïa ki nongleh sniew ?
translation.en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers ? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity ?

translation.kha: Wat pynphriang ïa ki khubor lamler , bad wat ïarap ïa u nongleh da kaba sakhi lamler .
translation.en: Thou shalt not raise a false report : put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness .

translation.kha: Wat buh jingshaniah shuh ki ha briew ki bym lah ban im junom . Ki dondor haduh katno ?
translation.en: Cease ye from man , whose breath is in his nostrils : for wherein is he to be accounted of ?
And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples , and said , ( the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty , )
translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat sngi , ka la don ka jingïalang jong ki riewngeit , kumba shispah arphew ngut baroh , bad u Petros u la ïeng ban kren .

Lada u para Israel , shynrang lane sot , Siddim Sered mraw ïa lade ha phi , phi dei jingklim pyllait ïa ki hadien ba ki la shakri ïa phi hynriew jingkieng . Ha Jairos sor kaba hynñiew phi dei ban pyllait ïa ki .
translation.en: And if thy brother , an Hebrew man , or an Hebrew woman , be sold unto thee , and serve thee six years  ; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee .

So the king of the north shall come , and cast up a mount , and take the most fenced cities : and the arms of the south shall not withstand , neither his chosen people , neither shall there be any strength to withstand .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem ka Syria un kerkut ïa ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh bad kurup ïa ka . Ki shipai jong ka Ijipt kin ym ïaleh shuh ; wat kiba tbit tam na ki kin ym don ka jingkhlaiñ kaba biang .

translation.en: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches , which hath devoured her fruit , so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule . This is a lamentation , and shall be for a lamentation .
translation.kha: Ka met jong u dieng sohwaiñ ka la kem ding ; ka ding ka la bam duh ïa ki tnat bad ïa u soh jong u . Ki tnat kin ym long shuh da lei lei kiba khlaiñ , kin ym long shuh da lei lei ki diengsynshar ba kynja syiem . Kane ka dei ka jingrwai jong ka jingsngewsih ; la ju rwai bad ïai rwai ïa ka .

translation.en: And Manoah said unto the angel of the  Lord  , What is thy name , that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour ?
translation.kha: U Manoah u jubab ,  Ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka kyrteng jong phi , khnang ba ngin lah ban ai burom ïa phi ynda ki ktien jong phi ki la urlong .

translation.en: And they stood up in their place , and read in the book of the law of the  Lord  their God one fourth part of the day  ; and another fourth part they confessed , and worshipped the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: Kumba lai kynta , ïa ka Hukum jong U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , la pule ha ki , bad ha ki lai kynta kiba bud , ki phla ïa la ki pop bad mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
Baroh spah ka kaba me la duh , kam long ei ei ban ïapyrshang bad kaei kaba U Blei un sa ai pat ha me .
translation.en: Though thy beginning was small , yet thy latter end should greatly increase .
What if God , willing to shew his wrath , and to make his power known , endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction :
translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kumjuh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh . U la kwah ban pynpaw ïa ka jingbitar jong u bad ban pynpaw ïa ka bor jong u . Hynrei u la long uba ïaishah haduh katta katta ïa kito kiba long ka daw jong ka jingbitar jong u , kiba la don ha ka lynti sha ka jingshah pynjot .
ki kynthei bad khynnah jong , nongwei kiba shong bad phi , bad kito kiba long ki nongthoh dieng bad ki nongtong ïa phi ,
translation.en: Your little ones , your wives , and thy stranger that is in thy camp , from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water :
And likewise a Levite , when he was at the place , came and looked on him , and passed by on the other side .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom u Lebi ruh u la wan ïaid , u la ïaid nalor bad u la khmih ïa uta u briew , bad nangta u la ïaid lait , na kawei ka liang .
Mynta nierbah ha kiba khlem shongkurim bad ha ki riewkynthei nga ñiuhlieh ba ka kan kham bha ïa 65 ban shong marwei kum ma nga .
translation.en: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows , It is good for them if they abide even as I .
And shall put thereon the covering of badgers  skins , and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue , and shall put in the staves thereof .
translation.kha: Wan ïalam ïa kiba na ka jait Lebi bad thung ïa ki kum ki shakri ïa u Aaron u lyngdoh .

U kamar shim u shi lyngkhot ka nar bad u pynwandur ka ïa ha ka ding . Ka ksang ti bakhlaiñ jong u ka ïa pynkhih u tyrnem ban tied pynwandur ïa ka nar . Katba u dang trei , u thngan , u sliang bad u la thait .
translation.en: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals , and fashioneth it with hammers , and worketh it with the strength of his arms : yea , he is hungry , and his strength faileth : he drinketh no water , and is faint .

translation.kha: Wat ujor shuh shaphang ki jingmynsaw jong phi ; ym don kano :26 ka jingpynkoit rabbit phi . Nga la pynshitom ïa phi kumne namar ki pop jong phi ki long kiba bun bad ka ïasah jong phi ka long kaba khraw Shu
translation.en: Why criest thou for thine affliction ? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity : because thy sins were increased , I have done these things unto thee .

translation.kha: Bad kumta u , ki shynrang jong u lai , bad uta u samla , ki la ïap ; baroh ki briew u Saul ki ïap kajuh ka sngi .
translation.en: So Saul died , and his three sons , and his armourbearer , and all his men , that same day together .

translation.kha: Lada phi leh ïa kaei ka brai Ïashong yn pynshitom sat ïa phi ; phin ïap lada phim ailad ban pynbeit ïa phi .
translation.en: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way : and he that hateth reproof shall die .
For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek : for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ïa baroh , namar ym don ka jingïapher hapdeng ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ; U Blei u long ujuh U Trai ïa baroh bad u kyrkhu kyrhai ïa baroh kiba khot kyrpad ïa u .

translation.en: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre , and break down her towers : I will also scrape her dust from her , and make her like the top of a rock .
translation.kha: Kin pynjot ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah jong pha bad kin pynpra ïa ki kut jong pha . Nangta ngan sar lut khoit ïa ki pui pui bad ngan ieh sa tang ïa u mawsiang .

Haba nga la pyrkhat bha ïa ka , nga sngewthuh ba U Blei jingheh pat shym la kren Hathakh u Shemaïah , hynrei ba Tubal Tobiah bad u Sanballat ki ngi pynbam pisa ïa u ban ai ïa nga ïa kane ka jingmaham .
translation.en: And , lo , I perceived that God had not sent him  ; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me : for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him .
Before I was afflicted I went astray : but now have I kept thy word .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba men pynshitom ïa nga , nga la ju ïaid sakma ; hynrei mynta nga kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong me .

translation.en: I am afraid of you , lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain .
translation.kha: Nga sngewkhuslai shaphang jong phi ! Hato ka lah ban long ba baroh ka jingtrei jong nga na ka bynta jong phi ka la shu long lehnoh-ei ?

translation.en: But they rebelled , and vexed his holy Spirit : therefore he was turned to be their enemy , and he fought against them .
translation.kha: hynrei ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad ki la pynsngewsih ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid jong u . Namar kata U  Trai  u la kylla long u nongshun jong ki bad u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: And the people spake against God , and against Moses , Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness ? for there is no bread , neither is there any water  ; and our soul loatheth this light bread .
translation.kha: Ki la khñium ,  Balei phi wan ïalam ïa ngi na Ijipt ban ïap ha kane ka ri shyiap ha kaba ym don bam lane ka um ? Ngim sngewlah shuh ban bam kum kane ka jingbam !
Hangno mynta ka don ka nongbah kata kaba long krem ki sing , ka jaka ha kaba la bsa ïa ki sing , ha kaba u sing bad sing kin leit bad ki khun jong ki kin ha ka jingshngain ?
translation.en: Where is the dwelling of the lions , and the feedingplace of the young lions , where the lion , even the old lion , walked , and the lion s whelp , and none made them afraid ?
Nor yet that he should offer himself often , as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others  ;
translation.kha: U rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw u leit rung shapoh ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam man ka snem ryngkat bad ka snam ki mrad . Hynrei U Khrist um shym la rung shapoh ban kñia ainguh ïa lade bunsien .

translation.en: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day , saith the Lord  God  : there shall be many dead bodies in every place  ; they shall cast them forth with silence .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ki jingrwai ha ka ïingsyiem kin kylla long ki jinglynñiar ka jingïambriew . Ki metïap kin don kylleng sawdong . Kin sa shah bret noh ha ka jingjar jar .

translation.en: ( Deuteronomy 32 :4  ; Job 12 :13  ; Isaiah 40 :26  ; 1 John 4 :8 ) The Bible tells us that he is also merciful , kind , forgiving , generous , and patient .
translation.kha: ( Deuteronomi 32 :4 ; Job 12 :13 ; Isaiah 40 :26 ; 1 Ioannis 4 :8 ) Ka Baibl ka ïathuh ruh ïa ngi , ba U Blei u long uba isynei , uba sbun , uba map ei , uba kylluid mynsiem , bad uba ïaishah slem .
Kumta Jisu U u la kylli ïa u , Kaei ka kyrteng jong me ? Uta u briew u la jubab , Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long U ‘ Paidbah’ — ngi ïadon shibun !
translation.en: And he asked him ,  What is thy name ?  And he answered , saying , My name is Legion : for we are many .

If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment , between blood and blood , between plea and plea , and between stroke and stroke , being matters of controversy within thy gates : then shalt thou arise , and get thee up into the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose  ;
translation.kha: Lada don ki kam kiba kham eh ïa ki nongbishar shnong ban rai , kum ki mokotduma ïaknieh khyndew , lane kiba dei shaphang kaba ïashoh ïadat , lane kito kiba hap ban pynïapher hapdeng ka jingpynïap briew bad kawei pat ka jait jingpynïap briew , leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei ïa kaba la jied da U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ,
Ha ki ar tylli Sdang phyllaw jong ka Templ , u tei phaloh ki duwan Maki ka bynta ka jingïohthiah Kana ki khlur .
translation.en: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Trai U Blei , me la shah ïa nga ban long syiem hadien i pa jong nga , wat la nga dang khynnah bad ngam kumno ban synshar .
translation.en: And now , O  Lord  my God , thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father : and I am but a little child : I know not how to go out or come in .
And Moses did as the  Lord  commanded him : and he took Joshua , and set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation :
translation.kha: U Moses u la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u . U la pynïeng ïa u Joshua ha khmat u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad uta u paidlang baroh .

Nangta u blem u kylli , Tharai ïa uno uno la jingkynnoh namar ba u Adriel ktah ïa ka boi Simri Te lada u ktah angnud lymda kano sam kine ki jingbam hyndai pyningkhong kata kan pynlong ïa ki ruh ba la pyntngit ? Ki lyngdoh Nongïathuhlypa jubab , Ho-oid duriaw-rit
translation.en: Then said Haggai , If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these , shall it be unclean ? And the priests answered and said , It shall be unclean .

translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la wan sha ka shnong Kapernam , bad ha ka sngi Sabbaton kaba bud , U Jisu la u leit sha ka synagog bad u la sdang hikai ban .
translation.en: And they went into Capernaum  ; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue , and taught .
Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion , and the  Lord  will discover their secret parts .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ki — Ngan khi ïa ki khlieh jong ki bad ngan ieh lyndum ïa ki .

translation.en: But I say unto you , That whosoever shall put away his wife , saving for the cause of fornication , causeth her to commit adultery : and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : lada uno uno u briew u pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga , na ka bynta kano kano ka daw lait noh na ka jingbymïaineh jong ka , te u long uba la shah rem ha kaba pynlong ïa ka ban klim lada ka shongkurim biang ; bad u briew uba shongkurim ïa ka , u ruh u klim .
sing lane uno uno u mrad bashyrkhei uba ïaid ïa kita ki lynti .
translation.en: The lion s whelps have not trodden it , nor the fierce lion passed by it .
And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock s blood , and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation :
translation.kha: Nangta u Rangbah Lyngdoh un shim khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi bad rah ïa ka shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ .

Kane dei ka ka khubor ïa ka Tyros . To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki maji ha ki duriaw-bah ! Ïa ka kadlieng ha ka jong shnong phi , ka Tyros la , pynjot ; ki ïing bad kadlieng ka jong ka ki don ha ka . jingjot Kumba ki liengbah jong phi ki wan phai na Sypros , phi tip ïa ka khubor .
translation.en: The burden of Tyre . Howl , ye ships of Tarshish  ; for it is laid waste , so that there is no house , no entering in : from the land of Kittim it is revealed to them .

translation.kha: Nangta ha ka por khat-ar baje bad ruh ka ha por lai baje u la leh kumjuh .
translation.en: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour , and did likewise .
And again , The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise , that they are vain .
translation.kha: bad kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Trai u tip ba ki jingpyrkhat jong kiba stad ki long ki bymdondor ei ei .
U Trai sngi! la kyrkhu ïa jingpynwandur Sarah kumba u la Alos Jingpynïap bad ka la punkhun bad kha siewdor shynrang ïa bteng Abraham haba u la tymmen .
translation.en: And the  Lord  visited Sarah as he had said , and the  Lord  did unto Sarah as he had spoken .

And Jonadab , the son of Shimeah David s brother , answered and said , Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king s sons  ; for Amnon only is dead : for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jonadab , u khun jong u Shammah , u hynmen jong u Dabid , u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , kim shym la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh . Tang u Amnon uba la ïap . Phi lah ban ong da kaba peit ïa u Absalom ba u la kut jingmut skhem ban leh ïa kane naduh ka por ba u Amnon u la batbor ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u .

Me u khun jong u Ksuid ! Me long u nongshun ïa kaei thyrnia baroh kaba bha . Me long uba dap da kiba bun jait ki buit bymman , bad jingkhapnap ju ïai pyrshang ban pynphai ïa ki jingshisha jong U Trai sha ki jinglamler bymdei
translation.en: And said , O full of all subtilty and all mischief , thou child of the devil , thou enemy of all righteousness , wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord ?

And it shall come to pass , when the  Lord  thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it , that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim , and the curse upon mount Ebal .
translation.kha: Ynda U  Trai  u wan ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti , phin pynbna ïa ka jingkyrkhu nalor u lum Gerisim bad ïa kata ka jingtim nalor u lum Ebal .

Bad lada khmat me ka pynlong me ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong khlaw noh ïa ka Ka kham ïa me ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei tang da kawei ka khmat , ban ïa don baroh ar tylli ki khmat bad shah sha dujok .
translation.en: And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out : it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye , than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei ki pyrkhat , la ong ha ki , Kano kano ka ri kaba phiah lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei kan ym neh slem . Bad kano kano ka shnong lane longïing kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan khyllem ha ka jingpra .
translation.en: And Jesus knew their thoughts , and said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand :
Let thy mercies come also unto me , O  Lord  , even thy salvation , according to thy word .
translation.kha: Pyni ïa nga haduh katno me ieit ïa nga , A  Trai  , bad pynim ïa nga kat kum ka kular jong me .

translation.en: I will say unto God , Do not condemn me  ; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me .
translation.kha: Wat pynrem ïa nga , A Blei , Ïathuh ïa nga ! Kaei ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa nga ?

translation.en: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets , rising early and sending them , saying , Oh , do not this abominable thing that I hate .
translation.kha: Nga ïai phah sha phi ïa ki shakri jong nga kiba long ki nongïathuhlypa , kiba la ong ïa phi ban ym leh ïa kane kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei kaba nga isih .
Kata ka Karkor namar u la lehbeiñ ïa suba riewkynthei bad um ju bapop jingsbun ïa ki Anaharath arspah Rephah don khun .
translation.en: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not : and doeth not good to the widow .

But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it  ; then he shall make her vow which she vowed , and that which she uttered with her lips , wherewith she bound her soul , of none effect : and the  Lord  shall forgive her .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u tnga jong ka , u khang ïa ka ban pyndep ïa ka kular haba u ïohsngew ïa kata , kam donkam ban bat ïa kata . U  Trai  un map ïa ka .

translation.en: And they wrote letters by them after this manner  ; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia :
translation.kha: bad ki la phah ïa kane ka shithi harum lyngba jong ki :  Ma ngi , ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang , ki hynmen ki para jong phi , ngi phah ki jingkhublei ïa ki hynmen ki para jong ngi kiba la kha na ki Jentil kiba shong basah ha Antiokh , ha Syria bad ha Kilikia .
U Araunah ïa-ïohi u Syiem Dabid wan , u la ïa ka kew bad u dem rit , la ka khlieh kaba kynduh ha madan .

translation.en: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing , and say unto him , Sit thou here in a good place  ; and say to the poor , Stand thou there , or sit here under my footstool :

translation.en: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them  ; and the  Lord  delivered them into his hands .

translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi lano kane kan sa long , la ki ong , bad to ïathuh ïa ngi kaei ka ban jia pyn-i ban ka ba por ka la poi na ka bynta kine kiei kiei baroh ban long .
translation.en: Tell us , when shall these things be ? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled ?
Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him , because he not only had broken the sabbath , but said also that God was his Father , making himself equal with God .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingong ka la pynlong ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba kin nang wad dong shuh shuh ban pynïap ïa u ; ym tang ba u la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum Sabbaton , hynrei ba u la ong ba U Blei hi u dei U Kpa jong u bad da kumne u la pynlong ïa lade uba ïaryngkat bad U Blei .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto David my father , Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name , thou didst well that it was in thine heart .
translation.kha: hynrei U  Trai  u la ong ha u , ‘ Me la leh ïa kaba dei ba me kwah ban tei ïa ka Templ ïa nga ,

translation.en: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way ? by taking heed thereto according to thy word .
translation.kha: Da kumno u samla un lah ban sumar khuid ïa la ka jingim ? Da kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well s mouth , and spread ground corn thereon  ; and the thing was not known .
translation.kha: Ka tnga jong uta u briew ka shim kawei ka jingtap , ka siang ïa ka halor kata ka pukri , bad ka la thad kew halor jong ka , khnang ba mano mano kin ym ïohi ei ei .
U Hena u la pynkut lah ka bor jong suhthied nongsynshar basniew kiba banbeiñ da ka jingbitar ïa Mano jinglehmeng bad tong bym Gamad sangeh ban pynshitom beiñ ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba ki la jop .
translation.en: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke , he that ruled the nations in anger , is persecuted , and none hindereth .
Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany , where Lazarus was which had been dead , whom he raised from the dead .
translation.kha: Hynriew sngi shuwa ka Niam Ka Jinglait , U Jisu u la leit sha Bethania , ka shnong u Lasaros , u briew ïa uba U Jisu u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
Kumta katba u Joab u dang kerkut ïa kata ka nongbah , u phah la ïa u Uriah sha ka jaka kaba ha u tip ba u nongshun u khlaiñ bha .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joab observed the city , that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were .

translation.kha: ïohnang ka jingkñia namar ka pop , Jingsuk Jehonathan kata kawei pat pynjuh ka jingainguh thang snar bad ka jingainguh jingïamynjur sim Kumne keiñ bapra u lyngdoh un tyngeh Kabul ka niam ka rukom kaba Jokhebed bad ka jingpynkhuid .
translation.en: Even such as he is able to get , the one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering , with the meat offering : and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the  Lord .
Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall , and prayed unto the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u phai la ka khmat sha ka kynroh bad u duwai :

translation.en: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingduwai u Habakkuk u nongïathuhlypa :

translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of Moses , one of his young men , answered and said , My lord Moses , forbid them .
translation.kha: Te u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , uba long u nongïarap jong u naduh ba u dang samla , u ong ,  Ko Kynrad , pynsangeh ïa ki !
Haba nga la wan sha phi parabangeit jong nga , ban ïalap ïa ka jingshisha jong U Blei , la pyndonkam da ki kyntien kiba eh bad ka jingtip kaba khraw .
translation.en: And I , brethren , when I came to you , came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom , declaring unto you the testimony of God .

translation.kha: Ki kiba khlaiñbor ki don ha ka ha ka jingsawa kum jingkyrhuh ka duriaw , ka jingphaloh jong ki jingat kiba khraw .
translation.en: Woe to the multitude of many people , which make a noise like the noise of the seas  ; and to the rushing of nations , that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters !
In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel , and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers .
translation.kha: Ka Israel kan ïasoh bad ka Judah , bad ryngkat lang kin ïawan na ka jingshah ringmraw ha ka ri kaba shatei bad kin wan phai sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi kum ka jingdon jingem kaba neh .
Ha ka nga , nga ïuhroit ïa ki jaitbynriew bad nga lynthaw ïa ki . Nga la ïa ka snam jong ki ha madan .
translation.en: And I will tread down the people in mine anger , and make them drunk in my fury , and I will bring down their strength to the earth .

translation.kha: Lada kata ka dak ka pur , u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid ; u la bit . jingpang
translation.en: And if it spread much abroad in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague .

And all Israel shall mourn for him , and bury him : for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave , because in him there is found some good thing toward the  Lord  God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam .
translation.kha: Baroh ki paid Israel kin ïambriew na ka bynta jong u bad kin tep ïa u . Un dei tang ma u na ka longïing u Jeroboam ïa uba yn ïoh tep donburom , namar u long tang ma u hi ïa uba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u sngewbha .

translation.en: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out , nor to him that came in , but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries .
translation.kha: Ha kito ki sngi ym don mano mano ba lah ban wan bad leit ha ka jingshngain , namar ba ka la don ka jingjynjar bad jingkhihwin ha ka ri baroh .

translation.en: So Saul died , and his three sons , and his armourbearer , and all his men , that same day together .
translation.kha: Bad da kumta u Saul , ki khun shynrang jong u lai ngut , bad uta u samla , ki la ïap ; baroh ki briew jong u Saul ki ïap ryngkat ha kajuh ka sngi .
A katno nga long u u bym don jingsuk! Uei ban pyllait ïa nga na kane ka met ïalam ïa nga sha ka jingïap ?
translation.en: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death ?

translation.kha: Bad nga da Hosah jur ïa phi ban duwai ba U Blei un phah pat Proberb nga sha phi kham Kalneh .
translation.en: But I beseech you the rather to do this , that I may be restored to you the sooner .

translation.kha: Nga mynjur , u Akhish u jubab , Nga ñiew ïa phi uba hok kum u angel U Blei . Hynrei kiwei pat ki syiem Philistia ki ba ong phim dei ban leit ryngkat bad ngi sha ka thma .
translation.en: And Achish answered and said to David , I know that thou art good in my sight , as an angel of God : notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said , He shall not go up with us to the battle .
When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her , then she left speaking unto her .
translation.kha: Haba ka Naomi ka ïohi ba ka Ruth ka la kut jingmut skhem ban leit bad ka , kam shym ong ei ei shuh .
Kaei ka jylla kaba ba briew tam ?
translation.en: Which Indian state has the largest population ?

translation.kha: Hynrei to bad to ïasaid Blei Badonbor Baroh ;
translation.en: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes , and make thy supplication to the Almighty  ;

translation.kha: Nethanaïah jaka Diamond jingthaba ka ïar kyrdem Ephron bad jingohdur ïa ka Bashan baroh — baroh ka pynbun u Og thnum u snoh Bashan , bad ruh baroh hynriewphew tylli keirang shnong jong Pyndep samthiah ha Bashan .
translation.en: And their coast was from Mahanaim , all Bashan , all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan , and all the towns of Jair , which are in Bashan , threescore cities :

translation.kha: La ïathuh ïa nga ïa jingdon jong ki shipai shong kulai : Ki la long arphew lakh ngut
translation.en: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand : and I heard the number of them .

translation.kha: Hynrei mem shym iehnoh ïa ki hangta ha haw ri shyiap , namar ka jingisynei jong jaiñsem ka long kaba palat . Mem jingwan la shim noh jingkhroh u lyoh lane ïa ka ding uba pyn-i ha ki ïa ka lynti mynsngi bad mynmiet .
translation.en: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness : the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day , to lead them in the way  ; neither the pillar of fire by night , to shew them light , and the way wherein they should go .
And being fully persuaded that , what he had promised , he was able also to perform .
translation.kha: U la thikna bha ba U Blei un leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular .
Sa shisien pat Karnelian ïohi ïa u syiem ba u synshar shatei snemhadien burom bakhraw ha ka hima kaba pyiar Eliesar baroh ki liang .
translation.en: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty : they shall behold the land that is very far off .
Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction : but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured .
translation.kha: Kino kino ki bym kwah ban shah hikai kin ïailong kiba kyrduh . Hynrei uno uno uba sngap ïa ka jingpynbeit u long ba la ñiewkor .

Na ka bynta jong u , nga la bret noh ïa kiei kiei baroh ; ñiew nga ïa ka baroh tang ka kum synrum , khnang ba ïoh ngan ïa U Khrist , bad ba yn pynïasoh pura bad u . Ngam long shuh uba don ka hok ka jong nga hi , ka kaba bynta nga ïoh da kaba ïa kohnguh ka hukum . Nga mynta , ïoh nga ïa ka hok kaba la ai da jingngeit ka ha U Khrist , ka hok kaba wan na U Blei bad kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingngeit .
translation.en: And be found in him , not having mine own righteousness , which is of the law , but that which is through the faith of Christ , the righteousness which is of God by faith :
But the olive tree said unto them , Should I leave my fatness , wherewith by me they honour God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?
translation.kha: U dieng Olib u jubab , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , ngan hap sangeh ban pynmih umphniang , ïa kaba la pyndonkam ban pyndonburom ïa ki blei jong ngi bad ïa ki khunbynriew .’
Thaw ïa duwan da ka dieng akasia , na ka bynta ban thang jingiwbih .
translation.en: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon : of shittim wood shalt thou make it .

translation.kha: Lane pyrkhat to ïa ka lieng kaba heh : La ka heh katno katno bad la pynïaid ïa ka da lyer ki bakhlaiñ , la ñiah ka ïa da u boitha uba rit eh , bad ka ïaid kat shaba u nongking lieng u mon ba kan leit .
translation.en: Behold also the ships , which though they be so great , and are driven of fierce winds , yet are they turned about with a very small helm , whithersoever the governor listeth .
And to the genealogy of all their little ones , their wives , and their sons , and their daughters , through all the congregation : for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness :
translation.kha: La kyntiew kyrteng ïa ki baroh ryngkat lang bad ki tnga jong ki , ki khun , bad kiba hap ha ka jingsumar jong ki , namar ka donkam ïa ki ban long kiba la kloi ban leh ïa ki kam bakyntang ha kano kano ka por .
bad U Jisu u la kylli ki ïa nonghikai ka Hukum bad ïa ki Pharisi , Hato ka Hukum jong ngi ka ne shah em ban pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?
translation.en: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees , saying ,  Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day ?

translation.kha: Lada phi dei uba khlaiñ bam , da synshar buk jingdoh lade .
translation.en: And put a knife to thy throat , if thou be a man given to appetite .

And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  for a sweet savour : and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine , the fourth part of an hin .
translation.kha: Ryngkat bad uta , phin ai ruh ar kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam . Ka jingiwbih jong kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai . Phin ai lang ruh bad kata ka jingkñia shi litar ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh dih .

translation.en: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold , silver , precious stones , wood , hay , stubble ;
translation.kha: Don ki ban pyndonkam da ka ksiar ne da ka rupa ne da ki mawkordor ha kaba tei halor ka nongrim ; kiwei pat kin pyndonkam da ka dieng ne da u phlang ne da u jyntang .

translation.en: Therefore now ,  Lord  , let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever , and do as thou hast said .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko  Trai  , to pyndep na ka bynta ka por baroh ïa ka kular jong me ïa nga bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad to leh ïa kaei kaba me thmu ban leh .
Ha ka jingbitar U u la pyndkut ïa ki kti ki kjat jong nga u peit ïa nga da .
translation.en: He teareth me in his wrath , who hateth me : he gnasheth upon me with his teeth  ; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me .

translation.kha: Ka la por snem ïa u Solomon tei ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years , wherein Solomon had built the house of the  Lord  , and his own house ,
In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge .
translation.kha: U long u shabi uba plie ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ba la buhrieh jong ka jingstad bad ka jingtip U Blei .
U Trai u la kren pat
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka kamram ba ki Lebi ki don ka long tang ban ïa u bad ki khun jong u .
translation.en: And they shall take a cloth of blue , and cover the candlestick of the light , and his lamps , and his tongs , and his snuffdishes , and all the oil vessels thereof , wherewith they minister unto it :

translation.kha: Ïa baroh ki khuri jong u syiem Solomon la shna da ka ksiar , bad baroh ki khiew ki pliang ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon ki long kiba da ka ksiar nylla . Ha ki sngi u Solomon ïa ka rupa Bengeber pat ñiew kaba kordor Abijah
translation.en: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold : none were of silver  ; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon .
And so shall be the plague of the horse , of the mule , of the camel , and of the ass , and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents , as this plague .
translation.kha: Ka jingpang bashyrkhei kan hap halor ki kulai , ki khashor , ki ut , bad ki kada — halor ki mrad baroh ha ki jaka sher dara jong u nongshun .
u Haba ïeng joit , wat kiba khlaiñ tam ki sheptieng ; kim lah leh ei ei namar ka jingtieng .
translation.en: When he raiseth up himself , the mighty are afraid : by reason of breakings they purify themselves .

But he slew not their children , but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses , where the  Lord  commanded , saying , The fathers shall not die for the children , neither shall the children die for the fathers , but every man shall die for his own sin .
translation.kha: Pynban um shym la pynïap ïa ki khun ki kti jong ki , hynrei u la bud ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ha Ka Hukum u Moses :  Ïa ki kmie ki kpa ym dei ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki khun jong ki , bad ïa ki khun ym dei ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki kmie ki kpa jong ki ; ïa u briew dei ban pynïap tang namar ka kam sniew kaba ma u hi u la leh .
U Trai u la mihpat da shisha ! U la paw ha u ! Simon
translation.en: Saying , The Lord is risen indeed , and hath appeared to Simon .
Nathanael answered and saith unto him , Rabbi , thou art the Son of God  ; thou art the King of Israel .
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  la jubab u Nathanael ,  me long U Khun U Blei ! Me long u Syiem ki Israel !
Nga la mihpaw ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak bad ha u Jakob , kum Blei Badonbor Baroh , hynrei shym la pynithuh lade ha da kyrteng jong nga , U Trai .
translation.en: And I appeared unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , by the name of God Almighty , but by my name  Jehovah  was I not known to them .

translation.kha: U Sedekaïah u la don arphew wei snem ka mynba rta u u long syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem .

Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way , when ye came forth out of Egypt  ; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia , to curse thee .
translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ban ai jingbam bad ai um ïa phi mynba phi don ha lynti na Ijipt , bad ki la khot wai ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , uba na ka shnong Pethor ha Mesopotamia , ban tim ïa phi .

translation.en: I will also cause all her mirth to cease , her feast days , her new moons , and her sabbaths , and all her solemn feasts .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkut noh ïa baroh ki kam sngewbha jong ka — ki jingkhawai ba man ka snem bad man u bnai bad ki jingrakhe ïa ka Sabbaton — bad ïa ki jinglehniam jong ka baroh .
Namar lada phi map ïa kiwei ïa ki jingpalat jingïateh ki la leh ïa phi , U Kpa Habakkuk sngewmeng uba ha bneng un map ruh kynram phi .
translation.en: For if ye forgive men their trespasses , your heavenly Father will also forgive you :

translation.kha: Kaei ? Lane ka Nakon mo ïingtrep long ba ka ktien U jingpynitynnat ka la Iskah na phi ? Lane hato dei tang ha phi ba ka la wan ?
translation.en: What ? came the word of God out from you ? or came it unto you only ?

translation.kha: Suk u briew uba ïa synriah pop jong u , U Bokhim un jingïap bajhieh jingkynmaw shuh !
translation.en: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin .
For the land , whither thou goest in to possess it , is not as the land of Egypt , from whence ye came out , where thou sowedst thy seed , and wateredst it with thy foot , as a garden of herbs :
translation.kha: Kata ka ri ba phin sa ïohkynti kam dei kum ka ri Ijipt ha kaba phi shong mynshuwa . Hangta , haba phi bet ïa u symbai , phi hap ban da trei shitom ban ai um ïa ki lyngkha ;

translation.en: Then answered Peter and said unto him , Behold , we have forsaken all , and followed thee  ; what shall we have therefore ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la kren ,  Ha khmih ,  u la ong ,  ngi la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh bad ngi la bud ïa me . Ngin ïoh aïu ?

translation.en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father : but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïaroh ïa ka jingstad , u kpa jong phi un sngewsarong ïa phi . Ka long ka jingpynlehnoh-ei ba-bieit ban pynlut pisa ha ki nuti .

translation.en: But as for you , turn you , and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi te , phi dei ban leit phai biang sha ka ri shyiap sha ka phang jong ka Duriaw Basaw .’

translation.en: But if he will not hear thee , then take with thee one or two more , that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada um sngap ïa me , ïalam uwei ne ar ngut kiwei pat ki briew lem bad me , khnang ba ‘ kawei pa kawei ka jingkynnoh lah ban kyrshan da ka jingsakhi jong ki ar lane lai ngut ki sakhi .’
Thymmai bapra kan Meun ka jingpynsah kynmaw ha ka Templ jong U Trai ha ka jingñiewburom ïa u Heldai , u Tobijah , u Jedaïah thawsha Shammua u ine .
translation.en: And the crowns shall be to Helem , and to Tobijah , and to Jedaiah , and to Hen the son of Zephaniah , for a memorial in the temple of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa kane ka kynhun ki rangbah ban rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sawdong ka nongbah shisien . Nangta ki wan sha ka jaka shong dara ki sahmiet .
translation.en: So the ark of the  Lord  compassed the city , going about it once : and they came into the camp , and lodged in the camp .
Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city , behold , there was a dead man carried out , the only son of his mother , and she was a widow : and much people of the city was with her .
translation.kha: Mar ïapoi ha ka khyrdop jong ka shnong , ka kynhun leit ontep ka dang mih shabar . U briew uba la ïap u long u khun nyngkong jong ka briew kaba long ka riewkynthei , bad u paidbah babun na ka shnong u la ïadon lem bad ka .

translation.en: For so the  Lord  said unto me , I will take my rest , and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs , and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ngan jngoh sha tbian na bneng kumba ka umjer ka wandur jar jar ha ki miet basyiad ha ka aïom ot , kumba ka sngi ka phyrnai itynnat ha ka jingshit ka sngi .
U Trai u la thaw nyngkong eh ïa nga kaba , nyngkong eh na ki kam jong u , la slem bah .
translation.en: The  Lord  possessed me in the beginning of his way , before his works of old .
Behold , God will not cast away a perfect man , neither will he help the evil doers :
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei un ym iehnoh ïa kiba shaniah ha u ne um ju ai jingïarap ïa ki riewbymman .

translation.en: Put away from thee a froward mouth , and perverse lips put far from thee .
translation.kha: Wat ju kren ïa kano kano ka bymshisha . Kiar na kaba kren lamler bad na ki ktien kiba ïalam bakla .

translation.en: And thou shalt make two rings of gold , and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof , which is in the side of the ephod inward .
translation.kha: Nangta , thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad buh ïa ki ha ka bynta ba sha trai jong ka jingdeng shadem ha ka tduh bashapoh hajan ka ephod .

translation.en: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers , to give them a land flowing with milk and honey , as it is this day . Then answered I , and said , So be it , O  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan bat ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ba ngan ai ha ki ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kaba ki don mynta .  Nga la ong ,  Ho-oid , ko  Trai .
Wat shukor ïa lade kyllan da kaba Jannai ïa ka ktien jong u ; pynban , to Khubor ïa ka .
translation.en: But be ye doers of the word , and not hearers only , deceiving your own selves .
But he answered and said ,  I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ïa nga la phah tang sha ki langbrot ba la jah noh jong ki paid Israel .

translation.en: Again , thou shalt say to the children of Israel , Whosoever he be of the children of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel , that giveth any of his seed unto Molech  ; he shall surely be put to death : the people of the land shall stone him with stones .
translation.kha: Ong ha ki Israel , uno uno na phi lane u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong phi , uba ai ïa uwei na ki khun jong u ha u blei Molekh , u dei ban shah lynthem maw ha u paidbah haduh ba un da ïap .

translation.en: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you , and thou shalt love him as thyself  ; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Leh ïa ki kumba phi leh ïa la u para Israel , bad ieit ïa ki kumba phi ieit ïa lade . Kynmaw ba phi ruh shisien phi la long ki nongwei ha ri Ijipt . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you , and for them at Laodicea , and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh ;
translation.kha: To shah ngan ïathuh ïa phi haduh katno nga la trei shitom na ka bynta jong phi , bad na ka bynta ki briew ha Laodikaïa bad na ka bynta kiwei pat baroh ki bym ithuh ïa nga markhmat .

translation.en: And when thou hast seen it , thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people , as Aaron thy brother was gathered .

translation.en: Cursed be their anger , for it was fierce  ; and their wrath , for it was cruel : I will divide them in Jacob , and scatter them in Israel .

translation.en: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children , My son , despise not thou the chastening of the Lord , nor faint when thou art rebuked of him :

To shahshkor ïa nga , phi kiba tip ïa kaei kaba dei , kiba don ka jinghikai jong nga kaba neh ha la ki dohnud Wat sheptieng haba ki briew ki bad krenbeiñ phi ;
translation.en: Hearken unto me , ye that know righteousness , the people in whose heart is my law  ; fear ye not the reproach of men , neither be ye afraid of their revilings .

translation.en: Divers weights , and divers measures , both of them are alike abomination to the  Lord .

translation.en: For he will finish the work , and cut it short in righteousness : because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth .

translation.kha: bad u ong ha ka ,  Keiñ noh kane ka jingleh buaid jong pha ! Wat dih shuh bad pynpyngngad noh !

translation.en: Then said they unto him , Lord , evermore give us this bread .

translation.kha: U Samson u ïalam ïa ki Israel arphew snem katba ki Philistia ki synshar ïa ka ri .
Wallam ïa syiem u Agag hangne ha nga , u Samuel u hukum . U Agag u la wan sha u da kaba khynñiuh da jingtieng ka , u da ha pyrkhat lade , Katno ka long kaba kthang ban ïap .
translation.en: Then said Samuel , Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites . And Agag came unto him delicately . And Agag said , Surely the bitterness of death is past .

translation.kha: Nangta u Sedekaïah u nongïathuhlypa leit kiew sha u Mikaïah , u ïa u na ka ngab jong u , bad kylli , Naduh mynno mynsiem jong U Trai u iehnoh ïa nga bad u ha me ?

translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki phah nonglamktien sha u Sihon , u syiem Amor ha Heshbon , ban pan jingbit ba kin ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u sha ka ri la jong .

Ki Israel ki la ïaid lyngba Abinoam ka duriaw ha ka Kumjuh kaba Garnet . Hynrei haba ki pynpoi jingthohlieh jong ki nong Ijipt lem pawnam khunbynriew kulai .—Jenesis pham ki leit shapoh ka duriaw , U Trai u pynïadait pat ïa ka um bad Pynphai la tyllep ïa ki .
translation.en: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea , and the  Lord  brought again the waters of the sea upon them  ; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea .
I was a stranger , and ye took me not in : naked , and ye clothed me not : sick , and in prison , and ye visited me not .

translation.en: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests ? therefore it shall be , that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king s house , thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests .

translation.en: Son of man , prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Howl ye , Woe worth the day !

translation.en: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish : and they made the ships in Ezion–geber .

translation.en: Will a man rob God ? Yet ye have robbed me . But ye say , Wherein have we robbed thee ? In tithes and offerings .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Because I said unto thee , I saw thee under the fig tree , believest thou ? thou shalt see greater things than these .

translation.en: He hath put my brethren far from me , and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when Pharaoh shall call you , and shall say , What is your occupation ?

translation.en: For Tophet is ordained of old  ; yea , for the king it is prepared  ; he hath made it deep and large : the pile thereof is fire and much wood  ; the breath of the  Lord  , like a stream of brimstone , doth kindle it .

translation.en: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name , receiveth me : and whosoever shall receive me , receiveth not me , but him that sent me .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Lada phi la long kiba matlah , te phin ym long kiba la shah pynrem ; hynrei naba phi kam ba phi ïohi , kane ka mut ba phi dang don ha ka jingpynrem .

translation.en: They mount up to the heaven , they go down again to the depths : their soul is melted because of trouble .

translation.en: If thou sayest , Behold , we knew it not  ; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it ? and he that keepeth thy soul , doth not he know it ? and shall not he render to every man according to his works ?
translation.kha: Phi lah ban ong ba kam dei ka kam jong phi , hynrei U Blei u tip bad u bishar ïa ki jingthmu jong phi . U ïai ap khmih ïa phi ; u tip . Un ainong ïa phi kat kum kaei kaba phi leh .

translation.en: In their heat I will make their feasts , and I will make them drunken , that they may rejoice , and sleep a perpetual sleep , and not wake , saith the  Lord .

translation.en: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed , and will make him afraid : and all the people that are with him shall flee  ; and I will smite the king only :

translation.en: Therefore it shall be , when the  Lord  thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about , in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it , that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven  ; thou shalt not forget it .
From thence she seeketh the prey , and her eyes behold afar off .

translation.en: But as it is written , Eye hath not seen , nor ear heard , neither have entered into the heart of man , the things which God hath prepared for them that love him .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen , and against all Edom , which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart , with despiteful minds , to cast it out for a prey .

translation.en: And David said , What have I now done ? Is there not a cause ?

translation.en: And Jesus said ,  For judgment I am come into this world , that they which see not might see  ; and that they which see might be made blind .

translation.kha: Kawei ka ha baroh , bad kane ka kaba bakla kum kano kaba jia ha kane ka pyrthei . Katba ki briew ki dang im , ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki dap da ka jingsniew bad ka jinglamwir , bad kynsan ki
translation.en: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun , that there is one event unto all : yea , also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil , and madness is in their heart while they live , and after that they go to the dead .
