Tang ma me marwei bniap wan sha jan jong nga ; Shammah kiwei pat kim bit ban wan sha jan . U paidbah lei lei um bit ban wan Lasaïa sha uta u lum .
translation.en: And Moses alone shall come near the  Lord  : but they shall not come nigh  ; neither shall the people go up with him .
They say unto him , Lord , that our eyes may be opened .
translation.kha: Ko Kynrad ,  ki la jubab ,  ngi kwah ïa me ban ai ha ngi ka jinglah ban ïohi !
me Hato tip mynno la kha ïa ki blang lum ? Hato me ju ïohi ïa ka skei khlaw ba ka kha khun ?
translation.en: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth ? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve ?

translation.kha: Ka thir hi ïa ïatong u ksai , bad ka pyntip Laiphew ïa la ka jaiñ .
translation.en: She layeth her hands to the spindle , and her hands hold the distaff .

translation.kha: Ha man ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , u Pilat kumba long ka rukom u ju pyllait ïa uno uno u koidi uba ki ki briew kwah .
translation.en: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner , whomsoever they desired .

translation.kha: Ïa baroh nga leh na ka bynta ka gospel , khnang ba ngan ïoh bynta ha ki jingkyrkhu jong ka .
translation.en: And this I do for the gospel s sake , that I might be partaker thereof with you .

translation.kha: Topas kpa tymmen jong phi bad kito ki nongïathuhlypa kim don shuh .
translation.en: Your fathers , where are they ? and the prophets , do they live for ever ?
For thus saith the Lord  God   ; When I shall make thee a desolate city , like the cities that are not inhabited  ; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee , and great waters shall cover thee  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba shah iehnoh kum ki nongbah ba la pynjot ha kaba ym don mano mano ban shong hangta . Ngan tap ïa pha da ka um jong ki jingjylliew ka duriaw-bah .

translation.en: I have cut off the nations : their towers are desolate  ; I made their streets waste , that none passeth by : their cities are destroyed , so that there is no man , that there is none inhabitant .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la pynduh lut ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ; nga la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ki bad iehnoh ïa ki kynroh bad ïa ki kut jong ki ha ki jingjot . Ki nongbah ki la shah iehnoh ; ki lynti bah ki thylli — ym shym pynsah ïa uwei ruh .

translation.en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men , much elder than thy father .
translation.kha: Ngi ïoh ïa ka jingstad na ki briew ba la phuh ñiuhlieh — kito ïa kiba la kha ha shuwa u kpa jong me .
phi ïaroh ïa ka jingstad , u jong sngewsarong ïa phi . Ka long ka jingpynlehnoh-ei ba-bieit ban pynlut pisa ha ki nuti .
translation.en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father : but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance .

translation.kha: kyntait ïa ri baroh pynim ïa ka jingim phi , namar phi long uba kordor ha nga bad namar ba nga ieit ïa phi bad ai ïa phi ka burom .
translation.en: Since thou wast precious in my sight , thou hast been honourable , and I have loved thee : therefore will I give men for thee , and people for thy life .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha duriaw-rit baroh ba maïan don na kito ki rangbah kiba la shah khot sngewbha ki ishongkhia ïohmad ïa ka Reference miet Rephaim nga !’
translation.en: For I say unto you , That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper .

translation.kha: U Jakob u la trei hynñiew snem ba u lah ban ïoh ïa ka Rakhel bad kata , ka por ka i kum khyndiat tylli ki sngi ïa u , namar u la ieit ïa ka .
translation.en: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel  ; and they seemed unto him but a few days , for the love he had to her .

Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon  ; and my servants shall be with thy servants : and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint : for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians .
translation.kha: Kumta phah ïa ki rangbah jong me sha Lebanon ban pynngat ïa ki dieng Kedar na ka bynta jong nga . Ki rangbah jong nga kin ïatreilang bad ki , bad ngan siew ïa ki rangbah jong me kat kaba me pynbeit . Kumba me tip bha , ki rangbah jong nga kim tip kumno ban pynngat ïa ki dieng kumba ki jong me ki tip .
Kumta ki la bret ïa u jong ka bri sohwaiñ bad ki . Kaei , te , ba u trai jong ka bri un leh ïa ki nongshimwai ? U u kylli .
translation.en: So they cast him out of the vineyard , and killed him . What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them ?

All that found them have devoured them : and their adversaries said , We offend not , because they have sinned against the  Lord  , the habitation of justice , even the  Lord  , the hope of their fathers .
translation.kha: Ki la shah tur ïaleh da baroh kiba ïakynduh ïa ki . Ki nongshun jong ki , ki ong , ‘ Ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad kumta kaei kaba ngi la leh , kam long kaba bakla . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki la shaniah ha U  Trai  , bad ma ki hi kiba la dei ban ïailong kiba ïaineh ha u .’
Bad u lyngskor un ïohsngew ïa , ngin pynngeit ïa u ba phi long bymtip ei , bad phin ym don ei ei ban khuslai .
translation.en: And if this come to the governor s ears , we will persuade him , and secure you .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki ktien u Amos , nongaplangbrot u na ka shnong Tekoa Ar . snem shuwa u jumai , mynba u Ussaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u Jeroboam u khun jong u Joash u long u syiem ka Israel , U Blei u la pynpaw ha u Amos ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ki shaphang Israel .
translation.en: The words of Amos , who was among the herdmen of Tekoa , which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel , two years before the earthquake .

translation.kha: Bad u ong la , La pyndep ! Nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh , uba sdang bad uba kut . Ha uno uno uba sliang ngan ai ïa ka hok ban dih na umpohliew ka ka jong um ka jingim khlem da siewdor ïa ka .
translation.en: And he said unto me , It is done . I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the end . I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely .

translation.kha: Ka rukom pynïaid kaba wanrah ïa jingpynrem ka ka la long kaba donburom ; katno kaba tam kaba kham donburom kata ka jingtrei kaba wanrah ïa ka jingpynim!
translation.en: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory , much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory .
If I rejoiced because my wealth was great , and because mine hand had gotten much  ;

Namar u Abraham u long u kpa ba kynja mynsiem jong ngi ; baroh
translation.en: Therefore it is of faith , that it might be by grace ; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed ; not to that only which is of the law , but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham ; who is the father of us all ,
And it is a rare thing that the king requireth , and there is none other that can shew it before the king , except the gods , whose dwelling is not with flesh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Cain , Where is Abel thy brother ? And he said , I know not : Am I my brother s keeper ?

translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit . Amen .

translation.en: So Joshua let the people depart , every man unto his inheritance .

translation.en: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit  ; neither hath he power in the day of death : and there is no discharge in that war  ; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it .

translation.en: Speak unto Aaron , saying , Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish , let him not approach to offer the bread of his God .

translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , U Trai u la bthah ïa leit pat sha bad shim ïa ki patlun lyngkot .
translation.en: And it came to pass after many days , that the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , go to Euphrates , and take the girdle from thence , which I commanded thee to hide there .
Who had his dwelling among the tombs  ; and no man could bind him , no , not with chains :

translation.en: So she wrote letters in Ahab s name , and sealed them with his seal , and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city , dwelling with Naboth .
translation.kha: Nangta ka thoh katto katne ki shithi , bad ka soi ïa ki ha ka kyrteng u Ahab , ka shonshab ïa ki da ka muhor jong u , bad ka phah ïa ki sha ki rangbah synshar bad ki riewpawkhmat ka Jesreel .
Namar kane ka daw U Jisu ruh u la shabar ïap nongbah ka , khnang ban pynkhuid ïa u paidlang na ka pop da ka snam jong u hi .
translation.en: Wherefore Jesus also , that he might sanctify the people with his own blood , suffered without the gate .
And let them gather all the food of those good years that come , and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh , and let them keep food in the cities .

translation.en: But in those days , after that tribulation , the sun shall be darkened , and the moon shall not give her light ,
And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him , and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king s treasuries for the Jews , to destroy them .
translation.kha: U Mordekai u ong ïa u ïa kaei baroh kaba la jia ïa u bad haduh katno ka pisa ba u Haman u la kular ban buh ha ka ïing jingkynshew u syiem lada ïa baroh ki Jiw la pynïap .

translation.en: And thou say in thine heart , My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth .
translation.kha: Husiar ïoh phi ong ha lade , ‘ Ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga hi ki la pynriewspah katne ïa nga .’

translation.en: And if the house be worthy , let your peace come upon it : but if it be not worthy , let your peace return to you .
translation.kha: Lada ki briew hapoh kata ka ïing ki pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , ai ba ka jingkhublei jingsuk jong phi kan neh ; hynrei lada kim pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , to shim noh pat ïa ka jingkhublei jong phi .

translation.en: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence , they were gathered together .
translation.kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la pynsngap jar ïa ki Saddusi , ki la ïawanlang ,

translation.en: A sword is upon their horses , and upon their chariots , and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her  ; and they shall become as women : a sword is upon her treasures  ; and they shall be robbed .
translation.kha: Pynjot ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong ka ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki shipai ba shu wai — Katno ki long kiba tlot ! Pynjot ïa ki jingkynshew jong ka ; lute bad rong noh .
Hynrei ki ki la ïathuh ïa ka hukum u syiem ha ka Bashti , ka ; ka la kyntait ban wan . Kane la pynbitar u syiem
translation.en: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king s commandment by his chamberlains : therefore was the king very wroth , and his anger burned in him .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka pyrthei kan long ba la dap da ka jingtip ïa ka burom U Trai kumba ki duriaw dap ki da ka um .
translation.en: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the  Lord  , as the waters cover the sea .

In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it : and it shall bring forth boughs , and bear fruit , and be a goodly cedar : and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing  ; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell .
translation.kha: halor u lumbah bakynjang tam jong ka Israel . Un sei ki tnat bad pynmih ki symbai bad kylla long u dieng Kedar ba-itynnat eh . Ki sim kiba bun jait kin im hangta bad ïoh jingda ha ka syrngiew jong u .

Ha kane ka jaka bathngan riphin ïa baroh ki jingthmu jong Khatphra briew ka Judah bad ka Jesreel . Ngan shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban risa halor jong ki bad pynïap ïa ki ha Ïalap thma . lypa ai ïa ki metïap jong kyiuh ha ki sim Pung ha ki shyrkhei kum ka jingbam jingsngewlehrain
translation.en: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place  ; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies , and by the hands of them that seek their lives : and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven , and for the beasts of the earth .

translation.kha: Bunsien nga shahshitom na ka mynsngi bad na ka jingkhriat . Ngam ju ïohthiah satia .
translation.en: Thus I was  ; in the day the drought consumed me , and the frost by night  ; and my sleep departed from mine eyes .

translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul , Khmih , ki briew ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai da kaba bam ka ïa doh kaba dang don hapoh snam jong ka . Phi ki dei nongshetkylla ! u Saul u kyang . Pyntyllun uwei u maw heh shane sha nga .
translation.en: Then they told Saul , saying , Behold , the people sin against the  Lord  , in that they eat with the blood . And he said , Ye have transgressed : roll a great stone unto me this day .

translation.kha: Ka kam julam ia ki marjan , namarkata ka ka jingpyndap pynkmen jong .
translation.en: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour : therefore love is the fulfilling of the law .
Who leave the paths of uprightness , to walk in the ways of darkness  ;
translation.kha: ki briew kiba iehnoh ïa ka jingim hok ban im ha ka jingdum ka pop ,

translation.en: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the  Lord  , which the  Lord  spake concerning the house of Ahab : for the  Lord  hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah .
translation.kha: Kane ka pynshisha ba baroh kaba U  Trai  u la ong shaphang ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab ka wan jia shisha . U  Trai  u la leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular lyngba u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa jong u .

translation.en: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te namarkata , haba ka por ka poi ba ïa ka ri yn ai pat sha ki briew jong U  Trai  , yn ym don shuh ka bynta ïano ïano na phi .

translation.en: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand , with part of the vessels of the house of God : which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god  ; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god .

translation.en: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish , saying , I have offended  ; return from me : that which thou puttest on me will I bear . And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold .

translation.en: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him , saying , Behold now , the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth : let thy word , I pray thee , be like the word of one of them , and speak that which is good .

translation.en: And Boaz answered and said unto her , It hath fully been shewed me , all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband : and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother , and the land of thy nativity , and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore .
And whatsoever we ask , we receive of him , because we keep his commandments , and do those things that are pleasing in his sight .
translation.kha: Ngi ïohpdiang na u ïa kano kano kaba ngi pan , namar ba ngi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u bad ngi leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u .

translation.en: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign , and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem , and did not that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  his God , like David his father .

translation.en: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us : for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul .

translation.en: Thou shalt be visited of the  Lord  of hosts with thunder , and with earthquake , and great noise , with storm and tempest , and the flame of devouring fire .

translation.en: And of thy garments thou didst take , and deckedst thy high places with divers colours , and playedst the harlot thereupon : the like things shall not come , neither shall it be so .

translation.en: And I , behold , I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel : to you they are given as a gift for the  Lord  , to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.en: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn , and to restore every man s money into his sack , and to give them provision for the way : and thus did he unto them .

translation.en: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness , but unto holiness .

don u lyngdoh uba khraw uba peit ka ïing U Blei .
translation.en: And having an high priest over the house of God  ;

translation.en: Yet he restored the money unto his mother  ; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver , and gave them to the founder , who made thereof a graven image and a molten image : and they were in the house of Micah .

translation.en: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom .

translation.en: He hath bent his bow like an enemy : he stood with his right hand as an adversary , and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion : he poured out his fury like fire .

translation.en: And I will set my face against you , and ye shall be slain before your enemies : they that hate you shall reign over you  ; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you .

translation.en: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king , and asked , saying , I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist .

translation.en: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren , like unto thee , and will put my words in his mouth  ; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him .

translation.kha: Bad haba nga la kdiah ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki saw hajar ngut ki briew , U Jisu u la kylli , katno tukri kiba da ki lyngkhot ba kpu sah tam kiba phi la ïalum ? Hynñiew , ki la jubab .
translation.en: And when the seven among four thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  And they said , Seven .
And Saul had a concubine , whose name was Rizpah , the daughter of Aiah : and Ish–bosheth said to Abner , Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father s concubine ?
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Ishbosheth u khun jong u Saul u kynnoh sniew ïa u Abner ba u ïathiah bad ka Rispah , ka tnga kliar jong u Saul , ka khun jong u Aïah .
Mynba U Jisu u don marwei , katto katne ngut na kito kiba la ïa u la wan u ryngkat bad ki khat-ar ki synran bad ki la kylli ïa u ban batai ïa ki pharshi .
translation.en: And when he was alone , they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable .
And this I do for the gospel s sake , that I might be partaker thereof with you .
translation.kha: Ïa kane baroh nga leh na ka bynta ka gospel , khnang ba ngan ïoh bynta ha ki jingkyrkhu jong ka .

translation.en: The table , and his staves , and all his vessels , and the shewbread ,
translation.kha: ïa ka miej , ki jingbah ïa ka , bad baroh ki tiar ki tar jong ka ; ïa u kpu ba la ainguh sha U Blei ;
To ïai pyrthuh bud ïa nga , ko ki parabangeit jong nga To . pynleit jingmut ïa kito kiba bud ïa ka nuksa dei kaba kaba ngi la buh na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: Brethren , be followers together of me , and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an example .
And Jesus saith unto him ,  The foxes have holes , and the birds of the air have nests  ; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Ki myrsiang ki don ki krem , bad ki sim ki don ki skum , hynrei U Khun U Briew um don jaka hangno hangno ban dem bad ban pynjahthait .
Uba khraw tam hapoh ka Hima ki u long uta uba ïa lade bad uba long kum une u khynnah .
translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child , the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: na ka bynta kawei kawei ka sharak bad uwei uwei u diengpynïeng sharak ,
translation.en: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold , and for their lamps of gold , by weight for every candlestick , and for the lamps thereof : and for the candlesticks of silver by weight , both for the candlestick , and also for the lamps thereof , according to the use of every candlestick .
The words of Agur the son of Jakeh , even the prophecy : the man spake unto Ithiel , even unto Ithiel and Ucal ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki ktien bashongkhia jong u Agur u khun jong u Jakeh :  U Blei um long bad nga , U Blei um long bad nga , bad nga long khlem jingïarap .

translation.en: So he went and did according unto the word of the  Lord  : for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith , that is before Jordan .
translation.kha: U Elijah u la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad u la leit bad shong harud ka wahduid Kherith .
U bishar hok ïa kiba duk , bad baroh ïaid ki beit bad u . Kata ka long ka jingmut ban ithuh ïa U Trai .
translation.en: He judged the cause of the poor and needy  ; then it was well with him : was not this to know me ? saith the  Lord .

That he told her all his heart , and said unto her , There hath not come a razor upon mine head  ; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother s womb : if I be shaven , then my strength will go from me , and I shall become weak , and be like any other man .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh u ïathuh ha ka ïa ka jingshisha .  Ïa u shñiuh jong nga ym pat ju khap ,  u ong ,  Ïa nga la pynkyntang sha U Blei kum u Nasir naduh ka por ba kha ïa nga . Lada la khi ïa u shñiuh jong nga , ngan duh noh ïa ka bor bad ngan long uba tlot kumba long lem kiwei .

translation.en: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem , and be glad with her , all ye that love her : rejoice for joy with her , all ye that mourn for her :
translation.kha: To shadkmen bad ka Jerusalem ; to lehkmen na ka bynta jong ka , phi baroh kiba ieit ïa kane ka nongbah ! To shadkmen bad ka , mynta phi baroh kiba la ïam pangnud na ka bynta jong ka !
Ka jingstad ka don ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki briew kiba stad ; kiba bieit kim tip bastad ei shaphang ka jingstad .
translation.en: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding : but that which is in the midst of fools is made known .
The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ,

u Gad u la leit sha u , ban ïathuh ïa u ïa nongleitkurim ba U Trai u Rameses ong , bad u kylli , Hosea kata Ki Ashteroth pat ? wah snem ka nemsniew ha ka Sergius jong phi , ïa-ithuh lai bnai kaba phet ïap na ki nongshun Lehsbun phi , ne lai sngi ka jingïapthem ha ka ri nongpyntrei phi ? Mynta to jingithuh , bad ïathuh ha nga jingbakla ka jubab ba ngan Kemuel rah sha sngewlah Trai .
translation.en: So Gad came to David , and told him , and said unto him , Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land ? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies , while they pursue thee ? or that there be three days  pestilence in thy land ? now advise , and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me .

translation.kha: Lada nga la ikwah ïa ka tnga u paramarjan jong nga , bad ïai ap ïai , shabar ka jingkhang jong ka ,
translation.en: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman , or if I have laid wait at my neighbour s door  ;
And they shall not teach every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the Lord : for all shall know me , from the least to the greatest .
translation.kha: Yn ym don na ki u ban hikai ïa la u para shnong lane ong ïa la u para ri , ‘ To tip ïa U Trai .’ Namar baroh kin tip ïa nga , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam .

translation.en: For the  Lord  hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit , and a wife of youth , when thou wast refused , saith thy God .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , pha long kum ka tnga ba dang kham samla , ba la iehnoh da u tnga jong ka bad ba sngew jynjar sat . Hynrei U  Trai  u khot pat ïa pha bad u ong :

Kam long ka jingmyntoi ïa ngi ban leit shapoh ka Shuwa namar ngin sa ïapthngan Baalath , hynrei lada ngi shong hangne nongmuna ngin ïap kumjuh . Kumta , Apollos ngin ïaleit noh teh ka jaka shong dara ki Syria ; kaba sniew tam ba ki lah ban leh ka long ba kin pynïap ïa ngi , Pyndep lehse kin pyllait im ïa ngi .
translation.en: If we say , We will enter into the city , then the famine is in the city , and we shall die there : and if we sit still here , we die also . Now therefore come , and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians : if they save us alive , we shall live  ; and if they kill us , we shall but die .
And they presented the burnt offering unto him , with the pieces thereof , and the head : and he burnt them upon the altar .
translation.kha: Ki ai ha u ïa ka khlieh bad ïa kiwei pat ki lyngkhot doh , bad u thang ïa ki ha ka duwan .

translation.en: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house , that ruled over all that he had , Put , I pray thee , thy hand under my thigh :
translation.kha: U ong ha u shakri jong u , uba la rangbah bha , uba peit halor baroh kiba u don ,  Buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki lbong jong nga bad pynlong ka jingsmai .

U Jisu u dang ïaid lyngba jingwallam lyngkha Sepngi ha ka sngi Sabbaton Jahas riewblei ïatei jong u ba-pura la poi ban kheit ïa ki kop kew , ki Boskath ïa ki ha ki kti jong ki , bad ki bam jingkam ki symboh kew kyntien
translation.en: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first , that he went through the corn fields  ; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn , and did eat , rubbing them in their hands .
And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month : and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening .
translation.kha: Nangta , ha ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong une u bnai , ki paid Israel baroh kin ïa-pynïap ïa kita ki mrad .

translation.en: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them , saying , Ye men and brethren , if ye have any word of exhortation for the people , say on .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingpule na ka Hukum u Moses bad na ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa , ki rangbah synshar jong ka synagog ki la phah khubor sha ki :  Ko hynmen ko para , ngi kwah ïa phi ban kren ha u paidbah lada phi don ka khubor ai mynsiem na ka bynta jong ki .
Kynther ïa lade , ko Jerusalem ! Ïeng joit na u pui pui bad shong halor la ka khet ! noh Law ki ïa kynjri kiba teh ïa pha , ki ba briew la shah khum jong ka Seïon !
translation.en: Shake thyself from the dust  ; arise , and sit down , O Jerusalem : loose thyself from the bands of thy neck , O captive daughter of Zion .

translation.kha: Hodabaïah ki briew ki la pule ïa ka , namar Keturah jaka ha kaba Adonibesek sahnarphna ïa U Jisu kam da jylliew na Seus nongbah . Ka jingthoh ka la long ha ki ktien Galilaïa —2 Latin bad Grik jingtynjuh
translation.en: This title then read many of the Jews : for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city : and it was written in Hebrew , and Greek , and Latin .

translation.kha: U u Ussaïah la ïap bad la tep ha ka jaka tep syiem hynrei namar ka jong jingpang u ym shym la tep ïa u ka ha jingtep ki syiem . U Jotham u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Uzziah slept with his fathers , and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings  ; for they said , He is a leper : and Jotham his son reigned in his stead .
Take his garment that is surety for a stranger : and take a pledge of him for a strange woman .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba mutlop palat kat ban kular ban bahkhlieh ïa ki ram jong u nongwei u dei ban don la ki jingdon jingem ban buh bynda .

translation.en: Woe unto them ! for they have gone in the way of Cain , and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward , and perished in the gainsaying of Core .
translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba kordit ïa ki ! Ki la bud ha ka lynti kaba u Kain u la ïaid . Na ka bynta ka tyngka , ki la aiti ïa lade sha ka jingbakla kaba u Balaam u la leh . Ki la ïaleh pyrshah kumba u Korah u la ïaleh pyrshah , bad kum ma u , la pynjot ïa ki .
Ngi basma sngewbha ïa kane ha kylleng kylleng bad ha ki por baroh , bad ngi da sngewnguh eh ïa me .
translation.en: We accept it always , and in all places , most noble Felix , with all thankfulness .
And they went up on the breadth of the earth , and compassed the camp of the saints about , and the beloved city : and fire came down from God out of heaven , and devoured them .
translation.kha: Ki la saphriang kylleng ka pyrthei bad ki la kerkut ïa ka jaka sher dara jong ki briew jong U Blei bad ïa ka nongbah kaba u ieit . Hynrei ka ding ka la wan hiar na bneng bad ka la pynjot ïa ki .
Nangta u la phah ïa ki samla shynrang bad ki la thang ïa ki jingkñia jingbynta U Trai bad ïaishah la kñia Solomon katne tylli ki jingri jingbang prong sleit jingïasyllok .
translation.en: And he sent young men of the children of Israel , which offered burnt offerings , and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the  Lord .
He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver  ; nor he that loveth abundance with increase : this is also vanity .
translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa ka pisa da lei lei ruh phin ym ïoh jinghun , lada phi angnud ban riewspah , phin ym ïoh ïa baroh kaba phi kwah . Ka long ka bymmyntoi .
Hato phin shu kren junom ? Hato borabor phin don kyntien ka khatduh ?
translation.en: Shall vain words have an end ? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest ?
Then Peter , turning about , seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following  ; which also leaned on his breast at supper , and said , Lord , which is he that betrayeth thee ?
translation.kha: U Petros u la phai sawdong bad u la ïohi hadien jong u ïa uta uwei pat u synran , ïa uba U Jisu u ieit — uta uba la shong shaniah ha U Jisu ha ka jingïabam miet bad uba la kylli ,  Ko Trai , uei u ban sa shetkylla ïa me ?

translation.en: Then said I , O my lord , what are these ? And the angel that talked with me said unto me , I will shew thee what these be .
translation.kha: Nga la kylli ïa u ,  Ko rangbah , kine ki kulai ki mut aïu ?  U la jubab  Ngan pyn-i ïa phi aïu ki kit jingmut .
U la pyrshang ban ïohi ïa Jisu ba U u long uba kumno , hynrei u long u briew uba rit bad um lah ban ïohi ïa U Jisu namar ki paidbah .
translation.en: And he sought to see Jesus who he was  ; and could not for the press , because he was little of stature .

translation.kha: Bun na ki briew kiba la wan jngoh ka ki la ïohi ïa kaba U Jisu u la leh , bad ki la ngeit
translation.en: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary , and had seen the things which Jesus did , believed on him .
And Balaam rose up in the morning , and said unto the princes of Balak , Get you into your land : for the  Lord  refuseth to give me leave to go with you .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u Balaam u la leit sha ki nonglamktien jong u Balak bad u ong ,  Khie leit phai sha la ïing ; U  Trai  um shah ba ngan leit bad phi .

translation.en: And they put away the strange gods from among them , and served the  Lord  : and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta ki bret noh ïa la ki blei nongwei bad ki la mane ïa U  Trai  ; bad u la pisa halor ka jingjynjar jong ki Israel .
ki ïasylla lang ban wan bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad thaw jingkulmar ,
translation.en: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem , and to hinder it .

The  Lord  hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion : he hath stretched out a line , he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying : therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament  ; they languished together .
translation.kha: Ka burom jong ka , ka la leit noh ; ka la lyngkhuit bad ka la don ha ka jingshah ñiewbeiñ . Ka ud bad ka buhrieh ïa la ka durkhmat ha ka jinglehrain . Ka Jerusalem ka la pynjakhlia ïa lade da ka pop kaba shyrkhei .

translation.en: And they asked them , saying , Is this your son , who ye say was born blind ? how then doth he now see ?
translation.kha: Hato une u dei u khun jong phi ? Phi ong ba la kha matlah ïa u ; te kumno pat mynta u la imat ?

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly  ; and he built in Judah castles , and cities of store .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jehoshaphat u nang roi bad nang khrawbor .

Ki pher kin thied ïa ki , bad ïa ki dulir thied jaka yn soi hylla shon muhor bad yn sakhi . Kane kan jia Aïu ka ri Benjamin , jingtbit ki shnong sawdong ïaring Jerusalem , ha ki shnong ka Judah , bad sabut ki shnong ka ri lum , phla ki kjat lum , bad ha ka Judah bashaphang bajyrngam . Ngan jongki pat ïai-ong ki briew ïa ka ri jong ki . Ma shynrong , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Men shall buy fields for money , and subscribe evidences , and seal them , and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin , and in the places about Jerusalem , and in the cities of Judah , and in the cities of the mountains , and in the cities of the valley , and in the cities of the south : for I will cause their captivity to return , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka burom bad ka main longsyiem ki ker sawdong ïa ; u ka bor bad ka jingitynnat ki pyndap ïa ka Templ jong u .
translation.en: Honour and majesty are before him : strength and beauty are in his sanctuary .

translation.kha: Mynta , weng noh ïa ki laiphew ar ngut ki nongsynshar na ka kyrdan ai hukum bad bujli Khet ïa ki da ki rangbah ai hukum na madan thma .
translation.en: And do this thing , Take the kings away , every man out of his place , and put captains in their rooms :

translation.kha: ïa ka miej bad ki tiar Aphek tar jong ka baroh , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak bad ki tiar ki tar jong Antiokh baroh , ïa ka Addi ban jingstad-buit jingiwbih ,
translation.en: And the table and all his vessels , and the candlestick and his vessels , and the altar of incense ,

translation.kha: Ngam shym sngap ïa ki nonghikai jong , ngam shym la ïa ki .
translation.en: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers , nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me !

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynmutlop ïa Pharaoh , bad um la shah ïa ki ban leit
translation.en: But the  Lord  hardened Pharaoh s heart , and he would not let them go .

translation.kha: U Trai la thaw ïa khlur ki Pleïades bad Orion u pynkylla ïa ka jingdum sha ka jingshai mynsngi ïa ka sngi sha miet . U na ka bynta ki um jong ka duriaw theh ïa ki ha sla khyndew . Ka kyrteng u ka dei U Trai
translation.en: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion , and turneth the shadow of death into the morning , and maketh the day dark with night : that calleth for the waters of the sea , and poureth them out upon the face of the earth : The  Lord  is his name :
And as he reasoned of righteousness , temperance , and judgment to come , Felix trembled , and answered , Go thy way for this time  ; when I have a convenient season , I will call for thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei katba u Paul u dang batai shaphang ka jingbha , ka bor halor lade , bad ka Sngi ka Jingbishar ka ban sa wan , u Pheliks u la sheptieng bad u la ong ,  Mynta me lah ban leit noh shuwa . Ngan sa phah khot pat haba nga ïohlad .

translation.en: Go through , go through the gates  ; prepare ye the way of the people  ; cast up , cast up the highway  ; gather out the stones  ; lift up a standard for the people .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid ka Jerusalem , leit shabar ka nongbah bad shna ka lynti na ka bynta u paidlang u ban wan phai ! Pynkhreh ïa ka lynti bah ; da pynkhuid ïa ki maw kiba don ha ka ! To sieh ïa ka lama , khnang ba ki jaitbynriew kin tip .
Ki la sahnarphna ïa u bad nangta Beryl la pynbynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki da kaba nongthaw .
translation.en: And they crucified him , and parted his garments , casting lots : that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet , They parted my garments among them , and upon my vesture did they cast lots .
Then would I speak , and not fear him  ; but it is not so with me .
translation.kha: Ngam sheptieng , ngan ïai kren beit namar nga tip ïa la ka dohnud .

Ha ka tnaw kaba bud , harum mynsiem bymman na U Blei kynsan kynsan u ïoh sngewtynnad ïa u Saul , bad u pynkulmar ha ïing khla-ka-wait kum uba lamwir . U Dabid u Korinth tem ïa ka duitara , kumba u ju leh nongpynïaidkam ka sngi , bad u Saul u hajir ïa durkhmat u sum markhmat
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul , and he prophesied in the midst of the house : and David played with his hand , as at other times : and there was a javelin in Saul s hand .
And there shall be an hole in the top of it , in the midst thereof : it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it , as it were the hole of an habergeon , that it be not rent .
translation.kha: Ka dei ban don ka thliew ha ka jaka ban phrung ïa ka khlieh , bad suh khylliap ïa ka baroh sawdong kumba leh ïa ka jymphong , khnang ba kan ym kad .

translation.en: And Rab–shakeh said unto them , Speak ye now to Hezekiah , Thus saith the great king , the king of Assyria , What confidence is this wherein thou trustest ?
translation.kha: Uwei na ki rangbah synshar ki Assyria u ïathuh ïa ki , ba u nongsynshar u kwah ban tip kaei kaba pynlong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ban sngewskhem .

ïa ki pyrda jong ka phyllaw , ïa rishot ki jong , ka bad ïa ki tnaw thliew jong ka ; ïa ka ïa pyrda ka khyrdop jong ka phyllaw bad ïa ki tyllai jong ka ; ïa ki snar jong ka Ïingjaiñ ; ïa ki tiar baroh kiba pyndonkam ha ka Ïingjaiñ ;
translation.en: The hangings of the court , his pillars , and his sockets , and the hanging for the court gate , his cords , and his pins , and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle , for the tent of the congregation ,

translation.kha: Pynban , phi wan sha u lum Seïon bad sha nongbah jong U Blei im , ka kaba kynja bneng , ha kaba la don hajar ki
translation.en: But ye are come unto mount Sion , and unto the city of the living God , the heavenly Jerusalem , and to an innumerable company of angels ,

translation.kha: U la pynshitom jur ïa nga , Bela um shym kpu shah ïa nga ban ïap khait
translation.en: The  Lord  hath chastened me sore : but he hath not given me over unto death .

translation.kha: Ki sei ïa u na ka kali ïapom jong u , ki buh ïa u ha ka ïapom kali kaba kaba ar u don hangta , bad ki kit ïa u sha Jerusalem . Hangta u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem . Baroh ki paid Judah bad Jerusalem ki ïambriew namar ka jingïap jong u .
translation.en: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot , and put him in the second chariot that he had  ; and they brought him to Jerusalem , and he died , and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers . And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah .
Moreover his mother made him a little coat , and brought it to him from year to year , when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice .
translation.kha: Man ka snem ka kmie jong u ka ju thain ïa u ka jaiñkup kaba rit , bad ka ju leit rah ïa ka haba ka leit lang bad la u tnga ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh kaba man ka snem .

translation.en: And I will execute judgments upon Moab  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka Moab , bad kin ïoh tip ba nga long U  Trai .
Uwei ki na u la mareh shisyndon , u la shim ïa u spoiñ , u la pynngam ïa u hapoh ka waiñ ka bym bha , u buh ïa u ha tduh u jong dieng , bad la u pyrshang ban pyndih ïa u .
translation.en: And straightway one of them ran , and took a sponge , and filled it with vinegar , and put it on a reed , and gave him to drink .

translation.kha: U Moses Absalom Addi jubab Kaphtorim Ngin ïaleit Rhesa jingïaleh , Meshekh ki khun jong ngi sepngi ki tymmen jong ngi . Ngin sien ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun Ishbah jong tap-lup , lem bad Arni langbrot bad ki ba-itriem , Kuartos ki masi jong ngi , namar ngi dei ban pynlong ka jingkhawai ban pyndonburom ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And Moses said , We will go with our young and with our old , with our sons and with our daughters , with our flocks and with our herds will we go  ; for we must hold a feast unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Lada u briew pdeng lah ban long uba hok da kaba kohnguh ïa jingpynithuh jingong ka hukum , nga long uba bniah jingrem .
translation.en: Concerning zeal , persecuting the church ; touching the righteousness which is in the law , blameless .
Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord s sake : whether it be to the king , as supreme  ;
translation.kha: Na ka bynta U Trai , to pynkohnguh ïa lade ha ki bor synshar baroh : Ha u Patsha uba long ka bor kaba ha khlieh tam ,

Kumta U Trai shah u ïa ki rangbah shipai jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah . Ki la ïa kem u Manasseh , ki pyndait ha jingbnoh u , ki teh ki kynjri ïa u , bad ïalam ïa u sha Babilon .
translation.en: Wherefore the  Lord  brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria , which took Manasseh among the thorns , and bound him with fetters , and carried him to Babylon .
Many daughters have done virtuously , but thou excellest them all .
translation.kha: U da ong ,  Shibun ki kynthei ki long ki tnga kiba bha , hynrei phi long kaba bha tam na ki baroh .
