translation.en: For his God doth instruct him to discretion , and doth teach him .
translation.kha: U tip kumno ban trei ïa ka kam jong u namar U Blei u hikai ïa u .
Naba katto katne por u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u ong la ïa u Herod , Ka long ka bym dei ïa ban me shongkurim ïa ka Herodias !
translation.en: For John said unto him , It is not lawful for thee to have her .

translation.kha: Hadien kane baroh , don tang kawei ban ong : To tiengburom ïa U Blei , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , namar dei ïa kane Hepher jingsngewtynnat la ïongjngum ïa u briew .
translation.en: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter : Fear God , and keep his commandments : for this is the whole duty of man .
Because it entereth not into his heart , but into the belly , and goeth out into the draught , purging all meats ?
translation.kha: namar kam rung sha ka dohnud , hynrei , shapoh ka kpoh jong u bad nangta ka mih shabar na ka met .  ( Ha kaba u ong ïa kane , U Jisu u la pynbna ba baroh ki jingbam ki long kiba bit ban bam . )

translation.en: And it came to pass , when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again , that they sent and called him unto the congregation , and made him king over all Israel : there was none that followed the house of David , but the tribe of Judah only .
translation.kha: Haba ki paid Israel ki ïohsngew ba u Jeroboam u la wan phai na Ijipt , ki khot sngewbha ïa u sha ka jingïalang paidbah bad ki pynlong ïa u , u syiem ki Israel . Tang ka jait Judah kaba ïaisah ban ïaineh bad kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid .
Ki masi bad ki blang jong ki , ki kyrhai ai ka dud , ki la don langbrot ki , ki blang , bad ki masi ruh kiba da kynsai , kew u uba kynsai tam bad ka waiñ kaba bang tam .
translation.en: Butter of kine , and milk of sheep , with fat of lambs , and rams of the breed of Bashan , and goats , with the fat of kidneys of wheat  ; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape .

translation.kha: Hato me lah ban teh lang ïa ki Pleïades , ne pynsynjor ïa ki jingkhum kiba teh ïa u ? Orion
translation.en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades , or loose the bands of Orion ?
For that which I do I allow not : for what I would , that do I not ; but what I hate , that do I .
translation.kha: Ngam shemphang kaei kaba nga leh ; namar ngam leh ïa kaei kaba nga kwah ban leh , hynrei pynban nga leh ïa kaei kaba nga isih .

Namar awria kane ka long kaba shisha , kaba katno Rakkath lah ban pyndep da ka Adar U Khrist ! Lyngba U Mynsiem bymjukut u la aiti ïa lade kum ka jingkñia kaba janai ha U Blei . Ka snam jong u kan pynkhuid ïa ka jingïatiplem jong ngi na ki niam khathynriew rukom ki bymmyntoi , khnang ba ngi lah ban Jehosabad ïa U Blei ïada im riewkyrpang
translation.en: How much more shall the blood of Christ , who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God , purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God ?
And the king commanded Hilkiah , and Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Abdon the son of Micah , and Shaphan the scribe , and Asaiah a servant of the king s , saying ,
translation.kha: bad u ai ïa kane ka hukum harum ha u Hilkaïah , u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , u Abdon u khun jong u Mikaïah , u Shaphan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad u Asaïah , u nongbud jong u syiem :

translation.en: I will seek that which was lost , and bring again that which was driven away , and will bind up that which was broken , and will strengthen that which was sick : but I will destroy the fat and the strong  ; I will feed them with judgment .
translation.kha: Ngan wad ïa kito kiba la jah , ngan wallam pat ïa kito kiba la sakma , ngan sop spaiñ ïa kito kiba la mong , bad ngan pynkhiah ïa kito kiba pang , hynrei ïa kito kiba sngaid bad kiba khlaiñ ngan sa pynjot , namar nga long u nongaplangbrot uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
Mynno Naba dohthang ju ïohi ïa me ba pynroi pang lane ba me don ha ka ïingbyndi , bad ba ngi wan jngoh husiar me ?’
translation.en: Or when saw we thee sick , or in prison , and came unto thee ?

translation.kha: ‘ Pynkloi , phet ban koum im !’ ki ong namarkata ‘ Mareh kum shikatdei kada khlaw ka jingbthah shyiap !’
translation.en: Flee , save your lives , and be like the heath in the wilderness .

Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump , and the fat that covereth the inwards , and the caul above the liver , and the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them , and the right shoulder  ; for it is a ram of consecration :
translation.kha: Ot noh ïa ka khleiñ jong uta u langbrot , ïa u tdong jong u , ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki  nierlang , ïa ka sbiar kaba haneng u dohnud , ïa ki khyllai baroh ar lem bad ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad ïa ka lbong kamon .

translation.en: For it increaseth . Thou huntest me as a fierce lion : and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me .
translation.kha: Lada nga ïoh ïa kano kano ka jingjop , me beh kthong ïa nga kum u sing ; ban pynmynsaw ïa nga me leh wat da ki kambah .

translation.en: Behold , the former things are come to pass , and new things do I declare : before they spring forth I tell you of them .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei kiba nga ïathuhlypa mynta ki la jia shisha . Mynta ngan ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai wat ha shuwa ba kin sdang ban jia .

translation.en: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw , ki la rakhe ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai banyngkong jong ka snem kaba bud .

hangto beh kthong ïa jingïakhaïi da ka rymbai , Adullam sawbthuh , bad dkoh jingpang jingweng bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei Hall sngewtriem ha kaei kaba ki ïohi . Kylleng Tabeel nga pynsakma ïa ki , ki briew kin kyndit bad sngewshyrkhei ha kaei kaba la jia ha ki . Ki briew kin krenbeiñ Maki ki bad pyndonkam ïa ki kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim Pham
translation.en: And I will persecute them with the sword , with the famine , and with the pestilence , and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth , to be a curse , and an astonishment , and an hissing , and a reproach , among all the nations whither I have driven them :

translation.kha: Kaba sah jong bishni histori u Abijah , kaei kaba u kit bad kaei kaba u leh , Kadesh thoh ha Ka Histori jong u Iddo u Nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Abijah , and his ways , and his sayings , are written in the story of the prophet Iddo .

And the first of all the firstfruits of all things , and every oblation of all , of every sort of your oblations , shall be the priest s : ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough , that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kin ïoh ïa kaba bha tam na ki soh nyngkong jong ka jingot bad na baroh kiei kiei kiwei ïa kiba la ainguh ha nga . Man ka por ba ki briew ki shet kpu , kin ai sha ki lyngdoh ïa u kpu banyngkong kum ka jingainguh , bad ki jingkyrkhu jong nga kin neh ha ki ïing ki sem jong ki .

translation.en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name s sake , that he might make his mighty power to be known .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la pynim ïa ki , kumba u la kular , khnang ban pyn-i ïa ka bor bakhraw jong u .
Nangta nga ïohi ïa ka bneng ba , bad la u kulai uba . nongshong ha la khot Uba Uba ka long ka jinglehhok ba u bishar bad u ïaleh ïa ki jingïaleh thma .
translation.en: And I saw heaven opened , and behold a white horse  ; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True , and in righteousness he doth judge and make war .

translation.kha: u khun jong u Jakob , u khun jingpynkha sih Isaak , u khun jong u Abraham , u jingïakynduh jong u sbiar , u khun jong u Nahor ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Jacob , which was the son of Isaac , which was the son of Abraham , which was the son of Thara , which was the son of Nachor ,
Ephraim feedeth on wind , and followeth after the east wind : he daily increaseth lies and desolation  ; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians , and oil is carried into Egypt .
translation.kha: Kaei kaei baroh ba ki paid Israel ki leh naduh mynstep haduh da miet ka long ka bymmyntoi bad kaba pynjot . Ka jingshetkylla bad ki jingleh jubor ki nang jyllei hapdeng jong ki . Ki ïateh jutang bad ka Assyria , bad ki ïakhaïi bad ka Ijipt .
Un long uba khlaiñ — hynrei ym da bor jong u hi . pynlong jingpynjot bashyrkhei bad un jop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u leh . ka jingjot halor rangbah kiba donbor bad ki briew jong U Blei hi .
translation.en: And his power shall be mighty , but not by his own power : and he shall destroy wonderfully , and shall prosper , and practise , and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people .
O  Lord  , correct me , but with judgment  ; not in thine anger , lest thou bring me to nothing .
translation.kha: Pynbeit ïa ki briew jong me , A  Trai  ; hynrei wat leh tyngeh halor jong ngi lane pynshitom ïa ngi haba me bitar ; kata ka lah ban long ka jingkut jong ngi .

Mynta , ha kaba ïadei Adam kaei kaba phi bashaphang Rehoboth shaphang ka pisa ka ban kynshew na ka bynta ban ïarap ïa ki briew U Blei ha Judia ïadat Phi dei ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ïa ki balang ha Galatia jingïadon leh .
translation.en: Now concerning the collection for the saints , as I have given order to the churches of Galatia , even so do ye .

translation.kha: U Abraham u khmih sawdong bad u la ïohi ïa u langbrot uba la sahkut ki reng ha ka bniap . U leit ban rymmiang ïa u jingartatiend bad kñia ïa u kum ka jingainguh thang ha ka jaka u khun jong u stai
translation.en: And Abraham lifted up his eyes , and looked , and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns : and Abraham went and took the ram , and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son .

translation.kha: U la ong ha uwei pat Kren briew , Bud ïa Khrist . Hynrei uta u briew u la Ade , Ko Kynrad , nyngkong to shah ïa nga ban leit phai pat bad ban tep pynsep u kpa jong nga bampong
translation.en: And he said unto another ,  Follow me .  But he said , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently .
translation.kha: A  Trai  me la ai ha ngi ïa ki aiñ jong me bad me la ong ïa ngi ban kohnguh biang biang ïa ki .
To shahshkor , ko ki paid Israel , ïa kane ka leit ontep kaba nga rwai ha phi :
translation.en: Hear ye this word which I take up against you , even a lamentation , O house of Israel .

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la dih khyndiat ka waiñ , Emim la buaid , u law ïa la ki tud bad u thiah lyngkhuit hapoh pa’ ka ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And he drank of the wine , and was drunken  ; and he was uncovered within his tent .

translation.kha: Ngan ai khang nongleh u , artatien iktiar hapoh jong u syiem Epainetos uba hiarpateng jong u Dabid . Un don thnum shabi jong ka jaka Mathaios ; kaei Law u plie , tong don mano mano misteri khang , bad kaei kaba u Hiel , ym don jingtynrah mano ban plie .
translation.en: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder  ; so he shall open , and none shall shut  ; and he shall shut , and none shall open .

When once the master of the house is risen up , and hath shut to the door , and ye begin to stand without , and to knock at the door , saying , Lord , Lord , open unto us  ; and he shall answer and say unto you , I know you not whence ye are :
translation.kha: U kynrad jong ka ïing un khie bad un khang ïa ka jingkhang ; nangta haba phi ïeng shabar bad sdang ban tied ha ka jingkhang bad ong , ‘ To plie ïa ka jingkhang na ka bynta jong ngi , ko kynrad !’ Un jubab ïa phi , ‘ Ngam ithuh ïa phi nangno phi ïawan !’
Une Nongrim paidbah um tip ïa khlam Hukum u Moses , Jingpynïasuk ki long hapoh ka jingtim jong U Blei !
translation.en: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed .
Even those that were numbered of them , were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore .
translation.kha: shihajar laispah hynriewphew san shekel ka rupa ,

translation.en: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod , and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Ki briew ba ïakhleh jaitbynriew kin shong kin sah ha Ashdod . U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pyndem lut ïa kine ki Philistia kiba sarong .

translation.en: Storehouses also for the increase of corn , and wine , and oil  ; and stalls for all manner of beasts , and cotes for flocks .
translation.kha: Nalor kita , u don ki ïing kynshew ba la shna na ka bynta u kew , ka waiñ , bad umphniang Olib , ki sem masi , bad ki jaka set ïa ki langbrot jong u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Israel dwelt in that land , that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father s concubine : and Israel heard it . Now the sons of Jacob were twelve :
translation.kha: Katba u Jakob u dang shong dang sah ha kata ka ri , u Reuben u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka Bilhah , kawei na ki tnga kliar jong u kpa jong u . U Jakob u la tip ïa kata bad u bitar shla . U Jakob u don khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang .
U Jisu u ong ha , Te , to peit ! Ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Receive thy sight : thy faith hath saved thee .

translation.kha: U Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah u la ïa phah u Pashhur , u khun jong u Malkhaïah , bad ïa u Sephanaïah u , lyngdoh u khun jong u Maaseïah , sha nga lem kane bad ka jingkyrpad :
translation.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Malchijah , and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , saying ,
The lion s whelps have not trodden it , nor the fierce lion passed by it .
translation.kha: Ym don sing lane uno uno u mrad bashyrkhei uba ïaid ïa kita ki lynti bakynjah .

translation.en: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain , and spoiled the city , because they had defiled their sister .
translation.kha: Hadien kata ka jingpynïap , kita kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la lute ïa kata ka shnong ban pynhiarkput namar ka jingpynkheiñ burom ïa ka para jong ki .

Hynrei kita ki briew kim shahshkor satia ïa u . Kumta u Lebi u shim ïa la ka tnga bad kliar u buh ïa ka shabar bad ki . Ki pynjahburom da kaba leh sang ïa ka baroh shi miet bad ki khlem sangeh haduh mynstep .
translation.en: But the men would not hearken to him : so the man took his concubine , and brought her forth unto them  ; and they knew her , and abused her all the night until the morning : and when the day began to spring , they let her go .
I shall not die , but live , and declare the works of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan ym ïap ; hynrei ngan im bad ngan pynbna ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh .
la Ki long ki briew ki bym lah ban leh ei ei shuh , kiba tlot palat ban ïa leh kano kano ka kam na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: Yea , whereto might the strength of their hands profit me , in whom old age was perished ?

translation.kha: Naba ym dei da kaba ïohsngew ïa ka Hukum ki ba briew ki don ka jingïadei bad U Blei , hynrei da leh kaba ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .
translation.en: ( For not the hearers of the law are just before God , but the doers of the law shall be justified .
Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar , sweareth by it , and by all things thereon .
translation.kha: Kumta te , haba u briew u smai da ka duwan , u smai da ka bad da baroh ki jingai sngewbha halor jong ka ;
Ki jubab , phi kwah ban shakri bha ïa kine ki briew , ai ïa ka jubab kaba biang ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ki , bad kin ïai shakri hok ïa phi .
translation.en: And they spake unto him , saying , If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day , and wilt serve them , and answer them , and speak good words to them , then they will be thy servants for ever .

translation.kha: Kane baroh kan jia ba ki paid Israel leh pop bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa Blei . Ïano yn kynnoh na ka bynta ka pyrshah ki Israel ? Ka Samaria hi , ka nongbah ! Mano ba shah kynnoh ïa ka jingmane bleithaw ha Judah ? Ka Jerusalem hi !
translation.en: For the transgression of Jacob is all this , and for the sins of the house of Israel . What is the transgression of Jacob ? is it not Samaria ? and what are the high places of Judah ? are they not Jerusalem ?
But as an hired servant , and as a sojourner , he shall be with thee , and shall serve thee unto the year of jubilee :
translation.kha: U dei ban shong bad phi kum u nongtrei bad shakri ïa phi haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .
Nangta u Elijah u ong hangtai Nga don sa tang ma jingpynsngewbha u nongïathuhlypa jong Gershom kyrngah uba dang sah , hynrei ki don sawspah Bethpeor ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong u symboh ringmraw
translation.en: Then said Elijah unto the people , I , even I only , remain a prophet of the  Lord   ; but Baal s prophets are four hundred and fifty men .
It shall not be baken with leaven . I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire  ; it is most holy , as is the sin offering , and as the trespass offering .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kin bam ïa kaba sah baroh . Yn pynlong ïa u kpu ba la shet khlem thiat bad ban bam ha ka jaka bakhuid , ka phyllaw jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . U  Trai  u la ai ha ki lyngdoh kum ka bynta jong ki na kata ka jingainguh bam . Ka long kaba khuid , kumba long ki jingainguh namar ka pop bad ki jingainguh namar ki jingleh palat .

U Syiem Dabid u ong u ha Solomon u khun jong u , To long uba sngewskhem bad uba kut jingmut . Sdang ïa kam ka bad wat ai kano kano ruh kan pynsangeh ïa me . U Trai U Blei , uba nga shakri un don bad me . Un ym iehnoh ïa me , hynrei un don me ryngkat bad tad haduh ba men pyndep ka ïa kam kaba dei ban trei ha ka jong Templ u .
translation.en: And David said to Solomon his son , Be strong and of good courage , and do it : fear not , nor be dismayed : for the  Lord  God , even my God , will be with thee  ; he will not fail thee , nor forsake thee , until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la bitar haba ki ïohi ïa kiei kiei phylla kiba u la leh bad ba ki khynnah ki ha Templ , ïaroh U u Dabid !
translation.en: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did , and the children crying in the temple , and saying , Hosanna to the Son of David  ; they were sore displeased ,

translation.kha: U Moses u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien na sha u syiem Edom . Ki ong Kane khubor ka wan na ki para kur jong phi , kiba ka jait . Phi tip ïa ki jingeh kiba ngi shah ,
translation.en: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom , Thus saith thy brother Israel , Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us :
How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger , and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel , and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger !
translation.kha: Katno kaba kynjah long ka Jerusalem , kaba shisien ka long kaba dap da ki briew ! Shisien la pyndonburom da ka pyrthei , mynta ka long kum ka riewkynthei ; kaba donburom tam na ki nongbah ka la kyllon sha ka jinglongmraw .

Kito kiba la ïohsngew nyngkong ïa ïa-ïeng Khubor Babha kim shym ïohpdiang ïa Berakhaïah ka jingjahthait , jingong ba kim shym la ngeit . Ki don , te poh-ïing Segub pat ïa kiba la shah ban ïohpdiang ïa ka Waw
translation.en: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein , and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief :
And Jesus went into the temple of God , and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple , and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers , and the seats of them that sold doves ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka Templ bad u la beh noh ïa baroh kito kiba ïadie bad kiba ïathied hangta . U la pynkylla khongpong ïa ki miej jong ki nongïapeiñ sbai bad ïa ki jaka shong jong kito kiba die paro ,
ka ka Kishion , ka Ebes ,
translation.en: And Rabbith , and Kishion , and Abez ,

translation.kha: Haba u shem ïa ka , nga ong ha phi phai u kham pyn-ap ïa hir kawei Maw langbrot Eliab ïa ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ki bym shym Admin jah .
translation.en: And if so be that he find it , verily I say unto you , he rejoiceth more of that sheep , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray .

translation.kha: Naba da kumno ki briew kin tip ba me sngewbha ïa une u paidlang diengduh ïa nga lada me men ym leit ryngkat alhia ngi ? mawtylliat jingkajia ryngkat jong nga! bad ngi kan pyn-i ba ngi long kiba hajar na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew la ka pyrthei pjiah
translation.en: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight ? is it not in that thou goest with us ? so shall we be separated , I and thy people , from all the people that are upon the face of the earth .
Lord  , how long shall the wicked , how long shall the wicked triumph ?
translation.kha: Slem haduh katno ki bymman kin ïalehkmen ? Slem haduh katno , A  Trai  ?
Lada phi siew kylliang ïa bha da kaba sniew , da phin ym lah ban beh ïa kaba sniew ka ïing jong phi .
translation.en: Whoso rewardeth evil for good , evil shall not depart from his house .
Thus the  Lord  saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria , and from the hand of all other , and guided them on every side .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa u syiem Hesekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem na ka bor u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria , bad ruh na kiwei ki nongshun jong ki . U ai ba ki briew kin im ha ka jingsuk bad baroh ki ri kiba marjan .
Ki nuti ki kynthei lyngkar ki long ka jingriam kaba shyrkhei .
translation.en: For a whore is a deep ditch  ; and a strange woman is a narrow pit .
Hear diligently my speech , and my declaration with your ears .
translation.kha: Mynta to sngap ïa ki ktien jingbatai jong nga .

Kaei te , ka jingthmu jong ka Hukum ? La bynrap khnang longïing pyn-i sbak kaei basan ka Bartimaïos ka sngewbha kyndok Bani la thmu ba kan neh jingbit ka jingwan uta u nonghiarpateng Pynkhreh u Abraham , ha nangto la pynlong ïa ka jingkular . 40 ka Hukum la aiti da ki angel , lem bad u ba-ijli Pa’ Ong Remalaïah Proberb Resheph .
translation.en: Wherefore then serveth the law ? It was added because of transgressions , till the seed should come to whom the promise was made ; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , Bamaïan pynmatlah ïa ki bun u Sedekaïah bad Bethuel teh bymman u da ki kynjri jingthymmai rah ïa u sha Babilonia .
translation.en: Moreover he put out Zedekiah s eyes , and bound him with chains , to carry him to Babylon .

translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , haba U Trai u pynbeit ïa phi , da shahshkor , bha bad shim ïa ka kum ka jingmaham .
translation.en: My son , despise not the chastening of the  Lord   ; neither be weary of his correction :

translation.kha: Badno phin nujor Lodebar nga ? ong U Trai . Hato don uno uno uba kum ma nga ?
translation.en: To whom will ye liken me , and make me equal , and compare me , that we may be like ?
O our God , wilt thou not judge them ? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us  ; neither know we what to do : but our eyes are upon thee .
translation.kha: Me long U Blei jong ngi ! Pynshitom ïa ki , naba ngim lah leh ei ei ruh em ha khmat jong kane ka kynhun shipai babun paid kaba tur ïaleh ïa ngi . Ngim tip kumno ngin leh , hynrei ngi phai sha me na ka bynta ka jingïarap .
Ym don mano mano hapoh ka kynhun kiba don ka jingdonkam . Kito kiba long trai ïa ki lyngkha , ki wallam ïa ka pisa ba na la ïohpdiang ka jingdie ,
translation.en: Neither was there any among them that lacked : for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them , and brought the prices of the things that were sold ,
Wilt thou judge them , son of man , wilt thou judge them ? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers :
translation.kha: Hato me la kloi ban ai ïa ka jingrai halor jong ki , ko khun u briew ? Te to leh kumta . Pynkynmaw ïa ki shaphang kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki kpa jong ki , ki la leh .
Baroh ki la ïawan hadien jong u bad ki pyrta la , Pynïap ïa u !
translation.en: For the multitude of the people followed after , crying , Away with him .
And wheresoever he shall go in , say ye to the goodman of the house , The Master saith , Where is the guestchamber , where I shall eat the passover with my disciples ?
translation.kha: Bud ïa u sha ka ïing ba un rung bad ong ïa u trai jong ka ïing : ‘ U Nonghikai u ong ,  Hangno ka kamra ha kaba ki synran jong nga bad ma nga ngin ïabam na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ?  ’

translation.en: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them , they could say nothing against it .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym don kano kano kaba ki lah ban ong , namar ba ki la ïohi ïa u briew uba la ïohkhiah uba ïeng hangta lem bad u Petros bad u Ïoannis .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto Jonah the second time , saying ,
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat U  Trai  u la kren ha u Jonah .
Nangta katto katne ngut ki mawshamok ki la ïeng bad ki la jingialeh ïa kane ka jinglamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu suba
translation.en: And there arose certain , and bare false witness against him , saying ,

translation.kha: Die noh ïa jingdon ki jong jingem phi baroh bad ai ïa ka pisa ha duk kiba . Pynbiang lade ïa ki pla kynshew ki ban ym jot noh , bad kynshew ïa ka spah jong phi ha bneng , ha kaba kan ym duna , namar ba ym don u nongtuh uba lah ban ïoh ïa ka , bad ym khñiang don ba lah ban pynjot ïa ka .
translation.en: Sell that ye have , and give alms  ; provide yourselves bags which wax not old , a treasure in the heavens that faileth not , where no thief approacheth , neither moth corrupteth .
Behold , it is written before me : I will not keep silence , but will recompense , even recompense into their bosom ,
translation.kha: Nga la kut jingmut lypa ban pynshitom ïa ki , bad ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa ki la dep buh jingthoh . Ngan ym leh bym ïohi ïa kaei kaba ki la leh , hynrei ngan siew kylliang ïa ki

translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying ,
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane khnang ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kren lyngba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa :
Haba u Moses u la ïohsngew ïa kane , la u sngewhun .
translation.en: And when Moses heard that , he was content .
And I will bring back all the people unto thee : the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned : so all the people shall be in peace .
translation.kha: bad nangta ngan wan ïalam pat ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh sha phi , kum ka nongleitkurim kaba wan phai sha la u jong u tnga . Phi kwah ban pynïap tang ïa uwei u briew ; kiba sah na ki paidbah kin lait im .
Hynrei uno uno uba uta pynni ka khubor basohsat u , pynlwait pynskhem da kane Sargon U Blei jingpynjahburom long uba shisha .
translation.en: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true .

translation.kha: hynrei namar ba u don ka jingduna ha ka met , bit ban wan ka jingkah pyrda kaba kyntang ne ban leit sha jan ka duwan . Um dei pynbit tngit ïa kine ki jaka kyntang jong ; namar nga long U Trai bad pynkyntang ïa ki .
translation.en: Only he shall not go in unto the veil , nor come nigh unto the altar , because he hath a blemish  ; that he profane not my sanctuaries : for I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
For a certain woman , whose young daughter had an unclean spirit , heard of him , and came and fell at his feet :
translation.kha: Kawei ka briew , kaba ka khun jong ka , ka don u mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong ka , ka la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu bad mar kumta hi ka la wan sha u bad ka la dem ha ki kjat jong u .
U Elijah u la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U bad Trai u la leit bad shong harud ka wahduid Kherith .
translation.en: So he went and did according unto the word of the  Lord  : for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith , that is before Jordan .
O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt , furnish thyself to go into captivity : for Memphis shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: To pynkhreh ban shah kem koidi , phi ki briew ka Ijipt ! Ïa ka Memphis yn sa pynlong ka ri shyiap , ka jingjot ha kaba yn ym don ban shong ban sah .

translation.en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity , and shall cut them off in their own wickedness  ; yea , the  Lord  our God shall cut them off .
translation.kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jong ki bad un pynjot ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki ; U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi un pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us , for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans , that they might put us to death , and carry us away captives into Babylon .
translation.kha: U Barukh u khun jong u Neraïah u la pynkhih ïa phi pyrshah ïa ngi , kumta ki nong Babilonia kin ïa-ïohbor halor jong ngi bad ki lah ban pynïap ïa ngi ne ïalam noh ïa ngi sha Babilonia .

Kane ka dei ka por jong ka jingkhih jingmut , ka jingshahjop bad , ka jingkulmar jingmut ha ka Them ka Jingïohipaw , bad U Trai U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh la u ïa phah ka ha ngi . Ïa ki jong kynroh ka nongbah jong ngi la tied pynkhyllem , bad ki jingkyang ban ïoh jingïarap ki la sawa hapdeng ki lum .
translation.en: For it is a day of trouble , and of treading down , and of perplexity by the Lord  God  of hosts in the valley of vision , breaking down the walls , and of crying to the mountains .

translation.kha: Naba ïa ka jingsopkjat u Moses la pule jingïohmap slem bah kyrwoh ki synagog man la ka sngi Sabbaton ïashongkha bad ïa ki ktien jong u la ïalap jingringmraw man ki shnong .
translation.en: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him , being read in the synagogues every sabbath day .
And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon  ; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father : for Hiram was ever a lover of David .
translation.kha: U Hiram , u syiem Tyros u la ju long u paralok jong u Dabid , bad haba u la ïohsngew ba u Solomon u la long syiem hadien jong u Dabid , u kpa jong u , u la phah ki nongkit  tiensyiem sha u .
Ki mawkyrdon ki lam sha ka kamra ka la long shiphew mitar ka pyngkiang bad hynriew ka . La don ar tylli païa , kawei jong ka tyngkong
translation.en: The length of the porch was twenty cubits , and the breadth eleven cubits  ; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it : and there were pillars by the posts , one on this side , and another on that side .

translation.kha: U Trai , Ngan pynkhih thma poh-ïing ha Ijipt bad ngan pynphai ïa u para ïa u para bad u pyrshah u paramarjan . Ki nongbah ba-ïashun kin ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat , bad syiem ba-ïashun ïaksaid ban ïoh ïa ka bor
translation.en: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians : and they shall fight every one against his brother , and every one against his neighbour  ; city against city , and kingdom against kingdom .
In your patience possess ye your souls .
translation.kha: To ïeng skhem , bad phin ri pynim ïa lade hi .

translation.en: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also , and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place , whither he himself would come .
translation.kha: Hadien kane U Jisu u la jied sa hynñiewphew ar ngut ki rangbah bad u la phah ïa ki ar ar ngut , ban leit ha shuwa jong u sha ki shnong baroh bad ki jaka ha kaba ma u , u la mut ban leit .

translation.en: And they have turned unto me the back , and not the face : though I taught them , rising up early and teaching them , yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction .
translation.kha: Ki la phai dien na nga ; bad wat la nga la ïai hikai ïa ki , kim shahshkor bad ïoh jinghikai .

translation.en: And he had in his right hand seven stars : and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword : and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength .
translation.kha: U bat ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki khlur ha ka kti kamon jong u , bad ka waitlam arliang syrti ka mih na ka shyntur jong u . Ka durkhmat jong u ka la long phyrnai kum ka sngi kaba shai ha ka por shiteng sngi .

translation.en: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison  ;
translation.kha: bad ha ka jingdon jong u ha ka mynsiem , u la leit bad ïalap ha ki mynsiem kiba la shah khum .

translation.en: A sword is upon the liars  ; and they shall dote : a sword is upon her mighty men  ; and they shall be dismayed .
translation.kha: Ka Jingïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bashukor jong ka — katno ki long kiba bieit ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki shipai jong ka — katno ki long kiba sheptieng !

translation.en: And she brought up one of her whelps : it became a young lion , and it learned to catch the prey  ; it devoured men .
translation.kha: Ka la pynheh pynsan ïa uwei u khun sing bad hikai ïa u kumno ban behmrad ; u la long u nongbam briew .

translation.en: Now the Egyptians are men , and not God  ; and their horses flesh , and not spirit . When the  Lord  shall stretch out his hand , both he that helpeth shall fall , and he that is holpen shall fall down , and they all shall fail together .
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt kim dei ki blei — ki long tang ki briew . Ki kulai jong ki kim dei kita kiba don ka bor bapalat liam . Haba U  Trai  u trei , ka hima bakhlaiñbor kan khyllem , bad ka hima batlot bor kaba ka ïarap kan kyllon . Baroh ar na ki kin shah pynjot .
Me ïa la , me la ïalam noh ïa ki briew kiba me pyllait im ; da ka bor , la btin ïa ki sha ka kaba kyntang jong me .
translation.en: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed : thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation .

translation.kha: Lada Jingshisha Sarephath sha ka ïing jong ka , phi ïaid ha ka lynti sha ka jingïap . Ban leit shata ka Japhia ban nuti Pethor ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translation.en: For her house inclineth unto death , and her paths unto the dead .
And at the king s commandment they made a chest , and set it without at the gate of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem u hukum ïa ki Lebi ban shna ka synduk na ka bynta ki jingnoh synñiang bad ban buh ïa ka ha ka khyrdop ka Templ .
ha ka jinglong riewblei pynlang ïa ka jingïadei parabangeit ; bad ha ka jingïadei parabangeit pynlang ïa ka . jingieit
translation.en: And to godliness brotherly kindness  ; and to brotherly kindness charity .
And Jesus cried with a loud voice , and gave up the ghost .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingpyrta kaba jam , U Jisu u la ïap .
Nangta ki nongïalam bad ki paidbah ki ong ha ki bad lyngdoh ki nongïathuhlypa Une , u briew u la kren ha ngi ha ka kyrteng jong Trai U U Blei jong ngi ; um dei ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets  ; This man is not worthy to die : for he hath spoken to us in the name of the  Lord  our God .

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong , kumta Da , te , siew sha u Patsha ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong u Patsha , bad siew sha U Blei kaei ïa kaba dei ka jong U Blei .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar s , and unto God the things which be God s .
Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with the best gold .
translation.kha: U phah shna ruh kawei ka khet kaba heh . Shi bynta na ka la tap da ka bniat hati , bad kaba sah pat la tap da ka ksiar nylla .

Pynban , lada ki briew na Makedonia kin wan nga bad bad kin shem ba phim pat long kiba kloi la , katno kan long ka jingpynlehrain ïa ngi — khlem da kren ïa ka ïa jinglehrain phi — naba ngi la shaniah katta ïa phi!
translation.en: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me , and find you unprepared , we ( that we say not , ye ) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingtamsneng nongdie ka phang :22-25 jong ka Jordan la ai ïa Esther longïing kiba sah iakane mishoneri jait set ïaring u Abieser , u Helek , u Asriel , u Shekhem , u Hepher , bad u Shemida . Nangno ki long pyndon khun Lym ksiew shynrang jong u Manasseh , u khun jong u Moserah bad ki long ki khlieh jong ki longïing .
translation.en: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families  ; for the children of Abiezer , and for the children of Helek , and for the children of Asriel , and for the children of Shechem , and for the children of Hepher , and for the children of Shemida : these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families .
For this is the will of God , even your sanctification , that ye should abstain from fornication :
translation.kha: U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban long kiba khuid bad kiba lait phar na ka jingjakhlia ka jingawria .

translation.en: They answered him , Jesus of Nazareth . Jesus saith unto them ,  I am he .  And Judas also , which betrayed him , stood with them .
translation.kha: U Jisu uba na Nasareth ,  ki la jubab .  Dei ma nga  u la ong . U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la ïeng hangta ryngkat bad ki .

translation.en: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire , or that useth divination , or an observer of times , or an enchanter , or a witch ,
translation.kha: Wat kñia ïa la ki khun da kaba thang ïa ki ha ka duwan jong phi ; wat shah ïa la ki briew ban khan , lane ban shat ban kheiñ , lane ban ai myntor ,
liengbah ym dei Nikopolis pynkhie uba la Hormah shukor Hattush den-um ka kynthei iada la shah shukor bad pynkheiñ kyiad ka hukum sti Blei .
translation.en: And Adam was not deceived , but the woman being deceived was in the transgression .

translation.kha: Basniew ïa ka kur Merari la ai khat-ar tylli ki nongbah .
translation.en: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families , which were remaining of the families of the Levites , were by their lot twelve cities .

Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken , and her high gates shall be burned with fire  ; and the people shall labour in vain , and the folk in the fire , and they shall be weary .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kynroh bakhlaiñ jong ka Babilon yn pyntwa haduh khyndew , bad ïa ki khyrdop bajrong jong ka yn thang noh . Ka jingtrei jong ki jaitbynriew baroh kam long ei ei ; ki jingpyrshang jong ki , ki kut ha ka ding . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh nga la kren .

translation.en: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day , and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men  ; all these drew the sword .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka sien kaba ar ki Benjamin ki wan mih na Gibeah , bad ha kane ka sien ki pynïap khatphra hajar ngut ki shipai batbit ka Israel .

translation.en: Do ye imagine to reprove words , and the speeches of one that is desperate , which are as wind ?
translation.kha: Phi tharai ngam shym kren ei ei hynrei tang ka lyer ; te balei phi jubab ïa ki ktien ka jingkutlad jong nga ?

translation.en: And the field of Ephron , which was in Machpelah , which was before Mamre , the field , and the cave which was therein , and all the trees that were in the field , that were in all the borders round about , were made sure
translation.kha: Da kumta keiñ ka khyndew jong u Ephron kaba ha Makhpelah , kaba don shaphang mihngi na Mamre , ka kylla long ka jong u Abraham . Ka kynthup ïa ka lyngkha , ïa ka krem kaba don hangta , bad ïa ki dieng baroh kiba don hapoh ki pud jong ka .
Haba u duwai , U Blei un jubab u ; un mane ïa Blei da kaba ; U Blei un buh beit shisien pat ïa kiei kiei ka jong u .
translation.en: He shall pray unto God , and he will be favourable unto him : and he shall see his face with joy : for he will render unto man his righteousness .
But every man in his own order : Christ the firstfruits ; afterward they that are Christ s at his coming .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa uwei pa uwei yn pynmihpat kat kum ka jingbuh ryntih : Ïa U Khrist nyngkong eh na baroh ; nangta ha ka jingwan jong u , sa ïa kito kiba dei ki jong u .
La don u uba kyrteng u Joseph na , shnong kaba ha Judia u briew uba bad uba donburom , uba apkhmih ka jong ka Hima U Blei . la u long u dkhot jong ka , shym mynjur bad ka jingrai bad jingleh jong .
translation.en: ( The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them  ; ) he was of Arimathaea , a city of the Jews : who also himself waited for the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: bad un synreit khyndiat ïa ka snam jong ka Buh ka krung jong ka duwan . Ïa ka snam kaba ïa-pakor sah yn pjiar ha Minnith ka Ber . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ban map ïa ka pop .
translation.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar  ; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar : it is a sin offering .
And when they found not his body , they came , saying , that they had also seen a vision of angels , which said that he was alive .
translation.kha: Ki la wan phai pat da kaba ong ba ki la ïohi ka jingïohipaw ïa ki angel kiba la ïathuh ha ki ba u im .
shuwa ba U un thaw ïa ka bad ïa ki pyntha jong ka , ne wat kham ka khyndew kaba nyngkong .
translation.en: While as yet he had not made the earth , nor the fields , nor the highest part of the dust of the world .

For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed  ; and he reared up altars for Baal , and made a grove , as did Ahab king of Israel  ; and worshipped all the host of heaven , and served them .
translation.kha: U tei pat ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ïa kiba u Hesekaïah u kpa jong u , u la pynjot ; u la tei ki duwan ban mane ïa u Baal bad thaw ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah , kumba u Ahab u syiem Israel u la leh . U Manasseh u la mane ruh ïa ki khlur .
Hangta ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong phi , uba la ïa kyrkhu phi , ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem phi jong phin ïabam bad ïalehkmen ha kiei kiei kiba bha kiba phi la trei shitom .
translation.en: And there ye shall eat before the  Lord  your God , and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto , ye and your households , wherein the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee .

translation.kha: Lada ma phi ko syiem phi lehsbun ban ai ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga jingïada download kwah ba ma phi bad u Haman phin long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ïakohnguh kawei Kham ka Eliphelet la shai ka sngi ba ngan pynkhreh na ka bynta jong mian . Ha kata ka por ngan sa ong ïa phi ïa pynkyndeh kaba nga kwah .
translation.en: If I have found favour in the sight of the king , and if it please the king to grant my petition , and to perform my request , let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them , and I will do to morrow as the king hath said .

And Joshua had commanded the people , saying , Ye shall not shout , nor make any noise with your voice , neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth , until the day I bid you shout  ; then shall ye shout .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joshua u la hukum ïa ki briew ban ym risa , lane kren shikyntien ruh tad haduh ba un da ai hukum .
U phah ïa ka lyer ha shuwa u jong kum ka jingshlei kaba kit lut ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ka sar ïa ki sha hima ka jingjot bad u pynkut ïa ki jingthmu basniew jong ki .
translation.en: And his breath , as an overflowing stream , shall reach to the midst of the neck , to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity : and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people , causing them to err .

translation.kha: Phin ïawad ïa nga , hynrei phin ym shem ïa nga Shimrith klong phim mynshem ban ithuh sha kaba ngan Siklag .
translation.en: Ye shall seek me , and shall not find me : and where I am , thither ye cannot come .
And there was a widow in that city  ; and she came unto him , saying , Avenge me of mine adversary .
translation.kha: Bad la don ka riewkynthei ha kata kajuh ka shnong kaba ïai wan sha u bad kyrpad na ka bynta ki hok jong ka , da kaba ong , ‘ To ïarap ïa nga pyrshah ïa u nongïaleh pyrshah jong nga !’
Jied khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , uwei na kawei kawei jait ka ,
translation.en: Take you twelve men out of the people , out of every tribe a man ,

translation.kha: Phi long ki paralok jong Adbeel ! To isynei arsut nga ! jingoh-shrong kti U Blei ka la Kappadokia ïa nga .
translation.en: Have pity upon me , have pity upon me , O ye my friends  ; for the hand of God hath touched me .

translation.kha: Ki wahduid kiba la khleh lang bad ka ïor lem bad thah u ,
translation.en: Which are blackish by reason of the ice , and wherein the snow is hid :

translation.kha: Nangta ar ngut na ki , ki leit Hoshea shapoh ïing , bad u nongïathuhlypa samla u theh pylleng kynshuit jingtriem Olib ha ka khlieh u Jehu , bad u ong ha u , U Trai , U Blei ki jingïohmap u pynbna , ‘ Nga pynsleh ïa me ban long u syiem shongkhia ki briew jong nga , ki Israel .
translation.en: And he arose , and went into the house  ; and he poured the oil on his head , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I have anointed thee king over the people of the  Lord  , even over Israel .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ha ong u Ahimelekh , Hato phi don u sum ne ka waitlam ba phi lah ban ïa ai nga ? Ki hukum jong u syiem ki la pynlong ïa nga ban mih kyrkieh kumne haduh ba ngam don por ban leit ïa shim la ka waitlam lane kano ïa kano ka atiar .
translation.en: And David said unto Ahimelech , And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword ? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me , because the king s business required haste .
He turned their waters into blood , and slew their fish .
translation.kha: U la pynkylla ïa ki wah jong ki sha ka snam bad pynïap ïa baroh ki dohkha jong ki .
U la kylla lieh blaid blaid bad la sheptieng katta katta ba ki khohsiew jong u ki la sdang ban khynñiuh .
translation.en: Then the king s countenance was changed , and his thoughts troubled him , so that the joints of his loins were loosed , and his knees smote one against another .
I will go in the strength of the Lord  God  : I will make mention of thy righteousness , even of thine only .
translation.kha: Ngan ïaroh ïa ka bor jong me , A  Trai  U Nongsynshar ; ngan pynbna ïa ka jingbha jong me , tang ka jong me hi .
Ki la ïasdang Shu ïakren para ma ki : U ong babiang kane namar ngim don kpu .
translation.en: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have no bread .
Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin , but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom phin pyrkhat ïa lade kum kiba la ïap , ha ka jingïadei bad ka pop , hynrei kiba im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei lyngba U Khrist Jisu .
Da shisha katto katne na ngut ki , ki ïalap U ïa Khrist namar ka jingpihuiñ bad ka jingïakajia , hynrei kiwei pat na ka mon kaba khuid .
translation.en: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife ; and some also of good will :

translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka jingsniew ïa Salome syiem ka Ijipt Mathaios Nga lama pynlong syiem ïa me khnang nongïalap pyndonkam ïa me ban pyn-i ïa ka ïateh jong nga bad ban pynphriang ïa ka nam thalab nga ha ka pyrthei baroh Pisgah .
translation.en: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh , Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up , that I might shew my power in thee , and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth .
I therefore so run , not as uncertainly ; so fight I , not as one that beateth the air :
translation.kha: Dei namar kata , nga mareh beit sha ka thong ; dei namar kata balei ba nga long kum nongïakura u bym pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka jingkura jong u .

Kan leit hangta ha ka por janmiet , bad ha ka step babud yn ïalam ïa ka sha kawei pat ka ïing ki kynthei bad buh hapoh ka jingpeit jong u Shaashgas , u ïunukh uba khmih ïa ka ïing ki tnga kliar u syiem . Kan ym leit shuh sha u syiem lymda u sngewtynnat ïa ka ba un phah khot ïa ka da kyrteng .
translation.en: In the evening she went , and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women , to the custody of Shaashgaz , the king s chamberlain , which kept the concubines : she came in unto the king no more , except the king delighted in her , and that she were called by name .

translation.kha: Ki dei ban pynkhuid ïa lade da ka um jingpynkhuid ka ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , te kin sa long kiba khuid Hynrei . lada kim pynkhuid ïa lade ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , kin ym long kiba khuid .
translation.en: He shall purify himself with it on the third day , and on the seventh day he shall be clean : but if he purify not himself the third day , then the seventh day he shall not be clean .

translation.kha: Nangta lumlang ïa u paidbah baroh hangta .
translation.en: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and gave it to them , saying ,  Drink ye all of it  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ka khuri , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , bad u la ai ïa ka ha ki .  To dih ïa ka , phi baroh ,  u la ong ;
Kaba bud , lada uno uno uba bam ïa u dih na ka khuri jong U Trai ha ka rukom kaba pynjahburom ïa U , ma u ma ki long la pynrem ha ka pop pyrshah ïa met bad ïa jong U Trai .
translation.en: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread , and drink this cup of the Lord , unworthily , shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord .

translation.kha: Me long u nongïada jong nga ; balei ba me iehnoh ïa nga ? ba ngan ïaishah shitom na jingshyrkhei ki nongshun jong nga ?
translation.en: For thou art the God of my strength : why dost thou cast me off ? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy ?

translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong , Pynlong ka jingsmai ba phin leh kumta . U Joseph u la pynlong ka jingsmai , bad u Jakob ruh u ainguh hangta ha jingthiah .
translation.en: And he said , Swear unto me . And he sware unto him . And Israel bowed himself upon the bed s head .

translation.kha: U Goliath u kob ïa ki Israel man la ka step bad man la ka janmiet haduh sawphew sngi .
translation.en: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening , and presented himself forty days .

translation.kha: Uwei u don ha ka phang jong ka , u da phai sha Mikhmash bad uwei ka phang bashathie , da phai sha Geba .
translation.en: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash , and the other southward over against Gibeah .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki Israel ,
Kumta ki ki Midian la shahjop ha Israel ki bad kim shym long shuh ka jingma ïa ki . Ka ri ka la don ha ka jingsuk haduh sawphew snem , haduh ba u Gideon u ïap .
translation.en: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel , so that they lifted up their heads no more . And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon .

Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan , and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city : and set thy face against it , and it shall be besieged , and thou shalt lay siege against it . This shall be a sign to the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Shim uwei u khiew nar bad pynïeng ïa u kum ka kynroh hapdeng jong me bad ka nongbah . Phai khmat sha ka nongbah . Ka don ha ka jingshah kerkut , bad dei ma me uba kerkut ïa ka . Kane kan long ka dak ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel .
nongpynïaid ju pyndonkam da u diengtied riewlamler khia ban shoh ïa ki Habakkuk dil ne Berakah ; hynrei u pyndonkam da ki dieng kiba Illyrikom kiba biang ka jingheh .
translation.en: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument , neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin  ; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff , and the cummin with a rod .

translation.kha: Kumta la buh bsiang u Petros ha ka phatok , hynrei ki briew jong ïakyrpad balang ki la duwai jur ha U Blei pynkhriat ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: Peter therefore was kept in prison : but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him .
And ye shall be betrayed both by parents , and brethren , and kinsfolks , and friends  ; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death .
translation.kha: Yn aiti ïa phi da ki kmie ki kpa jong phi , da ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong phi , da ki ba-ha-ïing jong phi , bad da ki paralok jong phi ; bad ïa katto katne na phi yn pynïap .
U dei ban pynphai shi bynta na ka dor ha kaba la thied ïa u kat kum ka jingdon jong snem ki kiba dang sah ,
translation.en: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee , then he shall count with him , and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption .
And Jehoiada made a covenant between the  Lord  and the king and the people , that they should be the  Lord s  people  ; between the king also and the people .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u lyngdoh , u pynlong ïa u syiem Joash bad ïa ki paidbah ban rung sha ka jingïateh jutang bad U  Trai  ba kin long ki briew jong U  Trai  ; u pynlong ruh ïa ka jingïateh jutang hapdeng u syiem bad ki paidbah .

translation.en: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel , whom I commanded to feed my people Israel , saying , Why build ye not me an house of cedar ?
translation.kha: Ha ka jingleit jong nga baroh bad ki paid Israel ngam pat ju ong ha uno uno na ki nongïalam ba nga la thung , balei ba kim shym la tei ïa nga ka templ kaba thaw da ki dieng Kedar .’

Hynrei nalor Rakhe baroh , phi ong re ‘ Nga long uba lui lui , da Rahab Ain Trai un ym bitar sah Beth nga .’ Hynrei ma nga , U Trai Barsillai ngan pynshitom kynjai phi namar jingklim phi len ba phi la leh pop balyngkot
translation.en: Yet thou sayest , Because I am innocent , surely his anger shall turn from me . Behold , I will plead with thee , because thou sayest , I have not sinned .
The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped , and the rain from heaven was restrained  ;
translation.kha: Ïa ki umpohliew shapoh ka khyndew bad ïa ki khyrdop um jong ka suiñbneng la khang noh .

translation.en: And as David came to Ornan , Ornan looked and saw David , and went out of the threshingfloor , and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground .
translation.kha: U Araunah mar ïa-ïohi ba u Syiem Dabid u wan , u la iehnoh ïa ka jaka shoh kew bad u dem rit , bad la ka khlieh kaba kynduh ha madan .
Ha kata U Blei u la mihpaw ha u Solomon bad u kylli , Kaei me ba ngan ai ïa me ?
translation.en: In that night did God appear unto Solomon , and said unto him , Ask what I shall give thee .

translation.kha: Buh ïa ka duwan ksiar ban thang jingiwbih ha khmat Synduk ka ka Jutang , bad wah ïa ka pyrda ka ha jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony , and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Nga ha phi ïa kane ba tip ba phi don ka jingim bymjukut phi kiba ngeit ha U Khun U Blei .
translation.en: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God  ; that ye may know that ye have eternal life , and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God .
And they had breastplates , as it were breastplates of iron  ; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle .
translation.kha: Ïa ki shadem jong ki la tap da kaei kaba i kum ki jingïada shadem da ka nar , bad ka jingsawa kaba mih na ki thapniang jong ki ka long kum ka jingriew jong ki kali kulai thma babun kiba leit tur sha ka thma .
Sawdong ïa ka khet , la don arphew saw kiwei pat ki khet , ha kaba la shong arphew ngut ki nongsharai balang la riam da kaba lieh bad phong ki ksiar .
translation.en: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats : and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting , clothed in white raiment  ; and they had on their heads crowns of gold .
Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies : my house shall be built in it , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la wan phai pat sha Jerusalem ban pyn-i jingisynei ïa ka nongbah . Yn pynïeng pat ïa ka Templ jong nga , bad ïa ka nongbah yn tei pat .
U Trai u la im ïa nga na ka jingïap , la pynsangeh ïa ki ummat jong nga , bad u la sumar ïa nga jingshahjop .
translation.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death , mine eyes from tears , and my feet from falling .
What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee ? for thou hast taught them to be captains , and as chief over thee : shall not sorrows take thee , as a woman in travail ?
translation.kha: Aïu phan ong haba ki briew kiba pha pyrkhat ki long ki paralok jong pha , ki jop ïa pha bad ki synshar halor jong pha ? Phan don ha ka jingpang kum ka kynthei kaba kha khun .
U briew u bym lah ïoh rupa ne ksiar jied da ka dieng ka ban ym pyut . U shem ïa u nongtrei dieng batbit shna ïa ka dur ban ym kyllon .
translation.en: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot  ; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image , that shall not be moved .

translation.kha: Ha kata Nimshi sngi ngan shim khrud me , Nasir Serubbabel bret shakri Shuah khlain , bad ngan Matthat ïa me ban synshar ha ka pynkhleh jong nga sisa Me long uta uba nga shrah jied sait U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la kren .
translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , will I take thee , O Zerubbabel , my servant , the son of Shealtiel , saith the  Lord  , and will make thee as a signet : for I have chosen thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: bad ïa hapoh ha ka ïing u kapten ki nongap phira , ha kajuh ka jaka ha la buh ïa u Joseph .
translation.en: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard , into the prison , the place where Joseph was bound .
The first angel sounded , and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood , and they were cast upon the earth : and the third part of trees was burnt up , and all green grass was burnt up .
translation.kha: U angel uba nyngkong u la put ïa la ka turoi . U phria bad ka ding , ba la khleh lang bad ka snam , ki la hap halor ka khyndew . Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka khyndew la thang duh noh , shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki dieng , bad ïa baroh ki phlang bajyrngam .
ong ha phi ba u Elijah u lah bad ki briew kim shym la ithuh u hynrei ki la ïa u katba sngewbit . Ha kajuh ka kin lehbeiñ ruh U Khun U Briew .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That Elias is come already , and they knew him not , but have done unto him whatsoever they listed . Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them .
These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God  ; that ye may know that ye have eternal life , and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God .
translation.kha: Nga thoh ha phi ïa kane ba phin tip ba phi don ka jingim bymjukut — phi kiba ngeit ha U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: The  Lord  is on my side  ; I will not fear : what can man do unto me ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u don bad nga , ngan ym sheptieng ; u briew un lah leh aïu ïa nga ?

translation.en: And Samuel called the people together unto the  Lord  to Mizpah  ;
translation.kha: U Samuel u khot lang ïa ki briew sha ka jingïalang niam ha Mispah ,
deng ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki la khot kyrpad ïa U Trai , bad u la idonburom ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Then they cried unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he delivered them out of their distresses .
Moreover as for me , God forbid that I should sin against the  Lord  in ceasing to pray for you : but I will teach you the good and the right way :
translation.kha: Ïa nga shimet , U  Trai  um shah da lei lei ba ngan leh pop pyrshah ïa u da kaba sangeh noh ban duwai na ka bynta jong phi . Pynban ngan hikai ïa phi ïa kaei kaba bha bad kaba dei ïa phi ban leh .
Un shim ka umphniang na la ka sla ti bad khyndiat snam jong khunlangbrot bad un tah ka shkor kamon ka tikmie kamon , bad ka jatkmie kamon jong uta u briew ïa yn pynkhuid .
translation.en: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot , upon the blood of the trespass offering :

translation.kha: Wat ym long ka jingshyrkhei ïa nga me ; long ka jaka shngain jong nga haba ka jingjynjar ka wan .
translation.en: Be not a terror unto me : thou art my hope in the day of evil .

translation.kha: Hynrei tharai mynta me pynmong ïa ka met jong u — un ïa tim me markhmat !
translation.en: But put forth thine hand now , and touch his bone and his flesh , and he will curse thee to thy face .
And when they had prayed , the place was shaken where they were assembled together  ; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost , and they spake the word of God with boldness .
translation.kha: Haba ki la dep duwai , ka jaka ha kaba ki la ïakynduh ka la khynñiuh . La pyndap ïa ki baroh da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ki la sdang ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei da ka jingshlur .

translation.en: His ways are always grievous  ; thy judgments are far above out of his sight : as for all his enemies , he puffeth at them .
translation.kha: U riewbymman u jop ha kiei kiei baroh . Um lah ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingbishar U Blei ; u rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nongshun jong u .
Hynrei ka Arsa kam shym ïoh hakpoh na u Jakob ïaiban kumta ka la bishni ïa la ka hynmen , bad ka ong ha u Jakob , Solomon khun ïa jingjahthait Abram lane ngan ïap noh Mei
translation.en: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children , Rachel envied her sister  ; and said unto Jacob , Give me children , or else I die .
And they commanded the people , saying , When ye see the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , and the priests the Levites bearing it , then ye shall remove from your place , and go after it .
translation.kha: bad ong ha ki paidbah ,  Haba phi ïohi ïa ki lyngdoh ba ki bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , loit noh ïa ka jaka shong dara bad bud ïa ki .

translation.en: Such is the way of an adulterous woman  ; she eateth , and wipeth her mouth , and saith , I have done no wickedness .
translation.kha: Ka tnga ka bymïaineh ka leh kumne : ka klim , ka sum , bad ka ong ,  Hynrei ngam shym leh ei ei ka bymdei !

translation.en: Male and female created he them  ; and blessed them , and called their name Adam , in the day when they were created .
translation.kha: Shynrang bad kynthei u la thaw ïa ki , U la kyrkhu ïa ki , bad u la kyrteng ïa ki ,  Ki Briew . )

translation.en: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life , all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow ? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun ?
translation.kha: Kumno uno uno u lah ban tip kaei kaba bha ïa ngi ha kane ka jingim jong ngi kaba lyngkot bad ka bymmyntoi — ka jingim kaba ïaid kum ka syrngiew ? Kumno ngi lah ban tip aïu kan jia ha ka pyrthei hadien ba ngi la ïap ?

translation.en: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion , and shall flow together to the goodness of the  Lord  , for wheat , and for wine , and for oil , and for the young of the flock and of the herd : and their soul shall be as a watered garden  ; and they shall not sorrow any more at all .
translation.kha: Kin wan bad rwai da ka jingkmen ha u lum Seïon bad kin kmen ha ki jingai sngewbha jong nga — ki jingai sngewbha da u kew bad ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib , ki jingai sngewbha da ki langbrot bad ki masi . Kin long kum ka kper bad la ai um bha ; kin don baroh kat kaba ki donkam .

translation.en: The king of Kedesh , one  ; the king of Jokneam of Carmel , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Kedesh , ka Jokneam ( ha Karmel ) ,

Kumta ha ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u bnai banyngkong , u Haman u la khot ïa ki jong syiem bad u la pule ki kin bud ïa ka jingpynbna bad ong ïa ki ban pynkylla ktien sha ki jait ktien bad rukom thoh ba la pyndonkam ha ka hima bad sha baroh ki nongsynshar , ki lat bad rangbah synshar . La ha kyrteng jong u syiem Serksis bad shon muhor da ka sati jong u .
translation.en: Then were the king s scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month , and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king s lieutenants , and to the governors that were over every province , and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof , and to every people after their language  ; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written , and sealed with the king s ring .
And the sun was darkened , and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka pyrda ba la wah hapoh ka Templ la pynkad arliang .

translation.en: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah , What have I offended against thee , or against thy servants , or against this people , that ye have put me in prison ?
translation.kha: Nangta nga la kylli ,  Kaei ka kam runar ba nga la leh pyrshah ïa phi lane ïa ki rangbah synshar jong phi lane ïa kane ka jaitbynriew , kaba pynlong ïa phi ban thep ïa nga ha byndi ?

translation.en: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward :
translation.kha: Da shisha phi la ïohsngew ba U Blei ha ka jingaiei jong u , u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kam ban trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi .

translation.en: And when the ten heard it , they were moved with indignation against the two brethren .
translation.kha: Haba kiwei pat ki shiphew ngut ki synran ki la ïohsngew shaphang kane , ki la bitar ïa kita ar ngut shi para .

translation.en: they will come
translation.kha: Kin Sa Wan
Hynrei ban pyn-i ha me ïa ka bor jong nga iohnong nga la shah ba Rangbah dang im , khnang ba yn ïoh pynbna Kishon ka kyrteng jong pyniwbih ha ka pyrthei bunktien kawei .
translation.en: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up , for to shew in thee my power  ; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth .

translation.kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka hukum jong U Trai , khnang ban beh noh ïa ki briew ka Judah na khmat jong u namar ki pop baroh kiba u syiem Manasseh u la leh ,
translation.en: Surely at the commandment of the  Lord  came this upon Judah , to remove them out of his sight , for the sins of Manasseh , according to all that he did  ;

translation.kha: Phi ïamihnoh na ka ri Ijipt ha ka sngi u bnai nyngkong , u bnai Abib .
translation.en: This day came ye out in the month Abib .

translation.kha: Balei phi ïa kane ? Ngi ngi long tang ki briew kiba ma phi ! Ngi don hangne ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha , ban pynphai noh ïa phi na kine kiei kiei ki bymmyntoi sha U Blei uba im , uba la thaw ïa ka duriaw , bad ïa baroh kat kaba don ha ki .
translation.en: And saying , Sirs , why do ye these things ? We also are men of like passions with you , and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God , which made heaven , and earth , and the sea , and all things that are therein :
And there came a fear on all : and they glorified God , saying , That a great prophet is risen up among us  ; and , That God hath visited his people .
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki baroh da ka jingsheptieng bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei .  U nongïathuhlypa uba khraw u la mihpaw hapdeng jong ngi !  ki la ong ;  U Blei u la wan ban pynim ïa ki briew jong u !
Un buh bad u ïa ka kata kitab bad un pule na ka synñia , sngi ba un tip ban tiengburom ïa U Trai kohnguh bad hok ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba la thoh hangta .
translation.en: And it shall be with him , and he shall read therein all the days of his life : that he may learn to fear the  Lord  his God , to keep all the words of this law and these statutes , to do them :
So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee , where he made the water wine . And there was a certain nobleman , whose son was sick at Capernaum .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u leit biang sha Kana ha Galilaïa , ha kaba u la pynkylla waiñ ïa ka um . Uwei u rangbah synshar ka sorkar u la don hangta uba u khun jong u , u la pang , ha Kapernam .
kitkhlieh Ishar ïa ki paid Israel kum u slap ha ka dewryngkhiang . Kin phuh kum ki myrsiang ; jingsyllad suhthied skhem kum ki dieng ha Lebanon .
translation.en: I will be as the dew unto Israel : he shall grow as the lily , and cast forth his roots as Lebanon .
The house of the wicked shall be overthrown : but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish .
translation.kha: Ka ïing jong u briew uba bha kan dang ïeng hi hadien ba la pynjot ïa ka ïing jong u nongleh ïa kaba sniew .
Nga long u shakri jong me , ko Trai ; nga shakri ïa me , kumba ka jong kmie ka nga la leh . Me la pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingïap .
translation.en: O  Lord  , truly I am thy servant  ; I am thy servant , and the son of thine handmaid : thou hast loosed my bonds .

translation.kha: Ki Adnah nongïaleh jong ka Teman kin kyiuh , bad ïa uwei pa uwei u shipai ha Edom yn pynïap .
translation.en: And thy mighty men , O Teman , shall be dismayed , to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter .

translation.kha: Kumta jingoh-shrong ka threw u Soitan ka phiah ha ki kynhun ksai kan thir lah ban neh , hynrei kan kyllon noh bad poi sha ka jingkut .
translation.en: And if Satan rise up against himself , and be divided , he cannot stand , but hath an end .

translation.kha: Uta u rangbah u ïa u Philip , To ïathuh ïa nga , shaphang jongno u nongïathuhlypa u kren ïa kane ? Shaphang ïa lade ne shaphang uwei pat ?
translation.en: And the eunuch answered Philip , and said , I pray thee , of whom speaketh the prophet this ? of himself , or of some other man ?

translation.kha: U shna ruh laispah tylli ki stieh kiba kham rit bad ar kilo ka ksiar ka leit lawbah kawei kawei ka ïawan . U phah buh ïa kine ki stieh baroh ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon .
translation.en: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold  ; three pound of gold went to one shield : and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon .
And I heard the angel of the waters say , Thou art righteous , O Lord , which art , and wast , and shalt be , because thou hast judged thus .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa u angel uba dei khmih ïa ki um ba u ong ,  Ki jingbishar kiba me la pynlong ki long kiba hok , A Uba Khuid , me uba long bad uba la long !

translation.en: They abhor me , they flee far from me , and spare not to spit in my face .

translation.en: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain , so shall all the heathen drink continually , yea , they shall drink , and they shall swallow down , and they shall be as though they had not been .

translation.en: Am I now come up without the  Lord  against this place to destroy it ? The  Lord  said to me , Go up against this land , and destroy it .

translation.en: For in those days shall be affliction , such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time , neither shall be .

translation.en: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden , and wouldest forbear to help him , thou shalt surely help with him .

translation.en: Observe thou that which I command thee this day : behold , I drive out before thee the Amorite , and the Canaanite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , and the Hivite , and the Jebusite .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Ngan beh noh ïa ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus , katba phi nang tur sha khmat .

translation.en: If ye then , being evil , know how to give good gifts unto your children : how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him ?

translation.en: For the  Lord  hath turned away the excellency of Jacob , as the excellency of Israel : for the emptiers have emptied them out , and marred their vine branches .

translation.kha: U nadong ka por ban kha bad dewbyrtha por ban ïap , jingbna por ban thung bad ka shla ban rat noh ,
translation.en: A time to be born , and a time to die  ; a time to plant , and a time to pluck up that which is planted  ;

translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la bashalak , jingkyllon ïa ki hukum kiba Leummim pashait bad wat bud ïa ki rukom im jong kito ki briew kiba shong Them Tep ka ri ha shuwa jong phi Berothai bad wat pynbyrsieh ruh ïa lade pynthame kaba leh ïa Pynkup kano na kine ki kam . jingneit long U Trai U Blei jong phi kiar
translation.en: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance , that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs , which were committed before you , and that ye defile not yourselves therein : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.en: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled , and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down , and the  Lord  alone shall be exalted in that day .

translation.en: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion , to give unto them beauty for ashes , the oil of joy for mourning , the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness  ; that they might be called trees of righteousness , the planting of the  Lord  , that he might be glorified .

translation.en: Wherefore thou art great , O  Lord  God : for there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .

translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki paidbah ,  Pynkhuid ïa lade , namar lashai U  Trai  un leh ki kambah hapdeng jong phi .

ba me pynïap ïa la ki briew ha ka ri khlaw ba namar mem lah ban ïalam ïa ki sha kata ka ri ïa kaba me la kular ai ban ha ki .
translation.en: Because the  Lord  was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them , therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness .

translation.en: And they remembered his words ,

Naba Ïoannis u u long uba uta ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong : ‘ U Blei u la ong , ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien ha shuwa jong me ban plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong me .’
translation.en: This is he , of whom it is written , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .
For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba ai khublei da ka jingsuk , u kylla long uba ïatreilang ha ki kam sniew ba u leh .

translation.en: But all that heard him were amazed , and said  ; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem , and came hither for that intent , that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests ?

translation.en: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die : and he called his son Joseph , and said unto him , If now I have found grace in thy sight , put , I pray thee , thy hand under my thigh , and deal kindly and truly with me  ; bury me not , I pray thee , in Egypt :

Shu shim nuksa ïa ki jingput jingtem ki bym don jingim kum ka tangmuri ne ka duitara — kumno phin tip ïa ka lymda la sur tem ha ki sur kiba shai ?
translation.en: And even things without life giving sound , whether pipe or harp , except they give a distinction in the sounds , how shall it be known what is piped or harped ?

translation.kha: Ha ka jaka kane , da ka mon balaitluid u kheiñduh noh ïa kaba baroh u don , bad u la shim ïa jinglong ka u shakri . U long kylla u kum u briew , bad u la wanpaw ha ka dur u briew .
translation.en: But made himself of no reputation , and took upon him the form of a servant , and was made in the likeness of men :
And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea , very much , until he left numbering  ; for it was without number .
translation.kha: La don kyrhai eh u kew kat haduh ba u Joseph um donkam shuh ban da thew ïa u — u la long kum u shyiap ka duriaw .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee .

translation.en: Then she saddled an ass , and said to her servant , Drive , and go forward  ; slack not thy riding for me , except I bid thee .

translation.en: Then thy elders and thy judges shall come forth , and they shall measure unto the cities which are round about him that is slain :

pynriam kwah ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum Bashan me Habakkuk to ai ha nga ka kyr-iat bathymmai , namar me long uba hok .
translation.en: Behold , I have longed after thy precepts : quicken me in thy righteousness .

translation.en: And many brought gifts unto the  Lord  to Jerusalem , and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah : so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth .

translation.en: And when they go forth into the utter court , even into the utter court to the people , they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered , and lay them in the holy chambers , and they shall put on other garments  ; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments .

translation.en: Then said they unto him , Where is he ? He said , I know not .

translation.en: And the city had no need of the sun , neither of the moon , to shine in it : for the glory of God did lighten it , and the Lamb is the light thereof .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that every one that is left in thine house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread , and shall say , Put me , I pray thee , into one of the priests  offices , that I may eat a piece of bread .

translation.en: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory ; why yet am I also judged as a sinner ?

translation.en: And he said unto the men of Succoth , Give , I pray you , loaves of bread unto the people that follow me  ; for they be faint , and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna , kings of Midian .
translation.kha: Haba ki poi ha Sukkoth , u ong ha ki rangbah jong kata ka nongrit ,  Sngewbha ai ïa ki rangbah jong nga katto katne ki kpu . Ki la thait ïan , bad nga dang beh ïa u Sebah bad u Salmunna , ki syiem Midian .
U briew uba shong u jubab , Kumno shaphang kine kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa — jong ki , ki dei kiei ? Dei kumta ba la ka jingong , Hato u Saul ruh u long u Nongïathuhlypa ?
translation.en: And one of the same place answered and said , But who is their father ? Therefore it became a proverb , Is Saul also among the prophets ?

translation.kha: bad ngan aiti ha kito kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa ki , ha u Nebukhadnessar , u ka syiem Babilonia bad ka kynhun shipai jong u . Hynrei hadien shen , ki briew kin shong kin sah biang Ijipt ha , kumba ki la leh ha ki por ba la leit . Ma nga , U Trai nga , la kren .
translation.en: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives , and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of his servants : and afterward it shall be inhabited , as in the days of old , saith the  Lord .
And Balaam said unto Balak , Build me here seven altars , and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams .
translation.kha: U ong ha u Balak ,  Tei ïa nga hangne hynñiew tylli ki duwan , bad wallam ïa nga hynñiew tylli ki masi kyrtong bad hynñiew tylli ki langbrot shynrang .

translation.en: Which was the son of Jose , which was the son of Eliezer , which was the son of Jorim , which was the son of Matthat , which was the son of Levi ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Joshua , u khun jong u Elieser , u khun jong u Jorim , u khun jong u Matthat , u khun jong u Lebi ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king had heard the words of the law , that he rent his clothes .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingpule na kata ka kitab , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih

translation.en: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah , and made a king over themselves .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba u Jehoram u synshar , ka Edom ka ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Judah , bad ka la kylla long ka hima kaba laitluid .
