Bun ki briew bad ki jaitbynriew bakhlaiñbor kin wan sha Jerusalem ban mane ïa U Trai Baroh Badonbor bad ban duwai na ka ka bynta jingkyrkhu jong u .
translation.en: Yea , many people and strong nations shall come to seek the  Lord  of hosts in Jerusalem , and to pray before the  Lord .

The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee  ; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet  ; and they shall call thee , The city of the  Lord  , The Zion of the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong kito kiba la banbeiñ ïa pha kin sa wan ban dem khrup ban burom ïa pha . Baroh kito kiba la ju ibeiñ ïa pha kin dem ngon ha ki kjat jong pha . Kin khot ïa pha , ‘ Ka Nongbah U  Trai  ,’ ‘ Ka Seïon , ka nongbah U Blei U Bakhuid ki Israel .’
U Jisu u la jubab Kaei U u kwah phi ban leh ban ngeit ha uta ïa uba u la phah .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  This is the work of God , that ye believe on him whom he hath sent .
They shall be carried to Babylon , and there shall they be until the day that I visit them , saith the  Lord   ; then will I bring them up , and restore them to this place .
translation.kha: Yn sa rah ïa ki sha Babilonia bad kin sah hangta tad haduh ba ngan da phai ka jingmut jong nga sha ki . Nangta ngan wallam pat ïa ki bad buh biang ïa ki ha kane ka jaka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Fear them not therefore : for there is nothing covered , that shall not be revealed  ; and hid , that shall not be known .
translation.kha: Kumta wat sheptieng ïa ki briew . Ïa kaei kaba la kah mynta yn weng noh , bad ïa kaei kaba la buhrieh yn pynpaw .

translation.en: Before their face the people shall be much pained : all faces shall gather blackness .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang wan , uwei pa uwei u sngewshyrkhei ; kawei pa kawei ka durkhmat ka kylla blad .

translation.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous : now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father , and his heavy yoke which he put upon us , lighter , and we will serve thee .
translation.kha: U Solomon u kpa jong phi u la banbeiñ ïa ngi bad u buh ki jingkit kiba khia ha ngi . Lada phi pynsting ïa kine ki jingkit bad pynsuk jingim ïa ngi , ngin long ki shakri bashaniah jong phi .
To phai nga sha mynta bad ban im , ko ki briew baroh kylleng ka pyrthei ! Nga long tang ma nga U Blei .
translation.en: Look unto me , and be ye saved , all the ends of the earth : for I am God , and there is none else .
And he said , When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women , and see them upon the stools  ; if it be a son , then ye shall kill him : but if it be a daughter , then she shall live .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïarap pynkha ïa ki kynthei Hebru , bad phi ïohi ba u dei u shynrang , pynïap ïa u ; hynrei lada dei ka kynthei , ai kan im .

translation.en: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease , neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest : but the  Lord  shall give thee there a trembling heart , and failing of eyes , and sorrow of mind :
translation.kha: Phin ym shongsuk hapdeng kita ki jaitbynriew , bad phin ym ïoh jaka ban kam kum la ka jong ; hangta U  Trai  un pynshong syier , un pynduh jingkyrmen , bad un pynswai mynsiem ïa phi .
Hynrei U Trai u kyrshan ïa nga ; U Blei jong u nga ïada ïa nga .
translation.en: But the  Lord  is my defence  ; and my God is the rock of my refuge .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la poi ha Sidon U Julius u la lehsbun ïa u Paul bad u la shah u ban bad ïa la ki paralok , ba kin ai kat u donkam .
translation.en: And the next day we touched at Sidon . And Julius courteously entreated Paul , and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself .
The night is far spent , the day is at hand : let us therefore cast off the works of darkness , and let us put on the armour of light .
translation.kha: Ka miet ka la jan kut , ka sngi ka la jan sdang . To ngin ïasangeh noh na kaba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba long jong ka jingdum , bad to ngin kieng ïa ki atiar ka jingïaleh ha ka jingshai .

translation.en: I will be surety for him  ; of my hand shalt thou require him : if I bring him not unto thee , and set him before thee , then let me bear the blame for ever :
translation.kha: Ngan bahkhlieh da la ka jingim , bad ngan kitkhlieh na ka bynta jong u . Lada ngam wan ïalam pat ïa u sha phi bad buh ïa u ha khmat jong phi , ieh ngan kit pop ma nga shi rta .

translation.en: Consider now from this day and upward , from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month , even from the day that the foundation of the  Lord s  temple was laid , consider it .
translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi ka dei ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba khyndai , ka sngi ha kaba la pyndep ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ . Ha khmih kaei ka ban sa jia naduh mynta .

te Mynta , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong : Nga long u nongshun jong u syiem ka Ijipt . Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ki ksang ti jong u baroh ar tylli — kaba dang bad bha la kaba kheiñ lypa — bad ka waitlam kan hap na ka kti u jong .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and will break his arms , the strong , and that which was broken  ; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand .

translation.kha: Shisien la don ngut ki rangbah kiba la leit sha ka Templ duwai : Uwei u la long u , uwei u long nonglum khajna
translation.en: Two men went up into the temple to pray  ; the one a Pharisee , and the other a publican .

translation.kha: Katto jingbah ngut Mahlah Usal nongaibuit la wallam ïa ki khunlung jong ki ba-dait U Jisu ba un buh ïa ki kti jong u halor jong ki . Ki synran Lym la ïohi ïa ki bad jingkyrduh Gideon kynhied ïa ki naba ki leh kumta bastet
translation.en: And they brought unto him also infants , that he would touch them : but when his disciples saw it , they rebuked them .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Nga bitar ïa kito nongwei kiba ïa ki briew jong , bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki . paid Judah ki long ki jong nga , ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , ngan sumar ïa . Kin long ki kulai thma badonbor jong nga .
translation.en: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds , and I punished the goats : for the  Lord  of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah , and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle .
So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them  ; and the  Lord  delivered them into his hands .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jephthah u jam sha shiliang wah ban ïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad U  Trai  u ai ha u ka jingjop .

translation.en: Jesus Christ the same yesterday , and to day , and for ever .
translation.kha: U Jisu Khrist u long ujuh mynhynnin , mynta bad sha ki bymjukut .

translation.en: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles , and shall be mocked , and spitefully entreated , and spitted on :
translation.kha: Ïa u yn sa aiti noh ha ki Jentil , ki ban ibeiñ ïa u , krenbeiñ ïa u bad bynthiew ïa u .

translation.en: And it was so , that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel , God gave him another heart : and all those signs came to pass that day .
translation.kha: Ynda u Saul u phai ban leit noh na u Samuel , U Blei u buh ha u ka jinglong kaba thymmai . Bad kita baroh kiba u Samuel u la ïathuh ha u ki wan jia long ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: How can you benefit from their visits ?
translation.kha: Kumno phin ïoh jingmyntoi na ka jingwan jong ki ?

Ngam long Nadab bit dor ban ïohpdiang Hall basarong ka jinglehisynei bad ka jingieit baïaineh ba me la pynpaw ha jingïaineh , u shakri jong me . Nga la jingpynmynsaw ïa ka wah Jordan tang bad u diengduh jong nga , ïabun mynta pat nga jingmyntoi wan phai Josis kine ar ki kynhun .
translation.en: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies , and of all the truth , which thou hast shewed unto thy servant  ; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan  ; and now I am become two bands .
And Abner said again to Asahel , Turn thee aside from following me : wherefore should I smite thee to the ground ? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother ?
translation.kha: Sa shisien u Abner u ong ha u ,  Sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa nga ! Balei men pynbor ïa nga ba ngan pynïap ïa me ? Kumno shuh ngan dang nud ban peit ïa ka khmat u Joab u hynmen jong me ?

translation.en: And I , if I be lifted up from the earth , will draw all men unto me .
translation.kha: Ynda la kyntiew ïa nga na ka pyrthei , ngan khring ïa ki briew baroh sha nga .

Ki synran jong ïajan Joab la kylli ïa u , Ko Kemuel bakylluid ka pop bakla kaba la pynlong ïa pynkynmaw langbrot kha matlah ? Hato ka dei ka pop Me shongnia hi ne kyllut jong ki kmie ki kpa pynrieh u jrong
translation.en: And his disciples asked him , saying , Master , who did sin , this man , or his parents , that he was born blind ?

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa shabi ki jong ka Hima ki bneng , kaei kaba me khang ha ka pyrthei yn khang ïa ka ha bneng , bad kaei kaba me ha shah ka pyrthei shah yn ïa ka ha bneng .
translation.en: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven : and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven : and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven .
Two men went up into the temple to pray  ; the one a Pharisee , and the other a publican .
translation.kha: Shisien la don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la leit sha ka Templ ban duwai : Uwei u la long u Pharisi , uwei pat u long u nonglum khajna .

Pynban me la bud ïa ka jingleh jong ki syiem ka Israel bad me ïalam la ïa ki briew ka Judah bad Jerusalem sha ka jinglong shuh bymïaineh ha U Blei , kumba u Ahab bad nongmih ki bujli jong u ki la ïalam ïa ki Israel sha ka jingbymïaineh . Me la pynïap wat ïa la ki para shynrang , long kiba ki rangbah kiba bha kham ban ïa kaba me long .
translation.en: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel , and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring , like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab , and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father s house , which were better than thyself :
Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka por kan poi haba ngan pyndep ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong bad ki paid Israel bad Judah .

translation.en: But thy servants will pass over , every man armed for war , before the  Lord  to battle , as my lord saith .
translation.kha: Hynrei baroh na ngi , ngi la kloi ban leit sha ka thma hapoh ka hukum jong U  Trai . Ngin jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ïaleh , kumba phi la ong .

translation.en: Then took they Jeremiah , and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech , that was in the court of the prison : and they let down Jeremiah with cords . And in the dungeon there was no water , but mire : so Jeremiah sunk in the mire .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la shim ïa nga bad ki la pynhiar ïa nga da ki tyllai shapoh ka pung u khun syiem Malkhaïah , kaba don hapoh ka phyllaw ïingsyiem . Ym don um ha kata ka pung , tang ka ktieh , bad nga la ngam shapoh ha ka .

Ïa u la otsher hadien , bad ka jingotsher ïa ka u la long ka dak ban pyn-i ba namar ka jingngeit jong u , Blei U u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok shuwa ban otsher ïa u . Bad kumta u Abraham u long u kpa ba mynsiem kynja baroh kiba jong ngeit ha U Blei bad ïa kiba la pdiang kum kiba hok da u , wat la ïa ki ym shym la otsher .
translation.en: And he received the sign of circumcision , a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised : that he might be the father of all them that believe , though they be not circumcised ; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also :

translation.kha: Ki la shakri kum nongbishar na bynta paidbah ha ki por baroh , da wallam ïa ki kam kiba eh sha Moses hynrei ki bishar hi ïa jingïakajia rit
translation.en: And they judged the people at all seasons : the hard causes they brought unto Moses , but every small matter they judged themselves .

translation.kha: Pynban uno uno uba don U Mynsiem , u lah ban bishar ïa ka dor jong kiei baroh , kiei hynrei ym don uba lah ban bishar ïa u .
translation.en: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things , yet he himself is judged of no man .
For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name , because ye belong to Christ , verily I say unto you , he shall not lose his reward .
translation.kha: Nga ong skhem ïa phi ba uno uno uba ai ïa phi ka um ban dih namar ba phi long ha ka liang jong nga , un ïoh da shisha ïa la ka bainong .

translation.en: And the rain descended , and the floods came , and the winds blew , and beat upon that house  ; and it fell not : for it was founded upon a rock .
translation.kha: U slap u la hap , ki wah ki la shlei , bad ka lyer ka la beh jur pyrshah ïa kata ka ïing . Hynrei kam shym la khyllem , namar la tei ïa ka halor u mawsiang .

U Trai un pynshitom ïa ki Israel , bad kan khynñiuh bsein pynkhih Heth u khah ha nard wahduid . Un rat dyngkhong ïa ki paid Israel Ishar kane ka ri kaba bha pynkhyllew u la ai ha ki kpa halor jong Joahas , bad un pynsakma ïa ki sha lyndet ka bthah Ïuphratis , namar ba labasa ïuhbeiñ pynbitar lep ïa Khereth da kaba thaw Hammath ki bleithaw jong ka Probins Asherah .
translation.en: For the  Lord  shall smite Israel , as a reed is shaken in the water , and he shall root up Israel out of this good land , which he gave to their fathers , and shall scatter them beyond the river , because they have made their groves , provoking the  Lord  to anger .
And I will scatter you among the heathen , and will draw out a sword after you : and your land shall be desolate , and your cities waste .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhie da ka thma ban pynsakma ïa phi kylleng kylleng ki ri nongwei . Ka ri jong phi kan sah kynjah , bad ki shnong jong phi kin sah ha ka jingjot .
u don ar ngut ki shynrang : U Mahli u Kine ki ki jait ki Lebi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki
translation.en: And the sons of Merari  ; Mahli and Mushi : these are the families of Levi according to their generations .

translation.kha: Phi phi ruh dei ban long kiba ïaishah . To batskhem ïa ki jingkyrmen jong phi , naba ka sngi jingwan ka U Trai ka la jan .
translation.en: Be ye also patient  ; stablish your hearts : for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh .

translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ban lait na ka jingjynjar to sumar ïa kaei kaba phi .
translation.en: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles .

translation.kha: Kumta u Jonah u la kohnguh Pyrthei U Trai bad jaka Khuid leit sha Ninebeh , ka nongbah kaba heh bat katta katta ba ka la shim por lai sngi ban ïaid lyngba jong ka ïohkynti
translation.en: So Jonah arose , and went unto Nineveh , according to the word of the  Lord . Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days  journey .

translation.kha: Namar uwei u kpu na ngi , wat la ngi long , ngi long kawei met , naba ngi baroh ngi ïoh bynta lem na ujuh u kpu .
translation.en: For we being many are one bread , and one body : for we are all partakers of that one bread .

Then said David to the Philistine , Thou comest to me with a sword , and with a spear , and with a shield : but I come to thee in the name of the  Lord  of hosts , the God of the armies of Israel , whom thou hast defied .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Me wan ïaleh ïa nga da ka waitlam , da u lyngka , bad da u sum , hynrei nga wan pyrshah ïa me ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  Badonbor , U Blei jong ki kynhun ïapom ki Israel , ïa uba me la ñiewbeiñ .

translation.en: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh  ; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet : and Deborah went up with him .
translation.kha: U Barak u la khot ïa ki jait Sebulun bad Naphtali sha Kedesh , bad shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ki la bud ïa u . Ka Deborah ka la leit bad u .

Hynrei haba u shakri jong nga u ka jingïathuh lypa , haba nga phah ïa u ban pynpaw ïa ki jingthmu nga , Nga pynlong ïa kito jingthmu bad ki jingïathuh lypa ban jia Nga ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ba ki briew kin shong biang , bad ïa ki nongbah jong yn sa tei pat . Kito nongbah kin ïeng na ki jingjot .
translation.en: That confirmeth the word of his servant , and performeth the counsel of his messengers  ; that saith to Jerusalem , Thou shalt be inhabited  ; and to the cities of Judah , Ye shall be built , and I will raise up the decayed places thereof :

translation.kha: Ngan leit lang bad me sha Ijipt , bad ngan wan ïalam biang ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me sha kane ka ri . Joseph U ruh don un ryngkat bad me ynda me ïap .
translation.en: I will go down with thee into Egypt  ; and I will also surely bring thee up again : and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes .

And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of David thy father , Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father , nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah ,
translation.kha: U Elijah u nongïathuhlypa u la phah shithi sha u Jehoram , kaba ong kumne harum :  U  Trai  , U Blei jong u Dabid , u kpa tymmen jong me , u pynrem ïa me , namar mem shym bud ïa ki nuksa u syiem Jehoshaphat , u kpa jong me lane ïa ka jong u syiem Asa , u kparad jong me .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Pharaoh , Glory over me : when shall I entreat for thee , and for thy servants , and for thy people , to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses , that they may remain in the river only ?
translation.kha: U Moses u phai ktien ,  Ngan da sngewbha eh ban duwai na ka bynta jong phi . Buh da ka por lano nga dei ban kyrpad na ka bynta jong phi , na ka bynta ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi , bad na bynta ki briew jong phi . Te phin sa lait na kine ki jakoid , bad kin ym don shuh hangno hangno lait sa tang ha ka wah Nile .

Ïa ka baroh thain naduh kawei Geba ha ka phang bashatei shaduh bad Rimmon ha ka phang bashathie , yn pynmadan . Ka Jerusalem kan ïeng halor ka ri jong sawdong ka ; ka nongbah kan kot naduh ka Khyrdop Benjamin shaduh ka Khyrdop Kyndong , ha kaba ju la don ka khyrdop ba-mynshuwa , bad na u Mot Hananel sha ki jaka khñiot waiñ jong u syiem .
translation.en: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem : and it shall be lifted up , and inhabited in her place , from Benjamin s gate unto the place of the first gate , unto the corner gate , and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king s winepresses .
And it came to pass , that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread , two omers for one man : and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynriew , ki ïalum ar shah , saw kilo ïa uwei uwei u briew . Ki nongïalam baroh jong ka kynhun ki wan ïathuh shaphang kata ha u Moses ,

translation.en: The day following , when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there , save that one whereinto his disciples were entered , and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat , but that his disciples were gone away alone  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki paidbah kiba la sah ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw ki la sngewthuh shai ba la don tang kawei ka lieng hangta . Ki la tip ba U Jisu um shym la kiew ha ka lem bad ki synran jong u , hynrei ba ki la leit noh khlem ma u .
Kaei kaba nga hikai ïa phi ka long kaba , bha kumta wat klet ïa ka .
translation.en: For I give you good doctrine , forsake ye not my law .

translation.kha: Ïasam lang ïa ki jingbam jong pyniehnoh bad kiba thngan , bad ai jaka sah ïa kiba khyrwait ki bym don ïing . Ai Rebekka ïa kito ki bym don jaiñ ban phong , bad wat ba-bhabriew ban ïarap ïa la ki jong ki ba-ha-ïing .
translation.en: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry , and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house ? when thou seest the naked , that thou cover him  ; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh ?
When your fathers tempted me , proved me , and saw my works forty years .
translation.kha: Hangta ki la tynjuh bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , ong U Blei , wat la ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ha ki sawphew snem .

translation.en: Then there went certain , and told David how the men were served . And he sent to meet them : for the men were greatly ashamed . And the king said , Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown , and then return .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewlehrain shikatdei ban leit phai sha ïing . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u phah ktien sha ki ba kin sah ha Jerikho bad ban ym wan phai tad haduh ba ki  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , ki da san biang .

translation.en: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth , even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs , when she is shaken of a mighty wind .
translation.kha: Ki khlur ki la hap ha pyrthei , kum ki soh Dumbur bym pat ih na u dieng haba kynther ka lyer kaba jur .

Ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi ! Uba la pynpaw sngewbha katno u eh ïa phi ïa bad pynlong phi u syiem ki Israel . Namar ba U Trai u ieit ïa ki Israel junom , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki khnang ban synshar bha bad bishar hok .
translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee , to set thee on the throne of Israel : because the  Lord  loved Israel for ever , therefore made he thee king , to do judgment and justice .

translation.kha: Mar ïa ïohsngew ïa kane , u Ananias u la kyllon ïap ; bad baroh kiba la ïohsngew shaphang kane ki , la sngewshyrkhei .
translation.en: And Ananias hearing these words fell down , and gave up the ghost : and great fear came on all them that heard these things .
But we see Jesus , who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death , crowned with glory and honour  ; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi da ïohi ïa U Jisu , ïa uba la pynlong shipor kham hapoh ban ïa ki angel , kumta ba lyngba ka jingaiei ka jong U Blei , u dei ban shahïap na ka bynta uwei pa uwei baroh . Mynta ngi ïohi ïa u , ba la pynphong pansngiat da ka burom bad da ka jingpyndonburom namar ka jingïap kaba u la shah .

translation.en: And it shall be our righteousness , if we observe to do all these commandments before the  Lord  our God , as he hath commanded us .
translation.kha: Lada ngi kohnguh hok ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la hukum ïa ngi , u ruh un sngewbha ïa ngi .’
Mynta ko Blei jong ïaktah , ngi ainguh ïa me , Asa Jasper jakoid ïa ka kyrteng kaba donburom jong me .
translation.en: Now therefore , our God , we thank thee , and praise thy glorious name .
And thou shalt be blessed  ; for they cannot recompense thee : for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just .
translation.kha: bad men long uba la kyrkhu , namar kim lah ban siew kylliang ïa me . U Blei un siew pat ïa me ha ka sngi ba ki briew kiba bha ki mihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: And mine eye shall not spare thee , neither will I have pity : but I will recompense thy ways upon thee , and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan ym tyngkai ïa pha , ne pyn-i jingisynei ei ei ïa pha . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha na ka bynta ki kam ba-ijli kiba pha la leh , kumta phan sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Then said they unto him , What shall we do unto thee , that the sea may be calm unto us ? for the sea wrought , and was tempestuous .
translation.kha: Ka  erïong ka la nang jur ha kata ka por , kumta ki maji ki la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei kaba ngi dei ban leh ïa me ban pynsangeh ïa ka  erïong ?

translation.en: For now we live , if ye stand fast in the Lord .
translation.kha: Namar mynta ngi im shisha , lada phi ïeng skhem ha ka ha U Trai .
Ngan Kwah Soh jngai bah ïa ki briew nongïam ngan pynlong kynjah ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And the  Lord  have removed men far away , and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land .
And when I come , whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters , them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la poi , ngan sa ai ïa ki shithi jingpynithuh sha kito kiba phi la mynjur , bad ban phah ïa ki ban leit rah ïa ka jingai jong phi sha Jerusalem .
Hangno ka don ka jingkyrmen jong nga ? Mano ba ïohi ïa nga ?
translation.en: And where is now my hope ? as for my hope , who shall see it ?
And the angel answering said unto him , I am Gabriel , that stand in the presence of God  ; and am sent to speak unto thee , and to shew thee these glad tidings .
translation.kha: Nga long u Gabriel ,  u angel u la jubab .  Nga ïeng ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga ban kren ha me bad ïathuh ha me ïa kane ka khubor babha .
Ki la jop ïa ka ri Kanaan ; me la jop ïa ki briew kiba shong . hangta Me la ai ïa ki briew jong me ka ban bor ïa leh kaba ki sngewbha bad ki briew bad ki syiem ka Kanaan .
translation.en: So the children went in and possessed the land , and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , and gavest them into their hands , with their kings , and the people of the land , that they might do with them as they would .
The proud have forged a lie against me : but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sarong ki la ïathuh lamler shaphang jong nga , hynrei da la ka dohnud baroh nga kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
Kine ki kim briew don ka jingshemphang , hynrei nga shem sngewbha ha ka aiñ jong me .
translation.en: Their heart is as fat as grease  ; but I delight in thy law .

translation.kha: Kum u syiem Jeroboam ha shuwa jong u , u leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai u ïalam ki Israel ban leh pop ; um shym la iehnoh ïa ki lynti bymman .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , which made Israel to sin  ; he departed not therefrom .

translation.kha: Ki la don ruh katne katto tylli ki dohkha rit . U Jisu u la ainguh na ka bynta kine bad u la ong ïa ki synran ban sam ki ïa ruh .
translation.en: And they had a few small fishes : and he blessed , and commanded to set them also before them .

translation.kha: Ki jingumsnam ki la knieh ïa ka Heshbon bad ki ïasylla Shalmaneser shaei ïa ka barabor ki Bithynia . Ïa ka shnong Madmen yn pynsngap Nongsharai ; ki ïaknieh kin tur pyrshah ïa ka .
translation.en: There shall be no more praise of Moab : in Heshbon they have devised evil against it  ; come , and let us cut it off from being a nation . Also thou shalt be cut down , O Madmen  ; the sword shall pursue thee .
For who hath stood in the counsel of the  Lord  , and hath perceived and heard his word ? who hath marked his word , and heard it ?
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Ym don na kine ki Nongïathuhlypa uba tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat barieh jong U  Trai . Ym don na ki uba la ju ïohsngew ne sngewthuh ïa ka khubor jong U ne uba la ju shahshkor ne pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba U ong .

translation.en: But if ye cannot declare it me , then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments . And they said unto him , Put forth thy riddle , that we may hear it .
translation.kha: U Samson u ong ha ki ,  Shah ngan buh ha phi kawei ka jingkyntip . Ngan thong ïa phi uwei pa uwei shi lyngkhot ka jaiñ linen bad laiphew riam ki jaiñ baremdor lada phi lah ban batai ha nga ïa ka jingmut jong ka ha shuwa ban kut kine ki hynñiew sngi jong ka jingkhawai shongkurim .  Ïathuh ha ngi ïa kata ka jingkyntip jong phi ,  ki ong .  To ai ba ngin ïohsngew ïa kata .

translation.en: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate , and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka ri lum Edom ka ri khlaw ; bad ngan pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lynti na ka .

Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , nga la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban thoh sha phi nguh ka jingpynim kaba ngi ïoh lang , haba nga la shem ïa ka jingdonkam ban thoh shisyndon ban pynshlur Kohnguh phi , Hotham ïaleh na ka bynta ka jingngeit Sabad U Blei u dep pynithuh shisien ai ha ki briew jong u .
translation.en: Beloved , when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation , it was needful for me to write unto you , and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints .
And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh  ; who also was gathered after him : and he sent messengers unto Asher , and unto Zebulun , and unto Naphtali  ; and they came up to meet them .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha kylleng ki bynta jong ka jaka ki Manasseh ban khot ïa ki ban bud ïa u . U phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki jait Asher , Sebulun , bad ki Naphtali , bad ki ruh ki la wan ban ïasoh bad u .

translation.en: Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world ? and if the world shall be judged by you , are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba ki briew U Blei kin sa bishar ïa ka pyrthei ? Te , namarkata , lada phi long ki ban bishar ïa ka pyrthei , hato phim long kiba lah ban bishar ïa kiei kiei kiba rit ?
Katba Ain por ka nang ïaid u Joseph , Mih hynmen jingïathuhkhana u ialap Jingkylli sa kiwei pat ruh jong kata ka pateng , Tei la ïap noh Templ
translation.en: And Joseph died , and all his brethren , and all that generation .

translation.kha: Haba uta u pynïaidkam u la ïohsngew , u la leit sha u rangbah ai hukum bad u kylli ïa u , leh aïu ? Utai u briew u dei u traishnong ka Rom ?
translation.en: When the centurion heard that , he went and told the chief captain , saying , Take heed what thou doest : for this man is a Roman .

translation.kha: Uei uba la ju katne ei ei ïa u kynram ba u hap ban siew pat ïa kata ?
translation.en: Or who hath first given to him , and it shall be recompensed unto him again ?

translation.kha: Hynrei kine ki jaitbynriew kim tip ïa kaei U Trai u ha ka jingmut jong u . Kim sngewthuh ba la ïa ki ban shah pynshitom ha kajuh ka rukom ba wanrah ïa u kew ban shoh .
translation.en: But they know not the thoughts of the  Lord  , neither understand they his counsel : for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor .
And I will make with them a covenant of peace , and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land : and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness , and sleep in the woods .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jutang bad ki kaba pynskhem ïa ka jingshongshngain jong ki . Ngan beh noh ïa ki mrad kynsha baroh na ka ri , khnang ba ki langbrot jong nga kin im ha ka jingshngain ha ki jaka phlang bad thiah ha ki khlaw .

translation.en: As the truth of Christ is in me , no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia .
translation.kha: Da ka jingshisha U Khrist kaba don ha nga , nga kular ba ïa kane ka jingsngew sarong jong nga yn ym pynsngap jar hangno hangno ha Akhaïa baroh kawei .

translation.en: Wherefore when he cometh into the world , he saith , Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not , but a body hast thou prepared me :
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw , haba U Khrist u la dei ban wan sha kane ka pyrthei u la ong ha U Blei :  Mem kwah ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki jingainguh , hynrei me la pynkhreh ka met na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: And she made haste , and let down her pitcher from her shoulder , and said , Drink , and I will give thy camels drink also : so I drank , and she made the camels drink also .
translation.kha: Kumta hi ka pynhiar stet ïa u khiew um na la tyrpeng bad ka ong , ‘ To dih , bad ngan ai um ruh ïa ki ut jong phi ba kin dih .’ Kumta nga la dih , bad ka la ai um ruh ïa ki ut .

U Trai u la ong u ha syiem Jehoïakhin , u khun jong u Jehoïakim u syiem ka Judah , Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei Uba im . Wat la me long ka kum sati muhor ha ka kamon kti jong nga , ngan weng noh ïa me ,
translation.en: As I live , saith the  Lord  , though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand , yet would I pluck thee thence  ;

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïa ong ki , Ïa u Nongïathuhlypa la burom ha kylleng lait noh tang ha la ka shnong bad da ki ba-ha-ïing ka bad longïing jong u .
translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  A prophet is not without honour , but in his own country , and among his own kin , and in his own house .

translation.kha: To mane ïa U buhnud , phi aiñ ka pyrthei ! To pyndonburom —Jenesis u , phi baroh jingïadon jaitbynriew ka pyrthei nongbat
translation.en: Let all the earth fear the  Lord  : let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him .

translation.kha: Kawei pat ka thma ka jia ha Gath , kaba ha don u ramhah uba don hynriew tylli ki shympriah kti ha kawei kawei ka kti bad hynriew tylli ki shympriah kjat kawei ha kawei ka kjat . U uba long hiarpateng na ki ramhah mynhyndai .
translation.en: And yet again there was war at Gath , where was a man of great stature , whose fingers and toes were four and twenty , six on each hand , and six on each foot : and he also was the son of the giant .
And we took all his cities at that time , there was not a city which we took not from them , threescore cities , all the region of Argob , the kingdom of Og in Bashan .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ruh ngi ïohknieh ïa ki shnong jong u baroh — ym don kawei ruh kaba lait ; baroh kita ki shnong ki long hynriewphew tylli — ïa ka thain Argob baroh kawei ha kaba u Og u Syiem Bashan u synshar .

Kito kiba long saphred mraw ki dei ban ñiew ba ki kynrad jong ki , ki long kiba kajuh hok ban lyoh ïa ka burom baroh jingïakynduh khnang ba yn ym don mano mano ki ban kren sniew ïa ka kyrteng U Blei bad ïa ka jinghikai khyrdep ngi kmen
translation.en: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour , that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed .

translation.kha: Wat halor thang jong ka ïa ka jingiwbih ba lah khang , ne ïa ka jingainguh da thang ki mrad ne ïa ka jingainguh bam , bad wat theh halor jong ka ïa ka jingainguh kaba ka da waiñ .
translation.en: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon , nor burnt sacrifice , nor meat offering  ; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon .

translation.kha: U jingbuh Sngi u la pyrshang ber Ïakynduhlang ïa ki kyntien pyntngen , hynrei ki ktien kiba u thoh ki long kiba lah ban pynpeit .
translation.en: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words : and that which was written was upright , even words of truth .

translation.kha: Ki la ïa ka jingbitar Trai da ki jingleh jong ki bad ka jingpang bashyrkhei ka la mih jong ki .
translation.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions : and the plague brake in upon them .

translation.kha: Pynphai ïa ki jong phi shawei pat na nga ; ki pynshohbieit ïa nga . U shñiuh jong phi u kum ka kynhun ki blang kiba sha trai jong ki lum ka .
translation.en: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel , and the hair of thine head like purple  ; the king is held in the galleries .

translation.kha: ong Nga ha phi , ngan ym dih shuh na ka kane waiñ tad haduh kata ka sngi ba nga dih na ka waiñ bathymmai ha ka Hima U Blei .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine , until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: Hynrei wat kynthup ïa riewkynthei kiba dang kham samla ha ka namar haba ka doh jong ki ban shongkurim , ki phai noh na U Khrist , bad ki don ka jingpynrem ba ki pynkheiñ ka jingtehkular bad u kaba .
translation.en: Having damnation , because they have cast off their first faith .

translation.kha: Ha ka hukum U Trai u dkhot jong ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa u hukum ïa u la para nongïathuhlypa ban shoh ïa u .
translation.en: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the  Lord  , Smite me , I pray thee . And the man refused to smite him .

translation.kha: Wat ïashongkha khleh bad ki , bad khang ïa ki khun :2 kti juk phi Sibaïah ïashongkha Amal ba-beit ki ,
translation.en: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them  ; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son , nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son .

translation.kha: Wat ki mradkhlaw kin burom :14 nga ; ki myrsiang bad ki ostrit kin ïaroh ïa nga haba rukom pynlong ïa ki wah Martha kin tuid ha ka ri shyiap ban ai Dor ïa ki briew ba la jied jong jingïoh .
translation.en: The beast of the field shall honour me , the dragons and the owls : because I give waters in the wilderness , and rivers in the desert , to give drink to my people , my chosen .

translation.kha: her la tnaw um na ka wahduid bad ki ïadait ki ñiewshiliang kpu Abraham wanrah doh ïa u man nap ka step kyrsum man la ka Hesion .
translation.en: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning , and bread and flesh in the evening  ; and he drank of the brook .

Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , and Shebna , and Joah , unto Rab–shakeh , Speak , I pray thee , to thy servants in the Syrian language  ; for we understand it : and talk not with us in the Jews  language in the ears of the people that are on the wall .
translation.kha: Nangta u Eliakim , u Shebna , bad u Joah ki ïathuh ïa u rangbah synshar ,  Kren ha ka ktien Aramaik ïa ngi , ko kynrad . Ngi sngewthuh ïa ka . Wat kren ha ka ktien Hebru ; baroh ki briew ha ka kynroh ki ïasngap .
Te U u la ai ïa ki jinghikai shuwa ba u Aaron un rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid , da sum , bad nangta un kup ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh ; ka sopti ka lyngkot , jingpanpoh , bad ka jaiñspong .
translation.en: He shall put on the holy linen coat , and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh , and shall be girded with a linen girdle , and with the linen mitre shall he be attired : these are holy garments  ; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water , and so put them on .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka ka ïam , bad u la kumno ba ki briew kiba la lem bad ka , ki ruh ki ïa-ïam ; la ktah ïa ka dohnud jong u , bad la pynkhih u
translation.en: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping , and the Jews also weeping which came with her , he groaned in the spirit , and was troubled ,

translation.kha: Ar sngi hadien pung-um la kha ïa u khun jong nga , ka ruh ka kha nongmane shynrang . Ngi ïadon tang ma ngi ïakhawai ar ngut ha pynhiarkput ka ïing Nikodemos ym don mano mano ba Jasper ryngkat kynoi
translation.en: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered , that this woman was delivered also : and we were together  ; there was no stranger with us in the house , save we two in the house .

translation.kha: Ka waitlam baroh kawei lem bad ka sping ka la shapoh bad ka khleiñ ka ïa ka U Ehud shym la ïa ka ka kpoh jong u bad ka la pei bla shadien , hapdeng ki kjat jong u .
translation.en: And the haft also went in after the blade  ; and the fat closed upon the blade , so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly  ; and the dirt came out .

translation.kha: ka u snieh langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw , ka snieh kaba jlih , bad ka dieng akasia ,
translation.en: And rams  skins dyed red , and badgers  skins , and shittim wood ,
For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine  ; and ye say , He hath a devil .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la wan , bad u la shahjingit bad um dih waiñ , bad phi ong , ‘ U don u ksuid hapoh jong u !’

translation.en: And the children of Gad built Dibon , and Ataroth , and Aroer ,
translation.kha: Ka jait Gad ka tei biang ïa ki shnong ba la ker da ki kut : Dibon , Ataroth , Aroer ,

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward Jerusalem , and drop thy word toward the holy places , and prophesy against the land of Israel ,
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  kyntait ïa ka Jerusalem . Kyntait ïa ki jaka ha kiba ki briew ki mane . Maham ïa ka ri Israel .
U Jisu u la ïohsngew ki bad u la jubab , Ki briew kiba bakhiah ïa u nongsumar hynrei tang kiba pang .
translation.en: But when Jesus heard that , he said unto them ,  They that be whole need not a physician , but they that are sick .

translation.kha: Baroh kiwei pat ki ki nongïathuhlypa ong ïa kajuh . Tur pyrshah ïa ka Ramoth bad sa phin jop , ki ong , U Trai un ai ïa phi ka jingjop .
translation.en: And all the prophets prophesied so , saying , Go up to Ramoth–gilead , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the hand of the king .

translation.kha: Haba ka phai sha mihngi , u pud u suh sha , Bethdagon u da kynjoh ïa ka Sebulun bad ka Them Iphtahel lynti ha ka shaphang shatei sha Bethemek bad Neiel . U bteng shaphang shatei sha ka Kabul ,
translation.en: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth–dagon , and reacheth to Zebulun , and to the valley of Iphtah–el toward the north side of Beth–emek , and Neiel , and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand ,
Do ye thus requite the  Lord  , O foolish people and unwise ? is not he thy father that hath bought thee ? hath he not made thee , and established thee ?
translation.kha: Pleng da kumne mo phi siew kylliang ïa U  Trai  , a , phi ka jaitbynriew kaba bieit bad kaba anna ? Hato um dei u kpa jong phi , uba la thaw ïa phi , uba la seng ïa phi kum kawei ka jaitbynriew ?

translation.en: O  Lord  , there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , ym don uwei pat kum ma me ; ngi tip borabor ba me long tang ma me marwei U Blei .

translation.en: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death : but God had mercy on him ; and not on him only , but on me also , lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow .
translation.kha: Da shisha u la pang bad u la jan ïap . Hynrei U Blei u la isynei ïa u , bad ym tang ïa u hynrei ïa nga ruh , bad u la pyllait ïa nga wat na ka jingsngewsih kaba kham khraw .
U Trai u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ha ki briew jong u , Haba uno uno kyllon u , hato un ym ïeng pat ? uno Lada uno u bakla lynti , un hato ym wan phai pat ?
translation.en: Moreover thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Shall they fall , and not arise ? shall he turn away , and not return ?
And they answered , John the Baptist : but some say , Elias  ; and others , One of the prophets .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki ong ba me long u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ki la jubab ;  kiwei pat ki ong ba me long u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong ba me long uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa .
ngi dei ban nguh ha ka jingpyndem , namar paki lah ban don ka jingkyrmen .
translation.en: He putteth his mouth in the dust  ; if so be there may be hope .

They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains , and burn incense upon the hills , under oaks and poplars and elms , because the shadow thereof is good : therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom , and your spouses shall commit adultery .
translation.kha: Ha ki jaka kyntang ha kliar ki lumbah ki kñia ainguh , bad ha ki lumrit ki thang jingiwbih hapoh ki dieng kiba jrong bad kiba ïar namar ka jingkahtngen jong ki ka long kaba sngewtynnat !  Kaba mih nangta , ki khun kynthei jong phi ki ïaleh nuti , bad ki pyrsa kurim kynthei jong phi ki ïaklim .
Dei ka jingngeit kaba la ïa Moses , haba u la rangbah ban yn khot ïa , u jong ka khun u Pharaoh .
translation.en: By faith Moses , when he was come to years , refused to be called the son of Pharaoh s daughter  ;
And they put his armour in the house of their gods , and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon .
translation.kha: Ki buh ïa ki atiar jong u ha kawei na ki templ jong ki bad wah ïa ka khlieh jong u ha ka templ jong u Dagon u blei jong ki .

translation.en: So the resurrection tells us about Jehovah’s love and undeserved kindness .
translation.kha: Te ka jingpynmihpat ka batai ïa ngi shaphang ka jingieit bad jingaiei jong U Jehobah .
Dei tang ma ki kthaw ki ban rung ha ka Templ jong nga khrai ban shakri ha Lah duwan jong nga , bad Kynthei katkum Demetrios ka Selsah ha ka Templ .
translation.en: They shall enter into my sanctuary , and they shall come near to my table , to minister unto me , and they shall keep my charge .

translation.kha: Naba ngi iaid da jingngeit ka , ym da ka jingïohi .
translation.en: For we walk by faith , not by sight .

translation.kha: U la shem ba Jakob u u la kohnguh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad u la leit sha Mesopotamia .
translation.en: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother , and was gone to Paddan–aram  ;

translation.kha: Mynba nga la don lem shynna sngewbang , nga la ri kyndong ïa ki donkam ka bor ka kyrteng jong me , ka ut kaba me la Pop jinglanot nga . Nga la ïada ishongkun bam , bad ym don uwei ruh na ki uba la jah noh , lait tang u briew uba la dei ban jah — khnang ba Arabah Jingthoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha .
translation.en: While I was with them in the world , I kept them in thy name : those that thou gavest me I have kept , and none of them is lost , but the son of perdition  ; that the scripture might be fulfilled .
And Moses said unto the  Lord  , Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant ? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight , that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me ?
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha U  Trai  ,  Balei keiñ ba me la pynjynjar sat ïa nga katne katne ? Balei ba mem sngewbha ïa nga ? Balei ba me la ai ha nga ka jingkitkhlieh ïa kine ki paidbah baroh ?
khyndaispah la duwai jar jar : tang ki rmiang shyntur jong puson ki khih , hynrei kam shym pynmih sur ei ei . Kumta u Eli la u pyrkhat ba ka la buaid ,
translation.en: Now Hannah , she spake in her heart  ; only her lips moved , but her voice was not heard : therefore Eli thought she had been drunken .
But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him , and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him , that stood before him .
translation.kha: Hynrei um kheiñ kor ïa ka jingai jingmut jong kita ki riewrangbah , bad u leit pynban sha ki samla kiba ïaheh ïasan ryngkat bad u bad kiba long mynta ki nongaibuit jong u .

u jied lai hajar ngut thri rangbah ; khum bat ar hajar ngut na ki bad u 45 Mikhmash jingialeh ha ka ri lum jong ka Bethel “ u phah shihajar jingpynkyntang bad u thang phum julor jong dewryngkhiang sha Gibeah , ha ka thain Benjamin . Ïa kiba sah pat prais phah pynïong sha la ïing .
translation.en: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel  ; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Beth–el , and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin : and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken : for thou hast found grace in my sight , and I know thee by name .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan leh thik kumta kumba me la kyrpad , namar nga tip bha ïa me , bad nga sngewbha ïa me .

translation.en: And when this cometh to pass , ( lo , it will come , ) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki ktien jong me ki wan urlong — bad kin wan urlong shisha — te kin sa tip ba pleng hapdeng jong ki u don u nongïathuhlypa .
Ki briew Gilboa riewdum ki kmen ha la ka jingbieit , hynrei nongpop stad kin leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
translation.en: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom : but a man of understanding walketh uprightly .

translation.kha: u Pilat u la aiti noh ïa Jisu sha ki ïa ka ban sahnarphna . Kumta ki la shimti noh U Jisu .
translation.en: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified . And they took Jesus , and led him away .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Ka jingsawa u shabuk , ka jingriew ki , ka jingsawa jingïaid kulai , jingkynthih jong ki kali ïapom !
translation.en: The noise of a whip , and the noise of the rattling of the wheels , and of the pransing horses , and of the jumping chariots .

translation.kha: To ïambriew na ka bynta kata ka hima , phi shong marjan , phi baroh kiba ka jingpawnam jong ka . To , ‘ Ka jingsynshar bakhrawbor jong ka la pyndkut ; ka burom bad ka bor jong ka kam shuh .’
translation.en: All ye that are about him , bemoan him  ; and all ye that know his name , say , How is the strong staff broken , and the beautiful rod !
And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the first month , in the seventh day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew jong u bnai uba nyngkong ha ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: What were the questions ?
translation.kha: Kiei Kiei Ki Jingkylli ?
katto katne na ki jingthaw ba bneng kynja ki la ïohi kine ba ki samla kynthei ki long kiba bhabriew , kumta ki la shim ïa kita kiba ki la mon .
translation.en: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair  ; and they took them wives of all which they chose .
But without faith it is impossible to please him : for he that cometh to God must believe that he is , and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba lah ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei khlem ka jingngeit , naba uta uba wan sha U Blei u dei ban don ka jingngeit ba U Blei u don , bad ba u ainong ïa kita kiba wad ïa u .

translation.en: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them , which I command thee this day , to love the  Lord  thy God , and to walk ever in his ways  ; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee , beside these three :
translation.kha: te phi dei ban jied sa lai tylli ki shnong . ( Un ai ha phi ïa kane ka ri lada phi leh ïa baroh kaba nga hukum ïa phi ha kane ka sngi bad lada phi ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad im kat kum ki jinghikai jong U . )

translation.en: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat , now walkest thou not charitably . Destroy not him with thy meat , for whom Christ died .
translation.kha: Lada phi pynmong ïa la u parabangeit namar kaei kaba phi bam , te phim leh shuh na ka jingieit . To wat ai ba ka jingbam kaba phi bam kan pynsniew ïa u briew ïa uba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta jong u!
Hynrei shaphang kita bujli angel Bam Blei u la ong , U Blei u la pynlong Tirhakah la ki Akhaikos kum ki lyer , bad ïa ki shakri jong u kum sia thylliej ding .
translation.en: And of the angels he saith , Who maketh his angels spirits , and his ministers a flame of fire .

translation.kha: Nangta sa ïathuh ïa Shahshkor ba ma nga , pynshah Trai Badonbor Baroh Jaser U Blei ki Israel , ngan wallam ïa jingpli shakri jong nga u Nebukhadnessar u Shatei-lam-mihngi ka Babilonia sha kane ka jaka , bad un buh ïa ka khet jong Phong halor kine ki Ithnan kiba me la tep , Jeshaïah un pyiar ïa ka ïingjaiñ jngut dait-thah jong ki .
translation.en: And say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon , my servant , and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid  ; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them .

translation.kha: Shim ar tylli ki mawkordor Karnelian , Jeremaïah thoh ha ki ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki tad pynshoh jong u Jakob ,
translation.en: And thou shalt take two onyx stones , and grave on them the names of the children of Israel :

translation.kha: Uta u briew uba kylla long u bymkhuid un ïaisah u bymkhuid haduh janmiet , hynrei la katta ruh um lah ban bam ïa ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang tad haduh u ba la sum dep .
translation.en: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even , and shall not eat of the holy things , unless he wash his flesh with water .
And he left them , and went out of the city into Bethany  ; and he lodged there .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la mihnoh na ka nongbah sha Bethania , ha kaba u la pynlut ïa ka miet .

translation.en: The Pharisees also came unto him , tempting him , and saying unto him , Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan sha u bad ki la pyrshang ban riam ïa u da kaba kylli ,  Hato ka Aiñ jong ngi ka shah ïa u briew ban pyllait noh ïa ka tnga jong u na ka bynta kano kano ka daw kaba u mon ?

U Trai u ong , Ko Babilon , to hiar noh Lahmam ka khet jong pha , bad shong Thiophilos pynshoi pui pui Borbah’ Khlemlait khyndew .org ba-bieit pha la long kum kaba sotti , ka nongbah bym pat shahjop , hynrei pham long sorkar kaba jem bad ba long jai jai ! Mynta pha ïaryngkat ka mraw !
translation.en: Come down , and sit in the dust , O virgin daughter of Babylon , sit on the ground : there is no throne , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate .

I thank thee , and praise thee , O thou God of my fathers , who hast given me wisdom and might , and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee : for thou hast now made known unto us the king s matter .
translation.kha: Nga ïaroh ïa me bad pyndonburom ïa me , A U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong nga . Me la ai ha nga ka jingstad bad ka jingkhlaiñ ; me la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad me la pyn-i ha ngi kaei ba ngin ïathuh ha u syiem .
hadien kata u la im sa shispah snem khatkhyndai , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translation.en: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years , and begat sons and daughters .
And Gideon came to Jordan , and passed over , he , and the three hundred men that were with him , faint , yet pursuing them .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka por , u Gideon bad la ki laispah ngut ki rangbah ki la wan sha ka wah Jordan bad jam sha shiliang ïa ka . Ki la thait hi ïan , hynrei ki dang beh kthong ïa ki nongshun .

translation.en: Then saith he to his servants , The wedding is ready , but they which were bidden were not worthy .
translation.kha: Nangta u la khot ïa la ki shakri bad u la ong ha ki , ‘ La dep khreh ïa ka jingkhawai jong nga , hynrei ki briew kiba nga la khot sngewbha kim don hok ban ïoh ïa ka .

translation.en: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border : the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee , and prevailed against thee  ; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee : there is none understanding in him .
translation.kha: Kiba ïateh lok bad phi ki la shukor ïa phi ; ki la beh noh ïa phi na la ka ri . Ki briew kiba ïasuk bad phi , mynta ki la jop ïa phi . Kito ki paralok kiba ju ïabam lang bad phi , ki la pynap jingriam ïa phi ; ki ong shaphang jong phi , ‘ Shano kato ka jingstad-buit baroh ba u don ?’

ñiuhmat un weng ïa ka khleiñ jong ka baroh , kumba ju weng ïa ka khleiñ na ki mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad longkmie thang ïa ka ha ka duwan Terah khnang ba ka jingiw na ka kan pynsngewbha ïa U Trai . Ha jew ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew , bad yn map ïa u .
translation.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof , as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings  ; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him , and it shall be forgiven him .

translation.kha: Pynduh khoit kita ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh : ïa ki Hit , ki Amor ki , Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa phi .
translation.en: But thou shalt utterly destroy them  ; namely , the Hittites , and the Amorites , the Canaanites , and the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites  ; as the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee :

translation.kha: u khun jong u Jesse , u khun jong u Obed u , khun jong u Boas , khun u jong u Salmon , u khun jong u Nahshon ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Jesse , which was the son of Obed , which was the son of Booz , which was the son of Salmon , which was the son of Naasson ,

translation.kha: U u la ithuh kita ki tiar , u ong , Ka don ha ka hok . Ngam shym la pyndep ïa ka kamram ha ka — nga dei ban ai ha ïa Shelah u jong nga ka jingshongkurim . Bad u Judah um shym shongkha shuh bad .
translation.en: And Judah acknowledged them , and said , She hath been more righteous than I  ; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son . And he knew her again no more .

translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka la ïohi ba la lap ka ïa kumta , ka la wan da kaba khynñiuh bad ka dem khrup ha ki kjat jong Jisu U . Hangta khmat ha jong uwei pa uwei baroh , ka la ïathuh ïa u balei ba ka la ktah ïa u bad kumno ba la pynkhiah ïa ka shisyndon .
translation.en: And when the woman saw that she was not hid , she came trembling , and falling down before him , she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him , and how she was healed immediately .

translation.kha: Nga tharai ka bha ba ki kot ki don dang , hynrei ki pynsamthiah ia nga .
translation.en: I think it is good that books still exist , but they do make me sleepy .
And the  Lord  said unto me , A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah , and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ki la ïathmu sniew pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And Judas and Silas , being prophets also themselves , exhorted the brethren with many words , and confirmed them .
translation.kha: U Judas bad u Silas , kiba long hi ki nongïathuhlypa , ki la kren slem bad ki , da kaba ai ha ki ka jingpynshlur bad ka jingpynkhlaiñ .
U Trai u jubab ïa u angel da ki kyntien pyntngen ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words .

translation.kha: ki la Emerald noh ïa A burom Thung U Blei bad ka dur jong u mrad uba bam phlang .
translation.en: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass .

translation.kha: Haba kiba duk ki lynñiar , nga ïarap ïa ki ; nga ai jingïarap ïa ki khunswet ki don bym lad shuh .
translation.en: Because I delivered the poor that cried , and the fatherless , and him that had none to help him .

And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria . And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance , and for the people that he had with him , and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth–gilead .
translation.kha: Bun snem hadien , u Jehoshaphat u leit sha ka nongbah Samaria ban leit khmih ïa u Ahab . Ban lehburom ïa u Jehoshaphat bad kito kiba bad u , u Ahab u phah pynïap shibun ki langbrot bad ki masi ban pynlong ka jingkhawai . U pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa u Jehoshaphat ban ïasnohkti lang bad u ha kaba tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .

Nangta u Petros u la wan sha Kper ïathuhlypa bad u la kylli , Ko Trai , lada u hynmen Rephah para jong nga u ïai leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , haduh katno sien Krit dei ban map ïa u ? Haduh hynñiew sien kiar
translation.en: Then came Peter to him , and said , Lord , how oft shall my brother sin against me , and I forgive him ? till seven times ?

translation.kha: Em , ngam saw leh bymdei ei ei ïa nongpruid . Ma taiew uba leh bymdei tuid nga da kaba siat thma pyrshah ïa Anathoth . Jair Trai u long u Nongbishar . Un Jerusalem mynta ka sngi hapdeng ki Israel bad ki Ammon .
translation.en: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee , but thou doest me wrong to war against me : the  Lord  the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: U Krispos , uba Shullam u pynsum jong ka synagog , u la ngeit ha U Trai , Eshan bad ka longïing jong u baroh ; bad kiba bun kiwei pat ki briew ha Korinth ki jinglute ïohsngew ïa miat khubor , ki la ngeit , Pynkyntang la pynbaptis ïa ki trep
translation.en: And Crispus , the chief ruler of the synagogue , believed on the Lord with all his house  ; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed , and were baptized .
Then went out to him Jerusalem , and all Judaea , and all the region round about Jordan ,
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la wan sha u na Jerusalem , na ka probins    baroh kawei jong ka Judia bad na kylleng ka ri kaba hajan ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: And Elijah came unto all the people , and said , How long halt ye between two opinions ? if the  Lord  be God , follow him : but if Baal , then follow him . And the people answered him not a word .
translation.kha: U Elijah u leit sha u paidbah bad ong ,  Sa katno slem ba phin pynbeit ïa ki jingmut jong phi ? Lada U  Trai  u dei U Blei , mane ïa u ; hynrei lada u Baal u dei U Blei , mane ïa u !  Hynrei u paidbah u la shu sngap jar .

translation.en: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness , thou shalt not lack any thing in it  ; a land whose stones are iron , and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass .
translation.kha: Hangta lano lano phin ym thngan , bad phin ym kyrduh ei ei . Ha ki mawsiang jong ka don u nar , bad ha ki lum jong ka lah ban tih tama .

Kñia ïa ki jingainguh Nasareth tin Pynduh ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha kata beit jaka mane Blei ba U Trai dep jied — ym hawei pat ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong phi un ai ha phi . Leh ïa kata ha ka por sep Gaddah , kaba ïadei myllen ka por Sokoh phi mih na Ijipt .
translation.en: But at the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose to place his name in , there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even , at the going down of the sun , at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt .

translation.kha: Haba ka khubor shaphang Hahiroth jingjop ki Israel Pynbiang la poi ha u Jabin u syiem ka Hasor , u phah ktien sha u Jobab u syiem jingmihnoh Madon , nongshetkylla u syiem Gurbaal pynshah bad u syiem ka Akhshaph ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things , that he sent to Jobab king of Madon , and to the king of Shimron , and to the king of Achshaph ,

translation.kha: Hynriew Tirsah kynthih , u la jingktah Sngap ki nierlang jong ka ïingsyiem jong u ha ka jingitynnat marsyndah jingkhraw jong ka .
translation.en: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days , even an hundred and fourscore days .

translation.kha: Kum la shai rashi jingsep phyrngab ki ïohi ba u mot u la kyllon biang ha khmat ka Karka Soko tur . Ha kane ka sien ka khlieh bad ki kti pla u baroh ar tylli ki la dkut jingngeit ki don hamar pynmatlah jingkhang btep sah sa tang ka met .
translation.en: And when they arose early on the morrow morning , behold , Dagon was fallen upon his face to the ground before the ark of the  Lord   ; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off upon the threshold  ; only the stump of Dagon was left to him .

translation.kha: U u Jisu la ong , Ka Hima jong nga kam long na ka jong kane ka , pyrthei lada ka hima jong nga ka long la ka na jong ka kane pyrthei , ki nongbud jong nga kin jin da la ïaleh ban ïada ïa nga na kaba aiti ha ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . Em , ka hima jong nga kam long hangne !
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  My kingdom is not of this world : if my kingdom were of this world , then would my servants fight , that I should not be delivered to the Jews : but now is my kingdom not from hence .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la ai ïa ka jingphla jong ki bad pynbna ïa khubor ka jong U Trai , Petros u bad u Ïoannis ki leit la phai pat sha Jerusalem . Ha lynti ki la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kiba bun ki shnong ha Samaria .
translation.en: And they , when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord , returned to Jerusalem , and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban bam ïa ka ym tang shi sngi ne sngi ar , ne san sngi , ne sngi shiphew , ne wat arphew sngi ruh ,
translation.en: Ye shall not eat one day , nor two days , nor five days , neither ten days , nor twenty days  ;
Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Tyre , and will cause many nations to come up against thee , as the sea causeth his waves to come up .
translation.kha: Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Nga long u nongshun jong pha , ko nongbah Tyros . Ngan wallam ïa kiba bun ki jaitbynriew ban tur ïaleh ïa pha , bad kin wan kum ki jingat phyllung jong ka duriaw .

translation.en: The  Lord  will be terrible unto them : for he will famish all the gods of the earth  ; and men shall worship him , every one from his place , even all the isles of the heathen .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynshyrkhei ïa ki . Un pynhiar ïa ki blei jong ka pyrthei sha ka bym long ei ei , bad kumta kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew kan mane ïa u , kawei kawei ha la ka jong ka ri .
ka Kaei kamram jong ki nongïarap ?
translation.en: What work do the ministerial servants perform for our benefit ?

translation.kha: Keiñ phad kaba rwai da baseisoh pynïapher phiah ; ngam Sharuhen Iim sngap ïa ki duitara jong Pyntrei .
translation.en: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs  ; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols .
Stay yourselves , and wonder  ; cry ye out , and cry : they are drunken , but not with wine  ; they stagger , but not with strong drink .
translation.kha: To long uba mutlop ! To long uba matlah ! To long uba buaid khlem kano kano ka waiñ ! To ïaid sheng sheng khlem dih wat tang shi jaw !
Lada phi pan na nga ïa kano kano ka kyrteng jong , leh ïa kata .
translation.en: If ye shall ask any thing in my name , I will do it .

translation.kha: To ïakhublei iwei ïa iwei da ka jingïathong parabangeit . Jingpynkyntang ki Sobah jong lur Khrist ki phah ki jingkhublei jong ki ïa phi .
translation.en: Salute one another with an holy kiss . The churches of Christ salute you .
But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah  ; we will go up by lot against it  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei ba ngin leh : ngin ïakynting sbai bad ngin jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Gibeah .

Syiem Kynrad , to shim ïa ka , u Araunah u ong , bad to kñia U ha Trai ïa kano kaba kano phi mon . Kine hangne ki masi ban dab thang kum ka jingainguh halor ka duwan ; kine hangne dei ki ki lyngkor jong ki bad ka lyntang shoh kew ban pyndonkam kum ka diengthang .
translation.en: And Araunah said unto David , Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him : behold , here be oxen for burnt sacrifice , and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood .

translation.kha: Kam myntoi ïa me ban shu ïai kren ; basian :6 kaba shai kdar ba mem pynneh ïa kaei kaba me kren .
translation.en: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain  ; he multiplieth words without knowledge .
And the king , and all Israel with him , offered sacrifice before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon bad ki paidbah baroh hangta ki kñia ki jingainguh ha U  Trai .
Ki Stoik ngut ki syiem Amor , pynban , junom! la phet ïap bad rieh hapoh ka krem ha Makkedah Nireus
translation.en: But these five kings fled , and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah .
When they were filled , he said unto his disciples ,  Gather up the fragments that remain , that nothing be lost .
translation.kha: Haba baroh ki la ïakdang , u la ong ha la ki synran ,  To khar ïa ki lyngkhot kiba tam ; ngim dei ban pynsep-ei .

translation.en: For from within , out of the heart of men , proceed evil thoughts , adulteries , fornications , murders ,
translation.kha: Naba na shapoh , na ka dohnud u briew , ki wan ki jingmut basniew kiba ïalam ïa u ban leh ki kam awria , ban lute , ban pynïap ,

translation.en: Haman said moreover , Yea , Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself  ; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba khamtam ïa ka kata ,  u Haman u ong shuh shuh ,  ka Esther , ka mahadei , ka la pynlong ka jingkhawai ym na ka bynta jongno jongno , hynrei tang ïa u syiem bad ïa nga , bad la khot sngewbha biang ïa ngi na ka bynta la shai ka sngi .

translation.en: To whom they all gave heed , from the least to the greatest , saying , This man is the great power of God .
translation.kha: U la kam ba u long uba khraw , bad uwei uwei baroh ha ka nongbah , na ki kyrdan baroh ha ka imlang ka sahlang , ki pynshahshkor kmang ïa u .  Une u briew u long kata ka bor jong U Blei ïa kaba la khot ‘ Ka Borbah’ ,  ki la ong .

To ïalumlang ha ka jingsheptieng , phi ki jaitbynriew To ! , shahshkor phi ki bynta ba sha jngai jong ka pyrthei . Pynkhreh ban ïaleh , hynrei to sheptieng ! Ho-oid to pynkhreh , hynrei to sheptieng !
translation.en: Associate yourselves , O ye people , and ye shall be broken in pieces  ; and give ear , all ye of far countries : gird yourselves , and ye shall be broken in pieces  ; gird yourselves , and ye shall be broken in pieces .

translation.kha: Dei namar kata ba u Manasseh u ïoh shiphew bynta nalor ka Hajan bad ka Sei ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan ,
translation.en: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh , beside the land of Gilead and Bashan , which were on the other side Jordan  ;
He said also unto me , Turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Men dang ïohi ïa ki ïa kiei kiei kiba kham ijli ban ïa kata .
U Hushai u , Ka jingai jingmut u Ahithophel u la ai ha phi ha kane por kam long .
translation.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom , The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time .

translation.kha: Wat kiba bha tam bad tam bahok na ki , ki long ki bymdondor kum ki ñiut . Ka sngi ka la haba poi U Blei un ïa pynshitom ki briew , kumba u la maham ïa ki lyngba ki nongap phira ki , nongïathuhlypa . Mynta ki don ha ka jingkulmar jingmut .
translation.en: The best of them is as a brier : the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge : the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh  ; now shall be their perplexity .
By what way is the light parted , which scattereth the east wind upon the earth ?
translation.kha: Hato me la ju poi sha ka jaka ha kaba ka sngi ka wan mih , lane sha ka jaka na kaba ka lyer mihngi ka beh ?
Kita kin jah noh , hynrei me men ïaisah ; baroh kin sa jot kum jaiñ
translation.en: They shall perish  ; but thou remainest  ; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment  ;
Then thus came every maiden unto the king  ; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king s house .
translation.kha: Haba ka leit na ka ïing ki kynthei sha ka ïingsyiem , ka lah ban riam kano kano ka jingriam kaba ka kwah .
( Uta uba la ïohi ïa ba kane ka jia la u kren shaphang jong ka , khnang ba ma phi ruh phin ïoh ngeit . Kaei kaba u la ong ka long kaba , shisha bad u tip ba u kren ïa ka jingshisha . )
translation.en: And he that saw it bare record , and his record is true : and he knoweth that he saith true , that ye might believe .

translation.kha: Bad mynta balei me pyntud ? ïeng bad ba yn pynbaptis ïa me bad sait noh ki pop jong me da kaba duwai sha u .’
translation.en: And now why tarriest thou ? arise , and be baptized , and wash away thy sins , calling on the name of the Lord .

translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingkyrkhu U Trai kaba pynriewspah ïa phi . Ka jingtrei kan ym lah ban kham pynriewspah ïa phi
translation.en: The blessing of the  Lord  , it maketh rich , and he addeth no sorrow with it .

translation.kha: bad ïa ki musla bad ïa ka umphniang na ka bynta ki sharak , na ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh , bad na ka jingiwbih bynta ka .
translation.en: And spice , and oil for the light , and for the anointing oil , and for the sweet incense .
Butter and honey shall he eat , that he may know to refuse the evil , and choose the good .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba u la rangbah bha ban pynlong ïa la ki jingkut jingmut , ki briew kin dih dud bad bam ngap .

translation.en: And she bare him Zimran , and Jokshan , and Medan , and Midian , and Ishbak , and Shuah .
translation.kha: Ka la kha na u ïa u Simran , u Jokshan , u Medan , u Midian , u Ishbak , bad u Shuah .
Katba ngi nang ïaid sha khmat sha kane shad ainguh , U Trai —Isaïah la beh ïa ki Amor ïabynta kiba shong nongkurup hangne . Kumta ma ngi ruh , ngin Meshullam ïa U Trai , Beri long U i-lub jong ngi .
translation.en: And the  Lord  drave out from before us all the people , even the Amorites which dwelt in the land : therefore will we also serve the  Lord   ; for he is our God .
And I will set my throne in Elam , and will destroy from thence the king and the princes , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki syiem bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki , bad ngan buh ïa ka khet jong nga hangta .
Hynrei ngim kumno pat mynta u la ïoh imat , lymne ngim tip mano ba la pynkoit ïa u na ka jingmatlah jong . Kylli ïa ; u la biang ka rta , bad u ban jubab da lade hi !
translation.en: But by what means he now seeth , we know not  ; or who hath opened his eyes , we know not : he is of age  ; ask him : he shall speak for himself .

translation.kha: Phi jingtngen balei nga la ïalap Khlaiñbor ka ïap! ha phi ha kaba nyngkong ; ka long namar ba nga la pang .
translation.en: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first .

translation.kha: To kmen , ko Israel , namar jinglehniam Nongthaw Horonaim phi ; to shadkmen , ko ki briew Othniel Seïon , na ka shuti pynjop syiem jong phi !
translation.en: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him : let the children of Zion be joyful in their King .

translation.kha: U dei u nongshun jong ki Israel baroh shi lynter jingim u Solomon .
translation.en: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon , beside the mischief that Hadad did : and he abhorred Israel , and reigned over Syria .

That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam , that is beside Zarethan : and those that came down toward the sea of the plain , even the salt sea , failed , and were cut off : and the people passed over right against Jericho .
translation.kha: ka um ka sangeh ban tuid bad ka lang shi jaka , kham jngai na kaba wan tuid ha Adam , ka nongbah hajan ka Sarethan . Ïa ka jingtuid jong ka arsut sha ka Duriaw Baïap la pyndkut , bad u paidbah u la lah ban jam sha shiliang hajan ka Jerikho .

Uwei uwei baroh u dei da sumar bha pyrshah ïa u paralok jong u , ym don uno uno lah ban shaniah ïa u hynmen u para jong u ; namar uwei uwei uba u long uba dap da ka jingshukor Jakob , bad uwei uwei u krenbeiñ ïa ki paralok .
translation.en: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour , and trust ye not in any brother : for every brother will utterly supplant , and every neighbour will walk with slanders .
Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil against thee .
translation.kha: Bad u Mikaïah u pynkut :  Kane ka dei kaei kaba la jia . U  Trai  u pynlong ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi ban lamler ïa phi . Hynrei u hi da lade u la dep rai ba phin ïakynduh ïa ka jingshyrkhei !
Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop ba mihngi sha sha ka phyllaw bashapoh . la U thew ïa ka khyrdop bad ka la heh katjuh kum kiwei pat .
translation.en: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east : and he measured the gate according to these measures .

translation.kha: ka kmen , ka Shilhim , ka Ain bad ka Rimmon : baroh lang ki long arphew khyndai tylli ki nongbah bymkhuid lem bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jong baje ïasylla
translation.en: And Lebaoth , and Shilhim , and Ain , and Rimmon : all the cities are twenty and nine , with their villages :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Kumno lada uwei na phi kawei u don langbrot ka bad ka hap hapoh ka thliew bajylliew ha ka sngi Sabbaton ? Hato phin ym bat ïa ka bad kyntiew ïa ka shabar ?
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What man shall there be among you , that shall have one sheep , and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day , will he not lay hold on it , and lift it out ?
And they caught him , and beat him , and sent him away empty .
translation.kha: Ki nongshimwai ki la kem ïa uta u mraw , ki la shoh ïa u , bad phah kylla ïa u khlem ai ei ei .

translation.en: And he commanded the steward of his house , saying , Fill the men s sacks with food , as much as they can carry , and put every man s money in his sack s mouth .
translation.kha: U Joseph u hukum ïa u shakri bahakhlieh ha ka ïing jong u ,  Pyndap ïa ki byrni jong kine ki briew da ka jingbam , katba ki lah ban kit , bad thep biang ïa ki pisa jong uwei pa uwei na ki ha khlieh ka byrni jong u .

translation.en: His lord answered and said unto him , Thou wicked and slothful servant , thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not , and gather where I have not strawed :
translation.kha: ‘ Me u shakri uba sniew bad uba jaipdeh !’ u kynrad jong u , u la ong . ‘ Me la tip , ym dei , ba nga ot ïa ki jingot na kaba ngam shym bet , bad lum ïa ki jingthung na kaba ngam shym bet symbai ?
U Nangta Trai u ong ïa u Joshua
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , saying ,
For the  Lord  hath chosen Jacob unto himself , and Israel for his peculiar treasure .
translation.kha: U la jied ïa u Jakob na ka bynta ïa lade , ïa ki paid Israel na ka bynta jong u hi .

translation.en: Then take of them again , and cast them into the midst of the fire , and burn them in the fire  ; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta shim biang katto katne na ki , bret ïa ki ha ka ding , bad ai ba yn thang ïa ki . Na ki ka ding kan klang sha ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh kawei .
Uno uno uba leit sha U Trai ban , uno ïaisah hapoh ka jong U Baroh ,
translation.en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty .
And he said unto them ,  This kind can come forth by nothing , but by prayer and fasting .
translation.kha: Tang da ka jingduwai lah ban beh noh kum ïa une ,  u Jisu u la jubab ;  ym don kawei pat kaba lah .

translation.en: And if ye walk contrary unto me , and will not hearken unto me  ; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins .
translation.kha: Lada phi dang ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad phim treh ban kohnguh ïa nga , ngan pynshitom shuh shuh ïa phi sa hynñiew shah .
U Blei jingtngen jubab ïa ka jingduwai ka ailad , bad shisien la punkhun Adullam ka kha ïa u khun ïa-thngian san ïa pynlwait Jakob .
translation.en: And God hearkened unto Leah , and she conceived , and bare Jacob the fifth son .
And they slew a bullock , and brought the child to Eli .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la pynïap ïa uta u masi , ki ïalam ïa uta u khynnah sha u Eli .
Shuwa ba un wan long briew U Jehobah u Shaphir pyndonkam ïa u Jisu kum u “rangbah nongtrei” ha kaba thaw mihnoh kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha bneng bad ha khyndew .
translation.en: Jehovah used the prehuman Jesus as his “master worker” in creating all other things in heaven and on earth .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit phai sha u Balak bad ki ïathuh ha u ba u Balaam um treh wan ban bad ki .
translation.en: And the princes of Moab rose up , and they went unto Balak , and said , Balaam refuseth to come with us .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba shisha ba ngi Siph ha ka pyrthei , hynrei ngim ïaleh na ki jingthmu ba kynja pyrthei .
translation.en: For though we walk in the flesh , we do not war after the flesh :
And Hebron , and Rehob , and Hammon , and Kanah , even unto great Zidon  ;
translation.kha: ka Ebron , ka Rehob , ka Hammon , bad ka Kanah , shaduh Sidon .

translation.en: For he is not a Jew , which is one outwardly ; neither is that circumcision , which is outward in the flesh :
translation.kha: Haba kumta , uei uba dei u Jiw bashisha , ba la otsher shisha ? Ym dei uta u briew uba dei u Jiw ha kaba shabar , uba ka jingotsher ka long ha ka doh .

translation.en: Search the scriptures  ; for in them ye think ye have eternal life : and they are they which testify of me .
translation.kha: Phi pule ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , namar phi pyrkhat ba ha ki phin shem ïa ka jingim bymjukut . Bad kine hi ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki kren shaphang jong nga !
