Ka long kum ka shithi na u kpa u baieit thep mynsiem sha la ki khun .
translation.en: It is like a letter from a loving father to his children .

translation.kha: Nga la shongsuk ha la ka ïing syiem jinglyng-a da bishar lehkmen ïakajia ka jingmanbha bakhraw Khlieh
translation.en: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house , and flourishing in my palace :
For they came up with their cattle and their tents , and they came as grasshoppers for multitude  ; for both they and their camels were without number : and they entered into the land to destroy it .
translation.kha: Ki wan lem bad la ki jingri bad ki dara kumba rben ki kynhun puit . Ma ki lem bad ki ut jong ki , ki bun haduh katta katta ba ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki . Ki wan bad pynjot thiaw ïa ka ri ,

U Karmel da lade hi u hukum ïa ka jingkem ïanguh u Ïoannis , bad Doeg la phah teh kynjri ïa u bad phah set ha ka byndi . U Herod u la leh kamai kane phin ka Herodias , ïa kaba u la lah shongkurim , wat la ka la long ka tnga u para najan u , u Philip .
translation.en: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John , and bound him in prison for Herodias  sake , his brother Philip s wife : for he had married her .

translation.kha: ïa ka jingkyrkhu , lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Trai U Blei jong ïa phi kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ;
translation.en: A blessing , if ye obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , which I command you this day :

translation.kha: Ki briew ba la jied jong badno kin pyndonkam hangto ka kyrteng jong phi ontep ka jingtim . Ma nga , U Trai nongsynshar ngan pynïap ïa phi . Hynrei ngan ai ka jingpynbor bathymmai Thung kito kiba kohnguh ïa nga .
translation.en: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen : for the Lord  God  shall slay thee , and call his servants by another name :

translation.kha: Bad phi ruh phi ïasngewdei ïa kata kaba bha ban .
translation.en: And ye answered me , and said , The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do .
And I will make thee swear by the  Lord  , the God of heaven , and the God of the earth , that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites , among whom I dwell :
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa me ban pynlong ka jingsmai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , U Blei jong ka bneng bad ka khyndew , ba men ym jied ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga na ki briew hangne ha ri Kanaan .
Ki wan ban ïa pynshlur ngi .
translation.en: They come to encourage us .
And Samuel arose , and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin . And Saul numbered the people that were present with him , about six hundred men .
translation.kha: U Samuel u mihnoh na Gilgal bad u leit la ka lynti . Kiba sah na ki briew ki la bud ïa u Saul katba u dang leit ban ïasoh bad la ki shipai . Ki leit na Gilgal sha Gibeah ha ka thain Benjamin . U Saul u leit peit ïa la ka kynhun shipai , kiba don kumba hynriewspah ngut .

translation.en: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors , and brought them forth , and said ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet u angel jong U Trai u la plie ïa ki khyrdop ka byndi , u la ïalam shabar ïa ki apostol , bad u la ong ha ki ,

translation.en: For he is gone down this day , and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance , and hath called all the king s sons , and the captains of the host , and Abiathar the priest  ; and , behold , they eat and drink before him , and say , God save king Adonijah .
translation.kha: Ha kane hi ka sngi u la leit ai jingkñia da shibun ki masi , ki langbrot , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid . U la khot sngewbha ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh , ïa u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong phi , bad ïa u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad mynta hi ki dang ïabam ïadih bad u bad ki pyrta , ‘ Im slem Syiem Adonijah !’
Hynrei ngam khulom satia mangi hok ban jied mano Libni ban shong sha kamon jong nga bad sha kadiang jong nga . Dei U Blei u Lied ai Pynkhreh kine ki jaka ha kito ïa kiba u la pynkhreh ïa ki .
translation.en: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give  ; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared .
And Jesus sat over against the treasury , and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury : and many that were rich cast in much .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang shong hajan ka jaka lum jingkynshew ha ka Templ , u la khmih ïa ki briew katba ki dang pynnoh ïa ka pisa jong ki . Bun kiba riewspah ki la pynnoh shibun ka pisa ;

translation.en: Then the  Lord  rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the  Lord  out of heaven  ;
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , U  Trai  u pynhap ïa u kyndok ding ha ki nongbah Sodom bad Gomorrah ,
U Jisu u dang beh noh ïa u ksuid u bym lah ban kren ; bad haba u u ksuid la mihnoh , uta u briew u la sdang kren ban . Ki paidbah ki la sngewlyngngoh ,
translation.en: And he was casting out a devil , and it was dumb . And it came to pass , when the devil was gone out , the dumb spake  ; and the people wondered .

translation.kha: U Dabid u kylli ïa u , Uei u kynrad jong me , bad na-ei me wan ? Nga dei u nong Ijipt , u mraw jong u nong Amalek , u la jubab U . jong kynrad nga u la iehnoh ïa nga lai sngi mynshuwa namar ba nga kem . pang
translation.en: And David said unto him , To whom belongest thou ? and whence art thou ? And he said , I am a young man of Egypt , servant to an Amalekite  ; and my master left me , because three days agone I fell sick .
And the disciples were astonished at his words . But Jesus answereth again , and saith unto them ,  Children , how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God !
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la sngewkyndit halor kine ki ktien , hynrei U Jisu u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ko khun jong nga , katno ka long kaba eh ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei !
Ki sing , kiba tam khlaiñ na ki mrad baroh bad ki bym tieng ïano ïano ;
translation.en: A lion which is strongest among beasts , and turneth not away for any  ;

translation.kha: kumta nga ong phi : To , bad phin ïohpdiang wad , bad phin shem ; to tied , bad ïa ka jingkhang yn plie na bynta jong phi .
translation.en: And I say unto you , Ask , and it shall be given you  ; seek , and ye shall find  ; knock , and it shall be opened unto you .

translation.kha: Bad kumta to pyntngen iwei ïa iwei pat bad to Seba iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba phi leh mynta .
translation.en: Wherefore comfort yourselves together , and edify one another , even as also ye do .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka nongïaleh Kiei U Jisu u dang duwai marwei , ki synran ki la wan ha u . Ki pynthymmai ki ong ba nga jingsan uei ? U la kylli ïa Khisloth .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he was alone praying , his disciples were with him : and he asked them , saying ,  Whom say the people that I am ?

translation.kha: shna ka rmiang kaba hynñiewphew san milimitar baroh sawdong jong , bad u da ka sawdong kata ka rmiang .
translation.en: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about  ; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong khuid ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa kata ka duwan bad , ngan pynkyrpang ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin ïa shakri nga kum ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation , and the altar : I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons , to minister to me in the priest s office .
Wherefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe to the bloody city , to the pot whose scum is therein , and whose scum is not gone out of it ! bring it out piece by piece  ; let no lot fall upon it .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ka nongbah jong ki nongpynïap briew ba la tim ! Ka long kum u khiew ba sarang u bym ju pynkhuid . Ïa kawei hadien kawei ka dkhot doh la sei shabar , bad ym shym pynsah kawei ruh .
Hynrei uta uba ïa ka khubor U Blei u kren ha ki briew u ai ha ïa ka jingïarap , ka jingpynshlur , bad jingpyntngen .
translation.en: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification , and exhortation , and comfort .
Pride goeth before destruction , and an haughty spirit before a fall .
translation.kha: Ka jingsarong ka ïalam sha ka jingjot , bad ka jingsngewmeng sha ka jingkyllon noh .

Ha ka snem nyngkong kaba u Belshassar u long u ka Babilonia , nga la bad nga la ïohi ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet . Nga la thoh ïa ka jingphohsniew , bad kane ka dei ka jingkynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga kata ka miet :
translation.en: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed : then he wrote the dream , and told the sum of the matters .
To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward , with the gate Shallecheth , by the causeway of the going up , ward against ward .
translation.kha: U Shuppim bad u Hosah ki ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang sepngi bad ka khyrdop Shallekheth ha ka surok kaba na neng . Ïa ka jingap phira la pynbynta ha ki por ba la buh , kawei hadien kawei pat .
Jisu u la ha khun jong , ka jong pha la pynkhiah ïa pha . Khie leit ha kaba suk
translation.en: And he said unto her ,  Daughter , be of good comfort : thy faith hath made thee whole  ; go in peace .
None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him , to uncover their nakedness : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih . Wat ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano kaba ïadei kur dei jait bad me .
Hynrei ha shuwa sngi kaba khraw bad kaba shyrkhei jong U Trai kan , ngan phah ha phi u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: Behold , I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the  Lord  :
He that feared the word of the  Lord  among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses :
translation.kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah synshar jong u Pharaoh ki la sheptieng namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la kren , bad ki wan ïalam noh kloi ïa la ki mraw bad ïa la ki jingri shapoh ïing .

translation.en: He sent Moses his servant  ; and Aaron whom he had chosen .
translation.kha: Nangta u phah ïa u shakri jong u , u Moses , bad u Aaron , ïa kiba u la jied .

translation.en: But some of them said , He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils .
translation.kha: hynrei katto katne ngut na u paidbah ki la ong ,  U dei u Beelsebul , u rangbah jong ki ksuid , uba la ai ha U ïa ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki .

translation.en: Thus was he fair in his greatness , in the length of his branches : for his root was by great waters .
translation.kha: Katno kaba itynnat uta u dieng u long — u jrong katta katta , lem bad ka jingpyiar ki tnat , ki thied jong u ki sam shaduh ki wahduid kiba jylliew — kiba tuid .

translation.en: And her gates shall lament and mourn  ; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground .
translation.kha: Ki khyrdop ka nongbah kin ïambriew bad kin kyang , bad ka nongbah hi kan long kum ka kynthei kaba shong ha madan kaba la shah sloit lyngkhuit .

translation.en: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon  ; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la pynïap ïa ki nongpynïap ïa u Amon bad ki la pynlong syiem u Josaïah u khun jong u .

translation.en: Of whom it was said , That in Isaac shall thy seed be called :
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha u ,  Dei lyngba u Isaak ba men ïoh ïa ki khun ki ksiew kiba nga la kular .
bad pli ïa la ki jaiñ . Ka dei ban sah ha ïing jong phi , ïam bad sngewsih shi ïa bnai la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie Hadien . kata , phi lah ban shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : U mraw um long kham khraw ban ïa u kynrad jong u , bad u nonglamktien um long kham khraw ban ïa uta uba la phah ïa u .

Bteng lang san tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba kin long kawei ka jaiñ jingtap , bad leh kumjuh ïa ki hynriew ki tylli lyngkhot jaiñ sah kiba ba kin long kawei ka pat jaiñ jingtap . Khylliap ar syrtap ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba hynriew kaba ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves , and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle .

translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa kiwei , hynrei um lah ban pynim ïa lade ! Hato um dei u une syiem ka Israel ? Lada u la noh hiar mynta na ka diengphna , ngin ngeit ha u !
translation.en: He saved others  ; himself he cannot save . If he be the King of Israel , let him now come down from the cross , and we will believe him .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u khot ïa ki paid Gibeon u ong ha , Kaei ngan na ka bynta jong phi ? kwah ban noh ka jingbakla ïa la phi , khnang ba phin kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong Trai ?
translation.en: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites , What shall I do for you ? and wherewith shall I make the atonement , that ye may bless the inheritance of the  Lord  ?
Behold , the  Lord s  hand is not shortened , that it cannot save  ; neither his ear heavy , that it cannot hear :
translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba U  Trai  u tlot palat ban pynim ïa phi lane ba u kyllut palat ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang jong phi ban ïoh jingïarap !

translation.en: And he saw that rest was good , and the land that it was pleasant  ; and bowed his shoulder to bear , and became a servant unto tribute .
translation.kha: Hynrei u ïohi ba ka jaka shongthait ka long kaba bha , Bad ba ka khyndew ka long kaba itynnat . Kumta u pyndem la ka met ban kit ïa ka jingkit , Bad la pynbor ban trei kum u mraw .
pynsabut u Saul mawkhang la kyang ar snem siaw klim ,
translation.en: Saul reigned one year  ; and when he had reigned two years over Israel ,

translation.kha: Ma ngi pynban , ngi long ki traishnong jong ka bneng jingkynthih bad ngi ïa-ap hir hir ïa U Nongpynim Hepher U Jisu Khrist uba U jingsaiñ ban wan na bneng .
translation.en: For our conversation is in heaven ; from whence also we look for the Saviour , the Lord Jesus Christ :

translation.kha: U Blei u sliang jingringmraw ha kine ki nongïathuhlypa ba ka jingtrei jong ki shiphew shym la long na ka bynta ka jingpynkhreh jong ki hi , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi Babbai riehtngen ba-ïaishah dang lah kren shaphang kito kiei Aïu ïa Kohnguh phi la ïohsngew mynta na ki nonglamktien kiba la pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha da dakmong bor U Mynsiem Bakhuid ba la phah na bneng . Kine ki long kiei kiei Sa wat Karpos angel ïapyllait thrang ban shemphang .
translation.en: Unto whom it was revealed , that not unto themselves , but unto us they did minister the things , which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven  ; which things the angels desire to look into .

translation.kha: pynkylla Ngan ïa ka nongbah Rabbah ka sha jaka ba ri ïa ki ut , ïa bad ka ri ki Ammon baroh kawei sha ka jaka ban ri ïa ki langbrot , khnang ba phin tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels , and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
Also , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God  unto the land of Israel  ; An end , the end is come upon the four corners of the land .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga kren ïa ka ri Israel : Kane ka dei kaba kut ïa ka ri baroh kawei !
Ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jong U pynlip ka pyndait thah ïa ki um sniehdoh bad Shimron pynkylla thah kano ki .
translation.en: By the breath of God frost is given : and the breadth of the waters is straitened .
( 2 Corinthians 7 :1 ) Applying God’s counsel found in the Bible also promotes happiness in marriage and self-respect .—1 Corinthians 6 :18 .
translation.kha: ( 2 Korinth 7 :1 ) Da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingsneng ba don ha ka Baibl kan wanrah ka jingkmen ha ka jingshong kurim bad ha jingburom ïalade . —1 Korinth 6 :18 .
To rwai ka jingïaroh ïa U Trai Shata ïathuh ïa kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh .
translation.en: Sing unto him , sing psalms unto him : talk ye of all his wondrous works .
For these are not drunken , as ye suppose , seeing it is but the third hour of the day .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew kim shym buaid , kumba phi tharai ; ka dang khyndai baje mynstep .
U Trai kren ha
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: U Bashyrkhei’ krenbeiñ khmih bha ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei shongsaiñ ban ai ka jingkhlaiñ ïa kito kiba ki shuwa jong ki , kaweh ïaineh ha u . Me la leh bieit , bad kumta naduh kyrdem men don shawkad ha ka jingïaleh thma bha’
translation.en: For the eyes of the  Lord  run to and fro throughout the whole earth , to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him . Herein thou hast done foolishly : therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars .

translation.kha: paid Israel ki long ki U Trai , bad u wallam ïa ki na ka ri ym dei ban die mraw ïa ki .
translation.en: For they are my servants , which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt : they shall not be sold as bondmen .

translation.kha: Na u Paul , u bad Silas u Timothi — Ha ki jong parabangeit ka balang ha Thessaloni , kiba long ki jong U uba Blei U Kpa jong ngi bad ki jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai :
translation.en: Paul , and Silvanus , and Timothy , unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ :

translation.kha: Ki bym leh ïa bymdei ki ïaid ha ki lynti U Trai .
translation.en: They also do no iniquity : they walk in his ways .

translation.kha: U u ong ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai bad u hukum u , ai ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ha u paid Israel
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses in mount Sinai , saying ,
And they shall take away the ashes from the altar , and spread a purple cloth thereon :
translation.kha: Ki Lebi mynta ki long ki jong nga . Mynba nga la pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong baroh jong ki nong Ijipt , nga la pynkyntang kum la u jong ïa u khun nyngkong na kawei pa kawei ka ïing Israel bad ïa uba la kha nyngkong na uwei pa uwei u mrad . Mynta , nga ïoh noh da ki Lebi kum la ki jong ha ka jaka ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong ki Israel ; ki kin long ki jong nga . Nga long U  Trai .
Te U Jisu u la jubab , Khie leit noh , ko Soitan ! Jingthoh Bakhuid ka , ‘ To ïa U Trai U Blei jong me bad shakri tang u hi !’
translation.en: Then saith Jesus unto him ,  Get thee hence , Satan : for it is written , Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God , and him only shalt thou serve .

translation.kha: ka lyngkha ka ka long pyrthei ; u symbai babha u long ki briew kiba long ki jong ka Hima ; ki ñiut ki long ki briew kiba ki long jong Uta u Basniew ;
translation.en: The field is the world  ; the good seed are the children of the kingdom  ; but the tares are the children of the wicked one  ;
He is green before the sun , and his branch shooteth forth in his garden .
translation.kha: Ki riewbymman ki khie lung kum ki ñiut ha ka sngi , kum ki ñiut kiba saphriang kylleng ka kper .

translation.en: And last of all he was seen of me also , as of one born out of due time .
translation.kha: Khatduh eh u la paw ruh ha nga — wat la nga long kum uta uba la kha khlem biang por .

translation.en: And it came to pass , whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive , that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters , that they might conceive among the rods .
translation.kha: Haba ki jingri kiba kham khlaiñ ki ïa-pakor , u Jakob u buh ïa ki tnat dieng ha khmat jong ki ha ki shyngoid dih um , ba kin dup seng khun hapdeng kita ki tnat dieng .

translation.en: He maketh the barren woman to keep house , and to be a joyful mother of children . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: U pyndonburom ïa ka tnga ka bym don khun ha ka ïingshong jong ka ; u pynkmen ïa ka da kaba ai ki khun ha ka . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
ha ka snem kaba san phi lah ban soh . Lada leh ïa kane baroh , ki diengsoh jong phi kin seisoh kham bun . Nga U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof , that it may yield unto you the increase thereof : I am the  Lord  your God .

And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him  ; and they were full of eyes within : and they rest not day and night , saying , Holy , holy , holy , Lord God Almighty , which was , and is , and is to come .
translation.kha: Baroh kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , ki don mar hynriew tylli ki thapniang , bad ïa ki la tap da ki khmat , shapoh bad shabar . Mynsngi bad mynmiet kim ju sangeh noh na kaba rwai :  Bakhuid , bakhuid , bakhuid , long U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , Uba la long , uba long bad u ban sa wan .

translation.en: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this  ; yea , also from this withdraw not thine hand : for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all .
translation.kha: Kiar ïa baroh ar tylli ki tduh . Lada phi don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei , la kumno kumno phin long kiba jop .
Kan sa long kaba kut ïa kito kiba banbeiñ ïa kiwei bad kiba pyn-i jingñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei . Ïa uwei pa uwei u nongpop yn pynjot .
translation.en: For the terrible one is brought to nought , and the scorner is consumed , and all that watch for iniquity are cut off :
The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked : but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness .
translation.kha: U Blei , uta uba hok , u tip ïa kaei kaba jia ha ki longïing ki riewbymman , bad un wallam ïa ki bymman sha ka jingjot jingpra .

Kane ka dei Sypros jingbatai kaba la sian ha nga khyndai U mradkhlaw uba saw u dei ka hima kaba saw ka ban don ha ka ïew nongpruid kan long kaba Jinglehbor na kiwei Susanna ki hima phai Kan treikam ïa ka pyrthei baroh khnap bad kan kyrdem ïa Bethpelet .
translation.en: Thus he said , The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth , which shall be diverse from all kingdoms , and shall devour the whole earth , and shall tread it down , and break it in pieces .
And it came to pass , while they were in the way , that tidings came to David , saying , Absalom hath slain all the king s sons , and there is not one of them left .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang don ha lynti sha ïing , la ïathuh ha u Dabid ,  U Absalom u la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh — ym don uwei ruh uba lait !

translation.en: And when he was come to the king , the king said unto him , Micaiah , shall we go to Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And he said , Go ye up , and prosper , and they shall be delivered into your hand .
translation.kha: Haba u ïeng ha khmat u syiem Ahab , u syiem u kylli ïa u ,  Ko Mikaïah , hato u syiem Jehoshaphat bad nga ngin leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth , ne em ?   Tur !  u Mikaïah u ong .  Da shisha phin jop . U  Trai  un ai ïa phi ka jingjop .

translation.en: And as he was now going down , his servants met him , and told him , saying , Thy son liveth .
translation.kha: Katba u dang don ha lynti sha ïing , ki shakri jong u ki la wan shem ïa u bad ka khubor ,  U khun jong me un im !
Ki jong ki la long kum ka thylliej ding , bad u shibun ki pansngiat ha ka khlieh jong u . U la don ka kyrteng ïa kaba la thoh halor jong u ïa kaba don hynrei lait tang u hi .
translation.en: His eyes were as a flame of fire , and on his head were many crowns  ; and he had a name written , that no man knew , but he himself .

translation.kha: Ki Israel kin long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad kin long kum u khra ba la pait .
translation.en: Israel is swallowed up : now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure .

translation.kha: Kumba ka dei ban long , ko ki parabangeit jong , nga ngam shym lah ban kren ha phi kumba kren nga ha briew ki kiba U don Mynsiem ; nga hap ban kren ha phi la kumba phi dei ki jong kane ka pyrthei , kum kiba dang khynnah ha ka jingngeit Khristan .
translation.en: And I , brethren , could not speak unto you as unto spiritual , but as unto carnal , even as unto babes in Christ .

translation.kha: Lada uno la uno u leh bymdei ïa phi , to wat siew kylliang ïa u da ka bymdei . To pyrshang ban leh ïa kaei kaba baroh ki ñiew ba ka long kaba bha .
translation.en: Recompense to no man evil for evil . Provide things honest in the sight of all men .

translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ïeng skhem haduh kaba kut un lait Adonijah ïasangeh
translation.en: But he that shall endure unto the end , the same shall be saved .
And every one had four faces , and every one had four wings .
translation.kha: hynrei uwei uwei na ki u don saw tylli ki durkhmat bad saw tylli ki thapniang .

Ka por ka wan haba U Trai Badonbor Baroh un pdiang ïa ki jingainguh na kane ka ri ba la ïa , kane ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñ bad kaba donbor , ki briew kiba bad kiba ka sniehdoh , ïa kiba la sheptieng ha ka pyrthei baroh Kin wan sha u Seïon , ha kaba la mane ïa U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: In that time shall the present be brought unto the  Lord  of hosts of a people scattered and peeled , and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto  ; a nation meted out and trodden under foot , whose land the rivers have spoiled , to the place of the name of the  Lord  of hosts , the mount Zion .

translation.kha: U pyrthuh ïa bud ki jingleh u kpa jong u , bad mane u ïa ki bleithaw ba u kpa jong u , u la mane .
translation.en: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in , and served the idols that his father served , and worshipped them :
And the night following the Lord stood by him , and said ,  Be of good cheer , Paul : for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem , so must thou bear witness also at Rome .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U Trai u la ïeng hajan u Paul bad u la ong ,  Wat sheptieng ! Me la ai ka jingsakhi na ka bynta jong nga hangne ha Jerusalem , bad me dei ban leh kumjuh ruh ha Rom .

translation.en: Love not sleep , lest thou come to poverty  ; open thine eyes , and thou shalt be satisfied with bread .
translation.kha: Lada phi pynlut ïa ka por ha kaba thiah , phin long uba duk . Ïai trei shitom bad phin ïoh kyrhai ka bam .
Haba u poi la hajan Bethphage bad Bethania ha u lum ki Olib u , la phah ar ngut ki synran sha shuwa lem bad kine ki jingbthah :
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount called the mount of Olives , he sent two of his disciples ,
But go thou thy way till the end be : for thou shalt rest , and stand in thy lot at the end of the days .
translation.kha: Bad ma me , ko Daniel , to ïaineh haduh kaba kut . Nangta men sa ïap , hynrei men mihpat ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bainong ha kaba kut jong ka por .

translation.en: Now king David was old and stricken in years  ; and they covered him with clothes , but he gat no heat .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid mynta u la tymmen bha , bad wat la ki shakri jong u ki tap ïa u da ki nep-syiad , um shym syaid satia .

translation.en: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth ? I tell you , Nay  ; but rather division :
translation.kha: Hato phi tharai ba nga la wan ban wallam ka jingsuk ha ka pyrthei ? Em , ym ka jingsuk , hynrei ka jingïapait .

Haba ki syiem kiba hap hapoh u Hadadeser ki Mispah ba ki la kheiñduh ha ki Israel , bapli pynlong ka Gether bad u Pyndonburom bad ki kylla Onan ki raïot jong u . Ki jingthain kim ju mon shuh ban ïarap ïa ki Ammon .
translation.en: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they made peace with David , and became his servants : neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more .

translation.kha: Leit u sha uba lyngdoh peit dei kam ha kata ka por , bad ong ha u , ‘ Nga pynbna mynta ka sngi ha U Trai U jong Blei nga ba nga la wan rung ha kata ka ri ba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ban ai ha ngi .’
translation.en: And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days , and say unto him , I profess this day unto the  Lord  thy God , that I am come unto the country which the  Lord  sware unto our fathers for to give us .
And Nadab and Abihu , the sons of Aaron , took either of them his censer , and put fire therein , and put incense thereon , and offered strange fire before the  Lord  , which he commanded them not .
translation.kha: U Nadab bad u Abihu , ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron , ki shim ïa la ki khiew thang jingiwbih , ki buh rnga ding ha ki , ki thang ïa ka jingiwbih hangta , bad ki kñia ainguh ïa ka ha U  Trai . Hynrei kane ka ding ka long ka bymkhuid , namar U  Trai  um shym la hukum ïa ki ban leh kumta .

translation.en: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the  Lord  your God  ; arise therefore , and build ye the sanctuary of the  Lord  God , to bring the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and the holy vessels of God , into the house that is to be built to the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Mynta , shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong phi baroh . Sdang noh ban tei ïa ka Templ , khnang ba phi lah ban buh ha ka ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  bad ïa baroh kiwei pat ki tiar bakyntang ba ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa u .

translation.en: And he said unto them , I am an hundred and twenty years old this day  ; I can no more go out and come in : also the  Lord  hath said unto me , Thou shalt not go over this Jordan .
translation.kha: bad u ong ,  Mynta nga la dap shispah arphew snem bad ngam lah shuh ban long u nongïalam jong phi . Nalorkata , U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha nga ba ngan ym ïoh ban jam ïa ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: And the sons of Korah  ; Assir , and Elkanah , and Abiasaph : these are the families of the Korhites .
translation.kha: U Korah u la don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Assir , u Elkanah , bad u Abiasaph ; kine ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong ka jait Korah .

translation.en: Likewise , ye younger , submit yourselves unto the elder . Yea , all of you be subject one to another , and be clothed with humility : for God resisteth the proud , and giveth grace to the humble .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ma phi kiba dang kham samla phi donkam ban kohnguh ïa kiba la kham rangbah . Bad ma phi baroh phi dei ban phong ïa ka jaiñkup ka jingsngewrit , ban shakri iwei ïa iwei pat ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u ïaleh pyrshah ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewbha ïa kiba sngewrit .
Ki briew ka Israel ki ïa-pait : don napdeng jong ki kiba kwah pynlong syiem ïa u Tibni u khun jong u Ginath , bad kiwei pat ki kwah ïa Omri .
translation.en: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts : half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath , to make him king  ; and half followed Omri .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki long kiba kham jingmut ban ïa ki briew kiba ha Thessaloni . Ki la shahshkor ïa khubor da ka bakhraw , bad man ka sngi ki pule bniah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid khmih lada kaba Paul u ong ka long kaba .
translation.en: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica , in that they received the word with all readiness of mind , and searched the scriptures daily , whether those things were so .

translation.kha: Lada phi sawspah haba pynseisoh shah pynbeit bthah phi long kiba stad mot
translation.en: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise .
These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people , when ye are come over Jordan  ; Simeon , and Levi , and Judah , and Issachar , and Joseph , and Benjamin :
translation.kha: Ynda phi la jam ïa ka wah Jordan , kine ki jait ki dei ban ïeng ha u lum Gerisim katba nang pynbna ïa ki jingkyrkhu : ka jait Simeon , ka jait Lebi , ka jait Judah , ka jait Issakhar , ka jait Joseph , bad ka jait Benjamin .
U sdie u la khreh ban khet ïa ki dieng na ki thied ; ïa uno uno u dieng baroh u bym u sei soh babha yn noh khet bad bret ha ka ding .
translation.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees : every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .

translation.kha: Bad ha jingkylla Solomon u ong shikyntien shem-lanot khun lehkmen nga , nga kyntu ïa Ryngkat ïatim ithuh ïa U Blei u Hesekaïah jong me , bad ban shakri ïa u da dop-syntiew dohnud Bashti skhem bad da ka ,44 kaba pyndem . U tip ïa baroh ki jingpyrkhat bad ki jingkwah jong ngi ïa-pihuin Lada Na-ei leit sha u , un pdiang arspah me , har lada me phai lyndet Meron u , u ruh un iehnoh ïa Ptolemais junom .
translation.en: And thou , Solomon my son , know thou the God of thy father , and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind : for the  Lord  searcheth all hearts , and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts : if thou seek him , he will be found of thee  ; but if thou forsake him , he will cast thee off for ever .
The shady trees cover him with their shadow  ; the willows of the brook compass him about .
translation.kha: Ki bniap shiah bad ki dieng Jamynrei    harud ka wahduid ki ai jakarieh ïa u ha ka jingkah syrngiew jong ki .

translation.en: And they went after them unto Jordan : and , lo , all the way was full of garments and vessels , which the Syrians had cast away in their haste . And the messengers returned , and told the king .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ki leit shaduh Jordan , bad baroh shi lynter lynti ki ïohi ïa ki jaiñkup bad ki tiar ki tar ba ki Syria ki la bret katba ki dang phet ïap . Nangta ki wan phai bad ki leit ïathuh ha u syiem .
U Blei u ong ha u Abraham , Men ym khot shuh ïa ka tnga me jong — ka ; Sarai naduh mynta ka kyrteng jong ka kan long noh — ka Sarah .
translation.en: And God said unto Abraham , As for Sarai thy wife , thou shalt not call her name Sarai , but Sarah shall her name be .
Can you give me your pen ?
translation.kha: Phi lah ban ai u khulom jong phi ?

translation.en: They have blown the trumpet , even to make all ready  ; but none goeth to the battle : for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof .
translation.kha: Ka turoi ka riew bad baroh ki la pynkhreh . Hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba leit sha ka thma , naba ka jingbitar jong U Blei ka long halor baroh kumjuh .
Ha kawei ka sngi u Jesse u ong ha u Dabid , Shim shiphew une u krai sdieh kine ki kpu shiphew tylli , leit rah ki sha ki hynmen jong phi ka jaka sher dara .
translation.en: And Jesse said unto David his son , Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn , and these ten loaves , and run to the camp to thy brethren  ;

translation.kha: Nalor kita , u don ki ïing kynshew ba la shna na ka bynta u kew ka , waiñ , bad umphniang Olib , ki sem masi , bad ki jaka set ïa ki jong langbrot u .
translation.en: Storehouses also for the increase of corn , and wine , and oil  ; and stalls for all manner of beasts , and cotes for flocks .

translation.kha: Ha man ba phi rung ha kano kano ka ïing , to ong nyngkong , Ka ‘ jingsuk kan long ha kane ka ïing .’
translation.en: And into whatsoever house ye enter , first say , Peace be to this house .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Kaei ka bym lah ha u briew ka long kaba ha U Blei .
translation.en: And he said ,  The things which are impossible with men are possible with God .

translation.kha: U u ha ngi ,
translation.en: That the  Lord  spake unto me , saying ,
