translation.kha: Naba ki sngi ki wan ha kaba ki briew kin ong , ‘ Katno kiba donbok long ki kynthei ki bym ju don khun , ki bym ju kha khunlung , ki bym ju bsa ïa ki !’
U long uba hakhlieh tam jingkñia kawei pa kawei ka jingsynshar ba kynja mynsiem bad ka bor synshar .
translation.en: And ye are complete in him , which is the head of all principality and power :

And he shall make an atonement for the holy place , because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel , and because of their transgressions in all their sins : and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation , that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam namar ka jingbymkhuid jong ki Israel bad namar ki pop jong ki baroh . U dei ban leh kumne ha ka Ïingjaiñ namar ka ïeng hapdeng ka jaka shong dara , ïa kaba la ñiew ba ka long ka bymkhuid .

translation.en: In whom ye also trusted , after that ye heard the word of truth , the gospel of your salvation : in whom also after that ye believed , ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise ,
translation.kha: Bad ma phi ruh , kiba la kylla long ki briew jong U Blei mynba phi la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor kaba shisha , ka khubor babha kaba wallam ïa phi ka jingpynim . Phi la ngeit ha U Khrist , bad U Blei u la buh ïa ka jingshonshab ka jinglong trai ha phi da kaba ai ha phi ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba u la kular .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Blessed art thou , Simon Bar–jona : for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee , but my Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Kaba bha ïa me , ko Simon u khun jong u Jonah !  la jubab U Jisu .  Naba kane ka jingshisha kam shym la wan ha me na uno uno u briew , hynrei la ai ïa ka ha me beit beit da U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .

translation.en: And they did so  ; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod , and smote the dust of the earth , and it became lice in man , and in beast  ; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta u Aaron u shoh ïa ka khyndew da la u diengduh ; te u pui pui baroh ha Ijipt u kylla mait , bad kumta la boi da u mait ha u briew bad ha u mrad .

translation.en: Therefore now thus saith the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Wherefore commit ye this great evil against your souls , to cut off from you man and woman , child and suckling , out of Judah , to leave you none to remain  ;
translation.kha: Bad kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , mynta nga kylli ba balei phi leh kum kata ka kam kaba sniew ïa lade . Hato phi kwah ban wallam ïa ka jingpynjot ha ki rangbah bad ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung , khnang ba yn ym don na ki briew jong phi ban dang sah ?

translation.en: Turn you at my reproof : behold , I will pour out my spirit unto you , I will make known my words unto you .
translation.kha: Shahshkor haba nga mai tyngeh ïa phi ; ngan ai ïa phi ïa ki jinghikai kiba bha bad ngan ïathuh lang ïa ka jingtip jong nga bad phi .

translation.en: Blessings are upon the head of the just : but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked .
translation.kha: U briew uba bha un ïoh jingkyrkhu . Ki ktien u riewbymman ki buhrieh ïa ka jinglong ba leh jubor .

translation.en: Speak to Zerubbabel , governor of Judah , saying , I will shake the heavens and the earth  ;
translation.kha: ïa u Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah :  Nga la jan ban pynkhih ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew
To ïaroh ïa U Trai , Jerusalem ko ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei jong pha , ko Seïon !
translation.en: Praise the  Lord  , O Jerusalem  ; praise thy God , O Zion .

translation.kha: Lada u rai pynrem ïa u briew lui uba lui , un long uba la tim bad isih da baroh .
translation.en: He that saith unto the wicked , Thou art righteous  ; him shall the people curse , nations shall abhor him :

translation.kha: tnga U uba ieit u sumar bha ïa la ka tnga , da ka jingieit bad da ka jingsngewthuh .
translation.en: A loving husband treats his wife with tenderness and understanding .
And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan , and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la wan phai na ka wah Jordan uba la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad la ïalam ïa u da U Mynsiem sha ka ri shyiap ,
Ki paidbah ki la ïeng hangta da kaba khmih katba ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki krenbeiñ ïa u : U la ïa pynim kiwei ; ai un pynim lade ïa lada u dei U Messaïah ïa U uba Blei u la jied !
translation.en: And the people stood beholding . And the rulers also with them derided him , saying , He saved others  ; let him save himself , if he be Christ , the chosen of God .

translation.kha: Haba u syiem Tiberias u Pomkranet ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia pynïatylli u sangeh longrynïeng kaba tei kut khet ka jumai jingkthang iehnoh ïa ka kam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Baasha heard it , that he left off building of Ramah , and let his work cease .

And every soul that eateth that which died of itself , or that which was torn with beasts , whether it be one of your own country , or a stranger , he shall both wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the even : then shall he be clean .
translation.kha: Uno uno u briew , la u dei u Israel ne u nongwei , uba bam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba shu ïap hi , ne uba shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw , u dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñkup , bad un sum , bad ap haduh janmiet shuwa ba yn ñiew ïa u ba u long uba khuid .
Katto katne ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la wan kylli ban na nga shaphang ka mon U Trai .
translation.en: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me , and sat before me .

translation.kha: Baroh ki jingleh bymdei ki long ka pop , hynrei ka don ka pop ka bym ïalam ka sha jingïap .
translation.en: All unrighteousness is sin : and there is a sin not unto death .
Neither shall ye profane my holy name  ; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel : I am the  Lord  which hallow you ,
translation.kha: Wat shim thala ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , hynrei to ai ban pynkyntang khuid ïa nga hapdeng ki Israel ; Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang ïa phi ,

Kine ki Lebi ki tei pat ïa kiba bun ki kiba bynta bud jong ka kynroh : U Rehum u jong khun u Bani u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud ; U Hashabaïah , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Keilah distrik , u ïa tei ka bynta kaba bud na ka ka bynta distrik jong u ;
translation.en: After him repaired the Levites , Rehum the son of Bani . Next unto him repaired Hashabiah , the ruler of the half part of Keilah , in his part .
And he made the breastplate of cunning work , like the work of the ephod  ; of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ka jingdeng shadem da kijuh ki tiar da kiba la suh ïa ka ephod , bad ki pynpur itynnat ïa ka ruh ha kajuh ka rukom .

translation.en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water , and bathe his flesh in water , and shall be unclean until the even .
translation.kha: Uta uba thang ïa kata ka masi ruh u dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad theh um ïa lade , hynrei u ruh u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .

translation.en: And whither I go ye know , and the way ye know .
translation.kha: Phi tip ïa ka lynti kaba ïalam sha kata ka jaka shano sha ba nga leit .

translation.en: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem  ; Shammua , and Shobab , and Nathan , and Solomon ,
translation.kha: Kine harum ki long ki khun jong u ïa kiba la kha ha Jerusalem : U Shammua , u Shobab , u Nathan , u Solomon ,
U Samuel u shahshkor ïa baroh kaba ki ong Sheleph bad nangta Seruïah leit bad ïathuh pyrman U Trai jingpyndem
translation.en: And Samuel heard all the words of the people , and he rehearsed them in the ears of the  Lord .

translation.kha: uba shahshkor un suk — u briew uba ap man ka ha jingkhang jong nga , uba ap ha jaka rung ïing jong nga
translation.en: Blessed is the man that heareth me , watching daily at my gates , waiting at the posts of my doors .
He shall lend to thee , and thou shalt not lend to him : he shall be the head , and thou shalt be the tail .
translation.kha: Kin don ka spah ka phew kat ban ai kylliang ïa phi , hynrei phi pat phin ym don ei ei ban ai kylliang ïa ki . Ha kaba khatduh kin sa long ki nongsynshar jong phi .
Ïalam ruh ïa la Meholah maphi , ïa-bta nongsah Hannah mar mar .
translation.en: Take also your brother , and arise , go again unto the man :

translation.kha: Ha lapbah pynïohnong sngi , ki dur ha ka pynsamthiah kin kylla long ki jinglynñiar ka jingïambriew . Ki metïap kin don kylleng Benjamin . Kin sa shah bret noh Suph ka jingjar jar .
translation.en: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day , saith the Lord  God  : there shall be many dead bodies in every place  ; they shall cast them forth with silence .
Pray for us : for we trust we have a good conscience , in all things willing to live honestly .
translation.kha: To ïai duwai namar jong ngi . Ngi sngewskhem ba ngi don ka jingïatiplem kaba khuid , namar ngi kwah ban leh ïa kaba dei ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed , that the man of the earth may no more oppress .
translation.kha: Men ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang jong kiba shah banbeiñ bad jong ki khunswet ; men bishar da kaba sngewlem ïa ki ; ba kumta ki briew kin ym pynjia jingshyrkhei shuh .

translation.en: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also , because he is the Son of man .
translation.kha: Bad u la ai ha U Khun ïa ka hok ban bishar , namar u long U Khun U Briew .

U Trai thong shin ha u Gideon , Ngan pyllait im ïa ïapstai bad ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor ki jingsngewma da ki sngewbha ngut ki rangbah jingpangnud shu jliah ïa ka um . Ber ïa kiwei bymsalia kin leit noh sha ïing .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Gideon , By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you , and deliver the Midianites into thine hand : and let all the other people go every man unto his place .
God is jealous , and the  Lord  revengeth  ; the  Lord  revengeth , and is furious  ; the  Lord  will take vengeance on his adversaries , and he reserveth wrath for his enemies .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei um lah shah ïa kino kino ki nongïaleh pyrshah ; u pynshitom ïa kito kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa u . Ha ka jingbitar jong u , u siew kylliang ïa ki .
U pynïakhlad ïa jingshai na ka jingdum ka syrwiang ba la dak ha khmat ka duriaw .
translation.en: He hath compassed the waters with bounds , until the day and night come to an end .

translation.kha: Ngam sheptieng , ïai ngan kren beit namar nga tip ïa la ka dohnud .
translation.en: Then would I speak , and not fear him  ; but it is not so with me .

translation.kha: Ngi thoh sha phi tang ïa kaba phi lah ban pule bad sngewthuh Hynrei . wat lada phi sngewthuh ïa ngi tang mynta katto katne , nga kyrmen phin ba poi sha kata ka jingsngewthuh kaba pura , khnang ba ha ka Sngi jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi phin ïoh sngewsarong ïa ngi kumba ngi ïa sngewsarong phi .
translation.en: As also ye have acknowledged us in part , that we are your rejoicing , even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus .

translation.kha: La don arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba ha ka jingkhot sngewbha u Absalom ki la leit na Jerusalem bad u ; kim tip ei shaphang ei ka jingthmu barieh bad ki la da leit kaba sngur mynsiem .
translation.en: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem , that were called  ; and they went in their simplicity , and they knew not any thing .
Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat  ; and they draw near unto the gates of death .
translation.kha: kim lah ban peit ïa ka jingbam bad ki la jan ban ïap .
To isynei ïa nga , bad ngan im ; namar nga shem sngewbha ka ha aiñ jong me .
translation.en: Let thy tender mercies come unto me , that I may live : for thy law is my delight .
On this side Jordan , in the land of Moab , began Moses to declare this law , saying ,
translation.kha: Dei ha ka por ba ki Israel ki don ha Moab sha mihngi na Jordan ba u Moses u sdang ban batai bad hikai ïa ki hukum U Blei .

translation.en: Remember that thou magnify his work , which men behold .
translation.kha: La ïai ïaroh ïa u namar kaei kaba u leh ; phi ruh phi dei ban ïaroh ïa u .
Ïa ka khyndew kaba dei ka jong ki lyngdoh te um ïabud thied . Kim donkam ban die nongdie la ka khyndew namar ba ki snier ken baibam kaba thikna na u syiem , bad ki im da kata .
translation.en: Only the land of the priests bought he not  ; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh , and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them : wherefore they sold not their lands .
And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead , now no more to return to corruption , he said on this wise , I will give you the sure mercies of David .
translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la ong shaphang kaba pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , ym ban pyut noh ha ka jingtep :   ‘ Ngan ai ha me ïa kita ki jingkyrkhu bakyntang bad kiba thikna kiba nga la kular ha u Dabid .’

translation.en: And cried with a loud voice , and said , What have I to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of the most high God ? I adjure thee by God , that thou torment me not .
translation.kha: Ko Jisu , U Khun jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh ! Me kwah aïu bad nga ? Nga kyrpad ïa me ban ym pynshitom ïa nga !

khnang yn ba ym don mano mano na phi ban phai dien noh namar kine ki jingpynshitom beiñ . Phi hi ïatip phi ba kiba kum kine ki jingpynshitom beiñ ki ka long bynta jong ka mon U Blei na ka bynta jong ngi .
translation.en: That no man should be moved by these afflictions : for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto .

translation.kha: U Moses u la leit hiar sha ki briew jinieid saraw la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba U dkoh u shitaiew lah ong .
translation.en: So Moses went down unto the people , and spake unto them .
And Zilpah Leah s maid bare Jacob a son .
translation.kha: Nangta ka Silpah ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment , nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongpop yn pynrem da U Blei bad yn pynïakhlad ïa ki na ki briew ki jong U Blei hi .

translation.en: Multitudes , multitudes in the valley of decision : for the day of the  Lord  is near in the valley of decision .
translation.kha: Da ki hajar hajar ki don ha ka Them jong ka Jingbishar . Dei hangta ba ka Sngi jong U  Trai  shen kan wan .

translation.en: And he said unto his daughters , And where is he ? why is it that ye have left the man ? call him , that he may eat bread .
translation.kha: Ha-ei u don ?  u kylli ïa la ki khun .  Balei phi shu ieh ïa uta u briew ? Khie leit khot ïa u ban ïabam bad ngi .

translation.en: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim . Then said Abner unto him , Go , return . And he returned .
translation.kha: U Paltiel u leit bud ïa ka haduh ka nongrit Bahurim , u da ïam katba u dang leit . Hynrei u Abner u ong ,  Khie leit noh sha ïing ,  bad u leh kumta .

translation.en: As an earring of gold , and an ornament of fine gold , so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear .
translation.kha: Ka jingmaham ba ai da u briew uba shemphang bha ha uno uno uba mon ban sngap ka long kaba kham kordor ban ïa ki sati ksiar ne ki jingdeng mawlynnai ba la saiñ na ka ksiar banylla .

translation.en: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them , and hid my face from them .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingbymkhuid bad ka jingbymman jong ki , bad nga la phai noh na ki .
Hynrei naduh mynta kan ym long shuh kaba bam briew bad kaba knieh noh na ka ki ïa khun jong ka . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , la nga kren .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more , neither bereave thy nations any more , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: U Petros u la ong ha ki , Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban phai noh na ki pop jong u bad ba yn pynbaptis ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist , khnang ba map yn ïa pop ki jong phi , bad phin ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba long ka jingai jong U Blei .
translation.en: Then Peter said unto them , Repent , and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins , and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost .
Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh . Nga long U  Trai .

U bad Moses u Aaron ki la jubab , U jong Blei ki Hebru u la pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi . Shah ïa ngi ban leit lai sngi sha ka shyiap ri ban ai jingkñia ha U Trai uba U Blei jong ngi . Lada ngim leh kumta , un sa pynïap ïa ngi da ka jingpang lane da ka . thma
translation.en: And they said , The God of the Hebrews hath met with us : let us go , we pray thee , three days  journey into the desert , and sacrifice unto the  Lord  our God  ; lest he fall upon us with pestilence , or with the sword .
Hear , O Israel : Thou art to pass over Jordan this day , to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself , cities great and fenced up to heaven ,
translation.kha: Shahshkor ko Israel ! Mynta ka sngi phin jam ïa ka wah Jordan bad knieh ïa kata ka ri jong ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khraw bad kham donbor ban ïa phi . Ki shnong jong ki , ki long kiba heh , bad ki kynroh jong ki , ki kot haduh suiñbneng .

translation.en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves , Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing ? behold , the world is gone after him .
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la ïakren para ma ki ,  Phi ïohi , ngim shym lah leh ei ei ruh em ! Khmih , ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïabud ïa u !

translation.en: Simon Peter said unto him , Lord , whither goest thou ? Jesus answered him ,  Whither I go , thou canst not follow me now  ; but thou shalt follow me afterwards .
translation.kha: Ko Trai , shano men leit ?  u Petros u la kylli ïa u .  Mem lah ban bud ïa nga mynta shano sha ba ngan sa leit ,  U Jisu u la jubab ;  hynrei hadien men sa bud ïa nga .

translation.en: Then one said unto him , Behold , thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to speak with thee .
translation.kha: Kumta uwei na ki briew hangta u la ong ha u ,  Ha khmih , ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong me ki ïa-ïeng shabar bad ki kwah ban ïakren bad me .

translation.en: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish , he shall not approach : a blind man , or a lame , or he that hath a flat nose , or any thing superfluous ,
translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew uba don jingduna ha ka met ban ai ïa kata ka jingkñia : kum uba matlah , uba dkoh , uba la sniew ka durkhmat , lane uba la thawsha ka met ;

translation.en: And saying ,  The time is fulfilled , and the kingdom of God is at hand : repent ye , and believe the gospel .
translation.kha: Ka por kaba dei ka la poi ,  u ong ,  bad ka Hima U Blei ka la hajan ! To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad ngeit ïa ka Khubor Babha !
U Elisha u khie joit , u ïaid shane shatai hapoh kamra , bad nangta u leit biang bad u pyiar ïa lade u khynnah . U khynnah u la synriah hynñiew sien bad u peit la ki .
translation.en: Then he returned , and walked in the house to and fro  ; and went up , and stretched himself upon him : and the child sneezed seven times , and the child opened his eyes .

translation.kha: ‘ pulom smai biar namar kim shym la kohnguh ïa Kim , uwei ruh na ki rangbah uba arphew snem lane ïong heh uba la ïashakri na Ijipt un ym Jehudi sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ha u Abraham , u Isaak , pynshah u Jakob .’
translation.en: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt , from twenty years old and upward , shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob  ; because they have not wholly followed me :
That they teach you not to do after all their abominations , which they have done unto their gods  ; so should ye sin against the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa ki , ba kin ym ïoh hikai shuh ïa phi ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba isaitmet ba ki ju leh haba ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki , kumta ba phin ym leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
U briew uba shem ïa nga u nongïohipaw ïa ka jingim , bad U Trai un sngewbha ïa u .
translation.en: For whoso findeth me findeth life , and shall obtain favour of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa kane , ka kynthei ka la kren ïingshong u Shipai bad ka .] ong ha u , A katno kaba kmen pyn-ap ka briew nongleitkurim la kha bad kaba la bsa kumno lamler ïa me !
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he spake these things , a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice , and said unto him , Blessed is the womb that bare thee , and the paps which thou hast sucked .

translation.kha: Ar ngut ki kynthei kin don ha ka jaka tylliat kpu : Ïa kawei jingpynsleh shim noh , ïa kawei pat Sarephath iehnoh khapbrip .
translation.en: Two women shall be grinding at the mill  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , baroh kiba klun ïa klun bad ïa baroh jong phi rah noh kum ki koidi . Ïa kiba banbeiñ ïa phi yn , bad ïa baroh kiba lute ïa phi yn lute .
translation.en: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured  ; and all thine adversaries , every one of them , shall go into captivity  ; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil , and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey .

translation.kha: Kumta kane ka dei kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong ha phi . Kane ka nongbah ka dei da shisha u khiew shet , hynrei kaei ka doh ? Ki metïap jong kito kiba phi la ! Phin ym shuh hangne — Ngan bret phi shabar kane ka nongbah .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it , they are the flesh , and this city is the caldron : but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it .
And when the  Lord  thy God hath delivered it into thine hands , thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword :
translation.kha: Te , ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi ïa kata ka shnong , pynïap lut ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang .

translation.en: Then David sent home to Tamar , saying , Go now to thy brother Amnon s house , and dress him meat .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u phah ktien sha ka Tamar ha ka ïingsyiem :  Khie leit sha ka ïing u Amnon bad khreh katto katne ka jingbam ïa u .
U Trai un pynhiarkput bad pynshitom ïa ki ka ; por kan poi kin haba kyllon ; ka sngi ka jingjot jong ki ka la jan .
translation.en: To me belongeth vengeance , and recompence  ; their foot shall slide in due time : for the day of their calamity is at hand , and the things that shall come upon them make haste .

translation.kha: ban ym shah pynshaïong jingmut kaba da suk ha jingpyrkhat ka jong phi lane ban shah pynkhuslai da ka ba jingkam ka Sngi jong U Trai ka la wan lah . Lehse ka long ba la mut ba ngi la ong ïa kane katba ngi dang ïathuhlypa lane ïalap , lane ba ngi la thoh ïa ka ha ka shithi .
translation.en: That ye be not soon shaken in mind , or be troubled , neither by spirit , nor by word , nor by letter as from us , as that the day of Christ is at hand .
Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground , and opened every man his sack .
translation.kha: Kumta ki pynhiar kloi kloi ïa la ki byrni ha madan , bad uwei pa uwei na ki u plied ïa la ka byrni .
U Asa pynsngewbha ïa U Trai U Blei jong u , da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha .
translation.en: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the  Lord  his God :
Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father s sake : but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son .
translation.kha: Pynban , na ka bynta u Dabid u kpa jong me , ngan ym leh ïa kane katba me dang im , hynrei ha ka por jingsynshar u khun jong me .
Nga tip ba ki jingbishar jong me ki long kiba hok , A Trai , bad ba me la pynshitom ïa nga sngap me long uba ïaineh .
translation.en: I know , O  Lord  , that thy judgments are right , and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me .
So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering , and offered it upon a rock unto the  Lord  : and the angel did wondrously  ; and Manoah and his wife looked on .
translation.kha: Kumta u Manoah u shim uwei u khunblang bad khyndiat u kew , bad u ainguh ïa ki halor ka duwan maw sha U  Trai  uba leh kamphylla .

translation.en: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar , and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee  ;
translation.kha: Kumta hamar ba phin ai ïa ka jingai jong phi sha U Blei ha ka duwan bad hangta phi kynmaw ba u para jong phi u don ei ei pyrshah ïa phi ,

translation.en: And he said unto his brethren , My money is restored  ; and , lo , it is even in my sack : and their heart failed them , and they were afraid , saying one to another , What is this that God hath done unto us ?
translation.kha: La pynphai pat ïa ki pisa jong nga ,  u la khot ïa la ki hynmen shynrang .  Kane hangne ha ka byrni jong nga !  Mar kumta ki rit mynsiem ria , bad da kaba sheptieng ki ïakylli para ma ki ,  Kaei keiñ kane kaba U Blei u la leh ïa ngi ?

translation.en: So he departed thence , and found Elisha the son of Shaphat , who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him , and he with the twelfth : and Elijah passed by him , and cast his mantle upon him .
translation.kha: U Elijah u la mihnoh bad shem ïa u Elisha ba u dang pynlur ïa shi jur ki masi dab ; la don khatwei jur ki masi dab kiba don ha ki lyngkor ha khmat jong u , bad u dang pynlur ïa kiba khatduh . U Elijah u la law noh ïa la ka barandi bad u la pynkup ha u Elisha .
Te kumta , ki la jubab , phi ruh phi dei na Galilaïa ? To pule ïa minot ki Jingthoh Bakhuid bad phin shem ba ym nongïathuhlypa don uba ju mih na Galilaïa .
translation.en: And every man went unto his own house .

translation.kha: Ki la sangeh ban mane ïa U Trai , ki kpa tymmen ki , U uba la wallam ïa ki na , ki sdang ban mane ïa pat ki blei blei jong jaitbynriew kiba don jong ki . Ki mane dem ïa ki , bad ki la pynlong ïa U Trai bitar
translation.en: And they forsook the  Lord  God of their fathers , which brought them out of the land of Egypt , and followed other gods , of the gods of the people that were round about them , and bowed themselves unto them , and provoked the  Lord  to anger .
And Judah was put to the worse before Israel  ; and they fled every man to their tents .
translation.kha: Ki shipai u Amasaïah ki shahjop , bad baroh ki shipai jong u ki phet krad sha la ki ïing .

translation.en: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation  ; and ye shall afflict your souls : ye shall not do any work therein :
translation.kha: Ïalumlang ban mane Blei ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew ; wat bam ei ei bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .

U Joïada , khun jong Paseah , bad u Meshullam , u khun u Besodeïah , ki tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Jeshanah . Ki buh ïa ki bim pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ki jingkhang ka khyrdop .
translation.en: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah , and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah  ; they laid the beams thereof , and set up the doors thereof , and the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .
And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day , and seven times in a day turn again to thee , saying , I repent  ; thou shalt forgive him .
translation.kha: Lada u leh pop pyrshah ïa phi hynñiew sien ha ka shi sngi , bad man ka por u wan sha phi da kaba ong , ‘ nga kylla-kaba-mut ,’ phi dei ban map ïa u .

rkhiang kiba sniew bus bym don blei ki long ki briew jong kane Kano sawspah ! U Jisu u la pynbna . Phi pan na mong ïa ka kambah ? Em ! Ka kambah kaba yn ai ha phi Haggith myntri Nehushtan ka kambah jong u Jonah u lypa .
translation.en: But he answered and said unto them ,  An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given to it , but the sign of the prophet Jonas :
When he was come down from the mountain , great multitudes followed him .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan hiar na u lum , ki paidbah babun ki la bud ïa u .

Ha ka sngi seisoh bud u la ïohi ar ngut ki Israel ïohthiah dang pynbit , bad u la pyrshang riewblei pynïasuk ïa ki Khreh da ong , ‘ Shahshkor , nym nabar ,’ Me la ong , ‘ tyrha ïalong para Israel ticket khet ba phi ïashoh kumne ?’
translation.en: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove , and would have set them at one again , saying , Sirs , ye are brethren  ; why do ye wrong one to another ?

translation.kha: Uno na phi uba la ïathuhlypa kane ba kan jia , ba khnang ngin lah ban ong ba phi long uba dei ? Ym don na phi uba la ong wat shikyntien shaphang jong ka ; ym don uba la ïohsngew ïa phi ba phi ong kata ïa .
translation.en: Who hath declared from the beginning , that we may know ? and beforetime , that we may say , He is righteous ? yea , there is none that sheweth , yea , there is none that declareth , yea , there is none that heareth your words .

translation.kha: Kumta u Iso ïathaw ong , Te kumta , shah ngan Ahikam katto katne Khylliap ki briew jong nga khraw phi . Hynrei u Jakob u ïaskhem , Ym Kyrinios donkam ban leh kumta namar nga kwah tang wandur ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi nongtrei”
translation.en: And Esau said , Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me . And he said , What needeth it ? let me find grace in the sight of my lord .

translation.kha: U Blei la pynpaw bneng pyrshah ïa baroh ka pop bad ka jingsniew ki briew kiba lynti basniew jong ki , ki jingtip ka jingshisha .
translation.en: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men , who hold the truth in unrighteousness ;

Then they said one to another , We do not well : this day is a day of good tidings , and we hold our peace : if we tarry till the morning light , some mischief will come upon us : now therefore come , that we may go and tell the king s household .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien kata ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ngim dei ban leh kumne ! Ngi don ka khubor babha , bad ngim dei ban buh ïa ka tang ha lade hi . Lada ngi ap haduh mynstep ban ïathuh ïa ka , ngi thikna ba ngin shah pynshitom . Ïa ngin ïaleit noh shisyndon ban ïathuh ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem !

translation.en: And many of the people believed on him , and said , When Christ cometh , will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done ?
translation.kha: Hynrei bun na uta u paidbah u la ngeit ha u bad u la ong ,  Haba U Messaïah un wan , hato un leh kham bun ki kambah ban ïa kaba une u briew u la leh ?

translation.en: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the  Lord  , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa uta u masi lyngraw hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga ha ka jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
Ki shalyntem ki thaba ki kum mawkordor , bad kawei pa kawei ka shalyntem don ka sa kawei pat ka shalyntem kaba ïasnohlang ha ka liang ka mon .
translation.en: And as for their appearances , they four had one likeness , as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel .
It is a night to be much observed unto the  Lord  for bringing them out from the land of Egypt : this is that night of the  Lord  to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations .
translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka miet ba U  Trai  u ap miet ban ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Ïa kane kajuh ka miet la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  pateng la pateng kum ka miet ha kaba ki Israel ki dei ban ap miet .

Haba ki briew jong me ki Israel ki ha ki nongshun jong ki namar ba ki leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad nangta ki sha me bad wan sha kane ka Templ da kyrpad da kaba sngewrit ha me na bynta ban jingmap , shahshkor ïa ki na bneng .
translation.en: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy , because they have sinned against thee , and shall turn again to thee , and confess thy name , and pray , and make supplication unto thee in this house :
Wisdom is the principal thing  ; therefore get wisdom : and with all thy getting get understanding .
translation.kha: Kaba ïoh ïa ka jingstad ka long kaei kaei kaba donkam tam ba phi dei ban leh . Nalor kaei kaei baroh kaba phi ïoh , to ïoh ruh ïa ka jingshemphang .
Nga ïa phi , ban ym noh mynsiem namar nga shahshitom na bynta jong ; ka dei na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong phi baroh
translation.en: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you , which is your glory .
Tell others about Jehovah and his ways . —Isaiah 43 :10 .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha kiwei shaphang U Jehobah bad ki lynti jong u .—Isaiah 43 :10 .

translation.en: So she went from him , and shut the door upon her and upon her sons , who brought the vessels to her  ; and she poured out .
translation.kha: Kumta ka kynthei ka la leit sha la ïing lem bad la ki khun shynrang , ka la khang ïa ka jingkhang , ka la shim ïa u khra umphniang Olib uba rit , bad ka la phylliew umphniang ha ki khra kiba ki khun shynrang jong ka ki la wallam .
Kumba ka shyieng ka thaba na shiliang sha shiliang jong ïashongduh sahit bneng bad ka pynshai ïa ka na kawei ka liang sha Shimei pat , kumta un long U Khun Rebekka ïajan ha sum khain jong u Obed
translation.en: For as the lightning , that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven , shineth unto the other part under heaven  ; so shall also the Son of man be in his day .

translation.kha: bad ha kylleng ri ka , ar na ka lai bynta ki briew kin ïap .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that in all the land , saith the  Lord  , two parts therein shall be cut off and die  ; but the third shall be left therein .
And he said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God : but if thou wilt enter into life , keep the commandments .
translation.kha: Balei me kylli na nga shaphang kaei kaba bha ?  la jubab U Jisu .  Don tang Uwei uba bha . To sumar ïa ki hukum lada me kwah ban rung sha ka jingim .

Kin wallam pat ïa baroh ki para kur ki para jait jong phi na ki jaitbynriew baroh kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa Kin wallam ki sha u lum bakyntang jong nga Jerusalem ha ki kulai , ki khashor bad ut , bad ha ki kali ïapom kali kit , kumba ki Israel ki wanrah ïa ki jingainguh bam sha ka Templ khiew lehniam kiba khuid .
translation.en: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the  Lord  out of all nations upon horses , and in chariots , and in litters , and upon mules , and upon swift beasts , to my holy mountain Jerusalem , saith the  Lord  , as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nga la bteng bhabriew duwai , da kaba phla ïaphiah ki pop jingïohmap nga bad ïa ki pop Salu ki briew jong nga ki Israel , bad da kaba ïasaid bad U itynnad U Blei jong nga ban pynbha pat ïa Jaser Templ bakhuid jong sorki ,
translation.en: And whiles I was speaking , and praying , and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel , and presenting my supplication before the  Lord  my God for the holy mountain of my God  ;

When I say unto the wicked , O wicked man , thou shalt surely die  ; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way , that wicked man shall die in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .
translation.kha: Lada nga pynbna ba u briew ba-bymman u dei ban ïap bad mem shym la maham ïa u ba un phai na ki lynti jong u khnang ba u lah ban pynim ïa la ka jingim , te un ïap , kum u nongpop , bad ngan pynkit pop ïa me na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u .
Nangta u Sennakherib , u ka Assyria u kylla dien bad phai noh sha Ninebeh
translation.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , and went and returned , and dwelt at Nineveh .

translation.kha: Ki tnga bad ki khun ki kti jong ngi , bad ki jingri bad ki langbrot jong ngi , kin sah hangne ha ki shnong Gilead .
translation.en: Our little ones , our wives , our flocks , and all our cattle , shall be there in the cities of Gilead :

translation.kha: Dabid tap ka kynthup ïa phi kiba ha Rom , ïa kiba U Blei u la khot ban long Soar jong U Jisu Khrist .
translation.en: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ .
A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him : neither will he go unto the wise .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba meng kim sngewtynnat ban shah sneng ; kim ju pan ïa ki jingai jingmut na kito kiba kham stad .
Baroh ki paid Israel , te , ki dei ban tip kaba da thikna ba une U Jisu , uba phi la sahnarphna u , dei uta uba U Blei u la pynlong U Trai bad U Messaïah !
translation.en: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly , that God hath made that same Jesus , whom ye have crucified , both Lord and Christ .

translation.kha: Suki suki kin pynkylla ïa ka sha ka .—Jenesis :28 ; 2 :8 15 .
translation.en: Gradually they would have made the entire earth into a paradise .—Genesis 1 :28  ; 2 :8 , 15 .

translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba pang ? U dei ban phah khot ïa ki nongsharai balang , ki ban na duwai ka bynta jong u bad pynsleh ha da u ka umphniang Olib ha ka jong kyrteng U Trai .
translation.en: Is any sick among you ? let him call for the elders of the church  ; and let them pray over him , anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord :
But his delight is in the law of the  Lord   ; and in his law doth he meditate day and night .
translation.kha: Pynban , ki shem jingkmen ha kaba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum jong U  Trai

translation.en: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment  ; and a babbler is no better .
translation.kha: Kaba tip kumno ban pynshohbieit ïa u bseiñ ka long ka bymdonkam lada phi shah ïa u bseiñ ban puh nyngkong .

To sngap ïa kaei kaba Trai U u kren , phi kiba sheptieng bad kohnguh ïa u : Namar phi long kiba ïaineh ha nga , katto katne na ki briew jong phi hi ki shun ïa phi bad kin ym don ïadon ei bynta ei bad phi . Ki rkhiebeiñ ïa phi bad , ong ‘ Ai U ba Trai un pyn-i ïa ka jingkhraw jong u bad pynim ïa , phi kumta ba ngin ïohi ïa phi ba phi shadkmen .’ Hynrei dei ma ki hi ki , ban jahburom !
translation.en: Hear the word of the  Lord  , ye that tremble at his word  ; Your brethren that hated you , that cast you out for my name s sake , said , Let the  Lord  be glorified : but he shall appear to your joy , and they shall be ashamed .
And would to God this people were under my hand ! then would I remove Abimelech . And he said to Abimelech , Increase thine army , and come out .
translation.kha: Nga pyrkhat ba ngan ïoh ïalam ïa kine ki briew ! ngan jin da la pynher krad ïa u Abimelekh ! Ngan ong ïa u , ‘ Pynbun shuh shuh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me , ale to mih ban ïaleh !’

translation.en: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him : and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight .
translation.kha: la kum ba leh ïa u nongbylla uba trei snem . U kynrad jong u , um dei ban pynshitom beiñ ïa u .
Don na phi kiba la ju kumta . Hynrei la pynkhuid ïa phi na ka pop la pynkyntang ïa phi sha U Blei ; pynksan ïa phi bad U Blei da U Jisu Khrist Trai da U U Blei jong ngi .
translation.en: And such were some of you : but ye are washed , but ye are sanctified , but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus , and by the Spirit of our God .

How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace  ; that bringeth good tidings of good , that publisheth salvation  ; that saith unto Zion , Thy God reigneth !
translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba phylla ban ïohi ïa u nonglamktien ba u wan na ki lumbah , u wanrah ïa ka khubor babha , ka khubor jong ka jingsuk ! U pynbna ïa ka jingjop bad u ong ïa ka Seïon ,  U Blei jong phi u long u syiem !

translation.en: Only take heed to thyself , and keep thy soul diligently , lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen , and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life : but teach them thy sons , and thy sons  sons  ;
translation.kha: Da leh husiar ! Kynmaw ba katba phi dang im phim dei ban klet ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohi da la ki khmat .
A Trai —Ïoannis katno slem nga dei bashalor pyrta jingïarap ha shuwa ba men shahshkor , ha shuwa pynlamwir men pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jingleh jubor ?
translation.en: O  Lord  , how long shall I cry , and thou wilt not hear ! even cry out unto thee of violence , and thou wilt not save !

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la ong ha u Moses u bad , Aaron Shim katto katne kham u dpei na ka lawar ding ; u Moses un kynting ïa u shajrong ha khmat u Pharaoh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses and unto Aaron , Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace , and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh .
And this is the condemnation , that light is come into the world , and men loved darkness rather than light , because their deeds were evil .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ka jingbishar ka trei : Ka jingshai ka la wan sha ka pyrthei , hynrei ki briew ki ieit ïa ka jingdum ban ïa ka jingshai , namar ba ki kam jong ki , ki long kiba sniew .
Ka duriaw ka la tyllep ïa ka bad tap da ki jingat phyllung .
translation.en: The sea is come up upon Babylon : she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof .

translation.kha: Thaw shuh sa ar tylli ki kyrwoh pyndait ïa ki ha ka bynta kaba trai jong ka bynta kaba ha jong ki ki tawah hajan ka jaka ba la suh pyndait bad haneng jong u panpoh ba thain itynnat bha .
translation.en: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make , and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart thereof , over against the other coupling thereof , above the curious girdle of the ephod .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Pilat u la kylli , Ka kam aïu runar u la leh ? Nangta ki la sdang pyrta ban da ka sur kaba jam tam : Sahnarphna ïa u !
translation.en: And the governor said , Why , what evil hath he done ? But they cried out the more , saying , Let him be crucified .

translation.kha: ka Ophir , ka Habilah bad , ka Jobab . Kine baroh ki dei kiba hiarpateng na u Joktan .
translation.en: And Ophir , and Havilah , and Jobab : all these were the sons of Joktan .
And thou shalt put them into one basket , and bring them in the basket , with the bullock and the two rams .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ki ha ka shang , bad wanrah ïa ki sha nga ha ka por ba me kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw bad ïa ki ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang .
Nangta pynkylla ïa ki briew ki hima , bad kin duwai tang sha bad ym sha kiwei pat ki blei . baroh kin kohnguh ïa nga .
translation.en: For then will I turn to the people a pure language , that they may all call upon the name of the  Lord  , to serve him with one consent .
Then shall the lame man leap as an hart , and the tongue of the dumb sing : for in the wilderness shall waters break out , and streams in the desert .
translation.kha: Kiba dkoh kin rynsied bad shad , bad kito ki bym lah ban kren kin pyrta da ka jingkmen . Ki wahduid kin tuid lyngba ka ri shyiap ;
Haba phi tei ïa ka duwan U Trai U Blei jong phi , pynïeng hajan jong ka ïa uno u dieng uba don ka dur ka bleithaw Asherah .
translation.en: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the  Lord  thy God , which thou shalt make thee .
Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted , because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely ?
translation.kha: Ngam shym la buh dor ei ei ïa phi haba nga la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha jong U Blei ha phi ; nga la pynrit ïa lade khnang ban kyntiew ïa phi . Hato nga la leh bakla ?
Ka ri kan ym shahshkor shuh ki jaitbynriew kiba ïa ka , lane ïohi ki kynja bynriew kiba peitbeiñ ïa ka . Ka ri kan ym knieh shuh ïa la ki khun na ka . Ma nga , U Trai nongsynshar , la kren
translation.en: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more , neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more , neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: U Elijah pynsuk u wan Shata , la pynjrong U Jisu , bad un pynkhreh ïa kiei kiei baroh .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Elias truly shall first come , and restore all things .

translation.kha: U bad Judas u Silas , kiba long hi ki nongïathuhlypa , ki la kren slem bad ki , da ai kaba ha ki ka jingpynshlur bad ka jingpynkhlaiñ .
translation.en: And Judas and Silas , being prophets also themselves , exhorted the brethren with many words , and confirmed them .
For I have kept the ways of the  Lord  , and have not wickedly departed from my God .
translation.kha: Nga la kohnguh ïa ka aiñ jong U  Trai  ; Ngam shym la phai noh na U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: We asked their names also , to certify thee , that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them .
translation.kha: Ngi kylli ruh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khnang ba ngi lah ban pyntip sha phi mano ki nongïalam jong kane ka kam ki dei .

translation.en: And he brought me into the inner court of the  Lord s  house , and , behold , at the door of the temple of the  Lord  , between the porch and the altar , were about five and twenty men , with their backs toward the temple of the  Lord  , and their faces toward the east  ; and they worshipped the sun toward the east .
translation.kha: Kumta u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka phyllaw kaba kham shapoh ka Templ . Hangta hajan ka jaka rung sha ka jaka kyntang , hapdeng ka duwan bad ka lynti rung , la don arphew san ngut ki rangbah . Ki phai dadien ïa ka jaka kyntang , bad ki pyndem ïa lade shaphang mihngi , ki da mane ïa ka sngi kaba dang mih .
Kumta u Petros u la hiar bad u la ha kita ki rangbah , Dei ma nga uta uba phi ïawad . Phi donkam aïu ?
translation.en: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius  ; and said , Behold , I am he whom ye seek : what is the cause wherefore ye are come ?

translation.kha: U Paul la buh ïa la kti halor jong , bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la ki la kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher bad ki la pynbna ruh ïa ka khubor jong U Blei .
translation.en: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them , the Holy Ghost came on them  ; and they spake with tongues , and prophesied .
Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart , having no necessity , but hath power over his own will , and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin , doeth well .
translation.kha: Khlemlait lada u briew , daym pynbor ban leh kumta , u la kut jingmut skhem ban ym shongkurim , bad lada ïa la ka mon u lah ban synshar bad ba u la rai kut ha ka jingmut jong u ïa kaei kaba un leh — te u leh ïa kaba dei ban ym shongkurim kata ka theisotti .

translation.en: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest :
translation.kha: Nalor katei , ka don ruh ka jingsmai ka jong U Blei . Ym shym la don ka jingsmai kaba kum kata haba la pynlong lyngdoh ïa kita kiwei pat .

translation.en: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison , he departed into Galilee  ;

translation.kha: Haba u u ïohsngew ba ki don ha Gath , u la jin ïa la ka bad u la leit sha u Syiem Akhish ha Gath ban wad ïa ki mraw . la lap ïa ki bad u wan ïalam pat ïa ïing .
translation.en: And Shimei arose , and saddled his ass , and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants : and Shimei went , and brought his servants from Gath .

translation.kha: ïalaw lah ban baskhem ïa iwei na Ki dor U Jehobah ban shadkmen ïa thik ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingmut jong ki dkhot Baibl .—Pule Loukas 24 mala , 45 Barnea
translation.en: Any one of Jehovah’s Witnesses will be pleased to help you to reason on the meaning of the Scriptures . —Read Luke 24 :32 , 45 .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada um sngap me ïa , ïalam uwei ne ar ngut kiwei pat ki briew lem bad me , khnang ‘ ba kawei kawei pa ka jingkynnoh lah ban kyrshan da ka jingsakhi jong ki ar lane lai ngut ki sakhi .’
translation.en: But if he will not hear thee , then take with thee one or two more , that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established .
As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest  ; because it did not rest in your sabbaths , when ye dwelt upon it .
translation.kha: Te ka ri kan ïoh lehkmen ha ki snem ka jingshongthait kaba pura ha kaba phin ym ai ei ei ïa ka ; kan long kaba la iehnoh bad kan ïoh shongthait , katba phi dang don ha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab , the son of Reuben : how the earth opened her mouth , and swallowed them up , and their households , and their tents , and all the substance that was in their possession , in the midst of all Israel :
translation.kha: Phi kynmaw aïu u la leh ïa u Dathan bad u Abiram , ki khun u Eliab uba na ka jait Reuben . Hangta ha khmat jong phi baroh , ka khyndew ka ang bad ka nguid ïa ki lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong ki , ïa ki ïingjaiñ , ki shakri , bad ki jingri jong ki baroh .

translation.en: For as the rain cometh down , and the snow from heaven , and returneth not thither , but watereth the earth , and maketh it bring forth and bud , that it may give seed to the sower , and bread to the eater :
translation.kha: Ka ktien jong nga ka long kum ka ïor bad u slap kiba wan hap na suiñbneng ban ai um ïa ka pyrthei . Ki pynlong ïa ki jingthung ban san bad pynmih ïa u symbai ban ïoh bet bad ka jingbam ban bam .

translation.en: Saying , Say ye , His disciples came by night , and stole him away while we slept .
translation.kha: bad ki la ong ,  Phi dei ban ong ba ki synran jong u ki la wan mynmiet bad ki la tuh ïa ka met jong u katba phi dang ïohthiah .
U la ong , Kine ki saw tylli ki mradkhlaw kiba khraw eh ki long ki saw ki tylli hima ki ban sa mih ha pyrthei ka .
translation.en: These great beasts , which are four , are four kings , which shall arise out of the earth .
Shall I not in that day , saith the  Lord  , even destroy the wise men out of Edom , and understanding out of the mount of Esau ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga pynshitom ïa ki Edom , ngan pynduh noh ïa ki rangbah basian buit jong ki bad pynjah noh ïa ka jingstad jong ki baroh .

translation.en: Go thee one way or other , either on the right hand , or on the left , whithersoever thy face is set .
translation.kha: Ot na sha kamon bad na sha kadiang , pha ka waitlam banep ! Ot na sha kano kano ka phang ba pha phai .

translation.en: The  Lord  is good , a strong hold in the day of trouble  ; and he knoweth them that trust in him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba bha ; u ïada ïa ki briew jong u ha ki por ka jingjynjar ; u ri sumar ïa kito kiba phai sha u .
nga , u Tertios , thoh kane ka shithi nga phah ïa ki .
translation.en: I Tertius , who wrote this epistle , salute you in the Lord .
By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all .

Hato uno uno un nud ban ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , Balei phi pynlong ïa nga kumne ?
translation.en: Woe unto him that saith unto his father , What begettest thou ? or to the woman , What hast thou brought forth ?
When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon , and into the cabins , and Jeremiah had remained there many days  ;
translation.kha: Ïa nga la set ha ka kamra kaba shapoh khyndew bad la set slem ïa nga hangta .

translation.en: Be strong and courageous , be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria , nor for all the multitude that is with him : for there be more with us than with him :
translation.kha: U ong ha ki ,  To long kiba kut jingmut bad kiba sngewskhem , bad wat sheptieng ïa u patsha ki nong Assyria lane ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba u ïalam . Ngi don kham bun ka bor ha ka liang jong ngi ban ïa kaba u don ha ka liang jong u .
badonburom ha 29 uno Peullethai pan pyn-ap phi Bamoth kano kano , bad haba uno uno u shim ïa bashapoh kaba khmut Jamin jong phi , wat pan Shomer ïa ka .
translation.en: Give to every man that asketh of thee  ; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again .

translation.kha: ( Naba ki Saddusi ki ong ba kin ym na jingïap bad ba ym angel lane ki mynsiem ; hynrei ki Pharisi ki ngeit ïa kine baroh lai tylli . )
translation.en: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection , neither angel , nor spirit : but the Pharisees confess both .

( U Trai u la ong , Ngan ym isynei ïano ha . Ma nga da lade ngan buh ïa ki briew baroh ka bor jong ki nongsynshar jong ki . Kine ki nongsynshar kin pynjot ïa ka pyrthei bad ngan ym pyllait ïa ka bor jong ki . )
translation.en: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land , saith the  Lord  : but , lo , I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour s hand , and into the hand of his king : and they shall smite the land , and out of their hand I will not deliver them .
Wilt thou trust him , because his strength is great ? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban shaniah ha ka jingkhlaiñ bakhraw jong u bad khmih lynti ïa u ban trei ïa ki kam bakhia jong me ?

translation.en: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this : why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings ?
translation.kha: Leh ïa kane shisyndon , khnang ba yn ym don shuh ka jingma ïa ki jingthmu jong nga .
Nga don hangne hapdeng ki briew ïa kiba me la kum la , ki briew kiba bun katta ba ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki .
translation.en: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen , a great people , that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude .

translation.kha: Kito kiba ong ïa kita kiei kiei , ki shai ba ki ïawad ïa ka ri la ka jong hi .
translation.en: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country .
If thou shalt do this thing , and God command thee so , then thou shalt be able to endure , and all this people shall also go to their place in peace .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh ïa kane , kumba U Blei u hukum , phin ym pynthait ïa lade , bad kine ki briew baroh ki lah ban leit sha ïing hadien ba la bishar ïa ki jingïakajia jong ki .

translation.en: Which the  Lord  commanded Moses in mount Sinai , in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the  Lord  , in the wilderness of Sinai .
translation.kha: Hangta halor u Lum Sinai ha ka ri shyiap , U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha u Moses ha kata ka sngi ba u la ong ïa ki paid Israel ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh jong ki .
Simon U hi ruh u la ngeit ; bad hadien ba la pynbaptis ïa u , u la bud kti ha ha kjat ïa Philip u bad u la sngewlyngngoh haba u la ïohi ïa ki kamphylla bad ki kambah ïa kiba la leh .
translation.en: Then Simon himself believed also : and when he was baptized , he continued with Philip , and wondered , beholding the miracles and signs which were done .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki Pynkheiñ ha Snam ki la ïohsngew pop! u Paul u la ïalap ïa ka ktien U Blei ha Beria ruh , shatri dur ïawan ieid bad ki la sdang ban pynkhih bad pynkulmar borbah u paidbhur .
translation.en: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea , they came thither also , and stirred up the people .
For John was not yet cast into prison .
translation.kha: ( Kane ka la long ha shuwa ban set byndi ïa u Ïoannis . )

translation.en: The  Lord  is good unto them that wait for him , to the soul that seeketh him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba bha ïa uwei pa uwei uba shaniah ha u ,

translation.en: And if thou say in thine heart , Wherefore come these things upon me ? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered , and thy heels made bare .
translation.kha: Lada pha kylli balei kane baroh ka la jia ha pha — balei ba ki jaiñ jong pha ki la kad noh bad pha la shah batbor — ka dei namar ba ka pop jong pha ka long kaba shyrkhei .

translation.en: And I brought you into a plentiful country , to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof  ; but when ye entered , ye defiled my land , and made mine heritage an abomination .
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka ri baseisoh , ban lehkmen ïa ki jingot jong ka , bad kiei kiei kiwei pat kiba bha jong ka . Hynrei pynban ki la pynjot ïa ka ri jong nga , ki la pyntngit ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki .

U la kurup ïa ka bad ïa u jingringdur jong ka , bad ïa baroh ki shatei Parosh markhap . Ki pynïap lut ïa uwei pa uwei hangta . U Joshua u Semar leh ïa ka Debir bad ïa u syiem jong ka kumba u la leh ïa jingkhan Hebron bad Lappidoth kaw Libnah bad u syiem jong khlong .
translation.en: And he took it , and the king thereof , and all the cities thereof  ; and they smote them with the edge of the sword , and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein  ; he left none remaining : as he had done to Hebron , so he did to Debir , and to the king thereof  ; as he had done also to Libnah , and to her king .
A husband should love his wife just as he loves himself .
translation.kha: U tnga u dei ban ieit ïa la ka tnga kumba u ieit ïalade .
Nangta ki Salekah sdang ban kylli para ma ki Elisha napdeng jong Harhas uba elders ban long u ban sa leh juh kane .
translation.en: And they began to enquire among themselves , which of them it was that should do this thing .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un shim ïa uta u khunlangbrot bad ïa kata ka umphniang Olib bad un ïa ai ki kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang ha U Trai na ka bynta u . lyngdoh
translation.en: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering , and the log of oil , and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Nga kloi la ban ïasaid ïa ka kam ka jong nga . Namar nga tip ba ngam shym bakla .
translation.en: Behold now , I have ordered my cause  ; I know that I shall be justified .

translation.kha: Bad .—Markos ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei kin tip ba jingpynphai U Trai hi u long U Blei — ym don uwei pat .
translation.en: That all the people of the earth may know that the  Lord  is God , and that there is none else .

translation.kha: Pynphong ïa ka jaiñspong ha ka khlieh jong u bad teh halor jong ka ïa ka dak ka ba la thoh ‘ La U Trai .’
translation.en: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head , and put the holy crown upon the mitre .

translation.kha: Ki don u syiem uba synshar halor jong ki , uba long u angel uba khmih ïa ka liewlong ba khlem trai . Ka kyrteng jong u ha ka ktien Hebru ka long u Abaddon ; bad ha Grik ka ktien ka long u Apollyon ( kaba u mut Nongpynjot ) .
translation.en: And they had a king over them , which is the angel of the bottomless pit , whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon , but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ïa ka baroh kat ïohi , bad kan long ka jong me .
translation.en: For all the land which thou seest , to thee will I give it , and to thy seed for ever .

translation.kha: U la poi kham sha ka nongbah , bad la ïohi ka , u la jong ka , da ong ,
translation.en: And when he was come near , he beheld the city , and wept over it ,
And Ruth the Moabitess said , He said unto me also , Thou shalt keep fast by my young men , until they have ended all my harvest .
translation.kha: Nangta ka Ruth ka ong ,  Kaba kor tam na baroh , u ong ba ngan ïai tam kew bad ki nongtrei jong u haduh ba kin da pyndep ïa ka jingot .
Hynrei haba u briew da bitar kaba u pynïap khnang ïa uwei pat , ban dei pynïap ïa u , wat la u wan ban rieh ha ka duwan jong nga .
translation.en: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour , to slay him with guile  ; thou shalt take him from mine altar , that he may die .
And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I have dreamed a dream , and there is none that can interpret it : and I have heard say of thee , that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u ,  Nga la phohsniew ïa ka jingphohsniew , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban batai ïa ka . La ïathuh ha nga ba me lah ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew .

translation.en: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong katto katne na ki , ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .

Kin jngai bah na ka , ba ki sheptieng ban bynta ha ki jingshitom jong ka . Ki ong Katno kaba ishyrkhei Katno kaba itriem ! ka nongbah Babilon kaba khraw bad kaba ! Tang hapoh shi kynta pha la shah pynshitom !
translation.en: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment , saying , Alas , alas , that great city Babylon , that mighty city ! for in one hour is thy judgment come .

translation.kha: Ki ïa ïathuh kaei ba yn leh ïa uta u briew uba pynïap ïa u Goliath .
translation.en: And the people answered him after this manner , saying , So shall it be done to the man that killeth him .

Behold , I am against thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will burn her chariots in the smoke , and the sword shall devour thy young lions : and I will cut off thy prey from the earth , and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard .
translation.kha: Nga long u nongshun jong pha !  ong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .  Ngan thang ïa ki kali ïapom jong pha . Ïa ki shipai jong pha yn pynïap ha ka thma , bad ngan shim lut ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la shim na kiwei . Ïa ka jingdawa jong ki nongsynran jong pha yn ym ïohsngew shuh .
Haba ngi la poi ha phatok , ngi la shem ba la khang pynskhem ïa ka bad baroh ki nongap phira ap kiba ki don ha khyrdop ka ; hynrei haba ngi la plie ki ïa khyrdop , ngim shem ïano ïano ruh hapoh !
translation.en: Saying , The prison truly found we shut with all safety , and the keepers standing without before the doors : but when we had opened , we found no man within .

translation.en: For the love of money is the root of all evil : which while some coveted after , they have erred from the faith , and pierced themselves through with many sorrows .

translation.en: And the children of Israel fled before Judah : and God delivered them into their hand .

translation.en: Then the soldiers , when they had crucified Jesus , took his garments , and made four parts , to every soldier a part  ; and also his coat : now the coat was without seam , woven from the top throughout .

translation.kha: U syiem Jehoïakim u la lum khajna na ki briew kat kum ka jingdon spah jong ki , khnang ban pynmih ïa ka pisa ba dei ban siew ïa ka bai nguh syiem kumba la dawa da u syiem Ijipt .

translation.en: And Micaiah said , Behold , thou shalt see in that day , when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself .

translation.kha: Kata ka ka ong ha u , Kynrad hato nga pan shynrang na phi ? Hato ngam shym ïathuh ïa phi ban ym kyntiew ïa ki nga ?
translation.en: Then she said , Did I desire a son of my lord ? did I not say , Do not deceive me ?

translation.en: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour : and he made himself treasuries for silver , and for gold , and for precious stones , and for spices , and for shields , and for all manner of pleasant jewels  ;
Then Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , arose and warred against Israel , and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you :

Hynrei mynta nga ong ha : phi ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad duwai na ka bynta kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa phi ,
translation.en: But I say unto you , Love your enemies , bless them that curse you , do good to them that hate you , and pray for them which despitefully use you , and persecute you  ;
And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee , and began to be sorrowful and very heavy .
translation.kha: U la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros bad ïa ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Sebedi . Ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingpisa lyng-a ka la tyllep ïa u ,

translation.en: Do not ye yet understand , that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly , and is cast out into the draught ?
translation.kha: Hato phim shemphang ? Kano kano kaba rung shapoh ka shyntur jong u briew ka leit shapoh ka kpoh jong u bad nangta pat shabar na ka met jong u .
Naba ïa baroh kiei kiei la thaw da u , bad baroh kiei kiei ki long lyngba jong u bad na ka bynta jong u . Ha U Blei , to long ka junom burom ! . Amen
translation.en: For of him , and through him , and to him , are all things : to whom be glory for ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Kine ki ki dei kyrteng ba la ai ïa u nongshun bakhraw tam jong U Blei .
translation.en: These are terms given to God’s chief enemy .
I have heard the check of my reproach , and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi la ong ka long ka jingñiewbeiñ , hynrei nga tip kumno ngan jubab ïa phi .
Wat ai ïa kaei kaba khuid ha ki — ksew kin shu phai pynban bad tur ban dait ïa phi . Wat bret ïa ki mawlynnai ha khmat ki sniang — kin shu ïuh ïa pynban ki hapoh kjat ka .
translation.en: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs , neither cast ye your pearls before swine , lest they trample them under their feet , and turn again and rend you .
And they shall wander from sea to sea , and from the north even to the east , they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the  Lord  , and shall not find it .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin ïaid sakma na ka Duriaw Baïap sha ka Mediterranian bad nangta shuh shuh na shatei shaduh mihngi . Kin ïakhmih kylleng kylleng ïa ka khubor na U  Trai  , hynrei kin ym shem ïa ka .
ym shongsuk hapdeng ki , bad phin ïoh jaka ban la jong ; hangta U Trai un pynshong syier , un pynduh jingkyrmen bad un pynswai mynsiem ïa phi .
translation.en: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease , neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest : but the  Lord  shall give thee there a trembling heart , and failing of eyes , and sorrow of mind :
And he cast for it four rings of gold , and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof .
translation.kha: U shna saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki ha ki saw tylli ki dong ha kiba don ki kjat jong ka .

translation.en: And Judah did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed , above all that their fathers had done .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad ki leh palat ban pynkhih bitar ïa U pyrshah ïa ki ban ïa kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki baroh ki la leh .

translation.en: And he took it , and did eat before them .
translation.kha: ïa kaba u la shim bad bam ha khmat jong ki .
Kumta u Jakob u shim uwei maw bad u pynïeng ïa kum ka jingsah .
translation.en: And Jacob took a stone , and set it up for a pillar .

Even as Sodom and Gomorrha , and the cities about them in like manner , giving themselves over to fornication , and going after strange flesh , are set forth for an example , suffering the vengeance of eternal fire .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ka Sodom bad Gomorrah , bad ki shnong ba-marjan , ha kaba ki briew ki leh kumba la leh kito ki angel bad ki kyrsum ha ki jingleh nuti bad bajakhlia : Ki shah ïa ka jingpynshitom ha ka ding bymjukut kum ka jingmaham ïa baroh .
Baroh ki pyrshang ban shem sngewbha bad ki briew kiba khraw ; baroh ki kob ïa ka jingïadei paralok bad kiba lah ban pynsngewbha .
translation.en: Many will entreat the favour of the prince : and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts .

translation.kha: Shihajar ngut na phi kin ïaphet krad haba phi ïohi uwei u shipai nongshun , bad san ki pynlong ïa phi ban phet krad . Yn ym don shuh shipai phi ka ban dang lait noh sa tang dieng lama ba sah ha kliar jong u lum !
