briew Ki kiba na ka jait bashaphang shatei phah ki khot ïa u ; bad baroh ki ïaleit lang sha u Rehoboam , bad ki ong ha u ,
translation.en: And they sent and called him . So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam , saying ,

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la pynlut sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet khlem jingbam , U Jisu Nob la Kedar .
translation.en: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights , he was afterward an hungred .
So he took him , and brought him to the chief captain , and said , Paul the prisoner called me unto him , and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee , who hath something to say unto thee .
translation.kha: U rangbah pynïaidkam u la shim ïa u , u la ïalam ïa u sha u rangbah ai hukum , bad u la ong ,  U Paul , u koidi , u la khot ïa nga bad kyrpad ïa nga ban wallam ïa une u samla sha me , namar ba u don ei ei ban ong ha me .

translation.en: And two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , such as he is able to get  ; and the one shall be a sin offering , and the other a burnt offering .
translation.kha: Un wallam ruh ar tylli ki paro ne ki lyngdkhur , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad kawei pat na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang .
Haba ngon Baalgad u la ïaphawar shispah san snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Enosh ,
translation.en: And Seth lived an hundred and five years , and begat Enos :

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi kaba nyngkong , phin shim ki ïa soh kiba kynsai , ïa ki tnat dieng Tlai , bad ïa ki tnat dieng kiba bun sla bad , sdang kane ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam ban ai burom ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees , branches of palm trees , and the boughs of thick trees , and willows of the brook  ; and ye shall rejoice before the  Lord  your God seven days .

And Joshua answered them , If thou be a great people , then get thee up to the wood country , and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants , if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee .
translation.kha: U Joshua u jubab ,  Lada phi ïabun paid haduh katta katta bad ba ka ri lum Ephraim ka rit than ïa phi , te khie leit sha ki khlaw bad prat na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka ri ki Peris bad ki Rephaim .

translation.en: And Israel joined himself unto Baal–peor : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki ,

translation.en: And they said , The man asked us straitly of our state , and of our kindred , saying , Is your father yet alive ? have ye another brother ? and we told him according to the tenor of these words : could we certainly know that he would say , Bring your brother down ?
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Uta u briew u ïai kylli bniah shaphang jong ngi bad shaphang ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ngi , u da ong , ‘ I pa jong phi i dang im ne em ? Phi dang don para shynrang shuh ?’ Ngi hap ban jubab ïa kita ki jingkylli . Kumno ngi lah ban tip ba un ong ïa ngi ban wan ïalam ïa u para jong ngi ?

translation.en: Then I commended mirth , because a man hath no better thing under the sun , than to eat , and to drink , and to be merry : for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life , which God giveth him under the sun .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la pdiang ba u briew u dei ban pynsngewbha ïa lade namar ka jingpynsngewbha kaba tang ma ka kaba u ïoh ha kane ka jingim ka long ka jingïabam bad ka jingïadih bad ka jinglehsngewbha ïa lade . U lah la kumno kumno ban leh ïa kane katba u trei ha ka jingim kaba U Blei u la ai ha u ha kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Our soul waiteth for the  Lord  : he is our help and our shield .
translation.kha: Ngi buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha U  Trai  ; u long ka jingïada bad ka jingïarap jong ngi .

Ki briew jong ka Judah ong ki , Ngi la ïohsngew katno briew ki jong ka Moab ki long kiba sarong . Ngi tip ba ki long kiba sngewmeng bad kiba sarong palat , hynrei ka jingkob jong ki ka kaba long thylli .
translation.en: We have heard of the pride of Moab  ; he is very proud : even of his haughtiness , and his pride , and his wrath : but his lies shall not be so .
And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight , to them that have sworn oaths : but he will call to remembrance the iniquity , that they may be taken .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem kim lah ban ngeit ïa kane , namar ki jingïateh lok kiba ki la pynlong . Hynrei kane ka jingïathuhlypa ka long ban pynkynmaw ïa ki ïa ki pop jong ki bad ban maham ïa ki ba kin sa shah kurup .
Ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor Blei ka dei ban long kaba synshar , namar Blei um kwah ngi ban long ha jingkynrum kynram ha ka jingryntih bad ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: For God is not the author of confusion , but of peace , as in all churches of the saints .
And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth  ; for I have hoped in thy judgments .
translation.kha: Pynlah ïa nga ban kren ïa ka jingshisha ha ki por baroh , namar ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka long ha ki jingbishar jong me .

dei .’—2 u , uba pynlah ïa ngi ban shakri ïa ka jutang kaba thymmai , kaba khlem kynthup ïa ka Shittah ba Sarephath thoh hynrei kaba da U Mynsiem . Ka khmat ba la thoh ka wallam ïa ka jaiñkup , hynrei U Mynsiem u ai jingim :9
translation.en: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament ; not of the letter , but of the spirit : for the letter killeth , but the spirit giveth life .
And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the  Lord  , died , being an hundred and ten years old .
translation.kha: U Joshua u shakri U  Trai  , u khun jong u Nun , u la ïap ha ka rta kaba shispah shiphew snem .

Hynrei u kpa jong u , u kyrngah bad u ong , Nga tip , khun ; nga tip Ki ki ksiew jong u Manasseh ruh kin kylla long jaitbynriew kaba khraw . Hynrei u para u un kham khraw ban ïa u , bad ki ki jong u kin kylla long ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw
translation.en: And his father refused , and said , I know it , my son , I know it : he also shall become a people , and he also shall be great : but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he , and his seed shall become a multitude of nations .

translation.kha: jingjubab la tan ïa ki lieng sangsot duriaw , ki umpohliew iehnoh jingnang kiei kiei baroh bad ki la bud jingmynthi U Jisu .
translation.en: And when they had brought their ships to land , they forsook all , and followed him .

translation.kha: Ashkenas Kpa uba im u isangsot jingjam ïa nga , bad jingïatylli jong u nga ruh nga im . Ha kajuh ka rukom uno uno uba ïongjngum Mikhael nga erlangthari im namar jong nga .
translation.en: As the living Father hath sent me , and I live by the Father : so he that eateth me , even he shall live by me .
Or , Deliver me from the enemy s hand ? or , Redeem me from the hand of the mighty ?
translation.kha: lane ban pyllait im ïa nga na uno uno u nongshun ne u nongbanbor ?

translation.en: Surely the isles shall wait for me , and the ships of Tarshish first , to bring thy sons from far , their silver and their gold with them , unto the name of the  Lord  thy God , and to the Holy One of Israel , because he hath glorified thee .
translation.kha: Ki dei ki liengbah kiba wan na ki ri kiba jngai , ki wallam ïa ki paidlang U Blei sha la ïing . Ki wanrah ryngkat bad ki ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ban pyndonburom ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai U Blei Bakhuid ka Israel , uba pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ban pyndonburom ïa ki briew jong u .

translation.en: Go ye , enquire of the  Lord  for me , and for the people , and for all Judah , concerning the words of this book that is found : for great is the wrath of the  Lord  that is kindled against us , because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book , to do according unto all that which is written concerning us .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad kylli na U  Trai  na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ki briew baroh jong ka Judah shaphang ka jinghikai jong kane ka Kitab . U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ngi namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la leh ïa kaei ba kane ka Kitab ka ong ba dei ban leh .

ki Ko paid Israel sangeh , kaba noh rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam kum ki riewthala . Phi la phai lyndet na la U Blei bad phi la long ki bymïaineh ha u . Ha baroh kawei ka ri phi la die ïa lade kum ki nuti ha u blei Baal bad phi la ieit ïa u kew uba pyrkhat ba phi u la siew na ka bynta jong phi !
translation.en: Rejoice not , O Israel , for joy , as other people : for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God , thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor .

translation.kha: Ka khun pynsat Pharaoh Tamar pynsmai ha ka , Khie leit . Kumta Rabboni ka khynnah pynheh leit bad ka lyiur ïalam da ka kmie jong uta u khunlung hi .
translation.en: And Pharaoh s daughter said to her , Go . And the maid went and called the child s mother .
And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain , and passed over Jordan , and went through all Bithron , and they came to Mahanaim .
translation.kha: U Abner bad ki briew jong u ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka Them Jordan baroh shi miet ; ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan , bad hadien ba ki la ïaid baroh shi step ha ka step kaba bud , ki la wan poi biang ha Mahanaim .

translation.en: For a small moment have I forsaken thee  ; but with great mercies will I gather thee .
translation.kha: Tang shipor nga la iehnoh ïa pha ; da ka jingieit kaba jylliew ngan shim pat ïa pha .
sngi lynter ïabam ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat , bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew phin pynlong ïa Jingkhawai Niam ban pyndonburom ïa U Trai
translation.en: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread , and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Shisyndon ki la lynñiar , Me kwah aïu bad ngi , me U Khun jong U Blei ? Hato me la ban wan pynshitom ngi ïa ha shuwa ka por kaba dei ?
translation.en: And , behold , they cried out , saying , What have we to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of God ? art thou come hither to torment us before the time ?

Then came Eliakim , the son of Hilkiah , that was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , the son of Asaph , the recorder , to Hezekiah with their clothes rent , and told him the words of Rabshakeh .
translation.kha: Te u Eliakim , u Shebna bad u Joah ki la tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih bad leit bad ïathuh ha u syiem ïa kaei kaba u rangbah synshar Assyria u la ong .
Ngi la kohnguh ïa baroh ki jingbthah ba u Jonadab u la ha ngi . Ma ngi hi ngim ju dih waiñ lymne ki tnga jong ngi , khun shynrang jong ngi , lane ki kynthei jong ngi .
translation.en: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jehonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us , to drink no wine all our days , we , our wives , our sons , nor our daughters  ;
Till we all come in the unity of the faith , and of the knowledge of the Son of God , unto a perfect man , unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ :
translation.kha: Haduh ngi baroh ngin wan ha ka jingtylli jong ka jingneit bad ha ka jingtip jong ngi ïa U Khun U Blei ; ngin long ki briew kiba rangbah bha , kiba kot shaduh ka rynïeng ka jinglong rangbah pura U Khrist .

translation.en: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry : for anger resteth in the bosom of fools .
translation.kha: Bat synshar ïa la ka jingkhluit khlieh ; ka long ka jingbieit ban pynlang ïa ka jingbatnud .

translation.en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together , and came and pitched in Shunem : and Saul gathered all Israel together , and they pitched in Gilboa .
translation.kha: Ki shipai Philistia ki ïalumlang bad ki wan sher dara ha Shunem ; u Saul pat u lumlang ïa ki Israel baroh bad ki sher dara ha u Lum Gilboa .

U Rangbah lyngdoh ha uba ïa ka umphniang pynsleh la theh ha ka khlieh jong u , bad ïa uba la pynkyntang phong ban ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh , um dei ban ieh ra-ngiep ïa la u lane shñiuh kad ïa ki la jaiñkup .
translation.en: And he that is the high priest among his brethren , upon whose head the anointing oil was poured , and that is consecrated to put on the garments , shall not uncover his head , nor rend his clothes  ;
And the heat-parched ground will have become as a reedy pool , and the thirsty ground as springs of water .”—Isaiah 35 :1 , 6 , 7 .
translation.kha: U shyiap uba shit phyrnai un long ka pung , bad ka khyndew kaba thrang um kan long ki umpohliew . —Isaïah 35 :1 , 6 , 7 .
U Soitan u , Hato u Job un mane ïa me lada um ïoh ei na ka ?
translation.en: Then Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , Doth Job fear God for nought ?
And come to the king , and speak on this manner unto him . So Joab put the words in her mouth .
translation.kha: Nangta leit sha u syiem bad ong ha u ïa kaei kaba nga bthah ïa phi ban ong .  Nangta u Joab u la ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei ban ong .

translation.en: Then saith he unto his disciples ,  The harvest truly is plenteous , but the labourers are few  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  Ka jingot ka khraw eh , hynrei don khyndiat ki nongtrei ban lumlang ïa ka shapoh .

translation.en: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place  ; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father s house .
translation.kha: Ngan pynskhem triang ïa u kum ïa u snar , bad un long ka tynrai jong ka jingpyndonburom ïa ka longïing jong u baroh kawei .

U syiem Ammon phngoid bymseisoh Addi ki nonglamktien u Jephthah , Mynba ki Israel ki Tiberios na pynstang , ki la knieh dustur ryñiot ri laitim nga naduh ka wah Arnon haduh ka wah Jabbok bad ka jingtynjuh Jordan . Mynta me dei ban pynphai noh jingbynta ka da traishnong suk .
translation.en: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah , Because Israel took away my land , when they came up out of Egypt , from Arnon even unto Jabbok , and unto Jordan : now therefore restore those lands again peaceably .
So David gathered all Israel together , from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hamath , to bring the ark of God from Kirjath–jearim .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u lumlang ïa ki paid Israel na baroh kawei ka ri , naduh khappud Ijipt ha ka phang shathie sha Khim Hamath ha ka phang shatei , khnang ban wallam ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang na Kiriath Jearim sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Saying , The Lord is risen indeed , and hath appeared to Simon .
translation.kha: U Trai u la mihpat da shisha ! U la paw ha u Simon !

Lehkmen ha khmat U Trai ryngkat bad ki Jingpynshitom ki kti jong phi , ki shakri shakor jong phi , bad ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , Enosh ki riewkynthei Parosh shong ha ki shnong jong phi . Leh ïa kane ha kata ka :15 mane Blei .
translation.en: And thou shalt rejoice before the  Lord  thy God , thou , and thy son , and thy daughter , and thy manservant , and thy maidservant , and the Levite that is within thy gates , and the stranger , and the fatherless , and the widow , that are among you , in the place which the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to place his name there .

Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast , the nation of the Cherethites ! the word of the  Lord  is against you  ; O Canaan , the land of the Philistines , I will even destroy thee , that there shall be no inhabitant .
translation.kha: Ma phi ki Philistia phi long kiba la tim , phi ki briew kiba shong basah ha shi lynter jong ka rud duriaw . U  Trai  u la ai ka rai bishar halor jong phi . Un pynjot ïa phi , bad yn ym pynsah ïa uwei ruh .
Hynrei u Petros u la ong ha u , don Ngam pisa ei ei , hynrei nga ai ha me ïa kaei kaba nga don : Ha ka jong kyrteng U Jisu Khrist uba na Nasareth nga hukum ïa me ïeng ban joit bad ïaid !
translation.en: Then Peter said , Silver and gold have I none  ; but such as I have give I thee : In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk .

translation.kha: la kum ki kulai ba la bsa bha , ki bym lah synshar ha ki jingkwah , uwei pa uwei da kwah ïa tnga jong u paramarjan jong u .
translation.en: They were as fed horses in the morning : every one neighed after his neighbour s wife .

translation.kha: kaba nyngkong , ki briew ha ka baroh ki la don tang kawei ka ktien ka thylliej bad ïa kijuh ki kyntien
translation.en: And the whole earth was of one language , and of one speech .

translation.kha: Nangta u Hananaïah u la loit ïa na u ryndang jong nga , la pynkheiñ lyngkhot ka ,
translation.en: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah s neck , and brake it .

translation.kha: wat la don katto katne ngut kiba kwah ban ïa pyndep ka . Da kaba leh mynleh kum ki , parabangeit kine ki rangbah ki la ïohrung shapoh ka kynhun jong ngi kum ki nongsyntiat , khnang ban lap shaphang ka jinglaitluid kaba ngi la mad da ka jingpynïasoh jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in , who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus , that they might bring us into bondage :

translation.kha: Ki jubab Proberb Mynta ngi blaid ba U Trai u don bad phi , bad tbeh daiñ ba ka dei main don ka jingïateh kular Bethel hapdeng mawbah ngi Serubbabel
translation.en: And they said , We saw certainly that the  Lord  was with thee : and we said , Let there be now an oath betwixt us , even betwixt us and thee , and let us make a covenant with thee  ;

translation.kha: Wat sngewlyngngoh ha kane ; ba ka por kan wan haba baroh kiba kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong bad kin jingtep jong : Kito kiba la leh ïa kaba bha kin mihpat bad kin im , bad kito kiba la leh ïa kaba sniew kin mihpat bad yn pynrem ïa ki .
translation.en: And shall come forth  ; they that have done good , unto the resurrection of life  ; and they that have done evil , unto the resurrection of damnation .
What is man , that thou shouldest magnify him ? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him ?
translation.kha: Balei ki briew ki long kiba donkam ha me ? Balei me da peit bniah ïa kaei ba ki leh ?

Katba phi dang im , ma phi bad ki ki khun ksiew jong phi , phi dei ban tiengburom ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ïa kiba nga ai phi ha , khnang ba phi lah ban im slem ha ka kata ri .
translation.en: That thou mightest fear the  Lord  thy God , to keep all his statutes and his commandments , which I command thee , thou , and thy son , and thy son s son , all the days of thy life  ; and that thy days may be prolonged .
That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong , so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress .
translation.kha: U wallam jingjot ha kiba khlaiñ bad ïa ki Kut baskhem jong ki .

translation.en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering , or for a sacrifice in performing a vow , or peace offerings unto the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Haba la wanrah ïa u masi kum ka jingainguh thang , lane kum ka jingkñia ha kaba pyndep ïa kano kano ka jingsmai skhem , lane kum ka jingainguh jingpynïasuk ,

translation.en: Speak , and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , Pharaoh king of Egypt , the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers , which hath said , My river is mine own , and I have made it for myself .
translation.kha: To ong ba kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ïathuh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt : Nga long u nongshun jong me , ma me u kuratia bakynsha , uba dem ha ka wah . Me ong ba ka wah Nile ka long ka jong me bad ba me la pynlong ïa ka .

translation.en: On this side Jordan , in the valley over against Beth–peor , in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites , who dwelt at Heshbon , whom Moses and the children of Israel smote , after they were come forth out of Egypt :
translation.kha: Dei hadien ba ki la wan mih na Ijipt bad mynba ki don ha kata ka them kaba sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan , marpyrshah ïa ka shnong Bethpeor , ba u ai ha ki ïa kine ki hukum . Kane ka long ha ka hima u Sihon u syiem Amor , uba synshar ha ka shnong Heshbon . Mynba U Moses bad ki Israel ki la jop ïa u ynda ki la mih na Ijipt .
Ka ha ong la u tnga , Nga thikna ba une u briew uba wan bunsien hangne u dei u riewkhuid .
translation.en: And she said unto her husband , Behold now , I perceive that this is an holy man of God , which passeth by us continually .
Answer a fool according to his folly , lest he be wise in his own conceit .
translation.kha: Ai ka jubab bieit ïa ka jingkylli bieit , bad uta uba kylli ïa ka un sngewthuh ba um long uba stad kumba u pyrkhat .

Kumta U Moses u Ha ong , kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti , ki briew ki shahshkor ïa kito kiba shat kheiñ kiba bad kiba wad ïa ki dak ki shin , hynrei U Trai U Blei jong phi u khang ïa phi ban leh kumta .
translation.en: For these nations , which thou shalt possess , hearkened unto observers of times , and unto diviners : but as for thee , the  Lord  thy God hath not suffered thee so to do .
The morning is come unto thee , O thou that dwellest in the land : the time is come , the day of trouble is near , and not the sounding again of the mountains .
translation.kha: Kaba kut ka la wan ha phi ki briew kiba shong ha ka ri . Ka por ka la jan ha kaba yn ym don shuh ka jingïaleh kmen ha ki jaka mane ha ki lumbah , tang ka jingkulmar suda .

translation.en: But Esaias is very bold , and saith , I was found of them that sought me not ; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me .
translation.kha: Bad u Isaïah u la long uba kham shlur haba u ong ,  Ïa nga la shem da kito ki bym shym la wad ïa nga ; nga la paw ha kito ki bym shym la kylli ïa nga .
La ban ïa nga da ka jingsngewsih ; to pynkhlaiñ ïa , nga kumba me la kular .
translation.en: My soul melteth for heaviness : strengthen thou me according unto thy word .
Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that they shall no more say , The  Lord  liveth , which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt  ;
translation.kha: Ka por kan wan  , ong U  Trai  ,  haba ki briew kin ym smai shuh da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa u paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt .

U u Trai la ong , Ko khun u briew , shim ïa ka waitlam kaba nep , bad pyndonkam ïa ka ban khi ïa la u ñiuhtmoh bad u ñiuhkhlieh jong me baroh . Nangta thew u ïa shñiuh ka ha tarajur bad pynbynta ïa u ha ki lai bynta .
translation.en: And thou , son of man , take thee a sharp knife , take thee a barber s razor , and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard : then take thee balances to weigh , and divide the hair .

translation.kha: U Shem , u hynmen jong u Japheth , u la long u kpa tymmen jong Hebru ki baroh .
translation.en: Unto Shem also , the father of all the children of Eber , the brother of Japheth the elder , even to him were children born .

And so return unto thee with all their heart , and with all their soul , in the land of their enemies , which led them away captive , and pray unto thee toward their land , which thou gavest unto their fathers , the city which thou hast chosen , and the house which I have built for thy name :
translation.kha: Lada ha kata ka ri ki kylla-kaba-mut da kaba shisha bad kaba sngur mynsiem , bad ki duwai ha me da kaba phai khmat sha kane ka ri kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , sha kane ka nongbah kaba me la jied , bad sha kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei na ka bynta jong me , to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .

translation.en: And Noah awoke from his wine , and knew what his younger son had done unto him .
translation.kha: Ynda u Noah u la pyngngad , bad u la tip aïu u khun khatduh jong u , u la leh ïa u ,
Ha kata ka khyllipmat u Sekharaïah u la lah pat ban kren , bad la u sdang ban ïaroh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And his mouth was opened immediately , and his tongue loosed , and he spake , and praised God .
And when he looked on him , he was afraid , and said , What is it , Lord ? And he said unto him , Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God .

Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you : and , lo , I am with you alway , even unto the end of the world . Amen .
translation.kha: bad hikai ïa ki ban kohnguh ha kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ïa phi . Bad ngan ïai don ryngkat lem bad phi , haduh kaba kut ka Ïa .

Katba ki dang pynsngewbha dustur lade kumta , kynsan kynsan jied don ki riewthala na kata ka shnong ki kerkut ïabuh kata ka Piram , ki da tied tyngeh ïa tei jingkhang . Ki ong Samuel uta u tymmen , Sei shabar ïa uto Syros briew uba rung ha prong jong plain ! Ngin ïathiah shongkha bad u !
translation.en: Now as they were making their hearts merry , behold , the men of the city , certain sons of Belial , beset the house round about , and beat at the door , and spake to the master of the house , the old man , saying , Bring forth the man that came into thine house , that we may know him .
Which was the son of Jesse , which was the son of Obed , which was the son of Booz , which was the son of Salmon , which was the son of Naasson ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Jesse , u khun jong u Obed , u khun jong u Boas , u khun jong u Salmon , u khun jong u Nahshon ,

Ki long ki mynsiem jong ki ksuid kiba leh ïa ki kambah . Kine lai tylli ki mynsiem ki leit noh sha ki syiem baroh jong ka pyrthei , ban lumlang ïa jingtyrwa na ka bynta jingot thma ha ka Sngi kaba khraw jong U jngoh Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: For they are the spirits of devils , working miracles , which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world , to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty .

translation.kha: Khmih ïa u kpu jong ngi . Mynba ngi na ïing bad u bad wan ïakynduh ïa , u dang syiad . Hynrei ha khmih ! u la tyrkhong bad la bthuh .
translation.en: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you  ; but now , behold , it is dry , and it is mouldy :

Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month , when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land , ye shall keep a feast unto the  Lord  seven days : on the first day shall be a sabbath , and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath .
translation.kha: Ynda phi la dep lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam hynñiew sngi naduh ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew . Ka sngi nyngkong ka dei ka sngi shongthait , bad kumjuh ruh ka sngi kaba phra .

translation.en: Woe to thee that spoilest , and thou wast not spoiled  ; and dealest treacherously , and they dealt not treacherously with thee ! when thou shalt cease to spoil , thou shalt be spoiled  ; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously , they shall deal treacherously with thee .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki la shahjop ! Ki la lute bad shetkylla , wat la ym shym don kiba la lute ne shetkylla ïa ki . Hynrei ka por ban lute bad shetkylla kan kut , bad ma ki hi kin sa long kiba shah lute bad kiba shah shetkylla .

Kumta nga leit sha u bad nga pynïap ïa u , namar nga tip ba un sa hi la kumno un tang shu kyllon . Nangta nga shim ïa ka pansngiat na ka jong bad ïa ka jingdeng ka ksang jong bad nga la wallam ïa ki sha phi , ko kynrad .
translation.en: So I stood upon him , and slew him , because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen : and I took the crown that was upon his head , and the bracelet that was on his arm , and have brought them hither unto my lord .

translation.kha: A Trai me la ai ngi ki aiñ jong me bad me la ong ïa ngi ban kohnguh biang biang ïa ki .
translation.en: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently .

translation.kha: Mynta to joit ïeng kum u rangbah bad jubab ïa ki jingkylli kiba nga kylli ïa me .
translation.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man  ; for I will demand of thee , and answer thou me .

translation.kha: U Neko u pynlong ïa u Eliakim u para jong u Joahas kum Judah bad u pynkylla ïa kyrteng jong u sha u Jehoïakim . Ïa u Joahas la ïalam sha Ijipt da u Neko .
translation.en: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem , and turned his name to Jehoiakim . And Neco took Jehoahaz his brother , and carried him to Egypt .

translation.kha: Ka sur ka la kren biang na , bneng ‘ Wat ñiew bymkhuid ïa kano kano U kaba Blei u la pynbna ba ka long kaba khuid .’
translation.en: But the voice answered me again from heaven ,  What God hath cleansed , that call not thou common .

translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka la poi , baroh ki riewngeit ki ïalumlang ha kawei ka jaka .
translation.en: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come , they were all with one accord in one place .

translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u la kren ha uta uwei , Khie bad ong ha u samla uba don u ksai yn sa don bun byllien ki briew bad shibun bah ki jingri ha Jerusalem , long kaba heh ban don kynroh .
translation.en: And said unto him , Run , speak to this young man , saying , Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein :

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pop jong ka Bithynia ki khynñiuh nongsiatkhnam ka jingsheptieng . Ki ong Hangne Ka Pynshad U Blei ka long kum ka ding kaba meh Makedonia . Hato uno uno na ngi un lait im na bapawkhmat Ruphos kaba kum kata ?
translation.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid  ; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites . Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire ? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings ?

For Tophet is ordained of old  ; yea , for the king it is prepared  ; he hath made it deep and large : the pile thereof is fire and much wood  ; the breath of the  Lord  , like a stream of brimstone , doth kindle it .
translation.kha: Naduh mynshuwa eh ïa ka jaka la pynkhreh ha kaba ka ding bajur kan thang ïa u patsha ka Assyria . Ka long kaba jylliew bad kaba ïar , bad ba la kynton jrong da ki diengthang . U  Trai  un pyrsad da ka phylliah ding ban thang ïa ka .
Kim lehrain satia ban ïai Siph ïa nga . Ki ai pahai sien jingpynshoi blei thala ha ki kper bakyntang nongtem thang jingiwbih ha Isaïah duwan ba-thala .
translation.en: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face  ; that sacrificeth in gardens , and burneth incense upon altars of brick  ;

translation.kha: Akhish syiem u hukum ïa ki jingput ban shna ka synduk na jingpdiang bynta phyrngab mraw synñiang kita jakoid buh ïa ka ha ka Naphtali ka Templ Ishod
translation.en: And at the king s commandment they made a chest , and set it without at the gate of the house of the  Lord .
For we have great joy and consolation in thy love , because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee , brother .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit jong me , ko para ba-ieit , ka la wallam ïa ka jingkmen bakhraw bad jingaimynsiem bajur ! Me la pynkmen ïa ki dohnud jong ki briew U Blei baroh .
La pynphai pat ïa ki pisa jong nga , u la khot ïa la hynmen shynrang . Kane hangne ha ka byrni jong nga ! Mar kumta ki rit mynsiem ria , bad da ki ïakylli para ma ki , keiñ kane kaba Blei u la ïa
translation.en: And he said unto his brethren , My money is restored  ; and , lo , it is even in my sack : and their heart failed them , and they were afraid , saying one to another , What is this that God hath done unto us ?

translation.kha: Kane dei ka khubor shaphang Edom Don uwei uba ïa nga na Edom , Ko nongap phira , shen sa ba kan kut ? Ïathuh ïa nga katno shen kan noh .
translation.en: The burden of Dumah . He calleth to me out of Seir , Watchman , what of the night ? Watchman , what of the night ?
No lion shall be there , nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon , it shall not be found there  ; but the redeemed shall walk there :
translation.kha: Yn ym don sing hangta , ym don ki mrad bashyrkhei ki ban ïaid na kata ka lynti . Kito ïa kiba U  Trai  u la pyllait im kin ïaid sha ïing na kata ka lynti .

translation.en: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws , and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk , and the work that they must do .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban hikai ïa ki shaphang ki hukum jong U Blei bad batai ïa ki kumno ki dei ban im bad aïu ki dei ban leh .
Kine ki long ki jingkyrkhu ba u Moses jinglong u briew jong khyllie Blei , u ai ha ki Israel shuwa ba un ïap .
translation.en: And this is the blessing , wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u nongïathuhlypa u leit u sha syiem Ahab , bad u la ong , U Trai u ong , ‘ Wat ïa sheptieng katai ka kynhun shipai kaba heh Ngan ! ai jingjop ïa me jong halor ka mynta ka sngi , bad men ïoh tip ba nga dei U Trai .’
translation.en: And , behold , there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou seen all this great multitude ? behold , I will deliver it into thine hand this day  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U ai ha u ïa ka kopi jong ka jingpynbna kaba u la pynmih ha Susa , kaba hukum ïa jingpynjot ki . Mordekai u ïa ban rah ka sha ka , ban ha ka ïa kaei kaba long , bad ban ong ka ban ïasaid u syiem bad kyrpad u ban jingisynei ïa ki briew jong .
translation.en: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them , to shew it unto Esther , and to declare it unto her , and to charge her that she should go in unto the king , to make supplication unto him , and to make request before him for her people .
We are orphans and fatherless , our mothers are as widows .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kpa jong ngi la pynïap da u nongshun , bad mynta ki kmie jong ngi ki long ki riewkynthei .
la sheptieng , kumta la leit bad buhrieh ïa ka pisa jong me ha ka khyndew . Ha khmih ! hangne ka long kaba dei jong me .’
translation.en: And I was afraid , and went and hid thy talent in the earth : lo , there thou hast that is thine .

translation.kha: Hynrei u pyllait ïa Shynrang kyrduh na ka jingjynjar jong ki bad pynlong ïa ki longïing jong ki ban roi kum ki jingri .
translation.en: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction , and maketh him families like a flock .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai ktien , Hato ngam shym la jied ïa phi kynha khat-ar ngut ? Probins uwei na Enhasor u long u ksuid !
translation.en: Jesus answered them ,  Have not I chosen you twelve , and one of you is a devil ?

translation.kha: Nonghikai ki synran la jubab , shen ki briew hangta la kwah lynthem maw ïa me , bad me ban leit shata
translation.en: His disciples say unto him , Master , the Jews of late sought to stone thee  ; and goest thou thither again ?

translation.kha: To ngin shna kawei ka kamra halor tnum ïing ngin buh jingthiah , kawei miej , kawei ka shuki , bad kawei ka sharak hapoh jong bad u lah ban hangta man ba wan ïa ngi .
translation.en: Let us make a little chamber , I pray thee , on the wall  ; and let us set for him there a bed , and a table , and a stool , and a candlestick : and it shall be , when he cometh to us , that he shall turn in thither .

translation.kha: Burom ïa U Trai U Blei phi jong da kaba phi rakhe ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha u bnai , Abib naba dei ha kawei ka miet jong uta u bnai ba la u pyllait ïa phi na Ijipt .
translation.en: Observe the month of Abib , and keep the passover unto the  Lord  thy God : for in the month of Abib the  Lord  thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night .
And one goat for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , his meat offering , and his drink offering .
translation.kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: Thou hypocrite , first cast out the beam out of thine own eye  ; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother s eye .
translation.kha: Phi u riewarsap ! Nyngkong eh weng noh ïa ka lyngkhot dieng na la ka khmat jong phi hi , bad nangta phin lah ban ïohi shai kdar ban khlaw ïa u thiat na ka khmat u para jong phi .

Nangta u la wan Akhaïa sha , ha kaba u la sah lai U bnai . la khreh ban leit sha Syria haba u la shem ba ki la don ki Jiw kiba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ; kumta u la kut jingmut ban leit phai pat lyngba ka Makedonia .
translation.en: And there abode three months . And when the Jews laid wait for him , as he was about to sail into Syria , he purposed to return through Macedonia .
For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion , How are we spoiled ! we are greatly confounded , because we have forsaken the land , because our dwellings have cast us out .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïam ha Seïon ,  La pynjot ïa ngi ! La pynlehrain khoit ïa ngi ! Ngi dei ban iehnoh ïa ka ri jong ngi ; ïa ki ïing jong ngi la pynkhyllem .

Ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem Benhadad ki ong ha u , Ki jingjubab pahuh Rekem Israel ki dei ki blei lum , bad dei na kata ka daw ba ki Israel ki jop ïa ngi . Hynrei ngin sa jop jingbiria pep ïa ki lada ngi Mahalab ïa ki ha ki bylla madan .
translation.en: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him , Their gods are gods of the hills  ; therefore they were stronger than we  ; but let us fight against them in the plain , and surely we shall be stronger than they .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , U Khrist um shym la shim lade ha ïa kane ka burom ka jinglong Rangbah Lyngdoh . Pynban , U Blei u la ong ha u , Me , me long U Khun jong nga ; ha kane ka sngi nga la long U Kpa jong me .
translation.en: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest  ; but he that said unto him , Thou art my Son , to day have I begotten thee .

translation.kha: Hato u nur-um Absalom u dang im ? U syiem u kylli . U Ahimaas u jubab , Kynrad stem haba u Aïu u idonburom pynïaidkam jong phi u phah ïa nga , nga khampoh ïa shynraiñ jingkhihwin Moab jur , hynrei ngam tip poh dei jingkhawai .
translation.en: And the king said , Is the young man Absalom safe ? And Ahimaaz answered , When Joab sent the king s servant , and me thy servant , I saw a great tumult , but I knew not what it was .

translation.kha: ka Hynrei ong ha la u kpa , To leh kane kawei ïa nga . por Ai ïa nga ar bnai ba ngan ïoh leit sha ki lum bad la ki paralok , ïa-ïam ban sngewsih ba nga dei ban ïap kum kaba dang sotti .
translation.en: And she said unto her father , Let this thing be done for me : let me alone two months , that I may go up and down upon the mountains , and bewail my virginity , I and my fellows .

translation.kha: U briew jinglehkmen jaipdeh uba kyntait ban trei u Atharim pynïap ei ïa lade stong baroh kaba Karpos leh Amminadab long ban pyrkhat shaphang kaei ba u kynshi ban don .
translation.en: The desire of the slothful killeth him  ; for his hands refuse to labour .
And so it was , when Israel had sown , that the Midianites came up , and the Amalekites , and the children of the east , even they came up against them  ;
translation.kha: Man ka por ba ki Israel ki thung jingthung , ki Midian , ki wan bad ki Amalek , bad ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars  hill , and said , Ye men of Athens , I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious .
translation.kha: U Paul u la ïeng ha khmat jong ka dorbar jong ka nongbah bad u la ong ,  Nga ïohi ba ha ki liang baroh ma phi ki nong Athens phi long kiba kit niam bha .

translation.en: And Abimelech rose up , and all the people that were with him , by night , and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies .
translation.kha: Kumta u Abimelekh lem bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la mih mynmiet bad ki rieh shabar ka Shekhem ha ki saw kynhun .

translation.en: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell ;
translation.kha: Naba ka la long da ka jingrai ka jong U Blei hi ba U Khun u la don ha lade hi ïa ka jinglong ba-pura jong U Blei .

translation.en: Then shall we know , if we follow on to know the  Lord  : his going forth is prepared as the morning  ; and he shall come unto us as the rain , as the latter and former rain unto the earth .
translation.kha: To ngin ïai pyrshang ban tip ïa U  Trai . Da shisha un sa wan sha ngi kum ka step phyrngab , shisha kum u slap pyrem uba ai um ïa ka khyndew .
U Trai Nongsynshar u bam , Hadien sawphew snem ngan wallam pat Samson ki nong Ijipt Duriaw ki pynthymmai sha kiba bymman la pynsakma ïa ki ,
translation.en: Yet thus saith the Lord  God   ; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered :
Confounded be all they that serve graven images , that boast themselves of idols : worship him , all ye gods .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba mane bleithaw kin shah pynlehrain , baroh ki blei ki dem ngon ha khmat jong U  Trai .
Weng noh ïa ki jingbymkhuid na ka rupa , bad u nong-ohdur un pynmih ïa kaei kaei kaba . itynnat
translation.en: Take away the dross from the silver , and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer .

translation.kha: ong , Na nongbam mih ka jingbam ; Na wan mih kaba . Hadien lai sngi ruh kim shym lah ban batai ïa kata jingkyntip .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Out of the eater came forth meat , and out of the strong came forth sweetness . And they could not in three days expound the riddle .

translation.kha: briew Ki kin shong kin sah hangta ha ka jingshngain , kin ym shah byrngem shuh da ka jingpynjot .
translation.en: And men shall dwell in it , and there shall be no more utter destruction  ; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited .

translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi lane ïa uno uno uba kam u ban ïathuh ïa la , la ka long da jingphohsniew kaba khot ïa mynsiem jong kiba ïap lane da ka myntor Ma baroh kim ong phi pyndem ha u syiem jong ka Babilonia .
translation.en: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets , nor to your diviners , nor to your dreamers , nor to your enchanters , nor to your sorcerers , which speak unto you , saying , Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon :

translation.kha: bad ki hukum jong nga baroh . Nga long U Trai
translation.en: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : I am the  Lord .
In the same hour came forth fingers of a man s hand , and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaster of the wall of the king s palace : and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan la mihpaw ka kti briew bad ka la sdang ban thoh ha ka kynroh ba la astor jong ka ïingsyiem , ha kaba ka jingshai na ki sharak ka shai phyrnai eh . Bad u syiem u la ïohi ïa ka kti katba ka dang thoh .
‘ Shuwa i ba pa in ïap , i la pynsmai ïa ba nga ngan leit tep ïa i ha ka jingtep ba i pynkhreh la ha Kanaan . Kumta shah ba ngan leit tep ïa i pa , bad hadien kata ngan sa wan phai pat .’
translation.en: My father made me swear , saying , Lo , I die : in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan , there shalt thou bury me . Now therefore let me go up , I pray thee , and bury my father , and I will come again .

And the same hour was there a great earthquake , and the tenth part of the city fell , and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand : and the remnant were affrighted , and gave glory to the God of heaven .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat hi la jia ka jingkhih jumai kaba jur ; shi bynta na ka shiphew bynta jong ka nongbah la pynjot , bad hynñiew hajar ngut ki briew ki la ïap . Kita kiwei pat ki briew ki la sngewtriem bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw U Blei jong ka bneng .

translation.en: The first man is of the earth , earthy : the second man is the Lord from heaven .
translation.kha: Ïa u Adam uba nyngkong , la thaw na ka dewmet , ba la wan na ka khyndew ; u Adam uba ar u la wan na bneng .

translation.en: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them , nor be an help nor profit , but a shame , and also a reproach .
translation.kha: ki briew jong ka Judah kin babe ba ki la shaniah ha kata ka hima ka bym lah ban shaniah , ka hima ka bym lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki haba ki khmih lynti ban ïoh jingïarap .
To pynïeng ki lynti bad ha ka surok ; to wad ïa ka kaba phi la iehnoh . To phai biang , phi ki Israel , to wan la ka ri , sha ki shnong kiba phi iehnoh .
translation.en: Set thee up waymarks , make thee high heaps : set thine heart toward the highway , even the way which thou wentest : turn again , O virgin of Israel , turn again to these thy cities .
And as they departed , Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John ,  What went ye out into the wilderness to see ? A reed shaken with the wind ?
translation.kha: Katba ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki dang mihnoh , U Jisu u la kren shaphang jong u ha ki paidbah ;  Haba phi leit sha u Ïoannis ha ka ri shyiap , kaei kaba phi khmih lynti ban ïohi ? Ïa u sla phlang ba la pynkhun ha ka lyer !

translation.en: Then the steward said within himself , What shall I do ? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship : I cannot dig  ; to beg I am ashamed .
translation.kha: U shakri u la ong ha lade , ‘ U Kynrad jong nga un sa beh ïa nga na ka kam jong nga . Kaei ba ngan leh ? Ngam long uba khlaiñ ban tih kharai , bad nga sngewlehrain ban khrong .

translation.en: Then took Jeremiah another roll , and gave it to Baruch the scribe , the son of Neriah  ; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire : and there were added besides unto them many like words .
translation.kha: Te nga la shim ïa kawei pat ka kot kli bad nga la ai ïa ka ha u sekretari jong nga u Barukh , bad u la thoh hangta ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ong . U la thoh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la don ha ka kot kli kaba nyngkong bad kijuh ki khubor kiba nga la ong ha u ban thoh .

Nga ainguh ïa U Blei , ïa uba nga shakri da ka khubor pynsuk Baibl kumba ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la Elul thohbroin bieit kshaid ïa u haba nga Abib ïa me borabor ha ki jingjynthut Sheba jingpynsngewbha mynmiet nongriam mynsngi .
translation.en: I thank God , whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience , that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day ;

translation.kha: Phi ïa ki maw kiba jlih nangta bad mane ïa ki kum ki blei . Phi ïa ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh ïa ki bad wallam sha ïa ki jingainguh kew . Phi tharai ba ngan sngewbha da kine kiei kiei ?
translation.en: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion  ; they , they are thy lot : even to them hast thou poured a drink offering , thou hast offered a meat offering . Should I receive comfort in these ?

translation.kha: Lada phi thmu sniew borabor , phin sa nam kum u nongthaw .
translation.en: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person .

translation.kha: Ha kane , u Lyngdoh u la tar ïa la ki jaiñ bad u la ong , Ka shuh bun ki sakhi ! Phi dang ïohsngew ka jingkrenbeiñ !
translation.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes , saying , He hath spoken blasphemy  ; what further need have we of witnesses ? behold , now ye have heard his blasphemy .
And he blessed them that day , saying , In thee shall Israel bless , saying , God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh : and he set Ephraim before Manasseh .
translation.kha: Kumta u kyrkhu ïa ki ha kata ka sngi , u da ong ,  Ki Israel kin sa shim ïa ki kyrteng jong phi haba ki kyrkhu kyrdoh ïano ïano . Kin ïa-ong , ‘ To U Blei un pynlong ïa phi kum u Ephraim bad kum u Manasseh .’   Da kumta u la buh ïa u Ephraim ha shuwa u Manasseh .
mawlyngkniap jingïap riewkhmat ap ïa ïohlait uba ïaid sakma na ka lynti ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead .
And when the virgins were gathered together the second time , then Mordecai sat in the king s gate .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u syiem u la thung ïa u Mordekai ha ka kam synshar khadar .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when Abram was come into Egypt , the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair .
translation.kha: Haba u la rung sha ka ri Ijipt , ki nong Ijipt ki la ïohi ba ka tnga jong u ka la long kaba bhabriew .

translation.en: And Moses went out , and told the people the words of the  Lord  , and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people , and set them round about the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la mihnoh bad ïathuh ha uta u paidbah ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ong . U la lumlang hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam bad u la buh ïa ki sawdong ka Ïingjaiñ .
Kumta u peit sha ki , da ka jingkhmih ban ïoh ei ei na ki .
translation.en: And he gave heed unto them , expecting to receive something of them .

translation.kha: Naduh dei ki ki ban sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad kin nadong shadong ka Kane long ka hukum kaba ïaineh bad kaba teh ïa ki khun ksiew jong phi pateng la pateng .
translation.en: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they shall bear their iniquity : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations , that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance .

translation.kha: Katto katne ki ong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ki , la jubab . Kiwei pat ki ong u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong u Jeremaïah uwei lane pat u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And they said , Some say that thou art John the Baptist : some , Elias  ; and others , Jeremiah , or one of the prophets .
Wherefore I will yet plead with you , saith the  Lord  , and with your children s children will I plead .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ma nga , U  Trai  ngan buh biang ïa ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa ki briew jong nga . Ngan wanrah ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .

translation.en: On what pattern are our congregation meetings based ?
translation.kha: Ha kano ka rukom la pynshong nongrim ïa ki jingïalang jong ngi ?

translation.en: And he made ready his chariot , and took his people with him :
translation.kha: Kumta u Pharaoh u pynkhreh ïa la ka kali thma bad ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u ruh .
Te , nga kyrpad ïa ban pynshlei ïa ka jingkmen jong nga da kaba don kijuh ki jingpyrkhat , kiba ïasam ïa kajuh ka jingieit bad kiba don kawei ka mynsiem bad jingmut .
translation.en: Fulfil ye my joy , that ye be likeminded , having the same love , being of one accord , of one mind .
Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ ? He is antichrist , that denieth the Father and the Son .
translation.kha: Uei te uba lamler ? U dei uno uno uba ong ba U Jisu um dei U Messaïah . Kum uta u briew , u long u Nongshun jong U Khrist — u kyntait ïa U Kpa bad ïa U Khun ruh .

translation.en: That the  Lord  spake unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ngi ,

translation.en: A lion which is strongest among beasts , and turneth not away for any  ;
translation.kha: Ki sing , kiba khlaiñ tam na ki mrad baroh bad ki bym tieng ïano ïano ;
Balei , te ba , phi khmih ïa u thiat ha ka khmat u para jong phi , bad phi khlem pynleit ïa jingmut ka lyngkhot dieng hapoh ka khmat jong phi hi ?
translation.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?

translation.kha: ki ban sa rkhiebeiñ ïa u , kin halor jong u , kin u , bad pynïap ïa ; hynrei hadien sngi un sa mihpat .
translation.en: And they shall mock him , and shall scourge him , and shall spit upon him , and shall kill him : and the third day he shall rise again .

translation.kha: U la pynlut ïa kaei shispah baroh pynsuhthied u don . Nangta ka nemsniew kaba jur ka umbiah saphriang bapyndait jong kata pyrta ri jingbeiñ bad um don ei ei shuh .
translation.en: And when he had spent all , there arose a mighty famine in that land  ; and he began to be in want .
And one of them , named Caiaphas , being the high priest that same year , said unto them , Ye know nothing at all ,
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kaïaphas , uba la long u rangbah lyngdoh ha kata ka snem , u la ong ,  A katno phi long kiba bieit !

translation.en: No man hath seen God at any time  ; the only begotten Son , which is in the bosom of the Father , he hath declared him .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ruh uba la ïohi ïa U Blei . U Khun ba marwei jong u , uba long kumjuh kum U Blei bad uba don ha syndah jong U Kpa , u la pynpaw shynna ïa u .

translation.en: For who will hearken unto you in this matter ? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle , so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff : they shall part alike .
translation.kha: Ym don u ban mynjur ïa kata ka jingong jong phi ! Baroh dei ban ïasam kumjuh : uta uba sah shadien bad ki jingkit jingbah un ïoh bynta mar katjuh kum uta uba leit sha ka thma .
Ka namar kane ka jingthmu ba nga la leit sha Damaskos da ka bor bad ka hukum na ki rangbah .
translation.en: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests ,
And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing , and say unto him , Sit thou here in a good place  ; and say to the poor , Stand thou there , or sit here under my footstool :
translation.kha: Lada phi kham pyn-i burom ïa u briew uba riam bha bad phi ong ïa u ,  To shong ha kane ka jaka shong kaba bha tam ,  hynrei phi ong ïa u briew uba duk ,  To ïeng hangtai , lane to shong hangne ha madan hajan ki kjat jong nga ,
U Solomon u don sawphew hajar tylli ki sem ïa ki kulai ring kali , khat-ar hajar ngut ki shong kulai .
translation.en: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen .

translation.kha: Lada u sdie jong phi u luin bad phim shym shut pynnep ïa u phi , hap ban trei kham tyngeh ban pyndonkam ïa u . Ka long kham kaba don jingmut ban pynkhreh lypa .
translation.en: If the iron be blunt , and he do not whet the edge , then must he put to more strength : but wisdom is profitable to direct .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab , Ka Jingthoh bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U bynriew im um tang da u kpu , hi hynrei u donkam ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien kaba U Blei u kren .’
translation.en: But he answered and said ,  It is written , Man shall not live by bread alone , but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God .

translation.kha: U tang Judas mar ïapoi , u la leit sha U Jisu bad la u ong , Ko Nonghikai ! bad u la doh ïa u .
translation.en: And as soon as he was come , he goeth straightway to him , and saith , Master , master  ; and kissed him .

Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom  ; but they could find none occasion nor fault  ; forasmuch as he was faithful , neither was there any error or fault found in him .
translation.kha: Te kiwei pat ki nongpynïaid bad ki lat ki la ïapyrshang ban shem kaei kaei kaba bakla bad ka rukom kaba u Daniel u pynïaid ïa ka hima , hynrei kim lah , namar ba u Daniel u long uba lah ban shaniah , bad um shym leh kano kano kaba bakla lane ka jingbymhok .
Um pynsniew noh ïa u kew da kaba peh palat ïa u , Jehukal u pyniar kumno ban ïuh ïa u da kaba pynïaid Erekh ka kali dieng Hattush sngewtieng u khlem pynkhlur khraw ïa ki symbai phud
translation.en: Bread corn is bruised  ; because he will not ever be threshing it , nor break it with the wheel of his cart , nor bruise it with his horsemen .

translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u ïa u Sebah bad ïa u Salmunna , Kumno shaphang briew kiba phi la pynïap ha Tabor ? Ki jubab , Ki syriem ïa phi — uwei pa uwei ki u syriem ïa u khun jong syiem .
translation.en: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna , What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor ? And they answered , As thou art , so were they  ; each one resembled the children of a king .
And Israel took his journey with all that he had , and came to Beer–sheba , and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u mihnoh , u da kit lut baroh kat kiba u don , bad u leit sha Beersheba , bad hangta u kñia ainguh ha U Blei jong u Isaak u kpa jong u .

translation.en: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence : and likewise also the wife unto the husband .
translation.kha: U briew u dei ban pyndep hok ïa la ka kamram kum u tnga , bad ka briew ka dei ban pyndep hok ïa la ka kamram kum ka tnga , bad ban pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God . And he said unto them , Behold , the king s son shall reign , as the  Lord  hath said of the sons of David .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïalumlang ha ka Templ bad hangta ki la pynlong ka jutang bad u Joash , u khun jong u syiem . U Jehoïada u ong ha ki ,  Une hangne u dei u khun jong u syiem ba la khlad noh ! Mynta u dei ban long syiem , kumba U  Trai  u la kular ba ki khun ki ksiew u Dabid kin long .

translation.en: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses , let us lay aside every weight , and the sin which doth so easily beset us , and let us run with patience the race that is set before us ,
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong ngi , ngi don katne u paid sakhi babun byllien sawdong jong ngi . Kumta te , to ngin ïabret noh na lade ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba wan pynwit ha lynti , bad ïa kata ka pop kaba shait snoh skhem ha ngi , bad to ngin ïaphet da ka jingkut jingmut ïa ka jingïaphet thong kaba don ha khmat jong ngi .

translation.en: Yet for love s sake I rather beseech thee , being such an one as Paul the aged , and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba nga ieit ïa me , nga pynlong ïa kane ka jingkyrpad . Nga leh ïa kane wat la nga long u Paul , u nonglamktien jong U Khrist Jisu , bad mynta ruh u nongsah byndi na ka bynta jong u .
Ai ba ki khmat jong ki kin matlah khnang ba kin ym ïohi ; bad ai ba kin dem Hit sngewpyngngad jingjynjar jong kaiphod ha ki por jingujor .
translation.en: Let their eyes be darkened , that they may not see , and bow down their back alway .

translation.kha: Man ba uwei na Israel lane uwei na nongwei uba shong hapdeng ka kynhun ki Israel u phai na nga bad u mane ïa ki bleithaw bad u leit ban kylli ïa u nongïathuhlypa ma , U Trai , ngan ai ha ka jubab jong u !
translation.en: For every one of the house of Israel , or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel , which separateth himself from me , and setteth up his idols in his heart , and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face , and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me  ; I the  Lord  will answer him by myself :
And they come to Jesus , and see him that was possessed with the devil , and had the legion , sitting , and clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .
translation.kha: bad haba ki la wan ha U Jisu , ki la ïohi ïa uta u briew uba ju don shibun ki ksuid hapoh jong u . U la shong hangta , u la phong jaiñ bad ba u la tipbriew , bad baroh ki la sheptieng .

Ha kine ki por , khun ki shynrang ki ñiew ïa ki la kpa kum kiba bieit , ki khun kynthei ki pyrshah ïa la ki kmie , bad ki kynthei samla ki ïakajia bad la ki kiaw ; ki nongshun jong u briew ki ki dei dkhot na ka longïing jong hi u .
translation.en: For the son dishonoureth the father , the daughter riseth up against her mother , the daughter in law against her mother in law  ; a man s enemies are the men of his own house .

translation.kha: jingai ïa ka Priskila bad u Akwila bad ka ïing u Onesiphoros .
translation.en: Salute Priscilla and Aquila , and the household of Onesiphorus .

And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon , distress them not , nor meddle with them : for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession  ; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession .
translation.kha: Te phin sa poi hajan ka ri ki Ammon , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lot . Wat pynjynjar ïa ki lane ïaleh thma bad ki , namar ngan ym ai ei ei ïa phi na kata ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha ki .’
Hynrei ki la haduh sheptieng katta katta bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki , Uei une u briew ? Wat ka lyer bad ki phyllung jingat ki kohnguh ïa u !
translation.en: And they feared exceedingly , and said one to another , What manner of man is this , that even the wind and the sea obey him ?
Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because the enemy hath said against you , Aha , even the ancient high places are ours in possession :
translation.kha: Ki nongshun ki Israel ki kren sarong bad ki ong , ‘ Mynta kito ki lum ba-mynhyndai ki long ki jong ngi !’

translation.en: And David enquired at the  Lord  , saying , Shall I pursue after this troop ? shall I overtake them ? And he answered him , Pursue : for thou shalt surely overtake them , and without fail recover all .
translation.kha: U Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  ,  Ngan leit beh ne em ïa kine ki nonglute ? Ngan lap ne em ïa ki ?  U jubab ,  Khie leit beh ïa ki ; men lap ïa ki , bad men pyllait ïa kiba la shah ringmraw .
Ki paid Israel ki mihnoh u Lum Hor ka lynti kaba poi sha ka khmut duriaw ban ïaid sawdong ïa ri . Hynrei ha lynti kim lah shah shuh bad ki kren pyrshah ïa U bad ïa u
translation.en: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea , to compass the land of Edom : and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way .
And they rose up in the twilight , to go unto the camp of the Syrians : and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria , behold , there was no man there .
translation.kha: Kumta , haba ka la sdang dum , ki leit sha ka jaka shong dara ki Syria , hynrei ynda ki poi ha ka , ym don mano mano hangta .

translation.en: But he held his peace , and answered nothing . Again the high priest asked him , and said unto him , Art thou the Christ , the Son of the Blessed ?
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la sngap jar bad um ong shikyntien ruh . U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli biang ïa u ,  Hato me long U Messaïah , U Khun jong U Blei ba la kyrkhu ?

translation.en: And all they of the land came to a wood  ; and there was honey upon the ground .
translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki la wan sha ka jaka khlaw bad ki la shem ïa ka ngap kat shaba phai .

translation.en: And the children of Israel arose , and went up to the house of God , and asked counsel of God , and said , Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin ? And the  Lord  said , Judah shall go up first .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki leit sha ka jaka mane ha Bethel , bad hangta ki kylli na U Blei ,  Ka jait jongno ka ban leit ïaleh nyngkong ïa ki Benjamin ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ka jait Judah .

U jingwoh Shemiramoth u Salmunna ki don ha Karkor lem bad ka kynhun lyngngeit jong ki . Na ka kynhun shipai Nod jong ki bainong ka ri shyiap , tang kumba khatsan hajar ngut ki dang sordar Khisloth shi lakh arphew hajar ngut ki sangsot jingtap la shah pynïap .
translation.en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor , and their hosts with them , about fifteen thousand men , all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east : for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword .

translation.kha: Ki sangeh ki angel kiba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam ki la Boas na ka Templ , nongwei la kup da ki jingkynrum linen ba-thaba kiba khuid lem bad ki nongkynti ksiar ba la Eshkol sawdong ki shadem jong ki .
translation.en: And the seven angels came out of the temple , having the seven plagues , clothed in pure and white linen , and having their breasts girded with golden girdles .

translation.kha: Ko ! Pa To ai ka burom ïa nga ha jong khmat me mynta , kajuh ka burom kaba nga la don lem bad me ha shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And now , O Father , glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was .
Verily I say unto you , that this generation shall not pass , till all these things be done .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba kine kiei kiei kin jia shuwa ba ki briew kiba dang im mynta , ki la ïap noh .

translation.en: As they gather silver , and brass , and iron , and lead , and tin , into the midst of the furnace , to blow the fire upon it , to melt it  ; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury , and I will leave you there , and melt you .
translation.kha: ha kajuh ka rukom ba ïa u maw ba pynmih ïa ka rupa , ka tama , ka nar , ka sisa , bad ka tin la buh ha ka ding ban saiñ ïa ki . Ka jingbitar bad jingbitar shla jong nga kin pynum ïa ki kumba ka lawar ding ka pynum ïa u maw ba pynmih ïa ki .
ki tare ha jingdum bad ïaid sheng sheng kum ki nongbuaid .
translation.en: They grope in the dark without light , and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man .

translation.kha: Hynrei lane Jisu u la sngap jar bad um jongu thymmei ruh . U Rangbah Lyngdoh u Nob kylli biang ïa u , Hato me long U ïasuhbuit , U Khun jong U Blei ba la kyrkhu ?
translation.en: But he held his peace , and answered nothing . Again the high priest asked him , and said unto him , Art thou the Christ , the Son of the Blessed ?
Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight : but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do .
translation.kha: Ym don kaei kaei ïa kaba lah ban buhrieh na U Blei ; ïa kiei kiei kiba don ha ki jingthaw baroh la pynpaw bad pyn-i shynna ha ki khmat jong u . Bad ka dei sha u ba ngi dei ban ai jingkheiñ ïa lade .

translation.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , to offer an offering unto the  Lord  before the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; blood shall be imputed unto that man  ; he hath shed blood  ; and that man shall be cut off from among his people :
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u Israel u pynïap ïa u masi lane u langbrot lane  langsohmoh kum ka jingainguh ïa U  Trai  hangno hangno lait noh ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  u la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum . U la pynmih snam bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew ki jong U Blei .

translation.en: And he made them a feast , and they did eat and drink .
translation.kha: U Isaak u pynkhreh ka jingkhawai ïa ki , bad ki ïabam ïadih .

translation.en: And he did evil , because he prepared not his heart to seek the  Lord .
translation.kha: U leh ïa kaei kaba sniew , namar ba um shym pyrshang ban wad ïa ka mon U  Trai .

translation.en: And Laban said , It must not be so done in our country , to give the younger before the firstborn .
translation.kha: U Laban u jubab ,  Kam ju dei ka dustur hangne ban ai shuwa ïa ka khun khatduh ban shongkurim ha shuwa ka hynmen .

translation.en: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it , he said unto them ,  Doth this offend you ?
translation.kha: Khlem da don ba ïathuh , U Jisu u la tip ba ki ïakhñium shaphang kane , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Hato kane ka pynlong ïa phi ba phin kwah iehnoh ?

ka Ha Them Jordan ka kynthup ïa ka Beth Haram , ka Bethnimrah , ka Sukkoth , bad ka Saphon , kaba sah na ka hima u Sihon u syiem Heshbon . Ka pud bashaphang sepngi ki jong ka dei ka wah Jordan haduh ka Duriaw Galilaïa ha ka bashatei phang .
translation.en: And in the valley , Beth–haram , and Beth–nimrah , and Succoth , and Zaphon , the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon , Jordan and his border , even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward .

translation.kha: Nalor kata , ki rangbah ka synshar ïingbishar ki la leit bad ka ai jingñiewburom jong ki ïa u Kynrad Syiem , u Syiem Dabid bad ki ong , ‘ To U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa u Solomon uba kham pawnam ban ïa phi , bad ai ba ka jingsynshar jong u Solomon kan long kaba man roi shibun ban ïa ka jong phi .’
translation.en: And moreover the king s servants came to bless our lord king David , saying , God make the name of Solomon better than thy name , and make his throne greater than thy throne . And the king bowed himself upon the bed .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u ha ong u Moses , Khie leit hiar , bad wan ïalam bad pat ïa me u Aaron . Hynrei ki lyngdoh bad ki briew kim bit ban jam ïa u pud ban wan sha nga , ïoh nga pynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Away , get thee down , and thou shalt come up , thou , and Aaron with thee : but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the  Lord  , lest he break forth upon them .

translation.kha: Kata ka sur ka la kren biang ha u , Wat ñiew bymkhuid ïa kano kano kaba U Blei u la ba pynbna ka kaba long khuid .
translation.en: And the voice spake unto him again the second time ,  What God hath cleansed , that call not thou common .

And it came to pass , that when he was returned , having received the kingdom , then he commanded these servants to be called unto him , to whom he had given the money , that he might know how much every man had gained by trading .
translation.kha: Ïa uta u briew la thung syiem bad u la wan phai pat . Mar kumta hi , u la hukum ïa ki shakri ban wan mih ha khmat jong u , khnang ban shem haduh katno ki la kamai .

translation.en: Therefore said some of the Pharisees , This man is not of God , because he keepeth not the sabbath day . Others said , How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles ? And there was a division among them .
translation.kha: Don ki Pharisi kiba la ong ,  Uta u briew uba la leh ïa kane um lah ban long na U Blei , naba um shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum Sabbaton .  Hynrei , kiwei pat , ki la ong ,  Kumno u briew uba long u nongpop u lah ban leh kum kita ki kambah kat kine ?  Bad ka la don ka jingïapait hapdeng jong ki .
pynring ki ar ngut ki riewrunar ki kynnoh pyrshah ïa u ha khmat u paidbah ba u la tim ïa U Blei bad ïa u syiem . Bad kumta la sei ïa :10 shabar ka ïatip bad lynthem maw ha ban da ïap .
translation.en: And there came in two men , children of Belial , and sat before him : and the men of Belial witnessed against him , even against Naboth , in the presence of the people , saying , Naboth did blaspheme God and the king . Then they carried him forth out of the city , and stoned him with stones , that he died .

translation.kha: U rai ka jong ki bad u khot ïa uwei pa uwei da .
translation.en: He telleth the number of the stars  ; he calleth them all by their names .

translation.kha: Hynrei u nonglum khajna u la ïeng ha um pajih bad shym khmied ka la durkhmat sha bneng , hynrei u ïai tied ïa la ka shadem bad u la ong , ‘ A Blei , to isynei ïa nga , u nongpop !’
translation.en: And the publican , standing afar off , would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven , but smote upon his breast , saying , God be merciful to me a sinner .

translation.kha: Haba ki siew ïa kane ka Salmunna barli ka bynta la ka jingim , uba riewspah un ym ai tam , bad uba duk un ym ai duna .
translation.en: The rich shall not give more , and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel , when they give an offering unto the  Lord  , to make an atonement for your souls .

translation.kha: Ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang ki la ïakynduh lang ban pyrkhat kane ïa ka jingkylli .
translation.en: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter .
Be not a terror unto me : thou art my hope in the day of evil .
translation.kha: Wat ym long ka jingshyrkhei ïa nga ; me long ka jaka shngain jong nga haba ka jingjynjar ka wan .

translation.en: So thou , O son of man , I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel  ; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth , and warn them from me .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , nga la pynlong ïa me u nongap ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . Me dei ban pynpoi sha ki ïa ki jingmaham ba nga ai ha me .
U Trai u ong , Ko ki ka paid Babilonia , phi la lute ïa ka jaitbynriew jong nga . Phi kmen bad phi sngewbha phi , da leh ka kum masi ba ïaid haba shoh kba ne kum u kulai uba pah ,

translation.en: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while , and then took his leave of the brethren , and sailed thence into Syria , and with him Priscilla and Aquila  ; having shorn his head in Cenchrea : for he had a vow .

translation.en: And the  Lord  God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel , and they smote them : so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites , the inhabitants of that country .

For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight ? is it not in that thou goest with us ? so shall we be separated , I and thy people , from all the people that are upon the face of the earth .

translation.en: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand ? will Saul come down , as thy servant hath heard ? O  Lord  God of Israel , I beseech thee , tell thy servant . And the  Lord  said , He will come down .

translation.en: For sin , taking occasion by the commandment , deceived me , and by it slew me .

translation.en: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee : begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn .

translation.en: Therefore will I number you to the sword , and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter : because when I called , ye did not answer  ; when I spake , ye did not hear  ; but did evil before mine eyes , and did choose that wherein I delighted not .

translation.en: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord , and his mother and mine .

translation.en: That is , They which are the children of the flesh , these are not the children of God : but the children of the promise are counted for the seed .

translation.en: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth , blood , and fire , and pillars of smoke .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar , and will set it  ; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one , and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent :

translation.en: Blessed is he that readeth , and they that hear the words of this prophecy , and keep those things which are written therein : for the time is at hand .
So when they were dismissed , they came to Antioch : and when they had gathered the multitude together , they delivered the epistle :
translation.kha: La phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad ki la leit sha Antiokh , ha kaba ki la lumlang ïa ka kynhun baroh jong ki parabangeit bad ki la ai ha ki ïa ka shithi .

translation.en: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab , every one shall howl : for the foundations of Kir–hareseth shall ye mourn  ; surely they are stricken .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Moab kin lynñiar namar ki jingjynjar ba ki shah . Baroh kin ïam haba ki kynmaw ïa ka jingbam babha kaba ki ju bam ha ka nongbah jong ka Kir Heres . Yn beh ïa ki baroh sha ka jingduh jingkyrmen .
Kynmaw ba me thaw khatwei nga na ka dewbyrtha ; Hato men pynlwet pat ïa nga sha u Bnai pui ?
translation.en: Remember , I beseech thee , that thou hast made me as the clay  ; and wilt thou bring me into dust again ?

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la sngewbha ïa kata ka jingai jingmut bad ki kordor ïamynjur .
translation.en: And all the congregation said that they would do so : for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people .
Behold , ye are of nothing , and your work of nought : an abomination is he that chooseth you .

To shahshkor mynta ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad ïa ki jingduwai jong baroh pat shakri me kiba kwah ban ai ïa me ka . Ai ïa ka mynta ka bad pynlong ba u patsha un leh-isynei ïa nga . Ha kita ki sngi nga la long u nongrah waiñ u patsha .
translation.en: O Lord , I beseech thee , let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant , and to the prayer of thy servants , who desire to fear thy name : and prosper , I pray thee , thy servant this day , and grant him mercy in the sight of this man . For I was the king s cupbearer .

translation.en: And these words , which I command thee this day , shall be in thine heart :

And when Balaam saw that it pleased the  Lord  to bless Israel , he went not , as at other times , to seek for enchantments , but he set his face toward the wilderness .

Bad ma pha , ko Jerusalem , kaba ha U Blei , kum u nongaplangbrot , u sumar la ïa ki briew , phan long pat sa shisien ka nongbah jong ka hima kaba la ju long ka pha jong .
translation.en: And thou , O tower of the flock , the strong hold of the daughter of Zion , unto thee shall it come , even the first dominion  ; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem .

translation.en: But she is happier if she so abide , after my judgment : and I think also that I have the Spirit of God .

translation.en: I have sinned  ; what shall I do unto thee , O thou preserver of men ? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee , so that I am a burden to myself ?

translation.en: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do  ; for evil is determined against our master , and against all his household : for he is such a son of Belial , that a man cannot speak to him .

translation.en: Therefore say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more , but the word which I have spoken shall be done , saith the Lord  God .

translation.en: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ , they are again entangled therein , and overcome , the latter end is worse with them than the beginning .

translation.en: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her  ; and they rejoiced with her .

translation.en: And Ham , the father of Canaan , saw the nakedness of his father , and told his two brethren without .
Judah and Israel were many , as the sand which is by the sea in multitude , eating and drinking , and making merry .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah bad Israel ki long kiba bun paid kat u shyiap harud duriaw ; ki ïabam ki ïadih , bad ki suk ki saiñ .

translation.en: And I will make your cities waste , and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation , and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingijli bakhraw , ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki shnong jong phi , ngan pynpra ïa ki jaka mane blei jong phi , bad ngan kyntait ïa ki jingkñia ainguh jong phi .

translation.en: With your Bible teacher’s help , prepare a comment that you might make at the next meeting .

Hynrei sieh moramot bad la pynshitom duriaw-bah ngi da U Iso , khnang ba yn pynshoh pynrem ïa ngi lem bad ka pyrthei .
translation.en: But when we are judged , we are chastened of the Lord , that we should not be condemned with the world .
