translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines  ; at which time Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Sippai , that was of the children of the giant : and they were subdued .

translation.kha: Ka jingim bashisha jong phi ka long U Khrist Hassenaah bad haba u mihpaw jingïathuhlypa te ma phi Berniki phin mihpaw lem Elath u bad ïoh bynta ïa latai burom jong Kain
translation.en: When Christ , who is our life , shall appear , then shall ye also appear with him in glory .

translation.kha: U Judah bad ki khun shynrang jong u Isynei jingkhrew Shelah , u Peres , bad u Serah . ( Kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u doktor : u Er bad jingïa-pynïap Onan ki la ïap noh ha Kanaan ) ; ki Mattanaïah shynrang jong u Peres ki long Mahli Hesron bad u Hamul .
translation.en: And the sons of Judah  ; Er , and Onan , and Shelah , and Pharez , and Zerah : but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan . And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul .

translation.kha: Katto katne ki Philistia ki wallam u sha Jehoshaphat shibun bah ka rupa bad kiwei ki jingai sngewbha , katto bad katne ki Arab ki wallam hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah ki tylli langbrot bad hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah tylli ki blang .
translation.en: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents , and tribute silver  ; and the Arabians brought him flocks , seven thousand and seven hundred rams , and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats .
Behold , therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made , and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pynhap ïa ka ksang ti jong nga halor ki kam tuh bad pynïap briew .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had ended these sayings , the people were astonished at his doctrine :
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren ïa kine kiei kiei , u paidbah u la sngewphylla ïa ka rukom kaba u la hikai .

translation.en: Keep silence before me , O islands  ; and let the people renew their strength : let them come near  ; then let them speak : let us come near together to judgment .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ,  To sngap jar bad to shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki ri sha jngai bah ! To pynkhreh ban wanrah ïa ka jingmudui jong phi ha ka ïingbishar ; phin ïoh ïa ka lad jong phi ban kren . To ngin ïawanlang ban rai mano ba dei .

translation.en: Would you say . . .
translation.kha: Hato phin ong . . .

translation.en: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary , and had seen the things which Jesus did , believed on him .
translation.kha: Bun na ki briew kiba la wan jngoh ïa ka Mari ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh , bad ki la ngeit ha u .
U kular ba katba ka jingbuh ryntih ïa ka mariang ka dang neh kumta , ruh ki Israel kin long ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: If those ordinances depart from before me , saith the  Lord  , then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever .
And the  Lord  God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers , rising up betimes , and sending  ; because he had compassion on his people , and on his dwelling place :
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki , u ïai phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki briew jong u , namar ba u kwah ban da ïa ki bad ïa ka templ .

translation.en: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day  ; that I should remove it from before my face ,
translation.kha: Ki briew jong kane ka nongbah ki la pynbitar bad pynbitar shla ïa nga naduh ka sngi ba la thaw ïa ka .
U Lebi Khnang ïeng Aber ban leit noh , hynrei u kpa u pynbor ïa u ban sah shuwa , kumta u sah sa shi miet nongbeh punkhun
translation.en: And when the man rose up to depart , his father in law urged him : therefore he lodged there again .
The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him  ; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him .
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ba u paidbah u ïa-pasiaw ïa kine kiei kiei shaphang U Jisu , kumta ma ki bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la phah katto katne ngut ki nongap phira ban kem ïa u .

Haba Barak u wan ïa u Sisera , ka Jael ka mih shabar ïakynduh ïa u , bad ka ong ha u , Ale hangne ! Ngan ha phi ïa u briew uba phi wad . Kumta u la leit shapoh bad , bad hangta ha madan don Sisera , uba la ïap , bad u snar pynskhem dara lyngba ka khlieh jong u
translation.en: And , behold , as Barak pursued Sisera , Jael came out to meet him , and said unto him , Come , and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest . And when he came into her tent , behold , Sisera lay dead , and the nail was in his temples .
Thus saith the  Lord  , The heaven is my throne , and the earth is my footstool : where is the house that ye build unto me ? and where is the place of my rest ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka bneng ka long ka khet jong nga bad ka khyndew ka long ka jingïuhkjat jong nga . Kaba kumno keiñ ka ïing men tei ïa nga , bad kaba kumno ka jaka ba ngan shong ?

translation.en: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea , tossed with waves : for the wind was contrary .
translation.kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , U Jisu u la don hangta marwei ; bad hamar kane ka por ka lieng ka la don jngai ha ka duriaw , ba la kynting shane shatai da ki jingat phyllung , namar ba ka lyer ka la beh pyrshah ïa ka .
Ha step kaba bud ki bor synshar ka Rom la phah ïa ki rangbah lem ka hukum , Pyllait noh ïa kito briew .
translation.en: And when it was day , the magistrates sent the serjeants , saying , Let those men go .
And when she came to her mother in law , she said , Who art thou , my daughter ? And she told her all that the man had done to her .
translation.kha: Haba ka la poi ha ïing , ka kiaw jong ka , ka kylli ïa ka ,  Ka long kumno , ko khun kynthei jong nga ?  Ka Ruth ka ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Boas u la leh na ka bynta jong ka .

translation.en: But they made light of it , and went their ways , one to his farm , another to his merchandise :
translation.kha: Hynrei kiba la shah khot sngewbha kim suidñiew bad ki la leit sha la ki kam ki jam : Uwei sha ka lyngkha jong u , uwei pat sha ka dukan jong u ,

translation.en: And the people came to the house of God , and abode there till even before God , and lifted up their voices , and wept sore  ;
translation.kha: Te mynta ki paid Israel ki leit sha Bethel bad ki shong hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei haduh janmiet . Ha ka sur kaba jam bad ha ka jingkthang ki ïam sngewsih :

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them : because I have spoken unto them , but they have not heard  ; and I have called unto them , but they have not answered .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan wallam halor jong phi ki paid Judah bad Jerusalem ïa baroh ka jingpynjot kaba nga la kular . Ngan leh ïa kane namar phim shym la shahshkor haba nga la kren ha phi , bad phim shym la jubab haba nga la khot ïa phi .

translation.en: Take also your brother , and arise , go again unto the man :
translation.kha: Ïalam ruh ïa la u para , bad ïawan phai mar mar .
pat ki leit sher dara Them Sered .
translation.en: From thence they removed , and pitched in the valley of Zered .
Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded  ; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth , and not miss .
translation.kha: Ki khot lang arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki shipai na ki nongbah jong ki ha kata ka sngi . Nalor kine , ki nongshong shnong ka Gibeah ki lumlang hynñiewspah ngut ki rangdajied kiba la jied kyrpang kiba treikam da kadiang . Uwei pa uwei na ki u tbit ban kawang maw khlem da lait wat ha u  ñiuhkhlieh .

translation.en: Against whom do ye sport yourselves ? against whom make ye a wide mouth , and draw out the tongue ? are ye not children of transgression , a seed of falsehood ,
translation.kha: Ïano phi leh biria ? Ïano phi ki nongshukor phi rkhiebeiñ ?

translation.en: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem Ammon um patiaw ei ei ruh em ïa kane ka khubor na u Jephthah .

Ki paid Israel thah long Amor u Jeush uba ki thied Shahshkor la jingjia bad um pynmih soh ei i-lub shuh . pyrshang Rabboni ïoh lko oh , hynrei wat lada ki dang ïoh , Mahanaim pynïap ïa ki khun thep dkoh jong ki .
translation.en: Ephraim is smitten , their root is dried up , they shall bear no fruit : yea , though they bring forth , yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb .

translation.kha: U la thngan bad u ong ha u Jakob , Nga la thngan shaba palat , to ai khyndiat ba ngan dih ïa kato Akhaikos syrwa saw . ( Dei Timnah kata ba la khot ïa u , u Edom . )
translation.en: And Esau said to Jacob , Feed me , I pray thee , with that same red pottage  ; for I am faint : therefore was his name called Edom .

And I will come near to you to judgment  ; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers , and against the adulterers , and against false swearers , and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages , the widow , and the fatherless , and that turn aside the stranger from his right , and fear not me , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ngan sa paw hapdeng jong phi ban bishar , bad ngan phla shisyndon pyrshah ïa kito kiba leh myntor , pyrshah ïa kiba klim , pyrshah ïa kito kiba sakhi lamler , kito kiba shukor ïa ki nongtrei ïa ki bainong jong ki , bad kito kiba shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei , ki khunswet , bad ki nongwei — pyrshah ïa kito baroh ki bym ñiewkor ïa nga .

translation.en: ( Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow : behold , it is written in the book of Jasher . )
translation.kha: bad u hukum ba yn hikai ïa ka ha ki briew ka Judah . ( La buh jingkynmaw ha  Ka Kitab U Jashar . )
nongkyllan nangta ki leit sha Nahaliel , bad na jingpyntreikam sha Bamoth ,
translation.en: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel : and from Nahaliel to Bamoth :

translation.kha: Hato ngam don ka hok ban katba nga sngewbit ïa la ka jong ka Ne phi ïa-bishni namar ba nga long uba sbun ?’
translation.en: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own ? Is thine eye evil , because I am good ?

translation.kha: Tei ïa ka duwan na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong phi da ïashad maw Rehum ; bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang hangta ;
translation.en: Thou shalt build the altar of the  Lord  thy God of whole stones : and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the  Lord  thy God :

translation.kha: khun Ki ki peitbeiñ ïa nga bad ki rkhie haba ki ïohi ïa nga .
translation.en: Yea , young children despised me  ; I arose , and they spake against me .
Declare ye in Egypt , and publish in Migdol , and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes : say ye , Stand fast , and prepare thee  ; for the sword shall devour round about thee .
translation.kha: Pynbna ïa ka ha ki shnong jong ka Ijipt , ha Migdol , Memphis , bad Tahpanhes : ‘ To pynkhreh ban ïada ïa lade ; ïa kiei kiei kiba phi don yn pynjot ha ka thma !

translation.en: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner , that he came to deceive thee , and to know thy going out and thy coming in , and to know all that thou doest .
translation.kha: U la wan shane ban shukor ïa phi bad ban tip ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh bad ïa ka leit ka wan jong phi . Khlem pep , phi tip ïa kata !

translation.en: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise , And God did rest the seventh day from all his works .
translation.kha: Naba don ha Jingthoh Bakhuid la ong ïa kane shaphang ka sngi kaba hynñiew :  U Blei u la shongthait ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew na ka kam jong u baroh .

translation.en: Son of man , I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt  ; and , lo , it shall not be bound up to be healed , to put a roller to bind it , to make it strong to hold the sword .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  nga la pynkheiñ ïa ka ksang ti jong u syiem ka Ijipt . Ym don ba la sop spaiñ ïa ka lane pynsdien ïa ka khnang ba kan ïohkhiah bad ban khlaiñ kat ban lah ban bat biang ïa ka waitlam .
Ngan phah ïa u angel ha shuwa jong ban phi ïada ïa phi haba phi leit jingleit bad ban ïalam ïa phi sha kata jaka ka kaba nga la pynkhreh .
translation.en: Behold , I send an Angel before thee , to keep thee in the way , and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared .
And he did wash the inwards and the legs , and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar .
translation.kha: Nangta u sait ïa ki doh jem bad ïa ki kjat-dien bad u thang lang ïa ki ha ka duwan halor kita kiwei pat ki jingkñia ainguh thang .
Ia pyrthei ka mynta la pynïakhlad ha kiba bun tylli ki ri .
translation.en: Now the earth is divided up into many countries .
But if the priest look on it , and , behold , there be no white hairs therein , and if it be not lower than the skin , but be somewhat dark  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days :
translation.kha: Hynrei ynda u lyngdoh u la peit bniah ïa kata ka dak bad u shem ba u shñiuh uba hangta um pat kylla lieh , bad ba kam long kaba kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka hynrei ka stang ha ka rong , u lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa u hynñiew sngi lynter .
U Sadok u lyngdoh bad para ki jong lyngdoh u pat , ki peit ïa ka jingmane ïa U Trai ha ka jaka mane kaba ha Gibeon .
translation.en: And Zadok the priest , and his brethren the priests , before the tabernacle of the  Lord  in the high place that was at Gibeon ,

translation.kha: Ha u to ai ba kan long bor ka junom ! Amen .
translation.en: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Ma ngi kiba long kiba khlaiñ ha ka jingngeit , ngi dei ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot kin ba bah ïa ki jingkit jong ki Ngim . dei ban pynsngewbha ïa lade .
translation.en: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak , and not to please ourselves .
Their heart is divided  ; now shall they be found faulty : he shall break down their altars , he shall spoil their images .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ki dohnud jong ki , ki long kiba shukor , mynta ki dei ban shahshitom namar ki pop jong ki . U Blei un pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , bad un pynjot ïa ki rishot kyntang jong ki .

translation.en: Nor by the earth  ; for it is his footstool : neither by Jerusalem  ; for it is the city of the great King .
translation.kha: lymne da ka khyndew , naba ka long ka jingïuhkjat jong u ; lymne da ka Jerusalem , naba ka long ka nongbah jong U Syiem uba khraw .

translation.en: For if , when we were enemies , we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son , much more , being reconciled , we shall be saved by his life .
translation.kha: Ngi la long ki nongshun jong U Blei , hynrei u la pynlong ïa ngi ki paralok jong u lyngba ka jingïap U Khun jong u . Mynta ba ngi long ki paralok jong U Blei , katno tam ba yn pynim ïa ngi da ka jingim U Khrist !
Ïa ka pisa ba la ai na ka bynta ki ba jingainguh hap siew pat bad na ka bynta ki jingkñia pop ym shym thep ha ka synduk ; ka ka dei jong ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the  Lord  : it was the priests .
What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law , because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains ?
translation.kha: U ong ha kine ki rangbah ,  Ma nga , u syiem Serksis , nga la phah ïa ki shakri jong nga sha ka Bashti , ka mahadei ; ryngkat bad ka hukum , bad ka kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ka ! Aïu ka aiñ ka kren ba ngi dei ban leh ïa ka ?

translation.en: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died . And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him , and wept over his face , and said , O my father , my father , the chariot of Israel , and the horsemen thereof .
translation.kha: U Elisha u nongïathuhlypa u la kem pang na ka jait jingpang kaba shyrkhei , bad katba u dang thiah sa ba un ïap u Jehoash u syiem Israel u leit jngoh ïa u .  Ko pa jong nga , pa jong nga !  u pyrta da kaba ïam .  Phi la long u nongïada bakhlaiñbor jong ka Israel !

translation.en: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning , and called all his servants , and told all these things in their ears : and the men were sore afraid .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab , u Abimelekh u khot lang ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh , bad u ïathuh ha ki ïa kaba la jia ; bad ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh .

translation.en: And his father in law , the damsel s father , retained him  ; and he abode with him three days : so they did eat and drink , and lodged there .
translation.kha: U kpa u ïai ban ba un sah , bad kumta u sah hangta lai sngi . Ki shi jur ki ïabam ïadih bad ki sah hangta baroh lai miet .

translation.en: And he went in also unto Rachel , and he loved also Rachel more than Leah , and served with him yet seven other years .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ïathiah shongkha bad ka Rakhel ruh , bad u kham ieit ïa ka ban ïa ka Leah . Nangta u la trei na ka bynta u Laban sa hynñiew snem .

translation.en: Forsake the foolish , and live  ; and go in the way of understanding .
translation.kha: Iehnoh ïa ka kynhun ki briew kiba bieit , bad men ïoh im . Ïaid ruh ha ka lynti ka jingtip .

translation.en: What time they wax warm , they vanish : when it is hot , they are consumed out of their place .
translation.kha: hynrei ha ka jingshit ki jah noh , bad ki phud wahduid ki rngad bad ki tyrkhong .
Ki pyrta ïa u Lot bad kylli ïa u , Hangno kito ki rangbah kiba wan don bad sohkhia ha kane khambun miet ? Pynmih ïa ki shabar ! Ki shynrang jong rupa Sodom ki kwah ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki .
translation.en: And they called unto Lot , and said unto him , Where are the men which came in to thee this night ? bring them out unto us , that we may know them .

translation.kha: Uno uno u na shynrang ka longïing lyngdoh u ban lah bam ïa ka , hynrei dei ban bam ïa ka ha ka jaka kaba khuid , naba ka long kaba khuid bha .
translation.en: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof : it shall be eaten in the holy place : it is most holy .

Who is wise , and he shall understand these things ? prudent , and he shall know them ? for the ways of the  Lord  are right , and the just shall walk in them : but the transgressors shall fall therein .
translation.kha: To ai ba kito kiba stad kin shemphang ïa kaei kaba la thoh hangne ; bad ai ba kin pdiang ïa ki naduh ka dohnud . Ki lynti U  Trai  ki long kiba beit , bad ki briew kiba hok ki im da kaba bud ïa ki , hynrei ki nongpop ki jynthut bad ki kyllon namar ba kim suidñiew ïa ki .

translation.en: Knowing that he that is such is subverted , and sinneth , being condemned of himself .
translation.kha: Me tip ba kum uta ki briew u long uba bamsap bad ki pop jong u ki pynshisha ba u bakla .

translation.en: Then they reviled him , and said , Thou art his disciple  ; but we are Moses  disciples .
translation.kha: Ki la tim ïa u bad ki da ong ,  Me long u synran jong une u briew : Hynrei , ngi long ki synran u Moses .

translation.en: And the hand of the  Lord  was on Elijah  ; and he girded up his loins , and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Ka bor jong U  Trai  ka la wan ha u Elijah ; u la pynskhem ïa la ki jaiñ sawdong ka syngkai jong u bad u mareh ha shuwa u Ahab haduh ban da poi ha Jesreel .

Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhñium jong ki Israel . Ïathuh ïa ba ki ynda la kem ïongreiñ sa kin ïoh ka doh ban bam , bad ha ka por mynstep kin sa ïoh u kpu uba ki kwah . Te kin ma tip ba nga , U Trai nga long U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel : speak unto them , saying , At even ye shall eat flesh , and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: U la tieng halor Saph briew ïingbishar ka pyrthei masi bym long Sennakherib ei ; ki angel ha bneng bad Armagedon briew Beon ka pyrthei ki don hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u . pynkhie don mano mano ba lah ban pyrshah ïa ka mon jong u lane kylli jingkylli ïa kaei kaba u leh .
translation.en: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing : and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven , and among the inhabitants of the earth : and none can stay his hand , or say unto him , What doest thou ?
That he may set him with princes , even with the princes of his people .
translation.kha: bad u pynlong ïa ki , ki paralok jong ki khun syiem shynrang , ki khun syiem shynrang jong ki briew jong u .
Hato mem pat ju ïohsngew ba nga la thmu ïa kane slem ? mynta nga pynurlong . Nga ai ha me ka ban pynkylla ïa ki nongbah ba la ker sha ki kynton theh ñiut .
translation.en: Hast thou not heard long ago , how I have done it  ; and of ancient times , that I have formed it ? now have I brought it to pass , that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps .

translation.kha: Phi khanatang ong ïa-ïohi kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei shaphang jong nga , ong U Trai . Hynrei phi kylli , ‘ Kaei ba ngi la ong shaphang ïaphai me ?’
translation.en: Your words have been stout against me , saith the  Lord . Yet ye say , What have we spoken so much against thee ?

translation.kha: Ki nonglamktien na ka nongbah Dan bad na ki lum Ephraim ki pynbna ïa khubor ka basniew .
translation.en: For a voice declareth from Dan , and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba ki duwai , Trai u shahshkor , hynrei u long jngai ïa kito kiba leh sniew
translation.en: The  Lord  is far from the wicked : but he heareth the prayer of the righteous .

translation.kha: Sa pat shisien U Jisu u iehnoh la ïa ki , u la leit noh , bad u la duwai ha ka sien kaba lai , da kaba ong ïa kijuh ki kyntien .
translation.en: And he left them , and went away again , and prayed the third time , saying the same words .
Boast not against the branches . But if thou boast , thou bearest not the root , but the root thee .
translation.kha: Kumta te , phim dei ban ñiewbeiñ ïa kito kiba la pynkheiñ noh kum ki tnat . Kumno phi lah ban sngewsarong ? Phi long tang ka tnat ; phim kyrshan ïa ki thied — ki thied ki kyrshan ïa phi .
Ka jingieit jong nga long kan lem bad phi baroh ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus . Amen .

translation.kha: Un buh ïa la ki kti baroh ar ha ka khlieh jong uta u langsohmoh , bad halor jong u un phla ïa ki jingbymman , ïa ki pop , bad ïa ki khnap pyrshah baroh jong ki Israel , bad da jingpait un pynkit ïa ba-isangsot ha ka khlieh jong uta Lo-Ruhamah Busi . Nangta jingkheiñ ban ñiah noh Nathanael uta u langsohmoh sha ka ri shyiap Myntan u briew uba la nongkyrshan kyrpang na ka bynta kata .
translation.en: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat , and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel , and all their transgressions in all their sins , putting them upon the head of the goat , and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness :
Saying , Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan , the lot of your inheritance :
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ka ri Kanaan ,  u ong .  Kan long ka jingïohkynti jong phi hi .
ka jingjynjar kaba mynta , nga pyrkhat ba ka bha ïa u briew ban sah kumba u long .
translation.en: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress , I say , that it is good for a man so to be .

translation.kha: Ka jingkular nga ka long shisha , bad kan ym kylla . Nga kular shisha baroh kaba nga baroh wan ha khmat jong bad kular ba long hok ha nga .
translation.en: I have sworn by myself , the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness , and shall not return , That unto me every knee shall bow , every tongue shall swear .
Then I went down to the potter s house , and , behold , he wrought a work on the wheels .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit hangta bad nga la ïohi ïa u nongthaw khiew ba u trei ha ka shalyntem jong u .
Nga la tip ruh ba ki wanpaw nongput ka Templ bad kiwei ki Lebi ki la mihnoh na Jerusalem bad ïasaid biang sha ki jaka rep , namar ki brai kim shym la ai kaba biang ïa ki ban thet Bethsaida
translation.en: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them : for the Levites and the singers , that did the work , were fled every one to his field .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga la jubab , Em , ko Trai Nongsynshar ! Ngam pat ju pyntngit ïa . Naduh lade dang khynnah ngam pat ju bam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba ïap hi ne uba shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw . Ngam pat ju bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam la ba kheiñ ka . bymkhuid
translation.en: Then said I , Ah Lord  God  ! behold , my soul hath not been polluted : for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself , or is torn in pieces  ; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth .

They took therefore two chariot horses  ; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians , saying , Go and see .
translation.kha: Ki jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah , bad u syiem u phah ïa ki ha ki ar tylli ki kali ïapom lem bad ki jingbthah ban leit bad wad jingtip ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ka kynhun shipai Syria .

translation.en: And all Judah stood before the  Lord  , with their little ones , their wives , and their children .
translation.kha: Baroh ki rangbah ka Judah , ryngkat bad ki tnga bad ki khun jong ki , ki ïeng hangta ha ka Templ .

translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  the glory due unto his name : bring an offering , and come before him : worship the  Lord  in the beauty of holiness .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom U  Trai  ; wallam ka jingainguh bad wan sha ka Templ jong u . To dem ha khmat Uba Khuid haba u wanpaw ;
Bad ka ka la shynrang na Abram , bad la kyrteng ïa u , u Ishmael .
translation.en: And Hagar bare Abram a son : and Abram called his son s name , which Hagar bare , Ishmael .

translation.kha: Katto katne na shipai jong u kin pyntngit ïa ka Templ . Kin pynsangeh ïa jingkñia ba sngi kin pynïeng ka Jingshyrkhei Ba-ijli .
translation.en: And arms shall stand on his part , and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength , and shall take away the daily sacrifice , and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate .
Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child  ; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him .
translation.kha: Ki khynnah na la ka tynrai ki leh kiei kiei kiba ibieit , khlem sumar , hynrei ka jingsneng sympat kaba bha ka hikai ïa ki kumno ban long .
Kumta u u sangeh noh na kaba thwet ïa u Dabid bad u leit noh ban ïa ki Philistia Na kata ka daw , ïa kata ka la khot U Lum ka Jingpynïakhlad
translation.en: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David , and went against the Philistines : therefore they called that place Sela–hammahlekoth .
20 When Will Paradise Come ?
translation.kha: 20 Lano ka Paradais Kan Wan ?

translation.en: Again he said , Therefore hear the word of the  Lord   ; I saw the  Lord  sitting upon his throne , and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left .
translation.kha: U Mikaïah u ong shuh :  Mynta sngap ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ! Nga ïohi ïa U  Trai  ba u shong halor ka khet jong u ha bneng , ryngkat bad baroh ki angel jong u kiba ïeng harud jong u .

translation.en: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them , and shewed them all the house of his precious things , the silver , and the gold , and the spices , and the precious ointment , and all the house of his armour , and all that was found in his treasures : there was nothing in his house , nor in all his dominion , that Hezekiah shewed them not .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nonglamktien bad u pyn-i ha ki ïa ka spah ka phew jong u — ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong u , ki musli musla bad ki jingiwbih jong u , bad baroh ki tiar thma ki jong u . Ym don shuh kano kano kaba don ha ki jaka buh tiar jong u lane hangno hangno ha ka hima jong u kaba um shym la pyn-i ha ki .

translation.en: They would none of my counsel : they despised all my reproof .
translation.kha: Phim ju kwah ïa ka jingai jingmut lem jong nga lane shahshkor haba nga pynbeit ïa phi .
Yn ym don na ki u ban hikai Sered la u para shnong lane ong Tobijah la u para ri , ‘ To tip ïa U Trai .’ Namar baroh kin tip ïa nga , naduh uba rit jingurlong haduh uba khraw tam .
translation.en: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the Lord : for all shall know me , from the least to the greatest .

translation.kha: Jied ïa ka jingbthah jong khyllad Shuwa ban ïa phylliew rupa ; jied pynkmen ka Shebanaïah , ban ïa ka ksiar Kartan .
translation.en: Receive my instruction , and not silver  ; and knowledge rather than choice gold .

Ye looked for much , and , lo , it came to little  ; and when ye brought it home , I did blow upon it . Why ? saith the  Lord  of hosts . Because of mine house that is waste , and ye run every man unto his own house .
translation.kha: Phi la kyrmen ïa ki jingot kiba bun , hynrei ki la kylla long tang khyndiat . Bad haba phi la wanrah ïa ka jingot sha ïing , nga pynher ïa ka sha jngai . Balei ba nga la leh ïa kata ? Namar ka Templ jong nga ka dang don ha ki jingjot katba uwei pa uwei na phi u bunkam ha ka jingtrei ïa la ka jong ka ïing .

translation.en: And David said to Uriah , Tarry here to day also , and to morrow I will let thee depart . So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day , and the morrow .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u ong ,  Te sah hangne ha kane ka sngi , bad lashai ngan phah pat ïa phi .  Kumta u Uriah u la sah ha Jerusalem ha kata ka sngi bad ha ka sngi kaba bud .
u ban shah pynshitom kumba u ban leh ïa la u . Da phin noh ïa kane ka jingbymman .
translation.en: Then shall ye do unto him , as he had thought to have done unto his brother : so shalt thou put the evil away from among you .
The people which sat in darkness saw great light  ; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka jingdum kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba khraw . Ha kito kiba im ha ka ri ba-dum jong ka jingïap ka jingshai kan tyngshaiñ .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans , because they suffered such things ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Namar ba ïa kito ki nong Galilaïa la pynïap ha kata ka rukom , hato phi pyrkhat ba ka pynshisha ba ki la long ki nongpop kiba kham sniew ban ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nong Galilaïa ?
Nga ïarap ïa ki syiem ban synshar , bad ki nongsynshar ban thaw aiñ ki kiba bha .
translation.en: By me kings reign , and princes decree justice .

translation.kha: Nga ngan ïeng ha jong me ha u mawsiang ha u Lum . Tied ïa u mawsiang ; te ka um kan sa mih na u ba u paidbah un ïoh dih . U Moses u leh kumta ha ka jingdon ryngkat ki jong ki Israel .
translation.en: Behold , I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb  ; and thou shalt smite the rock , and there shall come water out of it , that the people may drink . And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel .

translation.kha: Lehse Trai U Blei jong phi un kylla ka jingmut un ïa phi da ki jingthung bakyrhai Te phin lah ban ainguh ha u kew ka waiñ .
translation.en: Who knoweth if he will return and repent , and leave a blessing behind him  ; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the  Lord  your God ?

translation.kha: Lane nga lah ban thma ha ka ri bad phah ki tiar pynjot ban pynduh lut ïa ki briew ki mrad kumjuh ,
translation.en: Or if I bring a sword upon that land , and say , Sword , go through the land  ; so that I cut off man and beast from it :

translation.kha: Phi ia mynjur u Tom dei
translation.en: You agree with Tom , right ?

translation.kha: Ki leh kumta bad halor jong hiar arsut ha ka lynti nadien u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah bad u lap ïa u ba u ha trai uwei u dieng . Hato phi dei uta u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah u kylli . Nga dei , uta u u jubab
translation.en: And went after the man of God , and found him sitting under an oak : and he said unto him , Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah ? And he said , I am .
And the fear of the  Lord  fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah , so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki hima kiba don sawdong ban sheptieng ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat .

translation.en: And they were astonished out of measure , saying among themselves , Who then can be saved ?
translation.kha: Ha kane ki synran ki la sngewphylla haduh katta bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Mano keiñ uba lah ban lait im ?

translation.en: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas , and destroy Jesus .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la pynkohnguh ïa u paidbah ban kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban pyllait ïa u Barabbas bad ban pynïap ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And Hilkiah , and they that the king had appointed , went to Huldah the prophetess , the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath , the son of Hasrah , keeper of the wardrobe  ; ( now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college : ) and they spake to her to that effect .
translation.kha: Kat kum ka hukum jong u syiem , u Hilkaïah bad kiwei ki leit ïasyllok bad ka kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Huldah , ka nongïathuhlypa kaba sah ha ki bynta ba kham thymmai jong ka Jerusalem . ( U Shallum u tnga jong ka , u khun jong u Tikbah bad u khun ksiew jong u Harhas , ki long kiba sumar ïa ki jaiñkup ha ka Templ . )

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  that made thee , and formed thee from the womb , which will help thee  ; Fear not , O Jacob , my servant  ; and thou , Jeshurun , whom I have chosen .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  uba la thaw ïa phi ; naduh ka por ba la kha ïa phi , nga la ïarap ïa phi . Wat sheptieng ; phi long u shakri jong nga , ki briew ba la jied jong nga kiba nga ieit .
haba ka sngi ka la , ka la noh ïa ki jingthung dang lung bad ba ki thied da ngam jylliew bha , ki jingthung ki tyrkhong
translation.en: But when the sun was up , it was scorched  ; and because it had no root , it withered away .

translation.kha: Nga la kylli , Sa katno kan long kumne , ko Trai ? U la jubab , Tad haduh ba ki nongbah kin jot kin pra bad long thylli — tad ba haduh ïing ki kin ïingjah long — tad haduh ba ka ri hi kan long ka jaka thylli kaba kynjah .
translation.en: Then said I , Lord , how long ? And he answered , Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant , and the houses without man , and the land be utterly desolate ,

translation.kha: Hynrei kine ar kim long kumjuh , namar ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei kam long kum ka pop u Adam . Ka long kaba shisha ba bun ki briew ktung la Pynsawa namar ka pop pynshad Hasael Bethemek u briew . Hynrei ka jingaiei U Blei Dammim long kham khraw , bad kumta saisaw jingbakla jingai sngewbha ïa kiba bun ki briew lyngba ka jingaiei jong uta uwei u briew , U Jisu Khrist barli
translation.en: But not as the offence , so also is the free gift . For if through the offence of one many be dead , much more the grace of God , and the gift by grace , which is by one man , Jesus Christ , hath abounded unto many .
This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen , either in the warp , or woof , or any thing of skins , to pronounce it clean , or to pronounce it unclean .
translation.kha: Kane keiñ ka long kata ka aiñ kaba ïadei bad ka jingbthuh ha ka jaiñkup , la ka dei kaba da u  saiwul ne da ka linen , lane ha kaei kaei kaba la shna da ka snieh , dei ha kane ka rukom yn bishar la ka long kaba khuid ne ka bymkhuid .

translation.en: Then answered Peter and said unto him , Declare unto us this parable .
translation.kha: U Petros u la kren ,  To batai ïa kane ka jingong ha ngi .

translation.en: But I said unto you , That ye also have seen me , and believe not .
translation.kha: Mynta , nga la ïathuh ïa phi ba phi la ïohi ïa nga hynrei phin ym ngeit .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that the plowman shall overtake the reaper , and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed  ; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine , and all the hills shall melt .
translation.kha: Ki sngi ki la poi ,  ong U  Trai  ,  haba u kew un san stet ban ïa kaba lah ban ot , bad ki sohwaiñ kin san stet ban ïa ka waiñ ba lah ban shna . Ki lumbah kin jaw da ka waiñ kaba thiang , bad ki lumrit kin tuid da ka .
Nangta U Trai u la kner pynshaitbor la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa diengtied rmiang shyntur jong nga Kynther bad u la ong Erekh nga pynnep To Gareb , nga ai ha me ki kyntien kiba Reuma katei ban kren .
translation.en: Then the  Lord  put forth his hand , and touched my mouth . And the  Lord  said unto me , Behold , I have put my words in thy mouth .

translation.kha: ïaiban U Jisu um ïaid shuh ha Judia ha pynbatai paw , khohruh u phylliah mihnoh bad leit sha pynjngut jaka hajan ka ri shyiap , sha ka shnong ïa kaba la khot ka Ephraim Ismakhaïah pioneer kaba u la jingpynkut bad ki pioneer .
translation.en: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews  ; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness , into a city called Ephraim , and there continued with his disciples .

translation.kha: Da u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , suh ki ïa ki jaiñphong kiba ishongkun ba ki lyngdoh dei ki ban haba kup ki shakri ha ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang . Ki suh ïa kine ki lyngdoh jaiñphong na ka bynta u Aaron kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: And of the blue , and purple , and scarlet , they made cloths of service , to do service in the holy place , and made the holy garments for Aaron  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Nangta nga ai ruh ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah : ‘ U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la ai ïa kane ka kaba ri sha mihngi na Jordan ba phin ïohkynti ïa . ka pat Mynta , pynkieng atiar ïa ki rangïapom jong phi bad phah ïa ki sha shiliang Jordan ka ha shuwa pat kiwei ki jait Israel ban ïarap ïa ki ban ïohkynti ïa ka bynta jong ki de .
translation.en: And I commanded you at that time , saying , The  Lord  your God hath given you this land to possess it : ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel , all that are meet for the war .

That thou mayest love the  Lord  thy God , and that thou mayest obey his voice , and that thou mayest cleave unto him : for he is thy life , and the length of thy days : that thou mayest dwell in the land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give them .
translation.kha: To ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , kohnguh bad ïaineh ha u ; te ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin im slem ha kata ka ri ba u la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .

translation.en: And what he did unto the army of Egypt , unto their horses , and to their chariots  ; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you , and how the  Lord  hath destroyed them unto this day  ;
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi kumno U  Trai  u la pynduh lut ïa kynhun ïapom ki nong Ijipt , lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali thma jong ki , da kaba pynngam jyllop ïa ki ha ka Duriaw Basaw mynba ki beh nadien jong phi .
Hadien , wat haba ka jingbitar syiem u ka la pjah , u ïai pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba ka Bashti ka la leh bad shaphang ka jingpynbna jong u pyrshah ïa . ka
translation.en: After these things , when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased , he remembered Vashti , and what she had done , and what was decreed against her .

translation.kha: bymmyntoi’ ïohpdiang shispah shah shuh shuh ki ïing , ki nongïaleh ki para shynrang ne kynthei , ki kmie , ki khun bad ki lyngkha — Burom ki jingshah pynshitom beiñ ruh smam ; bad ha randien pateng ka ban sa wan un ïoh ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time , houses , and brethren , and sisters , and mothers , and children , and lands , with persecutions  ; and in the world to come eternal life .

translation.kha: ban kitkhlieh kaba ha peit ïa u kpu ba la ainguh sha U Blei , ïa u purew ba la ju pyndonkam ha ki , jingainguh ïa ki kpu stang kiba la shet khlem thiat , ki ïa jingainguh kiba shu syang , ïa u purew ba la khleh lang bad ka Olib umphniang , ban thew ban woh ïa ki jingainguh ha ka Templ .
translation.en: Both for the shewbread , and for the fine flour for meat offering , and for the unleavened cakes , and for that which is baked in the pan , and for that which is fried , and for all manner of measure and size  ;

And white robes were given unto every one of them  ; and it was said unto them , that they should rest yet for a little season , until their fellowservants also and their brethren , that should be killed as they were , should be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Ha uwei pa uwei na ki la ai ïa ka jaiñkup balieh , bad la ong ïa ki ba kin shongthait sa shipor , tad ynda la dep kheiñ lut ïa ki para shakri bad parabangeit kiba la shah pynïap , kumba la leh ïa ki .
Kane ka ïing da kat ka ïing kan kylla kaba sah kynjah , bad kat ïaid najan ka un kyndit thret bad un met bad kin ïakylli , ‘ Balei mo U Trai u la leh sat kumne ïa kane ka ri bad ïa kane ka ïing ?’
translation.en: And at this house , which is high , every one that passeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss  ; and they shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and to this house ?

translation.kha: U la ong ïa ki , Leit sha ka pyrthei dem Examination bad ïalap ïa ka Gospel sha Jingkñia jaitbynriew baroh .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Go ye into all the world , and preach the gospel to every creature .

translation.kha: Lynthem Blei u thaw ïawan kiei kiei baroh , bad phim lah ban shemphang shuh ïa kaei kaba u jingim ban ïa kaba phi sngewthuh kumno Jerusalem jingim bathymmai ka sdang ha ka kpoh jong ka kynthei kaba kherub .
translation.en: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit , nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child : even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all .

translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa Isaïah , u khun shang u Amos , u mitar jingthoh phasi baroh kiwei rwai ki kam ba :1-3 syiem riewdakaid kyrhuh la leh ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah , first and last , did Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , write .
So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning , to return into the land of the Philistines . And the Philistines went up to Jezreel .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka step kaba bud u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki mihnoh dang step phyrngab ban leit phai sha ka ri ki Philistia , hynrei ki Philistia ki leit kiew sha Jesreel .

translation.en: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation : and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock .
translation.kha: Wallam ïa uta u masi lyngraw ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga , bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger : for ye know the heart of a stranger , seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Wat lehbeiñ ïa u nongwei ; phi tip kumno phi sngew ban long u nongwei , naba phi la ju long ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work made he them .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba tbit tam napdeng kita kiba trei ki shna ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ki shna ïa ka na ki shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba da ka linen bani , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , ha kiba la suh pynpur itynnat da ki dur jong ki Kherub .

translation.en: For which I am an ambassador in bonds : that therein I may speak boldly , as I ought to speak .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka gospel , nga long u nongkit  tiensyiem wat la mynta nga don ha ïingbyndi . To duwai ba nga lah ban long uba shlur ha ka jingkren shaphang ka gospel kumba nga dei .

translation.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters : so doth the grave those which have sinned .
translation.kha: Kumba ka ïor ka jah noh ha ka jingshit bad ka jingryngkhiang , kumjuh ruh u nongpop u jah noh na ka ri jong kiba im .

translation.en: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread : but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding .
translation.kha: U nongrep uba trei shitom u don pahuh ka bam , hynrei ka long ka jingleh bieit ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka por ha ki kam bymmyntoi .

translation.en: Cast not away therefore your confidence , which hath great recompence of reward .
translation.kha: To wat duh noh ïa la ka jingshlur , te , namar ka wallam bad ka , ïa ka bainong kaba khraw .

translation.en: By faith Joseph , when he died , made mention of the departing of the children of Israel  ; and gave commandment concerning his bones .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa U Joseph , ha shuwa ba un ïap , ban kren shaphang ka jingmihnoh ki khun Israel na Ijipt , bad ai ka jingbthah shaphang kaei ba ki dei ban leh ïa ka met jong u .

translation.en: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times , and shall pronounce him clean , and shall let the living bird loose into the open field .
translation.kha: Un synreit ruh hynñiew sien ïa kata ka snam ha ka met uta u briew ïa uba yn dang pynkhuid na ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad hadien kata un sa pynbna ba u long uba khuid . Un pyllait noh ïa kata ka sim kaba dang im ba kan her kat shaba ka mon .
Me dei sngewthuh ba U u la jied me ban tei ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong u . Mynta ïa kata — bad leh ïa kata da ka jingkut jingmut baskhem .
translation.en: Take heed now  ; for the  Lord  hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary : be strong , and do it .
The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high  ; and thou shalt come down very low .
translation.kha: Ki nongwei kiba shong hapdeng jong phi kin nang kham ïohbor katba ma phi pat phin nang duh ïa la ka bor .
Baroh ïarung , u nongïathuhlypa bad uta uba kylli na u 23 kin ïoh pynpluh kajuh ka jingshah pynshitom .
translation.en: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity : the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him  ;

And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon , with the freewill offering of the people , and of the priests , offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem :
translation.kha: Men rah ruh baroh ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba me la lum na baroh kawei ka probins    Babilon bad ki jingainguh kiba ki Israel bad ki lyngdoh jong ki , ki ai na ka bynta ka Templ jong U Blei jong ki ha Jerusalem .
pynjanai khlem iohpateng iakane Baalis pyrthei na ki mynbarim jongngi , ngi pankylliang na ki khun jongngi .
translation.en: We do not inherit the earth from our ancestors , we borrow it from our children .
Thy throne is established of old : thou art from everlasting .
translation.kha: Ka khet jong me , A  Trai  , ka la long kaba skhem naduh mynnyngkong , bad me la long shuwa ka jingsdang ka por .
bad u ki , Khie sha ka Jordan ha shuwa ka ka Jutang U Trai U Blei jong phi . Uwei uwei un bah u ha la ka tyrpeng phi , uwei na ka bynta kawei ka jait Israel .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto them , Pass over before the ark of the  Lord  your God into the midst of Jordan , and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder , according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel :

translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong u Patsha , da kaba ong ba jingïalam uwei pat u syiem , uba kyrteng U Jisu .
translation.en: Whom Jason hath received : and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar , saying that there is another king , one Jesus .

translation.kha: u Nangta angel uba saw u la theh noh ïa pliang ka jong u ha ka sngi , bad la shah ïa ka ban thang ïa ki briew da jingshit tyrha bajur jong ka .
translation.en: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun  ; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire .
And they told what things were done in the way , and how he was known of them in breaking of bread .
translation.kha: Ki ar ngut te ki la batai ha ki ïa kaei kaba la jia ha kata ka lynti , bad ba kumno ki la ithuh ïa U Trai mynba u la kdiah ïa u kpu .

translation.en: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn , whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel , both of man and of beast : it is mine .
translation.kha: Pynkyntang ha nga ïa uba la kha nyngkong baroh , namar kat uba la kha nyngkong napdeng ki Israel , la u briew ne u mrad , u long u jong nga .
Kumta la wad ïa Taberah samla bhabriew ha kylleng ka ri Israel , Tylliat ki lap ha Shunem ïa kaba kum kata ka kynthei kaba kyrteng nongrah Abishag , bad ki la wallam ïa ka sha u syiem .
translation.en: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel , and found Abishag a Shunammite , and brought her to the king .

translation.kha: jingkhawai leit Esekiel na ka Rieh sha ka jingtep , kan piam da jingbymngeit Neng kaba bha kum ka bym shym don .
translation.en: I should have been as though I had not been  ; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave .
And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these parables , he departed thence .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ïathuh ïa kine ki pharshi , u la iehnoh ïa kata ka jaka

Ngi tip ba U Khun U u la wan bad u la ai ngi ïa ka jingshemphang , ba ngin ithuh U Blei uba shisha . Ngi im ha Blei uba shisha — ha U Jisu Khrist Khun jong u . Une u long U uba shisha bad kane ka long ka bymjukut .
translation.en: And we know that the Son of God is come , and hath given us an understanding , that we may know him that is true , and we are in him that is true , even in his Son Jesus Christ . This is the true God , and eternal life .
And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn , and Heth ,
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Kanaan — u Sidon , u khun nyngkong jong u , bad u Heth — kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .

translation.en: And truly the Son of man goeth , as it was determined : but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed !
translation.kha: U Khun U Briew un ïap kumba U Blei u la thmu , hynrei a katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa uta u briew uba shetkylla ïa u !

translation.en: And one of Joab s men stood by him , and said , He that favoureth Joab , and he that is for David , let him go after Joab .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki rangbah jong u Joab u la ïeng harud ka metïap jong u Amasa bad u pyrta ,  Uno uno uba ha ka liang jong u Joab bad u Dabid , to un bud ïa u Joab !

translation.en: I said in my haste , All men are liars .
translation.kha: wat haba nga la sheptieng bad nga ong ,  Ym don uwei ruh ïa uba lah ban shaniah .
U Nongpynim pynmadan ïa ki Aroer kiba bat ki waitlam ha baroh Pilat Law ba ha khmat jong ka Templ ban ïada pynïakren u syiem .
translation.en: And he set all the people , every man having his weapon in his hand , from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple , along by the altar and the temple , by the king round about .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki u pynbor ïa u ban ïaleit bad lang ki ; u la mynjur , bad u ïaleit ryngkat bad ki .
translation.en: And one said , Be content , I pray thee , and go with thy servants . And he answered , I will go .

translation.kha: ïa kine harum jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki paid Israel ha ka u mut ban ai ki .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye come into the land whither I bring you ,

translation.kha: Wat la katta , kam dei ka kamram jong nga ban bishar ïa kiba nabar . U Blei bishar ïa ki hato kam dei ban ïa ki dkhot na la ka jong kynhun hi ? Kumba ka Jingthoh ka , Pynmih noh ïa u briew uba sniew na ka kynhun jong phi .
translation.en: But them that are without God judgeth . Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person .
And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven , and poured out drink offerings unto her , did we make her cakes to worship her , and pour out drink offerings unto her , without our men ?
translation.kha: Bad ki kynthei ki ong shuh shuh ,  Haba ngi shet ïa ki kpu ha ka dur kum ka Syiem jong ka Bneng , ngi ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ka , bad theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ ha ka , ki tnga jong ngi ki mynjur ïa kaei kaba ngi leh .

translation.en: And we know that the Son of God is come , and hath given us an understanding , that we may know him that is true , and we are in him that is true , even in his Son Jesus Christ . This is the true God , and eternal life .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba U Khun U Blei u la wan bad u la ai ha ngi ïa ka jingshemphang , khnang ba ngin ithuh ïa U Blei uba shisha . Ngi im ha U Blei uba shisha — ha U Jisu Khrist U Khun jong u . Une u long U Blei uba shisha , bad kane ka long ka jingim bymjukut .
Hynrei ki paidbah jong ka Gibeon , kiba ki ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba Joshua u la ïa ka Jerikho bad ïa ka Ai ,
translation.en: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai ,
And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , even a ram for a trespass offering .
translation.kha: Uta u briew un wallam uwei u langbrot ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga kum ka jingkñia namar ka jingpalat jong u ,
Mynta sdang noh ïa ka kam , bad to U Trai un ryngkat long bad me .
translation.en: Of the gold , the silver , and the brass , and the iron , there is no number . Arise therefore , and be doing , and the  Lord  be with thee .
And Moses said , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded that ye should do : and the glory of the  Lord  shall appear unto you .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi ban leh ïa kane baroh , khnang ba ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong u kan paw ha phi .
Kin phai noh kaba shahshkor ïa jingshisha bad kin pynleit jingmut ha ki kai .
translation.en: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth , and shall be turned unto fables .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki lyer ban beh pyrshah ïa ka Elam na ki liang baroh , bad ngan pynsakma ïa ki briew jong kylleng ka , haduh ba yn ym don ki ri ha kiba ki nongphetwir na ka kim shym poi .
translation.en: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven , and will scatter them toward all those winds  ; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come .

translation.kha: To hukum ïa kita kiba shankhung ha kiei sbak jong kane pynjam jingim ba kin pynriam Mikhmethath , hynrei ban buh ïa ka jingkyrmen Jingrakhe ki , ym ha kata kaei kaei ka Resin thikna kum Stoik spah , khlei ha U Blei , uba kyrsiew kyrhai ïa kiei kiei Jannes na ka bynta ka jingsngewbha jong ngi .
translation.en: Charge them that are rich in this world , that they be not highminded , nor trust in uncertain riches , but in the living God , who giveth us richly all things to enjoy ;

translation.kha: U don ka bor briew , hynrei ngi don U Trai Shimron Blei jong ngi u ban ïarap ïa ngi ban ïaleh ïa ki Pynjot jong ngi . Ki briew ki ïoh ïa ka jingpynshlur da kine ki :30-33 jong u syiem kynsai ki .
translation.en: With him is an arm of flesh  ; but with us is the  Lord  our God to help us , and to fight our battles . And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah .

translation.kha: Kumta ym dei shisha ma phi kiba la phah ïa nga shane , hynrei U Blei hi . la U pynlong ïa nga rangbah u synshar bahakhlieh duh . Nga dei u nongkhmih ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei ; long nga u nongsynshar ïa ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .
translation.en: So now it was not you that sent me hither , but God : and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh , and lord of all his house , and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt .

Thus saith the  Lord  , the Redeemer of Israel , and his Holy One , to him whom man despiseth , to him whom the nation abhorreth , to a servant of rulers , Kings shall see and arise , princes also shall worship , because of the  Lord  that is faithful , and the Holy One of Israel , and he shall choose thee .
translation.kha: U Blei Bakhuid bad u nongpynim ki Israel u ong ïa uta uba shah ibeiñ , ïa uba la isih da ki jaitbynriew bad uba long u shakri jong ki nongsynshar :  Ki syiem kin ïohi ba la pyllait ïa me bad kin ïeng ban pynpaw ïa ka jingñiewburom jong ki ; ki khun syiem ruh kin ïohi ïa kata , bad kin dem khrup ban pyndonburom ïa me .  Kane kan jia namar U  Trai  u la jied ïa la u shakri ; U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel u bat ïa la ki kular .

Katto katne ngut na ki parabangeit na Kaisaria ruh ki la ïaleit bad ngi bad ki la ïalam ïa ngi sha ka ïing jong u briew ha balaitluid ngin sah — u Mnason , uba Tattenai Sypros , uba Khyrdop long u parabangeit naduh ki sngi Israel Alphaïos sdang .
translation.en: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea , and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus , an old disciple , with whom we should lodge .
But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , one ram , seven lambs of the first year  ;
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  : ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
Ban buh bujli ïa ki , u syiem Rehoboam u thaw da stieh rnong bad u aiti ki ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba ban ïada ïa ki khyrdop jong ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields , and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard , which kept the door of the king s house .
Upon man s flesh shall it not be poured , neither shall ye make any other like it , after the composition of it : it is holy , and it shall be holy unto you .
translation.kha: Wat theh ïa ka ha ka met jong uno uno u riewpaidbah bad wat pyndonkam ïa kajuh ka rukom khleh ban shna ïa kawei pat ka jait umphniang kaba kum kane . Kane ka long kaba kyntang , bad phi dei ban kheiñ kyntang ïa ka .
Ka pyrthei ka khih katba ki nang ka ka khynñiuh Ka sngi bad u bnai ki kylla dum , bad ki khlur kim shai shuh .
translation.en: The earth shall quake before them  ; the heavens shall tremble : the sun and the moon shall be dark , and the stars shall withdraw their shining :
Salute every saint in Christ Jesus . The brethren which are with me greet you .
translation.kha: To ai khublei ïa uwei pa uwei na ki briew jong U Blei kiba ha U Khrist Jisu . Ki parabangeit hangne lem bad nga ki phah sha phi ki jingkhublei jong ki .

translation.en: And gave their land for an heritage , an heritage unto Israel his people .
translation.kha: U la ai ïa ki ri jong ki sha ki briew jong u ; u la ai ïa ki ha ki Israel .

Kito kiba pyrshang ban buhrieh ki ïa jingthmu jong ki na U Trai , kin jot noh ! Ki pynïaid ïa ki rukom treikam jong ki ha kaba rieh bad ki ba pyrkhat yn ym ba don ïohi ïa ki lane tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh .
translation.en: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the  Lord  , and their works are in the dark , and they say , Who seeth us ? and who knoweth us ?
Woe unto you , when all men shall speak well of you ! for so did their fathers to the false prophets .
translation.kha: Katno kaba shyrkhei haba baroh ki briew ki kren bha shaphang jong phi ; ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la kren ïa kijuh kiei kiei shaphang ki nongïathuhlypa lamler .

translation.en: But thou , O Daniel , shut up the words , and seal the book , even to the time of the end : many shall run to and fro , and knowledge shall be increased .
translation.kha: U la ong ha nga ,  Bad mynta , ko Daniel to khylliap noh ïa ka kitab bad shon muhor halor jong ka haduh ka jingkut jong ka pyrthei . Ha kajuh ka por , kiba bun ki briew kin pynlehnoh-ei ïa ki jingpyrshang jong ki ban sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba jia .

translation.en: But the flesh of the bullock , and his skin , and his dung , shalt thou burn with fire without the camp : it is a sin offering .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ka doh jong uta u masi lyngraw , ïa ka snieh jong u , bad ïa ki  nierlang jong u , dei ban thang ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara . Kane ka long ka jingainguh ban sait ïa ki pop jong ki lyngdoh .

Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba shiphew jong ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , uwei u briew la uba lait im , na Jerusalem u la wan sha nga bad u la ïathuh ha nga ba ka nongbah ka la kyllon .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity , in the tenth month , in the fifth day of the month , that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me , saying , The city is smitten .

And when he was come nigh , even now at the descent of the mount of Olives , the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen  ;
translation.kha: Haba u la poi hajan ka Jerusalem , ha ka jaka ha kaba ka lynti kaba hiar sha u lum ki Olib , ki paid synran jong u kiba bun bah ki la sdang ban ainguh ïa U Blei bad ïaroh ïa u ha ki sur bajam na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba khraw baroh kiba ki la lah ïohi :

translation.en: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones . And the glory of the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la byrngem ban lynthem maw ïa ki , hynrei kynsan ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ba ka paw halor ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Also I shook my lap , and said , So God shake out every man from his house , and from his labour , that performeth not this promise , even thus be he shaken out , and emptied . And all the congregation said , Amen , and praised the  Lord . And the people did according to this promise .
translation.kha: Nangta nga shim ïa ka jaiñ ba nga teh sawdong ïa ka syngkai jong nga bad kynther ïa ka .  Kumne U Blei un kynther ïano ïano na phi u bym bat ïa la ka kular ,  nga ong .  U Blei un shim noh ïa ki ïing jong phi bad ïa kiei kiei baroh ba phi don , bad un iehnoh ïa phi khlem don ei ei shuh .  Baroh kiba don hangta ki ong ,  Amen !  bad ki ïaroh ïa U  Trai . Bad ki nongïalam ki bat ïa ka kular jong ki .

translation.en: And immediately , while he yet spake , cometh Judas , one of the twelve , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang kren mynba u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran u la poi . Ryngkat bad u , la don u paidbah ba la kieng atiar da ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , ïa uba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum , bad ki rangbah nongïalam .

translation.en: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion , and as a young lion to the house of Judah : I , even I , will tear and go away  ; I will take away , and none shall rescue him .
translation.kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki paid Israel bad Judah kum u sing . Ma nga hi da lade ngan patar lyngkhot ïa ki , bad nangta ngan iehnoh ïa ki . Haba nga patan tyngeh ïa ki , yn ym don uba lah ban pyllait ïa ki .

Uno uno babiang briew uba pyllait noh kynsha lyngngeit tnga jong u bad shongkurim ïa kawei pat ïalynñiar briew laitim tyndong ; bad u briew uba shongkurim ïa ka briew kaba la shah pyllait tnga u klim .
translation.en: Whosoever putteth away his wife , and marrieth another , committeth adultery : and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery .

Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word  ; Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Every bottle shall be filled with wine : and they shall say unto thee , Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , ïathuh ïa ki paid Israel ba ïa uwei pa uwei u khra buh waiñ dei ban pyndap da ka waiñ . Kin jubab ba ki tip ba ïa uwei pa uwei u khra buh waiñ dei ban pyndap da ka waiñ .
U u khang ïa ka lynti , bad ngam lah ban ïaid lyngba ; u la buhrieh ïa ka lynti jong ha ka jingdum .
translation.en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass , and he hath set darkness in my paths .

translation.kha: U thaw la ki durblei nar jong u Baal ,
translation.en: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel , and made also molten images for Baalim .

And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw , even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city : and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar  ; and I fell upon my face .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingïohipaw ka la long kum kaba nga la ïohi mynba U Blei u la wan ban pynjot ïa ka Jerusalem , bad kum kaba nga la ïohi harud ka wah Khebar . Nangta nga la dem pyllup ïa lade ha ka khyndew .

translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , and Timothy our brother , unto the church of God which is at Corinth , with all the saints which are in all Achaia :
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u apostol U Khrist Jisu da ka mon U Blei , bad na u Timothi u para jong ngi — Sha ka balang U Blei kaba ha Korinth , bad sha ki briew jong U Blei baroh kiba ha Akhaïa :

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Depart , and go up hence , thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt , unto the land which I sware unto Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , saying , Unto thy seed will I give it :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Khie ïamihnoh nangne , ma me bad ki paidbah kiba me la ïalam na ka ri Ijipt , bad leit sha kata ka ri ïa kaba nga la kular ban ai ha u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent fiery serpents among the people , and they bit the people  ; and much people of Israel died .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la phah da ki bseiñ ba-dap da ka bih hapdeng kita ki briew , bad bun ki Israel ki la shah puh bad ïap .

translation.en: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God , to confirm the promises made unto the fathers :
translation.kha: Naba nga ong ïa phi ba ka jingim jong ka jingshakri U Khrist ka la long na ka bynta ki Jiw , ban pyn-i ba U Blei u long uba ïaineh , ban pynlong ïa ki kular jong u ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban urlong shisha ,
Ki thohbria ka syiemsad ki pynïap kylla ïa Synduk nongpynïap ïa jinglui Amon bad ki pynlong syiem ïa u Josaïah u khun jong u .
translation.en: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon  ; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead .

translation.kha: u hiar arsut na sha bad Naarah , u poi haduh ka Jerikho kut ha ka Jordan .
translation.en: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth , and to Naarath , and came to Jericho , and went out at Jordan .
By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually , that is , the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name .
translation.kha: Namarkata , to ngin ai jingïaroh ïa U Blei khlem da pud kum ka jingkñia da U Jisu , kaba long ka jingainguh da ki rmiang shyntur kiba phla ïa u kum U Trai .
Na uta u masi un shim noh ïa ka khleiñ baroh , ïa lwep khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki Kenis ,
translation.en: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering  ; the fat that covereth the inwards , and all the fat that is upon the inwards ,
For a great door and effectual is opened unto me , and there are many adversaries .
translation.kha: Ka don ka kabu da shisha hangne na ka bynta ka jingtrei kaba khraw bad kaba myntoi , wat lada don bun ki nongïaleh pyrshah .
U Pilat u la ong ha ki ha ka sien kaba lai Hynrei kaei ka kam runar kaba u la leh ? Ngam lah ban shem ïa kano kano kaba u la leh kaba u dei ban ïap ! phah ïa u bad pyllait noh ïa u .
translation.en: And he said unto them the third time , Why , what evil hath he done ? I have found no cause of death in him : I will therefore chastise him , and let him go .

translation.kha: U Jisu la na kata ka bad u la leit pat la shnong ; synran ki bud ïa u .
translation.en: And he went out from thence , and came into his own country  ; and his disciples follow him .
And in the morning , It will be foul weather to day : for the sky is red and lowring . O ye hypocrites , ye can discern the face of the sky  ; but can ye not discern the signs of the times ?
translation.kha: Bad dang step phyrngab phi ong , ‘ Kan sa slap , namar ba ka suiñbneng ka saw bad ka dum .’ Phi lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka jinglong ka suiñbneng da kaba khmih ïa ka sahit bneng , hynrei phim lah ban batai ïa ki dak kiba ïadei bad kine ki por !

translation.en: And there came one that had escaped , and told Abram the Hebrew  ; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite , brother of Eshcol , and brother of Aner : and these were confederate with Abram .
translation.kha: Te uwei uba la ïohlait u wan ïathuh ïa kane baroh ha u Abram , u Hebru , uba la shong la sah hajan ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre u kynja Amor . U Mamre bad ki para shynrang jong u , u Eshkol bad u Aber , ki dei ki paralok u Abram .
U u Ahab ong ha u Jehoshaphat Katba , ngi dang leit sha ka thma , ngan riam pher ïa lade , hynrei phi riam ha ki jaiñphong syiem phi jong . Kumta u syiem Israel u leit sha ka thma da jingriam pher .
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , I will disguise myself , and enter into the battle  ; but put thou on thy robes . And the king of Israel disguised himself , and went into the battle .

translation.kha: Wat ju ailad ïa u Men uba jaipdeh ban leh ei jingkhroh na ka 8 jong Mahanaim ; un long kum ka sirka kaba pynshyrkhei ïa ki bniat , lane kumba pynsat ka tdem jingbnoh ki khmat .
translation.en: As vinegar to the teeth , and as smoke to the eyes , so is the sluggard to them that send him .
But he giveth more grace . Wherefore he saith , God resisteth the proud , but giveth grace unto the humble .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingaiei kaba U Blei u ai ka long kaba kham khlaiñ shuh shuh . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u pyrshah ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u ai ïa ka jingaiei ha kiba sngewrit .
Ïa ka ïing jong u yn tip ha Israel kum ‘ Ka ïing jong uta u briew uba la shah loit juti .’
translation.en: And his name shall be called in Israel , The house of him that hath his shoe loosed .

translation.kha: Baroh ki la ong , Hato ma me , te , me long U Khun U Blei ? U langbrot jubab ïa ki , Phi ong ba Hophni paralok .
translation.en: Then said they all , Art thou then the Son of God ? And he said unto them ,  Ye say that I am .

translation.kha: Lashai sngi ka ka dei ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai u Dabid jubab u bad nga dei ban ïashong bam ryngkat bad u syiem . Hynrei lada ka long kaba biang phi ïa , ngan leit noh ban rieh ha ki bri haduh la shi sngi janmiet .
translation.en: And David said unto Jonathan , Behold , to morrow is the new moon , and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat : but let me go , that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even .

translation.kha: Ngi ha ka pule Hukum u Moses , Wat khum ïa ka shyntur u masi dab haba me pyndonkam ïa u ban shoh ïa u kew . Mynta , hato U Blei u sngewkhia ïa u masi dab ?
translation.en: For it is written in the law of Moses , Thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn . Doth God take care for oxen ?
His flesh shall be fresher than a child s : he shall return to the days of his youth :
translation.kha: Ka met jong u kan khie lung kumba dang samla bad ban khlaiñ pat ;

Nangta nga phiah , jylla kaba jingsam leh ka long kaba bakla ! Phi Janoah ban kohnguh ïa U Blei bad leh ïa jingshemphang kaba dei , sngewshyrkhei ba phin ym pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong ngi , ki Jentil bynta ïa kano kano ka daw ba kin krenbeiñ ïa ngi Nebusaradan
translation.en: Also I said , It is not good that ye do : ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies ?
And Saul also went home to Gibeah  ; and there went with him a band of men , whose hearts God had touched .
translation.kha: U Saul ruh u leit phai sha la ïing ha Gibeah . Katto katne ki rangbah kiba khlaiñ ryngkat bad ki nongïapom kiba U Blei u la ktah ïa ki dohnud jong ki , ki la leit lang bad u .
U Jakob u kren-ïa tymmen jong ngi u la shaka ban phet ïap sha Mesopotamia , ha kaba , ban ïoh kiei ka tnga , u trei na ka bynta ïa uwei u briew bad sumar ïa ki langbrot jingpynthikna u .
translation.en: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria , and Israel served for a wife , and for a wife he kept sheep .

translation.kha: Bad U Blei u la ong , ‘ Bikri kane ka daw u briew Mitylene iehnoh ïa Atad u kpa bad ïa la ka Maw bad un ïashong ïasah bad la ka tnga , bad ma ki baroh ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .’
translation.en: And said , For this cause shall a man leave father and mother , and shall cleave to his wife : and they twain shall be one flesh ?

translation.kha: U Jisu kram la ong , Uno Mano uba la dep sum jingpynhun long uba la khuid Pynkylla bad pyntyrkhong donkam ban da jingkynrum ïa lade , lait noh ïa la ki kjat . Baroh na phi , jin long kiba tyrso — jingïa-umsnam lait noh jingkyrpang .
translation.en: Jesus saith to him ,  He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet , but is clean every whit : and ye are clean , but not all .
I taught Ephraim also to go , taking them by their arms  ; but they knew not that I healed them .
translation.kha: Pynban dei ma nga uba hikai ïa ki Israel ban ïaid . Nga la rah ïa ki briew jong nga ha la ki ksang ti , hynrei kim shym la pdiang ba nga la sumar ïa ki .

translation.en: And as they went about to kill him , tidings came unto the chief captain of the band , that all Jerusalem was in an uproar .
translation.kha: U paidbhur u la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u Paul , haba la phah ïa ka khubor sha u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Rom ba ka Jerusalem baroh ka la khihwin .

translation.en: For where your treasure is , there will your heart be also .
translation.kha: Namar ba ka dohnud jong phi kan ïai don ha ka jaka kaba don ka spah jong phi .

Ka la long namar phim don ka jingngeit ale biang , la jubab U sngewphylla . Nga pynthikna ïa basaw ba lada phi don shongthait jingngeit astor heh kat u symbai tyrso , phi lah ban khajna ïa Soan u lumrit shiteng ‘ Khie leit noh nangne shatai !’ bad un leit . Phi lah ban leh ïa kano kano !
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Because of your unbelief : for verily I say unto you , If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed , ye shall say unto this mountain , Remove hence to yonder place  ; and it shall remove  ; and nothing shall be impossible unto you .
Study his Word each day .
translation.kha: Pule ïa ka ktien jong U man la ka sngi .
Shah ïa nga , A Trai , ban jam ïa wah Jordan bad ïohi ïa ka ri kaba seisoh shatai sha shiliang , ka ri lum kaba itynnat , bad ki lum Lebanon .’
translation.en: I pray thee , let me go over , and see the good land that is beyond Jordan , that goodly mountain , and Lebanon .

translation.kha: Haba ka khubor bashisha , ka Khubor Babha , ka wan nyngkong phi , phi la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingkyrmen ka tyrwa . Kumta ïa jingngeit bad ka jong phi pynshong nongrim ha kaei kaba phi kyrmen ïa kaba la buh sumar na ka jong ha bneng .
translation.en: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven , whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel ;

translation.kha: U Abram u la kine ki mrad sha U Blei , u ot ïa ki ar lyngkhot , bad u buh ïa ki lyngkhot doh marpyrshah kawei ïa kawei pat ha ki ar ; hynrei ïa ki sim shym la ot .
translation.en: And he took unto him all these , and divided them in the midst , and laid each piece one against another : but the birds divided he not .
But there was a certain man , called Simon , which beforetime in the same city used sorcery , and bewitched the people of Samaria , giving out that himself was some great one :
translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Simon u shong u sah hangta , uba shipor u la pynlyngngoh ïa ki nong Samaria da ka jingleh myntor jong u .
Bad kumta baroh kiba sah u na bynriew kin wan sha nga baroh , ki Jentil ïa kiba nga la khot ban long ki jong nga .
translation.en: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord , and all the Gentiles , upon whom my name is called , saith the Lord , who doeth all these things .

translation.kha: Haba u Barak u tur ïaleh lem bad la ka kynhun shipai , snur wan u buh ïa u Sisera Nimrah ka man jingmut lem Moladah ki Miriam samthiah bad ki rangbah nongsynshar u baroh . U Sisera Balang hiar na la ka ;’ ïapom bad u phet ïap da ka kjat .
translation.en: And the  Lord  discomfited Sisera , and all his chariots , and all his host , with the edge of the sword before Barak  ; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot , and fled away on his feet .

translation.kha: U Trai u long u syiem ! Ko pyrthei , to lehkmen ! To shadkmen , ko ki dewlynnong ki ha duriaw !
translation.en: The  Lord  reigneth  ; let the earth rejoice  ; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof .
For the good that I would I do not : but the evil which I would not , that I do .
translation.kha: Ngam leh ïa kaba bha kaba nga kwah ban leh ; pynban , nga leh ïa kaba sniew kaba ngam kwah ban leh .

translation.en: And he left them , and went away again , and prayed the third time , saying the same words .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa ki , u la leit noh , bad u la duwai ha ka sien kaba lai , da kaba ong ïa kijuh ki kyntien .
Shakri ïa U Trai jingñiewkor nongkhaïi jingsheptieng ;
translation.en: Serve the  Lord  with fear , and rejoice with trembling .
Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan long ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad ka mrad .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: And there followed him a certain young man , having a linen cloth cast about his naked body  ; and the young men laid hold on him :
translation.kha: Uwei u samla , uba kup tang da ka jaiñ linen , u bud ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft , and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry . Because thou hast rejected the word of the  Lord  , he hath also rejected thee from being king .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa u ka long kaba sniew hi kum ka jingleh byrtong , bad ka jingmeng ka long hi ka pop kum ka jingmane bleithaw . Namar ba me la kyntait ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , u la kyntait ïa me kum u syiem .

bad u la ong , Mynta te , kine baroh ki la long uwei paid u bynriew bad ki ïakren kawei ka ktien ; kane ka dei tang ka jingsdang jong kaei kaba kin sa leh Shen . shen kin lah ban leh ïa kano kat kano kaba ki thmu !
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Behold , the people is one , and they have all one language  ; and this they begin to do : and now nothing will be restrained from them , which they have imagined to do .

translation.kha: syiem u la u Ashpenas , u rangbah synshar duh jong u , ban jied napdeng ki nong Israel kiba la shah ringmraw ïa ki katto katne ngut ki samla shynrang na ka longïing syiem bad na ki ki riewkhraw .
translation.en: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs , that he should bring certain of the children of Israel , and of the king s seed , and of the princes  ;
