translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka akasia dieng , bad suit ïa ki ruh da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold .

translation.kha: Shaniah ha U Trai da ka dohnud jong phi baroh . shaniah Wat ha kaei ba phi pyrkhat ba phi tip .
translation.en: Trust in the  Lord  with all thine heart  ; and lean not unto thine own understanding .
Thus saith the  Lord  the King of Israel , and his redeemer the  Lord  of hosts  ; I am the first , and I am the last  ; and beside me there is no God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  uba synshar bad uba ïada ïa ki Israel , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , u don ïa kane ban ong :  Nga long uba nyngkong , uba khatduh , tang ma nga hi U Blei ; ym don uwei pat U Blei hynrei tang ma nga .

Nangta ki briew ki Jahmai ong , To ngin leh ei ei ktieh u Jeremaïah ! Yn don borabor ki lyngdoh babe Haeleph hikai rukom ngi , ki rangbah bitar ban Khenanaïah jingsyllok ïa ngi , bad ki nongïathuhlypa Barsillai pynbna ïa Kamra khubor jong U Blei . To ngin wallam ngiah jingmudui ryndang-kti ïa u , bad sangeh ban pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba u ong .
translation.en: Then said they , Come , and let us devise devices against Jeremiah  ; for the law shall not perish from the priest , nor counsel from the wise , nor the word from the prophet . Come , and let us smite him with the tongue , and let us not give heed to any of his words .

translation.kha: Trai U u kylla biang la ka jingmut bad u la ong , Kane ruh kan ym jia .
translation.en: The  Lord  repented for this : This also shall not be , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: U Jakob u ong , Haba ka sngi ka dang kumne bad ka kam pat dei ban leit set ki langbrot , balei nang ai um ïa ki bad ïalam biang ïa sha ka jaka bam phlang ?
translation.en: And he said , Lo , it is yet high day , neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together : water ye the sheep , and go and feed them .
But as it is written , Eye hath not seen , nor ear heard , neither have entered into the heart of man , the things which God hath prepared for them that love him .
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ïa kaei kaba ym pat don mano mano ba la ïohi ne ïohsngew , ïa kaei kaba ym pat don mano mano ba la pyrkhat ba lah ban jia , ka long kata hi kaei kaei kaba U Blei u la pynkhreh ïa kito kiba ieit ïa u .

translation.en: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria , saying , If the  Lord  shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem , then I will serve the  Lord .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang sah ha Geshur kaba ha Syria , nga la kular ïa U  Trai  ba lada un ïalam biang ïa nga sha Jerusalem , ngan mane ïa u ha Hebron .

translation.en: At the same time my reason returned unto me  ; and for the glory of my kingdom , mine honour and brightness returned unto me  ; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me  ; and I was established in my kingdom , and excellent majesty was added unto me .
translation.kha: Haba ka jingtipbriew jong nga ka la wan phai , ïa ka burom jong nga , ka jinglong syiem jong nga , bad ka burom jong ka hima jong nga la ai pat ha nga . Ki rangbah synshar jong nga bad ki rangbah donburom jong nga ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , bad la ai pat ha nga ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem , bad wat ka jingpyndonburom kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaba mynshuwa .

Ha kawei ka sngi ka Ruth ka ong ha ka Naomi , Shah ba leit ngan sha ki lyngkha ban tam ïa u kew ba ki nongot ki ieh . Nga thikna shem ban u briew u ban shah ïa nga ban trei u bad . Ka Naomi ka ong , Khie , leit ko khun jong nga .
translation.en: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi , Let me now go to the field , and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace . And she said unto her , Go , my daughter .

translation.kha: Nangta halor u Lum Seïon bad halor baroh kiba sngewdei ïalumlang hangta , U Trai un Arbad ïa u lyoh ha jingmynsaw por mynsngi bad ka tdem bad ka thylliej ding baphyrnai ha (Khlem por mynmiet . Ka burom U Blei kan tap bad da ïa ka dkhoi baroh kawei .
translation.en: And the  Lord  will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion , and upon her assemblies , a cloud and smoke by day , and the shining of a flaming fire by night : for upon all the glory shall be a defence .

translation.kha: U syiem u la ïeng Resin , u kad Amasa la ki jaiñ Abishua ka jingsngewsih , bad u lympat ïa lade ha khyndew . Ki shakri ruh kiba don bashatei bad u ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ .
translation.en: Then the king arose , and tare his garments , and lay on the earth  ; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent .
For false Christs and false prophets shall rise , and shall shew signs and wonders , to seduce , if it were possible , even the elect .
translation.kha: Namar ki Messaïah balamler bad ki nongïathuhlypa balamler kin mih . Kin leh ïa ki kambah bad ki jingphylla khnang ban shukor wat ïa ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei , lada long kaba lah .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said , Take Micaiah , and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city , and to Joash the king s son  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Ahab u hukum ïa uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ,  Kem ïa u Mikaïah bad ïalam ïa u sha u Amon , u lat jong kane ka nongbah , bad sha u Joash u khun syiem .

translation.en: But who is able to build him an house , seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him ? who am I then , that I should build him an house , save only to burn sacrifice before him ?
translation.kha: Pynban ym don uno uno uba lah shisha ban tei ka Templ na ka bynta U Blei , namar wat ka jingïar jong ka bneng kam lah ban ngiam ïa u . Kumno te nga lah ban tei ka Templ ka ban long kaba kumno kumno kaba kham heh ban ïa ka jaka ban thang jingiwbih ïa U Blei ?
Hynrei mynta ngan lumlang ïa pihuiñ bad pynshitom Shelah ki . Shen shen :26 sa kyrthat ha hylla jingpang Sdien haba Pontos patsha ka sngewlah u banbeiñ ïa ki Thummim
translation.en: Yea , though they have hired among the nations , now will I gather them , and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes .
And if he shall neglect to hear them , tell it unto the church : but if he neglect to hear the church , let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican .
translation.kha: Bad lada um shahshkor ïa ki , te to ïathuh ïa kaei kaei baroh ha ka balang . Khatduh , lada um shahshkor ïa ka balang , to ñiew ïa u kumba u long u nongmane blei thala lane u nonglum khajna .
U Abimelekh u ong , Ngam shym tip mano ba la leh ïa . kane Mem shym la ïathuh ei ei shaphang kane ha nga , bad kane ka long ka sien kaba nyngkong nga ba ïohsngew la ïa ka .
translation.en: And Abimelech said , I wot not who hath done this thing : neither didst thou tell me , neither yet heard I of it , but to day .

translation.kha: Wat lada ki nga Blei jong ki bad ki kam ba ki dei ki briew jong nga bad ba ki ïa nga ,
translation.en: Israel shall cry unto me , My God , we know thee .

Behold , I will bring a fear upon thee , saith the Lord  God  of hosts , from all those that be about thee  ; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth  ; and none shall gather up him that wandereth .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa ka jingma ha phi na ki liang baroh . Baroh phin phet krad . Uwei pa uwei un phet ïap namar la ka jingim , bad yn ym don shuh mano mano ban wallam lang sa shisien ïa ki shipai .
Me la thaw ïa , me sumar ïa nga to ai ha nga ka jingshemphang , khnang ba ngan lah ban nang ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translation.en: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me : give me understanding , that I may learn thy commandments .
Rejoice in the  Lord  , ye righteous  ; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness .
translation.kha: Ko phi kiba hok baroh to lehkmen namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ! To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U Blei uba khuid u la leh , bad to ainguh ïa u .

U la ïa phi , u la pynshahthngan phi , bad hadien kata u la ai phi ïa manna ban bam , ka jingbam kaba ma ki kpa tymmen jong phi phim pat ïoh mynno . Ban hikai ïa phi ba u um im tang u kpu da ktien baroh kaba mih na U Trai
translation.en: And he humbled thee , and suffered thee to hunger , and fed thee with manna , which thou knewest not , neither did thy fathers know  ; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only , but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the  Lord  doth man live .
Seeing then that we have a great high priest , that is passed into the heavens , Jesus the Son of God , let us hold fast our profession .
translation.kha: Te , to ngin batskhem ïa ka jingngeit ïa kaba ngi phla . Naba ngi don U Rangbah Lyngdoh uba khraw uba la leit haduh ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei — U Jisu , U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: And the border went up to Beth–hoglah , and passed along by the north of Beth–arabah  ; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben :
translation.kha: ka ïar sha Beth Hoglah , nangta ka ïaid shaphang shatei jong ka kynjang ha kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Jordan . Nangta ka kiew artet sha u Maw jong u Bohan ( u Bohan u dei u khun jong u Reuben ) ,

U Trai u ong ha ki briew jong u , To ïeng ha ka ba ïashem ki lad bad to khmih . Kylli shaphang ki lynti ïaid mynbarim bad ka ka surok babha tam To ha ka , bad ha ka jingsuk . Hynrei ki ong , Em , ngin ym leh !
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Stand ye in the ways , and see , and ask for the old paths , where is the good way , and walk therein , and ye shall find rest for your souls . But they said , We will not walk therein .

translation.kha: U Saul u khot jingïathiah ïa ki Shuh Besek : ki Manoah Israel pneh don lai lakh ngut , kyndok ki rangbah Judah pat laiphew hajar ngut .
translation.en: And when he numbered them in Bezek , the children of Israel were three hundred thousand , and the men of Judah thirty thousand .

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut , Kata ka long kumno ba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng un leh uwei ïa pa uwei na phi lymda phi ïamap ïa la u hynmen para u naduh ka . dohnud
translation.en: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you , if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses .
And he ordained twelve , that they should be with him , and that he might send them forth to preach ,
translation.kha: Ki la wan sha u , bad u la jied khat-ar ngut , ïa kiba u la khot apostol .  Nga la jied ïa phi ban long lem bad nga ,  u la ong ïa ki .
Ai ba kin wan ïalam shane ïa u kpa jong phi ryngkat bad ki ha-sem ba-ha-ïing ki jong . ai Ngan ïa ki ka jaka kaba bha tam ha Ijipt , bad kin ïoh palat ïa kaba ki donkam .
translation.en: And take your father and your households , and come unto me : and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt , and ye shall eat the fat of the land .

translation.kha: Da kumta , te , kaba kumno ka jingpynbaptis la phi ïohpdiang ? Ka jingpynbaptis u Ïoannis , ki la jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Unto what then were ye baptized ? And they said , Unto John s baptism .

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi , la u ong ha ki , Phi ïatip kumno ba nga la pynlut ïa ka por haba nga la don bad phi , naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong ba nga la poi ha ka probins jong ka Asia .
translation.en: And when they were come to him , he said unto them , Ye know , from the first day that I came into Asia , after what manner I have been with you at all seasons ,
Notwithstanding , if he continue a day or two , he shall not be punished : for he is his money .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uta u mraw u im shi sngi lane ar sngi , uta u briew um dei ban shah pynshitom . Ka jingduh jong u ïa la u mraw uba long ka spah jong u ka la long hi ka jingpynshitom .

translation.en: Thou shalt fan them , and the wind shall carry them away , and the whirlwind shall scatter them : and thou shalt rejoice in the  Lord  , and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Men kynting ïa ki ha ka lyer ; ka lyer kaba jur kan kit lut ïa ki , bad yn pynsaphriang ïa ki da ka  erïong . Te men sa kmen namar nga long U Blei jong me ; men ïaroh ïa nga , U Blei bakhuid ki Israel .

translation.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money , or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life :
translation.kha: lada nga la bam ei ïa ka jingbam kaba la mih hangta hynrei nga pynshahthngan ïa ki nongrep kiba la rep ïa ka —

translation.en: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest , that he may bring her forth without the camp , and one shall slay her before his face :
translation.kha: bad kin ai ïa ka ha u Eleasar u lyngdoh . Dei ban ïalam ïa ka shabar ka jaka sher dara bad dei ban pynïap ïa ka hangta ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand , and all their earrings which were in their ears  ; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ai ha u Jakob ïa kita ki blei nongwei baroh kiba ki don , bad ruh ïa ki sohshkor ba ki deng . U Jakob u buhrieh ïa ki ha trai u dieng Sning hajan Shekhem .

translation.en: For the poor shall never cease out of the land : therefore I command thee , saying , Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother , to thy poor , and to thy needy , in thy land .
translation.kha: Yn don hi man la ka por ki Israel kiba duk bad kiba kyrduh , bad kumta nga hukum ïa phi ban lehsbun ïa ki .

translation.en: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath , as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa u syiem Hadadeser jong ka jylla Sobah jong ka Syria , kaba hajan ka ri Hamath , namar u Hadadeser u la pyrshang ban jop ïa ka ri kaba shaphang shaneng ka Ïuphratis .
Hynrei balei ngin shu ïap ei ? Kata ka ding kaba ishyrkhei thang duh ïa ngi . Khlem pep ngin ïap lada ngi ïohsngew biang ba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u kren
translation.en: Now therefore why should we die ? for this great fire will consume us : if we hear the voice of the  Lord  our God any more , then we shall die .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Keiñ noh kaba ïakren khñium hapdeng phi
translation.en: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them ,  Murmur not among yourselves .
To execute upon them the judgment written : this honour have all his saints . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew kumba U Blei u la hukum . Kane ka long ka jingjop jong ki briew jong U Blei . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
Mynta te , to Adar pyrshah ïa ki , ko khun u briew baranda
translation.en: Therefore prophesy against them , prophesy , O son of man .
To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth ,
translation.kha: U Trai u tip mynno ki mynsiem jong ngi ki shah pynlwet ha ka byndi ;
Wat la Judia ki dei ki para ri jong ki shipai Israel ki ring koidi ïa ki ar lakh ngut ki bad khynnah bad ki rah ïa ki sha Samaria , lem bad ka jinglute kaba .
translation.en: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand , women , sons , and daughters , and took also away much spoil from them , and brought the spoil to Samaria .

translation.kha: To shahshkor! Nga , u Paul , nga ïathuh ha phi ba lada phi shah ban ïa lade , mut ba U Khrist un ym myntoi da lei ïa phi .
translation.en: Behold , I Paul say unto you , that if ye be circumcised , Christ shall profit you nothing .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi kiba shahshkor ïa ïasyriem : Ieit jingshahshitom ki nongshun jong lehsbun , lehbha ïa kito kiba isih ïa phi jingbrai
translation.en: But I say unto you which hear , Love your enemies , do good to them which hate you ,

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka shispah laiphew lai mitar ka lynter , arphew ar mitar ka pyngkiang bad khatlai mitar ka jingjrong .
translation.en: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of : The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits , the breadth of it fifty cubits , and the height of it thirty cubits .

translation.kha: pynban , to long kiba kylluid mynsiem bad ai kylliang u ïa kat kaba u donkam .
translation.en: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him , and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need , in that which he wanteth .
In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam uba ar u syiem ka Israel , u Ussaïah u khun jong u Amasaïah u long u syiem ka Judah

translation.en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field  ; the which when a man hath found , he hideth , and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath , and buyeth that field .
translation.kha: Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew ryngkhat u shem ïa ka jingkynshew ba la buhrieh hapoh ka lyngkha . U tap pat ïa ka , bad u kmen haduh katta katta ba u leit bad die ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u la don , bad nangta u leit pat bad thied ïa kata ka lyngkha .
U Blei bakhraw jong ki Israel um ju lamler kylla lane la ka jingmut . Um dei u briew — ju um kylla la ka jingmut .
translation.en: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent : for he is not a man , that he should repent .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la hiarthma ïa ka ri jingpynshisha ngi la rai ban wan sha jingïarisa ban lait na ki kynhun shipai ka Babilonia bad ka Syria . Dei na kane ka Nangne balei ba ngi ïashong ïasah ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: But it came to pass , when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land , that we said , Come , and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans , and for fear of the army of the Syrians : so we dwell at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: jingjubab la jingbah da pynkhlaiñ jingsngewsih namar rumal Moab , da Hali jingpangnud namar ka Kir Heres .
translation.en: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab , and mine inward parts for Kir–heres .
And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Fear them not : for I have delivered them into thine hand  ; there shall not a man of them stand before thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Wat sheptieng ïa ki . Nga la ai lypa ha me ïa ka jingjop . Yn ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa me .
Ynda haba la dep pynbaptis ïa ki briew baroh , la pynbaptis ruh ïa u . Jisu Katba U dang duwai la , plie ïa ka bneng ,
translation.en: Now when all the people were baptized , it came to pass , that Jesus also being baptized , and praying , the heaven was opened ,

translation.kha: Ki la kmen namar kata ka jingjai jai , u pyllait ïa ki na ka jingma bad wallam ïa ki ka kaba ki kwah
translation.en: Then are they glad because they be quiet  ; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven .

translation.kha: Haba ngan wan sha phi , nga tip ba ngan wan ryngkat jingrwai ka jingkyrkhu ba-dap jong U Khrist .
translation.en: And I am sure that , when I come unto you , I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ .

translation.kha: ban ai ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ha baroh paid ki Israel ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .
translation.en: Speak unto Aaron , and unto his sons , and unto all the children of Israel , and say unto them  ; This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded , saying ,
Nay , in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us .
translation.kha: Em , ha kine baroh ngi ïoh ïa ka jingjop baroh lyngba jong uta uba la ieit ïa ngi!
Namar kata , kynmaw ïa kane ka sngi , bad wat klet ïa lano ka lano : U Trai long u U Blei ha bneng bad ha pyrthei . Ym don blei da uwei pat .
translation.en: Know therefore this day , and consider it in thine heart , that the  Lord  he is God in heaven above , and upon the earth beneath : there is none else .
I have compassion on the multitude , because they have now been with me three days , and have nothing to eat :
translation.kha: Nga sngewsynei ïa kine ki briew , namar ki la don bad nga la lai sngi bad mynta kim don ei ei shuh ban bam .
A wat pynïadait ïa kata ! Kiar na ka kam bymman ! Kyntait ïa Nethanaïah bad ïaid ha la jingpynbaptis lynti .
translation.en: Avoid it , pass not by it , turn from it , and pass away .

translation.kha: To ngin shong ri jong ngi . ïa ngi na kito kiba kwah ban pynjot ïa ngi . ( Ka jingshah banbeiñ bad ka jingpynjot kin kut bad kito kiba pynjot ïa ka ri kin jah noh .
translation.en: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee , Moab  ; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler : for the extortioner is at an end , the spoiler ceaseth , the oppressors are consumed out of the land .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la bthah ïa Sekharaïah ban ong ha briew Ma nga , U Trai , nga la ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ,
translation.en: The  Lord  hath been sore displeased with your fathers .
And God hath both raised up the Lord , and will also raise up us by his own power .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa U Trai na ka jingïap , bad un pynmihpat ruh ïa ngi da ka bor jong u .

translation.en: Therefore , my brethren dearly beloved and longed for , my joy and crown , so stand fast in the Lord , my dearly beloved .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , haduh katno phi long kiba ieit ïa nga bad haduh katno nga la sngewtmang ïa phi ! Haduh katno phi pynkmen ïa nga , bad haduh katno nga sngewsarong namar jong phi ! Kane te , ko ki parabangeit ba-ieit , ka long kumno phi dei ban ïeng skhem ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Trai .

translation.en: I will bring it forth , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and it shall enter into the house of the thief , and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name : and it shall remain in the midst of his house , and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ba un phah shabar ïa kane ka jingtim , bad kan rung shapoh ka ïing jong uwei pa uwei u nongtuh bad sha ka ïing jong uwei pa uwei uba ïathuh lamler hapoh ka jingsmai . Kan ïaineh ha ki ïing jong ki bad ieh ïa ki ha ka jingjot .

translation.en: And the  Lord  God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel , and they smote them : so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites , the inhabitants of that country .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ai jingjop ha ki Israel pyrshah ïa u Sihon bad ka kynhun shipai jong u . Kumta ki Israel ki shimti ïa baroh ka ri jong ki Amor kiba shong ha kata ka thain .

translation.en: Are thy days as the days of man ? are thy years as man s days ,
translation.kha: Hato ka jingim jong me ka lyngkot kum ka jong ngi ?

translation.en: For better it is that it be said unto thee , Come up hither  ; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban shah khot sha ka jaka kaba kham shajrong ban ïa kaba shah ong ban ai noh ïa ka jaka jong phi ha uwei uba kham pawkhmat .
To ïaroh ïa U , phi ba-im baroh ! ïaroh ïa Trai !
translation.en: Let every thing that hath breath praise the  Lord . Praise ye the  Lord

translation.kha: U Jisu u don ha ka bynta kaba shadien jong ka lieng , u da ïohthiah , ka khlieh jong u ha ka syngkhlieh . synran ki Ki la kyrsiew ïa u ki bad la ong , Ko Nonghikai , hato mem sngewlem ïa ngi ba ngin sa ïap ?
translation.en: And he was in the hinder part of the ship , asleep on a pillow : and they awake him , and say unto him , Master , carest thou not that we perish ?

translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt kim dei ki blei — ki long tang ki briew . Ki kulai jong kim dei ki kita kiba don bor ka bapalat liam . Haba U Trai u trei , ka hima bakhlaiñbor kan khyllem , bad ka hima batlot bor ka kaba ïarap kan kyllon . Baroh ar na ki kin shah pynjot .
translation.en: Now the Egyptians are men , and not God  ; and their horses flesh , and not spirit . When the  Lord  shall stretch out his hand , both he that helpeth shall fall , and he that is holpen shall fall down , and they all shall fail together .
A grievous vision is declared unto me  ; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously , and the spoiler spoileth . Go up , O Elam : besiege , O Media  ; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ka jingïohipaw jong ki jingjia ba-ishyrkhei , ka jingïohipaw ïa ka jingshetkylla bad ka jingpynjot . Ko kynhun shipai jong ka Elam , to tur ïaleh ! Ko kynhun shipai jong ka Media , to kerkut ïa ki nongbah ! U Blei un pynkut ïa ka jingshitom kaba la wanrah da ka Babilon .

translation.en: But the  Lord  thy God shall deliver them unto thee , and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction , until they be destroyed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un aiti ha phi ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad un pynkulmar ïa ki haduh ba kin da shah pynjot lut thiaw .
Ïa kata ka lyngkha bad ka krem kaba don hangta la thied na ki Hit . ïa Tep nga hangta .
translation.en: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth .
And leaving Nazareth , he came and dwelt in Capernaum , which is upon the sea coast , in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim :
translation.kha: Um shym la shong la sah ha Nasareth , hynrei u la leit ban shong ban sah ha Kapernam , ka nongrit harud ka Duriaw Galilaïa ha ka thain jong ka Sebulun bad ka Naphtali .
Wat ban kular kitkhlieh na ka bynta ki ram jong kiwei pat .
translation.en: Be not thou one of them that strike hands , or of them that are sureties for debts .
But though we , or an angel from heaven , preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you , let him be accursed .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat lada ma ngi ne u angel na bneng kin ïalap ïa ka Gospel kaba pher na kata ïa kaba ngi la ïalap ha phi , to ai ban rai pynrem ïa u sha dujok!

translation.en: And the  Lord  your God , he shall expel them from before you , and drive them from out of your sight  ; and ye shall possess their land , as the  Lord  your God hath promised unto you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa ki ban kynriah na phi , bad un beh ïa ki katba phi nang tur sha khmat . Phin ïoh ïa ka ri jong ki , kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kular ïa phi .
Ka Rebekka ka don u hynmen uba kyrteng u Jingïashun ; bad u Laban u la Migdol bran bran shabar ban leit sha kata ka Judith ha kaba u shakri jong u Abraham u Jabesh .
translation.en: And Rebekah had a brother , and his name was Laban : and Laban ran out unto the man , unto the well .
Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law , the priest of Midian : and he led the flock to the backside of the desert , and came to the mountain of God , even to Horeb .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba u Moses u dang ap ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong u Jethro , u kthaw kurim jong u , u lyngdoh ka Midian , u ïalam ïa kata ka kynhun lyngba ka ri shyiap , bad u wan poi ha Sinai , u lum uba khuid .

translation.en: At her feet he bowed , he fell , he lay down : at her feet he bowed , he fell : where he bowed , there he fell down dead .
translation.kha: U hap da ki khohsiew , U kyllon kram bad u thiah lyngktar ha ki kjat jong ka . Ha ki kjat jong ka u hap da ki khohsiew bad u kyllon ; U kyllon kram ha madan , uba la ïap .
Kumta haba la map ïa jingkwah , lyngkhuh donkam shuh ka jingainguh ban kit noh ïa ki pop .
translation.en: Now where remission of these is , there is no more offering for sin .

translation.kha: Une U Blei halor long ka jakarieh baskhem jingtipbriew nga , bad u pynshngain ïa ka lynti ïaid jong nga .
translation.en: God is my strength and power : and he maketh my way perfect .
Verily I say unto you , All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men , and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme :
translation.kha: Nga ong skhem ïa phi ba ïa ki briew lah ban map ïa ki pop jong ki baroh , bad ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba ki lah ban ong .

Dei tad ynda ka la shai mynstep ba u Jakob u shem ma ka pynbna ïakhawai da ka skud . U musli sha u Laban , bad u ong , Balei phi leh Siddim kane ha nga ? Nga la trei kynthih ïoh ïa ka Rakhel ? Mattithaïah phi la shukor kamet nga ?
translation.en: And it came to pass , that in the morning , behold , it was Leah : and he said to Laban , What is this thou hast done unto me ? did not I serve with thee for Rachel ? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me ?

But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth , shall he live ? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned : in his trespass that he hath trespassed , and in his sin that he hath sinned , in them shall he die .
translation.kha: Hynrei lad u briew uba hok u sangeh ban lehbha bad sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew baroh , ïa kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki briew kiba sniew ki leh , hato un ïai im ? Em , yn ym kynmaw ïa kano kano kaba bha kaba u la leh . Un ïap namar ka jingbymïaineh jong u bad ki pop jong u .

translation.en: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand , Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth , that I may lean upon them .
translation.kha: U Samson u ong ïa u khynnah uba btin ïa u na ka kti ,  Ai ba ngan ktah ïa ki rishot kiba kyrshan ïa kane ka ïing . Nga kwah ban shaniah ha ki !

translation.en: The  Lord  hath opened his armoury , and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation : for this is the work of the Lord  God  of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans .
translation.kha: Nga la plie ïa ka jaka ha kaba la buh ïa ki atiar jong nga , bad ha ka jingbitar nga la shim noh ïa ki , namar ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh , nga don ka kam ban leh ha Babilonia .

translation.en: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben–hadad , Tell my lord the king , All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do : but this thing I may not do . And the messengers departed , and brought him word again .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ahab u jubab ha ki nonglamktien jong u Benhadad ,  Ïathuh ha u syiem u kynrad jong nga , ba nga mynjur ïa ka jingdawa kaba nyngkong jong u , hynrei ngam lah ban mynjur ïa kaba ar .  Ki nonglamktien ki leit noh bad nangta ki wan biang da kawei pat ka khubor na u Benhadad ;

translation.en: And the  Lord  answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ïa u angel da ki kyntien pyntngen ,
Shah ïa u leit bad maham ïa ki , khnang ba ki , la kumno kumno , kin ym wan sha kane ka jaka ka .’
translation.en: For I have five brethren  ; that he may testify unto them , lest they also come into this place of torment .

translation.kha: U Jonathan ai u ïa kita tiar ki ïaleh u ha uta u khynnah , bad u ong ïa u ban leit rah ïa ki baroh sha shnong .
translation.en: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad , and said unto him , Go , carry them to the city .

And the king commanded , and they brought those men which had accused Daniel , and they cast them into the den of lions , them , their children , and their wives  ; and the lions had the mastery of them , and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la ai ki hukum ban kem ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba la lah mudui ïa u Daniel , bad la bret ïa ki , lem bad ki tnga jong ki bad ki khun jong ki , shapoh ka thliew kaba dap da ki sing . Ha shuwa ban kin poi sha tbian jong ka thliew , ki sing ki la kynrup ïa ki bad pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong ki baroh .

translation.en: Now therefore perform the doing of it ; that as there was a readiness to will , so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have .
translation.kha: To ïai trei , te , bad pyndep ïa ka kam ! To long kiba thrang ban pyndep ïa ka kumba phi la long ha kaba thmu ïa ka , bad to leh ïa ka da kaei kaba phi don mynta .
Uta u briew u khet pynriewspah Besalel jar jar shaid ka , ban peit Phanuel ka long ba U Trai u la ai jingjop ïa u .
translation.en: And the man wondering at her held his peace , to wit whether the  Lord  had made his journey prosperous or not .

translation.kha: U Dabid u dang shong ha ka jaka hapdeng ka khyrdop kaba shabar bad ka kaba khyrdop shapoh jong ka nongbah . U nongap u phira kiew shajrong kynroh bad u ïeng halor ka tnum jong ka khyrdop ; u peit sha khmat bad u ïohi ïa u briew uba mareh . marwei
translation.en: And David sat between the two gates : and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall , and lifted up his eyes , and looked , and behold a man running alone .
And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth , and to save your lives by a great deliverance .
translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa nga ha shuwa jong phi ban pyllait im ïa phi ha ka rukom kaba phylla , bad ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin im .

translation.en: Satan the Devil—where did he come from ?
translation.kha: U Soitan , u Ksuid—u wan nangno ?
U pud u suh sha sepngi na Tappuah sha ka wahduid Kanah bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian . Kane ka long ka la jaka ba ai ha ki longïing jong ka jait Ephraim ka kum jingïohkynti jong ki ,
translation.en: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah  ; and the goings out thereof were at the sea . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families .

translation.kha: Ïa ki them kiba seisoh jong ka Judah pyndap da ki kali ïapom ; ki shipai halor ki kulai ki ïeng ha khmat ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots , and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate .
Mark well , O Job , hearken unto me : hold thy peace , and I will speak .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko Job , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; long jar jar bad shah ba ngan kren .

translation.en: He is like a man which built an house , and digged deep , and laid the foundation on a rock : and when the flood arose , the stream beat vehemently upon that house , and could not shake it : for it was founded upon a rock .
translation.kha: U long kum u briew uba , ha kaba tei ïa la ka ïing , u la tih jylliew bad u la pynshong nongrim halor u mawsiang . Ka wah ka la shlei bad ka la lynshop ïa kata ka ïing hynrei kam lah ban pynkhih ïa ka , namar la shna bha ïa ka .

translation.en: Rise up , ye women that are at ease  ; hear my voice , ye careless daughters  ; give ear unto my speech .
translation.kha: Ko phi ki kynthei kiba im suk , ki bym don ki jingkhuslai , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong .

translation.en: And they took their journey from Succoth , and encamped in Etham , in the edge of the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki ïamihnoh na Sukkoth bad ki sher dara ha Etham , ha ka tduh jong ka ri shyiap .
Ha ka jingkiew rasong ka jingjop jong u pynban , ka jingkhia jong ka jingjynjar kan ban halor jong u .
translation.en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits : every hand of the wicked shall come upon him .

translation.kha: Hynrei Aleksandar jingïatreilang u la tip ïai ki I jong ki die u Kam ong ha uta u briew , Ïeng Elkosh bad wan shane sha khmat . Uta Babha briew Lot la Shaaraim joit bad u sngewrem ïeng hangta .
translation.en: But he knew their thoughts , and said to the man which had the withered hand ,  Rise up , and stand forth in the midst .  And he arose and stood forth .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Saul ki long u Jonathan , u Ishbi , bad u Malkhishua . Ka khun kynthei baheh jong u ka kyrteng Merab ka , bad kaba kham rit Mikhal ka .
translation.en: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan , and Ishui , and Malchi–shua : and the names of his two daughters were these  ; the name of the firstborn Merab , and the name of the younger Michal :

translation.kha: U Jakob u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha shuwa jong u sha u Iso u hynmen jong u ha ri Edom .
translation.en: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir , the country of Edom .
And one told David , saying , Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom . And David said , O  Lord  , I pray thee , turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness .
translation.kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u Dabid ba u Ahithophel u la ïasoh lang bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong u Absalom , u la duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , sngewbha pynpulom ïa ka jingaibuit u Ahithophel .

translation.en: With my whole heart have I sought thee : O let me not wander from thy commandments .
translation.kha: Da ka dohnud jong nga baroh nga pyrshang ban shakri ïa me ; to sumar ïa nga na ka jingbymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .
Khmih halor kane ka Templ mynsngi bad mynmiet kane ka jaka ha me la jied ban me . ïa nga nga phai ka khmat kane ka templ ban duwai .
translation.en: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day , even toward the place of which thou hast said , My name shall be there : that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place .

translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph , Ngam shym poi pyrkhat ba ngan dang ïohi biang ïa khmat jong me ; pynban U u la shah ba ngan ïohi sa ïa ki khun jong ruh .
translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , I had not thought to see thy face : and , lo , God hath shewed me also thy seed .
There is that scattereth , and yet increaseth  ; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet , but it tendeth to poverty .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba pynlut kai ïa la ka pisa bad ki nang ïai riewspah . Kiwei ki husiar , bad pynban ki nang ïai kyrduh .

translation.en: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers :
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga ïeng hangne ba yn bishar namar ka jingkyrmen kaba nga don ha ka jingkular kaba U Blei u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi —

U Trai u ong ha u Aaron pynphyrnai Ma me teh ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ki Lebi Abimelekh , Almon hap shah ïa Berakah kiei kiba mih na kano kano ka jingleh palat ha ka jingshakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon bleithaw :1-3 nga , hynrei Kpu nongïathuh me bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin shah ïa kiei kiba mih ha ka jingshakri ha ka jinglong lyngdoh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Aaron , Thou and thy sons and thy father s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary : and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood .
But the Comforter , which is the Holy Ghost , whom the Father will send in my name , he shall teach you all things , and bring all things to your remembrance , whatsoever I have said unto you .
translation.kha: Uta U Nongïarap , U Mynsiem Bakhuid , ïa uba U Kpa un phah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , un hikai ïa phi ïa kiei kiei baroh bad un pynkynmaw ïa baroh kaba nga la ïathuh ha phi .
bad ngan ai ïa me ha ki briew ïa kiba pynmutlop sheptieng , ki briew kiba kwah ban pynïap pynshoi babha . Ngan ai ïa jingpar ha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia bad ha Hadad shipai jong u jingap
translation.en: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life , and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest , even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of the Chaldeans .

translation.en: And I will come down and talk with thee there : and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee , and will put it upon them  ; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee , that thou bear it not thyself alone .

translation.kha: Haba ki Israel shong basah Them Jesreel la ïohsngew ba ka shipai ka phet ïap , bad ba u bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la ïap , ki iehnoh ïa la ki shnong bad ki phet ïap . Nangta ki Philistia ki wan bad ki shong ha ki
translation.en: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , then they forsook their cities , and fled : and the Philistines came and dwelt in them .
And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound .
translation.kha: Nangta kita ki hynñiew ngut ki angel kiba don kita ki hynñiew tylli ki turoi ki la pynkhreh ban put ïa ki .
dei kaba ong , U Moses u jubab Phin ïohi shuh ïa nga lano lano .
translation.en: And Moses said , Thou hast spoken well , I will see thy face again no more .

translation.kha: Haba ka kata por ka poi , ong U Trai Badonbor Baroh , plie yn ïa ka umpohliew ban pynkhuid ïa khun ki ki ksiew jong u Dabid bad ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem na ka pop bad ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki .
translation.en: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness .
Behold , thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands , by destroying them utterly : and shalt thou be delivered ?
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Assyria u leh ïa kano kano ka ri kaba u rai ban pynjot . Hato phi pyrkhat ba phin ïohlait im ?
rangbah jong u Dabid la ai ka khubor ha u Nabal ha ka kyrteng u Dabid .
translation.en: And when David s young men came , they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David , and ceased .

translation.kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la ki khun kynthei da kaba pynlong nuti ïa ha ki jaka mane bleithaw ; lada phi leh , phin phai noh sha kiwei ki bad ka ri kan jyllei da ka jingjyrsieh .
translation.en: Do not prostitute thy daughter , to cause her to be a whore  ; lest the land fall to whoredom , and the land become full of wickedness .

And unto the children of Gershon , of the families of the Levites , out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Beesh–terah with her suburbs  ; two cities .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki kynhun jong ki Lebi , ka kur Gershon , ka ïohpdiang ar tylli ki nongbah na ka jaka jong ka Manasseh ba sha Mihngi : ka Golan ha Bashan ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) bad ka Beeshterah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: And they answered Joshua , and said , Because it was certainly told thy servants , how that the  Lord  thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land , and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you , therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you , and have done this thing .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ,  Bah , ngi la leh ïa ka namar ngi la tip shisha ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa u Moses u shakri jong u ban ai ha phi ïa ka ri baroh kawei , bad ban pynïap ïa ki briew baroh kiba shong ha ka katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Ngi la leh ïa ka namar ba ngi la sngewsheptieng ïa phi ; ngi don ha ka jingsyier ïa la ka jingim .
Ka jingsngewsih jong ka nga la jan pynmatlah ïa nga ; ki kti bad ki kjat jong nga ki la rit kum ki syrngiew .
translation.en: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow , and all my members are as a shadow .

translation.kha: Lada u ai ha ngi ka spah bad jingdon jingem bad to ngin lehkmen ha ngi dei ban sngewnguh bad lehkmen kaei la . Ka dei ka jingai U Blei .
translation.en: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth , and hath given him power to eat thereof , and to take his portion , and to rejoice in his labour  ; this is the gift of God .

translation.kha: ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki nong Kiriath Jearim ong , Ki Philistia ki la pynphai ïa Synduk Ka U Ale wan shim noh ïa ka .
translation.en: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kirjath–jearim , saying , The Philistines have brought again the ark of the  Lord   ; come ye down , and fetch it up to you .

translation.kha: Hadien kane U , Jisu u la leit sha Jerusalem na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translation.en: After this there was a feast of the Jews  ; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U la im kawei ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei , hynrei baroh kiwei khyrdep , ki la long kiba sniew ha khmat Heshmon Blei Pomkranet kaban pher jingleh jubor ka la saphriang kylleng .
translation.en: The earth also was corrupt before God , and the earth was filled with violence .

And he removed from thence , and digged another well  ; and for that they strove not : and he called the name of it Rehoboth  ; and he said , For now the  Lord  hath made room for us , and we shall be fruitful in the land .
translation.kha: U la kynriah noh nangta bad tih ïa kawei pat ka pukri . Ym shym don jingïakajia shuh ïa kata , kumta u khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  Ka Jinglaitluid .  U ong ,  Mynta te U  Trai  u la ai jinglaitluid ïa ngi ban shong ban sah ha kane ka jaka , bad ngin sa nang roi ha kane ka ri .

translation.en: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal , and said , I have a secret errand unto thee , O king : who said , Keep silence . And all that stood by him went out from him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Ehud ïa lade u la kylla dien ha ki maw ba la ohdur hajan Gilgal , u la leit biang sha u Eglon , bad u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , nga don ka khubor barieh na ka bynta jong phi .  Kumta u syiem u hukum ïa la ki shakri ,  Ieh ïa ngi tang baroh ar ngut !  Bad baroh ki la ïamih shabar .
U ïa ki jingpyrkhat sniew , hynrei ha ki ktien kiba sngur jingmut
translation.en: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the  Lord  : but the words of the pure are pleasant words .

translation.kha: Kim dei ban don bynta na ka khyndew ka shyiap kum kiwei pat ki Nabynta jait jong ki ; ka bynta jong ki ka jinglamphrang ka kabu ka jinglong nongpynïaid lyngdoh jong U Trai , kumba u la kular .
translation.en: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren : the  Lord  is their inheritance , as he hath said unto them .
And in the morning came the word of the  Lord  unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: Thou fool , that which thou sowest is not quickened , except it die :
translation.kha: A me u bieit! Haba me bet ïa u symbai ha ka khyndew , um lah ban shylluit lymda u ïap noh .
To ai ïaroh ka kyrteng jong u mynta bad sha bymjukut !
translation.en: Blessed be the name of the  Lord  from this time forth and for evermore .

translation.kha: U la Leit Ma u .
translation.en: He had gone .
But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse , deceiving , and being deceived .
translation.kha: bad ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba shukor kin nang ïaid na kaba sniew sha kaba kham sniew , da kaba shukor ïa kiwei bad shah shukor ïa lade .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Go in peace . So he departed from him a little way .
translation.kha: Khie leit suk leit saiñ ,  u Elisha u ong . Bad u Naaman u leit noh . U la leit dang khyndiat ka jingjngai ,
Buh jingmut lypa ban ym khuslai shaphang kumno phin ïasaid da ïasngewskhem jingbymjanai ,
translation.en: Settle it therefore in your hearts , not to meditate before what ye shall answer :
We will not return unto our houses , until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance .
translation.kha: Ngin ym leit phai sha la ki longïing jong ngi tad haduh ba kiwei pat ki Israel baroh ki la shim kynti ïa ka ri kaba la ai ha ki .
A Baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel , uba shong ha ka khet shajrong ki kherub , me marwei me long U Blei , uba synshar ïa ki hima jong ka pyrthei . Me thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad ka bneng .
translation.en: O  Lord  of hosts , God of Israel , that dwellest between the cherubims , thou art the God , even thou alone , of all the kingdoms of the earth : thou hast made heaven and earth .
Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei na kita kiba la shong bam kiba la sngewthuh balei U Jisu u la ong ïa kane ha u .
U balyngkot u ïai pynpaw ïa lade ha Shiloh , naba u la paw ha u Samuel , bad u byrngia kren ruh ha japung . Bad snoh u Samuel jingïuhkjat kren , ki rashi baroh ki shahshkor .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared again in Shiloh : for the  Lord  revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Goliath U u sdang ban wan sha tur khmat sha u Dabid , bad u Dabid u mareh stet sha ka madan thma ban ïaleh ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the Philistine arose , and came and drew nigh to meet David , that David hasted , and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine .

translation.kha: Wan ïalam ïa ki khun Ahab jong u Aaron ban pynphong sopti ïa ki .
translation.en: And thou shalt bring his sons , and put coats upon them .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka ha por mynmiet , nga la ïohi ïa i kum u briew . U la wan sha nga , ba la ker sawdong da u lyoh , bad la sha uta uba la im bad ai sngewbha ha u .
translation.en: I saw in the night visions , and , behold , one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven , and came to the Ancient of days , and they brought him near before him .
And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba ki khun jong u Job ki dang ïakhawai sngewbha ha ïing jong u hynmen rangbah duh , u nonglamktien u la wan mareh sha u Job .
U la dem khohsiew bad u la kyang da ka ktien bajam , A Trai ! pyllaitluid kynmaw ïa kumba ka pop pyrshah ïa ki ! U la sanphew ïa kane bad u la ïap .
translation.en: And he kneeled down , and cried with a loud voice , Lord , lay not this sin to their charge . And when he had said this , he fell asleep .

translation.kha: U Amaraïah u phum Lyngdoh , un don ïa ka bor kaba hakhlieh tam ha jingainong ki kam niam bteng bad u Sebadaïah Shisha khun jong u Ishmael Esiongeber u lat ka baheh , un don ïa ka bor bahakhlieh duh ha baroh ngaiñ kam hima sima . Ki Lebi kin kitkhlieh ban peit halor ki jingpyntreikam ïa ki jingrai jong ki :14-16 . Long shlur bad pyndep ïa kine ki jingbthah , hajar Sabad smat Trai un long ha Kenkhria liang jong kiba leh ïa kaba dei !
translation.en: And , behold , Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the  Lord   ; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael , the ruler of the house of Judah , for all the king s matters : also the Levites shall be officers before you . Deal courageously , and the  Lord  shall be with the good .
Is there no balm in Gilead  ; is there no physician there ? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered ?
translation.kha: Hato ym don dawai ha Gilead ? Hato ym don doktor hangta ? Balei te ba ïa ki briew jong nga ym shym la pynkhiah ?

translation.en: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker ! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth . Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it , What makest thou ? or thy work , He hath no hands ?
translation.kha: Hato u khiew khyndew un nud ban ïatainia bad u nongthaw jong u , u khiew uba long kum baroh kiwei pat ? Hato ka dewbyrtha kan ong ïa u nongthaw khiew kaei ba u leh ? Hato u khiew un mudui ïa la u nongthaw khiew ba um don jingtbit ?
U Simon Petros u la jubab , Klaudia Trai , to wat sait tang ïa ki kjat jong nga , te ! Pynlwet sait ruh Epaphroditos ki kti bad ïa thurmur khlieh pynbyrngia nga ruh .
translation.en: Simon Peter saith unto him , Lord , not my feet only , but also my hands and my head .
And his fellow answered and said , This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash , a man of Israel : for into his hand hath God delivered Midian , and all the host .
translation.kha: U paralok jong u , u phai ktien ,  Ka dei ka waitlam jong u nong Israel , u Gideon u khun jong u Joash ! Kam mut da kumwei pat ! U Blei u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor ki Midian bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ngi baroh .

translation.en: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide : and he lifted up his eyes , and saw , and , behold , the camels were coming .
translation.kha: U la mih shabar ha ka por janmiet ban ïaid kai pyngngad ha ki pyntha bad u ïohi ïa ki ut ba ki dang wan .

translation.en: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment : else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old , and the rent is made worse .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba pyndonkam ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai ban syrdep ïa ka sopti barim , namar ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai kan ran bad kan pynkad katto katne ïa ka jaiñ barim , kan pynlong wat ïa ka jingkad kaba kham heh .
Wat ai ba yn bet ïa ki symbai ha kata ka ri ba yn ïa ka jingmih . Man uwei pa uwei u nongwei uba shong hangta un sheptieng ïa ba tur ïaleh bad ban leit phai ïing .
translation.en: Cut off the sower from Babylon , and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest : for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people , and they shall flee every one to his own land .

translation.kha: Don uwei u ban ong Ka jingbam ka dei na ka bynta ka kpoh , bad ka kpoh na ka bynta ka jingbam . Ho-oid , U Blei un sa pynduh ïa baroh ar . Ïa ka met ym ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam awria , ïa ka ban shakri ïa Trai ; U Trai u bsa ïa met .
translation.en: Meats for the belly , and the belly for meats : but God shall destroy both it and them . Now the body is not for fornication , but for the Lord ; and the Lord for the body .

translation.kha: Ki shipai phi jong ki jynthut bad ki kyllon ; uwei ong u ïa uwei pat , ‘ Pynkloi ! Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ïing sha ki briew jong ngi ban bad ïohlait im na ka waitlam u nongshun !’
translation.en: He made many to fall , yea , one fell upon another : and they said , Arise , and let us go again to our own people , and to the land of our nativity , from the oppressing sword .

translation.kha: mynta phi phai pyrshah ïa ka longïing jong jong nga . Phi la pynïap ïa ki khun jong i — hynñiewphew ngut ki rangbah halor uwei u maw — bad namar Abimelekh , ba i ïoh na ka shakri jong , u dei uba ïing jong phi , phi la pynlong ïa u , u ka Shekhem .
translation.en: And ye are risen up against my father s house this day , and have slain his sons , threescore and ten persons , upon one stone , and have made Abimelech , the son of his maidservant , king over the men of Shechem , because he is your brother  ; )
And , behold , there was a man named Zacchaeus , which was the chief among the publicans , and he was rich .
translation.kha: La don hangta u nonglum khajna uba ha khlieh duh uba kyrteng , u Sakhaïos , uba riewspah .
Uwei pa uwei u sngewkhia plain ïa la ki jong ja-um kam , Pynphai ïa kiei kiei ki jong U ktha Khrist .
translation.en: For all seek their own , not the things which are Jesus Christs .

translation.kha: Kumta ïathuhlypa ha ki nga ha ki ba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , ngan plied ïa ki jingtep jong ki . Ngan sei ïa shabar bad wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri Israel .
translation.en: Therefore prophesy and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , O my people , I will open your graves , and cause you to come up out of your graves , and bring you into the land of Israel .

translation.kha: U Moses bad Joshua u u khun jong u Nun ki ïathuh ïa ki ktien jong kane ka jingrwai , ki ba Israel kin ïohsngew ïa ka .
translation.en: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people , he , and Hoshea the son of Nun .
Shall mortal man be more just than God ? shall a man be more pure than his maker ?
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba hok ha ka jingkhmih U Blei ne uba sngur ha khmat u Nongthaw jong u ?

translation.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron , and said , Entreat the  Lord  , that he may take away the frogs from me , and from my people  ; and I will let the people go , that they may do sacrifice unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad ïa u Aaron , bad u ong ,  To kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ba un shim noh ïa kine ki jakoid , bad ngan sa pyllait ïa ki briew jong phi ba kin ïoh kñia ainguh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: When thou goest , thy steps shall not be straitened  ; and when thou runnest , thou shalt not stumble .
translation.kha: Yn ym don u ban pynwit ïa ka lynti jong phi lada phi ïaid kum uba stad , bad phin ym jynthut haba phi mareh .

Hadien ngan sa theh plain U Mynsiem jong nga klong uwei pa uwei : Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei bashaphang phi lashai shai ïa ka khambun jong nga Artemis ki tymmen Saddusi kin don ki jingmynjur Shema bad ki samla shynrang jong jinghiarpateng kin ïohi ki jingïohipaw .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass afterward , that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh  ; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy , your old men shall dream dreams , your young men shall see visions :
Yet saith the house of Israel , The way of the Lord is not equal . O house of Israel , are not my ways equal ? are not your ways unequal ?
translation.kha: Bad ma phi ki Israel phi ong , ‘ Kaei kaba U  Trai  u leh ka long ka bym dei .’ Phi pyrkhat ba ka lynti jong nga kam shym long kaba dei , hato ym dei kumta ? Ka dei ka lynti jong phi ka bym long kaba dei .

translation.en: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire .
translation.kha: Thang noh ïa ka doh ne ïa u kpu ba sah baroh .
U Syiem Solomon u la laiphew jied hajar ngut ki rangbah kum ki nongtrei ba shah pynbor na kylleng ka ri Israel ,
translation.en: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel  ; and the levy was thirty thousand men .
But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty , and continueth therein , he being not a forgetful hearer , but a doer of the work , this man shall be blessed in his deed .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba peit bniah ïa ka hukum bajanai kaba pyllaitluid ïa ki briew , uba ïai pynleit jingmut ïa ka bad ym tang ban sngap ïa ka bad nangta ban klet noh , hynrei u pyntreikam ïa ka — uta u briew un ïoh jingkyrkhu na U Blei ha kaei kaei kaba u leh .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah , first and last , behold , are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel ?
translation.kha: Ïa baroh kiwei kiwei pat kiba u Amasaïah u la leh naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut ka jingsynshar jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel

Hato mem , ngeit Philip ko , ba nga long ha U Kpa bad U u Kpa long ha nga ? Ki ktien kiba nga la kren phi ha , U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran , kim shym la wan na nga hi . U Kpa , uba ïaisah bad nga , u trei la ka jong ka kam .
translation.en: Believest thou not that I am in the Father , and the Father in me ? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself : but the Father that dwelleth in me , he doeth the works .

And he took all the gold and the silver , and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed–edom , and the treasures of the king s house , the hostages also , and returned to Samaria .
translation.kha: U la rah pat sha Samaria kum ka mar lute ïa baroh ka ksiar bad ka rupa kaba ha ka Templ , ki tiar ki tar ka Templ ïa kiba la ap phira da ki khun ki ksiew jong u Obed Edom , bad ïa ki jingkynshew ka ïingsyiem . U la ïalam ruh ïa ki koidi lem bad u .
rangbah na ka jait Gad ka jait Reuben ki jubab , Kynrad , ngin U Trai u la hukum
translation.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered , saying , As the  Lord  hath said unto thy servants , so will we do .

translation.kha: Haba U babit u synñia Moraïah ban pynjot Bethania ki kopi jong u Pontios u riewrunar ba la shispah jingpyndep u , u Bakhlem , u la Tabitha pyrshah ïa U Blei Jinglaitluid khang ïa ka jingbitar Eleasar u na kaba pynjot noh ïa ki Weng
translation.en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them , had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach , to turn away his wrath , lest he should destroy them .
But though he had done so many miracles before them , yet they believed not on him :
translation.kha: Wat la U Jisu u la leh ïa kine ki kambah baroh ha khmat jong ki , kim shym la ngeit ha u , ba yn pyndep ïa kaei kaba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la ong ba kan long shisha :

Ngan buh ïa pha ha kumno bor jingpynïasoh ki , bad kin pynkhyllem ïa ki jaka ha kiba pha ïaleh nuti bad Timaïos bleithaw . Kin shim noh mynhynnin ki jaiñ bad ïa ki Gideon jingpyntngen pha bad kin iehnoh lyngkhuit khoit ïa pha .
translation.en: And I will also give thee into their hand , and they shall throw down thine eminent place , and shall break down thy high places : they shall strip thee also of thy clothes , and shall take thy fair jewels , and leave thee naked and bare .

translation.kha: U Petros u la jubab , Ngan isaitmet iehnoh ïa me , krong la baroh mot pat kin Mahlon kumta !
translation.en: But Peter said unto him , Although all shall be offended , yet will not I .

translation.kha: Tang da Gederah , A Jehobah un jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong phi .—Hebru 11 :6 .
translation.en: Only then will Jehovah answer your prayers .—Hebrews 11 :6 .
Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts , and bring the description hither to me , that I may cast lots for you here before the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: To thoh ka jingbatai shaphang kine ki hynñiew bynta bad wallam ïa ka sha nga . Nangta ngan kynting sbai ban ïakren bad U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And Keilah , and Achzib , and Mareshah  ; nine cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Keilah , ka Akhsib , bad ka Mareshah : khyndai tylli ki nongbah lem ruh bad ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him : for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus , and took it , and carried the people of it captive to Kir , and slew Rezin .
translation.kha: U Tiglath Pileser , haba jubab ïa ka jingkyrpad u Ahas , u tur sha khmat bad la ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ka Damaskos , u kurup ïa ka , u pynïap ïa u syiem Resin , bad u ïalam koidi ïa ki briew sha Kir .

translation.en: And forty days were fulfilled for him  ; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed : and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days .
translation.kha: Ki shim por sawphew sngi ban pyndep ïa ka , namar ka bam por katta ban kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka metïap . Ki nong Ijipt ki pynlong ka jingïambriew ïa u hynñiewphew sngi .

translation.en: And Jonathan said , Far be it from thee : for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee , then would not I tell it thee ?
translation.kha: Wat nym pyrkhat ïa kaba kum kata ?  u Jonathan u jubab . Lada nga la tip shai ba i pa i la kut jingmut ban pynsniew ïa phi , hato ngan ym ïathuh ïa phi ?

translation.en: And the residue thereof he maketh a god , even his graven image : he falleth down unto it , and worshippeth it , and prayeth unto it , and saith , Deliver me  ; for thou art my god .
translation.kha: Ka dieng kaba sah u shna ïa ka bleithaw , bad nangta u dem bad mane ïa ka . U duwai ha ka bad u ong ,  Phi long U Blei jong nga — to pynim ïa nga !
Ha ka jingjynjar jingmut u syiem Belshassar u la nang lieh kham blaid blaid , bad ki rangbah donburom jong kim u tip shuh kumno yn leh .
translation.en: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled , and his countenance was changed in him , and his lords were astonished .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong nga , por ka ka la poi ïa nga ban shah kñia ; ka ka por long mynta ïa nga ban iehnoh ïa kane ka jingim .
translation.en: For I am now ready to be offered , and the time of my departure is at hand .
If they shall fall away , to renew them again unto repentance  ; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh , and put him to an open shame .
translation.kha: Bad hadien kata ki la iehnoh ïa la ka jingngeit ! Ka long ka bym lah long ban ïalam pat ïa ki ban kylla-kaba-mut biang , namar ki la sahnarphna biang ïa U Khun U Blei bad pynlehrain ïa u ha khmat ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another , saying , Let us go speedily to pray before the  Lord  , and to seek the  Lord  of hosts : I will go also .
translation.kha: Kito kiba na kawei ka nongbah kin ong ha kito kiba na kawei pat , ‘ Ngi leit ban mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh bad ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong u . To wan bad ngi !’

U pat ïa ki khiew ki pliang rupa jong ka Templ u Nebukhadnessar u la rah na ka Templ ha Jerusalem bad ha ka ha Babilon . U la aiti ïa kine ki pliang ha u briew uba kyrteng u Sheshbassar , ïa u la thung kum u ka Judah .
translation.en: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God , which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem , and brought them into the temple of Babylon , those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon , and they were delivered unto one , whose name was Sheshbazzar , whom he had made governor  ;

translation.kha: Lada ka thma ka khie , sianti lah ban leit ïasoh bad ki nongshun jong tat-dor ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ngi tiduh bad ban ïohphet Ahilud na kane ka ri . Gur ngin Amon ïaleh sian ban ym shah ïa ki ba kin nang ïaroi shuh shuh .
translation.en: Come on , let us deal wisely with them  ; lest they multiply , and it come to pass , that , when there falleth out any war , they join also unto our enemies , and fight against us , and so get them up out of the land .

translation.kha: Ynda phi poi ri Kanaan bad thung ïa uno uno u jait diengsoh , ba soh u , u long bymkhuid haduh lai snem Hapoh kane ka phim ban bam u .
translation.en: And when ye shall come into the land , and shall have planted all manner of trees for food , then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised : three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you : it shall not be eaten of .
And he spake this parable unto them , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi :

translation.en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation , which murmur against me ? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel , which they murmur against me .
translation.kha: Slem sa katno ba kine ki riewbymman kin khñium pyrshah ïa nga ? Nga la ïohsngew shibun ïa kine ki jingkhñium !

translation.en: For thou saidst , What advantage will it be unto thee ? and , What profit shall I have , if I be cleansed from my sin ?
translation.kha: ne ban kylli ïa U Blei ,  Da kumno ka pop jong nga ka ktah ïa me ? Nga ïohnong aïu na kaba khlem leh pop ?
Ngan nonglum ïa me bad ïa ki paralok jong me nonghiarpateng .
translation.en: I will answer thee , and thy companions with thee .

translation.kha: Ki ktien jong ki , ki dap da ki jingshukor bashyrkhei ; ki jingthok ba-bymman ki mih na thylliej ki jong ki , bad ki jingbyrngem kiba , ma kum ka bseiñ bih , na ki rmiang shyntur jong ki ;
translation.en: Their throat is an open sepulchre ; with their tongues they have used deceit ; the poison of asps is under their lips :

Then David said unto the messenger , Thus shalt thou say unto Joab , Let not this thing displease thee , for the sword devoureth one as well as another : make thy battle more strong against the city , and overthrow it : and encourage thou him .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha uta u nonglamktien ,  Pynshlur ïa u Joab bad ong ïa u ba un ym khuslai , namar phim lah ban ong mano ban ïap ha ka thma . Ïathuh ïa u ban pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba kham khlaiñ ïa ka nongbah bad kurup ïa ka .

translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of wisdom : a good understanding have all they that do his commandments : his praise endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ka lynti ban long uba stad ka long ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  ; u ai ka jingbishar kaba beit ïa baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u . U long uba dei ban ïaroh junom .

translation.en: And the garment , either warp , or woof , or whatsoever thing of skin it be , which thou shalt wash , if the plague be departed from them , then it shall be washed the second time , and shall be clean .
translation.kha: Lada u sait ïa kata bad ka jingbthuh ka jah noh , u dei ban sait biang ïa ka sa shisien , bad kan sa long kaba khuid .
Shah ngan ïathuh ïa me shaphang ki Riblah jong u Lebiathan bad batai haduh katno u Shuwa uba khraw Elhanan uba khlaiñ .
translation.en: I will not conceal his parts , nor his power , nor his comely proportion .
And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep : so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God .
translation.kha: U kñia arphew ar hajar tylli ki masi bad shi lakh arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot kum ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Bad kumta ma u bad uta u paidbah baroh ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil , and hideth himself : but the simple pass on , and are punished .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sngewthuh ki ïohi ïa ka jingma ba ka wan bad ki kynriah na ka , hynrei u briew u bym pyrkhat un ïaid beit ha ka bad un babe kylla hadien .
Phi ïohi ïa Sepngi ka nongrit ? Katai te ka kham jan . Shah ngan leit shata — phi ïohi ïa ka ba ka long tang ka snemhadien — bad ngan kmen thawsha .
translation.en: Behold now , this city is near to flee unto , and it is a little one : Oh , let me escape thither , ( is it not a little one ? ) and my soul shall live .
And it shall be , when thou hast made an end of reading this book , that thou shalt bind a stone to it , and cast it into the midst of Euphrates :
translation.kha: Ko Seraïah , ynda me dep ban pule ïa kane ka kot ha ki briew , nangta sa teh ïa ka ha u maw bad bret ïa ka ha ka wah Ïuphratis bad ong ,
Ong phi kwah aïu ngan ai , bad pynshongdor katba phi sngewbit ïa ka nongleitkurim , pioneer ai ha phi kat hynmen phi pan Damaskos tang Nun phi shah Kut nga ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: Ask me never so much dowry and gift , and I will give according as ye shall say unto me : but give me the damsel to wife .

translation.kha: U Trai u ha ong , nga ‘ Dei u u Solomon khun jong me u ban tei ïa ka Templ jong nga . Nga la jied ïa u ban long u khun jong nga , bad nga ngan long u kpa jong u .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Solomon thy son , he shall build my house and my courts : for I have chosen him to be my son , and I will be his father .
And there came a certain poor widow , and she threw in two mites , which make a farthing .
translation.kha: nangta , ka riewkynthei ka wan bad ka la noh ar tylli ki sbai tama , kiba shongdor kumba shi pisa .

Kine long ki ki ksiew jong u Lebi , kat kum ki bad ki longïing bad ïa uwei uwei ki la buh jingthoh da ka kyrteng pa uwei na ki khun ksiew , uba arphew snem ka ne tam u ïoh ka ha ka kam ha ka Templ U Trai .
translation.en: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers  ; even the chief of the fathers , as they were counted by number of names by their polls , that did the work for the service of the house of the  Lord  , from the age of twenty years and upward .

I also will do this unto you  ; I will even appoint over you terror , consumption , and the burning ague , that shall consume the eyes , and cause sorrow of heart : and ye shall sow your seed in vain , for your enemies shall eat it .
translation.kha: Ngan pynngat ha phi ïa ka jingjynjar — ki jingpang bym lah pynkhiah , bad ki jingpang shit ki ban pynmatlah ïa phi bad ban pynlong ïa ka jingim jong phi ban sep-ei . Phin bet ïa u symbai , hynrei um myntoi ïa phi , naba ki nongshun jong phi kin jop ïa phi bad kin bam ïa kaba phi la thung .

translation.en: Then Joshua built an altar unto the  Lord  God of Israel in mount Ebal ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u tei ha u Lum Ebal ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
Phi lah ban jot noh da jingkren ki briew kiba khlem blei , hynrei ka jingstad jong hok ka lah pyllait ïa phi
translation.en: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour : but through knowledge shall the just be delivered .
He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker : but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor .
translation.kha: Lada phi banbeiñ ïa ki briew kiba duk , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki ; hynrei ka jingpyn-i ïa ka jinglehsbun ïa kiba duk ka long ka kam jong ka jingmane .

translation.en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you .
translation.kha: Kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kin teh kumjuh ïa ki traishnong bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah bad phi .

translation.en: But he perceived their craftiness , and said unto them ,  Why tempt ye me ?
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïohi lut ïa ka buit jong ki bad u la ong ha ki ,
Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa jong ki thapniang ki jingthaw ba-im kiba ïatyngkhuh lang ha suiñ , bad ka jingkhynwin ki shalyntem , kiba sawa jam kum u jumai .
translation.en: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another , and the noise of the wheels over against them , and a noise of a great rushing .

translation.kha: Kumta te , u briew u mawleiñ Dura ïa kaba bha kaba u tip ba u dei ban Aïu u long uba shah pynrem namar ka pop mihnoh
translation.en: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good , and doeth it not , to him it is sin .
Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness , and his chambers by wrong  ; that useth his neighbour s service without wages , and giveth him not for his work  ;
translation.kha: Long ba la tim ïa u briew uba tei ïa la ka ïing da ka jingbymhok , bad uba pynheh pynïar ïa ka da ka jingleh bymhok ; uba pynlong ïa la ki para shnong ban trei khlem kam , bad u bym siew bainong ïa ki .
Un pyllait ïa phi lada phi long lui lui , lada kaei kaba phi leh ka long dei kaba .
translation.en: He shall deliver the island of the innocent : and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands .

translation.kha: Khun Ko u briew , u la ong , shi tang syntied ngan shim noh ïa u briew uba pha ieit eh . Pham dei ban wad daw lane ïam ne jaw ki ummat .
translation.en: Son of man , behold , I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke : yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep , neither shall thy tears run down .
And he left the linen cloth , and fled from them naked .
translation.kha: Ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa u , hynrei u la phet lyngkhuit , da kaba iehnoh ïa ka jaiñ shadien jong u .

translation.en: And Joab said to Amasa , Art thou in health , my brother ? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him .
translation.kha: U Joab u ong ha u Amasa ,  Phi long kumno , ko paralok jong nga ?  bad u bat ïa u Amasa na u  ñiuhtmoh jong u da la ka kti kamon ban doh ïa u .

translation.en: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house  ; and Absalom went in unto his father s concubines in the sight of all Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta ki pynïeng kawei ka ïingjaiñ ïa u Absalom ha tnum ka ïingsyiem ; bad ha ka jingïohi jong uwei pa uwei baroh , u Absalom u leit rung shapoh bad u la ïathiah shongkha bad ki tnga kliar jong u kpa jong u .

translation.en: Lest I be full , and deny thee , and say , Who is the  Lord  ? or lest I be poor , and steal , and take the name of my God in vain .
translation.kha: Lada nga ïoh palat , nga lah ban ong ba ngam donkam ïa me . Hynrei lada nga kyrduh pat , nga lah ban tuh bad pynjahburom ïa U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: Say , I pray thee , thou art my sister : that it may be well with me for thy sake  ; and my soul shall live because of thee .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba pha dei ka para jong nga ; khnang ba na ka bynta jong pha kin shah ïa nga ban im bad lehbha ïa nga .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence : but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live  ; for he shall have his life for a prey , and shall live .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Uno uno uba shong ha ka nongbah un ïap ha ka thma lane ka jingïapthngan lane ka jingpang . Hynrei uno uno uba mihnoh bad uba pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia , yn ym pynïap ; la kumno kumno un pyllait ïa la ka jingim .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the great trumpet shall be blown , and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria , and the outcasts in the land of Egypt , and shall worship the  Lord  in the holy mount at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi kan wan , ïa ka turoi yn put ban khot pat na Assyria bad Ijipt ïa baroh ki Israel kiba don ha ka jinglongmraw hangta . Kin wan bad mane ïa U  Trai  ha Jerusalem , ha u lum bakyntang jong u .

translation.en: For my yoke is easy , and my burden is light .
translation.kha: Naba ka lyngkor kaba ngan ai ha phi ka long kaba jem , bad ka jingkit ba ngan buh halor jong phi ka long kaba sting .
Kumta ki shipai ki la leit bad pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jong uta uba nyngkong bad nangta sa ïa ki jong pat uwei kiba la shah lem sahnarphna bad U Jisu .
translation.en: Then came the soldiers , and brake the legs of the first , and of the other which was crucified with him .

translation.kha: Haba phin ïohi ïa ki khun kiba ngan ai ha phi , phin pdiang ba long U Blei Bakhuid Israel Phin burom ïa nga bad phin ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom nga .
translation.en: But when he seeth his children , the work of mine hands , in the midst of him , they shall sanctify my name , and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob , and shall fear the God of Israel .
The children which thou shalt have , after thou hast lost the other , shall say again in thine ears , The place is too strait for me : give place to me that I may dwell .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong pha kiba la kha ha ka por ka jinglongmraw ha kawei ka sngi kin ong ha pha , ‘ Kane ka jaka ka rit eh — ngi donkam jaka shuh ban shong !’

translation.en: Being made so much better than the angels , as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they .
translation.kha: Ïa U Khun la pynlong uba kham khraw ban ïa ki angel , kumba ka kyrteng kaba U Blei u la ai ha u ka long kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka jong ki .
Ngi khmih sha phi kum u nongïalam ; tep ïa la ka tnga ha ka jaka tep bha tam kaba ngi don . Uno na un da sngewkmen ban ai jaka tep phi , ba phin ïoh ban tep ka .
translation.en: Hear us , my lord : thou art a mighty prince among us : in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead  ; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre , but that thou mayest bury thy dead .

And there went up some of the children of Israel , and of the priests , and the Levites , and the singers , and the porters , and the Nethinims , unto Jerusalem , in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king .
translation.kha: U Esra u long u riewstad uba don ka jingtip bajylliew ïa ka Hukum kaba U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel u la ai ha u Moses . Namar ba u Esra u don ïa ka jingkyrkhu U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u patsha u ai kat ïa kaba u pan . Ha ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Artakserksis , u Esra u la mih na Babilonia ban leit sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad shi kynhun ki Israel kiba kynthup ïa ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi , ki nongput nongtem ka Templ , ki nongap phira ka Templ bad ki nongtrei .

translation.en: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds , and their post by my posts , and the wall between me and them , they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed : wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger .
translation.kha: Ki syiem ki la shna ïa ki phyllaw bad ki shawkad ïingsyiem jong ki marpyrshah ïa ki phyllaw bad ki shawkad jong ka Templ jong nga , ba kumta ka don tang ka kynroh hapdeng jong ngi . Ki la pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga da baroh kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh , bad kumta ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga la pynjot ïa ki .
u Kumta Moses u la kren ha ki paid Israel ïa kaei kaei baroh ba U Trai u la hukum ïa u .
translation.en: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses .
And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel : and blow ye with the trumpet , and say , God save king Solomon .
translation.kha: ha kaba u Sadok bad u Nathan ki dei ban pynsleh ïa u kum u syiem Israel . Nangta put ïa ka turoi bad pyrta , ‘ Im slem Syiem Solomon !’
U kpa bad ka kmie jong u khunlung ki sngewlyngngoh ha kiei kiei kiba u Simeon u shaphang jong u .
translation.en: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him .
