translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa pynroi khlem Gath byrthen bad tap beiñ pha da ka jakhlia . Ki briew kin khmih ïa pha kerkut ka jingsngew shyrkhei .
translation.en: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee , and make thee vile , and will set thee as a gazingstock .
Nicodemus saith unto him , How can a man be born when he is old ? can he enter the second time into his mother s womb , and be born ?
translation.kha: Kumno lah ban kha pat ïa u briew uba la rangbah ?  U Nikodemos u la kylli .  Kam lah ban long ba un rung shapoh ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong u bad ban kha sa shisien !

translation.en: And in those days , when the number of the disciples was multiplied , there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews , because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , katba ka jingdon ki synran ka nang ïai kiew , la don ka jingïania hapdeng ki Jiw kiba kren Grik bad ki Jiw kiba kren ktien tynrai . Ki Jiw kiba kren Grik ki la kam ba ïa ki riewkynthei la leh klet ha ka jingsam pisa kaba man ka sngi .
Kawei adong kawei ka dkut ka mane pui kohnguh ha ïa ryntieh u jong u Ita , Keramim ngi Pamphylia mane bad kohnguh ïa U Trai U Blei khyllung ngi bla la junom .
translation.en: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god , and we will walk in the name of the  Lord  our God for ever and ever .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi don ei ei ban ong , to ai ba ngan sngew ïa ; kata ngan pdiang da kaba sngewbha lada kaba phi ong ka kaba long dei .
translation.en: If thou hast any thing to say , answer me : speak , for I desire to justify thee .

translation.kha: Pynban katba ki Israel ki nang shah pynshitom beiñ , katta ki nang ïaroi bad ki nang saphriang kylleng ka ri
translation.en: But the more they afflicted them , the more they multiplied and grew . And they were grieved because of the children of Israel .
Then the king commanded to call the magicians , and the astrologers , and the sorcerers , and the Chaldeans , for to shew the king his dreams . So they came and stood before the king .
translation.kha: kumta u la phah khot ïa ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongkheiñ ksuid bad ki nongleh byrtong ban ïawan bad batai ïa ka jingphohsniew ha u . Haba ki la ïawan bad ïeng ha khmat u syiem ,

Nangta u syiem ong u ha u Sadok , Khie leit rah biang ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha ka nongbah . Lada U Trai u sngewbha ïa nga , shisien ka sngi un shah ba ngan biang wan ban ïohi ïa ka bad ïa ka ha jaka kaba ka don .
translation.en: And the king said unto Zadok , Carry back the ark of God into the city : if I shall find favour in the eyes of the  Lord  , he will bring me again , and shew me both it , and his habitation :

And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west , from Baal–gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak , that goeth up to Seir  ; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions  ;
translation.kha: U Joshua bad ki paid Israel ki la jop ïa ki syiem baroh kiba ha ka ri kaba sha sepngi jong ka Jordan , naduh Baalgad ha Them Lebanon haduh u Lum Halak ha ka phang shathie hajan Edom . U Joshua u pynïabynta ïa kane ka ri hapdeng ki jait Israel bad u ai ïa ka ha ki kum ka jingïohkynti baneh junom .
Ki jingkhublei jong nga ïa u Ampliatos , u paralok ba-ieit jong nga ha ka U jingïasyllok Trai .
translation.en: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord .

translation.kha: Ha kaba kut ngim lah shah shuh . Kumta ngi la rai ban tang sah ma ngi ha Athens
translation.en: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear , we thought it good to be left at Athens alone ;
He is despised and rejected of men  ; a man of sorrows , and acquainted with grief : and we hid as it were our faces from him  ; he was despised , and we esteemed him not .
translation.kha: Ngi la ñiewbeiñ ïa u bad ngi la kyntait ïa u ; u la shah ïa ka jingshitom bad jingpang . Ym don mano mano wat ban peit ïa u — ngi la leh bymsalia ïa u kum u bym long ei ei .
Namar synñiang U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga Kyrteng tlot bad Helkath bym lah leh ei ei , ki phai pyrshah ïa Shemeber da ka jingbitar jong pynsngaid baroh .
translation.en: Because he hath loosed my cord , and afflicted me , they have also let loose the bridle before me .

translation.kha: Kaba kum kaba da sang eh ka dei ban shah pynshitom da ka jingïap .
translation.en: For this is an heinous crime  ; yea , it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges .
Which remain among the graves , and lodge in the monuments , which eat swine s flesh , and broth of abominable things is in their vessels  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka por mynmiet ki leit sha ki krem bad sha ki jaka tep ban ïasyllok bad ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap . Ki bam doh sniang bad ki dih ïa ka syrwa ba la shet da ka doh ba la ai jingkñia sha ki blei thala .
Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha ki , bad ngan ïai leh kumta , khnang ba ka jingieit kaba me don ïa nga kan ïoh long bad ki , bad nga kumta ngan ruh ïoh long bad ki .
translation.en: And I have declared unto them thy name , and will declare it : that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them , and I in them .

translation.kha: namar kiei kiba khraw kiba U Badonbor u la leh na ka bynta jong nga . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long kaba khuid
translation.en: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things  ; and holy is his name .

translation.kha: Ieh ! Kaei me kwah bad ngi , ko Jisu uba na Nasareth ? Hato me la wan hangne ban pynjot ïa ngi ? Nga me ithuh long uei : Me long u nonglamktien jong bakhuid U Blei !
translation.en: Saying , Let us alone  ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art  ; the Holy One of God .

translation.kha: ka u pynkyntang ruh ïa bynta kaba hapdeng ka phyllaw ka jaka kaba ha khmat ka Templ bad u kñia hangta ïa ki jingainguh , ïa jingainguh bam , bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ki na ka bynta ka jingainguh jingïasyllok . U leh ïa namar kata ka ka than eh na ka bynta baroh ki jingainguh
translation.en: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the  Lord  : for there he offered burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings : because the brasen altar that was before the  Lord  was too little to receive the burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings .
Pass ye away , thou inhabitant of Saphir , having thy shame naked : the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth–ezel  ; he shall receive of you his standing .
translation.kha: Phi ki briew ka Shaphir , leit shah ringmraw , ha ka jinglyngkhuit bad jinglehrain . Kito kiba shong ha Saanan kim nud ban mih shabar na ka nongbah jong ki . Haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki briew jong ka Bethesel ki ïambriew , phin tip ba ym don jakarieh hangta .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , what have I to do with thee ? mine hour is not yet come .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban ong ïa nga ïa kaei ba ngan leh ,  U Jisu u la jubab .  Ka por jong nga kam pat poi .
syiem Solomon u la rai ban tei ïa Templ ha kaba yn mane ïa U Trai , bad ruh ban tei ka bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the  Lord  , and an house for his kingdom .
Then answered one of the people , and said , Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath , saying , Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day . And the people were faint .
translation.kha: Hynrei uwei na ki rangbah u ong ha u ,  Ngi baroh ngi la tlot na ka jingthngan , hynrei i pa jong phi i la byrngem ïa ngi bad ong , ‘ Ka jingtim kan long ha uno uno uba bam ei ei mynta ka sngi .’

translation.en: For this is the word of promise , At this time will I come , and Sara shall have a son .
translation.kha: Naba ïa ka jingkular U Blei la pynlong ha kine ki ktien :  Ha ka por kaba dei ngan wan pat , bad ka Sarah kan ïoh khun shynrang .

translation.en: But at the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose to place his name in , there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even , at the going down of the sun , at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kñia ïa ki jingainguh na ka bynta ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha kata ka jaka mane Blei ba U  Trai  un jied — ym hawei pat ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ai ha phi . Leh ïa kata ha ka por sep sngi , kaba ïadei bad ka por ba phi mih na Ijipt .
U Moses u la bitar lep , bad u ong ha U , Wat ïa kano kano ka jingainguh ba kine ki briew ki wallam . Ngam shym la bymdei ïa uwei ruh na ki ; ngam shym la shim ruh wat tang na ki kada jong ki .
translation.en: And Moses was very wroth , and said unto the  Lord  , Respect not thou their offering : I have not taken one ass from them , neither have I hurt one of them .
Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Libnah with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Nalor jong ka Hebron ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , la ai ïa kine ki nongbah harum ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron u lyngdoh : Ka Libnah ,
Mynta ngi lah ban ainguh ïa U jong Blei ngi na ka bynta jong phi . Ngi ainguh ïa u na ka ka bynta jingkmen kaba ngi don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u namar jong phi .
translation.en: For what thanks can we render to God again for you , for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God ;

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la bitar lep ïa la ki briew u la ha ka ri jong ki ïa ki jingtim baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against this land , to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book :

translation.kha: Khat-ar ki tylli dur sing ki don ha mawkyrdon ki , uwei uwei ha ka tduh jong kawei pa kawei ka kyrdon . Ym pat ju don ka khet kaba kum kane ha kawei pat ka hima .
translation.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps . There was not the like made in any kingdom .

translation.kha: U tip kumno ban ïa trei ka kam jong u namar U Blei u hikai ïa u .
translation.en: For his God doth instruct him to discretion , and doth teach him .

And Samson s wife wept before him , and said , Thou dost but hate me , and lovest me not : thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people , and hast not told it me . And he said unto her , Behold , I have not told it my father nor my mother , and shall I tell it thee ?
translation.kha: Kumta ka tnga u Samson ka leit ha khmat jong u ryngkat bad ki ummat bad ka ong ,  Pleng , phim ieit satia ïa nga ! Phi isih ïa nga ! Phi buh jingkyntip ha ki paralok jong nga , hynrei phim shym ïathuh ha nga ka mut aïu !  U ong ,  Khmih , ngam shym pat la ïathuh ha la i pa bad i mei . Balei keiñ ngan ïathuh ha phi ?

translation.en: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel , and Eder , and Jagur ,
translation.kha: Ki nongbah kiba sha jngai eh shaphang shathie kiba dei ki jong ki , kito kiba hajan u pud jong ka Edom , ki long ka Kabseel , ka Eder , ka Jagur ,

translation.en: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night , and said , Rise up , and get you forth from among my people , both ye and the children of Israel  ; and go , serve the  Lord  , as ye have said .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka miet , u Pharaoh u la phah khot mar mar ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ,  Khie mihnoh na ka ri jong nga , ma phi bad ki Israel ! Khie leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  kumba phi la pan .

Gamad kata Jeduthun ka por ki paid Benjamin ki ïohsngew ba ki para jait jingjanai baroh ki la ïalumlang ha Mispah Tiberios Ki Israel ki kylli shahskhor Ïathuh ïa ngi , kumno kane ka kam runar ka la jia ?
translation.en: ( Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpah . ) Then said the children of Israel , Tell us , how was this wickedness ?

translation.kha: ‘ Ka Moab ka la kyllon ,’ kin jubab , ‘ ïam na bynta jong ka ; pynjahburom ka Pynbna ha lynter ka wah Arnon ba ïa Moab la pynjot !’
translation.en: Moab is confounded  ; for it is broken down : howl and cry  ; tell ye it in Arnon , that Moab is spoiled ,

translation.kha: hynmen Ko ko para jong nga , u la ong , ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ban dei urlong shisha ha kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u kren lyngba u , Dabid la u pynlong ka jingïathuh lypa shaphang u Judas , uba la long u nongïalam ïa kito kiba la kem ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: Men and brethren , this scripture must needs have been fulfilled , which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas , which was guide to them that took Jesus .
And he said , Art thou my very son Esau ? And he said , I am .
translation.kha: Hynrei hamar ba un sa ai artat ha u ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u , u la kylli biang ,  Phi dei shisha u Iso ?  U ruh u jubab ,  Nga dei !

Haba kata jingsngewkmen por ka poi Bethesda ki briew kin lehbha ïa kyn-ih jingïathuhkhana jong phi Amalek ka suit ïa ka jingpynjot , bad kin rwai ïa kane jingpalat ñianglartham sngewsih Rakhel ka jingshem jong phi : La pynjot thiaw ïa ngi ! U Trai u la shim noh ïa ka ri Niam ngi bad jingïadie la peh ïa ka sha kito kiba la ring koidi ïa ngi .
translation.en: In that day shall one take up a parable against you , and lament with a doleful lamentation , and say , We be utterly spoiled : he hath changed the portion of my people : how hath he removed it from me ! turning away he hath divided our fields .

And Ananias went his way , and entered into the house  ; and putting his hands on him said , Brother Saul , the Lord , even Jesus , that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest , hath sent me , that thou mightest receive thy sight , and be filled with the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ananias u la leit , u la rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaba u Saul u don , bad u la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong u .  Ko Saul , u para jong nga ,  u la ong ,  U Trai u la phah ïa nga — U Jisu hi , uba la mihpaw ha me ha ka lynti katba me dang wan shane . U la phah ïa nga khnang ba men ïoh imat pat bad ban pyndap ïa me da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: And the sons of Asher  ; Imnah , and Ishuah , and Ishvi , and Beriah , and Serah their sister : and the sons of Beriah  ; Heber , and Malchiel .
translation.kha: U Asher bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Imnah , u Ishbah , u Ishbi , bad u Beraïah lem bad ka Serah ka para jong ki . Ki khun shynrang u Beraïah ki long u Heber bad u Malkhiel .

U la ong , Ko Trai , lada me sngewbha shisha ïa nga , nga kyrpad ïa me ban wan ryngkat bad ngi . ki Kine briew ki kiba long mutlop , hynrei map ïa ka jingbymman bad ka pop jong ngi , bad pdiang ïa kum ngi ki briew ki jong me . hi
translation.en: And he said , If now I have found grace in thy sight , O Lord , let my Lord , I pray thee , go among us  ; for it is a stiffnecked people  ; and pardon our iniquity and our sin , and take us for thine inheritance .

translation.kha: U Joab jingkhroh Yiron Laodikaïa u , Lada phi sngewkwah Hananaïah ki Syria ki Shah ïa shongthait , wan bad ïarap ïa nga kadlieng bad lada Rispah Ammon ki jop ïa phi , bamaïan klop bad Ïoh ïa phi ïasyriem
translation.en: And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me , then thou shalt help me : but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee , then I will come and help thee .

translation.kha: Buh ïa ki jingleh myntor bad jingkhan jong pha baroh ; pha la pyndonkam ïa ki naduh ba pha dang samla . Lehse ki lah ban long jingïarap katto katne ïa pha ; lehse pha lah ban ïa pyntieng ki nongshun jong pha .
translation.en: Stand now with thine enchantments , and with the multitude of thy sorceries , wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth  ; if so be thou shalt be able to profit , if so be thou mayest prevail .

translation.kha: Nga pan na , Blei ban shah ïa nga ban don ar tylli kiei kiei shuwa ba ngan ïap :
translation.en: Two things have I required of thee  ; deny me them not before I die :

The wolf and the lamb shall feed together , and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock : and dust shall be the serpent s meat . They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki suri bad ki khunlangbrot kin ïabam lang , ki sing kin bam phlang , kumba bam ki masi , bad ki bseiñ kin ym long shuh ka jingma . Ha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong nga yn ym don shuh ka jingma ne kaba sniew .
U shaneng u la hukum ïa Benhail ksuid riew bad u la mihnoh shabar jong u khynnah , bad ha kata tv khyllipmat la pynkhiah ïa Hammolekheth .
translation.en: And Jesus rebuked the devil  ; and he departed out of him : and the child was cured from that very hour .
Remember the word which Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded you , saying , The  Lord  your God hath given you rest , and hath given you this land .
translation.kha: Kynmaw kumno u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la ïathuh ha phi ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ai ha phi ïa kane ka ri ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan kum ka ïing jong phi .
U Beraïah u don ar ki ngut khun shynrang , u Heber bad u Malkhiel . ( U Malkhiel u seng ïa nongbah ka Birsaith . )
translation.en: And the sons of Beriah  ; Heber , and Malchiel , who is the father of Birzavith .

translation.kha: U buh ka por ieit ban bad ka por ban isih , ka por ïa ka thma bad ka por ïa ka jingsuk .
translation.en: A time to love , and a time to hate  ; a time of war , and a time of peace .
The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan , and covered the company of Abiram .
translation.kha: Nangta ka khyndew ka ang bad nguid ïa u Dathan bad tep ïa u Abiram bad ka longïing jong u ;
Te nga ong ha me , ka jingieit bakhraw ka pyn-i ka ba ïa ki pop jong ka bun la map . uno uba u pyn-i tang khyndiat ka jingieit .
translation.en: Wherefore I say unto thee , Her sins , which are many , are forgiven  ; for she loved much : but to whom little is forgiven , the same loveth little .
By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry : they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki shah lehbeiñ , ki ud ; ki pyrta ba yn don mano mano ban pyllait im ïa ki .
Un shim me kum ïa ka bol bad un kynting sha ri kham . ïap hangta hajan kali ïapom me , me la sngewsarong . Me ka jingjahburom ïa ka longïing jong u me .
translation.en: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country : there shalt thou die , and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord s house .
The sinners in Zion are afraid  ; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites . Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire ? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings ?
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pop jong ka Seïon ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ki ong ,  Ka jingbishar U Blei ka long kum ka ding kaba meh junom . Hato uno uno na ngi un lait im na ka ding kaba kum kata ?

translation.en: Take an harp , go about the city , thou harlot that hast been forgotten  ; make sweet melody , sing many songs , that thou mayest be remembered .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka duitara , khie leit sawdong ïa ka shnong , Pha ka bapli ka nuti ba la klet noh ! To tem bad rwai biang ïa ki jingrwai jong pha To wallam ïa ki rangbah sa shisien pat .

translation.en: Be in pain , and labour to bring forth , O daughter of Zion , like a woman in travail : for now shalt thou go forth out of the city , and thou shalt dwell in the field , and thou shalt go even to Babylon  ; there shalt thou be delivered  ; there the  Lord  shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies .
translation.kha: To phai bad to ud , ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , kum ka briew ka ban sa kha khun , naba mynta phin sa hap ban ieh ïa ka nongbah bad ban im ha rudnong . Phi dei ban leit sha Babilon , hynrei hangta U  Trai  un pyllait ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: And Moses said , Let no man leave of it till the morning .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki ,  Uno uno ruh um dei ban pynsah ïa ka wat tang khyndiat ruh na ka bynta kaba la shai .

translation.en: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king s commandment by his chamberlains : therefore was the king very wroth , and his anger burned in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki shakri ki la ïathuh ïa ka hukum u syiem ha ka Bashti , ka mahadei ; ka la kyntait ban wan . Kane ka la pynbitar ïa u syiem .

translation.en: And if ye have erred , and not observed all these commandments , which the  Lord  hath spoken unto Moses ,
translation.kha: Hynrei lehse don uba kum bakla khlem da mut khnang ha kaba sumar ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses .

translation.en: And , behold , Boaz came from Beth–lehem , and said unto the reapers , The  Lord  be with you . And they answered him , The  Lord  bless thee .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por u Boas da lade hi u wan poi na Bethlehem bad u ai khublei ïa ki nongtrei .  To U  Trai  un long ryngkat bad phi !  u ong .  U  Trai  u kyrkhu ïa phi !  ki jubab .

translation.en: I will keep thy statutes : O forsake me not utterly .
translation.kha: Ngan kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me : A wat iehnoh da lei lei ïa nga !
ban shu ong , haba u Abraham u la siew ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew , ( kiba na u ki lum ïa ) ruh u la siew ka .
translation.en: And as I may so say , Levi also , who receiveth tithes , payed tithes in Abraham .
He setteth an end to darkness , and searcheth out all perfection : the stones of darkness , and the shadow of death .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ngam sha ki jaka bajylliew tam ka jingdum . Ki wad ïa ki jaka bajylliew ka pyrthei ; bad ki tih ïa ki mawsiang ha ka jingdum .

translation.en: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee , the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ki hima badonbor kin ïaroh ïa me bad yn sheptieng ïa me ha ki nongbah jong ki hima bashyrkhei .

Shihajar kynmaw ïa ki jingkular jong me bad wat ñiewbeiñ ïa ngi ; wat wallam nongshetkylla jingjahburom halor pynhun Jerusalem ka jaka jong ka khet badonburom jong me . nongsynran Menahem shakri ka jutang kaba me la pynlong bad ngi .
translation.en: Do not abhor us , for thy name s sake , do not disgrace the throne of thy glory : remember , break not thy covenant with us .

translation.kha: Nangta u la leit sha ka Jehoba kaba phai sha mihngi . U la kiew ïa ki mawkyrdon , Binnui ha kliar u mala thew ïa ka tyngkong ; ka la long lai mitar shapoh ha ka jingjylliew .
translation.en: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east , and went up the stairs thereof , and measured the threshold of the gate , which was one reed broad  ; and the other threshold of the gate , which was one reed broad .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka por nga ong ïa ki rangbah kiba khmih ïa kam , ba ma ki bad nongïarap jong ki , ki hap ban sah Jerusalem ha ka mynmiet , khnang ba ngi lah ban ap phira ïa ka nongbah bad kumjuh ruh ban trei ha ka por mynsngi .
translation.en: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people , Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem , that in the night they may be a guard to us , and labour on the day .

translation.kha: Ki Reuben jait bad ki jait Gad ki la don shibun ki jingri . Haba ki la ïohi ba ka Jaser ri bad ka ri Gilead ka long kaba bit eh na ka bynta ki jingri ,
translation.en: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle : and when they saw the land of Jazer , and the land of Gilead , that , behold , the place was a place for cattle  ;
Much food is in the tillage of the poor : but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment .
translation.kha: Ki lyngkha ba sah shrah ki lah ban pynmih shibun ka jingbam ïa kiba duk , hynrei ki bymhok kin shu ieh ïa kine khlem rep .

translation.en: Who is he that will plead with me ? for now , if I hold my tongue , I shall give up the ghost .
translation.kha: Hato me wan ban kynnoh ïa nga , A Blei ? Lada me leh kumta , nga kloi ban shu sngap jar bad ïap noh .

translation.en: And all his acquaintance , and the women that followed him from Galilee , stood afar off , beholding these things .
translation.kha: Baroh kito kiba la ithuh ïa U Jisu , kynthup ki kynthei kiba la bud ïa u na Galilaïa , ki la ïeng na pajih ban jngoh .

translation.en: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David , but carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid um shym leit rah shuh ïa ka sha Jerusalem . Pynban , u ieh ïa ka ha ka ïing jong u briew uba kyrteng u Obed Edom , u traishnong ka nongbah Gath .

Wat sheptieng , ko ki briew jong nga ! Phi tip ba naduh ki por mynbarim haduh mynta nga la ïathuhlypa ïa baroh ka ban sa jia , bad phi long ki Mynhynnin jong nga . khohsiew don uno uno uwei pat Entappuah Blei ? Hato don kiwei pat ki blei badonbor ba ngam shym thymmai ?
translation.en: Fear ye not , neither be afraid : have not I told thee from that time , and have declared it ? ye are even my witnesses . Is there a God beside me ? yea , there is no God  ; I know not any .
And when he looked on Amalek , he took up his parable , and said , Amalek was the first of the nations  ; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever .
translation.kha: Nangta ha ka jingïohipaw jong u , u Balaam u la ïohi ïa ki Amalek , bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  U Amalek u long ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñbor tam na baroh , Hynrei ha kaba kut un jah noh jar .
Katba ka ka jingïaleh dang bteng hapdeng ki kynhun jong u Dabid bad ki kynhun kiba ïashah ïa longïing ka jong u Saul , u Abner u la nang kham khrawbor napdeng ki nongbud jong u Saul .
translation.en: And it came to pass , while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David , that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul .
Also in Horeb ye provoked the  Lord  to wrath , so that the  Lord  was angry with you to have destroyed you .
translation.kha: Wat ha Lum Sinai ruh phi la pynbitar shla ïa U  Trai  kat haduh ban pynjot ïa phi .
pynkylla kyrteng ïa ka Laish sha ka Dan , kum ka kyrteng u kpa tymmen Dan , u khun jong u Jakob .
translation.en: And they called the name of the city Dan , after the name of Dan their father , who was born unto Israel : howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first .

translation.kha: Ko Trai , ym don uwei pat kum ma me ; ngi tip borabor ba me long tang ma me U marwei Blei .
translation.en: O  Lord  , there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .
And the governor said , Why , what evil hath he done ? But they cried out the more , saying , Let him be crucified .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Pilat u la kylli ,  Ka kam runar aïu u la leh ?  Nangta ki la sdang ban pyrta da ka sur kaba jam tam :  Sahnarphna ïa u !

translation.en: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God .
translation.kha: Nangta ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong ka jingsynshar u syiem Syros kum u patsha ka Babilonia , u Syros u la pynmih ïa ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingtei biang ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon , he , and his mother , and his servants , and his princes , and his officers : and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign .
translation.kha: bad u syiem Jehoïakhin lem bad ka kmie jong u , ki khun shynrang jong u , ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , bad ki rangbah synshar ha ka ïingsyiem , ki la pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia . Ha ka snem kaba phra jong ka jingsynshar u Nebukhadnessar u la shim koidi ïa u Jehoïakhin

translation.en: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , wat ki samla shynrang bad kynthei kiba koit bakhiah kin kyllon na ka jingsliang .

translation.en: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality .
translation.kha: Ki la shah tynjuh palat da ki jingjynjar kiba ki la ïaid lyngba ; hynrei ka jingkmen jong ki ka la long kaba khraw haduh katta katta ba ki la long kiba sbun shikatdei eh ha ka jingai jong ki , wat la ki long kiba duk shisha .
U Blei um wallam satia ka jingpynjot ki longïing ki ; kim im ha ka jingshyrkhei .
translation.en: Their houses are safe from fear , neither is the rod of God upon them .

translation.kha: Mynba kata ka por u! Jisu u la ong , Ko Kpa , U Trai ka Khet bad ka pyrthei ! Nga ainguh ïa me namar ba me la pyn-i ha ki bymstad ïa kaei kaba me la buhrieh na kiba stad bad kiba la ïoh jinghikai .
translation.en: At that time Jesus answered and said ,  I thank thee , O Father , Lord of heaven and earth , because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent , and hast revealed them unto babes .

translation.kha: nonghikai ka bad Pharisi ki la sdang ïakren para ma ki , Uei une u briew uba kum kane ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei ! U Blei long tang ma u hi lah ban map ïa ki pop !
translation.en: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason , saying , Who is this which speaketh blasphemies ? Who can forgive sins , but God alone ?
And by chance there came down a certain priest that way : and when he saw him , he passed by on the other side .
translation.kha: Ka la jia ryngkhat ba u lyngdoh u la leit hiar na kata ka lynti ; hynrei haba u la ïohi ïa uta u briew , u la ïaid lait na kawei ka liang .
Haba ïakhun phi ïa Amalek ki bad ki Kanaan , phin ïap ha ka thma ; U Trai un ym don lem bad phi , namar phi la kyntait ban bud ïa u .
translation.en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you , and ye shall fall by the sword : because ye are turned away from the  Lord  , therefore the  Lord  will not be with you .

translation.kha: ban jop ïa ki hima bad ban pynshitom ïa ki ; jaitbynriew
translation.en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen , and punishments upon the people  ;
And they took them out of the midst of the tent , and brought them unto Joshua , and unto all the children of Israel , and laid them out before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki wanrah ïa ki shabar ka ïingjaiñ , ki leit lam ïa ki sha u Joshua bad sha kita ki Israel baroh , bad ki buh ïa ki ha khmat U  Trai .
San ngut na ki , la long kiba bieit , bad san kiwei pat ki la long kiba .
translation.en: And five of them were wise , and five were foolish .

translation.kha: thnum wan sirka U Trai , u maw uba im uba ïa-shahskhor kyntait da u briew kum u nongshong hynrei uba la jied da U Blei ba u long uba kordor .
translation.en: To whom coming , as unto a living stone , disallowed indeed of men , but chosen of God , and precious ,
In Hebrew , “Gilead” means “Witness Pile .”
translation.kha: Ha ka ktien Hebru “Gilead” ka mut “Ka Sakhi ba Kynton .”

translation.en: And his servant Zimri , captain of half his chariots , conspired against him , as he was in Tirzah , drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah .
translation.kha: U Simri , uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam uba peit ïa shiteng ki kali ïapom jong u syiem , u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u . Ha kawei ka sngi ha Tirsah , u Elah u buaid ha ka ïing jong u Arsa , uba peit ïa ka ïingsyiem .
Kumno uwei un sngewthikna ba ka briew mynsiem ka kiew artet katba ba ka mynsiem jong ka mrad ka hiar sha tbian sha ka khyndew ?
translation.en: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward , and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth ?
How much less man , that is a worm ? and the son of man , which is a worm ?
translation.kha: Te kumta kumno shaphang u briew , uta u kruiñ , uta u khñiang ? u briew u long aïu ha ki khmat U Blei ?

translation.en: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had  ; and they cried before him , Bow the knee : and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U la ai ha u ïa ka kali syiem kaba ar ba un shong ; bad ki nongap ïa ka ïingsyiem ki ïaid ha khmat jong u bad ki pyrta ,  Kynriah ! kynriah !  Bad kumta la thung lat ïa u Joseph halor ka ri Ijipt baroh .
Phi la pynïap bah ki briew hangne hapoh ka nongbah ba ki lynti ki dap da ki metïap .
translation.en: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city , and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain .

And I will punish Bel in Babylon , and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up : and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him : yea , the wall of Babylon shall fall .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa u Bel , u blei ki nong Babilonia , bad ngan pynlong ïa u ban aiti noh ïa ki tiar jong u kiba shu tuh ; ki jaitbynriew kin ym mane shuh ïa u .  Ki kynroh ka Babilon ki la khyllem .
Hynrei namar don shibun kiba kob sarong Riew-ieit ki daw ba kynja briew , nga ruh ngan leh kumjuh .
translation.en: Seeing that many glory after the flesh , I will glory also .
Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not ; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth : for God hath received him .
translation.kha: U briew uba bam ïa kiei kiei baroh , um dei ban peitbeiñ ïa uta u bym bam ; katba uta uba bam tang da ki jhur um dei ban bishar ïa uta uba bam ïa kaei kaei ruh ; naba U Blei u la pdiang ïa u .

Kumta ha u ba bnai ar jong ka snem hadien ba ki la wan pat sha ka jaka jong ka Templ ha Jerusalem , ki sdang ïatrei ban Serubbabel . U , u Joshua bad kiwei pat ki para rangbah ka ri , ki lyngdoh , bad ki Lebi , ha ka jingshisha , baroh kiba shah ringmraw kiba la wan phai pat sha Jerusalem , ki la ïasnohkti ha lang ka jingtrei . Ïa baroh ki kiba Lebi la dap arphew snem ka rta lane tam , la buh ban khmih ha ka pat jingtei ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem , in the second month , began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites , and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem  ; and appointed the Levites , from twenty years old and upward , to set forward the work of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong ka u rupa ka don kynrei ha Jerusalem kumba don u maw , bad ïa u dieng Kedar kumba u pahuh dieng Dumbur ha ki kjat lum ka Judah .
translation.en: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones , and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale , for abundance .

For thus saith the  Lord  concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place , and concerning their mothers that bare them , and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land  ;
translation.kha: Ngan ïathuh ïa me kaei ka ban jia ïa ki khynnah kiba la kha hangne bad ïa ki kmie ki kpa jong ki .

translation.en: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour , and did likewise .
translation.kha: Nangta ha ka por khat-ar baje bad ruh ha ka por lai baje u la leh kumjuh .

translation.en: From the blood of the slain , from the fat of the mighty , the bow of Jonathan turned not back , and the sword of Saul returned not empty .
translation.kha: Ka ryntieh u Jonathan ka long kaba shyrkhei Ka waitlam u Saul ka long ka bym don jingisynei , Ka pynkhyllem ïa kiba khlaiñbor , ka da pynïap ïa ki nongshun .
Ynda u la long syiem katto katne por , u Joash u la kut jingmut ban shna pynbha ïa ka Templ
translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that Joash was minded to repair the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Yn don ka jingseisoh kaba khraw Jokmeam ki hynñiew snem ha ka ri Kingdom Sorah kawei .
translation.en: Behold , there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt :

translation.kha: u pynpaw ka jingibeiñ ïa ki nongbanbeiñ bad u pynlong ïa ki ban kopi Ahian ki ri shyiap bym don lynti .
translation.en: He poureth contempt upon princes , and causeth them to wander in the wilderness , where there is no way .
And , behold , there came a great wind from the wilderness , and smote the four corners of the house , and it fell upon the young men , and they are dead  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .
translation.kha: Ka rah ïa ka ïing bad pynïap ïa ki baroh . Tang ma nga uba la lait im ban wan ïathuh ïa phi .
ka Kum erïong , U Blei u pynjot ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .
translation.en: By the blast of God they perish , and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed .

translation.kha: Wat pynphriang shaphang lamler jongno jongno , bad haba uno uno u dang don ha ka jingbishar namar la ka jingim , kren pynpaw lada ka jingphla jong phi kan long jingïarap ïa u . Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people : neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha Elealeh ka khyllipmat hi la jia kjit jingkhih jumai kaba jur ; shi khliehduh na ka shiphew koidi Palal ka Benhesed Justos pynjot , bad hynñiew hajar ngut ki briew ki la ïap . Kita kiwei pat ki briew jingnoh la sngewtriem bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw U Blei jong ka bneng .
translation.en: And the same hour was there a great earthquake , and the tenth part of the city fell , and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand : and the remnant were affrighted , and gave glory to the God of heaven .

translation.kha: Ka jingngeit jong phi , Kseh , sian shylliah ha ka jingstad briew , hynrei , ha ka bor Amram Blei ka-por
translation.en: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men , but in the power of God .
Then were they all of good cheer , and they also took some meat .
translation.kha: Ki la sngew ïoh mynsiem bad uwei uwei na ki ruh , ki la bam khyndiat ka jingbam .

translation.en: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship , and humility , and neglecting of the body ; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh .
translation.kha: Da shisha kiba kum kine ki kyndon ki i kumba la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingstad ha ka jingmane ba shu pynbor ïa ki angel , bad ka jingsngewrit bymdei , bad ka jingleh palat ïa ka met ; hynrei ki bymdondor ei ei ha kaba synshar ïa ki jingbrai ka doh .

translation.en: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the  Lord  thy God , which thou shalt make thee .
translation.kha: Haba phi tei ïa ka duwan U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , wat pynïeng hajan jong ka ïa uno uno u dieng uba don ka dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah .
Baroh kaba la shna da ka rupa , ka ksiar ka , rnong lane ka nar la , buh kyrpang na ka bynta U Trai . Dei ban buh ïa kata ha ka ïing jingkynshew U Trai .
translation.en: But all the silver , and gold , and vessels of brass and iron , are consecrated unto the  Lord  : they shall come into the treasury of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Rehoboam u Reuben ïa u Adoniram , uba khmih ïa ki nongtrei ba la shu jakashong , ban leit angkor ki Israel , hynrei ki :4–12 lynthem phra ïa u pynjah ba un da ïap ryngkoh Ha kane u Rehoboam u Basemath pynstet ha jingpynbaptis ka kali ïapom bad u phet sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute  ; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones , that he died . But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .

And the men of Israel said , Have ye seen this man that is come up ? surely to defy Israel is he come up : and it shall be , that the man who killeth him , the king will enrich him with great riches , and will give him his daughter , and make his father s house free in Israel .
translation.kha: Peit ïa une u briew  ki ïakren para ma ki .  Sngap ïa ki jingkob jong u . U syiem Saul un ai ka nong kaba khraw ïa u briew u ban pynïap ïa u ; u syiem un ai ruh ban shongkurim ïa ka khun kynthei jong u bad ka ïing u kpa jong u kam donkam ban siew khajna .
Kin ym long shuh ki bymïaishah , hynrei kin trei ha ka jingshemphang bad kin ong kaei ïa kaba ki mut .
translation.en: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge , and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki para shynrang jong u ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai , Niam U Jisu ruh u la leit ; , pynban um shym la leit ha kaba paw , hynrei ha kaba rieh .
translation.en: But when his brethren were gone up , then went he also up unto the feast , not openly , but as it were in secret .

translation.kha: Hapdeng kita ki jingthaw don kaei kaei kaba syriem kum ka bun bameh , - ïai khih Amminadab Ka ding ka pyiar bad pynmih bakhuid pynong leilieh .
translation.en: As for the likeness of the living creatures , their appearance was like burning coals of fire , and like the appearance of lamps : it went up and down among the living creatures  ; and the fire was bright , and out of the fire went forth lightning .

translation.kha: Ka la phah ïa la ki ïada kynthei ban Joïada batuid jing-jngai jaka jaiñ jrong tam ha kata ka nongbah :
translation.en: She hath sent forth her maidens : she crieth upon the highest places of the city ,

translation.kha: Ki snep ha ka jong kpoh u ki long kum ki syrwiang khiew kiba nep ; ki tar ka ïa madan ktieh kumba long ka lyntang shoh kew .
translation.en: Sharp stones are under him : he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire .
Are they Hebrews ? so am I . Are they Israelites ? so am I . Are they the seed of Abraham ? so am I .
translation.kha: Hato ki long ki Hebru ? Nga ruh nga long . Hato ki long ki Israel ? Nga ruh nga long . Hato ki long kiba hiarpateng na u Abraham ? Nga ruh nga long .

Ka dohnud jong ka jam namar Moab ! briew ki la phet sha ki shnong , bad sha ka Shelishiyah . Katto katne ki kiew ïa ka Luhith , ki da ïam haba ki leit katto katne ki phet sha Horanaim , ïam sngewsih jam .
translation.en: My heart shall cry out for Moab  ; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar , an heifer of three years old : for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up  ; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction .

translation.kha: bih la leit phai sha ka nongbah pynbna :7 ïoh jingkoit Kñia ki jingmong jong u , bad u Ahasaïah u la leit shata ban jingthung ïa u .
translation.en: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah , when he fought against Hazael king of Syria . And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel , because he was sick .

translation.kha: Lada don u para Israel uba kyrduh ha kano kano ka shnong kaba ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei phi jong u ai ha , wat phi khim mynsiem bad wat kyntait ban ïarap ïa u ;
translation.en: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , thou shalt not harden thine heart , nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother :

Because that they have forsaken me , and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , Chemosh the god of the Moabites , and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon , and have not walked in my ways , to do that which is right in mine eyes , and to keep my statutes and my judgments , as did David his father .
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kane namar u Solomon u la kyntait ïa nga bad u la mane ïa ki blei nongwei : ka Astarte , ka blei ki Sidon ; u Khemosh , u blei ki Moab ; bad u Molekh , u blei ki Ammon . U Solomon u la lyndet ïa nga ; u la leh palat , bad um shym la sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga kumba u Dabid u kpa jong u , u la leh .

translation.en: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her , and said unto her , Entice him , and see wherein his great strength lieth , and by what means we may prevail against him , that we may bind him to afflict him : and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver .
translation.kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki leit sha ka bad ki ong ,  Khroh ïa u Samson ban ïathuh ha pha balei ba u long uba khlaiñbor bad kumno ngin lah ban jop ïa u , khum ïa u bad pynlong ba un ym lah leh ei ei shuh . Uwei pa uwei na ngi un ai ïa pha mar shihajar shispah tylli ki sbai rupa .

translation.en: For our exhortation was not of deceit , nor of uncleanness , nor in guile :
translation.kha: Ka jingkyrpad jong ngi ïa phi kam dei kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingbakla lane ha ki jingthmu bymkhuid , lymne ba ngi pyrshang ban shukor ïano ïano .

translation.en: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him : and he dipped his finger in the blood , and put it upon the horns of the altar , and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar :
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wanrah ïa ka snam , bad u wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka , bad u tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad u theh ïa kaba sah baroh ha trai ka duwan .
Mynta kren ha ki paid Israel bad ong ïa ki baroh pan ban na la ki paramarjan ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad ki jingdeng rupa .
translation.en: Speak now in the ears of the people , and let every man borrow of his neighbour , and every woman of her neighbour , jewels of silver , and jewels of gold .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ha U , Blei Ngam ei long ei . Kumno nga lah ban leit sha u Pharaoh bad ban ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na Ijipt ?
translation.en: And Moses said unto God , Who am I , that I should go unto Pharaoh , and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt ?
For our comely parts have no need : but God hath tempered the body together , having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked :
translation.kha: U Blei hi da lade u la buh lang ïa ka met ha kata ka rukom ban kham ai burom ïa kito ki dkhot met kiba donkam ïa ka .
Nangta U Trai u la ong ha u , Elijah
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto him , saying ,
And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people , because he hath magnified himself against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab yn pynjot bad kan ym long shuh ka hima , namar ka ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as they sat at the table , that the word of the  Lord  came unto the prophet that brought him back :
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïashong bam ha ka miej , ka ktien U  Trai  ka wan ha u nongïathuhlypa tymmen ,

translation.en: And they had a few small fishes : and he blessed , and commanded to set them also before them .
translation.kha: Ki la don ruh katto katne tylli ki dohkha rit . U Jisu u la ainguh na ka bynta kine bad u la ong ïa ki synran ban sam ïa ki ruh .

Ki hynmen jong u ki ïamynjur , bad katto haba katne nongkhaïi ki na Midian ki ïaid lynti nangta , hynmen ki ki la sei noh ïa u Joseph na kata ka pukri bad ki la die noh ïa u ha kita ki nong Ishmael tylli arphew ki sbai rupa , bad ki ruh ki la ïalam noh ïa u sha Ijipt .
translation.en: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen  ; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit , and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver : and they brought Joseph into Egypt .
When Simon Peter saw it , he fell down at Jesus  knees , saying , Depart from me  ; for I am a sinful man , O Lord .
translation.kha: Haba u Simon Petros u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba lah jia , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat U Jisu bad u la ong ,  Khie leit noh na nga , ko Trai ! Nga long u briew uba pop !

Ka por ka poi ! Ngan wallam sha ïing ïa ki jingkhynwin jong pha kiba la pynkyntang pynsakma ; ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba pawnam ha kylleng ka soh-ot bad idonburom iaki ïa nangto kaba manbha pat . U Hosea u la kren .
translation.en: At that time will I bring you again , even in the time that I gather you : for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth , when I turn back your captivity before your eyes , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Thaw tylli arphew ki jingker ïa ka liang kaba shaphang shathie ,
translation.en: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle , twenty boards on the south side southward .

And whether we be afflicted , it is for your consolation and salvation , which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer : or whether we be comforted , it is for your consolation and salvation .
translation.kha: Lada ngi shahshitom , ka long na ka bynta ka jingïarap bad ka jingpynim jong phi ; lada la ïarap ïa ngi , te la ïarap ïa phi ruh bad la ai ïa ka bor ban ïaineh lem da ka jingïaishah ha kita kijuh ki jingshahshitom ba ngi ruh ngi la ïaineh .

translation.en: And he took butter , and milk , and the calf which he had dressed , and set it before them  ; and he stood by them under the tree , and they did eat .
translation.kha: U shim katto katne ka malai , ka dud , bad ka doh , bad u buh ïa kita ki jingbam ha khmat jong kita ki rangbah . Hangta ha trai u dieng u la pynbiang ïa ki da lade hi , bad ki la ïabam .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  If I will that he tarry till I come , what is that to thee ? follow thou me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Lada nga mon ïa u ba un im tad ynda nga wan , ka pher aïu ïa me ? To bud ïa nga !

translation.en: Tell them therefore , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will make this proverb to cease , and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel  ; but say unto them , The days are at hand , and the effect of every vision .
translation.kha: Mynta ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga don ban ong shaphang kata . Ngan buh ka jingkut ïa kata ka proberb . Yn ym ïai kren shuh ïa ka da lei lei ha Israel . Pynban to ïathuh ïa ki : Ka por ka la wan , bad ki jingïathuhlypa ki la urlong shisha !

translation.en: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel .
translation.kha: Da kumta u Jehu u la pynduh pyndam ïa ka jingmane ïa u Baal ha Israel .
Ngam pat ju leh pop ba kin ïap .
translation.en: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul .
And they went into Capernaum  ; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue , and taught .
translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la wan sha ka shnong Kapernam , bad ha ka sngi Sabbaton kaba bud , U Jisu u la leit sha ka synagog bad u la sdang ban hikai .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they will diligently learn the ways of my people , to swear by my name , The  Lord  liveth  ; as they taught my people to swear by Baal  ; then shall they be built in the midst of my people .
translation.kha: Lada kin pdiang da ka dohnud jong ki baroh ïa ka niam jong ki briew jong nga bad kin smai , ‘ Kumba U  Trai  u im’ — kumba shisien ki la hikai ïa ki briew jong nga ban smai da u Baal — nangta ki ruh kin long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga ban kin manbha .

translation.en: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka jingieit kaba U Mynsiem u la ai ha phi .

Balei ? Namar ba ka Syria kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka Damaskos , nongbah ka jong ka , bad ka Damaskos kam long kham kaba khlaiñ ban ïa u Syiem Resin . Katba Israel ïa ka , hapoh ki hynriewphew san snem yn sa pynkhynñiuh ïa ka ruh ban lait im kum ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: For the head of Syria is Damascus , and the head of Damascus is Rezin  ; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken , that it be not a people .

translation.kha: ba ki jong kin shadkmen ki bad rwai kmen baroh shi miet .
translation.en: Let the saints be joyful in glory : let them sing aloud upon their beds .
If the clouds be full of rain , they empty themselves upon the earth : and if the tree fall toward the south , or toward the north , in the place where the tree falleth , there it shall be .
translation.kha: Kam pher sha kano ka liang u dieng u khyllem , un don ha ka jaka kaba u la kyllon . Haba ki lyoh ki dap , ka slap .

Hynrei u Asahel um shym sangeh ; kumta u Abner , da jingtynrah shadien ïa la u sum u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh ba kumta u sum u da pei bla ha ka ingdong jong u Asahel u kyllon ïap ha madan , bad uwei pa uwei uba wan ha ka jaka kaba kyllon u la sangeh ïeng hangta .
translation.en: Howbeit he refused to turn aside : wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib , that the spear came out behind him  ; and he fell down there , and died in the same place : and it came to pass , that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la khohwah jingsngewpihuiñ buit mareh na pyndum jingtep , ki da sngewkhuslai Seboim sngewshyrkhei . Kim smam la kine ei ei “Nga Bahok ruh , Libya ki la sheptieng . [
translation.en: And they went out quickly , and fled from the sepulchre  ; for they trembled and were amazed : neither said they any thing to any man  ; for they were afraid .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first : and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables , which thou brakest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Shtah ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kito kiba mynshuwa , bad ngan sa thoh ha ki ïa ki ktien kiba la don ha ki mawlyngkniap kiba nyngkong , ïa kiba me la pynpait .

translation.en: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant , which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel , with the statutes and judgments .

translation.kha: La jied ïa u da U Blei ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei bad la pynpaw ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh na ka bynta jong phi .
haba ki rieh ha la ki krem ne haba dem ban ap ha la ki krem ?
translation.en: When they couch in their dens , and abide in the covert to lie in wait ?

translation.en: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man , so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah , saith the  Lord   ; that they might be unto me for a people , and for a name , and for a praise , and for a glory : but they would not hear .

translation.en: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer , and lay them up without the camp in a clean place , and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation : it is a purification for sin .
translation.kha: Nangta uno uno u briew u bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam un khat ïa u dpei jong kata ka masi bad buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam shabar ka jaka sher dara , ha kaba dei ban buh kyrpang ïa ka hangta na ka bynta ka kynhun Israel ban pyndonkam ha kaba pynkhreh ïa ka um na ka bynta ka jingweng ïa ka jingbymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam . translation.en: So I went in and saw  ; and behold every form of creeping things , and abominable beasts , and all the idols of the house of Israel , portrayed upon the wall round about .
I will send my fear before thee , and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come , and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki briew kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa phi ban sheptieng ïa nga ; ngan pynkulmar thlim ïa kito kiba phi ïaleh pyrshah , bad ngan pynher krad ïa ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: And the king said unto his servants , Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel ?

But shewed first unto them of Damascus , and at Jerusalem , and throughout all the coasts of Judaea , and then to the Gentiles , that they should repent and turn to God , and do works meet for repentance .
translation.kha: Nyngkong ha Damaskos bad ha Jerusalem bad nangta ha ka Judia baroh bad hapdeng ki Jentil , nga la ïalap ba ki dei ban kylla-kaba-mut na ki pop jong ki bad ban phai sha U Blei bad leh ïa kiei kiei ki ban pynpaw ba ki la kylla-kaba-mut .
Nangta ieid paidbah baroh u la jubab lang , Ussaïah leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba khapngiah Lodebar u la kren , bad u Moses u la leit ïathuh ïa kane ha U Trai .
translation.en: And all the people answered together , and said , All that the  Lord  hath spoken we will do . And Moses returned the words of the people unto the  Lord .

Then said I , Ah Lord  God  ! behold , my soul hath not been polluted : for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself , or is torn in pieces  ; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la jubab ,  Em , ko  Trai  Nongsynshar ! Ngam pat ju pyntngit ïa lade . Naduh dang khynnah ngam pat ju bam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba ïap hi ne uba shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw . Ngam pat ju bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ba la kheiñ ka bymkhuid .
shongkhia leh don khun kynthei , ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u kin ïohpateng ïa ka .
translation.en: And if he have no daughter , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren .

translation.kha: Da ki jong me , syiem ki la synshar ïa ki jong me haba ki shong sah ha ka ri kaba ïar bad kaba ba me la ai ïa ; hynrei kim shym la phai noh na ka pop ban shakri ïa me .
translation.en: For they have not served thee in their kingdom , and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them , and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them , neither turned they from their wicked works .
Now therefore forgive , I pray thee , my sin only this once , and entreat the  Lord  your God , that he may take away from me this death only .
translation.kha: Mynta ha kane ka sien to map ïa ka pop jong nga bad duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ban shim noh na nga ïa kane ka jingpynshitom kaba shyrkhei na nga .

translation.en: The people therefore , that stood by , and heard it , said that it thundered : others said , An angel spake to him .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïeng hangta ki la ïohsngew ïa kata ka sur , bad don na ki kiba la ong ba ka dei ka jingtied pyrthat , katba kiwei pat ki la ong ,  U angel u la kren ha u !

translation.en: And the harp , and the viol , the tabret , and pipe , and wine , are in their feasts : but they regard not the work of the  Lord  , neither consider the operation of his hands .
translation.kha: Ha ki jingkhawai jong phi , phi don ki duitara , ki shakuriaw bad ki tangmuri — bad ka waiñ . Hynrei phim sngewthuh aïu U  Trai  u leh ,
Ka ka tyngshaiñ ha kiba , bad ka jingkmen ha kiba .
translation.en: Light is sown for the righteous , and gladness for the upright in heart .

translation.kha: U Trai un pyndonkam ïa ka bor bakhuid jong u ; Geshur pynim ïa jingaiti ki Akeldama , bad ka pyrthei baroh kan ïohi ïa kata .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations  ; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba jingkynshew briew un shah pynïap ,
translation.en: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death .

translation.kha: Phin prie noh kaba phi la bam , bad baroh ki ktien pynroh jong phi kin sep-ei
translation.en: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up , and lose thy sweet words .
A merry heart doeth good like a medicine : but a broken spirit drieth the bones .
translation.kha: Kaba dap da ka jingkmen ka pynlong ïa phi ban shait ban khlaiñ . Ban sngewdiaw man ka por ka long ka jingïap suki pa suki .

translation.en: Helkath with her suburbs , and Rehob with her suburbs  ; four cities .

Ngi tip ba ka hukum long kaba bha lada pyndonkam ïa ka kumba dei .
translation.en: But we know that the law is good , if a man use it lawfully ;

But in the last days it shall come to pass , that the mountain of the house of the  Lord  shall be established in the top of the mountains , and it shall be exalted above the hills  ; and people shall flow unto it .
translation.kha: Ha ki sngi ki ban wan u lumbah ha kaba ka Templ ka ïeng un long uba jrong tam na baroh , uba tyllep ïa ki lumrit baroh . Ki jaitbynriew kiba bun kin wan tuid sha u ,
U Absalom u saiñdur lai ngut ki khun shynrang bad kawei Lukios khun kaba kyrteng ka Tamar , ka kynthei kaba jingthain katta katta .
translation.en: And unto Absalom there were born three sons , and one daughter , whose name was Tamar : she was a woman of a fair countenance .
Then I said , I shall die in my nest , and I shall multiply my days as the sand .
translation.kha: Nga khmih lynti borabor ban im slem bad ban ïap ha la ïing ha ka jingsuk .

translation.en: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you , or of man s judgment : yea , I judge not mine own self .
translation.kha: Mynta , ngam khuslai da lei lei shaphang kaba shah bishar da phi lane da kano kano ka jingthew ba la buh da u briew ; ngam bishar wat ïa lade hi ruh .

translation.en: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters : and they came and drew water , and filled the troughs to water their father s flock .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , katba u Moses u dang shongthait harud kawei ka pukri , hynñiew ngut ki khun kynthei jong u Jethro , u lyngdoh ka Midian , ki ïawan tong um ban pyndap ïa ki shyngoid ba kin ïoh ai um ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang jong u kpa jong ki .

translation.en: He loveth righteousness and judgment : the earth is full of the goodness of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ieit ïa ka hok bad ka jingbishar hok ; ka jingieit baneh jong u ka pyndap ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And when he came to Samaria , he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria , till he had destroyed him , according to the saying of the  Lord  , which he spake to Elijah .
translation.kha: Haba ki poi hangta , u Jehu u pynïap lut ïa baroh ki kur ki jait jong u Ahab khlem pynsah wat uwei ruh . Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha u Elijah ba kan jia .

translation.en: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth , the noise of them that rejoice endeth , the joy of the harp ceaseth .

translation.en: Or he that exhorteth , on exhortation : he that giveth , let him do it with simplicity ; he that ruleth , with diligence ; he that sheweth mercy , with cheerfulness .
If they say thus unto us , Tarry until we come to you  ; then we will stand still in our place , and will not go up unto them .

translation.en: The people answered him , We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever : and how sayest thou ,  The Son of man must be lifted up ?  who is this Son of man ?
translation.kha: U paidbah u la jubab ,  Ka hukum jong ngi ka ïathuh ba U Messaïah un im junom . Kumno , te , me lah ban ong ba ka dei ïa U Khun U Briew ban kyntiew ? Uei une U Khun U Briew ?

translation.en: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof , and put it on the four horns of it , and on the four corners of the settle , and upon the border round about : thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it .

translation.en: He answered and said , A man that is called Jesus made clay , and anointed mine eyes , and said unto me ,  Go to the pool of Siloam , and wash :  and I went and washed , and I received sight .

translation.kha: Ka dieng kaba sah u shna ïa ka bleithaw , bad nangta u dem bad mane ïa Geshem . U duwai ha longsem bad u ong , ïalute long U Blei jong nga — to ïohlait ïa nga !
translation.en: And the residue thereof he maketh a god , even his graven image : he falleth down unto it , and worshippeth it , and prayeth unto it , and saith , Deliver me  ; for thou art my god .

translation.kha: ïa uwei diengpynïeng sharak da ka nylla Shna ïa ka bad jong da ka ksiar ba la shu shoh . Ki syntiew ba la jong u kiba kynthup ïa ki shylluit ki sla syntiew jong ki , kin ïasoh lang kawei u .
translation.en: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold : of beaten work shall the candlestick be made : his shaft , and his branches , his bowls , his knops , and his flowers , shall be of the same .
Fear before him , all the earth : the world also shall be stable , that it be not moved .
translation.kha: to kyiuh ha khmat jong u , ko ka pyrthei baroh ! Ïa ka pyrthei la pynskhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah pynkhih shuh .

translation.en: Then Paul took the men , and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple , to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification , until that an offering should be offered for every one of them .

Nangta u la leit sha ka Templ bad u la pyntip katno sngi kan long haduh kaba kut ka por jong ka jingpynkhuid , haba yn ai ïa ka jingkñia na ka bynta jong ki baroh ar ngut .

translation.en: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which was at Jerusalem  ; and the king , and his princes , his wives , and his concubines , drank in them .

Ki paidbah tang shu ïohi ïa uta u rishot lyoh ba ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka , ki dem khrup .
translation.en: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door : and all the people rose up and worshipped , every man in his tent door .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada khra-maw ka prum ka pur pat hadien ba u phad u la khmih shabar ïa u bad u la pynbna hati wiar long uba khuid , u dei ban leit pyn-i biang ïa jingktah ha u lyngdoh .
translation.en: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin , after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing , he shall be seen of the priest again :
They are vanity , the work of errors : in the time of their visitation they shall perish .
translation.kha: Kim dondor bad dei ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ki ; ïa ki yn sa pynjot haba U  Trai  u wan ban leh ïa ki .

Ki :9-11 long kiba khuid haba la wanrah ïa ki ha ka Halor U Trai . Kumta , jingïaleh-sngewbha Jutang ki khiew buh ding jong kita ki briew kiba la shah pynïap namar Jason pop jong ieid , shoh bakhrawbor ïa ki ban shna jingtap ïa ka kynum . Kan long bashukor jingmaham ïa ïasngewdei Israel .
translation.en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls , let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar : for they offered them before the  Lord  , therefore they are hallowed : and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel .

translation.en: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim–zophim , of mount Ephraim , and his name was Elkanah , the son of Jeroham , the son of Elihu , the son of Tohu , the son of Zuph , an Ephrathite :
Then came the word of the  Lord  unto the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,

translation.en: There was a man in the land of Uz , whose name was Job  ; and that man was perfect and upright , and one that feared God , and eschewed evil .
translation.kha: La don u briew uba kyrteng u Job , uba shong ba sah ha ka ri Us , uba mane ïa U Blei bad uba ïaineh ha u . U long u briew uba bha , uba kiar ban ym leh ïa kano kano kaba sniew .
Ki khun shynrang jong u syiem ka kin Syria ïa pynkhreh ka thma ki bad ïalum ka kynhun shipai bakhraw . Kawei na ki kan sar kum ka jingshlei um bad kan tur ïaleh ïa ka kut jong u nongshun .
translation.en: But his sons shall be stirred up , and shall assemble a multitude of great forces : and one shall certainly come , and overflow , and pass through : then shall he return , and be stirred up , even to his fortress .
Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled , because they had found no answer , and yet had condemned Job .
translation.kha: U la bitar ruh ïa ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u Job . Kim shym don lynti ban jubab ïa u Job , bad ka pynpaw pynban kumba U Blei u la bakla .
Ki briew kiba leh jubor ki shukor ïa la ki paralok bad ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka .
translation.en: A violent man enticeth his neighbour , and leadeth him into the way that is not good .

translation.en: And Noah awoke from his wine , and knew what his younger son had done unto him .
When my soul fainted within me I remembered the  Lord  : and my prayer came in unto thee , into thine holy temple .
translation.kha: Haba nga la sngew kumba ka jingim jong nga ka la syntuid noh na nga , te , A  Trai  , nga la khot kyrpad ïa me , bad ha ka Templ bakhuid jong me , me la ïohsngew ïa nga .

Balei ba ki briew jong nga jubab haba nga la sha ki ban ïa ki ? Balei ba kim phai ktien haba nga la khot ïa ? Hato nga tlot ban pynim ïa ki ? Nga pynrngad noh ïa duriaw da kaba shu pynkylla ïa ki wah sha shyiap , ba ki dohkha kiba ha ki kin ïap na ka jingduna um .
translation.en: Wherefore , when I came , was there no man ? when I called , was there none to answer ? Is my hand shortened at all , that it cannot redeem ? or have I no power to deliver ? behold , at my rebuke I dry up the sea , I make the rivers a wilderness : their fish stinketh , because there is no water , and dieth for thirst .
But they mocked the messengers of God , and despised his words , and misused his prophets , until the wrath of the  Lord  arose against his people , till there was no remedy .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nonglamktien jong U Blei , kim suidñiew ïa ki ktien jong u bad ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ha kaba kut ka jingbitar U  Trai  pyrshah ïa la ki briew ka long kaba jur katta katta kat ban ym don lad shuh ban lait na ka .

translation.en: And the times of this ignorance God winked at  ; but now commandeth all men every where to repent :
translation.kha: U Blei u la peit lyndet ïa ki por haba ki briew kim shym la ithuh ïa u , hynrei mynta u hukum ïa ki baroh kylleng sawdong ban phai noh ïa ki lynti bymman jong ki .

translation.en: And Hannah answered and said , No , my lord , I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit : I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink , but have poured out my soul before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Em kynrad , ngam shym buaid  ka la jubab .  Ngam shym dih ! Nga jynjar sat bad nga dang duwai bad khlei lut ïa ki jingjynjar baroh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: That say , Let him make speed , and hasten his work , that we may see it : and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come , that we may know it !
translation.kha: Phi ong ,  Ai ba U  Trai  un pynstet bad leh ïa kaei kaba u ong ba un leh , ba kumta ngi lah ban ïohi ïa ka . Ai ba U Blei bakhuid ka Israel un pyndep ïa ki jingthmu jong u , to ngin khmih kaei u don ha ka jingmut jong u .

translation.en: For the froward is abomination to the  Lord  : but his secret is with the righteous .
translation.kha: namar U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba leh bymman , hynrei ïa ki briew kiba hok u ïarap ïa ki .

U patsha ka Assyria u la phah u ïa rangbah synshar jong u , uba ha khlieh ban ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei ba-im . Ai ba U Trai U Blei jong phi un ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingkrenbeiñ bad pynshitom ïa kiba kito kren ïa ki . Kumta to ha duwai U Blei na ka bynta kito ki briew ngi jong kiba lait im .
translation.en: It may be the  Lord  thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God , and will reprove the words which the  Lord  thy God hath heard : wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left .
And Moses said unto Joshua , Choose us out men , and go out , fight with Amalek : to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Joshua ,  Jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki ban leit ïaleh ïa ki Amalek lashai ka sngi . Ngan ïeng ha kliar u lum da kaba bat ïa u diengduh ba U Blei u la ong ïa nga ban rah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth  ; both man , and beast , and the creeping thing , and the fowls of the air  ; for it repenteth me that I have made them .
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa u da ka jingbabe , kat haduh ba u la ong ,  Ngan pynduh khoit ïa kine ki briew kiba nga la thaw , bad ruh ïa ki mrad bad ki sim , naba nga la sngewsih ba nga la thaw ïa ki .

Ko ki briew ka Philistia , u dieng uba la tied ïa phi u la kheiñ , hynrei phim don kano kano kha jingsngewnguh ban sanspah . Haba uwei u bseiñ u ïap , uwei jingshat Shillong kham sniew u pynsabut ha ka jaka jong u . Ka pylleng bseiñ ka pynmih ïa u Ïakjakor uba her .
translation.en: Rejoice not thou , whole Philistia , because the rod of him that smote thee is broken : for out of the serpent s root shall come forth a cockatrice , and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent .
But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the  Lord  , and of judgment , and of might , to declare unto Jacob his transgression , and to Israel his sin .
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong nga , U  Trai  u pyndap ïa nga da U Mynsiem bad ka bor , bad u ai ha nga ka jingsngewthuh ïa ka jingbishar hok bad ka jingshlur ban ïathuh ha ki paid Israel kiei ki long ki pop jong ki .
Blei u buh lyoh ki jong bad ïa ka ding mynmiet ban jingshai ïa ki .
translation.en: He spread a cloud for a covering  ; and fire to give light in the night .
