translation.en: Behold , my terror shall not make thee afraid , neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee .
And the kings of the earth , who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her , shall bewail her , and lament for her , when they shall see the smoke of her burning ,
translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei kiba la ïashim bynta ha ka jingawria bad ka jingkwah brai jong ka kin lynñiar bad ïam na ka bynta ka nongbah haba ki ïohi ïa ka tdem na ki thylliej ding kiba bam duh ïa ka .

translation.en: Art not thou our God , who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel , and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever ?
translation.kha: Me long U Blei jong ngi . Mynba u paid Israel jong me u wan sha kane ka ri , me beh krad ïa ki briew kiba shong hangne bad me ai ïa ka ri ha ki khun ki ksiew u Abraham , u paralok jong me , ban long ka jong ki junom .

translation.en: Mine age is departed , and is removed from me as a shepherd s tent : I have cut off like a weaver my life : he will cut me off with pining sickness : from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingim jong nga la ot noh bad ka la kut , kum ka ïingjaiñ ba la pynkhyllem , kum ka jaiñ ba la khapnoh na ka kor thain jaiñ . Nga pyrkhat ba U Blei u la pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga .

translation.en: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law , Go , return each to her mother s house : the  Lord  deal kindly with you , as ye have dealt with the dead , and with me .
translation.kha: Khie leit phai noh sha ïing bad sah bad la ki kmie . Ai ba U  Trai  un lehbha ïa phi kumba phi la leh ïa nga bad ïa kito kiba la ïap .

translation.en: But if ye shall at all turn from following me , ye or your children , and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you , but go and serve other gods , and worship them :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ma me lane ki khun ki ksiew jong me phi phai dien noh na nga , bad phim kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi , hynrei phi leit mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,
Ngi la ïadon Naphtuh arspah hynñiewphew hynriew ngut ha ka lieng Sawphew
translation.en: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls .
I am my beloved s , and his desire is toward me .
translation.kha: Kaei kane kaba ka jingkhmih jong ka , ka long kum ka step ? Ka long kaba bhabriew bad kaba phyrnai , ka jingphyrnai kum ka sngi ne u bnai .
Kumta ki rangbah jong u Joab , ki nongïada ïa syiem u , bad kiwei pat shipai ki ki la mihnoh na Jerusalem bad u Abishai ban leit thwet ïa u Sheba .
translation.en: And there went out after him Joab s men , and the Cherethites , and the Pelethites , and all the mighty men : and they went out of Jerusalem , to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri .

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap Saul , u wan na ka jingjop jong u ïa ki Amalek bad u sah sngi ha Siklag .
translation.en: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul , when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites , and David had abode two days in Ziklag  ;
And I will bring you out of the midst thereof , and deliver you into the hands of strangers , and will execute judgments among you .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi shabar ka nongbah bad ngan aiti ïa phi ha ki nongwei . Nga la rai ïa phi ban ïap ,
U Trai kylla u noh la ka jingmut bad u ong , Kaei kaba phi la ïohi kan ym jia .
translation.en: The  Lord  repented for this : It shall not be , saith the  Lord .

The king said moreover to Shimei , Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to , that thou didst to David my father : therefore the  Lord  shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head  ;
translation.kha: Me tip biang biang ïa ka jingleh bakla baroh kaba me la leh ïa u Dabid u kpa jong nga . U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa me namar kata .
Kane ka dei kaei ka ban jia ha baroh ki jaitbynriew pyrthei . Kan long kum ka jingkut jong ka , haba ïa ki soh Olib dep tied pynhap na uwei pa uwei u dieng bad ba ïa ki sohwaiñ la kheit na ki dieng .
translation.en: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people , there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree , and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done .

translation.kha: rukom ka sien kaba ar U nongïatrei u la ong traishnong u , Ko Simon , u khun jong u Jona , me ieit ïa nga nongsngap Ho-oid , ko Trai , u la jubab , me tip ba nga ieit ïa me . U Jisu u la ong ha jingkharoi , To Suh ïa ki langbrot jong nga 29-35
translation.en: He saith to him again the second time ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me ?  He saith unto him , Yea , Lord  ; thou knowest that I love thee . He saith unto him ,  Feed my sheep .
After that , he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once ; of whom the greater part remain unto this present , but some are fallen asleep .
translation.kha: Nangta u la paw ha palat sanspah ngut ki nongbud jong u ha kajuh ka por , kiba kham bun na ki , ki dang im , wat la katto katne ngut ki la ïap .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Return to thy mistress , and submit thyself under her hands .
translation.kha: U ong ha ka ,  Khie leit phai pat sha la ka kynrad , bad long ka mraw jong ka .
Nangta , u syiem u bathymmai bymtip ei ei shaphang u Joseph , u la synshar ha Ijipt .
translation.en: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt , which knew not Joseph .

translation.kha: naki U Trai yn ym ïaroh da kiba ïap rue da kino kino kiba leit hiar Boskath ka ri ka jingsngap jar .
translation.en: The dead praise not the  Lord  , neither any that go down into silence .

translation.kha: Don tang uwei Regemmelekh Trai , kawei ka Siklag , Jahmai ka jingpynbaptis ;
translation.en: One Lord , one faith , one baptism ,
Ye have not gone up into the gaps , neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kim sumar ïa ki jaka ha kaba ki kynroh ki la khyllem , lymne ba ki tei pat ïa ki kynroh , bad kumta ym lah ban ïada ïa ka Israel haba wan ka thma ha ka sngi ka jong U  Trai .

U la hukum ruh ïa u shakri uba ha khmat eh , Philetos u Iso u hynmen jong nga u ïakynduh ïa ïap-tyrsaw , bad u kylli , ‘ Uei u kynrad jong me pathaw Shano men leit Ramath Uei u jait jong kine ki jingri kiba ha khmat jong me ?’
translation.en: And he commanded the foremost , saying , When Esau my brother meeteth thee , and asketh thee , saying , Whose art thou ? and whither goest thou ? and whose are these before thee ?

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la lah ong ïa kane , u la da ka sur jam , Ko , to mihnoh !
translation.en: And when he thus had spoken , he cried with a loud voice ,  Lazarus , come forth .

translation.kha: Hato tip ba ngin sa bishar ïa ki angel Katno tam , te , ïa kiei kiei jong kane ka jingim !
translation.en: Know ye not that we shall judge angels ? how much more things that pertain to this life ?

translation.kha: Ki kin briew kyllon kum ki kyrtong masi khlaw bad ki masi lyngraw , bad ka khyndew kan saw da ka snam bad yn tap da ka khleiñ .
translation.en: And the unicorns shall come down with them , and the bullocks with the bulls  ; and their land shall be soaked with blood , and their dust made fat with fatness .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Heshbon bad ka Elealeh ki kyang jam , bad Ussi ka jingsngur jong ki lah ban ïohsngew kat shaduh Jahas pynpoi Naarah ki Shebna ki thum ; ka jingshlur pynliem ki ka duh noh ïakheiñ
translation.en: And Heshbon shall cry , and Elealeh : their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz : therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out  ; his life shall be grievous unto him .

translation.kha: Hadien ar sngi , u bad Dabid ki jong briew u ki wan poi pat ha Siklag . Ki Amalek ki la lute ïa ka Judah ri kaba shathie bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Siklag . Ki la thang ïa ka shnong
translation.en: And it came to pass , when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day , that the Amalekites had invaded the south , and Ziklag , and smitten Ziklag , and burned it with fire  ;

translation.kha: Kiei Kiei Ki Jingkylli ?
translation.en: What were the questions ?

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por ka Naomi ka ong ha ka Nga ban shem u tnga na ka bynta jong phi , khnang ba phin don la ka jong ka longïing .
translation.en: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her , My daughter , shall I not seek rest for thee , that it may be well with thee ?

translation.kha: Ki briew lamwir ka Heshbon bad ka Kynthei Demetrios kyang , bad ïa ka sawspah jong ki lah ban ïohsngew shaduh sha masi ; lah ban ïohsngew da ki briew ha pynhieng , bad la ïohsngew shaduh sha Horonaim bad sha Pyntngit sumar . Wat ka wahduid man ka la rngad noh .
translation.en: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh , and even unto Jahaz , have they uttered their voice , from Zoar even unto Horonaim , as an heifer of three years old : for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate .
And all the prophets prophesied so , saying , Go up to Ramoth–gilead , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the king s hand .
translation.kha: Baroh na kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa kajuh .  Leit kiew pyrshah ïa ka Ramoth , bad phin jop ,  ki ong .  U  Trai  un ai ha phi ka jingjop .
Naba u la ong ha u Moses , Ngan leh-isynei ha uno uno uba nga ; kwah ngan sngewsynei ïa uno uno uba nga kwah .
translation.en: For he saith to Moses , I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy , and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion .
Now because we have maintenance from the king s palace , and it was not meet for us to see the king s dishonour , therefore have we sent and certified the king  ;
translation.kha: Mynta , namar ba ngi don hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong phi , ko syiem , ngim kwah ban ïohi ïa kane ba kan jia , bad kumta ngi ai jingmut

translation.en: And they said , We cannot , until all the flocks be gathered together , and till they roll the stone from the well s mouth  ; then we water the sheep .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Ngim lah ban leh kumta tad haduh ba ki kynhun langbrot baroh kin don hangne bad ba ym pat pyntyllun sharud ïa u maw ; nangta ngin sa ai um ïa ki langbrot .
Kumta te ki dieng ki ong ha u dieng sohwaiñ , ‘ Ale wan bad long u jong syiem ngi .’
translation.en: Then said the trees unto the vine , Come thou , and reign over us .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la bteng ban ong , pyndam don shisien uwei u briew uba Jingsuk jingjot ar ngut ki khun shynrang .
translation.en: And he said ,  A certain man had two sons :

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Omri u la leh baroh ki jingjop jong la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Israel
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did , and his might that he shewed , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
But the word is very nigh unto thee , in thy mouth , and in thy heart , that thou mayest do it .
translation.kha: Em , ka don hangne bad phi . Phi tip ïa ka bad phi lah ban sot ïa ka ; kumta mynta , kohnguh ïa ka .

translation.en: Then Zedekiah the king sent , and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of the  Lord  : and the king said unto Jeremiah , I will ask thee a thing  ; hide nothing from me .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka por u syiem Sedekaïah u la phah wallam ïa nga sha u ha ka khyrdop kaba lai sha ka Templ , bad u la ong ,  Ngan kylli ïa phi ka jingkylli , bad nga kwah ba phin ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingshisha baroh .
haba Bad phi ïeng bad duwai , to map kaei ïa kaei kaba phi lah ban don pyrshah ïano ïano , khnang U ba Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un map ïa ki jingleh bymdei kiba phi la leh .
translation.en: And when ye stand praying , forgive , if ye have ought against any : that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses .
I , even I , am he that comforteth you : who art thou , that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die , and of the son of man which shall be made as grass  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga long uta uba pynkhlaiñ ïa phi . Balei phin sheptieng ïa u briew u bym im junom , u bym kham neh ban ïa u phlang ?
Ha kata ka por Hima ka jong u Blei kan pynïoh pat ka jingsuk kaba ïadei bad kato kaba don ka ha Kper Eden hapdeng ki mrad , bad hapdeng ki mrad bad ki briew .
translation.en: In time , God’s Kingdom will even restore the peaceful relations that existed in the garden of Eden between animals , and between animals and humans .

translation.kha: Te kyiad une u briew u don u khun uba pynkordit bad uba ba , uba leh ïa kawei na kine kiei kiei kiba u kpa jong u um ju leh .
translation.en: If he beget a son that is a robber , a shedder of blood , and that doeth the like to any one of these things ,

translation.kha: Mano ba bsa ïa ki tyngab haba ki sakma haba thngan , ki haba khun jong rit ki , ki kyang sha nga ban ïoh jingbam ?
translation.en: Who provideth for the raven his food ? when his young ones cry unto God , they wander for lack of meat .
And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers , and stood and confessed their sins , and the iniquities of their fathers .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong ujuh u bnai , ki Israel ki ïalumlang ban shahjingit ban pynpaw ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki pop jong ki . Ki la lah pynïakhlad ïa lade na ki nongwei baroh . Ki phong ki jaiñ khain bad sleh pui pui ha ki khlieh jong ki kum ka dak jong ka jingsngewsih . Nangta ki ïeng bad sdang ban phla ïa ki pop kiba ma ki bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la leh .
Ïano ba me pyrkhat ba me la ñiewbeiñ bad rkhiebeiñ ? Me la long khlem burom ïa , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel .
translation.en: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed ? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice , and lifted up thine eyes on high ? even against the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: sahmiet ki la ïakynting sbai ban jied napdeng ki ar jingshonshab jingpynlehnoh-ei rangbah Baalis bad uta uba la Kiriath u la long bynshet Matthias , ïa uba be-ijot pynïasoh sha ka kynhun ki khatwei phria ki apostol Jakarieh
translation.en: And they gave forth their lots  ; and the lot fell upon Matthias  ; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles .

translation.kha: Ka long hangta ba imat ïohi ïa sohshnong jingstad bad u tynjuh ïa ka dor jong ka — U ai ïa ka Pynïoh ka jingmynjur jong u .
translation.en: Then did he see it , and declare it  ; he prepared it , yea , and searched it out .
Now it came to pass , when they spake daily unto him , and he hearkened not unto them , that they told Haman , to see whether Mordecai s matters would stand : for he had told them that he was a Jew .
translation.kha: man ka sngi ki kyntu ïa u ban pyndem , hynrei um sngap ïa ki .  Nga dei u Jiw ,  u batai ,  bad ngam lah ban dem ha u Haman .  Kumta ki ïathuh ïa kane ha u Haman , bad ki pyrkhat la un lah ban shah ïa kane ka jingleh u Mordekai .
Syndong Abdon Jehoshaphat .—Eklesiastis shna ba-itriem ki liengbah ban ïaid ha duriaw sha ka ri Ophir ban wad ksiar ; hynrei ki la paitlieng ha Esiongeber bad kim shym lah ïaid Khuid .
translation.en: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold : but they went not  ; for the ships were broken at Ezion–geber .
Then they cried unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he saved them out of their distresses .
translation.kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pynim ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .

Phim tip seh ïa ka jaka , ko kaba Elead tam napdeng ki kynthei ? Khie leit Kiba jingshlei ïa ka kynhun langbrot ; pyntlot wad ïa ki pyntha phlang na ka Kiwei ki blang pynsngewtynnat phi hajan ki ïingjaiñ jong ki nongap langbrot .
translation.en: The voice of my beloved ! behold , he cometh leaping upon the mountains , skipping upon the hills .
The king of Madon , one  ; the king of Hazor , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Madon , ka Hasor ,
Hynrei U khun jong u , uba na ka kynthei mraw la kha katba kum ka rukom briew ; hynrei ïa u khun jong u na ka kaba kynthei laitluid la kha ha jingkular ka U Blei .
translation.en: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh ; but he of the freewoman was by promise .

And the children of Israel said , Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the  Lord  ? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the  Lord  to Mizpah , saying , He shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Ki kylli ,  Hato don ka kynhun na ki jait Israel baroh ka bym shym la leit sha ka jingïalumlang ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ha Mispah ?  ( Ki la shim ïa ka jingsmai bakyntang ba uno uno u bym shym la leit sha Mispah un shah pynïap . )
U Jisu u la ong ha , Haba phi , to ong kane ‘ Ko Kpa : ba ka kyrteng jong me long kaba la pyndonburom ; ai ban wan ka Hima jong me .
translation.en: And he said unto them , When ye pray , say ,  Our Father which art in heaven , Hallowed be thy name . Thy kingdom come . Thy will be done , as in heaven , so in earth .

translation.kha: 20 Lano ka Paradais Kan ?
translation.en: 20 When Will Paradise Come ?

translation.kha: Me la ka bor u kpa jong nga ba un pynkha ïa nga , la pynlong ïa nga ban san ha ka kpoh ka kmie jong nga .
translation.en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk , and curdled me like cheese ?

translation.kha: U Trai tei u pat ïa ka Jerusalem ; u wallam pat ïa kiba la shah ringmraw .
translation.en: The  Lord  doth build up Jerusalem : he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel .

translation.kha: Bad phi lah ban sngewthikna ba lada trai u u ïing la tip ïa ka por haba u nongtuh un wan , un ym shah ïa u nongtuh ban prong shapoh ka ïing jong u .
translation.en: And this know , that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come , he would have watched , and not have suffered his house to be broken through .
Who maketh his angels spirits  ; his ministers a flaming fire :
translation.kha: Me pyndonkam ïa ki lyer kum ki nonglamktien jong me bad ki jingthaba leilieh kum ki shakri jong me .
Ki lyngkha ba sah shrah ki lah ban pynmih shibun ka jingbam ïa kiba duk , sarew ki bymhok kin niam ieh ïa kine khlem rep .
translation.en: Much food is in the tillage of the poor : but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment .

translation.kha: Katba ki thylliej ding ki dang kiew shajrong na ka duwan , u Manoah bad ka tnga u jong ïohi ki ïa u angel U Trai ba u kiew sha bneng ha ki thylliej ding U . Manoah hangta u sngewthuh ba uta u briew u dei u angel jong U Trai , bad ma u lem bad ka jong tnga ki u dem khrup ha khyndew . Kim shym ïohi shuh ïa u angel .
translation.en: But the angel of the  Lord  did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife . Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki wait Bera jong phi yn ai noh kum Jer mraw ha ki nongwei katba phi pat raïot jingawria peit jingpalat Man ka sngi phin pynshitom sat kner la jingjubab khmat ba mawlynnai ap lehnoh-ei ïa jingbymïaid ki khun 7 kin wan kynrei pat .
translation.en: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people , and thine eyes shall look , and fail with longing for them all the day long : and there shall be no might in thine hand .
Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands , which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay , and brake them to pieces .
translation.kha: Katba phi dang khmih ïa ka , u maw uba khraw u la lait na ka synrang khlem don mano mano ba ktah ïa u , u la shoh ïa ka kjat nar bad dewbyrtha jong ka durbriew , bad u la pynkhynñiuh ïa ki .

translation.en: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers : now the magicians of Egypt , they also did in like manner with their enchantments .
translation.kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u phah khot ïa ki riewstad bad ïa ki nongleh myntor jong u , bad ki ruh ki leh kumjuh da ka myntor jong ki .

translation.en: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me ; but I went into Arabia , and returned again unto Damascus .
translation.kha: lane ngam shym la leit sha Jerusalem ban ïakynduh ïa kito kiba long ki apostol shuwa jong nga . Pynban shisyndon nga la leit sha Arabia , nangta nga la wan phai pat sha Damaskos .

translation.en: Yea , thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea , or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast .
translation.kha: Phin sngew kumba phi don halor ka duriaw-bah , phi ïohpang duriaw , shah pynshad kynting shajrong ha ka jingshah pynkhih ka liengbah .
( Ha kaba ong kumne , U Jisu u la kdew kaba u kumno Petros un ïap bad ïa pyndonburom U Blei . ) Te U Jisu u la ong ha u , To bud ïa nga !
translation.en: This spake he , signifying by what death he should glorify God . And when he had spoken this , he saith unto him ,  Follow me .

translation.kha: Kumta baroh ki nongïalam ïashukor ki Israel ki la Haram sha u Syiem Dabid ha Hebron . U la pynlong ïa jingïateh khim bakyntang bad ki , Tim jingieid pynsleh Rat Jerusalem dait bad u la kadiang u syiem ki shipor .
translation.en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron  ; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the  Lord  : and they anointed David king over Israel .

translation.kha: Syiem Amasaïah u pynbeit ïa ki rangbah jong ki jait Judah bad Benjamin ha ki kynhun shipai , kat kum ki kur ki , bad u la buh ki rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka jingai hukum ïa ki kiba ngut bad ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut . Kane kynthup ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba snem ne kham ïaw , baroh ki long lai lakh ngut . Ki long ki ba la jied , kiba la kloi ban ïaleh thma kiba tbit ban ki .
translation.en: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together , and made them captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , according to the houses of their fathers , throughout all Judah and Benjamin : and he numbered them from twenty years old and above , and found them three hundred thousand choice men , able to go forth to war , that could handle spear and shield .
We are of God : he that knoweth God heareth us  ; he that is not of God heareth not us . Hereby know we the spirit of truth , and the spirit of error .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi , ngi long ki jong U Blei . Uno uno uba ithuh ïa U Blei , u shahshkor ïa ngi ; uno uno u bym long u jong U Blei , um shahshkor ïa ngi . Kane te , ka long kumno ngi lah ban ïathuh ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng U Mynsiem ka jingshisha bad u mynsiem ka jinglamler .

translation.en: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted , and shall kill you : and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name s sake .
translation.kha: Nangta ïa phi yn kem bad yn aiti ban shah pynshitom bad ban shah pynïap . Ki jaitbynriew baroh kin isih ïa phi namar jong nga .
Shisyndon U Mynsiem la pynlong ïa u ban leit sha ka ri shyiap ,
translation.en: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Pilat u la kylli ïa u paidbah , Uno na kine ar ba ngut phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka jong bynta phi ? Ïa u Barabbas ! ki la jubab .
translation.en: The governor answered and said unto them , Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you ? They said , Barabbas .

translation.kha: Balei ba me la ïa ngi slem katta katta ? Hato men dang kynmaw biang ïa ngi ?
translation.en: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever , and forsake us so long time ?

translation.kha: Ka jingpang Adadah kan hap halor ki kulai , ki khashor , ki ut , bad paramarjan kada — halor ki mrad baroh ha ki jaka sher dara jong u nongshun .
translation.en: And so shall be the plague of the horse , of the mule , of the camel , and of the ass , and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents , as this plague .

translation.kha: Nga dei ban sngewsarong , Meronoth Gehasi kam wanrah jingbha pynslem ei . pynsuki ngan kren mynta shaphang ki jingïohipaw bad kpoh jingpynpaw ba la ai ha nga da U Trai .
translation.en: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory . I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kito kiba don ha ïingbyndi Ebeneser Hahiroth kumba phi don ba-ïashun bad ki ha kada . Kynmaw ïa kito kiba shahshitom , la kumba phi ruh phi shahshitom kum ma ki .
translation.en: Remember them that are in bonds , as bound with them  ; and them which suffer adversity , as being yourselves also in the body .

translation.kha: Baroh ki dieng kin tip ba nga long U Trai . Nga khet ïa ki dieng bajrong bad nga pynlong ïa ki dieng rit ban san jrong . Nga pynïap stai ïa ki dieng bajyrngam bad ïa pynlong ki ba-tyrkhong dieng ban kylla jyrngam . Ma nga , U , Trai nga la kren . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong la ngan ba leh .
translation.en: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the  Lord  have brought down the high tree , have exalted the low tree , have dried up the green tree , and have made the dry tree to flourish : I the  Lord  have spoken and have done it .
O Israel , thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah : there they stood : the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Ki paid Israel kim shym la sangeh ban leh pop pyrshah ïa nga naduh ka por ba ki leh pop ha Gibeah . Kumta ha Gibeah ka thma kan lap ïa ki .

translation.en: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you , and ye need not that any man teach you : but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things , and is truth , and is no lie , and even as it hath taught you , ye shall abide in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong phi , U Khrist u la theh noh ïa la U Mynsiem ha phi . Katba U Mynsiem jong u , u dang ïaisah ha phi , phim donkam ïano ïano ban hikai ïa phi . Naba U Mynsiem jong u , un hikai ïa phi shaphang kiei kiei baroh , bad kaei kaba u hikai ka long kaba shisha , ym kaba lamler . Namarkata , to kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai U Mynsiem bad ïaisah ha U Khrist .

translation.en: Make a chain : for the land is full of bloody crimes , and the city is full of violence .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei baroh ki kulmar lut — ka ri ka kynrei da ki jingïa-pynïap bad ki nongbah ki shlei da ka jingleh thombor .

translation.en: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass , and the earth that is under thee shall be iron .
translation.kha: U slap un ym hap , bad ka khyndew kan kylla eh kum u nar .

translation.en: Fear not , O land  ; be glad and rejoice : for the  Lord  will do great things .
translation.kha: Ko ki lyngkha , wat sheptieng , hynrei to risa bad lehkmen namar baroh kaba U  Trai  u la leh ïa phi .

translation.en: And to carry the silver and gold , which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel , whose habitation is in Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: Men rah bad me ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa na ka bynta ki jingainguh , ïa kiba ma nga bad ki nongai jingmut jong nga , ngi kwah ban ai sha U Blei ki Israel , uba ka Templ jong u ka don ha Jerusalem .
Hynrei namar ba pha long kaba blem bym shit lymne , ngan prie noh ïa pha na ka jong !
translation.en: So then because thou art lukewarm , and neither cold nor hot , I will spue thee out of my mouth .

Tarry this night , and it shall be in the morning , that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman , well  ; let him do the kinsman s part : but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee , then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee , as the  Lord  liveth : lie down until the morning .
translation.kha: Sah hangne baroh shi miet , bad ha ka por mynstep ngin sa wad la un shim jingkitkhlieh ne em na ka bynta jong phi . Lada ka long kumta , ka la bha ; lada kam long kumta , te nga smai ha U  Trai  Uba im ba ngan shim ïa ka jingkitkhlieh . Mynta to thiah bad sah hangne haduh mynstep .
Dei u Jotham uba tei ïa ka Khyrdop kaba shaneng jong ka Templ , bad u la tei pynheh shuh ïa ka shuh kynroh ka nongbah hapoh ka jaka jong ka Jerusalem ba la khot ka Ophel .
translation.en: He built the high gate of the house of the  Lord  , and on the wall of Ophel he built much .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u , Uei uba ai ha u briew ïa pateng riewsniew khrum Uei uba pynlong ïa u uba kyllut ne u bymnang kren ? .—Jenesis uba ai ha u ïa ka jingïohi ne pynlong ïa bneng , uba matlah ong Dei ma nga , U Trai .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Who hath made man s mouth ? or who maketh the dumb , or deaf , or the seeing , or the blind ? have not I the  Lord  ?

translation.kha: khnap la patrong sha uwei na kito kiba ïeng hangta bad nga la ïohphet na u ban batai ïa jingkñia baroh . Put u la ïathuh trait nga Dalmanutha jingkhynwin jingmut jinglehbor
translation.en: I came near unto one of them that stood by , and asked him the truth of all this . So he told me , and made me know the interpretation of the things .
Why shouldest thou be as a man astonished , as a mighty man that cannot save ? yet thou , O  Lord  , art in the midst of us , and we are called by thy name  ; leave us not .
translation.kha: Balei me long kum u briew uba la shah shim kynsan , kum u shipai u bymdonbor ban ïarap ? Da shisha , A  Trai  , me long bad ngi ! ngi long ki briew jong me ; wat iehnoh ïa ngi .’

translation.en: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah , and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication , and compelled Judah thereto .
translation.kha: U la tei wat ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ha ki ri lum Judia bad u ïalam ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

bad ngi la lynñiar sha U Trai ban ïoh jingïarap . U la ïohsngew ïa jinglynñiar ka jong ngi bad u phah la ïa u angel , uba la ïalam noh ïa ngi na Ijipt . Mynta ngi don ha Kadesh , ka shnong kaba ha ka khappud hima jong phi .
translation.en: And when we cried unto the  Lord  , he heard our voice , and sent an angel , and hath brought us forth out of Egypt : and , behold , we are in Kadesh , a city in the uttermost of thy border :
Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed : howl for her  ; take balm for her pain , if so be she may be healed .
translation.kha: Ka Babilonia kynsan kynsan ka kyllon bad la pynjot noh ! To ïam namar jong ka ! Pynïoh dawai na ka bynta ki jingmong jong ka , bad lehse yn lah ban pynkhiah .

translation.en: The heaven , even the heavens , are the  Lord s  : but the earth hath he given to the children of men .
translation.kha: Ka bneng ka long ka jong U  Trai  hi , hynrei u ai ïa ka pyrthei ha u bynriew .

translation.en: And the men of Ephraim said unto him , Why hast thou served us thus , that thou calledst us not , when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites ? And they did chide with him sharply .
translation.kha: Nangta ki paid Ephraim ki ong ha u Gideon ,  Balei phim shym khot ïa ngi haba phi la leit ban ïaleh ïa ki Midian ? Balei phi leh kumne ïa ngi ?  Ki la khñium tyngeh shaphang kane .
Ym don kaei kaei ïa kaba lah ban buhrieh na U Blei ; kiei kiei don ha ki baroh la pynpaw bad pyn-i shynna ha ki khmat jong . ka sha u ba ngi dei ban ai jingkheiñ ïa .
translation.en: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight : but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai , nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa kaei ba ngan ïa leh kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ngam phah shym hynrei kiba kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad ong ba ka bad thma ka jingïapthngan kin ym lynshop ïa kane ka ri — pynïap ngan ïa ki ha ka thma bad da ka jingïapthngan .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name , and I sent them not , yet they say , Sword and famine shall not be in this land  ; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed .

translation.kha: kiba ïa jaiñ linen kin don ka jingduh jingkyrmen ;
translation.en: Moreover they that work in fine flax , and they that weave networks , shall be confounded .

translation.kha: U Laban u leit shapoh rung ka ïingjaiñ jong u Jakob , nangta u leit sha ïingjaiñ jong ka Leah , sha bad ka ïingjaiñ jong kita ki ar ngut ki mraw kynthei , hynrei um shym lap ïa blei ki jong u . Nangta u leit rung sa ha ka jong ïingjaiñ ka Rakhel .
translation.en: And Laban went into Jacob s tent , and into Leah s tent , and into the two maidservants  tents  ; but he found them not . Then went he out of Leah s tent , and entered into Rachel s tent .
And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation  ; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you  ;
translation.kha: To khmih ïa ka jingïaishah slem U Trai jong ngi kum ka lad ba u ai ha phi ban ïoh im , kumba u Paul u para ba-ieit jong ngi u la thoh ha phi , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingstad kaba U Blei u la ai ha u .

Nga ngam lah ban leh ei ei Mesha la ka jong ka bor ; nga bishar tang kat kaba bahynriew Blei ph ong ïa nga , pynlut ka jingbishar ïaring nga ka long khlieh hok , namar ba ngam pyrshang ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga mon , hynrei ïa kaei kaba uta uba la phah ïa nga u mon .
translation.en: I can of mine own self do nothing : as I hear , I judge : and my judgment is just  ; because I seek not mine own will , but the will of the Father which hath sent me .
There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God .
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka long , ka dang ïaisah hi ka jingjahthait ïa ki briew jong U Blei kumba U Blei u shongthait ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew .

Ki nongïathuhlypa kim kren ei ei hynrei tang ki jinglamler ; ki Dieng ki synshar tang kumba hukum ki nongïathuhlypa Esiongeber bad ki briew Pisidia nga kim shym pynpaw jingpyrshah ei ei . Hynrei kin leh banep haba baroh ka tapmoh sha kaba kut ?
translation.en: The prophets prophesy falsely , and the priests bear rule by their means  ; and my people love to have it so : and what will ye do in the end thereof ?
And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison , whom they had desired  ; but he delivered Jesus to their will .
translation.kha: U la pyllait noh ïa u briew uba ki la kwah , uta uba la shah set byndi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin bad ka jingpynïap briew , bad u la aiti ïa U Jisu ha ki ban leh kumba ki la kwah .

translation.en: Then said the king s servants that ministered unto him , Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king :
translation.kha: Kumta katto katne ngut na ki nongai jingmut u syiem kiba ïajan bad u ki ai jingmut ,  Balei phim pynlong ka jingwad ban shem katto katne ki theisotti ba-bhabriew ?

translation.en: Out of that land went forth Asshur , and builded Nineveh , and the city Rehoboth , and Calah ,
translation.kha: Na kata ka ri u leit sa sha Assyria , bad u tei hangta ïa ki nongbah ka Ninebeh , ka Rehoboth Ir , ka Kalah ,
Hynrei u Dabid u ong , Phim dei pynmynsaw u . Trai un pynshitom shisha ïa uta uba pynmynsaw ïa syiem ba la jong .
translation.en: And David said to Abishai , Destroy him not : for who can stretch forth his hand against the  Lord s  anointed , and be guiltless ?

translation.kha: te ïa ka jong kyrteng me ïai yn kynmaw ha ka templ jong nga bad hapdeng ki briew jong nga kham slem ban ïa kaba me don ki khun shynrang bad ki kynthei khun . Yn ym klet ïa me lano lano ruh .
translation.en: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters : I will give them an everlasting name , that shall not be cut off .

And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not  ; I will lead them in paths that they have not known : I will make darkness light before them , and crooked things straight . These things will I do unto them , and not forsake them .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa ki briew bamatlah jong nga na ki lynti kiba kim pat ju ïaid . Ngan pynkylla ïa ka jingdum jong ki sha ka jingshai bad pynlong ïa ki jaka khohruh khohram kiba jem ha khmat jong ki . Kine ki long ki jingkular jong nga , bad ngan batskhem ïa ki .

translation.en: And the king said unto her , What aileth thee ? And she answered , This woman said unto me , Give thy son , that we may eat him to day , and we will eat my son to morrow .
translation.kha: Kaei ka jynjar jong pha ?  Ka jubab ,  Ha kato ka sngi , kane ka briew hangne ka ai jingmut ba ngin ïabam ïa u khun jong nga , bad ban bam ïa u khun jong ka ha ka sngi kaba bud .

translation.en: Jesus answered them and said ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Ye seek me , not because ye saw the miracles , but because ye did eat of the loaves , and were filled .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phi ïawad ïa nga namar ba phi la bam ïa u kpu bad phi la ïoh baroh kaba phi kwah , ym namar ba phi la sngewthuh shai ïa ki kambah jong nga .

translation.en: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull , which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha :
translation.kha: U la mihnoh , u da bah ïa la ka diengphna , bad u la wan poi sha ka jaka ba la khot  Ka jaka Maloi Khlieh  , kumba la khot ïa ka . ( Ha ka ktien Hebru la khot  Golgotha  ) .
Na ka bynta jong me , ko khun jong nga , to long khlaiñ da ka jingaiei dei kaba ka jong ngi U ha Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: Thou therefore , my son , be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus .
Dan shall be a serpent by the way , an adder in the path , that biteth the horse heels , so that his rider shall fall backward .
translation.kha: U Dan un long kum u bseiñ harud lynti bah , Bad kum u  seiñpuh harud lynti , Uba puh na ka khongdong jat jong u kulai Khnang ba u nongshong un shah bret shadien .

Lada U Blei jong ki kpa jong nga , U kuratia jingdam u Abraham bad u Isaak um shym la don ryngkat bad nga , phin Body da la phah thylli ing nga . Hynrei U Blei u la ïohi ïa ka khadu jong nga bad ïa ka jingtrei Seku nga la pyntlot , bad hynne mynmiet u la ai mynhynne ka jingbishar sopti-lor u .
translation.en: Except the God of my father , the God of Abraham , and the fear of Isaac , had been with me , surely thou hadst sent me away now empty . God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands , and rebuked thee yesternight .
And the men of Israel , beside Benjamin , were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword : all these were men of war .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki jait Israel ki ïalumlang saw lakh ngut ki shipai kiba tbit bha .
Hynrei mynta , to sheptieng ka waitlam — ka waitlam kaba ïa ka jingbitar U ka pop , khnang ba phin tip don uwei uba bishar .
translation.en: Be ye afraid of the sword : for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword , that ye may know there is a judgment .
He came unto his own , and his own received him not .
translation.kha: U la wan sha la ka jong ka ri , hynrei ki briew jong u hi kim shym la pdiang ïa u .
Kumno u ban kren kumne ? Kane ka dei jingkrenbeiñ ! Dei tang hi marwei uba lah ban ïa ki pop !
translation.en: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies ? who can forgive sins but God only ?

translation.kha: Ki jong u briew ki long kum ka ha ka pukri kaba jylliew , hynrei uba jingïohi jngai lah ban tong noh ïa shabar .
translation.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water  ; but a man of understanding will draw it out .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Nga long uta uba Lystra ïa phi . Balei phin sheptieng ïa u briew u bym im junom , u bym kham neh ban ïa u phlang ?
translation.en: I , even I , am he that comforteth you : who art thou , that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die , and of the son of man which shall be made as grass  ;

And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the even : and it shall be unto the children of Israel , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them , for a statute for ever .
translation.kha: Uta uba khat ïa u dpei u dei ban da sait ïa la ki jaiñ , hynrei u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet . Kane ka rukom pynïaid ryntih ka long kaba dei ha ki por ki ban wan baroh na ka bynta ki Israel bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong ki .
pynshohbieit syiem u kyntait Eldad ka jingai jingmut ki riewrangbah bad Madmannah jingsakhi tohmet ïa Noadaïah ki briew , kumba la ai jingmut kita ishongkun samla .
translation.en: And the king answered the people roughly , and forsook the old men s counsel that they gave him  ;

translation.kha: Ka Rakhel ka ong ha u la kpa , Wat bitar ïa nga , kynrad ko , hynrei ngam lah ban ïeng ha khmat jong phi , nga dang poi bnai . U Laban la u wad , hynrei um shym la shem satia ïa kita ki blei ïing jong u .
translation.en: And she said to her father , Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee  ; for the custom of women is upon me . And he searched , but found not the images .
And slew famous kings : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: u la pynïap ïa ki syiem kiba pawnam ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
aiti ha phi ïa ki syiem jong ki . Phin pynïap ïa ki , bad yn klet ïa ki . Yn ym don mano ban khang ïa phi ; phin pynjot ki baroh .
translation.en: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand , and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven : there shall no man be able to stand before thee , until thou have destroyed them .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la iehnoh jingmeng jingïalap Topheth , ha kaba U Trai u la phah ïa nga ban pynbna ïa ka sngewkynjah jong u . Nga la leit bad ïeng Rakal ka phyllaw jong ka Templ bad ïathuh ha ki briew baroh
translation.en: Then came Jeremiah from Topheth , whither the  Lord  had sent him to prophesy  ; and he stood in the court of the  Lord s  house  ; and said to all the people ,

And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer , and said , Come up to us , and we will shew you a thing . And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer , Come up after me : for the  Lord  hath delivered them into the hand of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta ki pyrta ïa u Jonathan bad ïa uta u samla ,  Ale shane ! Ngi don ei ei ban ong ïa phi !  U Jonathan u ong ïa uta u samla ,  Bud ïa nga . U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor jong ki .

Haba u taiew u la ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u sohpdung-jinghikai u dei ban leh , u la jingkhublei , Kaei keiñ kane kaba kynshi leh na ka bynta u paidbah ? Balei phi shu leh hi marwei ïa phin baroh katba ki briew ki shu ïa-ïeng hangne naduh dang step haduh ban da miet ban ïasyllok bad me .
translation.en: And when Moses  father in law saw all that he did to the people , he said , What is this thing that thou doest to the people ? why sittest thou thyself alone , and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even ?
And every man went unto his own house .
translation.kha: Te kumta ,  ki la jubab ,  phi ruh phi dei na Galilaïa ? To pule minot ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid bad phin shem ba ym don nongïathuhlypa uba ju mih na Galilaïa .

translation.en: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow , behold , Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the  Lord . And they took Dagon , and set him in his place again .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki briew ka Ashdod , ki la ïohi ïa u mot jong u Dagon ba u la kyllon da pyllup ha madan ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai . Kumta ki khyllie bad buh biang ïa u ha kajuh ka jaka .

translation.en: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl : and they four had one likeness : and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel .
translation.kha: Ki shalyntem baroh saw tylli ki ïasyriem kumjuh , kawei pa kawei ka phyrnai la kum u mawkordor , bad kawei kawei ka don kawei pat ka shalyntem halor jong ka ha ka liang ka mon ,
Kumta u syiem mawshun Israel jingkwah la maham Ithlah ki otsher kiba shong hangta , bad jop la long phikir ïa lade . Kane ka jia bun bunsien .
translation.en: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of , and saved himself there , not once nor twice .
Men , brethren , and fathers , hear ye my defence which I make now unto you .
translation.kha: Ko ki para nong Israel jong nga , to shahshkor ïa nga katba nga dang pynlong ka jingïasaid na ka bynta ïa lade ha khmat jong phi !

translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  If thou wilt be perfect , go and sell that thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come and follow me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Lada me kwah ban long uba janai , to khie leit bad die noh ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , bad men don ka spah ha bneng ; nangta to wan bad bud ïa nga .

U Blei u ong , To sngap jar bad to shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki ri sha jngai bah ! To pynkhreh ban wanrah ïa Lymne jingmudui jingthlia phi ha ka ïingbishar ; phin ïoh ïa rangkynsai lad jong phi ban kren Jehoïada To ngin ïawanlang ban rai mano Kenkhria dei .
translation.en: Keep silence before me , O islands  ; and let the people renew their strength : let them come near  ; then let them speak : let us come near together to judgment .

translation.kha: Kumta ong U Trai , uba la pyntip ïa kane bah slem mynshuwa .’
translation.en: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world .

translation.kha: To wat kynthup ïa kano kano ka riewkynthei ha ka jingïa-ïaid ki riewkynthei lymda pynjahburom la dap hynriewphew snem tulop rta .
translation.en: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old , having been the wife of one man ,

translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki ïalam ïa la ki paralok , bad ym don uwei ruh uba ïathuh ïa jingshisha ; ki la hikai ïa la ki thylliej ban lamler bad kin ym iehnoh ïa ka jingleh pop jong ki . leh ïa kawei ka jubor hadien kawei pat , bad ka jingleh shukor ka bud ïa pat . U Trai u ong briew jong u kyntait ïa u .
translation.en: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit  ; through deceit they refuse to know me , saith the  Lord .
There is no fear of God before their eyes .
translation.kha: lymne ki la ïoh jinghikai ïa ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .

translation.en: It is as high as heaven  ; what canst thou do ? deeper than hell  ; what canst thou know ?
translation.kha: Ka sahit bneng kam dei kaba kut ïa U Blei , hynrei ka don palat ïa kaba me lah ban kynjoh . U Blei u tip ïa ka pyrthei kiba ïap , hynrei me mem tip ïa ka .

translation.en: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor , which is by the river of the land of the children of his people , to call him , saying , Behold , there is a people come out from Egypt : behold , they cover the face of the earth , and they abide over against me :
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Balak u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban ïakynduh ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , uba don ha Pethor hajan ka wah Ïuphratis ha ka ri jong ki Amaw . Ki wallam sha u ïa kane ka khubor na u Balak ,  Nga kwah ïa phi ban tip ba kawei ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka la wan na Ijipt ; kita ki briew ki la saphriang kylleng bad ki thmu ban knieh ïa ka ri jong ngi .
U Jisu pat u la sngewthuh ïa ka jingthmu basniew jong ki , bad kumta u la ong , Phi kiba arsap ! balei phi ïapyrshang ban riam ïa nga ?
translation.en: But Jesus perceived their wickedness , and said ,  Why tempt ye me , ye hypocrites ?

translation.kha: ngan noh ïa ki Israel na kane ka ri ïa nga ai ki bad ngan kyntait noh ïa kane ka ïing ïa kaba nga la pynkyntang na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga ; bad ki Israel kin sa shah rkhiebeiñ bad kynshi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong phi pat ko , ki parabangeit jong nga , la khot ïa phi ban long kiba laitluid . Hynrei wat shah ba ka kane jinglaitluid kan kylla ka long jingailad ïa ki jingkwah brai ka doh synshar ban ïa phi . Pynban , ai ba ka jingieit kan pynlong ïa phi ban ïashakri iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: For , brethren , ye have been called unto liberty ; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh , but by love serve one another .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba la sah ha Samaria ki ïai bteng ban thaw ïa la ki bleithaw , bad ki buh ïa ki ha ki jaka mane kiba ki Israel ki la tei . Kawei pa kawei ka ka la thaw ïa ki bleithaw nongbah ha kiba ki shong ki :
translation.en: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own , and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made , every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt .

And he smote Moab , and measured them with a line , casting them down to the ground  ; even with two lines measured he to put to death , and with one full line to keep alive . And so the Moabites became David s servants , and brought gifts .
translation.kha: Nangta u jop ïa ki Moab . U la phah thiah ïa ki koidi ha madan bad pynïap ar ngut na man ki lai ngut . Kumta ki Moab ki kylla long noh ki raïot jong u , bad ki siew khajna sha u .

translation.en: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God , and the song of the Lamb , saying , Great and marvellous are thy works , Lord God Almighty  ; just and true are thy ways , thou King of saints .
translation.kha: bad ki da rwai ïa ka jingrwai u Moses , u shakri jong U Blei , bad ïa ka jingrwai U Khunlangbrot :  U Trai uba U Blei Badonbor Baroh , katno kiba khraw bad kiba phylla long ki kam jong me ! U Syiem jong ki jaitbynriew , katno kiba dei bad kiba shisha ki long lynti jong me !

Hynrei lada u shñiuh ha kata ka dak um kylla lieh , bad kata ka dak kam long kaba kham jylliew ban ïa ka sawdong sniehdoh jong ka , hynrei ka stang ka ha rong , u u lyngdoh dei ban pynkyrpang ïa u hynñiew sngi lynter .
translation.en: But if the priest look on it , and , behold , there be no white hair in the bright spot , and it be no lower than the other skin , but be somewhat dark  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days :

translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por mynba u la ïeng ïaleh ïa pyrshah U Trai , ka la don ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u ha Jerusalem . Ha kaba khatduh u la phet sha ka nongbah Lakhish , ki hynrei nongshun jong u ki la ïa buddien u shata bad la ki pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the  Lord  they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem  ; and he fled to Lachish : but they sent to Lachish after him , and slew him there .

translation.kha: Te nga la khot kyrpad ïa U Trai , Nga kyrpad ïa me , A Trai , to pynim ïa nga !
translation.en: Then called I upon the name of the  Lord   ; O  Lord  , I beseech thee , deliver my soul .

translation.kha: ki Wat hynmen ki jong para shynrang me , ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong me hi , ki la shetkylla ïa me ; ki la ïasoh ha ki jingtur ïaleh pyrshah ïa me . Wat shaniah ïa ki , wat la ki kren ki ktien sngewieit .
translation.en: For even thy brethren , and the house of thy father , even they have dealt treacherously with thee  ; yea , they have called a multitude after thee : believe them not , though they speak fair words unto thee .

translation.kha: jingkheit Absalom Lukia ju ong , Khmih , ka aiñ jingñiewburom ha ka liang mihnoh me , hynrei ym don mano mano u ban mihkhmat ïa u syiem Baïap sngap ïa ka kam jong me .
translation.en: And Absalom said unto him , See , thy matters are good and right  ; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee .

translation.kha: Phin wan lem ne em bad nga ?
translation.en: Will you come with me ?

translation.kha: Ki la ïeng kham pajih bad ki la pyrta , Ko Jisu ! Ko Kynrad To ! isynei ïa ngi !
translation.en: And they lifted up their voices , and said , Jesus , Master , have mercy on us .

translation.kha: Syiem Kynrad , u Dabid u ong , la ju sharai ïa ki langbrot i pa jong nga . Man ba u sing lane ka dngiem ki wan rong ïa u khunlangbrot
translation.en: And David said unto Saul , Thy servant kept his father s sheep , and there came a lion , and a bear , and took a lamb out of the flock :

translation.kha: Nga kwah biah phi ban nongbuaid , ko parabangeit jong nga , ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa Mikhmethath kpa shohdab jingbishni ngi kiba la bud ïa u Moses . Baroh ki la don hapoh ka jingïada jong u lyoh , bad baroh ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Duriaw Basaw .
translation.en: Moreover , brethren , I would not that ye should be ignorant , how that all our fathers were under the cloud , and all passed through the sea ;
The “ sheep ” are those who will have proved themselves his loyal subjects .
translation.kha: Ki “ langbrot ” ki dei kito kiba pyni ba ki long kiba kohnguh sneng ïa u .
baroh ki dei jingshlei jubor katba ki kotbor , kat kum ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la .” ïa phi .
translation.en: Every man shall give as he is able , according to the blessing of the  Lord  thy God which he hath given thee .

translation.kha: Naduh Sadok Haba la ithuh ïa phi , phi shait ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Ye have been rebellious against the  Lord  from the day that I knew you .
And I subscribed the evidence , and sealed it , and took witnesses , and weighed him the money in the balances .
translation.kha: Nga la soi bad shon muhor ïa ka dulir , bad la sakhi ïa ka , bad la thew ïa ka pisa ha ka tarajur .
Ïeng sharud na kine Rehum briew bad ngan pynjot hektar Samson ki kumne kumne .
translation.en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation , that I may consume them in a moment .
And God spake unto Noah , and to his sons with him , saying ,
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Noah bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u ,

translation.en: I beheld , and the same horn made war with the saints , and prevailed against them  ;
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang khmih , kata ka reng ka pynlong thma bad ki briew jong U Blei bad ka la jop ïa ki .

translation.en: And upon Dibon , and upon Nebo , and upon Beth–diblathaim ,
translation.kha: Dibon , Nebo , Beth Diblathaim ,

translation.en: Thy seed also had been as the sand , and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof  ; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin roi kum ki symboh shyiap , bad ngan jin da la pynthikna ba yn ym pynjot ïa ki da lei lei .
Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa U Trai na ka Lukios ka jingieit tyngkreiñ jong u , na ka bynta kiei ïashem kiba phylla kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong Sebah Khinnereth
translation.en: Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !

translation.kha: Bad jingbha ka long ka jingmih ba la pynmih na ki kiba ki nongpynïasuk la bet ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace .
He croucheth , and humbleth himself , that the poor may fall by his strong ones .
translation.kha: Ki lanot ki bym ïoh jingïarap ki dem ha ka jinglwet ; ka jingkhlaiñ ba thombor ka la jop ïa ki .
Ki ai jingbieit jingpynkylla da ka ktien bieit! ki snieh ïa ka khnang ba u paidbah u lah ban Isynei ïa ka Hophni
translation.en: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly , and gave the sense , and caused them to understand the reading .

translation.kha: Ko Moab , pha shaniah ha la ka jingkhlaiñ bad ha la ka spah , markhmat mynta wat ïa pha ruh yn jop noh Hanani ïa u blei Khemosh jong pha yn ringmraw , ïalong Eleasar ki khun syiem bad Ktien Selophehad .
translation.en: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures , thou shalt also be taken : and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together .
But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors , whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen , that I might be their God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynthymmai ïa ka jutang ba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki mynba nga la pynpaw ïa la ka bor ha ki jaitbynriew baroh da kaba ïalam noh ïa la ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , khnang ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga lah ban long U Blei jong ki . Nga long U  Trai .

Wat tur ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ki hynmen para jong phi hi , ki paid Israel . Khie ïaleit noh sha ïing baroh phi . Kaei kaba jia ka long kaba nga . mon Baroh ki la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Trai bad ki leit phai sha la ïing .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Ye shall not go up , nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel : return every man to his house  ; for this thing is from me . They hearkened therefore to the word of the  Lord  , and returned to depart , according to the word of the  Lord .
He that wasteth his father , and chaseth away his mother , is a son that causeth shame , and bringeth reproach .
translation.kha: Tang u briew uba khlemrain bad bym donburom un lehbeiñ ïa la u kpa lane beh noh ïa la ka kmie na ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: Brethren , pray for us .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit , to duwai lem na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the  Lord s  passover .
translation.kha: Ka Niam Ka Jinglait , ïa kaba ju rakhe ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , ka sdang ha ka por sep sngi ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong .

translation.en: And Amram took him Jochebed his father s sister to wife  ; and she bare him Aaron and Moses : and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years .
translation.kha: U Amram u shongkurim ïa ka Jokhebed , ka para jong u kpa jong u , bad ka la kha ïa u Aaron bad u Moses . U Amram u la im haduh shispah laiphew hynñiew snem ka rta .

translation.en: And if a man lie with his daughter in law , both of them shall surely be put to death : they have wrought confusion  ; their blood shall be upon them .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka pyrsa kurim , baroh ar ngut kin shah pynïap . Ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba sang , bad ki la pan kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .

Yn sa ïa ki kum ïa mradkhlaw , bad kin shah ïa ka kaba la pynlong . Ka jingsngewbha ha ki ka long ban leh ïa kaei kaei ha kaba shai ka sngi ka pynhun ïa jingkwah brai ka doh ki long ka jinglehrain bad ka jingjahburom haba ki ïashong bam phi , katba nang leh sngewbha la ki lynti bashukor !
translation.en: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness , as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time . Spots they are and blemishes , sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you  ;

translation.kha: U Moses u leit , bad U Trai u ong ha u , Khie leit hiar bad maham ki ïa briew ban ym jam u ïa pud ban wan khmih ïa ; nga lada ki leh kumta , bun na ki kin ïap .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go down , charge the people , lest they break through unto the  Lord  to gaze , and many of them perish .

translation.kha: Sneng pynbeit la ïa u khun bad phi lah ban sngewsarong borabor ïa u . Un ym long daw ïa phi ban shah lehrain .
translation.en: Correct thy son , and he shall give thee rest  ; yea , he shall give delight unto thy soul .

translation.kha: kyndon por jong ka Mattithaïah Niam Ki Ïingtrep ka Jamin jan , kumta nongïarap para shynrang jong U Jisu Lehkmen la ong ïa u , To shibit nongleh kane ka jaka bad leit sha Judia Tiberios ba ki nongbud jong me kin ïohi Kelita shyrkhei kiei kiba me Boas .
translation.en: His brethren therefore said unto him , Depart hence , and go into Judaea , that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest .

translation.kha: Ki dohkha ha ka wah ki la ïap , bad ka la sma iwtung eh kat haduh ba ki nong kim Ijipt nud shuh ban dih um na ka . Ka ka snam la don kylleng ha ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And the fish that was in the river died  ; and the river stank , and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river  ; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U phatok la pan ïa ka jingshai , u la rung shapoh , bad u la dem da kaba khynñiuh ki kjat jong u Paul u Silas .
translation.en: Then he called for a light , and sprang in , and came trembling , and fell down before Paul and Silas ,

translation.kha: Naba da ka jingïap ba la kñia jong U naphang la pyllaitluid ïa ngi , Namar ka long , ïa Marah pop hi ngi bani khlemrain ei .
translation.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood , the forgiveness of sins , according to the riches of his grace ;
And straightway one of them ran , and took a sponge , and filled it with vinegar , and put it on a reed , and gave him to drink .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la mareh shisyndon , u la shim ïa u spoiñ    , u la pynngam ïa u hapoh ka waiñ ka bym bha , u buh ïa u ha tduh jong u dieng , bad u la pyrshang ban pyndih ïa u .

translation.en: Then he went down into the king s house , into the scribe s chamber : and , lo , all the princes sat there , even Elishama the scribe , and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah , and Elnathan the son of Achbor , and Gemariah the son of Shaphan , and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah , and all the princes .
translation.kha: Te u la leit sha ka ïingsyiem , sha ka kamra u sekretari ka ïingbishar , ha kaba baroh ki rangbah synshar ki dang don ha ka jingïalang . U Elishama , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u Delaïah u khun jong u Shemaïah , u Elnathan u khun jong u Akhbor , u Gemaraïah u khun jong u Shaphan , u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Hananaïah , bad baroh kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar ki la don hangta .

translation.en: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass , and his foot also of brass , to wash withal : and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar , and thou shalt put water therein .
translation.kha: Shna kawei ka dabor rnong , kaba ka jingpynshong jong ka ruh dei da ka rnong . Buh ïa ka hapdeng ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad pyndap um ïa ka .

translation.en: And these are the words that the  Lord  spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong ka Israel bad Judah :

Naba haba ki la shah kyntait , ïa u nongshukor la pynkylla na kaba long ki nongshun Basaw Blei sha kaba long ki paralok jong u . Kaei ka ban long te , haba la pdiang ïa ki ? Kan long sngewtmang jingim ïa kiba thapniang ïap!
translation.en: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world , what shall the receiving of them be , but life from the dead ?
That saith of Cyrus , He is my shepherd , and shall perform all my pleasure : even saying to Jerusalem , Thou shalt be built  ; and to the temple , Thy foundation shall be laid .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha u Syros , ‘ Me long uta u ban synshar na ka bynta jong nga ; men leh ïa kaei kaba nga kwah ïa phi ban leh ; men hukum ïa ka Jerusalem ban tei biang bad ïa ki nongrim jong ka Templ ban seng pat .’

translation.en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward : he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them .
translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa la ka jingim , phet krad na ki jingriam kaba pynngat ïa u bymman ha ka lynti ïaid .

U Aaron u dei ban teh ïa u thala ka shyllangmat jong u , shyngkub ba Kisleb nga , U Seboiim , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingainguh ba ki Israel ki pynkyntang sha nga , wat Hashabaïah ki briew ki Ïalam haba ki ai ïa ki .
translation.en: And it shall be upon Aaron s forehead , that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things , which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts  ; and it shall be always upon his forehead , that they may be accepted before the  Lord .
In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , uwei uwei na phi un khot sngewbha ïa la u paramarjan ban wan bad ban lehkmen ïa ka jingsuk bad ka jingshngain , ba la ker sawdong da ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki diengsoh Dumbur .

translation.en: Gather yourselves together , and hear , ye sons of Jacob  ; and hearken unto Israel your father .
translation.kha: Ale lang bad sngap , phi ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob , Shahshkor ïa u Israel u kpa jong phi .
namar ngan ai ha ki kyntien ka don na ki nongshun jong phi kiba lah kyntait lane ïa-pyrshah kaei kaba phi ong
translation.en: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom , which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist .

translation.kha: U Trai u kren ha u Jehu u Nongïathuhlypa , u khun jong u bad ai ha u ïa kane ka khubor na ka bynta u Baasha
translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha , saying ,
Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly .
translation.kha: U shah ïa u slap ban theh na ki lyoh ha kaba ai um ïa u khunbynriew baroh .

translation.en: And he said , Open the window eastward . And he opened it . Then Elisha said , Shoot . And he shot . And he said , The arrow of the  Lord s  deliverance , and the arrow of deliverance from Syria : for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek , till thou have consumed them .
translation.kha: Nangta , da kaba kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah u nongïathuhlypa , u syiem u plie ïa ka jingkhang kaba phai khmat sha Syria .  Siat ïa u khnam !  u Elisha u hukum . Hamar ba u syiem u siat ïa u khnam , u nongïathuhlypa u pyrta ,  Me long u khnam jong U  Trai  , da u , un sa ïoh ka jingjop halor ka Syria . Men ïaleh ïa ki Syria ha Aphek haduh ba men da jop thiaw ïa ki .

translation.en: Therefore is judgment far from us , neither doth justice overtake us : we wait for light , but behold obscurity  ; for brightness , but we walk in darkness .
translation.kha: U paidlang u ong ,  Mynta ngi tip balei U Blei um pyllait ïa ngi na kito kiba banbeiñ ïa ngi . Ngi kyrmen ïa ka jingshai ban ïaid ryngkat , hynrei ka don tang ka jingdum ,
U shñiuh jong phi halor ki ngab phi , bad u noh ha ryndang jong phi kum ki mawkordor .
translation.en: My beloved spake , and said unto me , Rise up , my love , my fair one , and come away .
Lest there be any fornicator , or profane person , as Esau , who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un long uba im thala lane u bym kynja mynsiem , kum u Iso , uba tang namar shisien ka jingbam u la die noh ïa ki hok jong u kum u hynmen .

translation.en: And we said unto my lord , The lad cannot leave his father : for if he should leave his father , his father would die .
translation.kha: Ngi ruh ngi la jubab ba u para um lah ban ieh ïa i pa ; namar lada u leh kumta , i pa in ïap .

translation.en: But now he hath made me weary : thou hast made desolate all my company .
translation.kha: Me la pynduhbor ïa nga , A Blei ; me la shah ba yn pynïap ïa ka longïing jong nga .
Hynrei ma nga , U Trai , ngan ïada , bad ngan ym aiti noh ïa me ki sha briew kiba me sheptieng .
translation.en: But I will deliver thee in that day , saith the  Lord  : and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid .
The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee , the fir tree , the pine tree , and the box together , to beautify the place of my sanctuary  ; and I will make the place of my feet glorious .
translation.kha: Ïa ki dieng jong u dieng Kseh , u dieng Kseh-Juniper , bad u dieng Kseh-Sypress , ki dieng kiba kynsai tam jong ka khlaw Lebanon yn wallam ban tei biang ïa pha , ko Jerusalem , ban pynitynnat ïa ka Templ jong nga , ban pyndonburom ïa ka nongbah jong nga .

translation.en: But covet earnestly the best gifts : and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way .
translation.kha: Namarkata , to puson ha ki dohnud jong phi , halor ki jingai kiba kham donkam . Pynban , kaba bha tam ka long ka rukom kaba bud nangne .

translation.en: And Pharaoh rose up in the night , he , and all his servants , and all the Egyptians  ; and there was a great cry in Egypt  ; for there was not a house where there was not one dead .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , la pynkyndit ïa u Pharaoh , ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ïa baroh ki nong Ijipt . Ka jinglynñiar kaba jam ka la don ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt , namar ym shym don kawei ruh ka ïing kaba ym don u khun uba khlem ïap .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Know ye Laban the son of Nahor ? And they said , We know him .
translation.kha: U kylli ,  Phi ithuh ïa u Laban u khun jong u Nahor ?   Ho-oid , ngi ithuh ,  ki jubab .

translation.en: A little one shall become a thousand , and a small one a strong nation : I the  Lord  will hasten it in his time .
translation.kha: Wat ka jait ka kynja kaba rit bad ba duk tam kan sa long kaba khraw kum ka jaitbynriew kaba donbor . Haba ka por kaba biang ka la wan , ngan pynjia kloi ïa kine kiei kiei . Nga long U  Trai  !

translation.en: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing , he sought to slay Moses . But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh , and dwelt in the land of Midian : and he sat down by a well .
translation.kha: Haba u Pharaoh u ïohsngew ïa kata , u pyrshang ban phah pynïap ïa u Moses ; hynrei u Moses u la phet ïap , bad u leit shong noh ha ri Midian .

translation.en: And what I say unto you I say unto all , Watch .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga ong ïa phi , te , nga ong ïa baroh : To khmih bha !

translation.en: Thou shalt not curse the deaf , nor put a stumblingblock before the blind , but shalt fear thy God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat tim ïa u briew uba kyllut lane wat buh ei ei ha khmat uba matlah ban pynlong ba un jynthut halor uta . Tiengburom ïa nga ; nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And he took his staff in his hand , and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook , and put them in a shepherd s bag which he had , even in a scrip  ; and his sling was in his hand : and he drew near to the Philistine .
translation.kha: U shim ïa la u diengduh bad u tam san tylli ki maw kiba jlih na ka wahduid bad u thep ïa ki ha ka pla kieng jong u . Lem bad ka jingshat maw ha kti , u tur ban ïakynduh ïa u Goliath .

translation.en: The sons also of Jediael  ; Bilhan : and the sons of Bilhan  ; Jeush , and Benjamin , and Ehud , and Chenaanah , and Zethan , and Tharshish , and Ahishahar .
translation.kha: U Jediael u don uwei u khun , u Bilhan , bad u Bilhan u don hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jeush , u Benjamin , u Ehud , u Khenaanah , u Sethan , u Tarshish , bad u Ahishahar .

Katba ngi dang shong ha kane ka ïingjaiñ kaba kane ka khyndew , sat da ka jingsngew ba shah banbeiñ ; kam dei ba ngi kwah noh na ka met ka khyndew , hynrei ba ngi kwah ban ïoh noh ban phong da kata kaba kynja bneng , khnang ba ïa kata kaba ïap yn ïoh pynkylla dur noh .
translation.en: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan , being burdened : not for that we would be unclothed , but clothed upon , that mortality might be swallowed up of life .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngi phla ïa ki pop jong ngi ha U Blei , un bat ïa la ka kular un ïa kaei kaba dei : Un map ïa ngi ki pop jong bad un pynkhuid ïa ngi na ki kam bymman baroh .
translation.en: If we confess our sins , he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins , and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness .
