translation.kha: Alphaïos jutang kiei kiba jingïakynduhlang Josaïah u la leh — Ashdod jingaiti lut jong u sha U Trai , Shemida jingkohnguh jong u ïa ka Hukum , bad Malkhijah ka Shaniah Thiat Baasha naduh jingriam sdang haduh kaba kut — la pynjuh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Akhan haei Ka Israel Bad pushara Judah .
translation.en: And his deeds , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah .
And God Almighty give you mercy before the man , that he may send away your other brother , and Benjamin . If I be bereaved of my children , I am bereaved .
translation.kha: To U Blei Badonbor Baroh un pynlong ïa uta u briew ba un isynei ïa phi , khnang ba un pynphai sha phi ïa u hynmen u para jong phi , bad ïa u Benjamin de . Ïa nga shimet te , lada nga dei ban duh ïa la ki khun , ieh ngan mat duh ïa ki .

translation.en: For , when we were come into Macedonia , our flesh had no rest , but we were troubled on every side ; without were fightings , within were fears .
translation.kha: Wat hadien ba ngi la poi ha Makedonia , ngim shym la ïoh shongthait . Ki la don ki jingjynjar ha kylleng sawdong , ki jingïakajia bad kiwei pat , ki jingsheptieng ha ki dohnud jong ngi .
Ngam treh kyntait ban ka ïa jingaiei U Blei . Hynrei lada la pynksan ïa u briew ha U Blei da ka Hukum , ka mut ba U Khrist u la ïap lehnoh-ei!
translation.en: I do not frustrate the grace of God : for if righteousness come by the law , then Christ is dead in vain .

translation.kha: haduh ha kaba khatduh U Trai u pyndam noh ïa ki na khmat jong u , kumba la maham lyngba ki shakri jong u nongïathuhlypa , ba un leh kumta . paid la pynryngkang par sha Assyria , ha kaba ki dang ïaisah hangta .
translation.en: Until the  Lord  removed Israel out of his sight , as he had said by all his servants the prophets . So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day .

translation.kha: U Araunah la ai lut ha u syiem bad ong ha u , To U Trai U Blei jong un pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong phi .
translation.en: All these things did Araunah , as a king , give unto the king . And Araunah said unto the king , The  Lord  thy God accept thee .
For even hereunto were ye called : because Christ also suffered for us , leaving us an example , that ye should follow his steps :
translation.kha: Ka dei ïa kane ba U Blei u la khot ïa phi , naba U Khrist hi u la shahshitom na ka bynta jong phi bad u la iehnoh ha phi ïa ka nuksa , khnang ba phin bud ha ki dien jat jong u .

translation.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , as did the house of Ahab : for the daughter of Ahab was his wife : and he did evil in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka tnga jong u ka dei ka khun jong u Ahab , bad kumba long kiba na ka ïing u Ahab , u ruh u bud ïa ki lynti bymman jong ki syiem ka Israel . U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

kylleng ka ri ki la sdang ban ïakajia para ma . U syiem Dabid u la pyllait im ïa ngi ki nongshun ngi , ki ïa-ong uwei ïa uwei pat . U pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philistia ; hynrei mynta pat u phet na u Absalom u la iehnoh ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel , saying , The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies , and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines  ; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom .
Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth ? declare , if thou hast understanding .
translation.kha: Hato me don hangta mynba nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthei ? Lada me tip haduh katta katta , to ïathuh ïa nga shaphang kata .

translation.en: But Festus answered , that Paul should be kept at Caesarea , and that he himself would depart shortly thither .
translation.kha: U Phestos u la jubab ,  Ïa u Paul la set kum u koidi ha Kaisaria , bad nga hi ngan sa leit pat shen shata .

translation.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David , the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth–rehob , and the Syrians of Zobah , twenty thousand footmen , and of king Maacah a thousand men , and of Ish–tob twelve thousand men .
translation.kha: Ki Ammon ki la sngewthuh ba ki la pynlong nongshun ïa u Dabid , kumta ki la phah wai arphew hajar ngut ki shipai Syria na Bethrehob bad na Sobah , khat-ar hajar ngut ki rangbah na Tob , bad ïa u syiem Maakah lem bad shihajar ngut ki rangbah .

translation.en: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar : and the Ethiopians were overthrown , that they could not recover themselves  ; for they were destroyed before the  Lord  , and before his host  ; and they carried away very much spoil .
translation.kha: Ki phet ïap , bad u Asa lem bad ki kynhun jong u ki beh kthong ïa ki haduh Gerar . Te bun na ki nong Sudan ki la ïap haduh ba ka kynhun shipai kam shym lah shuh ban lum pat bad ïaleh . Ki la shah pyndem lin ha U  Trai  bad ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad ka kynhun shipai ka la ïoh rah bun ka jinglute .
To wat ieit ïa Shihajar pyrthei , lymne ïa kaei kaei kaba dei jong ka pyrthei . Lada phi ieit ïa Borbah’ pyrthei , jingjot ka long ba phim ieit ïa U ïashang .
translation.en: Love not the world , neither the things that are in the world . If any man love the world , the love of the Father is not in him .

translation.kha: Ki khun jong ka Para ba-ieit jong ki phah jingai khublei ïa phi .
translation.en: The children of thy elect sister greet thee . Amen .
And when thou hast stayed three days , then thou shalt go down quickly , and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand , and shalt remain by the stone Ezel .
translation.kha: La shi sngi , ka jingbymdon jong phi kan kham paw shuh shuh ; te leit hiar sha kato ka jaka ha kaba phi rieh mynshuwa ; bad rieh ha lyndet ka kynton maw hangto .

translation.en: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles , whom God drave out before the face of our fathers , unto the days of David  ;
translation.kha: Hadien , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka ïingjaiñ na ki kpa jong ki , ki la bah ïa ka lem bad ki haba ki la leit bad u Joshua bad shimti ïa ka ri na ki jaitbynriew kiba U Blei u la beh katba ki nang tur sha khmat . Bad ka la don hangta haduh ka por jong u Dabid .
Kin ïoh kyrhai u slap Bad kin thung la ïa u symbai ha ki lyngkha ba ïoh um bha . syiem U jong ki un kham khraw ïa Agag u , Bad ka bor synshar jong u kan ïar kylleng sawdong .
translation.en: He shall pour the water out of his buckets , and his seed shall be in many waters , and his king shall be higher than Agag , and his kingdom shall be exalted .

translation.kha: Asa u leit ban ïaleh ïa u , bad baroh arliang ki ïeng ha la ki jaka ka Them Sephathah hajan Mareshah .
translation.en: Then Asa went out against him , and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah .

translation.kha: Nalor , u dei ruh ban wanrah kum ka jingainguh ïa ki kpu ba khleh thiat .
translation.en: Besides the cakes , he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings .
And Joseph said unto his brethren , I am Joseph  ; doth my father yet live ? And his brethren could not answer him  ; for they were troubled at his presence .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen bad ha la u para ,  Nga dei u Joseph ! Shisha i pa i dang im ?  Ki hynmen shynrang jong u kim lait ang shuh , ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh kat haduh ba kim lah ban jubab .

translation.en: And Micah said unto him , Dwell with me , and be unto me a father and a priest , and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year , and a suit of apparel , and thy victuals . So the Levite went in .
translation.kha: U Mikah u ong ,  Shong noh bad nga . Long u nongaibuit bad u lyngdoh jong nga , bad ngan ai ïa phi shiphew ki sbai rupa shisnem , ki jaiñ bad ka jingbam ïa phi .

translation.en: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship , and to go before him unto the other side , while he sent the multitudes away .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la pynlong ïa ki synran ban kiew ha ka lieng bad ban nang leit sha shiliang ka duriaw , katba u la nang phah noh ïa u paidbah .

translation.en: Then took he him up in his arms , and blessed God , and said ,
translation.kha: u Simeon u la shim ïa u khunlung ha ki ksang ti jong u bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei :

translation.en: The same followed Paul and us , and cried , saying , These men are the servants of the most high God , which shew unto us the way of salvation .
translation.kha: Ka la bud ïa u Paul bad ïa ngi , ka da pyrta ,  Kine ki briew ki long ki shakri U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh ! Ki pynbna ha phi kumno ba yn pynim ïa phi !

translation.en: Who can discover the face of his garment ? or who can come to him with his double bridle ?
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban tar noh ïa ka jingsop bashabar jong u lane pynpei ïa ka atiar jingïada kaba u phong .

translation.en: For this cause we also , since the day we heard it , do not cease to pray for you , and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding ;
translation.kha: Na kane ka daw , ngi ju duwai borabor na ka bynta jong phi , naduh ba ngi la ïohsngew shaphang jong phi . Ngi kyrpad ïa U Blei ban pyndap ïa phi da ka jingtip ïa ka mon jong u , da ka jingstad baroh bad ka jingshemphang ba U Mynsiem jong u , u ai .

translation.en: As concerning the rest of the beasts , they had their dominion taken away : yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki mradkhlaw ki la shah knieh noh ka bor jong ki , hynrei la shah ïa ki ban im shipor .
Kumta ki tep khyndew noh ïa nonghiarthma pukri baroh kiba ki shakri jong u kpa jong u , u Abraham ki la tih mynba u Abraham u dang im .
translation.en: For all the wells which his father s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father , the Philistines had stopped them , and filled them with earth .

Behold , at that time I will undo all that afflict thee : and I will save her that halteth , and gather her that was driven out  ; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame .
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ! Ngan pynshitom ïa ki nongbanbeiñ jong pha ; ngan pyllait im ïa baroh kiba dkoh bad ngan wallam sha ïing ïa kiba shah ringmraw . Ngan pynphai ïa ka jinglehrain jong ki sha ka jingdonburom , bad baroh ka pyrthei kan ïaroh ïa ki .

translation.en: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field , and hast forgot a sheaf in the field , thou shalt not go again to fetch it : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow : that the  Lord  thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands .
translation.kha: Haba phi lum ïa u kew bad phi kum klet shi song ha lyngkha , wat leit tam shuh ïa u ; ieh ïa u hangta na ka bynta ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , khnang ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa phi ha ka kam jong phi baroh .
U ong ha u Shaphan , Nga shem la ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum hangne ha ka Templ .
translation.en: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe , I have found the book of the law in the house of the  Lord . And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki kyang jam nga sha , ‘ Wat la ki pop jong ngi ki pynrem ïa ngi , to ïarap ïa ngi , A Trai , kumba me la kular . Ngi la phai dien noh na me bun bunsien ; ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me .
translation.en: O  Lord  , though our iniquities testify against us , do thou it for thy name s sake : for our backslidings are many  ; we have sinned against thee .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong Birsaith Yn ym Akhshaph na ki hima ba-marjan kiba la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka Israel da ka jingkrenbeiñ , ki ban long pat kum ki shiah bad 33 shiah buid ban pynmong ïa ki Meun . Bad kin dem sangsot Jorim nga , nga long U Trai Nongsynshar .
translation.en: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel , nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them , that despised them  ; and they shall know that I am the Lord  God .

translation.kha: U Trai un kynting ïa phi shabar jong kane ka ri ; un Abijah download lehburom Probins haduh ba yn ym don uno uno ruh na phi uba dang sah . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once , and will distress them , that they may find it so .
And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures , which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Bad na dang khynnah , Me tip sngwthuh ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , kiba lah ban ai ha me ïa ka jingstad kaba ïalam sha ka jingpynim da ka jingngeit ha U Khrist Jisu .
La pyllaitluid ïa phi ka pop bad phi la long pat ki mraw jong ka hok .
translation.en: Being then made free from sin , ye became the servants of righteousness .

translation.kha: Phi pynleit jingmut ïasylla uba ki katto katne ki sngi , ki bnai , ki aïom , bad ki snem .
translation.en: Ye observe days , and months , and times , and years .

translation.kha: Te u Philip u la sdang ban kren Bengeber da kaba sdang na kane ka bynta Hali ka Jingthoh Bakhuid , u la ïathuh ïa u ïa ka Khubor byrngia shaphang U Jisu .
translation.en: Then Philip opened his mouth , and began at the same scripture , and preached unto him Jesus .

translation.kha: To trei minot bad phin pahuh ha rahah mynno ; lada phi shu bunktien phin ïoh long kiba kyrduh .
translation.en: In all labour there is profit : but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury .

translation.kha: Nga buh ki ha mawlynnai pha — ki khadu bad ki kpieng .
translation.en: I decked thee also with ornaments , and I put bracelets upon thy hands , and a chain on thy neck .
And it came to pass , that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day  ; and his disciples began , as they went , to pluck the ears of corn .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang ïaid lyngba katto katne ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Katba ki synran jong u ki dang ïa-ïaid ryngkat bad u , ki sdang ban khet ïa ki symboh kew .
U kñia arphew ar hajar sohwaiñ ki masi bad shi lakh arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot kum ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Bad kumta ma u nongkren uta Hashabaïah paidbah jingainguh ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep : so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God .

translation.kha: Ira Abraham u jubab kpoh To da khmih bha ba men ym phah noh ïa u jingpyllait jong nga jingbymngeit !
translation.en: And Abraham said unto him , Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again .

translation.kha: U don ruh ka kynhun shipai kaba kaba heh la kloi na ka bynta ka thma . Ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh jong ka la sumar da u Jeiel u bad u Maaseïah , ki jong sekretari u hapoh ka jingpeit u Hananaïah , u jong dkhot ki nongtrei jong u syiem .
translation.en: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men , that went out to war by bands , according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler , under the hand of Hananiah , one of the king s captains .

translation.kha: U Trai ong , Namar jutang jong nga phi kaba la shonshab ka snam jong ki jingkñia , ngan pyllaitluid ïa ki briew jong phi — kaba na ki bym don um ka jingshah ringmraw .
translation.en: As for thee also , by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water .
And they said unto him , Where wilt thou that we prepare ?
translation.kha: Hangno ba me kwah ïa ngi ban pynkhreh ïa ka ?  ki la kylli ïa u .
lah Nga thngan
translation.en: I am hungry
Even when we were dead in sins , hath quickened us together with Christ , ( by grace ye are saved ; )
translation.kha: ba haba ngi la long kiba ïap ha ka jinglong ba kynja mynsiem ha ka jingbymkohnguh jong ngi u la wallam ïa ngi sha ka jingim lem bad U Khrist . Ka dei da ka jingaiei U Blei ba la pynim ïa phi .

translation.en: I said , Surely thou wilt fear me , thou wilt receive instruction  ; so their dwelling should not be cut off , howsoever I punished them : but they rose early , and corrupted all their doings .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba kumta ki briew jong nga kin da la ñiewkor ïa nga bad pdiang ïa ka jingsneng pynbeit jong nga , ba kin ym da la klet ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la hikai ïa ki . Hynrei shen shen ki la leh bymman kumba ki ju leh .

Kohnguh rusom ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka basah , khnang ba ma phi bad ki khun Khaldi ksiew jong phi phin manbha . Phin ïaishong ba-bhabriew dewryngkhiang kata Suit Dibon ïa kaba Suph Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ba kan long ka sahkynmaw jong phi junom doktor
translation.en: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes , and his commandments , which I command thee this day , that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee , and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , for ever .

translation.kha: u Akhish u ong ki jong u , Ha khmih ! Une u briew u ! Balei phi wan ïalam ïa u sha nga ?
translation.en: Then said Achish unto his servants , Lo , ye see the man is mad : wherefore then have ye brought him to me ?

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la pynleit bha jingmut ïa kaei kaba u Philip u la ong , haba ki la shahshkor ïa u bad ïohi ïa ki kiba kambah u la leh .
translation.en: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake , hearing and seeing the miracles which he did .

translation.kha: Nga leh ïa kane khnang ba yn pyndap ïa ki da ka jingshlur bad ba yn lah ban khring lang ïa ki ha ka jingieit , bad kumta kin ïoh ïa ka jingdap ba-pura ïa ka jingsngewskhem kaba jingshemphang wallam . Ha kane ka rukom kin ïa jingmaïan ka jong U Blei , kaba long U Khrist hi
translation.en: That their hearts might be comforted , being knit together in love , and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding , to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God , and of the Father , and of Christ ;

For the  Lord  had said unto Moses , Say unto the children of Israel , Ye are a stiffnecked people : I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment , and consume thee : therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee , that I may know what to do unto thee .
translation.kha: Naba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki ,  Phi long u paidlang uba mutlop . Lada ngan leit ryngkat bad phi wat tang shikhyllipmat ruh , ngan jin da la pynjot thiaw ïa phi . Law noh mynta ïa kito ki jingdeng jong phi , bad ngan sa rai ngan leh kumno ïa phi .

translation.en: Remove out of the midst of Babylon , and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans , and be as the he goats before the flocks .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , to phet noh na Babilonia ! Iehnoh ïa ka ri ! Long kiba nyngkong ban iehnoh ïa ka !

translation.en: And base things of the world , and things which are despised , hath God chosen , yea , and things which are not , to bring to nought things that are :
translation.kha: U la jied ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka ñiew poh bad ibeiñ , bad ka pyrkhat ba kam long ei ei , khnang ban pynjot ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka pyrkhat ba ka long kaba donkam .
Te U Trai u la ïathuh ha nga ban ong ha u paidbah , To shahshkor ! Ma nga , U jingkmen , nga Ira lur phi ka jingjied hapdeng ka lynti ka ban lam sha ka jingim bad ka lynti ka ban lam sha ka jingïap .
translation.en: And unto this people thou shalt say , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I set before you the way of life , and the way of death .
But Abner the son of Ner , captain of Saul s host , took Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , and brought him over to Mahanaim  ;
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u Saul , u Abner u khun jong u Ner , u la phet bad u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Saul sha Mahanaim .

translation.en: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth .
translation.kha: Ïa kata ka lyngkha bad ka krem kaba don hangta la thied na ki Hit . Tep ïa nga hangta .
U Solomon un ïoh kawei ka na bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga bad na ka bynta Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la jied ban long ka jong nga na ka ri Israel baroh .
translation.en: ( But he shall have one tribe for my servant David s sake , and for Jerusalem s sake , the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel : )

translation.kha: Hynrei U un ym iehnoh ïa kiba shaniah ha um ju ai jingïarap ïa ki .
translation.en: Behold , God will not cast away a perfect man , neither will he help the evil doers :
Cast in thy lot among us  ; let us all have one purse :
translation.kha: Ale bad ïoh bynta lang bad ngi , bad ngin ïasam ïa kaba ngi ïoh lute .
ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u ka , u Shallum u khun jong u Jabesh u long u ka Israel , bad u shi bnai ha Samaria
translation.en: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah  ; and he reigned a full month in Samaria .
I speak not of you all : I know whom I have chosen : but that the scripture may be fulfilled , He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me .
translation.kha: Ngam shym kren shaphang jong phi baroh ; nga tip ïa kito kiba nga la jied . Hynrei ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka dei ban urlong shisha , kaba ong , ‘ U briew uba la ïabam lang ïa ka jingbam jong nga u phai pyrshah ïa nga .’

Harbonah ïa kine ki jaiñ ha u Aaron u hynmen jong me bad Dor ki khun lup jong u . Nangta pynkupbor sylla ki pynrit pynkyntang da kaba pynsleh ïa ki da ka umphniang Olib Ho-oid’ khnang ba ki lah ban shakri blei nga Hangta ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother , and his sons with him  ; and shalt anoint them , and consecrate them , and sanctify them , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office .

translation.kha: U la wan sha nga u la ïeng hajan jong nga bad u la ong , ‘ Ko Saul , men ïoh imat pat Ha kata hi ka la lah ban pat bad nga la khmih ïa u .
translation.en: Came unto me , and stood , and said unto me , Brother Saul , receive thy sight . And the same hour I looked up upon him .

But none of these things move me , neither count I my life dear unto myself , so that I might finish my course with joy , and the ministry , which I have received of the Lord Jesus , to testify the gospel of the grace of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ñiew ïa la ka jingim ba ka long ka bymdondor ei ei ïa nga ; nga kwah tang ban pyndep ïa ka jingtrei jong nga bad pyndep pura ïa ka kam kaba U Trai Jisu u la ai ha nga ban leh , kaba long ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka jingaiei jong U Blei .

translation.en: He will surely reprove you , if ye do secretly accept persons .
translation.kha: Wat la ïa ka jingnoh shiliang la buhrieh , un pynrem ïa me ,
Ka Jehosheba ka sumar ïa u khynnah haduh hynriew snem bad nongshna pynrieh ïa u ha prong Templ Eliphas katba ka Athalaïah ka dang synshar kum ka syiem .
translation.en: And he was with her hid in the house of the  Lord  six years . And Athaliah did reign over the land .

translation.kha: lada Ham long uba hok Naboth uba khuid , te Sokoh Blei jongno Lano mynkata ïarap pynsuhthied me bad pynïoh pat ïa Rakal ïing ka sem Erekh me kum ka kopi .
translation.en: If thou wert pure and upright  ; surely now he would awake for thee , and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous .

translation.kha: Hynrei dang ki nud hi ban leit kiew sha kata ka ri lum , wat la ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai lymne u kim Moses shim mih na ka jaka shong dara .
translation.en: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top : nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and Moses , departed not out of the camp .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ai ïa kane ka jubab : To thoh shai ha ki lyngkniap dewbyrtha ïa kaei ba ngan pynpaw ha me , khnang ban ban lah mar pule syn peit .
translation.en: And the  Lord  answered me , and said , Write the vision , and make it plain upon tables , that he may run that readeth it .

translation.kha: U Blei u pyn-i ha ki ïa ki pop jong ki bad ïa ka jong jingsarong ki .
translation.en: Then he sheweth them their work , and their transgressions that they have exceeded .

translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa kito kiba shong ha Ijipt , kumba nga pynshitom ka ïa Jerusalem — da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad ka jingpang .
translation.en: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt , as I have punished Jerusalem , by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence :

translation.kha: Haduh katno ki thapniang ka jong Ostrit ki kaweh stet ! Hynrei ym don kano kano ka Ostrit kaba lah ban her kum ka thring .
translation.en: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks ? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich ?
All the kings of the nations , even all of them , lie in glory , every one in his own house .
translation.kha: Baroh ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki thiah ha ki jingtep kiba itynnat ,
Ka ri blaid seisoh bha , bad phin ngam Jingpynphai bam kat ïa kaba phi kwah , bad sngewpang ïoh shongshngain hangta Barnea
translation.en: And the land shall yield her fruit , and ye shall eat your fill , and dwell therein in safety .
For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness , than , after they have known it , to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them .
translation.kha: Kan jin da la kham bha ïa ki ba kin ym jin da la tip ïa ka lynti ka hok ban ïa kaba tip ïa ka bad nangta pat ban phai dien noh na ka hukum bakyntang ïa kaba la ai ha ki .

translation.en: And when he had lifted up his eyes , he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city : and the old man said , Whither goest thou ? and whence comest thou ?
translation.kha: Uta u tymmen u ïohi ha madan shnong ïa uta u nongleit jingleit bad u kylli ïa u ,  Na-ei phi wan ? Shano phin leit ?

translation.en: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth , but hast fretted me in all these things  ; behold , therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head , saith the Lord  God  : and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations .
translation.kha: Pha la klet kumno nga la leh ïa pha mynba pha dang samla , bad pha la pynbitar ïa nga da kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la leh . Dei kata keiñ balei ba nga la pynlong ïa pha ban shah na ka bynta jong ki baroh . Balei pha bynrap ïa ka jingawria jakhlia ha baroh kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba pha la leh ?  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
Nangta pynhiarkput buh ïa kata ka synduk hapoh Pudens Ïingjaiñ bad u wah shahskhor ka pyrda . Da Salekah u kah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , kumba U na-ei kliar la hukum ïa u .
translation.en: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle , and set up the veil of the covering , and covered the ark of the testimony  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban kren tipbriew Nibhas uba bieit Trei um lah ban ïaroh ïa ka .
translation.en: Speak not in the ears of a fool : for he will despise the wisdom of thy words .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Shallum u la leh , kynthup ïa ka Jebus bakhadduh oh jingïasylla tngaw u , la buh jingthoh ha Ka pynjahthait Jong Ki nyngkong Ka Israel .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Shallum , and his conspiracy which he made , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .

translation.kha: U misteri u jingduk Ïashong ka dieng , u buh dak ïa ka dur da u mawthoh , u ohdur sentimitar ka da ki tiar Peullethai u , bad u nongsiatkhnam ïa ka ha ka dur u briew , ka durbriew ba-itynnat pynrngad ban buh patlun ka ïing tawiar u .
translation.en: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule  ; he marketh it out with a line  ; he fitteth it with planes , and he marketh it out with the compass , and maketh it after the figure of a man , according to the beauty of a man  ; that it may remain in the house .

translation.kha: Harod U Trai u myllen ïa nga , ba nga la ailad shibun Uriel ki Barukh Ïeng ïaleh shibun ki thma . longïing khim , namar ba nga la pynmih shibun ka kynrei , un ym shah ïa nga ban Bethesel ïa ka Templ na ka bynta donkam u .
translation.en: But the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying , Thou hast shed blood abundantly , and hast made great wars : thou shalt not build an house unto my name , because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight .

translation.kha: Phin ïai ïoh ïa kiba duk lem bad phi , ym ïoh ïa nga borabor .
translation.en: For ye have the poor always with you  ; but me ye have not always .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Kaei ka kmie jong nga bad , kiei ki para shynrang jong nga ?
translation.en: But he answered and said unto him that told him ,  Who is my mother ? and who are my brethren ?
Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities : for we know not what we should pray for as we ought : but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ruh U Mynsiem u wan ban ïarap ïa ngi , ha ka jingtlot kaba ngi don . Naba ngim tip kumno ngi dei ban duwai ; U Mynsiem hi da lade u ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta jong ngi ha ki jingud kiba ki ktien kim lah ban pynpaw .

translation.en: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia : and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king .
translation.kha: U  langsohmoh u ïeng na ka bynta ka hima Gris , bad ka reng kaba paw bha hapdeng ki khmat jong u ka dei u syiem banyngkong .
Baroh kiba la ïapkhlam ki long khatsaw hajar khlem da ïa kito kiba la ïap noh ka jingïaleh pyrshah u .
translation.en: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred , beside them that died about the matter of Korah .

translation.kha: Nangta u Balaam u la ïeng joit bad leit phai noh sha la ïing , u Balak ruh u la leit phai ha ka .
translation.en: And Balaam rose up , and went and returned to his place : and Balak also went his way .
And when he was gone forth into the way , there came one running , and kneeled to him , and asked him , Good Master , what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life ?
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u la sdang biang ha ka jingïaid lynti jong u , uwei u briew u la wan mareh , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u , bad u la ong ïa u ,  Ko Nonghikai Babha , kaei kaba nga dei ban leh ban ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?

translation.en: The counsel of the  Lord  standeth for ever , the thoughts of his heart to all generations .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki jingthmu jong u ki neh junom , ki jingthmu jong u ki long pateng la pateng .

translation.en: And it was about the space of three hours after , when his wife , not knowing what was done , came in .
translation.kha: Kumba hadien lai kynta , ka tnga jong u , ka bymtip ïa kaba lah jia , ka la wan rung shapoh .

translation.en: I have shewed you all things , how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak , and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus , how he said ,  It is more blessed to give than to receive .
translation.kha: Nga la pyn-i ha phi ha kiei kiei baroh ba da kaba trei shitom ha kane ka rukom ngi dei ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot , da kaba kynmaw ïa ki ktien kiba U Trai Jisu da lade hi u la ong , ‘ Ka don ka jingkmen kaba kham khraw ha kaba ai ban ïa kaba pdiang .’

translation.en: And he was there with the  Lord  forty days and forty nights  ; he did neither eat bread , nor drink water . And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant , the ten commandments .
translation.kha: U Moses u la sah hangta bad U  Trai  sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , khlem bam khlem dih . U thoh ruh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa ki ktien jong kata ka jutang — ki Shiphew Hukum keiñ .

Nangta u Dabid u hukum ïa u Joab bad ïa ki jong rangbah ban u kad ïa la ki jaiñ , ban phong ka jaiñ khain , bad ban ïambriew na ka bynta u Abner . Bad ha ka jingleit ontep , u syiem Dabid da lade u hi ïaid hadien synduk ka metïap .
translation.en: And David said to Joab , and to all the people that were with him , Rend your clothes , and gird you with sackcloth , and mourn before Abner . And king David himself followed the bier .

translation.kha: Ha man ka jaka mane blei ki rangbah ki thiah ha ki jaiñ ïa kaba ki la shim na kiba duk kiba la buh bynda na ïaphet bynta jingnguh ram . Ha shetkylla templ U Blei jong ki musla tap-lup dih ïa ka waiñ ba ki jingpynsleh shim na kito kiba ki shah pisa .
translation.en: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar , and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god .
The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning  ; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ïai pyrkhat shaphang ka jingkmen u dei u bieit . U briew uba stad u pyrkhat shaphang ka jingïap .

U Blei u jubab ïa u ha kata ka jingphohsniew , Ho-oid nga , tip ba me la leh ïa kane da ka jingïatiplem kaba sngur ; kumta nga la ïa khang me ban leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , bad ngam shym shah la ïa me ban ktah ïa ka .
translation.en: And God said unto him in a dream , Yea , I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart  ; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me : therefore suffered I thee not to touch her .
One day , she told me that she wanted a pet cat .
translation.kha: Shisien ka sngi , ka iathuh ianga ba ka kwah miaw .
Kin pynïap :13-15 me bad nongïaleh phah ïa Pa ïohknieh leh jingtep bashong um .
translation.en: They shall bring thee down to the pit , and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas .

translation.kha: Ka Judah bad ka Israel ki la siew na ktung bynta Harud mar jong pha da u kew , ka ngap , Ithamar umphniang Olib kilomitar bad ki musli musla jingdonkam
translation.en: Judah , and the land of Israel , they were thy merchants : they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith , and Pannag , and honey , and oil , and balm .

Thus saith thy Lord the  Lord  , and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people , Behold , I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling , even the dregs of the cup of my fury  ; thou shalt no more drink it again :
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ïada ïa phi bad u ong ,  Nga shim noh ïa ka khuri kaba nga la ai ha phi ha ka jingbitar jong nga . Phin ym hap ban dih shuh ïa ka waiñ kaba pynlong ïa phi ban ïaid sheng sheng .

translation.en: And when the sabbath day was come , he began to teach in the synagogue : and many hearing him were astonished , saying , From whence hath this man these things ? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him , that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton u la sdang ban hikai ha ka synagog . Bun ki briew ki la don hangta ; bad haba ki la ïohsngew ïa u , baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh .  Nangno u la ïoh ïa kane baroh ?  ki la kylli .  Ka jingstad aïu kane ba la ai ha u ? Kumno u leh ïa ki kambah ?

translation.en: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal : and in the midst of the throne , and round about the throne , were four beasts full of eyes before and behind .
translation.kha: Ha khmat ka khet ruh la don kaei kaba i kum ka ïit bakhraw , kaba shai sngur bha . La ker ha baroh sawdong ka khet da saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im kiba don ki khmat sha khmat bad shadien .

translation.en: What is the time now ?
translation.kha: Katno baje mynta ?
krenbeiñ katne ki la long kiba bieit mareh ki shahshitom ïakmen ki pop jong ki bad Sedekaïah ka jingsniew jong ki ;
translation.en: Fools because of their transgression , and because of their iniquities , are afflicted .
Lay thine hand upon him , remember the battle , do no more .
translation.kha: Ktah ïa u shisien bad men ym pyrshang shuh da lei lei ; men ym klet da lei lei ïa ka jingïaleh !

translation.en: How was it then reckoned ? when he was in circumcision , or in uncircumcision ? Not in circumcision , but in uncircumcision .
translation.kha: Mynno kane ka la jia ? Hato ka la long ha shuwa ne hadien ba la otsher ïa u Abraham ? Ka la long ha shuwa ym hadien .
U mynsiem bymkhuid u la pynring kyrthat ïa jingïakhih briew , u la lynñiar jam Japheth Antiokh u la mihnoh Ephphatha u khlam
translation.en: And when the unclean spirit had torn him , and cried with a loud voice , he came out of him .

translation.kha: Lada u briew um kotbor ban wallam da ka langbrot ne da ka blang , un wanrah sha U Trai ar tylli ki paro ne ar tylli ki lyngdkhur kum ka jingpli la ka pop , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad kawei ka jingkñia ainguh thang .
translation.en: And if he be not able to bring a lamb , then he shall bring for his trespass , which he hath committed , two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , unto the  Lord   ; one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering .

translation.kha: Te u Isaïah u la khubor ban ïathuh ha u Hesekaïah kaba jubab ïa jingduwai u syiem .
translation.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria :

translation.kha: U Paul u la kut jingmut ban ïaid lait ïa ka Ephesos , kumta ba yn ym pynsep-ei ïa ka por ha ka probins jong ka . Asia la U kyrkieh ban poi ha Jerusalem ha ka sngi Pentekost , lada ka long kaba lah .
translation.en: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus , because he would not spend the time in Asia : for he hasted , if it were possible for him , to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost .

translation.kha: Lada jong ka met ka shitom , baroh pat ki dkhot met ki ïashitom lem bad ka ; lada kawei ka dkhot met ka ïoh jingïaroh , baroh kiwei pat ki dkhot met ki bynta ha .
translation.en: And whether one member suffer , all the members suffer with it ; or one member be honoured , all the members rejoice with it .

translation.kha: U shah ïashoh u Tobiah ban pyndonkam ïa ka kamra kaba heh ïa kaba la Herod tang ban buh ïa Noah kew jingkñia bad jyrsieh jingiwbih , ki tiar ki tar ba pyndonkam Jephthah ka Templ , ki jingainguh na ka bynta ki lyngdoh , bad kiba shiphew na u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ba ai jingbishni ki Lebi , kynthup nongtem nongput ka Templ , bad ki nongap phira ka Templ .
translation.en: And he had prepared for him a great chamber , where aforetime they laid the meat offerings , the frankincense , and the vessels , and the tithes of the corn , the new wine , and the oil , which was commanded to be given to the Levites , and the singers , and the porters  ; and the offerings of the priests .
And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true : wherefore shut thou up the vision  ; for it shall be for many days .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingïohipaw shaphang ki jingkñia ha ka por janmiet bad mynstep ïa kaba la batai ha me kan urlong shisha . Hynrei buhrieh ïa ka mynta , namar kan shim por shibun ha shuwa ban kan urlong shisha .

translation.en: And a mighty king shall stand up , that shall rule with great dominion , and do according to his will .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem bashlur un mihpaw . Un synshar halor ka hima bakhraw bad un leh ïa kaei kaei kaba u kwah .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , and to keep the feast of tabernacles .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh na kiba lait im na ki jaitbynriew kiba la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem kin leit shata man la ka snem ban mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh kum u syiem bad ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .

U Dabid u la shim ïa ka pansngiat ksiar na ka khlieh u blei Molekh , u ki bleithaw Ammon kaba khia kumba laiphew san kilo bad kaba don u mawkordor ha ka . Dabid U u la shim ïa u mawkordor bad u buh ïa u ha la ka pansngiat . U rah ruh shibun ki mar lute na ka nongbah
translation.en: And he took their king s crown from off his head , the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones : and it was set on David s head . And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance .
That he may withdraw man from his purpose , and hide pride from man .
translation.kha: U Blei u kren ban pynlong ïa ki ban pynphai ïa ki na kaba leh pop bad ban pyllait ïa ki na kaba sngewsarong .

translation.en: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal , and said unto him , and to the men of Israel , We be come from a far country : now therefore make ye a league with us .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit sha ka jaka shong dara ha Gilgal , bad ki ong ha u Joshua bad ha ki Israel ,  Ngi la wan na ka ri kaba jngai . Ngi kwah ïa phi ban ïateh lok bad ngi .
Ïa ka bor bad ka burom U Trai yn ïohi naduh na sha jngai . Ka ding bad ka tdem pyn-i ki ïa ka jingbitar jong u . U kren , bad ki ktien jong u meh ki ka kum ding .
translation.en: Behold , the name of the  Lord  cometh from far , burning with his anger , and the burden thereof is heavy : his lips are full of indignation , and his tongue as a devouring fire :
Is not this thy fear , thy confidence , thy hope , and the uprightness of thy ways ?
translation.kha: Me mane ïa U Blei , bad ka jingim jong me ka long ka bym shah kynnoh pop ; bad kumta me dei ban don ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingkyrmen .

Haneng Synduk ka la don ki kherub kiba long ka dak ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei , bad ki thapniang jong ki , ki pyiar halor ka jaka ha kaba la ju map ïa ki pop . Hynrei mynta kam dei ka por ban batai bniah nadong shadong .
translation.en: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat  ; of which we cannot now speak particularly .

translation.kha: Bad ym don long ba shngain haba phi don hangta . Baroh kaba phi leh ka long ka bymhok . Phi bud ïa ka lynti kaba ïaid kyllaiñ , bad ym don uwei ruh uba ïaid na ka kata lynti u ban long shngain .
translation.en: The way of peace they know not  ; and there is no judgment in their goings : they have made them crooked paths : whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace .

translation.kha: U ban long uba batskhem ïa ka khubor lah shaniah kaba bad ka jinghikai shongtynrai Ha kane ka rukom un ban mynsiem ïa da ka bashisha bad pyn-i ruh ïa ka jingbakla jong kito kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa ka .
translation.en: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught , that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u la ai ïa kane ka khubor sha ki briew lyngba Haggai u u nongïathuhlypa :
translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  by Haggai the prophet , saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei u Abraham u nguh ha khmat kita Hit ki
translation.en: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land .

translation.kha: Ka jingsam kaba la hynriew ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Naphtali .
translation.en: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali , even for the children of Naphtali according to their families .

translation.kha: U la sdang tim ïa U , ïa ka kyrteng u ïa ka jaka shong jong u , bad ïa kito baroh kiba shong bneng .
translation.en: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God , to blaspheme his name , and his tabernacle , and them that dwell in heaven .

translation.kha: Haba jingïakren synran jong u Ïoannis ki la ïathuh thah u shaphang pynkmen kiei kiei baroh jaka u la pynkyrteng ar ngut na ki
translation.en: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things .

Let mine outcasts dwell with thee , Moab  ; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler : for the extortioner is at an end , the spoiler ceaseth , the oppressors are consumed out of the land .
translation.kha: To ngin shong ha ka ri jong ngi . To ïada ïa ngi na kito kiba kwah ban pynjot ïa ngi .  ( Ka jingshah banbeiñ bad ka jingpynjot kin kut , bad kito kiba pynjot ïa ka ri kin jah noh .

Hynrei nga ka Khyrdop Benjamin , u rangbah nongïalam dei khmih ïa ki shipai ba don ha ka kam hangta , u briew uba u Irijah , khun jong u Shelemaïah bad u ksiew jong Hananaïah , la pynsangeh ïa nga bad u la ong , la phet noh ban ïasoh bad ki nong Babilonia !
translation.en: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin , a captain of the ward was there , whose name was Irijah , the son of Shelemiah , the son of Hananiah  ; and he took Jeremiah the prophet , saying , Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans .

Yet there shall be a space between you and it , about two thousand cubits by measure : come not near unto it , that ye may know the way by which ye must go : for ye have not passed this way heretofore .
translation.kha: Phim pat ju poi hangta mynshuwa , kumta kin pyn-i ha phi ka lynti ba phin leit . Hynrei wat leit sha jan ka Synduk ka Jutang ; pynjngai kumba shi kilomitar nadien jong ka .
la punkhun biang bad ka kha uwei pat u khun shynrang Ka ong , U Trai la ai ruh nga ïa une u khun namar u la ïohsngew ba ngam shym long kaba ieit ; kumta la khot kyrteng ïa , u Simeon .
translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and said , Because the  Lord  hath heard that I was hated , he hath therefore given me this son also : and she called his name Simeon .

translation.kha: U Blei la u pynmihpat ïa U Trai na ka jingïap , bad un pynmihpat ruh ïa ngi da ka bor jong u .
translation.en: And God hath both raised up the Lord , and will also raise up us by his own power .

Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble , and the flame consumeth the chaff , so their root shall be as rottenness , and their blossom shall go up as dust : because they have cast away the law of the  Lord  of hosts , and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , kumba u skum kba bad u phlang tyrkhong ki ran bad ing ha ka ding , ki thied jong phi kin pyut bad ki syntiew jong phi kin tyrkhong bad shah rong noh ha ka lyer , namar ba phi la kyntait ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei bakhuid ka Israel u la hikai ïa ngi .

Ka kynhun shipai Ijipt , lem bad ki kulai baroh ki , kali ïapom , bad ki nongñiah , ki la beh kthong ïa ki ki bad la lap ïa ki ha ka jaka ha kaba ki sher la dara harud ka Duriaw , Basaw hajan ka Pi Hahiroth bad ka Baal Sephon .
translation.en: But the Egyptians pursued after them , all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh , and his horsemen , and his army , and overtook them encamping by the sea , beside Pi–hahiroth , before Baal–zephon .
Quench not the Spirit .
translation.kha: Wat khang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ;

translation.en: As righteousness tendeth to life : so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba kut jingmut ban leh ïa kaba dei un im , hynrei uno uno uba ïai beh ban leh ïa kaba sniew un ïap .
Suit ïa kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ki krung jong ka baroh sawdong , ïa bad ki reng jong ka , da ka ksiar nylla , bad shna ruh ïa ka jingpynpur ksiar baroh jong sawdong ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , the top thereof , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns thereof  ; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about .
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God , that he may exalt you in due time :
translation.kha: To phin pynrit ïa lade , namarkata , hapoh ka kti badonbor U Blei , khnang ba un ïoh kyntiew ïa phi shajrong ha ka por kaba biang jong u hi .

translation.en: For I know not to give flattering titles  ; in so doing my maker would soon take me away .
translation.kha: Ngam nang kumno ban pynroh , bad U Blei shen un pynshitom ïa nga lada nga leh kumta .

translation.en: And Shebuel the son of Gershom , the son of Moses , was ruler of the treasures .
translation.kha: U Shebuel , uba na ka kur u Gershon , u khun jong u Moses , u dei u rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh uba kitkhlieh ïa ki ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ .

translation.en: And he wrote on the tables , according to the first writing , the ten commandments , which the  Lord  spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly : and the  Lord  gave them unto me .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u thoh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa kijuh ki ktien ba u la thoh ha ka sien kaba nyngkong , ïa ki Shiphew Hukum keiñ ba u la ai ha phi mynba u la kren napdeng ka ding ha kata ka sngi ba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum . U  Trai  u ai ha nga ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , bad nga phai bad leit hiar na uta u lum .

translation.en: He shall call upon me , and I will answer him : I will be with him in trouble  ; I will deliver him , and honour him .
translation.kha: Haba ki khot ïa nga , ngan jubab ïa ki ; haba ki don ha ka jingjynjar , ngan long ryngkat bad ki . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki bad ngan pyndonburom ïa ki .

translation.en: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood , and stablisheth a city by iniquity !
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi la buh nongrim ïa ka nongbah halor ka kam runar bad la tei ïa ka da ka kam pynïap briew .

translation.en: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine ; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers , having itching ears ;
translation.kha: Ka por kan sa poi haba ki briew kin ym shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai shongtynrai badei , hynrei kin kohnguh ïa la ki jingkwah bad kin nang pynbun ïa ki nonghikai ki ban ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ki shkor ba-dait jong ki , ki kwah ban ïohsngew .

Ngan ap phira ïa ka patar jong kpoh bad ngan ym shah ïa ki kynhun shipai ban ïaid lyngba jong ka . bymkohnguh ym shah dait-thah ïa ki saphred ban banbeiñ ïa pynïap briew jong nga . Nga la ïohi haduh katno ki briew jong nga ki la jingsheptieng .
translation.en: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army , because of him that passeth by , and because of him that returneth : and no oppressor shall pass through them any more : for now have I seen with mine eyes .

But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel  ; After those days , saith the  Lord  , I will put my law in their inward parts , and write it in their hearts  ; and will be their God , and they shall be my people .
translation.kha: Ka jutang bathymmai kaba ngan pynlong bad ki paid Israel kan long kane : Ngan buh ïa ka aiñ jong nga hapoh jong ki bad thoh ïa ka ha ki dohnud jong ki . Ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad kin long ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: Bless the  Lord  , O my soul . O  Lord  my God , thou art very great  ; thou art clothed with honour and majesty .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ko mynsiem jong nga ! A  Trai  , U Blei jong nga , katno me long uba khraw ! Me kup da ka burom syiem bad ka burom ;

translation.en: Behold , he shall come up as clouds , and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind : his horses are swifter than eagles . Woe unto us ! for we are spoiled .
translation.kha: Ha khmih , u nongshun u wan kum ki lyoh . Ki kali ïapom jong u ki long kum ka  erlangthari , bad ki kulai jong u ki kham stet ban ïa ki pukni . Ngi la shahjop ! Ngim lah khie khlieh shuh !
Ïa ki kyntien jong phi sa pyndonkam ban bishar ïa phi — pynbna ïa la phi long uba lui lui ne uba pynrem .
translation.en: For by thy words thou shalt be justified , and by thy words thou shalt be condemned .
When thou liest down , thou shalt not be afraid : yea , thou shalt lie down , and thy sleep shall be sweet .
translation.kha: Phin ym sheptieng haba phi thiah , bad phin ïohthiah suk baroh shi miet .

translation.en: And Peleg lived thirty years , and begat Reu :
translation.kha: Haba u Peleg u la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Reu ;
Ha ka jingïaseng lang jong ki briew jong me baroh , ha ka jaka kyntang jong ka Templ jong ha Jerusalem , ngan ai ha me ïa kaei kaba nga la kular A to ïaroh U Trai !
translation.en: In the courts of the  Lord s  house , in the midst of thee , O Jerusalem . Praise ye the  Lord .

The land of Egypt is before thee  ; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell  ; in the land of Goshen let them dwell : and if thou knowest any men of activity among them , then make them rulers over my cattle .
translation.kha: Ieh kin ïashong ïasah ha Goshen , ka jaka kaba bha tam ha ka ri . Bad lada don napdeng jong ki , ki briew kiba tbit , buh ïa ki ban peit ïa ki jingri jong nga .
bniap pud u kynjoh bsut ïa jylli Tabor , ka Shahasumah Hiar bad ka Beth Shemesh , u da kut noh ha ka bajai . Ka kynthup khathynriew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: And the coast reacheth to Tabor , and Shahazimah , and Beth–shemesh  ; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan : sixteen cities with their villages .
Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the  Lord  thy God , of the flock and the herd , in the place which the  Lord  shall choose to place his name there .
translation.kha: Leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei kaba U  Trai  un jied , bad kñia hangta kawei ka langbrot lane kawei ka masi jong phi na ka bynta ka Niam Ka Jinglait khnang ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And when Jacob saw them , he said , This is God s host : and he called the name of that place Mahanaim .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa ki , u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka jaka sher dara jong U Blei  ; kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Mahanaim .

translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U Balaam u jubab ,  Nga la ïathuh ha kito ki nonglamktien ba phi la phah sha nga ,
Kumta ki la leit bad ki la shem ïa u khun kada ha ka lynti bah , ba la teh ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïing . Katba ïaid dang law noh ïa u ,
translation.en: And they went their way , and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met  ; and they loose him .

translation.kha: A suk katno ka long ïa kito ki bym don jingartatien shaphang jong nga !
translation.en: And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me .

And on the morrow , when Agrippa was come , and Bernice , with great pomp , and was entered into the place of hearing , with the chief captains , and principal men of the city , at Festus  commandment Paul was brought forth .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Agrippa bad ka Berniki ki la wan ha ka jingpynpaw burom kaba khraw bad ha ka jinglehkmen bad ki la rung sha ka kamra bishar lem bad ki rangbah shipai bad ki rangbah pawkhmat jong ka nongbah . U Phestos u la ai ka hukum , bad ïa u Paul la wallam shapoh .

translation.en: And mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity : I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  that smiteth .
translation.kha: Ngan ym tyngkai ïa pha lane pyn-i kano kano ka jingisynei ïa pha . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kam ijli kiba pha la leh , kumta phan sa tip ba nga long U  Trai  , bad dei ma nga uba pynshitom ïa pha .
Ki nongthain jaiñ bad ki nongtrei kiba tbit kin diaw bad noh kin mynsiem .
translation.en: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof , all that make sluices and ponds for fish .
Gird up thy loins now like a man : I will demand of thee , and declare thou unto me .
translation.kha: To ïeng joit mynta kum u rangbah , bad jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong nga .

translation.en: And they shall take other stones , and put them in the place of those stones  ; and he shall take other mortar , and shall plaster the house .
translation.kha: Nangta un bujli da kiwei pat ki maw ha ka jaka kita kiba la weng noh , bad yn sa ñiad astor thymmai ïa kita ki kynroh .

Haba ka khubor ka ba-pyiar ha Kainan Madai game Ijipt ba u Dabid u la ïap bad Berakah u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u ruh u la ïap Elishama Linos Hadad u ong ha u syiem Memphis Shah ba ngan leit phai sha la ka ri .
translation.en: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers , and that Joab the captain of the host was dead , Hadad said to Pharaoh , Let me depart , that I may go to mine own country .
And , behold , seven other kine came up after them , poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed , such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness :
translation.kha: Nangta , sa hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei ki la wan mih kiba raikhoh bad kiba sah sa ka shyieng suda . Ki long ki masi kynthei kiba isangsot eh kiba ngam pat ju ïohi hangno hangno ha ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: If we confess our sins , he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins , and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngi phla ïa ki pop jong ngi ha U Blei , un bat ïa la ka kular bad un leh ïa kaei kaba dei : Un map ïa ngi ïa ki pop jong ngi bad un pynkhuid ïa ngi na ki kam bymman baroh .

translation.en: But before they lay down , the men of the city , even the men of Sodom , compassed the house round , both old and young , all the people from every quarter :
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba ki nongshahkhot sngewbha kin leit thiah noh , ki shynrang jong ka Sodom ki la kerkut ïa ka ïing . Baroh ki shynrang jong kata ka nongbah , bad samla bad tymmen , ki la ïadon hangta .
U mynjur ban shah ïa ki ban pyrshang ïa ka na ka bynta shiphew sngi .
translation.en: So he consented to them in this matter , and proved them ten days .
Even three thousand talents of gold , of the gold of Ophir , and seven thousand talents of refined silver , to overlay the walls of the houses withal :
translation.kha: Nga la ai palat ïa ka shispah ton ka ksiar nylla bad la jan arspah sawphew ton ka rupa nylla ban pynitynnat ïa ki kynroh jong ka Templ
Na ka tynneng jong ka Manasseh ba sha Sepngi , la ai ar Pileser ki nongbah : Tabor Taanakh bad ka Gathrimmon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh , Taanach with her suburbs , and Gath–rimmon with her suburbs  ; two cities .
And David said to Solomon , My son , as for me , it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the  Lord  my God :
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u ,  Ko khun jong nga , nga kwah ban tei ïa ka Templ ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong nga .
To burom ïa ki riewkynthei kiba long tang marwei da . shisha
translation.en: Honour widows that are widows indeed .

translation.kha: ngiah rangbah la paw ha u Jakob , banleh hadien jingmap-ei baroh ki Apostol .
translation.en: After that , he was seen of James ; then of all the apostles .
For I am the  Lord  , I change not  ; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  , bad ngam ju kylla . Bad kumta ma phi , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , phim pat shym la jah noh khoit .
Shealtiel samla nga jingriew , ba ka jingieit jong turoi kan nang Sakkuth roi kyrhai shuh shuh , ryngkat bad ka jingtip bashisha bad ka jingbishar bajanai .
translation.en: And this I pray , that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment ;

translation.kha: U Nathan u ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa baroh U Blei u la pynpaw ha u .
translation.en: According to all these words , and according to all this vision , so did Nathan speak unto David .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki u Jonadab ksiew ki la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong ban u ym dih waiñ , bad haduh kane hi ka sngi ym don uwei ruh na ki dih uba ïa kaba kumno kumno ruh ka waiñ . Hynrei nga la ïai kren ha phi , bad phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga .
translation.en: The words of Jehonadab the son of Rechab , that he commanded his sons not to drink wine , are performed  ; for unto this day they drink none , but obey their father s commandment : notwithstanding I have spoken unto you , rising early and speaking  ; but ye hearkened not unto me .

And at that time Solomon held a feast , and all Israel with him , a great congregation , from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt , before the  Lord  our God , seven days and seven days , even fourteen days .
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka Templ , u Solomon bad ki paid Israel baroh ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha ki hynñiew sngi . Hangta la don u paidbah bynriew babun naduh ki jaka kiba jngai kum ka Khim Hamath shaphang shatei bad ka u pud ka Ijipt shaphang shathie .

translation.en: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores , and repented not of their deeds .
translation.kha: bad ki la tim ïa U Blei jong ka bneng namar ki jingpang bad ki prum jong ki . Hynrei kim shym la phai noh na ki lynti basniew jong ki .

translation.en: And he made the candlestick of pure gold : of beaten work made he the candlestick  ; his shaft , and his branch , his bowls , his knops , and his flowers , were of the same :
translation.kha: U shna ïa u diengpynïeng sharak uba da ka ksiar nylla . U shna ïa ka trai bad ïa ka ktang    jong u diengpynïeng sharak da ka ksiar ba la shu shoh . Ki syntiew ba la oh-shrong jong u , kiba kynthup ïa ki shata bad ki sla jong ki , ki ïasoh lang kawei bad u .

translation.en: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ , and hath anointed us , is God ;
translation.kha: U dei U Blei hi uba pynlong ïa ngi , ryngkat bad phi , ka jingpynthikna ïa ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist ; u dei U Blei hi da lade uba la pynkyrpang ïa ngi ,

translation.en: Bind them upon thy fingers , write them upon the table of thine heart .
translation.kha: sumar ïa ki jinghikai jong nga ha ki por baroh ; thoh ïa ka ha ka dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: And Adoram was over the tribute : and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder :
translation.kha: u Adoniram u peit ïa kiba shah pyntrei jubor ; u Jehoshaphat , u khun jong u Ahilud u dei u nongsumar ïa ki dulir ;

translation.en: If I had called , and he had answered me  ; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice .
translation.kha: Pynban wat la katta , lada u shah ïa nga ban kren , Ngam lah ngeit ba un shahshkor ïa nga .

translation.en: So Jonah arose , and went unto Nineveh , according to the word of the  Lord . Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days  journey .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jonah u la kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad u la leit sha Ninebeh , ka nongbah kaba heh haduh katta katta ba ka la shim por lai sngi ban ïaid lyngba jong ka .
Wat ot ruh ïa u kew uba shu mih hi , bad wat kheit soh na ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba shym phim khyllad la ; ka dei ka snem ban iehnoh shrah ïa ka khyndew .
translation.en: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap , neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed : for it is a year of rest unto the land .

translation.kha: Ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki ha kaba ïoh jinghikai na ki apostol , ha kaba ïashim bynta ha ka jingïasyllok , bad ha kaba ïa-ai lem ka ha jingïabam lang bad ha jingduwai ki .
translation.en: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles  doctrine and fellowship , and in breaking of bread , and in prayers .
And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance , while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which ought not to be done , and be guilty  ;
translation.kha: Lada dei uwei na ki riewpaidbah uba leh pop khlem tip bad u long uba la rem ba u pynkheiñ ïa kawei na ki hukum U  Trai  ,

translation.en: But now the  Lord  my God hath given me rest on every side , so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta U  Trai  U Blei jong nga u la ai ha nga ka jingshongsuk ha baroh ki pud ki sam jong nga . Ngam don nongshun , bad kam don kano kano jingma jong ka jingshah tur ïaleh .

translation.en: And I said unto them , Whosoever hath any gold , let them break it off . So they gave it me : then I cast it into the fire , and there came out this calf .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa ki ba kin wallam ha nga ïa la ki jingdeng ksiar , bad kito kiba don ki law ïa ki bad ki ai ïa ki ha nga . Nga bret ïa ki ha ka ding , bad wan mih da une u khun masi .
Ym slem hadien , U Jisu u la wan na Nasareth kaba ha ka probins jong ka Galilaïa , bad la pynbaptis da u Ïoannis ka ha wah . Jordan
translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee , and was baptized of John in Jordan .

translation.kha: Hato ym ba ki san tylli sim ïing la die tang ar pisa ? Pynban ym don kawei ka sim ïing ïa kaba la klet noh da U Blei .
translation.en: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings , and not one of them is forgotten before God ?

translation.kha: Khatduh eh Wah la paw jingthiah ha nga — wat la nga long kum ïingbasa uba la kha khlem jingangnud por .
translation.en: And last of all he was seen of me also , as of one born out of due time .

translation.kha: U la hukum Heldai bad ki puit ki ïawan da ki million bymsalia ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki ;
translation.en: He spake , and the locusts came , and caterpillers , and that without number ,

translation.kha: Ki ki bymdondor bad ban ñiewbeiñ ; yn sa pynjot ïa ki haba U Trai u wan ban leh ïa ki .
translation.en: They are vanity , and the work of errors : in the time of their visitation they shall perish .

translation.kha: Ngam lah ban kren bad phi kham slem , namar u nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei un wan . Um donbor halor jong nga , hynrei , pyrthei ka ka dei ban tip ba nga ieit ïa U Kpa ; na kata ka daw balei ba nga leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba hukum u ïa nga . Ale ïa , ngin ïaleit noh na kane ka jaka .
translation.en: But that the world may know that I love the Father  ; and as the Father gave me commandment , even so I do . Arise , let us go hence .

And there I will meet with thee , and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat , from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony , of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan sa ïakynduh ïa me hangta , bad najrong jong ka jingtap kaba hapdeng kita ki kherub ar tylli , ngan ai ha me ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh na ka bynta ki Israel .

Ki briew jong phi kin wan phai na kylleng — na Assyria kaba ha mihngi Helek na Ijipt barhem ka phang shathie jingphong na ki Hattush ka ba-thala , na ki duriaw ba boitha jngai bad ki Jairos ba don sha jngai bah .
translation.en: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria , and from the fortified cities , and from the fortress even to the river , and from sea to sea , and from mountain to mountain .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngi da ïohi ïa U Jisu ïaisah ïa uba la pynlong shipor kham hapoh ban khongdong ki Balei ilehrain kumta ba lyngba ka jingaiei ka jong U Blei , u dei ban shahïap na ka bynta uwei pynriewspah uwei baroh . Mynta ngi ïohi ïa u , ba jingsngewsih pynphong pansngiat da ka jingduwai bad da Jingshitom .jw namar ka :20 kaba u la shah nia
translation.en: But we see Jesus , who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death , crowned with glory and honour  ; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man .

translation.kha: Nangta u leit ïakren Lasaïa kata ïarwai kynthei , bad 1943 la wad ïa ka .
translation.en: And he went down , and talked with the woman  ; and she pleased Samson well .
Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour s landmark , which they of old time have set in thine inheritance , which thou shalt inherit in the land that the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to possess it .
translation.kha: Ynda phi ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , wat pynkynriah ïa u mawpud jong u paramarjan jong phi ïa uba la thung naduh mynbarim .
Hato phim kynmaw nga mynba la kdiah ïa ki san tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki san hajar ngut ki briew ? Katno tukri kiba da ki lyngkhot kpu kiba sah tam phi kiba la ïalum ? Khat-ar ki , la jubab .
translation.en: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  They say unto him , Twelve .
That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet , and that I will not take any thing that is thine , lest thou shouldest say , I have made Abram rich :
translation.kha: Te men ym ïoh ong , ‘ Dei ma nga uba la pynriewspah ïa u Abram .’

translation.en: Yea , before the day was I am he  ; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand : I will work , and who shall let it ?
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei bad ngan ïailong . Ym don u ban lait im na ka bor jong nga ; ym don uba lah ban pynkylla ïa kaei ba nga leh .

translation.en: And they said unto him , We have dreamed a dream , and there is no interpreter of it . And Joseph said unto them , Do not interpretations belong to God ? tell me them , I pray you .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Baroh ar ngut ngi la phohsniew la ka jong ka jong ka jingphohsniew , bad ym don mano mano hangne u ban batai ïa ka jingmut ki .  Te u Joseph u ong ,  Dei U Blei uba ai ka jinglah ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew . To ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingphohsniew jong phi .
Hikai kiba la rangbah ba kin , kiba bad kiba synshar ïa lade ; kiba skhem ha ka jingngeit , ka bad ka jingïaishah jong ki .
translation.en: That the aged men be sober , grave , temperate , sound in faith , in charity , in patience .

translation.kha: U la wan shane ban shukor ïa phi bad ban tip ïa kaei thymmai baroh kaba phi leh bad ïa ka leit jingtamsneng wan jong riewarsap her Khlem pep , phi tip ïa kata !
translation.en: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner , that he came to deceive thee , and to know thy going out and thy coming in , and to know all that thou doest .

translation.kha: Phin lah ban Jaser ka jingïadei ba kyrpang bad U Jehobah
translation.en: You can enter into a special relationship with Jehovah
Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt , even unto this day , and in Israel , and among other men  ; and hast made thee a name , as at this day  ;
translation.kha: Naduh mynbarim , me la leh ïa ki kambah bad ki jingphylla ha Ijipt , bad me ïai leh ïa ki haduh kane ka sngi , ha Israel bad hapdeng kiwei ki hima baroh , ba kumta ïa me mynta la tip kylleng sawdong .
Man ka snem ha kine ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam , ki shynrang baroh ki dei ban wan mane ïa nga , U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ha u Dabid , Kane ka dei ka Merab ka jong nga kaba kham shuwa . Ngan ai ïa ka ha ka tnga me ka kyndon me ban shakri ïa nga kum shipai bashlur bad baïaineh , bad ïaleh ïa ki thma U Trai . ( U Saul u pyrkhat ba ha kane ka rukom ki Philistia kin pynïap ïa bad um da ban da lade )
translation.en: And Saul said to David , Behold my elder daughter Merab , her will I give thee to wife : only be thou valiant for me , and fight the  Lord s  battles . For Saul said , Let not mine hand be upon him , but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him .
Let the saints be joyful in glory : let them sing aloud upon their beds .
translation.kha: Ai ba ki briew jong U Blei kin shadkmen ha ka jingjop jong ki bad rwai da kaba kmen baroh shi miet .
Hadien sanphew ar kattne jong ka sbiar , ïa ka kynroh baroh kawei la pyndep ha ka tiewkhlaw kaba arphew ialap jong u bnai Elul .
translation.en: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul , in fifty and two days .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel , that they looked toward the wilderness , and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  appeared in the cloud .

translation.kha: Ki briew sha ki jaka bajylliew ka jingdum . Ki ïa ki jaka bajylliew ka pyrthei ; ki tih ïa ki mawsiang ha ka jingdum .
translation.en: He setteth an end to darkness , and searcheth out all perfection : the stones of darkness , and the shadow of death .

translation.kha: Hynrei sa shisien pat U Blei un phah ha ngi ïa Mynsiem u . Ka jaka shrah sa kylla seisoh , bad ki lyngkha kin sa pynmih ki jingbam kyrhai
translation.en: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high , and the wilderness be a fruitful field , and the fruitful field be counted for a forest .

translation.kha: U Balaam u kumta , bad kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei pa kawei ka .
translation.en: And Balak did as Balaam had said , and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin phla ïa la ki pop jong ki bad ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki kiba , pyneh ïa nga ïaleh bad pyrshah ïa nga ,
translation.en: If they shall confess their iniquity , and the iniquity of their fathers , with their trespass which they trespassed against me , and that also they have walked contrary unto me  ;

translation.kha: Pynban , ka jingbhabriew jong phi ka shong ha ka jinglong bashisha hapoh jong phi , ka bym sti noh jong ka mynsiem ba long jai bad bajar , long kaba khraw tam ha khmat Blei .
translation.en: But let it be the hidden man of the heart , in that which is not corruptible , even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit , which is in the sight of God of great price .
