Namar kane ka daw , haba U Khrist u la dei ban wan Jong kane ka pyrthei u la ong ha U Blei : Mem kwah ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki lym , jingjynjar me la pynkhreh ka met na ka bynta jong Imnah Kyntang
translation.en: Wherefore when he cometh into the world , he saith , Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not , but a body hast thou prepared me :

Let it rest on the head of Joab , and on all his father s house  ; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue , or that is a leper , or that leaneth on a staff , or that falleth on the sword , or that lacketh bread .
translation.kha: To ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta kane kan hap halor u Joab bad ka longïing jong u baroh ! Ha kawei pa kawei ka pateng to yn don u shynrang ha ka longïing jong u , uba don ka jingpang  ñiangkulia lane ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba shyrkhei lane uba hap ban trei tang ïa ka kam ba trei ki kynthei lane uba shah pynïap ha ka thma lane uba kyrduh bam !

translation.en: Take him , and look well to him , and do him no harm  ; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee .
translation.kha: Khie leit wad ïa u Jeremaïah bad sumar bha ïa u . Wat pynmynsaw ïa u , hynrei leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u kwah .
Sa shisien pat ka Judah kan long ka nongkynti bakyrpang jong U Trai ha ri ka bakyntang jong u , bad ka Jerusalem kan long ka nongbah u kaba ieit tam na baroh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land , and shall choose Jerusalem again .
They shall bring thee down to the pit , and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas .
translation.kha: Kin pynïap ïa me bad kin phah ïa me sha ka jingtep bashong um .

translation.en: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant , even as I had pity on thee ?
translation.kha: Me la dei ban don jingisynei ïa la u para shakri , kumba nga la isynei ïa me .’

translation.en: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan , which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei , who remained of the remnant of the giants : for these did Moses smite , and cast them out .
translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka hima jong u Og , uba khatduh jong ki Rephaim , uba la synshar ha Ashtaroth bad Edrei . U Moses u la jop ïa kine ki briew bad u la beh noh ïa ki .
A phi ki nong Galatia kiba bieit! Uei uba la pynthame ïa phi ? Ha khmat ki khmat jong hi phi la batai shai kdar ïa ka jingïap U Khrist Jisu halor ka diengphna!
translation.en: O foolish Galatians , who hath bewitched you , that ye should not obey the truth , before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth , crucified among you ?
Then said the  Lord  unto Isaiah , Go forth now to meet Ahaz , thou , and Shear–jashub thy son , at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller s field  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Isaïah ,  To shim ïa u Shear Jashub u khun jong me , bad khie leit ban ïakynduh ïa u Syiem Ahas . Men shem ïa u ha ka lynti ha kaba ki nongthain jaiñ ki treikam , ha kaba kut ka nala kaba wallam um na ka pung kaba haneng .

U Solomon u jubab bakynjang Me la ju ïai proh ka jingieit bakhraw ïa u Dabid , u kpa jong nga , u shakri pynsaphred me , bad u phlang long uba bha , Hadad ïaineh , bad wahbah hok ha Kim Ma jong u bad me . Bad Neng la ïai bteng ban pyn-i ha u ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad baneh skhem da kaba ai ha u ïa sngewbha khun uba mynta u synshar ha ka jaka Birsha u .
translation.en: And Solomon said , Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy , according as he walked before thee in truth , and in righteousness , and in uprightness of heart with thee  ; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness , that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne , as it is this day .
And the  Lord  thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies , and on them that hate thee , which persecuted thee .
translation.kha: Un pynngat kylla ïa kine ki jingtim baroh ha ki nongshun jong phi , kiba isih bad banbeiñ ïa phi ,

translation.en: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon , to declare in Zion the vengeance of the  Lord  our God , the vengeance of his temple .
translation.kha: ( Ki nongphetwir ki la lait phet na Babilonia bad wan sha Jerusalem , bad ki ïathuh kumno U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u siew kylliang na ka bynta kaei kaba ki nong Babilonia ki la leh ïa ka Templ jong u . )
Hynrei ki Israel ong , Balei ngin pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad phi ? lah ban long pynban ba phi shong phi .
translation.en: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites , Peradventure ye dwell among us  ; and how shall we make a league with you ?
The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God , those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban ai sngewbha sha U Blei ha Jerusalem ïa baroh ki khiew ki pliang ïa kiba la ai ha phi ban pyndonkam ha ki jingshakri ha ka Templ .

translation.en: And the Hittites , and the Perizzites , and the Rephaims ,
translation.kha: ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Rephaim ,

translation.en: Shall I not visit them for these things ? saith the  Lord  : shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?
translation.kha: Hato ngan ym pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kine kiei kiei ? Hato ngan ym pynhiarkput halor ka jaitbynriew kaba kum kane ? Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway .
translation.kha: Ïa ka miej dei ban buh ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad u kpu ainguh uba kyntang u dei ban don halor jong ka borabor .

translation.en: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind , he chose of all the choice men of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians :
translation.kha: U Joab u la ïohi ba ka kynhun u nongshun kan tur ïaleh ïa u na sha khmat bad na shadien , kumta u la jied ïa kiba kynsai tam na ki shipai Israel , bad u la buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki Syria .
ngan kynmaw ïa la ka :6 ha phi bad ha ki mrad jyrthiaw ba ka jingshlei um da lei lei ruh Rabbah ym pynjot shuh Merathaim ki jingthaw ba-im baroh .
translation.en: And I will remember my covenant , which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh  ; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh .
Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God , so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear .
translation.kha: Ka long da ka jingngeit ba ngi sngewthuh ba la pynlong ïa ka pyrthei da ka ktien U Blei , khnang ba ïa kaei kaba lah ban ïohi la pynlong na kaei ka bymlah ban ïohi .

translation.en: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume .
translation.kha: Ki khñiang kin bam duh ïa ki dieng bad ki jingthung jong phi baroh .

U Moses u khot lang ïa ki Israel baroh bad snier ong ha ki Gederah Ko phi ki Ayyah , shahshkor ïa Pynim hukum baroh ïa kiba ngan ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Pule ïa ki bad pynthikna ba phi kohnguh ïa ki .
translation.en: And Moses called all Israel , and said unto them , Hear , O Israel , the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day , that ye may learn them , and keep , and do them .
This is the interpretation of the thing : MENE  ; God hath numbered thy kingdom , and finished it .
translation.kha: Bad kane ka dei ka jingmut jong ka :  Ka dak jingkheiñ  , U Blei u la kheiñ ïa ki sngi jong ka hima jong phi bad u la wallam ïa ka sha ka jingkut ;

translation.en: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe , that observe and do  ; but do not ye after their works : for they say , and do not .
translation.kha: Kumta phi dei ban kohnguh bad leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki ong ïa phi ban leh ; pynban , wat pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki ; namar ba kim leh ïa kaei kaba ki ïalap .
U shakri u pynmih ka shabar khang jingkhang . Ka Tamar kup ïa ka sopti jynsur kaba , jait jaiñ ba ju phong da syiem kynthei ki bym pat shongkurim ha kito ki sngi .
translation.en: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her : for with such robes were the king s daughters that were virgins apparelled . Then his servant brought her out , and bolted the door after her .

translation.en: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end :

translation.kha: Lada u jop bad u pynïap ïa nga , ngin jingkynting noh ki longrynïeng jong phi ; hynrei lada ma nga , nga lypa bad nga pynïap ïa u , phin long ki mraw jong ngi .
translation.en: If he be able to fight with me , and to kill me , then will we be your servants : but if I prevail against him , and kill him , then shall ye be our servants , and serve us .
To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you , and not to boast in another man s line of things made ready to our hand .
translation.kha: Te ngi lah ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kiwei pat ki ri jngai na phi bad yn ym donkam ban leh sarong shaphang ka jingtrei ïa kaba la lah leh lypa ha ka lyngkha jong uwei pat u briew .

translation.en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him , and saith of him ,  Behold an Israelite indeed , in whom is no guile !
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa u Nathanael ba u wan sha u , u la ong shaphang jong u ,  Une u dei u kynja Israel uba shisha , ym don kano kano ka bymshisha ha u !

translation.en: He cropped off the top of his young twigs , and carried it into a land of traffick  ; he set it in a city of merchants .
translation.kha: kaba u la rah sha ka ri jingkhaïi bad u la buh ha ka nongbah ki nongkhaïi .

translation.en: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes .
translation.kha: U briew uba don ha ka lyngkha um dei ban phai dien ban leit shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong u .

translation.en: But I know thy abode , and thy going out , and thy coming in , and thy rage against me .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip lut shaphang jong me , kaei ba me leh bad shano me leit , bad nga tip kumno ba me bitar shla pyrshah ïa nga .

Kan sa long ka sngi dum kaba bad kaba pynlong jingkhuslai , ka sngi kaba ïong bad ba-dum lyoh . Ka kynhun bakhraw jong ki puit ka tur kum ka jingdum kaba pyiar halor ki lumbah . Ym ju mynno don mynno kum ruh kane , bad yn don ym shuh lano lano ruh .
translation.en: A day of darkness and of gloominess , a day of clouds and of thick darkness , as the morning spread upon the mountains : a great people and a strong  ; there hath not been ever the like , neither shall be any more after it , even to the years of many generations .

translation.en: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh–naphtali , and said unto him , Hath not the  Lord  God of Israel commanded , saying , Go and draw toward mount Tabor , and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun ?

And Boaz answered and said unto her , It hath fully been shewed me , all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband : and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother , and the land of thy nativity , and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore .
translation.kha: U Boas u jubab ,  Nga la ïohsngew shaphang kiei kiei baroh kaba phi la leh ïa la ka kiaw kurim naduh ba u tnga jong phi u la ïap . translation.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans , but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon , and shall speak with him mouth to mouth , and his eyes shall behold his eyes  ;
translation.kha: Yn aiti noh ïa u ha u syiem ka Babilonia ; un peit ïa u markhmat bad un kren ïa u hi da lade .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ngi tip kaei ka jingieit : U Khrist u la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi . Ngi ruh , namarkata , ngi dei ban ai ïa la ki jingim na ka bynta ki parabriew !

translation.en: But he said , I am not mad , most noble Festus  ; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness .

Pynbeit la ki khun katba ki dang lung ban shah . Lada phim leh kumta , phi ïarap ïa ki pynjot da hi .
translation.en: Chasten thy son while there is hope , and let not thy soul spare for his crying .

translation.en: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare , and into many foolish and hurtful lusts , which drown men in destruction and perdition .

translation.en: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee , then he shall count with him , and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the people rose early , and built there an altar , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings .

translation.en: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers , nor rejoiced  ; I sat alone because of thy hand : for thou hast filled me with indignation .

translation.en: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones  ; for I say unto you , That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven .

translation.kha: Hillel ïa U Trai ! Tel Belteshassar ki la kut jingmut Stakhos Tba pynkhuid Holocaust paidbah da kaba kmen u tyrwa mon sngewbha nguid
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord  for the avenging of Israel , when the people willingly offered themselves .

translation.en: Behold , to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail , such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now .
For the  Lord  hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep , and hath closed your eyes : the prophets and your rulers , the seers hath he covered .

translation.en: This is the water of Meribah  ; because the children of Israel strove with the  Lord  , and he was sanctified in them .

translation.en: And they said , What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpah to the  Lord  ? And , behold , there came none to the camp from Jabesh–gilead to the assembly .
For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved .
