U paralok jong nga uba don ha ka jingleit u dang shu wan poi ha ka ïing jong , shym don ei ei jong u !’
translation.en: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me , and I have nothing to set before him ?
As it is written , Behold , I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence : and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed .
translation.kha: uba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka kren shaphang uta :  Ha khmih , nga buh ha Seïon ïa u maw u ban pynlong ïa ki briew ban jynthut , u mawsiang u ban pynlong ïa ki ban kyllon . Hynrei uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym shem ïa kaba sngewsih .

translation.en: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding , that the king enquired of them , he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm .
translation.kha: Kam pher kaei ka jingkylli ba u syiem u la kylli , lane kano ka jingeh kaba u pynpaw , kine ki saw ngut ki la kham tip shiphew shah ban ïa uno uno u nongbatai kupar lane u nongleh myntor ha ka hima jong u baroh kawei .

translation.en: Thou blind Pharisee , cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter , that the outside of them may be clean also .
translation.kha: Ko Pharisi bamatlah ! To pynkhuid nyngkong ïa kaei kaba shapoh jong ka khuri , bad nangta kaba shabar kan long ruh kaba khuid !
Baroh ki kut pha kin long kum ki Dumbur bad ki soh Dumbur ba la ih Khynñiuh ïa ki dieng bad ki soh kin hap beit hapoh ka jong pha !
translation.en: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs : if they be shaken , they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater .
He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly : and a man of wicked devices is hated .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shit khlieh ki leh ïa ki kam bieit ; ki briew kiba stad ki long jai jai .
Ngam dei u nongthaw jingkulmar tyngkreiñ u Elijah u la jubab . Dei ma phi — ma phi bad u kpa jong phi . Phim shym ujor kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Trai bad phi mane ïa ki bleithaw Messaïah Baal .
translation.en: And he answered , I have not troubled Israel  ; but thou , and thy father s house , in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the  Lord  , and thou hast followed Baalim .

translation.kha: Ka khubor shaphang kane ka la poi ha ka Balang ha Jerusalem , kumta ki la phah ïa u Barnabas sha . Antiokh
translation.en: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem : and they sent forth Barnabas , that he should go as far as Antioch .
And they feared exceedingly , and said one to another , What manner of man is this , that even the wind and the sea obey him ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la sheptieng haduh katta katta bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Uei une u briew ? Wat ka lyer bad ki jingat phyllung ki kohnguh ïa u !

translation.en: If they say , Come with us , let us lay wait for blood , let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause :
translation.kha: Tharai lada ki ong ,  Ale ngin leit apthap ïano ïano ban ïoh pynïap ! Ïa ngin leit tur ïaleh ïa ki briew kiba lui lui tang ban shu ïoh leh dusmon !

translation.en: Yet they say , The  Lord  shall not see , neither shall the God of Jacob regard it .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  U  Trai  um ym ïohi ïa ngi ; U Blei ki Israel um ithuh ei ei .
biar u syiem u Stoik khot ïa u Siba , u shakri jong u Saul , bad u ong , Nga ai ha u Mephibosheth , u Sha jong u ïasyllok jong me , ïa baroh kaba dei ka jong u Saul bad ka longïing jong Arkhippos .
translation.en: Then the king called to Ziba , Saul s servant , and said unto him , I have given unto thy master s son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house .
And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar , and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god .
translation.kha: Ha man ka jaka mane blei ki rangbah ki thiah ha ki jaiñ ïa kaba ki la shim na kiba duk kiba la buh bynda na ka bynta ki ram . Ha ka templ U Blei jong ki , ki dih ïa ka waiñ ba ki la shim na kito kiba ki shah pisa .
Wat kmie ka jong u kam kynmaw shuh ïa u mynta ; la bam ïa u da ki ksaiñ la bad pynjot kum ïa u dieng ba la khyllem .
translation.en: The womb shall forget him  ; the worm shall feed sweetly on him  ; he shall be no more remembered  ; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree .
In one house shall it be eaten  ; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house  ; neither shall ye break a bone thereof .
translation.kha: Dei ban bam ïa ka jingbam baroh hapoh ka ïing ha kaba la khreh ïa ka ; phim bit ban rah ïa ka shabar ; bad ym dei ban pynkheiñ wat tang kawei ruh ka shyieng jong u mrad .
Ko khun u briew , yn sa khum sa teh ïa me da ki tyllai , bad men ym lah ban sha leit jaka paidbah .
translation.en: But thou , O son of man , behold , they shall put bands upon thee , and shall bind thee with them , and thou shalt not go out among them :
Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt : for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward .
translation.kha: U la ñiew ba ka jingshah krenbeiñ na ka bynta U Messaïah ka long kaba kham kordor bun shah ban ïa ka spah baroh jong ka ri Ijipt , naba u khmih lynti ïa ka bainong ka ban sa wan .

translation.en: And Saul sent to Jesse , saying , Let David , I pray thee , stand before me  ; for he hath found favour in my sight .
translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u phah khubor sha u Jesse :  Nga sngewbha eh ïa u Dabid . Ieh un sah hangne ha ka jingtrei bad nga .
ka da pyrta jam ha ki khyrdop nongbah bad kat haba ki ki briew ïalumlang :
translation.en: She crieth in the chief place of concourse , in the openings of the gates : in the city she uttereth her words , saying ,

translation.kha: Kum ki wah kiba la sangeh noh ban tuid , bad ki pung-um kiba la noh ,
translation.en: As the waters fail from the sea , and the flood decayeth and drieth up :
Who shall declare his way to his face ? and who shall repay him what he hath done ?
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano u ban pharep ïa u briew uba sniew lane ban siew kylliang ïa u na ka bynta baroh kaba u la leh .
Mynta leit bad ai ïa kane khubor ki synran jong u , kynthup u Petros ‘ Un leit sha Galilaïa ha shuwa jong phi hangta phin ïohi ïa u , kumba u ong ha phi
translation.en: But go your way , tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee : there shall ye see him , as he said unto you .

translation.kha: Kito kiba buh la ka jingshaniah ha ka Sudan bad kob ka Ijipt kin shaïong ki jingkyrmen jong ki .
translation.en: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation , and of Egypt their glory .
And I , brethren , if I yet preach circumcision , why do I yet suffer persecution ? then is the offence of the cross ceased .
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong nga , ko parabangeit , lada nga dang bteng ban ïalap ba ka jingotsher ka long kaba donkam , balei te ba nga dang shah pynshitom beiñ ? Lada kata ka la long kaba shisha , te ka jingïalap jong nga ïa ka diengphna U Khrist kan ym long daw jingeh ei ei .

translation.en: He answered and said to Arioch the king s captain , Why is the decree so hasty from the king ? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel .
translation.kha: u la kylli ïa u Ariokh balei ba u syiem u la pynmih kum kane ka hukum kaba eh . Kumta u Ariokh u la ïathuh ïa u Daniel ïa kaei kaba la lah jia .
Ki jyrthiaw kin phi ban sumar ïa ki jong bad phin long ki jong nga .
translation.en: That ye may remember , and do all my commandments , and be holy unto your God .

And I called for a drought upon the land , and upon the mountains , and upon the corn , and upon the new wine , and upon the oil , and upon that which the ground bringeth forth , and upon men , and upon cattle , and upon all the labour of the hands .
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ka jingtyrkhong ha ka ri — ha ki lumrit jong ka , ha ki lyngkha kew jong ka , ki bri sohwaiñ , ki brisoh Olib — ha baroh ki jingthung kiba ka khyndew ka pynmih , ha ki briew bad ki mrad , ha baroh kiba phi pyrshang ban pynmih .
ngan sa kynmaw ïa la ka jutang ba nga la pynlong bad u Jakob bad u Isaak bad u Abraham , bad ngan sa pynthymmai ïa la ka Hoglah ban ai ïa kata ka ri ha ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob , and also my covenant with Isaac , and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember  ; and I will remember the land .
And , behold , there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy .
translation.kha: Uwei u briew uba ki kjat bad ki kti jong u ki la sieb u la wan sha U Jisu ,

Nga tip ba shnongrit ka hukum jong mar , phin sa ryntih ïa ki nongïamareh bymman bad kyntait ïa jingpyndap nga la hikai ïa Pynleit :4–12 awria ha ki sngi ki ban ba-im ka prong kan ngat ha suidñiew , namar ba phin pynbitar ïa U Trai da kaba phi leh ïa kata 16 u pynïatylli Elon .
translation.en: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves , and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you  ; and evil will befall you in the latter days  ; because ye will do evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands .
Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born again , he cannot see the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Ym don uba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Hima U Blei lymda kha pat ïa u .
Haba ngi pyndap ïa kine ki pla snieh , waiñ ki dang thymmai , hynrei ha khmih ! Ki la jot . Ki jaiñ bad ki juti ngi jong ki la jot namar ka jingïaid lynti kaba jngai .
translation.en: And these bottles of wine , which we filled , were new  ; and , behold , they be rent : and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey .
And he turned him unto his disciples , and said privately ,  Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see :
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la phai sha ki synran bad u la ong ha ki ha kaba rieh ,  A katno phi long kiba donbok ban ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba phi ïohi !
Simeon ba phi ïai syngkhlieh ïa nga bameh ki ktien ?
translation.en: How long will ye vex my soul , and break me in pieces with words ?
When a man s ways please the  Lord  , he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him .
translation.kha: Haba phi pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , phi lah ban pynkylla paralok ïa ki nongshun jong phi .

Haba ki la pyndap ïa kita ki khra baroh , ka jingïania kylli la dang don skain ne em . Uto u dei uba khatduh , uwei na ki khun Rehum jong ka u jingpynsngewbha . Bad longing umphniang Olib ka jingbrai sangeh ban tuid .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the vessels were full , that she said unto her son , Bring me yet a vessel . And he said unto her , There is not a vessel more . And the oil stayed .

translation.kha: Jingdon la khot ïa pynpait u shakri , bad u hylla , Beh noh ïa kane ka Shabar na khmat jong nga pyndei Pynmih Jethro ka shabar Oholibah khang ïa ka jingkhang !
translation.en: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him , and said , Put now this woman out from me , and bolt the door after her .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngi ki jong ka sngi bad ngi dei ban pyngngad . Ngi dei ban kup ïa ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingieit kum ka , bad ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ïa ka jingpynim ka jingda khlieh .
translation.en: But let us , who are of the day , be sober , putting on the breastplate of faith and love ; and for an helmet , the hope of salvation .
How much more , when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed ? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand , and take you away from the earth ?
translation.kha: Katno kaba kham sniew kan long ïa ki riewbymman kiba pynïap ïa u briew uba lui lui uba dang ïohthiah ha la ka jong ka ïing ! Mynta ngan pynhiarkput ïa phi namar ka jingpynïap ïa u bad ngan pyndam ïa phi na sla khyndew !

ka Siba kan sa wan pynthait ki briew jong phi , bad ïa ki kut jong phi baroh yn pynjot . Kan long kum Ryngkat sngi ha kaba u syiem Shalman u la pynjot ïa ka nongbah Betharbel ha Ebes thma Jeshua ha kaba ïa ki kmie khadu ki khun jong ki la Nongshun haduh ban da ïap .
translation.en: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people , and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled , as Shalman spoiled Beth–arbel in the day of battle : the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children .
Tell ye the daughter of Sion , Behold , thy King cometh unto thee , meek , and sitting upon an ass , and a colt the foal of an ass .
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ka nongbah Seïon , ha khmih , u Syiem jong pha u wan sha pha ! U long uba sngewrit bad u shong halor ka kada bad halor u khun kada .

translation.en: And the woman conceived , and bare a son : and when she saw him that he was a goodly child , she hid him three months .
translation.kha: Haba ka ïohi ba u long u khunlung uba bhabriew , ka buhrieh ïa u lai bnai .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the light shall not be clear , nor dark :
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don shuh ka jingkhriat lane u thah ,

translation.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood , the forgiveness of sins , according to the riches of his grace ;
translation.kha: Naba da ka jingïap ba la kñia jong U Khrist la pyllaitluid ïa ngi , kata ka long , ïa ki pop jong ngi la map ei .
U Lasaros u la mihnoh , ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong la kyllaiñ u da ki jaiñsop kiba ïa ïap bad , da ka jaiñ la teh ïa ka khmat jong u . To law noh na u , U Jisu u la ong ha ki , bad ai ba un ïaid .
translation.en: And he that was dead came forth , bound hand and foot with graveclothes : and his face was bound about with a napkin . Jesus saith unto them ,  Loose him , and let him go .

translation.kha: ( U Shemida u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ahian , u Shekhem , u Likhi , bad u Aniam . )
translation.en: And the sons of Shemida were , Ahian , and Shechem , and Likhi , and Aniam .
Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jehonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us , to drink no wine all our days , we , our wives , our sons , nor our daughters  ;
translation.kha: Ngi la kohnguh ïa baroh ki jingbthah ba u Jonadab u la ai ha ngi . Ma ngi hi ngim ju dih waiñ , lymne ki tnga jong ngi , ki khun shynrang jong ngi , lane ki khun kynthei jong ngi .
Ha ka , nga ong ha , ki jong Blei ki risa halor uwei u nongpop uba kylla-kaba-mut .
translation.en: Likewise , I say unto you , there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth .

translation.kha: rashi kham bha bashong bashyrkhei ka ri shyiap ban ïa kaba bad ka tnga Haman bunktien bad wanna thnum Jotham
translation.en: It is better to dwell in the wilderness , than with a contentious and an angry woman .
Men and brethren , this scripture must needs have been fulfilled , which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas , which was guide to them that took Jesus .
translation.kha: Ko hynmen ko para jong nga ,  u la ong ,  ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka dei ban urlong shisha ha kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u kren lyngba u Dabid , u la pynlong ka jingïathuh lypa shaphang u Judas , uba la long u nongïalam ïa kito kiba la kem ïa U Jisu .
Nangta ka punkhun biang bad ka kha sa pat uwei u khun shynrang . Ka ong , Ha kane ka sien ngan ïaroh ïa U Trai ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa , u u Judah Nangta . ka la wai noh ban ïoh khun .
translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son : and she said , Now will I praise the  Lord  : therefore she called his name Judah  ; and left bearing .
Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew ka Sebulun bad Naphtali , Ki kheiñduh la ka jingim ha ka madan thma .

translation.en: Then came the same Sheshbazzar , and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem : and since that time even until now hath it been in building , and yet it is not finished .
translation.kha: Kumta u Sheshbassar u la wan bad buh ïa ka nongrim jong ka ; ka jingtrei ka la ïaid naduh kata ka por haduh mynta , hynrei ym pat pyndep ïa ka Templ .’

Kynmaw kumno U Trai Blei jong phi u la ïalam ïa phi baroh shi lynter lyngba ka ri ha kine snem kiba la dep ba un pyndem ïa phi u tynjuh ïa phi ba un ïoh tip phi thmu leh , bad la phin kohnguh ne em ïa ki jong
translation.en: And thou shalt remember all the way which the  Lord  thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness , to humble thee , and to prove thee , to know what was in thine heart , whether thou wouldest keep his commandments , or no .
And he made an house of high places , and made priests of the lowest of the people , which were not of the sons of Levi .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u tei ruh ïa ki jaka mane ha kliar ki lum , bad u jied ïa ki lyngdoh napdeng ki longïing ki bym dei na ka jait Lebi .

translation.en: Who died for us , that , whether we wake or sleep , we should live together with him .
translation.kha: uba la ïap na ka bynta jong ngi khnang ba ngi lah ban ïa-im lem bad u , la ngi im lane ngi ïap haba u wan .
Ki khun jong u briew uba bha kin long kiba donbor ka ha ; ri ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin long kiba la kyrkhu .
translation.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth : the generation of the upright shall be blessed .

translation.kha: Phi tip ba mynba phi long kiba mane bleithaw , la ïalam sakma ïa phi ha ki rukom kiba bun sha ki jingmane ïa bleithaw ki bym don jingim .
translation.en: Ye know that ye were Gentiles , carried away unto these dumb idols , even as ye were led .
And they had hair as the hair of women , and their teeth were as the teeth of lions .
translation.kha: U shñiuh jong ki u long kum u shñiuh kynthei , ki bniat jong ki , ki long kum ki bniat sing .

translation.en: When goods increase , they are increased that eat them : and what good is there to the owners thereof , saving the beholding of them with their eyes ?
translation.kha: Kat phi nang roi ha ka spah , katta ki shyntur phin hap ban bsa . Baroh kaba phi ïohnong ka dei ka jingtip ba phi long uba riewspah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  hath given a commandment concerning thee , that no more of thy name be sown : out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image : I will make thy grave  ; for thou art vile .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la rai shaphang ki nong Assyria :  Kin ym don kino kino kiba hiarpateng ki ban bah ïa ka kyrteng jong ki . Ngan pynjot ïa ki bleithaw kiba don hapoh ka templ jong ki blei jong ki . Nga pynkhreh ka jingtep ïa ki nong Assyria — kim don hok ban im !
batip por kan Ïingtrep haba U kliang sakma prie ïa ki bor ba-halor bad drama ki nongsynshar ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high , and the kings of the earth upon the earth .

translation.kha: Hadien kata jingpynïap , kita kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la lute ïa ban pynhiarkput namar ka jingpynkheiñ burom ïa para jong ki .
translation.en: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain , and spoiled the city , because they had defiled their sister .

Be patient therefore , brethren , unto the coming of the Lord . Behold , the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth , and hath long patience for it , until he receive the early and latter rain .
translation.kha: To long kiba ïaishah , namarkata , ko parabangeit jong nga , haduh ba U Trai un wan . Khmih katno u nongrep u long uba ïaishah haba u ap ïa la ka khyndew ban pynmih ïa ki jingthung kiba kordor . U ïaishah ban ap ïa u slap synrai bad ïa u slap pyrem .

translation.en: These things speak , and exhort , and rebuke with all authority . Let no man despise thee .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa kine kiei kiei bad pyndonkam pura ïa la ka iktiar haba me ai mynsiem bad haba sneng ïa ki nongsngap jong me . Wat ai ïano ïano na ki ban ibeiñ ïa me .

translation.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth : the strength of the hills is his also .
translation.kha: U synshar halor ka pyrthei baroh , na ki krem kiba jylliew tam sha kliar ki lum bajrong tam .

translation.en: Then Nathan said unto David , Do all that is in thine heart  ; for God is with thee .
translation.kha: U Nathan u jubab ,  Leh kat kaba don ha ka jingmut jong phi , namar U Blei u long ryngkat bad phi .
Leh ïa ki kumba phi leh ïa u Israel , bad ïa phi ieit ïa lade . Kynmaw ba phi ruh phi la long ki nongwei ha ri Ijipt . Nga U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you , and thou shalt love him as thyself  ; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka pynbuh briew u bad ka nong Ijipt .
translation.en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran : and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Ki dei liengbah ki kiba wan na ki ri kiba jngai , ki wallam ïa ki paidlang U Blei sha la ïing . Ki wanrah ryngkat bad ki ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , pyndonburom ban ïa ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei Bakhuid ka , Israel uba pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh pyndonburom ban ïa ki briew jong u .
translation.en: Surely the isles shall wait for me , and the ships of Tarshish first , to bring thy sons from far , their silver and their gold with them , unto the name of the  Lord  thy God , and to the Holy One of Israel , because he hath glorified thee .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka kamra , don saw tylli ki miej , ar tylli ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka kamra . Dei halor kine miej la pynïap ïa ki mrad dei ai kum ki jingkñia , lane ban thang tylli , lane ban long ki sait pop ne kum ki jingtyrwa siew .
translation.en: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side , and two tables on that side , to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering .
For by fire and by his sword will the  Lord  plead with all flesh : and the slain of the  Lord  shall be many .
translation.kha: Da ka ding bad ka waitlam un pynshitom ïa ki briew baroh jong ka pyrthei kiba u shem ba la pynrem — bad shibun kin shah pynïap .

translation.en: Tremble , ye women that are at ease  ; be troubled , ye careless ones : strip you , and make you bare , and gird sackcloth upon your loins .
translation.kha: Phi la ju im suk , phim don ki jingkhuslai ; hynrei mynta , to khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng ! To loit ïa la ki jaiñ bad teh da ki jaiñjot sawdong ïa la ka syngkai .

translation.en: And the wild asses did stand in the high places , they snuffed up the wind like dragons  ; their eyes did fail , because there was no grass .
translation.kha: Ki kada khlaw ki ïeng halor ki kliar lum bad ki thrang ban ring mynsiem kum ki myrsiang ; ka jingïohi ki khmat jong ki kam ïarap ïa ki namar kim don jingbam .

translation.en: And there were some that had indignation within themselves , and said , Why was this waste of the ointment made ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew kiba don hangta ki la bitar bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Kaei ka jingmyntoi ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka jingsleh iwbih ?
Nangta ki nongïalam baroh na kata ka shnong kaba jan eh bad ka jaka ha kaba shem ïa kin thet ïa la ki kti halor kata ka masi
translation.en: And all the elders of that city , that are next unto the slain man , shall wash their hands over the heifer that is beheaded in the valley :

translation.kha: U syiem Shishak u wan bad u shim ïa ki jingkynshew na ka Templ bad na ka ïingsyiem U shim lut ïa kiei kiei kaba kynthup ïa ki ksiar kaba u syiem Solomon u la thaw .
translation.en: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem , and took away the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house  ; he took all : he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made .

translation.kha: Yn sdang don uwei ruh Jisu kyn-ih u ban hap hikai ïa Memphis u Horanaim ri ban tip ïa U Trai , bashisha baroh kin tip ïa nga , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam . Ngan map bahynriew ki Shekanaïah jong ki bymdonbor jingkhawai Shemuel kynmaw jing phrung wah jingbakla jong ki . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la ,’ .
translation.en: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the  Lord  : for they shall all know me , from the least of them unto the greatest of them , saith the  Lord  : for I will forgive their iniquity , and I will remember their sin no more .
He watereth the hills from his chambers : the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works .
translation.kha: Na suiñbneng me phah ïa u slap halor ki lum , bad ïa ka pyrthei la pyndap da ki jingkyrkhu jong me .

translation.en: Stablish thy word unto thy servant , who is devoted to thy fear .
translation.kha: Pyndep ïa ka kular jong me ha nga , u shakri jong me — ka jingkular kaba me pynlong ha kito kiba kohnguh ïa me .
Hato don uno uno hapdeng jong phi uba dang kynmaw katno ka jingiphuh ka Templ ka la ju long Kumno ? ïohi phi ïa kane mynta ? Ka paw kumba kam long ei ei ruh .
translation.en: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory ? and how do ye see it now ? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing ?

translation.kha: U u Joseph jubab , Lada phim don pisa shuh , wallam ïa ki jingri jong ; phi te ngan ïapli ïa ka jingbam bad kita ki jingri .
translation.en: And Joseph said , Give your cattle  ; and I will give you for your cattle , if money fail .

And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself , and took the captains of hundreds , Azariah the son of Jeroham , and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan , and Azariah the son of Obed , and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah , and Elishaphat the son of Zichri , into covenant with him .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingap kaba hynriew snem , u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u la rai ba ka la dei ka por ban leh ei ei . U ïateh kular bad san ngut ki rangbah shipai : u Asaraïah u khun jong u Jeroham , u Ishmael u khun jong u Jehohanan , u Asaraïah u khun jong u Obed , u Maaseïah u khun jong u Adaïah , bad u Elishaphat u khun jong u Sikhri .
U Trai u ong , U shakri jong nga un jop ha ka kam jong u ; un ïoh ka burom . bakhraw
translation.en: Behold , my servant shall deal prudently , he shall be exalted and extolled , and be very high .
Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem :
translation.kha: U Manasseh u la don khat-ar snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar ha Jerusalem sanphew san snem .

translation.en: And the Egyptians evil entreated us , and afflicted us , and laid upon us hard bondage :
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki lehbeiñ ïa ngi bad pyntrei jubor ïa ngi kum ki mraw .
Haba ka ïohi ba long u u khunlung uba bhabriew , ka buhrieh ïa u lai bnai .
translation.en: And the woman conceived , and bare a son : and when she saw him that he was a goodly child , she hid him three months .

translation.kha: Pynban , ngi kren U Blei kwah ngi kumta , namar u la ñiew ïa ngi kiba bit ban shaniah ïa ka Khubor Babha . Ngim shym pyrshang ban ïa ki briew , hynrei ban ïa U Blei , ïa ki jingthmu ngi .
translation.en: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel , even so we speak ; not as pleasing men , but God , which trieth our hearts .

translation.kha: Ijon ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai , kadiang ïa ka bna siew ka kali , bad ba-im paradais kawei jingkynjah synduk kaba pynhiarkput syndah jong ka ïa kita ki dur kiba da ka ksiar ba phi phah sha u kum ka Salu namar iakane pop jong phi nongïalam —Ephesos ïa badonbok kali ha ka lynti jong ka bad khi kan ïasheptieng hi .
translation.en: And take the ark of the  Lord  , and lay it upon the cart  ; and put the jewels of gold , which ye return him for a trespass offering , in a coffer by the side thereof  ; and send it away , that it may go .
Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant , when , lo , he had given his hand , and hath done all these things , he shall not escape .
translation.kha: U la pynkheiñ ïa la ka jingsmai bad ïa ka jingïateh lok kaba u la lah pynlong . U la leh ïa kine kiei kiei , bad mynta un ym ïohlait ban phet .

translation.en: If thou wert pure and upright  ; surely now he would awake for thee , and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous .
translation.kha: lada me long uba hok bad uba khuid , te U Blei um wan ban ïarap ïa me bad pynïoh pat ïa ka ïing ka sem jong me kum ka bainong .

Nangta un thang preg ka khleiñ Gomorrah u baroh halor ka duwan , kumba ju thang ïa Pynjot khleiñ jong ki mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ki shlei ïasyllok . Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar Jong pop jong uta u nongsynshar arphew bad yn map ïa u .
translation.en: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar , as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings : and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin , and it shall be forgiven him .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban kynmaw , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba bunsien nga la thmu ban wan jngoh Resen phi , hynrei don kaei kaei kaba la ju khang ïa nga borabor na kaba leh kumta . Nga synduk ban jop ïa ki mynsiem napdeng jong phi ruh , kumba shipa la ju leh hapdeng kiwei ki Jentil .
translation.en: Now I would not have you ignorant , brethren , that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you , (but was let hitherto ,) that I might have some fruit among you also , even as among other Gentiles .
God also told Noah to build a huge boat , called an ark , and to take into it his family and every sort of animal .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ruh ha u Noah ban thaw ïa ka ïinglieng kaba heh , bad ban wallam ïa la ka ïing ka sem bad ki mrad ba laiphew jait hapoh jong ka .

translation.en: And Paul , earnestly beholding the council , said , Men and brethren , I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day .
translation.kha: U Paul u la peit shlip sha ka Dorbar bad u la ong ,  Ko ki para nong Israel jong nga ! Ka jingïatiplem jong nga ka sngur shaphang ka rukom ha kaba nga la im ha khmat U Blei haduh kane ka sngi .
Bad U Blei u la pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong u Elparan ngi da kaba phah ïa la U Khun ba marwei sha ka pyrthei ïashongkurim jingshna ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingim da Nisan .
translation.en: In this was manifested the love of God toward us , because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world , that we might live through him .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka long kaba shisha bad don sabut ban pyn-i ba kata briew ka long kaba dang ,
translation.en: But if this thing be true , and the tokens of virginity be not found for the damsel :
And great multitudes were gathered together unto him , so that he went into a ship , and sat  ; and the whole multitude stood on the shore .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïalum sawdong ïa u , ki la bun katta katta haduh ba u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la shong ha ka , katba ki paidbah ki la ïeng harud duriaw .
Bad na ka pynrit jong Dieng nga pynkyntang ïa lade sha me , khnang ba ma ki artatien Maki ki Lamekh ban long kiba la ïoh pynkyntang da shisha sha me .
translation.en: And for their sakes I sanctify myself , that they also might be sanctified through the truth .

translation.kha: Nangne ong , Kynrad , baroh Tubal ïadon khat-ar ngut shi leilieh Tel ki khun jong ujuh u briew Tba ka ri Kanaan . Uwei jingrem para u la ïap , bad uba khatduh u don mynta bad i pa .
translation.en: And they said , Thy servants are twelve brethren , the sons of one man in the land of Canaan  ; and , behold , the youngest is this day with our father , and one is not .

translation.kha: Kumta u u Aaron rah ïa la u diengduh kita halor ki um ; te ki jakoid ki ïamih bad ki tap lin ïa kata ka ri .
translation.en: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt  ; and the frogs came up , and covered the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Hynrei ban pyllait ïa nga na kaba da dap ka jingsarong namar kiei kiei kiba bun kiba phylla ba nga la , ïohi la buh ha nga ïa ka jingpang kaba jur ha ka met , long kaba kum u nonglamktien jong Soitan u ban pynshitom ïa nga bad ban pyllait ïa nga na ka jingsngew sarong .
translation.en: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations , there was given to me a thorn in the flesh , the messenger of Satan to buffet me , lest I should be exalted above measure .
Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem three months . And his mother s name was Nehushta , the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Jehoïakhin u la don khatphra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Nehushta , ka khun jong u Elnathan uba na Jerusalem .

translation.en: All hands shall be feeble , and all knees shall be weak as water .
translation.kha: Ki kti uwei pa uwei kin tlot , bad ki khohsiew kin kyiuh .
Uta uba ot u ïoh la pynpur bainong bad u iada ïa ka jingmih na ka bynta Maakah jingim bymjukut ; ba uta Bidkar bet bad uta shin ot kin ïakmen shoh-ïap .
translation.en: And he that reapeth receiveth wages , and gathereth fruit unto life eternal : that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together .

translation.kha: Katba u dang bet ïa u symbai ha ka lyngkha , khyndiat na u symbai u Iathuh hap bajyrngam lynter Beon dakhol ïaid kjat Jied bad ki pud ki la wan bad bam noh .
translation.en: And when he sowed , some seeds fell by the way side , and the fowls came and devoured them up :

translation.kha: U syiem un ïam pangnud , u khun syiem un duh jingkyrmen , bad Elparan briew kin khynñiuh Phira ka jingsheptieng . Ngan pynshitom ïa phi na ka bynta :9-11 kaba phi la leh , ba-mynshuwa nongpruid bishar ïa phi ha kajuh ka rukom kumba phi la bishar ïa Mejarkon . Kane kan pyn-i ha phi ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: The king shall mourn , and the prince shall be clothed with desolation , and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled : I will do unto them after their way , and according to their deserts will I judge them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

And Absalom met the servants of David . And Absalom rode upon a mule , and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak , and his head caught hold of the oak , and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth  ; and the mule that was under him went away .
translation.kha: Kynsan u Absalom u ïakynduh katto katne ki rangbah jong u Dabid . U Absalom u dang shong ha u khashor , bad katba u khashor u dang ïaid napoh u dieng Sning uba heh , ka khlieh u Absalom ka sahkut ha ki tnat dieng . U khashor u la mareh bad u Absalom u la shah iehnoh da kaba sdien ha shiteng suiñ .
Nga la ha kren ki nongïathuhlypa bad ai ha ki shibun ki jingïohipaw , bad lyngba nongïathuhlypa ki nga ai jingmaham ïa ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: I have also spoken by the prophets , and I have multiplied visions , and used similitudes , by the ministry of the prophets .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don uwei u koidi uba pawnam uba kyrteng u Jisu Barabbas .
translation.en: And they had then a notable prisoner , called Barabbas .

translation.kha: Ki maw khyndew ki don u mawkordor Sapphir , bad ki pui pui jong ki ksiar .
translation.en: The stones of it are the place of sapphires : and it hath dust of gold .
And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry : and I will multiply them , and they shall not be few  ; I will also glorify them , and they shall not be small .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sah hangta kin rwai ïaroh ; kin pyrta jam da ka jingkmen . Da ka jingkyrkhu jong nga kin roi ha ka jingbun paid ; ka jingkyrkhu jong nga kan wallam ha ki ka burom .
U Philip u la jubab , Lada uwei uwei un ïoh tang khyndiat , kan palat ïa ka arspah tylli sbai rupa ban thied kpu kat ban .
translation.en: Philip answered him , Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them , that every one of them may take a little .
And the  Lord  was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him : and I prayed for Aaron also the same time .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa u Aaron ruh kat ban pynïap ïa u ; kumta ha kajuh ka por nga duwai na ka bynta jong u ruh .

translation.en: Lord , they have killed thy prophets , and digged down thine altars ; and I am left alone , and they seek my life .
translation.kha: Ko Trai , ki la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me bad pynkhyllem ïa ki duwan jong me ; nga long sa tang ma nga marwei uba sah , bad ki pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga .
U Makhir u pynïoh kawei ka tnga ïa u Huppim bad kawei pat ïa u Shuppim . Ka para jong u ka kyrteng ka Maakah . U Julius uba ar jong u Makhir u dei u Selophehad , bad u don tang ki khun kynthei .
translation.en: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim , whose sister s name was Maachah  ; ) and the name of the second was Zelophehad : and Zelophehad had daughters .
And Jesus stood still , and called them , and said ,  What will ye that I shall do unto you ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la khot ïa ki .  Kaei phi kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong phi ?  u la kylli ïa ki .

translation.en: Remember this , and shew yourselves men : bring it again to mind , O ye transgressors .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kane , phi ki nongpop ; pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba nga la leh .

To ïam lyng-a to ud jingpeitbha ko dieng Kseh-Sypress — ki nonglur ki la kyllon shyllangmat ïa kito ki dieng badonburom la pynjot ! mar ïam tyrtho to ud , ko ki dieng Sning jong ka Bashan — ïa ka khlaw kaba rben la khet noh !
translation.en: Howl , fir tree  ; for the cedar is fallen  ; because the mighty are spoiled : howl , O ye oaks of Bashan  ; for the forest of the vintage is come down .

translation.kha: to long kiba sngewnguh ha kiei kiei baroh . Kane ka long kaei kaba U kwah Blei u na phi ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: In every thing give thanks : for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you .

translation.kha: Ynda u Moses rumal la lah ïakren bad ki , u tap ïa la ka khmat da ka jaiñtapkhmat .
translation.en: And till Moses had done speaking with them , he put a veil on his face .
Can a man be profitable unto God , as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself ?
translation.kha: Hato don u briew , wat la u long uba stad tam , uba la ju long uba larkam na ka bynta U Blei ?

Ko Patsha ka Assyria Rum kyrdoh lat kassia me ki la ïap , bad ki rangbah donburom jong me ki ïohthiah junom ! Ïa ki briew jong me la pynsakma sieh ki ïatur , bad ym don shuh mano mano ban wallam Seus ïa ki sha ïing .
translation.en: Thy shepherds slumber , O king of Assyria : thy nobles shall dwell in the dust : thy people is scattered upon the mountains , and no man gathereth them .

translation.kha: Te u la sha ïingsyiem , sha ka kamra u sekretari ka ïingbishar ha kaba baroh ki rangbah synshar ki dang ha ka . U Elishama , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , Delaïah u khun jong u Shemaïah , u Elnathan u khun jong Akhbor , Gemaraïah khun jong u Shaphan , Sedekaïah u khun u Hananaïah , pat ki rangbah ki la don hangta .
translation.en: Then he went down into the king s house , into the scribe s chamber : and , lo , all the princes sat there , even Elishama the scribe , and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah , and Elnathan the son of Achbor , and Gemariah the son of Shaphan , and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah , and all the princes .
When will God bring an end to evil on earth ?
translation.kha: Lano U Blei un pynkut ïa ki jingsniew ha pyrthei ?
Katba ki dang wan hiar na u lumbah , U Jisu Utai la hukum ïa ki , Wat ïathuh nongïohipaw hano ruh ïa kane ka jingïohipaw kaba phi la ïohi tad haduh ba ïa U Khun U seh la Geba na ka jingïap .
translation.en: And as they came down from the mountain , Jesus charged them , saying ,  Tell the vision to no man , until the Son of man be risen again from the dead .
In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin : but he that refraineth his lips is wise .
translation.kha: Katba phi nang bunktien , katta phi nang leh pop . Lada phi long uba stad phin sngap jar .

translation.en: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition , which ye have delivered : and many such like things do ye .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ka jinghikai ba phi ai pateng sha kiwei pat ka pynduh noh ïa ka ktien jong U Blei . Bad don bun kiwei kiei kiei kum kane kaba phi leh .
Khynñiuh kumta nga la ïaid ha ka traishnong ryngkat ñiew Kingdom Trai ha Bneng pyrthei jong kiba im .
translation.en: I will walk before the  Lord  in the land of the living .

translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , la ki bud ïa u . U la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki , u la kren ha ki shaphang ka Hima U , Blei bad u la pynkhiah ïa kiba kito donkam ïa ka .
translation.en: And the people , when they knew it , followed him : and he received them , and spake unto them of the kingdom of God , and healed them that had need of healing .

translation.kha: Kumta u Haman shapoh , u syiem u ong ha u , Don nga eh ban lehburom ngan na une u briew ? U Haman u la ha lade , Mynta ïano syiem u kwah eh ban pyndonburom ? Dei ïa keiñ .
translation.en: So Haman came in . And the king said unto him , What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour ? Now Haman thought in his heart , To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself ?

And I went out by night by the gate of the valley , even before the dragon well , and to the dung port , and viewed the walls of Jerusalem , which were broken down , and the gates thereof were consumed with fire .
translation.kha: Ka dang long mynmiet katba nga la mihnoh na ka nongbah lyngba ka Khyrdop Them shaphang sepngi bad leit shaphang shathie da kaba ïaid lait ïa ka Umpohliew u Ïakjakor sha ka Khyrdop Synrum . Katba nga dang leit , nga khmih ïa ki kynroh ba la pra jong ka nongbah bad ki khyrdop ïa kiba la pynjot da ka ding .

translation.en: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain  ; and ye say , that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen nong Samaria jong nga ki la ïamane ïa U Blei halor une u lum , hynrei phi ki Jiw phi ong ba ka Jerusalem ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ngi dei ban mane ïa U Blei .

U Trai u ong pynïashong u Joshua , kulmar kaba nga leh Mynta Pamphylia sngi kan pynlong ïa ki paid Israel baroh ban sdang ban burom ïa me kum u riewkhraw , bad kin Lukios tip ba nga long lem ryngkat badno Menna kumba nga la long bad u Moses .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel , that they may know that , as I was with Moses , so I will be with thee .

translation.kha: Ka Syiem jong Sheba ka shaphang ka Solomon , bad ka leit sha Jerusalem ban u da ki jingkylli kiba eh .
translation.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the  Lord  , she came to prove him with hard questions .
Wherefore now let the fear of the  Lord  be upon you  ; take heed and do it : for there is no iniquity with the  Lord  our God , nor respect of persons , nor taking of gifts .
translation.kha: Burom ïa U  Trai  bad trei bha , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi um lah shah ïa ka jingleh bymdei lane ka jingleh shiliang khmat lane ka jingshim pisa thok .

translation.en: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years , and saw his sons , and his sons  sons , even four generations .
translation.kha: U Job u la im shispah sawphew snem hadien kane , ka jingim kaba la jlan bha kat ban ïohi ïa ki ksiew bad ïa ki ksiew tun .
Katto katne ki leit da ka liengbah halor ka duriaw-bah , ki trei na bynta ka ka jingim jong ki ha ki duriaw-rit .
translation.en: They that go down to the sea in ships , that do business in great waters  ;
By long forbearing is a prince persuaded , and a soft tongue breaketh the bone .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaishah ba pynkohnguh ka lah ban pynpra ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah bakhlaiñ tam bad ka lah ban pynngeit wat ïa ki nongsynshar .

translation.en: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them , and will bring them again to their folds  ; and they shall be fruitful and increase .
translation.kha: Ngan lum ïa kiba sah na ki briew jong nga na ki ri kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha la ka jong ka ri . Kin ïoh bun ki khun bad kin nang roi ha ka jingbun briew .

translation.en: ( Luke 23 :43 ) Also , millions of dead ones will be resurrected to human life on the earth .
translation.kha: ( Loukas 23 :43 ) Shuh shuh yn sa pynmihpat ïa ki milian ngut ki briew kiba la ïap sha ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: But if we hope for that we see not , then do we with patience wait for it .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngi kyrmen ïa kaei kaba ngim ïohi , ngi ap ïa kata da ka jingïaishah .

translation.en: And Samuel said unto Saul , I will not return with thee : for thou hast rejected the word of the  Lord  , and the  Lord  hath rejected thee from being king over Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan ym leit phai bad phi ,  u Samuel u jubab .  Phi la kyntait ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , bad u la kyntait ïa phi kum u syiem ki Israel .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of the men of Anathoth , that seek thy life , saying , Prophesy not in the name of the  Lord  , that thou die not by our hand :
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Anathoth ki la kwah ïa nga ban shah pynïap , bad ki la ong ïa nga ba kin pynïap ïa nga lada nga dang ïai pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel , then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers , and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received : so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance .
translation.kha: Hynrei kynmaw , lada ki ïashongkurim bad ki shynrang kiba na kawei pat ka jait , ka bri ka khyndew jong ki kan long noh ka jong kata ka jait , bad ka bynta kaba dei ka jong ngi kan nang duna .

translation.en: Then the Spirit said unto Philip , Go near , and join thyself to this chariot .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la ong ha u Philip ,  Khie leit sha jan ka kali kulai bad bud mar jan ïa ka .

translation.en: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him , when he fought with Hazael king of Syria . ) And Jehu said , If it be your minds , then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehu u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Joram uba dang don ha Jesreel , ha kaba u la leit ban ïoh jingkoit na ki jingmong kiba u la ïoh ha ka thma ha Ramoth pyrshah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria . Kumta u Jehu u la ong ha ki para rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Lada phi don bad nga , pynthikna ba uwei ruh na phi un ym leit noh na Ramoth bad maham ïa ki briew jong ka Jesreel .

ther u Samuel u shim shi klong ka bujli Teresh bad u theh Heber ka ha ka khlieh u Saul , u doh ïa u , bad u ong , U Trai u la pynsleh ïa me Babel u nongsynshar ki briew nongpynkha u , ki lymne . Men synshar ïa ki briew jong u Probins Hena ïada ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki . Bad kane nongbat long ka khap Rakkon me ba U Trai u la pynsleh ïa me ban long Nongpynjot nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong u :
translation.en: Then Samuel took a vial of oil , and poured it upon his head , and kissed him , and said , Is it not because the  Lord  hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance ?
Backbiters , haters of God , despiteful , proud , boasters , inventors of evil things , disobedient to parents ,
translation.kha: Ki ïa-lorni bad kren sniew uwei ïa uwei pat ; ki long kiba shun ïa U Blei , kiba pynbitar , kiba sarong bad kiba sngewmeng ; ki pyrkhat ïa kiba bun ki lynti ban leh ïa kaba sniew ; kim kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa ;

bad artet lyngba ka Hinnom Them ter ter sha ka bashathie phang jong u lum ha kaba don ka nongbah Jerusalem jong ki Jebus . Nangta u pud u kiew artet sha ka kliar u lum ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Them Hinnom , ha ka tduh ka bashatei jong Them Rephaim .
translation.en: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite  ; the same is Jerusalem : and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward , which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward :
Thus said the  Lord  unto me  ; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people , whereby the kings of Judah come in , and by the which they go out , and in all the gates of Jerusalem  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , khie leit bad pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga ha ka Khyrdop Paidbah , kaba lyngba jong ka ki syiem jong ka Judah ki rung shapoh bad mih shabar ka nongbah ; nangta leit sha baroh kiwei pat ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem .
Namar kane ka daw , nga u Paul , u nongsah byndi U ka bynta Jentil , nga duwai ha U Blei .
translation.en: For this cause I Paul , the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles ,

translation.kha: khlem da shim ïa ki jong khun nga bad kñia ïa ki ha ki bleithaw ?
translation.en: That thou hast slain my children , and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them ?
Neither as being lords over God s heritage , but being ensamples to the flock .
translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban leh trai khlieh halor kito ha kiba la ai ïa phi ban sumar , hynrei to long ka nuksa ïa ka kynhun .

translation.en: Is Christ divided ? was Paul crucified for you ? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul ?
translation.kha: Te ïa U Khrist la phiah ha ki kynhun ! Hato dei u Paul uba la ïap halor ka diengphna namar jong phi ? Hato la pynbaptis ïa phi kum ki synran jong u Paul ?

U wallam sha Jerusalem ïa ki lyngdoh kiba ju khlemrain ha ki nongbah ka Judah , bathngan ha kylleng jong ka ri u la Arnon ïa ki duwan ha kiba ki ju iphylla jingkñia . U pynphetwir pyntwa ruh ïa pynpait duwan jutang Jinglamphrang haei sha ki ksuid-durblang hajan ka khyrdop ba la tei da Edrei Joshua , u Kloi ka nongbah , kiba don sha kadiang jong ka khyrdop bah kaba ki ju rung sha ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah , and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense , from Geba to Beer–sheba , and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city , which were on a man s left hand at the gate of the city .

translation.kha: Ym da donkam ba U Blei por ki briew ban leit bad ba yn bishar ïa da .
translation.en: For he will not lay upon man more than right  ; that he should enter into judgment with God .

translation.kha: Ka kmie jong me ka la long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba la thung hajan ka wahduid . Namar ba la don kyrhai um ka , ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la tap ki da sla bad u soh .
translation.en: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood , planted by the waters : she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa uta uwei pat u angel ba u jubab , Kan ïailong haduh shi hajar shispah sanphew , sngi ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia janmiet bad mynstep yn ym ai . Hadien kata yn sa pynbha pat Templ ïa ka .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Unto two thousand and three hundred days  ; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed .

translation.kha: Uta u paidbah u ïawan sha u Moses bad u skhem , Ngi leh-isynei leh pop haba ngi la kren pyrshah Julius U Trai Shelomoth ïa Tyngka ruh . Mynta to duwai ha U Trai ba un shim noh ïa kine dakhol bseiñ . Kumta u Moses u la duwai na ka bynta uta u paidbah .
translation.en: Therefore the people came to Moses , and said , We have sinned , for we have spoken against the  Lord  , and against thee  ; pray unto the  Lord  , that he take away the serpents from us . And Moses prayed for the people .

translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaba la Tehsong , bad ka shniah ïa ki ban leit phai pat sha u syiem bad ban ai pynurlong u ïa kane harum ka khubor na U Trai :
translation.en: And she answered them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Tell ye the man that sent you to me ,

And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , with all the captives of Judah , that went into Babylon , saith the  Lord  : for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam pat ruh ïa u syiem ka Judah , u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim , lem bad ki briew baroh jong ka Judah kiba la leit sha ka jinglongmraw ha Babilonia . Ho-oid , ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong u syiem ka Babilonia . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

Ym don mano mano ba thang ka ïa sharak bad tap ïa da ka ka shang lane buh ïa ka ha khrum jingthiah . Pynban , u buh ïa halor ka u diengpynïeng sharak , khnang ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai katba ki dang wan rung .
translation.en: No man , when he hath lighted a candle , covereth it with a vessel , or putteth it under a bed  ; but setteth it on a candlestick , that they which enter in may see the light .
Why did he bring the bag ?
translation.kha: Balei u wanrah ia ka pla ?

translation.en: Give to him that asketh thee , and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away .
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u pan ei ei na phi , to ai ïa kata ha u ; haba uno uno u kwah ban pan kylliang ei ei na phi , to ai kylliang ïa u .
Kan long ha kaba ka Ïa : ki angel kin mihnoh ban lumlang ïa ki briew kiba sniew napdeng kiba bha
translation.en: So shall it be at the end of the world : the angels shall come forth , and sever the wicked from among the just ,

translation.kha: To ïa Trai , namar u long uba bha ; to rwai ki jingïaroh ïa ka jong u , namar long uba bha sbun .
translation.en: Praise the  Lord   ; for the  Lord  is good : sing praises unto his name  ; for it is pleasant .

translation.kha: To long uba stad bha ym ban ym ban pyrshang pynpaw ïa lade ban ïoh spah .
translation.en: Labour not to be rich : cease from thine own wisdom .

translation.kha: Ïa jingbymkhuid ka jong ka lah ban ïohi da kaba suk , hynrei kam la shym pynpaw jingsngewkhia ei ei ïa la ka kupar . Ka jingkyllon jong ka , ka long kaba shyrkhei ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyntngen ïa ka . Ki nongshun jong ka ki la jop , bad ka kyang sha U Trai na ka bynta jingisynei ka .
translation.en: Her gates are sunk into the ground  ; he hath destroyed and broken her bars : her king and her princes are among the Gentiles : the law is no more  ; her prophets also find no vision from the  Lord .
Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ ? shall I then take the members of Christ , and make them the members of an harlot ? God forbid .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba ki met jong phi ki long ki dkhot jong ka met U Khrist . Hato ngan shim noh shi lyngkhot na ka met U Khrist bad pynlong ïa ka shi bynta jong ka met jong ka nuti ? Kam lah ban long!
Ki kynhun shipai jong ki , ki jubor sha khmat ban jop , bad uwei pa uwei u la sngewtriem katba ki nang tur . Kiba shah kem ki bun bah kum u shyiap .
translation.en: They shall come all for violence : their faces shall sup up as the east wind , and they shall gather the captivity as the sand .
As I live , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts , Surely as Tabor is among the mountains , and as Carmel by the sea , so shall he come .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga long u syiem . Nga long U Blei Uba im . Kumba u lum Tabor u ïeng kynjang tam ïa ki lum bad u lum Karmel u ïeng hajrong tam ïa ka duriaw , kumta kan long ka jingkhlaiñ jong uta uba tur ïaleh ïa me .
Ki briew kiba la ïaid ha ka jingdum ki la ïohi ïa syndah jingshai shapoh khraw Iso Ki la shong klim ka thngan jong ki syrngiew , mawjam mynta ka jingshai ka la tyngshaiñ Taanakh jong ki .
translation.en: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light : they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death , upon them hath the light shined .

translation.kha: U Barukh u khun u Neraïah u la pynkhih ïa phi ngi kumta nong Babilonia kin ïa-ïohbor jong bad lah ban pynïap ïa ngi ïalam noh ïa ngi Babilonia .
translation.en: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us , for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans , that they might put us to death , and carry us away captives into Babylon .
Feed the flock of God which is among you , taking the oversight thereof , not by constraint , but willingly  ; not for filthy lucre , but of a ready mind  ;
translation.kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi ban long ki nongsharai ïa ka kynhun ïa kaba U Blei u la ai ha phi bad ban sumar ïa ka da ka mon sngewbha , kumba U Blei u kwah ïa phi , bad ym da kaba shu pynbor . Trei ïa la ka kam , ym tang na ka bynta ka bainong , hynrei na ka jingthrang ban shakri .
don u riewngeit ha uba kyrteng u . U ïoh ka jingïohipaw , ha kaba U Trai u la ong ha u , Ananias ! Hangne nga A Trai , u la .
translation.en: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus , named Ananias  ; and to him said the Lord in a vision ,  Ananias .  And he said , Behold , I am here , Lord .
And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city , and communed with the men of their city , saying ,
translation.kha: U Hamor bad u Shekhem u khun jong u ki la leit sha ka jaka long dorbar ha ka khyrdop shnong bad ki kren ha la ki para shnong ;
ïa ki jaitbynriew na bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka . Phah ïa ki syiem ka Media , nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki , bad ki kynhun shipai jong ki ri baroh kiba ki synshar .
translation.en: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes , the captains thereof , and all the rulers thereof , and all the land of his dominion .
The burden of the valley of vision . What aileth thee now , that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops ?
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Them ka Jingïohipaw . Kaei kaba jia ? Balei ki briew baroh jong ka nongbah ki rakhe lehkmen halor ki tnum ïing ?

translation.en: Fear not  ; for thou shalt not be ashamed : neither be thou confounded  ; for thou shalt not be put to shame : for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth , and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more .
translation.kha: Wat nym sheptieng — phan ym shah pynlehrain biang ; phan ym shah pynjahburom . Phan klet noh ïa ka jingbymlongkhuid kum ka tnga ba dang kham samla , bad ïa ka jinglong marwei ba shah ibeiñ kum ka riewkynthei .

translation.en: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage .
translation.kha: bad ha kane ka rukom , un pyllait ïa kita baroh kiba la long ki mraw shi lynter ka jingim jong ki , namar ka jingsheptieng jong ki ïa ka jingïap .
U jop ruh ïa ki Moab kiba kylla long ki raïot jong u bad siew khajna sha . u
translation.en: And he smote Moab  ; and the Moabites became David s servants , and brought gifts .

translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba nga ieit ïa me , nga pynlong ïa kane ka jingkyrpad . Nga leh ïa kane jingshisha la nga long khar Paul , u nonglamktien jong U Pyntngit Jisu , bad mynta ruh u nongsah byndi na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: Yet for love s sake I rather beseech thee , being such an one as Paul the aged , and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ .
They zealously affect you , but not well ; yea , they would exclude you , that ye might affect them .
translation.kha: Kiba pyn-i ka jingsngewtynnat kaba katta katta ïa phi , hynrei kam bha . Hooid , kin kyntait ia phi , lah kumba phin pynsniew iaki .

translation.en: And of some , that Elias had appeared  ; and of others , that one of the old prophets was risen again .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong ba u Elijah u la mihpaw , bad sa kiwei pat ki ong ba uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa na mynbarim u la mihpat .

translation.en: Now is my soul troubled  ; and what shall I say ? Father , save me from this hour : but for this cause came I unto this hour .
translation.kha: Mynta ka mynsiem jong nga ka pisa — bad aïu ngan ong ? Hato ngan ong , ‘ Ko Pa , wat ai ba kane ka kynta kan wan ha nga ?’ Hynrei dei na ka bynta kata nga la wan — khnang ba ngan ïoh ïaid lyngba kane ka kynta jong ka jingshah shitom .

translation.en: I have set watchmen upon thy walls , O Jerusalem , which shall never hold their peace day nor night : ye that make mention of the  Lord  , keep not silence ,
translation.kha: Ha ki kynroh jong pha , ko Jerusalem , nga la buh ïa ki nongap phira ; mynsngi ne mynmiet kin ym sngap jar . Kin pynkynmaw ïa U  Trai  ïa ki kular jong u , bad kin ym shah ba un klet ïa ki .

translation.en: He that walketh righteously , and speaketh uprightly  ; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions , that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes , that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood , and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil  ;
translation.kha: Phi lah ban lait im lada phi ong bad phi leh ïa kaba dei . Wat pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong phi ban shukor ïa kiba duk bad wat pdiang ïa ka pisa bashukor . Wat ïasnohkti bad kito kiba thmu ban pynïap briew lane ban leh ïa kiwei ki kam sniew .
Hynrei ym shym la don ha bneng lane ha khyndew lane ha ka pyrthei kaba shapoh , uba lah ban plied ïa kot kli ka bad ban khmih shapoh jong ka .
translation.en: And no man in heaven , nor in earth , neither under the earth , was able to open the book , neither to look thereon .

And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah  ; they shall feed thereupon : in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening : for the  Lord  their God shall visit them , and turn away their captivity .
translation.kha: Ki paid ka Judah kiba lait im kin buhai ha ka ri jong phi . Kin pynbamphlang ïa ki kynhun langbrot jong ki hangta bad thiah hapoh ki ïing ka Ashkelon . U  Trai  U Blei jong ki un long lem bad ki bad un pynlong ïa ki ban manbha pat .

translation.en: But the rich , in that he is made low : because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away .
translation.kha: Naba uba riewspah un tlor noh kum u syntiew jong u jingthung ha khlaw .
La don ruh ka Ain , ka Rimmon , ka Ether , ka bad Ashan : saw tylli ki nongbah , lem ki bad nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: Ain , Rimmon , and Ether , and Ashan  ; four cities and their villages :

translation.kha: Ho-oid , hadien kita ki sngi bad miet , U Trai u la ai ha nga ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa kata ka jutang .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights , that the  Lord  gave me the two tables of stone , even the tables of the covenant .

translation.kha: Wat iehnoh ïa ka jingstad bad kan ïada ïa phi ieit ïa ka kan sumar bha ïa phi .
translation.en: Forsake her not , and she shall preserve thee : love her , and she shall keep thee .

translation.kha: pynlong Ngan ka jutang jong nga bad me , bad ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew .
translation.en: And I will make my covenant between me and thee , and will multiply thee exceedingly .
And Pharaoh sent , and called for Moses and Aaron , and said unto them , I have sinned this time : the  Lord  is righteous , and I and my people are wicked .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ha ki ,  Ha kane ka sien nga la leh pop ; U  Trai  u leh ïa kaba dei ; ma nga bad ki briew jong nga ngi la leh bakla .

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die , it abideth alone : but if it die , it bringeth forth much fruit .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa ka jingshisha : U symboh kew u ïaisah hi tang shi symboh lymda la pynhap ïa u ha ka khyndew bad u ïap . Lada u da ïap , te u sei shibun ki sohkew .

translation.en: Which were clothed with blue , captains and rulers , all of them desirable young men , horsemen riding upon horses .
translation.kha: Ki long ki shipai ha ka riam shipai ba rong jngum , ki riew kynsai bad ki rangbah shipai bahakhlieh ; baroh na ki , ki long ki samla shipai ba-bhabriew .
Ki shynrang ki dei ban ieit ïa ki tnga jong ki kumba ki ieit ïa ki la jong ki met . U shynrang uba ieit ïa la ka tnga u ieit lade ïa hi .
translation.en: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies . He that loveth his wife loveth himself .
Then an herald cried aloud , To you it is commanded , O people , nations , and languages ,
translation.kha: u sangot u la pynbna ha ka sur bajam ,  Ko ki briew jong ki ri baroh , ki jaitbynriew bad ki jait ktien !
Ki la ong ha Moses Hato ym jingtep ha Ijipt ? Hato phin hap ïalam ïa ngi hangne ha ri shyiap ban ïap ? Peit aïu phi leh ïa ngi da kaba phi wan ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt !
translation.en: And they said unto Moses , Because there were no graves in Egypt , hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness ? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us , to carry us forth out of Egypt ?

translation.kha: U Samson u ong Mynta ka kynti , ngan ym kitkhlieh ïa kaei ba ngan sa leh ïa ki Philistia .
translation.en: And Samson said concerning them , Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines , though I do them a displeasure .
It is better to trust in the  Lord  than to put confidence in princes .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban shaniah ha U  Trai ban ïa kaba shaniah ha ki nongïalam ba kynja briew .

translation.en: And there came a man of God , and spake unto the king of Israel , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because the Syrians have said , The  Lord  is God of the hills , but he is not God of the valleys , therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand , and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Ahab bad ong ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong : ‘ Namar ba ki Syria ki ong ba nga long u blei jong ki lum bad ym jong ki jaka madan , ngan sa ai jingjop ïa phi halor ka kynhun shipai bakhraw jong ki , bad ma phi bad ki briew jong phi kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .’

translation.en: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand , the earth swallowed them .
translation.kha: Me kner ïa la ka kti kamon , bad ka khyndew ka nguid ïa ki nongshun jong ngi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall scatter thee among all people , from the one end of the earth even unto the other  ; and there thou shalt serve other gods , which neither thou nor thy fathers have known , even wood and stone .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh , kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei , bad hangta phin shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei kiba da ka dieng bad da u maw , ki blei kiba ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi phim pat ju mane mynshuwa .

translation.en: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree  ; and none shall make them afraid : for the mouth of the  Lord  of hosts hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un shongsuk hapdeng ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Dumbur la ki jong hi , bad yn ym don mano mano ban pynsheptieng ïa u . U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kular ïa kane .
Shim ïa kane ka kitab ka Aiñ U Blei bad buh ïa ha syndah ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai U jong phi , ba kan don hangta kum ka sakhi ïa ki briew jong u .
translation.en: Take this book of the law , and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , that it may be there for a witness against thee .

translation.kha: Ngi Beraïah leh bymman pyrshah ïa me Peleth ngim thai la leh ïa kaei —Isaïah me la hukum astor Ngim shym la sumar ïa ki hukum kiba Shemida la ai Melkhisedek ngi lyngba u Moses biria u shakri pynïapmat me .
translation.en: We have dealt very corruptly against thee , and have not kept the commandments , nor the statutes , nor the judgments , which thou commandedst thy servant Moses .
Then spake Haggai the  Lord s  messenger in the  Lord s  message unto the people , saying , I am with you , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Haggai u la ai ïa ka khubor jong U  Trai  ha u paidbah :  Ngan long ryngkat bad phi — kata ka long ka jingkular jong nga .

translation.en: And they kept that saying with themselves , questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean .
translation.kha: Ki la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u , hynrei para ma ki , ki la sdang ban ïakren shaphang kane ,  Aïu kane ‘ kaba mihpat na ka jingïap’ ka mut ?

translation.en: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity .
translation.kha: Palat ïa shisien , haba nga donkam jingïarap ha Thessaloni , phi la phah ïa ka sha nga .

translation.en: And when he had looked round about on them with anger , being grieved for the hardness of their hearts , he saith unto the man ,  Stretch forth thine hand .  And he stretched it out : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la bitar katba u la peit sawdong ïa ki , hynrei ha ka kajuh ka por u la sngewsih na ka bynta jong ki , namar ba ki eh mynsiem bad leh bymdei . Te u la ong ha uta u briew ,  Rah ïa la ka kti .  U la rah ïa ka , bad ka la khiah bha pat .

translation.en: And he said , While the child was yet alive , I fasted and wept : for I said , Who can tell whether  God  will be gracious to me , that the child may live ?
translation.kha: Ho-oid ,  u Dabid u jubab ,  Nga la shahjingit bad ïam katba i dang im . Nga la pyrkhat ba U  Trai  lehse un sngewsynei ïa nga bad un ym shah ba i khunlung in ïap .
u “buh jingpyut ha nga sumar To thoh ha ka kitab ïa pynsuk kaei baroh kaba nga la ong ha me ,
translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  God of Israel , saying , Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book .

translation.kha: Hynrei Lusias rangbah u la tuklar la ïa u na .
translation.en: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us , and with great violence took him away out of our hands ,
The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity  ; but a wounded spirit who can bear ?
translation.kha: Ka mon jong phi ban im kan kyrshan ïa phi haba phi pang , hynrei lada phi duh ïa ka , ka jingkyrmen jong phi kaba sah ka la jah noh .

translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts hath sworn , saying , Surely as I have thought , so shall it come to pass  ; and as I have purposed , so shall it stand :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la smai ka jingsmai :  Kaei kaba nga la thmu kan jia . Kaei kaba nga la kut jingmut ban leh yn pyndep .

translation.en: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour : so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour .
translation.kha: Ki skain kiba ïap ki lah ban pyniwtung ïa baroh ka jingiwbih hapoh ka dabi , bad tang khyndiat ka jingmutlop ka lah ban pynduh ïa ka jingstad kaba khraw tam .

translation.en: Behold , I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth : thou shalt thresh the mountains , and beat them small , and shalt make the hills as chaff .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me kum ka kor khlur-kba , lem bad ki bniat kiba thymmai banep . Men tylliat ïa ki lumbah bad pynlwet ïa ki ; ki lumrit kin lwet kum u pui pui .

translation.en: And if ye salute your brethren only , what do ye more than others ? do not even the publicans so ?

translation.en: Having yet therefore one son , his wellbeloved , he sent him also last unto them , saying , They will reverence my son .

Nga shim ïa kata kaei kaei kaba hi ka pop — kata ka dur masi keiñ kaba phi la thaw bad nga bret ïa ka ha ka ding . Nangta nga pynpait pharia ïa ka nga tylliat ni ïa ka haduh ba kan da long kum u pui pui , bad nga bret ïa kata ha ka wah kaba tuid na uta u lum .
translation.en: And I took your sin , the calf which ye had made , and burnt it with fire , and stamped it , and ground it very small , even until it was as small as dust : and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynkylla Antarctica ka rukom kaba phi im bad khroh pynpdang kiei baroh kiba phi leh , jingtamsneng Makkedah dei ban kohnguh ïa U Trai U Blei jong Josabad . Lada phi leh kumta , un kylla ïa la ka jingmut na ka jingpynjot kaba u la ong ïabuh un wallam jingartatien jong phi .
translation.en: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings , and obey the voice of the  Lord  your God  ; and the  Lord  will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you .
Now therefore let me alone , that my wrath may wax hot against them , and that I may consume them : and I will make of thee a great nation .
translation.kha: Mynta , wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa nga . Nga bitar ïa ki , bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki . Nangta ngan pynlong ïa me bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .
Balei , A Blei , me shah ba yn kha ïa nga ? Nga la dei ban ïap ha ba shuwa uno uno un ïohi nga ïa !
translation.en: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb ? Oh that I had given up the ghost , and no eye had seen me !

translation.kha: Kam wanrah ei ei kaba Jubab sbiar pynlut pisa ha ka jingpynnang baieit ïa uba bieit , namar um jingïakhih jingshemphang satia .

translation.kha: Ki i kum ki kulai ; ki mareh nonglute ki kulai thma .

translation.en: Say unto the king and to the queen , Humble yourselves , sit down : for your principalities shall come down , even the crown of your glory .

For bodily exercise profiteth little : but godliness is profitable unto all things , having promise of the life that now is , and of that which is to come .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynmlien ïa ka met ka ai katto katne ka jingbha , hynrei ka jingpynmlien ba kynja mynsiem ka pynmyntoi ha ki liang baroh , namar ka kular ïa ka jingim ha ka mynta bad ha ka lawei .

translation.en: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant  ; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver , and the ox shall be stoned .

translation.en: And I will give them one heart , and I will put a new spirit within you  ; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh , and will give them an heart of flesh :

translation.en: Till a dart strike through his liver  ; as a bird hasteth to the snare , and knoweth not that it is for his life .

And a certain woman named Lydia , a seller of purple , of the city of Thyatira , which worshipped God , heard us : whose heart the Lord opened , that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul .
translation.kha: Kawei na kito kiba la ïohsngew ïa ngi ka dei ka Lydia kaba na Thiatira , ka dei ka nongdie ïa ka jaiñ sawbthuh . Ka long ka briew kaba mane ïa U Blei , bad U Trai u la plie ïa ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ka ban pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba u Paul u ong .

Te rangbah ai u la khot ar ngut na ki rangbah jong bad u ong Pynkhreh ngut ki shipai ban leit sha Kaisaria , lem bad hynñiewphew ngut ki shipai kulai bad arspah ngut ki nongbat bad ban mih ka por baje mynta ka .
translation.en: And he called unto him two centurions , saying , Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea , and horsemen threescore and ten , and spearmen two hundred , at the third hour of the night  ;
Thou shalt increase my greatness , and comfort me on every side .
translation.kha: Men pynlong ïa nga uba kham khraw ban ïa kaba ju long ; bad men pyntngen biang ïa nga .
kaba Ha sdang , ka hima jong u ka kynthup ïa ka Babilon , ka Erek , bad ka Akkad , kiba baroh don ha ka ri Babilonia .
translation.en: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel , and Erech , and Accad , and Calneh , in the land of Shinar .

translation.en: The rich ruleth over the poor , and the borrower is servant to the lender .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they say unto thee , Whither shall we go forth ? then thou shalt tell them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Such as are for death , to death  ; and such as are for the sword , to the sword  ; and such as are for the famine , to the famine  ; and such as are for the captivity , to the captivity .

translation.kha: Khie ïaid lyngba ïa ka nongbah Jerusalem bad buh dak ha ka shyllangmat jong uwei pa uwei uba shem jynjar bad khuslai namar ki kiei kiei baroh kiba ijli kiba la leh ha ka nongbah .

translation.en: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently , that nothing be wanting unto them .

translation.en: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .

translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ka khyndew basboh ban kylla ri khlaw mluh namar ka jingbymman jong kito kiba shong hangta .

translation.en: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal , saying , Slack not thy hand from thy servants  ; come up to us quickly , and save us , and help us : for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us .

translation.en: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout , they said , What meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews ? And they understood that the ark of the  Lord  was come into the camp .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingrisa bad ki ong ,  Sngap ïa kata ka jingrisa baroh ha ka jaka shong dara ki Hebru ! Ka mut aïu kata ?  Haba ki shem ba ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka la poi ha ka jaka shong dara ki Hebru ,

translation.en: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment  ; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great  ; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man  ; for the judgment is God s : and the cause that is too hard for you , bring it unto me , and I will hear it .
And they said unto him , Where is Sarah thy wife ? And he said , Behold , in the tent .

Nangta ngi la khublei ïakhlad iwei ïa iwei pat , bad ngi la leit kiew ha ka lieng katba ma ki , ki la phai leit ïing sha .
translation.en: And when we had taken our leave one of another , we took ship  ; and they returned home again .

translation.en: ( Psalm 104 :15  ; 1 Corinthians 6 :10 ) Godly principles benefit us by teaching us to guard not just our actions but also our thoughts .

translation.en: And so were the churches established in the faith , and increased in number daily .

translation.en: Now therefore , O king , come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down  ; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king s hand .

Nga phah la ïa ka khlam ha phi kum kata kaba nga la phah ha Ijipt . Nga la pynïap ki ïa shynrang samla jong phi ha ka thma bad nga la knieh noh ïa ki kulai jong phi . Nga la pyndap ïa ki thliew khmut jong phi da ka ki jingiwtung metïap ha ki jaka shong dara phi jong . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .
translation.en: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt : your young men have I slain with the sword , and have taken away your horses  ; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Hegai u la itynnat ïa ka Esther , bad ka la ïoh ïa ka jinglehsbun jong u Um . shym pynslem ha kaba ai ka na jingsumar ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew bad ki bakyrpang jingbam . U ai ïa ka , ka jaka babha tam ha ka ki ïing kynthei bad buh hynñiew ngut ki samla kynthei ba la jied na kyrpang ka ïingsyiem ban shakri ïa ka .
translation.en: And the maiden pleased him , and she obtained kindness of him  ; and he speedily gave her her things for purification , with such things as belonged to her , and seven maidens , which were meet to be given her , out of the king s house : and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women .

translation.kha: U la kren shaphang u Judas u khun jong u Simon Iskariot . Naba Judas , wat la u dei uwei na khat-ar ngut ki un sa shetkylla ïa u .
translation.en: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon : for he it was that should betray him , being one of the twelve .

translation.en: Thou hast despised mine holy things , and hast profaned my sabbaths .
Judge not , that ye be not judged .

translation.en: Ten fat oxen , and twenty oxen out of the pastures , and an hundred sheep , beside harts , and roebucks , and fallowdeer , and fatted fowl .

translation.en: Hast thou an arm like God ? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him ?
