translation.en: And when they had preached the gospel to that city , and had taught many , they returned again to Lystra , and to Iconium , and Antioch ,

translation.en: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world , and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles ; how much more their fulness ?
If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself , or if thou hast thought evil , lay thine hand upon thy mouth .
translation.kha: Lada phi la long kiba bieit shisha ban sngewmeng bad ban thmu sniew , sangeh bad pyrkhat !
Tei ïa ka duwan Ebedmelekh da Judas maw ïa kiba ym pat pyndei shniah .
translation.en: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the  Lord  thy God , an altar of stones : thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them .
Blessed are the merciful : for they shall obtain mercy .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba isynei ïa kiwei pat ; U Blei un isynei ïa ki !
Ki ki dei ban nang sngap jar da ka baroh
translation.en: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection .

translation.kha: Ngim dei ban long kiba kynnoh ba shah leh awria , kumba don na ki , kiba la leh kumta — bad ha ka shi sngi , arphew lai hajar ngut na ki , ki la kyllon ïap .
translation.en: Neither let us commit fornication , as some of them committed , and fell in one day three and twenty thousand .

translation.kha: U Abraham ong , A , wat bitar ba ngan kren biang . lada don tang laiphew ngut ? U Ngan ym leh ei ei ïa ka lada nga shem laiphew ngut hangta .
translation.en: And he said unto him , Oh let not the Lord be angry , and I will speak : Peradventure there shall thirty be found there . And he said , I will not do it , if I find thirty there .

translation.kha: Une u U Trai Badonbor Baroh — long ka kyrteng ha uba dei ban mane .
translation.en: Even the  Lord  God of hosts  ; the  Lord  is his memorial .
And when he came , lo , Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching : for his heart trembled for the ark of God . And when the man came into the city , and told it , all the city cried out .
translation.kha: U Eli , uba dang pyrkhat khuslai shaphang ka Synduk ka Jutang , u dang shong harud lynti , u da peit lyngngoh . Uta u rangbah u pynphriang ïa ka khubor kylleng ka shnong bad uwei pa uwei u lynñiar da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: And he will take your daughters to be confectionaries , and to be cooks , and to be bakers .
translation.kha: Ki khun kynthei jong phi kin hap shna ki jingiwbih ïa u , bad trei kum ki nongshet jingshet bad ki nongshet kpu jong u .

translation.en: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants , even Esther s feast  ; and he made a release to the provinces , and gave gifts , according to the state of the king .

Da kumta phin leh ïa kita ki jingpynlut kiba sha jngai na jinglehbor ka Ekron jingshahshitom kaba phin shong .
translation.en: Thus shalt thou do unto all the cities which are very far off from thee , which are not of the cities of these nations .

translation.kha: Ym don pat batip , lano kata ka sngi lane ka kynta kin wan — lymne wat angel ki ha bneng , lymne U Khun tang ; U Kpa u tip .
translation.en: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man , no , not the angels which are in heaven , neither the Son , but the Father .

translation.kha: Sngewbha , wat pynleit jingmut ei ei ïa u Nabal uto , u bym long ei ! ei U hi dei thik kumba ka kyrteng jong u ka mut — u bieit ! Kynrad , ngam shym don hangta haba ki shakri jong phi ki wan poi .
translation.en: Let not my lord , I pray thee , regard this man of Belial , even Nabal : for as his name is , so is he  ; Nabal is his name , and folly is with him : but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord , whom thou didst send .
The burden upon Arabia . In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge , O ye travelling companies of Dedanim .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Arabia . Phi ki briew jong ka Dedan , kiba ki kynhun leit jingleit jong phi ki shong dara ha ka rudnong bashrah jong ka Arabia ,

Nangta u Shebanaïah u ïalam ïa Dothan Rebekka shapoh ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba ka Sarah ka kmie jong u patlun la ju Nahaliel , bad ka la kylla long ka tnga jong u . U Isaak u ieit ïa Aphek dik , bad da kumta u Kada ïoh jingtngen hadien ba u la duh pruh la Jingshyrkhei kmie .
translation.en: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah s tent , and took Rebekah , and she became his wife  ; and he loved her : and Isaac was comforted after his mother s death .

translation.kha: Ka Rakhel ka ong , Nga la ïakhun ka jingïaleh kaba jwat la hynmen , hynrei nga la jop ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa , u Naphtali .
translation.en: And Rachel said , With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister , and I have prevailed : and she called his name Naphtali .
Israel shall cry unto me , My God , we know thee .
translation.kha: Wat lada ki khot ïa nga U Blei jong ki bad ki kam ba ki dei ki briew jong nga bad ba ki tip ïa nga ,

translation.en: For there is hope of a tree , if it be cut down , that it will sprout again , and that the tender branch thereof will not cease .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingkyrmen ïa u dieng uba la khet ; u lah ban im pat bad un khie lung .
U ïam rangbah rangsan hangta haduh ba kita ki Ijipt ki ïohsngew , bad leit rah ïa ka khubor sha ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And he wept aloud : and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard .
Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour s landmark . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynkynriah ïa u mawpud jong u paramarjan .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

Shim ïa ka kot kli bad thoh ha ka ïa kaba baroh nga la ha ong me shaphang ka Israel bad ka Judah bad baroh ki jaitbynriew . Thoh lut ïa baroh kaba nga la ong ha me naduh ka por ba nga la kren nyngkong me ha , mynba u Josaïah u long , syiem haduh mynta .
translation.en: Take thee a roll of a book , and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel , and against Judah , and against all the nations , from the day I spake unto thee , from the days of Josiah , even unto this day .

Then was Daniel brought in before the king . And the king spake and said unto Daniel , Art thou that Daniel , which art of the children of the captivity of Judah , whom the king my father brought out of Jewry ?
translation.kha: Ïa u Daniel la wallam shisyndon shapoh sha ka jaka ba don u syiem , bad u syiem u la ong ha u ,  Hato me dei u Daniel , uto u Jiw uba shah ringmraw ïa uba u kpa jong nga u syiem u la wallam hangne na Judah ?

translation.en: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives , of which the name of the one was Shiphrah , and the name of the other Puah :
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem ka Ijipt u ong ha ki nongpynkha khun kiba na ki kynthei Hebru , kawei kaba kyrteng ka Shiphrah bad kawei pat ka Puah ,

U Trai u ong , Ki briew jong nga ki long kiba ; mutlop kim ithuh ïa nga . long Ki kiba bieit kum ki khynnah ; kim don kano kano ka jingshemphang . Ki long kiba tbit kaba ha leh ïa kaba , sniew hynrei ki bym lah ban leh ïa kaba bha .
translation.en: For my people is foolish , they have not known me  ; they are sottish children , and they have none understanding : they are wise to do evil , but to do good they have no knowledge .

translation.kha: jingbymshimkhia pynkordit met baroh kawei ka long tang ka khmat , da kumno yn ïohsngew ? Bad swar ka Jedidaïah tang Harumaph shkor , da kumno yn iw ?
translation.en: If the whole body were an eye , where were the hearing ? If the whole were hearing , where were the smelling ?
If thou hast nothing to pay , why should he take away thy bed from under thee ?
translation.kha: Lada phim lah ban siew , kin knieh noh wat ïa ka jingthiah jong phi ruh .

translation.en: That I may know him , and the power of his resurrection , and the fellowship of his sufferings , being made conformable unto his death ;
translation.kha: Baroh kaba nga kwah ka long ba ngan ithuh ïa U Khrist bad ban mad ïa ka bor ka jingmihpat jong u , ban ïoh bynta ha ki jingshahshitom jong u , bad ban long kum ma u ha ka jingïap jong u ,

U la ong , Shim jingïasoh ki jingai sngewbha ba la ai da basaw Heldai , u tukri bad u Jedaïah kiba la shah ringmraw , bad leit shisyndon sha ka ïing jong nga Josaïah u khun jong u Sephanaïah . Kine ki rangbah baroh ki la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilonia .
translation.en: Take of them of the captivity , even of Heldai , of Tobijah , and of Jedaiah , which are come from Babylon , and come thou the same day , and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah  ;
And she said , Drink , my lord : and she hasted , and let down her pitcher upon her hand , and gave him drink .
translation.kha: Ka ong ,  Ko rangbah , to dih  bad ka pynhiar kloi kloi ïa uta u khiew um na ka tyrpeng jong ka , bad ka pynbat katba u dang dih .

translation.en: Now in the morning as he returned into the city , he hungered .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka lynti ba u leit phai sha ka nongbah , U Jisu u la thngan .

translation.en: Then he said unto me , Lo , I have given thee cow s dung for man s dung , and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith .
translation.kha: Kumta U Blei u la ong ,  Ka bha shibun . Ngan shah ïa me ba men pyndonkam noh da ka eit masi pynban , bad me lah ban shet ïa la u kpu ha ka .

translation.en: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died :
translation.kha: ngan ym beh shuh ïa kano kano na ki jaitbynriew kiba dang don ha ka ri haba u Joshua u la ïap .

translation.en: And said , By myself have I sworn , saith the  Lord  , for because thou hast done this thing , and hast not withheld thy son , thine only son :
translation.kha: Nga la smai da ka kyrteng jong nga — U  Trai  u kren — ba ngan kyrkhu kyrhai ïa me . Namar me la leh ïa kane , bad mem shym la tyngkai noh ïa la u khun marwei na nga ,

translation.en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me , therefore will I call upon him as long as I live .
translation.kha: U shahshkor ïa nga , man ka por ba nga khot kyrpad ïa u .
Ki la don sawdong jong nga ha ki liang baroh ; hynrei nga la pynjot ïa ki ka da bor jong U Trai !
translation.en: They compassed me about  ; yea , they compassed me about : but in the name of the  Lord  I will destroy them .
And Israel said unto Joseph , Now let me die , since I have seen thy face , because thou art yet alive .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  Mynta nga la kloi lada ïap noh ruh , namar ba nga la ïohi ïa me bad tip ba me dang im .

translation.en: Then the Pharisees went out , and held a council against him , how they might destroy him .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Pharisi ki la mihnoh bad ki la pynlong ki jingthmu ban pynïap ïa U Jisu .
Naba U u Khrist la ïap bad u la mihpat sha ka jingim khnang ban long U Trai jong kiba im bad jong kiba ïap .
translation.en: For to this end Christ both died , and rose , and revived , that he might be Lord both of the dead and living .

translation.kha: Haba U Khun U Briew u la wan , u la bad bam u la dih , bad uwei uwei baroh u la ong , ‘ khmih Ha ïa une u briew ! U long uba lalot bad u nongdih , u paralok jong ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah !’ kyntait Pynban ïa , ka jingstad Blei la pyn-i ba ka long kaba shisha da mih kiba na ka .
translation.en: The Son of man came eating and drinking , and they say , Behold a man gluttonous , and a winebibber , a friend of publicans and sinners . But wisdom is justified of her children .
Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth , and called thee from the chief men thereof , and said unto thee , Thou art my servant  ; I have chosen thee , and not cast thee away .
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa me na kiba kut ka pyrthei ; nga la khot ïa me naduh ki pud bajngai bah jong ka bad nga la ong ha me ‘ me long u shakri jong nga ,’ ngam shym la kyntait ïa me , hynrei nga la jied ïa me .

translation.en: They shall come all for violence : their faces shall sup up as the east wind , and they shall gather the captivity as the sand .
translation.kha: Ki kynhun shipai jong ki , ki tur jubor sha khmat ban jop , bad uwei pa uwei u la sngewtriem katba ki nang tur . Kiba shah kem ki bun bah kum u shyiap .

Hynrei ka long namar Iathuh U Trai u ieit ïa phi bad u bat ïa la ka kular kaba u metbneng ai ha wiang Naei tymmen jong phi , bad namar kata u la ïalam noh ïa phi bameh ka borbah Ahian jingryngkhiang bad u la Shomer na ka jinglongmraw ïa phi na u Pharaoh Ekesiastis syiem ka Ijipt Gerar
translation.en: But because the  Lord  loved you , and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers , hath the  Lord  brought you out with a mighty hand , and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen , from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt .
Even him , whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders ,
translation.kha: Uta u Basniew un wan ha ka bor u Soitan bad un leh shibun ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kiba bakla ,
Ki la ïalam ïa u sha Kaisaria , ki la ai ïa ka shithi ha u lyngskor , bad ki la aiti ïa u Paul ha u .
translation.en: Who , when they came to Caesarea , and delivered the epistle to the governor , presented Paul also before him .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la ong ïa , u la jur bad u la pynbna da shai , Nga ïathuh ha ïa ka jingshisha : Uwei na phi un sa shetkylla ïa nga .
translation.en: When Jesus had thus said , he was troubled in spirit , and testified , and said ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .

translation.kha: Blei u long tang uwei , bad un pynlong ha lade hi ka hok bad ki Jiw ka nongrim jong ka jingngeit jong ki bad un pynlong ka hok bad ki Jentil ka jingngeit jong ki .
translation.en: Seeing it is one God , which shall justify the circumcision by faith , and uncircumcision through faith .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Gideon , Ki rangbah kiba me don , ki la bun eh ïa nga ban ai ki ha ka jingjop halor ki . Midian Ki lah ban ba pyrkhat ki la jop da lade hi , bad kumta kim ai burom ïa nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Gideon , The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands , lest Israel vaunt themselves against me , saying , Mine own hand hath saved me .

translation.kha: Shim ïa u khun jong me , U Blei u ong , u Isaak , u khun ba pynpaw marwei jong me kadlieng phom jinglwet re ieit thep mynsiem , bad leit sha ka ri Moraïah . Shabbethai halor u lum ïa jingïatylli ngan sa pyn-i lypa me , kñia ïa u kum pynpulom jingainguh ha nga .
translation.en: And he said , Take now thy son , thine only son Isaac , whom thou lovest , and get thee into the land of Moriah  ; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of .
Woe to the multitude of many people , which make a noise like the noise of the seas  ; and to the rushing of nations , that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters !
translation.kha: Ki hima kiba khlaiñbor ki don ha ka jingkhynwin ha ka jingsawa kum ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw , kum ka jingphaloh jong ki jingat phyllung kiba khraw .
Naba dohnud phi kan don hangta ha kaba don ka spah phi .
translation.en: For where your treasure is , there will your heart be also .
Woe unto you , lawyers ! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge : ye entered not in yourselves , and them that were entering in ye hindered .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum ! Phi la bat noh ïa u shabi uba plie ïa ka khyrdop sha ka ïing jong ka jingtip ; phi hi phim leit rung shapoh , bad phi khang ïa kito kiba pyrshang ban rung shapoh !
Ïa ki khyrwait la jingialam Sorek ki khuri ksiar , kiba ïapher dur kawei na kawei pat , synlar u syiem u la ai pahuh ïa ka waiñ jong u .
translation.en: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold , ( the vessels being diverse one from another , ) and royal wine in abundance , according to the state of the king .

translation.kha: Kynsan u Absalom u ïakynduh katto katne ki rangbah jong u . Dabid U Absalom u dang shong ha u khashor , bad katba u khashor u ïaid dang napoh u dieng Sning uba heh , ka khlieh u Absalom ka sahkut ha ki tnat dieng . U khashor u la mareh bad u Absalom u la shah kaba iehnoh da sdien ha shiteng suiñ .
translation.en: And Absalom met the servants of David . And Absalom rode upon a mule , and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak , and his head caught hold of the oak , and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth  ; and the mule that was under him went away .
Be sober , be vigilant  ; because your adversary the devil , as a roaring lion , walketh about , seeking whom he may devour :
translation.kha: To leh adkar , to sharai ! U nongshun jong phi , u Ksuid , u shang kylleng kum u sing bakyrhuh , da kaba wad ïa uno uno ba un nguid tylli .

translation.en: But we have dwelt in tents , and have obeyed , and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us .
translation.kha: Ngim ju tei ki ïing ki sem ban shong ban sah — ngi shong ha ki ïingjaiñ — bad ngim don ki bri sohwaiñ la ki jong , ki lyngkha , lane u kew . Ngi la kohnguh tylli ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u kpa tymmen jong ngi u Jonadab u la hukum ïa ngi .

Kum ban pynkut : Phi baroh to ïadon kajuh ka jingmut bad kajuh ka jingsngew , to ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat lehkmen shi para , bad to pynshoh exam sbun mynsiem sdieh kiba sngewrit iwei ïa iwei ïasnohlang .
translation.en: Finally , be ye all of one mind , having compassion one of another , love as brethren , be pitiful , be courteous :

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , kynthei Samaria , kiba nang sngaid kum ki masi ba la bsa bha jong ka Bashan kiba lehbeiñ kiba tlot , kiba banbeiñ ïa kiba bad kiba ba ki tnga jong phi kin phi da ka !
translation.en: Hear this word , ye kine of Bashan , that are in the mountain of Samaria , which oppress the poor , which crush the needy , which say to their masters , Bring , and let us drink .

translation.kha: Nangta , u Samson u la sliang um palat , kumta u kyrpad ïa U Trai bad ïashem ong , Me la ai kyndiah Arba Helkath kane ka jingjop kaba O ieh hato ngan baïong ïap Kinah na ka jingsliang um bad ban hap ha ki kti jong kine ki Philistia shaïong ?
translation.en: And he was sore athirst , and called on the  Lord  , and said , Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant : and now shall I die for thirst , and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised ?
And Jesse took an ass laden with bread , and a bottle of wine , and a kid , and sent them by David his son unto Saul .
translation.kha: U Jesse u phah ïa u Dabid sha u Saul lem bad u khunblang , u kada uba kit shikhung u kpu bad ka pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ .

Kynmaw jinglehburom , ïa kaei kaba la hikai slipar Philetos bad ïa kaei kaba pha la ïohsngew ; kohnguh ïa kata bad phai tasngeng na tmoh pop jong pha . riewpaidbah pham ïabishar bynriew noh , ngan khatkhyndai ha pha tari u nongtuh , bad phan ym lah wat ban tip ïa ka por lano ngan wan .
translation.en: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard , and hold fast , and repent . If therefore thou shalt not watch , I will come on thee as a thief , and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ruh ïa u Sedekaïah syiem ka Judah ïa ki rangbah jong u sha kito kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa ki . Ngan aiti ki sha ka kynhun shipai Babilonia , kaba la sangeh ban tur ïaleh ïa phi
translation.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies , and into the hand of them that seek their life , and into the hand of the king of Babylon s army , which are gone up from you .
And when all the people saw it , they fell on their faces : and they said , The  Lord  , he is the God  ; the  Lord  , he is the God .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki ïohi ïa kane , ki ïadem khrup ha khyndew bad ki ïa-pyrta jam ,  U  Trai  u long U Blei ; U  Trai  tang ma u , u long U Blei !

Nangta u ong la , Ko Daniel , to wat . sheptieng U Blei u la shahshkor ïa ki jong jingduwai me naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong ba me la jingmut kut ban pynrit ïa lade khnang ban ïoh ïa ka jingshemphang . Nga la wan ban ai jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong me .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Fear not , Daniel : for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand , and to chasten thyself before thy God , thy words were heard , and I am come for thy words .

And take the ark of the  Lord  , and lay it upon the cart  ; and put the jewels of gold , which ye return him for a trespass offering , in a coffer by the side thereof  ; and send it away , that it may go .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , buh ïa ka ha kata ka kali , bad thep ha kawei ka synduk kaba ha syndah jong ka ïa kita ki dur kiba da ka ksiar ba phi phah sha u kum ka jingainguh namar ki pop jong phi . Pyllait ïa ka kali ha ka lynti jong ka bad ieh kan leit hi .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year , on the first day of the month , that the tabernacle was reared up .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem kaba ar hadien ba ki la mihnoh na Ijipt , la pynïeng ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: Behold , my terror shall not make thee afraid , neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee .
translation.kha: Te phim don daw ban sheptieng ïa nga ; ngan ym leh jubor ïa phi .

U la leit kham jngai sa katto katne , u dem la khrup ïa lade bad ka khmat sha khyndew , bad u la duwai , Ko Kpa jong nga , lada ka long kaba lah , to shim noh ïa kane khuri ka ka shitom jingshah na nga ! Pynban , ym ïa kaei kaba nga mon , ïa hynrei kaei kaba me mon .
translation.en: And he went a little further , and fell on his face , and prayed , saying ,  O my Father , if it be possible , let this cup pass from me : nevertheless not as I will , but as thou wilt .
And now , behold , I have brought the firstfruits of the land , which thou , O  Lord  , hast given me . And thou shalt set it before the  Lord  thy God , and worship before the  Lord  thy God :
translation.kha: Kumta nga wallam mynta sha U  Trai  ïa u soh nyngkong na ka jingot ba u la ai ha nga .’  Nangta buh ïa ka shang ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  bad mane hangta .

translation.en: And , behold , two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus , which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi , ar ngut na ki nongbud jong U Jisu ki dang leit sha ka shnong kaba kyrteng ka Emmaus , kumba khatwei kilomitar na Jerusalem ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ? And he said , I will go forth , and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And he said , Thou shalt persuade him , and prevail also : go forth , and do so .
translation.kha: ‘ Kumno ?’ U  Trai  u kylli . U mynsiem u jubab , ‘ Ngan leit bad pynlong ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa u Ahab ban kren lamler . U  Trai  u ong , leit bad shukor ïa u . Phin sa jop .’

translation.en: Her house is the way to hell , going down to the chambers of death .
translation.kha: Lada me leit sha ka ïing jong ka , me don ha ka lynti sha ka ri kiba ïap . Ka dei ka lynti kaba jan tam sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: O  Lord  , I have heard thy speech , and was afraid : O  Lord  , revive thy work in the midst of the years , in the midst of the years make known  ; in wrath remember mercy .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei ba me la leh , bad nga la dap da ka jingtiengburom . Mynta to leh biang ha ki por jong ngi ïa ki kam bakhraw kiba me la ju leh . To leh-isynei , wat haba me bitar .

translation.en: For was not Israel a derision unto thee ? was he found among thieves ? for since thou spakest of him , thou skippedst for joy .
translation.kha: Ko Moab , to kynmaw kumno pha rkhiebeiñ ïa ki paid Israel ? Pha la leh ïa ki kumba ki la ngat ha ka kynhun ki nonglute .
Hynrei u u pynlong ïa Joab ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ba kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u ; ki la mihnoh na khmat jong u bad ki la leit ban ñiew ïa paid Israel
translation.en: Notwithstanding the king s word prevailed against Joab , and against the captains of the host . And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king , to number the people of Israel .
O earth , cover not thou my blood , and let my cry have no place .
translation.kha: Ko Pyrthei , wat buhrieh ïa ki jingbakla ba la leh ïa nga ! Wat ai ba ka jingkhot jong nga ïa ka jingshisha , yn pynsngap jar !

translation.en: Whether you have the New World Translation in your language or not , we encourage you to get into a good routine of reading Jehovah’s Word every day . —Joshua 1 :8  ; Psalm 1 :2 , 3 .
translation.kha: La phi don ne phim don ïa ka Jingpynkyllaktien Pyrthei Bathymmai ha ka ktien jong phi , ngi pynshlur ïa phi ban pule ïa ka ktien jong U Jehobah man la ka sngi . —Joshua 1 :8 ; Salm 1 :2 , 3 .
To ïaishah bad shahshkor sa katne ïa kaei ba nga ong na ka liang jong U Blei .
translation.en: Suffer me a little , and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God s behalf .

translation.kha: U Saul leit u mar mar ryngkat bad lai hajar ngut ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel sha ka ri Siph khlaw ban wad ïa u Dabid ,
translation.en: Then Saul arose , and went down to the wilderness of Ziph , having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him , to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph .

translation.kha: Mynno ngi la ju ïohi ïa me ba me long u nongwei bad , ba pdiang ngi sngewbha ïa me ha ki ïing jong ngi , lane ba me lyngkhuit bad ba ngi pynkup jaiñ ïa me ?
translation.en: When saw we thee a stranger , and took thee in ? or naked , and clothed thee ?
Now I know that the  Lord  is greater than all gods : for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them .
translation.kha: Mynta nga tip ba U  Trai  u kham khraw ban ïa ki blei baroh , namar u la leh ïa kane mynba ki nong Ijipt ki la lehbeiñ shaba palat ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , If ye have faith , and doubt not , ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree , but also if ye shall say unto this mountain , Be thou removed , and be thou cast into the sea  ; it shall be done .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lada phi ngeit bad phim sngew artatien , phin lah ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ïa une u dieng Dumbur . Bad ym tang kane , hynrei phin lah wat ban ong ha une u lum , ‘ Khie joit bad pynnoh ïa lade sha duriaw ,’ bad un leh kumta .

translation.en: And the three companies blew the trumpets , and brake the pitchers , and held the lamps in their left hands , and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal : and they cried , The sword of the  Lord  , and of Gideon .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Moses kynting ong jingkhñium ki mut , jingïasoh la ïa-lamler Mareshah pahai pop kaba Loit eh . Mynta ngan die kiew biang sha satia Trai ; lehse nga jubor ban pynïoh ïa at jingmap ïa ka pop jong phi .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses said unto the people , Ye have sinned a great sin : and now I will go up unto the  Lord   ; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin .

translation.kha: Katba u syiem bad ki briew jong Khalkedon baroh ki nongkam iehnoh ïa ka nongbah , ki la sangeh ha ka ïing kaba khatduh .
translation.en: And the king went forth , and all the people after him , and tarried in a place that was far off .

translation.kha: U Trai wanpaw u u ha Solomon mynmiet . U ong ha u , Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong me , bad nga la pdiang ïa kane ka Templ kum ka jaka kaba ha yn ai ïa ki jingkñia ha nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared to Solomon by night , and said unto him , I have heard thy prayer , and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice .

translation.kha: Lada kaei kaba la tei ha ka nongrim kam ing ha ka ding , u un ïohpdiang ïa ka bainong .
translation.en: If any man s work abide which he hath built thereupon , he shall receive a reward .
Their slain also shall be cast out , and their stink shall come up out of their carcases , and the mountains shall be melted with their blood .
translation.kha: Yn ym tep ïa ki metïap jong ki , hynrei kin pyut hangta bad kin iwtung ; bad ki lumbah kin saw da ka snam .

translation.en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes , and when she saw Isaac , she lighted off the camel .
translation.kha: Haba ka Rebekka ka ïohi ïa u Isaak , ka la hiar noh na ka ut ,
Nangta Joab la phah khubor sha u Dabid kaba ïa u shaphang ka ,
translation.en: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war  ;
And he discerned him not , because his hands were hairy , as his brother Esau s hands : so he blessed him .
translation.kha: Um shym la ithuh ïa u Jakob namar ba ki kti jong u ki long kiba mih shñiuh kum ki jong u Iso .

translation.en: And the chief priests took the silver pieces , and said , It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury , because it is the price of blood .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la khar ïa ki sbai rupa bad ki la ong ,  Kane ka dei ka pisa babit snam , bad ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ban buh ïa ka hapoh ka jingkynshew ka Templ .

translation.en: Ye are bought with a price ; be not ye the servants of men .
translation.kha: U Blei u la thied ïa phi da ka dor ; kumta to wat long ki mraw jong ki briew .

translation.en: And Esau said , I have enough , my brother  ; keep that thou hast unto thyself .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Iso u ong ,  Ko hep , nga dap biang kyrhai ; buh ïa kaei kaba phi don .

translation.en: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant , to be a God unto thee , and to thy seed after thee .
translation.kha: Ngan bat ïa la ka kular bad me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ha ki pateng ki ban dang wan ba kan long ka jutang kaba ïaineh junom . Ngan long U Blei jong me bad U Blei jong ki khun ki ksiew jong me .

Ko parabangeit jong ngi , ngi hukum ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ban ngi noh kiar na ki bangeit baroh im kiba ka jingim bajaipdeh bad ki bym bud ïa ki jingbthah kiba ngi ai ha ki .
translation.en: Now we command you , brethren , in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly , and not after the tradition which he received of us .
And there were also sodomites in the land : and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the  Lord  cast out before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Kaba kham sniew ïa baroh , ka long ba don ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kiba shakri kum ki nuti ha kita ki jaka mane blei thala . Ki paid Judah ki la leh ïa kine ki kam kiba ilehrain ba ju leh da kito ki briew ïa kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki Israel ki dang leit kurup ïa ka .

translation.en: And ran through that whole region round about , and began to carry about in beds those that were sick , where they heard he was .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïamareh ha baroh kata ka thain ; bad shano shano ba ki la ïohsngew ba u don , ki la wallam ha u ïa ki briew kiba pang kiba thiah ha ki jingthiah jong ki .

translation.en: And call ye on the name of your gods , and I will call on the name of the  Lord  : and the God that answereth by fire , let him be God . And all the people answered and said , It is well spoken .
translation.kha: Nangta ai ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal kin duwai ha u blei jong ki , bad ma nga ngan duwai ha U  Trai  , bad uta uba jubab da kaba phah ïa ka ding — uta u dei U Blei .  U paidbah u la pyrta bad ai ïa ka jingmynjur .

translation.en: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field , and his boughs were multiplied , and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters , when he shot forth .
translation.kha: Namar ba la ai um pahuh , u san kham shajrong ban ïa kiwei pat ki dieng ki tnat jong u ki rben bad ki jrong .

translation.en: And when they were come to the place , which is called Calvary , there they crucified him , and the malefactors , one on the right hand , and the other on the left .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka jaka ba la khot  Ka Maloi Khlieh ,  ki la sahnarphna ïa U Jisu hangta , bad ïa ki ar ngut ki nongleh kam runar , uwei sha kamon jong u bad uwei pat sha kadiang jong u .

translation.en: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds , with their knops and their flowers .
translation.kha: Ha ka met jong u diengpynïeng sharak hi yn don saw tylli ki khuri kiba kum ki syntiew almond lem bad ki shylluit bad ki dop-syntiew ba la oh-shrong itynnat .
Hynrei u Abiathar , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Ahimelekh , u la lait im , bad u leit ïasoh bad u . Dabid
translation.en: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub , named Abiathar , escaped , and fled after David .
But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed , and keep all my statutes , and do that which is lawful and right , he shall surely live , he shall not die .
translation.kha: Lada u briew uba sniew u sangeh ban leh pop bad u sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga , lada u leh ïa kaba dei bad kaba bha , un ym ïap ; un im da shisha .

translation.en: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the  Lord s  lot fell , and offer him for a sin offering .
translation.kha: U Aaron un kñia ïa u  langsohmoh uba hap ha U  Trai  da ka jingkynting sbai , bad un kñia ïa u kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop .

translation.en: It is for the prince  ; the prince , he shall sit in it to eat bread before the  Lord   ; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate , and shall go out by the way of the same .
translation.kha: Hynrei u khun syiem uba synshar , u lah ban rung hangta ban bam ïa ka jingbam bakhuid ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga . Un rung bad mih ïa ka khyrdop lyngba ka kamra ban rung ban mih ha ka bynta kaba kham shapoh .

To pynshlur ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem lamwir) To ïathuh ha ki sahnarphna ki la jynjar slem bha bad ïa ki pop jong ki la map mynta tyrpeng Nga la pynshitom ïa ki la biang Hephsibah na ka bynta ki pop jong ki baroh .
translation.en: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem , and cry unto her , that her warfare is accomplished , that her iniquity is pardoned : for she hath received of the  Lord s  hand double for all her sins .

translation.kha: Ki ki ñiewkor ïa kiwei pat , lah pynkhih kulmar ïa ki baroh . kiba stad jai ïa kiei .
translation.en: Scornful men bring a city into a snare : but wise men turn away wrath .
And saith unto him , All these things will I give thee , if thou wilt fall down and worship me .
translation.kha: Ïa kine baroh ngan ai ha me ,  u Soitan u la ong ,  lada men dem khohsiew bad mane ïa nga .
U uba long shaniah ha U Blei , uba la jied u ïa ban leh ïa kane ka kam , kumba u Moses u la long uba lah ban shaniah ha ka kam jong ha u ka ïing U Blei .
translation.en: Who was faithful to him that appointed him , as also Moses was faithful in all his house .
For he cometh in with vanity , and departeth in darkness , and his name shall be covered with darkness .
translation.kha: Kam wanrah jingbha ïa ita i khunlung i ban sa kha , i jah noh sha ka jingdum , ha kaba la klet noh ïa i .

Bad ma ngi da lade ngi tip tlang Mynmiet ïa ka jingieit myntoi U Blei u don na ka bynta jong ngi . U Blei bakhuid jingbitar jingkraw jingieit , jingsam uno uno uba im ha ka jingieit , u mirr bad Gimso Blei bad U Blei u im hapoh jong u .
translation.en: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us . God is love  ; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God , and God in him .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatsaw , u Khedorlaomer lem bad kita Taberah syiem kiba Sing ha ka liang jong u shohdab la wan ryngkat bad la jingïathoh shipai Thang jop ñiew pyntwa Rephaim ha Ashteroth Karnaim , ïa Jin Susim pynkhap Ham , ïa ki Emim ha ka pyntha jong ka Kiriathaim ,
translation.en: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer , and the kings that were with him , and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim , and the Zuzims in Ham , and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim ,

translation.kha: Ka kynhun lieng jong u Hiram , kaba la wan kit ksiar na Ophir , ka la wan kit ruh ki dieng Kseh-Juniper bad mawlynnai
translation.en: And the navy also of Hiram , that brought gold from Ophir , brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees , and precious stones .

translation.kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un bakyrpang uba im thala jingbnoh patan bym kynja mynsiem , kum u Iso , uba tang namar shisien ka jingbam u la jingit noh ïa ki hok jong u kum u hynmen .
translation.en: Lest there be any fornicator , or profane person , as Esau , who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright .
And the men of Gibeah rose against me , and beset the house round about upon me by night , and thought to have slain me : and my concubine have they forced , that she is dead .
translation.kha: Ki nong Gibeah ki wan ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad mynmiet ki kerkut ïa ka ïing . Ki thmu ban pynïap ïa nga ; pynban ki leh pynjahburom ïa ka tnga kliar jong nga , bad ka da ïap noh .
Baroh kito kiba la ithuh ïa U Jisu , kynthup ki kynthei kiba la bud u ïa na Galilaïa ki , la ïeng na pajih ban jngoh .
translation.en: And all his acquaintance , and the women that followed him from Galilee , stood afar off , beholding these things .
And he said unto them ,  Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place , and rest a while :  for there were many coming and going , and they had no leisure so much as to eat .
translation.kha: La don bun ki briew kiba la wan bad leit , haduh ba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u kim don por shuh wat ban bam jingbam . Kumta u la ong ïa ki ,  To ngin ïaleit noh tang ma ngi sha ka jaka ba ngin ïalong tang para ma ngi bad phi lah ban pynjahthait shipor .
U Trai kren ha u Moses u Aaron ha Ijipt :
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt , saying ,
Now we know that God heareth not sinners : but if any man be a worshipper of God , and doeth his will , him he heareth .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei um ju shahshkor ïa ki nongpop ; u shahshkor ïa ki briew kiba burom ïa u bad ba leh ïa kaei kaba u kwah ïa ki ban leh .

U pynlong ïa ki paid Benjamin bad uwei pa uwei uba ha don Jerusalem ban kular sumar ban ïa ka jutang . Bad kumta ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ki kohnguh ïa ki jingdawa ka jutang kiba ki la pynlong bad U Blei jong ki kpa jong tymmen ki .
translation.en: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it . And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God , the God of their fathers .
And Samuel came to Saul : and Saul said unto him , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  : I have performed the commandment of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Samuel u la leit sha u Saul , uba la khublei ïa u , da kaba ong ,  U  Trai  u kyrkhu ïa phi , Samuel ! Nga la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai .

translation.en: Destruction and misery are in their ways :
translation.kha: ki ieh ka jingjot bad ka jingpynjot shano shano ba ki leit .

translation.en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been  ; as infants which never saw light .
translation.kha: Te ngan jin da la ïohthiah kum ki khun syiem kiba pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ka ksiar bad ka rupa , lane ïohthiah kum u khunlung ba dang shu kha .

translation.en: Then Jesus sent the multitude away , and went into the house : and his disciples came unto him , saying , Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa u paidbah bad u la leit rung shapoh ïing , ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  To ïathuh ïa ngi aïu ka pharshi shaphang ki ñiut hapoh ka lyngkha ka kit jingmut .

translation.en: The nakedness of thy father , or the nakedness of thy mother , shalt thou not uncover : she is thy mother  ; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .
translation.kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kmie , namar mem dei ban pynjahburom ïa la ka jong ka kmie .

Ngan tbeh ïa ka ding ha ki templ jong ki blei ki Ijipt , bad u syiem ka Babilonia un ïa ki jong ki ne ïalam noh ki . Katba ki nongap langbrot dang jied ïa ki jaiñ jong ki kiba lait jynreiñ , te u ka Babilonia un pynkhuid ïa ka ri Ijipt nangta ki da ka jingjop .
translation.en: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt  ; and he shall burn them , and carry them away captives : and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt , as a shepherd putteth on his garment  ; and he shall go forth from thence in peace .
For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers , specially they of the circumcision :
translation.kha: Naba don shibun , khamtam kiba la kylla na ka niam Jiw , kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad kiba shukor ïa kiwei da ka jingleh bym don jingmut jong ki .

translation.en: I will also gather all nations , and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat , and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel , whom they have scattered among the nations , and parted my land .
translation.kha: Ngan lumlang ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew bad wallam ïa ki sha ka Them jong ka Jingbishar . Hangta ngan bishar ïa ki na ka bynta baroh kaba ki la leh ïa ki briew jong nga . Ki la pynsakma ïa ki Israel sha ki ri nongwei bad ki la phiah ïa ka Israel , ka ri jong nga .

translation.en: For there is nothing hid , which shall not be manifested  ; neither was any thing kept secret , but that it should come abroad .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei kaei ba la buhrieh yn sei shabar ha kaba paw , bad ïa kaei kaei ba la tap yn sa law noh .
Ainguh ïa ka jingainguh bam da u purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u purew lem bad u masi , sa ar kilo u purew bad u langbrot ,
translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram ,
He telleth the number of the stars  ; he calleth them all by their names .
translation.kha: U rai ïa ka jingdon jong ki khlur bad u khot ïa uwei pa uwei da ka kyrteng .

translation.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah , which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga ha ka snem kaba shiphew ba u Sedekaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , kaba long ruh ka snem kaba khatphra jong u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia .
Ïa ki kulai na ka bynta Solomon la wan kit na Musri bad na kiwei pat ki .
translation.en: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt , and out of all lands .
God promised that Jesus would become the King of His Kingdom .
translation.kha: U Blei u kular ba u Jisu un-long U Syiem jong ka Hima jong u .

Kin hap shuh ban khar diengïap sha lum sha wah ne thoh dieng na khlaw , namar ki don ki ba la iehnoh ban thang ding . Kin kurup bad lute kito kiba kurup bad lute ïa ki , U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: So that they shall take no wood out of the field , neither cut down any out of the forests  ; for they shall burn the weapons with fire : and they shall spoil those that spoiled them , and rob those that robbed them , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Namar ba la palat ka jingthngan , hap bam sa ïa la ki ki khun .
translation.en: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons , and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat .

translation.kha: pynsieb ïa-bta Trai sngewlyngngoh la kper ha nga ;
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Wat pyntam ei ei nalor kaba nga hukum ïa phi , lane pynduna ei na ka . Kohnguh ïa hukum U Trai U Blei jong phi ïa kiba la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you , neither shall ye diminish ought from it , that ye may keep the commandments of the  Lord  your God which I command you .

translation.kha: Ko Kornelios ! U Blei u ïohsngew ïa ki jingduwai jong me kynmaw ïa ki kam jong me .
translation.en: And said , Cornelius , thy prayer is heard , and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God .

translation.kha: Ka la san khlaiñ eh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ka bneng , ïa ki khlur , hi bad ka la bret katto katne na ki sha bad khyndew ka la ïuh halor jong ki .
translation.en: And it waxed great , even to the host of heaven  ; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground , and stamped upon them .

translation.kha: U Isaïah u jubab , U Trai un ai ha me dak ban pynshisha ba un bat ka kular .
translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the  Lord  , that the  Lord  will do this thing that he hath spoken  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei , A Trai , me long u Kpa jong ngi . Ngi long kum ka , dewbyrtha bad me long kum u nongthaw khiew .
translation.en: But now , O  Lord  , thou art our father  ; we are the clay , and thou our potter  ; and we all are the work of thy hand .
And he communed with them , saying , If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight  ; hear me , and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar ,
translation.kha: Lada phi shah ïa nga ban tep ïa la ka tnga hangne , to pynkyrpad lem ïa u Ephron u khun jong u Sohar ba un die ha nga ïa ka krem Makhpelah , kaba don ha trai ka lyngkha jong u .

translation.en: If he be able to fight with me , and to kill me , then will we be your servants : but if I prevail against him , and kill him , then shall ye be our servants , and serve us .
translation.kha: Lada u jop bad u pynïap ïa nga , ngin long noh ki mraw jong phi ; hynrei lada ma nga , nga jop bad nga pynïap ïa u , phin long ki mraw jong ngi .
To pyrkhat khia uwei ïa pat , ban ïarap uwei ïa uwei pat , ban pynpaw ïa ka jingïa-ieit bad ban lehbha .
translation.en: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works :
Then said Joab , I may not tarry thus with thee . And he took three darts in his hand , and thrust them through the heart of Absalom , while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak .
translation.kha: Ngan ym pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por bad me ,  u Joab u ong . U rah lai tylli ki sum , bad u pynngam ïa ki ha ka shadem jong u Absalom katba u dang im , haba u dang sdien ha u dieng Sning .
Kumta u Asa u shim rupa bad ksiar na ka jingkynshew jong Templ bad ka ïingsyiem bad sha Damaskos , Benhadad u syiem Syria , bad kane khubor :
translation.en: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the  Lord  and of the king s house , and sent to Ben–hadad king of Syria , that dwelt at Damascus , saying ,

translation.kha: Wat haba la pynshitom , Girgash shym la pynïap ; wat haba la pynsngewsih , ngi long borabor kiba kmen ; ngi paw kum kiba duk , hynrei ngi riehtngen ïa ine iphuh kiba bun ; ngi jingpynbna kum ki Bymjukut don ei ei , pynban ngi don lut ïa kiei kiei baroh .
translation.en: As sorrowful , yet alway rejoicing ; as poor , yet making many rich ; as having nothing , and yet possessing all things .

translation.kha: Kumta u Isaak u la shong la ha sah Gerar .
translation.en: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar :

translation.kha: U Asalaïah jubab , Sha Babilonia , ha kaba kin shi Lusias templ krensih ka bynta jong ka . Haba la dep shna ïa ka Templ , ïa ka shang yn buh hangta ïa ka ba yn mane .
translation.en: And he said unto me , To build it an house in the land of Shinar : and it shall be established , and set there upon her own base .

translation.kha: U nongrep uba jaipdeh palat Bashngain lur ïa ki lyngkha jong u ha ka por Mihngi biang un ym ïoh ei ei ïa ka ban ot i
translation.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold  ; therefore shall he beg in harvest , and have nothing .

And I have heard of thee , that thou canst make interpretations , and dissolve doubts : now if thou canst read the writing , and make known to me the interpretation thereof , thou shalt be clothed with scarlet , and have a chain of gold about thy neck , and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom .
translation.kha: Mynta nga la ïohsngew ba me lah ban shem ïa ki jingmut barieh bad batai ïa ki jingmaïan . Lada me lah ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ïathuh ïa nga aïu ka kit jingmut , yn pynkup ïa me ha ki jaiñkup syiem ba sawbthuh , yn pyndeng ha me ïa u kynjri ksiar jong ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong me , bad men long uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hima .
ngi leit phai sha ka shyiap shaphang ka Duriaw Basaw , kumba U Trai la , bad la pynlut por slem kaba ïaid sakma ha ri lum Edom .
translation.en: Then we turned , and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea , as the  Lord  spake unto me : and we compassed mount Seir many days .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ngi dei nang ïa ka ha kaba leh babha ba ki lah pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam bashisha ; kim dei im ka jingim bymlarkam .
translation.en: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses , that they be not unfruitful .
Yea , young children despised me  ; I arose , and they spake against me .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki peitbeiñ ïa nga bad ki rkhie haba ki ïohi ïa nga .

translation.en: By the word of truth , by the power of God , by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left ,
translation.kha: Ngi don ïa ka hok kum ka atiar jong ngi , ïa ka ban ïaleh bad ban ïada ïa lade ruh .

translation.en: I will go and return to my place , till they acknowledge their offence , and seek my face : in their affliction they will seek me early .
translation.kha: Ngan lyndet noh ïa ki briew jong nga haduh ba kin shahshitom ha ban da biang na ka bynta ki pop jong ki bad wan ban wad ïa nga . Lehse ha ki jingshah shitom jong ki , kin pyrshang ban wad ïa nga .

translation.en: And Abraham was an hundred years old , when his son Isaac was born unto him .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la dap shispah snem ka rta mynba la kha ïa u Isaak .
Ka long ka jingbieit bud ïa la ki jong . To long shngain , bad bud ïa ki jinghikai jong ki briew kiba kham stad .
translation.en: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool : but whoso walketh wisely , he shall be delivered .

translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai , namar hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong u pat kiwei ki dkhot jong ka longïing u syiem Ahab ki la long ki nongai jingmut ïa u , bad ki la pynlong ïa ka jingkyllon noh jong u .
translation.en: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  like the house of Ahab : for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction .

translation.en: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest , and cut off his right ear .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Pharaoh , Glory over me : when shall I entreat for thee , and for thy servants , and for thy people , to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses , that they may remain in the river only ?
Though the root thereof wax old in the earth , and the stock thereof die in the ground  ;
translation.kha: Wat la ki thied jong u ki man tymmen noh , bad u dyngkhong jong u , u ïap ha ka khyndew ,

Namar kane ngan pynhap ïa ka jingjynjar ha ka longïing syiem jong ngan pynïap ïa ki khun ki ksiew shynrang baroh , ïa u samla bad u tymmen kumjuh . Ngan pynduh khoit ïa longïing jong me kumba sar lut ïa ka jakhlia .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam , and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel , and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam , as a man taketh away dung , till it be all gone .
And why call ye me , Lord , Lord , and do not the things which I say ?
translation.kha: Balei ba phi khot ïa nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai ,’ bad pynban phim leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ha phi ?
Napdeng jong ki , ki long ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Mari ka kmie u Jakob bad u Josis jingiaseng Jehoïakhin tnga u Sebedi Arnon
translation.en: Among which was Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James and Joses , and the mother of Zebedee s children .
And the Egyptians shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh , upon his chariots , and upon his horsemen .
translation.kha: Ynda nga la jop ïa ki , ki nong Ijipt kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah , and it shall devour the palaces thereof , with shouting in the day of battle , with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind :
translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ki kynroh ka nongbah Rabbah , bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut jong ka . Te kan don ki jingkhynwin ha ka sngi ïaleh thma , bad ka jingïaleh kaba jur kum ka  erlangthari .
bad kumta U Trai u ong ba ki pynkhlaiñ hajrong u Selophehad ïabuaid lah ban Hanokh ho-oid uno uno uba ki mon , hynrei tang hapoh ka jait jong ki hi .
translation.en: This is the thing which the  Lord  doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad , saying , Let them marry to whom they think best  ; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry .

translation.kha: To ba ka jingisynei , jingsuk , bad ka jingieit kan long ha phi ha ka jingthew ba-dap .
translation.en: Mercy unto you , and peace , and love , be multiplied .

translation.kha: U Trai u la Onan ba pynsakma Solomon u la pan ïa kane ,
translation.en: And the speech pleased the Lord , that Solomon had asked this thing .

translation.kha: To khmih ïa ka jingïaishah slem U Trai jong ngi kum ka lad ba u ai ha phi ban ïoh im , kumba u u Paul para ba-ieit jong ngi u la thoh ha phi , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingstad kaba U Blei la u ai ha u .
translation.en: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation  ; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you  ;

translation.kha: Haba nga la ïohi ïa u , nga la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong Mano kum u briew ba la ïap . U la buh ïa ka kti kamon jong u halor jong nga Nimrah u pynsuki ong , Wat sheptieng ! Nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh .
translation.en: And when I saw him , I fell at his feet as dead . And he laid his right hand upon me , saying unto me ,  Fear not  ; I am the first and the last :

translation.kha: u Abishai u khun jong ka Seruïah u wan ïarap ïa u Dabid , u tur ïaleh ïa u bad u pynïap ïa u . Nangta ki rangbah u Dabid ki la pynkular ïa u Dabid ba un ym leit shuh da lei lei ruh sha ka thma Phi long ka jingkyrmen jong ka Israel , bad ngim ban noh ïa phi , ki la ong .
translation.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him , and smote the Philistine , and killed him . Then the men of David sware unto him , saying , Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle , that thou quench not the light of Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei ynda ka k poi hangta , U Trai u pynshitom sa ïa jingsngewrit ka nongbah nia bad u pynkhih kulmar ïa ka rangsan U pynshitom ïa ki da ki jingmad purew kiba mih mai baroh thombor Teng jong ka nongbah , ki samla bad tymmen kumjuh jingheh
translation.en: And it was so , that , after they had carried it about , the hand of the  Lord  was against the city with a very great destruction : and he smote the men of the city , both small and great , and they had emerods in their secret parts .

translation.kha: Ngam ong ba ka kular jong U kam la treikam namar ym baroh ki paid Israel ki long briew jong .
translation.en: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect . For they are not all Israel , which are of Israel :

translation.kha: Kam don jingbha ban thaw ïa ka dur nar ban mane u blei !
translation.en: Who hath formed a god , or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing ?
Let all bitterness , and wrath , and anger , and clamour , and evil speaking , be put away from you , with all malice :
translation.kha: To bret noh ïa baroh ka jingkthang mynsiem , ka jingkwah brai bad ka jingbitar . Keiñ noh ka jingkaw kaw , lane ka jingkrenbeiñ bad keiñ noh ki jingsngew isih la ha kano kano ka rukom .
Wat pynduh Onesimos ki hok jong Jakarieh bran lane ki banleh , bad pynkohnguh shim ïa Pahath jaiñkup jong ka riewkynthei kum Akhsib bynda ïa kano kano ka jingpeit .
translation.en: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger , nor of the fatherless  ; nor take a widow s raiment to pledge :
And they all wept sore , and fell on Paul s neck , and kissed him ,
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïa-ïam haba ki la kdup ïa u bad ki la doh khublei ïakhlad bad u .

Lada u syiem u mih bad ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ban ïa ïaleh uwei pat u syiem uba wan pyrshah ïa u lem bad arphew hajar ngut ki rangbah , nyngkong un shong bad rai la u long uba khlaiñ bha ïa ban ïakynduh uwei pat u syiem .
translation.en: Or what king , going to make war against another king , sitteth not down first , and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand ?

translation.kha: U Isaak u la tei ka duwan hangta mane ïa U . Nangta u ïa ka dara hangta , bad ki shakri jong u ki ïatih sa kawei pat ka pukri .
translation.en: And he builded an altar there , and called upon the name of the  Lord  , and pitched his tent there : and there Isaac s servants digged a well .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ban u ban bad U na ka jong nga , u briew u ïasaid ka u paralok jong u .
translation.en: O that one might plead for a man with God , as a man pleadeth for his neighbour !

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki dieng da jingbah ka dieng akasia , bad suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , that the table may be borne with them .
And Micaiah said , Behold , thou shalt see in that day , when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself .
translation.kha: Phin sa shem haba phin leit shadien ka kamra ban rieh ,  U Mikaïah u jubab .

Lada ka pynsngewbha ïa phi , ko syiem , Beerelim lada phi sngewsynei ïa nga bad ka pa’ kaba dei ha phi , sngewbha pynmih in jingpynbna longsyiem jylli ïa ki hukum u Haman na kaba pyntreikam ïa ki jingtynrah kito ki hukum kiba u 22 jong u Hammedatha uba hiarpateng na u Agag u la ai na ka bynta ka jingpynjot kismis ki shnong baroh ha pui hima .
translation.en: And said , If it please the king , and if I have found favour in his sight , and the thing seem right before the king , and I be pleasing in his eyes , let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king s provinces :
And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father : and the physicians embalmed Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u hukum ban kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka met u kpa jong u . Ki nongkyllan jingiwbih ruh ki leh kumta .

translation.en: And the  Lord  God prepared a gourd , and made it to come up over Jonah , that it might be a shadow over his head , to deliver him from his grief . So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  U Blei u la pynlong ïa u jingthung ban san kham jrong ïa u Jonah khnang ban ai ïa u katto katne ka jingkah syrngiew , khnang ba un kham tngen . U Jonah u la sngewkmen shibun ïa u jingthung .

translation.en: Open thy mouth , judge righteously , and plead the cause of the poor and needy .
translation.kha: Kren na ka bynta jong ki bad long u nongbishar uba hok . Ïada ïa ki hok jong kiba duk bad kiba kyrduh .
la thaw ïa u khun masi ksiar ha Sinai bad mane ïa uta bleithaw ;
translation.en: They made a calf in Horeb , and worshipped the molten image .

So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought  ; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised , and her magnificence should be destroyed , whom all Asia and the world worshippeth .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingma , te , ba kane ka kam jong ngi kan budnam . Ym tang kata , hynrei ka don ruh ka jingma ba ka templ jong ka blei Artemis kan ym don jingmut ei ei shuh bad ba ïa ka jingkhraw jong ka yn pynduh — ka blei ba la mane da uwei pa uwei ha Asia bad ha ka pyrthei baroh !

translation.en: So Gad came to David , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Choose thee
translation.kha: U Gad u la leit sha U Dabid , u ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong , bad u kylli ,  Kano men jied ?

U angel jong U Trai u la ong ha u Soitan , To U Trai un pynrem ïa , ko me Soitan ! To U Trai , uba ieit ïa ka Jerusalem , un pynrem ïa me . Une u briew u kum long u dieng ïa uba la noh sei na ka ding .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , The  Lord  rebuke thee , O Satan  ; even the  Lord  that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee : is not this a brand plucked out of the fire ?

translation.kha: Ka don ka jingkyrmen na ka bynta ka lawei jong phi ; ki khun jong phi kin wan phai sha pat la ri ka . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And there is hope in thine end , saith the  Lord  , that thy children shall come again to their own border .

And , behold , the angel of the Lord came upon him , and a light shined in the prison : and he smote Peter on the side , and raised him up , saying , Arise up quickly . And his chains fell off from his hands .
translation.kha: Kynsan u angel jong U Trai u la ïeng hangta , bad ka jingshai ka la thaba hapoh ka kamra byndi . U angel u la pynkhih ïa u Petros na ka tyrpeng , u la kyrsiew ïa u , bad u la ong ,  Pynkloi ! Khie joit !  mar kumta hi ki kynjri ki la hap na ki kti jong u Petros .

translation.en: And Baalath , and Tamar in the wilderness , in the land ,
translation.kha: ka Baalath , ka Tamar ha ka ri khlaw Judah ,

translation.en: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus : and great grace was upon them all .
translation.kha: Da ka bor bakhraw ki apostol ki la sakhi ïa ka jingmihpat jong U Trai Jisu , bad U Blei u la theh ki jingkyrkhu ba-dap kyrhai ha ki baroh .

Tang shu kynjat shai , U Jisu u la mihnoh na shnong bad ïaryntih la leit sha ka jaka bakynjah . Ki paidbah ki la sdang ban wad ïa u , bad haba ki la shem ïa bahakhlieh , ki la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u na kaba leit ïadon .
translation.en: And when it was day , he departed and went into a desert place : and the people sought him , and came unto him , and stayed him , that he should not depart from them .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,

translation.en: Or have found that which was lost , and lieth concerning it , and sweareth falsely  ; in any of all these that a man doeth , sinning therein :
translation.kha: lane da kaba thok shaphang kano kano ba ka la jah noh bad u smai ba um shym shem pat ïa ka .

translation.en: Then should I yet have comfort  ; yea , I would harden myself in sorrow : let him not spare  ; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One .
translation.kha: Lada nga la tip ba un leh , ngan rynsied da kaba kmen , kam pher katno khraw ka jingpang jong nga . Nga tip ba U Blei u long uba khuid ; ngam pat ju pyrshah ïa kaei kaba u hukum .

translation.en: A day of darkness and of gloominess , a day of clouds and of thick darkness , as the morning spread upon the mountains : a great people and a strong  ; there hath not been ever the like , neither shall be any more after it , even to the years of many generations .
translation.kha: Kan sa long ka sngi kaba dum bad kaba pynlong jingkhuslai , ka sngi kaba ïong bad ba-dum lyoh . Ka kynhun bakhraw jong ki puit ka tur kum ka jingdum kaba pyiar halor ki lumbah . Ym ju don mynno mynno ruh kum kane , bad yn ym don shuh lano lano ruh .

translation.en: Wealth and riches shall be in his house : and his righteousness endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ka longïing jong u kan long kaba don ba em bad kaba riewspah ; bad un roi kyrhai junom .

Phi tip khlur-kba Kosam Jisu jingpihuiñ na Nasareth bad kumno U Blei Samuel la theh diengphasi jong u ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad kynteit ka bor . U la leit kylleng Trophimos u da leh ki kam babha ïashun u da pynkhiah tnum baroh kiba la prong jingbymman ka bor jong u Ksuid , naba U Blei u la don lem bad u .
translation.en: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power : who went about doing good , and healing all that were oppressed of the devil  ; for God was with him .
And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness , but rather reprove them .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban ïadon bynta ei ei bad ki kam bym don jingmyntoi kiba ki briew ki leh , kiba long ki kam ka jingdum . Pynban wallam ïa ki sha ka jingshai .

translation.en: Know ye not that we shall judge angels ? how much more things that pertain to this life ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba ngin sa bishar ïa ki angel ? Katno tam , te , ïa kiei kiei ki jong kane ka jingim !
Hato me la pan Eshtemoa kynrei Blei ban pyn-i ha me ïa ki jingduna jong moi , bad hato me la kohnguh ban ym leh pop shuh ?
translation.en: That which I see not teach thou me : if I have done iniquity , I will do no more .
After they were come to Mysia , they assayed to go into Bithynia : but the Spirit suffered them not .

translation.en: And Joseph found grace in his sight , and he served him : and he made him overseer over his house , and all that he had he put into his hand .

Bad da kaba khlem tlot jingngeit , u um shim rkhiang ba kamet jongu mynta ka la iap myn ha ka por ba u la dap shispah :97-100 ka rta , lane ïa ka plakhun jong ka Sarah .
translation.en: And being not weak in faith , he considered not his own body now dead , when he was about an hundred years old , neither yet the deadness of Sara s womb :

translation.en: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him , even unto Artaxerxes the king  ; Thy servants the men on this side the river , and at such a time .

translation.kha: U Moses u la sngewlyngngoh ïa kaei kaba u la ïohi , bad u la hajan leit lawlynnong ka ban ïohi kham bha . Hynrei u la ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Trai :
translation.en: When Moses saw it , he wondered at the sight : and as he drew near to behold it , the voice of the Lord came unto him ,

And when James , Cephas , and John , who seemed to be pillars , perceived the grace that was given unto me , they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship ; that we should go unto the heathen , and they unto the circumcision .
translation.kha: U Jakob , u Petros , bad u Ïoannis , kiba i ba ki long ki nongïalam , ki la tip ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kam bakyrpang ; kumta ki la ïakhublei kti ïa u Barnabas lem bad ïa nga de , kum ka dak ba ngi ïalong baroh ki nongïatrei lang . Ngi la ïamynjur ba u Barnabas bad nga , ngin ïatrei hapdeng ki Jentil , bad ki pat hapdeng ki Jiw .

translation.en: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace ;
translation.kha: bad da ka jinglong la kloi ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha ka jingsuk , kum ki juti jong phi .
U nongïalam jong ki shipai na ka Benjamin kur u dei u Eliada , u shipai batbit , uba long halor ki ar lakh ngut ki rangbah ba la kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki . ryntieh
translation.en: And of Benjamin  ; Eliada a mighty man of valour , and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand .
O earth , earth , earth , hear the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko ka ri , ko ka ri , ko ka ri ! to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ;

translation.en: They shall enter into my sanctuary , and they shall come near to my table , to minister unto me , and they shall keep my charge .
translation.kha: Dei tang ma ki , ki ban rung ha ka Templ jong nga , ban shakri ha ka duwan jong nga , bad ban pynïaid ïa ka jingmane ha ka Templ .

translation.en: And provide them beasts , that they may set Paul on , and bring him safe unto Felix the governor .
translation.kha: Pynbiang kulai na ka bynta u Paul ban shong bad pynpoi ha kaba suk ïa u sha u Pheliks u Lyngskor .

translation.en: The burden of the beasts of the south : into the land of trouble and anguish , from whence come the young and old lion , the viper and fiery flying serpent , they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses , and their treasures upon the bunches of camels , to a people that shall not profit them .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor jong U Blei shaphang ki mrad jong ka ri shyiap bashathie :  Ki nongkit  tiensyiem ki ïaid lyngba ka ri bashyrkhei , ha kaba ki sing ki don bad ha kaba ki bseiñ kiba don bih bad ki Ïakjakor kiba her . Ki pynkit halor ki kada bad ki ut jong ki da ki jingai sngewbha baremdor na ka bynta ka hima ka bym lah ban ai ïa ki kano kano ka jingïarap .
U la ha ki uwei pa uwei la ïaroh ïa u .
translation.en: And he taught in their synagogues , being glorified of all .
And Joab said unto the man that told him , And , behold , thou sawest him , and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground ? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver , and a girdle .
translation.kha: U Joab u jubab ,  Lada me la ïohi ïa u , balei men shym pynïap ïa u ha shen ? Nga da lade hi ngan jin da la ai ha me shiphew tylli ki sbai rupa bad uwei u panpoh .

translation.en: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest , and the other priests , and said unto them , Why repair ye not the breaches of the house ? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance , but deliver it for the breaches of the house .
translation.kha: Kumta u phah khot ïa u Jehoïada bad ïa kiwei pat ki lyngdoh bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Balei ba phim shym shna pynbha ïa ka Templ ? Naduh mynta phim dei shuh ban bat ïa ka pisa kaba phi ïohpdiang ; phi dei ban aiti noh , khnang ban ïoh shna pynbha .

translation.en: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only , or upon the uncircumcision also ? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness .
translation.kha: Hato kane ka jingsuk kaba U Dabid u la kren ka long tang ïa kito ïa kiba la otsher ? Ym kumta keiñ! Ka long ruh ïa kito ki bym shym la otsher . Naba ngi ong na ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ,  U Abraham u la ngeit ha U Blei , bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok .
Wat bamsap , naba kaba bamsap ka pynmatlah ïa ki briew ym ïohi shuh dei , bad ka pynduh ïa ka nia jong lui .
translation.en: And thou shalt take no gift : for the gift blindeth the wise , and perverteth the words of the righteous .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh shim un ïa kane ka khleiñ bad un thang ha ka duwan ka jingkñia ainguh thang , u kumba ju leh ïa ka khleiñ na u mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ka jingainguh ïasyllok .
translation.en: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings : and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering .

translation.kha: Un hap ban iehnoh ïa baroh kaba la dep ; un ym ïohlad ban lehkmen halor ka spah jong u ,
translation.en: That which he laboured for shall he restore , and shall not swallow it down : according to his substance shall the restitution be , and he shall not rejoice therein .

translation.kha: U Syiem u ong , Ïa kane la kynthup ha ka kaba kat kum ki jingbthah kiba U da hi u ai ha nga ban pyntrei .
translation.en: All this , said David , the  Lord  made me understand in writing by his hand upon me , even all the works of this pattern .
By me kings reign , and princes decree justice .
translation.kha: Nga ïarap ïa ki syiem ban synshar , bad ki nongsynshar ban thaw ki aiñ kiba bha .

translation.en: And do this thing , Take the kings away , every man out of his place , and put captains in their rooms :
translation.kha: Mynta , weng noh ïa ki laiphew ar ngut ki nongsynshar na ka kyrdan ai hukum bad bujli noh ïa ki da ki rangbah ai hukum na madan thma .

translation.en: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel  ; so that they shall not say , This is Jezebel .
translation.kha: Ïa kaba sah jong ka yn pynsaphriang hangta kum ka jakhlia , khnang ba yn ym don mano mano uba lah ithuh ïa ki .’

translation.en: For the  Lord  shall be thy confidence , and shall keep thy foot from being taken .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ri sumar ïa phi . Un ym shah ba phin hap ha ka jingriam .

translation.en: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you .
translation.kha: Ym shym la leh da U Blei , uba la khot ïa phi .

translation.en: The nations have heard of thy shame , and thy cry hath filled the land : for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty , and they are fallen both together .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingshah lehrain jong pha ; baroh ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam jong pha . Uwei u shipai u ban halor uwei pat , bad baroh ar ngut ki kyllon ha madan .
