And David built there an altar unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings . So the  Lord  was entreated for the land , and the plague was stayed from Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta u la thaw ka duwan ïa U  Trai  bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok . U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad ka jingïapthem ha Israel ka la sangeh .

translation.en: Thou son of man , shew the house to the house of Israel , that they may be ashamed of their iniquities : and let them measure the pattern .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u la ong shuh ,  Ko u khun u briew , to ïathuh ïa ki paid Israel shaphang ka Templ , bad ai ba kin ïitbniah ïa ka jingthmu jong ka . Pynlong ïa ki ban sngewlehrain ïa ki kam pop jong ki .

translation.en: And the sons of Simeon  ; Jemuel , and Jamin , and Ohad , and Jachin , and Zohar , and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman .
translation.kha: U Simeon bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Jemuel , u Jamin , u Ohad , u Jakhin , u Sohar , bad u Shaul , u khun ka kynthei nong Kanaan .
Ki la Deuteronomi matlah ïa u bad ki la kylli ïa ïarisa , Mano jingthoh tied ïa me ? To antad !
translation.en: And when they had blindfolded him , they struck him on the face , and asked him , saying , Prophesy , who is it that smote thee ?
And the people gave a shout , saying , It is the voice of a god , and not of a man .
translation.kha: Ym dei u briew uba kren , hynrei u blei !  ki la pyrta .

U Joshua u ong ha u paidbah baroh Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai , Blei ki Israel , u don ban ong : ‘ Mynhyndai , ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki shong ki sha shiliang jong Ïuphratis , ki la mane ïa pat ki blei . Uwei na kito ki kpa tymmen dei Terah , u kpa u Abraham bad u Nahor .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto all the people , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time , even Terah , the father of Abraham , and the father of Nahor : and they served other gods .

translation.kha: Ka kynthup Balei shongtynrai ka Gilead , lem ruh Melkhi ka Ashtaroth bad Edrei , ki nongbah jong ka hima u Og ha ne . Dieng kane baroh la ai hangta kaba shiteng jong tuklar longïing kiba hiarpateng marbl u Makhir u Ïakynduhlang jong u Manasseh .
translation.en: And half Gilead , and Ashtaroth , and Edrei , cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan , were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh , even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families .
And his inward affection is more abundant toward you , whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all , how with fear and trembling ye received him .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka jingieit jong u ïa phi ka nang khraw , kumba u kynmaw kumno phi baroh phi la kloi ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong u , kumno phi la pdiang sngewbha ïa u da ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingkyiuh .

translation.en: Whoso is simple , let him turn in hither : and as for him that wanteth understanding , she saith to him ,
translation.kha: Ale wan shane , phi ki briew kiba duna ka jingsngewthuh !  Ha u briew uba bieit ka ong ,

translation.en: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the  Lord  continually , being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant .
translation.kha: Man ka Sabbaton , u Aaron u dei ban buh ïa une u kpu ha khmat U  Trai  na ka bynta ki Israel kum ka jutang kaba neh junom .
Hadien ba nga la Meres ïa ka dulir thied jaka sai-sawar u Barukh , nga la ïakhreh Nasareth
translation.en: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah , I prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka met u ka kum u mawlynnai . Ka durkhmat jong ka thaba kum ka jingthaba leilieh , ki jong u ki meh kum ka ding . ki kjat u tyngshaiñ kum ka rnong ba la shut phyrnai , ka sur jong u ka sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh u .
translation.en: His body also was like the beryl , and his face as the appearance of lightning , and his eyes as lamps of fire , and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass , and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude .

Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king , for her bowels yearned upon her son , and she said , O my lord , give her the living child , and in no wise slay it . But the other said , Let it be neither mine nor thine , but divide it .
translation.kha: Ka kmie kaba shisha , da ka dohnud kaba shlei da ka jingieit ïa la u khun , ka ong ha u syiem ,  Sngewbha , ko Syiem Kynrad , wat pynïap ïa u khunlung ! Ai ïa u ha ka !  Hynrei kata kawei pat ka kynthei ka ong ,  Wat ai ïa u hano hano na ngi ; to leh bad phiah arliang ïa u .

translation.en: So two or three cities wandered unto one city , to drink water  ; but they were not satisfied : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingtlot namar ka jingsliang , ki briew jong kiba bun ki nongbah ki la leit sha ka nongbah kaba ki kyrmen ban ïoh um , hynrei kim ïoh ka umdih ka ban biang . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .

Wan bad nga na ki lumbah ka Lebanon , ka ko nongleitkurim jong nga ; wan bad nga na Lebanon . Wan hiar na kliar u lum Amana , u na Senir lum bad u lum Hermon , ha kaba ki sing bad ki labasa ki shong .
translation.en: I charge you , O daughters of Jerusalem , if ye find my beloved , that ye tell him , that I am sick of love .
And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter , or concerning the treasures .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingbthah kiba u Dabid u la ai ha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba ïadei bad ki ïing buh tiar bad kiwei kiwei ki kam la bud bniah .

translation.en: That they might observe his statutes , and keep his laws . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: khnang ba ki briew jong u kin kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u bad ban bat ïa ki hukum jong u baroh . Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
Hynrei mar ïa ïa ki briew shabar , U Jisu u la shapoh ka kamra ka bad la bat ïa ka kti jong ka , khie joit .
translation.en: But when the people were put forth , he went in , and took her by the hand , and the maid arose .
As is the earthy , such are they also that are earthy : and as is the heavenly , such are they also that are heavenly .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dei jong ka pyrthei ki long kum uta uba la thaw na ka dewmet ; kito kiba dei jong ka bneng ki long kum uta uba la wan na bneng .

translation.en: At the same time came to them Tatnai , governor on this side the river , and Shethar–bozenai , and their companions , and said thus unto them , Who hath commanded you to build this house , and to make up this wall ?
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , u Tattenai , u lat ka Ïuphratis Sepngi , u Shethar Bosenai bad ki para rangbah synshar , ki wan sha Jerusalem bad ki dawa bad ong :  Mano ba ai hukum ïa phi ban tei ïa kane ka Templ bad pynbiang ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka ?
Wat lada phi shoh ïa u bieit ba haduh u la jan ïap , pynban phin ym lah satia ban weng ïa jingbieit ka na u .
translation.en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle , yet will not his foolishness depart from him .

translation.kha: Nga tharai , u Simon u la jubab , un long uta uba la ïohmap kham bun . Me ong kaba dei , U Haggan u la ong .
translation.en: Simon answered and said , I suppose that he , to whom he forgave most . And he said unto him ,  Thou hast rightly judged .
And they were instant with loud voices , requiring that he might be crucified . And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ïai pyrta da ka sur kaba jam eh ba ïa U Jisu dei ban sahnarphna , bad khatduh ka jingpyrta jong ki ka la jop .

translation.en: And Joshua said unto all the people , Behold , this stone shall be a witness unto us  ; for it hath heard all the words of the  Lord  which he spake unto us : it shall be therefore a witness unto you , lest ye deny your God .
translation.kha: U ong ha u paidbah baroh ,  Une u maw un long u sakhi ïa ngi . U la ïohsngew ïa ki ktien baroh ba U  Trai  u la kren ha ngi . Kumta un long u sakhi pyrshah ïa phi , ban da ïa phi na kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Then said Joshua , Open the mouth of the cave , and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u ong ,  Plie ïa ka jaka rung sha ka krem bad wallam ïa kito ki san ngut ki syiem sha nga .

translation.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David his father : and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Rehoboam u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
hynrei u Jakob shym phah ïa u Benjamin , u trai jong u Joseph ba un leit lem bad ki , namar u sheptieng ïoh jia ei ei ïa .
translation.en: But Benjamin , Joseph s brother , Jacob sent not with his brethren  ; for he said , Lest peradventure mischief befall him .
And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh , Thus saith the  Lord  , Israel is my son , even my firstborn :
translation.kha: Te me dei ban ong ha u ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong , ‘ U Israel u long u khun nyngkong jong nga .

translation.en: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing , and thy lips with rejoicing .
translation.kha: Un shah ïa phi ban rkhie bad ban kyang jam pat ,
Ïa u jingthung jingpangnud ïa uba U Kpa pynliem nga uba ha bneng um shym la thain , yn rat noh , la jingkhanglad U Jisu khynwin
translation.en: But he answered and said ,  Every plant , which my heavenly Father hath not planted , shall be rooted up .

translation.kha: Ka longïing jong u Meshelemaïah ka pynmih khatphra ki ngut rangbah kiba tbit .
translation.en: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren , strong men , eighteen .
And one ran and filled a sponge full of vinegar , and put it on a reed , and gave him to drink , saying , Let alone  ; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la mareh bad u spoiñ ba la wieh ha ka waiñ bym bha , bad ba la teh ïa u ha tduh jong u dieng . Nangta u la rah shalor ha ki rmiang shyntur U Jisu bad u la ong ,  To ap , ngin ïakhmih la u Elijah un wan ban pynhiar ïa u na ka diengphna !

translation.en: Pilate answered , Am I a Jew ? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me : what hast thou done ?
translation.kha: U Pilat u la phai ktien ,  Me tharai nga dei u Jiw ? Dei ki briew jong me hi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh kiba la aiti ïa me sha nga . Kaei kaba me la leh ?

translation.en: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets , Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone ;
translation.kha: Ïa phi ruh , la tei ha ka nongrim ba la buh da ki apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa , u mawdong uba long U Khrist Jisu hi .

translation.en: Him therefore I hope to send presently , so soon as I shall see how it will go with me .
translation.kha: Kumta nga kyrmen ban phah shen ïa u sha phi tang mar shu tip kumno kiei kiei kin long na ka bynta jong nga .
ieh hangta ïa ki briew kiba sngewrit bad kiba duk , ki wan sha nga ka bynta ka .
translation.en: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people , and they shall trust in the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nga la ïeng hapdeng jong phi bad U Trai ha kata ïathuh ha aïu namar ba phi kata ka ding bad phim shym leit sha uta u lum . U Trai la ong ,
translation.en: ( I stood between the  Lord  and you at that time , to shew you the word of the  Lord  : for ye were afraid by reason of the fire , and went not up into the mount  ; ) saying ,
And the  Lord  said unto the children of Israel , Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians , and from the Amorites , from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha ki ïa kane ka jubab ,  Ki Ijipt , ki Amor , ki Ammon , ki Philistia
Bad ka bor U Trai ka la sdang ban pynkhlaiñ ïa u katba u dang don hapdeng Sorah bad Eshtaol Ladan Dothan jaka jingpyllaitluid dara jong ki pynkhlaiñ .
translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol .

translation.kha: Kata kali ka ka wan sha ka lyngkha jong briew u uba kyrteng u Joshua , uba shong ha Beth Shemesh , bad ka sangeh hajan u mawbah . Kita ki briew ki pom lyngkhot ïa kata ka kali dieng , pynïap ki ïa kita ki masi kynthei bad ki kñia ïa ki kum ka jingainguh thang ha U . Trai
translation.en: And the cart came into the field of Joshua , a Beth–shemite , and stood there , where there was a great stone : and they clave the wood of the cart , and offered the kine a burnt offering unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Meshek nongsynshar jong ki Jiw Ruphos Jerusalem ki la phah katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi rangkynsai u Ïoannis , ban tyngkong ïa u , Me dei uei ?
translation.en: And this is the record of John , when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him , Who art thou ?
And Joshua blessed him , and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la kyrkhu ïa u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh bad u la ai ha u ïa ka nongbah Hebron kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .

shai Trai , lada nga ïasaid ïa ka kam jong nga bad me , Jonadab kynshoit jah me long ha phi dei . Pynban nga dei ban jingsngewpihuiñ ïa me shaphang ki bynta Addar jingbishar hok . Balei ba ki rangbah basniew ki kynthup katta sai-sawar ? Mephibosheth ba ki rangbah bymhok ki jop ?
translation.en: Righteous art thou , O  Lord  , when I plead with thee : yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments : Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper ? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously ?
Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul ?
translation.kha: Ym don kano kano kaba u lah ban ïa-peiñ na ka bynta la ka jingim .
U Trai hi un ïalam ïa me un bad don ryngkat bad me . Un ieh ym ïa me lane kyntait ïa me ; kumta wat syier bad wat sheptieng .
translation.en: And the  Lord  , he it is that doth go before thee  ; he will be with thee , he will not fail thee , neither forsake thee : fear not , neither be dismayed .
The same was in the beginning with God .
translation.kha: Naduh kaba sdang u Ktien u la don bad U Blei .
U Trai Dinah jingkhyllem ïa u Lum Seïon , hynrei ki briew jong dulan Moab kin shah ïuhroit sieh kumba ïa u phlangïap la ïuh haba shna sboh markhap
translation.en: For in this mountain shall the hand of the  Lord  rest , and Moab shall be trodden down under him , even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill .
This shall be the punishment of Egypt , and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles .
translation.kha: Kane kan long ka jingpynshitom ka ban hap halor ka Ijipt bad ha baroh kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew lada kim rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years , until they came to a land inhabited  ; they did eat manna , until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la bam ïa ka manna sawphew snem lynter , haduh ba kin da poi ha ka ri Kanaan , ha kaba ki la shongduh .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Because of your unbelief : for verily I say unto you , If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed , ye shall say unto this mountain , Remove hence to yonder place  ; and it shall remove  ; and nothing shall be impossible unto you .
translation.kha: Ka la long namar phim don ka jingngeit kaba biang ,  la jubab U Jisu .  Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lada phi don ka jingngeit kaba heh kat u symbai tyrso , phi lah ban ong ïa une u lumrit , ‘ Khie leit noh nangne shatai !’ bad un leit . Phi lah ban leh ïa kano kano !
Nga la ïathuh ha phi kane dang don bad phi .
translation.en: These things have I spoken unto you , being yet present with you .

And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire : and them that had gotten the victory over the beast , and over his image , and over his mark , and over the number of his name , stand on the sea of glass , having the harps of God .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaba i kum ka ïit bakhraw kaba la khleh lang bad ka ding . Nga la ïohi ruh ïa kito kiba la jop ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka dur jong u bad ïa uta uba ka kyrteng jong u la mihkhmat da u dak jingkheiñ . Ki la ïeng hajan ka ïit bakhraw , ki da bat ïa ki duitara kiba U Blei u la ai ha ki
nangta khatsaw snemhadien nga la leit pat sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad Barnabas , nga da ïalam lang ruh u .
translation.en: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas , and took Titus with me also .
And Enos lived ninety years , and begat Cainan :
translation.kha: Haba u Enosh u la dap khyndaiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Kenan ,
Ym don jingartatien ba uta uba kyrkhu u ban ïa uba shah kyrkhu .
translation.en: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better .
Thirty milch camels with their colts , forty kine , and ten bulls , twenty she asses , and ten foals .
translation.kha: laiphew tylli ki ut ai dud lem bad ki khun jong ki , sawphew tylli ki masi kynthei bad shiphew tylli ki masi kyrtong , arphew tylli ki kada kynthei bad shiphew tylli ki kada shynrang .

translation.en: Or if a soul swear , pronouncing with his lips to do evil , or to do good , whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath , and it be hid from him  ; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty in one of these .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u smai khlem da pyrkhat , kam pher la ka long ïa kano kano , u long uba la rem mar ïasngewthuh ïa kaei ba u la leh .
Kane ka long jingkñia ka namar ka jingleh palat ïa ka pop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: It is a trespass offering : he hath certainly trespassed against the  Lord .
Because that thou mayest understand , that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship .
translation.kha: Kumba me lah ban shem hi da lade , ym pat palat khat-ar sngi ba nga la leit sha Jerusalem ban mane .
U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad synran ki jong u ki la ïaleit bad u .
translation.en: And when he was entered into a ship , his disciples followed him .

Also day by day , from the first day unto the last day , he read in the book of the law of God . And they kept the feast seven days  ; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly , according unto the manner .
translation.kha: Naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam haduh ka sngi kaba khatduh , ki pule ïa ki bynta jong ka Hukum U Blei man ka sngi . Ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la long na ka bynta hynñiew sngi , bad ha ka sngi kaba phra , ka la don ka jingpynkut ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam kumba la ong ha ka Hukum .

translation.en: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord , and that he had spoken these things unto her .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Mari ka nong Magdala ka la leit bad ïathuh ïa ki synran ba ka la ïohi ïa U Trai bad pynshai ha ki ïa kaei kaba u la ïathuh ïa ka .

Ki , Ussaïah ! Phim don hok ban thang jingiwbih U Trai Dei tang lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng Aaron ïa kiba la pynkyntang ban leh ïa kane . Khie mihnoh ka kyntang Phi la pynsngewsih ïa U Trai , phin ïoh shuh jingkyrkhu jong u .
translation.en: And they withstood Uzziah the king , and said unto him , It appertaineth not unto thee , Uzziah , to burn incense unto the  Lord  , but to the priests the sons of Aaron , that are consecrated to burn incense : go out of the sanctuary  ; for thou hast trespassed  ; neither shall it be for thine honour from the  Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ki la noh mynsiem namar ka jingsuki jong jingïaid ka ka kam . Hynrei kin ba ïohi u Serubbabel u dang ïai tei ïa ka Templ , bad kin long kiba kmen . U angel u la ong ha nga , Ki hynñiew ki tylli sharak ki long hynñiew ki tylli ki khmat jong U Trai kiba khmih halor ka pyrthei baroh .
translation.en: For who hath despised the day of small things ? for they shall rejoice , and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven  ; they are the eyes of the  Lord  , which run to and fro through the whole earth .
And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt , such as there was none like it , nor shall be like it any more .
translation.kha: Kan don ka jinglynñiar kaba jam ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt , ka bym pat ju don mynno mynno kaba kum kata lane ka ban ym don shuh lano lano .
Te U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki , Wat ïathuh hano hano ruh shaphang jong nga .
translation.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him .

translation.kha: Sa katno ba ka ri jong ngi kan tyrkhong , bad ba u phlang ha kawei pa kawei ka pyntha jingkyrkieh ïapstai ? Ki mrad bad ki sim ki ïap namar ka jingbymman jong ki briew jong ngi Sanballat Onesimos briew Adaïah ong , Synreit U tyrsim um ïohi ïa jingïaphet Oi’ ngi leh .’
translation.en: How long shall the land mourn , and the herbs of every field wither , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein ? the beasts are consumed , and the birds  ; because they said , He shall not see our last end .
So Saul died , and his three sons , and all his house died together .
translation.kha: Da kumta u Saul bad lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u baroh ki la ïap lang bad ym don uba na ki khun ki ksiew jong u kiba ïoh ban synshar .
Nangta ki synran ki la shemphang ba shym um la maham ïa ki ban sumar ïa na lade u thiat uba pyndonkam ha u kpu , hynrei na ka jinghikai ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi .
translation.en: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread , but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .

When they were past the first and the second ward , they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city  ; which opened to them of his own accord : and they went out , and passed on through one street  ; and forthwith the angel departed from him .
translation.kha: Ki la ïaid najan ka jaka ap phira kaba nyngkong bad nangta ïa kaba ar , bad ki la poi khatduh ha ka khyrdop nar kaba lam sha ka nongbah . Ka khyrdop ka la plie hi na ka bynta jong ki , bad ki la mih shabar . Ki la ïaid ha ka lynti bah , bad kynsan u angel u la iehnoh ïa u Petros .

translation.en: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day . The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand  ; because he had forsaken the  Lord  God of his fathers .
translation.kha: Ka Edom ka la laitluid na ka Judah naduh kata ka por . Ha kane kajuh ka por , ka nongbah Libnah ruh ka la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , namar u Jehoram u la iehnoh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong u .

translation.en: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook , and as the stream of brooks they pass away  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei phi , ko paralok jong nga , phi shukor ïa nga kum ki wahduid kiba ju rngad noh ha bym don slap .

translation.en: Ye fools , did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also ?
translation.kha: A ki bieit ! Hato ym dei U Blei uba la thaw ïa kaba shabar , uba la thaw ruh ïa kaba shapoh ?

translation.en: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness , in the plain over against the Red sea , between Paran , and Tophel , and Laban , and Hazeroth , and Dizahab .
translation.kha: Ki ktien ha kane ka kitab ki long kito kiba u Moses u la kren ha ki Israel mynba ki don ha ka ri khlaw sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan . Ki ïadon ha ka Them Jordan hajan Suph , hapdeng ka shnong Paran ha kawei ka liang bad ki shnong Tophel , Laban , Haseroth , bad Disahab ha kawei pat ka liang .

translation.kha: Haba ki shaniah ha phi , phi kheiñ noh , u dung ïa ki tohtit jong ki , bad pynlong ïa ki ban pynkdor ïa la ki met .
Ko ki paid mohkhiew , to phet noh na Babilonia ! Iehnoh ïa ka ri ! Long Eglath nyngkong ban iehnoh ïa ka !
translation.en: Remove out of the midst of Babylon , and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans , and be as the he goats before the flocks .
But when his disciples saw it , they had indignation , saying , To what purpose is this waste ?
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ïohi ïa kane bad ki la bitar .  Balei ba shu pynsep-ei ïa kane baroh ?  ki la kylli .

ka Lada long kumta , nga kyrpad ïa me ba ïathuh men ha nga ïa ki jingthmu jong me , khnang ba nga lah ban ïai shakri bad pynsngewbha ïa me . To da kynmaw ruh ba me la jied ïa kane ka jaitbynriew ba long kan u paidlang jong me .
translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , if I have found grace in thy sight , shew me now thy way , that I may know thee , that I may find grace in thy sight : and consider that this nation is thy people .
Command the children of Israel , that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light , to cause the lamps to burn continually .
translation.kha: Hukum ïa ki Israel ban wanrah ïa ka umphniang Olib kaba khuid bha na ka bynta kita ki sharak , ba kin ai jingshai man la ka por .
Kaei kaba pha kwah ? U Jisu u la kylli ïa ka . Ka jubab la , To kular ïa nga ba kine ki khun shynrang jong nga kin shong ha ka liang kamon bad liang ka kadiang jong haba me men long u Syiem .
translation.en: And he said unto her ,  What wilt thou ?  She saith unto him , Grant that these my two sons may sit , the one on thy right hand , and the other on the left , in thy kingdom .

But now I have written unto you not to keep company , if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator , or covetous , or an idolater , or a railer , or a drunkard , or an extortioner ; with such an one no not to eat .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba phin ym ïakhleh bad u briew uba khot ïa lade u parabangeit hynrei uba awria ne uba lalot ne uba mane bleithaw ne uba kren sniew ne uba buaid ne u nongtuh . To wat ïashong bam lem bad kum uta u briew .

translation.en: For that ye ought to say , If the Lord will , we shall live , and do this , or that .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi dei ban ong ka long kane :  Lada U Trai u mon , ngin im bad ngin leh ïa kane lane ïa katai .

translation.en: For it is a fact : This “world is passing away and so is its desire , but he that does the will of God remains forever ,” to enjoy eternally the blessings to be showered down by our loving Creator .—1 John 2 :17 .
translation.kha: Namar ka long ka bashisha “Kane ka pyrthei ka ïaid jah noh bad kata ka jingkwah brai jong ka , hynrei uta uba leh ïa ka mon u Blei u ïaisah bymjukut ,” ban lehkmen junom ïa ki jingkyrkhu ban thehsei da u Trai Nongbuh Nongthaw . —Ïoannis 2 :17 .

translation.en: But I beseech you , that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence , wherewith I think to be bold against some , which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh .
translation.kha: Da ka jingjemnud bad jingbha U Khrist , nga kyrpad ïa phi ban nym pynbor ïa nga ban long uba eh haba nga wan ; naba nga thikna ba nga lah ban leh da kaba eh ïa kito kiba ong ba ngi leh ïa kiei kiei na ki jingthmu ba kynja pyrthei .

translation.en: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah , the son of Dodo , a man of Issachar  ; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Abimelekh , u Tola u khun jong u Puah bad u ksiew jong u Dodo , u la wan ban pyllait ïa ki Israel . U dei na ka jait Issakhar bad u shong ha Shamir ha ka ri lum Ephraim .

translation.en: Either make the tree good , and his fruit good  ; or else make the tree corrupt , and his fruit corrupt : for the tree is known by his fruit .
translation.kha: Ban ïoh ïa u soh uba bha phi dei ban don u dieng uba plung bha ; lada phi don u dieng uba swai , phin ïoh u soh uba sniew . Ïa u dieng la tip da u jait soh ba u pynmih .
Ngi la pynsleh ïa u Absalom kum u syiem jong , hynrei la pynïap ha ka thma . Kumta , balei ym don mano ba pyrshang ban wallam biang ïa u syiem Dabid ?
translation.en: And Absalom , whom we anointed over us , is dead in battle . Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back ?
The king of Libnah , one  ; the king of Adullam , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Libnah , ka Adullam ,
Te mynta , phin lada kohnguh ïa nga bad sumar ka ïa jutang jong nga , phin long ki briew jong nga . Ka pyrthei baroh ka kawei long ka jong nga , bad phi pat phin long ki briew kiba nga la jied ,
translation.en: Now therefore , if ye will obey my voice indeed , and keep my covenant , then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people : for all the earth is mine :
Yea , behold , being planted , shall it prosper ? shall it not utterly wither , when the east wind toucheth it ? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew .
translation.kha: Ho-oid la thung ïa ka , hynrei hato kan im bad san ? Hato kan ym ïapstai haba ka lyer mihngi ka shoh ïa ka ? Hato kan ym ïapstai hangta ha kaba ka san ?
mynta , Kumta ko ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , shaniah ha U Blei jong phi bad wan phai pat sha u . Long kiba ïaineh bad kiba lehhok , bad ap da kaba ïaishah ïa U jong Blei phi ban leh .
translation.en: Therefore turn thou to thy God : keep mercy and judgment , and wait on thy God continually .

translation.kha: Haba paidbah la ïohsngew ïa ka jingtied u pyrthat ïa jingsawa ka turoi , bad ïohi ïa ka leilieh bad ïa u lum uba mih tdem kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng la ïeng noh sha .
translation.en: And all the people saw the thunderings , and the lightnings , and the noise of the trumpet , and the mountain smoking : and when the people saw it , they removed , and stood afar off .

And it shall be unto you for a fringe , that ye may look upon it , and remember all the commandments of the  Lord  , and do them  ; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes , after which ye use to go a whoring :
translation.kha: Ki ksai jyrthiaw kin long kum ki jingpynkynmaw , bad man ka por ba phi ïohi ïa ki , phin kynmaw ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh bad kohnguh ïa ki ; te kumta phin ym phai noh na nga bad bud ïa ki jingkwah mon bad ki jingkwah brai jong phi .
Kito kiba jingjop ïohi ïa jingong Kenan la ïathuh ha ki briew kaei kaba la lah jia tynrah uta ïor i-ieit uba Hukkok ksuid pynlah bad ïa Patsha ki sniang .
translation.en: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil , and also concerning the swine .
Thou shalt be blessed above all people : there shall not be male or female barren among you , or among your cattle .
translation.kha: Yn ym don ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ka ban ïoh kat kine ki jingkyrkhu . Yn ym don mano mano u ban lyngki napdeng jong phi , lane napdeng ki jingri jong phi .
U la Libya ban Gurbaal Mehujael lem bad ka Mari , kaba lui Khebar bad u khrup
translation.en: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife , being great with child .
Even the  Lord  God of hosts  ; the  Lord  is his memorial .
translation.kha: Une u dei U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh — U  Trai  long ka kyrteng ha uba dei ban mane .

translation.en: And , lo , I perceived that God had not sent him  ; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me : for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him .
translation.kha: Haba nga la pyrkhat bha ïa ka , nga sngewthuh ba U Blei um pat shym la kren ha u Shemaïah , hynrei ba u Tobiah bad u Sanballat ki la pynbam pisa ïa u ban ai ïa nga ïa kane ka jingmaham .
Naba lada ïa kiba kynrad yn Lymne pynmihpat , te ïa U Khrist ruh ym shym Aben pynmihpat .
translation.en: For if the dead rise not , then is not Christ raised :
And while he yet spake , behold , Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came : and Adonijah said unto him , Come in  ; for thou art a valiant man , and bringest good tidings .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un pynkut ïa ka jingkren , u Jonathan , u khun jong u Abiathar u lyngdoh , u la wan poi .  Ale rung ,  u Adonijah u ong .  Me long u briew uba bha — me dei ban wanrah ka khubor kaba bha .

translation.en: Then said Paul , I stand at Caesar s judgment seat , where I ought to be judged : to the Jews have I done no wrong , as thou very well knowest .
translation.kha: U Paul u la ong ,  Nga ïeng ha khmat ka kamra bishar ka jong u Patsha hi , ha kaba ka dei ban bishar ïa nga . Ngam shym leh kano kano kaba bakla ïa ki Jiw , kumba me hi me tip bha .

translation.en: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar : and he was driven from men , and did eat grass as oxen , and his body was wet with the dew of heaven , till his hairs were grown like eagles  feathers , and his nails like birds  claws .
translation.kha: Ki kyntien ki wan urlong shisha mar kumta hi . Ïa u Nebukhadnessar la beh noh na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew bad u la bam phlang kum u masi dab . Ka umjer ka la hap halor ka met jong u , bad u shñiuh jong u , u la san jrong kum ki sner jong ki pukni bad ki tyrsim jong u ki jrong kum ki tnaw jong ki sim .

translation.en: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away : and David rescued his two wives .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la pyllait im ïa baroh bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki Amalek ki la knieh kynthup ïa ki tnga jong u ar ngut .

translation.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , the top thereof , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns thereof  ; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about .
translation.kha: Suit ïa kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ki krung jong ka baroh sawdong , bad ïa ki reng jong ka , da ka ksiar nylla , bad shna ruh ïa ka jingpynpur ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest , who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the  Lord  : at his word shall they go out , and at his word they shall come in , both he , and all the children of Israel with him , even all the congregation .
translation.kha: Un hap shaniah ha u Eleasar u lyngdoh , ban wad ïa ka mon jong nga da kaba pyndonkam ïa u Urim bad u Thummim   . Da kumne u Eleasar un kdew ïa u Joshua bad u paid Israel ha ki kam jong ki baroh .

U Joshua u jubab , Lada phi ïabun paid haduh katta katta bad ba ka ri khunbynriew Ephraim ka rit than ïa phi , te khie leit sha ki khlaw bad prat jingñiewbeiñ ka bynta ïa lade ha jingmutlop ri Arah Peris bad ki Rephaim .
translation.en: And Joshua answered them , If thou be a great people , then get thee up to the wood country , and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants , if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee .

translation.kha: Nga leh ïa her khnang ba phin tip ïa 16 jingshisha pyndkut shaphang kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba ïanujor hikai ïa Meron .
translation.en: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things , wherein thou hast been instructed .
But I have prayed for thee , that thy faith fail not : and when thou art converted , strengthen thy brethren .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la duwai na ka bynta jong me , ko Simon , ba ka jingngeit jong me kan ym duh noh . Bad haba me la wan phai pat sha nga , me dei ban pynkhlaiñ ïa ki hynmen ki para jong me .
Nangta u ia , Syiem Kynrad , Hato phi la dep pynbna ba u Adonijah Jorim long syiem hadien jong phi ?
translation.en: And Nathan said , My lord , O king , hast thou said , Adonijah shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne ?
And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out , and cast it from thee : it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye , rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire .
translation.kha: Bad lada ka khmat jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , to khlong bad to bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban rung sha ka jingim tang da kawei ka khmat ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki khmat bad ban shah bret shapoh ka dujok ding .

translation.en: And the  Lord  smote the king , so that he was a leper unto the day of his death , and dwelt in a several house . And Jotham the king s son was over the house , judging the people of the land .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u shoh ïa u Ussaïah da ka jingpang sniehdoh kaba shyrkhei kaba la sah bad u shi lynter ka jingim jong u . U sah hi marwei ha la ka jong ka ïing , la pyllait ïa u na ki kamram baroh , katba u Jotham u khun jong u , u pynïaid ïa ka hima .

translation.en: Yea , ye overwhelm the fatherless , and ye dig a pit for your friend .
translation.kha: Phi te phi nud ban kynting sbai ïa ki khunswet mraw bad pynlong riewspah ïa lade na ki paralok bajan tam eh .

translation.en: The eternal God is thy refuge , and underneath are the everlasting arms : and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee  ; and shall say , Destroy them .
translation.kha: U Blei u ïailong ka jingïada jong phi ; Ki ksang ti uba na bymjukut ki kyrshan ïa phi . U beh ïa ki nongshun jong phi katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , Bad u ong ïa phi ban pynjot thiaw ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: But the centurion , willing to save Paul , kept them from their purpose  ; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea , and get to land :
translation.kha: Hynrei u rangbah shipai u la kwah ban pyllait im ïa u Paul , kumta u la khang ïa ki na kaba leh ïa kane . Pynban , u la hukum ïa kito kiba lah ban jngi ban ryngkoh nyngkong bad ban jngi sha ryngkew ;

translation.en: And he dreamed yet another dream , and told it his brethren , and said , Behold , I have dreamed a dream more  ; and , behold , the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew , bad u la ïathuh ha la ki hynmen shynrang .  Nga la phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew , ha kaba nga la ïohi ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur khatwei tylli ba ki ïanguh ïa nga .
Phin leit thied aiu ?
translation.en: What are you buying ?
And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord  : and the  Lord  strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel , because they had done evil in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la leh pop biang pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Namar kane keiñ U  Trai  u la pynkhlaiñbor ïa u Eglon u syiem ka Moab ban ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast clapped thine hands , and stamped with the feet , and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong : phi la thab ïa ki kti bad kynthih da ka jingkmen . Phi ñiewbeiñ ïa ka ri ki Israel .

Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa u la sngewlyngngoh bad ki la kylli , Hato une um dei uto uba ha Jerusalem u pynïap ïa kito kiba mane ïa U Jisu ? Bad hato um shym wan hangne na ka bynta kajuh ka ban kem ïa kito ki briew ban ïalam pat ïa ki sha ki lyngdoh ?
translation.en: But all that heard him were amazed , and said  ; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem , and came hither for that intent , that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests ?

translation.kha: Ki thaw sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka ban rnong pyndait lang ïa kita ki ar ki tylli sut ba kin long kawei ka jingtap .
translation.en: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together , that it might be one .

translation.kha: Ka bynta ba ki pule kynthup ïa jingbuh jingthoh shaphang kumno u u la lap ka jingsylla ban pynïap syiem — ka jingsylla da Bigthana bad u Teresh , ki ar ngut ki ïunukh ka ïingsyiem kiba ap phira ïa ki kamra syiem .
translation.en: And it was found written , that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh , two of the king s chamberlains , the keepers of the door , who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .

translation.kha: Hangta ngi la shem ïa ka lieng ban leit sha Phoenisia , kumta ngi la ïakiew ha ka bad la noh .
translation.en: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phoenicia , we went aboard , and set forth .

translation.kha: Kumta te , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Baroh , U Blei ki , ngan leh Ngan ai ki jhur kthang ha ki briew nga bam bad ka bih ban dih .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will feed them , even this people , with wormwood , and give them water of gall to drink .

translation.kha: Nga ngeit ba phin ïoh tip ba ngim long kiba la shahjop .
translation.en: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates .

translation.kha: To shad , to shad , ko theisamla ka Shullam Shah ïa ngi ban ïa phi katba dang shad . Balei phi kwah ban khmih ïa nga katba nga dang shad hapdeng ki nongkhmih kai ?
translation.en: The mandrakes give a smell , and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits , new and old , which I have laid up for thee , O my beloved .
Turn ye not unto idols , nor make to yourselves molten gods : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Wat lyndet ïa nga bad mane ïa ki bleithaw ; wat thaw ïa ki blei ba shu saiñ na ka sisa bad ban mane ïa ki . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Go and tell Hananiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood  ; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron .
translation.kha: ban leit bad ong ha u Hananaïah :  U  Trai  u la ong ba me lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor dieng , hynrei un bujli ïa ka da ka lyngkor nar .

translation.en: David said furthermore , As the  Lord  liveth , the  Lord  shall smite him  ; or his day shall come to die  ; or he shall descend into battle , and perish .
translation.kha: Da U  Trai  uba im ,  u Dabid u bteng biang ,  nga tip ba U  Trai  hi un shoh ïap ïa u , lane un ïap hi ynda poi ka por ba un ïap , lane haba un ïap ha ka thma .
Ka Jingthoh —Nong ka ong , sngewdiaw ka daw jong phi ki Jiw , babniah Jentil ki kren sniew Seïon U Blei .
translation.en: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you , as it is written .
It'd be about time to reply to his letter .
translation.kha: Lah jan dei por ban jubab iaka shithi jong u .

translation.en: And the officers shall speak further unto the people , and they shall say , What man is there that is fearful and fainthearted ? let him go and return unto his house , lest his brethren s heart faint as well as his heart .
translation.kha: Kita ki rangbah synshar kin ong ruh ha uta u paidïapom , ‘ Don mo hangne uba sheptieng bad uba rit mynsiem ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u pynsyier mynsiem ïa kiwei pat .’

translation.en: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own ? Is thine eye evil , because I am good ?
translation.kha: Hato ngam don ka hok ban leh katba nga sngewbit ïa la ka jong ka pisa ? Ne phi ïa-bishni namar ba nga long uba sbun ?’
To pyrkhat ïa ki paid Israel kito ; kiba bam ïa kaei kaba la kñia ki ïoh bynta ka ha jingshakri ha ka duwan sha U Blei .
translation.en: Behold Israel after the flesh : are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar ?

He that regardeth the day , regardeth it unto the Lord ; and he that regardeth not the day , to the Lord he doth not regard it . He that eateth , eateth to the Lord , for he giveth God thanks ; and he that eateth not , to the Lord he eateth not , and giveth God thanks .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba kheiñ kor bha ïa kano kano ka sngi , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai , uno uno u ban bam ïa kaei kaei , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai , namar u ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kata ka jingbam . Uno uno uba kyntait ban bam ïa kino kino ki jingbam , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai bad u ainguh sha U Blei .
sawphew bad tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa hapoh jong ki , ar ar tylli ki thliew tnaw hapoh kawei ka jingker ban bat ïa kita tnaw ki jong ka ar tylli .
translation.en: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards  ; two sockets under one board for his two tenons , and two sockets under another board for his two tenons .

translation.kha: Ko paid Israel , ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi ki long ki bymmyntoi kum ki myrsiang kiba shong hapdeng ki ka nongbah .
translation.en: O Israel , thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts .

translation.kha: Namar da ka jingaiei U Blei ba ïa phi la pynim ka jingngeit . Kam dei na ka jingmih na ki kam jong phi hi hynrei ka long ka jingai U Blei , khnang ba uno un ym lah ban kren sarong shaphang .
translation.en: Not of works , lest any man should boast .
He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins .
translation.kha: U siat ïa la ki khnam jylliew shapoh ka met jong nga .

translation.en: Ye shall not steal , neither deal falsely , neither lie one to another .
translation.kha: Wat tuh lane shukor lane lamler .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter : for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land .
translation.kha: kin ai shibun ka dud kaba un dih kat kaba u donkam baroh . Ho-oid , khyndiat ngut kiba lait im kiba la iehnoh ha ka ri kin don ka dud bad ka ngap ban bam .

translation.en: Thou knowest the commandments , Do not commit adultery , Do not kill , Do not steal , Do not bear false witness , Defraud not , Honour thy father and mother .
translation.kha: Me tip ïa ki hukum : ‘ Wat pynïap ; wat klim ; wat tuh ; wat kynnoh bym dei ïano ïano ; wat thok ; burom ïa u kpa jong me bad ïa ka kmie jong me .’

translation.en: And their eyes were opened , and they knew him  ; and he vanished out of their sight .
translation.kha: Te ïa ki khmat jong ki la plie bad ki la ithuh ïa u , hynrei u la jah noh na khmat jong ki .

translation.en: And these are they which are sown among thorns  ; such as hear the word ,
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai ba la bet hapdeng ki bniap shiah . Kine ki long kita kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ,
Kiwei pat ki Lebi ki peit halor ka jingpynkit bad jingkit halor ki nongtrei ha ki kam bapher bapher , bad kiwei ki buh jingkheiñ ki lane shakri kum ki nongap phira .
translation.en: Also they were over the bearers of burdens , and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service : and of the Levites there were scribes , and officers , and porters .

translation.kha: khiew , baroh ki jingri jong ki , ki pun bad Hynrei kha khlem don ka jingeh .
translation.en: Their bull gendereth , and faileth not  ; their cow calveth , and casteth not her calf .
And Moses returned unto the  Lord  , and said , Lord , wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people ? why is it that thou hast sent me ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u la phai biang sha U  Trai  bad u la ong ,  A  Trai  , balei me lehbeiñ sat ïa la ki briew ? Balei me phah ïa nga shane ?

Haba ka kata por ka wan , hynñiew ngut ki kynthei kin bat ïa uwei u briew bad ong , Ngi lah ban bad bsa pynkup jaiñ ïa lade , sngewbha hynrei shah ngi ïa ban ong ba phi long u tnga jong ngi , ba kumta ngim donkam ban shah ïa ka jinglehrain jong ka jinglong bym pat shongkurim .
translation.en: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man , saying , We will eat our own bread , and wear our own apparel : only let us be called by thy name , to take away our reproach .

translation.en: Then Achish called David , and said unto him , Surely , as the  Lord  liveth , thou hast been upright , and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight : for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day : nevertheless the lords favour thee not .
Finally , my brethren , be strong in the Lord , and in the power of his might .
translation.kha: Ha kaba pynkut noh , to long kiba khlaiñ ha U Trai bad ha ka bor ka jingkhlaiñ jong u .

U u shoh ïa u Ussaïah da ka jingpang kaba shyrkhei kaba la sah bad u shi lynter ka jingim jong sah marwei ha la ka ka ïing , la pyllait ïa u na ki kamram baroh , katba u Jotham u khun jong u , u pynïaid ïa ka hima .
translation.en: And the  Lord  smote the king , so that he was a leper unto the day of his death , and dwelt in a several house . And Jotham the king s son was over the house , judging the people of the land .
And thou shalt take no gift : for the gift blindeth the wise , and perverteth the words of the righteous .
translation.kha: Wat bamsap , naba kaba bamsap ka pynmatlah ïa ki briew ban ym ïohi shuh ïa kata kaba dei , bad ka pynduh ïa ka nia jong kiba lui lui .

translation.en: For her blood is in the midst of her  ; she set it upon the top of a rock  ; she poured it not upon the ground , to cover it with dust  ;
translation.kha: Ka la don ka jingpynïap briew ha ka nongbah , hynrei ka snam kam shym pashait ha ka khyndew ha kaba ka khyndew kam lah ban buhrieh ïa ka ; ka la pashait ha u mawsiang basyllen .

Phim pat siew bainong ei ei ïa ki briew kiba trei ha ki lyngkha jong phi . ñianglartham shahshkor ïa ki jingmudui jong pyut ! Ki jingkyang jong kito kiba la lum ïa ki jingot ki pynbynta poi sha ki shkor jong U Blei , U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Behold , the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields , which is of you kept back by fraud , crieth : and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki bneng bajrong tam , ki bad um halor ka sahit bneng .
translation.en: Praise him , ye heavens of heavens , and ye waters that be above the heavens .

translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa ki briew bamatlah jong nga na ki lynti kiba kim pat ju ïaid . Ngan pynkylla ïa jingdum ka ki jong sha ka jingshai bad pynlong ki ïa jaka khohruh khohram kiba jem ha khmat jong ki . Kine ki long ki jong jingkular nga , bad ngan batskhem ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not  ; I will lead them in paths that they have not known : I will make darkness light before them , and crooked things straight . These things will I do unto them , and not forsake them .

translation.kha: Bad pynban , ïakren tba jingkhraw ka jingisynei jong me , mem shym iehnoh her pynjot ïa ki thylliej pynlah long U Blei ka jingaiei bad Bel jingisynei !
translation.en: Nevertheless for thy great mercies  sake thou didst not utterly consume them , nor forsake them  ; for thou art a gracious and merciful God .

translation.kha: Nangta u Josaïah u hukum ïa u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh angkor ïa ki lyngdoh ba ïarap ïa u Shomer bad Sethan Jotbathah nongap kiba treikam ha ka jaka rung sha ka Templ ban wanrah ticket ka bahryntieh ïa pynni ki Tahan kiba pyndonkam ha ka Dinah ïa u Baal Arbad ïa ka blei Asherah , bad ïa ki khlur . U syiem u Omega thang ïa kine ki tiar hylla shabar ka nongbah hajan ka Them Kidron pyrta bad nangta ïa u dpei la rah sha Bethel .
translation.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest , and the priests of the second order , and the keepers of the door , to bring forth out of the temple of the  Lord  all the vessels that were made for Baal , and for the grove , and for all the host of heaven : and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron , and carried the ashes of them unto Beth–el .
And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles  hands the Holy Ghost was given , he offered them money ,
translation.kha: U Simon u la ïohi ba la ai ïa U Mynsiem ha ki bangeit haba ki apostol ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki . Kumta u la tyrwa pisa ha u Petros bad u Ïoannis ,
Hynrei haba Abel’ ïohknieh Seba ki noh shrak hapoh kata ka ri ba U mat U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi ban Sargon ka jingïohpateng , pynïap ïa Bishar :32 uwei .
translation.en: But of the cities of these people , which the  Lord  thy God doth give thee for an inheritance , thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth :

translation.kha: angel u jubab , tnga jong phi ka dei ban sumar leh ïa kita ïa kaba nga la bthah ïa .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware .

translation.kha: u Adoniram u peit ïa shah jubor u Jehoshaphat , khun jong u Ahilud u dei u nongsumar ïa ki dulir ;
translation.en: And Adoram was over the tribute : and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder :

translation.kha: Kumta te , Dabid , dang lashai step baroh na phi kiba la iehnoh ïa u Saul bad kiba la wan sha nga ki dei ban khie dang step bad mih shu mar kynjat shai .
translation.en: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master s servants that are come with thee : and as soon as ye be up early in the morning , and have light , depart .
And I will do in thee that which I have not done , and whereunto I will not do any more the like , because of all thine abominations .
translation.kha: Namar kiei kiei baroh kiba pha leh ki long kiba nga ijli , ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem ïa kaba ngam pat ju leh mynno mynno , bad ïa kaba ngan ym leh shuh lano lano ruh .
Haba peit ïa ka lawei , ïathuh shaphang “Ki bneng thymmai bad ka kiba katba kum kata ka jingkular jong u Blei ) ngi ïakhmih lynti , ha kiba shong sah” —2 Petros 3 :13 ; Isaïah 65 :17 .
translation.en: Looking to the future , the Bible tells of a “new heavens and a new earth that we are awaiting according to [God’s] promise , and in these righteousness is to dwell .”—2 Peter 3 :13  ; Isaiah 65 :17 .
Come down , and sit in the dust , O virgin daughter of Babylon , sit on the ground : there is no throne , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Babilon , to hiar noh na ka khet jong pha , bad shong ha u pui pui halor ka khyndew . Shisien pha la long kum kaba sotti , ka nongbah bym pat shahjop , hynrei pham long shuh kaba jem bad ba long jai jai ! Mynta pha long ka mraw !

translation.en: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness , and prayed .
translation.kha: Hynrei u ju leit noh sha ki jaka kynjah , ha kaba u la duwai .
Dei na kata ka daw balei ba u paidbah u ïakynduh ïa U — namar ba ki ïohsngew ba U leh kane ka kambah .
translation.en: For this cause the people also met him , for that they heard that he had done this miracle .

translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt baroh ki shi ïa ban ïoh umdih , namar kim lah shuh dih ïa ka um na ka wah .
translation.en: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink  ; for they could not drink of the water of the river .

translation.kha: Nga ïaleh khmied Shim tnum halor ki khlieh ki kherub bad halor jong ki ka don utai kaei kaba ïohpateng rabbit ka khet ba la shna na u mawkordor sapphir .
translation.en: Then I looked , and , behold , in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone , as the appearance of the likeness of a throne .
Take heed now  ; for the  Lord  hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary : be strong , and do it .
translation.kha: Me dei ban sngewthuh ba U  Trai  u la jied ïa me ban tei ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong u . Mynta leh ïa kata — bad leh ïa kata da ka jingkut jingmut baskhem .

translation.en: And he said , Peaceably : I am come to sacrifice unto the  Lord  : sanctify yourselves , and come with me to the sacrifice . And he sanctified Jesse and his sons , and called them to the sacrifice .
translation.kha: Ho-oid  u jubab .  Nga la wan ban ai ka jingkñia ainguh ha U  Trai . Pynkhuid ïa lade , bad wan bad nga .  U ong ruh ïa u Jesse bad ki khun shynrang jong u ban pynkhuid ïa lade , bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki sha kata ka jingkñia .

translation.en: And this he said to prove him : for he himself knew what he would do .
translation.kha: ( U la ong ïa kane ban tynjuh ïa u Philip ; ha ka jingshisha u la lah tip lypa ïa kaei ba un leh . )
Ho-oid , ka por kan wan :23 ki jingdam kin khot ha ki lum ka Ephraim , ‘ Ïa ngin ïaleit haduh Seïon , sha U Trai nongmuna Blei jong ngi .’
translation.en: For there shall be a day , that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry , Arise ye , and let us go up to Zion unto the  Lord  our God .
That is , that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba ma phi bad ma nga ngin ïoh ka jingïarap ha kajuh ka por , ma phi da ka jingngeit jong nga bad ma nga da ka jong phi .

translation.en: Ephraim , as I saw Tyre , is planted in a pleasant place : but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , nga lah ban ïohi ïa ki khun jong ki ba ki shah beh kthong bad shah pynïap .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world , this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her .
translation.kha: Mynta , nga ong skhem ha phi , ba shano shano ba yn ïalap ïa ka Gospel ha kylleng ka pyrthei , ïa kaei kaba ka la leh yn ïathuh ban kynmaw ïa ka .

Ki Philistia ki ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingrisa bad ki ong , Sngap ïa kata ka jingrisa baroh ha ka jaka shong ki Hebru ! Ka mut aïu kata Haba ki shem ba ka Jutang U Trai ka la poi ha ka jaka shong dara ki Hebru
translation.en: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout , they said , What meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews ? And they understood that the ark of the  Lord  was come into the camp .
And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north , he measured the length thereof , and the breadth thereof .
translation.kha: Nangta uta u briew u la thew ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shatei , kaba lam sha ka phyllaw bashabar .
U Jehoshaphat u pynlong jingïasuk bad u syiem . Israel
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren biang ha nga .
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ki riewsniew ki don hapdeng ki briew jong nga ; ki apthap kum ki briew kiba phriang ïa ki jar riam ban ïa ki , sim hynrei kiba pynap ïa ki jingriam ki jong ban riam ïa ki briew .
translation.en: For among my people are found wicked men : they lay wait , as he that setteth snares  ; they set a trap , they catch men .

translation.kha: Ngim dei ban leh ïa kane ha ka por Jingkhawai Ka Niam , ki la ong , kumta lymda ki paidbah ki lah ban khih kulmar .
translation.en: But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar of the people .
Now therefore hold him not guiltless : for thou art a wise man , and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him  ; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood .
translation.kha: Hynrei mem dei ban shah ïa u ban lait khlem ka jingpynshitom . Me tip kaei ba men leh , bad me dei ban khmih ba u dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh ha u Moses , ban ong ha ki kynhun Israel ,
Ko Israel , U Blei uba la thaw phi u ong , Wat sheptieng — ngan pyllait phi , nga la khot ïa phi da ka kyrteng phi long u jong nga
translation.en: But now thus saith the  Lord  that created thee , O Jacob , and he that formed thee , O Israel , Fear not : for I have redeemed thee , I have called thee by thy name  ; thou art mine .

translation.kha: Naba uno u uno bym long pyrshah ïa ngi u long ha ka liang jong ngi .
translation.en: For he that is not against us is on our part .

translation.kha: Ka dei lyngba ka jingngeit ba phi baroh long phi ki khun U Blei ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus .
Then I returned , and I saw vanity under the sun .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kawei pat kaei kaei ha ka jingim kaba long ka bymmyntoi .

translation.en: Take thou no usury of him , or increase : but fear thy God  ; that thy brother may live with thee .
translation.kha: Wat shim sut ei ei na u , hynrei kohnguh ïa U Blei , bad shah ïa uta u para Israel jong phi ban shong marjan bad phi .

translation.en: And he changeth the times and the seasons : he removeth kings , and setteth up kings : he giveth wisdom unto the wise , and knowledge to them that know understanding :
translation.kha: U bat synshar ïa ki por bad ki aïom ; u pynlong bad u weng ïa ki syiem ; long ma u , uba ai ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jedidah , the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath .
translation.kha: U Josaïah u la don phra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar laiphew wei snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jedidah , ka khun jong u Adaïah , na ka shnong na Boskath .

translation.en: And two olive trees by it , one upon the right side of the bowl , and the other upon the left side thereof .
translation.kha: Don ar tylli ki dieng Olib hajan u diengpynïeng sharak , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jong u .
Phin mynjur , namarkata Jakob ba tohmet shahshitom la long ka jingbankhia ïa Jashar . Hynrei don jingsangsot ban ong ba nga la long uba sianti , bad riam ïa phi da ki jingshukor .
translation.en: But be it so , I did not burden you : nevertheless , being crafty , I caught you with guile .
And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush : and he looked , and , behold , the bush burned with fire , and the bush was not consumed .
translation.kha: Hangta u angel jong U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u ha ka dur ka thylliej ding napdeng kawei ka  lawlynnong . U Moses u ïohi ba kata ka  lawlynnong ka la kem ding , hynrei kam shym ing satia .
Un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka jong ka bad pynïap ïa ka ha ka phang kaba shatei ka duwan ka jaka ba ki ju pynïap ïa ki mrad ka bynta ki jingkñia ainguh thang .
translation.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering , and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering .
And Jesus , which is called Justus , who are of the circumcision . These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God , which have been a comfort unto me .
translation.kha: U Joshua , ïa uba la khot ruh u Justos , u phah ruh ïa ki jingai khublei . Kine lai ngut ki long tang ma ki , ki parabangeit Jiw kiba trei bad nga na ka bynta Ka Hima U Blei , bad ki la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa nga .

Akrabbim don ruh ha shiliang duriaw . Phim ngut ban da kylli mihpaw ‘ Uei keiñ u ban leit nongot pynthaba pynduk bad wallam ïa ka Shelomoth ngi Baroh khnang Khatduh ngi Anakim ban ïohsngew bad kohnguh basian ka ?’
translation.en: Neither is it beyond the sea , that thou shouldest say , Who shall go over the sea for us , and bring it unto us , that we may hear it , and do it ?
And the men took of their victuals , and asked not counsel at the mouth of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la pdiang katto katne ka jingbam na ki , hynrei kim shym kynjoh ktien na U  Trai  shaphang kata .

Ha ka pyrem kaba bud , ha por jong ka haba ki syiem ki ju leit sha ka thma , u Dabid u la phah ïa u Joab bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u bad ka shipai Israel ki la jop ïa ki Ammon bad ki la kerkut ïa ka nongbah Rabbah . u Dabid hi u la sah ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , after the year was expired , at the time when kings go forth to battle , that David sent Joab , and his servants with him , and all Israel  ; and they destroyed the children of Ammon , and besieged Rabbah . But David tarried still at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Bad mynta ka jingshai ha ka sahit bneng ka phyrnai , eh ka phyrnai haduh katta katta ïa ngi ban khmih ïa ka bad ; ïa ka sahit bneng la sar pynkhuid da ka lyer .
translation.en: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds : but the wind passeth , and cleanseth them .

translation.kha: Ki ar ngut te ki batai ha ki ïa kaei kaba la jia ha kata ka lynti , bad ba kumno ki la ithuh U Trai mynba u la ïa u kpu .
translation.en: And they told what things were done in the way , and how he was known of them in breaking of bread .

translation.kha: shipai ka jingtrei minot u kwah pynsngewbha ïa la u rangbah bad kumta um bad ka jingim kaba ïadei .
translation.en: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life ; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier .
And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?
translation.kha: Balei , te , ba phi khmih ïa u thiat ha ka khmat u para jong phi , bad phi khlem pynleit jingmut ïa ka lyngkhot dieng hapoh ka khmat jong phi hi ?

translation.en: They are all gone out of the way , they are together become unprofitable ; there is none that doeth good , no , not one .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la phai noh na U Blei ; baroh ki la leh bym dei ; ym don uno uno uba leh ïa kaba dei , ym don uwei ruh .
uno Lada uno u leh pop khlem tip da kaba u pynkheiñ ïa kano ka kano hukum U Trai , u long uba la rem bad u dei ban ïoh ïa ka bainong .
translation.en: And if a soul sin , and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the  Lord   ; though he wist it not , yet is he guilty , and shall bear his iniquity .

Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them , to shew it unto Esther , and to declare it unto her , and to charge her that she should go in unto the king , to make supplication unto him , and to make request before him for her people .
translation.kha: U ai ha u Hathakh ïa ka kopi jong ka jingpynbna kaba u la pynmih ha Susa , kaba hukum ïa ka jingpynjot ïa ki Jiw . U Mordekai u ong ïa u ban rah ïa ka sha ka Esther , ban batai ha ka ïa kaei kaba long , bad ban ong ïa ka ban ïasaid bad u syiem bad kyrpad ïa u ban don jingisynei ïa ki briew jong ka .
hynrei ki jingpynkhuslai jong kane ka jingim , ka jingieit ïa ka spah , bad baroh ki jait ki tap bad kjap noh ïa ka khubor , bad kim seisoh satia .
translation.en: And the cares of this world , and the deceitfulness of riches , and the lusts of other things entering in , choke the word , and it becometh unfruitful .

translation.kha: Un shim ïa kaba shiphew na ki kynhun langbrot jong phi , pita phi phin long ki mraw jong ria .
translation.en: He will take the tenth of your sheep : and ye shall be his servants .
Where are you ?
translation.kha: Phi don shaei ?

translation.en: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes , and shave off all his hair , and wash himself in water , that he may be clean : and after that he shall come into the camp , and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days .
translation.kha: Uta u briew pat un sait ïa la ki jaiñ , un khi lut ïa la u shñiuh , bad un sum un sleh ; te un sa long uba khuid . U lah ban wan rung sha ka jaka shong dara , hynrei u dei ban shong shabar ka ïingjaiñ jong u hynñiew sngi lynter .

translation.en: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened , and the moon shall not give her light , and the stars shall fall from heaven , and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken :
translation.kha: Shen hadien ka jingjynjar jong kito ki sngi , ka sngi kan dum , u bnai un ym tyngshaiñ shuh , ki khlur kin hap na bneng , bad ki bor ha ka haw haw kin shah beh na ki lynti jong ki .

Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki lyngdoh bad ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phira ka Templ bad ha ki tymmen ki san kiba la wan hangta ban kem ïa u , Hato phi la dei ban ïawan bad ki bad ki dieng , la kumba nga u ?
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests , and captains of the temple , and the elders , which were come to him ,  Be ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and staves ?

translation.kha: Ka bymdon ka la rwai na ka bynta jong ki : To rwai ha U kitei namar ba u la jop ka jingjop badonburom ; u la bret ïa ki ïakheit bad ïa ki nongap jong ki sha Kata duriaw jingpynshoi
translation.en: And Miriam answered them , Sing ye to the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously  ; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .

translation.kha: Kumta te , uno uno u bymkohnguh wat ïa iba rit Khot jong ki hukum bad uba hikai ïa Abana pat ban leh kumjuh , un long uba nangno tam ha pashat Hima Pdiang Gath . jingïalumlang kawei pat ka liang Enaim uno uno uba kohnguh shaw ka Hukum bad uba hikai ïa kiwei kyndiah leh kumjuh , ïashukor long uba khraw ha jingïaphet Hima ki Bneng .
translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments , and shall teach men so , he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven : but whosoever shall do and teach them , the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: U Trai un bishar bad un rai mano ba bakla napdeng jong ngi . To un khmih ïa kane ka kam , un ïada ïa nga , bad un pyllait im ïa na nga . phi
translation.en: The  Lord  therefore be judge , and judge between me and thee , and see , and plead my cause , and deliver me out of thine hand .

translation.kha: kumta haba la bna ïa kata ka pop , u paidlang un wanlam ïa u masi lyngraw kum jingainguh ka namar ka pop . Kin wanrah sha Ïingjaiñ ka ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai .
translation.en: When the sin , which they have sinned against it , is known , then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin , and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation .

Then thou shalt say before the  Lord  thy God , I have brought away the hallowed things out of mine house , and also have given them unto the Levite , and unto the stranger , to the fatherless , and to the widow , according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me : I have not transgressed thy commandments , neither have I forgotten them :
translation.kha: phin ong ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ‘ Ngam shym pynsah ei ei shuh ha ïing na kata kaba nga la lum kyrpang ; nga la ai ïa ka ha ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , kumba me la hukum ïa nga . Ngam shym la leh palat lane leh klet ïa ki hukum jong me kiba ïadei bad kawei na ki shiphew .
To ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei jong ngi ; to mane ha khmat ka khet jong u ! Uba Khuid ma !
translation.en: Exalt ye the  Lord  our God , and worship at his footstool  ; for he is holy .
Of fowls after their kind , and of cattle after their kind , of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind , two of every sort shall come unto thee , to keep them alive .
translation.kha: Shim bad me shapoh kata ka lieng ïa u shynrang bad ka kynthei na kawei pa kawei ka jait mrad bad jait sim baroh , na ka bynta ba yn ri pynim ïa ki .
pyrshang pynsangeh ïa u , Jisu u la ong ïa ki , namar don uba leh ïa ka kambah ha kyrteng jong nga ba shen hadien un kiei kiei sniew shaphang nga .
translation.en: But Jesus said ,  Forbid him not : for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name , that can lightly speak evil of me .
Is not God in the height of heaven ? and behold the height of the stars , how high they are !
translation.kha: Hato U Blei um shong ha ki bneng kiba hajrong tam bad jngoh shapoh ïa ki khlur , wat la ki don hajrong ?

translation.en: Will open
translation.kha: Ngan sa Plie

translation.en: Say thou , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Shall it prosper ? shall he not pull up the roots thereof , and cut off the fruit thereof , that it wither ? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring , even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof .
translation.kha: Kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga kylli : Hato une u dieng sohwaiñ un im bad san ? translation.en: Let us pass , I pray thee , through thy country : we will not pass through the fields , or through the vineyards , neither will we drink of the water of the wells : we will go by the king s high way , we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left , until we have passed thy borders .

translation.en: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the  Lord  , that I die not :

translation.en: Observe thou that which I command thee this day : behold , I drive out before thee the Amorite , and the Canaanite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , and the Hivite , and the Jebusite .
Take heed to yourselves : If thy brother trespass against thee , rebuke him  ; and if he repent , forgive him .

translation.en: And he said , It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob , and to restore the preserved of Israel : I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles , that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth .

translation.en: And it was so , when Gideon heard the telling of the dream , and the interpretation thereof , that he worshipped , and returned into the host of Israel , and said , Arise  ; for the  Lord  hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian .

iphieng pynlong Hena me kum ka kynroh da ka rnong tylli ha ka jingïadei ai-jingmut ki . Kin ïakhun pyrshah ïa me Hanani lehnoh-ei! kin ym jop ïa jingpyrshah shylliah Ngan Stoik bad me ban Lakhish ïa me bad sumar pynim badonkam me .
translation.en: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall : and they shall fight against thee , but they shall not prevail against thee : for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: bad mynta une u syiem un ïalam ïa phi . Nga te nga la tymmen bad phuh ñiuhlieh , hynrei ki khun shynrang jong nga ki don bad phi . Nga la long nongïalam u jong phi naduh nga ba samla dang haduh mynta .
translation.en: And now , behold , the king walketh before you : and I am old and grayheaded  ; and , behold , my sons are with you : and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day .
When you meet members of our local congregation , try to get to know them better .

translation.en: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones , and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance .

translation.en: Then came to him his mother and his brethren , and could not come at him for the press .

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto them again ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , I am the door of the sheep .
