translation.en: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature ?
For we are the circumcision , which worship God in the spirit , and rejoice in Christ Jesus , and have no confidence in the flesh .
translation.kha: Dei ma ngi , ym ma ki , kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingotsher kaba shisha , naba ngi mane ïa U Blei da U Mynsiem jong u bad ngi lehkmen ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu . Ngim buh ïa kano kano ka jingshaniah ha ki jinglehniam kiba shabar .

Lada u Serksis marwei mynba Nebat wan ïadait u mraw jong phi , um dei ban ïalam ïa ka tnga jong u haba u mihnoh ; hynrei lada u la shongkurim henna u wan long u mraw jong phi , u lah ban ïalam ïa la ka tnga Mahli bad Riew-ieit .
translation.en: If he came in by himself , he shall go out by himself : if he were married , then his wife shall go out with him .
And Jezebel his wife said unto him , Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel ? arise , and eat bread , and let thine heart be merry : I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite .
translation.kha: Haba kumta , phi dei ne phim dei u syiem ?  Ka Jesebel ka jubab ,  To khie joit na jingthiah , lehkmen bad to bam . Ngan pynïoh ha phi ïa ka bri sohwaiñ u Naboth !

translation.en: And before this , Eliashib the priest , having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God , was allied unto Tobiah :
translation.kha: U Eliashib lyngdoh , uba khmih halor ki kamra buh tiar ka Templ , la slem u la don hapdeng ka jingïadei jingmut bad u Tobiah .

translation.en: He will swallow up death in victory  ; and the Lord  God  will wipe away tears from off all faces  ; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar un pynkut noh ïa ka jingïap junom ! Un ñiad noh ïa ki ummat na ki khmat jong baroh bad un weng noh ïa ka jingjahburom kaba ki briew jong u ki la shah ha kylleng ka pyrthei . U  Trai  hi da lade u la kren !

translation.en: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you , that ye both do and will do the things which we command you .
translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la ai ha ngi ka jingsngewskhem ha phi , bad ngi thikna ba phi leh bad phin ïai leh ïa kaei kaba ngi ong ïa phi .
Ki la ïa-rkhie ïa u , kumta u la phah ïa noh ki baroh shabar , u la shim ïa u bad kpa ïa ka kmie jong ka , bad ki lai ngut ki synran jong u , bad rung ka shapoh kamra ha kaba ka khynnah ka thiah .
translation.en: And they laughed him to scorn . But when he had put them all out , he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel , and them that were with him , and entereth in where the damsel was lying .

translation.kha: phah ïa ki jingkhublei ïa ka Priskila bad u Akwila , ki para nongtrei jong ha ka jingshakri ïa U Khrist Jisu ;
translation.en: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus :

translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ka jingstad jong U Blei la pyn-i ba ka long kaba shisha da baroh kiba pdiang ïa ka .
translation.en: But wisdom is justified of all her children .

translation.kha: Kumta ong ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , nga ong ha u , ‘ nga la shim ïa me na kaba ïa ki sumar ha langbrot ki jaka phlang bad pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar jong ki briew jong nga ki Israel .
translation.en: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I took thee from the sheepcote , even from following the sheep , that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel :
The heaven for height , and the earth for depth , and the heart of kings is unsearchable .
translation.kha: Phim ju tip kaei u syiem u pyrkhat ; ki jingmut jong u ki long sha lyndet ka jingtip jong ngi , kumba jrong ka sahit bneng ne kumba jylliew ka duriaw-bah .

translation.en: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it , by the two corners thereof , upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it  ; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal .
translation.kha: Thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki harum kata ka jingpynpur ha ki ar tylli ki krung kiba marpyrshah , ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah da kiba yn bah ïa ka .
Hynrei to mynta wat duh jingkyrmen , mano mano ruh na phi . Leh la ka kam , naba nga long ryngkat bad phi .
translation.en: Yet now be strong , O Zerubbabel , saith the  Lord   ; and be strong , O Joshua , son of Jehozadak , the high priest  ; and be strong , all ye people of the land , saith the  Lord  , and work : for I am with you , saith the  Lord  of hosts :

translation.kha: la lyngba ka shnong la ïashem u ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah pang ñiangthohlieh .
translation.en: And as he entered into a certain village , there met him ten men that were lepers , which stood afar off :
He is chastened also with pain upon his bed , and the multitude of his bones with strong pain :
translation.kha: U Blei u sneng ïa u briew da kaba phah ïa ka jingpang bad pyndap ïa ka met jong u da ka jingshitom .

translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: All who put their faith in Jesus can have their sins forgiven and receive everlasting life .—1 Timothy 2 :5 , 6  ; John 3 :16  ; Romans 5 :18 , 19 .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba don jingngeit ha u Jisu kin ïoh map na ki pop bad kin ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut .—1 Timothi 2 :5 , 6 ; Ioannis 3 :16 ; Rom 5 :18 , 19 .
Kumta te to ïakhlad ngin noh . Jied ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka ri kaba me mon . Me leit shawei , bad nga ngan shawei leit pat .
translation.en: Is not the whole land before thee ? separate thyself , I pray thee , from me : if thou wilt take the left hand , then I will go to the right  ; or if thou depart to the right hand , then I will go to the left .
Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall , and upon them that have daubed it with untempered mortar , and will say unto you , The wall is no more , neither they that daubed it  ;
translation.kha: Ka kynroh bad kito kiba tap ïa ka da ka jingpushara lieh kin sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga . Nangta ngan ïathuh ïa phi ba ka kynroh kam don shuh bad kumta ruh long kito kiba ñiad pushara lieh ïa ka —

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh : and he said unto them , Go , serve the  Lord  your God : but who are they that shall go ?
translation.kha: Kumta la wan ïalam biang ïa u Moses bad u Aaron sha u Pharaoh , bad u ong ha ki ,  Phi lah ban leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Hynrei pynthikna mano ban leit ?

translation.en: For out of prison he cometh to reign  ; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor .
translation.kha: Uno uno u lah ban kiew na ka jingduk ban long u syiem jong ka ri jong u , lane u ban leit na ka ïingbyndi sha ka khet , hynrei lada ha ka jinglong tymmen jong u , u long uba bieit eh ban shim ïa ka jingaibuit , um long uba kham bha kum u samla uba duk hynrei uba shemphang .

translation.en: And to masons , and hewers of stone , and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the  Lord  , and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it .
translation.kha: ki nongtrei maw , bad ki nongshniah maw , ki thied ïa ki dieng sawdong bad ïa ki maw kiba pyndonkam ha ka jingshna pynbha , bad siew ïa ki jingpynlut ba dei baroh .

Ka jutang bathymmai kaba samthiah pynlong bad ki paid Israel kan long kane : Ngan buh ïa ka trai jong nga hapoh jong ki bad thoh —Judah Sisera ha ki dohnud jong ki . Ngan long Ijon Blei jong ki , bad kin long ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel  ; After those days , saith the  Lord  , I will put my law in their inward parts , and write it in their hearts  ; and will be their God , and they shall be my people .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la Mikhmash pynshongkurim nga ba wat la ka Israel ka la phai noh na u Baal ka la lah Rephidim ba ka long kaba kham bha ban ïa ka Judah ka bymïaineh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah .

translation.kha: Kumba shi taïew hadien nierbah u la kren ïa kine kiei kiei , U sur-thma u la ïalam lem bad u ïa pynkyndeh Petros , langsohmoh Ïoannis bad ïa u Jakob bad sakhi sha u lum Belshassar duwai apkhmih
translation.en: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings , he took Peter and John and James , and went up into a mountain to pray .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat ki synran jong u Jisu ki la wan phai , bad ki la lyngngoh shikatdei eh ban lap ïa u ba u ïakren kata bad ka briew . Hynrei ym don na ki uba la ong ïa , Pha ka kwah aïu ? lane uba la kylli ïa , u Balei ba me ïakren bad ka ?
translation.en: And upon this came his disciples , and marvelled that he talked with the woman : yet no man said , What seekest thou ? or , Why talkest thou with her ?
Can the Ethiopian change his skin , or the leopard his spots ? then may ye also do good , that are accustomed to do evil .
translation.kha: U briew uba ïong u lah mo ban pynkylla ïa ka rong jong ka sniehdoh jong u , lane u  labasa u lah mo ban weng ïa ki jingthoh ïong jong u ? Lada ki lah , te ma pha ka bym leh ïa kano kano hynrei ka jingsniew pha lah ban tip ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
Naba Suk riewspah pynthame tlor noh kum u syntiew jong u jingthung ha khlaw .
translation.en: But the rich , in that he is made low : because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away .
Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days  ; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba sanphew , ka sngi kaba bud ïa ka Sabbaton kaba hynñiew , wan ai shuh ïa ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai  da u kew thymmai .
Katba ki don ha lynti sha ïing la ïathuh ha u Dabid , U Absalom la pynïap ki khun shynrang phi baroh ym uwei ruh uba lait !
translation.en: And it came to pass , while they were in the way , that tidings came to David , saying , Absalom hath slain all the king s sons , and there is not one of them left .

translation.kha: U nongthied borabor u khñium ba ka dor Almon rem eh , hynrei nangta u jingïamareh noh bad u Shah sarong ba u la ïoh da kaba ïadait dor .
translation.en: It is naught , it is naught , saith the buyer : but when he is gone his way , then he boasteth .

So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah , saying , As the  Lord  liveth , that made us this soul , I will not put thee to death , neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Sedekaïah u la kular ïa nga ha kaba rieh ,  Nga smai da U Blei uba im , U Blei uba ai jingim ïa ngi , ba ngan ym pynïap ïa phi lane ai noh ïa phi sha ki briew kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa phi .
Kumta ki la bad ki la pynskhem ka jingtep da kaba buh ïa ka muhor halor maw bad buh ïa ki nongap phira ban .
translation.en: So they went , and made the sepulchre sure , sealing the stone , and setting a watch .
And they put him in ward , that the mind of the  Lord  might be shewed them .
translation.kha: Ki set ïa u , bad ki ap haduh ba U  Trai  un ïathuh ïa ki kumno yn leh ïa u .
Ki jingïohipaw jong ki , ki long bakla , bad ki jingïathuh lypa jong ki , kiba . Ki kam ba ki kren ïa ka khubor jong nga shym la phah ïa ki . ki khmih lynti ba ki ktien jong ki shisha !
translation.en: They have seen vanity and lying divination , saying , The  Lord  saith : and the  Lord  hath not sent them : and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word .

translation.kha: Hynrei kane kam shym la jia ha uta ïa uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na ka . jingïap
translation.en: But he , whom God raised again , saw no corruption .
Hearken unto me now therefore , O ye children , and attend to the words of my mouth .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ko ki khun jong nga , sngap ïa nga . Pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
Balei phim sngewtynnad ianga ?
translation.en: Why don't you like me ?

translation.kha: Kumta mynnor Abimelekh lem bad syntied rangbah jong u baroh ki la mih mynmiet bad ki rieh shabar ka Shekhem ha ki Mattatha pyndam .
translation.en: And Abimelech rose up , and all the people that were with him , by night , and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies .

translation.kha: Ïarap lem la ki para Israel haduh ba kin da ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U Trai u ai ha sha sepngi na Jordan bad haduh ba U Trai un shah ba kin im suk im saiñ hangta , kumba u leh phi hangne . Hadien kata , phi ban wan sha kane ka ri ïa kaba la ha phi .
translation.en: Until the  Lord  have given rest unto your brethren , as well as unto you , and until they also possess the land which the  Lord  your God hath given them beyond Jordan : and then shall ye return every man unto his possession , which I have given you .

translation.kha: Da U Trai uba im , u Dabid u bteng biang , nga tip ba U Trai hi un shoh ïap ïa , u un lane ïap hi ynda poi ka ba por un ïap , lane haba un ïap ha ka thma .
translation.en: David said furthermore , As the  Lord  liveth , the  Lord  shall smite him  ; or his day shall come to die  ; or he shall descend into battle , and perish .

translation.kha: Ngan wallam pat ruh ïa u syiem ka Judah , u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim , lem bad ki briew baroh jong ka Judah kiba la leit sha ka jinglongmraw ha Babilonia . Ho-oid pynkheiñ , ngan ïa ka bor jong u syiem ka Babilonia nga . Ma , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , with all the captives of Judah , that went into Babylon , saith the  Lord  : for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon .

translation.kha: Haba u briew u smai “Nga u pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong uno uno ïasngap kham khraw ban ïa u , bad nongbah jingsmai Tabitha pynbeit ïa baroh ki jingïatainia .
translation.en: For men verily swear by the greater : and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife .
He also shall be my salvation : for an hypocrite shall not come before him .
translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba ka jingshlur jong nga kan pyllait im ïa nga , namar yn ym don u riewsniew u ban nud ban ïakynduh ïa U Blei .
Nangta Trai U u la ïathuh ha nga
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto me , saying ,
For I bear him record , that he hath a great zeal for you , and them that are in Laodicea , and them in Hierapolis .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban sakhi da lade hi ïa ka jingtrei shitom jong u na ka bynta jong phi bad na ka bynta ki briew kiba ha Laodikaïa bad ha Hierapolis .

U Dabid u jubab ïa u Gad , tmain don ha ka khim khait ! Hynrei ngam kwah ba Bidkar pynshitom Porsius ding da ki briew . Ai ba jingïap’ Trai da lade hi un ïa-ieit Ebi u ban pynshitom ïa nga , namar Tahan long uba dap da ka jingisynei jingtylli
translation.en: And David said unto Gad , I am in a great strait : let me fall now into the hand of the  Lord   ; for very great are his mercies : but let me not fall into the hand of man .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la hukum ïa phi ban ïa shim kine ki thied dulir jaka baroh ar tylli , ka dulir thied ba jaka la shon muhor bad ka kopi ba khlem shon muhor , bad ban buh ïa ki ha u khra khyndew , khnang ba kin neh ha ki snem ki ban . wan
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Take these evidences , this evidence of the purchase , both which is sealed , and this evidence which is open  ; and put them in an earthen vessel , that they may continue many days .
But Jesus did not commit himself unto them , because he knew all men ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu um shym la shaniah ïa lade ha ki , namar ba u la tip ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And God met Balaam : and he said unto him , I have prepared seven altars , and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram .
translation.kha: bad U Blei u ïakynduh ïa u . U Balaam u ong ha u ,  Nga la tei hynñiew tylli ki duwan bad nga la kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei kawei na ki .
Ki babun longïing jong ka kur Gershon ki la ïohpdiang baroh khatlai tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs .

translation.kha: Ki ïohi ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ba ki ïashad bad ki , ïarisa lem bad ïa u Samuel uba u ïalam na khmat . Nangta U Mynsiem U Blei u wan tyllep hiar ha ki rangbah jong u Saul , bad ruh ki ki sdang ban ïashad bad ïarisa .
translation.en: And Saul sent messengers to take David : and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying , and Samuel standing as appointed over them , the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul , and they also prophesied .

I saw the Lord standing upon the altar : and he said , Smite the lintel of the door , that the posts may shake : and cut them in the head , all of them  ; and I will slay the last of them with the sword : he that fleeth of them shall not flee away , and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa U  Trai  ba u ïeng harud ka duwan . U la ai ka hukum :  Tied tyngeh ïa ki khlieh rishot jong ka Templ haduh ba ka shyngkub baroh kawei kan da khih . Pynpait ïa ki bad ai ba kin hap halor ki khlieh jong ki briew . Ngan pynïap ha ka thma ïa ki briew kiba dang sah . Yn ym don u ban ïohphet ; wat uwei ruh un ym lait im .

translation.en: The land of Zabulon , and the land of Nephthalim , by the way of the sea , beyond Jordan , Galilee of the Gentiles  ;
translation.kha: Ko ka ri Sebulun bad ka ri Naphtali , kaba ha lynti sha ka duriaw , ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Jordan , ka Galilaïa , ka ri ki Jentil !

translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  : he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki nuksa jong u kpa jong u , u Ussaïah , u Jotham u la leh hi ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: If he beget a son that is a robber , a shedder of blood , and that doeth the like to any one of these things ,
translation.kha: Te tharai une u briew u don u khun uba lute bad uba pynïap , uba leh ïa kawei na kine kiei kiei kiba u kpa jong u um ju leh .

translation.en: My days are swifter than a weaver s shuttle , and are spent without hope .
translation.kha: Ki sngi ki ïaid khlem don jingkyrmen , ki ïaid kham stet ban ïa ka latai jong u nongthain jaiñ .
‘ Ko ,’ Kynrad nga la jubab , ‘ ki ïatip bha ba nga la leit sha ki synagog bad la nga kem bad shoh ïa kito kiba ngeit ha me .
translation.en: And I said , Lord , they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee :

translation.kha: bad Hamath la sdang ban hikai ïa ki :
translation.en: And he opened his mouth , and taught them , saying ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Soitan u la rung hapoh u Judas , ïa uba la khot u Iskariot , uba long uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran .
translation.en: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot , being of the number of the twelve .

translation.kha: Haba Shiphew ïohi ba la kerkut ïa ka Jesebel da ki kynhun shipai , te phin tip ba shen yn kyrthep pynjot noh Bethlehem ka .
translation.en: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies , then know that the desolation thereof is nigh .
Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that this place shall no more be called Topheth , nor The valley of the son of Hinnom , but The valley of slaughter .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ka por kan wan haba ïa kane ka jaka yn ym khot shuh ka Topheth lane ka Them Hinnom . Pynban yn tip ïa ka kum ka Them ka Jingpynïap .
Ka por ka la poi ïa ka ba kan kha , bad ka la ïoh ar ngut ki synrap khun shynrang .
translation.en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled , behold , there were twins in her womb .
But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates .
translation.kha: Nga ngeit ba phin ïoh tip ba ngim long kiba la shahjop .

translation.en: And under the firmament were their wings straight , the one toward the other : every one had two , which covered on this side , and every one had two , which covered on that side , their bodies .
translation.kha: Hangta hapoh kata ka tnum kita ki jingthaw ki ïeng , uwei uwei u pyiar ar tylli ki thapniang sha kiwei pat kiba hajan bad u bad tap pat ïa lade da ki ar tylli ki thapniang .

translation.en: But I receive not testimony from man : but these things I say , that ye might be saved .
translation.kha: Kam mut ba nga dei ban da ïoh ïa ka jingphla jong u briew ; nga ong ïa kane ba khnang ba phin ïohlait im .

translation.en: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him ? saith the  Lord . Do not I fill heaven and earth ? saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ym don uba lah ban rieh ha kaba ngam lah ban ïohi ïa u . Hato phim tip ba nga don ha ki jaka baroh ha bneng bad ha khyndew ?
U Blei un buh ïa ki angel ban khmih halor jong me ban ïada ïa me shano shano me ba leit .
translation.en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee , to keep thee in all thy ways .

translation.kha: U kpa jong u , u leit sha ïing kata ka kynthei , bad u Samson u pynlong ka jingkhawai hangta . Kane ka long kaba ki ju ki para samla .
translation.en: So his father went down unto the woman : and Samson made there a feast  ; for so used the young men to do .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ha nga , Ko khun u briew , to khot ïa ki sim bad ki baroh kiba ha khlaw , ban na baroh sawdong ban ïabam ïa ka nga pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ki . Kan long ka jingkhawai kaba heh ha ki lumbah Israel , ba kin ïabam ïa ka bad dih ïa snam .
translation.en: And , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Speak unto every feathered fowl , and to every beast of the field , Assemble yourselves , and come  ; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you , even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel , that ye may eat flesh , and drink blood .

translation.kha: U Joseph long uba dap shynrang bad uba bhabriew lymphuin , hadien khyndiat ka tnga jong u kynrad jong u ka la ban ikwah ïa u Joseph , bad ka ïa u ban leit thiah bad ka
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that his master s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph  ; and she said , Lie with me .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsarong jong kito ki nongïalam buaid yn ïuhroit hapoh ki kjat .
translation.en: The crown of pride , the drunkards of Ephraim , shall be trodden under feet :
They that make them are like unto them : so is every one that trusteth in them .
translation.kha: To ai ba baroh kiba la thaw ïa ki bad kiba shaniah ha ki kin kylla long kum ki bleithaw ba ki la shna !

translation.en: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul s bolster  ; and they gat them away , and no man saw it , nor knew it , neither awaked : for they were all asleep  ; because a deep sleep from the  Lord  was fallen upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u shim ïa uta u sum bad ïa uta u khiew um najan ka khlieh u Saul , bad ma u bad u Abishai ki mihnoh . Ym don mano mano uba la ïohi lane tip ïa kata ; ym don ruh mano mano uba la kyndit — baroh ki dang ïohthiah lyngngai , namar ba U  Trai  u la phah ïa ka jingïohthiah kaba jur ha ki baroh .

translation.en: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue , and seeth the tumult , and them that wept and wailed greatly .

translation.kha: U angel U Blei Arumah la kren ïa nga ha ka jingphohsniew bad u nongñiah , ‘ Jakob kti! ‘ ba-bymman nga la jubab .
translation.en: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream , saying , Jacob : And I said , Here am I .

translation.kha: U buhrieh ïa lade ha , da kaba apthap ban pynïap ïa briew kiba lui lui . U syntiat ïa ki lanot jong u , bym nongïarap ,
translation.en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages : in the secret places doth he murder the innocent : his eyes are privily set against the poor .

translation.kha: Haba Jisu U u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingngeit ki la don , u la ong ha uta u briew , La map ïa ki pop jong me , ko paralok jong . nga
translation.en: And when he saw their faith , he said unto him ,  Man , thy sins are forgiven thee .

translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ka ïa khubor , ong ki briew ka Jerusalem , bad ki kti jong ngi noh ki kyrwep , la kem ïa ngi da ka jinglyng-a bad ka jingpang kum ka kynthei kaba suh kha .
translation.en: We have heard the fame thereof : our hands wax feeble : anguish hath taken hold of us , and pain , as of a woman in travail .
Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart , and hear with thine ears .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ko khun u briew , sngap bha bad kynmaw ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga ong ha me .

translation.en: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears , and brought them unto Aaron .
translation.kha: Kumta ki paidbah baroh ki ïalaw noh ïa la ki sohshkor ksiar bad ki wallam ïa ki ha u Aaron .

translation.en: And the man wondering at her held his peace , to wit whether the  Lord  had made his journey prosperous or not .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u dang ïai khmih jar jar ïa ka , ban peit la ka long ba U  Trai  u la ai jingjop ïa u .
Ngan pynkut mynta ïa ka bor shatei ka Assyria halor jong phi bad ngan pyndkut ïa ki Jeroham bsiang teh ïa phi .
translation.en: For now will I break his yoke from off thee , and will burst thy bonds in sunder .

translation.kha: la u nongshoh-nar , uba pyrsad ïa ka ding bad shna ïa ki thma . Nga la thaw ruh ïa u shipai , uba pyndonkam ïa ki tiar ïapom ban pynïap .
translation.en: Behold , I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire , and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work  ; and I have created the waster to destroy .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip lut jong shaphang me , kaei ba me leh bad shano me leit , nga bad tip kumno ba me bitar shla pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: But I know thy abode , and thy going out , and thy coming in , and thy rage against me .

Wherefore the Lord said , Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth , and with their lips do honour me , but have removed their heart far from me , and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Kine ki briew ki ong ba ki mane ïa nga , hynrei ki ktien jong ki kim don jingmut ei ei , bad ki dohnud jong ki , ki long shawei pat . Ka niam jong ki kam long ei ei , hynrei ka long tang ki aiñ bad ki rukom briew , kiba ki shu spel lyndet .
U la million san nang san tad haduh ba u la kynjoh ïa ka sahit orpait bad ba lah ban kyrthep da baroh kiba don ha ka pyrthei iohi
translation.en: The tree grew , and was strong , and the height thereof reached unto heaven , and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth :
And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , saying , What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people ?
translation.kha: U syiem Rehoboam u ïasyllok bad ki riewrangbah kiba la shakri ïa u Solomon u kpa jong u kum ki nongaibuit .  Kaei ka jubab ba phin ai jingmut ïa nga ba ngan ai ha kine ki briew ?  u kylli .

translation.en: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the  Lord  : for there he offered burnt offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings , because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings , and the meat offerings , and the fat .
translation.kha: U Solomon u pynkyntang ïa ka jaka pdeng jong ka phyllaw , ka jaka kaba ha khmat ka Templ , bad u ai ki jingkñia hangta ba la thang tylli , ki jingainguh bam , bad ïa ka khleiñ na ki jingainguh ïasyllok . U leh ïa kane namar ba ka duwan rnong ba u la thaw ka rit than ïa kine ki jingainguh baroh .

translation.en: Am I a God at hand , saith the  Lord  , and not a God afar off ?
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei uba don ha ki jaka baroh bad ym tang ha kawei ka jaka .
Nga , nga long u jingim kpu ka U , Jisu u la ïathuh ïa ki . Kito kiba wan sha nga da lei lei kin ym thngan ; kito kiba ngeit ha nga da lei lei kin ym sliang .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  I am the bread of life : he that cometh to me shall never hunger  ; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst .

translation.kha: Ngan lyngngeit ïa me ha khyndew bad jingbymdei wanrah ïa ki sim bad ki mrad baroh jong ka pyrthei ba kin ïabam ïa jingpynnang doh jong me .
translation.en: Then will I leave thee upon the land , I will cast thee forth upon the open field , and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee , and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee .

translation.kha: Ïa kito thab ronsing tyrso , ka dei ka jingiwtung kaba pynïap ; hynrei ha kito kiba la pynim , ka nongthawdur ka jong kaba wallam jingim . Uei hajar , uba lah ban leh Besalel kaba kum kata ka kam ?
translation.en: To the one we are the savour of death unto death ; and to the other the savour of life unto life . And who is sufficient for these things ?
And he doeth great wonders , so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men ,
translation.kha: Une u mradkhlaw uba ar , u la leh ki kambah kiba khraw ; u la pynlong ïa ka ding ban wan hiar na bneng sha ka pyrthei ha ka jingïohi jong uwei pa uwei baroh .

translation.en: Among which was Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James and Joses , and the mother of Zebedee s children .
translation.kha: Napdeng jong ki , ki long ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Mari ka kmie u Jakob bad u Josis bad ka tnga u Sebedi .
ki sei jubab ïa u rishot bakyntang uba don hangta bad ki thang ïa u .
translation.en: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal , and burned them .
He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory : but he that seeketh his glory that sent him , the same is true , and no unrighteousness is in him .
translation.kha: U briew uba kren ha la ka jong ka bor u pyrshang ban ïoh burom na ka bynta ïa lade hi . Hynrei uba wad ïa ka burom jong uta uba la phah ïa u , u long uba shida , bad ym don ka bymshisha ha u .

translation.en: Be ye also patient  ; stablish your hearts : for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh .
translation.kha: Phi ruh phi dei ban long kiba ïaishah . To batskhem ïa ki jingkyrmen jong phi , naba ka sngi ka jingwan U Trai ka la jan .
Nalor hab jingheh , ïano pat ngan shakri ïa-ïohbor lada ym dei ïa u nongpynjot ïalaw u kynrad jong nga ? Kumba nga la shakri ïa bajar pa jong phi , Enhasor mynta ngan shakri ïa nongñiah .
translation.en: And again , whom should I serve ? should I not serve in the presence of his son ? as I have served in thy father s presence , so will I be in thy presence .

Behold , therefore I will gather all thy lovers , with whom thou hast taken pleasure , and all them that thou hast loved , with all them that thou hast hated  ; I will even gather them round about against thee , and will discover thy nakedness unto them , that they may see all thy nakedness .
translation.kha: Namar kane ngan wallam lang ïa baroh ki nongleh-ieit jong pha kiba mynshuwa — kito kiba pha la sngewtynnat bad kito kiba pha la isih . Ngan wallam ïa ki sawdong jong pha ha ka jylli , bad nangta ngan law ïa ki jaiñ jong pha bad shah ïa ki ban ïohi ba pha lyngkhuit .

Ma nga , bad ki hynñiew bani ki nongai jingmut , ngi phah dewbyrtha phi ban wad jingtip ïa ki jinglong jingman ha Jerusalem Epher Judah khnang ban iohnong kumno ïa ka jakhlia U Blei jong me , ïa kaba Sodom bynshet lam me , la riewlamwir pnah
translation.en: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king , and of his seven counsellors , to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem , according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand  ;

translation.kha: Ym pat thet don mynno mynno , bad yn hylla don lano lano , ba la don kum kata ka sngi , mynba shyntur Trai u la shahshkor jingsiangthiah u bynriew . U Amen u ïaleh ha ka kyang khyndiat Israel !
translation.en: And there was no day like that before it or after it , that the  Lord  hearkened unto the voice of a man : for the  Lord  fought for Israel .

And they set the altar upon his bases  ; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries : and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the  Lord  , even burnt offerings morning and evening .
translation.kha: Wat la kiba shah ringmraw kiba la wan phai , ki sheptieng ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri , pynban ki tei biang ïa ka duwan ha ka jaka ba ka ïeng mynshuwa . Nangta ki sdang biang ban thang halor jong ka ïa ki jingkñia man ka step bad man ka janmiet .

Kumta hi u pyntngen jingiap la ïalam ïa u Daniel sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar bad u la Riblah ha u syiem , Nga la shem uwei “phla ki Jiw kiba la shah bymsngewtynnat , uba lah ban bur Matri u Syiem Kynrad ïa ka jingmut Armoni ka jingphohsniew Thaw khat .
translation.en: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste , and said thus unto him , I have found a man of the captives of Judah , that will make known unto the king the interpretation .

translation.kha: Wat sngewlyngngoh namar ba nga ong ha me , ba ka dei ban kha pat ïa .
translation.en: Marvel not that I said unto thee , Ye must be born again .
And they entered in , and found not the body of the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: hynrei kim shym shem ïa ka met jong U Trai Jisu .

Ka jynrat ka mon jong U Trai ba u shakri jong u un san apot u jingthung uba ksam ïa ki thied ha ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong . pynum don main ne jingitynnat ban pynlong ïa ngi ban peit jingbei Resheph . Ym don kano kano kaba ngin ibha ïa bamatlah , ym don kano Philistia ka ban khring ïa ngi sha u .
translation.en: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant , and as a root out of a dry ground : he hath no form nor comeliness  ; and when we shall see him , there is no beauty that we should desire him .
We have shot at them  ; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon , and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah , which reacheth unto Medeba .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki la shah pynjot , Shi lynter naduh Heshbon haduh Dibon , Naduh Nashim haduh Nophah , hajan ka Medeba .
Em , ym kumta ! Bad nga ong ïa phi Kut lada phim phai noh na ki pop wai phi , phi baroh phin ïap kum ma Amasa .
translation.en: I tell you , Nay : but , except ye repent , ye shall all likewise perish .

translation.kha: U Joshua u ha ong u , Ko khun shynrang jong nga , ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha hangne ha khmat U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , bad phla Ïathuh . ha nga mynta ïa kaba kaei me la leh . Wat pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa ka na nga .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto Achan , My son , give , I pray thee , glory to the  Lord  God of Israel , and make confession unto him  ; and tell me now what thou hast done  ; hide it not from me .

translation.kha: Ka jingbitar jong nga kan meh lep ka kum ding , bad kan thang duh katba don ha sla pyrthei . Kan pur de shaduh ñiamra , bad kan thang ïa ki jong tynrai ki lumbah .
translation.en: For a fire is kindled in mine anger , and shall burn unto the lowest hell , and shall consume the earth with her increase , and set on fire the foundations of the mountains .

But he said unto her , Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh . What ? shall we receive good at the hand of God , and shall we not receive evil ? In all this did not Job sin with his lips .
translation.kha: U Job u jubab ,  Pha kren bieit ! Haba U Blei u phah ei ei kaba bha , ngi pdiang ïa kata . Kumno ngi lah ban khñium haba u phah ïa ki jingeh ha ngi ?  Wat la u shah ïa ki jingjynjar baroh , u Job um shym la kren ei ei pyrshah ïa U Blei .

translation.en: With all lowliness and meekness , with longsuffering , forbearing one another in love ;
translation.kha: To long borabor kiba sngewrit , kiba jemnud , bad kiba ïaishah . To pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong phi da kaba ïaishah iwei ïa iwei pat .
Ki la ïaleit sha baroh ki nongbah jong ka Judah bad ki wallam pat bad ki sha Jerusalem ïa ki Lebi bad ïa baroh ki rangbah kur .
translation.en: And they went about in Judah , and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah , and the chief of the fathers of Israel , and they came to Jerusalem .
Wherefore it shall come to pass , if ye hearken to these judgments , and keep , and do them , that the  Lord  thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers :
translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor ïa kine ki hukum bad kohnguh hok ïa ki , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïai bat ïa la ka jutang bad phi bad un pynpaw ha phi ïa ka jingieit jong u kaba ïaineh , kumba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

Lymne ym don uno uno u ban theh ïa waiñ ka bathymmai hapoh ki lwa snieh kiba la pyndonkam , namar ki snieh kin pdang bad waiñ ka kan tuid shabar , ïa bad ki lwa snieh yn pynsniew . Hynrei , ïa ka waiñ kaba thymmai la theh noh ha ki lwa snieh bym pat ju , pyndonkam bad baroh ar kin neh .
translation.en: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles : else the bottles break , and the wine runneth out , and the bottles perish : but they put new wine into new bottles , and both are preserved .

Yea , every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the  Lord  of hosts : and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them , and seethe therein : and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei u khiew shet ha Jerusalem bad ha baroh ka Judah yn pynkyrpang na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh . Ki briew kiba ai ïa ki jingkñia kin pyndonkam ïa ki ban phon ïa ka doh jong ki jingkñia . Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don shuh uno uno u nongkhaïi ha ka Templ jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
U syiem Hesekaïah u kylli , Kaei ka dak ba U un ïa nga bad ba hadien lai ngan sa lah ban leit sha ka Templ ?
translation.en: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah , What shall be the sign that the  Lord  will heal me , and that I shall go up into the house of the  Lord  the third day ?

translation.kha: U Dabid hi da lade u la khot ïa u ‘ U Trai’ ; te kumno U Messaïah u lah ban hiarpateng na u ? Dabid U babun paidbah u dang shahshkor ïa U Jisu da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: David therefore himself calleth him Lord  ; and whence is he then his son ?  And the common people heard him gladly .
Not boasting of things without our measure , that is , of other men s labours ; but having hope , when your faith is increased , that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly ,
translation.kha: Kumta ngim leh sarong shaphang ka kam kaba kiwei ki la leh palat shabar u pud ïa uba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi . Pynban , ngi kyrmen ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka nang san bad ba ngi lah ban leh ïa ka kam kaba kham khraw hapdeng jong phi , borabor hapoh ki pud ba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Mary .  She turned herself , and saith unto him , Rabboni  ; which is to say , Master .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Ko Mari !  Ka la phai sha u bad ka la ong ha ka ktien Hebru ,  Rabboni !  ( Kane ka mut  Ko Nonghikai ! . )

translation.en: And Moses did so : as the  Lord  commanded him , so did he .
translation.kha: U Moses u leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: Then said David , Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul ? And the  Lord  said , They will deliver thee up .
translation.kha: Bad hato ki nongshong shnong jong ka Keilah kin aiti ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah jong nga ha u Saul ?  u Dabid u kylli biang .  Kin ai ,  U  Trai  u jubab .

translation.en: And Adam was not deceived , but the woman being deceived was in the transgression .
translation.kha: Bad ym dei u Adam uba la shah shukor ; dei ka kynthei kaba la shah shukor bad pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum U Blei .

Te u Petros u la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba la lah jia ha u , bad u la , ong Mynta nga tip ba ka long kaba shisha ! U Trai u phah la ïa u angel jong u ban pyllait ïa nga na ka bor jong u Herod bad na kaei kaei baroh kaba Jiw ki ki la khmih lynti ba jia kan .
translation.en: And when Peter was come to himself , he said , Now I know of a surety , that the Lord hath sent his angel , and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod , and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews .
And take heed to yourselves , lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting , and drunkenness , and cares of this life , and so that day come upon you unawares .
translation.kha: Sumar bha ! Wat pynlut por shaba palat ha ka jingkhawai bad ka jingïadih bad ha ki jingkhuslai jong kane ka jingim , ïoh ba kata Ka Sngi kan kem kynsan ïa phi kum ka jingriam .
Ka jingïap ka dap wan ïashitom lyngba ki jingkhangïit jong patrong bad ka la rung sha Barnea ïingsyiem jong ngi ; ka la ot ïa ki khynnah ha pynjngut surok bad ïa ki samla shynrang ha ki jaka ïew .
translation.en: For death is come up into our windows , and is entered into our palaces , to cut off the children from without , and the young men from the streets .
So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul : when thou hast found it , then there shall be a reward , and thy expectation shall not be cut off .
translation.kha: phi lah ban sngewskhem ba ka jingstad ka long kaba bha ïa ka mynsiem . To ïoh ïa ka jingstad bad ka lawei jong phi kan long kaba phyrnai .

translation.en: As for these four children , God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom : and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ai ha ki saw ngut ki samla shynrang ïa ka jingtip bad ka jingtbit ha ka thoh ka tar bad ha ka saiñpyrkhat . Nalor kane , u la ai ha u Daniel ka jingtbit ban batai ïa ki jingïohipaw bad ïa ki jingphohsniew .

translation.en: O Lord , I beseech thee , let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant , and to the prayer of thy servants , who desire to fear thy name : and prosper , I pray thee , thy servant this day , and grant him mercy in the sight of this man . For I was the king s cupbearer .
translation.kha: To shahshkor mynta ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad ïa ki jingduwai jong baroh kiwei pat ki shakri jong me kiba kwah ban ai ïa me ka burom . Ai ïa ka jingjop mynta ka sngi bad pynlong ba u patsha un leh-isynei ïa nga .  Ha kita ki sngi nga la long u nongrah waiñ jong u patsha .
Suh ïa ka sopti u Aaron da ka linen bani , bad ïa ka jaiñspong ruh da ka linen bani bad ; ïa u panpoh ruh uba la pynpur suh itynnat .
translation.en: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen , and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen , and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework .
And the men , which Moses sent to search the land , who returned , and made all the congregation to murmur against him , by bringing up a slander upon the land ,
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba u Moses u la phah swar ïa ka ri , ki la wanrah ïa ka kaiphod balamler kaba la pynlong ïa u paidbah ban khñium pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Wherefore the  Lord  said unto Solomon , Forasmuch as this is done of thee , and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes , which I have commanded thee , I will surely rend the kingdom from thee , and will give it to thy servant .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar ïa u Solomon , bad u la ong ha u ,  Namar ba me la leh khnang ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang ba me la ïateh bad nga bad ba mem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , nga kular ban shim noh ïa ka hima na me bad ngan ai ha uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong me .

translation.en: After the doings of the land of Egypt , wherein ye dwelt , shall ye not do : and after the doings of the land of Canaan , whither I bring you , shall ye not do : neither shall ye walk in their ordinances .
translation.kha: Wat bud ïa ki rukom im ki briew ha ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi ruh shisien phi la shong , ne ïa ki jong ki briew ha ri Kanaan , sha kaba ngan ïalam ïa phi .
1870 kano kano ka jingai jingmut ba u Ahithophel tyngab tieng ïapher ha kito ki Tabrimmon kuna la pdiang kumba ka long hi ka ktien jong U Blei ; u Syros bad u Absalom baroh ar ngut ki bud ïa ka .
translation.en: And the counsel of Ahithophel , which he counselled in those days , was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God : so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom .
And he overlaid it with pure gold , both the top of it , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns of it : also he made unto it a crown of gold round about .
translation.kha: U suit ïa kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ki krung jong ka baroh sawdong , bad ïa ki reng jong ka , da ka ksiar nylla , bad u shna ruh ïa ka jingpynpur ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .

Haba u la poi bad u la Suah main U Blei u pynkthang kyrkhu ïa ki thwet , u Examination kmen bad u la kyntu ïa plakhun baroh pynsynjor ïaineh bad ban long kiba beit ha U Trai da ka dohnud jong ki baroh .
translation.en: Who , when he came , and had seen the grace of God , was glad , and exhorted them all , that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord .
But it came to pass , that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall , he was wroth , and took great indignation , and mocked the Jews .
translation.kha: Haba u Sanballat u ïohsngew ba ki Jiw ki la sdang ïa ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh , u la bitar bad u sdang ban krenbeiñ ïa ngi .

Ki ka Syria ki la ïa ki mar khaïi bad ki jingmih ba jong pha . Ki la ai ki mawkordor Emerald , ki jaiñ , ki ba-itynnat , ki linen bakynsai ki Koral , bad ki mawkordor Rubi kum ka jingsiew na ka bynta ki mar jong
translation.en: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making : they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds , purple , and broidered work , and fine linen , and coral , and agate .
The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and every one of the curtains shall have one measure .
translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ kan long khat-ar mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan . Baroh kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki dei ban long katjuh ka jingheh .

translation.en: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness  ; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday .
translation.kha: ne ïa ki khlam kiba shoh ha kaba dum , ne ïa ki jingsniew kiba pynïap haba shai ka sngi .

translation.en: When he speaketh fair , believe him not : for there are seven abominations in his heart .
translation.kha: Ki lah ban sawa sngewtynnat , hynrei wat ngeit ïa u , namar ka dohnud jong u ka dap haduh rymmiang da ka jingisih .
Ki apostol ki la wan phai bad ki la ïakynduh ïa U ; bad ki la ïathuh ha ïa baroh kaba la leh bad hikai .
translation.en: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus , and told him all things , both what they had done , and what they had taught .
When I lie down , I say , When shall I arise , and the night be gone ? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day .
translation.kha: Haba nga dem ban thiah , ki kynta ki ïaid suki nga khih pisa baroh shi miet bad ka slem ban kynjat shai .

Lyngba shakri jong nga la ai ki kpa tymmen jong phi ïa hukum bad ki jingmaham , hynrei ki la kyntait ïa ki bad ki la shahshitom kaba mih . Nangta ki la kylla-kaba-mut bad ki la pdiang ba ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , lah pynshitom ïa ki kumba ban shah bad kumba la jingmut ban leh .’
translation.en: But my words and my statutes , which I commanded my servants the prophets , did they not take hold of your fathers ? and they returned and said , Like as the  Lord  of hosts thought to do unto us , according to our ways , and according to our doings , so hath he dealt with us .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem u la ai ha ngi ka jingim , u dei ruh ban synshar ïa ki jingim jong ngi .
translation.en: If we live in the Spirit , let us also walk in the Spirit .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u ong ha u Dabid , To ai ba U Trai U Blei ki Israel un long u Sakhi hapdeng jong ngi ! Ha kum kane ka por lashai bad ha ka sngi kaba ngan bud jingkylli kylli ïa i pa . Lada ka jingthmu jong i ïa phi ka bha ngan , phah sa ktien ïa phi .
translation.en: And Jonathan said unto David , O  Lord  God of Israel , when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time , or the third day , and , behold , if there be good toward David , and I then send not unto thee , and shew it thee  ;

translation.kha: kim namar pat shym la sngewthuh ïa ka jingmut bashisha ka jong jingbsa ïa ki san hajar ngut ; ki jingmut jong ki kim lah ban ïohkem ïa kata .
translation.en: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves : for their heart was hardened .
Thus saith the  Lord   ; Deceive not yourselves , saying , The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us : for they shall not depart .
translation.kha: Ma nga U  Trai  , nga maham ïa me ban ym shukor ïa lade da kaba pyrkhat ba ki nong Babilonia kin ym wan shuh , namar kin sa wan biang .
Ynda u Joseph u la wan sha klongsnam , ki leit rah jingpar u hapoh ïing ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha , bad ki nguh ngon Khublei khmat jong u thung
translation.en: And when Joseph came home , they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house , and bowed themselves to him to the earth .
Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance , hewers and workers of stone and timber , and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work .
translation.kha: Me don bun ki nongtrei . Ki don ki rangbah ki ban trei ha ki par maw , bad ki don ki misteri maw bad misteri dieng , bad shibun ki nongtrei kti ha ki jait kam baroh ba ki lah ban trei ha ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong bad ka nar .

translation.en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran : and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka pynbuh briew ïa u bad ka nong Ijipt .

translation.en: For , behold , I will send serpents , cockatrices , among you , which will not be charmed , and they shall bite you , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Husiar !  U  Trai  u ong ,  nga phah ki bseiñ hapdeng jong phi , ki bseiñ don bih ki bym lah ban pynshohbieit , bad kin puh ïa phi .

translation.en: The  Lord  will smite thee with the botch of Egypt , and with the emerods , and with the scab , and with the itch , whereof thou canst not be healed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un shoh ïa phi da ki tohjaw , kumba u la leh ïa ki nong Ijipt . Un pynlong ïa ka met jong phi ban dap da ka prum . Yn tap ïa phi da ka sarew , bad phin daitbuid , hynrei yn ym don jingpynkhiah .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Pharaoh would hardly let us go , that the  Lord  slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both the firstborn of man , and the firstborn of beast : therefore I sacrifice to the  Lord  all that openeth the matrix , being males  ; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem .
translation.kha: Haba u Pharaoh u mutlop bad u kyntait ban shah ïa ngi ban leit , U  Trai  u la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong ha Ijipt , uba na u briew bad na u mrad ruh . Dei namar kata ba ngi kñia ainguh ha U  Trai  ïa uwei pa uwei uba la kha nyngkong na ki mrad , hynrei ngi pyllait pat ïa la ki khun shynrang baroh kiba la kha nyngkong .

translation.en: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives , and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of his servants : and afterward it shall be inhabited , as in the days of old , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad ngan aiti ha kito kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa ki , ha u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia bad ka kynhun shipai jong u . Hynrei shen hadien , ki briew kin shong kin sah biang ha Ijipt , kumba ki la leh ha ki por ba la leit . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Kane ka kynthup ïa pa baroh , lait noh u Kaleb u khun u Jephunneh uba na ka jait Kenis bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun ; ki ïailong kiba kohnguh Trai .
translation.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite , and Joshua the son of Nun : for they have wholly followed the  Lord .

translation.en: And there were seven steps to go up to it , and the arches thereof were before them : and it had palm trees , one on this side , and another on that side , upon the posts thereof .

And all the trees of the field shall know that I the  Lord  have brought down the high tree , have exalted the low tree , have dried up the green tree , and have made the dry tree to flourish : I the  Lord  have spoken and have done it .
translation.kha: Baroh ki dieng kin tip ba nga long U  Trai . Nga khet ïa ki dieng bajrong bad nga pynlong ïa ki dieng rit ban san jrong . Nga pynïap stai ïa ki dieng bajyrngam bad pynlong ïa ki dieng ba-tyrkhong ban kylla jyrngam . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh .

translation.en: And when he was come into his house , he took a knife , and laid hold on his concubine , and divided her , together with her bones , into twelve pieces , and sent her into all the coasts of Israel .
translation.kha: Ynda u la poi , u rung shapoh ïing bad u shim kawei ka tari . U shim ïa ka met ka tnga kliar jong u , u ot ïa ka khat-ar lyngkhot , bad u phah ïa kawei ka lyngkhot sha kawei pa kawei na ki khat-ar jait ki Israel .

translation.en: And all the congregation brought him without the camp , and stoned him with stones , and he died  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Nangta katto ngut na ki Pharisi napdeng paidbah ki la kren ïa U Jisu . Ko Nonghikai , ki la ong , hukum ïa ki synran jong ban sngap
translation.en: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him , Master , rebuke thy disciples .
Should a wise man utter vain knowledge , and fill his belly with the east wind ?
translation.kha: Ki ktien ba-thylli , ko Job ! Ki ktien ba-thylli !

translation.en: For by thee I have run through a troop : by my God have I leaped over a wall .
But he said ,  Yea rather , blessed are they that hear the word of God , and keep it .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Pynban , katno kaba kmen long kito kiba shahshkor ïa ka ktien jong U Blei bad kiba kohnguh ïa ka !
Nga U Trai , ju kylla . Bad kumta ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , phim shym la jah noh khoit
translation.en: For I am the  Lord  , I change not  ; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed .
For unclean spirits , crying with loud voice , came out of many that were possessed with them : and many taken with palsies , and that were lame , were healed .
translation.kha: Ki mynsiem bymman ki la mihnoh na kiba bun ki briew da kaba lynñiar jam , bad ïa kiba bun kiba pang ïapshiliang bad kiba dkoh la pynkhiah .

translation.en: There is one body , and one Spirit , even as ye are called in one hope of your calling ;
translation.kha: Don tang kawei ka met bad uwei U Mynsiem , kumba don tang kawei ka jingkyrmen sha kaba U Blei u la khot ïa phi .
Bad kumta nga ong ha phi baroh : ïa kaei kaba phi khang ha ka pyrthei yn khang ha bneng , bad kaei ïa kaba shah phi ha ka pyrthei yn shah ha bneng .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven : and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven .
And they mourned , and wept , and fasted until even , for Saul , and for Jonathan his son , and for the people of the  Lord  , and for the house of Israel  ; because they were fallen by the sword .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewsih kthang , ki ïambriew , bad ki la shahjingit haduh janmiet na ka bynta u Saul bad u Jonathan bad na ka bynta ki Israel , ki briew jong U  Trai  , namar bun bah ki la shah pynïap ha ka thma .

marpyrshah ki paid jingartatiend ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingrai jong u Solomon , ki la dap da eit jingñiewburom symboh ïa Kynmaw , namar ki tip hangta ba bamut Blei u la ai ha u ka jingstad ban pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia Synrum ka hok Shaalbim
translation.en: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged  ; and they feared the king : for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him , to do judgment .

translation.kha: ka long kaba shisha . Ïa pynkheiñ noh namar kim shym la ngeit , sah la ka jaka namar ba phi ngeit . Hynrei wat sngewsarong na ka bynta kata ; pynban , to sheptieng
translation.en: Well ; because of unbelief they were broken off , and thou standest by faith . Be not highminded , but fear :

translation.kha: Bad na dang , khynnah Me tip sngwthuh ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , kiba lah ban ai ha me ïa ka jingstad kaba ïalam ka sha jingpynim da ka jingngeit ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures , which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: Ka don ka jingmaïan kaba la pynpaw ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid , kaba nga sngewthuh kaba thew ïa U Khrist bad ïa ka . balang
translation.en: This is a great mystery : but I speak concerning Christ and the church .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong nga shah tian bishar ha khmat ki nongsynshar bad ki syiem , ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha ha bad ha ki Jentil .
translation.en: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake , for a testimony against them and the Gentiles .
We who are Jews by nature , and not sinners of the Gentiles ,
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , la kha ïa ngi kum ki Jiw bad ym kum  ki Jentil bapop  kumba la khot ïa ki .

translation.en: She openeth her mouth with wisdom  ; and in her tongue is the law of kindness .
translation.kha: Ka kren da ka jingstad kaba jai jai .

haduh ba kin da ïohkynti laiñ ka ri ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan ïa kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai Bigthana ki . Adadah ba u la pynïoh ïa ka jingshongshngain ïa ki jait Israel namsop , te phi lah ban wan phai pat bad shongsah hangne Kata ka ri jong Ngan ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan ïa kaba u Moses nongsaiñdur u shakri batylli Aphek , u la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Until the  Lord  have given your brethren rest , as he hath given you , and they also have possessed the land which the  Lord  your God giveth them : then ye shall return unto the land of your possession , and enjoy it , which Moses the  Lord s  servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising .

translation.kha: To ïasam lem ïa ki jingdon jong phi bad ki parabangeit kiba kyrduh bad , to pdiang sha sngewbha ki ïing jong phi ïa ki nongwei .
translation.en: Distributing to the necessity of saints ; given to hospitality .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u sngewlwait ïa u , Aïu ïasngewskhem bat ha la ka kti Shinab U Shiteng , u jubab .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , What is that in thine hand ? And he said , A rod .

translation.en: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel , I will search and take them out thence  ; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea , thence will I command the serpent , and he shall bite them :
And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me , then thou shalt help me : but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee , then I will come and help thee .
translation.kha: U Joab u ong ha u ,  Lada phi ïohi ba ki Syria ki jop ïa nga , wan bad ïarap ïa nga ; bad lada ki Ammon ki jop ïa phi , ngan leit bad ïarap ïa phi .
Kane ka long Mitylene hukum jong U Trai U Blei jong phi , uba :13 ïalam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ban Semar ha phi ïa ka Heleph Kanaan bad lip long U Blei jong nano .
translation.en: I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt , to give you the land of Canaan , and to be your God .
And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod s steward , and Susanna , and many others , which ministered unto him of their substance .

Hynrei ngan ym shah ba men ïohi ïa ka khmat nga jong , namar uno uno uba ïohi ïa ka un ym im shuh ,
translation.en: And he said , Thou canst not see my face : for there shall no man see me , and live .

translation.en: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden : and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen  ; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king .
Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan , that ye shall set up these stones , which I command you this day , in mount Ebal , and thou shalt plaster them with plaster .

translation.en: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars , and burned men s bones upon them , and returned to Jerusalem .
If I have withheld the poor from their desire , or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail  ;

kieng na ka bynta jong nga , ko parabangeit , lada nga dang bteng ban ïalap ba ka jingotsher ka long kaba donkam , balei jingpynim! ba nga dang shah pynshitom beiñ ? ksing kata :3 Jerikho jingshetkylla babha shisha , te ka jingïalap jong nga ïa ka diengphna U Khrist kan ym long daw jingeh ei ei .
translation.en: And I , brethren , if I yet preach circumcision , why do I yet suffer persecution ? then is the offence of the cross ceased .

And the  Lord  said unto Gideon , The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands , lest Israel vaunt themselves against me , saying , Mine own hand hath saved me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Gideon ,  Ki rangbah kiba me don , ki la bun eh ïa nga ban ai ha ki ka jingjop halor ki Midian . Ki lah ban pyrkhat ba ki la jop da lade hi , bad kumta kim ai burom ïa nga .

translation.en: And he said , For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand , that they may be a witness unto me , that I have digged this well .
translation.kha: U Abraham u jubab ,  To pdiang ïa kine ki hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot . Da kaba leh kumne , me kubur ba dei ma nga uba la tih ïa kane ka pukri .

translation.en: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings .
translation.kha: Ka la don ka jingïapait biang hapdeng ki briew namar kine ki ktien .
To leh ïa kiei kiei baroh khlem da ne khñium khlem ïania ,
translation.en: Do all things without murmurings and disputings :
But the judgment shall sit , and they shall take away his dominion , to consume and to destroy it unto the end .
translation.kha: Nangta ka ïingbishar ba kynja bneng kan shong bishar , kan knieh noh ïa ka bor jong u bad pynjot thiaw ïa u .
Me don borabor pynroh soi ngut Shakri nongsakhi pyrshah ïa nga ; ka jingbitar jong Khra-pait ïa ale pher nang jingïathiah julam jur ; me thaw ki lad thymmai ban ïaleh ïa nga .
translation.en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me , and increasest thine indignation upon me  ; changes and war are against me .

translation.kha: Ki syiem kim lah shah ïa ka jingsniew , namar jingbishar ka hok ka dei kaba pynlong ïa ka jingsynshar kaba khlaiñ .
translation.en: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness : for the throne is established by righteousness .

translation.kha: Ha u Lum Sinai , U Trai U Blei jong ngi la pynlong ka jutang ,
translation.en: The  Lord  our God made a covenant with us in Horeb .

translation.kha: hynrei ki la ïohi ïa u ba u ïaid halor ka um . Ka dei ka ! ki la pyrkhat , bad ki la lynñiar .
translation.en: But when they saw him walking upon the sea , they supposed it had been a spirit , and cried out :

translation.en: For Jesus himself testified , that a prophet hath no honour in his own country .

translation.kha: hato Bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Keilah kin aiti ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah jong nga ha u Saul ? u Dabid u kylli biang . Kin ai , U Trai u . jubab
translation.en: Then said David , Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul ? And the  Lord  said , They will deliver thee up .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la pynim ïa nga bad u la ai tynjuh ïa nga , ba nga la lah ban ïalap ïa ka jingbeiñ , bad ba Pynkhreh Jentil baroh kin siar ; U Blei synñia la pyllait ïa Lasha na ka jingïap .
translation.en: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me , and strengthened me ; that by me the preaching might be fully known , and that all the Gentiles might hear : and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion .
All these evil things come from within , and defile the man .

translation.en: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all , because I have you in my heart ; inasmuch as both in my bonds , and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel , ye all are partakers of my grace .
translation.kha: Phi long borabor ha ka dohnud jong nga ! Kumta ka long kaba dei ïa nga ban sngew kumba nga sngew shaphang jong phi . Namar phi baroh phi la ïoh bynta lem bad nga ha kane ka lad kaba U Blei u la ai ha nga , mynta haba nga don ha byndi bad ruh haba nga la long laitluid ban ïada ïa ka gospel bad ha kaba tei pynskhem ïa ka .

translation.en: And he took thereof in his hands , and went on eating , and came to his father and mother , and he gave them , and they did eat : but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion .

translation.en: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy .

translation.en: I am the vine , ye are the branches : He that abideth in me , and I in him , the same bringeth forth much fruit : for without me ye can do nothing .

translation.kha: Ki suri bad ki kin ïabam lang , ki kin bam phlang kumba bam ki , bad ki bseiñ ym long shuh . , u lum bakyntang jong nga yn ym don shuh jingma ne sniew
translation.en: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together , and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock : and dust shall be the serpent s meat . They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Ahas u shim kyrpang ïa ki kali rnong ba pyndonkam ha ka Templ bad weng ïa ki kiba don halor jong ki ; u shim ïa ka pipa rnong bynta ba shadien jong ki tylli ki masi dab , bad u buh ha u maw nongrim
translation.en: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases , and removed the laver from off them  ; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it , and put it upon a pavement of stones .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit nadien jong Eglon ryngkat bad ki briew jong ki bad lap ïa u hajan ka pung kaba heh ha Gibeon .
translation.en: Then they took all the men , and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon .
All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs , and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young , and under his shadow dwelt all great nations .
translation.kha: Baroh ki jait sim ki thaw skum ha ki tnat jong u ; ki mradkhlaw ki kha ïa la ki khun ha ki jingkah jong u ; ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei ki shong jahthait hapoh ka syrngiew jong u .

Hynrei shym tip skhem ïa kane : Lada phi pynïap Dagon nga jingkyang nongkhmih phi jingbam ki briew jong kane ka nongbah phin long kiba Selophehad rem ha kaba pynïap ïa u briew uba lui lui namar u dei U Trai uba la phah ïa nga ban ai ha phi ïa kane ka jingmaham .
translation.en: But know ye for certain , that if ye put me to death , ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves , and upon this city , and upon the inhabitants thereof : for of a truth the  Lord  hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears .
And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies : thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me : thou hast delivered me from the violent man .
