translation.en: And Manoah said unto his wife , We shall surely die , because we have seen God .
translation.kha: U Manoah u ong ha la ka tnga ,  Ngin sa ïap shisha , namar ba ngi la ïohi ïa U Blei !

translation.en: These are the commandments and the judgments , which the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki aiñ bad jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel lyngba u Moses ha ki pyntha ka Moab sha shiliang ka wah Jordan na Jerikho .

Kin shong ha ka ri nga ba la ai ha u shakri nga jong u Jakob , ri ka ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki shong ki sah . Kin shong junom hangta , bad kumta ruh ki khun jong ki bad baroh hiarpateng kiba na ki . U syiem uba kum u shakri jong nga , u Dabid un synshar halor jong ki . junom
translation.en: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant , wherein your fathers have dwelt  ; and they shall dwell therein , even they , and their children , and their children s children for ever : and my servant David shall be their prince for ever .

translation.kha: Ngi long ki nongshun jong Blei , u la pynlong ïa ngi ki paralok jong u ka jingïap U Khun jong u . Mynta ba ngi long ki paralok jong U Blei , katno tam ba pynim ïa ka jingim Khrist !
translation.en: For if , when we were enemies , we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son , much more , being reconciled , we shall be saved by his life .

translation.kha: Kumta jingpahuh Trai u bitar lep Mishael ki Israel , bad u shah ïa ki Philistia bad ki Ammon ban jop ïa ki .
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines , and into the hands of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: Wat ha shuwa ba ka por mynsaw ki kan wan , ki ïinglieng shah rong noh da ka jingshlei .
translation.en: Which were cut down out of time , whose foundation was overflown with a flood :

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet u angel jong U Trai u leit ka jaka sher dara ki Assyria bad u pynïap san hajar ki shipai . Dang step phyrngab ka sngi kaba bud , hangta ki la thiah lyngktar , baroh kiba la ïap !
translation.en: And it came to pass that night , that the angel of the  Lord  went out , and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand : and when they arose early in the morning , behold , they were all dead corpses .
And he sent forth a raven , which went forth to and fro , until the waters were dried up from off the earth .
translation.kha: Kam shym la wan phai , hynrei ka shu her kylleng kylleng haduh ba ka um kan da rngad .

translation.en: Without father , without mother , without descent , having neither beginning of days , nor end of life  ; but made like unto the Son of God  ; abideth a priest continually .
translation.kha: Ym shym la don jingthoh shaphang u kpa lane ka kmie lane jong kino kino ki kpa tymmen jong u Melkhisedek ; ym shym la don jingthoh shaphang ka jingkha lane ka jingïap jong u . U syriem ïa U Khun U Blei , u ïaisah u lyngdoh junom .

translation.en: Ye shall buy meat of them for money , that ye may eat  ; and ye shall also buy water of them for money , that ye may drink .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbam bad ka um phi lah ban thied na ki .’

translation.en: And charged them that they should not make him known :
translation.kha: bad u la ai hukum ïa ki ban ym ïathuh ha kiwei pat shaphang jong u .

translation.en: About whom , when I was at Jerusalem , the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me , desiring to have judgment against him .
translation.kha: bad haba nga la leit sha Jerusalem , ki rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw lem bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wanrah ïa ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u bad ki la kyrpad ïa nga ban rai pynrem ïa u .

Ka nang jingdoh nang ngam ha ka pynshoh bajakhlia jong ka . Ka ïapmat ïa ki durbriew piam ki rangbah Amon ka Babilonia ba la ohdur ha ka kynroh bad ibhabriew la airong da ka rong saw baphyrnai , lem manna Kynrad panpoh ha ki syngkai jong ki bad ki jaiñspong ba-itynnat Mahanaim ki khlieh jong Seleukia .
translation.en: Girded with girdles upon their loins , exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads , all of them princes to look to , after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea , the land of their nativity :

translation.kha: U Jakob u la mihnoh na Beersheba bad u leit shaphang Haran .
translation.en: And Jacob went out from Beer–sheba , and went toward Haran .
Deliver me in thy righteousness , and cause me to escape : incline thine ear unto me , and save me .
translation.kha: Namar me long uba hok , to ïarap ïa nga bad to pyllait ïa nga . To shahshkor ïa nga , bad to pynim ïa nga !

Kumta wat la nga la thoh ïa kato ka shithi , ka la ym namar jong uba la leh bymdei lane na ka uta uba shah leh . Pynban , nga la ka khnang pynshai ha , ha khmat jong U , ka long da kaba jylliew ka jong phi sha ngi .
translation.en: Wherefore , though I wrote unto you , I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong , nor for his cause that suffered wrong , but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you .

translation.kha: Ngan tei ïa ki kut ïa-ithuh pha da ki maw Rubi , ïa ki khyrdop jong pha mo ki maw kiba rhem kum ka ding , bad ki sliew sawdong jingbei pha da ki mawlynnai .
translation.en: And I will make thy windows of agates , and thy gates of carbuncles , and all thy borders of pleasant stones .
And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends , of wreathen work of pure gold .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ki kynjri kiba da ka ksiar nylla ba la jyrthiaw kum u tyllai na ka bynta kata ka jingdeng shadem .

translation.en: The  Lord  preserveth the strangers  ; he relieveth the fatherless and widow : but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down .
translation.kha: U ïada ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah ha ka ri jong ngi ; u ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei bad ki khunswet , hynrei u leit lam ïa ki bymman sha ka jingjot jong ki .

translation.en: He said unto him ,  What is written in the law ? how readest thou ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Aïu ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ? Kumno me batai ïa ki ?

translation.en: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh ; but he of the freewoman was by promise .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  khun jong u , uba na ka kynthei mraw la kha katba kum ka rukom briew ; hynrei ïa u khun jong u na ka kynthei kaba laitluid la kha ha ka jingkular U Blei .
U ïohsngew iwkhong ngi Elisheba ba ngi kyrpad ïa u ; bad namar pynlehnoh-ei ngi tip ba kane ka long kaba shisha , ngi tip ruh jingsuk! Malkhijah ai Bikri ngi ïa kaei kaba ngi kyrpad na Gamad .
translation.en: And if we know that he hear us , whatsoever we ask , we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him .

translation.kha: U phai sha uwei pat u jinglamler bad u Haggai ïa u ïa kajuh ka jingkylli , bad man ba u ïatan , u Anna ïa kajuh Lus jubab .
translation.en: And he turned from him toward another , and spake after the same manner : and the people answered him again after the former manner .
Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed , that could deliver his people out of mine hand , that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand ?
translation.kha: Mynno napdeng ki blei jong kito ki ri baroh , kiba lah ban pyllait ïa la ka ri na ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U Blei jong phi un pynim ïa phi ?

translation.en: Was not Abraham our father justified by works , when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar ?
translation.kha: Kumno u Abraham , u kpa tymmen jong phi u la long uba la pynksan da U Blei ? Ka la long namar ki kam ki jong u , mynba u la aiti ïa u Isaak u khun jong u ha ka duwan .

translation.en: Yet because this widow troubleth me , I will avenge her , lest by her continual coming she weary me .
translation.kha: pynban na ka bynta ka jingpynjynjar baroh ba kane ka riewkynthei ka ai ha nga , ngan khmih ïa kata ba kan ïoh ïa ki hok jong ka . Lada ngam leh kumta , kan ïai wan bad khatduh kan pynlwait ïa nga !’
Baroh kiba kwah ban ïa ka jingim bariewblei U Khrist Jisu kin shah pynshitom ;
translation.en: Yea , and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution .

And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah , the son of Koz . And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah , the son of Meshezabeel . And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baanah .
translation.kha: U Meremoth , u khun jong u Uriah bad u ksiew jong u Hakkos u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah bad u ksiew jong u Meshesabel u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Sadok , u khun jong u Baana u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
Ka Israel kan long kaba khlem ka Damaskos kan noh ïa ka jinglaitluid jong ka . Kito ki nong Syria kiba lait im kin don ka jinglehrain kum ki briew jong Israel . Nga , U Trai Baroh nga la kren .
translation.en: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim , and the kingdom from Damascus , and the remnant of Syria : they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
And the Lord said unto him ,  Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter  ; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness .
translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la ong ha u ,  Mynta te , phi ki Pharisi phi pynkhuid ïa kaba shabar jong ka khuri bad ka pliang jong phi , hynrei hapoh , phi dap da ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingsniew .

translation.en: And the drinking was according to the law  ; none did compel : for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house , that they should do according to every man s pleasure .
translation.kha: Ym don jingbuh pud ïa ka jingdih waiñ ; u syiem u la ai hukum ïa ki shakri ka ïingsyiem ba baroh ki lah ban dih katba ki sngewkwah .
Ka jingim jong u mynta ka ban sdang leit noh sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translation.en: Yea , his soul draweth near unto the grave , and his life to the destroyers .
Behold , we are servants this day , and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof , behold , we are servants in it :
translation.kha: Bad mynta ngi long ki mraw ha ka ri ba me la ai ïa ngi , kane ka ri baseisoh kaba ai jingbam ïa ngi .
Ko khun u briew , ngan phah ïa me sha ki Israel . Ki la ïaleh pyrshah ki phai lyndet ïa nga bad ki dang ïai pyrshah hi , kpa tymmen , ki la long .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , I send thee to the children of Israel , to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me : they and their fathers have transgressed against me , even unto this very day .

translation.kha: ba-eh katne ngut ki briew ki la mem ha u ïa u briew uba kyllut bad u bymnang kren , bad ki la kyrpad Nikolas U poi-pyrkhat ban imon ïa ki kti jong U halor jong mynshuwa .
translation.en: And they bring unto him one that was deaf , and had an impediment in his speech  ; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him .

translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng Suph Lasaros , uba sah ha lak , u la pang . Ka Bethania ka dei syngkai shnong ha kaba ka bymkut bad ka Martha ka para jong jingda , ki shong jingphyrnai sah jingsuk!
translation.en: Now a certain man was sick , named Lazarus , of Bethany , the town of Mary and her sister Martha .

translation.kha: ki san ngut ki nongsyntiat ki rung beit shapoh ïing bad ki shim ïa kata ka ba bleithaw la suit da ka rupa , kiwei pat ruh ki bleithaw , ïa bad ka ephod , katba u u lyngdoh dang ïeng ha ka khyrdop bad ki hynriewspah ngut ki kiba rangbah la kieng atiar .
translation.en: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up , and came in thither , and took the graven image , and the ephod , and the teraphim , and the molten image : and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war .
Lo , all these things worketh God oftentimes with man ,
translation.kha: U Blei u leh ïa kane baroh na kawei ka por sha kawei pat ;

jingtasngeng kumta keiñ ka khyndew jong u Ephron nongpang ha Makhpelah kun Geliloth don shaphang mihngi pah myntri , ka kylla long lyngkhuh jong u Abraham . Ka kynthup ïa kieng lyngkha , ïa ka krem kynsit don hangta , bad ïa ki dieng baroh kiba don hapoh ki pud jong ka .
translation.en: And the field of Ephron , which was in Machpelah , which was before Mamre , the field , and the cave which was therein , and all the trees that were in the field , that were in all the borders round about , were made sure

translation.kha: Ki la ong ha u syiem Nebukhadnessar , Ai ba u Syiem im junom
translation.en: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar , O king , live for ever .

translation.kha: Ha u , u khun bashisha jong ha ka jingngeit To Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi un ai ha me ïa ka jingaiei , ka jingisynei bad ka .
translation.en: Unto Timothy , my own son in the faith : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord .
For his eyes are upon the ways of man , and he seeth all his goings .
translation.kha: U peit-thuh ïa ki sien jam ba ki briew ki jam .
U bam ïa jingkñia ki kiba la ainguh ha ki jaka mane ba la mana bad u khroh pynbieit ïa ki tnga jong kiwei ki pat rangbah .
translation.en: And that doeth not any of those duties , but even hath eaten upon the mountains , and defiled his neighbour s wife ,

translation.kha: Ot noh ïa khleiñ ka jong u uta langbrot , ïa u tdong jong u , ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki nierlang , ïa ka kaba sbiar haneng u dohnud , ïa ki baroh khyllai ar lem bad ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad ïa ka lbong kamon .
translation.en: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump , and the fat that covereth the inwards , and the caul above the liver , and the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them , and the right shoulder  ; for it is a ram of consecration :
And it came to pass after many days , that the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , go to Euphrates , and take the girdle from thence , which I commanded thee to hide there .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban leit pat sha ka Ïuphratis bad shim ïa ki patlun lyngkot .
U Jisu u la ong ha Aner , Nga la leh shibun ki kam babha ha khmat tah phi Serahaïah kiba U Kpa u la pynshongkurim ïa nga ban leh ; Hapdeng na kine ba phi kwah ban Bathymmai maw ïa nga ?
translation.en: Jesus answered them ,  Many good works have I shewed you from my Father  ; for which of those works do ye stone me ?

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba u khynnah un heh un san ban ong ‘ Mei’ bad ‘ , ïa ka spah jong ka Damaskos bad ïa ka mar lute baroh jong ka Samaria yn kit u patsha ka Assyria
translation.en: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry , My father , and my mother , the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: bad ki la phah ïa kane ka shithi harum lyngba jong : ki Ma ngi , ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang , hynmen ki ki para jong phi , ngi phah ki jingkhublei ïa ki hynmen ki para jong ngi kiba la kha na ki Jentil shong kiba basah ha Antiokh , ha Syria ha bad Kilikia .
translation.en: And they wrote letters by them after this manner  ; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia :
Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers  ; yea , upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city :
translation.kha: bad ki bniap shiah bad ki shynraiñ ki mih ha ka ri ki briew jong nga . To ïam na ka bynta ki ïing baroh ha kaba ki briew ki la ju long kiba kmen bad ka nongbah kaba la ju dap da ka jingim .

translation.en: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the  Lord   ; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock s head , and kill the bullock before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Un wanlam ïa uta u masi sha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ , un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong u , bad un pynïap ïa u hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai .

U Moses u ïohsngew ba ki briew baroh ki ktang katba ki dang ïa-ïeng lymbung jynsur kynhun ha khmat jingkhang hano ki .—Sekharaiah jong ki . U Shisha sngewkhuslai namar ba U Trai bajew la “lada ïa ki ,
translation.en: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families , every man in the door of his tent : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled greatly  ; Moses also was displeased .
And when his disciples heard of it , they came and took up his corpse , and laid it in a tomb .
translation.kha: Haba ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki la ïohsngew shaphang kane , ki la wan bad shim noh ïa ka met jong u bad tep noh ïa ka .
Kaei ka kyrteng jong ? uta u briew u kylli . U Jakob , u jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto him , What is thy name ? And he said , Jacob .

translation.kha: un u nongpynkren lem jong me un kren ha u paidbah ka bynta jong me . Nangta me pat men long kum U Blei da kaba ïathuh ha u aïu un ong .
translation.en: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people : and he shall be , even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth , and thou shalt be to him instead of God .

translation.kha: U Trai u la khang ïa nga na ba-hajan Teh ïa phi . Hynrei nga smai da U Blei uba im jong ki Israel ba lymda phi la pynkloi ban ïashem bad nga , baroh ki briew jong u Nabal Arumah jin da la ïap lut kat ban da pynpait ka step !
translation.en: For in very deed , as the  Lord  God of Israel liveth , which hath kept me back from hurting thee , except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me , surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall .

translation.kha: sngewthait pyllait im ïa ki briew jong nga na ki ri sha kiba la shim noh ïa ki ,
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will save my people from the east country , and from the west country  ;
Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets , and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ïa ki samla shynrang yn pynïap ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah , bad ïa ki shipai jong ka baroh yn pynjot .

translation.en: And they took up Asahel , and buried him in the sepulchre of his father , which was in Beth–lehem . And Joab and his men went all night , and they came to Hebron at break of day .
translation.kha: U Joab bad ki rangbah jong u ki la shim ïa ka met jong u Asahel bad ki la tep ïa ka ha ka jingtep ka longïing jong u ha Bethlehem . Nangta ki la ïaid baroh shi miet , bad ha ka por kynjat shai ki la wan poi biang ha Hebron .
Shah ruh ki leh kumba la ong ; ki shim ar tylli ki masi kynthei bad ki teh Delilah briew ha kata ka kali tyndung pat ki set ïa ki khun masi ha Elath .
translation.en: And the men did so  ; and took two milch kine , and tied them to the cart , and shut up their calves at home :
The governor answered and said unto them , Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you ? They said , Barabbas .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Pilat u la kylli ïa u paidbah ,  Uno na kine ar ngut ba phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ?   Ïa u Barabbas !  ki la jubab .

translation.en: Satisfying answers to life’s big questions . —Proverbs 2 :1-5 .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ba sngewhun jong ki jingkylli ba kongsan shaphang ka jingim .—Proberb 2 :1-5 .

Haba ki kylli ïa me balei ba me ud , ïathuh ïa ki ba ka long na ka daw ka khubor kaba la ïohpdiang . Haba ka wan , ki dohnud jong ki kin dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki kti jong kin noh ka kyrwep , jong jingshlur ki kan duh , ki bad khohsiew ki jong kin kyiuh . Ka por ka la poi ; ka long hangne . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: And it shall be , when they say unto thee , Wherefore sighest thou ? that thou shalt answer , For the tidings  ; because it cometh : and every heart shall melt , and all hands shall be feeble , and every spirit shall faint , and all knees shall be weak as water : behold , it cometh , and shall be brought to pass , saith the Lord  God .
For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth , there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins ,
translation.kha: Naba yn ym don shuh kano kano ka jingkñia kaba lah ban kit noh ïa ki pop lada ngi ïai leh pop hadien ba ngi la tip ïa ka jingshisha .

translation.en: And he wrote in the letter , saying , Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle , and retire ye from him , that he may be smitten , and die .
translation.kha: U thoh :  Buh ïa u Uriah ha khmat duh , ha ka jaka kaba jur tam ka jingïaleh , nangta kynran dien noh bad ai ba un shah pynïap .

translation.en: The  Lord  reigneth , he is clothed with majesty  ; the  Lord  is clothed with strength , wherewith he hath girded himself : the world also is stablished , that it cannot be moved .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem . U kup da ka main longsyiem bad ka bor . Ïa ka pyrthei la pynskhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah ban pynkhih ïa ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field , in the wilderness wherein they chased them , and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword , until they were consumed , that all the Israelites returned unto Ai , and smote it with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u nongshun ha ka jaka bashrah ha kaba ki la beh ïa ki . Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha Ai bad ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba don hangta .
U ïathuh ïa ngi ba la lap ïa ki kada , Saul u u jubab — hynrei um shym ïathuh ha u kñi jong u ïa kaei kaba u Samuel u la shaphang kren ka Syiem jingpynlong ïa u .
translation.en: And Saul said unto his uncle , He told us plainly that the asses were found . But of the matter of the kingdom , whereof Samuel spake , he told him not .

translation.kha: U Joshua u la phah ïa ki paid Israel ha la ka lynti , salia uwei pa uwei u briew u Seba leit ban shim kynti ïa la ka bhah jong ka ri .
translation.en: And when Joshua had let the people go , the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land .

translation.kha: , ha ka sngi ba ka , ki dewlynnong ki khynñiuh , ki briew jong , ki kyndit kata ka jingpynjot .
translation.en: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall  ; yea , the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure .
But when we are judged , we are chastened of the Lord , that we should not be condemned with the world .
translation.kha: Hynrei la bishar bad la pynshitom ïa ngi da U Trai , khnang ba yn ym pynrem ïa ngi lem bad ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses , that the skin of Moses  face shone : and Moses put the veil upon his face again , until he went in to speak with him .
translation.kha: bad ki ïohi ba ka khmat jong u ka tyngshaiñ . Kumta u buh biang ïa kata ka jaiñtapkhmat haduh ba un da leit ïakren pat bad U  Trai .

translation.en: And he set the priests in their charges , and encouraged them to the service of the house of the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: U aiti ha ki lyngdoh ïa ki kamram kiba ki dei ban trei ha ka Templ bad u pynshlur ïa ki ban da lehbha ïa ki .

translation.en: To become a friend of God , you must obtain a good knowledge of Bible truth ( 1 Timothy 2 :3 , 4 ) , put faith in the things you have learned ( Hebrews 11 :6 ) , repent of your sins ( Acts 17 :30 , 31 ) , and turn around in your course of life .
translation.kha: Ban long u paralok jong U Blei , phi dei ban tip bha shaphang ka jingshisha jong ka Baibl ( 1 Timothi 2 :3 , 4 ) , ngeit ïa kiei kiei kiba phi la tip ( Hebru 11 :6 ) , kylla ka bamut na ki pop jong phi ( Kam 17 :30 , 31 ) , bad pynkylla noh ïa la ka rukom im .
U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka snam jong kata mrad ka , tah un ïa ka ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad un theh ïa kaba sah , ha trai duwan ka .
translation.en: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar .

translation.kha: U Blei bishar un ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ngi leh , la kaba bha ne kaba , sniew wat ïa kiei kiei kiba la leh ha kaba rieh .
translation.en: For God shall bring every work into judgment , with every secret thing , whether it be good , or whether it be evil .
How much more abominable and filthy is man , which drinketh iniquity like water ?
translation.kha: Bad ngi dih ïa ka jingbymman la kum ba ka dei ka um ; ho-oid , ngi long kiba bamsap ; ngim dondor ei ei .

translation.en: Two women shall be grinding at the mill  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
translation.kha: Ar ngut ki kynthei kin don ha ka jaka tylliat kpu : Ïa kawei yn shim noh , ïa kawei pat yn iehnoh shadien .

translation.en: But when the cattle were feeble , he put them not in : so the feebler were Laban s , and the stronger Jacob s .
translation.kha: Hynrei um shym buh ïa kita ki tnat dieng ha khmat ki jingri kiba kham tlot . Tang hapdeng khyndiat por u Laban u la ïoh ïa baroh ki jingri kiba tlot , bad u Jakob pat u ïoh baroh ki jingri kiba khlaiñ .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , I will multiply thy seed exceedingly , that it shall not be numbered for multitude .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Ngan ai ha pha bun ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki .
Thet ki kti .
translation.en: Wash your hands .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la u , Ai kan long kumta ïa mynta . Naba kumne keiñ ngin pyndep ïa kata baroh kaba U Blei u dawa . Kumta u Ïoannis u la mynjur
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Suffer it to be so now : for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness .  Then he suffered him .
They shall not drink wine with a song  ; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it .
translation.kha: Ym don shuh ka jingrwai bakmen ha ka por ba dih waiñ ; ym don basngewtynnat shuh ïa ka jingmad jong ka .

translation.en: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall  ; yea , the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha ka sngi ba ka kyllon noh , ki dewlynnong ki khynñiuh , bad ki briew jong ki , ki kyndit ha kata ka jingpynjot .

translation.en: There is one come out of thee , that imagineth evil against the  Lord  , a wicked counsellor .
translation.kha: Na pha , ko Ninebeh , la wan u briew uba dap da ki jingpyrkhat bymman , uba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

Kaei kaei baroh ba paid Israel ki ki leh naduh mynstep haduh da miet ka long ka bymmyntoi bad kaba . pynjot Ka jingshetkylla bad ki jingleh jubor ki nang jyllei hapdeng jong ki . Ki ïateh jutang bad ka Assyria , bad ki ïakhaïi bad ka Ijipt .
translation.en: Ephraim feedeth on wind , and followeth after the east wind : he daily increaseth lies and desolation  ; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians , and oil is carried into Egypt .

translation.kha: U Tom u kham bunkam pynshah ia nga .
translation.en: Tom was even busier than I was .
I called my servant , and he gave me no answer  ; I entreated him with my mouth .
translation.kha: Haba nga khot ïa u shakri , um jubab — wat la nga kyrpad ïa u ban ïarap ïa nga .
U Tom u heh ia nga tang khot lamwir leit
translation.en: Tom is a couple of years older than me , I think .

translation.kha: U Dabid u kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong U Trai bad leit u , kumba u Gad u la ong ïa u .
translation.en: And David went up at the saying of Gad , which he spake in the name of the  Lord .
But they shook off the dust of their feet against them , and came unto Iconium .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong ki ha ka jingpyrshah ïa ki bad ki la leit noh sha Ikoniom .

translation.en: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God , to blaspheme his name , and his tabernacle , and them that dwell in heaven .
translation.kha: U la sdang ban tim ïa U Blei , ïa ka kyrteng jong u , ïa ka jaka shong jong u , bad ïa kito baroh kiba shong ha bneng .

translation.en: And I came this day unto the well , and said , O  Lord  God of my master Abraham , if now thou do prosper my way which I go :
translation.kha: Haba nga la wan sha ka pukri mynta ka sngi , nga la duwai , ‘ A  Trai  , U Blei jong u kynrad jong nga u Abraham , sngewbha ai ka jingjop ha nga ha kaei ba nga leh .

translation.en: Hear counsel , and receive instruction , that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end .
translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor ïa ka jingai jingmut bad phi kloi ban shah hikai , ha kawei ka sngi phin long uba stad .
Trai Nongsynshar u wan ban synshar da ka , u da wallam ki briew ba la im .
translation.en: Behold , the Lord  God  will come with strong hand , and his arm shall rule for him : behold , his reward is with him , and his work before him .
God hath delivered me to the ungodly , and turned me over into the hands of the wicked .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ai noh ïa nga ha ki briew kiba sniew .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Surely I will be with thee , and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Me lah ban leh ïa ka namar ngan ïarap ïa me . Men pynlwet ïa ki Midian da kaba suk i kumba ki long tang uwei u briew .

translation.en: He riseth from supper , and laid aside his garments  ; and took a towel , and girded himself .
translation.kha: Kumta u la ïeng na ka miej bam , u la law noh ïa la ka jaiñkup , bad u la teh ïa ka jaiñ ñiad ha la ka syngkai .

translation.en: And many nations shall be joined to the  Lord  in that day , and shall be my people : and I will dwell in the midst of thee , and thou shalt know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto thee .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por shibun ki jaitbynriew kin wan sha U  Trai  bad long ki briew jong u . Un shong un sah hapdeng jong phi , bad phin tip ba u la lah phah ïa nga sha phi .

translation.en: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams , and go to my servant Job , and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering  ; and my servant Job shall pray for you : for him will I accept : lest I deal with you after your folly , in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right , like my servant Job .
translation.kha: Mynta shim hynñiew tylli ki masi lyngraw bad hynñiew tylli ki langbrot shynrang bad leit sha u Job bad ai ïa ki kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ïa lade . U Job un duwai na ka bynta jong me , bad ngan jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u bad ngan ym pynjahburom ïa me kumba ka dei hok ïa me . Mem shym la kren ïa ka jingshisha shaphang jong nga kumba u la leh .

translation.en: Another parable put he forth unto them , saying ,  The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed , which a man took , and sowed in his field :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki kawei pat ka pharshi .  Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew u shim ïa u symbai tyrso bad u bet ïa u hapoh ka lyngkha jong u .

translation.en: To whom will ye liken me , and make me equal , and compare me , that we may be like ?
translation.kha: Badno phin nujor ïa nga ?  ong U  Trai .  Hato don uno uno uba kum ma nga ?
U syiem u ong ruh ha u , Nga long u syiem — bad yn ym don uwei ruh ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei u ban leh ei khlem ei ka jingai jingbit jong . me
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I am Pharaoh , and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt .
But rejoice , inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ s sufferings  ; that , when his glory shall be revealed , ye may be glad also with exceeding joy .
translation.kha: Pynban to shadkmen ba phi ïoh bynta lem ha ki jingshahshitom u Khrist , khnang ba phi lah ban long kiba dap da ka jingkmen haba ïa ka burom jong u yn pynpaw .
Un kren ki kyntien ha phi kaba da ma phi bad baroh ka longïing phin ïohlait im .’
translation.en: Who shall tell thee words , whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved .
And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate : and they said one to another , Why sit we here until we die ?
translation.kha: Saw ngut ki rangbah kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh ki don shabar ki khyrdop jong ka Samaria , bad ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Balei ngin shu ap hangne haduh ba ngin da ïap ?
Ngan ïathuh ïa me kaei ka ban jia ïa ki khynnah kiba la ticket hangne bad ïa ki kmie ki kpa jong ki .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place , and concerning their mothers that bare them , and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land  ;
And God hath set some in the church , first apostles , secondarily prophets , thirdly teachers , after that miracles , then gifts of healings , helps , governments , diversities of tongues .
translation.kha: Ha ka balang , U Blei u la buh ïa baroh ha la ka bynta : Ha ka bynta banyngkong u buh ïa ki Apostol , ha ka bynta kaba ar ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kaba lai ïa ki nonghikai ; nangta ïa kito kiba leh ïa ki kambah , bud sa kito ha kiba la ai ïa ka bor ban pynkhiah lane ban ïarap ïa kiwei lane ban pyn-i lem lane ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher .

translation.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree  ; When his branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is nigh :
translation.kha: Ai ba u dieng Dumbur un hikai ïa phi . Haba ki tnat jong u ki jyrngam bad khie lung bad u sdang ban sei sla , phi tip ba ka lyiur ka la jan .

U Moses u ong ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u , Rah kane ïa ka doh sha ka khmat jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai , shet ïa ka , bad bam hangta ïa ka bad u kpu uba don ha ka shang ba la buh ïa ki jingainguh ka jingpynkyntang , kumba U Trai la hukum u .
translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons , Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation : and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations , as I commanded , saying , Aaron and his sons shall eat it .

translation.kha: Ki jingbishar jong u long shisha bad kiba hok ! la pynrem ïa ka kaba ïa ka da ki jong ka . U Blei la pynshitom ïa ka namar ba ka la pynïap ïa ki shakri jong .
translation.en: For true and righteous are his judgments : for he hath judged the great whore , which did corrupt the earth with her fornication , and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand .
But Elymas the sorcerer ( for so is his name by interpretation ) withstood them , seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki la pyrshah da u nongleh myntor uba kyrteng u Elumas ( kata ka long ka kyrteng jong u ha ka ktien Grik ) , uba la pyrshang ban pynphai noh ïa u lyngskor na ka jingngeit .

U leh pop pyrshah ïa U , Trai namar haduh ka sngi ka jingïap jong u , u bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u syiem Jeroboam u khun u jong Nebat , la uba ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop haduh ka sngi ka jingïap jong u .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  : he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord , let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord .
translation.kha: Sngewbha , ko kynrad , pdiang ïa kane ka jingai sngewbha kaba nga la wallam ïa phi , bad ai ïa ka ha ki briew jong phi .

translation.en: Declare ye among the nations , and publish , and set up a standard  ; publish , and conceal not : say , Babylon is taken , Bel is confounded , Merodach is broken in pieces  ; her idols are confounded , her images are broken in pieces .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ka khubor sha ki jaitbynriew ! Pynbna ïa ka ! Ai ka dak bad pynbna ïa ka khubor ! Wat buhrieh ïa ka ! Ka Babilon ka la kyllon ! U Marduk u blei jong ka u la khynñiuh ! Ïa ki bleithaw jong Babilon la buh ha ka jinglehrain , ïa ki dur ba-ijli jong ka la pynlwet !
Ki ïingjaiñ jong ki nongpynïaid ki Seba kiba itynnat , Kum ki dieng Tlai kiba ïeng laiñ .
translation.en: How goodly are thy tents , O Jacob , and thy tabernacles , O Israel !
Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land , and went up to Samaria , and besieged it three years .
translation.kha: Nangta u Shalmaneser u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel bad u kerkut ïa ka Samaria . Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingshah kerkut ,

Lada Pethor Ishbi na ka jait Gad bad ka jait shongneh ki jam sha shiliang ka Jordan kiba la kloi baseisoh ïaleh thma ha ka hukum jong U Trai bad lada da nongleh-ieit jingïarap jong ki phi Elmadam ban jop ïadep ka ri , te ai ha ki ïa ka ri Sawphew kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: And Moses said unto them , If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan , every man armed to battle , before the  Lord  , and the land shall be subdued before you  ; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession :
But if ye will not hear these words , I swear by myself , saith the  Lord  , that this house shall become a desolation .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , te nga smai ha phi ba kane ka ïingsyiem kan ngat ha ki jingjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

Kumta u Saul u riam pher lade da kaba phong kiwei pat jaiñ , bad ynda la dum ma bad ar ki jong u ki leit sha kata ka kynthei . Wad jingtip na ki na ka bynta jong nga bad to ïa nga kaei ka ban sa jia , u ong ha ka . Khot ïa uta u mynsiem jong uta u uba nga khot kyrteng .
translation.en: And Saul disguised himself , and put on other raiment , and he went , and two men with him , and they came to the woman by night : and he said , I pray thee , divine unto me by the familiar spirit , and bring me him up , whom I shall name unto thee .
Now it came to pass on a certain day , that he went into a ship with his disciples : and he said unto them ,  Let us go over unto the other side of the lake .  And they launched forth .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng lem bad ki synran jong u bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ïa ngin leit sha shiliang sha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw .  Kumta ki la ïaleit .
Ko ki paid ka Jerusalem , leit shabar ka bad shna ka lynti ka u paidlang u ban wan ! Pynkhreh ïa ka lynti bah ; da pynkhuid ïa ki kiba don ha ka ! ïa ka lama khnang ba ki jaitbynriew tip .
translation.en: Go through , go through the gates  ; prepare ye the way of the people  ; cast up , cast up the highway  ; gather out the stones  ; lift up a standard for the people .

translation.kha: Ynda phi la ïa kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei phi u ai ha phi bad la shong la sah hangta ,
translation.en: And it shall be , when thou art come in unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance , and possessest it , and dwellest therein  ;
He that walketh with wise men shall be wise : but a companion of fools shall be destroyed .
translation.kha: Ïalang paralok bad uba stad bad phin kylla stad . Lada phi ïalang paralok bad ki briew kiba bieit , phin long kiba bieit .

Mynta bahynñiew ka long Amon bha ban don kum kata ka jingsngewtynnat kaba khraw lada ka jingthmu ka bato kaba bha — kane ka long kaba shisha borabor , bad ym Adonijah tang haba nga 236 ryngkat bad phi .
translation.en: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing , and not only when I am present with you .

translation.kha: Ym mano mano u ban pharep ïa u briew uba sniew lane kylliang u na ka bynta baroh kaba u la leh .
translation.en: Who shall declare his way to his face ? and who shall repay him what he hath done ?

translation.kha: Hato me lah ban pyrta hukum ïa lyoh ki bad pynlong ïa ki ban pynjhieh ïa me da u slap ?
translation.en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds , that abundance of waters may cover thee ?

And Ittai answered the king , and said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as my lord the king liveth , surely in what place my lord the king shall be , whether in death or life , even there also will thy servant be .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Ittai u jubab ,  Ko Syiem kynrad , nga smai ha phi ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba ngan ïai leit bad phi kat shaba phi leit , wat la ka dei ban ïap .
Lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , ïaineh phin ha ka jingieit jong nga kumba , nga la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Kpa jong nga bad nga ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong u .
translation.en: If ye keep my commandments , ye shall abide in my love  ; even as I have kept my Father s commandments , and abide in his love .

translation.kha: Ngi 19 sngew jingtem la shynriah pynrem ïa ngi ban Jingïakajia . Hynrei kane ka la jia khnang ba ngi dei ban syngkien , ym ha ngi hi , hynrei lanot Jattir U Pynkylla keiñ , uba pynmihpat ïa kiba ïap .
translation.en: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves , that we should not trust in ourselves , but in God which raiseth the dead :

translation.kha: Nangta ong ka , Nga kular ïa pha da U Trai uba im uba la pyllait im ïa nga na ki jingjynjar baroh
translation.en: And the king sware , and said , As the  Lord  liveth , that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress ,
Then the Amalekites came down , and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill , and smote them , and discomfited them , even unto Hormah .
translation.kha: Te ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan kiba shong hangta ki wan tur ïaleh bad ki la jop ïa ki , bad ki beh krad ïa ki haduh Hormah .

Ngam shym kren shaphang jong phi baroh ; nga ïa tip kito kiba nga la jied . Hynrei ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka dei ban urlong shisha kaba , ong , ‘ U briew uba la ïabam lang ïa jingbam ka jong nga u phai pyrshah ïa nga .’
translation.en: I speak not of you all : I know whom I have chosen : but that the scripture may be fulfilled , He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me .

translation.kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la sngap jar katba dang ki sngap ïa jingïathuh ka jong u Barnabas bad u Paul ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla baroh kiba U Blei u la leh lyngba jong ki hapdeng ki . Jentil
translation.en: Then all the multitude kept silence , and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul , declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them .

translation.kha: Wat mane ïa uwei pat u blei tang hynrei ïa nga .
translation.en: Thou shalt have no other gods before me .

translation.kha: U kew te um shym julor , namar mawtylliat u ih uto hadien .
translation.en: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten : for they were not grown up .
And ye shall do as I have done : ye shall not cover your lips , nor eat the bread of men .
translation.kha: Nangta phan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh . Phan ym tap ïa la ki khmat lane bam ïa ka jingbam kaba ki nongïam pangnud ki bam .
Baroh ki kynthei kiba nang ban thir ki wallam ïa u ksai linen uba ni , bad ïa u saiwul uba jngum , uba bad sawbthuh , uba rong saw .
translation.en: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands , and brought that which they had spun , both of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine linen .

translation.kha: Ki jingbuh jingthoh ïa baroh ki jong Issakhar ki don phraphew hynñiew hajar ngut rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .
translation.en: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might , reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand .
And when the time of the fruit drew near , he sent his servants to the husbandmen , that they might receive the fruits of it .
translation.kha: Haba ka por ka la poi ban lumlang ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa ki mraw jong u sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bhah jong u na ka jingkheit .
Kiei kiei kiba ïathuhlypa mynta ki jia shisha . Mynta ngan ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai wat shuwa ba kin jia .
translation.en: Behold , the former things are come to pass , and new things do I declare : before they spring forth I tell you of them .
The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous , and the transgressor for the upright .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki wallam ha lade ka jingjynjar ïa kaba ki pyrshang ban pynjia ha ki briew kiba bha .
Ki paid Israel ki la jop ki syiem jong kine ki nongbah : ka Jerikho , ka ( hajan Bethel ,
translation.en: The king of Jericho , one  ; the king of Ai , which is beside Beth–el , one  ;

translation.kha: To bret noh ïa baroh ka jingkthang mynsiem , ka jingkwah brai bad ka jingbitar . Keiñ noh ka jingkaw kaw , lane ka jingkrenbeiñ bad keiñ ki noh jingsngew isih la ha kano kano rukom ka .
translation.en: Let all bitterness , and wrath , and anger , and clamour , and evil speaking , be put away from you , with all malice :

translation.kha: Pyndonkam ïa ka , ban pynsleh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon ryngkat jong nga , ïa ka Synduk Jutang ka ,
translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith , and the ark of the testimony ,
But unto them that are contentious , and do not obey the truth , but obey unrighteousness , indignation and wrath ,
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kiba khwan myntoi bad kiba kyntait ïa kaei kaba dei , khnang ban bud ïa kaei ka bym dei ; halor jong ki U Blei un theh noh ïa la ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla .
bad ong ha u Samuel , To ïai duwai ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi ban pyllait im ïa ngi ki na Philistia .
translation.en: And the children of Israel said to Samuel , Cease not to cry unto the  Lord  our God for us , that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines .
Who appeared in glory , and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: kiba la paw ha ka burom ba kynja bneng bad ki la ïakren bad U Jisu shaphang ka rukom ha kaba shen un sa pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong U Blei da kaba ïap ha Jerusalem .
Hamar kane ka por u Syiem Herod u la sdang ban pynshitom beiñ ïa ki katto katne ki ngut dkhot jong ka balang .
translation.en: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church .

translation.kha: U syiem Kiei la ong , To ïaroh ïa U jingkyrmen jong u Shadrakh , basanphew kata , bad u Abednego ! U la phah ïa u angel jong u bad pyllait jingpli ïa kine ki rangbah kiba la shakri bad shaniah ha u . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa Phong hukum jong nga bad ki la kheiñduh ïa la nongpang jingim khlur-kba ïa kaba dem ngon bad mane ïa uno uno u blei lait tang u jong ki hi .
translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake , and said , Blessed be the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , who hath sent his angel , and delivered his servants that trusted in him , and have changed the king s word , and yielded their bodies , that they might not serve nor worship any god , except their own God .

And Araunah said , Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant ? And David said , To buy the threshingfloor of thee , to build an altar unto the  Lord  , that the plague may be stayed from the people .
translation.kha: bad u kylli ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi wan shane ?  U Dabid u jubab ,  Ban thied ïa ka jaka shoh kew jong phi bad ban tei ka duwan ïa U  Trai  , khnang ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingïapthem .

translation.en: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness  ; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach :
translation.kha: Suh ki patlun lyngkot kiba da ka jaiñ linen , kiba kot naduh syngkai haduh lbong , khnang ba kin ym thad burom ïa lade .

translation.en: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion , and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Ngan wan sha Jerusalem ban ïada ïa phi bad ban pynim ïa phi baroh kiba la phai noh na ki pop jong phi .
U pynap shipai ha ki nongbah ba la tei kut ka Judah , ha ki rudnong Judah , bad ha ki nongbah Shua u Asa u la jop ha ka ri ki Gallio .
translation.en: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah , and set garrisons in the land of Judah , and in the cities of Ephraim , which Asa his father had taken .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang don hangta , uwei u tymmen uba dang wan phai na lyngkha bad ïaid nangta ynda la janmiet . U dei uba na ri lum Ephraim , hynrei ha kata ka por u shong u sah ha Gibeah . ( Kiwei kiba shong hangta ki dei na ka jait Benjamin . )
Katba nang bun ki duwan ba ki paid Israel ki thaw ban pynkhuid ïa ki pop , katta nang bun ki ba ki ïoh ban leh pop .
translation.en: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin , altars shall be unto him to sin .

translation.kha: Ka jaka shong u Dabid ka thylli , hynrei u Saul um shym ei ei kata ka sngi namar u pyrkhat , Kaei re kaei ka la jia ïa , bad um shym uba bit kat kum ka jinglehniam .
translation.en: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day : for he thought , Something hath befallen him , he is not clean  ; surely he is not clean .

translation.kha: Kito ïabet barhem Jearim ïa ka nongbah ki pyrta , ki pyrta lang da ka rkhiang ! Ki lah ban ïohi da la ki jong ki khmat ïa ka jingwan Daberath U Trai sha Seïon !
translation.en: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice  ; with the voice together shall they sing : for they shall see eye to eye , when the  Lord  shall bring again Zion .

And Ornan said unto David , Take it to thee , and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes : lo , I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings , and the threshing instruments for wood , and the wheat for the meat offering  ; I give it all .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka , Syiem Kynrad ,  u Araunah u ong ,  bad leh ïa ka katba phi sngewbit . Hangne ki don ki masi dab ban thang kum ka jingainguh ha ka duwan , bad hangne ki don ki lyntang shoh kew ban pyndonkam kum ka diengthang , bad u kew ban ai kum ka jingainguh . Nga ai ïa ki baroh ha phi .
Kumta la ki ïaid beit lyngba ka Mysia bad ki la leit sha Troas .
translation.en: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas .

translation.kha: U ïasaid u long uba khraw bad uba dei eh ban ïaroh ; u long uba dei ban shah pyndonburom kham palat ïa ki blei baroh .
translation.en: For the  Lord  is great , and greatly to be praised : he is to be feared above all gods .
Some men s sins are open beforehand , going before to judgment ; and some men they follow after .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba ki pop jong ki , ki long kiba paw tyngkreiñ , bad ki pop jong ki , ki leit ha shuwa jong ki sha ka jingbishar ; hynrei ki pop jong kiwei pat ki paw kham hadien .
Lada u briew ïathiah shongkha kano kano ka , ma kata ka mrad ban shah .
translation.en: And if a man lie with a beast , he shall surely be put to death : and ye shall slay the beast .
Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat  ; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Uno uno u dkhot na ka longïing jong me uba ïap ha ka nongbah un shah bam ha ki ksew , bad uno uno uba ïap ha rudnong un shah bam ha ki pukni . Nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .’

translation.en: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam , who made Israel sin , but walked therein : and there remained the grove also in Samaria . )
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym la iehnoh ïa ki pop sha kiba u syiem Jeroboam u la ïalam ïa ki Israel , hynrei ki ïai leh ïa ki ; bad ka durblei Asherah ka dang ïaisah ha Samaria .

translation.en: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the  Lord  , nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek , therefore hath the  Lord  done this thing unto thee this day .
translation.kha: Namar ba mem shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , bad mem shym la pynjot thiaw ïa ki Amalek bad ïa baroh kat kaba ki don . Na kata ka daw U  Trai  u la leh kumne ïa me mynta .

translation.en: And he had thirty sons , and thirty daughters , whom he sent abroad , and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons . And he judged Israel seven years .
translation.kha: U don laiphew ngut ki khun shynrang bad laiphew ngut ki khun kynthei . U pynshongkurim ïa la ki khun kynthei shabar na ka kur ka jait , bad u wanrah pat laiphew ngut ki samla kynthei nabar ka kur ka jait la jong ba kin shongkurim bad ki khun shynrang jong u . U Ibsan u ïalam ïa ki Israel hynñiew snem ,
Pynban uno uno uba bam ki sohwaiñ kiba jew pynlong bniat u kin shyrkhei ; bad uwei uwei baroh un jong u .
translation.en: But every one shall die for his own iniquity : every man that eateth the sour grape , his teeth shall be set on edge .

translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh na ki nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei uba la tip ïa kane ka . Lada ki la tip ïa ka kin ym la sahnarphna ïa U ka .
translation.en: Which none of the princes of this world knew : for had they known it , they would not have crucified the Lord of glory .

translation.kha: Khreh la shai dang step , kiew ïa u Lum Sinai ban ïashem bad hangta ha kliar lum .
translation.en: And be ready in the morning , and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai , and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount .

translation.kha: To un kyrkhu ïa me ïa bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me u kumba la kyrkhu ïa u Abraham , bad ai ba men shim kynti ïa kane ka ri ha kaba me la shong la sah bad ïa kaba U Blei u ai la ha u Abraham !
translation.en: And give thee the blessing of Abraham , to thee , and to thy seed with thee  ; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger , which God gave unto Abraham .

translation.kha: Te u Paul u la khot ïa uwei na ki pynïaidkam rangbah u bad la ong ha u , Ïalam ïa une u samla sha u rangbah ai hukum , u don ei ei ban ïathuh ha u .
translation.en: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him , and said , Bring this young man unto the chief captain : for he hath a certain thing to tell him .

translation.kha: Balei tyngkhuh kylli na nga shaphang kaei kaba bha ? la jubab U Jisu lynti Don tang Uwei uba bha tyrpeng To sumar ïa ki hukum lada me kwah ban rung jingaimynsiem ka ïadat .
translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God : but if thou wilt enter into life , keep the commandments .
All things have I seen in the days of my vanity : there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness , and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong nga ka long ka bym don jingmut , hynrei ha ka nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh . Katto katne ki briew kiba bha ki lah ban ïap katba kiwei pat ki dang im wat haba ki long kiba sniew .

Ki rangbah synshar jong u ruh ki ai sngewbha ïa paidbah ki , ki lyngdoh , bad ki Lebi ba pyndonkam kin . Bad ki rangbah synshar ba dei peit ïa ka Templ — u Hilkaïah , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , Sekharaïah u , bad u Jehiel — ki ai ïa ki lyngdoh ar hajar hynriewspah tylli ki langbrot ki bad bad khunblang laispah tylli ki masi lyngraw na ka bynta ki jingkñia ha por ka ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translation.en: And his princes gave willingly unto the people , to the priests , and to the Levites : Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel , rulers of the house of God , gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle , and three hundred oxen .

translation.kha: Kin bam ïa ki jingri jingdup bad ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong phi , bad phin ïapthngan . Kin ym pynsah ei ei , ïa u , kew ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ki masi lane , ki langbrot ; phin bad ïap .
translation.en: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle , and the fruit of thy land , until thou be destroyed : which also shall not leave thee either corn , wine , or oil , or the increase of thy kine , or flocks of thy sheep , until he have destroyed thee .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew u la ong , phai khmat sha ki lum ka , Israel bad to ïa ai ka khubor jong nga ha ki .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward the mountains of Israel , and prophesy against them ,
And he said ,  Woe unto you also , ye lawyers ! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne , and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  A katno kaba shyrkhei ruh ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum ! Phi buh ki jingkit halor ki met jong ki briew , kiba eh ïa ka ban kit , hynrei phi hi phim kner wat kawei ka shympriah kti ban ïarap ïa ki ban kit ïa kita ki jingkit .

translation.en: And they went out at noon . But Ben–hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions , he and the kings , the thirty and two kings that helped him .
translation.kha: Ka jingtur ïaleh ka la sdang ha ka por shiteng sngi katba u Benhadad bad ki laiphew ar ngut kiba ïateh lok bad u ki dang ïadih buaid ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki .
jingpynkylla durblei wallam ïa u ha ki synran jong me , hynrei kim lah ban pynkhiah ïa u .
translation.en: And I brought him to thy disciples , and they could not cure him .

The God of Abraham , and of Isaac , and of Jacob , the God of our fathers , hath glorified his Son Jesus  ; whom ye delivered up , and denied him in the presence of Pilate , when he was determined to let him go .
translation.kha: U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak , bad jong u Jakob , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la ai ïa ka burom ba kynja blei ha U Jisu u shakri jong u . Hynrei phi la aiti ïa u ha ki bor synshar , bad phi la kyntait ïa u ha khmat u Pilat , wat hadien ba u Pilat u la rai ban pyllait noh ïa u .

translation.en: So the young man , even the young man the prophet , went to Ramoth–gilead .
translation.kha: Kumta u nongïathuhlypa samla u leit sha Ramoth ,

translation.en: But they cried , saying , Crucify him , crucify him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la pyrta biang ,  Sahnarphna ïa u ! Sahnarphna ïa u !

translation.en: So Ebed–melech took the men with him , and went into the house of the king under the treasury , and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags , and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ebedmelekh u la leit bad ki rangbah sha ka kamra buh jingbam ha ka ïingsyiem bad la ïoh katto katne ki jaiñphong ba la rim kiba u la pynhiar sha nga da ki tyllai .

translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that he turned aside to see , God called unto him out of the midst of the bush , and said , Moses , Moses . And he said , Here am I .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïohi ba u Moses u wan kham hajan , u khot ïa u napdeng kata ka  lawlynnong , bad u ong ,  Moses ! Moses !  U ruh u jubab ,  Oi ! Nga don hangne .
Nangta katba dang ïam kumta , u piam doh sa ïa hynmen jong u baroh ; kata , ki jong ki sa ïakren ïakhana bad u .
translation.en: Moreover he kissed all his brethren , and wept upon them : and after that his brethren talked with him .
The  Lord  made not this covenant with our fathers , but with us , even us , who are all of us here alive this day .
translation.kha: ym tang bad ki kpa jong ngi , hynrei bad ngi baroh ruh kiba dang im haduh mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings , the flesh and the blood , upon the altar of the  Lord  thy God : and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the  Lord  thy God , and thou shalt eat the flesh .
translation.kha: Kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang hangta ha ka duwan U  Trai . Kñia ruh ïa kita ki jingainguh na kiba phi bam ïa ka doh jong ki , bad theh ïa ka snam jong ki ha ka duwan .
Ki ïa-ong Ngim lah ban ai ïa ka jong ka para ba kan ïashongkurim bad u u bym shym la otsher ; kan long ka jingjahburom ngi .
translation.en: And they said unto them , We cannot do this thing , to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised  ; for that were a reproach unto us :

translation.kha: U Reson u phah ïa ki rangbah sha u Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , ijuh bad kane ka khubor : Nga long u shakri baïaineh Nadab phi . To wan bad pyllait im pynïakhlad nongkren na ki syiem ka Syria bad Israel tnat kiba wan tur ïaleh Sihon nga .
translation.en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , saying , I am thy servant and thy son : come up , and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria , and out of the hand of the king of Israel , which rise up against me .
And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed : and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka umphniang kaba dang sah ha ka sla ti un kyllan ha ka khlieh jong uta u briew . Kumne keiñ u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .

translation.en: And there shall be no night there  ; and they need no candle , neither light of the sun  ; for the Lord God giveth them light : and they shall reign for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Yn ym don shuh kano kano ka miet , bad kin ym donkam ïa ki sharak lane ïa ka jingshai ka sngi , namar U Trai uba U Blei un long ka jingshai jong ki bad kin synshar kum ki syiem junom la junom .
bad nangta bynrap u , Nga don ei ei ban kylli na phi . Kaei kata ? ka kylli .
translation.en: He said moreover , I have somewhat to say unto thee . And she said , Say on .
Let me win . But if I cannot win , let me be brave in the attempt .
translation.kha: Ai ngan jop . Hynrei lada ngam lah jop , ai ngan long shlur ha ka jingpyrshang .

translation.en: For Moses said , Honour thy father and thy mother  ; and , Whoso curseth father or mother , let him die the death :
translation.kha: Naba u Moses u la hukum , ‘ Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ,’ bad , ‘ uno uno uba tim ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie yn pynïap .’
Nangta , kumba U Trai u la hukum , nga buh ïa ki ha kata ka synduk nga ba la thaw — bad ki dang don hangta naduh ka kata por .
translation.en: And I turned myself and came down from the mount , and put the tables in the ark which I had made  ; and there they be , as the  Lord  commanded me .
And when he was alone , they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable .
translation.kha: Mynba U Jisu u don marwei , katto katne ngut na kito kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la wan sha u ryngkat bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad ki la kylli ïa u ban batai ïa ki pharshi .

translation.en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  Asaph and his brethren , to minister before the ark continually , as every day s work required :
translation.kha: U syiem Dabid u buh pynskhem ïa u Asaph bad ïa ki para Lebi ha ka kam kaba ïadei bad ka jingmane ba pynlong ha ka jaka ba la buh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang . La buh ïa ki ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki hangta man ka sngi .

translation.en: I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki riewdonburom ban kylla-kaba-mut , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .

Ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong ujuh u bnai , ki Israel ki ïalumlang ban shahjingit ñiuhtmoh pynpaw ka iar na ka bynta ki pop jong ki . Ki la lah pynïakhlad lalot khan Pynpait ki nongwei baroh Karkor Ki Pyrta ki jaiñ khain bad jingpynkylla pui pui ha ki khlieh jong ki kum ka dak jong ka jingsngewsih 236 Jingshisha ki ïeng bad durbriew tem phla ïa ki pop kiba Korban’ ki bad ki Dan tymmen jong Minni , ki la leh .
translation.en: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers , and stood and confessed their sins , and the iniquities of their fathers .
Thine eye shall not pity him , but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel , that it may go well with thee .
translation.kha: Wat leh-isynei ïa u . Rat noh na Israel kum ïa uta u nongpynïap briew , khnang ba phin manbha .

translation.en: But the Jews which believed not , moved with envy , took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort , and gathered a company , and set all the city on an uproar , and assaulted the house of Jason , and sought to bring them out to the people .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki la bishni bad ki la lumlang ïa ki riewkhñium bymsalia na ki lynti bad na u paidbah . Ki la pynkhihwin ïa ka shnong baroh kawei bad ki la tur ïa ka ïing jong u briew uba kyrteng u Jason , ha ka jingpyrshang ban lap ïa u Paul bad u Silas bad ban wallam ïa ki shabar sha u paidbah .

translation.en: And all the acts of his power and of his might , and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai , whereunto the king advanced him , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia ?
translation.kha: Ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba phylla kiba u la leh , kumjuh ruh ïa baroh ka jingïathuhkhana kumno ba u la pynkiew ïa u Mordekai sha ka kyrdan treikam kaba halor , la buh jingkynmaw ha ki jingthoh ba dei ïa ki syiem ka Persia bad Media .

translation.en: And the  Lord  came down in the pillar of the cloud , and stood in the door of the tabernacle , and called Aaron and Miriam : and they both came forth .
translation.kha: Ki la leit , bad U  Trai  u wan hiar ha u rishot lyoh , u la ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ bad u pyrta  Aaron ! Miriam !  Baroh ar ngut ki wan sha khmat ,
Nangta u Dabid u la pdiang ïa kaei kaba ka la wallam ïa bad u u ong ha ka , Khie leit phai noh sha bad ïing wat khuslai . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah .
translation.en: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him , and said unto her , Go up in peace to thine house  ; see , I have hearkened to thy voice , and have accepted thy person .

translation.kha: me ïohi ? U la . U diengpynïeng sharak ba la shna da ka ksiar , nga la jubab . Ha ka kliar ka don ka pliang na ka bynta ka umphniang . Halor u diengpynïeng sharak don hynñiew tylli ki sharak , kawei bad ki jaka na ka bynta ki hynñiew ki ksai sharak .
translation.en: And said unto me , What seest thou ? And I said , I have looked , and behold a candlestick all of gold , with a bowl upon the top of it , and his seven lamps thereon , and seven pipes to the seven lamps , which are upon the top thereof :

translation.kha: Lada U u khmih bha ïa me , hato un shem kano kano kaba bha ? Hato me pyrkhat ba me lah ban shukor ïa U Blei kumba me shukor ïa ki briew ?
translation.en: Is it good that he should search you out ? or as one man mocketh another , do ye so mock him ?
And his disciples came to him , and awoke him , saying , Lord , save us : we perish .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ïaleit sha u bad kyrsiew ïa u .  Pyllait im ïa ngi , A Trai !  ki la ong .  Ngin sa ïap !

translation.en: Have ye not cast out the priests of the  Lord  , the sons of Aaron , and the Levites , and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands ? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams , the same may be a priest of them that are no gods .
translation.kha: Phi beh noh shabar ïa ki lyngdoh ki jong U  Trai  , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron , bad phi beh noh ïa ki Lebi . Ha ka jaka jong ki phi la thung ïa ki lyngdoh ha kajuh ka rukom ba kiwei ki jaitbynriew ki leh . Uno uno uba wanrah lang bad u masi ne hynñiew tylli ki langbrot u lah ban ïoh pynkyntang kum u lyngdoh jong kito kiba shu khot ki blei jong phi .

translation.en: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle , twenty boards on the south side southward .
translation.kha: Thaw arphew tylli ki jingker ïa ka liang kaba shaphang shathie ,

translation.en: And they passed over Jordan , and pitched in Aroer , on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad , and toward Jazer :
translation.kha: Ki la jam ïa ka Jordan bad ki la sher dara ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Aroer , ka nongbah kaba don hapdeng jong ka them , ha ka ri ki Gad . Na kata ka jaka ki la leit shaphang shatei sha Jaser ;

translation.en: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words : and that which was written was upright , even words of truth .
translation.kha: U Stad saiñpyrkhat u la pyrshang ban shem ïa ki kyntien pyntngen , hynrei ki ktien kiba u thoh ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .
Wat ka jingïap bad ka jingkyrpad ki ong ba ki la jingot tang ki hamsaïa .
translation.en: Destruction and death say , We have heard the fame thereof with our ears .
And when he had sent them away , he departed into a mountain to pray .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la khublei ïakhlad ïa ki briew , u la leit noh sha u lum ban duwai .
Hynrei um buh ïa kita ki tnat dieng ha khmat ki jingri kiba kham tlot Tang hapdeng khyndiat por u Laban la ïa baroh jingri kiba tlot , u Jakob pat u ïoh baroh ki jingri khlaiñ .
translation.en: But when the cattle were feeble , he put them not in : so the feebler were Laban s , and the stronger Jacob s .

translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim Khusa Kpa khot kaba bha ïa kaba sniew bad Samson sniew ïa kaba bha . Phi “Soitan” ïa ka jingdum sha ka jingshai bad shahjop ka jingshai sha marjan jingdum . Phi pynlong kaba thiang ïa kaba kthang bad Hephsibah kthang ïa kaba thiang .
translation.en: Woe unto them that call evil good , and good evil  ; that put darkness for light , and light for darkness  ; that put bitter for sweet , and sweet for bitter !

And Abraham rose up early in the morning , and took bread , and a bottle of water , and gave it unto Hagar , putting it on her shoulder , and the child , and sent her away : and she departed , and wandered in the wilderness of Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Abraham u ai katto katne ka jingbam bad ka pla snieh ba-dap um ha ka Hagar . U pynbah ïa u khun ha ka met jong ka bad u la phah noh ïa ka . Ka la mihnoh bad ka ïaid sakma ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Beersheba .

translation.en: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel , which they offer unto the  Lord   ;
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban pyntngit ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh

Hynrei noh! nga ong ha phi : lada Arimathaïa uno u pynjuh u pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga , na ka Mid bymdonbor Jonathan batista sngewieit lait noh sngewdiaw ka jingbymïaineh jong ka , te u long uba la shah rem ha kaba pynlong ïa ka ban ïam lada meinah! riewthombor biang ; bad u briew uba shongkurim ïa ka , u ruh u klim .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That whosoever shall put away his wife , saving for the cause of fornication , causeth her to commit adultery : and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery .
And Peter answered and said to Jesus , Master , it is good for us to be here : and let us make three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias .
translation.kha: U Petros u la kren bad ong ïa U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai , katno ka long kaba bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Ngin thaw noh lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ , kawei ïa me , kawei ïa u Moses , bad kawei ïa u Elijah .

translation.en: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath , in the days of Jael , the highways were unoccupied , and the travellers walked through byways .
translation.kha: Ha ki sngi u Shamgar u khun jong u Anath , Ha ki sngi jong ka Jael , Ki kynhun nongkhaïi kim shym leit shuh lyngba ka ri , Bad ki nongleit jingleit ki pyndonkam ïa ki lynti na shadien .

translation.en: And he charged them , saying ,  Take heed , beware of the leaven of the Pharisees , and of the leaven of Herod .
translation.kha: Sumar bha ,  U Jisu u la maham ïa ki ,  bad sumar ïa lade na u thiat jong ki Pharisi bad u thiat jong u Herod .
