translation.kha: Pule ïa ka Baibl bad ngi .

translation.en: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window , and cried through the lattice , Why is his chariot so long in coming ? why tarry the wheels of his chariots ?
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u Sisera ka la khmih na ka jingkhangïit ; Ka la phngoid na shadien ka jingker .  Balei ka kali ïapom jong u ka slem ban wan ?  ka la ong .  Balei ki kulai jong u ki tud ban wan phai ?

translation.en: And Pharaoh s cup was in my hand : and I took the grapes , and pressed them into Pharaoh s cup , and I gave the cup into Pharaoh s hand .
translation.kha: Nga la bat ïa ka khuri jong u syiem ; kumta nga la shim ïa kita ki sohwaiñ bad nga khem ïa ki ha kata ka khuri , bad nga la ai ïa ka ha u .
u Agrippa jong u Joanan , u khun jong u Rhesa pynrieh u khun Jingpynkyllaktien u iam , u khun jong pynïasuk Khim , u khun jong pahara Neri ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Joanna , which was the son of Rhesa , which was the son of Zorobabel , which was the son of Salathiel , which was the son of Neri ,
But he answered and said , Verily I say unto you , I know you not .
translation.kha: ‘ Da lei lei ruh em ! ngam ithuh ïa phi ,’ u nongleitkurim u la jubab .

translation.en: Also , thou son of man , appoint thee two ways , that the sword of the king of Babylon may come : both twain shall come forth out of one land : and choose thou a place , choose it at the head of the way to the city .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  pruid dak ar tylli ki lynti na kiba u syiem ka Babilonia u lah ban wan lem bad la ka waitlam . Baroh ar tylli ki dei ban sdang na kajuh ka ri . Buh ïa ka dak jingkdew shano ba ki lynti ki ïakhlad .
jingsumar bakordor jingsuk jong phi ki long kum u ribon basawbthuh ; katno ki long kiba i-ieit haba Nikodemos kren . Ishbak ngab jong phi ki thaba napoh ka jaiñtapkhmat .
translation.en: I have put off my coat  ; how shall I put it on ? I have washed my feet  ; how shall I defile them ?

And David spake unto the  Lord  when he saw the angel that smote the people , and said , Lo , I have sinned , and I have done wickedly : but these sheep , what have they done ? let thine hand , I pray thee , be against me , and against my father s house .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïohi ïa u angel uba u pynïap ïa ki briew , bad u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Dei ma nga uba la leh pop . Nga dei uta uba la leh bakla . Kine ki briew bapli ki la leh aïu ? Me dei ban pynshitom ïa nga bad ïa ka longïing jong nga .
Ha ka hukum u ki um shalor jong ka suiñbneng ki kyrhuh ; u wallam ki lyoh na kiba jong ka pyrthei . U pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban ha u slap bad u phah ïa ka lyer na kamra buh tiar jong u .
translation.en: When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens , and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth  ; he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .

translation.kha: Pynban dei ma nga uba hikai ïa ki Israel ban ïaid . Nga la rah ïa ki briew jong nga la ha ki ksang ti , hynrei kim shym la pdiang ba la nga sumar ïa ki .
translation.en: I taught Ephraim also to go , taking them by their arms  ; but they knew not that I healed them .
O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments ! then had thy peace been as a river , and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea :
translation.kha: Tang lada phi la sngap ïa ki hukum jong nga ! Te ki jingkyrkhu kin jin da la tuid ha phi kum ka wahduid ka bym ju rngad ! Ka jingjop kan jin da la wan ha phi kum ki jingat phyllung kiba phaloh ha ka rud duriaw .
U kynrad u Joseph la bitar lep
translation.en: And it came to pass , when his master heard the words of his wife , which she spake unto him , saying , After this manner did thy servant to me  ; that his wrath was kindled .
In whose hand is the soul of every living thing , and the breath of all mankind .
translation.kha: Dei U Blei uba pynïaid ïa ka jingim jong ki jingthaw jong u ; ka jingim jong uwei pa uwei ka don hapoh ka bor jong u .

translation.en: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery , which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God , who created all things by Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: U Blei uba long u Nongthaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , u la buhrieh ïa ka jingmaïan ha ki pateng baroh kiba mynshuwa ,
U pyndeng ha u ïa ka jingdeng shadem , bad u buh ha ka ïa u Urim bad Thummim u .
translation.en: And he put the breastplate upon him : also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim .
Then came his disciples , and said unto him , Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended , after they heard this saying ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  Hato me tip ba la pynmong ïa ki jingsngew jong ki Pharisi da kaei kaba me la ong ?

translation.en: And Rebekah arose , and her damsels , and they rode upon the camels , and followed the man : and the servant took Rebekah , and went his way .
translation.kha: Te ka Rebekka bad ki kynthei samla jong ka ki la dep khreh bad kiew ban shong halor ki ut ban leit bad u shakri jong u Abraham , bad ki ïamih lang baroh .

translation.en: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth , and horror shall cover them  ; and shame shall be upon all faces , and baldness upon all their heads .
translation.kha: Kin kup da ka jaiñ khain bad kin kyiuh ha ki jaka baroh . Yn khi lyndum ïa ki khlieh jong ki , bad yn pynlehrain ïa ki baroh .
Ki nongshna da ki ki kti ïarap bad ki pynshlur uwei ïa uwei pat .
translation.en: They helped every one his neighbour  ; and every one said to his brother , Be of good courage .

translation.kha: Rom ( 6 :19 ; 12 :1 ; 2 Korinth 7 :1 ) Ka lah ban long kaba eh ban iehnoh ïa kine ki jingmlien .
translation.en: ( Romans 6 :19  ; 12 :1  ; 2 Corinthians 7 :1 ) It can be very hard to give up these habits .

translation.kha: U Jisu u tip la ba U Kpa u la ai ha u ïa ka bor baroh ; u la tip ba u la wan U na Blei bad ba un sa leit sha U Blei .
translation.en: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands , and that he was come from God , and went to God  ;

translation.kha: Halor tnum baroh ha bad baroh ki jaka paidbah ym don ei ei tang ka jingïam sngewsih , namar nga la ïa ka Moab kum u khra uba ym don shuh mano mano
translation.en: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab , and in the streets thereof : for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure , saith the  Lord .
And he spake that saying openly . And Peter took him , and began to rebuke him .
translation.kha: U la ong shai bha ïa kane ha ki . Kumta u Petros u la shim kyrpang ïa u bad u la sdang ban sneng ïa u .
Ki rangbah kiba kum met ki dei hok ban ïoh ïa ka jingithuh .
translation.en: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours : therefore acknowledge ye them that are such .
But it displeased Jonah exceedingly , and he was very angry .
translation.kha: U Jonah u la sngewsih haduh katta katta shaphang kane bad u la bitar .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will bring again the captivity of Jacob s tents , and have mercy on his dwellingplaces  ; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap , and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan buh pat ïa ki briew jong nga ha ka ri jong ki bad ngan isynei ïa kawei pa kawei ka longïing ; ïa ka Jerusalem yn tei pat , bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong ka yn pynbha pat .
Naba kiba haba la ïap kin mihpat , kin long kum ki angel ha bneng ba kin ym shongkurim shuh .
translation.en: For when they shall rise from the dead , they neither marry , nor are given in marriage  ; but are as the angels which are in heaven .
For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country : and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh ka pur kylleng ki rudnong , bad kham bun ki rangbah ki la ïap ha khlaw ban ïa kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma .
Ki don ki khun bad ki khun ksiew , bad ki im ban khmih ïa ki baroh ba ki heh san ki ;
translation.en: Their seed is established in their sight with them , and their offspring before their eyes .
Commit thy works unto the  Lord  , and thy thoughts shall be established .
translation.kha: Kyrpad na U  Trai  ban kyrkhu ïa ki jingthmu jong phi , bad phin ïoh jingjop ha kaba pyntreikam ïa ki .
Ko Kynrad , u Simon u jubab la ngi , la trei shitom baroh shi miet bad ngim shym ngat ei ei . Hynrei lada me ong kumta , ngan pynhiar ïa ki jar .
translation.en: And Simon answering said unto him , Master , we have toiled all the night , and have taken nothing : nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net .
And straightway they forsook their nets , and followed him .
translation.kha: Shisyndon ki la iehnoh ïa la ki jar bad ki la leit bad u .

translation.en: Behold , I will send a blast upon him , and he shall hear a rumour , and shall return to his own land  ; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynjia ïa u nongsynshar ban ïohsngew ïa ka hamsaïa ka ban pynlong ïa u ban leit phai pat sha la ka ri , bad U  Trai  un pynjia ba yn pynïap ïa u hangta .

Ngan pynshitom ïa me , ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me , bad ïa ki jaiñsem synshar jong me namar ki pop kiba ma phi shawkad phi Rekhab leh . Ma me shwa ki briew ka Jeshaïah bad Judah ki la sngap ïa ki jingmaham jong nga , bad kumta ngan wallam halor baroh ïa ka pynteh ïa kaba nga Nebukhadnessar dep kren pyrshah tyrwa
translation.en: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity  ; and I will bring upon them , and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and upon the men of Judah , all the evil that I have pronounced against them  ; but they hearkened not .
There is none to plead thy cause , that thou mayest be bound up : thou hast no healing medicines .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba sumar ïa phi , ym don jingïarap na ka bynta ki prum jong phi , ym don jingkyrmen ban koit na ka bynta jong phi .
Na ka jait u Kohath ki mih longïing ki jong u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .
translation.en: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle , and the tabernacle of the congregation , his covering , and the covering of the badgers  skins that is above upon it , and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation ,
And we beseech you , brethren , to know them which labour among you , and are over you in the Lord , and admonish you ;
translation.kha: Ngi kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong ngi , ban ai ka burom kaba dei biang ïa kito kiba la trei hapdeng jong phi , kiba la ïalam bad hikai ïa phi ha ka jingim kum kiba ngeit .
Namar kane balei na bun phi , phi pang bad phi swai , bad bun bah ki la ïap .
translation.en: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you , and many sleep .

And he brought Aaron s sons , and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear , and upon the thumbs of their right hands , and upon the great toes of their right feet : and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about .
translation.kha: Nangta u wanlam ïa ki khun shynrang u Aaron kham sha khmat bad u tah ïa kata ka snam ha ki shkor kamon jong ki , ha ki  tikmie ba sha kamon , bad ha ki  jatkmie ba sha kamon jong ki . Nangta u Moses u theh ïa ka snam kaba sah ha baroh sawdong ka duwan .

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto them ,  Be not afraid : go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee , and there shall they see me .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki .  Khie leit bad ïathuh ïa ki para jong nga ban leit sha Galilaïa bad hangta kin ïohi ïa nga .
Nangta nga la ïohsngew ba U u Blei , pyrta Wan hangne , phi ki briew kiba leit ban pynshitom ïa ka nongbah . Wallam ïa ki tiar ïaleh bad phi .
translation.en: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice , saying , Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near , even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand .

And I polluted them in their own gifts , in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb , that I might make them desolate , to the end that they might know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga shah ïa ki ban pyntngit ïa lade da ki jingainguh jong ki hi , bad nga shah ïa ki ban kñia ïa ki khun shynrang banyngkong jong ki . Kane ka la long ban pynshitom ïa ki bad pyn-i ha ki ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Heal the sick , cleanse the lepers , raise the dead , cast out devils : freely ye have received , freely give .
translation.kha: To pynkhiah ïa kiba pang , to pynim pat ïa kiba ïap , to pynkhiah ïa kito kiba shitom na ki jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad to beh noh ïa ki ksuid . Phi la ïohpdiang ei , kumta to ai ei .

translation.en: And Laban said , This heap is a witness between me and thee this day . Therefore was the name of it called Galeed  ;
translation.kha: U Laban u ong ha u Jakob ,  Kane ka kynton maw kan long ka jingpynkynmaw ïa ngi baroh ar ngut .  Namar kata , la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Galeed .
Ka long bieit ban krenbeiñ ïa kiwei buhai Lada phi baïong uba sngewthuh wahbah phin shu sngap jar jar .
translation.en: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour : but a man of understanding holdeth his peace .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab kloi Bad balei I phim kohnguh jingïaineh ka hukum jong borabor Blei bad phi ding-ai-dak ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai ?
translation.en: But he answered and said unto them ,  Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition ?

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , baroh ki paid don Israel kiba ha Moab , Ammon , Edom bad kiwei ha ki ri , ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la shah katto ki katne nong Israel ban ïaisah ha Judah bad ba u la pynlong ïa u Gedalaïah u lat jong ki .
translation.en: Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab , and among the Ammonites , and in Edom , and that were in all the countries , heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah , and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan  ;

translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha , te ba Khun U Briew don ka bor ha ka pyrthei ban map ki pop . Kumta la ong ha u briew ba ïapshiliang ,
translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins ,  ( he saith to the sick of the palsy , )
Yea , my reins shall rejoice , when thy lips speak right things .
translation.kha: Ngan sngewsarong haba ngan ïohsngew ba phi kren ïa ki ktien ka jingstad .
U Joash um shym pynmynsaw ïa kine ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ki Israel Elim ki pynjanai ïohi ïa U Blei Tel bad hadien kata ki la ïabam bad ïadih .
translation.en: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand : also they saw God , and did eat and drink .

translation.kha: U Nongthaw jong pha un long kum u tnga ïa pha — U Trai Badonbor Baroh long ka kyrteng jong u . U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel pynim un ïa pha — u long u nongsynshar jong ka pyrthei baroh .
translation.en: For thy Maker is thine husband  ; the  Lord  of hosts is his name  ; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel  ; The God of the whole earth shall he be called .
Praise ye the  Lord . O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ai ki jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong ka long bymjukut .

translation.en: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek : and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki lumlang ïa u paidïapom jong ki baroh ha Aphek , katba ki Israel ki sher dara harud ka pung kaba ha ka them Jesreel .

translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Festus , I would also hear the man myself . To morrow , said he , thou shalt hear him .
translation.kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Phestos ,  Nga kwah ban ïohsngew ïa une u briew da lade hi .   Phin ïohsngew ïa u lashai ka sngi ,  u Phestos u la jubab .
ba mem arliang ka sahit bneng bad wan hiar ? Ki lumbah kin ïohi ïa bad da jingsheptieng .
translation.en: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens , that thou wouldest come down , that the mountains might flow down at thy presence ,

translation.kha: Nangta to ki ba ma nga , Trai , ngan ïa ki briew jong nga na ki jaitbynriew sha kiba ki la leit , ngan lumlang ki na wanrah ïa ki sha ka jong ka ri .
translation.en: And say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen , whither they be gone , and will gather them on every side , and bring them into their own land :

translation.kha: U Trai ong , Ngan ïa ki jingpynjot kiba kine ha u bynriew ba uwei baroh un shane shatai bamatlah . Ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga bad ïa ka snam jong ki yn theh noh kum um , bad ki metïap ki kin pyut ha .
translation.en: And I will bring distress upon men , that they shall walk like blind men , because they have sinned against the  Lord  : and their blood shall be poured out as dust , and their flesh as the dung .
Do they not err that devise evil ? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingshaniah bad jingñiewkor na kiwei lada phi trei na ka bynta kaba bha ; lada phi trei na ka bynta kaba sniew , phi leh ïa kaba bakla .
Namar ka jingieit baneh jong me Kseh-Sypress to long uba bha ïa nga , khnang ba ngan lah ban kohnguh ïa jam aiñ jong ibieit .
translation.en: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness  ; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth .
And Miriam answered them , Sing ye to the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously  ; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .
translation.kha: Ka Miriam ka la rwai na ka bynta jong ki :  To rwai ha U  Trai namar ba u la jop ka jingjop badonburom ; u la bret ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshong jong ki sha ka duriaw .

translation.en: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island .
translation.kha: Hynrei yn sa ïalam ïa ngi sha rud duriaw ha kawei ka dewlynnong .

Nga kiew ïa uta u lum bakynsai pdiang Rebekka ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa jingbynta jutang ba U duma u la idei bad phi . Nga sah hangta sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , bad ngam shym la bam ne dih ei phalor .
translation.en: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone , even the tables of the covenant which the  Lord  made with you , then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights , I neither did eat bread nor drink water :
As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire  ; so shall it be in the end of this world .
translation.kha: Kumba ïa ki ñiut la lumlang bad la thang ïa ki hapoh ka ding , kumta kajuh hi kan jia ha kaba kut ka Ïa :
U Merari u ar ki shynrang , u Mahli bad Mushi . U Mahli ruh u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Eleasar bad ,
translation.en: The sons of Merari  ; Mahli , and Mushi . The sons of Mahli  ; Eleazar , and Kish .
Then the king called to Ziba , Saul s servant , and said unto him , I have given unto thy master s son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u phah khot ïa u Siba , u shakri jong u Saul , bad u ong ,  Nga ai ha u Mephibosheth , u ksiew jong u kynrad jong me , ïa baroh kaba dei ka jong u Saul bad ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: And he said , Well  ; I will make a league with thee : but one thing I require of thee , that is , Thou shalt not see my face , except thou first bring Michal Saul s daughter , when thou comest to see my face .
translation.kha: Ka biang !  u Dabid u jubab .  Ngan ïateh kular bad phi tang ha kawei ka kyndon : phi dei ban wallam ïa ka Mikhal ka khun jong u Saul sha nga haba phi wan ïakynduh ïa nga .
Ki la phai dien na nga ; bad wat la nga la ïai hikai ïa ki , kim shahshkor bad ïoh . jinghikai
translation.en: And they have turned unto me the back , and not the face : though I taught them , rising up early and teaching them , yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction .

translation.kha: Da kitkhia ba men thaw ïa ki kat kum ka dur ba nga la pyn-i ha me ha une u lum .
translation.en: And look that thou make them after their pattern , which was shewed thee in the mount .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada U Trai u leh ïa kaei kaei kaba pat ju ym ïohsngew , bad ba ka khyndew ka ang bad nguid ïa ki bad baroh ïa kat kaba ki don , ba kumta ki hap sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , te phin sa tip ba kine ki briew ki la kyntait ïa U . Trai
translation.en: But if the  Lord  make a new thing , and the earth open her mouth , and swallow them up , with all that appertain unto them , and they go down quick into the pit  ; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the  Lord .
And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian , which she had born unto Abraham , mocking .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , u Ishmael ïa uba ka Hagar ka nong Ijipt ka la kha na ka bynta u Abraham , u dang ïalehkai bad u Isaak , u khun jong ka Sarah .

translation.en: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron , and said , Go ye , sacrifice to your God in the land .
translation.kha: Te u Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u la ong ,  Khie leit bad ai jingkñia ha U Blei jong phi hangne ha kane ka ri .

translation.en: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive , and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: u la kem im ïa u Agag , u syiem Amalek bad u la pynïap ïa ki briew baroh .
Kumta pynjia Abigail uno uno uba nongrahbor ïa kine ki ktien jong nga bad uba kohnguh ïa ki khapngiah long kum u briew Nahalal stad uba la tei ïa pynjngai kyr-eit ïing jingpahuh u mawsiang .
translation.en: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them , I will liken him unto a wise man , which built his house upon a rock :

Wherefore , behold , I send unto you prophets , and wise men , and scribes : and some of them ye shall kill and crucify  ; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues , and persecute them from city to city :
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ba ngan phah ha phi ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bad ïa ki briew kiba stad bad ïa ki nonghikai ; phin pynïap katto katne ngut na ki , phin sahnarphna ïa kiwei pat , bad phin sympat ïa kiwei pat ha ki synagog bad beh ïa ki na kawei ka shnong sha kawei pat .

U Moses bad Aaron u ki kynriah noh na u uta paidbah bad ki ïeng la ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ . Ki dem khrup ha khyndew , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai ka la paw ha ki .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they fell upon their faces : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto them .
But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews , that they could not cause them to cease , till the matter came to Darius : and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u peit halor ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw , bad ki rangbah synshar ki Persia ki rai ban ym leh ei ei haduh ba kin da lah thoh sha u Darius bad ïoh ïa ka jubab .

translation.en: And preached , saying , There cometh one mightier than I after me , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose .
translation.kha: U la pynbna ha ki briew ,  U briew u ban wan hadien jong nga u long uba kham khraw ban ïa nga . Ngam long uba bit nam wat ban dem bad law ïa ki juti jong u .

translation.en: Unto me , who am less than the least of all saints , is this grace given , that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ ;
translation.kha: Nga long uba rit na kiba rit tam na ki briew jong U Blei baroh ; pynban , U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kabu ban ïalap sha ki Jentil ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka jingkynrei spah bymkut shuh jong U Khrist , bad ban pynlong ïa ki briew baroh ban ïohi kumno ba la pyntreikam ïa ka jingthmu bamaïan U Blei .

translation.en: Turn again , and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people , Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of David thy father , I have heard thy prayer , I have seen thy tears : behold , I will heal thee : on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the  Lord .

translation.en: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven  ; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee , and thou , and thy lords , thy wives , and thy concubines , have drunk wine in them  ; and thou hast praised the gods of silver , and gold , of brass , iron , wood , and stone , which see not , nor hear , nor know : and the God in whose hand thy breath is , and whose are all thy ways , hast thou not glorified :

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi banyngkong jong Jingkhawai Niam Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ki synran ki la wan sha U bad la kylli ïa u , Hangno me kwah ïa ban pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Jingkhawai Ka Jinglait na bynta jong me ?
translation.en: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus , saying unto him , Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover ?

translation.en: The  Lord  standeth up to plead , and standeth to judge the people .

translation.en: Therefore , thou son of man , prepare thee stuff for removing , and remove by day in their sight  ; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight : it may be they will consider , though they be a rebellious house .

translation.en: And knew not until the flood came , and took them all away  ; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .

translation.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub , and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , were the priests  ; and Seraiah was the scribe  ;

translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kane namar ki briew ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad ki la pyntngit ïa kane ka jaka da kaba ai jingkñia hangne sha kiwei pat ki blei — ki blei kiba ym ma ki lymne ki kpa tymmen jong ki lymne ki syiem jong ka Judah ki la tip ei ei . translation.en: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab : and he said unto the king of Moab , Let my father and my mother , I pray thee , come forth , and be with you , till I know what God will do for me .

translation.en: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him , and smote the waters , and said , Where is the  Lord  God of Elijah ? and when he also had smitten the waters , they parted hither and thither : and Elisha went over .

translation.en: For precept must be upon precept , precept upon precept  ; line upon line , line upon line  ; here a little , and there a little :

translation.en: If then God so clothe the grass , which is to day in the field , and to morrow is cast into the oven  ; how much more will he clothe you , O ye of little faith ?

translation.en: With him is strength and wisdom : the deceived and the deceiver are his .

bad ngi ruma tare kum ki briew kiba matlah . Ngi jynthut ha ka por shiteng sngi , la kumba mynmiet long , la kumba ngi don ha ka pyrthei kaba dum jong kiba ïap .
translation.en: We grope for the wall like the blind , and we grope as if we had no eyes : we stumble at noonday as in the night  ; we are in desolate places as dead men .

translation.en: And he cometh , and findeth them sleeping , and saith unto Peter ,  Simon , sleepest thou ? couldest not thou watch one hour ?

translation.en: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear : Fear him , which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell  ; yea , I say unto you , Fear him .

ka Hasar Shual , Beersheba ka , ka Bisiothaïah ,

translation.en: Divers weights are an abomination unto the  Lord   ; and a false balance is not good .

translation.en: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests , Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel  ; and thus and thus have I counselled .

translation.en: And there are also many other things which Jesus did , the which , if they should be written every one , I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written . Amen .

ki nongleh myntor u Pharaoh ki la leh kumjuh da myntor jong ki ; bad u Pharaoh u mutlop hi kumba long . Kumba U Trai u la lah , u Pharaoh u la ban shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
translation.en: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments : and Pharaoh s heart was hardened , neither did he hearken unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .

translation.en: And Ben–hadad sent unto him , and said , The gods do so unto me , and more also , if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me .

translation.en: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee  ; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips .

U la ong kane ïa , bad nangta u la sah noh ha Galilaïa .
translation.en: When he had said these words unto them , he abode still in Galilee .
And I bowed down my head , and worshipped the  Lord  , and blessed the  Lord  God of my master Abraham , which had led me in the right way to take my master s brother s daughter unto his son .
translation.kha: Nga la dem khohsiew bad mane ïa U  Trai . Nga ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong u kynrad jong nga u Abraham , uba la ïalam beit ïa nga sha u kur u jait jong u kynrad jong nga , ha kaba nga la shem ïa ka khun jong u na ka bynta u khun jong u kynrad jong nga .
wat la u leit ha shuwa jong ba-pura riewpawkhmat ban wad ka jaka ba phin sher dara Menahem Ban kdew lynti ïa phi , u ïaid ha shuwa btin phi ha u rishot ding mynmiet bad ha u rishot lyoh mynsngi .
translation.en: Who went in the way before you , to search you out a place to pitch your tents in , in fire by night , to shew you by what way ye should go , and in a cloud by day .
Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the  Lord  God of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ki briew ka Judah bad Benjamin ki la ïohsngew ba kita kiba la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ki dang ïatei pat ïa ka Templ U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

Kylli punkhun kine kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah lada ki tip aïu ka pharshi ka Jehosheba . Ïathuh ïa ki ba u syiem ka Tattenai thmu la wan sha Jerusalem bad rah ïa u syiem bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u lem bad u sha Babilonia .
translation.en: Say now to the rebellious house , Know ye not what these things mean ? tell them , Behold , the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem , and hath taken the king thereof , and the princes thereof , and led them with him to Babylon  ;
That ye would walk worthy of God , who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory .
translation.kha: Ngi la pynshlur ïa phi , ngi la pyntngen ïa phi , bad ngi ïai kyrpad ïa phi ban im ka jingim kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei , uba khot ïa phi ban ïa-ïoh bynta lem ha ka Hima bad ka burom jong u hi .

translation.en: But if our gospel be hid , it is hid to them that are lost :
translation.kha: Naba lada la buhrieh ïa ka gospel kaba ngi ïalap , la buhrieh ïa ka tang na kito kiba la jah noh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall be king over all the earth : in that day shall there be one  Lord  , and his name one .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  un long u syiem jong ka pyrthei baroh ; uwei pa uwei baroh un mane ïa u kum U Blei bad tip ïa u da kajuh ka kyrteng .
Bad ki lynti bah kin dap pat da ki khynnah shynrang bad kynthei kiba ïalehkai .
translation.en: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof .

translation.kha: U tei ki duwan ki blei thala ha ka Templ , ka jaka ha kaba U taïew u la ong ba yn Khatphra ïa u junom .
translation.en: Also he built altars in the house of the  Lord  , whereof the  Lord  had said , In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever .

And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place  ; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies , and by the hands of them that seek their lives : and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven , and for the beasts of the earth .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka jaka ngan pynpulom ïa baroh ki jingthmu jong ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem . Ngan shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban risa halor jong ki bad pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma . Ngan ai ïa ki metïap jong ki ha ki sim bad ha ki mradkhlaw kum ka jingbam .

translation.en: For it is written in the book of Psalms , Let his habitation be desolate , and let no man dwell therein : and his bishoprick let another take .
translation.kha: Naba la thoh ha ka kitab ki Salm ,   ‘ Ai ba ka ïing jong u kan kylla long kaba thylli ; ai ban ym don mano mano bashong hapoh jong ka .’   La thoh ruh ,   ‘ Ai ba uwei pat un shim ïa ka jaka jong u ha ka jingshakri .’

translation.en: From the south , all the land of the Canaanites , and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians , unto Aphek , to the borders of the Amorites :
translation.kha: Ka dang don ka ri ki Kanaan baroh kawei , bad ka Mearah ( kaba dei ka jong ki nong Sidon ) , haduh ka Aphek , kaba ha khappud ki Amor ;
Bad pynban u dei U Blei uba la pynriewspah ïa ki — ngam lah ban hakhmat ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki bymman .
translation.en: Yet he filled their houses with good things : but the counsel of the wicked is far from me .
And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth : so that if a man can number the dust of the earth , then shall thy seed also be numbered .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki baroh ; kan kham jem ban ñiew ïa ki phngit pui pui ha ka khyndew !
U Dabid bad ki rangbah jong ki sah Gath ryngkat ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki . U Dabid u don ar ngut ki tnga lem bad u , ka Ahinoam na , bad ka ka tnga u Nabal uba la ïap , kaba na Karmel .
translation.en: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath , he and his men , every man with his household , even David with his two wives , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess , and Abigail the Carmelitess , Nabal s wife .
For as he thinketh in his heart , so is he : Eat and drink , saith he to thee  ; but his heart is not with thee .
translation.kha: To wan bad bam shuh sa khyndiat ,  u ong , hynrei um mut kumta . Kaei kaba u pyrkhat ka long kaei kaba u long da shisha .

translation.en: ( As it is written in the law of the Lord , Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord  ; )
translation.kha: kumba la thoh ha ka aiñ jong U Trai :  Ïa uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong dei ban pynkyntang sha U Trai .
Hynrei kynmaw , lada ki ïashongkurim bad ki shynrang na kawei pat ka jait , ka bri ka khyndew jong ki kan long noh ka jong kata ka jait , bad ka kaba dei ka jong ngi kan nang duna .
translation.en: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel , then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers , and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received : so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance .
And the  Lord  said unto him , What is that in thine hand ? And he said , A rod .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u kylli ïa u ,  Aïu me bat ha la ka kti ?   U diengduh ,  u jubab .
U ong ruh ha Aaron , Aïu kine briew ki leh ïa phi , haduh la pynlong ïa ban leh ïa pop kaba ishyrkhei kat kane
translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , What did this people unto thee , that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them ?

translation.kha: U long tang ma marwei u , uba sngewthuh ïa ki jingsngew jong nga , bad uba sngewlem shisha shaphang jong phi .
translation.en: For I have no man likeminded , who will naturally care for your state .
And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u Iso u sngewthuh ba u kpa jong u , u Isaak um mynjur ïa ki kynthei nong Kanaan .

translation.en: Behold , a whirlwind of the  Lord  is gone forth in fury , even a grievous whirlwind : it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked .
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar jong U ka long ka  erïong , ka  erlangthari ka ban khih bitar halor ki khlieh jong ki bymman ,
Ym ban dei bam im ne phon ïa ka , hynrei bam ïa ka da kaba shu syang tylli ïa kynthup ka khlieh , ki kjat bad ki doh jem .
translation.en: Eat not of it raw , nor sodden at all with water , but roast with fire  ; his head with his legs , and with the purtenance thereof .
And were continually in the temple , praising and blessing God . Amen .
translation.kha: bad ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki baroh hapoh ka Templ da kaba ainguh ïa U Blei .
Hadien , kata u shakri U Trai , Joshua u u khun jong u Nun , u la ïap ha ka rta kaba shispah shiphew snem .
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the  Lord  , died , being an hundred and ten years old .

And said , O  Lord  God of our fathers , art not thou God in heaven ? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen ? and in thine hand is there not power and might , so that none is able to withstand thee ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , me synshar ha bneng halor ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei . Me long uba donbor bad uba khrawbor , bad ym don ba lah ban pyrshah ïa me .

translation.en: And it came to pass the same night , that the word of God came to Nathan , saying ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet U Blei u ong ha u Nathan ,

translation.en: And Lot went out , and spake unto his sons in law , which married his daughters , and said , Up , get you out of this place  ; for the  Lord  will destroy this city . But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law .
translation.kha: Nangta u Lot u la leit sha ki rangbah kiba la ïatehktien bad ki khun kynthei jong u , bad u ong ,  To pynkloi bad mihnoh nangne ; naba U  Trai  un sa pynjot thiaw ïa kane ka jaka .  Hynrei ki pyrkhat ba u shu kren biria .

translation.en: Verily I say unto thee , Thou shalt by no means come out thence , till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing .
translation.kha: Hangta phin shong , nga ong ïa phi , tad haduh ba phin da siew dep ïa ka pisa bakhatduh jong ka jingshahdaiñ kuna .

translation.en: And they waited for me as for the rain  ; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain .
translation.kha: baroh ki pdiang ïa ki kumba ki nongrep ki pdiang sngewbha ïa u slap ha ka por pyrem .

Baroh ar ngut ki , syiem ba la riam ha ki jingphong syiem , ki shong halor ki khet jong ki ha ka jaka shoh kew kaba don ka shabar khyrdop jong ka Samaria , bad baroh ki ki nongïathuhlypa ïathuhlypa ha khmat jong ki .
translation.en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne , clothed in their robes , and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria  ; and all the prophets prophesied before them .
Peace I leave with you , my peace I give unto you : not as the world giveth , give I unto you . Let not your heart be troubled , neither let it be afraid .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsuk nga iehnoh ha phi , ïa ka jingsuk jong nga hi , nga ai ha phi . Ngam ai ïa ka kumba ka pyrthei ka ai . Wat sngewkhuslai bad sngewdiaw ; wat sngewsheptieng .

translation.en: Then after that saith he to his disciples ,  Let us go into Judaea again .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit phai noh sha Judia .
Kiba bun kito kiba ju leh myntor la lang ïa ki kitab jong ki baroh thang kita ha khmat u Ki la ïa dor ki kitab , bad ka jingkheiñ long kumba sanphew hajar tylli ki sbai rupa .
translation.en: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together , and burned them before all men : and they counted the price of them , and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver .
Their children that were left after them in the land , whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy , upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day .
translation.kha: U Solomon u pyntrei jubor ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki nong Kanaan ki bym shym la shah pynïap ha ki Israel mynba ki knieh ïa ka ri jong ki . Kine ki kynthup ïa ki Amor , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus , kiba ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki dang long ki mraw haduh kane ka por .

translation.en: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea , which cannot be measured nor numbered  ; and it shall come to pass , that in the place where it was said unto them , Ye are not my people , there it shall be said unto them , Ye are the sons of the living God .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Israel kin sa bun kum u shyiap ka duriaw , kin bun haduh bym lah shuh ban ñiew lane ban thew . Mynta U Blei u ong ïa ki ,  Phim dei ki briew jong nga ,  hynrei ka sngi kan poi ha kaba un ong ha ki ,  Phi dei ki khun jong U Blei uba im .

translation.en: And thou shalt hang up the veil under the taches , that thou mayest bring in thither within the veil the ark of the testimony : and the veil shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy .
translation.kha: Wah ïa kata ka pyrda na ki jingpyndait kiba don hapoh tnum Ïingjaiñ , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang kaba don ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap buh ïa ka sha lyndet ka pyrda . Kata ka pyrda kan pynïakhlad ïa ka Jaka Kyntang na ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam .

translation.en: Go from the presence of a foolish man , when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge .
translation.kha: Kiar na ki briew kiba bieit ; kim don ei ei ban hikai ïa phi .

translation.en: He saith among the trumpets , Ha , ha  ; and he smelleth the battle afar off , the thunder of the captains , and the shouting .
translation.kha: Ha man ba riew ka turoi ki pah sngewshyrkhei ; ki lah ban iw ïa ka thma ha shuwa ba kin poi hajan , bad ki sngew ïa ka sur hukum jong ki rangbah shipai .

translation.en: And they were coupled beneath , and coupled together at the head thereof , to one ring : thus he did to both of them in both the corners .
translation.kha: Ïa kine ki jingker kiba ha dong la pynïasoh lang naduh trai baroh shi lynter haduh khlieh . La shna ïa kine ki jingker kiba ha dong ha kajuh ka rukom .
Nangta khie Silpah ka la kha khun shynrang Ha u Jakob .
translation.en: And Zilpah Leah s maid bare Jacob a son .
And it came to pass , when she came to him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted from off her ass  ; and Caleb said unto her , What wilt thou ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kyntiew kurim , u Othniel u kyntu ïa ka , ban pan lyngkha na u kpa jong ka . Ka la hiar na ka kada jong ka , bad u Kaleb u kylli ïa ka aïu ka kwah .
ka Shaaraim , Adithaim ka , ka Gederah bad , ka Gederothaim : khatsaw tylli ki nongbah lem ruh bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: And Shaaraim , and Adithaim , and Gederah , and Gederothaim  ; fourteen cities with their villages :

translation.kha: To kynmaw ba kin sa wan ki por kiba jynjar ha ki Shiphew Jingïashun khatduh .
translation.en: This know also , that in the last days perilous times shall come .
The range of the mountains is his pasture , and he searcheth after every green thing .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki long ki jaka phlang ha kaba la bsa ïa ki , ha kaba ki wad ïa kano kano kaba jyrngam ban bam .
U , Ko khun u briew , me ïohi ïa ? Men sa ïohi shuh shuh ïa kiei kiei kham ijli .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Hast thou seen this , O son of man ? turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations than these .
It may be that the  Lord  will look on mine affliction , and that the  Lord  will requite me good for his cursing this day .
translation.kha: Lehse U  Trai  un ïohi ïa ka jinglanot jong nga bad un ai ha nga katto katne ki jingkyrkhu ban shim bujli ïa ka jingtim jong u .

Ha ka por ka jingsynshar u Dabid la don ka nemsniew kaba kaba la haduh lai snem lynter . u Dabid u kylli U shaphang kata bad U Trai u ong , Saul bad ka longïing jong u ki long kiba rem ha ka jingpynïap briew ; u la pynïap ïa ki paid Gibeon .
translation.en: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years , year after year  ; and David enquired of the  Lord . And the  Lord  answered , It is for Saul , and for his bloody house , because he slew the Gibeonites .

And they took it , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and the king thereof , and all the cities thereof , and all the souls that were therein  ; he left none remaining , according to all that he had done to Eglon  ; but destroyed it utterly , and all the souls that were therein .
translation.kha: Ki la pynïap ïa u syiem jong ka bad ïa uwei pa uwei baroh ha ka nongbah bad ha ki shnong kiba markhap . U Joshua u pynjot thiaw ïa kata ka nongbah , kumba u la leh ïa ka Eglon . Ym shym don uwei ruh hangta uba lait im .
Lai sngi kata ka jingïateh lok , ki ki sa tip ba kine ki ki dei shong basah hajan .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them , that they heard that they were their neighbours , and that they dwelt among them .

translation.kha: jingtim U Blei hap ha uta u briew uba ïalam lynti bakla u uba matlah .’ Bad u baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen
translation.en: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: U patsha ki jong un phet ha ka jingsngew shyrkhei , bad ki rangbah shipai kin haduh sheptieng katta katta haduh ba kin iehnoh ïa ki lama thma jong ki . U u Trai la kren U — Trai ïa uba la mane ha Jerusalem bad uba ka ding jong u ka thang hangta ïa ki jingkñia .
translation.en: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear , and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign , saith the  Lord  , whose fire is in Zion , and his furnace in Jerusalem .
And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves , he came , if haply he might find any thing thereon : and when he came to it , he found nothing but leaves  ; for the time of figs was not yet .
translation.kha: U la ïohi na jngai ïa u dieng Dumbur ba la tap da ki sla , kumta u la leit ban peit la u lah ban shem ki soh ha u . Hynrei haba u la wan sha uta u dieng , u la shem tang ki sla , namar kam pat dei ka por ban mih soh .
bad ha ka por kaba biang u la pynpaw ïa ka ha ka khubor jong u . Ïa la kane pynkhamti ha nga , bad nga pynbna ïa ka da ka U hukum Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi .
translation.en: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching , which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour ;

Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement : it shall be an holy convocation unto you  ; and ye shall afflict your souls , and offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew ka long ka sngi ka jingpyndep ïa ka jinglehniam kaba man ka snem ban weng noh ïa ki pop ki briew . Wat bam ei ei ruh em ha kata ka sngi ; ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai .

translation.en: The cities of the south shall be shut up , and none shall open them : Judah shall be carried away captive all of it , it shall be wholly carried away captive .
translation.kha: Ki shnong jong ka Judah bashathie ki don hapoh ka jingshah kerkut ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban leit lyngba sha ki . Ïa ki briew baroh jong ka Judah la shim noh sha ka jinglongmraw .

translation.en: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt , Jacob said unto his sons , Why do ye look one upon another ?
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob u la tip ba don kew ha Ijipt , u ong ha la ki khun shynrang ,  Balei phim ïaleh ei ei ?

translation.en: Then they sent to Jezebel , saying , Naboth is stoned , and is dead .
translation.kha: Ïa ka khubor la phah sha ka Jesebel ,  Ïa u Naboth la pynïap .

translation.en: Teach me , and I will hold my tongue : and cause me to understand wherein I have erred .
translation.kha: Kam lei lei , hikai ïa nga ; ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingbakla jong nga . Ngan sngap jar bad shahshkor ïa phi .
Kin pynkhih buk ïa u paidbah ban lynthem ïa pha , bad kin ot lyngkhot ïa da ki waitlam jong ki .
translation.en: They shall also bring up a company against thee , and they shall stone thee with stones , and thrust thee through with their swords .

translation.kha: U kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong u , bad ki don bun ki khun ki kti ; u pynlong ba ki jingri jingdup jong ki ym duna .
translation.en: He blesseth them also , so that they are multiplied greatly  ; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease .
But Noah found grace in the eyes of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la sngewbha eh ïa u Noah .

translation.en: And she conceived , and bare a son  ; and he called his name Er .
translation.kha: U la shongkurim ïa ka , bad ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u , ïa uba u la khot kyrteng u Er .

translation.en: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams  skins dyed red , and a covering above of badgers  skins .
translation.kha: Thaw sa ar tylli ki jingkah , kawei kaba da ka snieh jong ki langbrot shynrang ba la wieh rong saw , bad kawei pat kaba da ka snieh bha , ban long ka jingtap na shabar .

U Blei uba la ong , Na ka jingdum ka kan tyngshaiñ! u long ujuh U uba la pynlong ïa ka jingshai jong u ban tyngshaiñ ha dohnud jong ngi ban wanrah ha ngi ïa ka jingtip shaphang ka burom Blei kaba tyngshaiñ ha U Khrist
translation.en: For God , who commanded the light to shine out of darkness , hath shined in our hearts , to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ .
The sting of death is sin ; and the strength of sin is the law .
translation.kha: Ka jingïap ka ïoh na ka pop ïa ka bor ban pynmong , bad ka pop ka ïoh ïa ka bor jong ka na ka Hukum .
Ki leit shata namar dei hangta ba ka Ïingjaiñ Jingdon Ryngkat Trai ka don , ha kaba , u shakri jong U Trai , u la ha ka ri .
translation.en: So Solomon , and all the congregation with him , went to the high place that was at Gibeon  ; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God , which Moses the servant of the  Lord  had made in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Nangta u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u leit sha u syiem bad Hesekaïah kylli u , Nangno kine ki rangbah ki la wan bad ki la ong aïu ïa me ? U Hesekaïah u jubab , Ki la na wan ka ri kaba jngai , na Babilonia .
translation.en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah , and said unto him , What said these men ? and from whence came they unto thee ? And Hezekiah said , They are come from a far country , even from Babylon .
And one of you say unto them , Depart in peace , be ye warmed and filled  ; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body  ; what doth it profit ?
translation.kha: Kan myntoi aïu da kaba ong ha ki ,  U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi ! To phong syaid bad to bam bha !  — lada phim ai ha ki ïa ki jingdonkam jong ka jingim ?

Shaphir ki kulai ki ju mareh halor ki mawsiang nongsaiñdur Hato ki briew ki ju lur ïa ïaphiah Dekapolis da ki masi dab ? Pynban phi la pynkylla ïa ka jingbishar hok sha ka bih , bad ïa kaba nongmareh sha ka bymdei .
translation.en: Shall horses run upon the rock ? will one plow there with oxen ? for ye have turned judgment into gall , and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock :
If any man among you seem to be religious , and bridleth not his tongue , but deceiveth his own heart , this man s religion is vain .
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba pyrkhat ba u long uba riewblei ? Lada um synshar ïa la u thylliej , ka jinglong riewblei jong u kam myntoi bad u shukor ïa lade .
phi ïohkynti ïa kata ri ba U Trai U Blei jong u ai ha phi , wat ïa u mawpud jong u paramarjan jong phi uba thung naduh mynbarim .
translation.en: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour s landmark , which they of old time have set in thine inheritance , which thou shalt inherit in the land that the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to possess it .

And David saved neither man nor woman alive , to bring tidings to Gath , saying , Lest they should tell on us , saying , So did David , and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ju pynïap lut , shynrang bad kynthei , khnang ba yn ym don uba leit rah khubor sha Gath bad ïathuh aïu ma u bad ki briew jong u ki la leh . Kane ka long kaba u Dabid u la ju leh katba u dang sah ha ri Philistia .

translation.en: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtoreth : and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth–shan .
translation.kha: Nangta ki buh ïa ki tiar ïapom jong u ha ka ïing mane jong ka blei Astarte , bad ki sahnar ïa ka met jong u ha ka kynroh jong ka nongbah Beth Shan .
