Oh that I knew where I might find him ! that I might come even to his seat !
translation.kha: Haduh katno nga kwah ba ngan tip hangno ngan shem ïa u , ban tip kumno ngan leit shano ba u don .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih

Ai ba ka dohnud ba la pait jong kan phi pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewsih jong phi ; kaba kad ïa ki jaiñphong jong phi kam biang . To wan phai pat sha U Trai U Blei jong phi . U long sbun uba uba bad dap da ka jingisynei u ; long uba ïaishah slem bad uba bat ïa la ka kular ; u long borabor uba kloi ban map bad ym ban . pynshitom
translation.en: And rend your heart , and not your garments , and turn unto the  Lord  your God : for he is gracious and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and repenteth him of the evil .

translation.kha: bad kumba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ka bor ban synshar , kumta ngan ai ha phi ïa ka kajuh bor .
translation.en: And I appoint unto you a kingdom , as my Father hath appointed unto me  ;
And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace  ; thou shalt be buried in a good old age .
translation.kha: Me pat , men im tymmen , men ïap ha kaba suk , bad yn sa tep ïa me .
Te U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Ngan leh thik kumta kumba me kyrpad la , namar nga tip bha ïa me , bad nga ïa sngewbha me .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken : for thou hast found grace in my sight , and I know thee by name .

translation.kha: Haba u mynsiem bymkhuid u jingring mihnoh shimti u briew , jingsiangthiah ïaid puk ka jaka ryngkhiang Heliopolis kaba khmih ïa namsop jaka ban ïoh pynjahthait . Lada Darius siat rem shem ïa nong kano ,
translation.en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man , he walketh through dry places , seeking rest , and findeth none .

translation.kha: Ki kham paid ban ïa ngi ; kumta sngewbha wan bad tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga Ïoh lehse ngin lah ban jop ïa ki bad noh ïa ki na kane ka ri tip ba haba phi pynbna ki briew ki ïoh ka , bad haba phi pynbna ka jingtim , la buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingtim .
translation.en: Come now therefore , I pray thee , curse me this people  ; for they are too mighty for me : peradventure I shall prevail , that we may smite them , and that I may drive them out of the land : for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed , and he whom thou cursest is cursed .

translation.kha: Un leit ha shuwa jong U Trai uba , khlaiñ bad uba khrawbor kum u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa . Un pynïasuk pat ïa ki kpa bad ki khun ; pynphai un pat ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh sha ka rukom pyrkhat jong kiba ; hok un pynkhreh ïa ki briew jong U na Trai ka bynta jong U .
translation.en: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias , to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children , and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just  ; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord .

translation.kha: Shim ïa uta uwei pat u langbrot — u langbrot pyndonkam ban na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang — bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ki ïa khun shynrang jong u ban buh ïa la kti ki ha ka khlieh jong u .
translation.en: And thou shalt take the other ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .
Thou hast heard my voice : hide not thine ear at my breathing , at my cry .
translation.kha: Bad haba nga la kyrpad ïa me ban shahshkor ïa ka jingkyang jong nga , me la ïohsngew .
Lada ka jingbthuh ka paw biang ha kata ka ïing hadien ba la weng noh ïa kita ki maw bad hadien ba khrud bad la ñiad astor thymmai ruh ïa ka , u lyngdoh un leit khmih bha ïa .
translation.en: And if the plague come again , and break out in the house , after that he hath taken away the stones , and after he hath scraped the house , and after it is plastered  ;
And I said , Lord , they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee :
translation.kha: ‘ Ko Kynrad ,’ nga la jubab , ‘ ki ïatip bha ba nga la leit sha ki synagog bad nga la kem bad shoh ïa kito kiba ngeit ha me .

translation.en: All thy rulers are fled together , they are bound by the archers : all that are found in thee are bound together , which have fled from far .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong phi baroh ki la phet krad bad ki la shah kem ha shuwa ba kin ïoh siat uwei u khnam .

U Trai u khot biang ïa u Samuel . U khynnah um shym tip satia ba dei U Trai , namar U Trai um pat ju la kren bad u mynshuwa . Kumta u khie joit bad u leit sha u Eli bad , u , ong Phi khot ïa nga , bad nga hangne . Hynrei u Eli u , jubab jong Khun nga ngam , shym khot ïa phi ; khie leit thiah biang .
translation.en: Now Samuel did not yet know the  Lord  , neither was the word of the  Lord  yet revealed unto him .
But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him , and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need , in that which he wanteth .
translation.kha: pynban , to long kiba kylluid mynsiem bad ai kylliang ïa u kat kaba u donkam .

translation.en: But they constrained him , saying , Abide with us : for it is toward evening , and the day is far spent . And he went in to tarry with them .
translation.kha: hynrei ki la bat ïa u , ki da ong ,  To sah bad ngi ; ka sngi la jan kut bad ka la khreh dum .  Kumta u la leit ban sah bad ki .

translation.en: Wherefore I give you to understand , that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed : and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord , but by the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ba phin tip ba ym don uno uno uba la ïalam da U Mynsiem U Blei u lah ban ong  Long ba la tim ïa U Jisu!  bad ym don uno uno uba lah ban phla  U Jisu u long U Trai ,  lymda la ïalam ïa u da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: And the men of Beth–shemesh said , Who is able to stand before this holy  Lord  God ? and to whom shall he go up from us ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki rangbah na Beth Shemesh ki ïa-ong ,  Uei uba lah ban ïeng ha khmat U  Trai  , une U Blei uba Khuid ? Shano ngi lah ban phah ïa u ba un lait noh na ngi ?

translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and forgive , and do , and give to every man according to his ways , whose heart thou knowest  ; ( for thou , even thou only , knowest the hearts of all the children of men  ; )
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki na ka ïing jong me ha bneng , map ïa ki , bad ïarap ïa ki . Tang ma me hi uba tip ïa ki jingmut jong ka dohnud briew .
Ngan ïeng joit bad leit sha i pa jong bad nga ong , Ko pa , nga la leh pyrshah pop ïa U Blei bad pyrshah ïa phi .
translation.en: I will arise and go to my father , and will say unto him , Father , I have sinned against heaven , and before thee ,
And the  Lord  thy God will circumcise thine heart , and the heart of thy seed , to love the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul , that thou mayest live .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa phi kiba kohnguh hukum , khnang ba phin ieit ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh , bad ba phin ïaishong ha kata ka ri .
U la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad Rehoboam u khun jong , u long syiem ha jong u .
translation.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David his father : and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Nangta ki nong Moab kin ym ïa sngewbha u blei Khemosh jong ki , kumba ki Israel kim ïa sngewbha u blei Bethel ha uba ki shaniah .
translation.en: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh , as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth–el their confidence .

translation.kha: Ngin Sukkoth u syiem ka Ijipt khrup tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ka kynhun shipai kaba shihajar riewshemphang tylli Bethmeon Atharim ïapom Hasar hynriewphew hajar ngut ki ap shong kulai , bad shibun ki shipai ban ïa kaba lah ban ïa kaba lah Jairos Khloi , kaba kynthup ïa ki nong Libya , ki Sukki , bad ki Phong Sudan .
translation.en: With twelve hundred chariots , and threescore thousand horsemen : and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt  ; the Libyans , the Sukkiims , and the Ethiopians .

Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal , all his servants , and all his priests  ; let none be wanting : for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal  ; whosoever shall be wanting , he shall not live . But Jehu did it in subtilty , to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal .
translation.kha: Khot lang ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal baroh , ïa ki nongmane jong u baroh , bad ïa ki lyngdoh jong u baroh . Uwei ruh um dei ban pep ; nga ai ka jingkñia ainguh kaba khraw ha u Baal , bad uno uno uba jah un shah pynïap .  ( Kane ka long ka buit sianti ha ka liang jong u Jehu da kaba u mut ban pynïap lut ïa ki nongmane ïa u Baal . )
bad U Blei u la pynbna ba u long U Rangbah Lyngdoh ha ka rukom lyngdoh long jong u Melkhisedek .
translation.en: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec .

translation.kha: U u Trai ong ha u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa ,
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came to Elijah the Tishbite , saying ,

translation.kha: bad lada ka ïapoi shongkurim bad uwei pat briew u ,
translation.en: And when she is departed out of his house , she may go and be another man s wife .

translation.kha: Kito ki balamler ki kren shaphang kiei kiei ki jong ka pyrthei , bad ka pyrthei ka shahshkor ïa ki , ki long ki pyrthei .
translation.en: They are of the world : therefore speak they of the world , and the world heareth them .

translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ban ym kren shaphang kata hano hano ruh ; katba u nang hukum ïa ki ban ïathuh , katta ki nang .
translation.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man : but the more he charged them , so much the more a great deal they published it  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei ma , ko ki paralok jong nga , la tip lypa ïa kane . To sumar ïa lade , , ba phin ym shah bakla da jingpynbakla ki briew ki bym bat aiñ phi hap noh na ka ba shongshngain phi don .
translation.en: Ye therefore , beloved , seeing ye know these things before , beware lest ye also , being led away with the error of the wicked , fall from your own stedfastness .
Yet hast thou not walked after their ways , nor done after their abominations : but , as if that were a very little thing , thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways .
translation.kha: Hato pha la ïoh jinghun ban bud ïa ki dien jat jong ki bad pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki ? Em , tang hapoh khyndiat por pha la leh kham sniew palat ban ïa kaba ki long ha kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la leh .

Lada me kohnguh tylli ïa nga me , im hapoh ki hukum jong nga , bad me ïoh ïa ka jong jingmynjur nga da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba nga hukum , kumba u u Dabid shakri nga jong u la leh , ngan ïai don ryngkat bad me . pynlong Ngan ïa me u syiem ki Israel bad ngan pynthikna ba kiba hiarpateng na me kin synshar hadien jong me , nga kumba la leh ïa u Dabid .
translation.en: And it shall be , if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee , and wilt walk in my ways , and do that is right in my sight , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as David my servant did  ; that I will be with thee , and build thee a sure house , as I built for David , and will give Israel unto thee .
There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews  preparation day  ; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand .
translation.kha: Te naba ka la long ka sngi shuwa ka Sabbaton bad namar ba ka jingtep ka don ha syndah , ki la buh ïa ka met U Jisu hangta .

translation.en: Him God raised up the third day , and shewed him openly  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien lai sngi . U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u bad u la pynlong ïa u ban mihpaw ,

translation.en: For he said , Surely they are my people , children that will not lie : so he was their Saviour .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki long ki briew jong nga kin ym shukor ïa nga .  Bad kumta u la pyllait im ïa ki na ki jingjynjar jong ki baroh .

Lada nga la kwah ban sngewsarong , ngan ym jin da la long uba bieit , namar ngan jin da la ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha . Hynrei ngan ym kob , sarong ngam namar kwah mano mano ban ka don jingpyrkhat ba kham halor ïa nga ban ïa kaei kaba u ïohi la ba nga leh lane u la ïohsngew ïa kaba nga ong .
translation.en: For though I would desire to glory , I shall not be a fool ; for I will say the truth : but now I forbear , lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be , or that he heareth of me .

And Abimelech , and the company that was with him , rushed forward , and stood in the entering of the gate of the city : and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields , and slew them .
translation.kha: Katba u Abimelekh bad ka kynhun jong u ki tur pynkloi sha khmat ban ïada ïa ka khyrdop shnong , kiwei pat ki ar kynhun ki tur ïaleh ïa ki briew hapoh lyngkha bad ki pynïap ïa ki baroh .
ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel ba u wan mihnoh na ka Templ ha bneng , bad u ruh u don rashi kaba nep .
translation.en: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven , he also having a sharp sickle .

translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi sha Seïon , sha u lum bakyntang jong Laiphew ïa-ïohi ngan ai ha nongshim ka jingkmen ha pjiar ïing jingduwai jong nga ; bad pdiang Siklag ki jingkñia kiba phi Nongïalam ha ka duwan jong nga . Ïa ka ïing jong nga yn khot ka Etham jingduwai phra ka bynta Habassinaïah briew jong ki ri baroh jinglongmraw
translation.en: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain , and make them joyful in my house of prayer : their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar  ; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people .
Then cried he upon me , and spake unto me , saying , Behold , these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel u la pyrta jam sha nga ,  Ki kulai kiba la leit shaphang shatei sha Babilonia ki la pynjai jai ïa ka jingbitar jong U  Trai .
Jokshan kawei ka miet u Eli , uba la kham byr-ïe ki bymdonbor , u thiah ha la ka kamra ;
translation.en: And it came to pass at that time , when Eli was laid down in his place , and his eyes began to wax dim , that he could not see  ;
( Revelation 3 :14 ) Jesus himself said that he ‘ made God’s name known’ and kept ‘ bearing witness to the truth’ about God .
translation.kha: ( Jingpynpaw 3 :14 ) U Jisu hi u la ong ba u la ‘ pyntip ia ka kyrteng jong U Blei’ bad u la ïai “phla skhem ia ka jingshisha” shaphang U Blei .
kiba shim ïa ki khunlung pynkiew pynsarong jingkitpop lynthaw ïa ki ha u mawsiang .
translation.en: Happy shall he be , that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones .
Surely he scorneth the scorners : but he giveth grace unto the lowly .
translation.kha: Um donkam ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u lehsbun ïa kito kiba sngewrit .
Hadien ba la pynkynriah ïa ka metïap na lynti , uwei pa uwei la u bud ïa u Joab ban leit thwet ïa u Sheba .
translation.en: When he was removed out of the highway , all the people went on after Joab , to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri .

translation.kha: U Solomon u la tei biang ïa kine ki nongbah : ka Horon Beth Neng bad ka Beth Horon Rum , ( ki nongbah la ba ker kynroh bad ki khyrdop kiba lah ban khang ) ,
translation.en: Also he built Beth–horon the upper , and Beth–horon the nether , fenced cities , with walls , gates , and bars  ;
Ye have feared the sword  ; and I will bring a sword upon you , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Hato phi sheptieng ïa ki waitlam ? Ngan wallam ïa ki briew ryngkat bad ki waitlam ban tur ïaleh ïa phi .

Na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang , ki ai shispah tylli ki masi dabi , arspah ki langbrot , ïaleh sawspah tylli ïasah khunlangbrot Une ki jingainguh “Gilead” , bad khat-ar tylli ki blang kum ki jingainguh ïa ïaphet pop , uwei na ka bynta kawei ka jait ki Ijon .
translation.en: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks , two hundred rams , four hundred lambs  ; and for a sin offering for all Israel , twelve he goats , according to the number of the tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: Ai ba kito kiba pyndonburom ïa me kin wan nga — kito baroh kiba tip ïa ki hukum jong .
translation.en: Let those that fear thee turn unto me , and those that have known thy testimonies .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shit khlieh ki bieit ; ki briew stad ki long jai jai
translation.en: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly : and a man of wicked devices is hated .
These are the sons of Shem , after their families , after their tongues , in their lands , after their nations .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew na u Shem , kiba shong ha ki ri kiba pher bapher , bad ha la ka jait ka jait kaba kren ïa la ka jong ka jong ka ktien .

translation.en: And her parents were astonished : but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done .
translation.kha: Ka kmie bad u kpa jong ka ki la lyngngoh shikatdei , hynrei U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ban ym ïathuh hano hano ïa kaei kaba la jia .
Kin ïap na ka jingthngan bad ka jingpang ; kin ïap na ki jingpang kiba . ngan ki mradkhlaw kynrup ïa ki , bad ki bseiñ kiba don ban puh ïa ki .
translation.en: They shall be burnt with hunger , and devoured with burning heat , and with bitter destruction : I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them , with the poison of serpents of the dust .
Is it a book ?
translation.kha: Kane kadei ka kot ?

translation.en: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits , and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain : the eleven curtains were of one size .
translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ka long khatlai mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan ; bad baroh khatwei tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki long katjuh ka jingheh .

Ki ïaid shaphrang haduh ba kin da poi pyndonburom Bethlehem . Haba ki la poi hangta , ka ksiang baroh kawei ka nard sngewkmen , bad ki kynthei kiba Sohar ki la pyrta , Hato kane ka dei shisha ka Naomi ?
translation.en: So they two went until they came to Beth–lehem . And it came to pass , when they were come to Beth–lehem , that all the city was moved about them , and they said , Is this Naomi ?

translation.kha: Khmih ïa ki sim : kim bet symbai , kim ïalum ïa jingot bad buh ïa ha ki thiar ; pynban U Kpa jong phi ha bneng u sumar sukher ïa ki ! Hato phim kam kor shibun ban ïa sim ?
translation.en: Behold the fowls of the air : for they sow not , neither do they reap , nor gather into barns  ; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them . Are ye not much better than they ?

translation.kha: To sngap , phi ki syiem ! , phi ki nongsynshar ! Ngan rwai tem jingtem ha U Trai U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: Hear , O ye kings  ; give ear , O ye princes  ; I , even I , will sing unto the  Lord   ; I will sing praise to the  Lord  God of Israel .
Then shall he answer them , saying , Verily I say unto you , Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these , ye did it not to me .
translation.kha: U Syiem un jubab , ‘ Nga ong ha phi , ha man ba phi kyntait ban ïarap ïa iwei na kine kiba rit tam , phi kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga .’

translation.en: And David said unto the young man that told him , How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead ?
translation.kha: Kumno me tip ba u Saul bad u Jonathan ki la ïap ?  u Dabid u la kylli ïa u .

Hynrei U Trai u dang don ha ka nongbah ; leh kaei kaba dei bad da lei lei ruh em ïa kaei ka bymdei . Man ka step khlem bakla , u wallam ka jinglehhok ha ki jong u . Bad pynban hangta ki briew bymhok ki ïai leh bymdei bad kim sngewlehrain .
translation.en: The just  Lord  is in the midst thereof  ; he will not do iniquity : every morning doth he bring his judgment to light , he faileth not  ; but the unjust knoweth no shame .
Yea , better is he than both they , which hath not yet been , who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun .
translation.kha: Hynrei kham bha ban ïa kine baroh ar long kito ki bym pat shym la kha , ki bym pat ïohi ïa ka jingbymlehhok kaba trei ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field , keeping watch over their flock by night .
translation.kha: La don katto katne ngut ki nongap langbrot ha kata ka bynta jong ka ri kiba la sahmiet ha ki lum , da kaba sumar ïa ki kynhun langbrot jong ki .

translation.en: And they cast dust on their heads , and cried , weeping and wailing , saying , Alas , alas , that great city , wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness ! for in one hour is she made desolate .
translation.kha: Ki la kynting pui pui halor ki khlieh jong ki , ki la lynñiar bad ki la ïambriew , da kaba ong ,  Katno kaba shyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ïa ka nongbah kaba khraw ! Ka long ka nongbah ha kaba baroh kiba don ki liengbah kiba ïaid ha ki duriaw ki la kylla riewspah ha ka spah jong ka ! Bad ha ka shi kynta ka la duh lut ïa kiei kiei baroh !

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Ye shall not see wind , neither shall ye see rain  ; yet that valley shall be filled with water , that ye may drink , both ye , and your cattle , and your beasts .
translation.kha: Wat la phim ïohi ïa uno uno u slap lane ïa ka lyer , yn sa pyndap ïa kane ka phud um da ka um , bad ma phi , ki jingri jong phi , bad ki kynhun mrad jong phi kin ïoh kyrhai ban dih .’

translation.en: And he brought us out from thence , that he might bring us in , to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers .
translation.kha: U la pyllait ïa ngi na Ijipt ban wan ïalam ïa ngi shane bad ban ai ha ngi ïa kane ka ri , kumba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
Hato uno uno na phi uba long u kpa un ai ïa la u khun da u haba u pan ïa u kpu ?
translation.en: Or what man is there of you , whom if his son ask bread , will he give him a stone ?

translation.kha: Lada phim kohnguh ïa ka hukum U , Blei un shem ïa ki jingduwai jong phi kiba ijli eh ban sngap .
translation.en: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law , even his prayer shall be abomination .

translation.kha: Hynrei kata ha ka miet U Blei u ong ha u Nathan ,
translation.en: And it came to pass the same night , that the word of God came to Nathan , saying ,
A gift in secret pacifieth anger : and a reward in the bosom strong wrath .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u bitar ïa phi , ka jingai sngewbha kaba ai ha kaba rieh ka pynjem jai ïa u .

translation.en: Therefore will I return , and take away my corn in the time thereof , and my wine in the season thereof , and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka aïom ot ngan shim noh ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong nga da u kew bad ka waiñ , bad ngan shim noh ruh ïa u  saiwul bad ka jaiñ linen ba nga la ai ïa ka ban phong .
ki rangbah jong ka nongbah ki ïakynduh lang long uwei jong ki ,
translation.en: When I went out to the gate through the city , when I prepared my seat in the street !
And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod , and Abiezer , and Mahalah .
translation.kha: Ka Hammolekheth , ka para u Gilead , ka ïoh lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ishod , u Abieser , bad u Mahlah .

translation.en: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus , and bound him ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki shipai Rom lem bad u rangbah shipai jong ki bad ki nongap phira jong ki Jiw , ki la kem ïa U Jisu , ki la khum ïa u ,

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them , and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about , so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies .
translation.kha: Bad kumta U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki Israel bad u la shah ïa ki nonglute ban tur ïaleh bad lute ïa ki . U shah ïa ki nongshun kiba sawdong jong ki ban thombor ïa ki , bad ki Israel kim lah shuh ban ïada ïa lade .

translation.en: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ , yet have ye not many fathers : for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel .
translation.kha: Wat haba phi don shiphew hajar ngut ki nongsumar ha ka jingim jong phi kum ki bangeit , phi don tang uwei u kpa . Naba ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu nga la long u kpa jong phi da kaba wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi .
lai bymmyntoi , ka bymmyntoi , ong u Stad saiñpyrkhat . Baroh ka long ka bymmyntoi .
translation.en: Vanity of vanities , saith the preacher  ; all is vanity .
I was a derision to all my people  ; and their song all the day .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki rkhie ïa nga baroh shi sngi ; nga long ka jingbiria ïa ki baroh .
U Khun Briew u long U Kynrad jong ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath .
In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment  ; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee , saith the  Lord  thy Redeemer .
translation.kha: Nga la phai noh da ka jingbitar tang shipor , hynrei ngan pyn-i ha pha ïa ka jingieit jong nga junom .  Kumta u ong U  Trai  uba pynim ïa pha .
Pyni ïa nga haduh katno me ieit ïa nga , A Trai , bad pynim ïa nga kum kat ka kular jong me .
translation.en: Let thy mercies come also unto me , O  Lord  , even thy salvation , according to thy word .
For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John , and bound him in prison for Herodias  sake , his brother Philip s wife : for he had married her .
translation.kha: U Herod da lade hi u hukum ïa ka jingkem ïa u Ïoannis , bad u la phah teh kynjri ïa u bad phah set ha ka byndi . U Herod u la leh ïa kane namar ka Herodias , ïa kaba u la lah shongkurim , wat la ka la long ka tnga u para jong u , u Philip .

U Naaman , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai pynskhem , u long isih briew ïa uba la burom shikatdei eh bad lymbung shibun ksai u syiem pynphaloh , namar Salm u Naaman , U Trai u la ai ka jingjop ïa ki shipai Syria . U la long u shipai bakhraw , hynrei u don ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh .
translation.en: Now Naaman , captain of the host of the king of Syria , was a great man with his master , and honourable , because by him the  Lord  had given deliverance unto Syria : he was also a mighty man in valour , but he was a leper .
Where is the dwelling of the lions , and the feedingplace of the young lions , where the lion , even the old lion , walked , and the lion s whelp , and none made them afraid ?
translation.kha: Hangno mynta ka don ka nongbah kata kaba long kum ka krem jong ki sing , ka jaka ha kaba la bsa ïa ki sing samla , ha kaba u sing bad ka sing kin leit bad ki khun jong ki kin don ha ka jingshngain ?
U Moses u ïalam ïa ki shabar ka jaka sher dara ban ïashem bad U Blei , die ki la ïeng ha kjat pyn-ap u bthuh .
translation.en: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God  ; and they stood at the nether part of the mount .

translation.kha: Haba u Hushai u la wan poi Pekah u Absalom u ong ha u , Geshem ka dei ka jingai jingmut jong u Ahithophel kaba u la jingkhyllong ïa ngi ; Hato Hillel bud ïa Lehab ? nongshun em , to ïathuh ma phi ïa ngi ktang ba ngin lymne .
translation.en: And when Hushai was come to Absalom , Absalom spake unto him , saying , Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner : shall we do after his saying ? if not  ; speak thou .

translation.kha: U un Trai shah ïa ki briew ban shah synshar ha ki khynnah shynrang ki bym pat ïaw .
translation.en: And I will give children to be their princes , and babes shall rule over them .

translation.kha: Lada phi thrang ban ai , shynna Blei un pdiang ïa ka jingai jong phi ha ka nongrim jong kaei Kaei phi dei ban ai , kynrei halor ñiuhtmoh kaba jingpynbor don .
translation.en: For if there be first a willing mind , it is accepted according to that a man hath , and not according to that he hath not .
I tell you , Nay : but , except ye repent , ye shall all likewise perish .
translation.kha: Em , ym kumta ! Bad nga ong ha phi ba lada phim phai noh na ki pop jong phi , phi baroh phin ïap kum ma ki .

translation.en: Now therefore hearken unto their voice : howbeit yet protest solemnly unto them , and shew them the manner of the king that shall reign over them .
translation.kha: Kumta , sngap ïa ki , tangba me dei ban maham jur ïa ki bad pynshai kumno kita ki syiem kin leh ïa ki .

translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

translation.en: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ ,
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw , nga dem khohsiew ha khmat U Kpa ,
Shisien ne ar sien ki Bethesda babuhrieh die bun jait ki tiar ki jingpynduh ïa ka miet shuwa ka sngi Sabbaton Aswan ki kynroh ka nongbah .
translation.en: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice .

Therefore it is of faith , that it might be by grace ; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed ; not to that only which is of the law , but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham ; who is the father of us all ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa ka kular la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingngeit , khnang ba ïa ka jingngeit yn pynthikna kum ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei ïa baroh kiba hiarpateng na u Abraham — ym tang ïa kito kiba ngeit ïa ka Hukum , hynrei ïa kito ruh kiba ngeit kumba u Abraham u la leh . Namar u Abraham u long u kpa ba kynja mynsiem jong ngi baroh ;
‘ Kine briew , ong U Blei , ki pyndonburom ïa nga ïasngewdei ki kyntien jong ki , hynrei ka ha jong ki , jyrsieh shisha ka jingbynrap jngai balui paid nga .
translation.en: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth , and honoureth me with their lips  ; but their heart is far from me .
And Pharaoh called Abram , and said , What is this that thou hast done unto me ? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife ?
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la khot ïa u Abram , bad u kylli ïa u ,  Me leh aïu ïa nga ? Balei mem shym la ïathuh ïa nga ba ka dei ka tnga jong me ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Distress not the Moabites , neither contend with them in battle : for I will not give thee of their land for a possession  ; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Wat pynjynjar ïa ki briew jong ka ri Moab , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lot , lane wat ïaleh thma bad ki . Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka shnong Ar , bad ngan ym ai ei ei ïa phi na ka ri jong ki .’

U Shemaïah , u khun riewkhyllah Apollos u Obed Edom , u Maim hynriew namsop ki khun shynrang Jingrakhe u Othni , u jingibeiñ , u Elhanan , u Elsabad , u Elihu , bad u Semakhaïah . Ki dei ki rangbah kiba Abednego ha ka kur jong ki Tabitha Ei jingtbit palat jong ki ; ki ar syrngiew jingshitrhem khatduh , ki long —Proberb don ka sap bakyrpang .
translation.en: The sons of Shemaiah  ; Othni , and Rephael , and Obed , Elzabad , whose brethren were strong men , Elihu , and Semachiah .

translation.kha: ( Haba la kurup ïa ka Jerusalem , Baibyl ki rangbah synshar baheh kyrdan jong u Nong ka Babilonia pynwandur la wan bad ki Dionysius ïeng ha la ki jaka ha ka Khyrdop Pdeng , kaba kynthup ïa ka Nergal Sareser , ka Samgar Nebo , ka Sarsekhim , bad kawei pat ka Nergal Sareser Edrei )
translation.en: And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in , and sat in the middle gate , even Nergal–sharezer , Samgar–nebo , Sarsechim , Rab–saris , Nergal–sharezer , Rab–mag , with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon .

translation.kha: U syiem bad jingkhih rangbah synshar jong u ki la pdiang ïa kane ka jingai jingmut , bad riewrunar ong ha ki ,
translation.en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of all his servants .
When all Israel is come to appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose , thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing .
translation.kha: Pule ïa ka ha ki paid Israel haba ki wan ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ha kata ka jaka mane Blei .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest , which I have given to the fire for fuel , so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Kumba ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la shim na ka khlaw bad la thang , kumta ngan shim ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem
Wat nga long ryngkat bad phi ! Naduh mihngi bajngai bad sha bajngai tam , ngan wallam sha ïing ïa jong .
translation.en: Fear not : for I am with thee : I will bring thy seed from the east , and gather thee from the west  ;

translation.kha: U Lebi bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Gershon , u Kohath , u bad Merari .
translation.en: And the sons of Levi  ; Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .

translation.kha: La khot lang Uphas ki rangbah baroh kiba ha ka nongbah Asaraïahu leit beh ïa ki , bad katba ki lymbung beh ïa u Joshua , katta ruh ki nang jngai na ka Wanlam .
translation.en: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them : and they pursued after Joshua , and were drawn away from the city .
My son , fear thou the  Lord  and the king : and meddle not with them that are given to change :
translation.kha: Ko khun , tiengburom ïa U  Trai  bad burom ïa u syiem . Wat leh ei ei bad ki briew kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ;
( 1 Petros 3 :18 ) Riblah kata , bakynja Blei u la thung Malkhos u kum u jinglyngngoh .
translation.en: ( 1 Peter 3 :18 ) Since then , God has made him a King .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki kyang jam , Ka lyiur ka la leit , ka jingot ka la kut hynrei , ym shym la pynim ïa ngi .
translation.en: The harvest is past , the summer is ended , and we are not saved .

translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei hap kan ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kiaw kurim .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang ‘ , Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: Ki shipai ruh ki la krenbeiñ ïa pynbuaid : Ki la Badonbor sha u bad ki la tyrwa ha u ïa ka Assur bym bha pop! bad kyntien la ong ,
translation.en: And the soldiers also mocked him , coming to him , and offering him vinegar ,

translation.kha: Wat khuslai jingkheiñ Elijah u la ong ha ka . pynsuhthied leit bad pynkhreh ïa ka men jong phi . Hynrei nyngkong shet ïa u Ashpenas uba rit na kaei kaba Adrammelekh nonghiarthma bad wanrah ïa u sha nga , thawdur nangta sa shet ïa kaba sah na ka bynta jong pha bad ïa u khun jong pha .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto her , Fear not  ; go and do as thou hast said : but make me thereof a little cake first , and bring it unto me , and after make for thee and for thy son .

translation.kha: Khunlangbrot Blei Linos la ong ha nga , Ko khun u briew , Jinglait briew ka pynleit ki long kum kine ki shyieng . Ki ong ba ki la tyrkhong , kamra kano kano ka jingkyrmen bad ym don shuh ka lawei .
translation.en: Then he said unto me , Son of man , these bones are the whole house of Israel : behold , they say , Our bones are dried , and our hope is lost : we are cut off for our parts .

translation.kha: Ki ap ïa ka , jingïap hynrei kam wan satia ; ki kham mon ban jied ïa ka jingtep ban ïa ka spah .
translation.en: Which long for death , but it cometh not  ; and dig for it more than for hid treasures  ;

translation.kha: Ha kano ka phi kamra thiah ?
translation.en: In which room did you sleep ?
But unto the damsel thou shalt do nothing  ; there is in the damsel no sin worthy of death : for as when a man riseth against his neighbour , and slayeth him , even so is this matter :
translation.kha: Ym dei ban leh ei ei ïa kata ka briew , namar kam shym la leh ïa ka pop ba ka dei ban ïap , naba kane ka kam ka ïasyriem kum ïa kato kaba u briew u shoh bad pynïap ïa uwei pat u briew .

U 65 leit sha u Rangbah Lyngdoh , Jehohanan u la pan ïa ki shithi pynithuh kylla-kaba-mut bneng synagog kiba ha Damaskos , khnang ba lada jinglui lap ïano ïano hangta kiba bud ijakhlia Jedidah Lynti jong Tamar Trai , bahok Shan Sngewbha kem ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei bad wallam nongdie ïa ki sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues , that if he found any of this way , whether they were men or women , he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Shisha kumba symbai u lung bad san , U Trai Nongsynshar un ïada ïa ki briew jong u , bad ki baroh kin ïaroh ïa u .
translation.en: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud , and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth  ; so the Lord  God  will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations .

Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you : they make you vain : they speak a vision of their own heart , and not out of the mouth of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ha ki briew ka Jerusalem :  Wat sngap ïa kaei kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ; ki pyndap ïa phi da ki jingkyrmen bymshisha . Ki ïathuh ïa phi ïa kaei kaba ki shu mutdur bad ym ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .

translation.en: The word that the  Lord  spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha nga shaphang ka nongbah Babilon bad ki briew jong ka :

translation.en: Because they have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands  ; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place , and shall not be quenched .
translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ïa nga bad ki la ai jingkñia ha kiwei ki blei , bad kumta ki la pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar jong nga da baroh kaba ki la leh . Ka jingbitar jong nga ka la khie buk , bad ngan ym pynjah kumto .

translation.en: Let us go up against Judah , and vex it , and let us make a breach therein for us , and set a king in the midst of it , even the son of Tabeal :
translation.kha: Ki la thmu ban hiarthma ïa ka Judah , ban pyntieng ïa ki briew ban ïasoh ha ka liang jong ki , bad nangta ban buh ïa u khun jong u Tabeel halor ka khet .

To ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta kane kan halor hap u Joab bad ka longïing jong baroh u ! Ha kawei pa kawei ka pateng to yn don u shynrang ha ka longïing u jong uba , don ka jingpang ñiangkulia lane ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh kaba shyrkhei lane uba hap ban trei tang ïa ka kam ba trei ki kynthei lane uba shah pynïap ha thma ka lane uba kyrduh bam !
translation.en: Let it rest on the head of Joab , and on all his father s house  ; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue , or that is a leper , or that leaneth on a staff , or that falleth on the sword , or that lacketh bread .

And I will turn your feasts into mourning , and all your songs into lamentation  ; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins , and baldness upon every head  ; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son , and the end thereof as a bitter day .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi sha ki jingtep briew bad ngan pynkylla ïa ki jingrwai kmen jong phi sha ki jingïam sngewsih . Ngan pynlong ïa phi ba phin khi lyndum ïa la ka khlieh bad phin phong ka jaiñ khain , bad phin long kum ki kmie ki kpa kiba ïambriew na ka bynta u khun ba tang marwei jong ki . Kata ka sngi kan long kaba kthang haduh kaba kut .
U Ahimelekh u la kylli na U Trai ïa kaei ba u Dabid u dei ban , bad nangta u la ai katto katne ka jingbam ha u Dabid bad ïa ka waitlam u Goliath u nong Philistia .
translation.en: And he enquired of the  Lord  for him , and gave him victuals , and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine .
For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name : I have not sent them , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ki jinglamler ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong nga . Ngam shym phah ïa ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .’
Ka jingbam jong nga , U Jisu u la ha ki , long ban kohnguh ïa mon jong uba la phah ïa nga bad ban pyndep ïa ka kam kaba la ai ha nga ban leh .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto them ,  My meat is to do the will of him that sent me , and to finish his work .

translation.kha: Ha kane rukom U Trai u la pyllait im ïa u Hesekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem ka bor u Sennakherib u ka Assyria , bad na ki jong ki . U ai ba ki briew kin im ka jingsuk bad ri kiba marjan
translation.en: Thus the  Lord  saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria , and from the hand of all other , and guided them on every side .

translation.kha: Hynrei ai ïa kaei kaba hapoh khuri ki bad ki pliang jong phi ha kiba duk , bad kiei kiei baroh kin kiba long khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: But rather give alms of such things as ye have  ; and , behold , all things are clean unto you .

translation.kha: Kumno nga lah ban leh kata ïa ? U Samuel u kylli . Lada u u Saul ïohsngew ïa kata , un pynïap ïa nga ! U Trai u jubab , Shim ïa u khun masi bad ba ong me don hangta ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh ha U Trai .
translation.en: And Samuel said , How can I go ? if Saul hear it , he will kill me . And the  Lord  said , Take an heifer with thee , and say , I am come to sacrifice to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Blei U la u ong , Ko khun u briew , bam ïa kane ka kot kli , nangta leit bad kren ha ki paid Israel .
translation.en: Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , eat that thou findest  ; eat this roll , and go speak unto the house of Israel .
Then came Peter to him , and said , Lord , how oft shall my brother sin against me , and I forgive him ? till seven times ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la wan sha U Jisu bad u la kylli ,  Ko Trai , lada u hynmen u para jong nga u ïai leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , haduh katno sien nga dei ban map ïa u ? Haduh hynñiew sien ?

U syiem u la ong ha ki , Nga la kut jingmut ba phi ban dei ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingphohsniew bad nangta ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong . ka Lada lah phim , ngan phah tar ïa ka kti ka kjat jong phi kawei na kawei pat bad ngan pynlong ki ïa ïing jong phi ka kynton ki jingjot .
translation.en: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans , The thing is gone from me : if ye will not make known unto me the dream , with the interpretation thereof , ye shall be cut in pieces , and your houses shall be made a dunghill .
And in that day did the Lord  God  of hosts call to weeping , and to mourning , and to baldness , and to girding with sackcloth :
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la khot ïa phi ha kato ka por ban ïam bad ïam pangnud , ban khi ïa ki khlieh jong phi bad ban phong ki jaiñ khain .

translation.en: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment : who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain :
translation.kha: me tap ïa lade da ka jingshai . Me pyiar ïa ki bneng kum ka ïingjaiñ

translation.en: But Jesus called them to him , and saith unto them ,  Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them  ; and their great ones exercise authority upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki baroh sha u bad u la ong ,  Phi tip ba ki briew ïa kiba la ñiew kum ki nongsynshar jong kita kiba mane blei thala , ki leh donbor halor jong ki , bad ki nongïalam ki don ïa ka bor nadong shadong .

translation.en: And ye are risen up against my father s house this day , and have slain his sons , threescore and ten persons , upon one stone , and have made Abimelech , the son of his maidservant , king over the men of Shechem , because he is your brother  ; )
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta phi phai pyrshah ïa ka longïing jong i pa jong nga . Phi la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong i — hynñiewphew ngut ki rangbah halor uwei u maw — bad namar ba u Abimelekh , u khun ba i ïoh na ka shakri jong i , u dei uba ha ïing jong phi , phi la pynlong ïa u , u syiem ka Shekhem .

translation.en: And if he have no daughter , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren .
translation.kha: Lada um don khun kynthei , ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u kin ïohpateng ïa ka .

translation.en: Then all the children of Israel , and all the people , went up , and came unto the house of God , and wept , and sat there before the  Lord  , and fasted that day until even , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki briew ka Israel ki leit kiew sha Bethel bad ki ïamkthang . Ki shong hangta ha khmat U  Trai  bad kim shym bam ei ei haduh janmiet . Ki kñia ki jingainguh ïasyllok bad ki thang ïa ki jingainguh pynïasuk — baroh ha jingdon ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen  ; they shall go into thickets , and climb up upon the rocks : every city shall be forsaken , and not a man dwell therein .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingsawa jong ki shipai shong kulai bad jong ki nongsiatkhnam , uwei uwei baroh u phet krad . Katto katne kin phet sha khlaw , kiwei kin ïakiew shajrong hapdeng ki mawsiang . Ïa kawei pa kawei ka shnong yn iehnoh thylli , bad yn ym don uno uno u ban shong ban sah pat ha ki .

translation.en: Also they reported his good deeds before me , and uttered my words to him . And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïakren ha khmat jong nga shaphang baroh ki kam babha kiba u Tobiah u la leh bad ki ïathuh ha u ïa kiei kiei baroh ba nga la kren . Bad u ïai phah ïa nga ki shithi ban pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa nga .
Ka burom jong u kan kah ïa na jong ka bad pynlong ïa ka , ka shngain , kaba la da na u bad ka erïong .
translation.en: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat , and for a place of refuge , and for a covert from storm and from rain .

translation.kha: U Joseph u Nongrim thied ïa thai jaiñ linen , u la pynhiar ïa ka met shapoh , u la sop ïa ka da ka jaiñ , bad u Geshur buh ïa boi ha phad jingtep ïa pynmih la lah tih ha khliehduh mawsiang . Nangta u Tad ïa u Arab uba heh ha ka jaka rung Topas syiar jingtep .
translation.en: And he bought fine linen , and took him down , and wrapped him in the linen , and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock , and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre .
And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ki dkhot jong ki balang ha Judia kim pat ithuh ïa nga markhmat .

translation.en: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees , and told them what things Jesus had done .

translation.en: And these are they which are sown among thorns  ; such as hear the word ,

translation.en: Ye lust , and have not : ye kill , and desire to have , and cannot obtain : ye fight and war , yet ye have not , because ye ask not .

translation.en: Notwithstanding , that I be not further tedious unto thee , I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words .

translation.kha: Lada ki kpa lane ki hynmen shynrang jong ki , ki wan ban ïeng pyrshah ïa phi , phi lah ban ong , ‘ Sngewbha shah ba kin don bad ngi , namar ngim shym shim ïa ki na phi ha ka madan thma ban long ki tnga jong ngi . translation.en: Moreover when ye fast , be not , as the hypocrites , of a sad countenance : for they disfigure their faces , that they may appear unto men to fast . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .

Hato kane ka i kumba nga pyrshang ban ïoh jingpynshisha na u briew ? , ym Kaei nga kwah ka long ban pynshisha na U Blei! Hato nga pyrshang pynsngewbha ïa ki briew ? Lada nga dang long uba pyrshang ban kumta , ngam pat long u shakri U Khrist .
translation.en: For do I now persuade men , or God ? or do I seek to please men ? for if I yet pleased men , I should not be the servant of Christ .

translation.kha: Haba ka por la ka poi ban lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa u mraw sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang ïa ka la bynta na ka jinglum soh .
translation.en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant , that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard .

translation.en: And when he had given him licence , Paul stood on the stairs , and beckoned with the hand unto the people . And when there was made a great silence , he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue , saying ,
The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness  ; but of every one that is hasty only to want .
translation.kha: Da thmu bha bad phin ïoh kyrhai ; lada phi leh kyrkieh palat phin nym dap biang .

translation.en: And , behold , two blind men sitting by the way side , when they heard that Jesus passed by , cried out , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .

translation.en: But Peter said unto him , Thy money perish with thee , because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim :

translation.en: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God , and the name of Jesus Christ , they were baptized , both men and women .

translation.en: That this is a rebellious people , lying children , children that will not hear the law of the  Lord  :

translation.en: Just as a shepherd diligently cares for each one of his sheep , the elders try to get to know every member of the congregation individually . —Proverbs 27 :23 .

U shahshkor ïa nga , man ka por ba nga khot khublei! ïa u .
translation.en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me , therefore will I call upon him as long as I live .

translation.kha: To ïa pynrem ki na ka ka bynta jingbymman jong ki baroh ; to pynshitom ïa ki kumba me la pynshitom ïa nga na ka bynta pop ki jong nga . Nga ud ha ka jingjynjar , bad nga pang ha ka dohnud jong nga .

And now , though thou wouldest needs be gone , because thou sore longedst after thy father s house , yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods ?

translation.en: He answered and said , I will not : but afterward he repented , and went .

translation.en: But I wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted before the heathen , among whom they were , in whose sight I made myself known unto them , in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt .

miaw tip ka mut aïu ban sheptieng Khroh U Trai , bad kumta ngi pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa kiwei . U Blei u tip lut shaphang jong ngi , bad nga kyrmen ba ha ki dohnud jong thaw , phi tip ïa nga kumjuh .
translation.en: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord , we persuade men ; but we are made manifest unto God ; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences .

translation.en: And likewise also the men , leaving the natural use of the woman , burned in their lust one toward another ; men with men working that which is unseemly , and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet .

translation.en: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place , and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand : and they entered into the city , and took it , and hasted and set the city on fire .

translation.en: And he said , My son shall not go down with you  ; for his brother is dead , and he is left alone : if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go , then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave .

translation.en: And David said unto him , Thy blood be upon thy head  ; for thy mouth hath testified against thee , saying , I have slain the  Lord s  anointed .

translation.en: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart , to think that all the king s sons are dead : for Amnon only is dead .

translation.en: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee , O Egypt , upon Pharaoh , and upon all his servants .

translation.en: Thou hast covered with anger , and persecuted us : thou hast slain , thou hast not pitied .

translation.kha: U Jisu u long u briew u bajanai kum u Adam .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , My spirit shall not always strive with man , for that he also is flesh : yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan ym shah ïa ki briew ban im junom , ki long kiba dei ban ïap . Nangne sha khmat kin im ym palat ïa ka shispah arphew snem .
Lada u u shongkurim ïa ka briew bad sa ïa ka kmie jong ka ban thang im ïa , kan duh kan dam kam hapdeng jong phi .
translation.en: And if a man take a wife and her mother , it is wickedness : they shall be burnt with fire , both he and they  ; that there be no wickedness among you .
I will call on the  Lord  , who is worthy to be praised : so shall I be saved from mine enemies .
translation.kha: Nga khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun jong nga . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
Katba U Jisu u dang ka duriaw , u la ïohi ar ngut nongtong , u u u u Andriw dang ïatong da ka jar .
translation.en: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee , he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .
Their roaring shall be like a lion , they shall roar like young lions : yea , they shall roar , and lay hold of the prey , and shall carry it away safe , and none shall deliver it .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki kyrhuh kum ki sing kiba la pynïap ïa ka mrad bad kiba la rong ïa ka sha ka jaka ha kaba ym don ba lah ban knieh ïa ka na ki .

translation.en: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim , whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la pynlong syiem ïa u Sedekaïah , u khun jong u Josaïah u syiem ka Judah , ha ka jaka u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Ahab heard those words , that he rent his clothes , and put sackcloth upon his flesh , and fasted , and lay in sackcloth , and went softly .
translation.kha: Haba u Elijah u la dep kren , u Ahab u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ , u la law ïa ki bad u phong da ki jaiñ khain . Um treh bam , u thiah ha ka jaiñ khain , bad u leit phai da kaba khuslai bad rit mynsiem .
u syiem un mihpaw . Un synshar halor hima bakhraw bad un ïa kaei kaba u kwah .
translation.en: And a mighty king shall stand up , that shall rule with great dominion , and do according to his will .

translation.kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah synshar jong u Pharaoh ki la sheptieng namar kaei kaba U Trai u la kren bad , ki wan noh ïalam kloi ïa la ki mraw bad ïa la ki jingri shapoh ïing .
translation.en: He that feared the word of the  Lord  among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses :
How canst thou say , I am not polluted , I have not gone after Baalim ? see thy way in the valley , know what thou hast done : thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways  ;
translation.kha: Kumno me lah ban ong ba mem shym la pyntngit ïa lade , ba mem pat ju mane ïa u Baal ? Ha khmih kumno me la leh pop ha ka them ; ha peit kaei me la leh . Me long kum ka ut khlaw ha ka por jingkwah shongkha jong ka , kaba mareh laitluid kylleng ,

translation.en: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace ! O Judah , keep thy solemn feasts , perform thy vows : for the wicked shall no more pass through thee  ; he is utterly cut off .
translation.kha: Ha khmih , u nonglamktien u wan halor ki lumbah lem bad ka khubor kaba bha ! U don ha la ka lynti ban pynbna ïa ka jingjop ! Ko ki paid Judah , to rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi bad to ai ha U Blei ïa kaei kaba phi la kular kyntang ha u . U bymman da lei lei ruh un ym hiarthma shuh ïa ka ri jong phi . La pynjot thiaw ïa ki baroh !
To shahshkor ïa nga , phi baroh ! Ki don ki jingshyrkhei , ki liewlep , ki bad jingriam kiba ap ïa phi .
translation.en: Fear , and the pit , and the snare , are upon thee , O inhabitant of the earth .
But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink  ; and commanded the prophets , saying , Prophesy not .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi la pynlong ïa ki Nasir ban dih waiñ , bad phi la hukum ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban ym kren ïa ka khubor jong nga .

translation.en: And forgive us our sins  ; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us . And lead us not into temptation  ; but deliver us from evil .
translation.kha: To map ïa ki pop jong ngi , naba ngi map ïa uwei pa uwei uba leh bakla ïa ngi . Bad wat ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingtynjuh kaba eh .’
Ai ba ka jingieit baneh jong me kan pyntngen ïa nga , kumba me donnam syier ïa nga , u shakri jong me jingïasngewtynnat
translation.en: Let , I pray thee , thy merciful kindness be for my comfort , according to thy word unto thy servant .

translation.kha: Ai ba baroh mane ïa u kin ong , Ka jong u ka bymjukut .
translation.en: Let them now that fear the  Lord  say , that his mercy endureth for ever .
For we are in danger to be called in question for this day s uproar , there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse .
translation.kha: Naba hadien kaei kaba la jia mynta ka sngi , ka don ka jingma ba yn mudui ïa ngi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin . Ym don kano kano ka jingmap na ka bynta kane ka jingkhihwin , bad ngim lah ban ai kano kano ka daw kaba dei na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk , and curdled me like cheese ?
translation.kha: Me la ai ka bor ïa u kpa jong nga ba un pynkha ïa nga , Me la pynlong ïa nga ban san ha ka kpoh ka kmie jong nga .

translation.en: And they cried out all at once , saying , Away with this man , and release unto us Barabbas :
translation.kha: Ki paidbah baroh ki la pyrta ,  Pynïap ïa u ! Pyllait ïa u Barabbas ha ngi !

translation.en: He cried aloud , and said thus , Hew down the tree , and cut off his branches , shake off his leaves , and scatter his fruit : let the beasts get away from under it , and the fowls from his branches :
translation.kha: U la pynbna ha ka sur bajam , ‘ Pom ïa u dieng bad khet noh ïa ki tnat jong u ; sloit ïa ki sla jong u bad pynsaphriang ïa ki soh jong u . Beh noh ïa ki mrad napoh jong u bad ïa ki sim na ki tnat jong u .

translation.en: All his days also he eateth in darkness , and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness .
translation.kha: Ngi ïoh ban im ka jingim jong ngi ha ka jingdum bad ka jingsngewsih kthang , ngi khuslai , bitar bad ïohpang .

translation.en: And they were both righteous before God , walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless .
translation.kha: Baroh ar ngut ki im ka jingim kaba bha ha khmat U Blei bad ki la kohnguh lut ïa baroh ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong U Trai .

translation.en: And Esther spake yet again before the king , and fell down at his feet , and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite , and his device that he had devised against the Jews .
translation.kha: Nangta ka Esther ka kren biang ha u syiem da kaba dem ha ki kjat jong u bad ïam . Ka kyrpad ïa u ban leh ei ei ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingsylla basniew kaba u Haman , uba hiarpateng na u Agag , pyrshah ïa ki Jiw .
Bad Isaïah u pyrta shaphang ki : Wat lada ki paid Israel ki bun kat u shyiap harud pynban tang khyndiat na ki pynim ;
translation.en: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel , Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea , a remnant shall be saved :

translation.kha: Bad ki briew jong U Bahakhlieh Blei Tam Eh kin ïohpdiang ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem bad ban bat ïa ka junom la junom .
translation.en: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom , and possess the kingdom for ever , even for ever and ever .

translation.kha: bad jingpynkhlaiñ u nongpdiang ïa phi , uba la khot sngewbha ïa phi baroh Phira” ngut , un hap wan bad ong borabor phi Abishag ‘ Ai noh ha u ïa kane ba-ïashun jaka shong .’ Nangta phin basohsat bad wan ban shong ha ka Olib ba hapoh eh .
translation.en: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee , Give this man place  ; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room .

translation.kha: bad ïa ki Hor ha ki lumbah jong Edom , bad thwet ïa ki haduh Elparan kaba harud ka shyiap .
translation.en: And the Horites in their mount Seir , unto El–paran , which is by the wilderness .

Come now therefore , I pray thee , curse me this people  ; for they are too mighty for me : peradventure I shall prevail , that we may smite them , and that I may drive them out of the land : for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed , and he whom thou cursest is cursed .
translation.kha: Ki kham bun paid ban ïa ngi ; kumta sngewbha wan bad tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga . Ïoh lehse ngin lah ban jop ïa ki bad beh noh ïa ki na kane ka ri . Nga tip ba haba phi pynbna ka jingkyrkhu , ki briew ki ïoh ka jingkyrkhu , bad haba phi pynbna ka jingtim , la buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingtim .

translation.en: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David , saying , Bring him up to me in the bed , that I may slay him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Saul u phah biang ïa ki ba kin da leit peit da lade ïa u Dabid . U hukum ïa ki ,  Rah lang ïa u hangne ha ka jingthiah jong u bad ngan pynïap ïa u .
U Trai Baroh la ai ïa ka khubor ha u :
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  of hosts came to me , saying ,

translation.kha: Kan ym long kum ka ïa nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki kata ka sngi ha kaba nga la btin ïa bad la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka Ijipt . Kim shym ïaineh ka jutang kaba nga pynlong bad ki , bad ngam shym shahshkor ïa ki .
translation.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt  ; because they continued not in my covenant , and I regarded them not , saith the Lord .

translation.kha: Ha u Darius patsha , to synshar ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: They sent a letter unto him , wherein was written thus  ; Unto Darius the king , all peace .

translation.kha: Haba kane ka jingkheiñbriew kaba ka nyngkong la jia , u Kyrinios u long u lyngskor jong ka Syria .
translation.en: ( And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria . )
Am I not an apostle ? am I not free ? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord ? are not ye my work in the Lord ?
translation.kha: Hato ngam long u briew uba laitluid ? Hato ngam long u Apostol ? Hato ngam shym la ïohi ïa U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi ? Hato phi phim long u soh ka jingtrei jong nga na ka bynta U Trai ?

translation.en: Then spake Solomon , The  Lord  said that he would dwell in the thick darkness .
translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u duwai :  Me , A  Trai  , me la buh ïa ka sngi ha ka sahit bneng , pynban me la jied ban shong ha ki lyoh bad ka jingdum .
Un Ashtaroth kum u dieng Jingpynshitom uba duh noh ïa ki soh ki bym pat ih ; kum dalade dieng Olib uba hap noh ki jingda .
translation.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine , and shall cast off his flower as the olive .

translation.kha: Kaba nongkyndong kaba phi don shuwa ba ngan wan ka la roi kyrhai , Ethkasin U Trai u la diengtied ïa phi kat shaba nga leit . Mynta ka milimitar dei ka por :4 nga ban peit sa na bynta ïa lade ïasnohkti
translation.en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came , and it is now increased unto a multitude  ; and the  Lord  hath blessed thee since my coming : and now when shall I provide for mine own house also ?

The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us ( not the putting away of the filth of the flesh , but the answer of a good conscience toward God , ) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: kaba long ka dak kaba kdew sha ka jingpynbaptis , kaba pyllait im ïa phi mynta . Kam dei ka jingsait noh ïa ka jakhlia na ka met , hynrei ka jingkular ba la pynlong sha U Blei na ka jingïatiplem babha . Ka pynim ïa phi da ka jingmihpat jong U Jisu Khrist ,

Ha kajuh ka por , u Adummim u jait jingbhabriew khlieh pynïeng la ka dara marjan ïa ka Kedesh Gad u ter Sning ha Saanannim . shongkurim la kynriah Harnepher Lystra kiwei pat ki jait Ken , ki khun ki henna jong u Hobab , u shongdor shano u Moses .
translation.en: Now Heber the Kenite , which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses , had severed himself from the Kenites , and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanannim , which is by Kedesh .
And he went through the cities and villages , teaching , and journeying toward Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit lyngba ki nongbah bad ki nongrit , u da hikai ïa ki briew bad u da thew ïa la ka lynti sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And I gave thee thy master s house , and thy master s wives into thy bosom , and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah  ; and if that had been too little , I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha me ïa ka hima jong u bad ïa ki tnga jong u ; nga la pynlong ïa me u syiem halor ki Israel bad ki Judah . Lada kane kam pat biang , ngan jin da la ai shuh sa ar shah ïa me .

translation.en: Take heed , brethren , lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief , in departing from the living God .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , to sumar ïoh ba uno uno na phi u don ka dohnud kaba sniew eh bad bymngeit kat haduh ba un da phai dien noh na U Blei uba im .
Ngan map ïa ki jingbakla baroh threw pha la leh , hynrei phan kynmaw syrngiew ki bad sngewlehrain palat ban ang ïa la ka shyntur . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: That thou mayest remember , and be confounded , and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame , when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done , saith the Lord  God .
I have laid a snare for thee , and thou art also taken , O Babylon , and thou wast not aware : thou art found , and also caught , because thou hast striven against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko Babilonia , pha ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , bad pha la shah riam ha ka jingriam kaba nga la buh ïa pha , wat la pham shym la tip ïa ka .
Ynda ki la pynïap ïa uta Eleasar masi , ki ïalam ïa uta pynkhlad basohsat sha u Eli .
translation.en: And they slew a bullock , and brought the child to Eli .

translation.kha: Hynrei Simon u bad ki paralok jong u ki la leit wad ïa u ,
translation.en: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him .

translation.kha: Nangta shibun ki nongïathuhlypa lamler kin mih bad kin shukor ïa ki briew kiba . bun
translation.en: And many false prophets shall rise , and shall deceive many .
When Israel went out of Egypt , the house of Jacob from a people of strange language  ;
translation.kha: Mynba ki Israel ki la mihnoh na Ijipt , mynba ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob ki la mihnoh na kata ka ri nongwei ,
Ar ngut kham bha ban ïa kaba marwei , namar ryngkat lang ki lah ban trei shibun .
translation.en: Two are better than one  ; because they have a good reward for their labour .
The ants are a people not strong , yet they prepare their meat in the summer  ;
translation.kha: ki dkhiew : ki dei kiba tlot , hynrei ki kynshew ïa la ka jingbam mynlyiur ;
Pyntreikam ïa kaba phi la nang bad ïohpdiang na nga , na ki ktien jong nga bad ki jong nga . Bad U Blei uba ai ha ngi ka jingsuk , un long lem bad phi .
translation.en: Those things , which ye have both learned , and received , and heard , and seen in me , do : and the God of peace shall be with you .
And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle  ; and , behold , Miriam became leprous , white as snow : and Aaron looked upon Miriam , and , behold , she was leprous .
translation.kha: bad u lyoh u kynriah noh na ka Ïingjaiñ , hangta hi ka sniehdoh jong ka Miriam ka la tap da ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh bad ka la kylla lieh kum ka ïor . Haba u Aaron u peit ïa ka bad u ïohi ba ka la ngat ïa kata ka jingpang ,

translation.en: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars  ; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory , brought out of the isles of Kittim .
translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ki dieng Sning na Bashan ban shna boitha ; ki shna ïa ka rynsan jong pha na ki kseh ba na Sypros bad pyndait ha ka da ki bniat hati .

translation.en: The fault lies , not with all religion , but with false religion .
translation.kha: Ka jingkynnoh ka long ym ia baroh ki jaitniam , hynrei tang ia kito ki niam kiba kyntiew ia ki kam bymman .
Ki long borabor kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei , kiba telephone shukor , kiba ïai kyntait ïasngewdei shahshkor ïa ki jingieit U Trai .
translation.en: That this is a rebellious people , lying children , children that will not hear the law of the  Lord  :

Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance : for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me , and art gone up  ; thou hast enlarged thy bed , and made thee a covenant with them  ; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it .
translation.kha: Phi pynïeng ïa ki blei ba-ijli ha khmat ka jingkhang ki jingkhang bah ki ïing jong phi . Phi la lyndet ïa nga ; phi law ïa la ki jaiñ bad kiew halor ki jingthiah baheh jong phi ryngkat bad kiba ieit jong phi , ïa kiba phi la siewdor ban ïathiah lang bad ki . Bad hangta phi pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai jong phi .
Ha ka sngi ba nga leh ïa kane , barunar uno uba lait na ka janai un wan bad un ïathuh ha phi shaphang jong ka puson
translation.en: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee , to cause thee to hear it with thine ears ?

Know that thus saith the  Lord  of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David , and of all the people that dwelleth in this city , and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity  ;
translation.kha: Pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong shaphang u syiem uba synshar ïa ka hima kaba u Dabid u la synshar bad shaphang ki briew jong kane ka nongbah , kata , ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi ki bym shym la shah rah noh kum ki koidi lem bad phi .
Hangno phi la ïa tep u ? u la kylli ïa ki . To wan bad peit Ko Trai , ki la jubab .
translation.en: And said ,  Where have ye laid him ?  They said unto him , Lord , come and see .

translation.kha: Bad mynta ka jingpang jong u Naaman kan wan jong halor me , bad ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ïoh kin ïa ka shi junom ! Haba u u Gehasi la mihnoh , u la ïoh ïa jingpang ka — ka sniehdoh jong u ka la lieh kum ka ïor .
translation.en: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee , and unto thy seed for ever . And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow .

translation.kha: Da shisha men ym pynïap kiba hok ryngkat bad ki bymman . Kata ka bym lah ban long . Mem lah ban leh kumta . leh kumta , kiba kin shah pynshitom ryngkat bad ki bymman . Kata ka bym lah ban long . nongbishar jong pyrthei baroh ban lehhok .
translation.en: That be far from thee to do after this manner , to slay the righteous with the wicked : and that the righteous should be as the wicked , that be far from thee : Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right ?
Let brotherly love continue .
translation.kha: To ïaineh ha kaba ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei kum ki parabangeit .
Ngan pynjot ïa phi , ko ki paid Israel ! Te uei lah uba ban ïarap ïa phi ?
translation.en: O Israel , thou hast destroyed thyself  ; but in me is thine help .
For I know the thoughts that I think toward you , saith the  Lord  , thoughts of peace , and not of evil , to give you an expected end .
translation.kha: Tang ma nga hi nga tip ïa ki jingthmu kiba nga don na ka bynta jong phi , ki jingthmu ban wallam ha phi ka jingmanbha bad ym ka jingpynjot , ki jingthmu ban wallam ïa ka lawei kaba phi ap kyrmen .
Kane ka dei kaei ba ngin leh : ngin ïakynting bad sbai ngin jied katto katne ngut ki ban rangbah leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Gibeah .
translation.en: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah  ; we will go up by lot against it  ;

translation.kha: runar la u syiem Tarshish u shong u sah Khyrdop Jerusalem , u leit borabor sha ki Tebeth , na Beersheba shaphang woh shaduh kaba kut jong ka ri lum Ephraim shaphang shatei , khnang ban khot pat ïa ki briew sha U Trai , U Blei jong Persia kpa tymmen Kylleng ki .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem : and he went out again through the people from Beer–sheba to mount Ephraim , and brought them back unto the  Lord  God of their fathers .

translation.kha: U Jisu u khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran u bad u la ai ha ki ka iktiar beh ïa ki mynsiem bymman bad ban pynkhiah ïa pa kawei ka ïa kawei pa kawei ka .
translation.en: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples , he gave them power against unclean spirits , to cast them out , and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease .

translation.kha: U Manoah u ïeng joit u bud ïa la ka tnga . U leit uta u briew bad u kylli Dei ma phi mo briew uba la ïakren ka tnga jong nga ? Ho-oid u jubab .
translation.en: And Manoah arose , and went after his wife , and came to the man , and said unto him , Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman ? And he said , I am .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngin ïa-ong te , “mon u Abraham u kpa , sang meng jaitbynriew jong ngi Assur Kaei ka jingshem jong Kaei ?
translation.en: What shall we say then that Abraham our father , as pertaining to the flesh , hath found ?

The voice of joy , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride , the voice of them that shall say , Praise the  Lord  of hosts : for the  Lord  is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever : and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the  Lord . For I will cause to return the captivity of the land , as at the first , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kine ki jaka phin ïohsngew biang ïa ki jingpyrta jong ka jingkmen bad ka jinglehkmen bad ki jingsawa bakmen jong ki jingïabam khawai shongkurim . Phin ïohsngew ba ki briew ki ïarwai katba ki wallam ïa ki jingainguh thang sha ka Templ jong nga ; kin ïa-ong ,   ‘ To ainguh ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , namar u long uba bha bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .’ Ngan pynlong ïa kane ka ri kaba roi kyrhai kumba mynshuwa . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: All the brethren greet you . Greet ye one another with an holy kiss .
translation.kha: Baroh ki parabangeit hangne ki phah ka jingkhublei . To ïakhublei iwei ïa iwei da ka jingïadoh parabangeit .
U Aaron ong Law noh ïa ki sohshkor ksiar ba ki tnga jong phi , ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi ki deng , wallam ïa ki sha nga .
translation.en: And Aaron said unto them , Break off the golden earrings , which are in the ears of your wives , of your sons , and of your daughters , and bring them unto me .

translation.kha: U pynskhem ïa ki khyrdop jong phi ; u kyrkhu ïa ki jong phi .
translation.en: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates  ; he hath blessed thy children within thee .

And he said , Certainly I will be with thee  ; and this shall be a token unto thee , that I have sent thee : When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt , ye shall serve God upon this mountain .
translation.kha: U Blei u jubab ,  Ngan long lem bad me , bad haba me ïalam noh ïa ki briew jong nga na Ijipt , phin ïamane ïa nga ha une u lum . Kata kan long ka jingpynshisha ba nga la phah ïa me .
U Trai u shkor jingjop ha ki Israel pyrshah ïa ki shipai Benjamin Harod Ki Israel ki pynïap arphew san hajar shispah ngut ki shipai Benjamin ha kata ka sngi ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  smote Benjamin before Israel : and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men : all these drew the sword .

translation.kha: rah noh ïa ki jingri ki bad ki jinglute na shnong jong ki .

translation.en: And saith unto him ,  See thou say nothing to any man : but go thy way , shew thyself to the priest , and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .

translation.en: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge  ; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge .

translation.en: And these are the garments which they shall make  ; a breastplate , and an ephod , and a robe , and a broidered coat , a mitre , and a girdle : and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother , and his sons , that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .

nangta ha ka jingdon U Trai phin ong ïa kine ki : ‘ U tymmen jong nga u dei u Aram uba ïaidwir , uba la leit ïalam ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem sha Ijipt ban shong ban sah . Ki ïadon tang khyndiat eh mynba ki ïadon hangta hynrei ki la man long ka jaitbynriew kaba bun paid bad kaba khrawbor .
translation.en: And thou shalt speak and say before the  Lord  thy God , A Syrian ready to perish was my father , and he went down into Egypt , and sojourned there with a few , and became there a nation , great , mighty , and populous :

translation.en: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us . God is love  ; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God , and God in him .
