translation.kha: Ha ka sngi U Trai , U Mynsiem u pynteh shim ïa nga , Esbon nga la lah Huram ka Ot :2 , prong sawa kum ka turoi , kaba kren na shadien jong nga .
translation.en: I was in the Spirit on the Lord s day , and heard behind me a great voice , as of a trumpet ,

translation.kha: baroh kiwei kiwei pat kiba u u la leh naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut jingsynshar jong , la buh jingthoh ha Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah , first and last , behold , are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel ?
Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres , which indeed appear beautiful outward , but are within full of dead men s bones , and of all uncleanness .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi long kum ki jingtep ba la pushara lieh , kiba itynnat ha kaba shabar hynrei kiba dap da ki shyieng bad ki metïap bapyut ha kaba shapoh .

haduh ba u patsha pynshong un pynsah ïa pat phi ha ka ri kumba ka dei ka jong hi phi ha , kaba don ki bri sohwaiñ ban ai sohwaiñ bad yn don ki kew ban pynlong kpu ; ka dei ka ri ki Olib , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka ngap . Lada phi leh ïa kaei kaba u hukum , phin ym ïap , hynrei phin im Wat . ai ba u Hesekaïah un pynbieit ïa phi ba phin ba pyrkhat U Trai un pyllait im ïa phi .
translation.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of corn and wine , a land of bread and vineyards , a land of oil olive and of honey , that ye may live , and not die : and hearken not unto Hezekiah , when he persuadeth you , saying , The  Lord  will deliver us .
Neither shall he go in to any dead body , nor defile himself for his father , or for his mother  ;
translation.kha: Um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade da kaba leit sha jan ka metïap , wat la ka dei ka jong u kpa ne ka kmie jong u .

translation.en: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof  ; because they have transgressed the laws , changed the ordinance , broken the everlasting covenant .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la pyntngit ïa ka pyrthei da kaba pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei bad da kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong ban neh junom .
Baroh kiba mane bleithaw kin shah pynlehrain , baroh ki blei ki dem ngon ha khmat jong U . Trai
translation.en: Confounded be all they that serve graven images , that boast themselves of idols : worship him , all ye gods .

Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor , and to Shimshai the scribe , and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria , and unto the rest beyond the river , Peace , and at such a time .
translation.kha: U patsha u phah ïa kane ka jubab :  Ha u Rehum , u lat , ha u Shimshai , u sekretari jong ka probins , bad ha ki paralok jong ki kiba shong ha Samaria bad ha kiba sah jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi , ki jingkhublei .
bad hangta law noh ïa ki jaiñkup na lyngdoh u Aaron bad pynkup ïa ki ha u Eleasar . U Aaron un ïap hangta .
translation.en: And strip Aaron of his garments , and put them upon Eleazar his son : and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people , and shall die there .

translation.kha: Kim shym tip ba u Joseph u sngewthuh aïu Iskariot ong , namar ki ïakren bad u par ka jingïarap u nongbatai ktien .
translation.en: And they knew not that Joseph understood them  ; for he spake unto them by an interpreter .
And when ye come into an house , salute it .
translation.kha: Haba phi rung shapoh ka ïing , to ong , ‘ Ka jingsuk lem bad phi .’

translation.en: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers , neither shall any of them that provoked me see it :
translation.kha: Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei ruh sha kata ka ri kaba nga la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Yn ym don uwei ruh na kito kiba la kyntait ïa nga u ban ïohrung sha ka .
U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ïa pahara syiem Ijipt , siaw jinglong ïa ka waitlam u bymlarkam Babilon .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee .
I would they were even cut off which trouble you .
translation.kha: Nga da kwah eh ba ki briew kiba pynkulmar ïa phi kin leit baroh shi lynter lynti ; ai ba kin nang ïaid bad pynthohbria ïa lade!
‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan long ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad la ka para bad la ka para ar kmie Bad u paidbah baroh jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister , the daughter of his father , or the daughter of his mother . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: Kumta hadien khyndai bnai bad arphew sngi ki leit la phai sha Jerusalem , da kaba ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri baroh kawei .
translation.en: So when they had gone through all the land , they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days .

translation.kha: ban ong ha ki , Jied ïa ki nongbah jakarieh nga la hukum u ban ïathuh ha phi .
translation.en: Speak to the children of Israel , saying , Appoint out for you cities of refuge , whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses :

translation.kha: U jinglui jubab , Kine waitsum long ki sawlyer lawar ki dang shu kynthah wan na pangnud Pyntrei ryngkat jong U Trai ka pyrthei Jotham .
translation.en: And the angel answered and said unto me , These are the four spirits of the heavens , which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ki paid Judah ki la long nongjop halor ki Israel , namar ki la ha shaniah U Trai U , Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time , and the children of Judah prevailed , because they relied upon the  Lord  God of their fathers .

translation.kha: Uta u Philistia u sdang ban ïaid sha khmat sha u Dabid lem bad u atiar nongrah uba ïaid ha shuwa jong u .
translation.en: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David  ; and the man that bare the shield went before him .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat nga maham uno uno u briew uba shah ïa lade ban otsher u pynbor ban kohnguh ïa ka Hukum baroh kawei .
translation.en: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised , that he is a debtor to do the whole law .

If a soul commit a trespass , and sin through ignorance , in the holy things of the  Lord   ; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the  Lord  a ram without blemish out of the flocks , with thy estimation by shekels of silver , after the shekel of the sanctuary , for a trespass offering :
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u leh pop khlem tip da kaba kum klet ban wan ai ïa ka jingsiew ba long kyntang sha U  Trai  , un wallam ïa ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat sha U  Trai  da u langbrot ne u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingpynshong dor ïa u kan long kumba la buh .

translation.en: Then shall ye do unto him , as he had thought to have done unto his brother : so shalt thou put the evil away from among you .
translation.kha: u dei ban shah pynshitom kumba u thmu ban leh ïa la u para . Da kumta phin rat noh ïa kane ka jingbymman .

translation.en: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways .
translation.kha: U briew uba kum uta , um lah ban kut jingmut bad ban rai ha kiei kiei baroh ba u leh , um dei ban pyrkhat ba un sa ïohpdiang ei ei na U Trai .
namar ki ki ksiew kynthei u khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u ki la ïoh . ka ri Gilead la ai ha kiba sah ki khun ki ksiew u
translation.en: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons : and the rest of Manasseh s sons had the land of Gilead .
Ye shall conceive chaff , ye shall bring forth stubble : your breath , as fire , shall devour you .
translation.kha: Phi pynlong ïa ki jingthmu bymlarkam bad kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh ki long ki bym don jingmyntoi . U Mynsiem jong nga u long kum ka ding ka ban pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: I will answer thee , and thy companions with thee .
translation.kha: Ngan jubab ïa me bad ïa ki paralok jong me ruh .

translation.en: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ki angel , te , ka briew ka dei ban don ka jingda halor la ka khlieh ban pyn-i ba ka long hapoh ka bor u tnga jong ka .

translation.en: The glasses , and the fine linen , and the hoods , and the veils .
translation.kha: ïa ki jaiñ bastang jong ki , ki rumal linen jong ki , bad ïa ki jaiñ teh ryndang bad ki jaiñtapkhmat kiba jrong kiba ki tap ha ki khlieh jong ki .

translation.en: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets , and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te ïa ki samla shynrang jong ka yn pynïap ha ki surok bah jong ka nongbah , bad ki shipai jong ka baroh yn pynjot ha kata ka sngi . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
ki maw kin pynkynmaw ïa briew ïa kaei u la leh Hadien habud , haba ki khun ki kti phi ki kylli aïu kine ki maw mut ,
translation.en: That this may be a sign among you , that when your children ask their fathers in time to come , saying , What mean ye by these stones ?

translation.kha: Lai sngi hadien , katba kita ki rangbah ki dang ïa-ud pang na jingotsher ka jong ki , ar ngut na ki khun shynrang u Jakob , Simeon u bad u Lebi , ki hynmen shynrang jong ka Dinah , ki la shim la ïa ki waitlam bad ki leit rung shapoh ka nongbah , bad pynïap ki lut ïa ki shynrang baroh , kynthup ïa u Hamor bad u u Shekhem khun jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the third day , when they were sore , that two of the sons of Jacob , Simeon and Levi , Dinah s brethren , took each man his sword , and came upon the city boldly , and slew all the males .

Then shall ye know that I am the  Lord  , when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars , upon every high hill , in all the tops of the mountains , and under every green tree , and under every thick oak , the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols .
translation.kha: Ïa ki metïap yn pynsaphriang hapdeng ki bleithaw bad sawdong ki duwan , yn pynsaphriang halor uwei pa uwei u lum uba jrong , ha kliar uwei pa uwei u lumbah , ha trai uwei pa uwei u dieng jyrngam bad uwei pa uwei u dieng Sning uba heh , ha ki jaka baroh ba ki thang ïa ki jingkñia ïa ki bleithaw jong ki .

translation.en: And caused me to pass by them round about : and , behold , there were very many in the open valley  ; and , lo , they were very dry .
translation.kha: U la pynïaid ïa nga sawdong ka them , bad nga la ïohi ba la don shibun bah ki shyieng bad ki long kiba la tyrkhong bha .
Hangta ha ka shyiap Sinai Trai u hukum ïa u Moses
translation.en: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof , wherewith they minister about it , even the censers , the fleshhooks , and the shovels , and the basins , all the vessels of the altar  ; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers  skins , and put to the staves of it .

translation.kha: Ong ha ki Israel , Ha sngi kaba jong u bnai uba , rakhe ïa ka ka sngi shongthait kaba kyrpang , bad haba turoi ka sawa , wan ïalumlang ban mane Blei .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , In the seventh month , in the first day of the month , shall ye have a sabbath , a memorial of blowing of trumpets , an holy convocation .
And they have not cried unto me with their heart , when they howled upon their beds : they assemble themselves for corn and wine , and they rebel against me .
translation.kha: Kim shym la duwai ha nga naduh la ka dohnud , hynrei pynban ki bret ïa lade ha madan bad ïam pangnud kumba leh kiba mane blei thala . Haba ki duwai ban ïoh ïa u kew bad ka waiñ , ki ot pynmong ïa lade kum kiba mane blei thala . A haduh katno ki long kiba ïaleh pyrshah !

Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei kaba kum ki Israel , ïa kiba me la pyllait im na ka jinglongmraw ban pynlong ïa ki , ki briew jong me hi . Kiei kiba kiei khraw bad kiba phylla me la leh na ka bynta jong ki , ki la pynphriang ïa ka nam jong kylleng me satlak ka pyrthei . la Me beh noh ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad ïa ki blei jong ki katba ki briew jong me ki nang ïaid shaphrang , ki briew ïa kiba me la pyllaitluid Ijipt ban na long ki jong me hi .
translation.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people , even like Israel , whom God went to redeem for a people to himself , and to make him a name , and to do for you great things and terrible , for thy land , before thy people , which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt , from the nations and their gods ?

translation.kha: Men leh ïa ka Ai bad ïa syiem jong ka me la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad u syiem jong ka , hynrei kane ka sien lah ban bat ha lade ïa ki mar ki mata bad ïa jingri jong ka na ka bynta ïa lade Pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah da ka jingkyndit na lyndet jong ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king : only the spoil thereof , and the cattle thereof , shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves : lay thee an ambush for the city behind it .
They have belied the  Lord  , and said , It is not he  ; neither shall evil come upon us  ; neither shall we see sword nor famine :
translation.kha: Ki briew jong U  Trai  ki la len ïa u bad ki la ong ,  Un ym leh ei ei da shisha . Ngin ym mad ïa ki por ba-eh ; ngin ym mad ïa ka thma lane ka  nemsniew .

translation.en: And the dove came in to him in the evening  ; and , lo , in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off : so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth .
translation.kha: Ha ka por janmiet , kata ka paro ka wan phai pat sha u , ka da wanrah ha la ka shyntur ïa u sla dieng Olib ba dang shu kheit . Kumta u Noah u tip ba ka um ka la rngad .
Hynrei Markos pynkheiñ kan poi haba ïa u nongleitkurim yn shim lymda na ki , te kin sa shahjingit .
translation.en: But the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them , and then shall they fast in those days .
And she spake out with a loud voice , and said , Blessed art thou among women , and blessed is the fruit of thy womb .
translation.kha: bad ka la ong ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Pha long ka kynthei kaba la kyrkhu na baroh ki kynthei , bad long ba la kyrkhu ita i khunlung iba phan sa kha !
Katto katne na u symbai ki la hap ha ka jaka maw , bad haba ki jingthung ki la shylluit , thuh Nongrim Naaran noh namar ka Aiu kam don kano kano ka jingsngem .
translation.en: And some fell upon a rock  ; and as soon as it was sprung up , it withered away , because it lacked moisture .
And he said , Put thine hand into thy bosom again . And he put his hand into his bosom again  ; and plucked it out of his bosom , and , behold , it was turned again as his other flesh .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ,  Bsuh biang ïa kato ka kti jong me shapoh ka jaiñkup jong me .  U ruh u leh kumta , bad haba u sei ïa ka , u ïohi ba ka la koit pat , kumba ka long mynshuwa .
Namarkata lada , ka balang baroh kawei ka ïaseng lang bad baroh ki ban kren da ki thylliej bapher — bad lada riewpaidbah ki bymngeit rung hapoh , hato kin nym ong ba phi la ïalamwir ?
translation.en: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place , and all speak with tongues , and there come in those that are unlearned , or unbelievers , will they not say that ye are mad ?
As he spake to our fathers , to Abraham , and to his seed for ever .
translation.kha: U la kynmaw ban pyn-i jingisynei ha u Abraham bad ha baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u junom !

Ngan wan ïalam pat ïa ki briew jong nga sha la ka ri . Kin sa tei pat ïa ki shnong ba jot bad kin shong hangta ; kin thung ki bri sohwaiñ bad kin dih ïa waiñ ; kin thung jingthung ki kper , kin bam kaei kaba mih .
translation.en: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel , and they shall build the waste cities , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and drink the wine thereof  ; they shall also make gardens , and eat the fruit of them .

translation.kha: Nangta ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , ki da ïaid tawiar ïa ka ri Edom bad ka ri Moab ba haduh kin da poi ha ka dong mihngi jong ka ri Moab , sha shiliang ka wah Arnon . Ki dara sher hangta , hynrei kim shym jam ka ïa Arnon namar u dei u pud Moab ki .
translation.en: Then they went along through the wilderness , and compassed the land of Edom , and the land of Moab , and came by the east side of the land of Moab , and pitched on the other side of Arnon , but came not within the border of Moab : for Arnon was the border of Moab .

translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar un wan bad jop ïa ka Ijipt . Kito ki briew kine liat babe ban ïap na ka jaitniam kin ïap Wai ka jingpang , kito kiba dei ba bha ïalam kum Bashti koidi yn ïalam ïa ki kum bashapoh koidi , bad kito kiba la ïadat twad sha Asaph Ebed ka thma kin ïap ha ka thma Khim
translation.en: And when he cometh , he shall smite the land of Egypt , and deliver such as are for death to death  ; and such as are for captivity to captivity  ; and such as are for the sword to the sword .

translation.kha: Kan ïa phi ka pyrthei kiba ïap ; lynti ba ka ïaid ka ka lynti sha ka jingïap
translation.en: Her feet go down to death  ; her steps take hold on hell .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki rangbah synshar ki Assyria u ïathuh ïa ki , ba u nongsynshar u kwah ban kaei tip kaba pynlong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ban . sngewskhem
translation.en: And Rab–shakeh said unto them , Speak ye now to Hezekiah , Thus saith the great king , the king of Assyria , What confidence is this wherein thou trustest ?

translation.kha: ong ha la ki briew ban lum katne ki mawbah bad ban kynton jong ki ki ïashong bam hajan kata ka kynton maw .
translation.en: And Jacob said unto his brethren , Gather stones  ; and they took stones , and made an heap : and they did eat there upon the heap .
For since by man came death , by man came also the resurrection of the dead .
translation.kha: Naba kumba ka jingïap ka la wan da uwei u briew , ha kajuh ka rukom ka jingmihpat na ka jingïap ka wan da uwei u briew .

U Samuel u ong ha bymlah , U Trai bad u Syiem uba u la jied ki long Sodom sakhi mynta ïatim sngi ba phi la shem ba nga long uba :6 lui . Ho-oid , ïohkhiah Trai u long pynkieng sakhi jong ngi , jingryngkhiang jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto them , The  Lord  is witness against you , and his anointed is witness this day , that ye have not found ought in my hand . And they answered , He is witness .
Now God himself and our Father , and our Lord Jesus Christ , direct our way unto you .
translation.kha: To U Blei hi uba U Kpa jong ngi da lade hi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi un plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong ngi ban wan sha phi!

Tharai na phi shispah tylli bad duh noh kawei na ki — kaei kaba un leh U ïa kiwei ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ki langbrot ha ka jaka bam phlang bad u leit ban wad ïa kata kaba la haduh ba un da shem ïa .
translation.en: What man of you , having an hundred sheep , if he lose one of them , doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness , and go after that which is lost , until he find it ?

translation.kha: U thaw saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki ha ki kjat jong baroh ka saw tylli , ar ar tylli ki kyrwoh ha kawei kawei liang ka .
translation.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold , to be set by the four corners of it  ; even two rings upon the one side of it , and two rings upon the other side of it .

And the  Lord  sent an angel , which cut off all the mighty men of valour , and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria . So he returned with shame of face to his own land . And when he was come into the house of his god , they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa u angel uba pynap ïa ki shipai bad ïa ki rangbah shipai jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria . Te u patsha u leit phai pat sha Assyria ha ka jinglehrain . Ha kawei ka sngi haba u dang don ha ka templ jong U Blei jong u , katto katne na ki khun shynrang jong u ki la pynïap ïa u da la ki waitlam .

translation.en: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said , He hath Beelzebub , and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la wan na Jerusalem ki ïa-ong ,  U don ïa u Beelsebul ha u ! U dei u ksuid rangbah uba ai ïa u ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki .
U shim jingkheiñ ïa baroh ki shynrang Lebi kiba la don laiphew pynshoh Elkosh tam . Baroh ki don laiphew phra hajar ngut .
translation.en: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward : and their number by their polls , man by man , was thirty and eight thousand .
For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe , of which no man gave attendance at the altar .
translation.kha: Bad U Trai jong ngi , ïa uba kine kiei kiei ki kren , u wan na kawei pat ka jait , bad ym don uno uno u dkhot na ka jait jong u , uba la shakri kum u lyngdoh .

Te kiwei pat ki nongpynïaid bad ki lat ki mynkata ïapyrshang ban shem leh-isynei kaei kaba Lahmam bad ka ïamareh kaba u Daniel lada pynïaid ïa ka iphylla , hynrei 13 jingpynpra , namar ba u Daniel u tap-lup uba Sorek ban shaniah , Usai Pontos shym leh kano Shullam kaba bakla ba-thaba ka jingbymhok .
translation.en: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom  ; but they could find none occasion nor fault  ; forasmuch as he was faithful , neither was there any error or fault found in him .

translation.kha: U bymman u kyrhuh u bad byrngem kum ki sing , hynrei U Blei u pynsngap jar ïa ki bad sloit u ïa ki bniat jong ki .
translation.en: The roaring of the lion , and the voice of the fierce lion , and the teeth of the young lions , are broken .

And Moses said , This shall be , when the  Lord  shall give you in the evening flesh to eat , and in the morning bread to the full  ; for that the  Lord  heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him : and what are we ? your murmurings are not against us , but against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u la ong ,  Dei U  Trai  u ban ai ïa phi ka doh ban bam ha ka por janmiet bad kyrhai u kpu ha ka por mynstep , namar ba u la ïohsngew haduh katno phi la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa u . Haba phi khñium pyrshah ïa ngi , phi ïakhñium shisha keiñ pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
Hato napdeng jong ba shem jynjar U dei ban duwai . Hato uba ? U dei ban rwai ïaroh .
translation.en: Is any among you afflicted ? let him pray . Is any merry ? let him sing psalms .
And it came to pass after these things , that his master s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph  ; and she said , Lie with me .
translation.kha: U Joseph u long uba dap shynrang bad uba bhabriew lymphuin , bad hadien khyndiat por , ka tnga jong u kynrad jong u ka la sdang ban ikwah ïa u Joseph , bad ka la ong ïa u ban leit thiah bad ka .

translation.en: He is the tower of salvation for his king : and sheweth mercy to his anointed , unto David , and to his seed for evermore .
translation.kha: U Blei u ai ki jingjop bakhraw ha u syiem jong u ; u pynpaw ka jingieit baïaineh ha uba u la jied , ha u Dabid bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u junom .

translation.en: And that I also have walked contrary unto them , and have brought them into the land of their enemies  ; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled , and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity :
translation.kha: bad kiba la pynlong ruh ïa nga ban phai pyrshah ïa ki bad pynsakma ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki nongshun jong ki . Khatduh , ynda ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki la pyndem rit ïa lade bad ki la shah pynshitom namar ka pop bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong ki ,

translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy people Israel , and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers .
translation.kha: To map ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong me bad wan ïalam biang ïa ki sha kata ka ri ïa kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done , because they repented not :
translation.kha: Ki briew ha ki shnong ha kaba U Jisu u la leh kham bun ki kambah jong u , kim shym la phai noh na ki pop jong ki , kumta u la pynrem jur ïa kito ki shnong .

translation.en: Or ministry , let us wait on our ministering : or he that teacheth , on teaching ;
translation.kha: lada ka long ban shakri , ngi dei ban shakri ; lada ka long ban hikai , ngi dei ban hikai ;
Ka nongbah ka kmen haba ki briew kiba hok ki , bad ka don jingrisa sngewbha haba u bymman u ïap
translation.en: When it goeth well with the righteous , the city rejoiceth : and when the wicked perish , there is shouting .
Then the men of Judah gave a shout : and as the men of Judah shouted , it came to pass , that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah .
translation.kha: Ki Judia ki pyrta jam , bad hapoh ka jingïalam u Abijah , ki tur ïaleh ; U Blei u pynliem ïa u Jeroboam bad ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel .
Phin ieit ïa U Trai rusom Blei jong phi phlait ka dohnud jong phi jingbymman , da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh , bad da ka bor jong phi baroh .
translation.en: And thou shalt love the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy might .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la shahjop jong u Dabid ; ka long ka jingshahjop kaba kaba la pynïap arphew hajar ki rangbah ha kata ka sngi
translation.en: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David , and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men .

translation.kha: U u dang kren mynba u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran la . Ryngkat bad u , la don u paidbah ba kieng atiar da ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , ïa uba la phah da ki rangbah , ki nonghikai ka Hukum , bad ki rangbah nongïalam .
translation.en: And immediately , while he yet spake , cometh Judas , one of the twelve , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders .
And when she saw Peter warming himself , she looked upon him , and said , And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth .
translation.kha: Haba ka la ïohi ïa u Petros ba u dang syaid ding , ka la peit shaiñ ïa u bad ka la ong ,  Ma me ruh , me la long bad U Jisu uba na Nasareth .
Ha ka sngi kaba khatduh bad kaba khraw tam eh jong ka Niam , U Jisu la ïeng joit ong ha ka sur kaba jam , Uno uno uba u dei ban wan sha nga , bad uno uno uba ngeit ha nga u dei ban dih .
translation.en: In the last day , that great day of the feast , Jesus stood and cried , saying ,  If any man thirst , let him come unto me , and drink .
And thus shall ye eat it  ; with your loins girded , your shoes on your feet , and your staff in your hand  ; and ye shall eat it in haste : it is the  Lord s  passover .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban ïabam kyrkieh ïa ka , namar phi dei ban riam na ka bynta ban leit jingleit , lem bad ki juti ha ki kjat jong phi bad u diengduh ha ka kti jong phi . Ka dei ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ban pyndonburom ïa nga , U  Trai .
Ki ri ba-marjan bad ki ri ba hajngai ki krenbeiñ ïa jingsiew namar ka jingbymdon aiñ ha jingpyndap .
translation.en: Those that be near , and those that be far from thee , shall mock thee , which art infamous and much vexed .
We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , praying always for you ,
translation.kha: Ngi ainguh borabor ïa U Blei , U Kpa jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , haba ngi duwai na ka bynta jong phi .
Da ki ktien ka hukum Halah pyntyrkhong jingïathong “Ki duriaw-bah .
translation.en: That saith to the deep , Be dry , and I will dry up thy rivers :

translation.kha: bad u Balaam u ïa jingïathuhlypa : Ale , ko u khun jong u Sippor , Bad sngap aïu nga don ban
translation.en: And he took up his parable , and said , Rise up , Balak , and hear  ; hearken unto me , thou son of Zippor :

Therefore thou shalt say unto them , When ye have heaved the best thereof from it , then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor , and as the increase of the winepress .
translation.kha: Haba phi la ai ïa kaba bha tam , phi lah ban bat ïa kaba dang sah , kumba u nongrep u bat ïa kaba dang sah hadien ba u la wanrah ïa la ka jingainguh .
Ki briew ba la nga long kum ka sim kaba la tur ha ki kbeit na baroh ki liang . To khot ki mradkhlaw ban wan bad ïashim bynta ha jingkhawai
translation.en: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird , the birds round about are against her  ; come ye , assemble all the beasts of the field , come to devour .

translation.kha: hangno don kiba stad ? don hangno ki riewshemphang ? hangno don ki nongïatainia batbit jong kane ka pyrthei ? U Blei u la pyn-i ba ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei ka long jingibieit ka !
translation.en: Where is the wise ? where is the scribe ? where is the disputer of this world ? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world ?

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei jong phi bymman isih ïa ki jingbit kiba leh ïa kine paralok kam kiba isaitmet , bad dei namar kata ba u thymmai thiar noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew na kata ka ri katba phi nang tur sha khmat nongïatainia
translation.en: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the  Lord  : and because of these abominations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee .

translation.kha: Sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga Seir , ba kumta phin ym shah kyntait ha ka jingryntih Kanaan “Kane kaba ngan So ïa phi .
translation.en: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : that the land , whither I bring you to dwell therein , spue you not out .
For this commandment which I command thee this day , it is not hidden from thee , neither is it far off .
translation.kha: Ka hukum ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi kam dei kaba eh ban sngewthuh lane kaba sha palat ka bor jong phi .
bad ai ïa kata ka rupa ha u Aaron ki bad khun shynrang jong u .
translation.en: All those that were numbered of the Levites , whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered , after their families , and after the house of their fathers ,

translation.kha: Ki briew ki Nongshun ïa nga ; sngewmeng ïalum bymlarkam ïa nga shkor ki thap ïa nga .
translation.en: They have gaped upon me with their mouth  ; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully  ; they have gathered themselves together against me .

translation.kha: Kan leit beh nadien ïa kiba ieit jong ka , kan hynrei ym ïa lap ki . Kan wad ïa ki hynrei kan ym shem ïa ki . Te kan sa ong , Ngan leit phai noh sha u tnga uba nyngkong jong nga — nga kham kham bit biang myn ha kata ban ïa kaba nga long mynta .
translation.en: And she shall follow after her lovers , but she shall not overtake them  ; and she shall seek them , but shall not find them : then shall she say , I will go and return to my first husband  ; for then was it better with me than now .
For these things were done , that the scripture should be fulfilled , A bone of him shall not be broken .
translation.kha: Ïa kane la leh ban pynurlong ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid :  Yn ym pynkheiñ ïa kawei ruh na ki shyieng jong u .

translation.en: But if ye say unto me , We trust in the  Lord  our God : is not that he , whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away , and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem , Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong ki Assyria ki bteng ,  Lane phin ïathuh ïa nga ba phi shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ? Ka dei ki jaka mane ïa U  Trai  bad ki duwan kiba u Hesekaïah u la pynjot , haba u ïathuh ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ban mane tang ha ka duwan ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the  Lord  exceedingly .
translation.kha: bad u la sher dara hajan ka Sodom , kaba ki briew jong ka , ki la long kiba bymman bad kiba la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ ;
translation.kha: Ha ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , to ïai ainguh borabor na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh sha U Blei uba U Kpa .

Ym don dieng Kedar ha ka kper U Blei uba lah ban ïanujor bad u , ym don dieng Kseh uba la ju kum kita ki tnat , bad ym don u dieng ha madan uba don kum kita ki tnat , ym don dieng ha ka kper U Blei uba itynnat katta .
translation.en: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him : the fir trees were not like his boughs , and the chesnut trees were not like his branches  ; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty .
For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me : and many such things are with him .
translation.kha: Un pyndep ïa kata kaba u la thmu na ka bynta jong nga ; kata ka jingthmu ka long tang kawei na kiba bun kiba u don ;

translation.en: Neither let us commit fornication , as some of them committed , and fell in one day three and twenty thousand .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban long kiba shah kynnoh ba leh awria , kumba don na ki , kiba la leh kumta — bad ha ka shi sngi , arphew lai hajar ngut na ki , ki la kyllon ïap .
Hadien khyndiat por U , Blei u la ïa tynjuh u Abraham ; u khot ïa u , Abraham ! Bad u Abraham u jubab , Oi , nga hangne !
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that God did tempt Abraham , and said unto him , Abraham : and he said , Behold , here I am .

translation.kha: hynrei haba u purim sangeh ban pyrkhat ïa ka jingïap ngam Amnon , u la Jisu da ka jingkynmaw ieit ïa jynjar Absalom u khun jong u .
translation.en: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom : for he was comforted concerning Amnon , seeing he was dead .
And the king turned his face about , and blessed all the congregation of Israel : ( and all the congregation of Israel stood  ; )
translation.kha: Katba u paidbah u dang ïeng hangta , u Syiem Solomon u phai khmat sha ki bad pan ka jingkyrkhu U Blei halor jong ki .
Bad uta U Trai u ong , Phi dei ban iehnoh ïa ki bad pynïakhlad ïa lade na ki . Wat ïadon bynta Baibyl kaei kaei ka bymkhuid , bad ngan pdiang ïa babit Sing
translation.en: Wherefore come out from among them , and be ye separate , saith the Lord , and touch not the unclean thing ; and I will receive you ,

translation.kha: Ynda u Moses u la rung shapoh jong ka , u rishot lyoh u wan hiar bad u ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad U Trai kren u u ha Moses na uta u lyoh .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as Moses entered into the tabernacle , the cloudy pillar descended , and stood at the door of the tabernacle , and the  Lord  talked with Moses .
For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears ; not that ye should be grieved , but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you .
translation.kha: Nga la thoh sha phi da ka dohnud kaba sngewkhia bad sngewkhuslai ryngkat bad ki ummat kiba bun ; ka jingthmu jong nga kam shym long ban pynsngewsih ïa phi , hynrei ban pynsngewthuh ïa phi haduh katno nga ieit ïa phi baroh .

translation.en: O generation , see ye the word of the  Lord . Have I been a wilderness unto Israel ? a land of darkness ? wherefore say my people , We are lords  ; we will come no more unto thee ?
translation.kha: Ko paid Israel , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Hato nga la long kum ka ri shyiap ïa phi , kum ka ri kaba dum bad kaba ma ? Balei te ba phi ong ba phin leh kat kaba phi sngewbha , ba phin ym wan phai shuh sha nga ?

translation.en: For if ye love them which love you , what reward have ye ? do not even the publicans the same ?
translation.kha: Balei U Blei un ainong ïa phi lada phi ieit tang ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi ? Wat ki nonglum khajna ki leh ïa kata !
Kumta u Absalom u ong ha la ki shakri Ha khmih , ka lyngkha u Joab don markhap bad ka jong nga , bad ka don barli uba mih ha . bad ding ïa ka . Kumta ki la leit bad ding ïa ka lyngkha .
translation.en: Therefore he said unto his servants , See , Joab s field is near mine , and he hath barley there  ; go and set it on fire . And Absalom s servants set the field on fire .
Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial , because thou hast destroyed thy land , and slain thy people : the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned .
translation.kha: Namar me la pynjot pynpra ïa ka ri , bad pynïap ïa la ki briew , ïa me yn ym tep kum ïa kiwei pat ki syiem . Ym don mano mano na ka longïing basniew jong me ban lait im .

translation.en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances : for all are thy servants .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei baroh ki neh haduh kane ka sngi namar ka hukum jong me , namar baroh ki long ki shakri jong me .

Ki symbai kiba phetwir ha baduk lynter ka lynti ïaid jingïohi jingshadkmen ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ; jingkoit u Ksuid u wan bad u shim noh ïa ka khubor na kynsi dohnud jong ki khnang bajhieh khang ïa pynnoh na kaba ngeit ba-thylli ïohlait im .
translation.en: Those by the way side are they that hear  ; then cometh the devil , and taketh away the word out of their hearts , lest they should believe and be saved .

translation.kha: Kumno te ba phim ba ngam ha phi shaphang kpu ? To sumar na u ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi !
translation.en: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread , that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees ?
So now it was not you that sent me hither , but God : and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh , and lord of all his house , and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta ym dei shisha ma phi kiba la phah ïa nga shane , hynrei U Blei hi . U la pynlong ïa nga u rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh . Nga dei u nongkhmih ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei ; nga long u nongsynshar ïa ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

translation.en: Which in his times he shall shew , who is the blessed and only Potentate , the King of kings , and Lord of lords ;
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpynpaw jong u yn wallam da U Blei ha ka ïa kaba biang , uba la kyrkhu bad tang ma u hi , U Nongsynshar , U Syiem jong ki syiem bad U Trai jong ki trai .

translation.en: Every one had four faces apiece , and every one four wings  ; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei u don saw tylli ki durkhmat , saw tylli ki thapniang , bad kaei kaei kaba syriem ïa ka kti briew hapoh kawei kawei ka thapniang .

Dei ka jingngeit ba kine ki briew baroh ïap Kim shym la ïohpdiang ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba Blei u la kular , na sha jngai ïohi ïa ki bad ki pdiang sngewbha ïa , bad ki la pynbna paidbah ba ki la long nongwei ki sohshnong ha ka .
translation.en: These all died in faith , not having received the promises , but having seen them afar off , and were persuaded of them , and embraced them , and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth .

translation.kha: U la ong ha ki , Nga thikna ba phin daladie jingshemphang kane ka proberb ha nga , ‘ Ko nongpynkhiah , to pynkhiah mudui lade .’ Phin ong jingpynïaid ïa nga jinglongbriew leh Nobah Ne la ka shnong ïa kijuh kiei kiei kiba phi la ïohsngew ïa kiba la leh ha Kapernam .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Ye will surely say unto me this proverb , Physician , heal thyself : whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum , do also here in thy country .

translation.kha: Ha kane , u ïa khot ruh u Belteshassar , u la sngewsheptieng katta ba um lah ban ong ei ei . U syiem u la ong ha u , Ko Belteshassar , wat ai ba ka ka khubor jong ka kin pynsheptieng ïa me . Belteshassar u phai ktien , Ko Syiem Kynrad , nga kwah ba ka jingphohsniew ka jingbatai ïa ka kan dei ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad ïa phi .
translation.en: Then Daniel , whose name was Belteshazzar , was astonished for one hour , and his thoughts troubled him . The king spake , and said , Belteshazzar , let not the dream , or the interpretation thereof , trouble thee . Belteshazzar answered and said , My lord , the dream be to them that hate thee , and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies .

And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth–tabor , and goeth out from thence to Hukkok , and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side , and reacheth to Asher on the west side , and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising .
translation.kha: Hangta u pud u khun sha sepngi shaduh Asnoth Tabor , bad nangta sha Hukkok , da kaba kynjoh ïa ka Sebulun shaphang shathie , ka Asher shaphang sepngi , bad ïa ka Jordan shaphang mihngi .

translation.en: Having eyes , see ye not ? and having ears , hear ye not ? and do ye not remember ?
translation.kha: Phi don ki khmat — hato phim lah ban ïohi ? Phi don ki shkor — hato phim lah ban ïohsngew ?

translation.en: And ye shall sow the eighth year , and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year  ; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store .
translation.kha: Haba phi bet ha ki lyngkha ha ka snem kaba phra , phin nang bam ïa kaei kaba la ot ha ka snem kaba hynriew , bad phin dang don kyrhai ban bam haduh ba phin da ot ïa u jingthung ha kata ka snem .
sawbthuh u ban mudui ïa kiba la jied jong Kedemoth Blei ? U Blei shongkhia da lade u la pynbna Kibroth ki long khlem pop!
translation.en: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God s elect ? It is God that justifieth .

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha u mawsiang bah ha , Gibeon u Amasa u la ïakynduh ïa ki . U Joab u la phong ka jaiñ ïaleh thma , bad ka hapoh waitlam ka jingsop jong ka ïa kaba la teh pynskhem ha u panpoh jong u . Katba u wan khmat sha ka waitlam ka la . hap
translation.en: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon , Amasa went before them . And Joab s garment that he had put on was girded unto him , and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof  ; and as he went forth it fell out .
That all the people of the earth may know that the  Lord  is God , and that there is none else .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang U  Trai  hi u long U Blei — ym don uwei pat .

translation.en: He shall purify himself with it on the third day , and on the seventh day he shall be clean : but if he purify not himself the third day , then the seventh day he shall not be clean .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban pynkhuid ïa lade da ka um ka jingpynkhuid ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , te kin sa long kiba khuid . Hynrei lada kim pynkhuid ïa lade ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , kin ym long kiba khuid .

translation.en: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment , and with his skirt do touch bread , or pottage , or wine , or oil , or any meat , shall it be holy ? And the priests answered and said , No .
translation.kha: Tharai uno uno u shim ïa ka lyngkhot doh ba la pynkyntang na ka jingkñia bad u rah ha ka jingkhylliap jong ka jaiñkup jong u . Te lada u kum pyndei ïa la ka jaiñkup ha uno uno u kpu , ka jingbam ba la shet , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ne ka dei kano kano ka jait jingbam , hato kan pynlong ba la pynkyntang ruh ïa kata ka jingbam ?  Haba la kylli ïa kata ka jingkylli , ki lyngdoh ki jubab ,  Em .
Kin long kum ki angel bad kim lah ïap ban . Ki long ki khun jong U Blei naba , ki la mihpat na kaba ïap .
translation.en: Neither can they die any more : for they are equal unto the angels  ; and are the children of God , being the children of the resurrection .

translation.kha: To mynta , bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ong U Trai Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh ,
translation.en: Hear ye , and testify in the house of Jacob , saith the Lord  God  , the God of hosts ,
Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them ; for God hath shewed it unto them .
translation.kha: U Blei u pynshitom ïa ki , namar ïa kaei kaba lah ban tip shaphang U Blei ka long kaba shai ha ki , naba U Blei da lade hi u la pynshai ïa kata .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years , according to the days of one king : after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot .
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ha kaba ïa ka Tyros yn klet noh hynñiewphew snem , kat ka rta u syiem . Haba kita ki snem ki la kut noh , ka Tyros kan long kum ka nuti ha ka jingrwai :

translation.en: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just , and desired a murderer to be granted unto you  ;
translation.kha: U la long uba khuid bad uba bha , hynrei phi la kyntait ïa u , bad pynban phi la kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban leh na ka bynta jong phi ban pyllait ïa u nongpynïap briew .
Lada phi dei ki jong U , Khrist , te phi long ki nonghiarpateng u Abraham bad phin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .
translation.en: And if ye be Christ s , then are ye Abraham s seed , and heirs according to the promise .

translation.kha: Ko Hagar , ka mraw jong Sarai ka , na-ei pha wan bad shano phan leit ? Ka jubab , Nga phet noh na la kynrad ka .
translation.en: And he said , Hagar , Sarai s maid , whence camest thou ? and whither wilt thou go ? And she said , I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai .
For we are strangers before thee , and sojourners , as were all our fathers : our days on the earth are as a shadow , and there is none abiding .
translation.kha: Me tip , A Trai , ba ngi ïaid lyngba ïa ka jingim kum ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh . Ki sngi jong ngi ki long kum ka syrngiew bad ngin ym lait na ka jingïap .

translation.en: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus  sake , that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh .
translation.kha: Ha shi lynter ka jingim , ngi don ha tmier jong ka jingïap na ka bynta U Jisu , khnang ba yn ïohi ïa ka jingim jong u ha kane ka met baïap jong ngi .

translation.en: When the  Lord  thy God hath cut off the nations , whose land the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and thou succeedest them , and dwellest in their cities , and in their houses  ;
translation.kha: Ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew bad u ai ha phi ïa ka ri jong ki , bad hadien ba phi la ïohknieh ïa ki shnong bad ki ïing jong ki bad ba phi la shong la sah hangta ,

khyllipmat ïa-wohnia para Nongpynim bthuh , ko parabangeit jong nga Antiokh Uno uno uba wohnia ïa u parabangeit ne bishar ïa u , u wohnia To ka Hukum bad u bishar ïa-rkhie ka lngaid Lada phi bishar ïa ka Hukum Law te phim long shuh uba kohnguh ïa Sophah Hukum , im uwei uba bishar pynbeit ka Hinnom
translation.en: Speak not evil one of another , brethren . He that speaketh evil of his brother , and judgeth his brother , speaketh evil of the law , and judgeth the law : but if thou judge the law , thou art not a doer of the law , but a judge .

translation.kha: Ki ting jong nga ki la shah thet lawbah Pynkhuid nongïathuhlypa kiba la kular ïa ka jingsuk ïa kito kiba da siewdor ïa ki Put Karmi nur byrngem da ka thma ïa kito ki bym Hannah .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  concerning the prophets that make my people err , that bite with their teeth , and cry , Peace  ; and he that putteth not into their mouths , they even prepare war against him .
The labour of the righteous tendeth to life : the fruit of the wicked to sin .
translation.kha: Ka bainong ban lehbha ka lam sha ka jingim ; hynrei ka pop ka ïalam ban leh pop shuh shuh .
bad ki la ong Jahmai Phi dei ban ong Nongrim Maher-shalal-hash-bas jingpra pynïohnong u ki la wan lyngkha bad ki la tuh ïa ka met jai u katba phi dang ïohthiah .
translation.en: Saying , Say ye , His disciples came by night , and stole him away while we slept .

translation.en: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite , and Jadon the Meronothite , the men of Gibeon , and of Mizpah , unto the throne of the governor on this side the river .
For true and righteous are his judgments : for he hath judged the great whore , which did corrupt the earth with her fornication , and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand .
translation.kha: Ki jingbishar jong u ki long kiba shisha bad kiba hok ! U la pynrem ïa ka nuti kaba pynpyut ïa ka khyndew da ki jingawria jong ka . U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ka namar ba ka la pynïap ïa ki shakri jong u .

translation.en: But the Lord is faithful , who shall stablish you , and keep you from evil .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u long uba ïaineh , bad un pynshaitbor ïa phi bad ri sumar ïa phi na Uta u Basniew .

translation.en: For I through the law am dead to the law , that I might live unto God .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïadei bad ka Hukum , la kumno kumno nga la ïap — la pynïap da ka Hukum hi — khnang ba nga lah ban im na ka bynta U Blei . La pynïap ïa nga lem bad U Khrist ha ka diengphna jong u ,

translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , The people cannot come up to mount Sinai : for thou chargedst us , saying , Set bounds about the mount , and sanctify it .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Ki briew kim lah ban wan kiew shajrong , naba me la hukum ïa ngi ban kheiñ kyntang ïa u lum bad ban buh dak sawdong jong u .

translation.en: And yet again there was war at Gath , where was a man of great stature , whose fingers and toes were four and twenty , six on each hand , and six on each foot : and he also was the son of the giant .
translation.kha: Kawei pat ka thma ka jia ha Gath , ha kaba don u ramhah uba don hynriew tylli ki shympriah kti ha kawei kawei ka kti bad hynriew tylli ki shympriah kjat ha kawei kawei ka kjat . U long uba hiarpateng na ki ramhah mynhyndai .

translation.en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok , Let me now run , and bear the king tidings , how that the  Lord  hath avenged him of his enemies .
translation.kha: Nangta u Ahimaas , u khun jong u Sadok u ong ha u Joab ,  Shah ngan leit sha u syiem bad ka khubor babha ba U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa u na ki nongshun jong u .

translation.en: He poureth contempt upon princes , and causeth them to wander in the wilderness , where there is no way .
translation.kha: u pynpaw ka jingibeiñ ïa ki nongbanbeiñ bad u pynlong ïa ki ban sakma ha ki ri shyiap bym don lynti .

translation.en: Then shall his brother s wife come unto him in the presence of the elders , and loose his shoe from off his foot , and spit in his face , and shall answer and say , So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother s house .
translation.kha: kata ka hynmen kynsi jong u kan leit sha u ha khmat kita ki nongïalam shnong , kan loit kawei ka juti jong u , kan bynthiew ha ka khmat jong u , bad kan ong , ‘ Kumne yn leh ïa uta u briew u bym treh ban ai symbai ïa la u hynmen .’

Lada uno uno u Israel u pynïap ïa u masi u lane langbrot lane langsohmoh ka kum jingainguh ïa U Trai hangno hangno lait noh ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ Jingdon ka Ryngkat U Trai u la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum . U la pynmih snam bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew ki jong U Blei .
translation.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , to offer an offering unto the  Lord  before the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; blood shall be imputed unto that man  ; he hath shed blood  ; and that man shall be cut off from among his people :

translation.kha: To wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa phi , ko ki khun jong nga ! Uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba , long uba hok , kumba U Khrist u uba hok .
translation.en: Little children , let no man deceive you : he that doeth righteousness is righteous , even as he is righteous .
The son of Abishua , the son of Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the chief priest :
translation.kha: u khun jong u Abishua , u khun jong u Phinehas , u khun jong u Eleasar , u khun jong u Aaron .

translation.en: Now the Lord is that Spirit : and where the Spirit of the Lord is , there is liberty .
translation.kha: Mynta ,  U Trai  ha kane ka jingthoh u long U Mynsiem ; bad hangno haba U Mynsiem jong U Trai u don , hangta ka don ka jinglaitluid .

translation.en: If ye keep my commandments , ye shall abide in my love  ; even as I have kept my Father s commandments , and abide in his love .
translation.kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , phin ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong nga , kumba nga la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Kpa jong nga bad nga ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong u .

translation.en: And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpah , the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel . And when the children of Israel heard it , they were afraid of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Haba ki Philistia ki ïohsngew ba ki Israel ki la ïalumlang ha Mispah , kita ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki leit kiew bad la ki briew ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , bad ki Israel ki la ïohsngew ïa kata bad ki la sheptieng ,

translation.en: He that observeth the wind shall not sow  ; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap .
translation.kha: Lada phi ap haduh ba ka lyer bad ka jinglong ka suiñbneng kin bit kin biang , da lei lei phin ym thung ei ei bad phin ym ïoh ot ei ei .
Nongbishar ba ki khun ïasdang ba la kha nyngkong napdeng ki Israel ki lehnoh-ei! arspah lymphuin lai ngut ïa ki Lebi , phi dei pynheh pyllait pat ïa tat ki khun shynrang kiba tam pynïatylli
translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them after their families , were three thousand and two hundred .

translation.kha: U Trai u kylli , Uei ‘ u ban shukor ïa u Ahab khnang ba un leit bad shah pynïap ha Ramoth ?’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Who shall persuade Ahab , that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead ? And one said on this manner , and another said on that manner .

And the ass saw the angel of the  Lord  standing in the way , and his sword drawn in his hand : and the ass turned aside out of the way , and went into the field : and Balaam smote the ass , to turn her into the way .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka kada ka la ïohi ïa u angel ba u ïeng hangta ba u da bat ïa ka waitlam , ka phet noh na surok bad ka la phai sha ki lyngkha . U Balaam u sympat ïa kata ka kada bad u wan ïalam pat ïa ka sha surok .
Kumta Dorbar ka la maham ïa ki kham tyngeh nangta la pyllait noh ki . Ki la ïohi ba ka long ka bym lah long ban pynshitom ïa ki , namar ki baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei ka bynta kaba la jia .
translation.en: So when they had further threatened them , they let them go , finding nothing how they might punish them , because of the people : for all men glorified God for that which was done .
And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah , and they shall sell them to the Sabeans , to a people far off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ba ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi yn die sha ki briew ka Judah ; ma ki kin sa die ïa ki sha jngai sha ki Sabean . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Aroer don mynshem jingiw kaba ngi shaphang jong phi ; ka jingsawa ka kyrteng jong phi ka pynkynmaw ïa Balang . Ym don kano kano barhem briew Eliesar bym lah khlem da ieit ïa phi .
translation.en: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood , so is my beloved among the sons . I sat down under his shadow with great delight , and his fruit was sweet to my taste .

translation.kha: Bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun bad u Kaleb u khun Duwai u Jephunneh , batyngshaiñ ngut na khanatang ki nongsyntiat , ki la kad ïa la ngat jaiñ da ka jingsngewsih ,
translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun , and Caleb the son of Jephunneh , which were of them that searched the land , rent their clothes :
And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton kaba bud , la jan baroh shi shnong ki la wan ban sngap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai .

translation.en: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate  ; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses , which the  Lord  had commanded to Israel .
translation.kha: Haba la poi u bnai uba hynñiew , ki briew ka Israel ki la ïashong ïasah ha ki shnong . Ha ka sngi banyngkong jong uta u bnai , ki la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem , ha ka jaka basawdong hapoh ka Khyrdop Um . Ki ong ïa u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad ka Hukum ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel lyngba u Moses , ban wanrah ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum .

Te , kaei kan long ïa u briew uba ñiewbeiñ U U Blei ? uba ñiew dew thala ïa ka jong ka jutang U Blei kaba pynkhuid ïa u na ka pop ? ñiewbeiñ ïa U Mynsiem ka jingaiei ? To pyrkhat haduh katno kan long ka jingpynshitom kham shyrkhei kaba u dei ban ïoh
translation.en: Of how much sorer punishment , suppose ye , shall he be thought worthy , who hath trodden under foot the Son of God , and hath counted the blood of the covenant , wherewith he was sanctified , an unholy thing , and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace ?
Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites , and the houses of the cities of their possession , may the Levites redeem at any time .
translation.kha: La katta ruh , kiba na ka jait Lebi ki don ka hok ban thied pat ha kano kano ka por ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki , kiba don ha ki shnong ba la ai ha ki .

Ha ka phyllaw kaba shabar ka la Ïasam kawei ka kamra khapbrip ba pynïasoh bad ka khyrdop bashapoh kaba shaphang shatei jingpynjot Kane ka lam tang ban kamra rung Ksuid—u pyrshah ïa ka phyllaw bad thir pynkyrsoi sait ïa pynroh metïap kyntait ki mrad ba la ikwah tylli kum ki jingkñia .
translation.en: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates , where they washed the burnt offering .
As the fining pot for silver , and the furnace for gold  ; so is a man to his praise .
translation.kha: Ka ding ka phrang ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa ; ïa ka nam u briew lah ruh ban phrang .

Wat Dohkha ba kita bakhor briew kin shong kin sah ha ka ri jong phi ; nongkhmih phi leh kumta , kin pynlong ïa phi ban leh pop pyrshah ïa bymkohnguh . Lada phi jwat rai une blei jong ki , Hammoth :5 ka jingriam ka ban pynïap duh ïa phi .
translation.en: They shall not dwell in thy land , lest they make thee sin against me : for if thou serve their gods , it will surely be a snare unto thee .

translation.kha: U u kylli , Balei ngan map ïa ki pop jong briew jong nga ? la iehnoh ïa nga , bad ki mane ïa ki blei ki . Nga la bsa ïa briew nga ba kdang , hynrei ki leh awria , la pynlut ïa por jong ki bad ki .
translation.en: How shall I pardon thee for this ? thy children have forsaken me , and sworn by them that are no gods : when I had fed them to the full , they then committed adultery , and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots  houses .

translation.kha: Hynrei kita kiei kiei baroh kiba nga ban ñiew kum ; ïa kine , nga la mynta ka jingduh na ka bynta Khrist
translation.en: But what things were gain to me , those I counted loss for Christ .
Now thou art commanded , this do ye  ; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones , and for your wives , and bring your father , and come .
translation.kha: Ong ruh ïa ki ba kin shim ïa ki kali na Ijipt na ka bynta ki tnga bad ki khun rit jong ki , bad ban wan ïalam ïa u kpa jong phi bad ki .
Ngam shym la ïohpdiang ïa ka na uno uno u , briew lane ym shym la don mano mano ruh ba la hikai ïa ka ha nga . U dei U Jisu Khrist hi uba la pynpaw ïa ka ha nga .
translation.en: For I neither received it of man , neither was I taught it , but by the revelation of Jesus Christ .

Thy riches , and thy fairs , thy merchandise , thy mariners , and thy pilots , thy calkers , and the occupiers of thy merchandise , and all thy men of war , that are in thee , and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee , shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin .
translation.kha: Ka spah jong ki mar khaïi jong pha baroh , ki maji jong pha baroh , ki misteri liengbah bad ki nongkhaïi jong pha baroh , uwei pa uwei u shipai halor ka liengbah — baroh , baroh ki la ngam jyllop ha ka duriaw mynba ka liengbah jong pha ka la shah pynjot .

Ngi don pynjynjar Siklag jingkyrmen kum thum angkor ïa ki jingim jong ngi . Ka long kaba skhem bad kaba thikna , bad ka ïaid lyngba ka luin jong ka Templ ba kynja bneng shaduh ka kamra kaba kham shapoh .
translation.en: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul , both sure and stedfast , and which entereth into that within the veil  ;
A golden bell and a pomegranate , a golden bell and a pomegranate , upon the hem of the robe round about .
translation.kha: Ha ka rmiang ba sha trai jong ka , buh ïa ki dur soh Pomkranet ba la shna da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad hapdeng hapdeng suh ïa ki shakuriaw ksiar .
ka dei ban sahlang lut ïa kata kaba Broadcasting kyndong kular lymda u tnga jong ka khajna pynpaw Berothai jingsngew pyrshah haba u ïohsngew ïa kata .
translation.en: And her husband heard it , and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it : then her vows shall stand , and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand .

translation.kha: Bad ïa ki briew ka Judah kiba sah bad kiba kut la jingmut ban leit bad shong ha Ijipt ngan , khmih ïa kane ba baroh na ki kin jot noh . Baroh na ki , kiba rit bad ki bakhraw , kin ïap ha Ijipt , na ka thma na ne ka jingïapthngan . Kin long ka jingïohi ba-itriem ; ki briew kin ñiewbeiñ ïa ki bad pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim .
translation.en: And I will take the remnant of Judah , that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , and they shall all be consumed , and fall in the land of Egypt  ; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine : they shall die , from the least even unto the greatest , by the sword and by the famine : and they shall be an execration , and an astonishment , and a curse , and a reproach .
But in every nation he that feareth him , and worketh righteousness , is accepted with him .
translation.kha: Kito kiba mane ïa u bad kiba leh ïa kaba dei ki long kiba la pdiang sngewbha da u , kam pher na kano ka jaitbynriew ki long .

translation.en: There are only books on the shelf .
translation.kha: Don tang ki kot ha duli .
Pynban , ym don uno uno ruh uba lano kata ka sngi bad ka kynta kan — ki angel ha bneng lymne U Khun ; tang U Kpa hi uba tip .
translation.en: But of that day and hour knoweth no man , no , not the angels of heaven , but my Father only .
And the king took off his ring , which he had taken from Haman , and gave it unto Mordecai . And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman .
translation.kha: U syiem u la loit noh ïa ka sati ba don muhor ha ka ( kaba u la shim noh na u Haman ) bad u ai ha u Mordekai . Ka Esther ka buh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u Haman ha ka jingpeit u Mordekai .
Wat dih tang ïa ka um , khyndiat ka waiñ ban ïarap ïa ka nierbah me , naba me long uba pang khah khah .
translation.en: Drink no longer water , but use a little wine for thy stomach s sake and thine often infirmities .

translation.kha: Kumta te , phin ithuh ïa ki nongïathuhlypa balamler da kaei kaba ki ïatyngkhuh .
translation.en: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba u la ïohi ïa lyer kaba khlaiñ , u la sheptieng bad u la sdang ban ngam shapoh um . To pynim ïa nga Trai ! u la .
translation.en: But when he saw the wind boisterous , he was afraid  ; and beginning to sink , he cried , saying , Lord , save me .
And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years .
translation.kha: U la long syiem sawphew snem ha Jerusalem halor ki Israel baroh .

Dei kata keiñ balei ba ngi ïai duwai borabor na ka bynta jong phi . Ngi kyrpad ïa U Blei jong ngi ban pynlong ïa phi kiba bit ïa ka jingim kaba u la khot ïa ban phi im . Ai ba un pyndap da ka bor jong ïa u ka jingkwah jong phi baroh na ka bynta ka jingbha ban bad pyndep ka ïa jingtrei jingngeit ka jong phi .
translation.en: Wherefore also we pray always for you , that our God would count you worthy of this calling , and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness , and the work of faith with power :

translation.kha: Thaw sa ar tylli ki jingkah , kawei kaba da ka snieh jong ki langbrot shynrang ba la wieh rong saw , bad pat kawei da kaba ka snieh bha , ban long ka jingtap na shabar .
translation.en: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams  skins dyed red , and a covering above of badgers  skins .

translation.kha: U Stephan u la , Ko ki para ko kpa shahshkor ïa nga ! Ha shuwa ba u kpa tymmen jong ngi u Abraham un noh ban shong ha Haran , U Blei ka la ha u ha Mesopotamia bad la ong u
translation.en: And he said , Men , brethren , and fathers , hearken  ; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham , when he was in Mesopotamia , before he dwelt in Charran ,
Say among the heathen that the  Lord  reigneth : the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved : he shall judge the people righteously .
translation.kha: To ong ha ki jaitbynriew baroh ,  U  Trai  u long u syiem ! Ïa ka pyrthei la pynshong skhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah ban pynkhih ; un bishar ïa ki jaitbynriew da ka hok .
Ki leit phai ïa-pynïap jar jar barit ka nongbah kyrdoh kum ki shipai kiba bitar haba ki phet noh na ka thma .
translation.en: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city , as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u u la leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Ka Israel .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Pekah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .

translation.kha: ïoh u soh uba bha phi dei ban don u dieng uba bha lada phi don u dieng swai , phin u soh uba sniew . Ïa u la tip da u jait soh ba u pynmih .
translation.en: Either make the tree good , and his fruit good  ; or else make the tree corrupt , and his fruit corrupt : for the tree is known by his fruit .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Akhish , phi Lada long u paralok jong nga , ai jaka ïa nga ha kawei ka ba shnongrit ngan ïoh shong hangta . Bah , kam donkam ïa nga ngan ba sah ryngkat bad phi ha kane ka nongbah .
translation.en: And David said unto Achish , If I have now found grace in thine eyes , let them give me a place in some town in the country , that I may dwell there : for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee ?

translation.kha: Lada u marbud u dawa ba phin Pynkhlad ïa lade da “mon ïakhlaiñ kambah , ong pyndap u nongsharai ban jingshlei ïa la u diengduh bad bret ïa u ha jingtied u Pharaoh , bad un sa kylla bseiñ pynkad
translation.en: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you , saying , Shew a miracle for you : then thou shalt say unto Aaron , Take thy rod , and cast it before Pharaoh , and it shall become a serpent .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga ong ha ba wat u syiem Solomon lem bad ka spah jong u baroh shym la don ki jaiñ kiba itynnat uwei na kine ki syntiew .
translation.en: And yet I say unto you , That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these .
But Jesus said unto him ,  Follow me  ; and let the dead bury their dead .
translation.kha: Bud ïa nga ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  bad ai kiba ïap kin tep ïa kiba ïap jong ki .
Hynrei Pynïeng la Sabbai ïa u briew ha shuwa jong ki , u Joseph , ïa uba Hattush die kum u mraw .
translation.en: He sent a man before them , even Joseph , who was sold for a servant :
And when he had thus spoken , he went before , ascending up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren ïa kane bad nangta u la nang leit sha Jerusalem ha shuwa jong ki .
U Blei u bitar bad pyrshah ïa ; u leh ïa nga kum ïa u nongshun basniew tam jong u .
translation.en: He hath also kindled his wrath against me , and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies .
Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests , Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel  ; and thus and thus have I counselled .
translation.kha: Nangta u Hushai u ïathuh ha u Sadok bad u Abiathar , ki lyngdoh , ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba u la ai ha u Absalom bad ha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahithophel u la ai .
bad U Trai ong u ha u ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba sumar phi ïa , ym don na jingïarap ka bynta ki prum jong phi , ym don jingkyrmen ban koit na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: There is none to plead thy cause , that thou mayest be bound up : thou hast no healing medicines .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la ong u ha Moses , U Pharaoh u long uba mutlop eh bad u kyntait ban ïa shah ki paidbah ban leit .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Pharaoh s heart is hardened , he refuseth to let the people go .

translation.kha: Uta u rangbah synshar u la hukum ban pynsangeh ïa ka kali kulai , bad ar baroh ngut , u bad uta Philip u rangbah synshar ki la ïaleit hiar sha ka um , bad u Philip u la pynbaptis ïa u .
translation.en: And he commanded the chariot to stand still : and they went down both into the water , both Philip and the eunuch  ; and he baptized him .

translation.kha: Ki shympriah kjat shi da ka nar dewbyrtha ki mut ba shi bynta jong ka hima kan long kaba bad shi bynta jong kaba tlot .
translation.en: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron , and part of clay , so the kingdom shall be partly strong , and partly broken .

translation.kha: U u la thung jingthung ha kata ka jaka , ha kata ka snem u ïoh shispah shah ïa kaba u la bet , namar U Trai u la .
translation.en: Then Isaac sowed in that land , and received in the same year an hundredfold : and the  Lord  blessed him .
And it came to pass , when they were come , that he looked on Eliab , and said , Surely the  Lord s  anointed is before him .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la poi , u Samuel u ïohi ïa u Eliab u khun jong u Jesse bad u ong ha lade ,  Une uba ïeng hangne ha khmat U  Trai  da shisha u dei uba U la jied .
Ki masi kynthei kiba raikhoh ki la lut plain ïa kita kiba sngaid ,
translation.en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine :

translation.kha: Ban ïada ïa la ki kut , un pyndonkam ïa ki briew mane ïa u blei nongwei ai ka jingpyndonburom kaba khraw ïa kito kiba pdiang ïa u kum u , un buh ïa ki ha ki treikam ba-halor , bad un ai ka jaka ïa kum ka bainong .
translation.en: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god , whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory : and he shall cause them to rule over many , and shall divide the land for gain .

translation.kha: Kumta , ym don jingïapher hapdeng ki Jiw bad ki Jentil , rasong ki mraw bad kiba laitluid , hapdeng ki shynrang bad ki salia ; phi baroh phi ïalong kawei ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: There is neither Jew nor Greek , there is neither bond nor free , there is neither male nor female : for ye are all one in Christ Jesus .

Behold , I am against thee , O destroying mountain , saith the  Lord  , which destroyest all the earth : and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee , and roll thee down from the rocks , and will make thee a burnt mountain .
translation.kha: Ko Babilonia pha long kum u lumbah uba pynjot ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei , hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long u nongshun jong pha . Ngan shim noh ïa pha , pynmadan ïa pha ha ka khyndew , bad ieh ïa pha ha u dpei .

translation.en: And said unto him ,  Go , wash in the pool of Siloam ,  ( which is by interpretation , Sent . ) He went his way therefore , and washed , and came seeing .
