translation.en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages : in the secret places doth he murder the innocent : his eyes are privily set against the poor .
translation.kha: U buhrieh ïa lade ha ki shnongrit , da kaba apthap ban pynïap ïa ki briew kiba lui lui . U syntiat ïa ki lanot jong u , ki bym don nongïarap ,

namar u long u jong U Blei uba trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi . Hynrei leh ïa kaba sniew , te to sheptieng , namar ka bor jong u ban pynshitom ka long kaba dei . U u shakri jong U Blei bad ïa ka jingpynshitom U halor kito kiba leh ïa kaba .
translation.en: For he is the minister of God to thee for good . But if thou do that which is evil , be afraid ; for he beareth not the sword in vain : for he is the minister of God , a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil .

translation.kha: Bad lada uwei na ki shipai u pynbor ïa phi ban kit ïa ud jingkit jong u shi pynpait dik to kit ïa Amal ar kilomitar .
translation.en: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile , go with him twain .

translation.kha: Hynrei wat ki paid Judah ruh kim shym kohnguh ïa ki aiñ U Trai U jong Blei ki ; ki pyrthuh bud ki ïa rukom ba dang bat da ki paid Israel .
translation.en: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the  Lord  their God , but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made .
And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ngan pynlong ïa ka Ammon ban manbha biang . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

Men ïap ha , bad kumba ki briew ki thang jingiwbih haba ki tep ïa ki tymmen jong me , kiba long ki syiem ha shuwa jong me , ha kajuh ka rukom kin ki jingiwbih na ka bynta jong me . Kin ïambriew namar jong me bad kin ong , ‘ U syiem jong u la ïap !’ Ma nga , U Trai la kren .
translation.en: But thou shalt die in peace : and with the burnings of thy fathers , the former kings which were before thee , so shall they burn odours for thee  ; and they will lament thee , saying , Ah lord ! for I have pronounced the word , saith the  Lord .

The sons of Amram  ; Aaron and Moses : and Aaron was separated , that he should sanctify the most holy things , he and his sons for ever , to burn incense before the  Lord  , to minister unto him , and to bless in his name for ever .
translation.kha: U Amram , u khun nyngkong jong u , u dei u kpa jong u Aaron bad u Moses . ( Ïa u Aaron bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u la pynkyrpang ban sumar junom ïa ki tiar ki tar kiba khuid , ban thang jingiwbih ha ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  , ban shakri ïa u , bad ban kyrkhu ïa ki briew ha ka kyrteng jong u .

Kin long ka dak jong ka jingdon ryngkat U jong Trai Baroh Badonbor ha Ijipt . Haba ïa ki briew hangta la banbeiñ bad ki la kyang jam sha U Trai ban ïoh jingïarap , un ïa phah uno uno ban pyllait ïa ki .
translation.en: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the  Lord  of hosts in the land of Egypt : for they shall cry unto the  Lord  because of the oppressors , and he shall send them a saviour , and a great one , and he shall deliver them .

translation.en: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines , named Goliath , of Gath , whose height was six cubits and a span .
And he called the porters  ; and they told it to the king s house within .
translation.kha: Ki nongap khyrdop ki pynbna ïa kata ka khubor , bad la leit rah ïa ka sha ïingsyiem .

Kito kiba la im pahuh pahai shisien mynta ki leit bylla ban ïoh , bam hynrei kiba kito thngan kim thngan shuh . Ka briew kaba lyngki ka ïoh khun hynñiew ngut , hynrei ka kaba kmie bun ki khun ka sah marwei .

And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod s jurisdiction , he sent him to Herod , who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time .

translation.en: And should sleep , and rise night and day , and the seed should spring and grow up , he knoweth not how .

ïa u kew ba la tylliat bha bym pat khleh thiat , bad shet katto katne ki ba khleh bad ka umphniang Olib , bad katto katne khlem umphniang katto katne ki kpu lyngkniap la shu kyllan da ka umphniang .
translation.en: And unleavened bread , and cakes unleavened tempered with oil , and wafers unleavened anointed with oil : of wheaten flour shalt thou make them .

translation.en: But Uriah slept at the door of the king s house with all the servants of his lord , and went not down to his house .
And the famine was over all the face of the earth : And Joseph opened all the storehouses , and sold unto the Egyptians  ; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt .

translation.en: And on the morrow , when Agrippa was come , and Bernice , with great pomp , and was entered into the place of hearing , with the chief captains , and principal men of the city , at Festus  commandment Paul was brought forth .

And as for Ishmael , I have heard thee : Behold , I have blessed him , and will make him fruitful , and will multiply him exceedingly  ; twelve princes shall he beget , and I will make him a great nation .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyrpad jong me na ka bynta u Ishmael , kumta ngan kyrkhu ïa u bad ngan ai ha u shibun ki khun ki ksiew . Un long u kpa jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun syiem , bad ngan pynlong ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw na ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me the second time , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga , bad u la ong ,
Ki briew ki rkhie ïa nga baroh shi sngi ; long nga ka jingbiria ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: I was a derision to all my people  ; and their song all the day .

translation.kha: Nangta jingsian nongrah khuri u ong ha u syiem , Nga dei ban Salu mynta ba nga la leh nongriam .
translation.en: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh , saying , I do remember my faults this day :

translation.en: God wants people to enjoy life on earth .
And when he had thus spoken , he dismissed the assembly .

Kumta U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki , phi don kpu ? Khie leit bad khmih . Haba ki shem , ki ïathuh ïa u , San tylli ki ar tylli dohkha ruh .
translation.en: He saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ? go and see .  And when they knew , they say , Five , and two fishes .

translation.kha: Kine baroh bthat long ki aiñ bad ki hukum pynïohnong U Trai u Tahan ai ha ïasngewdei ïalong , ha u baphylla Sinai na ka bynta ki paid Jehoash .
translation.en: These are the statutes and judgments and laws , which the  Lord  made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: Hynrei ko , Trai Badonbor Baroh , me tynjuh hok ïa ki briew ; me kaei tip kaba don hapoh ki dohnud bad ka jingmut jong ki . Kumta shah ngan ïohi ba me pynhiarkput halor ki nongshun nga jong , namar la nga buh ïa ka kam jong nga ha ki kti jong me .
translation.en: But , O  Lord  of hosts , that triest the righteous , and seest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I opened my cause .

translation.kha: kumta , phin weng noh ïa jingshah kynnoh pop napdeng jong phi , haba phi leh ïa kata kaba dei ha U Trai .
translation.en: So shalt thou put away the guilt of innocent blood from among you , when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the  Lord .
Attending meetings at the local Kingdom Hall of Jehovah’s Witnesses will help you to do so .—Isaiah 11 :9  ; Hebrews 10 :24 , 25 .
translation.kha: Ka jingleit jingïaseng ha ka Kingdom Hall Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah , kan ïarap ïa phi ban leh kumta .—Isaiah 11 :9 ; Hebru 10 :24 , 25 .

translation.en: I pray thee , forgive the trespass of thine handmaid : for the  Lord  will certainly make my lord a sure house  ; because my lord fighteth the battles of the  Lord  , and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days .
translation.kha: Sngewbha map ïa nga , ko kynrad , na ka bynta kano kano ka jingbakla kaba nga la leh . U  Trai  un pynlong ïa phi u syiem , bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ruh , naba phi ïaleh ïa ki thma jong u ; bad phin ym leh kano kano kaba sniew katba phi dang im .
Suk kito biah isynei Ephphatha kiwei pat ; U Blei un isynei ïa ki !
translation.en: Blessed are the merciful : for they shall obtain mercy .

translation.kha: U syiem un suidñiew ïa u blei ba ki tymmen jong u ki la shakri , bad ruh ïa u blei ba ki kynthei ki . Ha jingshisha un ym suidñiew ïa uno uno u blei , namar un pyrkhat ba u kham khraw ïa uno na ki .
translation.en: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers , nor the desire of women , nor regard any god : for he shall magnify himself above all .
And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur , the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Rephaïah , u khun jong u Hur , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Jerusalem distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .

translation.en: And when he came to his disciples , he saw a great multitude about them , and the scribes questioning with them .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïadon bad kiwei ki synran , ki la ïohi ïa u paidbah babun sawdong jong ki bad katto katne na ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki ïania bad ki .

translation.en: And she said unto him , My lord , thou swarest by the  Lord  thy God unto thine handmaid , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne .
translation.kha: Ka jubab ,  Syiem Kynrad , phi la pynlong ka jingsmai bakyntang ha nga ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ba u Solomon , u khun jong nga un long syiem hadien jong phi .
Man la ka janmiet , u Aaron un thang ki bad un ieh meh haduh mynstep ha khmat U Trai shabar ka jingkah kaba ha khmat ka Synduk Jutang . Ïa kane ka hukum dei ban leh pateng la pateng .
translation.en: Without the veil of the testimony , in the tabernacle of the congregation , shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the  Lord  continually : it shall be a statute for ever in your generations .
And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God , to them who are the called according to his purpose .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ha kiei kiei baroh , U Blei u trei na ka bynta ka jingpynbha ïa kito kiba ieit ïa u , ïa kito ïa kiba u la khot kat kum ka jingthmu jong u .
U Eliphas rangsamla u Bildad bad u Uei ki la leh apostol kaei ba U Trai u la bthah ïa Khynñiuh ban .—Hebru , bad jingtep Trai u la jubab Jearim ka jingduwai Baïap u Job pynsngewshyrkhei
translation.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went , and did according as the  Lord  commanded them : the  Lord  also accepted Job .
And I looked , and , behold , ye had sinned against the  Lord  your God , and had made you a molten calf : ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the  Lord  had commanded you .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ba phi la lyndet ïa ka hukum ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi , bad ba phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa u da kaba phi thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ka durblei ba la saiñ ha ka dur u khun masi .
Nangta u Gideon u la sngewthuh ba dei u angel jong U Trai ba u la ïohi , bad u ong ka ha jingsheptieng , A Trai Bakhrawbor ! Nga la ïohi ïa u angel jong markhmat me !
translation.en: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the  Lord  , Gideon said , Alas , O Lord  God  ! for because I have seen an angel of the  Lord  face to face .

translation.kha: ka Kinah ka Dimonah , ka Adadah ,
translation.en: And Kinah , and Dimonah , and Adadah ,
Remember , I beseech thee , the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses , saying , If ye transgress , I will scatter you abroad among the nations :
translation.kha: To kynmaw mynta kaei kaba me la ong ha u Moses : ‘ Lada ma phi ki briew ka Israel phin ym ïaineh ha nga , ngan pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng kiwei ki jaitbynriew .
Ngam don hok ïa kaba kum kane ka bainong bakhraw . Kumta ngan shu sngap on ïohbat ïa phi Diblathaim “lada katne palat ïa ka Jordan .
translation.en: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king : and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward ?

translation.kha: buh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga jong phi bad ngan peit phi bud ïa ki jong nga bad sumar ki hukum jong nga kiba nga ai phi .
translation.en: And I will put my spirit within you , and cause you to walk in my statutes , and ye shall keep my judgments , and do them .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u ha ki briew , u da pyndonkam shibun kiwei pat ki pharshi kum kine ; u ïathuh la shibun ïa ki kat ki kaba lah ban sngewthuh .
translation.en: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them , as they were able to hear it .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki kum ka kynhun ki nonglute kiba ïa u . Wat ha ka lynti sha ka jaka bakhuid ha Shekhem ki pynïap briew . Bad ki leh ïa kane kaba sniew baroh da thmu !

translation.en: For ye see your calling , brethren , how that not many wise men after the flesh , not many mighty , not many noble , are called :

translation.en: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar , the shittah tree , and the myrtle , and the oil tree  ; I will set in the desert the fir tree , and the pine , and the box tree together :

translation.en: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan , and swear to the  Lord  of hosts  ; one shall be called , The city of destruction .

And when Peter saw it , he answered unto the people , Ye men of Israel , why marvel ye at this ? or why look ye so earnestly on us , as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk ?

To ai ba ki briew ka Seïon kin ong , To ai ba ka Babilonia kan kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka halor jinglehbor jong ngi ! To ba ai ki briew Jerusalem ka kin ong , To ai ba ka Babilonia kan kitkhlieh na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la shahshitom !
translation.en: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon , shall the inhabitant of Zion say  ; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea , shall Jerusalem say .

translation.kha: Ka jingkheiñ ki rangbah kiba la bam ka la long saw hajar , ngut khlem da ñiew ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .
translation.en: And they that did eat were four thousand men , beside women and children .
The paper reeds by the brooks , by the mouth of the brooks , and every thing sown by the brooks , shall wither , be driven away , and be no more .
translation.kha: bad baroh ki jingthung ba la bet ha ki rudwah jong ka Nile kin tyrkhong bad yn sa rong noh .

Ha kata ka por wat ïa Horonaim baje ha ki pynkyllut teh jong ki kulai yn thoh da ki jingrai Ba la pynkyntang sha shano Trai . Ki khiew shet ha ka Templ ktang long kiba kyntang kum ki Bha ha khmat ka duwan .
translation.en: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses , HOLINESS UNTO THE  Lord   ; and the pots in the  Lord s  house shall be like the bowls before the altar .

And the man that will do presumptuously , and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the  Lord  thy God , or unto the judge , even that man shall die : and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba nud ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u nongbishar lane ïa u lyngdoh uba shakri ha kata ka por ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; u dei ban shah pynïap . Da kumta phin pynkhuid ïa kata ka jingbymman na Israel .

translation.en: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen , that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard : but the husbandmen beat him , and sent him away empty .
translation.kha: Haba ka por ka poi ban lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa u mraw sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang na ki ïa la ka bynta na ka jingkheit soh . Hynrei , ki nongshimwai ki shoh ïa uta u mraw bad ki la phah noh thylli ïa u .

translation.en: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together , and encamp against the city , and take it : lest I take the city , and it be called after my name .
translation.kha: Mynta , lumlang ïa kiba sah jong ki shipai jong phi , tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , bad knieh ïa ka da lade hi . Ngam kwah ban ïoh ka burom ïa ka jingïohknieh ïa ka .
Bad mynta , ko Trai , to khmih ïa ki jingbyrngem kiba ki la pynlong , shah bad ïa ngi , ki shakri jong me , ban kren ïa ka khubor jong me da ka baroh jingshlur .
translation.en: And now , Lord , behold their threatenings : and grant unto thy servants , that with all boldness they may speak thy word ,
He is wise in heart , and mighty in strength : who hath hardened himself against him , and hath prospered ?
translation.kha: U Blei u long uba stad bad uba donbor katta katta ; ym don u briew uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa u .
U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis la u wan , bad u la shahjingit bad um dih waiñ , phi bad ong , ‘ U don u ksuid hapoh jong u !’
translation.en: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine  ; and ye say , He hath a devil .

translation.kha: Ka ruh ka dap da ka jingkwah brai ïa ki kynsai riew bad ki rangbah shipai nong Assyria — ki shipai ha ki riam shipai baphyrnai — bad ïa ki samla shipai ba-bhabriew , kito baroh ki shynrang samla ba-bhabriew .
translation.en: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours , captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously , horsemen riding upon horses , all of them desirable young men .

translation.kha: Na suiñbneng me phah ïa u slap halor ki lum , bad ïa pyrthei ka la pyndap da ki jingkyrkhu jong me .
translation.en: He watereth the hills from his chambers : the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works .

translation.kha: Kumta u Isaak u kylli Balei ba wan sha nga mynta , phi la isih ïa nga mynshuwa bad ba phi la ïa nga ban mihnoh na ri jong phi
translation.en: And Isaac said unto them , Wherefore come ye to me , seeing ye hate me , and have sent me away from you ?
Salt is good : but if the salt have lost his savour , wherewith shall it be seasoned ?
translation.kha: Ka mluh ka long kaba bha , hynrei lada ka duh noh ïa ka jingmad , ym don lynti shuh da kumno kumno ban pynbang pat ïa ka .

translation.en: And there abode three months . And when the Jews laid wait for him , as he was about to sail into Syria , he purposed to return through Macedonia .
translation.kha: Nangta u la wan sha Akhaïa , ha kaba u la sah lai bnai . U la khreh ban leit sha Syria haba u la shem ba ki la don ki Jiw kiba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ; kumta u la kut jingmut ban leit phai pat lyngba ka Makedonia .

translation.en: And then will I profess unto them , I never knew you : depart from me , ye that work iniquity .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan ong ha ki , ‘ Ngam ju la ithuh ïa phi . Khie leit noh na nga , phi ki briew bymman !’

translation.en: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel , I will search and take them out thence  ; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea , thence will I command the serpent , and he shall bite them :
translation.kha: Lada ki rieh ha khlieh u lum Karmel , ngan wad ïa ki bad kem ïa ki . Lada ki rieh na jong nga ha trai duriaw , ngan hukum ïa ki mrad duriaw bakynsha ban dait ïa ki .
wer u rangbah synshar u ïeng Probins bad u pyrta ha ka Gideon Hebru , To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Assyria u ïathuh ha phi Gerar
translation.en: Then Rabshakeh stood , and cried with a loud voice in the Jews  language , and said , Hear ye the words of the great king , the king of Assyria .

And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king , saying , Two measures of barley for a shekel , and a measure of fine flour for a shekel , shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria :
translation.kha: U Elisha u la ïathuh ha u syiem ba ha kaba kum kata ka por ha ka sngi kaba bud lai kilo u kew uba bha tam lane hynriew kilo u barli yn die ha Samaria ha ka dor shi sbai rupa ,

translation.en: Then thine heart be lifted up , and thou forget the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage  ;
translation.kha: kynmaw ban ym sngewsarong bad ban ym klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
Ko Kynrad , phai rangbah synshar to bad shuwa ba u khun jong un ïap .
translation.en: The nobleman saith unto him , Sir , come down ere my child die .
The Lord  God  which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith , Yet will I gather others to him , beside those that are gathered unto him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar , uba la wallam pat ïa ki paid Israel sha ïing na ka ri ka jinglongmraw , u la kular ba un sa wallam ïa kiwei pat ki briew ban ïasoh lang bad ki .

translation.en: Then Judah came near unto him , and said , Oh my lord , let thy servant , I pray thee , speak a word in my lord s ears , and let not thine anger burn against thy servant : for thou art even as Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Nangta u Judah u leit kham hajan u Joseph , bad u ong ,  Ko kynrad , shah ïa nga ban kren laitluid bad phi . Wat bitar ïa nga , phi long kum u syiem hi .

translation.en: And I will set my face against you , and ye shall be slain before your enemies : they that hate you shall reign over you  ; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you .
translation.kha: Ngan phai pyrshah ïa phi , te phin shahjop ha ki nongshun jong phi , bad kito kiba phi isih kin synshar halor jong phi ; phin sngewsheptieng haduh katta katta ba phin phet ïap haba ym don ba beh ïa phi .
Kumno nga lah ban tim ïa kaei kaba U Blei um shym la tim , Lane kren shaphang ka jingjot haba U Trai um shym kren ?
translation.en: How shall I curse , whom God hath not cursed ? or how shall I defy , whom the  Lord  hath not defied ?

translation.kha: Em , U nongpruid u jingmihnoh ïathuh ïa ngi Patmos ïaw kaba sngewbiang . Kaei kaba u dawa kdup ngi ka long kane : Ban leh ïa kaei Ïuphratis hok , Seus pyn-i ïa ka jingieit baneh , bad ban pyn-at ha ka jingïasyllok basngewrit bad U pynrung jong ngi .
translation.en: He hath shewed thee , O man , what is good  ; and what doth the  Lord  require of thee , but to do justly , and to love mercy , and to walk humbly with thy God ?
Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men  ; that I might leave my people , and go from them ! for they be all adulterers , an assembly of treacherous men .
translation.kha: Nga thrang ban don ka jaka ban sah ha ka ri shyiap ha kaba nga lah ban lait na ki briew jong nga . Ma ki baroh ki long ki bymïaineh , ki paidbhur ki nongshetkylla .
Ym shym la don kamar ki ha Israel , namar ki Philistia ki la kut jingmut ban ailad ym ïa ki Hebru ban shna ïa ki waitlam ne ki sum .
translation.en: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel : for the Philistines said , Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears :

translation.kha: Ngan pynpluh ïa ki kynroh jong ka da Damaskos ka ding bad yn thang khoit ïa ki ïingsyiem jong u syiem Benhadad . Ma nga , Trai U Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .
translation.en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus , and it shall consume the palaces of Ben–hadad .

translation.kha: Mar kumta bit u angel Tertullos U Trai u la tied ïa u Herod , namar ba um shym ai burom ïa U jingkajia Tabrimmon La bam ïa u katto ki ksaiñ plung bad u la ïap .
translation.en: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him , because he gave not God the glory : and he was eaten of worms , and gave up the ghost .
So when they had further threatened them , they let them go , finding nothing how they might punish them , because of the people : for all men glorified God for that which was done .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Dorbar ka la maham ïa ki kham tyngeh bad nangta la pyllait noh ïa ki . Ki la ïohi ba ka long ka bym lah long ban pynshitom ïa ki , namar ki paidbah baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kaei kaba la jia .
Phim lah ban dih jynrat ka khuri U Trai bad ruh na ka khuri ki ksuid ; Olumpas lah jingphla ïabam na ka miej U Trai bad ruh na ka miej jingmaham ïashad .
translation.en: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord , and the cup of devils : ye cannot be partakers of the Lord s table , and of the table of devils .

Then Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city , and those that fell away , that fell to him , with the rest of the people that remained .
translation.kha: Khatduh u Nebusaradan , u rangbah shipai , u la ringmraw sha Babilonia ïa ki briew ba dang sah ha ka nongbah , ryngkat bad ïa kito kiba la iehnoh ïa u .
Lada phi long kiba shemphang , Hadassah ïoh jingïohpateng ; lada phi long kiba mutlop , ki mawthoh kin peitbeiñ ïa phi .
translation.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom : but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised .

And this I say , that the covenant , that was confirmed before of God in Christ , the law , which was four hundred and thirty years after , cannot disannul , that it should make the promise of none effect .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa ka jutang bad u Abraham bad u la kular ban bat ïa ka . Ka hukum , ïa kaba la ai hadien sawspah laiphew snem , kam lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad pyndam noh ïa ka jingkular U Blei .

translation.en: Then Hazael king of Syria went up , and fought against Gath , and took it : and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Hasael u syiem ka Syria u tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Gath bad u jop ïa ka ; nangta u rai ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And if thou deal thus with me , kill me , I pray thee , out of hand , if I have found favour in thy sight  ; and let me not see my wretchedness .
translation.kha: Lada me leh kumne ïa nga , to sngewsynei ïa nga bad pynïap noh ïa nga , khnang ba ngan ym hap shah shuh ïa kane ka jingleh badonbor jong me .
Ngan sa pynshlei ïa ka pyrthei da um ka ban pynduh noh khoit ïa ki ba-im kynja baroh . Baroh kat kiba don ha ka pyrthei kin ïap .
translation.en: And , behold , I , even I , do bring a flood of waters upon the earth , to destroy all flesh , wherein is the breath of life , from under heaven  ; and every thing that is in the earth shall die .

translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka long , bad ïa ki khyrdop ka la pyntwa noh .
translation.en: In the city is left desolation , and the gate is smitten with destruction .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Mynta nga pynlong ka jutang bad ki paid Israel Ha . khmat jong ki leh ngan ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw , ïa kiba ym pat ju leh mynno mynno ha ka pyrthei hapdeng kano kano ka jaitbynriew . Baroh ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ïa ki kam kiba khraw kiba ma nga , U Trai nga ban lah leh , namar ngan leh ïa kaei kaba kaei na khraw ka jong bynta phi .
translation.en: And he said , Behold , I make a covenant : before all thy people I will do marvels , such as have not been done in all the earth , nor in any nation : and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the  Lord  : for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee .

translation.kha: Shen hadien ba u Sedekaïah u la long u syiem ka Judah , U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la Jingiaid Kheiñ nga shaphang ka balung Elam .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah , saying ,

And it was so , that all that saw it said , There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day : consider of it , take advice , and speak your minds .
translation.kha: Kat uba ïohi ïa ka u ong ,  Ngim pat ju ïohsngew ïa kaba kum kane kaei kaei ! Ym pat ju jia mynno mynno kaba kum kane naduh ba ki Israel ki la mih na Ijipt ! Ngi dei ban leh ei ei na ka bynta kane ! Kan jia aïu hadien ?

translation.en: And he will appoint him captains over thousands , and captains over fifties  ; and will set them to ear his ground , and to reap his harvest , and to make his instruments of war , and instruments of his chariots .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki un thung kum ki rangbah synshar ki ban peit ïa ki shihajar ngut ki rangbah bad katto katne ngut ki ban peit ïa ki sanphew ngut ki rangbah : ki khun shynrang jong phi kin hap ban lur ïa ki lyngkha jong u , ban lum ïa ki jingmih jong u na ka khyndew , bad ban shna ïa ki tiar thma bad ki tiar kali ïapom jong u .
Hadien ba ki la pynlong “Ki kane ka jingïateh kular ha Thiah , u Abimelekh bad u Phikol ki leit phai 20 sha Philistia .
translation.en: Thus they made a covenant at Beer–sheba : then Abimelech rose up , and Phichol the chief captain of his host , and they returned into the land of the Philistines .
And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Suffer it to be so now : for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness .  Then he suffered him .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Ai ba kan long kumta ïa mynta . Naba kumne keiñ ngin pyndep ïa kata baroh kaba U Blei u dawa .  Kumta u Ïoannis u la mynjur .

translation.en: And a mitre of fine linen , and goodly bonnets of fine linen , and linen breeches of fine twined linen ,
translation.kha: bad ka jaiñspong , ki tupia , ki patlun ,

translation.en: Then the men feared the  Lord  exceedingly , and offered a sacrifice unto the  Lord  , and made vows .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynlong ïa ki maji ban sheptieng ïa U  Trai  ha kaba ki la ai ka jingkñia bad kular ban shakri ïa u .

translation.en: In that time shall the present be brought unto the  Lord  of hosts of a people scattered and peeled , and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto  ; a nation meted out and trodden under foot , whose land the rivers have spoiled , to the place of the name of the  Lord  of hosts , the mount Zion .
translation.kha: Ka por ka wan haba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pdiang ïa ki jingainguh na kane ka ri ba la pynïakhlad ïa ki wah , kane ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñ bad kaba donbor , ki briew kiba jrong bad kiba jlih ka sniehdoh , ïa kiba la sheptieng ha ka pyrthei baroh . Kin wan sha u Lum Seïon , ha kaba la mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: O Lord , what shall I say , when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies !
translation.kha: Aïu nga lah ban ong , A  Trai  , mynta ba ki Israel ki la kynran dien na u nongshun ?

Pha kynta ïa lade ha la ki kam sniew ; pha pyrkhat sawphew ym don Pisidia mano ba ïohi ïa pha . Ka jingstad bad jingrakhe jingtip jlih pha ki ïalam bakla ïa pha , bad pha ong snam lade , ‘ Nga long U bashipor — ym don uno uno pat kum ma nga .’
translation.en: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness : thou hast said , None seeth me . Thy wisdom and thy knowledge , it hath perverted thee  ; and thou hast said in thine heart , I am , and none else beside me .
Where are the gods of Hamath , and of Arpad ? where are the gods of Sepharvaim , Hena , and Ivah ? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand ?
translation.kha: Shano ki don mynta , ki blei jong ka Hamath bad ka Arpad ? Shano ki blei jong ka Sepharbaim , ka Hena , bad ka Ibbah ? Hato don na ki kiba la pyllait im ïa ka Samaria ?

translation.en: And Jacob went on his way , and the angels of God met him .
translation.kha: Katba u Jakob u nang leit ha la ka lynti , katto katne ngut ki angel ki la wan ïashem ïa u .

U Ahasaïah u la long syiem haba u la don arphew ar ka rta , bad u synshar shisnem Jerusalem . U Ahasaïah ruh u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong longïing jong u Syiem Ahab , ba ka Athalaïah , ka kmie jong u ka khun u syiem Ahab bad ka ksiew jong u Omri u ka — ka la ai jingmut ïa , kaba la ïalam sha ka jingsniew .
translation.en: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab : for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam Israel baroh ki shaniah la ha ka jingkhlaiñ bad ki pynïap briew .
translation.en: Behold , the princes of Israel , every one were in thee to their power to shed blood .
And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered , that this woman was delivered also : and we were together  ; there was no stranger with us in the house , save we two in the house .
translation.kha: Ar sngi hadien ba la kha ïa u khun jong nga , ka ruh ka kha khun shynrang . Ngi ïadon tang ma ngi hi ar ngut ha kata ka ïing — ym don mano mano ba don ryngkat .
Baroh ar ngut ki pynshongkurim ka jingim kaba bha ha khmat U Blei bad ki la kohnguh lut ïa baroh ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong U Trai .
translation.en: And they were both righteous before God , walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless .

translation.kha: U Trai u hukum ïa u Moses bad ïa u ; ha ki Israel bad ha u Pharaoh nga la hukum ïa phi ban noh ïa ki Israel na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel , and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt .
And he said , The God of our fathers hath chosen thee , that thou shouldest know his will , and see that Just One , and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth .
translation.kha: U la ong , ‘ U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la jied ïa me ban tip ïa ka mon jong u , bad ban ïohi ïa U Shakri bahok jong u , bad ban ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren ha ka sur jong u hi .

translation.en: And they journeyed : and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them , and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob .
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki sdang ban mih , ka jingsheptieng kaba khraw ka la wan hap ha ki briew kiba don ha ki shnong ba-marjan , bad kim shym la beh satia ïa ki .

translation.en: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward , even unto the sea of the plain , under the springs of Pisgah .
translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa kata ka thain baroh kaba sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan haduh ka Duriaw Baïap kaba shaphang shathie , bad nangta haduh ka kjat lum Pisgah shaphang mihngi .
Ïa ki miej ha kiba ki shong la tap da ka prie bad sloit don shuh ka jingbhasbun kaba khuid Shelomith
translation.en: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness , so that there is no place clean .

translation.kha: U Elijah u nongïathuhlypa u la phah shoh-ïap Ebed u Jehoram , kaba ong kumne harum : U Trai , Eli Blei kam u ruh , u kpa tymmen Mynsngi me , u Sedekaïah ïa me , namar mem shym bud ïa Nebaïoth shahshkor u syiem Jehoshaphat , u kpa Nashim Ninebeh lane Sawphew ka jong u syiem Asa , u Nongïarap jong me .
translation.en: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of David thy father , Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father , nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah ,

translation.kha: ïaskhem step phyrngab thehsei ka step baroh ki briew ki la leit sha Salmunna Templ ban sngap ïa u Pudens
translation.en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple , for to hear him .
Notwithstanding in this rejoice not , that the spirits are subject unto you  ; but rather rejoice , because your names are written in heaven .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat kmen namar ba ki mynsiem bymman ki kohnguh ïa phi ; pynban , to kmen namar ba ïa ki kyrteng jong phi la thoh ha bneng .

translation.en: Man knoweth not the price thereof  ; neither is it found in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingstad ym lah ban shem hapdeng ki briew ; ym don batip ïa ka dor bashisha jong ka .

translation.en: The length of the porch was twenty cubits , and the breadth eleven cubits  ; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it : and there were pillars by the posts , one on this side , and another on that side .
translation.kha: Ki mawkyrdon ki lam sha ka kamra rung ha kaba ka la long shiphew mitar ka pyngkiang bad hynriew mitar ka jingjylliew . La don ar tylli ki païa , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka tyngkong .

translation.en: I will never forget thy precepts : for with them thou hast quickened me .
translation.kha: Ngan ym leh lyndet ïa ki jingbthah jong me , namar da ki me la ri pynim ïa nga .

translation.en: Therefore doth my Father love me , because I lay down my life , that I might take it again .
translation.kha: U Kpa u ieit ïa nga namar ba nga kloi ban aiti ïa la ka jingim , khnang ba nga lah ban ïohpdiang pat ïa ka .
Ha ka jingshisha , la kha ïa ngi kum ki Jiw bad ym kum ki Jentil bapop kumba khot la ïa ki .
translation.en: We who are Jews by nature , and not sinners of the Gentiles ,

translation.kha: Ynda u Noah u la dap sanspah snem ka rta u , ïoh lai ngut ki khun , shynrang u Shem , u Ham , bad u Japheth .
translation.en: And Noah was five hundred years old : and Noah begat Shem , Ham , and Japheth .

translation.kha: Haba u nong-ohdur u kpa hajan jingpar Absalom ban nguh ha khmat jong u , u Absalom u ju kner Shur Thaw kti Hananel u bat ïa u , bad u doh ïa u .
translation.en: And it was so , that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance , he put forth his hand , and took him , and kissed him .

translation.kha: Haba un pyrshang ban phet na ka nar , ka ryntieh rnong kan siat ban ïa u .
translation.en: He shall flee from the iron weapon , and the bow of steel shall strike him through .

translation.en: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead four hundred young virgins , that had known no man by lying with any male : and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh , which is in the land of Canaan .
And their words pleased Hamor , and Shechem Hamor s son .
translation.kha: Kine ki kyndon ki ibit ibiang ïa u Hamor bad ïa u Shekhem u khun jong u ,
Haba la poi ha kata jaka , u la ong ha ki , Duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi .
translation.en: And when he was at the place , he said unto them ,  Pray that ye enter not into temptation .
In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus , of the seed of the Medes , which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans  ;
translation.kha: U Darius u nong Mid , uba long u khun jong u Serksis , u la synshar ïa ka hima Babilonia .

translation.en: The godly principles in the Bible show us how to live in a way that brings physical benefits .
translation.kha: Ka tynrai jong ka jingim ba riew Blei kaba don ha ka Baibl ka pyni ïa ngi kumno ban im ban sah ha ka rukom ka ban wanrah ka jingmyntoi shimet .
Mynshuwa nga la tip ïa tang kaei kaba kiwei ki la ïathuh ïa nga , da kaba nga ïohsngew pateng na kiwei ; hynrei mynta nga la ïohi ïa me da la jong ki ki khmat .
translation.en: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear : but now mine eye seeth thee .

And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword  ; and they shall have none to bury them , them , their wives , nor their sons , nor their daughters : for I will pour their wickedness upon them .
translation.kha: Ki briew ha kiba ki la kren ïa kine kiei kiei kin ïap ha kajuh ka rukom . Ïa ki met jong ki yn bret shabar ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem , bad yn ym don mano mano ban tep ïa ki . Kane kan jia ha ki baroh — kynthup ïa ki tnga jong ki , ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki . Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban siew na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong ki .
U Kibroth u ong shadong U Trai jingshah la Phikol ïa phi ban leh ïa kane baroh , synñia ba ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong u kan jingphna ha phi nujor
translation.en: And Moses said , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded that ye should do : and the glory of the  Lord  shall appear unto you .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u jubab , Kam long kaba dei ba ngin leh kumta , namar ki nong Ijipt kin thut haba ngin kñia ki ïa mrad kiba ngi ai sha U Trai U Blei jong ngi . Lada pyndonkam ngi ïa kine ki mrad pynmong bad ïa ki nong Ijipt da kaba kñia ïa kine ki jingri ha ka jaka ki ba lah ban , ïohi kin sa lynthem maw ïa ngi .
translation.en: And Moses said , It is not meet so to do  ; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the  Lord  our God : lo , shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes , and will they not stone us ?
How was the journey yesterday ?
translation.kha: Kumno ka Jingiaid lynti jong phi mynnin ?

translation.en: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat , and for a place of refuge , and for a covert from storm and from rain .
translation.kha: Ka burom jong u kan kah ïa ka nongbah na ka jingshit jong ka sngi bad pynlong ïa ka , ka jaka kaba shngain , kaba la da na u slap bad ka  erïong .
Methuselah u la dap shispah phraphew hynñiew snem ka rta , u khun shynrang , u Lamekh ,
translation.en: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years , and begat Lamech :
And now thy two sons , Ephraim and Manasseh , which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt , are mine  ; as Reuben and Simeon , they shall be mine .
translation.kha: U Jakob u bteng ,  Joseph , ki khun shynrang jong me ar ngut kiba me la ïoh ha Ijipt shuwa ba ngan wan hangne ki dei ki jong nga ; u Ephraim bad u Manasseh ki long ki khun jong nga kumba long u Reuben bad u Simeon .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel , Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki Israel :  Phi la ïohi kumno ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren ha phi na bneng .

translation.en: Tom gave his seat to an elderly lady .
translation.kha: U Tom u ai ia ka jakashong jong u ha I tymmen kynthei .
Phi sarong ba phi la pynlong ïa ka bad ka bad poi sha ka jingïakut bad ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Phi ba phin ka jingjot haba kan wan , namar shaniah ki bad ki jingshukor ban pyllait phi .
translation.en: Because ye have said , We have made a covenant with death , and with hell are we at agreement  ; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through , it shall not come unto us : for we have made lies our refuge , and under falsehood have we hid ourselves :
Thou knowest that I am not wicked  ; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand .
translation.kha: Me tip ba ngam shym leh pop , bad ba ym don uwei ruh uba lah ban pyllait im ïa nga na me .

translation.en: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart : thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour , and not suffer sin upon him .
translation.kha: Wat buhnud ïano ïano , hynrei ïapynbeit ïa ka jingïapher jingmut hapdeng jong phi , khnang ba yn ym pynleh pop ïa phi namar jong u .
Nangta , U Jisu u la leit sha Kapernam , ka shnong ha Galilaïa , ha lyndum u sngewdiaw hikai ïa u paidbah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: And came down to Capernaum , a city of Galilee , and taught them on the sabbath days .

And the people said unto Saul , Shall Jonathan die , who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel ? God forbid : as the  Lord  liveth , there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground  ; for he hath wrought with God this day . So the people rescued Jonathan , that he died not .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki paidbah ki ong ha u Saul ,  Hato u Jonathan , uba la jop ka jingjop kaba khraw na ka bynta ki Israel , un shah pynïap ? Em ! Ngi kular ha U  Trai  uba im ba uwei u shñiuh na ka khlieh jong u ruh un ym hap ha khyndew . Kaei kaba u la leh ha kane ka sngi la leh da ka jingïarap jong U Blei .  Kumta ki paidbah ki la pyllait im ïa u Jonathan na kaba shah pynïap .

translation.en: And the priest shall see him : and , behold , if the rising be white in the skin , and it have turned the hair white , and there be quick raw flesh in the rising  ;
translation.kha: u ban khmih bniah ïa u . Lada ka don ka prum kaba lieh ha ka sniehdoh jong u kaba la pynlieh ïa u shñiuh bad kaba dap da ka ksuit ,

Te shibun ki kin ïeng ïaleh pyrshah syiem ka Ijipt Bad katto katne ki rangbah thombor na ka jaitbynriew me , ko Daniel , kin ïeng ïaleh pyrshah namar ka jingïohipaw kaba ki la lah ïohi , hynrei kin sa shahjop .
translation.en: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south : also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision  ; but they shall fall .

translation.kha: Kumta uta uba hiar shapoh u long uta ujuh uba leit kiew shaneng , shajrong bad sha lyndet ki bneng kynsi ban Jerikho ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei da ka Jeremaïah ryngkat jong u .
translation.en: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens , that he might fill all things . )

And they shall fill thy houses , and the houses of all thy servants , and the houses of all the Egyptians  ; which neither thy fathers , nor thy fathers  fathers have seen , since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day . And he turned himself , and went out from Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Kin dap ha ki ïingsyiem jong me , bad ha ki ïing jong ki rangbah synshar bad ki briew jong me baroh . Kin long kiba kham sniew ban ïa kano kano kaba ki kpa tymmen jong me ki la ju ïohi .’   Nangta u Moses u phai bad u mihnoh .
U kpa u ïai ban ba un sah , bad kumta u sah hangta lai . sngi Ki shi jur ïabam ki ïadih bad ki sah hangta baroh lai miet .
translation.en: And his father in law , the damsel s father , retained him  ; and he abode with him three days : so they did eat and drink , and lodged there .

translation.kha: Mynta to iehnoh ïa nga marwei ban ïamkthang khlem kito na ki briew nongwankai nga kiba la ïap . Wat pyrshang ban pyntngen ïa nga .
translation.en: Therefore said I , Look away from me  ; I will weep bitterly , labour not to comfort me , because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people .

translation.kha: Ha ka ryngkat ki synran u U Jisu u la leh kiwei pat kambah ïa kiba ym shym la thoh ha ka kitab .
translation.en: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples , which are not written in this book :

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki lyngdoh ! To pynleit jingmut , kynthei ki paid Israel ! nga! shahshkor , phi jingtamsneng na ka longïing u syiem ! Jingpynïoh syrngiew ai ïa phi ban bishar da ka hok — Ahasaïah ka jingbishar pyndonkam wan hap ha phi ! .) la long stait jingriam kynjri Mispah , ka jar Asia la pynap ha u lum Tabor ,
translation.en: Hear ye this , O priests  ; and hearken , ye house of Israel  ; and give ye ear , O house of the king  ; for judgment is toward you , because ye have been a snare on Mizpah , and a net spread upon Tabor .

And Moses told his father in law all that the  Lord  had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel s sake , and all the travail that had come upon them by the way , and how the  Lord  delivered them .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ïathuh ha u Jethro ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la leh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki nong Ijipt khnang ba un ïoh pyllait im ïa ki Israel . U la ïathuh ruh ha u ïa ki jingeh ba ki Israel ki la ïakynduh ha lynti bad kumno U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa ki .
Da shisha , nga ong ha phi , u kynrad un buh ïa uta u shakri “ksuid” khmih ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u baroh .
translation.en: Of a truth I say unto you , that he will make him ruler over all that he hath .
Son of man , set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and prophesy against him , and against all Egypt :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . To ong ha u kumno ba ma u bad baroh kiba ha ka ri Ijipt kin shah pynshitom .
To wallam pat ïa ngi sha me , ko Trai ! To wallam pat ïa ngi ! To pynïoh pat ïa maw-it burom Anaharath Joanan
translation.en: Turn thou us unto thee , O  Lord  , and we shall be turned  ; renew our days as of old .
Afterwards the spirit took me up , and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea , to them of the captivity . So the vision that I had seen went up from me .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw , U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah shajrong ïa nga bad wallam pat ïa nga sha kiba shah ringmraw ha Babilonia . Nangta ka jingïohipaw ka jah noh ,
bakwah jingkyrmen bashisha ban ïashem biang pynphaloh kiba ieid ba thoin kiba la ïap .—Ioannis 5 :28 , 29 .
translation.en: A real hope of being reunited with your dead loved ones . —John 5 :28 , 29 .

translation.kha: Kiei kiei baroh ki neh haduh kane ka sngi namar ka hukum jong me , namar baroh ki long ki shakri jong batai .
translation.en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances : for all are thy servants .
Because he considereth , and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed , he shall surely live , he shall not die .
translation.kha: U sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba u leh bad u sangeh ban leh pop , kumta un ym ïap da shisha , hynrei un ïai im .
U Benabinadab , uba shongkurim ïa ka Taphath , ka khun jong Solomon : ka thain baroh kawei ;
translation.en: The son of Abinadab , in all the region of Dor  ; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife :

translation.kha: U Trai u ïalam ïa u shabar bad u ong , Khmih ka ïa sahit bneng , bad pyrshang ñiew ïa ki khlur ; ïoh men bun ki khun ki ksiew kat kita .
translation.en: And he brought him forth abroad , and said , Look now toward heaven , and tell the stars , if thou be able to number them : and he said unto him , So shall thy seed be .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ïa ka ka kur jong u Makhir bad ki la shong la hangta .
translation.en: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh  ; and he dwelt therein .
And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds , his knops , and his flowers :
translation.kha: Ka ktang jong uta u diengpynïeng sharak ka don saw tylli ki khuri kiba kum ka dur ki syntiew soh almond lem bad ki shata syntiew ba la oh-shrong itynnat .

Nangta tamasa suh sha ka sharing lum ha ka angkor nangta jong ka Lus ( kaba la khot jingshongthait ka Bethel ) , nangta arsut shaduh Ataroth Addar , ha u lum uba shathie na ka Beth Horon kaba sharum .
translation.en: And the border went over from thence toward Luz , to the side of Luz , which is Beth–el , southward  ; and the border descended to Ataroth–adar , near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth–horon .

translation.kha: U u Dabid jubab , Nga don ha ka khim khait ! ngam Hynrei kwah ba ngan shah pynshitom ha ki . briew Ai ba U Trai da lade hi un dei uta u ban pynshitom ïa ngi , namar u long uba dap da ka jingisynei .
translation.en: And David said unto Gad , I am in a great strait : let us fall now into the hand of the  Lord   ; for his mercies are great : and let me not fall into the hand of man .
To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph , of the house of David  ; and the virgin s name was Mary .
translation.kha: U la don ka khubor ïa ka theisotti kaba la ïatehktien bad u briew uba kyrteng u Joseph , uba long u nonghiarpateng na u syiem Dabid . Ka kyrteng jong ka , ka long ka Mari .
Uwei pa uwei uba shong ha lynter ka duriaw rud u kyndit ïa kupar ka jong pha . Wat ki syiem jong ki , ki sngewtriem , bad ka jingsheptieng ka paw ha ki khmat jong ki .
translation.en: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee , and their kings shall be sore afraid , they shall be troubled in their countenance .

translation.kha: Ynda u ai ïa ka ha phi , phi dei ban ai sha U Trai Baroh u khun nyngkong baroh jarjar Man uba la kha nyngkong na ki mrad u Jingot u jong U Trai .
translation.en: That thou shalt set apart unto the  Lord  all that openeth the matrix , and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast  ; the males shall be the  Lord s .

translation.kha: Ki pop u riewbymman ki long ka jingriam . U ngat ha ka jingriam jong ki pop jong u . hi
translation.en: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself , and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins .

The matter is not so : but a man of mount Ephraim , Sheba the son of Bichri by name , hath lifted up his hand against the king , even against David : deliver him only , and I will depart from the city . And the woman said unto Joab , Behold , his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall .
translation.kha: Kata kam dei ka jingthmu jong ngi . U briew uba kyrteng u Sheba , u khun jong u Bikri , uba na ka ri lum Ephraim , u la sdang ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa u Syiem Dabid . Aiti ïa une u briew , bad ngan kynriah noh na ka nongbah .   Ngin bret ïa ka khlieh jong u sha phi nalor ka kynroh ,  ka ong .

translation.en: Now when all this was finished , all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah , and brake the images in pieces , and cut down the groves , and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin , in Ephraim also and Manasseh , until they had utterly destroyed them all . Then all the children of Israel returned , every man to his possession , into their own cities .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la kut , baroh ki paid Israel ki leit sha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah ha Judah bad ki pynpra ïa ki rishot maw , ki pyndkut ïa ki dur ka blei Asherah , bad ki pynjot ïa ki duwan bad ki jaka mane blei thala . Ki leh ïa kajuh ha baroh ki bynta basah jong ka Judah , bad ïa ki ri jong ki Benjamin , Ephraim bad Manasseh ; nangta baroh na ki , ki leit phai sha ïing .

translation.en: And I , behold , I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel : to you they are given as a gift for the  Lord  , to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Dei ma nga uta uba la jied ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong me , ki Lebi , napdeng ki Israel kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa me . Ki , ki long kiba la pynkyrpang sha nga , khnang ba ki lah ban pyndep ïa la ki kamram ha ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: They go up by the mountains  ; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them .
translation.kha: Ki tuid nalor ki lumbah bad sha ki them , sha ka jaka ba me la buh na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep .
translation.kha: Ki ksuid ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ym phah ïa ki sha ka  liewlong khlem trai .

translation.en: The son of Geber , in Ramoth–gilead  ; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh , which are in Gilead  ; to him also pertained the region of Argob , which is in Bashan , threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars :
translation.kha: U Bengeber : ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead , bad ki shnong ha Gilead kiba dei jong ki kur u Jair , uba hiarpateng na u Manasseh , bad ka thain Argob ha Bashan , baroh hynriewphew tylli ki shnong kiba heh , kiba la ker da ki kynroh bad ki nar rnong ha ki khyrdop

translation.en: And Elijah said unto all the people , Come near unto me . And all the people came near unto him . And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  that was broken down .
translation.kha: Hadien kata u Elijah u ong ïa u paidbah ,  Wan kham hajan sha nga ,  bad baroh ki la wan ïalum sawdong ïa u . U shna pynbha ïa ka duwan U  Trai  kaba la pra .
Haba shem ka ïa ka , ka khot lang ïa paralok ki bad ïa paramarjan ki jong ka , bad ka ong ha ki , ‘ Nga kmen haduh katta katta ba nga la shem ïa ka pisa kaba nga la jah . To ngin ïalehkmen !’
translation.en: And when she hath found it , she calleth her friends and her neighbours together , saying , Rejoice with me  ; for I have found the piece which I had lost .
Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes , and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir–heres : because the riches that he hath gotten are perished .
translation.kha: Te ka dohnud jong nga ka ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka Moab bad na ka bynta ki briew ka Kir Heres , kumba mano re ba tem ïa ka jingrwai ïapbriew ha ka tangmuri , namar baroh kiei kiei kiba dei ki jong ki kim don shuh .

translation.en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet , and he walketh upon a snare .
translation.kha: U ïaid sha ka jar , bad ki kjat jong u ki ngat hangta ;

translation.en: And if he be not redeemed in these years , then he shall go out in the year of jubilee , both he , and his children with him .
translation.kha: Lada ym lah ban pyllait ïa u da kano kano na kine ki lad , ïa u bad ki khun jong u dei ban pyllait pat ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat ka ban wan .
Kane ka dei ka u Isaak u khun jong u Abraham .
translation.en: And these are the generations of Isaac , Abraham s son : Abraham begat Isaac :

translation.kha: Nangta Elath la ïohi ïa u angel uba la lah kren ha nga ïaphai u jam sha pynher bad ba uwei pynroh u angel u la wan ban ïashem ïa u rngai
translation.en: And , behold , the angel that talked with me went forth , and another angel went out to meet him ,
Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil concerning thee .
translation.kha: Bad u Mikaïah u pynkut :  Kane ka long kaei kaba la jia . U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me ban kren lamler ïa me . Hynrei ma u hi da lade u la rai ba phin ngat ha ka jingjot !

Ïa ki masi jong phi yn pynïap ha khmat jong phi hi , taïew phin ym pynpur bam ïa Rum pynlyngngoh jong aiñ . Ïa ki kada jong phi yn rong jubor ha khmat jong phi hi , bad yn nuti pynphai pat ïa riewtymmen sha phi mudui Ïa ki langbrot jong phi kada kor noh ha Sdang nongshun jong phi , bad yn ym don ba kynhied ïa phi .
translation.en: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes , and thou shalt not eat thereof : thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face , and shall not be restored to thee : thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies , and thou shalt have none to rescue them .
Wherefore comfort yourselves together , and edify one another , even as also ye do .
translation.kha: Bad kumta to pyntngen iwei ïa iwei pat bad to ïarap iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba phi leh mynta .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who was yet in Egypt , heard of it , ( for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon , and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt  ; )
translation.kha: Haba u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la leit sha Ijipt ban phet ïap na u syiem Solomon , u la ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u wan phai noh na Ijipt .

translation.en: He said unto him , I am a prophet also as thou art  ; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Bring him back with thee into thine house , that he may eat bread and drink water . But he lied unto him .
translation.kha: Te u nongïathuhlypa tymmen uba na Bethel u ong ha u ,  Nga ruh nga dei u nongïathuhlypa kum ma phi , bad ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  , u angel u la ong ïa nga ban ïalam ïa phi sha ïing bad ban ai ïa ka jingpdiang sngewbha ïa phi .  Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u lamler .

translation.en: And the first day of unleavened bread , when they killed the passover , his disciples said unto him , Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ka sngi ha kaba la pynïap ïa ki khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , ki synran U Jisu ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hangno me kwah ïa ngi ban leit bad ban pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ?

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel , Enquire , I pray thee , at the word of the  Lord  to day .
translation.kha: Hynrei ai ngin ïasyllok shuwa bad U  Trai .

Kumta nga la pyrkhat ba ka long kaba donkam ban ïa kyntu kine ki parabangeit ban leit ha shuwa jong nga sha phi bad ïoh pynkhreh lypa ïa ka jingai kaba phi la kular . Te kan kaba long la pynkhreh haba poi nga , bad kan pyn-i ba phi ai namar ba phi kwah ban leh kumta , ym namar ba phi dei ban kumta . leh
translation.en: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren , that they would go before unto you , and make up beforehand your bounty , whereof ye had notice before , that the same might be ready , as a matter of bounty , and not as of covetousness .
Not now as a servant , but above a servant , a brother beloved , specially to me , but how much more unto thee , both in the flesh , and in the Lord ?
translation.kha: Bad mynta um long shuh tang kum u mraw , hynrei kham palat ban ïa u mraw : u long u para ba-ieit ha U Khrist . Katno u long uba kordor ïa nga ! Bad katno khraw un long uba kordor ïa me , kum u mraw bad kum u para ha u Trai !

translation.en: Behold , I will bring evil upon thee , and will take away thy posterity , and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel ,
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ïa me , ‘ Ngan pynngat ïa ka jingjot ha me . Ngan sar noh phar ïa me , bad ngan pynduh khoit ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang na ka longïing jong me , la u samla bad tymmen kumjuh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand , in the fruit of thy body , and in the fruit of thy cattle , and in the fruit of thy land , for good : for the  Lord  will again rejoice over thee for good , as he rejoiced over thy fathers :
