Wat ka kynhun shipai kaba khlaiñ tam jong u syiem ka Ijipt kam Loit ban ïarep ïa u ban ïaleh pyndum thmu nong Ijipt buiñ tei ki jingtei khyndew bad tih “long kharai khnang ban pynïap bun ngut ki briew .
translation.en: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war , by casting up mounts , and building forts , to cut off many persons :

Then came there unto him all his brethren , and all his sisters , and all they that had been of his acquaintance before , and did eat bread with him in his house : and they bemoaned him , and comforted him over all the evil that the  Lord  had brought upon him : every man also gave him a piece of money , and every one an earring of gold .
translation.kha: Baroh ki hynmen ki para jong u Job , kynthei bad shynrang , bad ki paralok barim jong u , ki la wan jngoh ïa u bad ïabam sngewbha bad u ha ka ïing jong u . Ki la pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewlem jong ki bad ki pyngtngen ïa u namar ki jingjynjar baroh ba U  Trai  u la wallam halor jong u . Uwei pa uwei na ki u la ai katto katne ka pisa bad ka sati ksiar .

translation.en: For so is the will of God , that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men :
translation.kha: Naba U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban pynsngap jar ïa ka jingkren khlem pyrkhat jong ki briew kiba bieit da ki kam babha ba phi leh .

translation.en: Which he wrought in Christ , when he raised him from the dead , and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places ,
translation.kha: Kane ka bor kaba trei ha ngi ka long kajuh kum ka jingkhlaiñbor ba u pyndonkam haba u la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na kiba ïap , bad u la pynshong ïa u sha ka kti kamon jong u ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng .

translation.en: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger , in the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ïaishong ïaisah ha ka ri Kanaan , ha kaba u kpa jong u , u la shong la sah ,
mala shi miet lade” kyang bad Ap jingpang , la kumba u sing u pynkheiñ ïa kheiñlang shyieng jong nga . Nga pyrkhat ba U diengsoh u la pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga Teresh
translation.en: I reckoned till morning , that , as a lion , so will he break all my bones : from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me .

translation.kha: La don bun ki briew kiba la wan bad , haduh ba Jisu bad ki jong u kim don por shuh wat ban bam jingbam . Kumta u ong ïa ki , To ngin noh tang ngi sha ka jaka ba tang para ma ngi bad phi lah ban shipor .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place , and rest a while :  for there were many coming and going , and they had no leisure so much as to eat .
And now I am no more in the world , but these are in the world , and I come to thee . Holy Father , keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me , that they may be one , as we are .
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga wan noh sha me ; ngam don shuh ha kane ka pyrthei , hynrei ma ki , ki don ha ka pyrthei . Ko Pa Bakhuid ! To ri kyndong ïa ki da ka bor ka kyrteng jong me , ka kyrteng kaba me la ai ha nga , ba kin ïoh long kawei kumba ma me bad nga ngi ïalong kawei .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses said unto the people , Ye have sinned a great sin : and now I will go up unto the  Lord   ; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Moses u ong ha ki paidbah ,  Phi la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh . Mynta ngan leit kiew biang sha U  Trai  ; lehse nga lah ban pynïoh ïa ka jingmap ïa ka pop jong phi .
Nalor baroh , wat ïa uba bieit la pyrkhat long ba u uba stad bad shemphang lada u shu shong jar jar bad set ïa la ka shyntur .
translation.en: Even a fool , when he holdeth his peace , is counted wise : and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding .
But did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , like unto the abominations of the heathen , whom the  Lord  had cast out before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki hima kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki dang tur shaphrang , u Manasseh u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger , and the strength of battle : and it hath set him on fire round about , yet he knew not  ; and it burned him , yet he laid it not to heart .
translation.kha: Kumta u pynlong ïa ngi ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong u bad shah jynjar ïa ka jingshyrkhei ka thma . Kum ka ding ka jingbitar jong u ka meh kylleng ka Israel , hynrei ngim ju tip aïu ka jia ; ngim shym ïoh jinghikai satia ei ei na ka .

translation.en: But thanks be to God , which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Hynrei to long ka jingnguh ïa U Blei , uba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingjop thiaw lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi !

translation.en: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side , and two tables on that side , to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka kamra rung , la don saw tylli ki miej , ar tylli ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka kamra . Dei halor kine ki miej ba la pynïap ïa ki mrad ba dei ban ai kum ki jingkñia , lane ban thang tylli , lane ban long ki jingkñia sait pop ne kum ki jingtyrwa siew kylliang .

translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests , and said unto them , Take up the ark of the covenant , and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams  horns before the ark of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad ong ha ki ,  Shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad hynñiew ngut na phi kin leit ha shuwa jong phi , da kaba kieng ïa ki turoi .
U Jisu la bad u la hukum ïa ka lyer , Long jai jai ! bad u la ong ïa ki jingat phyllung , jai Ka ka la kynjah jar bad ka la don ka .
translation.en: And he arose , and rebuked the wind , and said unto the sea ,  Peace , be still .  And the wind ceased , and there was a great calm .

translation.kha: Ka jingwan U Khun U Briew long kum kaba la jia ha ka por u Noah
translation.en: But as the days of Noah were , so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .

translation.kha: Haba u u sing kyrhuh , uei uba lah ban lait na ka jingtieng ? Haba U Trai Nongsynshar kren u , uei uba lah ban lait khlem pynbna ïa ka khubor jong u ?
translation.en: The lion hath roared , who will not fear ? the Lord  God  hath spoken , who can but prophesy ?
Hearken unto me , ye stouthearted , that are far from righteousness :
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki briew ba-mutlop kiba pyrkhat ba ka jingjop ka dang sha jngai bah .

Ki bthah ïa u ong Shibboleth . Hynrei un ong namar um nang kynnoh beit ïa ka . ki kem ki pynïap u ha kawei na kita ki jaka na kiba dei ban jam ïa Jordan . Sawphew ar hajar ngut ki Ephraim ki shah ha kata ka por .
translation.en: Then said they unto him , Say now Shibboleth : and he said Sibboleth : for he could not frame to pronounce it right . Then they took him , and slew him at the passages of Jordan : and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand .

translation.kha: Mynta , ko Job , ïasuk noh bad U Blei bad sangeh noh na kaba pynlong ïa u kum u nongshun ; lada phi leh kumta , te un sa kyrkhu ïa phi .
translation.en: Acquaint now thyself with him , and be at peace : thereby good shall come unto thee .
But woe unto you , Pharisees ! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs , and pass over judgment and the love of God : these ought ye to have done , and not to leave the other undone .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki Pharisi ! Phi ai sha U Blei ïa kawei na ki shiphew jong ki jhur pynbang jingbam , kum u pudina bad u rue    bad baroh kiwei pat ki jait jhur , hynrei phi leh klet ïa ka jinglehhok bad ka jingieit ïa U Blei . Ïa kine phi la dei ban leh , khlem da leh klet ïa kiwei pat .
Ho-oid u . Nga la wan ban ai ka jingkñia ainguh ha U Trai . ïa lade , bad wan bad nga . U ïa Jesse bad khun shynrang jong u ban pynkhuid ïa lade , bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki sha kata ka jingkñia .
translation.en: And he said , Peaceably : I am come to sacrifice unto the  Lord  : sanctify yourselves , and come with me to the sacrifice . And he sanctified Jesse and his sons , and called them to the sacrifice .

translation.kha: Da shisha phi la ïohsngew ba U Blei ha ka jingaiei jong u , u la ai Bethesel nga ïa kane ka kam ban trei na ka bynta ka jingbha Sibmah phi bashaniah
translation.en: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward :

translation.kha: U Asaraïah u ryngkat bad phraphew ngut ki lyngdoh kiba khlaiñ bad bashlur ki bud nadien jong Syiem Ussaïah ban khang ïa u .
translation.en: And Azariah the priest went in after him , and with him fourscore priests of the  Lord  , that were valiant men :

translation.kha: Dei ban pynsangeh ïa u namar u la ong ïa ki briew ha ngaiñ ba kin long ki koidi slem bah hangta bad ba lyngkhuit jinieid ïa ki ïing kuman kin Karnelian , kin thaw ki Mediterranian , bad nonghiarpateng ïa kaei pynïabiang ki thung .
translation.en: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon , saying , This captivity is long : build ye houses , and dwell in them  ; and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom u Moses ruh la synreit ïa ka snam halor kata Ïingjaiñ ka Jutang bad halor kiei kiei kiba la pyndonkam ha ka jingmane .
translation.en: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle , and all the vessels of the ministry .

translation.kha: To wan ! la jubab U Jisu . Kumta u Petros u la hiar na ka lieng bad la sdang ban ïaid halor ka sha U Jisu .
translation.en: And he said ,  Come .  And when Peter was come down out of the ship , he walked on the water , to go to Jesus .
He suffered no man to do them wrong : yea , he reproved kings for their sakes  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei um shym la shah ïano ïano ban lehbeiñ ïa ki ; ban ïada ïa ki , u maham ïa ki syiem :
Naduh mihngi shaduh sepngi to A ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U Trai !
translation.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the  Lord s  name is to be praised .

translation.kha: Ka Gudgodah ka ïoh Paul kine ki phra ngut ki khun na u Nahor , u para u Abraham .
translation.en: And Bethuel begat Rebekah : these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor , Abraham s brother .

translation.kha: uba kdor ka ingdong u lane khyndai khup ; uba pang khmat , uba ïoh ñiangdait , uba don prum , lane u ïunukh .
translation.en: Or crookbackt , or a dwarf , or that hath a blemish in his eye , or be scurvy , or scabbed , or hath his stones broken  ;

translation.kha: Ynda U Trai U Blei jong phi u la pynjot ïa ki kita jaitbynriew bad u ai ha phi ïa ri ka jong ki , bad hadien ba phi la ïohknieh ïa ki shnong bad ïing ki jong ki bad ba phi la shong la sah hangta ,
translation.en: When the  Lord  thy God hath cut off the nations , whose land the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and thou succeedest them , and dwellest in their cities , and in their houses  ;

translation.kha: kata Namar , phi dei ban pynïapher ïa mrad ki bad ki sim ki bakhuid na kito ki bymkhuid . Wat bam ïa ki mrad bad ki sim ki bymkhuid . la Nga ñiew ïa ki , ki bymkhuid , bad kaba bam ïa ki ka pynlong ïa phi ki bymkhuid .
translation.en: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean , and between unclean fowls and clean : and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast , or by fowl , or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground , which I have separated from you as unclean .
And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim , from the rock , and upward .
translation.kha: Shatei na Sela , u pud ka Edom u ïaid lyngba ka Khim Akrabbim .
Ka ksiar jong ngi ka la jngut ; ki maw jong ka Templ don ha ka jingsaphred ha ki bah
translation.en: How is the gold become dim ! how is the most fine gold changed ! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street .
If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book , that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name , THE  Lord  THY GOD  ;
translation.kha: Lada phim kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai U Blei ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab , bad lada phim ñiewburom ïa ka kyrteng kaba phylla bad kaba khraw jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ,
U Solomon u arspah tylli ki stieh kiba heh bad hynñiew ka ksiar la pyndonkam kawei kawei ka
translation.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold : six hundred shekels of gold went to one target .
Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors .
translation.kha: Ki jingbthah jong me ki ai ka jingsngewbha ïa nga ; ki long ki nongaibuit jong nga .
Ki atiar kiba ngi ha ka jong ngi kim long ki jong ka pyrthei hynrei ki atiar kiba jong U Blei , ïa kiba ngi pyndonkam ban ïa ki kut baskhem .
translation.en: For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal , but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds .

translation.kha: bad haba ki la ha U Jisu ïohi ïa uta u briew uba don shibun ki ksuid jong . la shong hangta la phong bad ba u la , bad baroh ki la .
translation.en: And they come to Jesus , and see him that was possessed with the devil , and had the legion , sitting , and clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .
All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you , who is a beloved brother , and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord :
translation.kha: U para ba-ieit jong ngi u Tukhikos , u nongtrei uba lah ban shaniah bad u para shakri ha ka kam jong U Trai , un sa ai ïa phi ka khubor baroh shaphang jong nga .

U don ngut laiphew ki khun shynrang bad laiphew ngut ki khun kynthei . U pynshongkurim ïa la khun ki kynthei shabar na ka kur jait ka , bad u wanrah pat laiphew ngut samla ki kynthei nabar ka kur ka jait la jong ba kin shongkurim bad ki khun shynrang jong u . U Ibsan u ïalam ïa ki Israel hynñiew snem ,
translation.en: And he had thirty sons , and thirty daughters , whom he sent abroad , and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons . And he judged Israel seven years .

translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U , im kham slem . Ki bymman ki ïap shuwa ka por jong ki .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  prolongeth days : but the years of the wicked shall be shortened .
After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house . After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house .
translation.kha: U Benjamin bad u Hasshub ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba long ha khmat ki ïing jong ki . U Asaraïah , u khun jong u Maaseïah bad u ksiew jong u Ananaïah , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba long ha khmat ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: While the earth remaineth , seedtime and harvest , and cold and heat , and summer and winter , and day and night shall not cease .
translation.kha: Katba ka pyrthei ka dang sah , kan don ka aïom bet bad ka aïom ot . Kan don ka jingkhriat bad ka jingshit , ka lyiur bad ka tlang , ka sngi bad ka miet .

translation.en: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth , and length , and depth , and height ;
translation.kha: khnang ba ma phi lem bad ki briew jong U Blei baroh , phin lah ban ïoh ka bor ban sngewthuh katno ka jingïar bad ka lynter , katno ka jingjrong bad ka jingjylliew , ka long ka jingieit U Khrist .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the vessels were full , that she said unto her son , Bring me yet a vessel . And he said unto her , There is not a vessel more . And the oil stayed .
translation.kha: Haba ki la pyndap ïa kita ki khra baroh , ka la kylli la dang don shuh ne em .  Uto u dei uba khatduh ,  uwei na ki khun shynrang jong ka u jubab . Bad ka umphniang Olib ka la sangeh ban tuid .
U Moses u bishar bniah ïa ka kam baroh bad u ïohi ba ki la leh ïa Jingthoh kumba U Mispeh mynnin la jingkheit . Kumta u Moses u kyrkhu ïa Boskath .
translation.en: And Moses did look upon all the work , and , behold , they had done it as the  Lord  had commanded , even so had they done it : and Moses blessed them .

Say now to the rebellious house , Know ye not what these things mean ? tell them , Behold , the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem , and hath taken the king thereof , and the princes thereof , and led them with him to Babylon  ;
translation.kha: Kylli ïa kine kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah lada ki tip aïu ka pharshi ka mut . Ïathuh ïa ki ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan sha Jerusalem bad rah ïa u syiem bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u lem bad u sha Babilonia .

translation.en: Thy calf , O Samaria , hath cast thee off  ; mine anger is kindled against them : how long will it be ere they attain to innocency ?
translation.kha: Nga isih ïa u masi ksiar ba mane da ki briew jong ka nongbah Samaria . Nga bitar lep ïa ki . Sa katno kan shim por shuwa ba kin sangeh noh na kaba mane bleithaw ?

Ha kajuh ka por ka Kosbi Pyntrei kawei ka la don ha ka jingkhynwin : Katto katne ngut ki briew ki pyrta ïa kawei thup kiwei laiñ pyrta ïa kawei pat , namar kiba bun na ki kim da ) balei ba jingjemnud la ïawan lumlang .
translation.en: Some therefore cried one thing , and some another : for the assembly was confused  ; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together .
And he said , He that shewed mercy on him . Then said Jesus unto him ,  Go , and do thou likewise .
translation.kha: U Nonghikai ka Hukum u la jubab ,  Uta uba la lehbha ïa u .  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Te , ma me khie leit bad leh kumjuh .
Mar ïalong syiem sawkyr-ang u Simri jingïohipaw la pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot na ka sahnar u Te . Ïa uwei pa uwei u ba-ha-ïing bad uwei pa basngur pynhapoh paralok la pynïap .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he began to reign , as soon as he sat on his throne , that he slew all the house of Baasha : he left him not one that pisseth against a wall , neither of his kinsfolks , nor of his friends .
Remember the former things of old : for I am God , and there is none else  ; I am God , and there is none like me ,
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba la jia la slem bah ; to pdiang ba tang ma nga , nga long U Blei bad ym don uwei pat kum ma nga .
nongïalam jong ka la lyngba ki lynti bah kum ki rangbah kiba , kiba bit da ka snam haduh katta katta ba ym don mano ban ktah ïa ki .
translation.en: They have wandered as blind men in the streets , they have polluted themselves with blood , so that men could not touch their garments .

translation.kha: Namar mynhynne miet u angel jong U Blei ha uba nga long bad ïa uba nga mane u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,
translation.en: For there stood by me this night the angel of God , whose I am , and whom I serve ,
Therefore , my beloved brethren , be ye stedfast , unmoveable , always abounding in the work of the Lord , forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord .
translation.kha: Te kumta , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga , to long phi kiba ïeng skhem bad kiba ïaineh . To long kiba ïai trei minot ïa ka kam U Trai , namar phi tip ba kano kano kaba phi leh ha ka jingshakri ïa U Trai kam ju long kaba lehnoh-ei .

translation.en: And the coast reacheth to Tabor , and Shahazimah , and Beth–shemesh  ; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan : sixteen cities with their villages .
translation.kha: U pud u kynjoh ruh ïa ka Tabor , ka Shahasumah , bad ka Beth Shemesh , u da kut noh ha ka Jordan . Ka kynthup khathynriew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

Trai u ong , Baroh ki kam sniew jong ki , ki sdang ha Gilgal . Ka la long hangta ba nga ban isih ïa ki . Bad namar ka jingsniew ba ki leh , ngan beh noh ïa ki na ka ri jong nga . Ngan ym ieit shuh ïa ki ; ki nongïalam jong ki ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: All their wickedness is in Gilgal : for there I hated them : for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house , I will love them no more : all their princes are revolters .

( Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees , and with gold , according to all his desire , ) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee .
translation.kha: U Hiram jong ka Tyros u la pynbiang ïa u ïa ki dieng Kedar bad ki dieng Kseh , bad ïa ka ksiar ruh , katba u donkam . Ynda la dep tei ïa ki , u Syiem Solomon u ai ïa u Hiram arphew tylli ki shnong ha ka thain Galilaïa .

translation.en: Thy dead men shall live , together with my dead body shall they arise . Awake and sing , ye that dwell in dust : for thy dew is as the dew of herbs , and the earth shall cast out the dead .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dei napdeng ki briew jong ngi kiba la ïap kin im biang ! Ki met jong ki kin wan phai biang sha ka jingim . Baroh kito kiba ïohthiah ha ki jingtep jong ki kin kyndit thiah bad kin rwai namar ka jingkmen . Kumba ka umjer baphyrnai ka pynthymmai bor ïa ka khyndew , kumta ruh U  Trai  un pynkhie im pat ïa kito kiba la ïap la slem .
U Moses u bad Joshua ki leit la sha ka Ïingjaiñ bad U Trai u wanpaw ha ki hangta ha u rishot lyoh uba ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud : and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle .

translation.kha: tad ynda nga buh ïa ki nongshun jong me kum ka jingïuhkjat hapoh ki kjat jong .’ me
translation.en: Until I make thy foes thy footstool .

translation.kha: U Joshua bad ki rangbah jong Aswan jingïap leh mynleh lamkhmat phai dien , bad ki phet sha ka jaka bashrah .
translation.en: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them , and fled by the way of the wilderness .
This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the  Lord  : where I will meet you , to speak there unto thee .
translation.kha: Ha ki por baroh ki ban wan , dei ban ai ïa kane ka jingainguh thang ha khmat jong nga ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga . Kata ka long ka jaka ha kaba ngan ïashem bad ki briew jong nga bad ngan ïakren bad me .
Ha khmat jong u wat u bnai um long uba phyrnai , ne ki khlur kim long kiba .
translation.en: Behold even to the moon , and it shineth not  ; yea , the stars are not pure in his sight .

translation.kha: U la ong , Ïathuh ïa ki shna jong ka ri bad ïa ki lyngdoh ba haba ki shahjingit bad ïambriew ha u bnai Nireus ym bahynñiew ha kine ki hynñiewphew snem , kam shym dei umpohliew ka jingñiewburom Tibhath nga .
translation.en: Speak unto all the people of the land , and to the priests , saying , When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month , even those seventy years , did ye at all fast unto me , even to me ?
To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality , eternal life :
translation.kha: Katto katne ki briew ki ïai leh ïa kaba bha , bad wad burom , ka nam babha , bad ka jingim bymïap shuh ; ïa ki U Blei un ai ka jingim bymjukut .

Katba u Petros u dang shaphang sngewlyngngoh ka jingmut jong kane ka jingïohipaw , ki rangbah kiba u Kornelios la u phah ki la tip hangno ka ïing jong u Simon don ka , bad mynta ki la ïeng ha khmat ka khyrdop .
translation.en: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean , behold , the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon s house , and stood before the gate ,

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ki synran ki la wan sha Dura Jisu , da kaba kylli , shajan uba khraw tam ha ka Hima ki bneng Kynrad
translation.en: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus , saying , Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven ?
And they shall take gold , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen .

translation.en: And I fell at his feet to worship him . And he said unto me , See thou do it not : I am thy fellowservant , and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus : worship God : for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy .

translation.en: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots , and the king of Maacah and his people  ; who came and pitched before Medeba . And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities , and came to battle .

translation.en: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom , and the  Lord  his God was with him , and magnified him exceedingly .
translation.kha: U Solomon u khun jong u syiem Dabid u la pynskhem ïa ka jingsynshar ïa ka hima Israel , bad U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u la kyrkhu ïa u bad pynlong ïa u uba khlaiñbor shikatdei eh .

translation.en: The instruments also of the churl are evil : he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words , even when the needy speaketh right .
translation.kha: U briew uba mutlop u long uba sniew bad u leh ïa ki kam kiba sniew ; u ïasylla ban pynsniew ïa kiba duk da ki jingshukor bad ban khanglad ïa ki ban ïoh ïa ki hok jong ki .

translation.en: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind , called Euroclydon .
translation.kha: Hynrei shen ka lyer kaba jur — kata kaba la khot ka lyer  Shatei-lam-mihngi  — ka la beh na ka dewlynnong .

translation.en: Hear my words , O ye wise men  ; and give ear unto me , ye that have knowledge .
translation.kha: Phi ki rangbah phi long kiba da stad , kiba sian bha , to shahshkor mynta ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
u kren u ka jingïap jong ki ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron kiba la shah pynïap mynba ki kñia ainguh U Trai da ka ding bymkhuid .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron , when they offered before the  Lord  , and died  ;
And when they had received it , they murmured against the goodman of the house ,
translation.kha: Ki la shim la ka bainong bad ki la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa u nongaikam .
Kaba rwai jingrwai ha u briew uba khuslai mynsiem ka long kumba loit noh ïa ki jaiñ u jong ha ka por lane khriat kum kaba kyllan mluh ha ka jingmong .
translation.en: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather , and as vinegar upon nitre , so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart .

translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa ka longïing jong u Ahab kumba nga leh ïa ka longïing jong u u Jeroboam syiem ka bad Israel jong u Baasha u syiem ka Israel .
translation.en: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah :

And the man said unto me , Son of man , behold with thine eyes , and hear with thine ears , and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee  ; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither : declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel .
translation.kha: U ong ha nga ,  To khmih , ko khun u briew , shahshkor kyndiang bad pynleit jingmut bha ïa kata baroh kaba nga pyn-i ha me ; namar ba na ka bynta kane la ïalam ïa me hangne . Me dei ban ïathuh ïa kata baroh ba me ïohi sha ki briew ka Israel .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when ye shall say , Wherefore doeth the  Lord  our God all these things unto us ? then shalt thou answer them , Like as ye have forsaken me , and served strange gods in your land , so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours .
translation.kha: Haba ki kylli balei ba nga la leh ïa kine kiei kiei , ïathuh ïa ki , ko Jeremaïah , ba kumba ki la phai noh na nga bad shakri ïa ki blei nongwei ha ka ri jong ki hi , kumta kin shakri ïa ki nongwei ha ka ri ka bym dei ka jong ki .

translation.en: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation , and the altar : I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons , to minister to me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong khuid ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa kata ka duwan , bad ngan pynkyrpang ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .
U Joab u long u rangbah hukum jong ka shipai Israel u Benaïah , jong u Jehoïada khmih ka kynhun ïada ïa u Dabid ;
translation.en: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel : and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites :

translation.kha: Ashpenas pynsleh u briew Belteshassar ïohi ba um lah jop ïa u Jakob , u kura ïa u na ka skhep ; bad kata ka skhep jong u wanrah la lait .
translation.en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him , he touched the hollow of his thigh  ; and the hollow of Jacob s thigh was out of joint , as he wrestled with him .

translation.kha: A Trai , ai ba ki jingtim jong ki baroh kin urlong shisha lada ngam shym la shakri bha ïa me , Elnathan ngam shym la du bad me na ka bynta ki nongshun jong nga mynba ki don ha ka jingjynjar bad jingeh bajur .
translation.en: The  Lord  said , Verily it shall be well with thy remnant  ; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction .

Also we certify you , that touching any of the priests and Levites , singers , porters , Nethinims , or ministers of this house of God , it shall not be lawful to impose toll , tribute , or custom , upon them .
translation.kha: La khang pyrshah ïa phi na kaba lum khajna na ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi , ki nongput nongtem , ki nongap phira , ki nongtrei lane kino kino kiba don ka jingïadei bad kane ka Templ .
Kynmaw ba kumba u kpa u sneng pynbeit ïa la u khun , kumta ruh Trai U U Blei jong phi u sneng ïa pynbeit phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart , that , as a man chasteneth his son , so the  Lord  thy God chasteneth thee .
Who would not fear thee , O King of nations ? for to thee doth it appertain : forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations , and in all their kingdoms , there is none like unto thee .
translation.kha: Uei u ban ym pyndonburom ïa me , u syiem jong ki jaitbynriew baroh ? Me dei hok ban ïoh ka pyndonburom . Ym don mano mano uba kum ma me hapdeng ki riewstad baroh jong ki jaitbynriew lane napdeng uno uno u syiem jong ki .

translation.en: The righteous is delivered out of trouble , and the wicked cometh in his stead .
translation.kha: Uba hok u lait na ka jingjynjar ; pynban u bymman u hap ha ka .

translation.en: Take counsel , execute judgment  ; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday  ; hide the outcasts  ; bewray not him that wandereth .
translation.kha: Ki ong ha ki briew jong ka Judah ,  Ong ïa ngi kaei ba ngin leh . To ïada ïa ngi kum u dieng uba shat syrngiew tngen ha ka jingshit jong ka shiteng sngi , bad shah ïa ngi ban pynjahthait ha ka jingda jong me . Ngi long ki phetwir ; to buhrieh ïa ngi ha ka jaka ha kaba ym don mano mano ban shem ïa ngi .

translation.en: And now , O Lord  God  , thou art that God , and thy words be true , and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant :
translation.kha: Bad mynta , A  Trai  Nongsynshar , me long U Blei ; me ju ïai bat ïa la ki kular , bad me la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kular kaba phylla .
Nangta U Moses u kyrpad , Sngewbha shah ngan ïohi ïa ka jingshai jong batyngshaiñ ka jingdon ryngkat jong me .
translation.en: And he said , I beseech thee , shew me thy glory .
Thou also shalt be drunken : thou shalt be hid , thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy .
translation.kha: Ko Ninebeh , pha ruh phan hap ha ka jingbuaid bymtip briew ! Pha ruh phan pyrshang ban lait phet na ki nongshun jong pha .

translation.en: For he was numbered with us , and had obtained part of this ministry .
translation.kha: U Judas u la long u dkhot jong ka kynhun jong ngi , namar la lah jied ïa u ban ïadon bynta lem ha ka kam jong ngi .

translation.en: Until the  Lord  have given rest unto your brethren , as well as unto you , and until they also possess the land which the  Lord  your God hath given them beyond Jordan : and then shall ye return every man unto his possession , which I have given you .
translation.kha: Ïarap lem ïa la ki para Israel haduh ba kin da ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  u ai ha ki sha sepngi na Jordan bad haduh ba U  Trai  un shah ba kin im suk im saiñ hangta , kumba u la leh ïa phi hangne . Hadien kata , phi lah ban wan phai sha kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha phi .

translation.en: Our Creator can hear even silent prayers .
translation.kha: U Nongthaw u lah ban ïohsngew wat ïa ki jingduwai bajarjar .

translation.en: There the righteous might dispute with him  ; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge .
translation.kha: Nga long uba hok ; nga lah ban ïasaidnia bad U Blei ; un pynbna shisien pynbna , ba nga long uba hok .

translation.en: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword , and took Dinah out of Shechem s house , and went out .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïalam noh ruh ïa ka Dinah na ïing u Shekhem , bad ki ïaleit noh .

translation.en: Have pity upon me , have pity upon me , O ye my friends  ; for the hand of God hath touched me .
translation.kha: Phi long ki paralok jong nga ! To isynei ïa nga ! Ka kti U Blei ka la ïaleh ïa nga .
U Jonathan u jubab U , Blei un ym shah ba phin shu ïap ! I pa i da ïathuh shuwa ha ïa nga kaei kaei ba i leh , kaba donkam ne ka bymdonkam , bad im buhrieh ju ïa kane na nga : Kam long kaba shisha !
translation.en: And he said unto him , God forbid  ; thou shalt not die : behold , my father will do nothing either great or small , but that he will shew it me : and why should my father hide this thing from me ? it is not so .

translation.kha: san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei pat liang , bad tylli ïa ki jingker kiba shaphang .
translation.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle , for the two sides westward .

translation.kha: U u ruh u kpa jong ki Jebus , ki Amor ,
translation.en: And the Jebusite , and the Amorite , and the Girgashite ,

translation.kha: To risa da ka jingkmen , phi ki bneng ! To risa , ko ki jaka bajylliew jong ka pyrthei ! To risa da ka jingkmen , ko ki lumbah , bad man la u dieng jong khlaw ka U Trai ! u pyn-i la ïa ka jingkhraw jong u da kaba u pynim ïa ki briew jong u ki Israel .
translation.en: Sing , O ye heavens  ; for the  Lord  hath done it : shout , ye lower parts of the earth : break forth into singing , ye mountains , O forest , and every tree therein : for the  Lord  hath redeemed Jacob , and glorified himself in Israel .
And by thy sword shalt thou live , and shalt serve thy brother  ; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion , that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck .
translation.kha: Men im da ka waitlam , Hynrei men long u mraw jong u para jong me . Pynban haba me ïeng ban ïaleh pyrshah , Men lait na ka jingsynshar jong u .
Mynta ka por ba ïa ka pyrthei yn bishar ; ïa u jong kane ka pyrthei yn pynhiar khet
translation.en: Now is the judgment of this world : now shall the prince of this world be cast out .

translation.kha: Ki parabangeit baroh kiba don hangne ki ïasnohkti lang bad nga ha kaba phah ïa ki jingai khublei sha balang ki ha Galatia :
translation.en: And all the brethren which are with me , unto the churches of Galatia :
Only then will Jehovah answer your prayers .—Hebrews 11 :6 .
translation.kha: Tang da kumta , U Jehobah un jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong phi .—Hebru 11 :6 .
ïai na kaei kaba ka la sdang kum ka ha Ijipt , ha kaba la duh noh ïa la jinglong sotti . Naduh ka por ba ka long ka samla ba dang khynraw , ki rangbah ki la ïathiah bad ka bad leh ïa ka kum ka nuti .
translation.en: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt : for in her youth they lay with her , and they bruised the breasts of her virginity , and poured their whoredom upon her .

translation.kha: Phin bam bad dih ha Us miej jingpynlehrain nga ha ka Hima jong pahuh kem bad phin shong halor pynkyrteng khet ban synshar halor buddien khat-ar jait —Loukas Israel .
translation.en: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom , and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: Ka jingringdur ka dei Belteshassar pud bashaphang sepngi jong ka Rephah Reuben Garnet Kine ki long ki kyntiap bad durbriew nongrit kiba Ophir ai ha ki longïing jong ka jait Reuben kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan , and the border thereof . This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families , the cities and the villages thereof .

translation.kha: Kan ing Tarshish bad mynmiet , iwei arsap tdem kan kiew na ka junom . Ka khyndew kan sah lehnoh-ei na kawei nongkren rta sha kawei pat , jingshalan yn ym don shuh u ban ïaid lyngba jong ka .
translation.en: It shall not be quenched night nor day  ; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever : from generation to generation it shall lie waste  ; none shall pass through it for ever and ever .

translation.kha: Da kumta u Jehu u la pynduh pyndam ka jingmane ïa u Baal ha Israel .
translation.en: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel .
I will say of the  Lord  , He is my refuge and my fortress : my God  ; in him will I trust .
translation.kha: u lah ban ong ha u ,  Me long u nongkyrshan bad nongïada jong nga , me long U Blei jong nga ; ha me nga shaniah .
Ki nongsuhjaiñ batbit ki dei rben tmain sahmiet u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad Resen rong saw , u 43 ksiar , bad da ka jaiñ linen bani .
translation.en: And they shall take gold , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen .

translation.kha: la U buh biang ïa u nongrah khuri rangbah ha ka kyrdan kaba bat u mynshuwa , hynrei u la pynïap ïa u nongshet kpu rangbah .
translation.en: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again  ; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh s hand :

And the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , get thee down quickly from hence  ; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves  ; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them  ; they have made them a molten image .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Khie leit hiar kloi na une u lum , namar kita ki briew jong me ïa kiba me la ïalam na Ijipt , ki la mut sniew bad ki la leh bymman . Ki lah da kynriah noh na kata ka lynti ïa kaba nga la hukum ïa ki , bad ki la thaw pynban ïa ka durblei na ka bynta ïa lade .’

Shahshkor ki , ko , bad kohnguh ïa ! Te phin bha bad phin nang roi bad long ka jaitbynriew kaba donbor bad phin ïoh shong ha kata ka ri tuid ka dud bad ngap , kumba Trai U Blei ki tymmen jong ngi , u la kular .
translation.en: Hear therefore , O Israel , and observe to do it  ; that it may be well with thee , and that ye may increase mightily , as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee , in the land that floweth with milk and honey .

translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , lumlang ïa u la paid ! Ngi lah shah kerkut ! Ki ïatur ïaleh ïa u nongïalam ki Israel !
translation.en: Now gather thyself in troops , O daughter of troops : he hath laid siege against us : they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek .
And out of the tribe of Benjamin , Gibeon with her suburbs , Geba with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Benjamin la ai saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Gibeon , ka Geba ,

U Petros u la pynbna , Da lei lei ha idei kano ka por men ym ïoh ban sait har ki kjat jong jingïohkynti . Lada ngam ïoh ban pjiar ïa jingkrenbeiñ kjat nong-ohdur me , U Jisu u la jubab , men ym ïoh long Shisha u synran jong nga .
translation.en: Peter saith unto him , Thou shalt never wash my feet . Jesus answered him ,  If I wash thee not , thou hast no part with me .
If it be so , our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace , and he will deliver us out of thine hand , O king .
translation.kha: Lada U Blei uba ngi shakri u lah ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ka lawar ding baklang bad na ka bor jong phi , te un leh .

translation.en: On that day the  Lord  magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel  ; and they feared him , as they feared Moses , all the days of his life .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ha kata ka sngi , ka la pynlong ïa ki paid Israel ban ñiew ïa u Joshua u riewkhraw . Ki burom ïa u shi lynter ka jingim jong u , kumba ki la burom ïa u Moses .
Ha ka por shiteng synñia nga khie ban ïaroh me ïa namar ki jingbishar hok jong me .
translation.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments .

translation.kha: Nangta u la ong , Ngan ai ha pha bun ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , I will multiply thy seed exceedingly , that it shall not be numbered for multitude .

translation.kha: tip skhem U Trai U Blei jong phi un ym beh shuh ïa kine ki jaitbynriew na jong phi katba nang ïaid sha Pynban , kin long ka jingmynsaw ïa phi kum ka lane ka thliew bad kaba eh kum jingsympat ha ka jong phi lane ki shiah ha khmat jong phi . Bad kane neh tad haduh ba ym don shuh uwei napdeng jong phi uba dang lait im ha kane ka ri kaba bha ïa kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Know for a certainty that the  Lord  your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you  ; but they shall be snares and traps unto you , and scourges in your sides , and thorns in your eyes , until ye perish from off this good land which the  Lord  your God hath given you .

translation.kha: Ki kyntien jong u Dabid ki la ïa pynïoh ka jingshaniah tylli jong baroh ki rangbah ka Judah , bad ki la phah ktien sha u ban wan phai ki bad rangbah synshar jong u baroh .
translation.en: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah , even as the heart of one man  ; so that they sent this word unto the king , Return thou , and all thy servants .

translation.kha: Kin san kin plung kum u phlang ba la ai um bha , ki kum dieng Jamynrei harud ki wahduid jong ka um batuid .
translation.en: And they shall spring up as among the grass , as willows by the water courses .
And they came with haste , and found Mary , and Joseph , and the babe lying in a manger .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit kloi bad ki la shem ïa ka Mari bad u Joseph bad ki la ïohi ïa u khunlung uba thiah ha ka shyngoid .
Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam Hushim pynthohbria ka Shaaraim , u Abijah u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai jingïashem ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah .
I beheld the mountains , and , lo , they trembled , and all the hills moved lightly .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih ha ki lumbah — ki la khynñiuh , bad ki lumrit ki khih shadien bad sha khmat .

translation.en: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God , and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you ?
translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba phi long ka templ jong U Blei bad ba U Mynsiem U Blei u shong hapoh jong phi !

translation.en: And , behold , one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand , and drew his sword , and struck a servant of the high priest s , and smote off his ear .
translation.kha: Uwei na kito kiba la ïadon lang bad U Jisu , u la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u la shoh ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , da kaba mait noh ïa ka shkor jong u .

translation.en: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king s provinces , to destroy , to kill , and to cause to perish , all Jews , both young and old , little children and women , in one day , even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar , and to take the spoil of them for a prey .
translation.kha: Ki nongrah-khubor ki la rah ïa kane ka jingpynbna sha kawei pa kawei ka probins jong ka hima . Ka don ki jingbthah ba tang ha kawei ka sngi , ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , ïa baroh ki Jiw — samla bad tymmen , kynthei bad khynnah — dei ban pynïap . Ïa ki dei ban pynïap khlem jingisynei bad ba ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki dei ban shim noh .
Hynrei lada uno uno um sumar ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , khamtam ïa ki dkhot ka longïing jong u hi , u la len ïa jingngeit ka bad kham u sniew ban ïa u bymngeit .
translation.en: But if any provide not for his own , and specially for those of his own house , he hath denied the faith , and is worse than an infidel .

translation.kha: Kata ka ïing ka khapngiah Ïasam ki shynrang bad ki kynthei . Ki syiem Philistia baroh jingkhiah ngut ki don ïasngewskhem ïamih bad ki don kumba lai hajar ngut ki rangbah bad ki kynthei halor tnum ïing sahkynmaw kiba khmih kai ïa u ba u pynbyrngia ïa ki .
translation.en: Now the house was full of men and women  ; and all the lords of the Philistines were there  ; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women , that beheld while Samson made sport .
The  Lord  hath taken away thy judgments , he hath cast out thine enemy : the king of Israel , even the  Lord  , is in the midst of thee : thou shalt not see evil any more .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynkut ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa phi ; u la weng noh ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh . U  Trai  , u syiem ka Israel , u long bad phi ; ym don daw mynta ban sheptieng .
Baroh ki mrad ha ki khlaw synduk ka Lebanon kim pat biang na ka bynta ka jingkñia sha U Blei jong ngi , bad Agur dieng jong ka ki khyndiat eh donburom pynmeh ïa ka ding .
translation.en: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn , nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering .

translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat sngi , ka la don ka jingïalang iaki ki riewngeit , Governing shispah arphew ngut baroh , ïuhkjat u Petros Ïakjakor la ïeng Khatphra kren .
translation.en: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples , and said , ( the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty , )

translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong Julia ki la don bad sdie ïa ka Ïingjaiñ lute Jingdon Ryngkat U Blei tyngab ha ka Etam shyiap . La thaw jingdih ka kat kumba U Ñiew u la ong ha u jingthymmai ban thaw ïa ka , kat kum ka dur ïa kyrsiew airong katjuh ha suda Moses .
translation.en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness , as he had appointed , speaking unto Moses , that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen .

translation.kha: uta u briew un khi lyndum ïa la ka khlieh , lait noh ïa ka jaka prum . U lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa u sa hynñiew sngi .
translation.en: He shall be shaven , but the scall shall he not shave  ; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more :

translation.kha: Te kumta , kumba ka met khlem ka mynsiem ka long kaba ïap , kumta ruh ka jingngeit khlem ki kam ka long ïap kaba .
translation.en: For as the body without the spirit is dead , so faith without works is dead also .
Who are they among all the gods of the countries , that have delivered their country out of mine hand , that the  Lord  should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand ?
translation.kha: Mynno na kine ki blei jong ki ri baroh kiba la ju pyllait im ïa ki ri jong ki na u patsha jong ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa ka Jerusalem ?
Ki rang bahryntieh jong ki , ki ki shipai bakhrawbor kiba khlem jingisynei .
translation.en: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre , they are all mighty men .
And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land  ; I will bereave them of children , I will destroy my people , since they return not from their ways .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong ha ka ri nga la kynting ïa phi sha ka lyer kum ïa u phlangïap . Nga la pynjot ïa phi , ki briew jong nga , nga la pynïap ïa ki khun jong phi namar phim shym sangeh ïa ki rukom basniew jong phi .

translation.en: Lift up your eyes , and behold them that come from the north : where is the flock that was given thee , thy beautiful flock ?
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , ha khmih ! Ki nongshun jong pha ki wan hiar na shatei ! Hangno ki briew kiba la buh ha ka jingsumar jong pha , ki briew jong pha kiba pha la sngewsarong haduh katta katta ?
Suk ma haba phi ki briew ki krenbeiñ bad pynshitom ïa beiñ phi , bad ong bun jait ki jinglamler basniew pyrshah ïa phi namar ba phi long ki nongbud jong nga .
translation.en: Blessed are ye , when men shall revile you , and persecute you , and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely , for my sake .
And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt , to be a reproach and a proverb , a taunt and a curse , in all places whither I shall drive them .
translation.kha: Ngan sa pynngat ha ki ka jinglanot ha kaba ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei baroh kin da sngewshyrkhei , ki briew kin rkhiebeiñ ïa ki ; kin ïakren kai ïa ki , kin ïakynshi ïa ki , bad kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim kylleng kat shaba nga pynsakma ïa ki .

Wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh Asalaïah buaid bha bad ki ïaid sheng sheng . Ki la dih waiñ bad dih kyiad haduh katta katta Benhadad ba ki jynthut kulmar . Ijipt nongïathuhlypa ki ïabuaid haduh katta Habassinaïah ba kim sngewthuh shuh ïa ki jingïohipaw ba U pynkhiah u phah , bad ki lyngdoh ki buaid haduh ba kim lah shuh ban Erastos jingrai ïa ki kam ba la wanrah ha ki .
translation.en: But they also have erred through wine , and through strong drink are out of the way  ; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink , they are swallowed up of wine , they are out of the way through strong drink  ; they err in vision , they stumble in judgment .

translation.kha: U Simri , uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam uba ïa peit shiteng ki kali ïapom u jong syiem , u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u . Ha kawei sngi ka ha Tirsah , u Elah u buaid ha ka ïing jong u Arsa , uba peit ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And his servant Zimri , captain of half his chariots , conspired against him , as he was in Tirzah , drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah .

translation.kha: la don sawphew snem rta mynba la thung ïa u kum u syiem Israel , bad u la synshar . Hynrei ka jait Judah ka ïaineh ha u ,
translation.en: Ish–bosheth Saul s son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel , and reigned two years . But the house of Judah followed David .
He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people , nor any remaining in his dwellings .
translation.kha: Um don ki nonghiarpateng , ym don kiba lait im .
Baroh kiei kiei kiba Phi Jehoash lud la leh Alos kaba kynthup ïa Phibi jingshlur jong u ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah , la bor jingthoh ha Ka pyndih Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did , and his might , and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: Ka wahduid Nimrim ka rngad , u phlang harud jong ka u la ïapstai , bad ym kano don kano kaba jyrngam kaba dang sah .
translation.en: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate : for the hay is withered away , the grass faileth , there is no green thing .

translation.kha: Te mynta , A Trai , kat kum ka jingkhraw ka jingieit baïaineh jong me , to map , nga kyrpad na ka bynta ka pop jong ki kine briew kumba me la map ïa ki naduh ba la ki mih na . Ijipt
translation.en: Pardon , I beseech thee , the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy , and as thou hast forgiven this people , from Egypt even until now .

translation.kha: snemhadien shah ruh ba ki nongshun jong ki kin lute ïa Rehob ka spah jong Jeroham ka nongbah khyndew kurup ïa ka jingdon jingem baroh , wat bynrap ki jingkynshew jong ki syiem ka Judah , bad kit noh ïa kiei kiei baroh sha Barsabbas nongkurup
translation.en: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city , and all the labours thereof , and all the precious things thereof , and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies , which shall spoil them , and take them , and carry them to Babylon .
When Jesus heard it , he marvelled , and said to them that followed ,  Verily I say unto you , I have not found so great faith , no , not in Israel .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la lyngngoh bad u la ong ha ki briew kiba bud ïa u ,  Nga ong ha phi , ngam pat ju shem ïano ïano ha Israel lem bad ka jingngeit kaba kum kane .

translation.en: Behold , the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches , and with a shadowing shroud , and of an high stature  ; and his top was among the thick boughs .
translation.kha: Me long kum u dieng Kedar ka Lebanon , lem bad ki tnat kiba itynnat bad ba kah syrngiew , u dieng uba jrong katta katta uba kot haduh ki lyoh .
Haba ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong , u Hophni bad u Phinehas kin ïap ha kajuh ka sngi , kan pyn-i me baroh nga la kren kan urlong .
translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee , that shall come upon thy two sons , on Hophni and Phinehas  ; in one day they shall die both of them .
And gave them for the potter s field , as the Lord appointed me .
translation.kha: bad ki la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa ban thied ïa ka lyngkha u nongthaw khiew , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa nga .
Kumta jingkhyllem la shim ïa u Paul , ki la wallam Asaph u ha khmat ka dorbar jong ka nongbah , ka Ariopagos , bad ki la ong , Ngi kwah ban tip kaei kane ka jinghikai nadong bla me kren .
translation.en: And they took him , and brought him unto Areopagus , saying , May we know what this new doctrine , whereof thou speakest , is ?

translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ri ka ki Amor baroh naduh Arnon shaphang shathie haduh Jabbok shaphang , shatei bad naduh ri shyiap shaphang mihngi haduh Jordan shaphang sepngi .
translation.en: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites , from Arnon even unto Jabbok , and from the wilderness even unto Jordan .
O thou sword of the  Lord  , how long will it be ere thou be quiet ? put up thyself into thy scabbard , rest , and be still .
translation.kha: Phi kyang jam , ‘ Ka waitlam jong U  Trai  ! Katno slem phin ïai talain ïa ka ? Khie leit phai noh sha ka jingsop , sah hangta bad shongthait !’
Balei thiah phi ?
translation.en: Why did you sleep ?

Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which ought not to be done , and shall do against any of them :
translation.kha: ban ïathuh ha ki Israel ba uno uno u briew uba leh pop khlem tip bad u pynkheiñ ïa kano kano ka hukum U  Trai  , u dei ban bud ïa kine ki aiñ harum .

translation.en: That in those days , when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom , which was in Shushan the palace ,
translation.kha: Na ka khet syiem ha ka nongbah Susa jong ka Persia , u syiem Serksis u synshar halor ki shispah arphew hynñiew tylli ki jylla , naduh India haduh Sudan .

translation.en: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island , and the satyr shall cry to his fellow  ; the screech owl also shall rest there , and find for herself a place of rest .
translation.kha: Ki mradkhlaw kin ïaid kai hangta , bad ki ksuid kin ïakhot para ma ki . U mrad kynsha ba shang mynmiet un wan hangta bad un wad jaka shongthait .

translation.en: For he is our peace , who hath made both one , and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us ;
translation.kha: Namar U Khrist da lade hi u la wanrah ha ngi ïa ka jingsuk da kaba pynlong kawei ka jaitbynriew ïa ki Jiw bad ki Jentil . Da ka met jong u hi , u la pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh kaba pynïakhlad ïa ki bad kaba pynlong ïa ki , ki nongshun .
Kumta u Jakob u ong ha ki ba-ha-ïing bad ha kita kiba don lem bad u , Bret noh ki blei baroh kiba phi don ; pynkhuid ïa lade , bad da ki jaiñ kiba khuid .
translation.en: Then Jacob said unto his household , and to all that were with him , Put away the strange gods that are among you , and be clean , and change your garments :
And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God  ; and they stood at the nether part of the mount .
translation.kha: U Moses u ïalam ïa ki shabar ka jaka sher dara ban ïashem bad U Blei , bad ki la ïeng ha kjat jong u lum .

translation.en: And he went out , and followed him  ; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel  ; but thought he saw a vision .
translation.kha: U Petros u la bud ïa u shabar jong ka byndi , khlem da tip , la kaei kaba u angel u la leh ka long kaba shisha ; u la pyrkhat ba u la ïohi ka jingïohipaw .

translation.en: Let my lord , I pray thee , pass over before his servant : and I will lead on softly , according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure , until I come unto my lord unto Seir .
translation.kha: Sngewbha , khie nang ïaid sha khmat , ngan nang bud suki suki , ban ïaid katba nga lah lem bad kine ki jingri bad ki khynnah haduh ba ngin sa ïashem pat bad phi ha Edom .

translation.en: And he set all the people , every man having his weapon in his hand , from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple , along by the altar and the temple , by the king round about .
translation.kha: U la buh ïa ki rangbah kiba bat ki waitlam ha baroh ka bynta ba ha khmat jong ka Templ ban ïada ïa u syiem .
Kat kumba U Blei u kren ïa ka jingshisha , ka jingkular blei nga pyllut phi kam Amana ap Ho-oid bad jingstad-buit Em Bethesel
translation.en: But as God is true , our word toward you was not yea and nay .
He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life , righteousness , and honour .
translation.kha: Lehsbun bad lehhok bad phin im slem ; kiwei kin burom ïa phi bad kin lehbha ïa phi .

translation.en: First , I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all , that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world .
translation.kha: Nyngkong , nga ainguh ïa U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist na ka bynta jong phi baroh , namar ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïohsngew shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi .

translation.en: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest , who was also chief governor in the house of the  Lord  , heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things .
translation.kha: Mynba u Pashhur u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Immer , uba long u rangbah pynïaidkam bahakhlieh duh jong ka Templ , u la ïohsngew ba nga pynbna ïa kine kiei kiei ,
Ki paid ka Horonaim ki kyang , ‘ ! Ka Jingpynjot !’
translation.en: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim , spoiling and great destruction .

translation.kha: Kin kitkhlieh ïa ruh ki rijied , ïa ki thliew tnaw , ïa ki snar , bad ïa ki tyllai jong ka phyllaw .
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that entereth into the service , for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation :

translation.kha: Hynrei ha ki nongïathuhlypa ka Jerusalem nga la ba ïohi ki leh kaba kham sniew : ki klim bad ki kren lamler ; ki pynshlur ki ïa briew ban leh ïa ka bymdei , kumta ba ym don ba sangeh noh ïa kaei kaba sniew . Ha nga , ki long baroh kiba sniew kum ki briew ka Sodom , bad ka Gomorrah .
translation.en: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing : they commit adultery , and walk in lies : they strengthen also the hands of evildoers , that none doth return from his wickedness : they are all of them unto me as Sodom , and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah .
I will teach you by the hand of God : that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal .
translation.kha: Shah ïa nga ba ngan hikai ïa phi katno ka khraw ka bor U Blei , bad ban batai kaei kaba U Blei Badonbor baroh u la thmu lypa .
U Blei u ong La , slem bah nga la sngap jar ; ngam shym la jubab ïa ki briew nga jong . Hynrei ka mynta por ban leh ka la wan ; nga kyang jam kum ka kynthei kaba suh kha .
translation.en: I have long time holden my peace  ; I have been still , and refrained myself : now will I cry like a travailing woman  ; I will destroy and devour at once .

In those days , while Mordecai sat in the king s gate , two of the king s chamberlains , Bigthan and Teresh , of those which kept the door , were wroth , and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .
translation.kha: Katba u Mordekai u dang long u nongtrei ha ka ïingsyiem , u Bigthana bad u Teresh , kiba long ar ngut na ki ïunukh ka ïingsyiem kiba ap phira ïa ka khyrdop sha ki kamra u syiem , ki la shun ïa u syiem Serksis bad sylla ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them , and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy .
translation.kha: U pynim ïa ki na kito kiba shun ïa ki ; u pyllait ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki .

Ki rangbah kin aiti noh ïa la ki jong ki hynmen bad para ïa ka ban pynïap ïa ki , bad ki kpa kin leh kumjuh ïa la ki khun ; ki khun kin ïaleh phai pyrshah ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad kin phah pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death , and the father the child : and the children shall rise up against their parents , and cause them to be put to death .
And it came to pass , as her soul was in departing , ( for she died ) that she called his name Ben–oni : but his father called him Benjamin .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka la jan ïap , bad haba kan sa dkut mynsiem , ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Benoni , hynrei u kpa jong u , u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Benjamin .

translation.en: For ye have need of patience , that , after ye have done the will of God , ye might receive the promise .
translation.kha: Phi donkam ban long kiba ïaishah , khnang ba phi lah ban leh ïa ka mon U Blei bad ïohpdiang ïa kata kaba u kular .

translation.en: Now therefore make a new cart , and take two milch kine , on which there hath come no yoke , and tie the kine to the cart , and bring their calves home from them :
translation.kha: Kumta pynkhreh kawei ka kali thymmai bad ar tylli ki masi kynthei ha kiba ym pat ju pyndait lyngkor ; teh ïa ki ha kata ka kali , bad ïalam noh ïa ki khun masi sha sem .

translation.en: And for this cause Hezekiah the king , and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz , prayed and cried to heaven .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Hesekaïah bad u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos ki duwai ha U Blei bad ki khot kyrpad ïa u ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And they rose up before Moses , with certain of the children of Israel , two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly , famous in the congregation , men of renown :
translation.kha: U Korah u khun jong u Ishar na ka jait Lebi jong u Kohath , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jingïalam jong u Moses . La wan ïasoh lem bad u da lai ngut ki dkhot na ka jait Reuben — u Dathan bad u Abiram , ki khun shynrang jong u Eliab , bad u On u khun jong u Peleth — bad da ki arspah sanphew ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah Israel , ki nongïalam kiba pawkhmat ba la jied da ka kynhun .
Arsa ba Ïada lyngkhot khiew um da wandur bha , u ju shim jingarsap ka Bha bad pynwandur ïa ka sha kawei pat .
translation.en: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter : so he made it again another vessel , as seemed good to the potter to make it .
And when Eli heard the noise of the crying , he said , What meaneth the noise of this tumult ? And the man came in hastily , and told Eli .
translation.kha: U Eli u la ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingsawa bad u kylli ,  Ka jingsawa aïu kata ?  Uta u rangbah u leit kloi kloi sha u Eli ban ïathuh ha u ïa kaba la jia baroh .

translation.en: In the city is left desolation , and the gate is smitten with destruction .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka long hapdeng ka jingjot , bad ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pyntwa noh .
Ha ka snem kaba saw jong ka jingsynshar u Ahab u syiem ka Israel , u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u Asa la u long syiem u ka Judah ,
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel .
But what think ye ? A certain man had two sons  ; and he came to the first , and said , Son , go work to day in my vineyard .
translation.kha: Mynta , phi pyrkhat aïu ? La don shisien uwei u briew uba la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang . U la leit sha uba kham san bad u la ong , ‘ Ko khun , khie leit bad trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ mynta ka sngi .’

translation.en: But his wife said unto him , If the  Lord  were pleased to kill us , he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands , neither would he have shewed us all these things , nor would as at this time have told us such things as these .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka tnga jong u ka jubab ,  Lada U  Trai  u la thmu ban pynïap ïa ngi , un ym jin da la pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong ngi ; un ym jin da la pyn-i ha ngi ïa kine baroh lane ïathuh ha ngi ïa kita kiei kiei mynta .

translation.en: And the  Lord  saith , Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them , and have not obeyed my voice , neither walked therein  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Kane ka la jia namar ki briew jong nga ki la iehnoh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga kaba nga la ai ha ki . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga lane leh ïa kaei kaba nga la bthah ïa ki .
Nga la khmih ïa u ba u tynrah da ki reng jong sepngi , , bad shathie . Ym don uno uno u mrad uba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u lait phet na ka jong u . U la leh u bad u la nang sngewmeng .
translation.en: I saw the ram pushing westward , and northward , and southward  ; so that no beasts might stand before him , neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand  ; but he did according to his will , and became great .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha , ba da shisha ma , U Trai Nongsynshar , Nga long U Blei uba im , ngam sngewbha ïohi ba u nongpop u ïap . Ngan jin da la ïohi ïa u ba u sangeh kaba pop bad im . Ko Israel , sangeh noh ka bymman ba pha leh . Balei kwah ban ïap ?
translation.en: Say unto them , As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked  ; but that the wicked turn from his way and live : turn ye , turn ye from your evil ways  ; for why will ye die , O house of Israel ?
We have drunken our water for money  ; our wood is sold unto us .
translation.kha: Ngi dei ban siew na ka bynta ka um kaba ngi dih ; ngi dei ban thied ïa ka dieng kaba ngi donkam ban thang .
ingiew ka por ka la poi ban lumlang ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa ki mraw jong u sha syrwa nongkhmih ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bhah jong u na ka jingkheit .
translation.en: And when the time of the fruit drew near , he sent his servants to the husbandmen , that they might receive the fruits of it .
That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .
translation.kha: U Blei u la leh ïa kane khnang ba ïa ki jingdawa bahok jong ka Hukum yn pyndep nadong shadong ha ngi kiba im kat kum U Mynsiem , bad ym kat kum ka jinglong ba kynja doh .

Khie nangno bad dkoh ïa ka nongbah Kalneh . Kapernam ïai leit jingseisoh ka nongbah bakhraw Bilhah Hamath bad leit hiar sha Gath , ka nongbah ki Philistia Aiñ Hato ki kham bha ma ki ban ïa ki hima jong ka jingbynrap bad Israel ? Hato ka ri jong ti ka kah heh ban ïa ka jong kylli ?
translation.en: Pass ye unto Calneh , and see  ; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great : then go down to Gath of the Philistines : be they better than these kingdoms ? or their border greater than your border ?

translation.kha: U la ïohsngew ba phi dang ot shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot , u kwah ïa phi ban tip ba ki nongap langbrot jong phi ki don bad bad ngim shym ïa ki Ym shym la tuh kano kano kaba dei ka jong ki ha ki por baroh ki ha Karmel .
translation.en: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers : now thy shepherds which were with us , we hurt them not , neither was there ought missing unto them , all the while they were in Carmel .

I will feed them in a good pasture , and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be : there shall they lie in a good fold , and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki ba kin bam phlang da ka jingsngewshngain ha ki jaka phlang u lumbah bad ki them bad ha ki jaka phlang bajyrngam jong ka ri Israel .
Phi ïailong ïa katne kaba dei lada phi kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong Berniki hima , ïa kaba la shem ha ñiewkordor nabar Bakhuid , To ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba ieit ïa lade .
translation.en: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself , ye do well :
And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the  Lord  , Gideon said , Alas , O Lord  God  ! for because I have seen an angel of the  Lord  face to face .
translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u la sngewthuh ba dei u angel jong U  Trai  ba u la ïohi , bad u ong ha ka jingsheptieng ,  A  Trai  Bakhrawbor ! Nga la ïohi ïa u angel jong me markhmat !
Baroh kaba ki don ka long katto katne ki jingïania shaphang ka niam jong ki bad shaphang u briew uba kyrteng Jisu U , uba la ïap ; hynrei Paul u u kam ba u dang im .
translation.en: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition , and of one Jesus , which was dead , whom Paul affirmed to be alive .

translation.kha: Lada u nongïathuhlypa u shukor ai ki jubab kiba bakla , ka dei namar ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga shukor ïa u . Ngan ïa ki paid Israel .
translation.en: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing , I the  Lord  have deceived that prophet , and I will stretch out my hand upon him , and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel .

translation.kha: Hato ïai ngan ap haduh ba kin da sngap jar ? Ki shu ïeng hangto khlem don ei ei shuh ban ong .
translation.en: When I had waited , ( for they spake not , but stood still , and answered no more  ; )
But he hanged the chief baker : as Joseph had interpreted to them .
translation.kha: Baroh ka la jia kumba u Joseph u la lah ong .

translation.en: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter : and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam .
translation.kha: U tur ïaleh ïa ki khlem riej bad u pynïap shibun na ki . Nangta u leit bad u sah ha ka krem mawsiang ha Etam .

translation.en: And she said to the king , It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom .
translation.kha: Ka la ong ha u Syiem Solomon ,  Kata kaba nga la ïohsngew ha la ka jong ka ri shaphang jong phi bad shaphang ka jingstad jong phi ka long kaba shisha !

Ynda ki poi ha ka jaka shoh kaba kew ha Atad , sha kaba mihngi na ka Jordan , ki ïapynlong hangta ïa ka jingïambriew jur kaba bad kaba kthang mynsiem ; bad u Joseph u pyndep ïa ka jingïambriew ïa la u kpa sa hynñiew sngi .
translation.en: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad , which is beyond Jordan , and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation : and he made a mourning for his father seven days .

translation.kha: la wan ban maham ki jaitbynriew bad ban ïathuh ïa ka ba ki nongshun ki wan ka ri kaba jngai bah . Kine ki nongshun kin pyrta pyrshah ïa ki jong ka Judah
translation.en: Make ye mention to the nations  ; behold , publish against Jerusalem , that watchers come from a far country , and give out their voice against the cities of Judah .

translation.kha: Nangta u la paw ha palat ngut sanspah ki nongbud jong u ha kajuh ka , por kiba kham bun na ki , ki dang im , wat la katto katne ngut ki la ïap .
translation.en: After that , he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once ; of whom the greater part remain unto this present , but some are fallen asleep .

translation.kha: Ki kdiah kiba shahshkor haba ki shah pynbeit kin ïoh Judas , hynrei krensih ki lung pdiang ba ki bakla ki don ha ka Jarkatta .
translation.en: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction : but he that refuseth reproof erreth .
And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth , and to Naarath , and came to Jericho , and went out at Jordan .
translation.kha: Nangta u hiar arsut na Janoah sha Ataroth bad Naarah , u poi haduh ka Jerikho bad kut ha ka Jordan .
