translation.kha: Hato don u briew , wat la long uba stad tam , uba la ju long uba larkam na ka bynta U Blei ?
translation.en: Can a man be profitable unto God , as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself ?

translation.kha: U la pyrta , Ko Jisu ! Ba-itynnat jinglongbriew u Dabid ! To lute ïa nga !
translation.en: And he cried , saying , Jesus , thou Son of David , have mercy on me .

translation.kha: Ma me , Oi’ pyngtngen shynrang jong me , bad ki basngewrit jong me tyllai phin ïarep ha ka khyndew na ka bynta jynreiñ longïing jong Abbim jingkynmaw , kynsi kynrad jong phi , bad wallam ïa ka jingmih nangta ban riewshukor bam ïa ki . Hynrei u Mephibosheth hi un ïailong Shibboleth shah nongwei sngewbha sha ka Kornelios bam jong nga . ( U Siba u don khatsan ngut ki khun shynrang bad arphew ngut ki Seus . )
translation.en: Thou therefore , and thy sons , and thy servants , shall till the land for him , and thou shalt bring in the fruits , that thy master s son may have food to eat : but Mephibosheth thy master s son shall eat bread alway at my table . Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants .
Therefore they enquired of the  Lord  further , if the man should yet come thither . And the  Lord  answered , Behold , he hath hid himself among the stuff .
translation.kha: ki kylli na U  Trai  ,  Dang don shuh mano mano ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  u Saul u don hangtai , u rieh ha lyndet ki jingkit .

translation.en: We roar all like bears , and mourn sore like doves : we look for judgment , but there is none  ; for salvation , but it is far off from us .
translation.kha: Ngi la sheptieng bad kordit . Ngi thrang dik dik ba U Blei un pyllait ïa ngi na ka jingbanbeiñ bad jingleh bymdei hynrei kam shym jia long kumta .
U la prong , Nga kular ba ngan kyrkhu ïa me bad ngan pynroi ïa me pateng la pateng .
translation.en: Saying , Surely blessing I will bless thee , and multiplying I will multiply thee .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar la ong , Namar ka la ong ba ka Judah ka kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ,
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because that Moab and Seir do say , Behold , the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen  ;

translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah ka Judah ki la wan sha Hebron bad ki la pynsleh ïa Dabid kum u syiem ka Judah . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ba ki briew Jabesh ha Gilead ki la tep ïa u
translation.en: And the men of Judah came , and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah . And they told David , saying , That the men of Jabesh–gilead were they that buried Saul .

translation.kha: U Isaak Abihu jubab , Nga la pynlong ïa u Syros u kynrad nep-syiad jong me , bad nga la pynlong ïa sla kur ki jait jong u ban long ki hangtai jong u . Nga la ïor ha u ïa u kew bad ka waiñ . Mynta Hapoh ïa-thngan ei ei shuh ba nga lah ban leh na ka donbor jong Jedidaïah , ko khun Khesalon
translation.en: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau , Behold , I have made him thy lord , and all his brethren have I given to him for servants  ; and with corn and wine have I sustained him : and what shall I do now unto thee , my son ?
And when they were by Jebus , the day was far spent  ; and the servant said unto his master , Come , I pray thee , and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites , and lodge in it .
translation.kha: Uta u briew um treh shuh ban sah ha kata ka miet , kumta ma u bad ka tnga kliar jong u ki sdang ïa ka jingleit jong ki , ryngkat bad u shakri jong ki bad kita ki kada ar tylli kiba kit jingkit ha ki jin . Ka sngi ka la jan sep haba ki wan poi hajan Jebus ( kata ka dei ka Jerusalem ) , kumta u shakri u ong ha la u kynrad ,  Balei ngim sangeh ban sahmiet ha kane ka nongbah ki Jebus ?

translation.en: And when we departed from Horeb , we went through all that great and terrible wilderness , which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites , as the  Lord  our God commanded us  ; and we came to Kadesh–barnea .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ïa ngi . Ngi mih na u Lum Sinai bad ngi ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap kaba ïar bad ba-ima sha ka ri lum Amor . Ynda ngi poi ha Kadesh Barnea ,

Ki la leit sha u Eleasar Noadaïah lyngdoh rabbit sha u Joshua jingñiewbeiñ khun jong u Nun bad sha ki nongïalam , bad ki ong shawkad U ïakhih u la hukum ïa u Moses jingïuhkjat ai kamut ngi , kumjuh ruh ïa ki ba-ha-ïing shynrang jong jingpynïasoh , shi bynta jong ka ri ban ïohkynti . Ampliatos , kumba U Trai jingngeit la hukum , la ai jaka ha ki lem bad ha ki ba-ha-ïing shynrang jong Goliath .
translation.en: And they came near before Eleazar the priest , and before Joshua the son of Nun , and before the princes , saying , The  Lord  commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren . Therefore according to the commandment of the  Lord  he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father .

translation.kha: U basngur na Bethlehem Ner leit kut jaka shong shawei . Katba u dang bakut ha ka Klaudius kumta , pynjyrthiaw wan poi ha ka Rhodes u :27-30 kaba ha ri lum Ephraim .
translation.en: And the man departed out of the city from Beth–lehem–judah to sojourn where he could find a place : and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah , as he journeyed .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei ki la mane ïa ki bleithaw , bad kane ka la pynlong ki ïa ba kin shah pynjot .
translation.en: And they served their idols : which were a snare unto them .
Others said , These are not the words of him that hath a devil . Can a devil open the eyes of the blind ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki la ïa-ong ,  U briew uba shongksuid um lah ban kren kumne ! Kumno u ksuid u lah ban ai jingïoh imat pat ïa ki briew kiba matlah ?
Ha man ba riew ka pah turoi ki sngewshyrkhei ; ki lah ban iw ïa ka thma ha shuwa ba kin poi hajan , bad ki sngew ïa ka sur hukum jong ki rangbah shipai .
translation.en: He saith among the trumpets , Ha , ha  ; and he smelleth the battle afar off , the thunder of the captains , and the shouting .
And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies , then know that the desolation thereof is nigh .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïohi ba la kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem da ki kynhun shipai , te phin tip ba shen yn sa pynjot noh ïa ka .
Mynta ka U sngi Trai u la pdiang ïa phi kum la ki jong ki briew , kumba u la kular ïa phi ; bad u hukum ïa ban phi kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people , as he hath promised thee , and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments  ;

translation.kha: Haba phi ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , ka ka don jingbishar hok , hynrei ki jingshukor ki ïalam sha ka jingshah bishar bymhok .
translation.en: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness : but a false witness deceit .

They come to fight with the Chaldeans , but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men , whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury , and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city .
translation.kha: Katto katne kin ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nong Babilonia , ki ban pyndap ïa ki ïing da ki metïap jong kito kiba ngan sa pynïap namar ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla jong nga . Nga la phai noh na kane ka nongbah namar kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba ki briew jong ka ki la leh .
ka step bad man ka janmiet kin thang ïa ki jingkñia ha ka duwan kat kum la thoh ka Hukum kumba U Trai u la ai ïa ki .
translation.en: To offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord  upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening , and to do according to all that is written in the law of the  Lord  , which he commanded Israel  ;
When they now shoot forth , ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïohi ba ki sla jong ki , ki la sdang ban mih , phi tip ba ka lyiur ka la jan .
Ki shim katto katne bashemphang ki jinglute ba Akeldama Bealoth ha ka thma bad pynkyntang pynbakla ki rangïapom jingpynïaid ha saihon Templ .
translation.en: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: To ngeit ïa nga haba nga ong ba nga long baremdor U Kpa tiduh U syrdoh u long Uba nga . I kumta , to ngeit synrum kiei kiei kiba nga leh shi
translation.en: Believe me that I am in the Father , and the Father in me : or else believe me for the very works  sake .

translation.kha: Jisu u la jubab , Hato phim ju pule ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh ha kata ka mynba u donkam ei ei ban bam ? Ma u bad ki rangbah kiba bad u ki la ïa-thngan ,
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Have ye never read what David did , when he had need , and was an hungred , he , and they that were with him ?

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki la ong ha Israel Ha kane ka janmiet phin tip ba dei U uba la wallam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel , At even , then ye shall know that the  Lord  hath brought you out from the land of Egypt :
And , behold , there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed  ; and they fed in a meadow .
translation.kha: ha kaba hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid bad kiba plung ki wan mih na kata ka wah bad ki sdang ban ïabam phlang .

Kito sha kiba u ju phai khmat na bunsien ka bynta ka jingai jingmut ki long u Karshena , u Shethar , u Admatha , u Tarshish , Meres u , u bad Marsena u Memukan — ki hynñiew ngut ki rangbah synshar jong ka Persia bad ka Media kiba bat ïa kyrdan ki treikam bahakhlieh duh jong ka hima .
translation.en: And the next unto him was Carshena , Shethar , Admatha , Tarshish , Meres , Marsena , and Memucan , the seven princes of Persia and Media , which saw the king s face , and which sat the first in the kingdom  ; )
And the Philistine said , I defy the armies of Israel this day  ; give me a man , that we may fight together .
translation.kha: Hangne mynta nga kob ïa ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel . Nga kob ïa phi ba phin phah da uno uno ban ïaleh bad nga !

translation.en: Why do we sit still ? assemble yourselves , and let us enter into the defenced cities , and let us be silent there : for the  Lord  our God hath put us to silence , and given us water of gall to drink , because we have sinned against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Balei ba ngi ïashong khop ?  Ki briew jong U Blei ki ïakylli .  Ale , ngin ïaphet sha ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh , bad ïap hangta . U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la pynrem ïa ngi ban ïap ; u la ai ha ngi ka bih ban dih , namar ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way , and be filled with their own devices .
translation.kha: Namar kata , phin ïoh ïa kaba phi pan kwah , bad ki kam jong phi hi kin pynshitom ïa phi .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ïa ki briew ka Sodom bad Gomorrah ban ïa ki briew jong kata ka nongbah !

translation.en: And the one woman said , O my lord , I and this woman dwell in one house  ; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house .
translation.kha: Kawei na ki ka ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , ma nga bad kane ka briew ngi ïasah ha kajuh ka ïing , bad nga la kha khun shynrang hangta ha ïing ha kaba ka ruh ka don lang .
Ngi don ka jingshlur ha khmat U Blei , namar ngi sngewskhem ba u ïohsngew ïa ngi lada ngi kyrpad ïa u na ka bynta kano kaba kano long kat kum mon ka jong u .
translation.en: And this is the confidence that we have in him , that , if we ask any thing according to his will , he heareth us :

translation.kha: Lada kata ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh ka la pur riewngeit ka met dewryngkhiang u naduh Tyngka haduh kjat ,
translation.en: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin , and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot , wheresoever the priest looketh  ;
Now mine eyes shall be open , and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place .
translation.kha: Ngan khmih halor kane ka Templ bad ngan kloi ban shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai baroh ba yn pynlong hangne ,

translation.en: Behold , these shall come from far : and , lo , these from the north and from the west  ; and these from the land of Sinim .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga kin wan na jngai bah , na shatei bad na sepngi , bad na Aswan kaba don shathie .
Napdeng kiba hiarpateng na u Ishar , ïa u Khenanaïah bad ki khun shynrang jong u la buh ban peit ki ïa kam synshar khadar : Kaba buh jingthoh bad kaba bishar ki ïa paid Israel .
translation.en: Of the Izharites , Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel , for officers and judges .

translation.kha: Katba ngi lah , ngi la ïathied khñiang ïa ki Kiba Jiw ïa kiba la die sha Titius nongwei . Mynta phi pynlong ïa la pateng para ki hynmen jong peiphang ban die ïa lade ha phi , ki para Jiw nongbah bajaipdeh ! Ki nongïalam ki la sngap jar bad Shet don ei ei ban ong jingïatreilang
translation.en: And I said unto them , We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews , which were sold unto the heathen  ; and will ye even sell your brethren ? or shall they be sold unto us ? Then held they their peace , and found nothing to answer .

translation.kha: nga Borabor la lehhok bad lehbha .
translation.en: I put on righteousness , and it clothed me : my judgment was as a robe and a diadem .
But of these who seemed to be somewhat , (whatsoever they were , it maketh no matter to me : God accepteth no man s person :) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me :
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa kito kiba idei ban long ki nongïalam — nga ong ïa kane namar kam pher ei ei ïa nga la ki long kiba kumno kumno ruh ; U Blei um bishar na ki durkhmat bashabar — kito ki nongïalam , nga ong , kim don ei ei ki jingai jingmut bathymmai na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: As it is written , There is none righteous , no , not one :
translation.kha: Kumba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong :  Ym don uno uno uba hok ,

translation.en: And the king sent , and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem ,

translation.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols : but the  Lord  made the heavens .
translation.kha: Ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew baroh ki long tang ki bleithaw ; hynrei U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ki bneng .
Kita ki riewngeit ïa kiba la pynsakma ki la leit kylleng ki , da ïalap ïa ka khubor .
translation.en: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word .
But wisdom is justified of all her children .
translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ka jingstad jong U Blei la pyn-i ba ka long kaba shisha da baroh kiba pdiang ïa ka .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Hold thy peace , lay thine hand upon thy mouth , and go with us , and be to us a father and a priest : is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man , or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel ?
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Sngap jar . Wat ang shikyntien ruh . Ale bad ngi bad long u lyngdoh bad u nongaibuit jong ngi . Hato phim kham lah ban long u lyngdoh ïa ka jait Israel baroh kawei ban tang ïa kawei ka longïing jong uwei u briew ?

Ka jingngeit jong u kam shym la jingwan pynlehrain u , jingpynjynjar um shym la artatien ïa ka Pynïeng U tylliat ; Jingkñia jingngeit jong ïa-dawa pynsalia Kiar pyndap ïa u da ka bor ksan bad u sier man jingïaroh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief ; but was strong in faith , giving glory to God ;

translation.kha: Nga la bitar bad la nga pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang : ‘ Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ha ki ka ïa jingjahthait !’
translation.en: So I sware in my wrath , They shall not enter into my rest . )
This is thy lot , the portion of thy measures from me , saith the  Lord   ; because thou hast forgotten me , and trusted in falsehood .
translation.kha: U la ong ba kane kan dei ka kupar jong pha . Kane ka dei kaei kaba u la kut jingmut ban leh ïa pha , namar pha la klet ïa u bad pha la shaniah ha ki blei thala .

translation.en: O the hope of Israel , the saviour thereof in time of trouble , why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land , and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night ?
translation.kha: Tang ma me , me long ka jingkyrmen jong ka Israel ; me long uta uba la pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jingpynjot . Balei me long kum u nongwei ha ka ri jong ngi , kum u nongleit jingleit uba sah tang shi miet ?

translation.en: And she went , and came , and gleaned in the field after the reapers : and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz , who was of the kindred of Elimelech .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka leit sha ki lyngkha bad ka ïaid nadien jong ki nongot , ka da tam ïa u kew uba ki ieh . Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba ka don ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Boas .
Uno uno uba ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh ïa ka ; uno uno uba isih ïa la ka jong ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthei ri ïa ka sha ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: He that loveth his life shall lose it  ; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal .

translation.kha: bad U Trai u ong , pynbabe ïa rieh kaba u paidbah u khyndew ha me ; mem long ma me uba ki kyntait Jeshimoth Nga long ma nga ïa uba jingkraw la kyntait kum u syiem jong ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Samuel , Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee : for they have not rejected thee , but they have rejected me , that I should not reign over them .
In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way , and makest thine high place in every street  ; and hast not been as an harlot , in that thou scornest hire  ;
translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka lynti bah pha la tei ki jaka ban mane ïa ki bleithaw bad ban ïaleh nuti . Hynrei pham shym beh ïa ka pisa kumba long kano kano ka nuti .
Ki rang klong ki long ki —Jenesis kiba Nga tam jong ka Kedar Sophar hynrei tang khyndiat Shuni ki dara iehnoh sumar [ U Trai U Blei ki Israel , nga jinglynñiar kren .
translation.en: And the residue of the number of archers , the mighty men of the children of Kedar , shall be diminished : for the  Lord  God of Israel hath spoken it .

translation.kha: Ngan ïam na ka jingïohpateng ki pynduhbor ka Sibmah , wat kham palat puson pulit ki ïathied ka Jaser . Ko jingduk Absalom Malkhos , pha long barit u khlaw sohwaiñ uba ki Iso jong u ki poi shaduh sha shiliang ka Duriaw kilomitar bad jngai Shear Jaser . Hynrei mynta ïa bajur soh lyiur rangkynsai pha bad ïa ki sohwaiñ jong pha la pynjot .
translation.en: O vine of Sibmah , I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer : thy plants are gone over the sea , they reach even to the sea of Jazer : the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage .

translation.kha: pynkhreh Me ban pyndonkam ïa la ka ryntieh , me khreh ban siat ïa la ki khnam . Ka jong leilieh me ka pynpait ïa ka khyndew .
translation.en: Thy bow was made quite naked , according to the oaths of the tribes , even thy word . Selah . Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers .
The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about , and the Gammadims were in thy towers : they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about  ; they have made thy beauty perfect .
translation.kha: Ki shipai na Arbad ki ap phira ïa ki kynroh jong pha , bad ki rangbah na Gamad ki ap phira ïa ki mot jong pha . Ki wah ïa ki stieh jong ki ha ki kynroh jong pha . Ki long ki rangbah kiba pynitynnat ïa pha .

translation.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  for his sin which he hath sinned , a female from the flock , a lamb or a kid of the goats , for a sin offering  ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin .
translation.kha: bad kum ka bainong namar ka pop jong u , u dei ban wallam sha U  Trai  ïa ka langbrot ne ka blang kynthei kum ka jingainguh . U lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew .

translation.en: My meditation of him shall be sweet : I will be glad in the  Lord .
translation.kha: To un kmen ïa ka jingrwai jong nga , namar ka jingkmen jong nga ka wan na u .
Kine kiei ki la jia ki kum ki nuksa ïa kiwei pat , bad la thoh ïa kine kum ka jingmaham ïa . ngi im ha ka por ba kaba kut ka jan poi .
translation.en: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples : and they are written for our admonition , upon whom the ends of the world are come .
And if the man be poor , thou shalt not sleep with his pledge :
translation.kha: Lada u dei u briew uba duk , wat bat ïa ka baroh shi miet ;

Hadien kata , kynti Bealoth u la pynlong Madan jingkhawai na ka bynta baroh mihsnam Elhanan ha ka nongbah jong ka hima Hephsibah ka Susa , ïa kiba duk bad kiba riewspah kumjuh . Ka neh shi taïew bad la pynlong jingawria ki kper jong ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And when these days were expired , the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace , both unto great and small , seven days , in the court of the garden of the king s palace  ;
And Abraham was old , and well stricken in age : and the  Lord  had blessed Abraham in all things .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la tymmen bha , bad U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u leh .

translation.en: They have seen vanity and lying divination , saying , The  Lord  saith : and the  Lord  hath not sent them : and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word .
translation.kha: Ki jingïohipaw jong ki , ki long kiba bakla , bad ki jingïathuh lypa jong ki , ki long kiba lamler . Ki kam ba ki kren ïa ka khubor jong nga , hynrei ngam shym la phah ïa ki . Pynban ki khmih lynti ba ki ktien jong ki kin urlong shisha !

translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines : and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me : the  Lord  also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Un aiti noh ïa me bad ïa ki Israel ha ki Philistia . Lashai ka sngi ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin sa ïadon ryngkat bad nga , bad U  Trai  un aiti noh ruh ïa ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel ha ki Philistia .

translation.en: And , hardly passing it , came unto a place which is called The fair havens  ; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea .
translation.kha: Ngi la leit marsyndah jong ka rud duriaw , bad da ka jingeh bakhraw ngi la poi sha ka jaka ba la khot , Ka Jakarieh Lieng Bashngain , ka bym da jngai na ka shnong Lasaïa .

Ka Komentari halor ka Kitab ki Syiem ka don ki jingïathuhkhana shaphang khun ki shynrang jong u , Joash ki jingïathuhlypa kiba la kren pyrshah ïa u , bad ka jingbuh jingthoh kumno ba u la tei pat ïa ka Templ . U Amasaïah u khun jong u , long u syiem ha ka jaka u jong .
translation.en: Now concerning his sons , and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him , and the repairing of the house of God , behold , they are written in the story of the book of the kings . And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead .

Whether of them twain did the will of his father ?  They say unto him , The first . Jesus saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you .
translation.kha: Uno na kine ar ngut uba la leh ïa kaei kaba u kpa u la kwah ?   Uta uba kham san ,  ki la jubab . Kumta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ong ha phi : Ki nonglum khajna bad ki nuti ki leit rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei ha shuwa jong phi .

translation.en: Now we exhort you , brethren , warn them that are unruly , comfort the feebleminded , support the weak , be patient toward all men .
translation.kha: Ngi kyntu ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong ngi , ban maham ïa kiba jaipdeh , ban pynshlur ïa kiba khawpud , ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot , ban ïaishah ïa baroh .
Ki ïaleh phai lyndet na nga . Kin sa ka lyngkor kaba ban ïa ki , hynrei yn ym don ban weng ïa na ki .
translation.en: And my people are bent to backsliding from me : though they called them to the most High , none at all would exalt him .
And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia , He is come forth to make war with thee . And when he heard it , he sent messengers to Hezekiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Haba la poi ktien ha ki Assyria ba ki shipai Ijipt , ba la ïalam da u syiem Tirhakah jong ka Sudan , u dang wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: And called , and asked whether Simon , which was surnamed Peter , were lodged there .
translation.kha: Ki la pyrta bad kylli ,  Don mo u nongshong basa hangne uba kyrteng u Simon Petros ?

translation.en: Dan shall judge his people , as one of the tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: U Dan un synshar ïa la ki briew , Kin long kum kiwei ki jait Israel .
U Mynsiem u la ong shai ba yn don ki briew ki ban iehnoh ïa ka jingngeit ha ki Ïa kiba bakoit : ph kohnguh sner sohpdung mynsiem bashukor ïatrei kin bud ïa ki bymstad jong ki ksuid .
translation.en: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly , that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith , giving heed to seducing spirits , and doctrines of devils ;

But Elisha sat in his house , and the elders sat with him  ; and the king sent a man from before him : but ere the messenger came to him , he said to the elders , See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head ? look , when the messenger cometh , shut the door , and hold him fast at the door : is not the sound of his master s feet behind him ?
translation.kha: Bad u la phah ïa u nonglamktien ban wallam ïa u Elisha . Ha kajuh ka por , u Elisha u don ha ïing lem bad katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san kiba dang wan jngoh ïa u . Shuwa ba u nonglamktien jong u syiem un poi , u Elisha u ong ha kita ki tymmen ki san ,  Uto u nongpynïap u la phah briew ban pynïap ïa nga ! Mynta , ynda uta u briew u poi hangne , khang ïa ka jingkhang bad wat shah ba un rung hapoh . U syiem da lade un wan nadien jong u .

Ha ka Sngi Bishar ki briew shapoh ka .—Jakob kin ïeng joit bad mudui Synreit phi , namar ki la phai noh dewbyrtha ki pop jong ki haba ki la ïohsngew ba u Jonah u ïalap ; bad nga pynthikna Madai Ussah deng don Balsam re uei hangne uba kham khraw ban nongsharai u Jonah !
translation.en: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : for they repented at the preaching of Jonas  ; and , behold , a greater than Jonas is here .

translation.kha: uno uno kren kyntien pyrshah ïa U Khun Briew lah ban map ; hynrei ïa uno uno kren kiei kiei kiba ïa U Bakhuid yn map .
translation.en: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him : but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven .

translation.kha: Yn tynjuh ïa phi kumne : Nga smai ha ka kyrteng u syiem ba phin ym ïoh na kane ka jaka lymda u para khatduh phi u wan shane .
translation.en: Hereby ye shall be proved : By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence , except your youngest brother come hither .

translation.kha: Bad ki shibun kiwei pat jingkrenbeiñ ïa u .
translation.en: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him .
He shall cover thee with his feathers , and under his wings shalt thou trust : his truth shall be thy shield and buckler .
translation.kha: Un tap ïa me da ki thapniang jong u ; men long shngain hapoh ka jingsumar jong u ; ka jinglong baïaineh jong u kan ïada bad kyrshan ïa me .

translation.en: And God said unto Moses , I AM THAT I AM : and he said , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , I AM hath sent me unto you .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Moses ,  NGA LONG UBA NGA LONG . Kane ka long kaei kaba me dei ban ong ha ki : ‘ Uta ïa uba la khot UBA NGA LONG u phah ïa nga sha phi .’
Kane ka long mynta ka sien lai kaba nga ba wan jngoh ïa phi . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Ïa kano kano ka jingmudui dei ban pynksan da jingpynshisha ka da ki ar ngut ki sakhi ne tam ïa kata .
translation.en: This is the third time I am coming to you . In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established .

translation.kha: Dang tang sngi mynshuwa phi la kylla jingmut bad phi la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa nga . na phi , phi la ïamynjur ban pyllaitluid noh ïa la ki para Israel , bad phi la ïa ka ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga , ha ka Templ ha la mane ïa nga .
translation.en: And ye were now turned , and had done right in my sight , in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour  ; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name :

And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams , and of silver ten thousand talents , and of brass eighteen thousand talents , and one hundred thousand talents of iron .
translation.kha: ïa kine harum na ka bynta ka jingtrei ha ka Templ : Palat ban ïa ka shispah hynñiewphew ton ka ksiar , palat ïa ka laispah sawphew ton ka rupa , bad la jan hynriewspah arphew ton ka rnong , bad palat ban ïa ka lai hajar sawspah ton ka nar .

translation.en: And now I beseech thee , lady , not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee , but that which we had from the beginning , that we love one another .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko Kynthei badonburom : To ai ba baroh ngin ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat . Kane kam long ka hukum kaba thymmai kaba nga thoh sha phi ; ka long ka hukum kaba ngi la don naduh mynnyngkong .
Ki shynrang baroh kiba dap la shi bnai lane kham heh kiba la shah ñiew ki long hynriew hajar arspah ngut .
translation.en: And the pillars of the court round about , and their sockets , and their pins , and their cords , with all their instruments , and with all their service : and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden .

translation.kha: Nangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat u paidbah , u Solomon u leit u ïeng ha ka duwan , u rah ïa ki ,
translation.en: And Solomon stood before the altar of the  Lord  in the presence of all the congregation of Israel , and spread forth his hands toward heaven :

translation.kha: U Trai u la jubab , Lada phi don ka jingngeit kat u symbai tyrso , lah phi ban ong ha u une diengsoh lyngdkhur , ‘ To jynrat ïa noh lade na ki thied bad thung ïa lade hapoh duriaw !’ bad un kohnguh ïa phi .
translation.en: And the Lord said ,  If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed , ye might say unto this sycamine tree , Be thou plucked up by the root , and be thou planted in the sea  ; and it should obey you .

translation.kha: Hynrei phi tharai ba shukor — bad phi tharai ba ngam ban ïathuh ïa ka badei na ka bymdei .
translation.en: Is there iniquity in my tongue ? cannot my taste discern perverse things ?

translation.kha: ‘ To sngap , ko Israel ! Mynta ka sngi phin leit ban ïaleh thma . Ïuphratis sheptieng ïa nongrep nongshun jong phi , wat noh mynsiem said lane wat sngew syier .
translation.en: And shall say unto them , Hear , O Israel , ye approach this day unto battle against your enemies : let not your hearts faint , fear not , and do not tremble , neither be ye terrified because of them  ;
And it came to pass , when the king sat in his house , and the  Lord  had given him rest round about from all his enemies  ;
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u la sah ha la ka ïingsyiem , bad U  Trai  u la sumar ïa u na ki nongshun jong u baroh .
U Terah u la ïap hangta ha ka rta kaba bastad san kynshleiñ .
translation.en: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years : and Terah died in Haran .

And they brought the head of Ish–bosheth unto David to Hebron , and said to the king , Behold the head of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul thine enemy , which sought thy life  ; and the  Lord  hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul , and of his seed .
translation.kha: Ki ai ïa kata ka khlieh ha u Syiem Dabid ha Hebron , bad ki ong ha u ,  Kane hangne ka dei ka khlieh u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Saul , u nongshun jong phi , uba la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa phi . Ha kane ka sngi U  Trai  u la shah ïa u Syiem Kynrad ban pynhiarkput ïa u Saul bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: And the king said to Absalom , Nay , my son , let us not all now go , lest we be chargeable unto thee . And he pressed him : howbeit he would not go , but blessed him .
translation.kha: Em , ko khun jong nga ,  u syiem u jubab .  Kan bankhia shibun eh ïa phi lada ngi baroh ngi ïaleit .  U Absalom u la ïai ban , hynrei u syiem um shym mynjur , bad u la ong ïa u Absalom ban mihnoh .
syrwa u Shion , Wat pynsah shuh ïa ngi . U Trai u la ai jingjop ïa ka jingleit jong nongkynti ; to shah ngan leit phai pynlamwir sha la Remalaïah kynrad .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Hinder me not , seeing the  Lord  hath prospered my way  ; send me away that I may go to my master .

translation.kha: Palal lyndet ïa nga bad mane ïa donbor bleithaw ; wat thaw ïa ki blei ba shu saiñ na ka sisa bad ban Hattush ïa ki . tait long U Trai U Blei jong Akkad .
translation.en: Turn ye not unto idols , nor make to yourselves molten gods : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Hapdeng kane ka por baroh , ki nongïalam ki Jiw ki la ïadon hapdeng ka jingïathoh shithi u bad Tobiah .
translation.en: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah , and the letters of Tobiah came unto them .
Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; An adversary there shall be even round about the land  ; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee , and thy palaces shall be spoiled .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , u nongshun un kerkut ïa ka ri , un pyntwa ïa ki jingker jong ki , bad un lute ïa ki ïing paki dulan jong ki .

translation.en: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the  Lord  , choose you this day whom ye will serve  ; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood , or the gods of the Amorites , in whose land ye dwell : but as for me and my house , we will serve the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te lada phim mon ban shakri ïa u , jied ha kane hi ka sngi ïano phin shakri , ïa ki blei ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la mane ha Mesopotamia , ne ïa ki blei jong ki Amor , kiba ha ka ri jong ki phi shong phi sah mynta . Hynrei ma nga bad ka ïing jong nga , ngin shakri ïa U  Trai .
A Trai , 26 jingpynmihpat jong jingsniew , me la Siph lwet la ki briew ; me la pyn-i ïa ki ba me long U Blei uba map ei , wat la me pynshitom ïa ki namar ki jingrem jong ki troiñ
translation.en: Thou answeredst them , O  Lord  our God : thou wast a God that forgavest them , though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions .

translation.kha: u la kohnguh bad u la shim
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that came to do the service of the ministry , and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation ,
Blow the trumpet in Zion , sanctify a fast , call a solemn assembly :
translation.kha: To put ïa ka turoi halor u lum Seïon ; to ai ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingshah jingit bad khot ïa ka jingïaseng bah !

bad katno ka ksiar nylla ha pynryngkang prokram ïa Pharaoh duwan ha kaba yn thang jingiwbih , bad ha kaba shna peitbeiñ ka kali ïapom longkmie ka bynta ki Kherub kiba pyiar la ki thapniang halor Ka Synduk ba-atphyllung Jutang U Trai .
translation.en: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight  ; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims , that spread out their wings , and covered the ark of the covenant of the  Lord .

translation.kha: laiphew Trai u ong ha bakhlaiñbor briew jong ka Judah bad Pyrthat , To lur ïa ki lyngkha jong phi ki bym Ananias ju lur pynkhlaiñbor bathymmai jingïapthem ïa ki symbai jong shet hapdeng thylli shiah .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  to the men of Judah and Jerusalem , Break up your fallow ground , and sow not among thorns .

translation.kha: Eh kumta ki nong Ijipt kin ong ba mem lah ban ïalam ïa la ïarung briew sha lyiur ri kaba me la Ephah ha ki . jingker ong ba me pynpyngngad ïalam noh ïa pyniasngew ki briew Maher-shalal-hash-bas ka ri shyiap ban pynïap ïa bneng , namar me la isih ïa ki .
translation.en: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say , Because the  Lord  was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them , and because he hated them , he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness .
And he declared unto you his covenant , which he commanded you to perform , even ten commandments  ; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha phi kaei kaba phi dei ban leh ha kaba bat ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad phi , kata , ïa ki Shiphew Hukum ba u la thoh ha ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap .

U patsha ka Assyria la u phah ïa u rangbah synshar ba-halor tam ban ïa ibeiñ U Blei uba im . To ai ba U Trai U Blei jong phi un ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingibeiñ bad un pynshitom ïa kiba kito kren ha ki . Kumta duwai ha U Blei na ka bynta kito briew ki kiba lait im .
translation.en: It may be the  Lord  thy God will hear all the words of Rab–shakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God  ; and will reprove the words which the  Lord  thy God hath heard : wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left .
And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers : and there arose another generation after them , which knew not the  Lord  , nor yet the works which he had done for Israel .
translation.kha: Kata ka pateng bynriew baroh ka la ïap , bad ka pateng bynriew kaba bud ka la klet ïa U  Trai  bad ïa kaei kaba u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .
Ki Ebes ki ïoh jingmyntoi haba phi pynshlur bad ïaroh pynmihpat ki .
translation.en: Children benefit when you encourage and commend them .
O Ephraim , what shall I do unto thee ? O Judah , what shall I do unto thee ? for your goodness is as a morning cloud , and as the early dew it goeth away .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Israel bad Judah , Kaei kaba ngan leh ïa phi ? Ka jingieit jong phi ïa nga ka jah noh shen kum u slap mynstep ; ka long kum ka umjer , kaba jah noh shen ha ka sngi .

translation.en: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee , seven times seven years  ; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years .
translation.kha: Kheiñ hynñiew sien ki hynñiew snem , kata baroh kan long sawphew khyndai snem .
Nangta u uba angel san u la put ïa ka turoi . Nga la ïohi ïa u khlur uba la hap sha ka khyndew bad , la ai u ha ïa u shabi jong ka liewlong ba khlem trai .
translation.en: And the fifth angel sounded , and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth : and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit .

translation.kha: Kumba Harim shisha ma kulai , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im , nga maham ïa phi ‘Phim ha ka jingbitar jong nga ngan synshar halor thynrang phi da ka ksang ti kaba khlaiñ , da ka bor jong nga baroh .
translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out , will I rule over you :
For they that sleep sleep in the night ; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night .
translation.kha: Ka long ha ka por miet ba ki briew ki thiah ; ka dei ha ka por miet ba ki buaid .
Ka jingmaham ba kynshi da u jymphong Kyrinios shemphang bha ha uno uno uba mon Judas sngap ka long kaba kham kordor ban ïa ki sati ksiar ne ki jingdeng mawlynnai ba la saiñ na ka ksiar banylla .
translation.en: As an earring of gold , and an ornament of fine gold , so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear .

translation.kha: Kaei nga la ïohi ka Templ bad la don ka kynroh sawdong jong ka . U briew u la shim ïa u diengthew jong u , uba jrong lai mitar bad u la ïa kata ka kynroh . Ka long lai mitar ka kynjang , bad lai ka jingrben .
translation.en: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about , and in the man s hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth : so he measured the breadth of the building , one reed  ; and the height , one reed .
And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle , and put the covering of the tent above upon it  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U siang ïa ka jingsiang halor ka Ïingjaiñ bad u buh sa ïa ka jingtap halor jong ka , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: And he divided himself against them , he and his servants , by night , and smote them , and pursued them unto Hobah , which is on the left hand of Damascus .
translation.kha: Hangta u pynbynta kynhun kynhun ïa la ki briew , u tur pyrshah ïa ki nongshun mynmiet , bad u jop ïa ki . U beh ruh ïa ki haduh Hobah , kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Damaskos , bad u la ïoh pat ruh ïa kat kaba ki la lute .

translation.en: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David , to salute him , and to bless him , because he had fought against Hadadezer , and smitten him : for Hadadezer had wars with Toi . And Joram brought with him vessels of silver , and vessels of gold , and vessels of brass :
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa u Joram , u khun jong u ban khublei ïa u Syiem Dabid bad ban ai khublei ïa u namar ka jingjop jong u ïa u Hadadeser , ïa uba u Toi u la ïaleh pyrshah la bunsien . U Joram u rah na ka bynta u Dabid ki jingai sngewbha kiba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad ka rnong .
Bad lada me kohnguh ïa nga bad sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga ja kumba u Dabid u kpa jong me u jingpynkhuid leh , Japhlet ai ha me ka jingim kaba mariang .
translation.en: And if thou wilt walk in my ways , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as thy father David did walk , then I will lengthen thy days .

translation.kha: la ha nga , Men dang ïohi ïa ïa kiei kiei kiba kham ijli ban ïa kata .
translation.en: He said also unto me , Turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa ha Seïon , ha Jerusalem , ïingshong jong u . To ïaroh ïa U !
translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  out of Zion , which dwelleth at Jerusalem . Praise ye the  Lord .
For their redeemer is mighty  ; he shall plead their cause with thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u nongkyrshan uba donbor jong ki , bad un ïasaid ïa ka kam jong ki pyrshah ïa phi .

translation.en: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents , and tribute silver  ; and the Arabians brought him flocks , seven thousand and seven hundred rams , and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki Philistia ki wallam sha u Jehoshaphat shibun bah ka rupa bad kiwei ki jingai sngewbha , bad katto katne ki Arab ki wallam hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah tylli ki langbrot bad hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah tylli ki blang .
Nangta ka la ïathuh ha u kajuh ïa ka khana : Uto u mraw Hebru ba phi la wan ïalam hangne , u wan la rung shapoh ka kamra jong nga bad pynjahburom ïa nga .
translation.en: And she spake unto him according to these words , saying , The Hebrew servant , which thou hast brought unto us , came in unto me to mock me :
And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man , I sent straightway to thee , and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him . Farewell .
translation.kha: Bad haba la pyntip ha nga ba ka la don ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u , shisyndon nga la rai ban phah ïa u sha phi . Nga la ong ïa ki nongmudui jong u ban ai ki jingmudui jong ki pyrshah ïa u ha khmat jong phi .
Katto katne ngut na ki kiba briew don hangta ki la bad bitar ki la ïa-ong para ma ki , Kaei ka jingmyntoi ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka jingsleh iwbih ?
translation.en: And there were some that had indignation within themselves , and said , Why was this waste of the ointment made ?

translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ba une U Jisu uba na Nasareth un sa pynkyllon ïa Templ ka bad pynkylla ïa ki rukom la kiba wan sha ngi lyngba u Moses !
translation.en: For we have heard him say , that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place , and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us .
Let another man praise thee , and not thine own mouth  ; a stranger , and not thine own lips .
translation.kha: Ai ba kiwei pat ki briew kin ïaroh ïa phi — wat ki nongwei ; ym dei ban leh ïa ka na lade .
Uba hapoh jong u ha ka jingïalam ki ïa shipai u dei u Jehosabad uba long halor ki shi lakh phraphew hajar ngut ki rangbah , kiba la kieng atiar bha na ka bynta thma ka .
translation.en: And next him was Jehozabad , and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war .

translation.kha: Te ha kata kajuh ka miet ïa ka jingmaïan la pynpaw ha u Daniel ha ka ïabna , bad u la ïaroh ïa Baibl Blei ka bneng :
translation.en: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision . Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven .

translation.kha: U Trai Pynpait la ong ha nga .
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,

translation.kha: Phim ïaryngkat bor wat tang bad uba don ha kyrdan hapoh eh jong ki synshar jong ki Assyria , bad pynban phi khmih lynti ki nong Ijipt kin phah ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai !
translation.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?

translation.kha: Lada U Mynsiem jong U uba la pynmihpat ïa U na ka jingïap , u im hapoh jong phi , te uta uba la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap , un ai jingim ruh ki met kynja jong phi ka jingdon U jong u hapoh jong phi
translation.en: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you , he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you .

translation.kha: U Syiem Jeroboam u ong ha u nongïathuhlypa , Sngewbha duwai na ka bynta jong nga ha U Trai Blei jong phi , bad kyrpad ba un pynkhiah ïa ka kti jong nga ! nongïathuhlypa u la duwai ha U Trai bad pynkhiah ïa ka jong syiem .
translation.en: And the king answered and said unto the man of God , Entreat now the face of the  Lord  thy God , and pray for me , that my hand may be restored me again . And the man of God besought the  Lord  , and the king s hand was restored him again , and became as it was before .
And the apostles , when they were returned , told him all that they had done . And he took them , and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la wan phai pat bad ki la ïathuh ha U Jisu ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki la leh . U la ïalam ïa ki bad u , bad ki la ïaleit tang ma ki hi sha ka shnong ba la khot , ka Bethsaida .
U Trai u ki Israel , bad shah ïa u Hasael u ka Syria bad u khun jong u Benhadad ban jop ki Israel na ka sha ka
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel , and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria , and into the hand of Ben–hadad the son of Hazael , all their days .

translation.en: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.en: His breasts are full of milk , and his bones are moistened with marrow .

The  Lord  hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest , that ye should be officers in the house of the  Lord  , for every man that is mad , and maketh himself a prophet , that thou shouldest put him in prison , and in the stocks .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa phi u lyngdoh ha ka jaka jong u Jehoïada , bad mynta phi long u rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka Templ . Ka dei ka kamram jong phi ban khmih ba ïa uwei pa uwei u riewlamwir uba leh mynleh ba u long u nongïathuhlypa dei ban buh ha ki kynjri lem bad u jingdeng ryndang uba da ka nar .

translation.en: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus : for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied .
translation.kha: Nga sngewkmen shaphang ka jingwan u Stephanas , u Phortunatos , bad u Akhaikos ; ki la bujli ïa ka jingbymdon jong phi bad ki la pynsngewbha ïa nga , kumba ki la pynsngewbha ïa phi .

Wat phi haba don shiphew hajar ngut ki nongsumar ha ka jong jingim phi kum ki , bangeit phi don tang uwei u kpa . Naba ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu nga la long u kpa jong phi da kaba wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi .
translation.en: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ , yet have ye not many fathers : for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ha ki la kren ïa kine kiei kiei kin ïap ha kajuh ka rukom . Ïa ki met jong ki yn bret shabar ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem , bad yn ym don mano mano ban tep ki ïa . Kane kan jia ha ki baroh — kynthup ïa ki tnga jong ki ki , khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki Ngan . pynlong ïa ki ban siew na bynta ka jingbymman ka jong ki .
translation.en: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword  ; and they shall have none to bury them , them , their wives , nor their sons , nor their daughters : for I will pour their wickedness upon them .

translation.kha: bad u ong ha u Moses , Shim ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel baroh da bad kaba kohnguh ïa nga , pynïap ïa ki haba shai ka sngi te ngan ym bitar shuh ïa ki . briew
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Take all the heads of the people , and hang them up before the  Lord  against the sun , that the fierce anger of the  Lord  may be turned away from Israel .
To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys , in caves of the earth , and in the rocks .
translation.kha: Ki la dei ban im ha ki krem , ha ki thliew ba la tih ha ki sharing jong ki riat .

translation.en: If a man beget an hundred children , and live many years , so that the days of his years be many , and his soul be not filled with good , and also that he have no burial  ; I say , that an untimely birth is better than he .
translation.kha: Ngi lah ban don shispah ngut ki khun bad ban im slem , hynrei kam pher haduh katno ngi im , lada ngim ïoh ïa la ka bynta jong ka jingsngewkmen bad ïohpdiang ïa ka jingontep kaba donburom , te nga ong ba kham bha u khunlung uba la kha ïap .

translation.en: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place , where the ashes are poured out , and burn him on the wood with fire : where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt .
translation.kha: un rah ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara sha ka jaka lehniam bakhuid ha kaba yn theh ïa u dpei , bad hangta un thang ha ka kynton diengïap .
U la don ïa kot ka kli barit ba la plied ha ka kti jong u . U la buh ïa ka kjat kamon jong u halor ka duriaw bad ïa ka kjat kadiang jong u halor ka khyndew ,
translation.en: And he had in his hand a little book open : and he set his right foot upon the sea , and his left foot on the earth ,
And if the plague come again , and break out in the house , after that he hath taken away the stones , and after he hath scraped the house , and after it is plastered  ;
translation.kha: Lada ka jingbthuh ka paw biang ha kata ka ïing hadien ba la weng noh ïa kita ki maw bad hadien ba la khrud bad la ñiad astor thymmai ruh ïa ka , u lyngdoh un leit khmih bha ïa ka .
Hynrei um shym ong ei ei ha kaba jubab ïa ki jingmudui jong ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki ki tymmen san .
translation.en: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders , he answered nothing .
Yea , I will cause men to walk upon you , even my people Israel  ; and they shall possess thee , and thou shalt be their inheritance , and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men .
translation.kha: Ngan sa wallam pat ïa phi , ki briew jong nga ki Israel ban shong biang ha ka ri . Kan long noh ka ri jong phi bad ki khun jong phi kin ym kyrduh bam .
sa shi bynta na ka lai bynta kin ïeng ap phira ha ka Khyrdop Sur , kiba sah shi bynta ka lai na phi kin ïeng phira ha ka khyrdop ha lyndet kiwei ki nongap .
translation.en: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur  ; and a third part at the gate behind the guard : so shall ye keep the watch of the house , that it be not broken down .
His bones are full of the sin of his youth , which shall lie down with him in the dust .
translation.kha: Ka met jong u ka ju long kaba samla bad kaba khlaiñ , hynrei shen kan sa kylla pui pui .

translation.en: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate : for the hay is withered away , the grass faileth , there is no green thing .
translation.kha: Ka wahduid Nimrim ka rngad , u phlang harud jong ka u la ïapstai , bad ym don kano kano kaba jyrngam kaba dang sah .
Hynrei U Blei u u , Me don hok aïu ban bitar ïa u jingthung ? U Jonah u la jubab , Nga don ka hok ban bitar — ban bitar eh ban ïap !
translation.en: And God said to Jonah , Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd ? And he said , I do well to be angry , even unto death .

translation.kha: U 1943 u Paphos phah katto katne ki rangbah shipai bad shi kynhun ki nongshong kulai bad nga , bad nga leit sha kyrtong Ïuphratis Kaba Shaphang Sepngi . Hangta Rehob rangsamla ïa ki shithi u patsha ha ki lat .
translation.en: Then I came to the governors beyond the river , and gave them the king s letters . Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me .
Son of man , thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house , which have eyes to see , and see not  ; they have ears to hear , and hear not : for they are a rebellious house .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  me im hapdeng ki briew kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah . Ki don ki khmat , hynrei kim ïohi ei ei ; ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim ïohsngew ei ei , namar ki long kiba ïaleh pyrshah .
U shakri u la bah ïa u khynnah sha ka kmie jong u , thum kaba u ïa ha la ka pneh haduh shiteng sngi , ka por ha kaba u la ïap .
translation.en: And when he had taken him , and brought him to his mother , he sat on her knees till noon , and then died .

Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread ? and your labour for that which satisfieth not ? hearken diligently unto me , and eat ye that which is good , and let your soul delight itself in fatness .
translation.kha: Balei ban pynlut pisa ha kaei ka bym ai jinghun ? Balei ban pynlut ïa ka bainong jong phi bad ban dang hap shahthngan hi ? To shahshkor ïa nga bad leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong , bad phin sngewtynnat ïa ka jingbam kaba bang tam na baroh .

translation.en: If my step hath turned out of the way , and mine heart walked after mine eyes , and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands  ;
translation.kha: Lada nga la phai noh na ka lynti kaba dei lane shah ban pynthame ïa lade da kaba sniew , lada ki kti jong nga ki bit da ka pop ,

U “ksuid” bad ki Israel baroh ki ong (Nga Ka jingai jingmut jong u Hushai ka kham bha ban ïa ka jong u Ahithophel . U Gederah u la masi ban pynpulom ïa ka jingai jingmut babha ka jong u Ahithophel , khnang ba ka jingjot kan wan ha ïamareh Absalom .
translation.en: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said , The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel . For the  Lord  had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel , to the intent that the  Lord  might bring evil upon Absalom .

translation.kha: U Trai un aiti phi ki nongshun jong bad un pynkulmar ïa haduh ba kin da shah pynjot thiaw .
translation.en: But the  Lord  thy God shall deliver them unto thee , and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction , until they be destroyed .
And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear , and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign , saith the  Lord  , whose fire is in Zion , and his furnace in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U patsha jong ki un phet ha ka jingsngew shyrkhei , bad ki rangbah shipai kin sheptieng haduh katta katta haduh ba kin iehnoh ïa ki lama thma jong ki .  U  Trai  u la kren — U  Trai  ïa uba la mane ha Jerusalem bad uba ka ding jong u ka thang hangta ïa ki jingkñia .

translation.en: As for the likeness of the living creatures , their appearance was like burning coals of fire , and like the appearance of lamps : it went up and down among the living creatures  ; and the fire was bright , and out of the fire went forth lightning .
translation.kha: Hapdeng kita ki jingthaw don kaei kaei kaba syriem kum ka dongmusa bameh , kaba ïai khih . Ka ding ka klang bad pynmih ki jingthaba leilieh .

translation.en: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule , and her stature was exalted among the thick branches , and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches .
translation.kha: Ki tnat jong u ki long kiba khlaiñ bad ki san ban long u diengsynshar ba kynja syiem . U dieng sohwaiñ u la san jrong eh ban kot ïa ki lyoh ; uwei uwei baroh u la ïohi haduh katno u la long uba rben ki sla bad uba jrong .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians , and went and served Baal , and worshipped him .
translation.kha: Kam shym pat biang ïa u ban leh pop kum u syiem Jeroboam ; u leit kham jngai shuh shuh bad u shongkurim ïa ka Jesebel , ka khun jong u Ethbaal u syiem ka Sidon , bad u la mane ïa u Baal .

translation.en: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth , and honoureth me with their lips  ; but their heart is far from me .
translation.kha: ‘ Kine briew , ong U Blei , ki pyndonburom ïa nga da ki kyntien jong ki , hynrei ka dohnud jong ki , da shisha ka long jngai eh na nga .

translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child , the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Uba khraw tam hapoh ka Hima ki bneng u long uta uba pynrit ïa lade bad uba long kum une u khynnah .
Lada khun u lyngdoh ka ïaid nuti ka pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa ; yn thang ïa ka haduh ba kan da ïap
translation.en: And the daughter of any priest , if she profane herself by playing the whore , she profaneth her father : she shall be burnt with fire .

translation.kha: Kiba duk bad ki bym don jingïarap ki phet sha me bad ki shongshngain ha por ki ka jingjynjar . Me ai jakarieh ïa ki na ki erïong bad ka jakarieh tngen na ka jingshit kyr-ang . Ki riewrunar ki tur kum ïaleh ka tlang erïong ,
translation.en: For thou hast been a strength to the poor , a strength to the needy in his distress , a refuge from the storm , a shadow from the heat , when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pyllait im ïa la ki langbrot bad ngan ym shah ba yn lehbeiñ shuh ïa . ki Ngan bishar ïa kawei pa kawei na ki langbrot jong nga bad pynïakhlad ïa bha kiba na kiba sniew .
translation.en: Therefore will I save my flock , and they shall no more be a prey  ; and I will judge between cattle and cattle .
It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them  ; that they may return every man from his evil way  ; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin .
translation.kha: Lehse haba ki paid Judah kin ïohsngew shaphang baroh ka jingpynjot kaba nga thmu ban wallam halor jong ki , kin phai noh na ki lynti bymman jong ki . Te ngan map ïa ka jingbymman jong ki bad ïa ki pop jong ki .

To jingkulmar ïa kaei “lada ma nga , U Trai , nga ong ! Nga long pyrshah ïa kito mai nongïathuhlypa kiba ïathuh ïa la ki jingphohsniew kiba dap da ki jinglamler . Ki ïathuh ïa kine khroh jingphohsniew bad ïalam bakla Oholah ki briew jong iwjit da ka jinglamler Neng ka jingsngewmeng jong ki . Ngam shym la phah ne hukum ïa Kaisaria im’ shait Krist bad kim shym la long satia ka jingïarap ïa ki briew . Ma Tehsong , U thut , nga la kren jingphyrnai
translation.en: Behold , I am against them that prophesy false dreams , saith the  Lord  , and do tell them , and cause my people to err by their lies , and by their lightness  ; yet I sent them not , nor commanded them : therefore they shall not profit this people at all , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Wat ha ka jingshitom nga jong , la pyntngen ïa nga namar ka jingkular jong me ka ai jingim ïa nga .
translation.en: This is my comfort in my affliction : for thy word hath quickened me .
And Terah lived seventy years , and begat Abram , Nahor , and Haran .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Terah u la dap hynñiewphew snem ka rta , u la long u kpa jong u Abram , u Nahor , bad u Haran .
U Moses u la shim ïa kita ki diengduh pynkhap bad u la pyn-i ïa ki ha bus Israel . prum la ïohi ïa kaba la Shaphang , bad uwei pa Jaka u nongïalam u la shim noh ïa la u jong Pdeng diengduh lad
translation.en: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the  Lord  unto all the children of Israel : and they looked , and took every man his rod .

Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law , but by the faith of Jesus Christ , even we have believed in Jesus Christ , that we might be justified by the faith of Christ , and not by the works of the law : for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified .
translation.kha: Pynban , ngi tip ba ïa u briew la pynksan ha khmat U Blei tang da ka jingngeit ha U Jisu Khrist , ym da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa . Ngi ruh , ngi la ngeit ha U Khrist Jisu khnang ban pynksan ha U Blei da ka jingngeit jong ngi ha U Khrist bad ym da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa . Namar ym don uno uno ruh ïa uba la pynksan ha U Blei da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .

translation.en: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities , in reproaches , in necessities , in persecutions , in distresses for Christ s sake : for when I am weak , then am I strong .
translation.kha: Nga sngewhun ha ki jingtlot , ki jingkrenbeiñ , ki jingjynjar , ki jingshah pynshitom , bad ki jingeh na ka bynta U Khrist . Naba haba nga tlot , dei hangta ba nga khlaiñ .
Ka tdem ka na ki thliew khmut jong u , bad ka ding bam duh bad ki kiba rhem na ka shyntur jong u
translation.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils , and fire out of his mouth devoured : coals were kindled by it .
And Hezekiah prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: Te u la leit sha ka Templ , u buh ïa ka shithi hangta ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  , bad u duwai ,

translation.en: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about : all ye that bend the bow , shoot at her , spare no arrows : for she hath sinned against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko nongsiatkhnam , to ïeng ryntih na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilon bad kerkut ïa ka . To siat ïa ki khnam jong phi baroh ïa ka Babilon , namar ka la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , U  Trai .
Ho-oid , wat ha ki shakri jong nga , baroh shynrang bad kynthei , ngan theh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha ki sngi , bad kin pynbna ka khubor jong nga .
translation.en: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit  ; and they shall prophesy :

translation.kha: Ko khun ki ba-ieit jong nga ! Sa shisien , kum ka kmie kaba suh kha , nga sngew ïa kajuh ka jait jingsuh na ka bynta jong tad haduh phi ka jinglong U Khrist kan da thawdur ha phi .
translation.en: My little children , of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you ,
And they said unto her , Surely we will return with thee unto thy people .
translation.kha: Em ! Ngin leit bad phi sha ki briew jong phi .

translation.en: Gracious is the  Lord  , and righteous  ; yea , our God is merciful .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba bha ; U Blei jong ngi u long uba sngewlem .

translation.en: Whereas thou camest but yesterday , should I this day make thee go up and down with us ? seeing I go whither I may , return thou , and take back thy brethren : mercy and truth be with thee .
translation.kha: Phi la sah hangne tang khyndiat por , kumta balei ngan pynlong ïa phi ban ïaid sakma kylleng bad nga ? Ngam tip shano ngan leit . Khie leit phai noh bad ïalam bad phi ïa la ki jong ki briew — bad to U  Trai  un lehsbun bad ïaineh bad phi .

bad u la kren biang ha u haba u Jehoïakim per khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem . Hadien kata , jingïakren Trai u jingñiewbeiñ kren ha u bun bunsien , tad haduh pynmeng snem Abishua khatwei jong ka jingsynshar u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Josaïah Abida Ha u bnai uba san jong kata ka Lur , ïa ki briew jong ka phylla la ringmraw noh Syros
translation.en: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month .

translation.kha: Thoh rngad u angel jong ka balang shrieh Laodikaïa : Jingsngewbha saisiej long ka khubor na U Amen , uba ïaineh bad u Susah bashisha , uba long u jingsdang jong baroh kaba U Blei u la thaw .
translation.en: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write  ; These things saith the Amen , the faithful and true witness , the beginning of the creation of God  ;

And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne , as the appearance of a sapphire stone : and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it .
translation.kha: Halor ka tnum ka don kaei kaei kaba i kum ka khet ; ba la shna da u mawkordor Sapphir ; bad don bashong halor kata ka khet ba i kum u briew .
Ha ka rukom , pynkyntang ïa ka bad ïa ka jingpynshong jong ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot , and sanctify it .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ban tynjuh ïa ki Israel , ban lap kin kohnguh ne em ïa ki hukum ba U Trai u la ai ha kpa tymmen jong ki da u Moses .
translation.en: And they were to prove Israel by them , to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the  Lord  , which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha , Phim shuh kiba kham nep jingmut ïa pat .
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Are ye also yet without understanding ?

translation.kha: Ka Kut pyndonkam briew kam lah ban jop ïa ka mawkordor bahok jong U Blei .
translation.en: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God .
And , behold , there was lifted up a talent of lead : and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah .
translation.kha: Ka shang ka la don ka jingtap ba la shna da ka sisa . Katba nga dang khmih , la plied ïa ka jingtap , bad hangta hapoh ka shang la shong ka kynthei !

Phim tip da lei lei lano ka por jong phi ka wan . Kum ki sim kiba la kynsan ha ki jingriam , kum ki dohkha kiba la ngat ha ka jar , ngi la shah riam ha ki khep basniew ngim khmih lynti satia ïa kata .
translation.en: For man also knoweth not his time : as the fishes that are taken in an evil net , and as the birds that are caught in the snare  ; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time , when it falleth suddenly upon them .

translation.kha: Nga thoh ha phi ïa kane ka shithi kaba lyngkot da ka jingïarap u Silas , ïa uba nga ñiew Mahli u para Khristan baïaineh . Gilboa kwah ban pynshlur jingskhem phi bad ban nongïatainia ïa ka jingphla jong nga ba kane ka dei ka jingaiei bashisha jong U ïohrung . To ïeng Thymmai ha Dei .
translation.en: By Silvanus , a faithful brother unto you , as I suppose , I have written briefly , exhorting , and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand .
I also could speak as ye do : if your soul were in my soul s stead , I could heap up words against you , and shake mine head at you .
translation.kha: Lada phi don ha ka jaka jong nga bad ma nga ha ka jaka jong phi , ngan lah ban ong ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phi ong . Nga lah ban pynkhih ïa ka khlieh jong nga ha ka jingsian bad ngan pynïap jyllop ïa phi ha ka jingshlei jong ki ktien .

translation.en: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them , I will liken him unto a wise man , which built his house upon a rock :
translation.kha: Kumta te , uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien jong nga bad uba kohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba stad uba la tei ïa la ka ïing halor u mawsiang .
Uwei Kpa uwei un Jehasiel hapdeng ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Arbad la ki Addi hi , ine-ine yn ïalum Uri mano mano ban pynsheptieng ïa u . U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la kular ïa kane .
translation.en: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree  ; and none shall make them afraid : for the mouth of the  Lord  of hosts hath spoken it .
And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake , for a testimony against them and the Gentiles .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong nga phin shah tian bishar ha khmat ki nongsynshar bad ki syiem , ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha ha ki bad ha ki Jentil .
Ki Pynkyntang baroh ki la pyrta , Pynïap ïa u ! kah ïa u Barabbas Harim ngi !
translation.en: And they cried out all at once , saying , Away with this man , and release unto us Barabbas :

And he said , I have been very zealous for the  Lord  God of hosts : because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant , thrown down thine altars , and slain thy prophets with the sword  ; and I , even I only , am left  ; and they seek my life , to take it away .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  A  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh , nga la shakri borabor ïa me — tang ïa me hi . Hynrei ki paid Israel ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad me , ki la pynpra ïa ki duwan jong me bad pynïap ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong me . Dei tang ma nga uba dang sah — bad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ruh !

translation.en: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations , and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did , which were before him , and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols :
translation.kha: U syiem Manasseh u la leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba ijli , kiei kiei kiba kham sniew ban ïa kaei kaba ki nong Kanaan ki la leh , bad ryngkat bad ki bleithaw jong u , u la ïalam ïa ki briew jong ka Judah ban leh pop .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations , and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue :
translation.kha: ban ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Shna ki ksai jyrthiaw ha ki dong jaiñkup jong phi bad buh ïa u ksai uba jngum ha uwei uwei u jyrthiaw . Phi dei ban leh ïa kane shi lynter .
Ka jingpynkut bad jingkhublei ki shimet
translation.en: Be it known therefore unto you , that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles , and that they will hear it .

translation.kha: Nga thoh sha phi , , namarkata ym ba namar phim tip ïa ka jingshisha ; pynban , ka namar long ba phi da tip ïa ka , bad phi tip ruh ym don ka lamler kaba ju mihnoh na ka jingshisha .
translation.en: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth , but because ye know it , and that no lie is of the truth .
How long shall they utter and speak hard things ? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves ?
translation.kha: Slem haduh katno ki riewrunar kin leh sarong bad kob shaphang ki kam runar jong ki ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ka long namar ba U  Trai  u ieit ïa phi bad u bat ïa la ka kular kaba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , bad namar kata u la ïalam noh ïa phi da ka borbah jong u bad u la pyllait na ka jinglongmraw ïa phi na u Pharaoh u syiem ka Ijipt .

jingïapthngan sumar ïa u ha ïing haduh Geliloth bnai shun bad haba la buh ïa u shabar na ka ïing jong u nongpynjot ka khun jong u syiem ka la Tekoa khun ïa u bad ka la pynheh pynsan wahbah bashathie kum la u jong u sngewrit .
translation.en: And when he was cast out , Pharaoh s daughter took him up , and nourished him for her own son .
Are all religions pleasing to God , or is just one ?
translation.kha: Hato baroh ki niam ki pynsngewbha ïa U Blei , ne tang kawei ?

translation.en: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame , and thine infamy turn not away .
translation.kha: Lym kumta baroh kin tip ba phi long u bym lah ban set ïa kiei kiei kiba rieh bad phin ym lah ban lait na kane ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: So he arose and went to Zarephath . And when he came to the gate of the city , behold , the widow woman was there gathering of sticks : and he called to her , and said , Fetch me , I pray thee , a little water in a vessel , that I may drink .
translation.kha: Kumta u Elijah u la leit sha Sarephath . Ynda u poi ha khyrdop shnong , u la ïohi ïa kawei ka riewkynthei kaba tam diengïap . U khot ïa ka , bad u ong ,  Sngewbha ai ha nga ka um ban dih .
Ki ki wallam ha lade ka jingjynjar ïa kaba pyrshang pynjia ha briew kiba bha .
translation.en: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous , and the transgressor for the upright .
If there be a controversy between men , and they come unto judgment , that the judges may judge them  ; then they shall justify the righteous , and condemn the wicked .
translation.kha: Lada ar ngut ki Israel ki ïakajia , bad ki leit sha ka ïingbishar , ki nongbishar kin rai pynksan ïa uba hok bad pynrem ïa uba leh palat .

translation.en: And unto man he said , Behold , the fear of the Lord , that is wisdom  ; and to depart from evil is understanding .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ïa ki briew ,  Ban long uba stad , phi dei ban don ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai . Ban shemphang , phi dei ban phai noh na kaba sniew .

translation.en: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people , saying ,

translation.en: If a woman also vow a vow unto the  Lord  , and bind herself by a bond , being in her father s house in her youth  ;

translation.en: And , behold , seven other kine came up after them , poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed , such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness :

translation.en: And when the sun was going down , a deep sleep fell upon Abram  ; and , lo , an horror of great darkness fell upon him .
Even that it would please God to destroy me  ; that he would let loose his hand , and cut me off !
translation.kha: Lada u tang shu mon bad pynïap ïa nga !
U Simon u la ong ha u bad u Ïoannis , Sngewbha duwai ha U Trai na ka bynta jong nga , khnang ba kawei ruh na kiei kiei kiba phi kren kan ym jia ha nga .
translation.en: Then answered Simon , and said , Pray ye to the Lord for me , that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me .

translation.kha: lah ban long yn don uno uno u ym kohnguh ïa ka khubor kaba sha phi ha kane shithi . Lada ka long kumta , u bad wat ïadon bynta ei ei bad u , khnang ba lehrain .
translation.en: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle , note that man , and have no company with him , that he may be ashamed .

translation.kha: Ym da donkam myntri thoh sha phi shaphang ka jingïa-ieit ïa ki parabangeit jong phi . Ma phi Badonbor phi long kiba la ïoh hikai na U Blei kumno phi dei ban ieit sha ïa iwei jingiwtung .
translation.en: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you : for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another .

translation.en: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof , and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it  ; that he may return unto his possession .
In the fifth day of the month , which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin s captivity ,
translation.kha: ( Ka la long ka snem kaba san naduh ba la ringmraw ïa u syiem Jehoïakhin . )

translation.en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father .
translation.kha: Phi baroh ar ngut phi tip ba nga la trei na ka bynta i pa jong phi katba kot la ka bor .
Kumta u Joab bad u Abishai u para jong u ki la pynhiarkput ïa u Abner namar ka jingpynïap kliang Pedaïah Asahel u hynmen u para donbok ki ha ka Uriah ha Gibeon .
translation.en: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner , because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle .

translation.kha: Haba ki u kti Moses ki la sakhrai , u Aaron bad u Hur ki rah uwei u maw ba un shong , katba ma ki pat ki ïeng syndah ha jong u , uwei sha kadiang bad uwei pat sha kamon , bad ki kyrshan ïa ki kti jong u , ki da kyrshan skhem ïa ki kumta haduh ban da sep ka sngi .
translation.en: But Moses  hands were heavy  ; and they took a stone , and put it under him , and he sat thereon  ; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands , the one on the one side , and the other on the other side  ; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun .

And the three hundred blew the trumpets , and the  Lord  set every man s sword against his fellow , even throughout all the host : and the host fled to Beth–shittah in Zererath , and to the border of Abel–meholah , unto Tabbath .
translation.kha: Katba ki rangbah jong u Gideon ki dang put ïa la ki turoi , U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ki kynhun shipai jong ki nongshun ban tur ïaleh para ma ki da la ki waitlam . Ki la mareh sha Sarethan haduh Beth Shittah , haduh ka nongrit jong ka Abel Meholah hajan ka Tabbath .

translation.en: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house , and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria .

translation.en: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered , from twenty years old and above , shall give an offering unto the  Lord .

translation.en: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen , neither shall the beast of the land devour them  ; but they shall dwell safely , and none shall make them afraid .

translation.en: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance , he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor .

translation.kha: To nang ïaid , bad pyndep ïa kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi la sdang !
translation.en: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers .
What shall we say then that Abraham our father , as pertaining to the flesh , hath found ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngin ïa-ong te , ba u Abraham u kpa , jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi , Kaei ka jingshem jong u ?

translation.en: He answered and said , Lo , I see four men loose , walking in the midst of the fire , and they have no hurt  ; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God .

translation.kha: Bad nangta kin wan sha ka bad kin lait na ka jingriam u Ksuid , uba la pynngat ïa ïa ki ïa ka jong u .
translation.en: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil , who are taken captive by him at his will .

translation.en: Moreover he provided him cities , and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance : for God had given him substance very much .

translation.kha: Men rah baroh ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba me la lum na baroh kawei ka probins Babilon bad ki jingainguh kiba ki Israel bad ki lyngdoh jong ki ai bynta ka Templ jong U Blei jong ki ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon , with the freewill offering of the people , and of the priests , offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem :

translation.en: And when they heard it , they glorified the Lord , and said unto him , Thou seest , brother , how many thousands of Jews there are which believe  ; and they are all zealous of the law :

translation.kha: ryngkat bad ki mraw baroh jong u Abraham .
translation.en: And all the men of his house , born in the house , and bought with money of the stranger , were circumcised with him .

translation.kha: Jehosadak rangbah kiba ap ïa ki sniang ki la phet noh bad ki la thnum shapoh Jehosadak shnong , ha kaba ki la ïathuh ïa ka jingjia baroh ïamihnoh bad ïa kaei kaba la Em! ha Samsummim rangbah kiba shongksuid .
translation.en: And they that kept them fled , and went their ways into the city , and told every thing , and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils .

translation.kha: Hadien kane u Paul u mihnoh na Athens u la leit sha .
translation.en: After these things Paul departed from Athens , and came to Corinth  ;
God thundereth marvellously with his voice  ; great things doeth he , which we cannot comprehend .
