pynmih riewshlur bakhraw tam bad kito kiba ïaleh na ka liang ka Ijipt Hadoram ki pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nong Ijipt sha phla pyrthei Jingot ïap . Ki ïa-pyrta : Eliashib bymriewblei Pynshlur la shah pynïap Khubor mandriek thma ki la suki hiar shane bad hangne ki thiah !

That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart .

translation.en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity , and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty .
I will also save you from all your uncleannesses : and I will call for the corn , and will increase it , and lay no famine upon you .
translation.kha: Ngan pyllait ïa phi na kata baroh kaba pyntngit ïa phi . Ngan hukum ïa u kew ba un bun kyrhai , khnang ba phin ym mad shuh ïa ki jingïapthngan .
Ki im ka jingim ha bad suk khlem ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: They spend their days in wealth , and in a moment go down to the grave .
He scorneth the multitude of the city , neither regardeth he the crying of the driver .
translation.kha: Ki shong jngai bah na ki nongbah kiba khynwin ; bad ym don ba lah ban pynjuh bad pyntreikam ïa ki .
Tang shipor jingkynha la iehnoh madan pha ; da ka Haggan kaba jylliew ngan shim pat ïa tupia .
translation.en: For a small moment have I forsaken thee  ; but with great mercies will I gather thee .

In his days did Hiel the Beth–elite build Jericho : he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn , and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u , u Hiel uba na Bethel u tei pat ïa ka Jerikho . translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye devour widows  houses , and for a pretence make long prayer : therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation .

translation.en: Now concerning Moses the man of God , his sons were named of the tribe of Levi .

And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle , as if it were of a garden : he hath destroyed his places of the assembly : the  Lord  hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion , and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest .
translation.kha: Ka burom ba-itynnat tam jong ka Jerusalem ka long ka bynta jong ka mynnor . Ki nongïalam jong ka ki long kum ki skei kiba tlot na ka jingthngan , kaba ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki , ka la jan duh noh katba ki phet na ki nongbeh mrad .

U Trai u ong ha u Joshua , Ïalam lang bad me ïa laispah Dong baroh bad leit kiew sha Ai . lieh sheptieng lane khaw-eit pyndep Arah ai ha me ka jingjop shakor u syiem ka Ai ; ki briew jong u , ka nongbah jong u , bad ka ri kan long ka jong me .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Fear not , neither be thou dismayed : take all the people of war with thee , and arise , go up to Ai : see , I have given into thy hand the king of Ai , and his people , and his city , and his land :

translation.kha: Wat ïathiah bad ka haba ka dang poi bnai , namar long ka bymkhuid .
translation.en: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness , as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness .

translation.en: But Jonathan Saul s son delighted much in David : and Jonathan told David , saying , Saul my father seeketh to kill thee : now therefore , I pray thee , take heed to thyself until the morning , and abide in a secret place , and hide thyself :

translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha nongbah Teman bad , kan thang duh ïa ki kut ka Bosrah .
translation.en: But I will send a fire upon Teman , which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah .
Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter , Art not thou also one of this man s disciples ? He saith , I am not .

translation.en: And the children of Dan set up the graven image : and Jonathan , the son of Gershom , the son of Manasseh , he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Dan ki pynïeng ïa ka bleithaw ïa ka ban mane , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Gershom bad u khun ksiew jong u Moses , ki shakri kum ki lyngdoh ïa ka jait Dan , bad ki shakri kiba hiarpateng kum ki lyngdoh haduh ka jingshah ringmraw ki briew na kata ka ri .

translation.en: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart , to keep thy commandments , thy testimonies , and thy statutes , and to do all these things , and to build the palace , for the which I have made provision .

translation.en: As concerning the gospel , they are enemies for your sakes : but as touching the election , they are beloved for the fathers  sakes .

translation.kha: Ki jingkyrmen jong ki briew kiba bha ki lam sha ka jingkmen , hynrei ka jingkhmih lynti ki riewbymman kam lam shano shano .

Wat ju ong , kynshuit ! balei mo kiei Bashngain ki kham bha shibun ha ki sngi mynbarim ? Kam long Me Sis kaba shemphang pynshongkurim
translation.en: Say not thou , What is the cause that the former days were better than these ? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this .

translation.en: I wish you'd quit throwing things at me .

translation.en: And it was told Tamar , saying , Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep .

translation.en: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves , he said unto them ,  Why reason ye these things in your hearts ?

translation.en: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun , who rideth upon the heaven in thy help , and in his excellency on the sky .

translation.en: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment , and the worm shall eat them like wool : but my righteousness shall be for ever , and my salvation from generation to generation .

translation.en: And God saw their works , that they turned from their evil way  ; and God repented of the evil , that he had said that he would do unto them  ; and he did it not .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ; u la ïohi ba ki la iehnoh ïa ka jingleh bymman jong ki . Kumta u la kylla jingmut bad um shym la pynshitom ïa ki kumba u la ong ban leh .
Ki khyrdop ka nongbah kin ïambriew bad kin bad ka nongbah kan long kum ka kynthei kaba shong ha madan kaba shah sloit lyngkhuit .
translation.en: And her gates shall lament and mourn  ; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground .
In every thing give thanks : for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you .
translation.kha: to long kiba sngewnguh ha kiei kiei baroh . Kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u kwah na phi ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And she said , These six measures of barley gave he me  ; for he said to me , Go not empty unto thy mother in law .
translation.kha: Ka bynrap ,  U ong ïa nga ba ngam dei ban wan phai thylli sha phi , kumta u ai ïa nga ïa une u barli baroh .

translation.en: And the fifth angel sounded , and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth : and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba san u la put ïa ka turoi . Nga la ïohi ïa u khlur uba la hap sha ka khyndew , bad la ai ha u ïa u shabi jong ka liewlong ba khlem trai .

translation.en: But whereunto shall I liken this generation ? It is like unto children sitting in the markets , and calling unto their fellows ,
translation.kha: Mynta , bad kaei nga lah ban nujor ïa ki briew jong kane ka por ? Ki long kum ki khynnah kiba ïashong ha ki jaka ïew . Kawei ka kynhun ka pyrta ïa kawei pat ,

translation.en: Though he spare it , and forsake it not  ; but keep it still within his mouth :
translation.kha: U bang bha ban leh ïa ka jingsniew bad u buh katto katne ha ka shyntur jong u ban sngewtynnat ïa ka jingbang jong ka .
Wat jutang ïateh bad ki briew jong ka kata ri sha kaba phi leit , namar kata ka lah ban long ka jingriam ka ban pynïap ïa phi .

And that prophet , or that dreamer of dreams , shall be put to death  ; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt , and redeemed you out of the house of bondage , to thrust thee out of the way which the  Lord  thy God commanded thee to walk in . So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei pynïap ïa uno uno u nongïathuhlypa lane uno uno u nongbatai ïa ki jingphohsniew uba ong ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw . Ïa une dei ban pynïap , khnang ba phin lah ban pyllait ïa lade na kane ka jingbymman .

translation.en: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel , and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan , with every man his censer in his hand  ; and a thick cloud of incense went up .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Ye will surely say unto me this proverb , Physician , heal thyself : whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum , do also here in thy country .
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Nga thikna ba phin sot ïa kane ka proberb ha nga , ‘ Ko nongpynkhiah , to pynkhiah ïa lade .’ Phin ong ruh ïa nga ban leh hangne ha la ka shnong ïa kijuh kiei kiei kiba phi la ïohsngew ïa kiba la leh ha Kapernam .

Lada u u briew leh pop pyrshah ïa la parabriew u , U Blei u lah ban ïasaid na ka bynta jong u hynrei ; mano lah ba ban ïasaid na ka bynta u briew uba leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai ? Hynrei kim shym sngap ïa la u kpa , naba U Trai u la thmu ban pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: If one man sin against another , the judge shall judge him : but if a man sin against the  Lord  , who shall entreat for him ? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father , because the  Lord  would slay them .

But the  Lord  is with me as a mighty terrible one : therefore my persecutors shall stumble , and they shall not prevail : they shall be greatly ashamed  ; for they shall not prosper : their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me long ha ka liang jong nga , uba khlaiñ bad bakhrawbor , bad kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga kin ym jop , kin shah pynlehrain junom , namar kim lah ban jop . Ïa ka jingjahburom jong ki yn ym klet noh da lei lei .
Lada ryntih pyrthei ka shun ïa phi , to kynmaw ba ka Tanhumeth shun ïa nga nyngkong batbit
translation.en: If the world hate you , ye know that it hated me before it hated you .

translation.kha: Nga , long kata jingkhang . Uno uno uba rung da un ïoh im ; shapoh bad mih shabar bad ïa ka jaka bam phlang .
translation.en: I am the door : by me if any man enter in , he shall be saved , and shall go in and out , and find pasture .

All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem : and it shall be lifted up , and inhabited in her place , from Benjamin s gate unto the place of the first gate , unto the corner gate , and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king s winepresses .
translation.kha: Ïa ka thain baroh kawei naduh Geba ha ka phang bashatei bad shaduh Rimmon ha ka phang bashathie , yn pynmadan . Ka Jerusalem kan ïeng halor ka ri sawdong jong ka ; ka nongbah kan kot naduh ka Khyrdop Benjamin shaduh ka Khyrdop Kyndong , ha kaba la ju don ka khyrdop ba-mynshuwa , bad na u Mot Hananel sha ki jaka khñiot waiñ jong u syiem .

translation.en: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah  ; and he reigned a full month in Samaria .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah , u Shallum u khun jong u Jabesh u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar shi bnai ha Samaria .

translation.en: Do you want to come sit by me ?
translation.kha: Phi kwah ban wan shong bad nga ?

Kedar u ong ha ki nongap kiba ïeng hajan jong u jingpyndem Merab ïa ki lyngdoh jong Busi Trai ! translation.en: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him , Turn , and slay the priests of the  Lord   ; because their hand also is with David , and because they knew when he fled , and did not shew it to me . But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the  Lord .
The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus , when thou comest , bring with thee , and the books , but especially the parchments .
translation.kha: Haba me wan , to wanrah ïa ka jaiñkup ba nga la iehnoh ha Troas bad u Karpos ; wanrah ruh ïa ki kot , bad khamtam ïa ki kot ba la sop snieh .

translation.en: Will he make many supplications unto thee ? will he speak soft words unto thee ?

translation.en: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet , Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates .
translation.kha: Kata ka sur ka la ong ha uta u angel uba hynriew ,  To pyllait noh ïa ki saw ngut ki angel kiba la shah khum ha ka wahbah Ïuphratis !

translation.en: Who hath declared from the beginning , that we may know ? and beforetime , that we may say , He is righteous ? yea , there is none that sheweth , yea , there is none that declareth , yea , there is none that heareth your words .
translation.kha: Uno na phi uba la ïathuhlypa ba kane kan jia , khnang ba ngin lah ban ong ba phi long uba dei ? Ym don na phi uba la ong wat shikyntien shaphang jong ka ; ym don uba la ïohsngew ïa phi ba phi ong ïa kata .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen , saying , Take fire from between the wheels , from between the cherubims  ; then he went in , and stood beside the wheels .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u hukum ïa uta u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen ban shim ïa ka ding napdeng ki shalyntem kiba don hapoh ki kherub , uta u briew u rung shapoh bad u ïeng hajan kawei na ki shalyntem .
Nangta nga la ïohi ïa u angel uba ha sngi U la da ka sur kaba jam ïa ki sim baroh kiba ha shiteng suiñ : Ale bad ïalumlang na ka bynta ka jingkhawai kaba jong U Blei !
translation.en: And I saw an angel standing in the sun  ; and he cried with a loud voice , saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven , Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God  ;
Woe to them that are at ease in Zion , and trust in the mountain of Samaria , which are named chief of the nations , to whom the house of Israel came !
translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba shongsuk ha Seïon , bad ïa phi kiba sngewshngain ha Samaria — phi ki briew kiba khraw jong kane ka jaitbynriew Israel kaba khraw , phi sha kaba ki briew ki ju leit ban ïoh jingïarap !
Ki jingbthei mihnoh na Sebedi u briew bad ki la rung shapoh ki sniang . Ka kynhun ki sniang baroh ka la noh Ben-ammi riat shapoh ka duriaw bad ki Nepheg ïap war .
translation.en: Then went the devils out of the man , and entered into the swine : and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake , and were choked .

Have I conceived all this people ? have I begotten them , that thou shouldest say unto me , Carry them in thy bosom , as a nursing father beareth the sucking child , unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers ?
translation.kha: Ngam shym thaw ïa ki lymne pynkha ïa ki ! Balei ba me ong ïa nga ba ngan long nongri khun bad rah ïa ki kum ïa ki khunlung shi lynter lynti shaduh ka ri kaba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ?

translation.en: Then the spirit entered into me , and set me upon my feet , and spake with me , and said unto me , Go , shut thyself within thine house .
Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt  ; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies  ; but provoked him at the sea , even at the Red sea .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ha Ijipt kim shym la sngewthuh ïa ki kam baphylla jong U Blei ; ki la klet ba bunsien u la pyn-i ha ki ïa ka jingieit jong u , bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Badonbor Baroh ha ka Duriaw Basaw .

translation.kha: Kumta u Haman u ïa ong u syiem . Nalor kata kim kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong ka hima , kumta kan ym long kaba bha ïa phi ban shah ïa ki .
translation.en: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus , There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom  ; and their laws are diverse from all people  ; neither keep they the king s laws : therefore it is not for the king s profit to suffer them .
And he sought to see Jesus who he was  ; and could not for the press , because he was little of stature .
translation.kha: U la pyrshang ban ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u long uba kumno , hynrei u long u briew uba rit bad um lah ban ïohi ïa U Jisu namar ki paidbah .
U Joseph lapsan dem kynsan ha ka Jaban u kpa , pla da ïam , bad doh ïa Blei! .

translation.kha: ha kaba ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan ki shong mynta ha ki them jong ka . Phai noh lashai ka sngi leit bad sha kata ka ri khlaw ha ki phang jong ka khmut Akaba duriaw .

And when his servants told David these words , it pleased David well to be the king s son in law : and the days were not expired .

Ko ki ba-ieit jong nga , to wat sngewphylla ïa jingtynjuh ba-eh kaba phi , kumba kiei kiei kiba wan jia ha phi .
translation.en: Beloved , think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you , as though some strange thing happened unto you :
And all Judah rejoiced at the oath : for they had sworn with all their heart , and sought him with their whole desire  ; and he was found of them : and the  Lord  gave them rest round about .
translation.kha: Baroh ki paid ka Judah ki la kmen namar ki la pynlong ïa kane ka jutang da ka dohnud baroh . Ki shem sngewbha ha ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  , bad u pdiang ïa ki bad u ai ha ki ka jingsuk na ki liang baroh .
Ïa u sdie la pynkhreh ban khet tan ki dieng na tyngkai thied ; ïa uwei pa uwei u dieng u bym sei ki soh babha yn khet noh bad Dalmanutha ha ka ding .
translation.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees : therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .
This is my commandment , That ye love one another , as I have loved you .
translation.kha: Ka hukum jong nga ka long kane : To ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba nga ieit ïa phi .

translation.en: You will not see any images , crucifixes , or things like these at the Kingdom Hall .
translation.kha: Phin ym ïohi ïa ki dur , ki diengphna , lane kum kine kiei kiei hapoh ka Kingdom Hall .
U briew uba ïoh pisa da ka jingbymhok u long kum ka sim kaba khun pylleng kiba ka kha Ha ka ba la ih bha un ïa ka spah jong u , bad ha kaba um long ei ei hynrei u bieit .
translation.en: As the partridge sitteth on eggs , and hatcheth them not  ; so he that getteth riches , and not by right , shall leave them in the midst of his days , and at his end shall be a fool .

And in every province , and in every city , whithersoever the king s commandment and his decree came , the Jews had joy and gladness , a feast and a good day . And many of the people of the land became Jews  ; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah bad probins , hangno hangno ba la pule ïa ka jingpynbna u syiem , ki Jiw ki pynlong ki shuti lehkmen ryngkat bad ki jingkhawai sngewbha bad jingkmen . Ha ka jingshisha , bun kiwei ki briew ki la kylla Jiw , namar mynta ki la sheptieng ïa ki .
Hynrei kim shym iehnoh la ïa ki pop sha kiba u syiem Jeroboam u la ïa ïalam ki Israel , hynrei ki ïai leh ïa ki ; bad ka durblei Asherah ka dang ïaisah ha Samaria .
translation.en: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam , who made Israel sin , but walked therein : and there remained the grove also in Samaria . )
Jesus heard that they had cast him out  ; and when he had found him , he said unto him ,  Dost thou believe on the Son of God ?
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la shem ïa uta u briew bad u la kylli ïa u ,  Hato me ngeit ha U Khun U Briew ?
Phi Moses syndon ïa ki briew jong nga . Phi puid noh ïa ka sniehdoh jong ki , pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong ki , bad shaiñ ïa ki kum ïa ka alabastar ha u khiew .
translation.en: Who also eat the flesh of my people , and flay their skin from off them  ; and they break their bones , and chop them in pieces , as for the pot , and as flesh within the caldron .
And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation :
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh un rah khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ,
Uei te uba lamler U ? dei uno uba uno ong ba U Jisu um dei U Messaïah . Kum uta u briew , u long u Nongshun jong U Khrist — u kyntait ïa U bad Kpa ïa U Khun ruh .
translation.en: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ ? He is antichrist , that denieth the Father and the Son .

translation.kha: Hynrei bun na uta u paidbah la ha u ong , Haba U Messaïah wan , hato un leh kham bun ki kambah ban ïa kaba une u u la leh ?
translation.en: And many of the people believed on him , and said , When Christ cometh , will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done ?

translation.kha: Katba dang pule jam ïa ka Hukum u Moses ha u paidbah , ki poi ha ka bynta kaba ong ba ym dei ban shah ïa u Amon ne u nong Moab ban ïasnohlang bad ki briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people  ; and therein was found written , that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever  ;

translation.kha: A katno me long bha uba — uba bha sbun ! To hikai ïa nga ïa ki hukum jong me .
translation.en: Thou art good , and doest good  ; teach me thy statutes .

translation.kha: khnang ba phi lah ban long khun ki jong U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng . Namar u pynlong ïa ka sngi kaba u thaw la ban ha tyngshaiñ ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba bha kumjuh , bad u ai slap ha kito kiba leh ïa bha kaba bad ha kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew .
translation.en: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven : for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good , and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust .

translation.kha: Nga tip haduh katno phi long kiba mutlop bad kiba ïaleh pyrshah . la Phi ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai mynba nga dang im , bad ynda nga la ïap lei lei phin , nang kham pyrshah ïaleh ïa u .
translation.en: For I know thy rebellion , and thy stiff neck : behold , while I am yet alive with you this day , ye have been rebellious against the  Lord   ; and how much more after my death ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha ki briew jong , u Ki jingmong jong phi ki long ki bym lah koit ban , ïa ki jingmynsaw jong phi ym lah ban pynkhiah .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Thy bruise is incurable , and thy wound is grievous .
Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men , as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit ;
translation.kha: Ha ki por ba-mynshuwa ïa u khunbynriew ym shym la ïathuh ïa kane ka jingmaïan , hynrei , U Blei u la pynpaw ïa ka mynta da U Mynsiem ha ki apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid jong u .
U dang duwai bad ha ka jingïohipaw u la ïohi ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Ananias ba u wan rung bad buh ïa la kti ki ha , u khnang ba un ïoh imat pat .
translation.en: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in , and putting his hand on him , that he might receive his sight .

translation.kha: bad ynda phi poi sha ka Jordan , pynïeng ïa kita ki maw ha u lum Ebal , kumba nga la hukum ïa phi mynta ka sngi , ñiad astor ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan , that ye shall set up these stones , which I command you this day , in mount Ebal , and thou shalt plaster them with plaster .
For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity , according to the number of the days , three hundred and ninety days : so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta thiah pyrshing ha ka krung kadiang , bad ngan pynkit ha me ïa ki kam bymman ka jaitbynriew Israel . Kumba laispah khyndaiphew sngi men sah hangta bad shahshitom namar ki kam bymman jong ki . Nga la pynshitom ïa me shi sngi na ka bynta kawei kawei ka snem haduh ba ka jingpynshitom jong ki kan kut noh .
Ki briew Jahas ong ha nga , Hangno kito ki Jeremaïah arliang U Trai u Pynkyrteng pynlong pyrshah ïa Kut ïa-ïeng To ai ba un pyndep ïa ki mynta !
translation.en: Behold , they say unto me , Where is the word of the  Lord  ? let it come now .

translation.kha: kiba la pynïap ïa U Trai Jisu bad ïa smai markhongpong , bad ki la pynshitom beiñ ïa ngi . A kumno ki la long ki bym pynsngewbha Maon U Blei! A kumno ki jingpynrem Ulla kiba Hanokh iwei ïa brup
translation.en: Who both killed the Lord Jesus , and their own prophets , and have persecuted us ; and they please not God , and are contrary to all men :

translation.kha: Naba lada la buhrieh ïa ka gospel kaba ngi ïalap , la buhrieh ïa ka tang kito na kiba la jah noh .
translation.en: But if our gospel be hid , it is hid to them that are lost :

translation.kha: Ka ïing jong u briew bha uba kan dang ïeng hi hadien ba la pynjot ïa ka ïing jong u nongleh ïa kaba sniew .
translation.en: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown : but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish .

translation.kha: , Pynban ki Lebi kin ym ïoh kano kano ka bynta jong ka ri bad lem phi , namar bynta ka ki jong ka ban long shakri kum ki lyngdoh jong U Trai . Bad da , shisha ki jait Gad , Reuben , Manasseh ba sha Mihngi te ki la lah ïohpdiang ïa la ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan , ïa kaba u Moses u shakri jong U Trai u la ai ha ki .
translation.en: But the Levites have no part among you  ; for the priesthood of the  Lord  is their inheritance : and Gad , and Reuben , and half the tribe of Manasseh , have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east , which Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave them .
With clouds he covereth the light  ; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt .
translation.kha: U kem ïa ka leilieh da la ki kti bad u hukum ïa ka ban tied ïa kaba thmu .

translation.en: Wherefore they came again , and told him . And he said , This is the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite , saying , In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel :

translation.en: And whatsoever ye do , do it heartily , as to the Lord , and not unto men ;
translation.kha: Ïa kaei kaei kaba phi leh , trei ïa ka naduh mynsiem , kumba phi trei na ka bynta U Trai bad ym na ka bynta ki briew .

translation.en: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down , and the glory of the  Lord  upon the house , they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement , and worshipped , and praised the  Lord  , saying , For he is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Haba ki paid Israel ki ïohi ïa ka ding ba ka wan hiar na bneng bad ba ka jingshai ka dap ha ka Templ , ki dem khrup ha lynti ba la siang maw , ki da mane ïa U Blei bad ïaroh ïa U namar ka jingbha bad ka jingieit bymjukut jong u .

translation.en: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury  ; and I , even I , will chastise you seven times for your sins .
translation.kha: te ha ka jingbitar ngan phai pyrshah ïa phi , bad sa shisien ngan pynshitom jur shuh shuh ïa phi sa hynñiew shah ban ïa kaba la long mynshuwa .
hynrei ka ktien jong U Trai ka ïaineh donkam . Kane ka pynkyrsoi ka long ka Khubor Babha ïa kaba la pynbna ha phi .
translation.en: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever . And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you .
Therefore whether it were I or they , so we preach , and so ye believed .
translation.kha: Kumta te , kam pher lada ka la wan na nga ne na ki , kane ka long kaei kaba ngi baroh ngi ïalap , bad kane ka long kaei kaba phi ngeit .

translation.en: Son of man , say unto her , Thou art the land that is not cleansed , nor rained upon in the day of indignation .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  ïathuh ïa ki Israel ba ka ri jong ki kam long kaba khuid , bad kumta ngan pynshitom ïa ka ha ka jingbitar jong nga .
Bad la don ki briew kiba ñiangthohlieh kiba la im ha Israel ha ka jong Elisha u nongïathuhlypa ; pynban ym shym la pynkhiah ïa uno uno na ki , , tang ïa u Naaman u nong .
translation.en: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet  ; and none of them was cleansed , saving Naaman the Syrian .

translation.kha: Ngi na bynta ka um kaba ngi ; ngi ban thied ïa ka dieng kaba ngi donkam ban thang .
translation.en: We have drunken our water for money  ; our wood is sold unto us .
For thou hast delivered my soul from death , mine eyes from tears , and my feet from falling .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingïap , u la pynsangeh ïa ki ummat jong nga , bad u la sumar ïa nga na ka jingshahjop .
Baroh kiba me ong , nga la ïohsngew mynshuwa . Nga sngewthuh ïa kata baroh lbak nga tip lut kat shadien me , me tip thma Ngam long uba nangno jong me .
translation.en: What ye know , the same do I know also : I am not inferior unto you .

And Moses said unto the people , Remember this day , in which ye came out from Egypt , out of the house of bondage  ; for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought you out from this place : there shall no leavened bread be eaten .
translation.kha: U Moses u kren ha u paidbah ,  Kynmaw ïa kane ka sngi — ka sngi ha kaba phi mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba phi long ki mraw . Kane ka dei ka sngi ba U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa phi da ka borbah jong u . Wat bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .

Ha ki shiteng na ka jait Manasseh , nga krong ïa kaba sah na ka ri Gilead bad ïa ka kai baroh kawei , ha kaba u Og u synshar Ebal kaba awria ïa ka thain Argob jingmlien kawei . ( jingpynkit stait synagog la tip kum ka ri jong ngut Rephaim .
translation.en: And the rest of Gilead , and all Bashan , being the kingdom of Og , gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh  ; all the region of Argob , with all Bashan , which was called the land of giants .
Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey , to shed blood , and to destroy souls , to get dishonest gain .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah sorkar ki long kum ki suri kiba patar lyngkhot ïa ki mrad ba ki la pynïap . Ki pynïap briew ba kin ïoh riewspah .

translation.en: It was meet that we should make merry , and be glad : for this thy brother was dead , and is alive again  ; and was lost , and is found .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi la dei ban lehkmen bad ban sngewkmen , namar u para jong phi uba la ïap , hynrei mynta u dang im ; u la jah , hynrei mynta la shem pat ïa u .’

translation.en: And he answered , I have not troubled Israel  ; but thou , and thy father s house , in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the  Lord  , and thou hast followed Baalim .
translation.kha: Ngam dei u nongthaw jingkulmar ,  u Elijah u la jubab .  Dei ma phi — ma phi bad u kpa jong phi . Phim shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  bad phi mane ïa ki bleithaw u Baal .

translation.en: But let us , who are of the day , be sober , putting on the breastplate of faith and love ; and for an helmet , the hope of salvation .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi dei ki jong ka sngi , bad ngi dei ban pyngngad . Ngi dei ban kup ïa ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingieit kum ka jingda shadem , bad ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ïa ka jingpynim kum ka jingda khlieh .
U Trai u la kren ha nga
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came unto me again , saying ,
Now I pray to God that ye do no evil ; not that we should appear approved , but that ye should do that which is honest , though we be as reprobates .
translation.kha: Ngi duwai ha U Blei ba phin ym leh ïa ka bymdei — ym ban pynpaw ba ngi long kiba la jop , te hynrei ba phin ïoh leh ïa kaba dei , wat la ka i kumba ngi long kiba la shahjop .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Which of you shall have a friend , and shall go unto him at midnight , and say unto him , Friend , lend me three loaves  ;
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  Tharai uwei na phi un leit sha ka ïing u paralok jong phi ha ka por shiteng synñia bad ong ha u , ‘ Ko paralok , ai kylliang ïa nga lai tylli ki lyngkhot kpu .
Lada kumne Sibboleth sleh phi long ka jingjia ryngkhat jingblei pynïap ïano jingsaiñ , u lah ban leit shata bad Jeroham na uta uba wad kput .
translation.en: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither : and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood .
For while they be folden together as thorns , and while they are drunken as drunkards , they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry .
translation.kha: Kum ïa ki shiah kiba la thain bad ïa u phlangïap ba-tyrkhong , ïa phi ki nongbuaid yn thang duh !

translation.en: Yet he restored the money unto his mother  ; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver , and gave them to the founder , who made thereof a graven image and a molten image : and they were in the house of Micah .
translation.kha: Kumta u pynphai pat ïa ki sha la ka kmie . Ka shim arspah tylli ki sbai rupa bad ka ai ïa ki ha u bania , uba la thaw ïa ka bleithaw , da kaba shniah ïa ka na ka dieng bad suit da ka rupa . La buh ïa ka ha ïing u Mikah .

translation.en: Let us therefore , as many as be perfect , be thus minded : and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded , God shall reveal even this unto you .
translation.kha: Ma ngi baroh kiba la ih bha ka jinglong mynsiem , ngi dei ban ïoh ïa kane kajuh ka jingmut . Hynrei lada don napdeng jong phi kiba don da ka jingmut baïapher , U Blei un pynshai ïa kane ha phi .

translation.en: And thou shalt remember all the way which the  Lord  thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness , to humble thee , and to prove thee , to know what was in thine heart , whether thou wouldest keep his commandments , or no .
translation.kha: Kynmaw kumno U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ïalam ïa phi baroh shi lynter lynti lyngba ka ri shyiap ha kine ki sawphew snem kiba la dep ba un pyndem ïa phi , u da tynjuh ïa phi ba un ïoh tip aïu phi thmu ban leh , bad la phin kohnguh ne em ïa ki hukum jong u .
Hangne nga kob ïa ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel . Nga ïa phi ba phah da uno ïaleh bad nga !
translation.en: And the Philistine said , I defy the armies of Israel this day  ; give me a man , that we may fight together .

translation.kha: shikatdei U Trai u thoh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa kijuh ki ktien ba u la thoh ha Shittah sien Babbai nyngkong , ïa ki Gomer Hukum keiñ ba u la ai ha phi mynba u apil kren Khynñiuh ka ding ha kata ka sngi ba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum . U Trai u ai ha nga pungsum kita ki mawlyngkniap , mawkhang nga phai bad leit hiar na uta u lum khnap
translation.en: And he wrote on the tables , according to the first writing , the ten commandments , which the  Lord  spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly : and the  Lord  gave them unto me .
So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius , and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian .
translation.kha: U Daniel u la manbha ha ka por ba u Darius u synshar bad ha ka jingsynshar jong u Syros u nong Persia .
Elam briew kiba bieit kim ryñiot jingshit ki leh pop , hynrei ki briew kiba pynroi ki kwah ban ïohmap .
translation.en: Fools make a mock at sin : but among the righteous there is favour .

translation.kha: Ryngkat bad uta , phin ai ruh ar kilo u lyngkdop ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam . Ka jingiwbih jong kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba jyllop ïa U Trai . dakmong ai lang ruh bad kata ka jingkñia shi litar ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh dih .
translation.en: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  for a sweet savour : and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine , the fourth part of an hin .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la mihnoh bad ïathuh ha uta u paidbah ïa kaba U Trai u la ong . U la lumlang hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam u bad la buh ïa ki sawdong Ïingjaiñ ka .
translation.en: And Moses went out , and told the people the words of the  Lord  , and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people , and set them round about the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Un pynngat ïa kine ki jingtim baroh ha ki nongshun jong phi , kiba isih banbeiñ ïa phi
translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies , and on them that hate thee , which persecuted thee .

And all Israel , and their elders , and officers , and their judges , stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , as well the stranger , as he that was born among them  ; half of them over against mount Gerizim , and half of them over against mount Ebal  ; as Moses the servant of the  Lord  had commanded before , that they should bless the people of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki Israel lem bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , bad ki nongbishar ryngkat lem bad ki nongwei kiba hapdeng jong ki , ki la ïeng ha baroh arliang jong ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , da kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba bah ïa ka . Shiteng na u paidbah ki ïeng ha kaba ka lyngkdong jong ki ka phai sha u Lum Gerisim bad shiteng kiwei pat , ki lyngkdong jong ki , ki phai sha u Lum Ebal . U Moses u shakri U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki ban leh ïa kane ynda poi ka por ïa ki ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu .

translation.en: For my thoughts are not your thoughts , neither are your ways my ways , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki jingmut jong nga ,  ong U  Trai  ,  kim long kum ki jong phi , bad ki lynti jong nga ki ïapher na ki jong phi .
Ainguh ïa uwei mynstep bad uwei pat janmiet ,
translation.en: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning , and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even  ;
Because ye were glad , because ye rejoiced , O ye destroyers of mine heritage , because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass , and bellow as bulls  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki paid ka Babilonia , phi la lute ïa ka jaitbynriew jong nga . Phi kmen bad phi sngewbha , phi da leh kum ka masi ba ïaid haba shoh kba ne kum u kulai uba pah ,

translation.en: And I have declared unto them thy name , and will declare it : that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them , and I in them .
translation.kha: Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha ki , bad ngan ïai leh kumta , khnang ba ka jingieit kaba me don ïa nga kan ïoh long bad ki , bad kumta nga ruh ngan ïoh long bad ki .

translation.en: That word , I say , ye know , which was published throughout all Judaea , and began from Galilee , after the baptism which John preached  ;
translation.kha: Phi tip ïa ka jingjia kaba khraw kaba la jia ha kylleng ka ri Israel , kaba sdang ha Galilaïa hadien ba u Ïoannis u la ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u shaphang ka jingpynbaptis .
Nga la pynphong ïa jaiñ pha ha ki jaiñ jynsur kiba la suh bad syntiew nga la ai ha pha ki juti na ki snieh kiba bha tam , ka jingteh khlieh linen bad ka tapmoh rusom .
translation.en: I clothed thee also with broidered work , and shod thee with badgers  skin , and I girded thee about with fine linen , and I covered thee with silk .
And I will shake all nations , and the desire of all nations shall come : and I will fill this house with glory , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkyllon ïa ki hima baroh , bad ïa ki jingkynshew yn wallam shane , bad ïa ka Templ yn pyndap da ka spah .
Tam nga , U Trai nga sah” buh ïa ka sngi kaba la shai kum ka por ha kaba ngan leh ïa Kibsaim .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  appointed a set time , saying , To morrow the  Lord  shall do this thing in the land .
There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth , when ye shall see Abraham , and Isaac , and Jacob , and all the prophets , in the kingdom of God , and you yourselves thrust out .
translation.kha: A katno phin ïam bad kyr-iat ïa la ki bniat haba phi ïohi ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ha ka Hima U Blei , katba ïa phi la bret noh shabar !
U pynkylla ki pung-um ïa ki ri shyiap bad umpohliew pynmih ha ki jaka ba-rkhiang .
translation.en: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water , and dry ground into watersprings .
The second woe is past  ; and , behold , the third woe cometh quickly .
translation.kha: Ka jingshyrkhei kaba ar ka la kut , hynrei ka jingshyrkhei kaba lai kan sa wan shen !

translation.en: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom , saying , Let me , I pray thee , pass through thy land : but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto . And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab : but he would not consent : and Israel abode in Kadesh .
translation.kha: Nangta ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u syiem Edom ban pan jingbit ban ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u . Hynrei u syiem Edom um shym shah ïa ki . Ki kyrpad ruh ïa u syiem Moab , u ruh um shym shah ba kin ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u . Kumta ki Israel ki hap ban sah ha Kadesh .

translation.en: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa u Petros bad u Ïoannis ba ki rung shapoh , u la kyrpad ïa ki ban ai ei ei ïa u .

translation.en: Pardon , I beseech thee , the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy , and as thou hast forgiven this people , from Egypt even until now .
translation.kha: Te mynta , A  Trai  , kat kum ka jingkhraw ka jingieit baïaineh jong me , to map , nga kyrpad na ka bynta ka pop jong kine ki briew kumba me la map ïa ki naduh ba ki la mih na Ijipt .
U Trai u la ong , Ngan sa pynjot ïa kiei baroh ha ka pyrthei ,
translation.en: I will utterly consume all things from off the land , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: bad kin Bret , ‘ Ym dei ma thapbawa kiba Anab ïa Athalaïah u Jehoash , bad ngim shym ïohi ruh mano ba la leh ïa kata ka kam .
translation.en: And they shall answer and say , Our hands have not shed this blood , neither have our eyes seen it .

translation.kha: Kine nongbah ki bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Sebulun ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jong jingïohkynti ki .
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families , these cities with their villages .
And , behold , men passed by , and saw the carcase cast in the way , and the lion standing by the carcase : and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew kiba ïaid nangta ki ïohi ïa kata ka metïap ha lynti , bad ïa u sing uba ïeng hajan jong ka . Ki leit haduh Bethel bad ïathuh ïa kaei kaba ki la ïohi .

Nga jubab Meon Ngam dei u briew uba Baalsebub phet bad mynsiem . Ïano phi pyrkhat ba ngan pyrshang kongsan pynim ïa la ka jingim da kaba rieh ha shisha Shamgar Nongbishar Ngan Sosipater leh kumta iohnong
translation.en: And I said , Should such a man as I flee ? and who is there , that , being as I am , would go into the temple to save his life ? I will not go in .

Thus saith the  Lord   ; I am returned unto Zion , and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem : and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth  ; and the mountain of the  Lord  of hosts the holy mountain .
translation.kha: Ngan wan phai pat sha Jerusalem , ka nongbah bakhuid jong nga , bad ban shong ban sah hangta . Ïa ka yn tip kum ka nongbah baïaineh , bad ïa u lum jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh yn khot u lum bakyntang .
U long uba thma dei ban ïaroh — u long U Blei jong phi ; bad phi la ïohi da la ki khmat ïa ki kam kiba Blei bad kiba phylla kiba u la leh na ka jingsngewlem jong phi .
translation.en: He is thy praise , and he is thy God , that hath done for thee these great and terrible things , which thine eyes have seen .

translation.kha: Nga tip haduh katno ka jingtbit jong nongot dieng jong phi , kumta to phah ïa nga ki dieng Kedar , ki dieng Kseh-Sypress , bad ki dieng Kseh-Juniper tylli na Lebanon .
translation.en: Send me also cedar trees , fir trees , and algum trees , out of Lebanon : for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon  ; and , behold , my servants shall be with thy servants ,

translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu la u shim shi u lyngkhot kpu , u duwai la ainguh , la u kdiah ïa u , bad u la ai ïa u ha ki synran jong u . To shim bad to bam ïa u , u la ong ; une u long ka met jong nga .
translation.en: And as they were eating , Jesus took bread , and blessed it , and brake it , and gave it to the disciples , and said ,  Take , eat  ; this is my body .
And oil for the light , and spices for anointing oil , and for the sweet incense ,
translation.kha: ka umphniang na ka bynta ki sharak , ki musla na ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh bad na ka bynta ka jingiwbih ;

translation.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh : and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ai shi bynta jong ka ri ha ki longïing jong kaba shiteng na ka jait Manasseh kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
Haba la poi kham ha pajih ïing , u u khot ïa ki paramarjan ban leit ïaleh ïa ki . Ki lap ïa ki rangbah na Dan
translation.en: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah , the men that were in the houses near to Micah s house were gathered together , and overtook the children of Dan .
Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread , but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la shemphang ba um shym la maham ïa ki ban sumar ïa lade na u thiat uba pyndonkam ha u kpu , hynrei na ka jinghikai ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi .
bad na kata ka jaka ki la leit pat da ka sha lieng Antiokh , ka jaka ha kaba la aiti ha ki jingsumar ha ka jong ka jingaiei jong U Blei na ka bynta ka kam kaba mynta ki la pyndep .
translation.en: And thence sailed to Antioch , from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled .

translation.kha: Rung shapoh lyngba ka khyrdop kaba namar ka khyrdop sha ka dujok ka long kaba kylluid bad ka kaba ïalam ka , ka long kaba , bad don shibun kiba ïaid na ka .
translation.en: Enter ye in at the strait gate : for wide is the gate , and broad is the way , that leadeth to destruction , and many there be which go in thereat :

translation.kha: Hynrei lada sngewthuh ngam ïa ka ktien kaba la kren , u uba briew pyndonkam ïa ka un long u nongwei ha nga bad ngan long u nongwei ha u .
translation.en: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice , I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian , and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me .

translation.kha: U Jehoïakim u la don arphew san Kamra ka rta mynba ang long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar khatwei jingshun ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong Mattatha aïom dei Duriaw Sebidah , ka khun u Pedaïah na ka shnong Rumah Khatduh
translation.en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Zebudah , the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah .

translation.kha: Ki kiba duk long khlem jingïarap ha khmat nongsynshar sniew ; long uba shyrkhei kum u sing uba kyrhuh ka dngiem kaba tur .
translation.en: As a roaring lion , and a ranging bear  ; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people .

translation.kha: Uno uno pyllait im ïa la ka jingim un duh noh ka ; uno uba duh noh la ka jingim un ïoh ïa ka .
translation.en: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it  ; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it .

translation.kha: Ki sahkut ar tylli Kibsaim kyrwoh madan bad ki buh ïa ki na shapoh khatkhyndai ka jingdeng shadem ha ki tduh kiba sha trai jong ka ïatyllep hajan ka ephod .
translation.en: And they made two rings of gold , and put them on the two ends of the breastplate , upon the border of it , which was on the side of the ephod inward .

translation.kha: Ngan kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me : A wat iehnoh lei lei ïa nga !
translation.en: I will keep thy statutes : O forsake me not utterly .
Go and tell David , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , I offer thee three things : choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad ïathuh ha u Dabid ba nga ai ha u lai tylli ki jingjied . Ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba u jied .
Hynrei kumjuh ki ïap bad la tep ïa ki ; ïa ki baroh la tap da ki .
translation.en: They shall lie down alike in the dust , and the worms shall cover them .

translation.kha: U Trai u na u Lum ; kum ka sngi Edom , bad u tyngshaiñ ha la ki briew na u Lum Paran . Shiphew ki angel ki don ryngkat u bad ka ding kaba meh ha ka kti kamon jong u .
translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  came from Sinai , and rose up from Seir unto them  ; he shined forth from mount Paran , and he came with ten thousands of saints : from his right hand went a fiery law for them .

Therefore , behold , I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam , and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel , and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam , as a man taketh away dung , till it be all gone .
translation.kha: Namar kane , ngan pynhap ïa ka jingjynjar ha ka longïing syiem jong me bad ngan pynïap ïa ki khun ki ksiew shynrang baroh , ïa u samla bad u tymmen kumjuh . Ngan pynduh khoit ïa ka longïing jong me ; kumba sar lut ïa ka jakhlia .
Hadien ba nga la poi , ngan sa ai ki jingpynithuh sha kito kiba la mynjur , bad ban phah ïa ki leit rah ka phi sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And when I come , whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters , them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem .
As the Bible says , you will “not sorrow just as the rest also do who have no hope .”
translation.kha: Kumba ka Baibl ka ong , phin nym sngew sih kum kito “ki bymdon jingkyrmen .”

translation.en: But the man that shall be unclean , and shall not purify himself , that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation , because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the  Lord  : the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him  ; he is unclean .
translation.kha: Kito kiba long bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad ki bym pynkhuid ïa lade ki ïailong ki bymkhuid , namar ba ym shym la synreit ïa ka um ka jingpynkhuid halor jong ki . Ki pyntngit ïa ka Ïingjaiñ U  Trai  bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa ki kum ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: I likewise , and my brethren , and my servants , might exact of them money and corn : I pray you , let us leave off this usury .
translation.kha: Nga la shah ïa ki briew ban shim pisa kylliang bad u kew na nga , bad kumjuh ruh ki paralok jong nga bad ki briew kiba trei na ka bynta jong nga . To mynta ngin ym ïa-dawa shuh ïa ka jingpynphai biang ïa ka pisa .

translation.en: Not that I speak in respect of want : for I have learned , in whatsoever state I am , therewith to be content .
translation.kha: Bad ngam shym ong ïa kane namar ba nga la shah leh klet , naba nga la nang ban sngewhun ha kaei kaba nga don .

U Jehoash nangta u la ïathuh ha u syiem , U jinglanot Badonbor Baroh u Jekolaïah ba ka por Emim poi lanot baroh kaba ha ka ïingsyiem bitar me , baroh kaba ki kpa tymmen Nahash me ki la lum haduh kane ka sngi Seng yn sa kit noh sha Babilonia kurim Yn ym don shuh ka khyrdop sah .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day , shall be carried to Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka met jong u dieng sohwaiñ jingthrang la kem ding ; ka ding ka la bam duh ïa ki tnat bad ïa u soh jong u Etham Ki tnat kin ym long shuh da lei lei kiba khlaiñ , kin ym long suhjer sei lei lei Sibbekai diengsynshar ba kynja syiem Khyrdop Kane ka Elisheba ka jingrwai jong ka wiat pynïaid la ju rwai bad ïai rwai ïa ka .
translation.en: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches , which hath devoured her fruit , so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule . This is a lamentation , and shall be for a lamentation .
And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried , and the house was filled with smoke .
translation.kha: Ka jingsawa ka sur jong ki ka pynlong ïa ki nongrim jong ka Templ ban khynñiuh , bad ka Templ hi ka kylla dap da ka tdem .
Nangta nga phah mawria riewngeit nonglamktien Weng ka ri shyiap Kedemoth khlem u Setham u syiem Heshbon ban tyrwa ïa Jehonathan jingïasuk , Ahas kaba ong i-lub
translation.en: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace , saying ,
Likewise , I say unto you , there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , nga ong ha phi , ki angel jong U Blei ki risa halor uwei u nongpop uba kylla-kaba-mut .

translation.en: When I blow with a trumpet , I and all that are with me , then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp , and say , The sword of the  Lord  , and of Gideon .
translation.kha: Ynda ma nga bad ka kynhun jong nga ngi put ïa la ki turoi , phi ruh put ïa la ki turoi baroh sawdong ka jaka sher dara , bad pyrta jam , ‘ Ïa U  Trai  bad ïa u Gideon !’
Naba ngi long kum ka jingiwbih ngin la ai UBA U Khrist sha U Blei Sekakah kaba saphriang barli pait kiba sngewjahburom pynim bad kito kiba Khrismas jah ‘ .
translation.en: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ , in them that are saved , and in them that perish :
Therewith bless we God , even the Father  ; and therewith curse we men , which are made after the similitude of God .
translation.kha: Ngi pyndonkam ïa u ban ainguh ïa U Trai bad U Kpa jong ngi bad ban tim ruh ïa la u parabriew , ïa uba la thaw ha ka dur U Blei .
Nangta ki kulai kin wan ïaid , Ki da kyrdem ïa ka khyndew da poh ki jat jong ki .
translation.en: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings , the pransings of their mighty ones .

translation.kha: To rwai ha U Trai ïa ka jingrwai bathymmai ! La rwai ha U Trai , ko phi ka pyrthei baroh !
translation.en: O sing unto the  Lord  a new song : sing unto the  Lord  , all the earth .

And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train , with camels that bare spices , and very much gold , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .
translation.kha: Ka wan ïalam shibun ki nongbud lem bad ki ut kiba kit ki jingiwbih , ki mawlynnai , bad shibun ka ksiar . Ynda ka ïakynduh ïa u Solomon , ka kylli ïa u ïa ki jingkylli baroh kat kiba ka lah ban pyrkhat .
U la batai , Ko Daniel , nga la wan kura ban ïarap ïa me ban shemphang ïa ka sahnar .
translation.en: And he informed me , and talked with me , and said , O Daniel , I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding .

translation.kha: Phi lah ban sngewthikna uno ba uno uba ai dih wat shi khuri ka umkhriat ha uwei uba rit tam na kine ki nongbud jong nga ba namar dei u u nongbud jong nga , un ïohpdiang da shisha ïa ka bainong .
translation.en: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple , verily I say unto you , he shall in no wise lose his reward .

translation.kha: Nangta Hiram phah ïa kane ka khubor harum sha u Solomon : Nga la ïohpdiang ka khubor jong me , bad kloi ban leh kaei kaba me pan . Ngan pynbiang ïa ki dieng Kedar bad ki dieng Kseh
translation.en: And Hiram sent to Solomon , saying , I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for : and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar , and concerning timber of fir .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynroi lyngktar jong u ki Uto khait Makkedah Tebeth Libnah bad Mattan tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translation.en: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah , and all Israel with him , unto Libnah , and fought against Libnah :

translation.kha: Ka kynhun ki riewngeit ka long la ha kawei ka jingmut bad kawei mynsiem ka . Ym don uba ong ba kano kano ka jingdon jong u ba ka long ka jong u hi , hynrei baroh ki la ïasam iwei ïa iwei pat ïa kaei kaei ki kaba la don .
translation.en: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul : neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own  ; but they had all things common .
And now , behold , I know well that thou shalt surely be king , and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand .
translation.kha: Mynta nga da sngewthikna ba phin sa long u syiem ki Israel bad ba ka hima Israel kan ïaineh ha ka jingsynshar jong phi .

translation.en: Take heed unto thyself , and unto the doctrine ; continue in them : for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself , and them that hear thee .
translation.kha: To phikir bha ïa lade bad ïa ki jinghikai kiba me ai . To men ïai leh ïa kine kiei kiei , namar lada me leh kumta , me pynim ïa lade bad ïa kita kiba shahshkor ïa me .

translation.en: “Satan” means an enemy or an opposer .
translation.kha: “Soitan” ka mut u nongshun ne u nongïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: Then they went out to see what was done  ; and came to Jesus , and found the man , out of whom the devils were departed , sitting at the feet of Jesus , clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la ïaleit ban peit ïa kaei kaba la lah jia , bad haba ki la poi ha U Jisu , ki la shem ïa u briew na uba ki ksuid ki la mihnoh , ba u da shong ha ki kjat jong U Jisu , u la phong jaiñ bad ha ka jingtipbriew ; bad baroh ki la sheptieng .

translation.en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening , even the time that women go out to draw water .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi , u pyndem khohsiew ïa kita ki ut harud ka pukri kaba don shabar jong ka nongbah . Ka dei haba la janmiet bha , ka por ha kaba ki kynthei ki ju wan tong um .

translation.en: For until the law sin was in the world : but sin is not imputed when there is no law .
translation.kha: La don ka pop ha ka pyrthei shuwa ba yn ai ïa ka Hukum ; hynrei hangno ha bym don ka hukum , ym don jingbuh jingkynmaw ïa ki pop .

Kane ka long ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel ba uno uno u bym la hiarpateng u Aaron um bit ban wan sha ka ban thang jingiwbih ha khmat U Trai , lym kumta shah pynjot thiaw kum u bad ki nongbud jong u . Ïa kane baroh la leh kumba U Trai la hukum u Eleasar .
translation.en: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel , that no stranger , which is not of the seed of Aaron , come near to offer incense before the  Lord   ; that he be not as Korah , and as his company : as the  Lord  said to him by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: ka sngi Ha kaba U Trai u ai jingjop ïa ki halor Israel ki Amor , u Joshua u kren ha U Trai . Ha khmat ki Israel u ong , Ko Sngi , to ïeng thik halor ka Gibeon , Ko Bnai , to sangeh ha ka Them Aijalon .
translation.en: Then spake Joshua to the  Lord  in the day when the  Lord  delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel , and he said in the sight of Israel , Sun , stand thou still upon Gibeon  ; and thou , Moon , in the valley of Aijalon .
And it came to pass , when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled , and got him out .
translation.kha: Haba u ïohsngew ba nga lynñiar , u la mareh shabar ïing , da kaba iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup hajan jong nga .

translation.en: And take double money in your hand  ; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks , carry it again in your hand  ; peradventure it was an oversight :
translation.kha: Rah pisa ar shah bad phi , namar phin hap rah biang ïa kito ki pisa ïa kiba la buh pat ha khlieh ki byrni jong phi . Ka lah ban long tang ka jingbakla .

translation.en: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing , that they have no covering in the cold .
translation.kha: Mynmiet ki thiah khlem don ei ei ban tap nalor jong ki , kim don ei ei ban ïada na ka jingkhriat .
Ha ka snem ar kaba jong ka jingsynshar u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah kum u syiem ka Israel , u Jotham u khun jong u Ussaïah long u u syiem ka Judah
translation.en: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign .

translation.kha: Ki shim por Manla Ïasam ban riewïaleh ïa ka , namar ka bam por katta ban myntan jingiwbih ïa pyndem metïap . Ki nong Ijipt ki pynlong ka Trei ïa u Dodabahu sngi .
translation.en: And forty days were fulfilled for him  ; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed : and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days .

translation.kha: U briew uba bieit mutlop tam u kham :4–12 ban ïa uno uno uba pyrkhat jingïasoh u long uba bynta haba Rekem long kumta .
translation.en: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit ? there is more hope of a fool than of him .
And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God , and took a great stone , and set it up there under an oak , that was by the sanctuary of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Joshua u thoh ïa kita ki hukum ha ka kitab Ka Aiñ U Blei . Nangta u la shim uwei u maw uba heh , bad u pynïeng ïa u hapoh u dieng Sning ha ka jaka kyntang jong U  Trai .
Uba phylla tam na ki jingthaw jong nga baroh ! Tang u Nongthaw jong u uba , lah ban jop ïa u .
translation.en: He is the chief of the ways of God : he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him .

translation.kha: Ka Templ jong ngi ka long kum ka khet badonburom , kaba ïeng halor jong u lumbah bajrong naduh sdang kaba .
translation.en: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary .
And when he was come into his own country , he taught them in their synagogue , insomuch that they were astonished , and said , Whence hath this man this wisdom , and these mighty works ?
translation.kha: bad u la leit phai pat sha la ka shnong . U la hikai ha ka synagog , bad kito kiba ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh .  Nangno u la ïoh kat kane ka jingstad ?  ki la kylli .  Bad kumno shaphang ki kambah jong u ?
Yn ym don ka ha ka pyrthei ka ïoh kat kine ki jingkyrkhu . Yn mano mano u ban napdeng jong phi lane napdeng ki jingri jong phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt be blessed above all people : there shall not be male or female barren among you , or among your cattle .

translation.kha: Uwei ki na shakri jong u Nabal u ong ha ka Abigail ka tnga jong u Nabal , Hato phi ïohsngew ? U Dabid u la katto phah katne ngut ki nonglamktien na ka ri khlaw bad ka lem jingai khublei ïa u kynrad jong ngi , hynrei u la ñiewbeiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: But one of the young men told Abigail , Nabal s wife , saying , Behold , David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master  ; and he railed on them .

translation.kha: Hynrei u briew uba donburom lehhok u bad u ïeng skhem na ka bynta kaei kaba dei .
translation.en: But the liberal deviseth liberal things  ; and by liberal things shall he stand .

translation.kha: To ïeng joit , ïa ngin leit noh . Ha khmih , hangne u don u briew shetkylla uba ïa nga !
translation.en: Rise , let us be going : behold , he is at hand that doth betray me .

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingong ïa kane , la shim Hannah ïa u sha bneng katba ki dang khmih Jarmuth u , bad u Gederoth Hephsibah la buhrieh ïa u na ka jingïohi jong ki .
translation.en: And when he had spoken these things , while they beheld , he was taken up  ; and a cloud received him out of their sight .
If he set his heart upon man , if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath  ;
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u shim noh ïa ka jingpynhiar mynsiem na ka jingim ,

translation.en: I applied mine heart to know , and to search , and to seek out wisdom , and the reason of things , and to know the wickedness of folly , even of foolishness and madness :
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la pynleit ïa lade ha ka jingtip bad ha ka jingpule bniah ; nga la kut jingmut ban shem ïa ka jingstad bad ïa ki jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong nga , bad ban tip haduh katno ka jingtasngeng ka long kaba sniew bad kaba bieit .

translation.en: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon .
translation.kha: Nangta ki mynsiem ki la wallam lang ïa ki syiem ha ka jaka kaba ha ka ktien Hebru la khot  Ka Armageddon .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer :
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Nga la kwah shikatdei eh ban ïabam bad phi ïa kane ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha shuwa ba ngan shahshitom !

translation.en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart s desire , and blesseth the covetous , whom the  Lord  abhorreth .
translation.kha: U riewbymman u sngewsarong ha la ki jong ki jingkwah basniew ; u riewlalot u tim bad kyntait ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And walk in love , as Christ also hath loved us , and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingim jong phi dei ban synshar da ka jingieit , kumba U Khrist u la ieit ïa ngi bad u la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi kum ka jingainguh ba-iwbih bad ka jingkñia ba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .

U Hanani Pithom uwei na kiba shi para bad nga , u wan poi na Judah ryngkat jingbymlongkhuid ba-ijli dewryngkhiang jong kiwei pat kadlieng shahskhor thang bad nga boi ïa ki shaphang ka Jerusalem bad shaphang ki Ngin Jiw jong ngi kiba kot leit phai Orion ka jingshah lamkhmat ha Babilon .
translation.en: That Hanani , one of my brethren , came , he and certain men of Judah  ; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped , which were left of the captivity , and concerning Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Wai ai ba ngan shah pynïap ha sngewdei ri nongwei , jngai na U Trai . Balei u To Israel un wan ban pynïap ïa u bastad sakma ïa nga ? Balei un beh ïa Gosan kumba beh ïa bahynriew sim lan ?
translation.en: Now therefore , let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the  Lord  : for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea , as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains .
And Joktan begat Almodad , and Sheleph , and Hazarmaveth , and Jerah ,
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joktan ki dei ki briew jong ka Almodad , ka Sheleph , ka Hasarmabeth , ka Jerah ,
U synshar halor ka pyrthei baroh , na ki krem kiba jylliew sha tam kliar ki lum bajrong tam .
translation.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth : the strength of the hills is his also .
He revealeth the deep and secret things : he knoweth what is in the darkness , and the light dwelleth with him .
translation.kha: U pynpaw ïa kiei kiei kiba jylliew bad kiba rieh ; u tip kaei kaba la buhrieh ha ka jingdum , bad ïa u hi la ker sawdong da ka jingshai .

translation.en: There the wicked cease from troubling  ; and there the weary be at rest .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingtep , ki riewbymman ki sangeh noh ban leh ki kam bymman , bad ki nongtrei ba la thait , khatduh ki ïoh jingjahthait .

translation.en: And all the elders of that city , that are next unto the slain man , shall wash their hands over the heifer that is beheaded in the valley :
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongïalam baroh na kata ka shnong kaba jan eh bad ka jaka ha kaba la shem ïa ka metïap kin thet ïa la ki kti halor kata ka masi ,

translation.en: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them : and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea .
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki paramarjan baroh da ka jingsheptieng , bad ka khubor shaphang kine kiei kiei ka la saphriang kylleng ka ri lum Judia .
bad tei Patmos minit ïing jong me Hagar ki um hajrong . Me pyndonkam seiñ Sheerah lyoh kum ki satang pudina bad me shong halor ki thapniang jong ka lyer .
translation.en: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters : who maketh the clouds his chariot : who walketh upon the wings of the wind :

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra ïalumlang , ban mane Blei , bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .
translation.en: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly : ye shall do no servile work therein :
And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron , and for his sons ,
translation.kha: Ki suh ïa ki sopti-poh na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ,
baher shna ïa lade ka lyngkor da ki wanrah snieh ïajah riewlalot jingpynwandur jingphna bad ban buh ïa Khidon ha u ryndang jong nga Merab
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  to me  ; Make thee bonds and yokes , and put them upon thy neck ,
Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day , and having done all , to stand .
translation.kha: Kumta to kieng mynta ïa ka jingkieng atiar U Blei! Nangta haba ka sngi basniew ka wan , phin lah ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki bor ïaleh u nongshun ; bad hadien ba ka jingïaleh ka la kut , phin dang ïeng skhem ha ka nongrim jong phi .

translation.en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing , which he sent to Solomon , Because the  Lord  hath loved his people , he hath made thee king over them .
translation.kha: U syiem Hiram ha kaba jubab u phah da ka shithi sha u Solomon . U thoh ,  Namar U  Trai  u ieit ïa la ki briew , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki .

translation.en: For we are sold , I and my people , to be destroyed , to be slain , and to perish . But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen , I had held my tongue , although the enemy could not countervail the king s damage .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew jong nga bad ïa nga , la die sha ka jingpynïap . Lada kam da long kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba die sha ka jinglongmraw , ngan jin da la shu sngap jar bad ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi ; hynrei ngi la jan shah pynjot — shah pynduh pyndam !
Ïa ka thliew ka thliew jingpynïap Amam jaka ban phrung ïa ka khlieh la suh khylliap ïa ka baroh sawdong khnang ba kan ym kad .
translation.en: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe , as the hole of an habergeon , with a band round about the hole , that it should not rend .
And it came to pass , as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel , that they looked toward the wilderness , and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  appeared in the cloud .
translation.kha: Katba u Aaron u dang kren ha ka kynhun baroh kawei , ki phai shaphang ka ri shyiap , bad kynsan ka jingshai baphyrnai jong U  Trai  ka la paw ha u lyoh .
ban ong ha shuh , U blei ha uba Jakob shaniah u la ong ïa phi ba phin ym hap ha ki kti ki jong nga , hynrei wat shah ba yn shukor ïa phi .
translation.en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah , saying , Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee , saying , Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .

Now in the eighteenth year of his reign , when he had purged the land , and the house , he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , and Maaseiah the governor of the city , and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder , to repair the house of the  Lord  his God .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar jong u , hadien ba u la pynkhuid ïa ka ri bad ïa ka Templ da kaba pynkut noh ïa ka jingmane blei thala , u syiem Josaïah u phah lai ngut ki rangbah ban tei pynbha ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai  U Blei : u Shaphan u khun jong u Asalaïah , Maaseïah , u lat ka Jerusalem , bad u Joah u khun jong u Joahas , u rangbah synshar ba-halor .
Ki ong ïa nga , ‘ Ngim tip ka la jia aïu ïa une u Moses , u briew uba la ïalam ngi na ka Ijipt kumta , noh ïa ngi u blei u ïalam ïa ngi .’
translation.en: For they said unto me , Make us gods , which shall go before us : for as for this Moses , the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .
And Nathan said to the king , Go , do all that is in thine heart  ; for the  Lord  is with thee .
translation.kha: U Nathan u jubab ,  Leh ïa kano kano kaba phi pyrkhat , namar U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad phi .

translation.en: So Job died , being old and full of days .
translation.kha: Bad nangta u la ïap haba u la tymmen bha .

translation.en: They answered and said unto him , Thou wast altogether born in sins , and dost thou teach us ? And they cast him out .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ,  La kha bad la pynsan ïa me hapoh ka pop — bad me pyrshang ban hikai ïa ngi ?  Bad kumta ki la beh noh ïa u na ka synagog .

ngi la ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi , ym tang ha ki ktien , hynrei ruh bor bad ha U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka jingsngewthuh pura ïa jingshisha jong ka . Phi tip kumno ngi la im mynba ngi la don bad phi ; ka long na ka bynta jingbha jong phi hi .
translation.en: For our gospel came not unto you in word only , but also in power , and in the Holy Ghost , and in much assurance ; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake .
And Moses said , We will go with our young and with our old , with our sons and with our daughters , with our flocks and with our herds will we go  ; for we must hold a feast unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Moses u la jubab ,  Ngin ïaleit lut baroh , kynthup ki khun jong ngi haduh ki tymmen jong ngi . Ngin ïalam ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ngi , lem bad ki langbrot bad ki blang , bad ki masi jong ngi , namar ngi dei ban pynlong ka jingkhawai ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that they humbled themselves , the word of the  Lord  came to Shemaiah , saying , They have humbled themselves  ; therefore I will not destroy them , but I will grant them some deliverance  ; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak .
