translation.en: And he received them at their hand , and fashioned it with a graving tool , after he had made it a molten calf : and they said , These be thy gods , O Israel , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
Wherefore shew ye to them , and before the churches , the proof of your love , and of our boasting on your behalf .
translation.kha: To pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong phi ïa ki , khnang ba ki balang baroh kin sngewskhem ïa kata bad kin tip ba ngim shym bakla ha kaba ngi kob sarong shaphang jong phi .
Ko khun u briew , u ong , ka kane long kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar kren nga ïa ka ri Israel : Kane ka dei kaba kut ïa ka ri baroh kawei !
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God  unto the land of Israel  ; An end , the end is come upon the four corners of the land .
Which justify the wicked for reward , and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him !
translation.kha: Hynrei tang namar ka jingïoh pisa bymdei phi shah ïa kiba shah pynrem ban lait bad phi khang ïa kiba lui lui na kaba ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok .
kaba da ïa shah uno uno u briew u bym dei hok ban bam ïa ki ; kata kan pynhap ïa uta u briew ha ka pop , bad un shah pynshitom . Nga long Trai U uba pynkyntang ïa ki jingainguh .
translation.en: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass , when they eat their holy things : for I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
And Manoah said , Now let thy words come to pass . How shall we order the child , and how shall we do unto him ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Manoah u kylli ,  Ynda la wan urlong ki ktien jong phi , uta u khynnah u dei ban leh aïu ? Ka jingim kaba kumno u dei ban im ?

hynrei mem don kano kano ka jingtep , bad ka ïa metïap jong me la bret shabar ba kan . pyut La tap ïa ka da ki met jong ki shipai ba shah la pynïap ha ka thma , la kynting ïa ka lem bad ha ki ka thliew mawsiang , bad la ïuh ïa ka .
translation.en: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch , and as the raiment of those that are slain , thrust through with a sword , that go down to the stones of the pit  ; as a carcase trodden under feet .

translation.kha: , to ïam namar u Saul ! Uba la pynkup ïa phi da ki jaiñ saw , Bad u la pyndeng ïa phi da ki mawlynnai bad ka ksiar .
translation.en: Ye daughters of Israel , weep over Saul , who clothed you in scarlet , with other delights , who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel .

translation.kha: Ki dieng Kseh-Sypress kin san ha ka jaka mynta don ki dieng shynraiñ ki dieng mih ha ka jaka ki shiah . Kane kan long ka dak ban neh , ka jingpynkynmaw ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai , nga la leh .
translation.en: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree , and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree : and it shall be to the  Lord  for a name , for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off .

translation.kha: Ka jingim jong nga ka la long ka nuksa ïa kiba , bun namar me la long ka jingïada bakhlaiñ jong nga .
translation.en: I am as a wonder unto many  ; but thou art my strong refuge .
Then came he to Derbe and Lystra : and , behold , a certain disciple was there , named Timothy , the son of a certain woman , which was a Jewess , and believed  ; but his father was a Greek :
translation.kha: U Paul u la nang leit sha Derbe bad Lystra , ha kaba uwei u Khristan uba kyrteng u Timothi u shong u sah . Ka kmie jong u , kaba long ruh ka Khristan , ka long ka Jiw , hynrei u kpa jong u , u long u Grik .
U Mynsiem Bakhuid u tait shai na kine ki rukom pynbeit , iai-kynmaw 25 ka lynti Shaneng ka Jaka bakhraw Kyntang Mluh ym pat lah ban plie , dewmet sakhi krong Ïingjaiñ kaba ha khmat ka dang ïeng .
translation.en: The Holy Ghost this signifying , that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest , while as the first tabernacle was yet standing :
For thou art my lamp , O  Lord  : and the  Lord  will lighten my darkness .
translation.kha: Ma me , ko  Trai  , me long ka jingshai jong nga , me beh noh ïa ka jingdum jong nga .
Ka jingïoh ïa ka spah kaba da suk eh , ka jinglut noh jong ka ruh ka long kloi kaba eh . Kaba kham eh ban ïoh ïa ka , kaba kham roi ruh ka jingïoh ïa ka .
translation.en: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished : but he that gathereth by labour shall increase .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingieit U Trai ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ka long kaba khraw katta katta ba u la jied ïa phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh , bad phi dang long ka haduh mynta ba jaitbynriew la jied jong u .
translation.en: Only the  Lord  had a delight in thy fathers to love them , and he chose their seed after them , even you above all people , as it is this day .

translation.kha: Khie leit Um da pynthikna bha sa shisien pat ; wad biang biang ha-ei u don , bad uei uba la ïohi Long u hangta . Nga tip ba u long Hamul sianti bymman byrngem
translation.en: Go , I pray you , prepare yet , and know and see his place where his haunt is , and who hath seen him there : for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly .

translation.kha: la Ngi khmih tad haduh ba ngim lah shuh ban khmih ïa ka jingïarap ka bym ju wan . Ngi la ïai ap ïa ka na jingïarap ka hima ka bym don ei ei ban ai .
translation.en: As for us , our eyes as yet failed for our vain help : in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us .
And David said to Joab , and to all the people that were with him , Rend your clothes , and gird you with sackcloth , and mourn before Abner . And king David himself followed the bier .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u hukum ïa u Joab bad ïa ki rangbah jong u ban kad ïa la ki jaiñ , ban phong ka jaiñ khain , bad ban ïambriew na ka bynta u Abner . Bad ha ka jingleit ontep , u syiem Dabid da lade hi u ïaid hadien ka synduk metïap .
lwait u Pharaoh u la ong ha Hosia Moses bad u Aaron , Phi mut kumno Tei kaba shem-lanot ïohknieh ki briew ban leh klet ïa la ki kam ? Susah ïa shitom ban leit sha la ki kam ki kam !
translation.en: And the king of Egypt said unto them , Wherefore do ye , Moses and Aaron , let the people from their works ? get you unto your burdens .

translation.kha: Nga wallam ïa ka sngi ka jingjop sha jan — kam long satia kaba dang sha jngai . Ïa ka jingjop jong yn nga ym pynslem Ngan . pyllait im ïa ka Jerusalem bad wallam ngan ïa ka burom ka Israel hangta .
translation.en: I bring near my righteousness  ; it shall not be far off , and my salvation shall not tarry : and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory .

translation.kha: Ki mraw kiba long ki jong ki riewkhñium kiba Borabor kim dei ban ñiewbeiñ ïa pynring , naba ki long ki parabangeit jong ki . Pynban , ki dei ban shakri ni ki kham bha shuh shuh , namar kito kiba ïoh myntoi na ka jingtrei jong ki , ki long ki parabangeit ïa kiba jingbymman Minnith . Me dei ban hikai bad jynreiñ ïa hynmen Nethanel kiei nonglam
translation.en: And they that have believing masters , let them not despise them , because they are brethren ; but rather do them service , because they are faithful and beloved , partakers of the benefit . These things teach and exhort .

translation.kha: U syiem la loit noh ïa don muhor ha ka ( kaba u la shim noh na u Haman ) bad u ai ha u Mordekai . Esther ka buh ïa ki jingdon jong Haman ha ka jingpeit u Mordekai .
translation.en: And the king took off his ring , which he had taken from Haman , and gave it unto Mordecai . And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman .
And Judas Iscariot , which also betrayed him : and they went into an house .
translation.kha: bad u Judas Iskariot , uba la shetkylla ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: If the  Lord  delight in us , then he will bring us into this land , and give it us  ; a land which floweth with milk and honey .
translation.kha: Lada U  Trai  u la sngewbha ïa ngi , un ïalam ïa ngi shata bad ai ha ngi ïa kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .

translation.en: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God ;
translation.kha: Hynrei phi don ka dohnud kaba eh bad kaba kuman , bad kumta phi pynlong ka jingpynshitom ïa lade hi wat kham khraw ha ka Sngi ha kaba ïa ka jingbitar U Blei bad ki jingbishar bahok yn pynpaw .

translation.en: And Isaac loved Esau , because he did eat of his venison : but Rebekah loved Jacob .
translation.kha: U Isaak u kham jied ïa u Iso , namar u bang bha ban bam ïa ki mrad kiba u Iso u pynïap , hynrei ka Rebekka ka kham jied ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: All the heave offerings of the holy things , which the children of Israel offer unto the  Lord  , have I given thee , and thy sons and thy daughters with thee , by a statute for ever : it is a covenant of salt for ever before the  Lord  unto thee and to thy seed with thee .
translation.kha: Nga ai ha me , ha ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong me , ha ki por ki ban wan baroh ïa ki jingai bakyrpang baroh ba ki Israel ki ai ha nga . Kane ka long ka jutang bym lah pynkheiñ kaba nga la pynlong bad me lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me .
U Solomon mynta u long u . syiem
translation.en: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom .

translation.kha: Ka nam jong u ka la kut ha ïing bad shabar ; ym don kynmaw ba shuh ïa u .
translation.en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth , and he shall have no name in the street .
If these men die the common death of all men , or if they be visited after the visitation of all men  ; then the  Lord  hath not sent me .
translation.kha: Lada kine ki briew ki ïap kumba ïap ki parabriew khlem da hap ha kano kano ka jingpynshitom na U Blei , te shisha U  Trai  um shym la phah ïa nga .

U Trai um ju bitar shen hynrei , u long uba khrawbor um bad ju shah ba kiba shah rai pynrem kin lait khlem shah pynshitom . Hangno ha kaba U Trai u ïaid , ki erïong ki khie ; ki lyoh ki long ki pui pui ba la pynmih da ki kjat jong u !
translation.en: The  Lord  is slow to anger , and great in power , and will not at all acquit the wicked : the  Lord  hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm , and the clouds are the dust of his feet .

translation.kha: Kumta mynta to phah sha ïa ngi u kew , u barli , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ba phi la kular .
translation.en: Now therefore the wheat , and the barley , the oil , and the wine , which my lord hath spoken of , let him send unto his servants :
Watch ye and pray , lest ye enter into temptation . The spirit truly is ready , but the flesh is weak .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ïa ki ,  To sumar bad to duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi . Ka mynsiem ka kwah hynrei ka doh ka tlot .

translation.en: The  Lord  will destroy the house of the proud : but he will establish the border of the widow .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynjot ïa ki longïing jong ki briew kiba sarong , hynrei un ïada ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ka riewkynthei .

translation.en: What do ye imagine against the  Lord  ? he will make an utter end : affliction shall not rise up the second time .
translation.kha: Aïu phi ïasylla pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ? un pynjot ïa phi . Ym don mano mano uba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u palat ïa ka shisien .

Naba haba la pynbaptis ïa phi , la tep ïa phi bad U , bad ha ka jingpynbaptis la pynmihpat ruh ïa phi bad Khrist da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka bor ba-ïaitrei jong U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa na ka jingïap .
translation.en: Buried with him in baptism , wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God , who hath raised him from the dead .
For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh , Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up , that I might shew my power in thee , and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ïa u syiem ka Ijipt ,  Nga la pynlong syiem ïa me khnang ban pyndonkam ïa me ban pyn-i ïa ka bor jong nga bad ban pynphriang ïa ka nam jong nga ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

translation.en: And they said unto her , Thou art mad . But she constantly affirmed that it was even so . Then said they , It is his angel .
translation.kha: Pha long kaba lamwir !  ki la ong ïa ka . Hynrei ka la ïai ban ba ka la long kaba shisha . Kumta ki la jubab ,  U dei u angel jong u .
Namar haba ar lane lai ngut ïawanlang ha ka kyrteng jong nga , nga don hangta lem bad ki .
translation.en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name , there am I in the midst of them .

translation.en: And they came to the place which God had told him of  ; and Abraham built an altar there , and laid the wood in order , and bound Isaac his son , and laid him on the altar upon the wood .

translation.kha: U la Haggi ka por kaba Shim ïa kaei kaei baroh . pynkloi la ai ha ngi ka jingkwah ban kadei ïa ka Abilene , hynrei um ju ai aiu ngi ka lyngki ban sngewthuh lut ïa kaei kaba u leh .
translation.en: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time : also he hath set the world in their heart , so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end .
This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families , these cities with their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Asher ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah , in Issachar :

translation.en: He answereth him , and saith ,  O faithless generation , how long shall I be with you ? how long shall I suffer you ? bring him unto me .

translation.kha: Blei U u tyrwa me ha ïa ka jingpyntngen ; balei ba me dang kyntait ïa ka ? Ngi la ïakren bad u ha ki ktien bajai jai .
translation.en: Are the consolations of God small with thee ? is there any secret thing with thee ?

translation.en: And if she had at all an husband , when she vowed , or uttered ought out of her lips , wherewith she bound her soul  ;

translation.en: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch , saying , I am shut up  ; I cannot go into the house of the  Lord  :

translation.en: Then said Abishai to David , God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day : now therefore let me smite him , I pray thee , with the spear even to the earth at once , and I will not smite him the second time .

translation.kha: Ïaroh U Trai U Blei ki Israel , Nongthaw ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew ! U la ha u Dabid , ïa u khun uba , uba dap da ka jingshemphang bad ka jingtbit , uba mynta u ka ka bynta Trai bad ka na ka bynta ïa lade
translation.en: Huram said moreover , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , that made heaven and earth , who hath given to David the king a wise son , endued with prudence and understanding , that might build an house for the  Lord  , and an house for his kingdom .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïa kaei kaba U Blei leh ha lawei , kumta u la kren shaphang ka jingmihpat jong U Messaïah haba u ong , ‘ Ym shym la iehnoh u ha ka pyrthei kiba ; ka met jong u kam shym la pyut hapoh ka jingtep
translation.en: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ , that his soul was not left in hell , neither his flesh did see corruption .
Also in the day of the firstfruits , when ye bring a new meat offering unto the  Lord  , after your weeks be out , ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam ka Jingot , haba phi wanrah ïa ka jingainguh da u kew thymmai sha U  Trai  , phi dei ban ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad phim dei ban treikam ei ei .
Te mynta , ko samla , shahshkor ïa nga Leh . kumba nga ong , bad phin long suk .
translation.en: Now therefore hearken unto me , O ye children : for blessed are they that keep my ways .
For a fire is kindled in mine anger , and shall burn unto the lowest hell , and shall consume the earth with her increase , and set on fire the foundations of the mountains .
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar jong nga kan meh lep kum ka ding , bad kan thang duh katba don ha sla pyrthei . Kan pur de shaduh ñiamra , bad kan thang ïa ki tynrai jong ki lumbah .

translation.en: Behold , this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom , pride , fulness of bread , and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters , neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy .
translation.kha: Ma ka bad ki khun kynthei jong ka ki la sngewsarong namar ki la don kyrhai ban bam bad im ha ka jingsuk bad ka jingjar jar , hynrei kim shym la sumar ïa kiba duk bad ïa kiba rangli .
Ym namar kano kano na ki kam babha kiba ma ngi hi ngi la , hynrei namar ka jingisynei jong u hi ba la pynim ngi , lyngba U Mynsiem , ai ïa ngi ka jingkha ka jingim kaba da kaba sait ngi .
translation.en: Not by works of righteousness which we have done , but according to his mercy he saved us , by the washing of regeneration , and renewing of the Holy Ghost ;
For it is written , I will destroy the wisdom of the wise , and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ngan pynjot noh ïa ka jingstad jong kiba stad bad ngan kyntait sharud ïa ka jingshemphang jong ki riewshemphang .

translation.en: For he was yet in the loins of his father , when Melchisedec met him .

translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! because ye build the tombs of the prophets , and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous ,

translation.kha: Wanlam ar ngut ki rangbah ba lah ban shaniah , u Uriah u lyngdoh bad u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Jeberekhaïah , ban long kum ki sakhi .
Haba ki synran baroh ki la ïawanlang ha Galilaïa , U Jisu u la ong ha ki , U Khun U Briew u la jan ba un shah aiti ha pynsngewthuh briew ,
translation.en: And while they abode in Galilee , Jesus said unto them ,  The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men :

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka Jediael katba ki sngewhun jong u Job ki dang ïakhawai sngewbha ha ïing jong u hynmen rangbah duh jingjynthut u nonglamktien u la wan mareh sha u Job .
translation.en: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :

And Saul said unto the Kenites , Go , depart , get you down from among the Amalekites , lest I destroy you with them : for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel , when they came up out of Egypt . So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites .
translation.kha: U la phah ka jingmaham sha ki Ken , ki briew kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la lehsbun ïa ki Israel mynba ki wan na Ijipt :  Khie leit bad iehnoh ïa ki Amalek , ba kumta ngan ym pynïap ïa phi lem bad ki .  Kumta ki Ken ki mihnoh .

translation.en: Is not this laid up in store with me , and sealed up among my treasures ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kynmaw aïu ki nongshun jong ki , ki la leh ; u ap ïa ka por kaba biang ban pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent thee on a journey , and said , Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites , and fight against them until they be consumed .
translation.kha: bad u la phah ïa phi lem bad ka hukum , ban pynjot ïa ki Amalek , ki briew bymman . U la ong ïa phi ban ïaleh haduh ba phin da pynïap ïa ki baroh .

Ym don kino kino ki bleithaw jong ki jaitbynriew kiba lah ban phah ïa u slap ; ka suiñbneng da lade hi kam lah ban slap pynhap . Ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me A , Trai U Blei ngi jong , namar me long uta uba leh ïa kine kiei . kiei
translation.en: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain ? or can the heavens give showers ? art not thou he , O  Lord  our God ? therefore we will wait upon thee : for thou hast made all these things .

translation.kha: Kum ki dieng , ki briew jong nga kin im slem Hodaïah Kin ïoh ban lehkmen heh ha kiei kiei Samgar ki Ashbath trei shitom Etham
translation.en: They shall not build , and another inhabit  ; they shall not plant , and another eat : for as the days of a tree are the days of my people , and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands .

translation.kha: Hynrei un jubab , Ym nga ma ! Ngam lah ban ïarap phi ïa . Ngam don jingbam ei ei lane ki jaiñ ruh kumjuh . Wat pynlong ïa nga u nongïalam jong phi !
translation.en: In that day shall he swear , saying , I will not be an healer  ; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing : make me not a ruler of the people .
Then said the  Lord  , Thou hast had pity on the gourd , for the which thou hast not laboured , neither madest it grow  ; which came up in a night , and perished in a night :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u ,  Une u jingthung u la san ha ka shi miet bad jah noh ha kaba bud ; mem shym la leh ei ei na ka bynta jong u , bad mem shym la pynlong ïa u ban san — pynban me la sngewsih na ka bynta jong u !

translation.en: Then his father and his mother said unto him , Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren , or among all my people , that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines ? And Samson said unto his father , Get her for me  ; for she pleaseth me well .
translation.kha: Hynrei u kpa bad ka kmie jong u ki ong ïa u ,  Balei phin da leit sha kito ki Philistia bymngeit ban ïoh ïa ka kurim ? Hato phim lah ban shem ïa ka theisamla na la ka kur ka jait , hapdeng ki briew jong ngi baroh ?  Hynrei u Samson u ong ha la u kpa ,  Kane ka dei kaba nga kwah ba phin pynïoh na ka bynta jong nga . translation.en: He answered them , I have told you already , and ye did not hear : wherefore would ye hear it again ? will ye also be his disciples ?

translation.kha: U Trai u jingdeng riewpawkhmat ki Israel ïa u nongïalam , uba pyllaitluid ïa ki na Malkhishua lan , bad kumta ki Israel ki im Jeriel ka jingsuk , kumba mynshuwa .
translation.en: ( And the  Lord  gave Israel a saviour , so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians : and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents , as beforetime .

translation.kha: Ynda Belteshassar poi Dionysius kata ka ri ba U Trai U Rephaïah jong phi u ai ha phi , wat pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh kiba ijli jong ki jaitbynriew sopkjat shong hangta iohi
translation.en: When thou art come into the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations .
Great is my boldness of speech toward you , great is my glorying of you : I am filled with comfort , I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation .
translation.kha: Nga sngewthikna katta katta ïa phi ; nga sngewsarong na ka bynta jong phi ! Ha ki jingjynjar jong ngi baroh nga dang dap hi da ka jingshlur ; nga shlei da ka jingkmen .
ïawan Syiem pynsyaid Ashbath me ieit ïa Jetur jingshongthait dei ; me la pynskhem ïa ka jingbishar hok Khublei Israel ; me la wanrah ïa ka hok bad ka jinglehhok .
translation.en: The king s strength also loveth judgment  ; thou dost establish equity , thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob .

translation.kha: U Judas blaid la long u dkhot jong ka kynhun jong ngi , namar la Kumta jied ïa u ban ïadon bynta lem ha ka Mynmiet jong ngi .
translation.en: For he was numbered with us , and had obtained part of this ministry .

Then said the  Lord  unto Moses , Behold , I will rain bread from heaven for you  ; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day , that I may prove them , whether they will walk in my law , or no .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Mynta ngan pynhap bam na bneng ïa phi baroh . Ki briew ki dei ban mih shabar man ka sngi ban lum kat ban biang na ka bynta kata ka sngi . Da kumta nga lah ban tynjuh ïa ki ban shem la kin kohnguh ne em ïa ki jingbthah jong nga .
ka Jarmuth , bad ka , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: Jarmuth with her suburbs , En–gannim with her suburbs  ; four cities .

translation.kha: Kam pher sha kano ka liang u dieng u khyllem un don ha ka jaka kaba u la kyllon . Haba ki lyoh ki dap , ka .
translation.en: If the clouds be full of rain , they empty themselves upon the earth : and if the tree fall toward the south , or toward the north , in the place where the tree falleth , there it shall be .
Tom said it was all like a dream .
translation.kha: U Tom u ong ba dei tang ka jingphohsniew .

Haba u mynsiem tur ïaleh ïa u , u bret ïa u sha madan bad u sei shyntur , u kyr-iat ki bniat , bad u eh tnen baroh shi rynïeng Nga la ong ïa synran jong me ban beh ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid , hynrei kim shym la lah .
translation.en: And wheresoever he taketh him , he teareth him : and he foameth , and gnasheth with his teeth , and pineth away : and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out  ; and they could not .
Then thou shalt say , They be thy servant Jacob s  ; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau : and , behold , also he is behind us .
translation.kha: Me dei ban jubab , ‘ Ki dei ki jong u Jakob u shakri jong phi . U phah ïa ki kum ka jingai sngewbha sha u kynrad jong u , u Iso . U Jakob hi u hadien jong ngi .’
ki ïam pangnud ka bynta jong , da sleh pui pui ha ki khlieh jong ki bad tyllun ha u dpei .
translation.en: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee , and shall cry bitterly , and shall cast up dust upon their heads , they shall wallow themselves in the ashes :
Behold , all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded : they shall be as nothing  ; and they that strive with thee shall perish .
translation.kha: Kito kiba bitar ïa me kin tip ïa ka jinglehrain ka jingshahjop kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa me kin ïap

translation.en: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds , and by thousands : but David and his men passed on in the rearward with Achish .
translation.kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki ïaid sha khmat ryngkat bad la ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut bad kiba shihajar ngut , u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki ïaid nadien bad u syiem Akhish .
bad u ong , Na ka khyndew ha kaba U Trai u buh la ka jingtim , une u khunlung un wallam ha ngi ka jingpyntngen na baroh ka jingtrei shitom ; jong ngi kumta u la kyrteng ïa u , u Noah .
translation.en: And he called his name Noah , saying , This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands , because of the ground which the  Lord  hath cursed .
And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him , whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba shong ha ka pyrthei kin mane ïa u , lait noh ïa kito kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki la thoh ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei ha ka kitab jong kiba im kiba dei ki jong uta U Khunlangbrot ïa uba la shah pynïap .

translation.en: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein , which brought fish , and all manner of ware , and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah , and in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki rangbah na ka nongbah Tyros ki shong ki sah ha Jerusalem , bad ki wanrah dohkha bad baroh ki jait mar sha ka nongbah ban die ha ki briew jong ngi ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: Now Saul , and they , and all the men of Israel , were in the valley of Elah , fighting with the Philistines .
translation.kha: U syiem Saul , ki hynmen jong phi , bad baroh kiwei ki Israel ki don ha ka Them Elah , ki dang ïaleh thma ïa ki Philistia .
Hynrei u Jehoshaphat kylli , Hato ym don sa uwei pat nongïathuhlypa uba ngin kylli ïa U Trai ?
translation.en: But Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  besides , that we might enquire of him ?
And he stripped off his clothes also , and prophesied before Samuel in like manner , and lay down naked all that day and all that night . Wherefore they say , Is Saul also among the prophets ?
translation.kha: U loit noh ïa la ki jaiñ bad u shad bad risa ha khmat u Samuel , bad u thiah lyngkhuit ha kata ka sngi baroh shi sngi bad ha kata ka miet baroh shi miet . ( Ha kane ka rukom la mih ka jingong ,  Hato wat u Saul ruh u la kylla long u nongïathuhlypa ?  )

Hadien ba ka la mihnoh ban leit tam kew , u u hukum ïa ki nongtrei , Shah ïa ban tam wat ka jaka ha kaba ki ki don , bad wat ei ei ban khang ka . Nalor kata , sei ruh katne ki kew ki song bad ïa ba kan tam .
translation.en: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her , and leave them , that she may glean them , and rebuke her not .

translation.kha: Ka jingkhuslai ka bymïaineh Eliel ïabiang kumne : ka klim , Taberah sum , bad ka pui , Hynrei ngam shym leh ei ei ka bymdei !
translation.en: Such is the way of an adulterous woman  ; she eateth , and wipeth her mouth , and saith , I have done no wickedness .
And a vision appeared to Paul in the night  ; There stood a man of Macedonia , and prayed him , saying , Come over into Macedonia , and help us .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , u Paul u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ha kaba u la ïohi ïa u nong Makedonia uba ïeng bad kyrpad ïa u ,  Ale shane sha Makedonia bad ïarap ïa ngi !

translation.en: Behold , now I have opened my mouth , my tongue hath spoken in my mouth .
translation.kha: Nga kloi ban ong ïa kaba don ha ka jingmut jong nga .

translation.en: But now is made manifest , and by the scriptures of the prophets , according to the commandment of the everlasting God , made known to all nations for the obedience of faith :
translation.kha: Mynta pat , ïa kata ka jingshisha la pynmih ha kaba paw lyngba ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa ; bad da ka hukum jong U Blei bymjukut , ïa ka la pyntip sha baroh ki jaitbynriew , khnang ba baroh ki lah ban ngeit bad kohnguh .

Kito kiba thied la bad die ïa ki langbrot ki la wai ïa nga , bad nga la long u nongaplangbrot jong ki langbrot kiba dei la ban shah shohdoh . Nga la shim ar tylli ki dieng Ïa : uwei nga la U khot Jingsngewbha bad ïa uwei pat U Jingtylli . Bad nga la sumar ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: And I will feed the flock of slaughter , even you , O poor of the flock . And I took unto me two staves  ; the one I called Beauty , and the other I called Bands  ; and I fed the flock .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long ka lynti kaba dei ka ban ïalam sha ka jingïap .
translation.en: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man , but the end thereof are the ways of death .
And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day , and put themselves in array against Gibeah , as at other times .
translation.kha: Nangta lynter ha ka sngi kaba lai ki leit tur pyrshah ïa ki kynhun shipai Benjamin bad ki pynïeng ïa la ki shipai pyrshah ïa ka Gibeah , kumba ki la leh mynshuwa .

translation.en: Cease ye from man , whose breath is in his nostrils : for wherein is he to be accounted of ?
translation.kha: Wat buh jingshaniah shuh ha ki briew ki bym lah ban im junom . Ki dondor haduh katno ?

translation.en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together , about four hundred men , and said unto them , Shall I go against Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And they said , Go up  ; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ahab u khot ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kumba sawspah ngut na ki , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Hato ngan leit ne em ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ?   Tur ïaleh ïa ka ,  ki jubab ,  U  Trai  un ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop .

translation.en: Can a woman forget her sucking child , that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb ? yea , they may forget , yet will I not forget thee .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u jubab ,  Hato ka briew ka lah ban klet noh ïa la i khunlung bad ban ym ieit ïa i khun iba ka la kha ? Wat la ka kmie ka lah ban klet ïa la i khun , da lei lei ngan ym klet ïa phi .

translation.en: Woe unto you ! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets , and your fathers killed them .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ! Phi thaw ki mot jingtep ba-itynnat na ka bynta ki nongïathuhlypa — kita ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la pynïap .

translation.en: But when they shall lead you , and deliver you up , take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak , neither do ye premeditate : but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour , that speak ye : for it is not ye that speak , but the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Bad haba la kem ïa phi bad ïalam sha ka ïingbishar , wat khuslai lypa ïa kaei kaba phin kren ; haba ka por kan poi , to kren ïa kaei kaei kaba yn sa ai ha phi ha kata ka por . Namar ki ktien kiba phin sa kren , kin ym long ki jong phi ; kin wan na U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

U Isaïah u jubab , U Trai un sa ai ïa ka dak ban pynshisha ba un bat ïa la kular ka . , Mynta hato jied men ïa ka syrngiew ha ki mawkyrdon ban jam shiphew jam sha khmat ne ban leit shiphew jam shadien ?
translation.en: And Isaiah said , This sign shalt thou have of the  Lord  , that the  Lord  will do the thing that he hath spoken : shall the shadow go forward ten degrees , or go back ten degrees ?
And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Behold , all that he hath is in thy power  ; only upon himself put not forth thine hand . So Satan went forth from the presence of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kam pher ,  U  Trai  u ong ïa u Soitan ,  baroh kaba u don ki long hapoh ka bor jong me , hynrei men ym pynmong ïa u Job hi .  Te u Soitan u la leit noh .
Ynda uta u khunlung u la san , ka leit ïalam ïa u sha ka khun u Pharaoh ; ka ruh ka ri ïa u kum la u khun , bad ka khot kyrteng ïa u , u , , Moses Namar ka ong , nga la sei ïa u na ka um .
translation.en: And the child grew , and she brought him unto Pharaoh s daughter , and he became her son . And she called his name Moses : and she said , Because I drew him out of the water .

And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab : which Amasa was a man s son , whose name was Ithra an Israelite , that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash , sister to Zeruiah Joab s mother .
translation.kha: ( U Absalom u la buh ïa u Amasa ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai ha ka jaka jong u Joab . U Amasa u dei u khun jong u Jether u nong Ishmael ; ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abigail , ka khun jong u Nahash bad ka para jong ka Seruïah , ka kmie jong u Joab . )
Ki basngewsih ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki shipai Benjamin , bad ki pynïeng ktien ki shipai marpyrshah kata ka nongbah .
translation.en: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin  ; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u lah ong : Lada me kohnguh ïa ki aiñ nga bad leh ïa ki kiba nga la shaniah ha , te men ïailong uba khmih ka Templ jong nga ïa ki phyllaw jong ka , ngan shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong me , kumba nga ïa ki jingduwai jong ki angel kiba ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; If thou wilt walk in my ways , and if thou wilt keep my charge , then thou shalt also judge my house , and shalt also keep my courts , and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by .

translation.kha: Men sa ïap halor uta u lum kumba Aaron u u hynmen jong me u la ïap ha u Lum Hor ,
translation.en: And die in the mount whither thou goest up , and be gathered unto thy people  ; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor , and was gathered unto his people :

translation.kha: Lada jia ba phi lap ïa ka skum sim ha u dieng ne ha khyndew lem ïa ka sim kmie kaba pdem ïa pylleng kaba kdup khun , dei ban kem ïa sim kmie .
translation.en: If a bird s nest chance to be before thee in the way in any tree , or on the ground , whether they be young ones , or eggs , and the dam sitting upon the young , or upon the eggs , thou shalt not take the dam with the young :

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin roi kum skei symboh shyiap , bad ngan jin da Hanun pynthikna ba yn ym pynjot baseball ki da lei lei .
translation.en: Thy seed also had been as the sand , and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof  ; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me .

translation.kha: U Trai u la jubab , Me don pynskhem aïu ban bitar siat
translation.en: Then said the  Lord  , Doest thou well to be angry ?

translation.kha: lem bad u Elisaphan u khun jong u Ussiel u kum rangbah kur .
translation.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation : and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .
And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation , which I cast out before you : for they committed all these things , and therefore I abhorred them .
translation.kha: Wat bud ïa ki rukom im jong ki briew kiba shong hangta ; ngan beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew ki bymngeit Blei ba phin ïohrung ha kata ka ri . Nga isih eh ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jong ki baroh .

translation.en: I have raised up one from the north , and he shall come : from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name : and he shall come upon princes as upon mortar , and as the potter treadeth clay .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa u briew uba shong basah shaphang mihngi ; ngan wallam ïa u ban tur ïaleh na shaphang shatei . Un ïuh halor ki nongsynshar la kumba dei ka ktieh , kum u nongthaw khiew uba ïuh ïa ka dewbyrtha .

translation.en: These four were born to the giant in Gath , and fell by the hand of David , and by the hand of his servants .
translation.kha: Kine saw ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ramhah ka Gath , bad ki la shah pynïap ha u Dabid bad ha ki rangbah jong u .
Ka khun u lyngdoh eh” shongkurim bad u bym Methuselah na ka longïing lyngdoh kam lah ïathaw bam ïa kita ki jingkñia shahtehmraw kiba kyntang .
translation.en: If the priest s daughter also be married unto a stranger , she may not eat of an offering of the holy things .

translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la kylli ïa U Jisu , Balei ki nonghikai Aiñ ki ba Elijah la dei ban wan shuwa
translation.en: And his disciples asked him , saying , Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come ?

And when he had given him licence , Paul stood on the stairs , and beckoned with the hand unto the people . And when there was made a great silence , he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue , saying ,
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la shah ïa u , kumta u Paul u la ïeng halor ki mawkyrdon bad u la ai dak da ki kti jong u ha u paidbah ban sngap jar . Haba ki la sngap jar , u Paul u la kren ïa ki ha ka ktien Hebru :

translation.en: And it was so , when the days of their feasting were gone about , that Job sent and sanctified them , and rose up early in the morning , and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all : for Job said , It may be that my sons have sinned , and cursed God in their hearts . Thus did Job continually .
translation.kha: Ha man ka step kaba bud jong ka jingkhawai , u Job u ju khie dang step bad u ai ïa ki jingkñia na ka bynta iwei pa iwei na ki khun jong u ban pynkhuid ïa ki . U ju leh ïa kane borabor namar u pyrkhat ba ïoh iwei na ki i leh pop da kaba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei khlem poi pyrkhat .

translation.en: Yea , thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised , and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword .
translation.kha: Kata ka long ba kumno ïa ki Ijipt yn pynlwet hapdeng kiba khlem otsher kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: They have cut off my life in the dungeon , and cast a stone upon me .
translation.kha: Ki la bret im ïa nga shapoh ka thliew bad ki la khang ïa ka da u maw .

Suki pa suki un beh ïa kine ki jaitbynriew katba phi nang tur sha khmat . Phin ym lah ban pynduh lut ki shisyndon , namar lada phi leh kumta , mradkhlaw kin jyllei palat bad kin long ka jingma ïa phi .
translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little : thou mayest not consume them at once , lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee .
The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth : there was Abraham buried , and Sarah his wife .
translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka lyngkha kaba u Abraham u la thied na ki Hit , dei hangta ba la tep ïa u Abraham bad ïa ka tnga jong u ka Sarah .

translation.en: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof , and called them Havoth–jair .
translation.kha: U Jair uba na ka jait Manasseh u la tur ïaleh bad ïohknieh katto katne ki shnong bad u la khot kyrteng ïa ki  Ki shnong u Jair .

translation.en: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter : now his sons were with his cattle in the field : and Jacob held his peace until they were come .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la tip ba la pynkheiñ burom ïa ka khun jong u ; hynrei namar ba ki khun shynrang jong u ki dang don sha ki pyntha bad la ki jingri , um shym leh ei ei tad haduh ba kin da wan phai .
Ki la wanrah khyndiat ki soh ba ki shem hangta , bad ki la ïathuh ba ruh kata ka ri ïa kaba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u ai ha ngi ka long seisoh kaba bha .
translation.en: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands , and brought it down unto us , and brought us word again , and said , It is a good land which the  Lord  our God doth give us .

translation.kha: Sngap , u la ong ïa , ngi dang leit kaba U Khun U Briew yn sa aiti ha lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka . ban pynïap ïa u bad nangta kin aiti ïa u sha ki Jentil
translation.en: Saying ,  Behold , we go up to Jerusalem  ; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests , and unto the scribes  ; and they shall condemn him to death , and shall deliver him to the Gentiles :

translation.kha: Naba ïa ka briew la thaw na u briew , kumta ruh ïa u briew la kha ka briew ; bad dei U Blei uba pynlong ïa baroh .
translation.en: For as the woman is of the man , even so is the man also by the woman ; but all things of God .
( And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria . )
translation.kha: Haba kane ka jingkheiñbriew kaba nyngkong ka la jia , u Kyrinios u long u lyngskor jong ka Syria .

translation.en: Exalt ye the  Lord  our God , and worship at his footstool  ; for he is holy .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ; to mane ha khmat ka khet jong u ! Uba Khuid long ma u !
Wat na ka Sudan kaba sha jngai , ki briew jong nga kiba sakma la kin wallam ki jingainguh sha nga .
translation.en: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants , even the daughter of my dispersed , shall bring mine offering .
He sendeth the springs into the valleys , which run among the hills .
translation.kha: Me pynlong ïa ki umpohliew ban tuid sha ki them , bad ïa ki wah ba kin tuid hapdeng ki lum .

translation.en: As for these things which ye behold , the days will come , in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Kane baroh kaba phi ïohi — ka por kan poi ha kaba yn ym iehnoh hangne ïa uwei ruh u maw ha ka jaka ba u don ; ïa uwei uwei baroh yn bret sha tbian .

translation.en: But he answered and said ,  It is not meet to take the children s bread , and to cast it to dogs .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kam long kaba dei ban shim ïa ka jingbam jong ki khun bad bret ïa ka sha ki ksew .
Ki leh kumba ki jingmong jong ïakut briew jong nga ki long tang pynkhlaiñ jingtrud . ‘ Baroh ka bit ka biang ,’ ki ong , haba baroh kam bit kam ïasaid .
translation.en: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , Peace , peace  ; when there is no peace .

translation.kha: Ki nongbah ba la ker da ki kynroh ki long ka Siddim , ka Ser Adonisedek ka Hammath , ka Rakkath , ka Khinnereth ,
translation.en: And the fenced cities are Ziddim , Zer , and Hammath , Rakkath , and Chinnereth ,

translation.kha: Ha ka pynphai kaba lai jong ïingjah jingsynshar jlan u , u kmiesan ïa kine ki pyllaitluid synshar ban hikai Hanniel ïakhmih nongbah ka Judah : u Benhail , u sdien , u Sekharaïah , u Nethanel bad u Mikaïah .
translation.en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes , even to Ben–hail , and to Obadiah , and to Zechariah , and to Nethaneel , and to Michaiah , to teach in the cities of Judah .

And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying , Behold , the tabernacle of God is with men , and he will dwell with them , and they shall be his people , and God himself shall be with them , and be their God .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam kaba kren na ka khet :  Mynta ka ïing jong U Blei ka long bad u bynriew ! Un shong bad ki , bad kin long ki briew jong u . U Blei da lade hi un long bad ki , bad un long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Non his son , Jehoshua his son .
translation.kha: u Nun , u Joshua .

translation.en: And he took them the same hour of the night , and washed their stripes  ; and was baptized , he and all his , straightway .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka kynta jong ka miet , u nongpeit phatok u la ïalam ïa ki bad u la sait ïa ki jingmong jong ki ; bad shisyndon la pynbaptis ïa u lem bad ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: And when they were at Salamis , they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews : and they had also John to their minister .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha Salamis , ki la ïalap ïa ka ktien U Blei ha ki synagog . Ki la don lang bad ki u Ïoannis Markos ban ïarap ha ka kam .

translation.en: And all the people went to Gilgal  ; and there they made Saul king before the  Lord  in Gilgal  ; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the  Lord   ; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly .
translation.kha: Kumta ki ïaleit baroh sha Gilgal , bad hangta ha ka jaka kyntang ki pynbna ba u Saul u long u syiem . Ki kñia ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad u Saul bad ki paid Israel baroh ki ïalehkmen ha kane ka jingjia .

Kane ka thain ba U Trai u la ïarap ïa ki Israel ban ïohkynti — ki shnong Ataroth , Dibon , , Jaser Nimrah , Heshbon , Elealeh , , Sibmah Nebo Beon bad — ka long ka kaba jaka bha na ka bynta ki jingri , bad ngi don shibun bah ki jingri .
translation.en: Even the country which the  Lord  smote before the congregation of Israel , is a land for cattle , and thy servants have cattle :

Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy servants , and of thy people Israel , that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk , and give rain upon thy land , which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance .
translation.kha: To map ïa ka pop jong u syiem bad jong ki paid Israel . Hikai ïa ki ban leh ïa kaba dei . Nangta , A  Trai  to phah ïa u slap ha kane ka ri jong me , ïa kaba me la ai ha la ki jong ki briew kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki junom .

translation.en: I have digged , and drunk water  ; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places .
translation.kha: Me kob sarong ba me la tih ïa ki pukri bad dih um ha ki ri nongwei , bad ba ki kjat jong ki shipai jong me ki la ïuh ha ka wah Nile ba-rkhiang .

translation.en: But , behold , the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table .
translation.kha: Hynrei , ha khmih ! Uta uba shetkylla ïa nga u don hangne ha ka miej lem bad nga !
Ong ïa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka ba ynda ki ha ka , dei ban ïaid ha ki bad ban hajan rudwah
translation.en: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant , saying , When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan , ye shall stand still in Jordan .
He saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ? go and see .  And when they knew , they say , Five , and two fishes .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki ,  Katno phi don kpu ? Khie leit bad khmih .  Haba ki la shem , ki la ïathuh ïa u ,  San tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha ruh .
Ïa ki nongai jingmut bad ki nongleh myntor la wallam shapoh ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ïathuh ha nga ka kit jingmut , hynrei kim shym lah ban shem ïa ka jingmut .
translation.en: And now the wise men , the astrologers , have been brought in before me , that they should read this writing , and make known unto me the interpretation thereof : but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing :

translation.kha: U u sneng u briew da kaba phah ïa ka jingpang bad pyndap ka met u da ka jingshitom .
translation.en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed , and the multitude of his bones with strong pain :

translation.kha: bad u hukum yn ba hikai ïa ka ha ki briew ka Judah . ( La buh jingkynmaw ha Ka Kitab U Jashar . )
translation.en: ( Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow : behold , it is written in the book of Jasher . )

translation.kha: Ki ñiewbeiñ ki syiem bad ki rkhiebeiñ ki rangbah synshar ba-halor . Ym don ka kut kaba ban pynsangeh ki — ki kynton ïa khyndew pyrshah ïa ka bad ki knieh ïa ka .
translation.en: And they shall scoff at the kings , and the princes shall be a scorn unto them : they shall deride every strong hold  ; for they shall heap dust , and take it .

translation.kha: Me la pyn-i nga ha ïa ki lynti ïaid kiba ïalam ka sha jingim , bad ka jingdon ryngkat jong me kan pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkmen .’
translation.en: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life  ; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance .
Begin by getting an overall idea of the subject .
translation.kha: Nyngkong eh , pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingmut ba pura jong ka phang .
Mynba phi la mihnoh na ri Ijipt , nga la kular ba pynmeng long lem bad Ïuphratis borabor Rehabaïah ,44 dang long lem bad phi , kumta wat sheptieng .
translation.en: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt , so my spirit remaineth among you : fear ye not .

But he himself went a day s journey into the wilderness , and came and sat down under a juniper tree : and he requested for himself that he might die  ; and said , It is enough  ; now , O  Lord  , take away my life  ; for I am not better than my fathers .
translation.kha: U Elijah u ïaid baroh shi sngi ha ka ri khlaw . U la sangeh bad shong ha ka jingkah syrngiew u dieng bad u kwah tang ban ïap noh .  Ka la long palat , ko  Trai  ,  u la duwai .  Shim noh ïa ka jingim jong nga ; ka bha ïa nga ban ïap noh .

translation.en: The  Lord  talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire ,
translation.kha: Hangta halor u lum , U  Trai  u la kren ha phi markhmat napdeng ka ding .

Kumba u pynkyndit u parabriew Kine ïa u seiñ rnong ha u dieng ha ka ri shyiap , bakhlem proh ka batbit ka jingitynnat ïa U Khun U Briew ba yn kyntiew shajrong , ba uno khynwin Siphmoth snar ïapli u un ïoh ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have eternal life .
And Reuben answered them , saying , Spake I not unto you , saying , Do not sin against the child  ; and ye would not hear ? therefore , behold , also his blood is required .
translation.kha: U Reuben u ong ha ki ,  Ngam shym la ong ïa phi ban ym ktah kti ïa u para , hynrei phim shym shahshkor . Kumta ngi hap shahshitom kylla mynta namar kata ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely because my flock became a prey , and my flock became meat to every beast of the field , because there was no shepherd , neither did my shepherds search for my flock , but the shepherds fed themselves , and fed not my flock  ;
translation.kha: Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , phin kham bha ba phi shahshkor ïa nga . Ki langbrot jong nga ki la shah patar ha ki mradkhlaw kiba pynïap bad bam ïa ki namar bym don u nongsharai . Ki nongsharai jong nga kim shym la pyrshang ban wad ïa ki langbrot . Ki la sumar bha ïa lade bad ym ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: It is not good to eat much honey : so for men to search their own glory is not glory .
translation.kha: Kaba bam than ïa ka ngap kam bha ïa phi ; bad kumta ruh ka long kaba pyrshang ban ïoh palat ka jingïaroh .

translation.en: From whence come wars and fightings among you ? come they not hence , even of your lusts that war in your members ?
translation.kha: Nangno ki mih ki thma bad ki jingïakajia hapdeng jong phi ? Ki mih na ki jingkwah brai jong phi ïa ka jingsngewbha , kiba ïai ïaleh hapoh jong phi .

Ki Jether ki la shna ïa ki phyllaw bad ki shawkad ïingsyiem Amasa ki marpyrshah Paradais ki phyllaw kynram sngewlah shawkad ïap ka shongsuk jong nga , dambit kumta ka Gidom tang Pirathon kynroh hapdeng jong ngi . Ki la pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga byrngut baroh kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh pynjakhlia bad kumta ha “U Jehiel jong nga , nga la pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds , and their post by my posts , and the wall between me and them , they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed : wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger .

translation.kha: Um ju lane lute ïano ïano . U pynphai kaba nongshim ram buh bynda ; u ïa kiba thngan bad u ai jaiñ kiba lyngkhuit
translation.en: And hath not oppressed any , but hath restored to the debtor his pledge , hath spoiled none by violence , hath given his bread to the hungry , and hath covered the naked with a garment  ;

translation.kha: Nangta sa shisien pat nga dem khrup ha khmat U Trai sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , bad ngam shym la bam ne dih ei ei , namar ba phi la leh phiah pyrshah Nile U Trai bad phi la nongpynïaidkam ïa u .
translation.en: And I fell down before the  Lord  , as at the first , forty days and forty nights : I did neither eat bread , nor drink water , because of all your sins which ye sinned , in doing wickedly in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
And said unto them ,  Thus it is written , and thus it behoved Christ to suffer , and to rise from the dead the third day :
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba la thoh : U Messaïah u dei ban shahshitom bad u dei ban mihpat na ka jingïap hadien lai sngi ,
bad kan ym kut haduh ba un da leh ïa baroh kaba U thmu ban leh . Ha ki sngi ban wan ki U kin sngewthuh shai ïa kane .
translation.en: The anger of the  Lord  shall not return , until he have executed , and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart : in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly .

translation.kha: Meshakh phi kwah ban ïakynduh ïa u briew uba khraw ? Rah sha u ka nongmih sngewbha bad kan pynsuk ïa phi .
translation.en: A man s gift maketh room for him , and bringeth him before great men .
Now the Philistines fought against Israel  ; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain in mount Gilboa .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel halor u lum Gilboa . Shibun na ki Israel ki la shah pynïap hangta bad kiba sah na ki , kynthup ïa u syiem Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ki la phet ïap .
Kat kum ki jingbthah kiba jingtrud jong u Dabid , ïa baroh ki Lebi la buh jingthoh ba Kir shakri haba ki la dap arphew snem ka rta ,
translation.en: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above :
In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped , and thou shalt speak , and be no more dumb : and thou shalt be a sign unto them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi men ïoh pat ïa ka bor ban kren ïa kaba me la duh noh , bad men ïakren bad u . Ha kane ka rukom men long ka dak ïa ki briew , bad kin ïoh tip ba nga long U  Trai .
Hynrei nga la ong , ‘ Da lei lei ruh em , Trai ko ! Ym kano don kano ka jingbam ka kat bymkhuid kum ka jinglehniam lane kaba sang kaba la ju rung ha ka shyntur jong nga .’
translation.en: But I said , Not so , Lord : for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth .
And how shall they preach , except they be sent ? as it is written , How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace , and bring glad tidings of good things !
translation.kha: Bad kumno ïa ka khubor lah ban pynbna lada ïa ki nongrah-khubor ym shym la phah ? Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Katno ka long kaba phylla ka jingwan jong ki nongrah-khubor kiba wallam ïa ka khubor babha !

translation.en: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel : and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew phra jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Ahab u khun u Omri u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u la synshar arphew ar snem ha Samaria .

translation.en: So Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam , and Achbor , and Shaphan , and Asaiah , went unto Huldah the prophetess , the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah , the son of Harhas , keeper of the wardrobe  ; ( now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college  ; ) and they communed with her .
translation.kha: U Hilkaïah , u Ahikam , u Akhbor , u Shaphan , bad u Asaïah , ki leit ban kylli na ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Huldah , ka nongïathuhlypa , kaba shong ba sah ha ka jaka ba kham thymmai jong ka Jerusalem . ( U Shallum u tnga jong ka , u khun jong u Tikbah bad u ksiew jong u Harhas , uba dei khmih ïa ki barandi ka Templ . ) Ki batai ha ka , ïa kaei kaba la jia ,

translation.en: A faithful man shall abound with blessings : but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba lehhok kin ïoh ka jingim kaba kyrhai bad kaba suk . Hynrei lada phi long kyrkieh ban riewspah , phin ym lait na kaba shah pynshitom .

translation.en: And in every province , whithersoever the king s commandment and his decree came , there was great mourning among the Jews , and fasting , and weeping , and wailing  ; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes .
translation.kha: Ha baroh ki jylla , hangno hangno ba la pynbna paidbah ïa ka jingpynbna u syiem , la don ka jingsawa jong ka jingïambriew hapdeng ki Jiw . Ki shahjingit , ki ïam bad lynñiar bad bun na ki , ki phong jaiñ khain bad thiah ha u dpei .
U u la ong ha u , La don shisien uwei u briew uba la khreh ka jingkhawai kaba khraw ha kaba u la khot sngewbha bun ki
translation.en: Then said he unto him ,  A certain man made a great supper , and bade many :

translation.kha: Pynban , kum u syiem Jeroboam u shtah jong u soi uba ha umkhriat jong u Jael u la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban pei pop , bad um shym Pelataïah .
translation.en: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , which made Israel to sin  ; he departed not therefrom .

translation.kha: U la klet u Noah , bad ki baroh kiba lem bad u ha ka lieng ; u pynlong ïa lyer ban beh ka um ka la sdang hiar .
translation.en: And God remembered Noah , and every living thing , and all the cattle that was with him in the ark : and God made a wind to pass over the earth , and the waters assuaged  ;

translation.kha: Un shim noh ïa ki jingkynshew ksiar bad rupa ba la buhrieh jong ka Ijipt bad ïa kiwei kiwei ki jingdon jingem jong ka kiba la eh ñiewkordor . Un ïa hiarthma ka Libya bad ka Sudan .
translation.en: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver , and over all the precious things of Egypt : and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps .
And they brought up the ark of the  Lord  , and the tabernacle of the congregation , and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle , even those did the priests and the Levites bring up .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi bad ki lyngdoh ruh ki pynkynriah noh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad ki tiar ki tar baroh jong ka sha ka Templ .

translation.en: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul :
translation.kha: U Blei u la leh ki kambah kiba kham phylla lyngba u Paul .
Kumta u Dabid u ïa iehnoh la u kpa bad ka ha kmie u syiem Moab , bad ki la sah hangta katba u Dabid u dang rieh ha ka krem .
translation.en: And he brought them before the king of Moab : and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold .

translation.kha: Ka shithi kaba u rah ka ong : ka Kane shithi kan pynithuh ïa u Naaman , rangbah u pynïaidkam jong nga . Nga kwah ïa phi ban pynkhiah ïa u na ka jingpang jong u .
translation.en: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel , saying , Now when this letter is come unto thee , behold , I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee , that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy .

The Chaldeans answered before the king , and said , There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king s matter : therefore there is no king , lord , nor ruler , that asked such things at any magician , or astrologer , or Chaldean .
translation.kha: Ki nongai jingmut ki la jubab ,  Ym don mano mano ha sla pyrthei kiba lah ban ïathuh ïa u Syiem Kynrad ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban tip . Ym don u syiem , ym don wat uba khraw tam bad uba donbor tam , uba la pynlong kum kane ka jingdawa na ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor bad ki nongleh byrtong .

translation.en: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel :
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa U Jisu Khrist , uba la mihpat na ka jingïap , uba la hiarpateng na u Dabid , kumba la hikai ha ka Khubor Babha kaba nga ïalap .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations  ; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pyndonkam ïa ka bor bakhuid jong u ; un pynim ïa la ki briew , bad ka pyrthei baroh kan ïohi ïa kata .

translation.en: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah , and smote the host : for the host was secure .
translation.kha: U Gideon u ïaid na ka lynti na ki tduh jong ka ri shyiap , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Nobah bad ka Jogbehah , bad u la tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai ha kaba kim shym poi pyrkhat .
Kumta haba kane ka jia , bad ïa kaba dei ban ïap pynkylla sha ka bym dei ban , ka Jingthoh kan urlong shisha : Ïa jingïap la thiaw ; ka jingjop ka la long kaba pura!
translation.en: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption , and this mortal shall have put on immortality , then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written , Death is swallowed up in victory .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka Jerusalem ka la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki hukum jong nga , ka da pynpaw ba ka long kaba kham sniew Amnon ‘Ki kiwei pat ki ri , ka Ai long bymkohnguh kham palat ïa ki ri kiba don sawdong jong ka barhem Ka Bar ka la kyntait ïa lang! kaw jong nga bad kam kohnguh kamai ïa ki aiñ jong nga .
translation.en: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations , and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her : for they have refused my judgments and my statutes , they have not walked in them .

translation.kha: Ha kylleng ka ri , ïa ka hok bad ka jingbishar hok , yn pyndep .
translation.en: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness , and righteousness remain in the fruitful field .
But glory , honour , and peace , to every man that worketh good , to the Jew first , and also to the Gentile :
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei un ai ka burom , ka nam babha bad ka jingsuk ïa baroh kiba leh ïa kaei kaba bha , ïa ki Jiw nyngkong bad ïa ki Jentil ruh .
Nangta ki la tap ïa ki jaiñkup jong halor ki u khun kada bad ki la ïarap ïa U Jisu ban kiew halor jong u .
translation.en: And they brought him to Jesus : and they cast their garments upon the colt , and they set Jesus thereon .

translation.kha: Hamar ba mih , u Lot u la poi Soar .
translation.en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar .

translation.kha: Nga tip ka , la jubab , ba un sa mihpat ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .
translation.en: Martha saith unto him , I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day .
And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim , even unto Gaza , the Caphtorims , which came forth out of Caphtor , destroyed them , and dwelt in their stead . )
translation.kha: Ka jaka harud ka Duriaw Mediterranian ka long kaba shong da ki Kaphtorim kiba wan na ka dewlynnong Krit . Kine ki la pynjot ïa ki Abbim kiba dei ki trai jaka , bad ki knieh lut ïa ka ri jong ki haduh ka shnong Gasa kaba shaphang shathie . )

translation.en: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron : and the whole congregation said unto them , Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt ! or would God we had died in this wilderness !
translation.kha: Ki la khñium pyrshah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad ki ong ,  Kan jin da la kham bha ban ïap ha Ijipt lane wat hangne ha ka ri khlaw !

translation.en: And they said , Thy servants are twelve brethren , the sons of one man in the land of Canaan  ; and , behold , the youngest is this day with our father , and one is not .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Kynrad , baroh ngi ïadon khat-ar ngut shi para , ki khun jong ujuh u briew ha ka ri Kanaan . Uwei u para u la ïap , bad uba khatduh u don mynta bad i pa .

u ong , Sumar dkhiew shekel kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh kiba nga la ai hajir dawai Atroth ka sngi . Ïathuh ïa ki ha ki khun ayu kti Seraïah Jingthoh , duh ki ruh kin ïai kohnguh ïa baroh Truphosa jinghikai jong U Blei .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day , which ye shall command your children to observe to do , all the words of this law .

translation.kha: Wat tuh lane shukor lane lamler .
translation.en: Ye shall not steal , neither deal falsely , neither lie one to another .

translation.kha: Nga la u Seraïah , Haba poi ha Babilon , pynthikna ban pule jam ki ïa kiei kiei ba la thoh hangne .
translation.en: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah , When thou comest to Babylon , and shalt see , and shalt read all these words  ;

translation.kha: Ka rnong ba la pynkyntang sha U ka don hapdeng ka bathymmai bad ka Templ , te u pynkynriah noh ka sha ka bynta bashaneng jong ka duwan bathymmai .
translation.en: And he brought also the brasen altar , which was before the  Lord  , from the forefront of the house , from between the altar and the house of the  Lord  , and put it on the north side of the altar .
And he brought the meat offering , and took an handful thereof , and burnt it upon the altar , beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning .
translation.kha: U kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam bad u shim shi kham u purew bad u thang ïa u halor ka duwan . ( Kane ka long nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi . )
Jngai na kaba ki briew ki shong ki sah ; lane ba ki kjat briew ki ju ïaid , ki briew ki tih ïa ki thliew ha ki . par Hangta ki trei ha ka jingkynjah marwei , da kaba sdien ïa ki tyllai ha ki thliew .
translation.en: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant  ; even the waters forgotten of the foot : they are dried up , they are gone away from men .

translation.kha: Ki jait Manasseh kim shym la beh noh ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha Beth Shan , Taanakh , Dor , Ibleam , Megiddo bad ha ki nongrit kiba hajan ; ki Kanaan ki dang shong hangta .
translation.en: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth–shean and her towns , nor Taanach and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns : but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .

translation.kha: Hynrei uta u briew u la bad leit u la sdang ban pynphriang ïa ka khubor kylleng . Ha ka jingshisha , u la ïathuh ha baroh haduh ba U Jisu um lah shuh ban shapoh rung shnong ha kaba paw paidbah . Hynrei , U la shong noh ha ki jaka kynjah , ki bad ki briew la ïawan sha u na kylleng .
translation.en: But he went out , and began to publish it much , and to blaze abroad the matter , insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city , but was without in desert places : and they came to him from every quarter .

translation.kha: Dei namar jong phi ba U Trai U jong la bitar ïa nga bad la kren da kaba shai ba ngan ym ïoh jam ïa ka wah ban leit sha kata ka ri kaba seisoh u kum ka jong phi .
translation.en: Furthermore the  Lord  was angry with me for your sakes , and sware that I should not go over Jordan , and that I should not go in unto that good land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance :

translation.kha: la Kane ka jia namar ki pop jong u pyrshah ïa U Trai . Kum u Jeroboam uba ha shuwa jong u , u la pynsngewsih ïa U Trai ki da pop jong u hi bad da kaba ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translation.en: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the  Lord  , in walking in the way of Jeroboam , and in his sin which he did , to make Israel to sin .
He is ‘ the god of this world .’—2 Corinthians 4 :4 .
translation.kha: U dei ‘ u blei jong kane ka pyrthei .’—2 Korinth 4 :4 .
U Trai u long u syiem junom . Blei U jong pha , ko Seïon , un baroh synshar shi rta . To ïaroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: The  Lord  shall reign for ever , even thy God , O Zion , unto all generations . Praise ye the  Lord .
