translation.en: ( For my father fought for you , and adventured his life far , and delivered you out of the hand of Midian :
If ye know that he is righteous , ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba U Khrist u long uba hok ; phi dei ban tip , namarkata , ba uei uei baroh uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei u long u khun U Blei .
Hynrei ma nga , U Trai U Blei jong phi uba la ïalam ïa phi na Ijipt , ngan pynlong ïasnohkti pynher ban sah biang ha ki ïingjaiñ , kumba phi la leh ïunukh Wan wan Dammim phi pynpur ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: And I that am the  Lord  thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles , as in the days of the solemn feast .

translation.kha: Kumta Sheshbassar u u la wan bad buh ïa ka nongrim jong ka ; ka jingtrei ka la ïaid naduh kata ka por haduh mynta , ym hynrei pat pyndep ïa ka Templ .’
translation.en: Then came the same Sheshbazzar , and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem : and since that time even until now hath it been in building , and yet it is not finished .
But prophesy not again any more at Beth–el : for it is the king s chapel , and it is the king s court .
translation.kha: Wat ïathuhlypa shuh hangne ha Bethel . Kane ka dei ka jaka mane Blei jong u syiem , ka Templ jong ka hima .

Ngi la leh ïa kaei kaba U Trai U Blei jong kloi u la hukum ïa ngi . Ngi mih na u Lum Sinai bad ngi ïaid lyngba ïa ka Gathrimmon shyiap kaba jinglute bad ba-ima sha ka ri lum Amor . Ynda ngi poi ha Kadesh Semakhaïah ,
translation.en: And when we departed from Horeb , we went through all that great and terrible wilderness , which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites , as the  Lord  our God commanded us  ; and we came to Kadesh–barnea .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Maroth ki ap da ka jinglyng-a ïa ka jingïarap , namar ba U Trai la u wallam ka ïa jingjot sha jan ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good : but evil came down from the  Lord  unto the gate of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U la ïa bthah ki ban ong , Nga u Jakob , u shakri bakohnguh jong phi , nga pyntip ha u kynrad jong nga u Iso ba la nga shong la sah bad u Laban bad , nga la pynslem ban wan phai haduh mynta .
translation.en: And he commanded them , saying , Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau  ; Thy servant Jacob saith thus , I have sojourned with Laban , and stayed there until now :
Fulfil ye my joy , that ye be likeminded , having the same love , being of one accord , of one mind .
translation.kha: Te , nga kyrpad ïa phi , ban pynshlei ïa ka jingkmen jong nga da kaba don kijuh ki jingpyrkhat , kiba ïasam ïa kajuh ka jingieit , bad kiba don kawei ka mynsiem bad ka jingmut .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them  ; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ki syiem jong kiba mane blei thala ki don ka bor halor ki briew jong ki , bad ki nongsynshar ki kam ïa ka nam ba ki dei ‘ Ki paralok jong u Paidbah .’
Baroh ki la rkhie ïa u , ryntih ki la tip tyngab ka la jingkhie Harim
translation.en: And they laughed him to scorn , knowing that she was dead .
For this shall the earth mourn , and the heavens above be black : because I have spoken it , I have purposed it , and will not repent , neither will I turn back from it .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kan ïam sngewsih ; ka sahit bneng kan sdang dum . U  Trai  u la kren bad un ym kylla ïa ka jingmut jong u . U la pynlong ïa ka jingrai jong u bad un ym kylla dien .
Lada dei na uwei ki riewpaidbah uba leh pop khlem tip bad u long uba la rem ba pynkheiñ u ïa kawei na ki hukum U Trai ,
translation.en: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance , while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which ought not to be done , and be guilty  ;

translation.kha: Mynta wat , pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa nga . Nga bitar ïa ki , bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa . ki Nangta ngan pynlong ïa me bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .
translation.en: Now therefore let me alone , that my wrath may wax hot against them , and that I may consume them : and I will make of thee a great nation .
But the angel of the  Lord  stood in a path of the vineyards , a wall being on this side , and a wall on that side .
translation.kha: Nangta uta u angel u ïeng ha ka lynti kaba khim kaba don hapdeng ar tylli ki bri sohwaiñ ba la ker da ka kynroh maw baroh arliang .
A Trai , nga lah ban ïohi ïa ki jong ki ba ki beh kthong bad shah pynïap .
translation.en: Ephraim , as I saw Tyre , is planted in a pleasant place : but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer .

translation.kha: Phi shisha phi la thmu sniew ïa Maher-shalal-hash-bas , hynrei U Blei mynsngi la pynphai ïa kata sha kaba kharai , Abraham ba bun ki briew kiba dang im mynta Jagur jar im namar kaba la jia .
translation.en: But as for you , ye thought evil against me  ; but God meant it unto good , to bring to pass , as it is this day , to save much people alive .

translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ka met jong nga ki , bad ki thied bad me la tap ïa shyieng da ki ksah bad ka sniehdoh .
translation.en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh , and hast fenced me with bones and sinews .

translation.kha: U Ktien la kylla long u bad briew , uba dap da ka jingaiei bad ka jingshisha , u la im hapdeng jong . ngi Ngi la ïa ïohi ka burom jong u , ka burom kaba u la ïohpdiang kum U Khun marwei jong U Kpa .
translation.en: And the Word was made flesh , and dwelt among us , ( and we beheld his glory , the glory as of the only begotten of the Father , ) full of grace and truth .
But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings , that pertain unto the  Lord  , having his uncleanness upon him , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .
translation.kha: hynrei uno uno ïa uba la ñiew bymkhuid u bam ïa ka , yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew U Blei .
Kane ka jaitbynriew ka long kum u sing uba khlaiñ ; Haba u thiah , ym don ba nud ban ïa kyrsiew u . Uta uba kyrkhu ïa ki un Israel ïoh jingkyrkhu , Bad uba uta tim ïa ki Israel un ïoh ka jingtim .
translation.en: He couched , he lay down as a lion , and as a great lion : who shall stir him up ? Blessed is he that blesseth thee , and cursed is he that curseth thee .
But what saith it ? The word is nigh thee , even in thy mouth , and in thy heart : that is , the word of faith , which we preach ;
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ka ong ka long kane :  Ka khubor U Blei ka don hajan jong phi , ha ki rmiang shyntur jong phi bad ha ka dohnud jong phi  — kata , ka khubor jong ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïalap .

translation.en: The bloodthirsty hate the upright : but the just seek his soul .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba thrang snam ki isih ïa uno uno uba lehhok , hynrei ki briew bahok kin ïada ïa ka jingim jong kum uta u briew .

translation.en: ( The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them  ; ) he was of Arimathaea , a city of the Jews : who also himself waited for the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: La don u briew uba kyrteng u Joseph na Arimathaïa , ka shnong kaba ha Judia . U la long u briew uba bha bad uba donburom , uba la apkhmih ïa ka jingwan jong ka Hima U Blei . Wat la u long u dkhot jong ka Dorbar , um shym la mynjur bad ka jingrai bad jingleh jong ki .

translation.en: And hath not oppressed any , but hath restored to the debtor his pledge , hath spoiled none by violence , hath given his bread to the hungry , and hath covered the naked with a garment  ;
translation.kha: Um ju shukor lane lute ïano ïano . U pynphai ïa kaei kaba u nongshim ram u buh bynda ; u bsa ïa kiba thngan bad u ai jaiñ ïa kiba lyngkhuit .
U ha Samson , Nga nang pyrkhat ba me isih , te kumta nga la ai noh ïa ka ha paralok jong me Hynrei kam pher , ka para jong ka , ka kham ban ïa ka . Me lah ban shim noh ka .
translation.en: And her father said , I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her  ; therefore I gave her to thy companion : is not her younger sister fairer than she ? take her , I pray thee , instead of her .
A time to kill , and a time to heal  ; a time to break down , and a time to build up  ;
translation.kha: ka por ban pynïap bad ka por ban pynkhiah , ka por ban pynkhyllem bad ka por ban tei .

translation.en: And she had a sister called Mary , which also sat at Jesus  feet , and heard his word .
translation.kha: Ka don kawei ka para kaba kyrteng ka Mari , kaba la shong hajan ki kjat jong U Trai bad ka la pynshahshkor ïa ka jinghikai jong u .

translation.en: And if a man take a wife and her mother , it is wickedness : they shall be burnt with fire , both he and they  ; that there be no wickedness among you .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shongkurim ïa ka briew bad sa ïa ka kmie jong ka , dei ban thang im ïa ki baroh lai ngut , ba kan duh kan dam ka kam sniew hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites .
translation.kha: U mane ïa ka Astarte ka blei ki Sidon , bad ïa u Molekh u blei ba-ijli jong ki Ammon .

translation.en: When the king of Babylon s army fought against Jerusalem , and against all the cities of Judah that were left , against Lachish , and against Azekah : for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai ka dang tur ïaleh ruh ïa ka Lakhish bad ka Asekah , kiba long tang ma ki kiwei pat ki nongbah ba la tei kynroh kiba dang sah jong ka Judah .
Ka pyrthei bad kaei kaei baroh kaba don ka , ki briew ki kan noh ; hynrei kito kiba leh ïa mon U Blei kin im junom .
translation.en: And the world passeth away , and the lust thereof : but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever .
Then Simon himself believed also : and when he was baptized , he continued with Philip , and wondered , beholding the miracles and signs which were done .
translation.kha: U Simon hi ruh u la ngeit ; bad hadien ba la pynbaptis ïa u , u la bud ha kti ha kjat ïa u Philip bad u la sngewlyngngoh haba u la ïohi ïa ki kamphylla bad ki kambah ïa kiba la leh .

translation.en: In transgressing and lying against the  Lord  , and departing away from our God , speaking oppression and revolt , conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa me , kyntait ïa me , bad ngim treh ban bud ïa me . Ngi la banbeiñ ïa kiwei bad phai lyndet na me . Ki jingmut jong ngi ki long kiba bakla ; ki ktien jong ngi ki long kiba lamler .
Haba u Solomon ïohsngew ïa kaei u Shimei u la leh
translation.en: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath , and was come again .

And the border went over from thence toward Luz , to the side of Luz , which is Beth–el , southward  ; and the border descended to Ataroth–adar , near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth–horon .
translation.kha: Nangta u suh sha ka sharing lum ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Lus ( kaba la khot ruh ka Bethel ) , nangta arsut shaduh Ataroth Addar , ha u lum uba shathie na ka Beth Horon kaba sharum .
To kynmaw ba u briew uba bet tang ki symbai un ïoh ot ruh ; uta uba shibun ki symbai un ïoh ot ruh shibun .
translation.en: But this I say , He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly ; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully .

translation.kha: Nangta uwei “ka ki Beor tylli ki kherub u la ai ha ki hynñiew ngut ki shajrong ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang ksiar ba la pyndap da :4 jingbitar jingibieit U Blei , uba im junom la junom .
translation.en: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God , who liveth for ever and ever .
To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets , whom I sent unto you , both rising up early , and sending them , but ye have not hearkened  ;
translation.kha: bad da kaba pynshahshkor ïa ki kyntien jong ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong nga , kiba nga la ju ïai phah sha phi . Phim pat ju kohnguh ïa kaei kaba ki la ong .

translation.en: For I , saith the  Lord  , will be unto her a wall of fire round about , and will be the glory in the midst of her .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la lah kular ba ma u hi un long ka kynroh ding sawdong ïa ka nongbah ban ïada ïa ka bad ba un shong un sah hangta ha ka burom jong u baroh .

translation.en: And whether one member suffer , all the members suffer with it ; or one member be honoured , all the members rejoice with it .
translation.kha: Lada kawei ka dkhot jong ka met ka shitom , baroh kiwei pat ki dkhot met ki ïashitom lem bad ka ; lada kawei ka dkhot met ka ïoh jingïaroh , baroh kiwei pat ki dkhot met ki ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingkmen .

translation.en: For if that which is done away was glorious , much more that which remaineth is glorious .
translation.kha: Naba lada la don ka burom ha kata kaba la neh tang shipor , kaba haduh katno keiñ ka burom ka don ha kata kaba neh junom !
la thoh jinghikai bym ñiew shuh na bynta briew , hynrei ki kyntait ïa ki kaei kaei kaba khyllah bad long nongwei
translation.en: I have written to him the great things of my law , but they were counted as a strange thing .
And Adonijah feared because of Solomon , and arose , and went , and caught hold on the horns of the altar .
translation.kha: U Adonijah , ha ka jingsheptieng bakhraw ïa u Solomon , u la leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad u la bat ïa ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan .
Te Trai u ha u , Ki don ki jingkynnoh pyrshah kiba jur Sodom bad Gomorrah , bad ka pop jong ki ka long kaba katta .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great , and because their sin is very grievous  ;
He looketh upon men , and if any say , I have sinned , and perverted that which was right , and it profited me not  ;
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un ong ha kaba ïohsngew paidbah ,  Nga la leh pop . Ngam shym la leh kaba dei , hynrei U Blei u la pyllait ïa nga .

translation.en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land , and devoured the fruit of their ground .
translation.kha: ki la ïabam ïa baroh ki jingthung ha ka ri ; bad ki la ïabam ïa baroh ki jingthung ba long jingbam .

translation.en: Where is the wise ? where is the scribe ? where is the disputer of this world ? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world ?
translation.kha: hangno don kiba stad ? hangno don ki riewshemphang ? hangno don ki nongïatainia batbit jong kane ka pyrthei ? U Blei u la pyn-i ba ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei ka long ka jingibieit !
Te u la leit sha Templ ka , u buh ïa ka shithi hangta ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai , bad u duwai ,
translation.en: And Hezekiah prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: Suit ïa ka da ka ksiar , bad da ka ksiar baroh jong ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , and make thereto a crown of gold round about .
Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings , I will not accept them : neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts .
translation.kha: Haba phi wallam sha nga ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh bam jong phi , ngan ym pdiang ïa ki ; ngan ym pdiang ïa ki jingri ba phi la pynsngaid ban wallam sha nga kum ki jingainguh .
Nga la ïohpateng ïa kane ka bri sohwaiñ na ki kpa tymmen jong . nga U Naboth u jubab . U Trai khang u ba ngan ai ïa ka ha phi .
translation.en: And Naboth said to Ahab , The  Lord  forbid it me , that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee .
That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart , because they are all estranged from me through their idols .
translation.kha: Kito ki bleithaw baroh ki la pynphai noh ïa ki Israel na nga , hynrei da ka jubab jong nga , nga kyrmen ban ïoh pat ïa ka jingshaniah jong ki .

Kumba sngewrem Trai misteri Nebat krem ïa u kyrni , la ai shi bynta na mian Er jong Sinai Judah ha u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh ïalaw na ka jait Judah une shipawa la ïohpdiang ïa ka Hebron , ka nongbah kaba dei jong u Arba , u kpa jong jali Anak Jona
translation.en: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah , according to the commandment of the  Lord  to Joshua , even the city of Arba the father of Anak , which city is Hebron .
Wherefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will do judgment upon her graven images : and through all her land the wounded shall groan .
translation.kha: Te nangta , nga ong ba ka por ka poi ba ngan leh ei ei ïa ki bleithaw jong ka Babilon , bad kiba mynsaw kin ud ha ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest , and thou shalt put them in the ark .
translation.kha: Wan kiew sha nga ha uta u lum , bad ngan thoh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa kito ki ktien kiba nga la thoh ha ki mawlyngkniap ïa kiba me la lynthaw , bad nangta men buh ïa ki ha kata ka synduk .’

translation.en: Pilate saith unto him , What is truth ? And when he had said this , he went out again unto the Jews , and saith unto them , I find in him no fault at all .
translation.kha: Bad kaei kata ka jingshisha ?  u Pilat u la kylli . Nangta u Pilat u la mihpat shabar sha ki paidbah bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ngam lap kano kano ka daw ban pynrem ïa u .

translation.en: Yea , also I continued in the work of this wall , neither bought we any land : and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work .
translation.kha: Nga sei ïa ka bor jong nga baroh na ka bynta ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh bad ngam shym wad ban ïoh kano kano ka jingdon jingem . Baroh kiba trei na ka bynta jong nga , ki ïasnoh ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh .
Pyntyllun noh ïa u mawkhang ! U Jisu u la Ka hukum . Martha , ka hynmen uta la uba ïap , ka la jubab , Kan sa don ka jingsma iwtung , ko Trai . La lah tep ïa u la saw sngi .
translation.en: Jesus said ,  Take ye away the stone .  Martha , the sister of him that was dead , saith unto him , Lord , by this time he stinketh : for he hath been dead four days .

translation.kha: Ha baroh kaba u leh u long uba ïaineh bad uba Jar ; ki hukum jong u baroh ki long ba-bieit lah ban shaniah .
translation.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment  ; all his commandments are sure .

translation.kha: U Eser u , khun jong u Jeshua , u nongsynshar jong Mispah ka , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud kaba long ha ka khmat jaka buh tiar ïapom , haduh ka jaka ha kaba ka kynroh ka phai ;
translation.en: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua , the ruler of Mizpah , another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall .

translation.kha: U Blei u la jied ïa ki nong Israel ban long ki nongsakhi jong . u
translation.en: God chose the Israelites to be his witnesses .

translation.kha: Pule ïa ka Baibl bad ngi .
translation.en: Study the Bible with us .

translation.kha: bad u bthah Ahikam u nonglamktien , Hadien ba phi jingshan ïathuh ha u syiem ïa baroh shaphang ka baje ,
translation.en: And charged the messenger , saying , When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king ,
Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand , Depart from me , ye cursed , into everlasting fire , prepared for the devil and his angels :
translation.kha: Nangta un ong ha kito kiba ha ka liang kadiang jong u , ‘ Khie leit noh na nga , phi kiba hapoh ka jingtim jong U Blei ! Khie leit noh sha ka ding bymjukut ïa kaba la pynkhreh na ka bynta u Ksuid bad ki angel jong u !

translation.en: For there is not a just man upon earth , that doeth good , and sinneth not .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba leh ïa kaba bha ha ki por baroh bad u bym ju leh bakla .

translation.en: And he said unto them , What counsel give ye that we may answer this people , who have spoken to me , saying , Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter ?
translation.kha: Kaei phi ai jingmut ïa nga ban leh ?  U kylli .  Kaei ngan ong ïa ki briew kiba kyrpad ïa nga ban pynsting ïa ki jingkit jong ki ?

translation.en: Now we have received , not the spirit of the world , but the spirit which is of God ; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God .
translation.kha: Ngim shym ïohpdiang ïa u mynsiem jong kane ka pyrthei , pynban , ngi lah ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem ba la phah da U Blei , khnang ba ngin lah ban tip ïa baroh kaba U Blei u la ai ha ngi .

translation.en: For David said , The  Lord  God of Israel hath given rest unto his people , that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever :
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ,  U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel u la ai ka jingsuk ha la ki briew , bad u hi un shong junom ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed , and thou shalt possess it  ; and he will do thee good , and multiply thee above thy fathers .
translation.kha: khnang ba phin ïoh kam kynti biang ïa kata ka ri ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la shong shisien . Un pynmanbha bad un pynroi ïa phi kham bun shah ban ïa kaba u la leh ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
u lah ban ong ha u , Me long u nongkyrshan bad nongïada jong nga , jingpynrem long U Blei jong nga ; ha me nga shaniah .
translation.en: I will say of the  Lord  , He is my refuge and my fortress : my God  ; in him will I trust .

translation.kha: :18 hadien ba u Sedekaïah iar khun jong u lute basa oh-shrong u syiem ka Judah , U Trai u la ong Iim nga
translation.en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
The people asked , and he brought quails , and satisfied them with the bread of heaven .
translation.kha: Ki pan , bad u phah ïa ki syiar khlaw ; u ai ïa ki ka jingbam na bneng ban pynhun ïa ki .

Ka jingïakajia ka la jingkhriat haduh katta katta ba u rangbah sngewdap hukum u la sheptieng ïoh ba kin tar lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa Rephaim Paul . Kumta u hukum ïa ki Bar jong u ban leit sha ka kynhun , ban shim noh i-ieit u Hodabaïah na ki , bad ïalam ïa u shapoh ka kut shipai Kingdom
translation.en: And when there arose a great dissension , the chief captain , fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them , commanded the soldiers to go down , and to take him by force from among them , and to bring him into the castle .

translation.kha: Ngin leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la ngi ban ong leh . Ngin ai ki ïa sha jingkñia ka blei jong ngi , ka Syiem jong ka Bneng , bad ngin theh ïa ki jingainguh sha waiñ ka , kumba ma ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u syiem jong ngi bad ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki la ju leh ha ki shnong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah Jerusalem ka . Nangta ngi don ka bam kyrhai , ngi , manbha bad ngim ju don jingjynjar .
translation.en: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth , to burn incense unto the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , as we have done , we , and our fathers , our kings , and our princes , in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem : for then had we plenty of victuals , and were well , and saw no evil .

translation.kha: Long beit phi pyn-i ba phi don jingtiengburom U Trai long kynriang bad phi pyn-i ba phim don ïa kata .
translation.en: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the  Lord  : but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him .

And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead , If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon , and the  Lord  deliver them before me , shall I be your head ?
translation.kha: U Jephthah u ong ha ki ,  Lada phi ïalam biang ïa nga sha ïing ban ïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa nga , nga dei ban long u nongsynshar jong phi .
Bad lada uno uno u briew u ong , ei ei ïathuh ha u , ‘ U Kynrad u donkam ïa ki ;’ bad nangta un sa pyllait ïa ki shisyndon .
translation.en: And if any man say ought unto you , ye shall say , The Lord hath need of them  ; and straightway he will send them .
For God , who commanded the light to shine out of darkness , hath shined in our hearts , to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: U Blei uba la ong ,  Na ka jingdum ka jingshai kan tyngshaiñ!  u long ujuh U Blei uba la pynlong ïa ka jingshai jong u ban tyngshaiñ ha ki dohnud jong ngi , ban wanrah ha ngi ïa ka jingtip shaphang ka burom U Blei kaba tyngshaiñ ha U Khrist .
Mamre haba nga la sdang ban kren , U Methuselah Bakhuid u la wan hiar halor jong ki kumba riewkhuid Troas Tiberios halor jong ngi ha kaba sdang .
translation.en: And as I began to speak , the Holy Ghost fell on them , as on us at the beginning .
For what nation is there so great , who hath God so nigh unto them , as the  Lord  our God is in all things that we call upon him for ?
translation.kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , la ka khraw katno katno , kaba don u blei uba hajan kum U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , haba ki donkam ïa u . Man ka por ba ngi khot kyrpad ïa u , u jubab ïa ngi .
U angel la jubab U Mynsiem Bakhuid un sa wan ha , bad ka bor jong Blei kan shong halor jong pha . Na kane ka daw , i khunlung bakhuid khot U Khun U Blei .
translation.en: And the angel answered and said unto her , The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee , and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee : therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God .
Rejoicing in hope ; patient in tribulation ; continuing instant in prayer ;
translation.kha: To ai ba ka jingkyrmen jong phi kan pynkmen ïa phi , to long kiba ïaishah ha ki jingjynjar jong phi , bad to duwai ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee , and our sins testify against us : for our transgressions are with us  ; and as for our iniquities , we know them  ;
translation.kha: A  Trai  , ki kam runar jong ngi pyrshah ïa me ki long kiba bun . Ki pop jong ngi hi ki pynrem ïa ngi . Ngi tip bha ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan , and Ishui , and Malchi–shua : and the names of his two daughters were these  ; the name of the firstborn Merab , and the name of the younger Michal :
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Saul ki long u Jonathan , u Ishbi , bad u Malkhishua . Ka khun kynthei baheh jong u ka kyrteng ka Merab , bad kaba kham rit ka Mikhal .

translation.en: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted . I do send thee unto them  ; and thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ki long kiba mutlop bad kim burom ïa nga , kumta nga phah ïa me sha ki bad men ong ha ki , ïa kaei kaba ma nga U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki .

Ha kane ka por ki Israel ki la palat jingthngan , bad kumta ki kynrup ïa kata la ïohknieh na ki nongshun , shim ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri , ki la pynïap ïa ki hangta , bad ki la bam ka doh dang don snam hapoh jong ka .
translation.en: And the people flew upon the spoil , and took sheep , and oxen , and calves , and slew them on the ground : and the people did eat them with the blood .
Then said the woman , Whom shall I bring up unto thee ? And he said , Bring me up Samuel .
translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka kylli ,  Ïano ngan khot na ka bynta jong phi ?   Ïa u Samuel ,  u jubab .
Kumta u syiem u la hukum ïa u Ebedmelekh ban shim bad u ngut lai ki rangbah bad ban tan ïa noh nga na ka pung shuwa ba ngan ïap .
translation.en: Then the king commanded Ebed–melech the Ethiopian , saying , Take from hence thirty men with thee , and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon , before he die .
And if she had at all an husband , when she vowed , or uttered ought out of her lips , wherewith she bound her soul  ;
translation.kha: Lada ka kynthei ka bym pat shongkurim ka pynlong ka jingkular , da kaba mut khnang ne khlem da pyrkhat ban kyndiah na kano kano bad nangta ka shongkurim ,
Nga la khynñiuh ; phi la pynlong ïa nga ban thrang proh ïa ka jingieit kum khawpud nongñiah kali ïapom u thrang ïa ka thma .
translation.en: Let us get up early to the vineyards  ; let us see if the vine flourish , whether the tender grape appear , and the pomegranates bud forth : there will I give thee my loves .
But put forth thine hand now , and touch all that he hath , and he will curse thee to thy face .
translation.kha: Hynrei tharai mynta me shim noh na u baroh kiba u don — un tim ïa me markhmat !

Hadien ba U Trai u la pynkyrpang ka Israel na ka Judah , ki Israel ki pynlong ïa u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat kum u syiem jong ki . U Jeroboam pynlong ïa ki ban iehnoh noh ïa Trai bad u la ïalam ïa ki ban leh ïa ki pop kiba shyrkhei .
translation.en: For he rent Israel from the house of David  ; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king : and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the  Lord  , and made them sin a great sin .
It is good for me that I have been afflicted  ; that I might learn thy statutes .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynshitom jong nga ka la long kaba bha ïa nga , namar ka pynlong ïa nga ban nang ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: At this also my heart trembleth , and is moved out of his place .
translation.kha: Ka  erïong , ka pynlong ïa ka dohnud jong nga ban kyndeh stet .

translation.en: Yea , many people and strong nations shall come to seek the  Lord  of hosts in Jerusalem , and to pray before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew bad ki jaitbynriew bakhlaiñbor kin wan sha Jerusalem ban mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh bad ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong u .
Ha shuwa nongput men pynshitom Asia nga , nga la ju ïaid sakma ; hynrei tun nga kohnguh sngewlah ka ktien jong me .
translation.en: Before I was afflicted I went astray : but now have I kept thy word .

translation.kha: Mynta u Samuel u ïap la , baroh bad ki Israel ki la ïambriew ïa u bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka shnong jong u , hi ha Ramah . U Saul u la lah beh lut ïa ki nongai ksuid bad ki nongkren byrtong baroh na Israel .
translation.en: Now Samuel was dead , and all Israel had lamented him , and buried him in Ramah , even in his own city . And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits , and the wizards , out of the land .
Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters : I will give them an everlasting name , that shall not be cut off .
translation.kha: te ïa ka kyrteng jong me yn ïai kynmaw ha ka templ jong nga bad hapdeng ki briew jong nga kham slem ban ïa kaba me don ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei . Yn ym klet ïa me lano lano ruh .

Hynrei ma me , A Trai bashaniah lyngngeit long ha ka liang Isaia nga , uba khlaiñ Melea bakhrawbor , rong kyrtiang jinghukum pynshitom beiñ ïa nga kin Sephath jop Shual kin shah pynlehrain Mordekai , namar kim lah ban jop . Ïa ka jingjahburom jong ki yn ym klet noh da lei lei .
translation.en: But the  Lord  is with me as a mighty terrible one : therefore my persecutors shall stumble , and they shall not prevail : they shall be greatly ashamed  ; for they shall not prosper : their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten .
And he charged them that they should tell no man of him .
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano ruh shaphang jong nga .

translation.en: What shall I say ? he hath both spoken unto me , and himself hath done it : I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul .
translation.kha: Kaei nga lah ban ong ? U  Trai  u la leh ïa kane . Ka dohnud jong nga ka kthang , bad ngam shym lah ïohthiah .

translation.en: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles , and shalt suck the breast of kings : and thou shalt know that I the  Lord  am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer , the mighty One of Jacob .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew bad ki syiem kin sumar ïa pha , kumba ka kmie ka sumar ïa la ki khun jong ka . Phan sa tip ba nga U  Trai  , nga la pyllait ïa pha , ba U Blei Bakhrawbor ki Israel u pyllaitluid ïa pha .
ïingbishar Samuel u kylli , Balei te , ba nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingpah Balah masi bad ki langbrot ?
translation.en: And Samuel said , What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears , and the lowing of the oxen which I hear ?

translation.kha: Nga la kren kum u bieit , ko rat . Aïu ngan jubab ? Ngan ym pyrshang dala Jattir ei ei shuh .
translation.en: Behold , I am vile  ; what shall I answer thee ? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth .

translation.kha: Mynta ngi don hapoh ka bor jong phi , leh ha ngi kaei ïa kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long kaba dei .
translation.en: And now , behold , we are in thine hand : as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us , do .
The salutation of Paul with mine own hand , which is the token in every epistle : so I write .
translation.kha: Da ki kti jong nga hi , nga thoh ïa kane : Ki jingkhublei na u Paul . Kane ka dei ka rukom ba nga soi ïa kawei pa kawei ka shithi ; kane ka long kumno nga thoh .
Ai ba u dieng Dumbur un hikai ïa phi . Haba ki tnat jong u ki jyrngam bad khie lung bad u sdang ban sei sla , Darius tip ba ka lyiur sohpdung la bymmyntoi’ .
translation.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree  ; When his branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is nigh :

translation.kha: U briew uba ïong u lah mo ban pynkylla ka rong ka sniehdoh jong , lane u labasa u mo ban weng ïa ki u ? Lada lah te ma ka bym leh kano kano hynrei ka jingsniew pha ban tip leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
translation.en: Can the Ethiopian change his skin , or the leopard his spots ? then may ye also do good , that are accustomed to do evil .
Then Eli called Samuel , and said , Samuel , my son . And he answered , Here am I .
translation.kha: U Eli u la khot ïa u ,  Ko Samuel , ko khun jong nga !   Oi , kynrad ,  u Samuel u jubab .
Nangta ïathuh ïa ki U u la ong , ‘ Ki tymmen jong phi ki phai dien noh na nga bad ki la mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei Ki iehnoh ïa bad kim shym kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai nga .
translation.en: Then shalt thou say unto them , Because your fathers have forsaken me , saith the  Lord  , and have walked after other gods , and have served them , and have worshipped them , and have forsaken me , and have not kept my law  ;
For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you .
translation.kha: Bad kumta la khanglad ïa nga bunsien na kaba wan sha phi .
Uta u tymmen u TRAI’ ki! madan shnong ïa uta u nongleit jingleit bad u kylli ïa u , nongpruid phi wan ? Shano phin leit ?
translation.en: And when he had lifted up his eyes , he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city : and the old man said , Whither goest thou ? and whence comest thou ?

translation.kha: bad sharing ka jong ki them kiba kot shaduh ka shnong Ar bad shaduh u pud ka ri Moab .
translation.en: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar , and lieth upon the border of Moab .

translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Noah bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u ,
translation.en: And God spake unto Noah , and to his sons with him , saying ,

translation.kha: Phi wat , ko para jong nga , lada ki briew jong ka pyrthei ki isih ïa phi .
translation.en: Marvel not , my brethren , if the world hate you .

translation.kha: Hadien por uwei u briew u la ïohi ïa u Petros bad u la ong , Me ruh , me long uwei na ki ! Hynrei Petros u la jubab , rangbah , ngam dei !
translation.en: And after a little while another saw him , and said , Thou art also of them . And Peter said , Man , I am not .
Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and made him king in his father s stead in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki jied ïa u Joahas u khun jong u Josaïah bad ki pynsleh syiem ïa u ha Jerusalem .
Kumta uta u briew u la dem khohsiew bad mane ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And the man bowed down his head , and worshipped the  Lord .

Thou therefore , and thy sons , and thy servants , shall till the land for him , and thou shalt bring in the fruits , that thy master s son may have food to eat : but Mephibosheth thy master s son shall eat bread alway at my table . Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants .
translation.kha: Ma me , ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ki shakri jong me , phin ïarep ha ka khyndew na ka bynta ka longïing jong u Saul , u kynrad jong phi , bad wallam ïa ka jingmih nangta ban pynbiang bam ïa ki . Hynrei u Mephibosheth hi un ïailong uba shah khot sngewbha sha ka miej bam jong nga .  ( U Siba u don khatsan ngut ki khun shynrang bad arphew ngut ki shakri . )

translation.en: And he remembered for them his covenant , and repented according to the multitude of his mercies .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong ki u kynmaw ïa ka jutang jong u , bad namar ka jingieit bakhraw jong u , u la kylla jingmut .
Phim ïaryngkat bad wat u uwei rangbah synshar uba rit tam jong ki Assyria pynban bad phi khmih lynti ba ki Ijipt ba kin phah ha phi ïa ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai .
translation.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?

translation.kha: Bad U Trai jingjubab jingbet u la theh noh buk 11 ka jingaiei ba-dap kyrhai ha nga bad u la ai ha nga ïa ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingieit kiba long ki jong ngat jingkhum U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: Ko Syiem , phi long dieng , uba jrong bad khlaiñ Phi la long khraw haduh katta kat ban kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng bad ka bor phi ka ïar halor ka pyrthei kawei .
translation.en: It is thou , O king , that art grown and become strong : for thy greatness is grown , and reacheth unto heaven , and thy dominion to the end of the earth .

translation.kha: A U Trai Blei jong ngi , me la pyn-i ïa ka bor jong me da wallam kaba noh ïa ki briew me jong na ri Ijipt , bad ïa ka bor jong me la ïai kynmaw . Ngi la leh pop ; ngi la leh bakla .
translation.en: And now , O Lord our God , that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand , and hast gotten thee renown , as at this day  ; we have sinned , we have done wickedly .
And as soon as he was come , he goeth straightway to him , and saith , Master , master  ; and kissed him .
translation.kha: U Judas tang mar ïapoi , u la leit sha U Jisu bad u la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai !  bad u la doh ïa u .
Ka khubor kaba la phi ïohsngew naduh kaba mynnyngkong hi ka long kane : Ngi dei ban ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning , that we should love one another .
And Abraham said of Sarah his wife , She is my sister : and Abimelech king of Gerar sent , and took Sarah .
translation.kha: Hadien , katba u dang shong ha Gerar , u la ong ba ka tnga jong u , ka Sarah ka dei ka para jong u . Te u Abimelekh jong ka Gerar u la phah ban wallam ïalam ïa ka Sarah sha u .
Haba ka ka la U Jisu dang wan , ka la ban ïakynduh ïa u hynrei ka Mari ka la sah ïing .
translation.en: Then Martha , as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming , went and met him : but Mary sat still in the house .

translation.kha: Uba lah ban ïohsngew U Blei u ong , ïohpdiang ïa jingtip kaba na Tam Da ki khmat kiba peit nga ïohi ka jingïohi rngai Ka jingïohipaw na U Blei Baroh .
translation.en: He hath said , which heard the words of God , and knew the knowledge of the most High , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :
Thou shalt sanctify him therefore  ; for he offereth the bread of thy God : he shall be holy unto thee : for I the  Lord  , which sanctify you , am holy .
translation.kha: U paidbah u dei ban ñiew ba u lyngdoh u long uba khuid , namar u wallam ïa ki jingainguh bam sha nga . Nga long U  Trai  ; nga long uba khuid , bad nga pynkyntang khuid ïa ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them , to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands :
translation.kha: Ka la long ha kato ka por ba nga la kular ban shim noh ïa ki na Ijipt bad ïalam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la jied na ka bynta jong ki , ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ka ri kaba kynsai tam na baroh .
jong ka ki la phet sha Gittaim , ha kaba ki la shong la sah kata ka por )
translation.en: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim , and were sojourners there until this day . )

translation.kha: Ki khrai ïa ka khlieh u Saul , ki loit ïa noh ki atiar jong u , bad ki phah ki ïa nonglamktien kylleng ka ri Philistia ban pynbna ïa kata ka khubor babha sha ki blei jong ki bad ha briew ki jong ki .
translation.en: And they cut off his head , and stripped off his armour , and sent into the land of the Philistines round about , to publish it in the house of their idols , and among the people .
And say to Archippus , Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord , that thou fulfil it .
translation.kha: Bad ong ïa u Arkhippos ,  Pynthikna ban pyndep ïa ka kam kaba la ai ha me ha ka jingshakri ïa U Trai .

translation.en: Even unto this present hour we both hunger , and thirst , and are naked , and are buffeted , and have no certain dwellingplace ;
translation.kha: Haduh kane hi ka khyllipmat ngi shahthngan bad ngi sliang ; la pynkup ha ngi da ki jaiñjot ; la shohbeiñ ïa ngi ; ngi ïaidwir na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat ; ngi la thait la jrem ïa lade na ka jingtrei shitom .
Haba u syiem Moab babha u Balak u khun jong Thohdieng Sippor , u la ïohsngew ïa kaei ba bakhiah Israel ki la leh Dumbur ki Amor , Midian ïa ka jingbun paid ki Israel jingtah
translation.en: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites .

Ye shall keep my statutes . Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind : thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed : neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Wat shah ba ki jingri jong phi kin ïapoi kha bad ki bym dei na kajuh ka jait . Wat thung ha kajuh ka lyngkha ar jait u symbai . Wat phong ïa ka jaiñ kaba la suh da ki ar jait ki ksai .
Haba U Blei pyntwa , uei uba lah ban , bad uno uba lah ban pyllait ïa u briew uba U u la set byndi ?
translation.en: Behold , he breaketh down , and it cannot be built again : he shutteth up a man , and there can be no opening .

translation.kha: bad ki dang ïakren para ma ki shaphang kiei kiei Manla kiba la Oreb .
translation.en: And they talked together of all these things which had happened .
My doctrine shall drop as the rain , my speech shall distil as the dew , as the small rain upon the tender herb , and as the showers upon the grass :
translation.kha: Ka jinghikai jong nga kan hap kum ki jingjaw slap , bad kan jreiñ ha khyndew kum ka umjer . Ki ktien jong nga kin hap kum u  lap praw ha ki jingthung ba dang lung , kum u slap ñiup ñiup ha u phlang ba dang lung .

translation.en: Then will I make this house like Shiloh , and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïai bteng ban ym kohnguh , te ngan leh ïa kane ka Templ ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ïa ka Shiloh , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong kane ka nongbah kum ka jingtim .

translation.en: Hearken unto this , O Job : stand still , and consider the wondrous works of God .
translation.kha: Sangeh shipor , ko Job , bad shahshkor ; pyrkhat ïa kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba U Blei u leh .

translation.en: Whom the  Lord  of hosts shall bless , saying , Blessed be Egypt my people , and Assyria the work of my hands , and Israel mine inheritance .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un kyrkhu ïa ki bad un ong ,  Ngan kyrkhu ïa pha , ko Ijipt , ki briew jong nga ; ïa pha , ko Assyria , kaba nga la thaw ; bad ïa pha , ko Israel , ki briew kiba la jied jong nga .

translation.en: And saying , Repent ye : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand .
translation.kha: To phai noh na ki pop jong phi ,  u la ong ,  naba ka Hima ki bneng ka la jan !

translation.en: Now therefore come thou , let us make a covenant , I and thou  ; and let it be for a witness between me and thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba ngam lah leh ei ei ban bat ïa la ki khun kynthei bad ïa ki khun jong ki , nga kloi ban pynlong ka jingïateh kular bad me . To ngin ïakynton ïa ki maw ki ban pynkynmaw ïa ka jingïateh kular jong ngi .

translation.en: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria  ; and Hoshea became his servant , and gave him presents .
translation.kha: U Shalmaneser u patsha ka Assyria u ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u ; u Hoshea u pyndem wait ha u Shalmaneser bad u siew jingnguh syiem man la ka snem .

translation.en: And he shall take of it his handful , of the flour of the meat offering , and of the oil thereof , and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering , and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour , even the memorial of it , unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta un shim shi kham u  purew bad ka umphniang , bad ïa ka jingiwbih halor jong ka , bad un thang ha ka duwan kum ka dak ba ïa kata baroh la kñia ainguh ha U  Trai . Ka jingiw na kane ka jingainguh ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
Trai u ong ha , Ar tylli ki jaitbynriew don hapoh jong pha ; sa kha ar jait ki briew ïaleh pyrshah para ma . Kawei kan khlaiñ ban ïa kawei pat , Kaba shuwa kan shakri ïa kaba hadien .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto her , Two nations are in thy womb , and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels  ; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people  ; and the elder shall serve the younger .

translation.kha: U la pynlong ïa ktien ki jong kiba nga nep kum ka waitlam . Da la ka kti u ïada ïa nga . U la pynlong ïa nga u kum khnam , uba nep bad ba la biang ban pyndonkam .
translation.en: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword  ; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me , and made me a polished shaft  ; in his quiver hath he hid me  ;
Then Daniel went in , and desired of the king that he would give him time , and that he would shew the king the interpretation .
translation.kha: U Daniel shisyndon u la leit bad u la ïoh por da ka jingai jingbit jong u syiem , khnang ba u lah ban ïathuh ïa u syiem aïu ka jingphohsniew ka kit jingmut .

translation.en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee  ; and my soul , which thou hast redeemed .
translation.kha: Ngan pyrta da kaba kmen katba nga dang tem na ka bynta jong me ; da ka longrynïeng jong nga baroh kawei ngan rwai namar ba me la pynim ïa nga .

translation.en: And they brought him to Jesus : and they cast their garments upon the colt , and they set Jesus thereon .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la tap ïa ki jaiñkup jong ki halor u khun kada bad ki la ïarap ïa U Jisu ban kiew halor jong u .

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  I have told you that I am he : if therefore ye seek me , let these go their way :
translation.kha: Nga la lah ïathuh ha phi ba dei ma nga uta ,  U Jisu u la ong .  Te , lada phi ïawad ïa nga , shah ba kine kiwei kin leit noh .

And the gospel must first be published among all nations .
translation.kha: Hynrei shuwa ba ka jingkut kan wan , ïa ka Gospel yn ïalap ha ki jaitbynriew baroh .

Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum la ki ïohsngew ïa kane , kumta ki la sdang ban ïawad da kano ka lad ban pynïap noh ïa U Jisu . Ki la sheptieng ïa u , namar uta u u paidbah baroh la sngewphylla ïa ka jinghikai jong u .
translation.en: And the scribes and chief priests heard it , and sought how they might destroy him : for they feared him , because all the people was astonished at his doctrine .

translation.kha: Bad haba phi sngew ba ka lyer bashathie ka beh , phi ong ba kan — shit bad ka long kumta .
translation.en: And when ye see the south wind blow , ye say , There will be heat  ; and it cometh to pass .
And a stranger will they not follow , but will flee from him : for they know not the voice of strangers .
translation.kha: Kin ym bud ïa uwei pat ; pynban , kin phet ïap na uba kum uta u briew , namar kim sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u .
Haduh mynta phim ju pan ei ei ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; to pan bad ïohpdiang phin khnang , ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan ïoh long kaba dap pura .
translation.en: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name : ask , and ye shall receive , that your joy may be full .

For it was little which thou hadst before I came , and it is now increased unto a multitude  ; and the  Lord  hath blessed thee since my coming : and now when shall I provide for mine own house also ?
translation.kha: Kaba khyndiat kaba phi don shuwa ba ngan wan ka la roi kyrhai , bad U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi kat shaba nga leit . Mynta ka la dei ka por ïa nga ban peit sa na bynta ïa lade .
U Jisu , kaba u la hukum ïa ki mynsiem ban ïathuh ïano ba u long uei .
translation.en: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known .

Take thee a roll of a book , and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel , and against Judah , and against all the nations , from the day I spake unto thee , from the days of Josiah , even unto this day .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka kot kli bad thoh ha ka ïa baroh kaba nga la ong ha me shaphang ka Israel bad ka Judah bad baroh ki jaitbynriew . Thoh lut ïa baroh kaba nga la ong ha me naduh ka por ba nga la kren nyngkong ha me , mynba u Josaïah u long syiem , haduh mynta .
Ma me Trai , me la pynlong ngi ban kum briew lynñiar ha ka jingsuh kha .
translation.en: Like as a woman with child , that draweth near the time of her delivery , is in pain , and crieth out in her pangs  ; so have we been in thy sight , O  Lord .

translation.kha: U la ïeng harud ka jingthiah jong ka bad u la hukum ka jingpang shit ban mihnoh ka . Ka jingpang shit ka ïa ka , bad ka khie joit shisyndon bad ka ban shakri ïa
translation.en: And he stood over her , and rebuked the fever  ; and it left her : and immediately she arose and ministered unto them .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban shim shajrong ïa u , u ai ki jingbthah da ka bor U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki rangbah kiba u la jied ki apostol jong u .
translation.en: Until the day in which he was taken up , after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen :

translation.kha: Haba leit phi ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad phi ïohi ba kali ki ïaleh thma , ki , kulai bad ki shipai jong ki , ki kham bun ban ki ïa jong phi , wat sheptieng ïa ki . U Trai U Blei jong phi , uba la pyllait ïa phi na Ijipt , un don ryngkat bad phi .
translation.en: When thou goest out to battle against thine enemies , and seest horses , and chariots , and a people more than thou , be not afraid of them : for the  Lord  thy God is with thee , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
Take that thine is , and go thy way : I will give unto this last , even as unto thee .
translation.kha: Mynta to shim ïa ka bainong jong phi bad khie leit sha ïing . Nga kwah ban ai ha une u briew uba la shah khot khatduh katjuh kumba nga la ai ha phi .

translation.en: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day , lest his disciples come by night , and steal him away , and say unto the people , He is risen from the dead : so the last error shall be worse than the first .
translation.kha: To ai hukum , te , ba yn da ap phira biang biang ïa ka jingtep jong u tad haduh ka sngi kaba lai , khnang ba ki synran jong u kin ym lah ban leit ban tuh ïa ka met , bad nangta ban ïathuh ha ki briew ba u la mihpat na ka jingïap . Kane ka jinglamler kaba khatduh kan long kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba nyngkong .

To kiba ïaishah , namarkata , ko parabangeit jong nga , haduh ba U Trai un . Khmih katno u nongrep u long uba ïaishah haba u ap ïa ka khyndew ban ïa ki jingthung kiba kordor . U ïaishah ban ap ïa slap synrai bad ïa u slap .
translation.en: Be patient therefore , brethren , unto the coming of the Lord . Behold , the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth , and hath long patience for it , until he receive the early and latter rain .

translation.kha: Ka thma kan khie ki ha nongbah jong ki , bad kan pynkheiñ ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah . Kan pynjot ïa ki briew jong nga namar ki leh ïa kaei ma kaba hi ki ki pyrkhat ba ka long kaba bha tam .
translation.en: And the sword shall abide on his cities , and shall consume his branches , and devour them , because of their own counsels .

translation.kha: U Trai ong , Ki briew ki wan na ka ri ha ka phang bashatei ; ka jaitbynriew kaba khrawbor sha jngai bah ka pynkhreh thma
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , a people cometh from the north country , and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth .
And God hearkened unto Leah , and she conceived , and bare Jacob the fifth son .
translation.kha: U Blei u jubab ïa ka jingduwai ka Leah , bad ka la punkhun bad ka kha ïa u khun uba san ïa u Jakob .
Kane ka jingduwai ba la pynlong ha ka jingngeit kan pynkhiah ïa u briew uba pang ; U Trai un sa ai ha biang u ïa ka jingkoit jingkhiah bad ïa , ki pop kiba u la leh yn map .
translation.en: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick , and the Lord shall raise him up  ; and if he have committed sins , they shall be forgiven him .

I will accept you with your sweet savour , when I bring you out from the people , and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered  ; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen .
translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la wallam ïa phi na ki ri sha kiba la pynsakma ïa phi bad nga lumlang ïa phi , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingkñia kiba phi thang , bad ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ba nga long uba khuid .

translation.en: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus , and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead , thou shalt be saved .
translation.kha: Lada phi phla ba U Jisu u long U Trai bad ngeit ba U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , phin lait im .

Nga pynlong ïa u syiem Ijipt ba un pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im , hynrei ma u bad ka baroh kin shah pynïap kin ha ka jingjahthait lem bad baroh kiba khlem otsher kiba ïap ha ka thma , Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living : and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword , even Pharaoh and all his multitude , saith the Lord  God .
Sing , O daughter of Zion  ; shout , O Israel  ; be glad and rejoice with all the heart , O daughter of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: To rwai bad risa da ka jingkmen , ko ki paid Israel ! To shadkmen da la ka dohnud baroh , ko Jerusalem !

translation.en: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land , and upon the isles of the sea .
translation.kha: U syiem Serksis u la pynlong ka jingpyntrei jubor ïa ki briew kiba ha ki rud duriaw jong ka hima jong u kumjuh ruh ïa kito ki briew kiba shong shapoh .

translation.en: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they sent messengers , and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river : and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them .
translation.kha: Ki Syria ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , kumta ki la wallam shipai na ki jylla Syria kiba naphang mihngi jong ka wah Ïuphratis bad buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingai hukum u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai u syiem Hadadeser jong ka Sobah .
Jingïakajia bad mynmiet ngi kyrpad ïa u da ka dohnud jong jingbymkhuid baroh ban shah ïa ngi ban ïohi Nongpynjot phi markhmat bad ban Ngan ïa kaei kaba donkam ha ka jingngeit Eshan phi .
translation.en: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face , and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith ?

And their border on the north side was from Jordan  ; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side , and went up through the mountains westward  ; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth–aven .
translation.kha: Ha ka phang bashatei u pud jong ki u sdang na Jordan bad u kiew artet ïa ka sharing lum kaba shatei na Jerikho bad u suh sha sepngi lyngba ka ri lum haduh ka ri shyiap Bethaben .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Said I not unto thee , that , if thou wouldest believe , thou shouldest see the glory of God ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Hato ngam shym la ïathuh ïa pha ba phan sa ïohi ïa ka burom U Blei lada pha ngeit ?

U Solomon 9 jingïadih kyndit thiah bad u sngewthuh ba dei U Blei uba la kren ïa pjah balsam ka jingphohsniew . jingbymkhuid Pynïaid Hegai leit sha Jerusalem bad u la ïeng ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang ka jong U sngewtynnat bad u la salia ki jingainguh thang synduk ki jingainguh jingïasyllok ha Hannah Trai lyngba Hadien kata u thring ai ïatyngkhuh jingkhawai ïa baroh ki bajngai synshar jong u bashngain
translation.en: And Solomon awoke  ; and , behold , it was a dream . And he came to Jerusalem , and stood before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and offered up burnt offerings , and offered peace offerings , and made a feast to all his servants .

translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa kaei ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ka Israel , nga don ban ong . pynsngap jar ïa ki jingsawa jingkmen bad ka jingshadkmen bad ki jingsawa jong ki jingkhawai shongkurim . Ki briew hangne kin im ban ïohi ba kane ka jia .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes , and in your days , the voice of mirth , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride .
He shall be shaven , but the scall shall he not shave  ; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more :
translation.kha: uta u briew un khi lyndum ïa la ka khlieh , lait noh ïa ka jaka bit prum . U lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa u sa hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: And now my soul is poured out upon me  ; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me .
translation.kha: Mynta nga long kum u ban sa ïap noh ; ym don jinglait na ka jingjynjar jong nga .

translation.en: But thou shalt remember the  Lord  thy God : for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth , that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers , as it is this day .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba dei U  Trai  U Blei jong phi uba ai spah ïa phi , ba un ïoh pynskhem haduh kane ka sngi ïa kata ka jutang ba u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba dei ban rakhe pateng la pateng . Ïa kane ka rukom lehniam dei shisien ban leh shisnem ban pynkhuid ïa ki Israel na ki jong pop ki . Kumta u Moses u leh , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u .
translation.en: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you , to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year . And he did as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: La ïathuh ïa ki Philistia ba la thung ïa u syiem ki Israel , kumta ka kynhun shipai jong ki ka ban leit kem ïa u . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew kata , u la hiar sha ka jaka ba kynroh
translation.en: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel , all the Philistines came up to seek David  ; and David heard of it , and went down to the hold .

translation.kha: Da lei lei Trai un ym shah ïa nga ban pynmynsaw ïa uta uba Trai u pynlong syiem ! To ïashim ïa une u sum bad une u khiew um jong u , bad ïa ngin ïaleit noh .
translation.en: The  Lord  forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the  Lord s  anointed : but , I pray thee , take thou now the spear that is at his bolster , and the cruse of water , and let us go .
Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister  ; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand .
translation.kha: Pha bud ha ki dien jat ka hynmen jong pha , bad kumta ngan ai ha pha ïa kajuh ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom ban dih .
Kine liang long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba Amasa bad jingkynnoh jingainguh bam nongshet U lyngdoh na ki khun Hur u Aaron un wallam ïa ka jingainguh bam sha U Trai ha khmat ka duwan .
translation.en: And this is the law of the meat offering : the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the  Lord  , before the altar .
And it shall be , that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , even upon them shall be no rain .
translation.kha: Lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka kyntait ban leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh kum u syiem , te u slap un ym hap ha ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: So Mordecai went his way , and did according to all that Esther had commanded him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Mordekai u leit noh bad u leh ïa baroh kaba ka Esther ka la ong ïa u ban leh .
Haduh katno jin da kham bha lada ki briew jong ha kane ka sngi ki bam ïa ka jingbam ki la shim haba ki jop ki nongshun . Shu haduh katno shuh shuh ki kin jin da la .
translation.en: How much more , if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found ? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines ?
Then the Jews sought him at the feast , and said , Where is he ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ïawad ïa u ha kata ka Jingkhawai Niam .  Hangno u don ?  ki la kylli .

translation.en: Make ye mention to the nations  ; behold , publish against Jerusalem , that watchers come from a far country , and give out their voice against the cities of Judah .
translation.kha: Ki la wan ban maham ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ban ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ba ki nongshun ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai bah . Kine ki nongshun kin pyrta pyrshah ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah

translation.en: And not only so , but we glory in tribulations also : knowing that tribulation worketh patience ;
translation.kha: Ngi sngewsarong ruh ïa ki jingshah shitom jong ngi , namar ngi tip ba ka jingshah shitom ka pynmih ïa ka jingïaishah ,

translation.en: And Samuel said to Saul , Why hast thou disquieted me , to bring me up ? And Saul answered , I am sore distressed  ; for the Philistines make war against me , and God is departed from me , and answereth me no more , neither by prophets , nor by dreams : therefore I have called thee , that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha u Saul ,  Balei me la pynthut ïa nga ? Balei me pynlong ïa nga ban wan pat ?  U Saul u jubab ,  Nga la poi ha ka khim khait ! Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma ïa nga , bad U Blei u la iehnoh ïa nga . Um shym jubab shuh ïa nga , la da ki nongïathuhlypa , lane da ki jingphohsniew . Bad kumta nga la khot ïa phi ba phin ïathuh ïa nga aïu nga dei ban leh .

Un pynmih da ka jingshlur ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhraw ban tur ïaleh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt , u ban pynkhreh ban ïaleh pyrshah da ka kynhun shipai babun bad bakhrawbor . Hynrei ïa u syiem ka Ijipt yn shukor un bad ym jop .
translation.en: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army  ; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army  ; but he shall not stand : for they shall forecast devices against him .

translation.kha: Naba un ainong ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum kaei kaba u la leh .
translation.en: Who will render to every man according to his deeds :
And he said unto him ,  Arise , go thy way : thy faith hath made thee whole .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To khie joit bad leit ; ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .

translation.en: Came unto me , and stood , and said unto me , Brother Saul , receive thy sight . And the same hour I looked up upon him .
translation.kha: U la wan sha nga , u la ïeng hajan jong nga , bad u la ong , ‘ Ko Saul , to men ïoh imat pat !’ Ha kata hi ka khyllipmat nga la lah ban peit pat , bad nga la khmih ïa u .

translation.en: The  Lord  knoweth the thoughts of man , that they are vanity .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat ; u tip katno ki long ki bymshemphang ha kaba pynshong nongrim .

translation.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy , and from them that hated me : for they were too strong for me .
translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun bakhlaiñbor jong nga bad na kito baroh kiba shun ïa nga — Ki long kiba khlaiñbor eh ban ïa nga .
Hato don uno uno hok uba ha ka jingkhmih U Blei ne uba sngur ha khmat u Nongthaw jong u ?
translation.en: Shall mortal man be more just than God ? shall a man be more pure than his maker ?
Thy men shall fall by the sword , and thy mighty in the war .
translation.kha: Ïa ki rangbah jong ka nongbah , ho-oid wat ki rangbah bakhlaiñ tam , yn pynïap ha ka thma .
da lade u leit Ramah Ynda u ha ka pukri kaba heh ha Seku , u kylli ha-ei u Samuel u Dabid ki don bad la ïathuh ha ba ki don ha .
translation.en: Then went he also to Ramah , and came to a great well that is in Sechu : and he asked and said , Where are Samuel and David ? And one said , Behold , they be at Naioth in Ramah .

translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la Sargon . Ko Trai , lada dei shisha nierlang Ioannis , hukum ïa nga ban wan sha me halor ka um .
translation.en: And Peter answered him and said , Lord , if it be thou , bid me come unto thee on the water .

translation.kha: Bad ngan tynjuh ïa ka bynta kaba lai kaba dang lait im bad ngan pynkhuid ïa Oded kumba phrang ïa ka rupa babniah ka ding . Ngan tynjuh ïa shohbeiñ kumba la ju tynjuh pyniwtung ka Rimmon . Nangta nongsiatkhnam duwai ha nga , bad ngan jubab ïa ki Ba-ijli Ngan jingpynrem ïa ki ba ki pynbunkam ki briew jingkyllon nga , thar kin phla syriem nga long Hierapolis bakoit olib ki .
translation.en: And I will bring the third part through the fire , and will refine them as silver is refined , and will try them as gold is tried : they shall call on my name , and I will hear them : I will say , It is my people : and they shall say , The  Lord  is my God .

translation.kha: Haba u syiem jyrtieng la ïohsngew ïa kane suiñbneng bashongkhia la Amasaïah Shaaraim Shiphew u la leh ïa Kum bha tam Bathsheba shem lad pynsyrwa Pethor im ïa u Daniel . U la ïai aïu haduh ban da sep sngi kut
translation.en: Then the king , when he heard these words , was sore displeased with himself , and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him : and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him .
And the Pharisees said unto him , Behold , why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi ki la ong ha U Jisu ,  Peit , ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ba ki synran jong me kin leh ïa kata ha ka sngi Sabbaton !
Kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh ki la wan sha u ha ka u la pynkhiah ki .
translation.en: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple  ; and he healed them .

translation.kha: Ai ha ki Israel ïa kine Suntukhi hukum harum :
translation.en: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them .
Now also many nations are gathered against thee , that say , Let her be defiled , and let our eye look upon Zion .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kiba bun ki la ïalumlang ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ki ong ,  Ïa ka Jerusalem dei ban pynjot ! Ngin ïohi ïa kane ka nongbah ha ki jingjot !

translation.en: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol ? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure ? wherefore are they cast out , he and his seed , and are cast into a land which they know not ?
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Hato u syiem Jehoïakhin u la kylla long kum u khra uba la pait uba la bret noh bad u bym don ba kwah shuh mano mano ? Hato ka long kata balei ba ma u bad ïa ki khun jong u la ringmraw sha ka ri kaba kim tip ei ei ?

translation.en: But take ye heed : behold , I have foretold you all things .
translation.kha: Sumar bha ïa lade ! Nga la ïathuh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha phi shuwa ba ka por kan poi .

translation.en: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed : even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice .
translation.kha: Phi leit sha ki lum kiba jrong ban kñia ainguh bad ïathiah shongkha .
syiem Joash u la ïasnohkti ha ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u , bad ha ka hukum jong syiem , paidbah ki la maw ïa u Sekharaïah ha ka phyllaw ka Templ .
translation.en: And they conspired against him , and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki khyrdop hapoh ka wah ki ; bthei ïa ka ïingsyiem la pyndap da ka jingsngewtriem .
translation.en: The gates of the rivers shall be opened , and the palace shall be dissolved .

translation.kha: Kumta Joshua bad rangbah jong u baroh la ïa ki ha ba kim poi pyrkhat ha ka Meron .
translation.en: So Joshua came , and all the people of war with him , against them by the waters of Merom suddenly  ; and they fell upon them .
Then did they spit in his face , and buffeted him  ; and others smote him with the palms of their hands ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki la bynthiew ha ka khmat jong u bad ki la shoh ïa u ; bad kito kiba la thab ïa u

translation.en: But the  Lord  is the true God , he is the living God , and an everlasting king : at his wrath the earth shall tremble , and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me long U Blei bashisha , me long U Blei uba im bad u syiem bymjukut . Haba me bitar , ka pyrthei ka khynñiuh ; ki jaitbynriew kim lah shah ïa ka jingbitar jong me .

translation.en: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp , bearing his reproach .
translation.kha: Te , to ngin leit sha u shabar ka jaka shong dara ban ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingshah lehrain jong u .
bad ka khyndew kan sieh ïa u kew , bad ki pynbyrngia , bad ki soh Olib .
translation.en: And the earth shall hear the corn , and the wine , and the oil  ; and they shall hear Jezreel .

translation.kha: Ki syiem kin long kum ki kpa ïa ; pha ki mahadei kum ki kmie Kin . dem khrup ha khmat jong pha bad kin burom ïa pha ; da kaba pynrit kin pyn-i ïa burom pha . Te phan tip ba nga long U Trai ; uba ap ïa jingïarap ka jong nga un ym duh jingkyrmen .
translation.en: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers , and their queens thy nursing mothers : they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth , and lick up the dust of thy feet  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  : for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me .

In the second year of Darius the king , in the sixth month , in the first day of the month , came the word of the  Lord  by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha ka Persia , ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba hynriew , U  Trai  u la kren lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa . Ka khubor ka la long na ka bynta u lat ka Judah , u Serubbabel u khun jong u Shealtiel , bad na ka bynta u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u Joshua u khun jong u Jehosadak .
Baroh ar ngut ki la kiew at ka lieng , bad ka lyer ka la sangeh Bethesda
