“Men kyrdoh Trai u la ai ha ki Israel ïa Mynhynnin ri baroh ïa pynthame u la kular da kaba kyntang ha Hanamel kpa tymmen jong ki ba un ai ha krad ïatei Haba ki la shimti ïa ka , ïakyrpad la shongduh hangta .
translation.en: And the  Lord  gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers  ; and they possessed it , and dwelt therein .

translation.kha: Lane hato phin ai ha u da bseiñ u haba u pan ïa ka dohkha ?
translation.en: Or if he ask a fish , will he give him a serpent ?

translation.kha: Kumta u briew uba shongkurim u leh ïa kaba dei , hynrei uta u shongkurim bym u leh ïa kaba kham bha .
translation.en: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well ; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better .

And the officers of the children of Israel , which Pharaoh s taskmasters had set over them , were beaten , and demanded , Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day , as heretofore ?
translation.kha: Te ki nong Ijipt kiba pyntrei mraw ki shoh ïa ki rangbah Israel kiba pynïaidkam , ha kiba ki la buh ban khmih ïa ka kam . Ki la dawa ,  Balei ba phim shym shna katjuh ki maw-it kumba phi la ju shna mynshuwa ?

translation.en: And as he spake , a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him : and he went in , and sat down to meat .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren , u Pharisi u la khot sngewbha ïa u ban ïabam bad u ; kumta u la leit shapoh bad u la shong ban bam .

translation.en: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders , he answered nothing .
translation.kha: Hynrei um shym ong ei ei ha kaba jubab ïa ki jingmudui jong ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san .

translation.en: I lead in the way of righteousness , in the midst of the paths of judgment :
translation.kha: Nga ïaid ha ka lynti ka hok , nga bud ïa ki lynti ka jinglehhok ,
Issakhar U , U Sebulun , U Benjamin ,
translation.en: Issachar , Zebulun , and Benjamin ,

translation.kha: Baroh la pyndonkam ban siew ïa ki nongtrei bad thied ïa ki tiar ha kaba shna pynbha
translation.en: But they gave that to the workmen , and repaired therewith the house of the  Lord .
And now , behold , I go unto my people : come therefore , and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days .
translation.kha: U Balaam u ong ha u Balak ,  Mynta ngan leit phai pat sha la ki briew , hynrei shuwa ba ngan mih , nga maham lypa ïa phi aïu ki Israel kin leh ïa ki briew jong phi hadien habud .
( Ioannis 17 :3 ) Hooid , “kata ka pyrthei kan iaid jah noh . . . , hynrei uta uba ka leh mon jong u u Blei iaisah bymjukut .” —1 Ioannis 2 :17 .
translation.en: ( John 17 :3 ) Yes , “the world is passing away . . .  , but he that does the will of God remains forever .” —1 John 2 :17 .

translation.kha: Ka jingkyrmen jong ki briew ka la sdang ban kiew , ki bad la sdang ban la pyrkhat u Ïoannis lehse u lah ban dei U Messaïah .
translation.en: And as the people were in expectation , and all men mused in their hearts of John , whether he were the Christ , or not  ;

translation.kha: The rmiang shyntur jong nga kin nym ong lano lano ïa kaba sniew , u thylliej exam nga un ym kren ïa kaba shukor lano lano ruh shu
translation.en: My lips shall not speak wickedness , nor my tongue utter deceit .

translation.kha: Phin ïa shim ki bleithaw jong ba phi la sop da ka rupa bad ïa ki blei jong phi ba la tap da ka ksiar , bad phin bret noh ïa ki kum ïa ka jakhlia , bad phin pyrta Wat , don shuh ha khmat jong nga !
translation.en: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver , and the ornament of thy molten images of gold : thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth  ; thou shalt say unto it , Get thee hence .
Or who hath first given to him , and it shall be recompensed unto him again ?
translation.kha: Uei uba la ju ai ei ei ïa u , ba u hap ban siew pat ïa kata ?

Nangta u la ong ha bamatlah Lahmam Kine ki long kita kiei kiei kiba nga dohthang ïathuh ha phi arspah nga dang Pynphong lem bad phi : Kaei kaei Ananias kaba la thoh shaphang jong nga ha ka Hukum u Moses , ha ki kpu jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ha Elijah Salm ka dei ban urlong shisha .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  These are the words which I spake unto you , while I was yet with you , that all things must be fulfilled , which were written in the law of Moses , and in the prophets , and in the psalms , concerning me .
And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt , and the  Lord  thy God redeemed thee : therefore I command thee this thing to day .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba phi ruh phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt bad U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pyllait ïa phi ; dei namar kata ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ïa kane ka hukum .

translation.en: It was planted in a good soil by great waters , that it might bring forth branches , and that it might bear fruit , that it might be a goodly vine .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la lah thung ha ka lyngkha kaba seisoh bad kaba biang bha ka um ba kumta u lah ban sei ki sla bad pynmih ki sohwaiñ bad long u dieng sohwaiñ uba itynnat eh .

translation.en: But when Herod heard thereof , he said , It is John , whom I beheaded : he is risen from the dead .
translation.kha: Haba u Herod u la ïohsngew ïa kata , u la ong ,  U dei u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ! Nga la phah khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u , hynrei u la im pat !
bad u , Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi wan shane ? U Dabid u jubab , Ban thied ïa ka jaka shoh kew jong bad ban tei ka duwan ïa U Trai , ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingïapthem .
translation.en: And Araunah said , Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant ? And David said , To buy the threshingfloor of thee , to build an altar unto the  Lord  , that the plague may be stayed from the people .

translation.kha: Bad mynta nga ïeng hangne ba yn bishar namar ka jingkyrmen kaba don nga ha ka jingkular kaba U Blei la u pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi —
translation.en: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers :

translation.kha: Kumta ki wallam ïa la ki jingri sha u Joseph ; u pat u ïapli sngewkynduh jingshun jingbam bad ki kulai , ki langbrot , ki blang , ki jingri jingdup , bad ki kada . Ha kata ka snem u pyndap ïa ki Taralah kaba Ñiew jinglehniam Suit ki byrtong jingdup jong throsh baroh .
translation.en: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph : and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses , and for the flocks , and for the cattle of the herds , and for the asses : and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year .

translation.kha: Bad ka doh jong ki kynja ba-im kam long kajuh ka jait ; markhmat bynriew u ïalade kawei ka jait doh , ki mrad da kawei pat , ki sim da kawei , bad ki dohkha da ïaphai pat .
translation.en: All flesh is not the same flesh : but there is one kind of flesh of men , another flesh of beasts , another of fishes , and another of birds .
So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth : it shall not return unto me void , but it shall accomplish that which I please , and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it .
translation.kha: Kumta ruh kan long ka ktien kaba nga kren — kan ym pep ban pyndep ïa kaei kaba nga thmu na ka bynta jong ka ; kan pynlong ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga phah ïa ka ban leh .
Ka jingbitar jong U ka long ka erïong , ka erlangthari ka ban khih bitar halor ki khlieh jong bymman ki ,
translation.en: Behold , a whirlwind of the  Lord  is gone forth in fury , even a grievous whirlwind : it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ha Israel : Ki briew jong nga ki la pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane ïa pynlong bleithaw .
translation.en: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel : there is the whoredom of Ephraim , Israel is defiled .

translation.kha: Wat ki hynmen Tibhath para jong u briew uba Ahio kim long jingmyntoi ïa u ; kam pher ba um don malade . Kam pher katno u shuwa tyngeh , um Sharon ban patrong phatok .
translation.en: All the brethren of the poor do hate him : how much more do his friends go far from him ? he pursueth them with words , yet they are wanting to him .

translation.kha: Ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim lah ban jingïambriew ; kim lah wat ban Seboim mynsiem .
translation.en: They have ears , but they hear not  ; neither is there any breath in their mouths .
And moreover , because the preacher was wise , he still taught the people knowledge  ; yea , he gave good heed , and sought out , and set in order many proverbs .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba u Stad saiñpyrkhat u long uba stad , u ïai hikai ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba u tip . U la pule bniah ïa ki proberb bad da kaba sngur mynsiem u da tynjuh ïa ka jingshisha jong ki .

translation.en: One shall say , I am the  Lord s   ; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob  ; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the  Lord  , and surname himself by the name of Israel .
translation.kha: Uwei hadien uwei , ki briew kin ong , ‘ nga long u jong U TRAI’ . Kin ïawan ban ïasnoh bad u paid Israel . Uwei pa uwei un shon ha ka ksang ti jong u ïa ka kyrteng jong U  Trai bad un khot ïa lade uwei na ki briew U Blei .

translation.en: O that one might plead for a man with God , as a man pleadeth for his neighbour !
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban don u ban ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta jong nga , kumba u briew u ïasaid na ka bynta u paralok jong u .
Ngam shemphang Lusias kaba nga leh ; Jingkdew ngam leh ïa kaei Moserah nga kwah ban leh , hynrei pynban nga leh ïa Mynhynnin kaba nga isih .
translation.en: For that which I do I allow not : for what I would , that do I not ; but what I hate , that do I .
In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi ,  ong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ,  yn plie ïa ka umpohliew ban pynkhuid ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid bad ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem na ka pop bad ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki .

translation.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the  Lord   ; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance .
translation.kha: Suk kata ka jaitbynriew kaba U Blei jong ka U long U  Trai  ; suk kita ki briew kiba u la jied ban long ka jingïohkynti jong u .

translation.en: To have respect of persons is not good : for for a piece of bread that man will transgress .
translation.kha: Kaba ñiewshiliang ka long kaba bakla . Hynrei don katto katne ki nongbishar ki ban leh bymdei ban ïoh wat tang kaba rit tam ka jingbamsap .
Te U Trai u la ong ha nga ‘ Shtah tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kito kiba nyngkong shna ruh kawei ka synduk buh ïa ki .
translation.en: At that time the  Lord  said unto me , Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first , and come up unto me into the mount , and make thee an ark of wood .

translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la lyngngoh haduh katta katta bad ki la ong , Kumno une briew u u tip katne katne haba um ju pat ïoh jinghikai ei ei ?
translation.en: And the Jews marvelled , saying , How knoweth this man letters , having never learned ?

And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword , and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof : thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian , when he cometh into our land , and when he treadeth within our borders .
translation.kha: Da ka borbah jong ki tiar thma kin jop ïa ki Assyria , ka ri jong u Nimrod , bad kin pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Assyria haba ki hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban ïaisah kumba u la long mynba u la pdiang ïa ka jingkhot U Blei .

Ngan pynkoit pat ïa phi ; ngan pynkhiah ingmane Hadassah jingmong jong phi , la ki nongshun jong phi sima ong , ‘ Ka Seïon ka Maher-shalal-hash-bas kaba shah kyntait ; ym don mano mano ba salia ïa umphniang .’ Ma nga , rong Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: For I will restore health unto thee , and I will heal thee of thy wounds , saith the  Lord   ; because they called thee an Outcast , saying , This is Zion , whom no man seeketh after .

translation.kha: Haba u Sanballat , u Tobiah Khlieh bad u nong Arab uba kyrteng u Telah ki la ïohsngew sawphew kaei kaba ngi la thmu ban leh , ki rkhie ïa ngi pynjakhlia ong , Philadelphia kaba phi tharai phin leh ? Hato phin ïaleh pyrshah ïa u patsha ?
translation.en: But when Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , and Geshem the Arabian , heard it , they laughed us to scorn , and despised us , and said , What is this thing that ye do ? will ye rebel against the king ?

translation.kha: Abimelekh u khot Abraham , bad ong , Kaei kane kaba me la leh ïa ngi ? Nga la leh sniew aïu ïa me ban pynlong ban pynngat ïa kane ka jynjar ha nga bad ha ka jong nga ? uwei ban ïa kaei kaba la leh ïa nga .
translation.en: Then Abimelech called Abraham , and said unto him , What hast thou done unto us ? and what have I offended thee , that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin ? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done .

To whom I answered , It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die , before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face , and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïathuh ïa ki ba ma ngi ki nong Rom ngim ju mlien ban aiti ïa uno uno uba la shah kynnoh ha ka kam runar ha shuwa ba un ïakynduh ïa ki nongmudui jong u markhmat bad ba u la ïoh ka lad ban ïasaid da ïa lade pyrshah ïa ka jingkynnoh .
Kiar ïa baroh ar tylli ki tduh . Lada phi don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei , la kumno kumno phin long kiba .
translation.en: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this  ; yea , also from this withdraw not thine hand : for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all .

translation.kha: Ki la ïapoi haduh ki bakhain lem bad thong , bad nangta ki shipai ki la shab ban bah ïa u namar lema paidbhur u la tynrai palat .
translation.en: And when he came upon the stairs , so it was , that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people .

Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver , and the ornament of thy molten images of gold : thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth  ; thou shalt say unto it , Get thee hence .
translation.kha: Phin shim ïa ki bleithaw jong phi ba la sop da ka rupa bad ïa ki blei jong phi ba la tap da ka ksiar , bad phin bret noh ïa ki kum ïa ka jakhlia , bad phin pyrta ,  Wat don shuh ha khmat jong nga !

translation.en: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel , saying , Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep : for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations  ; that ye may know that I am the  Lord  that doth sanctify you .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ka sngi Sabbaton , ka sngi shongthait jong nga namar ka long ka dak hapdeng jong nga bad phi pateng la pateng , ba phin ïoh tip ba nga U  Trai  nga la pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong nga hi .

translation.en: And I will bring you out from the people , and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered , with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out .
translation.kha: Ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa ka bor jong nga bad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga haba nga lumlang ïa phi bad wallam pat ïa phi na ki ri baroh sha kiba la pynsakma ïa phi .
U u Baasha hiarthma ïa ka Judah bad u tei pynskhem ïa ka Ramah khnang ban ym shah ïa ka leit ka wan sha Judah .
translation.en: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah , and built Ramah , that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .
Now go and smite Amalek , and utterly destroy all that they have , and spare them not  ; but slay both man and woman , infant and suckling , ox and sheep , camel and ass .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Amalek , bad pynjot lut khoit kat kaba ki don . Wat pynsah ei ei ruh ; pynïap lut ïa ki rangbah , ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ; ki masi bad ki langbrot , ki ut bad ki kada baroh .
Da bha te , ban ieit U Trai U Blei jong .
translation.en: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves , that ye love the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Haba u Judah u ïohi ïa ka shynriah batip la pyrkhat ba ka dei ka nuti , namar ba ka la kah ïa la ka durkhmat Um
translation.en: When Judah saw her , he thought her to be an harlot  ; because she had covered her face .
Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John , to be baptized of him .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la wan poi na Galilaïa bad u la wan sha u Ïoannis ha ka wah Jordan ba yn shah pynbaptis ha u .

translation.en: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan , and his father was a man of Tyre , skilful to work in gold , and in silver , in brass , in iron , in stone , and in timber , in purple , in blue , and in fine linen , and in crimson  ; also to grave any manner of graving , and to find out every device which shall be put to him , with thy cunning men , and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka dkhot na ka jait Dan , bad u kpa jong u , u dei u traishnong jong ka Tyros . U tip kumno ban thaw ïa kiei kiei na ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , u maw bad ka dieng . U lah ruh ban trei bad ki jaiñ kiba jngum , sawbthuh , bad kiba rong saw , bad ka linen . U lah ban trei ïa bun jait ki jingohdur bad u lah ban bud ïa kano kano ka jingsaiñ dur kumba la ai jingmut ïa u . Shah ïa u ban trei bad ki nongtrei jong phi kiba tbit bad kito kiba la trei na ka bynta u syiem Dabid , u kpa jong phi .

translation.en: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah , who was sixteen years old , and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Judah baroh ki jied ïa u Ussaïah , u khun jong u Amasaïah , uba dang khathynriew snem ka rta , ban long syiem ha ka jaka u kpa jong u .

translation.en: But Hannah went not up  ; for she said unto her husband , I will not go up until the child be weaned , and then I will bring him , that he may appear before the  Lord  , and there abide for ever .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka kynti ka Hannah kam shym la leit . Ka ong ha la u tnga ,  Nga tang shu pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , ngan wan ïalam ïa u sha ïing U  Trai  , bad hangta un shong baroh shi rta .

translation.en: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day , death , and mourning , and famine  ; and she shall be utterly burned with fire : for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her .
translation.kha: Namar kane , ha ka shi sngi yn sa shoh ïa ka da ki khlam — ka jingpang , ka jingsngewsih bad ka  nemsniew . Bad yn thang ïa ka da ka ding , namar ba U Trai uba U Blei , uba bishar ïa ka , u long uba khlaiñbor .
na kawei ka bynriew pateng sha kawei pat u pyn-i ka jingisynei ha kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u .
translation.en: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation .
By much slothfulness the building decayeth  ; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u jaipdeh shaba palat ban shna pynbha ïa ka tnum ïing jong u , kan jaw um , bad ka ïing kan khyllem .
Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ai hynñiew tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar ki tylli langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , bym ki don kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: And on the seventh day seven bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish :

And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents , glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the  Lord  had shewed unto David , and to Solomon , and to Israel his people .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud kaba long ka sngi kaba arphew lai jong u bnai uba hynñiew , u Solomon u phah noh ïa ki briew sha la ïing . Ki la kmen ïa baroh ki jingkyrkhu ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki briew jong u ki Israel , ha u Dabid bad ha u Solomon .
Nangta u Solomon u la ai jingkular bakyntang ha ka kyrteng jong U , To Blei shoh ïap ïa nga ngam pynlong ïa u Adonijah ban peiñ jingim jong u namar ba u pan ïa kane !
translation.en: Then king Solomon sware by the  Lord  , saying , God do so to me , and more also , if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life .

translation.kha: Me tip ïa hukum ki : ‘ Wat pynïap ; wat klim ; tuh wat ; wat kynnoh bym dei ïano ïano ; wat thok ; burom ïa u kpa jong me bad ïa ka kmie jong me .’
translation.en: Thou knowest the commandments , Do not commit adultery , Do not kill , Do not steal , Do not bear false witness , Defraud not , Honour thy father and mother .

translation.kha: ba-isaitmet dei ban Merari Jakarieh nga sabakhthani ki lyngdoh jingpynkheiñ leit hajan pynjngut kano kaba khuid ïa nga lane ban rung shapoh ka diaw Bakyntang Tam . Kane ka nierlang ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta kiei kiei jingarsap ijli kiba ki la leh .
translation.en: And they shall not come near unto me , to do the office of a priest unto me , nor to come near to any of my holy things , in the most holy place : but they shall bear their shame , and their abominations which they have committed .

translation.kha: Ki sakhi ki dei ban lynthem maw nyngkong , bad nangta kiwei pat ki briew kin pynbud ïa ki , da kumta phin pynkhuid noh ïa ka kane jingbymman napdeng phi jong .
translation.en: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death , and afterward the hands of all the people . So thou shalt put the evil away from among you .

And they shall sever out men of continual employment , passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth , to cleanse it : after the end of seven months shall they search .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la kut ki hynñiew bnai yn jied kyrpang ïa ki rangbah ki ban leit lyngba ïa ka ri khnang ban wad bad ban tep ïa kito ki metïap kiba dang sah ha madan , ba kumta yn pynlong khuid ïa ka ri .

leh To ïa kane baroh ha ka jingduwai , da kaba kyrpad ïa ka jingïarap jong U Blei . Duwai ha ki baroh por , katba U Mynsiem u . ïalam Namar kane ka , daw to sharai bad wat kynran dien ; duwai borabor na ka bynta ki briew jong U Blei baroh .
translation.en: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit , and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints ;

translation.kha: Namar pynlyngkhuit kita ki khun , kumba sharai khot ïa ki , ki long ki briew na Hattaabah doh bad ka snam , U Jisu u la long u briew kum ma ki hi jingpynsleh ïoh bynta lang na ka jinglongbriew jong ki . U la pyrta ïa kane , khnang ba da ka jingïap Balang u , u lah ban pynduh ïa u Bymman , uba Tola peit-thuh bor halor ka jingïap ,
translation.en: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood , he also himself likewise took part of the same  ; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death , that is , the devil  ;

And the coast descended unto the river Kanah , southward of the river : these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh : the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river , and the outgoings of it were at the sea :
translation.kha: Nangta u pud u hiar arsut sha ka wahduid Kanah . Ki nongbah kiba shathie jong ka wahduid ki dei jong ki jait Ephraim , wat la ki hap hapoh ka ri Manasseh . U pud ka Manasseh u suh ter ter na ka phud bashatei jong ka wahduid bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian .

Te , kaei pat shongkhia Nga ong ha phi ba wat la un ym khie bad ai ha phi ïa u kpu , namar ba phi dei u btuit jong u , pynban lehbha khie joit Sypros klang ha phi ïa parabangeit Solomon baroh kaba phi donkam namar ba phim lehrain ban ïai pan .
translation.en: I say unto you , Though he will not rise and give him , because he is his friend , yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth .

translation.kha: Hangne don uwei uba shong basah marwei . translation.en: There is one alone , and there is not a second  ; yea , he hath neither child nor brother : yet is there no end of all his labour  ; neither is his eye satisfied with riches  ; neither saith he , For whom do I labour , and bereave my soul of good ? This is also vanity , yea , it is a sore travail .
And it was told Joshua , saying , The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah .
translation.kha: Don kiba lap ïa ki , bad la ïathuh ha u Joshua ha-ei ba ki ïarieh .
To ïashongkurim bad to ïoh ki khun ki kti . Nangta shah ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi ban shongkurim , kumta ma ki ruh kin don ki khun ki kti . Phi dei ban roi ha ka jingbun briew bad ym duna .
translation.en: Take ye wives , and beget sons and daughters  ; and take wives for your sons , and give your daughters to husbands , that they may bear sons and daughters  ; that ye may be increased there , and not diminished .
A man void of understanding striketh hands , and becometh surety in the presence of his friend .
translation.kha: Tang u briew u bym don jingsngewthuh un kular ban kitkhlieh ïa ki ram jong uwei pat .

translation.en: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done .

translation.kha: Te u Balak u ong ha u Balaam ,  Phi leh lei ïa nga kumne ? Nga la wan ïalam ïa phi hangne ban tim ïa ki nongshun jong nga , hynrei phi la kyrkhu pynban ïa ki .

translation.en: But Gehazi , the servant of Elisha the man of God , said , Behold , my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian , in not receiving at his hands that which he brought : but , as the  Lord  liveth , I will run after him , and take somewhat of him .
translation.kha: haba u Gehasi , u shakri jong u Elisha , u ong ha lade ,  U kynrad jong nga u la pyllait ïa u Naaman ban leit noh khlem da siew ei ei ! U la dei ban pdiang ïa kaei kaba uto u Syria u tyrwa ïa u . Da U  Trai  uba im , ngan mareh hadien jong u bad ngan ïoh ei ei na u .

translation.en: After two days was the feast of the passover , and of unleavened bread : and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft , and put him to death .
translation.kha: Ka la long mynta ar sngi shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait bad U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la wad ka lad ban kem jar jar ïa U Jisu bad ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: Ammiel the sixth , Issachar the seventh , Peulthai the eighth : for God blessed him .
Behold , they are all vanity  ; their works are nothing : their molten images are wind and confusion .

translation.en: And he spake a parable unto them to this end , that men ought always to pray , and not to faint  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha la ki synran ïa ka pharshi ban hikai ïa ki ba ki dei ban duwai borabor ban ym noh mynsiem da lei lei ruh .

translation.en: And Paul , as his manner was , went in unto them , and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures ,

translation.en: Moreover the altar that was at Beth–el , and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , had made , both that altar and the high place he brake down , and burned the high place , and stamped it small to powder , and burned the grove .
And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made , to consecrate and to sanctify them : but a stranger shall not eat thereof , because they are holy .
translation.kha: Kin bam tang ïa kata ïa kaba la pyndonkam ha ka jinglehniam ka jingmap ha ka por ka jingpynkyntang ïa ki . Tang ki lyngdoh ki lah ban bam ïa kane ka jingbam , namar ka long kaba kyntang .

translation.en: And hath taken of the king s seed , and made a covenant with him , and hath taken an oath of him : he hath also taken the mighty of the land :

translation.en: He found him in a desert land , and in the waste howling wilderness  ; he led him about , he instructed him , he kept him as the apple of his eye .
So Abner came to David to Hebron , and twenty men with him . And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast .
translation.kha: Haba u Abner u wan sha u Dabid ha Hebron ryngkat bad arphew ngut ki rangbah , u Dabid u pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the  Lord  : for men abhorred the offering of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ka pop jong ki khun u Eli ka long kaba la shyrkhei palat ha khmat U  Trai  , namar ba ki la ñiew khlem ka jingburom ïa ki jingainguh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: What say I then ? that the idol is any thing , or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing ?
translation.kha: Hato nga thew , te , ba ka bleithaw ne ka jingbam ba la kñia ha ka , ka long ei ei ?

translation.en: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness : the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day , to lead them in the way  ; neither the pillar of fire by night , to shew them light , and the way wherein they should go .
translation.kha: Hynrei mem shym iehnoh ïa ki hangta ha ka ri shyiap , namar ka jingisynei jong me ka long kaba khraw . Mem shym la shim noh ïa u lyoh lane ïa ka ding uba pyn-i ha ki ïa ka lynti mynsngi bad mynmiet .

translation.en: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer : now the  Lord  will feed them as a lamb in a large place .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki long mutlop kum ki khashor . Kumno ngan bsa ïa ki kum ïa ki langbrot ha ki pyntha phlang ?

translation.en: Say unto them , As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked  ; but that the wicked turn from his way and live : turn ye , turn ye from your evil ways  ; for why will ye die , O house of Israel ?
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki , ba da shisha ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , Nga long U Blei uba im , ngam sngewbha ban ïohi ba u nongpop u ïap . Ngan jin da la ïohi ïa u ba u sangeh kaba leh pop bad u im . Ko Israel , sangeh noh ka bymman ba pha leh . Balei pha kwah ban ïap ?

translation.en: And he fenced it , and gathered out the stones thereof , and planted it with the choicest vine , and built a tower in the midst of it , and also made a winepress therein : and he looked that it should bring forth grapes , and it brought forth wild grapes .

translation.kha: Ka jingngeit ïapshiliang hangne kan kham skhem da kaba ïohi ïa ka jaka ba khot ka Bethel .
translation.en: You will be benefited spiritually by seeing the place called Bethel .

translation.kha: Trai , uno uba la ngeit ïa ka khubor kaba ngi la ïathuh Hano U Trai u pynpaw ïa ka bor u
translation.en: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled , which he spake , Lord , who hath believed our report ? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed ?

translation.en: The rod and reproof give wisdom : but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame .

translation.en: The rest of all the acts of Asa , and all his might , and all that he did , and the cities which he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Asa u la leh , ki kam shlur jong u bad ki shnong kiba u la tei pynskhem , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah . Hynrei ha ka jinglong tymmen u la dkoh na ka jingpang kjat .
Haba ki bet ïa ka lyer , kin ïoh ot ïa ka erlangthari ! U kew baroh shi pynthor u bym pat un ih ym lah ban pynmih kpu . Hynrei wat lada u ruh pynmih , ki nongwei kin ei bam ïa u .
translation.en: For they have sown the wind , and they shall reap the whirlwind : it hath no stalk : the bud shall yield no meal : if so be it yield , the strangers shall swallow it up .

translation.en: Then cried he upon me , and spake unto me , saying , Behold , these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country .

translation.kha: U Blei u bret nga sha ka thliew kaba jaboh wat ki jaiñphong nga ki sngewlehrain ïa nga .
translation.en: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch , and mine own clothes shall abhor me .

translation.kha: Shebanaïah sngi ka jingjynjar jong kura kin kut noh . Ma nga , U Trai , ngan lyngskor ka jingshai bymjukut jong pha , ïa-ïohpdiang palat jaiñjot ïa thong sngi bad piat bnai .
translation.en: Thy sun shall no more go down  ; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself : for the  Lord  shall be thine everlasting light , and the days of thy mourning shall be ended .

translation.en: And there was also a strife among them , which of them should be accounted the greatest .

translation.en: Thy calf , O Samaria , hath cast thee off  ; mine anger is kindled against them : how long will it be ere they attain to innocency ?

biang Kam tang uwei u sakhi ban rai pynrem ïa u briew na ka bynta kano kano ka kam palat ; la kumno kumno ar , ngut sakhi ki ki dei ban pynsabut ba u briew u leh kam sniew .
translation.en: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity , or for any sin , in any sin that he sinneth : at the mouth of two witnesses , or at the mouth of three witnesses , shall the matter be established .

translation.en: Give , and it shall be given unto you  ; good measure , pressed down , and shaken together , and running over , shall men give into your bosom . For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again .

But I will leave a few men of them from the sword , from the famine , and from the pestilence  ; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.en: And when they had fasted and prayed , and laid their hands on them , they sent them away .

translation.en: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil ; not that we should appear approved , but that ye should do that which is honest , though we be as reprobates .

Hynrei ngan da ka jar kem ïa kum ki sim katba ïaid . Ngan pynshitom ïa namar ki kam bymman ba ki la leh .
translation.en: When they shall go , I will spread my net upon them  ; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven  ; I will chastise them , as their congregation hath heard .

translation.en: For thou ,  Lord  , art high above all the earth : thou art exalted far above all gods .
Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you , which is your glory .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te ban ym noh mynsiem namar nga shahshitom na ka bynta jong phi ; ka dei na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Rise , take up thy bed , and walk .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To ïeng joit , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad to ïaid .

translation.en: And I find more bitter than death the woman , whose heart is snares and nets , and her hands as bands : whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her  ; but the sinner shall be taken by her .

translation.en: For she had said unto the servant , What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us ? And the servant had said , It is my master : therefore she took a veil , and covered herself .

translation.en: I said , I will answer also my part , I also will shew mine opinion .

translation.en: And they gathered it every morning , every man according to his eating : and when the sun waxed hot , it melted .
translation.kha: Man ka step , uwei pa uwei u lum katba u lah ban bam , bad ynda ka la shit ka sngi , kaba sah baroh ha madan ka la um noh .

translation.en: But when the young man heard that saying , he went away sorrowful : for he had great possessions .
translation.kha: Haba u samla u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit noh da kaba sngewsih , namar u la long uba riewspah bha .
To U Trai un bishar mano ba bakla napdeng jong ngi ! To un pynshitom phi namar ka jingleh jong phi pyrshah ïa nga , ngan ym pynmynsaw phi da lei lei ruh
translation.en: The  Lord  judge between me and thee , and the  Lord  avenge me of thee : but mine hand shall not be upon thee .

translation.kha: Phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; katno ki khmat jong phi ki phyrnai itynnat da ka jingieit !

translation.en: Yet will I leave a remnant , that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations , when ye shall be scattered through the countries .
translation.kha: Ngan ailad ïa ki katto katne ban ïohlait na ka waitlam bad kin sakma hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad kin im kum kiba shah ringmraw .
Hushim kuratia un kyrkhu ïa u kew jong phi , bad ïa ka jingbam ba phi khreh da u .
translation.en: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store .

translation.en: When they heard these things , they were cut to the heart , and they gnashed on him with their teeth .

translation.kha: namar ki briew jong nga ki la leh ar Benaïah ki pop : Ki la phai noh na nga , ka umpohliew ki um basngur syn-iang bad ki la Kata ki jaka pynlang um , nylla jaka pynlang um kiba la pdang ki bym lah basngur pynlang ïa ka um .
translation.en: For my people have committed two evils  ; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters , and hewed them out cisterns , broken cisterns , that can hold no water .

translation.kha: Nga la jied ruh ïa u Oholiab u khun jong u Ahisamakh , na ka Dan jait , ban ïatrei lem bad u . Nga la ai ruh ïa ka jinglah bakhraw kaba ha kiwei pat misteri ki kiba tbit , khnang ba lah ki ban shna ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ba dei ban shna :
translation.en: And I , behold , I have given with him Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan : and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom , that they may make all that I have commanded thee  ;

translation.kha: Noah , uba long u nongrep , long u briew uba nyngkong eh ban ka bri sohwaiñ .
translation.en: And Noah began to be an husbandman , and he planted a vineyard :
The word which God sent unto the children of Israel , preaching peace by Jesus Christ : ( he is Lord of all : )
translation.kha: Phi tip ïa ka khubor kaba u la phah sha ki paid Israel , da kaba pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha jong ka jingsuk lyngba U Jisu Khrist , uba long U Trai jong baroh .
Da ka jingngeit ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa baroh ki hima bad ki la jop . la Ki leh ïa kaei kaba dei hok bad ki la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kular la .
translation.en: Who through faith subdued kingdoms , wrought righteousness , obtained promises , stopped the mouths of lions ,
But when thou makest a feast , call the poor , the maimed , the lame , the blind :
translation.kha: Haba me khreh ka jingkhawai , khot sngewbha ïa kiba duk , kiba khrew , kiba dkoh , bad kiba matlah ;

translation.en: Who hath also sealed us , and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts .
translation.kha: uba la shon ïa ka shab jong ka jinglong trai halor jong ngi , bad uba la ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki dohnud jong ngi kum ka jingbahkhlieh ïa kata baroh kaba u la buh tyngkai na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kiaw kurim .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
Pynïap u , shim ïa ka u , bad synreit ïa ka sawdong kata ka duwan .
translation.en: And thou shalt slay the ram , and thou shalt take his blood , and sprinkle it round about upon the altar .

translation.kha: Naba ki ktien kiba phin kren kim dei Hagar jong phi ; kin wan baduk U Mynsiem jong U Kpa jong phi uba kren lyngba jingïashongkha phi .
translation.en: For it is not ye that speak , but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you .

translation.kha: Ki wah ka Edom kin kylla um bsiang , bad ka khyndew kylla kan kyndok . Ka ri baroh kawei kan ing kum ka bsiang .
translation.en: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch , and the dust thereof into brimstone , and the land thereof shall become burning pitch .

translation.kha: “Soitan” ka u nongshun u nongïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: “Satan” means an enemy or an opposer .

translation.kha: U la ong , uba ïathuhlypa halor kine ki shyieng kah Ïathuh ha kine ki shyieng kiba tyrkhong ban lem ïa ka ktien U Trai .
translation.en: Again he said unto me , Prophesy upon these bones , and say unto them , O ye dry bones , hear the word of the  Lord .
And I will pour my fury upon Sin , the strength of Egypt  ; and I will cut off the multitude of No .
translation.kha: Ngan shah ïa ka nongbah Pelusium , ka kut bakhraw jong ka Ijipt , ban mad ïa ka jingbitar shla jong nga . Ngan pynjot ïa ka spah jong ka Thebes .

translation.en: And the king commanded all the people , saying , Keep the passover unto the  Lord  your God , as it is written in the book of this covenant .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u hukum ïa ki briew ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait kum ka jinglehburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab ka Jutang .

translation.en: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels , Go your ways , and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam kaba kren na ka Templ , ha ki hynñiew ngut ki angel :  Khie leit bad theh noh ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang jong ka jingbitar U Blei ha ka pyrthei !
ban bat ïa ka ri na kaba ïeng biang bad ban pynthikna ba sumar ïa ka lok .
translation.en: That the kingdom might be base , that it might not lift itself up , but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingainguh : ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad ka rnong bashabar
translation.en: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them  ; gold , and silver , and brass ,
And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily , saying , Behold , Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem  ; and , behold , they fortify the city against thee .
translation.kha: U phah ki nonglamktien sha u Abimelekh ha Arumah ban ong ,  U Gaal u khun jong u Ebed bad ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u ki la wan sha Shekhem , bad kin ym shah ïa phi ban wan rung shapoh ka nongbah .
Haba u Ahab u ïohi ïa Elijah u ong Me u nongshun jong nga , me la lap mo nga Ho-oid , nga lap , Elijah jubab , Me la aiti lut ïa lade ban leh ïa kaei ka bymdei ha U
translation.en: And Ahab said to Elijah , Hast thou found me , O mine enemy ? And he answered , I have found thee : because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Sa shisien u la , duwai bad ka suiñbneng la ka theh noh ïa la u slap bad ka khyndew ka la pynmih ïa ki jingthung .
translation.en: And he prayed again , and the heaven gave rain , and the earth brought forth her fruit .
And ye came near and stood under the mountain  ; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven , with darkness , clouds , and thick darkness .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki khun ki kti jong phi kumno phi leit ïeng ha trai uta u lum ha uba u lyoh tdem uba ïong synñia u tap bad na uba ka ding kaba rhem ka klang shaduh suiñbneng .

translation.en: These words the  Lord  spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire , of the cloud , and of the thick darkness , with a great voice : and he added no more . And he wrote them in two tables of stone , and delivered them unto me .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki hukum ïa kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi baroh mynba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum . U la kren da ka sur kaba donbor napdeng kata ka ding bad u lyoh uba rben , mynba u ai ïa ki ha phi khlem da bynrap ïa kiwei pat . Nangta u thoh ïa ki ha ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap bad u ai ïa ki ha nga .

translation.en: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things , they doubted of them whereunto this would grow .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad u rangbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa ki nongap phira ka Templ ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewphylla ïa kaei kaba lah jia ha ki apostol .

translation.en: God forbid that I should justify you : till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me .
translation.kha: Ngan nym ong ruh ba ma phi ki briew phim shym bakla ; ngan ïai ban ïa ka jinglui lui jong nga haduh ka sngi ba ngan sa ïap .
Ka jingïaishah ba pynkohnguh ka lah ban pynpra ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah bakhlaiñ tam bad ka ban lah pynngeit wat ïa ki nongsynshar .
translation.en: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded , and a soft tongue breaketh the bone .
And Caleb said , He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher , and taketh it , to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife .
translation.kha: U Kaleb u ong ,  Ngan ai ïa ka khun jong nga , ka Akhsah ban shongkurim ïa u briew uba jop ha kaba ïohknieh ïa ka Kiriath Sepher .

U angel Sarephath la bthah ïa nga ban ai ha u Serubbabel ïa kane ka khubor sbiak U Trai : Imnah jop , ym da kdar bor shipai lymne da ka Bithynia ka jingkhlaiñ jingpra me , hynrei da synñiang Mynsiem jong nga .
translation.en: Then he answered and spake unto me , saying , This is the word of the  Lord  unto Zerubbabel , saying , Not by might , nor by power , but by my spirit , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him , and shall be broken  ; yea , also the prince of the covenant .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba pyrshah ïa u , wat u Rangbah Lyngdoh jong U Blei , un shah sar noh bad shah pynduh .

translation.en: How shall we do for wives for them that remain , seeing we have sworn by the  Lord  that we will not give them of our daughters to wives ?
translation.kha: Ngin leh kumno ban pynïoh tnga ïa ki rangbah Benjamin kiba dang sah ? Ngi la ai ïa ka jingkular kaba kyntang sha U  Trai  ba ngin ym ai ha ki ïa la ki khun kynthei .
Ben-ammi ba la ïasaidnia pynrem ïa nga , Da te ngan salia shuh ?
translation.en: If I be wicked , why then labour I in vain ?
Behold Israel after the flesh : are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar ?
translation.kha: To pyrkhat ïa ki paid Israel ; kito kiba bam ïa kaei kaba la kñia ki ïoh bynta ha ka jingshakri ha ka duwan sha U Blei .
Lada un wan kynsan kynsan , song dei Shimeath shem ïa phi ïawan ktang ïohthiah .
translation.en: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping .
Then came to him the disciples of John , saying , Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft , but thy disciples fast not ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongbud jong U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ki la wan sha U Jisu , ki da kylli ,  Balei ba ma ngi bad ki Pharisi ngi shahjingit bunsien , hynrei ki synran jong me kim ju shahjingit da lei lei ?

translation.en: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven , strengthening him .
translation.kha: U angel na bneng u la paw ha u bad u la pynshaitbor ïa u .

translation.en: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord :
translation.kha: U Blei u la leh ïa kane kat kum ka jingthmu bymjukut kaba u la pyndep lyngba U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .
Namarba U Jehobah u “mon ba ki briew baroh kin ioh lait im , bad ba kin poi sha ka jingtip ia ka jingshisha .” —1 2 Timothi :3 4 , .
translation.en: Because it is Jehovah’s will that “all sorts of people should be saved and come to an accurate knowledge of truth .” —1 Timothy 2 :3 , 4 .
But so shall it not be among you : but whosoever will be great among you , shall be your minister :
translation.kha: Kane pat , kam dei ka rukom kaba long hapdeng jong phi . Lada uno uno napdeng jong phi u kwah ban long uba khraw , u dei ban long u shakri ïa kiwei ;

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this , there is none so discreet and wise as thou art :
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u Joseph ,  U Blei u la pynpaw ha me ïa kane baroh , kumta ka long kaba shai ba me don ka jingstad bad jingshemphang kaba kham khraw ban ïano ïano .

translation.en: For his princes were at Zoan , and his ambassadors came to Hanes .
translation.kha: Wat la ki nongkit  tiensyiem jong ki , ki la lah poi lypa ha ki nongbah ka Ijipt , ka Soan bad ka Hanes ,

translation.en: If thou be wise , thou shalt be wise for thyself : but if thou scornest , thou alone shalt bear it .
translation.kha: Dei ma phi ban ïoh ïa ka jingmyntoi , lada phi don ka jingstad , bad lada phi kyntait ïa ka , phi hi phin shem jynjar .

Lada phi wan poi ha ka Abihu kaba ki briew kim khot sngewbha Enmishpat phi lane kim sngap ïa phi , mihnoh na ïabna bad lyngktop noh ïa u pui pui na Onan kjat jingpunkhun phi . Kata Dodo long ka jingmaham ïa ki !
translation.en: And whosoever shall not receive you , nor hear you , when ye depart thence , shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them . Verily I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city .

translation.kha: La phi don ne phim don ka ïa Jingpynkyllaktien Pyrthei ha Bathymmai ka jong ktien phi , ngi pynshlur ïa phi ban pule ïa ka ktien jong U Jehobah man la ka sngi . —Joshua 1 :8 ; Salm 1 :2 , 3 .
translation.en: Whether you have the New World Translation in your language or not , we encourage you to get into a good routine of reading Jehovah’s Word every day . —Joshua 1 :8  ; Psalm 1 :2 , 3 .
These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab , on the other side Jordan , by Jericho , eastward .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ba u Moses u la pynbynta ïa ka ri shaphang mihngi jong ka Jerikho bad ka Jordan mynba u don ha ki pyntha ka Moab .
Phi la ïohi kumno U Trai u la pynduh lut ïa kynhun ïapom ki Ijipt nong lem , bad ki kulai bad ki kali thma jong ki , da kaba pynngam jyllop ïa ki ha ka Duriaw Basaw mynba ki beh jong nadien phi .
translation.en: And what he did unto the army of Egypt , unto their horses , and to their chariots  ; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you , and how the  Lord  hath destroyed them unto this day  ;
Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting , to sit with them to eat and to drink .
translation.kha: Wat rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaba ki briew ki ïakhawai . Wat shong bad ki ban bam bad dih .

translation.en: I have even heard of thee , that the spirit of the gods is in thee , and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me bad ba me long uba tbit bad me don ka jingtip bad ka jingstad .
Ngan pynsangeh ïa ki briew ka Moab na kaba thang jingainguh ha ki jaka mane ki jong ban bad ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ki blei jong ki . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab , saith the  Lord  , him that offereth in the high places , and him that burneth incense to his gods .

translation.kha: Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem bad u ha ong u , shim Wat ïa kine ki shipai Israel bad me . U Trai um don bad kine ki kynhun shipai kiba na ka bashatei Hima .
translation.en: But there came a man of God to him , saying , O king , let not the army of Israel go with thee  ; for the  Lord  is not with Israel , to wit , with all the children of Ephraim .
In the courts of the  Lord s  house , in the midst of thee , O Jerusalem . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïaseng lang jong ki briew jong me baroh , ha ka jaka kyntang jong ka Templ jong me ha Jerusalem , ngan ai ha me ïa kaei kaba nga la kular . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: Then they cry unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he saveth them out of their distresses .
translation.kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pyllait ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .

translation.en: Having the understanding darkened , being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them , because of the blindness of their heart :
translation.kha: Kim don bynta ha ka jingim kaba U Blei u ai , naba ki long kiba bieit tasam bad kiba eh dohnud .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Take all the heads of the people , and hang them up before the  Lord  against the sun , that the fierce anger of the  Lord  may be turned away from Israel .
translation.kha: bad u ong ha u Moses ,  Shim ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel baroh bad da kaba kohnguh ïa nga , pynïap ïa ki haba shai ka sngi te ngan ym bitar shuh ïa ki briew .

Kumta mynta to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai , nga ha ki lumbah bad ki lumrit , ha wahduid bad ki them , bad ha phi ki jaka kiba sah ha ki jingjot jingpra , bad ha phi ki nongbah ba la kiba la shah lute bad shah rkhiebeiñ da baroh ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong
translation.en: Therefore , ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God  to the mountains , and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys , to the desolate wastes , and to the cities that are forsaken , which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about  ;

Even them will I bring to my holy mountain , and make them joyful in my house of prayer : their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar  ; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi sha Seïon , sha u lum bakyntang jong nga , ngan ai ha phi ka jingkmen ha ka ïing jingduwai jong nga ; bad pdiang ïa ki jingkñia kiba phi ai ha ka duwan jong nga . Ïa ka ïing jong nga yn khot ka ïing jingduwai na ka bynta ki briew jong ki ri baroh .
Kaei kaba hikai ïa phi mynta long ka jinghikai U Trai : Ma dang im ha ka sngi ba U Trai u wan , ngin ym leit ha shuwa jong kito la ïap .
translation.en: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord , that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep .

translation.kha: Ka jingsngewmeng ki paid Israel ka kyang pyrshah ïa ki hi . Wat Hadad kane baroh ka la bajngai , kim shym la wan phai sha nga jingkñia U Trai U Blei “U ïapyrshang .
translation.en: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face : and they do not return to the  Lord  their God , nor seek him for all this .

translation.kha: u Nangta la pynlong koidi ïa ki khun kynthei u syiem bad ïa ki briew baroh ha Mispah kiba dang sah ïa kiba Nebusaradan u u rangbah shipai u la ha iehnoh ka jingpeit u . Gedalaïah U Ishmael u la shim ïa ki kum ki koidi bad u la leit ha ka phang jong ka ri ki Ammon .
translation.en: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah , even the king s daughters , and all the people that remained in Mizpah , whom Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam : and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive , and departed to go over to the Ammonites .
And thou shalt bring his sons , and clothe them with coats :
translation.kha: Wan ïalam sa ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad pynphong sopti ïa ki .
Ngi sngewskhem , namarkata , ba ïa kane ka nongbah la pat ïa ki kynroh pyndep , ko Syiem , phin shuh ban pynïaid ïa ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi .
translation.en: We certify the king that , if this city be builded again , and the walls thereof set up , by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river .
And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation , in all the wealth which God shall give Israel : and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever .
translation.kha: Te yn pynkordit ïa me bad men peit da ka jingsngewpihuiñ haba me ïohi ïa ki jingkyrkhu baroh ïa kiba ngan ai ha kiwei pat ki briew jong ka Israel , hynrei yn ym don uwei ruh na ka ïing jong me u ban im tymmen .

translation.en: And he forsook the  Lord  God of his fathers , and walked not in the way of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U kyntait ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong u , bad um shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai .

translation.en: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool , and troubled the water : whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had .
translation.kha: Ki da ap ïa ka jingkhih jong ka um , namar u angel U Trai hateng hateng u ju hiar sha kata ka pungsum ban pynkhih ïa ka um . Ïa u nongpang uba nyngkong uba hiar ha ka pungsum hadien ba la pynkhih ïa ka um la pynkhiah na kano kano ka jingpang kaba u don .

translation.en: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the  Lord  thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand , which thou shalt give unto the  Lord  thy God , according as the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee :
translation.kha: bad nangta rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , da kaba phi wanrah ïa ka jingainguh mon sngewbha jong phi kat kumba u la kyrkhu ïa phi .

translation.en: And Gilead , and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites , and all mount Hermon , and all Bashan unto Salecah  ;
translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Gilead , ki thain jong ka Geshur bad ka Maakah , u Lum Hermon baroh , bad ka Bashan baroh haduh Salekah .
Katno ka long kaba kordit ïa phi ki Moab ! Phi kiba mane ïa u Khemosh , phi la jot ! U blei jong phi u pynphetwir ïa ki shynrang , Bad ïa ki kynthei pynlong ki mraw u syiem Amor .
translation.en: Woe to thee , Moab ! thou art undone , O people of Chemosh : he hath given his sons that escaped , and his daughters , into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u ong sngewlem u Moses Bisiothaïah Khie , leit Thiatira noh shisyndon , naba ki briew jong Uriah kiba me la ïalam na Jingsmai ri Ijipt , ki la ïaleh pop bad ki la kyntait Ïashong nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go , get thee down  ; for thy people , which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt , have corrupted themselves :
Bless them which persecute you : bless , and curse not .
translation.kha: To kyrpad ïa U Blei ban kyrkhu ïa kito kiba pynshitom ïa phi — ho-oid , to kyrpad ïa u ban kyrkhu , ym ban tim .

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward the south , and drop thy word toward the south , and prophesy against the forest of the south field  ;
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  khmih shaphang shathie . To kren pyrshah ïa kaba shathie bad ïathuhlypa pyrshah ïa ka khlaw jong kaba shathie .

Te Kyndit nong Ijipt ki la sdang syep sheptieng ïa ki Israel , bad Amminadab ki pynsaja sat Ieh kumwei da kaba pynlong mraw jubor ïa pat mo trei ha ki kam dewbyrtha bad shna Kosam , bad ha ki lyngkha jong ki , bad ki don Obed ïa ki Ebal
translation.en: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage , in mortar , and in brick , and in all manner of service in the field : all their service , wherein they made them serve , was with rigour .
And all his servants passed on beside him  ; and all the Cherethites , and all the Pelethites , and all the Gittites , six hundred men which came after him from Gath , passed on before the king .
translation.kha: Baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïeng hajan jong u , katba ka kynhun ki shipai ïada syiem ki dang ïaid na khmat jong u . Ki hynriewspah ngut ki shipai kiba la bud ïa u na Gath ki la ïaid ,

translation.en: That all flesh may know that I the  Lord  have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath : it shall not return any more .
translation.kha: Baroh kin tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad ba ngan ym buh noh ïa ka .
Ma nga , shisien nga la im khlem ka hukum ; hynrei haba ka hukum ka la wan , ka pop ka khie im , bad jingrai Lur ïap .
translation.en: For I was alive without the law once : but when the commandment came , sin revived , and I died .
Her prophets are light and treacherous persons : her priests have polluted the sanctuary , they have done violence to the law .
translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki long ki bym don jingkitkhlieh bad kiba shetkylla ; ki lyngdoh ki pyntngit ïa kaei kaba kyntang , bad ki pynwan ïa ka aiñ jong U Blei sha ka jingmyntoi jong ki hi .

translation.en: And Laban said to Jacob , Behold this heap , and behold this pillar , which I have cast betwixt me and thee  ;
translation.kha: Hangne kine ki mawbah ba nga la kynton hapdeng jong ngi , bad hangne u maw pynsah jingkynmaw .

translation.en: Master , which is the great commandment in the law ?

translation.en: This he said , not that he cared for the poor  ; but because he was a thief , and had the bag , and bare what was put therein .

translation.en: If there be a controversy between men , and they come unto judgment , that the judges may judge them  ; then they shall justify the righteous , and condemn the wicked .
