translation.kha: Naba uno uno u bym long pyrshah ïa ngi u long ha ka liang jong ngi .

translation.en: Remember Abraham , Isaac , and Israel , thy servants , to whom thou swarest by thine own self , and saidst unto them , I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven , and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed , and they shall inherit it for ever .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , ki shakri jong me . Kynmaw ïa ka jingkular bakyntang kaba me la pynlong bad ki ban ai ha ki ïa ki khun ki ksiew kiba bun kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng , bad ban ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ïa kata ka ri baroh kaba me la kular ba kan long ka jingïohkynti jong ki junom .
Dei kata balei U Blei phah ïa ka kti ban thoh ïa kine ki kyntien .
translation.en: Then was the part of the hand sent from him  ; and this writing was written .
One way is by observing the things he has created and thinking deeply about what they tell us .
translation.kha: Kawei na ki lad ka long da kaba peit bniah ïa ki jingthaw kiba u la thaw bad ban pyrkhat jylliew ïa kaei kaba ki , ki ïathuh ïa ngi .

Namar ba u Judas u long uba bat ïa Rispah pla pisa , don Reba ki synran ki la pyrkhat ba U Jisu u la ong ïa u Khusa leit Bethemek thied ïa kaei kaba ki shadong na ka bynta ka baheh Niam , lane ban ai mang ei Rebekka sew-ap dngiem .
translation.en: For some of them thought , because Judas had the bag , that Jesus had said unto him , Buy those things that we have need of against the feast  ; or , that he should give something to the poor .

translation.kha: Ether u syiem Ammon um jingpunkhun ei ei shongshit em ïa kane ka ïa-pyrkhat na u Jephthah .
translation.en: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him .
Doth God pervert judgment ? or doth the Almighty pervert justice ?
translation.kha: U Blei um ju pynkyllaiñ ïa ka jingbishar hok , um ju pep ban leh ïa kaba dei .
Kaei kaba phi dei ban ong ka kane long : Lada U u Trai mon , ngin im bad ngin leh ïa kane lane ïa katai .
translation.en: For that ye ought to say , If the Lord will , we shall live , and do this , or that .

translation.kha: Kumta ai Rabbith u Syiem sharum un pynmih ïa kane ka hukum bapyllun soi ïa ka , bad kan treikam , ka aiñ jong ki Mid kadiang ki Persia jingbabe ka bym lah ban pynkylla seiñpuh
translation.en: Now , O king , establish the decree , and sign the writing , that it be not changed , according to the law of the Medes and Persians , which altereth not .

translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh ka pur kylleng ki rudnong , kham bad bun ki rangbah ki la ïap khlaw ha ban ïa kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translation.en: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country : and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured .
As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather , and as vinegar upon nitre , so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart .
translation.kha: Kaba rwai jingrwai ha u briew uba khuslai mynsiem ka long kumba loit noh ïa ki jaiñ jong u ha ka por khriat lane kum kaba kyllan mluh ha ka jingmong .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these sayings , he departed from Galilee , and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren ïa kine kiei kiei , u la mihnoh na Galilaïa bad u la leit sha ka thain Judia sha shiliang jong ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: And the curious girdle of the ephod , which is upon it , shall be of the same , according to the work thereof  ; even of gold , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
translation.kha: Ïa u panpoh ba la thain itynnat bha da kijuh ki tiar dei ban pyndait ha ka ephod khnang ba kan ïalong kawei ka lyngkhot bad ka .

translation.en: Run now , I pray thee , to meet her , and say unto her , Is it well with thee ? is it well with thy husband ? is it well with the child ? And she answered , It is well .
translation.kha: Pynkloi ban leit sha ka bad kylli la kiei kiei baroh ki bit ki biang bad ka , u tnga jong ka , bad u khun jong ka .  Ka ïathuh ha u Gehasi ba kiei kiei baroh ki bit ki biang ,

translation.en: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee : thou saidst , Fear not .
translation.kha: Me la jubab ïa nga bad ong ïa nga ban ym sheptieng .
Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew ban ïathiah shongkha shynrang para . U Blei u isih eh ïa kata .
translation.en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind , as with womankind : it is abomination .
If there arise among you a prophet , or a dreamer of dreams , and giveth thee a sign or a wonder ,
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa ne u nongbatai ïa ki jingphohsniew u lah ban kular ïa ka kambah ne ka kamphylla ,
Nga sngewsynei ïa kine ki briew , namar ki la don nga bad la lai sngi bad mynta kim don ei ei shuh ban bam .
translation.en: I have compassion on the multitude , because they have now been with me three days , and have nothing to eat :

translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Shekhem ki buh briew ban apthap ïa u Abimelekh ki ha kliar lum , bad ki lute la ïa uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lynti nangta . La ïathuh ïa kane ha u Abimelekh .
translation.en: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains , and they robbed all that came along that way by them : and it was told Abimelech .

And every one that hath forsaken houses , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my name s sake , shall receive an hundredfold , and shall inherit everlasting life .
translation.kha: Bad uno uno uba la iehnoh ïa ki ïing ki sem lane ïa ki hynmen ki para lane ïa u kpa lane ïa ka kmie lane ïa ki khun ki kti lane ïa ki lyngkha na ka bynta jong nga , un ïohpdiang shispah shah tam ïa kata , bad yn ai ha u ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
Ki nongbah ha kjat lum ki long ka Eshtaol Sorah , ka Ashnah ,
translation.en: And in the valley , Eshtaol , and Zorah , and Ashnah ,
Again Esther spake unto Hatach , and gave him commandment unto Mordecai  ;
translation.kha: bad ka Esther ka ai ïa kane ka khubor ban leit rah pat sha u Mordekai :
Ngan pynshitom ïa ki jong nga namar ki la leh pop ; ki la phai dien noh na nga , ki la jingkñia pat ki blei , bad la shna ki bleithaw bad mane ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness , who have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , and worshipped the works of their own hands .

translation.kha: U Pilat u la sngewlyngngoh ban ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la lah ïap . U la khñiang ïa u rangbah shipai bad u la Rephael ïa u la U Jisu u la Ïingtrep ïap la slem .
translation.en: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead : and calling unto him the centurion , he asked him whether he had been any while dead .
Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee , he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid narud ka duriaw Galilaïa , u la ïohi ar ngut ki nongtong dohkha , u Simon bad u para jong u , u Andriw , ba ki dang ïatong dohkha da ka jar .
Hadien kane , Joshua bad ka kynhun ki leit phai pat sha ka jaka shong dara ha Gilgal .
translation.en: And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , unto the camp to Gilgal .

He saith , Yes . And when he was come into the house , Jesus prevented him , saying ,  What thinkest thou , Simon ? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute ? of their own children , or of strangers ?
translation.kha: Ho-oid shisha ,  u Petros u la jubab . Haba u Petros u la rung shapoh ïing , U Jisu u la kren nyngkong ,  Ko Simon , kaei ka jingpyrkhat jong me ? Mano ba siew ïa ki bai khrong lane ki khajna sha ki syiem jong kane ka pyrthei ? Ki traishnong jong ka ri ne ki nongwei ?

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; It shall also come to pass , that at the same time shall things come into thy mind , and thou shalt think an evil thought :
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ïa u Gog :  Haba kata ka por ka la poi , men sa sdang pyrkhat ïa ka buit sniew .

translation.en: And I spake unto you at that time , saying , I am not able to bear you myself alone :
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Mynba ngi dang don ha u Lum Sinai , nga la ïathuh ha phi , ‘ Ka jingkitkhlieh ban ïalam ïa phi ka khia than ïa nga , ngam lah shuh ban kit ïa ka tang marwei .

translation.en: Brethren , be followers together of me , and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an example .
translation.kha: To ïai pyrthuh bud ïa nga , ko ki parabangeit jong nga . To pynleit jingmut ïa kito kiba bud ïa ka nuksa kaba dei kaba ngi la buh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And the servant of the Lord must not strive ; but be gentle unto all men , apt to teach , patient ,
translation.kha: Bad kum u shakri jong U Trai , mem dei ban ïakajia . Bad to long jaijai ha ki briew baroh , bato hikai , jingiashah .

translation.en: The righteous shall see it , and rejoice : and all iniquity shall stop her mouth .
translation.kha: Kiba hok ki ïohi ïa kane bad ki kmen , hynrei ïa baroh kiba bymman la pynsngap jar .

translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses , and fifty men to run before him .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Absalom u la pynbiang ïa lade kawei ka kali ïapom bad ki kulai lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah kiba synran ïa u .
Nangta u Dabid u la phah ktien sha u Joab : Phah sha nga u ïa Uriah u Hit nong . Kumta u Joab u phah ïa u sha u Dabid .
translation.en: And David sent to Joab , saying , Send me Uriah the Hittite . And Joab sent Uriah to David .
And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death : nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul : and the  Lord  repented that he had made Saul king over Israel .
translation.kha: Katba u Samuel u dang im , um shym ïohi shuh ïa u syiem ; hynrei u khuslai sat na ka bynta jong u . U  Trai  u la sngewsih ba u la thung ïa u Saul kum u syiem ki Israel .
Khatsaw sngi hadien ba ka kynthei ka kha khun kynthei , kan long ka bymkhuid kum ha por ba ka poi bnai . shim pat sa hynriewphew hynriew sngi ba yn ñiew ïa ka kaba la khuid biang na ka jingmihsnam .
translation.en: But if she bear a maid child , then she shall be unclean two weeks , as in her separation : and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days .

translation.kha: ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid u briew uba la koit na ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh . Ha kata ka sngi ha kaba pynkhuid ïa u , yn wallam ïa ha khmat u lyngdoh ,
translation.en: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing : He shall be brought unto the priest :

translation.kha: To pan , bad ngan ai ha me ïa jaitbynriew baroh ; ka pyrthei baroh kan long ka jong me .
translation.en: Ask of me , and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance , and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession .

translation.kha: U ïaleh bad u angel bad u la jop . U la par bad pan ïa ka jingkyrkhu . Bad ha Bethel U Blei u la wan sha u kpa Salome jong ngi u Jakob bad u la ïakren bad u .
translation.en: Yea , he had power over the angel , and prevailed : he wept , and made supplication unto him : he found him in Beth–el , and there he spake with us  ;

For even thy brethren , and the house of thy father , even they have dealt treacherously with thee  ; yea , they have called a multitude after thee : believe them not , though they speak fair words unto thee .
translation.kha: Wat ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me , ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong me hi , ki la shetkylla ïa me ; ki la ïasoh ha ki jingtur ïaleh pyrshah ïa me . Wat shaniah ïa ki , wat la ki kren ki ktien sngewieit .
Ki Katba shoh ïa u na ka khlieh da Jobab sang , ki la bynthiew ïa u Jakob ki la dem ngin , bad ki la nguh ïa u .
translation.en: And they smote him on the head with a reed , and did spit upon him , and bowing their knees worshipped him .

translation.kha: Haba baroh ki la ïakdang , u la ong ha la ki synran , To khar ïa ki lyngkhot kiba tam ; ngim dei ban pynsep-ei .
translation.en: When they were filled , he said unto his disciples ,  Gather up the fragments that remain , that nothing be lost .
( For as yet he was fallen upon none of them : only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus . )
translation.kha: Naba U Mynsiem Bakhuid um pat shym la wan hiar hano hano ruh na ki ; la pynbaptis ïa ki tang ha ka kyrteng U Trai Jisu .

translation.en: And when we had launched from thence , we sailed under Cyprus , because the winds were contrary .
translation.kha: Ngi la nang leit nangta , bad namar ba ka lyer ka beh pyrshah ïa ngi , ngi la ïaid sha ka liang ba kah lyer jong ka dewlynnong Sypros .
Hynrei ma phi , ko paralok jong nga , leh ïa kita kiei kiei hi kiba phi bishar ïa kiwei! phi phin na ka jingbishar U Blei ?
translation.en: And thinkest thou this , O man , that judgest them which do such things , and doest the same , that thou shalt escape the judgment of God ?
After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , and advanced him , and set his seat above all the princes that were with him .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por u syiem Serksis u la pynkiew kyrdan ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Haman sha ka kyrdan myntri rangbah . U Haman u dei u khun jong u Hammedatha , uba hiarpateng na u Agag .

Bad u la shukor ïa ki briew baroh kiba im ha ka pyrthei da ki kambah ïa kiba la shah ïa u ban leh ha khmat uta jong u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong . U mradkhlaw u la ong ïa ban ki tei ka durblei ha ka jingpyndonburom ïa u mradkhlaw ïa uba la shah da pynmynsaw ka waitlam bad pynban dang uba im .
translation.en: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast  ; saying to them that dwell on the earth , that they should make an image to the beast , which had the wound by a sword , and did live .
Also the children of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of thy head .
translation.kha: Ho-oid ki rangbah jong ka Memphis bad ka Tahpanhes ki la pynpait ïa ka shynrong khlieh jong u .

translation.en: And if ye call on the Father , who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man s work , pass the time of your sojourning here in fear :
translation.kha: Phi khot ïa u , U Kpa , haba phi duwai ha U Blei , uba bishar ïa ki briew baroh da kajuh ka jingthew , katba kum kaei kaba uwei pa uwei u la leh ; kumta te , to pynlut ïa kaba sah ka jingim jong phi hangne ha ka pyrthei ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U .

translation.en: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture , Behold , I lay in Sion a chief corner stone , elect , precious : and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Nga la jied ïa u maw uba kordor ïa uba nga buh kum u mawdong ha Seïon ; bad uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym noh mynsiem da lei lei .

translation.en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing , nor uncircumcision , but a new creature .
translation.kha: Kam pher ei ei satia la otsher ne ym shym la otsher , kaei kaba donkam ka long ban long u jingthaw uba thymmai .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Who art thou ? And I answered him , I am an Amalekite .
translation.kha: U kylli nga dei uei , bad nga la ïathuh ïa u ba nga dei u Amalek .

ym don mano mano ban thied ka ïa ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawkordor , bad ki jong paila ki ; ki mar , linen ka jaiñ sawbthuh , ka jaiñ rusom , bad ka jaiñ basaw hain hain ; ïa baroh jait ki dieng bakynsai bad baroh ki jait jingthaw ba la shna na ka bniat hati bad na ka dieng baremdor , na rnong ka , ka nar , bad u maw marbl ;
translation.en: The merchandise of gold , and silver , and precious stones , and of pearls , and fine linen , and purple , and silk , and scarlet , and all thyine wood , and all manner vessels of ivory , and all manner vessels of most precious wood , and of brass , and iron , and marble ,

translation.kha: Kum u hynmen jong me ha U ka bynta kane ka ba lah ban sngew katne ban ïa me ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei ban leh .
translation.en: Wherefore , though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient ,

translation.kha: Te kumta , ka Hukum hi ka long kaba khuid , bad ka jinghukum ka long kaba khuid , kaba bad dei kaba bha .
translation.en: Wherefore the law is holy , and the commandment holy , and just , and good .

And ye went over Jordan , and came unto Jericho : and the men of Jericho fought against you , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Girgashites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites  ; and I delivered them into your hand .
translation.kha: Phi la jam ïa ka Jordan bad wan poi sha ka Jerikho . Ki rangbah ka Jerikho ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , kumba la leh ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Girgash , ki Hib bad ki Jebus . Hynrei nga la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor jong ki baroh .

translation.en: He is the Rock , his work is perfect : for all his ways are judgment : a God of truth and without iniquity , just and right is he .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u nongïada bakhlaiñbor jong phi , ki lynti jong u ki long kiba janai , bad bahok ; U Blei jong phi u long uba ïaineh bad uba shisha ; u leh ïa kaba hok bad kaba beit .

translation.en: Then there came out a spirit , and stood before the  Lord  , and said , I will entice him . And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ?
translation.kha: haduh ba u mynsiem u wan sha khmat , u wan ha U  Trai  , bad ong , ‘ Ngan shukor ma nga ïa u .’ ‘ Kumno ?’ U  Trai  u kylli .

translation.en: And I say unto you , Ask , and it shall be given you  ; seek , and ye shall find  ; knock , and it shall be opened unto you .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi : To pan , bad phin ïohpdiang ; to wad , bad phin shem ; to tied , bad ïa ka jingkhang yn plie na ka bynta jong phi .
Ka Sillah ka la kha ïa Tubal Kain uba u uba ïa ki tiar baroh na ka rnong bad ka nar . Ka para jong u Tubal Kain ka dei Naamah .
translation.en: And Zillah , she also bare Tubal–cain , an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron : and the sister of Tubal–cain was Naamah .

And it came to pass , that in process of time , after the end of two years , his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness : so he died of sore diseases . And his people made no burning for him , like the burning of his fathers .
translation.kha: Kumba ar snem ka la nang jur tad haduh ba u syiem u la ïap ha ka jingkordit . Ki raïot jong u kim shym thang ding shabar ha kaba ïambriew ïa u kumba la leh ïa ki kpa tymmen jong u .

translation.en: But thou , when thou fastest , anoint thine head , and wash thy face  ;
translation.kha: Haba phi leit khlem bam ei ei , bta ïa ka khmat jong phi bad sad ïa u shñiuh jong phi ,

translation.en: Sing unto him a new song  ; play skilfully with a loud noise .
translation.kha: To rwai ha u ïa ka jingrwai bathymmai , to tem da ka jingtbit ïa ka duitara , bad to risa jam da ka jingkmen !

Lada ki rangbah kiba ïashoh ki pynmynsaw ka ïa kynthei kaba , punkhun bad kata ka briew ka hap khun , hynrei shym kam mong shym mynsaw da kumwei pat , uta uba pynmynsaw ïa ka un shah kuna shaiñ kat kumba u tnga jong kata ka briew u dawa , bad u dei ban siew kumba la buh dor ki nongbishar .
translation.en: If men strive , and hurt a woman with child , so that her fruit depart from her , and yet no mischief follow : he shall be surely punished , according as the woman s husband will lay upon him  ; and he shall pay as the judges determine .
And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple , for to hear him .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab man ka step baroh ki briew ki la leit sha ka Templ ban sngap ïa u .
Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ïa ki khynnah sha U ba Jisu buh un ïa ki kti jong u halor jong ki bad ba un duwai ka na bynta jong ki , hynrei ki synran ki la mai ïa ki briew .
translation.en: Then were there brought unto him little children , that he should put his hands on them , and pray : and the disciples rebuked them .
His disciples say unto him , Master , the Jews of late sought to stone thee  ; and goest thou thither again ?
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  ki synran ki la jubab ,  dang shen ki briew hangta ki la kwah ban lynthem maw ïa me , bad hato me thmu ban leit phai shata ?

translation.en: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold , because he did this thing , and because he had no pity .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingleh ïa kaba kum kane ka jingleh barunar , u dei ban buria saw shah ïa kaba u la shim .

translation.en: And he from within shall answer and say , Trouble me not : the door is now shut , and my children are with me in bed  ; I cannot rise and give thee .
translation.kha: Bad tharai u paralok jong phi un jubab napoh ïing , ‘ Wat pynwit ïa nga ! Ïa ka jingkhang la lah khang , bad ma nga lem bad ki khun jong nga ngi la thiah . Ngam lah ban khie bad ai ei ei ha phi .’

translation.en: Who hath directed the Spirit of the  Lord  , or being his counsellor hath taught him ?
translation.kha: Don uno uno uba lah ban ïathuh kaei ba U  Trai  u leh ? Mano ba lah ban hikai ïa u lane ban ai jingmut ïa u ?
Haba ki paid Israel ki la dep bynta ïa ka ri , ki la ai ha u Joshua u jong khun Nun u shi bynta jong ka ri kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translation.en: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts , the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them :
What is my strength , that I should hope ? and what is mine end , that I should prolong my life ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka jingkhlaiñ kaba nga don ba ngan ïai im ? Balei ngan dang im haba ngam don ka jingkyrmen ?

translation.en: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land , even forty days , each day for a year , shall ye bear your iniquities , even forty years , and ye shall know my breach of promise .
translation.kha: Phin shah jynjar sawphew snem namar ka pop jong phi , kawei kawei ka snem na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka sngi na kita ki sawphew sngi ba phi la pynlut ha kaba swar ïa ka ri . Te phin sa sngewthuh ka long kumno haba nga ïeng pyrshah ïa phi !
Te namarkata , haba ka nonglamktien phna poi ba ïa ka ri 1943 ai pat sha ki briew Pynshahshkor U Trai , Stakhos ym don pyllut kynduh bynta ïano ïano na phi .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad u rangbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa ki nongap phira ka ki la ïohsngew ïa , ki la sngewphylla ïa kaei kaba lah jia ha ki apostol .
translation.en: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things , they doubted of them whereunto this would grow .
Let her not be as one dead , of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother s womb .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba kan long kum u khunlung ba la kha ïap , uba la shah bam noh shiteng ka met jong u .

translation.en: Thou , O  Lord  , remainest for ever  ; thy throne from generation to generation .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me long u syiem junom , bad men synshar sha kaba kut ka por .
Kumba u kpa uba bha u Job ïa kaba bha tam na ka bynta ki khun , u Haggi bneng jong ngi ruh u kwah ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingïasylla bymjukut .
translation.en: Just as a good father wishes the best for his children , our heavenly Father desires that we enjoy eternal happiness .

translation.kha: bad kata ka bri ka kan ym leit na ka jait sha kawei pat . Kawei kawei ka jait kan ïai bat ïa la ka bri ka khyndew .
translation.en: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe  ; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance .

translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Beeri , ki thain jong ka Geshur bad ka Maakah , u Lum Hermon duriaw-bah , bad ka Bashan baroh mynhyndai Salekah joit

translation.en: And the servants of Amon conspired against him , and slew the king in his own house .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Amon ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa u , bad ki la pynïap ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: The breath of our nostrils , the anointed of the  Lord  , was taken in their pits , of whom we said , Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen .
translation.kha: Ki la kurup ïa ka tynrai jong ka jingim jong ngi , ïa u syiem uba U  Trai  u la jied , uta uba ngi la shaniah ban ïada ïa ngi na uno uno u nonghiarthma .

translation.en: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid . And Jesus lifted up his eyes , and said ,  Father , I thank thee that thou hast heard me .
translation.kha: Ki la pyntyllun noh ïa uta u mawkhang . U Jisu u la khmied shajrong bad u la ong ,  Nga ainguh ïa me , ko Kpa , ba me shahshkor ïa nga .
Ma phi ki briew phi la kyntait ïa nga ; phi la pynphai ïa la ingdong ki sha nga . Kumta la nga kner ïa ka la kti bad pynlwet ïa phi namar nga la thait ban teh lakam ïa ka jingbitar jong nga .
translation.en: Thou hast forsaken me , saith the  Lord  , thou art gone backward : therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee , and destroy thee  ; I am weary with repenting .

translation.kha: U hukum ïa u
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: U Judah u ong , Ko kynrad , ngin ong aïu pat ha phi ? Kumno keiñ ngin ïasaid ? Kumno keiñ lah ngi ban sait ïa khuid lade ? U Blei la u lap ïa kane ka kam bymman jong ngi . Mynta te , baroh ngi long ki mraw jong phi , bad ym tang uta na uba la shem ïa ka . khuri
translation.en: And Judah said , What shall we say unto my lord ? what shall we speak ? or how shall we clear ourselves ? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants : behold , we are my lord s servants , both we , and he also with whom the cup is found .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor jong Seng Trai : U la mrad kruiñ ïa ka ri Hadrakh bad ïa ka nongbah Damaskos . khlem tang ki jait Israel hynrei ka nongbah Syria baphylla ka long ka jong Ita Trai .
translation.en: The burden of the word of the  Lord  in the land of Hadrach , and Damascus shall be the rest thereof : when the eyes of man , as of all the tribes of Israel , shall be toward the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ïa ki kpa jong ngi la pynïap da u nongshun , mynta bad ki kmie jong ngi ki long ki riewkynthei .
translation.en: We are orphans and fatherless , our mothers are as widows .

translation.kha: ( U Jisu u la ong ïa kane namar katto katne briew ki ki ïa-ong , U don u mynsiem bymkhuid ha u . )
translation.en: Because they said , He hath an unclean spirit .

translation.kha: Blei u la ai ha u Solomon ïa ka jingstad ka jingsngewthuh kiba kham pher , bad ïa kaba khraw palat ïa ka ban thew
translation.en: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much , and largeness of heart , even as the sand that is on the sea shore .
His head is as the most fine gold , his locks are bushy , and black as a raven .
translation.kha: Ka jingmad ka ngap ka don ha ki rmiang shyntur jong phi , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; u thylliej jong phi u long ka dud bad ka ngap ïa nga . Ka jaiñ jong phi ka don baroh ki jingiwbih ka Lebanon .

translation.en: Ish–bosheth Saul s son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel , and reigned two years . But the house of Judah followed David .
translation.kha: U la don sawphew snem ka rta mynba la thung ïa u kum u syiem Israel , bad u la synshar ar snem . Hynrei ka jait Judah ka ïaineh skhem ha u Dabid ,
u pyrta ïa ki shipai u Saul bad ïa u Abner , Ko Abner ! Hato phi ïohsngew nga ïa ? Uei uta uba pyrta bad uba pynkyndit thiah ïa u syiem ? u u Abner kylli .
translation.en: And David cried to the people , and to Abner the son of Ner , saying , Answerest thou not , Abner ? Then Abner answered and said , Who art thou that criest to the king ?
If I be wicked , why then labour I in vain ?
translation.kha: Namar ba la rai pynrem ïa nga , balei te ngan salia shuh ?

translation.en: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob , and he loved the damsel , and spake kindly unto the damsel .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u shem ba ka samla ka long kaba i-ieit kat haduh ba u la ïapmat ïa ka , bad u la pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewieit na ka .
Ko shyiap thang nga , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; sngap ïa ki ktien jong nga .
translation.en: My son , attend to my words  ; incline thine ear unto my sayings .

translation.kha: ba-pynmynsaw ka jingjop bakhraw me Karkhemish pura ki nongshun jong me ; ka jingbitar jong me ka meh bad ka bam duh ïa ki kum ïa u phlangïap .
translation.en: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee : thou sentest forth thy wrath , which consumed them as stubble .

And it shall come to pass at that time , that I will search Jerusalem with candles , and punish the men that are settled on their lees : that say in their heart , The  Lord  will not do good , neither will he do evil .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan shim ïa ka sharak bad wad ïa ka Jerusalem . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew kiba sngewhun ha lade bad kiba sngewskhem , kiba ong ha lade , ‘ U  Trai  um ju leh ei ei , kumne lane katai .’

translation.en: For we being many are one bread , and one body : for we are all partakers of that one bread .
translation.kha: Namar don uwei u kpu , baroh na ngi , wat la ngi long shibun , ngi long kawei ka met , naba ngi baroh ngi ïoh bynta lem na ujuh u kpu .

U la ailad ïa phi ban ïohsngew ïa ka jong ktien u na bneng khnang ba u lah ban hikai ïa phi ; hangne ha bad pyrthei u la ailad ba phin ïohi ïa ka ding kaba kyntang jong u , bad u la kren ha phi na ka .
translation.en: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice , that he might instruct thee : and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire  ; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire .

translation.kha: Nga thmu ban tei ka Templ kaba khraw , namar U bleithaw Sirion ngi u kham khraw ban ïa batip uno uwei pat u blei .
translation.en: And the house which I build is great : for great is our God above all gods .
All unrighteousness is sin : and there is a sin not unto death .
translation.kha: Baroh ki jingleh bymdei ki long ka pop , hynrei ka don ka pop ka bym ïalam sha ka jingïap .

Mar ïapoi ha ka khyrdop jong ka shnong , ka kynhun leit ontep ka dang mih shabar . U briew uba la ïap long u u khun nyngkong jong ka kaba briew long ka riewkynthei , bad u paidbah babun na ka shnong u la ïadon lem ka bad .
translation.en: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city , behold , there was a dead man carried out , the only son of his mother , and she was a widow : and much people of the city was with her .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ngan tei ïa phi . Sa shisien pat phin shim ïa ki kanjari bad phin shad da jingkmen ka .
translation.en: Again I will build thee , and thou shalt be built , O virgin of Israel : thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets , and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry .
But they , when they were departed , spread abroad his fame in all that country .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la leit noh bad pynphriang ïa ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ha kylleng jong kata ka bynta jong ka ri .

translation.en: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings , the pransings of their mighty ones .
translation.kha: Nangta ki kulai kin wan ïaid , Ki da kyrdem ïa ka khyndew da ki poh jat jong ki .

translation.en: As the  Lord  thy God liveth , there is no nation or kingdom , whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee : and when they said , He is not there  ; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation , that they found thee not .
translation.kha: Da U  Trai  uba im , U Blei jong phi , nga smai ba u syiem u la phah wad ïa phi ha baroh sawdong ki ri ka pyrthei . Haba uno uno u nongsynshar ka ri u ïathuh ba phim don ha ka ri jong u , u Ahab un dawa na uta u nongsynshar ban smai ba phi long u bym lah ban shem .

Nalor kane ruh , u syiem u ong la ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh kiba long ki kiba bynta dei jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , khnang ba ki lah ban ai ïa ka jong por ki sha baroh ki jingdawa jong ka Hukum jong U Trai .
translation.en: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites , that they might be encouraged in the law of the  Lord .
If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Phi la shem da lade haduh katno U Blei u long uba sbun .
byrngut ka jaka jong ka jait Issakhar ki la Pynbthi saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Kishion , ka Daberath ,
translation.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar , Kishion with her suburbs , Daberath with her suburbs ,
And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps . There was not the like made in any kingdom .
translation.kha: Khat-ar tylli ki dur sing ki don ha ki mawkyrdon , uwei uwei ha ka tduh jong kawei pa kawei ka kyrdon . Ym pat ju don ka khet kaba kum kane ha kawei pat ka hima .

translation.en: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren , which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow .
translation.kha: Dei ha me , ym ha ki hynmen jong me , ba nga ai ïa ka Shekhem , kata ka jaka kaba seisoh ba nga la ïohknieh na ki Amor da ka waitlam bad ka ryntieh jong nga .
Ki briew kiba beit kin lehbha ïa phi ; bymman ki ki kwah tang ban shukor ïa phi .
translation.en: The thoughts of the righteous are right : but the counsels of the wicked are deceit .
No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new : for he saith , The old is better .
translation.kha: Bad ym don uno uno uba kwah ïa ka waiñ bathymmai hadien ba u la dih ïa ka waiñ barim . ‘ Kaba rim ka kham bha ,’ u ong .

U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa Trai U , kumba u kpa jong u , u la ; leh hynrei , ym kum u kpa jong u , um shym leh la pop da kaba thang jingiwbih ha ka Templ . Ki briew pynban , ki dang ïai leh pop .
translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father Uzziah did : howbeit he entered not into the temple of the  Lord . And the people did yet corruptly .

translation.kha: Ha kaba kut u Job sdang u ban kren bad ban sngewsih ïa ka sngi ha kaba la kha ïa u .
translation.en: After this opened Job his mouth , and cursed his day .
For they served idols , whereof the  Lord  had said unto them , Ye shall not do this thing .
translation.kha: bad kim kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  ban ym mane ïa ki bleithaw .
Ka long kaba kham bha ban ïaishah ban ïa kaba long uba donbor . Ka bha ban don ka halor lade ban halor ki nongbah baroh .
translation.en: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty  ; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city .

translation.kha: Um don jingsngewbha ban pynlong ïa ngi ban sngewsih ban lane pang .
translation.en: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men .

And Gideon went in , and made ready a kid , and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour : the flesh he put in a basket , and he put the broth in a pot , and brought it out unto him under the oak , and presented it .
translation.kha: Kumta u Gideon u la leit sha la ïing bad u shet uwei u khunblang bad u la pyndonkam shiphew kilo u  purew ban shet ïa u kpu khlem thiat . U buh ïa ka doh ha ka shang bad ïa ka syrwa hapoh u khiew , u la wallam ïa ki sha u angel jong U  Trai  ha trai u dieng Sning , bad u ai ïa ki ha u .

translation.en: But in the place which the  Lord  shall choose in one of thy tribes , there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings , and there thou shalt do all that I command thee .
translation.kha: hynrei leit rah ïa ki tang ha kawei ka jaka ha kaba U  Trai  un jied na ka ri jong kawei na ki jait jong phi , bad hangta phin leh ïa kita baroh kiba nga la hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east , and went up the stairs thereof , and measured the threshold of the gate , which was one reed broad  ; and the other threshold of the gate , which was one reed broad .
translation.kha: Nangta u la leit sha ka khyrdop kaba phai sha mihngi . U la kiew ïa ki mawkyrdon , bad ha kliar u la thew ïa ka tyngkong ; ka la long lai mitar shapoh ha ka jingjylliew .

translation.en: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God : but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had .
translation.kha: Naba kiwei ki la ai ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong ki na kaei kaba ki don , ban ym ktah ïa ka spah jong ki ; hynrei ma ka , ha ka jingduk jong ka , ka la ai ïa baroh kaba ka donkam ïa lade .

Kumta u la pyrta , ‘ Ko Kpa Abraham ! To sngewsynei ïa nga , bad phah ïa u Lasaros ban wieh ïa shynriah ka ti jong u ha ka um khyndiat bad pyntngen ïa u thylliej jong nga namar , nga ha don ka jingshitom bakhraw ha kane ka ding !’
translation.en: And he cried and said , Father Abraham , have mercy on me , and send Lazarus , that he may dip the tip of his finger in water , and cool my tongue  ; for I am tormented in this flame .

translation.kha: To ïaleh shitom ban pynneh ïa ka jinglong shi tylli ïa kaba U Mynsiem u ai lyngba jingsuk ka kaba tehsong lang ïa phi .
translation.en: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace .

They shall cast their silver in the streets , and their gold shall be removed : their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the  Lord  : they shall not satisfy their souls , neither fill their bowels : because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity .
translation.kha: Kin bret noh ïa la ka ksiar bad ka rupa ha ki lynti bah kum kiba la kyntait , namar ka ksiar lymne ka rupa kan ym lah ban pynim ïa ki haba U  Trai  un theh noh ïa ka jingbitar shla jong u . Kin ym lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki ban pynhun ïa ka jingangnud jong ki ne pyndap ïa ki snier jong ki . Ka ksiar bad ka rupa ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingleh pop .

translation.en: For the terrible one is brought to nought , and the scorner is consumed , and all that watch for iniquity are cut off :
translation.kha: Kan sa long kaba kut ïa kito kiba banbeiñ ïa kiwei bad kiba pyn-i jingñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei . Ïa uwei pa uwei u nongpop yn pynjot .

translation.en: And the frogs shall depart from thee , and from thy houses , and from thy servants , and from thy people  ; they shall remain in the river only .
translation.kha: Ma phi , ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi , bad ki briew jong phi , phin sa lait na kine ki jakoid , bad kin ym don shuh hangno hangno lait sa tang ha ka wah Nile .
Ngi tip ba U Blei um shahshkor ïa ki ; u shahshkor ïa ki briew kiba burom ïa u bad ba leh ïa kaei kaba u kwah ïa leh .
translation.en: Now we know that God heareth not sinners : but if any man be a worshipper of God , and doeth his will , him he heareth .
And the second time the cock crew . And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him ,  Before the cock crow twice , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And when he thought thereon , he wept .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u syiar u kyn-ih ha ka sien kaba ar , bad u Petros u la kynmaw kumno ba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa u ,  Shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih ar sien , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .  Bad u la pait ka dohnud bad u la lynñiar kthang .

translation.en: But she was plucked up in fury , she was cast down to the ground , and the east wind dried up her fruit : her strong rods were broken and withered  ; the fire consumed them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki kti ba bitar ki la rat ïa u naduh tynrai bad bret ïa u sha madan . Ka lyer mihngi ka la pyntyrkhong ïa u soh jong u . Ki tnat jong u ki la kheiñ ; ki la tyrkhong bad la thang noh .
Nga da eh ba briew kiba pynkulmar phi kin leit baroh lynter lynti ; ai ba kin ïaid bad ïa
translation.en: I would they were even cut off which trouble you .

translation.kha: Naba men long u sakhi na ka jong bynta u ban ïathuh ha uwei pa uwei ïa kaei kaba me la ïohi bad ïohsngew .
translation.en: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard .

translation.kha: U u leit noh shaphang shatei na ka Ijipt sha phang bashathie jong ri Kanaan lem bad ka tnga jong u bad baroh kat kiba u don , u Lot u la leit lem bad u
translation.en: And Abram went up out of Egypt , he , and his wife , and all that he had , and Lot with him , into the south .
For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner .
translation.kha: Baroh ki paidbah jong u Dabid bad baroh ki paidbah ha Israel ki sngewthuh ba u syiem um don bynta ha ka jingpynïap ïa u Abner .

translation.en: In a dream , in a vision of the night , when deep sleep falleth upon men , in slumberings upon the bed  ;
translation.kha: Mynmiet haba ki briew ki dang ïohthiah , U Blei u kren ha ki jingphohsniew bad jingïohipaw .
Kaei la leh ka long ban theh ïa kane ka jingsleh iwbih ha ka met jong nga ban pynkhreh ïa nga ka ban tep .
translation.en: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body , she did it for my burial .
I have chosen the way of truth : thy judgments have I laid before me .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ban kohnguh ; nga la pynshahshkor ïa ki jingbishar jong me .

translation.en: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord  ; and a fierce king shall rule over them , saith the Lord , the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ngan aiti ïa ki nong Ijipt sha u nongsynshar lehbor , sha u syiem runar u ban synshar ïa ki . Nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .
Te un sa beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew katba nang ïaid khmat , bad phin sa ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri jong ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw kham donbor ban ïa phi .
translation.en: Then will the  Lord  drive out all these nations from before you , and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves .
And the king commanded , and they brought great stones , costly stones , and hewed stones , to lay the foundation of the house .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum u Solomon ki la shtah ïa ki maw kiba heh itynnat na ka bynta ka nongrim jong ka Templ .
Hynrei ba ngi sangeh ban jingkñia ha ka Syiem jong Bneng bad ngi sangeh ban ïa ki jingainguh ha ka shym don ei ei shuh , bad briew ngi ki ha ka thma bad na ka jingïapthngan
translation.en: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , we have wanted all things , and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine .
Then said God , Call his name Lo–ammi : for ye are not my people , and I will not be your God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Hosia ,  Pynkyrteng ïa u , ‘ u Lo-ammi ,’ namar ki briew ka Israel kim dei ki briew jong nga , bad ngam long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice : and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him .
translation.kha: U kpa jong u briew uba hok u don ka daw babiang ban kmen . Phi lah ban sngewsarong ha u khun uba stad .

translation.en: And afterward he read all the words of the law , the blessings and cursings , according to all that is written in the book of the law .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u pule jam ïa ka Hukum baroh kawei , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingkyrkhu bad ïa ki jingtim , kumba la thoh ha ka kitab ka Hukum .

translation.en: And Jacob said unto Laban , Give me my wife , for my days are fulfilled , that I may go in unto her .
translation.kha: Te u Jakob u ong ha u Laban ,  Ka por ka la kut noh ; to shah ba ngan shongkurim noh ïa ka khun jong phi .
Tang ma nga hi nga tip ïa jingthmu ki kiba nga don na ka bynta jong phi , jingthmu ki ban ha wallam phi ka jingmanbha bad ym ka jingpynjot , ki jingthmu ban wallam ïa ka lawei kaba phi ap kyrmen .
translation.en: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you , saith the  Lord  , thoughts of peace , and not of evil , to give you an expected end .

translation.kha: Ki jinglehrain bad jingjahburom jong phi kut kin noh . Phin sa shong ha la ka jong ka ri , bad ka spah jong phi kan roi ar ; shah ka jingkmen jong phi kan neh bymjukut .
translation.en: For your shame ye shall have double  ; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion : therefore in their land they shall possess the double : everlasting joy shall be unto them .
As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard , so is a parable in the mouth of fools .
translation.kha: U bieit uba pyndonkam ïa ka jingong kaba stad u pynkynmaw ïa phi shaphang u nongbuaid uba pyrshang ban phut ïa u shiah ha ka kti jong u .

Kin don kiei kiei kiba ki phylla ban jia ha ka sngi , ha bnai u , bad ha ki khlur . Ha ka pyrthei , ki ri baroh kin don ha ka jingnoh mynsiem , tieng ki ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw bad ïa ka jingkhih phaloh ki jingat phyllung .
translation.en: And there shall be signs in the sun , and in the moon , and in the stars  ; and upon the earth distress of nations , with perplexity  ; the sea and the waves roaring  ;

When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens , and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth  ; he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum jong u ki um shalor jong ka suiñbneng ki kyrhuh ; u wallam ïa ki lyoh na kiba kut jong ka pyrthei . U pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ha u slap bad u phah ïa ka lyer na ka kamra buh tiar jong u .

translation.en: And when they heard that , they entered into the temple early in the morning , and taught . But the high priest came , and they that were with him , and called the council together , and all the senate of the children of Israel , and sent to the prison to have them brought .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la kohnguh , bad haba dang byrngut ki la rung sha ka Templ bad ki la sdang ban hikai . U Rangbah Lyngdoh bad kiba synran ïa u ki la khot lang ïa ki tymmen ki san jong ki Jiw na ka bynta ka jingïalang ba-pura jong ka Dorbar ; nangta ki la phah hukum sha ka byndi ban wallam ïa ki apostol ha khmat jong ki .
ki Girgash Karnelian , bad kiwei pat ki mawlynnai ban buh ha ka ephod jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad ha ka jingdeng shadem jong u .
translation.en: Onyx stones , and stones to be set in the ephod , and in the breastplate .

translation.kha: Haba ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la kyndit thret . Uei te uba lah ban lait im ? ki la kylli .
translation.en: When his disciples heard it , they were exceedingly amazed , saying , Who then can be saved ?

translation.kha: Me maham ïa ban ki kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong me hynrei , ha ka jingsarong ki kyntait ïa ki jong hukum me , wat la kaba sumar ïa ka Hukum ka long ka lynti sha ka jingim . Kiba mutlop bad kiba ehrang , ki kyntait ban kohnguh .
translation.en: And testifiedst against them , that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law : yet they dealt proudly , and hearkened not unto thy commandments , but sinned against thy judgments , ( which if a man do , he shall live in them  ; ) and withdrew the shoulder , and hardened their neck , and would not hear .
To deliver thee from the way of the evil man , from the man that speaketh froward things  ;
translation.kha: bad khang ïa phi na kaba leh ïa ka bymdei . Kin sumar ïa phi na ki briew kiba pynkhih jingkulmar da kaei kaba ki kren —

translation.en: Therefore the showers have been withholden , and there hath been no latter rain  ; and thou hadst a whore s forehead , thou refusedst to be ashamed .
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba la bat noh ïa u slap , bad u slap pyrem um shym la wan . Pha la da i syriem hi kum ka nuti ; pham don kano kano ka jinglehrain .
Ka jingsam kaba ar ka long jingbatai mradkhlaw bynta ki longïing jingshim ka jait punkhun kan Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar shaduh ka ri ba-marjan la ai ha ka jait Judah .
translation.en: And the second lot came forth to Simeon , even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families : and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah .

translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u long syiem hadien u Asa kpa jong u , bad u la pynkhlaiñ lade pyrshah ïa ka Israel .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead , and strengthened himself against Israel .

translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim tynrah Blei kan hap ha uta u briew pynshongduh pynkynriah ïa u mawpud jong u paramarjan .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour s landmark . And all the people shall say , Amen .
And Joseph said unto them , Fear not : for am I in the place of God ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joseph u ong ha ki ,  Wat sheptieng ; ngam lah ban buh ïa lade ha ka jaka jong U Blei .

translation.en: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot , and stood at the door of the house of Elisha .
translation.kha: Kumta u Naaman u la leit lem bad la ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad u la sangeh ha ka jaka rung sha ka ïing jong u Elisha .

translation.en: A man shall not take his father s wife , nor discover his father s skirt .
translation.kha: Uno uno u briew um dei ban pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa da kaba u ïathiah shongkha bad kawei na ki tnga u kpa jong u .
ïa ki jaiñ babha jong ki , ki jaiñ jynsur , ki jaiñkup ki bad pla kynsit ;
translation.en: The changeable suits of apparel , and the mantles , and the wimples , and the crisping pins ,
Two men shall be in the field  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
translation.kha: Ar ngut ki rangbah kin ïatrei ha ka lyngkha : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shadien .

translation.en: But if , while we seek to be justified by Christ , we ourselves also are found sinners , is therefore Christ the minister of sin ? God forbid .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada , kumba ngi pyrshang ban pynksan ha U Blei da ka jingpynïasoh jong ngi bad U Khrist , yn shem ïa ngi ba ngi long ki nongpop kumba long hi ki Jentil — hato kane ka mut ba U Khrist u pynlong ka daw ïa ka pop ? Da lei lei ruh em !

translation.en: And Simon he surnamed Peter  ;
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki khat-ar ngut kiba u la jied : U Simon ( U Jisu u la ai kyrteng ïa u , u Petros ) ;

translation.en: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la sngewsih haba nga ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ki kynthei jong ka nongbah .

Khnang ban pynlang ïa ka um , phi la shna ka jaka pynlang um hapoh jong ka nongbah ban bat ïa Jahlil um kaba tuid na ka pung kaba rim . Hynrei phim shym la ïawer ïa ba-don Blei , uba la thmu ïa jingïathuh sngewkhia la slem bah bad uba la pynurlong ïa ka .
translation.en: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool : but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof , neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngam la shahshkor ïa u Balaam , kumta la kyrkhu , bad da kumta nga la pyllait phi na u Balak .
translation.en: But I would not hearken unto Balaam  ; therefore he blessed you still : so I delivered you out of his hand .
And Joab blew the trumpet , and the people returned from pursuing after Israel : for Joab held back the people .
translation.kha: U Joab u la hukum ban put ïa ka turoi ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingïaleh , bad ki shipai jong u , ki wan phai na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: So also is the resurrection of the dead . It is sown in corruption ; it is raised in incorruption :
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno kan jia haba ïa kiba ïap la pynmihpat . Haba ïa ka met la tep , ka long kaba ïap ; haba la pynmihpat , ka long ka bymïap shuh .
U Dabid u pynbynta ïa ki Lebi ha ki lai kynhun kat kum jong ki : Gershon , Kohath , bad Merari .
translation.en: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi , namely , Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .
And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , which spake with his mouth unto David my father , and hath with his hand fulfilled it , saying ,
translation.kha: U ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel ! uba la bat ïa la ka kular ba u la pynlong bad u Dabid u kpa jong nga , mynba u ong ,
Don kiba la kylli ïa u , Ko Kynrad , hato tang khyndiat ngut ki briew ki lait ban im ?
translation.en: Then said one unto him , Lord , are there few that be saved ? And he said unto them ,
And spake unto him , saying , Tell us , by what authority doest thou these things ? or who is he that gave thee this authority ?
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi , me donhok aïu ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses in mount Sinai , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai bad u hukum ïa u , ban ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ha u paid Israel .
Nangta men khmih man ka sien jam ba nga shim , hynrei Tip ym buddien ïa ki pop jong nga .
translation.en: For now thou numberest my steps : dost thou not watch over my sin ?

translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , haduh katno long kiba ieit ïa nga bad nga la sngewtmang ïa phi ! Haduh katno phi pynkmen ïa nga , bad haduh katno nga sngewsarong namar jong phi Kane te , ko parabangeit , ka long kumno phi dei ban ïeng skhem ka jingim phi ha U
translation.en: Therefore , my brethren dearly beloved and longed for , my joy and crown , so stand fast in the Lord , my dearly beloved .

translation.kha: Ka kmie kaba shisha , pynitynnat ka dohnud kaba Synagog da ka jingieit jingsylla la u pynhiar , ka Mibsan ha u syiem , Sngewbha jingialeh ko Syiem Kynrad , wat Terah afi u khunlung ! dkoh ïa u ha ka umkhriat Hynrei kata kawei maham ka kynthei ka ong , Wat ai ïa u hano hano na ngi ; to leh bad phiah arliang ïa u .
translation.en: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king , for her bowels yearned upon her son , and she said , O my lord , give her the living child , and in no wise slay it . But the other said , Let it be neither mine nor thine , but divide it .
And Ain with her suburbs , and Juttah with her suburbs , and Beth–shemesh with her suburbs  ; nine cities out of those two tribes .
translation.kha: ka Ain , ka Juttah , bad ka Beth Shemesh , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki : khyndai tylli ki shnong na ki jait Judah bad Simeon .

translation.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains , and embrace the rock for want of a shelter .
translation.kha: Ki jhieh ha u slap uba hap halor ki lumbah , bad ki ïa-thngian harud ki mawsiang ban rieh .

translation.en: And the children of Joseph said , The hill is not enough for us : and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron , both they who are of Beth–shean and her towns , and they who are of the valley of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Ka ri lum kam biang ïa ngi ; hynrei ki Kanaan ha ki ri thor ki don ki kali ïapom da ka nar , na ka bynta kito kiba shong ha Beth Shan bad ïa ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ka bad na ka bynta kito kiba shong ha ka Them Jesreel .
Baroh palat parabangeit hangne ki phah ka barli . To ïakhublei iwei ïa iwei jingpyntngen ka jingïadoh parabangeit .
translation.en: All the brethren greet you . Greet ye one another with an holy kiss .

translation.kha: namar nga khot ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka phang bashatei ban ïawan . Ki syiem jong ki kin pynïeng ïa ki khet jong ki ha ki khyrdop ka jong Jerusalem bad sawdong ïa ki kynroh jong ka bad ruh ïa sawdong kiwei pat nongbah ki jong ka Judah .
translation.en: For , lo , I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall come , and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem , and against all the walls thereof round about , and against all the cities of Judah .

And they said one to another , We are verily guilty concerning our brother , in that we saw the anguish of his soul , when he besought us , and we would not hear  ; therefore is this distress come upon us .
translation.kha: Ki te ki ïakohnguh ban leh kumta , bad ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ho-oid , mynta ngi shah jynjar namar kaei kaba ngi la leh ïa la u jong u para . Ngi la ïohi haduh katno u khuslai mynba u kyrpad ba ngin ïarap ïa u , bad ngim shym la shahshkor . Dei namar kata ba ngi shah jynjar kumne mynta .

Dei me uta uba nga la slem bah , haba pynbna lyngba ki shakri jong nga , ki nongïathuhlypa ka Israel , ba ha ki sngi ki ban wan ngan sa wallam ïa uno uno ban tur ïaleh ïa ki . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel , which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them ?

translation.kha: Na bneng , ha me kaba shong , sngap ïa u bad leh ïa kaba kaei u kyrpad ïa me ban leh , khnang ba baroh ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei kin tip ïa bad me kohnguh ïa me kumba ki paid Israel ki leh . Te kin tip ba kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei kan ka long ha jaka kaba yn mane ïa me .
translation.en: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for : that all people of the earth may know thy name , to fear thee , as do thy people Israel  ; and that they may know that this house , which I have builded , is called by thy name .
His work is honourable and glorious : and his righteousness endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba u leh ki dap da ka jingpyndonburom bad kaba iphieng ; ka hok jong u ka neh junom .

translation.en: Then Abraham gave up the ghost , and died in a good old age , an old man , and full of years  ; and was gathered to his people .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la ïap ha ka rta ba la ih bha haba u la dap shispah hynñiewphew san snem ka rta .
Yn pynum ïa ki ha Jerusalem kumba pynum ïa rupa ha lawar , nangta tip ba ki mad ïa ka jingbitar jong U Trai .
translation.en: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace , so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof  ; and ye shall know that I the  Lord  have poured out my fury upon you .

translation.kha: Yn sa ma u .
translation.en: He will go .
Blessed be the name of the  Lord  from this time forth and for evermore .
translation.kha: To ai ba yn ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u mynta bad sha bymjukut !

Nangta kan shim por pynriewspah sa laiphew jabieng sngi ba Rehabaïah ñiew ïa ka shapoh la khuid biang na ka jingmihsnam . ïakiew dei ksaiñ ktah ïa iakane kaei kaba khuid lane rung sha ka Ïingjaiñ tad jingshongshngain la kut ka por pynkhuid ïa ka .
translation.en: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days  ; she shall touch no hallowed thing , nor come into the sanctuary , until the days of her purifying be fulfilled .
Hear attentively the noise of his voice , and the sound that goeth out of his mouth .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ma phi baroh , ïa ka sur ka jong U Blei , ïa u pyrthat uba mih na ka shyntur jong u .

translation.en: I will bear the indignation of the  Lord  , because I have sinned against him , until he plead my cause , and execute judgment for me : he will bring me forth to the light , and I shall behold his righteousness .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , te mynta ngi dei ban ïaishah ïa ka jingbitar jong u shipor . Hynrei ha kaba kut un ïada ïa ngi bad un pynbeit ïa ka bymdei kaba la leh ha ngi . Un wallam ïa ngi shabar sha ka jingshai ; ngin im ban ïohi ba u pyllait im ïa ngi .
U u la leh ïa kane kum ka jingthmu bymjukut kaba u la pyndep lyngba U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .
translation.en: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord :
And turn ye not aside : for then should ye go after vain things , which cannot profit nor deliver  ; for they are vain .
translation.kha: Wat ïabeh ïa ki blei thala ; kim lah ïarap ïa phi ne pynim ïa phi namar kim dei kiba shisha .

translation.en: And Abijam slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him in the city of David : and Asa his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Abijah u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Asa u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city , and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city , they shall take him into the city unto them , and give him a place , that he may dwell among them .
translation.kha: U lah ban phet ïap sha kawei na kine ki nongbah , un leit sha ka jaka bishar ha ka khyrdop sha ka nongbah , bad batai ha ki nongïalam ïa kaba la jia . Nangta kin shah ba un rung shapoh ka nongbah bad kin ai jaka sah ïa u , ba kumta u lah ban shong ban sah hangta .

translation.en: If I go forth into the field , then behold the slain with the sword ! and if I enter into the city , then behold them that are sick with famine ! yea , both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not .
translation.kha: Haba nga leit sha ki lyngkha , nga ïohi ïa ki met jong ki rangbah kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma ; haba nga leit sha ki shnong , nga ïohi ïa ki briew kiba ïapthngan . Ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki trei la ki kam , hynrei kim tip ïa kaei ki leh .

translation.en: And Micah said unto him , Whence comest thou ? And he said unto him , I am a Levite of Beth–lehem–judah , and I go to sojourn where I may find a place .
translation.kha: U Mikah u kylli ïa u ,  Nangno phi wan ?  U jubab ,  Nga dei u Lebi na Bethlehem kaba ha Judah . Nga dang khmih hangno ba ngan shong ngan sah .

translation.en: And the woman bare a son , and called his name Samson : and the child grew , and the  Lord  blessed him .
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka kha ïa u khun shynrang bad ka ai kyrteng ïa u , u Samson . Uta u khunlung u la nang san bad U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u .
jingkhih la plie namar jong ngi jingbitar ka lynti kaba thymmai Imna ka lynti kaba idonburom , lyngba kata dait Janoah — kata ka lko , lyngba ka met jong Syria hi .
translation.en: By a new and living way , which he hath consecrated for us , through the veil , that is to say , his flesh  ;

translation.kha: bad u buh halor jong ka ïa u kpu la pynkyntang sha U Trai , kumba U Trai u la ïa u .
translation.en: And he set the bread in order upon it before the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  had commanded Moses .
Then I consulted with myself , and I rebuked the nobles , and the rulers , and said unto them , Ye exact usury , every one of his brother . And I set a great assembly against them .
translation.kha: Nga la pynrem ïa ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki paidbah bad ong ïa ki ,  Phi la banbeiñ ïa la ki para ki hynmen jong phi !  Nga la khot ïa ka jingïalang paidbah ban pynbeit ïa ka jingeh bad nga ong ,

translation.en: The woman answered and said , I have no husband . Jesus said unto her ,  Thou hast well said , I have no husband :
translation.kha: Ngam don tnga ,  ka la jubab . U Jisu u la phai ktien ,  Ka long kaba dei haba pha ong ba pham don tnga .

translation.en: Be ye angry , and sin not : let not the sun go down upon your wrath :
translation.kha: Lada phi bitar , wat ai ba ka jingbitar jong phi kan ïalam ïa phi ban leh pop , wat bitar sah baroh shi sngi .
Un khmih bha pat ïa jingshahjop ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad lada kata pynshahthngan jingbthuh ka la pur ïa-ïohbor kata ka long ka bymkhuid .
translation.en: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day : if the plague be spread in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in a skin , or in any work that is made of skin  ; the plague is a fretting leprosy  ; it is unclean .

translation.kha: Te phi ki khun ki kti jong phi phin sa ïoh shong slem ka katba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi Phin ïaishong hangta katba suiñbneng ka dang neh halor ka .
translation.en: That your days may be multiplied , and the days of your children , in the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give them , as the days of heaven upon the earth .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki synran jong u ban ym ïathuh hano hano ba u U Messaïah .
translation.en: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ .

translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ka ri shyiap ban long ka ïing jong ki , bad shah nga ba kin shong ha ki pyntha mluh .
translation.en: Whose house I have made the wilderness , and the barren land his dwellings .

Then said they unto him , Say now Shibboleth : and he said Sibboleth : for he could not frame to pronounce it right . Then they took him , and slew him at the passages of Jordan : and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand .
translation.kha: Ki bthah ïa u ban ong ,  Shibboleth .  Hynrei un ong  Sibboleth ,  namar um nang kynnoh beit ïa ka . Kumta ki kem bad ki pynïap ïa u ha kawei na kita ki jaka na kiba dei ban jam ïa ka Jordan . Sawphew ar hajar ngut ki Ephraim ki shah pynïap ha kata ka por .

Ïa ki bleithaw jong ki la (Khlem da ka rupa na Spain bad da ka ksiar na Uphas baroh ki jingtrei jong ki nongtrei ; la pynphong ;’ ïa ki ha Lebonah jaiñ ïongjngum bad sawbthuh ba la thain da ki nongthain jaiñ batbit .
translation.en: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish , and gold from Uphaz , the work of the workman , and of the hands of the founder : blue and purple is their clothing : they are all the work of cunning men .
And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of , and saved himself there , not once nor twice .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem ka Israel u la maham ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta , bad ki la long phikir ïa lade . Kane ka jia bun bunsien .
Ka wan ïalam shibun ki nongbud lem ki ut kiba kit ki jingiwbih , ki mawlynnai , bad shibun ka ksiar Ynda ïakynduh Solomon , ka kylli ïa u ïa ki jingkylli baroh kat kiba ka lah pyrkhat .
translation.en: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train , with camels that bare spices , and very much gold , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .

translation.kha: Trai u kiba isih ïa kaba sniew ; u ïa ka jingim jong briew jong u ; pyllait im ïa ki ka ki bymman .
translation.en: Ye that love the  Lord  , hate evil : he preserveth the souls of his saints  ; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked .
Remove not the ancient landmark , which thy fathers have set .
translation.kha: Wat ju pynkynriah ïa u mawpud ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la thung naduh mynbarim .
Kumta mynta , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Trai u ong . Me bthah ïa nga ban sangeh ïathuhlypa kaba , ban sangeh kaba kren pyrshah lamwir ïa ki briew ka Israel .
translation.en: Now therefore hear thou the word of the  Lord  : Thou sayest , Prophesy not against Israel , and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac .

And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me , Write , Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth : Yea , saith the Spirit , that they may rest from their labours  ; and their works do follow them .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na bneng kaba ong ,  To thoh ïa kane : Suk kito kiba naduh mynta ki ïap ha kaba shakri ïa U Trai !   Ho-oid shisha !  U Mynsiem u jubab .  Kin ïoh shongthait na ki jingtrei shitom jong ki , namar ki soh ka jingshakri jong ki , ki leit lem bad ki .

translation.en: For Isaiah had said , Let them take a lump of figs , and lay it for a plaster upon the boil , and he shall recover .
translation.kha: U Isaïah u ïathuh ha u syiem ban buh ka jingtah ba la shna da ki soh Dumbur ha u tohjaw jong u , bad un sa jem .
Bad ha ka sngi kaba arphew jong bnai ar , ka khyndew ka la rkhiang shadong .
translation.en: And in the second month , on the seven and twentieth day of the month , was the earth dried .
Say not thou , What is the cause that the former days were better than these ? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this .
translation.kha: Wat ju ong ,  O ! balei mo kiei kiei ki kham bha shibun ha ki sngi mynbarim ?  Kam long ka jingkylli kaba shemphang .
Ki synran ki la kylli ïa u , Nangno syiem ïoh bam kaba biang ha kane ka bakynsha shyiap ban bsa ïa une tat paidbah ?
translation.en: And his disciples say unto him , Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness , as to fill so great a multitude ?
Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter , but within they are full of extortion and excess .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi pynkhuid ïa kaba shabar jong ka khuri bad ka pliang jong phi , katba kaba shapoh ka dap da kaei kaba phi ïoh da ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingpyrkhat tang ïa lade .
Ko ki briew jingmynthi Jerusalem , Adonibesek por ban tei pat ïa ki sngewkynduh ka nongbah ka la poi . Ha tieng ka por ïa ka ri jong phi yn pynïar Ashkelon
translation.en: In the day that thy walls are to be built , in that day shall the decree be far removed .

translation.kha: Lada phi lah babiang pyllut shibun ka por lane tang khyndiat por man ka taiew , ki Ahikam ki lah ban pyllait ïalade ban ïarap ïa phi .
translation.en: If you are able to spend more time or are limited to less time each week , the Witnesses will make themselves available to help you .

translation.kha: Kumta uta shakri u buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki lbong u Abraham , kynrad jong u bad u pynlong ka jingsmai ban leh ïa u Abraham u la hukum u
translation.en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master , and sware to him concerning that matter .

translation.kha: Lada phi shem ha kawei na ki shnong Sapphir phi ïa u shynrang lane khyrdong Jadon Arbad Noah leh thir pyrshah ïa U Trai bad pynkheiñ bymnang ka jingsngewdiaw jong u jingïadoh
translation.en: If there be found among you , within any of thy gates which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , man or woman , that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  thy God , in transgressing his covenant ,
But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the  Lord  , thus shall ye say to him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , As touching the words which thou hast heard  ;
translation.kha: Na ka bynta u syiem hi , kane ka dei kaei kaba nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga ong : pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha ka Kitab ,
Nangta Jingpynphai Joseph u ong ïa la ki briew pynsngewbha smai . Kular ïa nga , u ong , ba ynda U Blei u ïalam noh ïa phi sha kata ka ri , haei rah .” ïa ka met jong khynwin nangne .
translation.en: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel , saying , God will surely visit you , and ye shall carry up my bones from hence .
As for thee also , by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Namar ka jutang jong nga bad phi kaba la shonshab da ka snam jong ki jingkñia , ngan pyllaitluid ïa ki briew jong phi — kaba laitluid na ki thliew bym don um jong ka jingshah ringmraw .

translation.en: I know his wrath , saith the  Lord   ; but it shall not be so  ; his lies shall not so effect it .

translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli ïa u ,  Na-ei me wan ?  U Soitan u jubab ,  Nga la leit ïaid shane bad shatai , da kaba shang kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Yet now hear , O Jacob my servant  ; and Israel , whom I have chosen :

translation.en: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants .

Therefore he cometh not unto the king s table .

translation.en: And the righteous men , they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses , and after the manner of women that shed blood  ; because they are adulteresses , and blood is in their hands .

translation.kha: Haba ka Delilah ka sngewthuh ba u la ïathuh ha ka ïa ka jingshisha , ka phah ktien sha ki syiem Philistia bad ka ong ,  Wan biang sa shisien . U la ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingshisha .  Kumta ki la ïawan bad ki wanrah artat ïa ki sbai rupa .

translation.en: Who said unto his father and to his mother , I have not seen him  ; neither did he acknowledge his brethren , nor knew his own children : for they have observed thy word , and kept thy covenant .
It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you , and ye shall afflict your souls , by a statute for ever .
translation.kha: Kata ka sngi ka dei ban long ka sngi kaba khuid bha , ka sngi ha kaba ki shahjingit bad kim trei ïa kano kano ka kam . Kine ki dei ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ban rakhe pateng la pateng .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Wherefore saith my lord these words ? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing :
translation.kha: Ki ruh ki jubab ïa u ,  Phi mut kumno , bah , da kaba kren ïa ngi kumne ? Ngi smai ba ngim shym leh ïa kaba kum kane .
ha kane ka kynti ngan pynshitom ym tang ïa ki rangbah synshar bad ki briew jong me , hynrei ïa me hi ruh , khnang ba men ïoh ym don uba kum ma nga ha ka pyrthei baroh .
translation.en: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart , and upon thy servants , and upon thy people  ; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth .
Where is the king of Hamath , and the king of Arpad , and the king of the city of Sepharvaim , of Hena , and Ivah ?

translation.en: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God .

translation.en: But if ye will not hear it , my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride  ; and mine eye shall weep sore , and run down with tears , because the  Lord s  flock is carried away captive .

translation.en: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified , and not by faith only .

translation.en: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe , of which no man gave attendance at the altar .

translation.en: But watch thou in all things , endure afflictions , do the work of an evangelist , make full proof of thy ministry .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto you out of the midst of the fire : ye heard the voice of the words , but saw no similitude  ; only ye heard a voice .

translation.en: And there are diversities of operations , but it is the same God which worketh all in all .

translation.en: And I sent messengers unto them , saying , I am doing a great work , so that I cannot come down : why should the work cease , whilst I leave it , and come down to you ?

ma ngi kiba ïa jingkynshew kaba kynja mynsiem ngi long kum ki khiew khyndew , ban pyn-i ka bor kaba tam long ka jong U Blei , ym ka jong ngi .
translation.en: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels , that the excellency of the power may be of God , and not of us .

translation.en: Come now therefore , and I will send thee unto Pharaoh , that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Mynta nga phah ïa me sha u Pharaoh khnang ba men ïalam noh ïa ki Israel , ki briew jong nga , na Ijipt .

translation.en: Concerning Damascus . Hamath is confounded , and Arpad : for they have heard evil tidings : they are fainthearted  ; there is sorrow on the sea  ; it cannot be quiet .

Hynrei ïa ki bneng bad ka pyrthei kiba long mynta la pynsah da kajuh ka hukum jong U Blei , khnang ban ïoh pynjot da ka ding . Ïa ki la pynsah na ka bynta ka sngi haba ki ïa briew ki bymtip Blei yn bishar bad pynjot noh .
translation.en: But the heavens and the earth , which are now , by the same word are kept in store , reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men .

translation.en: But hast done evil above all that were before thee : for thou hast gone and made thee other gods , and molten images , to provoke me to anger , and hast cast me behind thy back :

translation.en: The secret things belong unto the  Lord  our God : but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever , that we may do all the words of this law .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall open unto thee his good treasure , the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season , and to bless all the work of thine hand : and thou shalt lend unto many nations , and thou shalt not borrow .

translation.en: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him , and he heareth the cry of the afflicted .

translation.kha: Kine harum ki long ki jong me na ki jingainguh kiba kyntang tam ïa ki bym shym la thang ha ka duwan : ki jingainguh bam , ki jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ki jingainguh namar ka jingpalat . translation.en: God forbid : yea , let God be true , but every man a liar ; as it is written , That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings , and mightest overcome when thou art judged .
