translation.en: And Edom shall be a possession , Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies  ; and Israel shall do valiantly .
How much less shall I answer him , and choose out my words to reason with him ?
translation.kha: Kumta da kumno ngan shem ki kyntien ban jubab ïa U Blei ?

translation.en: And Joshua said unto them , Fear not , nor be dismayed , be strong and of good courage : for thus shall the  Lord  do to all your enemies against whom ye fight .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u ong ha ki rangbah shipai ,  Wat sheptieng lane khaw-eit . Long uba kut jingmut triang uba skhem namar kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  un leh ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh .
Athens Trai longing ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki Em’ ryntih na ka bynta ki Israel .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
Who changed the truth of God into a lie , and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator , who is blessed for ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Ki bujli ïa ka jingshisha U Blei da ka jinglamler ; ki mane bad shakri ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la thaw , ha ka jaka ban mane bad shakri ïa U Nongthaw hi , ïa uba dei ban ïaroh junom ! Amen .
U Hesekaïah u phai ïa la ka khmat sha duriaw-bah ïaseng bad u duwai ‘Phim
translation.en: Then he turned his face to the wall , and prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,
Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit , and her company is round about her grave : all of them slain , fallen by the sword , which caused terror in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Ki long baroh kiba la ïap ha ka thma , bad ki jingtep jong ki , ki don ha ki bynta ba sha trai eh jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Ki shipai jong ka baroh ki la kyllon ïap ha ka thma bad ki jingtep jong ki , ki ker sawdong ïa u lum jingtep jong ka . Pynban shisien ki la pyntriem ïa ka ri kiba im .
Haba ka kynhun shipai Judah ka la poi ha ka jaka ba don u mot ha ka ri shyiap , ki peit ki sha bad nongshun ïohi ba ki la thiah ïap ha madan . Ym don uba uwei lait phet .
translation.en: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness , they looked unto the multitude , and , behold , they were dead bodies fallen to the earth , and none escaped .
And the young man that told him said , As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa , behold , Saul leaned upon his spear  ; and , lo , the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba nga don ha u Lum Gilboa , bad nga la ïohi ïa u Saul ba u dang shaniah ha la u sum katba ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai jong ki nongshun ki la hajan jong u .

translation.en: And she yet again conceived , and bare a son  ; and called his name Shelah : and he was at Chezib , when she bare him .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ka la kha khun shynrang bad la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Shelah . U Judah u don ha Akhsib mynba la kha ïa u khunlung .
runar U Jisu u la pynkut , Ïa ka sngur la thaw na ka bynta ka jingbha u briew ; ïa u briew ym shym jingkhlaiñ thaw na ka jingsat ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  The sabbath was made for man , and not man for the sabbath :

translation.kha: To ngin ïa-ïaid shaphrang ! Bad kane ka long kaei kaba ngin leh , lada Blei u shah .
translation.en: And this will we do , if God permit .
See , I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah :
translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri bad u ksiew jong u Hur , na ka jait Judah ,

translation.en: But last of all he sent unto them his son , saying , They will reverence my son .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh u la phah ïa la u khun sha ki . ‘ Da shisha kin burom ïa u khun jong nga ,’ u la ong .
Me pyrkhat ba tiew Blei Emmaus ym pynshitom , ba um da pynleit jingmut shaphang ka pop .
translation.en: But now , because it is not so , he hath visited in his anger  ; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity :
He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow : and the father of a fool hath no joy .
translation.kha: Ym don ei ei ïa u kpa hynrei ka jingsngewsih bad jingkthang haba u khun jong u leh ïa ki kam bieit .

translation.en: And by great waters the seed of Sihor , the harvest of the river , is her revenue  ; and she is a mart of nations .
translation.kha: To ïam pangnud , phi ki nongkhaïi ka Sidon ! Phi phah ïa ki rangbah sha shiliang ka duriaw ban thied bad ban die ïa u kew uba mih ha Ijipt bad ban ïakhaïi bad baroh ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: Then said Jeremiah unto them , Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah :
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la kren ha nga , bad nga la ïathuh ha ki rangbah kiba la phah sha nga ban ïathuh ha u Sedekaïah ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel u la ong ,
Ki khyrdop jong ka nonglute kin plie baroh shi sngi ; yn ym khang ïa ki da lei lei , namar yn ym don ka shu hangta .
translation.en: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day : for there shall be no night there .

So that servant came , and shewed his lord these things . Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant , Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city , and bring in hither the poor , and the maimed , and the halt , and the blind .
translation.kha: U shakri u la leit phai bad u la ïathuh ïa kane baroh ha u kynrad jong u . U kynrad u la bitar shla bad u la ong ha u shakri , ‘ To leit kloi sha ki lynti bah bad ki lynti rit jong ka nongbah , bad wallam ïa kiba duk , kiba khrew , kiba matlah , bad kiba dkoh .’

translation.en: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop : but a good word maketh it glad .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhuslai kan lute ïa ka jingkmen na phi , hynrei ki ktien sbun kin pynkmen ïa phi .

translation.en: Blessed art thou , O  Lord  : teach me thy statutes .
translation.kha: Nga ïaroh ïa me , A  Trai  ; to hikai ïa nga ïa ki lynti jong me .

translation.en: So the  Lord  alone did lead him , and there was no strange god with him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  da lade hi u ïalam ïa la ki briew , ym don u blei nongwei uba ïarap ïa u .

translation.en: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul : and when Saul saw any strong man , or any valiant man , he took him unto him .
translation.kha: Katba u dang im , u Saul u hap ban ïaleh tyngeh pyrshah ïa ki Philistia . Kumta , man ka por ba u lap ïa u briew uba khlaiñ lane uba shlur , u ju pynrung ïa u ha ka kynhun ïapom jong u .

translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  shall raise him up a king over Israel , who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day : but what ? even now .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un buh ïa u syiem halor ki Israel u ban pynduh syndon ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Jeroboam .
Hoham Trai u la lah kular ba ma u jingkynduh un long ka kynroh ding sawdong jingtyrwa ka nongbah ban ïada jingkhriat ka bad ba un shong un sah hangta ha ka burom jong Aristobulos riewmadan Haei
translation.en: For I , saith the  Lord  , will be unto her a wall of fire round about , and will be the glory in the midst of her .

translation.kha: Kane long kaba la leh da U Trai ; A haduh katno ka kaei kaei kaba iphylla !’
translation.en: This was the Lord s doing , and it is marvellous in our eyes ?

translation.kha: Phi la ïohi aïu ma nga , U Trai nga la leh ïa ki nong Ijipt bad kumno ba nga la kit ïa phi kum ka kaba kit ïa la ki khun ha ki thapniang jong ka , bad la wan ïalam ïa phi sha ha ka jaka .
translation.en: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians , and how I bare you on eagles  wings , and brought you unto myself .

Then the angel of the  Lord  went forth , and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand : and when they arose early in the morning , behold , they were all dead corpses .
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u leit sha ka jaka shong dara ki Assyria bad u pynïap shi lakh phraphew san hajar ngut ki shipai . Dang step phyrngab ka sngi kaba bud hangta ki thiah , baroh ki la ïap !

translation.en: It may be the  Lord  thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God , and will reprove the words which the  Lord  thy God hath heard : wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left .
translation.kha: U patsha ka Assyria u la phah ïa u rangbah synshar jong u , uba ha khlieh ban ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei ba-im . Ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingkrenbeiñ bad pynshitom ïa kito kiba kren ïa ki . Kumta to duwai ha U Blei na ka bynta kito ki briew jong ngi kiba lait im .

translation.en: Lord  , when thy hand is lifted up , they will not see : but they shall see , and be ashamed for their envy at the people  ; yea , the fire of thine enemies shall devour them .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong me kim tip satia ba men pynshitom ïa ki . A  Trai  , buh ïa ki ha ka jingjahburom bad ai ba kin jynjar ; ai ba kin jynjar da ka jingpynshitom kaba me la pynkhreh . To pyn-i ïa ki haduh katno me ieit ïa la ki briew .

Hato u khiew khyndew un nud ban ïatainia bad u nongthaw jong u , u uba khiew long kum baroh kiwei pat ? Hato ka dewbyrtha kan ong ïa u nongthaw khiew kaei ba leh u ? Hato khiew u un mudui ïa la u nongthaw khiew ba um don jingtbit ?
translation.en: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker ! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth . Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it , What makest thou ? or thy work , He hath no hands ?

translation.kha: Katba ngi dang pynlur ïa ki lyngkha da ki masi lur , u la ong , bad ki kada ki ïabam dang phlang marjan .
translation.en: And there came a messenger unto Job , and said , The oxen were plowing , and the asses feeding beside them :
And Ahab made a grove  ; and Ahab did more to provoke the  Lord  God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him .
translation.kha: U pynïeng ruh ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah . U leh shibun ban pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , kham palat ban ïa ki syiem Israel baroh ha shuwa jong u .
Hadien kane ki leit ban ïaleh ïa Kanaan kiba shong ha ri lum , ha ki trai ki lum , ha ka ri ryngkhiang shaphang .
translation.en: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites , that dwelt in the mountain , and in the south , and in the valley .
For the word of the  Lord  is right  ; and all his works are done in truth .
translation.kha: Ki ktien U  Trai  ki long kiba shisha ; bad baroh ki kam jong u ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .

translation.en: And Jahzah , and Kedemoth , and Mephaath ,
translation.kha: ka Jahas , ka Kedemoth , ka Mephaath ,
Dabid u kylli ïa u , Nangno me wan ? Nga la lait phet na ka jaka sher dara ki Israel , u la jubab .
translation.en: And David said unto him , From whence comest thou ? And he said unto him , Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped .
And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross , having slain the enmity thereby :
translation.kha: Da ka jingïap jong u halor ka diengphna , U Khrist u la pynduh thiaw ïa ka jingïashun jong ki ; da ka lynti jong ka diengphna u la pynïasoh lang ar ki jaitbynriew ha kawei ka met , bad u la wallam pat ïa ki sha U Blei .

Ha ka rmiang ba pyniar trai jong nongïatrei , Sngi ïa ki jingtyrwa soh Pomkranet ba la shna da u saiwul uba pyntngen syrdoh uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad hapdeng hapdeng suh ïa ki shakuriaw ksiar .
translation.en: A golden bell and a pomegranate , a golden bell and a pomegranate , upon the hem of the robe round about .

translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki syang ki jingkñia ka Jingkhawai Niam Jinglait ha ka , kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih bad ki syrwa ïa ki jingainguh bakyntang ha ki khiew , ki khiew , ki khiew rit , bad kloi lan ki sam ïa ka doh ha ki briew .
translation.en: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance : but the other holy offerings sod they in pots , and in caldrons , and in pans , and divided them speedily among all the people .

translation.kha: Ka jingphla ka long kane : U Blei u la Shelishiyah ha ngi ïa ka jingim bymjukut , jingpyllaitluid kane ka jingim ka don ka tyllong jong ka ha U Khun jong u .
translation.en: And this is the record , that God hath given to us eternal life , and this life is in his Son .

translation.kha: U Trai shah um ïa ki briew kiba bha ban shahthngan , hynrei u khang ïa ki bymman ban ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .
translation.en: The  Lord  will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish : but he casteth away the substance of the wicked .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah bad u kiew la u sha lum , ha uba u la shong . Ki synran jong u ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u ,
translation.en: And seeing the multitudes , he went up into a mountain : and when he was set , his disciples came unto him :
But he , being full of the Holy Ghost , looked up stedfastly into heaven , and saw the glory of God , and Jesus standing on the right hand of God ,
translation.kha: Hynrei u Stephan , uba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u la khmied sha bneng bad u la ïohi ïa ka burom jong U Blei bad ïa U Jisu uba ïeng sha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .

translation.en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost , and Leah and her children after , and Rachel and Joseph hindermost .
translation.kha: U buh ha khmat eh ïa ki tnga kliar bad ki khun jong ki , nangta sa ka Leah bad ki khun jong ka , bad khatduh ïa ka Rakhel bad u Joseph hadien duh .

Ka ri ha kaba ki shim bad ka shongduh kynthup ïa Bethel ka bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ka naduh shaphang mihngi ka Naaran bad haduh shaphang sepngi ka Geser bad ki shnong sawdong jong ka . Ka kynthup ruh ïa ki nongbah ka Shekhem bad ka Ayyah bad ki shnong sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And their possessions and habitations were , Beth–el and the towns thereof , and eastward Naaran , and westward Gezer , with the towns thereof  ; Shechem also and the towns thereof , unto Gaza and the towns thereof :
And he took them up in his arms , put his hands upon them , and blessed them .
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ki khynnah ha la ki ksang ti , u la buh ïa ki kti jong u halor jong ki , bad u la kyrkhu ïa ki .

Uwei na ki Kynhun ong , Ngan sa jingïadon biang sha me hadien khyndai bnai , bad ka Sarah ka tnga jong me kan sa ïoh khun pynsngewshyrkhei . baryngkhiang Sarah kaba ïeng hadien Hangne u Joram ka jingkem ka ïingjaiñ khyllung rasong pynshahshkor .
translation.en: And he said , I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life  ; and , lo , Sarah thy wife shall have a son . And Sarah heard it in the tent door , which was behind him .

translation.kha: To Sephanaïah joit jingontep ko Jerusalem bad tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi ba-thala ka burom ka jong jingpynlehnoh-ei sip ka tyngshaiñ barieh Sdang !
translation.en: Arise , shine  ; for thy light is come , and the glory of the  Lord  is risen upon thee .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei lat don ha ka ha shuwa jong nga , u la ka jingbankhia ïa ki briew bad dawa sawphew ki pisa sngi na ka bynta jingbam bad ka waiñ . Wat ki shakri jong , ki ju ïa ki briew . Hynrei shym leh kumta , namar nga ïa U Blei .
translation.en: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people , and had taken of them bread and wine , beside forty shekels of silver  ; yea , even their servants bare rule over the people : but so did not I , because of the fear of God .
And Elisha said unto him , Go , say unto him , Thou mayest certainly recover : howbeit the  Lord  hath shewed me that he shall surely die .
translation.kha: U Elisha u jubab ,  U  Trai  u la pynpaw ha nga ba un ïap ; hynrei khie leit sha u bad ïathuh ha u ba un koit pat .
Nga la ïohi ïa kane baroh haba nga pyrkhat ïa kiei kiei kiba la leh ha kane ka pyrthei , ka pyrthei ha kaba katto ki katne briew ki don ka bor bad kiwei pat ki dei ban shahshitom hapoh jong ki .
translation.en: All this have I seen , and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun : there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt .

translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot swai lano dei ban long khatlai mitar Gebal lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan . Baroh khatwei tylli kita ki pynkhuslai jaiñ ki dei ban long katjuh ka jingheh .
translation.en: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure .

translation.kha: Nga la dem khrup ha kjat ki jong u ban ïa mane u , hynrei u la ong ha nga , Wat leh kumne ! Nga long u para shakri bad me bad ki kita parabangeit jong , me kito baroh kiba bat ïa ka jingshisha kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw . To mane ïa U Blei ! Naba ka jingshisha kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw ka long kata kaba pyrsad mynsiem ïa nongïathuhlypa ki .
translation.en: And I fell at his feet to worship him . And he said unto me , See thou do it not : I am thy fellowservant , and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus : worship God : for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonghikai na ka skul jong shabar dambit bad ki Stoik ki la ïabuh ruh bad u . Katto katne minot na ki , ki la kylli , Aïu Sniew u sarong bieit u pyrshang nongpdem ïaphah ? 1 pat ki jubab , shkor peiñ kumba u kren shaphang ki blei nongwei . jingpyntreikam la ong ïa kane skum astor u Paul u la ïalap shaphang U Jisu bad ka jingmihpat .
translation.en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans , and of the Stoicks , encountered him . And some said , What will this babbler say ? other some , He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods : because he preached unto them Jesus , and the resurrection .
Behold , he putteth no trust in his saints  ; yea , the heavens are not clean in his sight .
translation.kha: Balei , U Blei um shaniah wat ïa ki angel jong u ; wat ma ki kim long kiba khuid ha khmat jong u .
U Nathan u jubab , Leh kat kaba don ha ka jingmut jong phi , namar U u Blei long ryngkat bad phi .
translation.en: Then Nathan said unto David , Do all that is in thine heart  ; for God is with thee .
And he made staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .
translation.kha: U thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar ,

translation.en: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me , and bow down themselves unto me , saying , Get thee out , and all the people that follow thee : and after that I will go out . And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger .
translation.kha: U Moses u pynkut da kaba ong ,  Ki rangbah synshar jong phi baroh kin sa wan sha nga bad dem khrup ha khmat jong nga , bad kin sa kyrpad ïa nga ban ïalam noh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh bad ban mihnoh . Hadien kata ngan sa leit .  Nangta u Moses u mihnoh na u Pharaoh da ka jingbitar bakhraw .
Dei ma phi ban ïoh ïa ka jingmyntoi , lada phi don ka , jingstad lada bad phi kyntait ïa ka , phi hi phin shem jynjar .
translation.en: If thou be wise , thou shalt be wise for thyself : but if thou scornest , thou alone shalt bear it .

translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uno uno uba ngeit ha nga un leh ïa kaei kaba nga leh — , ho-oid un leh ïa wat ki kiei kiei kiba kham khraw , namar ngan leit U sha Kpa .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me , the works that I do shall he do also  ; and greater works than these shall he do  ; because I go unto my Father .

translation.kha: Hooid ryngkhiang ki don ki jingdawa kiba ngi hap ban pynbiang lada ngi kwah ban im junom la junom eitnar ka Paradais ban sa wan ha ka Pyrthei har
translation.en: Of course , there are requirements to be met if we are to live forever in the coming Paradise on earth .
Having therefore obtained help of God , I continue unto this day , witnessing both to small and great , saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come :
translation.kha: Hynrei haduh kane ka sngi , la ïarap ïa nga da U Blei , bad kumta nga ïeng hangne ban ai ïa ka jingsakhi jong nga ha baroh , ha uba rit bad ha uba khraw kumjuh . Kaei kaba nga ong ka long kajuh hi kaba ki nongïathuhlypa bad u Moses ki la ong ba kan sa jia :

translation.en: And when Jesus saw her , he called her to him , and said unto her ,  Woman , thou art loosed from thine infirmity .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka , u la pyrta ïa ka ,  Ko ka briew , pha la lait phar na ka jingpang jong pha !
U ai ïa ka khubor jong u sha briew ki jong u , ki jingbthah bad ki aiñ jong u ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: He sheweth his word unto Jacob , his statutes and his judgments unto Israel .

Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel  ; Behold , I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands , wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon , and against the Chaldeans , which besiege you without the walls , and I will assemble them into the midst of this city .
translation.kha: Ko Sedekaïah , ngan jop ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Babilonia bad ki shipai jong u . Ngan kynton ïa ki tiar ïapom jong ki shipai jong me hamar pdeng jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: Which the  Lord  commanded to be given them of the children of Israel , in the day that he anointed them , by a statute for ever throughout their generations .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki paid Israel ban ai ïa kane ka bynta jong ka jingainguh . Ka dei ka aiñ ba ki paid Israel ki dei ban kohnguh pateng la pateng .
Wat ïasoh ha ki pynksan basniew ïa-pait ki briew bad wat sheptieng ïa kiei kiei kiba ki sheptieng .
translation.en: Say ye not , A confederacy , to all them to whom this people shall say , A confederacy  ; neither fear ye their fear , nor be afraid .
And all the people of the land rejoiced , and the city was in quiet : and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king s house .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew ki la dap da ka jingkmen , bad ka nongbah ka kynjah , naba mynta la pynïap ïa ka Athalaïah ha ka ïingsyiem .
Te ngan jin da ïohthiah kum ki khun syiem kiba pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ka ksiar bad ka rupa , lane ïohthiah kum u khunlung ba shu kha .
translation.en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been  ; as infants which never saw light .

translation.kha: Nangta kata ka briew ka la iehnoh la ïa u khiew um , ka la leit phai sha shnong bad , ka la ong ïa ki briew hangta ,
translation.en: The woman then left her waterpot , and went her way into the city , and saith to the men ,
He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet , and drinketh damage .
translation.kha: Lada phi shah ba uba bieit un sam ïa ka khubor , ka long kumba ot ïa la ki jong ki kjat ; phi pan ïa ka jingjynjar .
bad u ai ïa ki ha u Aaron rben ki nierbah dum jong u .
translation.en: According to the commandment of the  Lord  they were numbered by the hand of Moses , every one according to his service , and according to his burden : thus were they numbered of him , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
The nobleman saith unto him , Sir , come down ere my child die .
translation.kha: Ko Kynrad ,  la phai ktien u rangbah synshar ,  to wan bad nga shuwa ba u khun jong nga un ïap .
To leh , adkar to sharai ! U nongshun jong phi , u Ksuid , u shang kylleng kum u sing bakyrhuh , da kaba wad ïa uno uno ba un tylli nguid .
translation.en: Be sober , be vigilant  ; because your adversary the devil , as a roaring lion , walketh about , seeking whom he may devour :

translation.en: The Father loveth the Son , and hath given all things into his hand .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne , bun na ki briew , kynthup ïa shynrang bad ki kynthei ki sdang ban ujor ïa ki jong ki .
translation.en: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews .
And the  Lord  spake unto you out of the midst of the fire : ye heard the voice of the words , but saw no similitude  ; only ye heard a voice .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki kumno U  Trai  u la kren ha phi na kata ka ding , kumno phi la ïohsngew ba u kren hynrei phim shym la ïohi satia ïa ka dur jong u .
U syiem u pynbiang ïa la ka durkhmat bad u kyang jam bashalak A , ko khun Justos nga ! Ko khun jong nga , Mahanaim Absalom ! ko Absalom , ko pyrthuh jong nga !
translation.en: But the king covered his face , and the king cried with a loud voice , O my son Absalom , O Absalom , my son , my son !

translation.kha: U syiem Abijah la ïap bad tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid . U u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u , bad hapoh ka jingsynshar u Asa ka ri ka mad ïa ka haduh shiphew snem .
translation.en: So Abijah slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David : and Asa his son reigned in his stead . In his days the land was quiet ten years .

translation.kha: Hamath u Eglaim ïalam ïa Libya shabar ka nongbah haduh ha Bethania , ha kaba op la rah ïa jingpynkhuid ki kti bad u jingshipa kyrkhu ïa ki .
translation.en: And he led them out as far as to Bethany , and he lifted up his hands , and blessed them .
And the king of Egypt called for the midwives , and said unto them , Why have ye done this thing , and have saved the men children alive ?
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Ijipt u phah khot ïa kita ki nongpynkha khun , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi leh kumne , bad phi shah ïa ki khun shynrang ba kin im ?
U Ïoannis u la long kum ka sharak kaba , meh bad kaba , tyngshaiñ bad phi la mon shipor ban lehkmen ha ka jingshai jong u .
translation.en: He was a burning and a shining light : and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light .
But he denied , saying , I know not , neither understand I what thou sayest . And he went out into the porch  ; and the cock crew .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la len ïa kata .  Ngam tip . . . ngam sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba pha kren ,  u la jubab , bad u la leit noh sha ka baranda . Hamar kata ka por u syiar u la kyn-ih .
Hato ki Sudan ki Libya kim don ki kynhun shipai baheh paid ryngkat bad ki kali ïapom bad ki nongshong kulai ? Hynrei namar ba me la ha U Trai , la jingjop ïa me halor jong ki .
translation.en: Were not the Ethiopians and the Libyans a huge host , with very many chariots and horsemen ? yet , because thou didst rely on the  Lord  , he delivered them into thine hand .
And Zadok the priest , and his brethren the priests , before the tabernacle of the  Lord  in the high place that was at Gibeon ,
translation.kha: U Sadok u lyngdoh bad ki para lyngdoh jong u pat , ki peit ïa ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  ha ka jaka mane kaba ha Gibeon .
U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa u Jehoshaphat namar u la bud ïa ka nuksa ba-mynshuwa jong ka jingim u kpa jong bad u shym um mane ïa u Baal .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Jehoshaphat , because he walked in the first ways of his father David , and sought not unto Baalim  ;

translation.kha: U long U Blei jingshongshngain pynkup ïa u phlang khlaw — u phlang uba don slap mynta Soh u bym don shuh lashai , ryngkhiang la thang duh ha ka lawar ding . Hato un ym da la kham leh thikna ban pynkup jaiñ ïa phi ? Katno kaba rit ka nym phi don !
translation.en: Wherefore , if God so clothe the grass of the field , which to day is , and to morrow is cast into the oven , shall he not much more clothe you , O ye of little faith ?
I said , I will go up to the palm tree , I will take hold of the boughs thereof : now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine , and the smell of thy nose like apples  ;
translation.kha: Ai ba u syiem un don hynriewphew ngut ki mahadei , phraphew ngut ki tnga kliar , ki kynthei ba dang samla khlem ka jingkheiñ ïa ka jingdon jong ki !

Tei ïa kawei ka duwan da ka khyndew bad kñia ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi jong halor jong ka ki jingainguh thang bad ki ïasyllok . Ha man la ka jaka ba nga pynkyrpang ba phin mane nga ngan bad kyrkhu ïa phi .
translation.en: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me , and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings , and thy peace offerings , thy sheep , and thine oxen : in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee , and I will bless thee .

And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Behold , thy days approach that thou must die : call Joshua , and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation , that I may give him a charge . And Moses and Joshua went , and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Me te , men ym im slem shuh . Khot ïa u Joshua bad wan ïalam ïa u sha ka Ïingjaiñ khnang ba ngan ai hukum ïa u .

translation.en: What could have been done more to my vineyard , that I have not done in it ? wherefore , when I looked that it should bring forth grapes , brought it forth wild grapes ?
translation.kha: Don kano kano kaba ngam shym la leh ïa ka ? Te balei ka pynmih ki sohwaiñ kiba jew bad ym kiba bha kumba nga la khmih lynti ?
nongmareh nga la pyllut hangta bad nga la ïohi ïa u nongthaw rnga ba ïa-pasiaw trei ha ka shalyntem jong u .
translation.en: Then I went down to the potter s house , and , behold , he wrought a work on the wheels .

translation.kha: Me jinglehrain ha bashathie ïa ka jingjahthait na ki sngi ka jingjynjar haduh ban da tih ïa ka tliew ban ngat pushara bymman .
translation.en: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity , until the pit be digged for the wicked .
Again , if two lie together , then they have heat : but how can one be warm alone ?
translation.kha: Lada ka khriat , ki ar ngut ki lah ban ïathiah lang bad ban neh ha ka jingsyiad , hynrei kumno phin pynneh jingsyiad tang ma phi da lade hi ?

translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins ,  ( he said unto the sick of the palsy , )  I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy couch , and go into thine house .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te , ba U Khun U Briew u don ka bor ha ka pyrthei ban map ïa ki pop .  Kumta u la ong ha u briew uba ïapshiliang ,  Nga ong ha me , to khie joit , shim ïa la ka jingthiah , bad khie leit noh sha ïing !

kiba shim kabu ïa jinglyngkhuit riewkynthei mihngi kiba jingainguh noh ïa mawthew ïing jong ki jingsngap bad nangta kiba pyn-i paidbah da kaba duwai jlan Katno bapawnam jingpynshitom ïa ki kan long samla kham shyrkhei !
translation.en: Which devour widows  houses , and for a shew make long prayers : the same shall receive greater damnation .

translation.kha: man ka snem sha ka ïing U Trai Blei jong u soh nyngkong uba phi ot Wat shet ïa u khunblang ne khunlangbrot ha ka dud ka jong u .
translation.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the  Lord  thy God . Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother s milk .

translation.kha: U Trai u kylli , ‘ ban Mano shukor ïa u Ahab khnang ba un leit bad shah pynïap ha Ramoth ?’ Katto katne ki angel ong ki ïa kawei , bad pat kiwei ki ong ïa kawei pat ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel , that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead ? And one spake saying after this manner , and another saying after that manner .
And they said , There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin , that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kim dei ban duh noh kawei na ki khat-ar jait jong ki . Ngi dei ban shem ka lynti na ka bynta ka jait Benjamin ban ym duh jait ,

translation.en: For thy Maker is thine husband  ; the  Lord  of hosts is his name  ; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel  ; The God of the whole earth shall he be called .
translation.kha: U Nongthaw jong pha un long kum u tnga ïa pha — U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh long ka kyrteng jong u . U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel un pynim ïa pha — u long u nongsynshar jong ka pyrthei baroh .

translation.en: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt , both of man and beast .
translation.kha: Ha Ijipt u la pynïap ïa baroh kiba la kha nyngkong na ki briew bad na ki mrad kumjuh .

krensih nongïalam kiba stad kin jingstad da ka jingphyrnai baroh ibieit ka suiñbneng . Bad kito kiba la hikai ïa kiba bun jingkynthih briew ban leh ïa kaei jinglur dei kin tyngshaiñ kum ki khlur junom .
translation.en: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament  ; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever .
Ask of me , and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance , and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession .
translation.kha: To pan , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ; ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan long ka jong me .

translation.en: And he had prepared for him a great chamber , where aforetime they laid the meat offerings , the frankincense , and the vessels , and the tithes of the corn , the new wine , and the oil , which was commanded to be given to the Levites , and the singers , and the porters  ; and the offerings of the priests .
translation.kha: U shah ïa u Tobiah ban pyndonkam ïa ka kamra kaba heh ïa kaba la thmu tang ban buh ïa u kew jingkñia bad ka jingiwbih , ki tiar ki tar ba pyndonkam ha ka Templ , ki jingainguh na ka bynta ki lyngdoh , bad kiba shiphew na u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ba ai sha ki Lebi , ki nongtem nongput ka Templ , bad ki nongap phira ka Templ .

Bad hadien kata ki la iehnoh ïa la ka jingngeit ! Ka long ka bym lah Un ban ïalam pat ïa Ruphos ban kylla-kaba-mut biang , namar ki la sahnarphna biang ïa U Khun U Blei thnam bymïap ïa u ha .—2 mawkhang pyrthei .
translation.en: If they shall fall away , to renew them again unto repentance  ; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh , and put him to an open shame .
And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils  ; for the boil was upon the magicians , and upon all the Egyptians .
translation.kha: Ki nongleh myntor kim lah ïeng shuh ha khmat u Moses namar ki la ïa-ïoh tohjaw lut kumba long lem kiwei pat ki nong Ijipt .
u bseiñ lane ka dohkha .
translation.en: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground , the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth :
These discovered her nakedness : they took her sons and her daughters , and slew her with the sword : and she became famous among women  ; for they had executed judgment upon her .
translation.kha: Ki law lyngkhuit ïa ka , ki kem ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei jong ka , bad nangta ki pynïap ïa ka da ka waitlam . Ki kynthei kylleng ki ïathuh lorni shaphang ka kupar jong ka .

translation.en: And when the south wind blew softly , supposing that they had obtained their purpose , loosing thence , they sailed close by Crete .
translation.kha: Ka lyer kaba jai jai na shathie ka la sdang ban beh , bad ki rangbah ki la pyrkhat ba ki lah ban pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong ki , kumta ki la ïaring noh ïa u angkor bad ki la king kham jan katba lah marsyndah jong ka rud duriaw jong ka Krit .
Bad u Elisha u bteng , Hynrei kane jinghikai long kaba jem ïa Adadah Trai ban leh ; dum ai ruh ha phi drama Beria pynshongduh bieit Moab .
translation.en: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the  Lord  : he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand .

translation.kha: U la pyntwa ruh ïa u mot ha Penuel bad pynïap ïa ki rangbah jong kata ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he beat down the tower of Penuel , and slew the men of the city .
In all the signs and the wonders , which the  Lord  sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh , and to all his servants , and to all his land ,
translation.kha: Ym don uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa uba la leh ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kum kito kiba U  Trai  u la phah ïa u Moses ban leh ha u syiem ka Ijipt , ha ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ha ka ri hi baroh kawei .
Un kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw kum jingkñia ka ban map ïa ki pop jong u bad jong ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering , which is for himself , and make an atonement for himself , and for his house .

translation.kha: Hynrei la katta ruh , ka dang don katto katne ka jingbha phi . Phi weng baroh dur jong blei Asherah kaba ki briew ki mane , bad phi la pyrshang ban bud ïa ka mon U Blei .
translation.en: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee , in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land , and hast prepared thine heart to seek God .

translation.kha: Bad U Trai peit-thuh la ong shuh , Ko u khun u briew , to ïathuh lyngkdong ki paid Israel shaphang ka Templ bashabar bad ai ba kin ïitbniah ïa ka jingthmu jong Asaraïahu . Pynlong ïa snieh ban adkar ïa ki kam Tahpenes jong ki Jaban
translation.en: Thou son of man , shew the house to the house of Israel , that they may be ashamed of their iniquities : and let them measure the pattern .
And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  : for ye have not walked in my statutes , neither executed my judgments , but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you .
translation.kha: Phin tip ba nga long U  Trai  bad ba katba phi dang bat ïa ki aiñ jong ki jaitbynriew ba-marjan , phi la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad khlem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .
Slem katno u la long kumne ? U Jisu u la kylli ïa u Urbanos jong u . Naduh ba u dang rit bakhlaiñbor u la jubab .
translation.en: And he asked his father ,  How long is it ago since this came unto him ?  And he said , Of a child .

translation.kha: bad ban pdiang! Jonathan ka Khyrdop Khra-pait Im sha ka Them Hinnom . Hangta nga dei ban pynbna ïa ka khubor kaba un kum Pynïoh Pleng .
translation.en: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom , which is by the entry of the east gate , and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee ,
And this is love , that we walk after his commandments . This is the commandment , That , as ye have heard from the beginning , ye should walk in it .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingieit kaba nga kren ka mut ba ngin ïaid ha ka jingkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U Blei . Ka hukum , kumba phi baroh phi la ïohsngew naduh mynnyngkong , ka long ba baroh phi dei ban ïa-ïaid ha ka jingieit .

translation.en: For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth .
translation.kha: naba ka dei ka jingshai kaba pynmih ïa ka jingot kaba kyrhai ha baroh ki jinglong babha , bahok , bad bashisha .
Kumta , hadien ba ngi la sah slem ha Kadesh ,
translation.en: So ye abode in Kadesh many days , according unto the days that ye abode there .

translation.kha: U jingshem um dei u mraw ; ba-bymman bakynjah la kha ïa u sha ka jinglongmraw . Balei te ba ki nongshun jong u jingkhum behmrad ïa u ?
translation.en: Is Israel a servant ? is he a homeborn slave ? why is he spoiled ?
And they talked together of all these things which had happened .
translation.kha: bad ki dang ïakren para ma ki shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia .

kyntu ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga : To husiar na kito kiba pynlong jingïapait bad kiba pynkulmar ïa ka jingngeit jong ki briew bad kiba ïaid pyrshah ïa ka jinghikai kaba phi la . To kiar na ki !
translation.en: Now I beseech you , brethren , mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned ; and avoid them .

translation.kha: U Jakob u kylli ïa ki nongap langbrot , Ko paralok , phi dei kiba na-ei Na ? Haran , ki jubab .
translation.en: And Jacob said unto them , My brethren , whence be ye ? And they said , Of Haran are we .

But Jehosheba , the daughter of king Joram , sister of Ahaziah , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him from among the king s sons which were slain  ; and they hid him , even him and his nurse , in the bedchamber from Athaliah , so that he was not slain .
translation.kha: Tang u Joash u khun jong u Ahasaïah u lait im . U la jan shah pynïap ryngkat bad kiwei , hynrei la pyllait im ïa u da ka ñiakha jong u , ka Jehosheba , kaba long ka khun jong u syiem Jehoram bad ka bakha u Ahasaïah . Ka shim ïa u lem bad ka nongsumar jong u sha ka kamra thiah kaba don ha ka Templ bad ka la pynrieh ïa u na ka Athalaïah , kumta um shym la shah pynïap .

translation.en: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof , he said , It is the man of God , who was disobedient unto the word of the  Lord  : therefore the  Lord  hath delivered him unto the lion , which hath torn him , and slain him , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake unto him .
translation.kha: Haba uta u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u ïohsngew ïa kata , u ong ,  Utai u dei u nongïathuhlypa uba la lyndet ïa ka hukum U  Trai . Bad kumta U  Trai  u phah ïa u sing uba la patar bad pynïap ïa u , kumba U  Trai  u la kren ha u .
Ki briew jong U Blei ki khaweh Maloi ha ka jingbun briew , ki long ki nongwei ïakheit ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: When they were but a few men in number  ; yea , very few , and strangers in it .

translation.kha: Ka Edom ka la laitluid na Judah naduh kata ka por . Ha kane kajuh ka ka nongbah Libnah ruh ka la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , namar u Jehoram la iehnoh ïa U Trai , U Blei ki kpa jong u .
translation.en: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day . The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand  ; because he had forsaken the  Lord  God of his fathers .

translation.kha: Lada um pyndep ïa kine ki kamram ha ka , u dei ban pyllaitluid noh ïa ka da khlem siew ei ei .
translation.en: And if he do not these three unto her , then shall she go out free without money .

translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , kane mynta ka long ka shithi kaba ar nga ba thoh sha phi . Ha baroh ar tylli ki shithi nga la pyrshang ban pynkhih ïa ki bakhuid jingpyrkhat ha ki jingmut jong phi da kaba pynkynmaw phi ïa ïa kine kiei kiei .
translation.en: This second epistle , beloved , I now write unto you  ; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance :

And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the  Lord  , and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the  Lord  , to repair and amend the house :
translation.kha: Nangta ïa kane ka pisa la pynkhamti ha ki lai ngut ki rangbah kiba peit halor ka jingtei pynbha ïa ka Templ ,
ki jew pynïap lut ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei baroh .—Salm bad rah noh ïa ki langbrot , ki masi , ki kada , ki ut , bad kyrsoi ïa moramot jaiñkup jaiñsem riewkhyllah .
translation.en: And David smote the land , and left neither man nor woman alive , and took away the sheep , and the oxen , and the asses , and the camels , and the apparel , and returned , and came to Achish .
The  Lord  therefore be judge , and judge between me and thee , and see , and plead my cause , and deliver me out of thine hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un bishar bad un rai mano ba bakla napdeng jong ngi . To un khmih ïa kane ka kam , un ïada ïa nga , bad un pyllait im ïa nga na phi .
la long sniew khlem jingkyrmen ha kaei kaei ki leh , kumba la long ha Gibeah . U Blei un kynmaw ïa ka pop jong ki , bad pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta .
translation.en: They have deeply corrupted themselves , as in the days of Gibeah : therefore he will remember their iniquity , he will visit their sins .

And it came to pass , when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses  hand , when he came down from the mount , that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him .
translation.kha: Mynba u Moses u wan hiar na u Lum Sinai , u da rah ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki Shiphew Hukum , ka khmat jong u ka tyngshaiñ namar ba u la ïakren bad U  Trai  ; hynrei um tip satia ïa kata .

translation.en: But Christ as a son over his own house  ; whose house are we , if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end .
translation.kha: Hynrei , U Khrist u long uba lah ban shaniah kum U Khun uba dei peit ïa ka ïing U Blei . Ngi long ka ïing jong u lada ngi ïaineh ha ka jingshlur bad ngi long skhem ha kaei kaba ngi kyrmen .
bad Judas Iskariot , uba la shetkylla ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And Judas Iscariot , which also betrayed him : and they went into an house .

translation.kha: ki briew kiba iehnoh ïa ka jingim hok im ha ka jingdum ka pop
translation.en: Who leave the paths of uprightness , to walk in the ways of darkness  ;
And they put the fat upon the breasts , and he burnt the fat upon the altar :
translation.kha: halor ki shadem jong ki bad u rah ïa ki baroh sha ka duwan . U thang ïa ka khleiñ halor ka duwan ,
Wallam shuh Mikhal ki dieng ! Pynrhem prong pnah ding ! Shet thnum ka ïa-lorni ! Phon ïa ka syrwa ! Thang noh ïa ki shyieng !
translation.en: Heap on wood , kindle the fire , consume the flesh , and spice it well , and let the bones be burned .

translation.kha: Ïa u Lum baroh Sinai uwei la tap da ka tdem , namar U Trai u wan la hiar ha u ha ka ding . Ka tdem ka kum kiew kaba mih na ka lawar ding , bad ki briew baroh ki la kyiuh shibun eh .
translation.en: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke , because the  Lord  descended upon it in fire : and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace , and the whole mount quaked greatly .
Now unto the King eternal , immortal , invisible , the only wise God , be honour and glory for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Ha u Syiem bymjukut , u bymïap shuh bad u bym lah ban ïohi , uba tang ma u hi U Blei — ha u to long ka jingpyndonburom bad ka burom junom la junom ! Amen .

translation.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .
translation.kha: Ka jinglorni ka bang palat — katno ngi sngewieit ban nguid tylli ïa ka !
U Jisu la ha ki kawei ka pharshi Ka Hima ki Bneng ka long kumne . Ka ka shim u thiat bad ka khleh ïa u bad sawphew kilo u tad ba u purew ba la khleh u sieb .
translation.en: Another parable spake he unto them  ;  The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven , which a woman took , and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .

translation.kha: bad ki jingtap tei ki duwan ïa ehrang nongpule khnang ban thang Kappadokia ki khun jong ki ha ka mawthoh kum ki jingkñia . Ngam thaba nongpdem ïa pajwa ban leh ïa kane ; kam shym rung hi ruh ba-pura ka jingpyrkhat jong nga .
translation.en: They have built also the high places of Baal , to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal , which I commanded not , nor spake it , neither came it into my mind :

translation.kha: Ka jingainguh kaba ka long ar litar waiñ lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw shi litar ka waiñ lem bad u langbrot , bad shi litar waiñ lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot . ka ka jingbuh ryntih ïa ka thang na ka bynta ka sngi nyngkong kaba la u bnai shisnem .
translation.en: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock , and the third part of an hin unto a ram , and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb : this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year .

translation.en: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold , truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold .

translation.en: When thou passest through the waters , I will be with thee  ; and through the rivers , they shall not overflow thee : when thou walkest through the fire , thou shalt not be burned  ; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee .

translation.en: Who , having received such a charge , thrust them into the inner prison , and made their feet fast in the stocks .

Who giveth food to all flesh : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.en: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake : I beheld even till the beast was slain , and his body destroyed , and given to the burning flame .

translation.en: And when Abner was returned to Hebron , Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly , and smote him there under the fifth rib , that he died , for the blood of Asahel his brother .

translation.en: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the  Lord  :

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Ye shall not see wind , neither shall ye see rain  ; yet that valley shall be filled with water , that ye may drink , both ye , and your cattle , and your beasts .

translation.kha: Haba shylluit leit na ka ïing ki kynthei sha ka ïingsyiem , ka lah ban riam koum kano khyllah jingriam mehding ka kwah .
translation.en: Then thus came every maiden unto the king  ; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king s house .

translation.kha: kumta Te kumno shaphang u briew , uta u kruiñ , uta u khñiang ? u briew u long aïu ha ki khmat U Blei ?
translation.en: How much less man , that is a worm ? and the son of man , which is a worm ?

translation.en: And he said unto me , To build it an house in the land of Shinar : and it shall be established , and set there upon her own base .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  Sha Babilonia , ha kaba kin tei ka templ na ka bynta jong ka . Haba la dep shna ïa ka Templ , ïa ka shang yn buh hangta ïa ka ba yn mane .

translation.en: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the  Lord  thy God : thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock , nor shear the firstling of thy sheep .
translation.kha: Buh kyrpang sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa ki shynrang baroh ba la kha nyngkong na ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi ; wat pyntreikam ïa kita ki masi , bad wat ot shñiuh ïa kita ki langbrot .

translation.en: Send therefore to Joppa , and call hither Simon , whose surname is Peter  ; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side : who , when he cometh , shall speak unto thee .
translation.kha: Phah ïano ïano sha Joppa ban shem ïa u briew uba ka kyrteng pura ka long u Simon Petros . U shong basa ha ka ïing jong u Simon , u nongpdem snieh , uba shong basah harud duriaw .’

translation.en: And Lot went up out of Zoar , and dwelt in the mountain , and his two daughters with him  ; for he feared to dwell in Zoar : and he dwelt in a cave , he and his two daughters .
translation.kha: Namar ba u Lot u sheptieng ban sah ha Soar , ma u lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong u ki la kynriah sha ki lum , bad ki ïashong ïasah ha kawei ka krem .

Katba ki Dong jong u Ïoannis ki Kherub mihnoh , U Jisu u ïakhleh kren shaphang pynkynroi u ha ki paidbah ; Haba phi leit Maki u bet ha ka “Gilead” beit , kaei kaba phi khmih kylla-kaba-mut ban ïohi ? Ïa u sla Kheiñ ba la pynkhun ha ka lyer !
translation.en: And as they departed , Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John ,  What went ye out into the wilderness to see ? A reed shaken with the wind ?
And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem , that were called  ; and they went in their simplicity , and they knew not any thing .
translation.kha: La don arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba ha ka jingkhot sngewbha u Absalom ki la leit na Jerusalem bad u ; kim tip ei ei shaphang ka jingthmu barieh bad ki la leit da kaba sngur mynsiem .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What things ?  And they said unto him , Concerning Jesus of Nazareth , which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people :
translation.kha: Kiei kita ?  u la kylli .  Kiei kiei kiba la jia ha U Jisu uba na Nasareth ,  ki la jubab .  Une u briew u la long u nongïathuhlypa bad la ñiew da U Blei bad da ki briew baroh ba u long uba donbor ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u kren bad leh .

La shah ïa u mradkhlaw uba ar ban pyrsad paro ha kata ka pynbitar pyrshing u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong , khyrdep ba ka durblei itynnad lah ban kynjat bad pynïap pyngkiang kito baroh ki ban ym nongïoh ïa ka .
translation.en: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast , that the image of the beast should both speak , and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki Philistia ki la ïohknieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ki kit ïa ka na Ebeneser sha ka nongbah jong ki ha Ashdod ,
translation.en: And the Philistines took the ark of God , and brought it from Eben–ezer unto Ashdod .

translation.kha: Bad , kat kum kaei kaba U Trai u la lah pyrshah ïa u Baasha lyngba u Jehu nongïathuhlypa , u u pynïap na ka jong u Baasha
translation.en: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet ,

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka dur kaba kdew sha ka kaba . Ka mut ba ka jingainguh bad ki da ki mrad kiba la ai sha U Blei kim lah satia ban pynjanai ïa ka dohnud jong uta mane ,
translation.en: Which was a figure for the time then present , in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices , that could not make him that did the service perfect , as pertaining to the conscience  ;

translation.kha: Kumta jingshon Paul u la ïalam kyntu kita ki rangbah bad ha ka sngi kaba bud u Hoshaïah pyndep ïa pynlyngki jinglehniam ka pynshong lem sirka ki . Nangta jinglwet jyllop leit sha ka Templ bad u la pyntip katno sngi kan long haduh kaba kut ka por jong ka jingpynkhuid , haba yn ai pyrta ïanguh jingkñia na ka bynta jong ki baroh ar ngut .
translation.en: Then Paul took the men , and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple , to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification , until that an offering should be offered for every one of them .
And Jesus stood , and commanded him to be brought unto him : and when he was come near , he asked him ,
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la hukum ban wallam sha u ïa u briew uba matlah . Haba u la wan hajan , U Jisu u la kylli ïa u ,

translation.en: But as for me , this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living , but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king , and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart .
translation.kha: Mynta , ïa kane ka jingmaïan la pynpaw ha nga , ym namar ba nga kham stad ban ïa uno uno uwei pat , hynrei khnang ba u Syiem Kynrad u lah ban ïoh tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka jingphohsniew jong phi bad shemphang ïa ki jingpyrkhat kiba la wan ha phi .
Ïalumlang ban mane Blei ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba Gaham . Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha kaba larkam burom ïa U Trai hynñiew sngi lynter , bad wat trei Ekron kano ka nongkam .
translation.en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work , and ye shall keep a feast unto the  Lord  seven days :
But have walked after the imagination of their own heart , and after Baalim , which their fathers taught them :
translation.kha: Pynban , ki la long kiba mutlop bad ki la mane ïa ki bleithaw u Baal kumba ki kpa jong ki , ki la hikai ïa ki ban leh .

U Trai u long u nongïada uba khlaiñ jong nga ; u long ma u , uba la pyllait im ïa nga U . dei U Blei jong , nga bad ngan ïaroh ïa u , U Blei jong kpa u jong nga , bad ngan rwai shaphang ka jingkhraw jong u .
translation.en: The  Lord  is my strength and song , and he is become my salvation : he is my God , and I will prepare him an habitation  ; my father s God , and I will exalt him .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba nga la kyang jam , u la mareh shabar ïing , da kaba iehnoh ïa la ka hajan jaiñkup jong nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled out .
The mandrakes give a smell , and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits , new and old , which I have laid up for thee , O my beloved .
translation.kha: To shad , to shad , ko  theisamla ka Shullam . Shah ïa ngi ban peit ïa phi katba phi dang shad . Balei phi kwah ban khmih ïa nga katba nga dang shad hapdeng ki nongkhmih kai ?
Hadien kata U u la shem ha ka Templ bad u la ong , shane , la khiah mynta ; sangeh kaba leh pop , ïoh kaei kaba kham sniew ka lah ban jia ïa me
translation.en: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple , and said unto him ,  Behold , thou art made whole : sin no more , lest a worse thing come unto thee .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , un pynïap ïa uta u langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar pop ka na ka bynta u paidbah , un rah ïa ka snam jong u sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , bad un synreit ïa ka halor jingtap ka bad ha khmat jong ka Synduk ka Jutang kumba , u la leh ka da snam jong uta u masi lyngraw .
translation.en: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering , that is for the people , and bring his blood within the veil , and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock , and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat , and before the mercy seat :

translation.kha: U Joab bad ki rangbah jong u ki la shim kyrduh pynjhieh met jong u Asahel bad ki la tep jaiñkup ka ha ïasngap jingtep ka longïing jong u ha Bethlehem . Kseh-Sypress ki la ïaid baroh shi miet , bad ha ka Sabakhthani kynjat shai ki la wan Jemuel biang ha Hebron ryngkhat
translation.en: And they took up Asahel , and buried him in the sepulchre of his father , which was in Beth–lehem . And Joab and his men went all night , and they came to Hebron at break of day .
And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave : that is the pillar of Rachel s grave unto this day .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la pynïeng u maw sahkynmaw hangta , bad u dang pynsah dak ïa ka jingtep jong ka Rakhel haduh kane ka sngi .

translation.en: Wherefore ( as the Holy Ghost saith , To day if ye will hear his voice ,
translation.kha: Kumta te , kumba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ong ;  Lada phi ïohsngew ïa ka sur ka jong U Blei ha kane ka sngi ,
Lada u briew u bad ka tnga jong u kñi jong u u pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kñi kumta u bad ka briew kin kit hi ïa ka pop ; baroh ngut kin ïap khlem khun .
translation.en: And if a man shall lie with his uncle s wife , he hath uncovered his uncle s nakedness : they shall bear their sin  ; they shall die childless .
We love him , because he first loved us .
translation.kha: Ngi ieit namar U Blei u la ieit shuwa ïa ngi .
To khmih bha ïa ki langbrot bad ïa ki masi jong phi katba phi lah shongkai
translation.en: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks , and look well to thy herds .

translation.kha: kynmaw ba phin ym klet ïa U Trai uba la phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
translation.en: Then beware lest thou forget the  Lord  , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .

translation.kha: Uta Body briew u jubab , Ka dei ngai theisamla Thet kaba la wan pynpaw Elishaphat Moab bad ka lyndet .
translation.en: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said , It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab :
And he leaping up stood , and walked , and entered with them into the temple , walking , and leaping , and praising God .
translation.kha: u la kynthih , u la ïeng ha la ki kjat , bad u la sdang ban ïaid kylleng sawdong . Nangta u la leit shapoh ka Templ lem bad ki , u da ïaid bad kynthih bad ïaroh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Why criest thou for thine affliction ? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity : because thy sins were increased , I have done these things unto thee .
translation.kha: Wat ujor shuh shaphang ki jingmynsaw jong phi ; ym don kano kano ka jingpynkoit ïa phi . Nga la pynshitom ïa phi kumne namar ki pop jong phi ki long kiba bun bad ka jingbymman jong phi ka long kaba khraw .

translation.en: And Abram took Sarai his wife , and Lot his brother s son , and all their substance that they had gathered , and the souls that they had gotten in Haran  ; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan  ; and into the land of Canaan they came .
translation.kha: U Abram u la shim ïa ka Sarai ka tnga jong u , bad ïa u Lot u pyrsa jong u , bad ïa ka spah ka phew baroh , bad ïa ki mraw baroh ba ki la lah ïoh ha Haran , bad ki la ïamihnoh ban leit sha ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: A land of wheat , and barley , and vines , and fig trees , and pomegranates  ; a land of oil olive , and honey  ;
translation.kha: ka ri kaba pynmih ïa u kew bad u barli , u dieng sohwaiñ bad u diengsoh Dumbur , u diengsoh Pomkranet bad u diengsoh Olib , bad ka ngap .

translation.en: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters , that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass .
translation.kha: Katno kan long kaba kmen haba uwei pa uwei un ïoh kyrhai ka um na ka bynta ki jingthung bad ki jaka pynbamphlang bashngain ha kylleng na ka bynta ki kada bad ki masi .

translation.en: This is he of whom I said , After me cometh a man which is preferred before me : for he was before me .
translation.kha: Une u long uta ïa uba nga la kren mynba nga la ong , ‘ U briew uba wan hadien jong nga , hynrei u long uba kham khraw ban ïa nga , namar u la don shuwa ban kha ïa nga .’

translation.en: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you : for morning by morning shall it pass over , by day and by night : and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report .
translation.kha: Kan shoh bad kan ïai shoh ïa phi , na kawei ka step sha kawei pat . Phin hap ban shah ïa ka bad sngi bad miet . Kawei pa kawei ka khubor thymmai na U Blei kan wanrah ïa ka jingshyrkhei bathymmai !
Bad lada u briew u sylla jyllei ka ronsing ka jingïatiplem ai ka jingsawa ñiewkordor shai , uei u Sepher pynkhreh ngan Kedesh bynta klet thma ?
translation.en: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound , who shall prepare himself to the battle ?

And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they made peace with David , and became his servants : neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more .
translation.kha: Haba ki syiem kiba hap hapoh u Hadadeser ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , ki pynlong ka jingïasuk bad u Dabid bad ki kylla long ki raïot jong u . Ki Syria kim ju mon shuh ban ïarap ïa ki Ammon .
U u , Mem ban ong ei ei shuh shuh . Nga la rai ma me bad men ïabynta ka jingdon jingem jong u .
translation.en: And the king said unto him , Why speakest thou any more of thy matters ? I have said , Thou and Ziba divide the land .
And it came to pass , as soon as Gideon was dead , that the children of Israel turned again , and went a whoring after Baalim , and made Baal–berith their god .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap jong u Gideon , ki paid Israel kim shym ïaineh shuh bad U Blei bad ki la mane ïa ki Baal . Ki la pynlong ïa u Baal-jong-ka-Jutang ban long u blei jong ki ,

translation.en: And after that I looked , and , behold , the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened :
translation.kha: Hadien kane nga la ïohi ïa ka templ ha bneng ba ka plie , lem bad ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Blei hapoh jong ka .

translation.en: That make a man an offender for a word , and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate , and turn aside the just for a thing of nought .
translation.kha: U Blei un pynjot ïa kito kiba kren sniew ïa kiwei , kito kiba khanglad ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa ki riewrunar , bad kito kiba kren lamler ban khang ïa ki briew kiba hok ban ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me , then I will punish you seven times more for your sins .
translation.kha: Lada wat hadien kat kane phim treh satia ban shahshkor ïa nga , ngan pynshitom jur ïa phi sa hynñiew shah .

translation.en: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha kaba pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  dei ban pynlong ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong .

Da kohnguh hok ïasngap ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi k ka Kular , Madmannah phin ïoh im , phin roi Pa’ larkam phin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba Athens Trai u la kular ha ki Senas tymmen jingjia phi .
translation.en: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do , that ye may live , and multiply , and go in and possess the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers .

translation.kha: Baroh ki dih khuri jingdih jong u ki Solomon long kiba la shna ka da ksiar , bad baroh ki khiew ki pliang ha ka Kamra heh jong Khlaw ka Lebanon ki long kiba da ka ksiar nylla . Ym shym pyndonkam da ka rupa , namar kam shym long kaba la ñiewkordor ha ki sngi u Solomon .
translation.en: And all king Solomon s drinking vessels were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold  ; none were of silver : it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go in unto Pharaoh : for I have hardened his heart , and the heart of his servants , that I might shew these my signs before him :
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie leit sha u Pharaoh . Nga la pynmutlop ïa u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , khnang ba nga lah ban leh ïa kine ki kambah hapdeng jong ki ,

translation.en: And Abraham said , Because I thought , Surely the fear of God is not in this place  ; and they will slay me for my wife s sake .
translation.kha: U Abraham u jubab ,  Nga la pyrkhat ba yn ym don hangne kiba sheptieng burom ïa U Blei , ba kumta kin pynïap ïa nga ban ïoh ïa ka tnga jong nga .

translation.en: Then saith Jesus unto them ,  All ye shall be offended because of me this night : for it is written , I will smite the shepherd , and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ha kane hi ka miet phi baroh phin ïaphet noh bad iehnoh ïa nga , naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un pynïap ïa u nongaplangbrot , bad ïa ki langbrot jong ka kynhun yn pynsakma .’

translation.en: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter  ; it is furbished that it may glitter : should we then make mirth ? it contemneth the rod of my son , as every tree .
translation.kha: La pynnep ïa ka ban pynïap , la pynphyrnai ba kan thaba kum ka leilieh . Kan ym don ka jinglehkmen , naba ki briew jong nga ki la leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingmaham bad jingpynshitom baroh .

Bad u la ïai kren ha ki , To khmih bha bad sumar ïa lade na kano kano ka jait jinglalot ; namar ba ïa ka jingim bashisha jong u briew ym la kiei kiei kiba don , kam pher haduh u lah ban long uba riewspah .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Take heed , and beware of covetousness : for a man s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth .
And the priest shall see the raw flesh , and pronounce him to be unclean : for the raw flesh is unclean : it is a leprosy .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa u , bad lada u ïohi ïa ka prum , un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid . Ka prum ka pyn-i ba ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad uta u briew u long u bymkhuid .

translation.en: And thy issue , which thou begettest after them , shall be thine , and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance .
translation.kha: Lada men dang ïoh khun shuh nalor jong ki , kita kin ym dei ki jong nga ; kano kano ka bynta kaba kin ïohpateng kan wan na u Ephraim bad u Manasseh .
bad u Elisha u ong ha u un pynkhreh ban siat . U syiem u leh kumta , bad u Elisha buh la ki kti ha ki kti u syiem
translation.en: And he said to the king of Israel , Put thine hand upon the bow . And he put his hand upon it : and Elisha put his hands upon the king s hands .
The one preach Christ of contention , not sincerely , supposing to add affliction to my bonds :
translation.kha: Kine ki leh kumta na ka jingieit , namar ki tip ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa ka kam ban ïada ïa ka gospel .

translation.en: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria , saying , The nations which thou hast removed , and placed in the cities of Samaria , know not the manner of the God of the land : therefore he hath sent lions among them , and , behold , they slay them , because they know not the manner of the God of the land .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ïa u patsha ka Assyria ba ki briew kiba u la pynshongduh ha ki nongbah ka Samaria kim shym la tip ïa ki aiñ jong u blei jong kata ka ri , bad kumta u blei u la phah ïa ki sing , kiba la pynïap ïa ki .
jynsur un wallam pat Elishah ki briew babun sha U Trai U Blei jong ki ryntih
translation.en: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God .

At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened , when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt : and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her : as for her , a cloud shall cover her , and her daughters shall go into captivity .
translation.kha: Ka jingdum kan tap ïa ka Tahpanhes haba ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong ka Ijipt bad ngan pynkut ïa ka jingkhlaiñ kaba ki sngewsarong palat . U lyoh un kah ïa ka Ijipt , bad ki briew jong ki nongbah jong ka baroh kin shah ïalam kum ki koidi .

translation.en: Be afflicted , and mourn , and weep : let your laughter be turned to mourning , and your joy to heaviness .
translation.kha: To leh sngewsih , to ïam , bad to ïamkthang ; to pynlong ïa ka jingrkhie ban kylla sha ka jingïam , ka jingkmen sha ka jingsngewdiaw !

translation.en: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them , and overcame them , and prevailed against them , so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded .
translation.kha: Uta u briew uba la don u mynsiem bymman u la tur puk sha ki da ka jinglehbor kaba haduh katta ba u la jop ïa ki baroh . Ki la phet noh na ka ïing jong u , kiba la mynsaw bad ha ki jaiñ kiba la shah tar .

translation.en: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel , whose name was called Belteshazzar  ; and the thing was true , but the time appointed was long : and he understood the thing , and had understanding of the vision .
translation.kha: ( Ha ka snem kaba lai kaba u Syros u long u patsha jong ka Persia , ïa ka khubor la pynpaw ha u Daniel , ïa uba la khot ruh u Belteshassar . Ka khubor ka long kaba shisha hynrei kaba jwat eh ban sngewthuh . La batai ïa ka ha u ha ka jingïohipaw . )

translation.en: And it came to pass , when they were gone over , that Elijah said unto Elisha , Ask what I shall do for thee , before I be taken away from thee . And Elisha said , I pray thee , let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me .
translation.kha: Hangta , u Elijah u ong ha u Elisha ,  To ong ha nga kaei me kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong me ha shuwa ba yn shim noh ïa nga .   Ai ngan ïohpdiang ïa ka bhah jong ka bor jong phi ka ban pynlong ïa nga u nongmih bujli jong phi ,  u Elisha u jubab .
Lada ngam ïoh ïa ka lad ban kren , ngan bthei kum ka lwa snieh kaba dap da ka bathymmai .
translation.en: Behold , my belly is as wine which hath no vent  ; it is ready to burst like new bottles .
Thus speaketh the  Lord  God of Israel , saying , Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book .
translation.kha: u la ong ha nga :  To thoh ha ka kitab ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga la ong ha me ,
un hynrei ym pynslem ban pynshitom ïa kito kiba isih ïa u .
translation.en: And repayeth them that hate him to their face , to destroy them : he will not be slack to him that hateth him , he will repay him to his face .

translation.kha: ki la poi ha ka ri Kanaan u Abram u ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri haduh ba da poi ha u dieng kyntang jong u Moreh , ka ha Shekhem . ( kata ka por , Kanaan ki don ha ka ri . )
translation.en: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Shechem , unto the plain of Moreh . And the Canaanite was then in the land .
And the word of the  Lord  came to Elijah the Tishbite , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa ,
Bad U Jisu u la pynkut Shibun , la khot sngewbha , hynrei khyndiat la jied .
translation.en: For many are called , but few are chosen .

And when the year was expired , king Nebuchadnezzar sent , and brought him to Babylon , with the goodly vessels of the house of the  Lord  , and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Haba ka pyrem ka la poi , u syiem Nebukhadnessar u ïalam ïa u Jehoïakhin sha Babilon kum u koidi , bad u rah lang ïa ki jingkynshew jong ka Templ . Nangta u Nebukhadnessar u pynlong ïa u Sedekaïah u kñi jong u Jehoïakhin kum u syiem ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And after he had spent some time there , he departed , and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order , strengthening all the disciples .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la pynlut katto katne por hangta , u la mihnoh bad u la leit lyngba ka thain jong ka Galatia bad Phrygia , da kaba pynkhlaiñ ïa ki parabangeit baroh .

translation.en: Arise ye , and depart  ; for this is not your rest : because it is polluted , it shall destroy you , even with a sore destruction .
translation.kha: To ïeng joit bad mihnoh ; naba ym don shuh ka jingshngain hangne . Ki pop jong phi ki la long jingtim sha ka jingpynjot ïa kane ka jaka .

translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne , to be king for the  Lord  thy God : because thy God loved Israel , to establish them for ever , therefore made he thee king over them , to do judgment and justice .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ! U la pynpaw kaba katno u sngewbha ïa phi da kaba pynlong ïa phi u syiem u ban synshar ha ka kyrteng jong u .
