translation.en: And thou shalt make a veil of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen of cunning work : with cherubims shall it be made :
Their knops and their branches shall be of the same : all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold .
translation.kha: Ki shylluit , ki tnat , bad u diengpynïeng sharak ki dei ban long kiba ïadait lang kawei bad kiba la shu shoh da ka ksiar nylla .

translation.en: And a stone of stumbling , and a rock of offence , even to them which stumble at the word , being disobedient : whereunto also they were appointed .
translation.kha: Bad kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Une u long u maw u ban pynlong ïa ki briew ban jynthut , u mawsiang u ban pynlong ïa ki ba kin kyllon .  Ki la jynthut namar ba kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka ktien , katta ka la long ka mon U Blei ïa ki .

translation.en: And when Silas and Timothy were come from Macedonia , Paul was pressed in the spirit , and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ .
translation.kha: Haba u Silas bad u Timothi ki la poi na Makedonia , u Paul u la pynlut ïa ka por jong u baroh ha kaba ïalap ïa ka khubor , da kaba sakhi ha ki Jiw ba U Jisu u dei U Messaïah .

translation.en: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them , and his hands waxed feeble : anguish took hold of him , and pangs as of a woman in travail .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , bad ki kti jong u ki noh kyrwep . U don ha ka jinglyng-a , da ka jingpang kum ka briew kaba suh kha .

Me shem ba u ïaineh ha me , bad me pynlong ka jingïateh ïuhkjat bad u Lied Me kular ban ai Jair u ïa ïaboi ri ki Rekem , ka Jingot jong ki Hit bad khatsaw Amor , ka ri ki hylla , ki Ar bad ki brup jingpeitbha elders long ka ri ha kaba ki khun ki ksiew jong lbong kin Togarmah kin sah . Me Tabor jing nonglur ka kular Akeldama namar me ba-ishyrkhei uba ïaineh .
translation.en: And foundest his heart faithful before thee , and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites , the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Jebusites , and the Girgashites , to give it , I say , to his seed , and hast performed thy words  ; for thou art righteous :

translation.kha: Namar kaei kaba jia la ha ka Sarah , ka tnga jong u Abraham , U Trai u la pynlyngki ïa ki kynthei baroh ha ka ïingsyiem jong u Abimelekh . Kumta u Abraham u duwai na ka bynta u Abimelekh , bad U Blei u pynkhiah la ïa u . U la ruh pynkhiah ïa ka tnga jong u , bad ki ïa mraw kynthei jong u , kumta ba ki ruh ki lah ban ïoh khun .
translation.en: For the  Lord  had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech , because of Sarah Abraham s wife .
For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears : we would know therefore what these things mean .
translation.kha: Katto katne kiei kiei kiba ngi ïohsngew ba me kren ki long kiba sngewphylla ïa ngi , bad ngi kwah ban tip aïu ki kit jingmut .
Kaba ban ïohnong da ka bymhok , ka pynngat ïa la ka longïing ha ka jingjynjar . bamsap bad phin im slem .
translation.en: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house  ; but he that hateth gifts shall live .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la ang ïa Ruphos ka shyntur , bad u la ai ha nga ïa ka kot kli ban bam lypa
translation.en: So I opened my mouth , and he caused me to eat that roll .

Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem , in the second month , began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites , and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem  ; and appointed the Levites , from twenty years old and upward , to set forward the work of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ha u bnai ba ar jong ka snem hadien ba ki la wan pat sha ka jaka jong ka Templ ha Jerusalem , ki sdang ban ïatrei . U Serubbabel , u Joshua bad kiwei pat ki para rangbah ka ri , ki lyngdoh , bad ki Lebi , ha ka jingshisha , baroh kiba shah ringmraw kiba la wan phai pat sha Jerusalem , ki la ïasnohkti lang ha ka jingtrei . Ïa baroh ki Lebi kiba la dap arphew snem ka rta lane tam , la buh ban khmih ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka Templ .
Kumno keiñ ngan long uba khlaiñbor haduh katta u Hasael u kylli Ngam long ei ei ! U Elisha u phai , U u la pynpaw ha nga ba men long u syiem ka Syria .
translation.en: And Hazael said , But what , is thy servant a dog , that he should do this great thing ? And Elisha answered , The  Lord  hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria .
( For not the hearers of the law are just before God , but the doers of the law shall be justified .
translation.kha: Naba ym dei da kaba ïohsngew ïa ka Hukum ba ki briew ki don ka jingïadei bad U Blei , hynrei da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .

U la tei jingthain ka kat kum ki jingbthah ba u Moses , Shu shakri jong U Trai u la ai krai ki Israel , kumba la thoh ha ka Hukum u Moses jingïathmu Ka duwan ba la tei da jaw maw ki bym shym la shtah da dadien tiar nar . Halor jong ka ki la thang ïa ki Nongleitkurim ha U Trai , bad lyngngun Soitan ainguh ruh Heldai ki jingainguh ïasyllok .
translation.en: As Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded the children of Israel , as it is written in the book of the law of Moses , an altar of whole stones , over which no man hath lift up any iron : and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the  Lord  , and sacrificed peace offerings .
When thy wares went forth out of the seas , thou filledst many people  ; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise .
translation.kha: Haba ki mar khaïi jong pha ki leit shabar ri , pha pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki hima baroh . la pynriewspah ïa ki syiem da ka spah jong ki mar jong pha .

translation.en: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills , and from the multitude of mountains : truly in the  Lord  our God is the salvation of Israel .
translation.kha: Ngim shym la ïoh jingïarap ei ei da ka jingmane jong ngi ka bym dei ïa me halor ki kliar lum . Ka jingïarap ïa ki Israel ka wan tang na U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: So he went with them . And when they came to Jordan , they cut down wood .
translation.kha: Ynda ki poi ha Jordan , ki la sdang ïa ka kam .

translation.en: Then I said , I will not make mention of him , nor speak any more in his name . But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones , and I was weary with forbearing , and I could not stay .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba nga ong ,  Ngan klet noh ïa U  Trai bad ngan ym kren shuh ha ka kyrteng jong u ,  te ka khubor jong me ka long kum ka ding kaba klang jylliew hapoh jong nga . Nga la pyrshang kat kaba nga lah ban kun ïa ka , hynrei ngam lah ban bat ïa ka .

translation.en: But these speak evil of those things which they know not : but what they know naturally , as brute beasts , in those things they corrupt themselves .
translation.kha: Hynrei , kine ki briew , ki tur ïaleh da kaba krenbeiñ da kiei kiei kiba kim sngewthuh ; bad kito kiei kiei kiba ki tip da ka bor tipthuh kum ki mradkhlaw , ki long kita hi kiei kiei kiba pynjot ïa ki .

Un jingsheptieng ïa ki Job hapdeng NGA suiñbneng pyllait hapdeng ki bor bakhraw hajan bad hajngai patsha Kin shoh tyrnem Aram la ki waitlam ban pynlong ki lyngkor bad Mispeh ki Mitylene sha ki wait pdem tnat dieng . syiemsad jaitbynriew kin ym ïaleh jingjulor babun , kin ym pynkhreh shuh ban riewkai thma ïadei
translation.en: And he shall judge among many people , and rebuke strong nations afar off  ; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruninghooks : nation shall not lift up a sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .
Do not err , my beloved brethren .
translation.kha: To wat shah shukor , phi ki parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga !

Nangta ki .—Isaiah ha u ïa kane ka khana : riewpoh , ngi la thyllah na Khlem Dan kaba jngai , namar ngi la Jngai shaphang U Trai Amaw Blei jong jingpunkhun . Ngi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u la leh ha Ijipt
translation.en: And they said unto him , From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the  Lord  thy God : for we have heard the fame of him , and all that he did in Egypt ,

translation.kha: ïa ka jingthmu kaba nga pyrshah ïa ki briew ka Edom , bad ïa kaba nga thmu ban leh ïa ki jong ka nongbah Teman . ïa ki yn paring ïa ki , bad uwei pa uwei un sngewtriem .
translation.en: Therefore hear the counsel of the  Lord  , that he hath taken against Edom  ; and his purposes , that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman : Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out : surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them .
And they cast lots , as well the small as the great , according to the house of their fathers , for every gate .
translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka longïing , la ka heh ne ka rit , ka kynting sbai ban tip ïa kano ka khyrdop ka kitkhlieh .

translation.en: But to the land whereunto they desire to return , thither shall they not return .
translation.kha: Men thrang ban ïohi ïa kane ka ri sa shisien pat , hynrei men ym ïoh wan phai shuh .

te Kumta , dei ban kup ïa lade naba , phi long ki briew jong U Blei ; u la ieit bad jied ïa phi na ka bynta jong u hi , da ka jingsngewsynei , ka jingbhasbun , jingsngewrit ka , ka jingjemnud , bad ka jingïaishah .
translation.en: Put on therefore , as the elect of God , holy and beloved , bowels of mercies , kindness , humbleness of mind , meekness , longsuffering ;

translation.kha: khapnap pat , uta u briew u la ïalam ïa Pynshahshkor taïew bangeit liang kaba shathie , bad hangta ngi la ïohi sa ïa kti! pat ka khyrdop . U la thew ïa ki Joel bashapoh bad ïatim ka ïa-bta rung jong ka , bad ka la long Sikhri kum kito kiwei pat .
translation.en: After that he brought me toward the south , and behold a gate toward the south : and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures .

translation.kha: U syiem Ahab , u la hiar sha madan , u la knieh ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad u jop thiaw ïa ki nong Syria .
translation.en: And the king of Israel went out , and smote the horses and chariots , and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter .

translation.kha: Wat klet ïa Apphia jutang U Blei , kaba u Ïaid pynlong Bethbarah neh pynsyier jingkyrpad
translation.en: Be ye mindful always of his covenant  ; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations  ;

translation.kha: U Trai u Nongsynshar ong , Ngan wallam ïa u syiem bakhraw tam na — baroh u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia ban — tur ïaleh ïa ka Tyros . Un wan na shaphang shatei bad ryngkat ka kynhun shipai babun , lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom bad ki nongshong kulai .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will bring upon Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , a king of kings , from the north , with horses , and with chariots , and with horsemen , and companies , and much people .
And he stood , and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice , saying ,
translation.kha: Da ka sur kaba jam u pan ki jingkyrkhu na U Blei halor u paidbah baroh uba ïalumlang hangta .
U lumlang ïa baroh ki duriaw-rit ha kawei ka jaka ; u khang ïa ki jingjylliew duriaw-bah ka ha ki ïing jingkynshew .
translation.en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap : he layeth up the depth in storehouses .
Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight : for by the law is the knowledge of sin .
translation.kha: Naba ym don uno uno ruh uba hok ha khmat U Blei da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ; kaei kaba ka Hukum ka leh ka long ban pynlong ïa u briew ban tip ba u la leh pop .

translation.en: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him , seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u long uba lah , mynta bad borabor , ban pynim ïa kita kiba wan sha U Blei da u , namar u im junom ban ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: And he tarried seven days , according to the set time that Samuel had appointed : but Samuel came not to Gilgal  ; and the people were scattered from him .
translation.kha: U la ap hynñiew sngi ïa u Samuel , kumba u Samuel u la bthah ïa u ban leh , hynrei u Samuel um pat shym wan poi sha Gilgal .
U Jephthah u phah riewdum biang sha u syiem Ammon
translation.en: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon :
Jesus saith unto her ,  Thy brother shall rise again .
translation.kha: U para jong pha un sa im pat ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ka .

translation.en: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you : but are there not with you , even with you , sins against the  Lord  your God ?
translation.kha: Bad mynta phi thmu sa ban pynlong ïa ki shynrang bad kynthei jong ka Jerusalem bad Judah ki mraw jong phi . Hato phim tip ba phi ruh phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong phi ?

translation.en: But if I do , though ye believe not me , believe the works : that ye may know , and believe , that the Father is in me , and I in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada nga leh ïa ki , wat lada phim ngeit ïa nga , phi la dei ban ngeit ïa ki kam jong nga , khnang ba phi lah ban tip shi syn tip ba U Kpa u long ha nga bad ba nga long ha U Kpa .

translation.en: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the  Lord  of all your tithes , which ye receive of the children of Israel  ; and ye shall give thereof the  Lord s  heave offering to Aaron the priest .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom phi ruh phin wanrah kumjuh ïa ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  na baroh kaba shiphew ba phi ïohpdiang na ki Israel . Phin ai ïa kane ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang na ka bynta U  Trai  ha u Aaron u lyngdoh .

translation.en: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies , and the house of Israel with deceit : but Judah yet ruleth with God , and is faithful with the saints .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki la ker sawdong ïa nga da ki jinglamler bad jingshukor , bad ki paid Judah ki dang ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , U Blei baïaineh bad uba khuid .

translation.en: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom : but within few days he shall be destroyed , neither in anger , nor in battle .
translation.kha: Yn bud ïa u da uwei pat u syiem , u ban phah ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam ban banbeiñ ïa ki briew da ki khajna na ka bynta ban pynroi ïa ka spah jong ka hima jong u . Tang khyndiat por ïa uta u syiem yn pynïap , hynrei ym ha kaba paw bad ym ha ka thma .
Kine da-ei long kthang kyrteng jong ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Judah bad Simeon ïa kiba la ai
translation.en: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah , and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon , these cities which are here mentioned by name ,
Therefore shall ye keep my commandments , and do them : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta phin sumar bad leh ïa ki hukum jong nga : nga long U  Trai .
Hynrei lada kim treh ïasuk , bad ki ïaleh pyrshah pynban ïa phi , kerkut ïa ka .
translation.en: And if it will make no peace with thee , but will make war against thee , then thou shalt besiege it :

translation.kha: Haba Sargon ktah jur sa Bneng sep U Jisu u jaw leit kliang ka jingtep ibieit kaba long ka krem ba la khang da u khyndew .
translation.en: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave . It was a cave , and a stone lay upon it .

translation.kha: Ka ïing jong pha ka long ka duriaw . Ki jong nongtei pha ki la shna ïa pha kum ka liengbah kaba itynnat ;
translation.en: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas , thy builders have perfected thy beauty .

translation.kha: U syiem Solomon don u saw hajar tylli ki sem kulai na ka bynta ki kali ïapom bad ki kulai jong u , bad u khat-ar don hajar tylli ki kulai . thma Katto katne na ki u buh ha Jerusalem bad ïa kiba sah u buh ha kiwei pat ki nongbah .
translation.en: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen  ; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities , and with the king at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ki ïaid ïa 26 ba kito kiba dang im bad kiba la poi biang ha la ka jong ka ri , ki don hapdeng ka jingkhlaiñbor bakhraw bad ba ki nongwei kiba shong basah marjan , ki peitbeiñ ïa ki . Ki ïathuh ruh ïa nga ba rngai kynroh ka Jerusalem ki la pra bad ba ïa ki khyrdop ym shym la pynbha pat naduh ka por ba la thang ïa Gederothaim .
translation.en: And they said unto me , The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach : the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down , and the gates thereof are burned with fire .
And when Elisha was come into the house , behold , the child was dead , and laid upon his bed .
translation.kha: Haba u Elisha u la poi , u la leit marwei shapoh ka kamra bad u la ïohi ïa u khynnah ba u thiah ïap halor ka jingthiah .

translation.en: He went to Pilate , and begged the body of Jesus . Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered .
translation.kha: U la leit sha u Pilat bad u la pan ïa ka met U Jisu . U Pilat u la hukum ban ai ïa ka met ha u Joseph .
Buh ïa ki ka , bad ïa ki nga ha ka por ba me kñia ïa uta u masi bad ïa ki tylli ki langbrot shynrang .
translation.en: And thou shalt put them into one basket , and bring them in the basket , with the bullock and the two rams .

translation.kha: Issakhar u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Tola , u Puah , u , bad u Shimron .
translation.en: Now the sons of Issachar were , Tola , and Puah , Jashub , and Shimron , four .

translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh uba kamai ïa kaba khwai ha ka Nile ud bad un ïam ; khwai bad ki jar jong ki kin long ki bymmyntoi shuh .
translation.en: The fishers also shall mourn , and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament , and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish .

translation.kha: u Ynda syiem Solomon u la dep tei ïa ka ïing U Trai bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , nalor kiwei pat kiba u la kwah ban , tei
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house , and all Solomon s desire which he was pleased to do ,

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kiba na ka jait Lebi baroh kim dei ïohpateng ei ei ka khyndew kumba long ki para ; ha ka jaka kata , kin ïoh ka bam tang na jingainguh bad pat ki jingkñia ainguh sha U Trai
translation.en: The priests the Levites , and all the tribe of Levi , shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel : they shall eat the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and his inheritance .

And the cart came into the field of Joshua , a Beth–shemite , and stood there , where there was a great stone : and they clave the wood of the cart , and offered the kine a burnt offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kata ka kali ka wan sha ka lyngkha jong u briew uba kyrteng u Joshua , uba shong ha Beth Shemesh , bad ka sangeh hajan u mawbah . Kita ki briew ki pom lyngkhot ïa kata ka kali dieng , ki pynïap ïa kita ki masi kynthei bad ki kñia ïa ki kum ka jingainguh thang ha U  Trai .

translation.en: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me , neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions  ; but that they may be my people , and I may be their God , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kane ban da ïa ki Israel na kaba klet noh ïa nga bad pynjakhlia ïa lade da ki pop jong ki . Ki dei ban long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: But they have not all obeyed the gospel . For Esaias saith , Lord , who hath believed our report ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ym baroh ki la pdiang ïa ka Khubor Babha . U Isaïah da lade hi u la ong ,  A Trai , uei uba la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong ngi ?
u la die ïa ka lyngkha ba u long trai , u la wallam ïa bymdondor pisa , bad u la ai ha ki apostol .
translation.en: Having land , sold it , and brought the money , and laid it at the apostles  feet .

translation.kha: Kaei kaei kaba jia lane kaba Hesron ban kyrthep ka la hakhlieh jia imat . U Blei u pynlong ïa Jingpynshitom ban jia bad ïai jia .
translation.en: That which hath been is now  ; and that which is to be hath already been  ; and God requireth that which is past .

And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the  Lord  , and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the  Lord . So he finished the house .
translation.kha: Lai sien shisnem , u Solomon u kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh pynïasuk ha kata ka duwan ba u la tei ha U  Trai . U thang ruh ïa ka jingiwbih ha khmat U  Trai . Bad kumta u pyndep kaba tei ïa ka Templ .

To phah ïa u paidbhur ban jingkhapnap ïa pynpra ïing jong ki khlem ka jingmaham ; pynlong barieh ki te kyang ha jubab jingshyrkhei Sa Ki la tih ka thliew na ka bynta jong nga ban hap ha ka bad ki la pynap ki jingriam ban pynngat ïa phlang .
translation.en: Let a cry be heard from their houses , when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them : for they have digged a pit to take me , and hid snares for my feet .

translation.kha: Me la peit bniah ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ? U Trai kylli Ym don uno uno ha ka uba ïaineh bad uba bha kat ma u . U mane ïa nga bad u kiar ban ym leh kano kaba sniew .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ?
But that ye also may know my affairs , and how I do , Tychicus , a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord , shall make known to you all things :
translation.kha: U Tukhikos u long u parabangeit ba-ieit jong ngi , bad u shakri baïaineh ha ka kam U Trai , un ïathuh lut ïa ka khubor shaphang jong nga , khnang ba phin tip kumno nga ïaid shaphrang .

translation.en: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king : only the spoil thereof , and the cattle thereof , shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves : lay thee an ambush for the city behind it .
translation.kha: Men leh ïa ka Ai bad ïa u syiem jong ka kumba me la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad u syiem jong ka , hynrei ha kane ka sien me lah ban bat ha lade ïa ki mar ki mata bad ïa ki jingri jong ka na ka bynta ïa lade . Pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah da ka jingkyndit na lyndet jong ka .

u la kñia ki jingainguh thang kat kum ka jingdawa jong ka Hukum u Moses na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka sngi kaba khuid : ki Sabbaton , ki Jingkhawai Niam Thymmai Bnai , bad lai ki tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam kiba man ka snem — ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ka Niam Jingkhawai ka Jingot , bad ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translation.en: Even after a certain rate every day , offering according to the commandment of Moses , on the sabbaths , and on the new moons , and on the solemn feasts , three times in the year , even in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles .
And as thy servant was busy here and there , he was gone . And the king of Israel said unto him , So shall thy judgment be  ; thyself hast decided it .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la bunkam bad kiwei pat ki kam , kumta uta u briew u lait noh .  U syiem u jubab ,  Phi la pynbna hi ïa ka rai , bad phin hap siew ïa ka kuna .

translation.en: Which shaketh the earth out of her place , and the pillars thereof tremble .
translation.kha: U Blei u phah ïa ki jumai bad u pynkhynñiuh ïa ka khyndew ; u kynjrat ïa ki païa kiba kyrshan ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it : whithersoever it turneth , it prospereth .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba pyrkhat ba kaba pynbam sap ka treikam kum ka myntor ; ki ngeit ba ka lah ban leh lut ïa kiei kiei .
Kito kiba thmu kin don ha ka jingkyndit thret , hynrei kito kiba trei na ka bynta kaba bha kin ïa ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil : but to the counsellors of peace is joy .

translation.kha: Haba uta u samla u ïohi ba u Saul u la ïap , u ruh u rynsied ïa lade ha ka la waitlam bad u lem ïap bad u Saul .
translation.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead , he fell likewise upon his sword , and died with him .
Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion : the same is the city of David .
translation.kha: ( Hynrei u Dabid u la ïohknieh ïa ka kut Seïon jong ki , bad la tip kyrteng ïa ka kum ka  Nongbah u Dabid .  )

Ong ïa ki Israel Debir ma nga , Shahasumah Trai , U Blei Mamre ki kpa tymmen jong ki khim bahaïing Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob , u la phah bhah Dong sha ki . Kane ka long ka kyrteng jong nga junom la jingdro dewbyrtha kumne ruh ki pateng bynriew ki basah dang wan ki dei tad khot ïa snieh .
translation.en: And God said moreover unto Moses , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , The  Lord  God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , hath sent me unto you : this is my name for ever , and this is my memorial unto all generations .
And the  Lord  hardened the heart of Pharaoh , and he hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had spoken unto Moses .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh bad , kumba u la lah ong , u Pharaoh um shym shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
Kumta ki briew ki Asriel shong ha ki laiñ , ha ngam shongkhlad bashispah ngut bad durblei kynhun basanphew ngut .
translation.en: And they sat down in ranks , by hundreds , and by fifties .

Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite , and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah , brother to Joab , saying , Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp ? And Abishai said , I will go down with thee .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u kylli ïa u Ahimelekh u nong Hit bad ïa u Abishai u para u Joab , ( ka kmie jong ki ka dei ka Seruïah ) ,  Mano napdeng jong phi ar ngut ban leit bad nga sha ka jaka shong dara u Saul ?   Ma nga ,  u Abishai u jubab .

translation.en: Go your ways : behold , I send you forth as lambs among wolves .
translation.kha: Khie leit ! Nga phah ïa phi kum ki khunlangbrot hapdeng ki suri .

translation.en: And he said unto her , What form is he of ? And she said , An old man cometh up  ; and he is covered with a mantle . And Saul perceived that it was Samuel , and he stooped with his face to the ground , and bowed himself .
translation.kha: Ka dur jong ka kaba kumno ?  u kylli .  Dei u tymmen uba wan mih ,  ka jubab .  U kup da ka barandi .  Kumta u Saul u tip ba uta u dei u Samuel , bad u dem ngon haduh khyndew da ka jingburom .

U Hilkaïah , u Ahikam u , , Akhbor u Shaphan bad , u Asaïah , ki leit ban kylli na ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Huldah , ka nongïathuhlypa , kaba shong ba sah ha ka jaka ba kham thymmai jong ka Jerusalem . ( U Shallum u tnga jong ka , u khun u jong Tikbah bad u ksiew jong u Harhas , uba dei khmih ïa ki barandi ka Templ ) . Ki batai ha , ka ïa kaei kaba la jia ,
translation.en: So Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam , and Achbor , and Shaphan , and Asaiah , went unto Huldah the prophetess , the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah , the son of Harhas , keeper of the wardrobe  ; ( now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college  ; ) and they communed with her .

translation.kha: u Paul , u U Khrist Jisu ka mon U Blei ha uba la phah pynbna ïa jingim ba la kular kaba ngi don ha U Khrist —
translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus ,

translation.kha: Uno uno uba dei ban shah kem un shah kem da shisha ; uno uno kamra dei ban shah ïuhkjat da ka waitlam un shah pynïap shisha da jingstad waitlam Khatwei sai Ephron dawa ïa Krist jingïaishah bad ïa ka jingngeit na ka liang jong ki briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity : he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword . Here is the patience and the faith of the saints .

translation.kha: Te nga la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u syiem Sedekaïah khappud Jerusalem ñiakha ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem ka Babilonia ka dang tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah .
translation.en: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem ,
A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches , and loving favour rather than silver and gold .
translation.kha: Lada phi dei ban jied hapdeng ka nam babha bad ka spah kaba khraw , jied ïa ka nam babha .

translation.en: In the first chariot were red horses  ; and in the second chariot black horses  ;
translation.kha: Ïa ka kali ïapom kaba nyngkong la tan da ki kulai rong saw , ïa kaba ar da ki kulai rong ïong ,

translation.en: So Joshua took the whole land , according to all that the  Lord  said unto Moses  ; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes . And the land rested from war .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la kurup ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses . U Joshua u la ai ïa ka ha ki Israel kum ka jong ki hi bad u la pynbynta ïa ka ha ki lyngkhot , kawei kawei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait . Kumta ki paidbah ki la shongthait na ka thma .
Hynrei kum ka tnga ka bymïaineh , pham shym la ïaineh nga ha . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband , so have ye dealt treacherously with me , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord .
Yet will I bring an heir unto thee , O inhabitant of Mareshah : he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Mareshah , U  Trai  un aiti noh ïa phi ha u nongshun , u ban kurup ïa ka shnong jong phi . Ki nongïalam ka Israel kin leit bad rieh ha ka krem ha Adullam .

translation.en: And he asked them of their welfare , and said , Is your father well , the old man of whom ye spake ? Is he yet alive ?
translation.kha: U la kylli shaphang ka jingkoit jingkhiah jong ki bad u ong ,  Phi la ïathuh ha nga shaphang i pa jong phi , iba la tymmen — i long kumno ? I dang im , bad i shait i khlaiñ bha ?
hynrei uno uno u mraw ba phi u ban bam ïa ka lada phi otsher shuwa ïa u .
translation.en: But every man s servant that is bought for money , when thou hast circumcised him , then shall he eat thereof .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa ka um bad sait ïa ka snam na . pha Nga kyllan umphniang Olib halor ka sniehdoh jong pha .
translation.en: Then washed I thee with water  ; yea , I thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee , and I anointed thee with oil .
I say therefore to the unmarried and widows , It is good for them if they abide even as I .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha kiba khlem shongkurim bad ha ki riewkynthei nga ong ba ka kan kham bha ïa phi ban shong marwei kum ma nga .
Ki teh ïa ka ha khmat ka jaiñspong da u ksai uba jngum , kumba ha-sem Trai ainguh ïap! hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: And they tied unto it a lace of blue , to fasten it on high upon the mitre  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
Judah is a lion s whelp : from the prey , my son , thou art gone up : he stooped down , he couched as a lion , and as an old lion  ; who shall rouse him up ?
translation.kha: U Judah u long kum u sing , Haba u la pynïap ïa uba u thmu u leit phai sha la krem ; Hangta u dem , bad u thiah . Uei uba nud ban pynthut ïa u ?

translation.en: And I , brethren , when I came to you , came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom , declaring unto you the testimony of God .
translation.kha: Haba nga la wan sha phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ban ïalap ïa ka jingshisha barieh jong U Blei , ngam shym la pyndonkam da ki kyntien kiba eh bad ka jingtip kaba khraw .

translation.en: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning  ; lo , he goeth out unto the water  ; and thou shalt stand by the river s brink against he come  ; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand .
translation.kha: Kumta khie leit bad ïakynduh ïa u mynstep ha ka por ba u leit hiar sha ka wah Nile . Rah bad me ïa u diengduh ïa uba la pynkylla bseiñ , bad ap ïa u harud wah .

translation.en: And when the Philistine looked about , and saw David , he disdained him : for he was but a youth , and ruddy , and of a fair countenance .
translation.kha: U ïai wan kham sha jan , bad haba u la ïohi shai ïa u Dabid , u la dap da ka jingbitar shla ïa u namar ba u long tang u khynnah uba saw ngab , uba phyrnai khmat .

translation.en: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward .
translation.kha: Kumta u la sdang bishni bad suba sniew ïa u Dabid naduh kata ka sngi .
Dang step phyrngab ka sngi kaba bud , ki briew ka ki la ïohi ïa u mot jong u Dagon ba u la kyllon da pyllup ha madan ha khmat ka ka Jutang U . Kumta ki khyllie bad biang u ha kajuh ka .
translation.en: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow , behold , Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the  Lord . And they took Dagon , and set him in his place again .
And daily in the temple , and in every house , they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Bad man ka sngi hapoh ka Templ bad ha ki ïing jong ki briew ki ïai bteng ban hikai bad ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu U Messaïah .

translation.en: And when the time was that Elkanah offered , he gave to Peninnah his wife , and to all her sons and her daughters , portions :
translation.kha: Man ka por ba u Elkanah u kñia ainguh , u ju ai shi bynta na ka doh ha ka Peninnah bad shi bynta ha uwei pa uwei na ki khun ki kti jong ka .

translation.en: Will ye accept his person ? will ye contend for God ?
translation.kha: Hato me pyrshang ban ïada ïa u ? Hato men leit ban ïasaid ïa ka kam jong u ha ka ïingbishar ?

translation.en: And he shall wave the sheaf before the  Lord  , to be accepted for you : on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it .
translation.kha: Uta un kaweh ïa kata ka song kum ka jingainguh kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  , khnang ba yn pdiang ïa phi . Uta u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba bud ïa ka Sabbaton .
Lada kum kita kiei kiei ki jia , hato phin leit rah ïa ki ban pynbeit da ki briew bym ki nongrim don ha ka balang ?
translation.en: If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life , set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church .

translation.kha: Shibun ïa jingngeit jong ki kata por ; kin ïashetkylla iwei ïa iwei pat bad isih ïa pat .
translation.en: And then shall many be offended , and shall betray one another , and shall hate one another .

translation.kha: U Gideon u leit phai nongïathuh sha la ïing Engedi u shongduh hangta .
translation.en: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house .

translation.kha: Mynba nga Rephah khmih , kata jingker-ïada reng ka pynlong thma bad ki briew prat U Linos bad ka la jop ïa ki .
translation.en: I beheld , and the same horn made war with the saints , and prevailed against them  ;

translation.kha: To pyn-i ha nga ïa ka pisa na ka bynta ban siew ïa ka khajna ! Ki la wanrah ha u ïa ka nongaplangbrot thliem
translation.en: Shew me the tribute money .  And they brought unto him a penny .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid harud ka Duriaw Galilaïa , u la ïohi ki ar ngut kiba long ki nongtong , u ( ïa uba la khot u ) bad u para jong u , u Andriw ba dang dohkha ha ka da ka jar .
translation.en: And Jesus , walking by the sea of Galilee , saw two brethren , Simon called Peter , and Andrew his brother , casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .
My beloved is like a roe or a young hart : behold , he standeth behind our wall , he looketh forth at the windows , shewing himself through the lattice .
translation.kha: Ma phi , ko ba-ieit jong nga , to pynskuiñ ïa ki rangbah kumba ka kulai ka pynskuiñ ïa ki kulai jong ki kali ïapom jong u Pharaoh .

translation.en: So I turned and came down from the mount , and the mount burned with fire : and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la phai bad leit hiar na uta u lum , nga da rah ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap ar tylli , ha kiba la thoh ïa ka jutang . Ki thylliej ding ki dang meh ha uta u lum .

translation.en: And he gave them their request  ; but sent leanness into their soul .
translation.kha: kumta u la ai ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki la pan kwah , bad u la phah ruh ïa ka jingpang bashyrkhei hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: A light to lighten the Gentiles , and the glory of thy people Israel .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ban pynpaw ïa ka mon jong me ha ki Jentil bad ban wallam ka burom ha ki briew jong me , ki Israel .

translation.en: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest , and my jealousy shall depart from thee , and I will be quiet , and will be no more angry .
translation.kha: Te ka jingbitar jong nga kan kut bad ngan long jai jai . Ngan ym bitar lane bishni shuh .

translation.en: In that day shall he swear , saying , I will not be an healer  ; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing : make me not a ruler of the people .
translation.kha: Hynrei un jubab ,  Ym ma nga ! Ngam lah ban ïarap ïa phi . Ngam don jingbam ei ei lane ki jaiñ ruh kumjuh . Wat pynlong ïa nga u nongïalam jong phi !

translation.en: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad  ; and a gift destroyeth the heart .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban long uba stad , hynrei lada phi shukor ïano ïano , phi leh la kum u bieit . Lada phi shim klop , phi pynjot ïa la ka jinglong jingim .

translation.en: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death , to guide our feet into the way of peace .
translation.kha: bad ban tyngshaiñ na bneng halor kito baroh kiba im ha ka syrngiew ba-dum jong ka jingïap , ban ïalam ïa ki sien jam jong ngi ha ka lynti jong ka jingsuk .
Kumta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit noh ha ka u Jentil u Titius Justos , uba mane ïa U Blei ; ïing jong ka don ha jong synagog .
translation.en: And he departed thence , and entered into a certain man s house , named Justus , one that worshipped God , whose house joined hard to the synagogue .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong , Hato ym don khat-ar kynta ha ka shi sngi ? Kumta uno uno ïaid uba dang haba shai ka sngi un ym jynthut , naba u ïohi ïa ka jingshai jong kane pyrthei ka .
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Are there not twelve hours in the day ? If any man walk in the day , he stumbleth not , because he seeth the light of this world .
So Abraham returned unto his young men , and they rose up and went together to Beer–sheba  ; and Abraham dwelt at Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: U Abraham u leit phai pat sha la ki shakri , bad ki ïaleit lang sha Beersheba , ha kaba u Abraham u shongneh hangta .

translation.en: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand , and for a memorial between thine eyes , that the  Lord s  law may be in thy mouth : for with a strong hand hath the  Lord  brought thee out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingrakhe kan long ka jingpynkynmaw , kum kaei kaei kaba la teh ha ka kti jong phi ne ha ka shyllangmat jong phi ; kan pynkynmaw ïa phi ban ïai kren bad ïai puson ïa ka Aiñ U  Trai  , namar U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt da ka borbah jong u .

translation.en: And therefore will the  Lord  wait , that he may be gracious unto you , and therefore will he be exalted , that he may have mercy upon you : for the  Lord  is a God of judgment : blessed are all they that wait for him .
translation.kha: Pynban U  Trai  u ap ban leh-isynei ïa phi . U kloi ban sngewlem ïa phi namar u long borabor uba leh ïa kaba dei . Suk kito kiba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong ki ha U  Trai .
kitab Ïa kane Ararat ri Kanah ju tip kum ka ri ki Rephaim , ka kyrteng jong kita ki briew kynthup ju shong hangta . Ki Ammon ki khot Resin pynïashong , ki Samsummim .
translation.en: ( That also was accounted a land of giants : giants dwelt therein in old time  ; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims  ;

And Asa cried unto the  Lord  his God , and said ,  Lord  , it is nothing with thee to help , whether with many , or with them that have no power : help us , O  Lord  our God  ; for we rest on thee , and in thy name we go against this multitude . O  Lord  , thou art our God  ; let not man prevail against thee .
translation.kha: U Asa u duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong u ,  A  Trai  , me lah ban ïarap ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba tlot da kaba suk kum kaba khlaiñ . Ïarap ïa ngi mynta , Ko  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , namar ba ngi shaniah ha me , bad ha ka kyrteng jong me ngi la mih ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa kane ka kynhun shipai kaba bun . A  Trai  , me long U Blei jong ngi ; ym don u ban kyrmen ban jop ïa me .

translation.en: For want and famine they were solitary  ; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste .
translation.kha: Ki la long kiba duk haduh katta katta bad kiba thngan haduh ba ki bam ïa ki thied tyrkhong — mynmiet , ha khlaw , ha ki jaka kynjah .
Kito kiba pyndonburom jynhaw me kin kmen haba ki ïohi ïa nga kitkhlieh namar nga Kish shaniah ha ka jingkular jong me .
translation.en: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me  ; because I have hoped in thy word .
Go therefore now , and work  ; for there shall no straw be given you , yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks .
translation.kha: Mynta khie leit sha la ka kam ! Yn ym ai phlangïap shuh ïa phi , hynrei phi dei ban pynmih katjuh ki maw-it .
Naba Jingthoh ka Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un hukum ïa ki angel jong u ban sumar bha ïa me .’
translation.en: For it is written , He shall give his angels charge over thee , to keep thee :
And ye shall teach them your children , speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jong phi . Ïalap shaphang jong ki haba phi don ha ïing bad haba phi ïaid ha lynti , haba phi shongthait bad haba phi trei phi ktah .
Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha kito ïa kiba me la ai ha nga na ka pyrthei . Ki la long ki jong me , bad me la ai ïa ki ha nga .
translation.en: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world : thine they were , and thou gavest them me  ; and they have kept thy word .

translation.kha: Haba ki Jentil ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , la bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka khubor jong U Trai , bad kito ïa kiba la jied na ka bynta ka jingim ki la long ki .
translation.en: And when the Gentiles heard this , they were glad , and glorified the word of the Lord : and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed .

translation.kha: sngewbishni ud U Trai U Blei jong phi sngew la kyrkhu ïa Ashkelon ha kiei kiei baroh ïeng phi la Pateng .—Mathaios U la sumar sukher ïa phi haba phi ïaid sakma lyngba jingthok ka jingïaseng shyiap kaba ïar Jokhebed U la don ryngkat bad phi ha kine ki sawphew snem , bad phi la ïoh ruh kat Anna kaba phi donkam .
translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand : he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness : these forty years the  Lord  thy God hath been with thee  ; thou hast lacked nothing .

translation.kha: Synagog tip ba shen ngan sa iehnoh ïa kane ka met bapyut kumba U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong Siphmoth u la ïathuh shai ha nga .
translation.en: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle , even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me .
And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him : but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba kren ka kyntien pyrshah ïa U Khun U Briew lah ban map ; hynrei ïa uno uno uba kren kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid yn ym map .

translation.en: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Ka jingduwai jong nga ka long ba ka jingïasyllok jong ngi bad me kum ki bangeit kan wallam ïa ka jingsngewthuh ba kham jylliew ïa ki jingkyrkhu baroh ïa kiba ngi ïoh ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist .

translation.en: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph , and said to him , In my dream , behold , a vine was before me  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u nongrah khuri rangbah u ong ,  Ha ka jingphohsniew jong nga , la don uwei u dieng sohwaiñ ha khmat jong nga , uba don lai tylli ki tnat .
Ka leilieh ka thaba ki na lyoh ,
translation.en: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud : he scattereth his bright cloud :
Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden ?
translation.kha: Hato phi la kut jingmut ban ïaid ha ki lynti kiba ki briew basniew ki ïaid borabor ?
;’ nangta ki duh lut ïa ka ha ki katto katne ki jingïakhaïi basniew bad ki sngewnguh ha ka jingbymdon ei ei shuh ban ai pateng ha la ki khun ki kti .
translation.en: But those riches perish by evil travail : and he begetteth a son , and there is nothing in his hand .
The archers have sorely grieved him , and shot at him , and hated him :
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong u ki tur ïaleh tyngeh ïa u , Bad ki beh ïa u da ki ryntieh bad ki khnam ;
Ïa kine baroh la nongkhmih jingthoh Kalah ki la jop da ka jingngeit ! hynrei kim shym la ïohpdiang jingwan Betharbel kaba Une Blei u la kular .
translation.en: And these all , having obtained a good report through faith , received not the promise :

translation.kha: Hadien ba ka jingkhihwin ka la jem jai , Paul u u la khot lang ïa ki parabangeit bad da ki ktien pynshlur u la khublei bad ïakhlad ki . Nangta u la mihnoh u bad la leit sha Makedonia .
translation.en: And after the uproar was ceased , Paul called unto him the disciples , and embraced them , and departed for to go into Macedonia .

translation.kha: U syiem u leit la rung shapoh ban khmih ïa kiba shah khot sngewbha u bad la ïohi ïa u briew uba khlem phong ki jaiñ shongkurim .
translation.en: And when the king came in to see the guests , he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment :
And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues , and talked with me , saying , Come hither , I will shew thee the bride , the Lamb s wife .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki hynñiew ngut ki angel uba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang kiba dap da ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam kiba khatduh u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,  To wan , bad ngan pyn-i ha me ïa ka Nongleitkurim , ka tnga jong U Khunlangbrot .

translation.en: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick .
translation.kha: Dei ban don uwei u shylluit syntiew hapoh , ha trai jong ki lai jur ki tnat .

translation.en: These are the sons of Ham , after their families , after their tongues , in their countries , and in their nations .
translation.kha: Kine keiñ ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ham kiba shong ha ki ri kiba pher bapher , bad ha la ka jait ka jait kaba kren ïa la ka jong ka jong ka ktien .
