translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ; ki la klet ïa baroh kaba me la leh ; ki la klet noh ïa ki kambah kiba me la leh . Ha ka jingsarong jong ki , ki la jied u nongïalam ban ïalam biang ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt . Hynrei me long U Blei uba map ; me long uba dap da ka jingaiei bad ka jingieit , uba suki ban bitar . Ka jingisynei jong me ka long kaba khraw ; mem shym iehnoh ïa ki .
hynrei katto ngut na u paidbah la , dei u Beelsebul , rangbah jong ki ksuid , uba la ai U ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki .
translation.en: But some of them said , He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils .
And it shall come to pass in that day , I will hear , saith the  Lord  , I will hear the heavens , and they shall hear the earth  ;
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan phah ïa u slap ba un hap ha ka khyndew

Ha Pynshlur ri shyiap nga la pyn-i ïa ka Minnith ïa kito ki briew kiba langsohmoh Obadaïah na Tiglath jingïap . Haba ki paid Israel ki jingwoh thrang ban ïoh ïa ka jingjahthait , nga la paw ha ki na pynban jngai bah .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness  ; even Israel , when I went to cause him to rest .
That then the  Lord  thy God will turn thy captivity , and have compassion upon thee , and will return and gather thee from all the nations , whither the  Lord  thy God hath scattered thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un leh-isynei ïa phi . Un wan ïalam pat ïa phi napdeng kita ki jaitbynriew sha kiba u la pynsakma ïa phi , bad un pynbha pat ïa phi .

translation.en: And this know , that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come , he would have watched , and not have suffered his house to be broken through .
translation.kha: Bad phi lah ban sngewthikna ba lada u trai ïing u la tip ïa ka por haba u nongtuh un wan , un ym shah ïa u nongtuh ban prong shapoh ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: And they shall come against thee with chariots , wagons , and wheels , and with an assembly of people , which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about : and I will set judgment before them , and they shall judge thee according to their judgments .
translation.kha: Kin tur ïaleh ïa pha naphang shatei , da kaba wanrah ïa ka kynhun shipai babun lem bad ki kali ïapom bad ki , ki kali ba-dap kyrhai ka jingbam . Da kaba kieng da ki stieh bad ki jingïada khlieh , kin ker sawdong ïa pha . Ngan aiti ïa pha ha ki , bad kin bishar ïa pha da la ki jong ki aiñ .
khnang ba ym dei shuh ma nga uba im , dei U Khrist uba ha nga . Kane ka jingim kaba nga im mynta , nga im da ka jingngeit ha U U Blei , uba la ieit ïa nga uba la aiti ïa la ka jingim ka bynta jong .
translation.en: I am crucified with Christ : nevertheless I live ; yet not I , but Christ liveth in me : and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God , who loved me , and gave himself for me .

translation.kha: lane leh myntor lane ban ïakren bad ki mynsiem jong kiba la
translation.en: Or a charmer , or a consulter with familiar spirits , or a wizard , or a necromancer .
Command the children of Israel , and say unto them , My offering , and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire , for a sweet savour unto me , shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season .
translation.kha: ban hikai ïa ki Israel ban wanrah sha U Blei ha ki por ba la buh ïa ki jingainguh bam badonkam kiba pynsngewbha ïa u .

Phi lah ban lait im lada ong phi bad phi ïa leh kaba dei . Wat pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong phi ban shukor ïa kiba duk bad wat pdiang ïa ka pisa bashukor . Wat ïasnohkti bad kito thmu kiba ban pynïap briew lane ban leh ïa kiwei ki kam sniew .
translation.en: He that walketh righteously , and speaketh uprightly  ; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions , that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes , that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood , and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil  ;

For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters , and that spreadeth out her roots by the river , and shall not see when heat cometh , but her leaf shall be green  ; and shall not be careful in the year of drought , neither shall cease from yielding fruit .
translation.kha: U long kum u dieng uba mih hajan ka wahduid bad uba ki thied ki ksam sha ka um . Um sheptieng haba ka jingshit ka suiñbneng ka wan , namar ki sla jong u ki sah jyrngam ; um don jingkhuslai haba ym don slap ; u ïai pynmih soh .
ngan Hynrei sa pynkhiah ïa kane ka nongbah bad ki briew jong ka bad ngan pynïoh pat ha ki ïa ka jingkoit jingkhiah . Ngan pyn-i ha ki ka ïa jingsuk kyrhai bad ka jingshongshngain .
translation.en: Behold , I will bring it health and cure , and I will cure them , and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth .

translation.kha: Nangta u phah ïa u shakri jong u , u Moses , u bad Aaron , ïa kiba u la jied .
translation.en: He sent Moses his servant  ; and Aaron whom he had chosen .
He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it : and he that hateth suretiship is sure .
translation.kha: Lada phi kular ban siew ïa ka ram u nongwei , phin babe ïa kata . Kan kham bha lada phi kiar na kata .

translation.en: Delight is not seemly for a fool  ; much less for a servant to have rule over princes .
translation.kha: Kiba bieit kim dei ban im ha ka pahuh pahai , bad ki mraw kim dei ban synshar halor ki briew badonburom .

Bad ka jubab kan long kyllum pynkhia Dei namar sngewsheptieng jingleh la Babha ïa ka jutang ba U Trai Ephraim Jedaïah Blei dieng ki kpa tymmen jong pyntha Uta u la pynlong bad khlup mynba nguh wan ïalam ïa jingkit na Ijipt .
translation.en: Then men shall say , Because they have forsaken the covenant of the  Lord  God of their fathers , which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt :

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingïalap jong u Saul ka la nang kham khrawbor , bad ki jingpynshisha jong U u ba Jisu u long U Messaïah ki long kiba ba skhem ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha Damaskos kim lah ban jubab ïa u .
translation.en: But Saul increased the more in strength , and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus , proving that this is very Christ .
So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad baroh ki briew ki la ïohsngew ba nga ong ïa kine kiei kiei ha ka Templ ,

Haba u Gideon u ïohsngew shaphang ka jong uta u briew bad ba mut kumno , u dem khohsiew khrup bad mane ïa U Trai . Nangta leit phai sha ka sher dara ki Israel , bad u ong , joit ! U Trai u ai ha phi ka jingjop ka kynhun shipai ki Midian !
translation.en: And it was so , when Gideon heard the telling of the dream , and the interpretation thereof , that he worshipped , and returned into the host of Israel , and said , Arise  ; for the  Lord  hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian .
A fool s wrath is presently known : but a prudent man covereth shame .
translation.kha: Haba uba bieit u phoi , u pynpaw kumne kumne ba yn tip . Ki briew kiba sian kim patiaw ïa ka jingshah krenbeiñ .

translation.en: And his disciples say unto him , Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness , as to fill so great a multitude ?
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la kylli ïa u ,  Nangno ngin ïoh bam kaba biang ha kane ka ri shyiap ban bsa ïa une u paidbah ?

translation.en: And Sarah said , God hath made me to laugh , so that all that hear will laugh with me .
translation.kha: Ka Sarah ka ong ,  U Blei u la wanrah ka jingkmen bad ka jingrkhie ïa nga . Kat kiba ïohsngew ïa kane kin ïa-rkhie bad nga .

translation.en: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets : my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword  ; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger  ; thou hast killed , and not pitied .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki jingud jong nga ; ym don mano mano ban pyntngen ïa nga . Ki nongshun jong nga ki kmen ba me la wallam ka jingjot halor jong nga . To wallam ïa ka sngi kaba me la kular ; to pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong nga ban shahshitom kum ma nga .

Hynrei ka lieng ka la tyngkhuh ïa ka jaka shyiap bad ka la sangeh ; ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka lieng ka la sahkut bad kam lah ban , khih katba ka bynta ba shadien ka la shah pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ha ki jingat phyllung bashyrkhei .
translation.en: And falling into a place where two seas met , they ran the ship aground  ; and the forepart stuck fast , and remained unmoveable , but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves .

translation.kha: Hato don phim la jong ka ka ïing ban ïabam ïadih ? Lane hato phi da ban kwah ñiewbeiñ ïa ka balang U Blei bad ban pynlehrain ïa ki briew kiba kyrduh Kaei ? ba phi khmih lynti ïa nga ban ong ha phi shaphang kane ? Hato ngan ïaroh ïa phi ? Em , ngan ym leh kumta!
translation.en: What ? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in ? or despise ye the church of God , and shame them that have not ? What shall I say to you ? shall I praise you in this ? I praise you not .

translation.kha: Hato u briew u lah ban hikai ïa U Blei Uba wat bishar ïa kito kiba heh kyrdan ?
translation.en: Shall any teach God knowledge ? seeing he judgeth those that are high .
And the sons of Gad  ; Ziphion , and Haggi , Shuni , and Ezbon , Eri , and Arodi , and Areli .
translation.kha: U Gad bad ki khun shynrang jong u : U Sephon , u Haggi , u Shuni , u Esbon , u Eri , u Arod , bad u Areli .

translation.en: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand ,  Stand forth .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha uta u briew ,  Wan shane sha khmat .
Em , ka long pynban da pynmong bor ka jong U Blei Phibi pathaw beh noh ïa ki ksuid , bad kane Enokh pynshisha ba ka Hima jong U Blei ka la da :24 ha phi .
translation.en: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils , no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you .
But when the fulness of the time was come , God sent forth his Son , made of a woman , made under the law ,
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ka ïa kaba biang ka la poi , U Blei u la phah ïa la U Khun .
Ïa ka jingsawa Pethor ka thma la ïohsngew ha Khilion jingaibuit , bad ka don ka jingpynjot bakhraw .
translation.en: A sound of battle is in the land , and of great destruction .
He brought me to the banqueting house , and his banner over me was love .
translation.kha: To shim ïa nga bad phi , bad ngin ïaphet noh ; to long u syiem jong nga bad shim ïa nga sha ka kamra jong phi . Ngin ïakmen lang , ngin ïadih bun bad pyllaitluid war ïa lade ha ka jingieit . Kam long kaba phylla ba baroh ki kynthei ki ieit ïa phi !
Ka por kaba dei ka la poi , u ong , bad ka Hima U Blei ka la hajan ! To phai noh na ki jong pop bad phi ngeit ïa ka Khubor Babha !
translation.en: And saying ,  The time is fulfilled , and the kingdom of God is at hand : repent ye , and believe the gospel .
And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations  ; and then shall the end come .
translation.kha: Bad ïa kane ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima yn ïalap ha kylleng ka pyrthei na ka bynta ka jingsakhi sha ki jaitbynriew baroh ; bad nangta kaba kut kan wan .

translation.en: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning : when he dresseth the lamps , he shall burn incense upon it .
translation.kha: Man ka step haba u Aaron u wan ban pynkhreh ïa ki sharak , u dei ban thang ïa ka jingiwbih halor jong ka .

translation.en: And said unto him , Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee ? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not .
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba u syiem Baalis jong ki Ammon u la phah ïa u Ishmael ban pynïap ïa phi ?  Hynrei u Gedalaïah um shym ngeit ïa kata .

Haba ki paidbah Hiram ka jait Dan ki la duh noh ïa la ka jaka , ki kput leit sha Kajuh bad sukher ïaleh ïa ka kynhied Ki jop ïa ka iwkhong nongrim pynïap ïa ki jingnoh hangta ïawad bad Beeroth kam kynti ïa ka na ka bynta ïa jingbymkhuid . Misraim shong ïuhbeiñ sah hangta bad ki jingstad-buit ïa Briew kyrteng jong ka nongbah —Ioanis ka Laish sha ka Dan , da kaba kyrteng ïa ka ha ka kyrteng u Dan u kpa Blei’ jong ki .
translation.en: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them : therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem , and took it , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and possessed it , and dwelt therein , and called Leshem , Dan , after the name of Dan their father .

translation.kha: Te u ong ha kita ki Nahalal , biria shong hangne bad ka habar . Ma nga bad Men khun Khmut leit hangtai ban mane Blei Resheph bad hadien kata ngin sa Balang pat sha phi .
translation.en: And Abraham said unto his young men , Abide ye here with the ass  ; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship , and come again to you .
Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa u kew jong phi , bad ïa ka jingbam ba phi khreh da u .

translation.en: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee , named Nazareth ,
translation.kha: Ha u bnai bahynriew jong ka jingpunkhun jong ka Elisabeth , U Blei u la phah ïa u angel Gabriel sha ka shong ha Galilaïa kaba kyrteng ka Nasareth .

translation.en: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem , A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people , not to fan , nor to cleanse ,
translation.kha: Ka por ka wan ha kaba ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem yn ïathuh ba ka lyer khluit ka beh shapoh sha ki na ka ri shyiap . Kan ym long ka lyer kaba jai jai kaba shu beh pynher noh ïa u stait —
Ko Ninebeh , pha don ha ka jingshah tur ïaleh ! Ka bor ka ban pha ka la wan . To buh briew ha ki jingïada To phira ïa ka lynti bah ! To ïa ka thma !
translation.en: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face : keep the munition , watch the way , make thy loins strong , fortify thy power mightily .

translation.kha: U Dabid la u duwai , Blei A , nga long ma nga uta la uba leh bakla . Nga dei uta uba la hukum ban kheiñ briew . Kine ki paidbah bapli ki la leh aïu ? A Trai , U Blei jong nga pynshitom , ïa nga bad ïa ka longïing jong nga , bad pyllait ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: And David said unto God , Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered ? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed  ; but as for these sheep , what have they done ? let thine hand , I pray thee , O  Lord  my God , be on me , and on my father s house  ; but not on thy people , that they should be plagued .
And it came to pass , that in the morning watch the  Lord  looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud , and troubled the host of the Egyptians ,
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban kynjat shai , U  Trai  u la khmih ïa ka kynhun shipai Ijipt na u rishot ding bad u rishot lyoh bad u pynkulmar thlim ïa ki .
Nangta uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran — uba u Judas Iskariot — u leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh ,
translation.en: Then one of the twelve , called Judas Iscariot , went unto the chief priests ,
And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah s tent , and took Rebekah , and she became his wife  ; and he loved her : and Isaac was comforted after his mother s death .
translation.kha: Nangta u Isaak u ïalam ïa ka Rebekka shapoh ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba ka Sarah ka kmie jong u ka la ju shong , bad ka la kylla long ka tnga jong u . U Isaak u ieit ïa ka Rebekka , bad da kumta u la ïoh jingtngen hadien ba u la duh ïa la ka kmie .

translation.en: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city , both man and beast : they shall die of a great pestilence .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba shong ha kane ka nongbah ; ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh ; kin ïap da ka khlam kaba shyrkhei .
U leh pyrshah ïa U Trai , da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh bymman uba ha shuwa jong u , u Jeroboam u khun jong u uba ïalam ïa ki ban leh pop .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  : he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels , and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ka nongbah Rabbah sha ka jaka ba ri ïa ki ut , bad ïa ka ri ki Ammon baroh kawei sha ka jaka ban ri ïa ki langbrot , khnang ba phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Therefore also said the wisdom of God , I will send them prophets and apostles , and some of them they shall slay and persecute :
translation.kha: Na kane ka daw ka Jingstad jong U Blei ka la ong , ‘ Ngan phah ha ki ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bad ïa ki nonglamktien ; kin pynïap katto katne ngut na ki bad kin pynshitom beiñ ïa kiwei pat .’
Phi la dep bam ja shiteng sngi soh
translation.en: Did you have lunch ?
For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me , to make the Gentiles obedient , by word and deed ,
translation.kha: Ngan long shlur bad ngan kren tang shaphang kaei kaba U Khrist u la leh lyngba jong nga , ban ïalam ïa ki Jentil ban kohnguh ïa U Blei . U la leh ïa kane da ki ktien bad ki kam ,

translation.en: Since thou wast precious in my sight , thou hast been honourable , and I have loved thee : therefore will I give men for thee , and people for thy life .
translation.kha: Ngan kyntait ïa ki ri baroh ban pynim ïa ka jingim jong phi , namar phi long uba kordor ha nga bad namar ba nga ieit ïa phi bad ai ïa phi ka burom .
Kaei kaei kaba jia ka dei kaba la rai lypa slem bah mynshuwa , bad ngi baroh ngi tip ba phim lah ban ïania bad uno uno uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa phi .
translation.en: That which hath been is named already , and it is known that it is man : neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he .
They shall perish  ; but thou remainest  ; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment  ;
translation.kha: Kita kin jah noh , hynrei me men ïaisah ; baroh kin sa jot noh kum ki jaiñ .

translation.en: For my people is foolish , they have not known me  ; they are sottish children , and they have none understanding : they are wise to do evil , but to do good they have no knowledge .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong nga ki long kiba mutlop ; kim ithuh ïa nga . Ki long kiba bieit kum ki khynnah ; kim don kano kano ka jingshemphang . Ki long kiba tbit ha kaba leh ïa kaba sniew , hynrei ki bym lah ban leh ïa kaba bha .

translation.en: Then the disciples looked one on another , doubting of whom he spake .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ïa-peit uwei ïa uwei pat da ka jinglyngngoh kaba jur , shaphang jongno u mut .
U Trai u ong , Haba ka por ka poi ïalehkai ki paid Israel sloit jingthok sngewdiaw wan ïa-ïam , Eltekeh wad ïa nga , shitom sohpdung jong ki .
translation.en: In those days , and in that time , saith the  Lord  , the children of Israel shall come , they and the children of Judah together , going and weeping : they shall go , and seek the  Lord  their God .
Hast thou eyes of flesh ? or seest thou as man seeth ?
translation.kha: Hato me ïohi ïa kiei kiei kumba ngi ïohi ?

Bad kumta naduh mynta hi Ka yn ym don shuh u dieng jingryngkhiang pynjrong pher LONG la ai um bha ïa u , un jrong pat sa shisien ne u ban kynjoh ïa la pynhieng kliar lyngba ki lyoh Elah u ban kot kat kato ka rynïeng . Ïa ki Jingshisha la buh Hashabneïah ïap kum ïa baroh ki briew ba dei Jakob ïap , la buh ba kin ïasoh bad kito kiba leit jingsiang Pynïap ka pyrthei kiba ïap hi
translation.en: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height , neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs , neither their trees stand up in their height , all that drink water : for they are all delivered unto death , to the nether parts of the earth , in the midst of the children of men , with them that go down to the pit .

translation.kha: U Isaak , Me dei uei ? Nga dei Iso , u khun nyngkong jong phi , u jubab .
translation.en: And Isaac his father said unto him , Who art thou ? And he said , I am thy son , thy firstborn Esau .

translation.kha: U syiem u law ïa la ka sati ba pyndonkam ha kaba ban muhor shon pynkupbor ïa ki jingpynbna , bad ai ïa ka ha u nongshun jong ka jaitbynriew Jiw , u Haman u khun jong u Hammedatha , uba hiarpateng na u Agag .
translation.en: And the king took his ring from his hand , and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , the Jews  enemy .
And Elijah said unto Ahab , Get thee up , eat and drink  ; for there is a sound of abundance of rain .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ha u syiem Ahab ,  Mynta , khie leit bad bam . Nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba u slap u wan .
Nga kwah ban wai Em’ , pyni ki dor seh .
translation.en: I want to rent a car , please show me a price list .
So shalt thou put away the guilt of innocent blood from among you , when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Da kumta , phin weng noh ïa ka jingshah kynnoh pop napdeng jong phi , haba phi leh ïa kata kaba dei ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt , from twenty years old and upward , shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob  ; because they have not wholly followed me :
translation.kha: ‘ Nga smai ba namar kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga , uwei ruh na ki rangbah uba arphew snem lane kham heh uba la wan na Ijipt un ym ïohrung sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ha u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .’

translation.en: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making : they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds , purple , and broidered work , and fine linen , and coral , and agate .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Syria ki la thied ïa ki mar khaïi bad ïa ki jingmih ba bun jong pha . Ki la ai ïa ki mawkordor Emerald , ki jaiñ bajngum , ki jingthain ba-itynnat , ki linen bakynsai , ki Koral , bad ki mawkordor Rubi kum ka jingsiew na ka bynta ki mar jong pha .

translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that entereth into the service , for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation :
translation.kha: Kin kitkhlieh ruh ïa ki rijied , ïa ki thliew tnaw , ïa ki snar , bad ïa ki tyllai jong ka phyllaw .

translation.en: Moab is spoiled , and gone up out of her cities , and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka la pynjot , ïa ki samla shynrang bakynsai tam la pynïap . Nga long u syiem , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , bad nga la kren .
U Ussaïah u la ïap bad la ha ka ki ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad Jotham u jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Azariah slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David : and Jotham his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: U don ka kynhun ki liengbah kiba ïaid sha duriaw ryngkat bad ki liengbah jong u syiem Hiram . Shisien lai snem ki lieng jong u ki wan phai , ki da kit ïa ka ksiar ka , rupa , ki bniat hati , ki tngaw , bad ki shrieh .
translation.en: For the king s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram : every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold , and silver , ivory , and apes , and peacocks .

translation.kha: To iwei ïa iwei pat da jingïadoh jong jingieit Khristan . To ka jingsuk kan long kiba dei jong Khrist
translation.en: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity . Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus . Amen .
For it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that I will break his yoke from off thy neck , and will burst thy bonds , and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong :  Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor kaba don sawdong ka ryndang jong ki bad ngan weng ïa ki kynjri jong ki , bad kin ym long shuh ki mraw jong ki nongwei .
Hymenaïos hato me la lynthaw Theh ngi junom ? Hato ym don jingkut ïa ka jingbitar jong me ?
translation.en: But thou hast utterly rejected us  ; thou art very wroth against us .

translation.kha: u rung shapoh , ïingsyiem bad u bam jingbam . Hadien kata u ong , Shim ïa kato ka kynthei ba la tim shah , bad tep ïa ka ; naba ka dei ka khun jong u syiem .
translation.en: And when he was come in , he did eat and drink , and said , Go , see now this cursed woman , and bury her : for she is a king s daughter .

Thou shalt bring them in , and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance , in the place , O  Lord  , which thou hast made for thee to dwell in , in the Sanctuary , O Lord , which thy hands have established .
translation.kha: Me wan ïalam ïa ki shapoh bad me buh ïa ki ha u lumbah jong me , ha ka jaka kaba me , ko  Trai  , me la jied na ka bynta ka ïing jong me , ka Templ kaba me hi me la tei .
Ka jingsawa ka turoi ka ruh nang jam nang jam . U Moses u kren la , bad U Blei u jubab ïa u ha ka sur u pyrthat .
translation.en: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long , and waxed louder and louder , Moses spake , and God answered him by a voice .

translation.kha: Kumta jingjlan la sdang ban wad labasa ban pynshitom ïa U Jisu , namar Letushim jingwallam la leh ïa Pynshong ka jingpynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton Mikaïah
translation.en: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus , and sought to slay him , because he had done these things on the sabbath day .
Which when they had read , they rejoiced for the consolation .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la pule ïa ka , la pyndap ïa ki da ka jingkmen da ka khubor ka jingpynshlur .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Is he well ? And they said , He is well : and , behold , Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep .
translation.kha: Hato u shait u khlaiñ ?  u kylli biang .  U shait u khlaiñ ,  ki jubab .  Khmih , hangne ka Rakhel ka khun jong u ka wan lem bad ki kynhun langbrot jong u .
Hato briew u u ïoh jingmyntoi ei ei lada u ïoh ïa pyrthei ka baroh kawei hynrei u duh noh ïa la ka jingim ? Em , un ym ïoh jingmyntoi ei ei !
translation.en: For what shall it profit a man , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ?

translation.kha: Kumta u Elijah u la leit . Ka ha nemsniew Samaria ka la don ha ka por kaba jur bha ,
translation.en: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab . And there was a sore famine in Samaria .
Thus saith the  Lord  , the Holy One of Israel , and his Maker , Ask me of things to come concerning my sons , and concerning the work of my hands command ye me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei bakhuid ki Israel , uta uba saiñdur ïa ka lawei , u ong :  Phim don hok ban kylli ïa nga shaphang ki khun jong nga lane ban ïathuh ïa nga kaei ba nga dei ban leh !
Nangta u pynïeng ki ïingjaiñ shipai ha ka ri jong ki , bad ki kylla long ki raïot jong u ki bad siew khajna sha u . U Trai u jingjop ai ïa u Dabid ha kylleng .
translation.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria–damascus  ; and the Syrians became David s servants , and brought gifts . Thus the  Lord  preserved David whithersoever he went .

translation.kha: bad u kumta la kylli ïa U Trai kaei ba un leh Hynrei U . Trai um shym jubab ei ei ïa u , la ha ki jingphohsniew , lane da u Urim bad u Thummim , lane da ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And when Saul enquired of the  Lord  , the  Lord  answered him not , neither by dreams , nor by Urim , nor by prophets .
And Jesus said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? none is good , save one , that is , God .
translation.kha: Balei me khot uba bha ïa nga ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa u .  Ym don uno uno uba bha lait tang U Blei .
Wat shim sut na la u para Israel haba ai phi ram , lane phi ai jingbam , lane phi ai shah ïa kaei kaei u ha .
translation.en: Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother  ; usury of money , usury of victuals , usury of any thing that is lent upon usury :

translation.kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la dem khrup 19 khyndew bad u la ai kmie na ka bynta ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh kiba dei ban ïaleit ïa u Daniel .
translation.en: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face , and worshipped Daniel , and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duk bad kiba rit kyrdan kin shem pat ka ïa jingsuk kaba U Trai , U Blei jong Bakhuid ki Israel , un ai .
translation.en: The meek also shall increase their joy in the  Lord  , and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kaba shisha , ïa kaba dei ban pdiang pura bad ban ngeit .
translation.en: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation .

translation.kha: Haba u syiem ka Ninebeh u ïohsngew shaphang la kata , u ïeng joit na la ka khet , u law noh la ïa ka jaiñkup , u phong da ka jaiñ khain , bad u shong ha u dpei .
translation.en: For word came unto the king of Nineveh , and he arose from his throne , and he laid his robe from him , and covered him with sackcloth , and sat in ashes .

translation.kha: Ha Shaphat sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba hynriew , jong ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingshah Abimael jong ngi , snemhadien rangbah kiba la shah ringmraw na Judah Dannah ïashong bad nga ha ka ïing Simon pynshlei . Kynsan kynsan ka bor jingtong U Trai Nongsynshar ka la wan sahnar jong kurim .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the sixth year , in the sixth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I sat in mine house , and the elders of Judah sat before me , that the hand of the Lord  God  fell there upon me .
All thy commandments are faithful : they persecute me wrongfully  ; help thou me .
translation.kha: Ki hukum jong me baroh ki long kiba lah ban shaniah ; ki briew ki pynshitom beiñ ïa nga da ki jinglamler — A ïarap ïa nga !

translation.en: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds , and cedar wood , and scarlet , and hyssop :
translation.kha: Ban pynkhuid ïa kata ka ïing , un shim ar tylli ki sim , khyndiat u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , u  saiwul uba saw , bad uwei u tnat Hissop .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Is the  Lord s  hand waxed short ? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not .
translation.kha: Hato don u pud ïa ka bor jong nga ?  U  Trai  u jubab .  Men sa ïohi shen la kata kaba nga la ong kan urlong ne em !
Wat hapdeng kita kiei kiei kiba la jia , Job u um shym la leh pop da kaba kynnoh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: In all this Job sinned not , nor charged God foolishly .

translation.kha: kata ka hynmen kynsi jong u kan leit sha u ha khmat kita ki nongïalam shnong , kan loit kawei ka juti jong u , kan bynthiew ha ka khmat jong u , bad ong kan , ‘ Kumne yn leh ïa u uta briew u treh bym ban ai symbai la ïa u hynmen .’
translation.en: Then shall his brother s wife come unto him in the presence of the elders , and loose his shoe from off his foot , and spit in his face , and shall answer and say , So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother s house .

translation.kha: Katno tylli ki kpu phi don ? U Jisu u la kylli . tylli Hynñiew ki kpu , ki la jubab , khyndiat bad ki dohkha rit .
translation.en: And Jesus saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ?  And they said , Seven , and a few little fishes .

translation.kha: Phi ka jingong ‘ Sa bnai bad pat ka aïom ot .’ nga ong ïa phi , to da khmih ïa lyngkha ; ki jingthung mynta la ih bad ki la ot !
translation.en: Say not ye , There are yet four months , and then cometh harvest ? behold , I say unto you , Lift up your eyes , and look on the fields  ; for they are white already to harvest .

translation.kha: U la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad ong ha ka Israel , Ko Israel , to wan pat sha . Nga long uba dap da jingisynei bad ngan bitar ; ngan ym bitar ïa pha shi junom .
translation.en: Go and proclaim these words toward the north , and say , Return , thou backsliding Israel , saith the  Lord   ; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you : for I am merciful , saith the  Lord  , and I will not keep anger for ever .
And it came to pass , that , when the sun went down , and it was dark , behold a smoking furnace , and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces .
translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka la sep , bad ba ka la dum , u khiew uba mih tdem bad ka dongmusa kaba mehding ki paw kynsan bad ïaid napdeng kita ki lyngkhot doh .

Man la ka jingtynjuh kaba phi la mad kata kaba ju wan ha ki briew . Hynrei U Blei u long uba ïa la kular , bad un ym shah ban tynjuh ïa phi sha bor jong ba phin ïoh ïaineh skhem ; ha ka por ba phi tynjuh , un ai ha phi ïa ka bor ba lah ban shah ïa ka bad kumta thaw ïa ka lad ba phi lah ban lait na ka .
translation.en: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man : but God is faithful , who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able ; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape , that ye may be able to bear it .

translation.kha: Hadien Timothi ka sngi ka la mih , U Blei u la phah ïa ka lyer mihngi sotti shit , Phah u malai u la jan ïapler na ka jingshit jingtyrwa ka sngi kaba shoh halor ka khlieh mutdur u pynphieng Kumta u la kwah ban kynting noh . Ka kham bha ïa nga ban pom noh ban ïa kaba NGA jingjrong u la jinghiarthma .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the sun did arise , that God prepared a vehement east wind  ; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah , that he fainted , and wished in himself to die , and said , It is better for me to die than to live .
They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger : for these pine away , stricken through for want of the fruits of the field .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ïap ha ka thma ki la long kiba kham bit ban ïa kito kiba ïap hadien , kiba ïap suki ha ka jingthngan , khlem kano kano ka jingbam ban ri pynim ïa ki .
Bad balei phi khuslai shaphang ki ? jaiñ Khmih kumno ki tiewkhlaw ki san : kim trei lane thain jaiñ na ka bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: And why take ye thought for raiment ? Consider the lilies of the field , how they grow  ; they toil not , neither do they spin :
And she brought forth her firstborn son , and wrapped him in swaddling clothes , and laid him in a manger  ; because there was no room for them in the inn .
translation.kha: Ka la kha ïa u khun nyngkong jong ka bad ka la sop ïa u da ki jaiñsop , bad ka la pynthiah ïa u ha ka shyngoid — ym shym don jaka ïa ki ha ka kamra sah   .
don ka ba ka donkam sha phi ïa u para ngi u Epaphroditos , uba la trei ha syndah jong nga bad la shakri kum u nonglamktien jong phi ha kaba ïarap ïa nga
translation.en: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus , my brother , and companion in labour , and fellowsoldier , but your messenger , and he that ministered to my wants .

And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth–el , and pitched his tent , having Beth–el on the west , and Ai on the east : and there he builded an altar unto the  Lord  , and called upon the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u la leit shaphang shathie sha ka ri lum ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Bethel bad u la pynïeng ïa ka dara hapdeng ka Bethel shaphang sepngi bad ka Ai shaphang mihngi . Hangta ruh u la tei ïa ka duwan bad u la mane ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And the people murmured against Moses , saying , What shall we drink ?
translation.kha: Kita ki paidbah ki la ïakhñium ïa u Moses , bad ki la kylli ,  Ngin ïadih da-ei ?

translation.en: Artaxerxes , king of kings , unto Ezra the priest , a scribe of the law of the God of heaven , perfect peace , and at such a time .
translation.kha: Na u patsha Artakserksis ha u Esra , u lyngdoh , riewstad ka Hukum jong U Blei ka Bneng .

translation.en: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon : for they heard that they should eat bread there .
translation.kha: Ki pynkhreh ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha ban ai ha u Joseph ynda u wan ha ka por shiteng sngi , namar la ïathuh ha ki ba ki dei ban ïabam ryngkat bad u .

Nangta ki Pham lah ban pynjot kotbah ki nongbah ngin ki phang ka Gerar , pynskuiñ ïajubab ki briew hangta ki la tuid ïa U Trai . ai kynhun shipai ka la Jehoash ïa baroh kito ki nongbah bad ki kurup shibun ka jinglute .
translation.en: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar  ; for the fear of the  Lord  came upon them : and they spoiled all the cities  ; for there was exceeding much spoil in them .

translation.kha: Lada phim te Blei un pyndonkam da ki nongwei kiba kren kawei pat ka sur ktien ba sngew khyllah ban ïa phi .
translation.en: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people .

translation.kha: Kine ki leh kumta na ka jingieit , ki namar tip ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa ka kam ban ïada ïa gospel ka .
translation.en: The one preach Christ of contention , not sincerely , supposing to add affliction to my bonds :

translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym la kohnguh ; ki long kiba mutlop kum ki kpa jong ki ki bym shym ha U Trai U Blei jong
translation.en: Notwithstanding they would not hear , but hardened their necks , like to the neck of their fathers , that did not believe in the  Lord  their God .

translation.kha: khynnah ka snem jong ka Jingpynïoh pat , ynda khwai baroh ka bri ka rnong ïa kaba la die la pynïoh pat sha ki sngewshngain khyndew , ïa ka jingïohkynti jong jinglakloi khun kynthei jong jingiehnoh Selophehad yn kynthup lang junom ha tduh ka jait kaba ki ïashongkurim Mehujael kan long ka jingduh Agrippa ka jait jong ngi .
translation.en: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be , then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received : so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers .

translation.kha: Ha ka jaka bam , nga ïam sngewsih , bad shym sangeh ban ud .
translation.en: For my sighing cometh before I eat , and my roarings are poured out like the waters .
And he said unto him , See , I have accepted thee concerning this thing also , that I will not overthrow this city , for the which thou hast spoken .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Kata ruh ka biang hi . Ngan nym pynjot ïa kata ka nongrit .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head , because thou canst not make one hair white or black .
translation.kha: Wat ym smai da ka khlieh jong phi , naba phim lah ban pynlieh lane pynïong ïa iwei i shñiuh .

translation.en: Now therefore arise , go forth , and speak comfortably unto thy servants : for I swear by the  Lord  , if thou go not forth , there will not tarry one with thee this night : and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now .
translation.kha: Mynta , to leit ban pynskhem biang ïa ki rangbah jong phi . Nga smai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba lada phim leh kumta , yn ym don shuh uwei ruh na ki u ban don bad phi lashai mynstep . Kata kan long ka jingjynjar kaba sniew tam kaba phin shah ha ka jingim jong phi baroh .

translation.en: For all the law is fulfilled in one word , even in this ; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
translation.kha: Naba ïa ka Hukum baroh kawei la kyllum lang ha kawei ka hukum kaba ong ,  Phin ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba phi ieit ïa lade .
U nongshun u la ïa ka jaka ba jam ïa ka wah bad u la thang ïa ki kut Ki shipai Babilonia ki la lamwir .
translation.en: And that the passages are stopped , and the reeds they have burned with fire , and the men of war are affrighted .

translation.kha: Phi donkam ban sympat ïa , phi dei teh ïa u kada , bad phi dei ban sympat ïa uba bieit .
translation.en: A whip for the horse , a bridle for the ass , and a rod for the fool s back .

translation.kha: Ka Leah ki khmat kiba i-ieit , ka Rakhel pat ka long bad kaba bhabriew .
translation.en: Leah was tender eyed  ; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured .
And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast : and they come and say unto him , Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast , but thy disciples fast not ?
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sien , ki nongbud jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis bad ki Pharisi ki dang ïashahjingit . Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wan ha U Jisu bad kylli ïa u ,  Balei ba ki synran jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis bad ki synran jong ki Pharisi ki shahjingit , katba ki jong me kim shahjingit ?
U lah ban ïa ki dieng Kedar ban pyndonkam , lane u jied da u dieng lane u na ka khlaw . Lane u lah ban thung u dieng ba jyrngam bad u ap ïa u slap ban pynmih ïa u .
translation.en: He heweth him down cedars , and taketh the cypress and the oak , which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest : he planteth an ash , and the rain doth nourish it .
And what man is there that hath betrothed a wife , and hath not taken her ? let him go and return unto his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man take her .
translation.kha: Don mo hangne uba dang shu dep ïatehktien ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u ïap ha madan thma , bad ba uwei pat un shongkurim ïa ka .’

Nga ong ha phi , U Jisu u la ong , u nonglum khajna , bad ym Pharisi u , uba don ha ka liang kaba dei bad U haba Blei u leit noh sha ïing . Naba ïa uno uno uba pynkhraw ïa lade yn pynrit , bad ïa uno uno pynrit uba yn pynkhraw .
translation.en: I tell you , this man went down to his house justified rather than the other : for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased  ; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted .

translation.kha: Men suri kurup , bad lute ïa pynbieit Ayyah kiba shong ha ki nongbah kiba shisien ki don ha ka jingjot . Ki long kiba la lumlang na ki jaitbynriew , bad mynta ki don bajanai ki jingri bad ki jingdon I , bad ki shong ha ki lad bah ka pyrthei .
translation.en: To take a spoil , and to take a prey  ; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited , and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations , which have gotten cattle and goods , that dwell in the midst of the land .

translation.kha: U Trai u leh kumba u Moses u kyrpad , bad kita jakoid kiba don hapoh ïing , ha phyllaw ïing , ha ruh , ki ïap lut phar .
translation.en: And the  Lord  did according to the word of Moses  ; and the frogs died out of the houses , out of the villages , and out of the fields .
And unto the married I command , yet not I , but the Lord , Let not the wife depart from her husband :
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew kiba la shongkurim , nga don ka hukum ym ka jong nga hynrei ka jong U Trai : Ka tnga kam dei ban iehnoh ïa la u tnga ;
u Kum kpa jong u , u Asa , ha shuwa jong u , u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei ha khmat U Trai ;
translation.en: And he walked in the way of Asa his father , and departed not from it , doing that which was right in the sight of the  Lord .
Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah , that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba nga la ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , ym shym la aiti ïa nga ha ki briew bad shah pynïap .
U la pynbor ïa nga ban shong ha ka jingdum baneh hajuh tiduh ka jingïap .
translation.en: He hath set me in dark places , as they that be dead of old .

translation.kha: To hukum ïa ki ba kin leh ïa kaba bha , ban man ha kyrhai ki kam babha , ban kiba long sbun bad kiba kloi ban ïasam bad kiwei .
translation.en: That they do good , that they be rich in good works , ready to distribute , willing to communicate ;

translation.kha: ka long ka rai nga ka ban ym haba ki jong nga ki pynlong ïa ka jingkñia , ka shadem bad ka lbong jong u ki ka bynta jong ki lyngdoh . Kane ka ka jingai sngewbha ki briew sha nga , U Trai .
translation.en: And it shall be Aaron s and his sons  by a statute for ever from the children of Israel : for it is an heave offering : and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings , even their heave offering unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Jisu u jubab , Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka Ym don lah ban ïohi ïa ka Hima U Blei kha pat ïa u
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born again , he cannot see the kingdom of God .

Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the  Lord  his God for the wars which were about him on every side , until the  Lord  put them under the soles of his feet .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba namar ki thma ba ïai khie , u Dabid , u kpa jong nga u la dei ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ri jong ki nongshun kiba sawdong jong u , um shym la lah ban tei ka templ na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u tad haduh ba u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong u baroh .
Ka Moab ka sarong Wah ! Nga la ïohsngew katno ka Hephsibah , ka Dabid ki briew ki long , Te ki pyrkhat shaphang ïa lade .
translation.en: We have heard the pride of Moab , ( he is exceeding proud ) his loftiness , and his arrogancy , and his pride , and the haughtiness of his heart .
Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee .
translation.kha: Te ngan long uba nyngkong ban ïaroh ïa me bad pdiang ba me la ïoh ka jingjop da lade hi .
Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoash u la kaba kynthup ïa ka jingshlur jong u ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah , la buh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Israel .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Joash , and all that he did , and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: Katno kiba suk bad kiba ïoh jingkyrkhu shikatdei eh ki long kito kiba la kynthup ha kane ka jingpynmihpat kiba ïap . Ka jingïap kaba ar kam donbor halor jong ki ; kin long ki lyngdoh jong bad jong U Khrist bad kin synshar bad u shihajar .
translation.en: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection : on such the second death hath no power , but they shall be priests of God and of Christ , and shall reign with him a thousand years .

translation.kha: U Saul u jubab , Ki jong nga ki la shim ïa ki na ki Amalek . Ki la buh ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba kynsai tam ainguh kum ka jingkñia ha U Trai U Blei jong phi , bad ïa kiba sah ngi la pynduh lut .
translation.en: And Saul said , They have brought them from the Amalekites : for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen , to sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God  ; and the rest we have utterly destroyed .
Then the Philistines went up , and pitched in Judah , and spread themselves in Lehi .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki wan bad sher dara ha Judah , bad ki hiarthma ïa ka shnong Lehi .

translation.en: Because they said , He hath an unclean spirit .

translation.kha: Kumba U Kpa da lade hi u long u tyllong jong ka jingim , ha kajuh ka rukom u la pynlong ïa U Khun jong u ban long u tyllong jong ka jingim .

translation.en: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat : because he hath nothing left him in the siege , and in the straitness , wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates .

translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp , to deliver thee , and to give up thine enemies before thee  ; therefore shall thy camp be holy : that he see no unclean thing in thee , and turn away from thee .

translation.en: For though I be absent in the flesh , yet am I with you in the spirit , joying and beholding your order , and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ .

translation.en: And , behold , the courses of the priests and the Levites , even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God : and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man , for any manner of service : also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment .

translation.en: Do not drink wine nor strong drink , thou , nor thy sons with thee , when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations :

translation.en: And they removed the burnt offerings , that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people , to offer unto the  Lord  , as it is written in the book of Moses . And so did they with the oxen .

translation.en: And ye shall be holy unto me : for I the  Lord  am holy , and have severed you from other people , that ye should be mine .

translation.en: And when they had sent away the multitude , they took him even as he was in the ship . And there were also with him other little ships .

translation.en: And when the tempter came to him , he said , If thou be the Son of God , command that these stones be made bread .

translation.en: And they cried unto the  Lord  , and said , We have sinned , because we have forsaken the  Lord  , and have served Baalim and Ashtoreth : but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies , and we will serve thee .

translation.kha: Un hiarthma wat ïa ka bad un pynïap ki phew hajar , hynrei ki ri Edom , Moab , bad kaei kaba la jong ka Ammon lait .
translation.en: He shall enter also into the glorious land , and many countries shall be overthrown : but these shall escape out of his hand , even Edom , and Moab , and the chief of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei bam ban ïa kano kano ka sim ne mrad kaba la ïap hi lane kaba la shah ha pynïap uwei pat u mrad .

Leave there thy gift before the altar , and go thy way  ; first be reconciled to thy brother , and then come and offer thy gift .

translation.en: And Reuben said unto them , Shed no blood , but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness , and lay no hand upon him  ; that he might rid him out of their hands , to deliver him to his father again .

translation.en: And brought them out , and said , Sirs , what must I do to be saved ?

translation.en: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God , God dwelleth in him , and he in God .

nongthied ba Gimso Trai u la jop ïa u Sihon u syiem sngewthikna uba shong ha jingdonburom , bad ïa u Og u syiem Bashan , uba synshar ha ki shnong Ashtaroth bad Edrei .

translation.en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land : for they have heard that thou  Lord  art among this people , that thou  Lord  art seen face to face , and that thy cloud standeth over them , and that thou goest before them , by day time in a pillar of a cloud , and in a pillar of fire by night .

translation.en: And as for Ishmael , I have heard thee : Behold , I have blessed him , and will make him fruitful , and will multiply him exceedingly  ; twelve princes shall he beget , and I will make him a great nation .
O  Lord  God , to whom vengeance belongeth  ; O God , to whom vengeance belongeth , shew thyself .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me long U Blei uba pynshitom ; to pynpaw ïa ka jingbitar jong me !
La ai ha ki ïa ka nongbah Arba ( u Arba u dei u kpa jong u Anak ) , ïa kaba mynta la khot ka Hebron , ha ka ri lum Judah , lem bad ki pyntha phlang sawdong ka jong .
translation.en: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak , which city is Hebron , in the hill country of Judah , with the suburbs thereof round about it .

translation.kha: Wat u Mikhael , u angel rangbah shym um la leh ïa kane . Ha jingïakajia ka u jong bad u Soitan , mynba ki la ïania uei shaphang u ban ïoh ïa ka met u Moses , u Mikhael um shym nud pynrem ban ïa u Soitan da ki ktien ban krenbeiñ , hynrei u la ong , U Trai un da sneng ïa me !

translation.en: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles  ; Prepare war , wake up the mighty men , let all the men of war draw near  ; let them come up :
