translation.en: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about , and the Gammadims were in thy towers : they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about  ; they have made thy beauty perfect .

Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning : I covered the deep for him , and I restrained the floods thereof , and the great waters were stayed : and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him , and all the trees of the field fainted for him .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong :  Ha ka sngi ba u dieng u leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ngan pynlong ïa ki um shapoh khyndew ban tap ïa u kum ka dak ka jingïambriew . Ngan set noh ïa ki wah bad ngan ym shah ïa ki wahduid ban tuid shabar . Namar ba u dieng u la ïap , ngan wallam ka jingdum halor ki lumbah ka Lebanon bad ngan pynlong ïa baroh ki dieng ha khlaw ba kin ïapstai .
U Joseph u jubab , Kine ki dei ki khun jong nga kiba U Blei u la ai ïa nga ha Ijipt hangne . U Jakob u ong , Wan ïalam ïa ki sha nga ngan ba ïoh kyrkhu ïa ki .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto his father , They are my sons , whom God hath given me in this place . And he said , Bring them , I pray thee , unto me , and I will bless them .
And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah  ; even Issachar , and also Barak : he was sent on foot into the valley . For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ka jait Issakhar ki wan bad ka Deborah ; Ho-oid , ki Issakhar ki wan bad u Barak ruh , Bad ki la bud ïa u sha ka them . Hynrei ki jait Reuben kim ïabeit jingmut , Kim shym lah rai ban ïawan .

translation.en: Having a form of godliness , but denying the power thereof : from such turn away .
translation.kha: ki bat ïa kaba paw shabar jong ka niam jong ki , hynrei kin kyntait ïa ka bor bashisha jong ka . To kiar noh na kiba kum kita ki briew .

translation.en: A false witness shall perish : but the man that heareth speaketh constantly .
translation.kha: Ym lah ban ngeit ïa ka jingphla shem mynsiem jong uba lamler , hynrei ka ktien jong uno uno uba da pyrkhat bha yn pdiang .

translation.en: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins : they afflict the just , they take a bribe , and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right .
translation.kha: Nga tip haduh katno ki pop jong phi ki long kiba sngewshyrkhei bad katno kiba bun ki kam runar phi la leh . Phi pynshitom beiñ ïa ki briew kiba bha , phi bamsap , phi khang noh ïa kiba duk ban ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok ha ki ïingbishar .

translation.en: And God came unto Balaam at night , and said unto him , If the men come to call thee , rise up , and go with them  ; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee , that shalt thou do .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U Blei u la wan ha u Balaam bad u ong ,  Lada kine ki briew ki la wan khot ïa me ban leit bad ki , to khreh ban leit ; hynrei leh tang ïa kata kaba nga ong ha me .
Kata ka kynthei ka kylli poi Ïano nongmane khot na ka bynta jong phi ? Ïa u Amnon , Pyntyllun bymsalia .
translation.en: Then said the woman , Whom shall I bring up unto thee ? And he said , Bring me up Samuel .
( There are eleven days  journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh–barnea . )
translation.kha: ( Ka shim por khatwei sngi ban ïaid na u Lum Sinai sha Kadesh Barnea na shaphang ka ri lum Edom . )
U la synshar ha Hebron hynñiew snem ha Jerusalem laiphew snem lai .
translation.en: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years  ; seven years reigned he in Hebron , and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ka bor jong U ka Trai la long lem bad ki , bad kiba bun ki briew ki la ngeit bad ki phai la sha U Trai .
translation.en: And the hand of the Lord was with them : and a great number believed , and turned unto the Lord .

And I beheld , and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven , saying with a loud voice , Woe , woe , woe , to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels , which are yet to sound !
translation.kha: Nangta nga la khmih , nga la ïohsngew ïa u pukni uba her shajrong eh jong ka suiñ ba u pyrta ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Kaba kordit ! Kaba kordit ! Katno kaba kordit kan long ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthei haba ka jingsawa ka mih na ki turoi ïa kaba kita kiwei pat ki lai ngut ki angel kin put .
Ka Bathsheba ka dem ngon bad ka ong Ai , ba u kynrad jong nga , u syiem un im junom !
translation.en: Then Bath–sheba bowed with her face to the earth , and did reverence to the king , and said , Let my lord king David live for ever .

translation.kha: Naba U Blei un pyn-i ym jingsngewsynei haba u bishar ïa u briew u bym shym la leh-isynei ; hynrei ka jinglehisynei ka jop noh halor jingbishar ka .
translation.en: For he shall have judgment without mercy , that hath shewed no mercy  ; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment .

I told you before , and foretell you , as if I were present , the second time ; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned , and to all other , that , if I come again , I will not spare :
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban ïathuh ha kito na phi kiba la leh pop ha ki por ba la leit , bad sha baroh kiwei pat ; nga la ong ïa kane mynshuwa ha ka jingwan jngoh kaba ar ïa phi , hynrei ngan ong biang mynta ba nga don jngai : Ha kawei ka por ba nga wan yn ym don mano mano ban lait na ka jingshah pynshitom .

translation.en: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple , and went about to kill me .
translation.kha: Dei na kane ka daw ba ki Jiw ki la kem ïa nga katba nga dang don hapoh ka Templ , bad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee , and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor , and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee , or to the stock of the stranger s family :
translation.kha: Lada u nongwei uba shong bad phi u kylla riewspah , katba u para Israel u kylla duk bad u die mraw noh ïa lade ha uta u nongwei ne ha u dkhot ka longïing jong u .
da ïa ka jingwad bniah ban noh ïa ki nongïalam bad bujli ïa ki kiwei pat .
translation.en: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number , and set others in their stead .

translation.kha: Ko Trai Palat nga ap ïa ka jingpyllait im jong me .
translation.en: I have waited for thy salvation , O  Lord .
As the holy flock , as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts  ; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki nongbah kiba mynta ki don ha ka jingjot kin sa dap da ki paidbah kumba ka Jerusalem shisien ka ju dap da ki langbrot ba la wanrah kum ki jingkñia ha ka Jingkhawai Niam . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed , or my mouth hath kissed my hand :
translation.kha: Ym pat la ïalam bakla ïa nga ban burom ïa ki da kaba doh ïa la ki kti kum ka jingnguh ïa ki .

translation.en: Peter therefore was kept in prison : but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him .
translation.kha: Kumta la buh ïa u Petros ha ka phatok , hynrei ki briew jong ka balang ki la duwai jur ha U Blei na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea , and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus , an old disciple , with whom we should lodge .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki parabangeit na Kaisaria ruh ki la ïaleit bad ngi bad ki la ïalam ïa ngi sha ka ïing jong u briew ha kaba ngin sah — u Mnason , uba na Sypros , uba la long u parabangeit naduh ki sngi kiba dang sdang .
U buh ka ïa duwan ksiar hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , ha khmat ka pyrda ,
translation.en: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the veil :
Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace , that we may obtain mercy , and find grace to help in time of need .
translation.kha: To ngin sngewskhem , te , bad leit sha ka khet U Blei , ha kaba don ka jingaiei . Hangta ngin ïohpdiang ïa ka jingisynei bad ngin shem ïa ka jingaiei ka ban ïarap ïa ngi ha ka por ba ngi donkam ïa ka .

translation.en: And he said unto him , If thy presence go not with me , carry us not up hence .
translation.kha: U Moses u la jubab ,  Lada me hi men ym leit ryngkat bad ngi , wat ai ba ngin mihnoh na kane ka jaka .

translation.en: Thine eyes shall behold strange women , and thine heart shall utter perverse things .
translation.kha: Ki dur khyllah kin paw ha ki khmat jong phi , bad phin ym lah ban pyrkhat ne kren shai .

translation.en: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal  ; and he sat down among the ashes .
translation.kha: U Job u leit bad u shong ha ka kynton ñiut bad u shim da ki saraw khiew ba la pait ban trud ïa ki tohjaw kiba don ha u .
Phim pat ju ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u lane pat phim ju ïohi ïa ka khmat jong u , bad phim ju sumar ka ïa khubor jong u ha ki dohnud jong phi , naba phim ngeit ha ïa uta uba u la phah .
translation.en: And ye have not his word abiding in you : for whom he hath sent , him ye believe not .

translation.kha: Pha bud ki ha dien jat ka hynmen jong , pha bad kumta ngan ai ha pha ïa kajuh ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom ban dih .
translation.en: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister  ; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand .
Let them be only thine own , and not strangers  with thee .
translation.kha: Ki khun jong phi kin san ban ïarap ïa phi , ym ki nongwei .

translation.en: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah .
translation.kha: Kine ki la pynkthang mynsiem ïa u Isaak bad ïa ka Rebekka .

translation.en: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter , James , and John his brother , and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart ,
translation.kha: Hadien hynriew sngi U Jisu u la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros bad ïa ki ar ngut shi para , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis bad u la ïalam ïa ki sha u lumbah uba jrong ha kaba ki la ïadon tang ma ki hi .

Mar kumta hi u Belshassar u ïa ki shakri jong u ban pynphong ïa u ka jaiñkup syiem kaba bad ban pyndeng u ksiar ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ryndang jong u . Bad u la pynlong ïa u , uba lai ha bor hapoh ka hima .
translation.en: Then commanded Belshazzar , and they clothed Daniel with scarlet , and put a chain of gold about his neck , and made a proclamation concerning him , that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom .

Because thy rage against me , and thy tumult , is come up into mine ears , therefore will I put my hook in thy nose , and my bridle in thy lips , and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor jong kata ka jingbitar shla bad ka jingsarong jong me , bad mynta ngan buh ïa u khwai ha ka khmut jong me bad u bnoh ha ka shyntur jong me bad ngan pynphai pat na ka lynti ha kaba me la wan .

translation.en: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa une u shakri bymmyntoi — bret ïa u shabar ha kaba dum ; hangta un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .’

translation.en: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen , Who is he , and where is he , that durst presume in his heart to do so ?
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Serksis u kylli ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei ,  Mano ba nud ban leh kum ïa kata kaei kaei ? Uei uta u briew ?

translation.en: But Amaziah would not hear . Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up  ; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth–shemesh , which belongeth to Judah .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Amasaïah u kyntait ban shahshkor , kumta u syiem Jehoash u tur shaphrang lem bad ki rangbah jong u bad u ïaleh pyrshah ïa u ha Beth Shemesh ha Judah .

translation.en: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom . And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri , and cast it out to Joab . And he blew a trumpet , and they retired from the city , every man to his tent . And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king .
translation.kha: Nangta ka leit sha ki briew jong ka nongbah lem bad ka jingthmu jong ka , bad ki la khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u Sheba bad bret ïa ka sha u Joab nalor ka kynroh . U la put ïa ka turoi kum ka dak ïa ki rangbah jong u ban iehnoh ïa ka nongbah , bad ki leit phai noh sha ïing . Bad u Joab u la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem sha u syiem .

Kane ka dei kaei kaba Ynda Trai Arni u ong : Ngan phah kynjri ki saw balaitluid ki Sha basniew tlot jong nga ha ka Jerusalem — Pelusium thma , ka nemsniew , ki mradkhlaw , bad Lot jingpang — ban pynjot ïa bymïaineh briew bad sia mrad kumjuh jingneh
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem , the sword , and the famine , and the noisome beast , and the pestilence , to cut off from it man and beast ?

translation.kha: U Te Trai u ong ha u Moses ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: bad kylla-kaba-mut bad pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jong , kad ïa ki jaiñ jong phi bad ïam haba phi ïohsngew kumno nga byrngem ban pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad briew jong ka . Ngan pynlong ka kaba ishyrkhei ban peit , ka jaka ha ïa ka kyrteng jong , ki briew kin pyndonkam kum ka jingtim . nga la ïohsngew ïa jong phi ,
translation.en: Because thine heart was tender , and thou hast humbled thyself before the  Lord  , when thou heardest what I spake against this place , and against the inhabitants thereof , that they should become a desolation and a curse , and hast rent thy clothes , and wept before me  ; I also have heard thee , saith the  Lord .
And forthwith , when they were come out of the synagogue , they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew , with James and John .
translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u , kynthup ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki la mih na ka synagog bad ki la leit beit sha ka ïing u Simon bad u Andriw .

tih Trai u ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor jong ki ; ki Israel ki tur ïaleh bad ki bad ki beh kthong ïa ki shaphang shatei haduh Misrephoth Maim bad Sidon , bad shaphang mihngi haduh ka them Mispah . Ka jingïaleh ka neh haduh ba rangsamla don shuh uwei ruh u nongshun uba lait im .
translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of Israel , who smote them , and chased them unto great Zidon , and unto Misrephoth–maim , and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward  ; and they smote them , until they left them none remaining .

translation.kha: Mar kumta hi uta u kynjai u shiteng sngewthikna , u la rah Tikbah Ïaleh ka jingthiah Ninebeh shakri la sdang ban ïaid sawspah
translation.en: And immediately the man was made whole , and took up his bed , and walked : and on the same day was the sabbath .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Lada u briew u pyllait noh ïa la ka Shaphang , bad ka iehnoh ïa u bad ka pashait noh ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew , um dei ban shim pat ïa ka . Kane kan pyntngit lut ïa ka ri . Hynrei , ko Israel shongman pha la lah don shibun ki nongleh-ieit , bad mynta pha kwah ban “Kane phai sha nga !
translation.en: They say , If a man put away his wife , and she go from him , and become another man s , shall he return unto her again ? shall not that land be greatly polluted ? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers  ; yet return again to me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ïano phi leh biria ? Ïano ki nongshukor phi rkhiebeiñ ?
translation.en: Against whom do ye sport yourselves ? against whom make ye a wide mouth , and draw out the tongue ? are ye not children of transgression , a seed of falsehood ,

translation.kha: ( Na ka bynta ki kumjuh ruh na bynta ki baroh , bud ïa ka kaba ki la ïoh na ki kpa tymmen jong ki : ju lymda ki sait ïa la ki kti ha ka rukom kaba dei ;
translation.en: For the Pharisees , and all the Jews , except they wash their hands oft , eat not , holding the tradition of the elders .

translation.kha: Hynrei hikai ba lada u briew u don kaei kaei kaba u lah ban pyndonkam ïarap ïa la u kpa lane ïa la ka kmie , hynrei u ong , ‘ Kane ka long ka jong U Blei ,’ um donkam burom ïa la u kpa .
translation.en: But ye say , Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother , It is a gift , by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me  ;

translation.kha: U Petros u la kner ïa la ki , kti u bad la ïarap pynkhie ïa ka . Nangta u la khot ki ïa parabangeit baroh , kynthup ïa ki riewkynthei , u la aiti ïa ka ha ki , ka briew kaba la im pat .
translation.en: And he gave her his hand , and lifted her up , and when he had called the saints and widows , presented her alive .
And the afflicted people thou wilt save : but thine eyes are upon the haughty , that thou mayest bring them down .
translation.kha: Me pyllait im ïa kito kiba sngewrit , hynrei me pynhiar ïa kito kiba sarong .
Ki briew kiba duna ka jingtip ki ïoh ïa kaei kaba ka jingbieit jong ki ka dei ïoh ban , hynrei ha kiba sian la da ainong ka jingtip .
translation.en: The simple inherit folly : but the prudent are crowned with knowledge .
We are imitating Jesus .
translation.kha: Ngi bud ïa ka nuksa jong u Jisu .

translation.en: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee : begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn .
translation.kha: Ñiew hynñiew taïew naduh ba phi sdang ot ïa u kew ,
U Trai u la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad thied uwei u khra khyndew . U la ong ïa ruh nga ban ïalam katto ngut katne ki tymmen ki san jong ki briew bad katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh ba tymmen la ,
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Go and get a potter s earthen bottle , and take of the ancients of the people , and of the ancients of the priests  ;

translation.kha: Haba me hukum ïa ki briew me ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah nongshun jong ki bad ba ki duwai ha hangno hangno ha kaba ki don , ki da phai khmat sha kane ka nongbah ïa kaba me la jied bad sha kane ka Templ ïa nga la tei na ka bynta jong me ,
translation.en: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy , whithersoever thou shalt send them , and shall pray unto the  Lord  toward the city which thou hast chosen , and toward the house that I have built for thy name :
Beloved , let us love one another : for love is of God  ; and every one that loveth is born of God , and knoweth God .
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit , to ngin ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei , namar ka jingieit ka wan na U Blei . Uno uno uba ieit , u long u khun jong U Blei bad u ithuh ïa U Blei .

U dieng Dumbur , ko parabangeit jong nga , um lah ban sei ïa ki soh Olib 48 ne u dieng sohwaiñ um lah ban sei ïa ki mad Dumbur , lymne ka umpohliew mluh ïapynbeit lah Mawsiang pynmih ïa ka um kaba bang .
translation.en: Can the fig tree , my brethren , bear olive berries ? either a vine , figs ? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh .
Thinkest thou this to be right , that thou saidst , My righteousness is more than God s ?
translation.kha: Kam long kaba dei , ko Job , na ka bynta jong me ban ong ba me long uba lui lui ha khmat U Blei ,
Wat rah ïa ka pla pisa lane ïa ka pla khrong lane ïa ki juti ; wat sangeh ban khublei ïano ïano ha lynti ka .
translation.en: Carry neither purse , nor scrip , nor shoes : and salute no man by the way .
For whoso findeth me findeth life , and shall obtain favour of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U briew uba shem ïa nga u shem ïa ka jingim , bad U  Trai  un sngewbha ïa u .
Katba U Sumar u dang wan hajan Soar Jerikho , la don u briew bamatlah uba Rieh harud ka lynti bah , u da khrong .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that as he was come nigh unto Jericho , a certain blind man sat by the way side begging :

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ruh ngi ïohknieh ïa ki shnong Timaïos maw-it baroh — ym pynlyngngoh kawei ruh kaba lait ; baroh ba-don ki jingbei ki Ktah hynriewphew tylli krem ïa ka thain Argob baroh kawei ha kaba u Og u Syiem Bashan u hangtei nongot
translation.en: And we took all his cities at that time , there was not a city which we took not from them , threescore cities , all the region of Argob , the kingdom of Og in Bashan .

And I will turn thee back , and put hooks into thy jaws , and I will bring thee forth , and all thine army , horses and horsemen , all of them clothed with all sorts of armour , even a great company with bucklers and shields , all of them handling swords :
translation.kha: Ngan pynphai sawdong ïa u , ngan buh ki khwai ha ki tyngam jong u bad ngan patan noh ïa u bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh . Ka kynhun shipai jong u ka long kaba khraw , lem bad ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai kiba riam ryntih , bad man la u shipai uba rah ka stieh bad kieng ka waitlam .

translation.en: We would have healed Babylon , but she is not healed : forsake her , and let us go every one into his own country : for her judgment reacheth unto heaven , and is lifted up even to the skies .
translation.kha: Ki nongwei kiba sah hangta ki ong , ‘ Ngi la pyrshang ban ïarap ïa ka Babilonia , hynrei ka la dier palat . To ngin ieh ïa ka mynta bad ngin leit phai noh sha ïing . U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ka Babilonia da ka bor jong u baroh bad u la pynjot thiaw ïa ka .’

translation.en: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven , having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth , and to every nation , and kindred , and tongue , and people ,
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel uba her shajrong eh ha suiñ , lem bad ka khubor bymjukut jong ka Khubor Babha ban pynbna ha ki briew ka pyrthei , ha kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew , ka jait , ka ktien bad ka kynja bynriew .

translation.en: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you , he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you .
translation.kha: Lada U Mynsiem jong U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa U Jisu na ka jingïap , u im hapoh jong phi , te uta uba la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap , un ai jingim ruh ïa ki met ba kynja doh jong phi da ka jingdon U Mynsiem jong u hapoh jong phi .

translation.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth : the generation of the upright shall be blessed .
translation.kha: Ki khun jong u briew uba bha kin long kiba donbor ha ka ri ; ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin long kiba la kyrkhu .
Hynrei lada u briew u shun ïa la u paramarjan bad u apthap ïa u , bad u shoh bad ïa pynmynsaw haduh u ba un da ïap bad , nangta u phet sha kawei na kita ki shnong ban ïoh jingïada ,
translation.en: But if any man hate his neighbour , and lie in wait for him , and rise up against him , and smite him mortally that he die , and fleeth into one of these cities :
And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head , and put the holy crown upon the mitre .
translation.kha: Pynphong ïa ka jaiñspong ha ka khlieh jong u bad teh halor jong ka ïa ka dak bakyntang jong ka jingpynkyntang ba la thoh ‘ La Pynkyntang sha U  Trai .’

Kumno lada U jong U Trai u rah noh ïa phi sha jaka bymtip tang mar ïamih ma nga ? Nangta haba ïathuh ïa u Ahab ba don hangne , um lah ban shem ïa phi un pynïap ïa nga . To kynmaw ba long uba mane hok ïa U naduh ba nga dang khynnah
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , as soon as I am gone from thee , that the Spirit of the  Lord  shall carry thee whither I know not  ; and so when I come and tell Ahab , and he cannot find thee , he shall slay me : but I thy servant fear the  Lord  from my youth .
Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering  ; ( for he is faithful that promised  ; )
translation.kha: To ngin batskhem da ka jingkyrmen ïa kaba ngi ïaphla , namar ngi lah ban shaniah ba U Blei u bat ïa la ka kular .

Ma Heth bad ki khun kynthei jong ka ki la spel namar ki la khliehduh kyrhai ban jingidiaw bad im Jingkhot ka jingsuk bad ka jingjar jar ïathuhlypa hynrei kim shym la sumar ïa kiba duk bad ïa kiba rangli .
translation.en: Behold , this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom , pride , fulness of bread , and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters , neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy .
We have sinned with our fathers , we have committed iniquity , we have done wickedly .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh ; ngi la long bymman bad sniew .
Ka la long la jan sngi shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . U Pilat u la ong ha ki briew , Une u syiem jong phi !
translation.en: And it was the preparation of the passover , and about the sixth hour : and he saith unto the Jews , Behold your King !
And the crowns shall be to Helem , and to Tobijah , and to Jedaiah , and to Hen the son of Zephaniah , for a memorial in the temple of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka pansngiat kan long ka jingpynsah kynmaw ha ka Templ jong U  Trai  ha ka jingñiewburom ïa u Heldai , u Tobijah , u Jedaïah , bad u Josaïah .

translation.en: As for our redeemer , the  Lord  of hosts is his name , the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel u pyllaitluid ïa ngi — ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: The virgin of Israel is fallen  ; she shall no more rise : she is forsaken upon her land  ; there is none to raise her up .
translation.kha: Ka theisotti Israel ka la kyllon ; Kan ym khie pat lano lano ! Ka shah iehnoh ha ka khyndew Bad ym don uwei ruh u ban khyllie ïa ka .
Lada ma bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin phai pat sha U Trai bad kohnguh da ka jong phi , bad da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh ïa ki hukum jong u kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ,
translation.en: And shalt return unto the  Lord  thy God , and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day , thou and thy children , with all thine heart , and with all thy soul  ;

translation.kha: Bud ïa ki hati jong pynlwait , Golan leh kat ïa kaba nga hukum . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Ye shall do my judgments , and keep mine ordinances , to walk therein : I am the  Lord  your God .
And they set the priests in their divisions , and the Levites in their courses , for the service of God , which is at Jerusalem  ; as it is written in the book of Moses .
translation.kha: Ki la buh ryntih ruh ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi na ka bynta ka jingshakri ha ka Templ ha Jerusalem , kat kum ki jingbthah bad don ha ka kitab u Moses .

translation.en: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished .
translation.kha: Kan mut ruh ba kiba ngeit ha U Khrist , kiba la ïap ki long kiba la jot noh keiñ .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , when the meat offering was offered , that , behold , there came water by the way of Edom , and the country was filled with water .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , ha ka por kñia ba man ka step , ka um ka la wan tuid na ka phang Edom , bad ka la pyndap ïa ka madan .

U Joshua u la khie dang step ha ka sngi kaba bud , ha ka sien kaba ar ki lyngdoh bad ki shipai ki ïaid tawiar ïa ka ha kajuh rukom kumba ki leh ha sngi kaba la dep : nyngkong ka kynhun shipai na khmat kata , ki hynñiew ngut ki put ïa hynñiew tylli ki turoi nangta , ki kiba bah ïa ka ka Jutang U Trai bad khatduh , ka shipai na shadien . Ha ki por baroh la put ïa ki turoi
translation.en: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams  horns before the ark of the  Lord  went on continually , and blew with the trumpets : and the armed men went before them  ; but the rearward came after the ark of the  Lord  , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .

translation.kha: U Nehemaïah , u khun jong u Asbuk , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Bethsur , distrik u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud haduh ka jingtep u Dabid , pungsum ka bad jaka sah shipai .
translation.en: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk , the ruler of the half part of Beth–zur , unto the place over against the sepulchres of David , and to the pool that was made , and unto the house of the mighty .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrshah ïa ka bor kaba synshar , u pyrshah ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la hukum ; bad uno uba uno leh kumta un wallam ka jingbishar pynrem halor hi lade .
translation.en: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power , resisteth the ordinance of God : and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation .

translation.kha: U la sdang ban shlur ha ka synagog . Haba ka Priskila u Akwila ki la ïa , ki la ïalam sha la ïing bad ki ha u kham bniah ïa ka Lynti jong Blei .
translation.en: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue : whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard , they took him unto them , and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly .
The works of his hands are verity and judgment  ; all his commandments are sure .
translation.kha: Ha baroh kaba u leh u long uba ïaineh bad uba hok ; ki hukum jong u baroh ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .
Te ngan kyntait ban ïarap ïa ki namar ba ki leh bymman bad mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei .
translation.en: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought , in that they are turned unto other gods .
Stolen waters are sweet , and bread eaten in secret is pleasant .
translation.kha: Ka um ba shu tuh ka kham shngiam , ka jingbam ba shu tuh ka kham bang .

translation.en: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee : thy throne shall be established for ever .
translation.kha: Men ïai don ki khun ki ksiew , bad ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong me ban neh junom . Ka longïing syiem jong me kan ym kut .’

Bad ki Israel ki duwai ïa kane ka jingduwai : Ma me , Ko Trai ma me hi long U Trai ; me thaw ki bneng ki khlur jong ka bneng . Me thaw ka ryngkew bad ïa ka bad baroh kiba don ha ki ; me ai jingim ïa baroh . Ki ha bneng ki bad ki mane ïa me .
translation.en: Thou , even thou , art  Lord  alone  ; thou hast made heaven , the heaven of heavens , with all their host , the earth , and all things that are therein , the seas , and all that is therein , and thou preservest them all  ; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee .
A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things : and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things .
translation.kha: U briew uba bha u sei ïa kiei kiei kiba bha na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba bha ; u briew uba sniew u sei ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba sniew .

translation.en: They shall cut down her forest , saith the  Lord  , though it cannot be searched  ; because they are more than the grasshoppers , and are innumerable .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong ki , ki bun shaba palat ban ñiew ; ki shipai jong ki , ki kham bun ban ïa ki puit .
Wat ai phlangïap Luhith ïa kine ki briew ban jingmaham pdeng . Ieh kin leit ïawad phlangïap hi da lade .
translation.en: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick , as heretofore : let them go and gather straw for themselves .

translation.kha: Phi long borabor ha ka dohnud jong nga ! Kumta ka long kaba dei ïa nga ban sngew kumba nga sngew shaphang jong phi . phi baroh la lem bad nga ha kane ka lad kaba Blei u la ai ha nga mynta haba nga don ha byndi bad ruh haba nga la long laitluid ban ïada ka gospel bad ha kaba tei pynskhem ïa .
translation.en: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all , because I have you in my heart ; inasmuch as both in my bonds , and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel , ye all are partakers of my grace .
Judgment also will I lay to the line , and righteousness to the plummet : and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies , and the waters shall overflow the hiding place .
translation.kha: Ka jingbishar hok kan long u  sai-thew na ka bynta ka nongrim , bad ka jinglehhok kan long u  sai-sawar jong ka .  U phria un sar noh ïa baroh ki jingshukor ha kiba phi shaniah , bad ki jingshlei kin pynjot ïa ki jingsngewshngain jong phi .

translation.en: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords , and drank wine before the thousand .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet u syiem Belshassar u la khot sngewbha shihajar ngut ki rangbah donburom sha ka jingkhawai kaba khraw , bad ki la ïadih waiñ lang .

translation.en: And Samuel lay until the morning , and opened the doors of the house of the  Lord . And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision .
translation.kha: U Samuel u thiah haduh ban da shai ; nangta u la khie bad plie ïa ki jingkhang ka ïing U  Trai . U la sheptieng ban ïathuh ha u Eli shaphang kata ka jingïohipaw .

translation.en: And when we were all fallen to the earth , I heard a voice speaking unto me , and saying in the Hebrew tongue ,  Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks .
translation.kha: Ngi baroh ngi la hap sha madan , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba kren ha nga ha ka ktien Hebru , ‘ Saul , Saul ! balei me pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ? Me pynmong ïa lade da kaba ïaleh pyrshah , kumba u masi dab u kynjat pyrshah ïa u dieng jong u kynrad jong u .’

translation.en: I will shew thee , hear me  ; and that which I have seen I will declare  ;
translation.kha: Mynta to shahshkor , ko Job , ïa kaei kaba nga tip ngan ïathuh .

Nangta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha u pyntieng , bad ki la ong , U Haram , U Jingmyntoi ki Israel sngewkmen u ong , ‘ Shah ïa ki briew ngon ot ban leit Barsabbas khnang ba kin ïoh pynlong ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam tohjaw ka ri oh ban pyndonburom ïa nga .’
translation.en: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in , and told Pharaoh , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Let my people go , that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Shisien man lai , ai kawei-na-kaba-shiphew — kaba shiphew na ki jingthung phi — ha ki Lebi ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , khnang ba ha man la ka shnong kin ïoh bam kdang . Haba la leh ïa kane ,
translation.en: When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year , which is the year of tithing , and hast given it unto the Levite , the stranger , the fatherless , and the widow , that they may eat within thy gates , and be filled  ;
Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father .
translation.kha: Kumta keiñ , baroh ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong u Lot ki la punkhun na u kpa la jong .

translation.en: Then he shall minister in the name of the  Lord  his God , as all his brethren the Levites do , which stand there before the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad u lah ban shakri hangta kum u lyngdoh jong U  Trai  U Blei jong u , kum kiwei pat ki Lebi kiba ïashakri hangta .

translation.en: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people , and laid before their faces all these words which the  Lord  commanded him .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u wan hiar bad u la khot lang ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
U Angel jong U Blei uba la ju don ha khmat jong ki paid Israel u la kynriah bad u la leit shadien . U rishot lyoh ruh u kynriah noh haduh tad ba la u don hapdeng ki Ijipt nong bad ki Israel .
translation.en: And the angel of God , which went before the camp of Israel , removed and went behind them  ; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face , and stood behind them :

translation.kha: u leit ha shuwa jong ki , u da nguh ngon haduh khyndew hynñiew sien katba u nang leit jan u hynmen u .
translation.en: And he passed over before them , and bowed himself to the ground seven times , until he came near to his brother .
Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs , singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord ;
translation.kha: To ïakren iwei ïa iwei pat da ki ktien ha ki salm , ki jingrwai ïaroh bad ki jingrwai ba kynja mynsiem ; da kaba rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh bad ki salm sha U Trai da ki jingïaroh ha ki dohnud jong phi .
Hangta ha ka , kumba la ïa ka , la don u briew uba la dkoh baroh shi jingim . Man ka bah ïa u sha ka khyrdop ban khrong pisa na ki briew kiba ka Templ
translation.en: And a certain man lame from his mother s womb was carried , whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful , to ask alms of them that entered into the temple  ;

translation.kha: ïohknieh kiba donbok lypa ïa ka lawei kin shah pynjahburom da ka jingbymlah jong ki . jingdap kin shah ïam namar U Blei um shym Ainguh ïa smat jingpyrkhat
translation.en: Then shall the seers be ashamed , and the diviners confounded : yea , they shall all cover their lips  ; for there is no answer of God .

And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone  ; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai : wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus , even the people of Mordecai .
translation.kha: bad haba u tip ba u Mordekai u dei u Jiw , u la rai ban pynshitom ym tang ïa u Mordekai marwei . U la don ka jingthmu ban pynïap ïa baroh ki Jiw ha ka hima Persia baroh kawei .

translation.en: Then said they unto him , Who art thou ? that we may give an answer to them that sent us . What sayest thou of thyself ?
translation.kha: Te ïathuh ïa ngi me dei uei ,  ki la ong .  Ngi hap ban rah ïa ka jubab sha kito kiba la phah ïa ngi . Kumno me ong shaphang ïa lade ?
Ka Templ kaba bathymmai kan kham iphuh ban ïa kaba rim , bad hangta ngan ha ki briew jong nga ïa ka jingdap kyrhai bad ka jingsuk . U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la kren .
translation.en: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former , saith the  Lord  of hosts : and in this place will I give peace , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
Ye shall not do so unto the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Wat mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi kumba leh kita ki briew .
U Trai u ïa phah ka ding najrong , bad ka thang duh ïa jingkñia ka , ïa ki diengthang bad ïa ki maw ; ka pyningkhong ïa ka khyndew bad pynrngad ïa lut ka um ha ka kharai .
translation.en: Then the fire of the  Lord  fell , and consumed the burnt sacrifice , and the wood , and the stones , and the dust , and licked up the water that was in the trench .

And it came to pass , when Pharaoh had let the people go , that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines , although that was near  ; for God said , Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war , and they return to Egypt :
translation.kha: Mynba u Pharaoh u shah ïa uta u paidbah ban leit noh , U Blei um shym ïalam ïa ki na ka lynti kaba poi shatei sha ka phang Philistia , wat la ka long kaba jan tam . U Blei u ong ,  Ngam kwah ba kine ki briew kin kylla dien bad kin leit phai pat sha Ijipt haba ki ïohi ba ki hap ban ïaleh thma .

translation.en: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial  ; they knew not the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang u Eli ki dei ki riewbymman . Kim ju shahshkor ïa U  Trai

translation.en: And I commanded Joshua at that time , saying , Thine eyes have seen all that the  Lord  your God hath done unto these two kings : so shall the  Lord  do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest .
translation.kha: Nangta nga ong ha u Joshua , ‘ Me la ïohi ïa kata baroh kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong me u la leh ïa kito ki ar ngut ki syiem , u Sihon bad u Og ; un leh kumjuh ïa kita baroh ïa kiba men dang hiarthma ha ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted , whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom , that they may make Aaron s garments to consecrate him , that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Khot ïa ki nongsuhjaiñ batbit kiba nga la ai ha ki ka sap bad ong ïa ki ba kin suh ïa ki jaiñkup u Aaron khnang ba yn ïoh pynkyntang ïa u kum u lyngdoh ban shakri ïa nga .

translation.en: He sheweth his word unto Jacob , his statutes and his judgments unto Israel .
translation.kha: U ai ïa ka khubor jong u sha ki briew jong u , ki jingbthah bad ki aiñ jong u ïa ki Israel .
Nga la ai ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban na ïoh ka bynta ka bad jingbymkhuid ka jingbymman jong ki , bad nga la phai noh na ki .
translation.en: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them , and hid my face from them .

translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei long ïa phi kiba angnud ïa ka sngi Trai ! Kaei kaba ka sngi kan long ïa phi ? Na ka bynta jong phi kan long tang ka sngi jong jingdum , bad ym jong ka jingshai .
translation.en: Woe unto you that desire the day of the  Lord  ! to what end is it for you ? the day of the  Lord  is darkness , and not light .

For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations , that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon  ; and they shall serve him : and I have given him the beasts of the field also .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ba un buh ka lyngkor nar halor kine ki jaitbynriew baroh bad ba kin shakri ïa u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilonia . U  Trai  u la ong ba un pynlong wat ïa ki mradkhlaw ban shakri ïa u Nebukhadnessar .
Hynrei U Jisu um ïohktah la shaniah Mahli ba-donnam ha ki ïapmat namar ba u la tip ïa ki pynkyndit .
translation.en: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them , because he knew all men ,
I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel :
translation.kha: Nga sngewlyngngoh ïa phi ! Tang katto katne por phi la iehnoh ïa uta uba la khot ïa phi da ka jingaiei U Khrist , bad ba phi la pdiang ïa kawei pat ka Gospel .

Wat siew kylliang kaba ïa sniew da sniew kaba lane ïa ka jingtim da ka jingtim ; pynban to , siew kylliang da ka jingkyrkhu , namar ka jingkyrkhu ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la kular ban ai ïa phi mynba u la khot ïa phi .
translation.en: Not rendering evil for evil , or railing for railing : but contrariwise blessing  ; knowing that ye are thereunto called , that ye should inherit a blessing .

But the men would not hearken to him : so the man took his concubine , and brought her forth unto them  ; and they knew her , and abused her all the night until the morning : and when the day began to spring , they let her go .
translation.kha: Hynrei kita ki briew kim shahshkor satia ïa u . Kumta u Lebi u shim ïa la ka tnga kliar bad u buh ïa ka shabar bad ki . Ki pynjahburom da kaba leh sang ïa ka baroh shi miet bad ki khlem sangeh haduh mynstep .
Yn ym don kawei ruh ka shnong ka ban lait na ka ; jingpynjot ki ri them bad ki ri thor kin shah pynjot Ma . nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And the spoiler shall come upon every city , and no city shall escape : the valley also shall perish , and the plain shall be destroyed , as the  Lord  hath spoken .

translation.kha: dkhot rangbah jong ka Anathoth ki la kwah ïa nga khyllad shah pynïap , bad ki la ong ïa step ba kin ïa-pihuin thehsei ïalehkmen lada nga dang ïai pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Trai .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of the men of Anathoth , that seek thy life , saying , Prophesy not in the name of the  Lord  , that thou die not by our hand :

translation.kha: to lehkmen ko lyngkha ki bad baroh kiei kiei kiba don ha pha ! Ki dieng ha ki khlaw kin risa da ka jingkmen ,
translation.en: Let the field be joyful , and all that is therein : then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

translation.kha: Don uwei u hangne uba don san tylli ki barli bad ar tylli dohkha . Hynrei kine kin ym pat biang na ka bynta ki briew baroh .
translation.en: There is a lad here , which hath five barley loaves , and two small fishes : but what are they among so many ?
And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man , and to birds , and fourfooted beasts , and creeping things .
translation.kha: ha ka jaka ba kin mane ïa U Blei uba im , ki mane ïa ki dur ba la thaw ban i kum u briew ne ki sim ne ki mrad ne ki mrad bapar kiba ïap noh .
Ngi ïoh ïa ka jingstad na ki briew ba la phuh ñiuhlieh kito — ïa kiba la kha ha shuwa u kpa jong me .
translation.en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men , much elder than thy father .

translation.kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u ïa ka khubor , bad ki kti jong u ki noh kyrwep . U ha jinglyng-a , da ka jingpang kum briew suh kha .
translation.en: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them , and his hands waxed feeble : anguish took hold of him , and pangs as of a woman in travail .

translation.kha: U Blei u uta long uba la thaw ki ïa bad lumbah uba pynlong ïa ki lyer . U pynpaw ïa la ki jingmut ha u briew ; u pynkylla ïa ka sngi sha ka miet . U ïaid ha kiba kynjang jong ka pyrthei . Kane ka long kyrteng ka jong u : U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh !
translation.en: For , lo , he that formeth the mountains , and createth the wind , and declareth unto man what is his thought , that maketh the morning darkness , and treadeth upon the high places of the earth , The  Lord  , The God of hosts , is his name .
And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song , until they were ended .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ïathuh ïa ki ktien jong kane ka jingrwai baroh kawei katba ki paid Israel baroh ki shahshkor .

translation.en: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem , and had taken it , and smitten it with the edge of the sword , and set the city on fire .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki kurup ïa ka . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka bad ki wiang ding ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: Now Barzillai was a very aged man , even fourscore years old : and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim  ; for he was a very great man .
translation.kha: U Barsillai u long uba la tymmen bha , u la phraphew snem ka rta . U long uba riewspah bha , bad u la pynbiang jingbam ïa u syiem mynba u dang sah ha Mahanaim .

translation.en: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted , he said unto Moses , There is a noise of war in the camp .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la ïohsngew ïa ki paidbah ba ki ïarisa bad u la ong ha u Moses ,  Nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kumba ïaleh thma ha ka jaka sher dara .
Mynta hangne u don u syiem phi la ; phi la pan ïa u , bad mynta U u la ai ïa ha phi
translation.en: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen , and whom ye have desired ! and , behold , the  Lord  hath set a king over you .

And she vowed a vow , and said , O  Lord  of hosts , if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid , and remember me , and not forget thine handmaid , but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child , then I will give him unto the  Lord  all the days of his life , and there shall no razor come upon his head .
translation.kha: Ka Hannah ka pynlong ka jingsmai kyntang ,  A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , to khmih ïa nga ka shakri jong me ! To peit ïa ka jingkordit jong nga bad kynmaw ïa nga ! To wat klet ïa nga ! Lada men ai khun shynrang ïa nga , nga kular ba ngan aiti ïa u sha me baroh shi rta ka jingim jong u , bad da lei lei yn ym khap ïa u shñiuh jong u .

Hynrei u Moses u , ong Em , ko Trai , wat phah ïa . nga Ngam ju u long nongkren ba-pnah , bad shym ngam long kum uwei na kita naduh ba me la sdang ban kren ïa nga . Nga long u bym pnah ban kren , uba suki bad uba thlun .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , O my Lord , I am not eloquent , neither heretofore , nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant : but I am slow of speech , and of a slow tongue .

translation.kha: Ka jingaiei ka jong U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi kan long lem bad phi . Amen .
translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you . Amen .

translation.kha: Bad ki jong kane ka jaitbynriew basniew kiba dang im , kiba shong ha ki jaka kiba nga la ïa ki , kin jied ban ïap ban ïa ki ïai . Ma , U Trai nga la kren .
translation.en: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family , which remain in all the places whither I have driven them , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la ot noh ïa ki angkor Borabor ki la shah ïa ki ba kin ngam ha ka duriaw lehbeiñ bad ha kajuh ka por ki la Heleph ïa nongïarap tyllai kiba la bat ïa ki boitha . Nangta ki la kyntiew ïa ka jaiñ pynshah lyer ha ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka Libya khnang Alos ka lyer ka lah ban beh pynpoh ka lieng sha lalot , bad ngi la ïaid beit sha ka ryngkew shat
translation.en: And when they had taken up the anchors , they committed themselves unto the sea , and loosed the rudder bands , and hoisted up the mainsail to the wind , and made toward shore .

And it shall come to pass , when all these things are come upon thee , the blessing and the curse , which I have set before thee , and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations , whither the  Lord  thy God hath driven thee ,
translation.kha: Mynta nga la ai ba phin jied napdeng ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingtim . Ynda kine kiei kiei baroh ki la wan jia ha phi , bad phi shong hapdeng ki jaitbynriew sha kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynsakma ïa phi , phin sa kynmaw ïa ka jingjied ba nga la ai ha phi .

translation.en: And said , I beseech thee , O  Lord  God of heaven , the great and terrible God , that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments :
translation.kha: Nga duwai ha U Blei ,  A  Trai  U Blei jong ka bneng ! Me long uba khraw , ngi ïeng ha ka jingsheptieng ïa me . Me batskhem ïa la ka jutang bad kito kiba ieit ïa me bad kiba leh ïa kaei kaba me hukum .
Ki la dem ngon ha khmat jong u , Oholibah u Joseph u ; , Kaei kane kaba Pung la leh ? Phim tip ba 29-35 briew uba ha ka longsem jong nga u lah ban lap ïa Hasarmabeth da ka kheiñ ka bishar ?
translation.en: And Joseph said unto them , What deed is this that ye have done ? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine ?
And if a man lie not in wait , but God deliver him into his hand  ; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka long tang kaba shu jia ryngkhat , bad um shym da mut shisha ban pynïap ïa u , u lah ban phet sha ka jaka kaba ngan jied na ka bynta jong phi , bad hangta un shngain .

translation.en: Ye are the children of the prophets , and of the covenant which God made with our fathers , saying unto Abraham , And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed .
translation.kha: Ki jingkular jong U Blei lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki long na ka bynta jong phi , bad phi ïoh bynta ha ka jutang kaba U Blei u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Kumba u la ong ha u Abraham , ‘ Lyngba ki khun ki ksiew jong me ngan kyrkhu ïa ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei .’

translation.en: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves , that ye love the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Da sumar bha te , ban ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

Mynta to kren ha ki har nongpynïap ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Sethan , nga ong ha ki : Uwei pa uwei u Israel uba la ai ïa la ka dohnud mahadei ki bleithaw bad shah ïa ki jingtipbriew ïalam ïa u sha thikna pop bad nangta uba pynsaphred tare kylli na u spaiñ , Asshurim ïoh ka jubab na nga — ka jubab Rwai ki bleithaw jong u ki dei hok ban ïoh !
translation.en: Therefore speak unto them , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart , and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face , and cometh to the prophet  ; I the  Lord  will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols  ;

And say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen , whither they be gone , and will gather them on every side , and bring them into their own land :
translation.kha: Nangta to ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan shim noh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh na ki jaitbynriew sha kiba ki la leit , ngan lumlang ïa ki na ki , bad wanrah pat ïa ki sha la ka jong ka ri .

translation.en: And he sent out arrows , and scattered them  ; lightning , and discomfited them .
translation.kha: U siat ïa ki khnam bad u pynsaphriang ïa ki nongshun jong u ; da ka jingthaba ka leilieh u pynher ïa ki .

translation.en: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death , and to the house appointed for all living .
translation.kha: Nga tip me la rah ïa nga sha ka jingïap , sha ka kupar ba la buh ïa baroh .
Kumta U Trai u ïa Bamaïan nga , ‘ tohkit la Jingshisha ïa kaba dei eh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , They have well spoken that which they have spoken .

translation.kha: Hynrei ynda ki la wan sha kane ka ri bad shimti ïa ka , kim kohnguh shym la ïa ki hukum jong me lane im kat kum ka jinghikai jong me ; kim shym la ïa leh kaba me la hukum ïa ki ban leh . Bad kumta me la wallam ïa kane ka baroh jingpynjot ha ki .
translation.en: And they came in , and possessed it  ; but they obeyed not thy voice , neither walked in thy law  ; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do : therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them :
And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices : and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne , which are the seven Spirits of God .
translation.kha: Na ka khet la mih ki jingthaba leilieh , ki jingkyrhuh , ki jingsawa u pyrthat . Ha khmat jong ka khet , la don hynñiew tylli ki dongmusa bameh , kiba long ki hynñiew ki mynsiem jong U Blei .

translation.en: And of Benjamin  ; Eliada a mighty man of valour , and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand .
translation.kha: U nongïalam jong ki shipai na ka kur Benjamin u dei u Eliada , u shipai batbit , uba long halor ki ar lakh ngut ki rangbah ba la kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki ryntieh .

Sning la wan sha u bad ki la ong , Ko Nonghikai , Ar tip ba me kren ïa ka jingshisha , khlem da khuslai ïa kaei kaba jingñiewbeiñ stet ki nongshimwai . Mem ñiew ïa ka kyrdan u briew , dabor me hikai ïa ka jingshisha shaphang ka skhep Kita Dionysius na ka bynta u sum . dap ïathuh ïa ngi , hato ka long pdiang ïa ka Hukum jong bajrong bakynja siew ki khajna sha u Krist ka Rom ? Hato ka dei ïa ngi ban siew ne ban ym un-long ?
translation.en: And when they were come , they say unto him , Master , we know that thou art true , and carest for no man : for thou regardest not the person of men , but teachest the way of God in truth : Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar , or not ?

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ki Philistia ïalumlang leit thma pyrshah ïa Israel , kumta Israel ki mih ban ïaleh ïa ki . Israel ki ha Ebeneser bad ki Philistia pat ha Aphek .
translation.en: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel . Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle , and pitched beside Eben–ezer : and the Philistines pitched in Aphek .

translation.kha: u mihnoh bad u wan sa hynñiew kiwei ki mynsiem wat kiba kham ban ïa u bad ki wan shongsah hangta . Kumta haba baroh ka la kut , uta un don ha ka kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba u la long ha sdang . ka long kaei ka ban jia ki briew kiba sniew jong kane ka por
translation.en: Then goeth he , and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself , and they enter in and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first . Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation .

translation.kha: Haduh ka por jong u Ïoannis baroh ki nongïathuhlypa bad ka Hukum Moses u ki la kren shaphang ka Hima ;
translation.en: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John .

translation.kha: Kumta ki Lebi kim donkam shuh ban kit ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai bad ïa ki tiar baroh ïa kiba la ha pyndonkam jingmane ka .
translation.en: And also unto the Levites  ; they shall no more carry the tabernacle , nor any vessels of it for the service thereof .

translation.kha: Ha u Lum Sinai me wan hiar na bneng ; jhur kren ha ki briew bad me ai ïa Bokhim , ki hukum babha bad ki jinghikai baskhem .
translation.en: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai , and spakest with them from heaven , and gavest them right judgments , and true laws , good statutes and commandments :
Only the land of the priests bought he not  ; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh , and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them : wherefore they sold not their lands .
translation.kha: Ïa ka khyndew kaba dei ka jong ki lyngdoh te um shym thied . Kim donkam ban die ïa la ka khyndew namar ba ki ïoh ka baibam kaba thikna na u syiem , bad ki im da kata .

translation.en: Now ye are the body of Christ , and members in particular .
translation.kha: Baroh na phi , phi long ka met U Khrist , bad uwei pa uwei u long u bynta jong ka .

translation.en: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches , and he that giveth to the rich , shall surely come to want .
translation.kha: Lada phi ai sngewbha sha ki briew kiba riewspah lane banbeiñ ïa kiba duk ban ïoh riewspah , phin long uba duk ïa lade .

u Nangta ai sa kawei hukum ka : Khie leit sha ki briew bad ong ïa ki ban wallam ïa la ki jingri bad ki langbrot hangne . ban Ki dei pynïap ïa ki bad bam ïa ki hangne ; kim dei ban leh pop pyrshah ïa Trai U da kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh ka jong . Kumta ha kata ka miet baroh ki wallam ïa la ki jingri bad ki pynïap ïa ki hangta .
translation.en: And Saul said , Disperse yourselves among the people , and say unto them , Bring me hither every man his ox , and every man his sheep , and slay them here , and eat  ; and sin not against the  Lord  in eating with the blood . And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night , and slew them there .
A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face  ; that sacrificeth in gardens , and burneth incense upon altars of brick  ;
translation.kha: Kim lehrain satia ban ïai pynbitar ïa nga . Ki ai jingkñia sha ki blei thala ha ki kper bakyntang bad thang jingiwbih ha ki duwan ba-thala .
Suk kito kiba shah pynshitom beiñ pynriewspah ba ki leh ïa kaei ïawad U Blei u dawa jingkhlaiñbor ka Hima ki bneng ka shekel ka jong ki !
translation.en: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness  sake : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .
And there was a certain man of Zorah , of the family of the Danites , whose name was Manoah  ; and his wife was barren , and bare not .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don u briew uba kyrteng u Manoah na ka shnong Sorah . U dei na ka jait Dan . Ka tnga jong u kam pat shym la lah ban ïoh khun .
Ki synran jong u ki la kylli ïa U Jisu aïu kane ka pharshi ka kit jingmut ,
translation.en: And his disciples asked him , saying , What might this parable be ?

translation.kha: bad u la kit sha Babilon ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ha ka Templ bad ïingsyiem . Kumba U Trai u la ïathuhlypa , u Nebukhadnessar u la pynpait ïa baroh ki khiew ki pliang ksiar kiba u Solomon syiem u la thaw ka na bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka . Templ
translation.en: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house , and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the  Lord  , as the  Lord  had said .

translation.kha: Katba nga dang khmih ki reng , la ïohi ïa ka reng rit kaba napdeng kiwei pat . Ka tar ïa lai tylli reng don lypa hangta . Kane ka reng ka la don ki khmat briew bad ka shyntur kaba kob sarong .
translation.en: I considered the horns , and , behold , there came up among them another little horn , before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots : and , behold , in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man , and a mouth speaking great things .
Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day , detained before the  Lord   ; and his name was Doeg , an Edomite , the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul .
translation.kha: ( U rangbah nongap jingri jong u Saul , u Doeg uba na Edom , da kaba jia ryngkhat u don hangta ha kata ka sngi , namar u hap ban pyndep ïa ka kamram lehniam . )

translation.en: And he asked for a writing table , and wrote , saying , His name is John . And they marvelled all .
translation.kha: U Sekharaïah u la pan ïa ka kynja sleit bad u la thoh ,  Ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Ïoannis .  A katno baroh ki la ïasngew kyndit !

Na kane Andriw jingkerkut , Tahash jingkyrduh bam kyllut ka nongbah ka Haggith kyrmen kaba Hashabneïah katta katta kat haduh ba kawei ka khlieh kada ka jingkit phraphew ki sbai rupa , Meholah arspah gram ka Pekah paro ka Dagon san sbai rupa .
translation.en: And there was a great famine in Samaria : and , behold , they besieged it , until an ass s head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver , and the fourth part of a cab of dove s dung for five pieces of silver .
And he returned to Judah , and said , I cannot find her  ; and also the men of the place said , that there was no harlot in this place .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit phai noh sha u Judah , bad u ong ,  Ngam shym lap satia ïa ka . Ki rangbah jong kata ka jaka ruh ki ong ba ym ju don nuti hangta .
Katba ka dang suh kha , uwei ki u pynmih shabar la ka kti ; ka nongpynkha khun ka bat ïa kata kti , ka teh ïa ka u saisaw , ka ong , Une dei uba mih nyngkong
translation.en: And it came to pass , when she travailed , that the one put out his hand : and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread , saying , This came out first .
And oppress not the widow , nor the fatherless , the stranger , nor the poor  ; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart .
translation.kha: Wat banbeiñ ïa ki riewkynthei , ki khunswet , ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong phi , lane mano mano kiwei pat kiba kyrduh . Bad wat pyrkhat ïa ki rukom ban pynmynsaw iwei ïa iwei pat .’
U Samuel u la leit sha u Saul , uba la khublei ïa u , da kaba ong , U u Trai kyrkhu ïa phi , Samuel Nga ! la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Trai .
translation.en: And Samuel came to Saul : and Saul said unto him , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  : I have performed the commandment of the  Lord .
He casteth forth his ice like morsels : who can stand before his cold ?
translation.kha: U phah ïa u phria kum u mawria ; ym don uba lah ban shah ïa ka jingkhriat ba u phah !

translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  came from Sinai , and rose up from Seir unto them  ; he shined forth from mount Paran , and he came with ten thousands of saints : from his right hand went a fiery law for them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wan na u Lum Sinai ; u mih kum ka sngi ha Edom , bad u tyngshaiñ ha la ki briew na u Lum Paran . Shiphew hajar ki angel ki don ryngkat bad u , bad ka ding kaba meh ha ka kti kamon jong u .
bad shi kilo u purew lem uwei bad u khunlangbrot .
translation.en: A several tenth deal unto one lamb , throughout the seven lambs  ;

translation.kha: Ka ri jong harud phi duriaw kan kylla long ki pyntha bym don lem jingkah bad ki trep jong ki nongap langbrot bad ki sem langbrot .
translation.en: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds , and folds for flocks .

translation.kha: hakhmat ïada ïaid lynti na Tobijah lyngkha kew jongno jongno , phi lah ban sip ïa u sohkew uba phi kheit shisien la ki kti , hynrei phim dei ban ot ïa u da Jerah rashi .
translation.en: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour , then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand  ; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour s standing corn .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u jubab , Ka jingshyrkhei kaba khraw i jong pa nga i la leh ïa ki briew jong ngi ! haduh Khmih katno nga sngew ïohbor namar ba nga bam khyndiat ka ngap !
translation.en: Then said Jonathan , My father hath troubled the land : see , I pray you , how mine eyes have been enlightened , because I tasted a little of this honey .
According to the number that ye shall prepare , so shall ye do to every one according to their number .
translation.kha: Haba wanrah kham bun ki jingri , ïa ki jingainguh bynrap dei ban pynbun kat ban ïabiang .

translation.en: And , behold , there came a man named Jairus , and he was a ruler of the synagogue : and he fell down at Jesus  feet , and besought him that he would come into his house :
translation.kha: Te u briew uba kyrteng u Jairos u la wan poi ; u la long u rangbah synshar ha ka synagog kaba ha kata ka shnong . U la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong U Jisu bad u la kyrpad ïa u ban leit sha ïing jong u ,
Wat pat leit tat ynda nga wanrah ha me ka jingainguh bam U jubab , ap haduh ba men da wan pat .
translation.en: Depart not hence , I pray thee , until I come unto thee , and bring forth my present , and set it before thee . And he said , I will tarry until thou come again .
Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction , and maketh him families like a flock .
translation.kha: Hynrei u pyllait ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingjynjar jong ki bad pynlong ïa ki longïing jong ki ban roi kum ki jingri .

translation.en: But when thou doest alms , let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth :
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi ïarap ïa u briew uba kyrduh , leh ïa ka ha kata ka rukom ba wat u paralok bajan tam jong phi un ym tip shaphang kata .
Dieng jingkordit kulmar ïa Ephod nongshun jong phi . Ngan beh noh ïa ki Hib , ki Kanaan , bad ki Hit khrew Jekolaïah nang Pynshitom sha khmat .
translation.en: And I will send hornets before thee , which shall drive out the Hivite , the Canaanite , and the Hittite , from before thee .

translation.kha: U Josaïah u la don phra snem jingbang rta mynba u long u syiem ka jingpyndonkam sangsot Pynbthi u synshar bapher Shallum snem ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years .
A new commandment I give unto you , That ye love one another  ; as I have loved you , that ye also love one another .
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga ai ha phi ka hukum kaba thymmai ; to ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei .
U Nahash jubab , Ngan ïateh jutang bad phi halor kawei ka kyndon : khlaw ïa ka khmat kamon phi baroh , bad da kumta ngan pynjahburom halor Israel baroh .
translation.en: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them , On this condition will I make a covenant with you , that I may thrust out all your right eyes , and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel .

translation.kha: Ong ïa Lo-ammi ïohmad ‘ I pa jong nga i la buh ha phi ïa ka jingkit kaba oh-shrong ; nga ngan kham pynkhia shuh shuh ïa baïar , i pa i la shoh ïa Ki da u riphin ; nga ngan sympat ïa phi da u shabuk !’
translation.en: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke , I will add to your yoke : my father hath chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .

translation.kha: To pan na U u slap pyrem jong snem . U dei U Trai uba ïa ki lyoh bad lap praw , da pynjyrngam ïa lyngkha na bynta uwei pa uwei .
translation.en: Ask ye of the  Lord  rain in the time of the latter rain  ; so the  Lord  shall make bright clouds , and give them showers of rain , to every one grass in the field .

translation.kha: bad ngan wallam pat longïing ki Adriel mihngi bad na sepngi ban shong pynbieit shoh-ïap ha jingshoh . ïapyrshang long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki , da kaba synshar ha ka jingïaineh jingpait ha ka jinglehhok .
translation.en: And I will bring them , and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem : and they shall be my people , and I will be their God , in truth and in righteousness .
Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary , and have given Jacob to the curse , and Israel to reproaches .
translation.kha: bad ki nongsynshar jong phi ki la pyntngit ïa ka ïingkyntang jong nga . Kumta nga la wallam ka jingpynjot ha Israel ; nga shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban shah rkhiebeiñ .
Te naba ka la long ka sngi shuwa ka Sabbaton bad namar ba ka jingtep ka don ha jingïa-umsnam jingdeng Khlemlait la buh ïa ka ïadoh U Jisu hangta .
translation.en: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews  preparation day  ; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand .
Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer , and for this I make haste .
translation.kha: Ko Job , phi la pynbitar ïa nga . Mynta ngam lah ap shuh ban jubab .

translation.en: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another  ; but thou shalt fear thy God : for I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Wat shukor ïa la u para Israel , hynrei kohnguh ïa U  Trai  uba U Blei jong phi .
Ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u saiñpyrkhat uba nyngkong jong ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jinglongmraw jong Gadara , U Trai u la naba ha nga Nahor
translation.en: It came to pass also in the twelfth year , in the fifteenth day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Hasor , ma nga , U , Trai nga maham ïa phi ban noh phet bad ban leit rieh . U Nebukhadnessar u , syiem ka Babilonia u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa phi , bad kane ka dei kaei kaba u ong ,
translation.en: Flee , get you far off , dwell deep , O ye inhabitants of Hazor , saith the  Lord   ; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you , and hath conceived a purpose against you .
He healeth the broken in heart , and bindeth up their wounds .
translation.kha: U pynkhiah ïa kiba la pait dohnud bad u sop spaiñ ïa ki jingmong jong ki .
Balei Snem ba phi wan ïalam ïa ngi sha kane ka ri khlaw ? Hato ba ngin ïap hangne bad la ki Naomi ?
translation.en: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the  Lord  into this wilderness , that we and our cattle should die there ?

translation.kha: Hynrei kim noh Kanaan kiba shong ha Geser ; kumta ki ki la shong la hapdeng Ephraim haduh kane ka sngi , hynrei la ïa ki ban trei kum ki mraw .
translation.en: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer : but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day , and serve under tribute .
And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast , these shall hate the whore , and shall make her desolate and naked , and shall eat her flesh , and burn her with fire .
translation.kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng kiba me la ïohi , bad u mradkhlaw , kin isih ïa ka nuti ; kin sa knieh noh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ka don bad kin iehnoh lyngkhuit ïa ka ; kin bam ïa ka doh jong ka bad kin pynjot ïa ka da ka ding .

translation.en: O Israel , thou hast destroyed thyself  ; but in me is thine help .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa phi , ko ki paid Israel ! Te uei uba lah ban ïarap ïa phi ?

translation.en: Therefore , thou son of man , prophesy against Gog , and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Gog , the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ko khun u briew , to kren pyrshah ïa u Gog , u nongsynshar rangbah jong ki jaitbynriew ka Meshekh bad ka Tubal bad ïathuh ïa u ba nga long u nongshun jong u .

Nangta ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang kiba shong ha ki khet jong ki khmat ha U Blei ki la dem ngon ïa lade bad ki la mane ïa U Blei , da kaba ong : Ko Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , uta uba long bad uba ju la long ! Ngi ïa ainguh me ba me la shimti ïa bor ka bakhraw jong me me bad la sdang ban synshar !
translation.en: Saying , We give thee thanks , O Lord God Almighty , which art , and wast , and art to come  ; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power , and hast reigned .

translation.kha: Ngan pynkhie da Bashti thma ban pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingpynkheiñ jutang jong phi , bad pynsngewrem phi wad ïakren ryngkew .—Jingpynpaw ïalumlang ha la ki shnong , ngan phah ïa ki jingpang lyngkhuh lah pynkhiah hapdeng jong phi bad Jingshyrkhei pynïong pyndem Abishag ki nongshun jong phi lawbah
translation.en: And I will bring a sword upon you , that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant : and when ye are gathered together within your cities , I will send the pestilence among you  ; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy .

translation.kha: ka briew ka la long ka , ba la ka thain Phoenisia ha Syria . Ka la ïa ban beh noh ïa u ksuid na ka khun jong ka .
translation.en: The woman was a Greek , a Syrophenician by nation  ; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister , to vex her , to uncover her nakedness , beside the other in her life time .

translation.kha: Mynta , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , to pyllait ïa ngi na ki Assyria , khnang ba baroh ki hima ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang ma me hi , U  Trai  , me long U Blei .
Kine ki san ngut ki syiem ki la pynlong ka jingïateh la ïasoh lang kum kawei ka kynhun ha ka Siddim kaba long mynta ka Duriaw Baïap .

The east wind carrieth him away , and he departeth : and as a storm hurleth him out of his place .

Baroh ïa ka kyrteng kaba khraw bad kaba kynja syiem jong . ma u !
translation.en: Let them praise thy great and terrible name  ; for it is holy .

translation.kha: U Trai kham Baroh jingkynnoh ong : Haba kata Jabesh sngi ka wan , ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor kaba don sawdong ka ryndang jong ki bad ngan weng ïa ki kynjri jong ki , bad kin ym long shuh ki mraw jong ki nongwei .
translation.en: For it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that I will break his yoke from off thy neck , and will burst thy bonds , and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him :
Hast thou an arm like God ? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him ?
translation.kha: Hato me long uba khlaiñ kum ma nga ? Hato ka sur jong me ka kyrhuh jam kum ka jong nga ?

Ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi U ! la pynpaw kaba katno u sngewbha ïa phi da kaba pynlong ïa phi u syiem u ban synshar ha ka kyrteng jong u . Namar ba u ieit ïa ki jong briew u Israel , ki , bad u kwah ban pynneh ïa ki junom , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong khnang ki ban pynneh ïa ka hukum bad ka jingbishar hok .
translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne , to be king for the  Lord  thy God : because thy God loved Israel , to establish them for ever , therefore made he thee king over them , to do judgment and justice .
As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord , so walk ye in him :
translation.kha: Naduh ba phi la pdiang ïa U Khrist Jisu kum U Trai , to im ha u .

translation.en: But the men marvelled , saying , What manner of man is this , that even the winds and the sea obey him !
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei baroh u la sngewphylla .  U briew uba kumno une u long ?  ki la ong .  Wat ki lyer bad ki jingat phyllung ki kohnguh ïa u !

translation.en: Thou shalt be visited of the  Lord  of hosts with thunder , and with earthquake , and great noise , with storm and tempest , and the flame of devouring fire .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan bad khlem poi pyrkhat U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pyllait im ïa pha da ki  erïong bajur bad ki jingkhih jumai . Un phah ïa ki  erlangthari bad ka ding baklang ;

translation.en: And the disciples came , and said unto him , Why speakest thou unto them in parables ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Balei me pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi haba me kren ha ki paidbah ?

translation.en: And Saul said , Draw ye near hither , all the chief of the people : and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day .

translation.en: Then stood up upon the stairs , of the Levites , Jeshua , and Bani , Kadmiel , Shebaniah , Bunni , Sherebiah , Bani , and Chenani , and cried with a loud voice unto the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jaka bakynjang , na ka bynta ki Lebi bad halor jong ka , u ïeng u Jeshua , u Bani , u Kadmiel , u Shebanaïah , u Bunni , u Sherebaïah , u Bani , bad u Khenani . Ki la duwai jam ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
lada ki shim ïa ki bseiñ lane kano kano bih , kin ym ; kin buh ïa ki pang ban ka jingkhiah
translation.en: They shall take up serpents  ; and if they drink any deadly thing , it shall not hurt them  ; they shall lay hands on the sick , and they shall recover .
And he said unto them , What manner of man was he which came up to meet you , and told you these words ?
translation.kha: U long kumno uta u briew ?  u syiem u kylli .

translation.en: Shall not all these take up a parable against him , and a taunting proverb against him , and say , Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his ! how long ? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay !
And the angel of the  Lord  said unto him , Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times ? behold , I went out to withstand thee , because thy way is perverse before me :
translation.kha: U angel u la kylli ,  Balei me da sympat kumne ïa la ka kada ha kine lai sien ? Nga la wan ban khang lynti ïa me namar mem shym la dei ban leit sha kane ka jingleit .

translation.en: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine  ; and she doted on her lovers , on the Assyrians her neighbours ,
translation.kha: La ka long ka jong nga , ka Oholah ka ïai bteng ban long ka nuti bad ka dap da ka jingkwah brai ïa ki nongleh-ieit jong ka na Assyria .

translation.en: And Israel took all these cities : and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites , in Heshbon , and in all the villages thereof .
translation.kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïohknieh ïa ki nongbah jong ki Amor baroh , lem bad ïa ka Heshbon bad ïa ki shnongrit baroh sawdong jong ka , bad ki la shong la sah hangta .
Hato ki para kynthei Arbad u baroh kim shong jingtian sah hangne ? Nangno u ïoh ïa kane baroh ?
translation.en: And his sisters , are they not all with us ? Whence then hath this man all these things ?

translation.kha: Ngin kohnguh ïa me kumba ngi la ju kohnguh ïa u Moses , bad ai ba U Trai U Blei jong me un long ryngkat bad u la long bad u !
translation.en: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things , so will we hearken unto thee : only the  Lord  thy God be with thee , as he was with Moses .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang shong hajan ka jaka jingkynshew ha , u la khmih ïa briew katba ki dang pynnoh ïa ka pisa jong ki . Bun kiba riewspah pynnoh ka pisa ;
translation.en: And Jesus sat over against the treasury , and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury : and many that were rich cast in much .

And the  Lord  shall return his blood upon his own head , who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he , and slew them with the sword , my father David not knowing thereof , to wit , Abner the son of Ner , captain of the host of Israel , and Amasa the son of Jether , captain of the host of Judah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa u Joab na ka bynta kito ki jingpynïap , kiba u la leh khlem ka jingtip u Dabid u kpa jong nga . U Joab u la pynïap ar ngut ki rangbah balui lui kiba kham bha ban ïa u — u Abner , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Israel , bad u Amasa , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Judah .

U syiem Serksis nangta u ong ha ka Esther ka mahadei bad u Mordekai , u Jiw , Peit , nga sdien la ïa phasi u na Haman ka bynta ka jingsylla pyrshah ïa ki Jiw , bad nga la ai ha ka Esther ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u .
translation.en: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew , Behold , I have given Esther the house of Haman , and him they have hanged upon the gallows , because he laid his hand upon the Jews .
Why do you drive the car ?
translation.kha: Balei phi ngiah ia ka kali ?
Ngam lah shah shuh ïa ki kynjah ngut kiwei ïakob ki nongaplangbrot , krai la isih sahmiet nga , bad Kaleb jingpyn-i beh noh ïa ki baroh hapoh shi bnai .
translation.en: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month  ; and my soul lothed them , and their soul also abhorred me .

translation.en: For every one shall be salted with fire , and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt .

translation.en: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes , and looking up to heaven , he blessed them , and brake , and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude .

translation.en: But when Jesus heard it , he answered him , saying ,  Fear not : believe only , and she shall be made whole .
