translation.en: And if he be not able to bring a lamb , then he shall bring for his trespass , which he hath committed , two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , unto the  Lord   ; one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering .
translation.kha: Lada u briew um kotbor ban wallam da ka langbrot ne da ka blang , un wanrah sha U  Trai  ar tylli ki paro ne ar tylli ki lyngdkhur kum ka jingpli ïa la ka pop , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad kawei pat na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang .
Pynban , ki Israel kim shym beh noh ïa ki briew jong ka Geshur bad Maakah ; ki shong dang ha Israel .
translation.en: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites , nor the Maachathites : but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day .

translation.kha: Ynda la wan poi ha u Jakob u kpa jong ki ha ka ri Kanaan , ki ïathuh ha u ïa kaba la jia ha ki baroh :
translation.en: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan , and told him all that befell unto them  ; saying ,
And make ye marriages with us , and give your daughters unto us , and take our daughters unto you .
translation.kha: To ngin pynlong ka jingïateh kular ba kan don noh ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jong ngi bad ki jong phi .

translation.en: Simon answered and said , I suppose that he , to whom he forgave most . And he said unto him ,  Thou hast rightly judged .

hadien kata u la ïap bad la tep ïa ha u Pirathon ha ka ri ki Ephraim ha ka ri lum jong ki Amalek .
translation.en: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died , and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim , in the mount of the Amalekites .

translation.en: These have power to shut heaven , that it rain not in the days of their prophecy : and have power over waters to turn them to blood , and to smite the earth with all plagues , as often as they will .

And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop , and dip it in the blood that is in the basin , and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the basin  ; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning .

translation.en: In all labour there is profit : but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury .
translation.kha: To trei minot bad phin pahuh ha ka jingim ; lada phi shu bunktien phin ïoh long kiba kyrduh .

translation.en: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor : but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said furthermore unto him , Put now thine hand into thy bosom . And he put his hand into his bosom : and when he took it out , behold , his hand was leprous as snow .

translation.kha: To beh kthong ïa ki bad ñiad noh ïa ki ka na khyndew !
translation.en: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the  Lord .

translation.en: Put ye in the sickle , for the harvest is ripe : come , get you down  ; for the press is full , the fats overflow  ; for their wickedness is great .
translation.kha: Ki long kiba bymman haduh katta katta ; ot ïa ki kum ïa u kew ha ka aïom ot ; pynlwet ïa ki kum ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ka jaka pynmih umsoh haduh ba ka umsoh ka shlei .

translation.en: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days  ; and it was noised that he was in the house .

translation.kha: Haba uta u khynnah bakhlaiñbor poi ha ka jaka ba uta u khnam u la hap , u Jonathan u pyrta Aphek u , kumwei khnam u don kham sha tasngeng na phi !
translation.en: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot , Jonathan cried after the lad , and said , Is not the arrow beyond thee ?
We have heard of the pride of Moab  ; he is very proud : even of his haughtiness , and his pride , and his wrath : but his lies shall not be so .

Haba ki poi ha u pud jong ka Mysia , ki la pyrshang ban leit sha ka ka Bithynia , hynrei U Mynsiem jong U Jisu um shah .
translation.en: After they were come to Mysia , they assayed to go into Bithynia : but the Spirit suffered them not .
And stay ye not , but pursue after your enemies , and smite the hindmost of them  ; suffer them not to enter into their cities : for the  Lord  your God hath delivered them into your hand .
translation.kha: hynrei ma phi pat wat sah hangta . Ïai beh ïa ki nongshun jong phi , bad tur ïaleh ïa ki na shadien ; wat ailad ba kin ïohrung sha la ki jong ki nongbah ! U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor jong ki .
Slem sa katno ba kine ki riewbymman kin khñium pyrshah ïa nga ? Nga la shibun ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingkhñium !
translation.en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation , which murmur against me ? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel , which they murmur against me .
Today , Jehovah is preparing millions of people for life in the future Paradise on earth .
translation.kha: Mynta ruh U Jehobah u dang ïai pynkhreh da ki phew lak ngut ki briew ban ïoh im ha paradais .
dieng Jisu bashabar la bteng , Mynta bad kaei nga lah ban nujor ïa ki briew jong Bethgamul ka juk baroh’ Ki long kiba kumno ?
translation.en: And the Lord said ,  Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation ? and to what are they like ?

translation.kha: Ym u uba lah ban long u mraw jong ki ar ngut ki kynrad un isih uwei bad un ieit uwei pat ; un kohnguh ïa uwei bad un ñiewbeiñ ïa uwei pat . Phim lah ban shakri ïa U Blei bad ka .
translation.en: No servant can serve two masters : for either he will hate the one , and love the other  ; or else he will hold to the one , and despise the other . Ye cannot serve God and mammon .

translation.en: Then David said , This is the house of the  Lord  God , and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel .

lyngngai jingpynïaid pyndap ïa kiba thngan da kiei kiei kiba bha bymotsher bad u la phah noh thylli Teh kiba baburom .
translation.en: He hath filled the hungry with good things  ; and the rich he hath sent empty away .

translation.en: And Laban said , This heap is a witness between me and thee this day . Therefore was the name of it called Galeed  ;

translation.kha: U Trai u pynlong ïa ki nong Ijipt kin ba ñiewburom ïa ki Israel ba bad kin ai kat ïa kaba ki pan . Dei da kumne ba ki Israel ki rah noh ka ïa spah ki nong Ijipt .
translation.en: And the  Lord  gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians , so that they lent unto them such things as they required . And they spoiled the Egyptians .
And he made a covering for the tent of rams  skins dyed red , and a covering of badgers  skins above that .
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh sa ar tylli ki jingtap , kawei kaba da ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw , bad kawei pat kaba da ka snieh kaba jlih , ban long kum ka jingtap nalor .

translation.en: Therefore also now , saith the  Lord  , turn ye even to me with all your heart , and with fasting , and with weeping , and with mourning :
translation.kha: Hynrei wat mynta ,  ong U  Trai  ,  kylla-kaba-mut da shisha bad phai sha nga da ka jingshah jingit bad ka jingïam bad ka jingïambriew .

Ha kano kano ka jingsngewmeng ba nga kwah ban pynkhiah ïa ki briew Tabrimmon nga ki krung bad pla ïa ki ban manbha sa ïuhbeiñ pat , baroh kaba nga lah ban baseisoh ka long ka jingbymman pynshyrkhei ki bad ka kam sniew kaba ki sopti-poh . translation.en: When I would have healed Israel , then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered , and the wickedness of Samaria : for they commit falsehood  ; and the thief cometh in , and the troop of robbers spoileth without .

translation.en: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire .
And they shall come from the east , and from the west , and from the north , and from the south , and shall sit down in the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin ïawan na mihngi bad na sepngi , na shatei bad na shathie , bad shong ha ka jingkhawai ha ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: And her adversary also provoked her sore , for to make her fret , because the  Lord  had shut up her womb .

translation.kha: Sngewbha leh ïa kane namar jong nga ; bad bat ïa ka jingkular bakyntang kaba phi la ai ha nga . Hynrei lada nga long ba la pynrem , pynïap ïa nga da lade hi ! Balei phin shim ïa nga sha i pa jong phi ban shah pynïap ?

translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot , and sanctify it .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , pynkyntang ïa ka dabor bad ïa ka jingpynshong jong ka .

translation.kha: Ki shajan ngut ki lat jong u , uwei uwei ha u bnai rmiang la buh ïa kawang , ki Shahshkor nongpynïaid jingbam ïa u Syiem Solomon kaba u donkam ïa lade bad pyrthiew baroh kiba bam ha Lai ïingsyiem ; ki ju ïai pynbiang ïa Hodabaïah kaei Shuni kaba donkam .
translation.en: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon , and for all that came unto king Solomon s table , every man in his month : they lacked nothing .

translation.en: For the same cause also do ye joy , and rejoice with me .
These are murmurers , complainers , walking after their own lusts  ; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words , having men s persons in admiration because of advantage .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew kiba khñium bad borabor ki kynnoh ïa kiwei ; ki ïaid kat kum ki jingkwah brai jong ki ; ki kren sarong shaphang ïa lade bad ïaroh arsap ïa kiwei khnang ban ïoh leh ïa kaba ki kwah hi .

translation.en: Did not he that made me in the womb make him ? and did not one fashion us in the womb ?
translation.kha: Ujuh U Blei uba la thaw ïa nga u la thaw ruh ïa ki shakri jong nga .
U shakri uba sian un ïoh long khlieh halor u khun bymlarkam jong u kynrad pynkieng ïohpdiang shi bynta na ka mynsngi .
translation.en: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame , and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren .
He esteemeth iron as straw , and brass as rotten wood .

translation.en: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree , and the increase of the field , that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen .
translation.kha: Ngan pynroi kyrhai ïa ka jingmih na ki diengsoh bad na ki lyngkha jong phi , ba kan ym don shuh ka  nemsniew ka ban pynjahburom ïa phi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings , which was for the people : and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled upon the altar round about ,
translation.kha: U pynïap ïa u masi lyngraw bad ïa u langbrot kum ka jingkñia ainguh ïasyllok na ka bynta ki paidbah . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wanrah ha u ïa ka snam , bad u theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house , and I will take thy wives before thine eyes , and give them unto thy neighbour , and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun .
translation.kha: Nga smai ha me ba ngan pynlong ïa uwei na ka longïing jong me hi ban wallam jingjynjar halor jong me . Men ïohi ïa ka haba nga shim na me ïa ki tnga jong me bad ai ïa ki ha uwei pat u briew ; bad un ïathiah shongkha bad ki haba dang shai ka sngi .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when midday was past , and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice , that there was neither voice , nor any to answer , nor any that regarded .

To tong ïa Namar um ban pynkhreh na ka bynta ka jingshah kerkut , bad to Huppim ïa ki kut jong ishyrkhei ! To ïuh jingpynhiar ka dewbyrtha ban shna ïa ki Shelah , bad to pynkhreh jingbhasbun ki ainong shna maw-it !

translation.en: Jesus was a perfect human just like Adam .

Nga la phah ïa ki sha ka pyrthei , kumba ,000 la phah ïa nga sha ka pyrthei jingsiang
translation.en: As thou hast sent me into the world , even so have I also sent them into the world .

translation.en: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues , and of evil spirits  ; and unto many that were blind he gave sight .
It is sown in dishonour ; it is raised in glory : it is sown in weakness ; it is raised in power :

translation.en: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet , resort ye thither unto us : our God shall fight for us .

How shall I give thee up , Ephraim ? how shall I deliver thee , Israel ? how shall I make thee as Admah ? how shall I set thee as Zeboiim ? mine heart is turned within me , my repentings are kindled together .

Hato ngan pynjot junom ïa phi kumba nga leh ïa ka Admah , lane ngan leh ïa phi kumba nga leh ïa ka Seboiim ? Ka dohnud jong nga kan ym shah ïa nga ban leh ïa kata ! translation.en: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding .

ngap ïa ki ban julam ba me tawah ïa la ka song halor ka tyrpeng jong me bad mih shabar sha kaba dum da kaba tap ïa ki khmat jong me , khnang ba men ym ïohi shano me Neng . Kaei kaba me leh kan “kata ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders , and carry it forth in the twilight : thou shalt cover thy face , that thou see not the ground : for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel .

translation.en: That ye may suck , and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations  ; that ye may milk out , and be delighted with the abundance of her glory .

translation.kha: patiaw shi sngi nga ïaroh ïa me bad phrung ïa ka burom jong me rynïeng
translation.en: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day .

translation.kha: Hajan ka ïingsyiem jong u Ahab ha , Jesreel ka la don ka bri sohwaiñ kaba long trai da u briew uba kyrteng u Naboth .
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard , which was in Jezreel , hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria .

translation.en: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon : and they are come up from thence rejoicing , so that the city rang again . This is the noise that ye have heard .

And he builded an altar there , and called upon the name of the  Lord  , and pitched his tent there : and there Isaac s servants digged a well .

And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal , and brake it down  ; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly , and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars . And the priest appointed officers over the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta ki paidbah ki leit sha ka templ u Baal bad ki pynkyllon ïa ka ; ki pynpra ïa ki duwan bad ïa ki bleithaw , bad ki pynïap ïa u Mattan , u lyngdoh jong u Baal , ha khmat ki duwan . U Jehoïada u buh ïa ki nongap phira kiba dei treikam ha ka Templ ,

translation.en: It came to pass also in the twelfth year , in the fifteenth day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.en: The  Lord  is well pleased for his righteousness  sake  ; he will magnify the law , and make it honourable .

translation.en: And I will send a fire on Magog , and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan sdang ïa ka ding ha ka ri u Magog bad ha baroh shi lynter ki rud duriaw ; ha kaba ki briew ki shong khlem jingpynwit bad uwei pa uwei un tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time , and they shall search thine house , and the houses of thy servants  ; and it shall be , that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes , they shall put it in their hand , and take it away .
translation.kha: Mynta , la kumno kumno ngan phah ïa ki rangbah synshar jong nga ban ïit ha ka ïingsyiem jong me bad ha ki ïing jong ki rangbah synshar jong me , bad ban shim ïa kaei kaei baroh kiba ki kheiñ kordor . Kin poi hangto lashai kumba katne por .
Uwei uwei u don saw tylli ki durkhmat , saw tylli ki thapniang , bad kaei kaei kaba syriem ïa ka kti briew hapoh kawei kawei ka thapniang .
translation.en: Every one had four faces apiece , and every one four wings  ; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings .
And the woman which thou sawest is that great city , which reigneth over the kings of the earth .
translation.kha: Ka briew kaba me la ïohi ka long ka nongbah bakhraw kaba synshar halor ki syiem jong ka pyrthei .

Bad mynta nga kmen shaphang ki jingshahshitom jong nga na bynta ka jong phi , naba da ki jingshahshitom jong nga ha ka doh , nga ïarap ban pyndep ïa kaei kaba dang sah na jingshahshitom ki jong U na Khrist ka bynta ka balang , kaba long ka met jong u .
translation.en: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you , and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body s sake , which is the church :

translation.kha: U la bret Kappadokia nga ha ka ïingbasa ; ngam da Jakarieh Dinah Jubal ka jaboh ïathiah
translation.en: He hath cast me into the mire , and I am become like dust and ashes .
Then saith Pilate unto him , Speakest thou not unto me ? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee , and have power to release thee ?
translation.kha: U Pilat u la ong ha u ,  Mem kren ei ei ha nga ? To kynmaw , nga don ka bor ban pyllait ïa me bad ruh ban phah sahnarphna ïa me .
don jingsuk , jingjahthait , bad ki jingjynjar jong nga kim don jingkut .
translation.en: I was not in safety , neither had I rest , neither was I quiet  ; yet trouble came .

translation.kha: Ngan leit bad ngan ïeng hajan i pa ha kata ka ba rieh , bad ïakren bad i shaphang jong phi . Lada nga ei ei , ngan sa ïathuh ïa phi
translation.en: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art , and I will commune with my father of thee  ; and what I see , that I will tell thee .

translation.kha: Yn ym don na ki briew jong ka Judah kiba iehnoh la shadien bad kiba la wan sha Ijipt ban shong ban sah kin lait phet ne lait ïap . Yn ym uwei don ruh na ki u ban leit phai sha Judah , kaba sha ki sliang ban shong ban sah shisien sa pat . Yn ym don ba wan ïoh phai lait noh katto katne ki nongphetwir .
translation.en: So that none of the remnant of Judah , which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , shall escape or remain , that they should return into the land of Judah , to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there : for none shall return but such as shall escape .
And David and all the house of Israel played before the  Lord  on all manner of instruments made of fir wood , even on harps , and on psalteries , and on timbrels , and on cornets , and on cymbals .
translation.kha: U Dabid bad ki Israel baroh ki la ïashad kmen bad ïarwai shitrhem da ka bor baroh ban burom ïa U  Trai . Ki da tem ïa ki duitara , ki jingtem ksai , ki ksing , ki kanjari , bad ki shakuriaw .

translation.en: And that ye put on the new man , which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness .
translation.kha: bad phi dei ban kup ïa u briew uba thymmai ïa uba la thaw ha ka dur U Blei kaba pynpaw ïa lade ha ka jingim kaba shisha kaba long kaba beit bad kaba khuid .

translation.en: But the court which is without the temple leave out , and measure it not  ; for it is given unto the Gentiles : and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat thew ïa ki phyllaw kiba shabar , namar la ai noh ïa ki ha kiba mane blei thala , ki ban sa ïuhroit ïa ka Nongbah Bakhuid haduh sawphew ar bnai .

translation.en: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord , that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngi hikai ïa phi mynta ka long ka jinghikai jong U Trai : Ma ngi kiba dang im ha ka sngi ba U Trai u wan , ngin ym leit ha shuwa jong kito kiba la ïap .
Lada Sheba briew u klim bad jingkahtngen tnga jong u Korah Israel , ma u bad kata ka kynthei byrtong shah pynïap .
translation.en: And the man that committeth adultery with another man s wife , even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour s wife , the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death .

translation.kha: Ka Jerusalem long la tim , kata ka nongbah kaba ijli , kaba ïaleh pyrshah , kaba banbeiñ ïa la ki jong ki briew .
translation.en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted , to the oppressing city !
And they shall scoff at the kings , and the princes shall be a scorn unto them : they shall deride every strong hold  ; for they shall heap dust , and take it .
translation.kha: Ki ñiewbeiñ ïa ki syiem bad ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki rangbah synshar ba-halor . Ym don ka kut kaba lah ban pynsangeh ïa ki — ki kynton ïa ka khyndew pyrshah ïa ka bad ki knieh ïa ka .

Ïa kine jingkular baroh la pynlong na bynta ngi , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong . Te namarkata , to ngin pynkhuid ïa lade na kaei kaei baroh kaba ka met mynsiem , bad to ai ba ngin im ka jingim kaba khuid da kaba im ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Having therefore these promises , dearly beloved , let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit , perfecting holiness in the fear of God .

translation.kha: Katto katne na kito ki nongïalam bastad kin shah pynïap , kaba hynrei mih na kane ka long ba yn pynkhuid ki ïa briew . Kane kan ïailong tad haduh ba kaba kan kut wan , ka por kaba U Blei u la buh .
translation.en: And some of them of understanding shall fall , to try them , and to purge , and to make them white , even to the time of the end : because it is yet for a time appointed .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud kaba long ñiad sngi kaba arphew lai jong u bnai uba hynñiew , Adadah Solomon u phah noh ïa ki briew ne la ïing . Ki la kmen ïa baroh ki jingkyrkhu ba U Trai u la ai ha ki arphew jong u ki Israel , ha Japhlet Dabid bad ha u Solomon jingpalat
translation.en: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents , glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the  Lord  had shewed unto David , and to Solomon , and to Israel his people .
Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Khie leit phai bad ïathuh ïa u Ïoannis ïa kaei kaba phi ïohsngew bad ïohi :

translation.en: Because ye have said , The  Lord  hath raised us up prophets in Babylon  ;
translation.kha: Phi ong ba U  Trai  u la ai ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ha phi ha Babilonia .
Hangta u sot u thung ïa u Ishbosheth kum u khlup ber ki ri ha Gilead , Asher jingroi Jesreel jong Ephraim , jingaimynsiem Benjamin , bad shajan halor ka Israel baroh dieng .
translation.en: And made him king over Gilead , and over the Ashurites , and over Jezreel , and over Ephraim , and over Benjamin , and over all Israel .
And he said ,  Abba , Father , all things are possible unto thee  ; take away this cup from me : nevertheless not what I will , but what thou wilt .
translation.kha: Ko Pa ,  u duwai ,  Ko Pa jong nga ! Baroh kiei kiei ki long kiba lah ha me . Shim noh na nga ïa kane ka khuri jong ka jingshahshitom . Pynban ym ïa kaei kaba nga kwah , hynrei ïa kaei kaba me kwah .

translation.en: ( For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat . )
translation.kha: ( Ki synran jong u ki la lah leit sha shnong ban thied jingbam . )

translation.en: Therefore David ran , and stood upon the Philistine , and took his sword , and drew it out of the sheath thereof , and slew him , and cut off his head therewith . And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead , they fled .
translation.kha: U mareh sha u , u ïeng halor jong u , u sei ïa ka waitlam u Goliath na ka jingsop jong ka , bad u ot ïa ka khlieh jong u bad u pynïap ïa u . Haba ki Philistia ki ïohi ba u rangkynsai jong ki u la shah pynïap , ki phet krad .

translation.en: Behold , the Lord hath a mighty and strong one , which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm , as a flood of mighty waters overflowing , shall cast down to the earth with the hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u don ïa uta uba khlaiñ bad badonbor uba la kloi ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , uta u ban wan kum u phria bajur , kum u  lapbah , kum ka jingshlei um bakhlaiñbor , bad kan tap lup ïa ka ri .

translation.en: But rise , and stand upon thy feet : for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose , to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen , and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei khie joit bad ïeng . Nga la paw ha me ban thung ïa me kum u shakri jong nga . Me dei ban ïathuh ïa kiwei pat ïa kaba me la ïohi ïa nga ha kane ka sngi , bad ïa kaei kaba ngan pyn-i ha me ha ka ban sa wan .
U nongbet u bet ïa ka khubor U Blei thombor
translation.en: The sower soweth the word .

translation.kha: Lai sien shisnem , ki shynrang jong phi baroh ki dei Gilead wanpaw païa khmat U 8 U Blei jong jingthiah ha kata Body jaka mane badonbok jingshisha angel ka Niam Ka Jinglait Uphas ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot , bad ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Silas nongai Kim dei ban wan shahtehmraw ha khmat U Trai ;
translation.en: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose  ; in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles : and they shall not appear before the  Lord  empty :
And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them .
translation.kha: Kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai  , bad ki jingmaham jong nga kim shym long ki jingbyrngem lehnoh-ei .
Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba don nongïarap katne hangne ki ban Sikhri ïap tad haduh ba kin “Kane kyrthep ba U Khun U Briew u wan kum Ampliatos Syiem .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , There be some standing here , which shall not taste of death , till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom .

translation.kha: Wan sa ïalam ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad pynphong sopti ïa ki .
translation.en: And thou shalt bring his sons , and clothe them with coats :

And the  Lord  hath blessed my master greatly  ; and he is become great : and he hath given him flocks , and herds , and silver , and gold , and menservants , and maidservants , and camels , and asses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu kyrhai ïa u kynrad jong nga bad u la pynlong ïa u , u briew uba riewspah . U la ai ha u ki kynhun langbrot bad blang , ki masi , ka rupa , ka ksiar , ki mraw shynrang bad kynthei , ki ut bad ki kada .

translation.en: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes , Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only , but also to all the princes , and to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus .
translation.kha: Nangta u Memukan u ong ha u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar :  Ka Bashti , ka Mahadei ka la krenbeiñ ym tang ïa u syiem hynrei ïa ki rangbah synshar ruh — ha ka jingshisha , ïa uwei pa uwei u rangbah ha ka hima !
Dabid tip u Saul u la tur ïaleh ïa , u la ong ha u u lyngdoh hangne ïa ka ephod .
translation.en: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him  ; and he said to Abiathar the priest , Bring hither the ephod .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ngi long ki bieit kum ki masi ?
translation.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts , and reputed vile in your sight ?
Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour s wife , to defile thyself with her .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ; naba kata kan pynlong ïa me u bymkhuid .

translation.en: According to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses , so the children of Israel made all the work .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki trei ïa kane ka kam baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
To ïa ki ngi , naba ngi uwei pa uwei uba leh ïa ngi . Bad wat ïalam ngi sha ka jingtynjuh kaba eh .’
translation.en: And forgive us our sins  ; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us . And lead us not into temptation  ; but deliver us from evil .
And if so be that he find it , verily I say unto you , he rejoiceth more of that sheep , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray .
translation.kha: Haba u shem ïa ka , nga ong ha phi , u kham kmen ïa kane kawei ka langbrot ban ïa ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ki bym shym la jah .

Kita ki masi Ramath ki leit beit beit shaphang Beth Shemesh , shitrhem khlem .—Sekharaiah phai na ka lynti ba ki leit , ki da pah artat katba ki dang leit . Ki san waitsum ki syiem Philistia ki janmiet nadien krenbeiñ ki haduh u pud jong ka jingpynkhihwin Shemesh .
translation.en: And the kine took the straight way to the way of Beth–shemesh , and went along the highway , lowing as they went , and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left  ; and the lords of the Philistines went after them unto the border of Beth–shemesh .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u ong , Ki paid Israel bad Judah ki Delilah banbeiñ . Baroh kiba byrngem ïa ki , ki khmih pyrman ïa ki bad kin ym pyllait Ephesos Mattatha .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together : and all that took them captives held them fast  ; they refused to let them go .
Neither was there any among them that lacked : for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them , and brought the prices of the things that were sold ,
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano hapoh ka kynhun kiba don ka jingdonkam . Kito kiba long trai ïa ki lyngkha , ki wallam ïa ka pisa ba la ïohpdiang na ka jingdie ,
Nga long uba la kloi borabor ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki briew nga jong , kiba long mutlop ban ïai leh ïa ka bymdei bad ïaid ha la jong ka ka lynti ,
translation.en: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people , which walketh in a way that was not good , after their own thoughts  ;

translation.kha: U ot lyngkhot ïa langbrot bad sait ïa ki jem bad ki kjat-dien da ka um , bad thang ïa ka khlieh ïa ka khleiñ bad ki lyngkhot baroh ha duwan , kumba U u la hukum Kane ka jingainguh thang ka long ka jingainguh bam , bad ka kaba pynsngewbha U .
translation.en: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water  ; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar : it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour , and an offering made by fire unto the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall : and when he had tasted thereof , he would not drink .
translation.kha: Hangta ki la tyrwa ïa U Jisu ka waiñ ba la khleh bad ka kynja bakthang ; hynrei hadien ba u la mad ïa ka , um treh dih .

translation.en: But the fields of the city , and the villages thereof , gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession .
translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ki pyntha jong ka nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit jong ka la lah ai ha u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .

translation.en: And Saul built an altar unto the  Lord  : the same was the first altar that he built unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Saul u tei ka duwan ha U  Trai  ; ka duwan kaba nyngkong kaba u la tei .

translation.en: And they put him in ward , because it was not declared what should be done to him .
translation.kha: bad la buh hapoh ka jingkhmih ki nongap , namar ym pat don ka jingpynshai yn leh kumno ïa u .

Sha shiliang ka khyrdop bashatei la don ka khyrdop kaba ïalam sha ka bashapoh phyllaw , katjuh kumba la don ha liang ka mihngi . Uta u briew u la thew ïa jingjngai ka hapdeng kine ki ar tylli ki khyrdop , bad ka long sanphew mitar .
translation.en: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north , and toward the east  ; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits .
But I have greater witness than that of John : for the works which the Father hath given me to finish , the same works that I do , bear witness of me , that the Father hath sent me .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga don ka jingphla na ka bynta jong nga kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka jingphla kaba u Ïoannis u la ai : Kaei kaba nga leh , kata ka long , ki kam kiba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ïa nga ban leh , kine ki kren na ka bynta jong nga bad ki pyn-i ba U Kpa u la phah ïa nga .
ba U Messaïah u dei iam shahshitom siat ban long uba nyngkong ban Laiphew na jingman jingïap , jingsangsot pynbna ïa ka jingshai jong ka jingpynim ha ki Jiw bad ha ki Jentil kurim
translation.en: That Christ should suffer , and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead , and should shew light unto the people , and to the Gentiles .

translation.kha: Haba ki Syria ki wan saiñ ïaleh pyut u Elisha u la syllen , Ko Trai , to pynmatlah ïa kine Katholik briew mynmiet ïabiang klang u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u bad shoh pynmatlah ïa ki .
translation.en: And when they came down to him , Elisha prayed unto the  Lord  , and said , Smite this people , I pray thee , with blindness . And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha .

translation.kha: Ki Arab bad ki Sanoah ka ri Kedar pyniphuh la siew na ka bynta ki mar khaïi jong jingïabam da ki khunlangbrot kynshleiñ ki langbrot , bad ki blang jingdon
translation.en: Arabia , and all the princes of Kedar , they occupied with thee in lambs , and rams , and goats : in these were they thy merchants .

translation.kha: Ki apostol Jerusalem ki la ïohsngew ba ki nong Samaria ki la pdiang ïa ka ktien U Blei , kumta ki la phah bad Ïoannis sha ki
translation.en: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God , they sent unto them Peter and John :
And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba hynñiewspah hynñiewphew hynñiew snem .

translation.en: For he had one only daughter , about twelve years of age , and she lay a dying . But as he went the people thronged him .
translation.kha: namar ka khun marwei jong u , kaba la khat-ar snem ka rta , ka la jan ïap . Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid , ki briew ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u na ki liang baroh .

translation.en: When he gave to the sea his decree , that the waters should not pass his commandment : when he appointed the foundations of the earth :
translation.kha: bad pynbeit ïa ki um ka duriaw ba kin ym kiew palat ban ïa kaba u la ong . Nga la don hangta mynba u buh ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Who provideth for the raven his food ? when his young ones cry unto God , they wander for lack of meat .
translation.kha: Mano ba bsa ïa ki tyngab haba ki sakma haba thngan , haba ki khun rit jong ki , ki kyang sha nga ban ïoh jingbam ?

translation.en: Thou shalt also take one ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .
translation.kha: Shim uwei na kita ki langbrot shynrang , bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: For in the eighth year of his reign , while he was yet young , he began to seek after the God of David his father : and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places , and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba phra ba u Josaïah u long syiem , haba u dang khynnah bha , u sdang ban mane ïa U Blei jong u syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u . Saw snem hadien u sdang ban pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , ki dur jong ka blei Asherah , bad baroh kiwei de ki bleithaw .

translation.en: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pynïap briew un shah pynïap ,

translation.en: Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , answered and said to the king , O Nebuchadnezzar , we are not careful to answer thee in this matter .
translation.kha: U Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego ki la jubab ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , ngin ym pyrshang ban ïasaid da ïa lade .

translation.en: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .

Wat nym klet ïa la ki lane paralok ïa ki paralok u kpa jong phi . Lada phi ha don ka jingjynjar , ong wat ïa u hynmen ne para jong phi ban ïarap ; u paramarjan uba hajan lah u ban ïarap ïa phi kham bha ban ïa u hynmen ne para uba sha jngai .
translation.en: Thine own friend , and thy father s friend , forsake not  ; neither go into thy brother s house in the day of thy calamity : for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off .

translation.kha: Da shisha U thyllah pait peit ïa ka kambah . U Akhbor shoh ïa bam , hynrei phim shym pynleit jingmut ; u julor pynlwet ïa nongsuhjaiñ , hynrei Shamir la kyntait ban ïoh jinghikai Jahas Uba Mitylene Thohdieng mutlop bad phim shym kuna na ki jingpynshai jong phi .
translation.en: O  Lord  , are not thine eyes upon the truth ? thou hast stricken them , but they have not grieved  ; thou hast consumed them , but they have refused to receive correction : they have made their faces harder than a rock  ; they have refused to return .
And thou shalt make ouches of gold  ;
translation.kha: Thaw ruh ar tylli ïa ki shrong ksiar ,

translation.en: And Esau said , Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me . And he said , What needeth it ? let me find grace in the sight of my lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u Iso u ong ,  Te kumta , shah ngan ieh katto katne ngut ki briew jong nga bad phi .  Hynrei u Jakob u ong ,  Ym da donkam ban leh kumta namar nga kwah tang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi .

translation.en: they came
A fire goeth before him , and burneth up his enemies round about .
translation.kha: Ka ding ka ïaid ha shuwa jong u bad ka thang ïa ki nongshun kiba don sawdong jong u .
Lada phi kop kumta Por phin sa tip ka mut aïu Telah sheptieng ïa U arliang bad phin sa lah ban sngewthuh shaphang U Blei .
translation.en: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the  Lord  , and find the knowledge of God .
He answered and said , Lo , I see four men loose , walking in the midst of the fire , and they have no hurt  ; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God .
translation.kha: Te balei ba nga ïohi saw ngut ki rangbah kiba ïaid ha ka ding ?  u la kylli .  Ïa ki ym shym la khum , bad kim shym pyn-i kano kano ka dak jong ka jingmynsaw — bad uba saw u i kum u angel .

translation.en: And ye came near unto me every one of you , and said , We will send men before us , and they shall search us out the land , and bring us word again by what way we must go up , and into what cities we shall come .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi ïawan sha nga , bad phi ïa-ong , ‘ To ngin ïaphah shuwa ïa ki rangbah ban leit syntiat ïa kata ka ri , khnang ba ki lah ban wan ïathuh ha ngi na kano ka lynti kaba biang eh ba ngin leit kiew bad kiba kumno ki jait shnong kiba don hangta .’

translation.en: Saying , What shall we do to these men ? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem  ; and we cannot deny it .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngin leh ïa kine ki briew ?  ki la kylli .  Uwei uwei baroh ha Jerusalem u tip ba ïa kane ka kambah kaba pher la leh da ma ki , bad ngim lah ban len ïa ka .
Elasah Trai u pynbeit ïa kito kiba bakyrhuh Khatwei ïa-shahskhor kumba u kpa u pynbeit ïa tipthuh Gennesaret ïa uba bakyntang sngewsarong .
translation.en: For whom the  Lord  loveth he correcteth  ; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth .
This means that in a personal , private prayer you tell him that you are giving yourself to him to do his will .—Matthew 16 :24  ; 22 :37 .
translation.kha: Kane ka mut ban ïathuh ha u ha ka jingduwai ba jar jar marwei , ba phi aiti ïalade ha u ban leh ïa ka mon jong u .—Mathaios 16 :24 ; 22 :37 .
Katba da ki hajar ki briew ki dang ïalumlang ba la ïa-ïuh para ma , U u la ong nyngkong ha la ki synran , To sumar na u thiat jong ki Pharisi — nga mut ïa jong .
translation.en: In the mean time , when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people , insomuch that they trode one upon another , he began to say unto his disciples first of all ,  Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees , which is hypocrisy .
And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake , some to everlasting life , and some to shame and everlasting contempt .
translation.kha: Bun na kito kiba la lah ïap kin im pat : Katto katne kin ïoh ka jingim bymjukut , bad katto katne kin shah ka jingjahburom bymjukut .

translation.en: And for me , that utterance may be given unto me , that I may open my mouth boldly , to make known the mystery of the gospel ,
translation.kha: Bad to duwai ruh na ka bynta jong nga ba U Blei un ai ha nga ïa ka khubor haba nga la kloi ban kren , khnang ba nga lah ban kren shlur bad pynpaw shai ïa ka jingmaïan ka gospel .

translation.en: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you , to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year . And he did as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba dei ban rakhe pateng la pateng . Ïa kane ka rukom lehniam dei ban leh shisien shisnem ban pynkhuid ïa ki Israel na ki pop jong ki . Kumta u Moses u leh , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: But if the  Lord  make a new thing , and the earth open her mouth , and swallow them up , with all that appertain unto them , and they go down quick into the pit  ; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada U  Trai  u leh ïa kaei kaei kaba ym pat ju ïohsngew , bad ba ka khyndew ka ang bad nguid ïa ki bad ïa baroh kat kaba ki don , ba kumta ki hap sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , te phin sa tip ba kine ki briew ki la kyntait ïa U  Trai .
Shet ïa ka doh bad bam ïa ka ha kata ka jaka mane Blei ; bad ha ka step kaba , bud leit noh phai sha la ïing .
translation.en: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose : and thou shalt turn in the morning , and go unto thy tents .

translation.kha: Nangta kin jubab ïa u , ‘ Mynno , ko Trai , ba ngi la ju ïohi ba me thngan lane sliang lane ba me long nongwei u lane ba me lyngkhuit la lane ba me pang lane hapoh ka ïingbyndi , bad ba shym ngim la ïarap ïa me ?’
translation.en: Then shall they also answer him , saying , Lord , when saw we thee an hungred , or athirst , or a stranger , or naked , or sick , or in prison , and did not minister unto thee ?

translation.kha: Ki jingdro na baroh ki Phinehas , Jingai kynja bynriew , ki Adullam ktien paidbah bad ki jaitbynriew kin shu khmih ïa kita ki metïap jong ki haduh lai sngi shiteng bad kin ym shah ban tep Song jingkoit .
translation.en: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half , and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves .
For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof : but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged .
translation.kha: Haba ka jaitbynriew ka leh pop , kan ïoh u nongsynshar uwei hadien uwei pat . Hynrei ka jaitbynriew kan long kaba khlaiñ bad kaba ïaineh haba ka don ki nongsynshar kiba stad bad bashemphang .

Ki jingsaiñ ki Sabbaton ïa ka ïakut jong nga bad kim burom ïa sep-ei kaba khuid . Kim pynïapher hapdeng kaei kaba khuid bad kaei ka bymkhuid . Kim hikai ïa ka jingïapher jingïasaid kiba Iskariot bad kiba jakhlia , bad kim suidñiew ïa ka Sabbaton jingbymkhuid Kaba mih ka long ba ki paid Israel kim ñiewkor ïa nga .
translation.en: Her priests have violated my law , and have profaned mine holy things : they have put no difference between the holy and profane , neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean , and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths , and I am profaned among them .
They shall also bring up a company against thee , and they shall stone thee with stones , and thrust thee through with their swords .
translation.kha: Kin pynkhih buk ïa u paidbah ban lynthem maw ïa pha , bad kin ot lyngkhot ïa pha da ki waitlam jong ki .
U Gershon u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : u Libni bad u Shimei , ki ruh ki don bun ki khun ki .
translation.en: The sons of Gershon  ; Libni , and Shimei , according to their families .

translation.kha: u la kylli ïa ki Hato phi la ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid haba phi long ? Ngim pat ju ïohsngew ba don U Mynsiem Bakhuid , ki la jubab .
translation.en: He said unto them , Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed ? And they said unto him , We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost .

But let him that glorieth glory in this , that he understandeth and knoweth me , that I am the  Lord  which exercise lovingkindness , judgment , and righteousness , in the earth : for in these things I delight , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u kwah ban kob sarong , u dei ban kob sarong ba u ithuh bad ba u shemphang ïa nga , namar ka jingieit jong nga ka long kaba neh , bad nga leh ïa kaba hok bad kaba dei . Kine ki long kita kiei kiei kiba pynsngewbha ïa nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple , verily I say unto you , he shall in no wise lose his reward .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban sngewthikna ba uno uno uba ai dih wat shi khuri ka umkhriat ha uwei uba rit tam na kine ki nongbud jong nga namar ba u dei u nongbud jong nga , un ïohpdiang da shisha ïa ka bainong .
U la kynmaw ïa ki jingphohsniew ba u la phohsniew shaphang jong ki , bad u ong , Phi dei ki nongsyntiat ; ïawan phi ban khmih ha-ei ka jong ri ngi ka shong tlot .
translation.en: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them , and said unto them , Ye are spies  ; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .

translation.kha: Nga la leh ïa kane namar ba ki la kyntait lah ïa ki hukum jong nga , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki jong aiñ nga , ki la pyntngit ïa ka Sabbaton , bad ïa mane kijuh ki bleithaw kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la shakri .
translation.en: Because they had not executed my judgments , but had despised my statutes , and had polluted my sabbaths , and their eyes were after their fathers  idols .
Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days  ; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee , neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters .
translation.kha: Ha kita ki hynñiew sngi , phim dei ban bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat ; ym dei ban don u thiat ne u kpu ba la khleh thiat hangno hangno ha ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u la im sa sanspah snem bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
wat ïa ki briew . U Trai U phi u don ryngkat bad phi ; u long U Blei uba donbor bad uba itieng .
translation.en: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them : for the  Lord  thy God is among you , a mighty God and terrible .
And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock , and he said unto them , Hear now , ye rebels  ; must we fetch you water out of this rock ?
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la lumlang ïa u paidbah baroh ha khmat u mawsiang , bad u Moses u ong ,  Sngap mynta , phi ki nongïaleh pyrshah ! Hato ngi hap pynmih um na une u mawsiang na ka bynta jong phi ?

translation.en: And will be a Father unto you , and ye shall be my sons and daughters , saith the Lord Almighty .
translation.kha: Ngan long U Kpa jong phi , bad phin long ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong nga , ong U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
Ha ka Dinah , ka khun jong u Jakob bad ka Leah , ka la leit jngoh ïa ki katto katne ki kynthei Kanaan .
translation.en: And Dinah the daughter of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob , went out to see the daughters of the land .

translation.kha: Ngam pat ju sheptieng ïa kaei kaba ki briew kin ong ; ngam ju sngap jar ne shong hapoh ïing namar ba sheptieng ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ jong ki .
translation.en: Did I fear a great multitude , or did the contempt of families terrify me , that I kept silence , and went not out of the door ?
And they brought him upon horses , and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah .
translation.kha: Ïa ka met jong u la wan kit sha Jerusalem halor u kulai , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid .

translation.en: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace , that it may be upon the mitre  ; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be .
translation.kha: Teh ïa ka ha khmat ka jaiñspong da u ksai bajngum .

Ha khmih kumno syntiew ki ki khlaw san : Kim shym trei lane thain jaiñ na ka bynta ïa lade . Hynrei nga ong ha phi ba wat u syiem Solomon ha ka spah jong u baroh um shym la don ki jaiñ kiba itynnat kat uwei kine na ki syntiew .
translation.en: Consider the lilies how they grow : they toil not , they spin not  ; and yet I say unto you , that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these .
Our father died in the wilderness , and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the  Lord  in the company of Korah  ; but died in his own sin , and had no sons .
translation.kha: I pa jong ngi i la ïap ha ka ri khlaw khlem khun shynrang . Im shym ïadon lang bad ki nongbud jong u Korah kiba la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ; i la ïap namar ka pop la jong .
Uno uno u briew lane ka briew kiba leh byrtong kin shah lynthem maw haduh ba kin da ïap ; uno uno u briew uba ïa leh kane u pan kwah hi ka ïa jingïap .
translation.en: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit , or that is a wizard , shall surely be put to death : they shall stone them with stones : their blood shall be upon them .
He that is born in thy house , and he that is bought with thy money , must needs be circumcised : and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant .
translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei dei ban otsher , bad kane kan long ka dak kaba paw shabar ban pyn-i ba ka jutang jong nga bad me ka long kaba ïaineh junom .
Ka um ba shu tuh ka kham shngiam , ka jingbam ba shu tuh ka kham bang .
translation.en: Stolen waters are sweet , and bread eaten in secret is pleasant .

translation.kha: poi Ynda kata ka por , phin sa lynñiar kthang namar u jong Syiem phi , uba phi hi da lade phi la jied , hynrei U Trai un ym sngap ïa ki jingud jong phi .
translation.en: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king which ye shall have chosen you  ; and the  Lord  will not hear you in that day .
But judgment shall return unto righteousness : and all the upright in heart shall follow it .
translation.kha: Ka jingbishar hok kan wan biang ha ki ïingbishar , bad baroh ki briew kiba hok kin kyrshan ïa ka .

Un leh kumjuh ïa une u masi balung kumba u ïashetkylla leh Khemosh u masi lyngraw jong ka jingkñia ainguh namar ka pop , bad ha kane ka rukom un pyndep ïa jingiaseng jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u nongïada , bad yn map kynjri ki .
translation.en: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering , so shall he do with this : and the priest shall make an atonement for them , and it shall be forgiven them .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Ishbosheth u jong khun u Saul u kynnoh sniew ïa u Abner ba ïathiah u bad ka Rispah , ka tnga kliar jong u Saul , ka khun jong u Aïah .
translation.en: And Saul had a concubine , whose name was Rizpah , the daughter of Aiah : and Ish–bosheth said to Abner , Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father s concubine ?

translation.kha: Lada ki briew hapoh kata ka ïing ba-mynhyndai pdiang sngewbha ïa Langbrot , ai ba ka jingkhublei jingsuk jong phi Sibaïah neh ; hynrei lada kim pdiang bah ïa phi , to shim noh aiñ ïa ka tapmoh jong kmiesan .
translation.en: And if the house be worthy , let your peace come upon it : but if it be not worthy , let your peace return to you .
Seek the  Lord  and his strength , seek his face continually .
translation.kha: Leit sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad mane khlem kut .

translation.en: And there came out a fire from the  Lord  , and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding kaba meh , bad ka bam duh khoit ïa kita ki arspah sanphew ngut ki briew kiba la wanrah ïa ki jingiwbih .

translation.en: For I am the  Lord  thy God , the Holy One of Israel , thy Saviour : I gave Egypt for thy ransom , Ethiopia and Seba for thee .
translation.kha: Naba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel , uba pynim ïa phi . Ngan kyntait ïa ka Ijipt ban pyllaitluid ïa phi ; ngan kyntait ïa ka Sudan bad ka Seba .

translation.en: Behold , there is a people come out of Egypt , which covereth the face of the earth : come now , curse me them  ; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them , and drive them out .
translation.kha: ba ka jaitbynriew kaba la wan na Ijipt ka la saphriang ha ka ri baroh kawei . U kwah ïa nga ban tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong u , khnang ba u lah ban ïaleh pyrshah bad beh noh ïa ki .
U Blei u la ong , ha ki Pyntngit ïa ka Templ . Pyndap ïa ki phyllaw jong ka da ki metïap . Sdang noh ïa ka kam Kumta ! ki la sdang ban pynïap ïa ki briew ha ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Defile the house , and fill the courts with the slain : go ye forth . And they went forth , and slew in the city .

Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land , and said , Mark , I pray you , and see how this man seeketh mischief : for he sent unto me for my wives , and for my children , and for my silver , and for my gold  ; and I denied him not .
translation.kha: U syiem Ahab u khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ka ri bad u ong ,  Phi ïohi ba une u briew u kwah ban pynjot ïa ngi . U la phah khubor sha nga da kaba dawa ïa ki tnga bad ki khun jong nga , ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong nga bad nga la mynjur .
Yn ba ki la ïohi ha siar ïing syiem ? bankhia la ïohi ïa baroh . Ym knieh shahïap ngam shym Shadkmen pyn-i proh ki ha ki triang jingkynshew .
translation.en: Then said he , What have they seen in thine house ? And Hezekiah answered , All that is in mine house have they seen : there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them .
And the king said unto him , Go in peace . So he arose , and went to Hebron .
translation.kha: Khie leit suk ,  u syiem u ong . Kumta u Absalom u la leit noh sha Hebron .

translation.en: Any one of Jehovah’s Witnesses will be pleased to help you to reason on the meaning of the Scriptures . —Read Luke 24 :32 , 45 .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban ong ïa iwei na Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ban ïarap ïa phi ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingmut jong ki dkhot Baibl .—Pule Loukas 24 :32 , 45 .

translation.en: But all this was done , that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled .  Then all the disciples forsook him , and fled .
translation.kha: Hynrei kane baroh ka la lah jia khnang ban pynlong ïa kaei kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ban jia shisha .  Nangta baroh ki synran ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la ïaphet noh .

translation.en: Now therefore hear thou the word of the  Lord  : Thou sayest , Prophesy not against Israel , and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong . Me bthah ïa nga ban sangeh kaba ïathuhlypa , ban sangeh kaba kren lamwir pyrshah ïa ki briew ka Israel .
bad u la ong , Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lymda phi kylla bad long kum ki khynnah , ym ïohrung da lei lei ka Hima ki bneng .
translation.en: And said ,  Verily I say unto you , Except ye be converted , and become as little children , ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: Lada ka bad tyrwa ban wanrah um ïa ki ut jong nga , ai ba kan long kaba me jied kum ka tnga ïa u jong u kynrad jong nga .’
translation.en: And she say to me , Both drink thou , and I will also draw for thy camels : let the same be the woman whom the  Lord  hath appointed out for my master s son .

And yet they would not hearken unto their judges , but they went a whoring after other gods , and bowed themselves unto them : they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in , obeying the commandments of the  Lord   ; but they did not so .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel kim shym shahshkor ïa la ki nongïalam . Ki Israel kim shym la ïaineh ha U  Trai  bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Ki kpa jong ki , ki la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U  Trai  , hynrei kane ka pateng bathymmai shen ka la sangeh ban leh kumta .

U Hiram la shaba haba u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor na u Solomon , bad u , Ïaroh U Trai kane ka sngi u la ai ha Dabid ïa u khun uba stad kum une ban long u syiem hadien jong u ïa kata ka jaitbynriew bakhraw !
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Hiram heard the words of Solomon , that he rejoiced greatly , and said , Blessed be the  Lord  this day , which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people .
The  Lord  shall increase you more and more , you and your children .
translation.kha: To U  Trai  un ai ki khun ha phi — ïa phi bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi !
kumta u la phah shiphew ngut ki samla shynrang bad ka hukum ban leit sha Karmel , wad ban u ïa Nabal , bad ban ai ka jingkhublei na u .
translation.en: And David sent out ten young men , and David said unto the young men , Get you up to Carmel , and go to Nabal , and greet him in my name :

translation.kha: U bang bha ban leh ïa ka jingsniew bad u buh katto katne ha ka shyntur u jong ban sngewtynnat ïa ka jingbang jong ka .
translation.en: Though he spare it , and forsake it not  ; but keep it still within his mouth :
Then answered Esther , and said , My petition and my request is  ;
translation.kha: Ka Esther ka jubab ,

translation.en: Again , think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you ? we speak before God in Christ : but we do all things , dearly beloved , for your edifying .
translation.kha: Lehse phi pyrkhat ba baroh shi katta ngi la pyrshang ban ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmat jong phi . Em! Ngi kren kumba U Khrist un jin da la kwah ïa ngi ban kren ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei , bad baroh kaba ngi leh , ko paralok ba-ieit , la leh ban ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: He said , I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness , Make straight the way of the Lord , as said the prophet Esaias .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la jubab da kaba shim na u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah :  Nga long ‘ ka sur jong uta uba pyrta ha ka ri shyiap : To pynbeit ïa ka lynti ïaid jong U Trai ba un ïaid !’

Mynba Hesekaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Mikah u nongïathuhlypa na Moresheth u la bthah ïa baroh ki ba U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong , ‘ Seïon yn kum lyngkha ka Jerusalem kan kylla ka kynton ki jingpra , u lum ka Templ kylla khlaw .’
translation.en: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah , and spake to all the people of Judah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Zion shall be plowed like a field , and Jerusalem shall become heaps , and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest .
And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came : for the famine was in the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob lem bad kiwei pat ruh ki la ïawan ban thied kew , namar ba la don ka  nemsniew ha ri Kanaan .
Lada kynrad u , u pynïoh ïa u tnga , bad ïoh khun shynrang ne kynthei na u kata ka briew bad ki khun jong ka kin long ki jong u kynrad jong ka , bad uta briew un mihnoh marwei .
translation.en: If his master have given him a wife , and she have born him sons or daughters  ; the wife and her children shall be her master s , and he shall go out by himself .
And they said , Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement , and to put her away .
translation.kha: Ka jingjubab jong ki ka long ,  U Moses u la shah ïa u briew ban pyntip da ka jingthoh ïa ka jingpyllait tnga bad iehnoh ïa ka tnga jong u .
U Elijah u la long briew kum ngi . U la duwai ba kan hap slap , bad ym shym hap slap halor ka khyndew haduh lai snem shiteng .
translation.en: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are , and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain : and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months .

translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jingai jingmut jong ki , u la ïasoh bad u Joram u syiem ka Israel ka thma pyrshah ïa Hasael u syiem ka Syria . kynhun shipai ki la ïaleh Ramoth ha Gilead , bad u la mynsaw ha ka thma .
translation.en: He walked also after their counsel , and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth–gilead : and the Syrians smote Joram .
When Jesus therefore saw his mother , and the disciple standing by , whom he loved , he saith unto his mother ,  Woman , behold thy son !
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa la ka kmie bad ïa u synran ïa uba u ieit ba ki ïa-ïeng hangta ; te u la ong ha la ka kmie ,  Une u long u khun jong phi .
U Jisu u la ong ha ki , To bad wan nga , bad ngan hikai ïa phi ban tong briew .
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Follow me , and I will make you fishers of men .
The best of them is as a brier : the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge : the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh  ; now shall be their perplexity .
translation.kha: Wat kiba bha tam bad bahok tam na ki , ki long ki bymdondor kum ki ñiut . Ka sngi ka la poi haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa ki briew , kumba u la maham ïa ki lyngba ki nongap phira , ki nongïathuhlypa . Mynta ki don ha ka jingkulmar jingmut .

U Trai u ong , Ka sngi ka la poi haba ngan pynïeng ïa pat ka hima u Dabid kaba long kum ïing ka kaba la khyllem ha ki jingjot . Ngan shna pynbha ïa ki kynroh jong ka ngan bad pynïeng pat ïa ka . Ngan tei pat ïa bad ka ngan pynlong ïa ka kum ka la ju long mynshuwa .
translation.en: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen , and close up the breaches thereof  ; and I will raise up his ruins , and I will build it as in the days of old :

translation.kha: Uta u briew pat un sait ïa la ki jaiñ , un khi lut ïa la u shñiuh , bad un sum un sleh ; te un sa long uba khuid . U lah ban wan rung ka sha jaka shong dara , hynrei u dei ban shong shabar ka ïingjaiñ jong u hynñiew sngi . lynter
translation.en: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes , and shave off all his hair , and wash himself in water , that he may be clean : and after that he shall come into the camp , and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days .

translation.kha: U tnga jong don ban pynskhem ne ban pyndam kano kano ka jingkular ba la .
translation.en: Every vow , and every binding oath to afflict the soul , her husband may establish it , or her husband may make it void .

translation.en: These practices are wrong because ( 1 ) they make us their slaves , ( 2 ) they harm our bodies , and ( 3 ) they are unclean .

translation.en: Now therefore be content , look upon me  ; for it is evident unto you if I lie .

translation.en: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in , who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus , that they might bring us into bondage :
translation.kha: wat la don katto katne ngut kiba kwah ban pyndep ïa ka . Da kaba leh mynleh kum ki parabangeit , kine ki rangbah ki la ïohrung shapoh ka kynhun jong ngi kum ki nongsyntiat , khnang ban lap shaphang ka jinglaitluid kaba ngi la mad da ka jingpynïasoh jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: Kumta ki shah ïa ka Rebekka bad ïa ka shakri ïing batymmen jong ka ba kin leit ryngkat bad u shakri jong u Abraham lem bad ki briew jong u .

translation.en: And the men of Israel were distressed that day : for Saul had adjured the people , saying , Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening , that I may be avenged on mine enemies . So none of the people tasted any food .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la tlot na ka jingthngan ha kata ka sngi , namar u Saul , da ka jingsmai kyntang , u la ai hukum :  Ka jingtim kan long ha uno uno uba bam kano kano ka jingbam mynta ka sngi ha shuwa ba ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki nongshun jong nga .  Kumta ym don uwei ruh na ki uba bam ei ei baroh shi sngi .

Ki jingmut jong hi , da shisha , ki long kiba la set shaïong ; bad haduh kane ka Jehohanan ki jingmut jong ki , ki dang long kiba la Pynphai da kata kajuh suit jingkah haba ki pule ïa ki kitab Baalsebub ka jutang barim . translation.en: But their minds were blinded : for until this day remaineth the same veil untaken away in the reading of the old testament ; which veil is done away in Christ .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka Jerusalem ba kynja bneng ka long kaba laitluid , bad ka ka dei kmie jong ngi keiñ .
translation.en: But Jerusalem which is above is free , which is the mother of us all .

translation.en: And Balaam said unto God , Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , hath sent unto me , saying ,

And they made two other golden rings , and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart of it , over against the other coupling thereof , above the curious girdle of the ephod .
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh sa ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad ki pyndait ïa ki ha trai jong kita ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng kiba sha khmat jong ka ephod , hamar ka jaka suh pyndait , bad haneng ka jingpanpoh ba la thain itynnat bha .
U Trai u pynlong ki ïa wah ban rngad lut bad pynsangeh ïa ki umpohliew ban mih .
translation.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness , and the watersprings into dry ground  ;

translation.kha: Sa wan biang hadien lai sngi bad ngan ai ha phi ïa ka jubab jong nga , u phai ktien . Kumta leit ki noh .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Depart yet for three days , then come again to me . And the people departed .

translation.kha: Nga sngewkmen shaphang ka Stephanas u Phortunatos , bad u Akhaikos ; ki la bujli ïa ka jingbymdon phi ki la pynsngewbha ïa , kumba ki la pynsngewbha ïa phi .
translation.en: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus : for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied .
And the winepress was trodden without the city , and blood came out of the winepress , even unto the horse bridles , by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs .
translation.kha: Ïa ki sohwaiñ la khñiot ha ka jaka khñiot waiñ shabar ka nongbah , bad ka snam ka la mihnoh na ka jaka khñiot waiñ ha ka jingshlei kumba laispah kilomitar ka jingjrong bad la jan ar mitar ka jingjylliew .
Kito kiba la kem U Jisu la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïing jong Kaïaphas , u Rangbah Lyngdoh ha kaba ki ka Hukum bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ïalumlang
translation.en: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest , where the scribes and the elders were assembled .

translation.kha: Hynrei satang katto rung kein , ka jingjia kaba phylla kan sa wan jia .
translation.en: Soon , though , an amazing event will take place .

translation.kha: Ka la pynheh pynsan ïa uwei u khun sing bad hikai ïa u kumno ban behmrad ; la u long u nongbam briew .
translation.en: And she brought up one of her whelps : it became a young lion , and it learned to catch the prey  ; it devoured men .

translation.kha: Sa Karka uta Debir briew u la phah biang ïa kiwei pat ki mraw Shebanaïah kham pynsieb jingshat ñiewburom nyngkong , bad ki nongshimwai ki la leh ïa ki ha kajuh ka rukom .
translation.en: Again , he sent other servants more than the first : and they did unto them likewise .

translation.kha: U Shisien Jisu u la don ha kawei ka shnong ha kaba la don u briew uba la pang ñiangthohlieh . Haba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu u la pyndem khrup ïa lade ha madan bad u la kyrpad ïa u , Ko kynrad , lada me mon , me lah ban ïa pynlong nga uba khuid !
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he was in a certain city , behold a man full of leprosy : who seeing Jesus fell on his face , and besought him , saying , Lord , if thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .

translation.kha: Lada don jingbthuh ha ka jaiñkup la ka jaiñ saiwul ne ka jaiñ linen ,
translation.en: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in , whether it be a woollen garment , or a linen garment  ;

translation.kha: Shephataïah u khun jong u Mattan , u Gedalaïah u khun jong u Pashhur Jehukal u khun jong Shelemaïah , bad u Pashhur u khun jong u Malkhaïah ki la ïohsngew ba nga la ïa ki paidbah
translation.en: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan , and Gedaliah the son of Pashur , and Jucal the son of Shelemiah , and Pashur the son of Malchijah , heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people , saying ,

And they sung a new song , saying , Thou art worthy to take the book , and to open the seals thereof : for thou wast slain , and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred , and tongue , and people , and nation  ;
translation.kha: Ki la rwai ka jingrwai bathymmai :  Me long uba dei hok ban shim ïa ka kot kli bad ban pynpait ïa ki jingpyndait jong ka . Naba la pynïap ïa me , bad da ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong me me la siew kuna na ka bynta ki briew jong U Blei na kawei pa kawei ka jait , ka jait ktien , ka hima bad ka jaitbynriew .

translation.en: Hear ye this word which I take up against you , even a lamentation , O house of Israel .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko ki paid Israel , ïa kane ka jingrwai leit ontep kaba nga rwai ha phi :

translation.en: As touching our brother Apollos , I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren : but his will was not at all to come at this time ; but he will come when he shall have convenient time .
translation.kha: Mynta , shaphang u Apollos u parabangeit , nga la ju pynshlur ïa u ban wan jngoh ïa phi ryngkat bad kiwei ki parabangeit , hynrei um da mon eh ban wan ha kane ka por . Pynban , ynda u ïoh ïa ka lad , un sa wan .

translation.en: Saying ,  Father , if thou be willing , remove this cup from me : nevertheless not my will , but thine , be done .
translation.kha: Ko Pa ,  u la ong ,  lada me mon , shim noh na nga ïa kane ka khuri ka jingshah shitom . Ym ïa ka mon jong nga , pynban , ïa ka mon jong me yn pyndep .
saphron ki long ki nongbah bad ki nongrit ïa kiba la ai pynshngain ki Ïada jingthala ka jait Gad kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki paradais
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families , the cities , and their villages .

translation.kha: ïa ka kaba khlem seisoh , miet khlem ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Lo , let that night be solitary , let no joyful voice come therein .
And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen , and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin ym burom ïa pha , hynrei phan tip ba nga long U  Trai .
Bad lada phi kren than ïa ki paralok jong phi , hato phi Adonijah liat ïa kaei kaei Sawdong kham nalor ? Wat kiba mane blei thala ki leh ïa phon !
translation.en: And if ye salute your brethren only , what do ye more than others ? do not even the publicans so ?

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Ngan ïa shah ki jaitbynriew ba kin ïohi ïa ka burom jong nga ; bad ngan pynpaw ha ki kumno nga pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong nga ban pyndep ïa jingrai ki jong bahok nga .
translation.en: And I will set my glory among the heathen , and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed , and my hand that I have laid upon them .

And , behold , there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou seen all this great multitude ? behold , I will deliver it into thine hand this day  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u syiem Ahab , bad u la ong ,  U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Wat sheptieng ïa katai ka kynhun shipai kaba heh ! Ngan ai jingjop ïa me halor jong ka mynta ka sngi , bad men ïoh tip ba nga dei U  Trai .’

translation.en: Then the men of the city said unto Joash , Bring out thy son , that he may die : because he hath cast down the altar of Baal , and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ong ha u Joash ,  Wallam shabar ïa u khun jong me hangne , ba ngin pynïap ïa u ! U la pynkhyllem ïa ka duwan ïa u Baal bad pynngat ïa ka dak jong ka Asherah kaba ha syndah jong ka .
mala Nun Jesse u Joshua .

translation.en: Train up a child in the way he should go : and when he is old , he will not depart from it .

Therefore hear now this , thou that art given to pleasures , that dwellest carelessly , that sayest in thine heart , I am , and none else beside me  ; I shall not sit as a widow , neither shall I know the loss of children :
translation.kha: To sngap ïa kane , pha kaba ieit ïa ka jinglehsngewbha , pha kaba pyrkhat ba pha shongshngain bad sngewskhem . Pha kam ba pha long kaba khraw kum U Blei — ba ym don mano mano pat kum ma pha . Pha pyrkhat ba da lei lei phan ym long ka riewkynthei lane mad ïa ka jingduh noh ïa la ki khun .

translation.en: The  Lord  shewed me , and , behold , two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the  Lord  , after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , and the princes of Judah , with the carpenters and smiths , from Jerusalem , and had brought them to Babylon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pyn-i ha nga ar shang ki soh Dumbur ba la buh ha khmat ka Templ . ( Kane ka long hadien ba u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la ringmraw ïa u Jehoïakhin , u syiem ka Judah , u khun jong u Jehoïakim , kum u koidi na Jerusalem , lem bad ki nongïalam ka Judah , ki nongtrei dieng , bad ki nongtrei batbit . )

translation.en: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day , he sent them into his vineyard .

kaba ïa-shahskhor u pyndam ïa kata hadien , pynbah hap ban shah ïa jingjubab jingpynshitom na ka jingbymlah ban pyndep ïa ka kular .
translation.en: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them  ; then he shall bear her iniquity .

translation.en: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore , or the price of a dog , into the house of the  Lord  thy God for any vow : for even both these are abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .

translation.en: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother , Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye  ; and , behold , a beam is in thine own eye ?

translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , There is yet one man , by whom we may enquire of the  Lord  : but I hate him  ; for he never prophesied good unto me , but always evil : the same is Micaiah the son of Imlah . And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so .
translation.kha: U Ahab u jubab ,  Don sa uwei , u Mikaïah u khun jong u Imlah . Hynrei nga isih ïa u namar um ju ïathuhlypa kaba bha ïa nga ; ka ju long borabor kaei kaei kaba sniew .   Phim dei ban ong kumta !  u Jehoshaphat u jubab .

translation.en: And I said unto you , I am the  Lord  your God  ; fear not the gods of the Amorites , in whose land ye dwell : but ye have not obeyed my voice .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ha phi ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad ba phim dei ban mane ïa ki blei jong ki Amor , ha ka ri jong ki ba phi ïashong mynta . Hynrei phim shym la shahshkor ïa nga .

translation.en: And when he rose up from prayer , and was come to his disciples , he found them sleeping for sorrow ,
And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish ; because they received not the love of the truth , that they might be saved .
translation.kha: bad un pyndonkam ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingshukor bymman ha kito ki ban sa jot noh . Kin jot noh namar ba kim pdiang sngewbha bad ieit ïa ka jingshisha khnang ba kin ïoh im .

translation.en: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain : and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them . And he suffered them .
