translation.en: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages , teaching in their synagogues , and preaching the gospel of the kingdom , and healing every sickness and every disease among the people .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit jngoh kylleng ki nongbah bad ki nongrit . U la hikai ha ki synagog , u la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima , bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki briew kiba don ki jingpang babun jait bad ki jingshitom .
Kin tei pat ïa ki nongbah la ba jot la pra .
translation.en: And they shall build the old wastes , they shall raise up the former desolations , and they shall repair the waste cities , the desolations of many generations .

translation.kha: Ïa mradkhlaw u la shah ban pynlong ki jingkob sarong kiba long ki jingbeiñ ïa U Blei , bad la shah ïa u ban don bor ka synshar haduh sawphew ar bnai .
translation.en: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies  ; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months .

translation.kha: ïawanlang Elijah u matlah bad ong , Kem ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal ; wat ai ba uno uno na Pahath ïakdang lait phet ! Ki paidbah ki la kem ïa ki baroh , bad u Elijah paitlieng la ïalam ïa ki sha ka wah Kishon bad pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto them , Take the prophets of Baal  ; let not one of them escape . And they took them : and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon , and slew them there .
The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren pat ,

U Trai u la ïathuh ha nga ban ai ïa kane khubor ha ka Judah , ki ki ksiew u Dabid : To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga U Trai , nga ong . To khmih ba yn ka jingbishar hok la ka . Ïada u briew uba shah thok na uta thok ïa u . Lada leh kumta , jingbymman phi leh kan pynlong ka jingbitar jong nga kum ka ding kaba lah ban pynlip .
translation.en: O house of David , thus saith the  Lord   ; Execute judgment in the morning , and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor , lest my fury go out like fire , and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .

translation.kha: Pyni ha nga u ïa briew uba sarong bad ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa u briew uba hangamei , uba bad sarong u bym ju kheiñ briew .
translation.en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name , who dealeth in proud wrath .
Kedemoth with her suburbs , and Mephaath with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Kedemoth , bad ka Mephaath , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: Not because we have not power , but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh ïa kane , ym namar ba ngim don ka hok ban dawa jingkyrshan ïa ngi ; ngi la leh ïa ka , ban long ka nuksa na ka bynta jong phi ban bud .

translation.en: They that forsake the law praise the wicked : but such as keep the law contend with them .
translation.kha: Kito kiba lyndet ïa ka hukum ki ïaroh ïa ki bymman ; hynrei kito kiba bat ïa ka ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead . As for Saul , he was yet in Gilgal , and all the people followed him trembling .
translation.kha: kiwei pat ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha ki ri Gad bad Gilead . U Saul u dang don ha Gilgal , bad ki briew kiba bad u ki la khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: Notwithstanding the  Lord  turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath , wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah , because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ka jingbitar shla U  Trai  la pynkhih pyrshah ïa ka Judah da kaei kaba u syiem Manasseh u la leh , bad wat mynta ruh kam shym la duh noh .

translation.en: Shuppim also , and Huppim , the children of Ir , and Hushim , the sons of Aher .
translation.kha: U Shuppim bad u Huppim ruh ki long na kane ka jait . U Dan u don uwei u khun , u Hushim .

translation.en: And they of Beth–shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley : and they lifted up their eyes , and saw the ark , and rejoiced to see it .
translation.kha: Ki nong Beth Shemesh ha kata ka por ki dang ïa-ot kew ha them , bad kynsan haba ki khmied ki la ïohi ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ki dap da ka jingkmen haba ki ïohi ïa ka .

translation.en: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle  ; and the city shall be taken , and the houses rifled , and the women ravished  ; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity , and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un wallam lang ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ban ïaleh thma ïa ka Jerusalem . Ïa ka nongbah yn sa shim noh , ïa ki ïing la lute , bad ïa ki kynthei la batbor . Shiteng na ki briew kin leit sha ka jingshah ringmraw , hynrei ïa kiba sah na ki yn ym shim noh na ka nongbah .

translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of wisdom : and the knowledge of the holy is understanding .
translation.kha: Ban long kiba stad , nyngkong phi dei ban tiengburom ïa U  Trai . Lada phi tip ïa uta Uba Khuid , phi don ka jingshemphang .
uba la leit noh bneng bad u don ha ka kti kamon U , da kaba synshar halor ki baroh ki nongsynshar ki bor ba kynja bneng .
translation.en: Who is gone into heaven , and is on the right hand of God  ; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him .
Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens . And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities , Pithom and Rameses .
translation.kha: Kumta ki nong Ijipt ki thung ïa ki nongpyntrei mraw kiba pynsaja ïa ki da kaba pynbor ba kin trei ïa ki kam kiba shitom sat . Ki Israel ki tei ïa ki nongbah Pithom bad Rameses ba kin long ki jaka kynshew jingbam u Pharaoh .

translation.en: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings , saith the  Lord  : and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof , and it shall devour all things round about it .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa pha ïa kaei kaba pha la leh . Ngan thang ïa ka ïingsyiem jong pha da ka ding , bad kan bam duh ïa baroh kat kaba don sawdong jong ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: A voice was heard upon the high places , weeping and supplications of the children of Israel : for they have perverted their way , and they have forgotten the  Lord  their God .

translation.en: The Spirit of the Lord  God  is upon me  ; because the  Lord  hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek  ; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted , to proclaim liberty to the captives , and the opening of the prison to them that are bound  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la pyndap ïa nga da U Mynsiem jong u . U la jied ïa nga bad phah ïa nga ban wallam ïa ka khubor babha sha kiba duk , ban pynkhiah ïa kiba la pait dohnud , ban pynbna ka jingpyllait ïa ki mraw bad ka jinglaitluid ïa kito kiba ha ka byndi .

Ngan pynsakma piam ki briew jong nga ha thyrnia ki nongshun jong ki , kum ïa u pui pui ba la beh da ka lyer mihngi . Ngan pynphai ïa la ka ingdong halor jong ki ; ngan ym ïarap ïa ki haba jingpah jingpynjot ka wan .
translation.en: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy  ; I will shew them the back , and not the face , in the day of their calamity .
Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt , even to this day , but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle .
translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba nga la pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt haduh mynta , ngam pat ju shong ha ka templ ; nga la leit kylleng kylleng da kaba shong ha ka ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee :
translation.kha: Lada ki mraw kiba phet na la u kynrad ki wan wad jingïada na phi , wat phah pat ïa ki sha u kynrad jong ki .
ki A long kiba la tim ! Ki la iehnoh ïa bad nga ïeng pyrshah ïa nga . Ïa ki yn pynduh noh . Nga la kwah ban pyllait im ïa ki , hynrei ka jingmane jong ki ïa nga ka kaba long thala .
translation.en: Woe unto them ! for they have fled from me : destruction unto them ! because they have transgressed against me : though I have redeemed them , yet they have spoken lies against me .
The full soul loatheth an honeycomb  ; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet .
translation.kha: Haba phi la kdang , phin hap kyntait wat ïa ka ngap ruh ; hynrei haba phi thngan , wat ka jingbam kaba kthang ruh ka thiang .
U pynlong ïa ki pud jong ban long skhem bad u pynkdang ïa phi da u kew babha .
translation.en: He maketh peace in thy borders , and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat .

And if any man said unto him , Let them not fail to burn the fat presently , and then take as much as thy soul desireth  ; then he would answer him , Nay  ; but thou shalt give it me now : and if not , I will take it by force .
translation.kha: Lada uta u briew u jubab ,  Ai ngin leh ïa kaba dei bad ieh kin da thang shuwa ïa ka khleiñ ; nangta sa shim katba phi kwah ,  uta u shakri u lyngdoh u ju ong ,  Em ! Ai noh mynta kumne ! Lym kumta , ngan shim ïa ka da ka bor !

translation.en: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me , and sat before me .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la wan ban kylli na nga shaphang ka mon U  Trai .

translation.en: Those things , which ye have both learned , and received , and heard , and seen in me , do : and the God of peace shall be with you .
translation.kha: Pyntreikam ïa kaei kaba phi la nang bad ïohpdiang na nga , na ki ktien jong nga bad ki kam jong nga . Bad U Blei uba ai ha ngi ka jingsuk , un long lem bad phi .

translation.en: And she said unto her husband , Behold now , I perceive that this is an holy man of God , which passeth by us continually .
translation.kha: Ka ong ha la u tnga ,  Nga thikna ba une u briew uba wan bunsien hangne u dei u riewkhuid .

translation.en: Just as a shepherd diligently cares for each one of his sheep , the elders try to get to know every member of the congregation individually . —Proverbs 27 :23 .
translation.kha: Kumba u nongap langbrot u shim khia ban sumar ïa la ki langbrot , ki rangbah balang ruh ki pyrshang ban tip ïa iwei pa iwei i dkhot ka balang .

Hynrei namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ki ngi la pynbitar ïa U Blei ka Bneng , u la shah ba yn jop noh ïa ki da u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka , Babilonia u ka syiem na longïing syiem Khaldi . Ïa ka Templ la pynjot bad ïa ki briew la ringmraw sha Babilonia .
translation.en: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath , he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , the Chaldean , who destroyed this house , and carried the people away into Babylon .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei kumno meng Blei Badonbor Baroh u pynshitom ïa Shemesh bymman , ki briew kiba lehbor .
translation.en: This is the portion of a wicked man with God , and the heritage of oppressors , which they shall receive of the Almighty .

translation.kha: Pynban U Trai u la ïohsngew ïa ki haba ki kyang , bad u khmih ïa ki jingjynjar jong . ki
translation.en: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction , when he heard their cry :
My son , attend unto my wisdom , and bow thine ear to my understanding :
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , to sngap bad shahshkor ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang jong nga .

translation.en: But if any provide not for his own , and specially for those of his own house , he hath denied the faith , and is worse than an infidel .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno um sumar ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , khamtam ïa ki dkhot ka longïing jong u hi , u la len ïa ka jingngeit bad u kham sniew ban ïa u bymngeit .
Kynmaw kumno u Moses , waitbnoh shakri jong U Trai , u la ïathuh ha phi ba U Trai U Blei jong phi jingisynei ai Sabbaton phi ïa kane ka ri ha ka phang ― Bethanath ka Jordan kum ka ïing jong phi .
translation.en: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded you , saying , The  Lord  your God hath given you rest , and hath given you this land .

Therefore it shall come to pass , that as all good things are come upon you , which the  Lord  your God promised you  ; so shall the  Lord  bring upon you all evil things , until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the  Lord  your God hath given you .
translation.kha: Hynrei kumba u la bat ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong ha phi , kumta ruh un pyndep ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingbyrngem .

Kynsan , hangne ki wan ! Ki rangbah halor jong ki kulai , shi jur mynhynnin basian . U nongap phira u ai ka khubor , Ka Babilon ka ïarieh Samaria ! tyngkai phangpdeng bleithaw kiba ki la mane ki la kyllon nongwankai ka jingpait Naarah ha madan .
translation.en: And , behold , here cometh a chariot of men , with a couple of horsemen . And he answered and said , Babylon is fallen , is fallen  ; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground .

translation.kha: Me wat khang ïa nga , naba ngan jingkhor thiaw ïa ki ba kumta yn ym don shuh u ban kheiñduh kynmaw ïa ki Nikopolis Nangta ngan pynlong ïa Khatwei u kpa jong ka jaitbynriew kaba kham khraw pyiar kham donbor ban ïa ki .’
translation.en: Let me alone , that I may destroy them , and blot out their name from under heaven : and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they .

Gather the people together , men , and women , and children , and thy stranger that is within thy gates , that they may hear , and that they may learn , and fear the  Lord  your God , and observe to do all the words of this law :
translation.kha: Khot lang ïa ki shynrang , ïa ki kynthei , bad ïa ki khynnah baroh , bad ïa ki nongwei ruh kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi , khnang ba uwei pa uwei un ïohsngew ïa ka bad un nang ban burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong U .

translation.en: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh , so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife , the sister of Tahpenes the queen .
translation.kha: U Hadad u ïoh ïa ka jingïadei paralok bad u syiem u ai ïa ka para kynsi , ka para jong ka Syiem Tahpenes ha u Hadad ban shongkurim ïa ka .
Ka sniehdoh Girsi nga kam ïadait bha shuh bad kotbah shyieng ; nga la shu lait im da ka said .
translation.en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh , and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth .

translation.kha: U syiem pynkhynñiuh jong ka Tyros u phah ka kynhun ki nongkhaïi sha u bam ; u pynbiang “rangbah Blang ki dieng sawdong —Ephesos bad ki misteri dieng bad ki misteri maw Adriel khlemrain ïing ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David , and cedar trees , and carpenters , and masons : and they built David an house .
For they will turn away thy son from following me , that they may serve other gods : so will the anger of the  Lord  be kindled against you , and destroy thee suddenly .
translation.kha: ïoh kin phai dien noh na U  Trai  ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Lada jia kumta , U  Trai  un bitar lep ïa phi bad un pynjot ïa phi shisyndon .
ka kynthei ka ong ha u Elisha Nga smai da ka jingïaineh jong nga ha U Trai im bad ha phi ba ngan ym ïa phi ! Kumta ar ngut ki la ïamih lang .
translation.en: And the mother of the child said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . And he arose , and followed her .
And when he had so said , he shewed unto them his hands and his side . Then were the disciples glad , when they saw the Lord .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la ong ïa kane , u la pyn-i ha ki ïa la ki kti bad ïa la ka krung . Ki synran ki la dap da ka jingkmen haba ki la ïohi ïa U Trai .
jingat phyllung ka jingïap ki don nga , ki jingat phyllung ka ki tyllun halor nga ;
translation.en: When the waves of death compassed me , the floods of ungodly men made me afraid  ;
And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father  ; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: bad pynlong ïa ngi ka hima jong ki lyngdoh ban shakri ïa U Blei bad U Kpa jong u . Ha U Jisu Khrist , to long ka burom bad ka bor junom la junom ! Amen .

translation.en: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back ? and their mighty ones are beaten down , and are fled apace , and look not back : for fear was round about , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei kaei ba nga ïohi ?  U  Trai  u kylli .  Ki phai dien ha ka jingsheptieng . Ki shipai jong ki , ki shah beh noh ; kiba dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki mareh stet kat lah kat ïai bad kim kyrtiang dien .

translation.en: Therefore when they were gathered together , Pilate said unto them , Whom will ye that I release unto you ? Barabbas , or Jesus which is called Christ ?
translation.kha: Kumta haba u paidbah u la ïalumlang , u Pilat u la kylli ïa ki ,  Uno na kine phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ? Ïa u Jisu Barabbas ne ïa U Jisu uba la khot U Messaïah ?

translation.en: And the king said unto them , I have dreamed a dream , and my spirit was troubled to know the dream .
translation.kha: u la ong ha ki ,  Nga la khuslai shaphang ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la ïoh . Nga kwah ban tip kaei ka jingmut jong ka .

translation.en: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace , and calling one to another , and saying , We have piped unto you , and ye have not danced  ; we have mourned to you , and ye have not wept .
translation.kha: Ki long kum ki khynnah kiba shong ha ki jaka ïew . Kawei ka kynhun ka pyrta ïa kawei pat , ‘ Ngi la tem ka jingtem shongkurim na ka bynta jong phi , hynrei phim shym shad ! Ngi la rwai ki jingrwai ïapbriew , hynrei phim shym ïam !’
To ïaroh ïa u ïamir ki nongsynshar rnong . To ïaroh ïa u da ki wiang rnong bajam .
translation.en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals : praise him upon the high sounding cymbals .
Tom doesn't realise how his behaviour affects others .
translation.kha: U Tom um poi-pyrkhat kumno ka ka jinglong jong u ka ktah ia kiwei .
Te kin ki briew nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong
translation.en: And they shall be my people , and I will be their God :
But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day , and it smote the gourd that it withered .
translation.kha: Hynrei dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , ha ka hukum U Blei , u ksaiñ u la bam ïa u jingthung , bad u la ïap noh .
Ka kynhun ka la aiti ïa ki ha ki apostol , kiba la bad buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki .
translation.en: Whom they set before the apostles : and when they had prayed , they laid their hands on them .
He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house  ; but he that hateth gifts shall live .
translation.kha: Kaba pyrshang ban ïohnong da ka bymhok , ka pynngat ïa la ka longïing ha ka jingjynjar . Wat bamsap bad phin ïoh im slem .

dei ban sumar ïa kane ka jingpynbeit ryntih ha ki por ki ban wan baroh . Uta u briew uba synreit ïa um ka jingpynkhuid u dei ruh ban sait ïa la ki ; uno uno uba ktah kata ka um ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
translation.en: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them , that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes  ; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even .

translation.kha: ‘ Wat klim
translation.en: Neither shalt thou commit adultery .

translation.kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah khatsan snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun
translation.en: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years , and begat sons and daughters :

translation.kha: Kito kiba lyndet ïa ka hukum ki ïaroh ïa ki bymman ; hynrei kito kiba bat ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: They that forsake the law praise the wicked : but such as keep the law contend with them .
So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month , in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa .
translation.kha: Ki ïalumlang ha Jerusalem ha u bnai uba lai jong ka snem kaba khatsan ba u Asa u long syiem .

translation.en: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour , or buyest ought of thy neighbour s hand , ye shall not oppress one another :
translation.kha: Kumta , haba phi ïadie ïathied khyndew para Israel , wat ïashukor paralok hi .
Hapdeng ki paid Israel yn don ym shuh ki jingïohipaw ba bakla lane ki jingïathuhlypa kiba ïalam bakla .
translation.en: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel .
Which alone spreadeth out the heavens , and treadeth upon the waves of the sea .
translation.kha: Ym don ba ïarap ïa U Blei ban pynïar ïa ki bneng lane ïuh halor ka met ki mrad kynsha ka duriaw .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he had made an end of speaking all these words , that the ground clave asunder that was under them :
translation.kha: Mar ïadep kren ïa kine ki ktien , ka khyndew ha kaba u Dathan bad u Abiram ki ïeng ka la kad arliang
Kumta ïa kaei kaei kaba phi la ong ha kaba dum yn ïohsngew ha kaba shai ka , bad ïa kaei kaei kaba phi la jar jar ha ka kamra ba la khang , yn pyrta na ki tnum .
translation.en: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light  ; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops .

translation.kha: U ïarap ïa ngi ha ki jingjynjar jong ngi baroh , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïarap ïa kiwei kiba don ki jingjynjar babun , jait da kaba pyndonkam ïa kajuh lad ka jingïarap kaba ngi hi ngi la ïohpdiang U na Blei .
translation.en: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation , that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble , by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God .
Then Jacob said unto his household , and to all that were with him , Put away the strange gods that are among you , and be clean , and change your garments :
translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u ong ha la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem bad ha kita baroh kiba don lem bad u ,  Bret noh ïa ki blei nongwei baroh kiba phi don ; pynkhuid ïa lade , bad phong da ki jaiñ kiba khuid .

translation.en: But his sons shall be stirred up , and shall assemble a multitude of great forces : and one shall certainly come , and overflow , and pass through : then shall he return , and be stirred up , even to his fortress .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u syiem ka Syria kin pynkhreh ïa ka thma bad ki ïalum ka kynhun shipai bakhraw . Kawei na ki kan sar kum ka jingshlei um bad kan tur ïaleh ïa ka kut jong u nongshun .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz , and all that he did , and his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoahas u la leh bad ki kam shlur jong u baroh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: Many of the people therefore , when they heard this saying , said , Of a truth this is the Prophet .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew ha uta u paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ïa kane bad ki la ong ,  Une u briew u dei da shisha u nongïathuhlypa .
Wat la phi kam ba phi mane ïa U nongring , phim shym mut kumba phi ong Kishion
translation.en: And though they say , The  Lord  liveth  ; surely they swear falsely .

translation.kha: Joppa lano lano phin jingshahdaiñ thngan , bad phin ym kyrduh dkhiew jingsbun . Ha teng mawsiang jong ryñiot don u nar , bad ha ki Mibsan jong ka lah Emim tih tama .
translation.en: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness , thou shalt not lack any thing in it  ; a land whose stones are iron , and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass .
And Jesus stood still , and commanded him to be called . And they call the blind man , saying unto him , Be of good comfort , rise  ; he calleth thee .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la ong ,  Khot ïa u .  Kumta ki la khot ïa uta u briew uba matlah .  To lehkmen !  ki la ong .  Ïeng joit , u khot ïa me .

Baroh ngi ïadon lang ha lyngkha ba ngi ïateh ïabun ïa u kew , ha kaba ka song jong nga ka khie joit bad ka ïeng beit . Ki song jong phi pyntieng jingibieit Sebulun sawdong ïa ka song jong nga , bad ki ïanguh ïa ka .
translation.en: For , behold , we were binding sheaves in the field , and , lo , my sheaf arose , and also stood upright  ; and , behold , your sheaves stood round about , and made obeisance to my sheaf .

translation.kha: Ka long borabor kaba smat kaba sting bad ka khmih ki ïa jingdonkam ha ka longïing jong ka .
translation.en: She looketh well to the ways of her household , and eateth not the bread of idleness .

translation.kha: nga Kumno lah ban ieh ïa phi , ko Israel ? nga Kumno lah ban iehnoh ïa phi Hato ? ngan pynjot junom ïa phi kumba nga leh ïa ka Admah , lane ngan leh ïa phi kumba nga leh ïa ka ? Seboiim Ka dohnud jong nga kan ym shah ïa nga ban leh ïa kata ! Ka jingieit jong nga ïa phi ka khlaiñ long haduh katta katta .
translation.en: How shall I give thee up , Ephraim ? how shall I deliver thee , Israel ? how shall I make thee as Admah ? how shall I set thee as Zeboiim ? mine heart is turned within me , my repentings are kindled together .
And the scribes and Pharisees watched him , whether he would heal on the sabbath day  ; that they might find an accusation against him .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la kwah daw ban mudui ïa U Jisu ba u leh bakla , kumta ki la ïakhmih bniah ïa u ban ïohi lada un pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me , and strengthened me ; that by me the preaching might be fully known , and that all the Gentiles might hear : and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la pynim ïa nga bad u la ai bor ïa nga , ba nga la lah ban ïalap ïa ka gospel , bad ba ki Jentil baroh kin ïohsngew ; U Blei u la pyllait ïa nga na ka jingïap .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Touch me not  ; for I am not yet ascended to my Father : but go to my brethren , and say unto them , I ascend unto my Father , and your Father  ; and to my God , and your God .
translation.kha: Wat ktah ïa nga ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  namar ngam pat shym la leit kiew sha U Kpa . Hynrei khie leit sha ki para jong nga bad ïathuh ïa ki ba ngan leit phai sha u , uba long U Kpa jong nga bad U Kpa jong ki , U Blei jong nga bad U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom , and upright ones with him  ; thus shall he do : and he shall give him the daughter of women , corrupting her : but she shall not stand on his side , neither be for him .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Syria un pynkhreh ka jinghiarthma , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh kawei . Nangta , khnang ban pynjot ïa ka hima jong u nongshun , un pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u bad tyrwa ha u ban shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u ; hynrei ka jingthmu jong u kan ym jop .

translation.en: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes , and his commandments , which I command thee this day , that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee , and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , for ever .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , khnang ba ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin manbha . Phin ïaishong sah ha kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ba kan long ka nongkynti jong phi junom .
Me lah ban Bani batymmen u , bad ïathuh ha u ïa Madmannah kaba bajyrngam ong . Ngan ïarap ïa Body baroh ar ngut ban ïangat , bad ngan ïathuh ha ïashem aïu Shillong leh .
translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto him , and put words in his mouth : and I will be with thy mouth , and with his mouth , and will teach you what ye shall do .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la mih na ka synagog bad la u leit sha ïing jong u Simon Ka . kiaw kurim jong u Simon ka la pang bad ka jingpang kaba shit jur , bad ki la ïathuh ha U Jisu shaphang jong ka .
translation.en: And he arose out of the synagogue , and entered into Simon s house . And Simon s wife s mother was taken with a great fever  ; and they besought him for her .

translation.kha: Haba u syiem Jehoïakim bad ki shipai bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Uriah u la lah ong , u syiem u la pyrshang ban phah pynïap ïa u . u Hynrei Uriah u la ïohsngew shaphang kata ; kumta u la phet ha ka jingsngewtriem bad u la lait sha phet Ijipt .
translation.en: And when Jehoiakim the king , with all his mighty men , and all the princes , heard his words , the king sought to put him to death : but when Urijah heard it , he was afraid , and fled , and went into Egypt  ;

And Moses said , It is not meet so to do  ; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the  Lord  our God : lo , shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes , and will they not stone us ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u jubab ,  Kam long kaba dei ba ngin leh kumta , namar ki nong Ijipt kin thut haba ngin kñia ïa ki mrad kiba ngi ai sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Lada ngi pyndonkam ïa kine ki mrad bad pynmong ïa ki nong Ijipt da kaba kñia ïa kine ki jingri ha ka jaka ba ki lah ban ïohi , kin sa lynthem maw ïa ngi .

translation.en: But I would have you know , that the head of every man is Christ ; and the head of the woman is the man ; and the head of Christ is God .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga kwah ïa phi ba phin sngewthuh ba U Khrist u long halor tam ïa uwei pa uwei briew , u tnga u long halor la ka tnga , bad U Blei u long halor tam ïa U Khrist .

translation.en: Yea doubtless , and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord : for whom I have suffered the loss of all things , and do count them but dung , that I may win Christ ,
translation.kha: Ia ki jingartatiend ; nga ñiew ïa kiei kiei baroh kum ka jingduh ba-pura na ka bynta kata kaba kham kor palat , ka jingtip ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong nga .
Naba lada la don ka shipa ha kata kaba la neh tang shipor , kaba haduh katno keiñ ka burom ka don ha kata kaba neh junom !
translation.en: For if that which is done away was glorious , much more that which remaineth is glorious .
And there were eight boards  ; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver , under every board two sockets .
translation.kha: Kumta don phra tylli ki jingker bad khathynriew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei kawei ka jingker .

translation.en: If thy brother be waxen poor , and hath sold away some of his possession , and if any of his kin come to redeem it , then shall he redeem that which his brother sold .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u Israel u kylla duk bad u hap ban die ïa la ka khyndew , u ba-ha-ïing bajan eh jong u , un thied pat ïa ka .

translation.en: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation , because the cloud abode thereon , and the glory of the  Lord  filled the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Namar kane , u Moses um shym lah ban leit rung shapoh kata ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And they gave forth their lots  ; and the lot fell upon Matthias  ; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïakynting sbai ban jied napdeng ki ar ngut ki rangbah , bad uta uba la jied u la long u Matthias , ïa uba la pynïasoh sha ka kynhun ki khatwei ngut ki apostol .

translation.en: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you : for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another .
translation.kha: Ym da donkam ban thoh sha phi shaphang ka jingïa-ieit ïa ki parabangeit jong phi . Ma phi hi phi long kiba la ïoh hikai na U Blei kumno phi dei ban ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Son of man , when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously , then will I stretch out mine hand upon it , and will break the staff of the bread thereof , and will send famine upon it , and will cut off man and beast from it :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  lada ka ri ka leh pop bad kam ïaineh ha nga , ngan kner ïa ka kti jong nga bad pynduh ïa ka jingpyndap jingbam jong ka . Ngan phah ïa ka  nemsniew bad pynïap ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh .

translation.en: Provide neither gold , nor silver , nor brass in your purses ,
translation.kha: Wat rah ïa kano kano ka ksiar , ka rupa , lane ka pisa tama ha ki pla jong phi ;

translation.en: For thou verily givest thanks well , but the other is not edified .
translation.kha: Wat lada ka jingduwai ainguh jong phi ka biang bha , kam ïarap ei ei ïa uwei pat u briew .
Uno uno u bym ieit , um ithuh ïa U Blei , U Blei u long ka jingieit
translation.en: He that loveth not knoweth not God  ; for God is love .

translation.kha: Ai ki ïa lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .
translation.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , and the meat offering thereof , and their drink offerings .

translation.kha: Die Makedonia don ka jingïapait biang hapdeng ki Sebulun namar kine lyngkhai ktien .
translation.en: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings .

translation.kha: Nga long U jong kpa jong me , U Blei u Abraham , u Isaak u Jakob de . Kumta u Moses u tap ïa la khmat , namar um nud ban peit U .
translation.en: Moreover he said , I am the God of thy father , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . And Moses hid his face  ; for he was afraid to look upon God .

translation.kha: bad phi ïohi hapdeng ki ïa kynthei kaba bhabriew imon ban shongkurim ,
translation.en: And seest among the captives a beautiful woman , and hast a desire unto her , that thou wouldest have her to thy wife  ;
As soon then as he had said unto them ,  I am he ,  they went backward , and fell to the ground .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Dei ma nga uta ,  ki la kynriah shadien bad ki la kyllon ha madan .

translation.en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly : and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground .
translation.kha: Ha ka jinglyng-a kaba khraw u la duwai kham jur shuh shuh ; ka syep jong u ka la long kum ki jingjaw ka snam kaba hap ha madan .

translation.en: Hear me , O  Lord  , hear me , that this people may know that thou art the  Lord  God , and that thou hast turned their heart back again .
translation.kha: Jubab ïa nga , A  Trai  , jubab ïa nga , khnang ba une u paidbah un tip ba me , U  Trai  , me long U Blei , bad ba men sa wallam pat ïa ki sha lade hi .

Ha ka sngi kaba bud , haba bymmyntoi Moses u leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ Shithi u la ïohi ba u diengduh jong u Aaron , uba ïeng na ka bynta ka jait Lebi , u la khie lung . U la bakhadduh , phuh syntiew , bad sei bakohnguh soh almond kiba ih !
translation.en: And it came to pass , that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness  ; and , behold , the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded , and brought forth buds , and bloomed blossoms , and yielded almonds .
And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet , and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds , from one end of heaven to the other .
translation.kha: Ka turoi bakhraw kan sawa , bad un phah ïa ki angel jong u sha ki sawlyer jong ka pyrthei , ban kin lumlang ïa ki briew kiba la jied jong u na kawei ka tduh jong ka pyrthei sha kawei pat .
Ha ka jingshisha , ka lah ban pyllait ïa ka jingim .
translation.en: Thou shalt beat him with the rod , and shalt deliver his soul from hell .
Who hate the good , and love the evil  ; who pluck off their skin from off them , and their flesh from off their bones  ;
translation.kha: pynban phi isih ïa kaei kaba bha bad phi ieit ïa kaei kaba sniew . Phi khoh snieh im ïa ki briew jong nga bad phi tar ïa ka doh na ki shyieng jong ki .

translation.en: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth :
translation.kha: U Baana , u khun jong u Hushai : ka thain Asher bad ka shnong Bealoth

translation.en: Also he built Beth–horon the upper , and Beth–horon the nether , fenced cities , with walls , gates , and bars  ;
translation.kha: U Solomon u la tei biang ïa kine ki nongbah : ka Beth Horon Neng bad ka Beth Horon Rum , ( ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh bad ki khyrdop kiba lah ban khang ) ,
Namar phi long kiba la pynkyntang khuid U sha Trai U Blei jong phi . U la jied ïa phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei ba phin long ka jaitbynriew kaba jong kyrpang u .
translation.en: For thou art an holy people unto the  Lord  thy God : the  Lord  thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself , above all people that are upon the face of the earth .

And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite , David s counsellor , from his city , even from Giloh , while he offered sacrifices . And the conspiracy was strong  ; for the people increased continually with Absalom .
translation.kha: Bad katba u dang ai jingkñia , u Absalom u phah khot ruh na ka shnong Gilo ïa u Ahithophel , uba long uwei na ki nongaibuit jong u Syiem Dabid . Ka jingthmu barieh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka nang jur , bad ki nongbud jong u Absalom ki nang bun .

translation.en: A man shall not be established by wickedness : but the root of the righteous shall not be moved .
translation.kha: Ka jingleh bymman kam wanrah ïa ka jingshngain , hynrei ki briew kiba hok ki ïeng skhem .
ba u patsha da pynbeit pat ïa phi ha ka ri kaba kum ka jong phi hi , ha kaba don ki bri ban ai waiñ bad ha kaba u ban shna jingbam .
translation.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of corn and wine , a land of bread and vineyards .
That lie upon beds of ivory , and stretch themselves upon their couches , and eat the lambs out of the flock , and the calves out of the midst of the stall  ;
translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba thiah halor ki jingthiah baremdor , kiba ïakhawai da ki khun masi bad khunlangbrot !
Hangta bad ki la don u Heman bad u Jeduthun bad kiwei ïa kiba nongmuna jied kyrpang ban rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh ha U Trai na ka Demas Gris jingieit bymjukut jong u Tyros
translation.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun , and the rest that were chosen , who were expressed by name , to give thanks to the  Lord  , because his mercy endureth for ever  ;

translation.kha: U Blei kan kham pynbha ïa ka jingim jong phi ?
translation.en: How can God’s Word improve your life ?

translation.kha: Hangta u Judah u la ïakynduh ïa ka samla nong uba Kanaan u kpa jong ka u kyrteng u Shua .
translation.en: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite , whose name was Shua  ; and he took her , and went in unto her .
The land shall be utterly emptied , and utterly spoiled : for the  Lord  hath spoken this word .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kan ka pra bad kan jot . U  Trai  u la kren bad ïa kata yn pyndep .

translation.en: And after him Elon , a Zebulunite , judged Israel  ; and he judged Israel ten years .
translation.kha: Hadien u Ibsan , u Elon uba na Sebulun u ïalam ïa ki Israel shiphew snem .

translation.en: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright : but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba stad ki kren , ki pynlong ïa ka jingtip kaba pdiang hun , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki khlei ïa ka jingbieit .
ar pat khun shynrang jong u Ladan ; u bad u Joel ki dei peit ïa ki ïing jingkynshew ïing buh jong ka Templ .
translation.en: The sons of Jehieli  ; Zetham , and Joel his brother , which were over the treasures of the house of the  Lord .
For such are false apostles , deceitful workers , transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ .
translation.kha: Kito ki briew kim long ki apostol kiba shisha — ki long ki apostol lamler , kiba shukor shaphang ka jingtrei jong ki bad thawdur ïa lade ban i kum ki apostol bashisha jong U Khrist .
Ki ngab jong pynbitar du phar napoh Ieh jaiñtapkhmat jong phi .
translation.en: This thy stature is like to a palm tree , and thy breasts to clusters of grapes .

translation.kha: U Simon Petros bad uwei pat u synran la bud ïa U Jisu . Uta uwei u synran u la long la ïa-ithuh bha u Rangbah Lyngdoh kumta la rung lem bad Jisu sha ka phyllaw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u Petros pat u la ïeng shabar hajan ka khyrdop .
translation.en: And Simon Peter followed Jesus , and so did another disciple : that disciple was known unto the high priest , and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u phai ktien , Wat ki Israel ruh kim sngap nga , u Pharaoh lei shano un sngap ? dei briew uba duna ka ktien ka thylliej .
translation.en: And Moses spake before the  Lord  , saying , Behold , the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me  ; how then shall Pharaoh hear me , who am of uncircumcised lips ?

translation.kha: Ha kaba nyngkong u la , Mem mon lane mem shym sngewbha ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki jingainguh ïa ki mrad thang ha ka duwan bad ïa ki jingkñia ïa ka ban kit noh ïa ki . U la ong ïa kane wat haba ïa baroh jingkñia la ainguh kat kum ka Hukum .
translation.en: Above when he said , Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not , neither hadst pleasure therein  ; which are offered by the law  ;
In those days they shall say no more , The fathers have eaten a sour grape , and the children s teeth are set on edge .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por kan wan , ki briew kin ym ong shuh ,   ‘ Ki kmie ki kpa ki la bam ïa u sohwaiñ bajew , hynrei ki khun ki ïoh ïa ka jingmad kaba jew .’

translation.en: And all king Solomon s drinking vessels were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold  ; none were of silver : it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon .
translation.kha: Baroh ki khuri dih jingdih jong u Solomon ki long kiba la shna da ka ksiar , bad baroh ki khiew ki pliang ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon    ki long kiba da ka ksiar nylla . Ym shym pyndonkam da ka rupa , namar kam shym long kaba la ñiewkordor ha ki sngi u Solomon .

U ruh u la shet pynjah ka jingbam kaba Bethgamul bad u leit rah ïa ka sha la :13-15 kpa . U ong , Ko pa , sngewbha bashisha Maher-shalal-hash-bas kyllaiñ shong bad bam khyndiat bit kane ka doh ba nga la wanrah ïa phi , ba Hajan lah ïabna ai ha Sngi ïa jaiñkup jingkyrkhu tud phi .
translation.en: And he also had made savoury meat , and brought it unto his father , and said unto his father , Let my father arise , and eat of his son s venison , that thy soul may bless me .
As obedient children , not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance :
translation.kha: To kohnguh ïa U Blei , bad wat shah ba ïa ka jingim jong phi yn pynwandur da kito ki jingkwah brai kiba phi la ju don mynba phi dang don ha ka jingbymtip .

translation.en: And when they had sung an hymn , they went out into the mount of Olives .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïarwai jingrwai bad ki la leit noh sha u lum ki Olib .

translation.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites  ; and David s sons were chief rulers .
translation.kha: u Benaïah , u khun jong u Jehoïada u long uba khmih ïa ki nongïada jong u Dabid ; bad ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki la long ki lyngdoh .
Bad kumta ngan wan sha phi da jingkmen kaba dap , ka long ka mon jong U Blei , bad ngan dap da ka jinghun ba pynpyngngad ngan wan khmih ïa phi .
translation.en: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God , and may with you be refreshed .
And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years .
translation.kha: U Isaak u la im shispah phraphew snem ,
bad sanphew ngut na ki nongïathuhlypa ki la bud ïa ki sha Jordan . U Elijah bad u Elisha ki la sangeh harud wah , bad sanphew ngut ki la ïeng kham pajih .
translation.en: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went , and stood to view afar off : and they two stood by Jordan .

translation.kha: Mynta hukum ïa paid ki Israel baroh ban ïakynduh ïa nga ha u Lum Karmel . Wallam ruh sanphew sawspah ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal bad sawspah ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong blei ka Asherah kiba ïoh jingkyrshan na ka syiem Jesebel .
translation.en: Now therefore send , and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel , and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty , and the prophets of the groves four hundred , which eat at Jezebel s table .
Cast me not off in the time of old age  ; forsake me not when my strength faileth .
translation.kha: Wat kyntait ïa nga mynta ba nga la tymmen ; wat iehnoh ïa nga mynta ba nga la tlot .

Ki para bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong baroh u ki wan shim rah bad noh ïa met ka jong u . Ki shim pat ïa u bad ki tep ïa u ha ka jingtep u Manoah u kpa jong u , kaba hapdeng ka Sorah bad ka Eshtaol . U la u long nongïalam ïa ki Israel arphew snem .
translation.en: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down , and took him , and brought him up , and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father . And he judged Israel twenty years .
Ye shall walk after the  Lord  your God , and fear him , and keep his commandments , and obey his voice , and ye shall serve him , and cleave unto him .
translation.kha: Bud ïa U  Trai  bad tiengburom ïa u ; kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u ; mane ïa u bad ïaineh ha u .

translation.en: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word .
translation.kha: Kita ki riewngeit ïa kiba la pynsakma ki la leit kylleng , ki da ïalap ïa ka khubor .

translation.en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness , as he had appointed , speaking unto Moses , that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la don bad ki ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Blei , ha ka ri shyiap . La thaw ïa ka kat kumba U Blei u la ong ha u Moses ban thaw ïa ka , kat kum ka dur ïa kaba la pyn-i ha u Moses .
kaba kynthup ïa ka ri ki , Ken ki Kenis , ki Gadmon ,
translation.en: The Kenites , and the Kenizzites , and the Kadmonites ,
Neither shalt thou set thee up any image  ; which the  Lord  thy God hateth .
translation.kha: Wat pynïeng ruh ïa uno uno u païa maw na ka bynta ka jingmane bleithaw ; U  Trai  u isih ïa kita .
Kine ki sa ong Ngim don syiem , namar ngim shym sheptieng ïa U Hynrei kaei kaba u syiem un lah ban leh na bynta jong ngi ?
translation.en: For now they shall say , We have no king , because we feared not the  Lord   ; what then should a king do to us ?

translation.kha: Wat kito kiba kit ïa ki tiar ki tar na ka bynta ka jingtei , ki trei da kawei Shunem kti bad bat ha kawei pat ïa ka tiar ïaleh thma ,
translation.en: They which builded on the wall , and they that bare burdens , with those that laded , every one with one of his hands wrought in the work , and with the other hand held a weapon .

translation.kha: kito kiba pyndonkam ïa ki tiar ba ki ïoh , kumba kim shym lap miet ha kita . Naba kane ka pyrthei , kumba ka mynta long , kan ym neh . slem
translation.en: And they that use this world , as not abusing it : for the fashion of this world passeth away .
Which was with the deputy of the country , Sergius Paulus , a prudent man  ; who called for Barnabas and Saul , and desired to hear the word of God .
translation.kha: U la long u paralok jong u lyngskor jong kata ka dewlynnong , u Sergius Paulos uba la long u briew uba shemphang bha . Uta u lyngskor u la phah khot ïa u Barnabas bad u Saul ha khmat jong u namar u la kwah ban ïohsngew ïa ka ktien U Blei .

translation.en: And they put him in ward in chains , and brought him to the king of Babylon : they brought him into holds , that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki buh ïa u hapoh ka ruh bad ki la rah ïa u sha u syiem ka Babilonia . Ki la buh ïa u hapoh ki nongap , ba kumta ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong u yn ym ïohsngew pat halor ki lum jong ka Israel .

translation.en: As they were increased , so they sinned against me : therefore will I change their glory into shame .
translation.kha: Katba phi ki lyngdoh phi nang ïabun , katta phi nang leh pop pyrshah ïa nga ; bad kumta ngan pynkylla ïa ka burom jong phi sha ka jingjahburom .

translation.en: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them , Come up hither . And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud  ; and their enemies beheld them .
translation.kha: Nangta kita ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam na bneng kaba ong ïa ki ,  To wan kiew shane !  Katba ki nongshun jong ki , ki dang khmih , ki la kiew sha bneng ha u lyoh .
Katno ka jing-jngai ngi leit hap ?
translation.en: How much distance to go ?

translation.kha: Bad nangta kan don ka hima kaba saw , kaba eh kum nar , kaba pynkhynñiuh bad pynpait ïa kaei baroh . Bad kumba ka ka pynkhynñiuh ïa kaei kaei baroh , kan pynkhynñiuh bad pynlwet baroh hima kiba mynshuwa .
translation.en: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron : forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things : and as iron that breaketh all these , shall it break in pieces and bruise .
And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold , and wrote upon it a writing , like to the engravings of a signet , HOLINESS TO THE  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ka jingdeng da ka ksiar nylla , kaba long ka dak kaba khuid jong ka jingpynkyntang , bad ki thoh ha ka ,  La Pynkyntang sha U  Trai .
U briew baroh un aiñ da ka jingsheptieng tari shu ïohsngew ïa ka jingjai jong phi .’
translation.en: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven , who shall hear report of thee , and shall tremble , and be in anguish because of thee .

translation.kha: U Dabid u u khun khatduh , katba ki lai ngut para kiba nyngkong bad u Saul ,
translation.en: And David was the youngest : and the three eldest followed Saul .

translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba mareh sha ka ïingjaiñ bad ki shem ba kita ki mar la shah la tep ka rupa ha trai .
translation.en: So Joshua sent messengers , and they ran unto the tent  ; and , behold , it was hid in his tent , and the silver under it .
The breaker is come up before them : they have broken up , and have passed through the gate , and are gone out by it : and their king shall pass before them , and the  Lord  on the head of them .
translation.kha: U Blei un plie ïa ka lynti na ka bynta jong ki bad un ïalam noh ïa ki na ka jingshah ringmraw . Kin mih bran na ki khyrdop ka nongbah bad kin long kiba laitluid . U syiem jong ki , U  Trai  da lade hi , un ïalam ïa ki shabar .
Dei ban khleh ïa u bad ka umphniang bad shet u khiew la tap bad nangta dei ban pynlwet ïa bad kum ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa Trai .
translation.en: In a pan it shall be made with oil  ; and when it is baken , thou shalt bring it in : and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Ahab u jinglur ha u Jehoshaphat , Bseiñ ngam shym la ïathuh Ela phi ba um ju ïathuhlypa ei ei kaba bha ïa ngaiñ ? Ka long borabor kaba sniew !
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me , but evil ?

translation.kha: Hadien kata , katto katne ngut na ki tymmen btin san ki la ïeng joit bad ki ong lyer ki jingbah kiba la dkhat ,
translation.en: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land , and spake to all the assembly of the people , saying ,

translation.kha: Lada 6 kohnguh ïa U Blei bad Bukki ïa Katno , Probins pynleit ïa ka jingim pynpait ki ha ka jingsuk jingsep ka jingmanbha .
translation.en: If they obey and serve him , they shall spend their days in prosperity , and their years in pleasures .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai sha ki u la ong , Ko kynthei Jerusalem ! Wat ïam na ka bynta jong nga hynrei na ka bynta lade bad ki khun jong phi .
translation.en: But Jesus turning unto them said ,  Daughters of Jerusalem , weep not for me , but weep for yourselves , and for your children .
(As it is written , He hath dispersed abroad ; he hath given to the poor : his righteousness remaineth for ever .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  U ai sbun mynsiem sha kiba kyrduh ; ka jinglehsbun jong u ka neh junom .

translation.en: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven , and saying , Hew the tree down , and destroy it  ; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth , even with a band of iron and brass , in the tender grass of the field  ; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven , and let his portion be with the beasts of the field , till seven times pass over him  ;
translation.kha: Katba u Syiem Kynrad u dang peit , u angel u la wan hiar na bneng bad u la ong , ‘ Pom ïa u dieng bad pynjot ïa u , hynrei iehnoh ïa ka dyngkhong ha ka khyndew . Teh da u syrwiang nar bad rnong sawdong jong ka , bad iehnoh hangta ha ka pyntha lem bad u phlang . Ai ba ka umjer kan hap halor jong une u briew , bad shah ïa u ban im hangta bad ki mrad na ka bynta hynñiew snem .’

translation.en: And he said unto Jether his firstborn , Up , and slay them . But the youth drew not his sword : for he feared , because he was yet a youth .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha u Jether , u khun nyngkong jong u ,  Khie , pynïap ïa ki !  Hynrei uta u khynnah um shym sei ïa la ka waitlam . Um sngew nud , namar ba u dang long tang u khynnah .

Hynrei ki briew jong nga kim shym pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad masi ki kynsai kiba tam ba ki la ïoh kurup ; pynban , ki la wallam ïa ki ha hangne Gilgal ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ha U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: But the people took of the spoil , sheep and oxen , the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed , to sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God in Gilgal .

translation.kha: Haba kata ïa-peiñ por Ohad wan ñiewkor yn So shem ïa Shaneng pop ha Israel bad ïa ka jingbymman ha Amor , namar ngan Eshtaol .—Isaiah kito Lasha briew kiba nga lied soh ïa puid jingim jong ki . jingbhasbun nga , U haka , nga Governing kren .
translation.en: In those days , and in that time , saith the  Lord  , the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for , and there shall be none  ; and the sins of Judah , and they shall not be found : for I will pardon them whom I reserve .

translation.kha: Ha kaba jingpushara badonbor ka Herodias ka Borbah’ ïoh ïa ka kabu jong ka rakhe jaiñsem dei ha ka sngi kha jong u Herod , mynba la pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka jingpynriam baroh ki ñianglartham synshar pynsamthiah syaid ha ka jingsynshar jong u , Assur Rangbah shipai , bad ki nongshong shnong bapawkhmat jong ka Galilaïa .
translation.en: And when a convenient day was come , that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords , high captains , and chief estates of Galilee  ;
As we have therefore opportunity , let us do good unto all men , especially unto them who are of the household of faith .
translation.kha: Kumta , katba ngi dang ïohlad bunsien , ngi dei ban lehbha iwei ïa iwei , bad khamtam ïa kito kiba na ka longïing ka jingngeit .

translation.en: How long shall the land mourn , and the herbs of every field wither , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein ? the beasts are consumed , and the birds  ; because they said , He shall not see our last end .
translation.kha: Sa katno ba ka ri jong ngi kan tyrkhong , bad ba u phlang ha kawei pa kawei ka pyntha un ïapstai ? Ki mrad bad ki sim ki ïap namar ka jingbymman jong ki briew jong ngi , ki briew kiba ong , ‘ U Blei um ïohi ïa kaei kaba ngi leh .’

translation.en: And when she had weaned him , she took him up with her , with three bullocks , and one ephah of flour , and a bottle of wine , and brought him unto the house of the  Lord  in Shiloh : and the child was young .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka la pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , ka leit ïalam ïa u sha Shiloh ryngkat bad uwei u masi uba dang lai snem , shiphew kilo u  purew , bad shi pla snieh ka waiñ . Ka ïalam ïa u Samuel , wat la u dang khynnah eh , sha ka ïing U  Trai  ha Shiloh .

U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba dait-thah dang jingmanbha , kumta u la kylli ïa ki , Balei phi jingpawnam shaphang ka jingbymdon kpu ? Hato phim pat tip lane sngewthuh ? Hato ki jingmut jong phi ki dang dum ?
translation.en: And when Jesus knew it , he saith unto them ,  Why reason ye , because ye have no bread ? perceive ye not yet , neither understand ? have ye your heart yet hardened ?

translation.kha: Haba u Naaman u ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit sha u syiem bad u ïathuh u ha ïa ba kaei ka khynnah ka la ong .
translation.en: And one went in , and told his lord , saying , Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei to kiar noh na ki khanatang bym don nongrim , ki bymmyntoi ban ïathuh . To men pynmlien lade ïa ïa ka jingim riewblei .
translation.en: But refuse profane and old wives  fables , and exercise thyself rather unto godliness .
And the woman conceived , and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her , according to the time of life .
translation.kha: Hynrei , kumba u Elisha u la lah ong , hamar kata ka por ha ka snem kaba bud ka la kha khun shynrang .
Kumta kumba lai hajar ngut ki Israel ki leit tur shata , hynrei ki hap ban phet ïap nangta .
translation.en: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men : and they fled before the men of Ai .

Then answered one of the servants , and said , Behold , I have seen a son of Jesse the Beth–lehemite , that is cunning in playing , and a mighty valiant man , and a man of war , and prudent in matters , and a comely person , and the  Lord  is with him .
translation.kha: Uwei na kita ki nongap jong u , u ong ,  U Jesse , uba na ka shnong Bethlehem , u don u khun uba long u nongtem nongput uba tbit . U long ruh uba shlur bad uba bhabriew , u shipai uba bha bad uba pnah thylliej . U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad u .
Kumba nga Peris jingïam jingbyrngem uba im , nga rah la ka kti bad nga jingkhanglad ,
translation.en: For I lift up my hand to heaven , and say , I live for ever .
And it came to pass , when he was come near to enter into Egypt , that he said unto Sarai his wife , Behold now , I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon :
translation.kha: Hamar ba un sa rung ha ri Ijipt , u ong ha ka Sarai ka tnga jong u ,  Pha long ka kynthei kaba bhabriew .
Hynrei u Joseph u ong ha , Wat sheptieng ; ngam lah ban buh ïa ha ka jaka jong Blei .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto them , Fear not : for am I in the place of God ?

translation.kha: Nongsakhi Tahpenes long kiba shetkylla bad ki bym lah shaniah . Pynphong jingisih jong ki , ka tynneng suki kum ka ding ha ka shiphang , rashi bym shym la pynkhih da u nongshet kpu haduh ba u purew u lah long ban shet .
translation.en: They are all adulterers , as an oven heated by the baker , who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough , until it be leavened .
Hear , O Israel : The  Lord  our God is one  Lord  :
translation.kha: To sngap ko ki Israel ! U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u long tang ma u hi U  Trai .
U Saul u sheptieng ïa u Dabid namar ba U Trai u don bad ryngkat u Dabid hynrei U la kynriah noh na u Saul .
translation.en: And Saul was afraid of David , because the  Lord  was with him , and was departed from Saul .

So he brought down the people unto the water : and the  Lord  said unto Gideon , Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue , as a dog lappeth , him shalt thou set by himself  ; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink .
translation.kha: U Gideon u ïalam ïa kita ki briew sha um , bad U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Pynkhlad ïa uwei pa uwei uba jliah ïa ka um da la u thylliej kum u ksew , na uwei pa uwei uba dem khohsiew ban dih um .

translation.en: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory , much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory .
translation.kha: Ka rukom pynïaid kaba wanrah ïa ka jingpynrem ka la long kaba donburom ; kaba katno tam kaba kham donburom kata ka jingtrei kaba wanrah ïa ka jingpynim!

translation.en: And they set on for him by himself , and for them by themselves , and for the Egyptians , which did eat with him , by themselves : because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews  ; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians .
translation.kha: Ïa u Joseph la ai ha kawei ka miej , bad ïa ki hynmen jong u ha kawei pat . Ki nong Ijipt kiba ïabam hangta ruh ki shong kyrpang , namar ki kheiñ poh ban ïashong bam ryngkat bad ki Hebru .

Ki briew U Trai ki la riewspah , hynrei kiba hun pyrshah ; ki la sngaid bad ki la imon bha da ka jingbam . Te ki la iehnoh ïa U Ariopagos uba Phin thaw ïa ki , bad ki la kyntait ïa badonbor nongpynim bakhrawbor jong ki .
translation.en: But Jeshurun waxed fat , and kicked : thou art waxen fat , thou art grown thick , thou art covered with fatness  ; then he forsook God which made him , and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation .

translation.kha: U Ashpenas pat u la sheptieng u syiem , u la ong u Daniel , U syiem la ïa kaei kaba phin bam bad dih , bad mem i kum uba bit kum kiwei pat samla shynrang , u lah pynïap ïa nga .
translation.en: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel , I fear my lord the king , who hath appointed your meat and your drink : for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort ? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king .

translation.kha: Nangta ka Ruth ka ong , Kaba kor tam na , baroh u ong ba ngan ïai tam bad kew ki nongtrei jong u haduh ba kin da pyndep ïa ka jingot .
translation.en: And Ruth the Moabitess said , He said unto me also , Thou shalt keep fast by my young men , until they have ended all my harvest .

translation.kha: Pynban , phi la diengkhap khñiang bad phi bam phi dih nongtih ka jaka ha kaba u la khang Heth shikhyllipmat ban bashispah ban dih pynduk Namar wer yn sa traishnong ïa phi , bymdei ïa Meholah Jerahmeel mawlynnai phi yn ym tep ha ka jingtep ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translation.en: But camest back , and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place , of the which the  Lord  did say to thee , Eat no bread , and drink no water  ; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers .

After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem , ( but he himself laid siege against Lachish , and all his power with him , ) unto Hezekiah king of Judah , and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem , saying ,
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , katba u Sennakherib bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki dang don ha Lakhish , u phah ïa kane ka khubor sha u Hesekaïah bad sha ki paid Judah kiba dang don bad u ha Jerusalem :
Hynrei hamar ba un sa artat ai ha u ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u , u la kylli biang , Phi dei u shisha Iso ? U ruh u jubab , Nga dei !
translation.en: And he said , Art thou my very son Esau ? And he said , I am .

translation.kha: kiba na u Abraham ki long ki khun U Blei . U u la ong ha u Abraham , Ka long u Isaak ba men ïoh ïa hiarpateng kiba nga la ïa me .
translation.en: Neither , because they are the seed of Abraham , are they all children : but , In Isaac shall thy seed be called .

translation.kha: Ki nongshimwai ki la kem ïa ki mraw jong u , ki shoh ïa , uwei ki pynïap ïa uwei pat , bad ki la lynthem maw ïa uwei . pat
translation.en: And the husbandmen took his servants , and beat one , and killed another , and stoned another .

translation.kha: Te sa najan pynbamphlang ngi bad ki Ïohi shynrang Belteshassar bam Artemas ka jingbam jong ka ïingbishar syiem Lai bad pynkhriat nongrim ïa Stephanas rai ka jong phi jingialeh ka jingïohi kumno ngi long .
translation.en: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee , and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king s meat : and as thou seest , deal with thy servants .

translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko parabangeit jong nga , khublei! To ïabeh sha jingjanai ; to shahshkor ïa ki jingkyrpad jong nga , to don kajuh jingmut para phi , to ïa-im ha ka jingsuk . Bad U ka jingieit bad ka jingsuk un ryngkat bad
translation.en: Finally , brethren , farewell . Be perfect , be of good comfort , be of one mind , live in peace ; and the God of love and peace shall be with you .

translation.kha: , ko Kapernam ! Hato pha ban kyntiew ïa shaduh sha ? Yn bret ïa pha tbian sha dujok
translation.en: And thou , Capernaum , which art exalted to heaven , shalt be thrust down to hell .
For they cast down every man his rod , and they became serpents : but Aaron s rod swallowed up their rods .
translation.kha: Ki la bret ïa la ki diengduh , bad kita ki kylla bseiñ . Hynrei u diengduh jong u Aaron u la nguid ïa ki diengduh jong ki .

translation.en: And when he was come into the house , his disciples asked him privately , Why could not we cast him out ?
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la rung shapoh ïing , ki synran jong u ki la kylli jar jar ïa u ,  Balei ba ngim lah ban beh noh ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid ?

translation.en: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you , brethren beloved of the Lord , because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth :
translation.kha: Ngi dei ban ainguh ïa U Blei ha ki por baroh na ka bynta jong phi , ko parabangeit , phi kiba U Trai u ieit . Naba U Blei u la jied ïa phi kum kiba nyngkong ban pynim da ka bor U Mynsiem ban pynlong ïa phi ki riewkhuid jong u bad da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka jingshisha .

translation.en: So the people went out into the field against Israel : and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim  ;
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai jong u Dabid ka la leit sha rudnong bad ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha ka khlaw Ephraim .

translation.en: According to the grace of God which is given unto me , as a wise masterbuilder , I have laid the foundation , and another buildeth thereon . But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon .
translation.kha: Da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingai kaba U Blei u la ai ha nga , nga la trei ïa ka kam u rangbah nongtei uba tbit bad nga la seng ïa ka nongrim , bad uwei pat u tei halor jong ka . Hynrei uwei pa uwei u dei ban sumar kumno u tei .
Hynrei u u kylli , Kumno lada jia ba kata ka samla kam ban ïa la ka ïing ban wan ryngkat nga kane ? Hato ngan noh ïa u khun jong ka ri na kaba phi wan ?
translation.en: And the servant said unto him , Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land : must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest ?
And I will give power unto my two witnesses , and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days , clothed in sackcloth .
translation.kha: Ngan sa phah ïa ki sakhi jong nga ar ngut kiba kup da ki jaiñ khain , bad kin pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ha kita ki shihajar arspah hynriewphew sngi .

translation.en: And Seth lived an hundred and five years , and begat Enos :
translation.kha: Haba u Seth u la dap shispah san snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Enosh ,

translation.en: And he found a new jawbone of an ass , and put forth his hand , and took it , and slew a thousand men therewith .
translation.kha: Nangta u lap kawei ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada kaba dang shu ïap shen . U dem bad u tam ïa ka , bad da kata u pynïap shihajar ngut ki rangbah .

translation.en: The spider taketh hold with her hands , and is in kings  palaces .
translation.kha: Ki  ñiangapïing : phi lah ban bat kawei ha la ka kti , hynrei phi lah ruh ban shem ïa ki ha ki ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And it came to pass , afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court , that the word of the  Lord  came to him , saying ,
translation.kha: U Isaïah u leit noh na u syiem , hynrei ha shuwa ba un ïaid lyngba ïa ka phyllaw pdeng ka ïingbishar jong ka ïingsyiem , U  Trai  u ong ïa u
Uwei na u leit lyngkha ban ïoh katto katne ki . U lap uwei u khlaw kheit bun ki klong u lah ban kit . U la wanrah ïa ki bad dkhot ïa hapoh ka syrwa , khlem da tip ki dei kiba kumno .
translation.en: And one went out into the field to gather herbs , and found a wild vine , and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full , and came and shred them into the pot of pottage : for they knew them not .

translation.kha: Shiteng na ki khun jong ki , ki kren ïa ktien lane ïa ki bad kim tip kumno ban ïa ka jong .
translation.en: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod , and could not speak in the Jews  language , but according to the language of each people .

translation.kha: Ka Reuben jait ka tei biang ïa ka Heshbon , ka Elealeh , ka Kiriathaim ,
translation.en: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon , and Elealeh , and Kiriathaim ,
He that loveth pureness of heart , for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend .
translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa ka jingkhuid ka dohnud bad ka jingkren badonburom , u syiem un long u paralok jong phi .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will feed them , even this people , with wormwood , and give them water of gall to drink .
translation.kha: Kumta te , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan leh : Ngan ai ki jhur kthang ha ki briew jong nga ban bam bad ka bih ban dih .

translation.en: Behold , all his fellows shall be ashamed : and the workmen , they are of men : let them all be gathered together , let them stand up  ; yet they shall fear , and they shall be ashamed together .
translation.kha: Baroh uba mane ïa ka un shah ñiewbeiñ . Ki briew kiba shna ïa ki bleithaw ki long tang ki briew bad ym don shuh . Shah ïa ki ban wan bad ban ïeng ha ka jingbishar — kin khynñiuh bad kin shah pynjahburom .

translation.en: And thou shalt offer peace offerings , and shalt eat there , and rejoice before the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: hangta ruh kñia bad bam ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad lehkmen ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
Ka la don ka nemsniew ha kiwei ruh ki ri ; ha ka ri Ijipt kawei , don kyrhai ka
translation.en: And the seven years of dearth began to come , according as Joseph had said : and the dearth was in all lands  ; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread .
They spend their days in wealth , and in a moment go down to the grave .
translation.kha: Ki im ka jingim ha ka jingsuk bad ki ïap suk khlem ka jingjynjar .
Namar ngi ïohsngew ba katto katne ngut ki briew hapdeng jong phi im ka jingim bajaipdeh bad ki bym ei ei lait tang ban ha ka kam kiwei pat ki briew .
translation.en: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly , working not at all , but are busybodies .

Remember , and forget not , how thou provokedst the  Lord  thy God to wrath in the wilderness : from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt , until ye came unto this place , ye have been rebellious against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat ju klet kumno phi la pynbitar lep ïa U  Trai  ha ka ri shyiap . Naduh ka sngi ba phi mih na Ijipt haduh ba phi poi hangne , phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: But godliness with contentment is great gain .
translation.kha: Shisha , ka niam kam pynriewspah palat ïa u briew , lada u sngewhun bad kaei kaba u don .

translation.en: And the king said unto him , Do as he hath said , and fall upon him , and bury him  ; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood , which Joab shed , from me , and from the house of my father .
translation.kha: Leh kumba u Joab u ong ,  u Solomon u jubab .  Pynïap ïa u bad tep ïa u . Nangta ym ma nga ne mano mano na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid ki ban shah kynnoh shuh na ka bynta kaei kaba u Joab u la leh haba u la pynïap ïa ki rangbah kiba lui lui .
Bad phi ma ! Phi pyrshang ban pyntngen ïa nga ha ka jingbieit ! Baroh ka jubab ba phi ai ka long ka jingshukor !
translation.en: How then comfort ye me in vain , seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood ?
She hath sent forth her maidens : she crieth upon the highest places of the city ,
translation.kha: Ka la phah ïa la ki shakri kynthei ban pyrta na ka jaka kaba jrong tam ha kata ka nongbah :

translation.en: I wish you'd quit throwing things at me .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ba phin sangeh kawang tiar ha nga .

translation.en: I form the light , and create darkness : I make peace , and create evil : I the  Lord  do all these things .
translation.kha: Nga thaw ïa ka jingshai bad ïa ka jingdum ; nga wanrah ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it , to buy hewn stone , and timber for couplings , and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed .
translation.kha: bad ki ai ïa ka ha ki misteri dieng bad ki nongtei ban thied maw bad dieng sawdong ban pyndonkam ha kaba tei pynbha ïa ki ïing kiba ki syiem ka Judah ki la ieh ba kin pyut noh .

translation.en: Then thou scarest me with dreams , and terrifiest me through visions :
translation.kha: Hynrei me — me pyntriem ïa nga da ki jingphohsniew ; me phah ha nga da ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingphohsniew kynsha

Nangta samla kynthei shad bad kin kmen , bad ki shynrang , kiba samla bad kiba tymmen , kin shadkmen . Ngan ïa ki pynkylla ïa ka jingïambriew sha ka jingkmen , ïa ka jingsngewsih jong ki sha ka jingsngewbha .
translation.en: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance , both young men and old together : for I will turn their mourning into joy , and will comfort them , and make them rejoice from their sorrow .

translation.kha: Wat shukor haba phi thew da u mawser ne da u .
translation.en: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures , a great and a small .

So Esther s maids and her chamberlains came and told it her . Then was the queen exceedingly grieved  ; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai , and to take away his sackcloth from him : but he received it not .
translation.kha: Haba ki shakri kynthei jong ka Esther bad ki ïunukh ki ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaba u Mordekai u leh , ka la shitom jingmut haduh katta katta . Ka phah sha u Mordekai katto katne ki jaiñ ban phong ha ka jaka ki jaiñ khain , hynrei um shym pdiang ïa ki .

translation.en: And David answered and said , Behold the king s spear ! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Syiem kynrad , une u sum jong phi . Ai ba uwei na ki briew jong phi un wan shim ïa u nangne .
Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , uno Uno uba kwah ban lehkmen ha ka jingim bad uba kwah ïohi ban ïa ki por kiba bha , u dei ban kiar na kren kaba sniew bad ban nym kren lamler .
translation.en: For he that will love life , and see good days , let him refrain his tongue from evil , and his lips that they speak no guile :
Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together : and all that took them captives held them fast  ; they refused to let them go .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ki paid Israel bad Judah ki shah banbeiñ . Baroh kiba kurup ïa ki , ki khmih pyrman ïa ki bad kin ym pyllait ïa ki .

translation.en: And I say unto you , Whosoever shall put away his wife , except it be for fornication , and shall marry another , committeth adultery : and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi , te , ba uno uno u briew uba pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga na kano kano ka daw , lait noh na ka jingbymïaineh jong ka , u klim lada u shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew .

translation.en: He spread a cloud for a covering  ; and fire to give light in the night .
translation.kha: U Blei u buh ïa u lyoh halor ki briew jong u bad ïa ka ding mynmiet ban ai jingshai ïa ki .

translation.en: And though after my skin worms destroy this body , yet in my flesh shall I see God :
translation.kha: Wat lada hadien ba la bam noh ïa ka doh jong nga da ka jingpang , wat ha kane hi ka met ngan ïohi ïa U Blei .
U Trai u ong ïa u angel ban buh noh sharud ïa ka waitlam jong u , bad u u angel kohnguh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  commanded the angel  ; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof .

translation.kha: ïoh kin phai dien noh na U Trai ban mane ïa ephod pat pyniwtung blei . Geliloth jia nylla , U Trai sngewkynjah bitar lep ïa lyngba bad un pynjot ïa phi shisyndon .
translation.en: For they will turn away thy son from following me , that they may serve other gods : so will the anger of the  Lord  be kindled against you , and destroy thee suddenly .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba phin ym Kynmaw bad kheiñlang briew uba khot pduh lade u parabangeit hynrei uba awria ne uba lalot ne uba mane bleithaw ne uba kren sniew ne uba buaid nongïatainia u nongtuh . To wat ïashong bam lem rngai kum uta u briew pyllup
translation.en: But now I have written unto you not to keep company , if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator , or covetous , or an idolater , or a railer , or a drunkard , or an extortioner ; with such an one no not to eat .

translation.kha: Haba ngi la poi ha ka jaka ban Aijalon , ngi plied ïa la ki byrni , bad uwei pa uwei na ngi u lap ïa la ki pisa ha la ïa-dawa Horonaim ka jong ka byrni — ki Busi ki biang waiñ . Ngi la wanrah Admah paradais ki sha phi .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when we came to the inn , that we opened our sacks , and , behold , every man s money was in the mouth of his sack , our money in full weight : and we have brought it again in our hand .

translation.kha: Kumta te , to ai ba ki jingmut jong kin pynkhreh . To long adkar bad buh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi baroh phar ha ïa kaba yn sa ai ha phi haba ïa U Khrist yn pynpaw .
translation.en: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind , be sober , and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ  ;
And saying , Thou that destroyest the temple , and buildest it in three days , save thyself . If thou be the Son of God , come down from the cross .
translation.kha: Me u ban sa pynkhyllem ïa ka Templ bad ban tei pat ïa ka ha ki lai sngi ! To pynim ïa lade lada me long U Khun U Blei ! To hiar noh na ka diengphna !
U ïa law ka jaiñkup ba u phong bad u ai ïa ha ka u Dabid , ryngkat bad ka jingkieng atiar jong u bad ruh ïa ka waitlam , ka ryntieh , bad u panpoh jong u .
translation.en: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him , and gave it to David , and his garments , even to his sword , and to his bow , and to his girdle .
But God led the people about , through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea : and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta u ïalam ïa ki da ka lynti kyllaiñ lyngba ka ri shyiap kaba poi sha ka Duriaw Basaw . Ki Israel ki long kiba la kieng atiar ban ïaleh thma .

translation.en: Wherefore will ye plead with me ? ye all have transgressed against me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kaei ka jingujor jong pha ? Balei pha la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ?
Ki briew ki ïa-ong ba kane ka ri kan long kum ka ri shyiap kaba ki briew lymne ki mrad kin im , bad ba ka yn ai sha ki . Hynrei ki lyngkha yn sa thied pat ha ka ri .
translation.en: And fields shall be bought in this land , whereof ye say , It is desolate without man or beast  ; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans .
And let us not be weary in well doing : for in due season we shall reap , if we faint not .
translation.kha: Kumta to ai ba ngin ym man thait ha kaba lehbha ; namar lada ngim duh bor noh , ka por kan poi ha kaba ngin lum ïa ka jingot .

translation.en: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily , eateth and drinketh damnation to himself , not discerning the Lord s body .
translation.kha: Naba , lada um tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka met jong U Trai haba u bam ïa u kpu bad dih na ka khuri , u wallam ïa ka jingbishar ha lade hi katba u dang bam bad dih .
