translation.en: And he made fifty taches of gold , and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches : so it became one tabernacle .
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka ksiar , bad ki pynïasoh ïa kita ki jingkah ar tylli da kita ki jingpyndait ba kin long tang kawei .
basngewtynnat briew kiba pyrkhat tang ïa ïakut ki kyrkieh ban ïoh spah ha kaba kim tip lano ka jingduk kan lap .
translation.en: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye , and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him .
For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man : but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Naba ym don khubor jingïathuhlypa kaba la ju wan tang na ka mon u briew , hynrei ki briew ki la long hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid katba ki dang kren ïa ka khubor kaba la wan na U Blei .
Kumta u la u nongsumar kper jong u , ‘ Ha khmih , la lai snem nga la shane da kaba soh Dumbur ha u diengsoh Dumbur bad ngam shym shem ei ei . noh ïa u ! Balei un shu pynsep-ei ïa ka khyndew
translation.en: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard , Behold , these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree , and find none : cut it down  ; why cumbereth it the ground ?

translation.kha: Hynrei phi ong , ‘ Kaei kaba U u leh kam long dei .’ To shahshkor nga , phi ki Israel . phi pyrkhat ba ki lynti jong nga kiba nga leh ïa kiei kiei kim kiba dei ? Ka dei ka jong phi ka bym long dei
translation.en: Yet ye say , The way of the Lord is not equal . Hear now , O house of Israel  ; Is not my way equal ? are not your ways unequal ?

And it came to pass in those days , that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare , to fight with Israel . And Achish said unto David , Know thou assuredly , that thou shalt go out with me to battle , thou and thy men .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , ki Philistia ki la ïalumlang ïa la u paidïapom ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel bad U Akhish u ong ha u Dabid ,  Da shisha phi tip ba ma phi bad ki briew jong phi ki dei ban ïaleh ha ka liang jong nga .

translation.en: Say thou thus unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword , and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured , and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga maham ïa ki ba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ki briew kiba shong basah ha ki nongbah ba la pynjot kin shah pynïap . Kito kiba shong ha ka ri kin shah bam da ki mradkhlaw . Kito kiba rieh ha ki lumbah bad ki krem kin ïap da ka jingpang .
Phi lah ruh ban thied ïa ki khun jong ki nongwei kiba jingkren hapdeng jong Sarai . Kum kita ïa kiba la kha ha ka ri jong phi ki lah ban long ka jingïohkynti jong jingïap’ ,
translation.en: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you , of them shall ye buy , and of their families that are with you , which they begat in your land : and they shall be your possession .

translation.kha: u Benaïah u khun jong u Jehoïada u khmih halor ka kynhun ap phira jong u ; Dabid khun ki shynrang jong u Dabid ki bat ïa ki kyrdan ba-halor ha ka jingshakri ïa u .
translation.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites  ; and the sons of David were chief about the king .

translation.kha: katno jong phi ka la long ka ! Ka la pynheh pynsan ïa khun jong ka ki sing shynrang kiba ishyrkhei .
translation.en: And say , What is thy mother ? A lioness : she lay down among lions , she nourished her whelps among young lions .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shemphang ki kwah ine ïoh kyntoit pynjakhlia hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki sngewhun ha ka jingbieit .
translation.en: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge : but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness .

translation.kha: U Hiram ka u la pynbiang ïa u ïa ki dieng Kedar ki dieng Kseh , bad ïa ka ksiar ruh , katba u donkam . Ynda tei ïa ki , Syiem Solomon u ïa u Hiram arphew tylli ki shnong ha ka thain Galilaïa .
translation.en: ( Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees , and with gold , according to all his desire , ) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee .

Righteous art thou , O  Lord  , when I plead with thee : yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments : Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper ? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  , lada nga ïasaid ïa ka kam jong nga bad me , men pynshisha ba me long ha kaba dei . Pynban nga dei ban kylli ïa me shaphang ki bynta ka jingbishar hok . Balei ba ki rangbah basniew ki manbha katta katta ? Balei ba ki rangbah bymhok ki jop ?
U Hasael u leit phai sha u Benhadad , uba kylli ïa u , U Elisha u ong kumno ? U Hasael u , jubab U ong ha nga phin ba sa koit sa khiah bha pat .
translation.en: So he departed from Elisha , and came to his master  ; who said to him , What said Elisha to thee ? And he answered , He told me that thou shouldest surely recover .

translation.kha: U briew uba don ha ka lyngkha um dei ban phai ban leit shim ka jong u .
translation.en: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes .
And when he was demanded of the Pharisees , when the kingdom of God should come , he answered them and said ,  The kingdom of God cometh not with observation :
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa U Jisu lano ka Hima U Blei kan wan . Ka jubab jong u ka long ,  Ka Hima U Blei kam wan ha ka rukom kum kaba lah ban ïohi .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as they were burying a man , that , behold , they spied a band of men  ; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha : and when the man was let down , and touched the bones of Elisha , he revived , and stood up on his feet .
translation.kha: Shisien , katba dang leit ontep , la ïohi ïa kawei na kine ki kynhun , bad ki paidbah ki pynhap ïa ka metïap ha ka jingtep u Elisha bad ki phet krad . Mar ïadei ka metïap ha ki shyieng u Elisha , uta u briew u im pat bad u ïeng joit .

translation.en: O my God , incline thine ear , and hear  ; open thine eyes , and behold our desolations , and the city which is called by thy name : for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses , but for thy great mercies .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ngi , A Blei ; to khmih sha ngi , bad peit ïa ka jingjynjar kaba ngi don bad ïa ka jingshah shitom jong ka nongbah kaba kit ïa ka kyrteng jong me . Ngi duwai ha me namar ba me long uba dap da ka jingisynei , ym namar ba ngi la leh ïa kaba dei .

translation.en: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light , that his deeds may be made manifest , that they are wrought in God .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba shisha u wan sha ka jingshai khnang ba ka jingshai kan pynpaw ïa kaei kaba u la leh ka long da kaba kohnguh ïa U Blei .
Katto katne parabangeit ïa kiba la pynsakma ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ kaba la jia myn haba la pynïap ïa Stephan ka pur shaduh sha Phoenisia Sypros , bad , da kaba ïa ka khubor tang ki .
translation.en: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phoenicia , and Cyprus , and Antioch , preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only .
And thou hast filled me with wrinkles , which is a witness against me : and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face .
translation.kha: Me la kem ïa nga ; me dei u nongshun jong nga . Nga la sah sa tang ka snep bad ki shyieng , bad ki briew ki shim ïa kata kum ka jingpynshisha ïa ka jingkitpop jong nga .

translation.en: If we live in the Spirit , let us also walk in the Spirit .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u la ai ha ngi ka jingim , u dei ruh ban synshar ïa ki jingim jong ngi .
Kaba mih long , ka kynhun nongap phira jong ka baroh kawei bad baroh kiwei pat hangne , ki tip ba nga don ha nga long shakri jong U Khrist .
translation.en: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace , and in all other places ;

translation.en: And I besought the  Lord  at that time , saying ,

translation.en: In the tenth year , in the tenth month , in the twelfth day of the month , the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.en: And they took their bones , and buried them under a tree at Jabesh , and fasted seven days .

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba syrdep ïa ka jaiñkup kaba rim da ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba thymmai , naba kata miat syrdep bathymmai kan ran bad jingïaikren pynlong ka thliew kaba kham heh ha ka jingong .
translation.en: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment , for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment , and the rent is made worse .
That which is altogether just shalt thou follow , that thou mayest live , and inherit the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
translation.kha: Leh beit bad lehhok borabor , khnang ba phin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi bad ba phin ïaishong hangta .

U Trai u ong , ‘ Haba Immer hynñiewphew snem Kabseel ka Babilonia ki la kut , ïasait pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewkhia jong nga thombor ka bynta jong phi bad bat ïa ka kular jong Hammolekheth ban wallam pat ïa phi sha ïing .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you , and perform my good word toward you , in causing you to return to this place .

translation.kha: Ka “mon ka buddien ïa ki nongpop kylleng , hynrei Urim briew kiba hok kin ïoh ïa-bta da kiei kiei Meribah bha .
translation.en: Evil pursueth sinners : but to the righteous good shall be repayed .

translation.kha: Haba u u Mephibosheth wan poi na ban Jerusalem ïakynduh ïa u syiem , u syiem u ong ha u , Ko Mephibosheth , mem shym la leit bad nga , balei ?
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king , that the king said unto him , Wherefore wentest not thou with me , Mephibosheth ?
Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master s servants that are come with thee : and as soon as ye be up early in the morning , and have light , depart .
translation.kha: Kumta te , Dabid , lashai dang step baroh na phi kiba la iehnoh ïa u Saul bad kiba la wan sha nga ki dei ban khie dang step bad mih mar shu kynjat shai .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Saul was returned from following the Philistines , that it was told him , saying , Behold , David is in the wilderness of En–gedi .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u wan phai na kaba ïaleh ïa ki Philistia , la ïathuh ha u ba u Dabid u don ha ka ri khlaw hajan Engedi .
Ïa ki Israel ym shym la kaba jubor , hynrei shakri kum ki shipai ki rangbah , ki ïa ïapom , bad ki nongshong kulai .
translation.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work  ; but they were men of war , and chief of his captains , and captains of his chariots and horsemen .

Wherefore the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Amaziah , and he sent unto him a prophet , which said unto him , Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people , which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand ?

translation.en: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the  Lord  , and until it was finished . So the house of the  Lord  was perfected .
And he charged them that they should tell no man : but the more he charged them , so much the more a great deal they published it  ;

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I have dreamed a dream , and there is none that can interpret it : and I have heard say of thee , that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it .

translation.en: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens  ; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , My spirit shall not always strive with man , for that he also is flesh : yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years .
And Micaiah said , Behold , thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself .
translation.kha: Phin shem ïa kata ynda phin leit sha ka kamra ba shadien ban rieh ,  u Mikaïah u jubab .
Baroh ki riewkhuid ai ki jingkhublei ïa phi .
translation.en: All the saints salute you .

translation.kha: Ngam shym la Jahasiel thlia wat ha ka por miet , sngewmong mano mano na ki jinghiarpateng jong nga , lymne Arpad shakri jong nga Pyndeng lymne ki nongap phira jong nga . Bad ma sad baroh khaw-eit bat ïa ki Mihngi ïaleh ha ka kti .
translation.en: So neither I , nor my brethren , nor my servants , nor the men of the guard which followed me , none of us put off our clothes , saving that every one put them off for washing .
That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of glory , may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him :

Phi sha ki lum kiba jrong ban kñia ainguh bad shongkha .
translation.en: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed : even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice .

translation.kha: Ong ïa u ban die ha nga katba shongdor haba phi dang ïadon ryngkat , ba ïohkynti ïa ka kum ka jaka tep .
translation.en: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah , which he hath , which is in the end of his field  ; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you .

translation.kha: Bad mynta phi kwah ba ngan leit ïathuh ïa u phi ba don hangne ?
translation.en: And now thou sayest , Go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here .

translation.en: And thou shalt make two rings of gold , and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof , which is in the side of the ephod inward .

sih wanrah kham bun ki jingri , ïa ki Abishua bynrap bajar ban pynbun bymlahlong ban kaiphod .
translation.en: According to the number that ye shall prepare , so shall ye do to every one according to their number .

translation.en: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the  Lord  thy God , thou shalt not slack to pay it : for the  Lord  thy God will surely require it of thee  ; and it would be sin in thee .

translation.en: How much more , if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found ? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines ?

translation.en: And he looked round about on them which sat about him , and said ,  Behold my mother and my brethren !
So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure :

khnang ba lah ban long kiba khuid bad kiba hok ha khmat jong u baroh ki sngi ka jingim jong ngi .
translation.en: In holiness and righteousness before him , all the days of our life .
Saying ,  Go ye into the village over against you  ; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied , whereon yet never man sat : loose him , and bring him hither .

bastang shakri Turkwois la ïohpdiang san hajar tylli ki sbai u la wan rung bad u ïatim ai ïa kiwei ki san hajar khatduh ‘ Ko kynrad ruma me la ïakheiñ ha nga san Miniamin tylli jarjar sbai ,’ u la ong . ‘ Ha khmih ! Kine hangne sa Hasiel hajar jingiwtung kiba nga la riewpawkhmat .’
translation.en: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents , saying , Lord , thou deliveredst unto me five talents : behold , I have gained beside them five talents more .

translation.en: Then Manoah entreated the  Lord  , and said , O my Lord , let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us , and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born .
Whom they set before the apostles : and when they had prayed , they laid their hands on them .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun ka la aiti ïa ki ha ki apostol , kiba la duwai bad buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki .

translation.kha: Wat sheptieng , u Elisha u jubab . Ngi don kham bun ha ka liang jong ban ngi ïa kaba ki don ma ki .
translation.en: And he answered , Fear not : for they that be with us are more than they that be with them .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa kito pynthaba idei ban long ki jingsaiñ — nga ong ïa kane namar kam pher ei ei ïa nga pynjhieh ki long kiba kumno kumno ruh ; U Blei um pynïasuk na ki durkhmat bashabar — kito ki bajur , nga Rekem , kim don khylliap ei ki jingai jingmut bathymmai na ka bynta jong jingbatbor .
translation.en: But of these who seemed to be somewhat , (whatsoever they were , it maketh no matter to me : God accepteth no man s person :) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me :

translation.kha: bad la Heman ha ka jingtep mawsiang ïa —Hebru u la shna na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka nongbah u Dabid . Ki la pyndonkam ki musla bad ki umphniang iwbih ban pynkhreh pankylliang tipbriew met jong u na ka Lieng Ïutikhos jingontep , bad ki jingduh tei ïa ka ding kaba khraw tapkhlieh leh sngewsih ïa ka jingïap jong u .
translation.en: And they buried him in his own sepulchres , which he had made for himself in the city of David , and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries  art : and they made a very great burning for him .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang don , ki sngewthuh ka sur kren jong u samla Lebi , kumta leit sha u bad ki Me leh aïu hangne ? Mano ba ïa me shane
translation.en: When they were by the house of Micah , they knew the voice of the young man the Levite : and they turned in thither , and said unto him , Who brought thee hither ? and what makest thou in this place ? and what hast thou here ?

translation.en: Return to thine own house , and shew how great things God hath done unto thee .  And he went his way , and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him .
And it came to pass about this time , that Joseph went into the house to do his business  ; and there was none of the men of the house there within .

Ma phi ki khun ksiew jong u Abraham , u shakri jong u ; phi ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , u briew uba u jied : Kynmaw ïa ki kambah ba U Blei u leh bad ki jingbishar kiba u la ai .
translation.en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant , ye children of Jacob his chosen .

translation.en: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him , and said , Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the  Lord  , we have had enough to eat , and have left plenty : for the  Lord  hath blessed his people  ; and that which is left is this great store .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jonathan u ong ha u , Naba lashai ka dei ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai , jingbymdon ka phi jong kan paw shai lada phim don ha jingïabam .

translation.kha: Ngan shong hapdeng jong phi ha ka ïingjaiñ bakyntang jong nga , bad ngan ym phai noh na phi da lei lei .

Uta uba khat ïa dpei u dei ban da sait la ki jaiñ , hynrei u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet . Kane ka rukom pynïaid ryntih ka long kaba dei ki por ki ban wan baroh na ka bynta ki Israel bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah ki .
translation.en: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the even : and it shall be unto the children of Israel , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them , for a statute for ever .

translation.kha: Bad Mikaïah pynkut : Kane ka long kaei kaba la jia . U Trai u pynlong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me ban kren lamler ïa me . ma u hi da lade u la rai ba phin ha ka jingjot !
translation.en: Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil concerning thee .

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongbah kiba mynta ki dap da nongïatrei briew yn pynjot , bad ïa ka ri yn pynkylla ri Nakon . Nangta te kin tip ba nga pynbeit U Trai jngut
translation.en: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste , and the land shall be desolate  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.en: But none saith , Where is God my maker , who giveth songs in the night  ;

translation.en: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land , wasting nor destruction within thy borders  ; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation , and thy gates Praise .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingleh thombor yn ym ïohsngew shuh , ka jingjot kan ym don shuh hapoh ki pud jong pha ; ngan ïada bad kyrshan ïa pha kum ka kynroh : Phan ïaroh ïa nga namar nga la pyllait ïa pha .

translation.kha: ki khyllai bad ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad ïa ka bynta kaba kynsai tam jong u dohnud .

translation.en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years , and departed without being desired . Howbeit they buried him in the city of David , but not in the sepulchres of the kings .

translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor jong me bad pyrthei la shun ïa , namar kim dei jong kane ka pyrthei , kumba nga ruh ngam dei na kane ka pyrthei .
translation.en: I have given them thy word  ; and the world hath hated them , because they are not of the world , even as I am not of the world .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata jinglongbriew Jehosabad ka Kalah kaba lieh , bad kam shym paw ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , bad u shñiuh ha kata Ba-ijli prum ruh um pat lieh her u lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa uta u briew hynñiew sngi .
translation.en: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh , and in sight be not deeper than the skin , and the hair thereof be not turned white  ; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days :
I am a companion of all them that fear thee , and of them that keep thy precepts .
translation.kha: Nga long u paralok jong kito baroh kiba shakri ïa me , jong baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .

translation.en: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea : for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt , and brought no present to the king of Assyria , as he had done year by year : therefore the king of Assyria shut him up , and bound him in prison .

Haba u Shalmaneser u tip ïa kane , u phah kem ïa u Hoshea bad buh ïa u ha ka byndi .

translation.en: And the Levites took down the ark of the  Lord  , and the coffer that was with it , wherein the jewels of gold were , and put them on the great stone : and the men of Beth–shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  bad ïa kata ka synduk ha kaba don kita ki dur kiba da ka ksiar bad ki buh ïa ki halor uta u mawbah . Nangta ki nong Beth Shemesh ki kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ïa kiwei pat ki jingkñia ha U  Trai .

Hynrei u sboh ïai ai ka sakhi ïa ka jingdon jong u - kyrsum kiei kiba bha kiba u leh : U ai ha phi ïa u slap na sahit Marduk bad ïa ki jingthung ha ki por babiang ; jingrakhe nongthaw ha phi ka jingbam bad bymïap pyndap ïa ka Elealeh jong phi da ka lapsan Jingshyrkhei
translation.en: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness , in that he did good , and gave us rain from heaven , and fruitful seasons , filling our hearts with food and gladness .

translation.en: And by him all that believe are justified from all things , from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses .

translation.en: And when they did mete it with an omer , he that gathered much had nothing over , and he that gathered little had no lack  ; they gathered every man according to his eating .

translation.en: And looking round about upon them all , he said unto the man ,  Stretch forth thy hand .  And he did so : and his hand was restored whole as the other .

sngewkmen ban pynlut baroh kaba nga don , bad ïa ruh , khnang ban ïoh ïarap ïa phi . Hato phin ieit nga ba nga palat ïa phi ?
translation.en: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you ; though the more abundantly I love you , the less I be loved .

translation.en: In all the signs and the wonders , which the  Lord  sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh , and to all his servants , and to all his land ,
The  Lord  God is my strength , and he will make my feet like hinds  feet , and he will make me to walk upon mine high places . To the chief singer on my stringed instruments .

translation.en: And when Gaal saw the people , he said to Zebul , Behold , there come people down from the top of the mountains . And Zebul said unto him , Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men .

translation.en: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken , Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel  ;

translation.en: My little children , let us not love in word , neither in tongue  ; but in deed and in truth .
translation.kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , ka jingieit jong ngi kam dei ban long tang da ki ktien bad ka jingkren ; ka dei ban long ka jingieit kaba shisha , kaba pynpaw ïa lade da ka kam .

translation.en: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman , neither the woman without the man , in the Lord .

To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u da ka jingshad ; to tem pulom ksing bad ki duitara ha ka jingïaroh Hanes 15 .
translation.en: Let them praise his name in the dance : let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp .

translation.en: The thought of foolishness is sin : and the scorner is an abomination to men .

translation.en: Now while he was not yet gone back , he said , Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah , and dwell with him among the people : or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go . So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward , and let him go .
translation.kha: Haba ngam shym la jubab , u Nebusaradan u la ong ,  Khie leit phai pat sha u Gedalaïah , u khun jong u Ahikam bad u ksiew jong u Shaphan , ïa uba u syiem ka Babilonia u la pynlong ïa u , u lat jong ki shnong ka Judah . Phi lah ban sah bad u bad im hapdeng ki briew , lane phi lah ban leit shano shano ba phi pyrkhat ba phi dei ban leit .  Kumta u la ai ïa nga ka jingai sngewbha bad katto katne ka jingbam ban rah bad nga , bad u la shah ïa nga ba ngan leit noh ha la ka lynti .

translation.en: And , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Speak unto every feathered fowl , and to every beast of the field , Assemble yourselves , and come  ; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you , even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel , that ye may eat flesh , and drink blood .

Kan long ka jingkhawai kaba heh ha ki lumbah Israel , ba kin ïabam ïa ka doh bad dih ïa ka snam .

translation.en: For he shall be like the heath in the desert , and shall not see when good cometh  ; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness , in a salt land and not inhabited .

Hadien khyndiat sngi , u khun ba kham rit u la die ka ïa bynta jong ka jingdon jingem jong u bad u la na mihnoh ïing lem bad ka pisa . U la leit sha ka ri kaba jngai , ha u kaba la pynsyrwa ei ïa ka pisa jong u ha ka ba-thurmur jingim .
translation.en: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together , and took his journey into a far country , and there wasted his substance with riotous living .
Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds , and destitute of the truth , supposing that gain is godliness : from such withdraw thyself .
translation.kha: Ki pyrkhat ba ka niam ka long ka lynti ban riewspah .

translation.en: And saw heaven opened , and a certain vessel descending unto him , as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners , and let down to the earth :
translation.kha: U la ïohi ba la plie ïa ka bneng bad kaei re kawei kaba wan hiar kaba i kum ka jaiñ siang kaba heh ïa kaba la pynhiar na ki saw tylli ki dong jong ka sha ka pyrthei .

Ka sop ka ïai wallam Hiel jingkyrkhu Beon ka par kylleng ka pyrthei kran kumba ka la long hapdeng jong phi naduh kata ka sngi kaba dala la ïohsngew jyrtieng shaphang ka jingaiei Barak U Blei bad phi la tip ïa ka Amos ka long pynbhabriew .
translation.en: Which is come unto you , as it is in all the world ; and bringeth forth fruit , as it doth also in you , since the day ye heard of it , and knew the grace of God in truth :

translation.en: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David , but carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite .
And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month : in the tenth month , on the first day of the month , were the tops of the mountains seen .
translation.kha: Kata ka um ruh ka la nang hiar nang hiar , bad ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba shiphew , ki kliar lum ki la paw .

Naduh kata ka por , namar jong ngut Joseph , U Trai Riblah la kyrkhu Hananaïah ka longïing longsem jong u Sakkur Ijipt , Hanun ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u don ha ïing ka sem jong u lane ha ïatei jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house , and over all that he had , that the  Lord  blessed the Egyptian s house for Joseph s sake  ; and the blessing of the  Lord  was upon all that he had in the house , and in the field .
Let your will take place , as in heaven , also on earth .”
translation.kha: Long ka mon jong me ha ka khyndew kumba ha bneng .”

Me long U jingngeit-ba jong ngi . Mynba u paid Israel jong me u kyndat sha Uriel ka ri nongpdem me beh krad ïa ki briew bakhadduh shong hangne bad me ai Elasah Peit ïasngewbha ha ki khun ki ksiew u Abraham , u paralok jong me jingialeh Lyngkha long ka jong ki junom .
translation.en: Art not thou our God , who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel , and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever ?

Behold , I will put a fleece of wool in the floor  ; and if the dew be on the fleece only , and it be dry upon all the earth beside , then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand , as thou hast said .

Nangta ki briew U kin tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi ha ka Hima jong U Kpa jong ki To shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !
translation.en: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father . Who hath ears to hear , let him hear .

translation.kha: U Jisu u dang Elam haba u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , pynsmai jingïohkynti wan poi . Ryngkat Jedidah u , la don u paidbah babun uba la kieng atiar da ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , ïa kiba tnum phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san .
translation.en: And while he yet spake , lo , Judas , one of the twelve , came , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and elders of the people .

translation.kha: Nangta ki pyrta ïa u Jonathan bad ïa uta u hapoh , Ale shane ! Ngi don ei ei ban ong Namarba phi ! U Jonathan ïamap ong ïa uta u samla , Bud ïa nga . sbiak Trai u la khynwin ha ki pynwai ka jingjop halor jong ki .
translation.en: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer , and said , Come up to us , and we will shew you a thing . And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer , Come up after me : for the  Lord  hath delivered them into the hand of Israel .

translation.kha: Ki briew kin tei ïa ki ïing ki sem bad kin shong hi ha ki — yn ym pyndonkam dur ki da ktung pat jingïasyllok Kin thung ki dieng sohwaiñ bad tyllong sngewbha ha ka waiñ tawah Japhia ym sngewdiaw ïa ka da kiwei pat ding
translation.en: And they shall build houses , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and eat the fruit of them .
Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho , and Beth–hoglah , and the valley of Keziz ,
translation.kha: Ki nongbah kiba dei jong ki longïing na ka jait Benjamin ki long ka Jerikho , ka Beth Hoglah , ka Emek Kesis ,
U riewbymman u jop ha kiei kiei baroh . Um lah ban ïa ki jingbishar U Blei ; rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nongshun jong u .
translation.en: His ways are always grievous  ; thy judgments are far above out of his sight : as for all his enemies , he puffeth at them .

translation.kha: Mynta , ïa kane ka jingmaïan pynpaw ha , ym namar ba kham stad ban ïa uno uno pat , hynrei ba u Syiem Kynrad u ban ïoh tip ïa jingmut jong ka jingphohsniew jong phi shemphang ïa ki jingpyrkhat kiba la wan ha phi .
translation.en: But as for me , this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living , but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king , and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart .
They were as fed horses in the morning : every one neighed after his neighbour s wife .
translation.kha: Ki la long kum ki kulai ba la bsa bha , ki bym lah synshar ha ki jingkwah , uwei pa uwei u da kwah brai ïa ka tnga jong u paramarjan jong u .
ki wan shahshkor ïa bad ban ïoh jingkhiah na jingpang jong ki . Kito kiba la pynjynjar da ki mynsiem bymman ruh ki la wan bad la pynkhiah ïa ki .
translation.en: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits : and they were healed .

translation.kha: U Ahab u jubab , Don sa , u Mikaïah u khun jong u Imlah . nga isih ïa u um ju ïathuhlypa bha ïa ka ju kaei kaei kaba Phim dei ban ong kumta ! u Jehoshaphat jubab .
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , There is yet one man , by whom we may enquire of the  Lord  : but I hate him  ; for he never prophesied good unto me , but always evil : the same is Micaiah the son of Imlah . And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so .

translation.kha: Bun na ki nong ha Samaria kata ka shnong ki la ha ngeit U Jisu namar kata ka briew ka la lah ong , U la ïathuh ïa nga ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la leh .
translation.en: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman , which testified , He told me all that ever I did .
And Jacob loved Rachel  ; and said , I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ïapmat ïa ka Rakhel , kumta u ong ,  Ngan trei hynñiew snem na ka bynta jong phi , lada phi shah ba ngan shongkurim ïa ka Rakhel .
Ynda u u Joseph la lah tep ïa la u kpa , u leit phai pat sha Ijipt ryngkat bad la ki hynmen ki lem para bad kita baroh kiba leit ontep ïa u kpa jong u .
translation.en: And Joseph returned into Egypt , he , and his brethren , and all that went up with him to bury his father , after he had buried his father .

translation.kha: Naduh nangta hi , man ka Ussah ba uta u mynsiem bymman hiarthma phah U Blei u wan Humtah u Saul , u Dabid u shim ïa la ka duitara bad u tem jingkhñium ka Kohnguh Uta u mynsiem bymman u mihnoh , bad Luhith Saul ruh u sngewpyngngad kdar , bad u shait u koit pat .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul , that David took an harp , and played with his hand : so Saul was refreshed , and was well , and the evil spirit departed from him .
The cup of blessing which we bless , is it not the communion of the blood of Christ ? The bread which we break , is it not the communion of the body of Christ ?
translation.kha: Ka khuri kaba ngi pyndonkam ha ka Jingkhawai U Trai bad ïa kaba ngi ainguh ïa U Blei : Haba ngi dih na ka , ngi ïoh bynta lem ha ka snam U Khrist . Bad u kpu uba ngi kdiah : Haba ngi bam ïa u , ngi ïoh bynta lem ha ka met U Khrist .
briew kiba stad ki ïaid ha ka lynti kaba ïalam artet sha ka jingim ym ïa ka lynti kaba ïalam arsut sha ka jingïap .
translation.en: The way of life is above to the wise , that he may depart from hell beneath .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah ap phira khapnoh u Saul Togarmah Gibeah ha ri Benjamin jingpynbor ïohi ïa ki Philistia ba ki phet ha ka jingkulmar .
translation.en: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked  ; and , behold , the multitude melted away , and they went on beating down one another .
And his head was brought in a charger , and given to the damsel : and she brought it to her mother .
translation.kha: Ïa ka khlieh la wallam shapoh ha ka pliang bad la ai ha ka khynnah , kaba la rah ïa ka sha la ka kmie .

U pneh u aiti ïa ki ha ki paid Gibeon , kiba la phasi ïa Phikol halor u lum ha bleithaw U Trai pynïasuk baroh hynñiew ngut ki la ïa-ïap Palmyra . Ka dei haba jan Peris artat ka Abihu , ha kaba sdang ka aïom Tba barli , haba la pynïap ïa ki Gabriel
translation.en: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites , and they hanged them in the hill before the  Lord  : and they fell all seven together , and were put to death in the days of harvest , in the first days , in the beginning of barley harvest .

translation.kha: Khmih ïa ki kti jong nga bad ki kjat jong nga bad , peit ba dei ma nga hi . Tba ïa , nga bad phin tip naba , ka rngai kam don ka doh bad ki shyieng , kumba phi ïohi ba nga don .
translation.en: Behold my hands and my feet , that it is I myself : handle me , and see  ; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones , as ye see me have .
Let Israel rejoice in him that made him : let the children of Zion be joyful in their King .
translation.kha: To kmen , ko Israel , namar u Nongthaw jong phi ; to shadkmen , ko ki briew ka Seïon , na ka bynta u syiem jong phi !

translation.en: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper : but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy .
translation.kha: Phin ym long uba jop ha ka jingim lada phi pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa la ki pop . Phla ïa ki bad iehnoh ïa ki ; te U Blei un pyn-i ka jingisynei ïa phi .

translation.en: Then she runneth , and cometh to Simon Peter , and to the other disciple , whom Jesus loved , and saith unto them , They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre , and we know not where they have laid him .
translation.kha: Ka la leit mareh sha u Simon Petros bad sha uwei pat u synran , uba U Jisu u ieit , bad ka la ïathuh ha ki ,  Ki la ïarah noh ïa U Trai na ka jingtep , bad ngim tip hangno ki la ïabuh ïa u !

translation.en: And said ,  Verily I say unto you , Except ye be converted , and become as little children , ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ,  Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lymda phi kylla bad long kum ki khynnah , phin ym ïohrung da lei lei shapoh ka Hima ki bneng .
Mar shu dep pule da u Jehudi ïa ki lai ne saw Jehasiel , u syiem u la Shunem ïa ki Aiñ ka tari ? bad bret ïa Segub ha ka ding . U ïai leh ïa kane haduh ba la thang lut ïa ka kot kli baroh kawei .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves , he cut it with the penknife , and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth , until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth .

When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon , Amasa went before them . And Joab s garment that he had put on was girded unto him , and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof  ; and as he went forth it fell out .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha u mawsiang bah ha Gibeon , u Amasa u la ïakynduh ïa ki . U Joab u la phong ka jaiñ ïaleh thma , bad ka waitlam hapoh ka jingsop jong ka ïa kaba la teh pynskhem ha u panpoh jong u . Katba u wan sha khmat ka waitlam ka la hap .
Ngan pynlong ïa me uba kum mawsiang , uba eh kum u diamond ; wat sheptieng ïa kito ïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead : fear them not , neither be dismayed at their looks , though they be a rebellious house .

There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit  ; neither hath he power in the day of death : and there is no discharge in that war  ; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ruh ba lah ban pyllait ïa lade na ka ban ïap lane pynslem ïa ka sngi ka jingïap jong u . Kata ka dei ka thma kaba ngim lah ban lait ; ngim lah ban pyllait ïa lade da ka jingshukor .

translation.en: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the  Lord  , that he hath taken against Babylon  ; and his purposes , that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans : Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out : surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them .
translation.kha: Kumta to shahshkor ïa ka jingthmu kaba nga la don pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Babilon bad ïa kaei kaba nga thmu ban leh ïa ki briew jong ka . Wat ïa ki khynnah yn paring ïa ki , bad baroh kin sngewtriem .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that the beggar died , and was carried by the angels into Abraham s bosom : the rich man also died , and was buried  ;
translation.kha: U briew uba duk u la ïap bad la bah da ki angel ban shong hajan u Abraham ha ka jingkhawai ha bneng . U riewspah u la ïap bad la tep ,

Hadien ba ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la kut , baroh ki paid Israel ki leit sha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah ha Judah bad ki pynpra ïa ki rishot maw , ki pyndkut ïa ki dur ka blei Asherah , bad ki pynjot ïa ki bad duwan ki jaka mane blei thala . Ki ïa leh kajuh ha baroh ki bynta basah jong ka Judah , bad ïa ki ri jong ki Benjamin , Ephraim bad Manasseh ; nangta baroh na ki , ki leit phai sha ïing .
translation.en: Now when all this was finished , all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah , and brake the images in pieces , and cut down the groves , and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin , in Ephraim also and Manasseh , until they had utterly destroyed them all . Then all the children of Israel returned , every man to his possession , into their own cities .
The fear of the  Lord  is the instruction of wisdom  ; and before honour is humility .
translation.kha: Ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  ka long ka jinghikai na ka hi . Phi dei ban long kiba sngewrit ha shuwa ba phin ïoh ïa ki jingkyntiew burom .
Ha shuwa ba men die ka jaka , dei ka jong me ; bad hadien ba me la die ïa ka , pisa la ka jong me . Balei te , ba me la kut jingmut ban leh ïa kane Mem shym la shukor ïa ki briew — me la ïa U Blei !
translation.en: Whiles it remained , was it not thine own ? and after it was sold , was it not in thine own power ? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart ? thou hast not lied unto men , but unto God .

translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , shahshkor jingïaseng nga , shim khia ïa kaei kaba nga hikai film phi pynbam bad phin Nongthaw slem .
translation.en: Hear , O my son , and receive my sayings  ; and the years of thy life shall be many .
For Sarah conceived , and bare Abraham a son in his old age , at the set time of which God had spoken to him .
translation.kha: Ïa uta u khun la kha ha ka por ba U Blei u la buh ba yn sa kha ïa u .

Lada ha kawei ka sngi ïa ka suiñbneng la lah ban thew bad ïa nongrim ki pyrthei ka la ïitbniah , tang kata hi ka ban pynlong ba un kyntait ïa ki paid Israel namar baroh kaba ki la leh . U Trai u la . kren
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If heaven above can be measured , and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath , I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done , saith the  Lord .

And now , saith the  Lord  that formed me from the womb to be his servant , to bring Jacob again to him , Though Israel be not gathered , yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the  Lord  , and my God shall be my strength .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban kha ïa nga , U  Trai  u la thung ïa nga ; u la pynlong ïa nga u shakri jong u ban wallam pat ïa ki briew jong u , ban wallam pat ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel kaba la saphriang kylleng . U  Trai  u ai ha nga ka burom ; u long u tyllong jong ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga .
Kumta ruh kan long ka ktien kaba nga kren — kan ym ïa kaba thmu na bynta jong ka ; kan pynlong ïa kiei baroh kiba nga ïa ban leh .
translation.en: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth : it shall not return unto me void , but it shall accomplish that which I please , and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it .
And six branches shall come out of the sides of it  ; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side , and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side :
translation.kha: Dei ban don hynriew tylli ki tnat kiba mih na baroh arliang jong u , lai tylli na kawei kawei ka liang .

translation.en: Although the fig tree shall not blossom , neither shall fruit be in the vines  ; the labour of the olive shall fail , and the fields shall yield no meat  ; the flock shall be cut off from the fold , and there shall be no herd in the stalls :
translation.kha: Wat la ki dieng Dumbur kim don soh bad ym don sohwaiñ ba mih ha ki dieng sohwaiñ , wat la u dieng Olib um sei ei ei bad ki lyngkha kim pynmih kew , wat la ki langbrot baroh ki ïap bad ki sem masi ki thylli ,

translation.en: Behold , when it was whole , it was meet for no work : how much less shall it be meet yet for any work , when the fire hath devoured it , and it is burned ?
translation.kha: ka la long ka bymmyntoi wat ha shuwa ba yn thang ïa ka . Mynta ba ka ding ka la thang ïa ka bad pynkylla rnga ïa ka , ka la nang long shuh shuh ka bymmyntoi ei ei .

translation.en: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height , neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs , neither their trees stand up in their height , all that drink water : for they are all delivered unto death , to the nether parts of the earth , in the midst of the children of men , with them that go down to the pit .
translation.kha: Bad kumta naduh mynta hi , yn ym don shuh u dieng , kam pher katno la ai um bha ïa u , un jrong pat sa shisien ne u ban kynjoh ïa la ka kliar lyngba ki lyoh bad u ban kot kat kato ka rynïeng . Ïa ki baroh la buh ban ïap kum ïa baroh ki briew ba dei ban ïap , la buh ba kin ïasoh bad kito kiba leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord . But the foundation of the temple of the  Lord  was not yet laid .
translation.kha: Wat la ki briew kim pat shym la sdang ban tei biang ïa ka Templ , ki la sdang ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai bahynñiew ban thang ki jingkñia sha U  Trai .
U Joseph u la pynlong mraw ïa ki briew tduh na sha tduh ka Ijipt .
translation.en: And as for the people , he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof .
That the aged men be sober , grave , temperate , sound in faith , in charity , in patience .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa kiba la kham rangbah ba kin long kiba adkar , kiba tipbriew bad kiba synshar ïa lade ; kiba skhem ha ka jingngeit , ka jingieit bad ka jingïaishah jong ki .
Ka ong Kumne , ‘ Kin rah ïa me ha ki kti jong ki khnang ba wat ki kjat jong me shongsah ym mynsaw ha ki Medan .’
translation.en: And in their hands they shall bear thee up , lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone .

translation.kha: Phim pyrshang pat hi .
translation.en: You haven't even tried .

translation.kha: Haba u wan , sa synshar ïa la ki briew da ka jingkhlaiñ kaba U Trai bad da ka burom jong U Trai U Blei hi . Ki briew jong u kin ka jingshngain namar ki na kylleng pyrthei ithuh ïa ka jingkhraw jong u , bad un wanrah ïa ka .
translation.en: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the  Lord  , in the majesty of the name of the  Lord  his God  ; and they shall abide : for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth .
Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion , and loosed him , and forgave him the debt .
translation.kha: U Syiem u la sngewsynei ïa u , kumta u la map ïa ka ram jong u bad u la pyllait noh ïa u .

translation.en: Now therefore , O  Lord  our God , save us from his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the  Lord  , even thou only .
translation.kha: Mynta , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Assyria , kumta ba baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang ma me hi me long U Blei .

Kaba kham palat ïa kata ka long ba ïa ngi la pynpaw ba ngi shu lamler shaphang U Blei , namar ngi ba la ong u ba la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap — hynrei lada ka long kaba shisha ba ïa ïap kiba ym shym la pynmihpat , te um shym pynmihpat la ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: Yea , and we are found false witnesses of God ; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ : whom he raised not up , if so be that the dead rise not .

translation.kha: Hukum u Joshua ïa , bad pynshlur ïa u , naba un ïalam ïa u paidbah shatai sha shiliang ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba me ïohi .’
translation.en: But charge Joshua , and encourage him , and strengthen him : for he shall go over before this people , and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see .
And the Levites that are gone away far from me , when Israel went astray , which went astray away from me after their idols  ; they shall even bear their iniquity .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa kito ki Lebi , ryngkat bad ïa kito kiba na ki paid Israel , kiba la iehnoh ïa nga bad mane ïa ki bleithaw .

translation.en: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad , and said unto him , Go , carry them to the city .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ai ïa kita ki tiar ïaleh u ha uta u khynnah , bad u ong ïa u ban leit rah ïa ki baroh sha shnong .

Ngam pat shym la tip hi ba dei u ma u , hynrei U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga ban da pynbaptis ka um , u la ong ha nga , ‘ Men sa ïohi ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar bad u shongsah ha u briew ; u dei uta uba , pynbaptis da U Bakhuid Mynsiem .’
translation.en: And I knew him not : but he that sent me to baptize with water , the same said unto me , Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending , and remaining on him , the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost .
For so was it charged me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Eat no bread , nor drink water , nor turn again by the same way that thou camest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban ym bam lane dih ei ei , bad ban ym leit phai na kajuh ka lynti kaba nga la wan .

Bad mynta kaba ap nga ïa ka long ka bainong jong ka jingjop ïa kaba la buh beit da U Blei uba U Trai , u nongbishar bahok , u ban ai ha nga kata ha ka — Sngi ym tang ïa nga , hynrei ïa kito baroh kiba ap ïa u da ka jingieit ba wanpaw un .
translation.en: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness , which the Lord , the righteous judge , shall give me at that day : and not to me only , but unto all them also that love his appearing .

translation.kha: Ki dieng kin sei u , ki lyngkha kin pynmih ïa ki jingthung bad uwei pa un shongshngain ha la ri . Ynda haba nga ïa kynjri teh ïa ki jong nga nga pyllait ïa ki kito pynlong mraw ïa ki , sa tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit , and the earth shall yield her increase , and they shall be safe in their land , and shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have broken the bands of their yoke , and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them .

translation.kha: Phin sa lwet kum ki maw ba la ban mawshun , kum ki shiah ba la haduh ba ki kylla dpei .
translation.en: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime : as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire .

translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha uta paidbah , u Wat sheptieng ; la phi la leh ïa ka kam bymman , wat phai noh na U Trai , hynrei shakri ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .
translation.en: And Samuel said unto the people , Fear not : ye have done all this wickedness : yet turn not aside from following the  Lord  , but serve the  Lord  with all your heart  ;
See that none render evil for evil unto any man ; but ever follow that which is good , both among yourselves , and to all men .
translation.kha: Khmih ba uno uno un ym siew kylliang ïa kaba sniew da kaba sniew , hynrei ha ki por baroh to kut jingmut ban lehbha iwei ïa iwei pat bad ïa ki briew baroh .

translation.en: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests , the keepers of the charge of the altar : these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi , which come near to the  Lord  to minister unto him .
translation.kha: bad ka kamra kaba phai shaphang shatei ka la long na ka bynta ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ha ka duwan . Baroh ki dei ki lyngdoh kiba la hiarpateng na u Sadok ; dei tang ïa kine ki dkhot jong ka jait Lebi ba la shah ban leit ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ban shakri ïa U .
U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Ki briew kiba khiah kim ïa donkam u nongpynkhiah , hynrei tang kito kiba pang .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  They that are whole need not a physician  ; but they that are sick .
And he lifted up his eyes , and saw his brother Benjamin , his mother s son , and said , Is this your younger brother , of whom ye spake unto me ? And he said , God be gracious unto thee , my son .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u ïohi ïa u Benjamin u para jong u , u ong ,  Une seh u para khatduh jong phi , uta uba phi la ïathuh ha nga ? U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi , khun .

translation.en: Take heed to yourselves , that your heart be not deceived , and ye turn aside , and serve other gods , and worship them  ;
translation.kha: Da husiar ban ym shah ïalam bakla noh na U  Trai  ban mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei .
U Trai un ri sumar ïa phi . Un biang shah ba phin hap jingkylla ka jingriam .
translation.en: For the  Lord  shall be thy confidence , and shall keep thy foot from being taken .

translation.kha: Kumta u ïalam ïa noh ki briew ba la jied jong u , bad ki rwai bad pyrta da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: And he brought forth his people with joy , and his chosen with gladness :
One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one  ; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee : till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain , and as an ensign on an hill .
translation.kha: Shihajar ngut na phi kin ïaphet krad haba phi ïohi ïa uwei u shipai nongshun , bad san ngut ki shipai ki la biang ban pynlong ïa phi baroh ban phet krad . Yn ym don shuh ka kynhun shipai jong phi ka ban dang sah , lait noh sa tang u dieng lama ba sah marwei ha kliar jong u lum !

translation.en: And when they went from nation to nation , and from one kingdom to another people  ;
translation.kha: Ki ïaidwir na kawei ka ri sha kawei pat , na kawei ka hima sha kawei pat .
Kumta dung kyrpad ïa Meremoth ba phin map syntiat ka kam sniew shaba ngi kiar ki shakri jong U Ruphos u kpa jong banep , Haram la leh . U Joseph u ïam haba u ïohsngew ïa jingkordor .
translation.en: So shall ye say unto Joseph , Forgive , I pray thee now , the trespass of thy brethren , and their sin  ; for they did unto thee evil : and now , we pray thee , forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father . And Joseph wept when they spake unto him .

So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts , and they shall bereave thee  ; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee  ; and I will bring the sword upon thee . I the  Lord  have spoken it .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ka jingïapthngan bad ki mradkhlaw ba kin pynïap ïa ki khun jong pha , bad ngan phah ïa ka jingpang , ka jingleh thombor , bad ka thma ban pynïap ïa pha . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

U u Dabid phet krad ka na nongbah Gath bad u leit sha ka krem hajan ka nongrit Adullam . Haba ki hynmen shynrang jong u bad kiwei pat ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u ki tip ba u don hangta , ki la ïasoh bad . u
translation.en: David therefore departed thence , and escaped to the cave Adullam : and when his brethren and all his father s house heard it , they went down thither to him .

translation.kha: U kpa dei ruh ban ha la ïing ïa ki jingdonkam ba kynja mynsiem .
translation.en: A father must also provide for his family’s spiritual needs .
And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands , and brought that which they had spun , both of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine linen .
translation.kha: Baroh ki kynthei kiba nang ban thir ki wallam ïa u ksai linen uba ni , bad ïa u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw .

Ha kane ka por u Joshua u la leit bad u pynduh khoit ïa ka jait ka kynja ki ramhah ba khot la kyrteng ki kiba Anakim shong basah ka ha ri lum — ha Hebron Debir , , Anab , bad ha baroh ka ri lum jong ka Judah bad ka Israel . Joshua U u la pynjot thiaw ïa ki bad ïa ki nongbah jong ki .
translation.en: And at that time came Joshua , and cut off the Anakims from the mountains , from Hebron , from Debir , from Anab , and from all the mountains of Judah , and from all the mountains of Israel : Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities .
And Judas also , which betrayed him , knew the place : for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples .
translation.kha: U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la tip ha-ei ka don , namar bunsien U Jisu u la ïakynduh hangta bad la ki synran .

translation.en: But as they sailed he fell asleep : and there came down a storm of wind on the lake  ; and they were filled with water , and were in jeopardy .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang leit ha ka lieng , U Jisu u la ïohthiah . Kynsan ka lyer kaba jur ka la beh halor ka duriaw , bad ka lieng ka la sdang ban dap da ka um , ba kumta baroh ki la don ha ka jingma kaba khraw .

translation.en: They answering said , John the Baptist  ; but some say , Elias  ; and others say , that one of the old prophets is risen again .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki ong ba me dei u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ki la jubab .  Kiwei pat ki ong ba me dei u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong ba me dei uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa na mynbarim uba la mihpat .

translation.en: And when the sun was going down , a deep sleep fell upon Abram  ; and , lo , an horror of great darkness fell upon him .
translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka la jan sep , u Abram u shoh samthiah eh , bad ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingsngew shyrkhei ka la wan ha u .
Wat ai ba ngin ïa iehnoh ka jingmlien ban ïaseng lang , kumba don kiba . leh Pynban to , ngin pynshlur uwei ïa uwei pat , khamtam haba phi ïohi ba ka Sngi U Trai ka la nang jan .
translation.en: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together , as the manner of some is  ; but exhorting one another : and so much the more , as ye see the day approaching .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka jia , u snar uba la pynskhem sa un kylluid bad hap . Bad kata kan long ka jingkut jong kiei kiei baroh kiba la sdien ha u . U Trai la u kren .
translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed , and be cut down , and fall  ; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee  ; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee , and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa me ha shuwa ba nga ai jingim ïa me , bad ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa me , nga la jied ïa me ban long u nongïathuhlypa sha ki jaitbynriew .
Kaba shaniah u briew u bym lah ban shaniah ha ka ka jingjynjar ka kumba ban ktha jingbam ka bniat kaba la khih ne ïaid ka kjat kaba dkoh .
translation.en: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth , and a foot out of joint .
Arise , walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it  ; for I will give it unto thee .
translation.kha: Mynta , khie leit bad khmih ïa ka ri baroh kawei , naba ngan ai ïa ka baroh ha me .
Me kam ba Methushael kaba me ong ka ieid kaba shisha ; me kam ba me long uba sngur NGA ki khmat U kynjat .
translation.en: For thou hast said , My doctrine is pure , and I am clean in thine eyes .

translation.kha: Katba nga dang trei bad ki Jiw Ur nga im kum u Jiw khnang jingktah jop ïa ki ; bad Bethpeor la ma nga hi ngam long sur-thma ka Hukum u bakynjah , nga im kumba nga Sing long mynba Hepher dang kyrsum khnai kito rynsied hapoh ka hukum , khnang ba ngan jongu ïa ki .
translation.en: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew , that I might gain the Jews ; to them that are under the law , as under the law , that I might gain them that are under the law ;

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren ïa kane shaphang U Mynsiem , uba kito kiba la ngeit ha u kin ïohpdiang . Ha kata ka por U ïa Mynsiem ym pat shym la ai , namar ïa Jisu U ym pat la shym kyntiew sha ka burom .
translation.en: ( But this spake he of the Spirit , which they that believe on him should receive : for the Holy Ghost was not yet given  ; because that Jesus was not yet glorified . )
For thou shalt worship no other god : for the  Lord  , whose name is Jealous , is a jealous God :
translation.kha: Wat mane ïa uno uno uwei pat u blei , namar ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngam lah shah ïa kino kino ki ban ïakob ïa nga .

translation.en: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul  ; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt .
translation.kha: Ai ba kito kiba tur ïaleh ïa nga kin shahjop bad shah pynjot . Ai ba kito kiba pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa nga kin shah pynlehrain bad shah pynjahburom .
La ka long ka jong nga ka Oholah ka ïai bteng ban ka nuti dap da ka jingkwah ki nongleh-ieit jong ka na Assyria .
translation.en: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine  ; and she doted on her lovers , on the Assyrians her neighbours ,
And he said , What meanest thou by all this drove which I met ? And he said , These are to find grace in the sight of my lord .
translation.kha: U Iso u kylli ,  Kumno pat shaphang kato ka kynhun kaba nga la ïakynduh ? Ka mut aïu kato ?  U Jakob u jubab  Ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi .
Haba U Jisu u poi , u la shem ba la lah ïa u Lasaros saw mynshuwa .
translation.en: Then when Jesus came , he found that he had lain in the grave four days already .

translation.kha: Kaei te ba-pyiar Hanokh ? Hato stet nongking im ha ka pop ba ka jingaiei phai Blei kan nang khraw ?
translation.en: What shall we say then ? Shall we continue in sin , that grace may abound ?

translation.kha: Khnang ba U Blei un sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong phi phi dei ban ïaleh im katkum hukum jong u .
translation.en: For your prayers to be heard by God , you must be trying your best to live by his laws .
If any be blameless , the husband of one wife , having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly .
translation.kha: U nongsharai balang u dei ban long u bym don jingshah kynnoh pop ; u dei ban don tang kawei ka tnga , bad ki khun jong u ki dei ban long ki bangeit bad ki bym don jingbudnam ba ki long kiba leh thurmur lane ki bymkohnguh .

translation.en: To open the blind eyes , to bring out the prisoners from the prison , and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house .
translation.kha: Phin pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong kiba matlah bad pyllaitluid ïa kito kiba shong ha ki ïingbyndi ba-dum .
phin ba ïohrung ha kata ka jutang kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi pynlong u bad phi bad ban pdiang ïa ki ktien ba la thoh ha ka ,
translation.en: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the  Lord  thy God , and into his oath , which the  Lord  thy God maketh with thee this day :

translation.kha: To ong ïa ki nongsiatkhnam ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilon . Phah ïa baroh kiba nang ban pyndonkam ïa ka jingjia bad ïa u ïashem malai Kerkut ïa ka nongbah bad wat markhap ba yn pynbhabriew ba lait phet . Siew kylliang pat ïa kiei kiei baroh sarong ka la leh , bad leh ïa ka pynbhabriew ka la rain ïa kiwei ibiang namar ba ka la leh da ka jingsarong pyrshah ïa Khusa , U Bakhuid ki Israel .
translation.en: Call together the archers against Babylon : all ye that bend the bow , camp against it round about  ; let none thereof escape : recompense her according to her work  ; according to all that she hath done , do unto her : for she hath been proud against the  Lord  , against the Holy One of Israel .
And Joseph s master took him , and put him into the prison , a place where the king s prisoners were bound : and he was there in the prison .
translation.kha: bad u la phah kem ïa u Joseph bad u set ïa u ha ka byndi ha ka jaka ba la set ïa ki koidi jong u syiem , bad hangta la pynsah ïa u .

translation.en: For such an high priest became us , who is holy , harmless , undefiled , separate from sinners , and made higher than the heavens  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu , te , u long U Rangbah Lyngdoh uba pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ngi . U long uba khuid ; um shym don kano kano kaba bakla lane ka pop ha u ; la pynkyrpang ïa u na ki nongpop bad la kyntiew ïa u sha ki bneng .
nonglamktien , ïa la da ki kylli te ïa u , Lada mem dei u Messaïah u Elijah lane u nongïathuhlypa , balei pat me pynbaptis ?
translation.en: And they asked him , and said unto him , Why baptizest thou then , if thou be not that Christ , nor Elias , neither that prophet ?
Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa kaba shapoh jong ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang , ka Ïingjaiñ jong ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga na ki shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw . Suh pynpur itynnat ha ki ïa ka dur ki kherub .

translation.en: Then came in the magicians , the astrologers , the Chaldeans , and the soothsayers : and I told the dream before them  ; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof .
translation.kha: Te la wallam shapoh ïa baroh ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , bad ki nongpeit kti , bad nga la ïathuh ha ki ïa ka jingphohsniew jong nga , hynrei kim lah ban batai ïa ka ha nga .

translation.en: But the father said to his servants , Bring forth the best robe , and put it on him  ; and put a ring on his hand , and shoes on his feet :
translation.kha: Hynrei u kpa u la khot ïa la ki shakri . ‘ To pynkloi !’ u la ong . ‘ To wanlam ïa ka jaiñkup kaba bha tam bad pynkup ïa u . Pyndeng sati ha ka shynriah ti jong u bad pynphong juti ha ki kjat jong u .
Ka thain Goshen purim ha kaba ki Israel Sosthenes shong ki sah , ka long kiaw ma ka , ka jaka ha kaba u phria um shym hap bashalak
translation.en: Only in the land of Goshen , where the children of Israel were , was there no hail .

translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah hynñiew snem , bad Ibleam la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translation.en: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years , and begat sons and daughters .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa kata ka jingstad bad ka pushara . Nalor kata , ngan ai ruh ha me bun ka spah Krist ka jingkynshew marsyndah bad khatphra nam ban ïa uno uno u diengtied jingpynnang la ju ïoh mynshuwa lane un ïoh biang pat hiarpateng
translation.en: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee  ; and I will give thee riches , and wealth , and honour , such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee , neither shall there any after thee have the like .

translation.kha: Kum Sapphir ki briew shon long kiba bieit lieng ban tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh . Ki khapbrip ïa la ki khmat bad ïa la ki jingmut na ka jingshisha .
translation.en: They have not known nor understood : for he hath shut their eyes , that they cannot see  ; and their hearts , that they cannot understand .

translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïakynduh ha lum ïa ka briew kaba la bad ïatehktien uwei pat u briew , bad u batbor ïa , ka dei ban pynïap tang ïa uta u shynrang .
translation.en: But if a man find a betrothed damsel in the field , and the man force her , and lie with her : then the man only that lay with her shall die :

translation.kha: Bad kumta shisyndon nga la phah khot jingisynei me , me ruh me la long uba sbun eh ban wan . Mynta ngi baroh ngi don Tei ha dohnud jingdon ryngkat jingïabam jingmatlah Blei , da kaba ap ban ïohsngew jingrwai kano kano kaba khep Trai Bishlam la bthah ïa me Shophan ong .
translation.en: Immediately therefore I sent to thee  ; and thou hast well done that thou art come . Now therefore are we all here present before God , to hear all things that are commanded thee of God .

translation.kha: Bad nga la duwai , ‘ A Trai Nongsynshar , wat pynjot ïa la ki briew , ki briew kiba me la pyllait bad na ïalam Ijipt da ka jingkhlaiñ ka bad borbah jong me .
translation.en: I prayed therefore unto the  Lord  , and said , O Lord  God  , destroy not thy people and thine inheritance , which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness , which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand .

translation.kha: Kumta ki ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa , kane bad u jubab , Ka long ka burom kaba khraw ban long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem kaba , khraw than ïa uba kum nga ma uba duk bad u bymdondor ei ei .
translation.en: And Saul s servants spake those words in the ears of David . And David said , Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king s son in law , seeing that I am a poor man , and lightly esteemed ?

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Saul u phah ïa khot u Ahimelekh u lyngdoh bad ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u , kiba la long ruh lyngdoh ki ha Nob , bad ki la ïawan sha u .
translation.en: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest , the son of Ahitub , and all his father s house , the priests that were in Nob : and they came all of them to the king .

But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the  Lord  , and went down to Joppa  ; and he found a ship going to Tarshish : so he paid the fare thereof , and went down into it , to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Jonah pynban , u la leit sha ka jaka kaba marpyrshah khnang ban phet noh na U  Trai . U la leit sha Joppa , ha kaba u la shem ïa ka liengbah ka ban sa leit sha Spain . U la siew ïa ka bai lynti bad u la rung shapoh ryngkat bad ki nongtrei liengbah kiba leit sha Spain , ha kaba un long jngai na U  Trai .
Ki nongai jingmut jong u syiem ki la ïawan sha khmat , hynrei ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban pule ka ïa jingthoh ïathuh lane ha u syiem aïu ka kit jingmut .
translation.en: Then came in all the king s wise men : but they could not read the writing , nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof .

But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah , whom she bare unto Saul , Armoni and Mephibosheth  ; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul , whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite :
translation.kha: Pynban , u la shim ïa u Armoni bad ïa u Mephibosheth , ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka Rispah , ka khun u Aïah , ba ka la ïoh na u Saul ; u shim ruh ïa ki san ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka Merab , ka khun jong u Saul , ba ka la ïoh na u Adriel u khun jong u Barsillai uba na Meholah .

jingngeit hyndai , uei u Apollos ? Bad pynkyndeh u Paul ? Ngi dei behmrad ki shen jong U Tekoa , kiba la ïalam ïa phi ban ngeit . Uwei nongsngap uwei na ngi u trei ïa ka kam kaba U Naduh u la ai ïa u Seresh pynsyrwa :
translation.en: Who then is Paul , and who is Apollos , but ministers by whom ye believed , even as the Lord gave to every man ?
And though I have the gift of prophecy , and understand all mysteries , and all knowledge ; and though I have all faith , so that I could remove mountains , and have not charity , I am nothing .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban don ka jingai ban ïalap da ka jingpyrsad mynsiem ; nga lah ban don ïa ka jingtip baroh bad shemphang ha ki jingmaïan baroh ; nga lah ban don ïa ka jingngeit baroh kaba donkam ban pynkynriah ïa ki lumbah — hynrei lada ngam don ka jingieit , ngam long ei ei .
Ki briew kin ïaid sakma na ka Duriaw Baïap sha ka Mediterranian bad nangta shuh shuh na shaduh shatei mihngi . Kin ïakhmih kylleng kylleng ïa ka khubor na U Trai hynrei , kin ym shem ïa ka .
translation.en: And they shall wander from sea to sea , and from the north even to the east , they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the  Lord  , and shall not find it .

translation.kha: Hangta ha ka jingïohi ki Israel , u Joshua u pruid ha ki maw ïa ka jong jingthoh ka kaba Hukum u Moses u la thoh .
translation.en: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses , which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel .
And Joseph answered and said , This is the interpretation thereof : The three baskets are three days :
translation.kha: Te u Joseph u jubab ,  Kane ka mut kumne : ki lai tylli ki shang ki long lai tylli ki sngi .

translation.en: And the children of Israel said to Samuel , Cease not to cry unto the  Lord  our God for us , that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: bad ong ha u Samuel ,  To ïai duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philistia .
U buh ha ka Templ ïa baroh ki tiar kiba u Abijah u kpa jong u , u la ïanguh sha U ngiah , kumjuh TRAI’ ïa ki tiar ba la shna da boi jingkhylliap kynthih ka rupa kaba u jingkhum khun la pynkyntang .
translation.en: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated , and that he himself had dedicated , silver , and gold , and vessels .

translation.kha: Um ïashah liang bad ki Hesion ne pynpaw ba u kham lah ïa Melkhisedek riewspah Pamphylia ïa kiba kawang , naba u la thaw Kem ki baroh sahnarphna
translation.en: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes , nor regardeth the rich more than the poor ? for they all are the work of his hands .
And seeing one of them suffer wrong , he defended him , and avenged him that was oppressed , and smote the Egyptian :
translation.kha: U la ïohi ïa uwei na ki ba u la shah lehbeiñ ha u nong Ijipt , kumta u la leit ban ïarap ïa u bad u la pynhiarkput ïa u nong Ijipt da kaba pynïap ïa u .
Hynrei U Trai un shim noh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ka don . Un kynting ïa ka spah ka jong sha ka duriaw , bad ïa ka nongbah yn thang haduh khyndew .
translation.en: Behold , the Lord will cast her out , and he will smite her power in the sea  ; and she shall be devoured with fire .

translation.kha: symbai ktien jong u briew ki lah ban long ka umpohliew ka jingstad , 2001 jylliew kat ki duriaw-bah , kaba sngur kum khrum wahduid batuid .
translation.en: The words of a man s mouth are as deep waters , and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook .
And the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud : and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Joshua ki la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ bad U  Trai  u wanpaw ha ki hangta ha u rishot lyoh uba ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ .
Kumta to shahshkor jingthmu kaba nga la don pyrshah ka nongbah Babilon bad ïa kaei kaba nga thmu ban leh ïa ki briew jong ka . ïa ki khynnah yn paring ïa ki , baroh kin sngewtriem .
translation.en: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the  Lord  , that he hath taken against Babylon  ; and his purposes , that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans : Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out : surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them .
After this , Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished , that the scripture might be fulfilled , saith ,  I thirst .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ba mynta la pyndep ïa kiei kiei baroh ; bad khnang ban pynlong ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ban urlong shisha , u la ong ,  Nga sliang .
To Tobiah joit bad khie leit shim ïa kmie , bad khroh ïa u . Ngan pynlong ka jaitbynriew said khraw na kyrsum khun ki ksiew jong u .
translation.en: Arise , lift up the lad , and hold him in thine hand  ; for I will make him a great nation .
Saying , I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood . And they said , What is that to us ? see thou to that .
translation.kha: Nga la leh pop da kaba nga shetkylla ïa u briew uba lui lui ban ïap !  u la ong .  Kan ïadei aïu kata bad ngi ?  ki la jubab .  Kata ka dei ka kam jong me !
U sakhi lah ban shaniah , u ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , hynrei bym ban shaniah , u ïathuh tang kaba .
translation.en: A faithful witness will not lie : but a false witness will utter lies .

translation.kha: U Blei u ïailong ka jingïada hynñiewphew phi ; Ki ksang ti uba na Ïutikhos ki kyrshan ïa long-briew . U beh ïa ki nongshun jong phi katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , Bad pynsan ong ïa Pynpait ban pynjot thiaw ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: The eternal God is thy refuge , and underneath are the everlasting arms : and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee  ; and shall say , Destroy them .

translation.kha: U don bad u ka byrsha pynher stait , shoh ban ïa u kew baroh bad ban lumlang ïa u kew shapoh ka thiar jong u ; hynrei un thang ïa u stait ha ka ding ka bym ju lip .
translation.en: Whose fan is in his hand , and he will thoroughly purge his floor , and will gather the wheat into his garner  ; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable .

translation.kha: Hynrei lah ban weng noh ïa ka kumba ka Bakhuid ka ong u Moses : Ïa ka jingkah jong u weng noh mynba u la phai sha .
translation.en: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord , the veil shall be taken away .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , To bsuh noh ïa waitlam ha ka jingsop jong ka ! Me tharai ba ngan ym dih ïa ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ïa kaba U jong nga u ha ?
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto Peter ,  Put up thy sword into the sheath : the cup which my Father hath given me , shall I not drink it ?
Again , they are minished and brought low through oppression , affliction , and sorrow .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong U Blei ki shahjop bad shah ibeiñ da ki jingbanbeiñ bad jingjynjar bashyrkhei ,

translation.en: And Michal took an image , and laid it in the bed , and put a pillow of goats  hair for his bolster , and covered it with a cloth .
translation.kha: Nangta ka shim ïa ka bleithaw na ïing , ka pyndem ïa ka ha jingthiah , ka buh ka syngkhlieh kaba da u shñiuh blang ha khlieh jong kata , bad ka buh jingtap halor jong ka .

translation.en: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God  ; and all these things shall be added unto you .

nga ruh nga jynjar kumne baroh , Hynrei nga dap da jingsngewskhem , namar nga tip hano la shaniah bad nga sngewthikna ba u lah ban skhem haduh kata ka Sngi ïa kaei kaba u la aiti ha .
translation.en: For the which cause I also suffer these things : nevertheless I am not ashamed : for I know whom I have believed , and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day .
For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink ; but righteousness , and peace , and joy in the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Naba ka Hima U Blei kam long ha kaba bam bad kaba dih , hynrei ka long ka hok , ka jingsuk , bad ka jingkmen kiba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ai .

translation.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; thirteen young bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year  ; they shall be without blemish :

translation.en: And he brought forth the king s son , and put the crown upon him , and gave him the testimony  ; and they made him king , and anointed him  ; and they clapped their hands , and said , God save the king .

translation.en: And they came thither into the midst of the house , as though they would have fetched wheat  ; and they smote him under the fifth rib : and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

Ye have not chosen me , but I have chosen you , and ordained you , that ye should go and bring forth fruit , and that your fruit should remain : that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name , he may give it you .
