translation.en: Behold , I am against them that prophesy false dreams , saith the  Lord  , and do tell them , and cause my people to err by their lies , and by their lightness  ; yet I sent them not , nor commanded them : therefore they shall not profit this people at all , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: To sngew ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong ! Nga long pyrshah ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ïathuh ïa la ki jingphohsniew kiba dap da ki jinglamler . Ki ïathuh ïa kine ki jingphohsniew bad ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga da ka jinglamler bad ka jingsngewmeng jong ki . translation.en: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause  ; and deceive not with thy lips .

Yet now be strong , O Zerubbabel , saith the  Lord   ; and be strong , O Joshua , son of Jehozadak , the high priest  ; and be strong , all ye people of the land , saith the  Lord  , and work : for I am with you , saith the  Lord  of hosts :

translation.en: And said unto them ,  Thus it is written , and thus it behoved Christ to suffer , and to rise from the dead the third day :

translation.en: With clouds he covereth the light  ; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt .

translation.kha: Ym don kaba sniew kaba jia ha ki briew kiba hok , hynrei ki bymman kim don ei ei tang ka suda jynjar .
translation.en: There shall no evil happen to the just : but the wicked shall be filled with mischief .

translation.en: Some said , This is he : others said , He is like him : but he said , I am he .

translation.en: To the law and to the testimony : if they speak not according to this word , it is because there is no light in them .

translation.en: And there went out fire from the  Lord  , and devoured them , and they died before the  Lord .

translation.en: And he said , Lord  God  , whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it ?

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam , phi dei ban ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad phim dei ban treikam ei ei ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: And when they urged him till he was ashamed , he said , Send . They sent therefore fifty men  ; and they sought three days , but found him not .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ïai ban haduh ba u la mynjur bad shah ïa ki ban leit . Ki sanphew ngut na ki , ki la leit bad ki la wad ïa u Elijah sha lum sha them haduh lai sngi , hynrei kim shym shem ïa u .

translation.en: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold , although they were yet alive : for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof , which shall not return  ; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life .
translation.kha: Yn ym don nongkhaïi ki ban im haduh ban ïoh biang ïa kaei kaba ki la duh , namar ka jingbitar U Blei ka long halor baroh . Kito kiba bymman kin ym lait im .

U Jisu u la jubab , A katno kaba shyrkhei ruh ïa phi ki nonghikai ka ! Phi buh jingkit halor ki met jong ki kiba eh ïa ka ban kit hynrei phi hi phim kner wat kawei ka shympriah ban ïa ki ban kit kita ki jingkit .
translation.en: And he said ,  Woe unto you also , ye lawyers ! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne , and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew jong ka jingsynshar u u syiem ka Israel , Asa u la long u syiem ka Judah bad u synshar sawphew wei snem ha Jerusalem
translation.en: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah .

translation.kha: U Gad bad ki khun Sardis jong u : U Sephon , u jingshipa , jingtasngeng Shuni , u Esbon , u Eri , u Arod riewpoh bad u Areli .
translation.en: And the sons of Gad  ; Ziphion , and Haggi , Shuni , and Ezbon , Eri , and Arodi , and Areli .

And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir , and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim , which is Chesalon , on the north side , and went down to Beth–shemesh , and passed on to Timnah :
translation.kha: ha kaba u tawiar shaphang sepngi jong ka Baalah sha ka ri lum jong ka Edom , ter ter sha ka phang bashatei jong u Lum Jearim ( lane Khesalon ) , arsut sha Beth Shemesh , bad ter ter lyngba ka Timnah .
Ki paid Israel kiba lait im kin long kum ka umjer ba pynpyngngad ba da Trai ka bynta ki jaitbynriew ba bun , kum ki um slap ha ki jingthung ba dang mih . Kin shaniah ha U Blei , ym ha u briew .
translation.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the  Lord  , as the showers upon the grass , that tarrieth not for man , nor waiteth for the sons of men .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïa ïohsngew ka sur kaba jam kaba kren na ka Templ , ki ha ngut hynñiew ki angel : Khie leit bad theh noh ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang jong ka jingbitar U Blei ha ka pyrthei !
translation.en: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels , Go your ways , and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth .

translation.kha: Ki buh ïa u hapoh ka Melkhi bad ki la rah ïa u sha u syiem ka Babilonia . Ki la buh suiñbneng u hapoh ki nongap tlot ba kumta ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong iar-ryngkuh pun ym ïohsngew pat halor Khorasin lum pynkhlur ka Israel .
translation.en: And they put him in ward in chains , and brought him to the king of Babylon : they brought him into holds , that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel .

translation.kha: tnga jong , ki khun jong phi , bad ki jingri phi kin sah hangne , hynrei ki shipai jong phi , kiba la kieng atiar na ka bynta ka thma kin jam shuwa ïa kiwei pat ki Israel khnang ban ïa ki
translation.en: Your wives , your little ones , and your cattle , shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan  ; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed , all the mighty men of valour , and help them  ;

translation.kha: Haba u paidbah u la ïalum bad sdang ban kylli ïa u Pilat na ka bynta ka jingleh bakyrpang ba ju leh , u kylli la ïa ki Hato , phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong ïa phi u syiem jong ki Jiw ?
translation.en: But Pilate answered them , saying , Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews ?

translation.kha: A Na-ei , ïa me yn pynbna borabor —Joshua U Blei ; ki pateng phet baroh kin kynmaw ïa me .
translation.en: Thy name , O  Lord  , endureth for ever  ; and thy memorial , O  Lord  , throughout all generations .

translation.kha: Haba thom Kular Joel Khynnah kulai la khrawburom hynmen shynrang jong u , ki law noh jingpynpra ka sopti jynsur jong u kaba jrong kti .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joseph was come unto his brethren , that they stript Joseph out of his coat , his coat of many colours that was on him  ;

For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan , until every thing was finished that the  Lord  commanded Joshua to speak unto the people , according to all that Moses commanded Joshua : and the people hasted and passed over .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki ïeng hapdeng jong ka Jordan haduh ban da pyndep lut ïa kaei kaei baroh ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua ban ong ïa u paidbah ban leh . Kane ka dei kata kaba u Moses u la hukum . U paidbah u la pynkloi sha shiliang ka wah .

translation.en: A several tenth deal for one lamb , throughout the seven lambs :
translation.kha: bad shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .

translation.en: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason .
translation.kha: U briew uba alhia u pyrkhat ba u kham stad ban ïa hynñiew ngut ki briew kiba lah ban ai ki nia kiba bha na ka bynta ka jingmut jong ki .

translation.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said , An eye for an eye , and a tooth for a tooth :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Ka khmat namar ka khmat , bad ka bniat namar ka bniat .’
thir ha kata kajuh ka khohsiew , bam bad dih ïa ïongreiñ kano kaba ki ai ïa phi , naba u nongtrei u dei ban ïoh ïa nongput bainong jong u Jordan Wat leit sawdong na kawei ka ïing sha kawei pat .
translation.en: And in the same house remain , eating and drinking such things as they give : for the labourer is worthy of his hire . Go not from house to house .

translation.kha: dei ban don mano mano ba ibeiñ ïa u , hynrei phi dei ban ïarap ïa ban bteng ïa jingleit jong u ha kaba suk , khnang un ïoh wan phai pat nga ; naba nga khmih ba un wan phai bad ki .
translation.en: Let no man therefore despise him : but conduct him forth in peace , that he may come unto me : for I look for him with the brethren .

translation.kha: Ba U Khrist un pynsuhthied ha mynsiem jongphi da jingngeit ba , phin , pynshong nongrim ha ka jingieit ,
translation.en: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith ; that ye , being rooted and grounded in love ,
Thou shalt eat it before the  Lord  thy God year by year in the place which the  Lord  shall choose , thou and thy household .
translation.kha: Man ka snem , ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong phi , phi dei ban ïabam ïa ki ha khmat U  Trai  ha kata ka jaka mane Blei ba U  Trai  un jied .
Wat shu ïeng hangto ! Leh kyrkieh ! Uta u khynnah u tam ïa u uta khnam bad u wan phai sha la u kynrad ,
translation.en: And Jonathan cried after the lad , Make speed , haste , stay not . And Jonathan s lad gathered up the arrows , and came to his master .

When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens  ; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth : he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum jong u ki um halor ka suiñbneng ki kyrhuh ; u wallam ïa ki lyoh na kiba kut ka khyndew . U pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ha u slap bad u phah ïa ka lyer na ka kamra jingkynshew jong u .

translation.en: Then said the high priest , Are these things so ?
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli ïa u Stephan ,  Hato kane ka dei kaba shisha ?

translation.en: When ye were but few , even a few , and strangers in it .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei ki long khyndiat , ki long ki nongwei ha ka ri Kanaan .
Hato nga patiaw , jingtian —Hebru ba ka bleithaw ne Jerikho jingbam ba la kñia ha ka , ka long bakhadduh ei ?
translation.en: What say I then ? that the idol is any thing , or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing ?
The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : for they repented at the preaching of Jonas  ; and , behold , a greater than Jonas is here .
translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi Bishar ki briew jong ka Ninebeh kin ïeng joit bad mudui ïa phi , namar ki la phai noh na ki pop jong ki haba ki la ïohsngew ba u Jonah u ïalap ; bad nga pynthikna ïa phi ba don uei re uei hangne uba kham khraw ban ïa u Jonah !

translation.en: He hath dispersed , he hath given to the poor  ; his righteousness endureth for ever  ; his horn shall be exalted with honour .
translation.kha: U ai kylluid ïa kiba kyrduh , bad ka jingbhasbun jong u kam ju duh ; un long uba donbor bad uba ïoh burom .

translation.en: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him , Hear now , ye Benjamites  ; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards , and make you all captains of thousands , and captains of hundreds  ;
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u ba la lap ïa u Dabid bad ki nongbud jong u , bad u ong ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ,  Shahshkor , ko rangbah Benjamin ! Hato phi pyrkhat ba u Dabid un ai ïa ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ ha phi baroh , bad ban thung ïa phi ki rangbah nongïalam ha ka kynhun shipai jong u ?
Ngan ïalam ki shah pynïap , kum ki khunblang , ki blang , ki langbrot shynrang . Ma nga , U Trai la kren .
translation.en: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter , like rams with he goats .
Cursed be he that lieth with his sister , the daughter of his father , or the daughter of his mother . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan long ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad la ka para ne bad la ka para ar kmie .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: Sihon king of the Amorites , who dwelt in Heshbon , and ruled from Aroer , which is upon the bank of the river Arnon , and from the middle of the river , and from half Gilead , even unto the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon  ;
translation.kha: Uwei u dei u Sihon , u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Heshbon . Ka hima jong u ka kynthup shiteng jong ka Gilead : naduh Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them Arnon ) bad na ka nongbah kaba hapdeng jong kata ka them , shaduh ka wah Jabbok , ka khappud jong ki Ammon ;
Wat la U Blei u kren bad ïai kren , ym don ïeng pynsngap ïa kaei kaba u ong .
translation.en: For God speaketh once , yea twice , yet man perceiveth it not .
Women received their dead raised to life again : and others were tortured , not accepting deliverance  ; that they might obtain a better resurrection :
translation.kha: Da ka jingngeit , ki kynthei ki la ïohpdiang ïa ki ba-ha-ïing kiba la ïap ïa kiba la pynim pat . Kiwei pat , kiba kyntait ban pdiang ïa ka jinglaitluid , ki la ïap ha ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ khnang ba yn pynmihpat sha ka jingim kaba kham bha .

translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed , and be cut down , and fall  ; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka jia , u snar uba la pynskhem un sa kylluid bad hap . Bad kata kan long ka jingkut jong kiei kiei baroh kiba la sdien ha u .  U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: But I would have you without carefulness . He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord , how he may please the Lord :
translation.kha: Nga da kwah eh ba phin long kiba lait na ka jingkhuslai . U briew u bym shym shongkurim u pyrkhat ïa lade ha ka kam U Trai , namar u wad ban pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .

translation.en: And I knew him not : but he that sent me to baptize with water , the same said unto me , Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending , and remaining on him , the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Ngam pat shym la tip hi ba u dei ma u , hynrei U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga ban pynbaptis da ka um , u la ong ha nga , ‘ Men sa ïohi ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar bad u shongsah ha u briew ; u dei uta , uba pynbaptis da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .’
U u Hathakh leh ïa kane ,
translation.en: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai .
But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix  room : and Felix , willing to shew the Jews a pleasure , left Paul bound .
translation.kha: Hadien , ar snem ki la leit , u Porsius Phestos u la shim ïa ka jaka jong u Pheliks kum u lyngskor . U Pheliks u la kwah ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong ki Jiw , kumta u la iehnoh ïa u Paul ha ka byndi .

translation.en: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness , as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time . Spots they are and blemishes , sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you  ;
translation.kha: Yn sa pynjot ïa ki kum ïa ki mradkhlaw , bad kin hap shah ïa ka jingshahshitom kaba ki la pynlong . Ka jingsngewbha ha ki ka long ban leh ïa kaei kaei ha kaba shai ka sngi ka ban pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai ka doh ; ki long ka jinglehrain bad ka jingjahburom haba ki ïashong bam bad phi , katba ki nang leh sngewbha ha la ki lynti bashukor !
Hynñiew sngi phim dei ban mih na ka Phah ka ïingjaiñ , tat ynda la jakhlia lut ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang .
translation.en: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days , until the days of your consecration be at an end : for seven days shall he consecrate you .

translation.kha: U sha phang haduh Gath Hepher Ethkasin , da ha ka liang jong ka Neah ha ka lynti Rimmon .
translation.en: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gath–hepher , to Eth–kazin , and goeth out to Rimmon–methoar to Neah  ;

translation.kha: kaba wai noh , ko parabangeit jong ngi , phi la ïohnang na ngi kumno dei ban khnang ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei . Kane ka long da shisha , kumno phi la ju im . Bad mynta ngi kyrpad bad kyntu ïa ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu ban leh kham bha shuh .
translation.en: Furthermore then we beseech you , brethren , and exhort you by the Lord Jesus , that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God , so ye would abound more and more .

translation.kha: To shahshkor , ma phi baroh ïa , ka sur ka jong U Blei , ïa u pyrthat uba mih na ka shyntur jong u .
translation.en: Hear attentively the noise of his voice , and the sound that goeth out of his mouth .
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ :
translation.kha: To ngin ai ki jingnguh sha U Blei bad U Kpa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi! Naba ha U Khrist , u la kyrkhu ïa ngi da kaba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynsiem baroh ha ka pyrthei kaba kynja bneng .
U tei ruh ïa ki jaka mane blei ha kaba ki tnga nongwei jong u baroh kin ïoh thang ki ïa jingiwbih bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha ki blei jong . ki
translation.en: And likewise did he for all his strange wives , which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods .

translation.kha: jingkordit Ka kaba nyngkong ka la kut ; hadien kane ka don sa ar tylli ki jingkordit ki ban wan .
translation.en: One woe is past  ; and , behold , there come two woes more hereafter .

But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath , he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , the Chaldean , who destroyed this house , and carried the people away into Babylon .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pynbitar ïa U Blei ka Bneng , u la shah ba yn jop noh ïa ki da u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilonia , u syiem na ka longïing syiem Khaldi . Ïa ka Templ la pynjot bad ïa ki briew la ringmraw sha Babilonia .

translation.en: Pilate saith unto them , What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ ? They all say unto him , Let him be crucified .
translation.kha: Kaei , te , ngan leh ïa U Jisu uba la khot U Messaïah ?   Sahnarphna ïa u !  Baroh ki la jubab .
jingpynpur , phi ki briew jong ki main baroh ! Pahath ïalumlang bad to Nabynta . ryñiot ba ka pyrthei baroh Aner nangta uwei pa uwei uba shong ha ka un wan hangne Aijalon shahshkor .
translation.en: Come near , ye nations , to hear  ; and hearken , ye people : let the earth hear , and all that is therein  ; the world , and all things that come forth of it .

translation.kha: Nga . sngewkmen
translation.en: I am happy .

And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi , Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land , among the Canaanites and the Perizzites : and I being few in number , they shall gather themselves together against me , and slay me  ; and I shall be destroyed , I and my house .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong ha u Simeon bad ha u Lebi ,  Phi la pynjynjar ïa nga ; ki Kanaan bad ki Peris , bad kat kiba don ha kane ka ri , mynta kin sa shun ïa nga . Ngam dei uba bun paid ; lada ki ïa-tylli lang kawei pyrshah ïa nga , bad ki ïaleh ïa nga , ma nga bad ka ïing jong nga baroh ngin sa shah pynjot .

translation.en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years , and bear your whoredoms , until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki kti jong phi kin ïaid sakma ha kane ka ri khlaw sawphew snem , kin shitom namar kata ka jingbymïaineh jong phi , tad haduh ba uba khatduh eh napdeng jong phi un ïap .
Nga duwai ba ki baroh kin ïalong kawei . Ko Pa ! ai ba kin ïalong ngi , kumba me long ha nga ma nga ha . To ai kin ïalong kawei , khnang ba ka pyrthei kan ngeit ba la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: That they all may be one  ; as thou , Father , art in me , and I in thee , that they also may be one in us : that the world may believe that thou hast sent me .

And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the  Lord  , and hast not kept the commandment which the  Lord  thy God commanded thee ,
translation.kha: bad u la kren jam ha u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah ,  U  Trai  u ong ba phi la lyndet ïa ka ktien U  Trai  , bad phim shym la leh kumba u la hukum ïa phi .
Ngan ïa u lyngdoh u ban kohnguh ïa nga bad leh ïa kata baroh kaba nga kwah ïa u . Ngan ai u ki khun ki ksiew ki shakri khmat u uba la jied jong .
translation.en: And I will raise me up a faithful priest , that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind : and I will build him a sure house  ; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever .

translation.kha: Mynta , shaphang u Apollos u parabangeit nga la ju pynshlur ïa u jngoh ïa phi ryngkat bad kiwei ki , hynrei um da mon eh wan ha kane ka por . Pynban , ynda u ïa ka lad , sa wan .
translation.en: As touching our brother Apollos , I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren : but his will was not at all to come at this time ; but he will come when he shall have convenient time .

translation.kha: Ka jingsarong jong pha ka la shukor ïa juti . Ka nongbah jong pha ka sang ka kut mawsiang baskhem ; ka ïing jong pha namsop don ha kliar ki lumbah , bad kumta Teresh jingsuh ha lade , ‘ Uei uba ba-mynshuwa Pasakh pynhiar ïa nga sha tbian ?’
translation.en: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee , thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , whose habitation is high  ; that saith in his heart , Who shall bring me down to the ground ?
He turneth the wilderness into a standing water , and dry ground into watersprings .
translation.kha: U pynkylla ki pung-um ïa ki ri shyiap bad pynmih umpohliew ha ki jaka ba-rkhiang .
Bad u Dabid ruh u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u ban Ishbosheth ong , Ai noh ha nga ïa ka Mikhal ka tnga nga jong Nga . la siew shispah tylli ki doh otsher jong ki Philistia ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: And David sent messengers to Ish–bosheth Saul s son , saying , Deliver me my wife Michal , which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines .
Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons  ; and now the  Lord  thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude .
translation.kha: Mynba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki leit sha Ijipt , ki ïadon baroh tang hynñiewphew ngut ; hynrei mynta U Blei u la pynroi ïa phi kat ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng .

skhep Lebi mynta ki long ki Ahishar nga pep Mynba nga jingshahslem pynïap Synagog u khun nyngkong ba-mynbarim jong ki nong Ijipt , nga la pynkyntang kum la u jong ïa u khun nyngkong na kawei pa kawei ka ïing Israel bad ïa uba la kha durkhmat riewsaid uwei pa uwei u mrad . Mynta jingtian nga ïoh noh Jephunneh ki Lebi kum la ki jong ha ka jaka ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong thai Israel Sabad ki kin long ki jong nga . Nga long jingseisoh jinglute .
translation.en: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar , and spread a purple cloth thereon :
Labour not to be rich : cease from thine own wisdom .
translation.kha: To long uba stad bha ym ban ym pyrshang ban pynpaw ïa lade ban ïoh spah .

translation.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host : and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests :
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai : U Benaïah , u khun jong u Jehoïada Ki lyngdoh : U Sadok bad u Abiathar

U Trai mane Pla leh kumjuh na ka bynta ïaryntih liewlong , ki khun ki ksiew Ruphos Iso , kiba shong jingïaleh-sngewbha ri lum Edom . U pynjot thup ki Hor , kumta ki Edom ki ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki Hangne ha-ei shongsah basang haduh mynta .
translation.en: As he did to the children of Esau , which dwelt in Seir , when he destroyed the Horims from before them  ; and they succeeded them , and dwelt in their stead even unto this day :
For we know him that hath said , Vengeance belongeth unto me , I will recompense , saith the Lord . And again , The Lord shall judge his people .
translation.kha: Namar ngi tip uei uta uba la ong ,  Ngan sa pynhiarkput , ngan siew kylliang ;  bad uba la ong ruh ,  U Trai un bishar ïa la ki briew .
Wat khum ïa ka shyntur u masi dab haba dkut pyndonkam ïa u ha kaba shoh kew .
translation.en: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn .
Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me : and , behold , the Lord  God  called to contend by fire , and it devoured the great deep , and did eat up a part .
translation.kha: Nga la ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U  Trai  Nongsynshar . Ha ka , nga la ïohi ïa u ba u dang pynkhreh ban pynshitom ïa ki briew jong u da ka ding . Ka ding ka la thang lut ïa ka duriaw-bah bakhraw hapoh ka sla pyrthei , bad ka la sdang ban bam duh ïa ka khyndew .

translation.en: And if a kingdom be divided against itself , that kingdom cannot stand .
translation.kha: Lada ka ri ka phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh pyrshah para ma ki , kata ka ri kan kyllon noh .

translation.en: And a certain man found him , and , behold , he was wandering in the field : and the man asked him , saying , What seekest thou ?

We have given the hand to the Egyptians , and to the Assyrians , to be satisfied with bread .
translation.kha: Ban ïoh jingbam kaba biang ban im , ngi la leit khrong sha Ijipt bad Assyria .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh , and they did so as the  Lord  had commanded : and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh , and before his servants , and it became a serpent .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha u Pharaoh bad ki leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . U Aaron u bret ïa la u diengduh ha khmat u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , bad u kylla bseiñ .
U Trai u ïathuh ha u Moses , ban ong ha ki kynhun Israel ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
And when he looked behind him , he saw me , and called unto me . And I answered , Here am I .
translation.kha: Nangta u phai sawdong , u la ïohi ïa nga , bad u la khot ïa nga . Nga jubab , ‘ Ho-oid , Kynrad !’

translation.en: Now is the judgment of this world : now shall the prince of this world be cast out .
translation.kha: Mynta ka dei ka por ba ïa kane ka pyrthei yn bishar ; mynta ïa u nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei yn pynhiar khet .

translation.en: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed , and sang praises unto God : and the prisoners heard them .
translation.kha: Kumba shiteng synñia , u Paul bad u Silas ki dang duwai bad rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh ïa U Blei bad kiwei pat ki koidi ki dang shahshkor ïa ki .

translation.en: Yes , I love you .
translation.kha: Haoid Nga ieid ia phi .

translation.en: For I came down from heaven , not to do mine own will , but the will of him that sent me .
translation.kha: Uno uno ïa uba U Kpa jong nga u ai ha nga un wan sha nga . Ngan ym kyntait ïa uno uno uba wan sha nga , namar nga la wan hiar na bneng ban leh ym ïa ka mon ka jong nga hynrei ïa ka mon jong uta uba la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon : and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men  ; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom , and slew two thousand men of them .
translation.kha: Kiba sah ki phai bad phet ïap shaphang ri khlaw sha u Mawsiang Rimmon . San hajar ngut na kita ki shah pynïap ha lynti bah . Ki Israel ki ïai beh ïa kiba dang sah haduh Gidom , ki da pynïap ar hajar ngut na kita .

translation.en: And the children of the Kenite , Moses  father in law , went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah , which lieth in the south of Arad  ; and they went and dwelt among the people .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u kthaw kurim u Moses , na ka jait Ken , ki la leit ryngkat bad u paid Judah na Jerikho , ka nongbah ki dieng Tlai , sha ka ri shrah ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Arad ha Judah . Ki shongduh hangta hapdeng ki Amalek .

translation.en: And I answered , Who art thou , Lord ? And he said unto me ,  I am Jesus of Nazareth , whom thou persecutest .
translation.kha: ‘ Me dei uei , A Trai ?’ nga la kylli . ‘ Nga long U Jisu uba na Nasareth , ïa uba me pynshitom beiñ ,’ u la ong ha nga .
Bad Absalom u la ïa Amnon haduh katta namar ka jingbatbor Tamar , ka para jong kat haduh ba um mon shuh ban kren ïa u
translation.en: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad : for Absalom hated Amnon , because he had forced his sister Tamar .
Notwithstanding ye would not go up , but rebelled against the commandment of the  Lord  your God :
translation.kha: Hynrei phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad phim treh ban leit rung sha kata ka ri .

translation.en: And when the woman saw that she was not hid , she came trembling , and falling down before him , she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him , and how she was healed immediately .
translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka la ïohi ba la lap ïa ka , kumta ka la wan da kaba khynñiuh bad ka dem khrup ha ki kjat jong U Jisu . Hangta ha khmat jong uwei pa uwei baroh , ka la ïathuh ïa u balei ba ka la ktah ïa u bad kumno ba la pynkhiah ïa ka shisyndon .
U syiem u la kyndit thiah u bad sngewthuh ba u la phohsniew .
translation.en: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears . And Pharaoh awoke , and , behold , it was a dream .

Therefore , thou son of man , say unto the children of thy people , The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression : as for the wickedness of the wicked , he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness  ; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , ïathuh ha ki Israel ba haba u briew babha u leh pop , ka jingleh babha ba u leh kam lah ban pynim ïa u . Lada u briew basniew , u sangeh kaba leh bymman , yn ym pynshitom ïa u , bad lada u briew babha u sdang ban leh pop , ïa ka jingim jong u yn ym pynsah .

translation.en: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine , and men of strength to mingle strong drink :
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Ki nongjop ïa ki klong waiñ ! Kiba shlur bad ki bym tieng ha kaba ïadei bad ki jingdih ba la khleh !

Naba ïa ki nongsynshar ym dei lei sheptieng da kito kiba leh ïa kaba bha , hynrei paila kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew . Hato phi kwah ban long u bymsheptieng ïa u jingpyntngen uba don ha ka bor ? Te Jehobah leh ïa jongka kaba bha Pynbiang bad un ïaroh ïa phi ,
translation.en: For rulers are not a terror to good works , but to the evil . Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power ? do that which is good , and thou shalt have praise of the same :
Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul , that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth .
translation.kha: Nalorkata Nga ñiew ïa U Blei kum u sakhi jong nga — u tip ïa ka dohnud jong nga ! Ka long na ka bynta ban ïada ïa phi ba nga la rai ban ym leit sha Korinth .
Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong , Hato tip me ba la pynmong ïa ki jingsngew jong ki Pharisi da kaei kaba la me ong ?
translation.en: Then came his disciples , and said unto him , Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended , after they heard this saying ?

translation.kha: To sumar bha , te , ba kaei kaba ki ki la ong kan ym jia phi
translation.en: Beware therefore , lest that come upon you , which is spoken of in the prophets  ;
Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts , that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering  ; but for a vow it shall not be accepted .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban kñia ainguh ïa u jingri uba raid lane u bym shong beit ka met ka phad kum ka jingainguh sngewbha , hynrei yn ym pdiang ïa u haba pyndep ïa kano kano ka jingkular .

translation.en: Who shall offer it before the  Lord  , and make an atonement for her  ; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood . This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un kñia ïa ka jingainguh jong ka ha U  Trai  bad un pynlong ka jinglehniam ban shim noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka ; bad kan sa long kaba la pynkhuid . Kane ka long kaba ka kynthei ka dei ban leh hadien ba kha khun .

translation.en: And the king said unto Hazael , Take a present in thine hand , and go , meet the man of God , and enquire of the  Lord  by him , saying , Shall I recover of this disease ?
translation.kha: u la ong ha u Hasael , uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Khie leit rah ka jingai sngewbha ïa u nongïathuhlypa , bad kyrpad ïa u ban kylli na U  Trai  la ngan koit biang ne em .

translation.en: Sihon king of the Amorites : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: ïa u Sihon , u syiem ki Amor ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: And being not weak in faith , he considered not his own body now dead , when he was about an hundred years old , neither yet the deadness of Sara s womb :
translation.kha: Bad da kaba khlem tlot jingngeit , u um shim hi ba kamet jongu mynta ka la iap , ha ka por ba u la dap shispah snem ka rta , lane ïa ka plakhun jong ka Sarah .

translation.en: Ye shall have one manner of law , as well for the stranger , as for one of your own country : for I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Kane ka hukum ka teh ïa phi baroh , ïa ki Israel bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong hapdeng jong phi , naba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

Hynrei lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima kam pyndem ha ka jingsynshar u jong , te ngan pynshitom ïa kata ka jaitbynriew ka da thma , ka jingïapthngan bad da ka jingpang tad ba haduh ngan da shah ïa u Nebukhadnessar ban pynjot khoit ïa ka .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon , that nation will I punish , saith the  Lord  , with the sword , and with the famine , and with the pestilence , until I have consumed them by his hand .
And one kid of the goats , to make an atonement for you .
translation.kha: Kñia ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ha kane ka rukom pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ïa u paidbah .
Ki rangbah kiba u Moses u la swar ïa ka ri , ki la wanrah ïa balamler kaba la pynlong u paidbah ban khñium pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And the men , which Moses sent to search the land , who returned , and made all the congregation to murmur against him , by bringing up a slander upon the land ,

translation.kha: Kam metïap rung ha ki jingmut jong ki ba ngan kynmaw ïathuh ïawer jew kam sniew baroh boi Babbai ki pop jong ki , ki ker sawdong ïa ki , bad jingblei Shishak khlem da pynïashong uno ki .
translation.en: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness : now their own doings have beset them about  ; they are before my face .
Yea , his soul draweth near unto the grave , and his life to the destroyers .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong u mynta ka sdang ban leit noh sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand ? will Saul come down , as thy servant hath heard ? O  Lord  God of Israel , I beseech thee , tell thy servant . And the  Lord  said , He will come down .
translation.kha: Hato ki nongshong shnong jong ka Keilah kin aiti ïa nga ha u Saul ? Hato u Saul un wan shisha , kumba nga la ïohsngew ? Ko  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga kyrpad ïa me ban jubab ïa nga !  U  Trai  u jubab ,  U Saul un wan .

translation.en: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them , and make merry , and shall send gifts one to another  ; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka pyrthei kin ïakmen namar ka jingïap jong kine ki ar ngut . Kin ïalehkmen bad kin ïa-ai jingai sngewbha markylliang , namar ba kita ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la wallam shibun ki jingshitom halor u bynriew .
Nga long ka Jingstad , bad nga don ka bor sngewthuh ; nga don ka jingtip ka bad bor pyrkhat kaba khlaiñ .
translation.en: I wisdom dwell with prudence , and find out knowledge of witty inventions .
Now a mediator is not a mediator of one , but God is one .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa u ksiang ym donkam haba treikam tang uwei u briew ; bad U Blei u long uwei .

translation.en: But it came to pass , when Ahab was dead , that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Ahab u syiem Israel u la ïap , u Mesha u ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
ka kumta mareh stet sha u , bad ka ong , Ha khmih ! U briew uba la wan sha nga ha kato ka u sngi wanpaw biang ha nga .
translation.en: And the woman made haste , and ran , and shewed her husband , and said unto him , Behold , the man hath appeared unto me , that came unto me the other day .
Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah the second time , while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison , saying ,
translation.kha: Katba nga dang don hi ha ka ïingbyndi ha ka phyllaw , ka khubor U  Trai  ka la wan biang ha nga .

translation.en: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images : and the kingdom was quiet before him .
translation.kha: Namar ba u pynduh noh ïa ki jaka mane blei thala bad ki duwan jingiwbih na baroh ki nongbah jong ka Judah , ka hima ka don ha ka jingsuk hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u .

translation.en: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant , saying , When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan , ye shall stand still in Jordan .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ba ynda ki poi ha ka wah , ki dei ban ïaid ha ki um bad ban ïeng hajan ka rudwah .

translation.en: Take the girdle that thou hast got , which is upon thy loins , and arise , go to Euphrates , and hide it there in a hole of the rock .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka Wah Ïuphratis bad buhrieh ïa ki patlun lyngkot hapoh ka thliew ha ki mawsiang .

Ïa ka jingjied jong u la nongshoh-nar nongrim ha ka jingaiei jong Busi , ym ha kaei kaba ki la leh . Namar lada ïa ka jingjied U Blei la pynshong nongrim Asshur kaei kaba ki briew ‘Phim leh , te ka jingaiei jingumsnam u kan ym long ka jingaiei kali .
translation.en: And if by grace , then is it no more of works : otherwise grace is no more grace . But if it be of works , then is it no more grace : otherwise work is no more work .

There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man : but God is faithful , who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able ; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape , that ye may be able to bear it .
translation.kha: Man la ka jingtynjuh kaba phi la mad ka long kata kaba ju wan ha ki briew . Hynrei U Blei u long uba bat ïa la ka kular , bad un ym shah ban tynjuh ïa phi sha palat ka bor jong phi ba phin ïoh ïaineh skhem ; ha ka por ba phi shah tynjuh , un ai ha phi ïa ka bor ba phi lah ban shah ïa ka , bad kumta un thaw ïa ka lad ba phi lah ban lait na ka .

translation.en: And they killed the passover , and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands , and the Levites flayed them .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang , ki Lebi ki khoh snieh ïa ki , bad ki lyngdoh ki synreit snam ha ka duwan .
Nangta ki her noh kum ka lyer bad ki jah syndon , kine ki briew kiba ka bor ka long u blei jong . ki
translation.en: Then shall his mind change , and he shall pass over , and offend , imputing this his power unto his god .

translation.kha: katno A ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad Pharisi ki ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi long kum ki jingtep ba la pushara lieh , kiba itynnat ha kaba shabar kiba hynrei dap da ki shyieng bad ki metïap bapyut ha kaba shapoh .
translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres , which indeed appear beautiful outward , but are within full of dead men s bones , and of all uncleanness .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngi ïohi ka long kum ka dur kaba byrngut ha ka ïitkhmih ; nangta ngin sa ïohi markhmat . kaba nga tip mynta ka long tang katto katne ; nangta kan sa kaba pura pura kum jingtip jong U ïa nga .
translation.en: For now we see through a glass , darkly ; but then face to face : now I know in part ; but then shall I know even as also I am known .

translation.kha: ïa Trai U Blei jong phi da kaba phi rakhe hynñiew sngi ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam kata ka jaka mane Blei . To lehkmen , namar U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa baroh ba phi la ïoh ot bad ïa ka phi baroh .
translation.en: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the  Lord  thy God in the place which the  Lord  shall choose : because the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase , and in all the works of thine hands , therefore thou shalt surely rejoice .
Forbear to cry , make no mourning for the dead , bind the tire of thine head upon thee , and put on thy shoes upon thy feet , and cover not thy lips , and eat not the bread of men .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba yn pynsngew ïa ki jingïam jong pha . Wat leit kumto khlem tapkhlieh lane khlem jingsopkjat kum ka dak jong ka jingïam pangnud . Wat tap ïa la ka khmat lane bam ïa ka jingbam kaba ki nongïam pangnud ki bam .
Kumta la phah khot ki briew kiba pang ha baroh ki jaka sawdong ka bad ki wallam ïa ki sha U Jisu .
translation.en: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him , they sent out into all that country round about , and brought unto him all that were diseased  ;
And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim , and were sojourners there until this day . )
translation.kha: Ki traishnong jong ka ki la phet sha Gittaim , ha kaba ki la shong la sah naduh kata ka por . )

translation.en: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel :
translation.kha: U Moses u ai ïa ki hukum bad ki jinghikai jong U Blei ha ki Israel .

translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families , the cities and their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Naphtali ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: So Jonah went out of the city , and sat on the east side of the city , and there made him a booth , and sat under it in the shadow , till he might see what would become of the city .
translation.kha: U Jonah u la mih bad leit shaphang mihngi jong ka nongbah bad u la shong hangta . U la shna ka jakarieh tngen ïa lade bad shong ha ka syrngiew jong ka , da kaba ap ban khmih kaei ka ban jia ïa ka Ninebeh .
U jingstad u isih baher ki briew kiba shukor .
translation.en: For all that do such things , and all that do unrighteously , are an abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .
Though thou , Israel , play the harlot , yet let not Judah offend  ; and come not ye unto Gilgal , neither go ye up to Beth–aven , nor swear , The  Lord  liveth .
translation.kha: Wat lada phi ki briew ka Israel phim ïaineh ha nga , ai ba ki Judah kin ym ngop ha kijuh ki jingleh pop . Wat leit mane sha Gilgal lane sha Bethaben , lane pynlong ki jingïateh kular ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  uba im .

translation.en: And they that passed by railed on him , wagging their heads , and saying , Ah , thou that destroyest the temple , and buildest it in three days ,
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ïaid nangta ki la kyrngah ïa la ki khlieh bad krenbeiñ ïa U Jisu :  Ade ! men pynjot ïa ka Templ bad tei pat ïa ka hapoh lai sngi !
U Judah u ong ha la u kpa , Phah ïa u para bad nga , bad ngin kumne ïamihnoh kumne Te . yn ym don uwei ruh na ngi u ban ïapthngan .
translation.en: And Judah said unto Israel his father , Send the lad with me , and we will arise and go  ; that we may live , and not die , both we , and thou , and also our little ones .

Moreover , thou son of man , take thee one stick , and write upon it , For Judah , and for the children of Israel his companions : then take another stick , and write upon it , For Joseph , the stick of Ephraim , and for all the house of Israel his companions :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  shim ïa u lyngkhot dieng bad thoh ha u ïa ki ktien ‘ Ka Hima Judah .’ Nangta shim sa uwei pat u lyngkhot dieng bad thoh ha u ïa kine ki ktien : ‘ Ka Hima Israel .’

Ki ai ïa kata ka khlieh ha u Syiem Dabid ha Hebron , bad ki ong ha , Kane hangne ka dei ka khlieh , khun u Saul , u nongshun jong phi , uba la pyrshang ban ïa phi Ha ka sngi U Trai u la shah ïa u Syiem Kynrad ban pynhiarkput u ki khun jong u .
translation.en: And they brought the head of Ish–bosheth unto David to Hebron , and said to the king , Behold the head of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul thine enemy , which sought thy life  ; and the  Lord  hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul , and of his seed .
Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded .
translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh ïa ki shynrang ba dang kham samla to kyntu jur ïa ki ban synshar bha ïa lade .

translation.en: And he drank of the wine , and was drunken  ; and he was uncovered within his tent .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la dih khyndiat ka waiñ , u la buaid , u law ïa la ki jaiñ bad u thiah lyngkhuit hapoh la ka ïingjaiñ .
Shahshkor ! ong U Jisu . Nga wan kloi ! Ngan wallam ïa ki bainong jong nga , ban ai ha sa pa uwei kat kum kaei kaba u la leh .
translation.en: And , behold , I come quickly  ; and my reward is with me , to give every man according as his work shall be .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go on before the people , and take with thee of the elders of Israel  ; and thy rod , wherewith thou smotest the river , take in thine hand , and go .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ïalam bad me katto katne ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad leit sha shuwa jong u paidbah . Rah ruh ïa u diengduh da uba me la shoh ïa ka wah Nile .
Ki sbiak ha ki ïa ka jinglaitluid katba ma ki , ki long ki mraw jong ki jingmlien bapynjot — naba u briew u long u mraw ha bamatlah kano kaba jop halor u .
translation.en: While they promise them liberty , they themselves are the servants of corruption : for of whom a man is overcome , of the same is he brought in bondage .

translation.kha: Kumba U Trai u la don riang bad u Syiem jingïashongkha , sloit ruh ai un don ryngkat jingsngewshngain u Solomon , bad pynlong ïa ka jingsynshar :27-30 u kaba kham roi ban ïa ka jong phi :27-29
translation.en: As the  Lord  hath been with my lord the king , even so be he with Solomon , and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David .

translation.kha: ban wallam ïa ka jingbishar ha baroh , ban pynrem ïa ki baroh ka na bynta ki kam bymriewblei ba ki la leh bad na ka bynta ki ktien ba sngewtriem kiba ki nongpop ba khlem blei ki la pyrshah kren ïa ! u
translation.en: To execute judgment upon all , and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed , and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him .
And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years , and begat Lamech :
translation.kha: Haba u Methuselah u la dap shispah phraphew hynñiew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Lamekh ,

Jin khubor shaphang U Khrist ka la shong skhem ha phi kat Blei’ ba phim shym duh noh rymmiang pdiang wat tang ïa kawei ka jingkyrkhu khum katba phi dang ap khmih suit ba yn pynpaw ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong satang .
translation.en: So that ye come behind in no gift ; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ :

translation.kha: Haba u la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u wan la na Judia sha Galilaïa , u la leit sha u bad kyrpad ïa ban u leit sha Kapernam ban bad pynkhiah ïa u khun jong u , uba don ha tmier ka jingïap .
translation.en: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee , he went unto him , and besought him that he would come down , and heal his son : for he was at the point of death .

Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the  Lord  , in the courts , and in the chambers , and in the purifying of all holy things , and the work of the service of the house of God  ;
translation.kha: bad la shaniah ha ki ïa kine ki kam : ban ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron bad ïa ka jingmane ha ka Templ , ban sumar ïa ki phyllaw bad ïa ki kamra jong ka , bad ban sumar khuid ïa kata baroh kaba kyntang ;
Namarkata kiba Jied jong Jingpynim pyrthei ki long Melataïah uta uba riewrunar thaw na ka dewmet ; kito kiba dei jong ka bneng ki long kum uta Jehudi la wan na bneng .
translation.en: As is the earthy , such are they also that are earthy : and as is the heavenly , such are they also that are heavenly .

U synran ïa uba U Jisu ieit u u la ong ha u Petros , U dei U Trai ! Haba Petros u u la ïohsngew ba dei U Trai , tap u da ka jaiñ ïa la ka met ( naba la u loit noh ïa la ki jaiñphong ) bad u la ryngkoh shapoh um .
translation.en: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter , It is the Lord . Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord , he girt his fisher s coat unto him , ( for he was naked , ) and did cast himself into the sea .
For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound , who shall prepare himself to the battle ?

nong Ki Moab ki ong ki ha nongïalam jong ki Midian , Kane ka kynhun shen kan sa pynjot ïa kaei kaei kaba baroh don sawdong jong ngi , kum u masi uba bam phlang ha ka pyntha phlang .
translation.en: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian , Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us , as the ox licketh up the grass of the field . And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time .

translation.en: He esteemeth iron as straw , and brass as rotten wood .
Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia , they came to Thessalonica , where was a synagogue of the Jews :
translation.kha: U Paul bad u Silas ki la leit lyngba ka Amphipolis bad ka Apollonia , bad ki la wan poi sha Thessaloni , ha kaba la don ka synagog .
Nangta nga la ïa buh ki khuri bad ki pliang ba la dap waiñ ha khmat ki Rekhab , bad nga ong ïa , ki To dih waiñ khyndiat .
translation.en: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine , and cups , and I said unto them , Drink ye wine .
Then said Micah , Now know I that the  Lord  will do me good , seeing I have a Levite to my priest .
translation.kha: U Mikah u ong ,  Mynta ba nga la don u Lebi kum u lyngdoh jong nga , nga tip ba U  Trai  un sa pynmanbha ïa nga .
Jisu U u la ïam .
translation.en: Jesus wept .

translation.kha: Beelsebul ngim shym la pyntud katne katne , ngin kumto da 29-35 wan phai kylla ar sien .
translation.en: For except we had lingered , surely now we had returned this second time .
And now , behold , I know that ye all , among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God , shall see my face no more .
translation.kha: Nga la ïaid kylleng hapdeng jong phi baroh , da kaba ïalap ïa ka Hima U Blei . Bad mynta nga tip ba ym don mano mano na phi ki ban dang ïohi shuh ïa nga .
Pynthikna ba ka jingïaishah jong phi rah ka ïa phi artet ka lynti khlem da hap noh , khnang ba phin long kiba janai bad kiba dap pura khlem , jingduna ei ei .
translation.en: But let patience have her perfect work , that ye may be perfect and entire , wanting nothing .
Nay , my lord , hear me : the field give I thee , and the cave that is therein , I give it thee  ; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee : bury thy dead .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko rangbah , ngan ai ha phi ïa ka lyngkha baroh kawei , bad ïa kata ka krem kaba don hangta . Hangne ha ka jingdon ryngkat ki para jait jong nga , ngan ai ïa ka ha phi khnang ba phin ïoh tep ïa la ka tnga .
Nga pyrshah ïa kito Shema nongïathuhlypa kiba shim ktien uwei na uwei bad ïakular ïa ki kum ka keiñ! jong nga .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , I am against the prophets , saith the  Lord  , that steal my words every one from his neighbour .
And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up , for to shew in thee my power  ; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth .
translation.kha: Hynrei ban pyn-i ha me ïa ka bor jong nga , nga la shah ba men dang im , khnang ba yn ïoh pynbna ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
Ngan pynkhlaiñbor lang bad phi .
translation.en: I shall come with you .

translation.kha: U ïa kane ban pynpaw ha ki por baroh ki ban sa wan ïa ka jingkhraw tam eh ka jong u ka jingieit ïa kaba pyn-i sha ngi ha Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus .
For how shall I go up to my father , and the lad be not with me ? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father .
translation.kha: Kumno keiñ nga lah ban leit phai sha i pa lada u para um don ryngkat bad nga ? Ngan ym lah shah ban ïohi kum ïa kata ka apot ba kan wan jia ha i pa .

translation.en: And they returned to Joshua , and said unto him , Let not all the people go up  ; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai  ; and make not all the people to labour thither  ; for they are but few .
translation.kha: ki wan ïathuh ha u Joshua ,  Ym da donkam ba baroh kin leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Ai . Phah tang kumba ar ne lai hajar ngut ki rangbah . Wat phah ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei ban leit ïaleh ; kam dei ka shnong kaba heh .

translation.en: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked : judgment and justice take hold on thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa phi la pynshitom kumba phi dei ban ïoh .
Hynrei ngan pyllait ka ïa ri Goshen , ha kaba ki briew jong nga ki shong , kumta ba yn don ym skain hangta . Ngan leh ïa kane ba men tip ba nga U Trai nga trei ha kane ka ri .
translation.en: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen , in which my people dwell , that no swarms of flies shall be there  ; to the end thou mayest know that I am the  Lord  in the midst of the earth .
And David said unto Gad , I am in a great strait : let me fall now into the hand of the  Lord   ; for very great are his mercies : but let me not fall into the hand of man .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ïa u Gad ,  Nga don ha ka khim khait ! Hynrei ngam kwah ba yn pynshitom ïa nga da ki briew . Ai ba U  Trai  da lade hi un long uta u ban pynshitom ïa nga , namar u long uba dap da ka jingisynei .

translation.en: But Jesus called them unto him , and said ,  Suffer little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: hynrei , U Jisu u la khot ïa ki khynnah sha u bad u la ong ,  Shah ïa ki khynnah ban wan sha nga bad wat khang ïa ki , namar ka Hima U Blei ka long ïa kiba kum kine .

translation.en: O Jerusalem , Jerusalem , thou that killest the prophets , and stonest them which are sent unto thee , how often would I have gathered thy children together , even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings , and ye would not !
translation.kha: A Jerusalem , Jerusalem ! Pha pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bad lynthem maw ïa ki nonglamktien kiba U Blei u la phah ha pha ! Katno sien nga la kwah ban kdup ha ki ksang ti jong nga ïa ki briew jong pha baroh , kumba ka syiar ka lumlang ïa la ki khun hapoh ki thapniang jong ka , hynrei pham shym la shah ïa nga .

translation.en: And straightway his ears were opened , and the string of his tongue was loosed , and he spake plain .
translation.kha: Shisyndon uta u briew u la lah ban ïohsngew , bad la weng noh ïa kata kaba teh ïa ka jinglah kren jong u , bad u la sdang ban kren khlem kano kano ka jingeh .
Ki briew jong U Blei kin lait na ki jingkhuslai , bad ïing ki jong ki kin suk bad kin shngain .
translation.en: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation , and in sure dwellings , and in quiet resting places  ;

translation.kha: U Terah u shim ïa u Abram u khun jong u , ïa u Lot u ksiew jong u uba , long u khun jong u Haran , bad ïa ka pyrsa kurim jong u ka , Sarai ka tnga jong u Abram , bad ki ïamih lang noh na ka shnong Ur kaba ha ka ri Babilonia ban leit sha ka ri Kanaan . Ki la haduh leit ha Haran bad ki la ïashong ïasah noh hangta .
translation.en: And Terah took Abram his son , and Lot the son of Haran his son s son , and Sarai his daughter in law , his son Abram s wife  ; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldeans , to go into the land of Canaan  ; and they came unto Haran , and dwelt there .

translation.kha: U Trai u khmih sumar ïa kiba kohnguh , ïa kito kiba shaniah ha ka jingieit baneh jong u ,
translation.en: Behold , the eye of the  Lord  is upon them that fear him , upon them that hope in his mercy  ;
And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house , which stood and said unto him , Send men to Joppa , and call for Simon , whose surname is Peter  ;
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ïa ngi kumno ba u la ïohi ïa u angel uba ïeng ha ka ïing jong u , bad uba la ong ha u , ‘ Phah ïano ïano sha Joppa bad leit shem ïa u briew uba ka kyrteng pura ka long u Simon Petros .

translation.en: And I took your sin , the calf which ye had made , and burnt it with fire , and stamped it , and ground it very small , even until it was as small as dust : and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount .
translation.kha: Nga shim ïa kata kaei kaei kaba long hi ka pop — kata ka dur khun masi keiñ kaba phi la thaw bad nga bret ïa ka ha ka ding . Nangta nga pynpait pharia ïa ka , nga tylliat ni ïa ka haduh ba kan da long kum u pui pui , bad nga bret ïa kata ha ka wah kaba tuid na uta u lum .
rkhiebeiñ shadem jong phi kan pynjakhlia khup ka moi kat ïa nongïam phi ïohi . Man ka step phin slap —kata kan wan shaw ka janmiet ; man ka Lebanon rynsan phin kwah ba ap wan Epainetos ka step .
translation.en: In the morning thou shalt say , Would God it were even ! and at even thou shalt say , Would God it were morning ! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear , and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see .

translation.kha: Te , ka lada jingbthuh ka paw biang , ka mut ba ka la pur wan biang , bad u trai u dei ban thang noh ïa ka .
translation.en: And if it appear still in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ; it is a spreading plague : thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire .

translation.en: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king , he removed her from being queen , because she had made an idol in a grove : and Asa cut down her idol , and stamped it , and burnt it at the brook Kidron .
For the  Lord  shall rise up as in mount Perazim , he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon , that he may do his work , his strange work  ; and bring to pass his act , his strange act .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ïaleh kumba u la leh ha u lum Perasim bad ha ka them Gibeon , khnang ba un leh ïa kaei kaba u thmu ban leh — wat la ki jingleh jong u kin long kum kiba ikhyllah . Un pyndep ïa ka kam jong u baroh , ka kam bamaïan jong u .

translation.en: Then say thou , Thus saith the Lord  God  , The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it , that her time may come , and maketh idols against herself to defile herself .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ka nongbah ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Namar ba pha la pynïap ïa kiba bun ki briew la jong bad pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw , ka por jong pha ka la poi .

translation.en: And Tyre did build herself a strong hold , and heaped up silver as the dust , and fine gold as the mire of the streets .
translation.kha: Ka Tyros ka la tei ki kut na ka bynta ïa lade bad ka la kynton shibun eh ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka la kynrei kum ka tngit .

translation.en: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers , and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury .

translation.en: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant , and of thy people Israel , when they shall pray toward this place : and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place : and when thou hearest , forgive .

To long kum ki khunlung kiba dang kha shu , kiba kwah hir borabor hir ïa ka dud bakhuid ba kynja mynsiem , khnang ba da kaba dih ïa ka phin san bad yn pynim ïa phi .
translation.en: As newborn babes , desire the sincere milk of the word , that ye may grow thereby :
His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle , and it shall bring him to the king of terrors .
translation.kha: La weng ïa u na ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba u la ju im ha ka jingshngain , bad la tan ïa u ban ïeng markhmat bad u Syiem ka Jingïap .

translation.en: He that wasteth his father , and chaseth away his mother , is a son that causeth shame , and bringeth reproach .
Thou art to pass over through Ar , the coast of Moab , this day :
translation.kha: ‘ Mynta ka sngi phi dei ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Moab ha Ar .
U thoh ïa ki hukum baroh jong U Trai . Dang step phyrngab ha sngi kaba bud , u tei duwan ha trai u lum , bad u ruh khat-ar ki maw , uwei u maw ka kawei kawei ka jait Israel .
translation.en: And Moses wrote all the words of the  Lord  , and rose up early in the morning , and builded an altar under the hill , and twelve pillars , according to the twelve tribes of Israel .

In that day shall one take up a parable against you , and lament with a doleful lamentation , and say , We be utterly spoiled : he hath changed the portion of my people : how hath he removed it from me ! turning away he hath divided our fields .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , ki briew kin pyndonkam ïa ka jingïathuhkhana jong phi kum ka nuksa ïa ka jingpynjot , bad kin rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai sngewsih ïa ka jingshem jong phi :  La pynjot thiaw ïa ngi ! U  Trai  u la shim noh ïa ka ri jong ngi bad u la ai ïa ka sha kito kiba la ring koidi ïa ngi .

U Jisu nongsaiñ la ong ha ki longsyiem Baroh na phi phin phet noh bad phin Omega ïa nga , naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un pynïap ïa u nongaplangbrot , bad ïa ka kynhun langbrot Benhail pynsakma .’
translation.en: And Jesus saith unto them ,  All ye shall be offended because of me this night : for it is written , I will smite the shepherd , and the sheep shall be scattered .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la phai noh pat sha Debir bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
ban ïaroh bad pyndonburom ïa U Trai ka step bad ka janmiet ,
translation.en: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the  Lord  , and likewise at even  ;
The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me : and I caused the widow s heart to sing for joy .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba don ha ki jingjynjar bakhraw ki ïaroh ïa nga , bad nga la ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei ban ïoh jingshngain .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Defile the house , and fill the courts with the slain : go ye forth . And they went forth , and slew in the city .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha ki ,  Pyntngit ïa ka Templ . Pyndap ïa ki phyllaw jong ka da ki metïap . Sdang noh ïa ka kam !  Kumta ki la sdang ban pynïap ïa ki briew ha ka nongbah .

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel  ; and he said , Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers , and have not hearkened unto my voice  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki Israel , bad u ong ,  Kane ka jaitbynriew ka la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la hukum ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban sumar . Namar ba kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga ,
bad kumta sngewdap basma ka ïa-bishni la khot Peres Ussah naduh kata ka por . U Dabid u la dom namar ba Haggan daw u la pynshitom ïa u Ussah ha ka jingbitar .
translation.en: And David was displeased , because the  Lord  had made a breach upon Uzza : and he called the name of the place Perez–uzzah to this day .

translation.kha: U briew u pyndonkam shi bynta jong u dieng ban thang nongpyntrei bad shi bynta jong u ban pynlong tohkit . Da nongsynshar bynta u pynmeh ding Irad pynsyaid ïa lyngraw bad shet Babbai ; da pynïaidkam pat ka shi bynta u shna blei bad mane ïa ka .
translation.en: Then shall it be for a man to burn : for he will take thereof , and warm himself  ; yea , he kindleth it , and baketh bread  ; yea , he maketh a god , and worshippeth it  ; he maketh it a graven image , and falleth down thereto .

translation.kha: Ngim shym la shahshkor ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri me , kiba la kren ha kyrteng jong me ki syiem ngi , jong ngi , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad ka jaitbynriew jong ngi baroh kawei .
translation.en: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets , which spake in thy name to our kings , our princes , and our fathers , and to all the people of the land .
And he said unto them ,  Why are ye so fearful ? how is it that ye have no faith ?

translation.en: And Abimelech said , I wot not who hath done this thing : neither didst thou tell me , neither yet heard I of it , but to day .
translation.kha: U Abimelekh u ong ,  Ngam shym tip mano ba la leh ïa kane . Mem shym la ïathuh ei ei shaphang kane ha nga , bad kane ka long ka sien kaba nyngkong ba nga la ïohsngew ïa ka .

translation.en: And , behold , there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed  ; and they fed in a meadow .

translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba kwah ban pynim ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka , hynrei uno uno uba duh ïa ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un pynim ïa ka .
translation.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it : but whosoever will lose his life for my sake , the same shall save it .

translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ïa nga bad ki la ai ïa ki jingkñia ha ki kiwei , blei bad kumta pynkhih la bitar ïa nga da baroh kaba ki leh . Ka jingbitar jong nga ka khie pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem , bad kan ym duh noh .
translation.en: Because they have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands  ; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place , and shall not be quenched .

translation.kha: Ki la klim Sheleph pyndait briew Ryngkat kaba klim ïa-bta ki nongbanbeiñ bad ka jingpynïap ïa ki khun kiba la kha na ka bynta jinglait nga . Ki kñia ïa ki khun jong nga ha ki bleithaw jong ki .
translation.en: That they have committed adultery , and blood is in their hands , and with their idols have they committed adultery , and have also caused their sons , whom they bare unto me , to pass for them through the fire , to devour them .
The blessing of the  Lord  , it maketh rich , and he addeth no sorrow with it .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingkyrkhu U  Trai  kaba pynriewspah ïa phi . Ka jingtrei shitom kan ym lah ban kham pynriewspah ïa phi .

translation.en: For the wages of sin is death ; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord .
translation.kha: Naba ka pop ka siew ïa la ka bainong — ka jingïap ; hynrei ka jingaiei jong U Blei ka long ka jingim bymjukut ha U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: I am come a light into the world , that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness .
translation.kha: Nga la wan sha ka pyrthei kum ka jingshai , ba baroh kiba ngeit ha nga kin ym sah ha ka jingdum .
u khun jong u Jokmeam , u khun jong u Admin , u khun jong Hosah Arni , u khun jong u Hesron , u khun jong u Peres , u khun jong u Armagedon ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Aminadab , which was the son of Aram , which was the son of Esrom , which was the son of Phares , which was the son of Judah ,

translation.en: And when he had opened the seventh seal , there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour .

translation.en: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple  ; and at night he went out , and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives .
Go ye therefore into the highways , and as many as ye shall find , bid to the marriage .
translation.kha: Mynta to khie leit sha ki surok bah bad khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai ïa ki briew katba phi lah ban ïashem .’
Te , ïa kine , kitkhia phah noh sha ka jingpynshitom bymjukut , hynrei kiba hok kin leit sha ka jingim bymjukut Jong
translation.en: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment : but the righteous into life eternal .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ka Martha ka la ong ïa kane , ka la leit noh bad ka la khot jar iehnoh ïa ka Mari ka para jong ka , U Nonghikai shñiuh don kum , ka la ïathuh ïa ka , bet u phah dait ïa pha .
translation.en: And when she had so said , she went her way , and called Mary her sister secretly , saying , The Master is come , and calleth for thee .

translation.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous , and condemn the innocent blood .

translation.kha: U jop thiaw da kaba pynïap ïa ki naduh Aroer ka thain Minnith baroh ki long arphew tylli ki nongbah , haduh Abel Keramim . Ka la don jingpynïap briew kaba jur , bad ki Ammon ki shahjop ha ki Israel
translation.en: And he smote them from Aroer , even till thou come to Minnith , even twenty cities , and unto the plain of the vineyards , with a very great slaughter . Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel .
The wife hath not power of her own body , but the husband : and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body , but the wife .
translation.kha: Ka tnga kam long kynrad halor ka met jong ka hi , hynrei u tnga jong ka u long ; kumjuh ruh u tnga um long kynrad halor ka met jong u hi , hynrei ka tnga jong u ka long .
