translation.en: Grace unto you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: ka jingaiei kan don ha phi , bad jingsuk , na U Blei jong ngi U Kpa bad U Trai Jisu Khrist .

Hynrei ngam shym la ngeit uta ki tad ynda nga la wan bad ïohi ïa ki thar lade hi . Nangno ngam shym peit ha-ei wat shiteng jong ka ; ka jingstad bad san spah Lehkmen phi ki long kiba khraw shibun eh ban Shallekheth kaei kaba la ïathuh ha nga .
translation.en: Howbeit I believed not the words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it : and , behold , the half was not told me : thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard .
And Moses wrote all the words of the  Lord  , and rose up early in the morning , and builded an altar under the hill , and twelve pillars , according to the twelve tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: U Moses u thoh ïa ki hukum baroh jong U  Trai . Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u tei ïa ka duwan ha trai jong u lum , bad u pynïeng ruh khat-ar tylli ki maw , uwei u maw na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel .
Hynrei U Blei u peit halor ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw , bad ki rangbah ki synshar Persia ki rai ban ym leh ei ei haduh kin ba da lah thoh sha u Darius bad ïoh ïa ka jubab .
translation.en: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews , that they could not cause them to cease , till the matter came to Darius : and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter .

translation.kha: Haba kin pynshitom beiñ ïa phi ha kawei ka shnong , to phet sha kawei pat . Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba phin ym pat ban lah pyndep ïa ka jong kam phi ha baroh shnong ki jong ka Israel ha shuwa ba U Khun U Briew un wan .
translation.en: But when they persecute you in this city , flee ye into another : for verily I say unto you , Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel , till the Son of man be come .

translation.kha: Wat ka jingim jong i khyllung i bym pat kha i ba don hakpoh jong ka kmie ruh Amalek long iba kordor hakhmat U kiew .
translation.en: Even the life of an unborn child inside its mother is precious to Jehovah .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka jingdum kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba khraw . Ha kito kiba im ha ka ri ba-dum jong ka ka jingïap jingshai tyngshaiñ kan .
translation.en: The people which sat in darkness saw great light  ; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up .

Was then that which is good made death unto me ? God forbid . But sin , that it might appear sin , working death in me by that which is good ; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful .
translation.kha: Hynrei hato kane ka mut ba kaei kaba bha ka pynlong ïa ka jingïap ïa nga ? Ym kumta! Ka dei ka pop kaba pynlong ïa kata ; da kaba pyndonkam ïa kaei kaba bha , ka pop ka la wallam ka jingïap ïa nga , khnang ba ïa kata ka jinglong bashisha jong ka pop yn pynpaw . Bad kumta , lyngba ka hukum , ïa ka pop la pynpaw ba ka long kaba kham shyrkhei .
ki Haba Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , la ki jubab , U la beh noh ïa ki ksuid tang namar ba u rangbah jong ki , u Beelsebul u ai bor ïa u ban leh kumta .
translation.en: But when the Pharisees heard it , they said , This fellow doth not cast out devils , but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils .

translation.kha: Haba ka khubor ka poi ïingsyiem ki hynmen u la poi , u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki sngewbha shibun eh
translation.en: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh s house , saying , Joseph s brethren are come : and it pleased Pharaoh well , and his servants .
Where are they ? where are thy wise men ? and let them tell thee now , and let them know what the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt .
translation.kha: Ko syiem Ijipt , shano kito ki nongai jingmut bashalak jong me ? Lehse ki lah ban ïathuh ha me ïa ki jingthmu jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh kiba u don ïa ka Ijipt .

translation.en: ( Proverbs 1 :8 ) Jehovah requires a wife to care for her family lovingly .
translation.kha: ( Proberb 1 :8 ) U Jehobah u kwah ïa ka tnga ban sumar sukher ïa la ka ïing ka sem da ka jingieit .

translation.en: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah : the same is a great city .
translation.kha: bad ka Resen , kaba don hapdeng ka Ninebeh bad ka nongbah bakhraw ka Kalah .
Ki briew ki leit sha shiliang jong ka Them ki dieng Jamynrei , Beser jingshah pyrshang ban pynum phet lem bad la ki jingdon jingem jong kynta tbeh
translation.en: Therefore the abundance they have gotten , and that which they have laid up , shall they carry away to the brook of the willows .

translation.kha: Ka lynti ban long uba ka long ban pyndonburom ïa U Trai u ai ka kaba beit ïa baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki jong u . U long uba dei ban ïaroh junom .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of wisdom : a good understanding have all they that do his commandments : his praise endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Ha ka miet hangta ka ïingbyndi uta u nongrah bad u nongshet rangbah la mar ka jong ka jingphohsniew don la ka jong ka jong ka .
translation.en: And they dreamed a dream both of them , each man his dream in one night , each man according to the interpretation of his dream , the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt , which were bound in the prison .

translation.kha: Kumno ngan lah ban shah ïa ka lada kane ka ka wan hap ha ki briew nga , bad ki ki shah pynïap ?
translation.en: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people ? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred ?

translation.kha: , u Paul u batai ruh ïa ka jingthmu jong ka Hukum U Blei bad ka pynkitkhlieh jong U Mynsiem sngewkyiuh Blei ha ka jingim jong uba ngeit . Nangta u apostol u ïaleh shitom ban pynshai ïa ka jingkylli Misrephoth ki ksuit bad ki Jingijli ki thala ka jingïadei Aben hukum jingthmu U Blei ïa ki khulom saisiej U pynkut Dekapolis ka jingkyntait jong ki Jiw ïa U Jisu ka long ka bynta jong ka jingthmu jingïuhkjat Blei ban wallam ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew hapoh ka jylli jong ka jingaiei jong riewkhlaw jingimat da U Jisu Khrist Puson jingkhie u ngeit ba pynjakhlia Jiw kin jingïakynduh kyntait sah Shtah U riewkhmat sngewstad Khatduh u Paul u UBA shaphang katne ban im ka jingim kumne , khamtam nongpynïaidkam ka lynti jong ka jingieit Lyngba ka jingïadei bad kiwei pat . Engannim thoh kiwei pat ki phangpdeng kum ka jingshakri ïa U Blei , ka kamram ki bapop barabor ka jingïadei bad pynseisoh hima ksaiñ rymmiang ka imlang sahlang , bad ki jingkylli shaphang ka jingïatiplem . U pynkut ïa ka jingkular da ki khubor jurip bad ki Khlem ïaroh ïa Nasir Blei . Ki rynjup Ka thab bad ka ïashetkylla
translation.en: And he shook off the beast into the fire , and felt no harm .
And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria , and the plummet of the house of Ahab : and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish , wiping it , and turning it upside down .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem kumba nga la leh ïa ka Samaria , kumba nga la leh ïa u Ahab u syiem ka Israel bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ngan pynkhuid phar ïa ka Jerusalem na ki briew jong ka kumba khuid ka pliang ba la ñiad bad pyndem pyllup ïa ka .
Kumta U Blei u la pynbna ïa ka jingtim ha ka pyrthei . Ki briew jong ka ki hap ban siew ïa kaba kaei ki la leh . Kiba im ki la nang duna nang bad duna .
translation.en: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth , and they that dwell therein are desolate : therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned , and few men left .

And David said unto him , Fear not : for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father s sake , and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father  ; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ,  u Dabid u jubab .  Ngan lehbha ïa phi na ka bynta u Jonathan , u kpa jong phi . Ngan ai pat ha phi ïa ka khyndew ka shyiap baroh kaba dei ka jong u Saul , u kparad jong phi , bad phin long uba la pdiang sngewbha borabor ha ka miej bam jong nga .

translation.en: Therefore the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he sold them into the hand of Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia : and the children of Israel served Chushan–rishathaim eight years .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa ki Israel bad u shah ïa u Kushan Rishathaim u syiem ka Mesopotamia ban jop ïa ki . Bad u synshar halor jong ki haduh phra snem .

translation.en: Moreover your little ones , which ye said should be a prey , and your children , which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil , they shall go in thither , and unto them will I give it , and they shall possess it .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha ngi baroh , ‘ Ki khun ki kti jong phi , kiba dang lung palat ban tip ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew , kin rung sha kata ka ri — ki khun ki kti kiba phi ong kin shah kurup ha ki nongshun jong phi . Ngan ai ïa ka ri ha ki , ban kin ïohkynti ïa ka .

translation.en: For when I had brought them into the land , for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them , then they saw every high hill , and all the thick trees , and they offered there their sacrifices , and there they presented the provocation of their offering : there also they made their sweet savour , and poured out there their drink offerings .
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki . Haba ki la ïohi ïa ki lum bajrong bad ïa ki dieng bajyrngam , ki la ai jingkñia ha ki baroh . Ki la pynbitar ïa nga da ki jingkñia kiba ki la thang bad da ka waiñ kaba ki la wallam kum ki jingainguh .
Phi la kumno ïohsngew ba nga la ju im nga mynba dang don ha ka niam Jiw , kumno nga la pynshitom beiñ khlem jingisynei ïa balang ka U Blei bad nga la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban pynduh noh ïa ka .
translation.en: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews  religion , how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God , and wasted it :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki , U Moses u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong phi , ba ka namar long kaba eh ban hikai ïa phi .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept .
And whiles I was speaking , and praying , and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel , and presenting my supplication before the  Lord  my God for the holy mountain of my God  ;
translation.kha: Nga la bteng ban duwai , da kaba phla ïa ki pop jong nga bad ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong nga ki Israel , bad da kaba ïasaid bad U  Trai  U Blei jong nga ban pynbha pat ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong u ,

translation.en: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good : and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrkhat bad kren ïa kaba sniew u lah ban khmih lynti ban ym shem ei ei kaba bha — tang ka jingpynjot .

translation.en: For the king had at sea a navy of Tarshish with the navy of Hiram : once in three years came the navy of Tarshish , bringing gold , and silver , ivory , and apes , and peacocks .
translation.kha: U don shi kynhun ki liengbah kiba ïaid ha duriaw ryngkat bad ka kynhun lieng u Hiram . Shisien lai snem ki kynhun lieng jong u ki ju wan phai , ki da wan kit ïa ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki bniat hati , ki tngaw , bad ki shrieh .

Ynda riewbieit dap shiteng jingsyllok u Elijah u la sdang ban kren habar ïa ki : Duwai kham jam ! U dei khrong blei ! Lehse u tapkhlieh phohsniew lane u dang leit tuklar lane lehse u dang leit Akaba ! Lane lehse Body dang ïohthiah , phin hap ban mawjam ïa u !
translation.en: And it came to pass at noon , that Elijah mocked them , and said , Cry aloud : for he is a god  ; either he is talking , or he is pursuing , or he is in a journey , or peradventure he sleepeth , and must be awaked .
And some fell among thorns  ; and the thorns sprang up with it , and choked it .
translation.kha: Katto katne na u symbai ki la hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah , kiba la san ryngkat bad ki jingthung bad ki la kjap ïa ki .

translation.en: Now this I say , that every one of you saith , I am of Paul ; and I of Apollos ; and I of Cephas ; and I of Christ .
translation.kha: Ai ba ngan buh ha kane ka rukom : Uwei pa uwei na phi u ong ïa kaei kaei kaba ïapher . Uwei u ong ,  Nga bud ïa u Paul ;  uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa u Apollos ;  uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa u Petros ;  bad uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa U Khrist .

Ngan wan ha phi bad im pyllait ïa phi . Ngan ïa pynjot ki hima baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , hynrei ngan ym pynjot ïa phi Ngan nym . shah ba phin lait khlem shah pynshitom ; hynrei haba nga pynshitom ïa phi , ngan lehhok . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Fear thou not , O Jacob my servant , saith the  Lord  : for I am with thee  ; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee : but I will not make a full end of thee , but correct thee in measure  ; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished .
Only ye shall not eat the blood  ; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water .
translation.kha: Hynrei phim bit ban bam ïa ka snam jong ki ; phi dei ban theh ïa ka ha ka khyndew kumba theh ïa ka um .
uba ar la kha da u batskhem triang ka khongdong jat jong u ; kumta la kyrteng u u Jakob . U Isaak u la dap hynriewphew snem ka rta mynba la ïa ki .
translation.en: And after that came his brother out , and his hand took hold on Esau s heel  ; and his name was called Jacob : and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them .

And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are : and when I see the blood , I will pass over you , and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you , when I smite the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ka snam ha ki shawkad kan long ka dak ban pyn-i ïa ki ïing ha kiba phi shong . Haba nga ïohi ïa kata ka snam , ngan ïaid lait na phi , bad ngan ym ktah ïa phi haba nga pynshitom ïa ki nong Ijipt .

translation.en: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin , saying , Go and lie in wait in the vineyards  ;
translation.kha: Ki ong ha ki Benjamin ,  Khie leit rieh ha ki bri sohwaiñ bad ap khmih .

translation.en: ( For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian , whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple . )
translation.kha: ( Ki la ong ïa kane namar ki la lah ïohi ïa u Trophimos uba na Ephesos ryngkat bad u Paul ha ka nongbah , bad ki la pyrkhat ba u Paul u la ïalam ïa u shapoh ka Templ . )

translation.en: And I beheld , and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders : and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand , and thousands of thousands  ;
translation.kha: Nga la khmih biang , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ki angel , da ki hajar bad ki million na ki ! Ki la ïeng sawdong ka khet , ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , bad ki nongsharai balang ,

translation.en: The  Lord  will not spare him , but then the anger of the  Lord  and his jealousy shall smoke against that man , and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him , and the  Lord  shall blot out his name from under heaven .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ym map kum ïa uta u briew . Hynrei ka jingbitar shla jong u kan meh lep pyrshah ïa u , bad ki jingjynjar baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab kin ngat ha u haduh ba U  Trai  un da pynjot thiaw ïa u .
Ka hapdeng ki kynhun kiba ïashah ïa ka longïing jong u Saul kito kiba ïashah u Dabid ka la neh slem Katba u Dabid u nang nang khlaiñ , ki pyrshah jong u nang nang tlot .
translation.en: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David : but David waxed stronger and stronger , and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker .

And Shaphan the scribe came to the king , and brought the king word again , and said , Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house , and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work , that have the oversight of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u leit phai pat sha u syiem bad ïathuh :  Ki shakri jong phi ki la shim ïa ka pisa kaba don ha ka Templ , bad ki ai ïa ka ha ki rangbah kiba dei khmih ïa ki jingshna pynbha .

translation.en: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the  Lord  bowls of silver , snuffers , basins , trumpets , any vessels of gold , or vessels of silver , of the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Pynban ym shym la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa , ban siew ha kaba shna ïa ki khuri rupa , ki khiew , ki turoi , ne ki tiar pynmeh ïa ki sharak , ne kiwei de ki tiar ba la shna na ka rupa ne na ka ksiar .
Haba u la dep , dih ka ong , Ngan leit tong um sa ïa ki jong ut phi de bad to ai ba kin ïoh dih katba ki kwah .
translation.en: And when she had done giving him drink , she said , I will draw water for thy camels also , until they have done drinking .

translation.kha: U la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros , u Jakob , bad u Ïoannis . Ka jingjynjar mynsiem bad ka jingsngewkhuslai ki la ha u ,
translation.en: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John , and began to be sore amazed , and to be very heavy  ;

translation.kha: pansngiat Jngai u kham jied ïa u Iso , namar u jingiathuhlypa bha ban bam ïa Mynhynnin mrad kiba u Iso u pynïap , hynrei sentimitar Rebekka ka kham jied ïa u Jakob .
translation.en: And Isaac loved Esau , because he did eat of his venison : but Rebekah loved Jacob .
And when the centurion , which stood over against him , saw that he so cried out , and gave up the ghost , he said , Truly this man was the Son of God .
translation.kha: U shipai rangbah uba ïeng hangta ha khmat ka diengphna u la ïohi kumno U Jisu u la ïap .  Une u briew u long shisha U Khun U Blei !  u la ong .
Wat pyrkhat ba nga la wan ban pyndam noh ïa ka Hukum Moses u bad ïa ki jinghikai jong ki nongïathuhlypa . Ngam shym ban la wan pyndam noh ïa ki , hynrei ban pynurlong shisha ïa ki jinghikai jong ki .
translation.en: Think not that I am come to destroy the law , or the prophets : I am not come to destroy , but to fulfil .

translation.kha: Haba uno uno khot sngewbha phi sha ka jingkhawai , wat shong ha ki jaka bakyrpang Ka lah ban jia ba uno kham donkam phi u la khot sngewbha ,
translation.en: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding , sit not down in the highest room  ; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him  ;

translation.kha: Ka spah kan ym lah ban ïa leh kaei kaei kaba bha ha ka sngi ba ïashem phi ïa ka jingïap , hynrei ka jinglehhok kan pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi .
translation.en: Riches profit not in the day of wrath : but righteousness delivereth from death .
These are the sons of Ishmael , and these are their names , by their towns , and by their castles  ; twelve princes according to their nations .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki kpa tymmen jong ki khat-ar jait , bad da ki kyrteng jong ki la jer ïa ki shnong bad ïa ki jaka sher dara jong ki .

translation.en: Whom having not seen , ye love  ; in whom , though now ye see him not , yet believing , ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory :
translation.kha: Phi ieit ïa u , wat haba phim pat ïohi ïa u , bad phi ngeit ha u , wat la phim pat ïohi ïa u mynta . Te phi shadkmen da ka jingkmen kaba khraw bad kaba dap da ka burom kiba ki ktien kim lah ban batai ,
don u ban ïa ka jingong phi ! dei ban kumjuh : uta uba sah shadien bad ki jingkit jingbah un ïoh bynta mar katjuh kum uba leit sha ka thma .
translation.en: For who will hearken unto you in this matter ? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle , so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff : they shall part alike .
And the second took her , and died , neither left he any seed : and the third likewise .
translation.kha: Nangta uba ar u la shongkurim ïa kata ka briew , bad u la ïap noh ruh khlem don khun . Ka la jia kumjuh ïa u para uba lai ,
Ha kata ka por U Trai pynlong ki kin bad sheptieng haduh katta ba uwei baroh ïa u briew hajan jong u bad tur ïaleh ïa .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that a great tumult from the  Lord  shall be among them  ; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour , and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour .

translation.kha: uba la kha nyngkong da kaba phin ai pat da u ha khunlangbrot ka jaka jong u . phim Lada thied biang ïa u , pynkheiñ ïa ka ryndang u jong . Thied biang uwei ïa pa uwei u khun nyngkong jong phi . Uno uno ruh , um dei ban wan ha khmat jong nga khlem ka jingainguh .
translation.en: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb : and if thou redeem him not , then shalt thou break his neck . All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem . And none shall appear before me empty .

translation.kha: katba uba duk pat u don tang iwei i khunlangbrot , iba u la thied . U sumar ïa i , bad i i heh san ha jong ïing u lem bad ki khun ki kti jong u . U ju bsa ïa i na ka jong jingbam u hi bad , shah ïa i ban ka dih na khuri jong u , bad u thum ïa i ha ka pneh jong u . Ita i khunlangbrot i la long kum ka khun kynthei ïa u .
translation.en: But the poor man had nothing , save one little ewe lamb , which he had bought and nourished up : and it grew up together with him , and with his children  ; it did eat of his own meat , and drank of his own cup , and lay in his bosom , and was unto him as a daughter .
And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him , whom Sarah bare to him , Isaac .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Isaak ,

translation.en: Their land also is full of silver and gold , neither is there any end of their treasures  ; their land is also full of horses , neither is there any end of their chariots :
translation.kha: Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , bad ym don jingkut ïa ki jingkynshew jong ki . Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ki kulai , bad ym don jingkut ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki .

translation.en: Without understanding , covenantbreakers , without natural affection , implacable , unmerciful :
translation.kha: kim don ka jingïatiplem ; kim bat ïa la ki kular , bad kim pyn-i jingsbun lane jingisynei ïa kiwei pat .
Ki ong ïa u , Ngi phai sha me mynta namar ngi me ban leit lang bad ngi ïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad long u nongïalam ïa ki Gilead baroh .
translation.en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah , Therefore we turn again to thee now , that thou mayest go with us , and fight against the children of Ammon , and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead .
This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh : What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Ka long thik kumba nga la ïathuh ha phi — U Blei u la pyn-i ha phi ïa kaei ba un sa leh .

translation.en: I thank my God , I speak with tongues more than ye all :
translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei ba nga kren ha ki thylliej bapher kham bun ban ïa uno uno na phi .
Long ba la tim u briew uba la pynkmen ïa pa jong mynba u la wallam ha i ka khubor , I dei u shynrang ! Phi la don khun shynrang !
translation.en: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father , saying , A man child is born unto thee  ; making him very glad .
I speak to your shame . Is it so , that there is not a wise man among you ? no , not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren ?

translation.en: And Gideon came to Jordan , and passed over , he , and the three hundred men that were with him , faint , yet pursuing them .

translation.en: Asshur shall not save us  ; we will not ride upon horses : neither will we say any more to the work of our hands , Ye are our gods : for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy .
If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things , thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ , nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine , whereunto thou hast attained .

translation.en: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour : so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour .

translation.kha: mawkyntang Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel , U Trai uba pynim ïa phi ïarwai u ong : Nga long U Trai U Blei ïa-ïap phi jingkhan shongksuid pynstang kwah ban Jingkular ïa phi na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi bad uba kdew ïa phi ïa ka lynti ba phi Jied ban leit Maham
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , thy Redeemer , the Holy One of Israel  ; I am the  Lord  thy God which teacheth thee to profit , which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go .

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei jong phi un leit ryngkat phi bad un ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop .’
translation.en: For the  Lord  your God is he that goeth with you , to fight for you against your enemies , to save you .
But when they sought to lay hands on him , they feared the multitude , because they took him for a prophet .
translation.kha: kumta ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa u . Hynrei ki la sngewsheptieng ïa u paidbah , uba la ñiew ba U Jisu u dei u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Repent ye therefore , and be converted , that your sins may be blotted out , when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord  ;
translation.kha: Te , to kylla-kaba-mut , bad to phai sha U Blei , khnang ba un map ïa ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: And it was found written , that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh , two of the king s chamberlains , the keepers of the door , who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .
translation.kha: Ka bynta ba ki pule ka kynthup ïa jingbuh jingthoh shaphang kumno u Mordekai u la lap ïa ka jingsylla ban pynïap ïa u syiem — ka jingsylla da u Bigthana bad u Teresh , ki ar ngut ki ïunukh ka ïingsyiem kiba ap phira ïa ki kamra u syiem .

translation.en: These were born unto the giant in Gath  ; and they fell by the hand of David , and by the hand of his servants .
translation.kha: Kine ki lai ngut kiba la shah pynïap ha u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u , ki long kiba hiarpateng na ki ramhah ha Gath .
Haba u syiem Jeroboam u ïohsngew ïa kane , u kdew ïa u hukum , Kem ïa uto u briew ! Mar kumta hi ka kti u syiem ka kumba ïap ba um lah pynkhun shuh ïa .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God , which had cried against the altar in Beth–el , that he put forth his hand from the altar , saying , Lay hold on him . And his hand , which he put forth against him , dried up , so that he could not pull it in again to him .
He is the chief of the ways of God : he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him .
translation.kha: Uba phylla tam na ki jingthaw jong nga baroh ! Tang u Nongthaw jong u , uba lah ban jop ïa u .

translation.en: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her  ; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more :
translation.kha: Ki nongkhaïi jong ka pyrthei ruh kin ïam bad ïambriew na ka bynta jong ka , namar ba ym don shuh mano mano ban thied ïa ki mar jong ki ;

translation.en: They that dwell in mine house , and my maids , count me for a stranger : I am an alien in their sight .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ju long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha ka ïing jong nga ki la klet noh ïa nga ; ki shakri kynthei ki leh ïa nga kum ïa uba kim ithuh bad u nongwei .
Kaei kaba phi ïoh da jingbymhok phi lehkmen ka jingbam babha tam , shen kan long kum u shyiap ka shyntur .
translation.en: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man  ; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel .

translation.kha: pita leit sha kata ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad un pynkhuid ïa ka . U dei ban shim diengduh na ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw bad khyndiat na ka snam jong uta u langsohmoh bad un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba pynshad synlar dong jong kata ka duwan .
translation.en: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the  Lord  , and make an atonement for it  ; and shall take of the blood of the bullock , and of the blood of the goat , and put it upon the horns of the altar round about .

translation.kha: namar phim pat rung ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong Shemida u ai ha Kaphtorim , ha kaba phin ïoh shongsuk shongsaiñ .
translation.en: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance , which the  Lord  your God giveth you .

translation.kha: Wat ju bam ïa ka ngap palat ban ïa kaba phi donkam ; kaba bam ka palat lah ban pynlong ïa phi ban prie .
translation.en: Hast thou found honey ? eat so much as is sufficient for thee , lest thou be filled therewith , and vomit it .

translation.kha: Ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long kaba khlaiñ bad pynkordit jingïaineh jong u ka long jingïashem . A to ïaroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: For his merciful kindness is great toward us : and the truth of the  Lord  endureth for ever . Praise ye the  Lord .
Which turned the rock into a standing water , the flint into a fountain of waters .
translation.kha: uba pynkylla ïa ki mawsiang sha ki pung-um , bad ïa ki synrang ba-eh sha ki umpohliew kiba tuid .

translation.en: And the seven angels came out of the temple , having the seven plagues , clothed in pure and white linen , and having their breasts girded with golden girdles .
translation.kha: Ki hynñiew ki angel kiba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam ki la mihnoh na ka Templ , kiba la kup da ki jaiñ linen ba-thaba kiba khuid lem bad ki panpoh ksiar ba la teh sawdong ki shadem jong ki .
Kine ki long kiba ka na longïing jong longsem u Aaron bad u Moses ha ka por ba U Trai u kren ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,

And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him : but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost , it shall not be forgiven him , neither in this world , neither in the world to come .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba kren ei ei pyrshah ïa U Khun U Briew u lah ban ïoh jingmap ; hynrei uno uno uba kren ei ei pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid un ym ïoh jingmap — mynta lane junom .
Kumta mynta nga ïa phi ban shahshkor ïa nga ; to shah ba ngan ha phi ïa kaei kaba nga .
translation.en: Therefore I said , Hearken to me  ; I also will shew mine opinion .
Who hath wrought and done it , calling the generations from the beginning ? I the  Lord  , the first , and with the last  ; I am he .
translation.kha: Mano dei uta ba pynlong ïa kane ban jia ? Uba la thmu skhem ïa ka jingïaid ka histori ? Nga , U  Trai  , nga la don hangta naduh mynnyngkong , bad nga , U  Trai  , ngan ïai don hangta ha kaba kut .
Ko Job , ha baroh ka jingim jong me , hato la me hukum ïa ka sngi haduh ka step ?
translation.en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days  ; and caused the dayspring to know his place  ;

translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka Asriel ïa u khun shynrang bad ka Semakhaïah kyrteng ïa u jingïohknieh u Samson . Lukia u khunlung u Pyrta nang san bad U por u la Parosh ïa u Proberb
translation.en: And the woman bare a son , and called his name Samson : and the child grew , and the  Lord  blessed him .
Then there arose certain of the synagogue , which is called the synagogue of the Libertines , and Cyrenians , and Alexandrians , and of them of Cilicia and of Asia , disputing with Stephen .
translation.kha: Hynrei la pyrshah ïa u da katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba long ki dkhot ka synagog jong ki briew kiba la laitluid ( kumba la khot ïa ki ) , kaba kynthup ïa ki Jiw na Kyrini bad na Aleksandria . Ma ki bad kiwei pat ki Jiw na ki thain ka Kilikia bad Asia ki la ïasdang ban ïasaidnia bad u Stephan .
Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa pha ïa kaei kaba pha la leh . Ngan ïa ka ïingsyiem jong pha da ka ding , bad kan bam duh ïa baroh kat don jong ka . nga , U Trai , nga kren .
translation.en: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings , saith the  Lord  : and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof , and it shall devour all things round about it .

translation.kha: Kumta u phah ïa u Joram u khun jong u leit khublei bad ai burom ïa u na ka bynta jingjop jong ïa u Hadadeser ïa uba u Toi u la ïaleh thma bunsien . U Joram wallam jingai sngewbha la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa bad rnong .
translation.en: He sent Hadoram his son to king David , to enquire of his welfare , and to congratulate him , because he had fought against Hadarezer , and smitten him  ; ( for Hadarezer had war with Tou  ; ) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass .
And when David enquired of the  Lord  , he said , Thou shalt not go up  ; but fetch a compass behind them , and come upon them over against the mulberry trees .
translation.kha: Sa shisien u Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  , uba jubab ,  Wat tur ïaleh ïa ki nangne , hynrei leit sawdong bad pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ki na kawei ka liang , najan ki dieng Balsam .

translation.en: And he turned him unto his disciples , and said privately ,  Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see :

translation.kha: Kumta baroh ki ïalumlang ha Mispah . Ki tong ïa ka um bad ki theh ïa ka kum ka jingainguh ha U  Trai  bad ki shahjingit baroh shi sngi . Ki ong ,  Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .  Dei ha Mispah ba u Samuel u pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng ki Israel .

translation.kha: Ki briew kin kyllon kum ki masi kyrtong khlaw bad ki masi lyngraw , bad ka khyndew kan saw da ka snam bad yn tap da ka khleiñ .

translation.en: But one of the young men told Abigail , Nabal s wife , saying , Behold , David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master  ; and he railed on them .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki shakri jong u Nabal u ong ha ka Abigail ka tnga jong u Nabal ,  Hato phi ïohsngew ? U Dabid u la phah katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien na ka ri khlaw lem bad ka jingai khublei ïa u kynrad jong ngi , hynrei u la ñiewbeiñ ïa ki .

Ngi pynshlur ïa ba phin bteng ban pule shaphang U Blei , ban ïathuh ïa la ki bahaïing hasem bad ki jong phi shaphang kiba phi pule bad ban ïasyllok bad ngi khlem da ha ki jingïalang Khristan jong ngi . —Hebru 10 :23-25 .
translation.en: We encourage you to keep on taking in knowledge of God , to tell the rest of your family and friends about what you are learning , and to associate regularly with us at our Christian meetings . —Hebrews 10 :23-25 .

translation.en: O Belteshazzar , master of the magicians , because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in thee , and no secret troubleth thee , tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen , and the interpretation thereof .

translation.en: A sword is upon the Chaldeans , saith the  Lord  , and upon the inhabitants of Babylon , and upon her princes , and upon her wise men .
A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul , and a sword , and a sharp arrow .

translation.en: Therefore hear now , I pray thee , O my lord the king : let my supplication , I pray thee , be accepted before thee  ; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe , lest I die there .

translation.en: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the  Lord  God of Israel with all his heart : for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam , which made Israel to sin .
He that speaketh flattery to his friends , even the eyes of his children shall fail .
translation.kha: Ha ka proberb ba-mynshuwa , u briew u die ïa la ki paralok na ka bynta ka pisa , bad ki khun jong u ki shahshitom na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: And shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Even so will I break this people and this city , as one breaketh a potter s vessel , that cannot be made whole again : and they shall bury them in Topheth , till there be no place to bury .
translation.kha: bad ban ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong ,  Ngan pynpait ïa kane ka jaitbynriew bad ïa kane ka nongbah , bad kan long kum une u khra khyndew ba la pait u bym lah ban pyndait pat . translation.en: They are vanity , the work of errors : in the time of their visitation they shall perish .
For the  Lord  knoweth the way of the righteous : but the way of the ungodly shall perish .

translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : because his mercy endureth for ever .

There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof , like a roaring lion ravening the prey  ; they have devoured souls  ; they have taken the treasure and precious things  ; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ki long kum ki sing kiba kyrhuh halor ki mrad kiba ki la pynïap . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew , ki shim ïa ka pisa baroh bad ki jingdon jingem kat kaba ki lah ban ïoh , bad da kaba pynïap briew ki pynsah riewkynthei ïa kiba bun .

translation.en: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the  Lord  our God , to walk in his statutes , and to keep his commandments , as at this day .

translation.en: He is not here : for he is risen , as he said . Come , see the place where the Lord lay .

And they shall be upon Aaron , and upon his sons , when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation , or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place  ; that they bear not iniquity , and die : it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him .
translation.kha: U Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei ban phong ïa ki man ka por ba ki leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga ne haba ki leit sha jan ka duwan ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang , khnang ba kin ym shah pynïap ba ki thad burom ïa lade . Kane ka long ka aiñ kaba neh shi rta ïa u Aaron bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: Awake , awake , stand up , O Jerusalem , which hast drunk at the hand of the  Lord  the cup of his fury  ; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling , and wrung them out .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , to khie noh ! Khie joit ïa lade bad ïeng ! Pha la dih ïa ka khuri ka jingpynshitom kaba U  Trai  ha ka jingbitar jong u , u la ai ba phan dih ; pha dih lut ïa ka , bad ka la pynlong ïa pha ban ïaid sheng sheng .

translation.en: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren , Let me find grace in your eyes , and what ye shall say unto me I will give .
translation.kha: Nangta u Shekhem u ong ha u kpa jong ka Dinah bad ha ki hynmen shynrang jong ka ,  Sngewbha pdiang ïa kane ka jingkyrpad jong nga , bad kat kaba phi kwah ngan ai .

translation.en: By faith he forsook Egypt , not fearing the wrath of the king : for he endured , as seeing him who is invisible .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Moses ban mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt khlem da sheptieng ïa ka jingbitar u Pharaoh . Ka la long kumba u la ïohi ïa U Blei u bym lah ban ïohi , u la kyntait ban phai dien .

translation.en: So the  Lord  was with Joshua  ; and his fame was noised throughout all the country .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la don ryngkat lem bad u Joshua , bad ka nam jong u ka saphriang kylleng kata ka ri .

translation.en: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves , and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Bteng lang san tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba kin long kawei ka jaiñ jingtap , bad leh kumjuh ïa ki hynriew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah ba kin long kawei pat ka jaiñ jingtap . Khylliap ar syrtap ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba hynriew kaba ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace .
translation.kha: Bad u la hukum ïa ki briew kiba khlaiñ tam ha ka kynhun shipai jong u ban khum ïa ki lai ngut ki rangbah bad ban bret ïa ki ha ka lawar ding baklang .

translation.en: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar  ; and I knew that they were the cherubims .
translation.kha: Nga la ithuh ba kine ki long kijuh ki jingthaw ba-im ba nga la ïohi kiba shong hapoh U Blei ki Israel harud ka wah Khebar .

translation.en: And as some spake of the temple , how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts , he said ,
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki synran ki dang ïakren shaphang ka Templ , ba katno ka long kaba itynnat lem bad ki maw bajlih jong ka bad ki jingai ïa kiba la ai sha U Blei .

translation.en: Go unto the house of the Rechabites , and speak unto them , and bring them into the house of the  Lord  , into one of the chambers , and give them wine to drink .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ki dkhot jong ka kur Rekhab bad ïakren bad ki . Nangta wallam ïa ki sha kawei na ki kamra ha ka Templ bad tyrwa waiñ ïa ki khyndiat .

translation.en: Because I knew that thou art obstinate , and thy neck is an iron sinew , and thy brow brass  ;
translation.kha: Nga la tip ba phin pynshisha ba phi long kiba mutlop , kiba pyneh kum ka nar bad ka rnong bym lah ban pynkdor .
namar U Khun U Briew u long U jong Trai ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day .

translation.kha: Lada don uba lait im bad uba khat jingpynjynjar :8 ki khun jong u , to khmih sha long! haba ki wan sha phi . Peit haduh katno ki long kiba sniew , khlur-kba jingkob sngewthikna ba ka jingpynshitom sur nga wallam ha Lur Jerusalem ka long kaba dei batskhem ,
translation.en: Yet , behold , therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth , both sons and daughters : behold , they shall come forth unto you , and ye shall see their way and their doings : and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem , even concerning all that I have brought upon it .

translation.kha: Ka khubor babha ka long ruh ba ka jingbishar ïa niam ki kiba hikai bakla kan sa wan shen .
translation.en: The coming judgment of false religion is good news .
Again , Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel . And Samuel said unto Jesse , The  Lord  hath not chosen these .
translation.kha: Da kumne u Jesse u wan ïalam hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u sha u Samuel . Bad u Samuel u ong ha u ,  Em , U  Trai  um shym la jied ïano ïano na kine .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Cain , Where is Abel thy brother ? And he said , I know not : Am I my brother s keeper ?
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u kylli ïa u Kain ,  Shano u Abel u para jong me ?  U te u jubab ,  Ngam tip . Hato dei ma nga u ban sumar ïa u para jong nga ?
Um shym la shong la sah ha Nasareth , hynrei u la leit ban shong ban sah ha Kapernam , ka nongrit harud ka Duriaw Galilaïa ka ha jong thain ka Sebulun bad ka Naphtali .
translation.en: And leaving Nazareth , he came and dwelt in Capernaum , which is upon the sea coast , in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim :
So the  Lord  smote the Ethiopians before Asa , and before Judah  ; and the Ethiopians fled .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jop ïa ka kynhun shipai Sudan mynba u Asa bad ki kynhun shipai jong ka Judia ki tur ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  , praise ye the  Lord  : for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers .
translation.kha: To rwai ha U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! u la pyllait im ïa kiba la shah banbeiñ na ka bor jong ki briew basniew .
Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu u la shim kpu , u la duwai ainguh bad la kdiah u , bad u la ai ïa ki synran jong u , Shim ïa u , une u long ka jong nga la ong .
translation.en: And as they did eat , Jesus took bread , and blessed , and brake it , and gave to them , and said ,  Take , eat : this is my body .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha nga ïa kane kawei : Hato phi pdiang ïa U Mynsiem da kaba leh ïa ba ka Hukum ka dawa ne da ïohsngew ïa ka Gospel bad ngeit ïa ?
translation.en: This only would I learn of you , Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?

translation.kha: Shah ba ïaid ngan hapdeng ki kynhun langbrot jong phi mynta ka sngi bad ban shim ïa ki baroh khunlangbrot baïong bad ïa ki khunblang baroh kiba thohbria bad thohbroin . Kata kan long ka bainong nga kaba kwah .
translation.en: I will pass through all thy flock to day , removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle , and all the brown cattle among the sheep , and the spotted and speckled among the goats : and of such shall be my hire .

translation.kha: Ki umphniang sleh bad ba-iwbih jingkhan mehding Eliada phi ban sngewkmen ïakynshi hynrei ïasngewthuh jingjynjar isynei pynkulmar ïa ka jingsuk jingmut jong phi .
translation.en: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart : so doth the sweetness of a man s friend by hearty counsel .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sngewthuh ki pdiang ïa jingpyn-i ki kiba dei , ki briew kiba kren bieit ki tur ruma sha ka jingjot .
translation.en: The wise in heart will receive commandments : but a prating fool shall fall .

translation.kha: jynreiñ Blei Ephesos shym la kyntait ïa satlak ki pdiang! ki briew , ïa nadong u la jied naduh kaba sdang . Phi tip ïa kaei Easter ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka khyllah ha ka nongbanbor Adaminekeb u Elijah ba pynphetwir ïasaid bad U lehnoh-ei pyrshah iohi Baasha Israel :
translation.en: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew . Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias ? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel , saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , phi long ki jong U pynlamwir , ko ki khun jong nga , bad phi la jop ïa ki nongïathuhlypa balamler , namar U Mynsiem Lebaoth don pynnep phi , u long ïohpdiang kham Kin Khatduh ïa u mynsiem ha kito kiba long tiengburom Gederothaim pyrthei .
translation.en: Ye are of God , little children , and have overcome them : because greater is he that is in you , than he that is in the world .

And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram : for when he was come , he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi , whom the  Lord  had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab .
translation.kha: U Blei u pyndonkam ïa kane ka jingleit jngoh ïa u Joram ban wanrah ka jingkyllon noh jong u Ahasaïah . Katba u Ahasaïah u dang don hangta , ma u bad u Joram ki la shah kynroi ha u briew uba kyrteng u Jehu , u khun jong u Nimshi , uba U  Trai  u la jied ban pynjot ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Ahab .

Ïa jingialeh kali ïapom jong u la sait ha jingïaburom pung Samaria ; ha kaba ki jingbanbeiñ jingbankhia jliah ïa ka snam jong u hynñiew bad ki nuti ki sum ki sleh hangta , said U Trai u la ong ba sep jia Jeush
translation.en: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria  ; and the dogs licked up his blood  ; and they washed his armour  ; according unto the word of the  Lord  which he spake .

translation.en: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb : in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the  Lord  for a drink offering .
And Jacob answered and said to Laban , Because I was afraid : for I said , Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me .
translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Nga la sheptieng , namar nga pyrkhat ïoh phin knieh jubor ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi na nga .

translation.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt , and the  Lord  brought an east wind upon the land all that day , and all that night  ; and when it was morning , the east wind brought the locusts .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u rah ïa la u diengduh , bad U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka lyer na shaphang mihngi ban beh ha kata ka ri baroh shi sngi bad baroh shi miet . Ynda mynstep kata ka lyer mihngi ka wan kit ïa ki puit .

translation.en: Now Rachel had taken the images , and put them in the camel s furniture , and sat upon them . And Laban searched all the tent , but found them not .

translation.kha: Me pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad pynpra ïa ki . Ki ïingsyiem kiba ki nongshun jong ngi la ki la jah noh junom .
translation.en: For thou hast made of a city an heap  ; of a defenced city a ruin : a palace of strangers to be no city  ; it shall never be built .

translation.en: The depth saith , It is not in me : and the sea saith , It is not with me .

translation.en: Behold , the Lord  God  will help me  ; who is he that shall condemn me ? lo , they all shall wax old as a garment  ; the moth shall eat them up .

translation.en: For my mouth shall speak truth  ; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips .

translation.en: As a fountain casteth out her waters , so she casteth out her wickedness : violence and spoil is heard in her  ; before me continually is grief and wounds .

translation.en: And as many as walk according to this rule , peace be on them , and mercy , and upon the Israel of God .

translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins ,  ( then saith he to the sick of the palsy , )  Arise , take up thy bed , and go unto thine house .

translation.en: And he lift up his eyes and looked , and , lo , three men stood by him : and when he saw them , he ran to meet them from the tent door , and bowed himself toward the ground ,

translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïalumlang ban ïaleh ïa u ; ki briew ki la ïawan na kylleng sawdong . Ki la phriang ïa la ki jar behmrad bad ki la ïohkem ïa u ha ka jingriam jong ki .
Ki la duh bor noh na ka jingtrei shitom ; kumba kin noh bad ym don ba .
translation.en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour  ; they fell down , and there was none to help .

translation.en: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet , and wept as he went up , and had his head covered , and he went barefoot : and all the people that was with him covered every man his head , and they went up , weeping as they went up .

translation.kha: Ka shithi kaba u patsha u Paradais thoh ka kren pyrshah ïa U Trai , bashaphang Blei ki Thep . Ka ong , Ki blei jong ryngkoh hima kim shym lah ban pyllait ïa ki briew jong ki na ka bor balang nga , bad da lei lei U Blei jong u Hesekaïah iitkhmat ym lah ban pyllait im ïa la ki briew na nga .
translation.en: He wrote also letters to rail on the  Lord  God of Israel , and to speak against him , saying , As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand , so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand .

translation.kha: U Laban u ong ha u , Shah ngan ong ïa kane : nga la ïoh jingtip da kaba na U ba U Trai kyrkhu ïa nga jong .
translation.en: And Laban said unto him , I pray thee , if I have found favour in thine eyes , tarry : for I have learned by experience that the  Lord  hath blessed me for thy sake .

translation.en: Thou shalt not be afraid of them : but shalt well remember what the  Lord  thy God did unto Pharaoh , and unto all Egypt  ;

translation.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them : but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them .
Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , eat that thou findest  ; eat this roll , and go speak unto the house of Israel .

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against Gog , the land of Magog , the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal , and prophesy against him ,

translation.en: Yet heard I the voice of his words : and when I heard the voice of his words , then was I in a deep sleep on my face , and my face toward the ground .
He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance , he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïoh spah da kaba kheiñ sut bad shim kabu ïa ki briew , ka spah jong phi kan leit sha uwei pat uba lehsbun ïa kiba duk .

translation.en: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem , saying , There is a king in Judah : and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words . Come now therefore , and let us take counsel together .
translation.kha: bad ba phi la pynbeit ba katto katne ki nongïathuhlypa kin pynbna ha Jerusalem ba phi long u syiem ka Judah . U syiem , khlem pep , un ïohsngew shaphang kane , kumta nga ai jingmut ba ma phi bad nga ngin ïakynduh ban ïakren halor kane ka kam .
U Trai u long uba bha ; u ïada ïa ki briew jong ha u ki por ka jingjynjar u ; ri sumar ïa kito kiba phai sha u .
translation.en: The  Lord  is good , a strong hold in the day of trouble  ; and he knoweth them that trust in him .

And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar , and of the anointing oil , and sprinkle it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon the garments of his sons with him : and he shall be hallowed , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons  garments with him .
translation.kha: Shim khyndiat ka snam kaba don ha kata ka duwan bad khyndiat ka umphniang pynsleh , bad synreit ha u Aaron bad ha ki jaiñkup jong u , bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ki jaiñkup jong ki . Ma ki bad ki jaiñkup jong ki kin long kiba la pynkyntang khuid sha nga .

translation.en: And he went forth again by the sea side  ; and all the multitude resorted unto him , and he taught them .

translation.en: And if a man also strive for masteries , yet is he not crowned , except he strive lawfully .

translation.en: And the angel said unto him , Gird thyself , and bind on thy sandals . And so he did . And he saith unto him , Cast thy garment about thee , and follow me .
For it came to pass , when Solomon was old , that his wives turned away his heart after other gods : and his heart was not perfect with the  Lord  his God , as was the heart of David his father .

translation.en: Thou shalt be perfect with the  Lord  thy God .

translation.en: And they journeyed : and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them , and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob .

translation.en: And hope maketh not ashamed ; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us .

translation.en: For what thanks can we render to God again for you , for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God ;

translation.en: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the  Lord  our God , to walk in his statutes , and to keep his commandments , as at this day .

translation.en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the  Lord  on the altar of the  Lord  , which he had built before the porch ,

translation.kha: Ïa phi ym dei ban khot ‘ ko jingsat ,’ namar ba phi baroh phi Pyrthei mar ryngkat phria don tang uwei U Nonghikai .
translation.en: But be not ye called Rabbi : for one is your Master , even Christ  ; and all ye are brethren .

translation.kha: Ki nong Gasa ki shem ba u Samson u don , hangta kumta ki kerkut ïa kata ka jaka bad ki ap ïa u shi baroh miet ha khyrdop shnong . Ki ap jar jar baroh shi miet , da pyrkhat kaba ha lade , Ngin ap haduh ban da kynjat shai , ban nangta ngin pynïap sa ïa u .

And the sons of Izhar  ; Korah , and Nepheg , and Zichri .
translation.kha: U Ishar u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Korah , u Nepheg , bad u Sikhri .

translation.en: But though I be rude in speech , yet not in knowledge ; but we have been thoroughly made manifest among you in all things .
translation.kha: Lehse nga long u bym da nang ban kren , hynrei da kaba sngewthikna ym ha ka jingtip ; ngi la pynshai ïa kane ha phi man la ka por bad ha ki jingshem baroh .
Bad balei ïaksaid shym la long kumta Elijah shongkhlad kim shym la shaniah napdeng ka jingngeit bastad ha kaei ba-halor ki la leh shakri Bad thup ki la jynthut ha U maw jong khlem jingjynthut
translation.en: Wherefore ? Because they sought it not by faith , but as it were by the works of the law . For they stumbled at that stumblingstone ;

Therefore wait ye upon me , saith the  Lord  , until the day that I rise up to the prey : for my determination is to gather the nations , that I may assemble the kingdoms , to pour upon them mine indignation , even all my fierce anger : for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy .
translation.kha: Shu ap ,  U  Trai  u ong .  Ap ïa ka sngi haba ngan ïeng ban pynrem ïa ki jaitbynriew . Ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei yn pynjot da ka ding ka jingbitar shla jong nga .

translation.en: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges ? who planteth a vineyard , and eateth not of the fruit thereof ? or who feedeth a flock , and eateth not of the milk of the flock ?
translation.kha: Uei u shipai uba ju dei ban siew ïa la ki jingpynlut ha ka kam shipai ? Uei u nongrep u bym bam ïa ki soh na la ka bri sohwaiñ ? Uei u nongaplangbrot u bym pyndonkam ïa ka dud na la ki jong ki langbrot ?

translation.en: Be ye not as your fathers , unto whom the former prophets have cried , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye now from your evil ways , and from your evil doings : but they did not hear , nor hearken unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat long kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi . La slem bah ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor jong nga , da kaba ïathuh ha ki ban ym im bymman , ban ym im shuh ka jingim bapop . Hynrei kim shym la shahshkor ïa nga lane kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: But when Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were with him , heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done ,

translation.en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you .

Foretelling a key part of the sign of “the last days ,” Jesus said : “This good news of the kingdom will be preached in all the inhabited earth for a witness to all the nations  ; and then the end will come .” —Matthew 24 :14 .
translation.kha: Ka jingiathuhlypa ia ka jinglong bakongsan shaphang ki dak jong “Ki sngi bakhadduh ,” U Jisu u la ong : “Te ia kane ka gospel jong ka hima yn ialap ha ka pyrthei baroh , ia kaban long ka jingphla ha ki kynja bynriew baroh ; ynda kumta kein kan jia kata kaba kut .” —Mathaios 24 :14 .

translation.en: And in the second month , on the seven and twentieth day of the month , was the earth dried .

translation.en: I commend unto you Phebe our sister , which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea .

translation.en: And Solomon said unto God , Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father , and hast made me to reign in his stead .

translation.en: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him .

translation.kha: U angel u la kylli ïa nga kaei nga la ïohi . Nga la jubab , Ka kot kli baher ha ka ; lyer ka don khyndai ka mitar lynter bad saw mitar shiteng ka pyngkiang .
translation.en: And he said unto me , What seest thou ? And I answered , I see a flying roll  ; the length thereof is twenty cubits , and the breadth thereof ten cubits .

translation.kha: Lada phi uba jaipdeh , phin ym ïoh da lei lei ïa kaei kaba phi ban long hadien , hynrei lada trei phin ïoh spah .
translation.en: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting : but the substance of a diligent man is precious .
Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban don khyndiat , kaba la kamai da ka hok , ban ïa kaba ïoh shibun , ba la lum da ka jingbymhok .

translation.en: And by their prayer for you , which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you .

translation.en: Neither shall ye build house , nor sow seed , nor plant vineyard , nor have any : but all your days ye shall dwell in tents  ; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers .

translation.en: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours ? only let us consent unto them , and they will dwell with us .
Moreover he hath not seen the sun , nor known any thing : this hath more rest than the other .

translation.en: So speak ye , and so do , as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty .
And immediately he arose , took up the bed , and went forth before them all  ; insomuch that they were all amazed , and glorified God , saying , We never saw it on this fashion .

translation.en: On the first day shall be an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong na kita ki sngi , ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat trei ei ei kumba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .

For in him we live , and move , and have our being  ; as certain also of your own poets have said , For we are also his offspring .

translation.en: Chasten thy son while there is hope , and let not thy soul spare for his crying .

hynrei u angel u la ha ong ki , To wat sheptieng ! Nga don hangne lem bad ka khubor babha na ka bynta jong phi , ka ban wanrah jingkmen ka kaba khraw ha ki briew baroh .

translation.en: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness , which causeth through us thanksgiving to God .

translation.en: Thou , O king , sawest , and behold a great image . This great image , whose brightness was excellent , stood before thee  ; and the form thereof was terrible .

translation.en: I returned , and saw under the sun , that the race is not to the swift , nor the battle to the strong , neither yet bread to the wise , nor yet riches to men of understanding , nor yet favour to men of skill  ; but time and chance happeneth to them all .

translation.en: Look even out the best and meetest of your master s sons , and set him on his father s throne , and fight for your master s house .

translation.en: That thou appear not unto men to fast , but unto thy Father which is in secret : and thy Father , which seeth in secret , shall reward thee openly .

translation.en: Here is wisdom . Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast : for it is the number of a man  ; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six .

But thou shalt die in peace : and with the burnings of thy fathers , the former kings which were before thee , so shall they burn odours for thee  ; and they will lament thee , saying , Ah lord ! for I have pronounced the word , saith the  Lord .

translation.en: And , behold , the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop , and brought in a great spoil with them : but Abner was not with David in Hebron  ; for he had sent him away , and he was gone in peace .

translation.en: And one of the multitude answered and said , Master , I have brought unto thee my son , which hath a dumb spirit  ;

translation.en: For he loveth our nation , and he hath built us a synagogue .

translation.en: But without faith it is impossible to please him : for he that cometh to God must believe that he is , and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him .

translation.kha: Lada phi long jai jai , phi long kiba stad , hynrei lada phi long kiba shit khlieh , phi shu pyn-i katno ka jinglong mutlop phi long .
haba u wan kata ka Sngi ban ïohpdiang ïa ka burom na ki briew u baroh bad ka jingpyndonburom na baroh ngeit . Phi phin long napdeng jong ki namar ba phi la ngeit ïa ka ngi la ïathuh ha .
translation.en: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints , and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day .
For when they had slain their children to their idols , then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it  ; and , lo , thus have they done in the midst of mine house .

translation.en: Few things are as fascinating as the good news from God .

translation.en: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle : them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me .
translation.kha: Me ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ban ïaleh thma , bad ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga .

translation.en: And they began to enquire among themselves , which of them it was that should do this thing .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la sdang ban kylli para ma ki uno napdeng jong ki uba lah ban long u ban sa leh ïa kane .
U Trai u jubab , Me lah ban leh ïa ka namar ngan ïarap ïa me . Men pynlwet ïa ki Midian da kaba suk i kumba ki long tang u briew .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Surely I will be with thee , and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man .
