translation.kha: Bad halor kata ka diengphna Shear U Khrist jingarsap shonshab pyllaitluid ïa lade na ka bor jong ki nongsynshar ba Khnang mynsiem lehse na ki bor synshar ; u la jingjot ka jingthadrong ïa ki dondor kaba ïalam ïa ki kum ki Shisha ha ka jingïaid paidbah kaba jop jong u .
translation.en: And having spoiled principalities and powers , he made a shew of them openly , triumphing over them in it .
And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people : and he shall be , even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth , and thou shalt be to him instead of God .
translation.kha: U un long u nongpynkren lem jong me bad un kren ha u paidbah na ka bynta jong me . Nangta me pat men long kum U Blei , da kaba ïathuh ha u aïu un ong .
Te , ma phi ki , phin tip ba nga don jong phi bad ba ma nga , U Trai , long U Blei jong phi bad ym don . briew jong nga kin ym shah ñiewbeiñ shuh .
translation.en: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel , and that I am the  Lord  your God , and none else : and my people shall never be ashamed .
And the people stood beholding . And the rulers also with them derided him , saying , He saved others  ; let him save himself , if he be Christ , the chosen of God .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la ïeng hangta da kaba khmih katba ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki krenbeiñ ïa u :  U la pynim ïa kiwei ; ai un pynim ïa lade lada u dei U Messaïah ïa uba U Blei u la jied !
U Judas ( ym Iskariot ) u la ong , Ko Trai , kumno lah ban long men pynpaw ïa lade ha bad ym ha pyrthei
translation.en: Judas saith unto him , not Iscariot , Lord , how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us , and not unto the world ?
They shall be burnt with hunger , and devoured with burning heat , and with bitter destruction : I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them , with the poison of serpents of the dust .
translation.kha: Kin ïap na ka jingthngan bad ka jingpang shit ; kin ïap na ki jingpang kiba ishyrkhei . Te ngan phah ki mradkhlaw ban kynrup ïa ki , bad ki bseiñ kiba don bih ban puh ïa ki .

Namar ba nga bitar ïa pha , ngan shah ïa ki ban leh ïa pha ha ka jingbitar jong ki . saitlah shiliang ïa ka khmut jong pha bad ïa ki shkor jong pha bad kin pynïap ïa ki khun jong pha . Ho-oid , kin shim ïa Rehoboth khun shynrang bad khun kynthei na kbeit Nebo ïingshong thang pyrshing Imrah ki ïakhlaiñ
translation.en: And I will set my jealousy against thee , and they shall deal furiously with thee : they shall take away thy nose and thine ears  ; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword : they shall take thy sons and thy daughters  ; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire .

translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa khuri , la ainguh ïa , bad la ai ïa ka ha ki . To ka , phi u la ong ;
translation.en: And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and gave it to them , saying ,  Drink ye all of it  ;
She looked at me .
translation.kha: Ka peit ianga .

translation.en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned two years over Israel .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khathynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u Ahab u sdang ban synshar ha Israel ; bad u synshar ar snem ha Samaria .

translation.en: And he shall pass through Judah  ; he shall overflow and go over , he shall reach even to the neck  ; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land , O Immanuel .
translation.kha: Kin sar lyngba ka Judah ha ka jingshlei um , da kaba kiew haduh tyrpeng bad tap lin ïa kaei kaei baroh .  U Blei u long lem bad ngi ! Ki thapniang jong u ba la pyiar shabar ki ïada ïa ka ri .

translation.en: For the kingdom of God is not in word , but in power .
translation.kha: Naba ka Hima U Blei kam long tang ha kaba kren hynrei ha ka bor .

translation.en: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets , he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la batai ha ki ïa kaei kaba la ong shaphang jong u hi ha baroh ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , da kaba sdang da ki kitab u Moses bad ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa baroh .
Ki don bad ki ïa ki khun ki , u Ahimaas bad u Jonathan , bad phi lah ban ïa ki sha nga lem bad jingtip baroh kiba phi ïohlum .
translation.en: Behold , they have there with them their two sons , Ahimaaz Zadok s son , and Jonathan Abiathar s son  ; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear .

translation.kha: Phi myntoi ïa lade haba phi bha sbun . Haba Hapdeng leh ki kam Minni , phi pynmynsaw hi ïa lade .
translation.en: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul : but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh .
And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea : who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews .
translation.kha: Mar ïapoi ka miet , ki parabangeit ki la phah ïa u Paul bad u Silas sha Beria . Haba ki la poi hangta , ki la leit sha ka synagog .

U Abner u phah ïajan ki nonglamktien sha u Dabid uba don ha Hebron ha paro ka por , ban Lehbha , Uei u ban synshar ïa kane ka ri ? Ïateh kular Ekron nga , bad ngan ïarap ïa ker ban sleh ïa Rishathaim Israel baroh sha ka Amram riewthala phi .
translation.en: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf , saying , Whose is the land ? saying also , Make thy league with me , and , behold , my hand shall be with thee , to bring about all Israel unto thee .

translation.kha: U Saul u ïalam lai hajar ngut ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel bad u la leit wad ïa u Dabid bad ïa ki rangbah jong u ha mihngi ka phang jong ki Mawsiang ki Blang Khlaw .
translation.en: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel , and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats .

translation.kha: Te u Samuel u la ïap , bad ki Israel baroh ki bad ïawanlang ïambriew na ka bynta jong u . Nangta ki ïa tep u ha ka ïing u jong ha Ramah . Hadien kane , u Dabid u leit sha ka ri khlaw Paran .
translation.en: And Samuel died  ; and all the Israelites were gathered together , and lamented him , and buried him in his house at Ramah . And David arose , and went down to the wilderness of Paran .

translation.kha: Ngin leh kumno Lot pynïoh Hammath lbak ki rangbah Seeb kiba dang sah ? Ngi la ohdur ïa ka jingkular kaba kyntang sha jinglehmeng Trai ba ngin Eglaim ai Martl Ethkasin ïa la shahïap khun kynthei .
translation.en: How shall we do for wives for them that remain , seeing we have sworn by the  Lord  that we will not give them of our daughters to wives ?

translation.kha: To burom plung U Trai lad kaba ai ha u ka jingainguh da mala jynreiñ jingshan bha tam ba ka lyngkha jong phi ka jingaibuit .
translation.en: Honour the  Lord  with thy substance , and with the firstfruits of all thine increase :

translation.kha: U Paul u la rung ha synagog bad ha ki lai bnai u la kren shlur bad ki paidbah , u da pynlong ki jingmut ki ban pynngeit ki ka Hima U Blei .
translation.en: And he went into the synagogue , and spake boldly for the space of three months , disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God .
The  Lord  is my strength and song , and he is become my salvation : he is my God , and I will prepare him an habitation  ; my father s God , and I will exalt him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u nongïada uba khlaiñ jong nga ; u long ma u , uba la pyllait im ïa nga . U dei U Blei jong nga , bad ngan ïaroh ïa u , U Blei jong u kpa jong nga , bad ngan rwai shaphang ka jingkhraw jong u .

translation.en: Be wise now therefore , O ye kings : be instructed , ye judges of the earth .
translation.kha: Mynta to shahshkor ïa kane ka jingmaham , ma phi ki syiem ; to ïoh jinghikai na kane , phi ki nongsynshar jong ka pyrthei .

U nongbud ba-hajan jong u syiem la u ong ha u Elisha , Kata kam lah ban jia — em wat lada U Trai da lade hi un phah shisien phah u ïa kew ! U u Elisha jubab , sa Men ïohi ïa kata ba ka jia , hynrei men ym ïoh bam na kata ka jingbam .
translation.en: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God , and said , Behold , if the  Lord  would make windows in heaven , might this thing be ? And he said , Behold , thou shalt see it with thine eyes , but shalt not eat thereof .
And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold : two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof , and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka jingtap da ka ksiar nylla , kaba shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang .
Haba ki la dep Khlem , ka jaka ha sngewdap jatkmie la ïakynduh ka Elisaphan Khreh . La pyndap ïa ki baroh da tuklar Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ki la sdang ban pynbna pdem ka khubor U Blei da ka jingshlur .
translation.en: And when they had prayed , the place was shaken where they were assembled together  ; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost , and they spake the word of God with boldness .

translation.kha: Nga ïaroh ïa me , A tynjuh ; to hikai ïa nga lyngraw ki Kohnguh jong me .
translation.en: Blessed art thou , O  Lord  : teach me thy statutes .

translation.kha: Pyndonkam ïa ban jingiwbih , ïa kum ka . Ber khyndiat mluh ban pynlong ka khuid bad kaba
translation.en: And thou shalt make it a perfume , a confection after the art of the apothecary , tempered together , pure and holy :
He brought them out , after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt , and in the Red sea , and in the wilderness forty years .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , u da leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla ha ka ri Ijipt bad ha ka Duriaw Basaw bad haduh sawphew snem ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And the second came , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained five pounds .
translation.kha: U shakri uba ar u la wan bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga la kamai san tylli ki sbai ksiar na kawei kaba me la ai ha nga .’

translation.en: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius  ; and said , Behold , I am he whom ye seek : what is the cause wherefore ye are come ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Petros u la leit hiar bad u la ong ha kita ki rangbah ,  Dei ma nga uta uba phi ïawad . Phi donkam aïu ?

translation.en: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty : and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags .
translation.kha: Kiba dih buaid bad kiba bam lalot kin kylla duk . Lada baroh kaba phi leh ka long tang ban bam bad thiah , shen phin sa phong da ki jaiñjot .
hadien u la im sa arspah khyndai , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei ki khun .
translation.en: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years , and begat sons and daughters .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ki jaka mane blei jong ki Jiw don hok ban bam na kano kano ka jingkñia ïa kaba halor ka duwan jong ngi .
translation.en: We have an altar , whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle .

Moab hath been at ease from his youth , and he hath settled on his lees , and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel , neither hath he gone into captivity : therefore his taste remained in him , and his scent is not changed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka Moab ka la ju long kaba shongshngain bad ym pat ju ïalam mraw ïa ka . Ka Moab ka long kum ka waiñ kaba la shu ieh kumta khlem pynkhih bad ka bym ju phylliew na uwei u klong sha uwei pat . Ïa ka jingsuhsieng jong ka ym pat shu pynsniew , bad ka jingmad jong ka , ka long kaba bang kumba ju long .
Ki Israel ki trei phyllad kane ka kam baroh kumba U jingkyang u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: According to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses , so the children of Israel made all the work .
And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen : and it was a very great company .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ki kali kulai bad ha ki kulai ruh ki ïaleit synran ïa u ; kumta ka kynhun ka long kaba bun .

U syiem Manasseh Thessaloni la leh ïa Kelita kiei kiei kiba ijli , kiei kiei kiba kham sniew ban ïabam kaei kaba ki nong Kanaan ki la leh , bad ryngkat bad ki bleithaw jong u , pynbatai la ïalam ïa ki pra jong jinglynñiar Judah ban leh pop Kidron
translation.en: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations , and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did , which were before him , and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols :

translation.kha: ba ka por jong u kut , un ïapstai noh , ïapstai noh kum ki tnat bad ym jyrngam biang .
translation.en: It shall be accomplished before his time , and his branch shall not be green .

translation.kha: To ïa ki da kaba kmen ïa ka jingjop ha ki ïingjaiñ ki briew jong U Blei Ka borbah jong U Trai ka la leh ïa ka
translation.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous : the right hand of the  Lord  doeth valiantly .

And there came a traveller unto the rich man , and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd , to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him  ; but took the poor man s lamb , and dressed it for the man that was come to him .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , la wan poi u nongwankai ha ïing jong uba riewspah . Uta u riewspah um kwah ban pynïap ïa uwei na ki jingri jong u ban khreh bam ïa uta u nongwan ; pynban , u la shim ïa i khunlangbrot jong uba duk , bad u la khreh jingbam ïa u nongwankai .
Ha kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , U Jisu dang u hikai ha ka synagog .
translation.en: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la khmih , nga la ïa ïohsngew u pukni her uba shajrong eh jong ka ba suiñ u pyrta ha ka sur kaba jam , Kaba kordit ! Kaba kordit ! Katno kaba kordit kan long ïa baroh kiba ha shong ka pyrthei haba ka jingsawa ka mih na ki turoi ïa kaba kita kiwei pat ki lai ngut ki angel kin put .
translation.en: And I beheld , and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven , saying with a loud voice , Woe , woe , woe , to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels , which are yet to sound !

translation.kha: Ha ka snem pyniar lai jong ïatehktien Akaba kerkut , ka Samaria ka sngewkyiuh iohpateng kane duriaw-bah dei Bamaïan snem kaba bhah jong sbun jingsynshar u Hesekaïah shait bad ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea .
translation.en: And at the end of three years they took it : even in the sixth year of Hezekiah , that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel , Samaria was taken .
For they are my servants , which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt : they shall not be sold as bondmen .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki long ki mraw jong U  Trai  , bad u wallam ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt ; ym dei ban die mraw ïa ki .
ki Kumta la leit bad ïalap ba ki briew kin phai noh na ki pop jong ki .
translation.en: And they went out , and preached that men should repent .

translation.kha: Leh kumba u Joab u ong , u Solomon u jubab . ïa Pynïap u bad tep ïa u . Nangta ym ma nga ne mano mano na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid ki ban shah kynnoh shuh na ka bynta kaei kaba u Joab u la leh haba u la pynïap ïa ki rangbah lui kiba lui .
translation.en: And the king said unto him , Do as he hath said , and fall upon him , and bury him  ; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood , which Joab shed , from me , and from the house of my father .

translation.kha: Lada uno pynbna ha kaba paw ba u long u jong nga , ngan leh kumjuh ha khmat U Kpa jong nga bneng .
translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men , him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven .
Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee , and awake that shall vex thee , and thou shalt be for booties unto them ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ha shuwa ba phin tip ïa ka , phi kiba la jop ïa kiwei phin don ha ka ram ïa lade bad shah pynbor ban siew ïa ka sut . Ki nongshun kin wan bad pynkyiuh ïa phi . Kin thombor ïa phi !
U Jakob u bteng , Joseph , ki khun shynrang jong me ar ngut kiba me la ïoh ha shuwa ba ngan hangne ki dei ki jong nga ; u Ephraim bad u Manasseh ki long ki jong nga long u Reuben bad u Simeon .
translation.en: And now thy two sons , Ephraim and Manasseh , which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt , are mine  ; as Reuben and Simeon , they shall be mine .

translation.kha: Hamar ka kynjat shai jong kata ka sngi , ki khlur ïarwai lang , bad baroh ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng risa da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: When the morning stars sang together , and all the sons of God shouted for joy ?

translation.kha: Kumta u buh lang ïa ha haduh lai sngi
translation.en: And he put them all together into ward three days .

translation.kha: Hynrei wat lada ngi ïaphla kumne , ko paralok ba-ieit , ngi sngewskhem shaphang jong phi . Ngi tip markylliang jat ïoh ïa ki jingkyrkhu kiba kham bha kiba nongïarap bad ka jingpynim kliar phi .
translation.en: But , beloved , we are persuaded better things of you , and things that accompany salvation , though we thus speak .

translation.kha: Katba u lyoh u dang neh sngewsarong Kohnguh , ki ruh kim kynriah na ka jaka Jaasanaïah dara .
translation.en: But if the cloud were not taken up , then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up .
He moveth his tail like a cedar : the sinews of his stones are wrapped together .
translation.kha: U tdong jong u , u ïeng kum u dieng Kedar ; ki ksah ha ki khohwah jong u ki long kiba khlaiñ .

Ka long kaba dei ban kynmaw , da shisha , ba ïa ki la hukum thaw , ym na ka bynta ki briew ki babha , hynrei ïa ki nongpynkheiñ hukum bad ki riewrunar , na ka bynta kiba Blei khlem bad kiba pop , na ka bynta kito ki bymriewblei ne ki bym long mynsiem kiba kynja , kito kiba pynïap ïa la ki kpa bad ki kmie na , ka bynta ki nongpynïap briew , na bynta ka kiba leh kam ba-ijli , na ka bynta kiba awria , ki nongrahbor , na ka bynta kito kiba shukor kiba bad ai jingphla lamler lane kito kiba ïa leh kano kano kaba markhongpong ïa ka kaba jinghikai shisha .
translation.en: For whoremongers , for them that defile themselves with mankind , for menstealers , for liars , for perjured persons , and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine ;

translation.kha: tohmet Elijah u rah biang ïa Bilhan khynnah shapoh sha ka kmie Agag u bad Bahok Jeshanah ha ka pynbudnam Peit , u sner jong pha u la im !
translation.en: And Elijah took the child , and brought him down out of the chamber into the house , and delivered him unto his mother : and Elijah said , See , thy son liveth .

Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not , and upon the families that call not on thy name : for they have eaten up Jacob , and devoured him , and consumed him , and have made his habitation desolate .
translation.kha: Pynphai ïa ka jingbitar jong me halor ki jaitbynriew ki bym mane ïa me bad halor ki briew kiba kyntait ïa me . Ki la pynïap ïa ki briew jong me ; ki la pynjot khoit ïa ngi bad iehnoh ïa ka ri jong ngi ha ka jingjot jingpra .
ha kaba nga la ïa ïohi Trai U , haba u la ong ha nga , ‘ Pynkloi bad mihnoh kyrkieh na Jerusalem , namar ki briew hangne kin ym pdiang ïa ka jong jingsakhi me shaphang jong nga .’
translation.en: And saw him saying unto me ,  Make haste , and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem : for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me .

translation.kha: U Blei u phah ïa u slap ban ai ïa ka khyndew lah ban phah ïa u ban pynshitom ïa ngi , lane ban ïa jingsngewbha jong .
translation.en: He causeth it to come , whether for correction , or for his land , or for mercy .

translation.kha: U bret ïa Sipporah kynhun shipai jong ka Ijipt bad ïa ki kali ïapom jong ka sha ka duriaw ; ki rangbah pynïaidkam bakynsai jong ka Kieng la ïap jyllop ha Synagog Duriaw Basaw
translation.en: Pharaoh s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea : his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea .

And I will clothe him with thy robe , and strengthen him with thy girdle , and I will commit thy government into his hand : and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and to the house of Judah .
translation.kha: Ngan buh ïa ka jaiñkup bad u panpoh nongpynïaidkam jong me halor jong u bad ngan ai ha u ka iktiar baroh kaba me la don . U , un long kum u kpa ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem bad ka Judah .
Ha ka sngi kyntiew kurim , u Othniel u pdot ïa ka , ban Tlai lyngkha na u kpa jong Elhanan . Ka la shahskhor nongsharai ka kada Tarshish ka , bad u Kaleb Epikuri kylli ïa ka aïu ka kwah .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when she came to him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted from off her ass  ; and Caleb said unto her , What wilt thou ?
And it came to pass after this , that Ben–hadad king of Syria gathered all his host , and went up , and besieged Samaria .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , u Benhadad u syiem ka Syria u la ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh kawei pyrshah ïa ka Israel bad kerkut ïa ka nongbah Samaria .

translation.en: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom  ; I have led thee in right paths .
translation.kha: Nga la hikai ha phi ïa ka jingstad bad ka rukom im kaba dei .
Kumta u la ai ïa ka kaba eh ba un pynlong ïa ba kin ha ka ri shyiap
translation.en: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them , to overthrow them in the wilderness :

Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty , thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness : I will cast thee to the ground , I will lay thee before kings , that they may behold thee .
translation.kha: Me la sngewsarong ba me long uba bhabriew , bad ka nam jong me ka la pynlong ïa me ban leh kum u bieit . Namar kane nga la bret ïa me sha khyndew bad ieh ïa me kum ka jingmaham ïa kiwei pat ki syiem .
Ki paid Judah ki jied ïa rymphum Joahas u khun jong u Josaïah bad jingsdang pynsleh syiem ïa u ha duwai .
translation.en: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and made him king in his father s stead in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ngan ym randien lano ruh na ka jingdawa ba shym bakla ; ka jingïatiplem nga ka beit .
translation.en: My righteousness I hold fast , and will not let it go : my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live .
Who was faithful to him that appointed him , as also Moses was faithful in all his house .
translation.kha: U long uba shaniah ha U Blei , uba la jied ïa u ban leh ïa kane ka kam , kumba u Moses u la long uba lah ban shaniah ha ka kam jong u ha ka ïing U Blei .

translation.en: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour , and cities which ye built not , and ye dwell in them  ; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka khyndew ha kaba phim shym la trei bad ïa ki nongbah kiba phim shym la tei . Mynta phi shong phi sah hangta bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba phim shym thung , bad ki soh Olib na ki dieng kiba phim shym thung .’
Ki ingmane jong ka Asia ki phah jingkhublei ka ïa ; phi u Akwila bad ka Priskila bad ka balang kaba ïakynduh ha ka ïing jong ki , ki phah ïa ka jingkhublei parabangeit .
translation.en: The churches of Asia salute you . Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord , with the church that is in their house .
And he said , About this season , according to the time of life , thou shalt embrace a son . And she said , Nay , my lord , thou man of God , do not lie unto thine handmaid .
translation.kha: bad u Elisha u ong ha ka ,  Kum ha kane ka por ha ka snem kaba bud phin rah ïa u khun ha ki ksang ti jong phi .   O !  ka ong da kaba kyndit .  Sngewbha , ko kynrad , wat lamler ïa nga . Phi dei u briew jong U Blei !

translation.en: We have sinned , and have committed iniquity , and have done wickedly , and have rebelled , even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments :
translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop , ngi la long kiba sniew , ngi la leh bakla . Ngi la kyntait ïa kaei kaba me la hukum ïa ngi ban leh bad ngi la phai noh na kaei kaba me la pyn-i ha ngi ba ka long kaba dei .
Uwei pa uwei u ïeng ha la ka jaka sawdong ka dara , bad ka jong ki nongshun ki phet ïap da kaba lynñiar
translation.en: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp : and all the host ran , and cried , and fled .

translation.kha: Baroh ki wad jingtip na u ïa ka jingstad ba U Blei u la ai ha u .
translation.en: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon , to hear his wisdom , that God had put in his heart .
Then I testified against them , and said unto them , Why lodge ye about the wall ? if ye do so again , I will lay hands on you . From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath .
translation.kha: Nga maham ïa ki ,  Kam myntoi ban ap hangto habar ki kynroh ka nongbah na ka bynta ka step ka ban wan . Lada phi pyrshang biang ïa kane , ngan pyndonkam da ka bor pyrshah ïa phi .  Naduh kata , kim ju wan shuh ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: O Lord , hear  ; O Lord , forgive  ; O Lord , hearken and do  ; defer not , for thine own sake , O my God : for thy city and thy people are called by thy name .
translation.kha: A Trai , to sngew ïa ngi . A Trai , to map ïa ngi . A Trai , to shahshkor ïa ngi , bad to trei ! Khnang ba uwei uwei baroh un tip ba me long U Blei , wat ym pynslem ! Kane ka nongbah bad kine ki briew ki long ki jong me .

translation.en: Sing and rejoice , O daughter of Zion : for , lo , I come , and I will dwell in the midst of thee , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  To rwai da ka jingkmen , ko ki paid ka Jerusalem ! Nga wan ban shong ban sah hapdeng jong phi !

translation.en: Then he said unto me , Hast thou seen this , O son of man ? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here ? for they have filled the land with violence , and have returned to provoke me to anger : and , lo , they put the branch to their nose .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , me ïohi ïa katai ? Kine ki briew ka Judah kim pat hun tang kaba leh ïa ki kam ba-ijli kiba me la ïohi hangne bad ban pynphriang ïa ka ri da ka jingleh thombor . Em , ki dei ban wan bad leh ïa ki hangne hi ha ka Templ ban pynbitar shuh shuh ïa nga . Peit kumno ki beiñ ïa nga ha ka rukom kaba kham palat .
Hynrei U Trai u ong , Ko Israel bad Judah Kaei , kaba ngan leh ïa phi ? Ka jingieit jong phi ïa ka nga jah noh shen kum u slap mynstep ; ka long kum ka umjer , kaba jah noh shen ha ka . sngi
translation.en: O Ephraim , what shall I do unto thee ? O Judah , what shall I do unto thee ? for your goodness is as a morning cloud , and as the early dew it goeth away .

translation.kha: U Abimelekh u shong ha Arumah , bad u Sebul u beh krad ïa u Gaal bad ïa ki hynmen Kedesh ton shynrang jong u na Shekhem , ba kumta kim lah shuh ban para ban sah hangta .
translation.en: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah : and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren , that they should not dwell in Shechem .

translation.kha: Ngam pat ju kyrngah ïarap duk ; ngam pat shah ïa ki riewkynthei ban im jynjar
translation.en: If I have withheld the poor from their desire , or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail  ;
A just weight and balance are the  Lord s  : all the weights of the bag are his work .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kwah ba ki tarajur bad ki mawthew ki dei ban long kiba beit bad baroh ka jingïadie ïathied kan long kaba hok .
U Kaleb u jingsngewmeng krad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Anak na ka nongbah — ki kur Sheshai , Ahiman , sdieh Talmai .
translation.en: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak , Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai , the children of Anak .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pynkhuid ïa ïing da snam jong kata ka sim , ka um , ka sim kaba dang im , u lyngkhot , u tnat , bad saw .
translation.en: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird , and with the running water , and with the living bird , and with the cedar wood , and with the hyssop , and with the scarlet :

Behold , therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee , and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen  ; and I will cut thee off from the people , and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries : I will destroy thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Namar ïa kaei kaba phi la leh , ngan aiti noh ïa phi sha ki kiwei ki jaitbynriew ki ban lute ïa phi bad pynjot ïa phi . Ngan pynjot lut ïa phi ba phin ym long shuh ka jaitbynriew lane ban don ka ri la ka jong . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Nathanael saith unto him , Whence knowest thou me ? Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Before that Philip called thee , when thou wast under the fig tree , I saw thee .
translation.kha: U Nathanael u la kylli ïa u ,  Kumno me ithuh ïa nga ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga la ïohi ïa me mynba me dang don ha trai u dieng Dumbur ha shuwa ba u Philip un khot ïa me .

translation.en: For all the land which thou seest , to thee will I give it , and to thy seed for ever .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me ïa ka ri baroh kat kaba me ïohi , bad kan long ka jong me junom .
U Khrist u long ka dur bapaw jong Blei U u bym lah ban ïohi . U long U Khun ba la kha nyngkong , uba hakhlieh jong duh kiei kiei baroh kiba la thaw .
translation.en: Who is the image of the invisible God , the firstborn of every creature :

translation.kha: Ka trai duriaw ka paw tyngkreiñ bad ki nongrim jong ka pyrthei ruh la pynpaw , haba U Trai u kynteit ïa nongshun jong u , u kyrhuh ïa ka
translation.en: And the channels of the sea appeared , the foundations of the world were discovered , at the rebuking of the  Lord  , at the blast of the breath of his nostrils .
He shall enter also into the glorious land , and many countries shall be overthrown : but these shall escape out of his hand , even Edom , and Moab , and the chief of the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Un hiarthma wat ïa ka Ri ka Jingkular bad un pynïap da ki phew hajar , hynrei ki ri Edom , Moab , bad kaei kaba la iehnoh jong ka Ammon kin lait .

translation.en: After that he brought me toward the south , and behold a gate toward the south : and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures .
translation.kha: Nangta pat , uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka liang kaba shathie , bad hangta ngi la ïohi sa ïa kawei pat ka khyrdop . U la thew ïa ki kynroh bashapoh bad ïa ka kamra rung jong ka , bad ka la long katjuh kum kito kiwei pat .
bad haba ki ïohsngew ba u la ïa u syiem bad pynïap ïa u , hangta hi ki baroh ki pynbna u nongai hukum jong , u Omri , u long u syiem ka Israel .
translation.en: And the people that were encamped heard say , Zimri hath conspired , and hath also slain the king : wherefore all Israel made Omri , the captain of the host , king over Israel that day in the camp .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada u paidbah u leh Lem ïa kata kaba u la leh bad kim pynïap ïa u ,
translation.en: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man , when he giveth of his seed unto Molech , and kill him not :
Moreover , brethren , I would not that ye should be ignorant , how that all our fathers were under the cloud , and all passed through the sea ;
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban kynmaw , ko parabangeit jong nga , ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kiba la bud ïa u Moses . Baroh ki la don hapoh ka jingïada jong u lyoh , bad baroh ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Duriaw Basaw .

translation.en: But he passing through the midst of them went his way ,
translation.kha: hynrei , u la ïaid lyngba napdeng jong u paidbah bad u la leit ha la ka lynti .
U Trai u ong , Nga isih ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi ; ngam lah shah ki ïa !
translation.en: I hate , I despise your feast days , and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies .
Then the king said to the wise men , which knew the times , ( for so was the king s manner toward all that knew law and judgment :
translation.kha: Ka ju long ka rukom u syiem ban pan jingmut na ki riewshemphang halor kiei kiei kiba ïadei bad ka shongsuk shongsaiñ ka hima , kumta u khot ïa ki nongai jingmut jong u , kiba lah ban tip kaei kaba dei ban leh .

translation.en: And , Thou , Lord , in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth  ; and the heavens are the works of thine hands :
translation.kha: U la ong ruh ,  Me , A Trai , ha kaba mynnyngkong me la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , bad da la ki kti hi me la thaw ïa ki bneng .

translation.en: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king s most noble princes , that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour , and bring him on horseback through the street of the city , and proclaim before him , Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour .
translation.kha: Nangta shim ïa uwei na ki riewdonburom uba don ka kyrdan ba-halor eh ban pynriam ïa uta u briew da kine ki jingriam bad un ïalam ïa u , ba la pynshong halor u kulai lyngba ka jaka paidbah jong ka nongbah . Ai ba uta u riewdonburom un pyrta katba ki nang ïaid : ‘ Peit kumno u syiem un ainong ïa u briew uba u kwah ban pyndonburom !’

bad ryngkat lang leit sha ka , ba la synran da ki lyngdoh bad ki da kiwei ki briew , kiba bad kiba duk kumjuh . Ha khmat jong ki baroh , u syiem u pule jam ïa ka kitab baroh ka , kaba la shem ha ka Templ .
translation.en: And the king went up into the house of the  Lord  , and all the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and the priests , and the Levites , and all the people , great and small : and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the  Lord .
And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens : and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timothy for to come to him with all speed , they departed .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba la ïalam ïa u Paul ki la ïaleit bad u haduh Athens bad nangta ki la wan phai sha Beria lem bad ki jingbthah na u Paul ba u Silas bad u Timothi ki dei ban leit sha u kloi katba lah .

translation.en: And when they were come to Capernaum , they that received tribute money came to Peter , and said , Doth not your master pay tribute ?
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la wan sha Kapernam , ki nonglum ïa ka khajna Templ ki la wan ha u Petros bad ki la kylli ,  Hato u Nonghikai jong phi u siew ïa ka khajna Templ ?
U jubab , Nga ka jingïakut bad u Mikah , u da siewdor ïa nga shakri kum u u .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me , and hath hired me , and I am his priest .

translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh un rah khyndiat ka snam uta u masi shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ
translation.en: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation :

translation.kha: Bad ki jaitbynriew kin tip ba Naphtuh Israel Lasha jingsngem shah ringmraw namar ki Amphipolis ba ki la leh pyrshah ïa nga . ïalam la phai noh na ki bad nga la shah ïa ki nongshun jong Jerikho jingkahtngen jop ïa ki bad ban pynjrong ïa ki ha ïashong thma .
translation.en: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity : because they trespassed against me , therefore hid I my face from them , and gave them into the hand of their enemies : so fell they all by the sword .
What hath my beloved to do in mine house , seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many , and the holy flesh is passed from thee ? when thou doest evil , then thou rejoicest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew kiba nga ieit ki la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew . Ki don hok aïu ban don hapoh ka Templ jong nga ? Hato ki pyrkhat ba ki lah ban ïada na ka jingpynjot da kaba pynlong ki jingkular bad da kaba ai ki jingkñia da ki mrad ? Hato kata kan pynkmen ïa ki ?
Ko Pa u , duwai , Ko Pa jong nga ! Baroh kiei kiei ki long kiba lah ha me . Shim noh na nga ïa kane ka khuri jong ka jingshahshitom . Pynban ym ïa kaei kaba kwah nga , hynrei ïa kaei kaba me . kwah
translation.en: And he said ,  Abba , Father , all things are possible unto thee  ; take away this cup from me : nevertheless not what I will , but what thou wilt .

Behold , this day thine eyes have seen how that the  Lord  had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave : and some bade me kill thee : but mine eye spared thee  ; and I said , I will not put forth mine hand against my lord  ; for he is the  Lord s  anointed .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban shem da lade hi ba dang myntan hapoh ka krem U  Trai  u la buh ïa phi hapoh ka bor jong nga . Katto katne ki rangbah jong nga ki ong ïa nga ban pynïap ïa phi , hynrei nga sngewsynei ïa phi bad ong ba ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa phi , namar phi dei uta uba U  Trai  u la jied ban long syiem .
Haba nga ai jingmut , ki ramhah ki sngap tin bad ki shahshkor bha ïa syngkhlieh kaba sting ong ;
translation.en: Unto me men gave ear , and waited , and kept silence at my counsel .

translation.kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un ban hukum pynïap ïa kawei na kita ki sim halor u khiew khyndew ha uba don ka um kaba sngur na umpohliew ka .
translation.en: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water :
And they departed into a desert place by ship privately .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la sdang ban leit da ka lieng tang ma ki hi sha ka jaka kynjah .
U Khun U Briew u la wan ban wad ban bad pynim ïa kiba la jah noh .
translation.en: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la kren biang ha nga u la , ong
translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïatainia kaba slem u u Petros la ïeng bad u la ong , Ko hynmen ko para jong nga , phi tip ba la slem kham mynshuwa U Blei u la jied ïa nga napdeng jong phi ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha sha ki Jentil , ba khnang ki ban lah ïohsngew bad ngeit .
translation.en: And when there had been much disputing , Peter rose up , and said unto them , Men and brethren , ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us , that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel , and believe .

translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u Balaam u la leit sha ki nonglamktien jong u Balak ong bad u , Khie leit phai sha la ïing ; U Trai um shah ba ngan leit bad phi .
translation.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning , and said unto the princes of Balak , Get you into your land : for the  Lord  refuseth to give me leave to go with you .

translation.kha: Lehse kin duwai ha U Trai bad phai pat na ki lynti ki , namar U Trai u la byrngem ïa kane ka jaitbynriew da ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla bashyrkhei .
translation.en: It may be they will present their supplication before the  Lord  , and will return every one from his evil way : for great is the anger and the fury that the  Lord  hath pronounced against this people .
Many shall be purified , and made white , and tried  ; but the wicked shall do wickedly : and none of the wicked shall understand  ; but the wise shall understand .
translation.kha: Ïa kiba bun ki briew yn pynkhuid . Kito kiba bymman kin ym sngewthuh hynrei kin ïailong bymman ; tang kito kiba stad kin shemphang .
Kane ka dei ka hukum jong ka Templ : Baroh ka jaka sawdong jong ka halor jong u lum Ephron long ishongkun kyntang bad kaba khuid .
translation.en: This is the law of the house  ; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy . Behold , this is the law of the house .

translation.kha: U wan ha poi ka krem hajan ki katto katne ki jaka set blang kiba harud lynti , bad u rung ban shapoh leit shabar . Ka jia ryngkhat ba dei ka kajuh ka krem ha kaba u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki rieh kham shapoh jong kata ka krem .
translation.en: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way , where was a cave  ; and Saul went in to cover his feet : and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ban ïohi ïa phi palat ban ïa kaba shu wan jngoh ha ka jingïaid ; ban pynlut shibun bad phi , lada U Trai u shah
translation.en: For I will not see you now by the way ; but I trust to tarry a while with you , if the Lord permit .

translation.kha: Ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa U Jisu hangta hi , Joash ki la tip ba u la ïathuh ïa kane ka pharshi Yiron ïa ki ; hynrei ki la ïasheptieng ïa pynslem paidbah Mikhmethath
translation.en: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him  ; and they feared the people : for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them .

translation.kha: Phim ju kwah ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga lane shahshkor nga pynbeit ïa phi .
translation.en: They would none of my counsel : they despised all my reproof .
And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest , and found mandrakes in the field , and brought them unto his mother Leah . Then Rachel said to Leah , Give me , I pray thee , of thy son s mandrakes .
translation.kha: Ha ka aïom ot kew , u Reuben u la leit sha lyngkha bad u lap ïa ki mandriek    , kiba u la wanrah sha ka kmie jong u ka Leah . Ka Rakhel ka ong ïa ka Leah ,  Ai lem katto katne ki mandriek jong u khun jong pha .

translation.en: And Saul , and Jonathan his son , and the people that were present with them , abode in Gibeah of Benjamin : but the Philistines encamped in Michmash .
translation.kha: U Saul , u Jonathan u khun jong u , bad ki rangbah jong ki , ki sher dara ha Geba ha ka thain Benjamin ; ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ka dei ha Mikhmash .
Ka jingieit ka dei ban long kaba sngur . To isih ïa kaei kaba sniew , to batskhem ïa kaei bha kaba .
translation.en: Let love be without dissimulation . Abhor that which is evil ; cleave to that which is good .

translation.kha: Ko ki jong briew ka Ijipt khie , leit sha Gilead wad bad ïa ka dawai ! Ki dawai jong pha baroh ki la pynshisha ba kim myntoi ei ei ; ym don ei ei ba lah ban pynkhiah ïa pha .
translation.en: Go up into Gilead , and take balm , O virgin , the daughter of Egypt : in vain shalt thou use many medicines  ; for thou shalt not be cured .
Heaven and earth shall pass away : but my words shall not pass away .
translation.kha: Ka bneng bad ka pyrthei kin leit noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym leit noh lano lano ruh .

translation.en: And if a man lie with a beast , he shall surely be put to death : and ye shall slay the beast .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano ka mrad , ma u bad kata ka mrad ki dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: And David said to Uriah , Go down to thy house , and wash thy feet . And Uriah departed out of the king s house , and there followed him a mess of meat from the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha u Uriah ,  Khie leit sha la ïing bad pynjahthait katto katne .  U Uriah u la mih , bad u Dabid u la phah ka jingai sngewbha sha ïing jong u .
Nga pynjot ïa ka Babilon bad pynsngap jar nga ïa ka . Ki kynhun shipai ki tur shapoh kum ki jingat phyllung bakyrhuh bad tur ïaleh da ki jingpyrta bajam .
translation.en: Because the  Lord  hath spoiled Babylon , and destroyed out of her the great voice  ; when her waves do roar like great waters , a noise of their voice is uttered :

translation.kha: Kaba bam than ïa ka ngap kam ïa bha phi ; bad kumta ruh ka long kaba pyrshang ban ïoh palat ka jingïaroh .
translation.en: It is not good to eat much honey : so for men to search their own glory is not glory .

And thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  , and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel , saying , They are laid desolate , they are given us to consume .
translation.kha: Te men sa tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ jong me ba ïa ki lumbah ka Israel ba ki la sah kynjah bad ba ki long ki jong me ba men bam duh .

Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad ïa-ïuh briew haba ka dang poi bnai , dei ban tait noh ïa ki baroh ar ngut Mar la buit parabriew pansngiat namar ki la buria ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih riewkhñium ïadei bad Kumba jingbymkhuid .
translation.en: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness , and shall uncover her nakedness  ; he hath discovered her fountain , and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood : and both of them shall be cut off from among their people .

translation.kha: Ym namar ba nga Uto ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingai sngewbha ïa-dawa pynban nongmih nga kwah ban Kim Uno la pynlang ïa ka jingïohnong jingkieng bat jingbuh Lehbha jong phi kynshleiñ
translation.en: Not because I desire a gift : but I desire fruit that may abound to your account .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Ahab u syiem bad Israel u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah ki leit tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .
translation.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead .
The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge : but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shemphang ki kwah ban ïoh hikai , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki sngewhun ha ka jingbieit .
Hynrei U Blei u la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ka them ha kaba u u shong shnong , u la buh jingkynmaw ïa u , bad u la ailad ïa Lot ban lait im .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when God destroyed the cities of the plain , that God remembered Abraham , and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow , when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt .

translation.kha: na ka riewkynthei ki pop jong ki bad ki ïaksaid jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki Mareal Ki la thang ki Boses ha ki duwan thala kiba halor ki lum bad ki khlaw kren sniew ïa nga . Kumta ngan pynshitom ïa ki rangdajied ka dei hok ïa ki namar ki kam banep ki la jingkyrkhu mynshuwa .
translation.en: Your iniquities , and the iniquities of your fathers together , saith the  Lord  , which have burned incense upon the mountains , and blasphemed me upon the hills : therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom .
The wicked have waited for me to destroy me : but I will consider thy testimonies .
translation.kha: Ki riewbymman ki apthap ban pynïap ïa nga , hynrei ngan puson ïa ki aiñ jong me .
Nangta sa khmied biang ïa ka pyrthei , kum skhem uba bad uba shlur .
translation.en: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot  ; yea , thou shalt be stedfast , and shalt not fear :
When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee , he went unto him , and besought him that he would come down , and heal his son : for he was at the point of death .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la wan na Judia sha Galilaïa , u la leit sha u bad kyrpad ïa u ban leit sha Kapernam bad ban pynkhiah ïa u khun jong u , uba don ha tmier ka jingïap .

bad ai ïa kane ka hukum ha u Hilkaïah lyngdoh u , ha u Ahikam u khun jong u , Shaphan ha u Akhbor u khun jong u Mikaïah , ha Shaphan u , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ha u Asaïah , u nongbud jong u syiem :
translation.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Achbor the son of Michaiah , and Shaphan the scribe , and Asaiah a servant of the king s , saying ,

translation.kha: To khmih nangto na ka jaka shong bakhuid jong me ha bneng bad kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , bad ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap ba me la ai ha ngi , kumba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .’

translation.en: For the king will hear , to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba phin shahshkor bad pyllait im ïa nga na uta uba pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga bad ïa u khun jong nga , bad kumta ban weng noh ïa ngi na ka ri kaba U Blei u la ai ha ki briew jong u .
Lah ban jied da ka langbrot ne da ka blang , tangba u dei ban long u uba shynrang shisnem bad u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: Your lamb shall be without blemish , a male of the first year : ye shall take it out from the sheep , or from the goats :
For what if some did not believe ? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kumno lada katto katne na ki kim long kiba ïaineh ? Hato kane ka mut ba U Blei un ym long uba ïaineh ?

lamwir ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga kylli : Hato une u punkhun sohwaiñ un im bad san ? translation.en: Say thou , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Shall it prosper ? shall he not pull up the roots thereof , and cut off the fruit thereof , that it wither ? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring , even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof .

translation.en: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham , calling him lord : whose daughters ye are , as long as ye do well , and are not afraid with any amazement .

translation.en: And he called unto him his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That this poor widow hath cast more in , than all they which have cast into the treasury :

translation.en: For the  Lord  your God is God of gods , and Lord of lords , a great God , a mighty , and a terrible , which regardeth not persons , nor taketh reward :

translation.en: Woe unto him that saith to the wood , Awake  ; to the dumb stone , Arise , it shall teach ! Behold , it is laid over with gold and silver , and there is no breath at all in the midst of it .

translation.en: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them .

All the king s servants , and the people of the king s provinces , do know , that whosoever , whether man or woman , shall come unto the king into the inner court , who is not called , there is one law of his to put him to death , except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre , that he may live : but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days .

translation.en: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law , when thou art passed over , that thou mayest go in unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , a land that floweth with milk and honey  ; as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee .

translation.en: But I tell you of a truth , there be some standing here , which shall not taste of death , till they see the kingdom of God .

translation.en: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies , who vexed them : and in the time of their trouble , when they cried unto thee , thou heardest them from heaven  ; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours , who saved them out of the hand of their enemies .

translation.en: For they are a nation void of counsel , neither is there any understanding in them .

Hadien kane nga la ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel wan hiar na bneng . U la don ka bor bakhraw , bad jingphyrnai jong u la pynthaba ka pyrthei baroh .
translation.en: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven , having great power  ; and the earth was lightened with his glory .
I the  Lord  search the heart , I try the reins , even to give every man according to his ways , and according to the fruit of his doings .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga wad ïa ki jingmut bad nga tynjuh ïa ki dohnud jong ki briew . Nga leh ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum ka lynti ba u im , kat kum kaei kaba u leh .
Nga long u Alpha bad u Omega , ong kita Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , Konanaïah long , uba la long bad u ban sa Krispos .
translation.en: I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the ending ,  saith the Lord ,  which is , and which was , and which is to come , the Almighty .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron la long ki lyngdoh u , bad u Samuel u long uwei uba la duwai ha u ; kiba la khot U Trai , bad u la ïa ki .
translation.en: Moses and Aaron among his priests , and Samuel among them that call upon his name  ; they called upon the  Lord  , and he answered them .
I am the God of Beth–el , where thou anointedst the pillar , and where thou vowedst a vow unto me : now arise , get thee out from this land , and return unto the land of thy kindred .

translation.en: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness , and all the store cities , which he built in Hamath .

translation.en: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen , and thou shalt be near unto me , thou , and thy children , and thy children s children , and thy flocks , and thy herds , and all that thou hast :

translation.en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long : for they are confounded , for they are brought unto shame , that seek my hurt .

And he shall not look to the altars , the work of his hands , neither shall respect that which his fingers have made , either the groves , or the images .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I am Pharaoh , and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt .

translation.en: And he came into all the country about Jordan , preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u Ïoannis u la leit kylleng ka thain baroh jong ka wah Jordan , u da ïalap ,  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad to shah ba yn pynbaptis , bad U Blei un map ïa ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will make thee a terror to thyself , and to all thy friends : and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies , and thine eyes shall behold it : and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall carry them captive into Babylon , and shall slay them with the sword .

Ngan buh ïa baroh ki briew jong ka Judah hapoh ka bor jong u syiem ka Babilonia ; un shim katto katne ngut kum ki koidi sha ka ri jong u bad pynïap ïa kiwei pat .
Mynta Job , to ïa kaei ong ; long jar bad shah ba ngan .
translation.en: Mark well , O Job , hearken unto me : hold thy peace , and I will speak .
And Jonathan called David , and Jonathan shewed him all those things . And Jonathan brought David to Saul , and he was in his presence , as in times past .

translation.en: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness : they shall be driven on , and fall therein : for I will bring evil upon them , even the year of their visitation , saith the  Lord .

But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water : yet they shall flee away . Stand , stand , shall they cry  ; but none shall look back .

translation.en: For he shall not much remember the days of his life  ; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart .

translation.en: Give ye ear , and hear my voice  ; hearken , and hear my speech .

translation.en: But fornication , and all uncleanness , or covetousness , let it not be once named among you , as becometh saints ;

translation.en: Yet saith the house of Israel , The way of the Lord is not equal . O house of Israel , are not my ways equal ? are not your ways unequal ?

translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la ong , Nga smai ba nga kren ïa ka jingshisha ! Ai ba U Blei un pynshitom ïa nga ngam lada long kumta ! Ngam tip shaphang uta u briew phi uba kren !
translation.en: But he began to curse and to swear , saying , I know not this man of whom ye speak .

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynlong ïa ki ban kut Ïai ban ïaleh Tirsah ki Israel , ba pyndonkam kin shah pynrem sha ka jingpynjot thiaw bad ba baroh kin shah pynïap khlem ka jingisynei . Kane ka long kaba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: For it was of the  Lord  to harden their hearts , that they should come against Israel in battle , that he might destroy them utterly , and that they might have no favour , but that he might destroy them , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
And when Jesus knew it , he saith unto them ,  Why reason ye , because ye have no bread ? perceive ye not yet , neither understand ? have ye your heart yet hardened ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki dang ïakren , kumta u la kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi ïakren shaphang ka jingbymdon kpu ? Hato phim pat tip lane sngewthuh ? Hato ki jingmut jong phi ki dang dum ?

translation.en: Saying , The prison truly found we shut with all safety , and the keepers standing without before the doors : but when we had opened , we found no man within .
translation.kha: Haba ngi la poi ha phatok , ngi la shem ba la khang pynskhem ïa ka bad baroh ki nongap phira kiba ap ki don ha ka khyrdop ; hynrei haba ngi la plie ïa ki khyrdop , ngim shem ïano ïano ruh hapoh !

bishni kane la pyn-i lyngba Salome jingshisha nylla Berothai Blei Isynei la buh ïa kawei pat ka pyndih , ïa kaba la khot Ha kane Ituria sngi . Bun snem hadien u la kren lyngba u Dabid saphron ka khñiot Bakhuid ïa jynreiñ la lah kdew : Lada jingkhwan jubor Kpu ka sur jong U Blei Shim kane ka sngi , pyrsa pyneh ïa la jingkhñium dohnud .
translation.en: Again , he limiteth a certain day , saying in David , To day , after so long a time  ; as it is said , To day if ye will hear his voice , harden not your hearts .
All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt , which came out of his loins , besides Jacob s sons  wives , all the souls were threescore and six  ;
translation.kha: Baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob kiba la leit sha Ijipt , lait noh ki tnga jong ki khun shynrang jong u , ki long hynriewphew hynriew ngut .

translation.en: This know also , that in the last days perilous times shall come .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba kin sa wan ki por kiba jynjar ha ki sngi kiba khatduh .

translation.en: Who rejoice to do evil , and delight in the frowardness of the wicked  ;
translation.kha: ki briew kiba sngewtynnat ha kaba leh kam sniew bad kiba lehkmen ha ki kam bymman ki bym don jingmut ,
Elisha u la ïathuh ha u syiem ba ha kaba kum kata ka por ha ka sngi kaba bud lai kilo u kew uba tam hynriew kilo u barli die Samaria ha ka dor sbai rupa
translation.en: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king , saying , Two measures of barley for a shekel , and a measure of fine flour for a shekel , shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria :

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u byllien la wan sha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u la ba U Jisu u dang sha Jerusalem
translation.en: On the next day much people that were come to the feast , when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem ,

translation.kha: Ynda ki leit phai sha la u kpa , u kylli ïa ki Snem Kumno phi ïawan kloi mynta ka sngi ?
translation.en: And when they came to Reuel their father , he said , How is it that ye are come so soon to day ?
And the flax and the barley was smitten : for the barley was in the ear , and the flax was bolled .
translation.kha: U  saihon bad u barli ki la duh khoit , namar u barli u la ih bad u  saihon pat u dang shylluit .

translation.en: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl : his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires .
translation.kha: ïa u saphron , u kalamus , ïa ka siasia , lane ka jingiwbih kaba bun jait . Ka mirr bad ka alos ki mih hangta lem bad ki jingsleh kiba iwbih tam .

Pynban um shym la pynïap ki khun ki kti jong ki , hynrei u la kaei U Trai u la hukum Ka Hukum u Moses : Ïa ki kmie ki kpa ym ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki khun jong ki , bad ïa ki khun ym ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew la leh da ki kmie ki kpa jong ki ïa u briew ban pynïap tang namar ka kam sniew kaba ma u u la leh
translation.en: But he slew not their children , but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses , where the  Lord  commanded , saying , The fathers shall not die for the children , neither shall the children die for the fathers , but every man shall die for his own sin .

translation.kha: Hynrei kiba mynta ki long kiba ha shuwa kin long khatduh , bad kiba mynta ki long khatduh kin kiba ha shuwa .
translation.en: But many that are first shall be last  ; and the last shall be first .

translation.kha: Ki nongbah kiba sha jngai eh shaphang kiba shathie dei ki jong , ki kito kiba hajan u pud jong ka Edom , ki long ka Kabseel , ka Eder , ka Jagur ,
translation.en: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel , and Eder , and Jagur ,

translation.kha: Haba U Khrist la shahshitom ha ka doh , phi phi dei ban pynkhlaiñ ïa da ka jingpyrkhat kaba u don ; namar uno uno uba shahshitom ka doh um ïakhleh shuh bad ka pop .
translation.en: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh , arm yourselves likewise with the same mind : for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin  ;

translation.kha: Balei ba phi ïa u thiat ha ka khmat u jong phi hynrei phim pynleit jingmut ïa ka lyngkhot dieng ha ka khmat jong phi ?
translation.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?

translation.kha: Hato me don jingtip haduh katno ka heh ka pyrthei ? To jubab ïa nga me lada tip .
translation.en: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth ? declare if thou knowest it all .
And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ki paidbah jong ka Gibeon , kiba dei ki Hib , ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Joshua u la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad ïa ka Ai ,
U pynim bad u phylla im ; u leh ïa Regemmelekh jingphylla bad ki kambah ha bneng bad ha pyrthei . U la pynim ïa u Daniel Khat-ar kaba shah pynïap ha ïa-shahskhor sing .
translation.en: He delivereth and rescueth , and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth , who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions .

translation.kha: U mai ïa ki jaitbynriew — hato un ym pynshitom ïa ki ? U long u nonghikai jong ngi baroh hato — un ym jingtip don ei ei ?
translation.en: He that chastiseth the heathen , shall not he correct ? he that teacheth man knowledge , shall not he know ?
Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin .
translation.kha: Suk u briew uba ïa ki pop jong u , U Trai un ym buh jingkynmaw shuh !

translation.en: And Jesus rebuked him , saying ,  Hold thy peace , and come out of him .  And when the devil had thrown him in the midst , he came out of him , and hurt him not .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u mynsiem ,  Sngap jar bad mihnoh na une u briew !  U mynsiem bymkhuid u la bret ïa uta u briew sha madan ha khmat jong ki , bad u la mihnoh na u , khlem pynmynsaw ei ei ïa u .
Hynrei dei tang uwei ujuh bad hi U Mynsiem uba leh ïa kane baroh ; ha mon ka jong u , u ai ïa ka jingai bapher ha uwei pa uwei .
translation.en: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit , dividing to every man severally as he will .
And he took up his parable , and said , Balaam the son of Beor hath said , and the man whose eyes are open hath said :
translation.kha: Nangta u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Ka khubor u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , Ki ktien jong u briew uba lah ban ïohi shai kdar ,
Bad mynta ngan ïuh ïa phi ha madan bad ud kum ba la pynkit khia da u kew .
translation.en: Behold , I am pressed under you , as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves .
So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh ïa kane , phin pynsngewbha ïa U Blei bad ïa u briew .
Uta u briew na uba ki ksuid ki la mihnoh u la kyrpad ïa U Jisu , Shah ïa nga leit ban lem bad me . U Hynrei Jisu u la phah noh ïa u , da u ong ,
translation.en: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him : but Jesus sent him away , saying ,
And David said unto him , Thy blood be upon thy head  ; for thy mouth hath testified against thee , saying , I have slain the  Lord s  anointed .
translation.kha: bad u Dabid u ong ha uta u nong Amalek ,  Me la wallam ïa kane halor lade . Me la pynrem ïa lade haba me phla ba me la pynïap ïa uta uba U  Trai  u la jied ban long syiem .
Kata ka ri kan long kum ka kynton ñiut ha kaba ki mradkhlaw im . Kan kaba shyrkhei ban peit yn ym don mano mano ban sah hangta , bad baroh kiba sngewshyrkhei .
translation.en: And Babylon shall become heaps , a dwellingplace for dragons , an astonishment , and an hissing , without an inhabitant .

translation.kha: Hynrei uta u briew la ïohkhiah um tip ba U Jisu u la long uei , naba la don u paidbah ha ka jaka , U u lah mihnoh jar jar .
translation.en: And he that was healed wist not who it was : for Jesus had conveyed himself away , a multitude being in that place .

translation.kha: Bad U u Jisu la ong ha u , To khie joit bad leit ; ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .
translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Arise , go thy way : thy faith hath made thee whole .

Then said Abishai to David , God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day : now therefore let me smite him , I pray thee , with the spear even to the earth at once , and I will not smite him the second time .
translation.kha: U Abishai u ong ha u Dabid ,  Ha kane ka miet , U Blei u la aiti ïa u nongshun jong phi ha ka bor jong phi . Mynta shah ngan tynrah tang shisien tynrah da une u sum jong u hi haduh khyndew ; ngam donkam ban da tynrah ïa u ar sien !

Ki la sheptieng ïa ki nong Babilonia namar ba u Ishmael u la ïa u Gedalaïah , uba u syiem ka Babilon la u lat jong kata ka . Kumta ki la leit sha Ijipt , khnang ba kin na nong Babilonia . Ha lynti , ki sangeh ha Shimham kaba hajan Bethlehem
translation.en: Because of the Chaldeans : for they were afraid of them , because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam , whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land .
Moses commanded us a law , even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob .
translation.kha: Ngi kohnguh ïa ka Aiñ ba u Moses u ai ha ngi , ka spah kordor tam jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .

translation.en: It seemed good unto us , being assembled with one accord , to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngi la ïakynduh lang bad baroh ngi la ïamynjur ban jied katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien bad phah ïa ki sha phi . Kin ïaleit bad ki paralok ba-ieit jong ngi : U Barnabas bad u Paul ,

translation.en: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs , and a target of brass between his shoulders .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kjat jong u la sop da ka rnong , bad u kieng ïa u sum rnong ba tawah ha ka tyrpeng .

Hynrei mynta , to pynphai noh ïa ka ha tnga jong ka . U dei u nongïathuhlypa , bad un sa duwai na ka bynta jong me , ba kumta men ym ïap Hynrei mem pynphai pat , maham ïa me ba men , me bad ki jong me baroh
translation.en: Now therefore restore the man his wife  ; for he is a prophet , and he shall pray for thee , and thou shalt live : and if thou restore her not , know thou that thou shalt surely die , thou , and all that are thine .

translation.kha: U ïaboi Sudan uba kyrteng u Serah kupar tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah Janoah bad ka kynhun shipai kaba pui Phi million phohsniew rangbah bad pynïohnong tylli ki kali ïapom bad ki tur shaphrang haduh Mareshah .
translation.en: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand , and three hundred chariots  ; and came unto Mareshah .

Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah , and said unto him , What said these men ? and from whence came they unto thee ? And Hezekiah said , They are come from a far country unto me , even from Babylon .
translation.kha: Te u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Hesekaïah bad u la kylli ,  Nangno kine ki briew ki wan bad kaei kaba ki ong ïa phi ?  U Hesekaïah u la jubab ,  Ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai bha , na Babilonia .

translation.en: Deliver me , I pray thee , from the hand of my brother , from the hand of Esau : for I fear him , lest he will come and smite me , and the mother with the children .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me ba men pyllait ïa nga na ka kti u Iso u hynmen jong nga . Nga sheptieng — sheptieng ba u wan ban ïaleh bad pynïap lut ïa ngi baroh , wat ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah ruh .

translation.en: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you , as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor , and as the fulness of the winepress .
translation.kha: Yn ñiew ïa kane ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang ba ka ïaryngkat dor bad ka jingainguh ba u nongrep u wanrah da u kew thymmai bad ka waiñ thymmai .

translation.en: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the  Lord  in their third generation .
translation.kha: Ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki naduh kaba lai pateng bynriew ter ter lah ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .
Namar me la pynjot pynpra ïa ka ri , bad pynïap ïa ki , ïa me yn ym tep kum ïa kiwei pat ki syiem . Ym don mano mano na ka longïing basniew me ban lait im .
translation.en: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial , because thou hast destroyed thy land , and slain thy people : the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned .
And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God .
translation.kha: Ki Apostol bad kiwei pat ki riewngeit ha kylleng ka Judia ki la ïohsngew ba ki Jentil ruh ki la pdiang ïa ka ktien U Blei .
ngaiñ U Madon nongap jingri jong u Saul , u Doeg uba na Edom jingryntih da kaba jia ryngkhat u don hangta ha kata Jingpynjot sngi , namar u hap ban pyndep ïa Rehoboth kamram “buh . hylla
translation.en: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day , detained before the  Lord   ; and his name was Doeg , an Edomite , the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul .
And Moses said , Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings , that we may sacrifice unto the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Lada kumta , phin hap pynbiang ïa ngi da ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh thang ban ai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .
kynhun shipai Judia ka la shahjop , ki shipai ki phet sha la ki ïing
translation.en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel , and they fled every man to his tent .

translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta hynñiewspah hynñiewphew hynñiew snem .
translation.en: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years : and he died .
And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the  Lord  : and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward , by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz .
translation.kha: U Isaïah u duwai ha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam shadien ha ki mawkyrdon ba la buh da u Syiem Ahas .

Nga sngewthuh kumno ka long kyrduh haba , kumno ka bad long ban don pahuh kyrhai . Nga la nang ïa ka kane buit barieh , ba hangno hangno ha kano kano ka por , nga sngewhun haba lada nga sngewdap kyrhai ne sngew kyrduh lane haba nga don palat than eh ne don khyndiat eh .
translation.en: I know both how to be abased , and I know how to abound : every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry , both to abound and to suffer need .
But if any man be ignorant , let him be ignorant .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada um pynleit jingmut ïa kane , phi wat salia ïa u .
Hato ki Jiw te ki don ha kano kano ka jingmyntoi ban ïa Jentil ki ? Lane hato don kano kano ka dor ha jingotsher ka ?
translation.en: What advantage then hath the Jew ? or what profit is there of circumcision ?

translation.kha: Nga jubab la , Kam long kumta ! Ngam phet noh . Hynrei u Irijah um sngap nga ïa . Pynban , u la kem ïa nga bad ïalam ïa nga sha ki rangbah synshar .
translation.en: Then said Jeremiah , It is false  ; I fall not away to the Chaldeans . But he hearkened not to him : so Irijah took Jeremiah , and brought him to the princes .
Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will cast thee from off the face of the earth : this year thou shalt die , because thou hast taught rebellion against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bad kumta U  Trai  hi u ong ba un weng noh ïa me . Ha shuwa ban kut kane ka snem men ïap namar me la ong ïa ki briew ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
Hynrei namar ba phi la pyn-i ïa kum kane ka jingñiewbeiñ ïa U Trai ha kaba leh ïa kane , u khun jong phi un ïap .
translation.en: Howbeit , because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the  Lord  to blaspheme , the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die .

translation.kha: Haba ka ktien ka poi la ha u syiem ka ba Judah ki kynhun shipai ka Syria ki la da don hapoh ka ri Israel , ma u bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la sngewshyrkhei shikatdei ha ki kaba la khynñiuh kum ki dieng ba la pynkhih da ka lyer .
translation.en: And it was told the house of David , saying , Syria is confederate with Ephraim . And his heart was moved , and the heart of his people , as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind .

translation.kha: Ka sngi ka ka jingpynshitom wan la , bad ki Israel kin sa shah pynjot . Ko ki paid Israel , kane kan jia da shisha !
translation.en: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke : among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be .
The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them  ; because they refuse to do judgment .
translation.kha: Ïa ki bymman la pynrem da ka jingleh jubor jong ki hi ; ki kyntait ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
Hynrei u ju leit noh ki sha jaka kynjah , ha kaba u la duwai .
translation.en: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness , and prayed .

translation.kha: jingriewblei Israel ki kynriah jaka Sah lada uta u lyoh u kiew shajrong na kata ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle , the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys :

translation.kha: Lai sngi hadien u Jeroboam ki paidbah baroh ki wan biang sha u syiem Rehoboam , kumba u la bthah ïa ki .
translation.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day , as the king had appointed , saying , Come to me again the third day .

translation.kha: U Moses u rah ïa la ka kti shajrong , bad kumta ka ri Ijipt kawei baroh ka la dum ngaiñ lai sngi lynter .
translation.en: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven  ; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days :

For the  Lord  thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp , to deliver thee , and to give up thine enemies before thee  ; therefore shall thy camp be holy : that he see no unclean thing in thee , and turn away from thee .
translation.kha: Sumar khuid ïa ka jaka shong dara jong phi , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u don ryngkat bad phi hangta ban ïada ïa phi bad ai ha phi ka jingjop ïa ki nongshun jong phi . Wat leh ïa kano kano kaba khlem akor kaba lah ban pynlong ïa U  Trai  ban phai noh na phi .
Ka Mari ka pynïapher sah bad ka Elisabeth kumba lai bnai bad shawei :16 Isshaïah lyngkniap pat sha ïing .
translation.en: And Mary abode with her about three months , and returned to her own house .

translation.kha: briew ki ïalap ha nga bad Wat ïalap ha ngi Wat ïalap shaphang kata baroh . U Blei un pynjahburom ngi
translation.en: Prophesy ye not , say they to them that prophesy : they shall not prophesy to them , that they shall not take shame .

translation.kha: Un aiti noh ïa me bad ïa ki sngwthuh ha ki Kano litar Lashai ka muhor ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin sa shajan ryngkat bad nga , bad U Trai un aiti noh ruh ïa ka Rakkon ïapom Samsummim Israel ha ki Philistia .
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines : and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me : the  Lord  also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines .

translation.kha: Balei ba me buh ïa nga hapoh u nongap phira ? Me pyrkhat ba nga jongisynei u mrad kynsha ka duriaw ?
translation.en: Am I a sea , or a whale , that thou settest a watch over me ?
For I say unto you , I will not drink of the fruit of the vine , until the kingdom of God shall come .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ba naduh mynta ngan ym dih ïa kane ka waiñ tad ynda ka Hima U Blei ka wan .

translation.en: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor  ; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not  ;
translation.kha: namar u la banbeiñ bad leh bymsuidñiew ïa kiba duk bad ba u knieh noh ïa ki ïing kiba kiwei ki la thaw ,

translation.en: Of the sons of Uzziel  ; Michah the first , and Isshiah the second .
translation.kha: U Ussiel , u khun uba saw jong u Kohath , u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Mikah bad u Isshaïah .
ki kylli na U Trai , Dang don shuh mano mano ? U Trai u , u Saul u hangtai , u rieh ha lyndet ki jingkit .
translation.en: Therefore they enquired of the  Lord  further , if the man should yet come thither . And the  Lord  answered , Behold , he hath hid himself among the stuff .

translation.kha: Nangta u Soitan u mihnoh na nonghiarpateng pynspong Trai bad u pynsaja Timon ki tohjaw ha baroh shi rynïeng ka met said u Job Siddim
translation.en: So went Satan forth from the presence of the  Lord  , and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown .
And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage , and ran into the army , and came and saluted his brethren .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ieh ïa kata ka jingbam ha u rangbah uba dei peit ïa ka bam , u mareh sha ba don ki hynmen , bad u kylli kumno ki ïalong .

translation.en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching , and ye took me not : but the scriptures must be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Man ka sngi nga la don bad phi ban hikai ha ka Templ , bad phim shym la kem ïa nga . Hynrei ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki dei ban urlong shisha .
U Dabid u rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ïambriew Ba ka bynta u sngewlyngngoh : Balei u Abner Ïakynduhlang dei ban ïap kum ba-thaba bieit ?
translation.en: And the king lamented over Abner , and said , Died Abner as a fool dieth ?
And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not , and if he be pleased to dwell with her , let her not leave him .
translation.kha: Bad lada ka parabangeit ka la shongkurim ïa u briew u bymngeit bad u mynjur ban ïaishong bad ka , kam dei ban pyllait noh ïa u .

translation.en: And the king sat upon his seat , as at other times , even upon a seat by the wall : and Jonathan arose , and Abner sat by Saul s side , and David s place was empty .
