translation.en: Then shalt thou say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will fill all the inhabitants of this land , even the kings that sit upon David s throne , and the priests , and the prophets , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , with drunkenness .
translation.kha: Nangta ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pyndap ïa ki briew ha kane ka ri da ka waiñ tad haduh ba kin buaid : ki syiem , kiba long kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid , ki lyngdoh , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad baroh ki briew jong ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And they were scattered , because there is no shepherd : and they became meat to all the beasts of the field , when they were scattered .
translation.kha: Namar ba ki langbrot kim don u nongsharai , ki la sakma noh , bad ki mradkhlaw ki pynïap bad bam ïa ki .
Jingthoh Bakhuid ong , Mano batip ïa jingmut U ? Mano ba lah ban ai jingmut ïa u ? Pynban , ma ngi , ngi don ïa ka U Khrist .
translation.en: For who hath known the mind of the Lord , that he may instruct him ? But we have the mind of Christ .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa kata ka prum pdiang bad lada u shñiuh hangta u la kylla lieh bad Thohdieng ka prum ka i kumba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , kata kyrpang dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh , bad Assyria lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u tem u long u prokram Matthat
translation.en: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh : and when the hair in the plague is turned white , and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh , it is a plague of leprosy : and the priest shall look on him , and pronounce him unclean .

translation.kha: U buh ïa baroh ki rangbah ha ka nongbah ka hapoh jingai hukum ki rangbah shipai bad u hukum ïa ki ban ïalumlang ha ka jaka kaba ha kylluid ka khyrdop ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he set captains of war over the people , and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city , and spake comfortably to them , saying ,
And he had an helmet of brass upon his head , and he was armed with a coat of mail  ; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass .
translation.kha: bad u phong ka jingkieng atiar da ka rnong kaba khia kumba sanphew hynñiew kilo bad ka jingda khlieh da ka rnong .
ba Teman ki riewbymman napdeng jong phi kiba la ïalam bakla ïa la samthiah para pynryngkang leilieh thaw ban mane pynlyngngoh ki blei kiba phim Tohu mane mynno mynno .
translation.en: Certain men , the children of Belial , are gone out from among you , and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city , saying , Let us go and serve other gods , which ye have not known  ;

translation.kha: Bad to U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingïaishah bad ka jingpynshlur un , pynlah ïa phi ban don kajuh ka jingmut hapdeng jong phi da kaba bud ïa ka U nuksa Khrist Jisu ,
translation.en: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus :
I beseech thee , O  Lord  , remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart , and have done that which is good in thy sight . And Hezekiah wept sore .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A  Trai  , ba nga la shakri ïa me ha ka hok bad jingïaineh skhem , bad nga la pyrshang borabor ban leh ïa kaei kaba me kwah ïa nga ban leh .  Bad u sdang ban ïamkthang .
Phi ïa syiem bad ki nongïalam , hynrei mynta kumno ki pyllait im ïa ka ri ?
translation.en: I will be thy king : where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities ? and thy judges of whom thou saidst , Give me a king and princes ?
To him that made great lights : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: U la thaw ïa ka sngi bad ïa u bnai ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
Kumta U Trai u , jubab Hato ka briew ka lah ban klet noh ïa la i khunlung bad ban ym ieit ïa i iba khun ka la kha ? Wat la ka kmie ka lah ban klet ïa la i khun , da lei lei ngan ym klet phi ïa .
translation.en: Can a woman forget her sucking child , that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb ? yea , they may forget , yet will I not forget thee .

translation.kha: bad lada hadien , ha kata ka jaka ba mih u tohjaw , ka don jingat ka kaba lieh ka ne dak kaba byrsaw-lieh , u dei ban leit pyn-i ha u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising , or a bright spot , white , and somewhat reddish , and it be shewed to the priest  ;
The simple inherit folly : but the prudent are crowned with knowledge .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duna ka jingtip ki ïoh ïa kaei kaba ka jingbieit jong ki ka dei ban ïoh , hynrei ha kiba sian la ainong da ka jingtip .

translation.en: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down , What is sweeter than honey ? and what is stronger than a lion ? And he said unto them , If ye had not plowed with my heifer , ye had not found out my riddle .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ha shuwa ba u Samson un leit sha la kamra thiah , ki briew jong kata ka shnong ki ong ha u ,  Kaei kaba kham thiang ban ïa ka ngap ? Uei uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa u sing ?  U Samson u jubab ,  Lada phim shym la lur da ka masi jong nga , Phin ym tip ïa ka jubab mynta .

Te u Jehoïada ïa ka synduk , u ksam ha ka jingtap , bad u buh ïa ka synduk hajan ka duwan , ha ka kamon haba rung sha ka Templ . Ki kiba dei treikam ha ka jaka rung ki ha ka synduk ka pisa baroh kaba la ai da ki nongwan mane .
translation.en: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest , and bored a hole in the lid of it , and set it beside the altar , on the right side as one cometh into the house of the  Lord  : and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord .
And I will give unto thee , and to thy seed after thee , the land wherein thou art a stranger , all the land of Canaan , for an everlasting possession  ; and I will be their God .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me , bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me , ïa kane ka ri ha kaba mynta me long u nongwei . Ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei kan long ka jingïohkynti junom jong ki khun ki ksiew jong me ; bad nga ngan long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: And the west border was to the great sea , and the coast thereof . This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families .
translation.kha: kaba pynlong ïa ka pud sepngi . Hapoh kine ki pud sawdong ki shong ki sah ki briew kiba na ki longïing u Judah .

translation.en: So Gad came to David , and told him , and said unto him , Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land ? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies , while they pursue thee ? or that there be three days  pestilence in thy land ? now advise , and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me .
translation.kha: u Gad u la leit sha u , ban ïathuh ïa u ïa kaei ba U  Trai  u la ong , bad u kylli ,  Kano kata ka ban long ? Lai snem ka  nemsniew ha ka ri jong phi , lane lai bnai kaba phet ïap na ki nongshun jong phi , ne lai sngi ka jingïapthem ha ka ri jong phi ? Mynta to pyrkhat , bad ïathuh ha nga kaei ka jubab ba ngan leit rah sha U  Trai .

Phi khot ïa Shabbethai , U Ashteroth , haba phi duwai ha U Blei , uba bishar ïa jaiñspong briew baroh da kajuh ka sngewbit , Shim kum kaei kaba uwei pa Siph u la leh ; kumta te , to pynlut ïa Eliashib mem ka jingim jong phi hangne ha Ngam pyrthei ha ka jingtiengburom ïa bapawkhmat .
translation.en: And if ye call on the Father , who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man s work , pass the time of your sojourning here in fear :

translation.kha: Baroh ngi Tarsos jingmyntoi na jemnud jingbam bakynja mynsiem
translation.en: We all benefit from our spiritual food

translation.kha: U Trai ïambriew long u syiem , bad ki briew Ahishahar khynñiuh . U shong ha ka khet halor ki kherub , bad ka pyrthei kan khynñiuh .
translation.en: The  Lord  reigneth  ; let the people tremble : he sitteth between the cherubims  ; let the earth be moved .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor baroh , Blei U ki Israel , u ong Haba , ngan wallam pat ïa ki briew sha ka ri jong ki , sa shisien pat kin ong ha ka ri Judah bad ki shnong ka jong , ‘ To U un Trai kyrkhu ïa u lum bakyntang jong ka Jerusalem , ka jaka bakhuid ha kaba u shong .’
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof , when I shall bring again their captivity  ; The  Lord  bless thee , O habitation of justice , and mountain of holiness .
Their throat is an open sepulchre ; with their tongues they have used deceit ; the poison of asps is under their lips :
translation.kha: Ki ktien jong ki , ki dap da ki jingshukor bashyrkhei ; ki jingthok ba-bymman ki mih na ki thylliej jong ki , bad ki jingbyrngem kiba ma , kum ka bih bseiñ , na ki rmiang shyntur jong ki ;

translation.en: Go , I pray you , prepare yet , and know and see his place where his haunt is , and who hath seen him there : for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad da pynthikna bha sa shisien pat ; wad biang biang ha-ei u don , bad uei uba la ïohi ïa u hangta . Nga tip ba u long uba sianti bha .

translation.en: Men groan from out of the city , and the soul of the wounded crieth out : yet God layeth not folly to them .
translation.kha: Ha ki nongbah , kiba mynsaw bad kiba la jan ïap ki lynñiar , hynrei U Blei um patiaw ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .

translation.en: And when ye did eat , and when ye did drink , did not ye eat for yourselves , and drink for yourselves ?
translation.kha: Bad haba ki la bam bad dih , ka long na ka bynta ka jingpynhun ïa ki hi .

translation.en: They did eat , they drank , they married wives , they were given in marriage , until the day that Noah entered into the ark , and the flood came , and destroyed them all .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh u ïai ïabam bad ïadih , bad ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ki ïashongkurim , haduh ka sngi kaba u Noah u la leit rung shapoh ka lieng bad ka jingshlei um ka la wan bad ka la pynïap ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men s lives , but to save them .  And they went to another village .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit sha kawei pat ka nongrit .

translation.en: And he brake in pieces the images , and cut down the groves , and filled their places with the bones of men .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u la pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki rishot maw , u ot lyngkhot ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah , bad ïa ka jaka ha kiba ki ïeng u la tap da ki shyieng briew .
Ki Israel ki ïamihnoh na bad Sukkoth ki sher dara ha Etham , ha ka tduh jong ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: And they took their journey from Succoth , and encamped in Etham , in the edge of the wilderness .

translation.kha: U Petros jingkhlem-akor la pynlong ïa kane pynmatlah shonshab ñiut ki saphriang da ki kyntien babun u la kyrpad Bethgamul ki , da kaba jingshalan jingïamynjur tawah pynim ïa lade na Aram jingpynshitom kaba sot ha une u paidbah ba-bymman !
translation.en: And with many other words did he testify and exhort , saying , Save yourselves from this untoward generation .
Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken  ; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee :
translation.kha: Wat pynleit jingmut ha kaei kaei baroh kaba ki briew ki ong — phi lah ban ïohsngew ba u shakri jong phi u ibeiñ ïa phi ,
Ki Jiw ki la kyrshan ïa kane ka jingmudui bad ki la ong ba kane baroh ka long kaba kynha .
translation.en: And the Jews also assented , saying that these things were so .
And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him , saying , If thou be Christ , save thyself and us .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki nongleh kam runar uba la sdien hangta u la krenbeiñ ïa u :  Hato mem long U Messaïah ? To pynim ïa lade bad ïa ngi !

translation.en: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east , and unto the sea of the plain , even the salt sea on the east , the way to Beth–jeshimoth  ; and from the south , under Ashdoth–pisgah :
translation.kha: ka kynthup ïa ka Them Jordan naduh Duriaw Galilaïa arsut shaduh Beth Jeshimoth ( shaphang mihngi jong ka Duriaw Baïap ) bad sha trai jong u Lum Pisgah .

translation.en: I speak not this to condemn you : for I have said before , that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you .
translation.kha: Ngam shym ong ïa kane ïa ka ban pynrem ïa phi ; naba kumba nga la ong mynshuwa , phi long kiba ngi ieit eh ba ngi ïalong lang borabor , lada ngi im lane ngi ïap .
Hynrei lada um pynleit jingmut kane , phi wat salia ïa .
translation.en: But if any man be ignorant , let him be ignorant .

translation.kha: U syiem u Solomon arspah shna tylli ki stieh kiba heh , ïa kawei pa kawei la sop da ka ksiar ba la shoh kaba khia kumba hynriew kilo ,
translation.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold : six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target .
Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea  ; and he shall be for an haven of ships  ; and his border shall be unto Zidon .
translation.kha: U Sebulun un shong harud duriaw ; Ka jaka shong jong u kan long ka jakarieh ïa ki liengbah , Bad ka khyndew ka shyiap jong u kan ïar haduh Sidon .

Kine rnga briew kiba :12 bad borabor ba-donnam Thliew ïa kiwei ; ki ïaid kat kum ki jingkwah brai jong ki jingkajia ki kren sarong shaphang ïa lade bad Pyndap arsap ïa kiwei khnang ban ïoh Perasim ’ kaba ki kwah hi .
translation.en: These are murmurers , complainers , walking after their own lusts  ; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words , having men s persons in admiration because of advantage .
And , behold , the man clothed with linen , which had the inkhorn by his side , reported the matter , saying , I have done as thou hast commanded me .
translation.kha: Te uta u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen u la leit phai bad wan ïathuh ha U  Trai  ,  Nga la leh kumba me la hukum ïa nga .

translation.en: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers : all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise .
translation.kha: Ki misteri liengbah na Biblos ki long ki rangbah ba la ïoh jinghikai bha . Ki maji na baroh ki liengbah duriaw ki la ïakhaïi pateng ha ki dukan jong pha .

translation.en: And the Jews marvelled , saying , How knoweth this man letters , having never learned ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la lyngngoh haduh katta katta bad ki la ong ,  Kumno une u briew u tip katne katne haba um pat ju ïoh jinghikai ei ei ?
synran jong la ong ïa u , Lada ka long kumne hapdeng u bad ka tnga , ka kham bha ban ym shongkurim .
translation.en: His disciples say unto him , If the case of the man be so with his wife , it is not good to marry .

translation.kha: U , ong La kha ïa nga lyngkhuit khlem don ei ei bad ngan ïap lyngkhuit don khlem ei ei . U Trai u la ai , bad mynta u la shim noh . To ai ba yn ïaroh ïa ka jong kyrteng u !
translation.en: And said , Naked came I out of my mother s womb , and naked shall I return thither : the  Lord  gave , and the  Lord  hath taken away  ; blessed be the name of the  Lord .
Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith  ; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross , despising the shame , and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God .
translation.kha: To ngin ïakhmih shaiñ sha U Jisu , ha uba ka jingngeit jong ngi ka don naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut . U bym shym la kynran dien namar ka diengphna ! Pynban , namar ka jingkmen kaba la ap ïa u , um shym pyrkhat ei ei ïa ka jingjahburom ban shahïap halor ka diengphna , bad mynta u la shong ha ka liang ka mon jong ka khet U Blei .

translation.en: And it was the preparation of the passover , and about the sixth hour : and he saith unto the Jews , Behold your King !
translation.kha: Ka la long la jan shiteng sngi shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . U Pilat u la ong ha ki briew ,  Une u syiem jong phi !

translation.en: Fear not : for I am with thee : I will bring thy seed from the east , and gather thee from the west  ;
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng — nga long ryngkat bad phi !  Naduh mihngi bajngai bad sha sepngi bajngai tam , ngan wallam sha ïing ïa ki briew jong phi .

translation.en: And he commanded the chariot to stand still : and they went down both into the water , both Philip and the eunuch  ; and he baptized him .
translation.kha: Uta u rangbah synshar u la hukum ban pynsangeh ïa ka kali kulai , bad baroh ar ngut , u Philip bad uta u rangbah synshar ki la ïaleit hiar sha ka um , bad u Philip u la pynbaptis ïa u .

translation.en: And thorns shall come up in her palaces , nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof : and it shall be an habitation of dragons , and a court for owls .
translation.kha: Ki shiah bad shiah buid kin mih ha baroh ki ïingsyiem bad ki shnong ba la ker kynroh , bad ki myrsiang bad ki dkhoh kin shong ha ki .

translation.en: For there shall be a day , that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry , Arise ye , and let us go up to Zion unto the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ka por kan wan haba ki nongap kin khot ha ki lum ka Ephraim , ‘ Ïa ngin ïaleit haduh Seïon , sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .’

Naduh ka sngi nyngkong ka Jingkhawai Niam haduh ka sngi kaba khatduh , ki pule ïa ki bynta jong ka Hukum U Blei man ka . Ka Jingkhawai Niam la na bynta hynñiew sngi ka sngi phra , ka la don ka jingpynkut ka Jingkhawai Niam kumba la ha ka .
translation.en: Also day by day , from the first day unto the last day , he read in the book of the law of God . And they kept the feast seven days  ; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly , according unto the manner .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai ong u ha u Moses Kane , ka long kata ka ri ba nga la kular ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob ban ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki . Nga la shah ïa me ban ïohi ïa , hynrei ka ngan ym shah ba men leit shata .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , This is the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , saying , I will give it unto thy seed : I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes , but thou shalt not go over thither .

translation.kha: Lah ban sympat ïa u haduh sawphew thri , hynrei ym palat ïa kata ; lada palat ïa kata , kan pynpoh dor ïa u ha khmat ki briew .
translation.en: Forty stripes he may give him , and not exceed : lest , if he should exceed , and beat him above these with many stripes , then thy brother should seem vile unto thee .

translation.kha: u Hynrei rangbah u shipai la kwah ban pyllait im ïa u Paul , kumta u la khang ïa ki na kaba leh ïa kane . Pynban , u la hukum kito ïa kiba lah ban jngi ban ryngkoh nyngkong bad ban jngi sha ryngkew ;
translation.en: But the centurion , willing to save Paul , kept them from their purpose  ; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea , and get to land :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la peit sawdong ha ki synran jong u bad u la ong ïa ki , jingkhlaiñbor katno plakhun long kaba eh ïa kiba riewspah ban rung sha ka bakhor U Blei !
translation.en: And Jesus looked round about , and saith unto his disciples ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !

translation.kha: Phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka sngi kum ka Jingkhawai jingpynpra ban pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa kaei kaba nga jingpynmihpat khrup Trai , nga la leh . Rakhe ïa ka pateng la pateng bynriew .
translation.en: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial  ; and ye shall keep it a feast to the  Lord  throughout your generations  ; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever .

translation.kha: To shadkmen , bakynjah ka bneng , namar ksaiñ jingpynjot ïa ka ! to shadkmen , ko ki Sered jong U Blei bad Korinth apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa Wad Deuteronomi U Blei u shispah pynrem ïa Akhish na ka bynta kaei kaba ka la leh ïa phi kanjari
translation.en: Rejoice over her , thou heaven , and ye holy apostles and prophets  ; for God hath avenged you on her .
And Joseph placed his father and his brethren , and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt , in the best of the land , in the land of Rameses , as Pharaoh had commanded .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u ai jaka shong jaka sah ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ki hynmen ha Ijipt , ha ka bynta kaba bha tam hajan ka nongbah Rameses , kumba u syiem u la hukum .

translation.en: The proud have digged pits for me , which are not after thy law .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sarong , ki bymkohnguh ïa ka aiñ jong me , ki la tih ki thliew ban riam ïa nga .
Hapoh ar snem ngan wallam Hobah sha kane ka jaka Hesion Senir ki jingkynshew ka Middin kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la rah sha Babilonia .
translation.en: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the  Lord s  house , that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place , and carried them to Babylon :

According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee , and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee , thou shalt do : thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee , to the right hand , nor to the left .
translation.kha: Pdiang ïa ka rai jong ki bad leh thik kumba ki bthah ïa phi .
Kum ki sing ki bym don ei ei ban pynïap bad bam , ki ïap ki khun jong ki ki sakma .
translation.en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey , and the stout lion s whelps are scattered abroad .
He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul : he that keepeth understanding shall find good .
translation.kha: Lehbha ïa lade bad wad jinghikai kat kaba phi lah ; nangta kynmaw ïa kaei kaba phi ïoh jinghikai bad phin manbha .

translation.en: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months .
translation.kha: U Dabid u sah ha ri Philistia khathynriew bnai .
Da la ka kti hi nga ïa thoh kane : Ki Jingai Khublei na u Paul .
translation.en: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand .

The  Lord  said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king , Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done ? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree , and there hath played the harlot .
translation.kha: Mynba u Josaïah u long syiem , U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Hato me la ïohi ïa kaei ba ka Israel , kata ka kynthei bymïaineh , ka la leh ? Ka la phai lyndet noh na nga , bad halor uwei pa uwei u lum bajrong bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam , ka la leh kum ka nuti .
Blei U ong u ha u Jakob , Khie leit sha Bethel bad shongsah hangta . Tei ïa ka duwan hangta ïa nga , U Blei uba la mihpaw me ha mynba me dang phet ïap na u Iso u hynmen jong me .
translation.en: And God said unto Jacob , Arise , go up to Beth–el , and dwell there : and make there an altar unto God , that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother .
Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hephzi–bah .
translation.kha: U Manasseh u la dap khat-ar snem ka rta mynba u long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar sanphew san snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hephsibah .

translation.en: But now , because it is not so , he hath visited in his anger  ; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity :
translation.kha: Me pyrkhat ba U Blei un ym pynshitom , ba um da pynleit jingmut shaphang ka pop .

translation.en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man : seek out his wickedness till thou find none .
translation.kha: Pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong ki riewbymman bad ki riewsniew ; pynshitom ïa ki namar ka jingbakla kaba ki la leh tad haduh ba kin ym leh shuh ïa ka .

translation.en: Thy tacklings are loosed  ; they could not well strengthen their mast , they could not spread the sail : then is the prey of a great spoil divided  ; the lame take the prey .

translation.kha: Ka bleithaw u Mikah ka ïaisah hangta ha kaba ka Ïingjaiñ ba mane ïa U Blei ka dang sah ha Shiloh .

translation.en: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there : and they came not for Jesus  sake only , but that they might see Lazarus also , whom he had raised from the dead .
translation.kha: Bun bah ki briew ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la don ha Bethania , kumta ki la leit shata , ym tang namar jong U Jisu hynrei ban ïohi ruh ïa u Lasaros , ïa uba U Jisu u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them , and said , It is not reason that we should leave the word of God , and serve tables .
translation.kha: Kumta ki khat-ar ngut ki apostol ki la khot lang ïa ka kynhun riewngeit baroh kawei bad ki la ong ,  Kam long kaba dei ïa ngi ban leh klet ïa ka jingïalap ïa ka ktien U Blei khnang ban pynïaid ïa ka kam pisa tyngka .

translation.en: And he charged them , saying , Thus shall ye do in the fear of the  Lord  , faithfully , and with a perfect heart .
translation.kha: U ai ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah :  Phi dei ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong phi ha ka jingsheptieng burom ïa U  Trai  , da kaba kohnguh hok ïa u ha kiei kiei ba phi leh .

translation.en: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again , even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him .
translation.kha: Ngi ngeit ba U Jisu u la ïap bad u la mihpat , bad kumta ngi ngeit ba U Blei un shim pat bad U Jisu ïa kito kiba la ïap da kaba ngeit ha u .

translation.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki kynjri kiba da ka ksiar nylla ba la jyrthiaw kum u tyllai na ka bynta kata ka jingdeng shadem .

translation.en: But he answered and said unto them ,  Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Bad balei ba phim kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong U Blei bad phi bud ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai ?

translation.en: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose  ; in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles : and they shall not appear before the  Lord  empty :
translation.kha: Lai sien shisnem , ki shynrang jong phi baroh ki dei ban wanpaw ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ha kata ka jaka mane Blei : ha ka Niam Ka Jinglait , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot , bad ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep . Kim dei ban wan thylli ha khmat U  Trai  ;

translation.en: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah , whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilon u la rah ïa u Jehoïakhin u syiem ka Judah ha ka jingringmraw na Jerusalem , ryngkat bad shi kynhun ki koidi , u Mordekai u long uwei na ki .

translation.en: Then he said , I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains , as sheep that have no shepherd : and the  Lord  said , These have no master  ; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace .
translation.kha: U Mikaïah u jubab ,  Nga ïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel ba la pynsakma halor ki lum kum ïa ki langbrot bym don nongsharai . Bad U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Kine ki rangbah kim don nongïalam ; ai ba kin leit phai noh sha la ïing ha ka jingsuk .’
Hynrei lada phim kohnguh bad kyntait phi ban shahshkor , bad phi shah ïalam bakla ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,
translation.en: But if thine heart turn away , so that thou wilt not hear , but shalt be drawn away , and worship other gods , and serve them  ;
When Christ , who is our life , shall appear , then shall ye also appear with him in glory .
translation.kha: Ka jingim bashisha jong phi ka long U Khrist , bad haba u mihpaw , te ma phi ruh phin mihpaw lem bad u bad ïoh bynta ïa ka burom jong u!
Hangta ki pyrshang ban ai ïa u ka waiñ ba la khleh bad ka jingdih ba la khot mirr , hynrei U Jisu um dih ïa ka
translation.en: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh : but he received it not .
When it goeth well with the righteous , the city rejoiceth : and when the wicked perish , there is shouting .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka kmen haba ki briew kiba hok ki manbha , bad ka don ki jingrisa sngewbha haba u bymman u ïap .
Ngan ïai lehkmen shadkmen , namar U Trai U Blei u long u nongpynim jong .
translation.en: Yet I will rejoice in the  Lord  , I will joy in the God of my salvation .
But it shall not be so among you : but whosoever will be great among you , let him be your minister  ;
translation.kha: Kane , la kumno kumno , kam dei ka rukom ban long hapdeng jong phi . Lada uwei na phi u kwah ban long uba khraw , u dei ban long u shakri ïa kiwei pat ;
Ïa ki rangbah bastad jong ; la shaïong bad shah riam . Ki la kyntait ïa ki jong nga ; ka jingstad kaba kumno ki la ïoh mynta ?
translation.en: The wise men are ashamed , they are dismayed and taken : lo , they have rejected the word of the  Lord   ; and what wisdom is in them ?

translation.kha: U Pharisi u la kyndit haba u ïohi ba Jisu U um shym la thet ha shuwa ban bam .
translation.en: And when the Pharisee saw it , he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner .

translation.kha: Baroh na phi , phi long ka met U Khrist , bad uwei pa uwei u long u bynta jong . ka
translation.en: Now ye are the body of Christ , and members in particular .

And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment , or in the skin , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ; it is a plague of leprosy , and shall be shewed unto the priest :
translation.kha: lada ka dei kaba lam jyrngam lane kaba lam saw , ka dei ka jingbthuh kaba pur bad dei ban leit pyn-i ïa ka ha u lyngdoh .
la khmih shaiñ ki u jubab , Kane ka long ka bym lah ïa u briew , hynrei ym ïa U Blei ; kiei baroh ki kiba lah U .
translation.en: And Jesus looking upon them saith ,  With men it is impossible , but not with God : for with God all things are possible .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai , ngan kren ha ki , bad ïa kaei kaba nga ong yn . pyndep Yn ym don shuh ka jingpyntud ka . Ha por ka jong phi hi , ko ki nongïeng ïaleh pyrshah , ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la maham ïa phi ba ngan leh . Nga la kren ong , U Trai Nongsynshar .
translation.en: For I am the  Lord  : I will speak , and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass  ; it shall be no more prolonged : for in your days , O rebellious house , will I say the word , and will perform it , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , phi phi tip ba ka jingwan jngoh ngi ïa phi kam shym la kaba sep-ei .
translation.en: For yourselves , brethren , know our entrance in unto you , that it was not in vain :

translation.kha: Hangta ka ri baroh ki la ïakhñium ïa u bad u Aaron bad ki la ong ha ,
translation.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness :
They made a calf in Horeb , and worshipped the molten image .
translation.kha: Ki la thaw ïa u khun masi ksiar ha Sinai bad mane ïa uta u bleithaw ;

translation.en: How can ye believe , which receive honour one of another , and seek not the honour that cometh from God only ?
translation.kha: Phi sngewtynnat ban ïohpdiang jingïaroh uwei na uwei pat , hynrei phim pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingïaroh na uta uba ma u hi u long U Blei ; kumno , te , phi lah ban ngeit ha nga ?
Kum ïa ki shiah kiba la bad ïa phlangïap ba-tyrkhong , phi ki nongbuaid yn thang duh !
translation.en: For while they be folden together as thorns , and while they are drunken as drunkards , they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry .

translation.kha: To wan bad bam shuh sa khyndiat Bela u ong , hynrei um mut kumta . Kaei kaba u pyrkhat lieh long kaei kaba u long da Karmi .
translation.en: For as he thinketh in his heart , so is he : Eat and drink , saith he to thee  ; but his heart is not with thee .

translation.kha: Ki la khñium pyrshah ïa nongbishar Moses bad u Aaron naphang pyndkoh ki ong , Kan jin da la symbai bha ban ïap ha Ijipt lane wat hangne ha ka ri khlaw !
translation.en: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron : and the whole congregation said unto them , Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt ! or would God we had died in this wilderness !

translation.kha: kyndit U Trai phah ïa lyer kaba wan kit ïa ki iar khiar na duriaw kiba her kumba shi mitar na sla khyndew . Kine ki ha ka sher dara bad baroh sawdong jong ka da bun bun kilomitar kat shaba phai
translation.en: And there went forth a wind from the  Lord  , and brought quails from the sea , and let them fall by the camp , as it were a day s journey on this side , and as it were a day s journey on the other side , round about the camp , and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth .
And when he had taken him , and brought him to his mother , he sat on her knees till noon , and then died .
translation.kha: U shakri u la bah ïa u khynnah sha ka kmie jong u , kaba thum ïa u ha la ka pneh haduh shiteng sngi , ka por ha kaba u la ïap .

translation.en: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan , and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah , ( whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon ) saying ,
translation.kha: Nga la ai ïa ka shithi ha u Elasah u khun jong u Shaphan bad ha u Gemaraïah u khun jong u Hilkaïah , ïa uba u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah u phah sha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia . Ka ong :

translation.en: Do you know how much profit we made ?
translation.kha: Phi tip katno ngi lah iohnong ?
Ha ka nga ai ha me ka iktiar halor ki jaitbynriew bad hima ban rat bad pynkhyllem , pynjot bad ban bret , ban tei bad ban thung .
translation.en: See , I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms , to root out , and to pull down , and to destroy , and to throw down , to build , and to plant .

translation.kha: bad ba phi lah pa’ ïathuh Amal Eh khun kyrsum hikai jong phi kumno nga la pynpaw bieit ïa ki nong Ijipt haba nga leh ïa kine ki kambah . Phi baroh phin tip ba jingpyrta Hoshaïah U Trai .
translation.en: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son , and of thy son s son , what things I have wrought in Egypt , and my signs which I have done among them  ; that ye may know how that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Me don ka bor halor jong nga tang Ithnan ba la ai ha pathaw Barukh U sngewsynei . Kumta u briew uba aiti noh ïa nga ha me u long uba jingtynrah rem na ka Nebo kaba kham khraw .
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Thou couldest have no power at all against me , except it were given thee from above : therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin .

translation.kha: Dabid u nang bteng la ka lynti u lem bad sawspah rangbah kita arspah ngut kiwei pat , namar ba ki la thait eh , kim lah shuh ban jam sha shiliang ka wahduid , bad ki sah noh .
translation.en: But David pursued , he and four hundred men : for two hundred abode behind , which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor .

And I will be found of you , saith the  Lord  : and I will turn away your captivity , and I will gather you from all the nations , and from all the places whither I have driven you , saith the  Lord   ; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , nga ong , phin shem ïa nga , bad ngan buh pat ïa phi ha ka ri jong phi hi . Ngan lumlang ïa phi na kawei pa kawei ka ri bad na kawei ka jaka sha kaba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , bad ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha ka ri na kaba nga la phah noh ïa phi sha ka jingshah ringmraw . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .’

translation.en: And when they had platted a crown of thorns , they put it upon his head , and a reed in his right hand : and they bowed the knee before him , and mocked him , saying , Hail , King of the Jews !
translation.kha: Nangta ki la thain pansngiat na ki tnat ba don shiah bad ki la buh ïa ka halor ka khlieh jong u , bad ki la buh ïa u dieng ha ka kti kamon jong u ; nangta ki la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u bad ki la kren ibeiñ ïa u .  Im slem u Syiem ki Jiw !  ki la ong .
Ka Tamar ka la leit pat phai sha la ïing , ka law noh ïa ka jingkah khmat , bad ka phong ïa biang ki jaiñ riewkynthei .
translation.en: And she arose , and went away , and laid by her veil from her , and put on the garments of her widowhood .

translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Ka namar khmat ka khmat , bad ka bniat namar ka bniat .’
translation.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said , An eye for an eye , and a tooth for a tooth :
Thus saith the king , Let not Hezekiah deceive you : for he shall not be able to deliver you .
translation.kha: U maham ïa phi ban ym shah ba u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi . U Hesekaïah um lah ban pyllait ïa phi .

translation.en: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found , both let him die , and we also will be my lord s bondmen .
translation.kha: Bah , lada yn shem ïa ka ha uno uno na ngi , uta u dei ban ïap , bad kiba sah na ngi kin long noh ki mraw jong phi .

translation.en: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the  Lord  deceitfully , and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood .
translation.kha: ( Long ba la tim ïa u briew u bym leh ïa ka kam U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong u baroh ! Long ba la tim ïa uno uno u bym pom bad pynïap ! )

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses sat to judge the people : and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Moses u dang pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng u paidbah , bad kumta u la bunkam naduh mynstep haduh ban da miet .
Lada kumta , un kit hi ïa la jingpynshitom .
translation.en: But if he wash them not , nor bathe his flesh  ; then he shall bear his iniquity .

translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me ban kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga khnang ba kin ïai ïohpdiang ïa ka jinglehbha jong me . me Ma , A Trai Nongsynshar , me la kular ïa kane bad , ka jingkyrkhu jong kan me ïaisah bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga junom .
translation.en: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may continue for ever before thee : for thou , O Lord  God  , hast spoken it : and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever .

translation.kha: Kim dei ban ai shongthait ïa u tad ynda u dep tei pat ïa ka Jerusalem , bad pynlong ïa ka , ka nongbah ha ka kaba pyrthei kawei baroh ka ïaroh .
translation.en: And give him no rest , till he establish , and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Kam long kaba dei ban shim ïa ka jingbam ba-don ki khun bad bret ïa ka 65 ki ksew .
translation.en: But he answered and said ,  It is not meet to take the children s bread , and to cast it to dogs .
But the chief captain Lysias came upon us , and with great violence took him away out of our hands ,
translation.kha: Hynrei u Lusias , u rangbah shipai u la tuklar bad u la knieh jubor ïa u na ngi .

translation.en: Son of man , wail for the multitude of Egypt , and cast them down , even her , and the daughters of the famous nations , unto the nether parts of the earth , with them that go down into the pit .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  to ïamkthang namar baroh u paidbah babun ka Ijipt . Phah ïa ki ban hiar lem bad ki jaitbynriew badonbor sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
Ki la iehnoh ka ïa lynti kaba beit bad ki la jah lynti ; ki la bud ïa ka lynti jong u Balaam , u khun jong u Beor , uba ieit ïa ka pisa kaba u ïoh da ka kam bymhok
translation.en: Which have forsaken the right way , and are gone astray , following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor , who loved the wages of unrighteousness  ;
But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise , Say not in thine heart , Who shall ascend into heaven ? ( that is , to bring Christ down from above : )
translation.kha: Hynrei kaei kaba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shaphang ka jingïadei bad U Blei lyngba ka jingngeit ka long kane :  Phim dei ban kylli ïa lade , Uei u ban leit sha bneng ?  ( kata ka long , ban wallam ïa U Khrist sha tbian ) .

translation.en: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments , and anoint him , and sanctify him  ; that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Pynkup ïa u Aaron da ki jaiñphong lyngdoh , pynsleh ïa u , bad da kane pynkyntang ïa u , ba u lah ban shakri ïa nga kum u lyngdoh .
Hato u Syiem Kynrad u mynjur ïa kane baroh bad ym shym ïathuh wat ki ïa rangbah synshar phi jong mano ban long syiem hadien jong phi ?
translation.en: Is this thing done by my lord the king , and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant , who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him ?

translation.kha: Ka Baibl ka ong “U : Blei u la iohi ia Kiei Kiei baroh ba u la thaw ha , khmih ruh , ka la bha eh .”
translation.en: The Bible states : “God saw everything he had made and , look ! it was very good .”

translation.kha: U la im Jehiskaïah ba u da ïohi ïa Tola khun bad ki ksiew jong u Ephraim , bad haduh syang u da ïohpdiang ïa ki khun jong u Makhir , u khun jong u Manasseh .
translation.en: And Joseph saw Ephraim s children of the third generation : the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph s knees .

translation.kha: Shah ïa nga ba ngan hikai ïa phi katno ka khraw ka bor U Blei , bad ban batai kaei kaba U Blei Badonbor baroh u la . thmu lypa
translation.en: I will teach you by the hand of God : that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal .
I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy  ; I will shew them the back , and not the face , in the day of their calamity .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki briew jong nga ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki , kum ïa u pui pui ba la beh da ka lyer mihngi . Ngan pynphai ïa la ka ingdong halor jong ki ; ngan ym ïarap ïa ki haba ka jingpynjot ka wan .

translation.en: For he that is called in the Lord , being a servant , is the Lord s freeman : likewise also he that is called , being free , is Christ s servant .
translation.kha: Naba u mraw uba la khot da U Trai u long uba laitluid na ka bynta U Trai ; kumjuh ruh u briew uba laitluid ïa uba la khot da U Khrist u long u mraw jong U .
U Solomon u la khat-ar ngut ki rangbah kum lat ka distrik ha Israel . dei ban bam na ki distrik jong ki ïa syiem bad ïa longïing jong u , uwei u rangbah kitkhlieh na ka uwei u bnai ha ka shisnem .
translation.en: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel , which provided victuals for the king and his household : each man his month in a year made provision .

translation.kha: kine briew ki kohnguh shong sah hapdeng jong ngi tang ha kyndon ba ngin otsher ïa ki shynrang ngi baroh , kumba ki ruh la shah otsher
translation.en: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us , to be one people , if every male among us be circumcised , as they are circumcised .
He that eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , dwelleth in me , and I in him .
translation.kha: Kito kiba bam ïa ka doh jong nga bad ba dih ïa ka snam jong nga ki ïaisah ha nga , bad ma nga ha ki .

translation.en: With twelve hundred chariots , and threescore thousand horsemen : and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt  ; the Libyans , the Sukkiims , and the Ethiopians .
translation.kha: U Shishak u syiem ka Ijipt u tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ka kynhun shipai kaba shihajar arspah tylli ki kali ïapom , hynriewphew hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai , bad shibun ki shipai ban ïa kaba lah ban ïa kaba lah ban ñiew , kaba kynthup ïa ki nong Libya , ki Sukki , bad ki kynhun Sudan .

bad u la leit sha ka umpohliew , u la nongthaw ïa ka mluh ha ka lei purim bad u ong , Kane ka pynpoi kaba U Trai u ong : païa Nga pynkhuid ïa kane ka Sah , bad kan ym pynjia shuh kano kano ka jingïap lane ki jinghap khun ishongkhia
translation.en: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters , and cast the salt in there , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have healed these waters  ; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land .

And the men of the place asked him of his wife  ; and he said , She is my sister : for he feared to say , She is my wife  ; lest , said he , the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah  ; because she was fair to look upon .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew hangta ki kylli shaphang ka tnga jong u , u jubab ba ka dei ka para jong u . Um shym ïathuh ba ka dei ka tnga jong u , namar u sheptieng ïoh ba ki briew hangta kin pynïap ïa u ban ïoh ïa ka Rebekka , kaba long kaba bhabriew eh .
Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u sha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad ong ba kin sum kat kum ka jinglehniam .
translation.en: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and shalt wash them with water .
This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka ri ba ki longïing jong ka jait Judah ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
Long kiba , khuid namar nga , U Trai U Blei jong phi , nga long uba khuid .
translation.en: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , and say unto them , Ye shall be holy : for I the  Lord  your God am holy .
He maketh peace in thy borders , and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat .
translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ki pud jong phi ban long skhem bad u pynkdang ïa phi da u kew babha tam .

translation.en: That in blessing I will bless thee , and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven , and as the sand which is upon the sea shore  ; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies  ;
translation.kha: nga kular ba ngan ai ha me ïa ki khun ki ksiew kat ki khlur ka sahit bneng , lane kat ki symboh shyiap harud ka duriaw . Ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki .

translation.en: What shall I render unto the  Lord  for all his benefits toward me ?
translation.kha: Kaei nga lah ban ai ïa U  Trai namar ka jinglehbha jong u baroh ïa nga ?

U jingmynjur u ong ha u Moses , Buh biang ïa u diengduh jong u Aaron ha pahai ka Synduk ka Jutang ban Dei ban buh ïa bameh kum ka jingmaham ïa ki Jehobah kiba ïaleh pyrshah ba kin ïap lymda ki sangeh noh ïa ki jingkren khñium jong pynlapmiet .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Bring Aaron s rod again before the testimony , to be kept for a token against the rebels  ; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me , that they die not .
For I know that the  Lord  is great , and that our Lord is above all gods .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba U  Trai  u long uba khraw , kham khraw ban ïa ki blei baroh .
tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar ïa ki ha ki saw ki dong kiba don ki kjat jong ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold , and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof .

translation.kha: Ka jinghikai jong kan ai phi ka jingim kaba jlan bad kaba manbha .
translation.en: For length of days , and long life , and peace , shall they add to thee .

And he said , All is well . My master hath sent me , saying , Behold , even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets : give them , I pray thee , a talent of silver , and two changes of garments .

translation.en: They said unto him , Grant unto us that we may sit , one on thy right hand , and the other on thy left hand , in thy glory .

translation.kha: U la jubab ïa ki nonglamktien jong u Ïoannis , Khie leit bad noh ïathuh ïa u Ïoannis ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohi bad ïohsngew Kiba : matlah ki lah ban ïohi , kiba ki dkoh lah ban ïaid , kito kiba pang ki ñiangthohlieh la long khuid , kiba kyllut ki lah ban ïohsngew , ïa kiba ïap pynim pat , bad ïa ka Babha Khubor la ïalap ha kiba duk .
translation.en: Then Jesus answering said unto them ,  Go your way , and tell John what things ye have seen and heard  ; how that the blind see , the lame walk , the lepers are cleansed , the deaf hear , the dead are raised , to the poor the gospel is preached .
But I say unto you , That Elias is come already , and they knew him not , but have done unto him whatsoever they listed . Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi ba u Elijah u lah da wan bad ki briew kim shym la ithuh ïa u , hynrei ki la leh ïa u katba ki sngewbit . Ha kajuh ka rukom kin lehbeiñ ruh ïa U Khun U Briew .

translation.en: And you hath he quickened , who were dead in trespasses and sins ;
translation.kha: Mynshuwa phi la long kiba ïap ha ka jinglong mynsiem namar ka jingbymkohnguh bad ki pop jong phi .
Shim bad me ïa baroh ki sim bad ki , mrad khnang ba ki lah ban ïaroi bad saphriang kylleng ka khyndew .
translation.en: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee , of all flesh , both of fowl , and of cattle , and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth  ; that they may breed abundantly in the earth , and be fruitful , and multiply upon the earth .

translation.en: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven , and will scatter them toward all those winds  ; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come .

translation.en: And as for the prophet , and the priest , and the people , that shall say , The burden of the  Lord  , I will even punish that man and his house .

translation.en: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me .

translation.en: But why dost thou judge thy brother ? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother ? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ .

translation.en: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies  ; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them  ; and they shall flee , as fleeing from a sword  ; and they shall fall when none pursueth .

translation.en: And they went to bury her : but they found no more of her than the skull , and the feet , and the palms of her hands .

translation.en: For if our heart condemn us , God is greater than our heart , and knoweth all things .

translation.en: There were once a King and a Queen , and they had a son called Sigurd , who was very strong and active , and good-looking .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Behold , I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee : begin to possess , that thou mayest inherit his land .

translation.en: He will keep the feet of his saints , and the wicked shall be silent in darkness  ; for by strength shall no man prevail .

translation.en: But he forsook the counsel of the old men , which they had given him , and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him , and which stood before him :

translation.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent : and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning .

translation.kha: Ïa ki kynhun shipai jong ki la pynïap da ka kaba waitlam mihnoh na ka shyntur jong uta uba la shong halor u ; kulai bad ki sim baroh ki la bam kat baroh kaba ki lah na ka doh jong ki .
translation.en: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse , which sword proceeded out of his mouth : and all the fowls were filled with their flesh .

translation.en: He hath blinded their eyes , and hardened their heart  ; that they should not see with their eyes , nor understand with their heart , and be converted , and I should heal them .

translation.en: Then the five men departed , and came to Laish , and saw the people that were therein , how they dwelt careless , after the manner of the Zidonians , quiet and secure  ; and there was no magistrate in the land , that might put them to shame in any thing  ; and they were far from the Zidonians , and had no business with any man .
And another company turned the way to Beth–horon : and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness .
translation.kha: kawei ka leit shaphang Beth Horon , bad kawei pat ka leit shaphang ka khappud na kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Seboim bad ïa ka ri khlaw .
Suk uta u uba briew long stad — uba ïoh ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom , and the man that getteth understanding .

translation.kha: ngan ki nongshun kiba sniew ban tur ïaleh ïa me . pynjot ïa kiei kiei itynnat kiba me la pynïoh da ka jingtbit bad jingstad me .
translation.en: Behold , therefore I will bring strangers upon thee , the terrible of the nations : and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom , and they shall defile thy brightness .

translation.en: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands , and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them : the Great , the Mighty God , the  Lord  of hosts , is his name ,

translation.en: And he said ,  Go into the city to such a man , and say unto him , The Master saith , My time is at hand  ; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples .
Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hamutal , the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .
translation.kha: U Joahas u la don arphew lai snem ka rta mynba u long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hamutal , ka khun jong u Jeremaïah na ka nongbah Libnah .

translation.en: He divideth the sea with his power , and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud .

translation.en: And they offered unto the  Lord  the same time , of the spoil which they had brought , seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep .

translation.en: And I brake the jaws of the wicked , and plucked the spoil out of his teeth .

translation.en: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters ? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing .
Beasts , and all cattle  ; creeping things , and flying fowl :

translation.en: And all the cities of the plain , and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites , which reigned in Heshbon , whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian , Evi , and Rekem , and Zur , and Hur , and Reba , which were dukes of Sihon , dwelling in the country .
translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ki nongbah baroh jong ka jaka padun bad ka hima baroh kawei jong u Sihon u syiem Amor , uba la synshar ha Heshbon . U Moses u la jop ïa u , bad ruh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Midian : u Ebi , u Rekem , u Sur , u Hur , bad u Reba . Kine baroh ki la synshar na ka bynta u Sihon .

translation.en: And when the devil had ended all the temptation , he departed from him for a season .

translation.en: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God : and this is that spirit of antichrist , whereof ye have heard that it should come  ; and even now already is it in the world .

Fire , and hail  ; snow , and vapour  ; stormy wind fulfilling his word :

translation.kha: Ka Ijipt ka phet krad , ka pyrsad kum u bseiñ , katba ka kynhun shipai u nongshun ka wan tur . Ki tur ïaleh ïa ka da ki sdie , kum ki rangbah kiba pom ïa ki dieng bad kiba pynjot ïa ka khlaw barben .

translation.en: In the second year of Darius the king , in the sixth month , in the first day of the month , came the word of the  Lord  by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , saying ,

translation.kha: U un Trai jied kawei tang ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa u , bad hangta phi dei ban wanrah sha u ïa kata baroh kaba nga la : hukum ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingkñia jong phi , ïa na kawei ka shiphew bad ki jingainguh jong phi , bad ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha ba phi la kular sha U Trai .
translation.en: Then there shall be a place which the  Lord  your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there  ; thither shall ye bring all that I command you  ; your burnt offerings , and your sacrifices , your tithes , and the heave offering of your hand , and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the  Lord  :

translation.en: And lo a voice from heaven , saying , This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased .

translation.kha: U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ym don batip U Khun u long uei lait tang U Kpa , bad ym don batip U Kpa u long uei lait tang U Khun bad kito ha kiba U Khun u jied ban pynpaw ïa U .

translation.en: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things ? yet among many nations was there no king like him , who was beloved of his God , and God made him king over all Israel : nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin .

translation.en: In that day I will perform against Eli all things which I have spoken concerning his house : when I begin , I will also make an end .

translation.kha: Hato la klet ki ktien pynshlur ïa U Blei u la ha phi kum ïa la ki khun ? Ko nga , to jingmut haba Trai u sneng ïa phi , bad wat sngew noh mynsiem haba u sneng ïa phi .
translation.en: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children , My son , despise not thou the chastening of the Lord , nor faint when thou art rebuked of him :

translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , u khun jong u , sepngi shym la jinglehrain bynda lade , ïapkhlam la phi la tip nongkynti kane païa .
translation.en: And thou his son , O Belshazzar , hast not humbled thine heart , though thou knewest all this  ;
For after this manner in the old time the holy women also , who trusted in God , adorned themselves , being in subjection unto their own husbands :
translation.kha: Naba ki kynthei bariewblei ha ki por ba la leit noh ki la buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei , ki ju pynbhabriew ïa lade da kaba pynkohnguh ha la ki tnga .
Ki ong Hato U , Trai u la kren tang lyngba u Moses ? Hato um shym la kren lyngba jong ngi ruh ? U Trai u la ïohsngew aïu ki ong .
translation.en: And they said , Hath the  Lord  indeed spoken only by Moses ? hath he not spoken also by us ? And the  Lord  heard it .
And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap noh ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah sanphew snem .
Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , haba phi ïawanlang ban ïa bam ka Jingkhawai U Trai , to da ïa-ap paralok hi .
translation.en: Wherefore , my brethren , when ye come together to eat , tarry one for another .
This is the day which the  Lord  hath made  ; we will rejoice and be glad in it .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka sngi jong ka jingjop jong U  Trai  ; to ngin ïakmen , to ngin ïalehkmen !
Ka ar ka la kut , hynrei ka jingshyrkhei kaba lai kan wan shen !
translation.en: The second woe is past  ; and , behold , the third woe cometh quickly .

Either three years  famine  ; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes , while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee  ; or else three days the sword of the  Lord  , even the pestilence , in the land , and the angel of the  Lord  destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel . Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me .
translation.kha: Lai snem ka jingkyrduh bam ? Lane , lai bnai kaba phet krad na ki nongshun jong me ? translation.en: And brought them to the magistrates , saying , These men , being Jews , do exceedingly trouble our city ,

translation.en: So the Philistines were subdued , and they came no more into the coast of Israel : and the hand of the  Lord  was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel .

translation.en: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts , to dishonour their own bodies between themselves :
And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes , and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground  ; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ngan ym shah ïa ki khñiang ban pynjot ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong phi , bad ki dieng sohwaiñ jong phi kin dap da ki sohwaiñ .
Hynrei ïa u ksiang ym donkam haba treikam tang uwei u briew ; jaiñ-jin U samla u long uwei .
translation.en: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one , but God is one .

translation.en: What shall we say then ? Is the law sin ? God forbid . Nay , I had not known sin , but by the law : for I had not known lust , except the law had said , Thou shalt not covet .

translation.kha: U Joash u syiem ka Judah u shim lut ïa baroh ki jingai ba kiba ha shuwa jong u , u Jehoshaphat , u Jehoram , bad u Ahasaïah ki la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  , u kynthup lang ïa ki jingai jong u bad ka ksiar baroh kaba ha ki ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ bad ka ïingsyiem , bad u phah ïa kita baroh kum ka jingai sngewbha sha u syiem Hasael , uba ïalam noh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u na Jerusalem .

translation.en: And Ebed–melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah , Put now these old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords . And Jeremiah did so .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa nga to buh ïa ki jaiñ rim ha ki ksang ti jong nga , khnang ba ki tyllai kin ym pynmynsaw ïa nga .

translation.en: He took his brother by the heel in the womb , and by his strength he had power with God :

translation.en: And Jonathan Saul s son arose , and went to David into the wood , and strengthened his hand in God .
And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen : for the Lord  God  shall slay thee , and call his servants by another name :
translation.kha: Ki briew ba la jied jong nga kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong phi kum ka jingtim . Ma nga , U  Trai  nongsynshar ngan pynïap ïa phi . Hynrei ngan ai ka kyrteng bathymmai ha kito kiba kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles , that eat , asking no question for conscience sake :
translation.kha: Phi long kiba laitluid ban bam ïa kano kano kaba die ha ka ïew die doh , khlem da kylli jingkylli ei ei namar ka jingïatiplem jong phi .

translation.en: For I feared thee , because thou art an austere man : thou takest up that thou layedst not down , and reapest that thou didst not sow .

translation.en: And Laban said to Jacob , Behold this heap , and behold this pillar , which I have cast betwixt me and thee  ;

translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por U Jisu u la sdang ban ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u :  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi , namar ka hima ki bneng ka la jan !
Un ïaisah u bymkhuid katba ka kata jingpang ka dang , don bad u dei ban sah kyrpang shabar ka jaka shong dara , jngai na kiwei pat .
translation.en: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled  ; he is unclean : he shall dwell alone  ; without the camp shall his habitation be .

translation.kha: ki Haba jingsuh kha ki la eh thar , ka nongpynkha khun ka ong ïa ka , Wat sheptieng , ko Rakhel ; u dei sa uwei pat u shynrang .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when she was in hard labour , that the midwife said unto her , Fear not  ; thou shalt have this son also .

translation.en: And God said , Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed  ; and thou shalt call his name Isaac : and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant , and with his seed after him .

translation.kha: U , Balei phi da kwah ban tip ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ? Ka long phylla .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto him , Why askest thou thus after my name , seeing it is secret ?

translation.en: We then , as workers together with him , beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain .

translation.kha: Haba phi la ai ïa kaba bha tam , phi lah ban ïa kaba dang sah , u nongrep u bat kaba dang sah hadien ba u la ïa la ka jingainguh .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them , When ye have heaved the best thereof from it , then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor , and as the increase of the winepress .

translation.en: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes , O prince s daughter ! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels , the work of the hands of a cunning workman .

translation.en: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass  ; and as thy days , so shall thy strength be .

translation.en: Son of man , thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house , which have eyes to see , and see not  ; they have ears to hear , and hear not : for they are a rebellious house .

translation.kha: Rephah pyllait Benjamin me na ka jingma , Obed yn ym pynïap ïa me . Men lait im Mareal me la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha nga . Ma nga , U jingsngewbiang , nga la kren .
translation.en: For I will surely deliver thee , and thou shalt not fall by the sword , but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee : because thou hast put thy trust in me , saith the  Lord .

translation.en: Who have for my life laid down their own necks : unto whom not only I give thanks , but also all the churches of the Gentiles .

Nangta , lada uno uno u ong ha phi , ‘ Ha khmih , hangne U don U Messaïah !’ lane ‘ U don hangtai !’ — wat ngeit kata ïa .

translation.en: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God . And he said unto them , Behold , the king s son shall reign , as the  Lord  hath said of the sons of David .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses face to face , as a man speaketh unto his friend . And he turned again into the camp : but his servant Joshua , the son of Nun , a young man , departed not out of the tabernacle .

translation.en: Quench not the Spirit .

translation.en: He hath made the earth by his power , he hath established the world by his wisdom , and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding .

translation.en: Not purloining , but shewing all good fidelity ; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things .

translation.en: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit : he that is abhorred of the  Lord  shall fall therein .

translation.kha: U Trai u Moses ong ha ki Israel ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.en: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour : but the rich hath many friends .

Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may continue for ever before thee : for thou , O Lord  God  , hast spoken it : and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me ban kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga khnang ba kin ïai ïohpdiang ïa ka jinglehbha jong me . Ma me , A  Trai  Nongsynshar , me la kular ïa kane , bad ka jingkyrkhu jong me kan ïaisah bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga junom .

translation.en: For they call themselves of the holy city , and stay themselves upon the God of Israel  ; The  Lord  of hosts is his name .
translation.kha: Bad pynban phi sngewsarong ban ong ba phi long ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah bakhuid bad ba phi shaniah ha U Blei ki Israel , uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
Ka la sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u Petros bad ka haduh la kmen katta katta ba ka la mareh shapoh pat khlem da plie ïa ka jingkhang , bad ka la pynbna ba u Petros u ïeng shabar .
translation.en: And when she knew Peter s voice , she opened not the gate for gladness , but ran in , and told how Peter stood before the gate .

translation.kha: rwai Kin ïa kane ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta jong pha : Ïa nongbah bapawnam la pynjot ! Ïa ki liengbah jong ka la rong noh na ki duriaw . Ki briew kane jong ka nongbah ki synshar ïa ki duriaw bad pyntriem ïa baroh kiba shong harud . duriaw
translation.en: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee , and say to thee , How art thou destroyed , that wast inhabited of seafaring men , the renowned city , which wast strong in the sea , she and her inhabitants , which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it !

translation.kha: Ko Sedekaïah , ngan jop ïa kynhun shipai jong me kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Babilonia bad shipai jong u . Ngan kynton ïa ki tiar ïapom ki shipai me hamar pdeng jong ka nongbah .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel  ; Behold , I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands , wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon , and against the Chaldeans , which besiege you without the walls , and I will assemble them into the midst of this city .

translation.kha: Hynrei tang ka jingduwai bad ka jingshah jingit kaba lah ban beh noh shabar ïa u jait ; ym don kano pat lah .
translation.en: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting .

translation.kha: Lada nga leh ïa kaei kaba ngam kwah ban leh , ka mut ngam long shuh uta uba leh ïa kata ; pynban , ka dei ka pop kaba im hapoh nga .
translation.en: Now if I do that I would not , it is no more I that do it , but sin that dwelleth in me .

translation.kha: U Trai jabieng kyrkhu jingshah aïom kaei baroh kat kaba phi leh .
translation.en: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in , and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out .
Consider what I say ; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things .

translation.en: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh–naphtali , and said unto him , Hath not the  Lord  God of Israel commanded , saying , Go and draw toward mount Tabor , and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun ?

Ngan leh kane ïa namar u Solomon u kyntait la ïa nga bad u la mane ïa ki blei nongwei : ka Astarte , ka blei ki Sidon ; u Khemosh , u blei ki Moab ; bad u Molekh , u blei ki Ammon . translation.en: Because that they have forsaken me , and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , Chemosh the god of the Moabites , and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon , and have not walked in my ways , to do that which is right in mine eyes , and to keep my statutes and my judgments , as did David his father .

translation.en: He hath swallowed down riches , and he shall vomit them up again : God shall cast them out of his belly .

translation.en: And whithersoever he entered , into villages , or cities , or country , they laid the sick in the streets , and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment : and as many as touched him were made whole .

translation.en: Make no friendship with an angry man  ; and with a furious man thou shalt not go :

translation.en: If a man be found lying with a woman married to an husband , then they shall both of them die , both the man that lay with the woman , and the woman : so shalt thou put away evil from Israel .

translation.en: And the servants and officers stood there , who had made a fire of coals  ; for it was cold : and they warmed themselves : and Peter stood with them , and warmed himself .

translation.en: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hamutal , the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .

translation.en: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust , and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away : yea , it shall be at an instant suddenly .

translation.en: And as thy servant was busy here and there , he was gone . And the king of Israel said unto him , So shall thy judgment be  ; thyself hast decided it .

They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude : her graves are round about him : all of them uncircumcised , slain by the sword : though their terror was caused in the land of the living , yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit : he is put in the midst of them that be slain .

translation.en: Which also said , Ye men of Galilee , why stand ye gazing up into heaven ? this same Jesus , which is taken up from you into heaven , shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven .

translation.kha: Ki nong Samaria ki mih shabar bad ki leit lute ïa ka jaka shong dara ki Syria . Bad kumba U Trai u la lah kren , lai kilo u kew uba tam hynriew kilo u barli die ha ka dor shi rupa .
translation.en: And the people went out , and spoiled the tents of the Syrians . So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel , and two measures of barley for a shekel , according to the word of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba Augustus Dabid u la dep kren baranda u Saul u irmat , Hato dei ma phi shisha , ko Dabid u khun jong nga ? tangon u la sdang ban ïam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul , that Saul said , Is this thy voice , my son David ? And Saul lifted up his voice , and wept .

translation.en: Jesus said unto her ,  I am the resurrection , and the life : he that believeth in me , though he were dead , yet shall he live :

translation.en: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave , and the noise of thy viols : the worm is spread under thee , and the worms cover thee .

translation.kha: Kaba ar na ki hukum bakongsan tam ka dei tupia : mawkhang Men ieit ïa jingkhleh u paramarjan kumba me ieit ïa lade .’ Ym don jingkhia pat ka hukum kaba kham kongsan ban ïa kine ar tylli .
translation.en: And the second is like , namely this , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself . There is none other commandment greater than these .

translation.kha: U Pharaoh u la jubab , Phi kiba bad phim kwah ban , bad dei kata balei ba phi kyrpad ïa nga ban shah ïa phi ban leit bad ai jingkñia U Trai .
translation.en: But he said , Ye are idle , ye are idle : therefore ye say , Let us go and do sacrifice to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Namar u ïohi ïa kut jong ka pyrthei u ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ka suiñbneng
translation.en: For he looketh to the ends of the earth , and seeth under the whole heaven  ;
But this I say , He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly ; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba u briew uba bet tang khyndiat ki symbai un ïoh ot ruh khyndiat ; uta uba bet shibun ki symbai un ïoh ot ruh shibun .

translation.kha: Hamar ba ki la kren , nga la sdang ban thoh . Hynrei nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba kren na bneng ,  To buhrieh ïa kaei kaba ki hynñiew tylli ki pyrthat ki la ong ; wat thoh ïa ka !

translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he took bread , and gave thanks to God in presence of them all : and when he had broken it , he began to eat .

translation.en: But their laying await was known of Saul . And they watched the gates day and night to kill him .

translation.kha: Nangta uta u angel u la shim ïa kata ka pliang thang jingiwbih , u la pyndap ïa ka da ki rnga ding barhem na ka duwan , bad u la bret ïa ka halor ka khyndew . La don ki jingkyrhuh bad ki jingsawa u pyrthat , ki jingthaba leilieh , bad u jumai .
Kumta nga la wan phai sha Jerusalem ban pyn-i jingisynei ïa ka nongbah Yn pynïeng pat ïa ka nga , bad ïa ka nongbah yn tei pat .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies : my house shall be built in it , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u shahshkor ! ïathuh hano , khie leit beit beit sha u lyngdoh bad ai khmih ïa me te khnang ban pynshisha ha uwei uwei baroh ba me la khiah ïa ka jingkñia u Moses u la hukum .
translation.en: And Jesus saith unto him ,  See thou tell no man  ; but go thy way , shew thyself to the priest , and offer the gift that Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .

translation.en: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth , and cry mightily unto God : yea , let them turn every one from his evil way , and from the violence that is in their hands .

translation.kha: Shisien khubor ka wan jar jar , kaba jar eh ba ngam da ïohsngew ka
translation.en: Now a thing was secretly brought to me , and mine ear received a little thereof .

translation.en: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof , like a roaring lion ravening the prey  ; they have devoured souls  ; they have taken the treasure and precious things  ; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof .

translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  will come upon thee , and thou shalt prophesy with them , and shalt be turned into another man .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan , U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  un wan da ka bor ha me , bad me ruh men ïashad bad ïarisa lang bad ki , bad men kylla long da uwei pat u briew .
Kane ka long kaei kaba ngi kwah ïa me leh ban . Ki don saw ngut ki rangbah hangne kiba la shim jingsmai .
translation.en: Do therefore this that we say to thee : We have four men which have a vow on them  ;

translation.kha: Haba Dabid u u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u phah ïa u Joab ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei .
translation.en: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab , and all the host of the mighty men .

translation.en: And he came unto the men of Succoth , and said , Behold Zebah and Zalmunna , with whom ye did upbraid me , saying , Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand , that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary ?

translation.en: My lord asked his servants , saying , Have ye a father , or a brother ?

translation.kha: Mar kumta hi ka la bad ka la sdang ban ïaid shatai . ( Ka la don khat-ar ka . ) kane la jia , ki la lyngngoh shikatdei eh .
translation.en: And straightway the damsel arose , and walked  ; for she was of the age of twelve years . And they were astonished with a great astonishment .

translation.kha: To wat pynshahshkor ïa ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u nongsharai balang lymda la wanrah da ki ar ngut ne bun ngut ki sakhi .

translation.en: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness : now their own doings have beset them about  ; they are before my face .
translation.kha: Kam ju rung ha ki jingmut jong ki ba ngan kynmaw ïa kane ka kam sniew baroh ; hynrei ki pop jong ki , ki ker sawdong ïa ki , bad ngam lah khlem da ïohi ïa ki .

Nangta ka jingshai batyngshaiñ ka ïa iehnoh ka nongbah bad ka la leit sha u lumbah ha ka phang mihngi jong ka .

translation.en: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched , and that burned with fire , nor unto blackness , and darkness , and tempest ,

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , nangno u Ïoannis u la ïoh ïa ka hok ban pynbaptis : Ka la long na U Blei ne na u briew ?

translation.en: Thy righteousness also , O God , is very high , who hast done great things : O God , who is like unto thee !
translation.kha: Ka hok jong me , A Blei , ka kot ïa ki sahit bneng . Me la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw , ym don mano mano uba kum ma me .

translation.en: And hast given them this land , which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them , a land flowing with milk and honey  ;
translation.kha: Me la ai ha ki ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , kumba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
To rwai , ko ki ! bneng Pyrta da ka jingkmen , ko ka pyrthei To ! ai ba ki kin lumbah win ha ka jingrwai ! U Trai un pyntngen ïa la ki briew ; un don jingisynei ha ki briew jong u kiba jynjar .
translation.en: Sing , O heavens  ; and be joyful , O earth  ; and break forth into singing , O mountains : for the  Lord  hath comforted his people , and will have mercy upon his afflicted .
So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead .
translation.kha: U Absalom bad ki rangbah jong u ki la sher dara ha ka ri Gilead .
Me la shah ïa ka lyer ban beh noh ïa nga me la kynting ïa nga ha ka erïong bajur .
translation.en: Thou liftest me up to the wind  ; thou causest me to ride upon it , and dissolvest my substance .
