Bread corn is bruised  ; because he will not ever be threshing it , nor break it with the wheel of his cart , nor bruise it with his horsemen .
translation.kha: Um pynsniew noh ïa u kew da kaba peh palat ïa u , bad u tip kumno ban ïuh ïa u da kaba pynïaid ïa ka kali dieng halor jong u khlem pynkhlur noh ïa ki symbai .

translation.en: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity  ; and I will bring upon them , and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and upon the men of Judah , all the evil that I have pronounced against them  ; but they hearkened not .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa me , ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me , bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong me namar ki pop kiba ma phi baroh phi la leh . pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka ïa ka kynhun , bad yn ïa ki , namar ka jingbakla ka long kaba khlem da mut khnang bad ki la wallam ruh ïa jingkñia namar ka pop kum ka jingainguh bam sha Trai .
translation.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel , and it shall be forgiven them  ; for it is ignorance : and they shall bring their offering , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord  , and their sin offering before the  Lord  , for their ignorance :

For in very deed , as the  Lord  God of Israel liveth , which hath kept me back from hurting thee , except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me , surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall .

translation.en: And if he shall neglect to hear them , tell it unto the church : but if he neglect to hear the church , let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican .

translation.en: And he sought Ahaziah : and they caught him , ( for he was hid in Samaria , ) and brought him to Jehu : and when they had slain him , they buried him : Because , said they , he is the son of Jehoshaphat , who sought the  Lord  with all his heart . translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Behold , when ye are entered into the city , there shall a man meet you , bearing a pitcher of water  ; follow him into the house where he entereth in .

translation.en: I called upon thy name , O  Lord  , out of the low dungeon .

translation.en: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever : and they have no rest day nor night , who worship the beast and his image , and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name .
translation.kha: Ka tdem jong ka ding kaba pynsaja ïa ki ka kiew shajrong junom la junom . Ym don jingtngen mynsngi ne mynmiet ïa kito kiba mane ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka dur jong u , ïa uno uno uba don ïa ka shab jong ka kyrteng jong u mradkhlaw .

Da jingpynbaptis , ngi la bad u , bad ngi bynta bad ka jingïap jong u , khnang ba , kumba U Khrist la pynmihpat na jingïap da ka bor jong ka burom Kpa kumta ruh ngi , ngi lah ban im ka jingim bathymmai .
translation.en: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death : that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father , even so we also should walk in newness of life .

translation.en: And ye shall eat it in the holy place , because it is thy due , and thy sons  due , of the sacrifices of the  Lord  made by fire : for so I am commanded .

translation.kha: Kita ki nong Ijipt ki kyrpad ïa ki Israel pynstet bad mihnoh kata ka ri Ngin ïap lut lada phim leit noh , ong .
translation.en: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people , that they might send them out of the land in haste  ; for they said , We be all dead men .
O give thanks unto the God of heaven : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U Blei jong ka bneng ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
U briew uba la shah shohdab kum u masi , uba lane la duh ïa la ka long shynrang ym dei ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew Trai U .
translation.en: He that is wounded in the stones , or hath his privy member cut off , shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord .

translation.en: A man void of understanding striketh hands , and becometh surety in the presence of his friend .

translation.kha: Bad ka jingpynpra bymjukut ka mut ban Henadad ïa me , U Blei bashisha tang ma u hi , bad kaba ithuh ïa U Jisu Khrist , ïa uba me jingbabe phah .
translation.en: And this is life eternal , that they might know thee the only true God , and Jesus Christ , whom thou hast sent .
By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not , when she had received the spies with peace .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la ïada ïa ka Rahab ka nuti na kaba shah pynïap lem bad kito ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa U Blei ; naba ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongsyntiat na Israel .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ngan pyndonkam ïa u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia ban pyndkut noh ïa ka spah jong ka Ijipt .

translation.en: But ye have set at nought all my counsel , and would none of my reproof :
translation.kha: Phi la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga baroh , bad phim mon ba ngan pynbeit ïa phi .
U Jakob u shim ki ïa tnat kiba dang im na ka dieng lieng , u diengsoh almond bad , u dieng Sning , bad u khoh snep ha katto katne haduh jaka ba ki tnat dieng kin da paw ka met lieh .
translation.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar , and of the hazel and chesnut tree  ; and pilled white strakes in them , and made the white appear which was in the rods .

translation.kha: Me la pyrsad dap ka duriaw bad ka um ka kynton shajrong eh ; ka ïeng beit thik kum ka kynroh ; “Wat bynta bajylliew tam jong ka duriaw ka kylla eh .
translation.en: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together , the floods stood upright as an heap , and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea .
Vanity of vanities , saith the preacher  ; all is vanity .
translation.kha: Ka bymmyntoi , ka bymmyntoi , ong u Stad saiñpyrkhat . Baroh ka long ka bymmyntoi .

translation.en: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence  ; and the images , that were on high above them , he cut down  ; and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images , he brake in pieces , and made dust of them , and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them .
translation.kha: Hapoh ka jingbthah jong u ïa ki duwan ha kaba la mane ïa u Baal la pynpra , bad ïa ki duwan jingiwbih hajan jong ki la pyntwa . Ki pynlwet kum ki pui pui ïa ki dur ka Asherah bad ïa kiwei ki bleithaw baroh bad nangta ki bret ïa u pui pui ha ki jingtep jong ki briew kiba la ai jingkñia ïa lade ha ki .

translation.en: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another  ; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another .
translation.kha: Bteng lang san tylli na ki ba kin long kawei ka jingkah , bad leh kumjuh ïa ki san tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah .

translation.en: And Joshua , and all Israel with him , took Achan the son of Zerah , and the silver , and the garment , and the wedge of gold , and his sons , and his daughters , and his oxen , and his asses , and his sheep , and his tent , and all that he had : and they brought them unto the valley of Achor .
translation.kha: U Joshua , lem bad ki paid Israel , ki shim ïa u Akhan , ka rupa , ka barandi , ka lyngkhot ksiar , lem bad ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei jong u Akhan , ki jingri jong u , ki kada jong u , bad ki langbrot jong u , ka ïingjaiñ jong u , bad kaei kaei baroh kaba u don , bad ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka Them Jingjynjar .

translation.en: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta uba pynïasoh ïa lade sha U Trai u long kawei bad u ha kaba kynja mynsiem .

translation.en: Their visage is blacker than a coal  ; they are not known in the streets : their skin cleaveth to their bones  ; it is withered , it is become like a stick .
translation.kha: Mynta ki thiah khlem don batip ha ki lynti bah , ïa ki durkhmat jong ki la pynïong ha ka jingïap ; ka sniehdoh jong ki , ka tyrkhong kum ka dieng , ka la sti halor ki shyieng jong ki .

translation.en: For man also knoweth not his time : as the fishes that are taken in an evil net , and as the birds that are caught in the snare  ; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time , when it falleth suddenly upon them .
translation.kha: Phim tip da lei lei lano ka por jong phi ka wan . Kum ki sim kiba la ngat kynsan ha ki jingriam , kum ki dohkha kiba la ngat ha ka jar , ngi la shah riam ha ki katto katne ki khep basniew ha kaba ngim shym khmih lynti satia ïa kata .

translation.en: And there ran a man of Benjamin out of the army , and came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes rent , and with earth upon his head .

translation.en: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter , neither on the sabbath day :
translation.kha: To duwai ha U Blei ba phin ym hap ban phet noh ha ka por tlang lane ha ka sngi Sabbaton !

translation.en: Who , when he came , and had seen the grace of God , was glad , and exhorted them all , that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi bad u la ïohi kumno U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa ki briew , u la kmen bad u la kyntu ïa ki baroh ban ïaineh bad ban long kiba beit ha U Trai da ka dohnud jong ki baroh .

translation.en: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God , then the kingdom of God is come unto you .

translation.en: For the word of God is quick , and powerful , and sharper than any twoedged sword , piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit , and of the joints and marrow , and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the third year , that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel .

translation.en: But thanks be to God , which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you .

translation.en: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity , because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the  Lord  : and that soul shall be cut off from among his people .

translation.en: And when Jesus departed thence , two blind men followed him , crying , and saying , Thou Son of David , have mercy on us .

translation.en: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you .

translation.en: Wherefore receive ye one another , as Christ also received us to the glory of God .

translation.en: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee , and accomplish mine anger upon thee : and I will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense thee for all thine abominations .

translation.en: And many that believed came , and confessed , and shewed their deeds .

translation.en: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations .

Hato nga ong kane ïa namar ba ngam ieit ïa phi ? U Blei u tip ba nga ieit ïa phi !
translation.en: Wherefore ? because I love you not ? God knoweth .

translation.kha: , namar ba ngi don hapoh jong phi ko , ngim kwah ban ïohi ïa kane kan jia , bad kumta ai
translation.en: Now because we have maintenance from the king s palace , and it was not meet for us to see the king s dishonour , therefore have we sent and certified the king  ;

translation.kha: da-ei jaiñ-jin kynmaw lem ïa nga haba kiei kiei ki bit ki biang ïa phi , bad sngewbha ruh ban ïathuh lem shaphang jong nga ha Beeshterah syiem bad ïarap ba-sngewtriem ïa Kpa ban ïohlait noh na kane ka Ma .
translation.en: But think on me when it shall be well with thee , and shew kindness , I pray thee , unto me , and make mention of me unto Pharaoh , and bring me out of this house :

translation.kha: Kan long ka pansngiat ka burom ha phi .
translation.en: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace : a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee .

translation.kha: Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ïingbishar ; wallam ïa ka jong jingmudui phi ! Buh ïa ka kam jong ban phi pynshisha ba phi long ha kaba dei !
translation.en: Put me in remembrance : let us plead together : declare thou , that thou mayest be justified .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la pynkohnguh ïa u paidbah ban kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban pyllait ïa u Barabbas bad ban ïa U Jisu
translation.en: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas , and destroy Jesus .
To the praise of the glory of his grace , wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved .
translation.kha: To ngin ïaroh ïa U Blei namar ka jingaiei ba-dap da ka burom jong u , ïa ka jingai ei u la ai ha ngi ha U Khun uba ieit jong u!

U Abner u ong ha u Dabid , Ngan leit noh mynta , ngan bad pynwan ïa ki Israel baroh sha ko phi Syiem Bakhraw . Kin pdiang phi ïa kum u syiem , bad nangta ïoh phin ïa kaei kaba phi la kwah bad phin synshar halor ka ri baroh kawei U . Dabid u ai ka jingkular jingshngain ïa u Abner bad u phah noh ïa u .
translation.en: And Abner said unto David , I will arise and go , and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king , that they may make a league with thee , and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth . And David sent Abner away  ; and he went in peace .

translation.kha: Ngam ïohi ïa ka templ ha ka nongbah , namar ka templ ka , long U Trai U Blei Badonbor bad U Khunlangbrot .
translation.en: And I saw no temple therein : for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it .

translation.kha: Ngi don khat-ar ngut shi para , ki khun jong ujuh u kpa . Uwei u para u ïap la , bad uba khatduh u dang ha don Kanaan bad i pa .’
translation.en: We be twelve brethren , sons of our father  ; one is not , and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan .

translation.kha: don hangne phi dei ki Israel . Kaei ngin leh ha ïadei bad ?
translation.en: Behold , ye are all children of Israel  ; give here your advice and counsel .

translation.kha: To pynkhiah kiba pang , to pynim pat ïa kiba ïap , ïa kito kiba na ki jingpang ñiangthohlieh , to noh ki ksuid . Phi la ïohpdiang ei , kumta to ai .
translation.en: Heal the sick , cleanse the lepers , raise the dead , cast out devils : freely ye have received , freely give .

translation.kha: Ka jingim jong phi kan don borabor ha ka jingma . Synñia sngi phin khynñiuh ka jingsheptieng bad sngew kum ban ïap ha kano kano ka khyllipmat
translation.en: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee  ; and thou shalt fear day and night , and shalt have none assurance of thy life :

translation.kha: Kiwei ki pyrshang buhrieh ïa la ki pop , hynrei ïa la ki jong ngam ju buhrieh .
translation.en: If I covered my transgressions as Adam , by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom :

translation.kha: Uei uba kham khraw , uta uba shong Pynjah bam ne uta uba shakri ïa u ? shalyntem keiñ uba shong nongbylla Hynrei nga long hapdeng jong phi kum uta uba shakri .
translation.en: For whether is greater , he that sitteth at meat , or he that serveth ? is not he that sitteth at meat ? but I am among you as he that serveth .
Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do  ; for evil is determined against our master , and against all his household : for he is such a son of Belial , that a man cannot speak to him .
translation.kha: Sngewbha da pyrkhat shaphang kane bad sa rai ïa kaei ban leh . Kane ka lah ban long kaba shyrkhei ïa u kynrad jong ngi bad ïa ka longïing jong u baroh . U long uba sniew jinglong ba un ym sngap ïano ïano ruh !

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What man shall there be among you , that shall have one sheep , and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day , will he not lay hold on it , and lift it out ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kumno lada uwei na phi u don kawei ka langbrot bad ka hap hapoh ka thliew bajylliew ha ka sngi Sabbaton ? Hato phin ym bat ïa ka bad kyntiew ïa ka shabar ?
Wat thmu sniew ei ei pynmong ïa la u paramarjan , uba hajan jong phi , uba shaniah phi .
translation.en: Devise not evil against thy neighbour , seeing he dwelleth securely by thee .

And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees , whereof she hath said , These are my rewards that my lovers have given me : and I will make them a forest , and the beasts of the field shall eat them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjulor ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki diengsoh Dumbur jong ka , kiba ka ju ong ba kiba ieit jong ka ki ai ïa ka namar ba ka la shakri ïa ki . Ngan pynkylla ri khlaw ïa ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki brisoh jong ka ; ki mradkhlaw kin pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world : thine they were , and thou gavest them me  ; and they have kept thy word .
translation.kha: Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha kito ïa kiba me la ai ha nga na ka pyrthei . Ki la long ki jong me , bad me la ai ïa ki ha nga .

U ïeng ha ka ïeng jong ki bad pynlong ka jutang bad Trai ban kohnguh ïa u , ban sumar ïa ki bad ki hukum jong u , da ka dohnud bad mynsiem jong u bad ban leh ïa ki kiba bad ka kumba la thoh ha Kitab . Bad baroh ki kular ban bat ïa ka jutang .
translation.en: And the king stood by a pillar , and made a covenant before the  Lord  , to walk after the  Lord  , and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul , to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book . And all the people stood to the covenant .

translation.kha: Hato men ym khmih ïa nga , Blei , lane buh ïa nga ha jingbishar bad jingtian bishar
translation.en: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one , and bringest me into judgment with thee ?
Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples ,
translation.kha: Katba baroh ki paidbah ki dang shahshkor ïa u , U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,
Katto katne por ainguh jinglyngkhuit , u nongrah khuri kismis u syiem Ijipt bad u nongshet Kabbon rangbah jong ba-bang ki la pynbitar ïa u syiem .
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt .

translation.kha: Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ïa ki ! balang
translation.en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
And last of all the woman died also .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh eh , ka kynthei ka la ïap .

translation.en: And said ,  Where have ye laid him ?  They said unto him , Lord , come and see .
translation.kha: Hangno phi la tep ïa u ?  u la kylli ïa ki .  To wan bad peit Ko Trai ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shemphang ïa ka jingjubab jong u .

translation.en: The  Lord  will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish : but he casteth away the substance of the wicked .
translation.kha: U  Trai  um shah ïa ki briew kiba bha ban shahthngan , hynrei u khang ïa ki bymman ban ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .
U jingsngewlem u la ïeng joit Abihu u la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh bad u la bud ïa u .
translation.en: And he left all , rose up , and followed him .

translation.kha: Katto ngut na ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki ong , jubab dei ko !
translation.en: Then certain of the scribes answering said , Master , thou hast well said .

translation.kha: Ngi Daberath bymshisha marsyndah jong ka rud duriaw , bad da lawbah jingeh bakhraw ngi la pyrkhat sha ka jaka ba la jingpynphai , Ka Jakarieh Lieng Bashngain , jingduk bym da jngai na ka shnong Lasaïa .
translation.en: And , hardly passing it , came unto a place which is called The fair havens  ; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea .
Produce your cause , saith the  Lord   ; bring forth your strong reasons , saith the King of Jacob .
translation.kha: U  Trai  , u Syiem ki Israel , u don ïa kane ban ong :  Phi ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew , to buh ïa ka kam jong phi . Wallam ïa ki jingïasaid nia babha tam ba phi don !
Lada ki ïa plie ki khyrdop shnong bad ki kloi ban ïasuk baroh , ki dei ban long ki mraw jong phi bad kin trei ruh kum ki mraw .
translation.en: And it shall be , if it make thee answer of peace , and open unto thee , then it shall be , that all the people that is found therein shall be tributaries unto thee , and they shall serve thee .

translation.kha: Ki briew kin behmrad shipai da ki ryntieh bad ki khnam . Ho-oid , ka ri baroh kawei kan dap Bymman mandriek shynraiñ bad ki bniap shiah .
translation.en: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither  ; because all the land shall become briers and thorns .

translation.kha: Nga sngewthikna katta katta ïa phi ; nga sngewsarong na ka bynta jong phi ! Ha ki jong jingjynjar ngi baroh dang nga dap hi da ka jingshlur ; nga shlei da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Great is my boldness of speech toward you , great is my glorying of you : I am filled with comfort , I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ba nga la pyndep Ba-ijli ka Nongsakhi Pynkhuid kine ki thain bad namar ba nga la ju kwah la bun snem ban wan khmih ïa phi , Lymda kyrmen ban kpu kumta mynta .
translation.en: But now having no more place in these parts , and having a great desire these many years to come unto you ;

translation.kha: U Petros bad kiwei pat ki apostol ki la phai ktien , Ngi dei ban kohnguh ïa U Blei , ym ïa ki briew .
translation.en: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said , We ought to obey God rather than men .

translation.kha: Ka khlieh jong nga ka king Pynshad bad nga kynsit da ka jingsheptieng . Nga la khmih lynti ïa ka janmiet ban wan , hynrei kam shym wallam ei ei Hasarmabeth tang ka Khroh .
translation.en: My heart panted , fearfulness affrighted me : the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me .
But Zion said , The  Lord  hath forsaken me , and my Lord hath forgotten me .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ki la ong ,  U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa ngi ! U la klet ïa ngi .

translation.en: And all the people went over Jordan . And when the king was come over , the king kissed Barzillai , and blessed him  ; and he returned unto his own place .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid bad baroh ki rangbah jong u ki la jam sha shiliang ka Jordan . U la doh ïa u Barsillai bad u ai ha u ïa la ka jingkyrkhu kyrdoh , bad u Barsillai u leit phai noh sha ïing .

translation.en: That Hadad fled , he and certain Edomites of his father s servants with him , to go into Egypt  ; Hadad being yet a little child .
translation.kha: Ma u bad ki briew jong u ki la sah hynriew bnai ha Edom , bad ha kata ka por ki pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang ha Edom lait noh u Hadad bad katto katne ngut ki nong Edom kiba long ki shakri u kpa jong u , kiba la phet ïap sha Ijipt . ( Ha kata ka por u Hadad u dang long tang u khynnah . )

translation.en: And Noah began to be an husbandman , and he planted a vineyard :
translation.kha: U Noah , uba long u nongrep , u long u briew uba nyngkong eh ban thung ka bri sohwaiñ .
Uno uno uba artatien ïa ka jong iktiar me lane u bymkohnguh ïa kano kano na ki hukum jong me un shah pynïap . To long uba kut jingmut triang bad skhem uba .
translation.en: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment , and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him , he shall be put to death : only be strong and of a good courage .
Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old , having been the wife of one man ,
translation.kha: To wat kynthup ïa kano kano ka riewkynthei ha ka thup ki riewkynthei lymda ka la dap hynriewphew snem ka rta .

translation.en: That all of you have conspired against me , and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse , and there is none of you that is sorry for me , or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me , to lie in wait , as at this day ?
translation.kha: Hato dei na kata ba phi baroh phi la ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga ? Ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la ïathuh ha nga ba u khun jong nga hi u la ïateh kular bad u Dabid . Ym don uwei ruh uba pyrkhat sngewlem ïa nga lane ïathuh ha nga ba u Dabid , uwei na ki rangbah jong nga , u don hangne mynta , u da wad ïa ka kabu ban pynïap ïa nga , bad ba u khun jong nga u la pynshlur ïa u !
Mynta te , u Jotham u bteng , Hato phi lehhok bad kaba mynsiem haba phi thung syiem ïa u Abimelekh ? Hato kynmaw burom u bad lehbha ïa longïing jong u , kumba kam jong u ki dei ban ïoh ?
translation.en: Now therefore , if ye have done truly and sincerely , in that ye have made Abimelech king , and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house , and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands  ;

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ai hukum ha u Benaïah , uba mih shabar bad u Shimei . U Solomon mynta u la ïoh ka kaba .
translation.en: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada  ; which went out , and fell upon him , that he died . And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon .

translation.kha: Ngi ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong , ban maham ïa kiba , ban pynshlur ïa kiba khawpud , ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot , ïaishah ïa baroh .
translation.en: Now we exhort you , brethren , warn them that are unruly , comfort the feebleminded , support the weak , be patient toward all men .
For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth , and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth .
translation.kha: Namar U Trai u sneng ïa baroh kiba u ieit , bad u sympat ïa uno uno ïa uba u pdiang kum la u khun .
Ka kaba tnga bunktien ka long syriem kum ka um kaba jaw jrop shi jrop ha ka sngi ba slap .
translation.en: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike .

translation.kha: Jedaïah , u khun jong u Harumaph u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba don hajan ka ïing jong u hi . U Hattush , jong u Hashabneïah u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
translation.en: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph , even over against his house . And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah .
And the anointing oil , and sweet incense for the holy place : according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do .
translation.kha: ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , bad ïa ka jingiwbih basma sngewtynnat na ka bynta Ka Jaka Kyntang . Ha kaba shna ïa kine baroh , ki dei ban leh thik kat kumba nga la hukum ïa me .

Da kumta un ym sngew ba kham u halor ban ïa la ki para Israel bad un ym lyndet da kumno kumno ruh ïa ki U hukum . Trai Te un synshar bun snem , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u ruh kin ïoh synshar bun pateng ha Israel .
translation.en: That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren , and that he turn not aside from the commandment , to the right hand , or to the left : to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom , he , and his children , in the midst of Israel .
And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father s house , the offspring and the issue , all vessels of small quantity , from the vessels of cups , even to all the vessels of flagons .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u baroh bad kiba hapoh ka ïing jong u kin long ka jingbankhia ïa u . Kin sdien ha u kum ki khiew bad ki pliang kiba la wah ha u snar !

translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? Behold , they which are gorgeously apparelled , and live delicately , are in kings  courts .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei phi la leit ban peit ? Hato ïa u briew uba phong ki jaiñ kiba itynnat ? Ïa ki briew kiba riam kumta bad kiba shong ha ka jingdap kyrhai la shem ha ki ïingsyiem !

translation.en: Render unto them a recompence , O  Lord  , according to the work of their hands .
translation.kha: To pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh , A  Trai  ;
Haba u Nahor la dap arphew khyndai snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Terah ;
translation.en: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years , and begat Terah :

But they also have erred through wine , and through strong drink are out of the way  ; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink , they are swallowed up of wine , they are out of the way through strong drink  ; they err in vision , they stumble in judgment .
translation.kha: Wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki buaid bha bad ki ïaid sheng sheng . Ki la dih waiñ bad dih kyiad haduh katta katta haduh ba ki jynthut kulmar . Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïabuaid haduh katta katta ba kim sngewthuh shuh ïa ki jingïohipaw ba U Blei u phah , bad ki lyngdoh ki buaid haduh ba kim lah shuh ban ai jingrai ïa ki kam ba la wanrah ha ki .
Hynrei wat shah ïa u be-ijot pynkohnguh nongsuhjaiñ phi ; wat shahshkor ruh ïa u . Wat kyllan ïa hima-patsha ïada wat sngewsynei ïa ki , bad bymotsher ïada ïa ki Baalsebub
translation.en: Thou shalt not consent unto him , nor hearken unto him  ; neither shall thine eye pity him , neither shalt thou spare , neither shalt thou conceal him :

translation.kha: Na kano ka lynti u leit ? u ïa ki .
translation.en: And their father said unto them , What way went he ? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went , which came from Judah .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran u la ha ki ka bad ka iktiar ban beh noh ïa ki ksuid baroh bad ban pynkhiah ïa ki jingpang .
translation.en: Then he called his twelve disciples together , and gave them power and authority over all devils , and to cure diseases .

translation.kha: bad ka da phyrnai da ka burom jong U Blei Ka nongbah ka la kum u mawkordor , u maw Jasper , kaba shai sngur bha .
translation.en: Having the glory of God : and her light was like unto a stone most precious , even like a jasper stone , clear as crystal  ;

translation.kha: kito kiba ki long kiba khatduh kin long nyngkong , bad kito kiba mynta long nyngkong kin khatduh .
translation.en: And , behold , there are last which shall be first , and there are first which shall be last .

translation.kha: Naba ïa ka jingkular U Blei la pynlong ha kine ki ktien : Ha ka por kaba dei ngan wan pat , bad ka kan Sarah ïoh khun . shynrang
translation.en: For this is the word of promise , At this time will I come , and Sara shall have a son .

translation.kha: Nangta u teng shim shi Sinai u kpu , bad U la ainguh ha U Blei , U la kdiah ïa u , bad U la ai ïa u ha ki , khang kaba ong , Une u long ka met jong nga , pynïadait kaba Pyrkhat ai na Hul bynta jong phi . To leh ïa kane ban kynmaw ïa nga .
translation.en: And he took bread , and gave thanks , and brake it , and gave unto them , saying ,  This is my body which is given for you : this do in remembrance of me .

translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa u syiem jong ka jylla Sobah jong Syria , kaba hajan ka ri , namar u u la pyrshang ban jop ri kaba shaphang shaneng ka Ïuphratis .
translation.en: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath , as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates .
And Shaalabbin , and Aijalon , and Jethlah ,
translation.kha: ka Shaalbim , ka Aijalon , ka Ithlah ,
U Omri bad ki shipai jong u ki mihnoh Gibbethon na bad leit kerkut ïa ka Tirsah .
translation.en: And Omri went up from Gibbethon , and all Israel with him , and they besieged Tirzah .

And when Moses  father in law saw all that he did to the people , he said , What is this thing that thou doest to the people ? why sittest thou thyself alone , and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even ?
translation.kha: Haba u Jethro u la ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Moses u dei ban leh , u la kylli ,  Kaei keiñ kane kaba phi leh na ka bynta u paidbah ? Balei phi shu leh hi marwei ïa kane baroh katba ki briew ki shu ïa-ïeng hangne naduh dang step haduh ban da miet ban ïasyllok bad me .

translation.en: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself : and when he came home , he sent and called for his friends , and Zeresh his wife .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la shu tyngkan ïa lade bad u leit sha ïing . Nangta u khot sngewbha ïa ki paralok jong u sha ka ïing jong u bad ong ïa ka tnga jong u ka Seresh ban wan ban ïadon ryngkat bad ki .

translation.en: And he said , Take them alive . And they took them alive , and slew them at the pit of the shearing house , even two and forty men  ; neither left he any of them .
translation.kha: U Jehu u la hukum ïa la ki briew ,  Kem im ïa ki .  Ki la kem ïa ki , bad u pynïap ïa ki hajan kawei ka thliew hangta . Baroh ki ïadon sawphew ar ngut , bad ym shym la pyllait im ïa uwei ruh na ki .

Ephphatha nga pynbna ba u ïohphet ba-bymman u dei nongïasaid ïap sngewsarong Shibboleth shym la maham ïa u Synrum un phai na ki lynti bymdon u khnang ba u lah ban pynim ïa la ka jingim sympat te un ïap , kum Ayyah nongpop Lebi bad ngan pynkit pop ïa me na ka bynta ka jingïap Abner u .
translation.en: When I say unto the wicked , O wicked man , thou shalt surely die  ; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way , that wicked man shall die in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .

translation.kha: Man ka por ba langbrot ka ka shah pynïap ha mradkhlaw ki , nga kitkhlieh hi ma nga . Ngam ju wanrah ïa kata ban pyn-i ha phi ba kam shym dei ka jingbakla jong nga . Phi dawa ba ma nga hi hap ngan buria ïa kaba lah shah la tuh ka long mynsngi lane mynmiet .
translation.en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee  ; I bare the loss of it  ; of my hand didst thou require it , whether stolen by day , or stolen by night .
And another said , I have bought five yoke of oxen , and I go to prove them : I pray thee have me excused .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u la ong , ‘ Nga la thied san jur ki masi dab bad nga don ha ka lynti ban tynjuh ïa ki ; sngewbha pdiang ïa ka jingbymlah wan jong nga .’
Nangta pyndap u , Nga don hangne ka kitab kaba u u Hilkaïah la ai ha nga . Bad u pule jam ïa ka ha u syiem .
translation.en: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king , saying , Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book . And Shaphan read it before the king .
Therefore , O ye shepherds , hear the word of the  Lord   ;
translation.kha: Kumta to shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki nongsharai .
Ki ïathuh ki ïa phi ka kyrteng jong . Ngam shym phah ïa ki . Ma , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , la .’
translation.en: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name : I have not sent them , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la kylli ïa nga Hato , mem tip ? Em , ngam tip , ko rangbah , nga la jubab .
translation.en: And he answered me and said , Knowest thou not what these be ? And I said , No , my lord .

translation.kha: U dawa , Hato phi pyrkhat ba ktien ki ki lah ban shim ïa jaka jong ka ka jingtbit ha ka kam shipai bad ka bor ? Mano phi pyrkhat u ban ïarap ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Assyria ?
translation.en: Thou sayest , ( but they are but vain words , ) I have counsel and strength for the war . Now on whom dost thou trust , that thou rebellest against me ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Naba slem la nga la don bad phi baroh ; pynban mem ïa ithuh nga , Philip ko ? Uno uno uba la ïohi ïa nga u la ïohi U ïa Kpa . Balei , te , me ong , ‘ To pyn-i ha ngi ïa U Kpa ?’
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Have I been so long time with you , and yet hast thou not known me , Philip ? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father  ; and how sayest thou then , Shew us the Father ?

translation.kha: U Moses u la ai ha phi ïa Belshassar jingpynbynta , jingput jingkyntip dei kumta ? Hynrei ym don uwei na phi uba kohnguh ïa ïakhlad Hukum . Balei ba phi pyrshang ban kai ïa nga Salu
translation.en: Did not Moses give you the law , and yet none of you keepeth the law ? Why go ye about to kill me ?

And it came to pass on a certain day , as he was teaching , that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by , which were come out of every town of Galilee , and Judaea , and Jerusalem : and the power of the Lord was present to heal them .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi mynba U Jisu u dang hikai , katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la wan na kawei pa kawei ka shnong na Galilaïa bad Judia bad na Jerusalem ; ki la ïashong hangta . Ka bor jong U Trai ka la don na ka bynta U Jisu ban pynkhiah ïa kiba pang .
Ka sngi Goshen kat jingjot ka la wan ïa ka Israel . u ïalehkai jubor ka nang roi . Ka sawspah ka ñiar rasong plain
translation.en: Behold the day , behold , it is come : the morning is gone forth  ; the rod hath blossomed , pride hath budded .

translation.kha: Ki ummat jong nga kin mih kum ki wahduid ba ïai . tuid
translation.en: Mine eye trickleth down , and ceaseth not , without any intermission ,
The righteous considereth the cause of the poor : but the wicked regardeth not to know it .
translation.kha: U briew uba bha u tip ïa ki hok jong kiba duk , hynrei ki briew basniew kim lah sngewthuh kum ïa kita kiei kiei .
Nga ong skhem ïa phi ba ki ïa briew lah ban map ïa ki pop ki jong baroh , bad ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba ki lah ban ong .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men , and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme :
Then the fire of the  Lord  fell , and consumed the burnt sacrifice , and the wood , and the stones , and the dust , and licked up the water that was in the trench .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding najrong , bad ka thang duh ïa ka jingkñia , ïa ki diengthang bad ïa ki maw ; ka pyningkhong ïa ka khyndew bad pynrngad lut ïa ka um ha ka kharai .

translation.en: And when I beheld , lo , the sinews and the flesh came up upon them , and the skin covered them above : but there was no breath in them .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang peit , la sop ïa ki shyieng da ki thied , bad ka dohksah , bad nangta da ka sniehdoh . Hynrei ym don jingpynhiar mynsiem ha kita ki met .

Ngan pyntylli ïa ki kum kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka ri , halor ki lumbah ka ; Israel kin tang don uwei u syiem u ban synshar halor jong ki , bad kin ym long ka shuh jingïaphiah ha ki ar ki jaitbynriew lane ïabynta ha ki ar tylli ki hima .
translation.en: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel  ; and one king shall be king to them all : and they shall be no more two nations , neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all :

translation.kha: Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , bad ym don jingkut ki jingkynshew jong ki . Ka ri jong ki ka dap ki kulai , bad ym ïa ki jong ki .
translation.en: Their land also is full of silver and gold , neither is there any end of their treasures  ; their land is also full of horses , neither is there any end of their chariots :
And the vine said unto them , Should I leave my wine , which cheereth God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u dieng sohwaiñ u jubab , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , ngan hap sangeh ban pynmih ïa ka waiñ jong nga , kaba pynkmen ïa ki blei bad ïa ki khunbynriew .’
Ka kmie jong u ka jubab , To ai ba kano kano ka jingtim kan hap halor jong nga ; ,44 khun Siba nga , shu leh ïa-bujli nga ong Thep bad khie leit bad wanrah ïa ki blang Sihon nga .
translation.en: And his mother said unto him , Upon me be thy curse , my son : only obey my voice , and go fetch me them .
For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach , because we trust in the living God , who is the Saviour of all men , specially of those that believe .
translation.kha: Ngi ïaleh tyngeh bad trei shitom , namar ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha U Blei uba im , uba long U Nongpynim ïa baroh bad khamtam ïa kito kiba ngeit .

translation.en: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee : so will I destroy thy cities .
translation.kha: Ngan pynpra phom ïa ki dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah ha ka ri jong phi bad ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong phi .
Phim dei ban ïadon bynta ei ei bad ki kam bym jingmyntoi don kiba ki briew ki leh , kiba long ki kam ka . jingdum Pynban wallam ïa ki sha ka jingshai .
translation.en: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness , but rather reprove them .
And he laid his carcase in his own grave  ; and they mourned over him , saying , Alas , my brother !
translation.kha: U tep ïa ka metïap ha ka jingtep jong ka longïing jong u hi , bad ma u bad la ki khun shynrang ki ïam sngewsih ïa ka , ki da ong ,  O u para jong nga , u para jong nga !
Nga lah ban pynkhlaiñ ïa phi da ki jingai jingmut bad ngan ïai kren ban ephod ïa phi .
translation.en: But I would strengthen you with my mouth , and the moving of my lips should assuage your grief .

Therefore I am full of the fury of the  Lord   ; I am weary with holding in : I will pour it out upon the children abroad , and upon the assembly of young men together : for even the husband with the wife shall be taken , the aged with him that is full of days .
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar jong me pyrshah ïa ki ka pluh ruh hapoh jong nga , A  Trai  , bad ngam lah ban kun slem shuh ïa ka .  Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  To theh noh ïa ka jingbitar jong nga halor ki khynnah ha ki surok bad ha ki jingïalang jong ki samla shynrang . Ïa ki rangbah bad ki tnga jong ki yn shim noh , bad wat ïa kiba tymmen tam yn ym pynsah .
Khie leit phai noh sha , ïing naba nga la tymmen ban shongkurim biang . Wat lada nga pyrkhat dang ba don jingkyrmen , bad kumta ban shongkurim ha kane ka miet bad ïoh khun shynrang ,
translation.en: Turn again , my daughters , go your way  ; for I am too old to have an husband . If I should say , I have hope , if I should have an husband also to night , and should also bear sons  ;

translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw ba U Trai un sa hikai ïa phi kawei pa kawei kyntien ka , pa kawei kawei ka laiñ , kawei pa kawei ka jinghikai . Te phin jynthut ha kawei pa kawei ka jingjam ba phi . shim Phin sa mynsaw , shah riam phin bad long koidi .
translation.en: But the word of the  Lord  was unto them precept upon precept , precept upon precept  ; line upon line , line upon line  ; here a little , and there a little  ; that they might go , and fall backward , and be broken , and snared , and taken .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba khlem Blei long ki kum kito ki khah ; ka jingkyrmen ki jong ka duh noh , shisien ba la klet ïa U Blei .
translation.en: So are the paths of all that forget God  ; and the hypocrite s hope shall perish :
Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow , and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine : and spare ye not her young men  ; destroy ye utterly all her host .
translation.kha: Wat ai por ïa ki shipai ban siat ïa ki khnam ne kieng ïa ki atiar ïaleh jong ki . Wat pyllait ïa ki samla shynrang ! Pynjot ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei !

translation.en: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have no bread .
translation.kha: Ki la ïasdang ban ïakren para ma ki :  U ong ïa kane namar ngim don kpu .
U Abraham u la dohksah bha , bad U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa ontep ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u leh .
translation.en: And Abraham was old , and well stricken in age : and the  Lord  had blessed Abraham in all things .

translation.kha: Ka long ka jingstad ban bakynsai Jeriel wieh Trai . U pyrta ïa ka nongbah , To shahshkor phi ki briew kiba Karshena ha jingmihnoh nongbah !
translation.en: The  Lord s  voice crieth unto the city , and the man of wisdom shall see thy name : hear ye the rod , and who hath appointed it .

translation.kha: Kumta da husiar ïa kaei kaba phi leh ! u Lada hynmen u para jong phi u leh pop , to sneng tyngeh u ïa , bad lada u kylla-kaba-mut , to map ïa u .
translation.en: Take heed to yourselves : If thy brother trespass against thee , rebuke him  ; and if he repent , forgive him .
Vex the Midianites , and smite them :
translation.kha: Tur ïaleh ïa ki Midian bad pynjot thiaw ïa ki ,

translation.en: For Demas hath forsaken me , having loved this present world , and is departed unto Thessalonica ; Crescens to Galatia , Titus unto Dalmatia .
translation.kha: U Demas u la kham noh ha ki kam pyrthei bad u la iehnoh ïa nga , bad u la leit noh sha Thessaloni . U Kreskens u la leit sha Galatia ; u Titos sha Dalmatia .
Bun na ki , ki la ngeit , bad bun ki kynthei Grik kiba ha ka kyrdan ba-halor ha imlang ka ka sahlang bad bun ki rangbah Grik ruh ki ngeit la .
translation.en: Therefore many of them believed  ; also of honourable women which were Greeks , and of men , not a few .

translation.kha: Ka khubor ka long ka ding bad kum u tyrnem uba pynpait ïa ki mawsiang .
translation.en: Is not my word like as a fire ? saith the  Lord   ; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces ?

translation.kha: Ka long kaba sawdong bad kaba la khylliap ar . syrtap Ka don arphew ar sentimitar ka lynter bad arphew ar sentimitar ka jingïar .
translation.en: It was foursquare  ; they made the breastplate double : a span was the length thereof , and a span the breadth thereof , being doubled .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom jong U Trai ; to wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bad wan sha Templ ka jong u .
translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  the glory due unto his name : bring an offering , and come into his courts .

translation.kha: U la pynduh ïa ka hukum ki Jiw da ki jong ki hukum bad ki kyndon , khnang ban ïoh ïa ki ar tylli ki jaitbynriew kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba thymmai ha u hi , ha kane ka rukom u wanrah jingsuk .
translation.en: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity , even the law of commandments contained in ordinances ; for to make in himself of twain one new man , so making peace ;
And when the devil was cast out , the dumb spake : and the multitudes marvelled , saying , It was never so seen in Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei mar syn beh noh ïa u ksuid , u briew u la sdang ban kren , bad uwei uwei baroh u la lyngngoh ,  Ngim pat ju ïohi mynno mynno ruh kum kane ha Israel !  ki la ong .

translation.en: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the  Lord  , and he pondereth all his goings .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïohi ïa baroh kaba phi leh , kat shaba phi leit , u peit ïa phi .

translation.en: And I will set fire in Egypt : Sin shall have great pain , and No shall be rent asunder , and Memphis shall have distresses daily .
translation.kha: Ngan tbeh ding ïa ka Ijipt , bad ka Pelusium kan don ha ka jingkordit . Ki kynroh jong ka Thebes kin pra , bad ka nongbah kan shlei da ka um .
Ngan ailad ïa ki katto katne ban ïohlait na ka waitlam bad kin sakma hapdeng ki jaitbynriew bad kin im kum kiba ringmraw .
translation.en: Yet will I leave a remnant , that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations , when ye shall be scattered through the countries .
And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I also will ask you one thing , which if ye tell me , I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ngan kylli ïa phi tang kawei ka jingkylli , bad lada phi ai ha nga ka jubab , ngan ïathuh ha phi da ka bor aïu nga don ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark , that the ark may be borne with them .
translation.kha: Bsuh ïa kita ki dieng jingbah lyngba ki kyrwoh ha baroh arliang kata ka synduk , ba yn ïoh bah ïa ka da ki .
Ki khlieh jong ki longïing longsem ha ka kur u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir u ksiew jong u Manasseh u khun jong u Joseph , la ki leit sha Moses u bad kiwei pat nongïalam ki .
translation.en: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of the sons of Joseph , came near , and spake before Moses , and before the princes , the chief fathers of the children of Israel :
Now therefore hearken unto me , O ye children : for blessed are they that keep my ways .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ko samla , shahshkor ïa nga . Leh kumba nga ong , bad phin long suk .

La don kawei ka nongïathuhlypa kaba tymmen la bha , ka riewkynthei kaba kyrteng ka Anna , ka khun jong u Phanuel na ka jait Asher Ka . la tang shongkurim hynñiew snem bad ka mynta la dap phraphew saw snem ka rta . ju Kam mih shuh na ka Templ ; mynsngi bad mynmiet ka la mane ïa U Blei , da kaba shahjingit bad duwai .
translation.en: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years , which departed not from the temple , but served God with fastings and prayers night and day .
Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat , and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart , because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen .
translation.kha: Khatduh eh , U Jisu u la mihpaw ha ki khatwei ngut ki synran katba ki dang ïabam . U la kren tyngeh ïa ki , namar kim shym la don jingngeit bad namar ka jingmutlop palat ïa ka ban ngeit ïa kito kiba la lah ïohi ïa u ba u im .

translation.en: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king , she fell on her face to the ground , and did obeisance , and said , Help , O king .
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka leit sha u syiem , ka dem ngon haduh khyndew ha ka jingñiewburom bad ka ong ,  Ïarap ïa nga , ko Syiem Kynrad !

translation.en: ( And the children of Israel went up and wept before the  Lord  until even , and asked counsel of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother ? And the  Lord  said , Go up against him . )
translation.kha: Te ki khun Israel ki leit kiew sha jaka mane Blei bad ki ïamkthang ha khmat U  Trai  haduh janmiet . Ki kylli ïa u ,  Hato ngin leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki para jait jong ngi ki Benjamin ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ho-oid .  Kumta ki paidïapom ki Israel ki la ïoh mynsiem , bad ki pynïeng ïa la ki shipai ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ki la leh ha ka sngi kaba la dep .
U Abraham u leit phai jingïa-ïaid sha ïakut ki shakri , bad ki Ainguh Mareal sha Beersheba , ha kaba u Abraham u shongneh hangta .
translation.en: So Abraham returned unto his young men , and they rose up and went together to Beer–sheba  ; and Abraham dwelt at Beer–sheba .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa u Moses ,
U Daniel shisyndon u la leit bad u la ïoh por da jingai jingbit jong u syiem , khnang u lah ban ïathuh ïa u aïu ka jingphohsniew ka kit jingmut
translation.en: Then Daniel went in , and desired of the king that he would give him time , and that he would shew the king the interpretation .
And our father said , Go again , and buy us a little food .
translation.kha: Nangta i ong ban leit thied jingbam shuh sa khyndiat .

translation.en: Now therefore why should we die ? for this great fire will consume us : if we hear the voice of the  Lord  our God any more , then we shall die .
translation.kha: Hynrei balei ngin shu ïap ei ? Kata ka ding kaba ishyrkhei kan thang duh ïa ngi . Khlem pep ngin ïap lada ngi ïohsngew biang ba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u kren .
Me la buh ïa ka pyrthei ha ki baskhem , bad ym pynkhih shuh ïa ka .
translation.en: Who laid the foundations of the earth , that it should not be removed for ever .
So Joshua let the people depart , every man unto his inheritance .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u la phah noh ïa u paidbah , bad uwei pa uwei u leit phai pat sha la ka jong ka jong ka jaka .

translation.en: Break forth into joy , sing together , ye waste places of Jerusalem : for the  Lord  hath comforted his people , he hath redeemed Jerusalem .
translation.kha: To risa lang da ka jingkmen , phi ki jingpra ka Jerusalem ! U  Trai  un pyllait ïa la ka nongbah bad un pyntngen ïa la ki briew .
Nga la phah ki ïa lyer ba-tyrkhong bad u phria ban pynjot ïa baroh kiba phi pyrshang ban thung , hynrei phim kylla-kaba-mut hi .
translation.en: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands  ; yet ye turned not to me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: buddien kumta U Trai u bitar lep Shadkmen ki Israel bad u la shah dumok ki nonglute ban tur pa’ bad ïakhana ïa ki Dohkha U nongkurup ïa ki nongshun syntiat sawdong Us ki ban thombor ïa ki , bad ki tylli jyrtieng lah shuh ban ïada ïa lade .
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them , and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about , so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies .

translation.kha: Kin pyiar ïa la ki kti kumba ki pyrshang ban jngi , hynrei U Blei un pynjahburom ïa ki , bad ki kti jong kin ngam ki khlem ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them , as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim : and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands .
For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you , and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God ;
translation.kha: Kito ki briew baroh , ki kren shaphang kumno ba phi la pdiang ïa ngi myn haba ngi la wan jngoh ïa phi , bad kumno ba phi la phai noh na ki bleithaw sha U Blei , ban shakri ïa U Blei uba shisha bad uba im

translation.en: And I appeared unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , by the name of God Almighty , but by my name  Jehovah  was I not known to them .
translation.kha: Nga la mihpaw ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob , kum U Blei Badonbor Baroh , hynrei ngam shym la pynithuh ïa lade ha ki da ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , U  Trai .

translation.en: Then said I , Whither goest thou ? And he said unto me , To measure Jerusalem , to see what is the breadth thereof , and what is the length thereof .
translation.kha: Shano phin leit ?  nga la kylli .  Ban thew ïa ka Jerusalem ,  u la jubab ,  ban ïohi katno ka jingjrong bad ka jingïar jong ka .
Ngi ïaid lyngba ka jingpynjot bad jingpra ; ngi ha bad ka .
translation.en: Fear and a snare is come upon us , desolation and destruction .
For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever : and thou ,  Lord  , art become their God .
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki Israel , ki briew jong me hi junom , bad me , A  Trai  , me la long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: And I will cut off the cities of thy land , and throw down all thy strong holds :
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah ha ka ri jong phi bad pynpra ïa ki jingïada jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Then when Jesus came , he found that he had lain in the grave four days already .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la poi , u la shem ba la lah tep ïa u Lasaros saw sngi mynshuwa .

translation.en: And whosoever doth not bear his cross , and come after me , cannot be my disciple .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym bah ïa la ka diengphna bad wan nadien jong nga , um lah ban long u synran jong nga .

translation.en: When thou goest forth to war against thine enemies , and the  Lord  thy God hath delivered them into thine hands , and thou hast taken them captive ,
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pynjop thma ïa phi bad phi ïohkem koidi ,

pynap Huppim briew ki la thynrang palat bad ki la Shuah khñium jingsiangthiah u Moses Asalaïah Ki la Asahel , Balei tohkit ba phi wan ïalam noh ïa ngi jingpynkhuid ka ri Ijipt ? Hato phi mut bakyntang sopti-lor da ka bymman ïa ngi bad ïa ki khun lyer kti jong Arsa , bad ïa ki jingri jong ngi ?
translation.en: And the people thirsted there for water  ; and the people murmured against Moses , and said , Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt , to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst ?

translation.kha: man kaba ki rung shapoh Jingpynkyntang Ïingjaiñ ne ki leit sha jan kata ka duwan , kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: When they went into the tent of the congregation , and when they came near unto the altar , they washed  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
And Joshua at that time turned back , and took Hazor , and smote the king thereof with the sword : for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u wan phai , u la kurup ïa ka Hasor bad pynïap ïa u syiem jong ka . ( Ha kata ka por , ka Hasor ka long kaba khlaiñ tam na kito ki hima baroh . )
kane Mynno ka la jia ? Hato ka la long ha shuwa ne hadien la ba otsher ïa u Abraham ? Ka la long ha shuwa ym hadien .
translation.en: How was it then reckoned ? when he was in circumcision , or in uncircumcision ? Not in circumcision , but in uncircumcision .
The way of man is froward and strange : but as for the pure , his work is right .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pop ki ïaid ka lynti kyllaiñ ; hynrei kiba lui lui ki ïaid ha kaba beit .

translation.en: A wrathful man stirreth up strife : but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife .
translation.kha: Kaba shit khlieh ka thaw ki jingïania , hynrei ka jingïaishah ka wallam ïa ka jingsuk .

translation.en: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried , and she bound him with them .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki syiem Philistia ki wanrah ha ka Delilah hynñiew tylli ki  saisiej thymmai ki bym pat ïap saw , bad ka khum ïa u Samson da ki .

translation.en: Ask thy young men , and they will shew thee . Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes : for we come in a good day : give , I pray thee , whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants , and to thy son David .
translation.kha: Shu kylli ïa ki , bad kin ïathuh ïa phi . Ngi la wan ha ka sngi jingkhawai , bad u Dabid u kyrpad ïa phi ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ngi . Sngewbha ai ïa kaba phi lah ha ngi ki shakri jong phi bad ha u paralok ba-ieit jong phi , u Dabid .

translation.en: And the third row a ligure , an agate , and an amethyst .
translation.kha: u Turkwois , u Agate , bad u Amethyst ha ka kyrdon kaba lai ;

translation.en: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka khubor shaphang u Jisu ka la phriang stet kylleng ka probins jong ka Galilaïa .
Ngam shym ong ïa kane ïa ka ban pynrem ïa phi ; naba Nongsharai nga la ong mynshuwa , phi long kiba kun ieit syang ba ngi pynpaw lang borabor , lada ngi im lane ngi ïap .
translation.en: I speak not this to condemn you : for I have said before , that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you .
And the  Lord  hath done to him , as he spake by me : for the  Lord  hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand , and given it to thy neighbour , even to David :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la leh ha me kumba u la kren da nga : u la knieh kynthet ïa ka hima na me , bad pynban u la ai ïa ka ha u Dabid .

translation.en: But they that wait upon the  Lord  shall renew their strength  ; they shall mount up with wings as eagles  ; they shall run , and not be weary  ; and they shall walk , and not faint .
translation.kha: Hynrei kito kiba shaniah ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap kin shem ba la pynthymmai ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki . Kin ïeng joit ha ki thapniang kum ki pukni ; kin mareh bad kin ym sngewlwait ; kin ïaid bad kin ym sngewthait .
Ki rangbah sorkar ki kum ki suri kiba patar lyngkhot ïa ki mrad ba la . Ki pynïap ba kin ïoh riewspah .
translation.en: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey , to shed blood , and to destroy souls , to get dishonest gain .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un wait Paul kajuh ka kupar — ki lyngdoh bad ki briew , ki mraw bad ki kynrad , sylla thied bad kiba die lymphuin kiba ai kylliang bad kiba ïabam kylliang , kiba riewspah bad kiba duk Sawar
translation.en: And it shall be , as with the people , so with the priest  ; as with the servant , so with his master  ; as with the maid , so with her mistress  ; as with the buyer , so with the seller  ; as with the lender , so with the borrower  ; as with the taker of usury , so with the giver of usury to him .
And he straitly charged him , and forthwith sent him away  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong skhem ïa u bad phah noh ïa kumta hi ,

translation.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation : for when he is tried , he shall receive the crown of life , which the Lord hath promised to them that love him .
translation.kha: Suk uta u briew uba ïaineh hapdeng ki jingtynjuh , namar ynda u jop haba u la ïaid lyngba ïa kaba kum kata ka jingtynjuh , un ïohpdiang kum ka bainong jong u ïa ka jingim kaba U Blei u la kular ha kito kiba ieit ïa u .
bad ki Israel khyllem lah leh ei ei nongap ïa ki kynthet
translation.en: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites  ; and the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: biah ka bynta kane ka jingshakri kaba phi Sheerah ym ba ka pyndap tang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki briew jong U Blei byrsha hynrei ka pynshlei ruh ïa ka jingainguh ïa lip Blei .
translation.en: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints , but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God ;
Whosoever putteth away his wife , and marrieth another , committeth adultery : and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery .
translation.kha: Uno uno u briew uba pyllait noh ïa ka tnga jong u bad shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew u klim ; bad u briew uba shongkurim ïa ka briew kaba la shah pyllait tnga u klim .

translation.en: We certify the king that , if this city be builded again , and the walls thereof set up , by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river .
translation.kha: Ngi sngewskhem , namarkata , ba lada ïa kane ka nongbah la tei pat bad ba ïa ki kynroh la pyndep , ko Syiem , phin ym lah shuh ban pynïaid ïa ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi .
U Aaron u hynñiewspah Ïuodia ki ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la kren ïatyllep u Moses , bad nangta u Moses u leh 17 ki kambah baroh Gershon khmat Kishion paidbah .
translation.en: And Aaron spake all the words which the  Lord  had spoken unto Moses , and did the signs in the sight of the people .
If the scourge slay suddenly , he will laugh at the trial of the innocent .
translation.kha: Haba uba lui lui u ïap kynsan , U Blei u rkhie .

translation.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; one young bullock , one ram , and seven lambs of the first year without blemish :
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
Me la pynlong ïa ngi ka kynton jakhlia jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people .

translation.kha: Wat leit sha Beersheba ban mane Blei . Wat pyrshang ban wad ïa nga ha Bethel — ka Bethel kan ym long ei ei . Wat leit sha Gilgal — ïa briew ki jong ka la tim ba kin shah ringmraw .
translation.en: But seek not Beth–el , nor enter into Gilgal , and pass not to Beer–sheba : for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity , and Beth–el shall come to nought .

translation.kha: Namar ba phi la sngewkmen , ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka ri shyiap ba na mihngi ban jop ïa phi . Kin sher ïa ki dara jong ki ha ka ri jong phi bad shongduh hangta Kin . bam u soh ïa bad kin dih ïa dud ka kiba dei ki jong phi .
translation.en: Behold , therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession , and they shall set their palaces in thee , and make their dwellings in thee : they shall eat thy fruit , and they shall drink thy milk .

translation.kha: Baroh ïohi ïa nga shaphang jong nga ki don ban ong ïa kiei kiei kiba bha nga la leh .
translation.en: When the ear heard me , then it blessed me  ; and when the eye saw me , it gave witness to me :

translation.kha: U u ong , Ko syiem bad ma phi u paid Judah Jerusalem , U Trai u ong ba dei ban rit ne ban ïa kane ka ba paid . Ka thma ka shong ha U , ym phi .
translation.en: And he said , Hearken ye , all Judah , and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem , and thou king Jehoshaphat , Thus saith the  Lord  unto you , Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude  ; for the battle is not yours , but God s .

And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year , and one young bullock , and two rams : they shall be for a burnt offering unto the  Lord  , with their meat offering , and their drink offerings , even an offering made by fire , of sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ryngkat bad kita ki kpu , baroh phin ïa-ai hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot kiba shisnem , uwei u masi lyngraw , bad ar tylli ki  langsohmoh ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Yn ai ïa ki kum ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  ryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingainguh dih . Ka jingiwbih jong kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
Na sngewrit u ba lalot khlem hab ban buh ha ka jing bymlalot , bad kaei kaba dei ban ïap ka dei ban kylla sha kaei ka bym dei ban ïap shuh .
translation.en: For this corruptible must put on incorruption , and this mortal must put on immortality .
But neither so did their witness agree together .
translation.kha: Wat la kumta ruh , kim shym la lah ban pynlong ïa ki jingïathuh jong ki kiba ïahap .

translation.en: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity , they allure through the lusts of the flesh , through much wantonness , those that were clean escaped from them who live in error .
translation.kha: Ki kren ïa ki jingkren sarong bad ba-mutlop , bad ki riam pah da ki jingkwah brai jong ka doh ïa ki briew kiba dang shu sdang ban phet ïap napdeng ki briew kiba im ha ka jingleh bymdei .
sar uno uno uba ïa ka Nalor jong u ym shym Soitan thoh ha khlei imat kiba Jehosadak la Shibboleth sha ka pung ka ding .
translation.en: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire .

translation.kha: U Trai banylla ong , To rwai da pyrda jingkmen na Pethor “mon ki Israel 7 kiba khraw tam na ki jaitbynriew ut pynkhyllew rwai ïa ka jingduk jong ka shuwa jong Barnea , ‘ U Trai u la pynim ïa bamatlah ki briew ïeng u la pyllait im ïa baroh kiba dang sah .’
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Sing with gladness for Jacob , and shout among the chief of the nations : publish ye , praise ye , and say , O  Lord  , save thy people , the remnant of Israel .
For the arrows of the Almighty are within me , the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit : the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me .
translation.kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la siat da ki khnam ïa nga , bad ka bih jong ki ka par baroh kawei ka met jong nga . Da ki jingshyrkhei U Blei u la pynap riang pyrshah ïa nga .
Ki phai noh na ka lynti ban bah leit sahmiet hangta . rung Ki shapoh ka nongbah bad ki shong ha madan shnong , hynrei ym don ba khot basa ïa ki ha kata ka miet .
translation.en: And they turned aside thither , to go in and to lodge in Gibeah : and when he went in , he sat him down in a street of the city : for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga pynshitom ïa ki Edom , pynduh noh ïa ki rangbah basian buit jong ki bad pynjah noh ïa ka jong ki baroh .
translation.en: Shall I not in that day , saith the  Lord  , even destroy the wise men out of Edom , and understanding out of the mount of Esau ?
Then the soldiers , as it was commanded them , took Paul , and brought him by night to Antipatris .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la leh ïa kaba la hukum ïa ki . Ki la shim ïa u Paul bad ki la ïalam ïa u ha kata ka miet haduh Antipatris .
U Trai la nga , Ngan jngoh sha tbian na bneng ka umjer ka jar jar ki miet basyiad ha ka aïom ot kumba ka sngi ka phyrnai itynnat ha ka jingshit ka .
translation.en: For so the  Lord  said unto me , I will take my rest , and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs , and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest .
The floods have lifted up , O  Lord  , the floods have lifted up their voice  ; the floods lift up their waves .
translation.kha: Ki jingjylliew ka duriaw ki sawa jam , A  Trai  ; ki sawa jam bad ki kyrhuh .

Pynban ïamane kin smai da nga kum U Blei uba Jeroboam uba Beri wallam ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri bashatei bad na baroh kiwei pat ki ri ha kaba nga la pynsakma ïa jingïailong . jingïathuhlypa wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri ka jong ki hi , sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen Kwah jingshongkurim . Ma nga , U Trai , nga seraph kren .
translation.en: But , The  Lord  liveth , that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north , and from all the lands whither he had driven them : and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers .
I have put off my coat  ; how shall I put it on ? I have washed my feet  ; how shall I defile them ?
translation.kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong phi ki long kum u ribon basawbthuh ; katno ki long kiba i-ieit haba phi kren . Ki ngab jong phi ki thaba napoh ka jaiñtapkhmat .

translation.en: Wherefore have we fasted , say they , and thou seest not ? wherefore have we afflicted our soul , and thou takest no knowledge ? Behold , in the day of your fast ye find pleasure , and exact all your labours .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki kylli ,  Balei ngin shahjingit , lada U  Trai  um patiaw ? Balei ngi dei ban leit khlem bam lada um shahshkor ?  U  Trai  u ong ïa ki ,  Ka jingshisha ka long ba ha kajuh ka por ba phi shahjingit , phi ïabeh ïa la ki jong ki jingmyntoi bad banbeiñ ïa la ki nongtrei .

translation.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation : and thy gentleness hath made me great .
translation.kha: A Trai , Me ïada bad me pynim ïa nga , ka jingïarap jong me ka la pynkhraw ïa nga .

translation.en: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful , he said ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ba u la sngewsih bad u la ong ,  Katno ka long kaba eh ïa ki briew bariewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei !

Sa shisien sylla Jisu u la leit noh bad u ïa-bishni duwai , Ko ïaktah jong nga , lada ïa kane ka Halor nongpynkhiah jingshah shitom ym Elam ban shim noh lymda nga dih ïa Myntan , ïa kane Abraham jong me yn Mareh .
translation.en: He went away again the second time , and prayed , saying ,  O my Father , if this cup may not pass away from me , except I drink it , thy will be done .
A minister of the sanctuary , and of the true tabernacle , which the Lord pitched , and not man .
translation.kha: U shakri kum U Rangbah Lyngdoh ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam , kata ka long , ha ka ïingjaiñ kaba shisha ïa kaba U Trai u la pynïeng , ym da u briew .

translation.en: Because the sons of Jehonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father , which he commanded them  ; but this people hath not hearkened unto me :
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew u Jonadab ki la kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba u kpa tymmen jong ki u la ai ha ki , hynrei ma phi phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: And when the men of Israel turned again , the men of Benjamin were amazed : for they saw that evil was come upon them .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki phai kylla , bad ki Benjamin ki la kulmar hi thlim namar ki sngewthuh ba kin sa shah pynjot .
Ym don shuh ka Hima bakmen ha ka por sur Mihngi waiñ ; ym don basngewtynnat tasngeng ïa ka jingmad jong pyntriem .
translation.en: They shall not drink wine with a song  ; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it .
Wherefore it came to pass , when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived , that she bare a son , and called his name Samuel , saying , Because I have asked him of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Hannah ka punkhun bad ka kha khun shynrang . Ka la pynkyrteng ïa u , u Samuel , naba ka ong ,  Nga la pan ïa u na U  Trai .

translation.en: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father , saying , Thou hast clothing , be thou our ruler , and let this ruin be under thy hand :
translation.kha: Ka por kan poi ha kaba ki dkhot jong ka kur kin jied uwei napdeng jong ki bad ong ha u ,  Ma phi la kumno kumno phi don ei ei ban phong , kumta to long u nongïalam jong ngi ha kane ka por ka jingjynjar .

U Blei u pyndonkam ïa kane ka nongmareh dur ïa u Joram Ym wanrah ka jingkyllon noh jong u Ahasaïah . Katba u Ahasaïah u pynurlong don Hebru , ma u bad thala Joram ki la shah kynroi ha u briew liewlong kyrteng phyllung Jehu Hangno u khun jong u Nimshi , uba U Trai brup la jied ban pynjot ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Ahab .
translation.en: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram : for when he was come , he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi , whom the  Lord  had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab .

translation.kha: U Miniamin u sah ha ka jingkyllon Pa’ ri lum kaba ha ka ri khlaw hajan ka Siph jingsleh U Saul Memukan ïai pyrshang ban shem ïa u , klun U Blei daym shym la aiti Heh mat Dabid ha Hissop .
translation.en: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds , and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph . And Saul sought him every day , but God delivered him not into his hand .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bha ïa ka , bad un buh kyrpang ïa kata kaba la bit bthuh haduh sngi hynñiew .
translation.en: And the priest shall look upon the plague , and shut up it that hath the plague seven days :

translation.kha: Kin ïohsngew ïa ki jingsawa ki shipawa jong ki kulai , ki jingriew jong ki kali kpu , Jaasanaïah shatei-lam-mihngi jong ki shaka . Ki kpa kin phai shakri na ka bynta khmih’ ki khun ; ki kti jong ki Heth noh kyrwep .
translation.en: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses , at the rushing of his chariots , and at the rumbling of his wheels , the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands  ;

translation.kha: Nga ong ïa ki briew bad ïa ki synshar rangbah bad ki nongïalam , Ka jingtreikam ka la ïar bad la pynïakhlad ïa ngi da ka jingjngai uwei na uwei pat ha kynroh ka .
translation.en: And I said unto the nobles , and to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , The work is great and large , and we are separated upon the wall , one far from another .
Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave , though they cry in his destruction .
translation.kha: Balei ba me tur ïaleh ïa u briew ba la jot , uta u bym lah ban leh ei ei shuh hynrei uba kyrpad ïa ka jingisynei ?
ha ba U Trai u ong , ‘ Men ym ïohkhiah na ki jingmynsaw jong ; men ïap U u la leh kumba la hukum U
translation.en: Now therefore thus saith the  Lord  , Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die . And Elijah departed .

translation.kha: U Ktien u la long u tyllong jong ka jingim ; bad kane ka jingim ka wanrah la ka jingshai ïa u bynriew .
translation.en: In him was life  ; and the life was the light of men .
A people great and tall , the children of the Anakims , whom thou knowest , and of whom thou hast heard say , Who can stand before the children of Anak !
translation.kha: Ki briew pat ki long kiba radbah bad kiba jrong rynïeng ; ki dei ki ramhah , bad phi la bna ba don kiba ong ba ym don mano mano uba lah ban ïeng ïaleh ïa ki .
u jingtyllun Hadrakh ba yn tied ïa nga bad ban pyndait Seboiim hajan ka Khyrdop jingïadie ton hapoh ka Templ .
translation.en: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet , and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin , which was by the house of the  Lord .
Now therefore why tempt ye God , to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples , which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear ?
translation.kha: Kumta te , balei mynta phi kwah ban tynjuh ïa U Blei da kaba buh ka jingkit halor ki met jong ki parabangeit ïa kaba ym don ki kpa tymmen jong ngi lymne ma ngi hi kiba lah ban kit ?

translation.en: Hast thou not known ? hast thou not heard , that the everlasting God , the  Lord  , the Creator of the ends of the earth , fainteth not , neither is weary ? there is no searching of his understanding .
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ? Phim pat ïohsngew ? U  Trai  u long U Blei bymjukut ; u thaw ïa ka pyrthei baroh . Um ju sngewthait ne sngewlwait . Ym don uba sngewthuh ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong u
ka jingieit kam kmen ha ka jingbymman , hynrei ka kmen ha ka . jingshisha
translation.en: Rejoiceth not in iniquity , but rejoiceth in the truth ;
God forbid : for then how shall God judge the world ?
translation.kha: Ym kumta keiñ! Lada U Blei um long uba hok , kumno un bishar ïa ka pyrthei ?

translation.en: Lord , now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace , according to thy word :
translation.kha: Mynta , A Trai , me la bat ïa la ka kular , bad men shah ïa u shakri jong me ban leit noh ha kaba suk .

pynbabe sngewdap sha u Trai , bad “Wat ba bynda ka jingduwai kan long ka jingainguh sha u : To jingsat ïa ki pop jong ngi baroh bad pdiang ïa rnong jingduwai jong krenbeiñ , bad jingïambriew ïaroh ïa me kumba ngi la kular .
translation.en: Take with you words , and turn to the  Lord  : say unto him , Take away all iniquity , and receive us graciously : so will we render the calves of our lips .

translation.kha: Kumta ha ka sngi nyngkong kaba jong u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem kaba ar hadien ba ki la mihnoh na Ijipt , la pynïeng ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ Jingdon ka Ryngkat U Trai .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year , on the first day of the month , that the tabernacle was reared up .

That confirmeth the word of his servant , and performeth the counsel of his messengers  ; that saith to Jerusalem , Thou shalt be inhabited  ; and to the cities of Judah , Ye shall be built , and I will raise up the decayed places thereof :
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u shakri jong nga u pynlong ka jingïathuh lypa , haba nga phah ïa u nonglamktien ban pynpaw ïa ki jingthmu jong nga , Nga pynlong ïa kito ki jingthmu bad ki jingïathuh lypa ban jia shisha . Nga ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ba ki briew kin shong biang hangta , bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah yn sa tei pat . Kito ki nongbah kin ïeng na ki jingjot .

Ka jingmut jingai jong nga ka ba long phin lumlang ïa ki Israel baroh na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat , ki ban bun kat u ka shyiap rud duriaw , bad ba ma phi da lade hi phin ïalam ïa ki ha ka thma .
translation.en: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , as the sand that is by the sea for multitude  ; and that thou go to battle in thine own person .

translation.kha: jingmih phi lum kin long kiba bun , bad kin na ka bynta ; la ruh , phin hap bret noh ïa kaba dang sah na ka kaba rim ban pyllait jaka ïa ka jinglum thymmai .
translation.en: And ye shall eat old store , and bring forth the old because of the new .

translation.kha: kata ka spaiñ kaba ïeng ha tduh jong ka duriaw bad kaba ïakhaïi pateng bad ki briew sngewthikna shong ha man ki rud duriaw Kadmiel To ong ha ka tan kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar Eliashib ong : Ko jingpyndap , pha sngewsarong ïa ka jingbhabriew bajanai jong pha .
translation.en: And say unto Tyre , O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea , which art a merchant of the people for many isles , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; O Tyre , thou hast said , I am of perfect beauty .
To Timothy , my dearly beloved son : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord .
translation.kha: Ha u Timothi , u khun ba-ieit jong nga : To ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi un ai ha me ïa ka jingaiei , ka jingisynei , bad ka jingsuk .

U Samuel u ong ha u Saul , Balei me la pynthut nga ïa ? Balei me pynlong ïa nga ban wan pat ? U Saul u jubab , Nga la poi ha ka khim khait ! Ki Philistia ïaleh ki thma ïa nga , bad U Blei u la iehnoh ïa nga . Um shym jubab shuh ïa nga , la da ki nongïathuhlypa , lane ki da jingphohsniew . Bad kumta nga la khot ïa phi ba phin ïathuh nga ïa aïu nga dei ban leh .
translation.en: And Samuel said to Saul , Why hast thou disquieted me , to bring me up ? And Saul answered , I am sore distressed  ; for the Philistines make war against me , and God is departed from me , and answereth me no more , neither by prophets , nor by dreams : therefore I have called thee , that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do .
