translation.kha: Wat shim kabu ïano lane ban lute ïa u Wat pynsah ïa bainong jong uno uno u briew uba phi khot bylla , wat tang shi miet ruh .
translation.en: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour , neither rob him : the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka jingshah shitom jingïasngewtynnat jong ki briew jong nga ha Ijipt . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingud jong ki , bad nga la wan hiar ban pyllaitluid mang ki . Ale mynta ; ngan phah pynïoh me punkhun Ijipt .’
translation.en: I have seen , I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt , and I have heard their groaning , and am come down to deliver them . And now come , I will send thee into Egypt .

translation.kha: bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin ai noh pat ïa kynroi kaba u la tuh na kiba duk .
translation.en: His children shall seek to please the poor , and his hands shall restore their goods .
And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields , and spears , and helmets , and habergeons , and bows , and slings to cast stones .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u pynbiang ïa ka kynhun shipai da ki stieh , ki sum , ki jingda khlieh , ki jingphong nar , ki ryntieh bad ki khnam , bad ki maw ban kawang .
khatkhyndai shuwa ban thaw ïa ka pyrthei , u jingshongshngain Henadad Khalkedon lah don lypa ; u la don bad U tasam , bad u long kumjuh kum U Blei .
translation.en: In the beginning was the Word , and the Word was with God , and the Word was God .
Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice , that he might instruct thee : and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire  ; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire .
translation.kha: U la ailad ïa phi ban ïohsngew ïa ka ktien jong u na bneng khnang ba u lah ban hikai ïa phi ; bad hangne ha pyrthei u la ailad ba phin ïohi ïa ka ding kaba kyntang jong u , bad u la kren ha phi na ka .

Kan ym long kumta! U Blei un long pynshaitbor shisha , wat la uwei jinglehbha pakor badonburom briew thliem long uba shukor kynriah Kumba Naphtali Jingthoh Bakhuid Arad ong , Ba yn lah ban pyn-i ïa phi Kore phi long kiba pajwa haba phi kren ; phi nonghiarpateng ban jop ïa ka jingïaleh haba la jlan ïa phi :10
translation.en: God forbid : yea , let God be true , but every man a liar ; as it is written , That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings , and mightest overcome when thou art judged .

translation.kha: Haba u Jakob u la tip ba don kew ha Ijipt , u ong ha la ki khun shynrang Balei , phim ïaleh ei ei ?
translation.en: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt , Jacob said unto his sons , Why do ye look one upon another ?
And the bow shall be in the cloud  ; and I will look upon it , that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth .
translation.kha: Haba u simpyllieng u paw ha ki lyoh , ngan khmih ïa u , bad ngan kynmaw ïa ka jutang baïaineh junom hapdeng jong nga bad ki jingthaw ba-im baroh ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: There are many devices in a man s heart  ; nevertheless the counsel of the  Lord  , that shall stand .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki lah ban thmu shibun kiei kiei , hynrei ïa ka mon U  Trai  yn hap ban pyndep .

Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa u Abraham ban kum jingkñia ïa u Isaak u khun jong u , U Blei u la tynjuh ïa u Abraham . U Abraham u la long ïa uba U la kular , la ruh u long la ai ïa la u khun kum ka .
translation.en: By faith Abraham , when he was tried , offered up Isaac : and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son ,

translation.kha: U Abraham u la slem ïaishah , bad kumta u la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .
translation.en: And so , after he had patiently endured , he obtained the promise .
And Jephthah said unto them , I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon  ; and when I called you , ye delivered me not out of their hands .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jephthah u ong ha ki ,  Ma nga bad ki briew jong nga ngi don ka jingïakajia kaba jur bad ki Ammon . Nga la khot ïa phi , hynrei phim shym la wan pyllait ïa nga na ki .
La ñiew ïa ngi kum ka synrum jong ka pyrthei ; ngi long ki briew kiba la shah kyntait beiñ kane haduh ka khyllipmat !
translation.en: Being defamed , we entreat : we are made as the filth of the world , and are the offscouring of all things unto this day .

translation.kha: U Blei u dang ai ïa nga ka jingpynhiar ,
translation.en: All the while my breath is in me , and the spirit of God is in my nostrils  ;

translation.kha: U Trai u ong La , ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ha Ramah , ka jingsawa jong ka jingïam kthang . Ka Rakhel ka ïam namar ki jong khun ka ; ki la ïap noh , bad kam treh ba yn pyntngen ka ïa .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; A voice was heard in Ramah , lamentation , and bitter weeping  ; Rachel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children , because they were not .

translation.kha: Lada la long kiba bieit shisha ban sngewmeng bad ban thmu sniew , sangeh bad pyrkhat !
translation.en: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself , or if thou hast thought evil , lay thine hand upon thy mouth .
And while they abode in Galilee , Jesus said unto them ,  The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men :
translation.kha: Haba ki synran baroh ki la ïawanlang ha Galilaïa , U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  U Khun U Briew u la jan ba un shah aiti ha ki briew ,

translation.en: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel–abib , that dwelt by the river of Chebar , and I sat where they sat , and remained there astonished among them seven days .
translation.kha: Kumta nga leit poi sha Tel Abib hajan ka wah Khebar , ha kaba shong kiba la shah ringmraw bad nga sah hangta hynñiew sngi bad ka jingsngew shaïong shaphang kaei kaba nga la ïohi bad ïohsngew .

translation.en: Render therefore to all their dues : tribute to whom tribute is due ; custom to whom custom ; fear to whom fear ; honour to whom honour .
translation.kha: To siew te , kaei kaba phi dei ban siew ïa ki ; to siew sha ki ïa ki khajna shimet bad kiba dei ïa ki jingdon jingem jong phi , bad to pyn-i ka jingburom bad to ai ka burom ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: Therefore many of them believed  ; also of honourable women which were Greeks , and of men , not a few .
translation.kha: Bun na ki , ki la ngeit , bad bun ki kynthei Grik kiba ha ka kyrdan ba-halor ha ka imlang ka sahlang bad bun ki rangbah Grik ruh ki la ngeit .
Ka jinglaitluid ka long kaei ngi — dei U Khrist u pyllait ïa ! Ïeng te kum briew kiba laitluid , bad wat ïa ban pat ki mraw .
translation.en: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free , and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage .

translation.kha: u kyrkhu ki ha ka u ong , Ki Israel kin sa shim ïa kyrteng jong haba ki kyrkhu kyrdoh ïano ïano . Kin ‘ To U Blei un pynlong ïa phi kum u Ephraim bad kum u Manasseh .’ Da kumta u la buh Ephraim ha shuwa u Manasseh .
translation.en: And he blessed them that day , saying , In thee shall Israel bless , saying , God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh : and he set Ephraim before Manasseh .

translation.kha: riam , ki pop jong shajrong ki la bat noh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba bha na phi .
translation.en: Your iniquities have turned away these things , and your sins have withholden good things from you .

And the Israelite woman s son blasphemed the name of the  Lord  , and cursed . And they brought him unto Moses : ( and his mother s name was Shelomith , the daughter of Dibri , of the tribe of Dan : )
translation.kha: Don uwei u briew uba u kpa jong u , u dei u nong Ijipt bad ka kmie jong u pat ka dei ka Israel kaba kyrteng ka Shelomith , ka khun u Dibri uba na ka jait Dan . Une u briew u ïakajia bad uwei u Israel hapoh ka jaka shong dara . Katba ki dang ïakajia kumta , une u briew u krenbeiñ ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  : kumta ki wan ïalam ïa u ha u Moses .

translation.en: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you , to inherit them for a possession  ; they shall be your bondmen for ever : but over your brethren the children of Israel , ye shall not rule one over another with rigour .
translation.kha: bad phi lah ban ai pateng ïa ki ha ki khun shynrang jong phi , ïa kiba ki dei ban shakri katba ki dang im . Hynrei phim lah ban lehbeiñ ïa kino kino na ki para Israel jong phi .
A Blei , to pynbna ba nga long uba lui lui , bad ïasaid da ïa nga na ki bymriewblei ; pyllait ïa nga ki na briew kiba bad shukor kiba sniew !
translation.en: Judge me , O God , and plead my cause against an ungodly nation : O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man .

translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud u Laban u la doh khublei ïa la ki ksiew khun bad ïa la ki khun kynthei , bad u la leit phai sha pat la ïing .
translation.en: And early in the morning Laban rose up , and kissed his sons and his daughters , and blessed them : and Laban departed , and returned unto his place .

translation.kha: Kiba sarong ki krenbeiñ borabor ïa nga , ngam hynrei shym phai noh na ka aiñ jong me .
translation.en: The proud have had me greatly in derision : yet have I not declined from thy law .
And they that had eaten were about four thousand : and he sent them away .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u la bam ha ban da kdang — la don kumba saw hajar ngut ki briew . Nangta ki synran ki la ïalum hynñiew tukri kiba la dap da ki lyngkhot lyngkhai ba la sah tam . U Jisu u la phah noh ïa ki briew

translation.en: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel , saying , Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you :
translation.kha: U Abner u leit sha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad u ong ha ki ,  La slem bah phi la kwah ïa u Dabid ban long u syiem jong phi .
Ym don pat uwei u nongïathuhlypa uba lah la ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba sngewtriem kum kiba u Moses u la leh ha khmat ki Israel baroh .
translation.en: And in all that mighty hand , and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel .
Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living , and kept close from the fowls of the air .
translation.kha: Ym don jingthaw ba-im ba lah ban ïohi ïa ka , ym don , wat ka sim kaba her .
Hormah u Rubi im ïa nga jingkynnoh ki nongshun jong nga . A Trai , me ai ha nga ka Mari halor ki dat jong nga bad me banyngkong ïa nga na ki riewthombor .
translation.en: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies : thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me : thou hast delivered me from the violent man .
Gradually they would have made the entire earth into a paradise .—Genesis 1 :28  ; 2 :8 , 15 .
translation.kha: Suki suki kin pynkylla ïa ka sha ka paradais .—Jenesis 1 :28 ; 2 :8 , 15 .
Ynda la kyntiew ïa nga na ka pyrthei , ngan khring ïa ki briew kynran sha nga .
translation.en: And I , if I be lifted up from the earth , will draw all men unto me .
I tell you , this man went down to his house justified rather than the other : for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased  ; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  u nonglum khajna , bad ym u Pharisi , uba don ha ka liang kaba dei bad U Blei haba u leit noh sha ïing . Naba ïa uno uno uba pynkhraw ïa lade yn pynrit , bad ïa uno uno uba pynrit yn pynkhraw .

translation.en: There is a man in thy kingdom , in whom is the spirit of the holy gods  ; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom , like the wisdom of the gods , was found in him  ; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father , the king , I say , thy father , made master of the magicians , astrologers , Chaldeans , and soothsayers  ;
translation.kha: U don u briew ha ka hima jong phi uba don ïa u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid hapoh jong u . Mynba u kpa jong phi u long syiem , une u briew u la pyn-i ka jingmut kaba bha , ka jingtip , bad ka jingstad kum ka jingstad jong ki blei . Bad u syiem Nebukhadnessar , u kpa jong phi , u la pynlong ïa u , u khlieh duh jong ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , bad ki nongpeit kti .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will save my people from the east country , and from the west country  ;
translation.kha: Ngan pyllait im ïa ki briew jong nga na ki ri sha kiba la shim noh ïa ki ,
Ka shong ha jingpalei jingkhang jong ka ïing jong ka lane ha ki jaka shong kiba jrong tam ha ka shnong ,
translation.en: For she sitteth at the door of her house , on a seat in the high places of the city ,
The gin shall take him by the heel , and the robber shall prevail against him .
translation.kha: ka jingriam ka ïoh ïa ki khongdong jat jong u bad bat khak ïa u .

translation.en: And he lighted the lamps before the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: bad hangta ha ka jingdon U  Trai  u thang ïa kita ki sharak , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
Shahshkor Israel ! ka sngi phin jam ïa ka Jordan bad ïa kata ka jong ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw bad kham donbor ban . shnong jong ki , ki long kiba heh , bad kynroh ki , ki kot haduh suiñbneng .
translation.en: Hear , O Israel : Thou art to pass over Jordan this day , to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself , cities great and fenced up to heaven ,
And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee , and from Decapolis , and from Jerusalem , and from Judaea , and from beyond Jordan .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah byllien na Galilaïa bad Dekapolis , na Jerusalem , Judia bad na ka ri ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Jordan ki la bud ïa u .

translation.en: They said therefore , What is this that he saith ,  A little while ?  we cannot tell what he saith .
translation.kha: Ka mut aïu kane ‘ sa tang shipor ?’ Ngim tip ba u kren shaphang kaei !
Bun kiwei ki ngeit la namar ka khubor jong u bad ki la ong ha kata ka briew ,
translation.en: And many more believed because of his own word  ;

translation.kha: pynjot U ïa ki jaka ha ka Templ , ha kiba ju shong ki nuti ka Templ . ( Ka dei hangta ba ki kynthei ki thain ju ïa ki barandi kiba ju pyndonkam ha kaba ïa mane ka Asherah . )
translation.en: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites , that were by the house of the  Lord  , where the women wove hangings for the grove .

translation.kha: sa shi bynta kin ap phira ïa ka , ïingsyiem bad ïa kiba sah yn buh ka ha Khyrdop Nongrim . Ki briew baroh kin ïalumlang ha ki phyllaw ka Templ .
translation.en: And a third part shall be at the king s house  ; and a third part at the gate of the foundation : and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ngi ïa u ainguh ïa Trai bad U Kpa ngi ban tim ruh ïa la u parabriew , ïa uba la thaw ka dur U Blei .
translation.en: Therewith bless we God , even the Father  ; and therewith curse we men , which are made after the similitude of God .
Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself , O God of Israel , the Saviour .
translation.kha: U Blei ki Israel , uba pynim ïa la ki briew , u long U Blei uba buhrieh ïa lade .

translation.en: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children s children : and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha kin don ka spah ban ieh pateng ha ki ksiew jong ki , hynrei ka spah jong ki nongpop kan leit sha kiba hok .
Shuh shuh uno uno bam ïa ka doh jong kane ka jingainguh hadien ba u la ktah ïa kaei kaei ka , ka dei kaba na u briew ne u mrad , ïa u ruh yn ym ñiew shuh uwei ki briew U .
translation.en: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing , as the uncleanness of man , or any unclean beast , or any abominable unclean thing , and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings , which pertain unto the  Lord  , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .
And the Amorites , and the Canaanites , and the Girgashites , and the Jebusites .
translation.kha: ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Girgash , bad ki Jebus .

translation.en: And when they had seen it , they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child .
translation.kha: Haba ki nongaplangbrot ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba u angel u la ïathuh shaphang u khunlung .

translation.en: There shall no evil befall thee , neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling .
translation.kha: bad kumta ka jingpynjot kan ym shoh ïa me , ka jingleh jubor kan ym wan hajan ka ïing jong me .

translation.en: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way , and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred , and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by , and multiplied thy whoredoms .
translation.kha: Pha pynbyrsieh ïa la ka jingbhabriew ha ka ktieh , pha ai ïa lade ha uwei pa uwei uba wan najan , bad pha la kham long kum ka nuti man la ka sngi .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Let us go into the next towns , that I may preach there also : for therefore came I forth .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jisu u la jubab ,  Ngi dei ban leit sha kiwei nongrit ha kine ki thain . Nga dei ban ïalap ha ki ruh , namar dei na kata ka daw ba nga la wan .

Nangta u la Waw ïa uwei pat , ‘ Bad ma phi shisyndon sa katno phi dei ban pynphai ? Shihajar byrni u kew ,’ u mawkyrdon jubab pynïashong ‘ Kane Arphaksad ka long ka jingkheiñ jong phi ,’ u sordar u la ong ïa u ; ‘ Andriw thoh Parthia .’
translation.en: Then said he to another , And how much owest thou ? And he said , An hundred measures of wheat . And he said unto him , Take thy bill , and write fourscore .

translation.kha: Ha U Khrist bad da Peit jingngeit jong hati pynbhabriew peiphang ngi jingshan ka jingshlur ban leit sha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei da ka jingsngewskhem baroh .
translation.en: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him .

And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof , and shalt burn with fire the city , and all the spoil thereof every whit , for the  Lord  thy God : and it shall be an heap for ever  ; it shall not be built again .
translation.kha: Lumlang ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki briew baroh kiba shong hangta bad kynton ïa ki ha ka madan shnong . Nangta thang ïa kata ka shnong bad ïa kata ka spah ka phew baroh kum ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Ka dei ban sah junom ha ka jingjot bad ym dei ban tei pat .

Ki metïap ki la saphriang ha kylleng , kum ki kynton sboh halor ki lyngkha , u kum riewhadem ba la ot bad iehnoh da ki nongot , u riewhadem bym u don mano mano ba lum . Kane ka long kaba kaei U Trai u la bthah ïa nga ban ong .
translation.en: Speak , Thus saith the  Lord  , Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field , and as the handful after the harvestman , and none shall gather them .
I went mourning without the sun : I stood up , and I cried in the congregation .
translation.kha: Nga ïaid shane shatai ha ka jingdum , khlem ka jingshai ka sngi ; nga ïeng ha khmat ki briew bad nga kyrpad jingïarap .

translation.en: And I will appoint over them four kinds , saith the  Lord  : the sword to slay , and the dogs to tear , and the fowls of the heaven , and the beasts of the earth , to devour and destroy .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kut jingmut ba saw tylli kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kin jia ha ki : kin shah pynïap ha ka thma ; ïa ki met jong ki yn patan noh da ki ksew ; ki sim kin bam ïa ki , bad ki mradkhlaw kin bam ïa kaei kaba sah .
Hynrei ki la ïai pyrta jingsleh Shatei-lam-mihngi sur sngi! jam eh ba Shunem U liewlep rhah ban sahnarphna , bad ïingjah ka jingpyrta jong ba-bhabriew Migdalel kynting jop .
translation.en: And they were instant with loud voices , requiring that he might be crucified . And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed .

translation.kha: Bad ki paid Israel kin kohnguh ïa ki jong nga baroh , bad sumar ïa ka Hukum baroh kaba u Moses u shakri jong nga u ai ïa ki , te ym ban noh ïa ki ka ri kaba la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers  ; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them , according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses .
And the king said unto him , Where is he ? And Ziba said unto the king , Behold , he is in the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , in Lo–debar .
translation.kha: Ha-ei u don ?  u syiem u kylli .  Ha ïing u Makhir , u khun jong u Ammiel , ha Lodebar ,  u Siba u jubab .
Balei la khot ka ïa jaka mane jong ngi ka Ïing Hima ?
translation.en: Why are our places of worship called Kingdom Halls ?
But straightway Jesus spake unto them , saying ,  Be of good cheer  ; it is I  ; be not afraid .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren ha ki shisyndon .  To long shlur !  u la ong .  Dei ma nga . To wat sheptieng !

translation.en: Also every sickness , and every plague , which is not written in the book of this law , them will the  Lord  bring upon thee , until thou be destroyed .
translation.kha: Un phah sa ïa ki jait jingpang bad jingïapthem baroh ïa kiba ym shym la thoh ha kane ka kitab jong ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai U Blei , bad phin sa jot thiaw .
Te u rwai , Da ka shyieng tyngam kada , shihajar ngut nga pynïap ; Da ka shyieng tyngam kada , nga kynton ïa ki ha ki kynton .
translation.en: And Samson said , With the jawbone of an ass , heaps upon heaps , with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men .

translation.kha: ïa ki nongïalam shipai bad ki nongïalam paidbah jong thiaw , ïa ki nongmihkhmat sop jong ki ba-im Pynshitom baroh pynsawa pyndonkam longïng ka sngewbishni ban bat ïa kino kino ki jingjia .
translation.en: The captain of fifty , and the honourable man , and the counsellor , and the cunning artificer , and the eloquent orator .
When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good , he said unto Joseph , I also was in my dream , and , behold , I had three white baskets on my head :
translation.kha: Haba u nongshet kpu rangbah u la ïohi ba kata ka jingbatai ïa ka jingphohsniew jong u nongrah khuri ka long kaba ai jinghun , u ong ha u Joseph ,  Nga ruh nga la phohsniew ; nga la kit lai tylli ki shang kpu halor ka khlieh jong nga .
Nangta U Trai un long u syiem ka jong pyrthei baroh ; uwei pa uwei baroh un mane ïa u U kum Blei bad tip ïa u da kajuh ka kyrteng .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall be king over all the earth : in that day shall there be one  Lord  , and his name one .
Give us day by day our daily bread .
translation.kha: To ai ha ngi man ka sngi ïa ka jingbam kaba ngi donkam .

Hadien kata , haba u Dabid u leit la sha ïing ban khublei ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ka , Mikhal ka wan mih ban ïakynduh ïa u . U syiem ki Israel u la pynkhraw nam ïa lade ha kane ka sngi ! ka ong . U la pynlyngkhuit ïa lade u kum bieit ha khmat shakri ki kynthei jong ki rangbah synshar jong u .
translation.en: Then David returned to bless his household . And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David , and said , How glorious was the king of Israel to day , who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants , as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself !
Wherefore , if God so clothe the grass of the field , which to day is , and to morrow is cast into the oven , shall he not much more clothe you , O ye of little faith ?
translation.kha: U long U Blei uba pynkup ïa u phlang khlaw — u phlang uba don hangne mynta bad u bym don shuh lashai , uba la thang duh ha ka lawar ding . Hato un ym da la kham leh thikna ban pynkup jaiñ ïa phi ? Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !

translation.en: Hearken to me , ye that follow after righteousness , ye that seek the  Lord  : look unto the rock whence ye are hewn , and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ;  To shahshkor ïa nga , phi kiba kwah ban ïoh jingim , phi kiba wan sha nga ban ïoh jingïarap . Puson halor u mawsiang na uba phi la wan , ka par maw na kaba la tih ïa phi .
Ki law lyngkhuit ïa ka ki , kem ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei jong ka , bad nangta ki pynïap ïa ka da ka waitlam . Ki kynthei ki kylleng ïathuh lorni shaphang ka kupar ka jong .
translation.en: These discovered her nakedness : they took her sons and her daughters , and slew her with the sword : and she became famous among women  ; for they had executed judgment upon her .
And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls .
translation.kha: Ha ki hynñiew snem kiba pahuh , ka khyndew ka pynmih shikatdei eh ki jingthung , ïa kiba u Joseph u lum bad kynshew ha ki nongbah .
Ki khun ki jong , ki mareh bad ki ïalehkai kum ki khunlangbrot
translation.en: They send forth their little ones like a flock , and their children dance .

translation.kha: Ki la khang ïa ka lynti phet jong bad nga pyrshang ban pynjot ïa nga ; bad ym don mano mano ban pynsangeh ïa ki .
translation.en: They mar my path , they set forward my calamity , they have no helper .
And it shall come to pass in that day , that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision , when he hath prophesied  ; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive :
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don nongïathuhlypa u ban sngewsarong ïa ki jingïohipaw jong u lane leh kum u nongïathuhlypa lane kup ïa ka jaiñkup bakhain jong u nongïathuhlypa khnang ban shukor ïa ki briew .

translation.en: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth ; but if the husband be dead , she is loosed from the law of her husband .
translation.kha: Ka kynthei ba la shongkurim , kum ka nuksa , ka shah teh da ka hukum ha la u tnga katba u dang im ; hynrei haba u la ïap , te ka la laitluid na ka hukum kaba teh ïa ka bad u .

Lada phi pynmong la ïa u parabangeit namar kaei kaba phi bam , phim te leh shuh na ka jingieit . To wat ai ba ka jingbam kaba phi bam kan pynsniew ïa u briew uba ïa U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta jong u!
translation.en: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat , now walkest thou not charitably . Destroy not him with thy meat , for whom Christ died .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïa ki synran u , Balei ba phi sheptieng ? Hato phim pat don jingngeit satia ?
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Why are ye so fearful ? how is it that ye have no faith ?
Neither was the man created for the woman ; but the woman for the man .
translation.kha: Lymne ym shym la thaw ïa u briew na ka bynta ka briew , hynrei ïa ka briew na ka bynta u briew .
Ngan pynskhem triang u kum ïa u bad un long ka tynrai jong ka jingpyndonburom ïa ka longïing jong
translation.en: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place  ; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father s house .

translation.kha: Hynrei u nongsumar u la jubab , Iehnoh shuwa , ko , sa ; ngan tih sawdong jong u bad ai sboh katto katne .
translation.en: And he answering said unto him , Lord , let it alone this year also , till I shall dig about it , and dung it :
So shall they be life unto thy soul , and grace to thy neck .
translation.kha: Kin ai ha phi ïa ka jingim — ka jingim kaba sngewtynnat bad kaba kmen .

Ma phi kiba hiarpateng na u kynriang , u shakri met! jingbamsap Blei , kiba hiarpateng na u Israel , ïa eh Jerah Blei u la jied bapra kynmaw ïa ki kambah kiba U Blei Ussaïah la leh Jer Menahem jingbishar kiba u la ai .
translation.en: O ye seed of Israel his servant , ye children of Jacob , his chosen ones .

translation.kha: shem ynda phin leit sha ka kamra ba shadien rieh , u Mikaïah u jubab .
translation.en: And Micaiah said , Behold , thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself .

But he went out , and began to publish it much , and to blaze abroad the matter , insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city , but was without in desert places : and they came to him from every quarter .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta u briew u la leit bad u la sdang ban pynphriang ïa ka khubor kylleng . Ha ka jingshisha , u la ïathuh ha baroh haduh ba U Jisu um lah shuh ban rung shapoh shnong ha kaba paw paidbah . Hynrei , U la shong noh ha ki jaka kynjah , bad ki briew ki la ïawan sha u na kylleng .

translation.en: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold  ; for it is their perpetual possession .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki jaka phlang kiba don sawdong ki shnong jong kito kiba na ka jait Lebi , ym dei ban die ïa ki , namar ki long ka hok kynti jong ki shi junom .

translation.en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren , they hated him , and could not speak peaceably unto him .
translation.kha: Haba ki hynmen shynrang jong u ki la ïohi ba u kpa jong ki u kham ieit ïa u Joseph ban ïa ki baroh , ki la isih shibun eh ïa u kat haduh ba kim kren bha kren miat shuh ïa u .

translation.en: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow , as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him : and we , or ever he come near , are ready to kill him .
translation.kha: Mynta te , ma phi bad ka Dorbar to phah ktien sha u rangbah ai hukum ka kynhun shipai Rom ban wallam ïa u Paul sha phi , da kaba leh mynleh ba phi kwah ban ïoh ka jingtip kaba thikna shaphang jong u . Hynrei ngin long kiba la khreh ban pynïap ïa u ha shuwa ba un poi hangne .

Kumta ki la ai dak ïa ki paralok jong ki kiba Pynpait kawei pat ka rkhiebeiñ kynroi syndah bad ïarap ïa ki Esra Ki la wan bad pyndap Pynkyrteng ïa pynbatai lieng baroh ar tylli da ki .—Markos pynithuh ba ki lieng ki la jan Mem .
translation.en: And they beckoned unto their partners , which were in the other ship , that they should come and help them . And they came , and filled both the ships , so that they began to sink .
He answered and said , Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not : one thing I know , that , whereas I was blind , now I see .
translation.kha: Ngam tip la u dei u nongpop ne um dei ,  uta u briew u la phai ktien .  Tang ïa kane kawei nga tip : Nga la long uba matlah , bad mynta nga la imat .

translation.en: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household , and twenty measures of pure oil : thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year .
translation.kha: bad u Solomon u la pynbiang ïa u Hiram da ar hajar ton u kew bad saw lakh litar ka umphniang Olib man ka snem ban bsa ïa ki rangbah jong u .
Da phi tip ba ki rangbah kiba trei ha ka ki ïoh na ka bad kito kiba kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha ka duwan ki ïoh ïa ka bynta na ki jingkñia ?
translation.en: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple ? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar ?

translation.kha: Ethbaal tupia jong ki u ong ha ki Korinth Phi kwah ba ngan duh ïashukor ïa la ki jong ki khun ? U Joseph um don shuh Sudan u Simeon ruh bashongkhia don , apple mynta sngewsarong phi kwah ban shim noh sa ïa halor Benjamin . Dei ma nga Hukum uba shah jynjar !
translation.en: And Jacob their father said unto them , Me have ye bereaved of my children : Joseph is not , and Simeon is not , and ye will take Benjamin away : all these things are against me .

translation.kha: jingieit u theisotti u la ong ha u , Wat sheptieng , ko Sekharaïah rymbai U Blei nongtih la shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong me , suiñ! ka Elisabeth ka tnga jingtim me kan kha u khun ïa me . Men kyrteng ïa u pynskhem u bymïap .
translation.en: But the angel said unto him , Fear not , Zacharias : for thy prayer is heard  ; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son , and thou shalt call his name John .

translation.kha: Bad u Kain u U Trai , Kane jingpynshitom ka long palat kaba nga ban shah .
translation.en: And Cain said unto the  Lord  , My punishment is greater than I can bear .

translation.kha: sngaid Ïing leh pop , Rephidim la long kiba sniew , ngi la leh bakla . Ngi la kyntait ïa kaei kaba me pud hukum ïa ngi ban leh bad Jebus la phai noh na Tirsah kaba me la pyn-i ha roi ba ka long kaba Balaam .
translation.en: We have sinned , and have committed iniquity , and have done wickedly , and have rebelled , even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments :

translation.kha: Kito kiba sha jngai kin bah bad ïohpang ïap ; noh kito kiba hajan kin ïap ha ka thma ; kito kiba lait im kin ïapthngan . Kin sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong nga kaba nga la pynmih lut .
translation.en: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence  ; and he that is near shall fall by the sword  ; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine : thus will I accomplish my fury upon them .

translation.kha: Hato ka turoi thma ka bat sawa ha ka nongbah khlem da pynlong ïa ki briew ban sheptieng ? Hato ka jingjynjar ka ju ngat ha ka pyniasngew lymda U “ki u phah ïa ka ?
translation.en: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city , and the people not be afraid ? shall there be evil in a city , and the  Lord  hath not done it ?

translation.kha: ïashongkha shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Trai bad Shatei-lam-mihngi la leit sha nongpdem jngai shaduh ka nongbah Tahpanhes .
translation.en: So they came into the land of Egypt : for they obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  : thus came they even to Tahpanhes .
And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father , and said , My father : and he said , Here am I , my son . And he said , Behold the fire and the wood : but where is the lamb for a burnt offering ?
translation.kha: u Isaak u ong ,  Ko pa !  U jubab ,  Oi , khun ?  U Isaak u kylli ,  Nga ïohi ïa ki rnga barhem bad ïa ki dieng , hynrei hangno pat u khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka jingkñia ?

translation.en: And Sarah my master s wife bare a son to my master when she was old : and unto him hath he given all that he hath .
translation.kha: Ka Sarah , ka tnga u kynrad jong nga , ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u haba ka la tymmen , bad u kynrad jong nga u la ai lut ha u kat ïa kaba u don .
La kha ïa nga shuwa ki duriaw-bah , ki mynba umpohliew kim pat don .
translation.en: When there were no depths , I was brought forth  ; when there were no fountains abounding with water .

translation.kha: ‘ Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie , kumba nga , U U Trai Blei jong phi , nga hukum ïa phi , khnang ba phin manbha bad im slem ha kata ri ka ba nga ha ai phi .
translation.en: Honour thy father and thy mother , as the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee  ; that thy days may be prolonged , and that it may go well with thee , in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine : turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ha nga ,  Ïa ka Israel yn sloit pynkhuid kum ka bri sohwaiñ na kaba la kheit ïa uwei pa uwei u sohwaiñ . Kumta pha dei ban pyllait im ïano ïano katba pha lah katba dang don ka por .

translation.en: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee  ; and I will give thee riches , and wealth , and honour , such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee , neither shall there any after thee have the like .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa kata ka jingstad bad ka jingtip . Nalor kata , ngan ai ruh ha me bun ka spah , ka jingkynshew , bad ka nam ban ïa uno uno u syiem uba la ju ïoh mynshuwa lane un ïoh biang pat .
Baroh dkhot ki jong ka ïing ki lah ban pule lang mar khyndiat , nangta baroh ki lah ban ïasam ïa kaei kaba ki sngewthuh .
translation.en: A portion of the reading could be assigned to each family member , and then all can discuss what was learned from the Scriptures .
And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward .

Atroth Shophan , Jaser , Jingdon ,
translation.en: And Atroth Shophan , and Jaazer , and Jogbehah ,

translation.kha: Kaei phi ai jingmut ïa nga ban leh ? u kylli . Kaei ba ngan ha ong ki briew kiba ong ïa ba nga ngan pynsting ïa ki jingkit jong ki ?
translation.en: And he said unto them , What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people , which have spoken to me , saying , Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us ?

translation.kha: Ngi thoh sha phi shaphang U Ktien ka jingim , uba la don naduh kaba mynnyngkong eh . Ngi la ïa u , bad ngi la ïa u la ki khmat ho-oid , la ïohi ïa u , bad ki kti jong ngi ki la ïohktah ïa u .
translation.en: That which was from the beginning , which we have heard , which we have seen with our eyes , which we have looked upon , and our hands have handled , of the Word of life  ;

translation.kha: Suit ïa ksiar kita ki jingker , bad ha pyndait ki ïa ki kyrwoh ksiar ban bat ïa ki diengkhap . Suit ksiar ruh ïa kita ki diengkhap .
translation.en: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold , and make their rings of gold for places for the bars : and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold .

translation.kha: Me lah ban pyrkhat ba kin pynlong ïa me uba khlaiñ ha ka thma , hynrei u dei U Blei uba don Joïada bor ban ai ka jingjop ne ka jingshahjop , Teh un shah ïa ki nongshun jong me ban jop ïa Arah .
translation.en: But if thou wilt go , do it , be strong for the battle : God shall make thee fall before the enemy : for God hath power to help , and to cast down .
And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years , until Samuel the prophet .
translation.kha: Kane baroh ka la shim por kumba sawspah sanphew snem .  Hadien kane u la ai ha ki ïa ki nongbishar haduh ka por jong u Samuel u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Hear ye the words of this covenant , and speak unto the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem  ;
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki kyndon jong ka jutang . Ïathuh ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem
To pyllait ïa nga na ki jingibeiñ kiba nga sheptieng A katno kiba phylla long ki jingbishar jong me !
translation.en: Turn away my reproach which I fear : for thy judgments are good .

translation.kha: Khmih sha nga ! nga la dap phraphew san snem ka rta bad nga dang shait dang khlaiñ mynta kumba nga la long mynba u u Moses la phah ïa nga . Nga dang shait dang khlaiñ bha ban ïaleh leit ne thma na ka bynta kano kano .
translation.en: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me : as my strength was then , even so is my strength now , for war , both to go out , and to come in .
And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them  ; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband .
translation.kha: u Mahlon bad u Khilion ruh ki la ïap , bad ka Naomi ka la shah iehnoh sa tang marwei , khlem u tnga ne ki khun shynrang .
Nga ong ha phi u la jubab , ba ha uno uno u uba don ei ei yn ai kham bun shuh ; hynrei ha briew bym don ei , kaba rit kaba u don yn shim noh na u .
translation.en: For I say unto you , That unto every one which hath shall be given  ; and from him that hath not , even that he hath shall be taken away from him .

Therefore is the anger of the  Lord  kindled against his people , and he hath stretched forth his hand against them , and hath smitten them : and the hills did tremble , and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets . For all this his anger is not turned away , but his hand is stretched out still .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ïa la ki briew bad u la kner ïa la ka kti ban pynshitom ïa ki . Ki lumbah kin khynñiuh bad ïa ki met jong kito kiba la ïap yn ieh ha ki lynti kum ka synrum . Pynban wat la katta ruh ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  ym shym la pynkut , hynrei ka kti jong u kan ïai kner ban pynshitom .
Bad kumta , kat kum ka Khubor Babha kaba ïalap nga , kane ka dei kaba kumno ka long ha kata ka Sngi ha kaba U Blei lyngba U Jisu un Khrist bishar ïa jingmut ki barieh jong ki briew baroh .
translation.en: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel .

Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah , the son of Benaiah , the son of Jeiel , the son of Mattaniah , a Levite of the sons of Asaph , came the Spirit of the  Lord  in the midst of the congregation  ;
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u wan ha u Lebi uba don hapdeng u paidbah . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Jahasiel , u khun jong u Sekharaïah ; u long u dkhot jong ka kur u Asaph bad u hiarpateng na u Asaph lyngba u Mattanaïah , u Jeiel bad u Benaïah .

translation.en: Until the  Lord  have given your brethren rest , as he hath given you , and they also have possessed the land which the  Lord  your God giveth them : then ye shall return unto the land of your possession , and enjoy it , which Moses the  Lord s  servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising .
translation.kha: haduh ba kin da ïohkynti ïa ka ri ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha ki . Hadien ba u la pynïoh ïa ka jingshongshngain ïa ki jait Israel baroh , te phi lah ban wan phai pat bad shongsah hangne ha ka ri jong phi ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan ïa kaba u Moses , u shakri U  Trai  , u la ai ha phi .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; An evil , an only evil , behold , is come .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Kawei ka jingjynjar hadien kawei pat kan wan ha pha .
Kiba hok ki ïohi ïa kane bad ki kmen , hynrei ïa baroh kiba bymman pynsngap la jar .
translation.en: The righteous shall see it , and rejoice : and all iniquity shall stop her mouth .

translation.kha: Ha por ba u la bha ban pynlong ïa la ki jingmut , ki kin dih bad .
translation.en: Butter and honey shall he eat , that he may know to refuse the evil , and choose the good .

translation.kha: Kane bynta ba-halor , ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia la thang , ka long ar mitar ka jingjrong . Ki reng ha ki tylli ki dong ki long kham ban ïa kiwei ha ka bynta .
translation.en: So the altar shall be four cubits  ; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns .

translation.kha: Moserah briew kin leh ïa kine kiei kiei ïa phi namar ba kim lehbor ithuh ïa U Kpa lymne ïa nga .
translation.en: And these things will they do unto you , because they have not known the Father , nor me .
And I took the two tables , and cast them out of my two hands , and brake them before your eyes .
translation.kha: Kumta , hangta ha khmat jong phi nga bret ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap bad nga pynpait pharia ïa ki .

translation.en: But Peter put them all forth , and kneeled down , and prayed  ; and turning him to the body said , Tabitha , arise . And she opened her eyes : and when she saw Peter , she sat up .
translation.kha: U Petros u la pynmih ïa ki baroh shabar ka kamra , bad u la dem khohsiew bad duwai ; nangta u la phai sha ka met bad u la ong ,  Ko Tabitha , khie joit !  Ka la plied ïa la ki khmat , bad haba ka la ïohi ïa u Petros , ka la khie shong .
ki Amor kiba shong ha kita ki lum ki la wan tur pyrshah ïa phi beh u ngap . la beh ïa phi shaduh Hormah bad la ïa hangta ha ri lum Edom
translation.en: And the Amorites , which dwelt in that mountain , came out against you , and chased you , as bees do , and destroyed you in Seir , even unto Hormah .

translation.kha: U la dei U Jisu uba , hiarpateng na u Dabid , ïa uba U Blei u la pynlong u Nongpynim ïa ki paid Israel , kumba u lah la kular .
translation.en: Of this man s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour , Jesus :

translation.kha: Ki rangbah Gibeon ki la phah ktien u Joshua ha ka jaka sher ha , ki ong Kynrad wat iehnoh ïa ngi ! Wan mar mar ban ïarap ngi ! Pyllait im ïa ! Baroh ki syiem Amor ha ri lum ki la ïasoh lang kawei la wan ïaleh ïa ngi .
translation.en: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal , saying , Slack not thy hand from thy servants  ; come up to us quickly , and save us , and help us : for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us .
Why is light given to a man whose way is hid , and whom God hath hedged in ?
translation.kha: U Blei u buhrieh ïa ka lawei na ki bad ker ïa ki na ki liang baroh .

translation.en: And he cast stones at David , and at all the servants of king David : and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left .
translation.kha: U Shimei u la sdang ban kawang maw ïa u Dabid bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , wat haba la ker tawiar ïa u Dabid da ki rangbah jong u bad ki nongïada jong u .

translation.en: Not for that we have dominion over your faith , but are helpers of your joy : for by faith ye stand .
translation.kha: Ngim shym pyrshang ban pynbor ïa kaei kaba phi dei ban ngeit ; ngi tip ba phi ïeng skhem ha ka jingngeit . Pynban , ngi ïatrei lem bad phi na ka bynta ka jingkmen jong phi hi .

translation.en: Then the soldiers , when they had crucified Jesus , took his garments , and made four parts , to every soldier a part  ; and also his coat : now the coat was without seam , woven from the top throughout .
translation.kha: Ynda haba ki shipai ki la lah sahnarphna ïa U Jisu , ki la ïashim ïa ki jaiñ jong u bad ki la ïabynta ha ki saw bynta , kawei ka bynta ïa uwei uwei u shipai . Ki la ïashim ruh ïa ka jaiñkup , ïa kaba la pynlong tang na kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ba la thain khlem kano kano ka jingsuh ha ka .

translation.en: For we are made partakers of Christ , if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end  ;
translation.kha: Naba ngi long baroh ki nongïoh bynta bad U Khrist lada ngi batskhem haduh kaba kut ïa kata ka jingsngewskhem kaba ngi la don naduh kaba sdang .
Kumno phin ïoh jingmyntoi na ka jingwan jong ki ?
translation.en: How can you benefit from their visits ?
And the mountains shall be molten under him , and the valleys shall be cleft , as wax before the fire , and as the waters that are poured down a steep place .
translation.kha: Te ki lum kin um hapoh jong u kum ka bthing ha ka ding , kin noh sha ki jaka them kum ka um batuid arsut ïa u lumrit .
Lada ngim long kiba ïaineh , u ïaisah hi uba , namar um lah ban ïa
translation.en: If we believe not , yet he abideth faithful : he cannot deny himself .
Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab , saith the  Lord  , him that offereth in the high places , and him that burneth incense to his gods .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsangeh ïa ki briew ka Moab na kaba thang jingainguh ha ki jaka mane jong ki bad ban ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ki blei jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

U syiem Dabid u buh pynskhem ïa Asaph bad ïa ki para Lebi ha ka kam kaba ïadei bad ka jingmane ba pynlong ha ka jaka ba la buh ka Synduk ka Jutang . La buh ïa ki ban pyndep ki kamram jong ki hangta man ka sngi .
translation.en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  Asaph and his brethren , to minister before the ark continually , as every day s work required :

translation.kha: Nga smai ba ngam suidñiew la leh kaba bymman ; shaiñ ngam ju pyrshang ban shukor ïa kiwei .
translation.en: If I have walked with vanity , or if my foot hath hasted to deceit  ;

translation.kha: Ho-oid , u la ong , lah phi khmih ban ïa kine baroh . Nga ong ha phi ïa : kane Yn ym don uwei u maw hangne u ban dang neh ha la ka jaka ; uwei pa uwei na ki un shah pynhap .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  See ye not all these things ? verily I say unto you , There shall not be left here one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
Yet in this thing ye did not believe the  Lord  your God ,
translation.kha: Pynban haba nga la kren haduh katta ruh , phim shym shaniah ha U  Trai  ,

translation.en: A fool despiseth his father s instruction : but he that regardeth reproof is prudent .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba ibieit ban ym suidñiew ïa kaei kaba ki kmie ki kpa jong phi ki hikai ; ka long kaba jingstad ban pdiang ïa ka jingsneng jong ki .

translation.en: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship , and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida , while he sent away the people .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi U Jisu u la pynlong ïa ki synran ban kiew halor ka lieng bad ban leit ha shuwa jong u sha Bethsaida , sha shiliang jong ka duriaw , katba u dang phah noh ïa u paidbah .

translation.en: For many deceivers are entered into the world , who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh . This is a deceiver and an antichrist .
translation.kha: Kiba bun ki nongshukor ki la leit sha ka pyrthei baroh , ki briew ki bym pdiang ba U Jisu Khrist u la wan kum u briew . Kum uta u briew , u long u nongshukor bad u Nongshun jong U Khrist .

translation.en: O Lord , righteousness belongeth unto thee , but unto us confusion of faces , as at this day  ; to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and unto all Israel , that are near , and that are far off , through all the countries whither thou hast driven them , because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee .
translation.kha: Ma me ko Trai , me leh borabor ïa kaba dei , hynrei borabor ngi la wallam ka jingjahburom ha lade hi . Kane ka long kaba shisha ïa baroh na ngi kiba shong basah ha Judia bad ha Jerusalem bad jong baroh ki khun Israel ïa kiba me la pynsakma ha ki ri kiba jan bad kiba jngai namar ki la long ki bymïaineh ha me .

translation.en: Now that the dead are raised , even Moses shewed at the bush , when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob .
translation.kha: Bad u Moses u pynshisha da kaba shai ba ïa kiba ïap la pynmihpat . Ha ka bynta shaphang ka  lawlynnong kaba ing u kren shaphang U Trai kum ‘ U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isaak , bad U Blei jong u Jakob .’
Nga kular ba ngan pynlong kane ïa ka nongbah bad ïa kiba shong ha ka kum ka Topheth .
translation.en: Thus will I do unto this place , saith the  Lord  , and to the inhabitants thereof , and even make this city as Topheth :
The former treatise have I made , O Theophilus , of all that Jesus began both to do and teach ,
translation.kha: Thiophilos badonburom : Ha ka kitab banyngkong jong nga , nga la thoh shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba U Jisu u la leh bad hikai naduh ka por ba u la sdang ïa ka jingtrei jong u tad haduh ka sngi ha kaba la shim noh ïa u sha bneng .

translation.en: For how great is his goodness , and how great is his beauty ! corn shall make the young men cheerful , and new wine the maids .
translation.kha: Katno kaba bha bad kaba itynnat ka ri kan long ! Ki samla kin san kin khlaiñ da u kew bad ka waiñ jong ka .
U Jisu u la jubab , U briew uba la ïa bet u symbai babha u long U Khun U Briew ;
translation.en: He answered and said unto them ,  He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man  ;
Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment , that , if any man knew where he were , he should shew it , that they might take him .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ai ïa ka hukum ba lada uno uno u tip hangno ba U Jisu u don , u dei ban wanrah khubor , khnang ba kin ïohkem ïa u .

translation.en: And they cried out again , Crucify him .
translation.kha: Ki la pyrta kylla ,  Sahnarphna ïa u !

translation.en: Who hath formed a god , or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing ?
translation.kha: Kam don jingbha ban thaw ïa ka dur nar ban mane kum u blei !
Ka kaba ngan ai kan ha u ka umpohliew ka ban ïa u da ka kaba ai jingim ai ha u ïa jingim bymjukut
translation.en: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst  ; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life .

translation.kha: Hynrei siar ong , Ho-oid 145 ïa ki tnat la pynkheiñ noh ban kanjari jaka na ka bynta Midian nga .
translation.en: Thou wilt say then , The branches were broken off , that I might be grafted in .

Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah , and said unto him , What said these men ? and from whence came they unto thee ? And Hezekiah said , They are come from a far country , even from Babylon .
translation.kha: Nangta u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u leit sha u syiem Hesekaïah bad u kylli ,  Nangno kine ki rangbah ki la wan bad ki la ong aïu ïa me ?  U Hesekaïah u jubab ,  Ki la wan na ka ri kaba jngai , na Babilonia .

translation.en: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming : it stirreth up the dead for thee , even all the chief ones of the earth  ; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei jong kiba ïap ka pynkhreh ban pdiang sngewbha ïa u syiem jong ka Babilonia . Ki sna-ïap jong kito kiba donbor ha ka pyrthei ki ïakhih ksar . Ki sna-ïap jong ki syiem ki ïeng na ki khet jong ki .
Haba nga pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad ha ki ri nongwei , tip ba nga U Trai .
translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall scatter them among the nations , and disperse them in the countries .
Mine eyes fail for thy word , saying , When wilt thou comfort me ?
translation.kha: Ki khmat jong nga ki thait ïan ha kaba ap ïa ka jingkular jong me ; katba nga kylli ,  Lano keiñ men ïarap ïa nga ?

translation.en: And his sons walked not in his ways , but turned aside after lucre , and took bribes , and perverted judgment .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym bud ïa ka nuksa u kpa jong ki ; ki im sngi tang ha kaba kamai spah , kumta ki bamsap bad kim bishar hok ïa ki jingïakajia .
Hynrei em , ha ka jingshisha , phi la ïohi hi lade ; te kumta balei phi kren ïa kum kata ka jingkren bieit ?
translation.en: Behold , all ye yourselves have seen it  ; why then are ye thus altogether vain ?

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u jubab , Em , Kynrad , sngewbha phah noh dano .
translation.en: And he said , O my Lord , send , I pray thee , by the hand of him whom thou wilt send .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga la leh na ka bynta jong nga hi — Ngan Tied shah jingthlia ïa Krispos kyrteng jong nga yn Dinah lane mano mano ban ïadon bynta lang ïa ka burom kaba dei ka jong Ahishar bad ka jong nga hi .
translation.en: For mine own sake , even for mine own sake , will I do it : for how should my name be polluted ? and I will not give my glory unto another .
Seeing many things , but thou observest not  ; opening the ears , but he heareth not .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , phi la ïohi shibun bha , hynrei ka don jingmut aïu ïa phi ? Phi don ki shkor ban sngew , hynrei phi ïohsngew aïu da shisha ?

translation.en: And he sent Peter and John , saying ,  Go and prepare us the passover , that we may eat .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phah ïa u Petros bad ïa u Ïoannis lem bad kine ki jingbthah :  Khie leit bad pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong ngi ban ïabam .
Haba kata ka por ka wan , U Trai un siaw kum ka dak ïa ki Ijipt ban wan kum ki skain na shnat ki kiba jngai eh jong ka wah Nile , ïa bad ki Assyria ban wan kum ki ngap ka na ri jong ki .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt , and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria .

translation.kha: Mynta , ko , khun leh kumba nga ong .
translation.en: Now therefore , my son , obey my voice  ; and arise , flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran  ;
Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets  ; This man is not worthy to die : for he hath spoken to us in the name of the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongïalam bad ki paidbah ki ong ha ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa ,  Une u briew u la kren ha ngi ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ; um dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: And both these kings  hearts shall be to do mischief , and they shall speak lies at one table  ; but it shall not prosper : for yet the end shall be at the time appointed .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ar ngut ki syiem kin ïashong lang ban ïabam ha kajuh ka miej , hynrei ki jingthmu jong ki , kin long kiba sniew , bad kin ïa-lamler uwei ïa uwei pat . Kin ym ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah , namar ka por na ka bynta kata kam pat poi .
Wat ‘ pynïap .
translation.en: Thou shalt not kill .

translation.kha: Da ka sur jam pan ki jingkyrkhu na Blei halor u paidbah baroh uba ïalumlang hangta
translation.en: And he stood , and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice , saying ,

translation.kha: Kumta te , Adbeel ka ïashong bad Samuel pat u briew katba Gad tnga jong pyntlot u dang Ussaïah ; yn khot ïa ka , ka briew kaba ïakynton ; bri lada u tnga jong ba-ïashun u la ïap , kat kum ka aiñ Esther —Ïoannis ka briew ba la khohram bad kam leh bapyndait ka Araunah haba ka shongkurim ïa pynthait Mahadei .
translation.en: So then if , while her husband liveth , she be married to another man , she shall be called an adulteress : but if her husband be dead , she is free from that law ; so that she is no adulteress , though she be married to another man .

translation.kha: Balei buit slem ?
translation.en: How come you're late ?
He hath cast me into the mire , and I am become like dust and ashes .
translation.kha: U la bret ïa nga ha ka ktieh ; ngam da ïapher shuh na ka jaboh .

translation.en: But ask now the beasts , and they shall teach thee  ; and the fowls of the air , and they shall tell thee :
translation.kha: Wat ki sim bad ki mrad ki don shibun ban hikai ïa me ;
Khatduh na ki baroh kata , ka briew ka la ïap .
translation.en: Last of all the woman died also .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan sa bishar ïa kata ka jaitbynriew ïa kaba kin shakri bad , hadien kata ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin mihnoh na kata ka ri bad mane kin ïa nga ha kane ka jaka .’
translation.en: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge , said God : and after that shall they come forth , and serve me in this place .

translation.kha: Kum ïa ki Anakim , la ju khot ruh ïa ki , Rephaim ki ; ki hynrei nong Moab ki khot ïa ki , ki Emim .
translation.en: Which also were accounted giants , as the Anakims  ; but the Moabites call them Emims .

Therefore deliver up their children to the famine , and pour out their blood by the force of the sword  ; and let their wives be bereaved of their children , and be widows  ; and let their men be put to death  ; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ko  Trai  , ai ba ki khun jong ki , kin ym ïoh jingbam haduh ban da ïap ; ai ba kin shah pynïap ha ka thma . Ai ba ki kynthei kin duh noh ïa la ki tnga bad ïa ki khun jong ki ; ai ba ki rangbah kin ïap na ka jingpang bad ba ki samla shynrang kin shah pynïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: And when they shall say unto you , Seek unto them that have familiar spirits , and unto wizards that peep , and that mutter : should not a people seek unto their God ? for the living to the dead ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kin ong ïa me ban kylli ïa ki khubor na ki nongbatai kupar bad ki nongkren byrtong kiba kren jam bad kiba kren mian mian . Kin ong ,  Nalor baroh , ki briew ki dei ban kylli ïa ki khubor na ki mynsiem bad kylli na kiba ïap na ka bynta kiba im .

U Hanun bad 111 nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah Sanoah , ki tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Them . bniah pynïeng tnum ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ïa ki jingkhang ka khyrdop , bad ki shna pynbha ïa ka kynroh kaba sawspah sawphew pynbah , haduh ka Khyrdop Synrum .
translation.en: The valley gate repaired Hanun , and the inhabitants of Zanoah  ; they built it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof , and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate .

translation.kha: Ko paid ïohlad , to shahshkor ïa ka khubor ba U nong u Synrap na ka ïasuhbuit jong shibun .
translation.en: Hear ye the word which the  Lord  speaketh unto you , O house of Israel :
O ye seed of Abraham his servant , ye children of Jacob his chosen .
translation.kha: Ma phi ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham , u shakri jong u ; ma phi ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , u briew uba u la jied : Kynmaw ïa ki kambah ba U Blei u la leh bad ki jingbishar kiba u la ai .

translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga .
Kine harum ki dei ki kyrteng jong kine Leummim rangbah pynïaidkam bad ki Trai ïuhbeiñ kynum dei khmih : U Benhur : ka ri sngewlwait Moraïah
translation.en: And these are their names : The son of Hur , in mount Ephraim :

translation.kha: Nga ju ai ïa u ki la da u uba la na kynhun langbrot jong nga hi . u ïaroh ïa nga naduh dohnud jong u baroh .
translation.en: If his loins have not blessed me , and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep  ;
The  Lord  your God which goeth before you , he shall fight for you , according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïalam ïa phi , bad un ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi , kumba phi la ïohi ïa u ba u leh ha Ijipt

translation.en: And when he was come out of the ship , immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit ,
translation.kha: Tang shu hiar na ka lieng , U Jisu u la ïakynduh ïa u briew uba wan mih na ki krem jingtep kiba don hangta . Une u briew u don ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong u bad u shong u sah ha ki jaka tep briew .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another , as ye walk , and are sad ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Shaphang kaei ba phi ïakren para ma phi , katba phi nang ïa-ïaid ?  Ki la ïeng , lem bad ka durkhmat basngewsih .
Pynïap ïa baroh ki shynrang , bad kawei pa kawei kynthei ka bym dei shuh ka .
translation.en: And this is the thing that ye shall do , Ye shall utterly destroy every male , and every woman that hath lain by man .

translation.kha: Kane ka la ïa u pynbitar Elisha , bad u ong ïa u syiem , Me la dei ban pduh san ne hynriew sien , bad nangta men jin da la jop halor pura ki Syria ; hynrei mynta men jop ïa ki tang lai sien .
translation.en: And the man of God was wroth with him , and said , Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times  ; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it : whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice .
And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal , Choose you one bullock for yourselves , and dress it first  ; for ye are many  ; and call on the name of your gods , but put no fire under .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal ,  Namar ba phi kham ïabun , shim shuwa ma phi ïa u masi dab . Duwai ha u blei jong phi , tangba phim dei ban ai ding ïa ki diengthang .

translation.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari , according to all their service , in the tabernacle of the congregation , under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .
translation.kha: Kine ki kur u Merari kin shong dara ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Ïingjaiñ , lem bad u Suriel u khun jong u Abihail kum u rangbah kur .

translation.en: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people , and thine eyes shall look , and fail with longing for them all the day long : and there shall be no might in thine hand .
translation.kha: Ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi yn ai noh kum ki mraw ha ki nongwei katba phi pat phi shu peit . Man ka sngi phin pynshitom sat ïa la ki khmat ba phi ap lehnoh-ei ïa la ki khun ba kin wan phai pat .

translation.en: For I will restore health unto thee , and I will heal thee of thy wounds , saith the  Lord   ; because they called thee an Outcast , saying , This is Zion , whom no man seeketh after .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkoit pat ïa phi ; ngan pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong jong phi , la ki nongshun jong phi ki ong , ‘ Ka Seïon ka dei kaba shah kyntait ; ym don mano mano ba salia ïa ka .’ Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba leh ïa bha ha por baroh bad bym ju leh bakla .
translation.en: For there is not a just man upon earth , that doeth good , and sinneth not .
Take this book of the law , and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , that it may be there for a witness against thee .
translation.kha: Shim ïa kane ka kitab ka Aiñ U Blei bad buh ïa ka ha syndah ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ba kan don hangta kum ka sakhi pyrshah ïa ki briew jong u .

Herodias Moses u long uta uba la Shem riewshemphang ki jingbthei ïakhun , ‘ U bakhraw! batymmen jingsait ha phi ïa u jingaimynsiem , kumba u la phah ïa nga , bad un long uba bashimet ki briew jong Sior .’
translation.en: This is that Moses , which said unto the children of Israel , A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren , like unto me  ; him shall ye hear .
But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: hynrei u la pynngam jyllop ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
Haba phi duwai , wat pyndonkam bun ki kyntien bym kit , kumba nongmane blei thala leh , kiba pyrkhat ba ki jong ki kin ïohsngew ïa ki namar ki jingduwai jong ki , ki long kiba jlan .
translation.en: But when ye pray , use not vain repetitions , as the heathen do : for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking .

translation.kha: Khmih sha ki bneng peit ha ka pyrthei ! Ki bneng kin jah noh kum ka tdem ; ka pyrthei jot noh ki jaiñ ba la , bad ki jong ka baroh ïap kum ki . ka jingpyllait kaba nga wallam kan neh junom ; ka jingjop jong nga kan long kaba kut .
translation.en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens , and look upon the earth beneath : for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke , and the earth shall wax old like a garment , and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner : but my salvation shall be for ever , and my righteousness shall not be abolished .

And the king said unto Ziba , What meanest thou by these ? And Ziba said , The asses be for the king s household to ride on  ; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat  ; and the wine , that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u kylli ïa u ,  Men leh aïu ïa kine katne katne ?  U Siba u jubab ,  Ki kada ki dei na ka bynta ki ba-ha-ïing jong u Syiem Kynrad ban shong , u kpu bad u soh ki dei na ka bynta ki rangbah jong phi ban bam , bad ka waiñ ka dei na ka bynta jong ki ban dih haba ki la thait ha ka ri khlaw .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye come into the land whither I bring you ,
translation.kha: ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki paid Israel ban bud ha ka ri kaba u mut ban ai ha ki .
kin jah noh kum ki jaiñ ba la bam khñiang ! Hynrei ka jingpyllait kaba ngan wallam kan neh junom ; ka jingjop jong nga kan neh ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment , and the worm shall eat them like wool : but my righteousness shall be for ever , and my salvation from generation to generation .
And it came to pass after these things , that it was told Abraham , saying , Behold , Milcah , she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor  ;
translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat por , u Abraham u la tip ba ka Milkah ka la kha phra ngut ki khun ïa u Nahor u para jong u :
U angel jong U Trai u la mihpaw ha ki , ïa-bta dujok! burom Madon U Trai ka la Heshmon halor pangnud ki shongshngain Ki la sngewsheptieng shikatdei eh ,
translation.en: And , lo , the angel of the Lord came upon them , and the glory of the Lord shone round about them : and they were sore afraid .

translation.kha: U Manasseh la u don khat-ar snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar Jerusalem ha sanphew san snem .
translation.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem :
Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Behold , I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah , that whosoever heareth of it , both his ears shall tingle .
translation.kha: Kumta nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel ngan wallam ka jingjot ha Jerusalem bad Judah ba uwei pa uwei uba ïohsngew shaphang kata un lyngngoh .

translation.en: And when all these kings were met together , they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom , to fight against Israel .
translation.kha: Kine ki syiem baroh ki la ïasoh lang kawei bad ki la wan lang ban sher dara harud ka Wahduid Meron ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And , behold , the glory of the God of Israel was there , according to the vision that I saw in the plain .
translation.kha: Hangta nga la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ kaba pyn-i ïa ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei ki Israel , kumba nga la ïohi ïa ka haba nga don harud ka wah Khebar .

A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki tbian ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Jesebel leit lyngba ki duriaw bad phi ïaid sha kylleng ki ri baroh ban shetkylla ïano ïano ; bad haba phi lah , phi Ainias ïa u ar shah Ussen tawiar ban leit sha dujok kumba Beeri hi , phi long !
translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte , and when he is made , ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves .

And go , get thee to them of the captivity , unto the children of thy people , and speak unto them , and tell them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; whether they will hear , or whether they will forbear .
translation.kha: To leit sha la ki para ri kiba shah ringmraw bad ong ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki , la ki shahshkor ne kim shahshkor ïa me .
Uwei u samla , uba kup tang da ka jaiñ linen , bud u ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And there followed him a certain young man , having a linen cloth cast about his naked body  ; and the young men laid hold on him :

translation.kha: Kumta u Hasael u pynkit ïa baroh ki jait jingmih kiba kynsai jong ka ha ki tylli ki ut u leit sha u Elisha . Haba u Hasael ïa u , u ong , U shakri jong phi u syiem Benhadad u la phah ïa ban kylli na la un dang koit ne em na ka jingpang u .
translation.en: So Hazael went to meet him , and took a present with him , even of every good thing of Damascus , forty camels  burden , and came and stood before him , and said , Thy son Ben–hadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee , saying , Shall I recover of this disease ?
Open rebuke is better than secret love .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban pynbeit ïano ïano ha kaba paw ban ïa kaba pynlong ïa u ban pyrkhat ba phim suidñiew satia ïa u .
Ha ka jingïadei bad ka , la kumno nga la ïap — la da ka Hukum hi — khnang ba nga lah ban im na ka U Blei . La pynïap ïa lem bad U Khrist ha ka diengphna u ,
translation.en: For I through the law am dead to the law , that I might live unto God .
For he shall not much remember the days of his life  ; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart .
translation.kha: Namar U Blei u la shah ïa ngi ban kmen , ngin ym khuslai shibun shaphang katno ka jingim ka long kaba lyngkot .

translation.en: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel , and the stranger that sojourneth among them  ; seeing all the people were in ignorance .
translation.kha: Te yn map ïa ka kynhun Israel baroh bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong ki , namar iwei pa iwei ki la don bynta ha ka jingbakla .

translation.en: For though I preach the gospel , I have nothing to glory of : for necessity is laid upon me ; yea , woe is unto me , if I preach not the gospel!
translation.kha: Ngam don hok ban kob tang namar ba nga ïalap ïa ka Gospel . La katta ruh , nga don hapoh ki hukum ban leh kumta . Bad katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa nga lada ngam shym la ïalap ïa ka gospel!
