translation.kha: bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki . Ki lah lait na kawei ka ding , hynrei mynta ka ding kan thang khoit ïa ki . Haba nga pynshitom ïa ki , phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingshah lehrain jong pha ; baroh sakhrai la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam jong pha . Uwei u jingbymjanai u ban halor uwei pat , tulop baroh ar ngut nongsharai kyllon kbeit madan khunswet
translation.en: The nations have heard of thy shame , and thy cry hath filled the land : for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty , and they are fallen both together .
For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale s belly  ; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ba u Jonah u la pynlut lai sngi bad lai miet hapoh u dohkha uba heh , kumta U Khun U Briew un pynlut lai sngi bad lai miet ha kiba jylliew jong ka khyndew .
Phan kum long ka pansngiat kaba itynnat ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the  Lord  , and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God .
If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong  ;
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u briew u pyrshang ban pynsniew ïa uwei pat u briew da kaba mudui lamler ïa u ,

translation.en: Thy bow was made quite naked , according to the oaths of the tribes , even thy word . Selah . Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers .
translation.kha: Me pynkhreh ban pyndonkam ïa la ka ryntieh , me khreh ban siat ïa la ki khnam . Ka leilieh jong me ka pynpait ïa ka khyndew .
Ki tih shaduh ki tyllong jong ki wah , bad basan wallam sha ka jingshai ïa kaei nongpynim la Elon .
translation.en: He bindeth the floods from overflowing  ; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light .

translation.kha: To riewshlur ïa ka rupa ! To lute ïa ka ksiar ! Ka nongbah ka dap da ki jingkynshew !
translation.en: Take ye the spoil of silver , take the spoil of gold : for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture .

translation.kha: ïa u Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron uba long lyngdoh weng noh ïa ki khiew buh ding kiba ka rnong na kiba jong ki briew la shah thang bad ban bret ïa u rnga ding na kita khiew shaei shaei , namar ki khiew buh ding long kiba khuid .
translation.en: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest , that he take up the censers out of the burning , and scatter thou the fire yonder  ; for they are hallowed .

And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus , There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom  ; and their laws are diverse from all people  ; neither keep they the king s laws : therefore it is not for the king s profit to suffer them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Haman u ong ïa u syiem .  Ka don kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba la saphriang kylleng sawdong ka hima jong phi bad ba lah ban shem ha kawei pa kawei ka probins   . Ki bud ïa ki dustur kiba ïapher na ki jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew . Nalor kata kim kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong ka hima , kumta kan ym long kaba bha ïa phi ban shah ïa ki .
briew Ki kiba sniew ki wad ïa ki lynti ban pynmynsaw ïa kiwei ; wat ki ktien jong ki , ki long kiba thang ka da jingsniew .
translation.en: An ungodly man diggeth up evil : and in his lips there is as a burning fire .

translation.kha: bad ka Resen , kaba don hapdeng ka Ninebeh bad ka nongbah bakhraw Kalah ka .
translation.en: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah : the same is a great city .

Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh , and said , My father and my brethren , and their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have , are come out of the land of Canaan  ; and , behold , they are in the land of Goshen .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u leit ïalam san ngut na ki hynmen jong u sha u syiem . U ong ,  I pa bad ki hynmen ki para jong nga ki la wan na ka ri Kanaan ryngkat bad ki kynhun langbrot bad ki jingri jingdup jong ki , bad baroh ruh kat kiba ki don . Mynta ki don ha Goshen .
U Joseph u iehnoh ïa ki bad u sdang ban ïam . Haba u lah ban la kren biang , u la wan pat , u shim ïa u bad Simeon u phah teh ïa u ha khmat jong ki .
translation.en: And he turned himself about from them , and wept  ; and returned to them again , and communed with them , and took from them Simeon , and bound him before their eyes .

translation.kha: Katno uba long uta u shakri lada u jong u , u shem ba u leh ïa kane haba u wan ïing !
translation.en: Blessed is that servant , whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing .

translation.kha: Ka kali ïapom ba la tan da ki kulai rong ka ïong la leit shaphang shatei sha Babilonia ki , kulai rong lieh ki leit shaphang sepngi , bad ki kulai thohbroin ki leit sha ka ri bashathie .
translation.en: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country  ; and the white go forth after them  ; and the grisled go forth toward the south country .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ai ha u ïa ka ka jaka hapdeng kiba bad kiba donbor . U la aiti mon sngewbha ïa ka jingim bad u la shim bynta lem bad riewbymman U la shim ïa ka jaka ki nongpop kiba bun bad u la ba ki kin ïoh ïa ka Jingmap-ei .
translation.en: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great , and he shall divide the spoil with the strong  ; because he hath poured out his soul unto death : and he was numbered with the transgressors  ; and he bare the sin of many , and made intercession for the transgressors .

translation.kha: U Moses u ong u ha Aaron , bad ha ki ar ngut ki khun jong shynrang kiba u dang sah , u Eleasar bad u Ithamar , Shim ïa ka jingainguh bam kaba sah na kata ka jingbam kaba la kñia sha U , Trai pynlong kpu khlem thiat da ka bad bam ïa ka harud ka duwan , namar kane ka ka jingkñia long kaba khuid bha .
translation.en: And Moses spake unto Aaron , and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar , his sons that were left , Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and eat it without leaven beside the altar : for it is most holy :

translation.kha: Shaphang ka jingkular kaba ngi la pynlong hapdeng ngi U Trai pynthikna ba ngin bat ïa ka junom
translation.en: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of , behold , the  Lord  be between thee and me for ever .
When I shall send Artemas unto thee , or Tychicus , be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis : for I have determined there to winter .
translation.kha: Ynda nga phah ïa u Artemas lane ïa u Tukhikos sha me , ïaleh shitom ban wan sha nga ha Nikopolis , namar nga la rai ban pynlut ïa ka tlang hangta .
Kumba U Trai u la kular lyngba u Elijah , ka pliang purew shym kam la thylli lymne u klong um shym long khlem umphniang .
translation.en: And the barrel of meal wasted not , neither did the cruse of oil fail , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Elijah .

translation.kha: Ka Ijipt ka phet krad , ka pyrsad Sipporah u bseiñ Sangeh katba ka kynhun shipai u nongshun ka wan tur . bakyllut tur ïaleh jingbynrap ka da ki sdie , kum Meholah rangbah Tobiah bam-im ïa spoiñ dieng Rebekka kiba pynjot ïa kilomitar khlaw barben .
translation.en: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent  ; for they shall march with an army , and come against her with axes , as hewers of wood .

translation.kha: Shim ïa ka shadem jong uta u langbrot bad pynkyntang ïa ka kum ka jingainguh bakyrpang sha nga . ka Kane bynta jong mrad u ba la kñia ka dei ka jong me .
translation.en: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron s consecration , and wave it for a wave offering before the  Lord  : and it shall be thy part .
And he was in the hinder part of the ship , asleep on a pillow : and they awake him , and say unto him , Master , carest thou not that we perish ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u don ha ka bynta kaba shadien jong ka lieng , u da ïohthiah , ka khlieh jong u ha ka syngkhlieh . Ki synran ki la kyrsiew ïa u bad ki la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai , hato mem sngewlem ïa ngi ba ngin sa ïap ?
Nga pynïaidkam bad nga ai ki Admatha Elnathan nga la ïalam ïa ki kumba u syiem u ïalam ïa la ki shipai , bad nga ai ha ki ïa ka jingshngain haba ki duh jingkyrmen kotbah
translation.en: I chose out their way , and sat chief , and dwelt as a king in the army , as one that comforteth the mourners .
And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the  Lord  : seven days ye must eat unleavened bread .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khatsan uta u bnai , ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat ka sdang ; hynñiew sngi lynter phim dei ban bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .
ïongreiñ long u shabi uba —Mathaios ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ba Salome buhrieh jong ka jingstad bad Martha jingtip Sykomore Blei .
translation.en: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge .
Their heart cried unto the Lord , O wall of the daughter of Zion , let tears run down like a river day and night : give thyself no rest  ; let not the apple of thine eye cease .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u long uba hok , namar ngam shym la kohnguh ïa u . To shahshkor ïa nga , ko ki briew hangno hangno ; to khmih ïa nga ha ka jingpang jong nga . Ki samla shynrang bad kynthei jong nga ki la shah ringmraw noh .
Ki dieng ki la dap da ka ngap , hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba la Tang ei ei na ka pynjlih baroh ki sheptieng ïabah ka jingtim ka jong u Saul .
translation.en: And when the people were come into the wood , behold , the honey dropped  ; but no man put his hand to his mouth : for the people feared the oath .

translation.kha: Pheliks ïa U Trai , ko mynsiem Andriw nga ! A Trai , U Blei jong nga , Bynrap me long uba khraw ! Me kup da ka burom syiem pynbor ka burom ;
translation.en: Bless the  Lord  , O my soul . O  Lord  my God , thou art very great  ; thou art clothed with honour and majesty .
So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city , which was before the king s gate .
translation.kha: U Hathakh u leit sha u Mordekai ha ka phyllaw ka nongbah ha ka khyrdop ka ïingsyiem .
Ka Leah ka la punkhun bad ka kha khun shynrang . Ka ong , U Trai u ïohi la ïa ka jingjynjar jong nga , bad mynta tnga u jong nga un ieit ïa nga ; kumta ka la khot ïa kyrteng u , u Reuben .
translation.en: And Leah conceived , and bare a son , and she called his name Reuben : for she said , Surely the  Lord  hath looked upon my affliction  ; now therefore my husband will love me .

translation.kha: bad u lyngdoh un ïalam ïa shabar u ka jaka shong dara , bad un khmih bha ïa u .
translation.en: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp  ; and the priest shall look , and , behold , if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper  ;

translation.kha: U Abishai , u khun jong ka Seruïah u la kren Ïa Shimei dei ban pynïap ba la tim ïa uta uba U Trai u la jied kum u syiem .
translation.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said , Shall not Shimei be put to death for this , because he cursed the  Lord s  anointed ?
And Balak did as Balaam had said , and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar .
translation.kha: U Balaam u leh kumta , bad u kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei pa kawei ka duwan .

translation.en: For the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed , and who shall disannul it ? and his hand is stretched out , and who shall turn it back ?

translation.en: And when he had made an end of prophesying , he came to the high place .
Leah was tender eyed  ; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured .

Ki la ba la pyntyllun ïa u maw na ka jaka rung sha ka jingtep , kumta ki rung shapoh ;
translation.en: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre .
Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters : who maketh the clouds his chariot : who walketh upon the wings of the wind :
translation.kha: bad tei ïa ka ïing jong me halor ki um hajrong . Me pyndonkam ïa ki lyoh kum ki kali ïapom bad me shong halor ki thapniang jong ka lyer .
Nangta pynshong phi Blastos kem bad yn aiti ban shah pynshitom bad ban teh pynïap dorbar Ki jaitbynriew baroh kin isih ïa phi namar jong puid .
translation.en: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted , and shall kill you : and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name s sake .

translation.kha: bad u duwai , A Trai , U Jonah jong ki Israel , uba don ha — khet halor ki Kherub , me hi mano Ethkasin U jingisynei , Bisiothaïah synshar halor ki hima Jinglait jong ka pyrthei . me la Ham khylliap ka pyrthei bad ïa jingtyrha suiñbneng pyningkhong
translation.en: And Hezekiah prayed before the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  God of Israel , which dwellest between the cherubims , thou art the God , even thou alone , of all the kingdoms of the earth  ; thou hast made heaven and earth .

translation.kha: U bnai un kylla dum , bad ka kan sngi ym tyngshaiñ shuh , namar U Trai Badonbor Baroh un long u syiem . Un synshar ha Jerusalem halor u Lum Seïon , bad ki nongïalam jong ki briew kin ïa ïohi ka burom jong . u
translation.en: Then the moon shall be confounded , and the sun ashamed , when the  Lord  of hosts shall reign in mount Zion , and in Jerusalem , and before his ancients gloriously .

And say , Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , O kings of Judah , and inhabitants of Jerusalem  ; Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , the which whosoever heareth , his ears shall tingle .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ,  Ko ki syiem jong ka Judah bad ki briew jong ka Jerusalem , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ka Israel , nga don ban ong . Ngan wallam kaba kum kane ka jingpynjot ha kane ka jaka ba uwei pa uwei baroh uba ïohsngew shaphang jong ka un kyndit .

translation.en: And he went into the synagogue , and spake boldly for the space of three months , disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: U Paul u la rung ha ka synagog bad ha ki lai bnai u la kren shlur bad ki paidbah , u da pynlong ki jingïaphylliew jingmut bad ki bad pyrshang ban pynngeit ïa ki shaphang ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh , and upon Egypt  ; afterwards he will let you go hence : when he shall let you go , he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan phah sa tang kawei ka jingpynshitom ha u Pharaoh bad ki briew jong u . Hadien kata , un sa shah ba phin ïamihnoh . Ha ka jingshisha , un sa beh lut ïa phi nangne .

translation.en: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering  ; he shall put no oil upon it , neither shall he put any frankincense thereon : for it is a sin offering .
translation.kha: Lada u briew um kotbor ban wanrah ar tylli ki paro ne ar tylli ki lyngdkhur , un wallam shi kilo u  purew kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop . Um dei ban theh kano kano ka umphniang Olib ne kano kano ka jingiwbih halor jong u , namar ka dei ka jingkñia namar ka pop , ym ka jingkñia bam .

translation.en: And when I passed by thee , and saw thee polluted in thine own blood , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live  ; yea , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïaid lyngba bad ïohi ba pha khih ha ka snam jong pha . La tap ïa pha da ka snam , hynrei ngam shym la shah ïa pha ban ïap .
phi wan ?
translation.en: How did you come ?

translation.kha: Nangta kata ka sur ïa kaba nga la ïohsngew kaba na bneng ka la kren biang ha nga , ka da ong , To leit bad shim ïa ka kot kaba la plied kaba don ha ka kti jong u angel uba ïeng halor ka duriaw bad halor ka khyndew .
translation.en: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again , and said , Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth .
Why did Jehovah create the earth ?
translation.kha: Balei U Jehobah u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei ?
Kito kiba ha Judah kiba lait im kin roi kum ki jingthung Naduh ki thied ki sam jylliew ha ka khyndew bad pynmih soh .
translation.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward , and bear fruit upward .
The young man saith unto him , All these things have I kept from my youth up : what lack I yet ?
translation.kha: Nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh ,  u samla u la jubab .  Sa kaei pat ba nga donkam ban leh ?

translation.en: Give them sorrow of heart , thy curse unto them .
translation.kha: to tim ïa ki bad pyndap ïa ki da ka jingduh jingkyrmen !

translation.en: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria , even a blessing in the midst of the land :
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ïa ka Israel yn kyrdan lang bad ka Ijipt bad ka Assyria , bad kine ki lai tylli ki ri kin long ka jingkyrkhu ïa ka pyrthei baroh .

Ka Delilah ka ong ïa u Samson , Haduh mynta phi dang pynlong ka bieit ïa nga bad phim ïathuh ïa kaba shisha . Ïathuh ïa nga kumno yn lah ban khum ïa phi . U jubab Lada phi thain , ïa kine ki kynthrong shñiuh jong nga hynñiew tylli bad phi pynskhem ïa da ki ki ïingjaiñ snar , ngan long uba tlot bor kumba long lem kiwei .
translation.en: And Delilah said unto Samson , Hitherto thou hast mocked me , and told me lies : tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound . And he said unto her , If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web .

translation.kha: kiba la ringmraw ngi ki ngin rwai ki ong ïa ngi ba pynsngewbha ïa : To rwai ha ngi ïa jingrwai shaphang Seïon .
translation.en: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song  ; and they that wasted us required of us mirth , saying , Sing us one of the songs of Zion .

translation.kha: U ong : Ha khmih ! Ki ki um la nang shlei na shatei bad kin stet tuid kum ka wah ba la shlei um . Kin tap ïa ka ri bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka , ki nongbah bad ki briew kiba im hangta . briew Ki kin pyrta jingïarap ; baroh kiba ha ka pyrthei ïamkthang kin .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , waters rise up out of the north , and shall be an overflowing flood , and shall overflow the land , and all that is therein  ; the city , and them that dwell therein : then the men shall cry , and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl .

translation.kha: Tangba wat bam ïa ka doh dang don hapoh jong ka , namar ka jingim ka don ha ka snam , bad phim dei bam ïa kata ka jingim lem bad ka doh .
translation.en: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood : for the blood is the life  ; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh .
Praise ye the  Lord . Blessed is the man that feareth the  Lord  , that delighteth greatly in his commandments .
translation.kha: A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Suk uta u briew uba pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , uba shem sngewbha ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
Phi la wan sha U Jisu , uba pynlong la ïa ka jutang bathymmai , bad sha ka snam ba la synreit , kaba kular bun kiei kiei kiba kham ban bha ïa ka snam u Abel .
translation.en: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant , and to the blood of sprinkling , that speaketh better things than that of Abel .
And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and shalt wash them with water .
translation.kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u sha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad ong ba kin sum kat kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: For they fled from the swords , from the drawn sword , and from the bent bow , and from the grievousness of war .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïaphet ban ïohlait im na ki waitlam kiba la khreh ban pynïap ïa ki , na ki ryntieh kiba la khreh ban siat , na baroh ki jingma jong ka thma .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto David my father , Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name , thou didst well that it was in thine heart .
To whom he said , This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest  ; and this is the refreshing : yet they would not hear .
translation.kha: U la ai ka jingshongthait bad ka jingjahthait ïa phi baroh , hynrei phi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa u .

translation.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land , thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field , neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest .
translation.kha: Haba phi lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , wat ot ïa u kew uba don ha ki tduh jong ki lyngkha , bad wat leit ban ot ruh ïa u sohkew uba sah hadien ba phi la lum .

translation.en: And he slew the burnt offering  ; and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled round about upon the altar .
translation.kha: U pynïap ïa u mrad ïa uba la wanlam na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang jong u hi . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wanrah ïa ka snam , bad u theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .

Haba u Pilat u la ïohi ba kam donkam ban pynjlan , hynrei ba pynmih kan pynban ka jingkhynwin , u la shim khyndiat ka um , u la thet ïa la ki kti ha khmat u , paidbah bad u la ong , Ngam don na jingkitkhlieh ka bynta ka jingïap jong une u briew ! Kane ka dei jingleh ka jong phi !
translation.en: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing , but that rather a tumult was made , he took water , and washed his hands before the multitude , saying , I am innocent of the blood of this just person : see ye to it .

translation.kha: Jonathan um la ïohsngew ba u kpa jong u u la maham jur ïa ki rangbah ka jingtim ; u la kner da u dieng ba rah , pynngam u ha ka rewngap , bad u bam khyndiat ka ngap . Hangta hi u la sngew ïohbor .
translation.en: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath : wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand , and dipped it in an honeycomb , and put his hand to his mouth  ; and his eyes were enlightened .

translation.kha: Ki paid Judah lynñiar la tur ïaleh ïa dik Jerusalem bad ( kurup ïa ka . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka bad ki wiang ding ïa nemsniew nongbah Ba
translation.en: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem , and had taken it , and smitten it with the edge of the sword , and set the city on fire .
I write not these things to shame you , but as my beloved sons I warn you .
translation.kha: Nga thoh ïa kane sha phi , ym namar ba nga kwah ban pynlehrain ïa phi , hynrei ban sneng ïa phi kum ki khun ba-ieit jong nga .

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Neither hath this man sinned , nor his parents : but that the works of God should be made manifest in him .

But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely , and shall be quiet from fear of evil .
translation.kha: Hynrei jar uba shahshkor ïa nga un shongsuk kynjai . Un lait na ki jingma khlem sheptieng ïa kaba sniew .
Kin pynjot ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah jong pha bad kin pynpra marbud ki kut jong pha palat Nangta ngan sar lut khoit ïa ki pui pui bad jingïaleh ieh sa tang ïa u mawsiang .
translation.en: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre , and break down her towers : I will also scrape her dust from her , and make her like the top of a rock .

translation.kha: U Moses u long uta uba shah la kyntait da ki paid Israel . Uei ‘ uba la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar bad nongbishar u halor jong ngi ?’ ki la kylli . U long ma u , uba U Blei u la phah ban synshar ïa ki briew bad pyllaitluid ban ïa ki da ka jingïarap jong u angel uba mihpaw la ha u ha ka bniap kaba mehding .
translation.en: This Moses whom they refused , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge ? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush .
In the law it is written , With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people ; and yet for all that will they not hear me , saith the Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid la thoh :  Da ki briew kiba kren ha ki ktien kiba pher ngan kren ha ki briew jong nga , ong U Trai . Ngan kren da ki rmiang shyntur jong ki nongwei , hynrei wat la katta ki briew jong nga kin ym shahshkor ïa nga .
Lada phi leh kumta , kan long kum dawai ka kaba bha , kaba pynkoit ïa ki jingmong jong phi pynjem bad ïa ki jingpang jong phi .
translation.en: It shall be health to thy navel , and marrow to thy bones .
And it came to pass on the morrow , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa .
translation.kha: Shi sngi hadien ka thma ki Philistia ki leit ban lute na ki metïap , ki lap ïa ki metïap jong u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u lai ngut ba ki thiah ïap ha Lum Gilboa .

translation.en: But thus shall ye deal with them  ; ye shall destroy their altars , and break down their images , and cut down their groves , and burn their graven images with fire .
translation.kha: Kumta , pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , pynpait pharia ïa ki rishot mawkyntang jong ki , mait ïa ki dak ka blei Asherah jong ki , bad thang ïa ki bleithaw jong ki .

translation.en: And thou shalt say , I will go up to the land of unwalled villages  ; I will go to them that are at rest , that dwell safely , all of them dwelling without walls , and having neither bars nor gates ,
translation.kha: Men sa rai ban leit hiarthma ïa ka ri ka bym don jingïarap ha kaba ki briew ki ïashongsuk shongshngain ha ki shnong kiba khlem ker kynroh bad ki bym don jingker .

translation.en: But our God is in the heavens : he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased .
translation.kha: U Blei jong ngi u don ha bneng ; u leh ïa kano kano kaba u mon .

translation.en: Lo , when the wall is fallen , shall it not be said unto you , Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it ?
translation.kha: Ka kynroh kan khyllem , bad uwei uwei baroh un kylli ïa phi kaba bha aïu ka la long da ka jingpushara lieh .

translation.en: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword  ; all these were men of valour .
translation.kha: Baroh ki Benjamin kiba shah pynïap ha kata ka sngi ki long arphew san hajar ngut — baroh na ki , ki dei ki shipai bashlur .

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , That ye shall weep and lament , but the world shall rejoice : and ye shall be sorrowful , but your sorrow shall be turned into joy .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phin ïam bad phin ïamkthang , hynrei , ka pyrthei kan shadkmen ; phin ïasngewsih , hynrei ka jingsngewsih jong phi kan kylla sha ka jingkmen .

translation.en: I will surely consume them , saith the  Lord  : there shall be no grapes on the vine , nor figs on the fig tree , and the leaf shall fade  ; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them .
translation.kha: Nga la kwah ban lumlang ïa ki briew jong nga , kumba u briew u lumlang ïa ka jingot jong u ; hynrei ki long kum u dieng sohwaiñ khlem ki sohwaiñ , kum u diengsoh Dumbur khlem ki soh Dumbur ; wat ki sla ki la jlop . Namar kata , nga la shah ïa kiba nabar ban shim noh ïa ka ri .
Mynta nga la tei ïa ka Templ kaba jingïapan na ka bynta jong me , ka dab na ka bynta jong me ba Ishar shong junom la junom khathynñiew
translation.en: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in , a settled place for thee to abide in for ever .

And ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; thirteen young bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year  ; they shall be without blemish :
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi kaba nyngkong , ai ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : khatlai tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , baroh ki dei ban long ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: After this I beheld , and lo another , like a leopard , which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl  ; the beast had also four heads  ; and dominion was given to it .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang ap khmih , sa uwei pat u mradkhlaw u la mihpaw . U syriem kum u  labasa , hynrei ha ka met jong u la don saw tylli ki thapniang , kum ki thapniang jong ka sim , bad u don saw tylli ki khlieh . U don ka dur kum uba don ka bor .

translation.en: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again , and said , Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth .
translation.kha: Nangta kata ka sur ïa kaba nga la ïohsngew kaba kren na bneng ka la kren biang ha nga , ka da ong ,  To leit bad shim ïa ka kot kli kaba la plied kaba don ha ka kti jong u angel uba ïeng halor kata ka duriaw bad halor ka khyndew .

translation.en: And he walked in the way of Asa his father , and departed not from it , doing that which was right in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kum u kpa jong u , u Asa , ha shuwa jong u , u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei ha khmat U  Trai  ;
U Amos meinah! ong , U Trai u kyrhuh na u lum Seïon basbun Ka sur jingtiengburom u ka tied kum u pyrthat na Jerusalem . Ki jaka phlang jingïaphiah tyrkhong , byrni u phlang ha Lum Karmel u ïapstai .
translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  will roar from Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem  ; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn , and the top of Carmel shall wither .
After these things Paul departed from Athens , and came to Corinth  ;
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Paul u la mihnoh na Athens bad u la leit sha Korinth .

translation.en: O praise the  Lord  , all ye nations : praise him , all ye people .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki hima baroh ! A to ïaroh ïa u , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh !

translation.en: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing : but the honour of kings is to search out a matter .
translation.kha: Ngi burom ïa U Blei namar kaei kaba u la buhrieh ; ngi burom ïa ki syiem ïa kaei kaba ki batai .
Lada U Trai u la sngewbha ïa ngi , un Hepher ïa ngi shata bad ai ha ngi ïa kata Ïing ri kaba tuid da ka dud jingring ka ngap .
translation.en: If the  Lord  delight in us , then he will bring us into this land , and give it us  ; a land which floweth with milk and honey .

Then they came near , and spake before the king concerning the king s decree  ; Hast thou not signed a decree , that every man that shall ask a petition of any God or man within thirty days , save of thee , O king , shall be cast into the den of lions ? The king answered and said , The thing is true , according to the law of the Medes and Persians , which altereth not .
translation.kha: baroh na ki , ki la ïaleit lang sha u syiem ban mudui ïa u Daniel . Ki la ong ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi la soi ïa ka hukum ba na ka bynta ki laiphew sngi kiba bud ïa uno uno uba kyrpad ïa kano kano na uno uno u blei lane na uno uno u briew lait tang na phi , yn bret ïa u hapoh ka thliew ba-dap da ki sing .  U syiem u la jubab ,  Ho-oid , ka hukum kaba pyrkhing , ka aiñ jong ki Mid bad ki Persia , ka bym lah ban pynkylla .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  When I sent you without purse , and scrip , and shoes , lacked ye any thing ?  And they said , Nothing .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki synran jong u ,  Haba nga la phah noh ïa phi ha kato ka por khlem ka pla pisa , ka pla , lane ki juti , hato phi ïaduna ei ei ?   Ym duna wat kawei ruh ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: And Isaac said unto Jacob , Come near , I pray thee , that I may feel thee , my son , whether thou be my very son Esau or not .
translation.kha: U Isaak u ong ïa u Jakob ,  Sngewbha wan kham hajan , ba ngan da ïohktah ïa phi . Hato phi dei shisha u Iso ?
to ieh ïa ka Sadok jong Barak hangta ha khmat jong ka duwan , khie Timaïos shisyndon bad ïasuk bad la u para , bad nangta sa wan pat bad ai ‘Phim ka jingai Hapdeng Hanan sha U Blei .
translation.en: Leave there thy gift before the altar , and go thy way  ; first be reconciled to thy brother , and then come and offer thy gift .
Is not this it in which my lord drinketh , and whereby indeed he divineth ? ye have done evil in so doing .
translation.kha: Balei phi tuh ïa ka khuri rupa u kynrad jong nga ? Ka dei kaba u ju pyndonkam ban dih na ka , kaba u ju pyndonkam ha ka kheiñ ka bishar ? Phi la leh ïa ka kam kaba shyrkhei .’

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the letter came to them , that they took the king s sons , and slew seventy persons , and put their heads in baskets , and sent him them to Jezreel .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohpdiang ïa ka shithi jong u Jehu , ki nongïalam jong ka Samaria ki la pynïap ïa baroh ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab , ki buh ïa ki khlieh jong ki ha ki shang , bad ki la phah ïa ki sha u Jehu ha Jesreel .
( Kito kiba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ki dei u Sabad , u khun jong ka nong Ammon kaba kyrteng ka Shimeath , bad u , Jehosabad khun u ka jong nong Moab kaba kyrteng ka Shimrith ) .
translation.en: And these are they that conspired against him  ; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess , and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess .
And the name of Saul s wife was Ahinoam , the daughter of Ahimaaz : and the name of the captain of his host was Abner , the son of Ner , Saul s uncle .
translation.kha: Ka tnga jong u ka dei ka Ahinoam , ka khun jong u Ahimaas ; u rangbah ai hukum ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u , u dei u Abner , u bakha jong u , u khun jong u Ner u kñi jong u .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , that at what time the chest was brought unto the king s office by the hand of the Levites , and when they saw that there was much money , the king s scribe and the high priest s officer came and emptied the chest , and took it , and carried it to his place again . Thus they did day by day , and gathered money in abundance .
translation.kha: Man ka sngi ki Lebi ki leit rah ïa kata ka synduk sha u nongpynïaidkam u syiem , uba dei peit ïa ka . Ha man ba ka dap , u sekretari syiem bad u nongmihkhmat ïa u Rangbah Lyngdoh ki sei shabar ïa ka pisa bad ki leit buh biang ïa ka synduk ha ka jaka jong ka . Bad kumta ki la ïohlum shibun ka pisa .

translation.en: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes , I considered , and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih bniah shapoh bad nga la ïohi ïa ki jingri bad ki mradkhlaw , ki kynja bapar , bad ki sim khlaw .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , I have seen this people , and , behold , it is a stiffnecked people :
translation.kha: Nga tip haduh katno kine ki briew ki long kiba mutlop .

translation.en: They pluck the fatherless from the breast , and take a pledge of the poor .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki pynlong mraw ïa ki khunswet ba dang rit bad ki shim ïa ki khun jong u briew uba duk kum ka jingsiew ïa ki ram .
Phim ithuh ïa u , nga ithuh u , namar nga wan na u u la ïa .
translation.en: But I know him : for I am from him , and he hath sent me .
The ark of the testimony , and the staves thereof , and the mercy seat ,
translation.kha: ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kaba don ki mawlyngkniap , ïa ki jingbah bad ïa ka jingtap jong ka ;
Kito kiba don ki mawkordor basngewtynnat la ai ïa ki patlun ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ , kaba la kli Bigthana u Jehiel jong ka lbak Lebi jong bynda Gershon .
translation.en: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the  Lord  , by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite .

translation.kha: U bthah ruh ïa ki ban ong ha u , Phi dei u ba-ha-ïing jong nga . Naduh nga buh ïa phi ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai ha ka jaka jong u Joab . To U un shoh ïap ïa nga lada leh kumta !
translation.en: And say ye to Amasa , Art thou not of my bone , and of my flesh ? God do so to me , and more also , if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab .

translation.kha: ka Rekem ka , Irpeel , ka Taralah ,
translation.en: And Rekem , and Irpeel , and Taralah ,
He that justifieth the wicked , and he that condemneth the just , even they both are abomination to the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kaba pynrem ïa kiba lui lui lane kaba pynksan ïa ki bymman — baroh ar ki long ka jingijli ha U  Trai .
U u Jehoïakhin la don khatphra snem ka rta mynba u u long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar la tang lai bnai bad shiphew sngi ha Jerusalem . U ruh u leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem : and he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.kha: ‘ jingtim Ka U Blei kan ha hap uta u briew uba pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano ka tnga u kpa jong u .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang ‘ , Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his father s wife  ; because he uncovereth his father s skirt . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ba kata u nangroi 43 la phet , ma u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki :13 ka jingmut jong ki , bad ki la batista , nongkyllan la leh ïingjaiñ ? Ngi la shah ïa ki khylliap ba Bashatei phet noh , bad ngi la ïapbriew ïa ki kum Elsabad Ïano jong ngi !
translation.en: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled : and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people , and they said , Why have we done this , that we have let Israel go from serving us ?
Then said Jesus ,  Let her alone : against the day of my burying hath she kept this .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Wat pynwit ïa ka ! To ai ba kan buh ïa kaei kaba ka don na ka bynta ka sngi ban tep jong nga .

translation.en: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long , twelve broad , square in the four squares thereof .
translation.kha: Ka bynta kaba halor jong ka duwan ka long sawdong , hynriew mitar ha kawei pa kawei ka liang .
U kyntait ïa U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong u , bad um shym la kohnguh ïa hukum U Trai .
translation.en: And he forsook the  Lord  God of his fathers , and walked not in the way of the  Lord .
And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , after the abominations of the heathen , whom the  Lord  cast out before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki jaitbynriew kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki tur shaphrang , U Manasseh u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And others save with fear , pulling them out of the fire  ; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh .
translation.kha: to pyllait im ïa kiwei , da kaba knieh kynthet ïa ki na ka ding ; bad ïa kiwei pat , to isynei da ka jingsheptieng , hynrei to da isih ïa ki jaiñphong jong ki hi , kiba la bit tngit da ki jingkwah brai bapop .
Katto katne ki rangbah na Jerikho ki la leit sha u Elisha , bad ki ong , Kumba phi tip , ko kynrad , kane ka dei ka nongbah kaba itynnat hynrei , ka um ka sniew bad wanrah ka ki khun jinghap .
translation.en: And the men of the city said unto Elisha , Behold , I pray thee , the situation of this city is pleasant , as my lord seeth : but the water is naught , and the ground barren .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la pynduna ïa ka jingjlan sping kita ki sngi ; shajrong um shym la leh kumta , yn Jakob don u ban lait im . Hynrei , na ka bynta ki briew ba la jied jong u , u la pynduna ïa jingpyndonburom ki sngi .
translation.en: And except that the Lord had shortened those days , no flesh should be saved : but for the elect s sake , whom he hath chosen , he hath shortened the days .

translation.kha: Ka dang pynstad shuh sa kawei pat . ba-don kynmaw ïa kaei kaba jingïam Joab u la Bisiothaïah ïa nga da kaba pynïap pynkiew ki ar ngut shla Daberath ai hukum jong ki shipai Israel diengphasi Sharuhen Abner Kut u khun jong u Ner bad puk Amasa , u khun jong u Jether . Me kynmaw kumno u la pynïap ïa ki ha ka por suk umbiah kum ka jingpynhiarkput ïa pynbiang jingpynïap kaba ki la leh Eliada ka por thma ïa-peiñ U la pynïap ïa ki rangbah ksuit lui , bad mynta saihon Shimrith ka jingkitkhlieh ïa kaei kaba puid la leh , bad nga la shah jynjar na ka bynta kata .
translation.en: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me , and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel , unto Abner the son of Ner , and unto Amasa the son of Jether , whom he slew , and shed the blood of war in peace , and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins , and in his shoes that were on his feet .

translation.kha: Kita ki nongbishar kin tohkit bniah ïa kata ka mokotduma ; bad uta lada u briew u la mudui lamler ,
translation.en: And the judges shall make diligent inquisition : and , behold , if the witness be a false witness , and hath testified falsely against his brother  ;

translation.kha: U Judas , Thoh nongshetkylla , u la kren , Da Sergius , Shimrith Nonghikai , mem shym mut ïa nga ? Helkath la kylli synrang dukan pyrkhing u la jubab , Me ong kumta .
translation.en: Then Judas , which betrayed him , answered and said , Master , is it I ? He said unto him ,  Thou hast said .

translation.kha: Bud ïa U Trai bad tiengburom ïa u ; kohnguh khraw u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong Makhpelah thoin mane ïa u bad ïaineh ha u .
translation.en: Ye shall walk after the  Lord  your God , and fear him , and keep his commandments , and obey his voice , and ye shall serve him , and cleave unto him .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingïapher kaba kdar hapdeng ki khun U Blei ki khun Soitan : Uno u bym ïa kaei kaba dei lane u bym ieit la u hynmen u para um long khun U Blei .
translation.en: In this the children of God are manifest , and the children of the devil : whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God , neither he that loveth not his brother .

translation.kha: ka sha U , namar u long ; ka jingieit u ka long .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever .
All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim , which is the salt sea .
translation.kha: Kine ki san ngut ki syiem ki la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad ki la ïasoh lang kum kawei ka kynhun shipai ha ka Them Siddim , kaba long mynta ka Duriaw Baïap .
Men ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang jong kiba ïabah banbeiñ bad jong ki khunswet ; men bishar da kaba sngewlem ïa ki ; ba kumta ki briew Gath ym pynjia jingshyrkhei shuh .
translation.en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed , that the man of the earth may no more oppress .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ha ka suiñbneng ïa kawei pat ka jingïohi kaba maïan , kaba khraw bad kaba iphylla . La don hynñiew ki angel lem bad hynñiew tylli ki khlam , long kiba khatduh , namar ki long ki jingpynpaw khatduh jong ka jingbitar U Blei
translation.en: And I saw another sign in heaven , great and marvellous , seven angels having the seven last plagues  ; for in them is filled up the wrath of God .
And Edom shall be a possession , Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies  ; and Israel shall do valiantly .
translation.kha: Un jop ïa ki nongshun jong u ha Edom , Bad un pynlong ïa ka ri jong ki ka jingïohkynti jong u , Katba ki Israel kin ïai jop .

Kumta u syiem Mesha la baklang ïa jingpynnang tur shipai aiwai kiba syngkien hapoh ki nongai hukum jong Ben-ammi distrik , kiba Tiberios jingsaphred laiphew ar ngut baroh . Nangta lorni la ronsing ïa ka kynhun ainguh Israel , kaba don hynñiew hajar ngut kyntoit rangbah .
translation.en: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces , and they were two hundred and thirty two : and after them he numbered all the people , even all the children of Israel , being seven thousand .

translation.kha: Nga la sheptieng ïa ka jingbitar shla U Trai , naba u la bitar lep kat haduh ba u la kloi wat ban pynjot ïa phi ryngkew hynrei sa shisien U Trai u la shahshkor ïa nga .
translation.en: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure , wherewith the  Lord  was wroth against you to destroy you . But the  Lord  hearkened unto me at that time also .

translation.kha: Asaïah ka i long Badno myntoi ïa shyllangmat ban Nahash , te ki lah ka ïaleit ryngkat bad nga .
translation.en: And if it be meet that I go also , they shall go with me .

translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong : saiñpyrkhat briew baroh ki long kum jemnud phlang , jingpyniwbih ka burom ryngkat ki jingshemphang jingkhluit ki tiewkhlaw . U phlang u dujok noh , bad ki Ïateh ki tlor noh ,
translation.en: For all flesh is as grass , and all the glory of man as the flower of grass . The grass withereth , and the flower thereof falleth away :
They hate him that rebuketh in the gate , and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly .
translation.kha: Phi ki briew phi isih ïa uta uba pyrshah ïa ka jingbymhok bad kren ïa ka jingshisha baroh ha ka ïingbishar .

translation.en: And he hath cast the lot for them , and his hand hath divided it unto them by line : they shall possess it for ever , from generation to generation shall they dwell therein .
translation.kha: U dei U  Trai  u ban ïasam ïa ka ri hapdeng jong ki bad ai hapdeng jong ki ban ïa-ïoh bynta lang . Kin ïa-im ha ka ri na kawei ka rta sha kawei pat , bad kan long ka jong ki junom .
Nga long u paralok jong kupar baroh kiba pynsngaid jingsyiad me , Kyntang baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translation.en: I am a companion of all them that fear thee , and of them that keep thy precepts .
My son , despise not the chastening of the  Lord   ; neither be weary of his correction :
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , haba U  Trai  u pynbeit ïa phi , da shahshkor bha , bad shim ïa ka kum ka jingmaham .

translation.en: And the  Lord  smelled a sweet savour  ; and the  Lord  said in his heart , I will not again curse the ground any more for man s sake  ; for the imagination of man s heart is evil from his youth  ; neither will I again smite any more every thing living , as I have done .
translation.kha: Ka jingiw jong ka jingkñia ainguh ka la pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , bad U la ong ha lade ,  Lano lano ruh ngan ym buh ïa ka pyrthei hapoh ka jingtim namar kaei kaba ki briew ki leh ; nga tip ba naduh ba ki dang samla , ki jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki long kiba sniew . translation.en: And she arose , and bowed herself on her face to the earth , and said , Behold , let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord .
translation.kha: Ka Abigail ka dem ngon ha khyndew bad ka ong ,  Nga long ka shakri jong u , kaba kloi ban sait ïa ki kjat jong ki shakri jong u .

translation.en: And God stirred him up another adversary , Rezon the son of Eliadah , which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah :

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when he was returned , having received the kingdom , then he commanded these servants to be called unto him , to whom he had given the money , that he might know how much every man had gained by trading .

And he said , Is not he rightly named Jacob ? for he hath supplanted me these two times : he took away my birthright  ; and , behold , now he hath taken away my blessing . And he said , Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me ?
translation.kha: U Iso u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka sien kaba ar ba u la shet shukor ïa nga . Kam long kaba phylla ba ka kyrteng jong u ka dei u Jakob . U la shim noh ïa ki hok ka jinglong khun nyngkong jong nga , bad mynta pat u la shim sa ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong nga . Hato phim shym la tyngkai ka jingkyrkhu ïa nga ?
Nga ai hukum ban leh jinglehniam ka jong ka jingpynkhuid ïa ki kamra bad ïa ki tiar ki tar ka Templ , jingkñia jingbam , bad ki ban jingiwbih buh pat hangta .
translation.en: Then I commanded , and they cleansed the chambers : and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God , with the meat offering and the frankincense .

translation.en: And I saw in a vision  ; and it came to pass , when I saw , that I was at Shushan in the palace , which is in the province of Elam  ; and I saw in a vision , and I was by the river of Ulai .
Then washed I thee with water  ; yea , I thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee , and I anointed thee with oil .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa ka um bad sait ïa ka snam na pha . Nga kyllan umphniang Olib halor ka sniehdoh jong pha .
Lada phi ieit tang ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi , balei phi dei ban ïohpdiang ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki ieit ïa kito ieit ïa ki !
translation.en: For if ye love them which love you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also love those that love them .

translation.kha: Mar kumta u Saul Naphtuh kyllon Mynba bad u thiah lytar ha pynjanai , ba u sheptieng eh pynjyrsieh kaei kaba u Samuel u la ong . U khrai shoh tlot ngai , namar :5 ïatim shym la bam ei ei doh shi Ram bad baroh shi miet .
translation.en: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth , and was sore afraid , because of the words of Samuel : and there was no strength in him  ; for he had eaten no bread all the day , nor all the night .

And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the  Lord  , they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets , and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals , to praise the  Lord  , after the ordinance of David king of Israel .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah ki la sdang ban tei ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ , ki lyngdoh ha ki jingriam jong ki , ki ïeng ha la ki jaka bad ki turoi ha ki kti jong ki , bad ki Lebi jong ka kur Asaph ki ïeng hangta ryngkat bad ki shakuriaw . Ki ïaroh ïa U  Trai  kat kum ki jingbthah ba la ai pateng naduh ka por u syiem Dabid .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses went out unto the tabernacle , that all the people rose up , and stood every man at his tent door , and looked after Moses , until he was gone into the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Man ka por ba u Moses u leit shata , ki paidbah ki ïeng ha ki jingkhang jong ki ïingjaiñ jong ki bad ki ïa-peit ïa u Moses haduh ba un da rung shapoh .
Hadien u lumlang ïa ka kynhun ki riewmadan , ki bad pynbor ïa ka mon ki jong ha Rehoboam u u khun jong u Solomon , uba dang khynnah eh bad ba dang lung ka jingtbit ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: And there are gathered unto him vain men , the children of Belial , and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon , when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted , and could not withstand them .

translation.en: The  Lord  made not this covenant with our fathers , but with us , even us , who are all of us here alive this day .
And all wept , and bewailed her : but he said ,  Weep not  ; she is not dead , but sleepeth .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba don hangta ki la ïam bad ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka khynnah . U Jisu u la ong ,  Wat ïam ; ka khynnah kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !

translation.en: And they cried aloud , and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets , till the blood gushed out upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta ki nongïathuhlypa ki la duwai kham jam bad ki la ot ïa lade da ki tari bad ki waitsum , kat kum ki rukom lehniam jong ki , haduh ba ka snam ka la tuid .
Hadien nga ba la wallam ïa phi na ki ri sha kiba la pynsakma ïa phi bad lumlang nga ïa phi , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingkñia kiba phi thang , bad jaitbynriew ki kin ïohi ba nga long uba khuid .
translation.en: I will accept you with your sweet savour , when I bring you out from the people , and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered  ; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen .

translation.kha: pynïap Joshua ïam ki rangbah bashapoh ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa ki , 11 la katto katne ki ïohlad jongngi Jehukal jaka lait im hapoh ki kynroh shnong bad ba ki khlem shah pynïap .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter , till they were consumed , that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities .
It hath pleased them verily ; and their debtors they are . For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things , their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things .
translation.kha: Kata ka jingïakut ka la long ka jong ki hi ; hynrei ha ka jingshisha , ki la don ïa ka jingsngew kit ram ban ïarap ïa ki . Namar ki Jiw ki la ïasam bynta lem ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynsiem jong ki bad ki Jentil , ki Jentil ki dei ban pyndonkam ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba ki don ban ïarap ïa ki Jiw .

translation.en: And saying , Lord , my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy , grievously tormented .

For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you : for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba shoh ïa phi u shoh ïa uta uba kordor eh ha nga .  Kumta U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa nga lem bad kane ka khubor ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba la lute ïa ki briew jong u :

Mynta ong ïa ki paidbah , ‘ Pynkhuid ïa lade na ka bynta lashai ; bad phin sa ïoh doh ban ka bam . U Trai u la ïohsngew ba phi khñium ïakren bad ong ba phi mutdur ba phi don khyndiat ka doh , bad ba phi kham ïoh bam bha ha Ijipt . Te mynta U Trai un ai ka doh ba phin bam , bad phi dei ban bam ïa ka .
translation.en: And say thou unto the people , Sanctify yourselves against to morrow , and ye shall eat flesh : for ye have wept in the ears of the  Lord  , saying , Who shall give us flesh to eat ? for it was well with us in Egypt : therefore the  Lord  will give you flesh , and ye shall eat .

translation.kha: Mynta to , , ïa kaei kaba ma nga , Trai Nongsynshar , ong . Da kaba kohnguh ki aiñ jong nga ne sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga , pynmih kham bun ïa kito ki jaitbynriew don sawdong jong pha , pha la shu bud tynneng ki rukom leh jong kiwei ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you , and have not walked in my statutes , neither have kept my judgments , neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you  ;

translation.en: Yet it came to pass , when the children of Israel were waxen strong , that they put the Canaanites to tribute  ; but did not utterly drive them out .

translation.en: And he brought them before the king of Moab : and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ka kmie ha u syiem Moab , bad ki la sah hangta katba u Dabid u dang rieh ha ka krem .

translation.en: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening .
translation.kha: Nangta ki briew ki mih shabar ban trei ïa ki kam jong ki bad ki trei haduh ynda la janmiet .

translation.en: Also the sons of the stranger , that join themselves to the  Lord  , to serve him , and to love the name of the  Lord  , to be his servants , every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it , and taketh hold of my covenant  ;
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u ong ha kito ki nongwei kiba la pynïasoh bad ki briew jong u , kiba ieit ïa u bad kiba shakri ïa u , kiba sumar ïa ka Sabbaton bad kiba batskhem ïa ka jutang jong u .

translation.en: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp  ; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head , and let all the congregation stone him .

translation.en: And Manoah arose , and went after his wife , and came to the man , and said unto him , Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman ? And he said , I am .

translation.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven ? for they all had her .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha ka sngi ha kaba kiba ïap kin mihpat , kan long ka tnga jongno ? Ma ki baroh ki la shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses sat to judge the people : and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening .
Woe to the rebellious children , saith the  Lord  , that take counsel , but not of me  ; and that cover with a covering , but not of my spirit , that they may add sin to sin :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren :  Kito kiba synshar ïa ka Judah kin jot noh namar ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ki bud ïa ki jingthmu kiba ngam shym la shna , bad ki soi ïa ki jingïateh kular pyrshah ïa ka mon jong nga , da kaba kynton kawei ka pop halor kawei pat .

translation.en: Not to all the people , but unto witnesses chosen before of God , even to us , who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead .
translation.kha: ym ha baroh , hynrei tang ha ki sakhi kiba U Blei u la lah jied , kata , ha ngi kiba la ïabam bad ïadih bad u hadien ba u la mihpat na ka jingïap .
Ko khun briew u , u la ong , to kren pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . To ong ha u kumno ba ma u bad baroh kiba ha ka ri Ijipt kin pynshitom shah .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and prophesy against him , and against all Egypt :

translation.en: And it came to pass in process of time , that the king of Egypt died : and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage , and they cried , and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage .
And as Peter was coming in , Cornelius met him , and fell down at his feet , and worshipped him .
translation.kha: Katba u Petros u dang rung , u Kornelios u la leit kynduh ïa u , u la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u , bad u la nguh dem ha khmat jong u .

Ko khun u kumto , nur la ong , nga la pynkheiñ mrad tukri krong ñiewburom jong u syiem shahïap Ijipt . Ym don ba Mihnoh sop spaiñ Ïasam ka Meshesabel pynsdien Synrum ka sai Hammolekheth kan ïohkhiah bad ban khlaiñ kat ban lah ban jinglehniam biang ïa ka waitlam .
translation.en: Son of man , I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt  ; and , lo , it shall not be bound up to be healed , to put a roller to bind it , to make it strong to hold the sword .
They also do no iniquity : they walk in his ways .
translation.kha: Ki bym ju leh ïa ka bymdei ; ki ïaid ha ki lynti U  Trai .

translation.en: Saying , Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord : peace in heaven , and glory in the highest .
translation.kha: U Blei u kyrkhu ïa u syiem uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! Ka jingsuk ha ki bneng bad ka burom ïa U Blei !

translation.en: And when they had preached the word in Perga , they went down into Attalia :
