translation.en: And it repented the  Lord  that he had made man on the earth , and it grieved him at his heart .
translation.kha: u la sngewsih ba u lah thaw bad buh ïa ki ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: He wrote also letters to rail on the  Lord  God of Israel , and to speak against him , saying , As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand , so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand .
translation.kha: Ka shithi kaba u patsha u la thoh ka kren pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel . Ka ong ,  Ki blei jong ki hima kim shym lah ban pyllait ïa ki briew jong ki na ka bor jong nga , bad da lei lei U Blei jong u Hesekaïah un ym lah ban pyllait im ïa la ki briew na nga .

translation.en: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me , but walk contrary unto me  ;
translation.kha: Lada hadien kat kane phim treh ban shahshkor ïa nga bad phi dang ïai pyrshah hi ïa nga ,

translation.en: Reprove not a scorner , lest he hate thee : rebuke a wise man , and he will love thee .
translation.kha: Wat ju pynbeit ïa u briew uba hangamei ; un isih ïa phi na ka bynta kata . Hynrei lada phi pynbeit ïa u briew uba stad , un burom ïa phi .

translation.en: Thy first father hath sinned , and thy teachers have transgressed against me .
translation.kha: U kpa tymmen banyngkong eh jong phi u la leh pop ; ki nongïalam jong phi ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga ,

translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  prolongeth days : but the years of the wicked shall be shortened .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  , bad phin im kham slem . Ki bymman ki ïap shuwa ka por jong ki .

translation.en: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection , neither angel , nor spirit : but the Pharisees confess both .
translation.kha: ( Naba ki Saddusi ki ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap bad ba ym don ki angel lane ki mynsiem ; hynrei ki Pharisi ki ngeit ïa kine baroh lai tylli . )

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Behold , thou shalt sleep with thy fathers  ; and this people will rise up , and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land , whither they go to be among them , and will forsake me , and break my covenant which I have made with them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Shen men sa ïap noh , bad ynda me ïap u paidbah un sa phai noh na nga bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki . Kin kyntait ïa nga bad mane ïa ki blei thala jong kata ka ri sha kaba kin sa leit rung .

translation.en: For Israel hath not been forsaken , nor Judah of his God , of the  Lord  of hosts  ; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh , ngam pat shym la iehnoh ïa ka Israel bad ka Judah , wat la ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

translation.en: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt , as I have punished Jerusalem , by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence :
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa kito kiba shong ha Ijipt , kumba nga pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem — da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad ka jingpang .

translation.en: And all the devils besought him , saying , Send us into the swine , that we may enter into them .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki mynsiem bymkhuid ki la ïakyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Phah ïa ngi ha kitei ki sniang , bad shah ïa ngi ban rung hapoh jong ki .
Ngam Baladan Lemuel Epaphras shim noh ïa katta na ka pyrthei , hynrei nga da kyrpad ba men ri sngewlem ïa Pom na uta u bymman .
translation.en: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world , but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil .

translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa briew na ka ri Ijipt , u da leh ki kambah ki kamphylla ka ri Ijipt ha ka Duriaw Basaw bad haduh sawphew snem ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: He brought them out , after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt , and in the Red sea , and in the wilderness forty years .

translation.kha: U Aleksandar , u kamar-tama u la pyndik eh ïa nga ; U Trai un sa ainong u ïa kat kum ki kam jong u .
translation.en: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil : the Lord reward him according to his works :
Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , and to fear him .
translation.kha: Kumta , leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi : im kat kum ki hukum jong u bad kohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: Is not this David , of whom they sang one to another in dances , saying , Saul slew his thousands , and David his ten thousands ?
translation.kha: Nalorkata , une um dei u Dabid , uta uba ki kynthei ki ïaphawar katba ki dang ïashad , ‘ U Saul u la pynïap da ki hajar , hynrei u Dabid u la pynïap da ki phew hajar ?’

translation.en: Ponder the path of thy feet , and let all thy ways be established .
translation.kha: Da pyrkhat bha aïu phi leh , bad kat kaba phi leh kan long bha .

translation.en: And the priest shall look upon the plague , and shut up it that hath the plague seven days :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bha ïa ka , bad un buh kyrpang ïa kata kaba la bit bthuh haduh hynñiew sngi .
Kiba bun ki nongshukor ki la leit sha ka pyrthei baroh , ki briew ki bym ba pdiang U Jisu Khrist u la wan u kum briew . Kum uta u briew , u long u bad nongshukor u Nongshun jong U Khrist .
translation.en: For many deceivers are entered into the world , who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh . This is a deceiver and an antichrist .
But if ye shew the dream , and the interpretation thereof , ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour : therefore shew me the dream , and the interpretation thereof .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi lah ban ïathuh ha nga ïa baroh ar , ka jingphohsniew bad ïa ka jingmut jong ka , ngan ainong ïa phi da ki jingai sngewbha bad ka jingpyndonburom kaba khraw . Te mynta , ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingphohsniew bad kaei ka jingmut jong ka .

translation.en: The liberal soul shall be made fat : and he that watereth shall be watered also himself .
translation.kha: Long kiba sbun , bad phin manbha . Ïarap ïa kiwei , bad yn ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David , on the west side of Gihon , in the valley , even to the entering in at the fish gate , and compassed about Ophel , and raised it up a very great height , and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Manasseh u tei pynjrong ïa ka kynroh bashabar ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Nongbah u Dabid , na ka tduh jong ka them hajan ka umpohliew Gihon shaphang shatei sha ka Khyrdop Dohkha bad ka jaka jong ka nongbah ba khot ka Ophel . U buh ruh ïa u shipai pynïaidkam ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun ki shipai ha man ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh jong ka Judah .
Kita baroh ar ngut ki la pynlong ka kular bakyntang ïa iwei pat U Dabid u sah Horesh , bad Jonathan leit noh ïing .
translation.en: And they two made a covenant before the  Lord  : and David abode in the wood , and Jonathan went to his house .
Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah s neck , and brake it .
translation.kha: Nangta u Hananaïah u la loit ïa ka lyngkor na u ryndang jong nga , u la pynkheiñ lyngkhot ïa ka ,

translation.en: And he spake also a parable unto them  ;  No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old  ; if otherwise , then both the new maketh a rent , and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi :  Ym don uno uno uba tar ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai ban syrdep ïa ka jaiñkup kaba rim . Lada u leh kumta , un tar ïa ka jaiñ bathymmai , bad kata ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai kan ym ïadei ïa kaba rim .
Kumta lada hima jong u Soitan ka don ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei kawei kumno kan neh ? Phi ba beh noh ïa ki ksuid namar ba Beelsebul u ai ha nga ka bor ban kumta .
translation.en: If Satan also be divided against himself , how shall his kingdom stand ? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub .

translation.kha: Te uta u briew u balamler ïalam Jasper nga lyngba ka khyrdop bashaphang shatei haduh ha khmat ka jingïadih . Katba nga dang khmih , nga la ïohi Mura ïa ka Templ U Trai la pyndap ïasngewsih ka jingshai ba-thaba iahap ka jingdon ryngkat shakuriaw u Kilikia
translation.en: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house : and I looked , and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  filled the house of the  Lord  : and I fell upon my face .
And now , O inhabitants of Jerusalem , and men of Judah , judge , I pray you , betwixt me and my vineyard .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta u paralok jong nga u ong :  Ma phi ki briew kiba shong ha Jerusalem bad Judah , to bishar hapdeng jong nga bad ka bri sohwaiñ jong nga .

U Trai un shoh jingkieng phi da ki tohjaw , kumba u la leh ïa ki jingphaloh baïap . Un pynlong ïa ka met jong phi ban dap Dang ka prum . Yn tap ïingshong phi da ka sarew , bad phin daitbuid , hynrei nongleh ym don jingpynkhiah pynmeh
translation.en: The  Lord  will smite thee with the botch of Egypt , and with the emerods , and with the scab , and with the itch , whereof thou canst not be healed .
And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God , and from his power  ; and no man was able to enter into the temple , till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled .
translation.kha: Ïa ka templ la pyndap da ka tdem na ka burom bad ka bor jong U Blei , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban leit shapoh ka templ tad haduh ba ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam ba la wanrah da ki hynñiew ngut ki angel , ki la poi sha kaba kut .
Haba la pyndep ïa ka jingbishar hok , briew ki kiba bha ki kmen , hynrei ki briew kiba sniew ki sngewsih .
translation.en: It is joy to the just to do judgment : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .

translation.kha: U Jehoïada u jied ar ngut ki tnga na ka bynta u syiem Joash , bad tur Shemesh ïa u Rubi Sargon khun shynrang bad ki khun Ïashong .
translation.en: And Jehoiada took for him two wives  ; and he begat sons and daughters .

And they spake unto him , saying , No  ; but we will bind thee fast , and deliver thee into their hand : but surely we will not kill thee . And they bound him with two new cords , and brought him up from the rock .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , to  ki ong ,  ngin shu teh ïa me bad aiti ïa me ha ki . Ngin ym pynïap ïa me .  Kumta ki khum ïa u da ar tylli ki tyllai thymmai bad ki wanrah ïa u na kata ka krem .

translation.en: And when the Gentiles heard this , they were glad , and glorified the word of the Lord : and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed .
translation.kha: Haba ki Jentil ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la kmen bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka khubor jong U Trai , bad kito ïa kiba la jied na ka bynta ka jingim bymjukut ki la long ki riewngeit .

translation.en: Which things are an allegory : for these are the two covenants ; the one from the mount Sinai , which gendereth to bondage , which is Agar .
translation.kha: Ïa kine kiei kiei lah ban sngewthuh tang kum ka jingringdur : Ki ar ngut ki kynthei ki ïeng ïa ki ar tylli ki jutang ; kawei ïa kaba ki khun la kha ha ka jinglongmraw ka long ka Hagar , bad ka ïeng na ka bynta ka jutang ba la pynlong halor u lum Sinai .

Ïa ka nongbah bad baroh kiba don ha ka dei ban thiaw pynjot ka kum jingainguh ha U Trai . Tang ïa ka Rahab ka nuti bad ïa ka longïing longsem jong ka yn pyllait im , ka namar la pynrieh ïa ki nongsyntiat jong ngi .
translation.en: And the city shall be accursed , even it , and all that are therein , to the  Lord  : only Rahab the harlot shall live , she and all that are with her in the house , because she hid the messengers that we sent .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u long uba hok sngewkynduh namar ngam shym la kohnguh ïa u . To shahshkor ïa nga hynriewspah ko ki briew hangno hangno ; to khmih ïa nga ha ka jingpang Barakel nga Leummim Ki samla shynrang bad kynthei jong nga ki la janai ringmraw noh .
translation.en: Their heart cried unto the Lord , O wall of the daughter of Zion , let tears run down like a river day and night : give thyself no rest  ; let not the apple of thine eye cease .

translation.kha: U la synshar ha halor Hebron ka Judah haduh hynñiew shiteng snem , bad ha Jerusalem halor ki Israel bad Judah baroh haduh laiphew lai snem .
translation.en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months : and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah .

translation.kha: Kam don hangtei sahit bneng . Phim donkam ban da ong , ‘ keiñ u ban leit kiew bad wallam ïa ka shane sha ngi , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïohsngew kohnguh ïa ka ?’
translation.en: It is not in heaven , that thou shouldest say , Who shall go up for us to heaven , and bring it unto us , that we may hear it , and do it ?

And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place , according to the commandment of David , and Asaph , and Heman , and Jeduthun the king s seer  ; and the porters waited at every gate  ; they might not depart from their service  ; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongtem nongput harum na ka kur u Asaph jong ki Lebi ki don ha la ki jaka ba la aiti ha ki da ki jingbthah u Syiem Dabid : u Asaph , u Heman , bad u Jeduthun , u nongïathuhlypa jong u syiem . Ki nongap phira ha ki khyrdop ka Templ kim shym donkam ban mihnoh na ki jaka ba ki ap , namar kiwei pat ki Lebi ki pynkhreh ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: As they went out , behold , they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil .
translation.kha: Katba ki rangbah ki dang ïamih , katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wanlam sha U Jisu ïa u briew u bymnang kren namar ba u shongksuid .
U ong ha u Balak , Tei ïa nga hangne hynñiew tylli duwan ki , bad wallam ïa nga hynñiew tylli ki masi kyrtong bad hynñiew tylli langbrot ki shynrang .
translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Build me here seven altars , and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams .

Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead , and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall . And there was great indignation against Israel : and they departed from him , and returned to their own land .
translation.kha: Kumta u shim ïa u khun nyngkong jong u , uba dei ban long syiem hadien jong u , bad u la tyrwa ïa u halor ka kynroh shnong kum ka jingkñia sha u blei Moab . Ki Israel ki la sngewshyrkhei bad kumta ki la kynran na ka nongbah bad ki la leit phai sha la ka ri .

translation.en: Fear ye not therefore , ye are of more value than many sparrows .
translation.kha: Kumta wat sheptieng , phi kham kor bun shah ban ïa shibun ki sim ïing .

translation.en: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the  Lord  , and all the judgments : and all the people answered with one voice , and said , All the words which the  Lord  hath said will we do .
translation.kha: U Moses u wan ïathuh ha u paidbah ïa ki hukum baroh bad ïa ki aiñ baroh jong U  Trai  , bad ki briew baroh ki ïajubab lang ,  Ïa kita baroh kiba U  Trai  u ong , ngin leh .

baroh lang ki leit sha ka Templ , ba la synran da ki bad ki nongïathuhlypa bad baroh kiwei pat ki briew , kiba riewspah bad baduk kumjuh . jong , u syiem u baroh kawei ïa ka Kitab ka Jutang kaba la shem ha ka Templ .
translation.en: And the king went up into the house of the  Lord  , and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him , and the priests , and the prophets , and all the people , both small and great : and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Katba u ba jingaimynsiem trai im , um shym ïohi bajyrngam ïa shabar syiem ; hynrei u khuslai sat na Matri bynta jong u . U khadar u la sngewsih ba u la thung jing-jngai u Saul kum u syiem Erek Israel .
translation.en: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death : nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul : and the  Lord  repented that he had made Saul king over Israel .
When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days , even an hundred and fourscore days .
translation.kha: Hynriew bnai kynthih , u la pyn-i ïa ki spah jong ka ïingsyiem jong u ha ka jingitynnat bad jingkhraw jong ka .

translation.en: Then saith one of his disciples , Judas Iscariot , Simon s son , which should betray him ,
translation.kha: U Judas Iskariot , uwei na ki synran jong u — uta u ban sa shetkylla ïa u — u la ong ,
Uwei pa u uwei rangbah ha Ai u la leit beh ïa ki Israel , bad ki la iehnoh rynghang ïa ka nongbah , khlem don mano ban mano ïada ïa ka .
translation.en: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth–el , that went not out after Israel : and they left the city open , and pursued after Israel .
That which hath been is now  ; and that which is to be hath already been  ; and God requireth that which is past .
translation.kha: Kaei kaei kaba jia lane kaba lah ban jia ka la lah jia mynshuwa . U Blei u pynlong ïa kajuh ban jia bad ïai jia .

translation.en: And we indeed justly  ; for we receive the due reward of our deeds : but this man hath done nothing amiss .
translation.kha: Ïa ngi , pynban , ka long kaba dei hok , namar ba ngi ïoh ïa kaei kaba ngi dei ban ïoh na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la leh ; hynrei , um shym la leh kano kano ka bym dei .

translation.en: But when Herod s birthday was kept , the daughter of Herodias danced before them , and pleased Herod .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kha jong u Herod , ka khun jong ka Herodias , ka la shad ha khmat jong ka kynhun baroh kawei .

translation.en: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon , and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïam ha Babilon , jong ka jingïam pangnud namar ka jingpynjot ha ka ri .

translation.en: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt , being eighteen thousand men .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la nang kham pawnam shuh shuh haba u la wan phai na kaba pynïap khatphra hajar ngut ki nong Edom ha ka Them Mluh .

translation.en: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul , The magistrates have sent to let you go : now therefore depart , and go in peace .
translation.kha: Kumta u nongpeit phatok u la ïathuh ha u Paul ,  Ki rangbah synshar ki la phah ka hukum ban pyllait noh ïa me bad ïa u Silas . Te phi lah ban mihnoh , bad leit ha kaba suk .

U Haba u Trai ïalam ïa la ki briew lyngba ka ri shyiap kaba khluit , kaba tyrkhong , kim shym shahshitom la na ka jingsliang . U la pynlong ïa ka um ban mih na u mawsiang na ka bynta jong ki ; u pynpait ïa u mawsiang bad , ka um ka mih nangta .
translation.en: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts : he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them : he clave the rock also , and the waters gushed out .

translation.kha: ka Ebron , salm Rehob , Artakserksis khyndaiphew , jinghiarpateng ka Kanah , shaduh Sidon .
translation.en: And Hebron , and Rehob , and Hammon , and Kanah , even unto great Zidon  ;
Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned , and which he made Israel sin , by his provocation wherewith he provoked the  Lord  God of Israel to anger .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia namar u Jeroboam u pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , da ki pop kiba u la leh bad u la pynlong ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth , to burn incense unto the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , as we have done , we , and our fathers , our kings , and our princes , in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem : for then had we plenty of victuals , and were well , and saw no evil .
translation.kha: Ngin leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba ngi la ong ban leh . Ngin ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ka blei jong ngi , ka Syiem jong ka Bneng , bad ngin theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ sha ka , kumba ma ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u syiem jong ngi bad ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki la ju leh ha ki shnong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem . Nangta ngi don ka bam kyrhai , ngi manbha , bad ngim ju don jingjynjar .

translation.en: And Jesus went with him  ; and much people followed him , and thronged him .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit bad u . Kumta bun ki briew ki la ïaleit lang bad U Jisu , ki da ïa-thngian sha u na baroh ki liang .

translation.en: And be ready against the third day : for the third day the  Lord  will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad ban long kiba la khreh la shi sngi . Ha kata ka sngi ngan wan hiar ha u Lum Sinai ; ha kaba ki briew baroh kin ïohi ïa nga .

Ma nga , U khim Nongsynshar , nga pynbna ba sohshnong ym pynmutlop uno uno u nongwei bym shym la otsher , uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa nga , un rung ha ka badno jong nga , wat u nongwei uba shong basah bajrong puid paid Israel .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; No stranger , uncircumcised in heart , nor uncircumcised in flesh , shall enter into my sanctuary , of any stranger that is among the children of Israel .
And the priest shall come again the seventh day , and shall look : and , behold , if the plague be spread in the walls of the house  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , un leit biang bad khmih bha ïa kata ka jingbthuh .

Napdeng ki kiba shong ha nongbah ba la pynkhamti ha ki khun u , lane ha ki jaka phlang dei jong kine ki nongbah , la rangbah ba ban sam ïa ka jingbam sha ki baroh ha ka longïing ki lyngdoh bad sha pa uwei don kyrteng ha ka kur ki Lebi .
translation.en: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests , which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities , in every several city , the men that were expressed by name , to give portions to all the males among the priests , and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites .

And the sons of Tola  ; Uzzi , and Rephaiah , and Jeriel , and Jahmai , and Jibsam , and Shemuel , heads of their father s house , to wit , of Tola : they were valiant men of might in their generations  ; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred .
translation.kha: U Tola u don hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ussi , u Rephaïah , u Jeriel , u Jahmai , u Ibsam , bad u Shemuel . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing kiba na ka kur Tola , bad ki dei ruh ki shipai bapawnam . Ha ka por u syiem Dabid , ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki don arphew ar hajar hynriewspah ngut .

translation.en: Let them praise the name of the  Lord  : for he commanded , and they were created .
translation.kha: Ai ba baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ! U shu hukum , bad ïa ki la pynlong ;
Ngam wad ïa ka jingïaroh ki briew .
translation.en: I receive not honour from men .

translation.kha: Nangta pat u shim ïa ka kitab jutang ka ha kaba la thoh ïa ki hukum U Trai bad u pule jam ïa ka ha uta u paidbah ; ki ki ruh ïa-ong , Ïa kita baroh kiba U Trai u la hukum , ngin leh , bad kohnguh ngin .
translation.en: And he took the book of the covenant , and read in the audience of the people : and they said , All that the  Lord  hath said will we do , and be obedient .

translation.kha: Hynrei kine baroh kim long ei ei angkor nga katba nga dang ujuh Jekolaïah jingmut Pashhur ñiar , u Mordekai ba u badei ha ka lut sha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: Yet all this availeth me nothing , so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king s gate .

translation.kha: Te , ynda U Trai U Blei jaiñphong phi u ai ha phi ïa :32 Mawsiang shnong , pynïap lut ïa Nebat pa uwei u jingkah .
translation.en: And when the  Lord  thy God hath delivered it into thine hands , thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword :

translation.kha: ki ki briew ïa khot ki lyngdoh bad ki nongleh myntor bad ki kylli , Ngin leh kumno ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai ? Lada ngi phah biang ïa ka sha ka jaka jong ka da-ei ngin phah ryngkat bad ? ka
translation.en: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners , saying , What shall we do to the ark of the  Lord  ? tell us wherewith we shall send it to his place .

translation.kha: Uwei u shipai Israel uba kyrteng u Sikhri , u ïa-sngewlyngngoh pynïap ïa u sngur u khun jong u syiem Ahas , ïa Maki Asrikam u nongpynïaidkam ha ka ïingsyiem Bashti snieh Shalman u Elkanah Kane uba ha ka kyrdan kaba jingkyntu ïa u syiem .
translation.en: And Zichri , a mighty man of Ephraim , slew Maaseiah the king s son , and Azrikam the governor of the house , and Elkanah that was next to the king .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me ka ri khlaw junom la junom , bad yn ym don uno u ban uno shong shuh ha ki nongbah jong me . Te men sa tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: I will make thee perpetual desolations , and thy cities shall not return : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Uta u shakri u leh kumba la hukum ïa u , bad u leit ïalam jingpyntieng kita shi para sha ka ïing u Joseph .
translation.en: And the man did as Joseph bade  ; and the man brought the men into Joseph s house .
And when he knew it of the centurion , he gave the body to Joseph .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïathuh u rangbah shipai , u Pilat u la ong ïa u Joseph ba u lah ban shim ïa ka met .
Bud ïa ki rukom Hapdeng Markos ki hukum kiba nga ai Eri phi ; da kaba leh kumta hyndai phin ïoh im . Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes , and my judgments : which if a man do , he shall live in them : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta U Trai , to pynkohnguh ïa lade ha ki bor synshar baroh : Ha u Patsha uba long ka bor kaba khlieh ha , tam
translation.en: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord s sake : whether it be to the king , as supreme  ;

translation.kha: U Mordekai u tip shaphang kane bad u ïa ïathuh ka , Esther ka mahadei ; kaba la ïathuh pat ïa u syiem ïa kaei kaba u Mordekai u la shem .
translation.en: And the thing was known to Mordecai , who told it unto Esther the queen  ; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai s name .
And Jehu gathered all the people together , and said unto them , Ahab served Baal a little  ; but Jehu shall serve him much .
translation.kha: U Jehu u khot lang ïa ki briew jong ka Samaria , bad u ong ,  U syiem Ahab u la shakri ïa u blei Baal khyndiat , hynrei nga ngan shakri ïa u kham bun .

Hynrei shym kim la shahshkor kohnguh lane . Pynban , uwei baroh uwei u ïai bteng ban long uba mutlop bad uba sniew u kumba ju long . Nga la hukum ïa ki ban bat ïa ka jutang , hynrei ki la kyntait . Kumta nga la wallam halor jong ki baroh ïa ki jingpynshitom kiba la batai ha ka .
translation.en: Yet they obeyed not , nor inclined their ear , but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart : therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant , which I commanded them to do  ; but they did them not .
For they sleep not , except they have done mischief  ; and their sleep is taken away , unless they cause some to fall .
translation.kha: Ki riewsniew kim nang ïohthiah lymda ki ïoh ban leh ïa ka kam sniew ; ki peitmat sah lymda ki la ïoh pynmynsaw ïano ïano .

translation.en: Ye shall not fear them : for the  Lord  your God he shall fight for you .
translation.kha: Wat tieng ïa ki , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong me un ïaleh na ka bynta jong me .’

translation.en: They reel to and fro , and stagger like a drunken man , and are at their wits  end .
translation.kha: ki jynthut bad ki ïaid sheng sheng kum kiba briew kiba buaid — baroh ka jingtbit jong ki ka la lehnoh-ei .

translation.en: What thing shall I take to witness for thee ? what thing shall I liken to thee , O daughter of Jerusalem ? what shall I equal to thee , that I may comfort thee , O virgin daughter of Zion ? for thy breach is great like the sea : who can heal thee ?
translation.kha: U la phah ïa ka ding nalor , ka ding kaba thang hapoh jong nga . U la buh ka jingriam na ka bynta jong nga bad u la wanrah ïa nga sha khyndew . Nangta u la iehnoh ïa nga bad ieh ïa nga ha ka jingpang baneh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said to Aaron , Go into the wilderness to meet Moses . And he went , and met him in the mount of God , and kissed him .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por U  Trai  u la ong ha u Aaron ,  Khie leit sha ka ri shyiap ban ïakynduh ïa u Moses .  Kumta u leit ban ïakynduh ïa u ha uta u lum bakhuid ; bad haba u ïashem bad u , u doh ïa u .
Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong ngi ïingtrep to pham skhem shkor batskhem ha pynbam jingkordit jingshisha kiba erlangthari la hikai ïa phi kynroh ha ka jingïalap jong ngi bad ha ka shithi jong thlim .
translation.en: Therefore , brethren , stand fast , and hold the traditions which ye have been taught , whether by word , or our epistle .
But as touching the resurrection of the dead , have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God , saying ,
translation.kha: Mynta , ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingmihpat kiba ïap : Hato phim pat ju pule ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ïathuh ha phi ? U la ong ,

U Petros u dang ïeng hangta ban ïa pynsyaid lade . Kumta kiwei pat la ki ong ha u , Hato me ruh mem dei uwei na ki synran jong uta briew u ? Hynrei u Petros u la len ïa kata . Em , ngam dei , u la ong .
translation.en: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself . They said therefore unto him , Art not thou also one of his disciples ? He denied it , and said , I am not .

translation.kha: Kumta ki sop da ki jaiñ byrni sawdong ïa ki jong ki bad ki tyllai sawdong ïa ryndang jong ki , leit sha Ahab ong , U jong u kyrpad phi na ka bynta jingim u . U u jubab , U dang im ? Ka bha shibun ! U long kum uba shi para bad nga !
translation.en: So they girded sackcloth on their loins , and put ropes on their heads , and came to the king of Israel , and said , Thy servant Ben–hadad saith , I pray thee , let me live . And he said , Is he yet alive ? he is my brother .

translation.kha: Ka ïakynduh u Pharaoh ka ong ha ka , ïasngewtynnat Kpa une u khunlung bad ri ïa u na ka bynta shongthait nga , bad ngan da siew ïa pynkylluid . Kumta kata ka kynthei ka shim ïa kyrsoi u Katholik , bad ka ri ka Jerusalem’ ïa u .
translation.en: And Pharaoh s daughter said unto her , Take this child away , and nurse it for me , and I will give thee thy wages . And the woman took the child , and nursed it .

translation.kha: ka Siklag , ka Beth Markaboth ka Hasar Susah ,
translation.en: And Ziklag , and Beth–marcaboth , and Hazar–susah ,

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka Hima ki kan long kumne . Shisien la don shiphew ngut ki theisotti kiba la rah la ki sharak bad ki la mih ban ïashem ïa u nongleitkurim
translation.en: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins , which took their lamps , and went forth to meet the bridegroom .
That as sin hath reigned unto death , even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord .
translation.kha: Te kumta , kumba ka pop ka synshar da ka jingïap , kumta ruh ka jingaiei U Blei ka synshar da ka hok , ka ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingim bymjukut lyngba U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi .

Ki ong ha u Kane ka dei ka kabu jong phi ! U Trai u la ïathuh ïa phi ba un buh ïa u nongshun ha ka bor jong phi bad phi lah ban leh ïa u kat kaba phi kwah U Dabid u par sor sor u ot shi na ka jaiñkup u Saul khlem ka jingtip u Saul .

translation.en: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes , and bathe his flesh in water , and afterward come into the camp .

translation.en: There the wicked cease from troubling  ; and there the weary be at rest .

translation.en: All nations before him are as nothing  ; and they are counted to him less than nothing , and vanity .

translation.en: Comfort from knowing that God feels for us when we suffer . —Zechariah 2 :8 .
Then said I , I will not feed you : that that dieth , let it die  ; and that that is to be cut off , let it be cut off  ; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ha ka kynhun langbrot ,  Ngan ym long shuh u nongaplangbrot jong phi . Ai kin ïap kito kiba dei ban ïap . Ai ba yn pynjot kito kiba dei ban shah pynjot . Kito kiba dang sah kin pynjot iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Therefore the princes said unto the king , We beseech thee , let this man be put to death : for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city , and the hands of all the people , in speaking such words unto them : for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people , but the hurt .

translation.en: For the king of the north shall return , and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former , and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches .
And he will be a wild man  ; his hand will be against every man , and every man s hand against him  ; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren .
translation.kha: Hynrei u khun jong pha un im kum ka kada khlaw , un ïaleh pyrshah ïa uwei pa uwei u briew , bad uwei pa uwei u briew un ïaleh pyrshah ïa u . Un shong khlad na la ki kur ki jait baroh .

translation.en: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation ; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life .
translation.kha: Kumta te , kumba da kawei ka pop la pynrem ïa u bynriew baroh , ha kajuh ka rukom kawei ka kam bahok ka pyllait bad ka ai jingim ïa u bynriew baroh .
Hynrei mynta nga pynkhreh ban kyrkhu ïa ki paid ka Jerusalem bad Judah Kumta . wat sheptieng .
translation.en: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah : fear ye not .

translation.kha: Ïa ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong uta u shñiuh men thang hapoh ka nongbah , ynda la dep ka jingkerkut . translation.en: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city , when the days of the siege are fulfilled : and thou shalt take a third part , and smite about it with a knife : and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind  ; and I will draw out a sword after them .

translation.kha: Ka jingthmu jong U Blei ka long ban pyntip ïa jingmaïan ka jong u ha ki briew jong u , ïa kane ka jingmaïan basngewtynnat bad badonburom kaba u don na ka bynta ki briew baroh . Bad ka ka jingmaïan long , ba U Khrist don u hapoh jong phi kaba , mut , ba phin ïoh bynta ha ka burom jong U Blei .
translation.en: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles ; which is Christ in you , the hope of glory :

translation.en: And the Syrians fled before Israel  ; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians , and forty thousand horsemen , and smote Shobach the captain of their host , who died there .
For God hath not given us the spirit of fear ; but of power , and of love , and of a sound mind .
translation.kha: Naba U Mynsiem uba U Blei u la ai ha ngi um pynlong ïa ngi kiba khawpud ; pynban , U Mynsiem jong u , u pyndap ïa ngi da ka bor , ka jingieit , bad ka bor halor lade .

translation.en: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead , and took it , and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it .
translation.kha: Ka kur u Makhir u khun jong u Manasseh ka la hiarthma ïa ka ri Gilead , bad ka la ïohknieh ïa ka , bad beh krad ïa ki Amor kiba don hangta .

translation.en: When they were by the house of Micah , they knew the voice of the young man the Levite : and they turned in thither , and said unto him , Who brought thee hither ? and what makest thou in this place ? and what hast thou here ?
translation.kha: Katba ki dang don hangta , ki sngewthuh ïa ka sur kren jong u samla Lebi , kumta ki leit sha u bad ki kylli ,  Me leh aïu hangne ? Mano ba wallam ïa me shane ?

translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  What did Moses command you ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab da ka jingkylli ,  Kaei kaba ka hukum u Moses ka ai ha phi ?

translation.en: Then Abigail made haste , and took two hundred loaves , and two bottles of wine , and five sheep ready dressed , and five measures of parched corn , and an hundred clusters of raisins , and two hundred cakes of figs , and laid them on asses .
translation.kha: Ka Abigail ka la pynstet ban lum arspah tylli ki kpu , ar tylli ki pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ , san tylli ki langbrot kiba la syang , khathynñiew kilo u kew ba la sdieh ; shispah tylli ki rynjup soh kismis , bad arspah tylli ki thup soh Dumbur tyrkhong , bad ka pynkit ïa ki halor ki kada .
Um haba sheptieng ïohpdiang u ïa ka khubor kaba sniew ; ka jingngeit jong u ka long kaba khlaiñ , bad u shaniah ha U Trai .
translation.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings : his heart is fixed , trusting in the  Lord .
This is the service of the families of the Gershonites , to serve , and for burdens :
translation.kha: ïa ki pyrda jong ka phyllaw kaba long baroh sawdong ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa ka duwan , bad ïa ka pyrda ïa ka jingkhang jong ka phyllaw . Kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad kine ki tiar ki tar .
Men ym sheptieng na ki jingma mynmiet ne Shan ki jingtur ïaleh ha ka por mynsngi ,
translation.en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night  ; nor for the arrow that flieth by day  ;
And he said unto them in his doctrine ,  Beware of the scribes , which love to go in long clothing , and love salutations in the marketplaces ,
translation.kha: Katba u dang hikai ïa ki , u la ong ,  Sumar bha na ki nonghikai ka Hukum , kiba sngewtynnat ban leit kylleng ha ki jaiñkup jynsur bad ba yn khublei ïa ki da ka jinglehburom ha ka jaka ïew ,
U syiem Sumar la pan , hynrei Hangta ka jingkular kaba jingput la lah pynlong ha khmat baroh Pa nongshahkhot sngewbha lam u , u la ai bakoit hukum ba ïa ka syrdep jong ka yn ai .
translation.en: And the king was sorry : nevertheless for the oath s sake , and them which sat with him at meat , he commanded it to be given her .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa ka Templ jong pha yn iehnoh bad long kan kaba thylli .
translation.en: Behold , your house is left unto you desolate .

translation.kha: Trei ngin lyoh jong ka jingbitar mawkyntang jong me uba rben katta katta ïa ki jingduwai Adonijah ngi ban ksam lyngba .
translation.en: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud , that our prayer should not pass through .

translation.kha: Ka don ka por kaba dei bad ka lynti kaba dei leh ïa kiei kiei , tip khyndiat eh !
translation.en: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment , therefore the misery of man is great upon him .
We then , as workers together with him , beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingtrei jong ngi lem bad U Blei , namarkata , ngi kyrpad ïa phi kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingaiei U Blei ban ym pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka .

translation.en: If thy whole body therefore be full of light , having no part dark , the whole shall be full of light , as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light .
translation.kha: Lada ka met jong phi baroh kawei ka dap da ka jingshai , khlem kano kano ka bynta jong ka ha kaba dum , kan long kaba phyrnai ha baroh , kum haba ka sharak ka tyngshaiñ ha phi da ka jingphyrnai jong ka .
Shen phin sa lah leit ban ïalap ryngkat bad kiwei pat ki para bangeit jong Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ha ka shnong jong phi .
translation.en: In time , you may qualify to begin preaching with the local congregation of Jehovah’s Witnesses .

translation.kha: Katba u Saul u dang kren ha uta u lyngdoh ïa-ïap ka jingkulmar ha ka tnaw sher dara jingkynha Philistia ka nang bashemphang jur ïapshiliang kumta u Saul u Kushi ha u , Ym don por ban pynjahthait ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And it came to pass , while Saul talked unto the priest , that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased : and Saul said unto the priest , Withdraw thine hand .

And when they were departed from him , ( for they left him in great diseases , ) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest , and slew him on his bed , and he died : and they buried him in the city of David , but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings .
translation.kha: U la mynsaw jur , bad haba ki nongshun ki la leit noh , ar ngut ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u bad ki la pynïap ïa u ha ka jingthiah jong u ban pynhiarkput ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u khun jong u Jehoïada , u lyngdoh . La tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid , hynrei ym ha ka jingtep ki syiem .

translation.en: But Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  besides , that we might enquire of him ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jehoshaphat u kylli ,  Hato ym don sa uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa ïa uba ngin kylli ïa U  Trai  ?

translation.en: Of the nations concerning which the  Lord  said unto the children of Israel , Ye shall not go in to them , neither shall they come in unto you : for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods : Solomon clave unto these in love .
translation.kha: U shongkurim ïa ki wat haba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki Israel ban ym ïashongkha khleh bad kine ki briew , namar kin pynlong ïa ki Israel ban mane ïa kiwei ki blei .
Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad Eloi Eleasar u khun jingnguh u sha kliar Manoah Lum Hor ,
translation.en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son , and bring them up unto mount Hor :

translation.en: Servants , be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh , with fear and trembling , in singleness of your heart , as unto Christ ;
And again he said ,  Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli biang ,  Bad kaei ngan ïanujor ïa ka Hima U Blei ?

translation.kha: Ngan buh ïa me ban khmih ïa ka ri jong nga , bad ki briew jong nga baroh kin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me . Ka iktiar jong me hadien ka jong nga .

ïathiah shongkha bad la ksiew ; kata kan long ka .
translation.en: The nakedness of thy son s daughter , or of thy daughter s daughter , even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover : for theirs is thine own nakedness .
Don’t you agree that any family will benefit if the husband treats his wife with concern , as he himself would want to be treated ?

translation.en: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment : and it was early  ; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall , lest they should be defiled  ; but that they might eat the passover .
Ye have not eaten bread , neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink : that ye might know that I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Phim shym ïoh kpu ban bam , bad phim shym ïoh waiñ lane kyiad ban dih , hynrei U  Trai  u pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam jong phi khnang ba phin tip ba u long U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Then they sought to take him : but no man laid hands on him , because his hour was not yet come .
translation.kha: Te ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa u , hynrei ym don uba la ktah kti ïa u , namar ba ka kynta jong u kam pat poi .

Kumta nga la pdiang ba u briew dei u ban pynsngewbha ïa lade namar ka jingpynsngewbha kaba ma tang ka kaba u ïoh ha kane ka jingim ka long ka jingïabam bad ka jingïadih bad jinglehsngewbha ka ïa lade . U lah la kumno kumno ban leh ïa kane katba u ha trei jingim ka kaba U Blei u la ai ha u ha kane ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Then I commended mirth , because a man hath no better thing under the sun , than to eat , and to drink , and to be merry : for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life , which God giveth him under the sun .
Be not desirous of his dainties : for they are deceitful meat .
translation.kha: Wat kwah lalot ïa ki jingbam bang ba u pynkhreh ; u lah ban pyrshang ban riam ïa phi .

translation.en: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him , saying , Of a truth thou art the Son of God .
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran hapoh ka lieng ki la mane ïa U Jisu .  Da shisha me long U Khun U Blei !  ki la pynbna .
Kynsan ngut ar ki rangbah ki la ïakren bad u . Ki la long u Moses bad u Elijah ,
translation.en: And , behold , there talked with him two men , which were Moses and Elias :

translation.kha: Kita kiba bieit ki la rah ïa la ki sharak hynrei kim shym la rah tam ïa umphniang ka bad ki ,
translation.en: They that were foolish took their lamps , and took no oil with them :
Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things , O  Lord  ? wilt thou hold thy peace , and afflict us very sore ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  , hato yn ym pynkhih ïa me da kane baroh ? Hato men ym leh ei ei bad shah ba ngin shah jynjar palat ïa kaba ngi lah ban shah ?

Bad u Saul u la mynjur ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u Stephan . Ha kata hi ka sngi , balang ka ha Jerusalem ka la sdang ban mad ïa ka beiñ jingpynshitom kaba shyrkhei . Baroh riewngeit ki , lait noh ki apostol ki , la sakma sha kylleng jong ki thain ka Judia bad ka Samaria .
translation.en: And Saul was consenting unto his death . And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem  ; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria , except the apostles .
And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months .
translation.kha: bad u la synshar ha Hebron halor ka Judah hynñiew snem shiteng .
Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ka thiaw kim tip ka dei kaei , bad kumta Minnith ïakylli para ma ki , Kaei mo kane ? Te u sisa u ong ha ki , Une u dei u kpu ba iohnong Trai kamet la ai ha phi ban bam .
translation.en: And when the children of Israel saw it , they said one to another , It is manna : for they wist not what it was . And Moses said unto them , This is the bread which the  Lord  hath given you to eat .

translation.kha: u Apollos u la jingmut ban leit sha , parabangeit ha Ephesos ki la ïarap ïa u da kaba thoh sha ki parabangeit kiba ha Akhaïa , da kaba kyrpad ïa ki ban pdiang sngewbha u . la , u long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa kito kiba da jingaiei jong U Blei ki la kylla long ki .
translation.en: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia , the brethren wrote , exhorting the disciples to receive him : who , when he was come , helped them much which had believed through grace :
Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David . And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid bad u Jehoram u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And he said , Peace be to you , fear not : your God , and the God of your father , hath given you treasure in your sacks : I had your money . And he brought Simeon out unto them .
translation.kha: Uta u shakri u ong ,  Wat khuslai . Wat sheptieng ruh . Dei U Blei jong phi , U Blei jong u kpa jong phi , uba la thep ïa ki pisa ha ki byrni jong phi na ka bynta jong phi . Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka dor ba phi la siew .  Nangta u wan ïalam ïa u Simeon sha ki .
Ka U ka la phet na Israel , ong , namar ba la ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang Blei .
translation.en: And she said , The glory is departed from Israel : for the ark of God is taken .
And said to the judges , Take heed what ye do : for ye judge not for man , but for the  Lord  , who is with you in the judgment .
translation.kha: Da pyrkhat bha haba phi ai jingrai ; phim pyndep ïa ka kam ha ka bor briew , hynrei ha ka bor U  Trai  , bad u long bad phi haba phi ai ïa ka jingrai .
ar sngi , kumba phi , kan long ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , bad ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa aiti ïa ka ban shah sahnarphna
translation.en: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover , and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified .

translation.kha: Katba dang wallam ïa ka Synduk shapoh , ka Mikhal , ka khun jong u Saul , ka la peit na ka jingkhangïit bad ka la ïohi ïa u Syiem Dabid ba u kynthih kylleng sawdong ha bakyntang , bad ka la i ngiah u .
translation.en: And as the ark of the  Lord  came into the city of David , Michal Saul s daughter looked through a window , and saw king David leaping and dancing before the  Lord   ; and she despised him in her heart .

translation.kha: U Trai ong , Ko ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah ba shah jynjar bymdonbor , bad ym don u ban pyntngen ïa pha , ngan tei pat ki nongrim jong pha da ki mawkordor
translation.en: O thou afflicted , tossed with tempest , and not comforted , behold , I will lay thy stones with fair colours , and lay thy foundations with sapphires .

translation.kha: U Petros u la sdang ban kren : Mynta nga sngewthuh ka ba long kaba shisha ba Blei U u ñiew kumjuh ïa uno uno baroh .
translation.en: Then Peter opened his mouth , and said , Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Shisien la don u briew uba la leit hiar Jerusalem sha Jerikho ki nonglute ki la tur ïaleh u , ki la sloit lyngkhuit ïa u , bad ki la shoh ïa u ki da iehnoh lyngktop ïa kum uba ïap
translation.en: And Jesus answering said ,  A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho , and fell among thieves , which stripped him of his raiment , and wounded him , and departed , leaving him half dead .
For in that he died , he died unto sin once : but in that he liveth , he liveth unto God .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , namar ba u la ïap , ka pop kan ym donbor shuh halor jong u ; bad mynta u im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei .
Ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ , syiem u u la mane ïa U da Trai kaba ai ki jingkñia ha ka duwan rnong ; u la phah pynïap shihajar tylli ki jingri bad thang tylli halor jong ka .
translation.en: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the  Lord  , which was at the tabernacle of the congregation , and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it .

And God said moreover unto Moses , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , The  Lord  God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , hath sent me unto you : this is my name for ever , and this is my memorial unto all generations .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki Israel ba ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob , u la phah ïa me sha ki . Kane ka long ka kyrteng jong nga junom la junom ; kumne ruh ki pateng bynriew ki ban dang wan ki dei ban khot ïa nga .

Nangta u la ha nga ong , Halor jong ka la thoh ïa ka jingtim kaba dei leit ban sha ka ri baroh kawei . Ha kawei ka liang jong ka kot kli ka ong ba ïa uwei pa uwei u nongtuh yn weng noh na ka ri ; bad ha kawei pat ka liang ka ong ba ïa uno uno uba ïathuh hapoh lamler ka jingsmai yn shim noh ïa u . ruh
translation.en: Then said he unto me , This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth : for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it  ; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it .

translation.kha: Ki jong ngi ki la shahjop ! Ki la lute bad shetkylla wat la ym shym kiba la lute ne shetkylla ïa ki . Hynrei ka por ban lute bad kan , bad ki kin sa kiba lute bad shetkylla .
translation.en: Woe to thee that spoilest , and thou wast not spoiled  ; and dealest treacherously , and they dealt not treacherously with thee ! when thou shalt cease to spoil , thou shalt be spoiled  ; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously , they shall deal treacherously with thee .

translation.kha: Ko syiem , phi dei ban tip ba ngi la leit sha ka probins jong Sansannah Judah bad shem ba ïa ka Kyrini jong U Blei bakhraw pyniaid dang shna biang da ki maw baheh skum shaw ki bim dieng iaka la phetwir ha jyllang kynroh . Ïa ka kam la pyntrei ha ka bymïap Khot biang bha bad ka dang bymdonbor pyndonburom .
translation.en: Be it known unto the king , that we went into the province of Judah , to the house of the great God , which is builded with great stones , and timber is laid in the walls , and this work goeth fast on , and prospereth in their hands .

translation.kha: To wan bad khmih , u la jubab . ( Ka la ha long kata ka por kumba saw baje janmiet . ) Kumta ki la leit bad u , bad ki la ïohi hangno u sah , bad ki pynlut la ïa kaba sah jong ka sngi bad . u
translation.en: He saith unto them ,  Come and see .  They came and saw where he dwelt , and abode with him that day : for it was about the tenth hour .

translation.kha: Baroh ki Israel kiba don hangta ki la phet ïap ki haba ïohsngew ïa ka jinglynñiar jong ki . Ki la ïa-pyrta , Phet , khyndew Ka ka lah ban nguid ïa ngi ruh !
translation.en: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them : for they said , Lest the earth swallow us up also .

translation.kha: haba Hynrei ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor u jong Philip shaphang ka khubor babha jong ka Hima U Blei bad shaphang U Jisu Khrist , la pynbaptis ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei .
translation.en: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God , and the name of Jesus Christ , they were baptized , both men and women .
And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Elias truly shall first come , and restore all things .
translation.kha: U Elijah shisha u wan shuwa ,  la jubab U Jisu ,  bad un pynkhreh ïa kiei kiei baroh .
Sepngi katto katne ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai basarong Hukum ki la wan sha U Klemen na jingbatnud bad ki la kylli ïa u ,
translation.en: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees , which were of Jerusalem , saying ,
I think it is good that books still exist , but they do make me sleepy .
translation.kha: Nga tharai ka bha ba ki kot ki dang don , hynrei ki pynsamthiah ia nga .

translation.en: Drop down , ye heavens , from above , and let the skies pour down righteousness : let the earth open , and let them bring forth salvation , and let righteousness spring up together  ; I the  Lord  have created it .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ka jingjop na sahit bneng kum u slap ; ka khyndew kan ang ban pdiang ïa u bad kan phuh da ka jinglaitluid bad ka jingbishar hok . Nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynlong ïa kane ban jia .
To ai ha ngi man ka sngi ïa ka jingbam kaba ngi donkam .
translation.en: Give us day by day our daily bread .
Lord , have mercy on my son : for he is lunatic , and sore vexed : for ofttimes he falleth into the fire , and oft into the water .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , to isynei ïa u khun jong nga ! U long uba pang ring bad u la don ka jingkhie ring kaba shyrkhei eh ba bunsien u hap ha ka ding lane ha ka um .

translation.en: For he looketh to the ends of the earth , and seeth under the whole heaven  ;
translation.kha: Namar u ïohi ïa kiba kut jong ka pyrthei , u ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ka suiñbneng .

translation.en: The sons of Gershon  ; Libni , and Shimei , according to their families .
translation.kha: U Gershon u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : u Libni bad u Shimei , bad ki ruh ki don bun ki khun ki ksiew .

translation.en: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness : they shall be driven on , and fall therein : for I will bring evil upon them , even the year of their visitation , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki lynti ïaid ba ki bud kin long kiba btuit bad kiba dum ; ngan pynlong ïa ki ba kin jynthut bad kin kyllon . Ngan wallam ka jingpynjot ha ki ; ka por ka jingpynshitom ïa ki ka la nang wan , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

Kin wallam ïa ïaishong kjat-dien bad ïa ka shadem jingrung dang kñia ïa ka khleiñ jingpynshitom ka Manoah bam sha U pynwit . Kine ki bynta ki pynshitom ki jong me bad jong ki Jebus jong me pateng la pateng , kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat , to wave it for a wave offering before the  Lord   ; and it shall be thine , and thy sons  with thee , by a statute for ever  ; as the  Lord  hath commanded .

translation.kha: Nga la ong , Ym don jingkyrmen ïa nga ! Nga long ba la tim kawei namar pa kawei ka kaba kyntien mih na ki rmiang shyntur jong nga ka long kaba pop , bad nga shong nga sah hapdeng ki briew kiba kawei pa kawei ka ka kyntien long kaba . pop Bad pynban , la da ki jong ki khmat nga la ïohi ïa U Syiem , U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Then said I , Woe is me ! for I am undone  ; because I am a man of unclean lips , and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips : for mine eyes have seen the King , the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Nangta u u ong ïa ki u Baal , Namar ba phi kham ïabun , shim shuwa ma phi u . Duwai ha blei jong phi , tangba phim dei ban ai ding ïa ki diengthang
translation.en: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal , Choose you one bullock for yourselves , and dress it first  ; for ye are many  ; and call on the name of your gods , but put no fire under .

translation.kha: Ki jubab Kane , ka dei kaei ba phin ong ha ki : ‘ Ka tiduh jong nga ka kham rben ban ïa syngkai ka i pa jong nga .’
translation.en: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him , saying , Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee , saying , Thy father made our yoke heavy , but make thou it somewhat lighter for us  ; thus shalt thou say unto them , My little finger shall be thicker than my father s loins .
And they that weep , as though they wept not ; and they that rejoice , as though they rejoiced not ; and they that buy , as though they possessed not ;
translation.kha: kita kiba ïam , kumba kim shym la sngewsih ; kito kiba rkhie , kumba kim shym la don ka jingkmen ; bad kito kiba ïathied , kumba kim shym long trai ïa kaei kaba ki la thied ;
Ha ka phang bashatei u pud jong u na bad u artet ïa ka lum kaba shatei na Jerikho bad u sha sepngi lyngba ka lum haduh ka ri shyiap Bethaben .
translation.en: And their border on the north side was from Jordan  ; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side , and went up through the mountains westward  ; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth–aven .

For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus , which smote him : and he said , Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them , therefore will I sacrifice to them , that they may help me . But they were the ruin of him , and of all Israel .
translation.kha: U kñia ki jingainguh ha ki blei jong ki Syria , kiba la jop ïa u . U ong ,  Ki blei jong ki Syria ki la ïarap ïa ki syiem Syria , kumta lada nga ai jingkñia sha ki , ki lah ban ïarap ïa nga ruh .  Kane ka la wanrah jingpynjot ïa u bad ha ka hima jong u .

Nga la pynshitom ïa pha ba-pyiar hynrei kam shym jngut kano kano ka jingbha ; nongkamsniew kyrmen da la shah ïa nga ban Pynbeit ïa pha . Kum u sing uba shyrkhei , pha phaloh pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa Pleïades nga .
translation.en: In vain have I smitten your children  ; they received no correction : your own sword hath devoured your prophets , like a destroying lion .

Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren , Kadmiel and his sons , the sons of Judah , together , to set forward the workmen in the house of God : the sons of Henadad , with their sons and their brethren the Levites .
translation.kha: U Jeshua , u Lebi , lem bad ki khun shynrang bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u bad u Kadmiel bad ki khun shynrang jong u ( na ka kur Hodabaïah ) , ki la ïasnohkti lang ha kaba khmih ïa ka jingtei biang ïa ka Templ . ( Ïa ki la ïarap da ki Lebi jong ka kur Henadad . )
Nga da lade ngan hikai ki briew jong pha , bad ai ha ïa ka jingmanbha bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: And all thy children shall be taught of the  Lord   ; and great shall be the peace of thy children .

And I will take away his blood out of his mouth , and his abominations from between his teeth : but he that remaineth , even he , shall be for our God , and he shall be as a governor in Judah , and Ekron as a Jebusite .
translation.kha: Kin ym lah shuh ban bam ïa ka doh lem bad ka snam ha ka , lane ïa kiwei pat ki jingbam ba la mana . Baroh kiba lait im kin long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga bad kin long kum ka kur ha ka jait Judah . Ka Ekron kan kylla long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga , kumba ki Jebus ki la long .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they will not believe thee , neither hearken to the voice of the first sign , that they will believe the voice of the latter sign .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Lada kim ngeit ïa me lane kim lah pdiang ïa ka kambah kaba nyngkong , te kane kan pynngeit ïa ki .

translation.en: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips  ; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food .
translation.kha: Nga leh borabor ïa kaei kaba U Blei u hukum ; nga bud ïa ka mon jong u , ym ïa ki jingkwah jong nga hi .

translation.en: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared : there make ready for us .
translation.kha: Te un pyn-i ha phi ïa ka kamra kaba haneng kaba heh , ba la pynkhreh bad pynbiang , ha kaba phin ïoh baroh kiei kiei ba la pynkhreh lypa na ka bynta jong ngi .
U Jisu u la ong ha u , Ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban ngeit lymda u ïohi ki ïa kambah ki bad kamphylla .
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto him ,  Except ye see signs and wonders , ye will not believe .
And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates  ; and the water thereof was dried up , that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynriew u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka wahbah Ïuphratis . Ka wah ka la rngad , ban pynbiang ka lynti ïa ki syiem kiba wan na mihngi .
Uwei na kynshi , threw kyrteng u jingïapait u ong , Ngan ai ïa ka khun jong nga ka Akhsah ban shongkurim Nangne u briew uba jop ha JW kurup ïa ka bathymmai Sepher .
translation.en: And Caleb said , He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher , and taketh it , to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife .
And it shall come to pass , that in the place where it was said unto them , Ye are not my people ; there shall they be called the children of the living God .
translation.kha: Bad ha kata hi ka jaka ha kaba ki la ong , ‘Phim dei ki briew jong nga .’ Hangta yn khot ïa ki , ki khun jong U Blei ba-im .

translation.en: And he said ,  A certain man had two sons :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la bteng ban ong ,  La don shisien uwei u briew uba la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang .

translation.en: And this was done three times : and all were drawn up again into heaven .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia lai sien , bad khatduh ïa kata baroh kawei la tan pat sha bneng .
Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ki parabangeit jong nga , ba phin long kum ma nga . La shisha , nga long hi kum ma phi . Phim la shym leh sniew ei ïa ei nga .
translation.en: Brethren , I beseech you , be as I am ; for I am as ye are : ye have not injured me at all .
And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house . And the child did minister unto the  Lord  before Eli the priest .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elkanah u leit phai sha la ïing ha Ramah , hynrei u khynnah Samuel u sah ha Shiloh bad u shakri ïa U  Trai  ha ka jingïalam u Eli u lyngdoh .

translation.en: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban sngewsarong ïa ka jingshakri jong nga ïa U Blei , lyngba U Khrist Jisu

Ha ka step kaba bud u Elkanah bad ha baroh kiba ka ïing jong u ki la khie dang step phyrngab , bad hadien ba ki la mane ïa U Trai ; ki leit phai pat sha la ïing ha Ramah . U Elkanah u shongkha ïathiah bad Hannah ka ka tnga jong u , bad U Trai u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong ka .
translation.en: And they rose up in the morning early , and worshipped before the  Lord  , and returned , and came to their house to Ramah : and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife  ; and the  Lord  remembered her .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa U Trai ba u ïeng harud ka duwan U . la ai ka hukum Tied : tyngeh ïa ki khlieh rishot jong ka Templ haduh ba ka shyngkub baroh kawei kan da khih . Pynpait ïa bad ai ki kin ba hap halor ki khlieh jong ki briew . Ngan pynïap ha ka thma ïa ki briew kiba dang sah . ym Yn don u ban ïohphet ; wat uwei ruh un ym lait im .
translation.en: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar : and he said , Smite the lintel of the door , that the posts may shake : and cut them in the head , all of them  ; and I will slay the last of them with the sword : he that fleeth of them shall not flee away , and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered .
Every valley shall be filled , and every mountain and hill shall be brought low  ; and the crooked shall be made straight , and the rough ways shall be made smooth  ;
translation.kha: Ïa kawei pa kawei ka them dei ban pyndap , ïa uwei ba uwei u lumrit bad u lumbah dei ban pynmadan . Ïa ki lynti kiba kyllaiñ dei ban pynbeit , bad ïa ki lynti ïaid kiba khohruh khohram dei ban pynjlih .

translation.en: And if a man smite the eye of his servant , or the eye of his maid , that it perish  ; he shall let him go free for his eye s sake .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shoh na ka pyllew khmat ïa la u mraw , shynrang ne kynthei , bad kata ka khmat ka sep-ei noh , u dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uta u mraw kum ka jingsiew namar kata ka khmat .

translation.en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee , to keep thee in all thy ways .
translation.kha: U Blei un buh ïa ki angel ban khmih halor jong me ban ïada ïa me shano shano ba me leit .
Ka bynta kaba halor jong ka duwan ka long sawdong , hynriew mitar ha kawei kawei pa ka liang .
translation.en: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long , twelve broad , square in the four squares thereof .
For he satisfieth the longing soul , and filleth the hungry soul with goodness .
translation.kha: U la pynhun ïa kito kiba sliang bad pyndap ïa kiba thngan da kiei kiei kiba bha .

translation.en: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria , and reigned twenty years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba sanphew ar jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u Syiem ka Judah , u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar arphew snem ha Samaria .
Mynba u Abiathar u khun jong u Ahimelekh u la lait phet 15 kawei-na-kaba-shiphew ïasoh bad Ussiel Dabid ha bapyrkhing , u la rah jingneit ka ephod Bahok bad u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah , that he came down with an ephod in his hand .

And it came to pass , when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister s hands , and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister , saying , Thus spake the man unto me  ; that he came unto the man  ; and , behold , he stood by the camels at the well .
translation.kha: U Laban u la ïohi ïa ka sati khmut bad ïa ki khadu ha ki ryndang-kti jong ka para jong u , bad u la ïohsngew ïa ka ba ka ïathuh ïa kaei kaba uta u briew u la ong ha ka . U leit sha u shakri jong u Abraham , uba ïeng hajan ki ut jong u harud kata ka pukri ,

translation.en: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon , and there shall he be until I visit him , saith the  Lord  : though ye fight with the Chaldeans , ye shall not prosper .
translation.kha: Ïa u Sedekaïah yn rah noh sha Babilonia bad un sah hangta haduh ba ngan da pyndep ïa kaei ban leh ïa u . Wat lada un ïaleh ïa ki nong Babilonia , un ym lah ban jop . Ma nga U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels , until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day .
translation.kha: Me hi men ïoh ka jingpang bajur ha ki snier ka ban kham jur na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat .
Ko ba-ieit parabangeit jong ngi , ngi tip ba U Blei u ieit ïa phi bad ba u la jied ïa phi ban long ki jong hi u .
translation.en: Knowing , brethren beloved , your election of God .

translation.kha: Ho-oid la thung ïa ka , hynrei hato kan im bad san ? Hato kan ym ïapstai haba ka lyer mihngi shoh ka ka ïa ? Hato kan ym ïapstai hangta ha kaba ka san ?
translation.en: Yea , behold , being planted , shall it prosper ? shall it not utterly wither , when the east wind toucheth it ? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew .
Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt ? or is there any taste in the white of an egg ?
translation.kha: Hynrei uei uba lah bam ïa ka jingbam ka bym don jingmad bad kaba khlem mluh ? Don jingmad aïu ha ka bynta kaba lieh jong ka pylleng ?

translation.en: And it shall be , that the city which is next unto the slain man , even the elders of that city shall take an heifer , which hath not been wrought with , and which hath not drawn in the yoke  ;
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongïalam jong ka shnong kaba jan tam na kata ka jaka ha kaba la shem ïa ka metïap kin jied kawei ka masi lud ka bym pat ju ring lyngkor .
Kaba bha bad kaba sniew kumjuh ki jia Armoni ka hukum jong u .
translation.en: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good ?

translation.kha: bad ïa ki jaiñphong shaka ishongkun ba ki ti ki dei ban kup ha ka Jaka Kyntang — ki jaiñphong Tamarisk kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u lyngdoh bad ïa umdih khun shynrang jong u .
translation.en: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and his sons  garments , to minister in the priest s office .

translation.kha: U Elisha u jubab , To shahshkor kaei ïa kaba U Trai u ong ! Kum ha kane ka por lashai ka sngi phin lah ban ha thied Samaria lai kilo u kew uba bha tam lane hynriew u kilo barli tang shi sbai rupa .
translation.en: Then Elisha said , Hear ye the word of the  Lord   ; Thus saith the  Lord  , To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel , and two measures of barley for a shekel , in the gate of Samaria .

translation.kha: U Hushai u jubab , Balei ngan leh kumta ? Nga dei ka ha liang jong uta uba la jied da U Trai , da kine briew ki , bad da ki Israel baroh . sah Ngan bad phi .
translation.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom , Nay  ; but whom the  Lord  , and this people , and all the men of Israel , choose , his will I be , and with him will I abide .

translation.kha: U Jisu Spain la ïohi film u paidbah Israhaïah la nang kyntur ïa 15 , kumta u la hukum ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid . Mynsiem bakyllut bad jingmong kren , u la ong , Nga ïabeit ïa me ban mihnoh na u jingthok bad wat ju rung shuh hapoh jong lushia !
translation.en: When Jesus saw that the people came running together , he rebuked the foul spirit , saying unto him ,  Thou dumb and deaf spirit , I charge thee , come out of him , and enter no more into him .

translation.kha: kyr-ang shah ngan jingjahthait buit lem ïa phi , bad U kiei un Synagog LONG bad phi riewlalot Ka long kaba dei ba phin mihkhmat ïa jinglyngkhuit ki briew ha jingpynhiar U Blei , bad ban leit rah ïa ki jingïakajia tyndong ki sha u .
translation.en: Hearken now unto my voice , I will give thee counsel , and God shall be with thee : Be thou for the people to God-ward , that thou mayest bring the causes unto God :

translation.kha: Ïa kaei phi la leit Hananaïah peit ? Hato ïa u briew uba phong ki jaiñ kiba itynnat ? Ïa ki briew Jingshitom riam kumta bad kiba shong ha ka jingpyiar kyrhai la shem ha ki ïingsyiem jutang
translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? Behold , they which are gorgeously apparelled , and live delicately , are in kings  courts .

translation.kha: Ha ki ïing jong ki briew kiba sniew don ki jingkynshew kiba ki la lum da kaba leh bymhok . Ki pyndonkam da ki jingthew , bashukor kaei kaei nga kaba isih .
translation.en: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked , and the scant measure that is abominable ?
And if a soul sin , and hear the voice of swearing , and is a witness , whether he hath seen or known of it  ; if he do not utter it , then he shall bear his iniquity .
translation.kha: Ki Jingkñia namar ka Pop ki donkam na ka bynta kine ki jingleh . Lada uno uno u shah khot da ki bor ba-halor ban ai sakhi ha ka ïingbishar bad um ïathuh ei ei ïa kata kaba u la ïohi ne u la ïohsngew , u dei ban kit hi ïa kaba mih nangta .

translation.en: And he laid hold on the dragon , that old serpent , which is the Devil , and Satan , and bound him a thousand years ,
translation.kha: U la kem ïa u Ïakjakor , ïa uta u  seiñ hyndai — kata , u Ksuid lane u Soitan — bad u la teh kynjri ïa u haduh shihajar snem .
Ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingai sngewbha da ka jingthoh , ka long kaba donkam ban ba uba ai ïa ka la
translation.en: For where a testament is , there must also of necessity be the death of the testator .
And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years : and he slept with his fathers , and Nadab his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u la synshar kum u syiem arphew ar snem . U la ïap bad la tep ïa u , bad u khun jong u , u Nadab u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
Hamar kaba shiteng na ka Jingkhawai Niam dulan la jan kut U Jisu u la leit sha ka Templ bad u la sdang ban hikai .
translation.en: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple , and taught .

And I saw , when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away , and given her a bill of divorce  ; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not , but went and played the harlot also .
translation.kha: Ka Judah ka la ïohi ba nga la pyllait tnga ïa ka Israel bad phah noh ïa ka namar ba ka la phai noh na nga bad ka la kylla long ka nuti . Hynrei ka Judah , ka para bymïaineh jong ka Israel , kam shym sheptieng . Ma ka ruh ka la kylla long ka nuti

translation.en: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him .
translation.kha: Shi lynter ka jingim jong u , u leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , namar u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u la hikai ïa u .

translation.en: That which dieth of itself , or is torn with beasts , he shall not eat to defile himself therewith : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Um bit ban bam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba shu ïap hi , lane uba la shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw ; kata kan pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid . Nga long U  Trai .

Ki nongrah-khubor la ki ïa rah kane ka jingpynbna kawei sha pa kawei ka probins jong ka hima . Ka don ki jingbthah ba tang ha kawei ka sngi , ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , baroh ïa ki Jiw — samla bad tymmen , kynthei bad khynnah — dei ban pynïap . Ïa ki dei ban pynïap khlem jingisynei bad ba ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki dei ban shim . noh
translation.en: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king s provinces , to destroy , to kill , and to cause to perish , all Jews , both young and old , little children and women , in one day , even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar , and to take the spoil of them for a prey .

translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ka kitab synrang ka Ngan U Trai bad ki leit lyngba rhem baroh ki shnong sawar Judah , Nakon kaba hikai ïa Saddusi ha ki briew .
translation.en: And they taught in Judah , and had the book of the law of the  Lord  with them , and went about throughout all the cities of Judah , and taught the people .

translation.kha: Haba Beon synrai ka la poi ha kata ka snem sakma ka kynhun Annas Syria Arubboth la tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah bad ka pynthnam , sakhrai la pynïap ïa ki Herod ïaktah , bad riewïaleh la Pyni shibun ngim sngewlah lute sha Damaskos .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of the year , that the host of Syria came up against him : and they came to Judah and Jerusalem , and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people , and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus .
And were baptized of him in Jordan , confessing their sins .
translation.kha: Ki la phla ïa la ki pop , bad u la pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka wah Jordan .
Lada uno uno u Israel u kylla duk bad u hap ban die ïa la khyndew ka , u ba-ha-ïing bajan jong eh u , un thied pat ïa ka .
translation.en: If thy brother be waxen poor , and hath sold away some of his possession , and if any of his kin come to redeem it , then shall he redeem that which his brother sold .
