translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a woman have conceived seed , and born a man child : then she shall be unclean seven days  ; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean .
For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof .
translation.kha: Te ïa ka hukum kaba mynshuwa la buh sharud , namar ba ka long kaba tlot bad ka bymmyntoi .
pynlong umpohliew ban tuid sha ki them , bad ïa ki ba tuid hapdeng ki lum .
translation.en: He sendeth the springs into the valleys , which run among the hills .
The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand .
translation.kha: Da la ka kti hi nga thoh ïa kane :  Ki Jingai Khublei na u Paul .
U Blei u hukum , ki skain bad ki mait ki la dap kylleng ïa ka ri baroh kawei
translation.en: He spake , and there came divers sorts of flies , and lice in all their coasts .

translation.kha: Iehnoh ïa la ka longïing bad ïa ri bad leit sha jaka ngan pyn-i ïa .’
translation.en: And said unto him , Get thee out of thy country , and from thy kindred , and come into the land which I shall shew thee .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki briew ba-mutlop kiba pyrkhat ba ka jingjop ka dang sha jngai .
translation.en: Hearken unto me , ye stouthearted , that are far from righteousness :
The Son of man came eating and drinking , and they say , Behold a man gluttonous , and a winebibber , a friend of publicans and sinners . But wisdom is justified of her children .
translation.kha: Haba U Khun U Briew u la wan , u la bam bad u la dih , bad uwei uwei baroh u la ong , ‘ Ha khmih ïa une u briew ! U long uba lalot bad u nongdih , u paralok jong ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kyntait !’ Pynban , ïa ka jingstad Blei la pyn-i ba ka long kaba shisha da kiba mih na ka .

translation.en: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen , such as they have not heard .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka jingbitar bakhraw jong nga , ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: There is a generation , O how lofty are their eyes ! and their eyelids are lifted up .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba pyrkhat ba ki long kiba bha palat — oh , katno ka jingbha ki pyrkhat ba ki long !
Nga la siang pynitynnat ïa jingthiah ka jong nga da ka jaiñ linen bun rong na Ijipt .
translation.en: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry , with carved works , with fine linen of Egypt .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi kan , wan ïa ka turoi yn put ban khot pat na Assyria bad Ijipt ïa baroh ki Israel kiba don ha ka hangta jinglongmraw . wan Kin bad mane ïa U Trai ha Jerusalem , ha u lum bakyntang jong u .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the great trumpet shall be blown , and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria , and the outcasts in the land of Egypt , and shall worship the  Lord  in the holy mount at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Nga dei shakri u jong u Abraham , u la sdang .
translation.en: And he said , I am Abraham s servant .

translation.kha: Pynban kumba ka , ka dang ïaisah ka jingjahthait ïa briew jong U Blei kumba u ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew .
translation.en: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God .
Then saith he unto me , See thou do it not : for I am thy fellowservant , and of thy brethren the prophets , and of them which keep the sayings of this book : worship God .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha nga ,  Wat leh kumne ! Nga long u shakri ryngkat bad me lem bad ki nongïathuhlypa ki para jong me bad jong kito baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki ktien hapoh jong kane ka kitab . To mane ïa U Blei !

translation.en: Thou shalt not oppress an hired servant that is poor and needy , whether he be of thy brethren , or of thy strangers that are in thy land within thy gates :
translation.kha: Wat shukor ïa u shakri uba bylla , uba duk bad uba kyrduh , la u dei u para Israel lane u nongwei uba shong ha ki shnong jong phi .
ka Kumba Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong : U ai sbun mynsiem sha kiba kyrduh ; ka jinglehsbun jong u ka neh junom .
translation.en: (As it is written , He hath dispersed abroad ; he hath given to the poor : his righteousness remaineth for ever .
Nevertheless , whereto we have already attained , let us walk by the same rule , let us mind the same thing .
translation.kha: La kumno kumno , lada kata ka lah ban long , to ngin ïa-ïaid sha khmat kat kum kijuh ki kyndon kiba ngi la bud haduh mynta .

Katba u dang ïaid , u la ïohi ïa u nonglum khajna , u Lebi u khun jong u Alphaïos , ba u shong ha ka jaka jong treikam u . U u Jisu la ong ha u Bud , nga ïa . U Lebi u la ïeng joit bad u la bud ïa u .
translation.en: And as he passed by , he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom , and said unto him ,  Follow me .  And he arose and followed him .
Take heed that ye do not your alms before men , to be seen of them : otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Da pynthikna ba phin ym leh ïa ki kam niam jong phi ha kaba paw khnang ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh . Lada phi leh ïa kine kiei kiei ha kaba paw , phin ym ïoh kano kano ka nong na U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng .
U Trai Nongsynshar u ai ha nga lwet jingkhlaiñ . U pynlong ïa nga uba skhem ki kjat kum ka skei bad u sumar ïa nga halor ki ibiang .
translation.en: The  Lord  God is my strength , and he will make my feet like hinds  feet , and he will make me to walk upon mine high places . To the chief singer on my stringed instruments .
And they that had eaten were about five thousand men , beside women and children .
translation.kha: Ka jingkheiñ ïa ki rangbah kiba la bam ka la long san hajar ngut , khlem da ñiew ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .

Wat jingkhuslai shipai ba i wai jong ka ki long khlem bor kum ki khun masi . Kim Jingdon ïeng ban ïaleh ; Hadadeser na ki , ki phai bad phet noh . Ka sngi jingsngewsynei ka jingshahjop Rehoboth la poi , kyndiang por buh ka jingpynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks  ; for they also are turned back , and are fled away together : they did not stand , because the day of their calamity was come upon them , and the time of their visitation .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u la bam ha ban da kdang — la don saw kumba hajar ngut ki briew . Nangta synran ki ki la ïalum hynñiew tukri kiba la dap da ki lyngkhot lyngkhai ba la sah tam . Jisu U u la phah noh ïa ki briew
translation.en: And they that had eaten were about four thousand : and he sent them away .

translation.kha: ka Kibsaim , bad ka Horon Beth , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: And Kibzaim with her suburbs , and Beth–horon with her suburbs  ; four cities .

translation.kha: Kumta u rangbah ai hukum u la leit sha u Paul bad u la kylli ïa u Ïathuh , ïa nga , hato me dei traishnong u ka Hima Rom ? Ho-oid , la jubab u Paul .
translation.en: Then the chief captain came , and said unto him , Tell me , art thou a Roman ? He said , Yea .

translation.kha: Nga ong ïa : Kito ki jingïohipaw ba phi ïohi dei kiba bakla , bad ki jingïathuh lypa kiba thaw ki long kiba lamler . Phi ong ba ki dei ktien nga , hynrei ngam shym la kren ha phi !
translation.en: Have ye not seen a vain vision , and have ye not spoken a lying divination , whereas ye say , The  Lord  saith it  ; albeit I have not spoken ?

Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth–el  ; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Beth–el : the words which he had spoken unto the king , them they told also to their father .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don uwei u nongïathuhlypa uba la tymmen uba shong ha Bethel . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki la wan ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah u la leh ha Bethel ha kata ka sngi bad ïa kaei kaba u la kren ha u syiem Jeroboam .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury  ; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger , and great hailstones in my fury to consume it .
translation.kha: Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ha ka jingbitar jong nga ngan phah ïa ka lyer bajur , u slap bajur , bad u phria ban pynjot ïa ka kynroh .

translation.en: And Judas Iscariot , one of the twelve , went unto the chief priests , to betray him unto them .
translation.kha: Te u Judas Iskariot , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , u la mihnoh ban leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh khnang ban shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha ki .

phrang sai bad u Hosah ïamap ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang sepngi ïa-ïaid jlih khyrdop Shallekheth jingkhem ingiew surok kaba na neng . Ïa ka jingap :9-11 la pynbynta ha ki por ba la buh , kawei hadien kawei pat .
translation.en: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward , with the gate Shallecheth , by the causeway of the going up , ward against ward .
This is the thing that ye shall do  ; A third part of you entering on the sabbath , of the priests and of the Levites , shall be porters of the doors  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei ba ngin leh . Haba ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki wan ban pyndep kam ha ka Sabbaton , shi bynta na ka lai bynta na ki kin ap phira ïa ki khyrdop ka Templ ,
U Moses u jubab , Nga dei ban leh ïa kane namar ki ki briew ïawan sha nga ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei .
translation.en: And Moses said unto his father in law , Because the people come unto me to enquire of God :
And the husbandmen took his servants , and beat one , and killed another , and stoned another .
translation.kha: Ki nongshimwai ki la kem ïa ki mraw jong u , ki shoh ïa uwei , ki pynïap ïa uwei pat , bad ki la lynthem maw ïa uwei pat .

translation.en: And the messenger answered and said , Israel is fled before the Philistines , and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people , and thy two sons also , Hophni and Phinehas , are dead , and the ark of God is taken .
translation.kha: U nonglamktien u jubab ,  Ki Israel ki la phet ïap na ki Philistia ; ka la long ka jingshahjop kaba shyrkhei ïa ngi ; bad nalor kata ki khun jong phi , u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki la shah pynïap , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei la shah knieh noh !
u la ong ha ki , Kaei muhor kurup sa leh apot long ïa kaei kaba U Trai moi la hukum .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the congregation , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded to be done .
They profess that they know God ; but in works they deny him , being abominable , and disobedient , and unto every good work reprobate .
translation.kha: Ki kam ba ki tip ïa U Blei , hynrei ki jingleh jong ki , ki len ïa kata . Ki long kiba dap da ka jingisih bad bymkohnguh , ki bym biang ban leh ïa kano kano kaba bha .

translation.en: And he will love thee , and bless thee , and multiply thee : he will also bless the fruit of thy womb , and the fruit of thy land , thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep , in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee .
translation.kha: Un ieit bad kyrkhu ïa phi , ba phin nang roi kyrhai . Un kyrkhu ruh ba phin ïoh shibun ki khun ki kti ; un kyrkhu ïa ki lyngkha jong phi ba phin ïoh u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ; bad un kyrkhu ruh ïa phi da kaba ai ha phi shibun ki masi bad ki langbrot , ha kata ka ri ïa kaba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ban ai ha phi .

translation.en: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot , and she returned unto him into the ark , for the waters were on the face of the whole earth : then he put forth his hand , and took her , and pulled her in unto him into the ark .
translation.kha: Ka wan phai pat sha ka lieng , bad u Noah u kner ïa la ka kti , bad u rah ïa ka shapoh .
U Joab u ïohi ba ki shipai nongshun kin ïaleh ïa u na sha khmat bad shadien , kumta u jied ki shipai Israel bakynsai tam bad pynap da kaba pynphai khmat ïa ki shaphang ki Syria .
translation.en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind , he chose out of all the choice of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians .

translation.kha: U Samson u ong ïa u khynnah uba btin ïa u na ka kti , Ai ba ngan ki ktah ïa rishot kiba kyrshan ïa kane ka ïing . Nga kwah ban shaniah ha ki !
translation.en: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand , Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth , that I may lean upon them .
For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon , a flame from the city of Sihon : it hath consumed Ar of Moab , and the lords of the high places of Arnon .
translation.kha: Shisien na kane ka nongbah Heshbon Ka kynhun ïapom jong u Sihon ka mih kum ka ding ; Ka da pynjot ïa ka nongbah Ar ha Moab Bad ka bam duh ïa ki lum ka Arnon bashaneng .
Wat shah ba kin phet noh na phi ; kynmaw bad ri kyndong ïa ki ha ka dohnud phi .
translation.en: Let them not depart from thine eyes  ; keep them in the midst of thine heart .
Then the glory of the  Lord  departed from off the threshold of the house , and stood over the cherubims .
translation.kha: Te ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka mihnoh na ka jaka rung ka Templ bad ka ïaid shaphang ka jaka kaba halor kita ki jingthaw .

translation.en: And Pharaoh sent , and , behold , there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead . And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened , and he did not let the people go .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u phah kylli ïa kaei kaba la jia bad la ïathuh ba na ki jingri jong ki Israel ym don satia kaba ïap . Hynrei u dang mutlop hi bad um shah ïa u paidbah ban leit .

translation.en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted , to the oppressing city !
translation.kha: Ka Jerusalem ka long kaba la tim , kata ka nongbah kaba ijli , kaba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , kaba banbeiñ ïa la ki jong ki briew .
Hynrei lada baroh kin wan bad ïeng ha khmat jong nga , ym ngan shem wat tang uwei ruh na ki ba long u uba stad .
translation.en: But as for you all , do ye return , and come now : for I cannot find one wise man among you .
And he answered and said ,  He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish , the same shall betray me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Uta uba wieh ïa u kpu ha ka pliang lem bad nga , un shetkylla ïa nga .
Kemuel u Kpu un Admin ïa kata ka puson na phi bad buh ïa ka ha khmat ka duwan U Trai U Blei jong phi ;
translation.en: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand , and set it down before the altar of the  Lord  thy God .
And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor , and though I give my body to be burned , and have not charity , it profiteth me nothing .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban ai baroh kaba nga don , bad wat ïa ka met jong nga ïa ka ban thang — hynrei lada ngam don ka jingieit , kane kam myntoi ei ei ïa nga .
Ka long ka bathngan ïa baroh ki shipai kynrup , bad ka jingkwah brai jong ka , ka pynlong ïa ka ban pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane iphieng jingmeng bleithaw jingaimynsiem ki Rephidim Rephaim
translation.en: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them , with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria , and with all on whom she doted : with all their idols she defiled herself .

translation.kha: Kin pynkie ki briew ha Shebna bad Musri u lum Ïaleit ïasaid :37 lait im , namar U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la thew ban pynjia ïa kane .
translation.en: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant , and they that escape out of mount Zion : the zeal of the  Lord  of hosts shall do this .
For length of days , and long life , and peace , shall they add to thee .
translation.kha: Ka jinghikai jong nga kan ai ïa phi ka jingim kaba jlan bad kaba manbha .

translation.en: He loveth transgression that loveth strife : and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction .
translation.kha: Ban sngewtynnat ïa ka pop ka long ban sngewtynnat ban thaw jingkulmar . Lada phi kob man ka por , phi pan kwah ïa ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: Then fled Moses at this saying , and was a stranger in the land of Madian , where he begat two sons .
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la phet noh na Ijipt bad u la leit noh ban shong ban sah ha ka ri ki Midian . Hangta u la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang .

translation.en: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us ,
translation.kha: Thiophilos badonburom : Bun ki briew ki la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban thoh ka jingïathuh ïa kiei kiei kiba la lah jia hapdeng jong ngi .
Bad mynta , da kaba ïa kohnguh U Mynsiem Bakhuid ngan leit sha Jerusalem , khlem da tip aïu kan jia ïa nga hangta .
translation.en: And now , behold , I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem , not knowing the things that shall befall me there :

I saw the ram pushing westward , and northward , and southward  ; so that no beasts might stand before him , neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand  ; but he did according to his will , and became great .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih ïa u langbrot ba u tynrah da ki reng jong u sha sepngi , shatei , bad shathie . Ym don uno uno u mrad uba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u lane lait phet na ka bor jong u . U la leh katba u sngewbha bad u la nang sngewmeng .

translation.en: Tell ye , and bring them near  ; yea , let them take counsel together : who hath declared this from ancient time ? who hath told it from that time ? have not I the  Lord  ? and there is no God else beside me  ; a just God and a Saviour  ; there is none beside me .
translation.kha: Ale bad ai ïa ka kam jong phi ha ka ïingbishar ; ai ba ki nongïasaid kin ïasyllok uwei ïa uwei pat . Mano ba la ïathuhlypa slem mynshuwa kaei ban jia ? Hato ym dei ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei uba pynim ïa la ki briew ? Ym don uwei pat U Blei .

translation.en: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight , saying , No eye shall see me : and disguiseth his face .
translation.kha: Uba klim u ap ïa ka por janmiet ba kan wan ; u tap ïa la ka khmat khnang ban ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïohi ïa u .

translation.en: Behold , here I am : witness against me before the  Lord  , and before his anointed : whose ox have I taken ? or whose ass have I taken ? or whom have I defrauded ? whom have I oppressed ? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith ? and I will restore it you .
translation.kha: Hangne nga don . Lada nga la leh ïa kano kano kaba bakla , sakhi pyrshah ïa nga ha khmat U  Trai  bad ha khmat u syiem uba u la pynsleh . Hato nga la shim ïa ka masi ne ka kada jongno jongno ? Hato nga la shukor ne banbeiñ ïano ïano ? Hato nga la bamsap nano nano ? Lada nga la leh ïa kine kiei kiei ngan pynphai noh ïa kata kaba nga la shim .

khun Ko u briew , to ïathuhlypa . Pynbna ïa kaba kaei ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki nong Ammon , kiba krenbeiñ ïa ki Israel . Ong ha ki : ‘ Ka waitlam ka la kloi ban pynjot ; ïa ka la pynphyrnai ban pynïap , ban thaba kum leilieh . ka
translation.en: And thou , son of man , prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God  concerning the Ammonites , and concerning their reproach  ; even say thou , The sword , the sword is drawn : for the slaughter it is furbished , to consume because of the glittering :
Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba long U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ïa ka jingsuk .

translation.en: For God shall bring every work into judgment , with every secret thing , whether it be good , or whether it be evil .
translation.kha: U Blei un bishar ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ngi leh , la kaba bha ne kaba sniew , wat ïa kiei kiei kiba la leh ha kaba rieh .

translation.en: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver , neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold .
translation.kha: Wat thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ki blei kiba da ka rupa ne da ka ksiar ban mane ïa ki nalor jong nga .

U Trai u la ong ha nga , Ko khun u briew , me ïa ïohi katai ? Kine ki briew ka Judah kim pat tang hun kaba leh ïa ki kam ba-ijli kiba me la ïohi hangne bad ban pynphriang ïa ka ri da ka thombor jingleh . Em , ki dei ban wan bad leh ïa ki hangne hi ka ha Templ ban pynbitar shuh shuh ïa nga . Peit kumno ki beiñ ïa nga ha rukom ka kaba kham palat .
translation.en: Then he said unto me , Hast thou seen this , O son of man ? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here ? for they have filled the land with violence , and have returned to provoke me to anger : and , lo , they put the branch to their nose .
Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  unto them  ; Behold , I , even I , will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ïathuh ha phi ba ngan bishar hapdeng jong phi ïa ki langbrot kiba khlaiñ bad ki langbrot kiba tlot .

translation.en: And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me .
translation.kha: A katno suk ka long ïa kito ki bym don jingartatien shaphang jong nga !
Ka jingstad thai pynsngewtynnat Phortunatos ka jingim jong phi bad ka ai jingsuk lynter ïa phi .
translation.en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness , and all her paths are peace .
This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon , and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David . And Hezekiah prospered in all his works .
translation.kha: U dei u syiem Hesekaïah uba set ïa ka jingmih ka um na ka Umpohliew Gihon bad ban pun ïa ka um ba kan tuid lyngba ka nur-um sha ka tduh hapoh ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem .
Ha kata ka janmiet synran jong u ki sha u bad ki la ong , Ka la dier eh , bad kane ka dei ka jaka bakynjah . To phah noh ïa ki bad shah ïa ki ban leit sha ki ban thied jingbam na ka bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: And when it was evening , his disciples came to him , saying , This is a desert place , and the time is now past  ; send the multitude away , that they may go into the villages , and buy themselves victuals .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u ki da ksing bad ka jingshad . To ïaroh ïa u da ki duitara bad ki tangmuri .
translation.en: Praise him with the timbrel and dance : praise him with stringed instruments and organs .
For the stone shall cry out of the wall , and the beam out of the timber shall answer it .
translation.kha: Wat ki maw ha ki kynroh ki kyang pyrshah ïa phi , bad ki shankhung ki pynsawa ïa ka jingkyang .
Baroh kaba jia ha kane ka riewblei ka jia ha ka por kaba U Blei u jied .
translation.en: To every thing there is a season , and a time to every purpose under the heaven :

translation.kha: Kita ki rangbah synshar bad ki riewpawkhmat ka Jesreel ki la leh ïa kaei kaba ka Jesebel ka la hukum .

translation.en: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates , and for the joinings  ; and brass in abundance without weight  ;
translation.kha: U pynbiang shibun ka nar ban shna preg bad ki nar ban pyndait ïa ki khyrdop dieng , bad shibun ka rnong haduh ba ym don ba lah ban thew ïa ka .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto his father , They are my sons , whom God hath given me in this place . And he said , Bring them , I pray thee , unto me , and I will bless them .
translation.kha: U Joseph u jubab ,  Kine ki dei ki khun jong nga kiba U Blei u la ai ïa nga hangne ha Ijipt .  U Jakob u ong ,  Wan ïalam ïa ki sha nga ba ngan ïoh kyrkhu ïa ki .

translation.en: For now thou numberest my steps : dost thou not watch over my sin ?
translation.kha: Nangta men khmih man ka sien jam ba nga shim , hynrei men ym buddien ïa ki pop jong nga .

translation.en: Hear me now therefore , O ye children , and depart not from the words of my mouth .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ko ki khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa nga bad wat klet ïa ki ktien jong nga .

translation.en: Then said the lord of the vineyard , What shall I do ? I will send my beloved son : it may be they will reverence him when they see him .
translation.kha: Te u trai jong ka bri sohwaiñ u la ong , ‘ Kaei ngan leh ? ngan phah ïa u khun ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong nga ; da kaba thikna kin burom ïa u !’

translation.en: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother , Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye  ; and , behold , a beam is in thine own eye ?
translation.kha: Kumno phi nud ban ong ha u para jong phi , ‘ Sngewbha , shah ïa nga ban khlaw noh ïa u thngiat na ka khmat jong phi ,’ haba phi don ka lyngkhot dieng ha la ka jong ka khmat ?
Nga “lada uba nguid jingsngewtynnat , bad uba shaniah hok , hynrei ki ktien jong Huppim ki pynsngewrem loit thung baroh kaba nga ong ka i kumba ka pynrem ïa nga mait
translation.en: If I justify myself , mine own mouth shall condemn me : if I say , I am perfect , it shall also prove me perverse .
And he said , I beseech thee , shew me thy glory .
translation.kha: Nangta U Moses u kyrpad ,  Sngewbha shah ngan ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong me .
Ka Jingsngewbha ïa U Trai ka long ka jinghikai na ka ïalum . Phi dei ban long jingïapait sngewrit ha ktien ba phin ïoh ïa ki jingkyntiew burom Arad
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the instruction of wisdom  ; and before honour is humility .
Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages : they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me : their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly .
translation.kha: Ki khnam jong me ki sam lyngba ïa u nongïalam ka kynhun shipai jong u haba u la wan kum ka  erïong ban pynsakma ïa ngi , da ka jingsarong kum kito kiba banbeiñ ïa kiba duk ha kaba rieh .
Hynrei u Barsillai u jubab , don bun snem ban im balei ngan bad Syiem Kynrad sha Jerusalem ?
translation.en: And Barzillai said unto the king , How long have I to live , that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem ?
And when he was come into the ship , he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kiew halor ka lieng , uta u briew uba shongksuid u la kyrpad ïa u ,  Shah ïa nga ban leit bad me !

translation.en: And I sent messengers unto them , saying , I am doing a great work , so that I cannot come down : why should the work cease , whilst I leave it , and come down to you ?
translation.kha: Nga phah nonglamktien ban ong ïa ki ,  Nga dang leh ka kam badonkam bad ngam lah ban leit hiar shata . Ngan ym shah ban pynsangeh ïa ka kam tang namar ban leit ïashem ïa phi .
Bad mynta , ko Job , shahshkor bha ïa nga kaba nga don ong
translation.en: Wherefore , Job , I pray thee , hear my speeches , and hearken to all my words .

translation.kha: To phai U Trai bad duwai ha u , mynta ba u don hajan .
translation.en: Seek ye the  Lord  while he may be found , call ye upon him while he is near :

translation.kha: Shah ïa nga Lebanon shlei ïa Shillong na phi kiba bashabar ban jaw hapoh ka Hukum : Hato phim ïohsngew aïu ka Hukum kheit ong ?
translation.en: Tell me , ye that desire to be under the law , do ye not hear the law ?
Then the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah the prophet , after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien kane , U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga

translation.en: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me , which to you-ward is not weak , but is mighty in you .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingpynshisha baroh kaba phi kwah ba U Khrist u kren ha nga . Haba u pynbeit ïa phi , um long uba tlot , pynban , u pynpaw ïa la ka bor hapdeng jong phi .
Katno tylli ki soh apple ki don ha ka kti jong nga
translation.en: How many apples are there in my hand ?

translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki khun shynrang ba ka pynïar ka la kha na sngewkyndit Jakob ha Mesopotamia nalor ka khun kynthei jong kilo , ka Dinah . Baroh ki khun ki ksiew kiba u ïoh na ka Leah ki long laiphew lai ngut .
translation.en: These be the sons of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob in Paddan–aram , with his daughter Dinah : all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three .
And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , and their hooks shall be of gold : and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka pyrda , thaw san tylli ki rishot da ka dieng akasia ba la suit ksiar . Ki bnoh jong ki ruh ki dei ban long da ka ksiar . Thaw san tylli ki thliew tnaw rnong ha ka bynta kine ki rishot .

translation.en: And of Jezebel also spake the  Lord  , saying , The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Bad shaphang ka Jesebel , U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Ki ksew kin bam ïa ka met jong ka ha ka nongbah Jesreel hi .’

translation.en: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good , and I will bring them again to this land : and I will build them , and not pull them down  ; and I will plant them , and not pluck them up .
translation.kha: Ngan khmih halor jong ki bad ngan wallam biang ïa ki sha kane ka ri . Ngan tei bha ïa ki bad ngan ym tar lyngkhot ïa ki ; ngan thung ïa ki bad ngan ym rat ïa ki .

translation.en: And when he had declared all these things unto them , he sent them to Joppa .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba la jia bad u la phah noh ïa ki sha Joppa .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the mean while , that the heaven was black with clouds and wind , and there was a great rain . And Ahab rode , and went to Jezreel .
translation.kha: Tang hadien khyndiat por , ki lyoh dum ki la tap ïa ka suiñbneng , ka lyer ka sdang ban beh bad u slap bajur u sdang ban hap . U Ahab u shong ha ka kali ïapom bad u sdang ban leit phai sha Jesreel .
Uno uno uba sniew u dei ban ïai leh sniew bad uno uba jaboh dei ban ïai jaboh ; uno uno uba bha u dei ban lehbha , bad uno uba khuid u dei ïailong .
translation.en: He that is unjust , let him be unjust still : and he which is filthy , let him be filthy still : and he that is righteous , let him be righteous still : and he that is holy , let him be holy still .
And they spake unto him the word of the Lord , and to all that were in his house .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïalap ïa ka ktien U Trai ha u bad ha baroh kiwei pat kiba ha ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: Howl , O Heshbon , for Ai is spoiled : cry , ye daughters of Rabbah , gird you with sackcloth  ; lament , and run to and fro by the hedges  ; for their king shall go into captivity , and his priests and his princes together .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Heshbon , ki kyang ! Ïa ka Ai la pynjot ! Ki kynthei ka Rabbah , ki leit ïam sngewsih ! Ki phong ïa ki jaiñ khain bad ïam pangnud . Ki mareh lamwir . Ïa u Molekh u blei jong phi yn ïalam mraw , lem bad ki lyngdoh bad ki khun syiem .

Ieh ïa ka kumba ka long , ïasnoh Josaïah u hukum . Ïa Ainguh shyieng jong u ym dei ban pynkhih . Kumta ïa ki shyieng jong u , ym shym la pynkhih , lymne jong kito ki jong u khnam uba la wan Jingkylli Samaria .
translation.en: And he said , Let him alone  ; let no man move his bones . So they let his bones alone , with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria .
But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , and one ram , and seven lambs of the first year : they shall be unto you without blemish :
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai  : ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joseph was come unto his brethren , that they stript Joseph out of his coat , his coat of many colours that was on him  ;
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u wan ha la ki hynmen shynrang jong u , ki law noh ïa ka sopti jynsur jong u kaba jrong kti .
Ha ka sngi hi ba ïa jong ki jingkñia ki bleithaw , ki la wan ka Templ jong nga bad pyntngit ïa ka !
translation.en: For when they had slain their children to their idols , then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it  ; and , lo , thus have they done in the midst of mine house .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Amasaïah u kyntait lat shahshkor . Ka Me ka mon Likhi Blei ba U Amasaïah un shahjop , namar ba u diaw mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki Sargon Edom .
translation.en: But Amaziah would not hear  ; for it came of God , that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies , because they sought after the gods of Edom .

translation.kha: Nga la jubab , Lada nga Biblos ïa phi ïa ka jingshisha , phin sa pynïap ïa nga , bad lada nga jakoid nongthoh ïa phi , phin ym shahshkor satia .
translation.en: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah , If I declare it unto thee , wilt thou not surely put me to death ? and if I give thee counsel , wilt thou not hearken unto me ?
Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities  ; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .
translation.kha: Pynban ki paid Manasseh kim shym lah ban beh noh ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha kito ki nongbah , kumta ki Kanaan ki dang ïaishong hangta .

Haba me ïathuh ha ki kane ïa baroh , kin kylli ïa me balei ba nga la kut jingmut ban pynshitom ïa tyngeh ki . Kin kylli kaei ka kam runar kaba ki la shah pynrem bad kaei ka pop ba ki la leh pyrshah ïa U Trai U Blei ki jong .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when thou shalt shew this people all these words , and they shall say unto thee , Wherefore hath the  Lord  pronounced all this great evil against us ? or what is our iniquity ? or what is our sin that we have committed against the  Lord  our God ?

translation.kha: U la shim ïa uwei Argob ka longïing ïaknieh u pawkhmat pynjynjar u Shammah pynlong ka jingïateh lok shipa u , bad u la pynlong paidïapom u ban smai ban long uba ïaineh jinglur . U la rah koidi “Ki ki rangbah badonkam
translation.en: And hath taken of the king s seed , and made a covenant with him , and hath taken an oath of him : he hath also taken the mighty of the land :
But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah , wherein this passover was holden to the  Lord  in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Mynta ha kaba khatduh , ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Josaïah , la rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerusalem .
Ïa kine ki khat-ar ki ngut rangbah , U Jisu u la phah noh lem bad kine ki jingbthah harum : leit Wat sha kano kano ka thain ki jong Jentil lane sha kano kano ka shnong ki nong Samaria .
translation.en: These twelve Jesus sent forth , and commanded them , saying ,  Go not into the way of the Gentiles , and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not :

translation.kha: u Hynrei pyrthuh bud ïa ka pop jong u syiem Jeroboam uba , la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop ha kaba mane ïa ki khun masi ksiar kiba u la pynïeng ha Bethel bad ha Dan .
translation.en: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , Jehu departed not from after them , to wit , the golden calves that were in Beth–el , and that were in Dan .
Master , Moses wrote unto us , If a man s brother die , and leave his wife behind him , and leave no children , that his brother should take his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai , U Moses u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong ngi : ‘ Lada u briew u ïap bad u iehnoh ïa ka tnga khlem don khun , u para jong uta u briew u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka khnang ba ki lah ban don ki khun ïa kiba yn ñiew kum ki khun jong uta u briew uba la ïap .’

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt , and ye shall be gathered one by one , O ye children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , na Ïuphratis shaduh u pud ka ri Ijipt , U  Trai  un ïalum ïa uwei pa uwei na ki briew jong u , kum uba pynkhlad ïa u kew na u stait .

translation.en: And Abigail came to Nabal  ; and , behold , he held a feast in his house , like the feast of a king  ; and Nabal s heart was merry within him , for he was very drunken : wherefore she told him nothing , less or more , until the morning light .
translation.kha: Ka Abigail ka leit phai sha u Nabal , uba don ha ïing ha ka jingkhawai kaba kat ka jingkhawai u syiem . U la buaid bad shongshit , kumta kam shym ïathuh ei ei haduh ka step kaba bud .

translation.en: And to the others he said in mine hearing , Go ye after him through the city , and smite : let not your eye spare , neither have ye pity :
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa U Blei ba u ong ha kita kiwei pat ki briew ,  Bud ïa u sawdong ka nongbah , bad pynïap . Wat tyngkai ïano ïano , wat sngewsynei ïano ïano .
ki khlur kin na bneng , bad ïa ki bor ha ka haw yn pynkynriah noh na ki lynti ïaid jong .
translation.en: And the stars of heaven shall fall , and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken .
Jesus saith unto him ,  Thou hast said : nevertheless I say unto you , Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power , and coming in the clouds of heaven .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Me ong kumta . Hynrei nga ong ïa phi baroh : Naduh kane ka por phin ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew ba u da shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Bakhrawbor tam bad u da wan ha ki lyoh bneng !

translation.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me , Within a year , according to the years of an hireling , and all the glory of Kedar shall fail :
translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ha nga ,  Hapoh shisnem thik ka jingkhraw jong ki jait jong ka Kedar kan poi sha kaba kut .
Mynta bad kaei lah ban nujor ïa ki jong kane Ki long kum ki khynnah kiba ïashong ha ki jaka ïew . Kawei ka kynhun ka pyrta ïa kawei pat ,
translation.en: But whereunto shall I liken this generation ? It is like unto children sitting in the markets , and calling unto their fellows ,

But he said unto me , Behold , thou shalt conceive , and bear a son  ; and now drink no wine nor strong drink , neither eat any unclean thing : for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death .
translation.kha: Hynrei u da ong ha nga ba ngan sa punkhun bad ïoh khun shynrang . U ong ïa nga ban nym dih waiñ lane dih kyiad , lane bam ïa kano kano ka bymkhuid , namar uta u khunlung un long uba yn pynkyntang sha U Blei kum u Nasir katba u dang im .

translation.en: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren : the  Lord  is their inheritance , as he hath said unto them .
translation.kha: Kim dei ban don bynta na ka khyndew ka shyiap kum kiwei pat ki para jait jong ki ; ka bynta jong ki ka long ka kabu ka jinglong ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai  , kumba u la kular .
Nga sngewskhem ïa kane bad kumta nga tip ngan dang sah . ïaisah bad baroh pynsan shuh ïa phi bad ïa ka jingkmen ha ka jingngeit ,
translation.en: And having this confidence , I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith ;
Now the things which I write unto you , behold , before God , I lie not .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga thoh ka long kaba shisha . U Blei hi u tip ba ngam shym lamler!
U ai bainong ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba ki leh bad u leh ha ki kat kum ki kaba dei hok .
translation.en: For the work of a man shall he render unto him , and cause every man to find according to his ways .
How art thou fallen from heaven , O Lucifer , son of the morning ! how art thou cut down to the ground , which didst weaken the nations !
translation.kha: Ko syiem ka Babilonia , u khlur step baphyrnai , me la hap na bneng ! Ha kaba mynshuwa me la jop ïa ki hima , hynrei mynta la bret ïa me sha madan .

translation.en: And the angel answered and said unto me , These are the four spirits of the heavens , which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  Kine ki long ki sawlyer , ki dang shu lah wan na ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Trai ka pyrthei baroh .

translation.en: Hear ye the word which the  Lord  speaketh unto you , O house of Israel :
translation.kha: Ko paid Israel , to shahshkor ïa ka khubor ba U  Trai  u don na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And the city shall be accursed , even it , and all that are therein , to the  Lord  : only Rahab the harlot shall live , she and all that are with her in the house , because she hid the messengers that we sent .
translation.kha: Ïa ka nongbah bad baroh kiba don ha ka dei ban pynjot thiaw kum ka jingainguh ha U  Trai . Tang ïa ka Rahab ka nuti bad ïa ka longïing longsem jong ka yn pyllait im , namar ka la pynrieh ïa ki nongsyntiat jong ngi .
khnang ba haba basawdong Rehoboth pat bad phi , phin don dew Elsabad bun ka daw ban sngewsarong ïa nga ha than jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again .

And , behold , as Barak pursued Sisera , Jael came out to meet him , and said unto him , Come , and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest . And when he came into her tent , behold , Sisera lay dead , and the nail was in his temples .
translation.kha: Haba u Barak u wan wad ïa u Sisera , ka Jael ka mih shabar ban ïakynduh ïa u , bad ka ong ha u ,  Ale hangne ! Ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa u briew uba phi wad .  Kumta u la leit shapoh bad ka , bad hangta ha madan don u Sisera , uba la ïap , bad u snar pynskhem dara lyngba ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel , Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea , a remnant shall be saved :
translation.kha: Bad U Isaïah u la pyrta shaphang ki Israel :  Wat lada ki paid Israel ki bun kat u shyiap harud duriaw , pynban tang khyndiat na ki yn pynim ;
Kiba bun na ki , la ki ngeit ïa ka khubor jong u la bad pynbaptis ïa ki , bad kumba lai hajar ngut ki briew la pynïasoh sha ka kynhun ha kata ka sngi .
translation.en: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized : and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls .
But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast : but Sihon gathered all his people together , and pitched in Jahzah , and fought against Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Sihon um shym shah ïa ki Israel ba kin leh kumta . U lumlang ïa u paidïapom jong u baroh , u sher dara ha Jahas , bad u tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .
Te mynta , ko ki khun jong nga , sat ïa nga bad wat klet ïa ki khyndaiphew jong nga .
translation.en: Hear me now therefore , O ye children , and depart not from the words of my mouth .
And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father , we told him the words of my lord .
translation.kha: Ynda ngi leit phai pat sha i pa , ngi ïathuh lut ha i kat ïa kaba phi ong .
la U pyllait ïa ngi na ka bor jong ka jingdum bad u la wallam ha ka jingsuk ïa ngi sha ka jong hima U Khun ba-ieit jong u .
translation.en: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness , and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son .
I will also praise thee with the psaltery , even thy truth , O my God : unto thee will I sing with the harp , O thou Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Da shisha ngan ïaroh ïa me da ka duitara ; ngan ïaroh ïa ka jingïaineh jong me , A Blei jong nga . Ha ka duitara jong nga ngan tem ïa ki jingrwai sha me , Uta Uba Khuid ki Israel .

Nangta kanjari kyrpad ïa Anam ban nongpynkha diengsynshar nongïambriew da kaba ai ha nga ïa ki shithi sha Elparan thyllah ka ,000 Bymjukut Kaba jingïathmu Sepngi Ono da kaba bthah ïa ki ban shah ïa nga ban ïaid lyngba sha Judah Humtah
translation.en: Moreover I said unto the king , If it please the king , let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river , that they may convey me over till I come into Judah  ;
For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt , even unto this day , rising early and protesting , saying , Obey my voice .
translation.kha: Haba nga wallam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki na Ijipt , nga la maham kyntang ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa nga , bad nga la ïai maham ïa ki briew tad haduh kane ka sngi .
mynba u dang im , la ki jingai sngewbha ïa ki khun shynrang ba u ïoh na kiwei pat ki tnga jong u . Nangta phah noh kine ki khun sha ka ri kaba shaphang mihngi jngai na u khun jong u u Isaak .
translation.en: But unto the sons of the concubines , which Abraham had , Abraham gave gifts , and sent them away from Isaac his son , while he yet lived , eastward , unto the east country .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban , namarkata , kumba phi la kut jingmut , kaba ne kaba sngew kum ka kamram ; naba U Blei u ieit ïa uta ai da kaba .
translation.en: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart , so let him give ; not grudgingly , or of necessity : for God loveth a cheerful giver .
Well ; because of unbelief they were broken off , and thou standest by faith . Be not highminded , but fear :
translation.kha: Kata ka long kaba shisha . Ïa ki la pynkheiñ noh namar kim shym la ngeit , katba phi sah ha la ka jaka namar ba phi ngeit . Hynrei wat sngewsarong na ka bynta kata ; pynban , to sheptieng .
Nangta u uba ar u la put ïa la ka turoi . kaei re kaei kaba i kum u lumbah khraw uba mehding la duriaw .
translation.en: And the second angel sounded , and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea : and the third part of the sea became blood  ;

translation.kha: Mynta , lumlang ïa kiba sah jong Eliab shipai jong bteng , tur ïaleh ïa ; nongbah jingpynkit La knieh ïa ka tynjuh lade hi . Ngam kwah ban ïoh ka burom ïa ka jingïohknieh ïa ka .
translation.en: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together , and encamp against the city , and take it : lest I take the city , and it be called after my name .

translation.kha: la pyllait im ïa nga na ki bakhlaiñbor nga bad na kito baroh — Ki long kiba khlaiñbor ban ïa nga
translation.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy , and from them that hated me : for they were too strong for me .
