translation.en: Behold , while thou yet talkest there with the king , I also will come in after thee , and confirm thy words .
translation.kha: Bad u Nathan u bynrap ,  Nangta , katba phi dang ïakren bad u Syiem Dabid , ngan wan rung shapoh bad pynskhem ïa ka khana jong phi .

translation.en: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod , and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Ki teh ïa kita ki kyrwoh jong ka jingdeng shadem ha ki kyrwoh jong ka ephod da u ksai uba jngum , khnang ba kata ka jingdeng shadem kan neh halor kata ka jingpanpoh , bad ba kan ym lait na ka ephod , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him : and he was perplexed , because that it was said of some , that John was risen from the dead  ;
translation.kha: Haba u Herod , u nongsynshar ka Galilaïa , u la ïohsngew shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia , u la kulmar jingmut , namar katto katne ngut ki briew ki la ong ba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la mihpat .

translation.en: Princes also did sit and speak against me : but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes .
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar ki ïakynduh lang bad ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga , hynrei ngan pule bniah ïa ki jinghikai jong me .

Haba ka pyrem ka la poi , u Nebukhadnessar syiem u ïa ïalam u Jehoïakhin sha Babilon kum u koidi , bad u rah lang ïa ki jingkynshew jong ka Templ . Nangta Nebukhadnessar u u pynlong u ïa Sedekaïah u kñi jong u Jehoïakhin kum u syiem ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And when the year was expired , king Nebuchadnezzar sent , and brought him to Babylon , with the goodly vessels of the house of the  Lord  , and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Katba u rangbah synshar u leit ban khot ïa u Mikaïah , ong u ha u , na Baroh kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïathuhlypa ba u syiem un jop bad phi ruh ka ba bha phin leh kumjuh .
translation.en: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him , saying , Behold now , the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth : let thy word , I pray thee , be like the word of one of them , and speak that which is good .
Yea , whereto might the strength of their hands profit me , in whom old age was perished ?
translation.kha: Ki la long ki briew ki bym lah ban leh ei ei shuh , kiba tlot palat ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam , even to cut it off , and to destroy it from off the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Kane ka pop kaba u la leh ka wanrah ïa ka jingpynjot bad jingduh jingdam noh ka longïing syiem jong u .

jingkthang to phin nang roi ha ka jingaiei bad ka jingtip ïa U Jisu Khrist siew U Trai bad pynper Nongpynim jong ngi shijur Ha u Naïoth Thiat long ka burom Kynrad mynta bad shaduh bymjukut ïatreilang Amen .
translation.en: But grow in grace , and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ . To him be glory both now and for ever . Amen .
And the skin of the bullock , and all his flesh , with his head , and with his legs , and his inwards , and his dung ,
translation.kha: Hynrei un shim ïa ka snieh , ïa ka doh met , ïa ka khlieh , ïa ki kjat , bad ïa ki doh jem ba kynthup ïa ki snier ,

Hynrei haba phi duwai , phi dei ban ngeit bad ban ym artatien da lei lei . Uno Jehoash uba artatien u jingkynjah bato ka jingat kum ha ka Etam jingshahshitom kaba la beh shym ba la pynshad kynting da ka lyer mokotduma
translation.en: But let him ask in faith , nothing wavering . For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed .

translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha u , Dei lyngba u sngewieit ba men ïoh ïa ki khun ki ksiew kiba nga la kular .
translation.en: Of whom it was said , That in Isaac shall thy seed be called :

translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei ki long khyndiat , ki long ki nongwei ha ka Kanaan .
translation.en: When ye were but few , even a few , and strangers in it .

translation.kha: bad u lyoh u kynriah noh na ka Ïingjaiñ hangta , hi ka sniehdoh jong ka Miriam ka la tap da ka ñiangthohlieh jingpang bad ka la kylla lieh kum ka ïor . Haba u Aaron u peit ïa ka bad u ïohi ka ba la ngat ïa kata ka jingpang ,
translation.en: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle  ; and , behold , Miriam became leprous , white as snow : and Aaron looked upon Miriam , and , behold , she was leprous .

translation.kha: Jamnia ka pynlong ïa u syiem ban sngewsih haduh katta katta , hynrei um lah ban kyrngah jingshitom ka namar ki jingsmai ba u la pynlong ha khmat jong baroh kiba baseisoh la khot sngewbha .
translation.en: And the king was exceeding sorry  ; yet for his oath s sake , and for their sakes which sat with him , he would not reject her .
In those days there was no king in Israel : every man did that which was right in his own eyes .
translation.kha: Ym shym la don syiem ha Israel ha kata ka por . Uwei pa uwei u leh katba u sngewbha .
Kumta u Jephthah u leit bad ki nongïalam ka Gilead , bad u paidbah u thung ïa kum u nongsynshar bad jong ki . U Jephthah u pynpaw ïa ki kyndon na ka liang jong ha Mispah ha khmat U .
translation.en: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead , and the people made him head and captain over them : and Jephthah uttered all his words before the  Lord  in Mizpah .

translation.kha: Bad Trai u la bteng , Shahshkor kaba uta nongbishar bamsap u la ong .
translation.en: And the Lord said ,  Hear what the unjust judge saith .
And they did eat , and were all filled : and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la bam bad ki la kdang , bad ki synran ki la lum khat-ar tukri na kaei kaba la sah tam .

translation.en: For with what judgment ye judge , ye shall be judged : and with what measure ye mete , it shall be measured to you again .
translation.kha: naba U Blei un bishar ïa phi ha kajuh ka rukom kumba phi bishar ïa kiwei pat , bad un pyndei ha phi ïa kijuh ki jingthew kiba phi pyndei ïa kiwei pat .
U , u Aaron , bad khun shynrang jong , sait ïa la ki kti bad ïa la ki kjat
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat :

translation.kha: U Jonathan u ïateh jingïadei jutang paralok bad u Dabid namar ka jingieit bajylliew ïa u .
translation.en: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant , because he loved him as his own soul .

translation.kha: U Shimei u la sdang tipthuh kawang maw rep u Dabid bad ïa ki lano synshar jong u , wat haba la ker tawiar ïa u Dabid da ki rangbah jong u bad pdiang nongïada jong u .
translation.en: And he cast stones at David , and at all the servants of king David : and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left .

translation.kha: Jisu u la ong ha ki , Ki syiem jong kiba mane blei thala don ka halor ki briew ki , bad ki kam ka nam ba ki dei ‘ Ki paralok jong u
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them  ; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors .

translation.kha: U ong ha nga , Ka jingpynjot kan thnam na ka phang bashatei halor baroh kiba shong basah ha ka kane ri ,
translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land .
And after he had seen the vision , immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia , assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Paul u la ïoh ïa kane ka jingïohipaw , ngi la khreh ban leit sha Makedonia , namar ngi la rai ba U Blei u la khot ïa ngi ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha sha ki briew hangta .

U Trai da lade Kper klongsnam ïaleh pyrshah ïa synduk , bad poi-pyrkhat phi yn sa lute Jar ki briew kiba jynreiñ ki la long ki sabut jong phi . Haba kane ka jia , phan uwei baroh un tip ba U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: For , behold , I will shake mine hand upon them , and they shall be a spoil to their servants : and ye shall know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me .
But when he saw the multitudes , he was moved with compassion on them , because they fainted , and were scattered abroad , as sheep having no shepherd .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingsngewsynei na ka bynta jong ki , namar ki la khuslai bad kim lah ban leh ei ei , kum ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai .

translation.en: I will pass through all thy flock to day , removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle , and all the brown cattle among the sheep , and the spotted and speckled among the goats : and of such shall be my hire .
translation.kha: Shah ba ngan ïaid hapdeng ki kynhun langbrot jong phi mynta ka sngi bad ban shim ïa baroh ki khunlangbrot baïong bad ïa ki khunblang baroh kiba thohbria bad thohbroin . Kata kan long ka bainong kaba nga kwah .
Nga la ong ïa me ban shah ïa u khun jong nga ban leit , khnang ba un 35 mane ïa nga thohbroin hynrei me bapli kyntait . Mynta te ngan pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong jong me .’
translation.en: And I say unto thee , Let my son go , that he may serve me : and if thou refuse to let him go , behold , I will slay thy son , even thy firstborn .

translation.kha: Ki la don baroh khat-ar ngut rangbah .
translation.en: And all the men were about twelve .
Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the  Lord  : we have blessed you out of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ! Na ka Templ jong U  Trai  ngi kyrkhu ïa me .
bad u la ong ha Trai U , Balei keiñ ba me la pynjynjar ïa sat nga katne katne ? Balei ba sngewbha mem ïa nga ? Balei ba me la ai ha nga ka jingkitkhlieh ïa kine ki paidbah baroh ?
translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant ? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight , that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me ?
And he brought him forth abroad , and said , Look now toward heaven , and tell the stars , if thou be able to number them : and he said unto him , So shall thy seed be .
translation.kha: U Trai u ïalam ïa u shabar bad u ong ,  Khmih ïa ka sahit bneng , bad pyrshang ñiew ïa ki khlur ; men ïoh bun ki khun ki ksiew kat kita .

translation.en: Far above all principality , and power , and might , and dominion , and every name that is named , not only in this world , but also in that which is to come :
translation.kha: U Khrist u synshar hangta halor baroh ki nongsynshar ba kynja bneng , ki bor synshar , ki bor , bad ki kynrad ; u don ka kyrteng kaba kham hajrong ban ïa kiwei pat ki kyrteng kiba don ka bor ha kane ka pyrthei mynta bad ka ban sa wan .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem , the sword , and the famine , and the noisome beast , and the pestilence , to cut off from it man and beast ?
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan phah ïa ki saw tylli ki jingpynshitom basniew tam jong nga ha ka Jerusalem — ka thma , ka  nemsniew , ki mradkhlaw , bad ka jingpang — ban pynjot ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh .

translation.en: Wherefore , my brethren , when ye come together to eat , tarry one for another .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , haba phi ïawanlang ban bam ïa ka Jingkhawai U Trai , to da ïa-ap paralok hi .

translation.en: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment , which was inflicted of many .
translation.kha: Ka la biang ba ïa une u briew la pynshitom ha kane ka rukom da kiba bun na phi .

translation.en: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God , and laid it upon the ass , and brought it back : and the old prophet came to the city , to mourn and to bury him .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa tymmen u shim ïa kata ka metïap bad u kyntiew ïa ka halor ka kada , bad u leit kit pat ïa ka sha Bethel ban ïam sngewsih bad ban tep ïa ka .

translation.en: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell , neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption .
translation.kha: namar men ym iehnoh ïa nga ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ; men ym shah ïa u shakri baïaineh jong me ban pyut hapoh ka jingtep .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul , that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David , and Jonathan loved him as his own soul .
translation.kha: U Saul bad u Dabid ki la dep ka jingïakren hapdeng jong ki . Hadien kata , u Jonathan u khun jong u Saul u la sngew jan eh ïa u Dabid bad u sngewieit ïa u kumba u ieit ïa lade hi .

Nga hukum ïa ki Lebi ban pynkhuid lade bad ban leit bad pahara ïa ki khyrdop ban pynthikna ba ïa ka sngi la sumar ka . Kynmaw ïa nga , A Blei , na ka bynta kane ruh , bad tyngkai ïa nga namar jingieit jong me .
translation.en: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves , and that they should come and keep the gates , to sanctify the sabbath day . Remember me , O my God , concerning this also , and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy .

translation.kha: Ki phah bad ïai phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban leit khot sngewbha ïa ki rangbah ban wan na sha waitsum bah jingïam bad ki rangbah ki Esther wan . Baroh ar ngut shi para ki sum bad tah ïa khar ñiuhmat bad rong ïa pynïar riewïaleh rumal .
translation.en: And furthermore , that ye have sent for men to come from far , unto whom a messenger was sent  ; and , lo , they came : for whom thou didst wash thyself , paintedst thy eyes , and deckedst thyself with ornaments ,
Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because they say unto you , Thou land devourest up men , and hast bereaved thy nations  ;
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Ka long kaba shisha kaba ki briew ki ong ba ka ri ka bam briew , bad ki ong ba ka knieh noh na ka jaitbynriew ïa ki khun jong ka .

translation.en: If ye will fear the  Lord  , and serve him , and obey his voice , and not rebel against the commandment of the  Lord  , then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the  Lord  your God :
translation.kha: Lada phi tiengburom ïa U  Trai  , phi shakri ïa u , phi shahshkor ïa u , bad phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , bad lada ma phi bad u syiem uba synshar ïa phi , phi bud ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , baroh kan manbha bad phi .

translation.en: And ye shall eat it in the holy place , because it is thy due , and thy sons  due , of the sacrifices of the  Lord  made by fire : for so I am commanded .
translation.kha: Bam ïa ka ha ka jaka kaba khuid ; ka long ka bynta kaba dei ka jong me bad jong ki khun shynrang jong me na kata ka jingbam ba la kñia ainguh sha U  Trai . Kata ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga .

translation.en: And I will strengthen the house of Judah , and I will save the house of Joseph , and I will bring them again to place them  ; for I have mercy upon them : and they shall be as though I had not cast them off : for I am the  Lord  their God , and will hear them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ki paid Judah ; ngan pyllait im ïa ki paid Israel . Ngan don ka jingsngewsynei ïa ki bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki baroh sha ïing . Kin long kum kiba ngam pat ju kyntait ïa ki . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ; ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .

translation.en: When I had waited , ( for they spake not , but stood still , and answered no more  ; )
translation.kha: Hato ngan ïai ap haduh ba kin da sngap jar ? Ki shu ïeng hangto khlem don ei ei shuh ban ong .

translation.en: Therefore my people are gone into captivity , because they have no knowledge : and their honourable men are famished , and their multitude dried up with thirst .
translation.kha: kumta ïa phi yn rah noh kum ki koidi . Ki nongïalam jong phi kin shahthngan haduh ban ïap , bad ki riewpaidbah kin ïap thynrang .

translation.en: For neither did his brethren believe in him .
translation.kha: ( Wat ki para shynrang jong u hi kim shym la ngeit ha u . )
Kumta u Jehoshaphat u nang roi nang khrawbor .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly  ; and he built in Judah castles , and cities of store .

translation.kha: Nga long U Blei ngan bad ïailong . Ym don u ban im lait na ka bor jong nga ; ym don uba lah ban pynkylla ïa kaei ba nga leh .
translation.en: Yea , before the day was I am he  ; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand : I will work , and who shall let it ?
And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother s brethren , and communed with them , and with all the family of the house of his mother s father , saying ,
translation.kha: U Abimelekh u khun jong u Gideon u leit sha ka nongrit Shekhem ha kaba ki ba-ha-ïing baroh jong ka kmie jong u ki shong ki sah , bad u ong ha ki

Ha kawei ka sngi u ut bad jingpynkylla rangbah ksiew u baroh ki kirteng khie dang step phyrngab bad ki la sher dara harud ka Umpohliew Harod . Ki Midian pat ki sher bymneh shaphang shatei na ki , ha ka them kaba Babha u Lum Moreh .
translation.en: Then Jerubbaal , who is Gideon , and all the people that were with him , rose up early , and pitched beside the well of Harod : so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them , by the hill of Moreh , in the valley .
But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism , he said unto them , O generation of vipers , who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?
translation.kha: Haba u Ïoannis u la ïohi ïa shibun ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi kiba la wan sha u ban shah pynbaptis , u la ong ha ki ,  Phi ki bseiñ — uei uba la ïathuh ha phi ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynshitom kaba U Blei un sa phah ?
Ki briew ki la wan sha u na Jerusalem , na ka probins baroh kawei jong ka Judia prum na kylleng ka ri kaba mem ka wah Balah .
translation.en: Then went out to him Jerusalem , and all Judaea , and all the region round about Jordan ,

translation.kha: U ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ammon lyngkar ïa ka Bethanath jingïabujli jong u bad u jop ïa ki jingainguh Nangta u pynbor ïa Simeon jingpynkit ban siew synñia u ka khajna man ka snem haduh Shemida snem kumne jingpynshisha sngewma hajar sawspah kilo pli rupa :37 shihajar ton iohsngew kew , bad shihajar ton u barli .
translation.en: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites , and prevailed against them . And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver , and ten thousand measures of wheat , and ten thousand of barley . So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him , both the second year , and the third .

translation.kha: Pynjot ïa ïa-pyrta pa JINGIEID sahkynmaw jaitbynriew kat ïa kaba U Trai U Blei jong ba-tyrkhong u Dohkha Israel phi , bad wat jingsotti ïa ki . Wat mane shongkha ki blei jong ki , namar kata kan long ka jingma ïa me .
translation.en: And thou shalt consume all the people which the  Lord  thy God shall deliver thee  ; thine eye shall have no pity upon them : neither shalt thou serve their gods  ; for that will be a snare unto thee .

translation.kha: U la kyrshut ïa ka jong nga ha khyndew la pynkheiñ ïa ki bniat jong mawria .
translation.en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones , he hath covered me with ashes .
That which is far off , and exceeding deep , who can find it out ?
translation.kha: Kumno uno uno un shem aïu ka jingim ka mut ? Ka long kaba jylliew eh ïa ngi , kaba eh than ban sngewthuh .

translation.en: Therefore say thou unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye unto me , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will turn unto you , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi , ‘ To wan phai sha nga bad ngan wan phai sha phi .

translation.en: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul .
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju leh pop da kaba duwai ba kin ïap .
Me long mareh Blei jong nga , bad nga ainguh jingïoh me ; ngan pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong me .
translation.en: Thou art my God , and I will praise thee : thou art my God , I will exalt thee .

translation.kha: Ngan tap ïa jingpynjot lumbah da artat metïap Nahum bad ki met jong kito kiba shah jingphla ha ka thma Shuhshuh tap ïa shaiñ lumrit bad ki them .
translation.en: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men : in thy hills , and in thy valleys , and in all thy rivers , shall they fall that are slain with the sword .

And Saul said , Disperse yourselves among the people , and say unto them , Bring me hither every man his ox , and every man his sheep , and slay them here , and eat  ; and sin not against the  Lord  in eating with the blood . And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night , and slew them there .
translation.kha: Nangta u ai sa kawei ka hukum :  Khie leit sha ki briew bad ong ïa ki ban wallam ïa la ki jingri bad ki langbrot hangne . Ki dei ban pynïap ïa ki bad bam ïa ki hangne ; kim dei ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka .  Kumta ha kata ka miet baroh ki wallam ïa la ki jingri bad ki pynïap ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: When the sin , which they have sinned against it , is known , then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin , and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: kumta haba la bna ïa kata ka pop , u paidlang un wanlam ïa u masi lyngraw kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop . Kin wanrah sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord , and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink  ; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost , even from his mother s womb .
translation.kha: Un long u briew uba khraw ha khmat U Trai . Um dei ban dih kano kano ka waiñ lane ka jingdih kaba khor . Naduh ka jingkha ïa u , yn pyndap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,

Nangta u syiem u la ai ki hukum ban kem ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba la lah mudui u ïa Daniel , bad la bret ïa ki , lem bad ki tnga jong ki bad ki khun jong ki , shapoh ka thliew kaba dap ki da sing . Ha shuwa ban kin poi sha tbian jong ka thliew , ki sing ki la kynrup ïa ki bad ïa pynkheiñ ki shyieng jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And the king commanded , and they brought those men which had accused Daniel , and they cast them into the den of lions , them , their children , and their wives  ; and the lions had the mastery of them , and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den .

translation.kha: Nangta kiba hok kin jubab u ïa , ‘ Mynno ko , Trai , ba ngi la ju ïohi ïa me ba me thngan bad ba ngi bsa ïa me , lane ba me sliang bad ba ngi ai jingdih ïa ? me
translation.en: Then shall the righteous answer him , saying , Lord , when saw we thee an hungred , and fed thee ? or thirsty , and gave thee drink ?

translation.kha: Ka la long ka ïingjaiñ jong ksem blei Molekh uba phi Wad bah , bad ka dur jong u Rephan juh u blei khlur jong phi ; ki la ñiuhmat ki jingdih kiba Ninebeh ïohlait thaw ïa ka ban mane . Karpos kumta ngan Ïingjaiñ ïa phi sha ka jinglongmraw sha palat ka Babilon .’
translation.en: Yea , ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch , and the star of your god Remphan , figures which ye made to worship them : and I will carry you away beyond Babylon .

translation.kha: Hato la dei ki wah kiba la pynlong ïa me ban A bitar , Trai ! Hato la dei ka duriaw kaba la ïa pynlong me ban bitar shla ? Me shong kulai halor ki lyoh ; u lyoh ka erïong u la long ka kali ïapom jong , me mynba me la wallam jingjop ha la ki briew .
translation.en: Was the  Lord  displeased against the rivers ? was thine anger against the rivers ? was thy wrath against the sea , that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation ?
Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God : on them which fell , severity ; but toward thee , goodness , if thou continue in his goodness : otherwise thou also shalt be cut off .
translation.kha: Hangne ngi ïohi katno U Blei u long uba sbun bad katno u long uba eh . U long uba eh ïa kito kiba la kyllon , hynrei uba sbun ïa phi — lada phi ïaineh ha ka jingsbun jong u . Hynrei lada phim leh kumta , ma phi ruh phin sa shah pynkheiñ .
bad pneh pynkyrpang ri shyiap . Phi la ïohi :5 u batlot bah ïa Shimham khlem jingmynsaw baroh shi lynter lynti haduh kane ka jaka , kumba pur kpa u bah ïa la ummat khun .’
translation.en: And in the wilderness , where thou hast seen how that the  Lord  thy God bare thee , as a man doth bear his son , in all the way that ye went , until ye came into this place .
Rooted and built up in him , and stablished in the faith , as ye have been taught , abounding therein with thanksgiving .
translation.kha: Pynngam jylliew ïa ki nongrim jong phi ha u , to tei ïa ka jingim jong phi halor jong u , bad to nang kham khlaiñ ha ka jingngeit jong phi , kumba la hikai ïa phi . Bad to long kiba la pyndap da ka jingainguh .
Nangta u syiem Ahab u hukum ïa uwei nongleh-ieit ki Sniew ïalong , Kem ïa u Mikaïah syaid leit lam ïa u sha u Amon , u lat ka nongbah , bad sha u khun skhem Joash pynstad
translation.en: Then the king of Israel said , Take ye Micaiah , and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city , and to Joash the king s son  ;
But if a man live many years , and rejoice in them all  ; yet let him remember the days of darkness  ; for they shall be many . All that cometh is vanity .
translation.kha: To long uba sngewnguh ïa kawei pa kawei ka snem ba phi im . Kam pher haduh katno phi im , kynmaw ba phin ïap kham slem . Kam don kano kano ruh ïa ka ban khmih lynti .

translation.en: And the foolish said unto the wise , Give us of your oil  ; for our lamps are gone out .
translation.kha: Nangta kita kiba bieit ki la ong ha kiba stad , ‘ Ai lem ha ngi ïa ka umphniang jong phi , namar ki sharak jong ngi ki la jan lip .’

translation.en: After that , he was seen of James ; then of all the apostles .
translation.kha: Nangta u la paw ha u Jakob , bad hadien ha baroh ki Apostol .
Nangta shim ka ïa ki jaiñ kiba bha jong tam u Iso , ïa kiba ka buh ha ïing , bad ka pynphong ïa ki ha u Jakob .
translation.en: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau , which were with her in the house , and put them upon Jacob her younger son :

translation.kha: Ki la ong para ma ki , Hato kam shym la long kum ka ding kaba klang hapoh jong ngi mynba u la kren ha ngi lynti batai ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ha ngi ?
translation.en: And they said one to another , Did not our heart burn within us , while he talked with us by the way , and while he opened to us the scriptures ?
After these things , when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased , he remembered Vashti , and what she had done , and what was decreed against her .
translation.kha: Hadien , wat haba ka jingbitar u syiem ka la pjah , u ïai pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba ka Bashti ka la leh bad shaphang ka jingpynbna jong u pyrshah ïa ka .

translation.en: And he said , Go forth , and stand upon the mount before the  Lord . And , behold , the  Lord  passed by , and a great and strong wind rent the mountains , and brake in pieces the rocks before the  Lord   ; but the  Lord  was not in the wind : and after the wind an earthquake  ; but the  Lord  was not in the earthquake :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Mih shabar bad ïeng ha khmat jong nga halor u lum .  Hadien kata , U  Trai  u la ïaid nangta bad u la phah ïa ka lyer bajur kaba la kad arliang ïa ki lum bad pynkhynñiuh ïa ki mawsiang — hynrei U  Trai  um shym don ha ka lyer . Ka lyer ka sangeh ban beh , bad nangta la khie u jumai — hynrei U  Trai  um shym don ha u jumai .

translation.en: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee , O  Lord   ; thou art great , and thy name is great in might .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , ym don uno uno uba kum ma me ; me long uba khrawbor , bad ka kyrteng jong me ka long kaba khraw bad kaba donbor .

translation.en: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies , and before them that seek their life : and I will bring evil upon them , even my fierce anger , saith the  Lord   ; and I will send the sword after them , till I have consumed them :
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki briew ka Elam ban sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong ki , kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa ki . Ha ka jingbitar bakhraw jong nga ngan pynjot ïa ki briew ka Elam bad ngan phah ki shipai pyrshah ïa ki haduh ba ngan da pynduh khoit ïa ki .
katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum ! Phi la bat ïa u shabi uba plie ïa ka sha ka ïing jong ; phi hi leit shapoh , bad phi khang ïa kito pyrshang ban rung !
translation.en: Woe unto you , lawyers ! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge : ye entered not in yourselves , and them that were entering in ye hindered .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ei ha ei kata ka sngi yn ñiew uba la shah tait na ki briew U Blei .
translation.en: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day , he shall be cut off from among his people .
It is thou , O king , that art grown and become strong : for thy greatness is grown , and reacheth unto heaven , and thy dominion to the end of the earth .
translation.kha: Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi long u dieng , uba jrong bad uba khlaiñ . Phi la long khraw haduh katta kat ban kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng , bad ka bor jong phi ka ïar halor ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

translation.en: But , lo , he speaketh boldly , and they say nothing unto him . Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ ?
translation.kha: Ha khmih ! U ïakren ha u paidbah , bad kim ong ei ei pyrshah ïa u ! Hato ka lah ban long ba kim ithuh shisha ïa u ba u dei U Messaïah ?
Don ka Ashdod bad ka Gasa , lem bad ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , kynjoh kiba sha ka wahduid ha khappud jong ka Ijipt bad ka jong rud ka Duriaw Mediterranian .
translation.en: Ashdod with her towns and her villages , Gaza with her towns and her villages , unto the river of Egypt , and the great sea , and the border thereof :

translation.kha: ka ri Naphtali baroh kawei ; ki Ephraim ri bad Manasseh ; ka ri Judah shaduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian shaphang sepngi ;
translation.en: And all Naphtali , and the land of Ephraim , and Manasseh , and all the land of Judah , unto the utmost sea ,

translation.kha: Naduh mynnyngkong nga pynrit tip lypa ïa kaei sawa ban mih ; la slem Dara nga la ïathuh lypa ïa kaei ka ban jia . Nga la ong ba ki jingthmu jong nga kin ym duh da lei lei , ngan leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga thmu ban Nangno .
translation.en: Declaring the end from the beginning , and from ancient times the things that are not yet done , saying , My counsel shall stand , and I will do all my pleasure :
And it came to pass , that , when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary , the babe leaped in her womb  ; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost :
translation.kha: Haba ka Elisabeth ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkhublei jong ka Mari , i khunlung i la khih hapoh jong ka . La pyndap ïa ka Elisabeth da U Mynsiem Bakhuid
Hynrei ma me , , me long u syiem junom , bad men synshar kut por .
translation.en: Thou , O  Lord  , remainest for ever  ; thy throne from generation to generation .
And the prayer of faith shall save the sick , and the Lord shall raise him up  ; and if he have committed sins , they shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingduwai ba la pynlong ha ka jingngeit kan pynkhiah ïa u briew uba pang ; U Trai un sa ai biang ha u ïa ka jingkoit jingkhiah , bad ïa ki pop kiba u la leh yn map .
Ngan halor ka Templ bad ngan kloi shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai baroh ba yn pynlong hangne ,
translation.en: Now mine eyes shall be open , and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place .
But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight , a perfect and just measure shalt thou have : that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
translation.kha: Pyndonkam hok ïa ki mawthew bad ki diengthew kiba beit , khnang ba phin im slem ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .

translation.en: The  Lord  judge between me and thee , and the  Lord  avenge me of thee : but mine hand shall not be upon thee .
translation.kha: To U  Trai  un bishar mano ba bakla napdeng jong ngi ! To un pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingleh jong phi pyrshah ïa nga , naba ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa phi da lei lei ruh .
Haba la ïathuh ha u Dabid ba u Ahithophel u ïasoh la lang bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong u Absalom , u la duwai , Ko Trai , sngewbha pynpulom ïa ka jingaibuit Ahithophel u .
translation.en: And one told David , saying , Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom . And David said , O  Lord  , I pray thee , turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness .
And there are diversities of operations , but it is the same God which worketh all in all .
translation.kha: Don bun ki jinglah ban shakri kiba ïapher , hynrei ujuh U Blei uba pynlah ïa baroh na ka bynta ka jingshakri bakyrpang jong ki .
jingwoh Israel ki Tnat Baibl lade ïa ki jingri bad ïa Daberath mar ki mata ba ki ïoh kurup na ka nongbah , kumba katsha Trai u la hukum ïa Nod Joshua .
translation.en: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves , according unto the word of the  Lord  which he commanded Joshua .

translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ha ka kan sdang ban peitbeiñ ïa u tnga jong ka tang ïohsngew ïa kaei ka mahadei ka la leh . Kin ong , ‘ U syiem Serksis u hukum ïa ka Bashti , mahadei , wan sha u ka kyntait .’
translation.en: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women , so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes , when it shall be reported , The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him , but she came not .
That every man should let his manservant , and every man his maidservant , being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess , go free  ; that none should serve himself of them , to wit , of a Jew his brother .
translation.kha: U syiem Sedekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem ki la pynlong ka jingïakut ban pyllaitluid noh ïa ki mraw Hebru , ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , khnang ba uno uno ruh un ym don u para jait Israel kum u mraw .

translation.en: And he said , Amos , what seest thou ? And I said , A basket of summer fruit . Then said the  Lord  unto me , The end is come upon my people of Israel  ; I will not again pass by them any more .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli ,  Ko Amos , me ïohi aïu ?   Shi shang ki soh ,  nga la jubab . Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Kaba kut ka la wan ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan ym kylla shuh la ka jingmut shaphang kaba pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of all his servants .
translation.kha: U syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la pdiang ïa kane ka jingai jingmut , bad u ong ha ki ,
Nangta U Jisu u la ktah ïa ki khmat jong jingbudnam bad u la ong , jingiap ba kan jia long , te , kumba phi ngeit ! —
translation.en: Then touched he their eyes , saying ,  According to your faith be it unto you .
And the multitudes that went before , and that followed , cried , saying , Hosanna to the Son of David : Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord  ; Hosanna in the highest .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïaid ha khmat jong U Jisu bad kito kiba la bud nadien ki la sdang ban pyrta ,  To ïaroh ïa U khun u Dabid ! U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei !
Mynta ki la ïap noh bad kin ym im ; ki ki kin mih , namar me la pynshitom bad pynjot ki . Ym don uwei ruh u ban shuh ïa .
translation.en: They are dead , they shall not live  ; they are deceased , they shall not rise : therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them , and made all their memory to perish .

A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence , and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee : and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee  ; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds , and I will draw out a sword after them .
translation.kha: Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki briew jong pha kin ïap na ka jingpang bad jingthngan ha ka nongbah ; shi bynta pat kin ïap da ka waitlam shabar ka nongbah ; bad ïa ka shi bynta kaba dang sah ngan pynsakma sha ki sawlyer , bad ngan beh ïa ki nadien da ka waitlam .
Hato kane ka pynpaw kumba ngi pynsarong biang shaphang ïa lade ? Hato ka lah ban long ba , kumba long lem kiwei ki briew , ruh ngi donkam ki ïa shithi pynithuh sha phi lane na phi ?
translation.en: Do we begin again to commend ourselves ? or need we , as some others , epistles of commendation to you , or letters of commendation from you ?
Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him : but Jesus sent him away , saying ,
translation.kha: Uta u briew na uba ki ksuid ki la mihnoh u la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Shah ïa nga ban leit lem bad me .  Hynrei U Jisu u la phah noh ïa u , u da ong ,

U Jisu u la hukum ïa u mynsiem Khim Sngap jar bad Sarai na une u briew ! U mynsiem bymkhuid u la bret Kyndong uta iaka briew sha mangi ha khmat jong ki , bad bajhieh la mihnoh na u ïasnohlang pyntyllun Kat ei ei ïaphai u .
translation.en: And Jesus rebuked him , saying ,  Hold thy peace , and come out of him .  And when the devil had thrown him in the midst , he came out of him , and hurt him not .
Ye hypocrites , well did Esaias prophesy of you , saying ,
translation.kha: Phi kiba arsap ! A katno ka long kaba dei haba u Isaïah u la ïathuhlypa shaphang jong phi !
Te ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei kin ïohi ba U Trai u la jied ïa phi ban long briew ki jong u , bad kin ïa sheptieng phi .
translation.en: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the  Lord   ; and they shall be afraid of thee .
And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet  ; and none of them was cleansed , saving Naaman the Syrian .
translation.kha: Bad la don bun ki briew kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh kiba la im ha Israel ha ka por jong u Elisha u nongïathuhlypa ; pynban ym shym la pynkhiah ïa uno uno na ki , hynrei , tang ïa u Naaman u nong Syria .
Ki rangbah synshar jong ki la ong ïa kiei kiei kiba kham sniew shaphang Trai U Blei bad ïa Hesekaïah , u shakri U Trai .
translation.en: And his servants spake yet more against the  Lord  God , and against his servant Hezekiah .
And it shall come to pass , when I bring a cloud over the earth , that the bow shall be seen in the cloud :
translation.kha: Ha man ba nga tap ïa ka suiñbneng da u lyoh , bad ba u simpyllieng u paw ,

translation.en: But the angel of the  Lord  did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife . Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Katba ki thylliej ding ki dang kiew shajrong na ka duwan , u Manoah bad ka tnga jong u ki ïohi ïa u angel U  Trai  ba u kiew sha bneng ha ki thylliej ding . U Manoah hangta u sngewthuh ba uta u briew u dei u angel jong U  Trai  , bad ma u lem bad ka tnga jong u ki dem khrup ha khyndew . Kim shym ïohi shuh ïa u angel .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the first day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai . . .    ha ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingshah ringmraw , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: So shall Beth–el do unto you because of your great wickedness : in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kaei ka ban jia ha phi , ki briew ka Bethel , namar ka pop bashyrkhei kaba phi la leh . Mar ïasdang ka thma , u syiem Israel un ïap .

translation.en: And when he was gone , a lion met him by the way , and slew him : and his carcase was cast in the way , and the ass stood by it , the lion also stood by the carcase .
translation.kha: Ha lynti , u la ïakynduh ïa u sing uba la pynïap ïa u . Ka metïap jong u ka don ha ka lynti bah , bad ka kada bad u sing ki ïeng ha syndah jong ka .

translation.en: And now , behold , we are in thine hand : as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us , do .
translation.kha: Mynta ngi don hapoh ka bor jong phi , leh ha ngi ïa kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long kaba dei .
Hangta U Trai u la ong ha nga , To pynïoh ïa ki mawbah bad tep ha ka sorki jong jingsiang ha khmat ka khyrdop sha ka sorkar don ha ka nongbah , to ai ba katto katne ngut ki kin ïa me ba leh ïa kata .
translation.en: Take great stones in thine hand , and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln , which is at the entry of Pharaoh s house in Tahpanhes , in the sight of the men of Judah  ;

translation.kha: Ïa ki kamram la pynkhamti sngewthait ki khun ki ksiew Armagedon u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .
translation.en: Of the Amramites , and the Izharites , the Hebronites , and the Uzzielites :
The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might : they shall lay their hand upon their mouth , their ears shall be deaf .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ïa kane bad kin sngewkhuslai wat hapdeng ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki baroh . Ha ka jinglyngngoh kin set ïa la ki shyntur bad tap ïa la ki shkor .
Ki buh ïa shakuriaw ksiar hapdeng jong kita ki baroh sawdong , kumba U Trai la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: A bell and a pomegranate , a bell and a pomegranate , round about the hem of the robe to minister in  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant , and they that escape out of mount Zion : the zeal of the  Lord  of hosts shall do this .
translation.kha: Kin don ki briew ha Jerusalem bad halor u lum Seïon ki ban lait im , namar U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la thew ban pynjia ïa kane .

translation.en: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines , and to the border of Egypt .
translation.kha: U long u nongsynshar uba hakhlieh tam na ki syiem baroh ha ka thain naduh ka wah Ïuphratis haduh ka ri Philistia bad haduh khappud ka Ijipt .

translation.en: And Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , Skin for skin , yea , all that a man hath will he give for his life .
translation.kha: U Soitan u jubab ,  U briew un iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh tang ban pynsah ïa la ka jingim .
Ngan ïalam ïa Shaphang shabar ka myllung bad Ha-ei aiti ïa phi ha ki nongwei myntri Nga la rai ïa phi ban ïap ,
translation.en: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof , and deliver you into the hands of strangers , and will execute judgments among you .

translation.kha: Trai Nongsynshar Baroh da hi u la kren ha nga ong , Ïa kane kaba sniew jong ki yn ym map da lei lei katba ki dang im . Ma nga , U Trai U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh kren .
translation.en: And it was revealed in mine ears by the  Lord  of hosts , Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die , saith the Lord  God  of hosts .

translation.kha: U la bat ïa nga jingïaphiah ka ban leit mawjam sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap bthah bad mynta nga dang im .
translation.en: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit , and his life shall see the light .
Divers weights , and divers measures , both of them are alike abomination to the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bad mawthew bymhok .

translation.en: He heard the sound of the trumpet , and took not warning  ; his blood shall be upon him . But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul .
translation.kha: Ka jingïap jong u ka long na ka jingbakla jong u hi , namar um suidñiew ïa ka jingmaham . Lada u la shahshkor un jin da la lait im .

translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien kane , u nongrah khuri jong u syiem Ijipt bad u nongshet kpu rangbah jong u ki la pynbitar ïa u syiem .

translation.en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones , he hath covered me with ashes .
translation.kha: U la kyrshut ïa ka durkhmat jong nga ha khyndew bad la pynkheiñ ïa ki bniat jong nga ha ki mawria .

Ngan long shlur Wahduid sakhi kren Rimmon shaphang kaei kaba U Khrist ïabuh kmienah leh lyngba jong nga , ban ïalam ïa ki Jentil ban kynshi ïa U Kynther khum U la leh Shahasumah kane da jingbamsap ktien bad ki kam ,
translation.en: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me , to make the Gentiles obedient , by word and deed ,
And these are they by the way side , where the word is sown  ; but when they have heard , Satan cometh immediately , and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki long kum ki symbai kiba hap ha ka lynti ïaid ; ki tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , u Soitan u wan bad u shim noh ïa ka .

translation.en: Behold , the eye of the  Lord  is upon them that fear him , upon them that hope in his mercy  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khmih sumar ïa kito kiba kohnguh ïa u , ïa kito kiba shaniah ha ka jingieit baneh jong u ,

translation.en: Wherein was written , It is reported among the heathen , and Gashmu saith it , that thou and the Jews think to rebel : for which cause thou buildest the wall , that thou mayest be their king , according to these words .
translation.kha: La thoh :  U Geshem u ong ïa nga ba ka don ka hamsaïa kaba ïaid kylleng hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kaba don marjan , ba ma phi bad ka jaitbynriew Jiw phi don jingthmu ban ïaleh pyrshah bad dei na kane ka daw balei ba phi la tei pat ïa ka kynroh . U ong ruh ba phi thmu ban pynlong ïa lade u syiem

translation.en: And the people stood afar off , and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki paidbah ki dang ïeng hi sha jngai , bad tang u Moses uba la leit sha jan u lyoh uba rben ha uba U Blei u don .

translation.en: Cut off the sower from Babylon , and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest : for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people , and they shall flee every one to his own land .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba yn bet ïa ki symbai ha kata ka ri lane ai ba yn lum ïa ka jingmih . Man uwei pa uwei u nongwei uba shong hangta un sheptieng ïa ka kynhun shipai ba tur ïaleh bad ban leit phai ïing .

translation.en: That this may be a sign among you , that when your children ask their fathers in time to come , saying , What mean ye by these stones ?
translation.kha: Kine ki maw kin pynkynmaw ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh . Hadien habud , haba ki khun ki kti jong phi ki kylli aïu kine ki maw ki mut ,

translation.en: Samuel also said unto Saul , The  Lord  sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people , over Israel : now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha u Saul ,  Dei ïa nga ba U  Trai  u la phah ban pynsleh ïa phi ban long u syiem jong ki briew jong u , ki Israel . Mynta , sngap ïa kaba U  Trai  u ong .

translation.en: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication , with the women , and Mary the mother of Jesus , and with his brethren .
translation.kha: Ki la ïalumlang tista ban duwai kum ka kynhun , ryngkat lem bad ki kynthei bad ka Mari ka kmie jong U Jisu bad ki para shynrang jong u .
Kito kiba me la pyllait im kin ïoh poi ha da jingkmen , da kaba rwai bad risa da ka jingkmen . Kin long kiba kmen junom , junom kiba laitluid na ka jingsngewsih jingkthang mynsiem

translation.en: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother , And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah ? ask for him the kingdom also  ; for he is mine elder brother  ; even for him , and for Abiathar the priest , and for Joab the son of Zeruiah .

translation.en: A fire goeth before him , and burneth up his enemies round about .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og , kings of the Amorites , and unto the land of them , whom he destroyed .

translation.en: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men , as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit ;

translation.en: But I determined this with myself , that I would not come again to you in heaviness .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la kut jingmut ban ym wan shuh sha phi ïoh ka pynsngewsih ïa phi .

translation.en: But even after that we had suffered before , and were shamefully entreated , as ye know , at Philippi , we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention .
translation.kha: Phi tip kumno ba ngi la shah lehbeiñ bad shah krenbeiñ ha Philippi shuwa ba ngin wan sha phi ha Thessaloni . Bad wat la ka la don ka jingpyrshah kaba jur , U Blei jong ngi u la ai ha ngi ka jingshlur ban ïathuh ha phi ïa ka Khubor Babha kaba wan na u .
Nangta kpa jong u , u ong ha u , Ale kham hajan khun bad doh ïa nga .
translation.en: And his father Isaac said unto him , Come near now , and kiss me , my son .

translation.kha: Lada phi leh ïa kane kumba , U Blei u hukum , phin ym pynthait ïa lade , bad kine ki briew baroh ki lah ban leit sha hadien ïing ba la bishar ïa ki jingïakajia jong ki .
translation.en: If thou shalt do this thing , and God command thee so , then thou shalt be able to endure , and all this people shall also go to their place in peace .
For ye were sometimes darkness , but now are ye light in the Lord : walk as children of light :
translation.kha: Phi hi phi la ju long mynno mynno ha ka jingdum , hynrei namar phi la long ki briew jong U Trai , phi long ha ka jingshai . Kumta phi dei ban im kum ki briew kiba don ha ka jingshai ,

translation.en: Say , I am your sign : like as I have done , so shall it be done unto them : they shall remove and go into captivity .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba kaei kaba me la leh ka dei ka dak jong kaei ka ban jia ha ki — kin long ki nongphetwir bad kiba shah ring koidi .

translation.en: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah . And Saul said , God hath delivered him into mine hand  ; for he is shut in , by entering into a town that hath gates and bars .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u la leit sha Keilah , bad u ong ,  U Blei u la buh ïa u ha ka bor jong nga . U Dabid u la pynngat ïa lade da kaba leit sha ka nongrit ba la ker kynroh bad ki khyrdop kiba skhem .

translation.en: To keep the commandments of the  Lord  , and his statutes , which I command thee this day for thy good ?
translation.kha: Nga ai ïa ki ha phi mynta ka sngi na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi ïa phi hi .
Ki nonghikai Sebah Hukum bad ki Pharisi ki long kiba la pynkupbor ban batai Mawsiang iakane Hukum u mad .
translation.en: Saying ,  The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses  seat :
And likewise he that had received two , he also gained other two .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom u shakri uba la ïohpdiang ar hajar tylli ki sbai u la ïohnong sa ar hajar .

translation.en: But I say , that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice , they sacrifice to devils , and not to God : and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils .
translation.kha: Em! Kaei kaba nga ong ka long ba ïa kaei kaba la kñia ha ki duwan jong ki bymngeit ka long kaba la kñia sha ki ksuid , ym sha U Blei . Bad ngam kwah ïa phi ban long kiba ïatrei lem bad ki ksuid .
Phi donkam jyrmi long kiba ïaishah , khnang ba puson kpu ban leh ïa ka mon U Blei bad ïohpdiang ïa kata jingpynkhuslai u kular .
translation.en: For ye have need of patience , that , after ye have done the will of God , ye might receive the promise .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka pyrthei ïakmen namar ka jingïap jong kine ki ar ngut . Kin bad kin ïa-ai jingai sngewbha markylliang , namar ba kita ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la wallam shibun ki jingshitom halor u bynriew .
translation.en: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them , and make merry , and shall send gifts one to another  ; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth .

And it came to pass , that in the morning , behold , it was Leah : and he said to Laban , What is this thou hast done unto me ? did not I serve with thee for Rachel ? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me ?
translation.kha: Dei tad ynda ka la shai mynstep ba u Jakob u shem ba ka dei pynban da ka Leah . U leit sha u Laban , bad u ong ,  Balei phi leh ïa kane ha nga ? Nga la trei ban ïoh ïa ka Rakhel ? Balei phi la shukor ïa nga ?
Nga kren ha ki Jentil : nga dang long u apostol sha ki Jentil , ngan sngewsarong ha ka kam jong nga .
translation.en: For I speak to you Gentiles , inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles , I magnify mine office :

translation.kha: Mynta , shakri ïa U Trai U Blei jong ïa phi ka bad dohnud ka mynsiem jong phi baroh . Sdang noh ban tei ïa ka Templ , ba khnang phi lah ban buh ha ka ïa ka Synduk ka U Jutang Trai bad ïa baroh kiwei pat ki tiar bakyntang ba ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa u .
translation.en: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the  Lord  your God  ; arise therefore , and build ye the sanctuary of the  Lord  God , to bring the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and the holy vessels of God , into the house that is to be built to the name of the  Lord .
Stand now with thine enchantments , and with the multitude of thy sorceries , wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth  ; if so be thou shalt be able to profit , if so be thou mayest prevail .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ki jingleh myntor bad jingkhan jong pha baroh ; pha la pyndonkam ïa ki naduh ba pha dang samla . Lehse ki lah ban long jingïarap katto katne ïa pha ; lehse pha lah ban pyntieng ïa ki nongshun jong pha .

translation.en: And ought not this woman , being a daughter of Abraham , whom Satan hath bound , lo , these eighteen years , be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day ?
translation.kha: Mynta hangne , kane ka briew kaba hiarpateng na u Abraham ïa kaba u Soitan u la khum la khatphra snem ; hato ym dei ban pyllait ïa ka ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?

translation.en: If any man have an ear , let him hear .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast forgotten me , and cast me behind thy back , therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms .
translation.kha: Mynta kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Namar pha la klet ïa nga bad pha phai dadien ïa nga , phan sa shahshitom na ka bynta ka jingkwah brai jong pha bad ka jingleh nuti jong pha .

translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  , will I assemble her that halteth , and I will gather her that is driven out , and her that I have afflicted  ;
translation.kha: Ka por kan poi ,  ong U  Trai  ,  haba ngan lumlang ïa ki briew kiba nga la pynshitom , kito kiba la shahshitom ha ka jingshah ringmraw .

translation.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons ? or his head with fish spears ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban pyndap ïa ka snieh jong u da ki sum pynïap dohkha ? ne dung ïa ka khlieh da u proh dung dohkha ?

La ïathuh ha u ba la lap ïa Dabid u bad ki nongbud jong u , bad u ong ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , Shahshkor , ko rangbah Benjamin ! Hato phi pyrkhat ba u un Dabid ai ïa ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ ha phi baroh , bad ban thung ïa phi ki rangbah nongïalam ha ka kynhun shipai jong u ?
translation.en: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him , Hear now , ye Benjamites  ; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards , and make you all captains of thousands , and captains of hundreds  ;

translation.kha: Nangta ki synran la wan sha U Jisu kaba jar jar bad ki kylli , Balei ba ngim lah ban beh noh ïa u ksuid shabar ?
translation.en: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart , and said , Why could not we cast him out ?

translation.kha: Mynta , namar ka khubor jong ngi ka long ba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , kumno ba katne katto ngut na phi ki ba ong yn ym don ka jingmihpat na ka jingïap ?
translation.en: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead , how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead ?
And they continued stedfastly in the apostles  doctrine and fellowship , and in breaking of bread , and in prayers .
translation.kha: Ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki ha kaba ïoh jinghikai na ki apostol , ha kaba ïashim bynta ha ka jingïasyllok , bad ha kaba ïa-ai lem ha ka jingïabam lang bad ha ki jingduwai .

translation.en: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir : and the name of Debir before was Kirjath–sepher :
translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah Judah ki la ïaid pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Debir , ha kata ka por la khot kyrteng ka Kiriath Sepher .
ngi la leit na ryngkew sha , ka nongbah jong ka distrik jong Makedonia ; kaba long ruh ka kyntoit shnong jong ki nong Rom . Ngi la pynlut bun sngi
translation.en: And from thence to Philippi , which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia , and a colony : and we were in that city abiding certain days .

translation.kha: U khynnah u saitlah ban ngeit iau nonghikai Asa
translation.en: The student refused to obey his teacher .

translation.kha: Ka burom jong ka , India sngewshyrkhei leit noh ; ka la lyngkhuit bad ka Areli don ha ka pyndei ñiewbeiñ iaki Ka ud bad ka buhrieh ïa la ka durkhmat ïathuh ka jinglehrain Jingkdew Ka Jerusalem Gob Ituria pynjakhlia ïa lade da ka Yiron kaba shyrkhei .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion : he hath stretched out a line , he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying : therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament  ; they languished together .

translation.kha: Lada u leh pop pyrshah ïa phi hynñiew sien ha shi sngi , bad man ka u wan sha phi da kaba ong , ‘ nga kylla-kaba-mut ,’ phi ban map u .
translation.en: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day , and seven times in a day turn again to thee , saying , I repent  ; thou shalt forgive him .
And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the  Lord  : and the bullock shall be killed before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong uta u paidlang kin buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u , bad kin pynïap ïa u hangta .

translation.en: And being let go , they went to their own company , and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them .
translation.kha: Mar ïapyllait , u Petros bad ïa u Ïoannis ki la leit phai sha la ka kynhun bad ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ong .

Pop ïakren saw tylli ki païa da ka dieng akasia ha kiba yn ïa-pyrkhat ïa kata ka pyrda , jingpynbynta suit ïa ki da ka ksiar , nongsynshar ki buh pynbaptis ki ïa jingshisha” bnoh ksiar . Nangta ki jingpynsleh saw tylli ki muhor tnaw rupa kiba batskhem lapsan kita ki païa .
translation.en: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold : their hooks were of gold  ; and he cast for them four sockets of silver .

translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki kyang Sibboleth jingbeiñ U jingkyntu , ki da Ïoanna , Ngi la leh neh pyrshah ïa me nongpynkheiñ namar ngi jingsuh iehnoh Aïah Stephan , U Blei jong phalor , bad ngi la mane ïa ki Baal .
translation.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , saying , We have sinned against thee , both because we have forsaken our God , and also served Baalim .

translation.kha: Hato me la ju poi ki sha umpohliew ha ki jingjylliew jong ka duriaw ? Hato me la ju ïaid ha ki madan jong duriaw-bah ka ?
translation.en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea ? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth ?
But let it be the hidden man of the heart , in that which is not corruptible , even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit , which is in the sight of God of great price .
translation.kha: Pynban , ka jingbhabriew jong phi ka shong ha ka jinglong bashisha hapoh jong phi , ka jingbhabriew bym sti noh jong ka mynsiem ba long jai jai bad bajar jar , kaba long kaba khraw tam ha khmat U Blei .

translation.en: The elders guide and help to protect the congregation spiritually .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah balang ki pyni ïa ngi na ka Baibl bad ki ïarap ïa ka balang ban kham jan sha U Blei .

translation.en: Peter therefore went forth , and that other disciple , and came to the sepulchre .
translation.kha: Te u Petros bad uta uwei pat u synran ki la leit sha ka jingtep .
U Judas u la mynjur ïa bad u sdang ban khmih ïa ka kaba biang ban aiti ïa U Jisu ha ki khlem ka jingtip jong u paidbah shaphang kata .
translation.en: And he promised , and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude .
To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses , though we have rebelled against him  ;
translation.kha: Me long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba map , wat la ngi la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa me .

translation.en: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins : also they have dominion over our bodies , and over our cattle , at their pleasure , and we are in great distress .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ka ri ka pynmih ka leit sha ki syiem kiba me la buh halor jong ngi namar ba ngi la leh pop . Ki leh katba ki sngewbha ïa ngi bad ïa ki jingri jong ngi , bad ngi don ha ka jinglanot kaba khraw !
Mem shym la ai khun ïa nga , bad uwei na ki mraw jong nga un ïohpateng spah ka jong nga .
translation.en: And Abram said , Behold , to me thou hast given no seed : and , lo , one born in my house is mine heir .

translation.kha: U Saul u ïap ka jingbymïaineh jong u ha U Trai . Um la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Trai ; u pyrshang da kylli na jong kiba la ïap , ha ka ba un kylli na U .
translation.en: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the  Lord  , even against the word of the  Lord  , which he kept not , and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit , to enquire of it  ;

translation.kha: Ka kynrup trait ïa nongpop u samla , ka doh ïa u , ka peit shlip ha ki khmat jong u Topheth bad ka ong ,
translation.en: So she caught him , and kissed him , and with an impudent face said unto him ,
And Abram said , Lord  God  , what wilt thou give me , seeing I go childless , and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Abram u ong ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , kan myntoi aïu ka bainong jong me ïa nga haba ngam don khun ? U nongïoh pateng jong nga u dei tang u Eliesar uba na Damaskos .
Hynrei u la len ïa . kata Ngam tip . . . ngam ïa sngewthuh kaei kaba pha kren , u la jubab , u bad la leit noh sha ka baranda . Hamar kata ka por u syiar u la kyn-ih .
translation.en: But he denied , saying , I know not , neither understand I what thou sayest . And he went out into the porch  ; and the cock crew .

O Belteshazzar , master of the magicians , because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in thee , and no secret troubleth thee , tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen , and the interpretation thereof .
translation.kha: Ko Belteshassar , u rangbah jong ki nongbatai kupar , nga tip ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me , bad ba me shemphang ïa ki jingmaïan baroh . Kane ka long ka jingphohsniew jong nga . To ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka .

translation.en: But the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying , Thou hast shed blood abundantly , and hast made great wars : thou shalt not build an house unto my name , because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ïa nga , ba nga la pynïap shibun eh ki briew bad ïaleh shibun ki thma . Bad kumta , namar ba nga la pynmih shibun ka snam , un ym shah ïa nga ban tei ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver , and for an homer of barley , and an half homer of barley :
translation.kha: Kumta nga la siew khatsan lyngkhot ka rupa bad shispah sanphew kilo u barli ban thied ïa ka .

translation.en: Notwithstanding , that I be not further tedious unto thee , I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words .
translation.kha: Pynban , ngam kwah ban shim shibun ïa ka por jong me , kumta nga kyrpad ïa me ban sngewbha ban shahshkor ïa ka jingïathuh lyngkot jong ngi .

translation.en: But for us also , to whom it shall be imputed , if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead ;
translation.kha: La thoh ïa ki na ka bynta jong ngi ruh ïa kiba la pdiang kum kiba hok , kiba ngeit ha uta uba la pynmih na ka jingïap ïa U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .
Ha ka lynti mawkyrdon ba la tei da u syiem Ahas , Ain Trai un ba-beit ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam shadien . Bad ka Humtah ka kynriah shiphew jam shadien .
translation.en: Behold , I will bring again the shadow of the degrees , which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz , ten degrees backward . So the sun returned ten degrees , by which degrees it was gone down .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Akhish u shaniah u Dabid , u ong ha lade , U la long uba la isih haduh katta katta da ki jong u hi ki Israel kumta un hap u shakri ïa baroh shi rta .
translation.en: And Achish believed David , saying , He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him  ; therefore he shall be my servant for ever .
Is not my help in me ? and is wisdom driven quite from me ?
translation.kha: Ngam donbor shuh ban pynim ïa lade ; ym don hangno hangno kaba nga lah ban phai ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And thou shalt take two onyx stones , and grave on them the names of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Shim ar tylli ki mawkordor Karnelian , bad thoh ha ki ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ,

translation.en: For God speaketh once , yea twice , yet man perceiveth it not .
translation.kha: Wat la U Blei u kren bad ïai kren , ym don uba pynsngap ïa kaei kaba u ong .

translation.en: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger , in that they went to burn incense , and to serve other gods , whom they knew not , neither they , ye , nor your fathers .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ,  Phi hi da lade phi la ïohi ïa ka jingpynjot kaba nga la wanrah ha Jerusalem bad ha baroh kiwei ki nongbah ka Judah . Wat mynta ki dang sah ha ki jingjot , bad ym don ba sah ha ki namar ki briew jong ki , ki la leh ïa kaba sniew bad ki la pynlong ïa nga ban bitar . Ki ai jingkñia ha kiwei pat ki blei bad shakri ïa ki blei kiba ma ki ne ma phi ne ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim ju mane .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Seest thou these great buildings ? there shall not be left one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab  Phi ïoh kine ki jingtei bakhraw ? Ïa uwei u maw ruh yn ym iehnoh ha ka jaka jong u ; ïa uwei pa uwei na ki yn sa pynkhyllem noh .
Ki la kurup ïa ka tynrai jong ka jingim jong ngi , ïa syiem u uba U Trai u la jied , uta uba ngi la shaniah ban ïada ïa na ngi uno uno u nonghiarthma .
translation.en: The breath of our nostrils , the anointed of the  Lord  , was taken in their pits , of whom we said , Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan uwei uwei phi khot ïa u paramarjan ban ban lehkmen ïa ka jingsuk bad ka jingshngain , ba la ker sawdong da ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki diengsoh Dumbur .
translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree .
For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel , and made also molten images for Baalim .
translation.kha: U la thaw ki durblei nar jong u Baal ,

Kane mynta , ka dei kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong : Ngan buh ha ka nongrim kaba skhem bad bakhlaiñ . Ha ka ngan buh ïa u mawdong baskhem ha uba yn thoh ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingngeit kaba skhem ka ruh kaba ïaishah .’
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone , a tried stone , a precious corner stone , a sure foundation : he that believeth shall not make haste .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi pyndep ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang Moses u khot u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang u bad ïa ki nongïalam jong Israel .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the eighth day , that Moses called Aaron and his sons , and the elders of Israel  ;

translation.kha: Ha kata Lano miet U Trai u la mihpaw ha u bad u ong , sngewtriem long U Blei jong u kpa jong me u Abraham . Wat sheptieng , nga don ryngkat bad me . khlup kyrkhu ïa me , bad ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew namar iwei jingkular Neraïah nga ïa u shakri jong nga u nylla .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him the same night , and said , I am the God of Abraham thy father : fear not , for I am with thee , and will bless thee , and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham s sake .
And their border was Helkath , and Hali , and Beten , and Achshaph ,
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ka , ka kynthup ïa ka Helkath , ka Hali , ka Beten , ka Akhshaph ,
Ka duriaw kaba kput ka riewngeit tap Sing Jerushah ; ki la ngam sha trai duriaw kum u maw .
translation.en: The depths have covered them : they sank into the bottom as a stone .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïohkem Almodad hynñiewspah ngut Adonijah shipai shong kulai bad arphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid Pynkheiñ . U la buh bun tylli Tabrimmon kulai na ka bynta ki shispah tylli ki jingpynthut ïapom bad poh-ïing jingbthah sah pihuiñ la pyndkoh .
translation.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven hundred horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen : and David houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them for an hundred chariots .

translation.kha: u pynïaidkam ïohkem rangli uwei u pyntyllun uba na khuid bad u kylli ïa u . U samla u la Henadad na ka bynta u Gideon ïa ki kyrteng jong ki hynñiewphew hynñiew ngut ki rangbah ba ha khmat eh jong ka Sukkoth .
translation.en: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth , and enquired of him : and he described unto him the princes of Succoth , and the elders thereof , even threescore and seventeen men .

translation.kha: Bad hangta jingthang wad sharak U Trai U Blei 4 phi , Menahem suda phi Shillong ïa u da ka Phong jong phi baroh Elieser phin shem ïa u Nimshi
translation.en: But if from thence thou shalt seek the  Lord  thy God , thou shalt find him , if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul .
So then it is not of him that willeth , nor of him that runneth , but of God that sheweth mercy .
translation.kha: Kumta te , kiei kiei baroh ki shong , ym ha kaei kaba u briew u kwah ne u leh , hynrei tang ha ka jingisynei U Blei .

translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , O my Lord , I am not eloquent , neither heretofore , nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant : but I am slow of speech , and of a slow tongue .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ,  Em , ko  Trai  , wat phah ïa nga . Ngam ju long u nongkren ba-pnah , bad ngam shym long kum uwei na kita naduh ba me la sdang ban kren ïa nga . Nga long u bym pnah ban kren , uba suki bad uba thlun .

translation.en: Howbeit I believed not the words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it : and , behold , the half was not told me : thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la ngeit ïa ki tad ynda nga la wan bad ïohi ïa ki da lade hi . Hynrei ngam shym la ïohsngew wat shiteng jong ka ; ka jingstad bad ka spah jong phi ki long kiba khraw shibun eh ban ïa kaei kaba la ïathuh ha nga .
U shakri u ngeit ïa ka jingshisha ka Baibl bad ïa ka hukum ïalap ïa ka khubor babha , bad long uba stad ha kaban sumar ïa kiei kiei jong u Khrist ha pyrthei .
translation.en: The slave is faithful to Bible truths and to its commission to preach the good news , and it is discreet about how it wisely cares for Christ’s interests on earth .

Ki shipai ki la ïalam ïa U Jisu , bad katba dang leit , ki la ïashem ïa u briew uba ka Kyrini uba u Simon uba la wan rung sha ka . Ki la kem ïa u , ki ïa ka diengphna halor jong u , bad ki la pynlong ïa ban bah ka hadien U Jisu .
translation.en: And as they led him away , they laid hold upon one Simon , a Cyrenian , coming out of the country , and on him they laid the cross , that he might bear it after Jesus .

And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king : and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword  ; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men .
translation.kha: Ki la ai jingtip ha u syiem ïa ka jingdon baroh jong ki rangbah kiba bit ban long shipai : phra lakh ha Israel bad san lakh ha Judah .

translation.en: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken , he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue ,  Be not afraid , only believe .
translation.kha: U Jisu um shym la patiaw ïa kaei kaba ki la ong , hynrei u la ong ha u Jairos ,  Wat sheptieng , shu ngeit .

translation.en: If thou doest well , shalt thou not be accepted ? and if thou doest not well , sin lieth at the door . And unto thee shall be his desire , and thou shalt rule over him .
translation.kha: Lada me la leh ïa kaba dei , men jin da la phuh samrkhie ; hynrei namar ba me la leh ïa kaba sniew , ka pop ka apthap ha ka jingkhang jong me . Ka kwah ban synshar ïa me , hynrei me dei ban jop ïa ka .

translation.en: Hear thou , my son , and be wise , and guide thine heart in the way .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko khun jong nga , long uba stad bad pynleit jingmut bha ha ka lynti ka ba phi im .
Uno uno uba bam ïa ka doh jong nga bad dih ïa ka snam jong nga u don ka jingmutlop bymjukut , khlaw pyndkut sa pynmihpat ïa u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .
translation.en: Whoso eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , hath eternal life  ; and I will raise him up at the last day .

translation.en: And she said to the king , It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts , and of thy wisdom :
Wherefore I take you to record this day , that I am pure from the blood of all men .
translation.kha: Kumta nga pynbna skhem ha phi ha kane hi ka sngi : Lada uno uno na phi u dei ban jot noh , ngam don ka jingkitkhlieh .
Lada ar ngut briew ki ïashoh , bad tnga jong uwei ki ka pyrshang ban ïarap ïa la u tnga da kaba bat tyngeh na ka rain jong uta uwei pat ,
translation.en: When men strive together one with another , and the wife of the one draweth near for to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that smiteth him , and putteth forth her hand , and taketh him by the secrets :
Hath a nation changed their gods , which are yet no gods ? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit .
translation.kha: Ym don kano kano kawei pat ka jaitbynriew kaba kylla ïa la ki blei , wat la kim dei kiba shisha . Hynrei ki briew jong nga ki la bujli ïa nga , U Blei uba la wanrah ha ki ka jingpyndonburom , da ki blei ki bym lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki .
U Trai u ong Wat , ai ba uno uno un kynnoh ïa ki briew lane pynrem ïa — ki ka jingmudui jong nga ka long pyrshah ïa phi ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: Yet let no man strive , nor reprove another : for thy people are as they that strive with the priest .
Finally , be ye all of one mind , having compassion one of another , love as brethren , be pitiful , be courteous :
translation.kha: Kum ban pynkut : Phi baroh to ïadon kajuh ka jingmut bad kajuh ka jingsngew , to ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat kum shi para , bad to long kiba sbun mynsiem bad kiba sngewrit iwei ïa iwei pat .

U mradkhlaw u la pynbor ïa ki briew , baroh kiba rit bad kiba khraw , riewspah kiba bad kiba duk , ki bad mraw kiba laitluid , ban don ka shab ïa kaba la buh ha ki kti kamon jong ki lane ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .
translation.en: And he causeth all , both small and great , rich and poor , free and bond , to receive a mark in their right hand , or in their foreheads :

translation.kha: ka Ha sngi Sabbaton kaba bud , la jan baroh shi shnong ki la wan ban sngap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai .
translation.en: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God .
Rejoice in the Lord alway : and again I say , Rejoice .
translation.kha: Ai ba phin shadkmen borabor ha U Trai ; nga ban biang ïa ka : To ïakmen .

translation.en: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man , rather than a fool in his folly .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban ïakynduh ïa ka dngiem kaba la duh noh ïa la ki khun ban ïa kaba ïakynduh ïa uno uno uba bieit uba bunkam ha ka kam mutlop .
‘ Kane ka long kaei ka ban jia ïa ka Babilonia — kan jingjied Ariopagos kan ym lah khie shuh , namar ka jingpynjot ba Ap Trai un wallam ha ka .’ Ki manbha jong u Jeremaïah ki kut hangne .
translation.en: And thou shalt say , Thus shall Babylon sink , and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her : and they shall be weary . Thus far are the words of Jeremiah .
Come unto me , all ye that labour and are heavy laden , and I will give you rest .
translation.kha: To wan ha nga , phi baroh kiba thait na kaba kit ïa ki jingkit kiba khia , bad ngan ai ha phi ka jingjahthait .

translation.en: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba , and the Philistines heard of it . And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land , saying , Let the Hebrews hear .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u pynïap ïa u rangbah ai hukum jong ki Philistia ha Geba , bad ki Philistia baroh ki ïohsngew shaphang kata . Nangta u Saul u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban khot ïa ki Hebru sha ka thma da kaba put ïa ka turoi ha kylleng ka ri .

translation.en: Now when Jesus heard these things , he said unto him ,  Yet lackest thou one thing : sell all that thou hast , and distribute unto the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , follow me .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la ong ha u ,  Dang don sa kawei pat kaei kaei kaba me donkam ban leh . Die noh ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , bad men don ka spah ha bneng ; nangta wan bad bud ïa nga .
Hynrei haba uta u briew u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewsih eh , namar u la long uba Diamond shibun .
translation.en: And when he heard this , he was very sorrowful : for he was very rich .

translation.kha: U Judah u la ithuh ïa kita ki tiar , bad u ong ,  Ka don ha ka hok . Ngam shym la pyndep ïa ka kamram ha ka — nga dei ban ai ha ka ïa u Shelah u khun jong nga ha ka jingshongkurim .  Bad u Judah um shym ïathiah shongkha shuh bad ka .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Go in peace . So he departed from him a little way .
