translation.en: And he said , When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women , and see them upon the stools  ; if it be a son , then ye shall kill him : but if it be a daughter , then she shall live .
For this gird you with sackcloth , lament and howl : for the fierce anger of the  Lord  is not turned back from us .
translation.kha: Kumta to kup ka jaiñ khain , bad to ïam bad ud sngewsih namar ka jingbitar shla jong U  Trai kam shym la phai noh na ka Judah .
Ka jaitbynriew kaba khlem ka jingïalam U Blei ka long ka jaitbynriew ka bym ïaid . beit A suk uta briew u uba sumar ïa ka hukum U Blei !
translation.en: Where there is no vision , the people perish : but he that keepeth the law , happy is he .
The wrath of a king is as messengers of death : but a wise man will pacify it .
translation.kha: U briew uba stad un pyrshang ban ïai pynkmen ïa u syiem ; lada u syiem u bitar , don uba lah ban ïap .

translation.en: And he said , What pledge shall I give thee ? And she said , Thy signet , and thy bracelets , and thy staff that is in thine hand . And he gave it her , and came in unto her , and she conceived by him .
translation.kha: Ngan ai aïu ïa phi kum ka dak ka jingkular ?  u phai ktien . Ka jubab ,  Ka muhor jong phi bad u ksai jong ka , bad uto u diengduh ba phi rah .  U la ai ïa ki ha ka . Nangta ki la ïathiah shongkha , bad ka la punkhun .

translation.en: And I will establish my covenant with thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Ngan pynthymmai ïa ka jutang jong nga bad pha , bad phan tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: But the  Lord  your God ye shall fear  ; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ngan pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi .
Haba u la tip ba U Jisu u la na ka thain ba synshar u Herod u phah ïa u sha u Herod , uba la don ruh ha Jerusalem ha kata por .
translation.en: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod s jurisdiction , he sent him to Herod , who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time .

translation.kha: Naba ka lyngkor kaba ngan ai phi ka long kaba jem , bad jingkit ba ngan buh halor long kaba sting .
translation.en: For my yoke is easy , and my burden is light .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong na ki kita sngi , ïalumlang mane ban Blei , bad wat trei ei ei kumba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .
translation.en: On the first day shall be an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .
And they told him , that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by .
translation.kha: U Jisu uba na Nasareth u dang ïaid nangne ,  ki la ïathuh ïa u .
U Trai u la phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa maham ïa ki ban pat sha u , hynrei ki ki ban shahshkor .
translation.en: Yet he sent prophets to them , to bring them again unto the  Lord   ; and they testified against them : but they would not give ear .
I will scatter them also among the heathen , whom neither they nor their fathers have known : and I will send a sword after them , till I have consumed them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba ma ki lymne ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la ïohsngew , bad ngan phah ki kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ki tad haduh ba ngan da pynjot khoit ïa ki .

translation.en: And the navy also of Hiram , that brought gold from Ophir , brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees , and precious stones .
translation.kha: ( Ka kynhun lieng jong u Hiram , kaba la wan kit ksiar na Ophir , ka la wan kit ruh nangta shibun ki dieng Kseh-Juniper bad ki mawlynnai .
Katno phi long kaba ksing eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; katno phi long kaba janai Paralok
translation.en: The watchmen that went about the city found me , they smote me , they wounded me  ; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me .

translation.en: And he commanded the steward of his house , saying , Fill the men s sacks with food , as much as they can carry , and put every man s money in his sack s mouth .

translation.en: Arab , and Dumah , and Eshean ,

translation.kha: Naba ka la pynjot shibun ki rangbah bad ka la long ka daw jong ka jingïap kiba bun kiba ym lah ñiew shuh .

translation.en: ( For from my youth he was brought up with me , as with a father , and I have guided her from my mother s womb  ; )
translation.kha: Baroh shi jingim jong nga , nga la kitkhia ïa ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as they were burying a man , that , behold , they spied a band of men  ; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha : and when the man was let down , and touched the bones of Elisha , he revived , and stood up on his feet .
Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee , knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say .
translation.kha: Nga sngewthikna , katba nga dang thoh ïa kane , ba men leh ïa kaei kaba nga kyrpad — ha ka jingshisha nga tip ba men leh wat kham palat ïa kane .

translation.en: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the  Lord  out of all nations upon horses , and in chariots , and in litters , and upon mules , and upon swift beasts , to my holy mountain Jerusalem , saith the  Lord  , as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kin wallam pat ïa baroh ki para kur ki para jait jong phi na ki jaitbynriew baroh kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa nga . Ko ki khun jong nga , kut kaba ka la jan ! La ïathuh ha phi ba u Nongshun jong U Khrist un ; sa wan bad mynta ki nongshun babun jong U Khrist ki la lah paw , bad kumta ngi tip ba kaba kut ka la jan .
translation.en: Little children , it is the last time : and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come , even now are there many antichrists  ; whereby we know that it is the last time .
The dead are not able to see or hear or do anything . —Ecclesiastes 9 :5 , 10 .
translation.kha: Kiba ïap kim lah ban ïohi ne ïohsngew ne leh ei ei .—Eklesiastis 9 :5 , 10 .
U Blei u leh kumba pynmong Manoah u la kyrpad , bad u angel jong U krong u wan biang sha kata ka briew katba ka dang shong ha lyngkha . U Manoah , u tnga lute waiñ um shym don lang iarap ka ,
translation.en: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah  ; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field : but Manoah her husband was not with her .

translation.kha: Hynrei bun kiba la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ki la ngeit ; bad ka jingbun ki briew ka la roi sha kumba hajar san ngut .
translation.en: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed  ; and the number of the men was about five thousand .

translation.kha: U shna ïa kita ki jingbah da ka dieng akasia u bad suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .
How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power : who went about doing good , and healing all that were oppressed of the devil  ; for God was with him .
translation.kha: Phi tip shaphang U Jisu uba na Nasareth bad kumno U Blei u la theh halor jong u ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ïa ka bor . U la leit kylleng , u da leh ki kam babha bad u da pynkhiah ïa baroh kiba la long hapoh ka bor jong u Ksuid , naba U Blei u la don lem bad u .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded , and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan , as the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel , and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged , and laid them down there .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ki bud ïa ki hukum jong u Joshua . Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua , ki la shim khat-ar tylli ki maw napdeng jong ka Jordan , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel , ki la bah ïa ki sha ka jaka shong dara , bad ki buh ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: And he looked round about on them which sat about him , and said ,  Behold my mother and my brethren !
translation.kha: U la peit ïa ki briew kiba shong sawdong jong u bad u la ong ,  Khmih ! Hangne ki don ka kmie jong nga bad ki para jong nga !

translation.en: Then said I , Ah , Lord  God  ! behold , I cannot speak : for I am a child .
translation.kha: Nga jubab ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngam tip kumno ban kren ; nga dang khynnah eh .

translation.en: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will , and to agree , and give their kingdom unto the beast , until the words of God shall be fulfilled .

translation.en: And this they did , not as we hoped , but first gave their own selves to the Lord , and unto us by the will of God .

bad phin lah ym da lei lei ban sngewthuh U aïu Blei u leh . Wat haba phi pyrshang tyngeh ruh , phin ym shem da lei lei . Ki briew kiba stad ki lah ban kam ba ki tip , hynrei tip kim .
translation.en: Then I beheld all the work of God , that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun : because though a man labour to seek it out , yet he shall not find it  ; yea further  ; though a wise man think to know it , yet shall he not be able to find it .

translation.kha: ki traishnong Israel ki dei ban leh ïa kane haba ki wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner , in offering an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.en: And straightway many were gathered together , insomuch that there was no room to receive them , no , not so much as about the door : and he preached the word unto them .

translation.en: And there shall be no remnant of them : for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth , even the year of their visitation .

This is my comfort in my affliction : for thy word hath quickened me .
translation.kha: Wat ha ka jingshitom jong nga , la pyntngen ïa nga namar ka jingkular jong me ka ai jingim ïa nga .
ka jingriew ka turoi , bad ka jingsawa jong ka sur kaba bym . Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew Bashan kata ka jingsawa , ki la kyrpad wandur kim kwah shuh ïatan diengsoh sa ïa kawei pat ka ktien .
translation.en: And the sound of a trumpet , and the voice of words  ; which voice they that heard entreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more :
And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city , and they said unto him , Shew us , we pray thee , the entrance into the city , and we will shew thee mercy .
translation.kha: kiba la ïohi ïa uwei u briew uba wan mih bad ki ong ha u ,  Pyni ïa ngi kumno ngin ïohrung shapoh ka nongbah bad ngin ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .
Lyngba ka me pynlong ka ïaid na ka bynta ki briew me ïalam ïa ki ka khyndew ba-rkhiang . kito kiba beh ïa , me pynïap jyllop ka um bajylliew , kum u maw uba ngam ha ka duriaw ba-atphyllung .
translation.en: And thou didst divide the sea before them , so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land  ; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps , as a stone into the mighty waters .

translation.kha: Mynta , la kumno kumno ngan phah ki synshar jong nga ïit ha ka ïingsyiem jong me bad ha ki jong ki rangbah synshar jong me , ban shim ïa kaei kaei baroh kiba ki kheiñ kordor . Kin poi lashai kumba katne por .
translation.en: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time , and they shall search thine house , and the houses of thy servants  ; and it shall be , that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes , they shall put it in their hand , and take it away .
The  Lord  shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face : they shall come out against thee one way , and flee before thee seven ways .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ba kin shahjop haba ki wan ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi . Kin wan tur na kawei ka dong , hynrei kin sa her ïap na baroh ki dong .
Hynrei me , me ïohi khmih ïa ka jingjynjar bad ka jingshah shitom bad me ïailong uba la kloi ban ïarap . u bym nongïarap u aiti ïa lade ha me ; me la ju ïarap ïa uba kyrduh .
translation.en: Thou hast seen it  ; for thou beholdest mischief and spite , to requite it with thy hand : the poor committeth himself unto thee  ; thou art the helper of the fatherless .
Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea ? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth ?
translation.kha: Hato me la ju poi sha ki umpohliew ha ki jingjylliew jong ka duriaw ? Hato me la ju ïaid ha ki madan jong ka duriaw-bah ?
Ki nongsynshar ki ïakynduh lang bad ki ïasylla pyrshah , hynrei pule bniah ïa jinghikai me
translation.en: Princes also did sit and speak against me : but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Pharisi ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ka jong U Blei na ka jong bad ki la kyntait ban shah ha Ïoannis .
translation.en: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves , being not baptized of him .

But thus saith the  Lord  , Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away , and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered : for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee , and I will save thy children .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Kane ka long kata kaei ka ban sa jia . Ïa ki koidi jong u shipai yn ïalam noh , bad ïa ka jinglute jong u nongsynshar leh jubor yn bat noh . Ngan ïaleh pyrshah ïa uta uba ïaleh ïa pha , bad ngan pyllait ïa ki khun jong pha .

translation.en: What daily practice is good for anyone wanting to learn God’s will ?
translation.kha: Ban tip ïa ka mon jong U Blei , aïu dei ban leh man la ka sngi ?

translation.en: Nebuchadnezzar the king , unto all people , nations , and languages , that dwell in all the earth  ; Peace be multiplied unto you .
translation.kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah ïa ka khubor harum sha ki briew jong baroh ki jaitbynriew , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej ha ka pyrthei :  Khublei !
Ki thylliej jong ki , ki long khnam ki kiba shyrkhei ; ki ïathuh lamler borabor . Uwei uwei u kren ki kyntien sngewieit ïa u paramarjan jong u , hynrei ha ka jingshisha u pynap ïa ka jingriam u .
translation.en: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out  ; it speaketh deceit : one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth , but in heart he layeth his wait .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Ka jingshai kan don hapdeng jong phi sa katto katne por To . nang ïaid katba ka jingshai ka dang don , ba jingdum ka kan ym wan lap ïa phi naba ; uta uba ïaid ha ka jingdum um tip shano ba u leit .
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Yet a little while is the light with you . Walk while ye have the light , lest darkness come upon you : for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth .

translation.kha: Nangta uta u angel u ïeng ha ka lynti kaba khim kaba hapdeng don ar tylli ki bri sohwaiñ ba la ker da kynroh ka maw baroh arliang .
translation.en: But the angel of the  Lord  stood in a path of the vineyards , a wall being on this side , and a wall on that side .

Not for thy righteousness , or for the uprightness of thine heart , dost thou go to possess their land : but for the wickedness of these nations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee , and that he may perform the word which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob .
translation.kha: Ym dei namar ka hok jong phi ne ka jinglong beit ha ka dohnud ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong ki , hynrei ka long namar ka jingbymman jong kita ki jaitbynriew ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la beh krad ïa ki na khmat jong phi ; ba un pynskhem ïa la ka kular ba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .
Namar kata , kohnguh hok ki ktien baroh ba la thoh ha kane ka jutang khnang ba phin manbha ha ki jingtrei jingktah jong phi baroh .
translation.en: Keep therefore the words of this covenant , and do them , that ye may prosper in all that ye do .
So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me : for I trust in thy word .
translation.kha: Te ngan lah ban jubab ïa kito kiba ibeiñ ïa nga namar nga shaniah ha ka ktien jong me .
ki ïar ban shah khublei da ka jingburom ha ki jaka ïew bad ban shah khot ha ki shoiñ ‘ ko Nonghikai .’
translation.en: And greetings in the markets , and to be called of men , Rabbi , Rabbi .

translation.kha: Nangta un shim ïa ka khleiñ jong u baroh thang bad halor ka duwan .
translation.en: And he shall take all his fat from him , and burn it upon the altar .
Bless the  Lord  , O house of Levi : ye that fear the  Lord  , bless the  Lord .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki Lebi ; to ïaroh ïa u , phi baroh kiba mane ïa U !

translation.en: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah , and smote him , and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe : for they had made that the prison .
translation.kha: Ki la bitar haduh katta katta ïa nga bad hukum ban shoh ïa nga bad ban set ïa nga ha ka ïing u Jonathan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , kaba ïa ka ïing jong u la pynlong ka byndi .

translation.en: Now Caiaphas was he , which gave counsel to the Jews , that it was expedient that one man should die for the people .
translation.kha: Dei u Kaïaphas uba la ai jingmut ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba ka kham bha ba uwei u briew un ïap na ka bynta ka briew baroh .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father had done .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh jong u kpa jong u , u Jehoïakhin u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

U Joahas u la don arphew lai bteng ka rta mynba u long syiem ka jingkynrum sahnarphna bad ksiang synshar —Isaïah bnai ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hamutal , ka khun kane u Jeremaïah na ka nongbah Libnah .
translation.en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hamutal , the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .

translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor kaba me la ai ha pynbor , bad ki la pdiang sohkhram jingïaburom ; ki tip ba ïaineh long kiwei shisha khrud nga la wan na me , bad ki ngeit ba me la phah ïa lyngkor .
translation.en: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me  ; and they have received them , and have known surely that I came out from thee , and they have believed that thou didst send me .

translation.kha: Ha snem ka kaba san jong ka jingsynshar jong u ïa ka jingbymïaineh jong ki ha U Trai la pynshitom .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem , because they had transgressed against the  Lord  ,
Behold the fowls of the air : for they sow not , neither do they reap , nor gather into barns  ; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them . Are ye not much better than they ?
translation.kha: Khmih ïa ki sim : kim bet symbai , kim ïalum ïa ka jingot bad buh ïa ka ha ki thiar ; pynban U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng u sumar sukher ïa ki ! Hato phim kam kor shibun ban ïa ki sim ?
U Trai Pynthikna jingpyndonkam pyntip ha nga ïa ki jingthmu jingneit kiba ki nongshun jong nga ki pynkieng jingïap pyrshah ïarung nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath given me knowledge of it , and I know it : then thou shewedst me their doings .

translation.kha: ki briew Ki kylli ïa ki bleithaw bad ïa ki nongbatai kupar , hynrei ki jubab kiba ki ïoh ki long ki jinglamler bad ki bym don jingmut . Katto katne ki pyrshang ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew , tang hynrei shu ban ïalam bakla ïa phi ; ka jingpyntngen ba ki ai ka long ka bymmyntoi . Kumta ki ki briew sakma kylleng kum ka langbrot ba la jah . Ki don ha ka jingjynjar namar ba kim don u nongïalam .
translation.en: For the idols have spoken vanity , and the diviners have seen a lie , and have told false dreams  ; they comfort in vain : therefore they went their way as a flock , they were troubled , because there was no shepherd .

translation.kha: u phah shata jahthait ka kynhun babun ryngkat bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom . Ki la poi Wahduid ka sep-ei ba-iwbih bad ki khatsan ïa 40 .
translation.en: Therefore sent he thither horses , and chariots , and a great host : and they came by night , and compassed the city about .

translation.kha: Ale ïeng , ki pynphai , ktien Ïa ngin leit tur ïa ïaleh ka Laish . Ngi la ïohi ïa kata ka jaka bad , ka long kaba seisoh bha . Wat shong hangne khlem leh ei ei ; pynkloi ! Leit rung shapoh bad dakhol ïa ka !
translation.en: And they said , Arise , that we may go up against them : for we have seen the land , and , behold , it is very good : and are ye still ? be not slothful to go , and to enter to possess the land .

And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Be not afraid because of them : for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel : thou shalt hough their horses , and burn their chariots with fire .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Wat sheptieng ïa ki . Ha kane ka por lashai ka sngi ngan pynïap ïa ki baroh na ka bynta ki Israel . Phi dei ban pyndkoh ïa ki kulai jong ki bad thang ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki .

translation.en: Therefore sprang there even of one , and him as good as dead , so many as the stars of the sky in multitude , and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable .
translation.kha: La u Abraham u la ïap shisha , na une uwei u briew , la mih bun kiba hiarpateng kat ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng , kat u shyiap bymlah ñiew shuh harud duriaw .
Bad ngi la kyrmen un dei ma u uta u ban sa wan ban pyllaitluid ki ! Nalor kata baroh , kane mynta ka dei ka sngi kaba lai ba ka la jia
translation.en: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel : and beside all this , to day is the third day since these things were done .

translation.kha: Mar ha ïasngewskhem ka bor , u Amasaïah u ïa pynïap ki rangbah synshar kiba pynïap ïa u kpa jong u , uba long u syiem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand , that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father .
And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , unto the camp to Gilgal .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki leit phai pat sha ka jaka shong dara ha Gilgal .

translation.en: Even so , Father : for so it seemed good in thy sight .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , Ko Kpa , kane ka la long kumno me la kwah ïa ka ba kan jia .
Ki rangbah jong nga bad ma nga ngin leit tur sha ka nongbah . Haba ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki wan mih pyrshah ïa ngi , ngin phai dien bad ngin , phet kumba ngi leh la ka ha sien kaba nyngkong .
translation.en: And I , and all the people that are with me , will approach unto the city : and it shall come to pass , when they come out against us , as at the first , that we will flee before them ,

translation.kha: To Nongpynjot ba kito kiba sheptieng kin shemphang ïa kaei kaba la thoh hangne ; jingpyllaitluid ai Shittah kin Khesalon ïa Kamra naduh ka tai . Ki lynti U Trai ki long kiba beit banep bad ki briew kiba Nongïathuhlypa ki im da kaba bud ko pynkhriat , hynrei ki nongpop ki jynthut bad ki kyllon namar ba kim suidñiew ïa ki .
translation.en: Who is wise , and he shall understand these things ? prudent , and he shall know them ? for the ways of the  Lord  are right , and the just shall walk in them : but the transgressors shall fall therein .
But Pilate answered them , saying , Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews ?
translation.kha: Haba u paidbah u la ïalum bad sdang ban kylli ïa u Pilat na ka bynta ka jingleh bakyrpang ba ju leh , u la kylli ïa ki ,  Hato phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ïa u syiem jong ki Jiw ?

translation.en: If she please not her master , who hath betrothed her to himself , then shall he let her be redeemed : to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power , seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her .
translation.kha: Lada la die ïa ka ha uno uno uba mut ban pynlong ïa ka , ka tnga jong u , hynrei um sngewbha ïa ka , te u dei ban die pat ïa ka ha u kpa jong ka ; u kynrad jong ka um lah ban die ïa ka ha ki nongwei , namar u la leh bymdei ïa ka .

translation.en: And they did beat the gold into thin plates , and cut it into wires , to work it in the blue , and in the purple , and in the scarlet , and in the fine linen , with cunning work .
translation.kha: Ki shoh stang kum ki jingsiang ïa ka ksiar bad ki ot ïa ka ksiar kum ki ksai ïa ka ban suh ha kata ka jaiñ linen kaba ni , bad ha u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw .

translation.en: They compassed me about  ; yea , they compassed me about : but in the name of the  Lord  I will destroy them .
translation.kha: Ki la don sawdong jong nga ha ki liang baroh ; hynrei nga la pynjot ïa ki da ka bor jong U  Trai  !

translation.en: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness , that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands  ;
translation.kha: Kumta nga la pynlong ka jingkular ha ka ri shyiap ba ngan ym rah ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki , ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ka ri bakynsai tam na baroh .

U Moses Aaron bad ki khun jong u ki dei ban shong dara khmat Ïingjaiñ shaphang mihngi . Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam niam baroh kiba ban pyndep ha Jaka Kyntang na ka bynta ki Israel . Uno uno uwei pat uba pyrshang ban leh kumta un shah pynïap
translation.en: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty .
Moreover he provided him cities , and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance : for God had given him substance very much .
translation.kha: Nalor kine , U Blei u la ai ha u ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi bad shibun ka spah ka phew ba u ïoh ban tei shibun ki nongbah .
Naba ym shym dei u Dabid uba la leit kiew sha bneng ; pynban u la ong : ‘ U Trai u la Sahnarphna jinglalot u Trai jong jingpynwit : Shong Ashnah ha ka khliehduh kamon jong nga
translation.en: For David is not ascended into the heavens : but he saith himself , The  Lord  said unto my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand ,

Then said some of his disciples among themselves , What is this that he saith unto us ,  A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me : and , Because I go to the Father ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki synran jong u ki la ïakylli para ma ki ,  Ka mut aïu kane ? U ïathuh ïa ngi ba sa tang shipor ngin ym ïohi shuh ïa u ; bad nangta sa shipor hadien ngin sa ïohi ïa u ; bad u ong ruh , ‘ Ka long namar ba ngan sa leit noh sha U Kpa .’
Ha kata ka ka por Hima ki bneng kan long kumne . Shisien la don u briew u ban sa leit jingleit u ; la khot ïa ki shakri jong u bad u la buh ïa ki ban khmih ka ïa jingdon jingem jong u .
translation.en: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country , who called his own servants , and delivered unto them his goods .
When Ephraim saw his sickness , and Judah saw his wound , then went Ephraim to the Assyrian , and sent to king Jareb : yet could he not heal you , nor cure you of your wound .
translation.kha: Haba ka Israel ka ïohi haduh katno ka pang jur bad haba ka Judah ka ïohi ïa la ki jingmong , nangta ki Israel ki leit sha Assyria ban pan jingïarap na u syiem uba khrawbor , hynrei um lah ban pynkoit ïa ki lane pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong jong ki .

translation.en: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field , and from the land of Moab  ; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses : none shall tread with shouting  ; their shouting shall be no shouting .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingkmen la shim noh na ki jaka baseisoh jong ka Moab . Nga la pynlong ïa ka waiñ ban sangeh ban tuid na ki jaka khñiot waiñ ; ym don shuh mano mano ba shna ïa ka waiñ bad ban pyrta da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: Malchijah the son of Harim , and Hashub the son of Pahath–moab , repaired the other piece , and the tower of the furnaces .
translation.kha: U Malkhijah , u khun jong u Harim bad u Hasshub , u khun jong u Pahath Moab , ki tei baroh ar tylli ki bynta kiba bud bad ïa u Mot shet kpu .
U Rehoboam u jubab , Ai ïa nga lai sngi ba ngan pyrkhat ïa kane ka kam . Nangta sa wan pat . Kumta ki kita briew ki noh leit .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Come again unto me after three days . And the people departed .
And we have sent with him the brother , whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches ;
translation.kha: Lem bad u ngi phah ïa u parabangeit ïa uba la ñiewburom bha ha baroh ki balang na ka bynta ka jingtrei jong u ha kaba ïalap ïa ka gospel .

translation.en: And if the servant shall plainly say , I love my master , my wife , and my children  ; I will not go out free :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u mraw u pynbna ba u ieit ïa la u kynrad , ïa la ka tnga , bad ïa la ki khun , bad um kwah ban ïoh laitluid ,
Ki briew pashat hok ki ïoh ka jingsngewskhem borabor lyngkhuh hynrei shipor bymman kin ym lah ban im ha ka ri .
translation.en: The righteous shall never be removed : but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth .
It is set up in heaven and will rule over this earth .
translation.kha: La seng ïa ka ha bneng bad kan synshar ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes , and saw the place afar off .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai , u Abraham u la ïohi ïa kata ka jaka na jngai .

translation.en: Therefore it is come to pass , that as he cried , and they would not hear  ; so they cried , and I would not hear , saith the  Lord  of hosts :
translation.kha: Namar ba kim shym la shahshkor mynba nga la kren , ngam shym la jubab mynba ki la duwai .
Uba kum une u briew u kohnguh ïa hukum ki jong nga bad u sumar biang biang ïa ki aiñ jong nga . long U uba hok , bad un im , ong U Trai Nongsynshar .
translation.en: Hath walked in my statutes , and hath kept my judgments , to deal truly  ; he is just , he shall surely live , saith the Lord  God .
So the chief captain then let the young man depart , and charged him , See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me .
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la ong ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano ba me la ïathuh ïa kane ha nga .  Bad u la phah noh ïa uta u samla .
Naba u u la hukum , ‘ Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa ka ,’ bad ‘ uno uno uba tim u kpa la kmie yn pynïap .’
translation.en: For Moses said , Honour thy father and thy mother  ; and , Whoso curseth father or mother , let him die the death :

translation.kha: Haba ka la shai , u khot ïa la ki synran sha u bad u jied khat-ar ngut na , ïa kiba u la ai kyrteng , :
translation.en: And when it was day , he called unto him his disciples : and of them he chose twelve , whom also he named apostles  ;

translation.kha: U u syiem trei bad ka iktiar , bad ym don uba lah ban pyrshah ïa kaei ba u leh .
translation.en: Where the word of a king is , there is power : and who may say unto him , What doest thou ?

Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Let your hands be strong , ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets , which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the  Lord  of hosts was laid , that the temple might be built .
translation.kha: To long shlur ! Mynta phi ïohsngew ïa kijuh ki kyntien ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren ha ka por ba la buh nongrim na ka bynta ban tei pat ïa ka Templ jong nga .
U Pilat u la shabar sa shisien bad u la ong ha u paidbah Ha khmih , ngan wallam shabar ïa u hangne ha phi ba phin lah ban ïohi ba ngam lap daw ei ei ka ban pynrem ïa u .
translation.en: Pilate therefore went forth again , and saith unto them , Behold , I bring him forth to you , that ye may know that I find no fault in him .

translation.kha: Phi lah ban ïaid da kaba suk ha ? lynti tyngkan phi bad phin ym Mid .
translation.en: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely , and thy foot shall not stumble .
Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah , and the trumpet in Ramah : cry aloud at Beth–aven , after thee , O Benjamin .
translation.kha: To put ïa ki turoi thma ha Gibeah ! Pynsawa ïa ka jingkyrsiew ha Ramah ! Pyrta jam shaphang ka thma ha Bethaben ! Tur sha ka thma , ko ki rangbah Benjamin !

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Though thou detain me , I will not eat of thy bread : and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering , thou must offer it unto the  Lord . For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Manoah um shym tip ba u dei u angel jong U  Trai  , kumta u ong ha u ,  Sngewbha wat nym pat leit . Ai ba ngin ïoh shet uwei u khunblang na ka bynta jong phi .  Hynrei u angel u ong ,  Lada nga dei ban ap , ngan nym bam ïa ka jingbam jong phi . Hynrei lada phi kwah ban pynkhreh ïa ka , thang ïa ka kum ka jingainguh sha U  Trai .
Ka kham rain ban shah khot sha pluh jaka kaba kham shajrong jingïashongkha ïa kaba pynlut ong ban Hadassah pynjngai ïa ka jaka jong phi ha uwei uba kham pawkhmat .
translation.en: For better it is that it be said unto thee , Come up hither  ; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen .

translation.kha: U Asa u ïa kaba ïa U Trai , kumba u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u , u la leh .
translation.en: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  , as did David his father .
To be discreet , chaste , keepers at home , good , obedient to their own husbands , that the word of God be not blasphemed .
translation.kha: ban long kiba synshar ïa lade bad kiba sngur mynsiem , bad ki nongsumar ïing babha kiba pyndem ha la ki tnga , ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban kren sniew ïa ka khubor kaba wan na U Blei .

translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye devour widows  houses , and for a pretence make long prayer : therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad phi knieh noh ïa ki ïing jong ki , bad nangta phi pyn-i ïa ka jingduwai bajlan ! Namar kane , ka jingpynshitom ïa phi kan long kaba kham sniew !

translation.en: Therefore , brethren , stand fast , and hold the traditions which ye have been taught , whether by word , or our epistle .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong ngi , to ïeng skhem bad batskhem ha kito ki jingshisha kiba ngi la hikai ïa phi , ha ka jingïalap jong ngi bad ha ka shithi jong ngi .
Ha kawei ka sngi katba u Jakob dang shet syrwa jhur u Iso u la wan kaba behmrad .
translation.en: And Jacob sod pottage : and Esau came from the field , and he was faint :
In my Father s house are many mansions : if it were not so , I would have told you . I go to prepare a place for you .
translation.kha: Don shibun ki kamra ha ka ïing U Kpa jong nga , bad ngan leit ban pynkhreh ka jaka ïa phi . Ngan ym jin da la ïathuh ïa phi lada kam long kumta .

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat said , The word of the  Lord  is with him . So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him .
translation.kha: U dei u nongïathuhlypa bashisha ,  u syiem Jehoshaphat u ong . Kumta ki lai ngut ki syiem ki la leit sha u Elisha .

Khot lang ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal baroh , ki nongmane jong u baroh bad ïa ki lyngdoh jong u ruh ban pep ; nga ai ka jingkñia kaba khraw ha u Baal , bad uno uno jah un shah pynïap . Kane long buit sianti ha ka liang jong u Jehu da kaba u mut ban pynïap lut ïa ki nongmane ïa u Baal . )
translation.en: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal , all his servants , and all his priests  ; let none be wanting : for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal  ; whosoever shall be wanting , he shall not live . But Jehu did it in subtilty , to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal .

That hath taken off his hand from the poor , that hath not received usury nor increase , hath executed my judgments , hath walked in my statutes  ; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father , he shall surely live .
translation.kha: U kyntait ban leh ïa kaba sniew bad um ju ai pisa kylliang ban ïohnong . U sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Un ym ïap na ka bynta ki pop jong u kpa jong u , hynrei un im da shisha .

translation.en: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all , that ye say , We will be as the heathen , as the families of the countries , to serve wood and stone .
translation.kha: Phi la pynbeit ïa la ki jingmut ba phi ïakwah ban long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew , kum ki briew kiba shong basah ha kiwei pat ki ri bad kiba mane ïa ki dieng bad ki mawsiang . Hynrei kata kan ym long da lei lei .
shihajar laispah hynriewphew san shekel rupa ka ,
translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them , were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore .
And it shall come to pass in the day of the  Lord s  sacrifice , that I will punish the princes , and the king s children , and all such as are clothed with strange apparel .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ka jingpynïap ,  ong U  Trai  ,  ngan pynshitom ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki khun shynrang jong u syiem , bad baroh kiba leh ïa ki rukom nongwei .

translation.en: I receive not honour from men .
translation.kha: Ngam wad ïa ka jingïaroh ki briew .
ba ka por ka haba ïa kiei kiei kiba ha ka kiei kiba ki kpa tymmen ki kynshew haduh kane ka sngi , yn rong noh sha Babilonia . Yn ym don ei ei ka ban sah
translation.en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day , shall be carried into Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: , khun phrangsngi jong , Me long ka jingkhlaiñ nga , U soh jinglong nga , Uba sarong tam bad khlaiñ Na khun jong baroh .
translation.en: Reuben , thou art my firstborn , my might , and the beginning of my strength , the excellency of dignity , and the excellency of power :
Every man shall give as he is able , according to the blessing of the  Lord  thy God which he hath given thee .
translation.kha: baroh ki dei ban ai katba ki kotbor , kat kum ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kyrkhu ïa phi .
Phi dei ban ong , ‘ U shakri jong u Jakob u hadien jong ngi .’ U Jakob u la pyrkhat , Ngan pynum ïa ka mynsiem jong u ki jingai sngewbha bad haba ïakynduh ïa u , lehse un map ïa nga .
translation.en: And say ye moreover , Behold , thy servant Jacob is behind us . For he said , I will appease him with the present that goeth before me , and afterward I will see his face  ; peradventure he will accept of me .

translation.kha: U angel u la ong ha ka , To wat sheptieng , ko Mari ; U Blei la u sngewbha ïa pha .
translation.en: And the angel said unto her , Fear not , Mary : for thou hast found favour with God .
Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians , because thou wast unsatiable  ; yea , thou hast played the harlot with them , and yet couldest not be satisfied .
translation.kha: Namar ym shym la pynhun ïa pha da kiwei , pha la leit bud nadien ki nong Assyria . Pha la long ka nuti jong ki , hynrei ki ruh kim shym la pynhun ïa pha .

translation.en: And that the passages are stopped , and the reeds they have burned with fire , and the men of war are affrighted .
translation.kha: U nongshun u la kurup ïa ka jaka ba jam ïa ka wah bad u la thang ïa ki kut . Ki shipai Babilonia ki la lamwir .

translation.en: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days : so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki ïambriew ïa u laiphew sngi hangta ha ri them Moab .

U angel jong U Trai u leit na Gilgal sha u ong ha ki Israel , Nga la shim ïa phi na Ijipt bad wallam ïa phi sha ka ri kaba la ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi Nga la , ‘ Ngan ym pynkheiñ lano lano ïa jutang jong nga bad phi .
translation.en: And an angel of the  Lord  came up from Gilgal to Bochim , and said , I made you to go up out of Egypt , and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers  ; and I said , I will never break my covenant with you .

translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang sha U Trai ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa : uwei masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang shisnem rta , ki bym don kano ka .
translation.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the  Lord  for a sweet savour  ; one young bullock , one ram , and seven lambs of the first year  ; they shall be unto you without blemish :
Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah , first and last , did Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , write .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa Isaïah , u khun jong u Amos , u buh jingthoh ïa baroh kiwei pat ki kam ba u syiem Ussaïah u la leh ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u .

translation.en: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight , and a good blessing shall come upon them .
translation.kha: Ki nongbishar kiba pynshitom ïa uba shah pynrem , kin manbha bad kin ïoh ka nam babha .

translation.en: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast  ; and his kingdom was full of darkness  ; and they gnawed their tongues for pain ,

translation.en: And it shall be , when the  Lord  thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give thee great and goodly cities , which thou buildedst not ,
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , un ai ha phi ïa ka ri kaba don ki shnong kiba heh bad kiba pahuh pahai kiba phim shym la tei .

translation.en: And the children of Aram  ; Uz , and Hul , and Gether , and Mash .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aram ki long ki briew jong ka Us , ka Hul , ka Gether , bad ka Meshek .
U Jisu u . Sa shisien pat u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la ha u , Ha ka kyrteng jong U Blei uba im , mynta nga buh ïa me ha ka jingsmai : Ïathuh ïa lada me dei u Messaïah , U Khun U Blei .
translation.en: But Jesus held his peace . And the high priest answered and said unto him , I adjure thee by the living God , that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ , the Son of God .
But as a wife that committeth adultery , which taketh strangers instead of her husband !
translation.kha: Pha long kum ka kynthei kaba ïaleh awria bad ki nongwei ha ka jaka ban ieit ïa la u tnga .

translation.en: And the superscription of his accusation was written over , THE KING OF THE JEWS .
translation.kha: Ka jingthoh jong ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u ka long :  U Syiem jong ki Jiw .

translation.en: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled , and your agreement with hell shall not stand  ; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through , then ye shall be trodden down by it .
translation.kha: Ka jingïateh kular kaba phi la pynlong bad ka jingïap yn pynduh , bad ïa ka jingïakut jong phi bad ka pyrthei kiba ïap yn pyndam noh . Haba ka jingjot ka sar , phin shahjop noh .
Me ïohi nga mynta , hynrei ïohi shuh lada me peit ïa nga , nga la noh !
translation.en: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more : thine eyes are upon me , and I am not .
To Obed–edom southward  ; and to his sons the house of Asuppim .
translation.kha: U Obed Edom u ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shathie , bad ki khun jong u ki hap peit ïa ka kamra buh tiar .
Kumta u Akhish u ai ha u ïa ka shnong kamar-tama , bad na Migron ka daw ka Siklag ka long noh ka klongsnam ki syiem Judah naduh kata ka por .
translation.en: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day : wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga kular kyntang ba ki jaitbynriew kiba sawdong don kin shah pynpoh .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I have lifted up mine hand , Surely the heathen that are about you , they shall bear their shame .

As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel , because it was desolate , so will I do unto thee : thou shalt be desolate , O mount Seir , and all Edom , even all of it : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: kumba me shadkmen ha ka jingpynjot ïa ka Israel , ka nongkynti jong nga . Ki lumbah ka Seir , ho-oid , baroh ka ri Edom kin sah kynjah . Te baroh kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

Kumta ki mihnoh na ka jaka shong dara jong ki Syria , ki leit phai sha Samaria bad ki la khot ïa ki ha nongap phira ki khyrdop : Ngi leit la sha ka jaka shong dara jong ki Syria bad ngim shym la ïohi ne ïohsngew ïano ïano ; ki kulai bad ki kada dang kiba teh shah , bad ki ïingjaiñ ki long kumjuh kumba ki Syria ki la ieh ïa ki .
translation.en: So they came and called unto the porter of the city : and they told them , saying , We came to the camp of the Syrians , and , behold , there was no man there , neither voice of man , but horses tied , and asses tied , and the tents as they were .
God , who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets ,
translation.kha: Ha ki por mynbarim , U Blei u la kren ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bunsien bad ha ki rukom kiba bun lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And truly , if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out , they might have had opportunity to have returned .
translation.kha: Kim shym la im sngi ban pyrkhat ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba ki la iehnoh ; lada ki leh kumta , kin jin da la ïoh ka kabu ban leit phai pat .

translation.en: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ong ïa kita kiei kiei , ki ong shai ba ki ïawad ïa ka ri la ka jong hi .
Wat buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong phi ha ki nongïalam ba briew kynja ; ym don u briew uba lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .
translation.en: Put not your trust in princes , nor in the son of man , in whom there is no help .

translation.kha: Katba ki kulai ki thohbroin dang wan mih , ki la long kiba da kwah eh ban leit bad ban jurip ïa ka pyrthei . U angel u la ong , Khie leit jurip ïa bad ka pyrthei ! — bad ki la leh kumta .
translation.en: And the bay went forth , and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth : and he said , Get you hence , walk to and fro through the earth . So they walked to and fro through the earth .

Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead , that they might enlarge their border :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Ammon ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ha ki thma jong ki ban pynïoh bun ki jaka , ki la puid wat ïa ki kynthei kiba punkhun ha Gilead .

translation.en: And his disciples went forth , and came into the city , and found as he had said unto them : and they made ready the passover .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la leit , ki la rung sha ka nongbah , bad shem kiei kiei baroh kumba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa ki ; bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .

translation.en: And when they had eaten them up , it could not be known that they had eaten them  ; but they were still ill favoured , as at the beginning . So I awoke .
translation.kha: hynrei ym don mano mano batip shaphang kata , namar ki i kumjuh kumba ki long mynshuwa . Nangta nga la kyndit thiah .

translation.en: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name , receiveth me : and whosoever shall receive me , receiveth not me , but him that sent me .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa uwei na kine ki khynnah rit , u pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ; bad uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , u pdiang sngewbha ym tang ïa nga hynrei ïa uta ruh uba la phah ïa nga .
Ngan pyn-i ïa ka nga ïa ka jingbitar jong nga haba nga lumlang ïa phi bad wallam pat ïa phi na ki ri baroh sha kiba la ïa phi .
translation.en: And I will bring you out from the people , and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered , with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out .

And did eat and drink before the  Lord  on that day with great gladness . And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time , and anointed him unto the  Lord  to be the chief governor , and Zadok to be priest .
translation.kha: Kumta ha kata ka sngi ki la kmen shikatdei katba ki ïabam ïadih ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai . Ha ka sien kaba ar ki la thung syiem ïa u Solomon . Ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ki la pynsleh ïa u kum u nongsynshar jong ki bad ïa u Sadok kum u lyngdoh .
Ïa ki blei jong ki la thaw da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ba la da pynwandur ki kti jong ki briew .
translation.en: Their idols are silver and gold , the work of men s hands .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki paid Israel .

translation.en: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment : for if thou deliver him , yet thou must do it again .
translation.kha: Lada don uno uno uba bitar shen , to ai ba un shim ïa ki soh ba mih na kata . Lada phi pyllait ïa u na ka jingjynjar shisien , phin sa hap leh biang .

translation.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees : every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .
translation.kha: U sdie u la khreh ban khet ïa ki dieng na ki thied ; ïa uno uno u dieng baroh u bym sei u soh babha yn khet noh bad bret ha ka ding .
U Hesekaïah u jubab 18 Thiat suk sem pynlong ïa Sinai syrngiew ban jingotsher shiphew jam sha khmat ! Pynlong ïa ka ban leit shiphew lytar shadien .
translation.en: And Hezekiah answered , It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees : nay , but let the shadow return backward ten degrees .
The wise shall inherit glory : but shame shall be the promotion of fools .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba stad kin nang ïoh ka nam ka burom , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop kin nang mad ka jingjahburom .

translation.en: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh , which they bring unto the  Lord  , whether it be of men or beasts , shall be thine : nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem , and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem .
translation.kha: Uno uno ïa uba la kha nyngkong , la u dei u briew ne u jingri , ba ki Israel ki wanrah sha nga u long u jong me . Hynrei me dei ban pdiang ïa ka jingsiew ban thied pat ïa uwei pa uwei u khun ba la kha nyngkong , bad uwei pa uwei u jingri ba la kha nyngkong , ïa uba la ñiew ba u long u bymkhuid .
U pyndonkam kumba san laiphew kilo ka ksiar nylla ban shna ïa uta u diengpynïeng sharak bad ïa ki jingpyndait jong u baroh .
translation.en: Of a talent of pure gold made he it , and all the vessels thereof .
I spake unto thee in thy prosperity  ; but thou saidst , I will not hear . This hath been thy manner from thy youth , that thou obeyedst not my voice .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha phi mynba phi dang manbha , hynrei phi kyntait ban shahshkor . Kata ka long kaei kaba phi leh shi lynter ka jingim jong phi , phim ju treh ban kohnguh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Yet it pleased the  Lord  to bruise him  ; he hath put him to grief : when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin , he shall see his seed , he shall prolong his days , and the pleasure of the  Lord  shall prosper in his hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka dei ka mon jong nga ba un shah pynshitom ; ka jingïap jong u ka long ka jingkñia ban wanrah ïa ka jingmap-ei . Bad kumta un ïohi ïa la ki khun ki ksiew ; un ïoh ïa ka jingim kaba jlan , bad lyngba jong u ïa ka jingthmu jong nga yn pyndep .

translation.en: And he that blasphemeth the name of the  Lord  , he shall surely be put to death , and all the congregation shall certainly stone him : as well the stranger , as he that is born in the land , when he blasphemeth the name of the  Lord  , shall be put to death .
translation.kha: Uno uno u Israel lane u nongwei uba shong ha Israel uba krenbeiñ ïa U  Trai  un shah lynthem maw ha u paidbah haduh ba un da ïap .
To ïathuh ïa ngi te , me pyrkhat ? Hato ka long ïa Aiñ jong ngi ban siew khajna sha u Patsha hima Rom , ne kam long ?
translation.en: Tell us therefore , What thinkest thou ? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar , or not ?
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father s brother , thou shalt not approach to his wife : she is thine aunt .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga u para u kpa jong me , naba ka dei hi ka kmienah jong me .

translation.en: Now Samuel did not yet know the  Lord  , neither was the word of the  Lord  yet revealed unto him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khot biang ïa u Samuel . U khynnah um shym tip satia ba dei U  Trai  , namar U  Trai  um pat ju la kren bad u mynshuwa . Kumta u khie joit bad u leit sha u Eli , bad u ong ,  Phi khot ïa nga , bad nga hangne .  Hynrei u Eli u jubab ,  Khun jong nga , ngam shym khot ïa phi ; khie leit thiah biang .
ïa ka thang duwan jingiwbih ki bad jingbah ïa ka ; ïa ka umphniang pynsleh ; ïa ka jingiwbih ; ïa ka pyrda na ka bynta ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ;

And when the king came in to see the guests , he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment :

Ha kata ka por , ym don syiem ha Israel . Ha kita ki Bakhraw ki Dan ki dang wad nongdih la ka jong ban shong jyrmi haw namar kim pat shym la daladie la ka jingshukor hapdeng ki jait Kner .
translation.en: In those days there was no king in Israel : and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in  ; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel .
It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it , and on the morrow : and if ought remain until the third day , it shall be burnt in the fire .

Nga la ïa ka lyngkha na u Hanamel nga thew ïa ka pisa na ka bynta jong u ; ka shongdor khathynñiew lyngkhot ki sbai rupa .
translation.en: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle s son , that was in Anathoth , and weighed him the money , even seventeen shekels of silver .
If a man also lie with mankind , as he lieth with a woman , both of them have committed an abomination : they shall surely be put to death  ; their blood shall be upon them .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha para shynrang , ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba sang ; dei ban pynïap ïa ki baroh ar ngut .

translation.en: Until I make thy foes thy footstool .

translation.en: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee ,
And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto him , and said unto him , The  Lord  is with thee , thou mighty man of valour .
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u la wanpaw ha u hangta , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad me , me u briew bashlur bad bakhlaiñ !

translation.en: But I had pity for mine holy name , which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen , whither they went .
translation.kha: Kata ka pynlong ïa nga ban khuslai shaphang ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , namar ki Israel ki pynjahburom ïa ka kat shaba ki leit .

translation.en: And he set the priests in their charges , and encouraged them to the service of the house of the  Lord  ,
For without are dogs , and sorcerers , and whoremongers , and murderers , and idolaters , and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie .
translation.kha: Hynrei shabar ka nongbah ki don ki riewkhyllah bad kito kiba leh byrtong , kiba awria bad ki nongpynïap briew , kito kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw bad kito kiba lamler ha ki ktien bad ki kam .
Hynrei ngam shym la leh kumta , naba kata jin kan da la wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba la ïohi lah nga ïa ba nga ïalam ïa ki Israel shabar na ka Ijipt .
translation.en: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand , and wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen , in whose sight I brought them forth .

translation.kha: ban don ka thliew ha ka jaka ban phrung ïa ka khlieh , bad suh khylliap ïa ka baroh kumba leh ïa ka jymphong , ba kan ym kad .
translation.en: And there shall be an hole in the top of it , in the midst thereof : it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it , as it were the hole of an habergeon , that it be not rent .
Abraham had faith his wife would live again , yet we read that “ Abraham came in to bewail Sarah and to weep over her . ”
translation.kha: Wat la phi don jingkyrmen ha ka jingmih pat “ U Abraham u ngeit ba ka tnga jongu kan im biang , wat la katta ngi pule ” ba u Abraham u sngew sih bad iam namar jongka .

A Trai , naduh kaba nyngkong eh me long Blei . Me long Blei jong nga uba bad uba . A Trai , U jong nga bad u nongïada me la ïa nong Babilonia pynlong ïa kiba khlaiñ khnang ba kin lah pynshitom ïa ngi .
translation.en: Art thou not from everlasting , O  Lord  my God , mine Holy One ? we shall not die . O  Lord  , thou hast ordained them for judgment  ; and , O mighty God , thou hast established them for correction .
If when he seeth the sword come upon the land , he blow the trumpet , and warn the people  ;
translation.kha: Haba u ïohi ïa u nongshun ba u wan poi , u put ïa ka turoi ban maham ïa uwei pa uwei .

translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that Joash was minded to repair the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ynda u la long syiem katto katne por , u Joash u la kut jingmut ban shna pynbha pat ïa ka Templ .
U Trai u ïohi kaba jia ha ki jaka baroh khmih halor jong , la ngi leh ïa kaba ne sniew .
translation.en: The eyes of the  Lord  are in every place , beholding the evil and the good .

Is Ephraim my dear son ? is he a pleasant child ? for since I spake against him , I do earnestly remember him still : therefore my bowels are troubled for him  ; I will surely have mercy upon him , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , phi long u khun ba-ieit eh jong nga , u khun uba nga ieit tam . Man ba nga ong ïa ka kyrteng jong phi , nga pyrkhat shaphang jong phi da ka jingieit . Ka dohnud jong nga ka leit sha phi ; ngan isynei ïa phi .

translation.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?
translation.kha: Phim ïaryngkat bad wat uwei u rangbah synshar uba rit tam jong ki Assyria bad pynban phi khmih lynti ba ki Ijipt ba kin phah ha phi ïa ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai .
Ngan sa ïakynduh ieh me hangta lip Paulos najrong jong ka jingtap Joktheel hapdeng kita ki kherub ar tylli , ngan ai ha me ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh na ka bynta ki Israel .
translation.en: And there I will meet with thee , and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat , from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony , of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel .
This is he , that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sinai , and with our fathers : who received the lively oracles to give unto us :
translation.kha: U long ma u , uba la ïadon lem bad ki paid Israel haba ki la ïalumlang ha ka ri shyiap ; u la don lem hangta bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi lem bad u angel uba la kren ha u , ha u lum Sinai , bad u la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor ba-im ka jong U Blei ban ai pateng ha ngi .
U la ban pynkdang lade da ki jingbam ba bam ki sniang , hynrei don mano mano ba ai ïa u bam .
translation.en: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat : and no man gave unto him .

translation.kha: Ai ha nga lai ngut ki rangbah na kawei kawei bynñiaw jait . Ngan phah Rakkath ki ban leit lyngba ïa jingpyntud ri baroh kawei bad jurip ïa kata ka jaka kaba kin mon ban ïohkynti . bhah kata kin wan rabbit ha nga .
translation.en: Give out from among you three men for each tribe : and I will send them , and they shall rise , and go through the land , and describe it according to the inheritance of them  ; and they shall come again to me .

translation.kha: U la shongkurim ïa ka , bad ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u , ïa uba u khot la kyrteng u Er .
translation.en: And she conceived , and bare a son  ; and he called his name Er .

And he shall judge among many people , and rebuke strong nations afar off  ; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruninghooks : nation shall not lift up a sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .
translation.kha: Un pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , hapdeng ki bor bakhraw hajan bad hajngai . Kin shoh tyrnem ïa la ki waitlam ban pynlong ki lyngkor bad ïa ki sum sha ki wait ngor tnat dieng . Ki jaitbynriew kin ym ïaleh thma shuh , kin ym pynkhreh shuh ban ïaleh thma .
Adaminekeb ïaid lyngba ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ jong markylliang jingkhuid uba alhia , uba mutlop Examination
translation.en: I went by the field of the slothful , and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding  ;
Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , throughout thy tribes : and they shall judge the people with just judgment .
translation.kha: Thung ïa ki nongbishar bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar ha man la ka shnong ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi . Kine kin bishar hok ïa ki briew .
Phi ban lah ai u khulom jong phi ?
translation.en: Can you give me your pen ?
There salute thee Epaphras , my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus  ;
translation.kha: U Epaphras , uba don lang bad nga ha ka byndi na ka bynta U Khrist Jisu , u phah ïa ki jingai khublei jong u ïa me ,

translation.en: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself , according to the good pleasure of his will ,
translation.kha: Namar ka jingieit jong u , U Blei u la rai lypa ba da U Jisu Khrist un pynlong ïa ngi ki khun jong u — kane ka long ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingthmu jong u .
U briew uba bha un ïoh jingkyrkhu Ki ktien riewbymman ki buhrieh ka jinglong ba leh jubor
translation.en: Blessings are upon the head of the just : but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked .

translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko parabangeit ba-ieit nga jong ! U u Blei la jied ïa ki briew kiba duk ha kane ka pyrthei ban long kiba riewspah ha ka jingngeit bad ban kam kynti ïa ka kaba hima u la kular ha kito kiba ieit ïa u .
translation.en: Hearken , my beloved brethren , Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith , and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him ?
And they departed thence , and passed through Galilee  ; and he would not that any man should know it .
translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad ki la ïaleit lyngba ka Galilaïa . U Jisu um shym la kwah mano mano ruh ban tip hangno u don , namar u dang hikai ïa ki synran jong u :

translation.en: Moreover when ye fast , be not , as the hypocrites , of a sad countenance : for they disfigure their faces , that they may appear unto men to fast . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
translation.kha: Bad haba phi shahjingit , wat leh  mat sngewsih kumba ki riewarsap ki leh . Kim kheiñ ïa kaba paw shabar jong ki khnang ba baroh kin ïohi ba ki shahjingit . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ki la ïoh lypa ïa ka jingsiew kaba pura .

translation.en: Hear therefore , O Israel , and observe to do it  ; that it may be well with thee , and that ye may increase mightily , as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee , in the land that floweth with milk and honey .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa ki , ko Israel , bad kohnguh ïa ki ! Te phin shem bha , bad phin nang roi bad long ka jaitbynriew kaba donbor bad phin ïoh shong ha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , kumba U  Trai  U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la kular .
Pynphai ka jingbitar jong me halor ki jaitbynriew ki bym mane me halor briew kiba kyntait ïa me . Ki pynïap ïa ki jong me ; ki la pynjot khoit ïa ngi bad iehnoh ïa ka ri ngi ha ka jingjot
translation.en: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not , and upon the families that call not on thy name : for they have eaten up Jacob , and devoured him , and consumed him , and have made his habitation desolate .

translation.kha: Hamar kata ka por katto katne ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki Almond leit na Pyndeng sha Antiokh .
translation.en: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch .

translation.kha: Ong ïa u , ba U Trai nga ïa , ‘ ba me ïa u briew shim ruh ïa khyndew jong u ?’ ïathuh ruh ha u kaei ba nga ong : ‘ Ha kata hi ka jaka ba ki ksew ki jliah ïa ka snam u Naboth kin jliah ruh ka snam me !’
translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto him , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou killed , and also taken possession ? And thou shalt speak unto him , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood , even thine .
As a roaring lion , and a ranging bear  ; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duk ki long khlem jingïarap ha khmat u nongsynshar uba sniew ; u long uba shyrkhei kum u sing uba kyrhuh ne ka dngiem kaba tur .

translation.en: My son , attend to my words  ; incline thine ear unto my sayings .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; sngap ïa ki ktien jong nga .

translation.en: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven : they pursued us upon the mountains , they laid wait for us in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Kham stet ban ïa ki pukni kiba suh wia na sahit bneng , ki beh kthong ïa ngi sha tbian . Ki lap ïa ngi ha ki lumrit ; ki kurup ïa ngi ha ka jingkyndit ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken ! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations !
translation.kha: Ka Babilonia ka la tied tyrnem ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei lyngkhot lyngkhai , bad mynta uta u tyrnem u khynñiuh ! Ki jaitbynriew baroh ki kyndit halor kaei kaba la jia ïa kata ka ri .
U Trai la pynkhreh ïa ka waitlam jong u ha bneng , bad mynta mait ïa ki Edom , kita ki briew ïa kiba u pynrem sha ka jingjot .
translation.en: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven : behold , it shall come down upon Edom , and upon the people of my curse , to judgment .

And David said unto his men , Gird ye on every man his sword . And they girded on every man his sword  ; and David also girded on his sword : and there went up after David about four hundred men  ; and two hundred abode by the stuff .
translation.kha: Pyndait ïa la ki waitlam !  u la hukum , bad ki la leh kumta . U Dabid ruh u la pyndait ïa la ka waitlam bad u la mih lem bad kumba sawspah ngut ki rangbah jong u , da kaba iehnoh shadien ïa ki arspah ngut lem bad ki jingkit jingbah .

translation.en: That ye submit yourselves unto such , and to every one that helpeth with us , and laboureth .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ban bud ïa ka jingïalam jong kiba kum kita ki briew , bad uno uno de uba trei bad shakri lang bad ki .

translation.en: And so commanded he the second , and the third , and all that followed the droves , saying , On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau , when ye find him .
translation.kha: U la ai kajuh ka hukum ïa uba ar , uba lai , bad ïa kita baroh kiba khmih ïa kita ki kynhun jingri ,  Phi dei ban ong kumne ha u Iso haba phi ïakynduh ïa u .

translation.en: Which is his body , the fulness of him that filleth all in all .
translation.kha: Ka Balang ka long ka met U Khrist , kaba pyndap pura ïa u , uba da lade hi u pyndap pura ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kylleng ki jaka .
U kumjuh ha ki nongbah ki jaka ba la ieh jong ki , , bad Simeon , bad jngai shaduh shatei haduh .
translation.en: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh , and Ephraim , and Simeon , even unto Naphtali , with their mattocks round about .

translation.kha: U la bitar u u la leit , bad katba u Balaam u dang leit kaba shong halor ka u , la synran ïa da ar ngut ki jong u ; u U Trai u la ïeng ha ka surok ban khang lynti ïa u .
translation.en: And God s anger was kindled because he went : and the angel of the  Lord  stood in the way for an adversary against him . Now he was riding upon his ass , and his two servants were with him .
And he said , God forbid that I should do so : but the man in whose hand the cup is found , he shall be my servant  ; and as for you , get you up in peace unto your father .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ,  O , em ! da lei lei ngan ym leh kumta ! Tang uta keiñ ha uba la shem ïa ka khuri un long u mraw jong nga . Kiwei pat na phi ki lah ban leit phai suk sha la u kpa .

translation.en: Then goeth he , and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself  ; and they enter in , and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first .
translation.kha: Nangta u mih bad wallam ïa ki hynñiew ngut kiwei pat ki mynsiem kiba kham sniew ban ïa u hi , bad ki wan bad shongsah hangta . Kumta haba ka la dep baroh , uta u briew un don ha ka jinglong ba kham sniew ban ïa kaba u la long ha kaba sdang .

Katba u Jakob tyngkong dang pynjyrthiaw Tap sah ha kata ka ri pung Gaash Reuben u la ïathiah shongkha bad Hosea Bilhah , kawei na ki tnga kliar jong u kpa jong u . U Jakob u la tip ïa kata bad u ïa-rai shla . Bun Jakob u don jwat ngut ki Haggi shynrang .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Israel dwelt in that land , that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father s concubine : and Israel heard it . Now the sons of Jacob were twelve :

translation.kha: Namar ba ngi dei ki khun jong ki ngi la ia iohpateng kita ki jingbymjanai bad jingiap . —Nong Rom 5 :12 .
translation.en: Consistent with the laws of genetics , we have inherited that imperfection and death . —Romans 5 :12 .

translation.kha: uba pynkylla ïa ki mawsiang sha ki pung-um , bad ki synrang ba-eh sha ki umpohliew kiba tuid .
translation.en: Which turned the rock into a standing water , the flint into a fountain of waters .

translation.kha: Bad shaphang ka Jesebel U Trai u ong , ‘ Ki ksew bam ïa ka met jong ka ha ka hi .’
translation.en: And of Jezebel also spake the  Lord  , saying , The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel .

translation.kha: Mynta , lada don mano mano ba la pynsngewsih ïano ïano , shohdoh shym la pynryngkang Jer kata ha nga hynrei ha pom Bha — la kumno kumno shi bynta . (Nga ong jingbthuh kane Nebaïoth ngam muhor nongpynïap da Lodebar tyngeh halor jong u .)
translation.en: But if any have caused grief , he hath not grieved me , but in part : that I may not overcharge you all .

translation.kha: Nga long klongsnam Hooid jong phi bad ngan sumar ïa phi haduh snieh phin da tymmen bad ba u shñiuh jong Babbai u la lieh . Nga la thaw ïa phi bad ngan sumar ïa phi ; Ngan ai jingïarap ïa phi bad ngan pyllait ïa phi .
translation.en: And even to your old age I am he  ; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you : I have made , and I will bear  ; even I will carry , and will deliver you .
Ye shall eat nothing leavened  ; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter ym dei ban lap ïa u thiat ha ki ïing jong phi ; namar lada uno uno u bam ïa u kpu uba la khleh thiat la u dei u nongwei ne u traishnong , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .
lem bad katto katne ki nongbah bad ki barabor kiba don hapoh ki pud pynsaphriang Beeshterah ka Manasseh , hynrei kiba la ai ha ki Ephraim .
translation.en: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh , all the cities with their villages .

translation.kha: A Trai , me pynlong ka lynti kaba beit na ka bynta ki briew kiba bha ka kaba ki ïaid ka long kaba madan .
translation.en: The way of the just is uprightness : thou , most upright , dost weigh the path of the just .
Yet hear the word of the  Lord  , O Zedekiah king of Judah  ; Thus saith the  Lord  of thee , Thou shalt not die by the sword :
translation.kha: Ko Sedekaïah , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong shaphang jong me . Men ym shah pynïap ha ka thma .
Phi dei ban hikai ïa ki shaphang ki hukum jong U Blei bad batai ïa ki kumno ki dei ban im ki bad aïu dei ban leh .
translation.en: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws , and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk , and the work that they must do .
He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife : but he that putteth his trust in the  Lord  shall be made fat .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhapnap ka pynmih tang ka jingjynjar . Phi long kham bha ban shaniah ha U  Trai .
Moraïah me Kohnguh , bad la tep ïa me bad ki kpa shyllangmat jong me , ngan thung syiem ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ka hima jong Pleng .
translation.en: And when thy days be fulfilled , and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers , I will set up thy seed after thee , which shall proceed out of thy bowels , and I will establish his kingdom .
And he said to Jeroboam , Take thee ten pieces : for thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , Behold , I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon , and will give ten tribes to thee :
translation.kha: bad u ong ha u Jeroboam ,  Shim shiphew lyngkhot ha lade , namar U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ïa me , ‘ Ngan knieh noh ïa ka hima na u Solomon , bad ngan ai ha me shiphew jait .
la Ki ïaboi sawdong jong nga kum ki ngap , hynrei ki la ing duh kloi kum ka ding hapdeng ki shiah ; da ka bor ka jong U Trai nga la pynjot ki ïa .
translation.en: They compassed me about like bees  ; they are quenched as the fire of thorns : for in the name of the  Lord  I will destroy them .
And if men strive together , and one smite another with a stone , or with his fist , and he die not , but keepeth his bed :
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki ïakajia , bad uwei u shoh da u maw ne u kura da ka kti ïa uwei pat khlem da pynïap ïa u , yn ym pynshitom ïa u ,

translation.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , that the table may be borne with them .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , bad suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .

translation.en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs .
translation.kha: Ki longïing babun jong ka kur Gershon ki la ïohpdiang baroh khatlai tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
ka dei ban leh lut kumba ka la kular lymda u jong kpa ka u pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshah haba u ïohsngew ïa kata .
translation.en: And her father hear her vow , and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul , and her father shall hold his peace at her : then all her vows shall stand , and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand .
Put on the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil .
translation.kha: To kieng noh ïa ka jingkieng atiar U Blei baroh , khnang ba phi lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki buit thap basniew jong u Soitan .

translation.en: And of Naphtali he said , O Naphtali , satisfied with favour , and full with the blessing of the  Lord  : possess thou the west and the south .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Naphtali u ong ,  U Naphtali u long uba la ïoh kyrhai ki jingkyrkhu da ka jingsngewbha U  Trai  ; Ka ri jong ki shaphang shathie ka kot haduh duriaw Galilaïa .
Ki khah kim lah ban haba mih ym don um ; yn ym lah ban shem shabar ka jaka sngem .
translation.en: Can the rush grow up without mire ? can the flag grow without water ?
And with many other words did he testify and exhort , saying , Save yourselves from this untoward generation .
translation.kha: U Petros u la pynlong ïa kane ka jingkyrpad ha ki bad da ki kyntien babun u la kyrpad ïa ki , da kaba ong ,  To pynim ïa lade na ka jingpynshitom kaba wan ha une u paidbah ba-bymman !
Ka por ka wan ha kaba ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem yn ïathuh ba ka lyer khluit ka beh shapoh sha ki na ka ri shyiap . Kan ym long ka lyer kaba jai jai shu kaba beh noh pynher ïa u stait —
translation.en: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem , A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people , not to fan , nor to cleanse ,

translation.kha: Phi ot ïa u jyntang bad ot ïa phlang ha ki sharing lum katba u jyntang ba dang u dang san .
translation.en: The hay appeareth , and the tender grass sheweth itself , and herbs of the mountains are gathered .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u jubab , U la kyrpad nga ba ngan ïa u ban leit sha Bethlehem
translation.en: And Jonathan answered Saul , David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth–lehem :

And the king loved Esther above all the women , and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins  ; so that he set the royal crown upon her head , and made her queen instead of Vashti .
translation.kha: U syiem la u itynnat ïa ka palat ban ïa kiwei pat ki samla kynthei , bad palat ban ïa kiwei pat , ka la ïoh ïa ka jinglehbha bad ka jingsngewieit . U buh ïa ka pansngiat syiem ha ka khlieh jong ka bad pynlong mahadei ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka Bashti .

translation.en: What Is the Good News ?
translation.kha: Kaei Ka Khubor Babha ?
Phi long ba la tim ! Phi la pynriewspah ïa la ka longïing da kaei kaba phi la shim da kaba leh jubor , phi bad la pyrshang ban pynlong ïa la ka ïing lait kaba na ki jingpynmynsaw bad ! jingma
translation.en: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house , that he may set his nest on high , that he may be delivered from the power of evil !

translation.kha: Bad haba phi pan , phim ïoh ïa ka , namar ki jingthmu jong ki phi long kiba sniew ; phi pan ïa kiei kiei ban pyndonkam na bynta ka ki jingsngewbha jong phi hi .
translation.en: Ye ask , and receive not , because ye ask amiss , that ye may consume it upon your lusts .
Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances , and with the bag of deceitful weights ?
translation.kha: Kumno nga lah ban map ïa kito kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bad jingthew bashukor ?
ïapler shyiap , Ka step ka wan , hynrei ka miet kan imlang biang . Lada angel kwah ban kylli biang , sa Augustus pat bad kylli .
translation.en: The watchman said , The morning cometh , and also the night : if ye will enquire , enquire ye : return , come .
Thus I was  ; in the day the drought consumed me , and the frost by night  ; and my sleep departed from mine eyes .
translation.kha: Bunsien nga shahshitom na ka jingshit mynsngi bad na ka jingkhriat mynmiet . Ngam ju ïohthiah satia .
Katba ki dang ïamih shabar Selsah ki la ïakynduh ïa u briew na Kyrini uba kyrteng u Simon ryngkat bad ki shipai ki la pynbor ïa u 119 bah ïa ka diengphna jong U Jisu .
translation.en: And as they came out , they found a man of Cyrene , Simon by name : him they compelled to bear his cross .

And Moses spake unto Aaron , and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar , his sons that were left , Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and eat it without leaven beside the altar : for it is most holy :

jingtip jong nga ka long kaba ïar ; ngan pyndonkam ïa kaba nga tip ban pyn-i ba U Blei u jong nga , u long hok
translation.en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar , and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker .
And , behold , a woman in the city , which was a sinner , when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee s house , brought an alabaster box of ointment ,
translation.kha: Ha kata ka shnong , la don ka briew kaba la im ka jingim kaba dap da ka pop . Ka la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u wan bam ha ka ïing jong u Pharisi , kumta ka la wallam ïa ka dabi alabastar kaba la dap da ka jingsleh ba-iwbih

translation.en: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness , and walketh in darkness , and knoweth not whither he goeth , because that darkness hath blinded his eyes .

translation.en: Then the spirit entered into me , and set me upon my feet , and spake with me , and said unto me , Go , shut thyself within thine house .
