translation.en: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness , unto the mount of the daughter of Zion .
translation.kha: Na ka nongbah jong ka Sela ha ka ri shyiap , ki briew jong ka Moab ki phah u khunlangbrot kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa uta uba synshar ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Hearken , my beloved brethren , Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith , and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him ?
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga ! U Blei u la jied ïa ki briew kiba duk ha kane ka pyrthei ban long kiba riewspah ha ka jingngeit bad ban kam kynti ïa ka hima kaba u la kular ha kito kiba ieit ïa u .
Ym dei ma ngi kiba la khang ïa khop la ki dohnud sha phi ; dei ma phi kiba khang khop la ïa ki dohnud sha ngi .
translation.en: Ye are not straitened in us , but ye are straitened in your own bowels .
But they know not the thoughts of the  Lord  , neither understand they his counsel : for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor .

translation.en: Is it not wheat harvest to day ? I will call unto the  Lord  , and he shall send thunder and rain  ; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great , which ye have done in the sight of the  Lord  , in asking you a king .

translation.en: And he said unto them , What manner of man was he which came up to meet you , and told you these words ?

translation.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven ? for they all had her .

translation.en: And Samuel arose , and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin . And Saul numbered the people that were present with him , about six hundred men .

translation.en: But the hand of the  Lord  was heavy upon them of Ashdod , and he destroyed them , and smote them with emerods , even Ashdod and the coasts thereof .
And Moses did look upon all the work , and , behold , they had done it as the  Lord  had commanded , even so had they done it : and Moses blessed them .
translation.kha: U Moses u bishar bniah ïa ka kam baroh bad u ïohi ba ki la leh ïa ka kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Kumta u Moses u kyrkhu ïa ki .
pynpaw ïa kajuh ka jingïaineh skhem ïa ka ïing ka sem jong nga shi . Bad U Trai la pynjot thiaw ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh ,
translation.en: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever : no , not when the  Lord  hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth .

One woe is past  ; and , behold , there come two woes more hereafter .
translation.kha: Ka jingkordit kaba nyngkong ka la kut ; hadien kane ka don sa ar tylli ki jingkordit ki ban wan .

translation.en: And truly , if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out , they might have had opportunity to have returned .
And it was told him by certain which said , Thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to see thee .

translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , will I take thee , O Zerubbabel , my servant , the son of Shealtiel , saith the  Lord  , and will make thee as a signet : for I have chosen thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

u ïakren khñium : jin da la kham bha lada ngi ïap ha ka Ïingjaiñ U Trai lem bad kiwei pat para Israel .
translation.en: And the people chode with Moses , and spake , saying , Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the  Lord  !

translation.en: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the  Lord  , saying , This house shall be like Shiloh , and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant ? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Bad nga shaniah ha U Trai ba nga da lade hi , nga lah ban wan shen phi sha .
translation.en: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly .

translation.en: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim , when they heard that the Philistines fled , even they also followed hard after them in the battle .
And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus  ; and fear fell on them all , and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified .

translation.en: And this is the blessing , wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingkyrkhu ba u Moses , u briew jong U Blei , u ai ha ki Israel shuwa ba un ïap .

Lai ngut Pynshong nong Judia ki wan Jediael ïakynduh ïa lyndet ; u rangbah synshar uba dei Hahiroth ïa Pop ïingsyiem , u Eliakim u khun jong u Hilkaïah ; Hormah sekretari ka Merathaim , u Shebna ; bad u rangbah synshar ba dei peit ïa ïaseng jingbuh jingthoh syntiew Pekod Joah u ym Ulai u shakor .
translation.en: Then came forth unto him Eliakim , Hilkiah s son , which was over the house , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , Asaph s son , the recorder .
I am the living bread which came down from heaven : if any man eat of this bread , he shall live for ever : and the bread that I will give is my flesh , which I will give for the life of the world .
translation.kha: Nga long u kpu uba im uba la wan hiar na bneng . Lada uno uno u bam ïa une u kpu , un im junom . U kpu ba ngan ai ha u , u long ka doh jong nga , ïa kaba nga ai khnang ba ka pyrthei kan ïoh im .

Shna ïa ka jingdeng khain na ka bynta u Rangbah Lyngdoh khadar pyndonkam ha Ksuid—u Miphkad sngewbiang nongrwai mon jong U Blei . Shna ïa ka da kijuh ki tiar manbriew ïawan pyndonkam ha kaba suh ïa ka ephod Kanaan bad Amphipolis remdor ki jingsuh pynpur itynnat .
translation.en: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work  ; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it  ; of gold , of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine twined linen , shalt thou make it .

translation.kha: U pynshaitbor ïa kito kiba tlot bad kiba thait .
translation.en: He giveth power to the faint  ; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba Samgar dei jingïambriew kohnguh jingbymhok ki hukum baroh kiba u la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the  Lord  your God , and his testimonies , and his statutes , which he hath commanded thee .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ka :1-5 long ba pleng balang Shua kylleng ka Judia , Galilaïa bad Samaria ka la ïoh shongsuk . Da ka jingïarap jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid la pynshaitbor ïa ka bad ka la baïap san Ariopagos ka jingbun briew , haba ka ïaid ha ka jingsheptieng ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria , and were edified  ; and walking in the fear of the Lord , and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost , were multiplied .

And now , Lord , behold their threatenings : and grant unto thy servants , that with all boldness they may speak thy word ,
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko Trai , to khmih ïa ki jingbyrngem kiba ki la pynlong , bad shah ïa ngi , ki shakri jong me , ban kren ïa ka khubor jong me da ka jingshlur baroh .

translation.en: And the people , when they knew it , followed him : and he received them , and spake unto them of the kingdom of God , and healed them that had need of healing .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la bud ïa u . U la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki , u la kren ha ki shaphang ka Hima U Blei , bad u la pynkhiah ïa kito kiba donkam ïa ka .

ha ka rta kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong Rephidim jingmanbha dei ka Abijah , ka pynkoit jong u Sekharaïah .

translation.en: I speak as concerning reproach , as though we had been weak . Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold , ( I speak foolishly , ) I am bold also .

translation.en: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother , and saith , It is no transgression  ; the same is the companion of a destroyer .

translation.kha: Nyngkong , u Moses u la pynbna ha u paidlang ïa ki hukum baroh kat kum ba la buh ha ka hukum . Nangta u la shim ïa ka snam ki masi kyrtong bad ki blang , u la khleh ïa ka bad ka um , bad u la synreit ïa ka halor kata ka kitab ka hukum bad halor u paidbah baroh , da kaba pyndonkam ïa u tnat Hissop bad katto katne u  saiwul uba saw .

translation.en: And James the son of Zebedee , and John the brother of James  ; and he surnamed them Boanerges , which is , The sons of thunder :
translation.kha: u Jakob bad u para jong u , u Ïoannis , ki khun jong u Sebedi ( U Jisu u la ai kyrteng ïa ki , Boanerjes , kaba mut  ki Khun u Pyrthat  ) ;
Nga kylli te : Haba ki Jiw ki jynthut , hato ki hap sha ka jingjot jong ki ? Em , ym kumta ! Namar la ki leh pop , ka jingpynim ka la wan sha ki Jentil , ban pynlong ïa ki Jiw ban bishni ïa ki .
translation.en: I say then , Have they stumbled that they should fall ? God forbid : but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles , for to provoke them to jealousy .

translation.kha: Mynta khie leit , ïalam “ u paidbah sha tip) ka jaka kaba nga la ïathuh ïa Timotheus . Kynmaw ba u angel jong nga un ïalam ïa phi , hynrei ka por kan pynkhyllew ïa-bishni .—Sekharaiah ngan pynshitom ïa jingsumar shatei briew namar ka pop jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore now go , lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee : behold , mine Angel shall go before thee : nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them .
Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil , blind , and dumb : and he healed him , insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw .
translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam sha U Jisu ïa u briew uba la matlah bad u bymnang kren namar u la shongksuid . U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa u briew , ba kumta u la lah ban kren bad ïohi .

translation.en: And the lord commended the unjust steward , because he had done wisely : for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light .
translation.kha: Kaba mih ka long ba u trai jong une u sordar bymhok u la ïaroh ïa u ba u leh ïa kaba kum kane kaba sianti ; namar ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei ki long kiba kham sianti ha kaba trei ïa la ki kam ban ïa ki briew kiba long ki jong ka jingshai .

translation.en: And the second is like , namely this , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself . There is none other commandment greater than these .
translation.kha: Kaba ar na ki hukum bakongsan tam ka dei kane : ‘ Men ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba me ieit ïa lade .’ Ym don kawei pat ka hukum kaba kham kongsan ban ïa kine ar tylli .

translation.en: Let Israel now say , that his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ai ba ki paid Israel kin ong ,  Ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: When I would comfort myself against sorrow , my heart is faint in me .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsngewsih jong nga ym lah ban pynkhiah ; nga pang ha ka dohnud .
ka Keilah , ka Akhsib , bad ka Mareshah : khyndai tylli ki nongbah lem ruh bad nongrit ki kiba sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: And Keilah , and Achzib , and Mareshah  ; nine cities with their villages :
And he said , Nay , father Abraham : but if one went unto them from the dead , they will repent .
translation.kha: U riewspah u la jubab , ‘ Kata kam pat biang , ko kpa Abraham ! Hynrei lada uno uno u mihpat na ka jingïap bad leit sha ki , te kin phai noh na ki pop jong ki .’

translation.en: And thou shalt make a veil of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen of cunning work : with cherubims shall it be made :
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka pyrda da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw . Suh pynpur itynnat ha ka da ka dur ki kherub .

translation.en: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements : once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations : it is most holy unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Shisien shisnem , u Aaron un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka duwan da kaba buh ha ki reng jong ka baroh saw tylli ïa ka snam jong ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . Dei ban leh ïa kane man ka snem ha ki por baroh ki ban wan . Kane ka duwan ka dei ban long kaba khuid , kaba la pynkyntang sha nga , U  Trai .

translation.en: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction ? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba U Blei u bitar bad u pynshitom , dei u briew uba sniew uba ju lait borabor .

Ka khun jong ka Herodias ka la Templ shapoh pynriam ka jingkñia shad ïasylla bad ka la ryñiot Adoniram u Herod . nongïeng kiba u ïitbniah khot sngewbha . Kumta ñiup syiem Ahilud la ong tyngeh kata ka khynnah , Kaei pyniehnoh pha kwah ban kular Rehoboth Ngan ai ïa pha ïa kano kano kaba pha kwah .
translation.en: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in , and danced , and pleased Herod and them that sat with him , the king said unto the damsel , Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt , and I will give it thee .

Who is this that cometh from Edom , with dyed garments from Bozrah ? this that is glorious in his apparel , travelling in the greatness of his strength ? I that speak in righteousness , mighty to save .
translation.kha: Uei une uba wan na ka nongbah Bosrah ha Edom ? Uei une uba riam itynnat ha ki jaiñkup rong saw u da ïaid ryngkat ha ka bor bad jingkhlaiñ ?   U dei U Trai , uba donbor ban pyllait im , u wan ban pynbna ïa ka jingjop jong u .

Phin tip ba nga long jingbakla Trai Kñia ba katba phi dang bat ïa Jokneam aiñ jong Topas jaitbynriew ba-marjan , phi la pynkheiñ kyr-eit ki pynkha jingiaseng nga bad khlem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong Sarai .
translation.en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  : for ye have not walked in my statutes , neither executed my judgments , but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you .
This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you  ; but now , behold , it is dry , and it is mouldy :
translation.kha: Khmih ïa u kpu jong ngi . Mynba ngi mihnoh na ïing bad u bad wan ban ïakynduh ïa phi , u dang syiad . Hynrei ha khmih ! Mynta u la tyrkhong bad la bthuh .

translation.en: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them , as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim : and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands .
translation.kha: Kin pyiar ïa la ki kti kumba ki pyrshang ban jngi , hynrei U Blei un pynjahburom ïa ki , bad ki kti jong ki kin ngam khlem ïoh jingïarap .
kiba ka na ki ka kum ka bih bseiñ .
translation.en: Their wine is the poison of dragons , and the cruel venom of asps .
And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar : and the priest shall make an atonement for him , and he shall be clean .
translation.kha: bad un kñia ïa u bad ka jingainguh bam halor ka duwan . Kumne keiñ u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid , bad uta u briew un sa long uba khuid .
U Trai kyrhuh na u lum Seïon ; sur jong u ka byrthen na Jerusalem ; ka bad ka suiñbneng khynñiuh . Hynrei un ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: The  Lord  also shall roar out of Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem  ; and the heavens and the earth shall shake : but the  Lord  will be the hope of his people , and the strength of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Bad wat leit ba pyrkhat phi lah ban lait ka na jingpynshitom da kaba ong ba u Abraham u long u kpa tymmen jong phi . Nga ong ha phi ba U Blei u lah ban shim ïa kine ki bad maw pynlong ki khun ki ksiew na ka bynta u Abraham !
translation.en: And think not to say within yourselves , We have Abraham to our father : for I say unto you , that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham .

translation.kha: Ha kata hi , ka lyer kaba jur ka la beh bad la ïa pynkhih ka um .
translation.en: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew .
And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about , and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about .
translation.kha: Thaw ka rmiang kaba hynñiewphew san milimitar baroh sawdong bad pynpur da ka ksiar sawdong kata ka rmiang .

Hadien ba ngi la ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Moab Menna U mynjur u mynnin ha ngi , ‘ Khreh jingbymkhuid ban jam ïa ka wah Arnon . Nga la aiti ïa u Sihon u syiem ka Heshbon shit ki roi bad ïa ka bajynjar jong u sorki , . Tur ïaleh ïa u bad Malkhaïah kynti ïa ka ri jong u .
translation.en: Rise ye up , take your journey , and pass over the river Arnon : behold , I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite , king of Heshbon , and his land : begin to possess it , and contend with him in battle .
And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master , and departed  ; for all the goods of his master were in his hand : and he arose , and went to Mesopotamia , unto the city of Nahor .
translation.kha: Uta u shakri uba peit halor ki jingdon jingem jong u Abraham , u shim shiphew tylli ki ut jong u kynrad jong u bad u leit sha ka nongbah ha kaba u Nahor u shong u sah ha ka bynta bashaphang shatei ka ri Mesopotamia .
, kynrad , pdiang ïa kane ka sngewbha kaba nga la wallam ïa phi bad ai ïa ka ha briew jong phi .
translation.en: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord , let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord .
And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked  ; and , behold , the multitude melted away , and they went on beating down one another .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ap phira jong u Saul ha Gibeah ha ri Benjamin ki ïohi ïa ki Philistia ba ki phet ha ka jingkulmar .
U Pharaoh u ong , Ngan shah ba phin ïaleit ban ai jingkñia ha U Trai U Blei jong phi ha ka ri shyiap lada ; phim leit jngai than Duwai . na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said , I will let you go , that ye may sacrifice to the  Lord  your God in the wilderness  ; only ye shall not go very far away : entreat for me .
Saying ,  The Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes , and be slain , and be raised the third day .
translation.kha: U la ong ruh ha ki ,  U Khun U Briew u dei ban shahshitom shibun bad ban shah kyntait da ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad da ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Un shah pynïap , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .

translation.en: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat , and he shall yield royal dainties .
translation.kha: Ka khyndew u Asher kan seisoh shibun , Bad un pynmih ki jait jingbam kiba biang wat ïa u syiem .
To wan phai noh U Trai U jong phi ko paid Israel . Ka jong phi la pynlong ïa phi ban jynthut bad kyllon .
translation.en: O Israel , return unto the  Lord  thy God  ; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity .

translation.kha: Kumba ka long , don shibun ki hynrei dkhot tang kawei ka met .
translation.en: But now are they many members , yet but one body .

translation.kha: la Ngi sheptieng bad kordit . Ngi thrang dik dik ba Blei U un pyllait ïa ngi na ka jingbanbeiñ bad jingleh bymdei hynrei kam shym jia long kumta .
translation.en: We roar all like bears , and mourn sore like doves : we look for judgment , but there is none  ; for salvation , but it is far off from us .
For as often as ye eat this bread , and drink this cup , ye do shew the Lord s death till he come .
translation.kha: Kane ka mut ba man ba phi bam ïa une u kpu bad phi dih na kane ka khuri phi pynbna ïa ka jingïap U Trai tad ynda un wan .
ïaleh ban knieh ïa kano kano ka shnong , wat pom ïa jong ka , wat lada kerkut slem ïa ka . Bam u soh hynrei wat pynjot ïa ki , naba kim dei ki jong phi
translation.en: When thou shalt besiege a city a long time , in making war against it to take it , thou shalt not destroy the trees thereof by forcing an axe against them : for thou mayest eat of them , and thou shalt not cut them down ( for the tree of the field is man s life ) to employ them in the siege :
Who is a God like unto thee , that pardoneth iniquity , and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage ? he retaineth not his anger for ever , because he delighteth in mercy .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei pat u blei kum ma me , A  Trai  ; me map ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong me kiba la lait im . Mem neh junom ha ka jingbitar , hynrei me sngewbha haba me pynpaw ïa ka jingieit baïaineh jong me .

translation.en: For I would that all men were even as I myself . But every man hath his proper gift of God , one after this manner , and another after that .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha nga da kwah ba baroh na phi phin long kum ma nga ; hynrei uwei pa uwei u don ïa ka jingai kaba kyrpang na U Blei , uwei da kane ka jingai , ïa uwei pat da katai ka jingai .

translation.en: Remember me , O my God , concerning this , and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God , and for the offices thereof .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A Blei jong nga , ïa baroh kine kiei kiei kiba nga la leh na ka bynta ka Templ jong me bad ka jingmane jong ka .
Ki pyrshang shem ka kan long bad kumno kan wan . ka la long ka por sha kaba U U Khrist uba ha ki u kdew , kaba ïa ki jingshah shitom kiba U Khrist un hap ban shah bad ïa ka burom ka ban sa bud .
translation.en: Searching what , or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify , when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ , and the glory that should follow .

translation.kha: A katno ka kaba shyrkhei ïa , ki nonglam lynti matlah ! Phi hikai ‘ Lada uno uno u smai da Templ , ïa u ym shym la teh da ka jingsmai jong u ; lada u smai da ka ksiar hapoh ka Templ , u long uba la shah .’
translation.en: Woe unto you , ye blind guides , which say , Whosoever shall swear by the temple , it is nothing  ; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple , he is a debtor !

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san , ai khyndai tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka . jingduna
translation.en: And on the fifth day nine bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot :
But draw near hither , ye sons of the sorceress , the seed of the adulterer and the whore .
translation.kha: Ale hangne ban shah bishar , a phi ki nongpop ! Phim long kham bha ban ïa ki nongleh byrtong , kiba klim bad ki nuti .

translation.en: So Gideon , and the hundred men that were with him , came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch  ; and they had but newly set the watch : and they blew the trumpets , and brake the pitchers that were in their hands .
translation.kha: U Gideon bad ki shispah ngut ki rangbah ki la poi ha tduh kata ka jaka sher dara shuwa ka por shiteng synñia , hamar ba dang dep ïa-bujli ïa ki nongap phira . Nangta ki put ïa ki turoi bad ki pynpait ïa ki khra ba ki bat , bad kita ki ar kynhun ruh ki leh kumjuh .
U Solomon u jubab , Me ju ïai pynpaw ka jingieit tdem ïa u Dabid Aber Jingshitom jong nga , bad mynta ba me la Arimathaïa ïa nga ban long syiem hadien jong u .
translation.en: And Solomon said unto God , Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father , and hast made me to reign in his stead .
And when the woman saw Samuel , she cried with a loud voice : and the woman spake to Saul , saying , Why hast thou deceived me ? for thou art Saul .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka kynthei ka ïohi ïa u Samuel , ka lynñiar kliang , bad ka ong ha u Saul ,  Balei phi shet shukor ïa nga ? Phi dei u syiem Saul du !

Te mynta , ma ram , U Trai , riewkhlaw ong ba Nongbah shym la lat ïa nga : phim shym la ai ka jinglaitluid ïa la ki para mo . Kumta te , ngan ai ha jingdon ïa ka jinglaitluid : ka jinglaitluid ban ïap da ka thma kwah ka jingpang Mahli bad ka jingïapthngan . Ngan pynlong ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew pynpluh ka —Ïoannis ban sngewshyrkhei jingsuk kaei kaba Seruïah leh ïa phi .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Ye have not hearkened unto me , in proclaiming liberty , every one to his brother , and every man to his neighbour : behold , I proclaim a liberty for you , saith the  Lord  , to the sword , to the pestilence , and to the famine  ; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth .
Woe to the bloody city ! it is all full of lies and robbery  ; the prey departeth not  ;
translation.kha: Long kaba la tim ka nongbah kaba pynïap bad kaba lamler , kaba dap da ka spah ban shah lute bad shah kurup !

translation.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day , as the king had appointed , saying , Come to me again the third day .
translation.kha: Lai sngi hadien u Jeroboam bad ki paidbah baroh ki wan biang sha u syiem Rehoboam , kumba u la bthah ïa ki .
Katto katne ngut na briew ha uta u paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa ba u ong kane bad ki la ong , Une u briew dei shisha u .
translation.en: Many of the people therefore , when they heard this saying , said , Of a truth this is the Prophet .
And Joshua rose early in the morning  ; and they removed from Shittim , and came to Jordan , he and all the children of Israel , and lodged there before they passed over .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , u Joshua bad ki paid Israel baroh ki khie dang step phyrngab , bad ki mihnoh na ka jaka shong dara ha Akasia , bad ki la leit sha Jordan , ha kaba ki la sher dara katba ki dang ap ban jam ïa ka .

translation.en: And the hangings of the court , and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court , which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about , and their cords , and all the instruments of their service , and all that is made for them : so shall they serve .
translation.kha: Ki shynrang baroh kiba la dap shi bnai lane kham heh kiba la shah ñiew ki long phra hajar hynriewspah ngut .

translation.en: How he met thee by the way , and smote the hindmost of thee , even all that were feeble behind thee , when thou wast faint and weary  ; and he feared not God .
translation.kha: Kim sheptieng ïa U Blei , bad kumta ki wan ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi haba phi la thait bad la duh bor , bad ki la pynïap lut ïa kito baroh kiba bud suki nadien .
Kumta U u la hukum ïa ki paidbah ban shong ha madan .
translation.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground .

translation.kha: Ko Syiem , kaba kine ki briew ki la leh ka long bym dei Ki thep ïa Jeremaïah ha ka pung , ha , da shisha , un ïap ha jingïapthngan namar ym don jingbam shuh ha ka nongbah .
translation.en: My lord the king , these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet , whom they have cast into the dungeon  ; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is : for there is no more bread in the city .

translation.kha: la bitar ïa ki briew jong nga ; nga la shim ïa kim dei shuh ki : ki ha ka jong , bad pham pyn-i jinglehisynei ïa ki ; wat ïa kiba la tymmen pha leh da kaba tyngeh .
translation.en: I was wroth with my people , I have polluted mine inheritance , and given them into thine hand : thou didst shew them no mercy  ; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke .
And thou shalt beat some of it very small , and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation , where I will meet with thee : it shall be unto you most holy .
translation.kha: Tylliat khyndiat ïa ka haduh ba kan da lwet ni bha , rah ïa ka shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad ber ïa ka ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Kheiñ ïa kane ka jingiwbih kum kaba da kyntang janai .

translation.en: And Cabbon , and Lahmam , and Kithlish ,
translation.kha: ka Kabbon , ka Lahmam , ka Shitlish ,

translation.en: Therefore I will judge you , O house of Israel , every one according to his ways , saith the Lord  God . Repent , and turn yourselves from all your transgressions  ; so iniquity shall not be your ruin .
translation.kha: Mynta , ma nga U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa phi ki Israel ba ngan bishar ïa phi iwei pa iwei da kaei kaba phi la leh . To phai noh na kaba sniew baroh kaba phi leh , bad wat shah ba ka pop jong phi kan pynjot ïa phi .
kaba pynkylla maw ïa ka um , bad kaba pynkhriat ïa sla duriaw ?
translation.en: The waters are hid as with a stone , and the face of the deep is frozen .

translation.kha: U Khun U un Briew phah ïa la ki angel ba lumlang napoh ka Hima jong u ïa kito baroh kiba pynlong ïa ki jong briew u ban pop leh bad ïa baroh kiwei pat kiba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew ,
translation.en: The Son of man shall send forth his angels , and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend , and them which do iniquity  ;

translation.kha: Katba ki isaitmet ïabam , U Jisu u Nongbishar ong , Nga ong ha phi , uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa Khidon .
translation.en: And as they did eat , he said ,  Verily I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .
I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings , and will not be ashamed .
translation.kha: Ngan pynbna ïa ki hukum jong me ha ki syiem , bad ngan ym shah pynlehrain .

translation.en: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel , and Erech , and Accad , and Calneh , in the land of Shinar .
translation.kha: Ha kaba sdang , ka hima jong u ka kynthup ïa ka Babilon , ka Erek , bad ka Akkad , kiba don baroh ha ka ri Babilonia   .

translation.en: The apostle Paul told one of the congregations in his day : “I am longing to see you , . . . that we may have an interchange of encouragement by one another’s faith , both yours and mine .”
translation.kha: U apostol Paul u la ong ha kawei na ki balang : “Nga kwah hir hir ban iohi ia phi , . . . ba ha phi yn pyniasngew tngen lem ia nga bad phi , da la ka jingngeit jingngeit . . . ka jong phi ruh bad ka jong nga de .”
Me wan jngoh ïa ki man jingrang step , bad kyrpad tynjuh ïa ki man la ka minit Menna
translation.en: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning , and try him every moment ?
But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create : for , behold , I create Jerusalem a rejoicing , and her people a joy .
translation.kha: To kmen bad to shadkmen junom ha kaei kaba nga thaw . Ka Jerusalem bathymmai kaba nga pynlong kan dap da ka jingkmen , bad ki briew jong ka kin shem sngewbha .

translation.en: The Jews answered him , We have a law , and by our law he ought to die , because he made himself the Son of God .
translation.kha: U paidbah u la phai ktien ,  Ngi don ka hukum kaba ong ba u dei ban ïap , namar u la kam ba u long U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: And Samuel told him every whit , and hid nothing from him . And he said , It is the  Lord  : let him do what seemeth him good .
translation.kha: Kumta u Samuel u ïathuh ha u nadong shadong ; um shym buhrieh ei ei shuh na u . U Eli u ong ,  U long U  Trai  ; ieh un leh katba u sngewbit ïa u .
To kmen ba ngi long ki jong ; u ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u kin lehkmen !
translation.en: Glory ye in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the  Lord .

translation.kha: U tdong jong u , u ïeng ïa-tylli u dieng buria ; ki jingphylla ha ki khohwah jingiathuhlypa u ki long kiba khlaiñ .
translation.en: He moveth his tail like a cedar : the sinews of his stones are wrapped together .
Then Jonathan and David made a covenant , because he loved him as his own soul .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ïateh jutang jingïadei paralok bad u Dabid namar ka jingieit bajylliew ïa u .

translation.en: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down , and he reared up altars for Baalim , and made groves , and worshipped all the host of heaven , and served them .
translation.kha: U tei pat ïa ki jaka mane blei thala kiba u Hesekaïah u kpa jong u , u la pynjot . U tei ki duwan ban mane ïa u Baal , u thaw ki dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah , bad u mane ïa ki khlur .

translation.en: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day : and there escaped not a man of them , save four hundred young men , which rode upon camels , and fled .
translation.kha: Ka tang shu kynjat shai ha kawei pat ka sngi u Dabid u tur pyrshah bad u ïaleh ïa ki haduh janmiet . Ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lait im lait noh tang sawspah ngut ki samla shynrang kiba kiew ha ki ut bad kiba phet ïap .

translation.en: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men .
translation.kha: Ka jingdon ki rangbah ïa kiba la bsa ka la long san hajar ngut .

translation.en: And he came down with them , and stood in the plain , and the company of his disciples , and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem , and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon , which came to hear him , and to be healed of their diseases  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan hiar na u lum lem bad ki apostol , u la ïeng ha ka jaka madan lem bad kiba bun ki synran jong u . U paid byllien u la don hangta na kylleng ka Judia bad na Jerusalem bad na ki nongbah Tyros bad Sidon kiba harud duriaw ;

translation.en: And Moses said , Thou hast spoken well , I will see thy face again no more .
translation.kha: Ka dei kaba phi ong ,  U Moses u jubab .  Phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga lano lano .

translation.en: Nevertheless the  Lord  thy God would not hearken unto Balaam  ; but the  Lord  thy God turned the curse into a blessing unto thee , because the  Lord  thy God loved thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ym sngap ïa u Balaam ; u pynkylla pynban ïa kata ka jingtim sha ka jingkyrkhu , namar ba u ieit ïa phi .
Ha kata ka por ngan theh noh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga wat ha sting shakri , ki shynrang bad Assyria kynthei kumjuh .
translation.en: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit .
And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan , and told him all that befell unto them  ; saying ,
translation.kha: Ynda ki la wan poi ha u Jakob u kpa jong ki ha ka ri Kanaan , ki ïathuh lut ha u ïa kaba la jia ha ki baroh :
Don saw kiei kiei kiba ktah jur ïa ka haba peit ba ïaid :
translation.en: There be three things which go well , yea , four are comely in going :
And it was given unto him to make war with the saints , and to overcome them : and power was given him over all kindreds , and tongues , and nations .
translation.kha: La shah ïa u ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki briew jong U Blei bad ban jop ïa ki , bad la ai ha u ïa ka bor halor kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew , ka hima , ka ktien bad halor u bynriew baïapher .

translation.en: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea , to compass the land of Edom : and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la mihnoh na u Lum Hor na ka lynti kaba poi sha ka khmut duriaw Akaba , ban ïaid sawdong ïa ka ri Edom . Hynrei ha lynti kim lah shah shuh bad ki la kren pyrshah ïa U Blei bad ïa u Moses .
U Jisu Khrist u long ujuh mynhynnin , mynta bad sha ki . bymjukut
translation.en: Jesus Christ the same yesterday , and to day , and for ever .

translation.kha: Haba ïa u Gallio la pynlong u lyngskor jong ka Akhaïa kaba ha ka hima Rom , ki Jiw ki la ïalumlang hangta , ki la kem ïa u Paul , bad ki la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïingbishar .

translation.en: Even he shall build the temple of the  Lord   ; and he shall bear the glory , and shall sit and rule upon his throne  ; and he shall be a priest upon his throne : and the counsel of peace shall be between them both .
translation.kha: U long ma u , u ban tei ïa ka bad ïohpdiang ïa ka burom kaba dei ïa u syiem bad un synshar ïa ki briew jong u . U lyngdoh un ïeng hajan ka khet jong u , bad kin ïatreilang ha ka jingsuk bad ha ka jingïasngewtynnat .’

translation.en: But he said unto them ,  All men cannot receive this saying , save they to whom it is given .
