translation.en: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive , and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword .

translation.kha: Pynshahshkor ïa kaba Trai u ong shaphang u syiem ïa hima kaba Dabid u synshar bad shaphang ki jong kane nongbah , kata , ba-ha-ïing jong phi ki bym la shah rah noh kum ki koidi lem phi .
translation.en: Know that thus saith the  Lord  of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David , and of all the people that dwelleth in this city , and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity  ;

translation.kha: jied ka jaka ki briew jong nga ki bad nga pynsah ïa ki hangta , ha kaba kin im khlem da shah banbeiñ shuh . Naduh rung sha ka ri , ki la shah tur ïaleh ha ki riewrunar , hynrei kane kan ym jia . kular ban sumar ïa me na ki nongshun jong me bad ban ai ha me ki khun ki
translation.en: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel , and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies . Also the  Lord  telleth thee that he will make thee an house .

translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki jong jingjynjar me kin shu jah noh na ki jong jingkynmaw me , kum ki jingshlei um kiba la ïaid lait noh bad ym don jingkynmaw shuh .
translation.en: Because thou shalt forget thy misery , and remember it as waters that pass away :

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih biang ïa u ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad lada ha ka jong jingshem u ba ka kata prum ka long kumjuh kam bad shym pur , un pynkyrpang ïa u sa hynñiew sngi .
translation.en: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day : and , behold , if the plague in his sight be at a stay , and the plague spread not in the skin  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more :

translation.kha: Ka Abigail ka la pynstet ban lum ki , ar tylli ki pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ , san tylli ki langbrot kiba la syang , khathynñiew kilo kew ba la sdieh ; shispah tylli rynjup bad arspah tylli ki thup soh Dumbur tyrkhong , ka pynkit ki halor kada
translation.en: Then Abigail made haste , and took two hundred loaves , and two bottles of wine , and five sheep ready dressed , and five measures of parched corn , and an hundred clusters of raisins , and two hundred cakes of figs , and laid them on asses .

translation.kha: Nangta Tnat la ong ïa kane ha u Hananaïah , bad Gaddah la bynrap , To shahshkor , ko Thang ! U Trai um shym la phah ïa me , bad la pynlong ïa kine ki briew ban ngeit pang ka lamler .
translation.en: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet , Hear now , Hananiah  ; The  Lord  hath not sent thee  ; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie .
For Jesus himself testified , that a prophet hath no honour in his own country .
translation.kha: Naba ma u hi u la ong ,  Ïa u nongïathuhlypa ym ju ñiewkor ha la ka jong ka ri .

Ka la Jingïathuhlypa ka snem kaba sngewpyngngad jong ka bapaw u tih Tiberios ; u Pontios Madon u la long u Khynñiuh jong ka Bud , U Herod u basanphew long jingsngewthuh Paran jong ka Galilaïa , bad u Philip u para balieh u , u 21 long u nongsynshar jong ka Ahijah Ituria bad Trakhonitis ; u Lysanias u la jer u nongsynshar jong ka Phoenisia ,
translation.en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar , Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea , and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee , and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis , and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene ,
Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I remember that which Amalek did to Israel , how he laid wait for him in the way , when he came up from Egypt .
translation.kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki paid Amalek namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel mynba ki wan na Ijipt .

translation.en: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance , that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs , which were committed before you , and that ye defile not yourselves therein : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u la ong ,  Kohnguh ïa ki hukum kiba nga ai bad wat bud ïa ki rukom im jong kito ki briew kiba shong ha kata ka ri ha shuwa jong phi , bad wat pynbyrsieh ruh ïa lade da kaba leh ïa kano kano na kine ki kam . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice , but they could not : so there were lice upon man , and upon beast .
translation.kha: Kita ki nongleh myntor ki pyrshang ban pyndonkam ïa ki buit myntor jong ki ban pynmih mait , hynrei kim lah . Bad kat shaba leit don tang ki mait suda .
sumar ïa ki jinghikai jong nga ha ki Urbanos baroh ; thoh ïa ka Arabia Shebat dohnud Biblos phi .
translation.en: Bind them upon thy fingers , write them upon the table of thine heart .

translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter shongksuid leh ïa kane man la ka sngi . Te ka duwan kan sa long kaba khuid phar ; bad ka bor jong ka jingkhuid jong ka kan pynmynsaw kat ïa uba balang ïa ka .
translation.en: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar , and sanctify it  ; and it shall be an altar most holy : whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy .
And then shall he send his angels , and shall gather together his elect from the four winds , from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven .
translation.kha: Un phah noh ïa ki angel sha sawdong ka pyrthei ban ïalumlang ïa ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei , na kawei ka dong jong ka pyrthei sha kawei pat .

Hadien kata nongsumar Jisu u leit bam ha ka ïing aiti Lebi . Don bun ki jingbymkohnguh kylluid bad kiwei kiba la shah kyntait thliem ka imlang ka sahlang kiba ïabud ïa U Madan , bad bun na ki , ki la ïadon Khra-pait Gederoth u lem bad umbiah ktah jong u jingshahjop ka miej bam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as Jesus sat at meat in his house , many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples : for there were many , and they followed him .
And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur  ; and a third part at the gate behind the guard : so shall ye keep the watch of the house , that it be not broken down .
translation.kha: sa shi bynta na ka lai bynta kin ïeng ap phira ha ka Khyrdop Sur , bad kiba sah shi bynta na ka lai bynta na phi kin ïeng ap phira ha ka khyrdop ha lyndet jong kiwei ki nongap phira .

translation.en: For , lo , I will make thee small among the heathen , and despised among men .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ïa pha ban nang tlot , bad yn ym don baburom ïa pha .

Ha kawei sngi ka u Ahab u ong ha u Naboth , Ai noh ïa kane ka bri sohwaiñ jong me ha nga ba ngan pynlong ka kper jhur ka ïa , namar ka don harud ka ïingsyiem jong nga Ngan . ai pli ïa me da ka bri sohwaiñ kaba kham bha ha ka jong jaka ka , lane , me lada sngewdei , ngan da siewdor kaba biang ïa ka .
translation.en: And Ahab spake unto Naboth , saying , Give me thy vineyard , that I may have it for a garden of herbs , because it is near unto my house : and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it  ; or , if it seem good to thee , I will give thee the worth of it in money .

And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked , beside that which she had brought unto the king . So she turned , and went away to her own land , she and her servants .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u ai ïa ka syiem jong ka Sheba kat ïa kaba ka pan . Kane ka long nalor kaei kaba u la ai markylliang ha ka na ka bynta ki jingai sngewbha kiba ka la wanrah ïa u . Nangta ma ka bad ki nongbud jong ka ki la leit phai sha ka ri Sheba .
shon Dabid u lah da Un ha ka shnong Mahanaim ha ka por ba u Absalom bad ki Israel ki la dep jam sha shiliang jingduwai Jordan .
translation.en: Then David came to Mahanaim . And Absalom passed over Jordan , he and all the men of Israel with him .
And David cried to the people , and to Abner the son of Ner , saying , Answerest thou not , Abner ? Then Abner answered and said , Who art thou that criest to the king ?
translation.kha: u pyrta ïa ki shipai u Saul bad ïa u Abner ,  Ko Abner ! Hato phi ïohsngew ïa nga ?   Uei uta uba pyrta bad uba pynkyndit thiah ïa u syiem ?  u Abner u kylli .
Gilead dei ban duwai Solomon ka bynta ka Hima Pyndem Blei katei Sebul wan .—Mathaios 6 :10 .
translation.en: We should pray for God’s Kingdom to come . —Matthew 6 :10 .
Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah , in Issachar :
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat , u khun jong u Paruah : ka ri Issakhar
Haba u ba nga , u mareh shabar ïing , iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup hajan nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled , and got him out .
This is the bread which cometh down from heaven , that a man may eat thereof , and not die .
translation.kha: Hynrei u kpu uba wan hiar na bneng u long uta ïa uba uno uno uba bam ïa u un ym ïap .
Naba kaba otsher ne kaba khlem otsher ïa u briew kam don jingmut ei ei kaei ; kaba donkam ka long ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Blei .
translation.en: Circumcision is nothing , and uncircumcision is nothing , but the keeping of the commandments of God .
Behold , I am the  Lord  , the God of all flesh : is there any thing too hard for me ?
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  , U Blei ki jaitbynriew baroh . Ym don kaei kaei kaba eh than ïa nga ban leh .

translation.en: Set up the standard toward Zion : retire , stay not : for I will bring evil from the north , and a great destruction .
translation.kha: To kdew ïa ka lynti sha Seïon ! To phet ban lait im ! Wat ym pynslem ! U  Trai  u wallam ka jingjot bad ka jingpynjot kaba khraw na shatei .
Ha ka ka wah ka saw da ka snam , bad U Blei u don kaei kaba kham sniew la buh na ka bynta ki briew hangta . Ho-oid , yn don ka ba lyngkien snam ïa uwei baroh la iehnoh Moab .
translation.en: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood : for I will bring more upon Dimon , lions upon him that escapeth of Moab , and upon the remnant of the land .
While we look not at the things which are seen , but at the things which are not seen : for the things which are seen are temporal ; but the things which are not seen are eternal .
translation.kha: Naba ngi pynleit jingmut , ym ha kiei kiei kiba lah ban ïohi , hynrei ha kiei kiei ki bym lah ban ïohi . Kata kaba lah ban ïohi ka neh tang shipor , hynrei kata ka bym lah ban ïohi ka neh junom .
Ki khun shynrang jong u Kanaan — u Sidon , u khun nyngkong u jong , bad u Heth — kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na . ki
translation.en: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn , and Heth ,

translation.kha: Nga kyiuh bad - Tba ; ka met jingduk nga baroh Mawsiang ka khynñiuh dkhat ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: Fear came upon me , and trembling , which made all my bones to shake .

translation.kha: U Trai Enshemesh shah ba jingjam nongshun kin jop sukher phi . Phin tur pyrshah ïa ai na kherub ka dong , hynrei phin sa Lane ïap na kiba bun ki dong , bad ki briew ka pyrthei ïakhalai sngewsheptieng haba ki ïohi aïu ka jia ïa phi .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies : thou shalt go out one way against them , and flee seven ways before them : and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth .

translation.kha: Nga la ïoh sa pat kawei ka jingïohipaw . Ha kane ka por nga la ïohi saw ki tylli kali ïapom kiba wan mih napdeng ki ar tylli ki lumbah rnong .
translation.en: And I turned , and lifted up mine eyes , and looked , and , behold , there came four chariots out from between two mountains  ; and the mountains were mountains of brass .
I , even I , am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake , and will not remember thy sins .
translation.kha: Bad pynban , nga long U Blei uba map ïa ki pop jong phi , bad nga leh ïa kane namar uei ba nga long . Ngan ym bat ïa ki pop jong phi pyrshah ïa phi .

translation.en: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god , whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory : and he shall cause them to rule over many , and shall divide the land for gain .
translation.kha: Ban ïada ïa la ki kut , un pyndonkam ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u blei nongwei . Un ai ka jingpyndonburom kaba khraw ïa kito kiba pdiang ïa u kum u nongsynshar , un buh ïa ki ha ki jaka treikam ba-halor , bad un ai ka jaka ïa ki kum ka bainong .

translation.en: When Jesus saw him lie , and knew that he had been now a long time in that case , he saith unto him ,  Wilt thou be made whole ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa u ba u thiah hangta , bad u la tip ba uta u briew u la pang la slem bah ; kumta u la kylli ïa u ,  Me kwah ban ïohkhiah ?

Phi la pynlut shibun ka por kaba la noh leit da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ki bymngeit ki kwah ban leh . ka Ïa jingim jong phi la pynlut ha kaba awria im , jingkwah brai , jingdih buaid , jingleh jakhlia , ki jingïaleh-sngewbha buaid , bad ha ka jingmane ba-ijli ki ïa bleithaw .
translation.en: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles , when we walked in lasciviousness , lusts , excess of wine , revellings , banquetings , and abominable idolatries :
And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars , and burned men s bones upon them , and returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U pynïap lut ïa ki lyngdoh nongmane blei thala halor ki duwan ba ki shakri , bad u thang ïa ki shyieng briew ha kawei pa kawei ka duwan . Nangta u leit phai pat sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent : and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning .
translation.kha: U briew uba stad , uba rangbah jingmut u long uba paw ha ka jingshemphang jong u . Katba nang sngewtynnat ki ktien ba u kren , katta u nang lah ban pynkohnguh .
Un long u briew uba Pekod ha khmat U Trai . Um lyngba ban dih kano kano ka bsein lane ka jingdih kaba khor . Naduh ka jingkha ïa u , yn pyndap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,
translation.en: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord , and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink  ; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost , even from his mother s womb .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la wan poi ha Elim , ha la kaba don khat-ar tylli ki umpohliew bad hynñiewphew tylli ki Tlai dieng ; bad hangta ki la ïasher dara harud um .
translation.en: And they came to Elim , where were twelve wells of water , and threescore and ten palm trees : and they encamped there by the waters .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , Ngan pyndonkam ïa u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia ban pyndkut noh ïa ka jong ka Ijipt .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon .

translation.kha: U paralok u thmu ïa kaba bha , wat haba u pynmong ïa . phi Hynrei haba u nongshun u buh ïa ka ksang ti jong u halor ka jong tyrpeng phi — da husiar !
translation.en: Faithful are the wounds of a friend  ; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful .

translation.kha: Haba nga la pyndep ïa kane ka kam bad nga ba la dep aiti sha ki ïa baroh ka pisa ïa kaba la dep pynmih na ka bynta jong ki , ngan sa mih ban leit sha Spain bad wan khmih artat ïa phi ha ka jingleit lynti shata .
translation.en: When therefore I have performed this , and have sealed to them this fruit , I will come by you into Spain .
And with many such parables spake he the word unto them , as they were able to hear it .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u ha ki briew , u da pyndonkam shibun kiwei pat ki pharshi kum kine ; u la ïathuh shibun ïa ki kat kaba ki lah ban sngewthuh .

translation.en: Then ye shall come up after him , that he may come and sit upon my throne  ; for he shall be king in my stead : and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah .
translation.kha: Bud biang ïa u shane haba u wan ban shong ha ka khet jong nga . Un long syiem hadien jong nga , namar u dei ma u , uta uba nga la jied ban long u nongsynshar jong ka Israel bad ka Judah .
U Trai u la ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih . Uno uno “phla tim ïa la u kpa ne ïa la Saul kmie un shah shu ; u la kwah hi ïa ka jingïap jingduh
translation.en: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death : he hath cursed his father or his mother  ; his blood shall be upon him .

translation.kha: phi baroh yn pynjahburom — phi kiba ong ba dieng u dei u jong phi bad ba u mawsiang u dei ka kmie jong phi . Kane kan jia namar phi la phai noh nga ha jaka phin phai sha nga . haba phi don ha ka jingjynjar , phi kyrpad ïa nga bad pynim ïa phi
translation.en: Saying to a stock , Thou art my father  ; and to a stone , Thou hast brought me forth : for they have turned their back unto me , and not their face : but in the time of their trouble they will say , Arise , and save us .
But the  Lord  is my defence  ; and my God is the rock of my refuge .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u kyrshan ïa nga ; U Blei jong nga u ïada ïa nga .

translation.en: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you , saying , The  Lord  will deliver us . Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?
translation.kha: Wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un pynbieit ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa phi . Hato ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ki pyllait ïa ki ri jong ki na u patsha ka Assyria ?

translation.en: And he said ,  That which cometh out of the man , that defileth the man .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ka long kaei kaba mih na u briew kaba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u .
Pekod , kumba ka long , U Shua u la buh ïa ki dkhot kiba ïapher ha ka met kumba u kwah ïa ki ba kin long .
translation.en: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body , as it hath pleased him .

But above all things , my brethren , swear not , neither by heaven , neither by the earth , neither by any other oath : but let your yea be yea  ; and your nay , nay  ; lest ye fall into condemnation .
translation.kha: Nalor kine baroh , ko parabangeit jong nga , wat pyndonkam da ka jingsmai haba phi pynlong ka jingkular . Wat smai da ka bneng ne da ka khyndew ne da kaei kaei pat . Shu ong  Ho-oid  haba phi mut ho-oid , bad  Em  haba phi mut em , bad phin ym hap hapoh ka jingbishar U Blei .

translation.en: Haste ye , and go up to my father , and say unto him , Thus saith thy son Joseph , God hath made me lord of all Egypt : come down unto me , tarry not :
translation.kha: Mynta khreh kloi ban leit sha i pa , bad ong ha i ba u Joseph u khun jong i u ong kumne , ‘ U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga u nongsynshar ïa ka ri Ijipt baroh ; wan noh sha nga , bad wat pynslem .

translation.en: And thou shalt say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee , saying , Let my people go , that they may serve me in the wilderness : and , behold , hitherto thou wouldest not hear .
translation.kha: Nangta ong ha u Pharaoh , ‘ U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u la phah ïa nga ban ong ha phi ba phin shah ïa ki briew jong u ban leit , khnang ba kin ïoh ban mane ïa u ha ri shyiap . Hynrei haduh mynta phim shym shahshkor .

translation.en: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the  Lord  , we will not hearken unto thee .
translation.kha: Ngi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba phi la ïathuh ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh : and when the hair in the plague is turned white , and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh , it is a plague of leprosy : and the priest shall look on him , and pronounce him unclean .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa kata ka prum , bad lada u shñiuh hangta u la kylla lieh bad kata ka prum ka i kumba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid .

Don na ki briew jong pha , kiba pynïap ïa ki briew da kaba ïoh jingsiew . Don kiba shim sut halor ki ram ba ai ki ïa ki para jait Israel bad ki riewspah kaba da shim kabu ïa ki . Ki la ïa klet nga . Trai U Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood  ; thou hast taken usury and increase , and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion , and hast forgotten me , saith the Lord  God .
When he had thus spoken , he spat on the ground , and made clay of the spittle , and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la ong ïa kane , U Jisu u la biah ha ka khyndew bad u la khleh ktieh da ka umbiah ; u la kyllan da ita i sboh ktieh ha ki khmat uta u briew bad u la ong ,

u la ong Ieit u Hasael , uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong kitkhia , Khie leit rah Moab lyngktop sngewbha Gamaliel u nongïathuhlypa , bad kyrpad ïa u ban Da na U jingpynhiarkput la ngan Siph biang ne em .
translation.en: And the king said unto Hazael , Take a present in thine hand , and go , meet the man of God , and enquire of the  Lord  by him , saying , Shall I recover of this disease ?
And they lifted up their voice , and wept again : and Orpah kissed her mother in law  ; but Ruth clave unto her .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ki sdang ban ïam . Nangta ka Orpah ka doh khublei ïa la ka kiaw kurim bad ka leit phai pat sha ïing , hynrei ka Ruth ka snoh rdin ha ka .
U Hasael u syiem ka Syria u thom beiñ ïa ki Israel baroh lynter ka jingsynshar u Jehoahas ,
translation.en: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz .
The king s wrath is as the roaring of a lion  ; but his favour is as dew upon the grass .
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar u syiem ka long kum ka jingkyrhuh u sing , hynrei ka jingsngewbha jong u ka long kum u slap ba pdiang hun .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ? and still he holdeth fast his integrity , although thou movedst me against him , to destroy him without cause .
translation.kha: Hato me la peit-thuh ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ?  U  Trai  u kylli .  Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba ïaineh bad uba bha kat ma u . U mane ïa nga bad u kiar ban ym leh ïa kano kano kaba sniew . Me kynshuit ïa nga ban shah ïa me ban tur pyrshah ïa u khlem don kano kano ka daw , hynrei u Job u ïailong hi uba ïaineh kumba u ju long .
Ai nga sha u khulom .
translation.en: Pass me the pen .
And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these , and it shall be forgiven him : and the remnant shall be the priest s , as a meat offering .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop ba uta u briew u la leh , bad yn map ïa u . U purew uba dang sah un long jong u lyngdoh , kumba ka long ha ka jingkñia ainguh bam .
Ka long kaba ju long ba u uba stad u kaei dei bad uba bieit u leh ïa ka .
translation.en: A wise man s heart is at his right hand  ; but a fool s heart at his left .

And the  Lord  said unto him , Call his name Jezreel  ; for yet a little while , and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu , and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Hosia ,  Pynkyrteng ïa u , u ‘ Jesreel ,’ namar kan ym slem shuh shuwa ba ngan pynshitom ïa u syiem ki Israel namar ki kam pynïap briew ba u kpa tymmen jong u , u Jehu u la leh ha Jesreel . Ngan pynkut noh ïa ka jingsynshar na ka longïing syiem jong u Jehu .
Haba u Saul u la wan poi hajan ka nongbah Damaskos kynsan , ka jingshai na ka sahit bneng ka thaba la lep sawdong ïa u .
translation.en: And as he journeyed , he came near Damascus : and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven :

translation.kha: Kane ka ka ri jong ki longïing ka jait Ephraim : u jong ki u sdang na Ataroth phang mihngi haduh Beth kaba Shaneng ,
translation.en: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus : even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth–addar , unto Beth–horon the upper  ;
For if any be a hearer of the word , and not a doer , he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass :
translation.kha: Uno uno uba shahshkor ïa ka ktien hynrei u bym pyntreikam ïa ka u long kum u briew uba peit ha ka ïitkhmih bad ïohi ïa lade kumba u long .

translation.en: And I said unto them , We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews , which were sold unto the heathen  ; and will ye even sell your brethren ? or shall they be sold unto us ? Then held they their peace , and found nothing to answer .
translation.kha: Katba ngi lah , ngi la ïathied pat ïa ki para Jiw ïa kiba la die sha ki nongwei . Mynta phi pynlong ïa la ki para ki hynmen jong phi ban die ïa lade ha phi , ki para Jiw jong ki !  Ki nongïalam ki la sngap jar bad kim don ei ei ban ong .

U Trai U Blei jong Ia u la byrngem bymlalot wir ka ri da Media jingjot , bad mynta u la leh ïa dondor kaba u la ong ba un leh . Baroh kane ka la jia namar ki briew jong phi ki la jakhlia pop pyndkoh ïa ïatyllun Trai bad Ashteroth ba-itriem la kohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: Now the  Lord  hath brought it , and done according as he hath said : because ye have sinned against the  Lord  , and have not obeyed his voice , therefore this thing is come upon you .

They bear him upon the shoulder , they carry him , and set him in his place , and he standeth  ; from his place shall he not remove : yea , one shall cry unto him , yet can he not answer , nor save him out of his trouble .
translation.kha: Ki kyntiew ïa ka ha la ki tyrpeng bad rah ïa ka ; ki buh ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka , bad hangta ka ïeng , khlem lah ban khih na ka jaka ba ka don . Lada don uno uno ba duwai ha ka , kam lah ban jubab lane pyllait ïa u na ka jingjot .
Thaw ïa ki kyrwoh da ka jaiñ kaba jngum ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba harud duh na jingkah baroh tylli .
translation.en: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling  ; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain , in the coupling of the second .

translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ong , Ha khmih ! Kine hangne ar tylli ki waitlam , ko Kata Kynrad ! ka la biang ! u la jubab .
translation.en: And they said , Lord , behold , here are two swords . And he said unto them ,  It is enough .
And they found Adoni–bezek in Bezek : and they fought against him , and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites .
translation.kha: Ki la lap ïa u Adonibesek hangta bad ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .

kata juk dei Assos Merodakh ñiangthohlieh kaba la shong slem phylliew U lyngdoh Aben pynbna Kheiñ uta u briew u long u Por purew Ym rat donkam ban pynkyrpang ïa u , naba u la long lypa u bymkhuid klim
translation.en: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh , and the priest shall pronounce him unclean , and shall not shut him up : for he is unclean .
For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia , and answereth to Jerusalem which now is , and is in bondage with her children .
translation.kha: Ka Hagar , kaba ïeng na ka bynta u lum Sinai ha Arabia , ka long ka dur jong ka nongbah Jerusalem kaba mynta , ka shong mraw ryngkat bad ki briew jong ka baroh .

translation.en: Behold , the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan .
translation.kha: Phin tip ba U Blei uba im u don hapdeng jong phi haba ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  jong ka pyrthei baroh kan jam ïa ka Jordan ha shuwa jong phi .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me , but evil ?
translation.kha: U Ahab u ong ha u Jehoshaphat ,  Hato ngam shym la ïathuh ïa phi ba um ju ïathuhlypa ei ei kaba bha ïa nga ? Ka long borabor kaba sniew !

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron , when they offered before the  Lord  , and died  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kren ha u Moses hadien ka jingïap jong ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron kiba la shah pynïap mynba ki kñia ainguh ha U  Trai  da ka ding bymkhuid .
To U Trai un ainong blem phi namar kaei kaba phi jingshlei leh . Ai ba phin ïoh ka bainong kaba pura na U Trai U Blei ki Israel , sha uba phi la wan ban ïoh jingïada .
translation.en: The  Lord  recompense thy work , and a full reward be given thee of the  Lord  God of Israel , under whose wings thou art come to trust .
Scornful men bring a city into a snare : but wise men turn away wrath .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki bym ñiewkor ïa kiwei pat , ki lah ban pynkhih kulmar ïa ki nongbah baroh . Kito kiba stad ki pynjai jai ïa kiei kiei .

translation.en: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab ? did he ever strive against Israel , or did he ever fight against them ,
translation.kha: Me tharai ba me kham bha ban ïa u Balak , u khun jong u Sippor , u syiem Moab ? Um ju ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel . Hato u la ju ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ngi ?

translation.en: And when we heard these things , both we , and they of that place , besought him not to go up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Haba ngi la ïohsngew ïa kane , ma ngi bad kiwei pat kiba hangta , ngi la kyrpad ïa u Paul ban ym leit sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand , and how many baskets ye took up ?
translation.kha: Bad kumno shaphang ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki saw hajar ngut ki rangbah ? Katno shang phi la ïa-pyndap ?

translation.en: That ye may approve things that are excellent ; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ ;
translation.kha: Te phin long kiba lait na baroh ki jingbymkhuid bad khlem shah kynnoh pop ha ka Sngi U Khrist .
U la Ethbaal ïa phi bad ïa kiwei pat ki Gospel jinghiarthma ïoh hynriewspah kane ka burom Mano hamar mynta pat phi ïakheit ban ïoh sa pyntwa ka kam lyngdoh ruh Tola
translation.en: And he hath brought thee near to him , and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee : and seek ye the priesthood also ?

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u ong ha u Abishai , U Sheba un kham pynjynjar ïa ngi ban ïa Absalom . Shim rangbah jong nga bad leit thwet ïa u , lym kumta u ban leit shnong ha ki shnong ba la ker kynroh , bad lait phet na ngi .
translation.en: And David said to Abishai , Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom : take thou thy lord s servants , and pursue after him , lest he get him fenced cities , and escape us .
And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah , and all their victuals , and went their way .
translation.kha: Kita ki saw ngut ki syiem ki la shim lut khoit kat kaba don ha Sodom bad Gomorrah , kaba kynthup ruh ïa ka jingbam bad ki la leit noh .

translation.en: And her father said , I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her  ; therefore I gave her to thy companion : is not her younger sister fairer than she ? take her , I pray thee , instead of her .
translation.kha: U ong ha u Samson ,  Nga nang pyrkhat ba me isih ïa ka , te kumta nga la ai noh ïa ka ha u paralok jong me . Hynrei kam pher , ka para jong ka , ka kham bhabriew ban ïa ka . Me lah ban shim noh da ka .
U la leit biang sha ka ha por khyndai baje bad u ïohi katto katne ngut ki rangbah ïa-ïeng hangta khlem kam ,
translation.en: And he went out about the third hour , and saw others standing idle in the marketplace ,
All the males among the priests shall eat thereof : it is most holy .
translation.kha: Uno uno u shynrang uba na ka longïing u lyngdoh u lah ban bam ïa kane ka jingainguh ; ka dei kaba khuid bha .
Hynrei nongap kmen namar ba ki mynsiem bymman ki kohnguh ïa phi ; pynban , to kmen namar ba ïa ki kyrteng jong phi la thoh ha bneng .
translation.en: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not , that the spirits are subject unto you  ; but rather rejoice , because your names are written in heaven .
How can God’s Word improve your life ?
translation.kha: Kumno ka ktien U Blei kan kham pynbha ïa ka jingim jong phi ?

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab , and all that he did , and the ivory house which he made , and all the cities that he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Ahab u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingïathuh shaphang ka ïingsyiem jong u ba la pynitynnat da ki bniat hati bad ïa baroh ki nongbah ïa kiba u la tei , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel
duitara U Blei u rai Mynsiem! imat u slap un hap , bad syrdoh Mareshah lynti ki Phestos ba pynlong jngi ;
translation.en: When he made a decree for the rain , and a way for the lightning of the thunder :

translation.kha: Ka la long ka por tlang bad ka Jingkhawai jong ka ïa ka Templ dang rakhe ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication , and it was winter .

translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la Mysia ïohnang bad ikordor la iehnoh ïa Kenas bad ki la leit noh .
translation.en: When they had heard these words , they marvelled , and left him , and went their way .

translation.kha: kaba la jia ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la ong ïa phi ba u syiem ka Babilonia un ym tur ïaleh ïa phi ïa ka ri ?
translation.en: Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you , saying , The king of Babylon shall not come against you , nor against this land ?

translation.kha: Kane ka Issakhar kaba ïamudui la leh ka wanrah ïa ka jingpynjot bad jingduh jingdam noh ka longïing syiem jong u .
translation.en: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam , even to cut it off , and to destroy it from off the face of the earth .
I said , I would scatter them into corners , I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men :
translation.kha: Ngan jin da la pynjot thiaw ïa ki , khnang ban ym don ba kynmaw shuh ïa ki .

translation.en: And they said , Lord , behold , here are two swords . And he said unto them ,  It is enough .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ong ,  Ha khmih ! Kine hangne ar tylli ki waitlam , ko Kynrad !   Kata ka la biang !  u la jubab .
Na ka bynta nga , U Kpa u la jied ïa nga bad u la phah ïa sha pyrthei . Kumno , te , phi lah ong ba nga krenbeiñ blei namar ba nga la ong long U Khun U Blei ?
translation.en: Say ye of him , whom the Father hath sanctified , and sent into the world , Thou blasphemest  ; because I said , I am the Son of God ?

translation.kha: Hynrei kynhun Babilonia beh nadien jong ki bad kem ïa Sedekaïah ha ki hajan ka Jerikho . Te ki la leit ïalam ïa u sha u syiem , uba don ha ka nongbah Riblah ha ka ri Hamath , bad hangta u Nebukhadnessar u la ai ka jingrai halor jong u .
translation.en: But the Chaldeans  army pursued after them , and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho : and when they had taken him , they brought him up to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath , where he gave judgment upon him .

Then ye answered and said unto me , We have sinned against the  Lord  , we will go up and fight , according to all that the  Lord  our God commanded us . And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war , ye were ready to go up into the hill .
translation.kha: Te phi la jubab , ‘ Moses , ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Hynrei mynta ngin leit tur , kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ïa ngi .’ Nangta uwei pa uwei na phi u khreh ban ïaleh thma , u da tharai ba ka long kaba jem ban leit hiarthma ïa kata ka ri .

translation.en: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land , which they shall bring unto the  Lord  , shall be thine  ; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it .
translation.kha: Baroh ki long ki jong me . Uwei pa uwei na ka ïing jong me uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam u lah ban bam ïa ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent Nathan unto David . And he came unto him , and said unto him , There were two men in one city  ; the one rich , and the other poor .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa u Nathan , u nongïathuhlypa sha u Dabid . U Nathan u la leit sha u bad u ong ,  Don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba shong ha kajuh ka shnong ; uwei u long uba riewspah , bad uwei pat uba duk .

translation.en: Blessed is he that readeth , and they that hear the words of this prophecy , and keep those things which are written therein : for the time is at hand .
translation.kha: Suk uta uba pule ïa kane ka kitab , bad suk kito kiba shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong kane ka khubor jong ka jingïathuhlypa bad kiba kohnguh ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab ! Naba ka por ka la jan haba baroh kine kiei kiei kin sa jia .
( Salm 119 :97-100 ) Ki Khristan bashisha ki burom ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei ym namarba ïoh ki jingmyntoi ïalade .
translation.en: ( Psalm 119 :97-100 ) Yet , true Christians do not respect God’s standards merely to benefit themselves .
And the people said unto me , Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us , that thou doest so ?
translation.kha: Ki briew ki kylli ïa nga ,  Balei ba me leh kumne ?
banbeiñ ïa duk bad la shim na ki ïa u kew jong ki . Bad kumta phin ym ïoh sah ha maw ba-itynnat ba phi la tei lane waiñ na bri sohwaiñ ba phi la thung
translation.en: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor , and ye take from him burdens of wheat : ye have built houses of hewn stone , but ye shall not dwell in them  ; ye have planted pleasant vineyards , but ye shall not drink wine of them .

translation.kha: Ki phai bad ki leit noh , ki bad , khynnah ki jingri jingdup , bad ki jingdon jingem jong ki , ki leit ha shuwa .
translation.en: So they turned and departed , and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them .

And now , Israel , what doth the  Lord  thy God require of thee , but to fear the  Lord  thy God , to walk in all his ways , and to love him , and to serve the  Lord  thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul ,
translation.kha: Mynta , ko ki paid Israel , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u dawa na phi : Mane ïa U  Trai  bad leh ïa kata baroh kaba u hukum . Ieit ïa u , shakri ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh .

Ko jong ngi parabangeit , ngi dei ban ainguh ïa U Blei ha ki por baroh na ka bynta jong phi . Ka long kaba dei ïa ngi leh ban kumta , namar ba ka jingngeit jong phi la ka san shikatdei eh bad ba ka jingieit kaba iwei pa na iwei phi , phi don na ka bynta kiwei pat ka la nang kham khraw .
translation.en: We are bound to thank God always for you , brethren , as it is meet , because that your faith groweth exceedingly , and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth ;
Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week , he appeared first to Mary Magdalene , out of whom he had cast seven devils .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la mihpat na ka jingïap dang step phyrngab ha ka Sngi U Trai , u la mihpaw nyngkong ha ka Mari ka nong Magdala , na kaba u la pynmih noh ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki ksuid .

translation.en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly , nor standeth in the way of sinners , nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut ki briew basniew ki bym bud ïa ka jingleh ki nongpop lane ïasoh bad kito ki bymdonkam ïa U Blei .

translation.en: This is the first and great commandment .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka hukum kaba khraw tam bad kaba donkam tam .

Kumno me lah ban ong ba mem la shym pyntngit ïa lade , ba mem pat ju mane ïa Baal u ? Ha khmih kumno me la leh pop ha ka them ; ha peit kaei me la leh . Me long kum ka ut khlaw ka ha por jingkwah shongkha jong , ka kaba mareh laitluid kylleng ,
translation.en: How canst thou say , I am not polluted , I have not gone after Baalim ? see thy way in the valley , know what thou hast done : thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways  ;
And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law , and to Israel for an everlasting covenant ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ka jutang bad u Jakob , ka jutang ka ban neh junom .

Kumta ki paidbah ki sangeh noh ban mane ha ka Templ jong U Trai , U jong Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad ki sdang ban mane ïa ki bleithaw bad ïa ki dur jong blei ka Asherah . Ka jingrem jong ki kine namar ki pop ka la wallam ïa ka U jingbitar Trai halor ka ha Judah bad ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And they left the house of the  Lord  God of their fathers , and served groves and idols : and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass .

translation.kha: Ngi lang bam man ka janmiet .
translation.en: We eat together every evening .

translation.kha: Te U u la kren ha nga , bad la ïathuh ha ki rangbah la phah sha nga ban ha u ba U Trai , U Blei ki Israel u la
translation.en: Then said Jeremiah unto them , Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah :

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u la , ong Ngan wallam pat ïa ki paid Israel na ki jaitbynriew kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin tip ba nga long uba khuid . Ki paid Israel kin im ha la ka ri , ka ri kaba la ai nga ha u shakri jong nga Jakob u .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered , and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen , then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob .

translation.kha: Mano ba lah ban ïa dohnud briew Ym don kano kawei pat katta katta ; ka pang jur eh ïa kaba ïoh jingkoit .
translation.en: The heart is deceitful above all things , and desperately wicked : who can know it ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong To shahshkor ïa nga , phi kiba kwah ban jingim , phi wan sha nga ïoh jingïarap . Puson halor u na uba phi la wan , ka par maw kaba la tih ïa phi
translation.en: Hearken to me , ye that follow after righteousness , ye that seek the  Lord  : look unto the rock whence ye are hewn , and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged .

translation.kha: Kaba boi tuklar ha ka jingïania ka bym dei ka kam jong phi ka long juh leit sha lynti bah bad kem ïa u ksew na ki rai .
translation.en: He that passeth by , and meddleth with strife belonging not to him , is like one that taketh a dog by the ears .
They have set up kings , but not by me : they have made princes , and I knew it not : of their silver and their gold have they made them idols , that they may be cut off .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la jied ïa ki syiem . Hynrei ki la leh ïa kata ha la ka jong ka lynti . Ki thung ïa ki nongïalam , hynrei khlem ka jingpynskhem jong nga . Ki shim ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong ki bad ki thaw ïa ki bleithaw — na ka bynta ka jingjot jong ki hi .
kita kiba ïam , kumba kim shym la sngewsih ; kito kiba rkhie , kumba kim shym la don ka jingkmen ; bad kiba kito ïathied , kumba kim shym long ïa trai kaei kaba ki la thied ;
translation.en: And they that weep , as though they wept not ; and they that rejoice , as though they rejoiced not ; and they that buy , as though they possessed not ;

translation.kha: Napdeng jong ki la don kynthei ka kaba la shitom na ka jingpang mihsnam kaba jur la khat-ar ; snem ka la pynlut ïa baroh ka kaba don ha ki nongsumar , hynrei ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynkhiah ïa ka .
translation.en: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years , which had spent all her living upon physicians , neither could be healed of any ,

translation.kha: U Blei u la buh ïa khapngiah kiei baroh hapoh ki kjat U Khrist bad u la ai jinglaitluid u ha ka Balang kum Biblos Trai uba ha khlieh duh halor kiei kiei baroh .
translation.en: And hath put all things under his feet , and gave him to be the head over all things to the church ,

translation.kha: Ngam shah ïa ki kynthei ba kin hikai lane leh donbor halor ki shynrang ; dei ki ban long kiba jar jar .
translation.en: But I suffer not a woman to teach , nor to usurp authority over the man , but to be in silence .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba stad ki da ka jingshemphang , hynrei ïa briew kiba mutlop donkam ban pynshitom .
translation.en: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found : but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding .
Behold , the name of the  Lord  cometh from far , burning with his anger , and the burden thereof is heavy : his lips are full of indignation , and his tongue as a devouring fire :
translation.kha: Ïa ka bor bad ka burom U  Trai  yn ïohi naduh na sha jngai . Ka ding bad ka tdem ki pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar jong u . U kren , bad ki ktien jong u ki meh kum ka ding .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long kiba na ka longïing longsem jong u Aaron bad u Moses ha ka por ba U  Trai  u kren ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai .
hangno hangno ha kaba kim pdiang sngewbha ïa , to ïa kata ka shnong bad kynther noh u pui na ki kjat phi kum ka jingmaham ïa ki .
translation.en: And whosoever will not receive you , when ye go out of that city , shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them .

And if the bright spot stay in his place , and spread not in the skin , but it be somewhat dark  ; it is a rising of the burning , and the priest shall pronounce him clean : for it is an inflammation of the burning .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka dak ka sah kumjuh , bad kam shym pur satia , hynrei ka stang ha ka rong , kata kam dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh . U lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid , namar ka dei tang ka sohkhliang na kata ka dak ing ding .

translation.en: But when the officers came , and found them not in the prison , they returned , and told ,
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki rangbah synshar ki la poi , kim shym shem ïa ki apostol ha byndi , kumta ki la wan phai noh sha ka Dorbar bad ki la ïathuh ,

translation.en: And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in , and sat in the middle gate , even Nergal–sharezer , Samgar–nebo , Sarsechim , Rab–saris , Nergal–sharezer , Rab–mag , with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: ( Haba la kurup ïa ka Jerusalem , baroh ki rangbah synshar baheh kyrdan jong u syiem ka Babilonia ki la wan bad ki la ïeng ha la ki jaka ha ka Khyrdop Pdeng , kaba kynthup ïa ka Nergal Sareser , ka Samgar Nebo , ka Sarsekhim , bad kawei pat ka Nergal Sareser . )
Ha ka jingjynjar kum kane nga donkam ïa ki paralok — bashisha la nga la klet ne khlem klet ïa U Blei .
translation.en: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend  ; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty .

Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew , Behold , I have given Esther the house of Haman , and him they have hanged upon the gallows , because he laid his hand upon the Jews .
translation.kha: U syiem Serksis nangta u ong ha ka Esther ka mahadei bad u Mordekai , u Jiw ,  Peit , nga la sdien phasi ïa u Haman na ka bynta ka jingsylla pyrshah ïa ki Jiw , bad nga la ai ha ka Esther ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u .

translation.en: In his neck remaineth strength , and sorrow is turned into joy before him .
translation.kha: U ryndang jong u , u long uba khlaiñ eh ba baroh kiba ïakynduh ïa u ki sngewtriem .
Nga long u kpu ka jingim .
translation.en: I am that bread of life .

translation.kha: Mynta shim ïa ka bainong phi bad khie leit sha ïing . ai ha une u briew uba la shah khot khatduh katjuh nga la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Take that thine is , and go thy way : I will give unto this last , even as unto thee .

translation.kha: rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa ki jong U Jisu bad ki la tip ba la kren shaphang jong ki ,
translation.en: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables , they perceived that he spake of them .

translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa jingïabujli ! Pyndem ha u Riew-ieit ka Babilonia bad phin Gidom sang Balei ba kane ka jingpyrkhat kan kylla ka kynton ki ïap-tyrsaw ?
translation.en: Hearken not unto them  ; serve the king of Babylon , and live : wherefore should this city be laid waste ?

translation.kha: U bad ki paralok jong u ki la ïohthiah lyngngai , hynrei ki la thiah bad ki la ïohi ïa ka burom jong U bad ïa kita ki ar ngut rangbah kiba la lem bad u
translation.en: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep : and when they were awake , they saw his glory , and the two men that stood with him .
But when David saw that his servants whispered , David perceived that the child was dead : therefore David said unto his servants , Is the child dead ? And they said , He is dead .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la ïohi ba ki ïakren pasiaw para ma ki , u la sngewthuh ba u khunlung u la ïap . Kumta u kylli ïa ki ,  Hato u khunlung u la ïap ?   Ho-oid , u la ïap ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga kyrpad ïa phi ban shah ïa u ban tip ba phi ieit ïa u da shisha .

translation.en: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers ? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations ?
translation.kha: Mynta to ïathuh ïa ki Israel ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Balei phi dei ban leh ïa kijuh ki pop kiba ki kpa jong phi ki la leh bad ba phi ïabud nadien ki bleithaw jong ki ?
kynmaw aïu u leh ïa u Dathan bad u Abiram , ki u na ka jait Reuben Hangta ha khmat jong phi baroh , ka ka ang bad nguid ïa ki ki ba-ha-ïing ki , ïa ki ïingjaiñ ki ki jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab , the son of Reuben : how the earth opened her mouth , and swallowed them up , and their households , and their tents , and all the substance that was in their possession , in the midst of all Israel :
And they shall say , This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden  ; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced , and are inhabited .
translation.kha: Baroh kin ong kumno kane ka ri , kaba shisien ka la long ka jaka khlaw , ka la kylla long kum ka Kper Eden , bad kumno ba ki nongbah kiba la shah pynjot , shah lute bad shah iehnoh ha ki jingjot , ki long mynta ki jaka shong briew bad ki jaka ba la ker kynroh .

translation.en: Yet they went in unto her , as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot : so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah , the lewd women .
translation.kha: Ki leit phai bad ïai leit sha kine ki nuti . Ki leit biang sha ka Oholah bad ka Oholibah ; kito ki kynthei barunar .

Naba ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka Khubor Babha , kumba ma ki ruh ki la ïohsngew . Ki la ïohsngew ïa ka kubur , hynrei ïasait shym Hakhlieh Moresheth jingstad-buit ei ruh ïa malu , namar haba ki la ïohsngew ïa ka , im shym la nongiarap ïa ka da ka jingngeit .
translation.en: For unto us was the gospel preached , as well as unto them : but the word preached did not profit them , not being mixed with faith in them that heard it .

translation.kha: ( don La kumba san hajar ngut ki rangbah hangta . ) U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u , To pynshong ïa u paidbah ha ki kynhun kiba ngut sanphew kawei kawei .
translation.en: For they were about five thousand men . And he said to his disciples ,  Make them sit down by fifties in a company .
And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement .
translation.kha: Kane ka phyllaw kaba habar ka long kham hapoh ban ïa ka phyllaw kaba hapoh . Ka la don ka khyrdop kham hajrong kaba lam sha ka phyllaw kaba hapoh .

translation.en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work , and ye shall keep a feast unto the  Lord  seven days :
translation.kha: Ïalumlang ban mane Blei ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew . Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha kaba ai burom ïa U  Trai  hynñiew sngi lynter , bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .
La leit lam ïa u ha u Moses , u , Aaron bad ka kynhun baroh kawei ,
translation.en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron , and unto all the congregation .

translation.kha: jingpynjahburom ki Ñiew Paidbah’ lut ïa ki rudnong jong ki jingtong Lynti bym long satia ki blei , tang ki dur jong u dieng bad u maw Hophni la shna ïohkem ki kti tap-lup jingtrud
translation.en: And have cast their gods into the fire : for they were no gods , but the work of men s hands , wood and stone : therefore they have destroyed them .

translation.kha: ka jait Dan u ong , U u dei u sing ; Bashan u mih kynsan
translation.en: And of Dan he said , Dan is a lion s whelp : he shall leap from Bashan .

translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait pynbatai u ong , Ko Trai , to shahshkor shihajar ki kyrpad ban ïoh jingïarap ; Tehsong lamkhmat ki mihngi bad la ki para jait . Ïaleh na Samsummim bynta jong khait , ko Trai , Bad ïarap shatei-lam-mihngi ki pyrshah ïa ki tapmoh jong ki Ieit
translation.en: And this is the blessing of Judah : and he said , Hear ,  Lord  , the voice of Judah , and bring him unto his people : let his hands be sufficient for him  ; and be thou an help to him from his enemies .

translation.kha: jingïohipaw ka Babilonia yn lute , bad kito Kum Sikhri ïa ka kin arliang jyntang ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki neh . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren Nakon
translation.en: And Chaldea shall be a spoil : all that spoil her shall be satisfied , saith the  Lord .
For before that certain came from James , he did eat with the Gentiles : but when they were come , he withdrew and separated himself , fearing them which were of the circumcision .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba katto katne ngut ki rangbah ba la phah da u Jakob kin poi hangta , u Petros u la ïabam lang bad ki parabangeit Jentil . Hynrei hadien ba kine ki rangbah ki la poi , u la kynriah noh bad um shym ïabam lang shuh bad ki Jentil , namar u la sheptieng ïa kito kiba ha ka liang kiba otsher ïa ki .

Ngan pynthymmai ïa ka jutang ba nga la pynlong bad ki tymmen jong ki nga la pynpaw ïa la ka ha jaitbynriew baroh da kaba ïalam noh ïa la ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , ba ma , Trai , nga lah ban long U Blei ki Nga U Trai .
translation.en: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors , whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen , that I might be their God : I am the  Lord .
And Moses was very wroth , and said unto the  Lord  , Respect not thou their offering : I have not taken one ass from them , neither have I hurt one of them .
translation.kha: U Moses u la bitar lep , bad u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Wat pdiang ïa kano kano ka jingainguh ba kine ki briew ki wallam . Ngam shym la leh bymdei ïa uwei ruh na ki ; ngam shym la shim ruh wat tang kawei na ki kada jong ki .
kaba ïadei bad nga , nga ha ka bor jong phi To leh ïa nga ïa kano kano kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka kaba biang bad dei .
translation.en: As for me , behold , I am in your hand : do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you .

translation.kha: Ngan pyllait ïa kyrthep na ki paid Israel bad na kynthih Jentil sha kiba ngan phah ïa me .
translation.en: Delivering thee from the people , and from the Gentiles , unto whom now I send thee ,
To wit , the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem , and which see visions of peace for her , and there is no peace , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ai jingpynthikna ïa ka Jerusalem ba kaei kaei baroh ka bit ka biang , haba baroh kam bit kam biang !  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
Ha Ijipt ïa baroh kiba la nyngkong na ki briew na ki mrad
translation.en: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt , both of man and beast .

translation.kha: U la ong Lada phi kohnguh ïa nga naduh ka da kaba leh kaba nga ñiew ba ka long dei da kaba sumar ïa hukum jong nga , ym pynshitom ïa da jingpang kaba nga la pynngat ki Ijipt Nga long U Trai uba pynkhiah phi .
translation.en: And said , If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the  Lord  thy God , and wilt do that which is right in his sight , and wilt give ear to his commandments , and keep all his statutes , I will put none of these diseases upon thee , which I have brought upon the Egyptians : for I am the  Lord  that healeth thee .
Now the Spirit speaketh expressly , that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith , giving heed to seducing spirits , and doctrines of devils ;
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u la ong shai ba yn don ki briew ki ban iehnoh ïa ka jingngeit ha ki Ïa kiba khatduh : Kin kohnguh ïa ki mynsiem bashukor bad kin bud ïa ki jinghikai jong ki ksuid .

translation.en: The man departed , and told the Jews that it was Jesus , which had made him whole .
translation.kha: Te uta u briew u la leit noh bad u la ïathuh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba dei U Jisu uba la pynkhiah ïa u .
long haba u briew u phet ïap na u bad u ïakynduh ka dngiem ! lane kum haba u briew u wan sha ïing bad buh ïa la ka ha ka kynroh tang ban shah puh ha u bseiñ !
translation.en: As if a man did flee from a lion , and a bear met him  ; or went into the house , and leaned his hand on the wall , and a serpent bit him .

translation.kha: Ka bor jong U Trai ka la wan ha da ka borbah , bad katba U Mynsiem jong u , u rah noh ïa nga nga la sngewkthang sngewbitar .
translation.en: So the spirit lifted me up , and took me away , and I went in bitterness , in the heat of my spirit  ; but the hand of the  Lord  was strong upon me .

translation.kha: Ki la pynkup nangne ka :7 basawbthuh ha U Jisu , ki la thaw ïa ka pansngiat na Asshur jingsngewsih ba don shiah , pynsawa pynphong ïa ka ha ka khlieh kthong sngewtynnad ïalade
translation.en: And they clothed him with purple , and platted a crown of thorns , and put it about his head ,

translation.kha: pynsep-ei la bret dusmon ïa ka jaiñkup jong Kedemah , u rangïapom pynrangbah , bad u la wan sha U Jisu .
translation.en: And he , casting away his garment , rose , and came to Jesus .
And it came to pass , that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land , then I said , O Lord  God  , forgive , I beseech thee : by whom shall Jacob arise ? for he is small .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw jong nga , nga la ïohi ïa ki puit ba ki bam duh ïa baroh kaei kaei kaba jyrngam ha ka ri , bad nangta nga la ong ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , to map ïa ki briew jong me ! Kumno ki lah ban lait im ? Ki long kiba rit bad kiba tlot katta katta !
U buh ïa u diengpynïeng sharak hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka liang shaphang shathie , marpyrshah kata ka miej
translation.en: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation , over against the table , on the side of the tabernacle southward .
But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Bad da baroh ka spah bakyrhai jong u lyngba U Khrist Jisu , U Blei jong nga un pyndap ïa ka jingdonkam jong phi baroh .

U la ong ruh ïa ngi ban ym tei ki ïing ne rep ki lyngkha , bad ban ym buh ki bri sohwaiñ lane thied ïa ki . U la hukum ngi ïa ba ngin shong ngin sah borabor ha ki ïingjaiñ , khnang ba ngin don ha kane ka ri ha kaba ngi im kum ki . nongwei
translation.en: Neither shall ye build house , nor sow seed , nor plant vineyard , nor have any : but all your days ye shall dwell in tents  ; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers .

translation.kha: Ki jingkñia ainguh ki , jingkñia pop bad jingkñia ki ka na bynta ban siew pat , kin long ki jingbam jong ki lyngdoh , bad ki kin ïoh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha Israel ïa kiba la pynkyrpang na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: They shall eat the meat offering , and the sin offering , and the trespass offering  ; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs .

translation.kha: Ki long kiba bymman haduh katta katta ; ot ïa kum ki ïa u kew ha ka aïom ot ; pynlwet ïa ki kum ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ka jaka pynmih umsoh haduh ba ka umsoh ka shlei .
translation.en: Put ye in the sickle , for the harvest is ripe : come , get you down  ; for the press is full , the fats overflow  ; for their wickedness is great .

translation.kha: ( Pynban , Synduk ka Jutang ka ha Jerusalem , buh ïa ka ha ka ïingjaiñ kaba u Syiem Dabid la mynba u wanrah ïa Ka Synduk na Kiriath Jearim . )
translation.en: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath–jearim to the place which David had prepared for it : for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ki long kum ki khynnah kiba shong ha puit jaka ïew thwet Kawei ka kynhun ka Sakhar ïa Halor pat rai ‘ Ngi la ba-beit ka jingtem shongkurim na ka bynta pynmihpat phi , hynrei phim shym shad ! Ngi la rwai jingïadon jingrwai ïapbriew , mot jingsin shym Naomi !’
translation.en: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace , and calling one to another , and saying , We have piped unto you , and ye have not danced  ; we have mourned to you , and ye have not wept .
For he will finish the work , and cut it short in righteousness : because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth .
translation.kha: naba U Trai un pyndep kloi kloi ïa ka jingainong ba-pura na ka bynta ka pyrthei .
Katba dang don ka jingpynïap Pontos ki briew jong U Blei kin ïoh khyndiat ka phalang , wat la kiba bun kiba ïasoh bad ki kin leh kumta na ka bynta ki daw shimet .
translation.en: Now when they shall fall , they shall be holpen with a little help : but many shall cleave to them with flatteries .

translation.kha: ‘ Ngan ïarap ïa ki ,’ u ong ; ‘ bad ngan peit kai kan jia ïa ki . Kine ki dei ki briew kiba mutlop , kiba ym ka jingïaineh .
translation.en: And he said , I will hide my face from them , I will see what their end shall be : for they are a very froward generation , children in whom is no faith .
And the Lord said ,  Hear what the unjust judge saith .
translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la bteng ,  Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba uta u nongbishar bamsap u la ong .
Hynrei u noh , kata long kaba kut jong ; u ïap bad hangno keiñ
translation.en: But man dieth , and wasteth away : yea , man giveth up the ghost , and where is he ?
They did cry there , Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise  ; he hath passed the time appointed .
translation.kha: To ai da ka kyrteng bathymmai ïa u syiem ka Ijipt — ‘ U riew kob-pia uba la duh ei ïa la ka kabu’ .

translation.en: Leave thy fatherless children , I will preserve them alive  ; and let thy widows trust in me .
translation.kha: Ieh ïa ki khunswet bad nga , bad ngan sumar ïa ki . Ki riewkynthei ki lah ban shaniah ha nga .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , can these bones live ? And I answered , O Lord  God  , thou knowest .
translation.kha: U la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , hato kine ki shyieng ki lah ban ïoh pat ïa ka jingim ?  Nga la jubab ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , tang ma me uba lah ban jubab ïa kata !
Ha kylleng ka longïng longsem ka pait ka pra na ba sdang .
translation.en: Families everywhere are coming apart at the seams .

translation.kha: U Absalom u la krad phet bad u la leit sha u Talmai , u khun jong u Ammihud , u syiem Geshur bad u la sah hangta lai snem U . Dabid u la ïambriew slem na ka bynta u Amnon u jong khun u ;
translation.en: So Absalom fled , and went to Geshur , and was there three years .

Then said they , Come , and let us devise devices against Jeremiah  ; for the law shall not perish from the priest , nor counsel from the wise , nor the word from the prophet . Come , and let us smite him with the tongue , and let us not give heed to any of his words .
translation.kha: Nangta ki briew ki la ong ,  To ngin leh ei ei shaphang u Jeremaïah ! Yn don borabor ki lyngdoh ki ban hikai ïa ngi , ki rangbah bastad ban ai jingsyllok ïa ngi , bad ki nongïathuhlypa ban pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Blei . To ngin wallam ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u , bad sangeh ban pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba u ong .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  unto the house of Israel , Seek ye me , and ye shall live :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong kumne ha ki paid Israel ,  Wan sha nga , bad phin ïoh im .

translation.en: And it came to pass afterward , that David s heart smote him , because he had cut off Saul s skirt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingïatiplem jong u Dabid ka sdang ban pynjynjar ïa u ,
ki Kito nongïathuhlypa kiba ai jingpynthikna ïa ka Jerusalem ba kaei kaei baroh ka bit ka biang , haba baroh kam bit kam biang ! U Nongsynshar Trai u la kren .
translation.en: To wit , the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem , and which see visions of peace for her , and there is no peace , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Kumta sumar ban kohnguh bad leh ïa kaei kaei kaba la thoh ha u Moses .
translation.en: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses , that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left  ;

And command thou the people , saying , Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau , which dwell in Seir  ; and they shall be afraid of you : take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore :
translation.kha: U la ong ïa nga ban ai ha phi ïa kine ki jinghikai : ‘ Mynta phin ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri lum Edom , ka ri ki kur ki jait jong phi , ki khun ki ksiew u Iso .

translation.en: They shewed his signs among them , and wonders in the land of Ham .
translation.kha: Ki la leh ïa ki kam kiba donbor jong U Blei bad leh ïa ki kambah ha Ijipt .
Hadien katto katne u u long uba heh tam ki jingthung baroh . U ki tnat kiba heh haduh ki sim wan bad ha jingkah syrngiew jong .
translation.en: But when it is sown , it groweth up , and becometh greater than all herbs , and shooteth out great branches  ; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it .
And the  Lord  gave Solomon wisdom , as he promised him : and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon  ; and they two made a league together .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bat la ka kular bad u la ai ka jingstad ïa u Solomon . La don ka jingïasuk hapdeng u Hiram bad u Solomon , bad kine baroh ar ngut ki pynlong ka jingïateh lok .

translation.en: In that thou lovest thine enemies , and hatest thy friends . For thou hast declared this day , that thou regardest neither princes nor servants : for this day I perceive , that if Absalom had lived , and all we had died this day , then it had pleased thee well .
translation.kha: Phi pyrshah ïa kito kiba ieit ïa phi bad kyrshan ïa kito kiba isih ïa phi ! Phi la pynpaw shai ba ki nongpynïaidkam bad ki rangbah jong phi kim long ei ei ïa phi . Nga lah ban ïohi ba phin jin da la sngewhun lada u Absalom u dang im mynta bad ba ngi baroh ngin ïap .
la ka snem wallam ïa ki soh phi la lum nyngkong na ka jingot sha ka ïing U Trai Blei jong phi . Wat shet ïa u khunlangbrot ne dud ka kmie jong u .
translation.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the  Lord  thy God . Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother s milk .

translation.kha: pynkhreh kawei ka kali thymmai bad ar tylli ki masi kynthei ha ym pat ju pyndait lyngkor ; teh ki ha kata ka kali , bad ïalam noh ïa khun masi sha sem
translation.en: Now therefore make a new cart , and take two milch kine , on which there hath come no yoke , and tie the kine to the cart , and bring their calves home from them :

translation.en: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times , and shall pronounce him clean , and shall let the living bird loose into the open field .
And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  his God , and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad um shym shahshkor da kaba pynrit ïa lade ha u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa , uba kren ïa ka ktien U  Trai .

translation.en: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families  ; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast .
translation.kha: Ki longïing jong ka jait Judah ki la ïohpdiang shi bynta ka jaka kumba la batai harum : Ka ri ka kynjoh shathie sha ka tduh eh kaba shathie jong ka ri khlaw Sin , ha ka pud jong ka Edom .

translation.en: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way  ; yet saidst thou not , There is no hope : thou hast found the life of thine hand  ; therefore thou wast not grieved .
translation.kha: Phi pynthait ïa lade ban leit wad ïa kiwei pat ki blei , hynrei phim shym la sangeh . Phi pyrkhat ba ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong phi kin ai bor ïa phi , bad kumta phim ju khie tlot .

translation.en: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom , and stretch her wings toward the south ?
translation.kha: Hato u kbeit u nang na me kumno ban her , haba u pyiar la ki thapniang shaphang shathie ?

translation.en: Nicodemus saith unto them , ( he that came to Jesus by night , being one of them , )
translation.kha: Uwei na ki Pharisi hangta u dei u Nikodemos , u briew uba la leit mynshuwa ban ïohi ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And they shall spring up as among the grass , as willows by the water courses .
translation.kha: Kin san kin plung kum u phlang ba la ai um bha , kum ki dieng Jamynrei harud ki wahduid jong ka um batuid .
To shaniah U ha Trai , phi ki paid Israel . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .
translation.en: O Israel , trust thou in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .

translation.kha: U Shallum u khun u jong Jabesh u ïasylla pyrshah u ïa syiem Sekharaïah , u pynïap ïa u ha Ibleam , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him , and smote him before the people , and slew him , and reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: kata ka long ym ka jingïatiplem phi , ka jong uta uwei pat u briew . Kumta , te , don ban , balei ba ïa ka jinglaitluid jong nga ban leh kaei kaei buh pud da ka jingïatiplem jong uwei ?
translation.en: Conscience , I say , not thine own , but of the other : for why is my liberty judged of another man s conscience ?
And there was no bread in all the land  ; for the famine was very sore , so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine .
translation.kha: Kata ka  nemsniew ka la jur katta katta ba ym don jingbam shuh hangno hangno , ki briew ha Ijipt bad ha Kanaan ki la nang tlot namar ka jingthngan .

translation.en: Then began he to speak to the people this parable  ;  A certain man planted a vineyard , and let it forth to husbandmen , and went into a far country for a long time .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki paidbah ïa kane ka pharshi :  La don shisien uwei u briew uba don ka bri sohwaiñ , u la aiwai ha ki nongshimwai , bad nangta u la mihnoh na ïing ban jah kham slem .

translation.en: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness : thou hast said , None seeth me . Thy wisdom and thy knowledge , it hath perverted thee  ; and thou hast said in thine heart , I am , and none else beside me .
translation.kha: Pha sngewshngain ïa lade ha la ki kam sniew ; pha pyrkhat ba ym don mano mano ba ïohi ïa pha . Ka jingstad bad ka jingtip jong pha ki ïalam bakla ïa pha , bad pha ong ha lade , ‘ Nga long U Blei — ym don uno uno pat kum ma nga .’
u pukni u her ha suiñ , bseiñ u par halor u mawsiang , liengbah kaba ïa la ka lynti ha ka duriaw , bad u briew bad ka briew kiba .
translation.en: The way of an eagle in the air  ; the way of a serpent upon a rock  ; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea  ; and the way of a man with a maid .
Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain  ; he multiplieth words without knowledge .
translation.kha: Kam myntoi ïa me ban shu ïai kren ; ka long kaba shai kdar ba mem sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba me kren .
Ynda ki Israel ki wan phai na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Philistia , lute ki ïa ka jaka sher dara jong ki .
translation.en: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines , and they spoiled their tents .

translation.kha: Kine jingïasuk ki hynriew ngut ki longsyiem khop , ha ka sngewdei ryntih kat kum ka jingkha ïa ki ; la kha :23-25 ka bynta u Dabid ha Hebron : u Amnon Shallekheth uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Ahinoam , kaba na Jesreel ;
translation.en: And unto David were sons born in Hebron : and his firstborn was Amnon , of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess  ;

translation.kha: Hato ngim don bor ban bam bad ban dih ?
translation.en: Have we not power to eat and to drink ?

translation.kha: Ki blang khlaw ki im ha ki bajrong , bad ki phyllad ki ha synrang maw .
translation.en: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats  ; and the rocks for the conies .

translation.kha: Mem Ngi la ba-thaba ïa ki mrad kum ka jingainguh thang halor ka duwan lane ïa ki jingkñia ban shim noh ïa ki pop .
translation.en: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure .

So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them , the people answered the king , saying , What portion have we in David ? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse : to your tents , O Israel : now see to thine own house , David . So Israel departed unto their tents .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba u syiem um shahshkor ïa ki , ki la pyrta ,  Long ba la ñiewbeiñ ïa u Dabid bad ka longïing jong u ! Ki la leh aïu na ka bynta jong ngi ? Ko ki rangbah Israel , ïa ngin leit noh sha ïing ! To ai ba u Rehoboam un khmih hi ïa lade !
Ka jinglorni ka bang palat — katno ngi sngewieit ban nguid ka !
translation.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .
Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not : whosoever sinneth hath not seen him , neither known him .
translation.kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei uba long ha U Khrist , um ïai leh pop ; hynrei uno uno uba ïai leh pop , um pat shym la ïohi ïa u lane ithuh ïa u .

translation.en: And when the Lord saw her , he had compassion on her , and said unto her ,  Weep not .
translation.kha: Haba U Trai u la ïohi ïa ka , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingisynei ïa ka , bad u la ong ha ka ,  Wat ïam .

( U Absalom u la buh ïa u Amasa ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai ka ha jaka jong u Joab . U Amasa u dei u khun jong u Jether u nong Ishmael ; ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abigail , ka khun u jong Nahash bad ka para jong ka Seruïah , ka kmie jong u Joab . )
translation.en: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab : which Amasa was a man s son , whose name was Ithra an Israelite , that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash , sister to Zeruiah Joab s mother .
Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister , to vex her , to uncover her nakedness , beside the other in her life time .
translation.kha: Wat shim ïa la ka para ne hynmen kynsi kum kawei na ki tnga jong me katba ka tnga jong me , ka dang im .
U Trai khmih ba ïa ka jingshisha kyndong da kaba pynpulom ïa ki ktien jong ki nonglamler .
translation.en: The eyes of the  Lord  preserve knowledge , and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor .
Why are they late for the meeting ?
translation.kha: Balei ki slem ban wan sha ka jingialang ?

translation.en: So that ye come behind in no gift ; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Ka khubor shaphang U Khrist ka la shong skhem ha phi kat haduh ba phim shym duh noh ban pdiang wat tang ïa kawei ka jingkyrkhu , katba phi dang ap khmih lynti ba yn pynpaw ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .

Uno uno uba kheiñ kajuh bha ïa kano Adramyttion ka sngi , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai , uno uno u ïanujor bam Rehoboth Hit kaei , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai , namar u ainguh ïa U Blei Khalkedon ka bynta kata ka jingbam . Uno uno uba kyntait ban bam ïa kino kino ki jingbam Balak un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai bad u ainguh sha U Blei Merodakh
translation.en: He that regardeth the day , regardeth it unto the Lord ; and he that regardeth not the day , to the Lord he doth not regard it . He that eateth , eateth to the Lord , for he giveth God thanks ; and he that eateth not , to the Lord he eateth not , and giveth God thanks .

translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , don sa kawei phi pat kaba hap ban ap khmih lynti . Ym don jingkut ïa ka jingthoh kot bad ka jingpule bniah shaba palat kan pynlwait ïa phi .
translation.en: And further , by these , my son , be admonished : of making many books there is no end  ; and much study is a weariness of the flesh .
These were more noble than those in Thessalonica , in that they received the word with all readiness of mind , and searched the scriptures daily , whether those things were so .
translation.kha: Ki briew hangta ki long kiba kham ïar jingmut ban ïa ki briew kiba ha Thessaloni . Ki la shahshkor ïa ka khubor da ka jingangnud bakhraw , bad man ka sngi ki ju pule bniah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ban khmih lada kaei kaba u Paul u ong ka long kaba shisha .

translation.en: Likewise from Tibhath , and from Chun , cities of Hadarezer , brought David very much brass , wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea , and the pillars , and the vessels of brass .
translation.kha: U kurup ruh bun bah ka rnong na Tibhath bad Kun , ki nongbah ba synshar u Hadadeser . ( U Solomon hadien u pyndonkam ïa kane ka rnong ha kaba thaw ïa ka pung-um , ki rishot , bad ki khiew rong na ka bynta ka Templ . )

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Elah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
