Nangta waitlam la jingpynsah khlemrain ki Pyndonkam lyngdoh bad sha ki tymmen ki san sopti-lor ki Mephaath ong , Ngi la pynlong lang ka jingsmai ba sngewkhia ban ym bam Jerah kano tad Jakeh ngi la pynïap ïa u Paul .
translation.en: And they came to the chief priests and elders , and said , We have bound ourselves under a great curse , that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul .
And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women , and all that could hear with understanding , upon the first day of the seventh month .
translation.kha: Kumta u Esra u wanrah ïa ka sha ka jaka kaba u paidbah u la ïalumlang — ki rangbah , ki kynthei bad ki khynnah kiba la san kiba la lah ban sngewthuh .
Katba u dang kren , u lyoh u la paw bad u la Rabbah ïa ki par ka syrngiew jong u ; bad ki synran ki la sheptieng haba u lyoh u la wan halor jong ki .
translation.en: While he thus spake , there came a cloud , and overshadowed them : and they feared as they entered into the cloud .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , ki Israel ki ong Jingstad u Gideon , To long u nongsynshar jong ngi — ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew hadien jong me buh Me la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki katkum .
translation.en: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon , Rule thou over us , both thou , and thy son , and thy son s son also : for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian .

And the king said , And where is thy master s son ? And Ziba said unto the king , Behold , he abideth at Jerusalem : for he said , To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father .
translation.kha: Shaei u Mephibosheth u ksiew jong u Saul , u kynrad jong me ?  u syiem u kylli ïa u .  U sah ha Jerusalem ,  u Siba u la jubab ,  namar ba u la sngewthikna ba ki Israel mynta kin pynïoh pat ha u ïa ka hima jong u Saul , u kparad jong u .
Haba me phai noh na ki , ki sheptieng , haba me pynphai noh ka jingpyrsad , ïap bad ki phai khyndew na kaba ki la wan .
translation.en: Thou hidest thy face , they are troubled : thou takest away their breath , they die , and return to their dust .
How great are his signs ! and how mighty are his wonders ! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom , and his dominion is from generation to generation .
translation.kha: Katno kiba khraw ki long ki jingphylla jong U Blei kiba u pyn-i ha ngi ! Katno kiba khrawbor ki long ki kambah kiba u leh ! U Blei u long u syiem junom ; un synshar ha ki por baroh .
U wallam jingjot ha kiba khlaiñ bad ïa Kut baskhem jong ki .
translation.en: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong , so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress .

And her father hear her vow , and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul , and her father shall hold his peace at her : then all her vows shall stand , and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand .

translation.en: Then brought he me into the outward court , and , lo , there were chambers , and a pavement made for the court round about : thirty chambers were upon the pavement .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop sha ka phyllaw bashabar . La don laiphew tylli ki kamra ba la tei ha syndah ka kynroh bashabar bad ha khmat jong ki , la don ka jaka ba la siang maw kaba poi sawdong ka phyllaw .

translation.en: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah , and Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the proud men , saying unto Jeremiah , Thou speakest falsely : the  Lord  our God hath not sent thee to say , Go not into Egypt to sojourn there :
translation.kha: Nangta u Asaraïah u khun jong u Hoshaïah bad u Johanan u khun jong u Kareah bad baroh kiwei ki rangbah ba leh meng ki la ong ïa nga ,  Phi shukor . U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi um shym la phah ïa phi ban ong ha ngi ba ngin ym leit bad shong ha Ijipt .
Ha kane ka rukom , phin ïoh ïa ka jingñiewkor jong kito ki bym pat ngeit , bad phim ban donkam shaniah hano hano ka na bynta kaei kaba phi donkam .
translation.en: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without , and that ye may have lack of nothing .

translation.en: Which he wrought in Christ , when he raised him from the dead , and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places ,
And there shall be no remnant of them : for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth , even the year of their visitation .

punkhun kiba spah Wanlam , kynthei bad tar , ki ïawan jingkiew ïa ki jingpyndait ba la oh-shrong Mei’ ki sohshkor , ki sati , Habakkuk kpieng , bad ki jingdeng ksiar kiba har rukom mynnor bad ki pynkyntang ïa ki sha U Puah .
translation.en: And they came , both men and women , as many as were willing hearted , and brought bracelets , and earrings , and rings , and tablets , all jewels of gold : and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U ba ngin wad ïa u hynrei ngin ym shem ïa u , bad ba ngim lah ban leit sha kaba un don U aïu ?
translation.en: What manner of saying is this that he said ,  Ye shall seek me , and shall not find me : and where I am , thither ye cannot come ?
But that the world may know that I love the Father  ; and as the Father gave me commandment , even so I do . Arise , let us go hence .
translation.kha: Ngam lah ban kren bad phi kham slem , namar u nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei un wan . Um donbor halor jong nga , hynrei , ka pyrthei ka dei ban tip ba nga ieit ïa U Kpa ; na kata ka daw balei ba nga leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba u hukum ïa nga .  Ale , ïa ngin ïaleit noh na kane ka jaka .
Katba ki briew dang shahshkor ïa kane , Jisu u la bteng bad u la ïathuh ïa ka pharshi ha ki U la jan poi artat ha Jerusalem , bad ki la tharai ba ka Hima U Blei ka la jan paw .
translation.en: And as they heard these things , he added and spake a parable , because he was nigh to Jerusalem , and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear .

translation.kha: Ngan shim napdeng noh jong phi ïa kito ïeng kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad dap kiba da ka pop . Ngan shim noh ïa ki na ki ri ha kaba ki shong ki sah mynta , hynrei ngan ym shah ïa ki ban wan phai pat sha ka ri Israel . Te phin tip ba nga long Trai U .
translation.en: And I will purge out from among you the rebels , and them that transgress against me : I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn , and they shall not enter into the land of Israel : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U ha ki ïa kaei kaba jia bad u la noh ïa ki sha Joppa .
translation.en: And when he had declared all these things unto them , he sent them to Joppa .
The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats  ; and the rocks for the conies .
translation.kha: Ki blang khlaw ki im ha ki lumbah bajrong , bad ki phyllad ki rieh ha ki synrang maw .

translation.en: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal , to shew the people and the princes her beauty : for she was fair to look on .
translation.kha: U hukum ïa ki ban wallam shapoh ïa ka Bashti , ka mahadei ba la phong ïa ka pansngiat syiem . Ka mahadei ka long ka briew kaba bhabriew , bad u syiem u kwah ban pyn-i sarong ïa ka jingbhabriew jong ka ha ki rangbah synshar bad ha baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha .

translation.en: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans : and thou shalt not escape out of their hand , but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon : and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire .
translation.kha: Te nga la ong shuh shuh ,  Ïa baroh ki kynthei bad ki khun jong phi , yn rah noh sha ki nong Babilonia , bad ma phi ruh ïa lade phin ym lait na ki . Yn sa ïalam ïa phi kum u koidi da u syiem ka Babilonia , bad ïa kane ka nongbah yn sa thang lut khoit .

translation.en: O  Lord  , are not thine eyes upon the truth ? thou hast stricken them , but they have not grieved  ; thou hast consumed them , but they have refused to receive correction : they have made their faces harder than a rock  ; they have refused to return .
translation.kha: Da shisha U  Trai  u peit ïa ka jingïaineh . U la shoh ïa phi , hynrei phim shym pynleit jingmut ; u la pynlwet ïa phi , hynrei phi la kyntait ban ïoh jinghikai . Phi long kiba mutlop bad phim shym phai na ki pop jong phi .
U Jakob u phna ïa la ki kti bad u buh ïa ka Anna kamon khie ka khlieh u Ephraim , ñiamra la u long uba kham rit , nongdie ïa ka kti kadiang ha ka khlieh u Manasseh , uba kham san .
translation.en: And Israel stretched out his right hand , and laid it upon Ephraim s head , who was the younger , and his left hand upon Manasseh s head , guiding his hands wittingly  ; for Manasseh was the firstborn .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ïa ki blei jong phi uno uno hangne , uta pynïap . Hangne , lem bad ki briew jong ngi kum ki sakhi , peit ïa kano tiar kaba dei ka jong bad shim ïa kaba dei ka jong . U Jakob um shym tip ba ka ka la tuh ïa ki blei ïing jong u Laban .
translation.en: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods , let him not live : before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me , and take it to thee . For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them .
Of sin , because they believe not on me  ;
translation.kha: Ki bakla shaphang ka pop , namar ba kim shym la ngeit ha nga ;

translation.en: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands , and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them : the Great , the Mighty God , the  Lord  of hosts , is his name ,
translation.kha: Me la pyn-i ïa ka jingieit baneh sha ki hajar , hynrei me pynshitom ruh ïa ki briew na ka bynta ki pop ki kmie ki kpa jong ki . Me long U Blei bakhraw bad badonbor ; me long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness , they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day .
translation.kha: Shisien , katba ki Israel ki dang don ha ka ri khlaw , la lap ïa uwei u briew uba dang lum diengïap ha ka Sabbaton .

Ki la shim ïa la ki ryntieh khaw-eit ki jinglait ; ki long ïaphai runar bad ki bym don lytar . jinganna sawa kum ka duriaw bakyrhuh , katba jingpynphai jingkhawai ha ki kulai jong ki Rephael Ki la pynkhreh pynkyntang ka thma ram ïa tyllep Jerusalem .
translation.en: They shall lay hold on bow and spear  ; they are cruel , and have no mercy  ; their voice roareth like the sea  ; and they ride upon horses , set in array as men for war against thee , O daughter of Zion .

translation.kha: Ngi bud ïa ka mon jong me bad ngi buh jingkyrmen ka jong ngi ha me ; me long tang ma me uba ngi kwah .
translation.en: Yea , in the way of thy judgments , O  Lord  , have we waited for thee  ; the desire of our soul is to thy name , and to the remembrance of thee .

translation.kha: Kumno ka Jingiaid lynti jong phi Amana ?
translation.en: How was the journey yesterday ?

translation.kha: U shna ïa ka duwan da ka dieng akasia , na ka bynta ban thang jingiwbih . rynïeng long kaba sawdong , ka don sawphew Ashkelon sentimitar ka lynter bad sawphew san jingsngur ïatim jingïar bad khyndaiphew sentimitar ka jingjrong . Ki reng jong ka ha ki saw tylli ki Elihu ki ïadait lang kawei bad pynduhbor .
translation.en: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood : the length of it was a cubit , and the breadth of it a cubit  ; it was foursquare  ; and two cubits was the height of it  ; the horns thereof were of the same .
But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world , how he may please his wife .
translation.kha: Hynrei u briew uba la shongkurim u pyrkhat kiei kiei kiba kynja pyrthei , kumno ba un pynsngewbha ïa la ka tnga .
To shahshkor , ko rangbah ngan ai ïa ka lyngkha baroh kawei , bad ïa kata ka krem don Hangne ha ka jingdon ryngkat ki para jait jong nga , ngan ai ïa ka ha phi khnang ba ïoh tep ïa la tnga .
translation.en: Nay , my lord , hear me : the field give I thee , and the cave that is therein , I give it thee  ; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee : bury thy dead .

translation.kha: Kumta u Ananias u la leit u la rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaba u u don , bad u buh ïa la ki kti halor jong u . Ko Saul , u para jong nga , ong , U Trai u la phah ïa nga U Jisu hi uba la ha me ka lynti katba me dang wan shane . U la phah ïa nga khnang ba men ïoh imat pat bad ban pyndap ïa da U Mynsiem .
translation.en: And Ananias went his way , and entered into the house  ; and putting his hands on him said , Brother Saul , the Lord , even Jesus , that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest , hath sent me , that thou mightest receive thy sight , and be filled with the Holy Ghost .

Where were white , green , and blue , hangings , fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble : the beds were of gold and silver , upon a pavement of red , and blue , and white , and black , marble .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ïingsyiem la pynitynnat da ki pyrda bajngum bad balieh , ba la teh da ki tyllai linen sawjngum bani ha ki syrwiang rupa bad pyndait ha ki rishot maw marbl . Ïa ki jaka shong shaniah ha ka ïingsyiem , la shna da ka ksiar bad ka rupa , bad ïa ka madan la siang da u maw marbl balieh , maw marbl basaw , u mawkordor baphyrnai , bad u mawkordor bajngum .

translation.en: And now , O Lord our God , that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand , and hast gotten thee renown , as at this day  ; we have sinned , we have done wickedly .
translation.kha: A Trai U Blei jong ngi , me la pyn-i ïa ka bor jong me da kaba wallam noh ïa ki briew jong me na ri Ijipt , bad ïa ka bor jong me la ïai kynmaw . Ngi la leh pop ; ngi la leh bakla .
bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah hynriewphew ar snem .
translation.en: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years : and he died .

translation.kha: Sangeh shipor , ko Job , ïalum shahshkor ; shynriah ïa jingkad kiei kiba Jinglehbor kiba U pynpeit u jaw .
translation.en: Hearken unto this , O Job : stand still , and consider the wondrous works of God .
And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki paidbah ban shong ha madan .
Nga la khmih ha ka pyrthei — la long ka jingsep ei suda , sahit bneng — don kano kano ka jingshai .
translation.en: I beheld the earth , and , lo , it was without form , and void  ; and the heavens , and they had no light .
There were therefore seven brethren : and the first took a wife , and died without children .
translation.kha: Shisien la don hynñiew ngut shi para ki shynrang ; uba nyngkong duh u la shongkurim bad u la ïap khlem don khun .
Haba ki la ïa kane , la pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka jong U Trai Jisu .
translation.en: When they heard this , they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus .
But Samuel ministered before the  Lord  , being a child , girded with a linen ephod .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u khynnah Samuel u ïai shakri ïa U  Trai  , u da phong da ka sopti-lor da ka jaiñ linen kaba kyntang .

litar Jiw la phah khot ïa lamwir) Joab , ban kyrpad ïa u ban leit sha u syiem na ka bynta jong u ; hynrei u phira um wan . Tidal shisien u Absalom u la phah Kdew ïa u ; khat u Joab u kyntait biang ban wan .
translation.en: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab , to have sent him to the king  ; but he would not come to him : and when he sent again the second time , he would not come .

And , behold , I will send a lad , saying , Go , find out the arrows . If I expressly say unto the lad , Behold , the arrows are on this side of thee , take them  ; then come thou : for there is peace to thee , and no hurt  ; as the  Lord  liveth .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan ong ïa u shakri jong nga ban leit tam ïa ki . Bad lada nga ong ha u , ‘ Khmih , kito ki khnam ki don ha kane ka liang jong phi ; tam ïa ki ,’ kata ka mut ba kam lei lei bad phi lah ban mih shabar . Nga smai ha U  Trai  uba im ba phin ym don ha ka jingma .

translation.en: He trusted in the  Lord  God of Israel  ; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah , nor any that were before him .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u shaniah ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ; ki Judah kim shym ïoh da uwei pat u syiem kum ma u , ha shuwa ne hadien ka por jong u .

translation.en: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin , after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing , he shall be seen of the priest again :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka prum ka pur pat hadien ba u lyngdoh u la khmih bniah ïa u bad u la pynbna ba u long uba khuid , u dei ban leit pyn-i biang ïa lade ha u lyngdoh .

translation.en: And Saul cast the javelin  ; for he said , I will smite David even to the wall with it . And David avoided out of his presence twice .
translation.kha: Ngan sum ïa u ha ka kynroh ,  u Saul u ong ha lade , bad u kawang ïa u sum ha u ar sien ; hynrei ha baroh ar sien u Dabid u kynriah .

translation.en: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem , as against the gods of the people of the earth , which were the work of the hands of man .
translation.kha: Ki ïakren shaphang U Blei ka Jerusalem kumba ki ïakren shaphang ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew , ki bleithaw ba la shna da ki kti ki briew .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses bad u Aaron
Bad shaphang U Jisu ka la phriang kylleng ha kata ka thain .
translation.en: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka sngewbishni katba u dang ïaid , u la ïohi ïa u nonglum nongsuh , uba Shophan u Hilkaïah , uba shong ha jingaiti jaka treikam jong u jinglamler U ïaphet ong ha u , To bud ïa nga . U Matthaïos u sah” ïeng joit bad Mushi la bud ïa im’ .
translation.en: And as Jesus passed forth from thence , he saw a man , named Matthew , sitting at the receipt of custom : and he saith unto him ,  Follow me .  And he arose , and followed him .

translation.kha: haba Hynrei u uba angel hynñiew u put ïa la ka turoi , te U Blei un pyndep ïa ka jingthmu barieh jong u , kumba u la pynbna ha la ki shakri , ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel , when he shall begin to sound , the mystery of God should be finished , as he hath declared to his servants the prophets .
And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee : thou sentest forth thy wrath , which consumed them as stubble .
translation.kha: Da ka jingjop bakhraw me pynliem ïa ki nongshun jong me ; ka jingbitar jong me ka meh bad ka bam duh ïa ki kum ïa u phlangïap .

translation.en: Behold , this have I found , saith the preacher , counting one by one , to find out the account :
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ong u Stad saiñpyrkhat , nga la shem ïa kane khyndiat pa khyndiat katba nga dang wad ïa ki jubab .
U Dabid u jubab Nga la shad ban ïa U Trai , uba jied ïa nga ha ka jaka u bad ka longïing jong u , ban pynlong ïa nga u nongïalam jong briew jong u ki Israel Bad ngan ïai shad ban pyndonburom ïa U
translation.en: And David said unto Michal , It was before the  Lord  , which chose me before thy father , and before all his house , to appoint me ruler over the people of the  Lord  , over Israel : therefore will I play before the  Lord .

And all the cities of those kings , and all the kings of them , did Joshua take , and smote them with the edge of the sword , and he utterly destroyed them , as Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la kurup ïa kine ki nongbah baroh bad ïa ki syiem jong ki , da kaba pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei , kumba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la hukum .
Phi lehbha la katta katta! Uei uba la pynlong ïa phi ban sangeh ban kohnguh ïa ka jingshisha ? Da kumno u la khroh ïa ? phi
translation.en: Ye did run well ; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth ?
O  Lord  , truly I am thy servant  ; I am thy servant , and the son of thine handmaid : thou hast loosed my bonds .
translation.kha: Nga long u shakri jong me , ko  Trai  ; nga shakri ïa me , kumba ka kmie jong nga ka la leh . Me la pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingïap .

translation.en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth , and he shall have no name in the street .
translation.kha: Ka nam jong u ka la kut ha ïing bad shabar ; ym don ba kynmaw shuh ïa u .
Phin sa shah ai kajuh jingbhasbun jingpynshitom kum mane riewpaidbah ! Ngan pynshitom ïa phi jingpynjahburom pynlong Kyrteng phi ban Kpa pli ka bynta ka Thung ba phi leh .
translation.en: And there shall be , like people , like priest : and I will punish them for their ways , and reward them their doings .

translation.kha: Te kumno (naba hukum mokotduma nga ban leit kupar ong ïa u syiem ba Paltiel don hangne Pashhur Un sa Hattaabah jingri nga !
translation.en: And now thou sayest , Go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here : and he shall slay me .
Naked , and ye clothed me : I was sick , and ye visited me : I was in prison , and ye came unto me .
translation.kha: nga la lyngkhuit bad phi la pynkup jaiñ ïa nga ; nga la pang bad phi la shim ban sumar ïa nga , nga la don ha ïingbyndi bad phi la wan jngoh ïa nga .’

translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will allure her , and bring her into the wilderness , and speak comfortably unto her .
translation.kha: Te ngan leit ïalam biang ïa ka sha ri shyiap ; hangta ngan khroh biang ïa ka da ki ktien ieit .
phi lamler ha ka ïingbishar , phin shah — yn don jingpyllait .
translation.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished , and he that speaketh lies shall not escape .
But when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimea David s brother slew him .
translation.kha: U ïeng pyrshah ïa ki Israel , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Shammah uba shi para bad u Dabid , u pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded .
translation.kha: U Moses u ai ïa kine ki jingbthah ha ki nongïalam na ki jait Israel .

translation.en: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in , and served the idols that his father served , and worshipped them :
translation.kha: U pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh u kpa jong u , bad u mane ïa ki bleithaw ba u kpa jong u , u la mane .

translation.en: Whereby the world that then was , being overflowed with water , perished :
translation.kha: Ïa ka pyrthei la pynlong na ka um bad da ka um , bad ka la long ruh da ka um ; ka um jong ka jingshlei um , ba ïa ka pyrthei barim la pynjot .
Nangta la khot ki rangbah na jait Naphtali , Asher , bad na ka ar bynta , ki beh kthong ïa ki Midian .
translation.en: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali , and out of Asher , and out of all Manasseh , and pursued after the Midianites .
And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin  ; but he slipped away out of Saul s presence , and he smote the javelin into the wall : and David fled , and escaped that night .
translation.kha: U Saul u thmu ban sum ïa u Dabid ha ka kynroh , hynrei u Dabid u kynriah , bad uta u sum u sahkut ha ka kynroh . U Dabid u phet ïap bad u lait im .

translation.en: I have confidence in you through the Lord , that ye will be none otherwise minded : but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment , whosoever he be .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga dang sngew shaniah ïa phi . Ka jingim jong ngi ha U Trai , ka pynlong ïa nga ban sngewskhem ba phin ym shim da kumwei pat bad uta u briew uba pynkulmar ïa phi , la u long uei uei , un shah pynshitom ha U Blei .

translation.en: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar  ; two lambs of the first year day by day continually .
translation.kha: Man la ka sngi ha ki por ban wan , kñia ha kata ka duwan ar tylli ki khunlangbrot kiba shisnem .

nga ong , ‘ Mynta phi la poi ha ri lum Amor , kaba U U Trai Blei jong ngi , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen , jong ngi ai u ha ngi . Peit ïa ka hangtai . Khie leit kam kynti ïa ka kumba u la hukum . Wat leh tud , bad wat sheptieng .’
translation.en: Behold , the  Lord  thy God hath set the land before thee : go up and possess it , as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath said unto thee  ; fear not , neither be discouraged .

translation.kha: Namar ba kim shym la shahshkor mynba nga la kren , ngam shym la mynba duwai .
translation.en: Therefore it is come to pass , that as he cried , and they would not hear  ; so they cried , and I would not hear , saith the  Lord  of hosts :
And the angel of the  Lord  said unto him , Why askest thou thus after my name , seeing it is secret ?
translation.kha: U angel u kylli ,  Balei ba phi da kwah ban tip ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ? Ka long ka kyrteng kaba phylla .

U Jakob Mibsan ong , jingiashah , bashatei ibit da pher eh ; lada nga la phangpdeng ka jingsngewbha jong phi , to pdiang ïa ka jingai sngewbha lehbeiñ seiñïong . Ban ïohi ïa ka khmat shata phi ka long ïa nga Body jingïohkynti ïohi Bethdagon ka khmat U Blei , mynta ba phi la leh Mynmiet ïa nga katne .
translation.en: And Jacob said , Nay , I pray thee , if now I have found grace in thy sight , then receive my present at my hand : for therefore I have seen thy face , as though I had seen the face of God , and thou wast pleased with me .

And his servants said unto him , Behold now , we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings : let us , I pray thee , put sackcloth on our loins , and ropes upon our heads , and go out to the king of Israel : peradventure he will save thy life .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ki leit sha u bad ki ong ,  Ngi ïohsngew ba ki syiem Israel ki long kiba isynei . Ai jingbit ïa ngi ba ngin leit sha u syiem jong ka Israel ryngkat bad ki jaiñ byrni sawdong ki syngkai jong ngi bad ki tyllai sawdong ki ryndang jong ngi , bad lehse un pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: But when the husbandmen saw him , they reasoned among themselves , saying , This is the heir : come , let us kill him , that the inheritance may be ours .
translation.kha: Hynrei , haba ki nongshimwai ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la kren para ma ki , ‘ Une u dei u khun jong u trai . To ngin ïa-pynïap ïa u , bad ka jingdon jingem jong u kan long ka jong ngi !’

translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? Yea , I say unto you , and much more than a prophet .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , ïa kaei phi la leit ban peit ? Hato ïa u nongïathuhlypa ? Ho-oid , da shisha , hynrei phi la ïohi kham bun shah ban ïa u nongïathuhlypa .
Hynrei U Jisu u la ai ïa ka hukum bapyrkhing ban ïathuh hano hano ruh , bad u la ong , Ai ei ïa ka ban bam .
translation.en: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it  ; and commanded that something should be given her to eat .

translation.kha: Wat rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaba ki briew ki ïakhawai . Wat shong bad wei ban bam bad dih .
translation.en: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting , to sit with them to eat and to drink .

translation.kha: Kaei me pyrkhat ba men Jordan da kaba leit sha Ijipt ïakheit dih um na jingtamsneng Nile Philip Kaei me pyrkhat ba Ïakjakor ïoh da kaba leit sha Assyria ban dih pynïakren na ka Ïuphratis riewpaidbah
translation.en: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt , to drink the waters of Sihor ? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria , to drink the waters of the river ?

translation.kha: Me long kum Salmon umbah kaba shlei umbah Hynrei men ym ïoh ïa ka kyrdan bapawkhmat tam , jingshemphang bajew la ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga kliar khyllem nga , bad me la Joash ïa ka jingthiah u kpa jong me .
translation.en: Unstable as water , thou shalt not excel  ; because thou wentest up to thy father s bed  ; then defiledst thou it : he went up to my couch .

translation.kha: Balei u dei ïap ban ? u Jonathan u jubab . U la leh aïu eh ?
translation.en: And Jonathan answered Saul his father , and said unto him , Wherefore shall he be slain ? what hath he done ?

translation.kha: ngai baroh “U roi Taanakh kiei kiei pui long ki bymmyntoi shisien ba la Lied pyndonkam ; ki “ksuid” tang ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai Dong briew .
translation.en: Which all are to perish with the using ; ) after the commandments and doctrines of men ?
But I would not have you to be ignorant , brethren , concerning them which are asleep , that ye sorrow not , even as others which have no hope .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit , ngi kwah ïa phi ban tip ïa ka jingshisha shaphang kito kiba la ïap , khnang ba phin ym sngewsih , kumba long kito ki bym don ka jingkyrmen .

translation.en: Surely it is meet to be said unto God , I have borne chastisement , I will not offend any more :
translation.kha: Ko Job , hato me la phla ïa ki pop jong me ha U Blei bad kular ban nym leh pop shuh ?

translation.en: And they buried him  ; and all Israel mourned for him , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki ïambriew na ka bynta jong u bad ki tep ïa u , kumba U  Trai  u la kren lyngba u shakri jong u , u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: O Israel , return unto the  Lord  thy God  ; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity .
translation.kha: To wan phai noh sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ko paid Israel . Ka pop jong phi ka la pynlong ïa phi ban jynthut bad kyllon .
U Jethro u la wan bad ka tnga jong u Moses lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun jong shynrang ka sha ka ri shyiap ha kaba u Moses u la sher dara ha lum u bakhuid .
translation.en: And Jethro , Moses  father in law , came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness , where he encamped at the mount of God :
Believest thou not that I am in the Father , and the Father in me ? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself : but the Father that dwelleth in me , he doeth the works .
translation.kha: Hato mem ngeit , ko Philip , ba nga long ha U Kpa bad U Kpa u long ha nga ? Ki ktien kiba nga la kren ha phi ,  U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  kim shym la wan na nga hi . U Kpa , uba ïaisah bad nga , u trei la ka jong ka kam .

translation.en: And the angel of God said unto him , Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes , and lay them upon this rock , and pour out the broth . And he did so .
translation.kha: U angel u hukum ïa u ,  Buh ïa ka doh bad u kpu halor une u mawsiang , bad theh ïa ka syrwa halor jong ki .  U Gideon u leh kumta .

translation.en: Ye lust , and have not : ye kill , and desire to have , and cannot obtain : ye fight and war , yet ye have not , because ye ask not .
translation.kha: Phi kwah ei ei , hynrei phim ïoh ïa kita , kumta phi pynïap ; phi da kwah eh , hynrei phim lah ban ïoh ïa kita , kumta phi ïania bad phi ïaleh thma . Phim ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah , namar ba phim pan na U Blei ïa ka .

translation.en: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment , and two hundred shekels of silver , and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight , then I coveted them , and took them  ; and , behold , they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent , and the silver under it .
translation.kha: Napdeng kita ki mar kiba ngi la kurup , nga la ïohi kawei ka barandi Babilon kaba itynnat , kumba ar kilo ka rupa , bad shi lyngkhot ka ksiar kaba khia palat shiteng kilo . Nga la ikwah eh ïa ki , bad nga la shim ïa ki . Phin shem ba la tep ïa ki hapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong nga , bad ka rupa ka don ha trai .
Ka kyrteng jong kata Phrygia Iri ka dei ka Kosbi . jingailad Sur , u kpa Sabbaton ka u Blastos u rangbah bahakhlieh jong Pynpait pynjulor kynhun ki jait Midian .
translation.en: And the name of the Midianite woman that was slain was Cozbi , the daughter of Zur  ; he was head over a people , and of a chief house in Midian .
He it is , who coming after me is preferred before me , whose shoe s latchet I am not worthy to unloose .
translation.kha: U wan hadien jong nga , hynrei nga ngam long uba bit wat ban law ïa ki ksai juti jong u .
Haba ki koidi jong u ki la ïohi bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki shipai lem bad u , ki la kmen , bad phai bad mareh sha ki .
translation.en: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned , and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah .

translation.kha: Man ka snem ka jong u ka ju thain ïa u ka jaiñkup kaba rit , bad ka ju leit rah ïa ka haba ka leit lang bad la u tnga ban kñia ïa jingainguh kaba .
translation.en: Moreover his mother made him a little coat , and brought it to him from year to year , when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice .
Your kerchiefs also will I tear , and deliver my people out of your hand , and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan sloit ïa ki jaiñ teh khlieh jong phi bad ngan shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban lait shisyndon na ka bor jong phi . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And for a rising , and for a scab , and for a bright spot :
translation.kha: shaphang ka prum , u tohjaw , lane ka jingtyrha sniehdoh ; bad shaphang ka jingbthuh ha ki jaiñ lane hapoh ïing .
Ko khun u dom , u ong , ngan buh ïa me kum ba-bhabriew nongap phira katto-katne ka bynta ka jaitbynriew Israel . Men pynsngew ha ki ïa ki jingmaham kiba Kisleb ai ïa me .
translation.en: Son of man , I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel : therefore hear the word at my mouth , and give them warning from me .
Only Luke is with me . Take Mark , and bring him with thee : for he is profitable to me for the ministry .
translation.kha: Tang u Loukas u don bad nga . Leit wad ïa u Markos bad wan ïalam ïa u ryngkat bad me , namar u lah ban ïarap ïa nga .
Kita baroh kiba shong ha ka Dorbar ki la khmih shlip ha u Stephan bad ki ïohi ba ka durkhmat jong u ka la long kum ka durkhmat jong u angel
translation.en: And all that sat in the council , looking stedfastly on him , saw his face as it had been the face of an angel .
For vain man would be wise , though man be born like a wild ass s colt .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba mutlop kin sdang ban long kiba stad haba kha ïa ki kada khlaw ban long kum kiba la pynjuh .

translation.en: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart : so doth the sweetness of a man s friend by hearty counsel .
translation.kha: Ki umphniang sleh bad ba-iwbih ki pynlong ïa phi ban sngewkmen , hynrei ka jingjynjar ka pynkulmar ïa ka jingsuk jingmut jong phi .

translation.en: Because it is a trial , and what if the sword contemn even the rod ? it shall be no more , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Nga tynjuh ïa la ki briew , bad lada ki kyntait ban kylla-kaba-mut , kine kiei kiei baroh kin wan jia ha ki .

Cry aloud , spare not , lift up thy voice like a trumpet , and shew my people their transgression , and the house of Jacob their sins .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To pyrta jam katba phi lah ! Ïathuh ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel shaphang ki pop jong ki .

jingshadkmen syiem jong ka Sheba ka bna shaphang ka nam u Solomon , bad ka Holy jingkynmaw Jerusalem thlia tynjuh Hikai u da ki jingkylli kiba Selophehad . Ka wan ïalam shibun ki nongbud lem bad ki ut kiba Kam ki musla , ki mawkordor , bad shibun ka ksiar . Haba ka Humtah ïakynduh ïa dorbar Solomon , ka kylli Niam ïa baroh ki jingkylli kat kiba don pynïapthngan ka jingmut jong ka .
translation.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon , she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem , with a very great company , and camels that bare spices , and gold in abundance , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .
And it came to pass by the way in the inn , that the  Lord  met him , and sought to kill him .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka sahmiet ha lynti , U  Trai  u ïashem bad u Moses , bad u mut ban pynïap noh ïa u .

Ong ïa u ban da husiar , ban long jai jai , bad ban ym lane jingmut . Ka jingbitar u Syiem Resin bad ki Syria jong u bad ka jong u Syiem Pekah kam long don jingma ban ïa ka jong tylli ki shynraiñ dieng don ding .
translation.en: And say unto him , Take heed , and be quiet  ; fear not , neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands , for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria , and of the son of Remaliah .

translation.kha: Ki phong da ki jaiñjot bad ki slipar snieh ba la jot kiba la dep syrdep . U kpu ba ki rah u long uba tyrkhong bad uba bthuh .
translation.en: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet , and old garments upon them  ; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy .

translation.kha: Hynrei uwei ki na , u Pharisi uba kyrteng u Gamaliel , uba long u nonghikai ka Hukum bad ïa uba la burom shikatdei da briew ki , baroh u la ïeng ha ka Dorbar . U la hukum ban ïalam ïa ki apostol shipor shabar ,
translation.en: Then stood there up one in the council , a Pharisee , named Gamaliel , a doctor of the law , had in reputation among all the people , and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space  ;

translation.kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la u da kaba bad la ka kmie , namar mem ban pynjahburom ïa ka ka kmie .
translation.en: The nakedness of thy father , or the nakedness of thy mother , shalt thou not uncover : she is thy mother  ; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .

translation.kha: Un bat ïa ka jutang jong u junom , ki jingkular jong u na ka bynta ki hajar pateng .
translation.en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever , the word which he commanded to a thousand generations .
And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children , and the heart of the children to their fathers , lest I come and smite the earth with a curse .
translation.kha: Un wallam lang ïa ki kpa bad ki khun sa shisien ; lym kumta ngan hap ban wan bad pynjot ïa ka ri jong phi .

Ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah ki Israel kin ïamih shabar bad ïa khar ki tiar ïapom ba la iehnoh ïa ka ban thang diengïap . Kin sliew ding da ki stieh , ryntieh ki , ki khnam , sum ki bad ki dieng tangon , bad kin biang hynñiew haduh snem .
translation.en: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth , and shall set on fire and burn the weapons , both the shields and the bucklers , the bows and the arrows , and the handstaves , and the spears , and they shall burn them with fire seven years :

translation.kha: Ha ka por mynmiet ki leit sha ki sha krem bad ki jaka tep ban ïasyllok bad ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap . Ki bam doh sniang bad ki dih ïa ka syrwa ba la shet da ka doh ba la ai jingkñia sha ki blei . thala
translation.en: Which remain among the graves , and lodge in the monuments , which eat swine s flesh , and broth of abominable things is in their vessels  ;

But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him , and smote the Philistine , and killed him . Then the men of David sware unto him , saying , Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle , that thou quench not the light of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Abishai u khun jong ka Seruïah u wan ïarap ïa u Dabid , u tur ïaleh ïa u ramhah , bad u pynïap ïa u . Nangta ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki la pynkular ïa u Dabid ba un ym leit shuh da lei lei ruh bad ki sha ka thma .  Phi long ka jingkyrmen jong ka Israel , bad ngim kwah ban duh noh ïa phi ,  ki la ong .
Ynda ong ïa kane , u Paul u la shim katto katne kpu , u la ainguh ïa U ha khmat jong ki baroh , u la kdiah ïa u , u la ban bam .
translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he took bread , and gave thanks to God in presence of them all : and when he had broken it , he began to eat .

translation.kha: Ki tnat jong ki u long kiba khlaiñ bad ki san ban long u diengsynshar ba kynja syiem . U dieng sohwaiñ u la san jrong eh kot ban ki ïa lyoh ; uwei uwei baroh u la ïohi haduh katno u la long uba rben ki sla bad uba jrong .
translation.en: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule , and her stature was exalted among the thick branches , and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches .

translation.kha: Soh 119 Italy ïap! buh da ka kynhun pyniehnoh shisha ka jingbun paid ka long kat kato kaba la phai dait-thah noh na sngewkhia , buh katjuh smai jingbun durkhmat kulai bad ki kali ïapom . Ngin ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha ki jaka madan , bad ha kane ka sien ngin jop ïa ki . U syiem Benhadad u la mynjur bad bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong jingkieng .
translation.en: And number thee an army , like the army that thou hast lost , horse for horse , and chariot for chariot : and we will fight against them in the plain , and surely we shall be stronger than they . And he hearkened unto their voice , and did so .

translation.kha: U Trai u thaw ka pyrthei da ka jong u ; da ka jingshemphang jong u , u la buh beit ïa bneng ha la ka jaka .
translation.en: The  Lord  by wisdom hath founded the earth  ; by understanding hath he established the heavens .
And in that day ye shall ask me nothing . Verily , verily , I say unto you , Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name , he will give it you .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , phin ym pan ei ei na nga . Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : U Kpa un ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan na u ha ka kyrteng jong nga .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Ye do err , not knowing the scriptures , nor the power of God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  A katno phi long kiba bakla ! Ka long namar ba phim tip ïa ki jingthoh bakhuid lane ïa ka bor U Blei .

translation.en: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth .
translation.kha: Ngan ïai ban ha ka sur bajam ïa ki aiñ baroh kiba me la ai .

translation.en: He saith unto them ,  But whom say ye that I am ?
translation.kha: Kumno ma phi pat ?  U la kylli ïa ki .  Phi ong nga long uei ?

translation.en: For the  Lord  brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel  ; for he made Judah naked , and transgressed sore against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Namar u Ahas u syiem Judah u la pynkheiñ ïa ki hok ki briew jong u bad u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U  Trai  u la wallam ki jingjynjar ha ka Judah .

translation.en: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you , but have shewed you , and have taught you publickly , and from house to house ,
translation.kha: Phi ïatip ba ngam shym la buhrieh ïa kano kano ka ban long ka jingïarap ïa phi haba nga ïalap bad hikai ha ki paidbah bad ha ki ïing jong phi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Jehoshaphat , because he walked in the first ways of his father David , and sought not unto Baalim  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u Jehoshaphat namar u la bud ïa ka nuksa ba-mynshuwa jong ka jingim u kpa jong u bad um shym mane ïa u Baal .

translation.en: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest , the son of Ahitub , and all his father s house , the priests that were in Nob : and they came all of them to the king .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Saul u phah khot ïa u Ahimelekh u lyngdoh bad ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u , kiba la long ruh ki lyngdoh ha Nob , bad ki la ïawan sha u .

translation.en: The world cannot hate you  ; but me it hateth , because I testify of it , that the works thereof are evil .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kam lah ban shun ïa phi , hynrei ka shun ïa nga , namar ba nga ïai-ong ba ki lynti jong ka ki long kiba sniew .
U Moses u mihnoh na u Pharaoh bad , u kyrpad ïa U Trai ,
translation.en: And Moses went out from Pharaoh , and entreated the  Lord .
And he said unto me , Unto two thousand and three hundred days  ; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa uta uwei pat u angel ba u jubab ,  Kan ïailong haduh shi hajar shispah sanphew sngi , ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia janmiet bad mynstep yn ym ai . Hadien kata yn sa pynbha pat ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: He shall suck the poison of asps : the viper s tongue shall slay him .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba u briew uba sniew u nguid ka long kum ka bih ; ka pynïap ïa u kum ka jingpuh jong u bseiñ bashyrkhei .

nongsuh u Simon Petros bashathie u shakri bad u tba jong U Abinoam jingkhot — Sha kito ha kiba jingkyrpang ka hok Haoid U Blei wieh ngi bad U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim pynkylluid ai ïa ka Mnason kaba kordor kum khum jong ngi :
translation.en: Simon Peter , a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ , to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ :

translation.kha: U Dabid bad ki paidbah Esra leit sha ka nongbah Baalah , kata ka dei ka Kiriath jingkhrew , jingïohipaw ka ri Judah , ban wallam baklang ka Ahitub ka Jutang U Blei , kaba don jingïadie kyrteng jong jingïaineh Trai kparad shong halor ki Kherub meeting
translation.en: And David went up , and all Israel , to Baalah , that is , to Kirjath–jearim , which belonged to Judah , to bring up thence the ark of God the  Lord  , that dwelleth between the cherubims , whose name is called on it .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , hangne ka dei ka khet jong nga . Ngan shong hangne hapdeng ki paid Israel bad synshar halor jong ki junom Ki . paid Israel lymne ki syiem jong ki , kin ym shuh pynjahburom ïa kyrteng bakhuid jong nga kaba da mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei lane da kaba tep ïa ki metïap jong ki syiem ki jong kane ha ka jaka .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , the place of my throne , and the place of the soles of my feet , where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever , and my holy name , shall the house of Israel no more defile , neither they , nor their kings , by their whoredom , nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places .

translation.kha: Bad kum u shakri jong U Trai , mem dei ban ïakajia . Bad to long jaijai ha ki briew baroh , bato hikai , jingiashah .
translation.en: And the servant of the Lord must not strive ; but be gentle unto all men , apt to teach , patient ,
They have wandered as blind men in the streets , they have polluted themselves with blood , so that men could not touch their garments .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka ki la sakma lyngba ki lynti bah kum ki rangbah kiba matlah , kiba la bit da ka snam haduh katta katta ba ym don mano mano ban ktah ïa ki .

Ki kmie ki kpa kim dei ban shah pynïap nongshniah ki Dodo runar ki khun jong ki , bad leilieh khun ruh kim dei ïasait shah kthong namar A kam runar pynpur kmie ki pruid jong ki jingaimynsiem sbai briew u dei ban khamtam pynïap tang namar ka kam runar jong u hi .
translation.en: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers : every man shall be put to death for his own sin .

translation.kha: Don kiba klim bad kiwei ki ïa la ki pyrsa kurim ïa la ki bakha kynthei .
translation.en: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour s wife  ; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law  ; and another in thee hath humbled his sister , his father s daughter .
That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour ;
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi ki shynrang u dei ban tip kumno ban ïashong ïasah bad la ka tnga ha ka rukom kaba khuid bad kaba donburom ,

translation.en: And made him king over Gilead , and over the Ashurites , and over Jezreel , and over Ephraim , and over Benjamin , and over all Israel .
translation.kha: Hangta u Abner u thung ïa u Ishbosheth kum u syiem jong ki ri ha Gilead , Asher , Jesreel , Ephraim , bad Benjamin , bad shisha halor ka Israel baroh kawei .

Kin ym nap la sngewrem ïa ka pop lada ngam shym Khenaanah leh hapdeng Karpos ki ïa kiei kiei pyrthei ym don uno uno wia Sipporah uba la ju leh ; kumba ka long Gemaraïah ki la ïohi ïa Phla kaba nga tipbriew leh , shankhung ki shun btin nga bad ïa U Kpa jong nga .
translation.en: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did , they had not had sin : but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father .
Then the king commanded , and they brought Daniel , and cast him into the den of lions . Now the king spake and said unto Daniel , Thy God whom thou servest continually , he will deliver thee .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u la ai ki hukum ban kem ïa u Daniel bad ban bret ïa u shapoh ka thliew kaba dap da ki sing . U la ong ha u Daniel ,  Ai ba U Blei jong me , ïa uba me shakri hok katta katta , un pyllait im ïa me .

translation.en: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea  ; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith .
translation.kha: Pha la long ruh ka nuti ïa ki nong Babilonia , kata ka jaitbynriew ki nongkhaïi , hynrei kita ruh kim shym la pynhun ïa pha .

translation.en: Why art thou cast down , O my soul ? and why art thou disquieted within me ? hope in God : for I shall yet praise him , who is the health of my countenance , and my God .
translation.kha: Balei ba nga sngewsih haduh katta katta ? Balei ba nga sngew jynjar sat ? Ngan buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha U Blei , bad sa shisien pat ngan ïaroh ïa u , U nongpynim jong nga bad U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine , What is thy petition , queen Esther ? and it shall be granted thee : and what is thy request ? and it shall be performed , even to the half of the kingdom .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïadih waiñ , u syiem u la kylli biang ïa ka ,  Mynta , ko Esther , ko mahadei , kaei kaba pha kwah ? Ïathuh ïa nga bad phan ïoh ïa kata . Ngan ai ha pha wat shiteng na ka hima .

translation.en: Now when they shall fall , they shall be holpen with a little help : but many shall cleave to them with flatteries .
translation.kha: Katba dang don ka jingpynïap , ki briew jong U Blei kin ïoh khyndiat ka jingïarap , wat la kiba bun kiba ïasoh bad ki kin leh kumta na ka bynta ki daw shimet .

Ka Mari ka la ïeng shabar ka jingtep da ka ïam . Katba ka dang ïam , ka dem la bad jngoh shapoh ka jingtep bad ka la ïohi ar ngut ki angel hangta kiba la phong da ki jaiñ balieh , ki da ïashong ha la kaba buh ïa ka met Jisu U , uwei sha khlieh bad uwei pat sha kjat .
translation.en: And seeth two angels in white sitting , the one at the head , and the other at the feet , where the body of Jesus had lain .
Then shalt thou understand the fear of the  Lord  , and find the knowledge of God .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , phin sa tip ka mut aïu ban sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad phin sa lah ban sngewthuh shaphang U Blei .

translation.en: And Moses was content to dwell with the man : and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la mynjur ban shong ban sah noh hangta , bad u Jethro ruh u pynshongkurim ïa u bad ka Sipporah ka khun jong u kaba la kha khun shynrang ïa u Moses .

translation.en: And they said , The God of the Hebrews hath met with us : let us go , we pray thee , three days  journey into the desert , and sacrifice unto the  Lord  our God  ; lest he fall upon us with pestilence , or with the sword .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la jubab ,  U Blei jong ki Hebru u la pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi . Shah ïa ngi ban leit lai sngi sha ka ri shyiap ban ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  uba U Blei jong ngi . Lada ngim leh kumta , un sa pynïap ïa ngi da ka jingpang lane da ka thma .
kata Ha ka por , u Abimelekh u leit bad u Phikol , rangbah u ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad ong u ha u Abraham , U Blei u long ryngkat bad me ha kaei kaei baroh ba me leh .
translation.en: And it came to pass at that time , that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham , saying , God is with thee in all that thou doest :

translation.kha: To wat pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh , ka na daw ka jingbam . Ki jingbam baroh ki long kiba lah ban bam , hynrei ka long ka bym dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka ban pynlong ïano ïano ban hap ha ka pop .
translation.en: For meat destroy not the work of God . All things indeed are pure ; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence .

translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la Shi para ma ki , Shano ba Pharaoh sa leit ba ngi — ym bashrah ïa u ? Hato un leit sha ki shnong jong ki Grik ha kaba ki briew jreiñ Hamath ki sah , bad ban Lehse ïa Lyngdoh Grik ?
translation.en: Then said the Jews among themselves , Whither will he go , that we shall not find him ? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles , and teach the Gentiles ?

translation.kha: Kaei kata ? U Jisu la kylli ïa .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What would ye that I should do for you ?

translation.kha: Ki puit la ki mih na kata ka tdem ka sha khyndew , bad la ai ha ki ïa kajuh ka bor kaba ki ñianglartham ki don .
translation.en: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth : and unto them was given power , as the scorpions of the earth have power .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la smai da la ka pyngtngen ka jingim ba un wallam dulan ki rangbah ban tur da-ei sngi! ka Babilonia kum jingurlong kynhun ki puit , bad kin pyrta da ka mang .
translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts hath sworn by himself , saying , Surely I will fill thee with men , as with caterpillers  ; and they shall lift up a shout against thee .
And when he had begun to reckon , one was brought unto him , which owed him ten thousand talents .
translation.kha: U la dang shu sdang ban leh kumta haba la wallam ïa uwei uba la kit ram bun tyngka .

U la thaw nynkong ia ki Teresh ki briew U Adam ïasam ka Im , bad u la buh ia ki haka kper Eden , bunktien u la hukum ia ki , ba kin ioh khun ioh thiaw pduh bad ban pyniar shawkad ka pyrthei baroh kawei Lied ka kper Eden jingkren
translation.en: He created the first human pair Adam and Eve , placed them in an earthly paradise called Eden , and instructed them to have children and extend their Paradise home earth wide .

translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan ka lyer kaba jur ka la beh , bad ki jingat phyllung ki la sdang ban phaloh shapoh ka lieng , ba haduh ka jan la dap da ka um .
translation.en: And there arose a great storm of wind , and the waves beat into the ship , so that it was now full .

translation.kha: Na kane ka daw U Blei u la eh kyntiew ïa u sha ka jaka kaba hajrong tam eh , bad ai ha u ïa ka kyrteng kaba kham khraw ban ïa kano kano kawei pat kyrteng ka .
translation.en: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him , and given him a name which is above every name :

translation.kha: Mynta , lada ka pynsngewbha ïa phi , ko syiem Hotham ai ba yn ïit Shamir ki jingthoh syiem ha Babilon ban shem lada u Syros u la ai ne um shym la ai Ethanim hukum na ka Ebedmelekh ka jingtei pat ïa kane ka Templ jingtyrwa Jerusalem basawdong bad nangta Dodo jingneh ïa ngi kaei ka mon jong phi ha kane ka kam .
translation.en: Now therefore , if it seem good to the king , let there be search made in the king s treasure house , which is there at Babylon , whether it be so , that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem , and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter .
And it came to pass , that when the Jews which dwelt by them came , they said unto us ten times , From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you .
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka por sha ka por ki Jiw kiba shong hapdeng ki nongshun jong ngi ki wan ban maham ïa ngi ïa ki jingthmu jong ki nongshun jong ngi pyrshah ïa ngi .
shi la pyndep sha Bethsaida , ha kaba kylla-kaba-mut katne ngut ki briew ki la jong Haoid U jingduh ïa u briew uba matlah , bad ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ktah ïa u .
translation.en: And he cometh to Bethsaida  ; and they bring a blind man unto him , and besought him to touch him .
With long life will I satisfy him , and shew him my salvation .
translation.kha: Ngan ainong ïa ki da kaba pynslem ïa ka rta jong ki , ngan pynim ïa ki .

translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals to a bullock , and two tenth deals to one ram ,
translation.kha: Ai ïa ka jingainguh bam da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ,

translation.en: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters : they came to the pits , and found no water  ; they returned with their vessels empty  ; they were ashamed and confounded , and covered their heads .
translation.kha: Ki briew bariewspah ki phah ïa la ki shakri ban tong um ; ki leit sha ki thliew pynlang um , hynrei kim shem um ; ki wan phai pat bad ki khra thylli . Ki la noh mynsiem bad shaïong jingmut , ki buhrieh ïa la ki durkhmat .
Nangta baroh na kiba lait im na ki kiba la tur ïa ka kin leit shata man la ka snem ban U Trai Badonbor Baroh kum u syiem bad ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , and to keep the feast of tabernacles .

And they tarried till they were ashamed : and , behold , he opened not the doors of the parlour  ; therefore they took a key , and opened them : and , behold , their lord was fallen down dead on the earth .
translation.kha: Ki la ap haduh ba ki dang lah ban ap , hynrei haba um shym la plie ïa ka jingkhang , ki la shim ïa u shabi bad plie ïa ka . Bad hangta u don u kynrad jong ki , u da thiah ïap ha madan .

translation.en: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye , but not to doubtful disputations .
translation.kha: To pdiang sngewbha ïa u briew uba tlot ha ka jingngeit , hynrei wat ïania bad u shaphang ki jingpyrkhat bashimet jong u .

translation.en: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee , Give this man place  ; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room .
translation.kha: bad ba u nongpdiang ïa phi , uba la khot sngewbha ïa phi baroh ar ngut , un hap wan bad ong ha phi , ‘ Ai noh ha u ïa kane ka jaka shong .’ Nangta phin sngewlehrain bad wan ban shong ha ka jaka ba hapoh eh .

translation.en: Then answered they and said before the king , That Daniel , which is of the children of the captivity of Judah , regardeth not thee , O king , nor the decree that thou hast signed , but maketh his petition three times a day .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ong ha u syiem ,  U Daniel , uwei na kiba shah ringmraw na Judah , um shym burom ïa u Syiem Kynrad lane kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba phi la pynmih . U la duwai tista lai sien shi sngi .

translation.en: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour : but a man of understanding holdeth his peace .
translation.kha: Ka long bieit ban krenbeiñ ïa kiwei . Lada phi long uba sngewthuh , phin shu sngap jar jar .
