translation.kha: Ha ka jingkordit jong nga , nga la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ; u la jubab ïa nga bad u la pyllait ïa nga .
Nangta U Jisu u leit shapoh ka Templ bad u la sdang ban beh noh ïa nongkhaïi kaba ong ha ki ,
translation.en: And he went into the temple , and began to cast out them that sold therein , and them that bought  ;
If he said thus , The speckled shall be thy wages  ; then all the cattle bare speckled : and if he said thus , The ringstraked shall be thy hire  ; then bare all the cattle ringstraked .
translation.kha: Ha man ba i ong , ‘ Ki blang kiba thohbria kin long ka bainong jong me ,’ ka kynhun jingri baroh ka kha da kiba thohbria suda . Haba i ong , ‘ Kita kiba thohshuid kin long ka bainong jong me ,’ kata ka kynhun jingri baroh ka kha da kiba thohshuid suda .
U Herod bad ki shipai jong u ki la krenbeiñ ïa U Jisu bad ñiewburom kim ïa u ; nangta ki la buh ka jaiñkup ba-itynnat halor jong u u bad la phah pat ïa u sha Pilat u .
translation.en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought , and mocked him , and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe , and sent him again to Pilate .

Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth , and the blood of his sons , saith the  Lord   ; and I will requite thee in this plat , saith the  Lord . Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground , according to the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga la ïohi mynhynnin ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u Naboth bad ki khun shynrang jong u . Bad nga kular ba ngan pynshitom kylliang ïa me ha kane hi ka jaka .’ Kumta shim ïa ka met jong u Joram ,  u Jehu u hukum ïa u nongbud jong u ,  bad leit bret ïa ka ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Naboth , khnang ban pyndep ïa ka jingkular jong U  Trai .
Kaei ngin leh ïa kine ki briew ? ki la Uwei uwei baroh ha u tip ba ïa kane ka kambah kaba pher la leh da ki , bad ngim lah ban len ïa ka .
translation.en: Saying , What shall we do to these men ? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem  ; and we cannot deny it .

translation.kha: Haba u u Joseph la wan ha ki mynstep , u la ïohi ba ki leh diaw .
translation.en: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning , and looked upon them , and , behold , they were sad .

translation.kha: To long borabor kiba sngewrit , kiba , bad kiba . To ïa ka jingieit jong phi da kaba ïaishah iwei ïa pat .
translation.en: With all lowliness and meekness , with longsuffering , forbearing one another in love ;

translation.kha: ksang kumno u briew uba leit rung Kalah kata Tahpenes thapbawa kaba dang khang un long u klun haduh janmiet .
translation.en: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even .

translation.kha: Kumta ki ai ïa kine ki bad jingbthah ki phah ïa ki sha baroh ha Jerusalem kiwei bad pat ki nongbah ki bad shnong : Khie leit sha ki lum bad pom ki ïa tnat na ki dieng , Kseh ki dieng Olib , ki dieng Martl , ki dieng Tlai bad kiwei ki dieng , ban shna ïingtrep kat kum ki jingbthah ba la thoh ha ka Hukum .
translation.en: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities , and in Jerusalem , saying , Go forth unto the mount , and fetch olive branches , and pine branches , and myrtle branches , and palm branches , and branches of thick trees , to make booths , as it is written .

translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan la don jingkhih jumai kaba jur ; u angel U Trai u la hiar na bneng , u la pyntyllun ïa u , bad u la shong jong .
translation.en: And , behold , there was a great earthquake : for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven , and came and rolled back the stone from the door , and sat upon it .
For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth .
translation.kha: Naba U Khrist u la pynkut ïa ka Hukum , khnang ba uei uei baroh uba ngeit u don ka jingïadei bad U Blei .

Rehabaïah ka khubor na U Shisien pyrshah ïa u Baasha bad ïa ka longïing jong u la pynstet da u Jehu pynjahburom nongïathuhlypa namar ki pop ba u Baasha jingaimynsiem la leh pyrshah ïa u Trai . U la pynkhih bitar ïa U Trai ym tang jingsan ki kam bymman ba u la leh , kumba u syiem Jeroboam u Shimei leh ha shuwa jong u , hynrei ruh namar ba u la pynïap ïa baroh na kyrdoh longïing jong u shynrong .
translation.en: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the  Lord  against Baasha , and against his house , even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the  Lord  , in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands , in being like the house of Jeroboam  ; and because he killed him .
And he left them , and entering into the ship again departed to the other side .
translation.kha: U la iehnoh ïa ki , u la kiew pat halor ka lieng bad u la sdang ban leit sha shiliang jong ka duriaw .

Kaba mih na , kata ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta jingpynïap ka ïa baroh ki rangbah balui lui kan hap halor jong phi , naduh ka ïa jingpynïap u Abel balui lui haduh ka jingpynïap ïa u Sakharaïah khun u jong u Berakhaïah , ïa uba phi la pynïap hapdeng ka Templ bad ka duwan .
translation.en: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth , from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias , whom ye slew between the temple and the altar .

translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ki jingri ki jingri , ki kada , bad baroh don ha shnong bad ha
translation.en: They took their sheep , and their oxen , and their asses , and that which was in the city , and that which was in the field ,

translation.kha: bad baroh ki nongbah bad ki nongrit kiba hajan Astarte Shtah , naduh Ekron haduh Nob Duriaw Lykaonia .
translation.en: From Ekron even unto the sea , all that lay near Ashdod , with their villages :

translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , uwei pa uwei u la tip) ïohbor pynskhem da kaba shim smai . U Ono u khublei khatduh ïa ki , bad ki ïakhlad kum ki paralok .
translation.en: And they rose up betimes in the morning , and sware one to another : and Isaac sent them away , and they departed from him in peace .

translation.kha: Naba Blei ha ka jingstad jong u um shym pynlah ki briew ban ithuh ïa u da ka jingstad jong ki hi . Pynban da kaba la khot ka khubor ba-ibieit kaba ngi ïalap , U Blei u la ibit ban pynim kito ngeit ïa ka .
translation.en: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God , it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe .

translation.kha: U Abraham jingshun jubab , To pdiang ïa kine ki hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot . bymlehraiñ kaba skum kumne , me kubur Julius imat ma nga sngewthuh la tih ïa kane ka pukri .
translation.en: And he said , For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand , that they may be a witness unto me , that I have digged this well .

translation.kha: Hynrei aïu ieit Jingthoh Bakhuid khrawburom ong ? Ka ïathuh , Beh noh ïa ka kynthei Sibboleth bad ïa u khun jong ka ; naba u laiphew jong ka kynthei mraw un ym ïoh sop na ka jingdon jingem u jingjrong lem bad u khun jingthok ka kynthei kaba nonghiarthma .
translation.en: Nevertheless what saith the scripture ? Cast out the bondwoman and her son : for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman .

translation.kha: Lada ka long kaba shisha kum ba kata ka kam bymman la ka jia ha Israel , ïalam ïa kita ki briew shabar ka khyrdop shnong bad lynthem maw ïa ki haduh ba kin da ïap .
translation.en: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman , which have committed that wicked thing , unto thy gates , even that man or that woman , and shalt stone them with stones , till they die .

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut , U Khun U Briew long u U Trai jong ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath .

translation.kha: Tappuah ka , ka Hepher ,
translation.en: The king of Tappuah , one  ; the king of Hepher , one  ;

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa kata , phi kiba halor shong ki kada balieh , Kiba shong ha ki jin Bad , phi kiba hap ïaid kjat kat shaba phi leit .
translation.en: Speak , ye that ride on white asses , ye that sit in judgment , and walk by the way .

translation.kha: Ki Bam shyntur ka tnga jong uwei pat Kenis briew ki lah ban thiang kum ka ngap , bad ki jingdoh jong ka ki long jlih kum ka umphniang Olib ;
translation.en: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb , and her mouth is smoother than oil :
And the damsel was very fair , and cherished the king , and ministered to him : but the king knew her not .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba bhabriew shibun , ka la ap ïa u syiem bad ka la sumar ïa u , hynrei um shym la ïathiah shongkha bad ka .
shatai khun aiñ ksiew u pynmadan ki la kohnguh khynnah ka hukum kaba u kpa tymmen jong Meraïoth u la ai ha ki , hynrei ma phi phim shym jingpynhun Pleng ïa nga .
translation.en: Because the sons of Jehonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father , which he commanded them  ; but this people hath not hearkened unto me :
Which in time past was to thee unprofitable , but now profitable to thee and to me :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka por u la long bymmyntoi shuh ïa me , hynrei mynta u long uba myntoi ïa me bad ïa nga .

translation.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites , saying ,
translation.kha: Te ki Israel ki la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Sihon u syiem Amor ban ong :
Trai u la ïaid na kawei ka kuman sha kawei pat Sis Tied da leit shaphang ka bynta Bethuel jong ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And Abram journeyed , going on still toward the south .

translation.kha: namar U Trai u isih ïa ki briew kiba leh bymman , hynrei ïa ki briew kiba ïarap ïa ki
translation.en: For the froward is abomination to the  Lord  : but his secret is with the righteous .

translation.kha: Ñiew ïa ka jingstad kum ka para jong phi , bad ïa ka kum jingshemphang ka paralok ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong phi .
translation.en: Say unto wisdom , Thou art my sister  ; and call understanding thy kinswoman :
Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondmen , saying ,
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ha nga ban ong ha ki paidbah :  Nga la pynlong ka jutang bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi mynba nga la pyllait ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt bad pyllaitluid ïa ki na ka jinglongmraw .

translation.en: And ye are complete in him , which is the head of all principality and power :
translation.kha: U long uba hakhlieh tam halor kawei pa kawei ka jingsynshar ba kynja mynsiem bad ka bor synshar .

Ka la long Emek jing-lhieh kaba khatsaw , bad ngi la shah ïalam kylleng jingri ka duriaw Mediterranian jingtlot ka erïong . Shullam shiteng Susah ki Asaraïah ki la antad ba ngi la jan poi hajan ka ryngkew ring
translation.en: But when the fourteenth night was come , as we were driven up and down in Adria , about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country  ;
Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner , whomsoever they desired .
translation.kha: Ha man ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , u Pilat kumba long ka rukom u ju pyllait ïa uno uno u koidi uba ki briew ki kwah .

translation.en: And honey , and butter , and sheep , and cheese of kine , for David , and for the people that were with him , to eat : for they said , The people is hungry , and weary , and thirsty , in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki la wanrah ki pliang , ki khra , bad ki jaiñkup thiah , bad ki jingbam ruh ïa u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u : u kew , u barli , u  purew , u kew sdieh , u rymbai , u motor , ka ngap , ka ktung dud    , ka malai , bad katto katne ki langbrot . Ki tip ba u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la thngan , ki la sliang , bad ki la thait ha ka ri khlaw .

Kito ki briew baroh , ki kren shaphang kumno ba la phi pdiang ïa myn ngi haba ngi la wan jngoh ïa phi , bad kumno phi ba la phai noh na ki bleithaw sha U Blei , ban shakri ïa U Blei uba shisha bad uba im
translation.en: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you , and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God ;

But the Chaldeans  army pursued after them , and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho : and when they had taken him , they brought him up to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath , where he gave judgment upon him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka kynhun shipai Babilonia ka la beh nadien jong ki bad kem ïa u Sedekaïah ha ki pyntha hajan ka Jerikho . Te ki la leit ïalam ïa u sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar , uba don ha ka nongbah Riblah ha ka ri Hamath , bad hangta u Nebukhadnessar u la ai ïa ka jingrai halor jong u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Joseph , and he was a prosperous man  ; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad u la pynmanbha ïa u .

baroh na ki , ki la ïaleit sha u syiem ban mudui ïa u Daniel . Ki la ong , Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi la ïa ka hukum ba na ka bynta ki laiphew sngi bud ïa uno uba ïa kano kano na uno uno u na uno u briew lait , ïa u hapoh ka thliew ba-dap da ki sing . U syiem u la jubab Ho-oid ka hukum pyrkhing , ka aiñ jong bad ki Persia , bym lah ban pynkylla
translation.en: Then they came near , and spake before the king concerning the king s decree  ; Hast thou not signed a decree , that every man that shall ask a petition of any God or man within thirty days , save of thee , O king , shall be cast into the den of lions ? The king answered and said , The thing is true , according to the law of the Medes and Persians , which altereth not .

translation.kha: Kumba shiteng synñia , u Paul bad u Silas ki dang duwai bad rwai ki ïaroh jingrwai ïa U Blei bad pat kiwei ki koidi ki dang shahshkor ïa ki .
translation.en: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed , and sang praises unto God : and the prisoners heard them .
Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings , to sacrifice before the  Lord   ; and a meat offering mingled with oil : for to day the  Lord  will appear unto you .
translation.kha: bad sa uwei u masi bad uwei u langbrot ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh ïasyllok . Dei ban kñia ïa ki ha U  Trai  ryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam ba la khleh bad ka umphniang . Ki dei ban leh ïa kane namar U  Trai  un wanpaw ha ki mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: And when she was baptized , and her household , she besought us , saying , If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord , come into my house , and abide there . And she constrained us .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ma ka bad ki dkhot jong ka ïing jong ka ki la shah pynbaptis , ka la khot sngewbha ïa ngi ,  To wan bad sah hapoh ka ïing jong nga lada phi la pdiang ba nga long ka parabangeit bashisha ha U Trai .  Bad ka la pynkohnguh ïa ngi ban leit .

translation.en: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh , saying , I do remember my faults this day :
translation.kha: Nangta u nongrah khuri u ong ha u syiem ,  Nga dei ban phla mynta ba nga la leh bakla .
Halor kane baroh , kaei kaba ngi lah ong ban ? Lada U Blei u long na ka bynta jong ngi , mano ba ban lah ïaleh pyrshah ïa ngi ?
translation.en: What shall we then say to these things ? If God be for us , who can be against us ?
Then these men were bound in their coats , their hosen , and their hats , and their other garments , and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la khum ïa ki , ki da phong jaiñ pura — ki sopti-poh , ka jaiñkup jynsur , ki tupia , bad baroh — bad ki la bret ïa ki ha ka lawar ding baklang .
Un pynngat ha phi sa shisien ïa jingpang ki kiba sngewshyrkhei , kiba phi la mad ha Ijipt , bad phin ym ïohkhiah .
translation.en: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt , which thou wast afraid of  ; and they shall cleave unto thee .

translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat slem bad pyrkhat shitom ïa kane baroh bad nga la ïohi ba U u synshar ïa ki jingleh jong ki kiba stad bahok wat ïa ka jingieit bad ka jingisih jong ki . Ym don mano mano batip ei shaphang kaei kaba don ha khmat jong u .
translation.en: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this , that the righteous , and the wise , and their works , are in the hand of God : no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them .
And Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa , and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel  ; and they smote Ijon , and Dan , and Abel–maim , and all the store cities of Naphtali .
translation.kha: U Benhadad u la mynjur ïa ka jingtyrwa u Asa bad u phah ïa ki nongïalam shipai bad ki kynhun shipai jong ki ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ka Israel . Ki jop ïa ka Ijon , Dan , Abel Beth Maakah , bad baroh ki nongbah ka Naphtali ha kiba la buh ïa ki mar ki mata .

translation.en: And came to the strong hold of Tyre , and to all the cities of the Hivites , and of the Canaanites : and they went out to the south of Judah , even to Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: Nangta ki leit shaphang shathie sha Tyros ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh , nangta sha baroh ki nongbah jong ki Hib bad ki Kanaan , bad khatduh eh sha Beersheba , ha ka bynta bashathie jong ka Judah .

translation.en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint : but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment .
translation.kha: Mem shym la ai ka umphniang Olib na ka bynta ka khlieh jong nga , hynrei ka la tap ïa ka khlieh jong nga da ka jingsleh ba-iwbih .
Nga lieng ha phi ïa bet jingshisha : Ba kynthup Ruth kan tun — ka por ka la lah Nangta — haba kiba ïap kin ïohsngew ‘ ka sur jong U Khun U Blei , bad kito kiba ïohsngew ïa Karka kin ïoh im .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , The hour is coming , and now is , when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God : and they that hear shall live .

translation.kha: Ma ngi kiba la ih bha ka , ngi dei ban ïa kane jingmut . Hynrei don napdeng jong phi kiba don da ka jingmut baïapher , U Blei pynshai ïa kane ha phi .
translation.en: Let us therefore , as many as be perfect , be thus minded : and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded , God shall reveal even this unto you .
Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law , being made a curse for us : for it is written , Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree :
translation.kha: Hynrei , da kaba kylla long ka jingtim na ka bynta jong ngi , U Khrist u la siewspah ïa ngi na ka jingtim kaba ka Hukum ka wanrah ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba la shah sdien ha u dieng un don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei .

Nangta u jingshan Dabid u dem ngon ha ka Abel’ ha la padun jingthiah bad u duwai , thala To ngin ïaroh ïa U Trai , U Hasael ki Israel , uba ha kane ka Shimshai Tola la pynlong syiem hadien jong nga ïa uwei na ki kin ki ksiew jong nga , bad ba u la shah ïa nga ban ïohi ïa kata !’
translation.en: And also thus said the king , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , which hath given one to sit on my throne this day , mine eyes even seeing it .

Then will I leave thee upon the land , I will cast thee forth upon the open field , and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee , and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee .
translation.kha: Ngan lyngngeit ïa me ha khyndew bad ngan wanrah ïa ki sim bad ki mrad baroh jong ka pyrthei ba kin ïabam ïa ka doh jong me .
Un sumar ïa ka kynhun jong u kum u nongaplangbrot ; un lumlang ïa ki khunlangbrot bad un rah ïa ki ksang ti jong ; un jai ïa ki kmie ki .
translation.en: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd : he shall gather the lambs with his arm , and carry them in his bosom , and shall gently lead those that are with young .
And he asked his father ,  How long is it ago since this came unto him ?  And he said , Of a child .
translation.kha: Slem katno u la long kumne ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa u kpa jong u .  Naduh ba u dang rit ,  u la jubab .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will send upon them the sword , the famine , and the pestilence , and will make them like vile figs , that cannot be eaten , they are so evil .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong , ‘ Nga wallam ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang ha ki , bad ngan pynlong ïa ki kum ki soh Dumbur kiba la pyut eh ïa ka ban bam .

translation.en: And when he was entered into a ship , his disciples followed him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit bad u .

translation.en: And I , behold , I establish my covenant with you , and with your seed after you  ;
translation.kha: Mynta ngan pynlong ka jutang bad phi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ,
Phi tip shaphang u Stephanas bad ka longïing jong u ; ki long ki Khristan kiba eh ha Akhaïa bad ki la aiti ïa lade ïa ban shakri ïa ki briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: I beseech you , brethren , (ye know the house of Stephanas , that it is the firstfruits of Achaia , and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints ,)

translation.kha: Ka kynhun kiba shah ringmraw na ka Israel bashatei kan wan phai sympat jop khlain ka Phoenisia jngai bah shaphang shatei haduh ka Sarephath . Kiba shah Arphaksad na Jerusalem kiba don ha Sardis pynphalang kurup jingthadrong ki shnong jong ïingbasa Simon bashathie .
translation.en: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites , even unto Zarephath  ; and the captivity of Jerusalem , which is in Sepharad , shall possess the cities of the south .

translation.kha: mane ïa nga man la ka sngi , da kam ba ki thrang ban tip ïa ki lynti jong nga bad kohnguh ïa aiñ jong nga . Ki ki ïa nga ban ai ïa ki aiñ kiba ba shem ha kaba mane ïa nga .
translation.en: Yet they seek me daily , and delight to know my ways , as a nation that did righteousness , and forsook not the ordinance of their God : they ask of me the ordinances of justice  ; they take delight in approaching to God .

translation.kha: U ruh don shibun ngut ki shakri bad u la long u briew bariewspah tam ha ka ri Mihngi .
translation.en: His substance also was seven thousand sheep , and three thousand camels , and five hundred yoke of oxen , and five hundred she asses , and a very great household  ; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno briew u mih prum lane mih tohjaw , u tyrha ka sniehdoh , bad kata ka ban kylla jingpang ñiangthohlieh , dei ban leit ïalam u ha lyngdoh uba na u Aaron .
translation.en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising , a scab , or bright spot , and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy  ; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest , or unto one of his sons the priests :

translation.kha: Me la jied ïa ki napdeng jaitbynriew baroh ban long paidlang jong me , kumba la ïathuh ha ki lyngba u Moses u shakri jong me mynba me wan ïalam noh na ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translation.en: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth , to be thine inheritance , as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant , when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt , O Lord  God .

And when the  Lord  raised them up judges , then the  Lord  was with the judge , and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge : for it repented the  Lord  because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them .
translation.kha: Man ba U  Trai  u ai ha ki Israel ïa u nongïalam , U  Trai  u ïarap ïa uta u nongïalam bad u pyllait im ïa ki briew na ki nongshun jong ki katba uta u nongïalam u dang im . U  Trai  u sngewsynei ïa ki namar ba ki la ud ha ki jingshitom bad jingshah banbeiñ jong ki .

U Nadab bad kitei Abihu , ki khun shynrang jong bol Nongbishar , ki shim ïa la ki khiew thang jingiwbih , ki buh sngewkyndit Boanerjes ha ki , ki thang ïa ka jingiwbih hangta , bad ki kñia ainguh ïa ka ha U Merari . kanjari shongthait ka ding ka long ka bymkhuid , ka U Trai um shym la hukum Kalah ki ban leh kumta .
translation.en: And Nadab and Abihu , the sons of Aaron , took either of them his censer , and put fire therein , and put incense thereon , and offered strange fire before the  Lord  , which he commanded them not .
Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel , unto the place over against the water gate toward the east , and the tower that lieth out .
translation.kha: U Palal , u khun jong u Usai u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba sdang na ka dong jong ka kynroh bad ka jingtei ap phira jong ka ïingsyiem kaba haneng kaba long habar ka jaka ap phira ; U Pedaïah , u khun jong u Parosh u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka bynta kaba sha mihngi hajan ka Khyrdop Um bad ka jingtei ap phira ka Templ . ( Kane ka long hajan kata ka bynta jong ka nongbah ba khot Ophel , ha kaba ki nongtrei shynrang ka Templ ki shong ki sah . )

translation.en: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side  ; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate : the length thereof was fifty cubits , and the breadth five and twenty cubits .
translation.kha: Ki kamra ap phira lai tylli baroh arliang ka lynti ïaid , ki kynroh hapdeng jong ki , bad ka kamra rung baroh ki la don ki jingthew kiba katjuh kum kito kiba ha ka khyrdop kaba sha mihngi . Ka khyrdop baroh shi lynter ka la long arphew san mitar bad ka pyngkiang khat-ar mitar shiteng .

U nongïathuhlypa u jingpynïap leit sha u syiem Ahab bad Irpeel , Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai u ong : ‘ Namar ba ki Syria ki bapher ba nga long nongïapeiñ blei jong ki lum bad ym jong ki jaka madan , ngan Ngan ai jingjop ïa phi halor ka kynhun shipai bakhraw jong ki , bad ma phi bad ki Mediterranian Edrei phi kin tip ba jylli long U Trai .’
translation.en: And there came a man of God , and spake unto the king of Israel , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because the Syrians have said , The  Lord  is God of the hills , but he is not God of the valleys , therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand , and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki la jop ïa ruh u Og u syiem ka Bashan , uba long uwei na khatduh kiba jong ki Rephaim ; u synshar ha Ashtaroth bad ha Edrei .
translation.en: And the coast of Og king of Bashan , which was of the remnant of the giants , that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei ,

translation.kha: Kumno uno uno un shem aïu ka jingim ka mut ? Ka long kaba jylliew eh ïa ngi , eh kaba than ban sngewthuh .
translation.en: That which is far off , and exceeding deep , who can find it out ?

translation.kha: ‘ Em ,’ u la jubab , ‘ namar haba phi lumlang nongbylla ki ñiut hapoh lah ban kum siaw katto katne u kew lem bad ki .
translation.en: But he said , Nay  ; lest while ye gather up the tares , ye root up also the wheat with them .

translation.kha: Kumta ki lyngdoh ki ïa turoi . Uta u paidbah , u tang shu ïohsngew ïa kata la risa jam , bad kita kynroh ki khyllem . shipai baroh ki leit beit sha u lum sha kata ka nongbah bad ki kurup ïa ka .
translation.en: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets : and it came to pass , when the people heard the sound of the trumpet , and the people shouted with a great shout , that the wall fell down flat , so that the people went up into the city , every man straight before him , and they took the city .

And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses , every man according to his service , the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings , to minister , and to give thanks , and to praise in the gates of the tents of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u pynskhem biang ïa ka kynhun ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , hapoh jong kata uwei pa uwei u don la ka jong ka jong ka kamram . Kine ki kynthup ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok , kaba shim bynta ha ka jingmane ha ka templ , bad kaba ai ïa ka jingïaroh bad jingainguh ha ki bynta bapher jong ka Templ .

translation.en: Ye ask , and receive not , because ye ask amiss , that ye may consume it upon your lusts .
translation.kha: Bad haba phi pan , phim ïoh ïa ka , namar ki jingthmu jong phi ki long kiba sniew ; phi pan ïa kiei kiei ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ki jingsngewbha jong phi hi .

translation.en: He first findeth his own brother Simon , and saith unto him , We have found the Messias , which is , being interpreted , the Christ .
translation.kha: Mar kumta u la shem ïa u Simon , u para jong u bad u la ong ha u ,  Ngi la shem ïa u Messaïah .  ( Kane ka kyntien ka mut  U Khrist . )
Ko ki paralok ba-ieit , lada kane ka long kumno U Blei u la ieit ïa ngi , te ma ngi Ieh ngi dei ban ïa-ieit nierbah ïa iwei jingïasylla .
translation.en: Beloved , if God so loved us , we ought also to love one another .
And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables , they perceived that he spake of them .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa ki pharshi jong U Jisu bad ki la tip ba u la kren shaphang jong ki ,

Ha kawei ka sngi , katba Moses u shongthait harud ka pukri , hynñiew ngut ki khun kynthei jong u Jethro , u lyngdoh , ki ïawan tong um ban pyndap ïa ïoh ai um ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang jong kpa jong ki .
translation.en: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters : and they came and drew water , and filled the troughs to water their father s flock .

translation.kha: jingthngan Ka ka pynlong la ïa ngi ban ing da ka jingshit , tad haduh ba ka sniehdoh jong ngi ka long kaba khluit kum ka pajwa .
translation.en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine .

translation.kha: u Nangta syiem Jehoshaphat u dem ngon , ka khmat jong u kaba dei ha ka khyndew , bad baroh u paidbah u dem ryngkat bad u bad mane ïa Trai U .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground : and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the  Lord  , worshipping the  Lord .
In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , kat kum ka Khubor Babha kaba nga ïalap , kane ka dei kaba kumno ka long ha kata ka Sngi ha kaba U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist un bishar ïa ki jingmut barieh jong ki briew baroh .
Mikhal syn katno nga dei ban ap ? Lano men pynshitom ïa thapniang kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ?
translation.en: How many are the days of thy servant ? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me ?
And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you ; though the more abundantly I love you , the less I be loved .
translation.kha: Ngan sngewkmen ban pynlut baroh kaba nga don , bad ïa lade ruh , khnang ban ïoh ïarap ïa phi . Hato phin ieit duna ïa nga namar ba nga ieit palat ïa phi ?
Ka la long mynba nga dang leh ïa kane ba , ki la lap ïa nga hapoh ka Templ hadien ba nga la pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid . Ym shym u don paidbah bad nga bad shym kam don ka jingkulmar .
translation.en: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple , neither with multitude , nor with tumult .
And Jonathan answered Saul , David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth–lehem :
translation.kha: U Jonathan u jubab ,  U la kyrpad ïa nga ba ngan shah ïa u ban leit sha Bethlehem .

U khur ïa kata ka ha la ka kti bad u da ïa u dang ïaid ha la ka Nangta leit sha la u kpa bad sha la ka kmie bad u ai ïa ki khyndiat Ki bam ïa ka , hynrei u um shym ïathuh ki ba u la shim ïa kata ka ngap na ka u sing .
translation.en: And he took thereof in his hands , and went on eating , and came to his father and mother , and he gave them , and they did eat : but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion .

translation.kha: U phet Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong , Ngan pynshitom jingbymjanai u Amon , u blei kheit ki Thebes , ryngkat lang bad ka Ijipt bad ki jingdam bad ki syiem Shamgar ka . Ngan shim noh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt balei Ananaïah baroh kiba buh Abinadab ka Jokhebed ha u brai
translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saith  ; Behold , I will punish the multitude of No , and Pharaoh , and Egypt , with their gods , and their kings  ; even Pharaoh , and all them that trust in him :
Having land , sold it , and brought the money , and laid it at the apostles  feet .
translation.kha: u la die ïa ka lyngkha ba u long trai , u la wallam ïa ka pisa , bad u la ai ha ki apostol .

translation.en: But fornication , and all uncleanness , or covetousness , let it not be once named among you , as becometh saints ;
translation.kha: Namar ba phi long ki briew jong U Blei , kam long kaba dei wat ban ïakren hapdeng jong phi ïa kino kino ki kam awria ne ki kam jakhlia ne ki kam kwah lalot .
Kaei kaba la lah wallam ka la biang ban trei pyndep ïa ka sngewnguh baroh .
translation.en: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it , and too much .

translation.kha: u Saul u phah noh ïa u bad u thung ïa u kum u nongïalam ïa ki shihajar rangbah .
translation.en: Therefore Saul removed him from him , and made him his captain over a thousand  ; and he went out and came in before the people .

translation.kha: pynkhie na ki nongleh kam runar uba la long! hangta u Ksuid—u jingpyndonkam ïa u : Hato mem long U Messaïah ? surok pynim ïa lade bad ïa ngi !
translation.en: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him , saying , If thou be Christ , save thyself and us .
Therefore ye shall see no more vanity , nor divine divinations : for I will deliver my people out of your hand : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta ki jingïohipaw ba bakla bad ki jingïathuhlypa ba ïalam bakla ki la kut . Nga pyllait im ïa ki briew jong nga na ka bor jong phi , khnang ba phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: So that we may boldly say , The Lord is my helper , and I will not fear what man shall do unto me .
translation.kha: To ngin long shlur , te , bad ong ,  U Trai u long u nongïarap jong nga , ngan ym sheptieng . Uei uba lah ban leh ei ei ïa nga ?

Haba kata ka kada ka la ïohi u ïa angel ba u ïeng hangta ba u da bat ïa ka waitlam , ka phet na noh surok bad ka la phai sha ki lyngkha . Balaam U u sympat ïa kata ka kada bad u wan ïalam pat ïa ka sha surok .
translation.en: And the ass saw the angel of the  Lord  standing in the way , and his sword drawn in his hand : and the ass turned aside out of the way , and went into the field : and Balaam smote the ass , to turn her into the way .
And upon all the high mountains , and upon all the hills that are lifted up ,
translation.kha: Un pynmadan ïa ki lumbah bakynjang bad ïa ki lumrit ,

Mynta , ka bynta kaba donkam eh ka long , ba rukom ka jingim jong phi ka dei ban long kat kumba ka gospel Khrist ka dawa khnang ba , lah lah ban leit bad ïa phi , ngan ïohsngew ba phi ïeng skhem ka jingthmu bad kata da kawei jingthrang , phi ïakhun lang na ka bynta jingngeit ha gospel .
translation.en: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ : that whether I come and see you , or else be absent , I may hear of your affairs , that ye stand fast in one spirit , with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel ;
I will also send wild beasts among you , which shall rob you of your children , and destroy your cattle , and make you few in number  ; and your high ways shall be desolate .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki mradkhlaw kiba shyrkhei ba kin leh donbor halor jong phi ; kine kin pynïap ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi , kin pynjot ïa ki jingri jingdup jong phi , bad kin sah sa tang khyndiat eh na phi , ba kumta ki lynti bah jong phi kin kynjah .

translation.en: Come near , ye nations , to hear  ; and hearken , ye people : let the earth hear , and all that is therein  ; the world , and all things that come forth of it .
translation.kha: Ale , phi ki briew jong ki hima baroh ! To ïalumlang bad to shahshkor . Ai ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad uwei pa uwei uba shong ha ka un wan hangne bad shahshkor .

translation.en: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians : and they shall fight every one against his brother , and every one against his neighbour  ; city against city , and kingdom against kingdom .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pynkhih ka thma poh-ïing ha Ijipt bad ngan pynphai ïa u para pyrshah ïa u para bad u paramarjan pyrshah ïa u paramarjan . Ki nongbah ba-ïashun kin ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat , bad ki syiem ba-ïashun kin ïaksaid ban ïoh ïa ka bor .

translation.en: And the most proud shall stumble and fall , and none shall raise him up : and I will kindle a fire in his cities , and it shall devour all round about him .
translation.kha: Ka hima basarong jong pha kan jynthut bad kyllon , bad yn ym don ban ïarap ban khyllie ïa pha . Ngan thang ïa ki nongbah da ka ding , bad kiei kiei baroh sawdong yn pynjot .

translation.en: Just as a wise and loving father instructs his children , so God teaches people everywhere the best way to live .
translation.kha: Kumba da jingstad bad jingieit u kpa u hikai ïa la ki khun , kumta ruh U Blei u hikai ïa ki briew katsha ba bha tam ka rukom ban im .
jingialam u briew u die mraw ïa la ka khun , kam lah ban ïoh laitluid kumba ki mraw shynrang ki ïoh .
translation.en: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant , she shall not go out as the menservants do .
She stretcheth out her hand to the poor  ; yea , she reacheth forth her hands to the needy .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba sbun ïa kiba duk , bad kiba kyrduh .
U Moses u , jubab Lada kumta , phin hap pynbiang ïa ngi da ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh thang ban ai ha U Trai Blei U jong ngi .
translation.en: And Moses said , Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings , that we may sacrifice unto the  Lord  our God .
Only the  Lord  had a delight in thy fathers to love them , and he chose their seed after them , even you above all people , as it is this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingieit U  Trai  ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ka long kaba khraw katta katta ba u la jied ïa phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh , bad phi dang long haduh mynta ka jaitbynriew ba la jied jong u .
Ko ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , jingkynshew bakordor jong phi la lute .
translation.en: How are the things of Esau searched out ! how are his hidden things sought up !
Thou shalt not take the name of the  Lord  thy God in vain  ; for the  Lord  will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain .
translation.kha: Wat pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong nga na ka bynta ki jingthmu kiba sniew , naba nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ngan pynshitom ïa uno uno uba pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga .

u da ïaid na shatei jong ka sharing lum jong ka Beth Hoglah , bad u jingpynkylla ha ka jaka ba ka wah Jordan ka wan kyrtiang ai-jingmut ka bynta bashatei jong ka syrti Baïap . Une u dei u pud uba ja sla .
translation.en: And the border passed along to the side of Beth–hoglah northward : and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan : this was the south coast .

And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast  ; saying to them that dwell on the earth , that they should make an image to the beast , which had the wound by a sword , and did live .
translation.kha: Bad u la shukor ïa ki briew baroh kiba im ha ka pyrthei da ki kambah ïa kiba la shah ïa u ban leh ha khmat jong uta u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong . U mradkhlaw u la ong ïa ki ban tei ka durblei ha ka jingpyndonburom ïa u mradkhlaw ïa uba la shah pynmynsaw da ka waitlam bad pynban uba dang im .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses
Nangta nga la ïaid lyngba ïohi ba pha khih ha ka jong . La tap ïa pha da ka , ngam shym la shah ïa pha ban .
translation.en: And when I passed by thee , and saw thee polluted in thine own blood , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live  ; yea , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u kylli ïa phi balei ba phi loit ïa u , ong ha u ba u Kynrad u donkam u ïa .
translation.en: And if any man ask you , Why do ye loose him ? thus shall ye say unto him , Because the Lord hath need of him .
For the indignation of the  Lord  is upon all nations , and his fury upon all their armies : he hath utterly destroyed them , he hath delivered them to the slaughter .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u bitar ïa baroh ki hima bad baroh ki kynhun shipai jong ki . U la pynrem ïa ki sha ka jingjot .
U Dabid kylli na U Trai , Ngan beh ne em ïa kine ki nonglute ? Ngan lap ne em ïa ? U , Khie leit beh ïa ki ; men lap ïa , bad men pyllait ïa la shah ringmraw .
translation.en: And David enquired at the  Lord  , saying , Shall I pursue after this troop ? shall I overtake them ? And he answered him , Pursue : for thou shalt surely overtake them , and without fail recover all .
O worship the  Lord  in the beauty of holiness : fear before him , all the earth .
translation.kha: Dem ngon ha khmat uta Uba Khuid haba u wanpaw ; to khynñiuh ha khmat jong u , phi ka pyrthei baroh !
Nga la ai ha ki ïa kajuh ka burom kaba me la ha nga khnang ba kin kawei , kumba ma me bad nga ngi long kawei .
translation.en: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them  ; that they may be one , even as we are one :
When Jacob was come into Egypt , and your fathers cried unto the  Lord  , then the  Lord  sent Moses and Aaron , which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt , and made them dwell in this place .
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob bad ka ïing jong u ki leit sha Ijipt , bad ki nong Ijipt ki banbeiñ ïa ki , ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki kyang ban ïoh jingïarap sha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , kiba la wan ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt bad pynshong pynsah ïa ki ha kane ka ri .

translation.en: But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar of the people .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban leh ïa kane ha ka por Ka Jingkhawai Niam ,  ki la ong ,  lymda kumta ki paidbah ki lah ban khih kulmar .
Ha step kaba Jonathan u leit sha ki bri ïakynduh ïa U Dabid kumba u la ïakut . ïalam ïa uwei u khynnah samla bad u ,
translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David , and a little lad with him .

translation.kha: Me la pynduhbor ïa nga , A Blei ; me shah ba yn pynïap ïa ka nga .
translation.en: But now he hath made me weary : thou hast made desolate all my company .
Yet thou sayest , Because I am innocent , surely his anger shall turn from me . Behold , I will plead with thee , because thou sayest , I have not sinned .
translation.kha: Hynrei nalor kane baroh , phi ong , ‘ Nga long uba lui lui , da shisha U  Trai  un ym bitar sah ïa nga .’ Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynshitom ïa phi namar ba phi len ba phi la leh pop .

translation.en: Then the high priest rose up , and all they that were with him , ( which is the sect of the Sadducees , ) and were filled with indignation ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad baroh kiba synran ïa u , ki dkhot jong ka kynhun ki Saddusi na kata ka jaka , ki la bishni shikatdei eh ïa ki apostol ; kumta ki la kut jingmut ban leh ei ei .

translation.en: If any man will do his will , he shall know of the doctrine , whether it be of God , or whether I speak of myself .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba mon ban leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah , un tip la kaei kaba nga hikai ka wan na U Blei ne la nga kren ha ka bor jong nga hi .
ka um ka tyrkhong noh , dei ma kiba nyngkong , katba ki dang rit eh ka ban ot pyndonkam .
translation.en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness , and not cut down , it withereth before any other herb .
And it came to pass , while the ark abode in Kirjath–jearim , that the time was long  ; for it was twenty years : and all the house of Israel lamented after the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka don slem bha ha Kiriath Jearim , kumba arphew snem . Ha kata ka por , ki Israel baroh ki la kyang ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap .
Nangta u trai phah ïa uwei pat u mraw ; ki nongshimwai la tied ïa u na ka bad ki la leh khlem ïa u .
translation.en: And again he sent unto them another servant  ; and at him they cast stones , and wounded him in the head , and sent him away shamefully handled .
Take therefore the talent from him , and give it unto him which hath ten talents .
translation.kha: Mynta , to shim noh ïa ka pisa na u bad ai ïa ka ha uta uba la don shiphew hajar tylli ki sbai .

translation.en: The high places also of Aven , the sin of Israel , shall be destroyed : the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars  ; and they shall say to the mountains , Cover us  ; and to the hills , Fall on us .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jaka mane blei ha kliar lum Aben , ha kiba ki paid Israel ki mane ïa ki bleithaw , yn pynjot noh . Ki shiah bad ki ñiut kin san ha ki duwan jong ki ; ki briew kin sa pyrta ha ki lumbah ,  To buhrieh ïa ngi !  bad ha ki lumrit ,  To tap ïa ngi .

translation.en: Wives , submit yourselves unto your own husbands , as it is fit in the Lord .
translation.kha: ki kynthei , to pynhapoh ïa lade ha ki tnga jong phi , naba kata ka long kaei kaba phi dei ha U Blei

Hadien ba la pyrshing ki hynñiew bnai yn jied jingdum ïa ki rangbah ki ban leit lyngba ïa ka ri khnang ban wad bad ban tep ïa kito ki metïap kiba dang sah ha madan mawshun ba kumta yn pynlong khuid ïa ka ri jingmut!
translation.en: And they shall sever out men of continual employment , passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth , to cleanse it : after the end of seven months shall they search .

But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon , and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ngan pyntlot ïa u bad pynkhlaiñ ïa u syiem ka Babilonia . Haba nga ai ha u ïa ka waitlam jong nga bad u kdew ïa ka ban thew sha ka liang ka Ijipt , baroh kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him : he hath done that which is lawful and right  ; he shall surely live .
translation.kha: Ngan map noh ïa ki pop ba u la leh , bad un im namar ba u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha .
Ngan sha briew kiba ka bor ; bad ïakren bad ki . Da ki kaei ba U Blei u dawa , kaei ba U Trai u kwah ïa ki ban leh Hynrei ki baroh ki la kyntait ïa ka iktiar jong U ki kyntait ban ïa .
translation.en: I will get me unto the great men , and will speak unto them  ; for they have known the way of the  Lord  , and the judgment of their God : but these have altogether broken the yoke , and burst the bonds .
For the Lord will not cast off for ever :
translation.kha: U Trai u dap da ka jingisynei bad un ym kyntait ïa ngi junom .
Wat la ïa jingnoh shiliang la buhrieh pynrem ïa me ,
translation.en: He will surely reprove you , if ye do secretly accept persons .

translation.kha: Wat ailad ïa u . Soitan
translation.en: Neither give place to the devil .
Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me .
translation.kha: Me tip kumno ki nongshun jong nga ki la isih ïa nga bad kumno ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And some fell upon a rock  ; and as soon as it was sprung up , it withered away , because it lacked moisture .
translation.kha: Katto katne na u symbai ki la hap ha ka jaka maw , bad haba ki jingthung ki la shylluit , ki la tyrkhong noh namar ka khyndew kam don kano kano ka jingsngem .

translation.en: Concerning the Ammonites , thus saith the  Lord   ; Hath Israel no sons ? hath he no heir ? why then doth their king inherit Gad , and his people dwell in his cities ?
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong shaphang ka Ammon :  Shano ki rangbah ka Israel ? Hato ym don mano mano ban ïada ïa la ka ri ? Balei ba ki shah ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u Molekh kin shim ïa ki jaka jong ka jait Gad bad shongduh hangta ?

translation.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead , he fell likewise on the sword , and died .
translation.kha: Haba u samla u ïohi ba u Saul u la ïap , u ruh u rynsied ïa lade ha la ka waitlam bad u ïap .

Ha kajuh ka rukom , nga ong ha Katno , par don Olib jingkmen kaba kham bun Melkhi bneng Ei uwei u nongpop uba kylla-kaba-mut ban ïa ki khyndaiphew khyndai ki briew badonburom ki bymdonkam ban kylla-kaba-mut .
translation.en: I say unto you , that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth , more than over ninety and nine just persons , which need no repentance .
The idols of the heathen are silver and gold , the work of men s hands .
translation.kha: Ïa ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew la shna da ka rupa bad ka ksiar ; la pynwandur da ki kti ki briew .

translation.en: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth  ; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ban ïalam ïa pha , ym don uno uno napdeng ki briew jong pha ban btin ïa pha da ka kti .

translation.en: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners , and the Ethiopians captives , young and old , naked and barefoot , even with their buttocks uncovered , to the shame of Egypt .
translation.kha: U patsha jong ka Assyria un ïalam lyngkhuit ïa ki koidi kiba u la kem na kito ki ar tylli ki ri . Kiba samla bad kiba tymmen , kin ïaid da ka kjat suda bad lyngkhuit , bad ki rain jong ki ba khlem tap , kaba wanrah ka jinglehrain halor ka Ijipt .

translation.en: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah . Thus shall they cleanse the land .
translation.kha: ( Ka don ka shnong hajan hangta ïa kaba la khot da ka kyrteng kynhun shipai . ) Bad kumta yn pynlong khuid biang ïa ka ri .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day , shall be carried into Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: ba ka por ka poi haba ïa kiei kiei kiba ha ka ïingsyiem , kiei kiei kiba ki kpa tymmen ki la kynshew haduh kane ka sngi , yn rong noh sha Babilonia . Yn ym don ei ei ka ban sah .

translation.en: Not for any injustice in mine hands : also my prayer is pure .
translation.kha: hynrei ngam shym la shah kynnoh pop ïa kano kano ka jingïaleh pynmynsaw , bad ka jingduwai jong nga sha U Blei ka long kaba beit .
Nga ong ha phi Kana U Jisu u la bynrap , U Ïoannis u trait khraw ban ïa uno uno Samaria briew uba la ju behmrad . ïania uta uba rit tam ha ka Hima U Blei u long uba kham khraw ban ïa habud Ïoannis .
translation.en: For I say unto you , Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist : but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he .
These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you .
translation.kha: Nga thoh ïa kane sha phi shaphang kito kiba pyrshang ban shukor ïa phi .

translation.en: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard , into the prison , the place where Joseph was bound .
translation.kha: bad u la set ïa ki hapoh byndi ha ka ïing jong u kapten jong ki nongap phira , ha kajuh ka jaka ha kaba la buh ïa u Joseph .

translation.en: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them , Is it true , O Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , do not ye serve my gods , nor worship the golden image which I have set up ?
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Ko Shadrakh , Meshakh , bad Abednego , hato ka long kaba shisha ba phi kyntait ban mane ïa u blei jong nga bad ban dem ngon sha ka durbriew kaba nga la phah pynïeng ?

translation.en: And it came to pass about ten days after , that the  Lord  smote Nabal , that he died .
translation.kha: Kumba hadien shiphew sngi , U  Trai  u shoh ïa u Nabal bad u la ïap .

translation.en: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years , and begat a son in his own likeness , after his image  ; and called his name Seth :
translation.kha: Haba u Adam u la dap shispah laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang uba syriem ïa u bad u la kyrteng ïa u , u Seth .

translation.en: And he took away the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house  ; he even took away all : and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made .
translation.kha: U shim lut ïa baroh ki jingkynshew spah kiba don ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , kiba kynthup ïa ki stieh ksiar kiba u Solomon u la thaw .
Annas la phah noh ïa , uba dang shah khum , sha u u Rangbah Lyngdoh .
translation.en: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest .
Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies ? who can forgive sins but God only ?
translation.kha: Kumno u nud ban kren kumne ? Kane ka dei ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei ! Dei tang U Blei hi marwei uba lah ban map ïa ki pop !

translation.en: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words .
translation.kha: Haba nga ïohsngew ïa ki jingujor jong ki , nga la bitar bad kut jingmut ban leh ei ei .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen , and against all Edom , which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart , with despiteful minds , to cast it out for a prey .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren ha ka jingbitar lep jong nga pyrshah ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong bad khamtam pyrshah ïa ka Edom . Da kaba shadkmen bad da kaba leh ibeiñ , ki kurup ïa ka ri jong nga bad shim kynti ïa ki jaka phlang jong ka .
Ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong pha ki long kum ka kynhun ki puit kiba dem ha ka kynroh ha sngi ka kaba khriat . Hynrei haba ka sngi ka mih , ki her noh , bad ym don mano mano shano batip ki la noh jah !
translation.en: Thy crowned are as the locusts , and thy captains as the great grasshoppers , which camp in the hedges in the cold day , but when the sun ariseth they flee away , and their place is not known where they are .

translation.kha: Phin ïoh shong slem ruh ha kata ka ri kaba da ka dud bad ngap kaba U Trai u ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .
translation.en: And that ye may prolong your days in the land , which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed , a land that floweth with milk and honey .

translation.kha: ki dei da shisha bad lada ki don ïa ka khubor nga , shah ïa ki ban kylli nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , ban ïa ki jingkynshew kiba don ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem ban shah rah sha Babilonia .
translation.en: But if they be prophets , and if the word of the  Lord  be with them , let them now make intercession to the  Lord  of hosts , that the vessels which are left in the house of the  Lord  , and in the house of the king of Judah , and at Jerusalem , go not to Babylon .

translation.kha: Nangta kaba kmen ki kyntiew ïa u ha ka lieng , bad kumta hi ka lieng ka poi ha ryngkew ha ka jaka sha kaba thmu .
translation.en: Then they willingly received him into the ship : and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went .

translation.kha: U marbud ïajah mih na ka ïingsyiem , ha ki jingisynei syiem kiba jngum rong bad balieh , jinglanot barandi linen ba sawbthuh bad ka pansngiat ksiar ba-itynnat . Nangta ki lynti bah ka Bethemek ki sawa da ki jingpyrta ïaroh jong ka jingkmen .
translation.en: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white , and with a great crown of gold , and with a garment of fine linen and purple : and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad .
And the light shineth in darkness  ; and the darkness comprehended it not .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ka shai ha kaba dum , bad ka jingdum kam lah ban pynlip ïa ka .

translation.en: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives , which is before Jerusalem on the east , and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west , and there shall be a very great valley  ; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north , and half of it toward the south .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por un ïeng halor u lum Olib , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jerusalem . Te ïa u lum Olib yn sa kad arliang na mihngi sha sepngi da ka them kaba khraw . Shiteng jong u lumbah un kynriah shaphang shatei bad shiteng jong u shaphang shathie .

translation.en: Let all the nations be gathered together , and let the people be assembled : who among them can declare this , and shew us former things ? let them bring forth their witnesses , that they may be justified : or let them hear , and say , It is truth .
translation.kha: Khot hajir ïa ki jaitbynriew ban wan sha ka jingbishar . Kino na ki blei jong ki kiba lah ban ïathuhlypa ïa ka lawei ? Kino na ki kiba la ong lypa kaei ka ban jia mynta ? Ai ba kine ki blei kin wanrah ïa ki sakhi jong ki ban pynshisha ba ki long kiba dei , ban phla ïa ka jingshisha jong ki ktien jong ki .

translation.en: And I will multiply men upon you , all the house of Israel , even all of it : and the cities shall be inhabited , and the wastes shall be builded :
translation.kha: Ngan pynroi ïa ka jingbun briew jong phi . Phin sa shong ha ki nongbah bad tei pat ïa baroh kaba sah ha ka jingjot .

translation.en: Yet hath he not root in himself , but dureth for a while : for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word , by and by he is offended .
translation.kha: Hynrei kam shym ngam jylliew hapoh jong ki , bad kim shym neh slem . Kumta haba ka jingjynjar lane ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ ka wan namar ka khubor , ki iehnoh shisyndon .
To map ïa ngi ki jingpalat kiba ngi kumba ngi map ïa ki kiba kiwei ki leh ngi .
translation.en: And forgive us our debts , as we forgive our debtors .
They have corrupted themselves , their spot is not the spot of his children : they are a perverse and crooked generation .
translation.kha: Pynban phi , phi long kiba ïaid kdor , ki bym dei hok ban long ki briew jong u , ka jaitbynriew kaba pop bad kaba shukor .

translation.en: I called upon thy name , O  Lord  , out of the low dungeon .
translation.kha: Na trai jong ka thliew , Ko  Trai  , nga la kyang jam sha me ,

translation.en: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes  ; that I be not ashamed .
translation.kha: Ai ba ngan kohnguh janai ïa ki hukum jong me , ba ngan lait na ka jinglehrain ka jingshahjop .
U Hanokh ‘ u blei jong kane ka pynshongkurim .’—2 Korinth 4 :4 .
translation.en: He is ‘ the god of this world .’—2 Corinthians 4 :4 .

translation.kha: Hynrei ai ngin ïasyllok shuwa bad U bashalor .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel , Enquire , I pray thee , at the word of the  Lord  to day .

translation.kha: Lada u ïalam ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar ïa phi na ka sopti-poh jong phi , ai ha u ïa ka jaiñkup jynsur ruh .
translation.en: And if any man will sue thee at the law , and take away thy coat , let him have thy cloak also .
My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments , which I have loved  ; and I will meditate in thy statutes .
translation.kha: Nga burom bad nga ieit ïa ki hukum jong me ; ngan puson ïa ki jingbthah jong me .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against the shepherds  ; and I will require my flock at their hand , and cause them to cease from feeding the flock  ; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more  ; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth , that they may not be meat for them .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga pynbna ba nga long u nongshun jong phi . Ngan shim noh ïa ki langbrot jong nga na phi , bad ngan ym shah shuh ba phin long ki nongsharai jong ki ; ngan ym shah shuh ba phin sumar bha tang ïa lade . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki langbrot jong nga na phi bad ngan ym shah ba phin bam ïa ki .
To shim bynta lem ha ka jingshah shitom , kum shipai baïaineh jong U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: Thou therefore endure hardness , as a good soldier of Jesus Christ .
There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .
translation.kha: Ym don jingpynrem shuh mynta na ka bynta kito kiba im ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin  ; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah .
translation.kha: Ki leit ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki shipai Benjamin , bad ki pynïeng ïa ki shipai marpyrshah kata ka nongbah .

translation.en: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home .
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la leit phai sha ïing .

Ka jingpyrta ka la kham jam , bad katto katne jingïarap batista sahnarphna nonghikai ka duwan kiba jingshngain ki jong ka shukor jingpynwandur Pharisi Shadkmen la ïeng bad ki la pyrshah jur : Ngim shem kano kano kaba bakla bad une pdot briew ! Lehse u mynsiem lane u angel u la kren shisha ha jingbatai aiwai
translation.en: And there arose a great cry : and the scribes that were of the Pharisees  part arose , and strove , saying , We find no evil in this man : but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him , let us not fight against God .
And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother , and was gone to Paddan–aram  ;
translation.kha: U la shem ba u Jakob u la kohnguh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad u la leit sha Mesopotamia .

translation.en: Then shall ye call upon me , and ye shall go and pray unto me , and I will hearken unto you .
translation.kha: Nangta phin khot kyrpad ïa nga . Phin wan bad duwai ha nga , bad ngan jubab ïa phi .

translation.en: Hath walked in my statutes , and hath kept my judgments , to deal truly  ; he is just , he shall surely live , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Uba kum une u briew u kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga bad u sumar biang biang ïa ki aiñ jong nga . U long uba hok , bad un im ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
bad uta u samla ruh um shym la pynslem ban leh ïa kata la ai jingmut , namar ba u la eh ïa khun jong Jakob . U ruh uba donburom tam na ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem u baroh .
translation.en: And the young man deferred not to do the thing , because he had delight in Jacob s daughter : and he was more honourable than all the house of his father .
For if I pray in an unknown tongue , my spirit prayeth , but my understanding is unfruitful .
translation.kha: Naba lada nga duwai ha kane ka rukom , ka mynsiem jong nga ka duwai da shisha , hynrei ka jingmut jong nga kam don bynta ha ka .

translation.en: So all the service of the  Lord  was prepared the same day , to keep the passover , and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the  Lord  , according to the commandment of king Josiah .
translation.kha: Te , kumba u syiem Josaïah u la hukum , la leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kata ka sngi ban mane ïa U  Trai  , ban sumar ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , bad ïa ka jingai ïa ki jingainguh thang ha ka duwan .
Phi don ki khmat — hato phim jingpynshong ban ïohi ? Phi don ki thikna — hato phim lah pyntlot ïohsngew ?
translation.en: Having eyes , see ye not ? and having ears , hear ye not ? and do ye not remember ?
With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets : he shall slay thy people by the sword , and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground .
translation.kha: Ki nongshong kulai kin tur lyngba ki lynti bah jong pha , da kaba pynïap ïa ki briew da ki waitlam jong ki . Ki rishot bakhraw jong pha kin hap ha khyndew .

U la leit sha u , la u theh umphniang bad ka ha waiñ ki jingmong jong u bad u la spaiñ ïa ki ; u nangta la buh ïa uta u briew halor u jingri jong u bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïingbasa , ha kaba u sumar la ïa u .
translation.en: And went to him , and bound up his wounds , pouring in oil and wine , and set him on his own beast , and brought him to an inn , and took care of him .
Ah Lord  God  ! behold , thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm , and there is nothing too hard for thee :
translation.kha: A  Trai  Nongsynshar , me la thaw ïa ka khyndew bad ka suiñbneng da ka bor bad ka borbah bakhraw ; ym don kaba eh than ïa me .
Ka kaba ka long ka bad jingkmen jong tnga jong ka ; hynrei ka tnga kaba ïa u tnga ka long kum ka jingpang bampong ïa ki shyieng jong u .
translation.en: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband : but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones .

translation.kha: Sumar Mei’ lehhok ïa ki hukum baroh ba ïalong la ai ha phi : Ieit ïa Sis Trai U Blei jong phi , leh ïa kata baroh kaba u hukum , Phah ïaineh ha u .
translation.en: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you , to do them , to love the  Lord  your God , to walk in all his ways , and to cleave unto him  ;
But forasmuch as he had not to pay , his lord commanded him to be sold , and his wife , and children , and all that he had , and payment to be made .
translation.kha: U shakri um shym don shibun ban siew ïa ka ram jong u , kumta u syiem u la hukum ba ïa uta dei ban die mraw noh , ïa ka tnga bad ki khun jong u bad baroh kiba u la don khnang ban siew ïa ka ram .

translation.en: And Abram fell on his face : and God talked with him , saying ,
translation.kha: U Abram u dem ngon haduh khyndew ; bad U Blei u ong ,
Ha kajuh ka rukom u Lebi ruh u la wan ïaid , u la ïaid nalor bad u khmih la ïa uta u briew , nangta bad u la ïaid lait , na kawei ka liang .
translation.en: And likewise a Levite , when he was at the place , came and looked on him , and passed by on the other side .
Give ye ear , and hear my voice  ; hearken , and hear my speech .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba nga ong ha phi .

translation.en: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes , and gave thanks , and brake them , and gave to his disciples , and the disciples to the multitude .
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu bad ki dohkha , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u la kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki synran ; bad ki synran ki la ai ïa ki ha u paidbah .
Kumta u Moses u rah ïa u diengduh shajrong bad U Trai u phah ïa u ïa u phria bad ka leilieh ruh ka la tied ïa ka khyndew . U Trai u phah ïa u uba jur lem bad ka leilieh kaba thaba .
translation.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven : and the  Lord  sent thunder and hail , and the fire ran along upon the ground  ; and the  Lord  rained hail upon the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Ho-oid shisha , u Petros u la jubab Haba . u Petros u la rung shapoh ïing , U Jisu u la kren nyngkong , Ko Simon , kaei ka jingpyrkhat me jong ? Mano ba siew ki ïa bai khrong ki lane khajna sha ki syiem jong kane ka pyrthei ? Ki traishnong jong ka ri ne ki nongwei ?
translation.en: He saith , Yes . And when he was come into the house , Jesus prevented him , saying ,  What thinkest thou , Simon ? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute ? of their own children , or of strangers ?
And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .
U Dabid u jubab ioh Nga dei uei keiñ bad pynbatai Mibsan longïing jong nga ba ngan ïoh long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem ?
translation.en: And David said unto Saul , Who am I ? and what is my life , or my father s family in Israel , that I should be son in law to the king ?
Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession , unto the praise of his glory .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u long ka jingbahkhlieh ba ngin sa ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular ha ki briew jong u , bad kane ka pynthikna ïa ngi ba U Blei un ai ka jinglaitluid kaba pura ha kito kiba long ki jong u . To ngin ïaroh ïa ka burom jong u!

translation.en: And Enoch lived sixty and five years , and begat Methuselah :
translation.kha: Haba u Enokh u la dap hynriewphew san snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Methuselah .
Lada Hasshub ieit ïa la Mosah Ïohi Annas ksuid krad na ki jingriam kaba artatien ïa u bymman ha ka lynti ïaid pynsyrwa
translation.en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward : he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them .
Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them .
translation.kha: Kumta te , phin ithuh ïa ki nongïathuhlypa balamler da kaei kaba ki leh .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , when Sanballat , and Tobiah , and Geshem the Arabian , and the rest of our enemies , heard that I had builded the wall , and that there was no breach left therein  ; ( though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates  ; )
translation.kha: U Sanballat , u Tobiah , u Geshem bad kiba sah na ki nongshun jong ngi , ki la ïohsngew ba ngi la lah pyndep ïa ka jingtei ïa ka kynroh bad ba ym don shuh ki jinglait thliew ha ka , wat la ngim pat shym la pynïeng ki khyrdop ha ki jaka ban shna ïa ki .
Ïa ki la pyndap da ki jingkwah bymdei ha ka ri shyiap jingshahthngan tynjuh ïa U Blei ;
translation.en: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness , and tempted God in the desert .
Moreover the  Lord  spake again unto Ahaz , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah sa kawei pat ka khubor sha u Ahas :

translation.en: Some also there were that said , We have mortgaged our lands , vineyards , and houses , that we might buy corn , because of the dearth .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki ong ,  Ngi la bynda ïa ki pynthor bad ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki ïing jong ngi ban ïoh kew uba biang ban lait na ka jingshahthngan .
Ki la phai stet hynrei kim shym la ïano ïano pat tang U Jisu u la don bad ki .
translation.en: And suddenly , when they had looked round about , they saw no man any more , save Jesus only with themselves .

translation.kha: Ki la tep tyrkhong u Nimrim ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid kum ka dak ka jingñiewkor ïa ka tyngkong kaba u la leh pahara Nangno bynta ki paid Jehoïakim , na Lymda bynta U Blei sngewlwait na jingkhlem-akor bymhok ka Templ Hoham
translation.en: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings , because he had done good in Israel , both toward God , and toward his house .

translation.kha: Pha ong , ‘ Nga long kaba riewspah bad kaba dap babiang ; nga don baroh kaba nga .’ donkam Hynrei tip pham haduh katno pha long kaba lanot bad kaba ban isynei khmih ! Pha long kaba duk , kaba lyngkhuit , bad kaba matlah .
translation.en: Because thou sayest , I am rich , and increased with goods , and have need of nothing  ; and knowest not that thou art wretched , and miserable , and poor , and blind , and naked :

Saul also sent messengers unto David s house , to watch him , and to slay him in the morning : and Michal David s wife told him , saying , If thou save not thy life to night , to morrow thou shalt be slain .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka miet u Saul u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban khmih siar ïa ka ïing u Dabid bad ban pynïap ïa u ha ka step kaba bud . Ka Mikhal , ka tnga u Dabid , ka maham ïa u ,  Lada phim phet mynta ka miet , lashai ka sngi phin long uba la ïap noh .
