And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father , and said unto him , Let not the king sin against his servant , against David  ; because he hath not sinned against thee , and because his works have been to thee-ward very good :
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ïaroh ïa u Dabid ha u Saul bad u ong ,  Pa kynrad , wat leh bymdei ïa u shakri jong phi u Dabid . Um pat ju leh palat ïa phi ; ha kawei ka liang , kat kaba u la leh ka la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa phi .

translation.en: Say unto the king and to the queen , Humble yourselves , sit down : for your principalities shall come down , even the crown of your glory .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  To ïathuh ïa u syiem bad ïa ka kmie jong u ban wan hiar na ki khet jong ki , namar ba ki pansngiat ba-itynnat jong ki , ki la hap noh na ki khlieh jong ki .

translation.en: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned , and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah .
translation.kha: Haba ki koidi jong u Ishmael ki la ïohi ïa u Johanan bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki shipai lem bad u , ki la kmen , bad phai bad mareh sha ki .
Lym kumta baroh ïalamwir tip ba phi long u bym lah ban set ïa kiei Peleg kiba rieh bad phin ym lah ban Hukkok ïakynton kane ka jinglehrain .
translation.en: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame , and thine infamy turn not away .

translation.kha: Ki la klet ïa U Blei uba la im pyllait ïa ki da ki kam badonbor jong u ha Ijipt .
translation.en: They forgat God their saviour , which had done great things in Egypt  ;
Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour , as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal .
translation.kha: Ki pyrkhat ba ki jingphohsniew ba ki ïathuh kin pynlong ïa ki briew jong nga ban klet ïa nga , kumba ki kpa jong ki , ki la klet ïa nga bad phai sha u Baal .

U Trai u ong , Nga la pynduh lut ki jaitbynriew baroh ; nga la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong bad iehnoh ïa ki kynroh bad ïa ki kut jong ha ki jingjot . Ki nongbah ki la shah iehnoh ; ki lynti bah ki thylli shym pynsah uwei ruh
translation.en: I have cut off the nations : their towers are desolate  ; I made their streets waste , that none passeth by : their cities are destroyed , so that there is no man , that there is none inhabitant .

translation.kha: La katne ngut ki Jiw kiba phi la buh ban khmih ïa ka probins jong ka — u , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego — ki bym shym kohnguh ïa ki hukum u Syiem . Kim shym mane ïa blei jong phi lane ngon sha ka durbriew kaba phi la phah .
translation.en: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego  ; these men , O king , have not regarded thee : they serve not thy gods , nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up .
But sought to the  Lord  God of his father , and walked in his commandments , and not after the doings of Israel .
translation.kha: U shakri ïa U Blei jong u kpa jong u , u kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Blei , bad um shym leh ha ka rukom ba ki syiem Israel ki la leh .

translation.en: Which when the apostles , Barnabas and Paul , heard of , they rent their clothes , and ran in among the people , crying out ,
translation.kha: Haba u Barnabas bad u Paul ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba kin sa leh , ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñphong bad ki la mareh sha pdeng u paidbah , da kaba pyrta ,

translation.en: And they shall spread them before the sun , and the moon , and all the host of heaven , whom they have loved , and whom they have served , and after whom they have walked , and whom they have sought , and whom they have worshipped : they shall not be gathered , nor be buried  ; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ban lumlang bad ban tep , ki shyieng jong ki kin long kum ka sboh kaba don ha madan . Yn pynphriang ïa ki shabar ha khmat ka sngi , u bnai , bad ki khlur , kiba kine ki briew ki ieit bad shakri , bad kiba ki la ïakylli bad mane .
Ïa Lusias apple rain U Ïoannis la shna da u shñiuh jong ka ut ; u la panpoh iw u panpoh snieh pynrkhiang ka syngkai jong synrang , bad ka jingbam jong u ka la long da ki puit bad ka ngap khlaw .
translation.en: And the same John had his raiment of camel s hair , and a leathern girdle about his loins  ; and his meat was locusts and wild honey .

translation.kha: Ki shipai samla kiba la ïalam ïa ka jingtur , ïaleh ïa kiba la bud da ka kynhun shipai Israel ,
translation.en: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city , and the army which followed them .

translation.kha: Ki bymman ki sarong bad pynshitom beiñ ïa kiba ïawer jingkha Shithi pynwit ñiewkor ha ki jingriam kiba ki la thaw .
translation.en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor : let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined .

And he that was over the house , and he that was over the city , the elders also , and the bringers up of the children , sent to Jehu , saying , We are thy servants , and will do all that thou shalt bid us  ; we will not make any king : do thou that which is good in thine eyes .
translation.kha: Kumta u rangbah uba peit ïa ka ïingsyiem bad u rangbah synshar uba dei peit ïa ka nongbah , ryngkat bad ki riewpawkhmat bad ki nongsumar , ki la phah ïa kane ka khubor sha u Jehu :  Ngi long ki shakri jong phi bad ngi long kiba la kloi ban leh kat ïa kaba phi ong ; hynrei ngin ym thung syiem ïano ïano ; leh katba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam .
La ïathuh ha u Abimelekh ba Jehubbah la ïalum hangta ,
translation.en: And it was told Abimelech , that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together .

translation.kha: Iehnoh ïa ka kynhun ki briew kiba bieit , bad men ïoh im . Ïaid ha ruh ka lynti ka jingtip .
translation.en: Forsake the foolish , and live  ; and go in the way of understanding .

translation.kha: ba ki samla kynthei kin leit saw sngi man la ka snem ban ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka khun u Jephthah nong u Gilead .
translation.en: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year .
That saith , I will build me a wide house and large chambers , and cutteth him out windows  ; and it is ceiled with cedar , and painted with vermilion .
translation.kha: Kordit ïa u briew uba ong ,  Ngan tei ïa lade ka ïing paki dulan bad ki kamra kiba kylluid shajrong ki mala .  Kumta u buh ki jingkhangïit ha ka ïing jong u , bad u shna biar da ki dieng Kedar , bad u airong ïa ka da ka rong saw .

translation.en: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants , and to eat and drink with the drunken  ;
translation.kha: bad un sdang ban shoh ïa la ki para shakri bad ban ïabam ïadih bad ki nongbuaid .

Trai U u la kren ha nga hadien ba u Nebusaradan , u rangbah shipai , u la lah pyllait ïa nga ha Ramah . Ïa nga la leit ïalam shata ha ki kynjri , ryngkat bad baroh kiwei pat ki briew na Jerusalem bad Judah ïa la kiba leit ïalam kum ki koidi sha Babilonia .
translation.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , after that Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah , when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah , which were carried away captive unto Babylon .
Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God , and be more ready to hear , than to give the sacrifice of fools : for they consider not that they do evil .
translation.kha: Da sumar shaphang kaba leit sha ka Templ . Ka kham bha ban leit hangta ban ïoh jinghikai ban ïa kaba ai jingkñia kum ki briew ba-bieit ki bymtip ïa kaba dei na kaba bakla .

Ko parabangeit jong nga , lada uwei na phi u ïaid sakma na ka jingshisha bad uwei u pat pynphai pat ïa u , to kynmaw ïa kane : uno Uno uba pynphai pat ïa u nongpop na ka lynti kaba bakla un pynim ka ïa mynsiem jong uta u nongpop ka na jingïap bad yn map ïa ki pop kiba bun byllien jong u .
translation.en: Let him know , that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death , and shall hide a multitude of sins .

translation.kha: Ki jingkwah u briew ki long kum ka kiba ïap — Ka don borabor ka jingkwah shuh shuh .
translation.en: Hell and destruction are never full  ; so the eyes of man are never satisfied .

translation.kha: Lada uno uba ïohsngew ïa ka hynrei um suidñiew , u nongshun wan bad pynïap ïa u , te un pop hi la ka jong .
translation.en: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet , and taketh not warning  ; if the sword come , and take him away , his blood shall be upon his own head .
Yes , God will call false religion to account for all the despicable acts she has committed in his name .
translation.kha: Haoid , u Blei un sa khot ia ka niam ba bakla ban ai jingkhein halor ki kam niewbein kiba ka la leh ha ka kyrteng jong u .
Dei namar kata , nga mareh beit sha ka thong ; dei namar kata balei ba long nga kum nongïakura u bym ïa pynlehnoh-ei ka jingkura jong u .
translation.en: I therefore so run , not as uncertainly ; so fight I , not as one that beateth the air :

translation.kha: Ka jingim briew ka long kum ka jingshakri u shipai ba shu , pynbor kum ka jingim u nongbylla sngi uba hap ban trei shitom ,
translation.en: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth ? are not his days also like the days of an hireling ?

Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter s clay : for shall the work say of him that made it , He made me not ? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it , He had no understanding ?
translation.kha: Ki pynkylla khongpong ïa kiei kiei baroh . Kano kaba kham donkam , u nongthaw khiew ne ka dewbyrtha ? Hato lah mo ba kaei kaei kaba u briew u la thaw kan ong ha u ,  Phim shym la thaw ïa nga ?  Lane hato ka lah ban ong ha u ,  Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phi leh ?

Um long kum kiwei pat ki lyngdoh rangbah ; um donkam da ban da ai jingkñia man ka sngi na ka bynta ki pop jong u hi nyngkong ïa lade bad na nangta ka bynta ki pop jong ki briew U . ai kawei ka jingkñia , tang shisien hi , haba u la kñia noh ïa lade .
translation.en: Who needeth not daily , as those high priests , to offer up sacrifice , first for his own sins , and then for the people s : for this he did once , when he offered up himself .

translation.kha: U u Jisu la jubab ïa u , Ko paralok jong nga , mano ba la ai ha nga ka bor bishar ban lane ban pynbynta ïa ka jingdon jingem hapdeng jong phi ar ngut ?
translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Man , who made me a judge or a divider over you ?
Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely mine oath that he hath despised , and my covenant that he hath broken , even it will I recompense upon his own head .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ngan pynshitom ïa u na ka bynta ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka jingïateh lok kaba u la smai ha ka kyrteng jong nga ban bat .
Ki la jubab ïa u Joshua , Ngin leh ïa kaei kaei nongsakhi kaba me la ong ïa ngi bad ngin leit kat shaba me phah ïa ngi .
translation.en: And they answered Joshua , saying , All that thou commandest us we will do , and whithersoever thou sendest us , we will go .
And his disciples asked him , saying , What might this parable be ?
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u ki la kylli ïa U Jisu aïu kane ka pharshi ka kit jingmut ,

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that a great tumult from the  Lord  shall be among them  ; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour , and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ki ba kin shaïong jingmut bad sheptieng haduh katta ba uwei uwei baroh un kem ïa u briew hajan jong u bad tur ïaleh ïa u .

translation.en: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous , but grievous : nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby .
translation.kha: Haba la sneng sympat ïa ngi , ngi ju pyrkhat ha kata ka por ïa kaei kaei kaba pynsngewsih ïa ngi , bad ym kaba pynkmen ïa ngi . Pynban hadien , kito kiba shah pynbeit da kita ki rukom sneng sympat ki ïoh ot ïa ka bainong kaba ai jingsuk jong ka jingim bahok .

translation.en: The valley gate repaired Hanun , and the inhabitants of Zanoah  ; they built it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof , and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate .
translation.kha: U Hanun bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah Sanoah , ki tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Them . Ki pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ïa ki jingkhang ka khyrdop , bad ki shna pynbha ïa ka kynroh kaba sawspah sawphew mitar , haduh ka Khyrdop Synrum .

translation.en: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering , and one ram for a burnt offering .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki dei ban ai ïa u Aaron ar tylli ki  langsohmoh ban pynlong ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad uwei u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingkñia thang .
Ha kawei ka sngi u Saul u don ha Gibeah , u da shong trai ha u dieng Tamarisk halor lum u , lem bad la u sum ha ka kti , bad baroh ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u don ki sawdong jong u .
translation.en: When Saul heard that David was discovered , and the men that were with him , ( now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah , having his spear in his hand , and all his servants were standing about him  ; )

translation.kha: Kumta te kumba kawei ka pop la ïa u bynriew baroh , ha ka rukom kawei ka kam bahok pyllait bad ka ai jingim ïa u bynriew baroh .
translation.en: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation ; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life .

translation.kha: Man ka sngi na ka bynta hynñiew sngi men ai u langsohmoh , u masi kyrtong , shibit Tahash langbrot kum lyng-a jingkñia na Enshemesh Ïingjaiñ kumta Hirah . Baroh batuid dei ban long khlem kino kino ki jingduna .
translation.en: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering : they shall also prepare a young bullock , and a ram out of the flock , without blemish .

translation.kha: Nangta , ban pyn-i nuksa ïa ka jingshah kerkut , buh ki kharai ki , kynton khyndew , ki jaka sher dara bad ki tiar pynpait baroh kynroh sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And lay siege against it , and build a fort against it , and cast a mount against it  ; set the camp also against it , and set battering rams against it round about .
Yea , I will rejoice over them to do them good , and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul .
translation.kha: Ngan sngewbha ha kaba leh kiei kiei kiba bha na ka bynta jong ki , bad ngan buh pynskhem junom ïa ki ha kane ka ri .
Haba u u la , u briew u ban ot ïa u da ka rashi , namar ka aïom ka la poi .
translation.en: But when the fruit is brought forth , immediately he putteth in the sickle , because the harvest is come .
As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant , who is for you a faithful minister of Christ ;
translation.kha: Phi la ïoh tip ïa ka jingaiei jong U Blei na u Epaphras , u para shakri ba-ieit jong ngi , uba long u nongtrei baïaineh jong U Khrist na ka bynta jong ngi .
Haba u briew uba hok u sangeh ban leh ïa la bha bad u sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew bad hadien kata sngewjahburom ïap , u ïap namar ka jingsniew kaba u la Ishbi .
translation.en: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , and dieth in them  ; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die .

translation.kha: Bad khlem da ïa pynpaw kiwei pat kiei kiei , ka man sngi la ban ïa nga da ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta ki balang baroh .
translation.en: Beside those things that are without , that which cometh upon me daily , the care of all the churches .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam Hanokh uta u paidlang kin buh ïa jingkren ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u Mikhael te kin jingtyllun ïa u hangta liam
translation.en: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the  Lord  : and the bullock shall be killed before the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la ïohi ba pha leh ïa kiei kiei kiba u isih shongkhia U la ïohi ba pha bud ïa ki blei Abimael halor ki lum bad kynruh lyngkha , kum Bel jingpynskhem uba threw Lamekh ïa ka tnga iohsngew paramarjan Jingpynïasuk dkut lane jongnga u kulai ïa kyrngah kulai jingïohnong Ko ki briew jong ka Jerusalem , phi long kiba la tim ! Lano phin ïoh long nongthoh khuid ?
translation.en: I have seen thine adulteries , and thy neighings , the lewdness of thy whoredom , and thine abominations on the hills in the fields . Woe unto thee , O Jerusalem ! wilt thou not be made clean ? when shall it once be ?

translation.kha: U la pynwan ïa ki shakri ban pynspong ka jaiñspong bakhuid halor ka khlieh jong u Joshua . Ki la leh kumta badonkam bad nangta ki la pynphong mynhynne jaiñ distrik ïa u katba u angel jong U Trai u dang ïeng hangta .
translation.en: And I said , Let them set a fair mitre upon his head . So they set a fair mitre upon his head , and clothed him with garments . And the angel of the  Lord  stood by .
Jesus sent his followers to search for meek people and to teach them how to become acceptable to God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phah ïa la ki synran ban wad ïa ki briew kiba sngewrit bad ban hikai ïa ki kumno ban long ki paralok jong U Blei .

translation.en: And another angel came and stood at the altar , having a golden censer  ; and there was given unto him much incense , that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u angel , uba bat ïa ka pliang thang jingiwbih kaba da ka ksiar , u la wan bad u la ïeng ha ka duwan . La ai ha u shikatdei ka jingiwbih ryngkat bad ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong U Blei baroh bad ban ai ïa ka halor ka duwan ksiar kaba ïeng ha khmat kata ka khet .
don kano kano ka jaitbynriew kaba kylla la ki blei , la kim dei kiba shisha . Hynrei briew jong nga ki la bujli ïa nga , Blei wanrah ha ki ka jingpyndonburom , ki blei ki lah ban leh ei ïa ki .
translation.en: Hath a nation changed their gods , which are yet no gods ? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit .

translation.kha: lem bad ka jingainguh bam kaba shi kilo u purew ba la lang khleh bad shi litar ka umphniang Olib kaba bha tam .
translation.en: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering , mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil .
And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against this land , to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book :
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa la ki briew bad u la pynngat ha ka ri jong ki ïa ki jingtim baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab .

translation.en: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow , of things in heaven , and things in earth , and things under the earth ;
translation.kha: Bad kumta , kum ka burom ïa ka kyrteng U Jisu baroh ki jingthaw ha bneng , ha pyrthei bad ha ka pyrthei hapoh kin dem khrup ha ki khohsiew jong ki ,
Mynta , A Trai U Blei ngi , pyllait ïa ngi na Assyria , kumta ba baroh ki ka pyrthei kin tip ba ma me hi me long U Blei .
translation.en: Now therefore , O  Lord  our God , save us from his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the  Lord  , even thou only .

translation.kha: Ka ianga peit .
translation.en: She looked at me .

translation.kha: Hynrei phi , ko parabangeit , to wat man thait ha kaba ïa kaba bha .
translation.en: But ye , brethren , be not weary in well doing .
And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi , ka lyer kaba jur ka la beh bad la pynkhih ïa ka um .
U jingphohsniew mar kumta hi u la pyrta , baphyrnai don ka jingngeit , hynrei kam da biang . To ïarap ïa nga ba ngan don shuh shuh !
translation.en: And straightway the father of the child cried out , and said with tears , Lord , I believe  ; help thou mine unbelief .

translation.kha: Long ba la phet ïa ka jingbitar jong ki , Naba ka Kyndit kaba ishyrkhei ; Bad long siat la tim ïa ka jingbitar Naei jong ki , Naba ka long kaba shyrkhei katta katta . Sakkuth ka ri Israel ngan pynsakma ïa ki , Bad hapdeng ki briew jong ka un-long Ïalap nym ki jingdeng
translation.en: Cursed be their anger , for it was fierce  ; and their wrath , for it was cruel : I will divide them in Jacob , and scatter them in Israel .

translation.kha: Kajuh kaei kaei TRAI’ jia ïa ka Babilon jingjaw ka duma jia ïa ka Sodom bad ba-atphyllung , haba nga la pynjot ïa ki bad ïa ki shnong kiba marjan . Yn ym shylluit ba shong Pyrshang hangta . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la jingsat .
translation.en: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof , saith the  Lord   ; so shall no man abide there , neither shall any son of man dwell therein .

translation.kha: U briew uba mutlop u long sniew uba bad u leh ïa ki kam kiba sniew ; u ïasylla ban pynsniew ïa kiba duk da ki jingshukor bad khanglad ban ki ïa ban ïoh ïa ki hok jong ki .
translation.en: The instruments also of the churl are evil : he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words , even when the needy speaketh right .
But Philip was found at Azotus : and passing through he preached in all the cities , till he came to Caesarea .
translation.kha: U Philip u shem ïa lade ha Asotos ; u la nang leit sha Kaisaria , bad ha lynti u la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong .

translation.en: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land : and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver , that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand .
translation.kha: U Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel , bad u Menahem u ai ïa u laiphew saw ton ka rupa ban ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong u ban nang pynkhlaiñbor ïa u Menahem halor ka ri .

ïarwai la dem pyllup ha ka khyndew , bad U Trai u la ong ïa nga , bunsien khun Remalaïah briew , shahshkor ïa kaei jingingiew baroh ba me ïohi bad ïohsngew . Ngan pynni ïa me ïa ki aiñ bad ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka Pithom ka saiwul . Khmih bha ïa kiba kumno ki briew Hasason shah ban leit shapoh bad mih shabar ka dondor bad nongkhmih kiba kumno ki briew ym shah .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Son of man , mark well , and behold with thine eyes , and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the  Lord  , and all the laws thereof  ; and mark well the entering in of the house , with every going forth of the sanctuary .

translation.kha: Ka la don ka ha kata ka jaka ha la pynïap ïa U Jisu , bad ha kata ka kper la don kaba ha ym pat shym la ïano ïano .
translation.en: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden  ; and in the garden a new sepulchre , wherein was never man yet laid .

translation.kha: Ki jingïasylla bymman kiba phi pynlong ki long kiba kum shyrkhei ki pylleng jong ki bseiñ kiba don bih Pynpait . ïa kata ka pylleng , un mih u bseiñ .
translation.en: They hatch cockatrice  eggs , and weave the spider s web : he that eateth of their eggs dieth , and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper .
And Michal Saul s daughter loved David : and they told Saul , and the thing pleased him .
translation.kha: Ka Mikhal ka khun u Saul pynban ka ïapmat ïa u Dabid , bad haba u Saul u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewbha .
Hynrei U Blei um la shym shah ïano ïano ban banbeiñ ïa ki ; ban ïada ïa ki , u la maham ïa ki syiem ;

translation.en: And we dreamed a dream in one night , I and he  ; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet , baroh ar ngut ngi la phohsniew mar la ka jingphohsniew kaba don la ka jong ka jong ka jingmut .

translation.en: Neither do men light a candle , and put it under a bushel , but on a candlestick  ; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba thang ïa ka sharak bad buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang ; hynrei u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , na kaba ka ai jingshai ïa baroh kiba hapoh ka ïing .
phi lah ban sngewskhem ba ka ka long kaba bha ïa ka mynsiem . To ïoh ïa bad ka lawei jong phi long phyrnai .
translation.en: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul : when thou hast found it , then there shall be a reward , and thy expectation shall not be cut off .
If I have seen any perish for want of clothing , or any poor without covering  ;
translation.kha: Haba nga shem ïa uno uno uba kyrduh , uba duk palat ban ïoh thied jaiñ thied nep ,

Hynrei lada u para jong uta uba la ïap um mon ban shongkurim ïa ka , ka dei ban leit ha khmat ki nongïalam shnong bad ban ong , ‘ para U kynsi jong nga um treh ban ïa pynneh ka kyrteng u hynmen jong u hapdeng ki Israel ; um ban mon pyndep ïa ka la kamram .’
translation.en: And if the man like not to take his brother s wife , then let his brother s wife go up to the gate unto the elders , and say , My husband s brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel , he will not perform the duty of my husband s brother .

translation.kha: Nga la pyn-i ka nuksa ïa phi , ba phin leh kumba nga la leh ma ïa nga phi .
translation.en: For I have given you an example , that ye should do as I have done to you .
But flesh with the life thereof , which is the blood thereof , shall ye not eat .
translation.kha: Kawei kaba phim dei ban bam ka long ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka ; nga khang pyrshah ïa kane namar ba ka jingim ka don ha ka snam .

Haba ki shakri kynthei sabakhthani ka Esther bad ki ïunukh ki ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaba u nongthawdur u leh , ka la shitom jingmut haduh katta katta . Ka stang sha bajur Mordekai Blei katne nongïambriew jaiñ ban phong ha ka basawbthuh ki jaiñ khain basngewlehrain hynrei um shym pdiang ïa ki .
translation.en: So Esther s maids and her chamberlains came and told it her . Then was the queen exceedingly grieved  ; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai , and to take away his sackcloth from him : but he received it not .

translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem kumba nga la ïa leh ka Samaria , kumba nga leh la ïa u Ahab u syiem ka bad Israel ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ngan pynkhuid phar ïa ka Jerusalem na ki briew jong kumba ka khuid ka pliang ba la ñiad bad pyndem pyllup ïa ka .
translation.en: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria , and the plummet of the house of Ahab : and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish , wiping it , and turning it upside down .

translation.kha: Elumas Kynriah ñiewbeiñ ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga baroh , bad phim mon ba ngan war to ïaduna .
translation.en: But ye have set at nought all my counsel , and would none of my reproof :

And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau  ; and they of the plain the Philistines : and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim , and the fields of Samaria : and Benjamin shall possess Gilead .
translation.kha: Ki briew na ka Judah bashathie kin ïoh ïa ka Edom ; kito kiba na ki kjat lum shaphang sepngi kin knieh ïa ka Philistia ; ki Israel kin ïoh ïa ka ri Ephraim bad Samaria ; ki briew jong ka Benjamin kin shim ïa ka Gilead .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that before they call , I will answer  ; and while they are yet speaking , I will hear .
translation.kha: Wat ha shuwa ba kin dep duwai ha nga , ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .
wan sha Jerikho , bad katba U Jisu u sdang ban mihnoh ryngkat ki synran u bad u babun , u nongkhrong uba matlah uba kyrteng u Bartimaïos , u jong u Timaïos , dang harud lynti .
translation.en: And they came to Jericho : and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people , blind Bartimaeus , the son of Timaeus , sat by the highway side begging .
Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !
translation.kha: Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingieit baneh jong u , na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood , standing up .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ki jingker ïa ka Ïingjaiñ da ka dieng akasia .

translation.en: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak , Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai , the children of Anak .
translation.kha: U Kaleb u beh krad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Anak na ka nongbah — ki kur Sheshai , Ahiman , bad Talmai .

Ïa pisa ka kaba ka kamai da ka jingkhaïi pateng , yn pynkyntang sha U Trai . Pynban kan ym buh tyngkai , hynrei kito kiba ïa mane U Trai , kin pyndonkam ïa ka pisa jong ka ban thied jingbam ki bad jaiñ ki nep kiba ki donkam .
translation.en: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the  Lord  : it shall not be treasured nor laid up  ; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the  Lord  , to eat sufficiently , and for durable clothing .

translation.kha: U la jubab , long u Jiw , uba la kha ha Tarsos ha , traishnong ka nongbah ba-donnam Sngewbha shah ïa nga ban u .
translation.en: But Paul said , I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus , a city in Cilicia , a citizen of no mean city : and , I beseech thee , suffer me to speak unto the people .

translation.kha: Te u syiem u la ai hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u ban ïawanlang — ki khun syiem shynrang , ki lat , ki lat kiba hapoh kham , ki kommisshonor , ki nongbat , tyngka ki nongbishar , ki majistor , bad kiwei pat ki synshar rangbah jong ki jylla . Ki la dei wan ban sha ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka durbriew kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la pynïeng phah .
translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes , the governors , and the captains , the judges , the treasurers , the counsellors , the sheriffs , and all the rulers of the provinces , to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .
And they went out , and preached that men should repent .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit bad ïalap ba ki briew kin phai noh na ki pop jong ki .

Kane ka pyndap ïa ngi da jingkyrmen , bad kumta ngi peit sha khmat ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingkyrkhu kyrhai kiba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta ki briew jong u . buh ïa ki ha bneng na ka bynta jong phi , kaba kim lah lane duh noh lane sep
translation.en: To an inheritance incorruptible , and undefiled , and that fadeth not away , reserved in heaven for you ,

translation.kha: Hadien shi taïew u khunlung u la ïap bad ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la sheptieng ban ïathuh ha ïa u ka khubor . Ki ong , Mynba khunlung i i dang im , u Dabid um ju jubab ïa ngi haba ngi kren ïa u . Kumno ngin lah ban ïathuh ïa u ba i khun jong u i la ? ïap U lah ban pynmynsaw ïa lade !
translation.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that the child died . And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead : for they said , Behold , while the child was yet alive , we spake unto him , and he would not hearken unto our voice : how will he then vex himself , if we tell him that the child is dead ?

translation.kha: U Asa u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Jehoshaphat Shiteng khun synrum u , u long syiem ha umkhriat jaka jong ksem .
translation.en: And Asa slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead .

And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel , and they shall build the waste cities , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and drink the wine thereof  ; they shall also make gardens , and eat the fruit of them .
translation.kha: Ngan wan ïalam pat ïa ki briew jong nga sha la ka ri . Kin sa tei pat ïa ki shnong ba la jot bad kin shong hangta ; kin thung ki bri sohwaiñ bad kin dih ïa ka waiñ ; kin thung jingthung ha ki kper , bad kin bam na kaei kaba mih .

translation.en: Behold , it is cast into the fire for fuel  ; the fire devoureth both the ends of it , and the midst of it is burned . Is it meet for any work ?
translation.kha: Ka bha tang ban thang ding . Haba ki tduh ki la ing lut khoit bad ba ka pdeng ka la kylla rnga , hato phi lah ban shna ei ei na ka ?

translation.en: Though they bring up their children , yet will I bereave them , that there shall not be a man left : yea , woe also to them when I depart from them !
translation.kha: Hynrei wat la ki ïoh pynheh pynsan ïa la ki khun , ngan shim noh ïa ki bad ngan ym pynsah im uwei ruh . Haba ngan iehnoh noh ïa kine ki briew , kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kin wan jia ha ki .

translation.en: And Saul said unto his uncle , He told us plainly that the asses were found . But of the matter of the kingdom , whereof Samuel spake , he told him not .
translation.kha: U ïathuh ïa ngi ba la lap ïa ki kada ,  u Saul u jubab — hynrei um shym ïathuh ha u kñi jong u ïa kaei kaba u Samuel u la kren shaphang ka jingpynlong Syiem ïa u .
ka jong , yn ym don u ban shong ban sah ha Babilon ; kan sah ka jingjot , baroh kiba ïaid nangta kin kyndit bad .
translation.en: Because of the wrath of the  Lord  it shall not be inhabited , but it shall be wholly desolate : every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished , and hiss at all her plagues .

translation.kha: U shim shi jur ki masi lur , sngewrit ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki Wai u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban leit rah ïa kita ki lyngkhot kylleng ka ri Israel arphew bad kane ka dustur : Kat pynap bym bud ïa u Saul bad u ïawan sha ka thma jingtian kumne yn leh pun ki masi lur jong u . Te ki paid Israel ki sheptieng her jingbuhrieh kaei ba un leh pdiang! Trai , jingker baroh khlem pjiah uwei ruh , ki Ken mih ryntih lang Lada pham
translation.en: And he took a yoke of oxen , and hewed them in pieces , and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers , saying , Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel , so shall it be done unto his oxen . And the fear of the  Lord  fell on the people , and they came out with one consent .
Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them  ; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath : their own way have I recompensed upon their heads , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Te ngan theh ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ha ki , bad kum ka ding ngan pynjot ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong .

translation.en: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel , save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon : all other they took in battle .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah kaba la ïasuk bad ki paid Israel ka dei ka Gibeon , ha kaba katto katne ki Hib ki shong . Baroh kiwei pat ki la shahjop ha ka thma .

translation.en: We know that we have passed from death unto life , because we love the brethren . He that loveth not his brother abideth in death .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ngi la iehnoh ïa ka jingïap bad ngi la wan noh sha ka jingim ; ngi tip ïa ka namar ba ngi ieit ïa la ki hynmen ki para . Uno uno u bym ieit , u dang don hi hapoh ka bor jong ka jingïap .
U kyntiew jali kiba sngewrit , hynrei u pynlwet ïa ki bymman ha ka khyndew .
translation.en: The  Lord  lifteth up the meek : he casteth the wicked down to the ground .
And the men of Judah said , Why are ye come up against us ? And they answered , To bind Samson are we come up , to do to him as he hath done to us .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah Judah ki kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi wan tur ïaleh ïa ngi ?  Ki jubab ,  Ngi wan ban kem koidi ïa u Samson bad ban leh ïa u kumba u la leh ïa ngi .
u Elishama , Eliada u , bad u Eliphelet .
translation.en: And Elishama , and Eliada , and Eliphelet .
( And the  Lord  gave Israel a saviour , so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians : and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents , as beforetime .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ha ki Israel ïa u nongïalam , uba pyllaitluid ïa ki na ki Syria , bad kumta ki Israel ki im ha ka jingsuk , kumba mynshuwa .

translation.en: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field , and as plantings of a vineyard : and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley , and I will discover the foundations thereof .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pynlong ïa ka Samaria ka kynton ñiut ha rudnong , ka jaka ban thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ . Ngan theh noh ïa ka jakhlia jong ka nongbah sha ka jaka them , bad ngan pynpaw shabar tang ïa ki maw nongrim jong ka nongbah .
Ka ri ïasah long kaba shah ieh jingktah tam ha ka pyrthei , bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka yn ieh kumto ha ki jingjot .
translation.en: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate , and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted .

translation.kha: Katba kane ka dang long kumne , ngam shym la don ha Jerusalem , namar ha ka snem kaba laiphew ar ba u Artakserksis u long u syiem Babilon ka , nga dei la ban leit phai ban ai jingtip sha u . katto Hadien katne por , nga la ïoh jingbit
translation.en: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem : for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king , and after certain days obtained I leave of the king :

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ai ha nga ïa ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba u la thoh da la ka kti ïa kata kaba u la kren ha phi napdeng ka ding ha kato ka phi sngi ba ha ïalumlang uta u lum .
translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God  ; and on them was written according to all the words , which the  Lord  spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly .

translation.kha: Me dei balyngkot ban shiah khyndiat Nethanel um , ar khuri shi sngi .
translation.en: Thou shalt drink also water by measure , the sixth part of an hin : from time to time shalt thou drink .
And it came to pass after this , that the king of the children of Ammon died , and Hanun his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , u Nahash u syiem Ammon u la ïap , bad u Hanun , u khun jong u , u la long syiem .

translation.en: And the land was not able to bear them , that they might dwell together : for their substance was great , so that they could not dwell together .
translation.kha: Kumta ka jaka bam phlang kam biang ïa ki baroh ar ngut ban ïasah ryngkat , namar ba ki don shibun eh ki jingri .

jaiñjot phi leh shisha kumba nga la hukum katai te jingsiew khun ki ksiew u Dabid kin kyrsiew syiem . Bad ma ki , lem bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki bad ki briew jong ki , kin runar bteng ban ïaid lyngba ïa ki khyrdop jong kane ka ïingsyiem ha puta kali ïapom bad Marsena ki kulai .
translation.en: For if ye do this thing indeed , then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David , riding in chariots and on horses , he , and his servants , and his people .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïakynting sbai ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei , hynrei U Blei da hi lade u ai ïa ka jubab .
translation.en: The lot is cast into the lap  ; but the whole disposing thereof is of the  Lord .
And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed , and will make him afraid : and all the people that are with him shall flee  ; and I will smite the king only :
translation.kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa u katba u dang thait bad noh mynsiem . Un sa sheptieng ; bad ki rangbah jong u baroh kin phet krad . Ngan pynïap tang ïa u syiem ,

Hynrei Jahasiel Sngi jong U Trai kan wan kum u nongtuh . Ha kata ka Sngi , ki Ujuh kin Meremoth noh lem bad ka jingsawa kaba jam , ki metbneng kin ing duh borbah yn pynjot , bad kren-ïa pyrthei lem bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don kren ka kin jah rngai .
translation.en: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night  ; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise , and the elements shall melt with fervent heat , the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up .

translation.kha: Ngan pynrngad ïa ka wah Nile bad ngan jingringdur ïa ka Ijipt hapoh ka bor jong ki briew kiba sniew madan Ki nongwei kin pynjulor ïa ka ri baroh kawei . Ma nga , U Trai , nga Krit kren .
translation.en: And I will make the rivers dry , and sell the land into the hand of the wicked : and I will make the land waste , and all that is therein , by the hand of strangers : I the  Lord  have spoken it .
And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead : and calling unto him the centurion , he asked him whether he had been any while dead .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la sngewlyngngoh ban ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la lah ïap . U la khot ïa u rangbah shipai bad u la kylli ïa u la U Jisu u la lah ïap la slem .

translation.en: And David was the youngest : and the three eldest followed Saul .
translation.kha: U Dabid u dei u khun khatduh , bad katba ki lai ngut shi para kiba nyngkong ki sah bad u Saul ,

Ngan pynlong ïa ka jutang bymjukut bad ki . Ngan ym sangeh lano lano ruh leh ïa kiei kiei kiba na ka bynta ki , ngan pynlong ïa ki ban tiengburom ïa nga dohnud jong ki baroh , khnang ba kin ym phai dien shuh na nga .
translation.en: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them , that I will not turn away from them , to do them good  ; but I will put my fear in their hearts , that they shall not depart from me .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki beh krad ïa ki naduh ka khyrdop shnong haduh ki katto katne ki par bad ki jingbiria pynïap kumba laiphew Palmyra ngut tdong ka lynti sharum ki lumrit . Te ki Israel ki la duh ka jingshlur bad ki la sheptieng .
translation.en: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men : for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim , and smote them in the going down : wherefore the hearts of the people melted , and became as water .

And when he had found him , he brought him unto Antioch . And it came to pass , that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church , and taught much people . And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch .
translation.kha: Haba u la shem ïa u , u la ïalam ïa u sha Antiokh , bad baroh shisnem kine ar ngut ki la ïakynduh ïa ki briew ka balang bad ki la hikai ïa ka kynhun kaba heh . Ka la long ha Antiokh ba ïa ki parabangeit la khot nyngkong eh  Ki Khristan .
Shahshkor ! ong U Jisu . Nga wan kloi ! Suk kito kiba kohnguh ïa ki ïathuhlypa ktien kiba hapoh kane ka kitab !
translation.en: Behold , I come quickly : blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book .
Him would Paul have to go forth with him  ; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters : for they knew all that his father was a Greek .
translation.kha: U Paul u la kwah ban ïalam bad u ïa u Timothi , kumta u la otsher ïa u . U la leh kumta namar baroh ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha kita ki jaka ki tip ba u kpa jong u Timothi u long u Grik .

Haba u Dabid u la wan poi ha Mahanaim , u Shobi , u khun jong u Nahash , na ka shnong Rabbah kaba ha Ammon , u Makhir , u khun jong u Ammiel , Lodebar , bad u Barsillai na Rogelim kaba ha Gilead , ki la wan ïakynduh ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when David was come to Mahanaim , that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon , and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo–debar , and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim ,

translation.kha: Ynda ki pleng dep pyrthuh beiñ ïa u , ki la weng baryngkhiang ïa ka Pa’ Segub ki la pynphong ïasnoh ïa u da ki jaiñ jong u . riang ki la ïalam ïa u shabar kran sahnarphna ïa u .
translation.en: And after that they had mocked him , they took the robe off from him , and put his own raiment on him , and led him away to crucify him .
For it shall be , that on the day thou goest out , and passest over the brook Kidron , thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die : thy blood shall be upon thine own head .
translation.kha: Lada me tang shu mih bad leit sha shiliang ka wahduid Kidron , men ïap da shisha — bad me hi men shah kynnoh .

A Trai Nongsynshar , U Blei ki ! nga sngew ban duwai kane ka jingduwai ha me , namar me la pynpaw ïa kane baroh ha nga , u shakri jong me , bad ba la ong ha nga ba men pynlong syiem ïa khun ksiew jong
translation.en: For thou , O  Lord  of hosts , God of Israel , hast revealed to thy servant , saying , I will build thee an house : therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee .

Behold , I will command , saith the  Lord  , and cause them to return to this city  ; and they shall fight against it , and take it , and burn it with fire : and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ka hukum , bad kin wan biang sha kane ka nongbah . Kin tur ïaleh ïa ka , kin kurup ïa ka , bad thang duh ïa ka . Ngan pynlong ïa ki shnong ka Judah ba kin long kum ka ri shyiap ha kaba yn ym don mano mano ban shong ban sah ha ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

Trai U u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ki bad nongïathuhlypa ban ïa maham ki Israel bad Judah : Iehnoh noh ïa ki lynti kynriang bad kohnguh ïa ki jong hukum nga , ïa kiba la don ha ka Aiñ kaba nga la ai ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad kaba nga la aiti pateng ha phi lyngba ki shakri jong nga bad ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: Yet the  Lord  testified against Israel , and against Judah , by all the prophets , and by all the seers , saying , Turn ye from your evil ways , and keep my commandments and my statutes , according to all the law which I commanded your fathers , and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets .
Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread  ; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning .
translation.kha: Wat ainguh ha nga da u kpu ba la khleh thiat haba phi kñia ïa ka mrad ha nga . Ym bit ban ieh haduh mynstep ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad ba la kñia ha nga ha kine ki Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: For thy word s sake , and according to thine own heart , hast thou done all these great things , to make thy servant know them .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka mon jong me bad ka jingthmu jong me , ban leh ïa kane ; me la leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba khraw khnang ban hikai ïa nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  heard the voice of Elijah  ; and the soul of the child came into him again , and he revived .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ïa ka jingduwai u Elijah ; u khynnah u sdang ban ring mynsiem biang bad u la im pat .

translation.en: For all those things hath mine hand made , and all those things have been , saith the  Lord  : but to this man will I look , even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit , and trembleth at my word .
translation.kha: Ma nga hi nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei ! Nga shem sngewbha bad kito kiba sngewrit bad kiba kylla-kaba-mut , kiba sheptieng ïa nga bad kiba kohnguh ïa nga .
Ïa Ninebeh , ka nuti la nang pynshitom . Kaba khring bad kaba dap da ki jingpynshohbieit kiba ma , ka la ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ka la ringmraw ïa ki .

translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba u Moses um pat shym wan hiar na u lum hynrei u la sah slem hangta , ki la ïalumlang sawdong ïa u Aaron , bad ki la ong ha u ,  Ngim tip satia ka la jia aïu ïa une u Moses , uba la ïalam ïa ngi ban mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt ; kumta to thaw ïa ngi u blei u ban ïalam ïa ngi .

Hynrei hadien jemnud ki ïa-ong para ma ki , Ngim dei khrew leh kumne ! Ngi don tiew khubor babha , bad ngim dei ban buh ïa ka tang ha lade hi khlur Lada ngi ap haduh mynstep riewtymmen ïathuh ïa ka , ngi thikna ba ngin shah pynshitom . Ïa ngin ïaleit jingkordit shisyndon ban ïathuh ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem shlei
translation.en: Then they said one to another , We do not well : this day is a day of good tidings , and we hold our peace : if we tarry till the morning light , some mischief will come upon us : now therefore come , that we may go and tell the king s household .

Them did Moses the servant of the  Lord  and the children of Israel smite : and Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites , and the Gadites , and the half tribe of Manasseh .
translation.kha: Kine ki ar ngut ki syiem ki la shahjop ha u Moses bad ki paid Israel . U Moses , u shakri U  Trai  , u la ai ïa ka ri jong ki ha ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad , bad ha shiteng na ka jait Manasseh , ba kan long ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the  Lord  , in walking in the way of Jeroboam , and in his sin which he did , to make Israel to sin .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia namar ki pop jong u pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Kum u Jeroboam uba ha shuwa jong u , u la pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  da ki pop jong u hi bad da kaba ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: And all the people of Judah took Azariah , which was sixteen years old , and made him king instead of his father Amaziah .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah Judah te ki pynkup syiem ïa u khun jong u , u Ussaïah uba don khathynriew snem ka rta .
Haba ka la dei por ïa ka ban kha , la shem ba kan sa kha khun synrap .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the time of her travail , that , behold , twins were in her womb .

And when they were come , they say unto him , Master , we know that thou art true , and carest for no man : for thou regardest not the person of men , but teachest the way of God in truth : Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar , or not ?
translation.kha: Ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai , ngi tip ba me kren ïa ka jingshisha , khlem da khuslai ïa kaei kaba ki briew ki pyrkhat . Mem ñiew ïa ka kyrdan u briew , hynrei me hikai ïa ka jingshisha shaphang ka mon U Blei na ka bynta u briew . To ïathuh ïa ngi , hato ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ban siew ki khajna sha u Patsha ka Rom ? Hato ka dei ïa ngi ban siew ne ban ym siew ?

translation.en: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynïap briew ha kaba rieh .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
Haba ki apostol ki la ïalumlang bad U Jisu , ki la kylli ïa u , Ko Kynrad hato , ha kane ka men por ai pat ïa ka Hima ha ki Israel ?
translation.en: When they therefore were come together , they asked of him , saying , Lord , wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel ?
And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger , and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times :
translation.kha: Nangta u Eleasar un shim khyndiat na ka snam jong ka bad un synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien da la ka shynriah ti sha ka phang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
Nga la phai noh da ka jingbitar tang , hynrei ngan pyn-i ha pha ïa ka jingieit nga junom . ong U Trai uba pynim ïa pha .
translation.en: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment  ; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee , saith the  Lord  thy Redeemer .
And the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , saying , We have sinned against thee , both because we have forsaken our God , and also served Baalim .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki kyang jam ha U  Trai  , ki da ong ,  Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , namar ngi la iehnoh ïa me , U Blei jong ngi , bad ngi la mane ïa ki Baal .

Kumta , syiem kynrad , ai ka hukum ïa ngi bad ngin leit ïa wad u briew uba nang ban duitara tem . Te haba u mynsiem bymman u wan ha phi , uta u briew un tem ïa la ka duitara , bad phin sa shait sa koit . pat
translation.en: Let our lord now command thy servants , which are before thee , to seek out a man , who is a cunning player on an harp : and it shall come to pass , when the evil spirit from God is upon thee , that he shall play with his hand , and thou shalt be well .
The fear of the wicked , it shall come upon him : but the desire of the righteous shall be granted .
translation.kha: Kiba hok ki ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki thrang , hynrei ki riewbymman ki ïoh ïa kata kaba ki sheptieng eh .

translation.en: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain , Take up , and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite : for remember how that , when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father , the  Lord  laid this burden upon him  ;
translation.kha: bad u Jehu u ong ha u Bidkar , u nongbud jong u ,  Shim bret ïa ka met jong u ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Naboth . Phi kynmaw ba mynba ma phi bad ma nga ngi dang ïabud ha la ki kulai nadien u Ahab , u kpa jong u syiem Joram , U  Trai  u la kren ïa kine ki ktien pyrshah ïa u Ahab :

translation.en: And now , O Father , glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was .
translation.kha: Ko Pa ! To ai ka burom ïa nga ha khmat jong me mynta , kajuh ka burom kaba nga la don lem bad me ha shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: But one thing is needful : and Mary hath chosen that good part , which shall not be taken away from her .
translation.kha: hynrei , tang kawei kaba donkam . Ka Mari ka la jied ïa kaei kaba dei , bad yn ym shim noh ïa kata na ka .

translation.en: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart , that , as a man chasteneth his son , so the  Lord  thy God chasteneth thee .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba kumba u kpa u sneng pynbeit ïa la u khun , kumta ruh U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u sneng pynbeit ïa phi .
Hynrei U Jisu u la phai , u khmih la ïa ki synran jong u , bad u la sneng ïa u Petros . Khie noh na nga , u me Soitan , u la ong . Ki jong jingpyrkhat me kim shym wan na U Blei hynrei na u briew !
translation.en: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples , he rebuked Peter , saying ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : for thou savourest not the things that be of God , but the things that be of men .
And he cometh the third time , and saith unto them ,  Sleep on now , and take your rest : it is enough , the hour is come  ; behold , the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .
translation.kha: Haba u la wan pat ha ka sien kaba lai , u la ong ïa ki ,  Hato phi dang ïohthiah bad dang shongthait ? Ka la biang ! Ka kynta ka la poi ! Khmih , ïa U Khun U Briew yn ai noh mynta ha ka bor jong ki briew kiba pop .

translation.en: Who , when he was reviled , reviled not again  ; when he suffered , he threatened not  ; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously :
translation.kha: Haba la krenbeiñ ïa u , um shym pynphai ktien kylliang da kaba krenbeiñ ; haba u shahshitom , um shym la byrngem , hynrei u la buh ïa la ki jingkyrmen ha U Blei , u Nongbishar bahok .
Piram u Darius u shim noh ïa shim na nongtuh , bad u nguh u dem ïa u haduh madan .
translation.en: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees , and he bowed himself with his face to the earth .

And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Fear him not : for I have delivered him into thy hand , and all his people , and his land  ; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Wat sheptieng ïa u . Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong u , ïa ki briew jong u baroh , bad ïa ka ri jong u . Leh ïa u kumba me la leh ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Heshbon .

translation.en: And Jeremiah said , The word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga
hi ka pynhiar stet ïa u khiew um na la bad ka ong , ‘ To dih , bad um ruh ïa ki ut jong phi ba kin dih .’ Kumta nga dih bad ka la ai um ruh ïa ki ut .
translation.en: And she made haste , and let down her pitcher from her shoulder , and said , Drink , and I will give thy camels drink also : so I drank , and she made the camels drink also .

translation.kha: Me la ai ha ki ka jingkmen kaba khraw , ko Trai ; me la pynlong ïa ki ban kmen . Ki shadkmen ha kaei kaba me leh ki briew ki shadkmen haba ki ot kew lane haba ki ïabynta ïa spah ba la ïoh kurup .
translation.en: Thou hast multiplied the nation , and not increased the joy : they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest , and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil .
For as the new heavens and the new earth , which I will make , shall remain before me , saith the  Lord  , so shall your seed and your name remain .
translation.kha: Kumba ka khyndew bathymmai bad ki bneng kiba thymmai , kin ïaisah da ka bor jong nga , kumta ruh ki khun ki ksiew jong phi bad ka kyrteng jong phi kin ïaisah .
Ha U Khrist Jisu , la pynmihpat ïa ngi lem bad u , ba ngin ïoh synshar lem bad u ha Pamphylia pyrthei ba kynja bneng .
translation.en: And hath raised us up together , and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus :

translation.kha: Ki ki la leit pat ki rwai ki jingïaroh ïa Blei na baroh kaba ki la bad ïohi ; ka la long thik kumba angel u la ïathuh ha ki .
translation.en: And the shepherds returned , glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen , as it was told unto them .
Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Amon u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah

translation.en: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty , and playedst the harlot because of thy renown , and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by  ; his it was .
translation.kha: Hynrei pha shim kabu ïa ka jingbhabriew bad ka nam jong pha , ban ïathiah bad uno uno uba pha ïakynduh .

translation.en: They were a wall unto us both by night and day , all the while we were with them keeping the sheep .
translation.kha: Ki la ïada ïa ngi mynsngi bad mynmiet ha ka por baroh ba ngi don bad ki haba ngi sharai ïa la ki langbrot .

translation.en: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness , in that he did good , and gave us rain from heaven , and fruitful seasons , filling our hearts with food and gladness .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la ïai ai ka sakhi ïa ka jingdon jong u da kiei kiei kiba bha kiba u leh : U ai ha phi ïa u slap na sahit bneng bad ïa ki jingthung ha ki por babiang ; u ai ha phi ka jingbam bad u pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong phi da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children , and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , and when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jong phi . Ïai pynkynmaw ïa ki haba phi don ha ïing bad haba phi ïaid ha lynti , haba phi shongthait bad haba phi trei phi ktah .

translation.en: Now as he was speaking with me , I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground : but he touched me , and set me upright .

Uno kynsai uba wan sha jingjlan um lah ban long u synran jong nga lymda simpyllieng ieit ïa nga kham palat ban ïa kaba ― ieit ïa u Kappadokia bad ka kmie jong u , ïa ka shimet bad :20 khun jong u , ïa ki hynmen Malkhaïah para shynrang bad kynthei jong u , dujok ?’ niewbein pyngkiang .
translation.en: If any man come to me , and hate not his father , and mother , and wife , and children , and brethren , and sisters , yea , and his own life also , he cannot be my disciple .
And they called Rebekah , and said unto her , Wilt thou go with this man ? And she said , I will go .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la khot ïa ka Rebekka bad ki la kylli ,  Hato pha kwah ban leit bad une u briew ?   Ho-oid ,  ka jubab .

translation.en: And the  Lord  was with him  ; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth : and he rebelled against the king of Assyria , and served him not .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u long lem bad u , bad u long uba jop ha kiei kiei kiba u leh . U ïaleh pyrshah ïa u patsha ka Assyria bad u kyntait ban pyndem ha u .

translation.en: And there were many lights in the upper chamber , where they were gathered together .
translation.kha: La thang shibun ki sharak ha ka kamra ba haneng ha kaba ki la ïalang .
ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng jong ephod ba kin ïeng na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait . kane rukom u un kit ïa ki jong ha la ka tyrpeng khnang ba nga , U Trai ngan kynmaw ïa ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel : and Aaron shall bear their names before the  Lord  upon his two shoulders for a memorial .
But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will , and none shall stand before him : and he shall stand in the glorious land , which by his hand shall be consumed .
translation.kha: U nonghiarthma Syria un leh ïa ki kat kaba u sngewbha , khlem kano kano ka jingïapyrshah . Un ïeng ha ka Ri ka Jingkular bad un ïoh ïa ka baroh ha ka bor jong u .
Kumta u Solomon u mihnoh na ka jaka hynrei ha Gibeon bthat ha kaba don ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai , bad thawdur leit phai pat sha Jerusalem . Hangta u synshar ïa Nathan jingkutlad .
translation.en: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem , from before the tabernacle of the congregation , and reigned over Israel .

translation.kha: La don u briew uba kyrteng u Job , uba shong ba sah ha ka ri Us , uba ïa mane U Blei bad uba ïaineh ha u . U long u briew bha uba , uba kiar ban ym leh ïa kano kano kaba sniew .
translation.en: There was a man in the land of Uz , whose name was Job  ; and that man was perfect and upright , and one that feared God , and eschewed evil .
And he said unto his people , Behold , the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we :
translation.kha: Une u ong ha la ki briew ,  Kine ki Israel ki la ïaroi palat , bad ki la ïakhlaiñ eh ruh , bad ki long ka jingma ïa ngi .

translation.en: Also take your flocks and your herds , as ye have said , and be gone  ; and bless me also .
translation.kha: Ïalam ïa la ki langbrot , ki blang , bad ki masi , bad khie mihnoh . Duwai ruh na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu halor jong nga .

ngut para ki ïashong lang ha kajuh ka jaka bad uwei na ki u ïap khlem da ïoh khun shynrang , ka tnga jong uta uba ïap dei shongkurim ïa uno bym dei na ka ïing ka sem u para jong uta uba la ïap u dei shongkurim ïa .
translation.en: If brethren dwell together , and one of them die , and have no child , the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger : her husband s brother shall go in unto her , and take her to him to wife , and perform the duty of an husband s brother unto her .
And it came to pass , that on the next day , when they were come down from the hill , much people met him .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Jisu bad ki lai ngut ki synran ki la hiar na u lum , bad u paidbah babun u la ïakynduh ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: For the land is full of adulterers  ; for because of swearing the land mourneth  ; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up , and their course is evil , and their force is not right .
translation.kha: Ka ri ka jyllei da ki briew ki bymïaineh ha U  Trai  ; ki im ka jingim bymman bad pyndonkam bakla ïa la ka bor . Namar ka jingtim U  Trai  , ka ri ka ïamkthang , bad ki jaka phlang ki tyrkhong .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , and upon the inhabitants thereof , even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah :
translation.kha: Nga ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew baroh da ka jingtim ba la thoh ha ka kitab ïa kaba la pule ha khmat u syiem .

translation.en: And a certain scribe came , and said unto him , Master , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .
translation.kha: U nonghikai Aiñ u la wan sha u .  Ko Nonghikai ,  u la ong ,  Nga la kloi ban leit bad me kat shaba me leit .

Bad kumta ïa kaei Pynkynmaw U Trai u la ïathuh mynshuwa lyngba u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa Meshek pyndep : Ka ri kan sa sah kynjah haduh hynñiewphew snem , ban pynïabiang ïa ka jingshongthait Sabbaton jynrat ïa kaba ym pat shym la rakhe .
translation.en: To fulfil the word of the  Lord  by the mouth of Jeremiah , until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths : for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath , to fulfil threescore and ten years .

translation.kha: u Moses u ïohsngew ïa , u la dem ha khyndew bad u duwai .
translation.en: And when Moses heard it , he fell upon his face :
And they made their father drink wine that night : and the firstborn went in , and lay with her father  ; and he perceived not when she lay down , nor when she arose .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet ki la ai waiñ ïa la u kpa , bad kata ka khun nyngkong ka la ïathiah shongkha bad u . Hynrei u la buaid shaba palat kat haduh ba um tip ei ei shaphang kata .

translation.en: And Jacob their father said unto them , Me have ye bereaved of my children : Joseph is not , and Simeon is not , and ye will take Benjamin away : all these things are against me .
translation.kha: U kpa jong ki u ong ha ki ,  Phi kwah ba ngan duh lut ïa la ki jong ki khun ? U Joseph um don shuh , u Simeon ruh um don , bad mynta pat phi kwah ban shim noh sa ïa u Benjamin . Dei ma nga keiñ uba shah jynjar !
bad ki ïohi U ïa Blei Israel ki . Hapoh ki sla jat jong u , la don kaei kaba i kum ka jingsiang da u mawkordor Sapphir , kaba jngum kum ka suiñbneng .
translation.en: And they saw the God of Israel : and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone , and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness .

translation.kha: Ha bakhuid jong U Blei bad jong U Khrist Jisu bad jong Abdon angel to kohnguh ïa kine ki jinghikai khlem jingujor lane khlem shah iap ïano ïano jingdeng kano pynthymmai kaba me leh .
translation.en: I charge thee before God , and the Lord Jesus Christ , and the elect angels , that thou observe these things without preferring one before another , doing nothing by partiality .
Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because that Moab and Seir do say , Behold , the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Namar ba ka Moab ka la ong ba ka Judah ka long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ,
Shim bad me shapoh kata ka lieng ïa u shynrang bad ka kynthei na kawei pa ka kawei jait mrad bad jait sim baroh , na bynta ka ba yn ri pynim ïa ki .
translation.en: Of fowls after their kind , and of cattle after their kind , of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind , two of every sort shall come unto thee , to keep them alive .

translation.kha: To pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong phi ïa ki , khnang ki ba balang baroh kin sngewskhem ïa bad kata kin tip ba ngim shym bakla ha kaba ngi kob sarong shaphang jong phi .
translation.en: Wherefore shew ye to them , and before the churches , the proof of your love , and of our boasting on your behalf .

translation.kha: U Aaron u jubab , Wat bitar ñiangkulia nga . Phi sut ba kine ki briew Alos long kiba im sngi tang woh leh Jingpynïasuk kaba sniew sngewkhuslai
translation.en: And Aaron said , Let not the anger of my lord wax hot : thou knowest the people , that they are set on mischief .
And a curse , if ye will not obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day , to go after other gods , which ye have not known .
translation.kha: hynrei ïa ka jingtim , lada phi leh lyndet ïa kine ki hukum bad phai noh ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ïa kiba phim pat ju tip mynno mynno .

translation.en: And , behold , there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot , and subtil of heart .
translation.kha: Bad hangta ka la ïakynduh ïa u , ka da riam kum ka nuti bad ka da pyrkhat sniew .
U riewbymman u sngewsarong ha la ki jong ki jingkwah basniew ; u u riewlalot tim bad kyntait ïa U Trai .
translation.en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart s desire , and blesseth the covetous , whom the  Lord  abhorreth .

translation.kha: U Blei uba khlaiñ bad uba ïai jop baroh ar ngut — shah shukor u nongshukor ki don hapoh ka bor jong u .
translation.en: With him is strength and wisdom : the deceived and the deceiver are his .

translation.en: And the Jews  passover was at hand , and Jesus went up to Jerusalem ,

translation.en: Then Peter , turning about , seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following  ; which also leaned on his breast at supper , and said , Lord , which is he that betrayeth thee ?

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong ba u Syros ka ri Persia u long u patsha . U  Trai  u pynlong ïa kaei kaba u la ong lyngba u nongïathuhlypa Jeremaïah ban urlong shisha . ka Bathsheba ka jngoh ïa u syiem ha kamra thiah jong u . U la tymmen bha , bad ka , ka samla kynthei na Shunem , ka sumar ïa u .
translation.en: And Bath–sheba went in unto the king into the chamber : and the king was very old  ; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingpynïap kaba nyngkong , Jonathan u bad u samla ki la kumba pynïap arphew ngut ki briew ha ka jaka kaba heh kumba shipawa hektar .
translation.en: And that first slaughter , which Jonathan and his armourbearer made , was about twenty men , within as it were an half acre of land , which a yoke of oxen might plow .

translation.kha: Ngi la phai dien noh na me , hynrei shen ngi la kwah ban wan phai pat . Hadien ba me la pynshitom ïa ngi , ngi la pyndem ïa la ki khlieh ha ka jingsngewsih . Ngi la sngewlehrain bad jahburom , namar ngi la leh pop mynba ngi dang samla .’

translation.en: Speak not in the ears of a fool : for he will despise the wisdom of thy words .

translation.en: And it shall be in that day , that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem  ; half of them toward the former sea , and half of them toward the hinder sea : in summer and in winter shall it be .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ki angel ki bym shym la ri ïa ka burom hapoh ki pud ka bor synshar jong ki , hynrei ki la iehnoh ïa ki jaka shong jong ki hi : Ki shah khum da ki kynjri bymjukut hapoh kaba dum tliw tliw , ha kaba U Blei u buh ïa ki na ka bynta kata ka Sngi kaba khraw ha kaba yn pynrem ïa ki .

translation.en: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace , but of debt .

translation.en: We are fools for Christ s sake , but ye are wise in Christ ; we are weak , but ye are strong ; ye are honourable , but we are despised .

translation.en: And as they went through the cities , they delivered them the decrees for to keep , that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem .

translation.en: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh , and on all his servants , and on all the people of his land : for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them . So didst thou get thee a name , as it is this day .

translation.en: And she arose , and bowed herself on her face to the earth , and said , Behold , let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord .
And it came to pass , as the camels had done drinking , that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight , and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold  ;
translation.kha: Haba ka la dep ai um , uta u briew u shim ïa ka sati ksiar kaba remdor bad u pyndait ha ka khmut jong ka , bad u pyndeng ruh ar tylli ki khadu ksiar kiba heh ha ki ryndang-kti jong ka .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel , u Asa u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar sawphew wei snem ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes , the governors , and the captains , the judges , the treasurers , the counsellors , the sheriffs , and all the rulers of the provinces , to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .
translation.kha: Te u syiem u la ai hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u ban ïawanlang — ki khun syiem shynrang , ki lat , ki lat kiba kham hapoh , ki kommisshonor , ki nongbat tyngka , ki nongbishar , ki majistor , bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong ki jylla . Ki la dei ban wan sha ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka durbriew kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah pynïeng .

translation.en: And all the people shall hear , and fear , and do no more presumptuously .

translation.en: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali , and Shechem in mount Ephraim , and Kirjath–arba , which is Hebron , in the mountain of Judah .
That thy trust may be in the  Lord  , I have made known to thee this day , even to thee .

translation.en: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips  ; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue .

translation.en: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me .

translation.en: Nevertheless the  Lord  raised up judges , which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them .

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent Jerubbaal , and Bedan , and Jephthah , and Samuel , and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side , and ye dwelled safe .

translation.en: Just as a wise and loving father instructs his children , so God teaches people everywhere the best way to live .

translation.en: The lion is come up from his thicket , and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way  ; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate  ; and thy cities shall be laid waste , without an inhabitant .

translation.en: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth : but he that hath mercy on the poor , happy is he .

translation.en: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter s clay : for shall the work say of him that made it , He made me not ? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it , He had no understanding ?

translation.en: But he giveth more grace . Wherefore he saith , God resisteth the proud , but giveth grace unto the humble .

translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Festus , I would also hear the man myself . To morrow , said he , thou shalt hear him .

translation.en: Then the same day at evening , being the first day of the week , when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews , came Jesus and stood in the midst , and saith unto them ,  Peace be unto you .

translation.en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the  Lord  and the king and the people , that they should be the  Lord s  people  ; between the king also and the people .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  unto this people , Thus have they loved to wander , they have not refrained their feet , therefore the  Lord  doth not accept them  ; he will now remember their iniquity , and visit their sins .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong shaphang kine ki briew ,  Ki ieit ban phet noh na nga , bad kin ym lah ban bat synshar ïa lade . Kumta ngam shym la sngewbha bad ki . Ngan kynmaw ïa ki jingbakla kiba ki la leh bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: Put away from thee a froward mouth , and perverse lips put far from thee .

translation.en: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land , and said , Mark , I pray you , and see how this man seeketh mischief : for he sent unto me for my wives , and for my children , and for my silver , and for my gold  ; and I denied him not .

translation.kha: Shi bynta ka jong ri ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan ai la ha ki katto katne ki longïing kiba hiarpateng na u Manasseh , u khun nyngkong jong u Joseph . U Makhir , u kpa jong Gilead u , u dei u khun nyngkong u jong Manasseh bad u khla-ka-wait pawnam uba ; kumta ïa ka Gilead bad ka Bashan , ha ka phang mihngi ka Jordan , la ai ha u .
translation.en: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh  ; for he was the firstborn of Joseph  ; to wit , for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh , the father of Gilead : because he was a man of war , therefore he had Gilead and Bashan .
And he said unto his disciples ,  Therefore I say unto you , Take no thought for your life , what ye shall eat  ; neither for the body , what ye shall put on .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran ,  Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ban ym khuslai shaphang ka jingbam kaba phi donkam ban im lane shaphang ki jaiñ kiba phi donkam na ka bynta ka met jong phi .
Nga la hukum ban don ka , bad la shem shisha ba ki ka Jerusalem la ju ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka bor bad ba dap da ki nongïaleh pyrshah ki jingkulmar .
translation.en: And I commanded , and search hath been made , and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings , and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein .

translation.kha: Kumno re kumno pat , u shipai Syria u siat ïa u uba khnam ïa dei u syiem Ahab hapdeng ka jaka bapyndait ïa ka jingkieng atiar jong u . Nga la mynsaw ! u pyrta sha u nongñiah ka ïapom kali u jong . Phai noh bad phet noh na ka thma !
translation.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture , and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness : therefore he said to his chariot man , Turn thine hand , that thou mayest carry me out of the host  ; for I am wounded .

And the elders of the Jews builded , and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo . And they builded , and finished it , according to the commandment of the God of Israel , and according to the commandment of Cyrus , and Darius , and Artaxerxes king of Persia .

translation.en: See , I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness , until there come word from you to certify me .

translation.en: For thou art my hope , O Lord  God  : thou art my trust from my youth .

translation.kha: Te ym long shuh kum ki khynnah la pynshad da ki jingat phyllung bad ka jingbeh ka erïong man ba ka kylla da ka jinghikai jong ki riewshukor , kiba ïa kiwei pat sha ka jingbakla da ki buit sianti ba .
translation.en: That we henceforth be no more children , tossed to and fro , and carried about with every wind of doctrine , by the sleight of men , and cunning craftiness , whereby they lie in wait to deceive ;

And have tasted the good word of God , and the powers of the world to come ,
translation.kha: ki la tip naba ki la ïohmad ba ka Ktien U Blei ka long kaba bha , bad ki la ïohmad ruh ïa ki bor jong ka por ka ban sa wan .
