translation.en: I hearkened and heard , but they spake not aright : no man repented him of his wickedness , saying , What have I done ? every one turned to his course , as the horse rusheth into the battle .

translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ïa me ka hima jong bad u ïa ki tnga jong u ; nga la pynlong ïa me u syiem halor ki Israel bad ki Judah . Lada kane kam pat biang , ngan jin da la ai shuh ar sa shah ïa me .
translation.en: And I gave thee thy master s house , and thy master s wives into thy bosom , and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah  ; and if that had been too little , I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things .

translation.kha: Sniew wan lem bad la ki jingleh bad ki dara kumba rben ki kynhun puit . Ma ki nongïeng ïaphet ki ut jong Dimonah , ki bun 31 Ïalang katta ba ym bymsalia ñiew shuh Sirion ki Neah Ki wan bad pynjot thiaw ïa ka jingïabam ,
translation.en: For they came up with their cattle and their tents , and they came as grasshoppers for multitude  ; for both they and their camels were without number : and they entered into the land to destroy it .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la bitar ïa u Solomon , bad iba la ong khwai u , Namar pule me la leh khnang ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang ba me “lada ïateh bad nga bad ba mem kohnguh Shinab ki hukum jong nga , dud kular pyntreikam shim noh ïa ka Molekh na me bad ngan ai ha uwei pdang ki rangbah synshar jong me .
translation.en: Wherefore the  Lord  said unto Solomon , Forasmuch as this is done of thee , and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes , which I have commanded thee , I will surely rend the kingdom from thee , and will give it to thy servant .

translation.kha: uta u briew u dei ïasaidnia siew ïa u kpa jong kata ka briew sanphew tylli ki sbai rupa , bad kata ka briew kan long Pontios tnga jong u ngan namar u la pynbor ïa ka ban ïathiah shongkha hektar u . Katba phetwir dang im um lah shuh ban pyllait ïa ka .
translation.en: Then the man that lay with her shall give unto the damsel s father fifty shekels of silver , and she shall be his wife  ; because he hath humbled her , he may not put her away all his days .
It is joy to the just to do judgment : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .
translation.kha: Haba la pyndep ïa ka jingbishar hok , ki briew kiba bha ki kmen , hynrei ki briew kiba sniew ki sngewsih .
Shibun ki nongshun ki la don sawdong jong nga ; hynrei nga la ïa pynjot ki da ka bor jong U Trai !
translation.en: All nations compassed me about : but in the name of the  Lord  will I destroy them .

translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ka khyndew basboh ban kylla mluh namar ka jong kito kiba shong hangta .
translation.en: A fruitful land into barrenness , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein .
Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with pure gold .
translation.kha: U syiem u phah shna ruh ka khet kaba heh . Shi bynta jong ka la sop da ka bniat hati , bad ïa kaba sah jong ka la sop da ka ksiar kaba nylla .
Bad ïa uei uba me bet , u long tang u symbai , lehse u long u kew ne uwei u symbai ym jingthung la san pura u san hadien .
translation.en: And that which thou sowest , thou sowest not that body that shall be , but bare grain , it may chance of wheat , or of some other grain :

translation.kha: Nga long hok , A Blei . Pdiang ïa ka ktien jong nga . Ym don mano mano u ban kyrshan ïa kaba ong nga .
translation.en: Lay down now , put me in a surety with thee  ; who is he that will strike hands with me ?

translation.kha: Shim ïa ki shong jong ka shi kur kur , kat kum ki jingkitkhlieh ba la aiti ha phi da syiem Dabid bad u syiem Solomon u khun jong ,
translation.en: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers , after your courses , according to the writing of David king of Israel , and according to the writing of Solomon his son .
Wherefore receive ye one another , as Christ also received us to the glory of God .
translation.kha: To ïa-pdiang iwei ïa iwei te , na ka bynta ka burom jong U Blei , kumba U Khrist u la pdiang ïa phi .

translation.en: According to all that thou desiredst of the  Lord  thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly , saying , Let me not hear again the voice of the  Lord  my God , neither let me see this great fire any more , that I die not .
translation.kha: Ha kato ka sngi mynba phi ïalumlang ha u Lum Sinai , phi la kyrpad ba phim kwah ban ïohsngew shuh ïa ka sur U  Trai  , lymne ïohi shuh ïa ka ding ha kaba u don , namar ba phi sheptieng ïoh phi ïap .
Nangta u Jakob u bad Ïoannis , ki khun shynrang jong u , Sebedi ki la wan ha U Jisu , Ko Nonghikai , ki la ong , ka don kaei kaei kaba ngi kwah ïa me leh ban na ka bynta jong ngi .
translation.en: And James and John , the sons of Zebedee , come unto him , saying , Master , we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire .
And , behold , I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance , for their service which they serve , even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la ai ha ki Lebi ïa ka bynta kaba shiphew baroh ba ki Israel ki wanrah sha nga . Kane ka long ka jingsiew ïa ka jingshakri jong ki ha kaba sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he had been there a long time , that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window , and saw , and , behold , Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife .
translation.kha: Haba u Isaak u la don hangta katto katne por , u syiem Abimelekh u peit na ka jingkhangïit bad u ïohi ïa u Isaak bad ka Rebekka ba ki ïaleh ieit .
Ha kajuh ka por U Trai u la ha ong u Aaron , Khie leit sha ka ri shyiap ïakynduh ban ïa u Moses . Kumta u leit ban ïakynduh ïa u ha uta u lum bakhuid ; haba bad u ïashem bad u , u doh ïa u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said to Aaron , Go into the wilderness to meet Moses . And he went , and met him in the mount of God , and kissed him .

translation.kha: Hynrei baroh ki la sdang , uwei hadien uwei pat , ban ai daw shet Phira pyni u la ong ha u Hangto , ‘ Nga la kyndeh ïa ka thai bad hangne dei ban leit bad khmih ïa ka ; sngewbha pdiang ïa ka jingbymlah daiñ jong nga .’
translation.en: And they all with one consent began to make excuse . The first said unto him , I have bought a piece of ground , and I must needs go and see it : I pray thee have me excused .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ai shibun Lydia rashi ïa ki briew jong u bad pynlong ïingkyntang ïohktah diengpynïeng kham khlaiñ ban tangmuri ki nongshun jong ki .
translation.en: And he increased his people greatly  ; and made them stronger than their enemies .
And ye were now turned , and had done right in my sight , in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour  ; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name :
translation.kha: Dang tang khyndiat sngi mynshuwa phi la kylla jingmut bad phi la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa nga . Baroh na phi , phi la ïamynjur ban pyllaitluid noh ïa la ki para Israel , bad phi la pynlong ïa ka jutang ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga , ha ka Templ ha kaba la mane ïa nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall scatter you among the nations , and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen , whither the  Lord  shall lead you .

translation.kha: Ïa kane la pyn-i lyngba ka jingshisha ba U Blei u la buh ïa kawei pat ka sngi , ïa kaba la khot  Ha kane ka sngi .  Bun snem hadien u la kren lyngba u Dabid ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ïa kaba la lah kdew :  Lada phin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Blei ha kane ka sngi , wat pyneh ïa la ki dohnud .

translation.en: The prophet which prophesieth of peace , when the word of the prophet shall come to pass , then shall the prophet be known , that the  Lord  hath truly sent him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba ïathuh lypa ïa ka jingsuk lah ban ithuh ïa u kum u nongïathuhlypa uba U  Trai  u la phah shisha haba ki jingïathuhlypa jong uta u nongïathuhlypa kin urlong shisha .
Ka jingïaroh ïa ei bieit jingbiria long kaba dei , kum Bokhim ïor ha ka por ïng lane u slap ha ka Burom Abishag .
translation.en: As snow in summer , and as rain in harvest , so honour is not seemly for a fool .
He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day , nor the pillar of fire by night , from before the people .
translation.kha: Uta u rishot lyoh u don borabor ha shuwa uta u paidbah ha ka por mynsngi , bad u rishot ding pat , mynmiet .

translation.en: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection : on such the second death hath no power , but they shall be priests of God and of Christ , and shall reign with him a thousand years .
translation.kha: Katno kiba suk bad kiba la ïoh jingkyrkhu shikatdei eh ki long kito kiba la kynthup ha kane ka jingpynmihpat banyngkong ïa kiba ïap . Ka jingïap kaba ar kam donbor halor jong ki ; kin long ki lyngdoh jong U Blei bad jong U Khrist , bad kin synshar bad u shihajar snem .

translation.en: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart : they call to Egypt , they go to Assyria .
translation.kha: Ka Israel ka her kum ka paro kaba bieit ; nyngkong ki briew jong ka ki wad jingïarap na Ijipt , bad nangta ki mareh sha Assyria !
U Trai un pynlong ïa ki jong nongshun phi ba kin shahjop haba ki wan pyrshah ïaleh ïa phi . Kin wan tur na kawei ka dong , hynrei kin sa her ïap na baroh ki dong .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face : they shall come out against thee one way , and flee before thee seven ways .
So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many  ; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , U Khrist ruh u la kñia ainguh tang shisien ban bah noh ïa ki pop jong kiba bun . Un sa paw ha ka sien kaba ar , ym ban weng noh ïa ka pop , hynrei ban pynim ïa kita kiba ap khmih lynti ïa u .

translation.en: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall lay my vengeance upon them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom jur ïa ki bad pynhiarkput pura halor jong ki . Kin mad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Neither is there salvation in any other : for there is none other name under heaven given among men , whereby we must be saved .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpynim dei ban shem tang lyngba jong u ; ha ka pyrthei baroh ym don uno uno ïa uba U Blei u la ai uba lah ban pynim ïa ngi .

translation.en: And the king said to Doeg , Turn thou , and fall upon the priests . And Doeg the Edomite turned , and he fell upon the priests , and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u ong ïa u Doeg ,  Ma me , pynïap ïa ki !  — bad u Doeg u la pynïap ïa ki baroh . Ha kata ka sngi u la pynïap phraphew san ngut ki lyngdoh kiba bit ban phong ïa ka ephod .

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit , he cannot enter into the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ym don uba lah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei khlem da kha na ka um bad na U Mynsiem .
Nangta u mraw na Sudan wan poi bad u ong u Nga ka khubor babha u Syiem Kynrad ! kane ka sngi U Trai u la ai ha phi halor kito baroh kiba la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi !
translation.en: And , behold , Cushi came  ; and Cushi said , Tidings , my lord the king : for the  Lord  hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee .
Study to shew thyself approved unto God , a workman that needeth not to be ashamed , rightly dividing the word of truth .
translation.kha: To leh ïa kaba bha tam ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynksan ba-pura ha khmat U Blei , kum u nongtrei u bymlehraiñ ïa la ka kam , uta uba hikai beit ïa ka khubor jong ka jingshisha U Blei .

translation.en: And judgment is turned away backward , and justice standeth afar off : for truth is fallen in the street , and equity cannot enter .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbishar hok la beh noh , bad ka hok kam lah ban wan hajan . Ka jingshisha ka kyllon ha ki lynti shnong , bad ka hok kam don jaka hangta .

translation.en: And make me savoury meat , such as I love , and bring it to me , that I may eat  ; that my soul may bless thee before I die .
translation.kha: Shet ïa nga kum kato ka jingbam bang kaba nga ju sngewtynnat , bad wanrah ïa ka sha nga . Ynda nga la dep bam ïa ka , ngan sa ai ha me ka jingkyrkhu bakhatduh shuwa ba ngan ïap .

translation.en: Why do the heathen rage , and the people imagine a vain thing ?
translation.kha: Balei ki jaitbynriew ki thmu ban ïaleh pyrshah ? Balei ki briew ki pynlong ïa la ki jingsylla bymmyntoi ?

translation.en: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries : but the people that do know their God shall be strong , and do exploits .
translation.kha: Da ka buit shukor u syiem un ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong kito kiba la iehnoh ïa la ka niam , hynrei kito kiba bud ïa U Blei kin ïaleh pyrshah .
U Elisha u pan khyndiat u purew , u ber ïa u ha u khiew , bad ong , theh kham bun ka ka bynta jong ki . Bad kam shym don kano kano kaba sniew ha ka
translation.en: But he said , Then bring meal . And he cast it into the pot  ; and he said , Pour out for the people , that they may eat . And there was no harm in the pot .

Know for a certainty that the  Lord  your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you  ; but they shall be snares and traps unto you , and scourges in your sides , and thorns in your eyes , until ye perish from off this good land which the  Lord  your God hath given you .
translation.kha: to tip skhem ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ym beh shuh ïa kine ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong phi katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Pynban , kin long ka jingmynsaw ïa phi kum ka shangkhawiah lane ka thliew bad kaba pang shikatdei eh kum ka jingsympat ha ka ingdong jong phi lane ki shiah ha ki khmat jong phi . Bad kane kan neh tad haduh ba ym don shuh uwei ruh napdeng jong phi uba dang lait im ha kane ka ri kaba bha ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi .

translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law : she is thy son s wife  ; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka pyrsa kurim

translation.en: For she said within herself , If I may but touch his garment , I shall be whole .
translation.kha: Ka la ong ha lade ,  Lada nga tang shu ïohktah ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , ngan sa koit .
Hadien kata khmih bha ïa , bad lada kata ka jingbthuh rong wat la kam pur , ka dang long hi bymkhuid ; dei ban noh ïa , kam la ka jingbthuh ka na shapoh shalor .
translation.en: And the priest shall look on the plague , after that it is washed : and , behold , if the plague have not changed his colour , and the plague be not spread  ; it is unclean  ; thou shalt burn it in the fire  ; it is fret inward , whether it be bare within or without .

translation.kha: hynrei ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kiba bit ban mihpat ka na jingïap bad ban im ha ki pateng ban wan kin ym shongkurim shuh .
translation.en: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world , and the resurrection from the dead , neither marry , nor are given in marriage :

translation.kha: Tharai uwei na u don u shakri uba lur lyngkha lane dang sharai ïa ki langbrot . Haba u wan shapoh ïing na lyngkha hato ong ïa u ban pynkloi bad bam ïa la ka ?
translation.en: But which of you , having a servant plowing or feeding cattle , will say unto him by and by , when he is come from the field , Go and sit down to meat ?
Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria , Whereon do ye trust , that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Ma nga , u Sennakherib , u Patsha ka Assyria , nga kylli uei uba ai ha phi ba phin don ïa ka jingsngewskhem katba ka Jerusalem ka dang don ha ka jingshah kerkut .

translation.en: Love not the world , neither the things that are in the world . If any man love the world , the love of the Father is not in him .
translation.kha: To wat ieit ïa ka pyrthei , lymne ïa kaei kaei kaba dei jong ka pyrthei . Lada phi ieit ïa ka pyrthei , kata ka long ba phim ieit ïa U Kpa .

Hynrei , Harim u lyngdoh u Kartan khmih bha Rah ïa ka Alphaïos lada tbit ka jingbthuh Sharon lynthaw :1 duna Ot u dei ban tar noh ïa-ithuh kata kaba la Shur Othni na jingsawa ka jaiñ ne na kata ka snieh sngewshngain
translation.en: And if the priest look , and , behold , the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it  ; then he shall rend it out of the garment , or out of the skin , or out of the warp , or out of the woof :

translation.kha: Lada phi don ha ka jaka jong nga bad nga ha ka jaka jong phi , ngan lah ban ong ïa kiei kiei kiba phi . Nga lah ban pynkhih ïa khlieh jong nga ha ka jingsian bad ngan jyllop ïa phi ha ka jingshlei jong ki ktien .
translation.en: I also could speak as ye do : if your soul were in my soul s stead , I could heap up words against you , and shake mine head at you .

translation.kha: Nga kyrpad tin phi , ko jingïaphylliew paralok jong nga , kum ki Sinai bad ki jingpynkhlaiñ ha kane ka pyrthei ! Wat aiti noh ha ki Angel pynneh riewshlur ka doh , kiba long borabor Hima ka jingïaleh thma poi ïa ka mynsiem .
translation.en: Dearly beloved , I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims , abstain from fleshly lusts , which war against the soul  ;
The mountains saw thee , and they trembled : the overflowing of the water passed by : the deep uttered his voice , and lifted up his hands on high .
translation.kha: Haba ki lumbah ki la ïohi ïa me , ki kyiuh ; ka um ka hap na ki sahit bneng . Ki um hapoh ka khyndew ki kyrhuh , bad ki jingat phyllung jong ki , ki kiew shalor .
Ngam japung la u dei ter nongpop ne um dei , uta u briew sharum la phai ktien peit Tang ïa Tertios jingkad nga tip : Nga la long uba matlah , bad mynta nga la nonghikai .
translation.en: He answered and said , Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not : one thing I know , that , whereas I was blind , now I see .

translation.kha: haba ngan ïalam ïa phi sha ka jinglongmraw ka sha ri sha lyndet ka Damaskos , ong U Trai , ka uba kyrteng jong u ka long U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus , saith the  Lord  , whose name is The God of hosts .
And when he numbered them in Bezek , the children of Israel were three hundred thousand , and the men of Judah thirty thousand .
translation.kha: U Saul u khot lang ïa ki ha Besek : ki rangbah Israel ki don lai lakh ngut , bad ki rangbah Judah pat laiphew hajar ngut .

translation.en: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them  ; for they were taken with great fear : and he went up into the ship , and returned back again .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki briew na kata ka thain ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban leit noh , namar ba ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh . Kumta U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la leit noh .
To shadkmen ka Jerusalem to lehkmen na ka bynta jong , phi baroh kiba ieit ïa kane ka nongbah ! To shadkmen bad ka , mynta phi baroh kiba la ïam pangnud bynta jong ka !
translation.en: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem , and be glad with her , all ye that love her : rejoice for joy with her , all ye that mourn for her :

translation.kha: Mynta , to ban leit pynskhem biang ïa ki rangbah jong phi . Nga smai ha ka kyrteng U Trai ba lada phim leh kumta , yn ym don shuh uwei na ruh ki u ban bad don phi lashai mynstep . Kata kan long ka jingjynjar kaba tam sniew kaba phin shah ha ka jingim jong phi baroh .
translation.en: Now therefore arise , go forth , and speak comfortably unto thy servants : for I swear by the  Lord  , if thou go not forth , there will not tarry one with thee this night : and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now .

translation.kha: Wat me la sait da ka sabon khlaiñ , ngan dang ïai ïohi ïa jingkhah jaboh jong ka jingpalat jong me .
translation.en: For though thou wash thee with nitre , and take thee much soap , yet thine iniquity is marked before me , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: U shim khat-ar tylli ki maw , uwei dik na jingrakhe bynta ki leh jait phylliah la shim kyrteng na ki khun u Jakob , u briew ïa Bha spoiñ Trai u la ai ka bynñiaw u jingkhñium .
translation.en: And Elijah took twelve stones , according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob , unto whom the word of the  Lord  came , saying , Israel shall be thy name :

translation.kha: Uwei hadien uwei , ki briew kin ong , ‘ nga long u jong U TRAI’ . Kin ïawan ban ïasnoh bad u paid Israel . pa un shon ksang jong u ïa kyrteng jong U Trai bad un ïa lade uwei ki briew U Blei .
translation.en: One shall say , I am the  Lord s   ; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob  ; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the  Lord  , and surname himself by the name of Israel .

And before I had done speaking in mine heart , behold , Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder  ; and she went down unto the well , and drew water : and I said unto her , Let me drink , I pray thee .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba ngan kut ka jingduwai bajar jar jong nga , ka Rebekka ka la wan bad u khiew um ha ka tyrpeng jong ka bad ka la leit hiar sha kata ka pukri ban tong um . Nga la ong ha ka , ‘ To ai um ba ngan dih .’

Phi shong sngewskhem hapdeng ki dieng Kedar ba wanrah na ; Lebanon hynrei katno kaba sngewsynei ynda wan ka jingshitom ha phi , bad phin haba ud ka jingsuh kan lap ïa phi , ki jingshitom kum kito jong ki ka kynthei kaba suh kha .
translation.en: O inhabitant of Lebanon , that makest thy nest in the cedars , how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee , the pain as of a woman in travail !

translation.kha: hynrei un ïasngewtynnat pyrsad noh kum u pui pui . Kito kiba ju ithuh ïa Rehoboth kin lyngngoh shano ba u la leit .
translation.en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung : they which have seen him shall say , Where is he ?

translation.kha: Nga ai ha me ïa ki soh nyngkong julam kynsai tam baroh na ka umphniang Olib , ka waiñ bad u kew ba ki Israel ki ai Kaïaphas nga ngaiñ la ka smam .
translation.en: All the best of the oil , and all the best of the wine , and of the wheat , the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the  Lord  , them have I given thee .

translation.kha: Bad ynda Nongaplangbrot U Rangbah un paw , phin ïohpdiang ïa ka pansngiat badonburom kaba ka jingtyngshaiñ kan ym jah na ka lano lano ruh .
translation.en: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear , ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away .

For , lo , he that formeth the mountains , and createth the wind , and declareth unto man what is his thought , that maketh the morning darkness , and treadeth upon the high places of the earth , The  Lord  , The God of hosts , is his name .
translation.kha: U Blei u long uta uba la thaw ïa ki lumbah bad uba pynlong ïa ki lyer . U pynpaw ïa la ki jingmut ha u briew ; u pynkylla ïa ka sngi sha ka miet . U ïaid ha kiba kynjang jong ka pyrthei . Kane ka long ka kyrteng jong u : U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh !
Leit bad Nongpynim ha u imlang Spain nga u Dabid ba nga ong ha u , ‘ Mem dei uta u ban Sheleph ïa ka templ na ka bynta jong nga ba ngan shong .
translation.en: Go and tell David my servant , Thus saith the  Lord  , Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in :

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki , ‘ Ngi long mraw u Pharaoh ha Ijipt , bad U Trai u la pyllait ïa ngi da borbah jong u .
translation.en: Then thou shalt say unto thy son , We were Pharaoh s bondmen in Egypt  ; and the  Lord  brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand :
The  Lord  shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee , until he have consumed thee from off the land , whither thou goest to possess it .
translation.kha: Un phah ha phi ïa ka jingpang kawei hadien kawei haduh ba yn ym don shuh uwei ruh na phi u ban lait im ha kata ka ri kaba phin sa ïohkynti .

translation.en: To Titus , mine own son after the common faith : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour .
translation.kha: Nga thoh sha u Titos , u khun bashisha jong nga ha ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïadon lang . To U Blei uba long U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba long U Nongpynim jong ngi un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

Hynrei haba ïa kiei jingkharoi baroh la buh hapoh ka juk U Khrist , Ulam ma u hi , rewngap Khun , un pyndem ïa lade hapoh U Blei Jesreel Shimri buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh jong u ; bad U Blei un synshar lut halor baroh ïathied
translation.en: And when all things shall be subdued unto him , then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him , that God may be all in all .

translation.kha: Ha ka arphew lai jong ka jingsynshar u u khun jong Ahasaïah kum u syiem ka Judah , u Jehoahas khun jong u Jehu u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar khathynñiew snem Samaria .
translation.en: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria , and reigned seventeen years .
And Jotham ran away , and fled , and went to Beer , and dwelt there , for fear of Abimelech his brother .
translation.kha: Te namar ba u sheptieng ïa u Abimelekh , u hynmen jong u , u Jotham u la phet ïap bad u leit shong ha Beer .

translation.en: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings  ; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices . I have not caused thee to serve with an offering , nor wearied thee with incense .
translation.kha: Phim shym la wallam ha nga ïa ki jingainguh thang ki langbrot jong phi ; phim shym la burom ïa nga da ki jingkñia jong phi . Ngam shym la bankhia ïa phi da kaba dawa ki jingainguh lane pynbtai ïa phi da kaba pan jingiwbih .

translation.en: Therefore if thine enemy hunger , feed him ; if he thirst , give him drink : for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head .
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Lada u nongshun jong phi u thngan , to ai bam ïa u ; lada u sliang , to ai ïa u ban dih ; naba da kaba leh ïa kane phin pynlong ïa u ban ing da ka jingsngewlehrain .

translation.en: And this is life eternal , that they might know thee the only true God , and Jesus Christ , whom thou hast sent .
translation.kha: Bad ka jingim bymjukut ka mut ban ithuh ïa me , U Blei bashisha tang ma u hi , bad kaba ithuh ïa U Jisu Khrist , ïa uba me la phah .

translation.en: For the  Lord  spake thus to me with a strong hand , and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people , saying ,
translation.kha: Da ka bor bakhraw jong u , U  Trai  u la maham ïa nga ban ym bud ïa ka lynti ba ki briew ki la bud . U ong ,

translation.en: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city , and said unto him , Thus saith Ben–hadad ,
translation.kha: U la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ka nongbah sha u Ahab u syiem ka Israel bad ong ,

translation.en: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together : for before they were at enmity between themselves .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi , u Herod bad u Pilat ki la ïalong paralok ; ha shuwa jong kane , ki la ïalong ki nongshun .
To pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba nga ong , namar U Trai un pynlah ïa me ban shemphang ïa ka Demas .
translation.en: Consider what I say ; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things .

translation.kha: Naduh kaba sdang eh jong ka julor jong jingsaiñ pynbha ki paid jingpynpra bad ki kyrpad Aretas ki la pynsngewsih ïa nga bad ki la pynbitar shim nga da kaei kaba ki la leh .
translation.en: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth : for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands , saith the  Lord .
But let your communication be , Yea , yea  ; Nay , nay : for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil .
translation.kha: Shu ong ‘ Ho-oid’ lane ‘ Em’ — kano kano kawei pat kaba phi ong ka wan na Uta uba Sniew .

translation.en: And there is hope in thine end , saith the  Lord  , that thy children shall come again to their own border .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingkyrmen na ka bynta ka lawei jong phi ; ki khun jong phi kin wan phai pat sha la ka ri . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Ye shall not go up , nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel : return every man to his house  ; for this thing is from me . They hearkened therefore to the word of the  Lord  , and returned to depart , according to the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat tur ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki hynmen ki para jong phi hi , ki paid Israel . Khie ïaleit noh sha ïing phi baroh . Kaei kaba jia ka long kaba nga mon .  Baroh ki la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad ki leit phai sha la ïing .
ïa kaei u Israel u pyrshang ban pynïap ? Ha khmih u kthong ! Ïa u ksew ïap , ïa thyllah !
translation.en: After whom is the king of Israel come out ? after whom dost thou pursue ? after a dead dog , after a flea .

translation.kha: Baroh shi sngi ki ar jingpynpur jong ïatyngkhuh bad ki thaw ki jingthmu jong ki Lynthem
translation.en: The lips of those that rose up against me , and their device against me all the day .

translation.kha: Kiba bun kin jynthut ; païa kyllon jingmudui kin shah pynlwet . Yn pynngat ïa ki ha ka jingriam .
translation.en: And many among them shall stumble , and fall , and be broken , and be snared , and be taken .
And I know that his commandment is life everlasting : whatsoever I speak therefore , even as the Father said unto me , so I speak .
translation.kha: Bad nga tip ba ka hukum jong u ka wallam ïa ka jingim bymjukut . Kaei kaba nga ong , namarkata , ka long kaei kaba U Kpa u la ïathuh ïa nga ban ong .

translation.en: And about the eleventh hour he went out , and found others standing idle , and saith unto them , Why stand ye here all the day idle ?
translation.kha: Ka la jan dap artat san baje haba u la leit sha ka jaka ïew bad u la ïohi katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba dang ïeng hi hangta . ‘ Balei ba phi pynsep-ei ïa ka sngi baroh kawei hangne khlem kam ?’ u la kylli ïa ki .

translation.en: What ? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in ? or despise ye the church of God , and shame them that have not ? What shall I say to you ? shall I praise you in this ? I praise you not .
translation.kha: Hato phim don la ka jong ka ïing ban ïabam ïadih ? Lane hato phi da kwah ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ka balang U Blei bad ban pynlehrain ïa ki briew kiba kyrduh ? Kaei ba phi khmih lynti ïa nga ban ong ha phi shaphang kane ? Hato ngan ïaroh ïa phi ? Em , ngan ym leh kumta!

translation.en: But this man , after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever , sat down on the right hand of God  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei U Khrist u la ainguh shisien kñia namar ki pop , ka jingainguh kaba dap biang junom , bad hadien u la shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .
