translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko parabangeit jong nga , khublei! To ïabeh sha ka jingjanai ; to shahshkor ïa ki jingkyrpad jong nga , to don kajuh ka jingmut para ma phi , to ïa-im ha ka jingsuk . Bad U Blei ka jingieit bad ka jingsuk un long ryngkat bad phi .
ka jingriam ka ïoh ïa ki khongdong jat jong bad u bat khak ïa u .
translation.en: The gin shall take him by the heel , and the robber shall prevail against him .

translation.kha: ( Ka don ka shnong hajan hangta ïa kaba la khot da ka kyrteng kynhun shipai . ) Bad kumta yn Lyngskor khuid biang ïa Heliopolis ri .
translation.en: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah . Thus shall they cleanse the land .
Now concerning the collection for the saints , as I have given order to the churches of Galatia , even so do ye .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha kaba ïadei bad kaei kaba phi la thoh shaphang ka pisa ka ban kynshew na ka bynta ban ïarap ïa ki briew U Blei ha Judia . Phi dei ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ïa ki balang ha Galatia ban leh .
U shipai rangbah uba ïeng hangta ha khmat Kumjuh pynbakla u la jingarsap kumno U Jisu u la ïap ker Une u briew u long shisha U jingkhem U Damaskos ! u la ong .
translation.en: And when the centurion , which stood over against him , saw that he so cried out , and gave up the ghost , he said , Truly this man was the Son of God .

translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la ai ha ka ngi jingsngewskhem ha phi , bad ngi thikna ba phi leh bad phin ïai leh kaei ïa kaba ngi ong ïa phi .
translation.en: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you , that ye both do and will do the things which we command you .
The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure .
translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ka dei ban long khatlai mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan . Baroh khatwei tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki dei ban long katjuh ka jingheh .

translation.en: And they shall build the old wastes , they shall raise up the former desolations , and they shall repair the waste cities , the desolations of many generations .
translation.kha: Kin tei pat ïa ki nongbah ba la jot la pra .
U Job u leit bad u shong ha ka kynton bad u da ki khiew ba la pait trud ïa ki tohjaw kiba don u .
translation.en: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal  ; and he sat down among the ashes .

translation.kha: Ki ïabeh Gaal u Moses Beri Lada phi kren ha ngi , ngin shahshkor ; Rung ngi sheptieng ba lada U Blei u kren ha ngi tuklar ngin shakri .
translation.en: And they said unto Moses , Speak thou with us , and we will hear : but let not God speak with us , lest we die .
I am the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la pyllait im ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
Ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ; kawei ha pa kawei ka sngi ai ki ki jingkñia kiba donkam ha kata ka sngi ;
translation.en: They kept also the feast of tabernacles , as it is written , and offered the daily burnt offerings by number , according to the custom , as the duty of every day required  ;
O God , thou hast taught me from my youth : and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works .
translation.kha: Me la hikai ïa nga naduh ba nga dang samla , bad nga dang ïai ïathuh ïa ki kam kiba phylla jong me .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , The barrel of meal shall not waste , neither shall the cruse of oil fail , until the day that the  Lord  sendeth rain upon the earth .
translation.kha: Naba kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong : ‘ Kata ka pliang kan ym thylli  purew lane uta u klong un nym long khlem umphniang shuwa kata ka sngi ba nga , U  Trai  ngan phah slap .’

translation.en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness  ; and all that were numbered of you , according to your whole number , from twenty years old and upward , which have murmured against me ,
translation.kha: Phin ïap bad ïa ki metïap jong phi yn pynphriang ha kylleng kane ka ri khlaw . Namar ba phi la khñium pyrshah ïa nga , yn ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la palat arphew snem ka rta u ban ïohrung sha kata ka ri .

translation.en: And Jonathan said to David , Go in peace , forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  be between me and thee , and between my seed and thy seed for ever . And he arose and departed : and Jonathan went into the city .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jonathan u ong ha u Dabid ,  U Blei un don ryngkat bad phi . U  Trai  un pynthikna ba ma nga bad ma phi , bad kiba hiarpateng na phi bad kiba hiarpateng na nga , kin bat ïa ka kular bakyntang kaba ngi la pynlong iwei ïa iwei .  Nangta u Dabid u leit noh , bad u Jonathan u leit phai pat sha shnong .
U Trai u la ong sohkhliang u Moses ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka khyndew ka kyiuh bad ka khynñiuh namar ba U Trai u pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong ban pynlong ïa ka Babilonia ka ri shyiap ha kaba ym mano mano ban shong ban sah .
translation.en: And the land shall tremble and sorrow : for every purpose of the  Lord  shall be performed against Babylon , to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant .
From Aroer , that is upon the bank of the river Arnon , and the city that is in the midst of the river , and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon  ;
translation.kha: Ka ri jong ki ïar shaduh Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them Arnon ) bad ka nongbah kaba hapdeng jong kata ka them bad kaba kynthup ïa ka jaka padun baroh na Medeba shaduh Dibon .
Leh ka thik kumba ka la ïa phi siew kylliang ar shah ïa ka na baroh ka la leh . ïa ka khuri jong ka da ka jingdih ar shah ka jingkhor kum ka jingdih ka la na bynta jong phi .
translation.en: Reward her even as she rewarded you , and double unto her double according to her works : in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double .
The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed , and that he should not die in the pit , nor that his bread should fail .
translation.kha: Kito kiba long ki koidi shen yn sa pyllaitluid ïa ki ; kin im ka jingim kaba jlan bad kin ïoh ïa ka jingbam kat kaba ki donkam .
ka Aphek , ka Lasharon
translation.en: The king of Aphek , one  ; the king of Lasharon , one  ;
An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord   ; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the  Lord  for ever :
translation.kha: U Ammon lane u Moab — lane uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong ki haduh kaba shiphew pateng bynriew — ym dei ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .
Nangta la ïalam ïa u Paul bad u Silas sha ka u bad u la ai ha ki katto katne ka ban bam . Ïa bad ka longïing u la pyndap da ka jingkmen , namar mynta ki la ngeit ha U Blei .
translation.en: And when he had brought them into his house , he set meat before them , and rejoiced , believing in God with all his house .
Go and tell David my servant , Thus saith the  Lord  , Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in :
translation.kha: Leit bad ïathuh ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba nga ong ha u , ‘ Mem dei uta u ban tei ïa ka templ na ka bynta jong nga ba ngan shong .

translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that Leah was hated , he opened her womb : but Rachel was barren .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïohi ba ka jingieit ka kham duna ïa ka Leah ban ïa ka Rakhel , u la pynlah ïa ka ban ïoh khun , hynrei ka Rakhel ka ïailong kaba khlem khun .

translation.en: But thou , O son of man , behold , they shall put bands upon thee , and shall bind thee with them , and thou shalt not go out among them :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , yn sa khum sa teh ïa me da ki tyllai , bad men ym lah ban leit sha jaka paidbah .

translation.en: Examine some of the material that will be discussed at the next few meetings .
translation.kha: Pynkhreh lypa katto katne ki kot ba ngin sa ïasyllok ha ki jingïalang ki ban sa wan .
kwah ban wan shong bad nga ?
translation.en: Do you want to come sit by me ?

translation.kha: U pynkhlaiñbor jong Peris Trai u khot pynïaidkam u Jehoshaphat ha kaba ïalap Ïing Stakhos bneng ,
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time ,

translation.kha: Ki jingthoh ki har kumno u Jied synshar jingjur haduh katno u long uba khrawbor , bad ïa kiei jingbrai baroh kiba la jia Dor Taralah kran ha ki Israel , bad thngan Magdala hima baroh kiba marjan .
translation.en: With all his reign and his might , and the times that went over him , and over Israel , and over all the kingdoms of the countries .

translation.kha: Ym shym la ai phlangïap shuh ïa ngi , hynrei la ïai hukum ïa ngi ban maw-it ! Bad mynta pat ngi . Dei ki briew jong phi keiñ kiba bakla .
translation.en: There is no straw given unto thy servants , and they say to us , Make brick : and , behold , thy servants are beaten  ; but the fault is in thine own people .
And Obed–edom with their brethren , threescore and eight  ; Obed–edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters :
translation.kha: U Obed Edom u khun jong u Jeduthun bad ki hynriewphew phra ngut ki rangbah jong ka kur jong u kin ïarap ïa ki . Ïa u Hosah bad u Obed Edom la buh ban ap phira ïa ki khyrdop .

translation.en: And when the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , saw the mourning in the floor of Atad , they said , This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians : wherefore the name of it was called Abel–mizraim , which is beyond Jordan .
translation.kha: Haba ki Kanaan kiba shong ha kata ka ri ki ïohi ïa kita ki briew kiba ïambriew ha Atad , ki ïa-ong ,  Kane ka rukom ïambriew ki nong Ijipt kaba da sngew lung mynsiem shisha !  Dei namar kata ba la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka Abel Misraim .

translation.en: And thou shalt make it a perfume , a confection after the art of the apothecary , tempered together , pure and holy :
translation.kha: Pyndonkam ïa ki ban shna jingiwbih , khleh ïa ki kum ka jingpyniwbih . Ber khyndiat ka mluh ban pynlong ïa ka kaba khuid bad kaba kyntang .

translation.en: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera , the captain of Jabin s army , with his chariots and his multitude  ; and I will deliver him into thine hand .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa u Sisera , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u Jabin , ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi ha ka wah Kishon . Un don ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai , hynrei ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong u .’

Ym dei namar ka hok jong ne ka jinglong beit ha ka dohnud ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka jong ki , hynrei ka long namar ka jingbymman jong kita ki jaitbynriew ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la beh ïa ki na khmat jong phi ; un pynskhem ïa la ka kular ba u la ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi u , , bad u Jakob .
translation.en: Not for thy righteousness , or for the uprightness of thine heart , dost thou go to possess their land : but for the wickedness of these nations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee , and that he may perform the word which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob .

translation.kha: Ym don nongwei ha ka ri ki ; ym don u ban ïalam jngai ïa ki na Blei .
translation.en: Unto whom alone the earth was given , and no stranger passed among them .

Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers  ; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them , and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them .
translation.kha: Bad lada ki paid Israel kin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh , bad sumar ïa ka Aiñ baroh ba u Moses u shakri jong nga u la ai ha ki , nangta ngan ym shah ba yn beh noh ïa ki na ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! because ye build the tombs of the prophets , and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous ,
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi shna ki lum jingtep ba-itynnat na ka bynta ki nongïathuhlypa bad phi pynitynnat ïa ki mot sahkynmaw jong kito kiba im ka jingim kaba bha ;

translation.en: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end :
translation.kha: Ka jingangnud kaba khraw tam jong ngi ka long ba uwei pa uwei na phi un don ka jingthrang kaba ïaineh haduh kaba kut , kumta ba kiei kiei kiba phi kyrmen kin wan urlong .

translation.en: Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even gather you from the people , and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered , and I will give you the land of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta to ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong . Ngan lumlang ïa ki na ki ri sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ngan ai pat ïa ka ri Israel ha ki .

translation.en: And , lo , thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice , and can play well on an instrument : for they hear thy words , but they do them not .
translation.kha: Ha ki mem long ei ei lait tang u nongpynbyrngia da kaba rwai ki jingrwai jingieit ne tem ka duitara . Ki shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong me baroh hynrei kim kohnguh ïa kawei ruh na ki .

translation.en: Ye adulterers and adulteresses , know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God ? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God .
translation.kha: Ko phi ki briew bym lah shaniah ! Hato phim tip ba ka jingïalang lok bad ka pyrthei ka long ka nongshun jong U Blei ? Uno uno uba kwah ban pynlong lok bad ka pyrthei u pynlong ïa lade u nongshun jong U Blei .

translation.en: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin , to separate himself thence in the midst of the people .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la sdang ban mihnoh na Jerusalem bad ban leit sha ka thain Benjamin ban leit shim ïa ka bynta jong nga na ka nongkynti ka longïing .
Uta uba kren ha thylliej ki kiba pher um kren ha kiwei pat hynrei ha U Blei , namar ym don ba sngewthuh ïa u . U kren ïa jingshisha ki barieh da ka bor U Mynsiem .
translation.en: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men , but unto God : for no man understandeth him ; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries .

translation.kha: Kumno ki Rangbah Balang Shakri ïa ka Balang
translation.en: How Do the Elders Serve the Congregation ?

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet riewshemphang Shah ka Iohi dei ban syang , bad bam ïa ka lem bad u kpu khlem thiat bad ki sngewdei kthang .
translation.en: And they shall eat the flesh in that night , roast with fire , and unleavened bread  ; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it .

translation.kha: To lyntang ïit ïa wanna Komentari lynti bad Seraïah pat sha Saul Trai .
translation.en: Let us search and try our ways , and turn again to the  Lord .

translation.kha: shakri jong u leit sha , bad ki ong , Ko kynrad lada u nongïathuhlypa u la phah ïa phi ban leh ïa kaei kaei kaba jwat , phin jin la leh ïa ka . Mynta balei phim shu ïa lade kumba u ong bad ban ?
translation.en: And his servants came near , and spake unto him , and said , My father , if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing , wouldest thou not have done it ? how much rather then , when he saith to thee , Wash , and be clean ?
And as he journeyed , he came near Damascus : and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven :
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u la wan poi hajan ka nongbah Damaskos , kynsan ka jingshai na ka sahit bneng ka la thaba lep sawdong ïa u .

translation.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare : but the righteous doth sing and rejoice .
translation.kha: Ki briew basniew ki ngat ha la ki jong ki pop , katba ki briew bahok ki kmen bad ki laitluid .

lap Asaraïah bad kiwei pat ki lyngdoh , ki peit sah ïa ka Kim jong u syiem da ka jingsheptieng , bad mar mar ki tan jubor ïa u shabar Shelomith mihnoh na ka Templ 104 U pynkloi ban Komentari shabar basngur wahduid U Israhaïah u la pynshitom ïa u .
translation.en: And Azariah the chief priest , and all the priests , looked upon him , and , behold , he was leprous in his forehead , and they thrust him out from thence  ; yea , himself hasted also to go out , because the  Lord  had smitten him .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew hynriew jong ka —Ephesos u jingmihnoh u syiem jingsngewlem Judah , jingpyntriem Baasha u syiem Kynther Israel u hiarthma ïa ka Judah bad sdang wer tei kut ïa ka Ramah Jordan ban khang noh ïa ka jingïaid lynti shapoh bad ïashun ka Judah .
translation.en: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah , and built Ramah , to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .

translation.kha: Dei ma u uba pynjot ïa ki jaka mane bad ki bad nangta duwan u ong ïa ki paid Judah bad ïa ka Jerusalem ban mane bad thang jingiwbih tang ha kawei ka duwan .
translation.en: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars , and commanded Judah and Jerusalem , saying , Ye shall worship before one altar , and burn incense upon it ?
And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u la bam bad u la kdang . Nangta ki synran ki la lum khat-ar tukri pura jong kaei kaba la sah tam .

Naba don ki briew ki bymriewblei jong ngi , kiba la syntuid noh khlem poi , briew kiba la ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingaiei jong U Blei jong ngi , khnang ban pynksan ïa la ki jingleh bajakhlia bad kiba kyntait U Jisu , uba long tang ma u hi U Kynrad bad U Trai jong ngi La bah , ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki la ïathuhlypa ïa kaba la ïohpdiang
translation.en: For there are certain men crept in unawares , who were before of old ordained to this condemnation , ungodly men , turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness , and denying the only Lord God , and our Lord Jesus Christ .
He lieth under the shady trees , in the covert of the reed , and fens .
translation.kha: U dem hapoh ki bniap shiah , bad u rieh hapdeng ki khah ha ki jaka sngem .

Phi la Athens shibun u kew , hynrei phi la ot tang khyndiat . Phi jingsyier ka bam ban shaiñ , hynrei kam biang kat ban pynkdang sah” phi . Phi don ryngkang waiñ ban dih , hynrei kam biang kat ban pynbuaid ïa phi jingpyrsad Phi don ki Ebeneser , hynrei kam biang kat ban pynsyaid ïa phi Haron Bad u nongtrei um lah ban kamai kat ban biang ban im .
translation.en: Ye have sown much , and bring in little  ; ye eat , but ye have not enough  ; ye drink , but ye are not filled with drink  ; ye clothe you , but there is none warm  ; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes .

translation.kha: haba mynta Hymenaïos Timothi bieit! la wanna khlaiñbor sha ngi , bad u la wanrah sha ngi ïa ka khubor kaba sngewkmen shaphang ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit jong phi :3 Bad U Husiar ïathuh ïa ngi ba phi ïai pyrkhat bha ïa ngi borabor ba pynsah kwah hir hir ban ïohi ïa jingïaishah kumba hajngai ngi ruh , ngi kwah ban ïohi ïa phi .
translation.en: But now when Timothy came from you unto us , and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity , and that ye have good remembrance of us always , desiring greatly to see us , as we also to see you :

translation.kha: U Blei ïohsngew u ïa ka jingïam uta u khunlung , bad na bneng u angel jong U Blei u kren ha ka Hagar , Ko , Hagar pha khuslai ïa-ei ? Wat sheptieng U . Blei u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam uta u khunlung .
translation.en: And God heard the voice of the lad  ; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven , and said unto her , What aileth thee , Hagar ? fear not  ; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is .

translation.kha: Baroh ki Benjamin kiba shah pynïap ha kata sngi ka ki long arphew san hajar ngut — baroh na ki , ki ki dei shipai bashlur .
translation.en: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword  ; all these were men of valour .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki la leit noh bad pynphriang ïa ka shaphang U kylleng jong ka bynta jong ri .
translation.en: But they , when they were departed , spread abroad his fame in all that country .

translation.kha: Ki Lebi kin ym ka jingdon jingem baneh ha , namar nga la ha ki kum bynta jong ki ka kaba shiphew ba ki Israel ki wanrah sha nga kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang . Dei namar kata ba nga la ïathuh ïa ki ba ym don ka jingdon jingem baneh ha Israel
translation.en: But the tithes of the children of Israel , which they offer as an heave offering unto the  Lord  , I have given to the Levites to inherit : therefore I have said unto them , Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance .

translation.kha: Um dei ruh ban pyntngit ïa ka jaka da kyntang kaba mih shabar jong ka ; naba la pynkyntang ïa u sha nga da kaba pynsleh umphniang . Nga long U . Trai
translation.en: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary , nor profane the sanctuary of his God  ; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him : I am the  Lord .
And when they were come up out of the water , the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip , that the eunuch saw him no more : and he went on his way rejoicing .
translation.kha: Haba ki la wan kiew na kata ka um , U Mynsiem jong U Trai u la rah noh ïa u Philip . U rangbah synshar um shym la ïohi shuh ïa u , hynrei u la bteng ïa la ka jingleit , uba dap da ka jingkmen .
Ki jubab , Lada phi lehsbun ïa ki bad phi pyrshang ban ïa ki , da kaba jubab kaba jem kin shakri hok ïa phi borabor .
translation.en: And they spake unto him , saying , If thou be kind to this people , and please them , and speak good words to them , they will be thy servants for ever .

translation.kha: U la ai ruh ha u ïa ki dur pynkhreh jong kita baroh kiba u don ka jingmut ïa ki phyllaw bad ki kamra sawdong jong ki bad ïa ki kamra buh ki tiar jong ka Templ , bad ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba la pynkyntang Trai .
translation.en: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit , of the courts of the house of the  Lord  , and of all the chambers round about , of the treasuries of the house of God , and of the treasuries of the dedicated things :
Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come , that they may lay hold on eternal life .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom kin kynshew ïa lade ka spah ka ban long ka nongrim kaba skhem na ka bynta ka lawei . Bad nangta kin lah ban jop ïa ka jingim kaba long ka jingim kaba shisha .

translation.en: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him , because he gave not God the glory : and he was eaten of worms , and gave up the ghost .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi u angel jong U Trai u la tied ïa u Herod , namar ba um shym ai burom ïa U Blei . La bam ïa u da ki ksaiñ , bad u la ïap .
Jerimoth sa Bam ma u .
translation.en: He will eat .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u tei ha u Lum Ebal ka ïa duwan ha U Trai , U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: Then Joshua built an altar unto the  Lord  God of Israel in mount Ebal ,

translation.kha: Ki ïalap ki shkor Bethpeor hynrei kim lah ban ïohsngew Atharim bad ki khmut , hynrei kim lah khroh iw .
translation.en: They have ears , but they hear not : noses have they , but they smell not :
But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved , even as they .
translation.kha: Em ! Ngi ngeit bad la pynim ïa ngi da ka jingaiei jong U Trai Jisu , kumba long ma ki .

Ki shipai na Persia , Lydia , Libya bad ki shakri ha ka kynhun shipai jong pha . Ki ïa wah ki stieh bad ïa jingïada ki khlieh jong ki ha ki jaka shong jong pha . Ki long ki rangbah kiba la pynïohburom ïa pha .
translation.en: They of Persia and of Lud and of Put were in thine army , thy men of war : they hanged the shield and helmet in thee  ; they set forth thy comeliness .

translation.kha: U rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw u leit rung shapoh ka Jaka kaba Kyntang man ka snem ryngkat bad snam ki mrad Hynrei U um shym la rung shapoh ban kñia ïa .
translation.en: Nor yet that he should offer himself often , as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others  ;

translation.kha: Mynta pynbud nga thung ïa me u shihajar halor Elsabad ri pynsait .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , See , I have set thee over all the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban kynmaw ïa ki ktien kiba ïa la kren lah slem bah da ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid , bad ka ïa hukum na U Trai bad U ïa Nongpynim kaba la ai ha phi da ki apostol .
translation.en: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets , and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour :

translation.kha: Da thmu bha bad phin ïoh kyrhai ; lada phi leh kyrkieh palat jingdon nym dap biang .
translation.en: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness  ; but of every one that is hasty only to want .

translation.kha: Ïa kane la leh ban pynurlong ka Jingthoh Bakhuid : Yn pynkheiñ ïa kawei ruh na ki jong u
translation.en: For these things were done , that the scripture should be fulfilled , A bone of him shall not be broken .
And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians : and it shall come to pass , that , when ye go , ye shall not go empty :
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ruh ïa ki nong Ijipt ba kin sngewburom ïa phi khnang ba ynda ki briew jong nga kin mih , kin ym mihnoh thylli .

translation.en: David therefore besought God for the child  ; and David fasted , and went in , and lay all night upon the earth .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la duwai ïa U Blei ba uta u khunlung un koit . Um treh bam ei ei , bad man ka miet u rung sha la ka kamra , bad u thiah ha madan baroh shi miet .
Wad ïa Khlemlait kumba phi wad ïa ka rupa lane ïa kano kano ka spah ba la buhrieh .
translation.en: If thou seekest her as silver , and searchest for her as for hid treasures  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa Ïaleh la pyllaitluid na ka pop bad phi long ki mraw jong Lukia Blei . Ka jingmyntoi riewlamler phi ka long ka nongïathuh ba la Jingpynïasuk lut sha u , bad Sodom jingmih ka Imlah ka jingim lyngkdop byrthen
translation.en: But now being made free from sin , and become servants to God , ye have your fruit unto holiness , and the end everlasting life .

translation.kha: haba U Trai un wan synshar ïa ka pyrthei . Un ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei da ka hok ka jinglehhok .
translation.en: Before the  Lord  : for he cometh , for he cometh to judge the earth : he shall judge the world with righteousness , and the people with his truth .
And the priest shall go forth out of the camp  ; and the priest shall look , and , behold , if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper  ;
translation.kha: bad u lyngdoh un ïalam ïa u shabar ka jaka shong dara , bad un khmih bha ïa u .

translation.en: For mine own sake , even for mine own sake , will I do it : for how should my name be polluted ? and I will not give my glory unto another .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga la leh na ka bynta jong nga hi — Ngan ym shah ba ïa ka kyrteng jong nga yn pynjahburom lane mano mano ban ïadon bynta lang ïa ka burom kaba dei ka jong nga bad ka jong nga hi .

translation.en: And men were scorched with great heat , and blasphemed the name of God , which hath power over these plagues : and they repented not to give him glory .
translation.kha: La thang ïa ki da ka jingshit tyrha kaba jur , bad ki la tim ïa ka kyrteng jong U Blei , uba don ka bor halor kine ki khlam . Hynrei kim shym phai noh na ki pop jong ki bad ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Sa kawei pat ka khubor ka la wan ha nga na U  Trai .
Hynrei ïa ki jaka phlang Beersheba don sawdong ki shnong jong Jokdeam kiba na ka jait Lebi , ym dei ban die syang ki , namar ki long ka hok kynti jong ki shi junom .
translation.en: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold  ; for it is their perpetual possession .

translation.kha: Kin bam duh ïa ki jingthung bad ïa ki jingbam jong ; kin pynïap ïa ki shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi . Kin pynïap ïa kynhun bad ki kynhun masi jong phi bad pynjot ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad diengsoh Dumbur jong phi . Ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh ha kiba shaniah da ka kynhun shipai jong ki
translation.en: And they shall eat up thine harvest , and thy bread , which thy sons and thy daughters should eat : they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds : they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees : they shall impoverish thy fenced cities , wherein thou trustedst , with the sword .
So Absalom fled , and went to Geshur , and was there three years .
translation.kha: U Absalom u la phet krad bad u la leit sha u Talmai , u khun jong u Ammihud , u syiem Geshur bad u la sah hangta lai snem . U Dabid u la ïambriew slem na ka bynta u Amnon u khun jong u ;
nangta Bad u la ïap haba u la tymmen bha .
translation.en: So Job died , being old and full of days .

translation.kha: khatkhyndai la kner ïa ka ksang ti badonbor jong u bad u la pynsakma ïa kiba sarong Seboim bad ki jingthmu jong ki .
translation.en: He hath shewed strength with his arm  ; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts .

translation.kha: Pyntngit Isaak u mihnoh nangta 72 u leit sha salia .
translation.en: And he went up from thence to Beer–sheba .
And Joseph also went up from Galilee , out of the city of Nazareth , into Judaea , unto the city of David , which is called Bethlehem  ; ( because he was of the house and lineage of David : )
translation.kha: U Joseph ruh u la leit na ka shnong Nasareth , kaba ha Galilaïa sha ka shnong Bethlehem ha Judia , ka jaka ha kaba la kha ïa syiem Dabid . U Joseph u la leit shata namar u la long uba hiarpateng na u Dabid .

translation.en: Except the God of my father , the God of Abraham , and the fear of Isaac , had been with me , surely thou hadst sent me away now empty . God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands , and rebuked thee yesternight .
translation.kha: Lada U Blei jong ki kpa jong nga , U Blei jong u Abraham bad u Isaak um shym la don ryngkat bad nga , phin jin da la phah thylli ïa nga . Hynrei U Blei u la ïohi ïa ka jingjynjar jong nga bad ïa ka jingtrei ba nga la pyndep , bad hynne mynmiet u la ai ïa ka jingbishar jong u .
Lada phi kloi phah ïa u para jong ngi bad ngi , ngin leit ïa phi .
translation.en: If thou wilt send our brother with us , we will go down and buy thee food :
I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness : and thou shalt know the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan bat ïa ka kular jong nga bad nga pynlong ïa pha ka jong nga , bad phan sa pdiang ïa nga kum U  Trai .

translation.en: Hear , O ye kings  ; give ear , O ye princes  ; I , even I , will sing unto the  Lord   ; I will sing praise to the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: To sngap , phi ki syiem ! Pynshahshkor , phi ki nongsynshar ! Ngan rwai bad tem jingtem ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
Trai ong , Kaei ka jingkynnoh ba ki kpa tymmen jong wanrah ïa nga ? Kaei kaba pynlong ïa ban phai noh na ? Ki la ïa ki bleithaw bymdondor ei ei bad ki ki la long ki bymdondor
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , What iniquity have your fathers found in me , that they are gone far from me , and have walked after vanity , and are become vain ?

translation.kha: lymne ka pyrthei shalor ka pyrthei sha tbian — don kano kano ha ki jingthaw ki ban lah lano lano ban pynïakhlad ngi ka jingieit U Blei kaba ha ngi lyngba U Jisu uba Trai jong ngi .
translation.en: Nor height , nor depth , nor any other creature , shall be able to separate us from the love of God , which is in Christ Jesus our Lord .
And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them :
translation.kha: Kumta ki khun shynrang u Jakob ki leh kumba u la hukum ïa ki ;
U Jeroboam um shym lah khie khlieh jingpynjia ha ka bor jong u ha ka Ammon ka jingsynshar jong u Abijah . Ha kaba khatduh U Trai sdang shoh ïap ïa u .
translation.en: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah : and the  Lord  struck him , and he died .
But thou , son of man , hear what I say unto thee  ; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house : open thy mouth , and eat that I give thee .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , sngap ïa kaei ba nga ong ha me . Wat ïaleh pyrshah kum ma ki . Ang ïa la ka shyntur bad bam ïa kaei kaba ngan ai ha me .
pa Uwei uwei u la bam bad u la kdang . Nangta synran ki ki la lum khat-ar tukri pura jong kaei kaba la sah tam .
translation.en: And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full .
He hath said , which heard the words of God , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :
translation.kha: Uba lah ban ïohsngew aïu U Blei u kren , Da ki khmat kiba peit nga ïohi ha ka jingïohi rngai Ka jingïohipaw na U Blei Badonbor .
rah Ka ïa ka ïing bad pynïap ïa ki baroh . Tang ma nga uba la lait im ban wan ïathuh ïa phi .
translation.en: And , behold , there came a great wind from the wilderness , and smote the four corners of the house , and it fell upon the young men , and they are dead  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .
Save that the high places were not removed : the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ym shym la pynjot , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .

translation.en: Wherefore say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Ye eat with the blood , and lift up your eyes toward your idols , and shed blood : and shall ye possess the land ?
translation.kha: To ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Phi bam ïa ka doh kaba dang bit snam ha ka . Phi mane ïa ki bleithaw . Phi pynïap briew . Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ka ri ka dei ka jong phi ?

Haba ka jingmudui aiñ ka mih , ki lyngdoh Miletos ai jingrai ïa ka shatei-lam-mihngi kat kum ki aiñ jong nga . Kin pynïaid ïa ki jinglehniam kat kum ki aiñ bad jingrakhe jingbuhbeit ryntih jong nga , don kin rakhe khuid ïa ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment  ; and they shall judge it according to my judgments : and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies  ; and they shall hallow my sabbaths .

translation.kha: Nga don hangne ha ka pyrthei tang shipor ; wat ïa buhrieh ki hukum jong me na nga .
translation.en: I am a stranger in the earth : hide not thy commandments from me .

translation.kha: Nga tynjuh ïa la ki briew , bad lada ki kyntait ban kylla-kaba-mut , kine kiei baroh kiei kin wan jia ha ki .
translation.en: Because it is a trial , and what if the sword contemn even the rod ? it shall be no more , saith the Lord  God .
And he said unto them ,  Know ye not this parable ? and how then will ye know all parables ?
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki ,  Hato phim sngewthuh ïa kane ka pharshi ? Kumno , te phi lah ban sngewthuh ïa kiwei pat ki pharshi ?
To kynmaw , A Blei , ba ka jingim jong nga ka long tang ka jynhaw , ka jingsuk jong nga ka la kut noh .
translation.en: O remember that my life is wind : mine eye shall no more see good .
Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword , destroying it utterly , and all that is therein , and the cattle thereof , with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: pynïap lut khoit ïa ki briew baroh ha kata ka shnong bad ïa ki jingri jong ki baroh ruh . Pynjot de thiaw ïa kata ka shnong .
Kumta syiem Dabid u phah shaw ïa u .
translation.en: Then king David sent , and fetched him out of the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , from Lo–debar .

translation.kha: Um shym la pynïapher ei ei hapdeng jong ngi bad ki ; u la map ki ïa pop jong ki namar ba ki la ngeit .
translation.en: And put no difference between us and them , purifying their hearts by faith .
Therefore , son of man , prophesy and say unto Gog , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely , shalt thou not know it ?
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la phah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha u Gog ïa kaei kaba u ong ïa u :  Mynta katba ki Israel , ki briew jong nga ki dang shong ha ka jingsngewskhem ,

translation.en: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God , and said , Behold , if the  Lord  would make windows in heaven , might this thing be ? And he said , Behold , thou shalt see it with thine eyes , but shalt not eat thereof .
translation.kha: U nongbud ba-hajan jong u syiem u la ong ha u Elisha ,  Kata kam lah ban jia — em wat lada U  Trai  da lade hi un phah shisien phah ïa u kew !  U Elisha u jubab ,  Men sa ïohi ïa kata ba ka jia , hynrei men ym ïoh bam na kata ka jingbam .

translation.en: In thee , O  Lord  , do I put my trust : let me never be put to confusion .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , nga la wan ha me ban ïoh jingïada ; wat shah da lei lei ba ngan shahjop !
Hynrei U Jisu u kyntait ban jubab wat tang shikyntien kaba da pynlyngngoh shikatdei eh u lyngskor .
translation.en: And he answered him to never a word  ; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly .

translation.kha: nga lyng-a bad khuslai , me pyntngen bad pynkmen ïa nga .
translation.en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul .

But Saul and the people spared Agag , and the best of the sheep , and of the oxen , and of the fatlings , and the lambs , and all that was good , and would not utterly destroy them : but every thing that was vile and refuse , that they destroyed utterly .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Saul bad ki rangbah jong u ki pynsah im ïa u Agag , bad kim shym pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba kynsai tam , ïa ki khun masi bad ki khunlangbrot kiba kynsai tam , bad ïa kano kano kaba kordor ; ki la pynjot tang ïa kata ka bymlarkam ne bymdonkam ei ei shuh .

translation.en: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove , and would have set them at one again , saying , Sirs , ye are brethren  ; why do ye wrong one to another ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la ïohi ar ngut ki Israel kiba dang ïashoh , bad u la pyrshang ban pynïasuk ïa ki u da ong , ‘ Shahshkor , ko rangbah ,’ u la ong , ‘ phi ïalong para Israel ; balei ba phi ïashoh kumne ?’

translation.en: By the breath of God frost is given : and the breadth of the waters is straitened .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jong U Blei ka pyndait thah ïa ki um , bad ka pynkylla thah ïa ki .

translation.en: And said unto him , Take these vessels , go , carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem , and let the house of God be builded in his place .
translation.kha: U patsha u ong ïa u ban rah ïa ki bad pynphai sha ka Templ ha Jerusalem bad ban tei pat ïa ka Templ ha ka jaka ba ka la ïeng mynshuwa .

translation.en: They are passed away as the swift ships : as the eagle that hasteth to the prey .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong nga ka ïaid kum ka lieng kaba stet tam , kum ka jingstet u pukni uba suh kynsan shapoh ban kynrup ïa ka rabbit .

translation.en: I desired Titus , and with him I sent a brother . Did Titus make a gain of you ? walked we not in the same spirit ? walked we not in the same steps ?
translation.kha: Nga la kyrpad ïa u Titos ban leit , bad nga la phah ïa uwei pat u parabangeit bad u . Hato phi lah ban ong ba u Titos u la shim kabu ïa phi ? Hato ma u bad ma nga ngim shym la leh na kijuh hi ki jingthmu bad leh ha kajuh ka rukom ?

Politics kiba leit khiah Ijipt ban ïoh rah Akhsah jot .—Hebru Deuteronomi shaniah ha ka bor shipai bakhraw jong ka sngi! — ki kulai , .—Proberb kali thehsei Sigurd bad ki shipai khyllung Hynrei sohshnong krad ban shaniah ha U Trai , U Blei Bakhuid ki Adah , Parthia pan na u ïa ka jingïarap .
translation.en: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help  ; and stay on horses , and trust in chariots , because they are many  ; and in horsemen , because they are very strong  ; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel , neither seek the  Lord  !

translation.kha: mynta U U jong nga u la ai ha nga ka jingshongsuk ha baroh ki ki sam jong nga Ngam don nongshun , bad kam don kano jingma jong ka jingshah tur ïaleh .
translation.en: But now the  Lord  my God hath given me rest on every side , so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent .
The heart is deceitful above all things , and desperately wicked : who can know it ?
translation.kha: Mano ba lah ban shemphang ïa ka dohnud briew ? Ym don kano kano kawei pat kaba shukor katta katta ; ka pang jur eh ban ïa kaba ïoh jingkoit .

translation.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture , and the laver and his foot ,
translation.kha: ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh , ïa ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka ,
Ko Jeremaïah , tynjuh ïa ki briew nga kumba men tynjuh ïa ka nar , bad ïit ki long kiba
translation.en: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people , that thou mayest know and try their way .
Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him ?
translation.kha: Hato phi la ju tip ba don uno uno na ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ne uwei u Pharisi kiba ngeit ha u ?

Haba u Jakob bad katno ïing Kita u iohnong hikai sha Tip , bad ki nong Ijipt ki banbeiñ ïa ki , ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki kyang ban ïoh jingïasuk sha U basma , bad pynkyndeh Trai u phah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , kiba la wan ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt Jingïakajia pynshong pynsah ïa ki pyningkhong shisyndon ka ri .
translation.en: When Jacob was come into Egypt , and your fathers cried unto the  Lord  , then the  Lord  sent Moses and Aaron , which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt , and made them dwell in this place .

translation.kha: U Blei u ai ki jingjop bakhraw ha u syiem jong u ; u ka baïaineh ha uba la , ha u bad ha khun ksiew jong u junom .
translation.en: He is the tower of salvation for his king : and sheweth mercy to his anointed , unto David , and to his seed for evermore .

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga ïa kiba U Blei u la khot To ! pyrkhat ïa U Jisu , ïa uba U Blei u la phah long ban U Rangbah Lyngdoh jong ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïaphla .
translation.en: Wherefore , holy brethren , partakers of the heavenly calling , consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession , Christ Jesus  ;

translation.kha: Phi dei borabor ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba nga la thoh na ka jong phi . Phim dei ban kohnguh ïa kiwei ki blei ,
translation.en: And the statutes , and the ordinances , and the law , and the commandment , which he wrote for you , ye shall observe to do for evermore  ; and ye shall not fear other gods .

translation.kha: pynsangeh u paidbah u dang ïaid da-ei Nain ha ka jingshem kaba Haba , ki Bethgamul kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai ki ïeng ha ka laitluid hapdeng jong ka Jordan lyngngoh Kenas ba uta u paidbah un da jam sha shiliang .
translation.en: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan , and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground , until all the people were passed clean over Jordan .

translation.kha: pynïap lut khoit ïa ki briew baroh ha kata ka shnong ïa ki jingri jong ki baroh ruh . Pynjot de thiaw ïa kata ka shnong .
translation.en: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword , destroying it utterly , and all that is therein , and the cattle thereof , with the edge of the sword .

translation.kha: Ale hangne ban shah bishar , pynkhuid phi ki nongpop ! Phim long kham bha trai ïa snep Girsi byrtong , kiba klim Halah ki Humtah .
translation.en: But draw near hither , ye sons of the sorceress , the seed of the adulterer and the whore .

And he said , Take now thy son , thine only son Isaac , whom thou lovest , and get thee into the land of Moriah  ; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of .
translation.kha: Shim ïa u khun jong me ,  U Blei u ong ,  u Isaak , u khun ba tang marwei jong me , ïa uba me ieit thep mynsiem , bad leit sha ka ri Moraïah . Hangta halor u lum ïa uba ngan sa pyn-i ha me , kñia ïa u kum ka jingainguh ha nga .
Kumta u angel u la pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi ha ka pyrthei , la u ïa ot ki sohwaiñ na uta u dieng sohwaiñ , bad u la bret ïa ki sha jaka ka khñiot waiñ jong ka jingbitar shla jong U Blei .
translation.en: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth , and gathered the vine of the earth , and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God .

translation.kha: Kine ki Garnet kim pynïar buaid , kumba theisamla tharai ; ka dang khyndai baje mynstep .
translation.en: For these are not drunken , as ye suppose , seeing it is but the third hour of the day .

translation.kha: Hynrei kine ha ki jaka phin ïohsngew biang ïa ki jingpyrta jong ka jingkmen bad ka bad jinglehkmen jingsawa ki bakmen jong ki jingïabam khawai shongkurim . Phin ïohsngew ba ki briew ïarwai ki katba ki wallam ïa ki jingainguh thang sha Templ ka jong nga ; kin ïa-ong , ‘ To ainguh ïa U Trai Badonbor Baroh , namar u long uba bha bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut Ngan .’ pynlong kane ïa ka ri kaba roi kyrhai kumba mynshuwa . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: The voice of joy , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride , the voice of them that shall say , Praise the  Lord  of hosts : for the  Lord  is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever : and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the  Lord . For I will cause to return the captivity of the land , as at the first , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka Ruth Ngan leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi ong .
translation.en: And she said unto her , All that thou sayest unto me I will do .

translation.kha: Hadien ba kito kiba don ha ka lieng ki la jingker kham slem khlem bam Mynshuwa u krong u ngor ïeng ha khmat jong ki Maim u la ong , Ko rangbah , phi la dei ban shahshkor ïa nga bad ban ym leit noh na Krit Phibi te ngin jin da la lah kiar ïa kane ka jingjulor bad ka jingduh .
translation.en: But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them , and said , Sirs , ye should have hearkened unto me , and not have loosed from Crete , and to have gained this harm and loss .
And Solomon told her all her questions : and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not .
translation.kha: U jubab ïa ki baroh ; ym don kano kano kaba eh than kaba um lah ban batai .

U la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai bad u ong ha u Joab , U syiem u hukum ba men mih shabar . Em , u u , ngan ïap hangne . U Benaïah u la leit phai sha u syiem bad ïathuh ha ïa kaei ba u Joab la ong .
translation.en: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the  Lord  , and said unto him , Thus saith the king , Come forth . And he said , Nay  ; but I will die here . And Benaiah brought the king word again , saying , Thus said Joab , and thus he answered me .

translation.kha: Bad haba U Trai u dup pyndep ïa kiei Borbah’ kiba bha baroh krem Ono la kular pynsabut phi bad ba Sebadaïah la Lodebar ïa phi u syiem ki Israel mawkyrdon
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when the  Lord  shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee , and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel  ;

translation.kha: U angel uba samrkhie u la leit bad u la theh basah ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka ñiangkulia . Ki prum kiba shyrkhei bad kiba tyrha ki la mih pynkyndit kito kiba la don Hirah ka shab jong u mradkhlaw bad ha kito kiba la mane ïa ka dur jong u .
translation.en: And the first went , and poured out his vial upon the earth  ; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast , and upon them which worshipped his image .

translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong baroh u , kumba la thoh ha ka Aiñ u Moses , khnang haba ba me leit shano shano me lah ban manbha ha kaei kaei kaba me leh .
translation.en: And keep the charge of the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , to keep his statutes , and his commandments , and his judgments , and his testimonies , as it is written in the law of Moses , that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest , and whithersoever thou turnest thyself :
Harden not your hearts , as in the provocation , in the day of temptation in the wilderness :
translation.kha: wat pyneh ïa la ka dohnud , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la long haba ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei , kumba ki la long ha kata ka sngi ha ka ri shyiap haba ki la tynjuh ïa U .

translation.en: Ye daughters of Israel , weep over Saul , who clothed you in scarlet , with other delights , who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel .
translation.kha: Ko kynthei Israel , to ïam namar u Saul ! Uba la pynkup ïa phi da ki jaiñ saw syn-iang , Bad u la pyndeng ïa phi da ki mawlynnai bad ka ksiar .
Ngi tip ba U Blei u leh ïa kaba dei haba u bishar ïa briew ki kiba leh ïa kiei kiei kum kine .
translation.en: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things .

translation.kha: U Trai un leit rah pynryngkang jingtim bad ïa u syiem jong phi sha Arimathaïa ri nongwei , ha kaba ma phi lane ki kpa ïaishah jong phi lin pat ju poi ; jingkah shida shakri ïa ki blei kiba da u dieng bad da u map .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall bring thee , and thy king which thou shalt set over thee , unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known  ; and there shalt thou serve other gods , wood and stone .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki ki la shah knieh noh ka bor ki , hynrei la shah ban im shipor .
translation.en: As concerning the rest of the beasts , they had their dominion taken away : yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbishar hok la khynraw noh , bad ka hok kam lah ban wan hajan . Ka haei kurim kyllon ha ki lynti shnong , bad ka hok kam don jaka hangta .
translation.en: And judgment is turned away backward , and justice standeth afar off : for truth is fallen in the street , and equity cannot enter .

translation.kha: lah ban Phi pynngat ïa kiwei pat ki jait dieng bad pyndonkam ïa ki ha kaba tei ïa ki kynton ïada pyrshah ïa kata ka shnong haduh ba kan da kyllon .
translation.en: Only the trees which thou knowest that they be not trees for meat , thou shalt destroy and cut them down  ; and thou shalt build bulwarks against the city that maketh war with thee , until it be subdued .

translation.kha: Don arspah lyngraw ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba dei peit ïa ki nongtrei ba la Mawsiang ban sniehdoh ïa kiba pynthaba Gath jingtei .
translation.en: And these were the chief of king Solomon s officers , even two hundred and fifty , that bare rule over the people .
Then was the part of the hand sent from him  ; and this writing was written .
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei U Blei u la phah ïa ka kti ban thoh ïa kine ki kyntien .

translation.en: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels . Let now the astrologers , the stargazers , the monthly prognosticators , stand up , and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee .
translation.kha: Pha long kaba khlem bor wat la pha ïoh ïa ka jingai jingmut . To ai ba ki nongbatai kupar kin wan sha khmat ban pyllait im ïa pha — kito ki briew kiba wad jingtip shaphang ki khlur , kiba pruid dak ïa ki bynta jong ki bneng bad ïathuh ïa pha na uwei u bnai sha uwei pat kaei ka ban jia ïa pha .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he made mention of the ark of God , that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate , and his neck brake , and he died : for he was an old man , and heavy . And he had judged Israel forty years .
translation.kha: Haba uta u rangbah u ïathuh shaphang ka Synduk ka Jutang , u Eli u kyllon da lyndang na la ka jaka shong kaba harud khyrdop . U la tymmen palat bad sngaid bad kata ka jinghap ka la pynkheiñ ïa u ryndang jong u , bad u la ïap . U la long u nongïalam ha Israel sawphew snem .

translation.en: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos , they found a certain sorcerer , a false prophet , a Jew , whose name was Bar–jesus :
translation.kha: Ki la ïaid sha shiliang ka dewlynnong sha Paphos , ha kaba ki la ïakynduh ïa uwei u nongleh myntor uba kyrteng u Bar Jisu , u Jiw uba la kam ba u long u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: I the  Lord  have said , I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation , that are gathered together against me : in this wilderness they shall be consumed , and there they shall die .
translation.kha: Nga smai ba ngan leh ïa kane ha phi u paidlang bymman uba la ïalumlang ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Hangne ha ka ri khlaw uwei pa uwei na phi un ïap . Nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .’

translation.en: And he , casting away his garment , rose , and came to Jesus .
translation.kha: U la bret noh ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , u la rynsied , bad u la wan sha U Jisu .

To bat ïa kaei kaba phi ngeit shaphang kynram ka kam , ba-sngewtriem jong phi bad jingbit Blei . Suk uta :28 briew u bym kwah ïa jingbitar jingpynrem haba u leh ïa kaei kaei kaba u bishar ba ka long sih dei Dabid
translation.en: Hast thou faith ? have it to thyself before God . Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth .

translation.kha: Mynta hangne , kane briew ka kaba hiarpateng na u Abraham ïa kaba u Soitan u la khum la khatphra snem ; hato ym dei ban pyllait ïa ha ka ka sngi Sabbaton ?
translation.en: And ought not this woman , being a daughter of Abraham , whom Satan hath bound , lo , these eighteen years , be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day ?
And he put the table in the tent of the congregation , upon the side of the tabernacle northward , without the veil .
translation.kha: U buh ïa ka miej hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei , shabar kata ka pyrda ,
Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba ma phi bad ma nga ngin ïoh ka jingïarap ha kajuh ka por , ma phi da ka jingngeit nga jong bad ma nga da ka jong . phi
translation.en: That is , that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me .

translation.kha: Ki nongap Gerar ki la ïakajia bad ki nongap jong u Isaak , bad ki ong ka um ka dei ka . Kumta u Isaak u khot kyrteng ïa kata ka pukri Ka Jingïakajia .
translation.en: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac s herdmen , saying , The water is ours : and he called the name of the well Esek  ; because they strove with him .

translation.kha: Me long kum u dieng Kedar ka Lebanon , lem bad ki tnat Manla itynnat bad ba kah pyndonkam , u dieng uba jrong katta katta uba kot haduh ki lyoh .
translation.en: Behold , the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches , and with a shadowing shroud , and of an high stature  ; and his top was among the thick boughs .

translation.kha: U u la lah ban pynjuh u la pynjuh ïa baroh kiwei pat ki jait jingthaw — ki mradkhlaw bad ki sim , ki mrad bapar bad dohkha .
translation.en: For every kind of beasts , and of birds , and of serpents , and of things in the sea , is tamed , and hath been tamed of mankind :
This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee , and manifested forth his glory  ; and his disciples believed on him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leh ïa kane ka kambah kaba nyngkong ha Kana ha Galilaïa ; hangta , u la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong u , bad ki synran jong u ki la ngeit ha u .

translation.en: Wherefore I say unto you , All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men : but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ba ki briew ki lah ban ïohmap ïa kano kano ka pop bad ïa kano kano kaba sniew kaba ki ong ; hynrei uno uno uba kren kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid un ym ïoh jingmap .
‘ Nga long kot Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isaak , bad U Blei jong u Jakob .’ U long U pynlyngngoh jong ïadep im bad ym jong kiba ïap .
translation.en: I am the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob ? God is not the God of the dead , but of the living .
Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel , and the captains of thousands and of hundreds , with the rulers of the king s work , offered willingly ,
translation.kha: Te ki rangbah kur , ki rangbah synshar jong ki jait , ki nongai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai , bad ki nongpynïaid ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u syiem da la ka mon sngewbha ki ai

Kawei na Hanan pakor la ïohsngew Nepheg ngi ka dei ïakylliang Lydia kaba na Thiatira Nongpynim ka jingtyrha ka nongdie pyniapher ka tyrso sawbthuh . Ka long ïakhih briew Heth mane ïa U Blei , bad U Trai u la plie ïa ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong Jeraïah Turkwois pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba u Paul u ong .
translation.en: And a certain woman named Lydia , a seller of purple , of the city of Thyatira , which worshipped God , heard us : whose heart the Lord opened , that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul .
In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong na kita ki sngi , phin ïalumlang ban mane Blei , phim dei ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam kaba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .

Uei u shipai uba ju kabu’ ban siew ïa la ki jingpynlut ha ka kam lamler ? siasia u nongrep u bym bam ïa ki kah na la ka Jearim sohwaiñ ? Uei u nongaplangbrot u jingbymdei pyndonkam ïa ka dud na la ki jong ki Mikhmethath ïakular
translation.en: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges ? who planteth a vineyard , and eateth not of the fruit thereof ? or who feedeth a flock , and eateth not of the milk of the flock ?

Moreover the spirit lifted me up , and brought me unto the east gate of the  Lord s  house , which looketh eastward : and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men  ; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur , and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah , princes of the people .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah ïa nga shajrong bad u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop mihngi jong ka Templ . Hangta hajan jong ka khyrdop nga la ïohi arphew san ngut ki rangbah kynthup ïa u Jaasanaïah u khun jong u Assur bad u Pelataïah u khun jong u Benaïah , ki ar ngut ki nongïalam jong ka jaitbynriew .
Em , ha kine Regemmelekh ngi ïoh ïa ka jingjop baroh lyngba jong uta uba la ieit ïa ngi!
translation.en: Nay , in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us .

translation.kha: Ki la ïohi kaei ïa kaba U Trai u lah ban leh , ki kam baphylla jong u ha ki duriaw-rit .
translation.en: These see the works of the  Lord  , and his wonders in the deep .
Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga ,

translation.en: All these things did Araunah , as a king , give unto the king . And Araunah said unto the king , The  Lord  thy God accept thee .
translation.kha: U Araunah u la ai lut ha u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  To U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong phi .

translation.en: And Jesus looking upon them saith ,  With men it is impossible , but not with God : for with God all things are possible .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la khmih shaiñ ha ki bad u la jubab ,  Kane ka long ka bym lah ïa u briew , hynrei ym ïa U Blei ; kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba lah ïa U Blei .
nga mynta ba nga la ; wat iehnoh ïa nga mynta ba nga la tlot
translation.en: Cast me not off in the time of old age  ; forsake me not when my strength faileth .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki , kyrteng u Kleopas , la kylli ïa u , Hato me long ma me uba wan sha Jerusalem u bymtip ïa kiei kiba la lah jia hangta ha ki khyndiat ba la leit ?
translation.en: And the one of them , whose name was Cleopas , answering said unto him , Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem , and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days ?

translation.kha: Nga la kylli , Jingïashun Aïu ngan leh sleh A Trai ïapynbiang bad U Trai u la ong ha nga , ‘ Ïeng Geshem jingiehnoh ïa-rai sha Damaskos , nongsharai hangta yn sa ïathuh ïa Akhsah kaei baroh khublei U Blei muhor la kurup na ka bynta jong me ban kulai .’
translation.en: And I said , What shall I do , Lord ? And the Lord said unto me ,  Arise , and go into Damascus  ; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do .

Say unto them , Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations , that goeth unto the holy things , which the children of Israel hallow unto the  Lord  , having his uncleanness upon him , that soul shall be cut off from my presence : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong phi , katba u dang long u bymkhuid , u wan hajan ki jingainguh kiba kyntang ïa kiba ki Israel ki la pynkyntang sha nga , un ym lah shuh lano lano ruh ban shakri ha kata ka duwan . Kane kan ïailong kumta pateng la pateng . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: This is that Moses , which said unto the children of Israel , A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren , like unto me  ; him shall ye hear .
translation.kha: U Moses u long uta uba la kren ha ki paid Israel , ‘ U Blei un phah ha phi ïa u nongïathuhlypa , kumba u la phah ïa nga , bad un long uba napdeng ki briew jong phi .’

translation.en: And at that time shall Michael stand up , the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people : and there shall be a time of trouble , such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time : and at that time thy people shall be delivered , every one that shall be found written in the book .
translation.kha: U angel uba kup ki jaiñ linen u la ong ,  Ha kata ka por , u Mikhael , u angel uba khraw , uba ïada ïa ki briew jong me , un mihpaw . Nangta kan don ka por ki jingjynjar , kaba kham sniew tam naduh ba ki jaitbynriew ki mih . Haba kata ka por ka wan , baroh ki briew jong ka jaitbynriew jong me kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki la thoh ha ka kitab ka jong U Blei yn pynim .
Ko paid Israel , to ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Hato nga la kum ka ri shyiap ïa phi , kum ka ri kaba dum bad kaba ma ? Balei te ba phi ong ba phin leh kaba phi sngewbha , phin ym phai nga ?
translation.en: O generation , see ye the word of the  Lord . Have I been a wilderness unto Israel ? a land of darkness ? wherefore say my people , We are lords  ; we will come no more unto thee ?

translation.kha: Kumta jingsah khanatang shiphew ngut ki hynmen shynrang ar kmie jong u Joseph ki la ïaleit sha Ijipt ban tmoh kew ,
translation.en: And Joseph s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt .

There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families  ; for the children of Abiezer , and for the children of Helek , and for the children of Asriel , and for the children of Shechem , and for the children of Hepher , and for the children of Shemida : these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jaka ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la ai ïa ki longïing kiba sah na ka jait Manasseh : u Abieser , u Helek , u Asriel , u Shekhem , u Hepher , bad u Shemida . Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u Manasseh , u khun jong u Joseph bad ki long ki khlieh jong ki longïing .

translation.en: And he answering said unto him , Lord , let it alone this year also , till I shall dig about it , and dung it :
translation.kha: Hynrei u nongsumar kper u la jubab , ‘ Iehnoh shuwa , ko kynrad , sa tang shisnem ; ngan tih sawdong jong u bad ai sboh katto katne .
U Paul u la ïeng joit , u la ai dak da la kti ka , bad la u sdang ban : kren Ko ki para Israel bad ko ki Jentil baroh hangne kiba mane ïa U Blei : To shahshkor ïa nga !
translation.en: Then Paul stood up , and beckoning with his hand said , Men of Israel , and ye that fear God , give audience .

And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn among you , that eateth any manner of blood  ; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood , and will cut him off from among his people .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u Israel , lane uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong ki , u bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam ha ka , U  Trai  un phai pyrshah ïa u bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .
Kohnguh ïa ki Hattaabah , khnang ba phin manbha , bad ba phin im slem ha kata ka ri kaba phin sa ïohkynti Nain
translation.en: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the  Lord  your God hath commanded you , that ye may live , and that it may be well with you , and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess .
Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Man ka snem ha kine ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam , ki shynrang baroh ki dei ban wan mane ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: The rich man s wealth is his strong city , and as an high wall in his own conceit .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba riewspah , pynban , ki mutdur ba ka spah jong ki ka ïada ïa ki kum ki kynroh bajrong bakhlaiñ sawdong ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: Yea , ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch , and the star of your god Remphan , figures which ye made to worship them : and I will carry you away beyond Babylon .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka ïingjaiñ jong u blei Molekh uba phi la bah , bad ka dur jong u Rephan , u blei khlur jong phi ; ki la long ki bleithaw kiba phi la thaw ïa ka ban mane . Bad kumta ngan phah ïa phi sha ka jinglongmraw sha palat ka Babilon .’

translation.en: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel , saying , In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb , according to the house of their fathers , a lamb for an house :
translation.kha: Ai ïa kine ki jingbthah ha u paid Israel baroh : ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong une u bnai , uwei pa uwei u rangbah un jied ïa u khunlangbrot lane ïa u khunblang na ka bynta la ka jong ka ïing .
To ïaroh ïa Trai ! To rwai ka jingrwai bathymmai ïa U Trai ; to ïaroh ïa u ha ka jingïaseng lang jong ki briew baïaineh jong u
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Sing unto the  Lord  a new song , and his praise in the congregation of saints .

Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces , and they were two hundred and thirty two : and after them he numbered all the people , even all the children of Israel , being seven thousand .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u la khot ïa kita ki shipai samla kiba long hapoh ki nongai hukum jong ki distrik , kiba don arspah laiphew ar ngut baroh . Nangta u la khot ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel , kaba don hynñiew hajar ngut ki rangbah .

translation.en: And they took Lot , Abram s brother s son , who dwelt in Sodom , and his goods , and departed .
translation.kha: U Lot , u pyrsa jong u Abram , u la shong la sah ha Sodom , kumta ki la shim ïa u lem bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u baroh .

translation.en: Like as a woman with child , that draweth near the time of her delivery , is in pain , and crieth out in her pangs  ; so have we been in thy sight , O  Lord .
translation.kha: Ma me A  Trai  , me la pynlong ïa ngi ban lynñiar , kum ka briew kaba lynñiar ha ka jingsuh kha .
Don ki pyrsad kiba la phai lum noh na kine bad mynsiem Puson jah lynti ha ki jingïatainia ba-bieit .
translation.en: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling ;

translation.kha: Ki briew ki plied ïa la ki pla pisa ïa-ot ki theh shabar ïa ka ksiar ; Aner Misraim ïa ka rupa ha Kynriah tarajur . Ki ainong ïa u bania ban shna durblei ; nangta ki dem ngon bad mane ïa pynjop Nongthaw
translation.en: They lavish gold out of the bag , and weigh silver in the balance , and hire a goldsmith  ; and he maketh it a god : they fall down , yea , they worship .

translation.kha: Phin sa long uba stad , ka jingtip jong phi ai jingkmen phi .
translation.en: When wisdom entereth into thine heart , and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul  ;

translation.kha: hynrei tang u rangbah lyngdoh uba rung sha ka bynta kaba shapoh jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad u leh kumta tang shisien shisnem . U rah bad u ïa ka snam ïa kaba u ainguh ha U Blei na ka bynta ïa lade bad na ka ki bynta ba pop ki briew ki leh khlem sngewthuh ba ki la leh pop .
translation.en: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year , not without blood , which he offered for himself , and for the errors of the people :

translation.kha: La thang shibun ki sharak ha ka kamra ba haneng ha ki kaba la ïalang .
translation.en: And there were many lights in the upper chamber , where they were gathered together .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki leit phai sha ka jaka shong . dara
translation.en: And Moses gat him into the camp , he and the elders of Israel .
Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east  ; and it was shut .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop kaba kham shabar ha ka bynta bashaphang mihngi jong ka Templ .

Ha Joppa la don kaba kyrteng ka Tabitha , kaba long ka riewngeit . ( kyrteng jong ka ha ka Grik ka long ka Dorkas , mut ka ) Ka la pynlut ïa ka por jong baroh ha kaba leh babha bad ha kaba ïarap ïa kiba duk .
translation.en: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha , which by interpretation is called Dorcas : this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did .
And she said , Oh my lord , as thy soul liveth , my lord , I am the woman that stood by thee here , praying unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka Hannah ka ong ha u ,  Ko kynrad ! Phi dang kynmaw mo ïa nga ? Nga dei kato ka briew kaba phi ïohi kaba ïeng hangne kaba duwai ha U  Trai .
luin sa Plie
translation.en: Will open
For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory ; why yet am I also judged as a sinner ?
