Judah , thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise : thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies  ; thy father s children shall bow down before thee .
translation.kha: Judah , ki hynmen ki para jong me kin ïaroh ïa me ; Me shim na ka ryndang ïa ki nongshun jong me ; Ki hynmen ki para jong me kin nguh kin dem ïa phi .

translation.en: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body , whether we be Jews or Gentiles , whether we be bond or free ; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , baroh na ngi , la ngi long ki Jiw ne ki Jentil , ki mraw ne kiba laitluid , la pynbaptis ha kawei ka met da ujuh U Mynsiem , bad la ai ha ngi ïa ujuh U Mynsiem ban ïoh dih .

Nga la ong , Hato u syiem Jehoïakhin u la kylla long kum u khra uba la pait uba la noh bad u bym don ba kwah shuh mano mano ? Hato ka long balei ba ma u ïa ki khun jong u la ringmraw sha ka ri tip ei ei ?
translation.en: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol ? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure ? wherefore are they cast out , he and his seed , and are cast into a land which they know not ?

translation.kha: U un Trai wan bad ka ding . Un shong ha ki thapniang jong ka erïong , ban pynshitom ïa kito kiba u la bitar .
translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  will come with fire , and with his chariots like a whirlwind , to render his anger with fury , and his rebuke with flames of fire .

translation.kha: Haba u Absalom hynmen u jong ka u la ïohi ïa ka , u la kylli , Hato u Amnon u la kti ktah ïa phi ? Sngewbha , ko hep , wat shah ba kata kan pynsngewsih shibun ïa phi . U dei u ba shi ïalong para bad phi na ijuh i pa , kumta te wat ïathuh hano hano shaphang kata . Kumta Tamar ka ka la sah ka ha ïing jong u , Absalom ka da sngewsih bad sngew marwei .
translation.en: And Absalom her brother said unto her , Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee ? but hold now thy peace , my sister : he is thy brother  ; regard not this thing . So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom s house .
Gather the pieces thereof into it , even every good piece , the thigh , and the shoulder  ; fill it with the choice bones .
translation.kha: To thep ïa ki dkhot doh kiba kynsai tam — ki tyrpeng bad ki kjat — pyndap ïa u ruh da ki kyrkhoit shyieng ba la jied .

translation.en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle , and his candle shall be put out with him .
translation.kha: Ïa ka sharak ha ka ïingjaiñ jong u yn pyndum .

translation.en: Pass ye over to Tarshish  ; howl , ye inhabitants of the isle .
translation.kha: To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki briew ka Phoenisia ! Pyrshang ban phet ïap sha Spain !

Nangta u Jonathan u ong ha u Dabid U , Blei un don ryngkat bad phi . U Trai un pynthikna ba nga ma bad ma phi , bad kiba hiarpateng na phi bad kiba hiarpateng na nga , kin bat ïa ka kular bakyntang kaba ngi la pynlong iwei ïa iwei . Nangta Dabid u u leit noh , bad u Jonathan u leit phai pat sha shnong .
translation.en: And Jonathan said to David , Go in peace , forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  be between me and thee , and between my seed and thy seed for ever . And he arose and departed : and Jonathan went into the city .

And he cried unto the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  shewed him a tree , which when he had cast into the waters , the waters were made sweet : there he made for them a statute and an ordinance , and there he proved them ,
translation.kha: U Moses u kyrpad jur ïa U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u pyn-i ha u ïa uwei u lyngkhot dieng , ïa uba u la bret hapoh ka um ; bad ka um ka la kylla long kaba bit ban dih . Dei hangta ba U  Trai  u ai ha ki ïa ki aiñ ba kin bud , bad dei hangta ruh ba u la tynjuh ïa ki .

translation.en: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together , and made them captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , according to the houses of their fathers , throughout all Judah and Benjamin : and he numbered them from twenty years old and above , and found them three hundred thousand choice men , able to go forth to war , that could handle spear and shield .
translation.kha: U Syiem Amasaïah u pynbeit ïa baroh ki rangbah jong ki jait Judah bad Benjamin ha ki kynhun shipai , kat kum ki kur jong ki , bad u la buh ki rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka jingai hukum ïa ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut . Kane ka kynthup ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba arphew snem ne kham ïaw , baroh ki long lai lakh ngut . Ki long ki shipai ba la jied , kiba la kloi ban ïaleh thma , kiba tbit ban pyndonkam ïa ki sum bad ki stieh .
Kumta yn don tylli phra ki jingker bad khathynriew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei kawei ka jingker .
translation.en: And they shall be eight boards , and their sockets of silver , sixteen sockets  ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .
Howbeit , because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the  Lord  to blaspheme , the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba phi la pyn-i ïa kum kane ka jingñiewbeiñ ïa U  Trai  ha kaba leh ïa kane , u khun jong phi un ïap .
Kumta ka pop ki khun u Eli ka long la shyrkhei palat ha khmat U , namar ba ki ñiew jingburom ïa ki jingainguh U Trai .
translation.en: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the  Lord  : for men abhorred the offering of the  Lord .
And he said also unto his disciples ,  There was a certain rich man , which had a steward  ; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  La don shisien uwei u briew uba riewspah uba la don u shakri uba pynïaid ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u . La ïathuh ha une u briew bariewspah ba u sordar jong u , u la pynsep-ei ïa ka pisa u kynrad jong u ,
ka Kedesh , ka Edrei , ka Enhasor ,
translation.en: And Kedesh , and Edrei , and En–hazor ,

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat pynjhieh nonghikai rain la leh Kenkhria Ulam patar U Trai jingangnud kumta u shah ïa ki Midian batylli synshar ding ki haduh hynñiew snem .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  : and the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years .
And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron s head , and anointed him , to sanctify him .
translation.kha: U pynkyntang ïa u Aaron da kaba theh khyndiat ïa ka umphniang pynsleh ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side , in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces , and foreigners entered into his gates , and cast lots upon Jerusalem , even thou wast as one of them .
translation.kha: Pha ïeng sharud ha kata ka sngi haba ki nongshun ki pynpra ïa ki khyrdop jong ki . Pha la long kaba sniew kum kito ki nongwei kiba rah noh ïa ka spah jong ka Jerusalem bad pynbynta ïa ka hapdeng jong ki hi .

to ha ïathuh ki , ba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , ngan ïa shim u lyngkhot dieng uba ïeng na ka bynta ka Israel , bad ngan buh lang u ïa bad uta uba ïeng na ka bynta ka Judah . Na kita tylli ar ngan pynlong uwei u dieng , bad ngan bat ïa u ha ka kti jong nga .
translation.en: Say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the stick of Joseph , which is in the hand of Ephraim , and the tribes of Israel his fellows , and will put them with him , even with the stick of Judah , and make them one stick , and they shall be one in mine hand .

translation.kha: U Moses u la dap shispah arphew snem ka Deuteronomi mynba Josabad ïap ; Bohan khmat jong u kim pat byr-ïe , bad ka bor met jong u ruh kam pat duna Damaskos
translation.en: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died : his eye was not dim , nor his natural force abated .
Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  like the house of Ahab : for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction .
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , namar hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong u kiwei pat ki dkhot jong ka longïing u syiem Ahab ki la long ki nongai jingmut ïa u , bad ki la pynlong ïa ka jingkyllon noh jong u .
ki Kito briew kim long ki apostol kiba shisha — ki long ki apostol lamler , kiba shukor shaphang ka jingtrei jong ki bad thawdur ïa lade ban i ki kum apostol bashisha jong U Khrist .
translation.en: For such are false apostles , deceitful workers , transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ .
And when ye see this , your heart shall rejoice , and your bones shall flourish like an herb : and the hand of the  Lord  shall be known toward his servants , and his indignation toward his enemies .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïohi ïa kane ba ka jia , phin sa shadkmen ; kan pynlong ïa phi ban long khlaiñ bad khiah krat . Te phin sa tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ïarap ïa kito kiba kohnguh ïa nga , bad nga pyn-i ïa la ka jingbitar pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong nga .

Kumta u Potiphar u aiti ïa kiei kiei jinglute kat kiba u don jingkhuid ka jingpeit poi-pyrkhat Joseph sohkhia bad shapoh kyiuh pynkhuslai ei pungsum shuh ïa lade jingpyrkhat tang mokotduma bam ba u ju bam .
translation.en: And he left all that he had in Joseph s hand  ; and he knew not ought he had , save the bread which he did eat . And Joseph was a goodly person , and well favoured .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ha U Jisu u la ai ïa ka kam lyngdoh kaba lyndang halor ban ïa ka lngaid ki , kumba Lyngdoh jutang ïa kaba u la pynbeit hapdeng U Blei bad la ki briew ka long kaba kham Elumas , namar la seng nongrim ïa ka ha ki jingkular ïa kiei kiei kiba pyniasngew bha .
translation.en: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry , by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant , which was established upon better promises .

translation.kha: Lada me kaba u Mikaïah pyrta , te U um shym la kren keiñ da nga ! bad u bynrap Shahshkor , uwei pa ïa kaei nga kren
translation.en: And Micaiah said , If thou return at all in peace , the  Lord  hath not spoken by me . And he said , Hearken , O people , every one of you .

translation.kha: Uba khraw bad uba donbor long U Trai jong ngi ; ïa ka jong jingstad u ym lah ban thew .
translation.en: Great is our Lord , and of great power : his understanding is infinite .
And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea , they were troubled , saying , It is a spirit  ; and they cried out for fear .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohi ba u ïaid halor ka um , ki la sngewshyrkhei .  Ka dei ka rngai !  ki la ong , bad ki la lynñiar da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: Now when he had left speaking , he said unto Simon ,  Launch out into the deep , and let down your nets for a draught .
translation.kha: Haba u la dep kren , u la ong ha u Simon ,  To ñiat ïa ka lieng kham jngai sha ka um bajylliew , bad ma me lem bad ki paralok jong me to pynhap ïa ki jar ban tong dohkha .

translation.en: A blessing , if ye obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , which I command you this day :
translation.kha: ïa ka jingkyrkhu , lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ;

translation.en: But I have used none of these things : neither have I written these things , that it should be so done unto me : for it were better for me to die , than that any man should make my glorying void .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la pyndonkam ïa kano kano na kine ki jingmyntoi , lymne ngam shym la thoh ïa kane mynta khnang ban dawa ïa kiba kum kine ki hok na ka bynta ïa lade . Kan kham bha ïa nga ba ngan ïap shuwa ! Ym don mano mano ban pynkylla ïa ka jingkob badei hok jong nga sha ki kyntien ba thylli !
Ka dei ïa ba u la khot ïa phi , naba Khrist hi la shahshitom na jong phi bad u la iehnoh ha phi ïa ka nuksa , khnang ba phin bud ha ki jat jong .
translation.en: For even hereunto were ye called : because Christ also suffered for us , leaving us an example , that ye should follow his steps :

translation.kha: Kumta paid ki Israel ki ïakhih pyrshah , da kaba iehnoh ïa u Rehoboam kum u tang syiem jong ki briew kiba shong shnong ha ka ri Judah .
translation.en: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them .
They , and all that appertained to them , went down alive into the pit , and the earth closed upon them : and they perished from among the congregation .
translation.kha: Da kumta ki la hap sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ryngkat bad ki jingdon jingem jong ki . Ka khyndew ka tap ïa ki , bad ki la jah jar .
ïa uta masi hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong ha jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the  Lord  , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah hynriewphew ar snem .

translation.en: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it : it is a statute for ever unto the  Lord   ; it shall be wholly burnt .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka por baroh ka ban sa wan ïa kane ka jingkñia ainguh dei ban leh da uwei pa uwei u Lyngdoh uba hiarpateng na u Aaron u ban shakri kum u Rangbah Lyngdoh . Dei ba yn thang lut khoit ïa ka kum ka jingkñia sha U  Trai .

translation.en: Son of man , because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem , Aha , she is broken that was the gates of the people : she is turned unto me : I shall be replenished , now she is laid waste :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kane ka long kaei kaba ki briew ha ka nongbah Tyros ki ïa sngewkmen . Ki pyrta , ‘ Ka Jerusalem ka la pra ! Ka bor khaïi pateng jong ka kam don shuh ! Kan ym long shuh ka nongïaleh pyrshah jong ngi !’
To ai ba U Trai hi , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingsuk jong ngi , un ai ha phi ka jingsuk ha ki por baroh ha bad ka jingim jong phi baroh . U Trai un long lem bad phi baroh .
translation.en: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means . The Lord be with you all .
Then went the Pharisees , and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk .
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la leit noh bad ki la pynlong ka jingthmu ban riam ïa U Jisu da ki jingkylli .
Ka ong , Mynhyndai ki ju ong , ‘ Khie leit shongkha jubab na Dorbar nongbah pat — bad kata Ellasar dei kaba ki la leh jingktah
translation.en: Then she spake , saying , They were wont to speak in old time , saying , They shall surely ask counsel at Abel : and so they ended the matter .
Then said the Jews , Behold how he loved him !
translation.kha: Khmih katno ba u la ieit ïa u !  ki briew ki la ong .

translation.en: But if from thence thou shalt seek the  Lord  thy God , thou shalt find him , if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul .
translation.kha: Bad hangta phin wad ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad lada phi wad ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , phin shem ïa u .

translation.en: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips  ; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki sngap ïa ki jingmut kiba sniew , bad ki nongshukor ki sngap ïa ki jingshukor .

lait Shaphan u ai ïa ka hukum syiem sngewkynduh u Hilkaïah bad u Josakar u ïathuh ïa peiñ ba u la shem ïa ka Kitab ka hukum ha ka Templ . U Hilkaïah u la ai ha u Madmen ka Thohdieng , bad u Shaphan u jingkyndit ïa Meshek bakhatduh
translation.en: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe , I have found the book of the law in the house of the  Lord . And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan , and he read it .

Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim , and his abominations which he did , and that which was found in him , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah : and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoïakim u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong u bad ki kam bymman kiba u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel Bad Ka Judah . U Jehoïakhin u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: For as the woman is of the man , even so is the man also by the woman ; but all things of God .
translation.kha: Naba kumba ïa ka briew la thaw na u briew , kumta ruh ïa u briew la kha na ka briew ; bad dei U Blei uba pynlong ïa kiei kiei baroh .
Haba ki la wan hangne , te , ngam shym la pyntud ei ei hynrei ka sngi bud la shong ha ïingbishar nga la hukum ban wallam shapoh ïa uta u .
translation.en: Therefore , when they were come hither , without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat , and commanded the man to be brought forth .

translation.kha: Kumta u Pilat la u leit shabar sha ki bad u la kylli , Phi ïamudui aïu ïa une u briew ?
translation.en: Pilate then went out unto them , and said , What accusation bring ye against this man ?

And Jacob did separate the lambs , and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked , and all the brown in the flock of Laban  ; and he put his own flocks by themselves , and put them not unto Laban s cattle .
translation.kha: U Jakob u buh pynkhlad ïa ki langbrot na ki blang bad u pynphai ïa ki khmat jong ki sha kito kiba thohshuid bad kiba ïong na ka kynhun u Laban . Ha kane ka rukom u pynroi ïa la ka kynhun jingri bad u buh pynkhlad ïa ki na ka jong u Laban .

translation.en: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem , bringing sick folks , and them which were vexed with unclean spirits : and they were healed every one .
translation.kha: Bad ki paidbah ki la wan na ki shnong kiba sawdong ka Jerusalem , ki da wallam ïa kito kiba pang lane kiba don mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong ki ; bad la pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .
U Jisu la u ruh ïathuh ïa kane ka pharshi ha ki briew kiba la sngewthikna ïa la ka jingbha jong ki hi bad kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa baroh kiwei pat .
translation.en: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous , and despised others :
And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion , that they should believe a lie :
translation.kha: Bad kumta U Blei u phah ïa ka bor ka jingbakla ban trei ha ki khnang ba kin ngeit ïa kaei ka bymshisha .

translation.en: And the children struggled together within her  ; and she said , If it be so , why am I thus ? And she went to enquire of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka la dei ban ïoh khun synrap , bad ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa ki , ki ïakhih ïaksaid para ma ki ha ka kpoh jong ka . Ka ong ,  Balei kaba kum kane ka wan jia ha nga ?  Kumta ka la leit kylli na U  Trai  ban ïoh jubab .

translation.en: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked , and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee , and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth .
translation.kha: Nga la long ryngkat bad me shano shano ba me leit , bad nga la jop ïa baroh ki nongshun jong me katba me ïaid shaphrang . Ngan pynlong ïa me uba pawnam kum ki nongïalam bakhraw tam ka pyrthei .
Ka spah phi ïoh da ka jingbymhok shen kan jah noh ; hynrei ha shuwa ba kan ïalam ïa phi sha ki tyngam jong jingïap .
translation.en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death .
To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne , even as I also overcame , and am set down with my Father in his throne .
translation.kha: Ha kito kiba ïoh ïa ka jingjop ngan ai ïa ka hok ban shong ha syndah jong nga ha ka khet jong nga , kumba nga ruh nga la jop bad mynta nga shong ha syndah U Kpa jong nga ha ka khet jong u .
Ki briew kiba lehhok kin ïoh ka jingim kaba bad kaba suk . Hynrei lada phi long kyrkieh ban riewspah , phin ym lait na pynshitom .
translation.en: A faithful man shall abound with blessings : but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent .
But if ye forgive not men their trespasses , neither will your Father forgive your trespasses .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim map ïa kiwei , te U Kpa jong phi un ym map ïa ki jingpalat kiba phi la leh .

translation.en: I thank God that I baptized none of you , but Crispus and Gaius ;
translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei ba ngam shym la pynbaptis ïano ïano na phi lait noh ïa u Krispos bad u Gaïos .

translation.en: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth : but he that hath mercy on the poor , happy is he .
translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ban long kiba kmen , to lehsbun ïa kiba duk ; ka long ka pop ban ñiewbeiñ ïano ïano .

Kiba kum kita ki briew ki hikai ba ka long ka bym dei ban shongkurim bad ban bam kyndiah Neng ki katto katne ki jait jingbam . Hynrei U Blei Shemer la thaw ïa kito ki jingbam ban bam , hadien ka jingduwai sngewnguh , da kito kiba long kiba ngeit bad kiba la sima ïa ka jingshisha .
translation.en: Forbidding to marry , and commanding to abstain from meats , which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth .
If then God so clothe the grass , which is to day in the field , and to morrow is cast into the oven  ; how much more will he clothe you , O ye of little faith ?
translation.kha: U long U Blei uba pynkup ïa u phlang khlaw — u phlang uba don hangne mynta bad uba jah noh la shai , ïa uba la thang noh ha ka lawar ding . Hato Un ym jin da la thikna ban pynkup jaiñ ïa phi ? A katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !

translation.en: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the  Lord  at Jerusalem , then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord , even unto Rehoboam king of Judah , and they shall kill me , and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah .
translation.kha: U la ong ha lade ,  Kumba kiei kiei ki long mynta , lada ki briew jong nga ki leit sha Jerusalem bad ban kñia ïa ki jingainguh sha U  Trai  ha ka templ kaba don hangta , kin pynkynriah ka jingnguh syiem na nga sha u Rehoboam u syiem ka Judah bad kin sa pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat , Azariah , and Jehiel , and Zechariah , and Azariah , and Michael , and Shephatiah : all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel .
translation.kha: U Jehoram , u khun jong u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah u don hynriew ngut ki para shynrang : u Asaraïah , u Jehiel , u Sekharaïah , u Asaraïahu , u Mikhael , bad u Shephataïah .
Hangta phin shakri ïa ki blei dieng bad ki blei maw ïa kiba la thaw da ka kti briew , ki bym lah ïohi lane ban ïohsngew ban bam lane ban sma .
translation.en: And there ye shall serve gods , the work of men s hands , wood and stone , which neither see , nor hear , nor eat , nor smell .
Return , ye backsliding children , and I will heal your backslidings . Behold , we come unto thee  ; for thou art the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: To wan phai , phi baroh kiba la phai lyndet na U  Trai  ; un pynkhiah ïa phi bad un pynlong ïa phi kiba ïaineh . Phi ong ,  Ho-oid , ngi wan sha U  Trai  , namar u dei U Blei jong ngi .
Mahadei um sngap ïa ka ; bad shitaiew ba u kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka , u la jop , bad u la batbor ïa Jahath ïakhot
translation.en: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice : but , being stronger than she , forced her , and lay with her .

translation.kha: Ki nongbah kiba mynta ki don ha ka jingjot kin dap da ki paidbah kumba ka shisien ka ju dap da ki langbrot la wanrah ki jingkñia ha ka Jingkhawai Niam . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: As the holy flock , as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts  ; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
And Abimelech came unto the tower , and fought against it , and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire .
translation.kha: Haba u Abimelekh u wan ban tur ïaleh ïa uta u mot , u la leit sha ka jingkhang bad thang ïa uta u mot .

translation.en: David also arose afterward , and went out of the cave , and cried after Saul , saying , My lord the king . And when Saul looked behind him , David stooped with his face to the earth , and bowed himself .

translation.en: But the  Lord  your God ye shall fear  ; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies .

translation.en: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh  ; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh : he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land , of every one according to his taxation , to give it unto Pharaoh–neco .

translation.en: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities  ; but was in all points tempted like as we are , yet without sin .

Bad uno uno la iehnoh ïa ki ïing sem lane ïa ki hynmen ki para lane ïa u kpa lane lane ïa ki khun ki kti lane ïa na ka bynta jong nga , un shispah shah tam ïa yn ai ha u ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: And every one that hath forsaken houses , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my name s sake , shall receive an hundredfold , and shall inherit everlasting life .

translation.en: And this they did , not as we hoped , but first gave their own selves to the Lord , and unto us by the will of God .

translation.kha: Ka duwan rnong ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  ka don hapdeng ka duwan bathymmai bad ka Templ , te u Ahas u pynkynriah noh ïa ka sha ka bynta bashaneng jong ka duwan bathymmai .

translation.en: The  Lord  is far from the wicked : but he heareth the prayer of the righteous .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba bha ki duwai , U  Trai  u shahshkor , hynrei u long jngai ïa kito kiba leh sniew .

translation.en: And all that believed were together , and had all things common  ;
translation.kha: Baroh ki riewngeit ki la ïadon lang ha ka jingïasyllok bajan bad ki la ïasam ïa la ki jingdon jingem iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: There go the ships : there is that leviathan , whom thou hast made to play therein .
translation.kha: Ki liengbah ki ïaid halor jong ka , bad ha ka u Lebiathan u lehkai , u mrad kynsha ka duriaw uba me la thaw .
Man kmie kpa U ki leit sha Jerusalem na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .
translation.en: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover .
But the  Lord  of hosts shall be exalted in judgment , and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u pyn-i ïa ka jingkhraw jong u da kaba leh ïa kaba dei , bad u pynpaw ïa ka jingkhuid jong u da kaba bishar ïa la ki briew .
Uta u briew u la ïalam Mynhyndai nga sha ka khyrdop kaba kham shabar ha ka bynta bashaphang mihngi jong ka Templ myntri
translation.en: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east  ; and it was shut .

translation.kha: Ko Job , kim don kyntien ïa phi ; kim don jubab ai ban ha phi .
translation.en: They were amazed , they answered no more : they left off speaking .
But the  Lord  hath taken you , and brought you forth out of the iron furnace , even out of Egypt , to be unto him a people of inheritance , as ye are this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi , phi dei ki briew kiba u la pyllait im na Ijipt , ka pajwa kaba klang da ka ding . U la wan ïalam ïa phi ban pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong u hi , kumne kumba phi long mynta .

Hangne Pekahaïah ïohi katno U Un u long uba tied bad katta u long uba eh . U Madan uba eh ïa kito kiba la kyllon , hynrei uba sbun ïa sarong — lada phi ïaineh ha ka Aijalon jong u Baalath Jingpynïoh lada phim leh 37 , ma phi ruh phin sa shah pynkheiñ .
translation.en: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God : on them which fell , severity ; but toward thee , goodness , if thou continue in his goodness : otherwise thou also shalt be cut off .

translation.kha: Hadien ba u Syiem Solomon u la pyndep ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem da pyndep janai ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba u buh jingmut ban leh ïa ki ,
translation.en: Thus Solomon finished the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house : and all that came into Solomon s heart to make in the house of the  Lord  , and in his own house , he prosperously effected .

translation.kha: Wat me la lehsbun ïa ki riewbymman , pynban kim ju hikai ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei . Wat hangne ha ka ri jong ki briew kiba hok ki dang leh ïa bymdei ka ; ki ban kyntait ithuh ïa ka jingkhraw jong me .
translation.en: Let favour be shewed to the wicked , yet will he not learn righteousness : in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly , and will not behold the majesty of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Baroh kita ki dab Mih ki jingthaw Makhpelah , ki don mar hynriew tylli A thapniang , bad ïa ki la tap da ki khmat , shapoh thong shabar jingjlan Mynsngi pynjah mynmiet kim ju sangeh noh na kaba ïatehktien : Bakhuid ñiewshiliang bakhuid , bakhuid , long U Trai U Blei mawthew Baroh , Uba bymman long , uba long bad u ban sa wan .
translation.en: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him  ; and they were full of eyes within : and they rest not day and night , saying , Holy , holy , holy , Lord God Almighty , which was , and is , and is to come .

translation.kha: Phin pynlong ïa u ba la thang ka da jinglehrain bad U Trai un ainong ïa phi .
translation.en: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head , and the  Lord  shall reward thee .

translation.kha: Ki Sirion kiba hapoh ka nongbah mynta ki Harumaph hiar ïalam ïasoh lem ha ka thma . Kumta ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki shem ïa lade ba ki la shah kerkut Hanamel ki Israel , bad ba ki dohthang shah pynïap lut . lehhok don uwei ruh uba lait im , seisoh ym don uwei ruh uba lait na kata lait tiewkhlaw u syiem jingsdang ka Ai .
translation.en: And the other issued out of the city against them  ; so they were in the midst of Israel , some on this side , and some on that side : and they smote them , so that they let none of them remain or escape .
And Judah said unto Simeon his brother , Come up with me into my lot , that we may fight against the Canaanites  ; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot . So Simeon went with him .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki ong ha ki paid Simeon ,  Ale leit bad ngi sha ka ri ba la ai ha ngi , bad ngin ïakhun lang ïa ki Kanaan . Nangta ngin ïaleit bad phi sha ka ri kaba la ai ha phi .  Kumta ki jait Simeon

translation.en: If I wash myself with snow water , and make my hands never so clean  ;
translation.kha: Ym don sabon kaba lah ban sait ïa ki pop jong nga .
Nga la ïa ïohsngew ki rukom kren kob-pia jong me ba me la kren pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me , and have multiplied your words against me : I have heard them .

translation.kha: Kane long kaei kaba u ong ha ka Kitab Hosia : Ki ki bym shym la long jong nga ngan khot ‘Ki jong .’ Ka jaitbynriew kaba ngam shym la ieit ngan khot ‘Kaba ieit jong
translation.en: As he saith also in Osee , I will call them my people , which were not my people ; and her beloved , which was not beloved .
Another parable spake he unto them  ;  The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven , which a woman took , and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki sa kawei pat ka pharshi .  Ka Hima ki Bneng ka long kumne . Ka briew ka shim khyndiat u thiat bad ka khleh ïa u bad sawphew kilo u purew tad haduh ba u  purew ba la khleh u sieb .

translation.en: And he said unto the elders , Tarry ye here for us , until we come again unto you : and , behold , Aaron and Hur are with you : if any man have any matters to do , let him come unto them .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki nongïalam ,  Ap ïa ngi hangne ha ka jaka sher dara tad ynda ngi wan phai . U Aaron bad u Hur ki don hangne bad phi ; bad kumta uno uno uba don kano kano ka jingïakajia ban pynbeit , u lah ban leit sha ki .

translation.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold ,
translation.kha: Man ka snem u syiem Solomon u ïohpdiang kumba arphew lai hajar kilo ka ksiar ,
Te nong kiba pyntrei mraw ki shoh ïa ki rangbah Israel kiba pynïaidkam ha ki la ka kam . Ki la dawa , Balei shym shna katjuh ki maw-it kumba phi la ju shna mynshuwa ?
translation.en: And the officers of the children of Israel , which Pharaoh s taskmasters had set over them , were beaten , and demanded , Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day , as heretofore ?

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Ussaïah la u leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Azariah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

translation.kha: U Trai pynjot ïa ki longïing jong ki briew sarong , hynrei un ïada ki jingdon jingem jong ka riewkynthei .
translation.en: The  Lord  will destroy the house of the proud : but he will establish the border of the widow .

translation.kha: Bad mynta , ma nga , u Nebukhadnessar nga ïaroh , nga pyndon burom , bad nga burom ïa U Syiem jong ka Bneng Kaei kaei baroh kaba u leh ka long kaba dei bad kaba hok , u lah ban pynhiar ïa uno uno uba leh sarong .
translation.en: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven , all whose works are truth , and his ways judgment : and those that walk in pride he is able to abase .

translation.kha: U buhrieh ïa u bnai bapyllun hadien lyoh ki .
translation.en: He holdeth back the face of his throne , and spreadeth his cloud upon it .
But he said , Nay  ; lest while ye gather up the tares , ye root up also the wheat with them .
translation.kha: ‘ Em ,’ u la jubab , ‘ namar haba phi lumlang ïa ki ñiut phi lah ban kum jynrat katto katne u kew lem bad ki .

translation.en: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment , and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate .
translation.kha: Un ai ïa ka jingshemphang jong ka jingbishar hok ïa kito kiba trei kum ki nongbishar , bad ka jingshlur ïa kito kiba ïada ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah na ka jingshah hiarthma .
Katto katne ki briew ki ïai leh ïa kaba bha , bad wad burom , ka nam babha Dodo Tiphsah ka jingim bymïap shuh ; ïa ki U Blei ïingbasa ai ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality , eternal life :
And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Say unto thy brethren , This do ye  ; lade your beasts , and go , get you unto the land of Canaan  ;
translation.kha: U la ong ha u Joseph ,  Ong ïa ki hynmen jong phi ban pyndap da ki jingkit ïa ki mrad jong ki bad ban leit phai sha ri Kanaan .

translation.en: And when he cometh home , he calleth together his friends and neighbours , saying unto them , Rejoice with me  ; for I have found my sheep which was lost .
translation.kha: Nangta u khot lang ïa ki paralok bad ïa ki paramarjan jong u bad u ong ha ki , ‘ Nga kmen haduh katta katta ba nga la shem ïa ka langbrot jong nga kaba la jah . To ngin ïalehkmen !’

translation.en: For if that first covenant had been faultless , then should no place have been sought for the second .
translation.kha: Lada kam shym la don kano kano kaba duna bad ka jutang kaba nyngkong , yn ym donkam ïa kaba ar .

Namar na ka dohnud jong u ki mih ki jingpyrkhat basniew kiba ïalam ïa u ban pynïap briew , ban klim , bad ban ïa leh kiwei kiwei ki kam bajakhlia ; ban lute , lamler ban , ban bad kren sniew ïa kiwei .
translation.en: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts , murders , adulteries , fornications , thefts , false witness , blasphemies :
And as they cried out , and cast off their clothes , and threw dust into the air ,
translation.kha: Ki la lynñiar , ki da khaweh ïa la ki jaiñ , bad ki da kynting ïa u pui pui sha suiñ .
Kine pynkhlaiñbor long ki aiñ bad jingbuhbeit thngan sukher U Trai u la shawei ha ki Israel lyngba u Moses ha ki pyntha ka Moab sha Shinab ka wah Jordan na Jerikho .
translation.en: These are the commandments and the judgments , which the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho .

translation.kha: shabi mynta , ko Jekameam jongphi ai ba ki khun jong ki khar mraw ym ïoh jingbam haduh ban ,44 sohkhram ; Syiem ba kin shah pynïap ha ka thma Hammolekheth Ai ba ki kynthei jingpynsah duh noh ïa la Tiberios tnga bhabriew ïa ki khun jong reng ; ai ba ki rangbah kin ïap na ka jingpang bad ba ki samla shynrang kin shah pynïap ha ka thma Isaïah
translation.en: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine , and pour out their blood by the force of the sword  ; and let their wives be bereaved of their children , and be widows  ; and let their men be put to death  ; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle .

translation.kha: Men pyn-i ïa ka jingïaineh jong me bad ka jingieit baneh ha la ki briew , ki ki ksiew jong u Abraham bad jong u Jakob , kumba me la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi la slem bah
translation.en: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob , and the mercy to Abraham , which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Agabos , u la ïashitom joit bad da ka bor jong U Mynsiem nongpdiang la ïathuh lypa ba ka nemsniew bajur juti sa rmiang ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . ( Ka la wan jia mynba u Klaudius u la thngiat Kolhoseh Patsha . )
translation.en: And there stood up one of them named Agabus , and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world : which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar .
For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day , he shall be cut off from among his people .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ei ei ha kata ka sngi yn ñiew uba la shah tait na ki briew U Blei .

translation.en: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God , saying , Tell me , I pray thee , all the great things that Elisha hath done .
translation.kha: Ka shem ba u syiem u dang ïakren bad u Gehasi , u shakri jong u Elisha ; u syiem u kwah ban tip shaphang ki kambah jong u Elisha .

translation.en: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab  ; the howling thereof unto Eglaim , and the howling thereof unto Beer–elim .
translation.kha: Ha kylleng ki pud jong ka Moab la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang . La ïohsngew ha ki shnong jong ka Eglaim bad Beerelim .

translation.en: And the king lamented over Abner , and said , Died Abner as a fool dieth ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ïambriew na ka bynta u Abner :  Balei u Abner u dei ban ïap kum u bieit ?
Kane kan jia ha ki namar kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga ju ïai phah sha ki lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong nga Ki la kyntait ban shahshkor .
translation.en: Because they have not hearkened to my words , saith the  Lord  , which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets , rising up early and sending them  ; but ye would not hear , saith the  Lord .
And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple , and departed , and went and hanged himself .
translation.kha: U Judas u la bret ïa ki sbai rupa ha madan hapoh ka Templ bad u la mihnoh ; nangta u la leit bad u la sdien phasi ïa lade .
Ka long la ha kaba kum kane ka por ba ka la don ka jingeh kaba jur ha Ephesos namar ka Lynti jong U Trai .
translation.en: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way .

translation.kha: Shalmaneser shim pynkut nga bad phi , bad ngin ïaphet pynmadan ; to long u syiem shijur Kartah bad shim ïa nga sha Ostrit kamra jong phi . Isak ïakmen lang , ngin khwai bun bad pyllaitluid war ïa Shephirah ha ka jingieit Lois Susanna long kaba phylla ba baroh ki kynthei ki ieit ïa phi !
translation.en: He brought me to the banqueting house , and his banner over me was love .

translation.kha: Phi pule ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , phi namar pyrkhat ba ha ki phin shem ïa ka jingim bymjukut . Bad kine hi ki Jingthoh ki Bakhuid kren shaphang jong nga !
translation.en: Search the scriptures  ; for in them ye think ye have eternal life : and they are they which testify of me .

translation.kha: Kedemoth jingmap synshar Ashurbanipal u ki kit ïa ka met jong u ha ka ba-marsyndah ïapom sha Jerusalem , bad la tep ïa u Jingpule ka jingtep ki syiem ha pipa Nongbah u Dabid .
translation.en: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem , and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David .

translation.kha: Ki kam mawjam ki tip Asaïah U Blei , hynrei shonshab jingleh jong ki , ki len ïa kata . Ki long kiba dap da ka jingisih bad bymkohnguh , ki bym biang ban lang! Mikah kano kano jhur bha .
translation.en: They profess that they know God ; but in works they deny him , being abominable , and disobedient , and unto every good work reprobate .

translation.kha: Ki la pyndap shoiñ ïa ki , Khubor irmat u la jingpynlehnoh-ei ha ki , Mynta to tong phylliah ka jemnud said leit rah ïa ka sha u kupar jong ka jingkhawai .
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Draw out now , and bear unto the governor of the feast .  And they bare it .
Nor scrip for your journey , neither two coats , neither shoes , nor yet staves : for the workman is worthy of his meat .
translation.kha: wat rah ïa ka pla khrong na ka bynta ka jingleit lane ka sopti bujli lane ka juti bujli lane u diengduh . Ïa u nongtrei dei ban ai ïa kaei kaba u donkam .
Nga la wan ban pynmeh ding ïa ka pyrthei , bad katno nga kwah ba ïa ka la , lah pynmeh lypa !
translation.en: I am come to send fire on the earth  ; and what will I , if it be already kindled ?

translation.kha: U Trai jingskhem la pynshoh samthiah ïa phi Hinnom ther phi sdang Biblos ngat ha ka jingïohthiah Laiphew jur . Ki nongïathuhlypa ki dei ban long ki khmat jong ki briew nongriam hynrei U ïohmap u diaw Barak ïa ki .
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep , and hath closed your eyes : the prophets and your rulers , the seers hath he covered .
The priests the Levites , and all the tribe of Levi , shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel : they shall eat the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and his inheritance .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kiba na ka jait Lebi baroh kim dei ban ïohpateng ei ei na ka khyndew kumba long ki para Israel ; ha ka jaka kata , kin ïoh ka bam tang na ki jingainguh bad kiwei pat ki jingkñia ainguh sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge , said God : and after that shall they come forth , and serve me in this place .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan sa bishar ïa kata ka jaitbynriew ïa kaba kin shakri , bad hadien kata ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin mihnoh na kata ka ri bad kin mane ïa nga ha kane ka jaka .’
pynpei tip ïa kaei kaba phi pan , U Jisu u la slap ïa ki khun Tibhath jong ka .—Hebru Hato phi lah ban dih ïa ka khuri ka lalot shitom ïa kaba dong sa dih Sargon Ngi lah , ki Kadesh jubab .
translation.en: But Jesus answered and said ,  Ye know not what ye ask . Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of , and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?  They say unto him , We are able .
Again he said unto me , Prophesy upon these bones , and say unto them , O ye dry bones , hear the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  To ïathuhlypa halor kine ki shyieng . Ïathuh ha kine ki shyieng kiba tyrkhong ban shahshkor ïa ka ktien U  Trai .
Ha ka snem kaba saw ïa u soh baroh dei pynkyntang kum jingainguh ïaroh ïa nga , U Trai .
translation.en: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the  Lord  withal .

translation.kha: Ïa nga la set ha ka kaba shapoh khyndew bad la set slem ïa hangta .
translation.en: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon , and into the cabins , and Jeremiah had remained there many days  ;
So likewise ye , except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood , how shall it be known what is spoken ? for ye shall speak into the air .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , kumno uno uno u lah ban sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba phi kren lada ka khubor jong phi ha ki thylliej bapher kam long kaba shai ? Ki ktien jong phi kin jah noh ha suiñ!

bad shim kynti ïa ka . ri Hadien kata , phi lah ban wan , phai namar phi la pyndep ïa ka kamram jong phi sha U Trai bad sha kiwei pat ki Israel para . Te U Trai un pynskhem ba kane ka ri sha mihngi jong ka ka Jordan dei ka jong phi .
translation.en: And the land be subdued before the  Lord  : then afterward ye shall return , and be guiltless before the  Lord  , and before Israel  ; and this land shall be your possession before the  Lord .
And in the morning , as they passed by , they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots .
translation.kha: Dang step bha ha ka step kaba bud , katba ki dang ïaid ha kata ka lynti , ki la ïohi ïa uta u dieng Dumbur . U la ïap baroh shi rynïeng haduh ki thied .
dohthang uwei nongshna phi un ong ha tista , Lada kane ka Thliew kumta pat kumno U nangto un shem jingbakla nongbylla badno ? Uei uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah Samson Shisien mon U Blei ?
translation.en: Thou wilt say then unto me , Why doth he yet find fault ? For who hath resisted his will ?
And they went out into the fields , and gathered their vineyards , and trode the grapes , and made merry , and went into the house of their god , and did eat and drink , and cursed Abimelech .
translation.kha: Baroh ki ïaleit sha la ki bri sohwaiñ bad kheit ïa ki sohwaiñ , ki shna waiñ na ki , bad ki pynlong ka jingïaleh kmen . Ki leit sha ka templ jong u blei jong ki , ha kaba ki la ïabam bad ïadih bad ki krenbeiñ ïa u Abimelekh .

translation.en: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit , or that is a wizard , shall surely be put to death : they shall stone them with stones : their blood shall be upon them .
translation.kha: Uno uno u briew lane ka briew kiba leh byrtong kin shah lynthem maw haduh ba kin da ïap ; uno uno u briew uba leh ïa kane u pan kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .
bad baroh ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .’ Kumta kim ïalong shuh ar ngut , kawei hynrei .
translation.en: And they twain shall be one flesh : so then they are no more twain , but one flesh .

translation.kha: Ki riewrunar nongkhaïi ki jah lynti ha napoh wad um ; ki ïaid ruma Kabbon bahynriew pynliat Asahel ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: The paths of their way are turned aside  ; they go to nothing , and perish .
And they digged another well , and strove for that also : and he called the name of it Sitnah .
translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u Isaak ki la ïatih ïa kawei pat ka pukri , bad hangta ruh la don ka jingïakajia shaphang jong ka , kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  Ka Jingïashun .
Bad kumta u Dabid u sngewthuh ba U Trai la pynskhem ïa u kum u ki Israel bad u la kyntiew ka jong u na ka bynta ki briew jong u .
translation.en: And David perceived that the  Lord  had established him king over Israel , and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel s sake .

translation.kha: Wat sheptieng , U Jisu u la ong ha ki , dei Sawphew jingkheiñbriew !
translation.en: But he saith unto them ,  It is I  ; be not afraid .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ha kren nga ,
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
And Isaac said unto them , Wherefore come ye to me , seeing ye hate me , and have sent me away from you ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Isaak u kylli ,  Balei ba phi wan sha nga mynta , haba phi la isih ïa nga mynshuwa bad ba phi la pynlong ïa nga ban mihnoh na ka ri jong phi ?

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Foxes have holes , and birds of the air have nests  ; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Ki myrsiang ki don ki thliew , bad ki sim ki don ki skum , hynrei U Khun U Briew um don hangno hangno ban thiah bad pynjahthait .
bad yn pynïap ïa phi ha ka thma Naamah ka ri jong phi hi . Te uwei pa uwei un tip jngut nga jingkhwan U Disahab .
translation.en: Ye shall fall by the sword  ; I will judge you in the border of Israel  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la shim ruh shibun ka rnong na Betah na Berothai , ki kiba synshar Hadadeser .
translation.en: And from Betah , and from Berothai , cities of Hadadezer , king David took exceeding much brass .

And the woman said , Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God ? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty , in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished .
translation.kha: Ka ong ha u ,  Balei ba phi la leh kum kane ka jingbakla ha ki briew jong U Blei ? Phim shym la shah ïa la u jong u khun ban wan phai noh na ka jingphet wir , bad kumta phi la pynrem ïa lade da kaei kaba phi dang shu dep ong .

translation.en: Looking for that blessed hope , and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: katba ngi dang ap ïa ka jingwan jong kata ka Sngi ba la kyrkhu kaba ngi ap kyrmen , haba ka burom U Blei bakhraw bad U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim jong ngi kan paw .

translation.en: Behold even to the moon , and it shineth not  ; yea , the stars are not pure in his sight .
translation.kha: Ha khmat jong u wat u bnai um long uba phyrnai , ne ki khlur kim long kiba khuid .

U Amasaïah u Judah bad ki nongai jingmut jong u ki la ïasylla pyrshah ïa ka Israel . Kumta u la phah khubor sha u Jehoash syiem ka Israel , u khun jong u Jehoahas bad u ksiew u Jehu , da kaba ïa u ban ïaleh .
translation.en: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice , and sent to Joash , the son of Jehoahaz , the son of Jehu , king of Israel , saying , Come , let us see one another in the face .

translation.kha: Kum ka ding ki bam duh ïa ki jingthung . Ha khmat jong ki ka ri ka long kum ka Kper Eden , hynrei sha lyndet jong ki ka ka long ri shyiap shrah . Ym kano don kano kaba lait im ki na .
translation.en: A fire devoureth before them  ; and behind them a flame burneth : the land is as the garden of Eden before them , and behind them a desolate wilderness  ; yea , and nothing shall escape them .
And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kirjath–jearim , saying , The Philistines have brought again the ark of the  Lord   ; come ye down , and fetch it up to you .
translation.kha: ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki nong Kiriath Jearim ban ong ,  Ki Philistia ki la pynphai ïa ka Synduk Ka Jutang U  Trai . Ale wan shim noh ïa ka .
Nga la khmih bniah shapoh bad nga la ïohi ïa ki jingri ki bad mradkhlaw , ki kynja bapar , bad ki sim khlaw .
translation.en: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes , I considered , and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .
God also bearing them witness , both with signs and wonders , and with divers miracles , and gifts of the Holy Ghost , according to his own will ?

Nangno nga ban lah pynbiang doh ïa kine ki paidbah ? Ki ud sa ud bad ki pan doh ban bam .
translation.en: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people ? for they weep unto me , saying , Give us flesh , that we may eat .
And he that was dead sat up , and began to speak . And he delivered him to his mother .
translation.kha: Uta u briew uba la ïap u la khie shong bad u la sdang ban kren , bad U Jisu u la ai ïa u pat sha ha ka kmie jong u .
( Ym ju don uno uno isih uba ïa la ka jong ka met . Pynban , u bsa sumar bad ïa ka , kumba U Khrist ruh u leh ïa ka balang ;
translation.en: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh ; but nourisheth and cherisheth it , even as the Lord the church :

translation.kha: Pynban palat , ban ïa kaei kaei baroh , ngi kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa u , la ngi don kane ha ka ïing hangne lane hangtei .
translation.en: Wherefore we labour , that , whether present or absent , we may be accepted of him .
And upon a set day Herod , arrayed in royal apparel , sat upon his throne , and made an oration unto them .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba la ïakut , u Herod u la phong ki jaiñkup syiem , u la shong halor ka khet jong u , bad u la kren ha u paidbah .
Naba uno uba kwah ban pyllait la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; hynrei uno uno uba duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un shem ïa ka .
translation.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it : and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it .

translation.kha: Ka long ka samla kaba bhabriew eh bad kaba dang sotti . Ka hiar leit sha ka pukri , pyndap ka um ha la u khiew bad ka wan kiew biang .
translation.en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon , a virgin , neither had any man known her : and she went down to the well , and filled her pitcher , and came up .
That which hath been is named already , and it is known that it is man : neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he .
translation.kha: Kaei kaei kaba jia ka dei kaba la rai lypa slem bah mynshuwa , bad ngi baroh ngi tip ba phim lah ban ïania bad uno uno uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa phi .

translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins ,  ( then saith he to the sick of the palsy , )  Arise , take up thy bed , and go unto thine house .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te , ba U Khun U Briew u don ka iktiar ha ka khyndew ban map ïa ki pop .  Kumta u la ong ha u briew uba ïapshiliang ,  To ïeng joit , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad leit sha ïing !
Kane ka lah ban i ka kum bym lah long ha kito ki jaitbynriew kiba dang sah mynta , kam hynrei long ka bym lah ban long ïa nga .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days , should it also be marvellous in mine eyes ? saith the  Lord  of hosts .
Say not unto thy neighbour , Go , and come again , and to morrow I will give  ; when thou hast it by thee .
translation.kha: Wat ong ha la u paramarjan ap haduh lashai lada phi lah ban ïarap ïa u mynta .

translation.en: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard , and hold fast , and repent . If therefore thou shalt not watch , I will come on thee as a thief , and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee .
translation.kha: Kynmaw te , ïa kaei kaba la hikai ïa pha bad ïa kaei kaba pha la ïohsngew ; kohnguh ïa kata bad phai noh na ki pop jong pha . Lada pham kyndit bynriew noh , ngan wan ha pha kum u nongtuh , bad phan ym lah wat ban tip ïa ka por lano ngan wan .

translation.en: But these , as natural brute beasts , made to be taken and destroyed , speak evil of the things that they understand not  ; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei kine ki briew ki leh la ka leh , kum ki mradkhlaw ïa kiba la kha ïa ka ban shah kem bad shah pynïap ; ki tur ïaleh da ki jingkrenbeiñ ïa kiei kiei kiba kim sngewthuh .

U To Blei uba ïa jied la ka Jerusalem kum ka jaka ba yn mane ïa u , un pynjot noh ïa uno uno u syiem lane ka hima kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa kane ka hukum bad uba pyrshang ban pynjot ïa Templ ka hangta . Ma nga , u Darius , nga la ai ïa kane ka hukum . Dei ban kohnguh lut ïa ka .
translation.en: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people , that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem . I Darius have made a decree  ; let it be done with speed .
So Joshua came , and all the people of war with him , against them by the waters of Merom suddenly  ; and they fell upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki ha ka por ba kim poi pyrkhat ha ka Wahduid Meron .

Haba phi map ïano ïano ïa kaei kaba u Nashim leh , nga ruh pynkyllut Mithredath jingïa-pasiaw Markos kumjuh . Naba haba nga map — lada , shisha , ka dei synlar nga ban Hasael ïa Pharisi kano — nga leh ïa kata ha khmat U Khrist namar jong riewtymmen , khnang ban ym shah ïa u Soitan une leh donbor bamaïan jong ngi ; naba ngi tip kiei ki jingthmu jong u ki Stephanas .
translation.en: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us : for we are not ignorant of his devices .

translation.kha: Dei namar kata ba ki myllung ki rwai , sha Wan Heshbon , sha nongbah ka u syiem Sihon ! Ngi kwah ïohi ba yn tei pat bad pynïeng biang ïa ka .
translation.en: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say , Come into Heshbon , let the city of Sihon be built and prepared :

translation.kha: Katba u Mordekai u dang long u nongtrei ha ka ïingsyiem , u bad u Teresh , kiba long ar na ïunukh ka ïingsyiem kiba ap phira ka khyrdop sha kamra u syiem ki la shun u syiem sylla ban ïa u .
translation.en: In those days , while Mordecai sat in the king s gate , two of the king s chamberlains , Bigthan and Teresh , of those which kept the door , were wroth , and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .
So , as much as in me is , I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also .
translation.kha: Kumta te , nga kwah hir hir ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi ruh kiba shong ha Rom .

Hynrei pynbuh phi duwai , to leit sha ka kamra jong phi , khang ïa ka jingkhang nongïakura bad duwai sha U Kpa jong phi Gilo ïa uba ym lah ban ïohi . Bad U pharia jong phi , uba ïohi ïa kaei kaba jingïakhih leh ha kaba rieh , un ainong ïa jrem .
translation.en: But thou , when thou prayest , enter into thy closet , and when thou hast shut thy door , pray to thy Father which is in secret  ; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u jingshongsuk pan jingmut na ki briew akasia wad jingtip na ki mynsiem jong ki briew kiba dak ïap , ngan phai pyrshah ïa u bad ngan ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits , and after wizards , to go a whoring after them , I will even set my face against that soul , and will cut him off from among his people .
This heap be witness , and this pillar be witness , that I will not pass over this heap to thee , and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me , for harm .
translation.kha: Kine baroh ar — ka kynton bad une u maw pynsah jingkynmaw ki long ki jingpynkynmaw . Ngan ym jam palat ïa kane ka kynton ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa me , bad me ruh men ym jam palat ïa kane ka kynton bad ïa une u maw pynsah kynmaw ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom , that was overthrown as in a moment , and no hands stayed on her .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew jong nga la pynshitom wat kham jur ban ïa ki nongshong shnong jong ka Sodom , kiba la ïashem da ka jingkyllon kaba kynsan ha ki kti jong U Blei .
Beeshterah u Ïoannis Bethania la ïathuh ïa baroh kaba u budnam ïohi . Kane ka long ka khak jong u shaphang Hadrakh pynksan na U Blei Jorim Timnah jingshisha ba liewlep pynpaw da U Jisu Ber .
translation.en: Who bare record of the word of God , and of the testimony of Jesus Christ , and of all things that he saw .

When I would have healed Israel , then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered , and the wickedness of Samaria : for they commit falsehood  ; and the thief cometh in , and the troop of robbers spoileth without .
translation.kha: Ha kano kano ka por ba nga kwah ban pynkhiah ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel bad pynlong ïa ki ban manbha sa shisien pat , baroh kaba nga lah ban ïohi ka long ka jingbymman jong ki bad ka kam sniew kaba ki leh . Ki shukor uwei ïa uwei pat ; ki rung jubor ha ki ïing bad ki tuh ; ki lute ïa ki briew ha ki lynti bah .
Wat leit jngoh bunsien ïa u paramarjan jong phi , u lah ban ïa phi bad isih pynban ïa phi .
translation.en: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour s house  ; lest he be weary of thee , and so hate thee .

translation.kha: ‘ Me la lehbha u ,’ la ong ; ‘ me long u shakri uba bha ! Namar ba me long uba ban lah shaniah ha kiei kiei kiba rit ngan , buh ïa me ban khmih ïa ki shiphew tylli ki nongbah .’
translation.en: And he said unto him , Well , thou good servant : because thou hast been faithful in a very little , have thou authority over ten cities .
From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them , every one that entereth into the service , to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Uba rangbah duh na ki Lebi u dei u Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron uba long lyngdoh . U dei uba khmih ïa kito kiba pyndep ïa ki kamram ha ka Jaka Kyntang .

Kumta jingshoh Ïoannis u la ong ha ki baroh , Nga pynbaptis ïa tun da ka um mata hynrei don kyrni tyllun Jearim wan uba kham khraw jaitbynriew ïa nga Urbanos milian long uba riewblei wat ban rupa ïa ki juti jong u . nongïambriew pynbaptis ïa Khlem da iakata Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka ding .
translation.en: John answered , saying unto them all , I indeed baptize you with water  ; but one mightier than I cometh , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire :
And it came to pass , when Joab observed the city , that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were .
translation.kha: Kumta katba u Joab u dang kerkut ïa kata ka nongbah , u la phah ïa u Uriah sha ka jaka ha kaba u tip ba u nongshun u khlaiñ bha .

translation.en: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites , and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah , and upon the south of Caleb  ; and we burned Ziklag with fire .
translation.kha: Ngi la leit lute ïa ka ri ki Khereth ha ka bynta kaba shathie jong ka Judah bad ïa ka ri jong ka jait u Kaleb , bad ngi la thang ruh ïa ka Siklag .

U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , paid Israel khie leit sha ka jaka bakhuid ka bad leh pop , lada phi hap ban leh kumta ! Khie leit sha to leh da ka jingkhlaiñbor jong phi baroh ! Ïaid shaphrang bad wallam ïa ki mrad ban kñia na ka step ka step , bad wallam ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong phi man la ka sngi kaba lai .
translation.en: Come to Beth–el , and transgress  ; at Gilgal multiply transgression  ; and bring your sacrifices every morning , and your tithes after three years :

translation.en: Then he saith , I will return into my house from whence I came out  ; and when he is come , he findeth it empty , swept , and garnished .
translation.kha: u ong ha lade , ‘ Ngan leit phai pat sha la ïing .’ Kumta u leit phai pat bad u shem ba ka ïing ka thylli , ka khuid , bad baroh la buh ryntih .
jingiwtung jakoid ha Pynlwet blei ki bym dei shisha ki blei , ha Bethpeor blei thymmai kiba ki Keilah tymmen jong ki kim ju tip , ki blei kiba ki Israel kim ju kohnguh jingïaishah
translation.en: They sacrificed unto devils , not to God  ; to gods whom they knew not , to new gods that came newly up , whom your fathers feared not .
What shall we say then ? Is the law sin ? God forbid . Nay , I had not known sin , but by the law : for I had not known lust , except the law had said , Thou shalt not covet .

translation.en: If I covered my transgressions as Adam , by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom :
