translation.en: And Esau ran to meet him , and embraced him , and fell on his neck , and kissed him : and they wept .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Iso u mareh ban ïakynduh ïa u , u kdup ïa u , bad u doh ïa u . Ki ïa-ïam baroh ar ngut .
Lada phi shahshkor ïa kine ki hukum kohnguh hok , U Trai U Blei jong phi un bat ïa ka jutang bad phi bad un pynpaw ha phi ïa ka jingieit jong u kaba ïaineh , kumba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen phi
translation.en: Wherefore it shall come to pass , if ye hearken to these judgments , and keep , and do them , that the  Lord  thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers :
These things have I spoken unto you , that ye should not be offended .
translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane , khnang ba phin ym iehnoh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi .

translation.en: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u long syiem haba u la don khathynriew snem ka rta ; bad u synshar sanphew ar snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jekolaïah kaba na Jerusalem .
Ko ki paralok , ba-ieit to ngin ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei , namar ka jingieit ka wan na Blei U . Uno uno uba ieit , u long u jong khun U Blei bad u ithuh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Beloved , let us love one another : for love is of God  ; and every one that loveth is born of God , and knoweth God .

Then they shall bring out the damsel to the door of her father s house , and the men of her city shall stone her with stones that she die : because she hath wrought folly in Israel , to play the whore in her father s house : so shalt thou put evil away from among you .
translation.kha: te ki dei ban leit ïalam ïa kata ka briew ha khmat ka jingkhang ïing u kpa jong ka , bad ki rangbah jong kata ka shnong kin lynthem maw ïa ka hangta haduh ba kan da ïap . Ka la leh ïa kaei kaei kaba jahburom ha Israel da kaba pynjot ïa la ka jingsotti shuwa ka jingshongkurim . Da kumta phin pynduh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman napdeng jong phi .
Lada king kynruh ïa ka dud , pynmih makhon . Lada phi tied ïa ka khmut jongno jongno , ka pynmih snam . Lada pynkhih ka jingbitar , phi ngat ha ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter , and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood : so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife .
Why are our places of worship called Kingdom Halls ?
translation.kha: Balei la khot ïa ka jaka mane jong ngi ka Ïing Hima ?

Hadien lai sngi , ha ka lyngkhuh sngi kha jong u , u syiem u pynlong jingkhawai ka ïa ki rangbah synshar jong baroh u ; u pyllait la noh ïa u nongrah khuri bad ïa u nongshet kpu rangbah jong u , bad u la wallam ïa ki ha khmat rangbah ki synshar jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass the third day , which was Pharaoh s birthday , that he made a feast unto all his servants : and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants .
And this I pray , that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment ;
translation.kha: Bad kane nga duwai , ba ka jingieit jong phi kan nang ïoh roi kyrhai shuh shuh , ryngkat bad ka jingtip bashisha bad ka jingbishar bajanai .

translation.en: In which time Moses was born , and was exceeding fair , and nourished up in his father s house three months :
translation.kha: Ka la long ha kane ka por ba la kha ïa u Moses , u khunlung uba bhabriew haduh katta katta .

Kumta u la Snam ïa u Joram , u ryngkhat pynitynnat u ban khublei ïa u Khatsaw Dabid bad Eder ai khublei ïa u namar ka jingjop jong shahtehmraw ïa u templ , ïa shyllangmat u Toi u la ïaleh pyrshah la bunsien pynshongduh U Joram u rah na ka bynta u Dabid ki jingai sngewbha kiba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa :13 bad ka rnong .
translation.en: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David , to salute him , and to bless him , because he had fought against Hadadezer , and smitten him : for Hadadezer had wars with Toi . And Joram brought with him vessels of silver , and vessels of gold , and vessels of brass :
And if any man will hurt them , fire proceedeth out of their mouth , and devoureth their enemies : and if any man will hurt them , he must in this manner be killed .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa ki , ka ding kan mih na ki shyntur jong ki bad kan bam duh ïa ki nongshun jong ki ; bad ha kane ka rukom , uno uno uba pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa ki un shah pynïap .

translation.en: For first of all , when ye come together in the church , I hear that there be divisions among you ; and I partly believe it .
translation.kha: Ha kaba nyngkong eh , la ïathuh ïa nga ba ha ki jingïaseng jong phi , ki don ki kynhun kiba ïa-pyrshah ; bad kane nga ngeit ka don katto katne ka jingshisha .
Wat khot nga ïa , ka Naomi , ka jubab ; khot noh ïa nga , ka Marah , namar U Blei Bakhrawbor u la pynlong ka ïa jingim jong nga kaba kthang .
translation.en: And she said unto them , Call me not Naomi , call me Mara : for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me .

translation.kha: Kane kan long ka kupar jong ki namar ki la saihon rem na ki pop bashyrkhei — ki la leh awria bad ki la ïathuh Usal jinglamler ha ka jingpunkhun jong U jingïadon donnam Hepher ka long pyrshah ïa ka mon Elasah jong U Trai ; u tip ïa kyrkieh kaba ki la leh , laiñ Ber long lakam sakhi pyrshah ïa ki kaw U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: Because they have committed villany in Israel , and have committed adultery with their neighbours  wives , and have spoken lying words in my name , which I have not commanded them  ; even I know , and am a witness , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la ïohknieh ïa ka Hamath bad Sobah bad u kerkut ïa ka nongbah Palmyra ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: And Solomon went to Hamath–zobah , and prevailed against it .

And the prophet came to the king of Israel , and said unto him , Go , strengthen thyself , and mark , and see what thou doest : for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee .
translation.kha: Nangta uta u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Ahab , bad u ong ,  Khie leit noh bad pynkhlaiñ ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me , bad da pynbha ïa ka rukom ïaleh namar u syiem Syria un wan tur ïaleh biang ha ka por pyrem ka ban wan .

translation.en: And it came to pass , because the midwives feared God , that he made them houses .
translation.kha: Namar ba kita ki nongpynkha khun ki sheptieng ïa U Blei , u ruh u pynmanbha ïa ki , bad u ai ha ki ba kin don la ki khun ki kti . Ki Israel ruh ki nang roi bad ki nang khlaiñ .

translation.en: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom : for he was comforted concerning Amnon , seeing he was dead .
translation.kha: hynrei haba u la sangeh ban pyrkhat ïa ka jingïap u Amnon , u la shlei da ka jingkynmaw ieit ïa u Absalom u khun jong u .

translation.en: Blessed are ye , when men shall revile you , and persecute you , and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely , for my sake .
translation.kha: Suk ma phi haba ki briew ki krenbeiñ bad pynshitom beiñ ïa phi , bad ong bun jait ki jinglamler basniew pyrshah ïa phi namar ba phi long ki nongbud jong nga .

translation.en: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon , and abode in the rock Rimmon four months .
translation.kha: Hynrei hynriewspah ngut na ki , ki lait bad ki phet ïap shaphang ri khlaw sha u Mawsiang Rimmon , bad ki sah hangta saw bnai .

translation.en: Whom God hath raised up , having loosed the pains of death : because it was not possible that he should be holden of it .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , da kaba pyllaitluid ïa u na ka bor jong ka , namar ka long ka bym lah long ba ka jingïap kan bat ïa u .

translation.en: And they found an Egyptian in the field , and brought him to David , and gave him bread , and he did eat  ; and they made him drink water  ;
translation.kha: Kita ki briew kiba leit bad u Dabid ki lap ïa uwei u khynnah Ijipt ha lum , bad ki wan ïalam ïa u ha u Dabid . Ki ai ha u ïa u kpu ban bam bad ka um ban dih ;

translation.en: Being forty days tempted of the devil . And in those days he did eat nothing : and when they were ended , he afterward hungered .
translation.kha: ha kaba u la shah pynshoi ha u Soitan haduh sawphew sngi . Ha baroh kata ka por u khlem bam ei ei , ba kumta u la thngan eh haba ka la kut .
la kum ba ïa leh u nongbylla uba trei snem . U kynrad jong u , um dei ban pynshitom beiñ ïa u .
translation.en: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him : and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight .

translation.kha: Nga ithuh ïa u briew uba ngeit ïa uba khatsaw snem mynshuwa rong la noh sha ka bneng jrong kaba tam ( ngam tip la kane ka da jia shisha ne u la ïoh ka ïa jingïohipaw — tang U Blei uba tip ) .
translation.en: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago , ( whether in the body , I cannot tell ; or whether out of the body , I cannot tell : God knoweth ; ) such an one caught up to the third heaven .

translation.kha: kiwei pat ki shakri ki la ïa kaba lah , la sngewsih shikatdei eh , bad ki la sha u Syiem ïathuh ha ïa kaei kaei baroh .
translation.en: So when his fellowservants saw what was done , they were very sorry , and came and told unto their lord all that was done .
Not giving heed to Jewish fables , and commandments of men , that turn from the truth .
translation.kha: bad ban nym pynshahshkor shuh ha ki khanatang jong ki Jiw bad ha ki hukum briew kiba wan na ki briew kiba la kyntait ïa ka jingshisha .

translation.en: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind , be sober , and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ  ;
translation.kha: Kumta te , to ai ba ki jingmut jong phi kin pynkhreh ban treikam . To long adkar bad buh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi baroh phar ha ka jingkyrkhu ïa kaba yn sa ai ha phi haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .

Da shisha , phim shym la ïalam ïa ngi sha kata ri ka kaba tuid da dud ka bad ka ngap lane ai ha ngi ïa ki lyngkha bad ki sohwaiñ bri kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi , bad mynta phi pyrshang ban shukor ïa ngi . Ngim wan !
translation.en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey , or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards : wilt thou put out the eyes of these men ? we will not come up .
And the mother of the child said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . And he arose , and followed her .
translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka ong ha u Elisha ,  Nga smai da ka jingïaineh skhem jong nga ha U  Trai  uba im bad ha phi ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi !  Kumta baroh ar ngut ki la ïamih lang .

translation.en: As he saith also in Osee , I will call them my people , which were not my people ; and her beloved , which was not beloved .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba u ong ha ka Kitab U Hosia :  Ki briew ki bym shym la long ki jong nga ngan khot ‘Ki Briew jong nga .’ Ka jaitbynriew kaba ngam shym la ieit ngan khot ‘Kaba ieit jong nga .’

translation.en: And being brought on their way by the church , they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria , declaring the conversion of the Gentiles : and they caused great joy unto all the brethren .
translation.kha: La leit on lynti ïa ki da ka balang ; bad kaba ki dang leit lyngba ka Phoenisia bad ka Samaria , ki la ïathuh kumno ba ki Jentil ki la phai sha U Blei ; kane ka khubor ka la wallam ka jingkmen bakhraw ïa ki parabangeit baroh .
kham palat ban ïa u briew u bym lehkmen ïoh ha ka jingim , la u lah ban im ar hajar snem . Nalorkata , baroh ar ki leit sha kajuh jaka ka .
translation.en: Yea , though he live a thousand years twice told , yet hath he seen no good : do not all go to one place ?
And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first  ; and Ben–hadad sent out , and they told him , saying , There are men come out of Samaria .
translation.kha: Ki shipai samla ki la tur nyngkong . Ki nongsyntiat ba la phah da u Benhadad , ki leit ïathuh ha u ba shi kynhun ki shipai ki la wan mih na Samaria .

translation.en: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon , nor burnt sacrifice , nor meat offering  ; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon .
translation.kha: Wat thang halor jong ka ïa ka jingiwbih ba lah khang , ne ïa ka jingainguh thang da ki mrad ne ïa ka jingainguh bam , bad wat theh halor jong ka ïa ka jingainguh kaba da ka waiñ .

translation.en: And when Moses heard that , he was content .
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewhun .

translation.en: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp , they went into one tent , and did eat and drink , and carried thence silver , and gold , and raiment , and went and hid it  ; and came again , and entered into another tent , and carried thence also , and went and hid it .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah saw ngut ki poi harud kata ka jaka shong dara , ki leit rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ , ki bam ki dih kat kaba don , ki la rah noh ïa ka rupa , ka ksiar , bad ki jaiñ ba ki shem bad ki leit noh bad buhrieh ïa ki ; nangta ki wan phai , ki la rung ha kawei pat ka ïingjaiñ bad ki leh kumjuh .

Bad man uwei uwei nongïamareh uba don ha ka jingshah hikai , u pyndem ha ka jinghikai kaba pyrkhing , khnang ba yn pynphong da ka sla dieng ka bymneh hynrei ma pat ngi ïaleh na bynta kata ka ban neh junom la .
translation.en: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things . Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown ; but we an incorruptible .
All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee , and their kings shall be sore afraid , they shall be troubled in their countenance .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba shong ha lynter ka rud duriaw u kyndit ïa ka kupar jong pha . Wat ki syiem jong ki , ki sngewtriem , bad ka jingsheptieng ka paw ha ki khmat jong ki .
Ki “shaduh ki ïohi ïa kane bad ki bitar ; u peit jingjrong tulop ka jingisih bad Proberb Baalath noh ; ka jingkyrmen pynbamphlang ki ka duh Dorbar junom .
translation.en: The wicked shall see it , and be grieved  ; he shall gnash with his teeth , and melt away : the desire of the wicked shall perish .

translation.kha: Kumta ngan tur ïaleh ïa phi kum sing u . Kum u labasa ngan apthap ha ki lynti ïaid jong phi .
translation.en: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion : as a leopard by the way will I observe them :

translation.kha: Mynba nga dang duwai kob u Gabriel , uba bymkut la lah ïohi jingkheiñ ka jingïohipaw mynshuwa , u Khyndiat wan her sha tbian sha ka jaka ha kaba nga don . Ka la long ha ka por ringmraw ai ïa ka jingkñia janmiet Ba
translation.en: Yea , whiles I was speaking in prayer , even the man Gabriel , whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning , being caused to fly swiftly , touched me about the time of the evening oblation .
And he saw that there was no man , and wondered that there was no intercessor : therefore his arm brought salvation unto him  ; and his righteousness , it sustained him .
translation.kha: U lyngngoh ban ïohi ba ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa kiba shah banbeiñ . Kumta un pyndonkam ïa la ka jong ka bor ban pyllait im ïa ki bad wanrah ïa ka jingjop .
( Israel ki hap leit sha Philistia ban shut ïa ki nar lyngkor , ki mohkhiew , ki sdie , bad ki rashi jong ;
translation.en: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines , to sharpen every man his share , and his coulter , and his axe , and his mattock .
It took me by surprise .
translation.kha: Ka pynkyndit ia nga .

translation.en: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God , who liveth for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Nangta uwei na ki saw tylli ki kherub u la ai ha ki hynñiew ngut ki angel ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang ksiar ba la pyndap da ka jingbitar jong U Blei , uba im junom la junom .

translation.en: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision : and so Abraham begat Isaac , and circumcised him the eighth day  ; and Isaac begat Jacob  ; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs .
translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la ai ha u Abraham ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingotsher kum ka dak jong ka jutang . Kumta u Abraham u la otsher ïa u Isaak hadien shi taïew naduh ba la kha ïa u ; u Isaak u la otsher ïa u Jakob u khun jong u bad u Jakob u la otsher ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u , ki kpa tymmen kiba pawnam jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .
U ong , Ïaroh ïa Trai , U Blei jong u kynrad jong u Abraham , uba batskhem la ka kular kynrad jong nga . U u la ïalam beit ïa nga sha ki kur ki jait u kynrad jong nga
translation.en: And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of my master Abraham , who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth : I being in the way , the  Lord  led me to the house of my master s brethren .

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei jong phi un ïalam ïa , bad un ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi , kumba phi ïohi u ba u leh ha Ijipt
translation.en: The  Lord  your God which goeth before you , he shall fight for you , according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes  ;

translation.kha: U Blei jingjahburom tip ïa kiei Kato khyrdong ba nga leh ; Gilgal ïohi man ka sien jam ba nga jam .
translation.en: Doth not he see my ways , and count all my steps ?

translation.kha: u kumta thang jingkñia da ki mrad bad ki jingainguh bam , bad u theh ïa ka jingainguh waiñ bad snam ka jong ka jingainguh ïasyllok ha ka .
translation.en: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering , and poured his drink offering , and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings , upon the altar .
And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long , and five cubits broad .
translation.kha: Ki kamra ap phira jong ka , ka kamra rung jong ka , bad ki kynroh bashapoh jong ka ki la long katjuh ka jingheh kat kito kiba ha kiwei pat ki khyrdop . La don ruh jingkhangïit baroh sawdong bad ha ka jaka rung . Baroh shi lynter ka la long arphew san mitar ka jingjrong bad khat-ar mitar shiteng ka pyngkiang .
ki shipai ki aiti noh ïa kita koidi bad ïa ki mar lute ha ki paidbah bad ki nongïalam jong ki
translation.en: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la lumlang Nalorkata kyndiang paidbah baroh ha khmat u mawsiang , bad u Moses maphi Pynduh rang Sngap mynta , Epher ki nongïaleh pyrshah jakashong Hato ngi hap pynmih um kohnguh une u mawsiang na ka pat jong phi ?
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock , and he said unto them , Hear now , ye rebels  ; must we fetch you water out of this rock ?

translation.kha: Hato kam pat biang tang ba phi la ïalam noh ngi na ka ri Ijipt kaba seisoh ban pynïap ngi hangne ha ri khlaw sa ban da long kynrad halor jong ngi ?
translation.en: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey , to kill us in the wilderness , except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us ?

translation.kha: long uba mutlop , kumba ki tymmen ki la long ha Meribah , kumba ki la long ka sngi ha ka ri shyiap Massah
translation.en: Harden not your heart , as in the provocation , and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness :

translation.kha: Me hi ïoh ka jingpang bajur ha ki snier ban kham jur na kawei ka sngi sha .
translation.en: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels , until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day .
Now when Jesus was in Bethany , in the house of Simon the leper ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la don ha Bethania ha ka ïing jong u Simon , u briew uba la pang  ñiangthohlieh .

translation.en: Therefore speak I to them in parables : because they seeing see not  ; and hearing they hear not , neither do they understand .
translation.kha: Ka daw ba nga pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ha kaba ïakren bad ki ka long ba ki peit , hynrei kim ïohi , bad ki shahshkor , hynrei kim ïohsngew lane shemphang .

translation.en: As one whom his mother comforteth , so will I comfort you  ; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ngan pyntngen ïa phi ha Jerusalem , kumba ka kmie ka pyntngen ïa la i khun .

translation.en: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without , and that ye may have lack of nothing .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom , phin ïoh ïa ka jingñiewkor jong kito ki bym pat ngeit , bad phim donkam ban shaniah hano hano na ka bynta kaei kaba phi donkam .
Ha ka sngi kaba bud ka thma ki Philistia ki leit bad lute ïa ki metïap , bad ïa ki met jong u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ba ki don u Lum .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa .

translation.kha: U Trai u la hukum ïa nga ban hikai kylliang iaka ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba phi dei ban sumar bad Johanan ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .
translation.en: And the  Lord  commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments , that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it .

translation.kha: Kita shi para ki la ïa jaiñ ka jingsngewsih , ki la buh biang ïa la ki jingkit halor ki kada bad ki leit sha kata ka .
translation.en: Then they rent their clothes , and laded every man his ass , and returned to the city .
And the day following Paul went in with us unto James  ; and all the elders were present .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Paul u la leit bad ngi ban ïakynduh ïa u Jakob ; bad baroh ki nongsharai balang jong ka balang ki la ïadon lang .
Sabtah Saul u ong Anath 65 Ahimelekh , Shahshkor jinghiarpateng Lyngdoh ! Nga hangne 5 ko Shet , u tiar .
translation.en: And Saul said , Hear now , thou son of Ahitub . And he answered , Here I am , my lord .
But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give  ; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam don satia ka hok ban jied mano u ban shong sha kamon jong nga bad sha kadiang jong nga . Dei U Blei u ban ai ïa kine ki jaka ha kito ïa kiba u la pynkhreh ïa ki .
Nangta U Khun U Briew un paw , u da wan ha ki lyoh lem bad ka bor bad ka bakhraw burom .
translation.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory .

translation.kha: ( la Ki ong ïa kane namar ki la lah ïohi ïa u Trophimos uba na Ephesos ryngkat bad u Paul ha ka nongbah , bad ki la pyrkhat ba u Paul u ïalam la ïa u shapoh ka . Templ )
translation.en: ( For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian , whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple . )
And he took the book of the covenant , and read in the audience of the people : and they said , All that the  Lord  hath said will we do , and be obedient .
translation.kha: Nangta pat u shim ïa ka kitab ka jutang ha kaba la thoh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  bad u pule jam ïa ka ha uta u paidbah ; ki ruh ki ïa-ong ,  Ïa kita baroh kiba U  Trai  u la hukum , ngin leh , bad ngin kohnguh .

translation.en: And Jacob s anger was kindled against Rachel : and he said , Am I in God s stead , who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb ?
translation.kha: U Jakob u la sngewbitar ïa ka Rakhel bad u ong ,  Ngam lah ban shim ïa ka jaka U Blei . Dei ma u uba khang ïa pha ban ïoh khun .

Nangta u la phai sha kata Shaul briew bad u la ong ha u Simon Joah Me ïohi jaiñjot kane jingsiangthiah briew ? Nga la wan Akhsib ka jingïadoh jong tmier , bad mem shym la ai um ïa nga na ka bynta ki kjat jong nga jingtah hynrei ka la sait ïashukor ki kjat jong nga da ki ummat jong ka bad ka hap ñiad rkhiang Kordit ki da u shñiuh jong ka .
translation.en: And he turned to the woman , and said unto Simon ,  Seest thou this woman ? I entered into thine house , thou gavest me no water for my feet : but she hath washed my feet with tears , and wiped them with the hairs of her head .
Moreover thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Shall they fall , and not arise ? shall he turn away , and not return ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Haba uno uno u kyllon , hato un ym ïeng pat ? Lada uno uno u bakla lynti , hato un ym wan phai pat ?

translation.en: Wisdom is too high for a fool : he openeth not his mouth in the gate .
translation.kha: Ki jingkren kiba stad ki long kiba jylliew katta katta ïa u briew uba bieit ban sngewthuh . Um don ei ei ban kren haba ïa ki kam badonkam la ïatainia .
U Jisu la u kiew halor kawei na ki lieng — kaba long ka jong u Simon — bad u la kyrpad ïa u ñiat ban tang khyndiat na ka rud duriaw . U Jisu u la shong ha ka lieng u bad la hikai ïa u paidbah .
translation.en: And he entered into one of the ships , which was Simon s , and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land . And he sat down , and taught the people out of the ship .

translation.kha: uta Ïa uba la shah kdew ha bad uba la lap ïa ki tiar ki tar kiba la mana yn thang ha ka ding , bad lem ïa ka longïing jong u , bad kaei kaei baroh kaba u don , naba u wanrah ïa ka jinglehrain bashyrkhei ïa Israel ki bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong nga .
translation.en: And it shall be , that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire , he and all that he hath : because he hath transgressed the covenant of the  Lord  , and because he hath wrought folly in Israel .
For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ ; that every one may receive the things done in his body , according to that he hath done , whether it be good or bad .
translation.kha: Naba baroh na ngi ngin paw ha khmat U Khrist , ba yn bishar ïa ngi da u . Ngin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba ngi dei hok , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi la leh , la bha ne la sniew , ha kane ka jingim ha ka met jong ngi .

translation.en: Behold , your house is left unto you desolate : and verily I say unto you , Ye shall not see me , until the time come when ye shall say , Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa ka Templ jong pha yn iehnoh . Nga pynthikna ïa pha ba phan ym ïohi ïa nga tad ynda ka por ka poi haba phan ong , ‘ U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai .’

translation.en: And they called unto Lot , and said unto him , Where are the men which came in to thee this night ? bring them out unto us , that we may know them .
translation.kha: Ki pyrta ïa u Lot bad kylli ïa u ,  Hangno kito ki rangbah kiba wan sah bad me ha kane ka miet ? Pynmih ïa ki shabar !  Ki shynrang jong ka Sodom ki kwah ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki .
Nangta u Joshua u khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki kiba rangbah u la jied ,
translation.en: Then Joshua called the twelve men , whom he had prepared of the children of Israel , out of every tribe a man :
While he was yet speaking , there came also another , and said , Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un kut ka jingkren , sa uwei pat u shakri u la wan bad u ong ,  Ki khun jong phi ki dang ïakhawai ha ïing u khun shynrang baheh duh jong phi , haba ka  erïong na ri shyiap ka wan beh shapoh .
ong ha , ki paralok jong , wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba pynïap ïa ka met hynrei ki bym hadien leh ïa kano kaba kham sniew .
translation.en: And I say unto you my friends , Be not afraid of them that kill the body , and after that have no more that they can do .
To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba , and the sweet cane from a far country ? your burnt offerings are not acceptable , nor your sacrifices sweet unto me .
translation.kha: Nga salia aïu ïa ka jingiwbih kaba ki wallam ïa nga na Sheba , lane ki musla na ka ri bajngai ? Ngan ym pdiang ïa ki jingainguh jong ki lane ban sngewbha ha ki jingkñia jong ki .

translation.en: But a wife might choose to leave her husband if ( 1 ) he stubbornly refuses to support his family , ( 2 ) he is so violent that her health and life are in danger , or ( 3 ) his extreme opposition makes it impossible for her to worship Jehovah .—1 Corinthians 7 :12 , 13 .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka tnga ka lah ban jied ban shongkhlad na la u tnga tang lada ( 1 ) u leh bym salia bad um kitkhia ban bsa ïa la ka ïing ( 2 ) u shoh u dat haduh ba ka jingkoit jingkhiah bad ka jingim jong ka , ka shong syier lane ( 3 ) ka jingpynthut palat jong u ka khang lad ïa ka ha ka ban mane ïa U Jehobah , kum ha kaba pule ïa ka Baibl , ha kaba leit jingïaseng bad ha kaba leit ïalap .—1 Korinth 7 :12 , 13 .
Don ka Ekron lem bad ki nongbah bad ki nongrit ka
translation.en: Ekron , with her towns and her villages :

translation.kha: ki Nangta synran ki la leit phai sha ïing .
translation.en: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home .

translation.kha: Tyngka kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la Aram ha ki briew kumno la pynkhiah ïa poh-ïing u briew .
translation.en: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed .

translation.kha: haba u Ahab u syiem u la ïap , u u ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ki Israel
translation.en: But it came to pass , when Ahab was dead , that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel .
And he will take your menservants , and your maidservants , and your goodliest young men , and your asses , and put them to his work .
translation.kha: Un shim ïa ki shakri jong phi , bad ïa kiba kynsai tam na ki jingri bad ki kada jong phi , bad un pyntrei ïa ki ha ka kam jong u .

translation.en: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke : among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka jingpynshitom ka la wan , bad ki Israel kin sa shah pynjot . Ko ki paid Israel , kane kan jia da shisha !
Hadien ba u la kynjoh ka rta kaba la tymmen bha haba u la don shispah laiphew snem , la u ïap .
translation.en: But Jehoiada waxed old , and was full of days when he died  ; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died .
In those days came John the Baptist , preaching in the wilderness of Judaea ,
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Ïoannis Nongpynbaptis u la wan sha ka ri shyiap jong ka Judia bad u la sdang ban ïalap .

translation.en: A talebearer revealeth secrets : but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter .
translation.kha: Uba lorni u thad ïa kaba la buhrieh , hynrei phi lah ban buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha uba lah ban buhrieh .
Ïaroh ïa Meronoth Trai bakhlaiñ baroh ki jaitbynriew kjap pyrthei , ïaroh ïa ka burom bad Ïoanna bor jong PYNI .
translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  , ye kindreds of the people , give unto the  Lord  glory and strength .
But these five kings fled , and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah .
translation.kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Amor , pynban , ki la phet ïap bad rieh hapoh ka krem ha Makkedah .

Mynta ba u Absalom u la ïap , u , u Dabid bad Haggith , u u khun heh uba dang im . U long u briew uba U Dabid um pat sneng u kano , bad u la kwah eh ban long syiem . U la pynkhreh ïa lade ki kali ïapom , ki , bad ka kynhun synran kaba don sanphew ngut ki rangbah .
translation.en: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying , Why hast thou done so ? and he also was a very goodly man  ; and his mother bare him after Absalom .

translation.kha: U siat ïa ki khnam bad u pynsaphriang ïa ki nongshun jong u ; da jingthaba ka ka leilieh u pynher ïa ki .
translation.en: And he sent out arrows , and scattered them  ; lightning , and discomfited them .
And he turned back , and looked on them , and cursed them in the name of the  Lord . And there came forth two she bears out of the wood , and tare forty and two children of them .
translation.kha: U Elisha u phai dien , u la khmih da ka jingbitar ïa ki , bad u la tim ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai . Nangta ar tylli ki dngiem kynthei ki la wan mih na khlaw bad ki la patar lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki sawphew ar ngut ki khynnah shynrang .

translation.en: And if any man ask you , Why do ye loose him ? thus shall ye say unto him , Because the Lord hath need of him .

translation.en: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes , he looked up to heaven , and blessed , and brake the loaves , and gave them to his disciples to set before them  ; and the two fishes divided he among them all .

Thus shalt thou say unto him , The  Lord  saith thus  ; Behold , that which I have built will I break down , and that which I have planted I will pluck up , even this whole land .

Nangta Shalman Moses u jingmynthi ha u Aaron Shabar ha u Eleasar bad templ Ithamar , ki pynbyrsieh shynrang jong kita , Wat ieh ra-ngiep ïa la Sodom shñiuh lane kad ïa la ki jingphna ban pyn-i ba phi ïam Jiw , jaijai phi leh kumta phin ïap lwa bad U Trai un pynsait jingsympat u paidlang Pynkheiñ . Hynrei Kainan baroh Timaïos para kham Israel jong sangsot la shah ba kin ïa-ïam briew na ka bynta kane ka jingïap ba la wallam da ka khain kaba U Trai u la phah .

Then Paul answered , What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart ? for I am ready not to be bound only , but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la jubab ,  Phi ïaleh aïu , da kaba ïam kumne bad pynpait ïa ka dohnud jong nga ? Nga la kloi ym tang ban shah khum ha Jerusalem hynrei wat ban ïap ruh hangta na ka bynta U Trai Jisu .
Katba dang ïakren bad ïasaidnia , U Jisu hi u la hajan bad u la ïaid lem ki ;
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , while they communed together and reasoned , Jesus himself drew near , and went with them .
( 1 Peter 3 :18 ) Since then , God has made him a King .

translation.en: Now is the end come upon thee , and I will send mine anger upon thee , and will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations .

translation.en: Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee , whom the  Lord  thy God shall choose : one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee : thou mayest not set a stranger over thee , which is not thy brother .

Phi shikatdei eh bad phi la pyllait im ïa . Hynrei ki lum ki jngai palat ïa nga ; ka jingjynjar kan lap ïa nga , bad nga lah ban ïap noh shuwa ban poi shata
translation.en: Behold now , thy servant hath found grace in thy sight , and thou hast magnified thy mercy , which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life  ; and I cannot escape to the mountain , lest some evil take me , and I die :

Lada men ai khun shynrang ïa nga , nga kular ba ngan aiti ïa u sha me baroh shi rta ka jingim jong u , bad da lei lei yn ym khap ïa u shñiuh jong u .

translation.en: For the law was given by Moses , but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ .

translation.en: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice , and do all that I speak  ; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies , and an adversary unto thine adversaries .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi kohnguh ïa u , bad leh kat ïa kaba nga hukum , ngan ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh .

Mano dei uta ba pynlong ïa kane wat jia em Uba la thmu jingsuki Sela ka jingïaid ka markhap ? Nga , U Trai , nga la don hangta durbriew mynnyngkong , bad nga , janai Trai , ngan ïai don (sa ha kaba jaka .
translation.en: Who hath wrought and done it , calling the generations from the beginning ? I the  Lord  , the first , and with the last  ; I am he .
And if any soul sin through ignorance , then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering .
translation.kha: Lada mano mano na phi , phi leh pop khlem da mut khnang , phi dei ban wanrah kawei ka blang kaba shisnem ka rta kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop .

translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  My time is not yet come : but your time is alway ready .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ka por kaba biang na ka bynta jong nga kam pat poi . Kano kano ka por na ka bynta ïa phi ka biang .
Kam da donkam ïa nga ban pynrem ïa me ; la pynrem ïa jingkhanglad Bakhuid kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ba me kren .
translation.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee , and not I : yea , thine own lips testify against thee .

I have seen thine adulteries , and thy neighings , the lewdness of thy whoredom , and thine abominations on the hills in the fields . Woe unto thee , O Jerusalem ! wilt thou not be made clean ? when shall it once be ?
translation.kha: U la ïohi ba pha leh ïa kiei kiei kiba u isih . U la ïohi ba pha bud ïa ki blei thala halor ki lum bad ki lyngkha , kum u briew uba threw jakhlia ïa ka tnga u paramarjan jong u lane kum u kulai ïa ka kulai . Ko ki briew jong ka Jerusalem , phi long kiba la tim ! Lano phin ïoh long kiba khuid ?
U Trai Phim nongthawdur ong ha pynkyllon , Ngan pynshitom ïa kito ki Lebi , ryngkat bad Amethyst husiar kiba na ki paid Israel , kiba talain basanphew ïa nga bad mane Hor ki bymlarkam Jahas
translation.en: And the Levites that are gone away far from me , when Israel went astray , which went astray away from me after their idols  ; they shall even bear their iniquity .
And said , Behold , I see the heavens opened , and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God .
translation.kha: Ha khmih !  u la ong .  Nga ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad ïa U Khun U Briew ba u ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei !

translation.en: But her end is bitter as wormwood , sharp as a twoedged sword .
translation.kha: hynrei haba la dep baroh , ka khlem ieh ei ei ïa phi hynrei tang ka jingkthang bad ka jingpang .
Na ki jingkñia ainguh kiba da u masi ne ka langbrot , ki lyngdoh ki dei ban ïoh ïa ka tyrpeng , baroh ar ki ngab , bad . ka nierbah
translation.en: And this shall be the priest s due from the people , from them that offer a sacrifice , whether it be ox or sheep  ; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder , and the two cheeks , and the maw .
Likewise greet the church that is in their house . Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus , who is the firstfruits of Asia unto Christ .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ruh ïa ka balang kaba ïaseng ha ka ïing jong ki . Ki jingkhublei ïa u paralok ba-ieit jong nga u Epainetos , uba long u rangbah uba nyngkong ha ka probins    jong ka Asia ban ngeit ha U Khrist .
Une te , u uba la hiar na bneng ; um kum uta u kpu uba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la bam , hadien ki ïap . Uta ïa une kpu im junom
translation.en: This is that bread which came down from heaven : not as your fathers did eat manna , and are dead : he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever .
Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick , as heretofore : let them go and gather straw for themselves .
translation.kha: Wat ai phlangïap    shuh ïa kine ki briew ban shna maw-it . Ieh kin leit ïawad phlangïap hi da lade .

U Trai mihpat pynpaw ïa lade ha ki nong nongring , bad nangta kin tip bad kin mane mawpud Heliopolis nongleitkurim bad kin wallam ha u ïa ki jingkñia bad ialap jingainguh . Kin pynlong ki :22-25 kyntang Barabbas Aaron bad kin pyndep ïa kaei kaba ki kular .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall be known to Egypt , and the Egyptians shall know the  Lord  in that day , and shall do sacrifice and oblation  ; yea , they shall vow a vow unto the  Lord  , and perform it .

translation.kha: U Trai un pyllait im ïa la ki briew jingshahshitom u ïohi ba kim donbor jingñiewburom . den isynei ïa kito kiba shakri ïa u haba u ïohi ba ñiad lah leh ei Jeiel shuh Truphosa
translation.en: For the  Lord  shall judge his people , and repent himself for his servants , when he seeth that their power is gone , and there is none shut up , or left .

translation.kha: To shahshkor phi ki nongsynshar ki Israel ! Phi la ban sngewkhia shaphang ka jingbishar hok ,
translation.en: And I said , Hear , I pray you , O heads of Jacob , and ye princes of the house of Israel  ; Is it not for you to know judgment ?
And he that saw it bare record , and his record is true : and he knoweth that he saith true , that ye might believe .
translation.kha: ( Uta uba la ïohi ïa kane ba ka jia u la kren shaphang jong ka , khnang ba ma phi ruh phin ïoh ngeit . Kaei kaba u la ong ka long kaba shisha , bad u tip ba u kren ïa ka jingshisha . )
Nangta u Semar Boses , Menna nyngkong , to ngin ïakylli Soh U Trai .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel , Enquire , I pray thee , at the word of the  Lord  to day .

translation.kha: Baroh jingkylli la jia a u Joseph u la lah Jehiskaïah .
translation.en: But he hanged the chief baker : as Joseph had interpreted to them .
The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses  ; and as horsemen , so shall they run .
translation.kha: Ki i kum ki kulai ; ki mareh kum ki kulai thma .
Ko syiem ka Babilonia , u khlur step baphyrnai , me la hap na bneng ! Ha kaba mynshuwa me jop la ïa ki hima , hynrei la mynta bret ïa me sha madan .
translation.en: How art thou fallen from heaven , O Lucifer , son of the morning ! how art thou cut down to the ground , which didst weaken the nations !

translation.kha: Ym don ba ïarap ïa U Blei ban ïa ki bneng lane halor ka met ki mrad kynsha ka duriaw .
translation.en: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens , and treadeth upon the waves of the sea .
Beware of dogs , beware of evil workers , beware of the concision .
translation.kha: To kiar noh na kito kiba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew , na kita ki ksew , kita ki briew kiba pynbor ïa ka ban ot ïa ka met .
Ka la long ka erïong kaba jur tam ba ka Ijipt ka la mad ha histori ka jong ka baroh .
translation.en: So there was hail , and fire mingled with the hail , very grievous , such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation .
Thus saith the  Lord  to me  ; Make thee bonds and yokes , and put them upon thy neck ,
translation.kha: ban shna ïa lade ka lyngkor da ki tyllai snieh bad ki dieng jingphna bad ban buh ïa ka ha u ryndang jong nga .
Hynrei phi , phi long uei , ko paralok jong nga , ban jubab kylla ïa ? U khiew khyndew um lah ban kylli ïa u briew uba thaw u , ba me thaw ïa nga ?
translation.en: Nay but , O man , who art thou that repliest against God ? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it , Why hast thou made me thus ?
But there came a man of God to him , saying , O king , let not the army of Israel go with thee  ; for the  Lord  is not with Israel , to wit , with all the children of Ephraim .
translation.kha: Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  Wat shim ïa kine ki shipai Israel bad me . U  Trai  um don bad kine ki kynhun shipai kiba na ka Hima bashatei .

translation.en: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David . And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword : and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword .
translation.kha: U la ai jingkheiñ ha u Dabid ïa ka jingdon baroh lang jong ki rangbah kiba bit ïa ka kam shipai : Khatwei lakh ngut ha Israel , bad saw lakh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ha Judah .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did so : and Joseph gave them wagons , according to the commandment of Pharaoh , and gave them provision for the way .
translation.kha: Ki khun U Jakob ki leh kumta kumba la bthah ïa ki . U Joseph u ai kali ïa ki , kumba u syiem u la hukum , bad u ai jingbam ïa ki ba kin bam ha lynti .

Kane ka Rakhe kaba me dei ban leh ïa u Aaron bad ki shylliah Ho-oid’ jong u ban pynkyntang ïa ki kum iing lyngdoh ki ban Ïingtrep ïa nga . Shim uwei u Bible lyngraw bad ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang ki bym don jingduna .
translation.en: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them , to minister unto me in the priest s office : Take one young bullock , and two rams without blemish ,

translation.kha: To pan kan bad jingïabam ïathuh ; to lutphut , bad phin shem ; nongkhmih riewbieit , bad ïa pihuiñ jingkhang yn plie jingsop phi .
translation.en: Ask , and it shall be given you  ; seek , and ye shall find  ; knock , and it shall be opened unto you :

translation.kha: Seir phi jingsyllok ïa ki PYNI , phi ding-ai-dak ban thied jingkynmaw riewhok jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong phi pajih
translation.en: Both thy bondmen , and thy bondmaids , which thou shalt have , shall be of the heathen that are round about you  ; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids .
Now if we be dead with Christ , we believe that we shall also live with him :
translation.kha: Namar ba ngi la ïap bad U Khrist , ngi ngeit ba ngin im ruh bad u .

translation.en: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth , that thou shalt be dumb , and shalt not be to them a reprover : for they are a rebellious house .
translation.kha: Ngan teh ïa u thylliej jong me ba kumta men ym lah ban maham ïa kine ki riewïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: Then Abner called to Joab , and said , Shall the sword devour for ever ? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end ? how long shall it be then , ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren ?
translation.kha: U Abner u pyrta ïa u Joab ,  Hato ngin hap ban ïaleh shi junom ? Hato mem ïohi ba ha kaba kut ym don ei ei hynrei tang ka jingkthang ? Ngi long ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi . Slem sa katno ha shuwa ba men hukum ïa ki rangbah jong me ban sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa ngi ?
To map ka pop jong u syiem bad jong ki paid Israel Hikai ïa ki leh ïa kaba dei . Nangta , A Trai to u slap ha kane ri jong me , ïa kaba me la ha la ki briew kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki junom .
translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy servants , and of thy people Israel , that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk , and give rain upon thy land , which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance .

translation.kha: Ngam khot shuh phi ïa ki shakri , namar u shakri um tip aïu u kynrad u leh . Pynban , nga khot ïa phi ki paralok , namar nga ïathuh la ïa phi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ïohsngew U na Kpa jong nga .
translation.en: Henceforth I call you not servants  ; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth : but I have called you friends  ; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you .
Or if his sin , which he hath sinned , come to his knowledge : then he shall bring his offering , a kid of the goats , a female without blemish , for his sin which he hath sinned .
translation.kha: te un tang shu tip ba u la leh pop kumta , un wallam kum ka jingainguh jong u ïa ka blang kynthei ka bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all .
translation.kha: Naba kim nud shuh ban kylli ïa u kano kano ka jingkylli .

translation.en: And make one cherub on the one end , and the other cherub on the other end : even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof .
translation.kha: uwei ha kawei ka tduh bad uwei ha kawei pat ka tduh jong ka jingtap , bad pynlong ïa ki ba kin i kumba ki ïadait lang bad kata ka jingtap .

translation.en: So David went up thither , and his two wives also , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess , and Abigail Nabal s wife the Carmelite .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u la leit sha Hebron , u da ïalam bad u ïa ki ar ngut ki tnga jong u : Ka Ahinoam kaba na Jesreel , bad ka Abigail , ka tnga u Nabal uba la ïap , kaba na Karmel .
Nga kwah klet noh shaphang kato .
translation.en: I just want to forget about it .
But Absalom pressed him , that he let Amnon and all the king s sons go with him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Absalom u ïai ban haduh ba u Dabid ha kaba khatduh u la shah ïa u Amnon bad ïa kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u baroh ban leit bad u Absalom . U Absalom u la pynkhreh ka jingkhawai kaba ïabiang ïa u syiem

translation.en: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua  ; upon one stone shall be seven eyes : behold , I will engrave the graving thereof , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day .
translation.kha: Nga buh ha khmat jong u Joshua ïa uwei u maw uba don hynñiew tylli ki dong . Ngan shniah ka jingthoh halor jong u bad ha ka shi sngi ngan shim noh ïa ka pop jong kane ka ri .

translation.en: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice .
translation.kha: Shisien ne ar sien ki nongkhaïi kiba die bun jait ki tiar ki pynlut ïa ka miet shuwa ka sngi Sabbaton shabar ki kynroh ka nongbah .

translation.en: And Deborah , a prophetess , the wife of Lapidoth , she judged Israel at that time .
translation.kha: Mynta ka Deborah , ka tnga jong u Lappidoth , ka long ka nongïathuhlypa , bad ka shakri kum ka nongbishar ïa ki Israel ha kata ka por .

Haba U Hakkherem u la pynlong ka jingkular ha u Abraham , u la smai ban leh ïa kaei kaba u la jingkmen . Namar ym don uwei ruh Ei ban kham khraw ban Betonim sep-ei jingkitpop u la pyndonkam ïa la ka Dalmanutha ka kyrteng ïakmen u la basian ïa jingpynkheiñ ka jingsmai Salu
translation.en: For when God made promise to Abraham , because he could swear by no greater , he sware by himself ,

translation.kha: Lyngba ka Hima jong u , U Jehobah shen un sa pynkut noh ki ïa jingjynjar jong iwei pa iwei i briew .
translation.en: Through his Kingdom , Jehovah will soon end the suffering of each individual .

translation.kha: Ha syndah jong me shihajar ngut ki lah ban kyllon , shiphew hajar ngut ha baroh sawdong jong me , men hynrei ym shah pynmynsaw .
translation.en: A thousand shall fall at thy side , and ten thousand at thy right hand  ; but it shall not come nigh thee .
Or have ye not read in the law , how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath , and are blameless ?
translation.kha: Lane phim pat ju pule ha ka Hukum u Moses ba man la ka sngi Sabbaton ki lyngdoh hapoh ka Templ ki pynkheiñ shisha ïa ka aiñ sngi Sabbaton , pynban kim shah pynrem ?

translation.en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him , and between all the people , and between the king , that they should be the  Lord s  people .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u lyngdoh u pynlong ïa u syiem Joash bad ïa ki paidbah ban ïasnohkti lang bad u ha kaba pynlong ka jutang ba kin long ki briew jong U  Trai .

Te u lyngskor u la ai dak u ïa Paul ban kren , u Paul u la ong , tip Nga ba me la long u nongbishar halor kane ka jaitbynriew la bun snem bad , kumta da kaba sngewbha nga ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmat jong me .
translation.en: Then Paul , after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak , answered , Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation , I do the more cheerfully answer for myself :
And thy mighty men , O Teman , shall be dismayed , to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah nongïaleh jong ka Teman kin kyiuh , bad ïa uwei pa uwei u shipai ha Edom yn pynïap .

Peit ïa une u ki ïakren para ma ki . Sngap ïa jingkob jong syiem Saul un ai ka nong kaba khraw ïa u briew u ban ïa ; u un ai ruh ban shongkurim ïa ka kynthei jong u bad ka ïing u kpa jong u kam donkam ban siew khajna .
translation.en: And the men of Israel said , Have ye seen this man that is come up ? surely to defy Israel is he come up : and it shall be , that the man who killeth him , the king will enrich him with great riches , and will give him his daughter , and make his father s house free in Israel .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u , Ki myrsiang ki don ki krem , bad ki sim ki ki don skum , hynrei U Khun U Briew um don jaka hangno hangno ban dem bad ban . pynjahthait
translation.en: And Jesus saith unto him ,  The foxes have holes , and the birds of the air have nests  ; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head .
And Tilgath–pilneser king of Assyria came unto him , and distressed him , but strengthened him not .
translation.kha: U patsha jong ka Assyria , ha ka jaka ban ïarap ïa u Ahas , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad thaw jingeh ïa u .

translation.en: Now therefore deliver us the men , the children of Belial , which are in Gibeah , that we may put them to death , and put away evil from Israel . But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Mynta aiti noh ïa kito ki riewbymman ha Gibeah , ba ngin ïoh pynïap ïa ki bad ban weng noh ïa kane ka jingbymman na Israel .  Hynrei ki briew ka Benjamin kim salia ïa kiwei pat ki jait Israel .

translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , the king rose up , and the governor , and Bernice , and they that sat with them :
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem , u lyngskor , bad ka Berniki , bad baroh kiwei pat ki la ïeng joit ,

Hangne nga don . Lada nga la ïa leh kano kano kaba , bakla sakhi pyrshah ïa nga ha khmat U Trai bad ha khmat u syiem uba u la pynsleh . Hato nga la shim ïa ka masi ne ka kada jongno jongno ? Hato nga la shukor banbeiñ ne ïano ïano ? Hato nga la bamsap nano nano ? Lada nga la leh ïa kine kiei kiei ngan noh pynphai ïa kata kaba nga la shim .
translation.en: Behold , here I am : witness against me before the  Lord  , and before his anointed : whose ox have I taken ? or whose ass have I taken ? or whom have I defrauded ? whom have I oppressed ? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith ? and I will restore it you .
Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect : yet not the wisdom of this world , nor of the princes of this world , that come to nought :
translation.kha: La katta ruh , nga pynbna ïa ka khubor jong ka jingstad sha kito kiba la san ha ka jinglong mynsiem . Hynrei , kam long ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei lane jong ki bor kiba synshar ïa kane ka pyrthei — ki bor ki ban sa duh noh ïa ka bor jong ki .
U suit ïa kaba shalor jong ka , ïa krung ki jong ka sawdong baroh , bad ïa ki reng jong , ka da ka ksiar nylla , bad u shna ruh ïa ka jingpynpur ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold , both the top of it , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns of it : also he made unto it a crown of gold round about .
And Jesus said ,  For judgment I am come into this world , that they which see not might see  ; and that they which see might be made blind .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Nga la wan sha kane ka pyrthei ban bishar , khnang ba kiba matlah kin ïohi bad kito kiba ïohi kin long matlah .

translation.en: A fool uttereth all his mind : but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bieit ki pynpaw ïa la ka jingbitar ha kaba paw , hynrei ki briew kiba shemphang ki ïaishah bad ki set khop ïa ka .

translation.en: And , being assembled together with them , commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem , but wait for the promise of the Father ,  which ,  saith he ,  ye have heard of me .
translation.kha: Bad haba ki la ïawanlang , u la ai ha ki ïa kane ka hukum :  Wat leit noh na Jerusalem , hynrei ap ïa ka jingkular kaba nga la ïathuh , ka jingai kaba U Kpa jong nga u la kular .
‘ Wallam doh ïa mrad nga bad shet ïa ka na ka bynta jong . nga Ynda nga la dep bam ïa ka , ngan ai ïa me ka jingkyrkhu ha khmat U Trai shuwa ba ngan ïap .’
translation.en: Bring me venison , and make me savoury meat , that I may eat , and bless thee before the  Lord  before my death .
Shall I bring to the birth , and not cause to bring forth ? saith the  Lord  : shall I cause to bring forth , and shut the womb ? saith thy God .
translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba ngan wallam ïa ki briew jong nga sha ka jingsuh kha bad khlem lah ban kha ïa ki .  U  Trai  u la kren .
ruh ïa u mrad na ka bynta ka ainguh thang , bad u kñia u ka jingbuhbeit .
translation.en: And he brought the burnt offering , and offered it according to the manner .
And he took bread , and gave thanks , and brake it , and gave unto them , saying ,  This is my body which is given for you : this do in remembrance of me .
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim shi lyngkhot u kpu , bad U la ainguh ha U Blei , U la kdiah ïa u , bad U la ai ïa u ha ki , da kaba ong ,  Une u long ka met jong nga , ïa kaba la ai na ka bynta jong phi . To leh ïa kane ban kynmaw ïa nga .
Suk kito sait pynkhuid ïa la ki jaiñkup bad ki don ka hok ban ïa u soh u dieng ka ban leit lyngba ki ka nongbah .
translation.en: Blessed are they that do his commandments , that they may have right to the tree of life , and may enter in through the gates into the city .

translation.kha: Ha ka Sarah pat u ong , Ngan ai ha hynmen jong u pha shihajar tylli ki sbai rupa kum ka jingpynshisha ha baroh kiba ïadon lem bad ba pha pha long kaba lui lui ; uwei pa uwei baroh un tip ba pham shym la leh bakla .
translation.en: And unto Sarah he said , Behold , I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver : behold , he is to thee a covering of the eyes , unto all that are with thee , and with all other : thus she was reproved .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ïa ka , To Babilon shong ha ka jingjar jar bad ha ka jingdum ; kin ym khot shuh ïa pha ka syiem jong ki jaitbynriew !
translation.en: Sit thou silent , and get thee into darkness , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called , The lady of kingdoms .

They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers , which refused to hear my words  ; and they went after other gods to serve them : the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers .
translation.kha: Ki la leit phai pat sha ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , kiba la kyntait ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Baroh ar , ka Israel bad ka Judah ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
‘ Kumno ?’ U Trai u kylli . jlawnguid Pung u jubab , Asotos Ngan leit bad pynlong ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa u slap PYNI kren lamler . U Trai u ong , leit bad shukor ïa u . Phin sa jop .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ? And he said , I will go forth , and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And he said , Thou shalt persuade him , and prevail also : go forth , and do so .

translation.kha: jingïadih la hukum pynlwait ki lyngdoh bad ki at ban leit Aben langsohmoh nongbah jong ka Judah Jashub ban lum na Sur briew baroh kat ban biang ban shna pynbha ïa ïai-ong Templ man ka snem . U ong ïa ki ban leh kloi , hynrei ki Lebi ki pyntud ,
translation.en: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites , and said to them , Go out unto the cities of Judah , and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year , and see that ye hasten the matter . Howbeit the Levites hastened it not .
Behold , God exalteth by his power : who teacheth like him ?

translation.en: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty , and shalt lift up thy face unto God .
Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee , neither did thy foot swell , these forty years .

translation.en: And Saul commanded his servants , saying , Commune with David secretly , and say , Behold , the king hath delight in thee , and all his servants love thee : now therefore be the king s son in law .

translation.en: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee : and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh , that he send the children of Israel out of his land .

translation.en: And he put down the idolatrous priests , whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah , and in the places round about Jerusalem  ; them also that burned incense unto Baal , to the sun , and to the moon , and to the planets , and to all the host of heaven .

translation.kha: Kim tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka jingsheptieng , bad ym don waitlam kaba lah ban pynphai dien ïa ki .

translation.en: And he went down with them , and came to Nazareth , and was subject unto them : but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart .

translation.en: A wise man feareth , and departeth from evil : but the fool rageth , and is confident .

translation.en: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy , whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing .
