translation.kha: Mynba U  Trai  u la kren ha u Moses ha ka ri Ijipt , u la ong ,  Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days : for yet the vision is for many days .
translation.kha: Nga la wan ban pynsngewthuh ïa me ïa kaei ka ban jia ha ki briew jong me ha ka lawei . Kane ka dei ka jingïohipaw ïa ka lawei .

translation.en: When Saul heard that David was discovered , and the men that were with him , ( now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah , having his spear in his hand , and all his servants were standing about him  ; )
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Saul u don ha Gibeah , u da shong ha trai u dieng Tamarisk halor u lum , lem bad la u sum ha ka kti , bad baroh ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ki don sawdong jong u .
To kmen ba ngi long ki jong ; u ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u kin shadkmen .
translation.en: Glory ye in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the  Lord .
But Jehoiada waxed old , and was full of days when he died  ; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la kynjoh ka rta kaba la tymmen bha haba u la don shispah laiphew snem , u la ïap .
Ka mluh ka long , hynrei lada ka duh noh ïa ka jingmad , ym lynti shuh da kumno kumno ban pynbang pat ïa ka .
translation.en: Salt is good : but if the salt have lost his savour , wherewith shall it be seasoned ?

And Jephthah came to Mizpah unto his house , and , behold , his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances : and she was his only child  ; beside her he had neither son nor daughter .
translation.kha: Haba u Jephthah u wan phai sha la ïing ha Mispah , ka khun jong u ka wan ban ïakynduh ïa u , ka da shad bad tem ïa ka ksing . Ka dei ka khun marwei jong u .

Haba u syiem Ahasaïah u ïohi ïa kaba kaei la jia , kumta u phet ïap ha la ka kali ïapom sha ka shnong Beth Haggan , ba beh la da kthong u Jehu . ïa Pynïap u ruh ! U Jehu u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u , bad ki la pynmynsaw u ïa katba u dang ñiah ïa ka kali ïapom jong u ha ka lynti kaba kiew sha Gur kaba hajan ka shnong Ibleam . Hynrei u la ïohlad ban nang leit tad ba haduh un da poi ha ka nongbah Megiddo ha , kaba u ïap .
translation.en: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this , he fled by the way of the garden house . And Jehu followed after him , and said , Smite him also in the chariot . And they did so at the going up to Gur , which is by Ibleam . And he fled to Megiddo , and died there .

translation.kha: U pynjahburom ïa kito kiba ha don ka bor bad pynkut ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki nongsynshar .
translation.en: He poureth contempt upon princes , and weakeneth the strength of the mighty .

translation.kha: U la kular lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid jong u na mynbarim
translation.en: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets , which have been since the world began :

translation.kha: Wat u syiem u shaniah ha ka jingot .
translation.en: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all : the king himself is served by the field .

translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem u u Abiathar u lyngdoh , leit sha ka jong ka ri ha Anathoth . Me dei hok , hynrei ngan ym phah me mynta namar ba la khmih sumar ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Trai mynba me dang don bad Dabid , u kpa jong nga bad me la ïoh lem ki jingjynjar jong u baroh .
translation.en: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king , Get thee to Anathoth , unto thine own fields  ; for thou art worthy of death : but I will not at this time put thee to death , because thou barest the ark of the Lord  God  before David my father , and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted .
And he went up thence to Penuel , and spake unto them likewise : and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him .
translation.kha: U Gideon u la leit sha Penuel bad u la kyrpad kumjuh ïa ki briew kiba hangta , hynrei ki briew jong ka Penuel ki la ai kajuh ka jubab kum ki rangbah jong ka Sukkoth .

translation.en: And the next day we that were of Paul s company departed , and came unto Caesarea : and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist , which was one of the seven  ; and abode with him .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la mihnoh bad ngi la poi ha Kaisaria . Hangta ngi la sah ha ka ïing jong u Philip u ebanjelist , uwei na ki hynñiew ngut ki rangbah ba la jied kum ki nongïarap ha Jerusalem .
Naba ha u briew uba don ei ei yn nang shuh ai , shuh khnang ba un ïoh kham bun ; hynrei ha u briew u bym ei don ei yn shim noh na u wat ïa kaba rit tam kaba u don .
translation.en: For whosoever hath , to him shall be given , and he shall have more abundance : but whosoever hath not , from him shall be taken away even that he hath .

And I will sow her unto me in the earth  ; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy  ; and I will say to them which were not my people , Thou art my people  ; and they shall say , Thou art my God .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong skhem ïa ki briew jong nga ha ka ri bad ngan pynmanbha ïa ki . Ngan pyn-i jingieit ïa kito kiba la ju khot  Lo-Ruhamah ,  bad ïa kito kiba la ju khot  Lo-ammi  ngan sa ong ,  Phi long ki briew jong nga ,  bad kin jubab ,  Me long U Blei jong ngi .
bad ban nym pynshahshkor shuh jingshitrhem ki khanatang jong ki Jiw bad ha shrong hukum briew kiba wan na ki briew kiba la Lebiathan ba-dum ka jingshisha pynsyrwa
translation.en: Not giving heed to Jewish fables , and commandments of men , that turn from the truth .
And one of the same place answered and said , But who is their father ? Therefore it became a proverb , Is Saul also among the prophets ?
translation.kha: U briew uba shong hangta u jubab ,  Kumno shaphang kine kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa — ki kpa jong ki , ki dei kiei ?  Dei kumta ba la mih ka jingong ,  Hato wat u Saul ruh u la long u Nongïathuhlypa ?
Nangta la don ka thma ha ka ri , Haba ki Israel ki jied ki blei thymmai . Na ki sawphew hajar ngut a rangbah ha Israel Don mano Shemeber ba rah ïa ka stieh ne u dujok! ?
translation.en: They chose new gods  ; then was war in the gates : was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel ?

translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei yn pynjahburom , bad ïa baroh kiba yn sarong pynrit .
translation.en: And the mean man shall be brought down , and the mighty man shall be humbled , and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled :

translation.kha: Hajan Khyrdop ha Jerusalem ka la don pungsum kaba don tylli ki baranda ; ha ka ktien Hebru la ïa , ka Bethesda .
translation.en: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool , which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda , having five porches .

translation.kha: Naba U Khrist u la pynkut ïa ka Hukum , khnang ba uei uei baroh Ïingjaiñ ngeit ïabah don ka jingïadei bad U Blei pynjahburom
translation.en: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth .

translation.kha: Haba la ïohi ba ïa ka jingai jingmut jong u ym shym la pdiang , u teh jin ïa la ka kada bad u leit phai noh sha la shnong . Ynda la dep ïa la ki kam ïing kam sem , u la sdien ïa lade . La tep ïa u ka jingtep ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed , he saddled his ass , and arose , and gat him home to his house , to his city , and put his household in order , and hanged himself , and died , and was buried in the sepulchre of his father .
The  Lord  is well pleased for his righteousness  sake  ; he will magnify the law , and make it honourable .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long U Blei uba kwah eh ban pynim , kumta u kyntiew ïa ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai jong u , bad u kwah ba ki briew jong u ki burom ïa ki .

translation.en: Wherefore the law is holy , and the commandment holy , and just , and good .
translation.kha: Te kumta , ka Hukum hi ka long kaba khuid , bad ka jinghukum ka long kaba khuid , kaba dei bad kaba bha .

Nangta shim Burom jingpyrshah na ki riewdonburom uba don ka tangmuri ba-halor eh ban pynriam ibis uta u Shillong da kine mynstep jingriam bad un ïalam ïa u , ba la pynshong halor u kulai lyngba dondor lute bapyndait jong ka nongbah bajhieh Ai ba uta u riewdonburom un pyrta katba ki :39-44 ïaid : ‘ Peit kumno u syiem Miniamin ainong ïa Nangta briew uba u kwah ban pyndonburom !’
translation.en: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king s most noble princes , that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour , and bring him on horseback through the street of the city , and proclaim before him , Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour .
Therefore , as ye abound in every thing , in faith , and utterance , and knowledge , and in all diligence , and in your love to us , see that ye abound in this grace also .
translation.kha: Phi long kiba riewspah katta katta ha baroh kiba phi don : Ha ka jingngeit , ka jingkren , bad ka jingtip , ha ka jingangnud ban ïarap bad ha ka jingieit jong phi ïa ngi . Bad kumta ngi kwah ïa phi ban long kiba sbun ruh ha kane ka jingshakri jong ka jingieit .

translation.en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him , he touched the hollow of his thigh  ; and the hollow of Jacob s thigh was out of joint , as he wrestled with him .
translation.kha: Haba uta u briew u ïohi ba um lah jop ïa u Jakob , u kura ïa u na ka skhep ; bad kata ka skhep jong u ka la lait .

translation.en: And they shall mock him , and shall scourge him , and shall spit upon him , and shall kill him : and the third day he shall rise again .
translation.kha: ki ban sa rkhiebeiñ ïa u , kin bynthiew halor jong u , kin sympat ïa u , bad pynïap ïa u ; hynrei hadien lai sngi un sa mihpat .

translation.en: Then were there two thieves crucified with him , one on the right hand , and another on the left .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la sahnarphna ruh ïa ki ar ngut ki nonglute lem bad U Jisu , uwei sha ka liang kamon jong u bad uwei pat sha ka liang kadiang jong u .

translation.en: And he answered and said , Must I not take heed to speak that which the  Lord  hath put in my mouth ?
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Nga lah ban kren tang ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ïa nga ban kren .

translation.en: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud , that our prayer should not pass through .
translation.kha: da u lyoh jong ka jingbitar shla jong me uba rben katta katta ïa ki jingduwai jong ngi ban ksam lyngba .

translation.en: But Jehoshabeath , the daughter of the king , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him from among the king s sons that were slain , and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber . So Jehoshabeath , the daughter of king Jehoram , the wife of Jehoiada the priest , ( for she was the sister of Ahaziah , ) hid him from Athaliah , so that she slew him not .
translation.kha: U Ahasaïah u don kawei ka para ar kmie , ka Jehosheba , kaba shongkurim ïa u lyngdoh uba kyrteng u Jehoïada . Ka la pyllait im jar jar ïa u Joash , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Ahasaïah , ka la shim ïa u na kiwei pat ki khun syiem kiba la dei ban shah pynïap bad ka la buhrieh ïa u bad ka nongri khun ha ka kamra thiah ha ka Templ . Da kaba buhrieh ïa u , ka la pyllait im ïa u na ka jingshah pynïap ha ki kti jong ka Athalaïah .

translation.en: And set up false witnesses , which said , This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place , and the law :
translation.kha: Nangta ki la wallam katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban ïathuh lamler shaphang jong u .  Une u briew ,  ki la ong ,  u ïai kren borabor pyrshah ïa ka templ bakyntang bad ïa ka hukum u Moses .

Nga ong , Ngan ïam na ka bynta lumbah bad ummat na bynta pynbamphlang , namar ki la tyrkhong bad ym don mano mano ba jingleit lyngba ki . Ïa jingsawa ki jingri ym shym ïohsngew shuh ; ki sim bad mradkhlaw ki la phet bad kim shuh .
translation.en: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing , and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation , because they are burned up , so that none can pass through them  ; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle  ; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled  ; they are gone .

translation.kha: khnang ba , ‘ Kin khmih bad ïai khmih , pynban kin Governing ïohi ; pynkhia sngap Diklah ïai sngap , pynban kin babit sngewthuh . Namar lada ki ïohi lane sngewthuh batynrai kin phai sha U Blei , bad un map ïa ki .’
translation.en: That seeing they may see , and not perceive  ; and hearing they may hear , and not understand  ; lest at any time they should be converted , and their sins should be forgiven them .

translation.kha: I pa jong ngi i la ïap ha ka ri khlaw khlem khun shynrang . Im shym ïadon lang bad ki nongbud jong u Korah kiba la pyrshah ïaleh ïa U ; Trai i la ïap namar pop ka la jong .
translation.en: Our father died in the wilderness , and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the  Lord  in the company of Korah  ; but died in his own sin , and had no sons .

translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u la sheptieng sawlyer Amalek Trai bad u ong , Mynta kumno ngan lah ban shim ïa suda Synduk ka Jutang to Joahas ?
translation.en: And David was afraid of the  Lord  that day , and said , How shall the ark of the  Lord  come to me ?
Hearing of thy love and faith , which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus , and toward all saints  ;
translation.kha: Naba nga ïohsngew shaphang ka jingieit jong me ïa ki briew U Blei baroh bad ïa ka jingngeit kaba me don ha U Trai Jisu .
U Moses u kohnguh u bad buh jingthoh ïa ki khun shynrang baroh kiba la kha nyngkong ha Israel kumba U Trai u la hukum ,
translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them , throughout their families , by the house of their fathers , were two thousand and six hundred and thirty .
Therefore thus will I do unto thee , O Israel : and because I will do this unto thee , prepare to meet thy God , O Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko ki paid Israel , ngan pynshitom ïa phi . Bad namar ba ngan leh ïa kane , to pynkhreh ban mad ïa ka jingbishar jong nga !

translation.en: This is the law , when a man dieth in a tent : all that come into the tent , and all that is in the tent , shall be unclean seven days .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u ïap hapoh ka ïingjaiñ , mano mano ba don hapoh ka ïingjaiñ ha ka por ba ïap lane ba rung hapoh jong ka u long u bymkhuid haduh hynñiew sngi .
Nangta ki paid Israel — ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi bad baroh kiwei pat kiba la wan na phai ka jingshah ringmraw da — ka jingkmen ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And the children of Israel , the priests , and the Levites , and the rest of the children of the captivity , kept the dedication of this house of God with joy ,
And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal , and burned them .
translation.kha: ki sei shabar ïa u rishot bakyntang uba don hangta bad ki thang ïa u .

translation.en: And he said ,  Therefore said I unto you , that no man can come unto me , except it were given unto him of my Father .
translation.kha: Bad u la pyndap ,  Kane hi ka dei ka daw kaba nga la ïathuh ïa phi ba ym don uba lah ban wan sha nga lymda U Kpa u pynlah ïa u ban leh kumta .
ryndang phi u long kum u mot jong u , pyllun , lem u jingdeng ryndang kum shihajar tylli ki stieh kiba pynsdien sawdong jong u .
translation.en: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door , and my bowels were moved for him .
Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem , from before the tabernacle of the congregation , and reigned over Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta u Solomon u mihnoh na ka jaka mane ha Gibeon , ha kaba don ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad u leit phai pat sha Jerusalem . Hangta u synshar ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Being defamed , we entreat : we are made as the filth of the world , and are the offscouring of all things unto this day .
translation.kha: La ñiew ïa ngi kum ka synrum jong ka pyrthei ; ngi long ki briew kiba la shah kyntait beiñ haduh kane ka khyllipmat !
Hikai ïa kine kiei kiei bad pyndonkam ïa ka iktiar haba me ai mynsiem bad haba sneng ki me . Wat ai ïano ïano na ban ibeiñ ïa me .
translation.en: These things speak , and exhort , and rebuke with all authority . Let no man despise thee .

translation.kha: Ka jingïasoh jong nga bad U Trai ka Jisu pynlong thikna ïa nga ba ym don ka jingbam ha ka hi , kaba long bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam ; hynrei lada u briew u ngeit katto ba katne ka jingbam ka long ka bymkhuid te , ka long bymkhuid ïa u .
translation.en: I know , and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus , that there is nothing unclean of itself : but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean , to him it is unclean .
The proud have had me greatly in derision : yet have I not declined from thy law .
translation.kha: Kiba sarong ki krenbeiñ borabor ïa nga , hynrei ngam shym phai noh na ka aiñ jong me .
A Hassenaah , to Belshassar ïa kito ki ïap-tyrsaw ! To kynmaw hab kito kiba shahshitom !
translation.en: Arise , O  Lord   ; O God , lift up thine hand : forget not the humble .

translation.kha: bad u ïa ki , ki paralok jong ki khun syiem shynrang , ki syiem shynrang jong ki u .
translation.en: That he may set him with princes , even with the princes of his people .
Behold my servant , whom I uphold  ; mine elect , in whom my soul delighteth  ; I have put my spirit upon him : he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Une u long u shakri jong nga , uba nga pynshaitbor — Uta uba nga la jied , ha u nga shem sngewbha . Nga la pyndap ïa u da U Mynsiem jong nga , bad un wallam jingbishar hok ha man la ka jaitbynriew .
Balei me khot babha ïa nga ? U Jisu u la kylli ïa u . Ym don bha uba lait noh tang U Blei hi .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God .

translation.kha: Kseh-Phir kajuh kynsai rukom phin pyrkhat ïa lade kum bymshisha la ïap , bleithaw) Pharoah jingïadei syrdoh ka pop , pynmareh kiba im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei lyngba U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin , but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord .

translation.kha: U Kat um shym tip ba naba dei nongbatai angel jong U Trai , kumta Berakhaïah ong ha nalor , Sngewbha wat Jetur pat leit jingïa-ïaid Ai ba ngin ïoh bakla uwei u khunblang na ka bynta jong phi . pyntreikam u angel den ong , Lada nga dei ban ap , ngan nym bam ïa ka jingbam jong phi . Hynrei lada phi kwah ban Assyria ïa ka , said ïa ka balui jingbiria jingainguh sha U Pi .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Though thou detain me , I will not eat of thy bread : and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering , thou must offer it unto the  Lord . For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the  Lord .
Now these are the nations which the  Lord  left , to prove Israel by them , even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan  ;
translation.kha: Kumta te , U  Trai  u iehnoh katto katne ki jaitbynriew ha ka ri ban tynjuh ïa ki Israel ki bym pat mad ïa ki thma ha ri Kanaan .

translation.en: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel , with the priests and the Levites .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u lumlang ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel , bad ïa baroh ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .
Nga Shiphrah aïu kito ki nongïathuhlypa ki la Pynïeng , nongring duitara kren lamler ha ka pynsum jong nga bad Ussaïah Pynbeit nga la ai ha ki ïa ki khubor Ne nga ha ki Joseph jong ki .
translation.en: I have heard what the prophets said , that prophesy lies in my name , saying , I have dreamed , I have dreamed .
And it came to pass , as they journeyed from the east , that they found a plain in the land of Shinar  ; and they dwelt there .
translation.kha: Te ynda ki briew ki la ïaid kylleng ha ka phang mihngi , ki la poi sha ka pyntha ha Babilonia bad ki la ïashong sah hangta .

translation.en: And he said unto him , God forbid  ; thou shalt not die : behold , my father will do nothing either great or small , but that he will shew it me : and why should my father hide this thing from me ? it is not so .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u jubab ,  U Blei un ym shah ba phin shu ïap ! I pa i da ïathuh shuwa ha nga ïa kaei kaei ba i leh , kaba donkam ne ka bymdonkam , bad im ju buhrieh ïa kane na nga : Kam long kaba shisha !
La don kawei ka kynthei kaba stad hapoh ka nongbah kaba la pyrta na ka kynroh , Ha sngap ! Ha sngap ! Ong ïa u Joab un ba wan hangne ; nga kwah ban bad ïakren u .
translation.en: Then cried a wise woman out of the city , Hear , hear  ; say , I pray you , unto Joab , Come near hither , that I may speak with thee .
Then went Esau unto Ishmael , and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham s son , the sister of Nebaioth , to be his wife .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit sha u Ishmael u khun jong u Abraham , bad u shongkurim ïa ka khun kynthei jong u , ka Mahalath , kaba long ka para jong u Nebaïoth .

translation.en: And said unto them that sold doves ,  Take these things hence  ; make not my Father s house an house of merchandise .
translation.kha: bad u la hukum ïa kito kiba ïadie paro ,  Rah noh ïa ki nangne ! Wat pynlong jaka ïew ïa ka ïing U Kpa jong nga !

Kumta u la ïeng joit bad u la leit phai pat sha la u . kpa U dang kham ha pajih ka lynti na ïing haba u jong kpa u , u la ïohi ïa u ; ka dohnud jong u ka la dap da ka jingisynei , bad u la mareh , u la piam ïa la kti ki sawdong jong u , u bad la doh ïa u .
translation.en: And he arose , and came to his father . But when he was yet a great way off , his father saw him , and had compassion , and ran , and fell on his neck , and kissed him .

And he said unto them ,  These are the words which I spake unto you , while I was yet with you , that all things must be fulfilled , which were written in the law of Moses , and in the prophets , and in the psalms , concerning me .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki ,  Kine ki long kita kiei kiei kiba nga la ïathuh ha phi mynba nga dang don lem bad phi : Kaei kaei baroh kaba la thoh shaphang jong nga ha ka Hukum u Moses , ha ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ha Ki Salm ka dei ban urlong shisha .

translation.en: These are also proverbs of Solomon , which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out .
translation.kha: Hangne ki don shuh ki proberb u Solomon , ba la thoh da ki briew ha ka ïingbishar u Hesekaïah u syiem Judah .

Haba kin ïohi ïa u lyoh tdem uba kiew shajrong na kata nongbah ka , ki Israel kiba ha madan thma ki dei ban phai kylla . Hynrei kat haduh kane ka por , ki Benjamin ki la pynïap ïoh laiphew ngut ki Israel . Ki ong ha lade , Ho-oid , la ngi jop ïa ki kumba ngi leh la mynshuwa .
translation.en: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle , Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons : for they said , Surely they are smitten down before us , as in the first battle .
And he brought me into the inner court toward the east : and he measured the gate according to these measures .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop ba sha mihngi sha ka phyllaw bashapoh . U la thew ïa ka khyrdop bad ka la heh katjuh kum kiwei pat .
Nangta ong u , ‘ Ale hangne bad pynïap ïa nga . Nga la mynsaw palat bad nga la jan ïap .’
translation.en: He said unto me again , Stand , I pray thee , upon me , and slay me : for anguish is come upon me , because my life is yet whole in me .
Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it , and smote the high priest s servant , and cut off his right ear . The servant s name was Malchus .

translation.kha: Nangta un tah snam khyndiat ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan ka jingiwbih thang kaba hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ . U dei ban theh ïa ka snam kaba sah , ha trai ka duwan ki jingkñia ainguh thang kiba don ha khmat jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
U Dabid markhongpong kurup ïa ki ryntieh ksiar ba la rah da ki rangbah synshar jong u Hadadeser bad u rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer , and brought them to Jerusalem .
And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth , that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace .
translation.kha: bad ba ïa uno uno u bym dem ngon bad mane dei ban bret ha ka lawar ding baklang .
Haduh katno sien ba u briew un kem ïa nongshun u jong u bad nangta pyllait un ïa u ban leit noh khlem mynsaw ? U Trai kyrkhu un ïa phi ïa kaei kaba phi la leh ïa nga ha kane ka sngi !
translation.en: For if a man find his enemy , will he let him go well away ? wherefore the  Lord  reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day .

translation.kha: Nga lah ban don ka jingai ban ïalap da ka mynsiem ; nga lah don ïa ka jingtip baroh shemphang ha ki baroh nga ban don ïa ka jingngeit baroh kaba donkam ban pynkynriah ïa lumbah — hynrei lada ngam ka jingieit , ngam long ei .
translation.en: And though I have the gift of prophecy , and understand all mysteries , and all knowledge ; and though I have all faith , so that I could remove mountains , and have not charity , I am nothing .
There be three things which go well , yea , four are comely in going :
translation.kha: Don saw tylli kiei kiei kiba ktah jur ïa ka jingmut haba peit ba ki ïaid :
Kito kiba shna bleithaw kin shah ; baroh na ki kin jahburom .
translation.en: They shall be ashamed , and also confounded , all of them : they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols .
And their border went up toward the sea , and Maralah , and reached to Dabbasheth , and reached to the river that is before Jokneam  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u pud jong ka u suh beit shaphang sepngi shaduh Mareal , da kaba ktah ïa ka Dabbesheth bad ïa ka wahduid kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jokneam .

translation.en: To go into the clefts of the rocks , and into the tops of the ragged rocks , for fear of the  Lord  , and for the glory of his majesty , when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u wan ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka pyrthei , ki briew kin rieh ha ki thliew bad ki krem ha ki mawsiang lum ban pyrshang ban lait na ka jingbitar jong u bad ban rieh na ka bor bad ka burom jong u .
Justos u rishot lyoh u don borabor man shuwa uta u paidbah ha Hushah thep mynsngi , bad u Ïingjaiñ ding shon , sad .
translation.en: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day , nor the pillar of fire by night , from before the people .

translation.kha: Phi kynmaw kumno ngi la im ha Ijipt bad kumno ka la jia bad ngi haba shadkmen ïaid lynti na ka Humtah jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: ( For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt  ; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by  ;

translation.kha: Kata ka jingud tlot ki ka kiew sha U Blei , uba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud jingjia ki Gibbethon kynmaw ïa la ka jutang bad u Abraham , Meribah Gerisim bad a Jakob .
translation.en: And God heard their groaning , and God remembered his covenant with Abraham , with Isaac , and with Jacob .

translation.kha: Ha kane ki synran ki la sngewphylla haduh katta bad ki la ïa-ong para ki , Mano keiñ uba lah ban lait im ?
translation.en: And they were astonished out of measure , saying among themselves , Who then can be saved ?
Then Simon Peter answered him , Lord , to whom shall we go ? thou hast the words of eternal life .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros u la jubab ïa u ,  Ko Trai , sha uno pat ngin leit ? Me don ki ktien kiba ai ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: And the people flew upon the spoil , and took sheep , and oxen , and calves , and slew them on the ground : and the people did eat them with the blood .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka por ki Israel ki la tlot palat na ka jingthngan , bad kumta ki la kynrup ïa kata kaba ki la ïohknieh na ki nongshun , ki la shim ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri , ki la pynïap ïa ki hangta , bad ki la bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka .

pynjynjar long u nongaplangbrot khaweh la ki briew , ngin Trai , ki briew pynjot me la jied . Wat iphuh ki shong saphred ha ka ri khlaw , ka don ka jaka baseisoh sawdong jong ki . To ai ba kin leit bad bam na ki jaka phlang bajyrngam jong ka Bashan bad ka Gilead , kumba ki la leh mynshuwa la slem bah .
translation.en: Feed thy people with thy rod , the flock of thine heritage , which dwell solitarily in the wood , in the midst of Carmel : let them feed in Bashan and Gilead , as in the days of old .
Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day , that ye may be strong , and go in and possess the land , whither ye go to possess it  ;
translation.kha: To kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Kumta te phin lah ban jam sha shiliang wah bad ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit rung .

U la long u paralok naphang lwa lyngskor jong kata ka dewlynnong , u Sergius ïabeit kiwei! la long u tdong uba shemphang tmoh shibun Lykaonia u lyngskor u la phah khot ïa u Barnabas bad u btuit ha khmat jong u namar u la Briew ban ïohsngew ïa ka ktien U jingsngur jingsuki
translation.en: Which was with the deputy of the country , Sergius Paulus , a prudent man  ; who called for Barnabas and Saul , and desired to hear the word of God .
Saying , Let us alone  ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art  ; the Holy One of God .
translation.kha: Ieh ! Kaei me kwah bad ngi , ko Jisu uba na Nasareth ? Hato me la wan hangne ban pynjot ïa ngi ? Nga ithuh me long uei : Me long u nonglamktien bakhuid jong U Blei !

translation.en: Oil for the light , spices for anointing oil , and for sweet incense ,
translation.kha: ka umphniang ïa ki sharak , ki musla na ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh bad na ka bynta ka jingthang iwbih ;

translation.en: And it was told Tamar , saying , Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep .
translation.kha: Don uba la ïathuh ha ka Tamar ba u kthaw kurim jong ka u la leit sha Timnah ban khap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot .

Hynrei u ong ha , Kaei kaba nga lah ban leh kam long ei ei haba nujor bad kaei kaba phi leh . kata kaba eh ma phi ki paid Ephraim ka long kaba kham kor shikatdei eh ban ïa kaei kaba ka kur nga ka la leh .
translation.en: And he said unto them , What have I done now in comparison of you ? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi–ezer ?

But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven  ; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee , and thou , and thy lords , thy wives , and thy concubines , have drunk wine in them  ; and thou hast praised the gods of silver , and gold , of brass , iron , wood , and stone , which see not , nor hear , nor know : and the God in whose hand thy breath is , and whose are all thy ways , hast thou not glorified :
translation.kha: Phi la leh pyrshah ïa U Trai jong ka bneng bad phi la wallam shapoh ïa ki khuri bad ïa ki pliang kiba la shim na ka Templ jong u . Ma phi , ki rangbah donburom jong phi , ki tnga jong phi , bad ki tnga kliar jong phi ki la dih waiñ na ki bad ki la ïaroh ïa ki blei kiba la shna da ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , ka dieng , bad u maw — ki blei ki bym lah ban ïohi lane ïohsngew bad ba kim lah ban tip ei ei . Hynrei phim shym la pyndonburom ïa U Blei uba rai la phin im ne phin ïap bad uba synshar ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines , before that Pharaoh smote Gaza .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba u syiem jong ka Ijipt un tur ïaleh ïa ka Gasa , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga shaphang ka Philistia .

translation.en: And Samuel said unto all Israel , Behold , I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me , and have made a king over you .
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Nga la leh ïa kaba phi la ong ïa nga ban leh . Nga la ai ïa phi u syiem ban synshar ïa phi ,

translation.en: I also will laugh at your calamity  ; I will mock when your fear cometh  ;
translation.kha: Kumta ynda phi shah jynjar , ngan sa ïoh rkhie ïa phi . Ngan sa rkhiebeiñ ïa phi ynda phi hap ha ka jingsheptieng —

translation.en: As for the wheels , it was cried unto them in my hearing , O wheel .
translation.kha: Kine ki shalyntem ki long kumjuh kum kito kiba nga la ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw kaba nyngkong jong nga .
Ki nongjop jong ka Jerusalem kin tur ïaleh ïa ka Edom bad kin synshar halor jong ka . Bad U Trai da lade hi un long u Syiem
translation.en: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau  ; and the kingdom shall be the  Lord s .

translation.kha: Ngan tap ïa ki lumbah bad ïa ki them da ka metïap bapyut jong . me
translation.en: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains , and fill the valleys with thy height .
But the hand of the  Lord  was heavy upon them of Ashdod , and he destroyed them , and smote them with emerods , even Ashdod and the coasts thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynshitom jur ïa ki nong Ashdod bad u pyntriem ïa ki . U la pynshitom ïa ki bad ïa ki briew sawdong ka ri da kaba pynmih ha ki ïa ka jingpang thung .
ka janmiet ka la poi u trai u la bthah la u , ‘ To khot ïa ki nongtrei bad ïa ka jong ki na kito kiba la shah khot khatduh bad pynkut ha kito khot bylla nyngkong .’
translation.en: So when even was come , the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward , Call the labourers , and give them their hire , beginning from the last unto the first .
Hear ye now what the  Lord  saith  ; Arise , contend thou before the mountains , and let the hills hear thy voice .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ka jingmudui U  Trai  pyrshah ïa ki Israel . To khie , A  Trai  , bad wanrah ïa ka jingmudui jong me ; to ai ba ki lumbah bad ki lumrit kin ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba me ong .
U Joshua ong u ha ki jait Ephraim bad Manasseh ba sha Sepngi , Da phi shisha ïabun paid , bad phi long kiba khlaiñbor . Phi ïoh shuh shuh nalor ka shi bynta .
translation.en: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph , even to Ephraim and to Manasseh , saying , Thou art a great people , and hast great power : thou shalt not have one lot only :

translation.kha: Lada uno uno na ki khun ksiew jong phi , katba u dang long u bymkhuid u wan ki jingainguh kyntang ïa kiba ki Israel ki la pynkyntang sha nga , un ym lah lano lano ruh ban shakri ha kata duwan . Kane kan ïailong kumta pateng la pateng . Nga long U .
translation.en: Say unto them , Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations , that goeth unto the holy things , which the children of Israel hallow unto the  Lord  , having his uncleanness upon him , that soul shall be cut off from my presence : I am the  Lord .
Eye for eye , tooth for tooth , hand for hand , foot for foot ,
translation.kha: ka khmat namar ka khmat , ka bniat namar ka bniat , ka kti namar ka kti , ka kjat namar ka kjat ,

translation.en: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke , because the  Lord  descended upon it in fire : and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace , and the whole mount quaked greatly .
translation.kha: Ïa u Lum Sinai baroh uwei la tap da ka tdem , namar U  Trai  u la wan hiar ha u ha ka ding . Ka tdem ka kiew kum kaba mih na ka lawar ding , bad ki briew baroh ki la kyiuh shibun eh .

Yn ym don shuh kano kano ka miet , bad kin ym donkam ïa ki sharak lane ïa ka jingshai ka sngi , namar U Trai uba U Blei un long ka jingshai jong ki bad kin synshar kum Thohdieng syiem junom la junom jingïakynduhlang
translation.en: And there shall be no night there  ; and they need no candle , neither light of the sun  ; for the Lord God giveth them light : and they shall reign for ever and ever .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba la shah kynthup ha ka u jingkheiñbriew dei ban siew ïa dor ka ba la buh , kat kum ka jingthew ha ka jaka , kyntang uwei pa uwei un siew ïa kane kum ka jingainguh sha nga .
translation.en: This they shall give , every one that passeth among them that are numbered , half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary : ( a shekel is twenty gerahs : ) an half shekel shall be the offering of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hangta Joshua u u pynïeng ïa ki khat-ar tylli ki maw ba la shim na ka Jordan .
translation.en: And those twelve stones , which they took out of Jordan , did Joshua pitch in Gilgal .
And ye shall smite every fenced city , and every choice city , and shall fell every good tree , and stop all wells of water , and mar every good piece of land with stones .
translation.kha: Phin jop ïa baroh ki nongbah ba-itynnat jong ki ïa kiba la ker kynroh ; phin pom ïa baroh ki diengsoh jong ki , phin pynsangeh ïa baroh ki umpohliew jong ki ; bad phin pynjot ïa baroh ki lyngkha baseisoh jong ki da kaba tap ïa ki da ki maw .
U riewbymman um salia jingshaïong U Trai ; apkhmih ka jingsarong jong u , u pyrkhat ba jingring Blei um da habud kdor
translation.en: The wicked , through the pride of his countenance , will not seek after God : God is not in all his thoughts .
And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat : and no man gave unto him .
translation.kha: U la kwah ban pynkdang ïa lade da ki jingbam ba bam ki sniang , hynrei ym don mano mano ba ai ei ei ïa u ban bam .
U la wan sha u langbrot , uba nga la ïohi ba u ïeng harud ka jong wah , bad u la sha mareh u da ka bor jong u baroh .
translation.en: And he came to the ram that had two horns , which I had seen standing before the river , and ran unto him in the fury of his power .
The  Lord  doth build up Jerusalem : he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u tei pat ïa ka Jerusalem ; u wallam pat ïa kiba la shah ringmraw .

translation.en: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command , and make her nest on high ?
translation.kha: Hato u pukni u ap hukum na me ban shna ïa la ka skum halor ki lumbah ?
Ki nongbah ka pyn-i , Kanneh , bad Eden , ki nongkhaïi ka Sheba , ki nongbah ka Asshur bad Khilmad — jingsngewshngain ki ïakhun pateng bad pha .
translation.en: Haran , and Canneh , and Eden , the merchants of Sheba , Asshur , and Chilmad , were thy merchants .

translation.kha: Hynrei haduh mohkhiew ka sngi , la ïarap ïa nga da U Blei , bad kumta nga ïeng hangne ban ai ïa ka balung jong nga ha baroh , ha uba rit bad ha uba mawria kumjuh . ïam kaba nga ong kur long Sithri hi Niam ki nongïathuhlypa bad u Eleasar ki la pynriewspah ba kan sa diengduh :
translation.en: Having therefore obtained help of God , I continue unto this day , witnessing both to small and great , saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come :

translation.kha: U Hiram syiem ha kaba jubab u phah da ka shithi sha u Solomon . U thoh , Namar U Trai u ieit ïa la ki briew u , la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki .
translation.en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing , which he sent to Solomon , Because the  Lord  hath loved his people , he hath made thee king over them .

And when they were gone out of the city , and not yet far off , Joseph said unto his steward , Up , follow after the men  ; and when thou dost overtake them , say unto them , Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good ?
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïaid ym pat da jngai na shnong , u Joseph u ong ha uta u shakri bahakhlieh ha ka ïing jong u ,  Khie , leit bud mar mar nadien kito ki briew . Ynda phi lap ïa ki , ong ha ki , ‘ Balei phi siew kylliang da kaba sniew ïa kaba bha ?

translation.en: Behold , your house is left unto you desolate .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa ka Templ jong pha yn iehnoh bad kan long kaba thylli .

translation.en: And the  Lord  went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud , to lead them the way  ; and by night in a pillar of fire , to give them light  ; to go by day and night :
translation.kha: Mynsngi , U  Trai  u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki ha u rishot lyoh ban kdew lynti ïa ki , bad mynmiet pat u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki ha u rishot ding ban ai jingshai ïa ki , khnang ba ki lah ban ïaid mynsngi bad mynmiet .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Why art thou , being the king s son , lean from day to day ? wilt thou not tell me ? And Amnon said unto him , I love Tamar , my brother Absalom s sister .
translation.kha: U Jonadab u ong ha u Amnon ,  Phi dei u khun jong u syiem ; pynban na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat nga ïohi ba phi i sngewsih . Jia aïu ?   Nga ibha ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u Absalom , uba ïalong shi para bad nga na ijuh i pa ,  u la jubab .

translation.en: And the second is like unto it , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
translation.kha: Kaba ar ka hukum kaba donkam tam ka long kum katei : ‘ Ieit ïa u paramarjan jong me kumba me ieit ïa lade .’

translation.en: And the waters returned , and covered the chariots , and the horsemen , and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them  ; there remained not so much as one of them .
translation.kha: Ki um ki ïadait biang bad ki la tyllep ïa ki kali ïapom , ïa ki nongñiah , bad ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh jong u Pharaoh kaba la buddien ïa ki Israel sha duriaw , ym don kawei ruh na ki ïa kaba la iehnoh .

translation.en: O Lord , to us belongeth confusion of face , to our kings , to our princes , and to our fathers , because we have sinned against thee .
translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongsynshar jong ngi , bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pynlehrain bad ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me a Trai .

translation.en: Knowing this , that the trying of your faith worketh patience .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , to ñiew ïa lade ba phi long kiba donbok eh haba phi ïakynduh ïa ki jingtynjuh kiba bun ha ka lynti ka jingim jong phi , naba phi tip ba haba ka jingngeit jong phi ka jop haba ïashem kum kita ki jingtynjuh , ka jingmih ka long ka jinglah ban ïaishah .

translation.en: These are the statutes , which the  Lord  commanded Moses , between a man and his wife , between the father and his daughter , being yet in her youth in her father s house .
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki aiñ ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses kiba ïadei bad ki jingkular ba la pynlong da ka theisamla kaba dang sah ha ka ïing u kpa jong ka lane da ka kynthei kaba la shongkurim .

translation.en: They made shoulderpieces for it , to couple it together : by the two edges was it coupled together .
translation.kha: Ki shna ar tylli ki jingteh tyrpeng bad ki pyndait ïa ki ha ki rmiang jong ka ephod na baroh arliang , khnang ba lah ban teh skhem ïa ka .
A katno kyrmen ba long uba ïaineh ha kaba sumar ïa ki jingbthah jong me
translation.en: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes !
He will keep the feet of his saints , and the wicked shall be silent in darkness  ; for by strength shall no man prevail .
translation.kha: U ïada ïa ka jingim jong kito kiba shaniah ha u , hynrei kiba bymman kin shu jah lngaid ha ka jingdum ; u briew u jop ym da ka bor la jong .

translation.en: And that first slaughter , which Jonathan and his armourbearer made , was about twenty men , within as it were an half acre of land , which a yoke of oxen might plow .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingpynïap kaba nyngkong , u Jonathan bad u samla ki la pynïap kumba arphew ngut ki briew ha ka jaka kaba heh kumba shipawa hektar .

translation.en: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things , and wrote these things : and we know that his testimony is true .
translation.kha: U long u synran uba la kren kine kiei kiei , uta uba la thoh ruh ïa kine ; bad ngi tip ba kaei kaba u ong ka long kaba shisha .
Ki khun shynrang u Noah kiba la na kata ka lieng ki long u Shem , u Ham , bad . Ham u long u kpa jong u Kanaan . )
translation.en: And the sons of Noah , that went forth of the ark , were Shem , and Ham , and Japheth : and Ham is the father of Canaan .

translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , to phet lyngba ki surok bah jong phi ! To sawdong khmih ! Peit hi da lade ! To wad ki ïa jaka ïew ! Hato phi lah ban shem uwei u briew uba leh ïa kaba dei bad uba pyrshang ban ha ïaineh U Blei ? phi Lada lah , U Trai un map ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem , and see now , and know , and seek in the broad places thereof , if ye can find a man , if there be any that executeth judgment , that seeketh the truth  ; and I will pardon it .

The adversaries of the  Lord  shall be broken to pieces  ; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them : the  Lord  shall judge the ends of the earth  ; and he shall give strength unto his king , and exalt the horn of his anointed .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  yn pynjot ; kum u pyrthat na bneng un tied pyrshah ïa ki . U  Trai  un bishar ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei ; Un ai ka bor ha la u syiem , Un pynlong ïa u syiem ba la jied jong u ban ïoh ïa ka jingjop .

translation.en: And he said , Ye have taken away my gods which I made , and the priest , and ye are gone away : and what have I more ? and what is this that ye say unto me , What aileth thee ?
translation.kha: U Mikah u jubab ,  Phi mut aïu , ‘ kaei kaba la jia ?’ Phi la shim ïa u lyngdoh bad ki bleithaw ba nga la thaw , bad phi shu phet ! Kaei kaba sah bad nga ?

translation.en: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land , ye shall not vex him .
translation.kha: Wat lehbeiñ ïa ki nongwei kiba shong ha ka ri jong phi .
Ki pan , bad u phah ïa ki syiar khlaw ; u ai purim ki Harhas jingbam na bneng ban pynhun ïa ki .
translation.en: The people asked , and he brought quails , and satisfied them with the bread of heaven .

translation.kha: Bad Jisu U u la pynkut , Ha ka jingsngew jong me , uei na kine lai ngut uba la leh kum u ïa paramarjan u briew uba la shah tur ïaleh ha ki nonglute ?
translation.en: Which now of these three , thinkest thou , was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves ?

translation.kha: U Petros u la ïai kren ïa u Kornelios katba u dang leit shapoh ïing , ha kaba u Kemuel shem bun khoh briew kiba la ïalumlang .
translation.en: And as he talked with him , he went in , and found many that were come together .

In the cities of the mountains , in the cities of the vale , and in the cities of the south , and in the land of Benjamin , and in the places about Jerusalem , and in the cities of Judah , shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ki shnong jong ka ri lum , ha ki kjat lum , bad ha ka Judah bashaphang shathie , ha ka ri ki Benjamin , ha ki shnongrit sawdong ka Jerusalem bad ha ki shnong ka Judah , ki nongaplangbrot sa shisien kin ñiew biang ïa la ki langbrot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
kiba Kito na kawei ka nongbah kin ong ha kito kiba na kawei pat , ‘ Ngi leit ban ïa mane U Trai Badonbor bad Baroh ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong u . To wan bad ngi !’
translation.en: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another , saying , Let us go speedily to pray before the  Lord  , and to seek the  Lord  of hosts : I will go also .
And hallow my sabbaths  ; and they shall be a sign between me and you , that ye may know that I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa ka Sabbaton ka sngi kaba khuid , ba kumta kan long ka dak jong ka jutang ba ngi la thaw , bad kan pynkynmaw ïa phi ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
To kieng noh ka ïa jingkieng atiar U Blei baroh , khnang ba phi lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki buit thap basniew u jong Soitan .
translation.en: Put on the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil .
But Peter and John answered and said unto them , Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God , judge ye .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la jubab ïa ki ,  Phi hi bishar kano kaba dei ha khmat U Blei — ban kohnguh ïa phi ne ban kohnguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And bring hither the fatted calf , and kill it  ; and let us eat , and be merry :
translation.kha: Nangta khie leit bad shim ïa u khun masi uba la pynsngaid bha bad pynïap ïa u , bad to ngin ïalehkmen da ka jingkhawai !

Hadien ba la ïa kane , ki ki pynbiang na ka bynta ïa bad na ka bynta ki kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron namar ba ki lyngdoh ki bunkam haduh mynmiet , ha kaba thang tylli ïa ki jingri bad ïa ka jong jingkñia .
translation.en: And afterward they made ready for themselves , and for the priests : because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night  ; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves , and for the priests the sons of Aaron .
For as in Adam all die , even so in Christ shall all be made alive .
translation.kha: Naba kumba ki briew baroh ki ïap namar ka jingïadei jong ki ha u Adam , kumjuh ruh ïa baroh yn pynmihpat namar ka jingïadei jong ki ha U Khrist .

translation.en: A time to love , and a time to hate  ; a time of war , and a time of peace .
translation.kha: U buh ka por ban ieit bad ka por ban isih , ka por ïa ka thma bad ka por ïa ka jingsuk .

translation.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous : now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father , and his heavy yoke that he put upon us , and we will serve thee .

translation.kha: Ki pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap , shabi U Blei um jubab , naba ki long kiba sarong Kaphtorim ba-bymman .
translation.en: There they cry , but none giveth answer , because of the pride of evil men .
Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it : but the instruction of fools is folly .

translation.en: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof , and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it  ; that he may return unto his possession .
translation.kha: Lada kumta , u dei ban siew sha uta u briew uba la thied ïa ka ha ka dor ka ban ïahap bad ki snem kiba dang sah haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat kaba bud , hadien kata un ïoh pat ïa la ka khyndew .

translation.en: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel :

translation.en: And if , when the priest seeth it , behold , it be in sight lower than the skin , and the hair thereof be turned white  ; the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil .
And again he went away , and prayed , and spake the same words .
translation.kha: U la leit noh sa shisien bad u la duwai , da kaba ong ïa kijuh ki ktien .

translation.kha: Hato ki jlawnguid ? Ngan pynkhreh ïa ki ka jingkhawai bad pynlong ïa ki ban buaid bad sngewtynnat . Kin ïohthiah bad kin ym kyndit shuh .

translation.en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades , or loose the bands of Orion ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban teh lang ïa ki Pleïades    , ne pynsynjor ïa ki jingkhum kiba teh ïa u Orion    ?

translation.en: And they said , Cornelius the centurion , a just man , and one that feareth God , and of good report among all the nation of the Jews , was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house , and to hear words of thee .
translation.kha: U Kornelios , u rangbah shipai u la phah ïa ngi ,  ki la jubab .  U long u briew uba bha uba mane ïa U Blei bad uba la ñiewburom shikatdei da ki Jiw baroh . U angel jong U Blei u la ïathuh ïa u ban khot sngewbha ïa phi sha ka ïing jong u , khnang ba u lah ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba phi don ban ong .
Wat ki jingnoh jong nga ki rkhie ïa nga mynta ; ki rkhie , wat la nga Eri uba hok bad u bym shah kynnoh pop ; hynrei ka pynbiang jingsleh por mynba U Blei u jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong nga .
translation.en: I am as one mocked of his neighbour , who calleth upon God , and he answereth him : the just upright man is laughed to scorn .
For so hath the Lord commanded us , saying , I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles , that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: Naba kane ka long ka hukum kaba U Trai u la ai ha ngi :   ‘ Nga la pynlong ïa phi ka jingshai na ka bynta ki Jentil , khnang ba baroh ka pyrthei ka lah ban lait im .’

translation.en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you , and ye shall fall by the sword : because ye are turned away from the  Lord  , therefore the  Lord  will not be with you .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïakhun ïa ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan , phin ïap ha ka thma ; U  Trai  un ym don lem bad phi , namar phi la kyntait ban bud ïa u .

translation.en: And I brake the jaws of the wicked , and plucked the spoil out of his teeth .
translation.kha: Nga la pynduhbor ïa ki briew kiba shyrkhei bad nga la pyllait ïa kiba shah lehbeiñ na ki .

translation.en: So when his fellowservants saw what was done , they were very sorry , and came and told unto their lord all that was done .
translation.kha: Haba kiwei pat ki shakri ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba lah jia , ki la sngewsih shikatdei eh , bad ki la leit sha u Syiem bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaei baroh .
Ngin ym leit phai sha la ki longïing jong ngi tad haduh ba kiwei pat ki Israel baroh la ki shim kynti ïa ka ri kaba ai la ha ki .
translation.en: We will not return unto our houses , until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance .
But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification , and exhortation , and comfort .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta uba pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei u kren ha ki briew bad u ai ha ki ïa ka jingïarap , ka jingpynshlur , bad ka jingpyntngen .

translation.en: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven , where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt , and where thieves do not break through nor steal :
translation.kha: Hynrei , to kynshew spah na ka bynta ïa lade ha bneng , ha kaba ki khñiang bad ka sarang kim lah ban pynjot , bad ki nongtuh kim lah ban prong bad tuh .

translation.en: The Holy Ghost this signifying , that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest , while as the first tabernacle was yet standing :
translation.kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u pyn-i shai na kine ki rukom pynbeit , ba ïa ka lynti sha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam ym pat lah ban plie , katba kata ka Ïingjaiñ kaba ha khmat ka dang ïeng .
U Nebukhadnessar u ka u pynlong syiem ïa u Sedekaïah , u khun jong u u syiem ka Judah , ha ka jaka u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim .
translation.en: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim , whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah .
And Moses said unto his father in law , Because the people come unto me to enquire of God :
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Nga dei ban leh ïa kane namar ki briew ki ïawan sha nga ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei .

translation.en: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more : thine eyes are upon me , and I am not .
translation.kha: Me ïohi ïa nga mynta , hynrei mem ïohi shuh lada me peit ïa nga , nga la jah noh !

translation.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard .

translation.en: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands , and that it brake in pieces the iron , the brass , the clay , the silver , and the gold  ; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter : and the dream is certain , and the interpretation thereof sure .
And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself . They said therefore unto him , Art not thou also one of his disciples ? He denied it , and said , I am not .

translation.en: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also , because he is the Son of man .

Lada phim leh kumta , un tan ïa phi ha khmat u nongbishar , u ban aiti ïa phi ha ki nongap phira , bad ïa phi yn buh ha ka byndi .
Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïohknieh ïa nongbah ki jong ki Amor baroh , lem bad ïa ka Heshbon bad ïa ki shnongrit baroh sawdong jong ka , ki bad la shong la sah hangta .

translation.en: For there is hope of a tree , if it be cut down , that it will sprout again , and that the tender branch thereof will not cease .

translation.en: And there was given him dominion , and glory , and a kingdom , that all people , nations , and languages , should serve him : his dominion is an everlasting dominion , which shall not pass away , and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed .

translation.en: And if a man purchase of the Levites , then the house that was sold , and the city of his possession , shall go out in the year of jubilee : for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïeng joit bad u la bajarjar sha suiñbneng .
translation.en: And he arose , and departed to his house .

translation.kha: U Trai u lah Hesron Ko ki Israhaïah jong nga Gederoth nga la leh aïu ïa phi ? Kumno nga la long ka jingkit ïa phi ? To jubab ïa nga .
translation.en: O my people , what have I done unto thee ? and wherein have I wearied thee ? testify against me .

translation.en: But last of all he sent unto them his son , saying , They will reverence my son .

translation.kha: Namar kaei kaba u Phinehas u la leh , ngam bitar shuh ïa ki paid Israel . U kyntait ban shah ïa ka jingmane ïa uno uno u blei lait tang ïa nga , bad namar kata ngam shym la pynjot ïa ki wat haba nga la bitar .

translation.en: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death .

translation.kha: U Saw u la ïathuh ha u Dabid , Ki Israel ki la ïakular ban 10 jingkyrshan noh ïa u Em’ .
translation.en: And there came a messenger to David , saying , The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom .

translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan wallam ïa ki jingpynjot kiba kum kine ha u bynriew ba uwei uwei baroh un tare shane shatai kum u briew bamatlah . Ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , bad mynta ïa ka snam jong ki yn theh noh kum ka um , bad ki metïap jong ki kin pyut ha khyndew .

translation.en: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes ? For our sakes , no doubt , this is written : that he that ploweth should plow in hope ; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope .
translation.kha: Hato da shisha um mut ïa ngi haba u la ong ïa kata ? Da shisha ïa kata la thoh na ka bynta jong ngi . U briew uba lur bad u briew uba ot ki dei ban trei ïa la ki kam da kaba kyrmen ban ïoh bynta na u jingthung .

translation.en: I know his wrath , saith the  Lord   ; but it shall not be so  ; his lies shall not so effect it .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga tip ïa ka jinglehmeng jong ki . Ki jingkob jong ki kim long ei ei ruh , bad kiei kiei kiba ki leh kin ym neh .

translation.en: He hath said in his heart , God hath forgotten : he hideth his face  ; he will never see it .
And she said , Truth , Lord : yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters  table .

translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ,

translation.en: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread : but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough .
translation.kha: U nongrep uba trei shitom u don kyrhai ban bam . Ki briew kiba pynsyrwa ïa la ka por kin duk lynter .

translation.en: And they went up out of Egypt , and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father ,
translation.kha: Kumta ki ïamihnoh na Ijipt bad ki wan phai sha la u kpa ha Kanaan .

translation.en: And the mean man shall be brought down , and the mighty man shall be humbled , and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled :
translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei yn pynjahburom , bad ïa baroh kiba sarong yn pynrit .
Ym da donkam mano ban ïathuh ha shaphang jong ki , namar u u la kaba ka dohnud jong ki .
translation.en: And needed not that any should testify of man : for he knew what was in man .

translation.en: Son of man , hath not the house of Israel , the rebellious house , said unto thee , What doest thou ?

translation.kha: Ban pynkut : Wat ai ba uno un buh jingeh shuh ïa nga , namar ki dak mong kiba nga ha ka jong nga ki pyn-i nga long u mraw jong U Jisu .
translation.en: From henceforth let no man trouble me : for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus .
And Abram was very rich in cattle , in silver , and in gold .
translation.kha: U Abram u la long uba riewspah shibun , ha ka jingdon ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang , kumjuh ruh ha ka jingdon ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar .

translation.en: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains  ; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal : yea , ye shall flee , like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah : and the  Lord  my God shall come , and all the saints with thee .
translation.kha: Phin lait phet lyngba kane ka them kaba pynkhlad arliang ïa une u lumbah . Phin phet kumba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la leh mynba u jumai u khynñiuh ha ka por jong u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah . U  Trai  U Blei jong nga un wan , un wallam ïa ki angel baroh lem bad u .

translation.en: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger , and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst , and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them .

translation.en: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him , then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand  ; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly , and hated him not beforetime .

translation.en: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit , and worketh miracles among you , doeth he it by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?

translation.en: The  Lord  thy God , he will go over before thee , and he will destroy these nations from before thee , and thou shalt possess them : and Joshua , he shall go over before thee , as the  Lord  hath said .
