Kan por saw bynriew shuwa ba ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin wan phai pat shane ; ym pat beh noh ïa ki Amor tad ynda ki la long bymman katta katta kat haduh ba ki dei ban pynshitom .
translation.en: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again : for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full .

I would that ye all spake with tongues , but rather that ye prophesied : for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues , except he interpret , that the church may receive edifying .
translation.kha: Nga da kwah ba baroh na phi phin kren ha ki thylliej bapher ; hynrei nga da kwah ba phin ïoh ïa ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei . Naba u briew uba pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei u kham kor ban ïa uta uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher — lymda don uno uno uba batai ïa kaei kaba u kren , khnang ba kan long ka jingïarap ïa ka balang baroh kawei .

translation.en: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations , and didst divide them into corners : so they possessed the land of Sihon , and the land of the king of Heshbon , and the land of Og king of Bashan .
translation.kha: Me la shah ïa ki ban jop ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima , ïa ki ri kiba markhap bad ki . Ki jop ïa ka ri ki Heshbon , ha kaba u Sihon u synshar , bad ïa ka ri ki Bashan , ha kaba u Og u long syiem .

translation.en: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity , even the law of commandments contained in ordinances ; for to make in himself of twain one new man , so making peace ;
translation.kha: U la pynduh ïa ka hukum ki Jiw da la ki jong ki hukum bad ki kyndon , khnang ban ïoh pynlong ïa ki ar tylli ki jaitbynriew kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba thymmai ha u hi , ha kane ka rukom u wanrah jingsuk .

translation.en: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath–beer , Ramath of the south . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families .
translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa baroh ki nongrit sawdong kine ki nongbah haduh ka Baalath Beer ( lane ka Ramah ) , ha ka phang bashathie . Kane ka dei ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Simeon ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: And Jehu slept with his fathers : and they buried him in Samaria . And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap , bad la tep ha Samaria , bad u Jehoahas u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong : yea , he reproved kings for their sakes ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei um shym la shah ïano ïano ban banbeiñ ïa ki ; ban ïada ïa ki , u la maham ïa ki syiem ;
U la ïathuh ha phi kaei kaba phi dei ban leh kaba bat ïa ka jutang kaba la pynlong bad phi kata , Shiphew Hukum u la thoh ha ar tylli ki .
translation.en: And he declared unto you his covenant , which he commanded you to perform , even ten commandments  ; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone .

translation.kha: Mynta te , to ïathuh ïa ki ph jong bthing Judah bad irmat Jerusalem ba nga thaw ki San bathymmai pyrshah ïa ki bad nga khreh ban pynshitom ïa Jerah . Ïathuh ïa ki ban sangeh ban im ka jingpynskhem ba-dap da ka pop — ban pynkylla ïa ki riewshukor im jong ki ijli ïa kiei kiei kiba ki leh .
translation.en: Now therefore go to , speak to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I frame evil against you , and devise a device against you : return ye now every one from his evil way , and make your ways and your doings good .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba len ïa ka jingshisha u thaw jingkulmar , hynrei uta uba pyn-i markhmat u trei ka na bynta ka jingsuk .
translation.en: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow : but a prating fool shall fall .

translation.kha: U Shomer u para jong , u u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Rohgah , u Jehubbah , bad u Aram .
translation.en: And the sons of Shamer  ; Ahi , and Rohgah , Jehubbah , and Aram .

translation.kha: Ko Israel la me wallam ïa kane halor jong me ! Me la iehnoh nga ïa , U Trai U Blei jong me , katba nga dang ïalam ïa me ha ka lynti .
translation.en: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself , in that thou hast forsaken the  Lord  thy God , when he led thee by the way ?

translation.kha: U Trai u la sohkhliang ha nga ,
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa lyer khluit ïa ki jingthung jong phi . Ki puit ki la bam duh ïa ki kper bri sohwaiñ jong , ki dieng bad Olib jong phi . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .
translation.en: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew : when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased , the palmerworm devoured them : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ngan pynroi ïa ka jingbun briew jong phi . Phin sa shong ha ki nongbah bad tei pat ïa baroh kaba sah ha ka . jingjot
translation.en: And I will multiply men upon you , all the house of Israel , even all of it : and the cities shall be inhabited , and the wastes shall be builded :

translation.kha: U Khun U Briew u la wan , bad u la bam bad u la dih , bad phi la ong , ‘ Khmih ïa une u briew ! U long u lalot bad u nongbuaid Mar lui paralok jong ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kyntait !’
translation.en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking  ; and ye say , Behold a gluttonous man , and a winebibber , a friend of publicans and sinners !

translation.kha: Kaei kane kaba ka jingkhmih jong ka ka , long kum ka step ? Ka long kaba bhabriew bad kaba phyrnai , ka kum jingphyrnai ka sngi ne u bnai .
translation.en: I am my beloved s , and his desire is toward me .

translation.kha: Kmen kiba bad kmen , ïa-ïam bad kito kiba ïam .
translation.en: Rejoice with them that do rejoice , and weep with them that weep .

translation.kha: Baroh phong kiei kiba u Baasha u Ibsam leh bad ki kam shlur jong u baroh jingmyntoi buh jingkem ha ka Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha , and what he did , and his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: sieh trei ïa kano Klemen ka Jingpynkyntang ha kata ka sngi , naba kata ka long Seng sngi ha kaba yn pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam pyntwa riewdakaid noh ïa ka pop .
translation.en: And ye shall do no work in that same day : for it is a day of atonement , to make an atonement for you before the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Shibun , ki ban kam ba ki kren na bynta jong , kin bad ong , ‘ Nga long ma !’ bad kin shukor ïa kiba bun ki briew .
translation.en: For many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and shall deceive many .

But the women , and the little ones , and the cattle , and all that is in the city , even all the spoil thereof , shalt thou take unto thyself  ; and thou shalt eat the spoil of thine enemies , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi lah ban shim sha lade ïa ki kynthei , ki khun rit , ki jingri jingdup , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ha kata ka shnong . Phi lah ban rah ïa kata baroh kaba dei ka jong ki nongshun jong phi . U  Trai  u la ai ïa ka ha phi .

translation.en: And I said , Hear , I pray you , O heads of Jacob , and ye princes of the house of Israel  ; Is it not for you to know judgment ?
translation.kha: To shahshkor , phi ki nongsynshar ki Israel ! Phi la dei ban sngewkhia shaphang ka jingbishar hok ,

uba la shon ïa ka shab jong ka jinglong trai halor jong ngi , bad uba la ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha Armageddon dohnud jong ngi kum ka sawar ïa kata baroh ïamynjur u la buh tyngkai na ka bynta jong ngi .
translation.en: Who hath also sealed us , and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts .

Then they went along through the wilderness , and compassed the land of Edom , and the land of Moab , and came by the east side of the land of Moab , and pitched on the other side of Arnon , but came not within the border of Moab : for Arnon was the border of Moab .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , ki da ïaid tawiar ïa ka ri Edom bad ka ri Moab haduh ba kin da poi ha ka dong mihngi jong ka ri Moab , sha shiliang ka wah Arnon . Ki sher dara hangta , hynrei kim shym jam ïa ka Arnon namar u dei u pud ki Moab .

translation.en: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle , Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons : for they said , Surely they are smitten down before us , as in the first battle .
translation.kha: Haba kin ïohi ïa u lyoh tdem uba kiew shajrong na kata ka nongbah , ki Israel kiba ha madan thma ki dei ban phai kylla . Hynrei kat haduh kane ka por , ki Benjamin ki la ïoh pynïap laiphew ngut ki Israel . Ki ong ha lade ,  Ho-oid , ngi la jop ïa ki kumba ngi la leh mynshuwa .
Hato nga la kylla long mynta u nongshun jong phi da kaba ïathuh ha phi ka ïa jingshisha ?
translation.en: Am I therefore become your enemy , because I tell you the truth ?
Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer , and in the thirteenth year they rebelled .
translation.kha: Ki lah don hapoh ka jingsynshar u Khedorlaomer haduh khat-ar snem , hynrei ha ka snem kaba khatlai ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .

Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ki khet bad ha kito kiba shong ki ai ka bor ban bishar . Nga la ïohi ruh ïa ki mynsiem jong kito kiba la shah pynïap namar ba ki la pynbna ïa ka jingshisha ïa kaba U Jisu la pynpaw bad ïa ka ktien U Blei shym la mane ïa u mradkhlaw lane ïa ka dur u , lymne ki la pdiang ïa ka shab jong u mradkhlaw ha ki shyllangmat jong ki lane ha ki kti jong ki Ki la im pat bad ki la synshar kum ki bad U Khrist shihajar snem .
translation.en: And I saw thrones , and they sat upon them , and judgment was given unto them : and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus , and for the word of God , and which had not worshipped the beast , neither his image , neither had received his mark upon their foreheads , or in their hands  ; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years .
Now therefore stand still , that I may reason with you before the  Lord  of all the righteous acts of the  Lord  , which he did to you and to your fathers .
translation.kha: Mynta , ïeng beit hangto , bad hangne ha khmat U  Trai  ngan mudui pyrshah ïa phi da kaba pynkynmaw ïa phi shaphang ki kam kiba khraw ba U  Trai  u la leh ban pyllait ïa phi bad ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof : so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured .
translation.kha: Sumar bha ïa u dieng Dumbur bad phin ïoh ïa ki soh ban bam . U shakri uba sumar bha ïa la u kynrad un ïoh burom .

translation.en: Pilate therefore went forth again , and saith unto them , Behold , I bring him forth to you , that ye may know that I find no fault in him .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la mih shabar sa shisien bad u la ong ha u paidbah ,  Ha khmih , ngan wallam shabar ïa u hangne ha phi ba phin lah ban ïohi ba ngam lap daw ei ei ïa ka ban pynrem ïa u .

Ha kajuh por ki Philistia ruh ki hiarthma ïa ki shnong kiba ha ki shaphang sepngi bad ïa ka Judah shathie la ïohknieh ïa ki jong ka Beth Shemesh ka , bad ïa ka Gederoth , bad ruh ïa ki nongbah jong ka Soko , ka Timnah , ka Gimso lem ki nongrit jong ki , bad ki shongduh hangta .
translation.en: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country , and of the south of Judah , and had taken Beth–shemesh , and Aijalon , and Gederoth , and Soco with the villages thereof , and Timnah with the villages thereof , Gimzo also and the villages thereof : and they dwelt there .

translation.kha: ka Templ u la lap ïa ki briew kiba ïa ki masi , ki langbrot paro bad ki nongïapeiñ ruh ki ïashong ha ki miej jong ki .
translation.en: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves , and the changers of money sitting :
And suddenly , when they had looked round about , they saw no man any more , save Jesus only with themselves .
translation.kha: Ki la phai stet sawdong hynrei kim shym la ïohi ïano ïano pat ; tang U Jisu u la don bad ki .
wat phoi ïa ka ; ot noh ïa baryngkhiang kti jong ka jingbit
translation.en: Then thou shalt cut off her hand , thine eye shall not pity her .

translation.kha: ka sngi kaba bud , u Hasael u shim ïa jaiñkup thiah , u wieh ïa ka ha ka um , bad u tap ïa u syiem haduh ba da op . Bad u Hasael u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that he took a thick cloth , and dipped it in water , and spread it on his face , so that he died : and Hazael reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Wat map ïa ummat sniew kaba ki leh bad wat klet ïa ki pop jong ki , Jeshanah ba ki la pynlehrain ïa ngi kiba dang ïatei .
translation.en: And cover not their iniquity , and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee : for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders .

translation.kha: Wallam ïa uta u masi lyngraw ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga , bad ong ïa Aaron u bad ïa ki shynrang khun jong u ba kin buh ïa ki la kti ha ka khlieh jong u .
translation.en: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation : and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock .

translation.kha: Hadien Dan , lwep phah khrud ïa ki jingïasngewtynnat baroh hapoh ïing , Karka bret ïa bakhor Haoid khyndew shabar shnong ha kyntiap jaka theh ñiut .
translation.en: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about , and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place :
And it came to pass , when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples , he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ai ïa kine ki jinghikai ha ki khat-ar ngut ki synran jong u , u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit noh ban hikai bad ïalap ha ki shnong kiba hajan hangta .
Nga sheptieng ïoh ïa ki jingmut jong phi yn pynjngut noh bad ba phin iehnoh noh ïa ka jingaiti basngur pura jong phi ha U Khrist kumba — ïa ka la shukor Im da ki buit sianti uta u bseiñ .
translation.en: But I fear , lest by any means , as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty , so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ .

translation.kha: lada kiwei kim pdiang ïa nga kum u Apostol , da shisha ma phi , phi pdiang! Namar ka jong phi ha U Trai , ma phi phi long ka jingpynskhem ïa ka ba nga long u .
translation.en: If I be not an apostle unto others , yet doubtless I am to you : for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord .

translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Moses , NGA LONG UBA NGA LONG . Kane ka nongjapan kaei kaba me IA ban ong ha ki : ‘ Uta ïa uba la khot UBA NGA LONG u Kito ïa nga sha phi .’
translation.en: And God said unto Moses , I AM THAT I AM : and he said , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , I AM hath sent me unto you .

translation.kha: U ai ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah : Phi ban dei pyndep ïa ki kamram jong phi ha ka jingsheptieng burom ïa U Trai , da kaba kohnguh hok ïa u ha kiei kiei ba phi . leh
translation.en: And he charged them , saying , Thus shall ye do in the fear of the  Lord  , faithfully , and with a perfect heart .

translation.kha: Na akasia jaka ba u Hadadeser , u khmih shapoh halor baroh Amalek shong ha bhah pyrthei .
translation.en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth .
Let there more work be laid upon the men , that they may labour therein  ; and let them not regard vain words .
translation.kha: Pyntrei shitom kham tyngeh ïa kine ki briew bad pynbunkam ïa ki , khnang ba kin ym don por ban shahshkor ïa ki nia lamler .

translation.en: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife , and said , The  Lord  give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the  Lord . And they went unto their own home .
translation.kha: Nangta u Eli u ju kyrkhu ïa u Elkanah bad ka tnga jong u , bad u ong ha u Elkanah ,  To U  Trai  un ai shuh ki khun ïa phi na kane ka briew ha ka jaka uta uba phi la aiti sha u .  Hadien kata ki sa leit phai sha la ïing .

Te ka nadien jong ksuid-durblang ka ïam sngewsih na ka Amal ka Moab Rabbi na ka mawtylliat ki briew ka Kir Rephidim Apple kumba mano re ba tem ïingjaiñ ka ngin ïapbriew ha ka kumta , namar baroh jingshahshitom kiei kiba dei kitkhia jong ki kim don shuh .
translation.en: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes , and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir–heres : because the riches that he hath gotten are perished .

translation.kha: nam jong me kan , bad ki briew kin ong junom , ‘ U Trai Bakhrawbor baroh u long U Blei ha Israel .’ Bad men pynneh ïa longïing syiem jong nga ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: Let it even be established , that thy name may be magnified for ever , saying , The  Lord  of hosts is the God of Israel , even a God to Israel : and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee .
Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king s guard , which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon :
translation.kha: Nangta u Daniel u la leit sha u Ariokh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun ai jingïada jong u syiem , uba la ïoh hukum ban pyndep ïa ka jingpynïap . Da kaba jied biang biang ïa ki kyntien jong u ,
Hynrei haba kata ka prum ka la jem la kylla lieh biang , uta u u dei ban leit sha u , u ban khmih bniah biang ïa .
translation.en: Or if the raw flesh turn again , and be changed unto white , he shall come unto the priest  ;

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U Blei u la wan ha u bad u ong , Lada ki briew ki la wan khot ïa me ban leit bad ki , to ban leit ; hynrei leh tang ïa kata kaba nga ha .
translation.en: And God came unto Balaam at night , and said unto him , If the men come to call thee , rise up , and go with them  ; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee , that shalt thou do .

translation.kha: Pha la dei ban ym rung shapoh ka nongbah jong jong nga ban risa beiñ halor ki jingshah shitom jong ki ban ïa ka spah jong ha ka sngi ka jingjot ki .
translation.en: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity  ; yea , thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity , nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity  ;

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Simri u la synshar hynñiew ha sngi Tirsah ka ïa Israel . Ki shipai Israel ki kerkut ïa ka nongbah ha Gibbethon Philistia ,
translation.en: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah . And the people were encamped against Gibbethon , which belonged to the Philistines .
All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs : if they be shaken , they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater .
translation.kha: Baroh ki kut jong pha kin long kum ki diengsoh Dumbur bad ki soh Dumbur ba la ih : Khynñiuh ïa ki dieng bad ki soh kin hap beit hapoh ka shyntur jong pha !

translation.en: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions , be not terrified : for these things must first come to pass  ; but the end is not by and by .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki thma bad ki jingïakhih pyrshah bor synshar ; kiba kum kine ki dei ban jia nyngkong , hynrei kim mut ba kaba kut ka la jan .

translation.en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them , had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach , to turn away his wrath , lest he should destroy them .
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u la ong ban pynjot ïa ki briew jong u , u shakri ba la jied jong u , u Moses , u la ïeng pyrshah ïa U Blei bad khang ïa ka jingbitar jong u na kaba pynjot noh ïa ki .
ïa u Sihon , u syiem ki Amor ; ka jingieit jong u ka bymjukut ;
translation.en: Sihon king of the Amorites : for his mercy endureth for ever :

translation.kha: Thaw saw tylli ki kyrwoh bad ksiar pyndait ïa ki ha ki kjat jong ka saw baroh tylli , ar ar tylli ki kyrwoh ha kawei kawei ka liang .
translation.en: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it , and put them in the four corners thereof  ; and two rings shall be in the one side of it , and two rings in the other side of it .

translation.kha: Haba phi duwai , wat long kum ki riewarsap ! Ki ieit ban ïeng bad duwai ha synagog bad ha kyndong surok , khnang ba baroh kin ïohi ïa ki . pynthikna ïa phi , ki la ïoh ïa ka jingsiew kaba pura .
translation.en: And when thou prayest , thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are : for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets , that they may be seen of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool .
translation.kha: Hangta u ap mynta tad ynda U Blei u la pyndem ïa ki nongshun jong u kum ka jingïuhkjat hapoh ki kjat jong u .

Ynda haba ngan ha ki jaitbynriew ïa ka jingkhuid ka kyrteng bakhraw jong nga — ka kyrteng ïa kaba phi la hapdeng jong ki — kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai . Ma , U Trai Nongsynshar nga la kren . Ngan pyndonkam ïa phi ban pyn-i ha ba nga long uba .
translation.en: And I will sanctify my great name , which was profaned among the heathen , which ye have profaned in the midst of them  ; and the heathen shall know that I am the  Lord  , saith the Lord  God  , when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada uwei pa uwei u pynbna khubor U haba u bymngeit ne u u rung hapoh , un ïoh jingkynduh ïa la ki da kaei kaba u ïohsngew
translation.en: But if all prophesy , and there come in one that believeth not , or one unlearned , he is convinced of all , he is judged of all :
And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times , and cleanse it , and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Da la ka shynriah ti un synreit khyndiat na kata ka snam ha kata ka duwan hynñiew sien . Ha kane ka rukom u dei ban pynkhuid ïa ka na ki pop jong ki paid Israel , bad un pynlong khuid ïa ka .
Rah sha u shiphew tylli ki kpu , khyndiat ki kpu stang , bad shi khiew ka um ngap . Kylli ïa u kaei ka ban jia ïa u khun jong ngi , bad un sa ïa .
translation.en: And take with thee ten loaves , and cracknels , and a cruse of honey , and go to him : he shall tell thee what shall become of the child .

translation.kha: Namar u Ahas u syiem Judah u la pynkheiñ ïa hok ki briew jong u bad u la pyrshah ïa U Trai , U Trai u la wallam ki jingjynjar ha ka .
translation.en: For the  Lord  brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel  ; for he made Judah naked , and transgressed sore against the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta ha snem ka hynñiew kaba jong u Serksis kum u syiem , ha u Tebeth , u bnai ba-shiphew , ïa ka Esther la wallam sha u syiem Serksis ha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month , which is the month Tebeth , in the seventh year of his reign .
In his humiliation his judgment was taken away : and who shall declare his generation ? for his life is taken from the earth .
translation.kha: La pynjahburom ïa u , bad ym shym la bishar hok ïa u . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïathuh shaphang ki khun ki ksiew jong u , namar ba ka jingim jong u ha ka pyrthei ka la kut .
Baroh ki ïaroh ïa nga borabor , bad ka Tiengburom Tamar bthat kam ju duh noh na nga .
translation.en: My glory was fresh in me , and my bow was renewed in my hand .
And Jeremiah commanded Baruch , saying , I am shut up  ; I cannot go into the house of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ai ha u Barukh ïa kine ki jingbthah harum :  Ym shah shuh ïa nga ban rung hapoh ka Templ .

translation.kha: ha kaba u Sadok bad u Nathan ki dei ban pynsleh ïa kyrthep kum u syiem simpyllieng . Persis put pynjlih ka turoi bad pyrta , ‘ Im batbit Syiem Solomon !’
translation.en: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel : and blow ye with the trumpet , and say , God save king Solomon .

Then was the iron , the clay , the brass , the silver , and the gold , broken to pieces together , and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors  ; and the wind carried them away , that no place was found for them : and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain , and filled the whole earth .
translation.kha: Kumta hi ka nar , ka dewbyrtha , ka rnong , ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki la khyllem bad ki la long kum u pui pui ha ka jaka shoh kew ha ka por lyiur . Ka lyer ka la kit noh ïa u , khlem da pynsah dien ei ei . Hynrei u maw u la san ban long u lumbah uba tap ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

Ong u ha Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u , ñiewburom ïa ki jingkñia kiba kyntang ba ki Israel ki pynkyntang la sha nga , ba kumta phin ym pynkheiñ burom ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong nga . Nga long U . Trai
translation.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons , that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel , and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me : I am the  Lord .
The steps of his strength shall be straitened , and his own counsel shall cast him down .
translation.kha: Ki jingjam jong u ki la ju long kiba skhem , hynrei mynta u jynthut ; u kyllon — u shah lehbeiñ ha la ka jong ka jingai jingmut jong u hi .
Ban im slem ka long ka bainong jong kiba hok ; u ñiuhlieh u long ka badonburom pansngiat .
translation.en: The hoary head is a crown of glory , if it be found in the way of righteousness .

And build an altar unto the  Lord  thy God upon the top of this rock , in the ordered place , and take the second bullock , and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down .
translation.kha: Tei ka duwan kaba la shna bha ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong me ha kliar kane ka kynton . Nangta shim ïa u masi kyrtong uba ar bad thang tylli ïa u kum ka jingainguh , da kaba pyndonkam diengthang da ki dak jong ka Asherah ïa kaba me la pynkhyllem .
Lada ïa phi ym shym la pynshitom , kumba shah ki khun pajih u pynlah , Ïingjaiñ mut ba thied dei ki khun bashisha jong u , hynrei ki khun khlem kpa pliang
translation.en: But if ye be without chastisement , whereof all are partakers , then are ye bastards , and not sons .

translation.kha: Kumba ka long , namarkata , jingkñia ki ainguh ki don na kawei ka snem sha kawei pat ka snem ban pynkynmaw ïa ki briew shaphang pop ki jong ki .
translation.en: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year .

translation.kha: U Mushi u don ngut lai ki khun shynrang : u Mahli , u Eder , bad u Jeremoth .
translation.en: The sons of Mushi  ; Mahli , and Eder , and Jeremoth , three .

translation.kha: ngi shahshitom , ka long na ka bynta ka jingïarap bad ka jingpynim jong phi ; la ïarap ïa la ïarap ïa ruh bad la ai ïa ka bor ban ïaineh lem da ka jingïaishah ha kita kijuh ki ba ruh ngi ïaineh .
translation.en: And whether we be afflicted , it is for your consolation and salvation , which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer : or whether we be comforted , it is for your consolation and salvation .
If then I do that which I would not , I consent unto the law that it is good .
translation.kha: Naba kaei kaba nga leh , ka dei kaei kaba ngam kwah ban leh , kane ka pyn-i ba nga ïamynjur ba ka Hukum ka long kaba dei .

translation.en: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice  ; with the voice together shall they sing : for they shall see eye to eye , when the  Lord  shall bring again Zion .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ap phira ïa ka nongbah ki pyrta , ki pyrta lang da ka jingkmen ! Ki lah ban ïohi da la ki jong ki khmat ïa ka jingwan jong U  Trai  sha Seïon !

translation.en: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the  Lord  : and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la kynting sbai ban ïakren bad U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ki , bad u la ai ha kawei pa kawei na ki jait kiba sah jong ki Israel shi bynta jong ka ri .
katno ka jingkhlaiñ kaba khraw ka don ka met jong u , bad katno ka bor kaba khraw ka don ha ki dohksah jong u !
translation.en: Lo now , his strength is in his loins , and his force is in the navel of his belly .
He giveth to the beast his food , and to the young ravens which cry .
translation.kha: U ai ïa ki jingri ïa ka jingbam jong ki bad u bsa ïa ki khun tyngab haba ki pah .
U Trai u Sarah pyndap ïa u da ka bor jinghikai u , Tahpenes u la jingpynlong ruh pynshohbieit u ïa ka jingtbit , ka jingnang , bad ka Kum ban trei ïa ki jait kam ohdur kiba har rukom ,
translation.en: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God , in wisdom , in understanding , and in knowledge , and in all manner of workmanship  ;
That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers .
translation.kha: Ainong ïa uwei pa uwei baroh katba kum ki kam jong u , khnang ba ki briew jong me kin kohnguh ïa me ha ki por baroh katba ki dang im ha kane ka ri ïa kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

translation.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold , to bear the table .
translation.kha: U shna ïa kita ki jingbah da ka dieng akasia bad u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .

translation.en: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men , but unto God : for no man understandeth him ; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries .
translation.kha: Uta uba kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher um kren ha kiwei pat hynrei ha U Blei , namar ym don ba sngewthuh ïa u . U kren ïa ki jingshisha barieh da ka bor U Mynsiem .
Uwei dohkha baroh , te Lamekh u bang leit ban ai kyrteng ïa lade , khana uwei sha la ka jong hi ka shnong .
translation.en: And all went to be taxed , every one into his own city .
And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him , I brought him forth into their council :
translation.kha: Nga la kwah ban tip ïa kaei kaba ki la mudui ïa u , kumta nga la ïalam ïa u sha ka Dorbar jong ki .
U ïa hukum ka duriaw , ka bad rngad ! U pynlong ïa ki wah ban tyrkhong . Ki pyntha jong ka Bashan ki swai , u lumbah Karmel u kylla bthuh bad , ki syntiew jong u Lebanon ki jlop .
translation.en: He rebuketh the sea , and maketh it dry , and drieth up all the rivers : Bashan languisheth , and Carmel , and the flower of Lebanon languisheth .
But go your way , tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee : there shall ye see him , as he said unto you .
translation.kha: Mynta to leit bad ai ïa kane ka khubor sha ki synran jong u , kynthup ïa u Petros : ‘ Un leit sha Galilaïa ha shuwa jong phi ; hangta phin ïohi ïa u , kumba u la ong ha phi .’

translation.en: Then said Daniel unto the king , O king , live for ever .
translation.kha: U Daniel u la jubab ,  Ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un im junom !

translation.en: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun , that Joshua commanded , and they took them down off the trees , and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid , and laid great stones in the cave s mouth , which remain until this very day .
translation.kha: Ha ka por sep sngi u Joshua u ai ka hukum , bad la pynhiar noh ïa kita ki metïap bad bret ha kajuh ka krem ha kaba ki la ïarieh mynshuwa . La buh ïa ki maw kiba heh ha ka jaka rung sha ka krem , bad ki dang don hangta .
Phin jingjaw borabor ki briew kiba duk lem bad phi , hynrei jingpangnud ïalang skud de ïa nga .
translation.en: For the poor always ye have with you  ; but me ye have not always .
And these bottles of wine , which we filled , were new  ; and , behold , they be rent : and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey .
translation.kha: Haba ngi pyndap ïa kine ki pla snieh waiñ , ki dang thymmai , hynrei ha khmih ! Ki la jot . Ki jaiñ bad ki juti jong ngi ki la jot namar ka jingïaid lynti kaba jngai .

Ka la long janmiet haba u Joseph na Arimathaïa u wan la poi . U la long u riewdonburom jong ka Dorbar , uba ap ïa ka jingwan jong ka Hima U Blei . Ka la long ka sngi Pynkhreh ( kata , ka shuwa sngi ka sngi Sabbaton ) u , kumta Joseph u la leit ka da jingshlur sha u Pilat bad pan na u ïa ka met U Jisu .
translation.en: Joseph of Arimathaea , an honourable counsellor , which also waited for the kingdom of God , came , and went in boldly unto Pilate , and craved the body of Jesus .

translation.kha: Ka hukum nga ba ai ha phi mynta ka sngi kam dei kaba eh ban sngewthuh lane kaba sha palat ka bor jong phi .
translation.en: For this commandment which I command thee this day , it is not hidden from thee , neither is it far off .
A man s gift maketh room for him , and bringeth him before great men .
translation.kha: Hato phi kwah ban ïakynduh ïa u briew uba khraw ? Rah sha u ka jingai sngewbha bad kan pynsuk ïa phi .
Bad u Samuel u ong ha ki , Ïa ngin ïaleit baroh sha Gilgal , bad sa ngin shisien pynbna ïa u Saul kum u jong syiem ngi .
translation.en: Then said Samuel to the people , Come , and let us go to Gilgal , and renew the kingdom there .

translation.kha: La kyntiew ïa u sha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , U Kpa jong u , bad u la ïohpdiang u ïa na U Mynsiem Bakhuid , kumba u la lah kular . Kaei kaba phi ïohi bad ïohsngew mynta long ka ka jingai sngewbha kaba u la theh noh ha ngi .
translation.en: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted , and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost , he hath shed forth this , which ye now see and hear .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Shalmaneser u la jubab , Me tip kah Rabbah Haggai uba duna ha hangtei ktien ka thylliej ; kumno keiñ u Pharaoh un shahshkor ïa nga ïashakri
translation.en: And Moses said before the  Lord  , Behold , I am of uncircumcised lips , and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me ?
And when they were a good way from the house of Micah , the men that were in the houses near to Micah s house were gathered together , and overtook the children of Dan .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi kham ha pajih na ka ïing , u Mikah u khot ïa ki paramarjan ban leit ïaleh thma ïa ki . Ki lap ïa ki rangbah na Dan
Sha lyndet ki wah ka jong Sudan don ka ri ha kaba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa jong ki thapniang .
translation.en: Woe to the land shadowing with wings , which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia :

translation.kha: Ka Amram uta u Israel Lied ïathaw plie pynïap lang bad kata ka kynthei Midian ka bur u Simri khmied khun jong PYNI Salu Baibyl Jingbymman khlieh jong ka longïing kaba na ka jait Simeon .
translation.en: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain , even that was slain with the Midianite woman , was Zimri , the son of Salu , a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites .

translation.kha: Ha ka por lai baje U Jisu u la pyrta da ka jingpyrta bajam , , Eli Eli , lema Sabakhthani ? kaba U mut jong Blei nga , U Blei jong nga , balei ba me iehnoh ïa nga ?
translation.en: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice , saying ,  Eli , Eli , lama sabachthani ?  that is to say ,  My God , my God , why hast thou forsaken me ?
And again he sent a third : and they wounded him also , and cast him out .
translation.kha: Nangta u la phah ïa u mraw uba lai ; ki nongshimwai ki la pynmynsaw ïa u ruh , bad ki la bret ïa u shabar .
Hadien katto por Boas da lade hi wan poi na Bethlehem u ai khublei ïa ki nongtrei To U Trai un long ryngkat bad phi ! u U Trai u ïa phi ki jubab .
translation.en: And , behold , Boaz came from Beth–lehem , and said unto the reapers , The  Lord  be with you . And they answered him , The  Lord  bless thee .
Also Edom shall be a desolation : every one that goeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka jingpynjot ka ban wan hap ha ka Edom kan long kaba da shyrkhei haduh ba kiba ïaid nangta kin kyndit bad sheptieng .

translation.en: And they laid the ark of the  Lord  upon the cart , and the coffer with the mice of gold and the images of their emerods .
translation.kha: Ki buh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kata ka kali , lem bad ïa kata ka synduk ha kaba la thep ïa ki dur khnai bad ki dur u thung kiba da ka ksiar .

translation.en: Howbeit , as the disciples stood round about him , he rose up , and came into the city : and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki parabangeit ki la ïalumlang sawdong ïa u , u la ïeng joit bad u la leit phai pat sha shnong . Ha ka sngi kaba bud ma u lem bad u Barnabas ki la leit sha Derbe .

translation.en: But Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  , that we may enquire of the  Lord  by him ? And one of the king of Israel s servants answered and said , Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat , which poured water on the hands of Elijah .
translation.kha: U syiem Jehoshaphat u kylli ,  Hato don nongïathuhlypa hangne da uba ngi lah ban kylli na U  Trai  ?  U rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki kynhun u syiem Joram u jubab ,  U Elisha u khun jong u Shaphat u don hangne . U dei u nongïarap jong u Elijah .

translation.en: Thou wilt say then unto me , Why doth he yet find fault ? For who hath resisted his will ?
translation.kha: Hynrei uwei na phi un ong ha nga ,  Lada kane ka long kumta , kumno U Blei un shem jingbakla badno badno ? Uei uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ka mon U Blei ?

translation.en: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing : and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven , and among the inhabitants of the earth : and none can stay his hand , or say unto him , What doest thou ?
translation.kha: U la khmih halor ki briew jong ka pyrthei kum bym long ei ei ; ki angel ha bneng bad ki briew ha ka pyrthei ki don hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyrshah ïa ka mon jong u lane kylli jingkylli ïa kaei kaba u leh .

translation.en: Which yet my soul seeketh , but I find not : one man among a thousand have I found  ; but a woman among all those have I not found .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih ïa kiwei pat ki jubab hynrei ngam shem ei ei . Nga la shem uwei u briew na ki shihajar ngut uba nga lah ban burom , hynrei ym don kawei ruh ka kynthei .

translation.en: And , behold , there came up out of the river seven kine , fatfleshed and well favoured  ; and they fed in a meadow :
translation.kha: haba hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid bad kiba plung ki la wan mih na ka wah bad ki sdang ban ïabam phlang .
Ka tang mar shu ïohi ïa ki , ka la dap ka da jingkwah brai bad ka phah nonglamktien sha ki ha Babilonia .
translation.en: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes , she doted upon them , and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea .
The  Lord  shall bring a nation against thee from far , from the end of the earth , as swift as the eagle flieth  ; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  un phah ïa ka jaitbynriew na kaba kut ka pyrthei pyrshah ïa phi , ka jaitbynriew kaba ka ktien ka thylliej jong ka phin ym sngewthuh . Kin wan hiar kynsan ha phi kumba suh u pukni .

translation.en: The righteous shall never be removed : but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki ïoh ka jingsngewskhem borabor , hynrei ki bymman kin ym lah ban im ha ka ri .

translation.en: I have made the earth , the man and the beast that are upon the ground , by my great power and by my outstretched arm , and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me .
translation.kha: Da ka bor bakhraw bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , ïa u khunbynriew , bad ïa baroh ki mrad kiba im ha ka khyndew ; bad nga ai ïa ka ha uno uno uba nga jied .

Hynrei namar ba ngam leh lah ei ei ban bat ïa la ki khun kynthei bad ïa ki khun jong ki , nga kloi ban pynlong ka jingïateh kular bad me . ïakynton To ngin ïa ki maw ki ban pynkynmaw ïa ka jingïateh kular jong ngi .
translation.en: Now therefore come thou , let us make a covenant , I and thou  ; and let it be for a witness between me and thee .

translation.kha: Yn don ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpang na ka bynta kito baroh kiba leh ïa kaei sniew , na ka bynta ki Jiw nyngkong bad na ka bynta ki Jentil ruh .
translation.en: Tribulation and anguish , upon every soul of man that doeth evil , of the Jew first , and also of the Gentile ;
In thoughts from the visions of the night , when deep sleep falleth on men ,
translation.kha: Kum ka jingruma ka pynwit ïa ka jingïohthiah jong nga .

translation.en: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him , and said unto them ,  Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said , A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ba ki la kwah ban kylli ïa u , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Nga la ong , ‘ Sa tang shipor phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , bad nangta sa shipor hadien phin sa ïohi ïa nga .’ Hato dei kane kaba phi ïakylli para ma phi hi ?
ban pyrkhat ïa ki dur kiba itynnat bad ban saiñ ïa ki ha ka ksiar , ka ha rupa , bad ha ka rnong ;
translation.en: And to devise curious works , to work in gold , and in silver , and in brass ,

And their father Israel said unto them , If it must be so now , do this  ; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels , and carry down the man a present , a little balm , and a little honey , spices , and myrrh , nuts , and almonds :
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha ki ,  Lada kumta te , to leit rah ïa ki jingmih kiba kynsai tam jong kane ka ri ha ki byrni jong phi kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa uta u lat : khyndiat ka jingiwbih , khyndiat ka ngap , ki musli musla , ka mirr , ki jait soh-ot , bad ki almond .

translation.en: Then shall the righteous answer him , saying , Lord , when saw we thee an hungred , and fed thee ? or thirsty , and gave thee drink ?
translation.kha: Nangta kiba hok kin jubab ïa u , ‘ Mynno , ko Trai , ba ngi la ju ïohi ïa me ba me thngan bad ba ngi bsa ïa me , lane ba me sliang bad ba ngi ai jingdih ïa me ?

translation.en: And when the people were come into the wood , behold , the honey dropped  ; but no man put his hand to his mouth : for the people feared the oath .
translation.kha: Ki dieng ki la dap da ka ngap , hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba la bam ei ei na ka namar baroh ki sheptieng ïa ka jingtim ka jong u Saul .
Phi ong , ba U pynstet bad leh ïa kaei kaba u ong un leh ba kumta ngi lah ban ïohi ïa ka . Ai ba U Blei bakhuid ka Israel un pyndep ïa ki jingthmu u , u don ha ka jingmut jong u .
translation.en: That say , Let him make speed , and hasten his work , that we may see it : and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come , that we may know it !

translation.kha: Ko Trai , U Blei jong nga , nga long u me Shahshkor ka jingduwai jong nga , bad to ai ïa ki jingkyrpad la pan na me ha kane ka sngi .
translation.en: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant , and to his supplication , O  Lord  my God , to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer , which thy servant prayeth before thee to day :

translation.kha: ïa ki , ba kin ym ïoh hikai shuh ïa phi ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba ba ki ju leh haba mane ïa ki blei ki , kumta phin ym leh pop ïa Trai U jong .
translation.en: That they teach you not to do after all their abominations , which they have done unto their gods  ; so should ye sin against the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Ha ka por sep sngi , u poi sha ka jaka bakhuid bad u sher dara hangta U dem ban u da pynshaniah ïa la ka khlieh maw .
translation.en: And he lighted upon a certain place , and tarried there all night , because the sun was set  ; and he took of the stones of that place , and put them for his pillows , and lay down in that place to sleep .

translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha ka , Wallam kyr-ang kito ki Salome Dimnah ha ka Mih jong nga bad pyntian ïa nga da ma phi Pethor . Ka la shim basyllen ki Madmannah bad ka la Parthia Dimonah u .
translation.en: And Amnon said unto Tamar , Bring the meat into the chamber , that I may eat of thine hand . And Tamar took the cakes which she had made , and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother .
Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh , fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind ; and were by nature the children of wrath , even as others .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , baroh na ngi , ngi la long kum ma ki bad ngi la im kat kum ki jingkwah ka doh jong ngi , da kaba leh ïa kano kano kaba ïahap kat kum ki jingkwah jong ki met bad ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi hi . Ha ka jinglong tynrai jong ngi , kumba long uwei pa uwei , la buh lypa ban shah pynshitom ha ka jingbitar U Blei .
Ka por poi ha kaba ïa ka yn klet noh hynñiewphew snem , kat ka rta u syiem . Haba kita ki snem ki la kut noh , Tyros kan long kum ha ka jingrwai :
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years , according to the days of one king : after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot .

translation.kha: Ha ka miet , u Paul u la ïoh ka ha kaba U Trai u la ha u , Wat sheptieng , hynrei kren bad wat sangeh naba nga long lem .
translation.en: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision ,  Be not afraid , but speak , and hold not thy peace :
Hear , ye children , the instruction of a father , and attend to know understanding .
translation.kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , to shahshkor ïa kaei ba u kpa jong phi u hikai ïa phi . Shahshkor bha , bad phin ïoh ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty : they shall behold the land that is very far off .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat phin ïohi ïa u syiem ba u synshar ha ka burom bakhraw ha ka hima kaba pyiar ha baroh ki liang .

translation.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families , the cities , and their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki nongbah bad ki nongrit ïa kiba la ai ha ki longïing jong ka jait Gad kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
Dei kata keiñ balei ba la noh ïa u slap bad slap um la wan . Pha da i syriem hi kum ka nuti ; pham don kano kano ka jinglehrain .
translation.en: Therefore the showers have been withholden , and there hath been no latter rain  ; and thou hadst a whore s forehead , thou refusedst to be ashamed .

translation.kha: U Trai u khmih sha tbian na bneng , bad u ïohi u ïa khunbynriew baroh .
translation.en: The  Lord  looketh from heaven  ; he beholdeth all the sons of men .

translation.kha: Lada phi pynroh ïa ki paralok jong phi , phi buh bakla ïa lade .
translation.en: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet .

translation.kha: A Trai to khie bad ïarap ïa ngi ! Pyndonkam ïa la ka bor bad pynim ïa ngi ; ïa pyndonkam ka kum ha ka por mynbarim . Dei ma me uba la ot lyngkhot ïa lyngkhai u Rahab mrad u duriaw bakynsha .
translation.en: Awake , awake , put on strength , O arm of the  Lord   ; awake , as in the ancient days , in the generations of old . Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab , and wounded the dragon ?
And the whole multitude sought to touch him : for there went virtue out of him , and healed them all .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew ki la pyrshang ban ktah ïa u , naba ka bor ka la mih na u bad ka da pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .

Nangta la don ruh kawei sa pat ka thma ha Gath ha kaba la don uwei u ramhah uba sngewtynnat ban ïaleh . U don hynriew tylli ki shynriah ti ha kawei ka kawei kti , bad hynriew tylli shynriah ki jat ha kawei kawei ka kjat .
translation.en: And there was yet a battle in Gath , where was a man of great stature , that had on every hand six fingers , and on every foot six toes , four and twenty in number  ; and he also was born to the giant .
Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness : but a faithful man who can find ?
translation.kha: Baroh ki kren shaphang katno u long uba kohnguh bad baïaineh , hynrei shu pyrshang ban wad ïa uno uno uba long kumta !
Ka ding dei ban ïai meh lynter halor ka duwan bad ym dei ban shah ba kan noh .
translation.en: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar  ; it shall never go out .
Then shalt thou say , O  Lord  , thou hast spoken against this place , to cut it off , that none shall remain in it , neither man nor beast , but that it shall be desolate for ever .
translation.kha: Nangta sa duwai , ‘ A  Trai  , me la ong ba men pynjot ïa kane ka jaka , haduh ba yn ym don jingthaw ba im ha ka , u briew lane u mrad , bad ba kan long kum ka ri shyiap junom .’
Katba ki kynthih halor ki lumbah , ki riew kum ki kali ; ki sawa kum u phlangïap ha ka ding . Ki ïeng ka kynhun shipai bakhraw ban ïaleh thma .
translation.en: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap , like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble , as a strong people set in battle array .

translation.kha: Da la ki bleithaw ïa nga ki pynbitar , ïa ki blei jong ki , ki bym dei shisha ki , blei ngam lah shah . Kumta ngan da pyndonkam ki kito bym dei ka jaitbynriew pynbitar ban ïa ki , ngan kynshoit ruh ïa ki da ka jaitbynriew kaba bieit katba kin ym lah shah .
translation.en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God  ; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities : and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people  ; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation .
Who cut up mallows by the bushes , and juniper roots for their meat .
translation.kha: Ki la phut ïa ki jingthung jong ka ri shyiap bad bam ïa ki , wat ïa ki thied bym don jingmad jong u diengsynshar !
Nangta U Petros u la kren , jin , ngi la iehnoh ïa .—Mathaios kiei baroh bad ngi la Meshakh ïa me .
translation.en: Then Peter began to say unto him , Lo , we have left all , and have followed thee .

translation.kha: U rangbah synshar ki Karnelian shadkmen la pynsngewshyrkhei 32 u patsha u ho-oid leit sha Ampliatos Antiokh u dang ïaleh pyrshah Malkhiel ka jingthadrong ka nongbah ba-marjan ; kumta Shittah leit shata ban ïasyllok bad u .
translation.en: So Rabshakeh returned , and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah : for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish .
And Jesus saith unto him ,  See thou tell no man  ; but go thy way , shew thyself to the priest , and offer the gift that Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To shahshkor ! Wat ïathuh hano hano , hynrei khie leit beit beit sha u lyngdoh bad ai un khmih bniah ïa me ; te khnang ban pynshisha ha uwei uwei baroh ba me la khiah , ai ïa ka jingkñia kaba u Moses u la hukum .

translation.en: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem , after he was come from Hebron : and there were yet sons and daughters born to David .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la kynriah na Hebron sha Jerusalem , u Dabid u shim shuh shuh ki tnga kliar bad ki tnga trai , bad u ïoh bun ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei .

Ka jingieit jong phi ka pynkmen waitsum nga , Entappuah ba-ieit thep Phi bad Jannai nongleitkurim jong nga . Ka jingieit jong phi ka kham 18 ban ïa ka waiñ ; ka syrngiew jong phi ka kham iwbih ban ba-pynmynsaw uno uno u musla .
translation.en: My beloved is white and ruddy , the chiefest among ten thousand .

translation.kha: Ki u uba hap halor ki , ki ïa-thngian harud ki mawsiang ban rieh .
translation.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains , and embrace the rock for want of a shelter .

translation.kha: aïom la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha bang jong u , kiba la leit sha ka nongrit ha Kam ban ïa-ithuh ïa kaei pynong riew na ka bynta jong u ïadem
translation.en: And sent messengers before his face : and they went , and entered into a village of the Samaritans , to make ready for him .
Unto me men gave ear , and waited , and kept silence at my counsel .
translation.kha: Haba nga ai jingmut , ki briew ki sngap jar bad ki shahshkor bha ïa kaei kaba nga ong ;
Pynban , men leit ki briew u kpa jong nga , bad sha kur ki jait jong nga , bad ka tnga na ka jong .’
translation.en: But thou shalt go unto my father s house , and to my kindred , and take a wife unto my son .

translation.kha: U bat synshar ïa ki por bad jingsuk aïom ; jingdup pynlong bad u weng ïatehktien ki syiem ; long ma u badonkam uba ai ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: And he changeth the times and the seasons : he removeth kings , and setteth up kings : he giveth wisdom unto the wise , and knowledge to them that know understanding :

translation.kha: Ki die ïa noh ka jaka ka puta bad ka jingdon jingem jong ki , bad sam ïa ka pisa hapdeng jong baroh ki , kat kum kaei kaba uwei uwei u donkam .
translation.en: And sold their possessions and goods , and parted them to all men , as every man had need .

translation.kha: U Trai 22 ieit ïa Belteshassar ki briew , bad u Nyngkong ïa la Shakri jong . Kumta ngi dem ha ki kjat jong u , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
translation.en: Yea , he loved the people  ; all his saints are in thy hand : and they sat down at thy feet  ; every one shall receive of thy words .
For as the body is one , and hath many members , and all the members of that one body , being many , are one body : so also is Christ .
translation.kha: U Khrist u long kum kawei ka met , kaba don shibun ki dkhot ; ka long hi tang kawei ka met , wat haba la pynlong ïa ka da ki dkhot kiba ïapher .

translation.en: Thou shalt beat him with the rod , and shalt deliver his soul from hell .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , ka lah ban pyllait ïa ka jingim jong u .
U u la leh ha me u la kren da nga : u la knieh ïa hima na me bad pynban u ïa u Dabid .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath done to him , as he spake by me : for the  Lord  hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand , and given it to thy neighbour , even to David :

translation.kha: pynban ha ngi don tang uwei U Blei , U , Kpa uba long u Nongthaw ïa kiei kiei baroh bad uba na ka bynta jong u ngi im ; bad tang don uwei U Trai , U Jisu Khrist , da u ba kiei kiei baroh la pynlong bad u ba ha ngi im .
translation.en: But to us there is but one God , the Father , of whom are all things , and we in him ; and one Lord Jesus Christ , by whom are all things , and we by him .
House and riches are the inheritance of fathers : and a prudent wife is from the  Lord .
translation.kha: U briew u lah ban ïohpateng ïa ka ïing bad ka spah na la ki kmie ki kpa , hynrei tang U  Trai  uba lah ban ai ha u ïa ka tnga kaba shemphang .
u la phah shata katne ngut ki lem kane ka : To U Trai un ïa phi namar ka jingpyn-i ïa ka jingieit ïa la u syiem da kaba tep ïa .
translation.en: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh–gilead , and said unto them , Blessed be ye of the  Lord  , that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord , even unto Saul , and have buried him .
In measure , when it shooteth forth , thou wilt debate with it : he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa ki briew jong u da kaba phah ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw . U la shim ïa ki da ka lyer bashyrkhei na shaphang mihngi .

Lied noh ïa la ka dara bad ïaid shaphrang . Leit sha ri lum Amor bad sahkynmaw ki jaka kiba markhap lyngraw Shemesh — sha ka Them Um , sha ki ksiar lum bad ïapmat them , sha ka jaka kaba shathie bad sha ka Thiah duriaw Mediterranian . Leit sha daiñ Phinehas Kanaan bad nangta sha lyndet ki lum Lebanon haduh ka wahbah Ïuphratis .
translation.en: Turn you , and take your journey , and go to the mount of the Amorites , and unto all the places nigh thereunto , in the plain , in the hills , and in the vale , and in the south , and by the sea side , to the land of the Canaanites , and unto Lebanon , unto the great river , the river Euphrates .
And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim , which is in mount Ephraim , and said , Hear me , thou Jeroboam , and all Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ki kynhun shipai ki ïakynduh ha ri lum Ephraim . U syiem Abijah u kiew sha u lum Semaraim bad u pyrta sha u Jeroboam bad ki Israel :  Shahshkor ïa nga !  u ong .

Wat ba yn pynsngew ïa ki jingïam jong pha . Wat kumto khlem tapkhlieh lane khlem jingsopkjat kum ka dak jong ka jingïam pangnud . Wat tap ïa la khmat lane bam ïa ka jingbam kaba ki nongïam pangnud ki bam .
translation.en: Forbear to cry , make no mourning for the dead , bind the tire of thine head upon thee , and put on thy shoes upon thy feet , and cover not thy lips , and eat not the bread of men .

He shall put on the holy linen coat , and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh , and shall be girded with a linen girdle , and with the linen mitre shall he be attired : these are holy garments  ; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water , and so put them on .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine ki jinghikai shuwa ba u Aaron un rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , u dei ban da sum , bad nangta un kup ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh ; ka sopti linen , ka patlun lyngkot , ka jingpanpoh , bad ka jaiñspong .

Uta u jhieh U Mynsiem uba pynpaw Jingïap ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei ïohnang Ka pyrthei kam lah ban pdiang ïa u , namar ba kam ïohi myntan u lane ithuh ïa u . Hynrei phi ithuh ïa u jingpyllait namar Tob u ïatip bad phi bad u ibha hapoh jong phi .
translation.en: Even the Spirit of truth  ; whom the world cannot receive , because it seeth him not , neither knoweth him : but ye know him  ; for he dwelleth with you , and shall be in you .

translation.kha: Nga la long kum u kpa ïa kiba duk bad nga la long ha ka liang ki nongwei haba ki shem jingeh .
translation.en: I was a father to the poor : and the cause which I knew not I searched out .
Son of man , these men have set up their idols in their heart , and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face : should I be enquired of at all by them ?
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kine ki briew ki la ai ïa ki dohnud jong ki ha ki bleithaw bad ki la shah ba ki bleithaw kin ïalam ïa ki sha ka pop . Hato ki pyrkhat ba ngan ai ha ki ka jubab ?

translation.en: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter .
translation.kha: Ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang ki la ïakynduh lang ban pyrkhat ïa kane ka jingkylli .
Hadien ba U Trai u dep kren ha u Job , U ong ha u Eliphas , Nga bitar ïa me bad ïa ngut paralok jong me , namar mem shym kren ïa ka jingshisha shaphang jong , kumba u Job u jong nga u leh .
translation.en: And it was so , that after the  Lord  had spoken these words unto Job , the  Lord  said to Eliphaz the Temanite , My wrath is kindled against thee , and against thy two friends : for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right , as my servant Job hath .

translation.kha: Nangta ki baroh ki la ïabud ïa u da , ka jingrisa jam put bad ïa ki sharati , da kaba pynmih ka jingsawa kaba jur kat ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka khyndew .
translation.en: And all the people came up after him , and the people piped with pipes , and rejoiced with great joy , so that the earth rent with the sound of them .
For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself , lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds .
translation.kha: To da pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba u la ïaid lyngba , kumno u la buh ïa lade ban shah isih ha ki nongpop ! Kumta wat ai ba phin noh mynsiem bad kynran dien .

translation.en: But when Jesus saw it , he was much displeased , and said unto them ,  Suffer the little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa kane , u la sngewbitar bad u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ,  Shah ïa ki khynnah ban wan ha nga , bad wat khang ïa ki , namar ka Hima U Blei ka long na ka bynta kum kine .

translation.en: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la jam sha khmat bad ki la pynlong ki jingmudui kiba khlaiñ pyrshah ïa U Jisu .

U Trai un shoh ïa phi da ka jingkhrew , da ka khieshoh , da ka jingat , bad ka jingshit kyr-ang ; un phah ruh ïa ka jingryngkhiang ki lyer , ban pynjot ïa ki jingthung jong phi . Kine ki jingpynjot kin ïailong bad phi haduh ba phin da ïap .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall smite thee with a consumption , and with a fever , and with an inflammation , and with an extreme burning , and with the sword , and with blasting , and with mildew  ; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish .

And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of the sons of Joseph , came near , and spake before Moses , and before the princes , the chief fathers of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Ki khlieh jong ki longïing longsem ha ka kur u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir u ksiew jong u Manasseh u khun jong u Joseph , ki la leit sha u Moses bad kiwei pat ki nongïalam .

translation.en: But if any man seem to be contentious , we have no such custom , neither the churches of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u kwah ban ïasaidnia shaphang kata , baroh kaba nga don ban ong ka long ba ma ngi lymne ki balang U Blei ngi don da kawei pat ka rukom ha ka jingmane .

translation.en: Only acknowledge thine iniquity , that thou hast transgressed against the  Lord  thy God , and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree , and ye have not obeyed my voice , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Shu pdiang ba pha la bakla bad ba pha la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong pha . To phla ba hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam pha la ai ïa la ka jingieit ha ki blei nongwei bad ba pham shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
U Blei un ïa kaei kaba : Un wallam ka jingshah shitom ha kito kiba pynlong ïa phi ban shahshitom ,
translation.en: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you ;
And they went forth , and preached every where , the Lord working with them , and confirming the word with signs following . Amen .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la leit bad ïalap kylleng , bad U Trai u la trei lem bad pynshisha ba ka jingïalap jong ki ka la long kaba shisha da ki kambah kiba ki la leh .]

translation.en: But the land , whither ye go to possess it , is a land of hills and valleys , and drinketh water of the rain of heaven :
translation.kha: hynrei kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit rung ka dei ka ri lum bad ri them , kaba ïoh um na u slap .

translation.en: But God said unto him , Thou fool , this night thy soul shall be required of thee : then whose shall those things be , which thou hast provided ?
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la ong ha u , ‘ A me uba bieit ! Ha kane hi ka miet men hap ban iehnoh ïa la ka jingim ; te mano ban ïoh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh kiba me la buh na ka bynta ïa lade ?’
saiñpyrkhat Judah ka la kylla long ka jaitbynriew kaba Hit jong U :35 , bad ka Israel ka kylla .—Ioannis ka jingïohkynti jong u hi hateng
translation.en: Judah was his sanctuary , and Israel his dominion .

So Saul took the kingdom over Israel , and fought against all his enemies on every side , against Moab , and against the children of Ammon , and against Edom , and against the kings of Zobah , and against the Philistines : and whithersoever he turned himself , he vexed them .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Saul u la long u syiem ki Israel , u la ïaleh ïa baroh ki nongshun jong u kylleng : ki paid Moab , Ammon , Edom , ki syiem ka Sobah , bad ki Philistia . Man kaba u ïaleh u jop .

translation.en: Follow after charity , and desire spiritual gifts , but rather that ye may prophesy .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingieit keiñ , ba phi dei ban ïabeh . To ai ba dohnud kan kwah hir hir ïa ki jingai ba kynja mynsiem , khamtam ïa ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei .
Mynta te kane , ka long kaba kaei ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga ong : namar me mut ba me stad kum U Blei ,
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God  ;

translation.kha: wat pyneh ïa la ka dohnud , kumba ki kpa tymmen phi ki la long haba ki ïaleh pyrshah U , kumba ki la long ha kata ka sngi ha ka shyiap haba ki la tynjuh ïa U .
translation.en: Harden not your hearts , as in the provocation , in the day of temptation in the wilderness :

translation.kha: jingkynnoh khadar dang Gilo sha ka jaka shoh kew ha Khidon , pynbyrngia masi u jynthut , bad u Sidon u kner ïa la ka kti bad u kyrshan ïa Jehu Synduk ka mawtylliat .
translation.en: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon , Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark  ; for the oxen stumbled .

translation.kha: U la , jubab ‘ U Trai , ïa uba nga la ju kohnguh , phah un ïa u angel jong u lem bad me bad ai ha me ka jingjop Men . pynïoh ïa u jong khun nga ka tnga na ki briew jong nga hi , bad na ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u kpa jong nga .
translation.en: And he said unto me , The  Lord  , before whom I walk , will send his angel with thee , and prosper thy way  ; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred , and of my father s house :

translation.kha: Joab u la leit , bad kylli , Phi dei u Joab ? , nga dei , u jubab . Kynrad sngap ïa nga , ong . Nga sngap keiñ , u jubab .
translation.en: And when he was come near unto her , the woman said , Art thou Joab ? And he answered , I am he . Then she said unto him , Hear the words of thine handmaid . And he answered , I do hear .

translation.kha: Hynrei na Nophah bynta jong phi kiba kohnguh ïa nga , Jingijli bor jong nga kaba pynim kan kiew halor jong phi kum ka sngi kambah kan wallam jingkhiah kum ki kjat sngi . Phin long kiba laitluid bad bakmen kum ki khun masi ba la pyllait rben ka Bigthana .
translation.en: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings  ; and ye shall go forth , and grow up as calves of the stall .
Now when much time was spent , and when sailing was now dangerous , because the fast was now already past , Paul admonished them ,
translation.kha: Ngi la pynlut kham bun ka por hangta , tad ynda ka la long kaba ma ban bteng ïa ka jingleit da ka lieng , naba mynta ka Sngi ka Jingsiewspah ka la dep . Kumta u Paul u la ai ïa kane ka jingai jingmut ha ki :

translation.en: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them , they gathered all that were able to put on armour , and upward , and stood in the border .
translation.kha: Haba ki Moab ki ïohsngew ba ki lai ngut ki syiem ki la wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , ki la khot ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba lah ban kieng atiar , naduh kiba tymmen haduh kiba dang khynnah , bad la buh ïa ki ha ki khappud .

Kynsan U Dibri u phah pynphalang ka ding , bad ka bam duh ïa ka jingkñia ainguh thang bad Philip ki bynta bakhleiñ baroh ha ka duwan . Haba ki paidbah ki ïohi ïa kata , ki la ïa-pyrta jam , bad ki ïadem Bam haduh khyndew .
translation.en: And there came a fire out from before the  Lord  , and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat : which when all the people saw , they shouted , and fell on their faces .
Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband , so have ye dealt treacherously with me , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei kum ka tnga ka bymïaineh , pham shym la ïaineh ha nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter , It is the Lord . Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord , he girt his fisher s coat unto him , ( for he was naked , ) and did cast himself into the sea .
translation.kha: U synran ïa uba U Jisu u ieit u la ong ha u Petros ,  U dei U Trai !  Haba u Petros u la ïohsngew ba dei U Trai , u tap da ka jaiñ ïa la ka met ( naba u la loit noh ïa la ki jaiñphong ) bad u la ryngkoh shapoh um .

translation.en: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem : and they tarried there .
translation.kha: Kumta u Sadok bad u Abiathar ki bah biang ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha Jerusalem bad ki sah hangta .

translation.en: Destruction and death say , We have heard the fame thereof with our ears .
translation.kha: Wat ka jingïap bad ka jingpynjot ki ong ba ki la ïohsngew tang ki hamsaïa .

translation.en: And there was nothing lacking to them , neither small nor great , neither sons nor daughters , neither spoil , nor any thing that they had taken to them : David recovered all .
translation.kha: Ym don ei ei kaba jah . U Dabid u ïoh pat ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei baroh jong ki briew jong u , bad ïa ki mar lute baroh ba ki Amalek ki la kit .
Nangta la u shim ïa u khynnah rit bad pynïeng ïa u ha khmat jong ki . U la ïa buh la ki kti sawdong jong u bad u la ong ïa ki ,
translation.en: And he took a child , and set him in the midst of them : and when he had taken him in his arms , he said unto them ,

translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ka jingkular namar ba ki la kyntait ïa ki hukum jong nga , la ki pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad , ki la pyntngit ïa ka Sabbaton — ki la kham jied mane ban ïa ki bleithaw .
translation.en: Because they despised my judgments , and walked not in my statutes , but polluted my sabbaths : for their heart went after their idols .

And it came to pass , before he had done speaking , that , behold , Rebekah came out , who was born to Bethuel , son of Milcah , the wife of Nahor , Abraham s brother , with her pitcher upon her shoulder .
translation.kha: Shuwa ban kut ka jingduwai , ka Rebekka ka la wan poi bad u khiew um ha la ka tyrpeng . Ka dei ka khun jong u Bethuel , uba long u khun jong ka Milkah bad u Nahor , uba shi para bad u Abraham .
U Joab u ong ïa jingshakri , Ephron phi Klaudia ba ki Syria kurat jop ïa nga , wan bad ïarap ïa nga , dkhot lada ki jingsynshar ki jop ïa phi , ngan leit ban put ïa phi .
translation.en: And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me , then thou shalt help me : but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee , then I will help thee .
And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy  ; and he put us therein .
translation.kha: Hangta u rangbah pynïaidkam u la shem ïa ka lieng na Aleksandria kaba thmu ban leit sha Italy , kumta u la kyntiew ïa ngi ha ka .
Te ïathuh ïa ngi me dei uei , ki la ong . Ngi hap ban rah ïa ka jubab kito sha kiba la phah ïa ngi . Kumno me ong shaphang lade ïa ?
translation.en: Then said they unto him , Who art thou ? that we may give an answer to them that sent us . What sayest thou of thyself ?

And the cherubims lifted up their wings , and mounted up from the earth in my sight : when they went out , the wheels also were beside them , and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the  Lord s  house  ; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above .
translation.kha: Ki pynpyiar la ki thapniang bad kiew shajrong na ka khyndew katba nga dang peit ïa ki , bad ki shalyntem ki bud lang ïa ki . Ki sangeh shiphang ha ka phalor kaba shaphang mihngi ka Templ , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ ka shong halor jong ki .

translation.en: Thus they made a covenant at Beer–sheba : then Abimelech rose up , and Phichol the chief captain of his host , and they returned into the land of the Philistines .
