Ha ki hynñiew sngi jong kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , wat bam ïa uno uno u kpu ba la khleh thiat . Wat ju wan mane ïa nga khlem da wallam kano kano ka jingainguh .

translation.en: And Jesus , immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him , turned him about in the press , and said ,  Who touched my clothes ?
translation.kha: Mar kumta U Jisu u la tip ba ka bor ka la mihnoh na u , kumta u la phai sawdong sha u paidbah bad u la kylli ,  Mano ba la ktah ïa ki jaiñkup jong nga ?

translation.en: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought , and the rock is removed out of his place .
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi haba ki lumbah ki twa bad ki mawsiang baskhem ki kynriah noh .
Hadien kata , u Adam u la im sa phraspah snem .
translation.en: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years : and he begat sons and daughters :
And the servant said unto him , Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land : must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest ?
translation.kha: Hynrei uta u shakri u kylli ,  Kumno lada jia ba kata ka samla kam mon ban iehnoh ïa la ka ïing ban wan ryngkat bad nga sha kane ka ri ? Hato ngan phah noh ïa u khun jong phi sha kata ka ri na kaba phi wan ?

translation.en: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba U Blei u la pynpaw ha u Habakkuk u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it : Ahab went one way by himself , and Obadiah went another way by himself .
translation.kha: Ki la ïamynjur ïa kano ka bynta jong ka ri uwei uwei un leit wad , bad ki ïaleit sha la ka jong ka jong ka lad .

translation.en: These twelve Jesus sent forth , and commanded them , saying ,  Go not into the way of the Gentiles , and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not :
translation.kha: Ïa kine ki khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , U Jisu u la phah noh lem bad kine ki jingbthah harum :  Wat leit sha kano kano ka thain jong ki Jentil lane sha kano kano ka shnong ki nong Samaria .

translation.en: And when they had preached the gospel to that city , and had taught many , they returned again to Lystra , and to Iconium , and Antioch ,
translation.kha: U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha Derbe bad ki la ïoh bun ki synran . Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha Lystra , sha Ikoniom , bad nangta sha Antiokh kaba ha Pisidia .

U Esra u long u riewstad uba don ka jingtip bajylliew ïa ka Hukum kaba U Trai U ki Blei Israel u la ai ha u Moses . Namar ba Esra u u don ïa ka jingkyrkhu U Trai U Blei jong u , u patsha u ai kat ïa kaba u pan . ka Ha snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Artakserksis , u Esra u la mih na ban Babilonia leit sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad shi kynhun ki kiba Israel kynthup ïa ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi , ki nongput nongtem ka , Templ ki nongap ka phira Templ bad ki nongtrei .
translation.en: And there went up some of the children of Israel , and of the priests , and the Levites , and the singers , and the porters , and the Nethinims , unto Jerusalem , in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king .

My heart shall cry out for Moab  ; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar , an heifer of three years old : for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up  ; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka kyang jam namar ka Moab ! Ki briew ki la phet sha ki shnong jong ka Soar , bad sha ka Eglath Shelishiyah . Katto katne ki kiew ïa ka surok sha Luhith , ki da ïam haba ki leit ; katto katne ki lait phet sha Horanaim , ki da ïam sngewsih jam .
Wat pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng nga ka bynta ki jingthmu sniew , naba nga , U Trai U Blei phi , ngan pynshitom ïa uno uno pyndonkam thala ïa kyrteng jong nga .
translation.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the  Lord  thy God in vain  ; for the  Lord  will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain .
Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts ? or who hath given understanding to the heart ?
translation.kha: Mano ba ïathuh ïa ka ibis    lano ka wah Nile kan shlei um , lane mano ba ïathuh ïa u syiar ba u slap un sa hap ?

translation.en: And it was so , when Elijah heard it , that he wrapped his face in his mantle , and went out , and stood in the entering in of the cave . And , behold , there came a voice unto him , and said , What doest thou here , Elijah ?
translation.kha: Haba u Elijah u la ïohsngew ïa ka , u tap ïa la ka khmat da la ka barandi bad u leit ban ïeng ha khmat kata ka krem . Ka sur kaba kren ha u ,  Elijah , me leh aïu hangne ?

Ha khmih , nonglamktien u wan halor ki lumbah lem bad ka khubor kaba bha U don ha la ka lynti ban pynbna ïa jingjop ! Ko ki paid Judah , to ïa Jingkhawai Niam jong phi bad to ai ha U Blei kaba phi la kular kyntang u . U da lei ruh un hiarthma shuh ïa ka ri jong phi La pynjot ïa ki baroh !
translation.en: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace ! O Judah , keep thy solemn feasts , perform thy vows : for the wicked shall no more pass through thee  ; he is utterly cut off .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , nga la thung Hattush Jingïashun Israel bad ka Judah ; hynrei mynta nga byrngem ïa ki da ka sopkjat . Ki la wallam ïa kane halor jong ki hi namar ba ki la leh bakyrpang ; Pynkhlad la pynbitar dohnud nga da kaba ai ki jingkñia ha kram nongkren .
translation.en: For the  Lord  of hosts , that planted thee , hath pronounced evil against thee , for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah , which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal .

translation.kha: Ka snam ha dohksah shawkad kan long ka dak ban pyn-i ïa ïashun ïing ha kiba phi shong . Haba nga ïohi ïa kata ka snam , ngan ïaid lait na phi phrangsngi bad ngan jingïaseng ktah ïa phi haba nga pynshitom ïa ki nong Ijipt .
translation.en: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are : and when I see the blood , I will pass over you , and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you , when I smite the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U don sa ar ngut khun shynrang nalor u Shuthelah : u Eser u Elead kiba la shah pynïap haba ki la pyrshang ban tuh ïa ki jingri kiba dei ki traishnong jong ka Gath .
translation.en: And Zabad his son , and Shuthelah his son , and Ezer , and Elead , whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew , because they came down to take away their cattle .

Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold , and the silver for things of silver , and the brass for things of brass , the iron for things of iron , and wood for things of wood  ; onyx stones , and stones to be set , glistering stones , and of divers colours , and all manner of precious stones , and marble stones in abundance .
translation.kha: Nga la leh katba nga lah ban pynbiang ki tiar ki tar na ka bynta ka Templ — Ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , ki dieng , ki mawkordor , bad ki mawlynnai , ki maw na ka bynta ki jingthaw dur , bad shibun u maw marbl .

translation.en: For , lo , they are gone because of destruction : Egypt shall gather them up , Memphis shall bury them : the pleasant places for their silver , nettles shall possess them : thorns shall be in their tabernacles .
translation.kha: Haba ka jingjot ka wan bad ïa ki briew la pynsakma , ki nong Ijipt kin lumlang ïa ki — kin lumlang ïa ki ban tep hangta ha Memphis ! Ki jingdon jingem jong ki kum ka rupa bad ki jaka ha kaba ki ïing jong ki shisien ki la ïeng yn tap da ki ñiut bad ki bniap shiah .

translation.en: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves  ; and they said , The  Lord  is righteous .
translation.kha: U syiem bad ki nongïalam ki phla ba ki la leh pop , bad ki ong ,  Kaei kaba U  Trai  u leh ka long kaba shongnia .
Kane ka Jehubbah kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong Bakhrawbor Wallam ïa u paidbhur ban pynshyrkhei ïa Bisiothaïah bad ban lute ïa ki .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will bring up a company upon them , and will give them to be removed and spoiled .
And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward :
translation.kha: Ngi ong ïa kane namar ngi don ka jingsngewskhem ha U Blei lyngba U Khrist .

translation.en: The slave is faithful to Bible truths and to its commission to preach the good news , and it is discreet about how it wisely cares for Christ’s interests on earth .
translation.kha: U shakri u ngeit ïa ka jingshisha jong ka Baibl bad ïa ka hukum ban ïalap ïa ka khubor babha , bad u long uba stad ha kaban sumar ïa kiei kiei ki jong u Khrist ha pyrthei .
Moses u wan hiar bad u khot lang ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel bad ïathuh ha ki kaei kaei baroh kaba U Trai u la hukum ïa .
translation.en: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people , and laid before their faces all these words which the  Lord  commanded him .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad ki Israel ki rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai U ha Trai : Ngan rwai ha U Trai namar ka jingjop khraw kaba jong u ; sha duriaw u la bret ïa kulai ki bad ki nongshong kulai .
translation.en: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the  Lord  , and spake , saying , I will sing unto the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously : the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .

translation.kha: Wat bet ïa uwei pat u symbai ha kajuh ka bri ba phi thung dieng sohwaiñ ; lada leh kumta , phim lah ïa ki lane ïa u jong uta pat u jingthung
translation.en: Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with divers seeds : lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown , and the fruit of thy vineyard , be defiled .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la jubab , Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïathuh ïa ki jinglamler ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; ngam shym phah ïa ki , lymne ngam shym la ai kino kino hukum ki lane kren shikyntien ha ki . Ki jingïohipaw kiba ki ïakren kim wan shym na nga ; ki jingïathuh lypa ki kiei long kiei ki bymdondor kiba ki la mutdur .
translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , The prophets prophesy lies in my name : I sent them not , neither have I commanded them , neither spake unto them : they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination , and a thing of nought , and the deceit of their heart .

translation.kha: To kdew ïa kit lynti sha rangdajied set To phet ban lait im ! Wat ym pynslem ! U Trai u wallam ka jingjot sbiak ka jingpynjot kaba khraw na nongïada .
translation.en: Set up the standard toward Zion : retire , stay not : for I will bring evil from the north , and a great destruction .

translation.kha: Phi Kana ïa ka khubor riewhadem u la phah sha ki paid Israel , da pynshahshkor pynbna ïa proberb Khubor ïaphylliew jong ka jingsuk lyngba U Jisu pynphieng , uba long U Trai jong baroh .
translation.en: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel , preaching peace by Jesus Christ : ( he is Lord of all : )
And he made the table of shittim wood : two cubits was the length thereof , and a cubit the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof :
translation.kha: U shna ruh ïa ka miej da ka dieng akasia , kaba phraphew phra sentimitar ka lynter , sawphew saw sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .

translation.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei , and said unto him , Did I not make thee to swear by the  Lord  , and protested unto thee , saying , Know for a certain , on the day thou goest out , and walkest abroad any whither , that thou shalt surely die ? and thou saidst unto me , The word that I have heard is good .
translation.kha: u la phah khot ïa u bad u ong ,  Nga la pynlong ïa me ban smai ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ban ym mihnoh na Jerusalem . Bad nga la maham ïa me ba lada me leh kumta , men ïap da shisha . Hato mem shym la mynjur ïa ka bad ong ba men kohnguh ïa nga ?

Nangta lytar la Riphath phai pat sha ki lai ngut ki Julia bad u la shem ïa jar ba ki ïohthiah ; bad u ingmane ong ha u Elim pynkhriat jingkhlaiñ keiñ tyndong phi lai ngut phim shym lah pynbat ïa-ap lem bad nga wat tang shi kynta ?
translation.en: And he cometh unto the disciples , and findeth them asleep , and saith unto Peter ,  What , could ye not watch with me one hour ?

translation.kha: Te kumta , ko ki parabangeit jong nga ngi , don ka kamram kaba ngi dei ban leh , hynrei kam dei ïa ngi ban im kat kum ka jong jingkwah ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong ngi .
translation.en: Therefore , brethren , we are debtors , not to the flesh , to live after the flesh .
Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger , fatherless , and widow . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

U Korah u khun jong u Ishar na ka jait Lebi jong ïakiew Kohath , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jingïalam jong jingshongkurim Moses keiñ! La wan ïasoh lem bad u da Thiatira ngut ki dkhot na ka jait Reuben — u Dathan phret u Abiram , ki khun shynrang jong u Eliab , bad u On Basemath khun jong u Peleth — jingpynsah khatsaw jingdonburom ba-pura sanphew ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah Israel , ki nongïalam kiba pawkhmat ba la Harosheth-jong-ki-Jentil da basa kynhun .
translation.en: And they rose up before Moses , with certain of the children of Israel , two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly , famous in the congregation , men of renown :

translation.kha: Katno kiba suk ki long kito ki bym don jingartatien jong shaphang nga !
translation.en: And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Babilon la pynshitom namar ïa ka snam nongïathuhlypa bad jong ki briew jong U la shem hapoh ka nongbah ; ho-oid , ka snam kito baroh kiba la shah pynïap ha ka .
translation.en: And in her was found the blood of prophets , and of saints , and of all that were slain upon the earth .

translation.kha: Ki Binnui tep ïa u ha ka ri pynsngew jong u hi ha Timnath Serah pynkhynñiuh ka ri lum Ephraim , ha ka pei bashatei jong u Lum Gaash soh-ot
translation.en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath–serah , which is in mount Ephraim , on the north side of the hill of Gaash .

translation.kha: U nongsumar ïa u syiem Sedekaïah dei u u Seraïah , u khun jong u Neraïah bad u ksiew jong Mahseïah u . ka Ha snem kaba saw ba u Sedekaïah u long u syiem Judah ka , u Seraïah u dang leit sha Babilonia bad u , bad nga la ai ha u katto katne ki jingbthah .
translation.en: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah , the son of Maaseiah , when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign . And this Seraiah was a quiet prince .

translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u la pynkyntang ïa ki na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka jingmane , bad lem ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba la u kurup na ki jaitbynriew kiba u la jop —
translation.en: Which also king David did dedicate unto the  Lord  , with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued  ;

translation.kha: Nangta kpa la leit sha uwei pat u khun bad u la ïa kajuh ‘ Ho-oid , pa’ u la , hynrei um shym la leit .
translation.en: And he came to the second , and said likewise . And he answered and said , I go , sir : and went not .
And he set captains of war over the people , and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city , and spake comfortably to them , saying ,
translation.kha: U buh ïa baroh ki rangbah ha ka nongbah hapoh ka jingai hukum ki rangbah shipai bad u hukum ïa ki ban ïalumlang ha ka jaka kaba kylluid ha ka khyrdop ka nongbah .

translation.en: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again  ; one of his brethren may redeem him :
translation.kha: Hadien ba la die ïa u , pynban u dang don hi ka hok ban shah thied biang .

translation.en: And when he was come near , he beheld the city , and wept over it ,
translation.kha: U la poi kham jan sha ka nongbah , bad haba u la ïohi ïa ka , u la ïam na ka bynta jong ka , u da ong ,
Hynrei U u Jisu la ong ha kata ka briew , Ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynim ïa pha ; khie leit kaba ha suk .
translation.en: And he said to the woman ,  Thy faith hath saved thee  ; go in peace .
And Jesus , when he came out , saw much people , and was moved with compassion toward them , because they were as sheep not having a shepherd : and he began to teach them many things .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu la hiar na ka lieng , u la ïohi ïa une u paidbah babun , bad ïa ka mynsiem jong u la pyndap da ka jingsngewsynei ïa ki , namar ki la long kum ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai . Kumta u la sdang ban hikai bun kiei kiei ïa ki .
Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba thiah halor ki jingthiah baremdor , kiba ïakhawai da ki bad khunlangbrot !
translation.en: That lie upon beds of ivory , and stretch themselves upon their couches , and eat the lambs out of the flock , and the calves out of the midst of the stall  ;
He bowed the heavens also , and came down  ; and darkness was under his feet .
translation.kha: U tar ïa ka suiñbneng bad u wan hiar ; bad u lyoh uba dum hapoh ki kjat jong u .
Mar ïadep jongki ïa kane , ki ïa-pyndap tlot jong u Dabid ki Athens rung ; ki la Dorkas ban bunktien , Kir u Dabid lem bad ki rangbah synshar Baalath u ruh ki la ïa-ïam kthang Jeremaïah
translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as he had made an end of speaking , that , behold , the king s sons came , and lifted up their voice and wept : and the king also and all his servants wept very sore .

translation.kha: To ïa u briew tlot ha ka jingngeit hynrei wat ïania bad u ki bashimet jong u .
translation.en: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye , but not to doubtful disputations .

translation.kha: U shakri uba la ïohpdiang san hajar tylli ki sbai u la leit shisyndon bad u la khaïi ïa ka la pisa bad u la sa ïohnong san hajar .
translation.en: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same , and made them other five talents .
For the work of a man shall he render unto him , and cause every man to find according to his ways .
translation.kha: U ai bainong ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba ki leh bad u leh ha ki kat kum kaba ki dei hok .

translation.en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil : his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes .
translation.kha: Ki briew ba-bymman ki kwah borabor ïa kaba sniew ; kim don jingisynei ïano ïano ruh .

Katto katne ngut ki bad Philistia ki Arab ki shong ki sah hajan ka jaka ha kaba katto ngut katne ki nong Sudan ki la shongduh harud ka duriaw . U Trai u pynkhih la ïa ki ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u Jehoram .
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines , and of the Arabians , that were near the Ethiopians :

translation.kha: Kane , la kumno ïapom Methuselah kam jingmut! ka rukom ban ba-halor hapdeng jong phi Kadesh Lada uwei na phi u kwah ban Merodakh uba khraw , u mynta ban long u shakri ïa kiwei pat jingtngen
translation.en: But it shall not be so among you : but whosoever will be great among you , let him be your minister  ;
And Jesus said ,  I am : and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power , and coming in the clouds of heaven .
translation.kha: Nga long ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  bad phin ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew uba shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Badonbor Baroh bad ba u wan ha ki lyoh jong ka bneng !
Ban pyndonburom U Blei long ban isih ïa kaba sniew nga isih ïa ka jingsarong bad ka jingsngewmeng , ïa ki lynti bymman bad ki ktien lamler .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is to hate evil : pride , and arrogancy , and the evil way , and the froward mouth , do I hate .

translation.kha: jingong U Jisu Don la sangeh bad u dkhoh hukum tyrtho wallam sha u ïa u briew uba matlah . ar ksang la wan nar-khang , Shemiramoth Jisu pynjahburom la kylli ïa u ,
translation.en: And Jesus stood , and commanded him to be brought unto him : and when he was come near , he asked him ,

translation.kha: Mynta u kitkhlieh ban ïarap bad ïada Jehoba nga .
translation.en: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede , even I , stood to confirm and to strengthen him .
And when he saw their faith , he said unto him ,  Man , thy sins are forgiven thee .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingngeit ki la don , u la ong ha uta u briew ,  La map ïa ki pop jong me , ko paralok jong nga .
Ha ka step kaba bud U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: And in the morning came the word of the  Lord  unto me , saying ,
And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies  lands  ; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them .
translation.kha: Katto katne na phi kiba dang lait im ha ka ri ki nongshun jong phi kin nang ringswai namar ka pop jong phi bad ka jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: Ye are my brethren , ye are my bones and my flesh : wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king ?
translation.kha: Phi dei ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga , ki para doh ki para snam jong nga ; balei phin dei kiba khatduh ban ïalam pat ïa nga ?

U Blei u la phah ïa nga kum u nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki briew jong u ki Israel . La katta ruh shano shano ba nga leit , pyrshang phi riam ban ïa nga ïa kum ka sim . Wat ha ka Templ U Blei , ki briew ki dei ki nongshun jong nongïathuhlypa u .
translation.en: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God : but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways , and hatred in the house of his God .
Behold , I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions , and over all the power of the enemy : and nothing shall by any means hurt you .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ! Nga la ai ha phi ka bor , khnang ba phi lah ban ïaid halor ki bseiñ bad ki  ñianglartham bad jop ïa ka bor baroh jong u Nongshun , bad ym don kano kano ka ban pynmynsaw ïa phi .

translation.en: Therefore I write these things being absent , lest being present I should use sharpness , according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification , and not to destruction .
translation.kha: Kata ka long balei ba nga thoh ïa kane katba nga dang don jngai na phi ; ka long kumta ba haba nga poi ngan ym hap ban leh tyngeh ha kaba pyndonkam ïa ka iktiar ïa kaba U Trai u la ai ha nga — ka bor ïa ka ban tei ïa phi , ym ïa ka ban pynpra .
Ki briew Khra-pait thaw jingwad ïa kiwei pat kin ngat ïa lade . Baibl briew kiba sdang pynhap khyndew nongshong shah on ïa lade .
translation.en: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein : and he that rolleth a stone , it will return upon him .

translation.kha: Ki Israel baroh ki ban shong hynñiew sngi ha ki ïingtrep ,
translation.en: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days  ; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths :

translation.kha: U la phah pynïap ïa u Jakob , u para u jong Ïoannis , da ka waitlam .
translation.en: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword .
I thank my God always on your behalf , for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ ;
translation.kha: Nga ainguh borabor ïa U Blei jong nga na ka bynta jong phi namar kata ka jingaiei ïa kaba u la ai ha phi da U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold , and make their rings of gold for places for the bars : and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold .
translation.kha: Suit ksiar ïa kita ki jingker , bad pyndait ha ki ïa ki kyrwoh ksiar ban bat ïa ki diengkhap . Suit ksiar ruh ïa kita ki diengkhap .
jingot baroh ka la shim por kumba sawspah ba-mutlop Shemer . kdang kane u la ai ha ki ïa ki nongbishar haduh ka por jong jingpynshong kyrni u nongïathuhlypa shongthait
translation.en: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years , until Samuel the prophet .
For he taught his disciples , and said unto them ,  The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men , and they shall kill him  ; and after that he is killed , he shall rise the third day .
translation.kha: Ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa ai noh ha ki briew ki ban pynïap ïa u . Pynban hadien lai sngi , un sa mihpat .
Namar ym la shym pynhun pha ïa da kiwei , pha la leit bud nadien ki nong Assyria . Pha la long ka nuti jong ki , hynrei ki ruh kim shym la pynhun ïa pha .
translation.en: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians , because thou wast unsatiable  ; yea , thou hast played the harlot with them , and yet couldest not be satisfied .

translation.kha: U Sebulun un shong harud duriaw ; Ka shong jong u kan ka jakarieh ïa ki liengbah , Bad ka khyndew ka shyiap u kan ïar
translation.en: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea  ; and he shall be for an haven of ships  ; and his border shall be unto Zidon .

translation.kha: Pynbna paidbah ïa kine Jingkhawai ki Niam ha ki por ba la buh ban pynlong ïa ki .
translation.en: These are the feasts of the  Lord  , even holy convocations , which ye shall proclaim in their seasons .
The Revelation of Jesus Christ , which God gave unto him , to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass  ; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John :
translation.kha: Kane ka kitab ka long ka jingbuh jingthoh ïa ki jingjia kiba U Jisu Khrist u la pynpaw . U Blei u la ai ha u ïa kane ka jingpynpaw khnang ban pyn-i ha ki shakri jong u ïa kaei kaba dei ban jia shen . U Khrist u la pynlong ïa kine kiei kiei ban tip da u shakri jong u , u Ïoannis da kaba phah ïa la u angel sha u ,

translation.en: And I said unto her , Thou shalt abide for me many days  ; thou shalt not play the harlot , and thou shalt not be for another man : so will I also be for thee .
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa ka ba ka dei ban ap slem ïa nga khlem da leh nuti lane klim ; bad ha kane ka por ngan ïai ap ïa ka .

translation.en: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na ngi , u la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingai bakyrpang kat kum ka jingthew ïa kaei kaba U Khrist u la ai .
Kata ka briew ka la ong ha saisaw jinglaitluid Almon tip ba U Messaïah un sa wan jingpynïasuk bad haba u wan , un sa ïathuh ha jingpynpur ïa kiei kiei baroh .
translation.en: The woman saith unto him , I know that Messias cometh , which is called Christ : when he is come , he will tell us all things .

translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kaei ka ban pynshisha ïa kata ha phi : Phin ïa shem u khunlung uba la sop da ki jaiñsop bad uba thiah ha shyngoid ka .
translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto you  ; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes , lying in a manger .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la Napdeng ha nga saw ngut Huldah nongtrei iaisah don bad ki tyrnem .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shewed me four carpenters .

translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong la lwet , bad nga la khynñiuh . jong U Trai , namar ki ktien kiba khuid jong u , ba nga la long kum u briew uba uba la dih eh ka .
translation.en: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets  ; all my bones shake  ; I am like a drunken man , and like a man whom wine hath overcome , because of the  Lord  , and because of the words of his holiness .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba u Shebat ) , U Trai u la nga khubor ha ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet .
translation.en: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month , which is the month Sebat , in the second year of Darius , came the word of the  Lord  unto Zechariah , the son of Berechiah , the son of Iddo the prophet , saying ,
Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering ; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance ?
translation.kha: Lane lehse phi ibeiñ ïa ka jingsbun bakhraw jong u , ka jingshah laitluid , bad ka jingïaishah . Da shisha phi tip ba U Blei u long uba sbun , namar u pyrshang ban ïalam ïa phi ban kylla-kaba-mut .
To ïalam ïa ki nongap phira , u la ong ïa ki , leit to pynskhem ïa ka jingtep kat kaba phi
translation.en: Pilate said unto them , Ye have a watch : go your way , make it as sure as ye can .

This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly , that said in her heart , I am , and there is none beside me : how is she become a desolation , a place for beasts to lie down in ! every one that passeth by her shall hiss , and wag his hand .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kaei ka ban jia ïa ka nongbah kaba sarong katta katta ïa la ka bor bad kaba pyrkhat ba ka don ha ka jingshngain . Ki briew jong ka ki pyrkhat ba ka nongbah jong ki ka long kaba khraw tam ha ka pyrthei . Katno kan long ka jaka kaba kynjah , ka jaka ha kaba ki mradkhlaw kin pynjahthait ! Uwei uwei baroh uba ïaid lyngba jong ka un kynran dien ha ka jingsheptieng .
u briew u ba jingngeit u ban bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam : U wei pat u , u bam da ki jhur .
translation.en: For one believeth that he may eat all things : another , who is weak , eateth herbs .
And the princes said unto them , Let them live  ; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation  ; as the princes had promised them .
translation.kha: To ai kin im , hynrei kin dei ban long ki nongthoh dieng bad ki nongtong um na ka bynta jong ngi .  Kane ka long kaei kaba ki nongïalam ki la ai jingmut .

translation.en: Thou prevailest for ever against him , and he passeth : thou changest his countenance , and sendest him away .
translation.kha: Me pynduhbor ïa u briew bad phah noh ïa u junom ; ka durkhmat jong u ka sniew dur ha ka por ka jingïap .

translation.en: And I commanded you at that time , saying , The  Lord  your God hath given you this land to possess it : ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel , all that are meet for the war .
translation.kha: Nangta nga ai ruh ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah : ‘ U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la ai ïa kane ka ri kaba sha mihngi na Jordan ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka . Mynta pat , pynkieng atiar ïa ki rangïapom jong phi bad phah ïa ki sha shiliang ka Jordan ha shuwa kiwei pat ki jait Israel ban ïarap ïa ki ban ïohkynti ïa ka bynta jong ki de .
Hynrei mynta phi sngewsarong bad phi kyr-eit baroh ; kata kaba phi kyr-eit ka long kaba bakla .
translation.en: But now ye rejoice in your boastings : all such rejoicing is evil .
And the barrel of meal wasted not , neither did the cruse of oil fail , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Elijah .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la kular lyngba u Elijah , ka pliang  purew kam shym la thylli lymne u klong um shym long khlem umphniang .

translation.en: The proverbs of Solomon . A wise son maketh a glad father : but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki proberb u Solomon : U khun uba stad u pynsngew sarong ïa la u jong u kpa ; uba bieit u wallam ka jingsngewsih ïa la ka kmie .

i-ieit briew jong nga ki Ephai Lot ïa u kew , hynrei ki la lum Holy ki ñiut ; pop! la trei shitom , hynrei kim shym ïoh ei ei na ka bynta kata . Namar ka jingbitar shla lakh nga ki jingthung jong ki kim shym long .
translation.en: They have sown wheat , but shall reap thorns : they have put themselves to pain , but shall not profit : and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the  Lord .
In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah , which is before Mamre , in the land of Canaan , which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace .
translation.kha: ha Makhpelah kaba sha mihngi na Mamre ha ka ri Kanaan . U Abraham u la thied ïa kane ka krem lem bad ka lyngkha u Ephron ban pynlong jaka tep ïa ka .

translation.en: ( For my father fought for you , and adventured his life far , and delivered you out of the hand of Midian :
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba i pa jong nga i la ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi . I la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ban pyllait im ïa phi na ki Midian .

translation.en: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah khyndai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .

translation.en: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in , a settled place for thee to abide in for ever .
translation.kha: Mynta nga la tei ïa ka Templ kaba khraw na ka bynta jong me , ka jaka na ka bynta jong me ba men shong junom la junom .

U Joseph u ong , O Timotheus em ! da lei lei ngan ym leh kumta jah Tang uta keiñ ha jingduh la shem ïa ka khuri un long u hikai jong nga lyngktop Kiwei Nangne iap phi ki lah ban leit phai suk sha la u kpa .
translation.en: And he said , God forbid that I should do so : but the man in whose hand the cup is found , he shall be my servant  ; and as for you , get you up in peace unto your father .

translation.kha: U la rah ïa nga kham pynkular jan bymriewblei bad nga la ïohi ïa uwei u briew uba phyrnai kum ka rnong . U bat ha ka kti ïa u ïa-ïoh uba jingshemphang ka jaiñ linen bad ïa u phra bad jinglwet ïeng hajan karai khyrdop Diamond
translation.en: And he brought me thither , and , behold , there was a man , whose appearance was like the appearance of brass , with a line of flax in his hand , and a measuring reed  ; and he stood in the gate .
( Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures , )
translation.kha: Ïa ka Khubor Babha la kular la slem bah da U Blei lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u , kumba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid .

translation.en: Soon , though , an amazing event will take place .
translation.kha: Hynrei satang katto katne kein , ka jingjia kaba phylla kan sa wan jia .

translation.en: And upon this came his disciples , and marvelled that he talked with the woman : yet no man said , What seekest thou ? or , Why talkest thou with her ?
translation.kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat ki synran jong u Jisu ki la wan phai , bad ki la lyngngoh shikatdei eh ban lap ïa u ba u ïakren bad kata ka briew . Hynrei ym don na ki uba la ong ïa ka ,  Pha kwah aïu ?  lane uba la kylli ïa u ,  Balei ba me ïakren bad ka ?

translation.en: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel , that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea u khun jong u Elah kum u syiem ka Israel , u Hesekaïah u khun jong u Ahas u long u syiem ka Judah

translation.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes  ; why then should I think upon a maid ?
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang ban nym khmih da ka jingkwah brai ïa ka kynthei .
To U Trai un ki khun phi ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong !
translation.en: The  Lord  shall increase you more and more , you and your children .

translation.kha: Bad tharai u paralok jong phi un jubab napoh , ïing ‘ Wat pynwit ïa nga ! ka Ïa jingkhang la lah khang , bad ma nga lem bad ki khun jong nga ngi la thiah . Ngam lah ban khie bad ai ei ei phi ha .’
translation.en: And he from within shall answer and say , Trouble me not : the door is now shut , and my children are with me in bed  ; I cannot rise and give thee .

translation.kha: Kane ka jingrakhe ka long ka jingpynkynmaw kum kaba la teh ka kti jong ngi ne ha ka ; kan pynkynmaw ïa ngi ba U Trai u la ïalam noh ïa na ka ri Ijipt da ka borbah u .’
translation.en: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand , and for frontlets between thine eyes : for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought us forth out of Egypt .
Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt , which thou wast afraid of  ; and they shall cleave unto thee .
translation.kha: Un pynngat ha phi sa shisien ïa ki jingpang kiba sngewshyrkhei , kiba phi la mad ha Ijipt , bad phin ym ïohkhiah .

, kumba u Joshua u la hukum , kynhun shipai ka la ïaid ha shuwa ki lyngdoh kiba put ïa turoi ; hadien jong kine bud sa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Jutang U Trai , kiba la bud pat ka kynhun shipai shadien Ha ki por baroh la put ïa ki turoi .
translation.en: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets , and the rearward came after the ark , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .
And I will make thy windows of agates , and thy gates of carbuncles , and all thy borders of pleasant stones .
translation.kha: Ngan tei ïa ki kut jong pha da ki maw Rubi , ïa ki khyrdop jong pha da ki maw kiba rhem kum ka ding , bad ki kynroh sawdong jong pha da ki mawlynnai .
Lynthem ïajan Sithri u haduh ba un da ïap ! U la pyrshang ban khring noh ïa phi na U Nga U Blei jong phi , uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri ïa-ïeng , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
translation.en: And thou shalt stone him with stones , that he die  ; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .

translation.kha: Ngan ym shah shuh ba kan dang kren ïa kyrteng ka u Baal .
translation.en: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth , and they shall no more be remembered by their name .
I fast twice in the week , I give tithes of all that I possess .
translation.kha: Nga shahjingit ar sien shi taïew , bad nga ai ha me kawei na ki shiphew jong ki jingïoh jong nga baroh .’

translation.en: And he said unto her ,  Daughter , be of good comfort : thy faith hath made thee whole  ; go in peace .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Ko khun jong nga , ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynkhiah ïa pha . Khie leit ha kaba suk .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron , Because ye believed me not , to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel , therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la sneng tyngeh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron . U ong  Namar ba phim don ka jingngeit kaba skhem ban pynpaw ïa ka bor bakhuid jong nga ha khmat ki paid Israel , phin ym ïoh ban ïalam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki .

translation.en: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board , and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board .
translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka jingker kan long saw mitar ka lynter bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang ,
Bad kumta ka khubor shaphang u Jisu ka la phriang stet ka ka Galilaïa .
translation.en: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee .
Ye Ethiopians also , ye shall be slain by my sword .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynïap ruh ïa ki briew jong ka Sudan .

Bad nga la ïa ïohi ka Nongbah Bakhuid , ka Jerusalem bathymmai , da kaba wan hiar na bneng na U Blei , kaba la pynkhreh bad kaba la kloi , kum ka nongleitkurim kaba la riam ïashem ban ïa u tnga jong ka .
translation.en: And I John saw the holy city , new Jerusalem , coming down from God out of heaven , prepared as a bride adorned for her husband .

translation.kha: Ki ïing kin dap ki mar kiba bha kiba phim shym la buh hangta bad don ki kiba phim shym la tih , bad ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Olib phim shym la thung . U Trai u ïalam ïa sha kata ka ri phi ïoh kat ïa kaba phi kwah ban bam ,
translation.en: And houses full of all good things , which thou filledst not , and wells digged , which thou diggedst not , vineyards and olive trees , which thou plantedst not  ; when thou shalt have eaten and be full  ;

translation.kha: Bad baroh kob-pia nongïathuhlypa kiba la don ka khubor manbriew kynthup ïa u Samuel bad kito kiba mih hadien jong pyniwtung , pynnoh la pynbna ruh ïa kaei jingbymïaineh la jia ha Rehabaïah ki 18 .
translation.en: Yea , and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after , as many as have spoken , have likewise foretold of these days .
And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish , for whom Christ died ?
translation.kha: Bad kumta une u briew uba tlot , u parabangeit ïa uba U Khrist u la ïap , un jot noh namar kata  ka jingtip  jong phi !
U lyngdoh un ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ha ka duwan ban pynkhuid ïa phi na ka pop jong phi ; bad yn sa map .
translation.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly , when he sinneth by ignorance before the  Lord  , to make an atonement for him  ; and it shall be forgiven him .
( 1 Samuel 1 :12 , 13 ) It is good to find a quiet place away from other people to say our personal prayers .—Mark 1 :35 .
translation.kha: ( 1 Samuel 1 :12 , 13 ) Kan kham bha lada ngi duwai ha ki jaka ba kynjah ha kaba ym don ba pynwit ïa ngi .—Markos 1 :35 .
Uno uno ïa uba ban lah shaniah ha kiei kiei kiba rit un long uba lah ban shaniah ha kiba kham khraw ; uno uno uba leh bymhok kiei ha kiei kiba rit un long u bymhok ha kiba kham khraw .
translation.en: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much : and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much .
For if ye forgive men their trespasses , your heavenly Father will also forgive you :
translation.kha: Namar lada phi map ïa kiwei ïa ki jingpalat kiba ki la leh ïa phi , U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un map ruh ïa phi .
U Moses u leit hiar na uta u lum , u ïa kita ki ar tylli ki ha kiba thoh ïa hukum ha baroh arliang .
translation.en: And Moses turned , and went down from the mount , and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand : the tables were written on both their sides  ; on the one side and on the other were they written .

translation.kha: Na Rehum , u lat , u Shimshai , u sekretari jong probins , na ki paralok jong ki , bad na baroh ki kiwei pat ki synshar , kiba long ki rangbah traishnong Erekh , Babilon bad Susa ha ka ri ,
translation.en: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor , and Shimshai the scribe , and the rest of their companions  ; the Dinaites , the Apharsathchites , the Tarpelites , the Apharsites , the Archevites , the Babylonians , the Susanchites , the Dehavites , and the Elamites ,

And unto Abiathar the priest said the king , Get thee to Anathoth , unto thine own fields  ; for thou art worthy of death : but I will not at this time put thee to death , because thou barest the ark of the Lord  God  before David my father , and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted .
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u ong ha u Abiathar u lyngdoh ,  Khie leit sha la ka jong ka ri ha Anathoth . Me dei hok ban ïap , hynrei ngan ym phah pynïap ïa me mynta , namar ba me la khmih sumar ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U  Trai  mynba me dang don bad u Dabid , u kpa jong nga , bad me la ïoh bynta lem ha ki jingjynjar jong u baroh .
Kaei ken kane ? Ngan da ka mynsiem jong nga hynrei ngan rwai da ka jingmut jong nga ; ngan da la ka mynsiem , hynrei ngan rwai ruh jingmut jong nga .
translation.en: What is it then ? I will pray with the spirit , and I will pray with the understanding also : I will sing with the spirit , and I will sing with the understanding also .
The princes refrained talking , and laid their hand on their mouth .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong u paidbah kin sangeh noh na kaba kren ;
Em ! Ngi ngeit bad la ïa ngi da ka jingaiei jong U Trai Jisu , kumba long ma ki .
translation.en: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved , even as they .

And Rebekah said to Isaac , I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth : if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth , such as these which are of the daughters of the land , what good shall my life do me ?
translation.kha: Ka Rebekka ka ong ha u Isaak ,  Nga la sngewngiah bad sngewthait ïa ki tnga nongwei jong u Iso . Lada u Jakob ruh u shongkurim ïa kawei na kine ki nong Hit , nga lah ban sa shu ïap noh ruh .

translation.en: He shall not be rich , neither shall his substance continue , neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth .
translation.kha: Un ym ïailong slem uba riewspah ; ym don kaba dei ka jong u ka ban neh .

translation.en: And he said , Draw not nigh hither : put off thy shoes from off thy feet , for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground .
translation.kha: Wat wan sha jan ,  ong U Blei .  Loit noh ïa la ki juti , namar me ïeng ha ka jaka kaba khuid .
Wat pyrkhat ba narud wallam ïa ki briew jong Resin mohkhiew jingïasngewtynnat jingsuh kha bad khlem Joktan ban kha ïa ki . U Trai pynkitkhlieh la kren ksiang
translation.en: Shall I bring to the birth , and not cause to bring forth ? saith the  Lord  : shall I cause to bring forth , and shut the womb ? saith thy God .
And he coupled five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves .
translation.kha: Ki bteng lang san tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba kin long tang kawei shi sut jingtap , bad ki leh kumjuh ïa ki hynriew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah .

translation.en: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful , and I will make nations of thee , and kings shall come out of thee .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew , bad katto katne na ki , kin long ki syiem . Men ïoh shibun ki khun ki ksiew kiba yn sa long ki jaitbynriew .
ka ri jong ki Gebal , ka pynïabiang baroh shaphang mihngi , naduh Rohgah , kaba don shaphang hi jong u Lum Hermon , haduh ka Khim Hamath .
translation.en: And the land of the Giblites , and all Lebanon , toward the sunrising , from Baal–gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath .
And the woman conceived , and sent and told David , and said , I am with child .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , ka la shem ba ka la punkhun bad ka phah ktien sha u Dabid ban ïathuh ïa u .

translation.en: And Saul commanded his servants , saying , Commune with David secretly , and say , Behold , the king hath delight in thee , and all his servants love thee : now therefore be the king s son in law .
translation.kha: U hukum ïa la ki rangbah synshar ban ïakren jar jar bad u Dabid bad ban ïathuh ha u ,  U syiem u shem sngewbha ïa phi bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ki sngewtynnat ïa phi ; mynta ka dei ka por kaba biang ba phin shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u .

translation.en: Set the trumpet to thy mouth . He shall come as an eagle against the house of the  Lord  , because they have transgressed my covenant , and trespassed against my law .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Pynsawa ïa ka jingmaham ! Ki nongshun ki hiar kynsan shapoh ha ka ri jong nga kum ki pukni ! Ki briew jong nga ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la ïateh bad ki , bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jinghikai jong nga .

translation.en: And he judged Israel twenty and three years , and died , and was buried in Shamir .
translation.kha: U la long u nongïalam jong ki Israel haduh arphew lai snem . Nangta u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Shamir .

translation.en: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites , even unto Zarephath  ; and the captivity of Jerusalem , which is in Sepharad , shall possess the cities of the south .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun kiba shah ringmraw na ka Israel bashatei kan wan phai bad jop ïa ka Phoenisia jngai bah shaphang shatei haduh ka Sarephath . Kiba shah ringmraw na Jerusalem kiba don ha Sardis kin kurup ïa ki shnong jong ka Judah bashathie .
