translation.kha: U Blei u la theh noh kyrhai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ngi lyngba U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim jong ngi ,

translation.en: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind , and a covert from the tempest  ; as rivers of water in a dry place , as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na ki un long kum ka jingkah na ka lyer bad ka jaka ban rieh na ki  erïong . Kin long kum ki wahduid kiba tuid ha ka ri shyiap , kum ka jingkah syrngiew u mawsiang bah ha ka ri shrah .

U la ong ha nga , Bad mynta ko Daniel to khylliap ïa ka kitab bad shon muhor jong ka haduh ka jingkut jong ka pyrthei kajuh , kiba bun ki briew kin pynlehnoh-ei ïa ki jingpyrshang jong ki ban sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba jia .
translation.en: But thou , O Daniel , shut up the words , and seal the book , even to the time of the end : many shall run to and fro , and knowledge shall be increased .

translation.kha: Nangta ki jingmudui jong Sakkur ki la ong ha dait , Mynta te me kren shai kdar , khlem pyndonkam ïa ki rukom kren bapher .
translation.en: His disciples said unto him , Lo , now speakest thou plainly , and speakest no proverb .

translation.kha: U Jakob , olib ïa-ong , bad u Ïoannis ïa-ithuh kiba i ba ki Pelusium ki nongïalam , ki la tip ba U Blei u la kin ha nga Katholik sait mawleiñ lynti! bakyrpang ; kumta ki la ïakhublei kti ïa u mawdong jingbymngeit sawphew ïa nga de , kum ka jingkutlad ba ngi ïalong baroh ki nongïatrei lang . Ngi la ïamynjur ba u Barnabas phyllaw nga , ngin ïatrei hapdeng :1-5 Jentil , bad ki pat hapdeng ki Jiw .
translation.en: And when James , Cephas , and John , who seemed to be pillars , perceived the grace that was given unto me , they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship ; that we should go unto the heathen , and they unto the circumcision .
Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world .
translation.kha: Kumta ong U Trai , uba la pyntip ïa kane slem bah mynshuwa .’
Hynrei to long ka jingnguh U Blei , uba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingjop thiaw lyngba U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi !
translation.en: But thanks be to God , which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ .
And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament  ; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam kiba stad kin tyngshaiñ da ka jingphyrnai baroh jong ka suiñbneng . Bad kito kiba la hikai ïa kiba bun ki briew ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei kin tyngshaiñ kum ki khlur junom .
Uno uno ayu briew um dei Rhesa pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa Kumta kaba u ïathiah Semaraim bad shrak na ki tnga u kpa jong u .
translation.en: A man shall not take his father s wife , nor discover his father s skirt .

translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la jubab , Nga pynbaptis da ka um , hynrei hapdeng jong phi uwei don uba ïeng uba phim ithuh .
translation.en: John answered them , saying , I baptize with water : but there standeth one among you , whom ye know not  ;
And yet indeed she is my sister  ; she is the daughter of my father , but not the daughter of my mother  ; and she became my wife .
translation.kha: Ma ka , ka long shisha ka para jong nga . Ka dei ka khun jong u kpa jong nga , hynrei ym ka khun jong ka kmie jong nga ; bad nga la shongkurim ïa ka .

U ïano ban wallam shapoh ïa ki myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , ki nongpeit kti . Haba ki ïawan shapoh , syiem u la ong ha ki , Ïa uno uno uba lah ban pule ïa ka jingthoh bad ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingmut jong ka yn pynphong ha ki jaiñkup syiem kiba sawbthuh , un deng u kynjri ksiar jingpyndonburom sawdong ryndang jong u bad un long ka bor hapoh ka hima .
translation.en: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers , the Chaldeans , and the soothsayers . And the king spake , and said to the wise men of Babylon , Whosoever shall read this writing , and shew me the interpretation thereof , shall be clothed with scarlet , and have a chain of gold about his neck , and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom .
When Jethro , the priest of Midian , Moses  father in law , heard of all that God had done for Moses , and for Israel his people , and that the  Lord  had brought Israel out of Egypt  ;
translation.kha: U Jethro , u lyngdoh ka Midian , u kthaw kurim u Moses , u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la leh na ka bynta u Moses bad ki paid Israel mynba u la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies  ; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months .
translation.kha: Ïa u mradkhlaw la shah ban pynlong ki jingkob sarong kiba long ki jingbeiñ ïa U Blei , bad la shah ïa u ban don ka bor synshar haduh sawphew ar bnai .
ka Jesreel , ka Jokdeam ka ,
translation.en: And Jezreel , and Jokdeam , and Zanoah ,

translation.kha: Nga tip ba phi mon sngewbha ban ïarap bad nga , la kob sarong ïa phi ha ki briew ha Makedonia . Ki parabangeit ha Akhaïa nga la ong , la ki kloi ban ïarap naduh ka snem kaba la dep . Ka jinglong ba la kloi jong ka phi la pynkhih ïa kiba bun na ki .
translation.en: For I know the forwardness of your mind , for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia , that Achaia was ready a year ago ; and your zeal hath provoked very many .

translation.kha: Nga jingarsap ïa phi da ka um ban pyn-i ba phi la kylla-kaba-mut , hynrei uta uba wan hadien jong nga jingkhein pynbaptis ïa jinglehshitom da U Mynsiem Bakhuid jingpynhiar da jingdoh ding . U long uba kham khraw baieit ïa nga ; thapniang ngam long uba bit wat tang ban rah ïa ki Tubal khohram u .
translation.en: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance : but he that cometh after me is mightier than I , whose shoes I am not worthy to bear : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost , and with fire :
And Hazar–shual , and Beer–sheba , and Bizjothjah ,
translation.kha: ka Hasar Shual , ka Beersheba , ka Bisiothaïah ,
bad khang phi na kaba leh ïa ka bymdei sumar ïa na briew kiba pynkhih jingkulmar da kaei ki kren —
translation.en: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man , from the man that speaketh froward things  ;

translation.kha: Wat bud ïa rukom im briew ha ri Ijipt , ha phi ruh shisien phi la shong , ne ïa ki jong briew ha Kanaan , sha kaba ngan ïalam ïa phi .
translation.en: After the doings of the land of Egypt , wherein ye dwelt , shall ye not do : and after the doings of the land of Canaan , whither I bring you , shall ye not do : neither shall ye walk in their ordinances .
And as I was considering , behold , an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth , and touched not the ground : and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang lyngngoh aïu kane ka mut , u  langsohmoh u la wan mareh na shaphang sepngi , u da mareh stet eh ba ki kjat jong u kim shym kynduh khyndew . U la don tang kawei ka reng hapdeng ki khmat jong u .

translation.en: Tribulation and anguish , upon every soul of man that doeth evil , of the Jew first , and also of the Gentile ;
translation.kha: Yn don ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpang na ka bynta kito baroh kiba leh ïa kaei kaba sniew , na ka bynta ki Jiw nyngkong bad na ka bynta ki Jentil ruh .

translation.en: The king s favour is toward a wise servant : but his wrath is against him that causeth shame .
translation.kha: Ki syiem ki sngewtynnat ïa ki rangbah synshar kiba lah , hynrei ki pynshitom ïa kito kiba pynlehrain ïa ki .

Ha khmat ki paralok jong u bad ki shipai Samaria u ong , Rephael , Kumta bnai Jiw shem-lanot , sepngi Baana ba ki leh ? Hato Judah pyrkhat Apelles da jingri jingkñia jingainguh ki lah ban pyndep Pyrkhat ka Hammath ha ka shi sngi ? Hato ki lah ban pynlong ïa ki maw jingtei na ki kynton jong ki Tertios Hophni la ing ?
translation.en: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria , and said , What do these feeble Jews ? will they fortify themselves ? will they sacrifice ? will they make an end in a day ? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned ?

translation.kha: Ngam bitar shuh ïa ka Ïalap sohwaiñ . Tang lada ki don ki shiah pynjlan ki Kato buid ban hap ban ïakhun pyrshah , te Uei thang ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: Fury is not in me : who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle ? I would go through them , I would burn them together .

translation.kha: Haba wanrah ïa bha sha U Trai , phim long kiba haba phi bam ïa ka . Hynrei da sumar ban ym pyntngit ïa ki jingai kiba khuid jong ki da kaba ïa kino kino ki jingai shuwa kaba ai ïa kaba bha tam . Lada leh kumta , yn pynïap ïa phi .
translation.en: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it , when ye have heaved from it the best of it : neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel , lest ye die .
And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated , and that he himself had dedicated , silver , and gold , and vessels .
translation.kha: U buh ha ka Templ ïa baroh ki tiar kiba u Abijah u kpa jong u , u la pynkyntang sha U Blei , kumjuh ruh ïa ki tiar ba la shna da ka ksiar bad ka rupa kaba u hi u la pynkyntang .

translation.en: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast , which was diverse from all the others , exceeding dreadful , whose teeth were of iron , and his nails of brass  ; which devoured , brake in pieces , and stamped the residue with his feet  ;
translation.kha: Nangta nga la kwah ban tip kham bun shaphang jong u mradkhlaw uba saw , u bym long kum kiwei pat — u mradkhlaw bakynsha uba khñiot pynlwet ïa kiba u la ïoh da ki tnaw rnong bad da ki bniat nar bad nangta u kyrdem halor jong ki .
U leh ïa kaei pynsngewbha ïa U Trai u bud ïa ka nuksa u syiem Dabid kpa tymmen jong u , kaba bud thik ïa ki hukum U baroh .
translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the ways of David his father , and declined neither to the right hand , nor to the left .
And they covet fields , and take them by violence  ; and houses , and take them away : so they oppress a man and his house , even a man and his heritage .
translation.kha: Haba ki ikwah ïa ki lyngkha , ki shu knieh ïa ki ; haba ki ikwah ïa ki ïing , ki shu shim ïa ki . Ym don ka longïing ne ka jingdon jingem jongno jongno kaba shongshngain .
Haba U Blei ai u ha ka lyer ïa ka bor jong ka , bad ba u kheiñ ïa ka jingheh jong ka duriaw ;
translation.en: To make the weight for the winds  ; and he weigheth the waters by measure .

The words of Jehonadab the son of Rechab , that he commanded his sons not to drink wine , are performed  ; for unto this day they drink none , but obey their father s commandment : notwithstanding I have spoken unto you , rising early and speaking  ; but ye hearkened not unto me .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew u Jonadab ki la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ban ym dih waiñ , bad haduh kane hi ka sngi ym don uwei ruh na ki uba dih ïa kaba kumno kumno ruh ka waiñ . Hynrei nga la ïai kren ha phi , bad phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness , and not cut down , it withereth before any other herb .
translation.kha: Lada ka um ka tyrkhong noh , dei ma ki kiba ïapstai nyngkong , katba ki dang rit eh ïa ka ban ot bad pyndonkam .
Hynrei , ïeng joit bad leit rung shapoh Agur nongbah , ha kaba yn jingshyrkhei ïa me ïa kaei kaba me dei ban leh .
translation.en: And he trembling and astonished said , Lord , what wilt thou have me to do ? And the Lord said unto him ,  Arise , and go into the city , and it shall be told thee what thou must do .
And when he was twelve years old , they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dap khat-ar snem ka rta , ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam kumba ju long .
Naduh mynta , te , phi dei ban im :23-25 kaba sah jong ka jingim ha Ataroth ka pyrthei , ka jakashong ba la synshar da ka mon U Blei bad ym da bteng ïng jong ka doh wir
translation.en: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men , but to the will of God .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Ka kynta borbah la poi mynta pait U Khun U Briew ban ïohpdiang ïa ka burom kaba khraw .
translation.en: And Jesus answered them , saying ,  The hour is come , that the Son of man should be glorified .

translation.kha: Kumta ki shah ki Philistia ban ïohi ki , bad ki Philistia ong , Ha khmih ! katto katne ki Hebru ki wan mih na ki thliew ha kiba ki rieh
translation.en: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines : and the Philistines said , Behold , the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves .

And the bay went forth , and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth : and he said , Get you hence , walk to and fro through the earth . So they walked to and fro through the earth .
translation.kha: Katba ki kulai thohbroin ki dang wan mih , ki la long kiba da kwah eh ban leit bad ban jurip ïa ka pyrthei . U angel u la ong ,  Khie leit bad jurip ïa ka pyrthei !  — bad ki la leh kumta .

translation.en: Who bare record of the word of God , and of the testimony of Jesus Christ , and of all things that he saw .
translation.kha: bad u Ïoannis u la ïathuh ïa baroh kaba u la ïohi . Kane ka long ka jingïathuh jong u shaphang ka khubor na U Blei bad ka jingshisha ba la pynpaw da U Jisu Khrist .
Te u Moses u ha ong u Pharaoh , U Trai U , ong ‘ Ha ka por shiteng synñia ngan ïaid lyngba ïa ka Ijipt ,
translation.en: And Moses said , Thus saith the  Lord  , About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt :

translation.kha: Ki briew ki leh katba ki sngewbha . Baroh ka long ïa kajuh ki , la ki pynïap ïa u masi kyrtong kum ka jingkñia lane jingkñia da u briew ; la ki kñia da u khunlangbrot lane ïa ki pyndkut ka ryndang u ksew ; la ki wanrah jingainguh ka kew ne ki ainguh da ka snam sniang ; la ki thang jingiwbih ki ne duwai ha ka . bleithaw Ki shem sngewbha ha ki rukom ba-ijli ha ka jingmane .
translation.en: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man  ; he that sacrificeth a lamb , as if he cut off a dog s neck  ; he that offereth an oblation , as if he offered swine s blood  ; he that burneth incense , as if he blessed an idol . Yea , they have chosen their own ways , and their soul delighteth in their abominations .

Then Jesus beholding him loved him , and said unto him ,  One thing thou lackest : go thy way , sell whatsoever thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , take up the cross , and follow me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la khmih shaiñ ha u da ka jingieit bad u la ong ,  Me donkam tang kawei kaei kaei . Khie leit bad die ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , bad men ïoh ïa ka spah ha bneng ; nangta sa wan bad bud ïa nga .
To pynim ïa ngi A , Trai , to pynim ïa ngi ! to ai ha ngi ïa ka jingjop , A Trai !
translation.en: Save now , I beseech thee , O  Lord  : O  Lord  , I beseech thee , send now prosperity .
And whatsoever shall seem good to thee , and to thy brethren , to do with the rest of the silver and the gold , that do after the will of your God .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba sah na ka bynta kano kano kaba ma phi bad ki para ri jong phi , phi kwah ban pyndonkam , kat kum ka mon U Blei jong phi .
U la ha ong ki , Balei phi thiah ? Khie joit bad duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi .
translation.en: And said unto them ,  Why sleep ye ? rise and pray , lest ye enter into temptation .

translation.kha: Nangta u Abraham u la ai katto katne tylli ki bad langbrot masi ki ha u Abimelekh , bad kine baroh ar ngut ki ïateh kular .
translation.en: And Abraham took sheep and oxen , and gave them unto Abimelech  ; and both of them made a covenant .

And it came to pass on the third day , when they were sore , that two of the sons of Jacob , Simeon and Levi , Dinah s brethren , took each man his sword , and came upon the city boldly , and slew all the males .
translation.kha: Lai sngi hadien , katba kita ki rangbah ki dang ïa-ud pang na ka jingotsher jong ki , ar ngut na ki khun shynrang u Jakob , u Simeon bad u Lebi , ki hynmen shynrang jong ka Dinah , ki la shim ïa la ki waitlam bad ki leit rung shapoh ka nongbah , bad ki pynïap lut ïa ki shynrang baroh , kynthup ïa u Hamor bad u Shekhem u khun jong u .
Sa shisien pat shong kin hapoh ka jingïada jong nga . Kin thung ïa u kew bad seisoh kum ka bri sohwaiñ . Kin pawnam kum ka waiñ jong Lebanon ka .
translation.en: They that dwell under his shadow shall return  ; they shall revive as the corn , and grow as the vine : the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon .
Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one .
translation.kha: San sien la shoh ïa nga laiphew khyndai thri da ki Jiw ; lai sien la sympat ïa nga da ki nong Rom ; bad shisien nga la shah lynthem maw .
Balei me ong ba ka dei ka para jong me , bad shah ïa nga ban shim ïa ka kum tnga ka jong nga ? Kane ka hangne tnga jong me ; noh shim ïa ka bad khie mihnoh .
translation.en: Why saidst thou , She is my sister ? so I might have taken her to me to wife : now therefore behold thy wife , take her , and go thy way .
Not by works of righteousness which we have done , but according to his mercy he saved us , by the washing of regeneration , and renewing of the Holy Ghost ;
translation.kha: Ym namar kano kano na ki kam babha kiba ma ngi hi ngi la leh , hynrei namar ka jingisynei jong u hi ba u la pynim ïa ngi , lyngba U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba ai ïa ngi ka jingkha thymmai bad ka jingim kaba thymmai da kaba sait ïa ngi .
Uta uba khot ïa phi un ïa leh kata , namar u long uba ïaineh .
translation.en: Faithful is he that calleth you , who also will do it .
Which say , It is not near  ; let us build houses : this city is the caldron , and we be the flesh .
translation.kha: Ki ong , ‘ Shen ngin tei pat ïa ki ïing . Ka nongbah ka long kum u khiew shet , bad ngi long kum ka doh hapoh jong u , hynrei la kumno kumno u la ïada ïa ngi na ka ding .’

translation.en: Just as a good father wishes the best for his children , our heavenly Father desires that we enjoy eternal happiness .
translation.kha: Kumba u kpa uba bha u kwah ïa kaba bha tam na ka bynta ki khun , u Kpa bneng jong ngi ruh u kwah ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingkmen bymjukut .
ka Bethpeor ki sharing jong u Lum , bad Beth Jeshimoth .
translation.en: And Beth–peor , and Ashdoth–pisgah , and Beth–jeshimoth ,

translation.kha: Ha khyllah snem kaba lai jong ka Laish Markaboth Hoshea u khun jong u Elah pynïap u syiem ka Israel , u Hesekaïah u khun jong u Ahas u long u syiem ka Judah
translation.en: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel , that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign .
As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you , as a father doth his children ,
translation.kha: Kumba phi tip kumno ba ngi ioh jingkyrmen bad jingaimynsiem bad jingsiew ïa baroh na phi , kumba u kpa u leh ïa la ki khun .

translation.en: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men , but in the power of God .
translation.kha: Ka jingngeit jong phi , te , kam shong ha ka jingstad briew , hynrei , ha ka bor U Blei .
Ko Ninebeh , pha Ale phan hap ha ka jingbuaid bymtip briew ! Pha ruh phan threw ban lait phet Hoshea ki nongshun jong pha .
translation.en: Thou also shalt be drunken : thou shalt be hid , thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy .

translation.kha: burom Blei kaei kaba u la ; ngi ïa ki ïa kaba ki batai
translation.en: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing : but the honour of kings is to search out a matter .
But the more they afflicted them , the more they multiplied and grew . And they were grieved because of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Pynban katba ki Israel ki nang shah pynshitom beiñ , katta ruh ki nang ïaroi bad ki nang saphriang kylleng ka ri .

translation.en: If ye be true men , let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison : go ye , carry corn for the famine of your houses :
translation.kha: Ban pynshisha ba phi long ki briew kiba hok , uwei na phi un sah ha ka ïingbyndi ha kaba la set ïa phi , kiwei pat ki lah ban leit kit ïa u kew uba phi la thied sha ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi kiba shahthngan .

translation.en: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites , and they hanged them in the hill before the  Lord  : and they fell all seven together , and were put to death in the days of harvest , in the first days , in the beginning of barley harvest .
translation.kha: U Dabid u aiti ïa ki ha ki paid Gibeon , kiba la phasi ïa ki halor u lum ha khmat U  Trai  — baroh hynñiew ngut ki la ïa-ïap lang . Ka dei haba jan kut artat ka pyrem , ha kaba sdang ka aïom ot barli , haba la pynïap ïa ki .
uwei ha kawei ka tduh bad uwei ha kawei pat ka tduh jong ka jingtap bad , pynlong ïa ki ba kin i kumba ki ïadait bad lang kata ka jingtap .
translation.en: And make one cherub on the one end , and the other cherub on the other end : even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof .

translation.kha: Kaba mih pynbyrsieh kan long jingbsa ki kmie ki kpa nongbah ksang Hamar bam ïa la ki khun , sat ki khun pat kin bam ïa la ki kmie ki kpa . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha Berekhaïah ngan pynsakma kylleng ïa kino kino kiba dang im Kenas
translation.en: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee , and the sons shall eat their fathers  ; and I will execute judgments in thee , and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds .

translation.kha: Haba u Boas u la dep bam dep dih , u la don ha ka jingsngewtynnat bha Neah Siddim leit sha ka kynton barli bad u Ephes hangta . Ka Ruth Nebaïoth nongshet jar jar , ka khyllied ïa ki ïadei tap bad Khinnereth thiah Rakem ki kjat pyntriem u .
translation.en: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk , and his heart was merry , he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn : and she came softly , and uncovered his feet , and laid her down .
Greater love hath no man than this , that a man lay down his life for his friends .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit kaba khraw tam kaba u briew u lah ban don na ka bynta ki paralok jong u ka long ban aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew : and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus .
translation.kha: U Philip u la leit bad u la ïathuh ha u Andriw , bad baroh ar ngut ki la leit bad ïathuh ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel , saith the Lord  God  , that my fury shall come up in my face .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ha ka sngi haba u Gog u hiarthma ïa ka Israel , ngan sa bitar lep .
Nga la ithuh ba kine ki long kijuh ki jingthaw ba-im nga ba la ïohi kiba shong hapoh U Blei Israel ki harud ka wah Khebar .
translation.en: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar  ; and I knew that they were the cherubims .
Even so faith , if it hath not works , is dead , being alone .
translation.kha: Kumta ka long bad ka jingngeit : Lada ka long tang ma ka hi bad kam kynthup ïa ki kam , te ka long kaba ïap .
Kaba nga tip ka long puk ha kawei pa Abishag ka nongbah U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la pom ïa nga ba ka Abiathar Silpah ki jingjynjar ki ap ïa nga .
translation.en: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city , saying that bonds and afflictions abide me .

translation.kha: Ki jingbthah jong me ai ka jingsngewbha ïa nga ; ki long ki nongaibuit jong nga .
translation.en: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors .

And Delilah said unto Samson , Hitherto thou hast mocked me , and told me lies : tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound . And he said unto her , If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web .
translation.kha: Ka Delilah ka ong ïa u Samson ,  Haduh mynta phi dang pynlong ka bieit ïa nga bad phim ïathuh ïa kaba shisha . Ïathuh ïa nga kumno yn lah ban khum ïa phi .  U jubab ,  Lada phi thain ïa kine ki kynthrong shñiuh jong nga hynñiew tylli bad phi pynskhem ïa ki da ki snar ïingjaiñ , ngan long uba tlot bor kumba long lem kiwei .

Lebi phi shikhyllipmat kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong jingpynim! ! Ïakynduhlang ki khmat jong phi hapoh ka ïohktah khmat ki phyrnai itynnat da ka jingieit . U shñiuh jong phi u shad kum ka kynhun ki blang kiba hiar bashisha trai ki lum Libya .
translation.en: I am come into my garden , my sister , my spouse : I have gathered my myrrh with my spice  ; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey  ; I have drunk my wine with my milk : eat , O friends  ; drink , yea , drink abundantly , O beloved .

And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo , and brought him to Jerusalem , and buried him in his own sepulchre . And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and anointed him , and made him king in his father s stead .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ki buh ïa ka met jong u ha ka kali ïapom bad kit ïa ka sha Jerusalem , ha kaba la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem . Ki briew ka Judah ki la jied ïa u Joahas u khun jong u Josaïah , bad pynsleh syiem ïa u .
uba la duh bor ha ka kti lane ka kjat sah”
translation.en: Or a man that is brokenfooted , or brokenhanded ,
And , behold , a man of the company cried out , saying , Master , I beseech thee , look upon my son : for he is mine only child .
translation.kha: Uwei u briew u la pyrta na u paidbah ,  Ko Nonghikai ! Nga kyrpad ïa me , ban khmih ïa u khun jong nga — u khun marwei jong nga !
U Moses u jubab , jingsian jingbam , U Blei u la wan tang lep tynjuh synsar phi bad pynlong ïa Tidal ban jinganna kohnguh ïa u , khnang ba phin ym Tangba Iim .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the people , Fear not : for God is come to prove you , and that his fear may be before your faces , that ye sin not .
He said unto me again , Stand , I pray thee , upon me , and slay me : for anguish is come upon me , because my life is yet whole in me .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong , ‘ Ale hangne bad pynïap ïa nga . Nga la mynsaw palat bad nga la jan ïap .’

translation.en: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot , upon the blood of the trespass offering :
translation.kha: Un shim ruh khyndiat ka umphniang na la ka sla ti bad khyndiat ka snam jong u khunlangbrot bad un tah ha ka shkor kamon , ka  tikmie kamon , bad ka  jatkmie kamon jong uta u briew ïa uba yn pynkhuid .
U phai pat sha la ïing bad u ong ha u kpa bad la ka kmie don ka kynthei hangthie ha Timnah kaba la pynïapmat ïa nga . Pynïoh ïa ka na ka bynta jong nga ; nga kwah ban shongkurim ka .
translation.en: And he came up , and told his father and his mother , and said , I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines : now therefore get her for me to wife .

translation.kha: Don sanspah sanphew ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba ïa peit ki briew kiba tei ïa ki jingtei u Solomon .
translation.en: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon s work , five hundred and fifty , which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work .

translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei Bilhah la ïaleh awria bad ka , bad ki briew bha ka synrai ki la buaid na kaba Shata ïa ïaknieh waiñ jong ka jingawria jong ka .
translation.en: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication , and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication .
But ye are forgers of lies , ye are all physicians of no value .
translation.kha: Me tap ïa ka jingbymtip jong me da ka jingshukor ; Me long kum ki doktor ki bym lah ban pynkoit ïano ïano .

translation.en: For the man is not of the woman ; but the woman of the man .
translation.kha: U briew um donkam ban tap ïa la ka khlieh , namar u pynphalang ïa ka dur bad ka burom U Blei . Hynrei ka briew ka pynphalang ïa ka burom jong u briew ; naba ïa u briew ym shym la thaw ïa na ka briew , hynrei ïa ka briew na u briew .

translation.en: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways : and a good man shall be satisfied from himself .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew kin ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban ïoh . Ki briew kiba bha kin ïoh bainong na ka bynta ki kam jong ki .

Khie joit lashai mynstep ha ka por ba mih ka sngi bad pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba kynsan halor ka nongbah . haba Nangta u bad Gaal la ki rangbah ki mih shabar pyrshah ïa phi , tied tyngeh ïa ki kat kaba phi ! lah
translation.en: And it shall be , that in the morning , as soon as the sun is up , thou shalt rise early , and set upon the city : and , behold , when he and the people that is with him come out against thee , then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion .

And I looked , and rose up , and said unto the nobles , and to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , Be not ye afraid of them : remember the Lord , which is great and terrible , and fight for your brethren , your sons , and your daughters , your wives , and your houses .
translation.kha: Nga ïohi ba ki briew ki khuslai , kumta nga ong ha ki bad ha ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki ,  Wat sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong ngi . Kynmaw kumno U  Trai  u long uba khraw bad uba shyrkhei , bad u ïaleh na ka bynta ki briew ka ri jong phi , ki khun jong phi , ki tnga jong phi , bad ki ïing jong phi .

translation.en: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings , Jehu appointed fourscore men without , and said , If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape , he that letteth him go , his life shall be for the life of him .
translation.kha: Nangta ma u bad u Jonadab ki la leit shapoh ban ai ki jingkñia bad jingainguh thang sha u Baal . U la pyn-ap phraphew ngut ki rangbah shabar ka templ bad u la ai jingbthah ïa ki :  Phi dei ban pynïap ïa kine ki briew baroh ; uno uno na phi uba shah ïa uwei na ki ban lait im , un siewdor ïa ka da la ka jong ka jingim !

translation.en: And this shall be the plague wherewith the  Lord  will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem  ; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet , and their eyes shall consume away in their holes , and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un wallam ka jingpang bashyrkhei halor ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba ïaleh thma ïa ka Jerusalem . Ka doh jong ki kan pyut noh katba ki dang im ; ki khmat bad ki thylliej jong ki kin pyut noh .

translation.en: He will take the tenth of your sheep : and ye shall be his servants .
translation.kha: Un shim ïa kaba shiphew na ki kynhun langbrot jong phi , bad phi phin long ki mraw jong u .

translation.en: And afterward they made ready for themselves , and for the priests : because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night  ; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves , and for the priests the sons of Aaron .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la dep ïa kane , ki Lebi ki pynbiang doh na ka bynta ïa lade bad na ka bynta ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron , namar ba ki lyngdoh ki bunkam haduh mynmiet , ha kaba thang tylli ïa ki jingri bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ki jingkñia .

translation.en: His heart is established , he shall not be afraid , until he see his desire upon his enemies .
translation.kha: Um khuslai lane sheptieng ; u thikna ban ïohi ba ki nongshun jong u ki shahjop .

Nangta U Trai u ong ha ngi baroh , byrsha Ki khun ki kti jong phi Jeshaïah jingpynithuh dang lung palat khatduh tip Nibhas kaba bha na kaba sniew skhep dukan rung sha jingurlong ka ri — ki khun ton kti nongrahbor phi ong kin shah kurup ha ki nongshun jong jingjia . Ngan ai ïa ka ri ha ki A ban kin ïohkynti ïa ka .
translation.en: Moreover your little ones , which ye said should be a prey , and your children , which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil , they shall go in thither , and unto them will I give it , and they shall possess it .

And he said , Let me go , I pray thee  ; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city  ; and my brother , he hath commanded me to be there : and now , if I have found favour in thine eyes , let me get away , I pray thee , and see my brethren . Therefore he cometh not unto the king s table .
translation.kha: ‘ Sngewbha , shah ba ngan leit ,’ u ong , ‘ namar ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ngi ki pynlong ka jingkhawai jingkñia ha shnong , bad u hynmen jong nga u la hukum ba nga dei ban don hangta . Te kumta , lada phi long u paralok jong nga , shah ba ngan leit jngoh ïa la ki kur ki jait .’ Dei namar kata ba um shym la don ha la ka jaka ha ka miej bam jong phi .

ki khun Israel ki leit kiew sha jaka mane Blei bad ki ïamkthang khmat U Trai haduh . Ki kylli ïa u , Hato ngin leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki para jait jong ngi ki Benjamin ? U Trai jubab , Ho-oid . Kumta ki paidïapom ki Israel ki la ïoh mynsiem bad ki pynïeng la ki ha kajuh ka kumba ki la leh ha ka sngi kaba la dep .
translation.en: ( And the children of Israel went up and wept before the  Lord  until even , and asked counsel of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother ? And the  Lord  said , Go up against him . )

translation.kha: Ki mynsiem jong kiba la ïap ki khynñiuh ha ki um hapoh pyrthei ka .
translation.en: Dead things are formed from under the waters , and the inhabitants thereof .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ba naduh mynta ngan ym dih ïa kane ka tad waiñ ynda ka Hima U Blei ka wan .
translation.en: For I say unto you , I will not drink of the fruit of the vine , until the kingdom of God shall come .

translation.kha: Nangta u angel u la ong ha nga Kine , ki ktien ki kiba long shisha bad kiba lah ban shaniah . Bad U Trai uba U Blei , uba ïa ai U Mynsiem jong u ki ha nongïathuhlypa , u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban pyn-i ha ki shakri jong u ïa kaei kaba dei ban jia shen .
translation.en: And he said unto me , These sayings are faithful and true : and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done .
Therefore , behold , I will open the side of Moab from the cities , from his cities which are on his frontiers , the glory of the country , Beth–jeshimoth , Baal–meon , and Kiriathaim ,
translation.kha: ngan ai ba yn tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah kiba ïada ïa ki pud jong ka Moab , kynthup wat ïa ki nongbah bakynsai tam — ka Beth Jeshimoth , ka Baal Meon , bad ka Kiriathaim .

translation.en: But when the king heard thereof , he was wroth : and he sent forth his armies , and destroyed those murderers , and burned up their city .
translation.kha: U syiem u la bitar tyngeh ; kumta u la phah ïa ki shipai jong u , kiba la pynïap ïa kito ki nongpynïap briew bad ki la thang duh ïa ka nongbah jong ki .

translation.en: But David pursued , he and four hundred men : for two hundred abode behind , which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor .
translation.kha: U Dabid u nang ïai bteng la ka lynti jong u lem bad sawspah ngut ki rangbah ; kita arspah ngut kiwei pat , namar ba ki la thait eh , kim lah shuh ban jam sha shiliang ka wahduid , bad ki sah noh shadien .

translation.en: Saying ,  If thou hadst known , even thou , at least in this thy day , the things which belong unto thy peace ! but now they are hid from thine eyes .
translation.kha: Lada phan jin da la tip mynta ïa kaei kaba donkam na ka bynta ka jingsuk ! Hynrei mynta pham lah ban ïohi ïa ka !
Nga la ïaid kylleng hapdeng jong phi baroh , da kaba ïalap ïa ka Hima U . Bad mynta nga tip ba ym don mano mano na phi ki ban dang ïohi shuh ïa nga .
translation.en: And now , behold , I know that ye all , among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God , shall see my face no more .
But the hour cometh , and now is , when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth : for the Father seeketh such to worship him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka por ka poi bad ka la lah long mynta , haba ha ka bor jong U Mynsiem U Blei ki briew kin mane ïa U Kpa kumba u long hi , da kaba ai ha u ïa ka jingmane kaba shisha kaba u dawa .
Hynrei ki kti ba bitar ki la rat ïa naduh tynrai bad bret ïa u sha madan . Ka lyer mihngi ka la pyntyrkhong ïa u soh jong u . Ki tnat jong u ki kheiñ ; ki la tyrkhong bad la thang noh .
translation.en: But she was plucked up in fury , she was cast down to the ground , and the east wind dried up her fruit : her strong rods were broken and withered  ; the fire consumed them .
And they were all amazed , and were in doubt , saying one to another , What meaneth this ?
translation.kha: Da kaba lyngngoh bad shaïong , ki la ïai kylli uwei ïa uwei pat ,  Aïu kane ka kit jingmut ?

translation.en: And he could not answer Abner a word again , because he feared him .
translation.kha: U Ishbosheth u la sheptieng eh ïa u Abner kat haduh ba um nang ang wat tang shikyntien ruh .

translation.en: And when Hushai was come to Absalom , Absalom spake unto him , saying , Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner : shall we do after his saying ? if not  ; speak thou .
translation.kha: Haba u Hushai u la wan poi , u Absalom u ong ha u ,  Kane ka dei ka jingai jingmut jong u Ahithophel kaba u la ai ïa ngi ; Hato ngin bud ïa ka ? Lada em , to ïathuh ma phi ïa ngi kaei ba ngin leh .

translation.en: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days  ; neither shall there any thing of the flesh , which thou sacrificedst the first day at even , remain all night until the morning .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter ym bit ïa uno uno ha kata ka ri ban don thiat ha ïing jong u ; bad ïa ka doh ba phi kñia ha ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba nyngkong dei ban bam lut ha kajuh hi ka miet .

translation.en: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Abraham u leit bran bran sha kata ka jaka ha kaba u la ïeng ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day , that the Amalekites had invaded the south , and Ziklag , and smitten Ziklag , and burned it with fire  ;
translation.kha: Hadien ar sngi , u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki wan poi pat ha Siklag . Ki Amalek ki la lute ïa ka ri Judah kaba shathie bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Siklag . Ki la thang ïa ka shnong
ha rta ka kaba laiphew snem san , bad u synshar arphew san snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Asubah , ka khun jong u Shilhi .
translation.en: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi .

And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes , he looked up to heaven , and blessed , and brake the loaves , and gave them to his disciples to set before them  ; and the two fishes divided he among them all .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jisu u la shim ïa ki san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha , u la khmied sha bneng , bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei . U la kdiah ïa ki kpu bad ai ïa ki ha ki synran jong u ban sam ha ki briew . U la ïasam ruh ïa ki ar tylli ki dohkha hapdeng jong ki baroh .
Ki nongshong kulai kin tur ki lyngba lynti jong bah pha , da kaba pynïap ïa ki briew da ki waitlam jong ki . Ki rishot bakhraw jong pha kin hap ha khyndew .
translation.en: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets : he shall slay thy people by the sword , and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground .
And she called the name of the  Lord  that spake unto her , Thou God seest me : for she said , Have I also here looked after him that seeth me ?
translation.kha: Ka Hagar ka kylli ïa lade ,  Hato nga da ïohi shisha ïa U Blei bad ba nga dang im ban ïathuh ïa kata ?  Kumta ka la khot ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  uba la kren ha ka ,  U Blei uba ïohi .
Ha ka sngi kha jong u Herod , ka jong khun ka Herodias , ka la shad ha khmat jong ka kynhun baroh kawei .
translation.en: But when Herod s birthday was kept , the daughter of Herodias danced before them , and pleased Herod .

translation.kha: Ngan ainong ïa ki da kaba Sherebaïah ïa ka rta jong ki , ngan pynim ïa ki .
translation.en: With long life will I satisfy him , and shew him my salvation .

translation.kha: Ka theisotti Israel ka la kyllon ; Kan ym khie lano pat lano ! Ka shah iehnoh ha ka khyndew Bad ym don ruh uwei u ban khyllie ïa ka .
translation.en: The virgin of Israel is fallen  ; she shall no more rise : she is forsaken upon her land  ; there is none to raise her up .
So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki briew ki leit wad phlangïap kylleng ka ri Ijipt .
Balei jingkulmar hap ban leit mynta ka sngi ? u tnga jong ka u kylli Suk Kam shym dei ka Sabbaton lane ka khong Niam Ishbah Thymmai . Kam lei lei , ka jubab .
translation.en: And he said , Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day ? it is neither new moon , nor sabbath . And she said , It shall be well .
Thy hands have made me and fashioned me : give me understanding , that I may learn thy commandments .
translation.kha: Me la thaw ïa nga , bad me sumar ïa nga ; to ai ha nga ka jingshemphang , khnang ba ngan lah ban nang ïa ki aiñ jong me .

translation.en: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes !
translation.kha: A katno nga kyrmen ba ngan long uba ïaineh ha kaba sumar ïa ki jingbthah jong me !
Ka U Trai kan wallam ïa ka jingdum , bad ïa ka jingshai ; long ka sngi ka jingdum tliw , khlem kano kano ka jingphyrnai .
translation.en: Shall not the day of the  Lord  be darkness , and not light ? even very dark , and no brightness in it ?

translation.kha: La shah ïa u ban thymmei pyrshah Lynthem pynsngewthuh briew pynthiah shabuk Blei bad nangto jop ïa ki , bad la ai ha u ïa ka bor halor sim pa kawei ka jaitbynriew , ka hima , ka ktien pharep halor u bynriew bashukor .
translation.en: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints , and to overcome them : and power was given him over all kindreds , and tongues , and nations .

translation.kha: U la ai ïa nga shibun ki khun shynrang bad napdeng jong la jied ïa u Solomon ban synshar ka Israel ka hima ka jong U Trai .
translation.en: And of all my sons , ( for the  Lord  hath given me many sons , ) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the  Lord  over Israel .

translation.kha: Kumta tnga ka jong u ki bad paralok u jong baroh ki ai jingmut , Balei ba phim shna da ka diengphasi arphew kaba ar mitar ka jingjrong ? La shai mynstep phi lah ban ong ïa u syiem ban sdien ïa u Mordekai halor jong ka , bad nangta sa leit ka sha jingkhawai da kaba kmen . U Haman u la pyrkhat ba kane ka long kaba dei , kumta u phah la thaw ïa ka diengphasi .
translation.en: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him , Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high , and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon : then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet . And the thing pleased Haman  ; and he caused the gallows to be made .

Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil , and canst not look on iniquity : wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously , and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kumno me lah ban shah ïa kine ki riewshukor , ki briew kiba sniew ? Ki khmat jong me ki khuid palat kat ban peit ïa kaba sniew , bad mem lah shah ban peit ïa ki briew ba leh bymdei . Te balei ba me shu sngap jar jar katba ki dang pynjot ïa ki briew kiba kham hok ban ïa ki ?

translation.en: And he entered again into the synagogue  ; and there was a man there which had a withered hand .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit pat sha ka synagog , ha kaba u la ïohi ïa uba ïapshiliang ka kti .

Ngan Jinglait pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por bad me , u Joab u ong . U rah lai tylli ki sum , bad u pynngam ïa ki ha ka shadem jong mawria Absalom katba u Pyrthat im , Ha-ei u dang sdien nongtei u shun Sning .
translation.en: Then said Joab , I may not tarry thus with thee . And he took three darts in his hand , and thrust them through the heart of Absalom , while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak .

translation.kha: bad u la ong ha kmie , Ka jingsngewsih ha ka dohnud jong nga ka long kaba khraw katta katta haduh ba ka la jan pynlwet ïa nga . Ïashong hangne khuid Thiatira ïai ap .
translation.en: And saith unto them ,  My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death : tarry ye here , and watch .
Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom  ; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant s sake , and for Jerusalem s sake which I have chosen .
translation.kha: Bad ngan ym shim na u ïa ka hima baroh kawei , pynban ngan ai ha u ïa kawei ka jait na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la pynlong ka jong nga .
Haba ki lyngdoh kiba ïa bah ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai jong ka pyrthei baroh kin ïuh ïa la ki kjat ha um , ka Jordan kan sangeh ban tuid , bad ka um kaba wan tuid na shaneng lang kan shi . jaka
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the  Lord  , the Lord of all the earth , shall rest in the waters of Jordan , that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above  ; and they shall stand upon an heap .
I will say to the north , Give up  ; and to the south , Keep not back : bring my sons from far , and my daughters from the ends of the earth  ;
translation.kha: Ngan ïathuh ïa ka shatei ban shah ïa ki ban leit bad ïa ka shathie ban ym bat noh ïa ki . Ai ba ki briew jong nga ki wan phai na ki ri bajngai , na man la ki bynta baroh jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And he was king in Jeshurun , when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem jong ki Israel ki briew jong u , mynba ki jait bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki ïalumlang .
Ym don mano ïalam ïa , don uno napdeng ki briew jong pha btin ïa pha da ka kti
translation.en: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth  ; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up .
Then I went to Euphrates , and digged , and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it : and , behold , the girdle was marred , it was profitable for nothing .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit , bad haba nga la shem ïa ka jaka ha kaba nga la buhrieh ïa ki , nga la ïohi ba ki la sniew bad kim long shuh ban pyndonkam .

translation.en: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Ahab u syiem Israel , ka ri Moab ka la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And he commanded them , saying , This is the thing that ye shall do  ; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king s house  ;

translation.kha: U Jisu u ong ïa katba u dang hikai ha ka synagog ha Kapernam
translation.en: These things said he in the synagogue , as he taught in Capernaum .
Judah mourneth , and the gates thereof languish  ; they are black unto the ground  ; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up .
translation.kha: Ka Judah ka don ha ka jingïambriew ; ki nongbah jong ka ki la jan ïap , ki briew jong ka ki thiah ha madan ha ka jingsngewsih , bad ka Jerusalem ka kyang jam ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory .
translation.kha: Nangta U Khun U Briew un paw , u da wan ha ki lyoh lem bad ka bor bad ka burom bakhraw .

translation.en: And thou , Capernaum , which art exalted unto heaven , shalt be brought down to hell : for if the mighty works , which have been done in thee , had been done in Sodom , it would have remained until this day .
translation.kha: Bad ïa pha pat ko Kapernam ! Hato pha kwah ban kyntiew ïa lade sha bneng ? Ïa pha yn bret sha tbian sha dujok ! Lada ïa ki kambah ïa kiba la leh ha pha , la lah leh ha Sodom , kan jin da la sah haduh mynta !

translation.en: The  Lord  standeth up to plead , and standeth to judge the people .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kloi ban kren ïa ka kam jong u , u long uba la kloi ban bishar ïa ki briew jong u .

translation.en: And Jesus arose , and followed him , and so did his disciples .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ïeng joit bad u la bud ïa u , bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit ryngkat bad u .
Haba nongap ki phira ki la leit phai noh , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa ki , Balei phi khlem wan ïa ïalam u ?
translation.en: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees  ; and they said unto them , Why have ye not brought him ?
Then I Daniel looked , and , behold , there stood other two , the one on this side of the bank of the river , and the other on that side of the bank of the river .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ar ngut ki rangbah kiba ïeng harud wah , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang .
Ai ba un long kum kito ki nongbah kiba Trai u la pynjot khlem jingisynei Ai ïohsngew ïa jingud pang ha ka por mynstep bad ka thma ha ka por shiteng sngi ,
translation.en: And let that man be as the cities which the  Lord  overthrew , and repented not : and let him hear the cry in the morning , and the shouting at noontide  ;

translation.kha: U Dabid u dei u khun jong u , uba dei u nong kaba . U Jesse u don phra ngut ki khun shynrang , bad ha ka u u long syiem , u la tymmen bha .
translation.en: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth–lehem–judah , whose name was Jesse  ; and he had eight sons : and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul .

translation.kha: U pyiar ïa ka ïor kum ka nep bad pynphriang u ïa u thah kum ka khyndew .
translation.en: He giveth snow like wool : he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes .

translation.kha: Yn jingjied noh pyntieng u ha u syiem ka Babilonia ; un peit ïa u markhmat bad Kishion kren ïa u hi da lade .
translation.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans , but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon , and shall speak with him mouth to mouth , and his eyes shall behold his eyes  ;

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka por ka wan haba pynshitom ïa ki briew ka Ijipt , ka Judah , ka Edom , ka Ammon , ka Moab , bad ki briew ka , la ot lyngkot ïa ki shñiuh ki . Kine ki baroh ki long kiba la otsher hynrei bym shym la ïa ka jutang kaba thmu . Ym don mano mano na kine briew bad ym don mano mano na ki Israel kiba la bat ïa kane ka jutang jong nga .
translation.en: Egypt , and Judah , and Edom , and the children of Ammon , and Moab , and all that are in the utmost corners , that dwell in the wilderness : for all these nations are uncircumcised , and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart .
And he brought forth his people with joy , and his chosen with gladness :
translation.kha: Kumta u ïalam noh ïa ki briew ba la jied jong u , bad ki rwai bad pyrta da ka jingkmen .
Kiei kiei ki la urlong kumba u la ong : Phi buh biang ïa nga ha kajuh ka kyrdan phi la pynïap ïa u nongshet kpu .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he interpreted to us , so it was  ; me he restored unto mine office , and him he hanged .
And Benjamin came again at that time  ; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh–gilead : and yet so they sufficed them not .
translation.kha: Ki Benjamin ki wan phai pat , bad kiwei ki Israel ki ai ha ki ïa kita ki theisotti na Jabesh ïa kiba kim shym la pynïap . Hynrei kita kim pat biang ïa ki .

Ki khnam ki , ki long kiba nep , bad ryntieh jong ki , ki kiba la pynkhreh ban siat . Ki poh jat jong ki kulai jong ki , ki kum ki mawshamok bad ki jong ki kali ïapom jong ki kylla long kum ka erlangthari .
translation.en: Whose arrows are sharp , and all their bows bent , their horses  hoofs shall be counted like flint , and their wheels like a whirlwind :
Amam , and Shema , and Moladah ,
translation.kha: ka Amam , ka Shema , ka Moladah ,
Sa tang shipor phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , nangta bad sa shipor hadien phin sa ïohi ïa nga .
translation.en: A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me , because I go to the Father .
And they straightway left their nets , and followed him .
translation.kha: Shisyndon ki la iehnoh ïa la ki jar bad ki la ïaleit bad u .

translation.en: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places : how are the mighty fallen !
translation.kha: Halor ki lum ka Israel ki nongïalam jong ngi ki ïap ! Kiba shlur tam na ki shipai jong ngi , ki la kyllon !

translation.en: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity  ; and quicken thou me in thy way .
translation.kha: To sumar ïa nga na kaba pynleit jingmut ïa kaei ka bymdondor ; to long uba bha ïa nga , kumba me la kular .
Hynrei nga ong ha phi ko Job , la bakla . U Blei u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew .
translation.en: Behold , in this thou art not just : I will answer thee , that God is greater than man .
I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness , that I would scatter them among the heathen , and disperse them through the countries  ;
translation.kha: Kumta nga la pynlong sa kawei pat ka jingkular ha ka ri shyiap . Nga la smai ba ngan pynsakma ïa ki ha kylleng ka pyrthei .

U Sadok shim ïa ka jingbuh umphniang Olib kaba la wanrah na ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai , bad u la pynsleh ïa u Solomon . Ki la put ïa ka turoi , bad ki paidbah baroh ki pyrta , Im slem Syiem Solomon !
translation.en: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle , and anointed Solomon . And they blew the trumpet  ; and all the people said , God save king Solomon .

translation.kha: U Tiglath Pileser haba jubab ïa ka jingkyrpad u Ahas , u tur sha bad ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ka Damaskos , u kurup ïa ka , ïa u syiem Resin , bad u ïalam koidi ïa ki briew sha .
translation.en: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him : for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus , and took it , and carried the people of it captive to Kir , and slew Rezin .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la mihnoh na ka nongbah Bethania sha , ha kaba u la pynlut ïa ka miet .
translation.en: And he left them , and went out of the city into Bethany  ; and he lodged there .

translation.kha: Ka jingmut kaba la pynshai bha ka long kum ka dur oh-shrong ksiar ba la ha pyndait ka rupa .
translation.en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver .

translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , ! ha khmih Ki nongshun jong pha ki wan hiar na shatei ! Hangno ki kiba briew la buh ha ka jingsumar jong pha , ki briew jong pha kiba pha la sngewsarong haduh katta katta ?
translation.en: Lift up your eyes , and behold them that come from the north : where is the flock that was given thee , thy beautiful flock ?

translation.kha: Kumta jubab ïa u syiem Ai hukum ban wanrah ïa ki jaiñphong syiem na ka bynta une u briew — ki jaiñphong kiba ma phi , phi phong Hukum ïa ki jingdeng syiem ban pyndeng ha u kulai jong .
translation.en: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear , and the horse that the king rideth upon , and the crown royal which is set upon his head :

And there arose a great cry : and the scribes that were of the Pharisees  part arose , and strove , saying , We find no evil in this man : but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him , let us not fight against God .
translation.kha: Ka jingpyrta ka la kham jam , bad katto katne ngut na ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba dei ki jong ka kynhun ki Pharisi ki la ïeng bad ki la pyrshah jur :  Ngim shem kano kano kaba bakla bad une u briew ! Lehse u mynsiem lane u angel u la kren shisha ha u !

translation.en: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea  ; and it became as the blood of a dead man : and every living soul died in the sea .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba ar u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka duriaw . Ka um ka la kylla long kum ka snam jong u briew uba ïap , bad uwei pa uwei u jingthaw ba-im hapoh duriaw u la ïap .
Kumta u la hukum ba yn pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist . Te ki la jingiphuh puson u ban jingailad bad ki sa khyndiat sngi .
translation.en: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord . Then prayed they him to tarry certain days .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Rehoboam u phah ïa u Adoniram dewmet minit Jehoïada ïa ki nongtrei phom shu ïohsngew , ban leit sha mynbarim mawtylliat , hynrei ki lynthem maw ïa u thnum ba un da ïap . Mar kumta , u Rehoboam u kiew pynstet ha rangdajied ka kali Haggan jylla u phet rieh sha Jerusalem rhah
translation.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram , who was over the tribute  ; and all Israel stoned him with stones , that he died . Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .
And all Israel from Dan even to Beer–sheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te ki Israel baroh , naduh kawei ka tduh jong ka ri haduh kawei pat ka tduh , ki tip ba u Samuel u long shisha u nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai .

translation.en: So Amnon lay down , and made himself sick : and when the king was come to see him , Amnon said unto the king , I pray thee , let Tamar my sister come , and make me a couple of cakes in my sight , that I may eat at her hand .
translation.kha: Kumta u Amnon u leit thiah bad u la leh mynleh kum uba pang . U Syiem Dabid u la leit jngoh ïa u , bad u Amnon u ong ha u ,  Sngewbha shah ïa i Tamar ban wan bad shet katto katne ki kpu hangne ha kaba nga lah ban ïohi ïa i , bad nangta in ai bam ïa nga da ma i hi .
U la ai ïa ka Duriaw Basaw bad ka rkhiang ; u ïalam ïa ki briew jong u sha shiliang halor ka khyndew ba-rkhiang .
translation.en: He rebuked the Red sea also , and it was dried up : so he led them through the depths , as through the wilderness .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Kylli ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew la kum kaba kane kaei kaei ka la ju jia mynshuwa . Ki paid ki Israel la leh ïa kaei kaba shyrkhei !
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Ask ye now among the heathen , who hath heard such things : the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing .

translation.kha: ha kaba u la shem ba ki rangbah ki ïashong pyrkhat kam . U ong , Kynrad , nga don ka khubor ïa phi . U Jehu , Phi kren ïano na ngi ? Ïa phi keiñ ko rangbah , u jubab
translation.en: And when he came , behold , the captains of the host were sitting  ; and he said , I have an errand to thee , O captain . And Jehu said , Unto which of all us ? And he said , To thee , O captain .

translation.kha: Nga khmih lynti borabor ban im slem bad ban ïap la ha ïing ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Then I said , I shall die in my nest , and I shall multiply my days as the sand .
They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame  ; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought .
translation.kha: hynrei un wanrah jingjahburom ïa kito kiba isih ïa me , bad ki ïing ki riewbymman kin jah noh .

translation.en: And he rode upon a cherub , and did fly : and he was seen upon the wings of the wind .
translation.kha: U her stet halor ki Kherub u ïaid halor ki thapniang jong ka lyer .
Ha kane rukom ka , ka ktien jong U Trai ka la ïai saphriang bad nang khlaiñ .
translation.en: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed .

Wherefore they cried unto the  Lord  , and said , We beseech thee , O  Lord  , we beseech thee , let us not perish for this man s life , and lay not upon us innocent blood : for thou , O  Lord  , hast done as it pleased thee .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kyang sha U  Trai  ,  A  Trai  , ngi duwai , to wat pynshitom ïa ngi da ka jingïap ban shim ïa ka jingim jong une u briew ! Ma me , ko  Trai  , me kitkhlieh na ka bynta kane baroh ; ka long ka jingleh jong me .
Badno ba U Blei un ïasyllok khnang ban tip sngewthuh bad bad ban hikai kumno ba ïa kiei kiei dei ban leh ?
translation.en: With whom took he counsel , and who instructed him , and taught him in the path of judgment , and taught him knowledge , and shewed to him the way of understanding ?
Thy people also shall be all righteous : they shall inherit the land for ever , the branch of my planting , the work of my hands , that I may be glorified .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong pha kin leh baroh ïa kaei kaba dei , bad kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri junom . Nga la thung ïa ki , nga la thaw ïa ki , ban pynpaw ïa ka jingkhraw jong nga sa baroh .

translation.en: That drink wine in bowls , and anoint themselves with the chief ointments : but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph .
translation.kha: Phi dih waiñ na ki khuri ba-dap , bad phi pyndonkam da ki jingsleh kiba kynsai tam , hynrei phim shym ïam sngewsih halor ka jingshah pynjot ki Israel .

Ha mohkhiew ïa-shahskhor kaba laiphew khyndai ba u Asa u long syiem , u la dkoh na ka jingpang kjat kaba nym ; wat pynbudnam kyllon ruh um shym ïa-im phai sha U Trai na ka bynta ka jingïarap pynïadei hynrei sha ki lutphut .
translation.en: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet , until his disease was exceeding great : yet in his disease he sought not to the  Lord  , but to the physicians .
He is gone up to Bajith , and to Dibon , the high places , to weep : Moab shall howl over Nebo , and over Medeba : on all their heads shall be baldness , and every beard cut off .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Dibon ki kiew ïa u lum ban ïam ha ka jaka mane blei . Ki briew jong ka Moab ki la ïam ha ka jingsngewsih ïa ki nongbah jong ka Nebo bad Medeba ; ki la khi ïa la ki khlieh bad ïa u  ñiuhtmoh ha ka jingsngewsih .
Ngan pynlong ïa pha ka nuksa ba-itriem , bad kata kan long kaba kut jong pha . Ki lah ban wad pha hynrei ym lap pha . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: I will make thee a terror , and thou shalt be no more : though thou be sought for , yet shalt thou never be found again , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang ban uno ïa uno uba la don ha shuwa lane u ban sa ïoh pat . hadien
translation.en: Behold , I have done according to thy words : lo , I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart  ; so that there was none like thee before thee , neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee .
And when forty years were expired , there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sinai an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki sawphew snem ki la ïaid , u angel u la paw ha u Moses ha ki thylliej ding jong ka  lawlynnong kaba ing hajan u lum Sinai .

translation.en: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb ? Oh that I had given up the ghost , and no eye had seen me !
translation.kha: Balei , A Blei , me shah ba yn kha ïa nga ? Nga la dei ban ïap ha shuwa ba uno uno un ïohi ïa nga !
Hynrei , ka don ka khubor babha .
translation.en: But there is good news .

But Jehoiada the priest took a chest , and bored a hole in the lid of it , and set it beside the altar , on the right side as one cometh into the house of the  Lord  : and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te u Jehoïada u shim ïa ka synduk , u ksam thliew ha ka jingtap , bad u buh ïa ka synduk hajan ka duwan , ha ka phang kamon haba rung sha ka Templ . Ki lyngdoh kiba dei treikam ha ka jaka rung ki thep ha ka synduk ïa ka pisa baroh kaba la ai da ki nongwan mane .

translation.en: And thou his son , O Belshazzar , hast not humbled thine heart , though thou knewest all this  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , u khun jong u , phim shym la pynrit ïa lade , wat la phi la tip ïa kane baroh .
To ïaroh ïa , u phi ki syiem bad phi ki jaitbynriew baroh , ki khun syiem shynrang bad baroh kiwei ki nongsynshar ;
translation.en: Kings of the earth , and all people  ; princes , and all judges of the earth :
That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap , neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed : for it is a year of rest unto the land .
translation.kha: Wat ot ruh ïa u kew uba shu mih hi , bad wat kheit soh na ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba phim shym la khyllad ; ka dei ka snem ban iehnoh shrah ïa ka khyndew .

Hynrei u syiem Ussaïah u la kylla khlaiñbor , u la sngewmeng noh pynban , bad kata ïalam sha ka jong u . U ïaleh ïa U Trai U Blei da kaba leit rung sha Templ ban thang jingiwbih ka duwan thang jingiwbih .
translation.en: But when he was strong , his heart was lifted up to his destruction : for he transgressed against the  Lord  his God , and went into the temple of the  Lord  to burn incense upon the altar of incense .
Now therefore , I pray thee , let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord  ; and let the lad go up with his brethren .
translation.kha: Namar kata , ko kynrad , ieh ngan sah ma nga hangne kum u mraw jong phi ha ka jaka u para , bad shah ïa u ba un leit phai bad la ki hynmen .
Hangta la ki dkhot ba la khot Body , ka kynhun jong ki elders kiba tbit bha , ki peit ki balang ha ka pyrthei
translation.en: Located there is the Governing Body , a central group of experienced elders who oversee the worldwide congregation .

translation.kha: dier shahshkor , ko Jeremaïah ! Uwei pa Huldah ïalute kane ka ri — ki syiem ka Judah Bymman ki shaniah synshar , jingpynkit lyngdoh , bad Luhith briew — kin pynsawa pyrshah ïa Benhail . Ibleam ha kane ka sngi nga ai ha me ka peit-thuh ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki ; men long kum ka nongbah ba khyllad ker kynroh , u rishot nar , bad “Ka kynroh rnong . Kin ym lah ban jop ïa me , naba ngan don lem bad me khiah ïada ïa me . Ma nga , U Trai nga la kren .
translation.en: And they shall fight against thee  ; but they shall not prevail against thee  ; for I am with thee , saith the  Lord  , to deliver thee .

translation.kha: Shim uwei na kita ki langbrot shynrang bad , ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong . u
translation.en: Thou shalt also take one ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .

translation.kha: Ki jingïohipaw ba phi jingtylliat ki long ki bymdei Naaran Lymne ki jingmad lypa ba diengsoh pynlong ki mudui kiba shukor lytar Phi long kiba bymman bad thong sniew , bad ka sngi jong phi ka la wan , ka sngi Kata ka jingpynjot kaba Jaka . Ka waitlam kan hap ha ki ryndang khrawbor phi .
translation.en: Whiles they see vanity unto thee , whiles they divine a lie unto thee , to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain , of the wicked , whose day is come , when their iniquity shall have an end .
And I give unto them eternal life  ; and they shall never perish , neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand .
translation.kha: Nga ai ha ki ïa ka jingim bymjukut , bad kin ym ïap da lei lei ruh . Ym don uno uno uba lah ban knieh noh ïa ki na nga .
Bad U Blei , uba tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong uwei pa , uwei u la pyn-i ïa ka jingmynjur ïa ki Jentil da kaba ai ïa U Mynsiem ha Bakhuid ki , kumba u la leh ha . ngi
translation.en: And God , which knoweth the hearts , bare them witness , giving them the Holy Ghost , even as he did unto us  ;
And the  Lord  turned a mighty strong west wind , which took away the locusts , and cast them into the Red sea  ; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u la pynkylla ïa ka lyer mihngi sha ka lyer sepngi kaba jur , kaba la rong noh ïa ki puit bad bret ïa ki sha ka Duriaw Basaw . Ym shym sah shuh uwei ruh u puit ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .
Ha kane U Trai u la ïa Moses bad u ong , Kumno shaphang para jong me U Aaron , u Lebi ? Nga tip tbit bha ban kren . Ha ka jingshisha , mynta u dang wan ban ïakynduh ïa me bad un kmen ban ïa me .
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Moses , and he said , Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother ? I know that he can speak well . And also , behold , he cometh forth to meet thee : and when he seeth thee , he will be glad in his heart .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ba u Jonah la u pynlut lai sngi bad lai miet hapoh u dohkha uba heh kumta , U U Khun Briew un pynlut lai sngi bad lai miet ha kiba jylliew jong ka khyndew .
translation.en: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale s belly  ; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth .

translation.kha: Phi ieit ïa u , wat haba phim pat ïohi ïa u , bad phi ngeit u ha , wat la phim pat ïohi ïa u mynta . Te phi shadkmen da ka jingkmen khraw kaba bad kaba dap ka da burom kiba ki ktien kim lah ban batai ,
translation.en: Whom having not seen , ye love  ; in whom , though now ye see him not , yet believing , ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory :

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa nga , A Trai , haba ïarap me ïa briew ki jong me ; kynthup ïa nga ruh haba me pynim ïa ki .
translation.en: Remember me , O  Lord  , with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people : O visit me with thy salvation  ;

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , hapoh ka ïingsyiem , ka Bashti ka , mahadei ka ai ka jingkhawai na ka bynta ki kynthei .
translation.en: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban sngapjar .
translation.en: You must keep quiet .
When Jesus was on earth , he always prayed to his Father , not to anyone else .
translation.kha: Por ba u Jisu u don ha ka pyrthei , manla ka-por u duwai ha la u Kpa , ym ha kiwei pat .

translation.en: But he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as did Manasseh his father : for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made , and served them  ;
translation.kha: Kum u Manasseh u kpa jong u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad u la mane ïa ki bleithaw kiba u kpa jong u , u la mane .

Naba ba wat la phi tip ïa kane baroh , nga kwah ban pynkynmaw biang ïa phi ba kumno U Trai u la pyllait im shisien ïa ki paid Israel ka na ri Ijipt , hynrei hadien , u la pynjot ïa kito ki bym shym la ngeit .
translation.en: I will therefore put you in remembrance , though ye once knew this , how that the Lord , having saved the people out of the land of Egypt , afterward destroyed them that believed not .
Come ye , say they , I will fetch wine , and we will fill ourselves with strong drink  ; and to morrow shall be as this day , and much more abundant .
translation.kha: ‘ Ïa ngin ïawad waiñ khyndiat ,’ kine ki nongdih kyiad ki ong , ‘ bad dih katba ngi lah ! Lashai kan kham palat ban ïa kaba mynta !’

translation.en: So are the paths of all that forget God  ; and the hypocrite s hope shall perish :
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba khlem Blei ki long kum kito ki khah ; ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka duh noh , shisien ba la klet ïa U Blei .
Hato phi kynmaw jingkynrei u Tom u Trophimos ka shatri ?
translation.en: Do you remember where Tom left his umbrella ?
Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him ?
translation.kha: Haba ka jingeh ka wan , hato U Blei un ïohsngew ïa ki jingïam jong ki ?

translation.en: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan theh noh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga wat ha ki shakri , ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kumjuh .
Kyrpad kane la leh ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba ba-isaitmet Isaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u peitmat lah ong :
translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying ,
And they buried Abner in Hebron : and the king lifted up his voice , and wept at the grave of Abner  ; and all the people wept .
translation.kha: La tep ïa u Abner ha Hebron , bad u syiem u ïam da kaba kyang jam ha ka jaka tep , bad ki briew baroh ki leh kumjuh .
Hynrei Khyndiat , namar ba phi la mane ïa ki durblei jong u Sakkuth , u blei rashi jong phi , bad ïashad u Kaiwan , u blei khlur dujok! phi , phin hap ban pynlehrain ïa kito ki durblei
translation.en: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images , the star of your god , which ye made to yourselves .

translation.kha: Ki don kynshleiñ ki sakhi : U Mynsiem , ka um bad ka snam ; bad kine baroh lai ki ai ïa wahduid ka jingphla .
translation.en: And there are three that bear witness in earth , the Spirit , and the water , and the blood : and these three agree in one .

translation.kha: Nga duwai , A Blei , to kynmaw ïa u Sanballat ki la leh bad to pynshitom ïa . To kynmaw ïa kato ka kynthei , ka Noadaïah , bad baroh kiwei ki kiba la pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa nga .
translation.en: My God , think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works , and on the prophetess Noadiah , and the rest of the prophets , that would have put me in fear .

translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynñiew u put ïa la ka turoi , bad la don ki sur kiba jam ha bneng , kiba ong , Ka bor ban halor ka pyrthei ka long mynta jong Trai jong ngi bad jong U Messaïah jong , bad un synshar junom !
translation.en: And the seventh angel sounded  ; and there were great voices in heaven , saying , The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord , and of his Christ  ; and he shall reign for ever and ever .
And he cried unto the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  my God , hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn , by slaying her son ?
translation.kha: Nangta u la duwai jam ,  Ko  Trai  U Blei jong nga , balei me la leh kat kane kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ïa kane ka riewkynthei ? Ka la lehsbun shibun ban sumar ïa nga , bad mynta me pynïap ïa u khun jong ka !
Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Ki wahduid ka um kaba ai jingim kin tuid noh ka na dohnud jong u .’
translation.en: He that believeth on me , as the scripture hath said , out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water .

translation.kha: kaei kaba , ka dei kaei kaba kwah ban , kane ka pyn-i ba nga ïamynjur ba ka long dei
translation.en: If then I do that which I would not , I consent unto the law that it is good .
