translation.en: And there shall dwell in Judah itself , and in all the cities thereof together , husbandmen , and they that go forth with flocks .
And if thou wilt walk in my ways , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as thy father David did walk , then I will lengthen thy days .
translation.kha: Bad lada me kohnguh ïa nga bad sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong me u la leh , ngan ai ha me ka jingim kaba jlan .

translation.en: And he that killeth a beast , he shall restore it : and he that killeth a man , he shall be put to death .
translation.kha: Uta uba pynïap ïa uno uno u jingri u dei ban buria ïa u , hynrei uta uba pynïap ïa la u parabriew u dei ban shah pynïap .
U Dabid u la kular ba un leh kumta . Nangta jingpyntriem Saul u leit phai sha ïing , bad jyllang Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u Anna la da-ei pop biang sha la ka jakarieh .
translation.en: And David sware unto Saul . And Saul went home  ; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold .
But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body , as it hath pleased him .
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka long , U Blei u la buh ïa ki dkhot kiba ïapher ha ka met kumba u kwah ïa ki ba kin long .

translation.en: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season , the first rain and the latter rain , that thou mayest gather in thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , un sa pynhap slap ha ka khyndew jong phi ha ka aïom kaba biang , ha ka por synrai bad ha ka por pyrem , khnang ba phin ïohlum ïa u kew , ïa ka waiñ , bad ïa ka umphniang Olib na ka bynta jong phi hi , bad ïa u phlang na ka bynta ki jingri jong phi .
Kumta te , phi dei ban long kiba ïai pynkhreh jingdonkam namar ba U Khun U ba-isangsot bnai wan ha ka kynta klongsnam phim shym khmih lynti ïa jingai .
translation.en: Therefore be ye also ready : for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh .

translation.kha: U u Mikaïah ong shuh shuh : Mynta sngap ïa kaei ba Trai U u ong ! Nga ïohi ïa U Trai ba u shong ha ka khet jong u ha bneng , lem bad ki angel jong kiba u ïeng hajan jong u .
translation.en: And he said , Hear thou therefore the word of the  Lord  : I saw the  Lord  sitting on his throne , and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left .
Wherefore tongues are for a sign , not to them that believe , but to them that believe not : but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not , but for them which believe .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ka jingai ba lah ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher ka long ka jingpynshisha ha ki bymngeit , ym ha kiba ngeit , katba ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ka long ka jingpynshisha ïa kiba ngeit , ym ïa ki bymngeit .

translation.en: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue .
translation.kha: Sneng pynbeit ïa uno uno , bad hadien un ïaroh ïa ka kham bun ban ïa kaba pynroh .

translation.en: But Jesus turned him about , and when he saw her , he said ,  Daughter , be of good comfort  ; thy faith hath made thee whole .  And the woman was made whole from that hour .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai sawdong bad u la ïohi ïa ka , bad u la ong ,  To long shlur , ko ka khun jong nga ! Ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynkoit ïa pha .  Ha kata ka khyllipmat ka kynthei ka la koit .
ba ma nga , U Trai U ki Israel , nga la buh ka uwei uwei u bymkohnguh ïa ki kyndon jong kane ka jutang .
translation.en: And say thou unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel  ; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant ,

translation.kha: Hato ka dei ïa ban bud ïa ka nuksa phi bad ban kohnguh ïa U Blei jong ngi da shongkurim ïa ki kynthei nongwei ?
translation.en: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil , to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives ?

translation.kha: Teh jin Galeed ki kulai jong phi bad shong halor Athalaïah ki ! Asbuk ryntih bad phong ïa ki jingiashah khlieh jong phi ! Pynnep ïa ki sum jong shahjingit jingjemnud Kieng ïa ka iahap jong knieh !’
translation.en: Harness the horses  ; and get up , ye horsemen , and stand forth with your helmets  ; furbish the spears , and put on the brigandines .
Then David arose , and all the people that were with him , and they passed over Jordan : by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la sdang ban jam ïa ka Jordan , bad kat ban da kynjat shai mynstep , baroh ki la poi lut sha shiliang .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses  ; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment :
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la leh kumba u Moses u la lah ong ; bad ki la pan na ki nong Ijipt ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad ki jingdeng rupa , bad ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem de .

U Trai U u Blei la ong ha nga , Ko Jeremaïah ïathuh ïa , ki paid Israel ba ïa uwei pa uwei u khra buh dei waiñ ban pyndap da ka waiñ . Kin jubab ba ki tip ba ïa uwei pa uwei u khra buh waiñ dei ban pyndap da ka waiñ .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word  ; Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Every bottle shall be filled with wine : and they shall say unto thee , Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine ?

translation.kha: Bad ba ong ba u briew um dei ban klim , — hynrei phi klim ? Phi isih ïa ki bleithaw — hynrei lute phi ki ha templ ?
translation.en: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery , dost thou commit adultery ? thou that abhorrest idols , dost thou commit sacrilege ?

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la wan phai na ka ringmraw , la Niam Ka Jinglait ha sngi khatsaw jong u bnai banyngkong jong ka snem kaba bud .
translation.en: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month .
Flee out of the midst of Babylon , and deliver every man his soul : be not cut off in her iniquity  ; for this is the time of the  Lord s  vengeance  ; he will render unto her a recompence .
translation.kha: To phet noh na Babilonia ! Phet ban lait im ! Wat ai ba yn shah pynïap na ka bynta ka pop jong ka Babilonia . Nga mynta nga siew kylliang bad pynshitom ïa ka kumba ka dei hok .

translation.en: Great men are not always wise : neither do the aged understand judgment .
translation.kha: Kam dei ka rta kaba pynstad ïa ngi lane kaba ïarap ïa ngi ban tip kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: And as they sat and did eat , Jesus said ,  Verily I say unto you , One of you which eateth with me shall betray me .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang don ha ka miej ban ïabam , U Jisu u la ong ,  Nga ong ïa phi , ba uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa nga — uta uba dang ïabam bad nga .

translation.en: Riches profit not in the day of wrath : but righteousness delivereth from death .
translation.kha: Ka spah kan ym lah ban leh ïa kaei kaei kaba bha ha ka sngi ba phi ïashem ïa ka jingïap , hynrei ka jinglehhok kan pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall be known to Egypt , and the Egyptians shall know the  Lord  in that day , and shall do sacrifice and oblation  ; yea , they shall vow a vow unto the  Lord  , and perform it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynpaw ïa lade ha ki nong Ijipt , bad nangta kin tip bad kin mane ïa u , bad kin wallam ha u ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh . Kin pynlong ki jingkular kyntang ha u bad kin pyndep ïa kaei kaba ki kular .

translation.en: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat , to wave it for a wave offering before the  Lord   ; and it shall be thine , and thy sons  with thee , by a statute for ever  ; as the  Lord  hath commanded .
translation.kha: Kin wallam ïa ka kjat-dien bad ïa ka shadem katba dang kñia ïa ka khleiñ kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai . Kine ki bynta ki long ki jong me bad jong ki khun jong me pateng la pateng , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks , and into the caves of the earth , for fear of the  Lord  , and for the glory of his majesty , when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin rieh ha ki krem ha mawsiang lum lane tih thliew ha khyndew ban pyrshang ban lait na ka jingbitar jong U  Trai  bad ban rieh na ka bor bad ka burom jong u , haba u wan ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And as they led him away , they laid hold upon one Simon , a Cyrenian , coming out of the country , and on him they laid the cross , that he might bear it after Jesus .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la ïalam noh ïa U Jisu , bad katba ki dang leit , ki la ïashem ïa u briew uba ka Kyrini uba kyrteng u Simon uba la wan rung sha ka nongbah . Ki la kem ïa u , ki buh ïa ka diengphna halor jong u , bad ki la pynlong ïa u ban bah ïa ka hadien U Jisu .

translation.en: And the passover , a feast of the Jews , was nigh .
translation.kha: Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ka la jan .

translation.en: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon : and the people were very faint .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ki Israel ki jop ïa ki Philistia , ki da ïaleh shi lynter lynti naduh Mikhmash haduh Aijalon .

kem Jiw ki la ïarieh ïa une u Malkhiel bad sa ba Klemen pynïap ïa u pynkyllut Nga la ïoh jingtip ba u long u traishnong Heres Hima Rom , kumta nga la leit bad ki shipai jong nga bad jingpynsawa la tap-matlah im ïa u .
translation.en: This man was taken of the Jews , and should have been killed of them : then came I with an army , and rescued him , having understood that he was a Roman .

translation.kha: Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . briew u shem ïa ka jingkynshew ba la buhrieh hapoh ka lyngkha . U tap pat ïa ka , bad u kmen haduh katta katta ba u leit bad ïa kiei baroh kiba u la don bad nangta leit pat bad thied ïa kata ka lyngkha .
translation.en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field  ; the which when a man hath found , he hideth , and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath , and buyeth that field .
For to this end also did I write , that I might know the proof of you , whether ye be obedient in all things .
translation.kha: Nga la thoh sha phi ïa kato ka shithi namar nga la kwah eh ban tip haduh katno phi la ïeng ha kata ka jingtynjuh bad la phi la kloi borabor ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong nga .
ki dkhiew : ki dei kiba tlot kyntien hynrei ki kynshew ïa la ka jingbam mynlyiur ;

translation.en: And the covering of rams  skins dyed red , and the covering of badgers  skins , and the veil of the covering ,
Jesus answered him ,  If I have spoken evil , bear witness of the evil : but if well , why smitest thou me ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai  ; for I will give it into thine hand . And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city .

translation.en: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee ? will he enter with thee into judgment ?

translation.en: Lest the  Lord  see it , and it displease him , and he turn away his wrath from him .
For I was alive without the law once : but when the commandment came , sin revived , and I died .
translation.kha: Ma nga , shisien nga la im khlem ka hukum ; hynrei haba ka hukum ka la wan , ka pop ka khie im , bad nga la ïap .

translation.en: But if the watchman see the sword come , and blow not the trumpet , and the people be not warned  ; if the sword come , and take any person from among them , he is taken away in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at the watchman s hand .
translation.kha: Lada , kumno kumno , u nongap u ïohi ïa u nongshun ba u wan bad um shym put ïa ka turoi jingmaham , u nongshun un wan bad un pynïap noh ïa kita ki nongpop ; hynrei ngan pynkit pop ïa u nongap na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki .
Kane ka khubor ka Moab . Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Ar bad ka Kir la pynjot tang kawei miet , bad ka jingkynjah ka tap ïa ka ri Moab .
translation.en: The burden of Moab . Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste , and brought to silence  ; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste , and brought to silence  ;

Then said he unto them ,  Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder , which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old .
translation.kha: Kumta u la jubab ,  Kane ka mut , te , ba uwei pa uwei u nonghikai Aiñ uba long u synran hapoh ka Hima ki bneng u long kum u trai jong ka ïing uba la sei shabar ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai bad kiba rim napoh ka kamra kynshew jong u .

translation.en: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours , captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously , horsemen riding upon horses , all of them desirable young men .
translation.kha: Ka ruh ka dap da ka jingkwah brai ïa ki riew kynsai bad ki rangbah shipai nong Assyria — ki shipai ha ki riam shipai baphyrnai — bad ïa ki samla shipai ba-bhabriew , baroh kito ki samla shynrang ba-bhabriew .

kynran duwan rnong kaba la thaw da u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri pynjop u ksiew jong bastem Hur , jaitbynriew don ruh ha Gibeon ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon ïakajia U Trai . U syiem Solomon bad ki briew baroh ki la mane riat jingïa-pasiaw Trai hangta —Isaïah
translation.en: Moreover the brasen altar , that Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , had made , he put before the tabernacle of the  Lord  : and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it .
And I , brethren , could not speak unto you as unto spiritual , but as unto carnal , even as unto babes in Christ .
translation.kha: Kumba ka dei ban long , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ngam shym lah ban kren ha phi kumba nga kren ha ki briew kiba don U Mynsiem ; nga hap ban kren ha phi la kumba phi dei ki jong kane ka pyrthei , kum kiba dang khynnah ha ka jingngeit Khristan .

translation.en: Ye did run well ; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth ?
translation.kha: Phi la lehbha katta katta! Uei uba la pynlong ïa phi ban sangeh ban kohnguh ïa ka jingshisha ? Da kumno u la khroh ïa phi ?

translation.en: And their coast was from Aroer , that is on the bank of the river Arnon , and the city that is in the midst of the river , and all the plain by Medeba  ;
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar shaduh Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them Arnon ) bad ka nongbah kaba hapdeng jong kata ka them bad kynthup ïa ka jaka padun baroh sawdong ka Medeba .

translation.en: And Joseph returned into Egypt , he , and his brethren , and all that went up with him to bury his father , after he had buried his father .
translation.kha: Ynda u Joseph u la lah tep ïa la u kpa , u leit phai pat sha Ijipt ryngkat bad la ki hynmen ki para lem bad kita baroh kiba leit ontep ïa u kpa jong u .
Hadien ka jingphah noh ïa u paidbah u , la leit kiew ïa u lumrit marwei hi ban duwai .
translation.en: And when he had sent the multitudes away , he went up into a mountain apart to pray : and when the evening was come , he was there alone .
And these three men , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace .
translation.kha: Te u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego , kiba dang shah khum , ki la hap sha ka pdeng jong ka ding baklang .
Ha pat ka jingïohipaw la ïohi ïa u briew uba don u ka kti jong .
translation.en: I lifted up mine eyes again , and looked , and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la jubab , Naduh nga ba dang samla nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh .
translation.en: And he said , All these have I kept from my youth up .

The Lord was as an enemy : he hath swallowed up Israel , he hath swallowed up all her palaces : he hath destroyed his strong holds , and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ka ki la jop ; ki la bat ïa ka ha ka bor jong ki . U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka ban shahshitom na ka bynta ki pop kiba bun jong ka baroh . Ïa ki khun jong ka la kem bad la shah rah noh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Baasha heard it , that he left off building of Ramah , and let his work cease .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Baasha u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u sangeh na kaba tei kut ïa ka Ramah bad iehnoh ïa ka kam .

translation.en: And the bramble said unto the trees , If in truth ye anoint me king over you , then come and put your trust in my shadow : and if not , let fire come out of the bramble , and devour the cedars of Lebanon .

translation.kha: Lada u tang shu bad mon pynïap ïa nga !
translation.en: Even that it would please God to destroy me  ; that he would let loose his hand , and cut me off !

translation.kha: Kumta u Ïoannis u la sha wan ka ri shyiap , da kaba pynbaptis bad ïalap To . phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad to shah pynbaptis , u la ong ïa ki briew , bad U Blei un map noh ïa ki jong pop phi .
translation.en: John did baptize in the wilderness , and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins .
So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , and went and returned , and dwelt at Nineveh .
translation.kha: Te u Sennakherib u patsha ka Assyria u iehnoh bad leit phai sha Ninebeh .

translation.en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers ? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity ?
translation.kha: Uei uba ïeng na ka bynta jong nga pyrshah ïa ki bymman ? Uei uba don ha ka liang jong nga pyrshah ïa ki nongleh sniew ?

translation.en: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel , whose name was called Belteshazzar  ; and the thing was true , but the time appointed was long : and he understood the thing , and had understanding of the vision .

And Hadoram , and Uzal , and Diklah ,
translation.kha: ka Hadoram , ka Usal , ka Diklah ,
Namar wat Khun U Briew um shym la wan ba un shah shakri ; u la wan ban shakri bad ban aiti ïa la ka jingim ban pynim ïa kiba bun ki briew .
translation.en: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto , but to minister , and to give his life a ransom for many .

translation.kha: Don ruh ki met kynnoh kynja met! bad ki met kiba kynja doh ; ka jingitynnat sarong kita jingpynshong met kiba kynja bneng ka ïapher na Gera ïai jong kita kiba kynja doh lieng
translation.en: There are also celestial bodies , and bodies terrestrial : but the glory of the celestial is one , and the glory of the terrestrial is another .

And , behold , here cometh a chariot of men , with a couple of horsemen . And he answered and said , Babylon is fallen , is fallen  ; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground .
translation.kha: Kynsan , hangne ki wan ! Ki rangbah halor jong ki kulai , shi jur shi jur . U nongap phira u ai ka khubor ,  Ka Babilon ka la kyllon ! Baroh ki bleithaw kiba ki la mane ki la kyllon ha ka jingpait jingpra ha madan .

translation.en: Remember the word that I said unto you , The servant is not greater than his lord . If they have persecuted me , they will also persecute you  ; if they have kept my saying , they will keep yours also .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ha phi : ‘ U mraw um long kham khraw ban ïa la u Kynrad .’ Lada ki pynshitom ïa nga , kin pynshitom ïa phi ruh ; lada ki la kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , kin kohnguh ïa ka jong phi ruh .

translation.en: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received , how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures ;
translation.kha: Nga la aiti ha phi ïa kaei kaba nga la ïohpdiang , kaba long kaba donkam tam : Ba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta ki pop jong ngi , kumba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ;

translation.en: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created , till iniquity was found in thee .
translation.kha: Ka jingleh jong me ka la long kaba janai naduh ka sngi ba la thaw ïa me haduh ba me la sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew .
Ha kane jingshemphang rukom ka Baibl ka pynshai tari “ U Abraham da ka jingngeit-ba U Blei u lah ban pynmih-pat ia .—1 khun jong Telah Hamor Isak Pamphylia na ka jing iap . ”
translation.en: Thus the Bible explains : “ Abraham reckoned that God was able to raise [his son Isaac] up even from the dead . ”

translation.kha: Nangta u la ha ong ki synran , Ïa ngin ïaleit phai noh sha Judia .
translation.en: Then after that saith he to his disciples ,  Let us go into Judaea again .
And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished : there make ready .

Kumba lai kynta , ïa ka Hukum jong Trai U U Blei jong ki , la pule ha ki , bad ha ki lai kiba kynta bud , ki phla ïa la pop ki bad mane ïa U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And they stood up in their place , and read in the book of the law of the  Lord  their God one fourth part of the day  ; and another fourth part they confessed , and worshipped the  Lord  their God .
And Babylon shall become heaps , a dwellingplace for dragons , an astonishment , and an hissing , without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: Kata ka ri kan long kum ka kynton ñiut ha kaba ki mradkhlaw ki im . Kan long kaba shyrkhei ban peit ; yn ym don mano mano ban sah hangta , bad baroh kiba ïohi ïa ka kin sngewshyrkhei .

U Blei u la ong ha u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen , To Pyntrei Kane ki shalyntem jingkit ki kherub bad pyndap pynsat ki kti jong phi da ki rnga longkmie Jingpynkyllaktien . Nangta Khlieh ïa ki rnga Tang ka ïew . Nga la peit ïa u ba u leit .
translation.en: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen , and said , Go in between the wheels , even under the cherub , and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims , and scatter them over the city . And he went in in my sight .
Buried with him in baptism , wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God , who hath raised him from the dead .
translation.kha: Naba haba la pynbaptis ïa phi , la tep ïa phi bad U Khrist , bad ha ka jingpynbaptis la pynmihpat ruh ïa phi bad U Khrist da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka bor ba-ïaitrei jong U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap .

Pynban , na ka bynta jong nga , ngan sngewsarong tang shaphang ka U diengphna Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi naba ; da diengphna ka jong u , ka pyrthei ka la ïap ïa nga , bad nga la ïap ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: But God forbid that I should glory , save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom the world is crucified unto me , and I unto the world .
Kiss the Son , lest he be angry , and ye perish from the way , when his wrath is kindled but a little . Blessed are all they that put their trust in him .
translation.kha: to khynñiuh bad to nguh dem ïa u , lym kumta ïa ka jingbitar jong u yn pynkhie kynsan , bad phin ïap kyndit . Suk kita baroh kiba leit sha u ban ïoh ka jingïada .

translation.en: And likewise did he for all his strange wives , which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods .

translation.en: I indeed have baptized you with water : but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Nga pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um , hynrei un pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: No man shall take the nether or the upper millstone to pledge : for he taketh a man s life to pledge .
translation.kha: Haba phi ai kylliang ei ei ïano ïano , phim dei ban shim bynda da u mawtylliat kew jong u , namar kata ka long kumba phi shim bynda ïa ka tiar khreh bam kaba kyrshan ïa ka jingim jong u .
To wat jingtiengburom kyrkieh ha kaba buh ïa ki kti halor jongno jongno ban pynkyntang ïa briew Kynmaw ka kam U Trai . To wat ïadon bynta ha ki pop jong kiwei ; Aiu ri ïa lade uba sngur .
translation.en: Lay hands suddenly on no man , neither be partaker of other men s sins : keep thyself pure .
For ye , brethren , became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus : for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen , even as they have of the Jews :
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , kijuh kiei kiei kiba la jia ha phi ki la jia ha ki balang jong U Blei ha Judia , ha ki briew hangta kiba long ki jong U Khrist Jisu . Phi la shah ïa kijuh ki jingpynshitom beiñ na ki briew ki para ri jong phi hi kiba ki la shahshitom na ki Jiw ,

sngewlyngngoh shadem jong Gershon nguid ka long ka jingai kaba kyrpang , bad ka kjat-dien kamon ka long ka jingai . kyrpang kaba Jehonathan Trai jingïakajia la shim na ki paid Israel Un ban ai ha ki jingpyllaitluid . Kane ka long kaba ki paid Israel ki dei ban ai ha ki lyngdoh pateng la pateng .
translation.en: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings , and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel .
Now these are the commandments , the statutes , and the judgments , which the  Lord  your God commanded to teach you , that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it :
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki aiñ baroh ïa kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa nga ban hikai ïa phi . Sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .

translation.en: But who may abide the day of his coming ? and who shall stand when he appeareth ? for he is like a refiner s fire , and like fullers  soap :
translation.kha: Hynrei uei uba lah ban ïai ap ïa ka sngi haba un wan ? Uei uba lah ban lait im haba un paw ? Un long kum ka sabon basboh bha , kum ka ding kaba phrang ïa ka nar .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , I send thee to the children of Israel , to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me : they and their fathers have transgressed against me , even unto this very day .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , ngan phah ïa me sha ki paid Israel . Ki la ïaleh pyrshah bad ki phai lyndet ïa nga bad ki dang ïai pyrshah hi , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la long .

translation.en: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand , because they dealt faithfully .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba peit halor ka kam ki long kiba da khuid hok , te kim donkam ban hap ai jingkheiñ ïa ka jingmih .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families , and after the house of their fathers ,
translation.kha: Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ki tiar pynïeng Ïingjaiñ , ïa ki diengkhap , ïa ki rijied , ïa ki thliew tnaw , bad ïa ki tiar pyndait jong ka baroh . Kin kitkhlieh ruh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad kine ki tiar ki tar .

translation.en: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip , saying , Arise , and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza , which is desert .
translation.kha: U angel jong U Trai u la ong ha u Philip ,  To khreh bad leit shaphang shathie sha kata ka lynti kaba leit na Jerusalem sha Gasa .  ( Kane ka long ka lynti ka bym ju pyndonkam shuh mynta . )
ban bam ïa ka kaba la ainguh , ïa ka jingkñia bam kaba kyntang , bad kaba kyntang eh ;
translation.en: He shall eat the bread of his God , both of the most holy , and of the holy .
For the law was given by Moses , but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ai ïa ka hukum lyngba u Moses , hynrei ka jingaiei bad ka jingshisha ki la wan lyngba U Jisu Khrist .
Baroh ki briew ki la dap da ka jingkmen , bad ka nongbah ka kynjah naba mynta , la pynïap ïa ka Athalaïah ha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And all the people of the land rejoiced , and the city was in quiet : and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king s house .
Turn thou us unto thee , O  Lord  , and we shall be turned  ; renew our days as of old .
translation.kha: To wallam pat ïa ngi sha me , ko  Trai  ! To wallam pat ïa ngi ! To pynïoh pat ïa ka burom ba-mynbarim .
Pynlong ïa ka , ka sngi ka jingdum tliw bad synñia ; ïa ka da ki , bad tap noh ïa ka sngi .
translation.en: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it  ; let a cloud dwell upon it  ; let the blackness of the day terrify it .

Now therefore , our God , the great , the mighty , and the terrible God , who keepest covenant and mercy , let not all the trouble seem little before thee , that hath come upon us , on our kings , on our princes , and on our priests , and on our prophets , and on our fathers , and on all thy people , since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day .
translation.kha: A Blei , U Blei jong ngi , katno me long uba khraw ! Katno me long uba shyrkhei bad uba donbor ! Me batskhem ïa ki kular ka jingïateh jutang . Naduh ka por ba ki syiem Assyria ki banbeiñ ïa ngi , wat haduh kane ka por , haduh katno ngi shahshitom ! Ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki lyngdoh jong ngi bad ki nongïathuhlypa , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad baroh ki briew jong ngi ki shitom . To kynmaw haduh katno ngi la shahshitom !
To pan na Jehobah ban phi leh ïa kaba dei .
translation.en: Ask Jehovah to help you do what is good .

translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel halor u lum Gilboa Shibun . na ki Israel ki la shah pynïap hangta bad kiba sah na ki , kynthup ïa syiem u Saul bad ki khun jong shynrang u , ki la phet ïap .

translation.en: Behold , there is a people come out of Egypt , which covereth the face of the earth : come now , curse me them  ; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them , and drive them out .

translation.en: And in the morning , as they passed by , they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots .

The king shall mourn , and the prince shall be clothed with desolation , and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled : I will do unto them after their way , and according to their deserts will I judge them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.en: But now the  Lord  hath spoken , saying , Within three years , as the years of an hireling , and the glory of Moab shall be contemned , with all that great multitude  ; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble .
translation.kha: Bad mynta U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha ki lai snem thik , ka spah bakhraw jong ka Moab kan jah noh . Na ki briew kiba bun jong ka , tang khyndiat ki ban lait im , bad kin long kiba tlot .
Lada jia ba ha kata ka ri ki kylla-kaba-mut bad ki sha duwai me , ki da phla haduh katno ki la long kiba pop bad kiba bymman , to sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong A ki Trai .
translation.en: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives , and repent , and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives , saying , We have sinned , and have done perversely , we have committed wickedness  ;

translation.en: And Gad came that day to David , and said unto him , Go up , rear an altar unto the  Lord  in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite .

translation.en: They say unto him , Caesar s . Then saith he unto them ,  Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar s  ; and unto God the things that are God s .

translation.en: He is not the God of the dead , but the God of the living : ye therefore do greatly err .
I am clean without transgression , I am innocent  ; neither is there iniquity in me .

Knowing , brethren beloved , your election of God .

translation.en: That at that time ye were without Christ , being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel , and strangers from the covenants of promise , having no hope , and without God in the world :

translation.en: And as they went on their way , they came unto a certain water : and the eunuch said , See , here is water  ; what doth hinder me to be baptized ?

translation.en: While he was yet speaking , there came also another , and said , Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :

And he that sat upon the throne said , Behold , I make all things new . And he said unto me , Write : for these words are true and faithful .

Tang mar ïabna ïa ka jingshah pynïap u khun ka jong , ka Athalaïah , kmie ka jong u syiem Ahasaïah ka la ai hukum ban pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot jong ka longïing syiem Judah .

translation.en: And he slept and dreamed the second time : and , behold , seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk , rank and good .

translation.en: And I will bring back all the people unto thee : the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned : so all the people shall be in peace .

translation.en: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God .

translation.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark  ; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee .
But when Peter was come to Antioch , I withstood him to the face , because he was to be blamed .

translation.en: But Festus answered , that Paul should be kept at Caesarea , and that he himself would depart shortly thither .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la mareh bad u spoiñ ba la wieh ha ka waiñ bym bha , bad ba la teh ïa u ha tduh jong u dieng Nangta . u la rah shalor ha ki rmiang shyntur U Jisu bad la u ong , To ap , ngin ïakhmih la u Elijah un wan ban pynhiar ïa u na ka diengphna !
translation.en: And one ran and filled a sponge full of vinegar , and put it on a reed , and gave him to drink , saying , Let alone  ; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down .
O house of Aaron , trust in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .
translation.kha: To shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi ki lyngdoh jong U Blei . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .

translation.en: Having a good conscience  ; that , whereas they speak evil of you , as of evildoers , they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ .
translation.kha: hynrei , to leh ïa kata ha ka jingjai jai bad da kaba burom . To sumar khuid ïa ka jingïatiplem jong phi , khnang ba haba phi shah krenbeiñ , kita kiba kren sniew ïa ka jinglong jingim babha jong phi kum ki nongbud jong U Khrist kin shah lehrain na ka bynta kaei kaba ki ong .

translation.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Ahab u syiem Israel bad u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah ki leit tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .
Nongïalam ka ban dei ka Jubab ?
translation.en: What will be the answer ?

translation.kha: Kine ki rangbah ki mareh kloi sha pyrshah ka Gibeah ; ki Sabdi sha baroh ki liang ka nongbah bad put jingshahshitom ïa uwei pa uwei baroh hangta .
translation.en: And the liers in wait hasted , and rushed upon Gibeah  ; and the liers in wait drew themselves along , and smote all the city with the edge of the sword .

translation.kha: ha ki ba ma nga U Trai Nongsynshar , nga maham ïa ki da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ki briew kiba shong basah ha ki nongbah ba la pynjot kin shah pynïap . Kito kiba shong ha ka ri kin shah bam da mradkhlaw . kiba rieh ha ki lumbah ki krem kin ïap ka jingpang .
translation.en: Say thou thus unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword , and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured , and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence .

translation.kha: Ïa ka khlieh la wallam ha ka bad ai ha ka khynnah , kaba la rah ïa ka sha la ka kmie
translation.en: And his head was brought in a charger , and given to the damsel : and she brought it to her mother .
And he settled his countenance stedfastly , until he was ashamed : and the man of God wept .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elisha u peit shlip ïa u da ka jingpeit kaba ishyrkhei ïa ka khmat jong u haduh ba u Hasael u la kem pang . Kynsan u Elisha u jaw ki ummat brup .

translation.en: Then thou shalt bring her home to thine house  ; and she shall shave her head , and pare her nails  ;
translation.kha: ïalam ïa ka sha ïing jong phi , bad hangta kan khi ïa la ka khlieh , kan ot ïa la ki tyrsim ,
Ka Hagar , kaba ïeng na ka bynta u lum Sinai ha , Arabia ka long ka dur jong ka Jerusalem nongbah kaba mynta , ka shong mraw ryngkat bad ki briew jong ka baroh .
translation.en: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia , and answereth to Jerusalem which now is , and is in bondage with her children .
Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah : and the  Lord  struck him , and he died .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam um shym lah khie khlieh shuh ha ka bor jong u ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u Abijah . Ha kaba khatduh U  Trai  u shoh ïap ïa u .

translation.en: Then the king made Daniel a great man , and gave him many great gifts , and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon , and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon .
translation.kha: Te u la ai ha u Daniel ka kyrdan kaba halor , u la ai sngewbha ïa u da ki jingai kiba kynsai tam , u la buh ïa u ban khmih ïa ka probins    jong ka Babilon , bad u la pynlong ïa u , u khlieh jong baroh ki nongai jingmut ïa u syiem .

translation.en: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand , and look how thy brethren fare , and take their pledge .
translation.kha: Bad shim kine ki ktung dud    shiphew tylli sha u nongïalam rangbah . Wad jingtip kumno ki hynmen jong phi ki long bad wanrah dak ei ei ban pyn-i ba phi la ïohi ïa ki bad ba ki koit ki khiah .

translation.en: And Laban went into Jacob s tent , and into Leah s tent , and into the two maidservants  tents  ; but he found them not . Then went he out of Leah s tent , and entered into Rachel s tent .
translation.kha: U Laban u leit rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong u Jakob , nangta u leit sha ïingjaiñ jong ka Leah , bad sha ka ïingjaiñ jong kita ki ar ngut ki mraw kynthei , hynrei um shym lap ïa ki blei jong u . Nangta u leit rung sa ha ka ïingjaiñ jong ka Rakhel .
Ki set ïa u , bad ki haduh ap ba U Trai un ïathuh ïa ki kumno yn leh ïa u .
translation.en: And they put him in ward , that the mind of the  Lord  might be shewed them .
Hath not the potter power over the clay , of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour , and another unto dishonour ?
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , u briew uba thaw ïa ki khiew u don ka hok ban pyndonkam ïa ka dewbyrtha katba u kwah , bad ban thaw ar tylli ki khiew na kawei ka lyngngun dewbyrtha , ïa uwei na ka bynta ki por bakyrpang bad ïa uwei pat na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam paidbah .

translation.en: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers : every man shall be put to death for his own sin .
translation.kha: Ki kmie ki kpa kim dei ban shah pynïap namar ki kam runar ki khun jong ki , bad ki khun ruh kim dei ban shah pynïap namar ki kam runar ki kmie ki kpa jong ki ; u briew u dei ban shah pynïap tang namar ka kam runar jong u hi .

translation.en: And she answered them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Tell ye the man that sent you to me ,
translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaba la jia , bad ka ong ïa ki ban leit phai pat sha u syiem bad ban ai ha u ïa kane harum ka khubor na U  Trai  :
Ki ong Wat wan ïalam ïa kito ki shane , Ngi la leh pop lypa ïa U Trai pynbitar la biang ïa u ban pynshitom ngi . Mynta phi kwah ban leh ei ei ban nang pynkit pop ïa ngi .
translation.en: And said unto them , Ye shall not bring in the captives hither : for whereas we have offended against the  Lord  already , ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass : for our trespass is great , and there is fierce wrath against Israel .
And thou shalt set up the court round about , and hang up the hanging at the court gate .
translation.kha: Pynïeng ïa ka phyllaw kaba baroh sawdong bad wah ïa ka pyrda ha ka khyrdop jong ka .

translation.en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind , he chose out of all the choice of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians .
translation.kha: U Joab u ïohi ba ki shipai nongshun kin tur ïaleh ïa u na sha khmat bad na shadien , kumta u jied ki shipai Israel bakynsai tam bad pynap da kaba pynphai khmat ïa ki shaphang ki Syria .

translation.en: Set ye up a standard in the land , blow the trumpet among the nations , prepare the nations against her , call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat , Minni , and Ashchenaz  ; appoint a captain against her  ; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers .
translation.kha: To ai ïa ka dak ban tur ïaleh ! Put ïa ka turoi khnang ba ki jaitbynriew kin ïohsngew ! Pynkhreh ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia ! Ong ïa ki hima Ararat , Minni , bad Ashkenas ban tur ïaleh . Thung ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam ban ïalam ïa ka jingtur ïaleh . Wallam ïa ki kulai kum ka kynhun ki puit .
To thaw Lebanon pansngiat na ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba ki la Asotos , bad Shna ïa ka halor ka khlieh jong u Krit , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u khun pynjyrsieh jingkhraw Jehosadak .
translation.en: Then take silver and gold , and make crowns , and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest  ;

translation.kha: Men im da waitlam ka , Hynrei men long u mraw jong u para jong me . Pynban haba me ïeng ban ïaleh pyrshah , lait Men na ka jingsynshar jong u .
translation.en: And by thy sword shalt thou live , and shalt serve thy brother  ; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion , that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck .

translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ha ki la hynmen bad ha la u para , Nga dei u Joseph ! Shisha i pa i dang im Ki ? hynmen shynrang jong u kim lait ang shuh , la ki sheptieng shikatdei eh kat haduh ba kim lah ban jubab .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , I am Joseph  ; doth my father yet live ? And his brethren could not answer him  ; for they were troubled at his presence .

translation.kha: A katno kiba kmen long kito ki shakri kiba u kynrad jong ki u shem ba ki peitmat dang bad kiba la kloi haba u wan ! Nga ong ha phi , ba un law ïa la ka jaiñkup , un ong ïa ban ki shong , bad un shakri ki ïa .
translation.en: Blessed are those servants , whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching : verily I say unto you , that he shall gird himself , and make them to sit down to meat , and will come forth and serve them .

translation.kha: Namar kane , u Moses um shym lah ban leit rung shapoh kata ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation , because the cloud abode thereon , and the glory of the  Lord  filled the tabernacle .
And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother s sister , nor of thy father s sister : for he uncovereth his near kin : they shall bear their iniquity .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kmienah kmiesan , ne bad la ka ñiakha , baroh ar ngut ki dei ban shahshitom namar kata ka kam sang .
Haba ym don pisa ha Ijipt bad ha Kanaan , baroh ki nong Ijipt ïawan sha u Joseph , bad ki ong , Ai jingbam ba ngin bam ! Wat ai ba ngin shu ! Ngim don pisa shuh .
translation.en: And when money failed in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , all the Egyptians came unto Joseph , and said , Give us bread : for why should we die in thy presence ? for the money faileth .
Then Daniel answered and said before the king , Let thy gifts be to thyself , and give thy rewards to another  ; yet I will read the writing unto the king , and make known to him the interpretation .
translation.kha: U Daniel u la jubab ,  Buh ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong phi na ka bynta ïa lade lane ai ïa ki hano hano ha uwei pat . Ngan pule na ka bynta u Syiem Kynrad ïa kaei kaba la thoh bad ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingmut jong ka .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware .
translation.kha: U angel u jubab ,  Ka tnga jong phi ka dei ban sumar ban leh ïa kita baroh ïa kaba nga la bthah ïa ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass , while Saul talked unto the priest , that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased : and Saul said unto the priest , Withdraw thine hand .
translation.kha: Katba u Saul u dang kren ha uta u lyngdoh , ka jingkulmar ha ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ka nang kham jur ; kumta u Saul u ong ha u ,  Ym don por ban kylli ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity : the earth also shall disclose her blood , and shall no more cover her slain .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wan na ka jaka shong jong u na bneng ban pynshitom ïa ki briew jong ka pyrthei namar ki pop jong ki . Ki jingpynïap briew ha ka pyrthei ïa kiba la leh ha kaba rieh , yn pynpaw , bad ka khyndew kan ym lah shuh ban buhrieh ïa kito ïa kiba la pynïap .

Nangta U Jisu pynjlan la sdang ban hikai ïa ki synran jong u : ïor Khun U Briew Ekron dei ban Resen shibun bad jingïathong pynbieit kyntait nongïoh ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad da ki pulom ka Hukum kheiñ Un sa shah pynïap boi hynrei hadien lai sngi ) sa pynmihpat ïa u jlawnguid
translation.en: And he began to teach them , that the Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders , and of the chief priests , and scribes , and be killed , and after three days rise again .

And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites : and the children of Aaron the priest , which were of the Levites , had by lot out of the tribe of Judah , and out of the tribe of Simeon , and out of the tribe of Benjamin , thirteen cities .
translation.kha: Ki longïing na ka kur Kohath jong ka jait Lebi ki long kiba nyngkong eh ban ïoh ïa ki nongbah . Ki longïing kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron u lyngdoh ki ïoh khatlai tylli ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Judah , Simeon bad Benjamin .

Ngan pynjot ïa ki nong Assyria ha ka ri Israel jong nga bad ngan kyrdem halor jong ki lumbah jong nga . Ngan ïa pyllaitluid ki briew jong nga na ka lyngkor jong ki nong Assyria bad na jingkit kiba ki ki don ban bah .
translation.en: That I will break the Assyrian in my land , and upon my mountains tread him under foot : then shall his yoke depart from off them , and his burden depart from off their shoulders .
Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat sakhi lamler ïano ïano .

translation.en: And there is none that calleth upon thy name , that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee : for thou hast hid thy face from us , and hast consumed us , because of our iniquities .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh uba phai sha me ha ka jingduwai ; ym don uwei ruh uba leit sha me ban ïoh jingïarap . Me la buhrieh ïa lade na ngi bad iehnoh ïa ngi namar ki pop jong ngi .
Ki shyieng jong u ki khlaiñ kum ka , bad ki khohwah jong u ki long ki .
translation.en: His bones are as strong pieces of brass  ; his bones are like bars of iron .

translation.kha: U la long uba khuid bad shongksuid tarajur , hynrei Agate la kyntait ïa u , bad pynban phi la kyrpad Wat u Pilat ban leh khyrdong ka bynta jong phi ban pyllait ïa u nongpynïap briew .
translation.en: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just , and desired a murderer to be granted unto you  ;

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh , Blei ki Israel , u ong ha kito ki briew baroh kiba la shah ïa u Nebukhadnessar ban rah kum ki koidi na Jerusalem sha Babilonia :
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , unto all that are carried away captives , whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon  ;

translation.kha: Pynban , kumba la ha ong katto katne ki jaka ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid : U briew u long aïu , A Blei , ba men pyrkhat ïa u , tang uba kynja briew men , ba suidñiew ïa u ?
translation.en: But one in a certain place testified , saying , What is man , that thou art mindful of him ? or the son of man , that thou visitest him ?
And Joshua said unto Achan , My son , give , I pray thee , glory to the  Lord  God of Israel , and make confession unto him  ; and tell me now what thou hast done  ; hide it not from me .
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha u ,  Ko khun shynrang jong nga , ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha hangne ha khmat U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , bad phla . Ïathuh ha nga mynta ïa kaei kaba me la leh . Wat pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa ka na nga .

translation.en: For there are certain men crept in unawares , who were before of old ordained to this condemnation , ungodly men , turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness , and denying the only Lord God , and our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Naba don ki briew ki bymriewblei hapdeng jong ngi , kiba la syntuid noh khlem poi pyrkhat , ki briew kiba la pynkylla ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingaiei jong U Blei jong ngi , khnang ban pynksan ïa la ki jingleh bajakhlia , bad kiba kyntait ïa U Jisu Khrist , uba long tang ma u hi U Kynrad bad U Trai jong ngi . La slem bah , ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki la ïathuhlypa ïa ka jingpynrem kaba ki la ïohpdiang .
Ym don uwei na kita kiba la shong bam kiba la nongsharai balei U Jisu u la ong ïa kane ha u iw
translation.en: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him .
He shall be buried with the burial of an ass , drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Yn tep ïa u kumba tep ïa u kada , un sa shah ring bad bret ïa u shabar ki khyrdop ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the people said unto Joshua , The  Lord  our God will we serve , and his voice will we obey .
translation.kha: Nangta u paidbah u ong ha u Joshua ,  Ngin shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Ngin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .

Te U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong nga ha ong ban ha ki paidbah : Nga la pynlong ka jutang bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi mynba nga la pyllait ïa ki ka na ri Ijipt bad pyllaitluid ïa ki na ka jinglongmraw .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondmen , saying ,
You will be benefited spiritually by seeing the place called Bethel .
translation.kha: Ka jingngeit jong phi kan kham skhem da kaba ïohi ïa ka jaka ba khot ka Bethel .

translation.en: Saul also and his men went to seek him . And they told David : wherefore he came down into a rock , and abode in the wilderness of Maon . And when Saul heard that , he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon .
translation.kha: U Saul bad ki rangbah jong u ki mih ban leit wad ïa u , hynrei u la ïohsngew shaphang kata bad u la leit sha u mawsiang lum ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Maon bad u la sah hangta . Haba u Saul u tip ïa kane , u leit beh nadien u Dabid .
Blei U Badonbor Baroh u la siat da ki khnam ïa nga , bad ka bih jong ka ki par baroh kawei ka jong met nga . Da ki jingshyrkhei U Blei u la pynap riang pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me , the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit : the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me .

translation.kha: Suk ma phi kiba thngan mynta ; yn pyndap phi Suk ma phi kiba ïam mynta ; phin rkhie !
translation.en: Blessed are ye that hunger now : for ye shall be filled . Blessed are ye that weep now : for ye shall laugh .
I was at ease , but he hath broken me asunder : he hath also taken me by my neck , and shaken me to pieces , and set me up for his mark .
translation.kha: Nga la im ha ka jingsuk , hynrei U Blei u shim ïa nga na ryndang bad shoh bad pynlwet ïa nga . U Blei u pyndonkam ïa nga kum ka sohpdung

translation.en: And he said unto him , My lord knoweth that the children are tender , and the flocks and herds with young are with me : and if men should overdrive them one day , all the flock will die .
translation.kha: U Jakob u phai ktien ,  Phi tip ba ki khynnah ki tlot , bad nga dei ruh ban pyrkhat shaphang ki langbrot bad ki jingri kiba dang ai buiñ . Lada yn ñiah jubor ïa ki wat tang shi sngi ruh , baroh ki jingri kin ïap lut .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the sixth year , in the sixth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I sat in mine house , and the elders of Judah sat before me , that the hand of the Lord  God  fell there upon me .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba hynriew , jong ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , ki rangbah kiba la shah ringmraw na Judah ki ïashong bad nga ha ka ïing jong nga . Kynsan kynsan ka bor jong U  Trai  Nongsynshar ka la wan halor jong nga .

translation.en: Heaven is my throne , and earth is my footstool : what house will ye build me ? saith the Lord : or what is the place of my rest ?
translation.kha: ‘ Ka bneng ka long ka khet jong nga , ong U Trai , bad ka khyndew ka long ka jingïuhkjat jong nga . Ka ïing kaba kumno te phin tei ïa nga ? Hangno ka jaka ba ngan shong ?

translation.en: And there ran a young man , and told Moses , and said , Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp .
translation.kha: Uwei u samla u la mareh ban leit ïathuh ha u Moses shaphang kaei ba u Eldad bad u Medad ki leh .

translation.en: So kill the passover , and sanctify yourselves , and prepare your brethren , that they may do according to the word of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . Mynta pynlong ïa lade kiba la khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad pynkhreh ïa ki jingkñia ba ki para Israel kin ïoh bud ïa ki jingbthah kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses .
Pha la long Sepharbaim Jehasiel ïa ki jaitbynriew bad pynjakhlia ïa lade bad Iso Seng .
translation.en: I will do these things unto thee , because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen , and because thou art polluted with their idols .
For I have given you an example , that ye should do as I have done to you .
translation.kha: Nga la pyn-i ka nuksa ïa phi , ba phin leh kumba nga la leh ma nga ïa phi .

translation.en: And the priest shall put on his linen garment , and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh , and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar , and he shall put them beside the altar .
translation.kha: Nangta u lyngdoh , uba kup ïa ka jaiñkup linen bad uba phong ïa ka patlun linen kaba lyngkot , un weng noh ïa u dpei khleiñ ba sah ha ka duwan bad un buh ïa u harud jong ka duwan .

translation.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah , David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .
translation.kha: Haba ki Syria na Damaskos ki la phah ka kynhun shipai ban ïarap ïa u Hadadeser , u Dabid u la tur ïaleh ïa ka bad u la pynïap arphew ar hajar ngut ki rangbah .
Namar mynno ïa kine jinglehshitom kiei klop yn pynjot ha kane ka Paltiel ïasam ki briew kiba kumno phi dei ban bri ?
translation.en: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved , what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness ,

translation.kha: Lada Pyndap bieit katta katta ban shaniah ha ka jingsniew , te ka die kan long ka bainong jong u .
translation.en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity : for vanity shall be his recompence .

translation.kha: Kynmaw mynta ïa kaei kaba phi la shaphang U Trai lyngba jingïashem jong bad u . Dei ma phi ki ki kti jong phi kiba la ïohmad ïa kine ki jingïashem Phi la ïohi ïa ka jong u , ïa ka bor jong , bad ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong , ïa ki kambah jong
translation.en: And know ye this day : for I speak not with your children which have not known , and which have not seen the chastisement of the  Lord  your God , his greatness , his mighty hand , and his stretched out arm ,

translation.kha: U ïa ki wat U Trai u la ïa ki Israel ban ym ïashongkha khleh bad kine ki briew , namar kin pynlong ïa ki Israel ïa kiwei ki .
translation.en: Of the nations concerning which the  Lord  said unto the children of Israel , Ye shall not go in to them , neither shall they come in unto you : for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods : Solomon clave unto these in love .

translation.kha: Haba me la dep ïa kata , phai pyrshing pat sha ka krung kamon jong me shahshitom bad sawphew sngi namar ki kam bymman ka ïing Judah — kawei ka sngi namar kawei kawei ka snem jong ka pynshitom jingshah ki jong .
translation.en: And when thou hast accomplished them , lie again on thy right side , and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days : I have appointed thee each day for a year .
This image s head was of fine gold , his breast and his arms of silver , his belly and his thighs of brass ,

translation.en: But his bow abode in strength , and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob  ; ( from thence is the shepherd , the stone of Israel : )
