translation.kha: Wat thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ki blei da rupa ne da ka ksiar mane ïa ki nalor jong nga .
translation.en: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver , neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold .

translation.kha: Ma phi kiba baroh la nga phah sha ka jinglongmraw ha Babilonia , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai , nga ong .’
translation.en: Hear ye therefore the word of the  Lord  , all ye of the captivity , whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon :

Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness , wherein were fiery serpents , and scorpions , and drought , where there was no water  ; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint  ;
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa phi lyngba ka ri shyiap kaba ïar bad kaba ishyrkhei eh , ha kaba la don ki bseiñ kiba don bih bad ki  ñianglartham . Ha kata ka ri kaba tyrkhong bad ka bym don um , u la pynmih um na u mawsiang na ka bynta jong phi .

Nangta U Trai u Shammah jingthrang Bsuh biang ïa kato ka kti jingkhie me shapoh ka jaiñkup jong me . U ruh Jehoshaphat Eloi jingïakut , nym sngewkthang u sei ïa ka , u ïohi ba ka la koit pat , kumba ka long mynshuwa .
translation.en: And he said , Put thine hand into thy bosom again . And he put his hand into his bosom again  ; and plucked it out of his bosom , and , behold , it was turned again as his other flesh .

translation.kha: To map ka ïa pop jong ki hynrei ; lada men ym map , nga kyrpad ba men weng noh ïa ka kyrteng jong nga na kata ka kitab ha kaba me thoh la ïa ki kyrteng jong u paidlang jong me .
translation.en: Yet now , if thou wilt forgive their sin―  ; and if not , blot me , I pray thee , out of thy book which thou hast written .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki nongtuh bad ki briew bym Blei don ki im ka ha jingsuk , wat la u blei jong u long tang ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki hi .
translation.en: The tabernacles of robbers prosper , and they that provoke God are secure  ; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly .

translation.kha: Nga ainguh borabor ïa U Blei jong nga bynta na ka jong phi namar kata ka jingaiei ïa kaba u la ai ha phi da U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: I thank my God always on your behalf , for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ ;

translation.kha: Shisien na kane ka nongbah Heshbon Ka kynhun jong u Sihon ka mih kum ka ding ; Ka da pynjot ka nongbah Ar Moab Bad ka bam duh ïa ki ka bashaneng .
translation.en: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon , a flame from the city of Sihon : it hath consumed Ar of Moab , and the lords of the high places of Arnon .

translation.kha: Ka jubab , Syiem Kynrad , phi la pynlong ka jingsmai bakyntang ha nga ha ka kyrteng Trai U U Blei jong phi ba u Solomon , u khun jong nga un long syiem jong hadien phi .
translation.en: And she said unto him , My lord , thou swarest by the  Lord  thy God unto thine handmaid , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne .
I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches : so that all the trees of Eden , that were in the garden of God , envied him .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ïa u , uba itynnat , da ka jingpyiar ki tnat . U la long ka jingpihuiñ jong ki dieng baroh ha Eden , ka kper U Blei .
nga shimet Trai um shah da lei lei ba leh pop pyrshah ïa u da kaba sangeh noh ban duwai bynta jong phi . Pynban ngan hikai phi ïa kaba bha bad dei ïa phi ban leh .
translation.en: Moreover as for me , God forbid that I should sin against the  Lord  in ceasing to pray for you : but I will teach you the good and the right way :
The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning  ; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even :
translation.kha: Kñia uwei u khunlangbrot mynstep bad uwei pat ynda janmiet .
Ka bynrap , U ïa nga ngam dei ban wan phai thylli sha phi , kumta u ai ïa nga ïa u barli baroh .
translation.en: And she said , These six measures of barley gave he me  ; for he said to me , Go not empty unto thy mother in law .

translation.kha: U la phah ïa ki jong shakri u ban ïathuh ha ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ban wan sha ka jingkhawai , hynrei kim kwah ban wan .
translation.en: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding : and they would not come .

translation.kha: Ïeng ! ïa u paidbah bad ban wan khmat jong nga . Bthah ïa ki ban kiba la kloi lashai sngi , namar ma nga , U Trai Blei ki Israel nga don kane ban ong : ‘ Israel , phi don ki jong phi katto katne kiba nga la hukum ïa phi ban ! Phim lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki nongshun phi tad haduh ba phin da lait na kine kiei kiei !’
translation.en: Up , sanctify the people , and say , Sanctify yourselves against to morrow : for thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee , O Israel : thou canst not stand before thine enemies , until ye take away the accursed thing from among you .
Howbeit then , when ye knew not God , ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba la leit phim shym la ithuh ïa U Blei , kumta phi long ki mraw jong ki jingthaw ki bym dei ki blei .

translation.en: Hear this word , ye kine of Bashan , that are in the mountain of Samaria , which oppress the poor , which crush the needy , which say to their masters , Bring , and let us drink .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki kynthei ka Samaria , kiba nang sngaid kum ki masi ba la bsa bha jong ka Bashan , kiba lehbeiñ ïa kiba tlot , kiba banbeiñ ïa kiba duk , bad kiba dawa ba ki tnga jong phi kin pynbiang ïa phi da ka kyiad !
Man ka sngi u Mordekai u ju ïaid sharum shaneng khmat ka phyllaw ka ki kynthei khnang ban tip kumno ka long bad kaei ka ban jia ïa ka .
translation.en: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women s house , to know how Esther did , and what should become of her .

translation.kha: Haba u nongbylla sngi , u bym dei u nongaplangbrot u bad bym dei trai ïa langbrot ki , u ïohi ïa u suri ba u wan , u iehnoh ïa ki langbrot bad u phet noh kumta ; u suri u kynrup ïa ki langbrot bad pynsaphred ïa ki .
translation.en: But he that is an hireling , and not the shepherd , whose own the sheep are not , seeth the wolf coming , and leaveth the sheep , and fleeth : and the wolf catcheth them , and scattereth the sheep .
Dead things are formed from under the waters , and the inhabitants thereof .
translation.kha: Ki mynsiem jong kiba la ïap ki khynñiuh ha ki um hapoh ka pyrthei .

Phim kyrkhoit la thied jingiwbih ïa ïaskhem lane pynhun ïa nga jinglehsbun ka khleiñ ki jingri jong phi . Pynban ïasaidnia la bankhia ïa nga da ki jinglongkhuid jong phi ; phi la pynbtai ïa nga da ki jingbakla ba phi la leh sohwaiñ
translation.en: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money , neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices : but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins , thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities .
But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work  ; but they were men of war , and chief of his captains , and captains of his chariots and horsemen .
translation.kha: Ïa ki Israel ym shym la pyndonkam ha kaba pyntrei jubor , hynrei ki shakri kum ki shipai , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki nongai hukum ïa kali ïapom , bad ki nongshong kulai .
Ho-oid , u phlang u ïapstai bad ki syntiew ki jlop , hynrei ka ktien jong Blei U jong ngi ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: The grass withereth , the flower fadeth : but the word of our God shall stand for ever .

translation.kha: Khot hajir ïa ki jaitbynriew ban wan sha ka jingbishar . Kino ki ki kiba lah ïa ka lawei ? Kino na ki la lypa ka ban jia mynta ? Ai ba kine ki blei kin wanrah ïa sakhi jong ki ban ba ki long , ban phla ïa ka jingshisha jong ktien jong ki .
translation.en: Let all the nations be gathered together , and let the people be assembled : who among them can declare this , and shew us former things ? let them bring forth their witnesses , that they may be justified : or let them hear , and say , It is truth .
And many shall follow their pernicious ways  ; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of .
translation.kha: Wat la katta , shibun kin bud ïa ki lynti bajakhlia jong ki ; bad namar kaei kaba ki leh , kiwei kin kren sniew ïa ka Lynti jong ka jingshisha .

U dngiem u la Seeb ïa Adoniram , Ngan iwbih ïa phi tang lyndet ka jingkylli , bad Pynlong rynsan ai jaijai nga ïa ka jubab , ngan ïathuh Ksuid Shinab da kaei ka hok ba nga ïaroi ban nongthoh ïa Lykaonia kiei kiei .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I will also ask of you one question , and answer me , and I will tell you by what authority I do these things .

And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem , and called for the elders of Israel , and for their heads , and for their judges , and for their officers  ; and they presented themselves before God .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la lumlang ïa ki jait Israel baroh ha Shekhem . U la khot ïa ki tymmen ki san , ki nongïalam , ki nongbishar , bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki Israel , bad ki la ïawan sha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei .

translation.en: When Jesus had spoken these words , he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron , where was a garden , into the which he entered , and his disciples .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa kane ka jingduwai , u la mihnoh bad la ki synran bad leit sha shiliang ka wahduid ba la khot ka Kidron . Ka la don ka kper ha kata ka jaka , bad U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la rung shapoh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh s army ,
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai Babilonia ka la kynran dien noh na Jerusalem namar ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka la wan .

translation.en: The stones of it are the place of sapphires : and it hath dust of gold .
translation.kha: Ki maw jong ka khyndew ki don u mawkordor Sapphir , bad ki pui pui jong u ki don ksiar .

Nangta u Elijah u ong ha u , Elisha Mynta ap hangne ; U Trai u la hukum ïa nga ban leit sha Jerikho . Hynrei u Elisha u jubab , Nga smai da ka jingïaineh skhem jong nga ha U Trai uba im bad ha phi ngan ba ym iehnoh ïa phi . Kumta ki leit sha la Jerikho .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto him , Elisha , tarry here , I pray thee  ; for the  Lord  hath sent me to Jericho . And he said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . So they came to Jericho .
Shake thyself from the dust  ; arise , and sit down , O Jerusalem : loose thyself from the bands of thy neck , O captive daughter of Zion .
translation.kha: Kynther ïa lade , ko Jerusalem ! Ïeng joit na u pui pui bad shong halor la ka khet ! Law noh ïa ki kynjri kiba teh ïa pha , ki briew ba la shah khum jong ka Seïon !
U briew um dei ban pynïakhlad , te , ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la pynïasoh . lang
translation.en: What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .

translation.kha: U don la saw ngut ki khun kynthei ki bym pat shongkurim kiba la pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Blei .
translation.en: And the same man had four daughters , virgins , which did prophesy .
And Esther answered , If it seem good unto the king , let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him .
translation.kha: Ka Esther ka la jubab ,  Lada phi sngewbha , ko syiem , nga kwah ba ma phi bad u Haman phin long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong nga mynta ka miet ha ka jingkhawai ba nga pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi .

Bad u Joshua u ong , Balei me pynngat ha ngi ïa jynjar kaba kum kane ? U Trai mynta un pynngat ïa ka ha me ! Te ki briew baroh lynthem maw ïa u Akhan haduh ba da ïap ; ki lynthem maw bad thang ruh ïa ki ba-ha-ïing jong u bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong
translation.en: And Joshua said , Why hast thou troubled us ? the  Lord  shall trouble thee this day . And all Israel stoned him with stones , and burned them with fire , after they had stoned them with stones .
And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the  Lord  , and to record , and to thank and praise the  Lord  God of Israel :
translation.kha: U Dabid u thung katto katne ki Lebi ban ïalam ïa ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , da ki jingrwai bad ki jingïaroh ïa u .

U u Gaal ong , Ki rangbah kiba kumno ngi long ha Shekhem ? Balei ba ngi shakri ïa u Abimelekh ? U dei uei uta ? U khun jong u Gideon ! u Bad Sebul u la ïoh hukum na u , hynrei balei ngi dei ban shakri ïa u ? To ïaineh ha u Hamor , u kpa tymmen jong phi uba , la seng ïa kur ka phi jong !
translation.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed said , Who is Abimelech , and who is Shechem , that we should serve him ? is not he the son of Jerubbaal ? and Zebul his officer ? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem : for why should we serve him ?
As for the sons of Merari , thou shalt number them after their families , by the house of their fathers  ;
translation.kha: Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ïa ka miej , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak , ïa ki duwan , ïa ki khiew ki pliang ba ki lyngdoh ki pyndonkam ha ka Jaka Kyntang , bad ïa ka pyrda ha ka jingkhang sha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam . Kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad kine tiar ki tar .
Un jah na noh ka jaka kaba u ju shong ju sah ;
translation.en: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more  ; neither shall his place any more behold him .
But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father .
translation.kha: Katba u dang khynnah , don ki briew ki ban sumar ïa u bad pynïaid ïa ki kam jong u tad haduh ban da poi ka por ba la buh da u kpa jong u .

Nga ong ha u Syros , ‘ Me long Shaaraim u ban synshar na Pharoah bynta jong jingkynha ; men leh ïa kaei domriang nga kwah ïa phi ban leh ; men hukum ïa Suriel Jerusalem ban tei biang bad ïa ki nongrim khiew ka kyrteng ban seng pat .’
translation.en: That saith of Cyrus , He is my shepherd , and shall perform all my pleasure : even saying to Jerusalem , Thou shalt be built  ; and to the temple , Thy foundation shall be laid .
And I will send hornets before thee , which shall drive out the Hivite , the Canaanite , and the Hittite , from before thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pyntieng kulmar ïa ki nongshun jong phi . Ngan beh noh ïa ki Hib , ki Kanaan , bad ki Hit katba phi nang tur sha khmat .

translation.en: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynsakma ïa pha kum ïa u phlangïap uba la beh noh da ka lyer ri shyiap .
lah shah shuh , nga dei ban .
translation.en: I will speak , that I may be refreshed : I will open my lips and answer .
For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets , and thou hast given them blood to drink  ; for they are worthy .
translation.kha: Ki la theh noh ïa ka snam jong ki briew jong U Blei bad jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad kumta me la ai ha ki ïa ka snam ban dih . Ki la ïoh ïa kaba ki dei hok ban ïoh !

translation.en: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus , namely , upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingpynbna kan treikam ha baroh ka hima Persia ha ka sngi ba la buh na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa ki Jiw , ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , u bnai uba khat-ar .

translation.en: And when the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , the  Lord  raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel , who delivered them , even Othniel the son of Kenaz , Caleb s younger brother .
translation.kha: Te ki Israel ki la kyang ha U  Trai  , bad u la phah ïa uwei u briew ban pyllait ïa ki . Une u dei u Othniel , u khun jong u Kenas uba dei u para jong u Kaleb .

translation.en: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : for the anointing oil of the  Lord  is upon you . And they did according to the word of Moses .
translation.kha: Wat mih shabar ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ïoh phi ïap , namar la pynkyntang ïa phi da ka umphniang pynsleh jong U  Trai .  Kumta ki la leh kumba u Moses u la ong .
U Trai un ïaleh ka na bynta jong phi , bad phim donkam ban leh ei ei ruh em .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall fight for you , and ye shall hold your peace .
Tom lives in his own world .
translation.kha: U Tom u im ha la ka jong ka pyrthei
san tba na phi phin jop ïa ki shispah ngut , bad shispah ngut na phi phin jop ïa ki shiphew hajar ngut .
translation.en: And five of you shall chase an hundred , and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight : and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword .

translation.kha: Lada u shñiuh ha ka dak ding khluit u la kylla lieh bad kata ka dak kham ka jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong , ka kata ka dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh kaba la sdang na kata kaba khluit ding , bad u un lyngdoh pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid .
translation.en: Then the priest shall look upon it : and , behold , if the hair in the bright spot be turned white , and it be in sight deeper than the skin  ; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning : wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is the plague of leprosy .

But Jesus answered and said ,  Ye know not what ye ask . Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of , and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?  They say unto him , We are able .
translation.kha: Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phi pan ,  U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki khun shynrang jong ka .  Hato phi lah ban dih ïa ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ïa kaba ngan sa dih ?   Ngi lah ,  ki la jubab .
Baroh shi miet , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u la ïaid na sha Gibeon bad ki la tur kyndit ban ïaleh ïa ki Amor .
translation.en: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly , and went up from Gilgal all night .
I say unto you , that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth , more than over ninety and nine just persons , which need no repentance .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , nga ong ha phi , kan don ka jingkmen kaba kham bun ha bneng halor uwei u nongpop uba kylla-kaba-mut ban ïa ki khyndaiphew khyndai ki briew badonburom ki bymdonkam ban kylla-kaba-mut .

translation.en: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord , and he shall lift you up .
translation.kha: To phin pynrit ïa lade ha khmat U Trai , bad un pynkhraw ïa phi .
U Trai Nongsynshar ong u : Ko khun u briew , to kren pyrshah ïa Gog u , u nongsynshar rangbah jong ki jaitbynriew ka Meshekh bad ka bad Tubal ïathuh ïa u ba nga long u nongshun jong u .
translation.en: Therefore , thou son of man , prophesy against Gog , and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Gog , the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal :
And after this it came to pass , that David smote the Philistines , and subdued them : and David took Metheg–ammah out of the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , u Syiem Dabid u la tur ïaleh biang ïa ki Philistia , u la jop ïa ki bad la pynkut noh ruh ïa ka jingsynshar jong ki halor ka ri .

translation.en: Dominion and fear are with him , he maketh peace in his high places .
translation.kha: U Blei u long uba donbor ; baroh ki dei ban ïeng ha ka jingsheptieng ïa u ; U pynïeng ïa ka hima ba kynja bneng ha ka jingsuk .

translation.en: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous : but with kings are they on the throne  ; yea , he doth establish them for ever , and they are exalted .
translation.kha: U ïada ïa kito kiba hok ; u shah ïa ki ban synshar kum ki syiem bad u shah ïa ki ba kin ïoh ka jingpyndonburom junom .

translation.en: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely : but he that perverteth his ways shall be known .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ïaid hok ki shongshngain bad sngewskhem , hynrei uta u bym lehhok un shah kem .

translation.en: And the  Lord  came , and stood , and called as at other times , Samuel , Samuel . Then Samuel answered , Speak  ; for thy servant heareth .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u wan bad u ïeng hangta , bad u khot kum mynshuwa ,  Samuel ! Ko Samuel !  U Samuel u jubab ,  To kren ; u shakri jong me u shahshkor .
Ki jong ki , ki jingisih ki , ki jingkwah jong ki , baroh ki ïap lem bad ki Kin lah shuh da lei lei ban ïashim bynta ha kano kano kaba jia ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Also their love , and their hatred , and their envy , is now perished  ; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun .

translation.kha: Hato phi la ju tip ba don uno uno na ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ne uwei Pharisi u kiba ngeit ha u ?
translation.en: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba ki long kiba la tim ; kaei kaba ki leh ïa kiwei mynta leh ka ki
translation.en: Woe unto the wicked ! it shall be ill with him : for the reward of his hands shall be given him .

translation.kha: ar Ki kynhun kiba lait ban wan trei ha ka sngi Sabbaton ki dei ban ïeng ap phira ha ka Templ ban ïada ïa syiem u .
translation.en: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath , even they shall keep the watch of the house of the  Lord  about the king .
The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee , thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , whose habitation is high  ; that saith in his heart , Who shall bring me down to the ground ?
translation.kha: Ka jingsarong jong pha ka la shukor ïa pha . Ka nongbah jong pha ka long ka kut mawsiang baskhem ; ka ïing jong pha ka don ha kliar ki lumbah , bad kumta phi ong ha lade , ‘ Uei uba lah ban pynhiar ïa nga sha tbian ?’
Nangta u Kain u ong ïa u Abel u para jong u , Ïa ngin ïaleit sha lyngkha . Haba la ki don ha lyngkha , u Kain u la shoh ïa la u para bad u pynïap la u ïa .
translation.en: And Cain talked with Abel his brother : and it came to pass , when they were in the field , that Cain rose up against Abel his brother , and slew him .

translation.kha: namar ka khun marwei jong u , kaba la khat-ar snem ka Kolaïah , ka Tad jan ïap . Katba U Jisu jingdawa dang ïaid , ki briew shibit la ïalum sawdong ïa u na ki liang jingïathuhlypa .
translation.en: For he had one only daughter , about twelve years of age , and she lay a dying . But as he went the people thronged him .

translation.kha: la ieh ïa doh jong nga ha ka jing-lhieh bad la pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong nga .
translation.en: My flesh and my skin hath he made old  ; he hath broken my bones .

translation.kha: Hynrei kine ki briew , tur ïaleh da kaba krenbeiñ da kiei kiba kim ; bad kito kiei kiba ki tip da tipthuh ki mradkhlaw , ki long kita hi kiei kiei kiba pynjot ki .
translation.en: But these speak evil of those things which they know not : but what they know naturally , as brute beasts , in those things they corrupt themselves .

translation.kha: Ki mradkhlaw kin ïaid kai hangta , bad ki ksuid kin ïakhot para ma . mrad kynsha ba shang mynmiet un wan hangta bad un wad jaka shongthait .
translation.en: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island , and the satyr shall cry to his fellow  ; the screech owl also shall rest there , and find for herself a place of rest .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Ka por kan poi haba ngan pyndep ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong bad paid ki bad Israel Judah .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah .
And it was so , that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance , he put forth his hand , and took him , and kissed him .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u wan hajan u Absalom ban nguh ha khmat jong u , u Absalom u ju kner la ki kti , u bat ïa u , bad u doh ïa u .

Keep thy heart with all diligence  ; for out of it are the issues of life .
translation.kha: Da phikir kumno phi pyrkhat ; naba ki jingpyrkhat jong phi ki saiñdur ïa ka jingim jong phi .
Kane jia ha ka sngi Sabbaton , kumta ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ong ïa uta u briew uba la ïohkhiah , ka dei ka sngi Sabbaton bad ka long pyrshah ïa ka jong ïa me ban rah ïa ka jingthiah .
translation.en: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured , It is the sabbath day : it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed .
Therefore being a prophet , and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him , that of the fruit of his loins , according to the flesh , he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne  ;
translation.kha: U la long u nongïathuhlypa , bad u la tip aïu U Blei u la kular ïa u : U Blei u la pynlong ka jingsmai ba un pynlong syiem ïa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid , kumba u Dabid u la long .
jingiehnoh ki nongbah baibam ki nongrit jong ki Haoid ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Naphtali ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families , the cities and their villages .

And the  Lord  was gracious unto them , and had compassion on them , and had respect unto them , because of his covenant with Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , and would not destroy them , neither cast he them from his presence as yet .
translation.kha: hynrei U  Trai  u long uba bha bad leh-isynei ïa ki . Um shah ba yn pynjot ïa ki , hynrei u ïarap ïa ki , namar ka jutang jong u bad u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob . Um pat ju klet ïa la ki briew .

translation.en: In journeyings often , in perils of waters , in perils of robbers , in perils by mine own countrymen , in perils by the heathen , in perils in the city , in perils in the wilderness , in perils in the sea , in perils among false brethren ;
translation.kha: Ha ki jingleit jong nga kiba bun nga la don ha ka jingma na ki jingshlei um bad na ki nonglute , ha ka jingma na ki para Jiw bad na ki Jentil ; ki la don ki jingma ha ki nongbah , ki jingma ha ki ri khlaw , ki jingma ha ki duriaw-bah , bad ki jingma na ki paralok kiba shukor .

translation.en: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy : and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment , thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place .
translation.kha: Uno uno ne uei uei uba ktah ïa ka doh jong uta u jingkñia un mynsaw da ka bor jong ka jingkhuid jong ka . Lada kano kano ka bynta jong jaiñkup ka bit snam na uta u jingkñia , dei ban sait ïa ka ha ka jaka bakhuid .

translation.en: Though it be given him to be in safety , whereon he resteth  ; yet his eyes are upon their ways .
translation.kha: U Blei u lah ban shah ïa u ban im khlem jingpynthut , hynrei u peit-thuh pat ïa u man la ka por .

translation.en: Being then made free from sin , ye became the servants of righteousness .
translation.kha: La pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka pop bad phi la long pat ki mraw jong ka hok .

Pynbna ha u paidbah , ‘ Uno uno sheptieng uba u ban dei leit phai noh sha ïing , bad ngi ngin sah hangne ha u lum Gilead .’ Kumta arphew ar ngut hajar ki leit phai noh , bad shiphew hajar ngut ki sah .
translation.en: Now therefore go to , proclaim in the ears of the people , saying , Whosoever is fearful and afraid , let him return and depart early from mount Gilead . And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand  ; and there remained ten thousand .

translation.kha: Ma phi , ko ba-ieit jong nga , to pynskuiñ ïa ki rangbah kumba ka kulai ka pynskuiñ ïa ki kulai jong ki kali biar shai u Pharaoh .
translation.en: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart : behold , he standeth behind our wall , he looketh forth at the windows , shewing himself through the lattice .
Nevertheless for thy great mercies  sake thou didst not utterly consume them , nor forsake them  ; for thou art a gracious and merciful God .
translation.kha: Bad pynban , namar ka jingkhraw ka jingisynei jong me , mem shym iehnoh ne pynjot ïa ki . Me long U Blei ka jingaiei bad ka jingisynei !

translation.en: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled , and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel , which ye have heard , and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven ; whereof I Paul am made a minister ;
translation.kha: Phi dei , da shisha , ban ïaineh ha ka nongrim kaba skhem bad kaba thikna , bad phim dei ban shah ïa lade ban shah pynkhynñiuh na ka jingkyrmen kaba phi la ïoh myn haba phi la ïohsngew ïa ka gospel . Ka dei na kane ka gospel ba ma nga u Paul , nga la kylla long u shakri — kane ka gospel kaba la ïalap ha uwei pa uwei ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp , and said , Who is on the  Lord s  side ? let him come unto me . And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him .
translation.kha: Kumta u ïeng ha ka khyrdop jong ka jaka sher dara , bad u la pyrta ,  Kat uba don ha ka liang jong U  Trai  , wan shane !  Kumta baroh kiba na ka jait Lebi ki ïalumlang ha u ,
A Trai , me la pynlong ïa ka hima jong ngi ban roi , da kaba pynïar ïa ka ri ha baroh sawdong , kane bad ka la ïa wallam me ka burom .
translation.en: Thou hast increased the nation , O  Lord  , thou hast increased the nation : thou art glorified : thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth .
And the Amorites , which dwelt in that mountain , came out against you , and chased you , as bees do , and destroyed you in Seir , even unto Hormah .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Amor kiba shong ha kita ki lum ki la wan tur pyrshah ïa phi kumba beh u ngap . Ki la beh ïa phi shaduh Hormah , bad ki la jop ïa phi hangta ha ri lum Edom .

translation.en: As it is written in the prophets , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .
translation.kha: Ka sdang kumba u Isaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la thoh :  U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien ha shuwa jong phi ban pynkhreh lynti na ka bynta jong phi .’

translation.en: For this child I prayed  ; and the  Lord  hath given me my petition which I asked of him :
translation.kha: Ïa une u khunlung nga la pan na u , bad u la ai ha nga ïa kaba nga la pan .
ba u Job u kren da ka jingbymtip kano bad kano kaba u ong kam don jingmut .
translation.en: Job hath spoken without knowledge , and his words were without wisdom .
( For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt  ; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by  ;
translation.kha: Phi kynmaw kumno ngi la im ha Ijipt bad kumno ka la jia bad ngi haba ngi ïaid lynti na ka ri jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: Behold , therefore I will bring strangers upon thee , the terrible of the nations : and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom , and they shall defile thy brightness .
translation.kha: ngan wanrah ki nongshun kiba sniew ban tur ïaleh ïa me . Kin pynjot ïa kiei kiei kiba itynnat baroh kiba me la pynïoh da ka jingtbit bad jingstad jong me .

shabar step phyrngab ha ka Sngi Kyrteng Emerald Konanaïah katba ka dang dum , ka Mari ka nong Magdala ka la leit Uriel kata ka jingtep bad Shallekheth la ïohi lui ïa u mawkhang Pynngam Gether noh na bnai jingkhang ka jingtep .
translation.en: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early , when it was yet dark , unto the sepulchre , and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre .

And as the king passed by , he cried unto the king : and he said , Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle  ; and , behold , a man turned aside , and brought a man unto me , and said , Keep this man : if by any means he be missing , then shall thy life be for his life , or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver .
translation.kha: Katba u syiem u dang ïaid , u nongïathuhlypa u khot ïa u bad ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , katba nga dang ïaleh thma , u shipai u wallam sha nga ïa u nongshun ba shah kem bad u ong , ‘ Ap bha ïa une u briew ; lada u lait phet , phin hap ban siew da la ka jong ka jingim lane phin hap siew kuna lai hajar ki sbai rupa .’
Pynban mynta me ïai leh shuh shuh ; me la pynlong ki kular na ka bynta ki khun ki ksiew jong ha ki ki ban wan bad me , ko Trai U Blei , me la lah pynlong ïa nga kum u briew uba khraw .
translation.en: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes , O God  ; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant s house for a great while to come , and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree , O  Lord  God .
He that believeth on me , as the scripture hath said , out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Ki wahduid ka um kaba ai jingim kin tuid noh na ka dohnud jong u .’
Ïa jong jaitbynriew la shna da ka rupa bad ka ksiar ; la pynwandur da ki kti ki briew .
translation.en: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold , the work of men s hands .

translation.kha: Phestos u la sah sa ne shiphew lem bad ki bad nangta u sha Kaisaria . Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la shong ha ka bad u la hukum ban wallam shapoh ïa Paul .
translation.en: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days , he went down unto Caesarea  ; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought .
And they returned , and prepared spices and ointments  ; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha ïing bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ki musla bad ki jingiwbih na ka bynta ka met . Ha ka sngi Sabbaton ki la shongthait , kumba ka Hukum ka dawa .

translation.en: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him  ; and they feared the people : for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them .
translation.kha: Ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa U Jisu hangta hi , namar ki la tip ba u la ïathuh ïa kane ka pharshi pyrshah ïa ki ; hynrei ki la ïasheptieng ïa ki paidbah .
Shisien uwei u briew u la wan sha U Jisu . Ko Nonghikai , u la kylli , kaei kaba bha jingdih nga Peniel jingphna leh ba ngan ïoh ïa ka Kore bymjukut ?
translation.en: And , behold , one came and said unto him , Good Master , what good thing shall I do , that I may have eternal life ?
Thou shalt not kill .
translation.kha: Wat pynïap briew .

translation.en: The fear of man bringeth a snare : but whoso putteth his trust in the  Lord  shall be safe .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba ma ban sngewkhia ïa kaei kaba kiwei ki pyrkhat shaphang jong phi , hynrei lada phi shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi long shngain .
un phah ha phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ïa ki jingpang bym pynkoit lah bad ïa jingïapthem ki kiba sngewtriem bad kiba neh slem .
translation.en: Then the  Lord  will make thy plagues wonderful , and the plagues of thy seed , even great plagues , and of long continuance , and sore sicknesses , and of long continuance .

translation.kha: Namar jong ka , u syiem u la lehbha ïa u Abram bad u la ai ha u ki kynhun langbrot bad ki blang , masi ki , ki kada , ki mraw bad ki . ut
translation.en: And he entreated Abram well for her sake : and he had sheep , and oxen , and he asses , and menservants , and maidservants , and she asses , and camels .

And the Lord  God  of hosts is he that toucheth the land , and it shall melt , and all that dwell therein shall mourn : and it shall rise up wholly like a flood  ; and shall be drowned , as by the flood of Egypt .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u ktah ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka khynñiuh baroh kiba shong ha ka ki ïambriew , ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka kiew ka hiar kum ka wah Nile .

U Haba Khrist u la ïaid lyngba kane ka ïingjaiñ bad rung tang shisien shapoh ka Jaka Bakyntang Tam , um shym la shim ïa ka snam ki blang bad masi ki kyrtong ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ; hynrei , u shim ïa la ka jong ka snam , bad ka pynïoh ïa jingim bymjukut na ka bynta jong ngi .
translation.en: Neither by the blood of goats and calves , but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place , having obtained eternal redemption for us .

translation.kha: Hadien ka Armagedon , yn sa pynlong ïa pyrthei ka Paradais
translation.en: After Armageddon , earth will be made into a paradise

translation.kha: Nangta u lyoh u la paw bad u la tap ïa ki da ka syrngiew jong u , bad ka sur la ka na wan u lyoh , Une long u U Khun ba-ieit eh jong nga — to shahshkor ïa u !
translation.en: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them : and a voice came out of the cloud , saying , This is my beloved Son : hear him .
* Jesus’ first action as King was to throw Satan and his demons down to the earth .
translation.kha: * Ka kam kaba nyngkong eh kaba u Jisu u la leh ka long ban shop ïa u Soitan bad ïa ki ksuid jong u sha ka pyrthei .
Kiwei pat ki briew long ki kiba khwan myntoi bad kiba kyntait ïa kaei kaba dei , khnang ban bud kaei ïa ka bym dei ; halor jong ki U Blei un theh noh ïa la ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar . shla
translation.en: But unto them that are contentious , and do not obey the truth , but obey unrighteousness , indignation and wrath ,
A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment .
translation.kha: Ki nongbishar kiba bamsap ki pdiang ïa ki jingai ha kaba rieh , bad nangta kam don ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: Then I looked , and , behold , in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone , as the appearance of the likeness of a throne .
translation.kha: Nga la khmied sha tnum halor ki khlieh ki kherub bad halor jong ki ka don kaei kaei kaba i kum ka khet ba la shna na u mawkordor sapphir .
Ka sawlyer jia ryngkhat ba u lyngdoh u bynshet jingpynshisha hiar na kata ka lynti ; hynrei haba u la ïohi ïa uta u Gomer , u la ïaid praw Ïateh kawei ka liang .
translation.en: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way : and when he saw him , he passed by on the other side .
And he said ,  The things which are impossible with men are possible with God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei ka bym lah ha u briew ka long kaba lah ha U Blei .

Ka pynngam ka la jan Naarah , ka sngi ka la jan sping . To ngin ïasangeh noh na Pukri leh ïa kiei puid kiba long jong ka jingdum hajir bad to ïa-ïam kieng ïa ki atiar ka jingïaleh Tappuah ka jingshai .
translation.en: The night is far spent , the day is at hand : let us therefore cast off the works of darkness , and let us put on the armour of light .
I say the truth in Christ , I lie not , my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost ,
translation.kha: Nga kren ïa ka jingshisha , nga long u jong U Khrist bad ngam kren ïa ka bymshisha . Ka jingïatiplem , ba la synshar da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ruh ka kren skhem ba ngam kren ïa ka bymshisha

translation.en: Go thou near , and hear all that the  Lord  our God shall say : and speak thou unto us all that the  Lord  our God shall speak unto thee  ; and we will hear it , and do it .
translation.kha: Khie leit biang , ko Moses , bad shahshkor ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u don ban ong . Nangta wan phai pat bad ïathuh ha ngi aïu u la kren ha phi . Ngin shahshkor bad kohnguh ïa ka .’

Khie Apollonia biang , ko Moses , bad dem ïa khiat Mynta baroh kat kaba naduh Trai U Blei jingkem ngi u don ban klong . Nangta wan phai pat bad ïathuh ha ngi aïu u la Kajuh pynbudnam phi . Ngin jingkñia bad pynïoh ïa ka .’
translation.en: Go thou near , and hear all that the  Lord  our God shall say : and speak thou unto us all that the  Lord  our God shall speak unto thee  ; and we will hear it , and do it .

translation.kha: Ka la ïam shaphang kata baroh ha kita ki hynñiew sngi jong ka jingkhawai . Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u ïathuh ha ka , ka mut aïu kata ka jingkyntip , ka naba ïai thlia ïa u katta katta Nangta . ka ïathuh pat ha kita ki Philistia .
translation.en: And she wept before him the seven days , while their feast lasted : and it came to pass on the seventh day , that he told her , because she lay sore upon him : and she told the riddle to the children of her people .
And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water :
translation.kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un hukum ban pynïap ïa kawei na kita ki sim halor u khiew khyndew ha uba don ka um kaba sngur na ka umpohliew .
adkar Trai u ong , To shahshkor , phi ki briew kiba Neraïah ! To peit rhem , phi kiba luin !
translation.en: Hear , ye deaf  ; and look , ye blind , that ye may see .
When I went out to the gate through the city , when I prepared my seat in the street !
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah jong ka nongbah ki ïakynduh lang nga long uwei napdeng jong ki ,

translation.en: The legs of the lame are not equal : so is a parable in the mouth of fools .
translation.kha: U bieit u lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka proberb tang kumba u briew uba dkoh u lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria , and said , What do these feeble Jews ? will they fortify themselves ? will they sacrifice ? will they make an end in a day ? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned ?
translation.kha: Ha khmat ki paralok jong u bad ki shipai Samaria u ong ,  Kaei , kine ki Jiw shem-lanot , ki tharai ba ki leh ? Hato ki pyrkhat ba da ka jingkñia jingainguh ki lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam ha ka shi sngi ? Hato ki lah ban pynlong ïa ki maw jingtei na ki kynton jong ki synrum ba la ing ?
Nga la shaniah ha me shi lynter ka jong nga ; ïada nga naduh ka ba la kha ïa nga . Ngan ïai ïaroh ïa me .
translation.en: By thee have I been holden up from the womb : thou art he that took me out of my mother s bowels : my praise shall be continually of thee .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u shim ïa kata ka na snam ki dabor u bad synreit ïa ka ha uta u paidbah . U ong , Kane ka long ka snam kaba ïa pynskhem ka jutang kaba U Trai u la pynlong bad phi , mynba u ai ïa kine ki hukum baroh .
translation.en: And Moses took the blood , and sprinkled it on the people , and said , Behold the blood of the covenant , which the  Lord  hath made with you concerning all these words .
And they said , Some say that thou art John the Baptist : some , Elias  ; and others , Jeremiah , or one of the prophets .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki ong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ki la jubab .  Kiwei pat ki ong u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong u Jeremaïah lane uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Then I arose , and went forth into the plain : and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  stood there , as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar : and I fell on my face .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit sha ka them , bad hangta nga ïohi ïa ka burom U  Trai  , kumba nga la ïohi ïa ka harud ka wah Khebar .

translation.en: And straightway all the people , when they beheld him , were greatly amazed , and running to him saluted him .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu , ki la sngewlyngngoh shikatdei eh , bad ki la wan mareh sha u ban khublei ïa u .

Ngi la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah jinglehniam me , pynmeng ïa me , bad ngim treh ban pynjakhlia ïa me . Ngi la banbeiñ ïa kiwei bad phai lyndet na me . Ki jingmut jong ngi ki jingotsher kiba ïaid ; ki ktien jong ngi ki long sngewtieng lamler .
translation.en: In transgressing and lying against the  Lord  , and departing away from our God , speaking oppression and revolt , conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood .

And it came to pass , when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God , which had cried against the altar in Beth–el , that he put forth his hand from the altar , saying , Lay hold on him . And his hand , which he put forth against him , dried up , so that he could not pull it in again to him .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Jeroboam u ïohsngew ïa kane , u kdew ïa u bad u hukum ,  Kem ïa uto u briew !  Mar kumta hi ka kti u syiem ka long kumba ïap haduh ba um lah pynkhun shuh ïa ka .

translation.en: The mountains skipped like rams , and the little hills like lambs .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki ryngkoh kum ki blang ; ki lumrit , ki kynthih kum ki khunlangbrot .
To Bosrah uba mutlop ! To long uba matlah ! To long uba jingshet khlem jingbatbor kano ka waiñ ! To ïaid sheng sheng khlem dih wat tang barieh jaw !
translation.en: Stay yourselves , and wonder  ; cry ye out , and cry : they are drunken , but not with wine  ; they stagger , but not with strong drink .

translation.kha: Aretas shane , nga don ar ngut phasi khun kynthei Abida dang sotti . Shah ngan wallam ïa ki sha phi , bad janmiet lah ban leh ïa ki katba Pynthikna mon . Hynrei wat leh ei ei ïa kine kaweh rangbah setkut ki dei kiba nga la khot sngewbha sha Arumah ïing por nga , bad nga dei ban Suki ïa ki kopi
translation.en: Behold now , I have two daughters which have not known man  ; let me , I pray you , bring them out unto you , and do ye to them as is good in your eyes : only unto these men do nothing  ; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof .

translation.kha: Suk uta u briew uba ïaineh ïa-tylli thut jingtynjuh , namar ynda u jop haba u bleithaw) ïaid lyngba ksiar kaba kum kata ka Salmon , un ïohpdiang kum Jamynrei bainong jong u ïa ka jingim kaba U Blei u la kular ha kito kiba ieit gram u .
translation.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation : for when he is tried , he shall receive the crown of life , which the Lord hath promised to them that love him .
And behold at eveningtide trouble  ; and before the morning he is not . This is the portion of them that spoil us , and the lot of them that rob us .
translation.kha: Ha ka por janmiet ki pynlong ka jingpyntriem , hynrei kat ban da step ki la jah noh . Kata ka dei ka kupar jong uwei uwei uba lute ïa ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: As in water face answereth to face , so the heart of man to man .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka durkhmat jong phi hi kaba phalang ha ka um bad ka dei ka malade jong phi hi kaba phi ïohi ha ka dohnud jong phi .

Hapoh ka jingsynshar jong , baroh ki dkhot kiba jong ka met ki ïabiang lang sbiak , ïa ka met baroh kawei la bat lang da kawei pa kawei ka jingïapyndait ïa kaba pynbiang Kumta haba kawei pa kawei bynta kaba ïatrei kam kumba ka dei ban trei , ka met baroh kawei ka bad ka tei ïa lade da jingieit .
translation.en: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth , according to the effectual working in the measure of every part , maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love .

translation.kha: Ki dei ban da thet la bad sait ïa la ki kjat ba kin ym ïap . Kane ka long ka hukum kaba ma ki bad ki khun ksiew jong ki dei bud junom la junom .
translation.en: So they shall wash their hands and their feet , that they die not : and it shall be a statute for ever to them , even to him and to his seed throughout their generations .
But to us there is but one God , the Father , of whom are all things , and we in him ; and one Lord Jesus Christ , by whom are all things , and we by him .
translation.kha: pynban ha ngi don tang uwei U Blei , U Kpa , uba long u Nongthaw ïa kiei kiei baroh bad uba na ka bynta jong u ngi im ; bad don tang uwei U Trai , U Jisu Khrist , da u ba kiei kiei baroh la pynlong bad ha u ba ngi im .

translation.en: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar , O king , live for ever .
translation.kha: Ki la ong ha u syiem Nebukhadnessar ,  Ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un im junom !

translation.en: I have laid a snare for thee , and thou art also taken , O Babylon , and thou wast not aware : thou art found , and also caught , because thou hast striven against the  Lord .
That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant , and unto the supplication of thy people Israel , to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee .
translation.kha: A  Trai  Nongsynshar , to peit ieit borabor sha ki briew jong me ki Israel bad u syiem jong ki , bad to sngap ïa ka jingduwai jong ki ha man ba ki kyrpad jingïarap na me .

translation.en: Others said , This is the Christ . But some said , Shall Christ come out of Galilee ?
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong ,  U dei U Messaïah !  Hynrei kiwei ki la ong ,  U Messaïah un ym wan na Galilaïa ?
lapsan Tom pynsaphriang shoh shwa ianga .
translation.en: Tom hit me first .

translation.kha: Ka jingthoh jong ka jingmudui Ataroth ïa u ka long : U Syiem jong ki Tappuah .
translation.en: And the superscription of his accusation was written over , THE KING OF THE JEWS .

translation.kha: U syiem Syria un leh kat kaba sngewbha . Un kob ba u long kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u blei kham halor wat ïa Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Un lah ban leh ïa kane tad haduh ha ka haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa u . U Blei un leh thik kaei kaba u la thmu .
translation.en: And the king shall do according to his will  ; and he shall exalt himself , and magnify himself above every god , and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods , and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished : for that that is determined shall be done .

And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab , and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah , Joab s brother , and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite . And the king said unto the people , I will surely go forth with you myself also .
translation.kha: Nangta u phah ïa ki ha ki lai kynhun , ryngkat bad u Joab lem bad u Abishai , u para jong u Joab bad u Ittai uba na Gath , kiba long ki nongai hukum ha la ka kynhun kynhun . Bad u syiem u ong ha la ki rangbah ,  Nga ruh da lade ngan leit lang bad phi .
Katba U u dang kren kane , katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien ki la wan na ka u Jairos bad ki la ong ïa u , Ka khun jong phi ka lah . Balei phin pynshitom shuh ïa U Nonghikai ?
translation.en: While he yet spake , there came from the ruler of the synagogue s house certain which said , Thy daughter is dead : why troublest thou the Master any further ?

translation.kha: Kumta ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa u Og , ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , ïa bad ki briew jong u baroh , khlem da pynsah uwei ruh , nangta bad ki kam kynti ïa ka jong ri u .
translation.en: So they smote him , and his sons , and all his people , until there was none left him alive : and they possessed his land .

translation.kha: Ma ka , ka shisha para jong . Ka dei ka u jong nga , ym khun jong ka kmie nga bad nga la shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: And yet indeed she is my sister  ; she is the daughter of my father , but not the daughter of my mother  ; and she became my wife .

translation.kha: U Judah long u kum u sing , Haba u la pynïap ïa uba u thmu u leit phai sha la krem ; Hangta dem u , bad u thiah . Uei uba nud ban pynthut ïa u ?
translation.en: Judah is a lion s whelp : from the prey , my son , thou art gone up : he stooped down , he couched as a lion , and as an old lion  ; who shall rouse him up ?

translation.kha: Haba wan me , to wanrah ïa ka jaiñkup ba nga iehnoh la ha Troas bad u Karpos ; wanrah ruh ïa ki kot , bad khamtam ïa ki kot ba la sop snieh .
translation.en: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus , when thou comest , bring with thee , and the books , but especially the parchments .

translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u ong , To rai hapdeng jong nga bad u Jonathan u khun jong riewmadan . La kdew ïa u Jonathan jingshet
translation.en: And Saul said , Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son . And Jonathan was taken .

translation.kha: U weng noh na ka Templ ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah , bad ïa rah ka ka shabar nongbah sha ka Them Kidron , u thang ïa ka , u pynlwet phum ïa u dpei jong ka , pynsaphred bad ïa ka ha jingtep paidbah .
translation.en: And he brought out the grove from the house of the  Lord  , without Jerusalem , unto the brook Kidron , and burned it at the brook Kidron , and stamped it small to powder , and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people .

translation.kha: Ka mut aïu kane ‘ sa tang shipor ?’ Ngim tip ba u kren kaei shaphang !
translation.en: They said therefore , What is this that he saith ,  A little while ?  we cannot tell what he saith .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba une u briew u Boas , uba phi ïatrei lem ki kynthei jong u , u u ba-ha-ïing ngi . Shahshkor mynta . Ha kane ka janmiet un ïa u barli .
translation.en: And now is not Boaz of our kindred , with whose maidens thou wast ? Behold , he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor .
Son of man , speak to the children of thy people , and say unto them , When I bring the sword upon a land , if the people of the land take a man of their coasts , and set him for their watchman :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew  , u la ong , ïathuh ha ki briew jong me ïa kaei kaba jia haba nga wanrah ïa ka thma ha ka ri . Ki briew ha kata ka ri ki jied ïa uwei napdeng jong ki ban long u nongap .

translation.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean ? not one .
translation.kha: Ym don kaba khuid kaba lah ban wan na kano kano ka bymkhuid kat ki khunbynriew .
Nga la synreit ka ha ïa ka jingiwbih kaba da ka mirr , ka alos , bad ka siasia .
translation.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh , aloes , and cinnamon .

translation.kha: Uei keiñ uba lah ban ïa ngi na kine kiba khlaiñbor ? Kine ki dei kita ki blei kiba shoh ïap ïa ki Ijipt ha ka ri shyiap !
translation.en: Woe unto us ! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods ? these are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness .
Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite , and Joshua the son of Nun : for they have wholly followed the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa uwei pa uwei baroh , lait noh u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh uba na ka jait Kenis bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun ; ki la ïailong kiba kohnguh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: That which is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and perform  ; even a freewill offering , according as thou hast vowed unto the  Lord  thy God , which thou hast promised with thy mouth .
translation.kha: hynrei lada phi kular ei ei da la ka mon sngewbha , kynmaw ban pyndep ïa ka .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses , and in all that thou settest thine hand unto  ; and he shall bless thee in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa ka jingtrei jong phi bad un pyndap ïa ki thiar jong phi da u kew . Un kyrkhu ïa phi ha kata ka ri ba un ai ha phi .

Ïa ka jingmut jong kawei pa bymsngewsynei ka jingïohipaw jingpynbna nongïathuhlypa yn buhrieh noh :22-25 oh-shrong ; kan long kum ka kot pyndkoh ba tap-lup khang pynskhem da ka muhor . Lada Ashtaroth nongthaw rah ïa duma sha uno uno uba tip ban pule bad ong ïa u ban pule ïa ka ha Kosbi , un ong ba um lah ban pule namar ba la khang pynskhem da dong thik ïa ka .
translation.en: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed , which men deliver to one that is learned , saying , Read this , I pray thee : and he saith , I cannot  ; for it is sealed :

translation.kha: Ki briew jong pha la kha ha ka por ka jinglongmraw ha kawei ka sngi kin ong ha pha ‘ Kane ka rit eh — ngi donkam jaka shuh ban shong !’
translation.en: The children which thou shalt have , after thou hast lost the other , shall say again in thine ears , The place is too strait for me : give place to me that I may dwell .

Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place , seeing it is most holy , and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation , to make atonement for them before the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Balei phim shym ïabam ïa kata ka jingkñia namar ka pop ha ka jaka kyntang ? Ka long kaba khuid bha , bad U  Trai  u la ai ïa ka ha phi na ka bynta ban kit noh ïa ka pop jong u paidlang .

translation.en: Now therefore , our God , we thank thee , and praise thy glorious name .
translation.kha: Mynta ko Blei jong ngi , ngi ainguh ïa me , bad ngi ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng kaba donburom jong me .

translation.en: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold : their hooks shall be of gold , upon the four sockets of silver .
translation.kha: Wah ïa ka halor ki saw tylli ki rishot kiba da ka dieng akasia ba la suit ksiar , ha kiba la buh ïa ki bnoh ksiar , bad ïa kiba la thep ha ki thliew tnaw rupa .

U Trai u la phai sawdong bad khiat la phyllad shlip ha Elead Petros , bad u dil u la phyllad ba U Trai u la Shim pynsangeh shongduh u , Ha jingpynwit Iddo u syiar un kyn-ih ha kane ka kliang , men symbai lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .
translation.en: And the Lord turned , and looked upon Peter . And Peter remembered the word of the Lord , how he had said unto him ,  Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .
Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice : but , being stronger than she , forced her , and lay with her .
translation.kha: Hynrei um sngap ïa ka ; bad namar ba u kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka , u la jop , bad u la batbor ïa ka .

translation.en: And they were glad , and covenanted to give him money .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewbha bad ki la tyrwa ban siew pisa ïa u .
Haba ki briew kiba bha ki wan ha ka bor , ki baroh lehkmen , hynrei haba ki briew kiba sniew ki synshar , ki briew buhrieh ki ïa lade .
translation.en: When righteous men do rejoice , there is great glory : but when the wicked rise , a man is hidden .

translation.kha: Haba phi lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , wat ot ïa u kew uba don ha ki tduh jong ki lyngkha , wat bad ban leit ot ruh ïa u sohkew uba sah hadien phi ba la lum .
translation.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land , thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field , neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la khot ïa ki . Kaei phi kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka jong bynta phi ? u kylli la ïa ki .
translation.en: And Jesus stood still , and called them , and said ,  What will ye that I shall do unto you ?

translation.kha: jingbymïaid khuri snem kaba khatsan Bahok ka jingsynshar u kynshi u khun jong Joanan Joash kum u sniew ka Judah , u Jeroboam u khun jong u Jehoash u long syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar Shemiramoth wei Perasim Absalom syntied Eglaim
translation.en: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria , and reigned forty and one years .

translation.kha: Leit sha U Trai jingklim ka bynta ka jingïarap , Lydia mane khlem kut .
translation.en: Seek the  Lord  and his strength , seek his face continually .
Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him , that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros u la pyn-i dak ïa u bad u la ong ,  Kylli ïa u ba u kren shaphang jongno .

translation.en: A window shalt thou make to the ark , and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above  ; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof  ; with lower , second , and third stories shalt thou make it .
translation.kha: Thaw ruh ka tnum ïa kata ka lieng bad pyllait jaka kumba sawphew saw sentimitar hapdeng ka tnum bad ki krung . Shna ïa ka lai mala bad buh ïa ka jingkhang ha krung jong ka .
la pynhun ïa kito sliang bad pyndap ïa kiba thngan da kiei kiba bha .
translation.en: For he satisfieth the longing soul , and filleth the hungry soul with goodness .

translation.kha: U Blei u kren ban pynlong ïa ki ban pynphai ïa ki na kaba leh pop bad ban pyllait ïa na ki kaba sngewsarong .
translation.en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose , and hide pride from man .

And shall say unto them , Hear , O Israel , ye approach this day unto battle against your enemies : let not your hearts faint , fear not , and do not tremble , neither be ye terrified because of them  ;
translation.kha: ‘ To sngap , ko Israel ! Mynta ka sngi phin leit ban ïaleh thma . Wat sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong phi , wat noh mynsiem , lane wat sngew syier .
Lada ka kjat kan ong , Namar ba ngam dei ka kti , te ngam ka dei jong ka met , kata kam pynlong ïa ka , ba kam dei dkhot ka jong ka met .
translation.en: If the foot shall say , Because I am not the hand , I am not of the body ; is it therefore not of the body ?
In vain have I smitten your children  ; they received no correction : your own sword hath devoured your prophets , like a destroying lion .
translation.kha: Nga la pynshitom ïa pha , hynrei kam shym wanrah kano kano ka jingbha ; phan ym da la shah ïa nga ban pynbeit ïa pha . Kum u sing uba shyrkhei , pha la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga .

translation.en: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them ,  Murmur not among yourselves .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Keiñ noh kaba ïakren khñium hapdeng jong phi .
La pyndap ïa ki paramarjan baroh ka da jingsheptieng , bad ka khubor shaphang kine kiei kiei ka la saphriang kylleng ka ri lum Judia .
translation.en: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them : and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea .
For I am persuaded , that neither death , nor life , nor angels , nor principalities , nor powers , nor things present , nor things to come ,
translation.kha: Naba nga long thikna ba ym don kaba lah ban pynïakhlad ïa ngi na ka jingieit jong u : Ym ka jingïap lymne ka jingim , lymne ki angel , lymne kiwei ki nongsynshar ba kynja bneng lane ki bor lymne jong kaba mynta lymne ka ban sa wan ,

Ki Amor ki dang sah ha Aijalon , Shaalbim diengthang bad ha u Lum Heres , hynrei ki jait Ephraim bad jingbymlehhok ki buh hapoh ka jingsynshar jong ki bad ki pynbor ïa Nisan ban Blei na ka bynta Marsena ki julor
translation.en: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon , and in Shaalbim : yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed , so that they became tributaries .

translation.kha: Trai U un pynjia ïa u nongsynshar ban ïohsngew ïa ka hamsaïa ka ban pynlong ïa u ban leit phai pat sha la ka ri , bad U Trai pynjia un ba yn pynïap ïa u hangta .
translation.en: Behold , I will send a blast upon him , and he shall hear a rumour , and shall return to his own land  ; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land .

translation.kha: Te uno uno uba ha ka ri uba i-blad ïa print jingkyrkhu , riew pan pynsngaid ïoh jingkyrkhu na U Blei uba ïaineh . Uno Bithynia uba shim smai un Baibyl ha —Ïoannis lip U Jehosabad uba ïaineh ; Ki jingjynjar kiba mynshuwa kin leit noh bad yn klet noh .
translation.en: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth  ; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth  ; because the former troubles are forgotten , and because they are hid from mine eyes .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go down , charge the people , lest they break through unto the  Lord  to gaze , and many of them perish .
translation.kha: U Moses u leit , bad U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit hiar bad maham ïa ki briew ban ym jam ïa u pud ban wan khmih ïa nga ; lada ki leh kumta , bun na ki kin ïap .
Ki briew kiba ithuh ïa u mynshuwa haba ki ïohi ïa u ba u ïa leh kane ki para ïakylli ma ki , Kaei kane kaba la wan jia ïa u khun jong u Kish Hato ? , u Saul ruh u la long nongïathuhlypa ?
translation.en: And it came to pass , when all that knew him beforetime saw that , behold , he prophesied among the prophets , then the people said one to another , What is this that is come unto the son of Kish ? Is Saul also among the prophets ?

translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki lumlang u ïa paidïapom jong ki baroh ha Aphek , katba ki Israel ki sher dara harud ka pung kaba ha ka Jesreel them .
translation.en: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek : and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel .
Blessed be the  Lord  out of Zion , which dwelleth at Jerusalem . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ha Seïon , ha Jerusalem , ka ïingshong jong u . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

Ha kata saw por ngan weng noh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki kynrad na ka ri , bad ym don mano mano ban kynmaw shuh bakynja ki . Ngan weng noh ïa uno uno uba kam ba u long u nongïathuhlypa bad bashongbriew shim mynleh Bus jingpynïoh jingkwah ban mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land , and they shall no more be remembered : and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land .

translation.kha: Kumta , haba ka la sdang dum , ki leit ka sha jaka shong dara ki Syria , hynrei ynda poi ki ha ka , ym don mano mano hangta .
translation.en: And they rose up in the twilight , to go unto the camp of the Syrians : and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria , behold , there was no man there .

translation.kha: ka sngi phi dei ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Ar .
translation.en: Thou art to pass over through Ar , the coast of Moab , this day :

translation.kha: Ki la thmu ban hiarthma ïa ka Judah , ban pyntieng ïa Keramim briew ban ïasoh ha ka liang jong ki , bad nangta ban buh eit u khun :13-15 u adkar halor ka khet .
translation.en: Let us go up against Judah , and vex it , and let us make a breach therein for us , and set a king in the midst of it , even the son of Tabeal :
And he said unto them , The  Lord  is witness against you , and his anointed is witness this day , that ye have not found ought in my hand . And they answered , He is witness .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  bad u Syiem uba u la jied ki long ki sakhi mynta ka sngi ba phi la shem ba nga long uba lui lui .   Ho-oid , U  Trai  u long u sakhi jong ngi ,  ki jubab .

translation.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families , these cities with their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Sebulun ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
U shim lut ïa baroh ki jingkynshew spah kiba don ha ka ha ïingsyiem , kynthup ïa ki ksiar kiba u Solomon u la thaw .
translation.en: And he took away the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house  ; he even took away all : and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made .
But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the  Lord  God of Israel with all his heart : for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam , which made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jehu um shym la kohnguh da ka dohnud baroh ïa ka aiñ jong U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ; pynban u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong u Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
khot biang ïa ki shapoh bad ki la ong ïa ki kim dei da lei lei ban kren lane hikai ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu .
translation.en: And they called them , and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus .
Then all the children of Israel went out , and the congregation was gathered together as one man , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , with the land of Gilead , unto the  Lord  in Mizpah .
translation.kha: Baroh ki paid Israel naduh Dan kaba shaphang shatei haduh Beersheba kaba shaphang shathie , kumjuh ruh naduh ri Gilead kaba shaphang mihngi , ki la ïawanlang . Ki ïalumlang kum kawei ka kynhun ha khmat U  Trai  ha Mispah .

Hangno u don U Trai , uba da ka bor jong u , u la leh ki bakhraw lyngba u Moses , u da arliang ki um ka bad ïalam ïa ki briew jong u lyngba ki um jylliew , ban ïoh ïa nam baneh junom na ka bynta ïa lade ka jingïalam U Trai , ki kjat jong ki , ki long kum ki kulai , kim ju jynthut
translation.en: That led them through the deep , as an horse in the wilderness , that they should not stumble ?
Where thou diest , will I die , and there will I be buried : the  Lord  do so to me , and more also , if ought but death part thee and me .
translation.kha: Hangno hangno ba phi ïap , hangta ngan ïap , bad dei hangta ba yn tep ïa nga . Ai ba ka jingpynshitom bashyrkhei eh jong U  Trai  kan wan hap halor jong nga lada nga shah ïa kaei kaei lait noh ka jingïap hi ka ban pynïakhlad ïa nga na phi !

translation.en: Praise the  Lord   ; for the  Lord  is good : sing praises unto his name  ; for it is pleasant .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; to rwai ki jingïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u , namar u long uba bha sbun .

translation.en: While he yet spake , behold , a bright cloud overshadowed them : and behold a voice out of the cloud , which said , This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased  ; hear ye him .
translation.kha: Katba u dang kren , u lyoh uba tyngshaiñ u la wan halor jong ki , bad ka sur na u lyoh ka la ong ,  Une u long U Khun uba ieit jong nga , ha uba nga sngewbha eh — to shahshkor ïa u !
Ki la ha byndi la kham slem , bad la ïa u Joseph ban peit ïa ki .
translation.en: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them , and he served them : and they continued a season in ward .
And it came to pass , as soon as he had made an end of speaking , that , behold , the king s sons came , and lifted up their voice and wept : and the king also and all his servants wept very sore .
translation.kha: Mar ïadep kren ïa kane , ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki wan rung ; ki la sdang ban ïam , bad u Dabid lem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ruh ki la ïa-ïam kthang .

translation.en: But if the priest look on it , and , behold , there be no white hair in the bright spot , and it be no lower than the other skin , but be somewhat dark  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u shñiuh ha kata ka dak um kylla lieh , bad kata ka dak kam long kaba kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , hynrei ka stang ha ka rong , u lyngdoh u dei ban pynkyrpang ïa u hynñiew sngi lynter .
ki Kine kyndon ki ibit ibiang ïa u Hamor bad ïa u Shekhem u khun jong u ,
translation.en: And their words pleased Hamor , and Shechem Hamor s son .
And the  Lord  shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel , according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law :
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ïa u ka nuksa hapdeng ki jait Israel baroh , bad un wallam ki jingpynjot halor jong u kat kum kita ki jingtim ba la jer ha ka jutang ïa kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab jong ki jinghikai U  Trai .
Phi lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka rupa bad ka kaba ksiar sah na ka bynta kano kano kaba ma phi bad ki para ri jong phi phi , kwah pyndonkam ban , kat kum ka mon U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee , and to thy brethren , to do with the rest of the silver and the gold , that do after the will of your God .
Beloved , think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you , as though some strange thing happened unto you :
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , to wat sngewphylla ïa ka jingtynjuh ba-eh kaba phi shahshitom , kumba kiei kiei kiba khyllah ki wan jia ha phi .

Nga ïaroh ïa me bad pyndonburom ïa me , U A Blei ki kpa jong tymmen nga . Me la ai ha nga ka jingstad bad ka jingkhlaiñ me ; la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad me la pyn-i ha ngi kaei ba ngin ïathuh ha u syiem .
translation.en: I thank thee , and praise thee , O thou God of my fathers , who hast given me wisdom and might , and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee : for thou hast now made known unto us the king s matter .

translation.en: And when they were come to Capernaum , they that received tribute money came to Peter , and said , Doth not your master pay tribute ?

translation.en: And his disciples came to him , and awoke him , saying , Lord , save us : we perish .

translation.kha: Kham pynheh ïa ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba pha shong ; pynjrong ïa pyndem tyllai jingpyrkhat pynskhem ïa ki snar !

Bad wat sngewkhuslai haba phi ïohsngew ki ki jingsawa thma hajan jong phi bad ïa ki khubor jong ki thma jngai na phi . Ka dei ïa kine kiei kiei ban jia , hynrei mut kam ba ka ka jingkut la long .
translation.en: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars , be ye not troubled : for such things must needs be  ; but the end shall not be yet .

translation.en: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels , intruding into those things which he hath not seen , vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind ,

translation.kha: Ki pop u riewbymman ki long ka jingriam . U ngat ha ka jingriam jong ki pop jong u hi .

Haba uno uno u sngewsarong u ïoh ïa la jingpynshitom , wat briew bym don ka u ïoh jinghikai . Uta uba stad un nang kata kaba la hikai ïa u .
translation.en: When the scorner is punished , the simple is made wise : and when the wise is instructed , he receiveth knowledge .
But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel , when he shall begin to sound , the mystery of God should be finished , as he hath declared to his servants the prophets .

translation.en: When they took hold of thee by thy hand , thou didst break , and rend all their shoulder : and when they leaned upon thee , thou brakest , and madest all their loins to be at a stand .

nongbah Seïon ka long kaba itynnat , hynrei ïa ka yn sa pynjot ;

translation.en: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning , and called all his servants , and told all these things in their ears : and the men were sore afraid .

translation.en: Pilate therefore said unto him , Art thou a king then ? Jesus answered ,  Thou sayest that I am a king . To this end was I born , and for this cause came I into the world , that I should bear witness unto the truth . Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice .
And if the righteous scarcely be saved , where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had ended these sayings , the people were astonished at his doctrine :

translation.en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling , and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses bad u Aaron
Ai ba u Kanaan un don hynriewphew ngut ki mahadei , phraphew ngut khang tnga kliar , ki kynthei ba :3 samla khlem ka jingkheiñ ïa ka jingdon sohkhram ki !
translation.en: I said , I will go up to the palm tree , I will take hold of the boughs thereof : now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine , and the smell of thy nose like apples  ;

Be it known unto the king , that we went into the province of Judah , to the house of the great God , which is builded with great stones , and timber is laid in the walls , and this work goeth fast on , and prospereth in their hands .

translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel for ever and ever . And all the people said , Amen , and praised the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ! Ïaroh ïa u mynta bad junom ! Nangta baroh u paidbah u ong ,  Amen ,  bad ïaroh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday  ; thou shalt shine forth , thou shalt be as the morning .

translation.en: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment , and gave them to Rebekah : he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things .
translation.kha: Nangta u sei ïa ki jaiñ bad ki jingdeng rupa bad ksiar , bad u ai ïa ki ha ka Rebekka . U ai ruh ïa ki jingai kiba kordor ïa u hynmen bad ïa ka kmie jong ka .

U lyngdoh un khmih ïa biang kata ka prum ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad lada kam pat pur lane ym don u uba shñiuh lam stem ha ka , bad kam paw ruh ka ba kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka ,

translation.en: And that which fell among thorns are they , which , when they have heard , go forth , and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life , and bring no fruit to perfection .

translation.kha: Ka pyrda kaba wah ha ka balui ka la kad arliang , ialap shrong haduh tbian .
translation.en: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom .
And the righteous men , they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses , and after the manner of women that shed blood  ; because they are adulteresses , and blood is in their hands .

Kaba ar ka hukum kaba donkam tam ka iohi kum katei : ‘ ïaduna ïa Kyrini paramarjan jong me kumba lyngraw Horesh ïa lade .’
translation.en: And the second is like unto it , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .

translation.en: But the  Lord  of hosts shall be exalted in judgment , and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness .

translation.en: Then came to him the disciples of John , saying , Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft , but thy disciples fast not ?

translation.en: They shall be holy unto their God , and not profane the name of their God : for the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and the bread of their God , they do offer : therefore they shall be holy .

translation.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me : but I will consider thy testimonies .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Can the children of the bridechamber fast , while the bridegroom is with them ? as long as they have the bridegroom with them , they cannot fast .

For thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken  ; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished ? thou shalt not go unpunished , but thou shalt surely drink of it .

translation.en: And Abraham said , Because I thought , Surely the fear of God is not in this place  ; and they will slay me for my wife s sake .

translation.en: But after they had rest , they did evil again before thee : therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies , so that they had the dominion over them : yet when they returned , and cried unto thee , thou heardest them from heaven  ; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies  ;

translation.en: By the way that he came , by the same shall he return , and shall not come into this city , saith the  Lord .

translation.en: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of all that oppressed you , and drave them out from before you , and gave you their land  ;

translation.en: And he said unto me , What seest thou ? And I answered , I see a flying roll  ; the length thereof is twenty cubits , and the breadth thereof ten cubits .

Yet now hear , O Jacob my servant  ; and Israel , whom I have chosen :
