translation.kha: Ka ri ka jingdum , ki syrngiew bad jingkulmar , ha kaba ka jingshai hi ka long ka jingdum .

translation.en: But go ye and learn what that meaneth , I will have mercy , and not sacrifice : for I am not come to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad to wad kaei ka jingmut ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong : ‘ Dei ïa ka jingsbun ba nga kwah , ym ki jingkñia ïa ki mrad .’ Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki briew badonburom , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .
Baroh ki la noh na U Blei ; baroh ki la dei ; ym don uno leh ïa kaba dei ym don uwei ruh .
translation.en: They are all gone out of the way , they are together become unprofitable ; there is none that doeth good , no , not one .
Then Jethro , Moses  father in law , took Zipporah , Moses  wife , after he had sent her back ,
translation.kha: Kumta u la wan ha u Moses , u da ïalam ruh ïa ka Sipporah , ka tnga jong u Moses , kaba u khlem ïalam lang ,
U buh ka bapaw NGA shem bad ka por ban jah , ka por ban kynshew bad ka por ban bret noh ,
translation.en: A time to get , and a time to lose  ; a time to keep , and a time to cast away  ;

Then they said , Behold , there is a feast of the  Lord  in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth–el , on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth–el to Shechem , and on the south of Lebonah .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ïa-pyrkhat ,  Ka Jingkhawai Niam kaba shisien shisnem ha U  Trai  ha Shiloh shen ka la wan poi .  ( Ka Shiloh ka don shatei na Bethel , shathie na Lebonah , bad sha mihngi na ka lynti bah hapdeng ka Bethel bad ka Shekhem . )
Haba u Saul u wan phai na kaba ïaleh ïa ki , Philistia la ïathuh ha u ba u u Dabid don ha ka ri khlaw hajan Engedi .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Saul was returned from following the Philistines , that it was told him , saying , Behold , David is in the wilderness of En–gedi .
Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church .
translation.kha: Hamar kane ka por u Syiem Herod u la sdang ban pynshitom beiñ ïa ki katto katne ngut ki dkhot jong ka balang .
Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Menahem la u leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Menahem , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: un wieh ïa la shynriah ka ti kamon hangta , bad un synreit khyndiat na ka , hynñiew sien hangta ha khmat U Trai .
translation.en: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand , and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki nongshun jinglute nga ban phet krad na nga ; nga pynjot ïa kito kiba shun ïa nga .
translation.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies , that I might destroy them that hate me .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong la ha nga ,
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
Then the handmaidens came near , they and their children , and they bowed themselves .
translation.kha: Nangta kita ki tnga kliar ki la wan lem bad ki khun jong ki , bad ki nguh ;

translation.en: Now as they were making their hearts merry , behold , the men of the city , certain sons of Belial , beset the house round about , and beat at the door , and spake to the master of the house , the old man , saying , Bring forth the man that came into thine house , that we may know him .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang pynsngewbha ïa lade kumta , kynsan kynsan la don ki riewthala na kata ka shnong ki kerkut ïa kata ka ïing , ki da tied tyngeh ïa ka jingkhang . Ki ong ha uta u tymmen ,  Sei shabar ïa uto u briew uba rung ha ïing jong phi ! Ngin ïathiah shongkha bad u !

U uba kyrteng u Oded , u nongïathuhlypa jong U Trai ; u shong ha ka nongbah Samaria . U ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel kaba wan phai bad ki koidi Judia hamar ba kin rung sha ka nongbah bad u ong U Trai U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u la bitar ïa ki Judah , bad u la ïa phi ban jop ; hynrei mynta u la ïohsngew ïa ka jinglehbeiñ palat jong phi ba phi pynïap ki
translation.en: But a prophet of the  Lord  was there , whose name was Oded : and he went out before the host that came to Samaria , and said unto them , Behold , because the  Lord  God of your fathers was wroth with Judah , he hath delivered them into your hand , and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven .

Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon , who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land , God left him , to try him , that he might know all that was in his heart .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u ïoh jingjop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , bad wat haba ki nonglamktien ka Babilon ki wan ban kylli shaphang ki jingjia bym ju kham jia kiba jia ha ka ri , U Blei u shah ba u Hesekaïah un leit ha la ka lynti tang ban tynjuh ïa ka jinglong jong u .

translation.en: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things , wherein thou hast been instructed .
translation.kha: Nga leh ïa kane khnang ba phin tip ïa ka jingshisha ba-pura shaphang kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la hikai ïa phi .

translation.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days .
translation.kha: U Asa u syiem ka Judah bad u Baasha u syiem ka Israel ki don ha ka jingïaleh thma borabor katba ki dang don ha ka bor .

translation.en: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch , and as the raiment of those that are slain , thrust through with a sword , that go down to the stones of the pit  ; as a carcase trodden under feet .
translation.kha: hynrei mem don kano kano ka jingtep , bad ïa ka metïap jong me la bret shabar ba kan pyut . La tap ïa ka da ki met jong ki shipai ba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , la kynting ïa ka lem bad ki ha ka thliew mawsiang , bad la ïuh ïa ka .
Ki briew basniew ki ngat ha nangto ki jong ki pop , katba ki briew bahok ki Ampliatos bad ki laitluid .
translation.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare : but the righteous doth sing and rejoice .
When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba U Jisu un sdang ïa ka kam jong u , u Ïoannis u la ïalap ha ki paid Israel baroh ba ki dei ban phai noh na ki pop jong ki bad ban shah pynbaptis .
bad pynlong ïa ngi ka hima jong ki lyngdoh ban ïa shakri U Blei bad U Kpa jong u . Ha U Jisu Khrist , to long ka burom bad ka bor junom la junom Amen ! .
translation.en: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father  ; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .
For the sons of Athaliah , that wicked woman , had broken up the house of God  ; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the  Lord  did they bestow upon Baalim .
translation.kha: ( Ki nongbud jong ka Athalaïah , kata ka kynthei bymman , ki la pynjot ïa ka Templ bad ki la pyndonkam ïa kiba bun ki tiar ki tar bakyntang ha ka jingmane ïa u Baal . )
bad u la ai hukum ïa ki ban ym ïathuh ha kiwei pat shaphang jong . u
translation.en: And charged them that they should not make him known :
And Solomon s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour , and threescore measures of meal ,
translation.kha: Ki jingbam ba U Solomon u donkam man ka sngi ki long san hajar kilo u  purew bad shiphew hajar kilo ka jingbam ;
Te U Jisu u la kren bad u la ong ha ki , Hato donkam phi ban wan ryngkat bad ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon ban ïa kem nga , la kumba nga dei u riewsniew ?
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Are ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and with staves to take me ?

translation.kha: Nga la lah don hangta u mynba thaw ïa ka sahit bneng , mynba u pynïar ïa ka jylli halor ka duriaw ,
translation.en: When he prepared the heavens , I was there : when he set a compass upon the face of the depth :

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , U Blei ruh u la ai Simri ïa la ki sakhi ha ki , da kaba leh mem ki kambah bad ki kamphylla bad da kaba ïasam ïa ki jingai U Mynsiem Bakhuid kat kum ka mon jong u .
translation.en: God also bearing them witness , both with signs and wonders , and with divers miracles , and gifts of the Holy Ghost , according to his own will ?
O remember that my life is wind : mine eye shall no more see good .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A Blei , ba ka jingim jong nga ka long tang ka jynhaw , ka jingsuk jong nga ka la kut noh .

translation.en: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh , Speak , I pray thee , unto thy servants in the Syrian language  ; for we understand it : and speak not to us in the Jews  language , in the ears of the people that are on the wall .
translation.kha: Te u Eliakim , u Shebna bad u Joah ki la ong ha u rangbah synshar ,  Kren ha ngi da ka ktien Aramaik . Ngi sngewthuh ïa ka . Wat kren ha ka ktien Hebru ; baroh ki briew ha ka kynroh ki ïa-shahskhor .
Shahshkor ïa long kaba shisha ba ki don shibun riewkynthei Israel ha ka por jong u Elijah , haba don slap haduh lai shiteng bad ba ka nemsniew bajur ka la saphriang baroh kawei .
translation.en: But I tell you of a truth , many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias , when the heaven was shut up three years and six months , when great famine was throughout all the land  ;

translation.kha: naduh mynta U Khun U Briew un ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God .

When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number , then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the  Lord  , when thou numberest them  ; that there be no plague among them , when thou numberest them .
translation.kha: Haba me shim jingkheiñ ïa ka jingdon ki paid Israel , uwei pa uwei u briew u dei ban siew ïa nga ïa ka dor na ka bynta la ka jingim , khnang ba kano kano kaba sniew kan ym wan ha u katba dang shim jingkheiñ .

translation.en: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ , they are again entangled therein , and overcome , the latter end is worse with them than the beginning .
translation.kha: Lada ki briew ki la lait im na ki bor ba pynpyut jong ka pyrthei da ka jingtip jong ki ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong ngi , bad nangta ki ngat biang bad shahjop ha ki , kum kita ki briew ki don ha ka jinglong kaba kham sniew ha kaba kut ban ïa kaba ki la long ha kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: For when the Gentiles , which have not the law , do by nature the things contained in the law , these , having not the law , are a law unto themselves :
translation.kha: Ki Jentil kim don ïa ka Hukum ; hynrei haba ki leh da ka jingsngewthuh ha lade ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa , ki long ka hukum ïa lade , wat la kim don ka Hukum .
u la jubab ki , Ngan kylli ïa tang kawei ka , phi ha nga jubab , ngan ïathuh ha phi da ka bor aïu don ban ïa kiei kiei .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I also will ask you one thing , which if ye tell me , I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things .

translation.kha: Kumno ngin jubab ïa ki nonglamktien kiba wan sha ngi na ki Philistia ? ïathuh ïa ki U Trai u la seng nongrim ïa ka Seïon bad ba ki briew jong kiba kin shem ka jingshngain
translation.en: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation ? That the  Lord  hath founded Zion , and the poor of his people shall trust in it .

translation.kha: U maham ïa phi ba phin ym shah ïa u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi . U Hesekaïah um lah ban pyllait im phi ïa .
translation.en: Thus saith the king , Let not Hezekiah deceive you : for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand :
He shall not fail nor be discouraged , till he have set judgment in the earth : and the isles shall wait for his law .
translation.kha: Un ym duh jingkyrmen ne jingshlur ; un pynlong ka jingbishar hok ha ka pyrthei . Ki ri bajngai ki ap kmang ïa ka jinghikai jong u .

translation.en: And he said , My son shall not go down with you  ; for his brother is dead , and he is left alone : if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go , then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jakob u ong ,  U khun jong nga um lah ban leit ryngkat bad phi ; u hynmen jong u , u la ïap , bad u sah sa tang marwei . Kaei kaei ka lah ban ngat ha u ha lynti . Nga dei u briew uba la tymmen , bad ka jingsngewsih kaba phin pynjia ha nga kan sa pynïap ïa nga .
U pynshong ïa la ki briew , bad u pynlong hato Absalom bymjukut bad jingshngain . Uba khuid bad uba khrawbor u long ma u !
translation.en: He sent redemption unto his people : he hath commanded his covenant for ever : holy and reverend is his name .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa angel ki shym ri ïa ka burom hapoh pud ka bor synshar jong ki , ki ïa ki jaka jong hi : Ki shah khum da ki kynjri bymjukut hapoh kaba dum tliw , kaba U Blei u buh ïa ki na ka bynta ka Sngi kaba khraw ha kaba pynrem ïa .
translation.en: And the angels which kept not their first estate , but left their own habitation , he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day .

translation.kha: Tang da ka jingduwai lah ïa-tylli beh noh kum ïa nongsiatkhnam , u Jisu Khenani la jingburom ; ym don kawei pat kaba ïa-bta .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  This kind can come forth by nothing , but by prayer and fasting .
Hear ye , and testify in the house of Jacob , saith the Lord  God  , the God of hosts ,
translation.kha: To shahshkor mynta , bad maham ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh ,

translation.en: And the sons of Noah , that went forth of the ark , were Shem , and Ham , and Japheth : and Ham is the father of Canaan .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang u Noah kiba la ïawan mih na kata ka lieng ki long u Shem , u Ham , bad u Japheth . ( U Ham u long u kpa jong u Kanaan . )

translation.en: They kept also the feast of tabernacles , as it is written , and offered the daily burnt offerings by number , according to the custom , as the duty of every day required  ;
translation.kha: Ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ; ha kawei pa kawei ka sngi ki ai ki jingkñia kiba donkam ha kata ka sngi ;

translation.en: They are not humbled even unto this day , neither have they feared , nor walked in my law , nor in my statutes , that I set before you and before your fathers .
translation.kha: Hynrei haduh kane ka sngi phim shym la pynrit ïa lade . Phim shym la pyndonburom ïa nga lane im kat kum ki aiñ baroh kiba nga la ai ha phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
Lymda une u briew u la wan na U Blei , un ym lah ban leh ïa kum kane .
translation.en: If this man were not of God , he could do nothing .

According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day , wherewith they have forsaken me , and served other gods , so do they also unto thee .
translation.kha: Naduh ba nga la wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt , ki la phai noh na nga bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ; bad mynta ki leh ïa me kumba ki la ju leh ïa nga .
U Blei u pynlong hok bad ki briew lyngba ka jingngeit ki ha U Jisu Khrist . Blei u leh ïa kane ïa baroh ngeit ha U Khrist , namar ym satia kano kano jingïapher :
translation.en: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe : for there is no difference :

translation.kha: ïaphla u kyntait , bad kumta u ong ïa Elnathan , Namar ba phim shym Sapphira ïa jaijai Hades pynsyrwa Trai , pawkhmat sing un sa pynïap spoiñ phi tang mar Hur ïakhlad bad baïapher . Ïaid mar shu ïamih , Kherub sing u wan bad pynïap ïa u jingmane
translation.en: Then said he unto him , Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  , behold , as soon as thou art departed from me , a lion shall slay thee . And as soon as he was departed from him , a lion found him , and slew him .
Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , believe me , the hour cometh , when ye shall neither in this mountain , nor yet at Jerusalem , worship the Father .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  To ngeit ïa nga , ko ka briew , ba ka por kan poi haba ki briew kin ym mane ïa U Kpa halor une u lum ne ha Jerusalem .
To Trai un ai ïa ka jinglehisynei ha u ha kata ka Sngi ! phi tip shai kdar katno ba la leh na ka nga ha Ephesos .
translation.en: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day : and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus , thou knowest very well .

translation.kha: Ki Hima synshar riewkhlaw u Amon ki ïasylla pyrshah pynrkhiang u bad ki pynïap ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And his servants conspired against him , and slew him in his own house .

translation.kha: Hynrei maji pat , la pyrshang ïaleh ban ka lieng sharud duriaw , da kaba katba don ka bor jong ki . Hynrei ka erïong ka nang , kim poi shuh shano ruh
translation.en: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land  ; but they could not : for the sea wrought , and was tempestuous against them .

translation.kha: U Ussaïah u pynbiang ïa ka kynhun shipai da ki stieh , ki sum , jingda ki khlieh , ki jingphong nar , ryntieh ki bad ki khnam , bad ki maw ban kawang .
translation.en: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields , and spears , and helmets , and habergeons , and bows , and slings to cast stones .

translation.kha: Katba U u Jisu dang hikai ha ka Templ , u la kylli ka jingkylli , Kumno ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum ong ki ba U Messaïah un long uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ?
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said , while he taught in the temple ,  How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David ?

translation.kha: Ki briew ki la ong , ïa ki bad rwai ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka jong , tad haduh ba ki khmat ngi kin da ki , bad ba ki irmat ngi ki jhieh na kaba .
translation.en: And let them make haste , and take up a wailing for us , that our eyes may run down with tears , and our eyelids gush out with waters .
And the other disciples came in a little ship  ; ( for they were not far from land , but as it were two hundred cubits , ) dragging the net with fishes .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki synran ki la wan sha ryngkew ha ka lieng , ki da ïatan ïa ka jar kaba la dap da ki dohkha . Kim shym da don jngai eh na ryngkew , kumba shispah mitar ei ei .
Ka kham bha ban bam ïa ki bad jhur ki briew kiba ieit ïa ban phi ïa kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba bha tam ha kaba don ka jingpihuiñ .
translation.en: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is , than a stalled ox and hatred therewith .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba bhabriew shibun , ka la ap ïa u syiem bad la ka ïa sumar u , hynrei um shym la ïathiah shongkha bad ka .
translation.en: And the damsel was very fair , and cherished the king , and ministered to him : but the king knew her not .
The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples , and of his doctrine .
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli ïa U Jisu shaphang ki synran jong u bad shaphang ka jinghikai jong u .
U Darius u nong Mid , Jotbathah long u khun jong u Serksis , u la pynurlong ïa pukni hima Babilonia .
translation.en: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus , of the seed of the Medes , which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans  ;

translation.kha: Nga la pynshitom beiñ haduh kaba pynïap ïa ki briew kiba la bud ïa kane kutlad Lynti . Nga la kem ïa ki rangbah bad ki kynthei bad nga la ba-pynmynsaw ïa ki ha ka byndi .
translation.en: And I persecuted this way unto the death , binding and delivering into prisons both men and women .
It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop , than with a brawling woman and in a wide house .
translation.kha: Kan kham bha kaba shong ha tnum ïing ban ïa kaba sah lang ha kajuh ka ïing bad ka tnga kaba wad daw .

translation.en: And they journeyed from Oboth , and pitched at Iye–abarim , in the wilderness which is before Moab , toward the sunrising .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , ki la sher dara ha ki nongrim ba la jot jong ka Abarim kaba ha ka ri khlaw , shaphang mihngi na ka ri Moab .

Nga tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat bad ki kam jong thiang , ngan wan ban lumlang ïa ki briew jong ki hima baroh Tekoa Haba kin ïawanlang , kin sa ïohi kaei ba riewpaidbah bor jong nga ka Tappuah ban leh bad kin Salome tip ba nga dei uta uba wahbah ïa ki .
translation.en: For I know their works and their thoughts : it shall come , that I will gather all nations and tongues  ; and they shall come , and see my glory .

translation.kha: To kner ïa la ka kti ban pynkhiah , bad ai ba ki kamphylla bad ki kambah yn leh ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu u Shakri bakhuid jong me .
translation.en: By stretching forth thine hand to heal  ; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus .
Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt , and brought them into the wilderness .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga la ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt sha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And I turned myself and came down from the mount , and put the tables in the ark which I had made  ; and there they be , as the  Lord  commanded me .
translation.kha: Nangta , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , nga buh ïa ki ha kata ka synduk ba nga la thaw — bad ki dang don hangta naduh kata ka por .

translation.en: But when Moses went in before the  Lord  to speak with him , he took the veil off , until he came out . And he came out , and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Moses u leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ban ïakren bad U  Trai  , u weng noh ïa kata ka jaiñtapkhmat . Ynda u mih biang shabar u ïathuh ha ki Israel ïa kata baroh ïa kaba la hukum ïa u ban kren ,
Ka nongbah ka Akhaikos haba kiba hok ki kyrkhu ïa sawjngum ; hynrei ka nongbah ka Jingpynïasuk noh da ki ktien jong ki bymman Lasharon
translation.en: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted : but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked .

translation.kha: U Joshua u templ bajew ïa ki paidbah ba ki ïarisa bad u la ong ha u ïitkhmih Barabbas Nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kumba ïaleh thma ha ka jaka sher dara Pynshlur
translation.en: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted , he said unto Moses , There is a noise of war in the camp .

translation.kha: Ma u bad ka kynhun shipai jingbishar u bad bun ki jaitbynriew kiba don bad u kin tur ïaleh kum ka erïong bad dawai ïa ka ri kum u lyoh .
translation.en: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm , thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land , thou , and all thy bands , and many people with thee .

translation.kha: Kumno la pyndonkam ïa synñiang ?
translation.en: How are the voluntary contributions used ?

translation.kha: U syiem Dabid mynta u shong ha ka ïingsyiem jong . u Ha kawei ka sngi u phah khot ïa u Nathan u nongïathuhlypa bad ong ha u , Hangne nga shong ha ka ïing ba la da thaw ki dieng Kedar , ïa hynrei ka Synduk ka U Jutang Trai la buh ha ka ïingjaiñ !
translation.en: Now it came to pass , as David sat in his house , that David said to Nathan the prophet , Lo , I dwell in an house of cedars , but the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  remaineth under curtains .

Therefore the redeemed of the  Lord  shall return , and come with singing unto Zion  ; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head : they shall obtain gladness and joy  ; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away .
translation.kha: Kito kiba me la pyllait im kin ïoh poi ha Jerusalem da ka jingkmen , da kaba rwai bad risa da ka jingkmen . Kin long kiba kmen junom , junom kiba laitluid na ka jingsngewsih bad jingkthang mynsiem .
Kumta ki la ong ïa ki mihnoh ban na ka kamra ka Dorbar , bad nangta ki la sdang ïaphylliew jingmut para ma ki .
translation.en: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council , they conferred among themselves ,
Christ is become of no effect unto you , whosoever of you are justified by the law ; ye are fallen from grace .
translation.kha: Kito na phi kiba pyrshang ban pynksan ha khmat U Blei da kaba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , phi la dkhat noh ïa lade na U Khrist . Phi long shabar ka jingaiei U Blei .

translation.en: And John bare record , saying , I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove , and it abode upon him .
translation.kha: Bad u Ïoannis u la ai ïa kane ka jingphla :  Nga la ïohi ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar kum ka paro na bneng , bad u shongsah halor jong u .

translation.en: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land , and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it :
translation.kha: Nga shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga namar ki kam pynïap briew ba ki la leh ha ka ri bad namar ki bleithaw da kiba la pyntngit ïa ka .

translation.en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham , and blessed him that had the promises .
translation.kha: U Melkhisedek um shym la hiarpateng na u Lebi , hynrei u la lum ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na u Abraham bad u la kyrkhu ïa u , u briew uba la ïohpdiang ïa ki jingkular jong U Blei .
U Petros u la bud jngai na , haduh phyllaw ka jong ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh . U la leit shapoh ka phyllaw bad u la shong lem bad ki nongap byndi ban kumno khmih kan jia baroh .
translation.en: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest s palace , and went in , and sat with the servants , to see the end .
Now Samuel was dead , and all Israel had lamented him , and buried him in Ramah , even in his own city . And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits , and the wizards , out of the land .
translation.kha: Mynta u Samuel u la ïap , bad baroh ki Israel ki la ïambriew ïa u bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka shnong jong u hi , ha Ramah . U Saul u la lah beh lut ïa ki nongai ksuid bad ki nongkren byrtong baroh na Israel .

translation.en: And Joshua burnt Ai , and made it an heap for ever , even a desolation unto this day .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la thang ïa ka Ai bad u iehnoh ïa ka ha ka jingjot . Ka dang sah kumta mynta .
Kumjuh , ka Hima ki long kumne . U briew u wad ïa ki mawlynnai kiba kordor ,
translation.en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man , seeking goodly pearls :

translation.kha: To ong ha u , Pynim ïa ngi , A Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi ; lumlang ngi ïa baroh ; pyllait ïa ngi na jaitbynriew ki , ba khnang ngin sngewnguh bad ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me .
translation.en: And say ye , Save us , O God of our salvation , and gather us together , and deliver us from the heathen , that we may give thanks to thy holy name , and glory in thy praise .

If we say , We will enter into the city , then the famine is in the city , and we shall die there : and if we sit still here , we die also . Now therefore come , and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians : if they save us alive , we shall live  ; and if they kill us , we shall but die .
translation.kha: Kam long ka jingmyntoi ïa ngi ban leit shapoh ka nongbah namar ngin sa ïapthngan hangta , hynrei lada ngi shong hangne , ngin ïap kumjuh . Kumta , ïa ngin ïaleit noh sha ka jaka shong dara ki Syria ; kaba sniew tam ba ki lah ban leh ka long ba kin pynïap ïa ngi , hynrei lehse kin pyllait im ïa ngi .

translation.en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation , that I may consume them in a moment .
translation.kha: Ïeng sharud na kine ki briew bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki kumne kumne .
To pynshahshkor , phi ki briew kiba bieit bad , ba-mutlop kiba don ki khmat , ki hynrei bym lah ïohi , bad kiba don ki shkor , hynrei ki bym lah ïohsngew .
translation.en: Hear now this , O foolish people , and without understanding  ; which have eyes , and see not  ; which have ears , and hear not :

translation.kha: U Trai u , nga lap nyngkong ïa ki Israel , long kumba lap ki sohwaiñ kiba mih ha ri shyiap . Haba ïohi nyngkong ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi long kumba ïa u soh Dumbur uba ih nyngkong ha ka aïom . haba ki la wan u lum Peor , ki la sdang ïa u , bad tang katto por ki kylla long kiba isaitmet kita ki blei ki ieit .
translation.en: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness  ; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time : but they went to Baal–peor , and separated themselves unto that shame  ; and their abominations were according as they loved .

translation.kha: Ko Pa Bahok ! Ka kam ithuh ïa me , hynrei nga ïa bad kine me la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: O righteous Father , the world hath not known thee : but I have known thee , and these have known that thou hast sent me .
Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place , where there is no straitness  ; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness .
translation.kha: U Blei u la wallam noh ïa phi na ka jingjynjar bad u shah ïa phi ban kmen ha ka jingshngain ; ka miej jong phi ka shlei da ka jingbam .
Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba pynlong bymkhuid u briew . ban bam khlem da thet ïa ki kti jong phi kumba ki ong ïa phi ban kumta — Kane pynlong bymkhuid ïa u .
translation.en: These are the things which defile a man : but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man .

translation.kha: U Moses u kren ha u paidbah , Kynmaw ïa kane ka sngi — ka sngi ha kaba phi Memukan na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri lyngkdop kaba phi long ki mraw . Kane ka dei ka sngi ba U Trai u la ïalam noh ïa phi da ka borbah jong u . Wat bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat Horem
translation.en: And Moses said unto the people , Remember this day , in which ye came out from Egypt , out of the house of bondage  ; for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought you out from this place : there shall no leavened bread be eaten .

translation.kha: 7 u la duwai jam , Ko Trai U Blei jong nga , lbak me la leh kat kane kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ïa Hasael ka riewkynthei ? Ka la lehsbun shongsuk ban sumar ïa nga , bad mynta me pynïap ïa u khun jong ka !
translation.en: And he cried unto the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  my God , hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn , by slaying her son ?
Behold , I go forward , but he is not there  ; and backward , but I cannot perceive him :
translation.kha: Nga la wad shaphang mihngi , hynrei U Blei um don hangta ; ngam shym la shem ïa u haba nga wad shaphang sepngi .

translation.en: Thomas saith unto him , Lord , we know not whither thou goest  ; and how can we know the way ?
translation.kha: U Thomas u la ong ha u ,  Ko Kynrad , ngim tip shano ba men leit ; te kumno ngin tip ïa ka lynti ban poi hangta ?

translation.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness , and the moon into blood , before that great and notable day of the Lord come :
translation.kha: ïa ka sngi yn pyndum , bad u bnai un kylla saw kum ka snam , ha shuwa Ka Sngi kaba khraw bad kaba donburom jong U Trai ka wan .
Nga la ïai-ong ba borabor ka jingstad kham ka bha ban ïa ka jingkhlaiñ , hynrei ym don mano mano ba pyrkhat ïa u briew uba duk ba u long uba stad lane pynshahshkor ei ei ïa kaei kaba u ong .
translation.en: Then said I , Wisdom is better than strength : nevertheless the poor man s wisdom is despised , and his words are not heard .

And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing , I the  Lord  have deceived that prophet , and I will stretch out my hand upon him , and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel .
translation.kha: Lada u nongïathuhlypa u shah shukor ban ai ki jubab kiba bakla , ka dei namar ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la shukor ïa u . Ngan weng ïa u na ki paid Israel .

translation.en: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew , circumcision nor uncircumcision , Barbarian , Scythian , bond nor free : but Christ is all , and in all .
translation.kha: Kaba mih na kata , ka long ba ym don shuh ka jingpynïapher hapdeng ki Jentil bad ki Jiw , kiba la shah otsher bad ki bym shym la shah otsher , ki riewkhlaw , ki riewdum , ki mraw bad kiba laitluid ; hynrei U Khrist u long baroh , U Khrist u long ha baroh .
Kumta u Jesse phah khot ïa u . long uba bhabriew , u samla bakoit bakhiah bad ki khmat kiba phyrnai . U Trai u ong ha u Samuel , Dei une — pynsleh !
translation.en: And he sent , and brought him in . Now he was ruddy , and withal of a beautiful countenance , and goodly to look to . And the  Lord  said , Arise , anoint him : for this is he .

translation.kha: Dei ha ka por ba ki Israel ki don ha Moab mihngi na Jordan ba u Moses u ban batai bad hikai ïa hukum U Blei .
translation.en: On this side Jordan , in the land of Moab , began Moses to declare this law , saying ,

translation.kha: Kiba bun na nongbud jong u ki la ïohsngew ïa kane bad ki la ong , Kane ka jinghikai long kaba eh than . Uei u shahshkor ïa ka ?
translation.en: Many therefore of his disciples , when they had heard this , said , This is an hard saying  ; who can hear it ?

translation.kha: Ngan sa wan sha phi hadien ba la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Makedonia — naba nga ban lyngba ka Makedonia .
translation.en: Now I will come unto you , when I shall pass through Macedonia : for I do pass through Macedonia .
Then Jephthah fled from his brethren , and dwelt in the land of Tob : and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah , and went out with him .
translation.kha: U Jephthah u phet na la ki hynmen bad u leit shong ha ri Tob . Hangta shi kynhun ki nongkamsniew ki ïapynlong paralok bad u , bad ki leit lang kylleng lem bad u .

Ko ki briew jong nga , to kynmaw ïa kaei u u syiem ka Moab u la thmu ban leh ïa bad kumno u Balaam u khun jong u Beor la jubab ïa u . To kynmaw kiei kiba la jia ha na ka jaka shong dara Akasia sha Gilgal . To kynmaw ïa kine kiei kiei bad phin shem ïa kaei nga leh im ïa phi
translation.en: O my people , remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted , and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal  ; that ye may know the righteousness of the  Lord .
If God be glorified in him , God shall also glorify him in himself , and shall straightway glorify him .
translation.kha: Bad lada ïa ka burom U Blei la pynpaw lyngba jong u , te U Blei un pynpaw ïa ka burom jong U Khun U Briew ha lade , bad un leh kumta kumne kumne .

translation.en: Go not up , for the  Lord  is not among you  ; that ye be not smitten before your enemies .
translation.kha: Wat leit . U  Trai  um don lem bad phi , bad ki nongshun jong phi kin jop ïa phi .

U Iso Asa la isih ïa u Jakob , Lysanias ba Potiphar kpa jong u , u la ai Armoni bahok Jakob ïa ka jingkyrkhu . U la pyrkhat , Ka por ban ïambriew na ka bynta i pa jong nga jingpynshai la jan ; bakhia kumta ngan sa pynïap ïa u Jakob .
translation.en: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him : and Esau said in his heart , The days of mourning for my father are at hand  ; then will I slay my brother Jacob .

translation.kha: Ngan pynïoh pat ïa bor mynbarim jong ka jaitbynriew bad pynskhem biang ïa ka ; ngan pynshitom ïa baroh banbeiñ ïa .
translation.en: Their children also shall be as aforetime , and their congregation shall be established before me , and I will punish all that oppress them .

translation.kha: Kumta u shim ïa u khun nyngkong u , uba dei ban long hadien jong u la tyrwa ïa u halor ka kynroh kum ka jingkñia sha u blei Moab . Ki Israel ki sngewshyrkhei bad kumta ki la kynran ka nongbah bad ki la leit phai sha la ka ri .
translation.en: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead , and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall . And there was great indignation against Israel : and they departed from him , and returned to their own land .
If ye forsake the  Lord  , and serve strange gods , then he will turn and do you hurt , and consume you , after that he hath done you good .
translation.kha: Um lah ban shah ïa kiwei pat kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad u , bad lada phi iehnoh ïa u ban shakri ïa ki blei nongwei , un phai pyrshah ïa phi bad un pynshitom ïa phi . Un pynjot thiaw ïa phi , wat la u long uba bha ïa phi mynshuwa .

Nangta u angel uba saw u la put la ïa ka . turoi Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong sngi ka la shoh , bad shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong u bnai , bad shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki khlur , ba ka jingshai jong ki ka la jah noh shi bynta ka na lai bynta ka jingtyngshaiñ ; ym shym la don jingshai ha shi ka bynta na ka bynta lai jong ka sngi bad ïa ka shi bynta na ka bynta lai jong ka miet .
translation.en: And the fourth angel sounded , and the third part of the sun was smitten , and the third part of the moon , and the third part of the stars  ; so as the third part of them was darkened , and the day shone not for a third part of it , and the night likewise .
I am the door : by me if any man enter in , he shall be saved , and shall go in and out , and find pasture .
translation.kha: Nga , nga long kata ka jingkhang . Uno uno uba rung shapoh da nga un ïoh im ; kin ïohrung shapoh bad mih shabar bad shem ïa ka jaka bam phlang .

Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi shetkylla ki Saddusi kiba la wan sha ïaisah Jisu thadrong la kwah ban riam ïa u , kumta ki la kyrpad ïa u ban leh :37 ka kambah na khlup bynta jong ki , ban pyn-i ba U Blei u la pdiang ïa u .
translation.en: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came , and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven .
O  Lord  our God , all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand , and is all thine own .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , ngi la wallam lang ïa kane ka spah baroh ban tei ïa ka Templ ban pyndonburom ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me , hynrei kane baroh ka la wan na me bad ka long ka jong me .
Uta jingkhlem-akor dpei un sa her kum u pui pui uba jingburom ha ka ri Ijipt baroh , bad Dagon Leah Bad lwep un pynmih ki tohjaw sngewsynei kylla prum Leh u briew Keilah ha u mrad .
translation.en: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt , and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man , and upon beast , throughout all the land of Egypt .
And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the  Lord  of hosts in Shiloh . And the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , the priests of the  Lord  , were there .
translation.kha: Man ka snem , u Elkanah u mih na Ramah ban leit mane bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ha Shiloh ; ha kaba u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang u Eli , ki long ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai .

translation.en: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded , and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath , with them that were to go out on the sabbath : for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi bad ki briew ka Judah ki leh kumba la bthah da u Jehoïada . Ym shym la phah noh ïa ki rangbah haba ki la pyndep ïa la ki kamram ha ka Sabbaton , kumta ki rangbah ai hukum ki ïoh lang ïa kito kiba dang wan sha la ki kam bad kito kiba la pyndep kam .

translation.en: And saying , Where is the promise of his coming ? for since the fathers fell asleep , all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation .
translation.kha: Kin ibeiñ ïa phi bad kin kylli ,  U la kular ban wan , hato um shym la kular kumta ? Hangno u don ? Ki kpa tymmen ki la lah ïap , hynrei kiei kiei baroh ki dang ïaisah kumjuh kum mynba la pynlong ïa ka pyrthei !

translation.en: Let them bring them forth , and shew us what shall happen : let them shew the former things , what they be , that we may consider them , and know the latter end of them  ; or declare us things for to come .
translation.kha: Ale hangne bad ïathuhlypa ïa kaei ka ban sa jia , khnang ba ngin tip ïa ka haba ka urlong . To batai ha ka ïingbishar ïa ki jingjia kiba la dep bad ïathuh ïa ngi ka mut aïu .

translation.en: And Jacob said unto Joseph , God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan , and blessed me ,
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la wan mihpaw ha nga ha Lus ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u la kyrkhu ïa nga .

translation.en: And Jehoash said to the priests , All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the  Lord  , even the money of every one that passeth the account , the money that every man is set at , and all the money that cometh into any man s heart to bring into the house of the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: U Joash u phah khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad u hukum ïa ki ban kynshew ïa ki pisa ba siew ha kaba ïadei bad ki jingkñia ha ka Templ , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingsiew ba dei na ka bynta ki jingkñia ba ju leh bad ka pisa ba ai kum ki jingai sngewbha .

translation.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment , in meteyard , in weight , or in measure .
translation.kha: Wat shukor ïano ïano da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki jingthew thok , ha ka pruh , ha u mawthew , ne ha ka jingbun .

translation.en: My face will I turn also from them , and they shall pollute my secret place : for the robbers shall enter into it , and defile it .
translation.kha: Ngan ym leh ei ei haba ïa ka Templ bakordor jong nga yn pyntngit , haba ki nongtuh kin rung sha ka bad kin pyntngit ïa ka .

translation.en: And they shall make the ephod of gold , of blue , and of purple , of scarlet , and fine twined linen , with cunning work .
translation.kha: Kin suh ïa ka ephod da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , u  sai ksiar , bad da ka jaiñ linen bani .
Harud ki Uto ka ka-por ngi la shong ; hangta ngi ïam Pyni ngi Amminadab ïa ka Seïon .
translation.en: By the rivers of Babylon , there we sat down , yea , we wept , when we remembered Zion .
Ask Jehovah to help you do what is good .
translation.kha: To pan na U Jehobah ban ïarap ïa phi ban leh ïa kaba dei .

Phi jam la ïa ka Jordan bad wan poi sha ka Jerikho . Ki rangbah ka Jerikho ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , la kumba leh ki , Amor ki Peris , ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Girgash , ki Hib bad ki Jebus . Hynrei nga la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor jong baroh ki .
translation.en: And ye went over Jordan , and came unto Jericho : and the men of Jericho fought against you , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Girgashites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites  ; and I delivered them into your hand .

translation.kha: Haoid , u Blei un sa khot ksew ka niam ba bakla ban ai jingkhein halor ki kam niewbein kiba ka la leh ha ka kyrteng jong u .
translation.en: Yes , God will call false religion to account for all the despicable acts she has committed in his name .

translation.kha: To phin ïoh bun ki khun ki kti , ba ki khun ki ksiew jong jingdih kin sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And you , be ye fruitful , and multiply  ; bring forth abundantly in the earth , and multiply therein .

translation.kha: Te u angel u la leit noh bad u Kornelios u la khot ar ngut na ki shakri ïing jong bad uwei uba riewblei uba long uwei na kiba shakri ïa u .
translation.en: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed , he called two of his household servants , and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually  ;
These things have I spoken unto you , being yet present with you .
translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane katba nga dang don bad phi .

Uno uno ïa uba U Kpa jong nga u ha ai nga un wan sha nga . ym Ngan kyntait ïa uno uba uno wan nga sha , namar nga la wan hiar na bneng ban leh ym ïa ka mon ka jong nga hynrei ïa ka mon jong uta uba la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: For I came down from heaven , not to do mine own will , but the will of him that sent me .
And they come again to Jerusalem : and as he was walking in the temple , there come to him the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders ,
translation.kha: Ki la poi biang sa shisien ha Jerusalem . Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid ha ka Templ , ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki nonghikai ka Hukum , bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wan ha u

Ka dei ha ka ha ka por shiteng , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba nga la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba kham phyrnai ban ïa ka sngi , kaba wan na bneng bad kaba tyngshaiñ baroh sawdong ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah kiba lang bad nga .
translation.en: At midday , O king , I saw in the way a light from heaven , above the brightness of the sun , shining round about me and them which journeyed with me .
My God hath sent his angel , and hath shut the lions  mouths , that they have not hurt me : forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me  ; and also before thee , O king , have I done no hurt .
translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban set ïa ki shyntur jong ki sing khnang ba kin ym pynmynsaw ïa nga . U la leh ïa kane namar u tip ba nga la long uba lui lui bad namar ba ngam shym la leh kano kano kaba bakla ïa phi , ko Syiem Kynrad .

translation.en: And he went unto his father s house at Ophrah , and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal , being threescore and ten persons , upon one stone : notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left  ; for he hid himself .
translation.kha: U leit sha ïing u kpa jong u ha Ophrah , bad hangta ha khlieh jong uwei u maw u la pynïap ïa ki hynñiewphew ngut ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u , ki khun shynrang jong u Gideon . Hynrei u Jotham , u khun khatduh jong u Gideon , u la rieh bad um shym la shah pynïap .
Kumta u Jonathan u khot ïa u Dabid bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kita baroh ; nangta ïalam u ïa u sha u Saul , bad u Dabid u shakri ïa u syiem kumba u ju leh mynshuwa .
translation.en: And Jonathan called David , and Jonathan shewed him all those things . And Jonathan brought David to Saul , and he was in his presence , as in times past .
Among these were the divisions of the porters , even among the chief men , having wards one against another , to minister in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongap phira jong ka Templ la pynïabynta ha ki kynhun kynhun kat kum ki longïing , bad la pynkhamti ïa ki kam ha ka Templ kumba long lem kiwei pat ki Lebi .
Me sneng ïa kiba sarong ; kito ki bymkohnguh ïa ki jong hukum me ki long kiba la tim .
translation.en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed , which do err from thy commandments .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la siew khatsan lyngkhot ka rupa bad kilo u ban thied ïa
translation.en: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver , and for an homer of barley , and an half homer of barley :

translation.kha: Haba ki synran kiba ïadon bad U Jisu ki la ïohi ïa kaei ka ban jia , ki la kylli ,  Hato ngin pyndonkam ïa ki waitlam jong ngi , ko Kynrad ?

translation.en: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people , and hast sinned against thy soul .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki buit jong phi ki wanrah ka jinglehrain ha la ka longïing ; da kaba pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew babun phi la wallam tang ka jingjot ha lade .

translation.en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee , which thou shalt beget , shall they take away  ; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: Khyndiat na ki khun ki ksiew jong me hi yn sa ïalam noh bad ban pynlong ki ïunukh ban shakri ha ka ïingsyiem jong u syiem ka Babilonia .
khra-maw ym Rom ; hynrei ngan im bad ngan pynbna ïa kaei kaba U Trai Katto la leh .
translation.en: I shall not die , but live , and declare the works of the  Lord .

translation.kha: hynrei lada ka wan na U Blei , phim lah ban jop ïa ki . Phi ban lah shem ïa lade kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei ! Ka Dorbar ka la ïa kohnguh ka jingai jong jingmut u Gamaliel .
translation.en: But if it be of God , ye cannot overthrow it  ; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God .

And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears , out of Judah three hundred thousand  ; and out of Benjamin , that bare shields and drew bows , two hundred and fourscore thousand : all these were mighty men of valour .
translation.kha: U syiem Asa u don ka kynhun shipai kaba lai lakh ngut ki rangbah na Judah , kiba kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki sum , bad ar lakh phraphew ngut ki rangbah na Benjamin , kiba kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki ryntieh . Baroh na ki , ki long kiba shlur , ki rangbah ba la pyntbit bha .

translation.en: But if we walk in the light , as he is in the light , we have fellowship one with another , and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin .
translation.kha: Hynrei , lada ngi ïaid ha ka jingshai — kumba ma u , u long ha ka jingshai — te ngi don ka jingïasyllok paralok hi , bad ka snam U Jisu , U Khun jong u , ka pynkhuid ïa ngi na ka pop baroh .
ban pruid dur ba-itynnat ban bad saiñ ïa ki ha ka ksiar , ha ka rupa , bad ha ka rnong ;
translation.en: To devise cunning works , to work in gold , and in silver , and in brass ,

translation.kha: ‘ Tei ïa ki ïing bad shongduh . Thaw ki kper Pilat bam treh kaei lyer phi thung hangta .
translation.en: Build ye houses , and dwell in them  ; and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them  ;

translation.kha: ïa kaba lai da ki kulai rong lieh bad ïa saw da ki .
translation.en: And in the third chariot white horses  ; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses .
But when Jesus heard it , he answered him , saying ,  Fear not : believe only , and she shall be made whole .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kata bad u la ong ha u Jairos ,  Wat sheptieng ; tang shu ngeit , bad kan sa khiah .

translation.en: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy .
translation.kha: Kito kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw bym don jingmyntoi ki la iehnoh na kaba ïaineh ha me .

translation.en: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon , he and all the people that were with him  ; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand , and cut down a bough from the trees , and took it , and laid it on his shoulder , and said unto the people that were with him , What ye have seen me do , make haste , and do as I have done .
translation.kha: kumta u la leit kiew sha u Lum Salmon bad la ki rangbah . Hangta u shim uwei u sdie , u pom kawei ka tnat na u dieng , bad u bah ïa ka ha la ka tyrpeng . U ong ïa la ki rangbah ban pynkloi bad ban leh kumjuh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Edom , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because he did pursue his brother with the sword , and did cast off all pity , and his anger did tear perpetually , and he kept his wrath for ever :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Edom ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la beh krad ïa la ki hynmen ki para , ïa ki Israel bad khlem da pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki . Ka jingbitar jong ki kam don pud bad kim shah ba kin ïap .

translation.en: Nevertheless a lad saw them , and told Absalom : but they went both of them away quickly , and came to a man s house in Bahurim , which had a well in his court  ; whither they went down .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka sngi , jia ryngkhat uwei u khynnah u ïohi ïa ki , bad u leit ïathuh ha u Absalom ; kumta ki la leit bran bran ban rieh ha ka ïing jong uwei u briew ha Bahurim . U don ka pukri hajan ka ïing jong u , bad ki hiar shapoh jong ka .

soi ong ha nongbam Trai U Blei jong jingpynïasuk , aiti Ngam shym pynsah ei ei shuh ha ïing na Jehukal kaba nga la lum kyrpang ; nga la ai ïa ka Mediterranian ki Lebi , habud nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei phna kumba shrong la hukum ïa nga . Ngam shym la Gallio palat lane leh klet ïa ki pynpeit Ananias me ktang ïadei bad :21 na ki shiphew .
translation.en: Then thou shalt say before the  Lord  thy God , I have brought away the hallowed things out of mine house , and also have given them unto the Levite , and unto the stranger , to the fatherless , and to the widow , according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me : I have not transgressed thy commandments , neither have I forgotten them :

translation.kha: U Isaïah u leit na noh u syiem , hynrei ha ba shuwa un ïaid lyngba ïa ka phyllaw pdeng ka ïingbishar jong ka ïingsyiem , U Trai u ong ïa u
translation.en: And it came to pass , afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court , that the word of the  Lord  came to him , saying ,
Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai , and spakest with them from heaven , and gavest them right judgments , and true laws , good statutes and commandments :
translation.kha: Ha u Lum Sinai me wan hiar na bneng ; me kren ha ki briew bad me ai ïa ki , ki hukum babha bad ki jinghikai baskhem .
Phin shem kum ïa kita ki paralok hapdeng ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah .
translation.en: You will find such friends among Jehovah’s Witnesses .

translation.kha: Ka la long ha kato ka por ba nga la kular ban shim noh ïa ki na Ijipt bad ïalam ïa ki sha jingjar ri kaba nga la jied na ka bynta tang Amam , ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ka ri kaba kynsai tam na baroh .
translation.en: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them , to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands :

translation.kha: shahshkor To , phi kiba baroh shong ha ka pyrthei ! To ap ïa ka lama ai dak kaba yn kyntiew halor ki kliar jong ki lumbah ! To shahshkor ïa ka jingput ïa ka ronsing !
translation.en: All ye inhabitants of the world , and dwellers on the earth , see ye , when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains  ; and when he bloweth a trumpet , hear ye .
Because I delivered the poor that cried , and the fatherless , and him that had none to help him .
translation.kha: Haba kiba duk ki lynñiar , nga ïarap ïa ki ; nga ai jingïarap ïa ki khunswet ki bym don lad shuh .

Uno uno ïa uba la kha nyngkong , la u dei dak briew jingkhluit u jingri bymlalot ba ki Israel ki wanrah sha Shijur u long u tasngeng me jingpra Hynrei me dei ban pdiang ïa ka jingsiew ban thied pat ïa uwei pa uwei u khun ba la kha nyngkong , bad uwei pa uwei u jingri ba la kha nyngkong , Jason uba la ñiew :14-16 u long u bymkhuid .
translation.en: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh , which they bring unto the  Lord  , whether it be of men or beasts , shall be thine : nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem , and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem .

translation.kha: Kumta , ha kaei kaei kaba phi leh , ha kaba bam ne ha kaba dih , to leh phi ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka burom U . Blei
translation.en: Whether therefore ye eat , or drink , or whatsoever ye do , do all to the glory of God .

translation.kha: Kam shym pat biang ïa u ban leh pop kum u syiem Jeroboam ; u leit kham jngai shuh shuh bad u shongkurim ïa ka Jesebel , ka khun jong u Ethbaal u ka syiem Sidon , bad u la mane ïa u Baal .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians , and went and served Baal , and worshipped him .

translation.kha: U Gideon Emerald tamasa phah lumbah snar nonglamktien sha jingkhang Salaph Simran Ephraim Jagur ban ong , Ale sahmiet hiar ban ïaleh ïa ki Midian pynthiah Ïeng skhem ha ka ryndang Jordan Gedalaïah ha ki wahduid haduh Bethbarah , ban Bethesel ïa ki pynkloi na kaba jam ïa ki sha shiliang . Ki rangbah Ephraim jingbun la ïalumlang , bad ki la ïeng skhem ha ka Horonaim Jordan bad ha riewspah ïadon wahduid haduh Bethbarah .
translation.en: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim , saying , Come down against the Midianites , and take before them the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan . Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together , and took the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan .

translation.kha: U paralok jong u u , phai ktien , dei Ka ka waitlam jong u nong Israel , u Gideon u khun jong u Joash ! Kam mut da kumwei pat ! U Blei u ai la ha u ka jingjop halor ki Midian bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ngi baroh .
translation.en: And his fellow answered and said , This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash , a man of Israel : for into his hand hath God delivered Midian , and all the host .

Say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the stick of Joseph , which is in the hand of Ephraim , and the tribes of Israel his fellows , and will put them with him , even with the stick of Judah , and make them one stick , and they shall be one in mine hand .
translation.kha: to ïathuh ha ki , ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan shim ïa u lyngkhot dieng uba ïeng na ka bynta ka Israel , bad ngan buh lang ïa u bad uta uba ïeng na ka bynta ka Judah . Na kita ar tylli ngan pynlong uwei u dieng , bad ngan bat ïa u ha ka kti jong nga .

Ka la leh ïa kane bun sngi , lehbor ba u Paul u la sngew salia eh ba u la phai sawdong bad u la ong ha bhabriew jingïapthem mynsiem bymman , Ha ka kyrteng jong jingkyrpang sngewlem Khrist nga hukum thring me ban Sheshai na Julius Jehoaddin Uta u mynsiem bymman u Ïingtrep mihnoh na ka bai kata hi ka khyllipmat Beneberak
translation.en: And this did she many days . But Paul , being grieved , turned and said to the spirit , I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her . And he came out the same hour .
The eyes of the  Lord  are in every place , beholding the evil and the good .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïohi kaei kaba jia ha ki jaka baroh ; u khmih halor jong ngi , la ngi leh ïa kaba bha ne kaba sniew .

translation.en: The enemy said , I will pursue , I will overtake , I will divide the spoil  ; my lust shall be satisfied upon them  ; I will draw my sword , my hand shall destroy them .
translation.kha: U nongshun u ong , ‘ Ngan beh kthong bad kem ïa ki , ngan ïabynta ïa ka spah jong ki , bad ngan shim kat ïa kaba nga mon ; ngan sei ïa la ka waitlam , bad ngan shim ïa baroh kaba ki don .’

translation.en: And Jesus knew their thoughts , and said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Kano kano ka ri kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan ym neh slem . Bad kano kano ka shnong lane ka longïing kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan khyllem ha ka jingpra .

translation.en: Let his heart be changed from man s , and let a beast s heart be given unto him  ; and let seven times pass over him .
translation.kha: Haduh hynñiew snem un ym don ka bor pyrkhat briew , hynrei ka jingpyrkhat kum u mrad .

translation.en: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Bad U Trai jong ngi u la theh noh buk ïa ka jingaiei ba-dap kyrhai ha nga bad u la ai ha nga ïa ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingieit kiba long ki jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .

U Esra u ong , Ïaroh Mispah U Trai , rymphum Blei uba khraw ! Lakkum u atiar u rah la ki kti shajrong bad ong , Amen ! Amen ! Ki dem khohsiew ha ka sei Shephataïah ki phai ki khmat jong ki sha shniah .
translation.en: And Ezra blessed the  Lord  , the great God . And all the people answered , Amen , Amen , with lifting up their hands : and they bowed their heads , and worshipped the  Lord  with their faces to the ground .
So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai . Then was the king s wrath pacified .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa u Haman la sdien ha ka diengphasi kaba u la shna na ka bynta u Mordekai . Nangta ka jingbitar u syiem ka la long jai jai .
Ma nga hi sah ha ngan long u nongmihkhmat phi ki nong Babilonia kin wan shane . Hynrei lah ban lum kynshew ïa ka , ki soh , bad ka umphniang Olib , bad ban ban sah ha la ki shnongrit ba phi .
translation.en: As for me , behold , I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans , which will come unto us : but ye , gather ye wine , and summer fruits , and oil , and put them in your vessels , and dwell in your cities that ye have taken .

And he said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction , therefore thy life shall go for his life , and thy people for his people .
translation.kha: Nangta u nongïathuhlypa u ong ha u syiem ,  Kane ka dei ka ktien U  Trai  : ‘ Namar ba me la shah ïa u briew ban lait phet ïa uba nga la hukum ban pynïap , men hap ban siew da la ka jingim , bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me yn pynjot namar ba la pyllait ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ban lait phet .’
minot met jong ko hawei ju long kaba samla bad kaba khlaiñ , hynrei shen kan sa kylla pui pui .
translation.en: His bones are full of the sin of his youth , which shall lie down with him in the dust .
A bruised reed shall he not break , and the smoking flax shall he not quench : he shall bring forth judgment unto truth .
translation.kha: Un ym pynkheiñ ïa u khah ba la dem un ym pynlip ïa ka sharak ba dang mehding , un wanrah ka jingbishar hok baneh ïa baroh .

translation.en: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision . Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven .
translation.kha: Te ha kata kajuh ka miet ïa ka jingmaïan la pynpaw ha u Daniel ha ka jingïohipaw , bad u la ïaroh ïa U Blei ka bneng :
u Emerald , u Sapphir , bad u Diamond ka ha kyrdon kaba ar ;
translation.en: And the second row shall be an emerald , a sapphire , and a diamond .
And every one that heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them not , shall be likened unto a foolish man , which built his house upon the sand :
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien jong nga bad u bymkohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba bieit uba la tei ïa la ka ïing halor u shyiap .

translation.en: So they two went until they came to Beth–lehem . And it came to pass , when they were come to Beth–lehem , that all the city was moved about them , and they said , Is this Naomi ?
translation.kha: Ki ïaid shaphrang haduh ba kin da poi ha Bethlehem . Haba ki la poi hangta , ka shnong baroh kawei ka la sngewkmen , bad ki kynthei kiba hangta ki la pyrta ,  Hato kane ka dei shisha ka Naomi ?

translation.en: Through wisdom is an house builded  ; and by understanding it is established :
translation.kha: Ïa ki ïing la tei halor ka nongrim jong ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding : but that which is in the midst of fools is made known .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka don ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki briew kiba stad ; kiba bieit kim tip ei ei shaphang ka jingstad .

Don mano mano na ki rangbah synshar nga jong ha ïingsyiem ? u syiem u kylli . Mynta u Haman u dang shu rung ha phyllaw u ; la wan ban ong ïa u syiem ban phasi sdien ïa u Mordekai ha ka diengphasi kaba la dep pynkhreh .
translation.en: And the king said , Who is in the court ? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king s house , to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him .

translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la kren , Ko Kynrad , ngi la ïohi ïa u briew uba noh beh ïa ki ksuid ha kyrteng ka jong me , bad ngi la ong ïa u ban sangeh namar , um shym long u jong ka kynhun jong ngi .
translation.en: And John answered and said , Master , we saw one casting out devils in thy name  ; and we forbad him , because he followeth not with us .

And the king arose in the night , and said unto his servants , I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us . They know that we be hungry  ; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field , saying , When they come out of the city , we shall catch them alive , and get into the city .
translation.kha: Ka dang long mynmiet eh , hynrei u syiem u khie joit na jingthiah bad u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei ba ki Syria ki thmu . Ki tip ba ngi shahthngan hangne , kumta ki mih na la ka jaka shong dara ban leit rieh ha ki rudnong . Ki da pyrkhat ba ngin iehnoh ïa ka nongbah ban leit wad jingbam bad kumta kin sa kem ïa ngi bad kurup ïa kane ka nongbah .
Naba u ba kpu U Blei u ai u long uta uba wan hiar na bneng bad uba ai jingim ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven , and giveth life unto the world .
Jesus saith to him ,  He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet , but is clean every whit : and ye are clean , but not all .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Uno uno uba la dep sum u long uba la khuid bha bad um donkam ban da sait ïa lade , lait noh ïa la ki kjat . Baroh na phi , phi long kiba khuid — baroh lait noh uwei .
Kaei kaba u Syiem histori u pan ka long kaba Hasar Hapharaim katta katta ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban leh ïa kata lait tang ki blei , bad kim shong kim sah hapdeng hajuh bynriew .
translation.en: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth , and there is none other that can shew it before the king , except the gods , whose dwelling is not with flesh .

translation.kha: runar ki Ijon ki purew ïa kane kthang jingrwai : Ko ki pukri , pynkyrsoi ïa ka um jong phi , ïakynting ka Ishbah jingartatien pdiang sngewbha ïa ka .
translation.en: Then Israel sang this song , Spring up , O well  ; sing ye unto it :
And it shall be Aaron s and his sons   ; and they shall eat it in the holy place : for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire by a perpetual statute .
translation.kha: Uta u kpu u dei na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u . Ki dei ban bam ïa u ha ka jaka kaba kyntang , naba uta u long ka bynta kaba kyntang eh na ki jingainguh bam ba la kñia sha U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly : ye shall do no servile work therein :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra , ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .

translation.en: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war : for with thee will I break in pieces the nations , and with thee will I destroy kingdoms  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Babilonia , pha long u tyrnem jong nga , ka atiar jong nga ha ka thma . Nga la pyndonkam ïa pha ban ïuhroit ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ïa ki hima ,

translation.en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah , saying , Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee , saying , Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: ban ong ha u ,  U blei ha uba phi shaniah u la ong ïa phi ba phin ym hap ha ki kti ki jong nga , hynrei wat shah ba yn shukor ïa phi .

To pynbna ha kito kiba shong ha Gurbaal ïingsyiem ha Ijipt Babel Ashdod : Ïalumlang ha ki lum sawdong ka Samaria , jingtah peit ïa ka jingkhynwin kaba khraw bad ka jingïakynduh ba la jingkynmaw hangta .
translation.en: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod , and in the palaces in the land of Egypt , and say , Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria , and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof , and the oppressed in the midst thereof .

translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa ba ki man ki hynñiew snem ki dei ban ïa pyllaitluid uno uno u mraw Hebru uba la ïa shakri ki hynriew snem . Hynrei ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim shym la suidñiew ïa nga lane shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .
translation.en: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew , which hath been sold unto thee  ; and when he hath served thee six years , thou shalt let him go free from thee : but your fathers hearkened not unto me , neither inclined their ear .

translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa kaei ba la hikai ïa phi , long badonburom stad ; bastad lumrit ïa pynshongdor .
translation.en: Hear instruction , and be wise , and refuse it not .

translation.kha: Un jop ki bad pynïap ïa ki , bad ki jong ki kin sah ha ka surok bah kata bakhraw , ha kaba ïa U Trai la sahnarphna . Ka kyrteng pharshi kata ka nongbah ka long ka Sodom , lane ka Ijipt .
translation.en: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city , which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt , where also our Lord was crucified .

translation.kha: U ong , Namar kine ki briew ki kyntait um jai jong ka wahduid Shiloah bad khynñiuh ha khmat syiem Resin bad syiem Pekah ,
translation.en: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly , and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah s son  ;

translation.kha: Haba la pynkhih ïa u , u long uba shyrkhei ym ; don mano mano ba nud bad ïeng ha khmat jong u .
translation.en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up : who then is able to stand before me ?

And Shem and Japheth took a garment , and laid it upon both their shoulders , and went backward , and covered the nakedness of their father  ; and their faces were backward , and they saw not their father s nakedness .
translation.kha: Nangta u Shem bad u Japheth ki la shim kawei ka jaiñkup bad ki tawah ïa ka hadien jong ki ha la ka tyrpeng . Ki ïaid dadien shapoh ka ïingjaiñ bad ki tap ïa la u kpa , ki da phai dien khnang ba kin ym ïohi ïa u , ba u lyngkhuit .

translation.en: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers , who were ancient men , that had seen the first house , when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes , wept with a loud voice  ; and many shouted aloud for joy :
translation.kha: Bun na ki lyngdoh ba la kham tymmen , ki Lebi , bad ki rangbah kur , ki la ïohi ïa ka Templ banyngkong , bad ki peit ïa ka nongrim jong kane ka Templ katba dang tei , ki ïam pangnud . Hynrei kiwei pat kiba don hangta ki pyrta da ka jingkmen .

Hannah ka Kin kaba kordit ïa ki !
