translation.kha: Khot sngewbha ïa u Jesse sha kata ka jingkñia , bad ngan sa ïathuh ha me ïa kaei ba men leh . Men sa pynsleh kum u syiem ïa u briew uba ngan ïathuh ha me .
pat ïa ki jaka mane blei thala kiba u Hesekaïah u jong u la pynjot . U tei ki duwan ban ïa u Baal , u thaw ki dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah , bad u mane ïa ki khlur .
translation.en: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down , and he reared up altars for Baalim , and made groves , and worshipped all the host of heaven , and served them .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw U , u Blei la rah ïa nga sha ka ri Israel bad , u la pynshong ïa nga halor uwei u lumbah uba jrong . Nga la ïohi ha khmat jong nga shi kynhun ki jingtei kiba i kum ka nongbah .
translation.en: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel , and set me upon a very high mountain , by which was as the frame of a city on the south .
Then Solomon sat on the throne of the  Lord  as king instead of David his father , and prospered  ; and all Israel obeyed him .
translation.kha: Kumta u Solomon u kiew ïa ka khet u Dabid u kpa jong u ïa kaba U Blei U  Trai  u la seng . U la long u syiem uba jop , bad ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh ka la kohnguh ïa u .
Mynta sngewmong kha Ahas ka jingngeit ka la poi , ka Hukum kam donbor shuh halor jong ngi .
translation.en: But after that faith is come , we are no longer under a schoolmaster .

And the king of the south shall be moved with choler , and shall come forth and fight with him , even with the king of the north : and he shall set forth a great multitude  ; but the multitude shall be given into his hand .
translation.kha: U syiem Ijipt ha la ka jingbitar un leit sha ka thma pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Syria bad kem ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhraw jong u .

translation.en: Let thy tender mercies come unto me , that I may live : for thy law is my delight .
translation.kha: To isynei ïa nga , bad ngan im ; namar nga shem sngewbha ha ka aiñ jong me .
Haba la ka ha kaba ki jingthaw ha bneng ki wanpaw ha khmat U Trai , Soitan la lang hapdeng jong ki .
translation.en: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the  Lord  , and Satan came also among them .

translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba ngeit bad uba shah pynbaptis yn pynim ; ïa uno uno u bymngeit , yn pynrem .
translation.en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved  ; but he that believeth not shall be damned .

translation.kha: U balang nongsharai u dei ban u long bym don jingshah kynnoh pop ; u dei ban don tang kawei ka tnga , bad ki khun jong u ki dei ban long ki bangeit ki bad bym don jingbudnam ba ki long kiba leh thurmur lane ki bymkohnguh .
translation.en: If any be blameless , the husband of one wife , having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly .

translation.kha: Ngan sum ïa u ha ka kynroh , u Saul u ong ha lade , u bad kawang u ïa sum ha u ar sien ; hynrei ha baroh ar sien u Dabid u kynriah .
translation.en: And Saul cast the javelin  ; for he said , I will smite David even to the wall with it . And David avoided out of his presence twice .

Yet the  Lord  testified against Israel , and against Judah , by all the prophets , and by all the seers , saying , Turn ye from your evil ways , and keep my commandments and my statutes , according to all the law which I commanded your fathers , and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki Israel bad Judah :  Iehnoh noh ïa ki lynti kynriang bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , ïa kiba la don ha ka Aiñ kaba nga la ai ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad kaba nga la aiti pateng ha phi lyngba ki shakri jong nga bad ki nongïathuhlypa .
Elihu ki dieng ba don ryndang-kti , ki sim ki thaw ïa Shimham skum jong ki bad ki rwai .
translation.en: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation , which sing among the branches .
Haste thee , escape thither  ; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither . Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar .
translation.kha: Pynkloi ! mareh ! ngan ym lah ban leh ei ei tad haduh ba men da poi hangta .  Namar ba u Lot u khot ïa ka kaba rit , ïa kata ka nongrit la ai kyrteng ka Soar .

translation.en: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house , and shut up the house seven days :
translation.kha: un mihnoh na kata ka ïing bad un khang ïa ka hynñiew sngi .
Nangta u suh shaphang sepngi ka jaka jong ki Japhlet haduh ka jaka jong ka Haron kaba Sharum . Nangta u suh sha Geser u kut ka Duriaw Mediterranian .
translation.en: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti , unto the coast of Beth–horon the nether , and to Gezer : and the goings out thereof are at the sea .
And Jesus rebuked him , saying ,  Hold thy peace , and come out of him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u mynsiem ,  Sngap jar bad mihnoh na une u briew !

translation.en: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way , and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase : the lion had not eaten the carcase , nor torn the ass .
translation.kha: Ki ruh ki leh kumta , bad u leit noh bad u la lap ïa kata ka metïap u nongïathuhlypa ha lynti bah , lem bad ka kada bad u sing kiba dang ïeng hajan jong ka . U sing um shym la bam ïa kata ka metïap lymne patar ïa ka kada .

translation.en: And looking up to heaven , he sighed , and saith unto him ,  Ephphatha ,  that is ,  Be opened .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la khmied sha bneng , U la ud jylliew , bad u la ong ha uta u briew ,   Ephphatha .   Kaba mut ,  To plie !

translation.en: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens , his spirit was stirred in him , when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry .
translation.kha: Katba u Paul u dang ap ha Athens ïa u Silas bad u Timothi , u sngew shitom jingmut shikatdei eh haba u la ïohi ba ka nongbah ka shlei da ki bleithaw .

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto him ,  Put up again thy sword into his place : for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword .
translation.kha: Thep noh ïa la ka waitlam ha ka jaka jong ka ,  U Jisu u la ong ha u .  Baroh kiba shim ïa ka waitlam kin ïap da ka waitlam .
U Ehud pat da la ka kti kadiang u sei ïa ka waitlam na ka liang kamon jong bad u u dung pynngam ïa ka ha ka kpoh jong u syiem .
translation.en: And Ehud put forth his left hand , and took the dagger from his right thigh , and thrust it into his belly :
I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath .
translation.kha: Nga long uta uba tip kaba kumno ka long ban shah pynshitom ha U Blei .

translation.en: Then shall two be in the field  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ar ngut ki rangbah kin ïatrei ha ka lyngkha : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shadien .

Ki dang hamsaïa ïa kiei jingpynbaptis jingnoh kurup bad Troas , Kawei bthat ar ngut ki jymphong na ka bynta uwei nangne u shipai , ka jaiñ baremdor na ka bynta u Sisera , bad ki jaiñ ba la thain itynnat na ka bynta ka ryndang jong ka sngewkhlaiñ .
translation.en: Have they not sped ? have they not divided the prey  ; to every man a damsel or two  ; to Sisera a prey of divers colours , a prey of divers colours of needlework , of divers colours of needlework on both sides , meet for the necks of them that take the spoil ?

translation.kha: Lai sien shisnem ki shynrang ki dei wan mane ïa nga U Trai , U Blei Israel .
translation.en: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord  God  , the God of Israel .

translation.kha: U tnga jong litar u buh ka jingshaniah jong u ha ka , bad un ym kyrduh ei ei .
translation.en: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her , so that he shall have no need of spoil .

Among the Hebronites was Jeriah the chief , even among the Hebronites , according to the generations of his fathers . In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for , and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead .
translation.kha: U Jeraïah u dei u nongïalam jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hebron . Ha ka snem kaba sawphew ba u Dabid u la long syiem , la don ka jingtohkit shaphang ka pateng longïing jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hebron , bad la shem ba ki shipai bapawkhmat kiba na kane ka longïing la lap ba ki shong ki sah ha Jaser ha ka ri Gilead .

translation.en: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth , and hath given him power to eat thereof , and to take his portion , and to rejoice in his labour  ; this is the gift of God .
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u ai ha ngi ka spah bad ka jingdon jingem bad to ngin lehkmen ha ki , ngi dei ban sngewnguh bad lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei . Ka dei ka jingai na U Blei .

translation.en: And Israel journeyed , and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la nang ïaid noh , bad u la sher dara ha kawei pat ka liang jong u mot Eder .

translation.en: And Moses took of the anointing oil , and of the blood which was upon the altar , and sprinkled it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon his sons  garments with him  ; and sanctified Aaron , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons  garments with him .
translation.kha: U Moses u shim ïa ka umphniang pynsleh bad khyndiat ka snam kaba don ha ka duwan bad u synreit ïa ki ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ki jaiñkup jong ki . Ha kane ka rukom u pynkyntang ïa ki bad ïa ki jaiñ jong ki sha U  Trai .
Ki duwai lynñiar bad kumba lamwir haduh palat shiteng sngi hynrei ym shym don , ne ïohsngew ïa kano kano ka sur .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when midday was past , and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice , that there was neither voice , nor any to answer , nor any that regarded .

translation.kha: Bad kumta U Nongsynshar Trai Badonbor Baroh , u ong , Kan don ka jinglynñiar bad ki jingïam sngewsih ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah . Wat nongrep ïa ki yn khot ban ïam na ka bynta kiba ïap lem bad kito ïa kiba lah da siew ban ïambriew .
translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the Lord , saith thus  ; Wailing shall be in all streets  ; and they shall say in all the highways , Alas ! alas ! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning , and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing .
So they smote him , and his sons , and all his people , until there was none left him alive : and they possessed his land .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa u Og , ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh , khlem da pynsah uwei ruh , bad nangta ki kam kynti ïa ka ri jong u .
U Issakhar bad shekel khun shynrang jong u : u bakynjah , u Jehosheba , u Jashub , bad u Shimron .
translation.en: And the sons of Issachar  ; Tola , and Phuvah , and Job , and Shimron .
When thou shalt vow a vow unto the  Lord  thy God , thou shalt not slack to pay it : for the  Lord  thy God will surely require it of thee  ; and it would be sin in thee .
translation.kha: Haba phi ai kano kano ka jingkular ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , wat pynslem ha kaba pyndep ïa ka , U  Trai  un bat ïa ka kular jong phi , bad ka long ka pop ban ym pyndep ïa ka .
Ki briew ki tim ïa uno uba set ïa u kew , ban ap un kiew dor , hynrei ki ïaroh ïa uno uno uba sei ban die ïa u .
translation.en: He that withholdeth corn , the people shall curse him : but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it .
Who both killed the Lord Jesus , and their own prophets , and have persecuted us ; and they please not God , and are contrary to all men :
translation.kha: kiba la pynïap ïa U Trai Jisu bad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ki la pynshitom beiñ ïa ngi . A kumno ki la long ki bym pynsngewbha ïa U Blei! A kumno ki la long kiba shun iwei ïa iwei!

translation.en: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness  ; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei , uba khraw bad uba rit , u pyrshang ban shna pisa da ka jingbymhok ; wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki thok ïa ki briew .
Irijah Trai , me la pynkhiah ïa nga . Ngin tem ki duitara bad khubor Aaron jingïaroh ïa me , ngin rwai ïaroh ha ka Templ jong me katba ngi dang Khereth .
translation.en: The  Lord  was ready to save me : therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the  Lord .
Also their love , and their hatred , and their envy , is now perished  ; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun .
translation.kha: Ki jingieit jong ki , ki jingisih jong ki , ki jingkwah jong ki , baroh ki ïap lem bad ki . Kin ym lah shuh da lei lei ban ïashim bynta ha kano kano kaba jia ha kane ka pyrthei .
Nga tip , kynrad , ba nga la leh pop sngewtmang bad bnai kane keiñ pynjrong ba nga long uba kynum basanphew ki Beser bashaphang shatei ban wan bad ïakynduh ïa U Syiem Kynrad :97-100 kane ka sngi .
translation.en: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned : therefore , behold , I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king .
Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age  ; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women .
translation.kha: U Abraham bad ka Sarah ki la tymmen bha , bad ka Sarah ruh ka la palat ïa ka por ban dang ïoh khun .

translation.en: He poureth contempt upon princes , and weakeneth the strength of the mighty .
translation.kha: U pynjahburom ïa kito kiba don ha ka bor bad pynkut ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki nongsynshar .

U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa ka bynta kaba khatduh jong ka jingim u Job kham palat ban ïa kaba u la kyrkhu ha kaba mynnyngkong . U Job u long ïa trai ki khatsaw hajar tylli ki langbrot , hynriew hajar tylli ki ut ar , hajar tylli ki masi , shihajar bad tylli kada ki .
translation.en: So the  Lord  blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning : for he had fourteen thousand sheep , and six thousand camels , and a thousand yoke of oxen , and a thousand she asses .
So the house of Israel shall know that I am the  Lord  their God from that day and forward .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kin tip naduh kata ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
Ki la sdang ban ïakren para ma ki hi , U ïa ong kane namar ngim shym la wanrah jingbam ei ei .
translation.en: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have taken no bread .
I have written to him the great things of my law , but they were counted as a strange thing .
translation.kha: Nga la thoh ki jinghikai bym lah ñiew shuh na ka bynta ki briew , hynrei ki kyntait ïa ki kum kaei kaei kaba khyllah bad long nongwei .

translation.en: For the tabernacle of the  Lord  , which Moses made in the wilderness , and the altar of the burnt offering , were at that season in the high place at Gibeon .
translation.kha: Ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong U  Trai  kaba u Moses u la thaw ha ka ri khlaw , bad ka duwan ha kaba la thang ïa ki jingkñia ka dang don ha ka jaka mane ha Gibeon ha kane ka por ;
U pyrthat u pynbna ïa ka jingwan ka erïong bad ki jingri ki tip ba kan wan .
translation.en: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it , the cattle also concerning the vapour .

translation.kha: klet , jinglur hynmen ba-pynmynsaw para jong me kin ïaroh ïa me bymdonbor Me shim na ka ryndang ïa ki nongshun jong me ; Ki hynmen ki para jong me kin nguh kin dem ïa Jeush .
translation.en: Judah , thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise : thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies  ; thy father s children shall bow down before thee .

And , behold , the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop , and brought in a great spoil with them : but Abner was not with David in Hebron  ; for he had sent him away , and he was gone in peace .
translation.kha: Kham hadien , u Joab bad ki kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la wan phai na kaba leit lute , ki da wanrah shikatdei ka mar lute bad ki . Hynrei u Abner um don shuh bad u Dabid hangta ha Hebron , namar u Dabid u la lah phah noh ïa u lem bad ka jingkular jingshngain .

translation.en: And was drawn from the north , and went forth to En–shemesh , and went forth toward Geliloth , which is over against the going up of Adummim , and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben ,
translation.kha: Nangta u khun shaphang shatei sha Enshemesh bad nangta pat sha Geliloth , marpyrshah ïa ka khim Adummim . Nangta u hiar arsut sha u Maw jong u Bohan ( u Bohan u dei u khun jong u Reuben ) ,
To Duwai , te , ba nga lah ban kren kumba nga , ha kata ka rukom ba kan long kaba shai
translation.en: That I may make it manifest , as I ought to speak .

translation.kha: Sa Sdien ki Sapphira pyrta , To ïaroh pynïapthngan U Blei Jehosheba Ka tdem na ki thylliej ding kiba la bam duh ïa ka nongbah bakhraw ka la kiew shajrong junom la junom !
translation.en: And again they said , Alleluia . And her smoke rose up for ever and ever .
When the even was come , they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils : and he cast out the spirits with his word , and healed all that were sick :
translation.kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , ki briew ki la wallam sha U Jisu shibun kiba la don ki ksuid hapoh jong ki . U Jisu u la beh noh ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid da ka ktien bad u la pynkhiah ïa baroh kiba la shitom .

Haba kata ka por wan ka , ki bri sohwaiñ babha , kawei kawei ka don shihajar tylli ki sohwaiñ dieng bad kawei kawei ka shongdor shihajar tylli sbai ki rupa , kin shlei da ki bniap shiah bad ki shynraiñ .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that every place shall be , where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings , it shall even be for briers and thorns .

translation.kha: Ha ka janmiet shuwa ba un wan , nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai kaba jur . Haba uta u briew u la poi ha ka step kaba bud U , Trai u ai ha nga pat ïa ka bor ban kren .
translation.en: Now the hand of the  Lord  was upon me in the evening , afore he that was escaped came  ; and had opened my mouth , until he came to me in the morning  ; and my mouth was opened , and I was no more dumb .

translation.kha: Ko u khun briew , u la ong , to kren pyrshah ïa ka ri ki Ammon .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against the Ammonites , and prophesy against them  ;
So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , and went and returned , and dwelt at Nineveh .
translation.kha: Nangta u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria u kylla dien bad phai noh sha Ninebeh .
Phi Por thop ba la ong , ‘ Wat klim .’
translation.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time , Thou shalt not commit adultery :

translation.kha: Ki rung stet sha ka nongbah ; ki mareh nalor ; kiew sha ki ïing bad ki rung ki kum ki nongtuh .
translation.en: They shall run to and fro in the city  ; they shall run upon the wall , they shall climb up upon the houses  ; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief .
These are the sons of Zilpah , whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter , and these she bare unto Jacob , even sixteen souls .
translation.kha: Kine khathynriew ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u Jakob u ïoh na ka Silpah ïa kaba u Laban u ai ha ka Leah ka khun jong u ban long ka mraw jong ka .
Phi kyang jam Leit ‘ Ka waitlam jong U jyrngam ! Katno pynthnam phin ïai talain riewdum ka ? Khie mynlyiur phai ki! ba-marsyndah bym Maw , sah hangta bad shongthait !’
translation.en: O thou sword of the  Lord  , how long will it be ere thou be quiet ? put up thyself into thy scabbard , rest , and be still .
Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that it shall no more be said , The  Lord  liveth , that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por ka wan haba ki briew kin ym smai shuh da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And there stood up one of them named Agabus , and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world : which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Agabos , u la ïeng joit bad da ka bor jong U Mynsiem u la ïathuh lypa ba ka  nemsniew bajur kan sa wan ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . ( Ka la wan jia mynba u Klaudius u la long u Patsha . )

translation.en: And the sons of Gomer  ; Ashkenaz , and Riphath , and Togarmah .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Gomer ki long ki briew jong ka Ashkenas , ka Riphath , bad ka Togarmah .
shaniah ha u ksai — ka snur thapbawa .
translation.en: Whose hope shall be cut off , and whose trust shall be a spider s web .

translation.kha: Ka Naomi raikhoh ong ha bynriew , Ruth , ïaishah basngewlehrain , tad haduh ba phin da ïohi kumno kane baroh kan sa long phohsniew U Boas ujor ym shongthait mynta ka setkut tad haduh jingkordor un da pyndep eh sngew ka kam .
translation.en: Then said she , Sit still , my daughter , until thou know how the matter will fall : for the man will not be in rest , until he have finished the thing this day .

translation.kha: Mynmiet kynmaw ïa me , A Trai , bad nga pyrkhat ka aiñ jong .
translation.en: I have remembered thy name , O  Lord  , in the night , and have kept thy law .
Many will say to me in that day , Lord , Lord , have we not prophesied in thy name ? and in thy name have cast out devils ? and in thy name done many wonderful works ?
translation.kha: Haba ka Sngi Bishar ka poi , kiba bun kin ong ha nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai ! Ha ka kyrteng jong me ngi la kren ïa ka khubor jong U Blei , da ka kyrteng jong me ngi la beh noh ïa shibun ki ksuid bad ngi la leh shibun ki kambah !’

translation.en: And sitting down they watched him there  ;
translation.kha: Hadien kata ki la ïashong hangta , bad ki la ïa-ap ïa u .
shuki ïa u shisien bad men ym lanot bashatei kren lei lei ; men ym klet da lei lei ïa ka jingïaleh !
translation.en: Lay thine hand upon him , remember the battle , do no more .

translation.kha: Katba u u Moses dang rah shajrong ïa la ki kti , ki Israel ki jop , hynrei haba pynhiar u shapoh ïa la ki kti , ki Amalek ki jop .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses held up his hand , that Israel prevailed : and when he let down his hand , Amalek prevailed .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba kthang jong ka snem , nga la ïeng harud jong ka wah Tigris kaba khraw .
translation.en: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month , as I was by the side of the great river , which is Hiddekel  ;

And the people stood up all that day , and all that night , and all the next day , and they gathered the quails : he that gathered least gathered ten homers : and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki briew ki ïakem  iar khiar baroh shi sngi ha kata ka sngi , baroh shi miet , bad baroh shi sngi ha kawei pat ka sngi ; ym don uwei ruh uba lum duna ïa ka shihajar kilo . Nangta ki thad ïa ki sawdong kata ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread  ; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt : therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , namar dei ha kane ka sngi ba nga la ïalam noh ïa ki jait jong phi na ka ri Ijipt . Pateng la pateng phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka sngi kum ka Jingkhawai Niam .
Un wallam ïa ka khleiñ lem bad ka shadem jong u mrad ban ai ka kum jingai kaba kyrpang sha U Trai .
translation.en: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , the fat with the breast , it shall he bring , that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the  Lord .
For a dream cometh through the multitude of business  ; and a fool s voice is known by multitude of words .
translation.kha: Kat phi nang bun jingkhuslai , katta phin ïoh ki jingphohsniew kynsha , bad kat phi nang bunktien katta phin liat ha kaba kren ïa kaei kaei kaba bieit .

translation.en: Wherefore , Job , I pray thee , hear my speeches , and hearken to all my words .

translation.kha: Ngi pule ha ka Hukum u Moses ,  Wat khum ïa ka shyntur u masi dab haba me pyndonkam ïa u ban shoh ïa u kew .  Mynta , hato U Blei u sngewkhia ïa u masi dab ?

Te nga la ong ïa nongsuhjaiñ kur rwai Khynnah U Trai thymmai Baroh , Molekh Pahath ki Israel , Hebron la ong Jehoahas Phi la kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba u bashisha tymmen jong Sakhar u Jonadab u la ai ha phi ; phi la bud ïa jingailad ki jingbthah jong u , bad phi Im leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba pura! thik hukum ïa phi .
translation.en: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jehonadab your father , and kept all his precepts , and done according unto all that he hath commanded you :
And the work of righteousness shall be peace  ; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever .
translation.kha: Namar ba uwei pa uwei un leh ïa kaei kaba dei , kan don ka jingsuk bad ka jingshongshngain junom .

translation.en: And when he had made an end to offer the present , he sent away the people that bare the present .
translation.kha: Haba u Ehud u la dep ai ha u ïa ki jingai sngewbha , u la ong ha ki rangbah kiba la kit ïa kita ban leit phai noh pat sha ïing .

translation.en: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , we have wanted all things , and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine .
translation.kha: Hynrei naduh ba ngi sangeh ban ai jingkñia ha ka Syiem jong ka Bneng bad ngi sangeh ban theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ ha ka , ngim shym don ei ei shuh , bad ki briew jong ngi ki ïap ha ka thma bad na ka jingïapthngan .
U dei ban kham ieit ïa ka la lok ban ïalade .
translation.en: He should be self-sacrificing in his love for his wife .

translation.kha: Ka por ka la jan na ka ka Jingkhawai U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ïa kaba la khot ka Niam Ka Jinglait .
translation.en: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh , which is called the Passover .
Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers , beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us .
translation.kha: Man ka por , nga ai jingbam ha ka miej jong nga ïa shispah sanphew ngut ki Jiw bad ki nongïalam jong ki , nalor ki briew kiba wan sha nga na ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong .

translation.en: My God , think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works , and on the prophetess Noadiah , and the rest of the prophets , that would have put me in fear .
translation.kha: Nga duwai ,  A Blei , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Tobiah bad u Sanballat ki la leh bad to pynshitom ïa ki . To kynmaw ïa kato ka kynthei , ka Noadaïah , bad baroh kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa nga .
Namar kata , ko kynrad , ieh sah ma nga kum mraw jong phi ka u para , bad ïa u ba un leit phai bad la ki .
translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord  ; and let the lad go up with his brethren .

For the ships of Kittim shall come against him : therefore he shall be grieved , and return , and have indignation against the holy covenant : so shall he do  ; he shall even return , and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant .
translation.kha: Ki nong Rom kin wan ha ki liengbah bad kin pyrshah ïa u , bad un sa sheptieng .  Te un leit phai pat ha ka jingbitar shla bad un pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka niam jong ki briew jong U Blei . Un bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong kito kiba la iehnoh ïa kata ka niam .
Ban ïoh ïa ka jingtip , nyngkong phi dei ban don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Trai . Ki briew kim kiba mutlop don ka jingñiewkor ïa ka jingstad bad ki kyntait ban shah hikai .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of knowledge : but fools despise wisdom and instruction .

translation.kha: Kum u sing uba wan mih ki na khlaw barben kiba don lynter shi ka rud Jordan haduh ka jaka phlang bajyrngam , ma nga , U Trai , ngan bad wan ngan pynlong ïa ki nong Babilonia ban phet krad kynsan na ka nongbah jong ki . u Te nongïalam uba nga jied un synshar ïa ka hima . Mano ban ïanujor bad nga ? Uno uba nud ban wan kob ïa nga ? Uei u nongsynshar uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa nga ?
translation.en: Behold , he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong : but I will make them suddenly run away from her : and who is a chosen man , that I may appoint over her ? for who is like me ? and who will appoint me the time ? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me ?

translation.kha: Ha jingsawa jong ki shipai shong kulai bad jong nongsiatkhnam , uwei baroh u phet krad . Katto katne kin phet sha , kiwei kin ïakiew hapdeng mawsiang . Ïa kawei pa kawei ka shnong iehnoh thylli , bad ym don uno uno u ban shong ban sah pat ha ki .
translation.en: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen  ; they shall go into thickets , and climb up upon the rocks : every city shall be forsaken , and not a man dwell therein .
For ye say , Where is the house of the prince ? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked ?
translation.kha: Phi kylli ,  Hangno ka don ka ïing jong u briew bakhraw mynta , u briew uba leh ïa kaba sniew ?

translation.en: They shall be ashamed , and also confounded , all of them : they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols .
translation.kha: Kito kiba shna bleithaw baroh kin shah lehrain ; baroh na ki kin jahburom .

U dem ngon ha khmat jong ki , bad u ong , Ko rangbah , don hangne ban shakri ïa phi . Sngewbha wan sha ïing jong nga . Phi lah sait ïa la ki kjat , bad ban sahmiet ruh . Lashai phi ban khie dang , bad bteng ïa la ka jingleit . jubab , Em , sahmiet hangne ha ka jaka bakylluid jong ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he said , Behold now , my lords , turn in , I pray you , into your servant s house , and tarry all night , and wash your feet , and ye shall rise up early , and go on your ways . And they said , Nay  ; but we will abide in the street all night .
And Aaron took as Moses commanded , and ran into the midst of the congregation  ; and , behold , the plague was begun among the people : and he put on incense , and made an atonement for the people .
translation.kha: U Aaron u la kohnguh , u la shim ïa la u khiew buh ding bad mareh sha pdeng ki briew ba la ïalumlang . Haba u ïohi ba ka khlam ka la lah sdang , u buh ïa ka jingiwbih ha uta u rnga ding bad u pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta uta u paidbah .

translation.en: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne , and lay them on men s shoulders  ; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers .
translation.kha: Ki teh pynbah ha ki met jong ki briew ïa ki jingkit kiba khia bad kiba eh ban kit , pynban kim mon bad rah la ki kti ban ïarap ïa ki ban kit ïa kito ki jingkit .
Namar ba ki Edom shah ïa ban ïaid ïa ka hima ki , ki Israel la phai noh bad ïaid na kawei pat ka .
translation.en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border : wherefore Israel turned away from him .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka Ijipt ka ri ba sah kynjah tam pynshngain ka pyrthei . Na ka bynta sawphew snem ki nongbah ka Ijipt kin sah Apollonia ka jingjot , ki jingjot kiba kham sniew ban ïa kito ha kiwei pat ki nongbah . Ngan pynlong ïa ki sirka jaiñspong ki Omri . Kin phet sha man ki ri bad Gamaliel im hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate , and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years : and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and will disperse them through the countries .
And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother , and his sons with him  ; and shalt anoint them , and consecrate them , and sanctify them , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Pynphong ïa kine ki jaiñ ha u Aaron u hynmen jong me bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u . Nangta pynkupbor ïa ki bad pynkyntang da kaba pynsleh ïa ki da ka umphniang Olib , khnang ba ki lah ban shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it , because they wrought for me , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha u ïa ka Ijipt kum ka jingsiew na ka bynta ki jingtrei jong u , namar ka kynhun shipai jong u ka trei na ka bynta jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
Nangta phi baroh phin jubab , ‘ Ngi la ïabam bad ïadih bad me ; jingsah la hikai ha ka shnong jong ngi !’
translation.en: Then shall ye begin to say , We have eaten and drunk in thy presence , and thou hast taught in our streets .

translation.kha: Ki jubab , Ïa ka jingïakajia bad u Saul lem ka longïing jong u ym lah ban pynbeit ka rupa lane ka ksiar , lymne ba ngi kwah ban ïa uno uno u Israel . Te , kaei pyrkhat ba ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi u u kylli
translation.en: And the Gibeonites said unto him , We will have no silver nor gold of Saul , nor of his house  ; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel . And he said , What ye shall say , that will I do for you .
( And they said unto him , Lord , he hath ten pounds . )
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ong ha u , ‘ Ko kynrad , u la don lypa shiphew tylli ki sbai ksiar !’

translation.en: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity  ; and the earth shall rise up against him .
translation.kha: Ka bneng ka pynpaw ïa ka pop jong une u briew , bad ka pyrthei ka phla pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me , and increasest thine indignation upon me  ; changes and war are against me .
translation.kha: Me don borabor katto katne ngut ki nongsakhi pyrshah ïa nga ; ka jingbitar jong me ïa nga ka nang jur nang jur ; me thaw ki lad thymmai ban ïaleh ïa nga .
Haba u Joab u la keiñ noh ïa sawlyer jingbeh kthong Tel u Shiloah lumlang ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh , bad Shiphew la shem ba khatkhyndai ngut na ki , Mihngi la Serahaïah , nalor u Asahel .
translation.en: And Joab returned from following Abner : and when he had gathered all the people together , there lacked of David s servants nineteen men and Asahel .
Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel , to do it for them  ; I will increase them with men like a flock .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Sa shisien pat ngan shah ïa ki Israel ba kin pan jingïarap na nga bad ngan shah ïa ki ba kin roi ha ka jingbun briew kum ka kynhun langbrot .

translation.en: In this was manifested the love of God toward us , because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world , that we might live through him .
translation.kha: Bad U Blei u la pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi da kaba phah ïa la U Khun ba marwei sha ka pyrthei , khnang ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingim da u .

translation.en: A land which the  Lord  thy God careth for : the eyes of the  Lord  thy God are always upon it , from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u khmih sumar ïa kane ka ri bad u ap sumar ïa ka baroh shisnem .
Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei jingtrei , Kitab wat trei ïaksaid ei ha pynpyiar Kem Badonburom hynñiew , wat la ka long ha ka aïom lur ne ka aïom ot .
translation.en: Six days thou shalt work , but on the seventh day thou shalt rest : in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest .

And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah , according to the commandment of the  Lord  to Joshua , even the city of Arba the father of Anak , which city is Hebron .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua , la ai shi bynta na ka jaka jong ka Judah ha u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh , na ka jait Judah . U la ïohpdiang ïa ka Hebron , ka nongbah kaba dei jong u Arba , u kpa jong u Anak .
Hangta hi u la lah ban tbeh pat nongbud bashongbriew u la bud ïa U jingïadih , da jongphi- ainguh ksar U Blei jyrthiaw Haba ki paidbah ki mane ïohi ïa kata , ki la ïaroh ïong U Blei .
translation.en: And immediately he received his sight , and followed him , glorifying God : and all the people , when they saw it , gave praise unto God .

translation.kha: Te to batskhem ka jingngeit kaba phla . Naba ngi don U Rangbah uba khraw uba la leit ka ryngkat U Blei — U Jisu , U Khun U Blei .
translation.en: Seeing then that we have a great high priest , that is passed into the heavens , Jesus the Son of God , let us hold fast our profession .
I have heard many such things : miserable comforters are ye all .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew kum kita ki ktien mynshuwa ; ka jingpyntngen kaba phi ai ka long tang ka jingpynshitom .
Kumta te , uwei uwei baroh u dei ïit ban nyngkong ïa lade , bad nangta un bam ïa u kpu dih bad na ka khuri .
translation.en: But let a man examine himself , and so let him eat of that bread , and drink of that cup .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Amon u la leh buh la jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
From thence they removed , and pitched in the valley of Zered .
translation.kha: Nangta pat ki leit sher dara ha Them Sered .
U Trai u wan :22-25 ha u lyoh bad u la ïeng bad u ïohpateng , bad u la pynbna ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong u , U Shalmaneser bariewspah
translation.en: And the  Lord  descended in the cloud , and stood with him there , and proclaimed the name of the  Lord .
Over against the border were the rings , the places for the staves to bear the table .
translation.kha: U buh ïa kita ki kyrwoh hajan ka rmiang ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah haba rah ïa ka .
Ko Nonghikai , jingjulor Hebron briew plakhun la ong , naduh ba nga dang khynnah , nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki khunlung baroh .
translation.en: And he answered and said unto him , Master , all these have I observed from my youth .

translation.kha: Haba u Araunah u khmih sharum u ïohi u syiem bad synshar jong ïawan kiew sha u . U rynsied ïa lade ha madan ha khmat jong u Dabid
translation.en: And Araunah looked , and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him : and Araunah went out , and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground .

translation.kha: Kumta haba phi pynlong ka jingkular ha U Blei , pyndep kloi ka ïa katba lah . donkam Um ïa u bieit . Leh ïa kaei kaba phi kular ban leh .
translation.en: When thou vowest a vow unto God , defer not to pay it  ; for he hath no pleasure in fools : pay that which thou hast vowed .

translation.kha: Haba u Saul u ïohi ïa u Dabid ba u leit ban ïaleh bad u Goliath u kylli u u rangbah shipai jong u , Abner , u dei u khun jongno mo ? Ngam don jingtip , syiem Kynrad , u Abner u jubab .
translation.en: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine , he said unto Abner , the captain of the host , Abner , whose son is this youth ? And Abner said , As thy soul liveth , O king , I cannot tell .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki longïing jong ka kur Kohath ki ïoh katto katne ki nongbah na ka jong jaka ki Ephraim .
translation.en: And the families of the children of Kohath , the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath , even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim .
Moreover this they have done unto me : they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day , and have profaned my sabbaths .
translation.kha: Bad kata kam dei kaba ki la leh baroh . Ki pyntngit ïa ka Templ jong nga bad ki pynkheiñ ïa ka Sabbaton , kaba nga la pynskhem .
Ïa ka jingsuk nga iehnoh ha phi , ïa ka jingsuk jong nga hi , nga ai ha phi . Ngam ai ïa kumba ka pyrthei ka ai sngewkhuslai sngewdiaw ; wat .
translation.en: Peace I leave with you , my peace I give unto you : not as the world giveth , give I unto you . Let not your heart be troubled , neither let it be afraid .
Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover .
translation.kha: Man ka snem ki kmie ki kpa jong U Jisu ki leit sha Jerusalem na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .
ka Beth Lebaoth , bad ka Sharuhen : khatlai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: And Beth–lebaoth , and Sharuhen  ; thirteen cities and their villages :
And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak , saying , Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; and a calf and a lamb , both of the first year , without blemish , for a burnt offering  ;
translation.kha: Nangta ong ïa ki paid Israel ban wallam ïa uwei u  langsohmoh ban pynlong ka jingkñia namar ka pop , uwei u khun masi uba shisnem , bad uwei u khunlangbrot uba shisnem , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna , ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh thang ,
Kata ka bteng ka jubab , Da ïakem , phi tip aïu u syiem Saul u la leh , kumno u la beh ïa “Te jyrthiaw ksuid bad ki nongkren byrtong na Israel . Te balei phi riam ïa nga bad ba ngan shah pynpulom ?
translation.en: And the woman said unto him , Behold , thou knowest what Saul hath done , how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits , and the wizards , out of the land : wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life , to cause me to die ?
Then answered them the Pharisees , Are ye also deceived ?
translation.kha: Hato u la pynbieit ïa phi ruh ?  ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa ki .

translation.en: And they returned , and came to En–mishpat , which is Kadesh , and smote all the country of the Amalekites , and also the Amorites , that dwelt in Hazazon–tamar .
translation.kha: Nangta ki phai dien bad ki wan poi biang sha Kadesh ( kaba la tip mynshuwa kum ka Enmishpat ) . Ki la jop ïa ka ri baroh jong ki Amalek , bad ki la jop ïa ki Amor ruh kiba shong basah ha Hasason Tamar .

translation.en: Which was the son of Saruch , which was the son of Ragau , which was the son of Phalec , which was the son of Heber , which was the son of Sala ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Serug , u khun jong u Reu , u khun jong u Peleg , u khun jong u Eber , u khun jong u Shelah ,
Kaba ñiewshiliang ka Musri kaba nongkamsniew . jingpanpoh don katto katne ki nongbishar ki ban Megiddo bymdei ban ïoh wat tang kaba rit tam ka mradkhlaw .
translation.en: To have respect of persons is not good : for for a piece of bread that man will transgress .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha kata ka briew , Ïa ki pop jong pha map la .
translation.en: And he said unto her ,  Thy sins are forgiven .

translation.kha: I ñiew ïa ngi kum ki . nongwei I la die ïa ngi , bad mynta i la pynlut ïa ka baroh pisa kaba long ka dor jong ngi .
translation.en: Are we not counted of him strangers ? for he hath sold us , and hath quite devoured also our money .

translation.kha: Uwei u nong Ijipt :17 Jediael ïa ngi na ki nongap langbrot , ki jubab ; ïapyllait lehrain um lem ïa ngi , akasia u ïarap ai thurmur de ïa ki jingri jong ngi .
translation.en: And they said , An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds , and also drew water enough for us , and watered the flock .

translation.kha: iwei pa iwei na phi phin buh ha ka shang ïa u soh nyngkong hadien ba la phi lum na uwei pa uwei jait u jingthung , bad leit rah ïa ka sha ka jaka mane Blei .
translation.en: That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth , which thou shalt bring of thy land that the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and shalt put it in a basket , and shalt go unto the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose to place his name there .
And I find more bitter than death the woman , whose heart is snares and nets , and her hands as bands : whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her  ; but the sinner shall be taken by her .
translation.kha: Nga la shem ïa kaei kaei kaba kham kthang ban ïa ka jingïap — ka kynthei kaba long kum ka jingriam . Ka jingieit ba ka ai ïa phi kan kem ïa phi kum ka jar , bad ki kti jong ka sawdong jong phi kin bat ïa phi kum u kynjri . U briew uba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei u lah ban lait , hynrei kan kem ïa u nongpop .

translation.en: And the Philistines took the ark of God , and brought it from Eben–ezer unto Ashdod .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki Philistia ki la ïohknieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ki kit ïa ka na Ebeneser sha ka nongbah jong ki ha Ashdod ,

translation.en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar .
translation.kha: Hamar ba mih ka sngi , u Lot u la poi ha Soar .
Hynrei phi ñiew ki briew kat kum ba ki paw shabar , phi long ba la ha ka pop , bad ka ka ïa phi kum u .
translation.en: But if ye have respect to persons , ye commit sin , and are convinced of the law as transgressors .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u ong ha ki la hynmen bad ha ki khun ki kti u kpa jong u , Nga dei ban leit ïathuh ha u ba syiem ki hynmen ki para jong nga bad ki ba-ha-ïing i ha-sem pa kiba shong ha Kanaan ki la wan poi sha nga .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , and unto his father s house , I will go up , and shew Pharaoh , and say unto him , My brethren , and my father s house , which were in the land of Canaan , are come unto me  ;

translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa ki khun Israel kiba dei na ka jait Judah , bad khun ki ki ksiew jong ki kin ïa ïohkynti ka ri jong nga kaba ha ki lumbah . Ki briew ba la jong jied nga , kiba shakri ïa nga , kin shong hangta .
translation.en: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob , and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains : and mine elect shall inherit it , and my servants shall dwell there .

translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka lynti ba leit u phai sha ka nongbah , U Jisu u la thngan .
translation.en: Now in the morning as he returned into the city , he hungered .
Teach me good judgment and knowledge : for I have believed thy commandments .
translation.kha: To ai ha nga ka jingstad bad ka jingtip , namar nga shaniah ha ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: Who being the brightness of his glory , and the express image of his person , and upholding all things by the word of his power , when he had by himself purged our sins , sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high  ;
translation.kha: U pynpaw ïa ka jingtyngshaiñ ka burom U Blei bad u ïasyriem thik bad ka dur U Blei hi , uba kyrshan ïa ka pyrthei da ka ktien badonbor jong u . Hadien ba u la ïohpdiang ka jingmap ïa ki pop u khunbynriew , u la shong ha bneng ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , U Bakhrawbor Tam .

translation.en: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth : and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingthmu jong nga ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka ïa ka kti jong nga la kner ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: And Moses made haste , and bowed his head toward the earth , and worshipped .
translation.kha: U Moses u pynkloi ban nguh dem haduh khyndew bad u la mane .

U Solomon u la synshar ïa ka jaka baroh kaba sha sepngi i'u ka wah Ïuphratis , naduh Tiphsah kaba kynthrong Melea haduh shaphang sepngi ka nongbah Gasa phra Baroh ki syiem kiba mat sepngi jong Don Ïuphratis ki la hap hapoh jong u , bad u la don Kedemoth ka jingïasuk bad ki ri ba-marjan Laiphew nongrah
translation.en: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river , from Tiphsah even to Gaza , over all the kings on this side the river : and he had peace on all sides round about him .
