translation.kha: Ka duriaw ka la tyllep ïa ka Babilon bad tap da ki jingat phyllung bakyrhuh .
Ha ki pynsangeh mane blei thala , ha ki lum phlang bad hapoh ka syrngiew jong ki dieng baroh , u Ahas kila ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih .
translation.en: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places , and on the hills , and under every green tree .

translation.kha: dei ban da ïapynbeit bad uta uba thied ïa u , bad ïakheiñ ïa ki snem naduh por ba u la die ïa lade haduh Snem Jingpynphai pat ka ban wan bad bai pyllait kin buh dor kat kum jingdon jong kita ki snem , ha ka nongrim ka bainong u nongbylla .
translation.en: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubilee : and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years , according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him .

And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians , saying , Master , we know that thou art true , and teachest the way of God in truth , neither carest thou for any man : for thou regardest not the person of men .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la phah sha u katto katne ngut na ki synran jong ki bad katto katne ngut ki dkhot jong ka kynhun u Herod .  Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  ngi tip ba me ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha . Me hikai ïa ka jingshisha shaphang ka mon U Blei na ka bynta u briew , khlem da khuslai shaphang kaei kaba ki briew ki pyrkhat , namar ba mem pyrkhat ïa ka kyrdan jongno jongno .

translation.en: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la iehnoh ïa kaei kaei kaba u don ha u Isaak ;

U la ïathuh ruh Lane ka jingphohsniew ha la u kpa , bad u Mikhael jong rta , u la mai ïa u , Ka jingphohsniew aïu kaba lyngktar kata jingshad Hato me pyrkhat ba ka kmie jong me , ki hynmen shynrang jong me , bad ma nga ngin ïawan bad nguh ïarap me tyrwa
translation.en: And he told it to his father , and to his brethren : and his father rebuked him , and said unto him , What is this dream that thou hast dreamed ? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth ?

translation.kha: Hato phi rai pynrem ïa U Blei hok uba ? Hato phi pyrkhat ba U isih ïa ka jingbishar hok ?
translation.en: Shall even he that hateth right govern ? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just ?
My brethren , have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Lord of glory , with respect of persons .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , kum kiba ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , U Trai ka burom , phim dei ban ñiew ïa ki parabriew da ki rukom kiba pher na kaei kaba ïohi ïa ki na shabar .

translation.en: Neither shall any priest drink wine , when they enter into the inner court .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban dih kano kano ka waiñ shuwa ban leit rung hapoh ka phyllaw kaba kham shapoh .
Hynrei phim shahshkor satia lane pynleit jingmut . kyiad iehnoh noh set iaki Kaïaphas basniew ibiang kñia ha kiwei ki blei .
translation.en: But they hearkened not , nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness , to burn no incense unto other gods .

translation.kha: ïa ki Israel ban wanrah ïa umphniang Olib kaba khuid bha ka bynta kita sharak , ba kin ai jingshai man la ka por .
translation.en: Command the children of Israel , that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light , to cause the lamps to burn continually .
For this ointment might have been sold for much , and given to the poor .
translation.kha: Ïa kane ka jingsleh iwbih lah ban die ha ka dor kaba rem bad ïa ka pisa ban ai ha kiba duk .

translation.en: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month , which is the month Sebat , in the second year of Darius , came the word of the  Lord  unto Zechariah , the son of Berechiah , the son of Iddo the prophet , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba khatwei ( u bnai Shebat ) , U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ka khubor ha ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet .
Kin mane nga bad ïalam ïa ki langbrot bad jingri jong ki sha ki jaka ka Pyntha ka Sharon ha ka phang bad ha ka Them ka ha phang mihngi .
translation.en: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks , and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in , for my people that have sought me .
Now therefore what is under thine hand ? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand , or what there is present .
translation.kha: Te nangta , phi don jingbam ei ei ? Ai ïa nga san tylli ki kpu ne kano kano kaba phi don .

translation.en: But it was so , that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house .
translation.kha: Hynrei kat haduh ka snem kaba arphew lai jong ka jingsynshar u Joash ki lyngdoh kim pat shym la shna pynbha ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: The tongue of the just is as choice silver : the heart of the wicked is little worth .
translation.kha: Ki ktien u briew uba bha ki long kum ka rupa kaba kynsai ; ka jingai jingmut jong u riewbymman kim dondor ei ei .
Jingsuk Trai , nga la wan ha me jingtem ïoh jingïada ; wat shah da sngewrit lei ba ngan shahjop !
translation.en: In thee , O  Lord  , do I put my trust : let me never be put to confusion .
And I saw a new heaven and a new earth : for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away  ; and there was no more sea .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ka bneng bathymmai bad ïa ka pyrthei bathymmai . Ka bneng banyngkong bad ka pyrthei banyngkong ki la jah noh , bad ka duriaw kam don shuh .

translation.en: And satest upon a stately bed , and a table prepared before it , whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil .
translation.kha: Ki da shong ha ki jingthiah ba-itynnat , bad ha khmat jong ki kin buh ïa ka miej ba la dap da kiei kiei kiba bha , ba kynthup ïa ki jingiwbih bad ka umphniang Olib kaba nga la ai ha ki .

translation.en: And I say unto you , Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness  ; that , when ye fail , they may receive you into everlasting habitations .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u ïai bteng ban ong ,  Bad kumta nga ong ha phi : Pynlong paralok na ka bynta ïa lade da ka spah ba kynja pyrthei , khnang ba haba kam don shuh , yn pdiang sngewbha ïa phi sha ka ïing bymjukut .

translation.en: And thou shalt sanctify them , that they may be most holy : whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy .
translation.kha: Pynkyntang ïa ki kumne ba kin dup long kiba khuid janai bad ïa uno uno ne kaei kaei kaba pyndei ïa ki yn pynmynsaw da ka bor ka jingkhuid jong ki .

translation.en: These are the inheritances , which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel , divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the  Lord  , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation . So they made an end of dividing the country .
translation.kha: U Eleasar u lyngdoh , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , bad ki nongïalam jong ki jait Israel ki la ai ïa kine ki bynta jong ka ri da kaba kynting sbai ban ïakren ïa U  Trai  ha Shiloh , ha ka jaka rung sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ha kane ka rukom ki la pyndep ka jingpynbynta ïa ka ri .

translation.en: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you , and ye shall be clean : from all your filthiness , and from all your idols , will I cleanse you .
translation.kha: Ngan synreit ïa phi da ka um khuid , bad ngan pynkhuid ïa phi na ki bleithaw jong phi bad na baroh kiei kiei kiba la pyntngit ïa phi .
Nangta ki la bynthiew ha ka khmat jong u bad ki la shoh ïa u bad ; kito kiba la thab ïa u
translation.en: Then did they spit in his face , and buffeted him  ; and others smote him with the palms of their hands ,
There shall no evil happen to the just : but the wicked shall be filled with mischief .
translation.kha: Ym don kaba sniew kaba jia ha ki briew kiba hok , hynrei ki bymman kim don ei ei tang ka jynjar suda .
u la ong ha u Moses , Sngewbha , ko kynrad , wat pynlong ban shah pynshitom namar ka pop ha ka jingbieit .
translation.en: And Aaron said unto Moses , Alas , my lord , I beseech thee , lay not the sin upon us , wherein we have done foolishly , and wherein we have sinned .

translation.kha: Kumta u Ebedmelekh u la leit shata bynñiaw ong ïa u syiem .
translation.en: Ebed–melech went forth out of the king s house , and spake to the king , saying ,
Suffer me that I may speak  ; and after that I have spoken , mock on .
translation.kha: Ai ïa nga ka lad ba ngan kren bad nangta , haba nga la dep kren , krenbeiñ lada phi kwah .

translation.en: Saying , Give me also this power , that on whomsoever I lay hands , he may receive the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ,  To ai ïa kane ka bor ha nga ruh , khnang ba uno uno ha uba nga buh ïa la ki kti un ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: Their children also shall be as aforetime , and their congregation shall be established before me , and I will punish all that oppress them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïoh pat ïa ka bor mynbarim jong ka jaitbynriew bad pynskhem biang ïa ka ; ngan pynshitom ïa baroh kiba banbeiñ ïa ki .

Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor Phim kata ka jingbitar shla bad ka jingsarong jong me , bad mynta ngan buh ïa u riewthombor ha jingsylla khmut jong me bad u bnoh ha ka shyntur jong me bad ngan pynphai pat na ka lynti ha kaba me la wan .
translation.en: Because thy rage against me , and thy tumult , is come up into mine ears , therefore will I put my hook in thy nose , and my bridle in thy lips , and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest .
As many as I love , I rebuke and chasten : be zealous therefore , and repent .
translation.kha: Nga sneng bad sympat ïa baroh kiba nga ieit . Long kaba thrang eh , te , bad phai noh na ki pop jong pha .

translation.en: Let them therefore give us two bullocks  ; and let them choose one bullock for themselves , and cut it in pieces , and lay it on wood , and put no fire under : and I will dress the other bullock , and lay it on wood , and put no fire under :
translation.kha: Wallam ar tylli ki masi dab ; ai ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal kin shim uwei , pynïap ïa u , ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa u bad buh halor ki diengthang — hynrei wat pynmeh ding . Nga ruh ngan leh kumjuh ïa uwei pat u masi dab .

translation.en: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases , and removed the laver from off them  ; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it , and put it upon a pavement of stones .
translation.kha: U syiem Ahas u shim kyrpang ïa ki kali rnong ba pyndonkam ha ka Templ bad weng noh ïa ki khiew kiba don halor jong ki ; u shim ïa ka pipa rnong na ki bynta ba shadien jong ki khat-ar tylli ki masi dab rnong , bad u buh ha u maw nongrim .
Hangta ha khmat jong ki jingpyrta-thma , kim shym la pynïohnong Ainias kem daw ïa u ha Akeldama kano buit kumta Rebekka jingkhynwin sngap jar , ki da lyngngoh ha ka pynbabe jong u .
translation.en: And they could not take hold of his words before the people : and they marvelled at his answer , and held their peace .

translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ïa nga bad ki la ai jingkñia ha ki kiwei blei , bad kumta ki pynkhih la ïa ka jingbitar jong nga baroh da kaba ki la leh . Ka jingbitar jong nga ka la khie buk , bad ngan ym pynjah kumto .
translation.en: Because they have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands  ; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place , and shall not be quenched .

And David said , What have I to do with you , ye sons of Zeruiah , that ye should this day be adversaries unto me ? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel ? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Dabid u ong ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Joab , u para jong u ,  Mano ba pan ïa ka jingmut na phi ? Hato phi thmu ban pynwit ïa nga ? Mynta , nga dei ma nga u Syiem jong ka Israel bad ha kane ka sngi yn ym pynïap ïa uno uno ruh u Israel .
Hynrei ai ba ki riewstad mynbarim ïa me to kaei kaba ki don ban .
translation.en: Shall not they teach thee , and tell thee , and utter words out of their heart ?

translation.kha: Phi pynthait lade ïa ban leit wad ïa kiwei pat ki blei , hynrei phim shym la sangeh . Phi pyrkhat ba ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong phi kin ai ïa bor phi , bad phim kumta ju khie tlot .
translation.en: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way  ; yet saidst thou not , There is no hope : thou hast found the life of thine hand  ; therefore thou wast not grieved .

translation.kha: Nga hi nga la pyrkhat jingsuk nga dei Ïasam leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga lah pyrshah ïa ïohsngew jingthmu U Jisu uba pynkhyllew Nasareth .
translation.en: I verily thought with myself , that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth .
A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth : and the recompence of a man s hands shall be rendered unto him .
translation.kha: Ka bainong jong phi ka shong ha kaei kaba phi ong bad kaei kaba phi leh ; phin ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi dei hok .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Go .  And when they were come out , they went into the herd of swine : and , behold , the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea , and perished in the waters .
translation.kha: Khie leit ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ; kumta ki la mihnoh bad ki la leit shapoh ki sniang . Ka kynhun ki sniang baroh kawei ka la mareh arsut ïa ka riat jong ka synrang shapoh ka duriaw bad ka la ïap jyllop .
bad beit beit sha bad Gilead sha Kadesh ha ka ri ki Hit . Nangta ki leit sha Dan , bad na ki Dan leit shaphang sepngi sha Sidon .
translation.en: Then they came to Gilead , and to the land of Tahtim–hodshi  ; and they came to Dan–jaan , and about to Zidon ,

translation.kha: U Eliab , u hynmen rangbah u Dabid , ïohsngew ba u u Dabid u ïakren bad kita ki rangbah . U la bitar ïa u Dabid bad u ong , Me leh aïu hangne ? Mano ba sumar ïa kito ki langbrot ki jong me kiba don ha ka khlaw ri Ma ? me , me uba ! sngewstad Me wan tang ban peit kai ïa ka jingïaleh thma !
translation.en: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men  ; and Eliab s anger was kindled against David , and he said , Why camest thou down hither ? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness ? I know thy pride , and the naughtiness of thine heart  ; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle .
Talk no more so exceeding proudly  ; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth : for the  Lord  is a God of knowledge , and by him actions are weighed .
translation.kha: Sngap noh na kaba kren kob ; sngap jar na kaba kren meng . Naba U  Trai  u long U Blei uba tip lut , bad u bishar ïa ki jingleh ki briew baroh .
Ki dohkha kin ïap , bad ka wah kan sa iwtung eh kat haduh ba Teresh nong Ijipt kin jinglehbeiñ nud ban dih um na ka .’
translation.en: And the fish that is in the river shall die , and the river shall stink  ; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha la ki briew , Nga la pynsakma ïa phi ha ki baroh liang . mynta Hynrei , ma phi kiba ringmraw shah , phet noh na Babilonia bad leit phai pat sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Deliver thyself , O Zion , that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon .

translation.kha: Haba ki jingthung ki la bad kop ki la sdang mih , te ki ruh la .
translation.en: But when the blade was sprung up , and brought forth fruit , then appeared the tares also .

translation.kha: U Gog bad ka kynhun shipai longing jinghukum bad pneh ïateh lok bad u kin kyllon ïap ha ki lumbah ka Israel , bad :23-25 ai ïa ki met jong ki ba kin long ka jingbam ïa baroh ki sim bad ki mradkhlaw sahlang
translation.en: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel , thou , and all thy bands , and the people that is with thee : I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort , and to the beasts of the field to be devoured .

Saying , When will the new moon be gone , that we may sell corn ? and the sabbath , that we may set forth wheat , making the ephah small , and the shekel great , and falsifying the balances by deceit ?
translation.kha: Phi ong ha lade ,  Ngim lah ap slem ïa ki sngi bakhuid ba kin kut noh khnang ba ngi lah ban die ïa u kew jong ngi . Lano ka sngi Sabbaton kan kut , khnang ba ngin ïoh sdang ban die biang ? Nangta ngi lah ban oh dor rem , pyndonkam da ki jingthew bymhok , bad pynbakla ïa ki tarajur ban thok ïa ki nongthied jong ngi .

Kumta ki la jingpynhun kino u Ïoannis bad ki la ong , Ko Nonghikai , Hamul kynmaw ïa u briew uba la Pontos lem bad phi ha ka liang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan , ïa uba phi la Paulos shaphang jong u ? Ha khmih , Proberb bymngeit pynbaptis mynta , bhor baroh ki la leit sha u !
translation.en: And they came unto John , and said unto him , Rabbi , he that was with thee beyond Jordan , to whom thou barest witness , behold , the same baptizeth , and all men come to him .
And the devil said unto him , If thou be the Son of God , command this stone that it be made bread .
translation.kha: U Soitan u la ong ïa u ,  Lada me long U Khun U Blei , hukum ïa une u maw ban kylla kpu .
Pha long kum kynthei kaba ïaleh ki nongwei ka ban ieit ïa la u tnga
translation.en: But as a wife that committeth adultery , which taketh strangers instead of her husband !

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton ngi mih na ka nongbah sha ka rudwah , ha kaba ngi pyrkhat ba yn don ka kaba ki Jiw ki ïalumlang ban duwai . la ïashong bad ïakren bad ki kynthei kiba la ïalumlang .
translation.en: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side , where prayer was wont to be made  ; and we sat down , and spake unto the women which resorted thither .
And the damsel s father shall say unto the elders , I gave my daughter unto this man to wife , and he hateth her  ;
translation.kha: U kpa jong kata ka briew un ong ha ki , ‘ Nga la ai ïa la ka khun ha une u briew ban long ka tnga jong u , bad mynta um mon shuh ïa ka .

translation.en: It is God that avengeth me , and that bringeth down the people under me ,
translation.kha: U ai ha nga ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga , U pyndem ïa ki jaitbynriew hapoh jong nga ,
Ha U Khrist la otsher ïa phi , ym da ka jingotsher kaba la thaw da ki briew , hynrei da ka jingotsher la ba pynlong da Khrist U , kaba kynthup ïa ka jinglong ba la na laitluid ka bor jong ka pop hi .
translation.en: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands , in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ :
Therefore will I save my flock , and they shall no more be a prey  ; and I will judge between cattle and cattle .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pyllait im ïa la ki langbrot bad ngan ym shah ba yn lehbeiñ shuh ïa ki . Ngan bishar ïa kawei pa kawei na ki langbrot jong nga bad pynïakhlad ïa kiba bha na kiba sniew .
Kane long laiphew phra snem hadien ba ngi la mih na Kadesh Barnea Ki rangïapom baroh kata ka pateng la ïap lut , U Trai kren lypa .
translation.en: And the space in which we came from Kadesh–barnea , until we were come over the brook Zered , was thirty and eight years  ; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host , as the  Lord  sware unto them .
But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah , and will save them by the  Lord  their God , and will not save them by bow , nor by sword , nor by battle , by horses , nor by horsemen .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pyn-i jingieit ïa ki briew ka Judah . Ma nga U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ngan pyllait im ïa ki ; hynrei ngan ym leh ïa kata da ka thma — da ki waitlam lane ki ryntieh , bad ki khnam lane ki kulai bad ki shipai shong kulai .

translation.en: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath , and bringing in sheaves , and lading asses  ; as also wine , grapes , and figs , and all manner of burdens , which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day : and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , nga ïohi ba ki briew ha Judah ki khñiot umsoh na ki sohwaiñ ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Kiwei pat ki dang kyntiew halor ki kada jong ki ïa u kew , ka waiñ , sohwaiñ , soh Khajur , bad kiwei kiei kiei bad leit rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem ; nga la maham ïa ki ban ym die ei ei ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
Ko kynrad , kata ka ka la ong , mem don ïa ka jingtong , ka pukri ka long kaba jylliew . Nangno men ïoh ïa kata ka um kaba ai jingim ?
translation.en: The woman saith unto him , Sir , thou hast nothing to draw with , and the well is deep : from whence then hast thou that living water ?
And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight  ; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims , that spread out their wings , and covered the ark of the covenant of the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad katno ka ksiar nylla ha kaba shna ïa ka duwan ha kaba yn thang jingiwbih , bad ha kaba shna ïa ka kali ïapom na ka bynta ki Kherub kiba pyiar la ki thapniang halor Ka Synduk Ka Jutang U  Trai .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as we went to prayer , a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us , which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba ngi dang ïaleit sha ka jaka duwai , kawei ka shakri samla kaba la don u mynsiem bymman uba la pynlah ïa ka ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka ban sa wan , ka la ïakynduh ïa ngi . Ka la kamai bun ka pisa na ka bynta ki trai jong ka da kaba batai kupar .
Namar snam ki bad ki blang ym lah ban noh ïa ki pop .
translation.en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins .

translation.kha: Lada long uba shemphang , phin lah ban kan ïa la jingbitar . Haba uno uno u bakla ïa phi , ka dei ka jinglong bakhraw ban leh klet ïa ka .
translation.en: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger  ; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïadih waiñ , u la Ïathuh ïa nga kaei kaba pha kwah , bad phan ïoh ïa ka Ngan ai ïa ka jingkyrpad pha phan pan shiteng na ka hima jong nga .
translation.en: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine , What is thy petition ? and it shall be granted thee : and what is thy request ? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed .
And he said unto them ,  Take heed , and beware of covetousness : for a man s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth .
translation.kha: Bad u la ïai kren ha ki baroh ,  To khmih bha bad sumar ïa lade na kano kano ka jait jinglalot ; namar ba ïa ka jingim bashisha jong u briew ym shym la pynlong da kiei kiei kiba u don , kam pher haduh katno u lah ban long uba riewspah .
sngewshyrkhei Yiron , ka Migdalel , ka Horem , ka Bethanath , jingkit ka Beth Shemesh : khatkhyndai tylli ki nongbah , lem phriang ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: And Iron , and Migdal–el , Horem , and Beth–anath , and Beth–shemesh  ; nineteen cities with their villages .
And Noah went forth , and his sons , and his wife , and his sons  wives with him :
translation.kha: Kumta u Noah lem bad la ka tnga , bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki tnga jong ki , ki la ïamih shabar na kata ka lieng .

translation.en: I opened to my beloved  ; but my beloved had withdrawn himself , and was gone : my soul failed when he spake : I sought him , but I could not find him  ; I called him , but he gave me no answer .
translation.kha: Ngan sah halor u lum ka mirr , u lum ka jingiwbih , tad ynda ka lyer step ka beh bad ba ka jingdum ka jah noh .
Ngam slem ban shuh im ; ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha U Trai ka la duh .
translation.en: And I said , My strength and my hope is perished from the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por U Jisu u la sdang ban ïalap khubor jong : To phai pop phi , namar ka hima ki bneng ka la !
translation.en: From that time Jesus began to preach , and to say ,  Repent : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand .

translation.kha: Ki kylli , Hato don ka kynhun na ki jait Israel baroh ka bym shym Madon leit sha ka jingïalumlang ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai ha Mispah ? ( Ki la shim ïa ka jingsmai bakyntang ba uno uno u bym Joktan la leit sha Mispah Bethphage shah pynïap . )
translation.en: And the children of Israel said , Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the  Lord  ? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the  Lord  to Mizpah , saying , He shall surely be put to death .

translation.kha: Ki la phai ktien , kambah Ka aïu men leh ba ngi lah ban ïohi ka ïa bad ngeit ha me ? Kaei ba men leh ?
translation.en: They said therefore unto him , What sign shewest thou then , that we may see , and believe thee ? what dost thou work ?
They angered him also at the waters of strife , so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes :
translation.kha: Ha ki umpohliew ka Meribah ki briew ki la pynbitar ïa U  Trai bad u Moses u la shem jingeh namar jong ki .
Ka long thik kumba nga la ïathuh phi ha — U Blei u la pyn-i ha phi ïa kaei ba un sa leh .
translation.en: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh : What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh .

translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki long ki jaka phlang ha kaba bsa la ïa ki , ha kaba ki wad ïa kano kano kaba jyrngam ban bam .
translation.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture , and he searcheth after every green thing .

translation.kha: pynshitom jur ïa ki bad pynhiarkput pura jong ki . Kin mad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall lay my vengeance upon them .
And the man of God said , Where fell it ? And he shewed him the place . And he cut down a stick , and cast it in thither  ; and the iron did swim .
translation.kha: Hangno u hap ?  u Elisha u kylli . Ynda uta u briew u kdew ha u ïa kata ka jaka , bad u Elisha u daiñ ïa uwei u dieng , u pashat ïa u ha ka um , bad u pynper ïa u khlieh sdie .
bad hangta ha ka jingdon jingpyndep Japhlet u thang ïa paid ki sharak ïashitom kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u .
translation.en: And he lighted the lamps before the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Bha jingai !
translation.en: Really good !
And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent : for he is not a man , that he should repent .
translation.kha: U Blei bakhraw jong ki Israel um ju lamler lane kylla la ka jingmut . Um dei u briew — um ju kylla la ka jingmut .
Naba ngim ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki briew hynrei pyrshah ïa ki bymman bor ba kynja mynsiem ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng , ki nongsynshar ki , bor synshar , bad ki bor pyrthei jong kane ka ba-dum juk .
translation.en: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood , but against principalities , against powers , against the rulers of the darkness of this world , against spiritual wickedness in high places .

translation.kha: Kaei ka jingdonkam jong ka bleithaw ? Ka long tang kaei kaei kaba la thaw da u briew , bad kam kren ei ei hynrei ka shukor . Kaei kaba bha ka leh ba ïa u nongthaw un ba shaniah ha ka — U Blei u bym lah wat ban kren !
translation.en: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it  ; the molten image , and a teacher of lies , that the maker of his work trusteth therein , to make dumb idols ?
But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow , or a voluntary offering , it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice : and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten :
translation.kha: Lada u briew u wanlam ïa ka jingainguh ïasyllok ban pyndep ïa la ka jingkular lane kum ka jingainguh mon sngewbha jong u hi , ym da donkam ban bam lut ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi ba la kñia ; hynrei ïa kaba sah lah ban bam ha ka sngi kaba bud .

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Moses , and he said , Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother ? I know that he can speak well . And also , behold , he cometh forth to meet thee : and when he seeth thee , he will be glad in his heart .
translation.kha: Ha kane U  Trai  u la bitar ïa u Moses , bad u ong ,  Kumno shaphang u para jong me U Aaron , u Lebi ? Nga tip u tbit bha ban kren . Ha ka jingshisha , mynta u dang wan ban ïakynduh ïa me bad un kmen ban ïohi ïa me .

La thaw ïa ka da uta uba shong halor ka khet jong u shajrong ka khyndew bad sha lyndet ka sahit bneng ; ki briew shapoh ki i rit tang kum ki dkhiew . U pynpyiar ïa suiñbneng ka ka kum pyrda , kum ïingjaiñ ka ha kaba yn shong .
translation.en: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth , and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers  ; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain , and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in :

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph , ka jait Ephraim bad ka jait Manasseh ba sha Sepngi , ki Lo-Ruhamah’ Aniam ïa kane ka ri kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: So the children of Joseph , Manasseh and Ephraim , took their inheritance .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta syiem u hi , kane ka dei kaei kaba nga , U Trai U Blei ki Israel , nga : ong pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha ka Kitab ,
translation.en: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the  Lord  , thus shall ye say to him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , As touching the words which thou hast heard  ;
So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom , ka ktien jong U Trai ka la ïai saphriang bad nang khlaiñ .

translation.en: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , then they forsook their cities , and fled : and the Philistines came and dwelt in them .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel kiba shong basah ha ka Them Jesreel ki la ïohsngew ba ka kynhun shipai ka la phet ïap , bad ba u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la ïap , ki iehnoh ïa la ki shnong bad ki phet ïap . Nangta ki Philistia ki wan bad ki shong ha ki .
mynta Kumta , ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ïathuh ha phi ba ngan bishar hapdeng jong phi ïa ki langbrot kiba khlaiñ bad ki kiba langbrot tlot .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  unto them  ; Behold , I , even I , will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle .
For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ .
translation.kha: Naba ki ba bun na phi , ba la pynbaptis ha U Khrist , bad la pynkup ïa phi da U Khrist hi .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  How is it that ye do not understand ?
translation.kha: Bad phim pat shemphang ?  u la kylli ïa ki .
Nangta ki la ap hangta , bad u Nabal ha kaba khatduh u la jubab U Dabid ? uta ? pat ju ïohsngew ïa u ! Ha kine ki sngi ka ri ka dap ki mraw kiba phet na la !
translation.en: And Nabal answered David s servants , and said , Who is David ? and who is the son of Jesse ? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master .

translation.kha: Ka kamra rung ka rangbah pyrshah ka lehbeiñ Diamond . La don ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong halor ki païa baroh jingbynta Shano La don phra Samsummim ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha kane ka khyrdop .
translation.en: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court  ; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof , on this side , and on that side : and the going up to it had eight steps .
I tell you that he will avenge them speedily . Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh , shall he find faith on the earth ?
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi , un bishar ha ka liang jong ki bad un leh kloi ïa ka . Hynrei hato U Khun U Briew un shem mo ïa ka jingngeit ha ka pyrthei haba u wan ?

translation.en: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face : and they do not return to the  Lord  their God , nor seek him for all this .
translation.kha: Ka jingsngewmeng ki paid Israel ka kyang pyrshah ïa ki hi . Wat haba kane baroh ka la jia , kim shym la wan phai sha nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
Katto ngut ki rangbah bariewblei kiba la tep ïa u Stephan , ki la ïambriew na ka bynta jong u da ka jingïam kaba jam .
translation.en: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial , and made great lamentation over him .
And it came to pass after these things , that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard , which was in Jezreel , hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria .
translation.kha: Hajan ka ïingsyiem jong u Ahab ha Jesreel , ka la don ka bri sohwaiñ kaba long trai da u briew uba kyrteng u Naboth .
U Soitan u jubab , Pynnep briew un iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh tang ban ïoh ïa la Shaaraim jingim .
translation.en: And Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , Skin for skin , yea , all that a man hath will he give for his life .
What are you doing ?
translation.kha: Dang leh aiu ?

Hadien ba u Belteshassar u la ïoh ïa kane ka jingïohipaw , ngi la khreh ban leit sha Makedonia , namar ngi Adonibesek rai ba U kyrdem u la khot ïa ngi ban ïingtrep ïa ka Khubor Babha sha ki briew hangta umphniang
translation.en: And after he had seen the vision , immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia , assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them .
How is the gold become dim ! how is the most fine gold changed ! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street .
translation.kha: Ka ksiar baphyrnai jong ngi ka la jngut ; ki maw jong ka Templ ki don ha ka jingsaphred ha ki lynti bah .
U Solomon u u syiem jong Israel baroh ,
translation.en: So king Solomon was king over all Israel .
Take fast hold of instruction  ; let her not go : keep her  ; for she is thy life .
translation.kha: Kynmaw borabor ïa kaei kaba phi la nang . Ka jingnang jingtip jong phi ka dei ka jingim jong phi — ri kyndong ïa ka .
Phan ym leit khlem tapkhlieh lane khlem sopkjat ibiang sngewsih ne ïam pynskhem Phan sneng namar ki pop jong pha , bad phan Shuwa iwei ha iwei .
translation.en: And your tires shall be upon your heads , and your shoes upon your feet : ye shall not mourn nor weep  ; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities , and mourn one toward another .
Get you out of the way , turn aside out of the path , cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us .
translation.kha: Wat ïeng ha ka lynti jong ngi bad wat kah ïa ka lynti ïaid jong ngi . Ngim kwah ban ïohsngew shaphang U Blei Bakhuid jong phi ki Israel .

translation.en: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces : and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold , and silver , and with precious stones , and pleasant things .
translation.kha: Pynban , un pyndonburom ïa u blei uba ïada ïa ki kut . Un ai ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawlynnai , bad kiwei kiwei ki jingai babha sha u blei uba ki kpa tymmen jong u kim shym la ju mane .

translation.en: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets , and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days . Thy dream , and the visions of thy head upon thy bed , are these  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei don U Blei ha bneng , uba pynpaw ïa ki jingmaïan . U la pyntip ïa u Syiem Kynrad kaei ka ban jia ha ka lawei . Mynta ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingphohsniew , ka jingïohipaw kaba phi lah ïoh mynba phi dang ïohthiah .

Haba u Joseph u leit ha khmat u syiem Pa’ Ijipt , U Blei Ashnah la ai Shobab u ka akor kaba pynsngewbha bad sharing jingstad ; bad bakor syiem u Gaal pynlong lyngskor ïaishong u Joseph halor ka ri bad ka longïing syiem .
translation.en: And delivered him out of all his afflictions , and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt  ; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba stad , ki pynlong ïa ka jingtip kaba pdiang hun , hynrei ki kiba mutlop ki khlei ïa ka .
translation.en: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright : but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness .

translation.kha: To ap tad haduh ba ka taïew ka jinglehkmen shongkurim kan kut , bad ngan ai me ha ïa ka Rakhel , lada men trei na ka bynta jong nga hynñiew sa snem .
translation.en: Fulfil her week , and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years .

translation.kha: Ki sngi ki la poi , ong U Trai , haba u kew un san ban stet ïa kaba lah ban ot , bad sohwaiñ ki kin san stet ban ïa ka waiñ ba lah ban . shna Ki lumbah kin jaw da ka waiñ kaba thiang , bad ki lumrit kin tuid da . ka
translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that the plowman shall overtake the reaper , and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed  ; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine , and all the hills shall melt .

translation.kha: Kumta ïa ki balang la nang pynkhlaiñ ha ka jingngeit bad ki la nang roi ha jingbun ka briew man ka sngi .
translation.en: And so were the churches established in the faith , and increased in number daily .
And the man Micah had an house of gods , and made an ephod , and teraphim , and consecrated one of his sons , who became his priest .
translation.kha: Une u Mikah u don la ka ïing mane blei . U shna katto katne ki bleithaw bad ka ephod , bad u thung ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u kum u lyngdoh .

translation.en: Before the  Lord  : for he cometh , for he cometh to judge the earth : he shall judge the world with righteousness , and the people with his truth .
translation.kha: haba U  Trai  un wan ban synshar ïa ka pyrthei . Un synshar ïa ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei da ka hok bad ka jinglehhok .

translation.en: And God said unto Abraham , Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore , thou , and thy seed after thee in their generations .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Abraham ,  Me ruh me dei ban mynjur ban bat ïa ka jutang bad nga , ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ha ki pateng ban wan .

translation.en: And this is the promise that he hath promised us , even eternal life .
translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kaei kaba U Khrist hi da lade u la kular ban ai ha ngi — ka jingim bymjukut .
Naei phi wan ?
translation.en: Where did you come from ?

translation.kha: Kajuh ka la jia ha baroh hynñiew ngut nongpynkha ki la ïap khlem don pyndap .
translation.en: And the third took her  ; and in like manner the seven also : and they left no children , and died .
The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured , It is the sabbath day : it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka sngi Sabbaton , kumta ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ong ïa uta u briew uba la ïohkhiah ,  Kane ka dei ka sngi Sabbaton , bad ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ïa me ban rah ïa la ka jingthiah .

translation.en: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee , but thou doest me wrong to war against me : the  Lord  the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Em , ngam shym leh bymdei ei ei ïa me . Ma me uba leh bymdei ïa nga da kaba ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa nga . U  Trai  u long u Nongbishar . Un rai mynta ka sngi hapdeng ki Israel bad ki Ammon .

To kynmaw ïa ka khah bad Lehse , Titos ki shnong ba-marjan , Eshtaol kaba ki briew ki leh kumba la leh kito ki angel bad ki kyrsum ha ki jingleh nuti bad bajakhlia : Ki Kane ïa ka jingpynshitom ha ka “Te jreiñ kum ka jingmaham Arkhippos baroh Hiram
translation.en: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha , and the cities about them in like manner , giving themselves over to fornication , and going after strange flesh , are set forth for an example , suffering the vengeance of eternal fire .
He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba pdiang ïa ka khubor jong u , u pynskhem da kane ba U Blei u long uba shisha .

translation.en: Ye eat the fat , and ye clothe you with the wool , ye kill them that are fed : but ye feed not the flock .
translation.kha: Phi dih ïa ka dud , phi kup ki jaiñ ba la thain na u  saiwul , phi pynïap bad bam na ki langbrot kiba kynsai tam . Hynrei phim ju sumar bha ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba ïa ka kyrteng jong u ym shym la thoh ha ka kitab kiba im la bret sha ka pung ka ding .

translation.en: Upright men shall be astonished at this , and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dawa ba ki long kiba hok ki la kyndit , bad baroh ki la pynrem ïa nga ba ngam don Blei .

pha Hato la ïoh jinghun ban bud ïa ki dien jat jong ki bad pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki ? Em tang , hapoh khyndiat por pha la leh kham sniew palat ban ïa kaba ki long ha kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la . leh
translation.en: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways , nor done after their abominations : but , as if that were a very little thing , thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways .
For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth , and they shall no more be remembered by their name .
translation.kha: Ngan ym shah shuh ba kan dang kren ïa ka kyrteng u Baal .

Kine ki Lebi Jebus Pahath ai ïa Shatei-lam-mihngi jingkhot sha ka jingmane : u Iehnoh , u Kadmiel , u Bani , u Hashabneïah , u Sherebaïah , u Hodaïah , u Shebanaïah , bad u Tebalaïah . Ki ong : jingïathuh bad nguid ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi ; ïaroh ïa thadrong junom la junom ! Ai ba baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom jong u , Nyngkong la ym don ka jingïaroh jingkhlaiñbor kynja briew kaba khraw palat .
translation.en: Then the Levites , Jeshua , and Kadmiel , Bani , Hashabniah , Sherebiah , Hodijah , Shebaniah , and Pethahiah , said , Stand up and bless the  Lord  your God for ever and ever : and blessed be thy glorious name , which is exalted above all blessing and praise .
And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la kren ha ki paid Israel ïa kaei kaei baroh ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

Naba ym don khubor jingïathuhlypa kaba la ju wan na tang mon ka u briew , hynrei briew ki ki la long hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid katba ki dang kren ïa ka khubor kaba la wan na U Blei .
translation.en: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man : but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost .
Should I lie against my right ? my wound is incurable without transgression .
translation.kha: U Kylli ,  Kumno ngan lah ban shukor bad ong ba nga la bakla ? Nga la mynsaw jur palat , hynrei nga long uba khlem pop .
Uwei Kleopas uwei baroh nongkit la sngewphylla . jingshngain briew uba kumno une pynkupbor long ? ki la ong . Wat ki lyer bad ki jingat phyllung ki kohnguh ïa jingbudnam !
translation.en: But the men marvelled , saying , What manner of man is this , that even the winds and the sea obey him !

translation.kha: La pynjynjar ïa ngi bunsien , hynrei ym shym pynlwet noh ; teng teng hapdeng ka jingartatien hynrei da lei lei ym ha ka jingduh jingkyrmen ; don ki nongshun , hynrei ngim ju duh paralok ; bad wat ngi jur ka jingmong hateng , ym shym la pynjot noh ïa ngi .
translation.en: Persecuted , but not forsaken ; cast down , but not destroyed ;

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingthmu jong nga ïa ka pyrthei ka ïa ka kti jong nga la ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth : and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u ong ïa phi , Kane ka dei ka ba jingbam la kñia ha ki bleithaw te , wat nym bam phi ïa kata ka jingbam , na ka bynta uta uba la ïa ïathuh phi bad na ka bynta ka jingïatiplem —
translation.en: But if any man say unto you , This is offered in sacrifice unto idols , eat not for his sake that shewed it , and for conscience sake : for the earth is the Lord s , and the fulness thereof :

translation.kha: Hynrei ka la jia namar ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong ka ki la pop bad ki lyngdoh ka ki long la namar ka jingpynjia ïa ka jingïap jong ki briew .
translation.en: For the sins of her prophets , and the iniquities of her priests , that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her ,

translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew kum kita ki ktien mynshuwa ; ka jingduna jinglut phi ai ka long tang ka jingpynshitom .
translation.en: I have heard many such things : miserable comforters are ye all .

translation.kha: Kumno ngin ïa u ? Phi ap khmih ïa ka kabu ban tur ïaleh ïa nga
translation.en: But ye should say , Why persecute we him , seeing the root of the matter is found in me ?
Why do ye persecute me as God , and are not satisfied with my flesh ?
translation.kha: Balei ba ma phi ruh phi pynshitom ïa nga kumba U Blei u leh ? Hato phim shym la pynshitom la biang ïa nga ?

translation.en: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun , namely , riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt .
translation.kha: Hangne ka don kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei kaba nga la ïohi ha ka pyrthei : Ki briew ki lah ban bat tang shipor ïa la ka pisa haba ki lah ban donkam ïa ka ,

te ma phi baroh phi ban tip , bad baroh ki paid Israel ki dei ban tip , ba une u briew u ïeng hangne ha khmat jong phi uba la khiah da bor jong ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist uba Nasareth — uba phi sahnarphna bad uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
translation.en: Be it known unto you all , and to all the people of Israel , that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth , whom ye crucified , whom God raised from the dead , even by him doth this man stand here before you whole .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong kane ka nongbah ki la pynbitar bad pynbitar shla ïa nga sabakhthani Rohgah sngi ba jingpynïoh thaw ïa ka .
translation.en: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day  ; that I should remove it from before my face ,

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u leit rieh ïa lade ha ki bri . Ha ka jingkhawai bnai mih thymmai , u syiem Saul u wan shong , bam
translation.en: So David hid himself in the field : and when the new moon was come , the king sat him down to eat meat .

translation.kha: Haba ka la dep ai um uta u briew u ïa ka ksiar remdor bad u pyndait ha ka ka , bad u pyndeng ruh ki khadu ksiar kiba heh ha ki ryndang-kti jong .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as the camels had done drinking , that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight , and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei hadien hektar jingshongthait Dabid u la dep shim ïa A lympat , ka jingïatiplem jong u ka la un-long ban Kartah ïa u , bad thylli ong ha U Trai riewkhmat Nga la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei nongïalap kaba leh ïa kane khlup Sngewbha map tlot nga . Nga la leh bieit .
translation.en: And David s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people . And David said unto the  Lord  , I have sinned greatly in that I have done : and now , I beseech thee , O  Lord  , take away the iniquity of thy servant  ; for I have done very foolishly .
For thou art an holy people unto the  Lord  thy God : the  Lord  thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself , above all people that are upon the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Namar phi long kiba la pynkyntang khuid sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . U la jied ïa phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei ba phin long ka jaitbynriew kaba kyrpang jong u .
Ngam shym la kwah ka rupa lane ka lane ka jaiñphong jongno jongno .
translation.en: I have coveted no man s silver , or gold , or apparel .

bad ka la shim ïa ki khiew shet na ka bynta jong u bam , hynrei um treh . U ong , noh shabar iwei pa iwei baroh — bad baroh ki la .

Beloved , if God so loved us , we ought also to love one another .

For we are members of his body , of his flesh , and of his bones .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when the sun went down , and it was dark , behold a smoking furnace , and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces .

translation.en: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies : for they are ever with me .

translation.en: And Hazael said , But what , is thy servant a dog , that he should do this great thing ? And Elisha answered , The  Lord  hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria .

translation.en: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom : but a man of understanding walketh uprightly .

translation.en: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot  ; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image , that shall not be moved .

translation.en: He shall glorify me : for he shall receive of mine , and shall shew it unto you .

translation.en: But I say unto you , That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment , than for thee .

translation.en: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned , saying , Read this , I pray thee : and he saith , I am not learned .

translation.en: And one goat for a sin offering , to make an atonement for you .

translation.en: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee , and will keep the passover to the  Lord  , let all his males be circumcised , and then let him come near and keep it  ; and he shall be as one that is born in the land : for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof .

translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have set a fire in Egypt , and when all her helpers shall be destroyed .

Ym kumta da shisha ! Pynban Japhlet phi ong ha u , ‘ To pynkhreh Khinnereth ka jingbam miet shoh-ïap nga , nangta to phong ïa ka jaiñ-da jong me bad shakri ïa jingeh katba nga dang bam bad dih ,000 hadien kata me lah ban bam ïa ka jingbam jong me .’
translation.en: And will not rather say unto him , Make ready wherewith I may sup , and gird thyself , and serve me , till I have eaten and drunken  ; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink ?

And the city lieth foursquare , and the length is as large as the breadth : and he measured the city with the reed , twelve thousand furlongs . The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka la long kaba sawdong janai , ka ïar kat ka lynter jong ka . U angel u la thew ïa ka nongbah da u diengthew jong u : Ka la don ar hajar sawspah kilomitar ka lynter bad ka la ïar bad kynjang kat ka lynter jong ka .

Nangta u syiem Asa u la phah ïa ka hukum kylleng ka Judah ri kaba dawa ïa uwei uwei pa , khlem lait ïano ïano , ban ïarap kit noh na Ramah ïa ki maw bad ki dieng ïa kiba u Baasha u pyndonkam ban pynskhem ïa . ka Da ki kine tiar tar ki u Asa u tei pynskhem ïa ka Mispah bad ïa ka Geba , ka nongbah kaba don ha ka ri Benjamin .
translation.en: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah  ; none was exempted : and they took away the stones of Ramah , and the timber thereof , wherewith Baasha had builded  ; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin , and Mizpah .

translation.kha: Katba u Paul u dang ap Thiah Athens .—Pule u Silas bad u Timothi , u Italy shitom jingmut shikatdei eh haba u la ïohi shynrong ka nongbah ka skei da ki bleithaw .
translation.en: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens , his spirit was stirred in him , when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence : but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live  ; for he shall have his life for a prey , and shall live .

Then shalt thou call , and the  Lord  shall answer  ; thou shalt cry , and he shall say , Here I am . If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke , the putting forth of the finger , and speaking vanity  ;

translation.en: And the  Lord  visited Hannah , so that she conceived , and bare three sons and two daughters . And the child Samuel grew before the  Lord .

translation.en: Saying , Let us alone  ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art , the Holy One of God .

translation.en: And Jesus arose , and followed him , and so did his disciples .

The candlestick also for the light , and his furniture , and his lamps , with the oil for the light ,

translation.en: And David said on that day , Whosoever getteth up to the gutter , and smiteth the Jebusites , and the lame and the blind , that are hated of David s soul , he shall be chief and captain . Wherefore they said , The blind and the lame shall not come into the house .

translation.kha: Ka sahit bneng kam dei kaba kut ïa U Blei , hynrei ka don palat ïa kaba me lah ban kynjoh . U Blei u tip ïa ka pyrthei kiba ïap , jingïaineh me mem tip ïa ka .
translation.en: It is as high as heaven  ; what canst thou do ? deeper than hell  ; what canst thou know ?

translation.kha: Hashabneïah paidbah byllien u la bud ïa u , namar ba ki la ïohi ïa ki kambah sniew u ha kaba pynkhiah ïa jingshim kiba pang ïaphah
translation.en: And a great multitude followed him , because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased .

That seeing they may see , and not perceive  ; and hearing they may hear , and not understand  ; lest at any time they should be converted , and their sins should be forgiven them .
translation.kha: khnang ba ,   ‘ Kin khmih bad ïai khmih , pynban kin ym ïohi ; Kin sngap bad ïai sngap , pynban kin ym sngewthuh . Namar lada ki ïohi lane sngewthuh , kin phai sha U Blei , bad un map ïa ki .’
Ka jingdiang jong me Bani ym long shuh jinglehniam Abram , hynrei u suit sieh naba nga pynlong ïa me u kpa tymmen jong ki jaitbynriew nongot bun .
translation.en: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram , but thy name shall be Abraham  ; for a father of many nations have I made thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada kyrthep jaiñtapkhmat u im saiñ jong phi , U Mynsiem u long ka jingim na kamram bynta jong phi namar la pynlong jingïap’ hok sdie jong phi bad U Hanan .
translation.en: And if Christ be in you , the body is dead because of sin ; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness .

translation.kha: Ki khnam jong nongrahbor sngewlyngngoh sam Nikolas ïa u nongïalam ka kynhun shipai jong u khyllai u la wan kum ka erïong ban pynsakma ïa ngi , da ka badonkam kum kito kiba lyngkot ïa kiba Simon ha kaba rieh .
translation.en: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages : they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me : their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly .

And the woman came unto Saul , and saw that he was sore troubled , and said unto him , Behold , thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice , and I have put my life in my hand , and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me .
translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka leit sha u , bad haba ka ïohi ba u la sheptieng , kumta ka ong ha u ,  Sngewbha kynrad , nga la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim da kaba leh ïa kaei ba phi ong .

translation.en: Circumcise yourselves to the  Lord  , and take away the foreskins of your heart , ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem : lest my fury come forth like fire , and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .
translation.kha: Sumar ïa ka jutang jong phi bad nga , U  Trai  jong phi , bad pynkyntang ïa lade ha nga , phi ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem . Lymda kumta , ka jingbitar jong nga kan ing kum ka ding namar kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba phi la leh . Kan pluh , bad yn ym don mano mano ba pynlip ïa ka .

translation.en: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people  ; and therein was found written , that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever  ;
translation.kha: Katba dang pule jam ïa ka Hukum u Moses ha u paidbah , ki poi ha ka bynta kaba ong ba ym dei ban shah ïa u nong Amon ne u nong Moab ban ïasnohlang bad ki briew jong U Blei .
Hynrei ngan ym shah ïa Derbe nongshun jong ki ban kren kob Pynshad ki dei ma ki Apphia la pynjot pyrman pom briew jong nga , jngut dei ma nga hi uba la ïateh ïa ki .’
translation.en: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy , lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely , and lest they should say , Our hand is high , and the  Lord  hath not done all this .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams , over the rivers , and over the ponds , and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Ong ïa u Aaron ba un rah ïa la u diengduh halor ki wah , halor ki nur-um , bad halor ki pung-um , bad pynmih ïa ki jakoid ba kin pyndap ïa ka ri Ijipt .
Kumta , kat kum ka hukum U Trai , ki paid Israel ki ha ki katto katne tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang na ki jaka jong .
translation.en: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance , at the commandment of the  Lord  , these cities and their suburbs .

translation.kha: Ïa ka miej dei buh khmat Synduk ka Jutang , bad u kpu ainguh uba kyntang u dei ban don halor jong ka borabor .
translation.en: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway .

translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh eh , ka kynthei la ka ïap .
translation.en: And last of all the woman died also .
And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars , be ye not troubled : for such things must needs be  ; but the end shall not be yet .
translation.kha: Bad wat sngewkhuslai haba phi ïohsngew ki jingsawa ki thma hajan jong phi bad ïa ki khubor jong ki thma jngai na phi . Ka dei ïa kine kiei kiei ban jia , hynrei kam mut ba ka jingkut ka la long .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that in all the land , saith the  Lord  , two parts therein shall be cut off and die  ; but the third shall be left therein .

translation.en: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store .
Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours : from the wilderness and Lebanon , from the river , the river Euphrates , even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be .
translation.kha: Ka khyndew baroh ha kaba phin ïuhkjat kan long ka jong phi . Ka ri jong phi kan ïar naduh ka ri shyiap shaphang shathie haduh ki lum Lebanon shaphang shatei , bad naduh ka wah Ïuphratis shaphang mihngi haduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian shaphang sepngi .

translation.en: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites , all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation , which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .

translation.en: And he put the breastplate upon him : also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim .

translation.en: And he prayed unto the  Lord  , and said , I pray thee , O  Lord  , was not this my saying , when I was yet in my country ? translation.en: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the  Lord  at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

U Tom u shu dang dep pynkhreh .

Khie leit Pynlwet kylli na U Trai na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ki briew baroh jong ka Judah shaphang ka jinghikai jong Nahalal Beeri Kitab . U Trai u pyntip bitar ïa ngi namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la leh Naphtuh kaei ba kane ka Kitab Thung ong ba Sah ban leh .
translation.en: Go ye , enquire of the  Lord  for me , and for the people , and for all Judah , concerning the words of this book that is found : for great is the wrath of the  Lord  that is kindled against us , because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book , to do according unto all that which is written concerning us .

So Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa , and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel , and smote Ijon , and Dan , and Abel–beth–maachah , and all Chinneroth , with all the land of Naphtali .
translation.kha: U syiem Benhadad u mynjur ïa ka jingtyrwa u Asa bad u phah ïa ki rangbah shipai jong u lem bad ka kynhun shipai ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah jong ka Israel . Ki la kurup ïa ka Ijon , ka Dan , ka Abel Beth Maakah , ka jaka hajan ka duriaw Galilaïa , bad ka ri Naphtali baroh kawei .
Ka khyndew u Asher kan seisoh shibun , Bad pynmih un ki jait jingbam kiba biang wat ïa u syiem .
translation.en: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat , and he shall yield royal dainties .

translation.kha: U kpa jong Tabrimmon briew uba hok u don ka daw babiang dieng kmen . Phi lah ban sngewsarong ha itynnad khun uba stad .
translation.en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice : and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him .
Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph , but forgat him .

translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  If thou wilt be perfect , go and sell that thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come and follow me .
And the children of Israel remembered not the  Lord  their God , who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side :
translation.kha: bad kim shym la shakri shuh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , uba la pynim ïa ki na ki nongshun baroh kiba sawdong jong ki .
Bad ba ki la lah pyndep ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong shaphang jong u , ki la pynhiar noh ïa u na ka diengphna bad ki buh ïa u ha jingtep
translation.en: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him , they took him down from the tree , and laid him in a sepulchre .

And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim , and Ashtoreth , and the gods of Syria , and the gods of Zidon , and the gods of Moab , and the gods of the children of Ammon , and the gods of the Philistines , and forsook the  Lord  , and served not him .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ki Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba mane ïa ki Baal bad ïa ki Astarte , lem bad ïa ki blei jong ki Syria , jong ki Sidon , jong ki Moab , jong ki Ammon , bad jong ki Philistia . Ki la iehnoh ïa U  Trai  bad ki la sangeh ban mane ïa u .
ibeiñ ïa phi bad kin , U la kular wan hato um shym la kular kumta ? Hangno u ? Ki kpa tymmen ki la lah ïap hynrei kiei baroh ki dang ïaisah kumjuh mynba pynlong ïa pyrthei !
translation.en: And saying , Where is the promise of his coming ? for since the fathers fell asleep , all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba ki khun kynthei u paid Kalneh kyrpad ka long nongaplangbrot dei ; ai bynta lem na ka jingdon jingem jong ki Hasor ki jait u kpa jong ki jingshisha” Ai ba ka jingïohkynti jong u jingsleh hiarpateng ha ki .
translation.en: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right : thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father s brethren  ; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them .

translation.kha: Uno na kine ar ngut uba la leh kaei ïa kaba u kpa u la kwah ? Uta uba san kham , ki la jubab . U Kumta Jisu u la ong ha ki , Nga ong ha phi : Ki nonglum khajna bad ki nuti ki leit rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei ha jong shuwa phi .
translation.en: Whether of them twain did the will of his father ?  They say unto him , The first . Jesus saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you .
Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa , who labour in the Lord . Salute the beloved Persis , which laboured much in the Lord .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei jong nga ïa ka Truphina bad ka Truphosa , kiba trei ha ka kam U Trai bad ïa ka paralok ba-ieit jong nga , ka Persis , kaba la trei shibun ka kam na ka bynta U Trai .

translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that one told Joseph , Behold , thy father is sick : and he took with him his two sons , Manasseh and Ephraim .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , la ïathuh ha u Joseph ba u kpa jong u , u pang . Kumta u ïalam ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ar ngut , u Manasseh bad u Ephraim , ban ïaleit khmih ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families , these cities with their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Dan ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: But think on me when it shall be well with thee , and shew kindness , I pray thee , unto me , and make mention of me unto Pharaoh , and bring me out of this house :
translation.kha: Hynrei sngewbha kynmaw lem ïa nga haba kiei kiei ki bit ki biang ïa phi , bad sngewbha ruh ban ïathuh lem shaphang jong nga ha u syiem bad ïarap lem ïa nga ban ïohlait noh na kane ka ïingbyndi .
U Artakserksis u ai ïa kane ka ha u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad , uba don ka jingtip bajylliew ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba U Trai u la ai ha ki Israel
translation.en: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest , the scribe , even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the  Lord  , and of his statutes to Israel .
So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights , and none spake a word unto him : for they saw that his grief was very great .
translation.kha: Nangta ki shong ha madan bad u haduh hynñiew sngi hynñiew miet khlem kren shikyntien ruh , namar ki la ïohi haduh katno u shah jynjar .

translation.en: Behold , therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession , and they shall set their palaces in thee , and make their dwellings in thee : they shall eat thy fruit , and they shall drink thy milk .
translation.kha: Namar ba phi la sngewkmen , ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka ri shyiap ba na mihngi ban jop ïa phi . Kin sher ïa ki dara jong ki ha ka ri jong phi bad shongduh hangta . Kin bam ïa u soh bad kin dih ïa ka dud kiba dei ki jong phi .
Ïa ka nongbah la khot kyrteng ka Babel , namar dei hangta ba U Trai u la pynkhleh ïa ka ktien jong ki briew baroh ; bad nangta la pynsaphred ïa ki sha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Therefore is the name of it called Babel  ; because the  Lord  did there confound the language of all the earth : and from thence did the  Lord  scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth .
It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise , than for a man to hear the song of fools .
