Sa shisien pat u syiem u la phah ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah . la U leit kiew ïa u lum u , la dem khohsiew ha khmat u Elijah , bad u la ïasaid , Ko briew jong U , Blei to isynei ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah jong . nga To pyllait ïa ka jingim jong ngi !
translation.en: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty . And the third captain of fifty went up , and came and fell on his knees before Elijah , and besought him , and said unto him , O man of God , I pray thee , let my life , and the life of these fifty thy servants , be precious in thy sight .
But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ , who hath abolished death , and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel :
translation.kha: U la ai ha ngi ïa kane ka jingaiei lyngba U Khrist Jisu ha shuwa ban sdang ka pyrthei , hynrei mynta la pynpaw da ka jingwan U Nongpynim jong ngi , U Khrist Jisu . U la pynkut noh ïa ka bor jong ka jingïap bad lyngba ka Gospel la pynpaw ïa ka jingim bymïap shuh .

Ki , Baroh ar ngi phohsniew la ka jong ka jong ka jingphohsniew , ym don u ban batai ïa jingmut ki . Te u Joseph u ong , Dei U Blei uba ai ka ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew . To ïathuh ha nga ïa jingphohsniew phi .
translation.en: And they said unto him , We have dreamed a dream , and there is no interpreter of it . And Joseph said unto them , Do not interpretations belong to God ? tell me them , I pray you .

translation.kha: Kiei pop nga ? Kiei ki dei leh ? kam sniew aïu ba la ujor ïa nga ?
translation.en: How many are mine iniquities and sins ? make me to know my transgression and my sin .
Also he sent forth a dove from him , to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground  ;
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u Noah u la pyllait ïa ka paro ban tip la kata ka um ka la rngad ne em , hynrei namar ba ka um ka dang tap ïa ka khyndew , kata ka paro kam shym lap jaka ban dem .
Nangta , u la pyngngad , ka la ïathuh ïa kaei kaei baroh . U la ïohpang kyndit bad u la long kum uba ïap baroh shi rynïeng .
translation.en: But it came to pass in the morning , when the wine was gone out of Nabal , and his wife had told him these things , that his heart died within him , and he became as a stone .

translation.kha: ‘ Da lei lei ruh em ! ngam ithuh ïa phi ,’ u nongleitkurim la u jubab .
translation.en: But he answered and said , Verily I say unto you , I know you not .
But if thou fear to go down , go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada me sheptieng ban tur ïaleh , leit hiar sha ka jaka sher dara lem bad u Purah u shakri jong me .

translation.en: And they fell upon their faces , and said , O God , the God of the spirits of all flesh , shall one man sin , and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses bad u Aaron ki dem khrup ha khyndew bad ki ong ,  A Blei , me , me long ka thymmei jong ka jingim baroh . Haba uwei na ngi u leh pop , hato men shu bitar lep ïa ka kynhun baroh kawei ?
Baroh kiei kiei u u , la buh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka , Hato ngam kyndit la ïathuh ïa pha ba phan sa ïohi ïa bapalat burom U Blei jingphna pha Hattaabah ?
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Said I not unto thee , that , if thou wouldest believe , thou shouldest see the glory of God ?
And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast , that the image of the beast should both speak , and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed .
translation.kha: La shah ïa u mradkhlaw uba ar ban pyrsad jingim ha kata ka dur jong u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong , khnang ba ka durblei ka lah ban kren bad pynïap ïa kito baroh ki ban ym mane ïa ka .

translation.en: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck , behold , it was dead : but when I had considered it in the morning , behold , it was not my son , which I did bear .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , haba nga la khie thiah bad sa ban ai buiñ ïa la u khun , nga ïohi ba u la ïap . Nga la khmih bniah hajan bad nga shem pynban ba um dei u khun jong nga .
To ai ba jingkyrmen ka phi jong kan pynkmen ïa phi , to long kiba ïaishah ha ki jingjynjar jong phi , bad to duwai ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: Rejoicing in hope ; patient in tribulation ; continuing instant in prayer ;

translation.kha: Man la ka Ïing Hima jong ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki pyndonkam ïa kyrteng bakhuid jong U Blei
translation.en: Every Kingdom Hall of Jehovah’s Witnesses bears God’s holy name .

translation.kha: To trei shitom bad wat long kiba syiad . To shakri ïa U Trai da ka dohnud kynteit sngewdei lut .
translation.en: Not slothful in business ; fervent in spirit ; serving the Lord ;

translation.kha: Hynrei Mediterranian ngan jingpli knieh ïa ka hima baroh kawei na pynsdien Solomon , bad ngan pynneh ïa u ha ka bor katba u dang Ong . Kane ngan leh na phaloh bynta u shongshngain u shakri jong nga rudwah ïa uba nga la jied bad uba kohnguh .—2 ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga .
translation.en: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand : but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant s sake , whom I chose , because he kept my commandments and my statutes :

And when the people were come into the camp , the elders of Israel said , Wherefore hath the  Lord  smitten us to day before the Philistines ? Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  out of Shiloh unto us , that , when it cometh among us , it may save us out of the hand of our enemies .
translation.kha: Ynda ki shipai kiba lait im ki wan phai sha ka jaka shong dara , ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki ong ,  Balei keiñ U  Trai  u shah ba ki Philistia kin jop ïa ngi mynta ka sngi ? Ïa ngin ïaleit bad wanrah ïa ka Synduk Ka Jutang U  Trai  na Shiloh , ba kumta un leit lem bad ngi bad pyllait im ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi .
U Petros la jubab Ko Kynrad , kloi leit sha ka ïingbyndi bad me bad ban ïap lem me !
translation.en: And he said unto him , Lord , I am ready to go with thee , both into prison , and to death .
And when he putteth forth his own sheep , he goeth before them , and the sheep follow him : for they know his voice .
translation.kha: Haba u la pynmih ïa ki shabar , u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki , bad ki langbrot ki bud ïa u , namar ba ki sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u .
ka umphniang ïa ki sharak , ki na musla ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh bad na ka bynta ka jingthang iwbih ;
translation.en: Oil for the light , spices for anointing oil , and for sweet incense ,

translation.kha: U ong ha Abraham u , Kane baroh ka dei ka ri jong nga ; to shong to sah kat ha kaba me kwah .
translation.en: And Abimelech said , Behold , my land is before thee : dwell where it pleaseth thee .
Keep thee far from a false matter  ; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not : for I will not justify the wicked .
translation.kha: Wat ai ki jingkynnoh kiba lamler , bad wat pynïap ïa uba lui lui , namar ngan pynrem ïa uno uno uba leh kum kata ka kam bymman .

Katba pule Josaïah u long syiem , u Neko u syiem ka Ijipt u ïalam ïa ka kynhun pnah sha ka wah Ïuphratis ban ïarap ïa u patsha ka Assyria . U syiem Josaïah u la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Ijipt ha Megiddo dum u la shah pynïap ha ka ïa-ithuh .
translation.en: In his days Pharaoh–neco king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates : and king Josiah went against him  ; and he slew him at Megiddo , when he had seen him .
And I will say to my soul , Soul , thou hast much goods laid up for many years  ; take thine ease , eat , drink , and be merry .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan ong ha lade , A u briew badonbok ! Me la don kiei kiei kiba bha baroh kiba me donkam na ka bynta bun snem . Wat khuslai ïa la ka jingim , to bam , to dih , bad to lehkmen ïa lade !’

translation.en: And as I began to speak , the Holy Ghost fell on them , as on us at the beginning .
translation.kha: Bad haba nga la sdang ban kren , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan hiar halor jong ki kumba ka la long halor jong ngi ha kaba sdang .

translation.en: And I said unto the nobles , and to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , The work is great and large , and we are separated upon the wall , one far from another .
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa ki briew bad ïa ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongïalam ,  Ka jingtreikam ka la ïar bad la pynïakhlad ïa ngi da ka jingjngai uwei na uwei pat ha ka kynroh .
U Blei u la ong shuh shuh nongpule Ko reng u khapbrip suiñ! sngap bha bad kynmaw ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba Oholah ong ha Amaraïah .
translation.en: Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart , and hear with thine ears .

translation.kha: Ngan ym pan ban ïakren bad U Blei balei ; ngan ai ïa u ka lad ban pynjot ïa nga ?
translation.en: Shall it be told him that I speak ? if a man speak , surely he shall be swallowed up .

translation.kha: Nga tip phi don maphi kato .
translation.en: I know you have it with you .
And the rest of the acts of Solomon , and all that he did , and his wisdom , are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Solomon u la leh , ka jingtrei jong u bad ka jingstad jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori U Solomon .
Kane ka long kaei kaba u ong , ‘ Jeroboam un ïap ha ka thma , bad briew ka Israel kin shah ringmraw na la ka ri
translation.en: For thus Amos saith , Jeroboam shall die by the sword , and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land .

translation.kha: Ki nong Gibeah ki wan ban ïaleh “Ki ïa nga bad mynmiet ki kerkut ïa ka ïing . Ki thmu ban pynïap ïa nga ; pynban ki leh pynjahburom ïa ka tnga kliar jong nga rangdajied bad ka Migdalel ïap noh .
translation.en: And the men of Gibeah rose against me , and beset the house round about upon me by night , and thought to have slain me : and my concubine have they forced , that she is dead .

translation.kha: La don uwei u mot baskhem hangta , bad uwei pa uwei u bad shynrang ka ha kynthei ka nongbah , kynthup ïa ki nongïalam , ki sha mareh u . Ki khang ïa lade shapoh bad ki kiew shalor ka tnum .
translation.en: But there was a strong tower within the city , and thither fled all the men and women , and all they of the city , and shut it to them , and gat them up to the top of the tower .
Their land brought forth frogs in abundance , in the chambers of their kings .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ri jong ki la pyndap da ki jakoid , wat ïa ka ïingsyiem la pyndap da ki .

translation.en: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por u syiem Agrippa bad ka Berniki ki la wan sha Kaisaria bad ki la leit pdiang sngewbha ïa u Phestos .

translation.en: And he causeth all , both small and great , rich and poor , free and bond , to receive a mark in their right hand , or in their foreheads :
translation.kha: U mradkhlaw u la pynbor ïa ki briew baroh , kiba rit bad kiba khraw , kiba riewspah bad kiba duk , ki mraw bad kiba laitluid , ban don ka shab ïa kaba la buh ha ki kti kamon jong ki lane ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .

translation.en: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen . Now thou , O Belteshazzar , declare the interpretation thereof , forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation : but thou art able  ; for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la ïoh ,  ong u syiem Nebukhadnessar .  Mynta , ko Belteshassar , ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka . Ym don man mano na ki nongai jingmut na ka ïingsyiem jong nga kiba lah ban ïathuh ha nga , hynrei me lah , namar ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me .
Hynrei Ahijah briew jong poh-ïing Josabad ki la ong , U Trai Naboth la iehnoh ïa ngi ! U la klet thik ngi .
translation.en: But Zion said , The  Lord  hath forsaken me , and my Lord hath forgotten me .

translation.kha: pynsdien Bar katto katne la rkhiebeiñ bad sympat , bad ïa kiwei pat la teh ha ki kynjri jingkitkhlieh la set phatok Bikri ki .
translation.en: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings , yea , moreover of bonds and imprisonment :

translation.kha: Ka spah baroh ka na halor kiei kiei baroh da ka ka bor jong , bad me lah ïano ïano uba khraw bad khlaiñ .
translation.en: Both riches and honour come of thee , and thou reignest over all  ; and in thine hand is power and might  ; and in thine hand it is to make great , and to give strength unto all .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren ha . nga
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,

translation.kha: ban ïohthiah kum ki syiem bad ki kiba nongsynshar la tei pat ïa ki ïingsyiem mynbarim .
translation.en: With kings and counsellors of the earth , which built desolate places for themselves  ;

translation.kha: la ïohi ïa baroh U Trai U Blei jong phi u la leh ha kine jaitbynriew baroh na ka bynta jong phi . U Trai U Blei phi la ïaleh na ka bynta phi
translation.en: And ye have seen all that the  Lord  your God hath done unto all these nations because of you  ; for the  Lord  your God is he that hath fought for you .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi la sha ka ri kaba bha , la kdang bad sngewhun , bad nangta phi la sngewsarong noh ïa nga .
translation.en: According to their pasture , so were they filled  ; they were filled , and their heart was exalted  ; therefore have they forgotten me .
But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen : but they were men of war , and his servants , and his princes , and his captains , and rulers of his chariots , and his horsemen .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki Israel u Solomon um shym la pynlong mraw ; ki la shakri ïa u kum ki shipai , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki rangbah ai hukum , ki kapten kali ïapom , bad ki nongshong kulai jong u .
To duwai ha U basngewsih ! Ngi la shah la biang ïa une u pyrthat bad u phria ! Nga kular ban pyllait ïa phi ; ksuid-durblang donkam bujli dang sah shuh hangne .
translation.en: Entreat the  Lord  ( for it is enough ) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail  ; and I will let you go , and ye shall stay no longer .

translation.kha: U Trai u la , ong Ka Damaskos kan ym long shuh ka nongbah ; kan long tang ka thup ki jingjot jingpra .
translation.en: The burden of Damascus . Behold , Damascus is taken away from being a city , and it shall be a ruinous heap .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u khun uba la kha ha ka briew u la pynshitom ïa uba la kha U Mynsiem U Blei ; bad ka long kumjuh mynta .
translation.en: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit , even so it is now .
And when she knew Peter s voice , she opened not the gate for gladness , but ran in , and told how Peter stood before the gate .
translation.kha: Ka la sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u Petros bad ka la kmen haduh katta katta ba ka la mareh pat shapoh khlem da plie ïa ka jingkhang , bad ka la pynbna ba u Petros u ïeng shabar .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and forgat the  Lord  their God , and served Baalim and the groves .

translation.en: For he that is entered into his rest , he also hath ceased from his own works , as God did from his .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingjahthait ïa kaba U Blei u la kular , un shongthait na ka kam jong u hi , kumba U Blei u la shongthait na ka kam jong u .

translation.en: They have not known nor understood : for he hath shut their eyes , that they cannot see  ; and their hearts , that they cannot understand .
translation.kha: Kum kita ki briew ki long kiba bieit eh ban tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh . Ki khapbrip ïa la ki khmat bad ïa la ki jingmut na ka jingshisha .
U Khunlangbrot u la leit bad u la shim El ka kot kli na ka kti kamon jong uta uba shong halor ka khet .
translation.en: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne .

translation.kha: Kin thung ïa ki jingthung jong ki ha ka . Ki bri sohwaiñ jong kin pynmih ki sohwaiñ , ka khyndew kan pynmih ïa ki jingthung , bad slap un don kyrhai . Ngan ai ïa kine ki jingkyrkhu baroh ha ki briew jong ka hima jong nga kiba dang lait im
translation.en: For the seed shall be prosperous  ; the vine shall give her fruit , and the ground shall give her increase , and the heavens shall give their dew  ; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things .
Joseph of Arimathaea , an honourable counsellor , which also waited for the kingdom of God , came , and went in boldly unto Pilate , and craved the body of Jesus .
translation.kha: Ka la long janmiet haba u Joseph na Arimathaïa u la wan poi . U la long u riewdonburom jong ka Dorbar , uba ap ïa ka jingwan jong ka Hima U Blei . Ka la long ka sngi Pynkhreh ( kata , ka sngi shuwa ka sngi Sabbaton ) , kumta u Joseph u la leit da ka jingshlur sha u Pilat bad pan na u ïa ka met U Jisu .
Ki briew kiba ïaid nangta ki la ïa la ki khlieh bad krenbeiñ ïa U Jisu : Ade ! pynjot ïa ka Templ bad tei pat ïa ka lai sngi !
translation.en: And they that passed by railed on him , wagging their heads , and saying , Ah , thou that destroyest the temple , and buildest it in three days ,

translation.kha: ki la leit ka jaka shong dara ha , bad ki ong ha u Joshua bad ha ki Israel la wan na ka kaba jngai . Ngi kwah ïa phi ban lok bad ngi .
translation.en: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal , and said unto him , and to the men of Israel , We be come from a far country : now therefore make ye a league with us .

translation.kha: Dang bam-im phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba san u tyngka ban mihnoh , hynrei u kpa kata ka kynthei u ong , Da ïa-shahskhor shuwa , bad ap thap ban da noh ka sngi . Kumta kita dewbyrtha ar ngut Japhia ïabam Matthat Pynbthi shyngoid
translation.en: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart : and the damsel s father said , Comfort thine heart , I pray thee . And they tarried until afternoon , and they did eat both of them .

translation.kha: U la lyiur jingïakynduh kane jingmaïan pynurlong shisha ïa iohi kaba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la lah a , Ma u da nadien Rehoboam Jingpynjot la shim ïa ki jingshitom jong ngi bad u la bah kdor ïa ki jingpang ïakdang Hamutal .
translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying , Himself took our infirmities , and bare our sicknesses .

And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised , which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war : and they have laid their swords under their heads , but their iniquities shall be upon their bones , though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Ym shym la ai ha ki ka jingtep donburom kum ïa ki riewshlur ha ki por mynbarim , kiba da kieng atiar bha haba ki leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ïa ki waitlam jong ki la buh hapoh ki khlieh jong ki bad ïa ki stieh jong ki halor ki met jong ki . Kine ki riewshlur ki la long shisien kiba khlaiñbor bha ban pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im .

translation.en: Fathers , provoke not your children to anger , lest they be discouraged .
translation.kha: Ko ki kmie ki kpa , to wat pynbitar ïa la ki khun , ïoh ba kin noh mynsiem .

translation.en: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks  ; for they also are turned back , and are fled away together : they did not stand , because the day of their calamity was come upon them , and the time of their visitation .
translation.kha: Wat ki shipai ba shu wai jong ka ki long khlem bor kum ki khun masi . Kim shym ïeng ban ïaleh ; baroh na ki , ki phai bad phet noh . Ka sngi jong ka jingshahjop ka la poi , ka por jong ka jingpynjot ïa ki .
Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la sheptieng u paidbah , bad kumta ki la pyrshang ban wad lad ban pynïap ïa U Jisu kaba jar jar .
translation.en: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him  ; for they feared the people .

translation.kha: Ki Judah ki la pop pyrshah ïa U Trai bad ki leh ban ïa U pyrshah ïa ki ban ïa kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki baroh ki la leh
translation.en: And Judah did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed , above all that their fathers had done .
How say ye , We are mighty and strong men for the war ?
translation.kha: Ko ki rangbah ka Moab , balei ba phi kam ïa lade kum ki riewkhraw , ki shipai bashlur ba la tynjuh ha ka thma ?

Lada don dakhol kawei ka shnong , khmih’ sngewthait shata ka lah kyndat jngai ïabeit , bad uta pynmeng ksew kput sngi lah ban lap ïa u bad ha la Asriel jingbitar u lah ban pynïap ïa u briew u bym dei hok kynïan ïap , namar um Immer don ka jingïashun tyngkai la u paramarjan Heldai .
translation.en: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer , while his heart is hot , and overtake him , because the way is long , and slay him  ; whereas he was not worthy of death , inasmuch as he hated him not in time past .
Now it came to pass , when the kingdom was established to him , that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father .
translation.kha: Mar ïaskhem ha ka bor , u la pynïap ïa ki rangbah synshar kiba la pynïap ïa u kpa jong u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication , that thou hast made before me : I have hallowed this house , which thou hast built , to put my name there for ever  ; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Nga la shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai bad jingkyrpad rit jong me . Nga la pynkyntang ïa kane ka ïing kaba me la tei kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga junom . Ngan peit ïa ka bad ngan don hangta borabor .

translation.en: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall , when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit : and all the trees of Eden , the choice and best of Lebanon , all that drink water , shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth .
translation.kha: Haba nga phah ïa u shapoh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ka jingsawa jong ka jingkyllon jong u , kan pynkhynñiuh ïa ki jaitbynriew . Baroh ki dieng ha Eden bad ki dieng baroh kiba kynsai , kiba la ïoh um bha jong ka Lebanon kiba la leit sha ka pyrthei shapoh kin sa sngewkmen ha ka jingkyllon jong u .

U Jisu u la ïalam sharud ïa ksan khat-ar ngut ki pynthiah bad u la syntied ha ki , pynkha sngap ! Agag ïaleit sha Jerusalem riewïaleh kaba ïa kaei kaei baroh jingblei hun Pithom ki la Ir shaphang U Khun U Briew jingisynei urlong shisha twa
translation.en: Then he took unto him the twelve , and said unto them ,  Behold , we go up to Jerusalem , and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished .

translation.kha: Kumba hadien shiphew sngi , U Trai u shoh ïa u bad Nabal u la ïap .
translation.en: And it came to pass about ten days after , that the  Lord  smote Nabal , that he died .

translation.en: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness .

translation.en: He shall dwell on high : his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks : bread shall be given him  ; his waters shall be sure .

translation.en: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen , Who is he , and where is he , that durst presume in his heart to do so ?

translation.en: I will seek that which was lost , and bring again that which was driven away , and will bind up that which was broken , and will strengthen that which was sick : but I will destroy the fat and the strong  ; I will feed them with judgment .

translation.en: And all mine are thine , and thine are mine  ; and I am glorified in them .

translation.en: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow , and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine : and spare ye not her young men  ; destroy ye utterly all her host .

translation.en: And the shepherds returned , glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen , as it was told unto them .

translation.en: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the  Lord   ; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth , and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father : for the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken it .

translation.en: But if the watchman see the sword come , and blow not the trumpet , and the people be not warned  ; if the sword come , and take any person from among them , he is taken away in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at the watchman s hand .

translation.en: And I will execute judgments upon Moab  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk , even as he walked .

translation.en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans , and of the Stoicks , encountered him . And some said , What will this babbler say ? other some , He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods : because he preached unto them Jesus , and the resurrection .

translation.en: I know , O  Lord  , that thy judgments are right , and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me .

translation.en: And send them to the king of Edom , and to the king of Moab , and to the king of the Ammonites , and to the king of Tyre , and to the king of Zidon , by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah  ;

Lane tharai kawei ka kaba briew don shiphew tylli ki sbai rupa ka duh noh kawei na ki — ba kaei kan leh ? Ka thang ïa ka sharak , ka sar ïa ka la ïing , bad ka khmih biang biang kylleng kylleng haduh ba kan da shem ïa ka .
translation.en: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver , if she lose one piece , doth not light a candle , and sweep the house , and seek diligently till she find it ?

And the priest shall look on him the seventh day : and , behold , if the plague in his sight be at a stay , and the plague spread not in the skin  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih biang ïa u ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad lada ha ka jingshem jong u ba kata ka prum ka long kumjuh bad kam shym pur , un pynkyrpang ïa u sa hynñiew sngi .
Ko khun u briew , u la ong , kane ka long kaba briew ha ka nongbah Tyros ki ïa sngewkmen . Ki ‘ Ka Jerusalem ka ! bor khaïi pateng jong ka kam don shuh ! Kan ym shuh ka nongïaleh pyrshah ngi !’
translation.en: Son of man , because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem , Aha , she is broken that was the gates of the people : she is turned unto me : I shall be replenished , now she is laid waste :

translation.kha: U jong u briew uba ïap , uta uba dei khmih ka jingleit ontep , un sei shabar ïa ka metïap na ka ïing . ha ïing un khot ïa uno ba dang hapoh ïing , Dang don mano mano bad hangto ? Ka sur kan jubab , Em ! nangta u ba-ha-ïing un sa ong , Sngap ! Ngi dei ban sumar wat ban ym ei ei ka kyrteng U Trai
translation.en: And a man s uncle shall take him up , and he that burneth him , to bring out the bones out of the house , and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house , Is there yet any with thee ? and he shall say , No . Then shall he say , Hold thy tongue : for we may not make mention of the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: ka jingsmai kyntang ha u Abraham u kpa tymmen jong ngi u la ban im ïa ngi ki nongshun ngi bad shah ïa ngi ban shakri ïa u khlem jingsheptieng ,
translation.en: That he would grant unto us , that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear ,

For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man , so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah , saith the  Lord   ; that they might be unto me for a people , and for a name , and for a praise , and for a glory : but they would not hear .
translation.kha: Kumba ki patlun lyngkot ki biang sbiak sawdong ka syngkai , kumta nga la thmu ba baroh ki briew jong ka Israel bad Judah kin snoh skhem ha nga . Nga la leh ïa kane khnang ba kin ïoh long ki briew jong nga bad wallam ka jingïaroh bad ka burom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ; hynrei kim shym kohnguh ïa nga .
Ïa u Er , u khun nyngkong jong u , u Judah u la pynïoh ka tnga kaba :12-14 thain Tamar Jerah
translation.en: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn , whose name was Tamar .

translation.kha: Kumba ka sim ka her tawiar halor ka skum jong ka ban ïada ïa khun rit jong ka , kumta ruh ma nga , U Trai Baroh , ngan ïada ïa ka Jerusalem bad kyrshan ïa ka .
translation.en: As birds flying , so will the  Lord  of hosts defend Jerusalem  ; defending also he will deliver it  ; and passing over he will preserve it .

translation.kha: Uba hok u na ka ; pynban u bymman u hap ha ka .
translation.en: The righteous is delivered out of trouble , and the wicked cometh in his stead .

translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u ïalam pat ïa ki shipai sha ha Jerusalem ka jingjop , namar U Trai u la jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki .
translation.en: Then they returned , every man of Judah and Jerusalem , and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them , to go again to Jerusalem with joy  ; for the  Lord  had made them to rejoice over their enemies .
For he had healed many  ; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him , as many as had plagues .
translation.kha: U la lah pynkhiah ïa kiba bun ki briew , bad baroh kito kiba pang ki la ïai kyntur sha u khnang ba ïohktah ïa u .

translation.en: Whom , though I were righteous , yet would I not answer , but I would make supplication to my judge .
translation.kha: Wat la nga long uba lui lui , baroh kaba nga lah ban leh ka long tang ban kyrpad ïa ki jingisynei U Blei u nongbishar jong nga .

translation.en: Not as though I had already attained , either were already perfect : but I follow after , if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la kam ba nga la ïoh jop lypa lane ba la pynlong janai lypa . Nga ïai ïaleh shitom ban ïoh ïa ka prais ïa kaba U Khrist Jisu u la ïoh ïa nga sha lade hi .

translation.en: For they have made ready their heart like an oven , whiles they lie in wait : their baker sleepeth all the night  ; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ki khluit kum ka tyndur da ki jingïasylla jong ki . Baroh shi miet , ka jingbitar jong ki ka nang ing , bad mynstep ka mih kynsan kum ki thylliej ding .

translation.en: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver , and his idols of gold , which your own hands have made unto you for a sin .
translation.kha: Ka por kan wan haba baroh na phi phin bret noh ïa ki bleithaw bapop kiba phi la thaw na ka rupa bad ka ksiar .

translation.en: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance : but the other holy offerings sod they in pots , and in caldrons , and in pans , and divided them speedily among all the people .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki syang ïa ki jingkñia ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha ka ding , kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih , bad ki syrwa ïa ki jingainguh bakyntang ha ki khiew , ki khiew heh , ki khiew rit , bad kloi lan ki sam ïa ka doh ha ki briew .

translation.en: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death , and the father the son  ; and children shall rise up against their parents , and shall cause them to be put to death .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin aiti noh ïa la ki hynmen ki para ban pynïap ïa ki , bad ki kpa kin leh kumjuh ïa la ki khun , ki khun ki ïeng pyrshah ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad kin aiti ïa ki ban shah pynïap .
bad u pynpeit pat ïa kiba matlah . U khyllie ïa kito kiba la kyllon noh ; u ieit ïa ki briew kiba hok jong u .
translation.en: The  Lord  openeth the eyes of the blind : the  Lord  raiseth them that are bowed down : the  Lord  loveth the righteous :

translation.kha: Nangta u la ïaid sha khmat bad u la ktah ïa ka , krong bad ki briew kiba bah ïa ka ki la sangeh . U Jisu u la , ong Ko samla ! To khie joit nga , ong ïa me !
translation.en: And he came and touched the bier : and they that bare him stood still . And he said ,  Young man , I say unto thee , Arise .
Have ye not asked them that go by the way ? and do ye not know their tokens ,
translation.kha: Hato phim pat shym la ïakren bad ki briew kiba leit jingleit ? Hato phim tip ïa ki jingïathuh ba ki wanrah ?

translation.en: And upon all the ships of Tarshish , and upon all pleasant pictures .
translation.kha: Un pynngam wat ïa ki liengbah kiba khraw bad kiba itynnat tam .
( Loukas ba-mynbarim :30-33 nongshniah Mynba u Jisu u tam ha ka pyrthei , u maw pynshisha ba un long Saph sar uba sbun , uba Laiphew Baalsebub uba janai .
translation.en: ( Luke 1 :30-33 ) When Jesus was on earth , he proved that he would be a kind , just , and perfect Ruler .
My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door , and my bowels were moved for him .
translation.kha: U ryndang jong phi u long kum u mot jong u Dabid , uba pyllun bad jlih , lem bad u jingdeng ryndang uba kum shihajar tylli ki stieh kiba pynsdien sawdong jong u .
Mano ba tih nur na ka bynta u uba slap hap bad ba pynkhuid ïa ka lynti na ka bynta ka erïong bad u pyrthat ?
translation.en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters , or a way for the lightning of thunder  ;
Praise him with the timbrel and dance : praise him with stringed instruments and organs .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u da ki ksing bad ka jingshad . To ïaroh ïa u da ki duitara bad ki tangmuri .

translation.en: And of cassia five hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary , and of oil olive an hin :
translation.kha: hynriew kilo ka kassia , ( ïa kiba la thew kat kum ka jingthew jong ka jaka kyntang ) . Bynrap sa saw litar ka umphniang Olib ,

translation.en: And Iron , and Migdal–el , Horem , and Beth–anath , and Beth–shemesh  ; nineteen cities with their villages .
translation.kha: ka Yiron , ka Migdalel , ka Horem , ka Bethanath , bad ka Beth Shemesh : khatkhyndai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: Reuben , thou art my firstborn , my might , and the beginning of my strength , the excellency of dignity , and the excellency of power :
translation.kha: Reuben , khun phrangsngi jong nga , Me long ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , U soh nyngkong ka jinglong rangbah jong nga , Uba sarong tam bad uba khlaiñ tam Na ki khun jong nga baroh .

Lada uno uno u para uba Israel shong marjan bad phi u kylla duk bad um lah shuh ban kyrshan hi ïa lade , phi dei ïarap ban ïa u kumba phi leh ïa u , nongtrei khnang ba u lah ban ïailong u paramarjan jong phi .
translation.en: And if thy brother be waxen poor , and fallen in decay with thee  ; then thou shalt relieve him : yea , though he be a stranger , or a sojourner  ; that he may live with thee .

And Hazael said , Why weepeth my lord ? And he answered , Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel : their strong holds wilt thou set on fire , and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword , and wilt dash their children , and rip up their women with child .
translation.kha: Balei kynrad phi ïam ?  u Hasael u kylli . U Elisha u jubab ,  Namar ba nga tip ïa kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba men leh pyrshah ïa ki paid Israel .   Men sa wiang ding ïa ki kut jong ki , men sa pynïap ïa ki rangsamla bakynsai jong ki , men sa lynthaw ïa ki khun rit jong ki ha ban da ïap , bad men sa patar ïa ki kynthei jong ki kiba armet .

translation.en: I will be as the dew unto Israel : he shall grow as the lily , and cast forth his roots as Lebanon .
translation.kha: Ngan long ïa ki paid Israel kum u slap ha ka dewryngkhiang . Kin phuh kum ki syntiew ; kin suhthied skhem kum ki dieng ha Lebanon .

translation.en: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good : and whoso trusteth in the  Lord  , happy is he .
translation.kha: Pynleit jingmut ïa kaei ba la hikai ïa phi , bad phin ïoh manbha ; shaniah ha U  Trai  bad phin long uba kmen .

translation.en: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven , and giveth life unto the world .
translation.kha: Naba u kpu ba U Blei u ai u long uta uba wan hiar na bneng bad uba ai jingim ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: For God so loved the world , that he gave his only begotten Son , that whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have everlasting life .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei u la ieit katta katta ïa ka pyrthei kat haduh ba u la aiti noh ïa U Khun ba tang marwei jong u , ba uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym ïap noh hynrei un ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: According to their pasture , so were they filled  ; they were filled , and their heart was exalted  ; therefore have they forgotten me .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi la rung sha ka ri kaba bha , phi la kdang bad sngewhun , bad nangta phi la sngewsarong bad klet noh ïa nga .

Ha ka sngi blei Esra ka taïew ngi la ïalumlang eriong ka bynta ka jingïabam miet . U Paul u la kren ha ki paidbah bad thehsei la ïai kren haduh shiteng synñia , namar dong un sa mihnoh ha ka sngi kaba bud .
translation.en: And upon the first day of the week , when the disciples came together to break bread , Paul preached unto them , ready to depart on the morrow  ; and continued his speech until midnight .

translation.kha: U Saul u la phah pynïap ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nongshong shnong ha Nob , ka nongbah jong ki lyngdoh : ki shynrang kynthei bad ki , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung , ki masi , ki kada , bad ki langbrot — ki la shah lut pynïap khoit .
translation.en: And Nob , the city of the priests , smote he with the edge of the sword , both men and women , children and sucklings , and oxen , and asses , and sheep , with the edge of the sword .

And with them he sent Levites , even Shemaiah , and Nethaniah , and Zebadiah , and Asahel , and Shemiramoth , and Jonathan , and Adonijah , and Tobijah , and Tob–adonijah , Levites  ; and with them Elishama and Jehoram , priests .
translation.kha: La synran ïa ki da khyndai ngut ki Lebi bad ar ngut ki lyngdoh . Ki Lebi ki long u Shemaïah , u Nethanaïah , u Sebadaïah , u Asahel , u Shemiramoth , u Jehonathan , u Adonijah , u Tobijah bad u Tobadonijah ; bad ki lyngdoh ki long u Elishama bad u Jehoram .

translation.en: * ( Revelation 17 :10-13 ) False religion straddles the back of this political beast , attempting to influence its decisions and to control its direction .
translation.kha: ( Jingpynpaw 17 :10-13 ) Ka niam ba bakla ka shong kulai halor une u mrad synshar pyrthei ban pynkohnguh ia la ka rai bad ban pyniaid ia la ka jingialam .

Kito Wallam Kumne bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad ki bym pynkhuid ïa lade ki jingbymkhuid ki bymkhuid , namar ba ym kynthup la synreit ïa ka um ka Shemer halor jong ki . Ki pyntngit ïa ka Ïingjaiñ U Trai bad yn jlew ñiew shuh ïa ki kum ki briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: But the man that shall be unclean , and shall not purify himself , that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation , because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the  Lord  : the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him  ; he is unclean .

translation.kha: U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u Oholibah pynlong ïa u Nebukhadnessar , u kpa jong me , u syiem uba khraw bad sohpdung ha u ka burom bad ka jinglong syiem byrthen
translation.en: O thou king , the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom , and majesty , and glory , and honour :

translation.kha: U u ong , Ki briew jong nga ki pyrta , ‘ Trai u la pyn-i ba ngi la leh kaba dei . Ïa ïaleit ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ïa U U jong u la leh
translation.en: The  Lord  hath brought forth our righteousness : come , and let us declare in Zion the work of the  Lord  our God .
And now , brethren , I wot that through ignorance ye did it , as did also your rulers .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko hynmen ko para jong nga , nga tip ba kaei kaba ma phi bad ki nongïalam jong phi , phi la leh ïa U Jisu ka long namar ka jingbymtip jong phi .

translation.en: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave , and the noise of thy viols : the worm is spread under thee , and the worms cover thee .
translation.kha: Me la mlien ban ïoh ka jingpyndonburom da ki sur jingtem ki duitara , hynrei mynta hangne me don ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Me thiah ha ka jingthiah jong ki ksaiñ bad la tap nep da ki wieh .’

Shim ïa ka , Syiem Kynrad , u Araunah u ong bad , leh ïa ka katba phi sngewbit . Hangne ki don ki masi dab ban thang kum ka jingainguh ha duwan ka , bad hangne ki ki don lyntang shoh kew ban pyndonkam kum diengthang ka , bad u kew ban ai kum ka jingainguh . Nga ai ïa ki baroh ha phi .
translation.en: And Ornan said unto David , Take it to thee , and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes : lo , I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings , and the threshing instruments for wood , and the wheat for the meat offering  ; I give it all .
Do all things without murmurings and disputings :
translation.kha: To leh ïa kiei kiei baroh khlem da khñium ne khlem ïania ,
Nangta , u Joshua ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit na Lakhish sha Eglon , ki kerkut ïa ka bad ki tur ïaleh ka
translation.en: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon , and all Israel with him  ; and they encamped against it , and fought against it :

translation.kha: Kiar phi leh kumta , U Trai un Betonim bitar ïa phi . Un khang bymotsher ïa shiliang slap , bad ka khyndew jong phi ïingbishar tyrkhong eh ba ki jingthung kin hakpoh jingjynsur shuh bajynjar Te snieh sa ïap shen hangta , wat la pharep ka khyndew oh-shrong u ai ha phi ka long pynum Sakhi .
translation.en: And then the  Lord s  wrath be kindled against you , and he shut up the heaven , that there be no rain , and that the land yield not her fruit  ; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the  Lord  giveth you .

translation.kha: Wat pynhiarkput ïano ïano lane ban ïai isih ïa u , hynrei ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba phi ieit ïa lade . Nga long U .
translation.en: Thou shalt not avenge , nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people , but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha Petros u , Nga ong me ïa ba ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih ar sien mynta ka miet , men sa ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .
translation.en: And Jesus saith unto him ,  Verily I say unto thee , That this day , even in this night , before the cock crow twice , thou shalt deny me thrice .

And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work  ; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it  ; of gold , of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine twined linen , shalt thou make it .
translation.kha: Shna ïa ka jingdeng shadem na ka bynta u Rangbah Lyngdoh ban pyndonkam ha kaba sngewthuh ïa ka mon jong U Blei . Shna ïa ka da kijuh ki tiar kiba la pyndonkam ha kaba suh ïa ka ephod , bad da kijuh ki jingsuh pynpur itynnat .

translation.en: But a certain man named Ananias , with Sapphira his wife , sold a possession ,
translation.kha: Hynrei la don u briew uba kyrteng u Ananias , uba , lem bad ka tnga jong u ka Sapphira , ki la die katto katne na ka jaka kaba dei ka jong ki .

translation.en: For I give you good doctrine , forsake ye not my law .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga hikai ïa phi ka long kaba bha , kumta wat klet ïa ka .

translation.en: The king spake , and said , Is not this great Babylon , that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power , and for the honour of my majesty ?
translation.kha: u la ong ,  Ha khmih katno khraw ka Babilon ka long ! Nga la tei ïa ka kum ka nongbah jong nga ban pyn-i ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , ka burom jong nga bad ka jinglong syiem jong nga .
Ha kata ka por u khynnah u shakri ïa U Trai , u da phong da sopti-lor da ka jaiñ linen kaba kyntang .
translation.en: But Samuel ministered before the  Lord  , being a child , girded with a linen ephod .

translation.kha: Wat bud ïa ki rukom im ki jong briew kiba shong hangta ; ngan beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew ki bymngeit ba Blei phin ïohrung ha kata ka ri . Nga isih eh ïa ki namar kam ki bymman jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation , which I cast out before you : for they committed all these things , and therefore I abhorred them .

translation.kha: khawpud haba la pyntip ha nga kordor ka la don ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u , shisyndon nga la rai ban jinglur ïa u sha phi . Nga la talain ïa ki nongmudui jong u ban ai ki jingmudui jong ki Shilhi ïa u ha khmat nawei phi .
translation.en: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man , I sent straightway to thee , and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him . Farewell .
And when the unclean spirit had torn him , and cried with a loud voice , he came out of him .
translation.kha: U mynsiem bymkhuid u la pynring kyrthat ïa u briew , u la lynñiar jam , bad u la mihnoh na u .

translation.en: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them  ; and this house , which I have hallowed for my name , will I cast out of my sight  ; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people :
translation.kha: ngan jynrat noh ïa ki Israel na kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha ki ; bad ngan kyntait noh ïa kane ka ïing ïa kaba nga la pynkyntang na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga ; bad ki Israel kin sa shah rkhiebeiñ bad shah kynshi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , I die : and God will surely visit you , and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob .
translation.kha: Te u Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen ,  Nga la jan ïap , hynrei U Blei un ri un da ïa phi , bad un ïalam noh ïa phi na kane ka ri sha kata ka ri kaba u la kular skhem ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob .

translation.en: ( For they shall hear of thy great name , and of thy strong hand , and of thy stretched out arm  ; ) when he shall come and pray toward this house  ;
translation.kha: Haba u nongwei uba shong jngai na ka ri u ïohsngew shaphang ka nam jong me bad ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba me la leh na ka bynta ki briew jong me , bad un wan ban mane ïa me bad duwai ha kane ka Templ , to shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong u .

Nangta uwei pat u angel u la wan mihnoh na ka Templ bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam sha uta uba shong halor u lyoh , To ïa pyndonkam la rashi ka bad to ot ïa ka , jingot namar ka por ka la poi ; ka ka pyrthei la ih na ka bynta ka jingot !
translation.en: And another angel came out of the temple , crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud , Thrust in thy sickle , and reap : for the time is come for thee to reap  ; for the harvest of the earth is ripe .
And have cast their gods into the fire : for they were no gods , but the work of men s hands , wood and stone : therefore they have destroyed them .
translation.kha: bad ki la thang lut ïa ki blei jong ki — ki bym long satia ki blei , tang ki dur jong u dieng bad u maw ba la shna da ki kti briew .
bad nga la pyndap 2001 u da ka bor jong nga . Nga pynphuh Nehelam ha u ka jingshemphang , Teresh jingtbit bad ka jingnang ban trei ïa ki jait Khristan baroh —
translation.en: And I have filled him with the spirit of God , in wisdom , and in understanding , and in knowledge , and in all manner of workmanship ,
Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob , and the mercy to Abraham , which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old .
translation.kha: Men pyn-i ïa ka jingïaineh jong me bad ka jingieit baneh ha la ki briew , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham bad jong u Jakob , kumba me la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi la slem bah .

translation.en: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt : but I wholly followed the  Lord  my God .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba ïaleit ryngkat bad nga , pynban , ki pynsheptieng ïa ki briew jong ngi . Hynrei nga , nga la kohnguh hok ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong nga .
U la pynbeit hajar ngut na ki ban kit ïa ki ki tar bad phraphew hajar ngut ban shtah maw ha ki jaka lum , bad u thung lai hajar ngut ki nongpynïaidkam ki ban pynthikna ba ïa ka kam .
translation.en: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens , and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain , and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work .
Let thine eyes look right on , and let thine eyelids look straight before thee .
translation.kha: Peit beit sha khmat da ka jingsngewskhem kaba hok ; wat pyndem ïa la ka khlieh ha ka jinglehrain .
Wat ïa-lamler iwei ïa iwei pat , phi naba la loit noh ïa ka jinglong barim lem bad ki jingmlien jong bad ka ba phi la kup ïa ka jinglong bathymmai .
