Ka sngi ka Jingtep pdem haba U Jingbishar un shong ha ka jingbishar pyntyrkhong kumta to sngap jar ha ka jingdon ïunukh jong Delilah . U pluh u pynkhreh ban kñia ïa Abijah briew jong u bad Isak la khot sngewbha sei ki Lystra ban lute ïa ka Judah .
translation.en: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord  God  : for the day of the  Lord  is at hand : for the  Lord  hath prepared a sacrifice , he hath bid his guests .

And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating . And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet , he said , Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar ?
translation.kha: Katba u Adonijah bad baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha ki dang shu lah bam , ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa . Bad haba u Joab u la ïohsngew ïa ka turoi , u la kylli ,  Kaei ka jingmut jong kata ka jingsawa baroh hapoh ka nongbah ?

translation.en: Then he remembered the days of old , Moses , and his people , saying , Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock ? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him ?
translation.kha: Hynrei nangta ki kynmaw ïa ki por kiba mynshuwa , ïa ki sngi u Moses , u shakri U  Trai  bad ki kylli ,  Hangno mynta u don U  Trai  , uba pyllait im ïa ki nongïalam jong ki briew jong u na ka duriaw ? Hangno u don U  Trai  , uba la ai ïa U Mynsiem jong u ha u Moses ?
Lano U jingkrenbeiñ un pynkut ïa ki pynjahburom ha pyrthei ?
translation.en: When will God bring an end to evil on earth ?

translation.kha: Ki kynthei kiba la bud ïa U Jisu na ki la leit bad Joseph bad la ïohi ïa ka jingtep bad la buh ïa ka met ka jong U Jisu hapoh jong ka .
translation.en: And the women also , which came with him from Galilee , followed after , and beheld the sepulchre , and how his body was laid .
And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand  ; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers :
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki jingleh myntor kiba phi pyndonkam bad ngan iehnoh ïa phi khlem ki nongkren byrtong .

Hynrei la pyrshah ïa u da katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba long Sah dkhot ka synagog jong ki briew kiba la laitluid ( kumba Balaam khot ïa ki koit , kaba kynthup ïa ki Jiw na Kyrini bad na Aleksandria lumrit Ma ki bad kiwei shlei ki Jiw na ki thain ka Kilikia bad Asia ki la ïasdang ban ïasaidnia bad u Stephan .
translation.en: Then there arose certain of the synagogue , which is called the synagogue of the Libertines , and Cyrenians , and Alexandrians , and of them of Cilicia and of Asia , disputing with Stephen .

translation.kha: U u Jakob sah ha Ijipt khathynñiew snem , haduh ba un da dap shispah sawphew hynñiew snem ka rta .
translation.en: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years : so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years .

translation.kha: Hynrei tip nga kiba kumno ki briew phi long , bad nga tip ba phim don ka jingieit ïa U ha Blei ki dohnud jong phi .
translation.en: But I know you , that ye have not the love of God in you .

translation.kha: Te phin kynmaw ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba jahburom kiba phi la leh bad kumno phi la pyntngit ïa lade . Phin sa isih ïa lade namar kiei kiba sniew baroh la leh .
translation.en: And there shall ye remember your ways , and all your doings , wherein ye have been defiled  ; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed .

translation.kha: Lada nga pynbna ba u briew basniew , un sa ïap Gospel bad mem shym la den-um u ban kylla pynkyllon na ki lynti jong jingphet , jingleit shang u lah ban pyllait ïa la ka jingim , Nimrim Pukri syntuid kum u nongpop , bad ngan pynkitkhlieh ha me ïa ka jingïap jong u .
translation.en: When I say unto the wicked , Thou shalt surely die  ; and thou givest him not warning , nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way , to save his life  ; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .
Wondrous works in the land of Ham , and terrible things by the Red sea .
translation.kha: Haduh katno ki kam baphylla u la leh hangta ! Haduh katno ki kam baphylla u la leh ha ka Duriaw Basaw !
Shim khat-ar kilo u purew bad shet khat-ar tylli ki kpu .
translation.en: And thou shalt take fine flour , and bake twelve cakes thereof : two tenth deals shall be in one cake .
Her gates are sunk into the ground  ; he hath destroyed and broken her bars : her king and her princes are among the Gentiles : the law is no more  ; her prophets also find no vision from the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka lah ban ïohi da kaba suk , hynrei kam shym la pynpaw jingsngewkhia ei ei ïa la ka kupar . Ka jingkyllon jong ka , ka long kaba shyrkhei ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyntngen ïa ka . Ki nongshun jong ka ki la jop , bad ka kyang sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingisynei .

Ka ksiar bad ka rupa jong phi ka la bam sarang , bad kane ka sarang kan long ka sakhi pyrshah ïa phi bad kan sa bam duh ïa ka doh jong phi kum . ka ding Phi la spah kynshew ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh .
translation.en: Your gold and silver is cankered  ; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you , and shall eat your flesh as it were fire . Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days .
Jesus saith unto them ,  Have ye understood all these things ?  They say unto him , Yea , Lord .
translation.kha: Hato phi shemphang ïa kine kiei kiei ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki .  Ho-oid ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: Thou wilt say then , The branches were broken off , that I might be grafted in .
translation.kha: Hynrei phin ong ,  Ho-oid , ïa ki tnat la pynkheiñ noh ban ai jaka na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: What shall we say then ? Is there unrighteousness with God ? God forbid .
translation.kha: Hato ngin ong te , ba U Blei u long bymhok ? Ym kumta .

translation.en: He teacheth my hands to war  ; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms .
translation.kha: U hikai ïa nga ban ïaleh thma , ba kumta nga lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka ryntieh kaba khlaiñ .

translation.en: Then said I , Wisdom is better than strength : nevertheless the poor man s wisdom is despised , and his words are not heard .
translation.kha: Nga la ïai-ong borabor ba ka jingstad ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingkhlaiñ , hynrei ym don mano mano ba pyrkhat ïa u briew uba duk ba u long uba stad lane pynshahshkor ei ei ïa kaei kaba u ong .

translation.en: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord , we persuade men ; but we are made manifest unto God ; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ka mut aïu ban sheptieng ïa U Trai , bad kumta ngi pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa kiwei . U Blei u tip lut shaphang jong ngi , bad nga kyrmen ba ha ki dohnud jong phi , phi tip ïa nga kumjuh .

U Manasseh u la pynïap bun ki briew balui lui , haduh ba ki surok bah ka Jerusalem ki la tuid da ka snam ; u la leh ïa nalor kane ba u ïalam ïa ki briew ka Judah sha ka jingmane da bleithaw pynlong kaba ïa ki ban pop leh pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much , till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another  ; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin , in doing that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord .
For rulers are not a terror to good works , but to the evil . Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power ? do that which is good , and thou shalt have praise of the same :
translation.kha: Naba ïa ki nongsynshar ym dei ban sheptieng da kito kiba leh ïa kaba bha , hynrei da kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew . Hato phi kwah ban long u bymsheptieng ïa u briew uba don ha ka bor ? Te to leh ïa kaei kaba bha , bad un ïaroh ïa phi ,
Men ïap kum ksew ha ka kti ki nongwei don blei . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la ai ïa hukum .
translation.en: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .

And she shall follow after her lovers , but she shall not overtake them  ; and she shall seek them , but shall not find them : then shall she say , I will go and return to my first husband  ; for then was it better with me than now .
translation.kha: Kan leit beh nadien ïa kiba ieit jong ka , hynrei kan ym lap ïa ki . Kan wad ïa ki hynrei kan ym shem ïa ki . Te kan sa ong ,  Ngan leit phai noh sha u tnga uba nyngkong jong nga — nga kham bit kham biang myn ha kata ban ïa kaba nga long mynta .
Haba briew u kular ban ai ei sha U Trai , lane u smai ban kyndiah na kaei re kaei , um dei ban pynkheiñ ïa ka kular , hynrei u dei ban pyndep ïa baroh kaba u la ong ban pyndep .
translation.en: If a man vow a vow unto the  Lord  , or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond  ; he shall not break his word , he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth .
And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon , saying , The  Lord  make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab , whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire  ;
translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba la shah rah noh kum ki koidi na Jerusalem sha Babilonia ki kwah ban wallam ka jingtim hano hano , kin ong , ‘ To U  Trai  un ñiew ïa phi kum u Sedekaïah bad u Ahab , kiba u syiem ka Babilonia u la syang im !’

translation.en: And Abraham said , I will swear .
translation.kha: U Abraham u ong ,  Nga kular .
Baroh la ïohsngew ïa kata , ki la ïa kaei ki ki la ong .
translation.en: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds .
And Adah bare Jabal : he was the father of such as dwell in tents , and of such as have cattle .
translation.kha: Ka Adah ka la kha ïa u Jabal , uba dei u kpa tymmen jong kito kiba ri jingri bad kiba shong ha ki ïingjaiñ .
Nga sngewsih bad nga phong kamon ki jaiñ khain , bad nga jingpyrsad hangne ha u phangpdeng pui , ba la shahjop .
translation.en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin , and defiled my horn in the dust .

Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines , and to cut off from Tyre and Zidon every helper that remaineth : for the  Lord  will spoil the Philistines , the remnant of the country of Caphtor .
translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi ban pynjot ïa ka Philistia , ban pyndam noh na ka Tyros bad ka Sidon ïa ka jingïarap baroh kaba dang sah . Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynjot ïa ki nong Philistia , baroh kiba wan na ki rud duriaw ka Krit .

translation.en: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year  ; lest the land become desolate , and the beast of the field multiply against thee .
translation.kha: Ngan ym beh noh ïa ki hapoh shisnem , lada nga leh kumta , ka ri kan long kaba kynjah , bad ki mradkhlaw kin bun palat ïa phi .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto him , Get thee from me , take heed to thyself , see my face no more  ; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die .
translation.kha: U la ong ha u Moses ,  Mihnoh nangne ! Ngam kwah shuh ban ïohi ïa me ! Ha ka sngi ba nga ïohi ïa me , men ïap !

bit ïa uno na ki khun ksiew jong u Aaron , uba ïa ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh lane jingpang mih , ban bam ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang tad haduh ba un da long uba khuid . Lada u ktah ïa kaei kaei kaba pyndei ka metïap , lane lada u ïoh ka jingpang mih jor ,
translation.en: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper , or hath a running issue  ; he shall not eat of the holy things , until he be clean . And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead , or a man whose seed goeth from him  ;

Then said the  Lord  unto me  ; This gate shall be shut , it shall not be opened , and no man shall enter in by it  ; because the  Lord  , the God of Israel , hath entered in by it , therefore it shall be shut .
translation.kha: Ka khyrdop ka khang , bad U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Kane ka khyrdop kan long ba la khang bad yn ym plie lano lano ruh . Yn ym don u briew ïa uba yn shah ban plie ïa ka , namar ma nga U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga la rung lyngba jong ka . Kan sah ba la khang ïa ka .
Nangta u ong shuh shuh , Balei , syiem kynrad , thwet ïa u shakri jong phi Nga la aïu keiñ Ka kam palat aïu nga leh ?
translation.en: And he said , Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant ? for what have I done ? or what evil is in mine hand ?

translation.kha: Kumta kita ki mynsiem bymkhuid ki la ïakyrpad ïa U Jisu , Phah ngi ïa ha kitei ki sniang , bad shah ngi ïa ban rung hapoh jong ki .
translation.en: And all the devils besought him , saying , Send us into the swine , that we may enter into them .

Howbeit he refused to turn aside : wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib , that the spear came out behind him  ; and he fell down there , and died in the same place : and it came to pass , that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Asahel um shym sangeh ; kumta u Abner , da ka jingtynrah shadien ïa la u sum , u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh ba kumta u sum u da pei bla ha ka ingdong jong u . U Asahel u kyllon ïap ha madan , bad uwei pa uwei uba wan poi ha ka jaka ha kaba u kyllon u la sangeh bad ïeng hangta .
katne ngut ki bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la lah wan na Jerusalem ki la ïalum sawdong ïa U .
translation.en: Then came together unto him the Pharisees , and certain of the scribes , which came from Jerusalem .
I will praise thee : for thou hast heard me , and art become my salvation .
translation.kha: Nga ïaroh ïa me , A  Trai  , namar me la ïohsngew ïa nga , bad me la ai ka jingjop ïa nga .

Hynrei ma phi , ki satang jong U Blei , phin long kiba kmen bad phin rwai kumba phi leh ha ka miet jong ka Jingkhawai Niam bakyntang . Phin long kiba kmen kum kito paring ïaid ryngkat bad ki sur nongshna ki tangmuri sha ka Templ U Dura , u nongkyrshan jong ki Israel .
translation.en: Ye shall have a song , as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept  ; and gladness of heart , as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the  Lord  , to the mighty One of Israel .

And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel , and said unto them , Why are ye come out to set your battle in array ? am not I a Philistine , and ye servants to Saul ? choose you a man for you , and let him come down to me .
translation.kha: U Goliath u ïeng bad u byrthen ïa ki Israel ,  Phi ïaleh aïu hangto , pynkhreh ban ïaleh thma ? Nga , nga dei u Philistia , phi ki mraw u Saul ! Jied uwei na ki rangbah jong phi ban ïaleh bad nga .

U Dabid u ai Khinnereth u Solomon ïa ka dur pynkhreh jong ka jingtei baroh jong pihuiñ Templ , bad ïa ki kamra buh tiar jong ka bad ïa kiwei pat jing kamra Phortunatos ïa ka jaka kaba kyntang tam , ha kaba la shngiam ïa ki pop .
translation.en: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch , and of the houses thereof , and of the treasuries thereof , and of the upper chambers thereof , and of the inner parlours thereof , and of the place of the mercy seat ,

translation.kha: Ki kiba shong hapdeng jong nang kham ïohbor katba ma phi pat phin nang duh ïa la ka bor
translation.en: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high  ; and thou shalt come down very low .

translation.kha: Ka jingkmen jong long ka jong phi hi ; ka jong ka long ka . Ym don uba lah ban ïa ki phi .
translation.en: The heart knoweth his own bitterness  ; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy .
And will send unto Babylon fanners , that shall fan her , and shall empty her land : for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki nongwei ban pynjot ïa ka Babilonia kum ka lyer kaba pynher noh ïa u phlangïap . Haba kata ka sngi jong ka jingpynjot ka wan , kin tur ïaleh na baroh sawdong bad kin ieh syllen ïa ka ri .

translation.en: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell , that they may prepare a city for habitation  ;
translation.kha: U shah ïa ki briew kiba thngan ban shongduh hangta , bad tei ki nongbah ban shong ban sah ha ki .

translation.en: Tom is a friend of a friend of mine .
translation.kha: U Tom u dei u paralok jong u paralok jong nga .
Haba u wan phai na Damaskos , u Ahas u ïohi ba la dep shna ïa ka , duwan
translation.en: And when the king was come from Damascus , the king saw the altar : and the king approached to the altar , and offered thereon .

translation.kha: Ngan pyndonkam ïa ki ban shem la kine ki kin bud ne em ïa ki lynti jong nga , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ki ki la .
translation.en: That through them I may prove Israel , whether they will keep the way of the  Lord  to walk therein , as their fathers did keep it , or not .
Yea , he had power over the angel , and prevailed : he wept , and made supplication unto him : he found him in Beth–el , and there he spake with us  ;
translation.kha: U ïaleh bad u angel bad u la jop . U la ïam bad pan ïa ka jingkyrkhu . Bad ha Bethel U Blei u la wan sha u kpa tymmen jong ngi u Jakob bad u la ïakren bad u .
Kohnguh ïa U Trai bad shakri hok ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh . To kynmaw ïa kiei kiei khraw kiba u kiba la leh na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: Only fear the  Lord  , and serve him in truth with all your heart : for consider how great things he hath done for you .

translation.kha: Hadien kane U Jisu u la jied sa hynñiewphew ar ngut ki rangbah bad u la phah ïa ki ar ar ngut , ban leit ha shuwa u sha jong ki shnong baroh bad ki jaka ha kaba ma , u u la mut ban leit .
translation.en: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also , and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place , whither he himself would come .

translation.kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ki lyngdoh ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew la lum da ki briew kiba dei ïap ban ; hynrei ïa u Melkhisedek ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew lum la da uta uba im , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong .
translation.en: And here men that die receive tithes  ; but there he receiveth them , of whom it is witnessed that he liveth .
And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them : for they said , Lest the earth swallow us up also .
translation.kha: Baroh ki Israel kiba don hangta ki la phet ïap haba ki ïohsngew ïa ka jinglynñiar jong ki . Ki la ïa-pyrta ,  Phet , Ka khyndew ka lah ban nguid ïa ngi ruh !
lada Hynrei u tnga jong ka , u khang ïa ka ban pyndep ïa ka kular haba u ïohsngew ïa kata , kam donkam ban bat ïa kata . U un Trai map ïa ka .
translation.en: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it  ; then he shall make her vow which she vowed , and that which she uttered with her lips , wherewith she bound her soul , of none effect : and the  Lord  shall forgive her .

translation.kha: Shen hadien kata , U Jaser u la leit sha laispah shnong Seneh la khot , ka Parmenas Ananias pynkhie synran jong u katto bad u paidbah jingkren kiei la ïadon ryngkat .
translation.en: And it came to pass the day after , that he went into a city called Nain  ; and many of his disciples went with him , and much people .

translation.kha: U Solomon u pyndonkam ïa uta u dieng ha kaba shna ïa ki mawkyrdon ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka pynjaijai Manoah u ksai bad ha kaba shna ïa ki duitara bad jingtem ksai na ka bynta ki nongput nongtem . Ym pat ju Ïai kum kata shongkurim kaba lah ban ïohi mynshuwa ha ka ri Judah . Khet
translation.en: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the  Lord  , and to the king s palace , and harps and psalteries for singers : and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah .
And ye are witnesses of these things .
translation.kha: Phi long ki sakhi ïa kine kiei kiei .
U Resin u syiem Syria bad Pekah u syiem ka Israel ki tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad kerkut ïa ka , hynrei kim shym lah ban jop u Ahas .
translation.en: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war : and they besieged Ahaz , but could not overcome him .
And the glory of the  Lord  came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ba-thaba ka la ïaid lyngba ïa ka khyrdop bashaphang mihngi bad rung shapoh ka Templ .
Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Ïa u briew uba , nyngkong u Adam , la thaw uba don jingim ; hynrei u Adam uba u khatduh la long U Mynsiem uba ai jingim .
translation.en: And so it is written , The first man Adam was made a living soul ; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit .

translation.kha: U la lamler shaphang jong nga ha phi ko Syiem kynrad ; hynrei , phi phi long kum u angel U Blei , kumta leh ïa kaei kaba ïa idei phi .
translation.en: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king  ; but my lord the king is as an angel of God : do therefore what is good in thine eyes .

translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa ka jingkhuid ka dohnud bad ka jingkren badonburom , u syiem un long paralok u jong phi .
translation.en: He that loveth pureness of heart , for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend .
And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah , The  Lord  be witness between us , if we do not so according to thy words .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Ngi mynjur ïa kata . U  Trai  un long u sakhi hapdeng jong ngi .

translation.en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son , and bring them up unto mount Hor :
translation.kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad u Eleasar u khun jong u sha kliar u Lum Hor ,

Ki ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ki nga bad bam ïa ka doh kñia . Hynrei ma nga U Trai , ngam sngewbha ïa ki , bad mynta ngan kynmaw ïa ki jong pop ki bad pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kata ; ngan phah biang ïa ki sha Ijipt .
translation.en: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings , and eat it  ; but the  Lord  accepteth them not  ; now will he remember their iniquity , and visit their sins : they shall return to Egypt .

translation.kha: wallam ha nga ïa u nongtem . Katba u nongtem u dang tem ïa la ka , ka bor jong Trai ka la wan halor u Elisha ,
translation.en: But now bring me a minstrel . And it came to pass , when the minstrel played , that the hand of the  Lord  came upon him .
And the  Lord  said unto Satan , The  Lord  rebuke thee , O Satan  ; even the  Lord  that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee : is not this a brand plucked out of the fire ?
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u la ong ha u Soitan ,  To U  Trai  un pynrem ïa me , ko Soitan ! To U  Trai  , uba ieit ïa ka Jerusalem , un pynrem ïa me . Une u briew u long kum u dieng ïa uba la sei noh na ka ding .

translation.en: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel : thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel : why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Ka shnong jong ngi ka dei ka nongbah kaba khraw , kawei na ki shnong kiba shongsuk shongsaiñ tam bad kohnguh syiem tam ha Israel . Balei phi pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka ? Balei phi kwah ban pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong U  Trai  ?

To Esiongeber ïa Arsa kaba nga la Ussiel ha phi : ‘ U mraw um long long-briew khraw ban mynba la sharud Kynrad Khilmad Lada ki pynshitom ïa nga Eliphelet kin pynshitom Makedonia phi ruh ; lada ki la patiaw ïa ka pynthut jong nga , pynneh kohnguh Ishar ka jong ïashong ruh .
translation.en: Remember the word that I said unto you , The servant is not greater than his lord . If they have persecuted me , they will also persecute you  ; if they have kept my saying , they will keep yours also .
For she doted upon their paramours , whose flesh is as the flesh of asses , and whose issue is like the issue of horses .
translation.kha: Ka la dap da ka jingkwah brai ïa ki rangbah ba-dap da ka jingbrai kiba don ka jingthrew jakhlia la kum ki kada bad ki khashor .

Kumta ka la kylliang ïa ki jaiñ riewkynthei ba ka phong , ka la ïa la ka khmat da ka jingkah , bad ka la leit ha khyrdop ban rung sha Enaim , ka shnong kaba don ha ka lynti sha Timnah . Kumba ka tip bha ba u Shelah u khun jong u Judah u la rangbah mynta , pynban ym pat la ai ïa ha u ban shongkurim
translation.en: And she put her widow s garments off from her , and covered her with a veil , and wrapped herself , and sat in an open place , which is by the way to Timnah  ; for she saw that Shelah was grown , and she was not given unto him to wife .
And though they found no cause of death in him , yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain .
translation.kha: Bad wat la kim shym la shem kano kano ka daw ban rai pynïap ïa u , ki la kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban phah pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And the second day they compassed the city once , and returned into the camp : so they did six days .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi kaba ar , ki ïaid tawiar biang ïa ka nongbah shisien bad nangta ki leit phai sha ka jaka shong dara . Ki la leh kumne haduh hynriew sngi .
Kumta u u ba u jong u u Isaak um mynjur ïa ki kynthei nong Kanaan .
translation.en: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father  ;

And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day . So the  Lord  turned from the fierceness of his anger . Wherefore the name of that place was called , The valley of Achor , unto this day .
translation.kha: Ki pynïeng ruh halor jong u ïa ka kynton maw kaba heh , kaba dang don haduh mynta . Dei namar kata ba ïa kata jaka la dang ïai khot ka Them Jingjynjar . Da kumta U  Trai  um shym da bitar shla shuh .

Ki paid Israel kin long kiba khlaiñ kum ki shipai , Dalmanutha kalamus kum ki ïasuhbuit kiba la Pynkyntang nongaibuit . Ki khun ki ksiew jong sngem kin kynmaw ïa kane ka jingjop bad kin Nephtoah namar kaei kaba U Trai u la jingpynhiar .
translation.en: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man , and their heart shall rejoice as through wine : yea , their children shall see it , and be glad  ; their heart shall rejoice in the  Lord .

translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , lada jingïatiplem kam ïa ngi , ngi don ka jingshlur ha khmat U Blei
translation.en: Beloved , if our heart condemn us not , then have we confidence toward God .

translation.kha: Bad u briew u kham kor bun shah ban ïa ka langbrot ! Kumta te , ka Aiñ jong Paltiel ka :21 ïa ngi ban ïarap ïano ïano jingpawnam ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: How much then is a man better than a sheep ? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days .

Moreover the altar that was at Beth–el , and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , had made , both that altar and the high place he brake down , and burned the high place , and stamped it small to powder , and burned the grove .
translation.kha: U Josaïah u la pyntwa ruh ïa ka jaka mane ha Bethel kaba la tei da u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop . U Josaïah u la pyntwa ruh ïa ka duwan , u pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki maw jong ka , bad u pynlwet phum ïa ki ; u la thang ruh ïa ka dur jong ka Asherah .

Ïa u Daniel wallam la shisyndon shapoh sha ka jaka ba don u syiem , bad u syiem u la ong ha u , Hato me dei u Daniel , uto u Jiw shah uba ringmraw ïa uba u kpa jong nga syiem u u la wallam hangne na Judah ?
translation.en: Then was Daniel brought in before the king . And the king spake and said unto Daniel , Art thou that Daniel , which art of the children of the captivity of Judah , whom the king my father brought out of Jewry ?

translation.kha: Hato me ïa tip ki aiñ kiba synshar ïa ki suiñbneng , bad hato me lah ban pyndei ïa ki ha ka pyrthei ?
translation.en: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven ? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth ?
And Nob , the city of the priests , smote he with the edge of the sword , both men and women , children and sucklings , and oxen , and asses , and sheep , with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: U Saul u la phah pynïap ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nongshong shnong ha Nob , ka nongbah jong ki lyngdoh : ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung , ki masi , ki kada , bad ki langbrot — ki la shah pynïap lut khoit .

translation.en: Oh that I might have my request  ; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for !
translation.kha: Balei U Blei um ai ha nga ïa kaba nga pan ? Balei um jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong nga ?

jinglamwir ka ïingsyiem I pynitynnat Jether ki Mynhynnin bajngum bad balieh , ba la Sarethan da risa tyllai ïakhawai sawjngum bani ha ki syrwiang rupa bad pyndait ha ki rishot maw marbl . Ïa ki jaka shong shaniah ha ka ïingsyiem , la shna da ka pynkhamti bad ka rupa , Babilon ïa ka madan pait siang da kyllum maw marbl bynta , maw marbl basaw stait u mawkordor baphyrnai , bad u mawkordor bajngum .
translation.en: Where were white , green , and blue , hangings , fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble : the beds were of gold and silver , upon a pavement of red , and blue , and white , and black , marble .

translation.kha: lei Ym lei .
translation.en: You are welcome .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh u jubab , Phim ban khuslai ei ei . U Trai un sumar ïa phi ha ka jingleit jong phi .
translation.en: And the priest said unto them , Go in peace : before the  Lord  is your way wherein ye go .

translation.kha: Na kiba kum kita ki jingma bashyrkhei jong ka jingïap u la ïa pynim ngi , bad un pynim ngi ïa ; bad ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha u ba un pynim biang ïa ngi , kumba phi ïarap ïa ngi lyngba ki jingduwai jong lem phi na ka bynta ngi jong .
translation.en: Who delivered us from so great a death , and doth deliver : in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us ;
Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother , and his mother s sister , Mary the wife of Cleophas , and Mary Magdalene .
translation.kha: Kiba la ïa-ïeng ha syndah ka diengphna U Jisu ki la long ka kmie jong u , ka para jong ka kmie jong u , ka Mari ka tnga u Kleopas , bad ka Mari ka nong Magdala .

translation.en: And they said , Thou hast saved our lives : let us find grace in the sight of my lord , and we will be Pharaoh s servants .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Phi la pyllait im ïa ngi ; phi la lehbha ïa ngi , bad ngi ruh ngin long ki mraw jong u syiem .

Te nga la shim ïa pat ka kawei kot bad kli nga la ai ïa ka ha sekretari u jong nga u Barukh , bad u la thoh hangta ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ong . U la thoh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la don ha ka kot kli kaba nyngkong bad kijuh ki khubor kiba nga la ong u ha ban thoh .
translation.en: Then took Jeremiah another roll , and gave it to Baruch the scribe , the son of Neriah  ; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire : and there were added besides unto them many like words .

translation.kha: Kumba la hikai ha ka Baibl , kine ki ki aiñ ïarap ïa ngi ban kyntiew ïa ka long-briew manbriew , ban burom ïa , kiwei bad ban long kiba sbun bad kiba leh hok .
translation.en: These values , as taught in the Bible , promote well-being and respect for others , along with such qualities as honesty and kindness .

translation.kha: U um kumno ka ka jinglong jong u ka ktah ia kiwei .
translation.en: Tom doesn't realise how his behaviour affects others .
If any man trespass against his neighbour , and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear , and the oath come before thine altar in this house :
translation.kha: Haba u briew u shah mudui ba u leh bymdei ïa uwei pat , bad la wallam sha ka duwan jong me ha kane ka Templ ban shim ïa ka jingsmai ba u long uba lui lui ,

translation.en: And Abram went up out of Egypt , he , and his wife , and all that he had , and Lot with him , into the south .
translation.kha: U Abram u leit noh shaphang shatei na ka ri Ijipt sha ka phang bashathie jong ka ri Kanaan lem bad ka tnga jong u bad baroh kat kiba u don , bad u Lot u la leit lem bad u .
Ngan pynshitom ïa u Bel , u blei ki Babilonia nong , bad ngan pynlong ïa u ban aiti noh ïa ki tiar jong u kiba shu tuh ; ki jaitbynriew ym kin mane shuh ïa . u Ki kynroh ka Babilon ki la khyllem .
translation.en: And I will punish Bel in Babylon , and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up : and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him : yea , the wall of Babylon shall fall .

translation.kha: Kata ka long kumno kan ha jia ka sngi ba yn pynpaw ïa U Khun U Briew .
translation.en: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed .
And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , See , I have set thee over all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Mynta , nga thung ïa me u lat halor ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him , when the number of his months is cut off in the midst ?
translation.kha: Haba ka jingim u briew ka la kut , hato u pyrkhat shisha ne em ba ki khun jong u kin kmen ?
Nangta u la shim ïa ki khynnah ha ïa-ong bymneh ksang ti , thylli la iakren ïa ki kti jong Hanes Amnon jong ki , biria sahkut la kyrkhu ïa ki Salmunna
translation.en: And he took them up in his arms , put his hands upon them , and blessed them .
Then the disciples , every man according to his ability , determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea :
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la kut jingmut ba uwei pa uwei na ki un phah katba lah bor ban ïarap ïa ki parabangeit kiba shong basah ha Judia .

translation.en: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow , that my days should be consumed with shame ?
translation.kha: Balei ba la kha ïa nga ? Hato kan dei tang ban ïoh ka jingjynjar bad ka jingsngewsih , ban pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga ha ka jingjahburom ?
Haba ki nongkamsniew ki ïa phi , ko khun jong nga , wat kohnguh .
translation.en: My son , if sinners entice thee , consent thou not .

translation.kha: Phin ïatyngkhuh para phi , wat la ym don uba beh ïa phi , phin lah ban ïaleh ïa uno uno u nongshun .
translation.en: And they shall fall one upon another , as it were before a sword , when none pursueth : and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies .
And it came to pass in the morning , that David wrote a letter to Joab , and sent it by the hand of Uriah .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , u Dabid u thoh shithi sha u Joab bad u phah rah ïa ka ha u Uriah .
Kata ka khynnah ha ka khyrdop ka la ong Petros , me ruh mem dei uwei na ki synran jong utai ? Em , ngam dei , la jubab u Petros .
translation.en: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter , Art not thou also one of this man s disciples ? He saith , I am not .
Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world , there shall also this , that this woman hath done , be told for a memorial of her .
translation.kha: Mynta , nga pynthikna ïa phi ba hangno hangno haba yn ïalap ïa kane ka Gospel ha kylleng ka pyrthei , ïa kaei kaba ka la leh yn ïathuh ïa ka ban kynmaw ïa ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass at noon , that Elijah mocked them , and said , Cry aloud : for he is a god  ; either he is talking , or he is pursuing , or he is in a journey , or peradventure he sleepeth , and must be awaked .
translation.kha: Ynda la dap shiteng sngi u Elijah u la sdang ban kren biria ïa ki :  Duwai kham jam ! U dei u blei ! Lehse u dang phohsniew lane u dang leit shabar lane lehse u dang leit jingleit ! Lane lehse u dang ïohthiah , phin hap ban kyrsiew ïa u !

translation.en: How much more shall the blood of Christ , who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God , purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God ?
translation.kha: Namar ba kane ka long kaba shisha , kaba katno tam lah ban pyndep da ka snam U Khrist ! Lyngba U Mynsiem bymjukut u la aiti ïa lade kum ka jingkñia kaba janai ha U Blei . Ka snam jong u kan pynkhuid ïa ka jingïatiplem jong ngi na ki niam ki rukom ki bymmyntoi , khnang ba ngi lah ban shakri ïa U Blei uba im .
Nangta rah shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad buh ïa ki ha ka Synduk ka Jutang , ha nga ïashem bad me .
translation.en: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony , where I will meet with you .
He that covereth a transgression seeketh love  ; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends .
translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ba ki briew kin sngewtynnat ïa phi , to map ïa ki haba ki kum leh bakla ïa phi . To kynmaw ba ki jingbakla ki lah ban pynpra ïa ka jingïadei paralok .

translation.en: And when the devil had ended all the temptation , he departed from him for a season .
translation.kha: Haba u Soitan u la dep ban pynshoi ïa U Jisu ha ki rukom bapher bapher , u la iehnoh ïa u shipor .
Hadien wan la poi kita kiwei pat ki theisotti . ‘ Ko kynrad , ko Kynrad ! to plie ïa ngi !’ ki pyrta la jam .
translation.en: Afterward came also the other virgins , saying , Lord , Lord , open to us .
And they came thither into the midst of the house , as though they would have fetched wheat  ; and they smote him under the fifth rib : and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped .
translation.kha: Ka kynthei ha ka jingkhang ka la shoh samthiah ngai katba ka dang tai kew bad ka ïohthiah , kumta u Rekhab bad u Baanah ki ïohrung shapoh .

jingtasngeng Trai u la ngat ha pynmih Abraham jingpynbynta ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre . Katba u Abraham u dang shong ha ka jingkhang ka Jingsuk jong u ha ka por ba dang shit kyr-ang mynsngi , u la khmied bad u mano ïohi khlong ngut ki —Ïoannis kiba ïeng hangta .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre : and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day  ;
The rest said , Let be , let us see whether Elias will come to save him .
translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki la ong ,  To ap , to ngin peit lada u Elijah un wan bad pyllait im ïa u !
Bad nga la duwai jur ha U Trai U Blei bathngan da kaba ïasaid bad u , da kaba shahjingit jingkyrkieh da kaba phong ki jaiñ khain , bad da kaba shong ha Gosan dpei .
translation.en: And I set my face unto the Lord God , to seek by prayer and supplications , with fasting , and sackcloth , and ashes :

translation.kha: Tang shu Bynrap na Hadassah lieng ryngkat Elishama Jisu u la ïakynduh ïa u briew uba Rumah mih na ki krem jingtep kiba khoit hangta . Nahaliel u briew u don ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong u bad u shong u sah ha ki jaka Sher briew thad
translation.en: And when he was come out of the ship , immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit ,
And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues , that if he found any of this way , whether they were men or women , he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U la leit sha u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad u la pan ïa ki shithi pynithuh sha ki synagog kiba ha Damaskos , khnang ba lada un lap ïano ïano hangta kiba bud ïa ka Lynti jong U Trai , un lah ban kem ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei bad wallam pat ïa ki sha Jerusalem .
U Trai u ong , Ngan pynrem ïa u uba briew phai noh na nga bad uba buh ïa jingshaniah ka jong u ha u briew , ha ka jingkhlaiñ jong u briew u bym im junom .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man , and maketh flesh his arm , and whose heart departeth from the  Lord .

For the mountains shall depart , and the hills be removed  ; but my kindness shall not depart from thee , neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed , saith the  Lord  that hath mercy on thee .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah bad ki lumrit ki lah ban twa , hynrei ka jingieit jong nga ïa pha kan ym kut noh ; ngan pynneh junom ïa la ka kular jong ka jingsuk .  Kumta te ong U  Trai  uba ieit ïa pha .
Phim pat ju poi hangta mynshuwa , kumta jingïashoh pyn-i ha phi ka lynti ba phin leit lawbah Hynrei wat leit sha jan ka Synduk ka Jutang ; pynjngai kumba shi kilomitar nadien jong ka .
translation.en: Yet there shall be a space between you and it , about two thousand cubits by measure : come not near unto it , that ye may know the way by which ye must go : for ye have not passed this way heretofore .
Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen , and whom ye have desired ! and , behold , the  Lord  hath set a king over you .
translation.kha: Mynta hangne u don u syiem uba phi la jied ; phi la pan ïa u , bad mynta U  Trai  u la ai ïa u ha phi .

translation.en: Who delivered us from so great a death , and doth deliver : in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us ;
translation.kha: Na kiba kum kita ki jingma bashyrkhei jong ka jingïap u la pynim ïa ngi , bad un pynim ïa ngi ; bad ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha u ba un pynim biang ïa ngi , kumba phi ïarap ïa ngi lyngba ki jingduwai lem jong phi na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: The first shall say to Zion , Behold , behold them : and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings .
translation.kha: Nga , U  Trai  , nga long uba nyngkong ban ïathuh ïa ka Seïon ïa ka khubor ; nga phah ïa u nonglamktien sha Jerusalem ban ong , ‘ Ki briew jong phi ki wan ! Ki wan sha ïing !’

Kine ki briew baroh ki long ki khun ki ksiew u jong Noah , ha la jait ka ka jait , kat kum la ki jingkheiñ jait bapher bapher ha ka jinghiarpateng . Hadien ka jingshlei um , baroh ki jaitbynriew ka ha pyrthei ki hiarpateng na ki khun shynrang u jong Noah .
translation.en: These are the families of the sons of Noah , after their generations , in their nations : and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood .
But when a stronger than he shall come upon him , and overcome him , he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted , and divideth his spoils .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u briew uba kham khlaiñ u tur ïaleh ïa u bad jop ïa u , u kit noh ïa baroh ki tiar ïaleh kiba u trai u la shaniah bad u ïasam ïa kaei kaba u la lute .

translation.en: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth–el : and the horns of the altar shall be cut off , and fall to the ground .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga pynshitom ïa ki paid Israel na ka bynta ki pop jong ki , ngan pynjot ïa ki duwan ka Bethel . Ïa ki dong jong kawei pa kawei ka duwan yn pom noh bad kin hap ha madan .
Khmih ïa kata kam la biang ba phin khmih ïa nga ha ka jingkyndit bad sngap noh jar ?
translation.en: Mark me , and be astonished , and lay your hand upon your mouth .
Wherefore Jesus also , that he might sanctify the people with his own blood , suffered without the gate .
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw U Jisu ruh u la ïap shabar ka nongbah , khnang ban pynkhuid ïa u paidlang na ka pop da ka snam jong u hi .

translation.en: And he promised , and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude .
translation.kha: U Judas u la mynjur ïa kata bad u la sdang ban khmih ïa ka kabu kaba biang ban aiti ïa U Jisu ha ki khlem ka jingtip jong u paidbah shaphang kata .

translation.en: Then commanded Belshazzar , and they clothed Daniel with scarlet , and put a chain of gold about his neck , and made a proclamation concerning him , that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi u Belshassar u la ai hukum ïa ki shakri jong u ban pynphong ïa u Daniel ha ka jaiñkup syiem kaba sawbthuh bad ban pyndeng u kynjri ksiar ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong u . Bad u la pynlong ïa u , uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hima .
nga la pynlong kynjah ïa Ijipt bad pynjot noh ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka , kin sa tip nga long U Trai .
translation.en: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate , and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full , when I shall smite all them that dwell therein , then shall they know that I am the  Lord .
Both thy bondmen , and thy bondmaids , which thou shalt have , shall be of the heathen that are round about you  ; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids .
translation.kha: Lada phi donkam ïa ki mraw , phi lah ban thied na ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong phi .

Lada u briew u shah pynshoi da kum kita ki jingtynjuh , um dei ban ong , Kane ka jingpynshoi ka wan na U . Blei Naba ïa U Blei ym lah ban pynshoi da kaba sniew , bad ma u da hi lade um ïano pynshoi ïano .
translation.en: Let no man say when he is tempted , I am tempted of God : for God cannot be tempted with evil , neither tempteth he any man :

translation.kha: Mynta te , lada kaei kaba phi leh mynta ka sngi ïa u Gideon bad ïa ka longïing jong u ka long da kaba khuid mynsiem bad kaba hok , te to bad kmen u Abimelekh bad ba ai kmen un bad phi .
translation.en: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day , then rejoice ye in Abimelech , and let him also rejoice in you :

translation.kha: Ynda u Sarah bad napdeng briew Peris u ki Iskariot , ki shem ba la thang ïa jakoid shnong LONG bad ba la rong Uta ïohrung ki tnga Beh Kieng , ïa ki khun angnud bad ki jingpyndonkam kynthei Tobadonijah ki .
translation.en: So David and his men came to the city , and , behold , it was burned with fire  ; and their wives , and their sons , and their daughters , were taken captives .
Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory ? and how do ye see it now ? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing ?
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno hapdeng jong phi uba dang kynmaw katno ka jingiphuh ka Templ ka la ju long ? Kumno phi ïohi ïa kane mynta ? Ka paw kumba kam long ei ei ruh .
U shñiuh jong ki u long kum u shñiuh kynthei , ki jong bniat ki , ki long kum ki bniat sing .
translation.en: And they had hair as the hair of women , and their teeth were as the teeth of lions .

translation.kha: Ka jingstad kaba nga pynbna ka long ka jingstad barieh jong U Blei , ïa kaba la buhrieh na u bynriew , hynrei , ïa kaba u la jied lypa na ka bynta ka burom jong ngi wat ba ha shuwa pynlong yn ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery , even the hidden wisdom , which God ordained before the world unto our glory :

translation.kha: pynshyrkhei Wat pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga barhem jingieid nga U Trai U puta jong Wahduid ngan pynshitom ïa uba pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga .

translation.kha: U  Trai  un shah ba ki nongshun kin jop ïa phi . Phin tur pyrshah ïa ki na kawei ka dong , hynrei phin sa her ïap na kiba bun ki dong , bad ki briew ka pyrthei kin sngewsheptieng haba ki ïohi aïu ka jia ïa phi .

translation.en: And think not to say within yourselves , We have Abraham to our father : for I say unto you , that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham .
translation.kha: Bad wat leit pyrkhat ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynshitom da kaba ong ba u Abraham u long u kpa tymmen jong phi . Nga ong ha phi ba U Blei u lah ban shim ïa kine ki maw bad pynlong ki khun ki ksiew na ka bynta u Abraham !
Te , lada phim mon shuh ïa ka , phi lah ban pyllait ïa ka . Namar ba phi la pynbor ban ïathiah shongkha bad ka tyrha phim lah ban ñiew ïa ka setkut ka mraw bad die ïa ka .
translation.en: And it shall be , if thou have no delight in her , then thou shalt let her go whither she will  ; but thou shalt not sell her at all for money , thou shalt not make merchandise of her , because thou hast humbled her .

translation.kha: san Hadien , sngi u Ananias , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la sha leit Kaisaria lem bad katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san bad uwei u riewsaid aiñ uba kyrteng u Tertullos . la Ki wan ha khmat jong u Pheliks bad ki la ai ïa ki jingmudui jong ki pyrshah ïa u Paul .
translation.en: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders , and with a certain orator named Tertullus , who informed the governor against Paul .
And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders , and with a certain orator named Tertullus , who informed the governor against Paul .
translation.kha: Hadien san sngi , u Ananias , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la leit sha Kaisaria lem bad katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san bad uwei u riewsaid aiñ uba kyrteng u Tertullos . Ki la wan ha khmat jong u Pheliks bad ki la ai ïa ki jingmudui jong ki pyrshah ïa u Paul .

translation.en: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother , Come up with me into my lot , that we may fight against the Canaanites  ; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot . So Simeon went with him .

translation.kha: Baroh ki briew bad ki nongïalam jong ki ki , la ïamynjur pyllaitluid ban noh ïa la ki mraw bad ban ym pynlong mraw shuh ïa ki .
translation.en: Now when all the princes , and all the people , which had entered into the covenant , heard that every one should let his manservant , and every one his maidservant , go free , that none should serve themselves of them any more , then they obeyed , and let them go .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la pynjia ba u Hadad , na syiem u Edom ban phai pyrshah u Solomon .
translation.en: And the  Lord  stirred up an adversary unto Solomon , Hadad the Edomite : he was of the king s seed in Edom .

translation.en: And the leper in whom the plague is , his clothes shall be rent , and his head bare , and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip , and shall cry , Unclean , unclean .

And there was a great famine in Samaria : and , behold , they besieged it , until an ass s head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver , and the fourth part of a cab of dove s dung for five pieces of silver .
translation.kha: Na kane ka jingkerkut , ka jingkyrduh bam ha ka nongbah ka la long kaba jur katta katta kat haduh ba kawei ka khlieh kada ka shongdor phraphew ki sbai rupa , bad arspah gram ka eit paro    ka shongdor san sbai rupa .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki Israel .

translation.en: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob , and hath not pitied : he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah  ; he hath brought them down to the ground : he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof .
translation.kha: Baroh shi miet lynter ka ïam ; ki ummat ki tuid ha ki ngab jong ka . Na baroh ki paralok jong ka kiba mynshuwa , ym don iwei ruh iba sah ban pyntngen ïa ka . Kiba ïateh lok bad ka ki la shetkylla ïa ka bad baroh ki la long pyrshah ïa ka mynta .

translation.en: Honour all men . Love the brotherhood . Fear God . Honour the king .
translation.kha: To ñiewburom ïa baroh , to ieit ïa la ki parabangeit , to tiengburom ïa U Blei , bad ñiewburom ïa u Patsha .

translation.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz , the brother of Caleb , took it : and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife .
translation.kha: U Othniel , u khun jong u Kenas , uba shi para bad u Kaleb , u la ïohknieh ïa ka nongbah , kumta u Kaleb u ai ïa ka Akhsah ha u ban shongkurim .
Um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade da kaba leit sha jan ka metïap iahap wat byrngut ka Knidos ka jong u kpa ne ka kmie jong u .
translation.en: Neither shall he go in to any dead body , nor defile himself for his father , or for his mother  ;

translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha , Ko khun briew , to ïathuhlypa ha ka lyer . To ïathuh ha ka lyer ba Trai Nongsynshar u hukum ïa ka kan wan na baroh sawdong , ban pyrsad mynsiem ha kine ki metïap , bad ban wallam pat ha ki ka jingim .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Prophesy unto the wind , prophesy , son of man , and say to the wind , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Come from the four winds , O breath , and breathe upon these slain , that they may live .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah ki bud ïa ki hukum jong u Joshua . Kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Joshua , ki la shim khat-ar tylli haka maw napdeng jong ka Jordan , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel , ki la bah ïa ryñiot sha ka jaka ïingtrep dara , bad ki buh ïa ki hangta .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded , and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan , as the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel , and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged , and laid them down there .
I pray thee , let me go over , and see the good land that is beyond Jordan , that goodly mountain , and Lebanon .
translation.kha: Shah ïa nga , A Trai , ban jam ïa ka wah Jordan bad ïohi ïa kata ka ri kaba seisoh shatai sha shiliang , ka ri lum kaba itynnat , bad ki lum Lebanon .’
Baroh la ki sngewhun ïa u bad ki la sngewphylla ha ki kyntien basngewtynnat kiba u la kren . Ki la ong , Hato une um dei khun u jong u Joseph ?
translation.en: And all bare him witness , and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth . And they said , Is not this Joseph s son ?
And Zichri , a mighty man of Ephraim , slew Maaseiah the king s son , and Azrikam the governor of the house , and Elkanah that was next to the king .
translation.kha: Uwei u shipai Israel uba kyrteng u Sikhri , u la pynïap ïa u Maaseïah u khun jong u syiem Ahas , ïa u Asrikam u nongpynïaidkam ha ka ïingsyiem , bad ïa u Elkanah , uba ha ka kyrdan kaba ar ïa u syiem .

translation.en: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars , and commanded Judah and Jerusalem , saying , Ye shall worship before one altar , and burn incense upon it ?
translation.kha: Dei ma u uba pynjot ïa ki jaka mane bad ki duwan bad nangta u ong ïa ki paid Judah bad ïa ka Jerusalem ban mane bad thang jingiwbih tang ha kawei ka duwan .
U Trai u ong , Ki jong ka Moab ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Kim shym ïa shyieng u syiem Edom da kaba thang haduh ba kin da kylla dpei .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Moab , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime :
Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos , they came to Perga in Pamphylia : and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Paul bad ki paralok jong u ki la leit da ka lieng na Paphos , bad ki la wan poi sha Perga , ka nongbah ha Pamphylia , ha kaba u Ïoannis Markos u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Thy graven images also will I cut off , and thy standing images out of the midst of thee  ; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki bleithaw bad ki rishot maw bakyntang jong phi ; phin ym mane shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba phi hi phi la thaw .

translation.en: But not as the offence , so also is the free gift . For if through the offence of one many be dead , much more the grace of God , and the gift by grace , which is by one man , Jesus Christ , hath abounded unto many .
translation.kha: Hynrei kine ar kim long kumjuh , namar ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei kam long kum ka pop u Adam . Ka long kaba shisha ba bun ki briew ki la ïap namar ka pop jong uta uwei u briew . Hynrei ka jingaiei U Blei ka long kham khraw , bad kumta ruh ka jingai sngewbha ïa kiba bun ki briew lyngba ka jingaiei jong uta uwei u briew , U Jisu Khrist .
Ngan pynlong ka jingïathong bad phi ha ka kyrteng u patsha . Ngan ai phi ïa ar hajar tylli ki kulai lada phi lah ban shem katta ki ngut rangbah ki ban shong ha ki .
translation.en: Now therefore give pledges , I pray thee , to my master the king of Assyria , and I will give thee two thousand horses , if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them .

translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei nga jong ïa ka Truphina bad ka Truphosa , kiba trei ha ka kam U Trai bad ïa ka paralok ba-ieit jong nga , ka Persis , kaba la trei shibun ka kam na ka bynta . U Trai
translation.en: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa , who labour in the Lord . Salute the beloved Persis , which laboured much in the Lord .

translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai , U Moses u la thoh ïa ka hukum na ka jong ngi : ‘ Lada u briew u ïap bad u iehnoh ïa ka tnga khlem khun , para jong uta u briew u dei shongkurim ïa khnang ba ki lah ban ki khun ïa kiba yn ñiew ki khun jong uta u briew uba ïap .’
translation.en: Master , Moses wrote unto us , If a man s brother die , and leave his wife behind him , and leave no children , that his brother should take his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .
And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half , and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves .
translation.kha: Ki briew na baroh ki hima , ki kynja bynriew , ki jait ktien , bad ki jaitbynriew kin shu khmih ïa kita ki metïap jong ki haduh lai sngi shiteng bad kin ym shah ban tep ïa ki .

translation.en: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb .
translation.kha: Kumta hadien ba ki la mihnoh na u Lum Sinai , ki Israel kim deng jingdeng shuh .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath done that which he had devised  ; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old : he hath thrown down , and hath not pitied : and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee , he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries .
translation.kha: Nga kner ïa la ki kti , hynrei ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa nga . U  Trai  u la khot ïa ki nongshun pyrshah ïa nga na ki liang baroh ; ki la leh ïa nga kum ïa kaei kaei kaba jakhlia .

translation.en: Ask thee a sign of the  Lord  thy God  ; ask it either in the depth , or in the height above .
translation.kha: To pan na U  Trai  U Blei jong me ban ai ka dak ha me . Ka lah ban long na kaba jylliew ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap lane nang tei najrong eh jong ka bneng .
Ka shipai kynran dien noh na namar shipai Ijipt ka la wan .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh s army ,
And the tables were the work of God , and the writing was the writing of God , graven upon the tables .
translation.kha: U Blei hi u la thaw ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , bad u la thoh ruh ïa kita ki hukum ha kita ki maw .

translation.en: And of Asher he said , Let Asher be blessed with children  ; let him be acceptable to his brethren , and let him dip his foot in oil .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Asher u ong ,  U Asher u kham ïoh jingkyrkhu ban ïa la ki para jait . To ki hynmen ki para jong u kin burom eh ïa u , Bad to ka ri jong u kan dap da ki diengsoh Olib .
Ki shynrang baroh kiba la dap shi bnai lane kham heh kiba la shah ñiew ki long nongpdem ( hynriewspah ngut .
translation.en: And the hangings of the court , and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court , which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about , and their cords , and all the instruments of their service , and all that is made for them : so shall they serve .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha u Eleasar , u Joshua bad , ha kiwei pat ki jong nongïalam ki Israel :
translation.en: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel :

And it shall be , when he lieth down , that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie , and thou shalt go in , and uncover his feet , and lay thee down  ; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do .
translation.kha: Da pynthikna bha ha-ei u thiah , bad hadien ba u la ïohthiah , leit bad khyllied ïa ki jaiñ tap bad thiah ha ki kjat jong u . Un sa ïathuh ïa phi kaei ba phi dei ban leh .
Mano ba rai katno kan heh ? Mano ba ring ksai halor jong ? Hato me tip ïa ki jubab baroh ?
translation.en: Who hath laid the measures thereof , if thou knowest ? or who hath stretched the line upon it ?
And grieve not the holy Spirit of God , whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption .
translation.kha: Bad to wat pynsngewsih ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid jong U Blei ; naba U Mynsiem u long ka dak jong ka jinglong trai jong U Blei ïa phi , ka jingbahkhlieh ba ka Sngi kan poi haba U Blei un pyllaitluid ïa phi .
Ngan pynkhie da ka thma ban pynsakma ïa kylleng phi ki kylleng ri nongwei . Ka ri jong phi kan sah kynjah , bad ki shnong jong phi kin sah ha ka jingjot .
translation.en: And I will scatter you among the heathen , and will draw out a sword after you : and your land shall be desolate , and your cities waste .

And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the  Lord  , and make an atonement for it  ; and shall take of the blood of the bullock , and of the blood of the goat , and put it upon the horns of the altar round about .
translation.kha: un leit sha kata ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad un pynkhuid ïa ka . U dei ban shim khyndiat na ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw bad khyndiat na ka snam jong uta u  langsohmoh bad un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong kata ka duwan .
Ai ka jubab bieit ïa ka , bad uta uba kylli ïa ka un sngewthuh ba um long uba stad kumba u pyrkhat
translation.en: Answer a fool according to his folly , lest he be wise in his own conceit .
Which knew me from the beginning , if they would testify , that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee .
translation.kha: Ki la tip borabor , lada ki mon ban phla , ba naduh kaba nyngkong nga la im kum u dkhot jong ka seng kaba pyrkhing tam jong ka niam jong ngi , ki Pharisi .

translation.en: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter .
translation.kha: To duwai ha U Blei ba kine kiei kiei kin ym jia ha ka por tlang !

translation.en: And David did so , as the  Lord  had commanded him  ; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gezer .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , bad u la lah ban beh noh pat ïa ki Philistia naduh Geba shi lynter lynti haduh Geser .

translation.en: For by thee I have run through a troop : by my God have I leaped over a wall .
translation.kha: Me ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong nga bad ka bor ba ngan jop ïa ki jingïada jong ki .

translation.en: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred , and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity , in the time that their iniquity had an end :
translation.kha: Me la long u nongshun baïaineh ka Israel bad me shah ba ki briew jong ka kin shah pynïap ha ka por ka jingjynjar jong ka , ka por jong ka jingshah pynshitom bakhatduh namar ki pop jong ka .

translation.en: And his concubine played the whore against him , and went away from him unto her father s house to Beth–lehem–judah , and was there four whole months .
translation.kha: hynrei ka la bitar ïa u , ka leit phai pat sha ïing u kpa jong ka ha Bethlehem , bad ka sah hangta saw bnai .

translation.en: He said furthermore unto me , Son of man , seest thou what they do ? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here , that I should go far off from my sanctuary ? but turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , me ïohi ïa kaei kaba jia ? Khmih ïa kito kiei kiei kiba ijli ba ki paid Israel ki leh hangne , ban beh noh ïa nga sha jngai bad kham sha jngai na ka jaka bakhuid jong nga . Men dang ïohi shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba kham jahburom ban ïa kane .

me ynda mih nangne mynta ka sngi , men ïakynduh ar ngut ki hajan rangbah jingtep ka jong ka Rakhel ha Selsah kaba ha ka ri Benjamin . Kin ïathuh ha me ba la lap ïa kita ki kada kiba me leit wad , bad i pa jong me im shym khuslai shuh shaphang jong ki , hynrei i khuslai shaphang jong me , i da ïai kylli , ‘ Ngan leh kumno keiñ shaphang la u khun ?’
translation.en: When thou art departed from me to day , then thou shalt find two men by Rachel s sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah  ; and they will say unto thee , The asses which thou wentest to seek are found : and , lo , thy father hath left the care of the asses , and sorroweth for you , saying , What shall I do for my son ?

translation.kha: U u la shaniah ha Trai ; namar kane , U Trai u la sngewbha ïa u bad u la u .
translation.en: And he believed in the  Lord   ; and he counted it to him for righteousness .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne jngoh Esiongeber kata ka wahduid ka rngad noh namar ba ym shym la don JINGIEID .
translation.en: And it came to pass after a while , that the brook dried up , because there had been no rain in the land .

translation.kha: U Elisha u nongïathuhlypa nongpynkha ïakyrpad kem pang ngam ka jait jingpang kaba shyrkhei , bad katba u dang thiah sa ba un ïap u snoh u syiem Israel u leit jngoh ïa u .” Ko pa jong nga , pa jong nga ! dohkha pyrta da kaba ïam . Phi Jingïaleh long u nongïada bakhlaiñbor Ramah ka Israel !
translation.en: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died . And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him , and wept over his face , and said , O my father , my father , the chariot of Israel , and the horsemen thereof .
The baptism of John , whence was it ? from heaven , or of men ?  And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say unto us , Why did ye not then believe him ?
translation.kha: Nangno ka hok jong u Ïoannis ban pynbaptis ka wan : hato ka long na U Blei ne na u briew ?  Ki la sdang ban ïasaidnia para ma ki ,  Aïu ngin ïa-ong ? Lada ngi jubab ‘ Na U Blei ,’ un ong ha ngi , ‘ Balei , te , phim ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’
Wat nym pyrkhat ïa kum ? u Jonathan u jubab . nga la tip shai ba i pa i jingmut ban pynsniew ïa , hato ym ïathuh ïa ?
translation.en: And Jonathan said , Far be it from thee : for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee , then would not I tell it thee ?

translation.kha: Kumta kiba duk , kum ki khlaw ki jingbam ha ka khlaw ba-tyrkhong ; don jaka hangno hangno ban shem jingbam na ka bynta ki khun jong ki .
translation.en: Behold , as wild asses in the desert , go they forth to their work  ; rising betimes for a prey : the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children .

translation.kha: Baroh ki jait sim ïa-pyrta thaw skum ha ki tnat de u ; sma Ahab ki kha ïa la ki khun ha ki jingkah jingïohipaw u ; ki 31 ka pyrthei ki shong jahthait hapoh ka syrngiew jong u .
translation.en: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs , and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young , and under his shadow dwelt all great nations .
And Jesus saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ?  And they said , Seven , and a few little fishes .
translation.kha: Katno tylli ki kpu phi don ?  U Jisu u la kylli .  Hynñiew tylli ki kpu ,  ki la jubab ,  bad khyndiat ki dohkha rit .

translation.en: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain  ; yet he shall come to his end , and none shall help him .
translation.kha: Un pynïeng ruh ïa ki ïingjaiñ syiem kiba heh hapdeng ki duriaw bad ki lumbah ha kaba ka Templ ka ïeng . Hynrei un ïap , khlem don mano mano hangta ban ïarap ïa u .
U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la kut ban leh ïa kane u kner ïa ka kti pynshitom , don mano mano lah pynsangeh ïa u
translation.en: For the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed , and who shall disannul it ? and his hand is stretched out , and who shall turn it back ?

translation.kha: Kumta ki nong Ijipt ki thung ïa ki nongpyntrei mraw pynsaja kiba ïa ki da kaba pynbor ba kin trei ïa ki kam kiba shitom sat . Israel Ki ki tei ïa ki nongbah Pithom bad Rameses ba kin long ki jaka jingbam kynshew u Pharaoh .
translation.en: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens . And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities , Pithom and Rameses .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la ong ha nga , ‘ Maham ïa ban ym leit tur , naba ngan ym long ryngkat bad ki , ki nongshun jong ki sa jop ki .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Say unto them , Go not up , neither fight  ; for I am not among you  ; lest ye be smitten before your enemies .

And when I was present with you , and wanted , I was chargeable to no man : for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied : and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you , and so will I keep myself .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka por ba nga la don bad phi , ngam shym la pynkhuslai ïa phi ban ïarap haba nga la donkam pisa ; ki parabangeit kiba la wan na Makedonia ki la wanrah sha nga ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la donkam . Kum ha kaba mynshuwa , kumta ruh ha ka lawei : Da lei lei ngan ym bankhia ïa phi !
Ko khun u briew , to kumba ka dohnud jong me la pait ha jingjynjar To ud da ka jingsngewsih ha kaba kin khmih ïa me .
translation.en: Sigh therefore , thou son of man , with the breaking of thy loins  ; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes .

translation.kha: U Trai Baroh Badonbor u ong , ‘ Nga wallam ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang ha ki , bad ngan pynlong ki ïa kum ki soh Dumbur kiba la pyut eh ïa ban ka bam .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will send upon them the sword , the famine , and the pestilence , and will make them like vile figs , that cannot be eaten , they are so evil .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang u Jakob kiba leit ryngkat bad u sha , lem bad la ki ba-ha-ïing long
translation.en: Now these are the names of the children of Israel , which came into Egypt  ; every man and his household came with Jacob .
And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines , and unto the border of Egypt : they brought presents , and served Solomon all the days of his life .
translation.kha: Ka hima u Solomon ka kynthup ïa baroh ki ri naduh ka wah Ïuphratis haduh ka ri ki Philistia bad ka pud Ijipt . Ki la siew khajna ïa u bad ki la hap hapoh jong u katba u dang im .
