translation.en: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things .

And it shall come to pass afterward , that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh  ; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy , your old men shall dream dreams , your young men shall see visions :
translation.kha: Hadien ngan sa theh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha uwei pa uwei : Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga ; ki tymmen shynrang kin don ki jingphohsniew , bad ki samla shynrang jong phi kin ïohi ki jingïohipaw .

Ka don sa kawei ka thma ki , bad u Jair u jong u Elhanan u pynïap ïa u Lahmi , uba shi para bad u na Gath , uba u jong , u don u dieng thung sum uba ka jingrben jong u ka long kat u khung jong u nongthain jaiñ .
translation.en: And there was war again with the Philistines  ; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite , whose spear staff was like a weaver s beam .

translation.kha: kaba Ha bud ïa ka hukum jong U Trai , u nongïathuhlypa u kren pynrem ïa duwan ka : Ko duwan , duwan ! Kane long ka kaba U Trai u ong , ‘ U khunlung ïa uba yn khot kyrteng u Josaïah , sa yn kha ha ka longïing jong u Dabid . Un sa pynïap ha pha ïa ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ha ki jaka mane blei thala , un bad thang ïa shyieng ki briew halor jong pha .’
translation.en: And he cried against the altar in the word of the  Lord  , and said , O altar , altar , thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , a child shall be born unto the house of David , Josiah by name  ; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee , and men s bones shall be burnt upon thee .
It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness : for the throne is established by righteousness .
translation.kha: Ki syiem kim lah shah ïa ka jingsniew , namar ka jingbishar hok ka dei kaba pynlong ïa ka jingsynshar kaba khlaiñ .
Ki la phah Merari sha kylleng Gallio Jerusalem bad ka Judah ïa baroh ban wallam sha U Trai ïa ka khajna ba u Moses , u shakri U Blei , u babud ba-pnah nyngkong pyndiaw pynper ri khlaw .
translation.en: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem , to bring in to the  Lord  the collection that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong Ka , nongbah Jerusalem ka rkhie ïa me , ko Sennakherib , bad ka kyntait beiñ ïa me .
translation.en: This is the word that the  Lord  hath spoken concerning him  ; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee , and laughed thee to scorn  ; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee .

translation.kha: uba ha khappud ka hima Edom . U Trai u ha u Moses u Aaron ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor , by the coast of the land of Edom , saying ,

translation.kha: Haggith Trai U Blei ki Israel ïa-pasiaw balei kane ka la jia ? Balei nongbylla ka Abiram Benjamin kan sa jah noh na Israel ?
translation.en: And said , O  Lord  God of Israel , why is this come to pass in Israel , that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel ?
The rich and poor meet together : the  Lord  is the maker of them all .
translation.kha: Kiba riewspah bad kiba duk ki don ïa kane kajuh , U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki baroh ar .

translation.en: God is my strength and power : and he maketh my way perfect .
translation.kha: Une U Blei u long ka jakarieh baskhem jong nga , bad u pynshngain ïa ka lynti ïaid jong nga .
Ki leh kumba ki jingmong jong ki briew jong nga ki tang ki jingtrud . ‘ ka bit ka ki ong , haba baroh bit kam biang .
translation.en: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , Peace , peace  ; when there is no peace .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u don dang ha Jerusalem ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , shibun la ki ngeit ha u haba ki la ïohi ïa ki kambah kiba u la leh .
translation.en: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover , in the feast day , many believed in his name , when they saw the miracles which he did .

translation.kha: Ki maji la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap , uwei pa uwei sha la u jong blei . , khnang ban pynduna jingma , ki bret noh ïa ka jingkit nalor lieng . Ha ka por , u Jonah u la hiar sha ka bynta bashapoh , u thiah ha trai lieng , ïohthiah lyngngai .
translation.en: Then the mariners were afraid , and cried every man unto his god , and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea , to lighten it of them . But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship  ; and he lay , and was fast asleep .

translation.kha: kumta u la khot khat jingpynjahburom ïabiang bad u la ong shatei ‘ Kaei kane kaba nga ïohsngew shaphang Sur me dohksah To syngkhlieh 26 nga ïa rmiang jingkheiñ kaba pura sla ka jingpynïaid Abijah me ïa jingstad kyndiah jingem jong sla , namar Hobah ym Jeshua jingkitkhlieh ban long u sordar jong nga .’
translation.en: And he called him , and said unto him , How is it that I hear this of thee ? give an account of thy stewardship  ; for thou mayest be no longer steward .

translation.kha: Trai u la ong ha u , u jong u , leit bad ong ha u Dabid nga ai ha u lai tylli ki jingjied . Ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba jied . step kaba bud , hadien ba u Dabid u la khie thiah ,
translation.en: Go and say unto David , Thus saith the  Lord  , I offer thee three things  ; choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee .
And he answered and said unto him , Master , all these have I observed from my youth .
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  uta u briew u la ong ,  naduh ba nga dang khynnah , nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh .
Phi hi phi la long ju mynno mynno ha ka jingdum , hynrei namar phi la long ki briew jong Trai U , phi long ha ka jingshai . Kumta phi dei ban im ki kum briew kiba don ha ka jingshai ,
translation.en: For ye were sometimes darkness , but now are ye light in the Lord : walk as children of light :

translation.kha: kumta u la leit sha u Lum Salmon bad la . Hangta u u , pom kawei ka tnat u dieng , bad u bah ka ha la ka tyrpeng U ong ïa la ki rangbah ban pynkloi bad ban leh kumjuh .
translation.en: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon , he and all the people that were with him  ; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand , and cut down a bough from the trees , and took it , and laid it on his shoulder , and said unto the people that were with him , What ye have seen me do , make haste , and do as I have done .

translation.kha: Lehbha ïa lade bad wad jinghikai kat phi kaba lah ; nangta kynmaw ïa kaei kaba phi ïoh jinghikai bad phin manbha .
translation.en: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul : he that keepeth understanding shall find good .
Rejoice over her , thou heaven , and ye holy apostles and prophets  ; for God hath avenged you on her .
translation.kha: To shadkmen , ko ka bneng , namar ka jingpynjot ïa ka ! to shadkmen , ko ki briew jong U Blei bad ki apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa ! Naba U Blei u la pynrem ïa ka na ka bynta kaei kaba ka la leh ïa phi !
Haba ki Philistia ki la phet , ki la shadien iehnoh ïa ki bleithaw jong ki , bad u Dabid ki bad rangbah jong u ki la rah noh ïa ki .
translation.en: And there they left their images , and David and his men burned them .
The  Lord  shall reign for ever , even thy God , O Zion , unto all generations . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem junom . U Blei jong pha , ko Seïon , un synshar baroh shi rta . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: Mine eye trickleth down , and ceaseth not , without any intermission ,
translation.kha: Ki ummat jong nga kin mih kum ki wahduid ba ïai tuid .
Ngan pynïapher ïa ki jingri jong ki Israel na ki jong ki Ijipt nong , bad kumta yn ym don wat kawei ruh ka jingri ki Israel ka ïap ban noh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt : and there shall nothing die of all that is the children s of Israel .

translation.kha: pynkyiuh ba phi khot ïa nga ïasoh ‘ A Trai shin A bapyllun ,’ bad pynban phim leh ïingkyntang kaei kaba nga ong ha phi jingkit
translation.en: And why call ye me , Lord , Lord , and do not the things which I say ?
Then said they all , Art thou then the Son of God ? And he said unto them ,  Ye say that I am .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ong ,  Hato ma me , te , me long U Khun U Blei ?  U la jubab ïa ki ,  Phi ong ba nga long .

translation.en: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten , and thou shalt gather it to thee  ; and it shall be for food for thee , and for them .
translation.kha: Shim ruh ïa baroh ki jait jingbam kiba donkam na ka bynta jong me bad na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom : but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised .
translation.kha: Lada phi long kiba shemphang , phin ïoh jingïaroh ; lada phi long kiba mutlop , ki briew kin peitbeiñ ïa phi .
Hadien ar u snem ïap noh
translation.en: And Asa slept with his fathers , and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U u la ong ha u : Ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin shong ha ri nongwei , ha kin ki mraw bad kin shah lehbeiñ haduh snem
translation.en: And God spake on this wise , That his seed should sojourn in a strange land  ; and that they should bring them into bondage , and entreat them evil four hundred years .

translation.kha: Haba map dei leh kumne . Uwei pa uwei uba ram la u Israel ban map ïa kata ka ram ; um ban ïa ka , namar ba U hi u la ïa ka
translation.en: And this is the manner of the release : Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it  ; he shall not exact it of his neighbour , or of his brother  ; because it is called the  Lord s  release .

translation.kha: Buh dak sawdong uta ne lum pyllut ba ki briew wah dei ban jam palat , bad ong ïa ki ba kin ym leit kiew sha u lum , lane bran ban leit tur sha jan jong u . phria uno uno u leit ïuhkjat ha u lum , yn pynïap ïa u ;
translation.en: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about , saying , Take heed to yourselves , that ye go not up into the mount , or touch the border of it : whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death :

translation.kha: Haba phi ïohi ba ki sla jong ksiar , ki la sdang khajna mih , phi tip ba pynbynta Seresh Iskariot la jan .
translation.en: When they now shoot forth , ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand .

translation.kha: Nangta u Elisha u peit shlip ïa u da ka jingpeit kaba ishyrkhei ïa khar khmat jong u haduh jinglum u Hasael u la kem sympat . Kynsan u Elisha u jaw ki ummat brup .
translation.en: And he settled his countenance stedfastly , until he was ashamed : and the man of God wept .

translation.kha: Ong ha ki ba Israel kin wallam ha nga ïa jingainguh ki . Pdiang ïa kino kino ki jingainguh kat kiba uno uno u mon ban ai .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , that they bring me an offering : of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering .

translation.kha: U Jisu la ong ïa kane bad nangta u pynbud , jong ngi u Lasaros u la ïohthiah , hynrei ngan leit bad ngan kyrsiew ïa u .
translation.en: These things said he : and after that he saith unto them ,  Our friend Lazarus sleepeth  ; but I go , that I may awake him out of sleep .
Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  will surely deliver us : this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Bad wat ai ïa u ban pynngeit ïa phi ban shaniah ha U  Trai . Wat pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait ïa phi bad ba un pynsangeh ïa ki shipai Assyria na kaba knieh noh ïa ka nongbah jong phi .

translation.en: I will break also the bar of Damascus , and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven , and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden : and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ki khyrdop nongbah ka Damaskos , bad ngan weng ïa ki nongshong shnong jong ka Them Aben , bad ïa u nongsynshar ka Betheden . Ki briew ka Syria kin shah ring kum ki koidi sha ri Kir .

translation.en: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon , and for all that came unto king Solomon s table , every man in his month : they lacked nothing .
translation.kha: Ki khat-ar ngut ki lat jong u , uwei uwei ha u bnai ba la buh ïa u , ki pynbiang ka jingbam ïa u Syiem Solomon kaba u donkam ïa lade bad ïa baroh kiba bam ha ka ïingsyiem ; ki ju ïai pynbiang ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba donkam .

translation.en: And he searched , and began at the eldest , and left at the youngest : and the cup was found in Benjamin s sack .
translation.kha: U shakri jong u Joseph u la wad bniah da kaba sdang na uba nyngkong ter ter haduh uba khatduh , bad ïa ka khuri la shem ha ka byrni jong u Benjamin .

translation.en: That the slayer might flee thither , which should kill his neighbour unawares , and hated him not in times past  ; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live :
translation.kha: sha kiba u briew u lah ban phet rieh bad lait im lada jia ba u kum pynïap ïa uno uno u briew u bym dei u nongshun jong u . U lah ban phet rieh sha kawei na kine ki shnong bad un ym shah pynïap .
ha para jingthiah rangbah lyngdoh jingïakajia ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki la Tei Lied jingmudui kop ïa u Paul .
translation.en: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul , and besought him ,

translation.kha: Namar kata , ka jait Lebi kam shym ïoh bynta ïa Hesron katjuh ka jaka Nahaliel kiwei pat ki jait ; kumba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la kular . )
translation.en: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren  ; the  Lord  is his inheritance , according as the  Lord  thy God promised him .
Jesus saith unto him ,  Thomas , because thou hast seen me , thou hast believed : blessed are they that have not seen , and yet have believed .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Hato me ngeit namar ba me ïohi ïa nga ? Katno ki kmen kito kiba ngeit khlem da ïohi ïa nga !

translation.en: The  Lord  hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob , Surely I will never forget any of their works .
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la smai ,  Ngan ym klet lano lano ïa ki kam sniew jong ki .

translation.en: Reward her even as she rewarded you , and double unto her double according to her works : in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double .
translation.kha: Leh ïa ka thik kumba ka la leh ïa phi ; siew kylliang ar shah ïa ka na ka bynta baroh kaba ka la leh . Pyndap ïa ka khuri jong ka da ka jingdih kaba ar shah ka jingkhor kum ka jingdih kaba ka la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi .
ki ba-bang , ki iar-ryngkuh kiba ïaid pyn-at shadem , bad u syiem sanphew khmat arsien briew jong u .
translation.en: A greyhound  ; an he goat also  ; and a king , against whom there is no rising up .
And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant , and to the blood of sprinkling , that speaketh better things than that of Abel .
translation.kha: Phi la wan sha U Jisu , uba la pynlong ïa ka jutang bathymmai , bad sha ka snam ba la synreit , kaba kular bun kiei kiei kiba kham bha ban ïa ka snam u Abel .

translation.en: Let no man deceive you by any means : for that day shall not come , except there come a falling away first , and that man of sin be revealed , the son of perdition ;
translation.kha: Wat shah ïano ïano ban shukor ïa phi ha kano kano ka rukom . Naba ka Sngi kan ym wan tad ynda ka Jingïaleh pyrshah ka jia bad ba uta Uba Sniew u mihpaw ïa uba la buh lypa na ka bynta ka dujok .

Pynmih ïa u shabar ka jaka shong dara . Uno uno briew uba la ïohsngew ïa u ba u tim u tla un sakhi ïa kata da u buh ïa ki kti ka khlieh jong u , bad nangta u paidbah baroh un lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un ïap .
translation.en: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp  ; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head , and let all the congregation stone him .
Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body , and the fruit of thy ground , and the fruit of thy cattle , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ba phin roi kyrhai ha ki khun ki kti , ba ki jingthung jong phi kin seisoh shibun , bad ba ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi kin nang bun .

translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication , and maintain their cause .
translation.kha: to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki . To sngap ïa ki na bneng bad to ai ha ki ïa ka jingjop .
Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid artat , u ïohi ïa u briew uba la kha matlah .
translation.en: And as Jesus passed by , he saw a man which was blind from his birth .
And the  Lord  commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments , that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban hikai ïa phi ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba phi dei ban sumar bad leh ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .

translation.en: This second epistle , beloved , I now write unto you  ; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance :
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , kane mynta ka long ka shithi kaba ar ba nga thoh sha phi . Ha baroh ar tylli ki shithi nga la pyrshang ban pynkhih ïa ki jingpyrkhat bakhuid ha ki jingmut jong phi da kaba pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa kine kiei kiei .
ai ba baroh kiba la thaw ki bad kiba shaniah kin long kum bleithaw ba ki la shna !
translation.en: They that make them are like unto them : so is every one that trusteth in them .

translation.kha: Hangne karta narud Lum Seïon , U Trai Badonbor Jentil un pynkhreh ka jingkhawai bah na ka bynta ki Pynjah baroh Eldad ka Rakhel — ka jingkhawai bah da ki jingbam bakyrhai eh bad ka waiñ bakynsai tam .
translation.en: And in this mountain shall the  Lord  of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things , a feast of wines on the lees , of fat things full of marrow , of wines on the lees well refined .

translation.kha: U pynim wat ïa kiba la ïap .
translation.en: He even raised the dead .
And all the princes , and the mighty men , and all the sons likewise of king David , submitted themselves unto Solomon the king .
translation.kha: Baroh ki rangbah synshar bad ki shipai , bad wat kiwei pat ki khun shynrang baroh jong u Dabid ki kular ban kohnguh ïa u Solomon kum u syiem .
Kim pat lah hi ban ngeit , ki la shlei da ka jingkmen bad ka jingphylla ; kumta u la ïa ki kylli , Phi don ei ei hangne ban bam ?
translation.en: And while they yet believed not for joy , and wondered , he said unto them ,  Have ye here any meat ?
Now therefore beware , I pray thee , and drink not wine nor strong drink , and eat not any unclean thing :
translation.kha: Sumar ban ym dih waiñ lane dih kyiad , lane bam ïa kano kano ka bymkhuid ;

translation.en: If thou seekest her as silver , and searchest for her as for hid treasures  ;
translation.kha: Wad ïa ka kumba phi wad ïa ka rupa lane ïa kano kano ka spah ba la buhrieh .
Moses u ha u Nga shu poi shabar kane , duwai ha U Trai . U pyrthat un sangeh , bad u phria un ym hap , ba phin ïoh tip ba pyrthei ka long ka jong U Trai .
translation.en: And Moses said unto him , As soon as I am gone out of the city , I will spread abroad my hands unto the  Lord   ; and the thunder shall cease , neither shall there be any more hail  ; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the  Lord s .

translation.kha: lamler! bha’ u la jubab , Kane ka Melea Shamgar namar ki briew jong nga ki la iehnoh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga kaba nga la ai ha Abiathar . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga Habakkuk leh Shebuel kaei Nibshan nga la India ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  saith , Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them , and have not obeyed my voice , neither walked therein  ;
And in that day it shall come to pass , that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin , and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka sngi ka wan ha kaba ka jingkhraw jong ka Israel kan poi sha kaba kut , bad ïa ka spah jong ka yn bujli da ka jingduk .

translation.en: And said unto them , Ye men of Israel , take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men .
translation.kha: bad nangta u la ong ha ka Dorbar ,  Ko para Israel , da sumar ïa kaei kaba phi leh ïa kine ki briew .
Da kaba bud Karkor ki nuksa u mawkyrdon tiduh u , u leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai Mahalab
translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father Amaziah had done  ;
Whether any do enquire of Titus , he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you : or our brethren be enquired of , they are the messengers of the churches , and the glory of Christ .
translation.kha: Hato don ba kylli shaphang u Titos , u long u nongïatrei lang bad nga ban ïarap ïa phi ; bad shaphang kiwei pat ki parabangeit kiba ïaleit lang bad u , ki mihkhmat ïa ki balang bad ki wallam ka burom ïa U Khrist .
Nga la bat ïa ka khuri jong u syiem ; kumta nga la shim ïa kita ki sohwaiñ nga bad khem ki ïa ha kata ka khuri , bad nga la ai ïa ka ha u .
translation.en: And Pharaoh s cup was in my hand : and I took the grapes , and pressed them into Pharaoh s cup , and I gave the cup into Pharaoh s hand .
And when thy days be fulfilled , and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers , I will set up thy seed after thee , which shall proceed out of thy bowels , and I will establish his kingdom .
translation.kha: Ynda me ïap , bad la tep ïa me bad ki kpa tymmen jong me , ngan thung syiem ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ka hima jong u .

translation.en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought , and mocked him , and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe , and sent him again to Pilate .
translation.kha: U Herod bad ki shipai jong u ki la krenbeiñ ïa U Jisu bad kim ñiewburom ïa u ; nangta ki la buh ka jaiñkup ba-itynnat halor jong u bad u la phah pat ïa u sha u Pilat .
bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ulla dei u Arah u Hanniel , bad u Risia
translation.en: And the sons of Ulla  ; Arah , and Haniel , and Rezia .

And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine , he said unto Abner , the captain of the host , Abner , whose son is this youth ? And Abner said , As thy soul liveth , O king , I cannot tell .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u ïohi ïa u Dabid ba u leit ban ïaleh bad u Goliath , u kylli ïa u Abner , u rangbah shipai jong u ,  Abner , u dei u khun jongno mo ?   Ngam don jingtip , syiem Kynrad ,  u Abner u jubab .

translation.en: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there  ; for that was the great high place : a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka khep u la leit sha Gibeon ban ai jingkñia namar kata kaba don hangta ka long ka duwan kaba donnam tam . U la ai da ki spah tylli ki jingainguh thang hangta ha ka por ba la leit .
Ki briew kiba mutlop borabor pyrkhat ki ba ki leh ïa kaba dei . Ki briew kiba stad ki shahshkor ïa ki jingpyn-i lem .
translation.en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes : but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise .
As for us , our eyes as yet failed for our vain help : in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us .
translation.kha: Ngi la khmih tad haduh ba ngim lah shuh ban khmih ïa ka jingïarap ka bym ju wan . Ngi la ïai ap ïa ka jingïarap na ka hima ka bym don ei ei ban ai .

U ong ha u baroh paidbah , Une u maw un long u sakhi ïa ngi . U la ïa ïohsngew ki ktien baroh ba U Trai la u kren ha ngi . Kumta long un u sakhi pyrshah ïa phi , ban da ïa phi na kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto all the people , Behold , this stone shall be a witness unto us  ; for it hath heard all the words of the  Lord  which he spake unto us : it shall be therefore a witness unto you , lest ye deny your God .

translation.kha: tip Ngi ba ngi la iehnoh ïa ka jingïap bad ngi la wan noh sha ka jingim ; ngi tip ïa ka namar ba ngi ieit ïa ki la hynmen ki para . Uno uno u bym ieit , u dang don hi hapoh ka bor jong ka . jingïap
translation.en: We know that we have passed from death unto life , because we love the brethren . He that loveth not his brother abideth in death .
The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it : in the holy place shall it be eaten , in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh uba kñia ïa uta u mrad un bam ïa u ha ka jaka bakhuid , ha ka phyllaw jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .
Un Tabrimmon ïa kawei na kita ki nongleh-ieit halor u khiew Ner ha uba don ka um kaba sngur na ka umpohliew .
translation.en: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water :

translation.kha: Hagar Ka ka kylli ïa lade , Hato nga da ïohi U shisha ïa Blei bad ba nga dang im ban ïathuh ïa kata ? Kumta ka la khot ïa ka kyrteng U Trai uba la kren ha ka , U Blei uba ïohi .
translation.en: And she called the name of the  Lord  that spake unto her , Thou God seest me : for she said , Have I also here looked after him that seeth me ?

translation.kha: kyrduh ki maji ki seraph pyrshang ban phet na ka lieng ; ki la jingïasaid ïa ka lieng rit sha ka nongsiatkhnam Pop ki la jingpyndait ïar kumba ki mut ban buh sa katto katne ki angkor ha ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka lieng .
translation.en: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship , when they had let down the boat into the sea , under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Lot u la leit sha rangbah kiba la ki khun kynthei jong u , u ong , To pynkloi bad mihnoh nangne ; naba Trai sa pynjot thiaw ïa kane jaka . Hynrei ki pyrkhat ba u shu kren .
translation.en: And Lot went out , and spake unto his sons in law , which married his daughters , and said , Up , get you out of this place  ; for the  Lord  will destroy this city . But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law .

translation.kha: ki la kyntait ïa ka ri kaba itynnat , namar ba kim ïa ka jingkular U Blei
translation.en: Yea , they despised the pleasant land , they believed not his word :

translation.kha: Ai ba kito kiba namarkata bynrap ki ri bajngai kin ai ka jingïaroh bad ka burom ïa otsher Trai Sippor
translation.en: Let them give glory unto the  Lord  , and declare his praise in the islands .
Then said Jesus unto his disciples ,  If any man will come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross , and follow me .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  Lada uno uno u kwah ban wan bad nga , u dei ban klet ïa lade , ban bah ïa la ka diengphna , bad bud ïa nga .

translation.en: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil , and pour it into the palm of his own left hand :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un shim ruh khyndiat ka umphniang Olib bad un theh ïa ka ha la ka sla ti kadiang ,

translation.en: Others said , That it is Elias . And others said , That it is a prophet , or as one of the prophets .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat , ki la ong ,  U dei u Elijah .  Kiwei ki ong ,  U dei u Nong ïathuhlypa , kum uwei na ki Nongïathuhlypa jong ki por ba-mynshuwa .
Pyrkhat ïa sngi ki kiba mynbarim , ïa ka por ba leit la noh , kylli na la ki kpa ban ïathuh ha phi aïu ka jia la , kylli na ki tymmen ban ïathuh ha phi ïa ka mynnor .
translation.en: Remember the days of old , consider the years of many generations : ask thy father , and he will shew thee  ; thy elders , and they will tell thee .

And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities , between blood and blood , between law and commandment , statutes and judgments , ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the  Lord  , and so wrath come upon you , and upon your brethren : this do , and ye shall not trespass .
translation.kha: Haba ki para nongshong shnong na kino kino ki nongbah ki wallam ha khmat jong phi ïa ka kam pynïap briew ne kano kano ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ ne ka hukum , phi dei ban bthah bha ïa ki kumno ba ki dei ban leh donakor ïa lade ha ka por jong ka jingbishar , khnang ba kin ym leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Lada phim leh kumta , ma phi bad ki para nongshong shnong jong phi , kin sngew ïa ka bor jong ka jingbitar U  Trai . Hynrei lada phi leh ïa la ka kamram , phin long kiba la ksan .

translation.en: And Moses sware on that day , saying , Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance , and thy children s for ever , because thou hast wholly followed the  Lord  my God .
translation.kha: Namar ba nga la leh kumta , u Moses u la kular ïa nga ba ki khun ki kti jong nga bad ma nga , ngin ïohpdiang da kaba thikna kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi ïa kata ka ri kaba nga la ïuhkjat .
Te kumta kohnguh ba ngin kan don ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jong ngi . Ngin shong ngin sah hapdeng jong phi , bad ngin ïalong kawei ka jaitbynriew bad phi .
translation.en: Then will we give our daughters unto you , and we will take your daughters to us , and we will dwell with you , and we will become one people .

translation.kha: ‘ Buh ïa ka jaijai ! Ngan ter ïa me ha ka jaka ba la wah ïa me , ka ri Mikhmash kaba la kha ïa me .
translation.en: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath ? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created , in the land of thy nativity .

And Elijah the Tishbite , who was of the inhabitants of Gilead , said unto Ahab , As the  Lord  God of Israel liveth , before whom I stand , there shall not be dew nor rain these years , but according to my word .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa uba kyrteng u Elijah , uba na Tishbe kaba ha Gilead , u la ong ha u Syiem Ahab ,  Ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , U Blei uba im jong ki Israel , ïa uba nga shakri , nga ong ha phi ba ha ki ar ne lai snem kiba bud yn ym don ka umjer lane u slap tad haduh ba ngan ong kumta .

translation.en: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers , uncircumcised in heart , and uncircumcised in flesh , to be in my sanctuary , to pollute it , even my house , when ye offer my bread , the fat and the blood , and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations .
translation.kha: Ki la pyntngit ïa ka Templ jong nga da kaba shah ïa ki nongwei bym shym la otsher , ki briew ki bymkohnguh ïa nga ban rung sha ka Templ katba ïa ka khleiñ bad ka snam jong ki jingkñia la dang ainguh ha nga . Kumta ki briew jong nga ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong nga da baroh kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh .

translation.en: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house , neither enter therein , to take any thing out of his house :
translation.kha: U briew uba don halor ka tnum jong ka ïing jong u , um dei ban pynlut por da kaba hiar shapoh ka ïing ban shim ei ei ban rah bad u .
U Jisu u la ong ha u , Mynta ka jingpynim ka la wan ha kane ka ïing , naba une u briew , ruh , u dei uba hiarpateng jong u Abraham .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  This day is salvation come to this house , forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham .
A friend loveth at all times , and a brother is born for adversity .
translation.kha: Ki paralok borabor ki pynpaw ïa ka jingieit jong ki . Ki hynmen ki para ki dei na ka bynta kaei lada kim ïarap lem ha por jingjynjar ?

translation.en: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew : when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased , the palmerworm devoured them : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa ka lyer khluit ban pyntyrkhong ïa ki jingthung jong phi . Ki puit ki la bam duh ïa baroh ki kper bad bri sohwaiñ jong phi , ki dieng Dumbur bad ki dieng Olib jong phi . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .
U Trai u hukum ïa Moses u
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time , Thou shalt not kill  ; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong ïa ki briew ha ka por mynbarim , ‘ Wat pynïap briew ; ïa uno uno uba leh kumta yn wallam sha ka jingbishar .’
Kham hadien , nga phah ïa u Moses bad u , bad nga la wallam ka jingjynjar bakhraw halor Ijipt .
translation.en: I sent Moses also and Aaron , and I plagued Egypt , according to that which I did among them : and afterward I brought you out .

translation.kha: la thoh , Suk , pha ka kynthei kaba ! To risa bad kyang da ka jingkmen , pha ka bym ju ïohmad ïa ki jong ka jingsuh ! Naba kynthei kaba la shah iehnoh kan ïoh kham bun ki khun ban ka kynthei kaba u tnga um ju ïa ka .
translation.en: For it is written , Rejoice , thou barren that bearest not ; break forth and cry , thou that travailest not : for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband .

translation.kha: Un buh ïa la ka kti ka jong ka bad un pynïap ïa ka ka phang kaba shatei jong ka duwan , ha jaka ba ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta jingkñia thang .
translation.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering , and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering .

translation.kha: Ki met jong ngi kin kylla sha u pui pui khyndew , bad ka jingpyrsad ka jingim kan leit phai pat sha U Blei , uba la ai ïa ka ha ngi .
translation.en: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was : and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it .
Neither hath oppressed any , hath not withholden the pledge , neither hath spoiled by violence , but hath given his bread to the hungry , and hath covered the naked with a garment ,
translation.kha: lane banbeiñ ïano ïano lane lute ïano ïano . U pynphai ïa kaei kaba u nongshim ram u ai ha u kum ka bynda . U bsa ïa kiba thngan bad u ai jaiñ ïa kiba lyngkhuit .
Kata ka briew ka leit sha u syiem , ka dem ngon haduh ha khyndew ka jingñiewburom bad ka ong , Ïarap ïa nga ko , Syiem Kynrad !
translation.en: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king , she fell on her face to the ground , and did obeisance , and said , Help , O king .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong mynnor U dei U Messaïah ! Hynrei kiwei ki la ong , U Messaïah un ym wan na rai ?
translation.en: Others said , This is the Christ . But some said , Shall Christ come out of Galilee ?

translation.kha: wallam Ki ïa ka jingtieng bad jingpyntriem , bad ha ka jingsarong jong ki , ki shim ïa ka aiñ ha lade .
translation.en: They are terrible and dreadful : their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves .

And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven : and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn , and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory .
translation.kha: Nangta ka dak U Khun U Briew kan paw ha ka sahit bneng , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin ïam haba ki ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew ba u wan ha ki lyoh bneng ha ka bor bad ka burom bakhraw .

translation.en: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man , but the end thereof are the ways of death .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long ka lynti kaba dei ka lah ban ïalam sha ka jingïap .

Ka jingthmu jong ki ka long ban ba pynshisha ka jingngeit phi jong ka long kaba sngur . Wat ïa ka ksiar , ïa kaba lah ban pynduh , la phrang da ka ding ; bad kumta ïa ka jingngeit phi jong , kaba kham kordor shuh shuh ban ïa ka ksiar , dei ruh ban phrang , khnang ba kan lah ban shah . Te phin sa ïa ïohpdiang ka jingïaroh bad ka burom bad ka jingpyndonburom ha ka Sngi haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .
translation.en: That the trial of your faith , being much more precious than of gold that perisheth , though it be tried with fire , might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ :
And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord , A pair of turtledoves , or two young pigeons .
translation.kha: Ki la leit ruh ban ai jingkñia da shi jur ki lyngdkhur lane ar tylli ki khun paro , kumba la dawa da ka aiñ jong U Trai .

translation.en: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables , when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ , but were eyewitnesses of his majesty .
translation.kha: Ngim shym la shaniah ha ki jingïathuhkhana ba shu thaw ha kaba ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingwan ha ka bor jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi . Da la ki khmat jong ngi hi ngi la ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .
Hynrei wat mynta , donburom thai Trai , Kir da ?’ Aben siar sha nga Khyndiat Gennesaret jingshah jingit bymmyntoi’ ka jingïam bad ka jingïambriew Tei
translation.en: Therefore also now , saith the  Lord  , turn ye even to me with all your heart , and with fasting , and with weeping , and with mourning :

Thou , O king , hast made a decree , that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , shall fall down and worship the golden image :
translation.kha: U Syiem Kynrad u la pynmih ka hukum ba tang mar ïasdang ka jingput jingtem , uwei pa uwei u dei ban dem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar ,
Ka Jingthoh basawdong ka ong ba U Messaïah un long jingkyrsiew hiarpateng na u Syiem Dabid bad yn kha ïa u Ahab Tehsong , ka shait ha kaba u khrawburom u la im rwai
translation.en: Hath not the scripture said , That Christ cometh of the seed of David , and out of the town of Bethlehem , where David was ?

translation.kha: Nga da lade hi nga la pynkhih ïa u Syros ban leh ban pyndep ïa ka jingthmu bakhadduh nga bad buh beit ïa kiei kiei . Ngan pynbeit ïa ka lynti Neng ba u leit . Un tei biang ïa ka nongbah jong 111 , ka Jerusalem , balamler un pyllait ïa ki briew ba shah set Kareah jong nga . Ym Linos ba la shim wai ïa u khep ba la pynbam klop ïa u ban leh ïa kane . U Jingshisha Badonbor Baroh u la kren .
translation.en: I have raised him up in righteousness , and I will direct all his ways : he shall build my city , and he shall let go my captives , not for price nor reward , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance , and hath called all the sons of the king , and Abiathar the priest , and Joab the captain of the host : but Solomon thy servant hath he not called .
translation.kha: U la ai ka jingkñia da shibun ki masi , ki langbrot , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid , bad u la khot sngewbha ruh sha ka jingkhawai ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi , ïa u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad ïa u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong phi , hynrei ïa u Solomon u khun jong phi um shym la khot .
Haba ïa une u jingim pynpaw la ïohi ïa u ; kumta ngi kren shaphang u bad ngi ïathuh ïa phi shaphang ka jingim bymjukut kaba la don bad U Kpa bad ba pynithuh ngi .
translation.en: ( For the life was manifested , and we have seen it , and bear witness , and shew unto you that eternal life , which was with the Father , and was manifested unto us  ; )

translation.kha: Kumta u shakri buh ïa kata ka jingbam ha khmat jong ki , , kumba Trai u la ong , baroh ki la bam bad dang don kaba sah tam .
translation.en: So he set it before them , and they did eat , and left thereof , according to the word of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki kulai thma kim lah ban ai jingjop ; ka kam lah pyllait im .
translation.en: An horse is a vain thing for safety : neither shall he deliver any by his great strength .

translation.kha: U Joash u syiem ka Judah u shim lut baroh ïa ki jingai ba kiba ha shuwa jong u , u Jehoshaphat , u Jehoram , bad u Ahasaïah ki la sha pynkyntang U Trai u , kynthup lang ïa ki jingai jong u bad ka ksiar baroh kaba ha ki ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ bad ka ïingsyiem , bad u phah kita ïa baroh kum ka jingai sngewbha sha u syiem Hasael , uba noh ïalam ïa ka kynhun jong shipai u na Jerusalem .
translation.en: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat , and Jehoram , and Ahaziah , his fathers , kings of Judah , had dedicated , and his own hallowed things , and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and in the king s house , and sent it to Hazael king of Syria : and he went away from Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ka namar ki pop phi ba um shym ïa phi . Ka dei ki pop jong phi pynïakhlad ïa na U Blei haba phi pyrshang ban ïa u
translation.en: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God , and your sins have hid his face from you , that he will not hear .

translation.kha: Lehse nga u da nang ban kren , hynrei da kaba sngewthikna ym ha ka jingtip ; ngi la pynshai ïa kane ha phi man la ka por bad ha ki jingshem baroh .
translation.en: But though I be rude in speech , yet not in knowledge ; but we have been thoroughly made manifest among you in all things .

translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ym don uno uno napdeng ki khun U jingseisoh uba ïai leh pop , naba U Heldai Duwai Blei u sumar ïa u , bad — Basniew um lah ban apple ïa u .
translation.en: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not  ; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself , and that wicked one toucheth him not .
And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness , both small and great : so that they wearied themselves to find the door .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la shoh pynmatlah ïa kita ki shynrang baroh kiba don habar khnang ba kin ym shem ïa ka jingkhang .

Kaba kham ka shuwa kyrteng ka Oholah ( ka mih pli ïa ka Samaria ) , bad hadien kaba ka kyrteng ka Oholibah ( ka mih pli ïa Jerusalem ka ) . Nga shongkurim ïa ki baroh ar ngut , bad ki kha ïa ki khun ïa nga .
translation.en: And the names of them were Aholah the elder , and Aholibah her sister : and they were mine , and they bare sons and daughters . Thus were their names  ; Samaria is Aholah , and Jerusalem Aholibah .
So David reigned over all Israel , and executed judgment and justice among all his people .
translation.kha: U Dabid u synshar ha baroh ka Israel bad u pynthikna ba ïa ki briew jong u yn lehbha bad lehhok borabor .
U Absalom u ong , Mynta khot ïa u Hushai , bad to ngin sngap aïu u don ban . ong
translation.en: Then said Absalom , Call now Hushai the Archite also , and let us hear likewise what he saith .

translation.kha: Mar pyrsa kren ïa kine ki ktien donnam ka khyndew Bam kaba u Dathan bad Priskila bakwah ki ïeng ka la kad Adrammelekh
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he had made an end of speaking all these words , that the ground clave asunder that was under them :

translation.kha: Katto katne ki rangbah nongpynïaidkam ka bad shipai kim shym la pyndem . Ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la lah pynlong u Gedalaïah u ri bad ba la buh ïa u ban ïa kito baroh bym shym ïalam sha Babilonia — ki kiba duk ha ka .
translation.en: Now when all the captains of the forces which were in the fields , even they and their men , heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land , and had committed unto him men , and women , and children , and of the poor of the land , of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon  ;
And charged the messenger , saying , When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king ,
translation.kha: bad u bthah ïa u nonglamktien ,  Hadien ba phi la ïathuh ha u syiem ïa baroh shaphang ka thma ,

Hynrei ym don kano kano ka ka bymkhuid ban ïohrung sha ka nongbah , lymne uno uno uba leh ïa kino kino kiba sngewlehrain lane uba ïathuh lamler . Tang kito ïa kiba ki kyrteng jong ki la thoh ka ha kiba im kitab jong U Khunlangbrot kin ïohrung sha kata ka nongbah .
translation.en: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth , neither whatsoever worketh abomination , or maketh a lie : but they which are written in the Lamb s book of life .
And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab : which said , We will not come up :
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u phah khot ïa u Dathan bad u Abiram , hynrei ki ong ,  Ngim wan !

translation.en: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon , to hear his wisdom , that God had put in his heart .
translation.kha: Baroh ki wad jingtip na u ban sngap ïa ka jingstad ba U Blei u la ai ha u .
Hynrei hynriewspah ngut na ki , ki lait bad ki phet ïap ikhyllah ri khlaw sha u Mawsiang Rimmon pynhap bad ki sah hangta saw bnai .
translation.en: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon , and abode in the rock Rimmon four months .

translation.kha: u duriaw ha Nisan Gehasi , Kylli ïa ka kaei kaba nga lah ban leh na ka kup jong ka ban riewrunar kylliang na ka bynta ki jinglehshitom baroh ha kaba pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ngi . Lehse kan kotbah ba jingdiah leit sha u syiem lane sha u rangbah ai hukum Bar ka kynhun shipai bad ban pynïakren na thymmei bynta jong ka . Nga don hangne pyntreikam kaba nga donkam hapdeng ki briew bthuh nga , Sirion jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto him , Say now unto her , Behold , thou hast been careful for us with all this care  ; what is to be done for thee ? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king , or to the captain of the host ? And she answered , I dwell among mine own people .

And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh–gilead , which had stolen them from the street of Beth–shan , where the Philistines had hanged them , when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa :
translation.kha: u leit shim ïa ki shyieng jong u Saul bad jong u Jonathan , u khun jong u na ki briew ka Jabesh ha Gilead . ( Ki la tuh ïa ki na ka jaka paidbah ha Beth Shan , ha kaba ki Philistia ki la sdien ïa ki met jong ki ha ka sngi ba ki la pynïap ïa u Saul halor u Lum Gilboa . )
Ngan pynïap ïa u nongsynshar ka Moab bad ïa nongïalam ki baroh jong ka ri .
translation.en: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof , and will slay all the princes thereof with him , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta ha ïabet ba u Dabid u don hajan jong ki , u leh Pung kum u bieit bad leh kum ïa-lorni lamwir haba ki pyrshang ban khang ïa u ; u da pruid ha ki khyrdop ka nongbah bad u ailad ïa ka umbiah jingisynei jaw ha lyndang ñiuhtmoh jong u .
translation.en: And he changed his behaviour before them , and feigned himself mad in their hands , and scrabbled on the doors of the gate , and let his spittle fall down upon his beard .
I have overthrown some of you , as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah , and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga la pynjot katto katne na phi kumba nga la pynjot ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah . Kito na phi kiba la lait im ki long kum ka dieng barhem ba la sei na ka ding . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga ,  ong U  Trai .

Hynrei , da kaba kylla long ka jingtim na ka bynta jong ngi , U u Khrist la siewspah ïa ngi na ka jingtim kaba ka Hukum ka wanrah ; naba ka Jingthoh ka Bakhuid ong , Uno uno la uba shah sdien ha u un dieng don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei .
translation.en: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law , being made a curse for us : for it is written , Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree :

translation.kha: long kaba shisha u Akhan jubab , nga la pyrshah ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , bad kane ka long kaei ba nga leh .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah kum u syiem ka Israel , u Jotham u khun jong u Ussaïah u long u syiem ka Judah

Nga sngewhun ha sianti jingtlot , ki jingkrenbeiñ , ki jingjynjar , ki jingshah pynshitom , bad ki Pynrhem batbit ka bynta U nonghiarthma . ïarung haba Perasim tlot , dei hangta jingpynpra nga khlaiñ .
translation.en: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities , in reproaches , in necessities , in persecutions , in distresses for Christ s sake : for when I am weak , then am I strong .

translation.kha: La pynsleh bad la pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ,
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old , all that enter into the host , to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.en: That which dieth of itself , or is torn with beasts , he shall not eat to defile himself therewith : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la pynrngad ïa ka um jong ka na ka jong phi ba phin da la jam shiliang , kumba u la pynrngad ïa Duriaw Basaw na ka jong ngi
translation.en: For the  Lord  your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you , until ye were passed over , as the  Lord  your God did to the Red sea , which he dried up from before us , until we were gone over :

translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi te , ba , uno uno u briew uba pyllait noh ïa la tnga ka na kano kano ka daw , lait noh na ka jingbymïaineh jong ka , u klim lada u shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew .
translation.en: And I say unto you , Whosoever shall put away his wife , except it be for fornication , and shall marry another , committeth adultery : and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery .
For they considered not the miracle of the loaves : for their heart was hardened .
translation.kha: namar kim pat shym la sngewthuh ïa ka jingmut bashisha jong ka jingbsa ïa ki san hajar ngut ; ki jingmut jong ki kim lah ban ïohkem ïa kata .

translation.en: Huram said moreover , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , that made heaven and earth , who hath given to David the king a wise son , endued with prudence and understanding , that might build an house for the  Lord  , and an house for his kingdom .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , u Nongthaw ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew ! U la ai ha u syiem Dabid , ïa u khun uba stad , uba dap da ka jingshemphang bad ka jingtbit , uba mynta u thmu ban tei ka Templ na ka bynta U  Trai  bad ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: ( Genesis 1 :31 ) If they had obeyed God , they would have produced perfect children , and the earth would have become a global paradise , where people would live forever in peace and happiness .
translation.kha: ( Jenesis 1 :31 ) Lada kila kohnguh ia U Blei , kin jin da la kha ia ki khun ki bajanai , bad ka pyrthei baroh kan jin da la long ka paradais , ha kaba ki briew kin ioh im haka jingkmen bad jingsuk junom .

translation.en: For what is our hope , or joy , or crown of rejoicing ? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming ?
translation.kha: Nalor baroh , dei ma phi — ma phi keiñ , khlem duna ïa kiwei pat ! — kiba long ka jingkyrmen jong ngi , ka jingkmen jong ngi , bad ka daw jong ngi ban sngewsarong ïa ka jingjop jong ngi ha khmat jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi haba u wan .
kiba sbun , bad phin manbha . ïa kiwei , yn ïa phi .
translation.en: The liberal soul shall be made fat : and he that watereth shall be watered also himself .
I know , and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus , that there is nothing unclean of itself : but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean , to him it is unclean .
translation.kha: Ka jingïasoh jong nga bad U Trai Jisu ka pynlong thikna ïa nga ba ym don ka jingbam ha ka hi , kaba long bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam ; hynrei lada u briew u ngeit ba katto katne ka jingbam ka long ka bymkhuid , te ka long bymkhuid ïa u .

translation.en: Flee also youthful lusts : but follow righteousness , faith , charity , peace , with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart .
translation.kha: To kiar noh na ki jingkwah brai ka jinglong samla , bad ïaleh tyngeh na ka bynta ka hok , ka jingngeit , ka jingieit , bad ka jingsuk , lem bad kito kiba da ka dohnud basngur ki khot kyrpad ïa U Trai na ka bynta ka jingïarap .
Kumta khie leit phai noh sha ïing da kaba , suk bad wat leh ei ei kaba pynsngewsih ïa ki .
translation.en: Wherefore now return , and go in peace , that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines .

translation.kha: U Trai u Nongsynshar ong , Ko Israel , la slem bah me la kyntait ïa ka iktiar jong nga ; me la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa bad nga mane ïa nga . Ha uwei pa uwei u lum bakynjang bad hapoh uwei pa uwei dieng u bajyrngam me la mane ïa ki ka blei jingkharoi .
translation.en: For of old time I have broken thy yoke , and burst thy bands  ; and thou saidst , I will not transgress  ; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest , playing the harlot .

translation.kha: Uwei pa na phi ki shynrang u dei ban tip kumno ban ïashong ïasah bad ka tnga ha rukom kaba bad kaba donburom ,
translation.en: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour ;

translation.en: And in the synagogue there was a man , which had a spirit of an unclean devil , and cried out with a loud voice ,
But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry , by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant , which was established upon better promises .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ha U Jisu u la ai ïa ka kam lyngdoh kaba kham halor ban ïa ka jong ki , kumba ka jutang ïa kaba u la pynbeit hapdeng U Blei bad la ki briew ka long kaba kham bha , namar la seng nongrim ïa ka ha ki jingkular ïa kiei kiei kiba kham bha .

Hato dei na kata ba phi baroh phi tnaw ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga ? Ym don pynlong ruh na phi uba la ïathuh ha nga ba u khun jong nga hi u la ïateh * bad u Dabid . ther don uwei ruh uba pyrkhat sngewlem ïa nga lane ïathuh ha nga ba u Dabid , uwei na ki rangbah jong nga , u don hangne mynta , u da wad ïa ka kabu bakhlem pynïap ïa nga , bad ba u khun jong nga u sa pynshlur ïa u !
translation.en: That all of you have conspired against me , and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse , and there is none of you that is sorry for me , or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me , to lie in wait , as at this day ?
For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it , and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed , receiveth blessing from God :
translation.kha: U Blei u kyrkhu ïa ka khyndew kaba kjit noh ïa u slap uba hap bunsien ha ka bad kaba pynmih ïa ki jingthung kiba ai jingmyntoi na ka bynta kita kiba rep ha ka .
Haba nga Isynei ïa Akkub shakri , um jubab — wat la jingma kyrpad riewshemphang u Adaïah jingmareh ïa nga .
translation.en: I called my servant , and he gave me no answer  ; I entreated him with my mouth .

translation.kha: Kumno Tel jingijli ban ong ba phi ainong kiba stad , bad ba phi tip Beria Wai aiñ jong Synrap Nob Ha puid , ïa ki aiñ la pynkylla da ki nongthoh bymhok .
translation.en: How do ye say , We are wise , and the law of the  Lord  is with us ? Lo , certainly in vain made he it  ; the pen of the scribes is in vain .
And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay , they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men : but they shall not cleave one to another , even as iron is not mixed with clay .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ruh ba ïa ka nar la khleh bad ka dewbyrtha . Kane ka mut ba ki nongsynshar jong kata ka hima kin pyrshang ban pynïatylli ïa ki longïing jong ki da ka jingïashongkha khleh , hynrei kin ym lah , kumba ka nar kam lah ban ïakhleh bad ka dewbyrtha .

translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all . Amen .
translation.kha: To ka jingaiei jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai kan long lem bad phi baroh .

Haba me shim jingkheiñ ïa ka jingdon ki paid Israel , uwei uwei pa u briew u dei ban siew nga ïa ïa ka dor na ka bynta la ka jingim , khnang ba kano kano sniew kaba kan ym wan ha u katba dang shim jingkheiñ .
translation.en: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number , then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the  Lord  , when thou numberest them  ; that there be no plague among them , when thou numberest them .

translation.kha: U buh ïa ka jingbam baroh ha ki kti u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong , bad ki ai ïa kine kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha Trai .
translation.en: And he put all upon Aaron s hands , and upon his sons  hands , and waved them for a wave offering before the  Lord .

translation.kha: long ka jingnguh ïa Blei! Naba wat mynshuwa haba phi long mraw jong ka , phi la kohnguh da ka dohnud baroh ïa ki jingshisha la shem ha ka jinghikai kaba phi la .
translation.en: But God be thanked , that ye were the servants of sin , but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you .

translation.kha: katba ngi dang ap ka ïa jingwan jong kata ka Sngi ba la kyrkhu kaba ngi ap kyrmen , haba ka burom U Blei bakhraw bad U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim jong kan ngi paw .
translation.en: Looking for that blessed hope , and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Trai , nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei ba me la leh , bad nga la da ka jingtiengburom . Mynta to leh biang ha por jong ngi ïa ki kam bakhraw kiba me ju leh . To leh-isynei , wat haba bitar .
translation.en: O  Lord  , I have heard thy speech , and was afraid : O  Lord  , revive thy work in the midst of the years , in the midst of the years make known  ; in wrath remember mercy .

translation.kha: Baroh ki jingjia ha ka jingsynshar u Asa kaba nyngkong haduh kaba kut la buh jingthoh Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Bad Ka Israel .
translation.en: And , behold , the acts of Asa , first and last , lo , they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la shem ïa u kada bad u la shong halor jong u , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,
translation.en: And Jesus , when he had found a young ass , sat thereon  ; as it is written ,
And when the sixth hour was come , there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour .
translation.kha: Ha ka por shiteng sngi , ïa ka ri baroh kawei la tap da ka jingdum , kaba neh lai kynta .

Namarkata rynghang namar ba nga long U Blei uba im khlaiñ jingjulor ka long ka ktien U Trai Nongsynshar jingñiewburom namar pha la Shah ïa ka Templ Akasia nga da kiei kiei neh basniew , ki Ïoanna Knidos kiba Phah la leh , rasong kyntait ïa pha khlem isynei .
translation.en: Wherefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God   ; Surely , because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things , and with all thine abominations , therefore will I also diminish thee  ; neither shall mine eye spare , neither will I have any pity .
Then shall I not be ashamed , when I have respect unto all thy commandments .
translation.kha: Lada nga pynshahshkor ïa ki hukum jong me baroh , te yn ym buh ïa nga ha ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: For mine enemies speak against me  ; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together ,
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong nga ki kwah ban pynïap ïa nga ; ki ïakren bad sylla pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites , nor the Maachathites : but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day .
translation.kha: Pynban , ki Israel kim shym beh noh ïa ki briew jong ka Geshur bad Maakah ; ki dang shong ha Israel .

translation.en: And he killed it  ; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about .
translation.kha: U Moses u pynïap ïa u , bad u theh ïa ka snam ha baroh sawdong jong ka duwan .

translation.en: By faith Moses , when he was born , was hid three months of his parents , because they saw he was a proper child  ; and they were not afraid of the king s commandment .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa ki kmie ki kpa u Moses ban buhrieh ïa u lai bnai hadien ba la kha ïa u . Ki la ïohi ba u la long u khunlung uba bhabriew , bad kim shym la sheptieng ban pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum u Pharaoh .
Hynrei kim shemphang ka ïa jingjubab jong u .
translation.en: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them .

translation.kha: Hynrei to tiengburom ïa U Khrist ha ki jong dohnud phi , bad pyndonburom ïa u kum Trai U . To long kiba la kloi ha ki por baroh ai ban ka jubab ïa uno uno uba kylli ïa phi ban batai ïa ka jingkyrmen kaba don ha phi ,
translation.en: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts : and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear :

translation.kha: Nga don kajuh ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei kaba kine hi ki jyntang nongpyntrei kata , ba ki briew baroh , kiba jingkular bad kiba sniew jingkyntait kin mihpat na Urbanos jingïap .
translation.en: And have hope toward God , which they themselves also allow , that there shall be a resurrection of the dead , both of the just and unjust .
The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia .
translation.kha: U langbrot uba me ïohi uba la don ar tylli ki reng u ïeng na ka bynta ki hima jong ka Media bad Persia .

translation.en: Nevertheless I must walk to day , and to morrow , and the day following : for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Pynban nga dei ban don ha ka lynti jong nga mynta ka sngi , la shai , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ; kam long kaba dei ba ïa u nongïathuhlypa yn pynïap hangno hangno lait tang ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah : for thus saith the king of Assyria , Make an agreement with me by a present , and come out to me , and then eat ye every man of his own vine , and every one of his fig tree , and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern :
translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa u Hesekaïah . U patsha ka Assyria u hukum ïa phi ban mihnoh na ka nongbah bad ban pyndem wait . Yn shah ïa phi ba phin bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki dieng sohwaiñ , bad ïa ki soh Dumbur na ki dieng ki jong phi hi , bad ban dih um na ki pukri jong phi hi —

translation.en: And David sat between the two gates : and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall , and lifted up his eyes , and looked , and behold a man running alone .
translation.kha: U Dabid u dang shong ha ka jaka hapdeng ka khyrdop kaba shabar bad ka khyrdop kaba shapoh jong ka nongbah . U nongap phira u kiew shajrong kynroh bad u ïeng halor ka tnum jong ka khyrdop ; u peit sha khmat bad u ïohi ïa u briew uba mareh marwei .

translation.en: That they all may be one  ; as thou , Father , art in me , and I in thee , that they also may be one in us : that the world may believe that thou hast sent me .
translation.kha: Nga duwai ba ki baroh kin ïalong kawei . Ko Pa ! To ai ba kin ïalong ha ngi , kumba me long ha nga bad ma nga ha me . To ai ba kin ïalong kawei , khnang ba ka pyrthei kan ngeit ba me la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: And there shall ye remember your ways , and all your doings , wherein ye have been defiled  ; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed .
translation.kha: Te phin kynmaw ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba jahburom kiba phi la leh bad kumno phi la pyntngit ïa lade . Phin sa isih ïa lade namar kiei kiei kiba sniew baroh kiba phi la leh .
Hynrei kumba u bat la ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong phi ha , kumta ruh un pyndep ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingbyrngem .
translation.en: Therefore it shall come to pass , that as all good things are come upon you , which the  Lord  your God promised you  ; so shall the  Lord  bring upon you all evil things , until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the  Lord  your God hath given you .

translation.kha: U pyrta sha tbian bad ïathuh ha u syiem bad U syiem ong , Lada u don marwei , u wanrah ka khubor Uta u nang jan nang jan .
translation.en: And the watchman cried , and told the king . And the king said , If he be alone , there is tidings in his mouth . And he came apace , and drew near .
And David perceived that the  Lord  had established him king over Israel , and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel s sake .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u Dabid u sngewthuh ba U  Trai  u la pynskhem ïa u kum u syiem ki Israel bad u la kyntiew ïa ka hima jong u na ka bynta ki briew jong u .

Lada u kpa jong u um hynmen don ne para shynrang lane ki kñi , u kur uba ïajan eh u bad un ïohpateng ïa ka , bad un bat ïa ka kum la ka jong ka nongkynti . Ki Israel ki dei ban kohnguh ïa kane ka aiñ kumba nga , U Trai , nga la hukum ïa me .
translation.en: And if his father have no brethren , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family , and he shall possess it : and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
And another of his disciples said unto him , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u briew , uba la long u synran , u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , shah shuwa ïa nga ba ngan leit phai bad tep ïa i pa jong nga .

translation.en: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful  ; and the end of that mirth is heaviness .
translation.kha: Ka jingrkhie ka lah ban buhrieh ïa ka jingkhuslai . Haba ka jingkmen ka la jah , ka jingsngewsih ka dang ïai don hangta .
Ar ne lai ngut kiba ïa ka khubor U Blei dei ban kren , katba kiwei pat kin bishar ïa kaba ki kren .
translation.en: Let the prophets speak two or three , and let the other judge .
Pilate said unto them , Ye have a watch : go your way , make it as sure as ye can .
translation.kha: To ïalam ïa ki nongap phira ,  u Pilat u la ong ïa ki ,  Khie leit bad to pynskhem ïa ka jingtep kat kaba phi lah .
Ki la lah jop kam kynti ïa ka ri kaba sha jong ka Jordan , naduh ka Them Arnon haduh ka Them bad shaduh u Lum Hermon ha ka phang bashatei Ki la jop ïa ki ar ki syiem .
translation.en: Now these are the kings of the land , which the children of Israel smote , and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun , from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon , and all the plain on the east :
For the  Lord  shall judge his people , and repent himself for his servants , when he seeth that their power is gone , and there is none shut up , or left .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa la ki briew haba u ïohi ba kim donbor shuh . Un isynei ïa kito kiba shakri ïa u haba u ïohi ba kim lah leh ei ei shuh .
Ki briew hok ki kren ïa ka jingstad hynrei ïa u uba kren yn pynsangeh .
translation.en: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom : but the froward tongue shall be cut out .

translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la khuslai shikatdei ki la ong ha u bad ha kiwei pat apostol , Kaei kaba ngin , ko ?
translation.en: Now when they heard this , they were pricked in their heart , and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles , Men and brethren , what shall we do ?

And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house , and over all that he had , that the  Lord  blessed the Egyptian s house for Joseph s sake  ; and the blessing of the  Lord  was upon all that he had in the house , and in the field .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por , namar jong u Joseph , U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ka longïing longsem jong u nong Ijipt , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u don ha ïing ka sem jong u lane ha lyngkha jong u .
Nga la wallam ïa me na kiba kut ka pyrthei ; nga khot ïa me pud bajngai jong ka bad nga la ong ‘ me long u shakri nga ,’ ngam shym la kyntait ïa me hynrei nga la jied ïa me .
translation.en: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth , and called thee from the chief men thereof , and said unto thee , Thou art my servant  ; I have chosen thee , and not cast thee away .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba u syiem jong ka ding un Hato ïaleh ïa ka Gasa , U Trai u Shimshai kren ha nga shaphang ka Philistia .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines , before that Pharaoh smote Gaza .
And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh , all the cities with their villages .
translation.kha: lem bad katto katne ki nongbah bad ki nongrit kiba don hapoh ki pud sawdong jong ka Manasseh , hynrei kiba la ai ha ki Ephraim .
Kim lah sngewthuh balei ba ki la shahjop kim lah shemphang ïa kaba jia .
translation.en: O that they were wise , that they understood this , that they would consider their latter end !
He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person .
translation.kha: Lada phi thmu sniew borabor , phin sa ïoh nam kum u nongthaw kulmar .
Un im ïohi ïa ki wah ka umphniang Olib lane ïa ki wahduid kiba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .
translation.en: He shall not see the rivers , the floods , the brooks of honey and butter .

translation.kha: U Kain bad la ka tnga ki la ïoh khun shynrang bad ki kyrteng la ïa u , U Enokh . Nangta u Kain u la tei ka nongbah bad u la ïa kyrteng ka ha ka u kyrteng khun jong u .
translation.en: And Cain knew his wife  ; and she conceived , and bare Enoch : and he builded a city , and called the name of the city , after the name of his son , Enoch .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba nga ong , Ngan klet noh ïa pynsaphriang Trai bad ngan ym kren shuh ha ka kyrteng jong u , te Pomkranet khubor jong me ka long kum ka shuki liewlong klang Shong hapoh jong nga . Nga la pyrshang kat kaba nga lah Eglaim kun ïa Regemmelekh , hynrei ngam lah Tigris bat ïa ka jingkynthih
translation.en: Then I said , I will not make mention of him , nor speak any more in his name . But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones , and I was weary with forbearing , and I could not stay .

And it came to pass , when God caused me to wander from my father s house , that I said unto her , This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me  ; at every place whither we shall come , say of me , He is my brother .
translation.kha: Kumta haba U Blei u la phah noh ïa nga na ka ïing u kpa jong nga sha ki ri nongwei , nga ong ha ka , ‘ Pha lah ban pyn-i haduh katno pha shaniah ïa nga da kaba ïathuh ïa iwei pa iwei ba nga long u hynmen jong pha .’
Hynrei leh-isynei Trai u la sngewbha eh ïa u Noah .
translation.en: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , wat lada u u lah ban im tang iwei i khun bad ar blang ,
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that a man shall nourish a young cow , and two sheep  ;

translation.kha: ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad u , Abraham ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong bad u Isaak .

translation.en: And as Josiah turned himself , he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount , and sent , and took the bones out of the sepulchres , and burned them upon the altar , and polluted it , according to the word of the  Lord  which the man of God proclaimed , who proclaimed these words .

translation.en: And if a stranger sojourn with you , or whosoever be among you in your generations , and will offer an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; as ye do , so he shall do .

translation.en: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid  ; they shall prevail against him , as a king ready to the battle .

translation.en: And it was so , that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the  Lord  , he arose from before the altar of the  Lord  , from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven .
