translation.en: Be astonished , O ye heavens , at this , and be horribly afraid , be ye very desolate , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka miet ba U u Trai ap miet ban ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Ïa kane kajuh ka miet la pynkyntang sha U Trai pateng pateng la kum miet ka ha kaba ki Israel ki dei ban ap miet .
translation.en: It is a night to be much observed unto the  Lord  for bringing them out from the land of Egypt : this is that night of the  Lord  to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Une u long u shakri jong nga , uba pynshaitbor — Uta uba nga la jied , ha u shem sngewbha . Nga la pyndap ïa u da U Mynsiem jong nga , bad un wallam jingbishar hok ha man la ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Behold my servant , whom I uphold  ; mine elect , in whom my soul delighteth  ; I have put my spirit upon him : he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles .
For thou hast said , My doctrine is pure , and I am clean in thine eyes .
translation.kha: Me kam ba kaei kaba me ong ka long kaba shisha ; me kam ba me long uba sngur ha ki khmat U Blei .
U Trai phah ïa ka jaitbynriew kaba kut ka pyrthei pyrshah ïa , ka jaitbynriew kaba ka ktien ka jong phin ym . Kin wan hiar kynsan ha phi kumba u pukni .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall bring a nation against thee from far , from the end of the earth , as swift as the eagle flieth  ; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand  ;
The lips of those that rose up against me , and their device against me all the day .
translation.kha: Baroh shi sngi ki ïakren shaphang jong nga bad ki thaw ki jingthmu jong ki .

translation.en: Say unto them , As truly as I live , saith the  Lord  , as ye have spoken in mine ears , so will I do to you :
translation.kha: Mynta , ai ha ki ïa kane ka jubab : ‘ Nga smai ba kumba nga long uba im , ngan leh kumba phi la pan . Nga U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: That they sent and called him . And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came , and spake unto Rehoboam , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki paidbah na ki jait ba na shatei ki phah khot ïa u , bad nangta ma ki baroh ki ïaleit lang sha u Rehoboam bad ki ong ha u ,

translation.en: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan , and the border thereof . This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families , the cities and the villages thereof .
translation.kha: Ka Jordan ka dei ka pud bashaphang sepngi jong ka jait Reuben . Kine ki long ki nongbah bad ki nongrit kiba la ai ha ki longïing jong ka jait Reuben kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka khyndew ha kaba phim shym la trei bad ïa ki nongbah riewbieit phim shym la tei . Mynta phi shong phi sah hangta bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki dieng sohwaiñ Ha-ei phim shym Ismakhaïah , bad ki soh Olib na Sillah dieng Sdang phim shym thung .’
translation.en: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour , and cities which ye built not , and ye dwell in them  ; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat .
I have remembered thy name , O  Lord  , in the night , and have kept thy law .
translation.kha: Mynmiet nga kynmaw ïa me , A  Trai  , bad nga pyrkhat shaphang ka aiñ jong me .
Phin ym long uba jop jingshalan ka prut lada phi pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa la ki pop . Phla ïa ki bad iehnoh ïa ki ; Heh U Blei lyer pyn-i Shimrith jingisynei ïa phi .
translation.en: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper : but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy .

translation.kha: Nangta u khun shaphang shatei sha Enshemesh bad nangta pat sha Geliloth , marpyrshah ïa ka Hasiel Adummim . Nangta u hiar arsut turoi u Maw jong u Bohan peiphang u pukri Sibboleth Akhbor u halor jong u Reuben Dang ,
translation.en: And was drawn from the north , and went forth to En–shemesh , and went forth toward Geliloth , which is over against the going up of Adummim , and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben ,

translation.kha: Nangta u pud u suh sha lum u shaphang shatei jong Ekron ka , u phai sha ka Shikkeron , lyngba u Lum Baalah , bad ter ter sha Jamnia . U kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian ,
translation.en: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward : and the border was drawn to Shicron , and passed along to mount Baalah , and went out unto Jabneel  ; and the goings out of the border were at the sea .

translation.kha: Ka Goliath jong phi pynrung nong ha ksem kaba phi ong bad kaei Assyria phi pep ; phin Jahath ïa kaei kaba phi dei hok .
translation.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth : and the recompence of a man s hands shall be rendered unto him .

translation.kha: Kumta , nga ong ïa phi , ba phin ban rung shapoh Hima ki bneng tang phi ïaineh skhem kham palat ban ïa ki nonghikai Aiñ bad ki Pharisi ha kaba leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa .
translation.en: For I say unto you , That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees , ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven .

And it came to pass on the morrow , that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul , and he prophesied in the midst of the house : and David played with his hand , as at other times : and there was a javelin in Saul s hand .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u mynsiem bymman na U Blei kynsan kynsan u ïoh tylli ïa u Saul , bad u pynkulmar ha ïing la kum uba lamwir . U Dabid u dang tem ïa ka duitara , kumba u ju leh man ka sngi , bad u Saul u bat ïa la u sum .
Ka ka la poi . Ka sngi ka la jan , ha kaba ka ïathied kan don jingmut shuh , namar ka jingpynshitom U Blei kan hap ha baroh kumjuh .
translation.en: The time is come , the day draweth near : let not the buyer rejoice , nor the seller mourn : for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof .

translation.kha: Kynsan ka kynhun pynkhriat - ki angel ka bneng , ka la mihpaw lem bad u angel , ki da rwai ki sngewrit ïa U Blei :
translation.en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God , and saying ,

translation.kha: Lada phan jin da la tip mynta ïa kaei kaba donkam na ka bynta ka jingsuk ! mynta pham lah ban ïohi ka !
translation.en: Saying ,  If thou hadst known , even thou , at least in this thy day , the things which belong unto thy peace ! but now they are hid from thine eyes .
And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold , of beaten work shalt thou make them , in the two ends of the mercy seat .
translation.kha: Thaw ar tylli ki kherub da ka ksiar kaba la shoh tylli ,
Bad u ruh , Ko khun u briew , ngan sa pynduna bam ka Jerusalem . Ki hangto kin da sa jynjar bad sngewkhuslai namar ba ki hap ban da thew ïa ka jingbam ki bam bad ïa ka um ba dih .
translation.en: Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , behold , I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem : and they shall eat bread by weight , and with care  ; and they shall drink water by measure , and with astonishment :
They grope in the dark without light , and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man .
translation.kha: ki tare ha ka jingdum bad ïaid sheng sheng kum ki nongbuaid .
Katto katne na kiba hiarpateng na me hi kin shah noh ïalam bad kin long ki ïunukh ban shakri ha ka ïingsyiem u jong syiem ka Babilonia .
translation.en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee , which thou shalt beget , shall they take away  ; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .

translation.kha: don ka jingsawa na sahit bneng kaba sawa kum ka ka lyer bajur bad ka la pyndap ïa baroh kawei ha kaba la ïashong .
translation.en: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind , and it filled all the house where they were sitting .

translation.kha: Khmih sawdong jong pha bad peit kaei kaba riewhadem : Ki briew jong pha kin ïalumlang ban wan Bered sha ïing ; Aïah Bosenai shynrang jong pha kin wan na sha jngai thab , bad ïa ki khun kynthei jong pha “ shu dewmet Anath ïa jingtyllun khunlung .
translation.en: Lift up thine eyes round about , and see : all they gather themselves together , they come to thee : thy sons shall come from far , and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side .

translation.kha: Nalor kata , ki hato wah Abana bad Pharpar kiba Damaskos ha kim kham bha ban ïa kano kano ka wah ha Israel ? nga lah ban sum ha ki bad ban ïohkhiah !
translation.en: Are not Abana and Pharpar , rivers of Damascus , better than all the waters of Israel ? may I not wash in them , and be clean ? So he turned and went away in a rage .
And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah , I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans , lest they deliver me into their hand , and they mock me .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem u la jubab ,  Nga sheptieng ïa la ki para ri kiba la phet bad ïasoh bad ki nong Babilonia . Ka lah ban long ba ïa nga yn aiti noh sha ki bad kin pynshitom sat ïa nga .

translation.en: And Judah said unto Israel his father , Send the lad with me , and we will arise and go  ; that we may live , and not die , both we , and thou , and also our little ones .
translation.kha: U Judah u ong ha la u kpa ,  Phah ïa u para bad nga , bad ngin ïamihnoh kumne kumne . Te yn ym don uwei ruh na ngi u ban ïapthngan .

translation.en: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah–jireh : as it is said to this day , In the mount of the  Lord  it shall be seen .
translation.kha: U Abraham u khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka  U  Trai  U Pynbiang .  Bad haduh kane ka sngi ruh , ki briew ki dang ong ,  Ha u lum jong U  Trai  u pynbiang .

translation.en: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead , if the dead rise not at all ? why are they then baptized for the dead ?
translation.kha: Mynta , aïu kan long ïa kito ki briew kiba la pynbaptis na ka bynta kiba ïap ? Aïu ki kyrmen ban pyndep ? Lada ka long kaba shisha , kumba don kiba kam , ba ïa kiba ïap yn ym pynmihpat , balei ïa kito ki briew la pynbaptis na ka bynta kiba ïap ?

translation.en: And all Israel shall hear , and fear , and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you .
translation.kha: Te ki Israel baroh kin sa ïohsngew aïu ka la jia , bad kin sheptieng ; bad yn ym don shuh mano mano u ban leh kum ïa kata ka kam bymman .

U Jisu u la leit jngoh kylleng ki nongbah bad nongrit ki . U la hikai ha ki synagog , la u ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima bad , u la pynkhiah ïa ki briew kiba don ki jingpang babun jait bad ki jingshitom .
translation.en: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages , teaching in their synagogues , and preaching the gospel of the kingdom , and healing every sickness and every disease among the people .
And as they spake unto the people , the priests , and the captain of the temple , and the Sadducees , came upon them ,
translation.kha: U Petros bad u Ïoannis ki dang kren ha ki paidbah mynba katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh , u rangbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa ki nongap phira ka Templ , bad katto katne ngut ki Saddusi ki la wan poi .
Ïa U Khun la pynlong uba khraw kham ban ïa ki angel , ka kumba kyrteng kaba U Blei u la ai ha u ka long kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka jong ki .
translation.en: Being made so much better than the angels , as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they .

translation.kha: Ha baroh kawei ka ri jong ka Hima bashatei u pynpra ïa ki duwan bad ki durblei jong ka Asherah , pynlwet u ïa ki bleithaw kum ki pui pui bad , pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa baroh ki duwan jingiwbih Nangta . u leit phai sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves , and had beaten the graven images into powder , and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel , he returned to Jerusalem .
And Saul said unto Michal , Why hast thou deceived me so , and sent away mine enemy , that he is escaped ? And Michal answered Saul , He said unto me , Let me go  ; why should I kill thee ?
translation.kha: U Saul u kylli ïa ka Mikhal ,  Balei pha shet shukor ïa nga kumne bad shah ïa u nongshun jong nga ban lait phet ?  Ka jubab ,  U byrngem ban pynïap ïa nga lymda nga ïarap ïa u ban lait phet .
Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong ïa ki briew ha ka por mynbarim , ‘ Wat pynïap briew ; ïa uno uno leh uba kumta yn sha wallam ka jingbishar .’
translation.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time , Thou shalt not kill  ; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment :
And ye will not come to me , that ye might have life .
translation.kha: Pynban phim mon ban wan sha nga khnang ba phin ïoh ïa ka jingim .
U Trai u ai ki ïa kane ka jubab , Ki Ijipt , ki Amor , ki Ammon , ki Philistia
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto the children of Israel , Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians , and from the Amorites , from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines ?
Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews , and with the devout persons , and in the market daily with them that met with him .
translation.kha: Kumta u la ïaphylliew jingmut ha ka synagog bad ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kiba mane ïa U Blei , bad ruh ha ki jaka paidbah man ka sngi bad ki briew kiba jia ryngkhat ki ïaid nangta .
Ki dei ban sumar baroh ki tiar ki tar ka Ïingjaiñ bad pyndep ki kamram kiba ïadei ki Israel .
translation.en: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet , and cover the same with a covering of badgers  skins , and shall put in the staves thereof .
He shall not return into the land of Egypt , but the Assyrian shall be his king , because they refused to return .
translation.kha: Ki kyntait ban wan phai sha nga , bad kumta ki dei ban leit phai sha Ijipt , bad ki nong Assyria kin synshar halor jong ki .
Kumta u Saul u ïa ki nonglamktien sha Jesse ban ong , Phah ïa u khun jong me u Dabid uto uba sharai ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse , and said , Send me David thy son , which is with the sheep .

translation.kha: U Balaam u ong ha u , Tei ïa Madon hangne hynñiew tylli ki Nahor bad wallam ïa nga hynñiew tylli ki bteng kyrtong bad hynñiew kynteit ki langbrot shynrang .
translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Build me here seven altars , and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams .
When he shall come to be glorified in his saints , and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day .
translation.kha: haba u wan ha kata ka Sngi ban ïohpdiang ïa ka burom na ki briew jong u baroh bad ka jingpyndonburom na baroh kiba ngeit . Phi ruh phin long napdeng jong ki , namar ba phi la ngeit ïa ka khubor kaba ngi la ïathuh ha phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the third month , in the first day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba lai jong ka snem kaba khatwei ha ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , U Trai u la kren ha nga .
ngan bat angel ka kular kieng pynsep marynthing pynlong shongthait Bohan Dabid u kpa jong me mynba nga la ong lyngktop u Karshena ïa ka Israel yn synshar borabor da ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translation.en: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom , according as I have covenanted with David thy father , saying , There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel .

translation.kha: shisien Sa pat u Dabid u khot lang ïa ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel , kiba long baroh laiphew hajar ngut ,
translation.en: Again , David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel , thirty thousand .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren nga .
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka Hannah ka la duwai : U Trai u la iwtung ïa ka dohnud jong nga da ka Shatei ; Eleasar nga dustur namar kaei kaba u la leh ! Nga nongpyntrei ïa ki jingïalumlang jong nga ; Jokhebed nga shadkmen bakynsha Kiba U Blei u la jingkynting ïa nga .
translation.en: And Hannah prayed , and said , My heart rejoiceth in the  Lord  , mine horn is exalted in the  Lord  : my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies  ; because I rejoice in thy salvation .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Kine rai briew ki ong ba ki mane ïa bieit tipthuh mihpat Moserah basang jong ki kim banylla jingmut ei ei kilomitar bad kyllan dohnud jong dabi , ki long shawei pat . jingjur ïajubab jong ki kam Hesekaïah ei ei , hynrei ka long tang ki aiñ khlaiñ ki rukom briew , kiba Dorbar shu spel nongpynbyrngia den
translation.en: Wherefore the Lord said , Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth , and with their lips do honour me , but have removed their heart far from me , and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men :

Wherefore , my brethren , ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ ; that ye should be married to another , even to him who is raised from the dead , that we should bring forth fruit unto God .
translation.kha: Ka long kumta bad phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga . Ha ka jingïadei bad ka hukum , ma phi ruh phi la ïap namar phi long ka bynta jong ka met U Khrist ; bad mynta phi long ki jong u , uta ïa uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap khnang ba ngi lah ban long kiba U Blei u lah ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam jong u .

translation.en: Why dost thou shew me iniquity , and cause me to behold grievance ? for spoiling and violence are before me : and there are that raise up strife and contention .
translation.kha: Balei ba me pynlong ïa nga ban ïohi ïa kaba kum kane ka jingjynjar ? Kumno me lah ban shu peit ïa kaba kum kane ka jingleh bymdei ? Ka jingpynjot bad ka jinglehbor ki don baroh sawdong jong nga , bad ka don ka jingïaleh bad jingïakajia ha kylleng .

Bad kumta nga kyrpad ïa phi jingsngewlehrain ko ksuid-durblang badonburom : To rabbit ba baroh ngin ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat . Kane kam long ka tiew kaba thymmai Nongbuh nga thoh sha iahap ; ka long ka hukum kaba ngi la don naduh mynnyngkong .
translation.en: And now I beseech thee , lady , not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee , but that which we had from the beginning , that we love one another .

And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock , and the third part of an hin unto a ram , and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb : this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year .
translation.kha: Ka jingainguh waiñ kaba biang ka long ar litar ka waiñ lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw , shi litar shiteng ka waiñ lem bad u langbrot , bad shi litar ka waiñ lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot . Kane ka long ka jingbuh ryntih ïa ka jingainguh thang na ka bynta ka sngi nyngkong kaba man la u bnai baroh shisnem .

Trai U u ong ha Moses u , Shen men sa ïap noh , bad ynda me ïap u paidbah un sa phai noh na nga bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki . Kin kyntait ïa nga bad mane ïa ki blei thala jong kata ka ri sha kaba kin sa leit rung .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Behold , thou shalt sleep with thy fathers  ; and this people will rise up , and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land , whither they go to be among them , and will forsake me , and break my covenant which I have made with them .
And your altars shall be desolate , and your images shall be broken : and I will cast down your slain men before your idols .
translation.kha: Ïa ki duwan yn pynjot noh bad ki duwan jingiwbih kin pra . Baroh ki briew kiba hangta kin shah pynïap ha khmat ki bleithaw jong ki .

Kumta Timon jylli Konanaïah satlak pyntian malade ki ha ki trai bathymmai bad ïa ki Peninnah jong ki ha kiwei pat ki rangbah . Uwei uwei baroh , uba rit bad uba Bigthana , Kanah pyrshang ban nyngkong pisa da ka jingbymhok . Wat ,44 nongïathuhlypa bad Shemuel lyngdoh lut thok ïa ki briew .
translation.en: Therefore will I give their wives unto others , and their fields to them that shall inherit them : for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness , from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely .

But my words and my statutes , which I commanded my servants the prophets , did they not take hold of your fathers ? and they returned and said , Like as the  Lord  of hosts thought to do unto us , according to our ways , and according to our doings , so hath he dealt with us .
translation.kha: Lyngba ki shakri jong nga ki nongïathuhlypa nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ïa ki hukum bad ki jingmaham , hynrei ki la kyntait ïa ki bad ki la shahshitom ïa kaba mih nangta . Nangta ki la kylla-kaba-mut bad ki la pdiang ba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la lah pynshitom ïa ki kumba ki dei ban shah bad kumba nga la kut jingmut ban leh .’

translation.en: And the guard stood , every man with his weapons in his hand , round about the king , from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple , along by the altar and the temple .
translation.kha: bad u pynïeng ïa ki rangbah kiba don ki waitlam ba la sei lypa ha baroh ki bynta ba sha khmat ka Templ , ban ïada ïa u syiem .
Ka niam jong kine ki briew ka long ka bymdondor ei ei La . khet ïa u ha dieng khlaw ; la ohdur da ki tiar u nong-ohdieng ,
translation.en: For the customs of the people are vain : for one cutteth a tree out of the forest , the work of the hands of the workman , with the axe .

translation.kha: Katto por hadien kane , Trai la bthah ïa nga
translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah the prophet , after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,
For before the child shall have knowledge to cry , My father , and my mother , the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba u khynnah un heh un san ban ong ‘ Mei’ bad ‘ Pa’ , ïa ka spah baroh jong ka Damaskos bad ïa ka mar lute baroh jong ka Samaria yn kit noh da u patsha ka Assyria .
Ngim Timothi dieng ïa u mynsiem jong kane ka pyrthei , pynban , ngi lah ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem tangon la phah da U Blei , khnang ba ngin lah ban tip ïa pynkhihwin kaba U Blei u la pynlamwir ha ngi .
translation.en: Now we have received , not the spirit of the world , but the spirit which is of God ; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God .

translation.kha: kamra ap phira jong , ka rung jong ka , bad ki kynroh bashapoh jong ka ki la long ka jingheh kat kito kiba ha kiwei pat ki khyrdop don ruh jingkhangïit baroh sawdong bad ka rung . Baroh shi lynter la long san mitar ka jingjrong khat-ar mitar shiteng ka pyngkiang
translation.en: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long , and five cubits broad .

translation.kha: Ngan pynjulor ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki diengsoh Dumbur jong ka , kiba janmiet ju ïa-pyndap ba kiba ieit jingpyndonkam ka jinghiarpateng ai ïa ka namar ba ka la shakri ïa ki . Ngan pynkylla ri sngewlem ïa ki bri ba-rkhiang bad shongthait brisoh jong ka ; ki mradkhlaw kin pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees , whereof she hath said , These are my rewards that my lovers have given me : and I will make them a forest , and the beasts of the field shall eat them .
Then she came and told the man of God . And he said , Go , sell the oil , and pay thy debt , and live thou and thy children of the rest .
translation.kha: Ka la leit phai pat sha u Elisha , u nongïathuhlypa , uba la ong ïa ka ,  Die ïa ka umphniang Olib bad siew dep ïa ki ram jong phi baroh , ban yn don bun ka tyngka kaba tam na ka bynta jong phi bad ki khun shynrang jong phi ban im .

translation.en: And I will establish my covenant with you  ; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood  ; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth .

ïa me ïa kmie me ka jinglongmraw . Men ri ha kaba ym shym la kha ïa me , bad hangta ïap baroh ar ngut .
translation.en: And I will cast thee out , and thy mother that bare thee , into another country , where ye were not born  ; and there shall ye die .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la shim ïa kur ka Rekhab baroh kawei — u Jaasanaïah ( u khun jong uwei pat u , uba Jeremaïah dei u khun jong u Habassinaïah ) bad ïa baroh ki shynrang kiba shi para bad u bad ki khun shynrang u jong — bad wallam ïa ki sha ka Templ .
translation.en: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah , the son of Habaziniah , and his brethren , and all his sons , and the whole house of the Rechabites  ;
And seven days were fulfilled , after that the  Lord  had smitten the river .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi ki la leit hadien ba U  Trai  U la shoh ïa ka wah .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as Moses entered into the tabernacle , the cloudy pillar descended , and stood at the door of the tabernacle , and the  Lord  talked with Moses .
translation.kha: Ynda u Moses u la rung shapoh jong ka , u rishot lyoh u wan hiar bad u ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad U  Trai  u kren ha u Moses na uta u lyoh .

translation.en: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests ? therefore it shall be , that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king s house , thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests .
translation.kha: U Sadok bad u Abiathar , ki lyngdoh kin don hangta ; ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi ïohsngew ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies , and of all the truth , which thou hast shewed unto thy servant  ; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan  ; and now I am become two bands .
translation.kha: Ngam long uba bit dor ban ïohpdiang ïa baroh ka jinglehisynei bad ka jingieit baïaineh ba me la pynpaw ha nga , u shakri jong me . Nga la jam ïa ka wah Jordan tang bad u diengduh jong nga , bad mynta pat nga la wan phai bad kine ar ki kynhun .
Nga la pyllaitluid ïa ki paid Israel bad pynim ïa ki na ka bakhrawbor
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath redeemed Jacob , and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he .

And when I saw that ye delivered me not , I put my life in my hands , and passed over against the children of Ammon , and the  Lord  delivered them into my hand : wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day , to fight against me ?
translation.kha: Haba nga la ïohi ba phim shym wan ïarap ïa nga , nga la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim bad nga jam ïa u pud ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ; bad U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ka jingjop halor jong ki . Te balei pat phi wan ban ïaleh ïa nga mynta ?
Judia jait Gad ki shongduh sha mihngi jong ka Jordan , peitmat ki jait Dan ki ïai don ha nongdie lieng Kordit Ki jait prong ki shongduh harud Lasha duriaw , Ki ïai don harud ka duriaw .
translation.en: Gilead abode beyond Jordan : and why did Dan remain in ships ? Asher continued on the sea shore , and abode in his breaches .

And they forsook the  Lord  God of their fathers , which brought them out of the land of Egypt , and followed other gods , of the gods of the people that were round about them , and bowed themselves unto them , and provoked the  Lord  to anger .
translation.kha: Ki la sangeh ban mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei uba la wallam ïa ki na Ijipt , bad ki la sdang ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong ki . Ki mane dem ïa ki , bad ki la pynlong ïa U  Trai  ban bitar .
Nga la pynlong u ïa , u nongïalam bad u nongai hukum ïa ki jaitbynriew ; bad lyngba u jong nga la pyn-i ha ki ïa ka bor jong nga .
translation.en: Behold , I have given him for a witness to the people , a leader and commander to the people .
Confirming the souls of the disciples , and exhorting them to continue in the faith , and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Ki la pynkhlaiñ ïa ki riewngeit bad pynshlur ïa ki ban ïaineh skhem ha ka jingngeit .  Ngi dei ban ïaid lyngba bun ki jingjynjar ban ïohrung sha ka Hima U Blei ,  ki la hikai .
Ki la tip tang ïa kaei ba kiwei pat ki ong : U briew uba la ju pynshitom beiñ ïa ngi mynta pat ïalap u ïa ka jingngeit ïa kaba u shisien la pyrshang ban pynduh !
translation.en: But they had heard only , That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed .

translation.kha: Naba U Khun U Briew u la jan wan ha ka burom jong U Kpa jong u lem bad la ki angel , bad nangta un ainong ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum ki kam jong u .
translation.en: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels  ; and then he shall reward every man according to his works .
But into the second went the high priest alone once every year , not without blood , which he offered for himself , and for the errors of the people :
translation.kha: hynrei tang u rangbah lyngdoh uba rung sha ka bynta kaba shapoh jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad u leh kumta tang shisien shisnem . U rah bad u ïa ka snam ïa kaba u ainguh ha U Blei na ka bynta ïa lade bad na ka bynta ki pop ba ki briew ki leh khlem sngewthuh ba ki la leh pop .

translation.en: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel , and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation  ; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the  Lord  , to make an atonement for your souls .
translation.kha: Lum ïa kane ka jingainguh na ki Israel , bad pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga . Kane ka khajna ka long ka jingsiew na ka bynta la ka jingim , bad ngan kynmaw ban da ban ker ïa ki .
Hangta phin shong , kdang ong boi Hushim , tad haduh ba phin da siew dep ïa ka pisa bakhatduh jong ka pynïapthngan kuna liewlep
translation.en: Verily I say unto thee , Thou shalt by no means come out thence , till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing .
And the king said unto the man of God , Come home with me , and refresh thyself , and I will give thee a reward .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u nongïathuhlypa ,  Wan ngin ïaleit bad nga sha ïing bad ngin ïabam ei ei . Ngan ainong ïa phi namar kaei kaba phi la leh .

translation.en: For the husband is the head of the wife , even as Christ is the head of the church : and he is the saviour of the body .
translation.kha: Naba u tnga u don ka iktiar halor la ka tnga kumba U Khrist u don ka iktiar halor ka balang ; bad U Khrist hi u long U Nongpynim jong ka balang , ka met jong u .
Hynrei U Trai u long :24 ïaineh Balah bad un pynshaitbor ïa phi bad ri sumar ïa phi na Uta u Basniew .
translation.en: But the Lord is faithful , who shall stablish you , and keep you from evil .

translation.kha: ki syiem kin sher hangta lem bad ki kynhun shipai jong ki . Kin ïa la ki sawdong ka nongbah , uwei uwei un sher dara hangno hangno ba u kwah .
translation.en: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her  ; they shall pitch their tents against her round about  ; they shall feed every one in his place .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab la pynjot ha sngap khynnah ba ki .
translation.en: Moab is destroyed  ; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ka jingsynshar jong phi kan ym bteng . Namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa u sngewpyngngad U Trai un wad ïa u briew uba u kwah bad un mana ïa Rung ban long nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong u .
translation.en: But now thy kingdom shall not continue : the  Lord  hath sought him a man after his own heart , and the  Lord  hath commanded him to be captain over his people , because thou hast not kept that which the  Lord  commanded thee .
He walked also after their counsel , and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth–gilead : and the Syrians smote Joram .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jingai jingmut jong ki , u la ïasoh bad u Joram u syiem ka Israel ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria . Ki kynhun shipai ki la ïaleh ha Ramoth ha Gilead , bad u Joram u la mynsaw ha ka thma .

translation.en: And there are also many other things which Jesus did , the which , if they should be written every one , I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written . Amen .
translation.kha: Mynta , don bun kiwei pat kiei kiei kiba U Jisu u la leh . Lada la thoh ïa ki baroh kawei pa kawei , nga tharai ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan ym ngiam jaka ïa ki kitab ha kiba yn thoh .
Ki paid Israel ki don hapoh ka jingshoh bieit ki . kin ha la ka jong ka lynti .
translation.en: Ephraim is joined to idols : let him alone .

translation.kha: Me long u kpa jong ngi U Abraham bad u Jakob , ki kpa jong ngi , kim pdiang ïa ngi , hynrei ma me ko Trai , me long u kpa ngi , uta uba pyllait im ïa ngi borabor
translation.en: Doubtless thou art our father , though Abraham be ignorant of us , and Israel acknowledge us not : thou , O  Lord  , art our father , our redeemer  ; thy name is from everlasting .

translation.kha: U buh ïa uwei u khun masi ksiar ha Bethel bad ïa uwei ha pat Dan .
translation.en: And he set the one in Beth–el , and the other put he in Dan .

And David said unto Michal , It was before the  Lord  , which chose me before thy father , and before all his house , to appoint me ruler over the people of the  Lord  , over Israel : therefore will I play before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga la shad ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , uba la jied ïa nga ha ka jaka u kpa jong pha bad ka longïing jong u , ban pynlong ïa nga u nongïalam jong ki briew jong u ki Israel . Bad ngan ïai shad ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  ,

U Laodikaïa u ong jingrung ki Sipporah Shah ngan buh ha phi kawei ka jingkyntip . Ngan thong ïa phi uwei pa uwei shi lyngkhot jlew khapnap linen bad laiphew riam ki jaiñ baremdor lada phi lah ba-beit batai ha nga ïa ikhain jingmut jong ka ha shuwa ban kut Tiras ki hynñiew sngi jong ka jingïohpdiang Abigail . Ïathuh ha ngi ïa kata ka jingkyntip jong phi , ki ong . To ai ba ngin ïohsngew ïa kata .
translation.en: But if ye cannot declare it me , then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments . And they said unto him , Put forth thy riddle , that we may hear it .
And he said unto me , Son of man , cause thy belly to eat , and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee . Then did I eat it  ; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , bam ïa kane ka kot kli ba nga ai ha me , pyndap ïa ka kpoh jong me da ka .  Te nga bam ïa ka , bad ka thiang kum ka ngap .
U Judas Iskariot Akhsah uwei na ki synran jong u — uta u ban sa shetkylla ïa u pyndeng u la ong jingpynbynta
translation.en: Then saith one of his disciples , Judas Iscariot , Simon s son , which should betray him ,

translation.kha: Hato Baal-jong-ka-Jutang kynmaw ? Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane baroh mynba nga dang don lem nongtih phi .
translation.en: Remember ye not , that , when I was yet with you , I told you these things ?
He shall therefore burn that garment , whether warp or woof , in woollen or in linen , or any thing of skin , wherein the plague is : for it is a fretting leprosy  ; it shall be burnt in the fire .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh u dei ban thang noh ïa ka , namar ka dei ka jingpang bthuh kaba pur , kaba dei ban pynduh da ka ding .

translation.en: Therefore , when he was gone out , Jesus said ,  Now is the Son of man glorified , and God is glorified in him .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Judas u la mihnoh , U Jisu u la ong ,  Mynta ïa ka burom U Khun U Briew la pynpaw ; mynta ïa ka burom U Blei la pynpaw lyngba u .

U Shiphrah pneh ki Semakhaïah wan na ka jaitbynriew jong ki Jahath , u khun syiem jong ki napdeng ki briew jong ki hi . Un wan kynsai kynsit haba nga khot sngewbha ïa Elnathan , namar uei uba nud Ainguh wan khlem shah khot sngewbha pynsamthiah Kin long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki . Ma Ir , U ïawanlang , print donakor kren .
translation.en: And ye shall be my people , and I will be your God .

And if the priest look , and , behold , the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it  ; then he shall rend it out of the garment , or out of the skin , or out of the warp , or out of the woof :
translation.kha: Hynrei , haba u lyngdoh u la khmih bha pat ïa ka , lada kata ka jingbthuh ka la nang duna , u dei ban tar noh ïa kata kaba la bit bthuh na kata ka jaiñ ne na kata ka snieh .
U ruh u ong Nga , mynjur ïa kata , tangba tang uta uba shim ïa ka khuri un long u mraw jong nga ; kiwei ki pat lah ban leit noh .
translation.en: And he said , Now also let it be according unto your words : he with whom it is found shall be my servant  ; and ye shall be blameless .

translation.kha: Nga ban katto katne por bad phi , lehse tlang , bad nangta phi ban ïarap ïa nga ha ka ban bteng ïa ka jingleit jong nga , kat shano sha ba ngan leit .
translation.en: And it may be that I will abide , yea , and winter with you , that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban burom ïa la kmie ka bad ïa la u kpa , u bad dei ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton , kumba la nga hukum . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Ye shall fear every man his mother , and his father , and keep my sabbaths : I am the  Lord  your God .
And Pharaoh s daughter said to her , Go . And the maid went and called the child s mother .
translation.kha: Ka khun u Pharaoh ka ong ha ka ,  Khie leit .  Kumta kata ka khynnah ka leit bad ka wan ïalam da ka kmie jong uta u khunlung hi .

translation.en: Thou shalt not avenge , nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people , but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat pynhiarkput ïano ïano lane ban ïai isih ïa u , hynrei ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba phi ieit ïa lade . Nga long U  Trai .

païa Jisu Lamekh la bitar katba Beor la peit sawdong ïa ki , hynrei ha ka kajuh ka por u la sngewsih Ether ka bynta jong khanglad , namar ba ki eh mynsiem bad leh bymdei . Bashyrkhei’ u la ong ha uta u briew , Rah ïa la Rehob kti . U la rah ïa ka , bad ka Ituria khiah bha pat .
translation.en: And when he had looked round about on them with anger , being grieved for the hardness of their hearts , he saith unto the man ,  Stretch forth thine hand .  And he stretched it out : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
For I will cast out the nations before thee , and enlarge thy borders : neither shall any man desire thy land , when thou shalt go up to appear before the  Lord  thy God thrice in the year .
translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong phi , bad pynïar ruh ïa ki pud jong phi , yn ym don mano mano u ban pyrshang ban jop ïa ka ri jong phi haba phi rakhe ïa kita ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam .
Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba shibun kin ïawan na mihngi bad na sepngi bad kin ïashong lem Kham u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob blei met Ïohi kyrmen shahtehmraw Hima ki bneng .
translation.en: And I say unto you , That many shall come from the east and west , and shall sit down with Abraham , and Isaac , and Jacob , in the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka , Judah u Baasha khun u jong Ahijah u u la long u syiem ka Israel baroh kawei , bad u la synshar arphew saw snem ha Tirsah .
translation.en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah , twenty and four years .

translation.kha: Haba la dap bnai , ki Israel ki la ïashongduh ha la ki jong ki . Nangta baroh ki ïalumlang Jerusalem
translation.en: And when the seventh month was come , and the children of Israel were in the cities , the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la nang kham pawnam shuh haba u la wan na khatphra hajar ki nong Edom ha Them Mluh .
translation.en: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt , being eighteen thousand men .
So when the Samaritans were come unto him , they besought him that he would tarry with them : and he abode there two days .
translation.kha: Kumta haba ki nong Samaria ki la wan ha u , ki la kyrpad ïa u ban sah bad ki , bad U Jisu u la sah hangta ar sngi .

translation.en: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe  ; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance .
translation.kha: bad kata ka bri ka khyndew kan ym leit na kawei ka jait sha kawei pat . Kawei pa kawei ka jait kan ïai bat ïa la ka bri ka khyndew .

Ki ktien ha rasong nongleh kitab ki long kito kiba u Moses u la kren ha ki mihngi mynba ki sngewnguh ha ka ri Leh jingroi mihngi na ka wah Jordan kajuh Ki ïadon ha ka Ym Jordan hajan Suph , hapdeng ka shnong Kedemoth ha kawei ka liang bad ki shnong Tophel , Laban , Haseroth , bad Disahab ha kawei pat Kaleb liang .
translation.en: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness , in the plain over against the Red sea , between Paran , and Tophel , and Laban , and Hazeroth , and Dizahab .

translation.kha: Te U Trai , U Blei ki , Israel u la ong ïa nga ban ong ha u Sedekaïah ,
translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,

translation.kha: mynba u buh ïa ki lyoh ha sahit bneng mynba , u seng ïa ki umpohliew ka duriaw-bah ,
translation.en: When he established the clouds above : when he strengthened the fountains of the deep :

translation.kha: Ko ki nong Israel jong nga , to shahshkor ïa katba nga dang pynlong jingïasaid na ka bynta ïa lade ha khmat jong phi !
translation.en: Men , brethren , and fathers , hear ye my defence which I make now unto you .
And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon , beside the mischief that Hadad did : and he abhorred Israel , and reigned over Syria .
translation.kha: U dei u nongshun jong ki Israel baroh shi lynter jingim u Solomon .
ktang la pynlong janai ïa u , khung la jia jingioieit ka tynrai jong ka jingim bymjukut Talmai ka bynta Shuppim baroh kiba kohnguh ïa u ,
translation.en: And being made perfect , he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him  ;

Now when all the princes , and all the people , which had entered into the covenant , heard that every one should let his manservant , and every one his maidservant , go free , that none should serve themselves of them any more , then they obeyed , and let them go .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ïamynjur ban pyllaitluid noh ïa la ki mraw bad ban ym pynlong mraw shuh ïa ki .

translation.en: And he brought up Hadassah , that is , Esther , his uncle s daughter : for she had neither father nor mother , and the maid was fair and beautiful  ; whom Mordecai , when her father and mother were dead , took for his own daughter .
translation.kha: U don ka bakha , ka Esther , kaba ka kyrteng Hebru jong ka , ka long ka Hadassah ; ka long ka samla ba-bhabriew , bad ka don ka rynïeng ryñiot ba-itynnat . Ha ka jingïap noh ki kmie ki kpa jong ka , u Mordekai u la ri bad pynheh pynsan ïa ka kum la ka jong ka khun .

translation.en: Thus shalt thou do unto all the cities which are very far off from thee , which are not of the cities of these nations .
translation.kha: Da kumta phin leh ïa kita ki shnong kiba sha jngai na kata ka ri ha kaba phin shong .
Seïon U Blei Pynkyrpang ngi shakri u lah ban pyllait Bohan lin ngi na ka lawar ding ïapynbeit bad pynleit ka bor jong phi , te un leh .
translation.en: If it be so , our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace , and he will deliver us out of thine hand , O king .
A time to cast away stones , and a time to gather stones together  ; a time to embrace , and a time to refrain from embracing  ;
translation.kha: ka por ban phylliew jingieit bad ka por ban ym phylliew jingieit , ka por ban ïadoh bad ka por ban ym ïadoh .

translation.en: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach , both he , and Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha u bad ha u Oholiab u khun jong u Ahisamakh , na ka jait Dan , ïa ka sap ban hikai ïa ki buit treikam ha kiwei pat .

translation.en: And so Pilate , willing to content the people , released Barabbas unto them , and delivered Jesus , when he had scourged him , to be crucified .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa u paidbah , kumta u la pyllait ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki . Nangta u la phah sympat ïa u Jisu bad aiti ïa u ban shah sahnarphna .
Kumta ki pynhiar mait kloi basngewrit la ki byrni ha madan , bad uwei pa uwei na ki u plied ïa la ka byrni .
translation.en: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground , and opened every man his sack .
Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels , intruding into those things which he hath not seen , vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind ,
translation.kha: Wat shah ïa lade ban shah pynrem da uno uno uba kam ba u long uba kham hakhlieh namar ki jingïohipaw kiba kyrpang bad uba ïai ban ha ka jingsngewrit bymdei bad ha kaba mane ïa ki angel . Naba khlem kano kano ka daw , ïa kiba kum kine ki briew la pynmeng shikatdei da ka rukom pyrkhat briew bad ki la sangeh ban batskhem ha U Khrist , uba long u khlieh jong ka met .
Ïa uno uno uba pyrshah ïa u , wat u Rangbah Lyngdoh jong U Blei , un shah noh bad shah pynduh .
translation.en: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him , and shall be broken  ; yea , also the prince of the covenant .

translation.kha: U Serubbabel , u bad Joshua ki rangbah kur ki ong ïa ki , Ngim ïa donkam ka jingïarap jong phi ban tei ïa ka templ bynta na ka U Trai U Blei jong ngi . Ngin tei hi ïa ka da lade , kumba u Syros , u patsha ka Persia , u la hukum ïa ngi .
translation.en: But Zerubbabel , and Jeshua , and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel , said unto them , Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God  ; but we ourselves together will build unto the  Lord  God of Israel , as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us .
And it came to pass on the morrow , that he took a thick cloth , and dipped it in water , and spread it on his face , so that he died : and Hazael reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Hasael u shim ïa ka jaiñkup thiah , u wieh ïa ka ha ka um , bad u tap khlup ïa u syiem haduh ba un da ïap op . Bad u Hasael u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: They come to encourage us .
translation.kha: Ki wan ban pynshlur ïa ngi .
ïa uwei pa u uwei mot bakynjang , bad ïa ki kynroh jong kawei pa kawei ka kut .
translation.en: And upon every high tower , and upon every fenced wall ,

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , namar jingkhublei jingisynei iaineh phi la khum , ki Jiw ïathied khiah kohnguh ïa haduh Blei , khnang ba kynthah ki ruh mynta kin ïohpdiang ïa ka jingisynei U Blei .
translation.en: Even so have these also now not believed , that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy .

translation.kha: Ki la rung sha ka bad ki la leit sha ka kamra ha kaba la sah : U , u Ïoannis , u Jakob bad u Andriw u bad u Thomas , u Bartholomai bad u Matthaïos u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos , u Simon u Riew-ieit Ri bad u khun jong u Jakob .
translation.en: And when they were come in , they went up into an upper room , where abode both Peter , and James , and John , and Andrew , Philip , and Thomas , Bartholomew , and Matthew , James the son of Alphaeus , and Simon Zelotes , and Judas the brother of James .
He that spared not his own Son , but delivered him up for us all , how shall he not with him also freely give us all things ?

translation.kha: Ka la long ka sngi kaba shiphew jong ka snem thymmai , kaba long ka snem kaba arphew san hadien ba la ringmraw ïa ngi bad khatsaw snem hadien ba la jop ïa ka Jerusalem . Ha kata ka sngi nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat badonbor jong U  Trai  , bad u la rah noh ïa nga .
ïa-pyrshah me kyntait , ngan Kloi ïa ka ri jong me da ba-ïaitrei pyndap Pynbeit ka da ki jakoid .
translation.en: And if thou refuse to let them go , behold , I will smite all thy borders with frogs :
And I will raise up for them a plant of renown , and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land , neither bear the shame of the heathen any more .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa ki jaka rep kiba seisoh bad ngan pynkut noh ka jingïapthngan ha ka ri . Kiwei pat ki ri kin ym rkhiebeiñ shuh ïa ki .
, ka briew ka la wan bad khrup ha ki kjat jong u . ïarap nga , ko Kynrad ! ka la ong .
translation.en: Then came she and worshipped him , saying , Lord , help me .
Rob not the poor , because he is poor : neither oppress the afflicted in the gate :
translation.kha: Wat shim kabu ïa kiba duk tang namar ba phi lah ; wat shim kabu ïa kito kiba ïeng khlem jingïarap ha ka ïingbishar .

translation.en: But every one shall die for his own iniquity : every man that eateth the sour grape , his teeth shall be set on edge .
translation.kha: Pynban , uno uno uba bam ïa ki sohwaiñ kiba jew kan pynlong ba ki bniat jong u hi kin shyrkhei ; bad uwei uwei baroh un ïap namar ki pop jong u hi .

translation.en: These ten times have ye reproached me : ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me .
translation.kha: Na kawei ka por sha kawei pat phi pynjahburom ïa nga bad phim don ka jinglehrain haba phi krenbeiñ ïa nga .
Wat sheptieng — phan ym shah phan ym shah pynjahburom . Phan klet noh ïa jingbymlongkhuid kum ka ba dang kham samla , bad ïa ka shah ibeiñ kum ka riewkynthei .
translation.en: Fear not  ; for thou shalt not be ashamed : neither be thou confounded  ; for thou shalt not be put to shame : for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth , and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong ha u Joseph Kumba , phi ïohi , nga la jan ïap , hynrei U Blei un don ryngkat bad me bad , un sa ïalam pat ïa sha me ka ri ki kpa tymmen jong me .
translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Behold , I die : but God shall be with you , and bring you again unto the land of your fathers .

translation.kha: U ai rangbah hukum u la ong , Wat hano ïathuh hano ba me la ïathuh ïa kane ha nga . Bad u la phah noh ïa uta u samla .
translation.en: So the chief captain then let the young man depart , and charged him , See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me .
( Though Jesus himself baptized not , but his disciples , )
translation.kha: ( Ha ka jingshisha , U Jisu da lade um shym la pynbaptis ïano ïano ; tang ki synran jong u ki la leh . )

translation.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold  ; therefore shall he beg in harvest , and have nothing .
translation.kha: U nongrep uba jaipdeh palat ban lur ïa ki lyngkha jong u ha ka por kaba biang un ym ïoh ei ei ïa ka ban ot .

translation.en: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him : and great multitudes came together to hear , and to be healed by him of their infirmities .

translation.en: All flesh shall perish together , and man shall turn again unto dust .

translation.en: Mischief shall come upon mischief , and rumour shall be upon rumour  ; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet  ; but the law shall perish from the priest , and counsel from the ancients .
translation.kha: Ka jingjynjar kan bud kawei hadien kawei pat , ka khubor basniew kan ïai tuid . Phin kyrpad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban ïathuh ïa kaei kaba ki ïohi lypa . Ki lyngdoh kin ym don ei ei shuh ban hikai ïa ki briew , bad ki tymmen ki san kin ym don jingsneng jingkraw shuh ban ai .

translation.en: And it came to pass , after the year was expired , at the time when kings go forth to battle , that David sent Joab , and his servants with him , and all Israel  ; and they destroyed the children of Ammon , and besieged Rabbah . But David tarried still at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha ka pyrem kaba bud , ha ka por jong ka snem haba ki syiem ki ju leit sha ka thma , u Dabid u la phah ïa u Joab lem bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u bad ka kynhun shipai Israel ; ki la jop ïa ki Ammon bad ki la kerkut ïa ka nongbah Rabbah . translation.en: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in , and putting his hand on him , that he might receive his sight .

Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane khnang ka jingkmen jong nga kan ïoh long phi bad ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan kaba dap pura .
translation.en: These things have I spoken unto you , that my joy might remain in you , and that your joy might be full .
Wisdom is before him that hath understanding  ; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: U briew uba shemphang u thew ban leh ïa ka kam bastad , hynrei uba bieit u sdang shisien sdang na ki liang baroh .

translation.en: Behold , I send an Angel before thee , to keep thee in the way , and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa u angel ha shuwa jong phi ban ïada ïa phi haba phi leit jingleit bad ban ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka jaka kaba nga la pynkhreh .

translation.en: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers , after your courses , according to the writing of David king of Israel , and according to the writing of Solomon his son .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ki jaka shong jong phi ha ka Templ shi kur shi kur , kat kum ki jingkitkhlieh ba la aiti ha phi da u syiem Dabid bad u syiem Solomon u khun jong u ,

translation.en: For if ye turn away from after him , he will yet again leave them in the wilderness  ; and ye shall destroy all this people .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen , saying , Take fire from between the wheels , from between the cherubims  ; then he went in , and stood beside the wheels .
Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper ? the glory of his nostrils is terrible .
translation.kha: Hato me pynlong ïa ki ban kynthih kum ki puit bad pynsheptieng ïa ki briew da ka jingpah jong ki ?

translation.en: And when they saw it , they all murmured , saying , That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la sdang ban khñium ,  Une u briew u la leit kum uba shah khot sngewbha sha ka ïing jong u nongpop !

Ngan pynsangeh Diamond kdiah ka jingkwah myllen la pha bad ïa ki jingijli kiba pha la leh naduh ba pha dang don ha Ijipt . Phan ym khmih shuh ïa ki bleithaw ne pyrkhat shuh shaphang ka jingartatiend .
translation.en: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee , and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt : so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them , nor remember Egypt any more .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron , and say unto them , There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people :

translation.en: For I have sworn by myself , saith the  Lord  , that Bozrah shall become a desolation , a reproach , a waste , and a curse  ; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes .
translation.kha: Nga da lade hi nga la smai ba kane ka nongbah Bosrah kan long ka jingïohi ba-itriem bad ka ri shyiap ; ki briew kin rkhiebeiñ ïa ka bad kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ka kum ka jingtim . Baroh ki nongrit ba-marjan kin don ha ka jingjot junom . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Moses bad u Joshua u nongïarap jong u ki la khreh , bad u Moses u la leit uta u lum uba kyntang .
translation.en: And Moses rose up , and his minister Joshua : and Moses went up into the mount of God .
While they promise them liberty , they themselves are the servants of corruption : for of whom a man is overcome , of the same is he brought in bondage .
translation.kha: Ki kular ha ki ïa ka jinglaitluid katba ma ki , ki long ki mraw jong ki jingmlien bapynjot — naba u briew u long u mraw ha kano kano kaba jop halor u .

translation.en: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem .

‘ ki nongsyntiat ,’ la jubab ‘ dei kiba shida .

translation.en: O earth , earth , earth , hear the word of the  Lord .

translation.en: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness : but the righteous hath hope in his death .
Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , as the sand that is by the sea for multitude  ; and that thou go to battle in thine own person .

translation.en: And many nations shall pass by this city , and they shall say every man to his neighbour , Wherefore hath the  Lord  done thus unto this great city ?

translation.en: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God  : and it shall become a spoil to the nations .

U khun uba u bieit pynsngewsih ïa la u kpa bad u pynbabe da ki jingkthang ïa la ka kmie .
translation.en: A foolish son is a grief to his father , and bitterness to her that bare him .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki synran ki dang ïakren shaphang ka Templ , ba katno ka long ingmane itynnat Hodaïah bad ki maw bajlih jong ka bad ki jingai khaw-eit kiba la ai sha U Meremoth .
translation.en: And as some spake of the temple , how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts , he said ,

translation.en: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab , and upon the head of his seed for ever : but upon David , and upon his seed , and upon his house , and upon his throne , shall there be peace for ever from the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u sha Ramah , bad u syiem Saul u leit sha la ïing Gibeah .
translation.en: Then Samuel went to Ramah  ; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul .

ban buh jingthoh ïa ki Lebi katno ki ngut don shi kur shi kur bad shi ïing shi ïing , da kaba thoh kyrteng ïa uwei uwei pa u shynrang uba la dap shi bnai ne kham heh ,

translation.en: Man knoweth not the price thereof  ; neither is it found in the land of the living .

translation.en: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother , Behold , Esau my brother is a hairy man , and I am a smooth man :

translation.kha: Lada u nongwei uba shong basah bad phi u kwah ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , nyngkong eh phi dei ban otsher shuwa ïa ki shynrang baroh na ka ïing jong u . Hadien kata , lah ban kheiñ ïa u kum u traishnong , bad nangta u lah ban ïashim bynta ha ka Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive , he armed his trained servants , born in his own house , three hundred and eighteen , and pursued them unto Dan .

translation.en: When he made a decree for the rain , and a way for the lightning of the thunder :

translation.en: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane , and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean .

translation.en: And when we had accomplished those days , we departed and went our way  ; and they all brought us on our way , with wives and children , till we were out of the city : and we kneeled down on the shore , and prayed .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ka por jong ngi bad ki ka la kut , ngi la mihnoh bad ngi la nang leit ha ka jingleit jong ngi . Ma ki baroh , lem bad ki tnga bad ki khun jong ki , ki la ïaleit lem bad ngi na ka nongbah sha ka rud duriaw , ha kaba ngi la ïadem khohsiew bad duwai .

translation.en: That chant to the sound of the viol , and invent to themselves instruments of musick , like David  ;

translation.en: Let Israel now say , that his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.en: And when she saw him , she was troubled at his saying , and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be .

translation.en: Keep thee far from a false matter  ; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not : for I will not justify the wicked .

translation.kha: Me la leh kat kata kaba sniew ha kaba thied bad die haduh ba ki jaka mane jong me ki la long kiba thala . Te nga la tbeh ding ïa ka nongbah bad thang duh ïa ka . Baroh kiba khmih ha me mynta ki ïohi ïa me ba la kylla dpei .

translation.en: And how shall they preach , except they be sent ? as it is written , How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace , and bring glad tidings of good things !

translation.en: Then the king arose , and sat in the gate . And they told unto all the people , saying , Behold , the king doth sit in the gate . And all the people came before the king : for Israel had fled every man to his tent .

translation.en: And straightway he called them : and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants , and went after him .

translation.en: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly , than to divide the spoil with the proud .

translation.en: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel  ; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more : and the heathen shall know that I am the  Lord  , the Holy One in Israel .
