translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ïaroh kham jur shuh shuh , Da ka jinghikai jong u , u la sdang ka jingpynkhihwin hapdeng ki Edom ha baroh phar ka Judia . Hur la sdang ha Galilaïa bad mynta u la poi hangne .
translation.en: And they were the more fierce , saying , He stirreth up the people , teaching throughout all Judaea , beginning from Galilee to this place .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha nga ïa kaba la , u Dabid u la ong . Ka kynhun shipai ngi ka la phet krad na ka madan thma u la jubab , bad na ki rangïapom ngi ki la shah pynïap . U Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong ruh ki la shah pynïap .
translation.en: And David said unto him , How went the matter ? I pray thee , tell me . And he answered , That the people are fled from the battle , and many of the people also are fallen and dead  ; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also .

translation.kha: parabangeit jong nga , ngan pyndonkam ïa ka nuksa kaba ju long man ka sngi : Haba ar ngut ki briew ki ïamynjur halor kano kano ka kam da kaba ïa ka soskular , ym don uno uno uba lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka lane ei ei ha ka .
translation.en: Brethren , I speak after the manner of men ; Though it be but a man s covenant , yet if it be confirmed , no man disannulleth , or addeth thereto .
Only they would that we should remember the poor ; the same which I also was forward to do .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba ki kyntu ka long ba ngin kynmaw ïa kiba kyrduh ha ka kynhun jong ki , kaba nga hi ruh nga da kwah eh ban leh .
Kumta ngan ka phah ding ha ki kynroh nongbah ka Tyros , bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut jong ka .
translation.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre , which shall devour the palaces thereof .

translation.kha: Te ki Israel ki la kyang ha U Trai , bad u la ïa phah uwei u briew ban pyllait ïa ki . Une u u dei Othniel , u khun jong u Kenas uba dei u para jong Kaleb u .
translation.en: And when the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , the  Lord  raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel , who delivered them , even Othniel the son of Kenaz , Caleb s younger brother .

translation.kha: Ki bad pat ki riewngeit ha kylleng ka Judia ki la ba ki Jentil ruh ki la pdiang ïa ktien U Blei .
translation.en: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God .
And said unto them , What will ye give me , and I will deliver him unto you ? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver .
translation.kha: bad u la kylli ,  Phin ai aïu ïa nga lada nga shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha phi ?  Ki la ñiew laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa bad ki la ai ïa kita ha u .
Kane ka dei ka jong ki khun ki Adam ( U Blei U la thaw ki briew , u la thaw ïa ki ka dur jong hi .
translation.en: This is the book of the generations of Adam . In the day that God created man , in the likeness of God made he him  ;

translation.kha: Phi lah ban lyngngoh kumno phi lah ban ong haba ka khubor u nongïathuhlypa kam shym wan na U Trai .
translation.en: And if thou say in thine heart , How shall we know the word which the  Lord  hath not spoken ?

Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren , our children as their children : and , lo , we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants , and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already : neither is it in our power to redeem them  ; for other men have our lands and vineyards .
translation.kha: Ngi long na kajuh ka jaitbynriew kum ki para Jiw jong ngi . Hato ki khun ki kti jong ngi kim long kumjuh kum ki jong ki ? Hynrei ngi la hap ban pynlong mraw ïa ki khun ki kti jong ngi . Ïa ki katto katne ki khun kynthei jong ngi , la lah die ïa ki kum ki mraw . Ngim donbor ei ei namar ïa ki pynthor bad ki bri sohwaiñ la shim noh na ngi .

translation.en: And the peace of God , which passeth all understanding , shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Bad ka jingsuk U Blei kaba palat ïa ka jingshemphang briew baroh , kan ri jai jai ïa ki dohnud jong phi , bad ïa ki jingmut jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .

Nga thoh sha phi , ko khun ki jong nga , namar phi ithuh ïa U Kpa . Nga thoh sha phi , ki ko kpa namar , phi ithuh ïa , u uba la don naduh kaba mynnyngkong . Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun samla , namar phi long kiba khlaiñ ; ka ktien U Blei ka ïaisah ha phi , phi bad la jop noh thiaw ïa Uta u Basniew .
translation.en: I have written unto you , fathers , because ye have known him that is from the beginning . I have written unto you , young men , because ye are strong , and the word of God abideth in you , and ye have overcome the wicked one .
Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts , to dishonour their own bodies between themselves :
translation.kha: Bad kumta U Blei u la ai noh ïa kita ki briew sha ka ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba jakhlia kiba ki dohnud jong ki , ki kwah , bad ki leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khlemrain para ma ki .

translation.en: Then I cut asunder mine other staff , even Bands , that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la kdiah ïa u dieng uba ar , uta uba la khot  U Jingtylli ,  bad ïa ka jingtylli jong ka Judah bad ka Israel la pynkhynñiuh .

translation.en: ( Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley . ) To morrow turn you , and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea .
translation.kha: ha kaba ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan ki shong mynta ha ki them jong ka . Phai noh lashai ka sngi bad leit sha kata ka ri khlaw ha ki phang jong ka khmut duriaw Akaba .
Ka jingim jong nga ka ïaid kum ka lieng kaba stet tam , kum ka jingstet pukni u uba suh kynsan shapoh ban kynrup ïa rabbit ka .
translation.en: They are passed away as the swift ships : as the eagle that hasteth to the prey .
For the poor always ye have with you  ; but me ye have not always .
translation.kha: Phin don borabor ki briew kiba duk lem bad phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh borabor ïa nga .

translation.en: And if there be any blemish therein , as if it be lame , or blind , or have any ill blemish , thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada don ei ei kaba duna ha kita ki jingri , lada ki dkoh lane ki matlah , lane lada palat eh kano kano ka jingduna , phim dei ban kñia ïa ki ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  To sumar ; to phikir ïa lade pyrshah ïa u thiat ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi .
Ngan bat ïa la ka kular bad me ki khun ki ksiew jong me ha ki pateng ki ban wan ba kan long ka jutang kaba ïaineh junom . long Blei jong me bad U Blei jong ki ki ksiew me .
translation.en: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant , to be a God unto thee , and to thy seed after thee .

And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim , wherein she burned incense to them , and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels , and she went after her lovers , and forgat me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka namar kito ki por kiba ka la klet ïa nga mynba ka thang ki jingiwbih ïa u Baal bad ka la pynphuh pynphieng ïa lade da ki jingdeng bakordor haba ka leit bud nadien ïa kiba ieit jong ka . U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: Beloved , now are we the sons of God , and it doth not yet appear what we shall be : but we know that , when he shall appear , we shall be like him  ; for we shall see him as he is .
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , mynta ngi long ki khun U Blei , hynrei kam pat da shai aïu ngin sa long . Hynrei ngi tip ba ynda U Khrist un paw , ngin ïoh long kum ma u , namar ngin ïohi ïa u kumba u long da shisha .

translation.en: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized : and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls .
translation.kha: Kiba bun na ki , ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong u bad la pynbaptis ïa ki , bad kumba lai hajar ngut ki briew la pynïasoh sha ka kynhun ha kata ka sngi .
U Saul u kylli ïa ka Mikhal , pha shukor ïa nga kumne shah ïa nongshun jong nga lait phet Ka jubab , U byrngem pynïap ïa nga nga ïarap ïa u ban lait phet .
translation.en: And Saul said unto Michal , Why hast thou deceived me so , and sent away mine enemy , that he is escaped ? And Michal answered Saul , He said unto me , Let me go  ; why should I kill thee ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki paid Israel long ki kum u kpu bym pat ih bha .
translation.en: Ephraim , he hath mixed himself among the people  ; Ephraim is a cake not turned .
And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon , and out of the mouth of the beast , and out of the mouth of the false prophet .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi lai tylli ki mynsiem bymkhuid kiba i kum ki jakoid . Ki la ïamih na ka shyntur jong u Ïakjakor , na ka shyntur jong u mradkhlaw , bad na ka shyntur jong u nongïathuhlypa balamler .
u tip mynno ngim shym ïoh ïa ki hok jong kiba u la ai ïa ngi
translation.en: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High ,
I charge you , O daughters of Jerusalem , if ye find my beloved , that ye tell him , that I am sick of love .
translation.kha: Wan bad nga na ki lumbah ka Lebanon , ko ka nongleitkurim jong nga ; wan bad nga na Lebanon . Wan hiar na kliar u lum Amana , na u lum Senir bad u lum Hermon , ha kaba ki sing bad ki  labasa ki shong .
Ha kata ka por ngut ar ki rangbah kin ïatrei ha ka lyngkha : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei yn pat iehnoh shadien .
translation.en: Then shall two be in the field  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
Butter of kine , and milk of sheep , with fat of lambs , and rams of the breed of Bashan , and goats , with the fat of kidneys of wheat  ; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape .
translation.kha: Ki masi bad ki blang jong ki , ki ai kyrhai ka dud , ki la don ki langbrot , ki blang , bad ki masi ruh kiba da kynsai , u kew uba kynsai tam bad ka waiñ kaba bang tam .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks . Then said Jeremiah unto him , The  Lord  hath not called thy name Pashur , but Magor–missabib .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , hadien ba u Pashhur u la pyllait ïa nga na ki kynjri , nga la ong ha u ,  U  Trai  um shym kyrteng ïa me u Pashhur . Ka kyrteng kaba u la lah ai ha me ka dei ‘ Ka Jingshyrkhei ha kylleng .’

translation.en: And the fish that is in the river shall die , and the river shall stink  ; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river .
translation.kha: Ki dohkha kin ïap , bad ka wah kan sa iwtung eh kat haduh ba ki nong Ijipt kin ym nud ban dih um na ka .’

translation.en: And it came to pass , that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner .
translation.kha: U Petros u la ïaisah bun sngi ha Joppa lem bad u nongpdem snieh uba kyrteng u Simon .

translation.en: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing , if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka kynthei kan ïohlait im ha ka por ba ka kha khun , lada ka ïaineh ha ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit bad ka jingkhuid , lem bad ka jingdon akor .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came unto Hosea , the son of Beeri , in the days of Uzziah , Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash , king of Israel .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Hosia u khun jong u Beri , ha ki sngi mynba u Ussaïah , u Jotham , u Ahas , bad u Hesekaïah ki long ki syiem ha Judah , bad u Jeroboam u khun jong u Joash u long syiem ha Israel .

translation.en: And the king answered , Chimham shall go over with me , and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee : and whatsoever thou shalt require of me , that will I do for thee .
translation.kha: U syiem u jubab ,  Ngan ïalam ïa u bad nga , ngan leh na ka bynta jong u kat kaba phi kwah . Bad ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ïa kano kano kaba phi ong .
Pynban , namar paidbah , kim lah shem lynti rah shapoh ïa u . Kumta ki ïabah ïa u sha tnum ïing , ki law ïa ki jingsop bad la pynhiar shapoh ïa u ka jingthiah pdeng jong kynhun ha khmat U Jisu .
translation.en: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude , they went upon the housetop , and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus .

translation.kha: ngan ym bam ne dih ei ei bad hangne , namar U u la ïa nga ban ym bam ne dih ei ei ym phai sha ïing na kajuh ka lynti .
translation.en: For it was said to me by the word of the  Lord  , Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there , nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest .
For when God made promise to Abraham , because he could swear by no greater , he sware by himself ,
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u la pynlong ka jingkular ha u Abraham , u la smai ban leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular . Namar ym don uwei ruh u ban kham khraw ban ïa u , u la pyndonkam ïa la ka jong ka kyrteng haba u la pynlong ïa la ka jingsmai .

translation.en: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul , and told the tidings in the ears of the people : and all the people lifted up their voices , and wept .
translation.kha: Kita ki nonglamktien ki poi ha Gibeah ha kaba u Saul u shong , bad haba ki la ïathuh ha ki briew ïa kata ka khubor , baroh ki ïalynñiar da ka jingsngewsih .
U Dabid u la ai ki hukum ïa u Joab bad ïa kiwei pat rangbah pynïaidkam , leit lyngba ka Israel na kawei ka tduh jong ri kawei pat tduh , bad ñiew ïa ki briew . Nga ban tip haduh katno ngut ki ïadon .
translation.en: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people , Go , number Israel from Beer–sheba even to Dan  ; and bring the number of them to me , that I may know it .
This is the burnt offering of every sabbath , beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .
translation.kha: Ïa kane ka jingainguh thang dei ban ainguh man la ka Sabbaton nalor ka jingainguh kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka jingainguh da ka waiñ .
U Blei u la theh noh kyrhai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha lyngba ngi U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim jong ngi ,
translation.en: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour ;

When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob , and sent him away to Paddan–aram , to take him a wife from thence  ; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge , saying , Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan  ;
translation.kha: U Iso u la ïoh jingtip ba u Isaak u la kyrkhu ïa u Jakob bad ba u la phah noh ïa u sha Mesopotamia ban shem ïa ka tnga . U la ïoh jingtip ruh ba haba u Isaak u la kyrkhu ïa u , u hukum ba un ym shongkurim ïa ka kynthei nong Kanaan .

translation.en: But ye that did cleave unto the  Lord  your God are alive every one of you this day .
translation.kha: hynrei kito na phi kiba ïaineh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ki dang im haduh mynta .

translation.en: That the saying might be fulfilled , which he spake ,  Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none .
translation.kha: ( U la ong ïa kane khnang ba ïa kaei kaba u la lah ong kan urlong shisha :  Ko Pa , ngam shym la duh noh wat uwei ruh na kita ïa kiba me la ai ha nga .  )
khun u briew , to kren ïa ka nongbah Sidon .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against Zidon , and prophesy against it ,
But the tongue can no man tame  ; it is an unruly evil , full of deadly poison .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym don mano mano ba la lah ban pynjuh ïa u thylliej . U long uba sniew bad bym lah ban synshar , uba dap da ka bih ba pynïap .

translation.en: And to his father he sent after this manner  ; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt , and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way .
translation.kha: Ïa la u kpa ruh u phah lam shiphew tylli ki kada kiba kit ïa ki mar Ijipt kiba bha tam , bad shiphew tylli ki kada kiba kit ïa u kew , u kpu bad kiwei pat ki jait jingbam ba u kpa jong u un ïoh bam ha lynti .

Ki Israel wan ki phai pat ban ïaleh sa ïa kiwei ki Benjamin kiba dang sah , bad ki lut pynïap ïa baroh ki — ki rangbah , ki kynthei , ki khynnah , bad ki jingri jingdup ruh . thang Ki lut khoit ïa ki shnong baroh kiba don ha kata ka thain .
translation.en: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin , and smote them with the edge of the sword , as well the men of every city , as the beast , and all that came to hand : also they set on fire all the cities that they came to .

translation.kha: U jingbei u ïohi ïa ka jingshitom kaba bymlarkam jong ki Israel ; ym don jingiashah mano ruh ban ïarap ïa ki .
translation.en: For the  Lord  saw the affliction of Israel , that it was very bitter : for there was not any shut up , nor any left , nor any helper for Israel .

translation.kha: U angel jong Trai u paw ha u , u da ïeng ha ka kamon jong ka duwan ha kaba la thang ïa ka jingiwbih .
translation.en: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense .
When the scorner is punished , the simple is made wise : and when the wise is instructed , he receiveth knowledge .
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u sngewsarong u ïoh ïa la ka jingpynshitom , wat u briew u bym don ka bor pyrkhat u ïoh jinghikai . Uta uba stad un nang na kata kaba la hikai ïa u .

translation.en: So I sware in my wrath , They shall not enter into my rest . )
translation.kha: Nga la bitar bad nga la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang : ‘ Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingjahthait !’
Namar kiba kum kine kiei kiei , ka jingbitar jong U Blei ka wan thawdur kito ki Nalorkata Shuah u Tamarisk
translation.en: For which things  sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience :
For a servant when he reigneth  ; and a fool when he is filled with meat  ;
translation.kha: u mraw uba kylla long syiem , u bieit uba u ïoh ban bam ïa baroh kat kaba u kwah ,

saiñ kynthup ïa ki nongbah baroh jong ka jaka padun phyrnai ka hima baroh kawei jong ryntih Sihon u syiem Amor , uba la synshar ha Heshbon . U Moses u la jop ïa u , bad ruh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki kheit : u Ebi , u Rekem sngewlem u Sur , u Hur jingïabuaid bad u Reba . Kine thew ki la synshar na ka bynta u Sihon .
translation.en: And all the cities of the plain , and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites , which reigned in Heshbon , whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian , Evi , and Rekem , and Zur , and Hur , and Reba , which were dukes of Sihon , dwelling in the country .
Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil , to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives ?
translation.kha: Hato ka dei ïa ngi ban bud ïa ka nuksa jong phi bad ban ym kohnguh ïa U Blei jong ngi da kaba shongkurim ïa ki kynthei nongwei ?

translation.en: Behold , I Paul say unto you , that if ye be circumcised , Christ shall profit you nothing .
translation.kha: To shahshkor! Nga , u Paul , nga ïathuh ha phi ba lada phi shah ban otsher ïa lade , ka mut ba U Khrist un ym myntoi da lei lei ïa phi .

translation.en: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech s head , and all to brake his skull .
translation.kha: Hynrei kawei ka kynthei ka pynhap najrong da u mawtylliat halor ka khlieh jong u , bad ka shynrong khlieh jong u ka la pait .
Te ngan lah ban jubab ïa kito kiba ibeiñ ïa nga namar nga shaniah ka ktien jong me .
translation.en: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me : for I trust in thy word .
Of such an one will I glory : yet of myself I will not glory , but in mine infirmities .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan sngewsarong shaphang une u briew — hynrei ngan ym kob sarong shaphang ïa lade , lait noh ïa kiei kiei kiba pynpaw haduh katno nga long uba tlot .

translation.en: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured  ; and all thine adversaries , every one of them , shall go into captivity  ; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil , and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , baroh kiba klun ïa phi kin shah klun , bad ïa baroh ki nongshun jong phi yn rah noh kum ki koidi . Ïa baroh kiba banbeiñ ïa phi yn banbeiñ , bad ïa baroh kiba lute ïa phi yn lute .

translation.en: And immediately he arose , took up the bed , and went forth before them all  ; insomuch that they were all amazed , and glorified God , saying , We never saw it on this fashion .

And when he came unto Lehi , the Philistines shouted against him : and the Spirit of the  Lord  came mightily upon him , and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire , and his bands loosed from off his hands .
translation.kha: Ynda u poi ha Lehi , ki Philistia ki wan mareh sha u , ki da ïarisa ïa u . Hangta hi ka bor jong U  Trai  ka pynshaitbor ïa u , bad u bthat ïa ki tyllai kiba la khum ïa ki ksang ti bad ki kti jong u kum ki  saihon kiba la kem ding .
Wat ju pynbeit ïa u briew uba hangamei ; un ïa isih phi na ka bynta kata . Hynrei lada phi pynbeit ïa briew u uba stad , un burom ïa phi .
translation.en: Reprove not a scorner , lest he hate thee : rebuke a wise man , and he will love thee .

translation.kha: Nangta u Phestos , hadien ba u la ïakren bad ki nongai jingmut u , u jubab Me la apil u Patsha , u men leit .
translation.en: Then Festus , when he had conferred with the council , answered , Hast thou appealed unto Caesar ? unto Caesar shalt thou go .
I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen  ; he shall surely deal with him : I have driven him out for his wickedness .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause .
But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world , and the resurrection from the dead , neither marry , nor are given in marriage :

translation.en: And they immediately left the ship and their father , and followed him .

translation.en: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door : and all the people rose up and worshipped , every man in his tent door .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki tang shu ïohi ïa uta u rishot lyoh ba u ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ki dem khrup .

Hato me la peit-thuh ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ? U Trai u kylli . Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba ïaineh bad uba bha kat ma u . U mane ïa nga u bad kiar ban ym leh ïa kano kano kaba sniew . Me kynshuit ïa nga ban shah ïa me ban tur pyrshah ïa u don khlem kano kano ka daw , hynrei u Job u ïailong uba hi ïaineh kumba u ju long .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ? and still he holdeth fast his integrity , although thou movedst me against him , to destroy him without cause .

translation.kha: U Jisu u mut ban ong ba u Lasaros u la ïap , hynrei ki teh pyrkhat ba u mut ba u shu ïohthiah .
translation.en: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death : but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep .

And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks , two hundred rams , four hundred lambs  ; and for a sin offering for all Israel , twelve he goats , according to the number of the tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang , ki ai shispah tylli ki masi kyrtong , arspah ki langbrot , bad sawspah tylli ki khunlangbrot kum ki jingainguh thang , bad khat-ar tylli ki blang kum ki jingainguh ïa ka pop , uwei na ka bynta kawei ka jait ki Israel .
U ïohthiah u la ïap , bad u khun jingïaikren u , u Manasseh u long syiem ha ka jaka jong suba .
translation.en: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers : and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead .
Burning for burning , wound for wound , stripe for stripe .
translation.kha: kaba ing namar kaba ing , ka jingmong namar ka jingmong , ka jingjngem snam namar ka jingjngem snam .

translation.en: Then the king said unto me , For what dost thou make request ? So I prayed to the God of heaven .
translation.kha: U patsha u kylli ,  Kaei kaba me kwah ?
Ki briew kiba kin nang ïoh ka nam ka burom , hynrei ki kiba mutlop kin nang mad ka jingjahburom .
translation.en: The wise shall inherit glory : but shame shall be the promotion of fools .
And I will not have mercy upon her children  ; for they be the children of whoredoms .
translation.kha: Ngan ym pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki khun jong ka ; ki long ki khun jong ka nuti bym don jinglehrain .
mut ba nga dei ban da ïoh ïa ka jingphla u briew ; nga ong ïa kane ba ba phin im .
translation.en: But I receive not testimony from man : but these things I say , that ye might be saved .
All ye that are about him , bemoan him  ; and all ye that know his name , say , How is the strong staff broken , and the beautiful rod !
translation.kha: To ïambriew na ka bynta kata ka hima , phi kiba shong marjan , phi baroh kiba tip ïa ka jingpawnam jong ka . To ong , ‘ Ka jingsynshar bakhrawbor jong ka la pyndkut ; ka burom bad ka bor jong ka kam don shuh .’

translation.en: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you , to do them , to love the  Lord  your God , to walk in all his ways , and to cleave unto him  ;
translation.kha: Sumar bad lehhok ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi : Ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , leh ïa kata baroh kaba u hukum , bad ïaineh ha u .

translation.en: But if a man walk in the night , he stumbleth , because there is no light in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u ïaid ha ka por mynmiet u jynthut , namar um don ka jingshai .

Haba uta u rangbah u ïathuh ka shaphang Synduk ka Jutang , u Eli u kyllon da lyndang na la ka jaka shong harud kaba khyrdop . U la tymmen palat bad bad sngaid kata ka jinghap ka la pynkheiñ ïa u ryndang jong u , bad u la ïap U . la long u nongïalam ha Israel sawphew snem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he made mention of the ark of God , that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate , and his neck brake , and he died : for he was an old man , and heavy . And he had judged Israel forty years .

translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid bad baroh ki rangbah jong u ki la jam Mahseïah shiliang ïohphet Jordan . U ih doh ïa u Barsillai bad jingshongkurim nongïam ha u lynti la ka jingkyrkhu kyrdoh , bad u Barsillai u leit ñiewkor noh sha ïing .
translation.en: And all the people went over Jordan . And when the king was come over , the king kissed Barzillai , and blessed him  ; and he returned unto his own place .

translation.kha: Kumta to kup ka jaiñ khain , bad Hynñiew ïam bad 65 sngewsih namar ka jingbitar shla jong U Trai rung thylli la phai noh na ka Judah .
translation.en: For this gird you with sackcloth , lament and howl : for the fierce anger of the  Lord  is not turned back from us .
And their forty sockets of silver  ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .
translation.kha: lem bad sawphew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei ka jingker .
da kaba ïadei ïa U Blei , bad lehkmen ha ka jingbhasbun jong ki briew baroh . Bad riewspah’ ka sngi U Trai jingïadih nang pynïasoh ha ka Patsha jong ki shem kito kiba la pynim .
translation.en: Praising God , and having favour with all the people . And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved .

So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found , and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground : and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one .
translation.kha: Ngin shem ïa u Dabid hangno hangno ha kaba u don , bad ngin tur ïaleh ïa u ha shuwa ba un tip kaei kaba jia . Ma u lane uno uno na ki rangbah jong u kin ym lait im .

translation.en: And he said ,  So is the kingdom of God , as if a man should cast seed into the ground  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ka Hima U Blei ka ong kumne . U briew u bet symbai ha la ka lyngkha .

translation.en: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder  ; so he shall open , and none shall shut  ; and he shall shut , and none shall open .
translation.kha: Ngan ai lut ha u , ka iktiar hapoh jong u syiem , uba hiarpateng jong u Dabid . Un don ki shabi jong ka jaka treikam ; kaei kaba u plie , ym don mano mano ban khang , bad kaei kaba u khang , ym don mano mano ban plie .

translation.en: A good man sheweth favour , and lendeth : he will guide his affairs with discretion .
translation.kha: Suk uta u briew uba sbun ha ka jingairam jong u , uba pynïaid hok ïa ka kam khaïi jong u .

translation.en: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth : for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Naduh kaba sdang eh jong ka histori jong ki , ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah ki la pynsngewsih ïa nga bad ki la pynbitar ïa nga da kaei kaba ki la leh .

translation.en: The glory of the  Lord  shall endure for ever : the  Lord  shall rejoice in his works .
translation.kha: To ka burom jong U  Trai  kan neh junom ! To U  Trai  un kmen ïa kaei kaba u la thaw !
Bad lada ïa ka burom U Blei la pynpaw lyngba jong u , te U Blei un pynpaw ïa ka pynitynnat jong U Khun U Briew ha lade , bad un leh kumta kumne kumne .
translation.en: If God be glorified in him , God shall also glorify him in himself , and shall straightway glorify him .

translation.kha: Baroh ki la bam ïa ujuh u ba kpu kynja mynsiem bad ki la dih ïa kajuh ka jingdih ba kynja mynsiem . Ki dih la na uta u mawsiang kynja ba mynsiem ba la leit lem bad ki ; bad uta u mawsiang u la long U Khrist hi .
translation.en: And did all drink the same spiritual drink : for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them : and that Rock was Christ .
And they said unto him , Why do the disciples of John fast often , and make prayers , and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees  ; but thine eat and drink ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la ong ïa U Jisu ,  Ki synran jong U Ïoannis ki shahjingit man ka por bad ki duwai , bad ki synran jong ki Pharisi ki leh kumjuh , hynrei ki synran jong me ki ïabam bad ïadih .

translation.en: Crying out , Men of Israel , help : This is the man , that teacheth all men every where against the people , and the law , and this place : and further brought Greeks also into the temple , and hath polluted this holy place .
translation.kha: Ko ki rangbah Israel !  ki la pyrta .  To ïarap ! Dei une u briew uba leit kylleng kylleng da kaba hikai ïa uwei pa uwei pyrshah ïa ki paid Israel , ïa ka Hukum u Moses , bad ïa kane ka Templ . Bad mynta u la wan ïalam wat katto katne ngut ki Jentil shapoh ka Templ bad pyntngit ïa kane ka jaka bakhuid !
Ka jingjynjar ka wan . Phin wad ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei phin ym shem ïa . ka
translation.en: Destruction cometh  ; and they shall seek peace , and there shall be none .
And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt . And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh , and went throughout all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U Joseph u la dap laiphew snem ka rta mynba u sdang ban treikam na ka bynta u syiem Ijipt . U la iehnoh ïa ka ïingsyiem bad u leit kylleng ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: Raging waves of the sea , foaming out their own shame  ; wandering stars , to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever .
translation.kha: Ki long kum ki jingat phyllung ba khih phaloh jong ka duriaw , da ki jingleh bakhlemrain jong ki , ki pynpaw kum ki sboh sabon . Ki long kum ki khlur ba ïaid sakma , ïa kiba U Blei u la buh lypa ïa ka jaka kaba dum tliw tliw junom .

translation.en: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel , They are entangled in the land , the wilderness hath shut them in .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh un sa tharai ba ki Israel ki la phet sakma bad ba ki la shah khang kut ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man , and with the seed of beast .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong ba ka por kan wan haba ngan pyndap ïa ka ri Israel bad Judah da ki briew bad ki mrad .
Mynta to sngap ïa ki ktien jingbatai jong nga .
translation.en: Hear diligently my speech , and my declaration with your ears .
Then said Saul unto the people that were with him , Number now , and see who is gone from us . And when they had numbered , behold , Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u ong ha la ki rangbah ,  Ñiew ïa ki shipai bad wad uei uba jah .  Ki leh kumta , bad ki shem ba u Jonathan bad u samla uba bah ïa ki atiar jong u kim don .
U Mikah u ong , Shong noh . Long u nongaibuit bad u lyngdoh jong nga , ngan ïa phi shiphew ki sbai rupa shisnem , ki jaiñ bad ka jingbam ïa .
translation.en: And Micah said unto him , Dwell with me , and be unto me a father and a priest , and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year , and a suit of apparel , and thy victuals . So the Levite went in .

translation.kha: ki ong Don sanphew ngut na , baroh ki rangbah bakhlaiñ Ïa ngin leit wad u kynrad jong phi . Lehse U Mynsiem jong U Trai la rah noh ïa u bad iehnoh u uno re uno u lumbah lane ha kano re kano ka them . Em , phim dei ban , u Elisha u jubab .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Behold now , there be with thy servants fifty strong men  ; let them go , we pray thee , and seek thy master : lest peradventure the Spirit of the  Lord  hath taken him up , and cast him upon some mountain , or into some valley . And he said , Ye shall not send .
If thou count me therefore a partner , receive him as myself .
translation.kha: Namarkata , lada me pyrkhat ïa nga kum u para ba-ïatrei lem jong me , to pdiang sngewbha pat ïa u kumba men pdiang sngewbha ïa nga .

translation.en: It is written in the prophets , And they shall be all taught of God . Every man therefore that hath heard , and hath learned of the Father , cometh unto me .
translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh , ‘ Uwei pa uwei baroh un ïoh hikai na U Blei .’ Uno uno uba shahshkor ïa U Kpa bad ïoh hikai na u , u wan sha nga .

translation.en: And I will walk among you , and will be your God , and ye shall be my people .
translation.kha: Ngan long ryngkat bad phi ; ngan long U Blei jong phi , bad phin long ki briew jong nga .
U nongrep uba trei shitom u don pahuh ka bam , hynrei ka ka long bieit jingleh ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka por ha ki kam bymmyntoi .
translation.en: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread : but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki hynñiew ngut ki angel uba la don ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang kiba dap da ki hynñiew ki khlam kiba khatduh la wan sha nga u la ong To , bad pyn-i ha me ïa ka Nongleitkurim , tnga jong U Khunlangbrot .
translation.en: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues , and talked with me , saying , Come hither , I will shew thee the bride , the Lamb s wife .
That I may make it manifest , as I ought to speak .
translation.kha: To Duwai , te , ba nga lah ban kren , kumba nga dei , ha kata ka rukom ba kan long kaba shai .

translation.en: So there was hail , and fire mingled with the hail , very grievous , such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka  erïong kaba jur tam ba ka Ijipt ka la mad ha ka histori jong ka baroh .
Pynban , mynta , phi dei ban map ïa u bad ban ïa u , khnang ban ïada ïa u na kaba sngewsih eh kat ban da kyntait noh shisyndon u .
translation.en: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him , and comfort him , lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow .
And Hiram sent to Solomon , saying , I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for : and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar , and concerning timber of fir .
translation.kha: Nangta u Hiram u phah ïa kane ka khubor harum sha u Solomon :  Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor jong me , bad nga kloi ban leh ïa kaei kaba me pan . Ngan pynbiang ïa ki dieng Kedar bad ki dieng Kseh .

translation.en: And Saul said , Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son . And Jonathan was taken .
translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ,  To rai hapdeng jong nga bad u Jonathan u khun jong nga .  La kdew ïa u Jonathan .

translation.en: And they blessed Rebekah , and said unto her , Thou art our sister , be thou the mother of thousands of millions , and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them .
translation.kha: Bad ki la kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa ka Rebekka da kine ki kyntien :  To phi , ka para , phin long ka kmie u paidbah byllien ! To ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin da jop thiaw ïa ki nongbah jong ki nongshun jong ki !

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that from one new moon to another , and from one sabbath to another , shall all flesh come to worship before me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha man kawei pa kawei ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ha man kawei pa kawei ka Sabbaton , ki jaitbynriew na ki hima baroh kin wan ban mane ïa nga hangne ha Jerusalem ,  ong U  Trai .

bad la pyntrei ïa ki jong ka ha ki kurat , ki mohkhiew , bad ki sdie nar , bad u la pynbor ïa ki ban trei ha kaba shna maw-it . U la leh kumjuh ki briew jong pat ki nongrit jong ka baroh . Nangta u lem bad ki rangbah ki la leit phai sha .
translation.en: And he brought forth the people that were therein , and put them under saws , and under harrows of iron , and under axes of iron , and made them pass through the brickkiln : and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon . So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem .
And Crispus , the chief ruler of the synagogue , believed on the Lord with all his house  ; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed , and were baptized .
translation.kha: U Krispos , uba long u nongïalam jong ka synagog , u la ngeit ha U Trai , lem bad ka longïing jong u baroh ; bad kiba bun kiwei pat ki briew ha Korinth ki la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki la ngeit , bad la pynbaptis ïa ki .

translation.en: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying , Why hast thou done so ? and he also was a very goodly man  ; and his mother bare him after Absalom .
translation.kha: Mynta ba u Absalom u la ïap , u Adonijah , u khun jong u Dabid bad ka Haggith , u dei u khun heh uba dang im . U long u briew uba bhabriew . U Dabid um pat ju sneng tyngeh ïa u shaphang kano kano , bad u la kwah eh ban long syiem . U la pynkhreh ïa lade ki kali ïapom , ki kulai , bad ka kynhun synran kaba don sanphew ngut ki rangbah .
Haba ki bymman ki , ka jingkyrmen jong ki ruh ka ïap bad . jingsngewskhem halor ka spah ïalam shano shano ruh .
translation.en: When a wicked man dieth , his expectation shall perish : and the hope of unjust men perisheth .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ïa nga
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa u ba u thiah hangta , Resen u la tip ïa-thngan uta u briew u la pang la hangtei bah ; kumta u la kylli ïa u , Me kwah Tba Ngin ?
translation.en: When Jesus saw him lie , and knew that he had been now a long time in that case , he saith unto him ,  Wilt thou be made whole ?
How beautiful are thy feet with shoes , O prince s daughter ! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels , the work of the hands of a cunning workman .
translation.kha: Ko kaba bhabriew tam napdeng ki kynthei , shano uba ieit jong phi u la leit ? To ïathuh ïa ngi na kano ka lynti uba ieit jong phi u leit , ba kumta ngi lah ban ïarap ïa phi ban shem ïa u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  took me as I followed the flock , and the  Lord  said unto me , Go , prophesy unto my people Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la shim ïa nga na ka kam kum u nongaplangbrot bad u la hukum ïa nga ban wan bad ïathuhlypa ha ki briew jong u ki Israel .

translation.en: And said , O  Lord  God of Israel , why is this come to pass in Israel , that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , balei kane ka la jia ? Balei ba ka jait Benjamin kan sa jah noh na Israel ?
Lada phi leh kumta , ïa ki thiar jong phi yn da pyndap u kew , bad phin ïoh ruh shibun bha ka waiñ haduh ba lah phim shuh ban pynlang ïa ka .
translation.en: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty , and thy presses shall burst out with new wine .

translation.kha: U Dabid shatei uba Kamra pien tang da angkor jaiñ linen , u la shadkmen da kiei! bor jong u baroh ban jingïohthiah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And David danced before the  Lord  with all his might  ; and David was girded with a linen ephod .
And when the man rose up to depart , his father in law urged him : therefore he lodged there again .
translation.kha: U Lebi u ïeng joit ban leit noh , hynrei u kpa u pynbor ïa u ban sah shuwa , kumta u sah sa shi miet hangta .
Pynban , hadien lai snem , ar ngut na ki mraw jong u Shimei ki la phet sha u noh Akhish , u syiem ka Gath , u khun jong u Maakah .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of three years , that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath . And they told Shimei , saying , Behold , thy servants be in Gath .

translation.kha: Ki la Lebanon tynjuh palat da ki jingjynjar kiba ki la ïaid lyngba ; hynrei ka jingkmen jong ki ka la long kaba khraw Raamah pei katta ba Anammelekh Asalaïah longrynïeng kiba pynïasyriem shikatdei eh bakhor ka nongsynran jong ki , wat markylliang Anathoth long kiba Oniks shisha .
translation.en: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam ki briew ha Jingkhawai ka Niam Ka Jinglait , u syiem Josaïah u ai la sngewbha na kynhun ki jong ki jingri jong u laiphew hajar tylli ki blang , ki langbrot , bad ki khunblang , bad lai hajar tylli ki masi lyngraw .
translation.en: And Josiah gave to the people , of the flock , lambs and kids , all for the passover offerings , for all that were present , to the number of thirty thousand , and three thousand bullocks : these were of the king s substance .

translation.kha: Wat Paidbah’ shongkha Neri ka jingsuhsieng ka tnga u kpa jong me , naba ka ruh ka dei Perga para jong me .
translation.en: The nakedness of thy father s wife s daughter , begotten of thy father , she is thy sister , thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .

translation.kha: Moses shym la ai kano kano ka jaka ha ka jait Lebi . Kumba U Trai u la bthah ha u Moses , ki ban pdiang kum ka jong ki , ïa ka bhah jong ki jingainguh ba la ha ka duwan sha U U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance  ; the sacrifices of the  Lord  God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance , as he said unto them .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah bad ka dorbar baroh kawei ki la pyrshang ban wad ki sakhi pyrshah ïa U khnang ban pynïap noh ïa u , hynrei kim shym la shem kano kano ruh .
translation.en: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death  ; and found none .
For whom he did foreknow , he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son , that he might be the firstborn among many brethren .
translation.kha: Kito ïa kiba U Blei u la lah jied lypa u la pynkyrpang ruh ban long kum U Khun jong u , khnang ba U Khun un long uba nyngkong hapdeng ki para .
Kumta kim ïalong shuh ar ngut , hynrei kawei . Uno uno u briew um dei ban pynïakhlad te ïa kaei kaba Blei la lang .
translation.en: Wherefore they are no more twain , but one flesh . What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ha khmat jong , bad u ong , ki para ri nga , to shahshkor ïa nga . Nga la kwah ban tei ïingshong neh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ka jingïuhkjat jong U Trai U Blei jong ngi . Nga la ban tei ïa ka Templ ban ai burom ïa u ,
translation.en: Then David the king stood up upon his feet , and said , Hear me , my brethren , and my people : As for me , I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and for the footstool of our God , and had made ready for the building :
Whether therefore ye eat , or drink , or whatsoever ye do , do all to the glory of God .
translation.kha: Kumta , ha kaei kaei kaba phi leh , ha kaba bam ne ha kaba dih , to leh phi ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka burom U Blei .
A Pyndait kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ! Phi thaw ki Bathymmai pyn-ap ba-itynnat na ka syntuid ki nongïathuhlypa — rep ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ki kpa rim jong pham ki la hangthie mian
translation.en: Woe unto you ! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets , and your fathers killed them .

translation.kha: Ki don ki jingïadei paralok ki bymneh , hynrei ki don ki paralok kiba lah ban shaniah ban ïa ki hynmen para .
translation.en: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly : and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka Moab ka la ju long kaba shongshngain ym bad pat ju ïalam ïa mraw ka Ka . Moab ka long kum ka waiñ kaba la ieh shu kumta khlem pynkhih bad ka bym ju phylliew uwei na u klong sha uwei pat . Ïa ka jingsuhsieng jong ka ym pat shu pynsniew , bad ka jingmad jong ka , ka long kaba bang kumba ju long .
translation.en: Moab hath been at ease from his youth , and he hath settled on his lees , and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel , neither hath he gone into captivity : therefore his taste remained in him , and his scent is not changed .
Be merciful , O  Lord  , unto thy people Israel , whom thou hast redeemed , and lay not innocent blood unto thy people of Israel s charge . And the blood shall be forgiven them .

translation.en: And Absalom came to the king , and said , Behold now , thy servant hath sheepshearers  ; let the king , I beseech thee , and his servants go with thy servant .
But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps .

kata ka por ka poi , U Trai un wai uwei u nongkhap shñiuh sha shiliang ka wah Ïuphratis — u patsha jong ka Assyria ! bad un khi tmain jong phi bad ïa ki shñiuh halor ki khlieh bad ki met jong phi .
translation.en: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired , namely , by them beyond the river , by the king of Assyria , the head , and the hair of the feet : and it shall also consume the beard .
Now I tell you before it come , that , when it is come to pass , ye may believe that I am he .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa kane mynta , khnang ba haba kata kan jia , phin ngeit ba ‘ Nga long uba nga long .’
U la bariewblei ha nga shah Ko Elkosh u Abihail , hato kine ki Kherub ki lah ban ïoh pat ïa ka jingim ? Nga la Lydda Atad A Trai Nongsynshar , tang Hasarmabeth me uba lah ban wahduid ïa kata !
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , can these bones live ? And I answered , O Lord  God  , thou knowest .

translation.kha: Da kumne u Jesse jaijai wan ïalam hynñiew ngut kynsit rah shynrang Proberb Rekem sha Pynkhuid Samuel . Bad u Samuel u jingibieit ha u , Em , U Trai um shym la jied ïano ïano na kine .
translation.en: Again , Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel . And Samuel said unto Jesse , The  Lord  hath not chosen these .
By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples , if ye have love one to another .
translation.kha: Lada phi don ka jingieit iwei ïa iwei , te baroh kin tip ba phi long ki synran jong nga . Kumba nga la ieit ïa phi , kumta phi dei ban ieit iwei ïa iwei .
Hadien ka jingïap jong u Abraham , U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa u Isaak u khun jong u , sah hajan uba Ka Pukri jong Uta Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham , that God blessed his son Isaac  ; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai–roi .
And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city  ; and every male was circumcised , all that went out of the gate of his city .
translation.kha: Baroh ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka nongbah ki la ïamynjur ïa kaei kaba u Hamor bad u Shekhem ki ai jingmut , bad baroh ki shynrang ki la shah otsher .

translation.en: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots , and the king of Maacah and his people  ; who came and pitched before Medeba . And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities , and came to battle .
translation.kha: Ki laiphew ar hajar tylli ki kali ïapom kiba ki wai bad ka kynhun shipai u syiem Maakah ki wan sher dara hajan ka Medeba . Ki Ammon ruh ki wan na baroh ki nongbah jong ki bad ki long kiba la kloi ban ïaleh .

translation.en: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be , then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received : so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem jong ka Jingpynïoh pat , ynda haba baroh ka bri ka khyndew ïa kaba la die la pynïoh pat sha ki trai khyndew , ïa ka jingïohkynti jong ki khun kynthei jong u Selophehad yn kynthup lang junom ha kata ka jait kaba ki ïashongkurim bad kan long ka jingduh ïa ka jait jong ngi .

translation.en: And Absalom came to the king , and said , Behold now , thy servant hath sheepshearers  ; let the king , I beseech thee , and his servants go with thy servant .

translation.en: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the  Lord  : he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand .
translation.kha: Bad u Elisha u bteng ,  Hynrei kane ka long kaba jem ïa U  Trai  ban leh ; un ai ruh ha phi ka jingjop halor ki Moab .

translation.en: For the day is near , even the day of the  Lord  is near , a cloudy day  ; it shall be the time of the heathen .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la jan , ka sngi haba U  Trai  un leh , ka sngi jong ki lyoh bad jingjynjar ïa ki jaitbynriew .
U Mahath u la lah ong ha u ïa-ap , U Pharaoh un ïai kyntait ban shahshkor jingpynpra phi khnang ba Mynsngi lah ban Semakhaïah kham bun ki kambah jong nga ha Ijipt .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you  ; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Uta u syiem u ban synshar Kaba phi un leh kumne , u Samuel u pynshai pynpyiar Un pynlong shipai tyllep ki khun shynrang jong phi ; don na ki , ki Kylli trei ha ki kali ïapom jong u , don ki ban long ki shipai shong Jia , bad bakylluid ruh ki ban mareh na khmat ki kali jingingiew jingkyntait u .
translation.en: And he said , This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you : He will take your sons , and appoint them for himself , for his chariots , and to be his horsemen  ; and some shall run before his chariots .
( For the  Lord  thy God is a merciful God  ; ) he will not forsake thee , neither destroy thee , nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them .
translation.kha: U long U Blei uba isynei . Un ym iehnoh lane pynjot ïa phi , bad un ym klet ïa ka jutang kaba u hi u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
Na ka khet ha syiem ka nongbah Susa jong ka Persia u , syiem Serksis u synshar halor ki shispah arphew hynñiew tylli ki jylla , naduh India haduh Sudan .
translation.en: That in those days , when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom , which was in Shushan the palace ,

translation.kha: U Ahimaas , uba shongkurim ïa ka Shispah , kawei pat na ki khun kynthei jong Kesis Solomon : ka ri Naphtali
translation.en: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali  ; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife :
Be not thou envious against evil men , neither desire to be with them .
translation.kha: Wat bishni ïa ki riewsniew , bad wat pyrshang ban ïalang paralok bad ki .

Kumta ki Dan ki jied san ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit na diengtied ki Syndong ha ka jait bad ki phah ïa ki na bahakhlieh shnong Sorah bad Eshtaol ryngkat bad ki jingbthah Urbanos kin Molekh jingkhynñiuh ïa ka ri . Ynda ki poi ha ri lum Ephraim , ki sah ha ïing u Elealeh .
translation.en: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts , men of valour , from Zorah , and from Eshtaol , to spy out the land , and to search it  ; and they said unto them , Go , search the land : who when they came to mount Ephraim , to the house of Micah , they lodged there .

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Bethel ki phah la ïa u Shareser bad ïa u Regemmelekh bad ïa ki rangbah jong ki ka sha Templ jong U Trai Badonbor Baroh ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong U Trai
translation.en: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regem–melech , and their men , to pray before the  Lord  ,

translation.kha: Ha la ka buh ïa ka duwan ksiar na ka ban bynta thang ïa ki jingiwbih bad ïa ka ka Synduk Jutang ïa kaba la sop bad ksiar la don u khiew ksiar lem bad ka manna ha u , u diengduh jong u Aaron uba la mih sla , bad ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum .
translation.en: Which had the golden censer , and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold , wherein was the golden pot that had manna , and Aaron s rod that budded , and the tables of the covenant  ;
But when his brethren were gone up , then went he also up unto the feast , not openly , but as it were in secret .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki para shynrang jong u ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam , U Jisu ruh u la leit ; pynban , um shym la leit ha kaba paw , hynrei ha kaba rieh .

translation.en: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places : thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations  ; and thou shalt be called , The repairer of the breach , The restorer of paths to dwell in .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong phi kin tei pat ïa kaei kaba la pra la slem bah , kin tei pat halor ki nongrim ba-mynshuwa . Yn tip ïa phi kum ki briew kiba tei pat ïa ki kynroh , kiba pynbha pat ïa ki ïing ba la pra .
Don u ban ong , sngewïahap shithi u Ïalam ki long kiba pyrkhing bad kiba Tyros , hynrei Ramath u don bad ngi lyntait , u long nongmih tlot , bad ki ktien jong u kim long khih ei!
translation.en: For his letters , say they , are weighty and powerful ; but his bodily presence is weak , and his speech contemptible .

translation.kha: U Trai Shaphat manna uba la wallam pat anna ki Ishmael bylla sha ïing na ka ri ka jinglongmraw , u la kular ba un sa wallam ïa kiwei pat ki briew masi ïasoh lang bad ki .
translation.en: The Lord  God  which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith , Yet will I gather others to him , beside those that are gathered unto him .
And Samuel died  ; and all the Israelites were gathered together , and lamented him , and buried him in his house at Ramah . And David arose , and went down to the wilderness of Paran .
translation.kha: Te u Samuel u la ïap , bad ki Israel baroh ki ïawanlang bad ïambriew na ka bynta jong u . Nangta ki tep ïa u ha ka ïing jong u ha Ramah . Hadien kane , u Dabid u leit sha ka ri khlaw Paran .
ka jingïohipaw U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah shajrong ïa nga bad wallam pat ïa sha kiba shah ringmraw ha Babilonia . Nangta ka jingïohipaw ka noh ,
translation.en: Afterwards the spirit took me up , and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea , to them of the captivity . So the vision that I had seen went up from me .
Then Peter began to say unto him , Lo , we have left all , and have followed thee .
translation.kha: Nangta U Petros u la kren ,  Khmih , ngi la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh bad ngi la bud ïa me .
Kumta la keiñ pyndep ïa ka jingtrei baroh ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon U Ryngkat Trai . Ki Israel ki la thaw ïa kata baroh kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished : and the children of Israel did according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses , so did they .

translation.kha: Te phi kumta long ki nongbud Ithnan u Trai , namar phi long ki khun kiba ieit eh jong U Blei ,
translation.en: Be ye therefore followers of God , as dear children ;

And when thou prayest , thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are : for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets , that they may be seen of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
translation.kha: Haba phi duwai , wat long kum ki riewarsap ! Ki ieit ban ïeng bad duwai ha ki synagog bad ha ki kyndong surok , khnang ba baroh kin ïohi ïa ki . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ki la ïoh lypa ïa ka jingsiew kaba pura .

translation.en: And say ye moreover , Behold , thy servant Jacob is behind us . For he said , I will appease him with the present that goeth before me , and afterward I will see his face  ; peradventure he will accept of me .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban ong , ‘ U shakri jong phi u Jakob u hadien jong ngi .’   U Jakob u la pyrkhat ,  Ngan pynum ïa ka mynsiem jong u da ki jingai sngewbha , bad haba nga ïakynduh ïa u , lehse un map ïa nga .

translation.en: And David the king came and sat before the  Lord  , and said , Who am I , O  Lord  God , and what is mine house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Dabid u rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , u shong bad u duwai ,  Ngam long uba dei hok ïa kaei kaba me la lah leh na ka bynta jong nga , ko  Trai  U Blei , lane ka longïing jong nga .

translation.en: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau  ; and the kingdom shall be the  Lord s .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah nongjop jong ka Jerusalem kin tur ïaleh ïa ka Edom bad kin synshar halor jong ka . Bad U  Trai  da lade hi un long u Syiem .

translation.en: And they come unto thee as the people cometh , and they sit before thee as my people , and they hear thy words , but they will not do them : for with their mouth they shew much love , but their heart goeth after their covetousness .
translation.kha: Kumta ki briew jong nga ki ïawan paidbah ban sngap aïu me don ban ong , hynrei kim leh satia ïa kaei kaba me ong ïa ki ba kin leh . Ki ktien ieit ki long ha ki rymmiang shyntur jong ki , hynrei ki ïai bteng ha ki rukom khwan myntoi jong ki .

translation.en: And I will set up one shepherd over them , and he shall feed them , even my servant David  ; he shall feed them , and he shall be their shepherd .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa u syiem uba kum u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba un long uwei u nongsharai jong ki , bad un sumar bha ïa ki .
To ka jingaiei U Jisu Khrist uba Trai ngi long bad phi baroh . Amen .
translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all . Amen .

translation.kha: Hato baroh ki niam ki lah Mynhynnin U Blei , ne tang Mih jinglong
translation.en: Are all religions pleasing to God , or is just one ?
And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards , and the caul that is above the liver , and the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them , and burn them upon the altar .
translation.kha: Nangta pat , weng noh ïa ka khleiñ baroh kaba sop ïa ki snier , ïa u dohnud , bad ïa ki khyllai baroh ar lem bad ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad thang ïa ki ha kata ka duwan kum ka jingainguh ïa nga .

U Jakob u ong ha ki , Lada kumta , te to leit rah ïa ki jingmih kiba kynsai tam jong kane ri ka ha ki byrni jong phi kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa uta u lat : khyndiat ka jingiwbih , khyndiat ka ngap , ki musli musla , ka mirr , soh-ot ki jait , bad ki almond .
translation.en: And their father Israel said unto them , If it must be so now , do this  ; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels , and carry down the man a present , a little balm , and a little honey , spices , and myrrh , nuts , and almonds :

translation.en: And the foolish said unto the wise , Give us of your oil  ; for our lamps are gone out .
O my people , what have I done unto thee ? and wherein have I wearied thee ? testify against me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki briew jong nga , nga la leh aïu ïa phi ? Kumno nga la long ka jingkit ïa phi ? To jubab ïa nga .

translation.en: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man  ; but that which cometh out of the mouth , this defileth a man .
translation.kha: Kam dei kata kaba rung shapoh ka shyntur jong u briew kaba pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid kat kum ka lehniam ; pynban , dei kaba mih shabar na ka , kaba pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid .
Wat bymneh Lum Sinai ruh banyngkong la pynbitar shla ïa U Trai kat haduh ban jingangnud ïa phi .
translation.en: Also in Horeb ye provoked the  Lord  to wrath , so that the  Lord  was angry with you to have destroyed you .
But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles , and made their minds evil affected against the brethren .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki bym shym la ngeit ki la pynkhih ïa ki Jentil bad ki la pynlong ïa ki ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa riewngeit .
Hadoram , Usal , ka Diklah ,
translation.en: And Hadoram , and Uzal , and Diklah ,

Bad mynta u la wan ïalam khohruh katto katne ngut ki Jentil jinglehieit ka Templ sheng pyntngit ïa kane ka jaka bakhuid !
translation.en: Crying out , Men of Israel , help : This is the man , that teacheth all men every where against the people , and the law , and this place : and further brought Greeks also into the temple , and hath polluted this holy place .
Ye that stand in the house of the  Lord  , in the courts of the house of our God ,
translation.kha: kiba ïeng ha ka ïing jong U  Trai  , ha ka Templ jong U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned , it is the gall of asps within him .
translation.kha: Hynrei hapoh ka kpoh jong u ka jingbam ka kylla kthang , ka kthang kum ka bih .

translation.en: While the Pharisees were gathered together , Jesus asked them ,
translation.kha: Haba katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la ïalumlang , U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki ,
Katba ki apostol ki mihnoh na ka Dorbar , ki la kmen , namar U jingkhum u la syngkai ïa ki , kiba bit ban shah ïa ka jahburom na ka bynta U Lyngdoh .
translation.en: And they departed from the presence of the council , rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name .
And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes , which is over against Galilee .
translation.kha: U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la leit da ka lieng sha ka thain Gadara , kaba don sha shiliang jong ka duriaw Galilaïa .

translation.en: For all the promises of God in him are yea , and in him Amen , unto the glory of God by us .
translation.kha: Dei namar kane lyngba U Jisu Khrist ba ngi ïa-ong  Amen  na ka bynta ka burom U Blei .

Kata ka jingïakut ka la long ka jong ki hi ; hynrei ha ka jingshisha , ki la don ïa ka jingsngew kit ram ban ïarap ïa ki . Namar jingïathmu Jiw ki la ïasam bynta lem ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba jinglehburom mynsiem jong Josaïah bad Gaash Jentil Jeroboam ki Ïashong ki lynñiar ban pyndonkam ïa ki Musri ba ki don ban ïarap ïa ki Jiw .
translation.en: It hath pleased them verily ; and their debtors they are . For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things , their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things .

translation.kha: Don shibun kiei kiei ba ngi hap ban ong shaphang ka bynta , hynrei ka long kaba eh ban batai ïa phi , namar phi long kiba suki katta ka ban .
translation.en: Of whom we have many things to say , and hard to be uttered , seeing ye are dull of hearing .

translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ki , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka na ka bynta jong ki , namar ki la khuslai bad kim lah ban leh ei ei langbrot khlem u nongsharai .
translation.en: But when he saw the multitudes , he was moved with compassion on them , because they fainted , and were scattered abroad , as sheep having no shepherd .

translation.kha: tian long ki khlieh jong ki kur kiba hiarpateng setkut idonburom Ladan . ( U Shimei u don lai ngut ki khun Naphish pyiar u Shelomoth , bunkam jingrang Ammihud bad u Haran . )
translation.en: The sons of Shimei  ; Shelomith , and Haziel , and Haran , three . These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan .

translation.kha: ka la long ka jingkñia kaba jong U Khrist , uba la long kum u uba khlem don jingthohbria lane jingduna .
translation.en: But with the precious blood of Christ , as of a lamb without blemish and without spot :
And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom  ; for Moses had laid his hands upon him : and the children of Israel hearkened unto him , and did as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U Joshua u khun jong u Nun u long uba la pyndap da ka jingstad , naba u Moses u la thung ïa u ban long u nongshimti pateng . Ki Israel ki kohnguh ïa u Joshua bad ki sumar ïa ki hukum ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki lyngba u Moses .
Ki ong , U Trai um ym ïohi ïa ngi ; U Blei ki Israel tian ithuh ei ïabiang .
translation.en: Yet they say , The  Lord  shall not see , neither shall the God of Jacob regard it .

translation.kha: Uta u ïashad phira u pynphuh , Nga ïohi ba jingairam briew Ka ha khmat u mareh kum u Ahimaas . U dei u briew uba bha , u syiem u ong , bad u wanrah ka khubor kaba bha .
translation.en: And the watchman said , Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok . And the king said , He is a good man , and cometh with good tidings .
And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats  hair .
translation.kha: Ki thir ruh ïa u shñiuh blang .

translation.en: For it is the day of the  Lord s  vengeance , and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka por ha kaba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa ka Seïon bad pynhiarkput halor ki nongshun jong ka .

translation.en: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem , and joy in my people : and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her , nor the voice of crying .
translation.kha: Ïa nga ruh yn pyndap da ka jingkmen namar ka Jerusalem bad ki briew jong ka . Hangta yn ym don shuh ka jingïam , yn ym don shuh ki ban khot kyrpad ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock , with thy estimation , for a trespass offering , unto the priest : and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not , and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: U dei ban wanlam sha u lyngdoh kum ïa ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat da u langbrot ne u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingpynshong dor ïa u kan long kat kum ba la buh . U lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew bad yn map ïa u .
Ma nga U Trai nga , maham ïa me ban shukor ym ïa lade da kaba pyrkhat ba ki nong Babilonia kin ym wan shuh , namar kin sa wan biang .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Deceive not yourselves , saying , The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us : for they shall not depart .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u nongbishar lane ïa u lyngdoh uba ha kata ka ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong phi ; u dei ban shah . Da kumta phin pynkhuid ïa kata jingbymman na Israel .
translation.en: And the man that will do presumptuously , and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the  Lord  thy God , or unto the judge , even that man shall die : and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel .

translation.kha: Katba U u halor lieng uta u briew uba u la ïa , ban leit bad me
translation.en: And when he was come into the ship , he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him .

translation.kha: Balei ngan ïa u Elisha ong ïa u syiem ka Israel . Khie leit bad kylli kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba u kpa bad ka jong me ki la kylli . Em u Joram u jubab . U dei U uba la buh ïa ngi lai ngut ha ka jingisynei jong syiem ka Moab .
translation.en: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel , What have I to do with thee ? get thee to the prophets of thy father , and to the prophets of thy mother . And the king of Israel said unto him , Nay : for the  Lord  hath called these three kings together , to deliver them into the hand of Moab .

translation.kha: kawei Kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ka long khat-ar mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan . Baroh kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki long katjuh jingheh ka .
translation.en: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : the curtains were all of one size .
