translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ïeng lum , ha ka phang jong ka Jerusalem Te ïa u lum Olib sa kad arliang na mihngi sepngi da ka them kaba khraw . Shiteng jong u lumbah un kynriah shaphang shatei bad jong u shaphang shathie .
translation.en: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives , which is before Jerusalem on the east , and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west , and there shall be a very great valley  ; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north , and half of it toward the south .

translation.kha: Me mut me dei uei ? Me don hok aïu ban shna ka jingtep lade ïa ha ka sharing mawsiang ?
translation.en: What hast thou here ? and whom hast thou here , that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here , as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high , and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock ?

And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day , and on the seventh day : and on the seventh day he shall purify himself , and wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and shall be clean at even .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , u briew uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam un synreit ïa ka um ha kita ki briew ki bymkhuid . Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u dei ban pynkhuid ïa kito , kiba , hadien ba ki la sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad sum ïa lade , ki kylla long kiba khuid ha ka por sep sngi kat kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: And Josiah gave to the people , of the flock , lambs and kids , all for the passover offerings , for all that were present , to the number of thirty thousand , and three thousand bullocks : these were of the king s substance .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam ki briew ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , u syiem Josaïah u la ai sngewbha na ki kynhun jong ki jingri jong u laiphew hajar tylli ki blang , ki langbrot , bad ki khunblang , bad lai hajar tylli ki masi lyngraw .
Haba ki dang mihnoh , ki ïakynduh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , kiba ap ïa . ki
translation.en: And they met Moses and Aaron , who stood in the way , as they came forth from Pharaoh :
And when they were come , and had gathered the church together , they rehearsed all that God had done with them , and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha Antiokh , ki la lumlang ïa ki briew jong ka balang bad ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la leh bad ki , bad kumno u la plie ka lynti na ka bynta ki Jentil ban ngeit .

translation.en: And Laban said unto him , I pray thee , if I have found favour in thine eyes , tarry : for I have learned by experience that the  Lord  hath blessed me for thy sake .
translation.kha: U Laban u ong ha u ,  Shah ba ngan ong ïa kane : nga la ïoh jingtip da kaba wad na U Blei ba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa nga namar jong me .

translation.en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter , and abode with him fifteen days .
translation.kha: Ka la long lai snem hadien ba nga la leit sha Jerusalem ban ïoh jingtip na u Petros , bad nga la sah bad u ar taïew .

translation.en: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden : and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen  ; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king .
translation.kha: U syiem u ïeng ha ka jingbitar , u mih na ka kamra bad u leit shabar sha ki kper ka ïingsyiem . U Haman u ïohi ba u syiem u la kut jingmut ban pynshitom ïa u na ka bynta kane , kumta u sah hangta ban kyrpad ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei na ka bynta ka jingim jong u .

translation.en: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together , and took his journey into a far country , and there wasted his substance with riotous living .
translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat sngi , u khun ba kham rit u la die ïa ka bynta jong ka jingdon jingem jong u bad u la mihnoh na ïing lem bad ka pisa . U la leit sha ka ri kaba jngai , ha kaba u la pynsyrwa ei ïa ka pisa jong u ha ka jingim ba-thurmur .

translation.en: Folly is set in great dignity , and the rich sit in low place .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew ba-mutlop la ai ki kyrdan ba don iktiar katba ïa kiba riewspah la leh bymsuidñiew .

shakor paradais noh ïa kito ki riewbymman ha Khatphra , ba kulai ïoh pynïap ïa ki bad ban weng noh ïa kane plain jingbymman na Israel . Hynrei ki briew Gad Benjamin ieit salia ïa kiwei pat ki jait Shillong Blastos
translation.en: Now therefore deliver us the men , the children of Belial , which are in Gibeah , that we may put them to death , and put away evil from Israel . But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel :
But withal prepare me also a lodging : for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , to pynkhreh ïa ka kamra na ka bynta jong nga , namar nga kyrmen ba U Blei un jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong phi baroh bad ban ai pat ïa nga ha me .
U Thomas u jubab la ïa u , U Trai jong nga bad U Blei jong nga !
translation.en: And Thomas answered and said unto him , My Lord and my God .
And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven , having great power  ; and the earth was lightened with his glory .
translation.kha: Hadien kane nga la ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel uba wan hiar na bneng . U la don ka bor bakhraw , bad ka jingphyrnai jong u ka la pynthaba ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
Abigail hangne ïa ka Ephod , u Saul u ishyrkhei ha u Ahijah u lyngdoh . ( Ha dait-thah jingthrang sngi u Ahijah u dang rah ïa ka ha ishongkun ki paid Israel . )
translation.en: And Saul said unto Ahiah , Bring hither the ark of God . For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel .
And the man said , They are departed hence  ; for I heard them say , Let us go to Dothan . And Joseph went after his brethren , and found them in Dothan .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u jubab ,  Ki la ïaleit . Nga la ïohsngew ba ki ong ba kin leit sha Dothan .  Kumta u Joseph u leit beh nadien jong ki bad u lap ïa ki ha Dothan .

translation.en: Let them not depart from thine eyes  ; keep them in the midst of thine heart .
translation.kha: Wat shah ba kin phet noh na phi ; kynmaw bad ri kyndong ïa ki ha ka dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga ,

translation.en: Thy sun shall no more go down  ; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself : for the  Lord  shall be thine everlasting light , and the days of thy mourning shall be ended .
translation.kha: Ki sngi ka jingjynjar jong pha kin kut noh . Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan long ka jingshai bymjukut jong pha , kham palat ban ïa ka sngi bad u bnai .

Kumta u rangbah uba peit Kieng ka ïingsyiem bad u rangbah synshar uba dei peit ïa ka nongbah , ryngkat bad ki riewpawkhmat bad ki nongsumar , ki shankhung phah Kenas Sarsekhim ka khubor sha u jaiñkup : Ngi long ki shakri jong phi bad ngi long kiba la kloi ban :2 kat ïa Hynriew phi ong ; hynrei ngin jingïada thung syiem apil ïano ; pyndkoh katba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam pynbuh
translation.en: And he that was over the house , and he that was over the city , the elders also , and the bringers up of the children , sent to Jehu , saying , We are thy servants , and will do all that thou shalt bid us  ; we will not make any king : do thou that which is good in thine eyes .
Then I said unto you , Dread not , neither be afraid of them .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ong , ‘ Wat tieng ïa kita ki briew .

translation.en: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour , for to give repentance to Israel , and forgiveness of sins .
translation.kha: U Blei u la kyntiew ïa u sha ka liang kamon jong u kum u Nongïalam bad u Nongpynim , ban ai ha ki paid Israel ka kabu ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban ïoh ka jingmap ïa ki pop jong ki .
Nga pynlong ka jutang ïa ka sngi bad ka miet , khnang ba kin ha la ki biang ; bad ïa ka jutang ym ban .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If ye can break my covenant of the day , and my covenant of the night , and that there should not be day and night in their season  ;

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki nonglamktien jong u Ïoannis Baal la leit noh , U Jisu u la sdang ban kren shaphang jong u ha u Lahmi : Haba phi la leit sha u Ïoannis afi ka Palmyra shyiap , aïu phi la isaitmet lynti ban ïohi ? Hato ïa ka sla phlang kaba khun ha ka lyer ?
translation.en: And when the messengers of John were departed , he began to speak unto the people concerning John ,  What went ye out into the wilderness for to see ? A reed shaken with the wind ?
Once have I spoken  ; but I will not answer : yea , twice  ; but I will proceed no further .
translation.kha: Nga la kren palat ïa kaba nga dei ban kren .

translation.en: And when they had finished it , they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada , whereof were made vessels for the house of the  Lord  , even vessels to minister , and to offer withal , and spoons , and vessels of gold and silver . And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the  Lord  continually all the days of Jehoiada .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la pyndep ïa ka jingpynbha , ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa kaba tam la ai sha u syiem bad sha u Jehoïada , kiba la pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba phah shna ïa ki pliang bad kiwei ki pat ki khiew ki pliang na ka bynta ka Templ . Katba u Jehoïada u dang im , ïa ki jingkñia la ai tista ha ka Templ .
Ha ka sngi kaba lai , ki la shem ïa u hapoh ka Templ , u da shong bad ki nonghikai jong ki Jiw , da kaba shahshkor ki bad kylli jingkylli .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that after three days they found him in the temple , sitting in the midst of the doctors , both hearing them , and asking them questions .

And it shall come to pass in the last days , saith God , I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh : and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy , and your young men shall see visions , and your old men shall dream dreams :
translation.kha: ‘ Kane ka long kaei kaba ngan leh ha ki sngi bakhatduh , U Blei u ong : Ngan theh noh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga halor uwei pa uwei baroh . Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga ; ki samla shynrang jong phi kin ïohi ki jingïohipaw , bad ki rangbah ba la tymmen jong phi kin ïoh ki jingphohsniew .

translation.en: The poor useth entreaties  ; but the rich answereth roughly .
translation.kha: Haba u briew uba duk u kren , u hap kyrpad donakor , hynrei haba u briew uba riewspah u jubab , u kren khor .

Ki rangbah jingïakhaïi la Meron ïa u Paul ki la sngewkyndit bad u haduh Athens bad nangta mishoneri la wan phai sha Beria lem Markaboth ki sngewma na u Paul ba u Silas bad u Amraphel ki dei ban leit sha u kloi katba lah .
translation.en: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens : and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timothy for to come to him with all speed , they departed .
These be they who separate themselves , sensual , having not the Spirit .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki briew kiba pynlong ki jingïapait , kiba shah ïalam ha ki jingkwah ba kynja doh jong ki , ki bym don U Mynsiem .

Ngan sa pynngat ha ki ka jinglanot ha kaba ki jaitbynriew pyrthei ka baroh kin da sngewshyrkhei , ki briew kin rkhiebeiñ ïa ki ; kin ïa ïakren kai ki , kin ïakynshi ïa ki , bad kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong kum ki ka jingtim kylleng kat shaba nga pynsakma ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt , to be a reproach and a proverb , a taunt and a curse , in all places whither I shall drive them .

translation.kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jong ki un pynjot bad ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki ; U Trai U Blei jong ngi un pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity , and shall cut them off in their own wickedness  ; yea , the  Lord  our God shall cut them off .
And the soldiers also mocked him , coming to him , and offering him vinegar ,
translation.kha: Ki shipai ruh ki la krenbeiñ ïa u : Ki la wan sha u bad ki la tyrwa ha u ïa ka waiñ bym bha , bad ki la ong ,

translation.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation : and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .
translation.kha: lem bad u Elisaphan u khun jong u Ussiel kum u rangbah kur .
To put ïa ka turoi kylleng ka ! To pyrta jam bad shai kdar ! Ïathuh ha ki briew jong Judah bad Jerusalem ban phet sha nongbah ba la ker kynroh .
translation.en: Declare ye in Judah , and publish in Jerusalem  ; and say , Blow ye the trumpet in the land : cry , gather together , and say , Assemble yourselves , and let us go into the defenced cities .
Then Gideon built an altar there unto the  Lord  , and called it Jehovah–shalom : unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites .
translation.kha: U Gideon u tei hangta ka duwan ïa U  Trai  bad u khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  U  Trai  u long ka Jingsuk .  ( Ka dang ïeng ha Ophrah , kaba dei jong ki kur jong u Abieser . )

translation.en: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers , and their queens thy nursing mothers : they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth , and lick up the dust of thy feet  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  : for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me .
translation.kha: Ki syiem kin long kum ki kpa ïa pha ; ki mahadei kum ki kmie . Kin dem khrup ha khmat jong pha bad kin burom ïa pha ; da kaba pynrit kin pyn-i burom ïa pha . Te phan tip ba nga long U  Trai  ; uba ap ïa ka jingïarap jong nga un ym duh jingkyrmen .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that as ye were a curse among the heathen , O house of Judah , and house of Israel  ; so will I save you , and ye shall be a blessing : fear not , but let your hands be strong .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Judah bad Israel ! Ha ki por ba-mynshuwa ki nongwei ki ïatim iwei ïa iwei pat da kaba ong , ‘ Ai ba kijuh ki jingpynjot kiba la hap ha Judah bad Israel kin hap halor jong phi !’ Hynrei ngan pynim ïa phi , bad nangta kito ki nongwei kin ong iwei ïa iwei pat , ‘ Ai ba phin ïohpdiang ïa kijuh ki jingkyrkhu kiba la wan ha ka Judah bad Israel !’ Kumta to long shlur bad wat sheptieng .

translation.en: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: Te nga la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u syiem Sedekaïah ha Jerusalem katba ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem ka Babilonia ka dang tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah .
Lada phi pyndonkam ïa ktien ka u Blei , phin long ki briew ba kmen tam .
translation.en: If you apply God’s Word , you will be a happier person .

translation.kha: bad shaniah ha ki ïa kine ki ban ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh kiba na u Aaron ka jingmane ha ka Templ ban sumar ïa phyllaw bad ïa ki kamra jong ka , bad ban sumar khuid ïa kata baroh kaba kyntang ;
translation.en: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the  Lord  , in the courts , and in the chambers , and in the purifying of all holy things , and the work of the service of the house of God  ;

translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ïa kane bad kin wat sngewkhuslai hapdeng jingkhlaiñ ka jong ki baroh . Ha ka jinglyngngoh kin set ïa la ki shyntur bad tap ïa la ki shkor .
translation.en: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might : they shall lay their hand upon their mouth , their ears shall be deaf .

translation.kha: jingshahthngan Blei jingshetkylla la thung ïa nga dkhoi u apostol bad u nonghikai ïadon pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha , bad dei na kane ka daw ba nga shahshitom ïa jingthohbria kiei kiei .
translation.en: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher , and an apostle , and a teacher of the Gentiles .
There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius , a centurion of the band called the Italian band ,
translation.kha: La don u briew ha Kaisaria uba kyrteng u Kornelios , uba long u rangbah shipai ha ka kynhun shipai ka Hima Rom ba la khot  Ka Kynhun shipai Italian .
U Petros u la leit kylleng , kylleng bad ha kawei ka sien u la ban leit jngoh ïa ki briew jong U Blei kiba shong basah ha Lydda .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as Peter passed throughout all quarters , he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda .

translation.kha: Ngi buh ïa ka jingkyrmen ngi ha U Trai u long ka bad ka jingïarap jong .
translation.en: Our soul waiteth for the  Lord  : he is our help and our shield .
And they said unto Moses , Speak thou with us , and we will hear : but let not God speak with us , lest we die .
translation.kha: Ki ong ha u Moses ,  Lada phi kren ha ngi , ngin shahshkor ; hynrei ngi sheptieng ba lada U Blei u kren ha ngi , ngin ïap .

U Nebukhadnessar u la pynryngkang par ïa baroh ki rangbah badonkam sha Babilonia , baroh lang hynñiew hajar ngut , bad shihajar ngut ki nongtrei kiba tbit , kynthup ïa ki bania , baroh , ki long rangbah bakhlaiñ ka bynta ka kam shipai
translation.en: And all the men of might , even seven thousand , and craftsmen and smiths a thousand , all that were strong and apt for war , even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon .

translation.kha: Iathuh . hok
translation.en: Be honest .
And if thou refuse to let them go , behold , I will smite all thy borders with frogs :
translation.kha: Lada me kyntait , ngan pynshitom ïa ka ri jong me da kaba pyndap ïa ka da ki jakoid .

translation.en: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , thou shalt not harden thine heart , nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother :
translation.kha: Lada don u para Israel uba kyrduh ha kano kano ka shnong kaba ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , wat khim mynsiem bad wat kyntait ban ïarap ïa u ;

translation.en: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God .
translation.kha: Ki ieit ïa ka jingpynksan u briew ban ïa ka jingpynksan na U Blei .
U syiem jong nga u thiah ha la ka jingthiah bad ka jingsleh iwbih jong nga ka la pyndap ïa ka lyer da ka jingiw ba-iwbih .
translation.en: The flowers appear on the earth  ; the time of the singing of birds is come , and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land  ;

translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u , U Blei u la ha me ïa kane baroh kumta ka long kaba ba me don ka jingstad bad jingshemphang kaba kham khraw ban ïano ïano .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this , there is none so discreet and wise as thou art :
Then Peter , filled with the Holy Ghost , said unto them , Ye rulers of the people , and elders of Israel ,
translation.kha: U Petros , uba la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ko nongïalam jong ki paidbah bad ko ki tymmen ki san :

translation.en: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction .
translation.kha: Kren na ka bynta ki briew ki bym lah ban kren na ka bynta ïa lade . Ïada ïa ki hok jong baroh ki bym don jingïarap .

translation.en: Fair weather cometh out of the north : with God is terrible majesty .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingphyrnai ksiar la ïohi ha ka phang bashatei , bad ka burom jong U Blei ka pyndap ïa ngi da ka jingtiengburom .
Me don u ksuid hapoh jong me ! u paidbah u la jubab . Mano ba pyrshang ban pynïap hir pynlyngki ?
translation.en: The people answered and said , Thou hast a devil : who goeth about to kill thee ?
And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the  Lord  , as the showers upon the grass , that tarrieth not for man , nor waiteth for the sons of men .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel kiba lait im kin long kum ka umjer ba pynpyngngad ba la phah da U  Trai  na ka bynta ki jaitbynriew ba bun , kum ki um slap ha ki jingthung ba dang mih . Kin shaniah ha U Blei , ym ha u briew .

translation.en: And when he had received meat , he was strengthened . Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus .
translation.kha: bad hadien ba u la bam jingbam , u la ïohbor pat . U Saul u la sah katto katne sngi bad ki parabangeit ha Damaskos .
Phi tharai ngam shym kren ei ei hynrei ka tang lyer ; te balei phi jubab ïa ki ktien ka jingkutlad jong nga ?
translation.en: Do ye imagine to reprove words , and the speeches of one that is desperate , which are as wind ?

translation.kha: Ki kti me jong ki la pynlong bad pynwandur ïa nga , bad mynta kito kijuh ki kti ki pynjot ïa nga .
translation.en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about  ; yet thou dost destroy me .

translation.kha: Naba u la ka buh sngi ha kaba un bishar ïa ka pyrthei baroh da kawei ka jinglehhok , da uta u briew ïa uba u la jied . U la ai ka jingpynshisha ïa kane ha uwei pa uwei da kaba pynmihpat ïa uta u briew na jingïap ka !
translation.en: Because he hath appointed a day , in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained  ; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men , in that he hath raised him from the dead .
But found none : yea , though many false witnesses came , yet found they none . At the last came two false witnesses ,
translation.kha: hynrei kim lah ban shem ei ei , wat la shisha bun ki briew ki la wan sha khmat bad kren ki jinglamler shaphang jong u .

translation.en: Yea , the fir trees rejoice at thee , and the cedars of Lebanon , saying , Since thou art laid down , no feller is come up against us .
translation.kha: Ki dieng Kseh-Sypress bad ki dieng Kedar jong ka Lebanon ki risa da kaba kmen halor u syiem uba la kyllon , namar ym don mano mano ban khet ïa ki , mynta ba um don shuh !

translation.en: And if I also ask you , ye will not answer me , nor let me go .
translation.kha: bad lada nga kylli ïa phi ka jingkylli , phin ym jubab .
Hynrei sawbthuh bymman kin peit sawdong ha 21 jinglyng-a bad kin shem ba ym don lynti ban phet ïap . Tang kawei ka jingkyrmen sopkjat ki ka long ba ka jingïap kan wan .
translation.en: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail , and they shall not escape , and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost .

translation.kha: Kumta ngan shaphang une u — hynrei ym kob sarong shaphang ïa lade , lait noh ïa kiei kiei kiba pynpaw haduh katno nga long uba tlot .
translation.en: Of such an one will I glory : yet of myself I will not glory , but in mine infirmities .

And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light , and the sweet incense , and the daily meat offering , and the anointing oil , and the oversight of all the tabernacle , and of all that therein is , in the sanctuary , and in the vessels thereof .
translation.kha: bad u Moses u la leh kumta kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
( Ki synran jong u ki la lah leit sha shnong ban thied jingbam . )
translation.en: ( For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat . )

And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel , Because the king is near of kin to us : wherefore then be ye angry for this matter ? have we eaten at all of the king s cost ? or hath he given us any gift ?
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Judah ki jubab ,  Ngi leh ïa kata namar ba u syiem u long uwei na ngi . Balei kane kan pynbitar ïa phi ? Um shym la siew na ka bynta ka bam jong ngi lane um shym la ai ei ei ïa ngi .

translation.en: So after he had washed their feet , and had taken his garments , and was set down again , he said unto them ,  Know ye what I have done to you ?
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la sait ïa ki kjat jong ki , u la kup biang ïa ka jaiñkup bad u la leit phai sha la ka jaka ha ka miej .  Phi sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba nga dang shu dep ban leh ïa phi ?  u la kylli .

translation.en: Which have forsaken the right way , and are gone astray , following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor , who loved the wages of unrighteousness  ;
translation.kha: Ki la iehnoh ïa ka lynti kaba beit bad ki la jah lynti ; ki la bud ïa ka lynti jong u Balaam , u khun jong u Beor , uba ieit ïa ka pisa kaba u ïoh da ka kam bymhok
