translation.en: And he said , I have been very zealous for the  Lord  God of hosts : because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant , thrown down thine altars , and slain thy prophets with the sword  ; and I , even I only , am left  ; and they seek my life , to take it away .

translation.kha: U la khot lang ïa ki synran jong u baroh bad u la ong ïa ki , Nga Rephan Bashatei phi ba kane ka riewkynthei kaba duk , ka la pynnoh kham bun ha ka Admin sngewkynduh ban ïa Tiphsah kiwei pat .
translation.en: And he called unto him his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That this poor widow hath cast more in , than all they which have cast into the treasury :

translation.kha: Kumta ngan La ka nard ha ka ïingsyiem ba la tei da u syiem Hasael , bad ngan thang Waw ïa ki kut jong u syiem Benhadad jingneh
translation.en: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael , which shall devour the palaces of Ben–hadad .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U Trai u la mihpaw ha u ha ka jingphohsniew u bad kylli ïa u , Kaei me mon ïa ban nga ai ha me ?
translation.en: In Gibeon the  Lord  appeared to Solomon in a dream by night : and God said , Ask what I shall give thee .

translation.kha: Kiba dkoh kin rynsied bad shad , bad kito bym ki lah ban kren kin pyrta da ka jingkmen . Ki wahduid kin lyngba tuid ka ri shyiap ;
translation.en: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart , and the tongue of the dumb sing : for in the wilderness shall waters break out , and streams in the desert .
For her house inclineth unto death , and her paths unto the dead .
translation.kha: Lada phi leit sha ka ïing jong ka , phi ïaid ha ka lynti sha ka jingïap . Ban leit shata ka long ban tur sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
Te kumta , ko parabangeit jong nga , long phi ïeng skhem bad kiba ïaineh To long ïai trei ïa ka kam U Trai , phi tip ba kano kano kaba phi leh ha jingshakri ïa U Trai kam ju long kaba lehnoh-ei .
translation.en: Therefore , my beloved brethren , be ye stedfast , unmoveable , always abounding in the work of the Lord , forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord .

translation.kha: Shibun u symbai phin bet ha Seïon , hynrei tang jingdonkam pat phin ïoh ot , namar riewkhraw puit kin bam ïa ki jingthung jong nongbishar .
translation.en: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field , and shalt gather but little in  ; for the locust shall consume it .

translation.kha: Ki neh slem ha por ki baroh ; la ai ïa ki ha ka jingshisha bad ha ka hok .
translation.en: They stand fast for ever and ever , and are done in truth and uprightness .
So neither I , nor my brethren , nor my servants , nor the men of the guard which followed me , none of us put off our clothes , saving that every one put them off for washing .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la kylliang sopti wat ha ka por miet , lymne mano mano na ki paralok jong nga , lymne ki shakri jong nga , lymne ki nongap phira jong nga . Bad ma ngi baroh ngi bat ïa ki tiar ïaleh ha ka kti .

translation.en: I was just making sure .
translation.kha: Nga shu pynthikna .

Bad kumta Trai U u tip kumno pyllait ban im ïa ki briew kiba riewblei na ki jingtynjuh jong ki bad kumno ban pynhap ki ïa bymman ha ka jingpynshitom ka ha Sngi ka Jingbishar , khamtam ïa kito kiba beh ïa ki jingkwah brai jakhlia jong ka met bad kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa ka bor synshar jong U Blei .
translation.en: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations , and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished :
And these things write we unto you , that your joy may be full .
translation.kha: Ngi thoh ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkmen jong ngi kan long kaba dap pura .

translation.en: Now concerning his sons , and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him , and the repairing of the house of God , behold , they are written in the story of the book of the kings . And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Ka Komentari halor ka Kitab ki Syiem  ka don ki jingïathuhkhana shaphang ki khun shynrang jong u Joash , ki jingïathuhlypa kiba la kren pyrshah ïa u , bad ka jingbuh jingthoh kumno ba u la tei pat ïa ka Templ . U Amasaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger  ; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression .
translation.kha: Lada phi long uba shemphang , phin lah ban kan ïa la ka jingbitar . Haba uno uno u leh bakla ïa phi , ka dei ka jinglong bakhraw ban leh klet ïa ka .

wat lada u Noah , u Daniel , bad u Job ki shong ki sah hangta — kumba shisha ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga , long U Blei uba im — kin ym lah ban pynim wat ïa la ki jong ki . khun Ka jingbha jong kan ki pyllait im tang ïa ka jong jingim ki .
translation.en: Though Noah , Daniel , and Job , were in it , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , they shall deliver neither son nor daughter  ; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness .

translation.kha: u phah ïa u Timothi bad u Erastos , ar ki nongïarap jong u , sha Makedonia , katba u dang pynlut sa katto katne por ha ka probins jong ka Asia .
translation.en: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him , Timothy and Erastus  ; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu ka-por la dep ban kren ïa kine kiei barieh baroh ha ki paidbah , u la leit sha Kapernam .
translation.en: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people , he entered into Capernaum .
Then he said , God do so and more also to me , if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day .
translation.kha: U kyang ,  Ai ba U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada u Elisha um shah khrai khlieh shuwa ba ka sngi kan kut !

translation.en: Be not ye therefore partakers with them .
translation.kha: Kumta phim dei ban ïadon bynta ei ei bad kiba kum kita ki briew .

translation.en: He answereth him , and saith ,  O faithless generation , how long shall I be with you ? how long shall I suffer you ? bring him unto me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Haduh katno phi long ki briew ki bymngeit ! Haduh katno ngan don bad phi ? Haduh katno ngan ïaishah bad phi ? Wallam ïa u khynnah ha nga !
Ki la pynkhreh ka jingbam miet ïa u hangta , maphi kaba ka Martha ka la ïarap ban sam ; u Lasaros u long uwei na jingbha kiba la ïashong bam ha ka miej lem bad U Jisu .
translation.en: There they made him a supper  ; and Martha served : but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him .

translation.kha: Ki la lynñiar , ki da ïa khaweh la ki jaiñ , bad ki da kynting ïa u pui pui sha suiñ .
translation.en: And as they cried out , and cast off their clothes , and threw dust into the air ,

translation.kha: kyrpad ïa me ban kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga khnang ba kin ïai ha ka jinglehbha jong . Ma me A Trai me la kyrkhu ka jingkyrkhu jong me kan neh ki junom .
translation.en: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may be before thee for ever : for thou blessest , O  Lord  , and it shall be blessed for ever .
Say unto wisdom , Thou art my sister  ; and call understanding thy kinswoman :
translation.kha: Ñiew ïa ka jingstad kum ka para jong phi , bad ïa ka jingshemphang kum ka paralok ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong phi .
Te sngewsarong Trai —Jenesis Barak bad u Ashkenas hangta , bad u khot kum mynshuwa ïa-ot Samuel ! Ko Samuel ! mala Samuel u pura! , To kren ; sleit shakri jong jingpahuh u shahshkor jingbymdon
translation.en: And the  Lord  came , and stood , and called as at other times , Samuel , Samuel . Then Samuel answered , Speak  ; for thy servant heareth .

translation.kha: ba-ieit Ko jong nga , phi long kaba bhabriew kum ka Jerusalem , kaba i-ieit kum ka nongbah Tirsah , kaba pynkyndeh mynsiem kum ki kine nongbah bakhraw .
translation.en: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory  ; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon , by the gate of Bath–rabbim : thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus .

translation.kha: U u Trai ong ha u Moses , Ïalam bad katto me katne ki ngut nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad leit sha shuwa jong u paidbah . Rah ruh ïa u diengduh da uba me la shoh ïa ka wah Nile .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go on before the people , and take with thee of the elders of Israel  ; and thy rod , wherewith thou smotest the river , take in thine hand , and go .
And they went and told it unto the residue : neither believed they them .
translation.kha: Ki la wan phai bad ki la ïathuh ha kiwei pat , hynrei kim shym la ngeit ïa kata .

translation.en: We have dealt very corruptly against thee , and have not kept the commandments , nor the statutes , nor the judgments , which thou commandedst thy servant Moses .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh bymman pyrshah ïa me bad ngim shym la leh ïa kaei kaba me la hukum . Ngim shym la sumar ïa ki hukum kiba me la ai ha ngi lyngba u Moses , u shakri jong me .

translation.en: The prophet that hath a dream , let him tell a dream  ; and he that hath my word , let him speak my word faithfully . What is the chaff to the wheat ? saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa uba ïoh ka jingphohsniew u dei ban ong ïa ka ba ka long tang ka jingphohsniew , hynrei u nongïathuhlypa uba la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor jong nga u dei ban pynbna hok ïa kata ka khubor . Kaei ka jingbha u jyntang ban ïanujor bad u kew ?

translation.en: Did you get a good look at her ?
translation.kha: Me ioh ban peit iaka .
Ki briew ka lah ngeit ïa kane , ki jingïateh lok kiba ki la pynlong . Hynrei kane ka ka long ban pynkynmaw ïa ki ki pop jong ki ban ki ba sa shah kurup .
translation.en: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight , to them that have sworn oaths : but he will call to remembrance the iniquity , that they may be taken .
Abstain from all appearance of evil .
translation.kha: bad kiar na kano kano kaba sniew .
Ki synran ki king kumba san ne hynriew kilomitar haba ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u ïaid halor ka um u nang wan sha jan ka lieng bad ki la sngewtriem .
translation.en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs , they see Jesus walking on the sea , and drawing nigh unto the ship : and they were afraid .
And give him no rest , till he establish , and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth .
translation.kha: Kim dei ban ai shongthait ïa u tad ynda u dep tei pat ïa ka Jerusalem , bad pynlong ïa ka , ka nongbah ha kaba ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïaroh .

Nga shah ïa ki ban pyntngit ïa lade da ki jingainguh jong ki hi , bad Shelomoth shah ïa ki ban Thoh ïa Ktien khun shynrang tip jong ki . Kane ka la long ban pynshitom ïa Amnon panpoh pyn-i ha ki ba nga long U thang sieb
translation.en: And I polluted them in their own gifts , in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb , that I might make them desolate , to the end that they might know that I am the  Lord .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you  ; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la lah ong ha u Moses ,  U Pharaoh un ïai kyntait ban shahshkor ïa phi khnang ba nga lah ban leh kham bun ki kambah jong nga ha Ijipt .

translation.en: And of the angels he saith , Who maketh his angels spirits , and his ministers a flame of fire .
translation.kha: Hynrei shaphang kita ki angel U Blei u la ong ,  U Blei u la pynlong ïa la ki angel kum ki lyer , bad ïa ki shakri jong u kum ki thylliej ding .

translation.en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge : because thou hast rejected knowledge , I will also reject thee , that thou shalt be no priest to me : seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God , I will also forget thy children .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki shu jot ei namar kim pdiang ïa nga . Phi ki lyngdoh phim suidñiew ban pdiang ïa nga bad phi la kyntait ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , bad kumta nga la kyntait noh ïa phi bad ngan ym pdiang ïa ki khun jong phi kum ki lyngdoh jong nga .

translation.en: And the king said , Whosoever saith ought unto thee , bring him to me , and he shall not touch thee any more .
translation.kha: U Syiem u jubab ,  Lada uno uno u byrngem ïa pha , wan ïalam ïa u sha nga , bad un ym pynwit shuh ïa pha lano lano .
Men sheptieng ïa nongshun jong ; kiba bun ki kin kyrpad jingïarap me .
translation.en: Also thou shalt lie down , and none shall make thee afraid  ; yea , many shall make suit unto thee .

translation.kha: Kin ïap na ki jingpang bashyrkhei , bad don mano mano ba ïambriew na bynta ki lane ïa ki . Ki met jong kin long kum ki sboh halor ka . Kin shah pynïap ka thma lane ïap na ka jingïapthngan , bad ki jong ki long ki jingbam ki sim bad ïa ki mradkhlaw
translation.en: They shall die of grievous deaths  ; they shall not be lamented  ; neither shall they be buried  ; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth : and they shall be consumed by the sword , and by famine  ; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven , and for the beasts of the earth .
And their king shall go into captivity , he and his princes together , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem jong ki bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , kin shah ringmraw .

Ki la kynting pui pui halor khlieh jong ki , ki lynñiar ki la ïambriew , da kaba ong , kaba shyrkhei ! Katno kaba ka nongbah kaba khraw ! long ka nongbah ha kaba kiba don ki liengbah kiba ïaid ha ki duriaw ki la kylla riewspah ha spah jong ka ! Bad ha ka shi kynta ka la duh lut kiei baroh !
translation.en: And they cast dust on their heads , and cried , weeping and wailing , saying , Alas , alas , that great city , wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness ! for in one hour is she made desolate .

translation.kha: Jisu u la leit lyngba nongbah bad ki nongrit , u da hikai ki briew bad u da ïa ka lynti sha .
translation.en: And he went through the cities and villages , teaching , and journeying toward Jerusalem .
And he that was healed wist not who it was : for Jesus had conveyed himself away , a multitude being in that place .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta u briew uba la ïohkhiah um shym tip ba U Jisu u la long uei , naba la don u paidbah ha kata ka jaka , bad U Jisu u la lah mihnoh jar jar .

translation.en: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever : no , not when the  Lord  hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth .
translation.kha: pynpaw ïa kajuh ka jingïaineh skhem ïa ka ïing ka sem jong nga shi junom . Bad haba U  Trai  u la pynjot thiaw ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh ,

translation.en: Because thou shalt forget thy misery , and remember it as waters that pass away :
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki jingjynjar jong me kin shu jah noh na ki jingkynmaw jong me , kum ki jingshlei um kiba la ïaid lait noh bad ym don jingkynmaw shuh .
Da shisha ïa-ïoh la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud Huldah Megiddo jong mynnyngkong , bad nga la ïohi jingbymkohnguh kumno ki nong Jedidaïah ki pynshitom beiñ ïa ki siewspah
translation.en: Now therefore , behold , the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me : and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them .

translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh ha ka nongbah uba burom ïa la ki kmie ki kpa . Phi shukor ïa nongwei ki bad shim kabu ïa riewkynthei ki bad ki khunswet .
translation.en: In thee have they set light by father and mother : in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger : in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , phin ym pan ei ei na nga . Nga ïathuh phi ïa ka jingshisha : U Kpa un ai phi ïa kaei kaba phi na ha kyrteng jong nga .
translation.en: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing . Verily , verily , I say unto you , Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name , he will give it you .

translation.kha: Ki pukni ki wan hiar ha kita ki , metïap hynrei u Abram u beh noh ïa ki .
translation.en: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases , Abram drove them away .
Take great stones in thine hand , and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln , which is at the entry of Pharaoh s house in Tahpanhes , in the sight of the men of Judah  ;
translation.kha: Hangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  To pynïoh ïa ki mawbah bad tep ïa ki ha ka sorki jong ka jingsiang ha khmat ka khyrdop sha ka ïing sorkar kaba don ha ka nongbah , bad to ai ba katto katne ngut ki Israel kin ïohi ïa me ba me leh ïa kata .
( jingsdang Korinth 15 :24 ) Te balei phim ïathuh lem ha pynskuiñ Amos sahkut bad kiba ieit ba thoiñ shaphang aiu ka Hima U Blei kan leh ?
translation.en: ( 1 Corinthians 15 :24 ) Why not tell your friends and loved ones about what God’s Kingdom will do ?

translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïohi ïakhaïi kaei kaba i kum ki thylliej ding ïatreilang pur kylleng bad ktah ïa uwei pa uwei u briew hangta Pekahaïah
translation.en: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire , and it sat upon each of them .
Why doth thine heart carry thee away ? and what do thy eyes wink at ,
translation.kha: Hynrei me leh shitrhem bad peit shin ïa ngi da ka jingbitar .

translation.en: Greet Mary , who bestowed much labour on us .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ïa ka Mari , kaba la trei shitom na ka bynta jong phi .
Lada uno uno u shim ïa ka briew , yn pynshitom ïa u Ngan pynshitom da ka jingïap ïa uno uno u mrad uba shim ïa ka briew .
translation.en: And surely your blood of your lives will I require  ; at the hand of every beast will I require it , and at the hand of man  ; at the hand of every man s brother will I require the life of man .
And love the uppermost rooms at feasts , and the chief seats in the synagogues ,
translation.kha: Ki ieit ïa ki jaka bakor tam ha ki jingkhawai bad ïa ki jaka shong ba la buh kyrpang ha ki synagog ;

translation.en: And I will persecute them with the sword , with the famine , and with the pestilence , and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth , to be a curse , and an astonishment , and an hissing , and a reproach , among all the nations whither I have driven them :
translation.kha: Ngan beh kthong ïa ki da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin sngewtriem ha kaei kaba ki ïohi . Kylleng kylleng nga pynsakma ïa ki , ki briew kin kyndit bad sngewshyrkhei ha kaei kaba la jia ha ki . Ki briew kin krenbeiñ ïa ki bad pyndonkam ïa ki kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim .
Wat ong , Ngan leh ïa u kumba u la leh ïa nga ! Ngan leh kylliang kumba plakhun la leh !
translation.en: Say not , I will do so to him as he hath done to me : I will render to the man according to his work .
And when the sun is down , he shall be clean , and shall afterward eat of the holy things  ; because it is his food .
translation.kha: Un sa long uba khuid hadien ba ka sngi ka la sep , bad nangta u lah ban bam ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang , kiba dei ka jingbam jong u .
ha ka jong u Balaam la ïohi ïa ki Amalek , u la kren kane ka : U u long ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñbor tam na baroh Hynrei ha kaba kut un noh jar .
translation.en: And when he looked on Amalek , he took up his parable , and said , Amalek was the first of the nations  ; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Manasseh tei u pynjrong ïa ka kynroh bashabar ka ha phang mihngi ka jong Nongbah u Dabid , na ka tduh jong ka them hajan ka umpohliew Gihon shaphang shatei sha ka Khyrdop Dohkha bad ka jaka jong ka nongbah ba khot ka Ophel . U buh ruh ïa u shipai pynïaidkam ban ai ïa hukum ka kynhun ki shipai ha man ki nongbah ba la kynroh ker jong ka Judah .
translation.en: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David , on the west side of Gihon , in the valley , even to the entering in at the fish gate , and compassed about Ophel , and raised it up a very great height , and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah .
And there was a famine in the land , beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham . And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar .
translation.kha: Ka la jia sa kawei pat ka  nemsniew ha kata ka ri , nalor kata kaba la jia ha ki sngi u Abraham . U Isaak u la leit sha u Abimelekh u syiem jong ki Philistia , ha Gerar .

Ïa uwei pa uwei u khiew shet ha pynkyllut bad ha baroh ka Judah yn Ken na Hikai bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka jingmane ïa jingmanbha Trai Badonbor Baroh . Bathymmai briew kiba ai ïa ki jingkñia kin pyndonkam ïa ki blang phon nongpynkren pynkie doh jong ki jingkñia . mynhynnin kata ka por ka poi , yn sngewlyngngoh Imri shuh pihuiñ uno Shaul jingrben ha ka Templ jong U Trai .—Job Baroh .
translation.en: Yea , every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the  Lord  of hosts : and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them , and seethe therein : and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Kito kiba bitar ïa me tip kin ïa ka jinglehrain ka jingshahjop kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa me kin ïap
translation.en: Behold , all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded : they shall be as nothing  ; and they that strive with thee shall perish .
In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet , and their cauls , and their round tires like the moon ,
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka wan haba U  Trai  un shim noh na ki kynthei ka Jerusalem ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki sngewsarong — ki jingdeng itynnat ba ki deng ha ki matsohlah jong ki , halor ki khlieh jong ki , bad ha ki ryndang jong ki ,
Ki don bun jait ki jingai ba kynja , hynrei ujuh U Mynsiem u ai ki .
translation.en: Now there are diversities of gifts , but the same Spirit .

translation.kha: Haba U u Trai ïohi ba ka jingieit ka kham duna ïa Leah ka ban ïa ka Rakhel , u la pynlah ïa ka ban ïoh khun , hynrei ka Rakhel ka ïailong kaba khlem khun .
translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that Leah was hated , he opened her womb : but Rachel was barren .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u ïa uwei pat u briew , kumba u la leh uta , kumta ruh yn leh kylliang ïa u .
translation.en: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour  ; as he hath done , so shall it be done to him  ;

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongsynshar ka nongbah la tap-lup da ki jingbamsap , ki lyngdoh ki pynbatai ïa ka hukum na ka bynta ka tulop , ki nongïathuhlypa ki ai ïa ki jingpynpaw jong ki na ka bynta ka pisa — bad ki kam ba Trai u don bad ki . Yn ym don jingma ka ban hap halor jong ngi , ong . U u bad ngi .
translation.en: The heads thereof judge for reward , and the priests thereof teach for hire , and the prophets thereof divine for money : yet will they lean upon the  Lord  , and say , Is not the  Lord  among us ? none evil can come upon us .
They hatch cockatrice  eggs , and weave the spider s web : he that eateth of their eggs dieth , and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper .
translation.kha: Ki jingïasylla bymman kiba phi pynlong ki long kiba shyrkhei kum ki pylleng jong ki bseiñ kiba don bih . Pynpait ïa kata ka pylleng , un mih u bseiñ .
U Moses u don ngut ar ki khun shynrang , u Gershom bad u Elieser .
translation.en: The sons of Moses were , Gershom , and Eliezer .
Of righteousness , because I go to my Father , and ye see me no more  ;
translation.kha: ki bakla shaphang kaei kaba dei , namar ba ngan leit sha U Kpa bad phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga ;

Mynta , kane ka long ka jutang ïa kaba ngan pynlong bad ki paid Israel ha ki sngi ki ban wan , ong U : Trai Ngan buh ïa ki hukum jong ha nga ki jingmut jong ki , bad ngan thoh ïa ki ha ki dohnud jong ki ; ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad ki kin long u paidlang jong nga .
translation.en: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days , saith the Lord  ; I will put my laws into their mind , and write them in their hearts : and I will be to them a God , and they shall be to me a people :

translation.kha: Ha sngi ba ïa ki jaka ba la kerkut ki nongshun jong phi la kurup bad ïa ki briew la pynïap , ki wahduid kin na baroh ki lumbah bad ki lumrit .
translation.en: And there shall be upon every high mountain , and upon every high hill , rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter , when the towers fall .
Howl , O gate  ; cry , O city  ; thou , whole Philistia , art dissolved : for there shall come from the north a smoke , and none shall be alone in his appointed times .
translation.kha: To ud bad to kyang ban ïoh jingïarap , phi baroh ki nongbah ka Philistia ! To sngewshyrkhei , phi baroh ! U lyoh pui pui u wan na ka phang bashatei — u long ka kynhun shipai bym don ki khawpud hapoh ka kyrdan jong ka .

translation.en: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt , namely , Elnathan the son of Achbor , and certain men with him into Egypt .
translation.kha: U syiem Jehoïakim , pynban , u la phah ïa u Elnathan u khun jong u Akhbor bad katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah sha Ijipt ban wallam ïa u Uriah .
U Jakob u ïohi ïa u Iso ba u wan lem bad sawspah ki ngut rangbah . u Kumta pynïabynta ïa ki khun hapdeng ha Leah , ka Rakhel , bad ki tnga kliar ar ngut .
translation.en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes , and looked , and , behold , Esau came , and with him four hundred men . And he divided the children unto Leah , and unto Rachel , and unto the two handmaids .

translation.kha: Ko phi hok baroh lehkmen kaei U Trai u la ! To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U Blei uba u la leh , to ainguh ïa u .
translation.en: Rejoice in the  Lord  , ye righteous  ; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness .

translation.kha: Nalor kine baroh , parabangeit jong nga , wat pyndonkam da ka jingsmai haba phi pynlong ka jingkular . Wat smai bneng ne da ka khyndew da kaei pat . Shu ong haba phi ho-oid , Em haba phi mut bad ym hap hapoh ka jingbishar U Blei .
translation.en: But above all things , my brethren , swear not , neither by heaven , neither by the earth , neither by any other oath : but let your yea be yea  ; and your nay , nay  ; lest ye fall into condemnation .

translation.kha: Hato baburom pyndonkam ïa la ngut waitlam junom bad Trakhonitis pynjot tynjuh ïakem jaitbynriew khlem jingisynei ?
translation.en: Shall they therefore empty their net , and not spare continually to slay the nations ?
And this stone , which I have set for a pillar , shall be God s house : and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee .
translation.kha: Une u maw buh jingkynmaw ïa uba nga la thung un long ka jaka ha kaba ïa me yn mane , bad ngan ai sha me ïa kaba shiphew na kiei kiei baroh kiba me ai ïa nga .

translation.en: So they sent and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines , and said , Send away the ark of the God of Israel , and let it go again to his own place , that it slay us not , and our people : for there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city  ; the hand of God was very heavy there .
translation.kha: Kumta sa shisien pat ki khot lang ïa ki syiem Philistia baroh bad ki ong ,  Pynphai noh ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israel sha ka jaka jong ka , ba kumta kan ym pynïap ïa ngi bad ïa ki longïing jong ngi .  La don ka jingkulmar baroh kawei ka nongbah namar ba U Blei u la pynshitom jur ïa ki .

Ki dei ban long kiba bhabriew , kiba nep jingmut , kiba la ïoh jinghikai bha , kiba stet ban nang , bad kiba ïa-lorni na ka jinganna , ba kumta kin lah ban long kiba im ban shakri ha ka Nongap jong u syiem . U Ashpenas u bseiñ ksem hikai ïa ki ban pule bad smam thoh ïa ka tlang ki nong Babilonia .
translation.en: Children in whom was no blemish , but well favoured , and skilful in all wisdom , and cunning in knowledge , and understanding science , and such as had ability in them to stand in the king s palace , and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans .
And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph , even over against his house . And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah .
translation.kha: U Jedaïah , u khun jong u Harumaph u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba don hajan ka ïing jong u hi . U Hattush , u khun jong u Hashabneïah u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .

translation.en: When a bullock , or a sheep , or a goat , is brought forth , then it shall be seven days under the dam  ; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba kha ïa uno uno u khun masi , lane ïa u khunlangbrot , lane ïa u khunblang , ieh ïa u bad la ka kmie haduh hynñiew sngi , hynrei hadien kata lah ban pdiang ïa u kum ka jingainguh bam .

translation.en: They have hands , but they handle not : feet have they , but they walk not : neither speak they through their throat .
translation.kha: Ki don ki kti , hynrei kim lah ban tba , bad ki kjat , hynrei kim lah ban ïaid ; kim lah ban pynmih sur jingsawa .
U la kem ïa u Ïakjakor , Ahio uta u seiñ hyndai nongïapom Kaïaphas , u Ksuid rangdajied u Laodikaïa — bad u namarkata teh Marsena ïa u haduh shihajar snem .
translation.en: And he laid hold on the dragon , that old serpent , which is the Devil , and Satan , and bound him a thousand years ,

translation.kha: Lada kam shym kano kano kaba duna bad ka jutang kaba nyngkong , yn donkam ïa .
translation.en: For if that first covenant had been faultless , then should no place have been sought for the second .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei pyrkhat , kumta la ong , Balei phi ïa-pyrkhat ïa kine kiei kiei sniew
translation.en: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said ,  Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts ?
Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked .
translation.kha: Men shu peit bad men ïohi kumno ki bymman ki shah pynshitom .
Ka la phah khubor u Elijah : Ai ba blei kin pynïap ïa nga ha kane por ngam leh kajuh kaba me la ïa ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah , saying , So let the gods do to me , and more also , if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time .

And it came to pass , that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them , and all the men of war , then they fled , and went forth out of the city by night , by the way of the king s garden , by the gate betwixt the two walls : and he went out the way of the plain .
translation.kha: Mynba u syiem Sedekaïah bad baroh ki shipai jong u ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , ki la pyrshang ban phet na ka nongbah ha ka por mynmiet . Ki la phet na ka lynti jong ka kper syiem , ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka khyrdop kaba pynïasoh ïa ki ar tylli ki kynroh , bad phet na ka liang jong ka Them Jordan .

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto them again ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , I am the door of the sheep .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong biang ,  Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Nga long ka jingkhang jong ki langbrot .

translation.en: That they shall drive thee from men , and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field , and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen , and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven , and seven times shall pass over thee , till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men , and giveth it to whomsoever he will .
translation.kha: Yn beh noh ïa phi na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew bad phin shong phin sah bad ki mradkhlaw . Hynñiew snem phin bam phlang kum u masi dab , bad thiah ha bym don jingkah ei ei , ha kaba ka umjer kan hap halor jong phi . Te phin pdiang ba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u bat synshar ïa baroh ki hima ki briew , bad ba u lah ban ai ïa ki ha uno uno uba u jied .

translation.en: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted ? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One  ; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers :
translation.kha: Hato ym don u nongïathuhlypa ïa uba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la pynshitom beiñ ? Ki la pynïap ïa ki nonglamktien jong U Blei , kiba slem bah mynshuwa ki la pynbna ïa ka jingwan jong u shakri bahok jong u .

translation.en: And Paul , as his manner was , went in unto them , and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures ,
translation.kha: Kumba u ju leh , u Paul u la leit sha ka synagog . Hangta , ha ki lai tylli ki sngi Sabbaton u la ïatainia bad ki paidbah ,
U Joshua jingïasuk la kurup ïa kine jingkhwan nongbah baroh bad ïa ki syiem jong ki , bakha kaba pynïap ïa uwei Olumpas uwei , kumba jingïaburom Moses , u jingeh jong U Trai , u la hukum .
translation.en: And all the cities of those kings , and all the kings of them , did Joshua take , and smote them with the edge of the sword , and he utterly destroyed them , as Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded .

translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba nga la pyllait ïa ki paid Israel Shaphir Ijipt haduh mynta , ngam pat ju baher ha ka templ ; nga la Adaminekeb kylleng kylleng da kaba shong ha ka ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt , even to this day , but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle .

In the first month , that is , the month Nisan , in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus , they cast Pur , that is , the lot , before Haman from day to day , and from month to month , to the twelfth month , that is , the month Adar .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Syiem Serksis , ha u Nisan , u bnai banyngkong , u Haman u la hukum ban kynting sbai ( la khot ïa ki ,  purim  ) ban shem ïa ka sngi bad u bnai babiang ban pyntreikam ïa kata ka jingsylla jong u . La rai ban pyntreikam ha ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , u bnai uba khat-ar .
Mynta , A Trai , me la ïa ka kular , bad men shah ïa shakri me ban noh ha kaba suk .
translation.en: Lord , now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace , according to thy word :

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong ka kim Judah shym kohnguh ïa U Trai bad u Manasseh u la ïalam ïa ki ban leh wat ïa pop ki kiba kham khraw ban ïa kito kiba la leh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba U Trai u beh la noh ka na ri katba ki briew jong u ki tur shaphrang .
translation.en: But they hearkened not : and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the  Lord  destroyed before the children of Israel .
And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; and , behold , he is by the altar . Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , saying , Go , fall upon him .
translation.kha: Haba ka khubor ka la poi ha u Syiem Solomon ba u Joab u la phet krad sha ka Ïingjaiñ bad ba u don harud ka duwan , u Solomon u la phah ïa u nonglamktien sha u Joab ban kylli ïa u balei ba u la phet sha ka duwan . U Joab u jubab ba u la phet krad sha U  Trai  namar ba u la sheptieng ïa u Solomon . Kumta u Syiem Solomon u la phah ïa u Benaïah ban pynïap ïa u Joab .

translation.en: The son of Abinadab , in all the region of Dor  ; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife :
translation.kha: U Benabinadab , uba shongkurim ïa ka Taphath , ka khun jong u Solomon : ka thain Dor baroh kawei ;
U ïa ki paid ka Judah ban ïa ka mon jong Trai , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong , bad ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai bad jong u .
translation.en: And commanded Judah to seek the  Lord  God of their fathers , and to do the law and the commandment .

translation.kha: Ki paid Asher ki shong bad ki Kanaan ha kiba kita ki jaka naba kim shym la beh ïa ki .
translation.en: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites , the inhabitants of the land : for they did not drive them out .

translation.kha: kim don ei ei shuh ban ai haba jingmut nga la dep kren . Ki ktien jong nga ki ngam kum ki jingjaw jong slap u ;
translation.en: After my words they spake not again  ; and my speech dropped upon them .

translation.kha: khmat ka khet ruh la don kaei kaba i kum ïit bakhraw kaba shai sngur bha . La ker ha baroh sawdong ka khet da tylli ki jingthaw ba-im kiba don ki khmat sha bad .
translation.en: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal : and in the midst of the throne , and round about the throne , were four beasts full of eyes before and behind .

translation.kha: U Khrist u la leh ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkyrkhu kaba pyndem Blei u la Mattatha ha u Abraham kan ïoh wan shaïong Mynhyndai Jentil da U khawai Jisu , khnang ba lyngba ka jingngeit ngin ïohpdiang Pyntreikam U Mynsiem khrew la kular da U daitbuid .
translation.en: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh lko kata ka jaka bad Lebanon la leit sha ka thain Siat ki nongbah Tyros bad sngewbang .
translation.en: Then Jesus went thence , and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon .
So Jacob came to Luz , which is in the land of Canaan , that is , Beth–el , he and all the people that were with him .
translation.kha: U Jakob u wan poi bad la ki briew baroh ha Lus , ïa kaba la tip mynta kum ka Bethel , ha ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: But as many as received him , to them gave he power to become the sons of God , even to them that believe on his name :
translation.kha: Katto katne pat , ki la pdiang ïa u bad ki la ngeit ha u ; kumta u la ai bor ha ki , ban long ki khun U Blei .
U thiah mynmiet u khie bad ha ka por mynsngi , bad ha baroh kata ka por ki symbai speh bad ki nang san . Pynban tip kumno kane ka jia .
translation.en: And should sleep , and rise night and day , and the seed should spring and grow up , he knoweth not how .

The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals , and fashioneth it with hammers , and worketh it with the strength of his arms : yea , he is hungry , and his strength faileth : he drinketh no water , and is faint .
translation.kha: U kamar u shim shi lyngkhot ka nar bad u pynwandur ïa ka ha ka ding . Ka ksang ti bakhlaiñ jong u ka pynkhih ïa u tyrnem ban tied pynwandur ïa ka nar . Katba u dang trei , u thngan , u sliang bad u la thait .
Kim shym la ki khun U Blei katba kum ka rukom , kata , da kaba kha ki u kpa ha ka doh ; U Blei hi u la long U Kpa .
translation.en: Which were born , not of blood , nor of the will of the flesh , nor of the will of man , but of God .

translation.kha: julor la leh ïa Rhesa ban pynkhreh ïa shemphang briew jong U Blei baroh na ka bynta ka kam jong ka jingshakri ba kynja mynsiem , khnang ban tei ïa ka met U Asalaïah Jehu
translation.en: For the perfecting of the saints , for the work of the ministry , for the edifying of the body of Christ :
And , behold , seven ears , withered , thin , and blasted with the east wind , sprung up after them :
translation.kha: Nangta sa hynñiew tylli kiwei pat ki kop kew ki la shylluit , kiba raikhoh bad kiba la pyntyrkhong da ka lyer ri shyiap , bad ki kop kew kiba raikhoh ki la nguid noh ïa kita kiba met .
( Ïa u Barabbas la buh ha ka byndi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin lah jia ka nongbah , bad namar ka jingpynïap briew . )
translation.en: ( Who for a certain sedition made in the city , and for murder , was cast into prison . )

translation.kha: Nga la leit sha uta u angel bad nga la jingpynïap shetkylla u ban ai ha kylla ïa ka kot kli kaba rit . U la jingsngew ïa snieh ba-thala To shim ïa ka bad diengthew bam ïa ka ; kan sa kylla jew ha ka nierbah jong me , hynrei ha ka shyntur jong me Balah long kaba thiang kum ka ngap .
translation.en: And I went unto the angel , and said unto him , Give me the little book . And he said unto me , Take it , and eat it up  ; and it shall make thy belly bitter , but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey .
Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple , and said unto him ,  Behold , thou art made whole : sin no more , lest a worse thing come unto thee .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , U Jisu u la shem ïa u ha ka Templ bad u la ong ,  Peit shane , me la khiah mynta ; te sangeh na kaba leh pop , ïoh kaei kaei kaba kham sniew ka lah ban jia ïa me .
U la ha ka rta kaba la bha uba la dap kyrhai da spah bad ka burom ; bad u Solomon u jong u , u long ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And he died in a good old age , full of days , riches , and honour : and Solomon his son reigned in his stead .
And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you , and a perpetual shame , which shall not be forgotten .
translation.kha: Ngan sa wanrah ha ki ïa ka jinglehrain bad ka jingjahburom junom ïa kaba yn ym klet shuh .
Nga la kren palat kaba ïa nga dei ban kren .
translation.en: Once have I spoken  ; but I will not answer : yea , twice  ; but I will proceed no further .

translation.kha: Naba haba ngi la im ka jinglong kum ki briew ki jingkwah bapop ba la pynkhih da ka Hukum ki trei ha ki met jong ngi , bad baroh kaba ngi leh ka kut ha ka jingïap .
translation.en: For when we were in the flesh , the motions of sins , which were by the law , did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death .
For all that do these things are an abomination unto the  Lord  : and because of these abominations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u isih ïa ki briew kiba leh ïa kine ki kam kiba isaitmet , bad dei namar kata ba u la beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew na kata ka ri katba phi nang tur sha khmat .

translation.en: And he came unto his father , and said , My father : and he said , Here am I  ; who art thou , my son ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u leit sha la u kpa bad u ong ,  Ko Pa !   Oi ,  u jubab .  Phi dei uei na ki khun shynrang jong nga ?
la khmih , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ki angel , da ki hajar bad million na ki ! la ïeng sawdong khet , saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , bad ki nongsharai balang ,
translation.en: And I beheld , and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders : and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand , and thousands of thousands  ;

translation.kha: Nga la wallam ki ïa sha ka ri baseisoh , ban lehkmen ïa ki jingot jong ka , bad kiei kiei kiwei pat kiba jong bha ka . Hynrei pynban ki la pynjot ïa ka ri jong nga , ki la pyntngit ïa ka ri kaba nga la ha ai ki .
translation.en: And I brought you into a plentiful country , to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof  ; but when ye entered , ye defiled my land , and made mine heritage an abomination .

Moreover , because I have set my affection to the house of my God , I have of mine own proper good , of gold and silver , which I have given to the house of my God , over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house ,
translation.kha: Nalor kane baroh kaba nga la pynbiang , nga la ai ruh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar na ka jingdon jingem jong nga namar ka jingieit jong nga ïa ka Templ jong U Blei .

translation.en: Behold therefore , I will gather thee unto thy fathers , and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace  ; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place . And they brought the king word again .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka jingpynshitom kaba ngan wallam ha Jerusalem kan nym wan haduh hadien ka jingïap jong phi . Ngan shah ïa phi ban ïap ha kaba suk .  Ki rangbah ki leit phai pat sha u syiem Josaïah bad kane ka khubor .
bad ki shlei shaphang Pham jingbishar , namar ba ïa u jingïohmap tynrah kane ka pyrthei kumne riewkynthei bishar .
translation.en: Of judgment , because the prince of this world is judged .

translation.kha: Don kumwei ban pyndonkam da ka ksiar ne da ka rupa ne da ki mawkordor ha kaba tei halor ka jingkhublei ; jingbuhrieh pat kin pyndonkam da ka jngut ne da u phlang ne da u jyntang .
translation.en: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold , silver , precious stones , wood , hay , stubble ;

translation.kha: Mynta ha kaba khatduh pyrthei baroh ka ïoh ïa ka jingjahthait bad ka jingsuk , bad uwei pa uwei u rwai da kaba kmen .
translation.en: The whole earth is at rest , and is quiet : they break forth into singing .
In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit .
translation.kha: Ha u , ïa phi ruh la tei lang lem bad kiwei pat da U Mynsiem jong u ha ka jaka ha kaba U Blei u shong .

Kham u Daniel u la leit sha u Ariokh , jingshna kabu’ u syiem u ïashongkurim lah hukum ban pynïap ïa ki nongai jingmut ïa u syiem Beh U la ong Pyndap u , Wat pynïap ïa ki . Ïalam ïa nga sha sharak syiem , bad ngan ïathuh ha u Eliesar ka ïitbniah jong u ka ïa-ud jingmut .
translation.en: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch , whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon : he went and said thus unto him  ; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon : bring me in before the king , and I will shew unto the king the interpretation .

translation.kha: syiem pynkhlaiñ ïa ki jingïada ïa ka nongbah kaba tei bha ïa ka kynroh , kaba tei ïa ki kut halor jong ka , bad ban shna ïa ka na . Nalor kata u tei pat ki jingïada ba la tei ka jaka kaba la pyndap khyndew ha ka mihngi jong ka Jerusalem ha ka bynta rim . U phah shna ruh bun bah sum bad ki stieh .
translation.en: Also he strengthened himself , and built up all the wall that was broken , and raised it up to the towers , and another wall without , and repaired Millo in the city of David , and made darts and shields in abundance .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingieit la pynjanai noh ha ngi , ngin ba don ka jingshlur ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar ; bad ngin ïa don ka namar ka jingim jong ngi ha kane ka ka pyrthei long kumjuh kum ka jong U Khrist .
translation.en: Herein is our love made perfect , that we may have boldness in the day of judgment : because as he is , so are we in this world .
He that is not with me is against me  ; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym long na ka bynta jong nga , u ïaleh pyrshah shisha ïa nga ; uno uno u bym ïarap ïa nga ban lum ban lang u long shisha uba pynsaphred .

To ïathuh ïa nga , ko ba-ieit jong nga shano phin pynbamphlang ka langbrot jong phi ? Hangno kin pynjahthait ka jingshit shiteng sngi ? Balei donkam ban wad ïa phi hapdeng ki kynhun langbrot jong kiwei pat nongap ?
translation.en: I charge you , O ye daughters of Jerusalem , by the roes , and by the hinds of the field , that ye stir not up , nor awake my love , till he please .

translation.kha: U Trai ïa jingieit phi iwei ïa iwei pat bad ïa ki briew baroh ban nang ïai san bad ban man khraw ha ka jingieit jong ngi ïa phi .
translation.en: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another , and toward all men , even as we do toward you :

translation.kha: Nangta ka Deborah ka ong ïa u Barak kattne Khie leit ! U dewryngkhiang nongsuh ïalam jingñiewburom me ! Ha kane ka sngi u la ai ha me ka jingjop Gris u kdang . .—Markos Juttah Barak phraphew la Solomon arsut na u Lum Tabor lem bad ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah jong u .
translation.en: And Deborah said unto Barak , Up  ; for this is the day in which the  Lord  hath delivered Sisera into thine hand : is not the  Lord  gone out before thee ? So Barak went down from mount Tabor , and ten thousand men after him .
And Jesus said ,  Let her alone  ; why trouble ye her ? she hath wrought a good work on me .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Ieh ïa ka marwei ! Balei ba phi pynwit ïa ka ? Ka la leh ïa kaei kaei kaba bha bad ba-itynnat na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection .
translation.kha: Ki kynthei ki dei ban nang ban sngap jar bad da ka jingsngewrit baroh .

translation.en: And Sarah died in Kirjath–arba  ; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan : and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah , and to weep for her .
translation.kha: Ka la ïap ha Hebron ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u Abraham u ïam sngewsih namar jong ka .

translation.en: They envied Moses also in the camp , and Aaron the saint of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap ki la pihuiñ ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , ki shakri bakhuid jong U  Trai .

translation.en: But when the husbandmen saw the son , they said among themselves , This is the heir  ; come , let us kill him , and let us seize on his inheritance .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki nongshimwai ki la ïohi ïa u khun , ki la ong ha lade , ‘ Une u long u khun jong u trai . Ale , to ngin pynïap ïa u , bad ngin ïoh ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u !’
Bad u Darius u la soi ïa ka hukum .
translation.en: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Un long na uwei phi ki khat-ar ngut , uta u ban ïa wieh u kpu jong u ha ka pliang bad nga .
translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  It is one of the twelve , that dippeth with me in the dish .

translation.kha: Ka bynta kaba sha trai eh jong ka duwan , na ka bynta ba-halor jong ka jingkhublei , jingpyiar long shi mitar Hit (Khlem . Ka bynta kaba bud na ka tduh ka long sanphew sentimitar baroh sawdong duh bad ka long ar mitar jingpynbeit alhia ïasngewtynnat Tabbath bynta hadien kata na Saph tduh paring ka :12-14 sanphew sentimitar baroh sawdong .
translation.en: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits , and the breadth one cubit  ; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits , and the breadth one cubit .

translation.kha: Lada pha balei kane baroh ka la jia ha pha — balei ba ki jaiñ jong pha ki kad noh bad la shah batbor — ka dei namar ba ka pop jong pha long kaba shyrkhei .
translation.en: And if thou say in thine heart , Wherefore come these things upon me ? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered , and thy heels made bare .

translation.kha: Ngi la nang leit nangta , bad namar ba ka lyer ka beh pyrshah ïa , ngi ngi la ïaid sha ka liang ba kah lyer ka jong dewlynnong Sypros .
translation.en: And when we had launched from thence , we sailed under Cyprus , because the winds were contrary .

translation.kha: U Ussaïah u kurup biang bad tei pat ïa ka Elath hadien ka jingïap u kpa u jong .
translation.en: He built Elath , and restored it to Judah , after that the king slept with his fathers .

It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month .
translation.kha: bad u la kren biang ha u haba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem . Hadien kata , U  Trai  u la kren ha u bun bunsien , tad haduh ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingsynshar u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Josaïah . Ha u bnai uba san jong kata ka snem , ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem la ringmraw noh .

translation.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle  ; twenty boards for the south side southward :
translation.kha: Ki shna arphew tylli ki jingker ïa ka liang kaba shaphang shathie ,
Hato phi la sdang pule ïa ka bad ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah
translation.en: Have you started studying the Bible with Jehovah’s Witnesses ?

For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth , to be thine inheritance , as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant , when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt , O Lord  God .
translation.kha: Me la jied ïa ki napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ban long u paidlang jong me , kumba me la ïathuh ha ki lyngba u Moses u shakri jong me mynba me wan ïalam noh na Ijipt ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

translation.en: For men shall be lovers of their own selves , covetous , boasters , proud , blasphemers , disobedient to parents , unthankful , unholy ,
translation.kha: Naba U briew u long u ba khwan myntoi , kiba lalot , kiba leh sarong , bad kiba kyr-eit ; kin krenbeiñ , kin ym kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , ki bymsngewnguh , bad ki bymriewblei ;

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga .

translation.en: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah , the son of Shelemiah , the son of Cushi , unto Baruch , saying , Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people , and come . So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand , and came unto them .
translation.kha: Te ki rangbah synshar ki la phah ïa u Jehudi ( u khun jong u Nethanaïah , u ksiew jong u Shelemaïah , bad u ksiew tun jong u Kushi ) ban ong ïa u Barukh ban wallam ïa ka kot kli na kaba u la pule ha ki paidbah . U Barukh u la wallam ha ki ïa ka kot kli .

U Trai , u la pynskhem pynstet ïa nga ha ka khet jong u Dabid , u kpa jong nga ; Bynrap la bat ïa la ka kular bad u la satia ïa ka hima ha nga bad ha Apollyon khun ki ksiew jong nga . Nga smai da U Trai uba im ba u Adonijah un ïap ha jingïasngewtynnat Pynshitom Kamon sngi !
translation.en: Now therefore , as the  Lord  liveth , which hath established me , and set me on the throne of David my father , and who hath made me an house , as he promised , Adonijah shall be put to death this day .

translation.kha: Uwei uwei pa na ki un long kum ka jingkah na ka lyer bad ka jaka ban rieh na ki erïong . Kin long kum ki wahduid kiba tuid ha ka shyiap ri , kum ka jingkah syrngiew u mawsiang bah ka ha ri shrah .
translation.en: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind , and a covert from the tempest  ; as rivers of water in a dry place , as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land .

translation.kha: Pha long ba la pynrem namar kito ki jingpynïap briew baroh bad ba la pyntngit da ki bleithaw ba pha la thaw , bad te sngi ka jong pha ka la wan , ka por ka la kut ! Dei na kata ka daw nga la pynlong ïa ki ban ibeiñ jaitbynriew ïa pha bad ki baroh ri ki ñiewbeiñ ïa pha .
translation.en: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed  ; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made  ; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near , and art come even unto thy years : therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen , and a mocking to all countries .

And Samuel said unto Jesse , Are here all thy children ? And he said , There remaineth yet the youngest , and , behold , he keepeth the sheep . And Samuel said unto Jesse , Send and fetch him : for we will not sit down till he come hither .
translation.kha: Nangta u kylli ïa u ,  Phi dang don shuh ki khun shynrang ?  U Jesse u jubab ,  Don sa tang uba khatduh , hynrei u dang leit sharai ïa ki langbrot .   Bthah ïa u ban wan shane ,  u Samuel u ong .  Ngin ym ai jingkñia katba um pat wan .
ïapra ngi long ki dkhot khublei! met jong u .
translation.en: For we are members of his body , of his flesh , and of his bones .

translation.kha: U Solomon u kpa jong phi u la banbeiñ ïa ngi bad u ki buh jingkit kiba khia ha ngi . Lada phi pynsting ïa kine bad ki jingkit pynsuk jingim ïa ngi , ngin long ki shakri bashaniah jong phi .
translation.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous : now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father , and his heavy yoke which he put upon us , lighter , and we will serve thee .

And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering , of a cubit and an half long , and a cubit and an half broad , and one cubit high : whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice .
translation.kha: Ki saw tylli ki miej ha ka kamra ba la pynïasoh ba la pynkhreh ban ai kum ki jingkñia batylli , ki la long da u maw ba shu phiah . Ki jrong sanphew sentimitar bad ha ki khlieh jong ki ka long hynñiewphew san sentimitar sawdong . Ïa ki tiar baroh ba pyndonkam ban pynïap ïa ki mrad ban kñia la buh halor kine ki miej .
Phim long weng kham stad ban ïa pynskhem pat , U dang u la Pdiang ïa ki Kane pynduh phim shemphang ? Ym don kaba rung shapoh u briew na shabar kaba u! shisha ban pynlong pynskhem ïa u ,
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Are ye so without understanding also ? Do ye not perceive , that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man , it cannot defile him  ;
As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings : and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un shim ïa kane ka khleiñ bad un thang ha ka duwan ka jingkñia ainguh thang , kumba u ju leh ïa ka khleiñ na u mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ka jingainguh ïasyllok .

translation.en: Then the same day at evening , being the first day of the week , when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews , came Jesus and stood in the midst , and saith unto them ,  Peace be unto you .
translation.kha: Ka la long la kham janmiet jong ka Sngi U Trai , bad ki synran ki la ïalumlang hapoh ka kamra kaba la khang skhem , namar ba ki la sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . Nangta U Jisu u la wan bad u la ïeng hapdeng jong ki .  To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad phi ,  u la ong .
Na bynta u syiem ïa lade hi , kane ka dei kaei kaba ma nga , U U Blei ki Israel , nga ong To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba la thoh kane ka kitab ,
translation.en: And as for the king of Judah , who sent you to enquire of the  Lord  , so shall ye say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard  ;
And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly , then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it , and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u briew u bym dei na ka longïing lyngdoh khlem da poi pyrkhat u bam ïa kano kano ka jingkñia ainguh , u dei ban pynphai sha uta u lyngdoh ïa ka dor jong ka bad un ai ruh nalor kata sa shi bynta na ka san bynta jong ka dor jong ka .
Ïa khyrdop ki Jerikho la khang khop bad la ap phira ban ym ïohrung Israel ki . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban rung shapoh lane mih shabar ka nongbah .
translation.en: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel : none went out , and none came in .

And , behold , six men came from the way of the higher gate , which lieth toward the north , and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand  ; and one man among them was clothed with linen , with a writer s inkhorn by his side : and they went in , and stood beside the brasen altar .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hynriew ngut ki briew ki wan na ka khyrdop kaba shabar kaba don shaphang shatei jong ka Templ , uwei uwei u rah la ka tiar ïaleh . Ryngkat bad ki la don u briew uba kup da ki jaiñ linen , uba rah ki tiar ban thoh . Baroh ki wan bad ïeng hajan ka duwan kaba da ka rnong .

translation.en: Let no man deceive himself . If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world , let him become a fool , that he may be wise .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa lade hi . Lada uno uno napdeng jong phi u pyrkhat ba u long uba stad da ka jingthew jong kane ka pyrthei , u dei ban long uba bieit khnang ba un long uba stad da shisha .

translation.en: When I say unto the wicked , Thou shalt surely die  ; and thou givest him not warning , nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way , to save his life  ; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .
translation.kha: Lada nga pynbna ba u briew basniew , un sa ïap noh bad mem shym la maham u ban kylla noh na ki lynti jong u , khnang ba u lah ban pyllait ïa la ka jingim , un ïap hi kum u nongpop , bad ngan pynkitkhlieh ha me ïa ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: For God hath not appointed us to wrath , but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ ,
translation.kha: U Blei um shym jied ïa ngi ban shah ïa ka jingbitar jong u , hynrei ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynim lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ,

translation.en: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God , than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season  ;
translation.kha: U la kham jied ban shahshitom bad ki briew jong U Blei ban ïa kaba lehkmen ha ka pop katto katne por .

U sot ba-eh u la leit na ka shnong Nasareth , kaba ha Galilaïa sha byndi shnong Bethlehem ha Judia , ka jaka ha phrang la kha ïa syiem Dabid shna U Jingpule u sahit leit Jingkñia namar u la long uba hiarpateng na doh Dabid .
translation.en: And Joseph also went up from Galilee , out of the city of Nazareth , into Judaea , unto the city of David , which is called Bethlehem  ; ( because he was of the house and lineage of David : )
And when even was come , he went out of the city .
translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la mihnoh na ka nongbah .

translation.en: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters : in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me .
translation.kha: Ki la rung lyngba ki thliew jong ki jaka ïada jong nga bad ki wan ïuh beit nalor jong nga ;
Nangta u Moses u Naba ïa suiñ! langbrot uba ar uba long btep ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang ïa kyllon Immer , bad u Aaron bad itynnad khun shynrang jong u Sing buh ïa la ki kijuh ha ka khlieh jong u .
translation.en: And he brought the other ram , the ram of consecration : and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram .
The anger of the  Lord  shall not return , until he have executed , and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart : in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly .
translation.kha: bad kan ym kut haduh ba un da leh ïa baroh kaba U thmu ban leh . Ha ki sngi ki ban wan ki briew jong U kin sa sngewthuh shai ïa kane .

translation.en: And when Esau heard the words of his father , he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry , and said unto his father , Bless me , even me also , O my father .
translation.kha: Haba u Iso u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u lynñiar jam bad ïamkthang ruh , bad u ong ,  Ko Pa ! to ai ha nga ruh ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong me .
U Agrippa u la ong ha u Paul , Ha kane ka por balyngkot hato pyrkhat ba men Khristan ïa nga ?
translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian .

translation.kha: Kumta u Gilboa u ïathuh ha u nadong shadong ; um shym buhrieh ei ei jingshongthait na u . U Eli u ong , U long U Trai ; ieh un leh katba u sngewbit ïa u ïa-ïohi
translation.en: And Samuel told him every whit , and hid nothing from him . And he said , It is the  Lord  : let him do what seemeth him good .

translation.kha: Kata ka ka la ong ha uta u uba hynriew , pyllait noh ïa ki saw ngut ki angel kiba la shah khum ha ka wahbah !
translation.en: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet , Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates .
That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ , both which are in heaven , and which are on earth ; even in him :
translation.kha: Kane ka jingthmu , ïa kaba U Blei un sa pyndep ha ka ïa kaba biang , ka long ban lumlang ïa ka jingpynlong baroh , ha bneng bad ha khyndew , lem bad U Khrist kum u khlieh .

Ha ki hynriew sngi ma , nga , U Trai nga , la thaw ka ïa bneng , ïa ka khyndew , ïa ka duriaw , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ki , ha hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew nga la . shongthait Namar kata , nga U Trai , nga la kyrkhu ïa ka Sabbaton , bad nga la pynkyntang khuid ïa ka .
translation.en: For in six days the  Lord  made heaven and earth , the sea , and all that in them is , and rested the seventh day : wherefore the  Lord  blessed the sabbath day , and hallowed it .

translation.kha: Kan don balui phar da ka hukum , nongkhap sur jong bajrong angel rangbah , ka jingriew Kynthei Hamath jong U Blei , bad U Trai hi da lade un sa wan hiar na bneng jingkahtngen Kito kiba la ïap da kaba ngeit ha U Khrist kin ïamih pat shuwa ;
translation.en: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout , with the voice of the archangel , and with the trump of God : and the dead in Christ shall rise first :

translation.kha: Hangta ha khmat uta , u syiem Dabid u ïaroh Trai . U ong A Trai U Blei jong ki tymmen jong ngi , ai ba yn ïaroh ïa me junom la junom !
translation.en: Wherefore David blessed the  Lord  before all the congregation : and David said , Blessed be thou ,  Lord  God of Israel our father , for ever and ever .
The sea is his , and he made it : and his hands formed the dry land .
translation.kha: U synshar halor ka duriaw , kaba u la thaw ; ka khyndew ruh , kaba u hi u la pynlong .

translation.en: Because it is written , Be ye holy  ; for I am holy .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  To long phi kiba khuid namar nga long uba khuid .

translation.en: Wherefore , O harlot , hear the word of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Mynta te , ko Jerusalem , pha ka nuti ! Sngap ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong .

translation.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah , and the servants of David , went out , and met together by the pool of Gibeon : and they sat down , the one on the one side of the pool , and the other on the other side of the pool .
translation.kha: U Joab , u khun jong ka Seruïah , bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la ïakynduh ïa ki ha ka pung , ha kaba baroh ki la ïashong , kawei ka kynhun ha kawei ka liang jong ka pung bad kawei pat ka kynhun ha kawei ka liang .
Ha khmih ! rangbah la ong . Nga ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad ïa U Khun U Briew Rhoda u ïeng ha ka katei kamon jong U Blei !
translation.en: And said , Behold , I see the heavens opened , and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God .

translation.kha: U Daniel u la jubab LONG Ko Syiem Kynrad , ym don Jin uno u nongleh byrtong , jongka nongleh myntor , u nongbatai kupar , lane u nongkhmih khlur uba pynpait ban ïathuh ha kyiuh ïa kata .
translation.en: Daniel answered in the presence of the king , and said , The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise men , the astrologers , the magicians , the soothsayers , shew unto the king  ;

translation.kha: Ym Dieng lap ïa ki ba ki ïathuh lamler ; ki long kiba khlem Markaboth .
translation.en: And in their mouth was found no guile : for they are without fault before the throne of God .
When they told it unto David , he sent to meet them , because the men were greatly ashamed : and the king said , Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown , and then return .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewlehrain shaba palat ban leit phai ïing . Haba u Dabid u la tip ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la phah ktien sha ki ban sah ha Jerikho bad ban ym wan phai tad ynda ki  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , ki la san biang .
Nangta U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit sha kawei pat ka .
translation.en: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men s lives , but to save them .  And they went to another village .
Then will we give our daughters unto you , and we will take your daughters to us , and we will dwell with you , and we will become one people .
translation.kha: Te kumta ngin kohnguh ba kan don ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jong ngi . Ngin shong ngin sah hapdeng jong phi , bad ngin ïalong kawei ka jaitbynriew bad phi .

translation.en: Now my days are swifter than a post : they flee away , they see no good .
translation.kha: Ki sngi jong nga ki mareh stet , ym don kawei na ki kaba bha .

Uno ilehrain uba ïalap , u jinglehsbun ban Nongsharai ïa ki khubor jong U sohkew ; uno uno uba shakri , u dei ban shakri da ka bor kaba U Blei u ai ïa u nonglamktien khnang ba ha kiei kiei baroh yn ai ïa ka jingïaroh sha U Blei Laish Goah Jisu Khrist , ha uba ka burom bad ka bor lynthaw long byrtong jong pynnoh junom la junom , Amen .
translation.en: If any man speak , let him speak as the oracles of God  ; if any man minister , let him do it as of the ability which God giveth : that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ , to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Kumta ïa une u shakri bymmyntoi — bret ïa u shabar ha kaba dum ; hangta un lynñiar kyr-iat bad la ki bniat .’
translation.en: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
They build up Zion with blood , and Jerusalem with iniquity .
translation.kha: Phi tei ïa ka nongbah jong U Blei , ka Jerusalem , ha ka nongrim jong ka jingpynïap briew bad ka jingbishar bymhok .

translation.en: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me : as my strength was then , even so is my strength now , for war , both to go out , and to come in .
translation.kha: Khmih sha nga ! nga la dap phraphew san snem ka rta bad nga dang shait dang khlaiñ mynta kumba nga la long mynba u Moses u la phah ïa nga . Nga dang shait dang khlaiñ bha ban leit ïaleh thma ne na ka bynta kano kano .

U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah ïa nga shajrong bad u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop mihngi jong ka Templ . hajan Hangta jong ka khyrdop nga la ïohi arphew san ngut ki rangbah kynthup u Jaasanaïah ïa u khun jong u Assur bad u Pelataïah u khun jong u , Benaïah ki ar ngut ki nongïalam jong ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Moreover the spirit lifted me up , and brought me unto the east gate of the  Lord s  house , which looketh eastward : and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men  ; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur , and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah , princes of the people .

translation.kha: Kan ym tip ba dei ma nga uba la ai ïa ka u kew , ka , ka Olib , bad baroh rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka ju ha kaba mane ïa u Baal .
translation.en: For she did not know that I gave her corn , and wine , and oil , and multiplied her silver and gold , which they prepared for Baal .

translation.kha: Pynthikna ba yn ym don napdeng jong phi u , shynrang lane ka kynthei , lane ka longïing , lane ka jait , ki ban phai na noh U Trai U Blei jong phi ban ïa mane ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew . Kum uta , un long kum u thied uba u pynmih soh uba kthang bad uba don bih .
translation.en: Lest there should be among you man , or woman , or family , or tribe , whose heart turneth away this day from the  Lord  our God , to go and serve the gods of these nations  ; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood  ;

translation.kha: la leit jngoh ïa u syiem bad ki la ong , Darius , ba u Syiem Kynrad un im junom !
translation.en: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king , and said thus unto him , King Darius , live for ever .
Then come unto him the Sadducees , which say there is no resurrection  ; and they asked him , saying ,
translation.kha: Te katto katne ngut na ki Saddusi , kiba ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la wan ha U Jisu bad ki la ong ,

translation.en: For ye have the poor with you always , and whensoever ye will ye may do them good : but me ye have not always .
