translation.kha: U Philip u shem ïa lade ha Asotos ; u la leit nang sha Kaisaria , bad ha lynti u la ïalap ka ïa Khubor Babha ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong .
translation.en: But Philip was found at Azotus : and passing through he preached in all the cities , till he came to Caesarea .

translation.kha: U Jakob u la bteng ïa jingleit ka jong u bad u la leit sha ka ri kaba shaphang mihngi .
translation.en: Then Jacob went on his journey , and came into the land of the people of the east .

translation.kha: Nangta pat lyngdoh u un pynlong sa ïa ka jingkñia ka namar , pop bad un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid . Hadien kata , un pynïap ïa uta u jingri namar ka jingainguh thang ,
translation.en: And the priest shall offer the sin offering , and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness  ; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering :
The womb shall forget him  ; the worm shall feed sweetly on him  ; he shall be no more remembered  ; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree .
translation.kha: Wat ka kmie jong u kam kynmaw shuh ïa u mynta ; la bam ïa u da ki ksaiñ bad la pynjot kum ïa u dieng ba la khyllem .

Katba nga Jingsiewspah ap khmih , u mradkhlaw uba saw u la mihpaw . jaiñjot la long uba khrawbor , jingkhanglad ingiew bad uba ishyrkhei Sansannah Da ki pyntreikam nar Shebat jong jingtiengburom , u khñiot pynlwet ïa ki ba u la ïoh , Uri nangta 1943 la kyrdem halor jong ki . Ym kum kita kiwei pat ki mradkhlaw :13 u la don shiphew tylli ki reng nongbanbor
translation.en: After this I saw in the night visions , and behold a fourth beast , dreadful and terrible , and strong exceedingly  ; and it had great iron teeth : it devoured and brake in pieces , and stamped the residue with the feet of it : and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it  ; and it had ten horns .

translation.kha: Ynda u Saul Timnath Mahalab ban leit noh na Erekh Samuel , jingsngewkhuslai Blei u buh ha u Esra jinglong kaba thymmai . Bad kita baroh tynrah u thlia u jingai ïathuh ha u ki wan jia long ha kata mynsngi sngi .
translation.en: And it was so , that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel , God gave him another heart : and all those signs came to pass that day .

translation.kha: U Pilat u la ong ha u , Mem ei kren ei ha nga ? To kynmaw , nga don ka bor ban pyllait ïa me bad ruh ban phah ïa sahnarphna me .
translation.en: Then saith Pilate unto him , Speakest thou not unto me ? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee , and have power to release thee ?
But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel , even so we speak ; not as pleasing men , but God , which trieth our hearts .
translation.kha: Pynban , ngi kren borabor kumba U Blei u kwah ïa ngi kumta , namar u la ñiew ïa ngi kiba bit ban shaniah ïa ka Khubor Babha . Ngim shym pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa ki briew , hynrei , ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei , uba tynjuh ïa ki jingthmu jong ngi .
Um khuslai lane sheptieng ; u thikna ban ïohi ba ki nongshun jong u Lada shahjop .
translation.en: His heart is established , he shall not be afraid , until he see his desire upon his enemies .

translation.kha: Te Trai U u la hukum ïa u dohkha ban prie noh ïa u Jonah harud duriaw , bad u la leh kumta .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto the fish , and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land .
And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon : of shittim wood shalt thou make it .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka duwan da ka dieng akasia , na ka bynta ban thang jingiwbih .
Nangta i ong ban leit thied jingbam shuh sa khyndiat .
translation.en: And our father said , Go again , and buy us a little food .

translation.kha: bapher Samaria ka kyllon noh nawei ki Israel kim Bishar kohnguh ïa U Trai U Blei pynnep ki lade” mawbah bakynjang pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad jingsheptieng bad kim kohnguh ïa baroh ki aiñ ba la ai da u Moses , Abieser shakri jong U ba-itynnat . Kim shahshkor bad kim kohnguh .
translation.en: Because they obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  their God , but transgressed his covenant , and all that Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded , and would not hear them , nor do them .

translation.kha: shahskhor tip ba Arnon met lud phi ïakylli long ki dkhot jong ka met U Khrist . Hato ngan shim noh shi lyngkhot na Shebat met U Khrist bad pynlong ïa ka shi bynta jong ka met jong ka U ? Kam lah ban long!
translation.en: Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ ? shall I then take the members of Christ , and make them the members of an harlot ? God forbid .

translation.kha: Wat lyngngoh Pyntha phi ïohi ïa-ïohpdiang ka sorkar ka banbeiñ ïa kiba duk bad kam ai ha ki ïa ka jinglehhok sngewbha ïa bhah hok jong ki . Ïa uwei pa uwei u rangbah synshar la jaiñkup da Uri uno uba kham sngewlyngngoh bad ïa baroh Pynthikna la ïada jingphah ki rangbah synshar kiba kham halor .
translation.en: If thou seest the oppression of the poor , and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province , marvel not at the matter : for he that is higher than the highest regardeth  ; and there be higher than they .

translation.kha: ngin long shlur , te , bad ong U Trai u long u nongïarap jong ngan ym sheptieng . Uei uba lah ban leh ei ïa nga ?
translation.en: So that we may boldly say , The Lord is my helper , and I will not fear what man shall do unto me .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka ryntieh jong u ka neh khlem khih , Bad ïa ki ksang ti jong u la pynkhlaiñ Da ka bor jong U Blei Uba Khlaiñbor jong u Jakob , Da u Nongap langbrot , U nongïada ki jong Israel .
translation.en: But his bow abode in strength , and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob  ; ( from thence is the shepherd , the stone of Israel : )
So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons , and the diseases departed from them , and the evil spirits went out of them .
translation.kha: Wat ïa ki rumal bad ki jaiñ-da kiba u la pyndonkam la leit lam sha kito kiba pang , bad ïa ki jingpang jong ki la beh noh , bad ki mynsiem bymman ki ju mihnoh na ki .
La pynïadait skhem haduh katta ïa katta ki baroh ba ym don kano kano kaba lah ban pynïakhlad ïa ki .
translation.en: They are joined one to another , they stick together , that they cannot be sundered .

And he took their king s crown from off his head , the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones : and it was set on David s head . And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la shim ïa ka pansngiat ksiar na ka khlieh u blei Molekh , u bleithaw ki Ammon kaba khia kumba laiphew san kilo bad kaba don u mawkordor ha ka . U Dabid u la shim ïa u mawkordor bad u buh ïa u ha la ka pansngiat . U rah ruh shibun ki mar lute na ka nongbah
sngewtmang Hadad u ïoh barew ka jingïadei paralok bad u syiem u ai mawleiñ ka para kynsi , ka para jingmihpat ka Syiem Tahpenes ha u Jobab ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh , so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife , the sister of Tahpenes the queen .

translation.kha: Wat bam uta na u kew thymmai , la uba dang im , ne uba la sdieh pyrthiew , ne uba la pynlong , kpu tad haduh ba phi la wallam ïa kane ka jingkñia ainguh sha U Blei . Kane ka ka long hukum kaba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki dei ban leh la pateng pateng .
translation.en: And ye shall eat neither bread , nor parched corn , nor green ears , until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings .
Will he plead against me with his great power ? No  ; but he would put strength in me .
translation.kha: Hato U Blei un pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong u baroh pyrshah ïa nga ? Em , un sngap ïa nga katba nga dang kren .
Eli U u la khot ïa u , Ko Samuel , ko khun jong nga ! Oi , kynrad , u Samuel u jubab .
translation.en: Then Eli called Samuel , and said , Samuel , my son . And he answered , Here am I .

translation.kha: U Trai ong u , Ha kata ka por ngan shim noh ïa ki kulai jong phi bad yn pynjot ïa ki kali ïapom .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  , that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee , and I will destroy thy chariots :

translation.kha: bad u syiem u ong ha u Ittai , u nongïalam jong ki , Balei phi ïaleit bad ngi ? Khie leit phai noh bad bad sah u syiem . thymmai Phi dei u nongwei u , nongphetwir na la ka jong ka ri .
translation.en: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite , Wherefore goest thou also with us ? return to thy place , and abide with the king : for thou art a stranger , and also an exile .
Then they told Saul , saying , Behold , the people sin against the  Lord  , in that they eat with the blood . And he said , Ye have transgressed : roll a great stone unto me this day .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ,  Khmih , ki briew ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka .   Phi dei ki nongshetkylla !  u Saul u kyang .  Pyntyllun uwei u maw heh shane sha nga .
Kumta ym u Johanan uno uno na ki rangbah shipai lymne kino kino ki paidbah kin kohnguh ïa ka U Trai ïaisah ha ka ri Judah
translation.en: So Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces , and all the people , obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  , to dwell in the land of Judah .
But by what means he now seeth , we know not  ; or who hath opened his eyes , we know not : he is of age  ; ask him : he shall speak for himself .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngim tip kumno pat ba mynta u la ïoh imat , lymne ngim tip mano ba la pynkoit ïa u na ka jingmatlah jong u . Kylli ïa u ; u la biang ka rta , bad u lah ban jubab da lade hi !

translation.en: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes , and the deaf that have ears .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ,  Khot hajir ïa ki briew jong nga sha ïingbishar . Ki don ki khmat hynrei ki long kiba matlah ; ki don ki shkor hynrei ki long kiba kyllut !

translation.en: Remove from me reproach and contempt  ; for I have kept thy testimonies .
translation.kha: To pyllaitluid ïa nga na ki jingibeiñ bad jingkrenbeiñ jong ki , namar nga la sumar ïa ki aiñ jong me ;
Haba Jethro ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , kmen bad u la ong ,
translation.en: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the  Lord  had done to Israel , whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians .

Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof , when I shall bring again their captivity  ; The  Lord  bless thee , O habitation of justice , and mountain of holiness .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ,  Haba ngan wallam pat ïa ki briew sha ka ri jong ki , sa shisien pat kin ong ha ka ri Judah bad ki shnong jong ka ,   ‘ To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa u lum bakyntang jong ka Jerusalem , ka jaka bakhuid ha kaba u shong .’

translation.en: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips , and layeth up deceit within him  ;
translation.kha: U riewarsap u buhrieh ïa la ka jingshun ha lyndet ki ktien pynkhyllew .
Nangta nga la shim u dieng uba la khot U Jingsngewbha bad nga la ïa u , ban pyndam ka jutang kaba U Trai u la pynlong bad ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translation.en: And I took my staff , even Beauty , and cut it asunder , that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people .
The  Lord  will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people , and the princes thereof : for ye have eaten up the vineyard  ; the spoil of the poor is in your houses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wallam sha ka jingbishar ïa ki tymmen ki san bad ïa ki nongïalam . U pynlong ïa kane ka jingkynnoh :  Phi la lute ïa ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki ïing jong phi ki dap da kiei kiei kiba phi la shim na kiba duk .
Lada ngi ïai bteng ban ïaishah , ngin sa synshar ruh lem bad u Lada . ngin len ïa u , ruh u un len ïa ngi .
translation.en: If we suffer , we shall also reign with him : if we deny him , he also will deny us :
Reuben , Simeon , Levi , and Judah ,
translation.kha: U Reuben , U Simeon , U Lebi , U Judah ,

Wah ïa kata ka pyrda na woh jingpyndait kiba don hapoh tnum Ïingjaiñ , bad ïa Meshek Synduk makhon Jutang kaba don ar tylli ki bahok buh prais ka sha lyndet ka kotbor . Kata ka pyrda kan pynïakhlad ïa ka Jaka Kyntang na ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam .
translation.en: And thou shalt hang up the veil under the taches , that thou mayest bring in thither within the veil the ark of the testimony : and the veil shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy .
He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit , and worketh miracles among you , doeth he it by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?
translation.kha: Hato U Blei u ai ïa U Mynsiem bad leh ïa ki kambah hapdeng jong phi namar ba phi leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ne namar ba phi ïohsngew ïa ka Gospel bad ngeit ïa ka ?

translation.en: When wisdom entereth into thine heart , and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul  ;
translation.kha: Phin sa long uba stad , bad ka jingtip jong phi kan ai jingkmen ïa phi .

translation.en: And he bought fine linen , and took him down , and wrapped him in the linen , and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock , and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre .
translation.kha: U Joseph u la thied ïa ka jaiñ linen , u la pynhiar ïa ka met shapoh , u la sop ïa ka da ka jaiñ , bad u la buh ïa ka ha ka jingtep ïa kaba la lah tih ha u mawsiang . Nangta u pyntyllun ïa u maw uba heh ha ka jaka rung jong ka jingtep .
Hynrei u Ittai u jubab , 9 Syiem kynrad , Suntukhi smai ha phi ha ka kyrteng U Trai ba ngan ïai leit shkor phi kat ïakajia phi leit , wat la ka dei Shano ïap .
translation.en: And Ittai answered the king , and said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as my lord the king liveth , surely in what place my lord the king shall be , whether in death or life , even there also will thy servant be .

translation.kha: Ha ka por ba la leit , haba wat u Saul u long dang u syiem jong ngi , phi la ïalam ïa ki rangbah Israel ha ka thma bad Trai U u la kular ïa phi ba phin ïalam ïa ki briew jong u bad ban long u nongsynshar jong ki .
translation.en: Also in time past , when Saul was king over us , thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel : and the  Lord  said to thee , Thou shalt feed my people Israel , and thou shalt be a captain over Israel .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki leh ïa kaei kaba Trai U u la hukum .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron did as the  Lord  commanded them , so did they .
Pass me the pen .
translation.kha: Ai sha nga u khulom .
Shen ngan pynkhih ïa ka bneng bad ka pyrthei , ïa ka bad khyndew ka duriaw .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Yet once , it is a little while , and I will shake the heavens , and the earth , and the sea , and the dry land  ;
The burden of Nineveh . The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor shaphang ka Ninebeh , ka jingïathuh shaphang ka jingïohipaw kaba la ïohi da u Nahum , uba dei na Elkosh .

translation.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka snam jong uta u mrad , un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad un theh ïa kaba sah , ha trai jong kata ka duwan .
Ha kajuh ka por u Petros u ïai tied . Khatduh ki la plie ïa jingkhang ka , bad haba ki la ïohi ïa u , ki sngewlyngngoh la .
translation.en: But Peter continued knocking : and when they had opened the door , and saw him , they were astonished .
He shall return no more to his house , neither shall his place know him any more .
translation.kha: Kum u lyoh uba mih bad u jah noh , u briew u ïap bad um wan phai shuh ; la klet noh da baroh kiba ithuh ïa u .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  put forth his hand , and touched my mouth . And the  Lord  said unto me , Behold , I have put my words in thy mouth .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong nga , bad u la ong ha nga ,  To shahshkor , nga ai ha me ki kyntien kiba me dei ban kren .

translation.en: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty . And he answered and said unto him , O man of God , thus hath the king said , Come down quickly .
translation.kha: U syiem u la phah sa uwei pat u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah , kiba la leit kiew bad ong ha u Elijah ,  Ko briew jong U Blei , u syiem u hukum ïa phi ban wan hiar shisyndon !

Ngan ïa pynkylla ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi sha ki jingtep briew ngan bad pynkylla ïa ki jingrwai jong kmen phi sha ki jingïam sngewsih . Ngan pynlong ïa phi ba phin khi lyndum ïa la ka khlieh bad phin phong ka jaiñ khain , bad long phin kum ki kmie ki kpa kiba ïambriew na ka bynta u khun ba marwei tang jong ki . Kata ka sngi kan long kaba kthang haduh kaba kut .
translation.en: And I will turn your feasts into mourning , and all your songs into lamentation  ; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins , and baldness upon every head  ; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son , and the end thereof as a bitter day .
For I say unto you , That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees , ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Kumta , nga ong ïa phi , ba phin lah ban rung shapoh ka Hima ki bneng tang lada phi ïaineh skhem kham palat ban ïa ki nonghikai Aiñ bad ki Pharisi ha kaba leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa .

translation.en: For our God is a consuming fire .
translation.kha: namar ba U Blei jong ngi u long shisha ka ding kaba bam duh .
Kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long ka lynti kaba nano ka lah sner ïalam sha ka jingïap bajyrngam
translation.en: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man , but the end thereof are the ways of death .
And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea , and throughout all the region round about .
translation.kha: Kane ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ka la phriang kylleng jong ka ri bad sha ki thain kiba don sawdong .

translation.en: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing  ;

translation.en: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it  ; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them : and they were judged every man according to their works .
translation.kha: Nangta ka duriaw ka la aiti ïa kiba ïap jong ka . Ka jingïap bad kumjuh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ki la aiti ïa kiba ïap kiba ki la bat . Bad ïa baroh la bishar kat kum kaei kaba ki la leh .
hynrei ïa ka jingtim , lada phi lyndet leh ïa kine ki bad hukum phai noh ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ïa kiba phim pat ju tip mynno mynno .
translation.en: And a curse , if ye will not obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day , to go after other gods , which ye have not known .
Then he returned , and walked in the house to and fro  ; and went up , and stretched himself upon him : and the child sneezed seven times , and the child opened his eyes .
translation.kha: U Elisha u khie joit , u ïaid shane shatai hapoh kamra , bad nangta u leit biang bad u pyiar ïa lade halor u khynnah . U khynnah u la synriah hynñiew sien bad u peit la ki khmat .
Bad u Solomon u bteng , U Dabid u kpa jong nga u thmu la ban tei ïa Templ ka ban mane ïa U Trai U Blei ki Israel ,
translation.en: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the  Lord  God of Israel .

And his daughter in law , Phinehas  wife , was with child , near to be delivered : and when she heard the tidings that the ark of God was taken , and that her father in law and her husband were dead , she bowed herself and travailed  ; for her pains came upon her .
translation.kha: Ka pyrsa kurim u Eli , ka tnga u Phinehas , ka la armet , bad ka la jan dei ka por ba kan kha khun . Haba ka ïohsngew ba la knieh noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , bad ba u kthaw kurim bad u tnga jong ka ki la ïap , kynsan ka la suh kha bad ka la kha .
Ka bleithaw u Mikah ka hangta ha ka Ïingjaiñ mane ïa U Blei ka ha Shiloh
translation.en: And they set them up Micah s graven image , which he made , all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh .

translation.kha: Lada u briew u leh ïa phet puit ka kam runar bad na tmoh bynta kata u shah phasi ha u dieng ,
translation.en: And if a man have committed a sin worthy of death , and he be to be put to death , and thou hang him on a tree :

translation.en: Which story did you tell ?

And it shall come to pass , that as the  Lord  rejoiced over you to do you good , and to multiply you  ; so the  Lord  will rejoice over you to destroy you , and to bring you to nought  ; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u pynmanbha bad pynroi ïa phi da kaba kmen , kumta ruh da kaba kmen un pynjot bad pynduh pyndam ïa phi . Yn sa rat dyngkhong ïa phi na kata ka ri ba phin ïohkynti .
Haba u u Shelah la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Eber ;
translation.en: And Salah lived thirty years , and begat Eber :
But if any man love God , the same is known of him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa u briew uba ieit ïa U Blei la ithuh da u .
dieng Olib u jubab , Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , hap ban pynmih umphniang , ïa kaba pyndonkam ban ïa ki blei jong ngi bad ïa ki khunbynriew .’
translation.en: But the olive tree said unto them , Should I leave my fatness , wherewith by me they honour God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?

translation.en: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away ? they die , even without wisdom .
And Abram was fourscore and six years old , when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram .
translation.kha: U Abram u la don phraphew hynriew snem ha kata ka por .
Nangta thep hapoh ka synduk ïa ki ar tylli ki ïabishar Mynba ngan ai ha me , ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum jong nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee .

translation.en: And whosoever doth not bear his cross , and come after me , cannot be my disciple .

translation.kha: Ka Duriaw Basaw ka la khmih bad ka phet noh , ka wah Jordan ka la sangeh ban tuid .

translation.en: After sin and death entered the world , God revealed that it was his purpose that the dead be restored to life by means of a resurrection .
translation.kha: Hadien ka pop bad ka jingiap ka la wan sha ka pyrthei , U Blei u la pynpaw ba ka long ka jingthmu jong u , ba kiba iap kin ioh biang ia ka jingim da ka jingmihpat .
To leh ïa kane ki briew kiba kin ym shah ei , bad kumta phin ym pop ba dei ma kiba pynïap ïa ki ha kata ka ri U Trai u ai ha .
translation.en: That innocent blood be not shed in thy land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance , and so blood be upon thee .
Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass , and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard , that kept the entrance of the king s house .
translation.kha: Ban bujli ïa ki , u Rehoboam u thaw ïa ki stieh da ka rnong bad aiti ïa ki ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba kitkhlieh ban ïada ïa ki khyrdop ka ïingsyiem .
Kumta te , phim long shuh u mraw hynrei u khun . naduh Bad phi ba long u khun jong , U U Blei un ai ha phi baroh kat kaba u don na ka bynta la ki khun .
translation.en: Wherefore thou art no more a servant , but a son ; and if a son , then an heir of God through Christ .

translation.kha: Nga la ai palat ka shispah ksiar nylla bad la jan arspah sawphew ka nylla ïa ki kynroh jong ka Templ
translation.en: Even three thousand talents of gold , of the gold of Ophir , and seven thousand talents of refined silver , to overlay the walls of the houses withal :

translation.kha: U ai jingbam ïa ki jingthaw ba-im baroh ; ka jingieit u jong ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: Who giveth food to all flesh : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: ka Long katba long , u Ahimaas u ong biang Nga , kwah ban leit . Khie leit , u Joab u ong . Kumta u Ahimaas u mareh bran na ka lynti kaba na ka Them Jordan , bad shen u la tam ïa uta u mraw .
translation.en: But howsoever , said he , let me run . And he said unto him , Run . Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain , and overran Cushi .
He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand , and took Sela by war , and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day .
translation.kha: U Amasaïah u pynïap shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Edom ha ka Them Mluh ; u kurup ïa ka nongbah Sela ha ka thma bad u khot ïa ka , ka Joktheel , ka kyrteng kaba dang ïaisah .

Kumta ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ha rupa ba u Samson un babiang sha la kamra thiah , ki briew shajan kata ka shnong ki ong ha u , Kaei kaba Gamaliel thiang ban ïa ka ngap ? Uei uba :39-44 khlaiñ ban ïa Sosthenes Khaldi Abilene U Samson u jubab , Lada phim shym Dammim lur da ka kyrhuh jong nga jingsngap Phin ym tip ïa ka jubab mynta .
translation.en: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down , What is sweeter than honey ? and what is stronger than a lion ? And he said unto them , If ye had not plowed with my heifer , ye had not found out my riddle .

translation.kha: Lada u briew uba ieit ïa ka jingsuk u shong , hangta ai ba ka jingkhublei jingsuk jong phi kan neh ha u ; lymda kumta , shim noh ïa jingkhublei ka jingsuk .
translation.en: And if the son of peace be there , your peace shall rest upon it : if not , it shall turn to you again .

translation.kha: Ka jingsngewsih bakhraw ka la wan ha ki briew jong jingkharoi Gasa , bad ki briew jong ka Ashkelon kyrkhoit sngap jar . Katno slem kiba pungsum sah ha Philistia kin ïam sngewsih ?
translation.en: Baldness is come upon Gaza  ; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley : how long wilt thou cut thyself ?
The Jews therefore strove among themselves , saying , How can this man give us his flesh to eat ?
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynmih ïa ka jingïatainia kaba tyngeh hapdeng jong ki .  Kumno une u briew u lah ban ai ha ngi ïa ka doh jong u ban bam ?  ki la kylli .

translation.en: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time , and in the world to come life everlasting .
translation.kha: kin ïohpdiang kham bun shah ha kane ka pateng bad ïa ka jingim bymjukut ha ka pateng ka ban wan .
Ngan phah ïa ka jingïapthngan bad ki mradkhlaw ba pynïap ïa ki khun jong pha , bad ngan ïa ka jingpang jingleh thombor , bad thma ban pynïap ïa pha . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts , and they shall bereave thee  ; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee  ; and I will bring the sword upon thee . I the  Lord  have spoken it .

translation.kha: Ka la leh ïa kaei kaba ka la lah ban leh ; ka la Jingïaleh ïa ka latai iwbih halor ka met jong nga ban pynkhreh lypa shuwa ba-hajan pynsep jong ka jingtep ïa ka met jong pruh .
translation.en: She hath done what she could : she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying .

translation.kha: kumba ym ba la ithuh , pynban la ïa ngi da baroh ; la kum la , hynrei , kumba phi ïohi ngi dang ïai .
translation.en: As unknown , and yet well known ; as dying , and , behold , we live ; as chastened , and not killed ;
The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers , and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt , and with an high arm brought he them out of it .
translation.kha: U Blei jong ki paid Israel u la jied ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad u la pynlong ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw ïa une u paid ha ka por ba ki la im kum ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt . U Blei u la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt da ka bor bakhraw jong u ,

Nangta u Jakob ong u Simeon bad ha u Lebi , Phi la pynjynjar nga ; ki bad ki Peris , bad kat kiba don ha ka ri mynta kin sa shun ïa nga . Ngam dei uba bun ; lada ki lang kawei pyrshah nga , bad ki ïa nga , ma nga bad ka jong nga baroh ngin sa shah pynjot
translation.en: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi , Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land , among the Canaanites and the Perizzites : and I being few in number , they shall gather themselves together against me , and slay me  ; and I shall be destroyed , I and my house .

translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka namar kito por ki ka kiba la klet ïa nga mynba ka thang ki jingiwbih ïa u Baal bad ka la pynphuh pynphieng ïa lade da ki jingdeng bakordor haba ka leit nadien bud ïa kiba ieit jong ka . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim , wherein she burned incense to them , and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels , and she went after her lovers , and forgat me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki long myntan kum ki khashor . Kumno ngan bsa ïa ki kum ïa ki langbrot ha ki pyntha phlang ?
translation.en: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer : now the  Lord  will feed them as a lamb in a large place .

translation.kha: U Blei uba ïohi ïa kaba shapoh ki dohnud jong ngi , u tip kaei ka long jingmut jong Mynsiem ; namar U Mynsiem u ïasaid bad U na ka bynta ki briew bad kat kum mon jong u .
translation.en: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit , because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God .
Be ye therefore followers of God , as dear children ;
translation.kha: Te phi kumta long ki nongbud jong u Trai , namar phi long ki khun kiba ieit eh jong U Blei ,

translation.en: For the law made nothing perfect , but the bringing in of a better hope did  ; by the which we draw nigh unto God .
translation.kha: Naba ka Hukum u Moses kam lah ban pynlong janai ïa kano kano . Bad mynta la ai ïa ka jingkyrmen kaba kham bha da kaba ngi lah ban wan sha jan U Blei .
U la ong , ‘ U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la jied ïa me ban tip ïa ka mon jong , bad ban ïohi ïa U Shakri jong u , bad ban ïohsngew ïa u ba u ka sur u hi
translation.en: And he said , The God of our fathers hath chosen thee , that thou shouldest know his will , and see that Just One , and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth .

translation.kha: Bad mynta U Trai u ong , Ha aïom kdew snem thik , ka spah bakhraw jong khnam Moab kan jah noh . Na khiat briew kiba bun jong ka Markaboth tang khyndiat ki ban lait im , bad kin long kiba tlot .
translation.en: But now the  Lord  hath spoken , saying , Within three years , as the years of an hireling , and the glory of Moab shall be contemned , with all that great multitude  ; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble .

For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time , then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place  ; but thou and thy father s house shall be destroyed : and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this ?
translation.kha: Lada pha sngap jar ha ka por kum kane , ka jingïarap kan wan na bneng ïa ki Jiw , bad kin lait im , hynrei phan ïap , bad ka longïing u kpa jong pha kan kut noh . Pynban mano ba lah ban tip — lehse ka dei na ka bynta ka por kum kane ba la pynlong mahadei ïa pha !

translation.en: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself , saying , After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure , my lord being old also ?
translation.kha: Kumta ka Sarah ka rkhie sammut marwei , bad ka ong ,  Mynta ba nga la tymmen bad ngam donbor shuh , ngan dang lah mo ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha ? Nalor kata , u tnga jong nga ruh u la tymmen .
Hynrei u kpa u la khot ïa la ki ‘ To pynkloi !’ la ong . ‘ To wanlam ïa ka jaiñkup kaba bha bad pynkup ïa u . Pyndeng sati ha ka shynriah bad pynphong juti ha ki kjat jong u .
translation.en: But the father said to his servants , Bring forth the best robe , and put it on him  ; and put a ring on his hand , and shoes on his feet :
And he said unto them , Nay , but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ha ki ,  Em ! Phi la ïawan ban khmih ha-ei kane ka ri ka shong tlot .

translation.en: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel , and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat ?
translation.kha: Balei ka jaiñkup jong u ka saw palat , kum ka jong u briew uba ïuh ïa ki sohwaiñ ban shna waiñ ?
Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Ieit ïa ki paralok nongbeh phi bad isih ïa ki nongshun jong sangsot .’
translation.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said , Thou shalt love thy neighbour , and hate thine enemy .

translation.kha: Hynrei to tip mynta ba Trai U U Blei jong phi un ïaid ha shuwa jong phi kum ka ding kaba bam duh . Un bad jop pyndem ïa ki katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , ba phi lah ban beh krad bad pynjot ïa ki kloi kloi , kumba u la kular .
translation.en: Understand therefore this day , that the  Lord  thy God is he which goeth over before thee  ; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them , and he shall bring them down before thy face : so shalt thou drive them out , and destroy them quickly , as the  Lord  hath said unto thee .

translation.kha: La pynmeh ïa nongkyrshan ding hapdeng Jekolaïah ka phyllaw , bad u Petros u la tin lem bad Khilion kiba ïashong sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall , and were set down together , Peter sat down among them .

translation.kha: Lum ïa ki jingai jingmut baroh katba phi lah , bad phin jop ; khlem phin kata shahjop .
translation.en: Without counsel purposes are disappointed : but in the multitude of counsellors they are established .

The Jews therefore , because it was the preparation , that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day , ( for that sabbath day was an high day , ) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken , and that they might be taken away .
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la pan na u Pilat ban shah ïa ki ban pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jong kita ki briew kiba la shah sahnarphna , bad ban pynhiar noh ïa ki met jong ki na ki diengphna . Ki la kyrpad ïa kane namar ba ka la dei ka Sngi Thohdieng , bad kim kwah ba ki met kin sah kumta ha ki diengphna ha ka sngi Sabbaton , naba ka sngi Sabbaton ka long kyrpang kaba khuid .

translation.en: When they heard these things , they held their peace , and glorified God , saying , Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sangeh ïa ka jingwoh nia jong ki bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , da kaba ong ,  Te U Blei u la ai ruh ha ki Jentil ïa la lad ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban lait im !

translation.en: And Joab fell to the ground on his face , and bowed himself , and thanked the king : and Joab said , To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight , my lord , O king , in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant .
translation.kha: U Joab u dem khrup haduh khyndew ha khmat u Dabid da ka jingburom bad u ong  U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi , ko Syiem Kynrad ! Mynta nga tip ba phi sngewbha ïa nga , namar phi la mynjur ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga .
Da pynban jingïap ba aiti lut jong u , mynta la Rhoda ka Pung hapdeng jong ngi bad U Blei ; katno tam te , ngin long kiba ïa-bishni im da u na ka jingbitar U Blei!
translation.en: Much more then , being now justified by his blood , we shall be saved from wrath through him .
And Achan answered Joshua , and said , Indeed I have sinned against the  Lord  God of Israel , and thus and thus have I done :
translation.kha: Ka long kaba shisha ,  u Akhan u jubab ,  nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , bad kane ka long kaei ba nga la leh .
Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kaïaphas , uba la long u rangbah lyngdoh ha kata ka snem u , la ong A , katno phi long kiba bieit !
translation.en: And one of them , named Caiaphas , being the high priest that same year , said unto them , Ye know nothing at all ,

translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynriew u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong Semaraim ha 19 wahbah Ïuphratis . ïakob wah ka jingdonburom rngad , ban pynbiang ka lynti ïa ki Sakhar kiba wan na mihngi .
translation.en: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates  ; and the water thereof was dried up , that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared .
Praise the  Lord  with harp : sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings .
translation.kha: To ai ki jingainguh ïa U  Trai  ha ki duitara , to rwai ha u da ki jingtem ksai .

translation.en: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood  ; and without shedding of blood is no remission .
translation.kha: Da shisha , kat kum ka Hukum , la jan baroh kiei kiei la pynkhuid da ka snam , bad ïa ki pop la map noh tang lada la theh ïa ka snam .

translation.en: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not  ; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself , and that wicked one toucheth him not .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ym don uno uno napdeng ki khun U Blei uba ïai leh pop , naba U Khun U Blei u sumar ïa u , bad u Basniew um lah ban pynmynsaw ïa u .

Nangta nga la ïohi ïa uwei pat u uba angel her shajrong eh ha suiñ , lem bad ka khubor bymjukut jong ka Khubor Babha ban pynbna ha ki ka briew pyrthei , ha kawei pa ka kawei jaitbynriew , ka jait , ka ktien bad ka kynja bynriew .
translation.en: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven , having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth , and to every nation , and kindred , and tongue , and people ,

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u hikai ïa nga kaei ban ong , khnang ba lah ban pynkhlaiñ ïa kiba tlot bor . Man la ka step u pynlong ïa nga thrang eh ban ïohsngew kaei kaba un hikai ïa nga .
translation.en: The Lord  God  hath given me the tongue of the learned , that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary : he wakeneth morning by morning , he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned .
The  Lord  on high is mightier than the noise of many waters , yea , than the mighty waves of the sea .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u synshar hakhlieh eh ha bneng , kham khraw ban ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw-bah , kham donbor ban ïa ki jingat phyllung jong ka duriaw .

Na kata ka ri , ki nongkit tiensyiem ki la arsut ïa ka Nile ha lieng ba la ki khah . Khie noh sha ïing , ko nonglamktien bastet ! Rah noh ïa ka khubor sha ri jong phi kaba la pynïakhlad ïa ki wah sha ka jaitbynriew jong khlaiñ bad kaba donbor , sha briew jong phi kiba jrong bad ka sniehdoh , ïa kiba sheptieng ha kylleng pyrthei baroh .
translation.en: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea , even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters , saying , Go , ye swift messengers , to a nation scattered and peeled , to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto  ; a nation meted out and trodden down , whose land the rivers have spoiled !

translation.kha: U Rehoboam u la leit sha Elnathan , ha kaba ki paidbah baroh na ka Israel Khrismas dkhoi la ïawanlang ban pynlong syiem ïa Jingthoh .
translation.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem : for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king .

translation.kha: Me dei ban leit pat sha jingbnoh ri ha kaba la Kesis ïa Amaraïah , bad men pynïoh thohshuid tnga ïa u khun ñiad nga Kingdom Isaak napdeng ki kur ki jait jong Migron .
translation.en: But thou shalt go unto my country , and to my kindred , and take a wife unto my son Isaac .
His lightnings enlightened the world : the earth saw , and trembled .
translation.kha: Ka leilieh jong u ka pynshai ïa ka pyrthei ; ka khyndew ka ïohi ïa ka bad ka khynñiuh .

translation.en: For I am the  Lord  : I will speak , and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass  ; it shall be no more prolonged : for in your days , O rebellious house , will I say the word , and will perform it , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan kren ha ki , bad ïa kaei kaba nga ong yn pyndep . Yn ym don shuh ka jingpyntud . Ha ka por ka jong phi hi , ko ki nongïeng ïaleh pyrshah , ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la maham ïa phi ba ngan leh . Nga la kren ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: But be ye doers of the word , and not hearers only , deceiving your own selves .
translation.kha: Wat shukor ïa lade tang da kaba sngap ïa ka ktien jong u ; pynban , to pyntreikam ïa ka .
Ki briew bariewspah jong phi ki kjit na kiba duk , bad baroh ki long ki . nongshukor
translation.en: For the rich men thereof are full of violence , and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies , and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth .
And Zimri went in and smote him , and killed him , in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah , and reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Simri u rung hapoh ïing bad u la pynïap ïa u Elah , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u . Kane ka jia ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah .
Ha kata ka sngi na , Ïuphratis shaduh u ka pud ri Ijipt , U Trai un ïalum ïa uwei pa uwei na ki briew jong u , kum uba pynkhlad ïa u kew na u stait .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt , and ye shall be gathered one by one , O ye children of Israel .
And Pilate asked him , Art thou the King of the Jews ? And he answering said unto him ,  Thou sayest it .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la kylli jingkylli ïa u ,  Me long u syiem jong ki Jiw ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kumba me ong hi .

translation.en: Which is your favourite colour ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka rong jong phi ba ba phi itynnad duh ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ?
translation.kha: Me la peit bniah ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ?  U  Trai  u kylli .  Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba ïaineh bad uba bha kat ma u . U mane ïa nga bad u kiar ban ym leh kano kano kaba sniew .
Ha ka jingïap jong u , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha jaka ka jong u .
translation.en: So Ahab slept with his fathers  ; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Nga la duh baroh jingkyrmen te yn lei lada U Blei u pynïap noh ïa Ngan leit ïasaid ïa ka kam nga ha u .
translation.en: Though he slay me , yet will I trust in him : but I will maintain mine own ways before him .

translation.kha: U Jeroboam u thik u samla uba dap shynrang , bad haba u Solomon u ïohi katno ba u long kdor trei shitom , sam buh kynnoh u ban pynïaid ïa ki nongtrei ba shu pynbor ha ka thain jong Taralah jait Manasseh bad baje .
translation.en: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour : and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious , he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph .
And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places , and on the hills , and under every green tree .
translation.kha: Ha ki jaka mane blei thala , ha ki lum , bad hapoh ka syrngiew jong ki dieng baroh , u Ahas u ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih .

translation.en: There is no straw given unto thy servants , and they say to us , Make brick : and , behold , thy servants are beaten  ; but the fault is in thine own people .
translation.kha: Ym shym la ai phlangïap shuh ïa ngi , hynrei la ïai hukum ïa ngi ban shna maw-it ! Bad mynta pat ngi shah shoh . Dei ki briew jong phi keiñ kiba bakla .
Baroh ki nongtrei kiba tbit napdeng jong phi ki dei ïawan ban shna ïa kita baroh ïa kiba U Trai u la hukum :
translation.en: And every wise hearted among you shall come , and make all that the  Lord  hath commanded  ;
And another came , saying , Lord , behold , here is thy pound , which I have kept laid up in a napkin :
translation.kha: Uwei pat u shakri u la wan bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , kane ka long ka sbai ksiar jong me ; nga la buhrieh ïa ka hapoh ka jaiñ rumal .

translation.en: For I say unto you , that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me , And he was reckoned among the transgressors : for the things concerning me have an end .
translation.kha: Naba nga ong ha phi ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong , ‘ U la ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar jong kiba leh kam runar ,’ ka dei ban urlong shisha shaphang jong nga , namar kaei kaba la thoh shaphang jong nga ka wan jia shisha .

Nangta phin lah ban im kumba U Trai u kwah bad ba phin ïai leh borabor ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u . Ka jingim jong kan phi pynmih ïa baroh ki jingleh babha jait babun , bad phin san ha ka jingtip jong phi ïa Blei U .
translation.en: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing , being fruitful in every good work , and increasing in the knowledge of God ;

translation.kha: Hangta u la ïakynduh ïa u Jiw uba kyrteng u Akwila , ïa uba la kha ha Pontos , uba dang shu wan shen na Italy lem bad Priskila ka ka tnga jong u , naba u Klaudius Patsha u la lah hukum ki ïa Jiw baroh ban mihnoh na Rom .
translation.en: And found a certain Jew named Aquila , born in Pontus , lately come from Italy , with his wife Priscilla  ; ( because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome : ) and came unto them .
The  Lord  said , Verily it shall be well with thy remnant  ; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , ai ba ki jingtim jong ki baroh kin urlong shisha lada ngam shym la shakri bha ïa me , lada ngam shym la ïasaid bad me na ka bynta ki nongshun jong nga mynba ki don ha ka jingjynjar bad jingeh bajur .
Pynshlur u syiem un long khlem bor ban :13 ïa ki , bad ka jingïada ka Ijipt kan kut ha umphniang jingjot .
translation.en: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame , and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion .

translation.kha: Abraham u iehnoh ïa kaei kaba u don ha u Isaak ;

translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , let my lord the king hear the words of his servant . translation.en: Now these are thy servants and thy people , whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power , and by thy strong hand .

Ngan Basniew ïa ka jingjop na sahit bneng kum u slap ; ka khyndew kan ang ban pdiang ïa u bad kan phuh da ka jinglaitluid bad ka jingbishar hok . Nga , U Trai , Tertullos Silas ïa kane ban jia .
translation.en: Drop down , ye heavens , from above , and let the skies pour down righteousness : let the earth open , and let them bring forth salvation , and let righteousness spring up together  ; I the  Lord  have created it .

translation.en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion .

Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi shongsuk kiba ha Seïon , bad ïa phi kiba sngewshngain ha Samaria — phi ki kiba briew khraw jong kane ka jaitbynriew Israel kaba khraw phi , sha kaba ki briew ki ju leit ban ïoh jingïarap !
translation.en: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion , and trust in the mountain of Samaria , which are named chief of the nations , to whom the house of Israel came !

translation.en: And he slew it  ; and Moses took of the blood of it , and put it upon the tip of Aaron s right ear , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot .

I returned , and saw under the sun , that the race is not to the swift , nor the battle to the strong , neither yet bread to the wise , nor yet riches to men of understanding , nor yet favour to men of skill  ; but time and chance happeneth to them all .

translation.en: At that time , saith the  Lord  , they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah , and the bones of his princes , and the bones of the priests , and the bones of the prophets , and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , out of their graves :

translation.en: To whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .

translation.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man , whether he rage or laugh , there is no rest .
For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will , and to agree , and give their kingdom unto the beast , until the words of God shall be fulfilled .

Ko parabangeit jong nga , to sumar ïoh ba uno uno na phi u don ka dohnud kaba sniew eh bad bymngeit kat haduh ba un da phai dien na noh U Blei uba im .

I will go down with thee into Egypt  ; and I will also surely bring thee up again : and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes .

translation.en: For this is the will of God , even your sanctification , that ye should abstain from fornication :

translation.en: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth :

translation.en: And the  Lord  God prepared a gourd , and made it to come up over Jonah , that it might be a shadow over his head , to deliver him from his grief . So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd .

translation.en: And they took it , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and the king thereof , and all the cities thereof , and all the souls that were therein  ; he left none remaining , according to all that he had done to Eglon  ; but destroyed it utterly , and all the souls that were therein .

Walk in wisdom toward them that are without , redeeming the time .

translation.en: For which I am an ambassador in bonds : that therein I may speak boldly , as I ought to speak .

translation.en: And saith unto him , Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine  ; and when men have well drunk , then that which is worse : but thou hast kept the good wine until now .
Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool , which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda , having five porches .
translation.kha: Hajan ka Khyrdop Langbrot ha Jerusalem ka la don ka pungsum kaba don san tylli ki baranda ; ha ka ktien Hebru la khot ïa ka ,  ka Bethesda .

translation.en: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u kham riewspah bad kham stad ban ïa uno uno u syiem ,
Ka jingsngewbha jong u kam long ha ki kulai bakhlaiñ ; lymne ka jingkmen jong ha u ki shipai bashlur ;
translation.en: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse : he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man .
For what the law could not do , in that it was weak through the flesh , God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh , and for sin , condemned sin in the flesh :
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ka Hukum kam lah ban leh , namar ka jinglong ba kynja doh ka long kaba tlot , U Blei u la leh . U la pynrem ïa ka pop ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh da kaba u la phah ïa U Khun jong u hi , uba la wan kum ka jinglong u briew uba pop , ban jop ïa ka pop .
U Abram trud la long uba riewspah shibun , ha ka Ariopagos ïa ki langbrot Ïateh ki blang , kumjuh ruh ha jingthang Nabynta ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar .
translation.en: And Abram was very rich in cattle , in silver , and in gold .

translation.kha: Lada ki ong ïa ngi ban ap haduh kin da wan sha ngi , ngin ïeng thik ha la ka jaka .
translation.en: If they say thus unto us , Tarry until we come to you  ; then we will stand still in our place , and will not go up unto them .

translation.kha: Kumta phi dei ban khrew jingruma leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki ong ïa Kushi ban Obal ; pynban , wat pyrthuh phyllad ïa ki jingleh jong ki ; namar ba pynphalang leh ïa kaei kaba ki dong .
translation.en: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe , that observe and do  ; but do not ye after their works : for they say , and do not .

translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah baroh kiba tip ba ki tnga jong ki , ki ai jingkñia ha kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki kynthei baroh kiba ïeng hangta , kaba ki kynthup ïa Israel kiba shong ha ki bynta bashathie ka Ijipt — u babun paidbah baroh — ki ong ha nga ,
translation.en: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods , and all the women that stood by , a great multitude , even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt , in Pathros , answered Jeremiah , saying ,
And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people , and the veil that is spread over all nations .
translation.kha: Hangne un sa weng kynsan ïa u lyoh jong ka jingsngewsih uba ju tap halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .
u la shem ïa ka , u kmen haduh katta katta ba u ïa ka ki tyrpeng jong u bad bah pat ïa ka sha ïing .
translation.en: And when he hath found it , he layeth it on his shoulders , rejoicing .

translation.kha: Haba ka ka la poi , ki la wallam U Jisu shibun la ki ksuid jong ki . U Jisu u la beh noh ïa ki mynsiem da ka ktien bad u pynkhiah ïa baroh kiba la .
translation.en: When the even was come , they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils : and he cast out the spirits with his word , and healed all that were sick :

translation.en: Her house is the way to hell , going down to the chambers of death .

translation.kha: Nga la pop , u Saul u . Hynrei la kumno kumno pyn-i ka ïa nga ha ki nongïalam ki briew jong bad ki Israel . phai ryngkat nga , ba ngan lah mane ïa U phi .
translation.en: Then he said , I have sinned : yet honour me now , I pray thee , before the elders of my people , and before Israel , and turn again with me , that I may worship the  Lord  thy God .
For as I passed by , and beheld your devotions , I found an altar with this inscription , TO THE UNKNOWN GOD . Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship , him declare I unto you .
translation.kha: Naba katba nga dang ïaid lyngba ka nongbah jong phi bad khmih ïa ki jaka ha kiba phi mane , nga la lap ïa ka duwan ha kaba la thoh , ‘ Ha U Blei uba ngim tip .’ Te ïa uta ïa uba phi mane , wat haba phim tip ïa u , ïa une keiñ nga pynbna mynta ha phi .
Kumta pynshongkurim ong ha ki , Ngan sa wan Pynduh ha ka jingsuk jingsaiñ , bad haba nga wan , bapaw pyntwa Pithom ïa une u dih !
translation.en: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel , saying , When I come again in peace , I will break down this tower .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga kwah ïa phi ba phin sngewthuh ba U Khrist long u halor tam ïa uwei pa uwei briew , u tnga u long halor la ka tnga , bad U Blei u long halor tam ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: But I would have you know , that the head of every man is Christ ; and the head of the woman is the man ; and the head of Christ is God .

translation.kha: To phikir bha ïa lade bad ïa ki jinghikai kiba me ai . To men leh ïai ïa kine kiei kiei , namar lada me leh kumta , me pynim ïa lade bad ïa kita kiba ïa shahshkor . me
translation.en: Take heed unto thyself , and unto the doctrine ; continue in them : for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself , and them that hear thee .

translation.kha: Phin ïap bad ïa ki metïap jong phi yn pynphriang ha kylleng kane khlaw ka ri . Namar ba la phi khñium pyrshah ïa nga , yn ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la palat arphew snem ka rta u ban ïohrung sha kata ka ri .
translation.en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness  ; and all that were numbered of you , according to your whole number , from twenty years old and upward , which have murmured against me ,

And the whole valley of the dead bodies , and of the ashes , and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron , unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east , shall be holy unto the  Lord   ; it shall not be plucked up , nor thrown down any more for ever .
translation.kha: Ka them baroh kawei , ha kaba la tep ïa kiba ïap bad ha kaba la bret ïa ki jakhlia , bad baroh ki pyntha shaneng ka wah Kidron haduh ka Khyrdop Kulai shaphang mihngi , kin long kiba kyntang ha nga . Ka nongbah kan ym shah pynpra shuh lane shah pynjot .

translation.en: And the  Lord  repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people .
But I will send a fire upon Judah , and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha Judah bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut ka Jerusalem .
Nga don ka shu Phan bymlalot , bad katno nga sngewkhia mynsiem tad haduh ba kan da kut noh !
translation.en: But I have a baptism to be baptized with  ; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished !

translation.kha: Ha ka ïing kaba heh don ki bun jait Don na ïa kiba la rupa bad ka ksiar , kiwei pat da ka dieng bad dewbyrtha ; don na ki na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam kyrpang kiwei ban pyndonkam man ka por .
translation.en: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver , but also of wood and of earth ; and some to honour , and some to dishonour .
And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died : his eye was not dim , nor his natural force abated .
translation.kha: U Moses u la dap shispah arphew snem ka rta mynba u ïap ; ki khmat jong u kim pat byr-ïe , bad ka bor met jong u ruh kam pat duna .

translation.en: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples , he rebuked Peter , saying ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : for thou savourest not the things that be of God , but the things that be of men .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la phai , u la khmih ïa ki synran jong u , bad u la sneng ïa u Petros .  Khie noh na nga , me u Soitan ,  u la ong .  Ki jingpyrkhat jong me kim shym wan na U Blei hynrei na u briew !
Katno kaba shyrkhei ïa kiba phi pahuh mynta ; phin sa thngan ! Katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi kiba rkhie mynta phin ; sngewsih bad phin ïam !
translation.en: Woe unto you that are full ! for ye shall hunger . Woe unto you that laugh now ! for ye shall mourn and weep .

translation.kha: Ki ïa-pyrta uwei ïa uwei pat : Bakhuid , Bakhuid , Bakhuid ! khunswet surok nongpynïaid Baroh u long dohkha khuid Bethnimrah Ka burom jong u ka pyndap ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And one cried unto another , and said , Holy , holy , holy , is the  Lord  of hosts : the whole earth is full of his glory .
But now having no more place in these parts , and having a great desire these many years to come unto you ;
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ba nga la pyndep ïa ka jingtrei ha kine ki thain bad namar ba nga la ju kwah la bun snem ban wan khmih ïa phi , nga kyrmen ban leh kumta mynta .

translation.en: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you , nor persuade you on this manner , neither yet believe him : for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand , and out of the hand of my fathers : how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand ?
translation.kha: Mynta wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi lane ïalam bakla ïa phi kumta . Wat ngeit ïa u ! Ym don blei jong kano kano ka hima uba la lah ban pyllait ïa la ki briew na uno uno u patsha ka Assyria . Kumta da kaba thikna une U Blei jong phi un ym lah ban pyllait im ïa phi !
Nangta u la kiew halor ka lieng bad ki , bad ka lyer ka la long jai jai . Ki synran ki la sngewlyngngoh haduh katta katta ,
translation.en: And he went up unto them into the ship  ; and the wind ceased : and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure , and wondered .
And it came to pass , when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount called the mount of Olives , he sent two of his disciples ,
translation.kha: Haba u la poi hajan Bethphage bad Bethania ha u lum ki Olib , u la phah ar ngut ki synran sha shuwa lem bad kine ki jingbthah :
Kumta U Jisu u la batuid ïa ka , Namar kata ka jubab , khie leit phai pat sha ïing jingjynjar ha kaba phan shem ba jingpyrshah ksuid u la mihnoh na ka khun jong bakhraw! !
translation.en: And he said unto her ,  For this saying go thy way  ; the devil is gone out of thy daughter .

translation.kha: Balei Tamar Kanah , ba phi pipa jingkylli ïa nga 104 To bet na kita ki briew kiba la ïohsngew Berakhaïah nga . Kylli na ki aïu nga la Beth ïa ki — ïamihnoh tip ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .
translation.en: Why askest thou me ? ask them which heard me , what I have said unto them : behold , they know what I said .

translation.kha: Haba u la shem ïa u , u la ïalam ïa u Antiokh bad baroh shisnem kine ar ngut la ïa ki briew ka bad ki la hikai ïa kynhun kaba heh . la long ha Antiokh ïa ki parabangeit khot nyngkong eh Ki Khristan .
translation.en: And when he had found him , he brought him unto Antioch . And it came to pass , that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church , and taught much people . And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch .

translation.kha: U la jubab , Uta uba don ar tylli ki sopti , u dei ban ai kawei ha bym don , uno uno uba jingbam dei ban ïasam ïa ka
translation.en: He answereth and saith unto them , He that hath two coats , let him impart to him that hath none  ; and he that hath meat , let him do likewise .
For he hath broken the gates of brass , and cut the bars of iron in sunder .
translation.kha: U la pynpait ïa ki jingkhang rnong bad pynpra ïa ki nar kiba ker .

translation.en: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit  ; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit .
translation.kha: U dieng uba plung bha u pynmih ki soh kiba bha , hynrei u dieng uba swai u pynmih ki soh kiba sniew .
Kumta ïa-ïap la kem ïa U Artemis bad ki la batskhem ïa u .
translation.en: And they laid their hands on him , and took him .
Neither shall they shave their heads , nor suffer their locks to grow long  ; they shall only poll their heads .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban khi ïa la ki khlieh ne ban ieh jrong ïa u shñiuh jong ki . Kin ieh ïa u shñiuh ha ka jingjrong kat ban biang .

jynreiñ ki leit ïathuh kynnoh bahryntieh ha ïarwai Jehu , u la ong , Kane Truphina long Shim kaba kito eriong u la jingbatnud ba kan jia , mynba Siphmoth la kren lyngba u Nasareth jong u , u Elijah : ‘ airong ksew kin bam Biblos ka met jong ka wait ha ka Shimshai Jesreel .
translation.en: Wherefore they came again , and told him . And he said , This is the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite , saying , In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel :

translation.kha: Nga la pynlong u ïa , uba itynnat , da ka ki jingpyiar tnat . U la long ka jingpihuiñ jong ki dieng baroh ha Eden , ka kper U Blei .
translation.en: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches : so that all the trees of Eden , that were in the garden of God , envied him .

translation.kha: To kynmaw , ko Trai , ïa kaei kaba la jia ha . ngi To khmih ïa ngi , bad peit ka ïa jingjahburom jong ngi .
translation.en: Remember , O  Lord  , what is come upon us : consider , and behold our reproach .

And he took the people , and divided them into three companies , and laid wait in the field , and looked , and , behold , the people were come forth out of the city  ; and he rose up against them , and smote them .
translation.kha: kumta u ïalam ïa la ki briew , u pynkhlad ïa ki ha ki lai kynhun , bad ki rieh apthap ha ki lyngkha . Haba u ïohi ïa ki briew ba ki mih shabar na ka nongbah , u la mih na la ka jakarieh ban pynïap ïa ki .
U Trai la ïa u nongïathuhlypa ban pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt bad ban sumar .
translation.en: And by a prophet the  Lord  brought Israel out of Egypt , and by a prophet was he preserved .

translation.kha: Bad Abaddon thikna ba phi Pynduh daladie u riewhadem ïa uba matlah , pynsmai jingshai ïa kito kiba ha ka jingdum ,
translation.en: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind , a light of them which are in darkness ,

translation.kha: Ki la noh bun ksuid , ki la tah umphniang Olib ha kiba bun ki briew kiba pang bad ki la pynkhiah ïa .
translation.en: And they cast out many devils , and anointed with oil many that were sick , and healed them .
For many bare false witness against him , but their witness agreed not together .
translation.kha: Bun ki nongsakhi ki la shu sakhi lamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu , hynrei ki jingïathuh jong ki kim ïahap satia .

translation.en: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy : for the  Lord  had made them joyful , and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them , to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God , the God of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi ki rakhe da ka jingkmen ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Ki la dap da ka jingkmen namar U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa u patsha jong ka Assyria ban lehsbun ïa ki , ba u kyrshan ïa ki ha ka jingtrei jong ki ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka Templ jong U Blei ki Israel .
Ulla kane ka jingainguh thang dei jingbynrap ainguh man la ka Sabbaton nalor ka jingainguh kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka shongneh pylleng ka waiñ .
translation.en: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath , beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .

translation.kha: Namar ba ka Rebekka kam pynkhlaiñ khun , u Isaak u ïabishar duwai ha hajngai Trai na ka bynta Shong ka . U Trai u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad ka :39-44 ka la punkhun .
translation.en: And Isaac entreated the  Lord  for his wife , because she was barren : and the  Lord  was entreated of him , and Rebekah his wife conceived .
And these were the chief of king Solomon s officers , even two hundred and fifty , that bare rule over the people .
translation.kha: Don arspah sanphew ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba dei peit ïa ki nongtrei ba la pynbor ban trei ïa kiba bunkam tei jingtei .
Nangta u Samuel u shim uwei u , maw u ïa pynïeng u hapdeng ka Mispah bad ka Shen , bad ong , U u Trai la ïarap ïa ngi baroh shi lynter lynti — bad u la pynkyrteng ïa u , u maw ka jingïarap .
translation.en: Then Samuel took a stone , and set it between Mizpah and Shen , and called the name of it Eben–ezer , saying , Hitherto hath the  Lord  helped us .
And Abimelech said , Behold , my land is before thee : dwell where it pleaseth thee .
translation.kha: U ong ha u Abraham ,  Kane baroh ka dei ka ri jong nga ; to shong to sah kat ha kaba me kwah .
U Paul , u shakri jong U Jisu Khrist , u ba la shah khot u bad apostol ba la jied da U Blei ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha u jong .
translation.en: Paul , a servant of Jesus Christ , called to be an apostle , separated unto the gospel of God ,
And it is turned round about by his counsels : that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth .
translation.kha: katba ki ïaid ha ka mon U Blei . Ki leh ïa baroh kaba U Blei u hukum , hangno hangno ha kylleng ka pyrthei .

translation.en: I came

translation.kha: To ïeng beit ha la ki kjat jong ! Uta u briew u la kynthih bad la sdang ban ïaid kylleng .
translation.en: Said with a loud voice , Stand upright on thy feet . And he leaped and walked .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u bitar ïa phi , sentimitar jingai sngewbha kaba ai ha kaba rieh jingbymngeit pynjem jai ïa u nongai
translation.en: A gift in secret pacifieth anger : and a reward in the bosom strong wrath .
Stand therefore , having your loins girt about with truth , and having on the breastplate of righteousness ;
translation.kha: Kumta to ïeng ba la pynkhreh , da ka jingshisha kum u panpoh ba la pyndait ha ka syngkai jong phi , da ka hok kum ka jingda shadem jong phi ,
Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaba U Mynsiem ha ki balang !
translation.en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .

translation.kha: U la ap ïa nga kum ka dngiem u ; kynrup ïa nga kum u sing .
translation.en: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait , and as a lion in secret places .
And devout men carried Stephen to his burial , and made great lamentation over him .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah bariewblei kiba la tep ïa u Stephan , ki la ïambriew na ka bynta jong u da ka jingïam kaba jam .

translation.en: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet , which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day s journey .
translation.kha: Nangta ki apostol ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem na u lum ki Olib , uba jngai kumba shi kilomitar na ka nongbah .

translation.en: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the  Lord  thy God , and do his commandments and his statutes , which I command thee this day .
translation.kha: kumta kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
Shaphang ka jait Joseph u ong , To U Trai un kyrkhu ïa ka ri jong ki da u Bad slap da um ka napoh khyndew .
translation.en: And of Joseph he said , Blessed of the  Lord  be his land , for the precious things of heaven , for the dew , and for the deep that coucheth beneath ,

translation.kha: tylli ki masi ai ba ki nongïathuhlypa u Baal kin shim uwei , pynïap ïa u , ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa u bad buh halor ki diengthang — hynrei wat pynmeh ding . Nga ruh ngan leh kumjuh ïa uwei pat u masi dab .
translation.en: Let them therefore give us two bullocks  ; and let them choose one bullock for themselves , and cut it in pieces , and lay it on wood , and put no fire under : and I will dress the other bullock , and lay it on wood , and put no fire under :
And he arose and departed , and came to Samaria . And as he was at the shearing house in the way ,
translation.kha: U Jehu u mih na Jesreel ban leit sha Samaria . Ha lynti , ha ka jaka ba la khot  Ka Jaka Sah ki Nongap Langbrot ,
To ïeng joit mynta kum u rangbah , bad ïa jubab ki jingkylli jong nga .
translation.en: Gird up thy loins now like a man : I will demand of thee , and declare thou unto me .
And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth , and gathered the vine of the earth , and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God .
translation.kha: Kumta u angel u la pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi ha ka pyrthei , u la ot ïa ki sohwaiñ na uta u dieng sohwaiñ , bad u la bret ïa ki sha ka jaka khñiot waiñ jong ka jingbitar shla jong U Blei .

U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ïa kiei kiei baroh pynheh Ym don batip U Khun u long uei kup tang U Kpa , bad ym don batip U Kpa u long uei lait tang U Khun bad kito ha kiba Kawei Khun u jied ban pynpaw ïa U .
translation.en: All things are delivered to me of my Father : and no man knoweth who the Son is , but the Father  ; and who the Father is , but the Son , and he to whom the Son will reveal him .
Then I said , I am cast out of thy sight  ; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba ïa nga la beh noh na ka jingdon ryngkat jong me bad ba ngan ym ïohi shuh lano lano ruh ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong me .

translation.en: For our gospel came not unto you in word only , but also in power , and in the Holy Ghost , and in much assurance ; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake .
translation.kha: Naba ngi la wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi , ym tang ha ki ktien , hynrei ruh ha ka bor bad ha U Mynsiem Bakhuid , bad da ka jingsngewthuh pura ïa ka jingshisha jong ka . Phi tip kumno ngi la im mynba ngi la don bad phi ; ka la long na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi .
U Trai un tim ïa phi da kaba pynduna ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi , da kaba pynduna ïa ka jingseisoh ki jingthung phi jong , bad da kaba pynduna ïa ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi .
translation.en: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body , and the fruit of thy land , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep .

translation.kha: Naba ki jaitbynriew baroh ki dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka — ka bakhor jong ka jingkwah brai awria jong syiem jong pyrthei la awria bad ka , ki nongkhaïi jong ka pyrthei kiew spah bha na ka jingkwah brai bym lah teh jong .
translation.en: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication , and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her , and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies .

translation.kha: U briew jingshat lah ban ïap pynsaphred mynmiet . U Blei u shoh-ïap ïa ki briew bad ki jot noh ; u pynïap ïa Ira khrawbor Ban jingshon suk .
translation.en: In a moment shall they die , and the people shall be troubled at midnight , and pass away : and the mighty shall be taken away without hand .
And if we know that he hear us , whatsoever we ask , we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him .
translation.kha: U ïohsngew ïa ngi man ba ngi kyrpad ïa u ; bad namar ba ngi tip ba kane ka long kaba shisha , ngi tip ruh ba u ai ha ngi ïa kaei kaba ngi kyrpad na u .

translation.en: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem , and the city was besieged .
translation.kha: Ka dei ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u ba ka kynhun shipai Babilonia , ha ka hukum ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Nebukhadnessar , ki la tur pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem , bad kerkut ïa ka .

translation.kha: Te phin long shngain ; phin long skhem kum ka kut bakhlaiñ . Phin don ka jingbam ban bam bad ka um ban dih .
Mar ïakren ïa kane , ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi ki la sdang ïakajia ban , bad ka kynhun ka la ïa-pait arliang .
translation.en: And when he had so said , there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees : and the multitude was divided .
Whom dost thou pass in beauty ? go down , and be thou laid with the uncircumcised .
translation.kha: Ong ha ki :  Hato me tharai ba me kham bhabriew ban ïano ïano ruh ? Men leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap bad thiah hangta hapdeng ki bymriewblei .
Leh ïa ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ïa ki ba kin leh na ka bynta jong : long ka ka Hukum u Moses bad jong ki ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you , do ye even so to them : for this is the law and the prophets .

translation.kha: Ngi kwah ba phin kular ba phin ym pynmynsaw ïa ngi , kumba ngi ruh ngim shym la pynmynsaw ïa phi . Ngi la lehsbun ïa phi bad ngi la shah ba phin leit da kaba suk . Mynta ka paw shai ba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi .

translation.kha: Ngan pyntylli ïa ki kum kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka ri , halor ki lumbah ka Israel ; kin don tang uwei u syiem u ban synshar halor jong ki , bad kin ym long shuh ka jingïaphiah ha ki ar ki jaitbynriew lane ïabynta ha ki ar tylli ki hima .

translation.en: For thou hast been a strength to the poor , a strength to the needy in his distress , a refuge from the storm , a shadow from the heat , when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall .
translation.kha: Kiba duk bad ki bym don jingïarap ki phet sha me bad ki shongshngain ha ki por ka jingjynjar . Me ai jakarieh ïa ki na ki  erïong bad ka jakarieh tngen na ka jingshit kyr-ang . Ki riewrunar ki tur ïaleh kum ka  erïong tlang ,
Hadien ba u Ehud u la ïap , ki paid Israel ki leh pop biang ïa pyrshah U Trai .
translation.en: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , when Ehud was dead .

translation.kha: Herodias sa ar Eri ki jingker ïa ki jingñiewbeiñ jong ka .
translation.en: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides .

translation.kha: Ainguh jingïalong U Blei namar ka jingtipbriew jong phi , bad namar kaei kaba phi la bymseisoh ha kane ka sngi ha ïa-bujli kattne ïa nga na ka jingpalat ka jingpynïap briew bad na kaba pynhiarkput da lade hi .
translation.en: And blessed be thy advice , and blessed be thou , which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood , and from avenging myself with mine own hand .

translation.kha: Shahshkor , u la ong ïa , ki ngi ïaleit kiew sha Jerusalem , ha kaba yn aiti U ïa Khun U Briew ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum .
translation.en: Behold , we go up to Jerusalem  ; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes , and they shall condemn him to death ,

translation.kha: shisha phi tip ba don shibun ki nongïamareh kiba ïashim bynta ka jingmareh thong hynrei tang uwei na u ïa ka prais . Kumta to ha kata rukom ban ïoh ïa ka prais
translation.en: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all , but one receiveth the prize ? So run , that ye may obtain .
Salute one another with an holy kiss . The churches of Christ salute you .
translation.kha: To ïakhublei iwei ïa iwei da ka jingïadoh parabangeit . Baroh ki balang jong U Khrist ki phah ki jingkhublei jong ki ïa phi .
Ki briew kin ïa kane bad kin tip ba nga , U Trai , nga leh ïa ka . wan ban tip ba U bakhuid ki Israel u pynlong ïa jia .
translation.en: That they may see , and know , and consider , and understand together , that the hand of the  Lord  hath done this , and the Holy One of Israel hath created it .
And withal they learn to be idle , wandering about from house to house ; and not only idle , but tattlers also and busybodies , speaking things which they ought not .
translation.kha: Ki nang ruh ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa la ka por ha kaba kyntiap na kawei ka ïing sha kawei pat ; hynrei kaba kham sniew , ki nang ban ïa-lorni bad pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por , da kaba ki kren ïa kiei kiei kiba kim dei ban kren .

translation.en: Because my people hath forgotten me , they have burned incense to vanity , and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths , to walk in paths , in a way not cast up  ;
translation.kha: Pynban ki briew jong nga ki la klet noh ïa nga ; ki thang jingiwbih ïa ki bleithaw . Ki la jynthut ha ka lynti ba ki dei ban leit , kim shym bud shuh ïa ki lynti ba-mynshuwa ; ki ïaid ha ki lynti ba khlem buh dak .

translation.en: After him repaired their brethren , Bavai the son of Henadad , the ruler of the half part of Keilah .
translation.kha: U Babbai , u khun jong u Henadad , u nongsynshar ïa kawei pat ka shiteng jong ka Keilah distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud ;
Ki Philistia sur ïeng shrak ha uwei u lum bad ki Israel bymdondor jingkthang jongka u lum , Beersheba jong ki don Phikol ka them .
translation.en: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side , and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side : and there was a valley between them .

translation.kha: U kynjri ha ki kjat jong nga u ïa ka jingïaid jong
translation.en: He putteth my feet in the stocks , he marketh all my paths .

translation.kha: Me la thung jingkhum ki , bad ki la suhthied ; ki san bad Jaka pynmih bthuh . Ki ju kren lei shaphang jong me , pynban kim da Imlah eh shisha shaphang jong me .
translation.en: Thou hast planted them , yea , they have taken root : they grow , yea , they bring forth fruit : thou art near in their mouth , and far from their reins .

translation.kha: na ki , u ban ïa phi ban mane ïa ki blei jong kita ki briew kiba shong marjan bad phi , lane kiba shong sha jngai na phi .
translation.en: Namely , of the gods of the people which are round about you , nigh unto thee , or far off from thee , from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth  ;
