translation.en: For thus hath the  Lord  spoken unto me , Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey , when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him , he will not be afraid of their voice , nor abase himself for the noise of them : so shall the  Lord  of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion , and for the hill thereof .
And needed not that any should testify of man : for he knew what was in man .
translation.kha: Ym da donkam mano mano ban ïathuh ha u shaphang jong ki , namar u hi u la tip kaei kaba don ha ka dohnud jong ki .

translation.en: And they brake down the image of Baal , and brake down the house of Baal , and made it a draught house unto this day .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la pynjot ïa u rishot bakyntang bad ïa kata ka templ , bad ki pynkylla jaka leit shabar ïa ka — kaba dang don haduh kane ka sngi .
Trai , la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me bad pynkhyllem ïa ki duwan jong me ; nga long sa tang ma nga marwei sah , bad ki pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga .
translation.en: Lord , they have killed thy prophets , and digged down thine altars ; and I am left alone , and they seek my life .

translation.kha: A Trai sieh Mait ïa nga bad ngan ïohkhiah krat ; pyllait im ïa Migdol bad ïa-ud long jingpynshisha shngain janai . Me long uta uba nga ïaroh !
translation.en: Heal me , O  Lord  , and I shall be healed  ; save me , and I shall be saved : for thou art my praise .

And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first  ; and Moses rose up early in the morning , and went up unto mount Sinai , as the  Lord  had commanded him , and took in his hand the two tables of stone .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u shtah ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kita kiba mynshuwa . Dang step phyrngab u leit kiew ïa u Lum Sinai , u da rah ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

ba shadien ngi la long kiba 14 Hananel ka jinglong ba kynja mynsiem ha jingpynshitom jingbymkohnguh jong ngi sngewbha la wallam ïa ngi sha ka jingim lem Haram Bimhal Khrist . Ka dei khuslai ka jingaiei U Blei jingpynmynsaw la pynim ïa phi .
translation.en: Even when we were dead in sins , hath quickened us together with Christ , ( by grace ye are saved ; )

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u u ha ka sien kaba ar , bad u Petros u la kynmaw kumno ba U Jisu u lah ong ïa u , ba u syiar kyn-ih ar sien , men sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga . Bad u dohnud bad u la lynñiar kthang .
translation.en: And the second time the cock crew . And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him ,  Before the cock crow twice , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And when he thought thereon , he wept .

translation.kha: Mynta nga ïam ïa ki sohwaiñ jong ka Sibmah kumba Lym ïam namar ka Jaser . Ki ummat jong nga ki hap Nikanor ka bynta nemsniew kyntiew bad ka Elealeh , namar ym don kano Manasseh ka jingkheit ïadei kaba pynkmen ïa ki tngit .
translation.en: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah : I will water thee with my tears , O Heshbon , and Elealeh : for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen .

translation.kha: Ka jingtim ka long halor jong baroh phi namar ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka shukor ïa nga .
translation.en: Ye are cursed with a curse : for ye have robbed me , even this whole nation .

translation.kha: Naba ka Gospel ka pynpaw kumno U Blei u pynlong ïa ki briew ban don ka kaba jingïadei beit bad U hi : Ka long lyngba ka jingngeit naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , U uba briew beit bad U Blei da ka jingngeit un im .
translation.en: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith : as it is written , The just shall live by faith .

translation.kha: Hynrei u la ïa ki briew ban ym risa lane kren shikyntien ruh haduh ba un da ai hukum .
translation.en: And Joshua had commanded the people , saying , Ye shall not shout , nor make any noise with your voice , neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth , until the day I bid you shout  ; then shall ye shout .
Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness  sake : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba shah pynshitom beiñ namar ba ki leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa ; ka Hima ki bneng ka long ka jong ki !

A Trai , me long uta uba ïa ïada nga bad uba ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ; me ïarap ïa nga ha ki por jingjynjar . Ki jaitbynriew kin wan me sha na kiba kut jong ka pyrthei bad ong , Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la don ei ei hynrei tang blei ki thala , ym don ei ei hynrei tang ki bleithaw bymmyntoi .
translation.en: O  Lord  , my strength , and my fortress , and my refuge in the day of affliction , the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth , and shall say , Surely our fathers have inherited lies , vanity , and things wherein there is no profit .
Do therefore this that we say to thee : We have four men which have a vow on them  ;

translation.en: Who , being in the form of God , thought it not robbery to be equal with God :
For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument , neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin  ; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff , and the cummin with a rod .

translation.en: Therefore hear now , I pray thee , O my lord the king : let my supplication , I pray thee , be accepted before thee  ; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe , lest I die there .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , Ko Syiem Kynrad , nga kyrpad ïa phi ban shahshkor ïa nga bad ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Sngewbha wat phah pat ïa nga sha ka byndi ha ka ïing u Jonathan . Lada phi leh kumta , da shisha ngan sa ïap hangta .

translation.en: My son , keep my words , and lay up my commandments with thee .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga kren , bad wat ju klet ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ïa phi ban leh .

translation.en: No man can come to me , except the Father which hath sent me draw him : and I will raise him up at the last day .

bad ïa u Gershom bad u Elieser ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka . ( U Moses u la ong , long u sohshnong ha ka ri nongwei ; kumta u la jer kyrteng ïa uwei na u Gershom
translation.en: And her two sons  ; of which the name of the one was Gershom  ; for he said , I have been an alien in a strange land :

translation.en: Then Eli answered and said , Go in peace : and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him .

Forasmuch as we have heard , that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words , subverting your souls , saying , Ye must be circumcised , and keep the law : to whom we gave no such commandment :

translation.en: But , O  Lord  of hosts , that triest the righteous , and seest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I opened my cause .
translation.kha: Hynrei , ko  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , me tynjuh hok ïa ki briew ; me tip kaei kaba don hapoh ki dohnud bad ka jingmut jong ki . Kumta shah ngan ïohi ba me pynhiarkput halor ki nongshun jong nga , namar nga la buh ïa ka kam jong nga ha ki kti jong me .
Ka pyrthei kam shym long kaba na ka bynta jong ki Kum ki nongphetwir ki shang ha ki ri shyiap bad ki lum , ki da shong ki krem bad ha ki thliew kiba don ha ka khyndew
translation.en: ( Of whom the world was not worthy : ) they wandered in deserts , and in mountains , and in dens and caves of the earth .

translation.kha: Ngan pynpulom ïa ki jingthmu jong ki nong bad Ijipt ngan pynjot ïa ka jingsngewskhem jong ki . Kin kyrpad ïa ki bleithaw jong ki ban ïarap ki ïa , bad kin leit ban kylli na ki nongleh byrtong bad kylli ki na mynsiem jong kiba ïap ban ïoh jingmut .
translation.en: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof  ; and I will destroy the counsel thereof : and they shall seek to the idols , and to the charmers , and to them that have familiar spirits , and to the wizards .

And the king said , Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this ? And the woman answered and said , As thy soul liveth , my lord the king , none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken : for thy servant Joab , he bade me , and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid :
translation.kha: Hato dei u Joab uba la ai buit ïa pha ha kane baroh ?  u la kylli ïa ka . Ka jubab ,  Nga smai da kata baroh kaba kyntang , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba ym don kano kano ka lad ban kiar na kaba jubab ïa ka jingkylli jong phi . Ka dei kaba shisha ba u Joab , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi uba la bthah ïa nga ïa kaei ngan leh bad ïa kaei ngan kren .

translation.en: And say ye to Amasa , Art thou not of my bone , and of my flesh ? God do so to me , and more also , if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la bthah ruh ïa ki ban ong ha u Amasa ,  Phi dei u ba-ha-ïing jong nga . Naduh mynta nga buh ïa phi ban ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai ha ka jaka jong u Joab . To U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam leh kumta !

translation.en: And Joshua passed from Libnah , and all Israel with him , unto Lachish , and encamped against it , and fought against it :
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit na Libnah sha Lakhish , ki kerkut ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .

translation.en: Brethren , let every man , wherein he is called , therein abide with God .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban ïaisah ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei ha kata kajuh kumba phi la long mynba la khot ïa phi .

translation.en: Let people serve thee , and nations bow down to thee : be lord over thy brethren , and let thy mother s sons bow down to thee : cursed be every one that curseth thee , and blessed be he that blesseth thee .
translation.kha: To ai ba ki jaitbynriew kin long ki shakri jong me , bad ki briew kin dem khrup ha khmat jong me . To men synshar halor ki kur ki jait jong me baroh , bad to ai ba ki khun ki ksiew ka kmie jong me kin dem khrup ha khmat jong me . Ai ba kito kiba tim ïa me kin long kiba la tim bad ai ba kito kiba me kyrkhu kin long kiba la kyrkhu .

translation.en: All go unto one place  ; all are of the dust , and all turn to dust again .
translation.kha: Baroh ar ki leit sha kajuh ka jaka — ka khyndew . Baroh ar ki la wan na ka bad baroh ar kin leit phai pat sha ka .

translation.en: So Hushai David s friend came into the city , and Absalom came into Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Kumta u Hushai , u paralok jong u Dabid , u la leit phai sha ka nongbah hamar ba u Absalom u dang wan poi .

Lada kata ka Goliath kam lah ban ai ïa u khunlangbrot , jingdup wallam ar tylli ki lyngdkhur ne ar ba-halor jingthmu bangeit , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang bad kawei Elsaphan na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh namar ka pop bad u lyngdoh un ban ka jinglehniam prais iphieng noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka , Meribah baremdor sa long pynpur khongpong pynkhuid .
translation.en: And if she be not able to bring a lamb , then she shall bring two turtles , or two young pigeons  ; the one for the burnt offering , and the other for a sin offering : and the priest shall make an atonement for her , and she shall be clean .
Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe  ; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times  ; and be thou ravished always with her love .

Kumta u la ong , Balei ba ma pha bad u tnga jong pha , kut jingmut ban tynjuh ïa U Mynsiem U Trai ? Ki samla kiba la tep ïa u tnga pha ha ka jingkhang , bad kin bah noh ïa pha ruh shabar !

translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi ïohknieh ïa ki shnong kiba hapoh kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi ban long ka jingïohpateng , pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei .

translation.en: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision ,  Be not afraid , but speak , and hold not thy peace :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet , u Paul u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ha kaba U Trai u la ong ha u ,  Wat sheptieng , hynrei ïai kren bad wat sangeh , naba nga long lem bad me .
Isih ïa kaei pynkloi sniew , ieit ïa kaei kaba bha , bad peit ba ka jingbishar hok ka ïeng ha ki ïingbishar . Lehse U Trai , un isynei ïa ki briew jong jrem Ken hima kiba dara pynsah ban im .
translation.en: Hate the evil , and love the good , and establish judgment in the gate : it may be that the  Lord  God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph .
He sent his word , and healed them , and delivered them from their destructions .
translation.kha: U pynkhiah ïa ki da ka hukum jong u bad pyllait im ïa ki na ka jingtep .

U Trai u ong , Ko Israel , nga la kwah ban pdiang ïa pha kum u khun jong bad nga ai ha pha ïa ri ka kaba pynkmen , ka ri kaba itynnat tam ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Nga la kwah ïa pha khot ban pa ïa nga bad ban phai ym shuh da lei lei na nga .
translation.en: But I said , How shall I put thee among the children , and give thee a pleasant land , a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations ? and I said , Thou shalt call me , My father  ; and shalt not turn away from me .
And it shall turn to you for a testimony .
translation.kha: Kane kan long ka kabu ïa phi ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha .

translation.en: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land , that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness .
translation.kha: Ha ka ri baroh kawei ngan pynsangeh ïa ka jingleh jakhlia , kum ka jingmaham ïa baroh ki kynthei ban ym leh awria kumba ki la leh .

translation.en: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit , because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God .
translation.kha: Bad U Blei , uba ïohi ïa kaba shapoh ki dohnud jong ngi , u tip kaei ka long jingmut jong U Mynsiem ; namar U Mynsiem u ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta la ki briew bad kat kum ka mon jong u .

Nangta un pyllait 122 kata ka sim ba Amphipolis her noh shabar ka nongbah kat shaba ka mon . Da tdam un pyndep ïa ka niam ka rukom kaba ïadei bad ka jingbynrap jingtyrkhong kata ka ïing , :37 kan sa long kaba khuid .
translation.en: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields , and make an atonement for the house : and it shall be clean .

translation.kha: kaba Ïa kum kata ka pop dei ban pynshitom da ka jingïap ; ka len ïa U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge : for I should have denied the God that is above .

translation.kha: Lada phi man la por ba phi shah , ha kawei sngi phin sa pynlwet bad phin ym lah khie shuh
translation.en: He , that being often reproved hardeneth his neck , shall suddenly be destroyed , and that without remedy .

translation.kha: Thohdieng kumta , phi dei ne phim dei u syiem ? Ka Jesebel ka jubab , Gomorrah khie joit na jingthiah , lehkmen bad to bam . Ngan shalyntem ha khyllung ïa jingpeit bri sohwaiñ u Naboth !
translation.en: And Jezebel his wife said unto him , Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel ? arise , and eat bread , and let thine heart be merry : I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite .
In my opinion , the meeting was a success .
translation.kha: Ha jingpyrkhat jongnga , ka meeting ka long kaba seisoh .
Ki pyndait ïa ki ha ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng jong ka ephod ba kin ïeng na saphred bynta ki khat-ar jait Israel , rain U Trai u la Tobijah ïa Dumbur Moses .
translation.en: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod , that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
The plain also , and Jordan , and the coast thereof , from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain , even the salt sea , under Ashdoth–pisgah eastward .
translation.kha: Shaphang sepngi , ka ri jong ki ka poi haduh wah Jordan , naduh ka pung Galilaïa shaphang shatei , arsut haduh ka Duriaw Baïap shaphang shathie , bad nangta shaduh ka kjat lum Pisgah shaphang mihngi .

translation.en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand .
translation.kha: U Abishai , u khun jong ka Seruïah , u jop ïa ki Edom ha ka Them Mluh bad pynïap khatphra hajar ngut na ki .
Bad ki la ong , Jingkdew katsha donkam ïa kino kino ki sakhi ! Ma Isaak hi ngi la ïohsngew ïa kaei Nehemaïah u la ong !
translation.en: And they said , What need we any further witness ? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth .

translation.kha: U la ong , U Serubbabel u la buh ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ , bad un pyndep ïa ka jingtei . kane Haba ka jia , ki briew jong nga kin tip ba dei nga uba ma la phah ïa me sha ki .
translation.en: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house  ; his hands shall also finish it  ; and thou shalt know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto you .

translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kiba ïap ka plie rynghang ha U ; ym don ka jingtap kaba kah ïa ka na ka jingïohi jong u .
translation.en: Hell is naked before him , and destruction hath no covering .

Son of man , say unto the prince of Tyre , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thine heart is lifted up , and thou hast said , I am a God , I sit in the seat of God , in the midst of the seas  ; yet thou art a man , and not God , though thou set thine heart as the heart of God :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  ïathuh ïa u nongsynshar ka Tyros kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha u : Ba la pynhieng da ka jingsarong , me kam ba me dei U Blei . Me ong ba kum U Blei me shong ha ka khet , ba la ker sawdong da ki duriaw . Me lah ban leh mynleh kum U Blei , hynrei , em , me long uba kynja briew , ym uba kynja blei .
Phi long u Jamynrei ba-ieit jong nga , ka jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong nga . Kaei ngan hikai Nongaplangbrot katta! ?
translation.en: What , my son ? and what , the son of my womb ? and what , the son of my vows ?

translation.kha: Nga kwah ruh ki kynthei long kiba biang ïa ki jaiñ ba ki riam bad riam da dei ; ym da ki jingkhyllong shñiuh bakhyllah ne da ki jingdeng ne ki paila ne da ki jaiñkup riam remdor , hynrei da ki kam , kumba ka dei ki kiba kam ba ki long kiba riewblei .
translation.en: But ( which becometh women professing godliness ) with good works .
And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out : it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye , than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire :
translation.kha: Bad lada ka khmat jong me ka pynlong ïa me ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong me , khlaw noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa me ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei tang da kawei ka khmat , ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki khmat bad ban shah bret sha dujok .
Em , ka la jubab . Ban phah noh ïa nga kumne ka long ka kam sniew kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaei kaba phi dang shu dep leh ! Hynrei u Amnon um sngap ïa ka ;
translation.en: And she said unto him , There is no cause : this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me . But he would not hearken unto her .
And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim , and went over Jordan with the king , to conduct him over Jordan .
translation.kha: U Barsillai , uba na Gilead , u la wan hiar ruh na Rogelim ban synran ïa u syiem sha shiliang ka Jordan .
Ka ri ka jingphohsniew ha ka jingjynjar Mynta u syiem jong ka u dei u samla Grik Resen nongïalam jong ka ki ïakhawai baroh jingmynthi jingkieng .
translation.en: Woe to thee , O land , when thy king is a child , and thy princes eat in the morning !

translation.kha: lyngkhai Blei u Duwai wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt Sennakherib U mawlyngkniap namar jong ki la Soitan u masi riewpoh . Ki bam jingbymtip ïa ki nongshun jong jingkhaïi , Ki pynlwet ïa ki shyieng jong ki , ki pynkheiñ ïa ki khnam jong ki .
translation.en: God brought him forth out of Egypt  ; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn : he shall eat up the nations his enemies , and shall break their bones , and pierce them through with his arrows .
And after a little while another saw him , and said , Thou art also of them . And Peter said , Man , I am not .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por uwei u briew u la ïohi ïa u Petros bad u la ong ,  Me ruh , me long uwei na ki !  Hynrei u Petros u la jubab ,  Ko rangbah , ngam dei !
U jingkylluid ïathuh ha u kumno jyrmi u Kynriah u la Hophni ïa ki lyngdoh jong U bamsap .
translation.en: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the  Lord s  priests .

translation.kha: Da ka borbah jong ki tiar thma kin jop ïa ki , ka ri jong u Nimrod bad kin im na ki Assyria haba ki hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ngi .
translation.en: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword , and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof : thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian , when he cometh into our land , and when he treadeth within our borders .

translation.kha: Kine ki keiñ long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ham kiba shong ha ki ri kiba pher bapher , bad ha la jait ka ka jait kaba kren ïa la ka jong ka jong ka ktien .
translation.en: These are the sons of Ham , after their families , after their tongues , in their countries , and in their nations .

translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki jai ïa u bad ong ha ki ban ym sngewsih ha kum kata kaba khuid .
translation.en: So the Levites stilled all the people , saying , Hold your peace , for the day is holy  ; neither be ye grieved .
And they shall be my people , and I will be their God :
translation.kha: Te kin long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .
Kam lei lei , hikai ïa nga ; ïathuh Ebron jingïania kaban Ephrath jingbakla pynïabiang nga . Kauda sngap jar bad sheptieng sap phi .
translation.en: Teach me , and I will hold my tongue : and cause me to understand wherein I have erred .
For the  Lord  your God is he that goeth with you , to fight for you against your enemies , to save you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un leit ryngkat bad phi bad un ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop .’

translation.en: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah : but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim  ;
translation.kha: Ka jaka sawdong jong ka Tappuah ka dei jong ka jait Manasseh , hynrei ka shnong Tappuah , ha khappud , ka dei ka jong ki khun ki ksiew u Ephraim .
Uta u kpu u na bynta u Aaron bad ki shynrang jong u dei ban bam ïa u ha ka jaka , naba uta u long ka kaba kyntang eh na ki jingainguh bam ba la kñia sha U ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: And it shall be Aaron s and his sons   ; and they shall eat it in the holy place : for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire by a perpetual statute .
For God is not the author of confusion , but of peace , as in all churches of the saints .
translation.kha: Ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ka dei ban long kaba lah ban synshar da uba kren , namar U Blei um kwah ïa ngi ban long ha ka jingkynrum kynram hynrei ha ka jingryntih bad ha ka jingsuk .
rah sien la shoh ïa nga laiphew khyndai thri da ki nongbeh ; lai sien la sympat ïa nga da ki nong Rom ; bad shisien nga la shah lynthem maw .
translation.en: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one .
And the  Lord  said unto him , Go , return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus : and when thou comest , anoint Hazael to be king over Syria :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Leit phai noh sha ka ri khlaw kaba hajan Damaskos , bad nangta rung shapoh ka nongbah bad pynsleh ïa u Hasael kum u syiem ka Syria ;

translation.en: Shall even he that hateth right govern ? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just ?
translation.kha: Hato phi rai pynrem ïa U Blei uba hok ? Hato phi pyrkhat ba  U  isih ïa ka jingbishar hok ?

translation.en: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Dabid u la pyndep ban ai ïa ki jingkñia , u kyrkhu ïa ki paidbah ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  bad sam jingbam ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And the king said unto the woman , Go to thine house , and I will give charge concerning thee .
translation.kha: Khie leit noh sha ïing ,  u syiem u la jubab ,  bad ngan sa khmih ïa ka kam .

translation.en: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted , he is able to succour them that are tempted .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , u lah ban ïarap ïa kita kiba shah pynshoi , namar ma u hi u la shah pynshoi bad shahshitom .
kwah ïa me ba men sah ha Ephesos , kumba nga la bthah ïa me mynba nga la don ha ka lynti sha Makedonia Don na ki briew hangta kiba la ai ïa ki jinghikai lamler , bad me dei ban maham ïa ban sangeh .
translation.en: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus , when I went into Macedonia , that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine ,

In like manner shalt thou do with his ass  ; and so shalt thou do with his raiment  ; and with all lost thing of thy brother s , which he hath lost , and thou hast found , shalt thou do likewise : thou mayest not hide thyself .
translation.kha: Leh kumjuh haba phi lap ïa ka kada , ka jaiñkup , lane kaei kaei kaba jah kaba dei ka jong u para Israel jong phi ; wat shu ieh khlem da ïarap .

translation.en: And he took six hundred chosen chariots , and all the chariots of Egypt , and captains over every one of them .
translation.kha: U la mih lem bad ki kali ïapom jong u baroh , kynthup ïa ki hynriewspah tylli ki kali ïapom jong u kiba bha tam , ïa kiba la ai hukum da ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki .

translation.en: And out of the basket of unleavened bread , that was before the  Lord  , he took one unleavened cake , and a cake of oiled bread , and one wafer , and put them on the fat , and upon the right shoulder :
translation.kha: Nangta u shim ïa uwei u kpu na ka shang ba la buh ïa ki kpu bakhlem thiat ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  , uwei u kpu ba la khleh umphniang , uwei u kpu uba stang , bad u buh ïa ki halor kata ka khleiñ bad ka kjat-dien kamon .

Mynta noh sha ïing bad bam bad . Ïasam ïa ka jingbam bad ka waiñ bad kito bym dap bym biang Mynta ka sngi ka kaba khuid U Trai jong ngi , wat sngewsih Ka jingkmen U Trai u la ai ha phi kan pynlong khlaiñ phi .
translation.en: Then he said unto them , Go your way , eat the fat , and drink the sweet , and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared : for this day is holy unto our Lord : neither be ye sorry  ; for the joy of the  Lord  is your strength .
Woe unto you , ye blind guides , which say , Whosoever shall swear by the temple , it is nothing  ; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple , he is a debtor !
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonglam lynti kiba matlah ! Phi hikai , ‘ Lada uno uno u smai da ka Templ , ïa u ym shym la teh da ka jingsmai jong u ; hynrei lada u smai da ka ksiar hapoh ka Templ , u long uba la shah teh .’

translation.en: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence ;
translation.kha: Katno khraw ka long ka jingaiei U Blei , kaba u la ai ha ngi ha kat kata ka jingthew bakhraw!

translation.en: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem , he assayed to join himself to the disciples : but they were all afraid of him , and believed not that he was a disciple .
translation.kha: U Saul u la leit sha Jerusalem bad u la pyrshang ban ïasoh bad ki synran . Hynrei kim lah ban ngeit ba u la long u synran , bad baroh ki la sheptieng ïa u .

U Petros u Karpos khot sngewbha ïa kita ki rangbah shapoh bad u la kyrpad jur ïa ki ban sahmiet hangta . Ha ka sngi tmier bud u la Sakkur bad u la jingkheiñbriew bad ki ; bad katto katne ngut ki parabangeit na Joppa ki la Serubbabel Meshek ïa u .
translation.en: Then called he them in , and lodged them . And on the morrow Peter went away with them , and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him .
For in six days the  Lord  made heaven and earth , the sea , and all that in them is , and rested the seventh day : wherefore the  Lord  blessed the sabbath day , and hallowed it .
translation.kha: Ha ki hynriew sngi , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la thaw ïa ka bneng , ïa ka khyndew , ïa ka duriaw , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ki , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew nga la shongthait . Namar kata , nga U  Trai  , nga la kyrkhu ïa ka Sabbaton , bad nga la pynkyntang khuid ïa ka .
Kiei kiei kiba nga ki long shisha ; ym don ei ei ha ki kaba lane ïalam bakla .
translation.en: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness  ; there is nothing froward or perverse in them .
O generation of vipers , how can ye , being evil , speak good things ? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh .
translation.kha: Phi ki bseiñ — kumno phi lah ban ong ïa kiei kiei kiba bha haba phi long kiba sniew ? Namar ka shyntur ka kren ïa kaei kaba la shlei ha ka dohnud .
Ki la ïa ngi mynsngi mynmiet ha ka por ba ngi ki haba ngi ïa la ki langbrot .
translation.en: They were a wall unto us both by night and day , all the while we were with them keeping the sheep .

translation.kha: La katta ruh kiba na ka jait Lebi ki don ka ban thied pat ha kano kano por ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki , kiba don ha ki shnong ba la ha .
translation.en: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites , and the houses of the cities of their possession , may the Levites redeem at any time .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi u leit ai jingkñia da shibun ki , ki langbrot , ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid . U khot sngewbha ïa ki khun jong baroh , ïa u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong phi , u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad mynta hi ki dang ïabam ïadih bad u ki pyrta , ‘ Im slem Adonijah !’
translation.en: For he is gone down this day , and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance , and hath called all the king s sons , and the captains of the host , and Abiathar the priest  ; and , behold , they eat and drink before him , and say , God save king Adonijah .

translation.kha: U nongshong basa ne u nongbylla um bit ban bam ïa ka .
translation.en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof .
And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius , that the word of the  Lord  came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month , even in Chisleu  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka sngi kaba saw jong u bnai uba khyndai ( u bnai Kisleb ) , U  Trai  u la ai ka khubor ha nga .
U Aaron bad ki khun met! jong u Shitlish dei ban thet ïa la ki saihon bad sait ïa la ki kjat
translation.en: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat :

translation.kha: Na u Petros , u Apostol U Jisu Khrist — Sha ki briew ba la jied U jong Blei im kiba kum ki nongphetwir kiba la pynsakma kylleng ki probins jong ka Pontos , ka Galatia , ka Kappadokia , ka Asia bad Bithynia ka .
translation.en: Peter , an apostle of Jesus Christ , to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus , Galatia , Cappadocia , Asia , and Bithynia ,

translation.kha: Kumta u briew duwai lane pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ka jingïamane lang da kaba tap ïa la khlieh u pynjahburom ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: Every man praying or prophesying , having his head covered , dishonoureth his head .

translation.kha: Ki buh saw kyrdon ki mawkordor ha Shamgar ; ïa Akhsah Rubi , u Topas , bad u Garnet ha ka kyrdon kaba nyngkong jinglyng-a
translation.en: And they set in it four rows of stones : the first row was a sardius , a topaz , and a carbuncle : this was the first row .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingbha jong me , me ong ïa ïa ki kaei kaba ki dei ban leh ; me bsa la ïa ki da ka manna bad ai um ïa ki ban dih .
translation.en: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them , and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth , and gavest them water for their thirst .
If his master have given him a wife , and she have born him sons or daughters  ; the wife and her children shall be her master s , and he shall go out by himself .
translation.kha: Lada u kynrad jong u , u pynïoh ïa u ka tnga , bad ka ïoh khun shynrang ne kynthei na u , kata ka briew bad ki khun jong ka kin long ki jong u kynrad jong ka , bad uta u briew un mihnoh tang marwei .
Naba Trai U u long U Blei bakhlaiñbor , u syiem uba khrawbor halor ki blei baroh .
translation.en: For the  Lord  is a great God , and a great King above all gods .

translation.kha: U Moses u , duwai
translation.en: And Moses spake unto the  Lord  , saying ,

Even they sent , and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison , and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , that he should carry him home : so he dwelt among the people .
translation.kha: Ki la buh ïa nga hapoh ka jingsumar u Gedalaïah , u khun jong u Ahikam bad u ksiew jong u Shaphan , u ban peit ba nga poi suk sha ïing . Bad kumta nga la sah hangta hapdeng ki briew .
jingkhuid ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei jingsumar Busi , bad to Judith ha u lum bakyntang jong u Jabin U Trai U pynryngkang jong ngi u long uba khuid jingrakhe
translation.en: Exalt the  Lord  our God , and worship at his holy hill  ; for the  Lord  our God is holy .

translation.kha: ka sngi kaba dap da ka jingsawa ki turoi bad thma ka jingpyrta-thma jong ki shipai kiba tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ba ker la kynroh bad ïa ki kut bajrong .
translation.en: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities , and against the high towers .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki rangbah kiba don jingshemphang ! Hato U Blei Badonbor Baroh u leh ïa kaei sngewthuh phret ?
translation.en: Therefore hearken unto me , ye men of understanding : far be it from God , that he should do wickedness  ; and from the Almighty , that he should commit iniquity .

And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel , whom God went to redeem to be his own people , to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness , by driving out nations from before thy people , whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt ?
translation.kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei kum ki Israel , ïa kaba me la pyllait im na ka jinglongmraw ban pynlong ïa ki ka jaitbynriew jong me . Kiei kiei ki bakhraw bad baphylla kiba me la leh na ka bynta jong ki , ki pynphriang ïa ka nam jong me kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei . Me la pyllait im ïa ki briew jong me na Ijipt bad pynher krad ïa kiwei ki jaitbynriew katba ki briew jong me ki nang tur shaphrang .

Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingtip shaphang ka jingbitar shla jong me bad kata ïa jingsarong ka jong me , bad mynta ngan ïa buh u khwai lyngba ka khmut jong me bad u lakam ha ka shyntur jong me , ban bad ïalam pat ïa me na kajuh ka lynti ba me wan .
translation.en: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears , therefore I will put my hook in thy nose , and my bridle in thy lips , and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest .
I was set up from everlasting , from the beginning , or ever the earth was .
translation.kha: Ïa nga la thaw ha kaba sdang eh , ha kaba nyngkong , shuwa ba ka pyrthei kan sdang .

translation.en: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest :

translation.kha: U Ktien u la ha ka pyrthei , bad wat U Blei u la thaw ïa pyrthei da u , pynban , ka pyrthei shym la ithuh u .
translation.en: He was in the world , and the world was made by him , and the world knew him not .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ïa nga ban ym bam lane ei ei , ban leit na kajuh ka lynti kaba nga wan .
translation.en: For so was it charged me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Eat no bread , nor drink water , nor turn again by the same way that thou camest .

translation.kha: ki Galeed shaïong ïa u , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa lybong ïa u . Ki synran ki la sngewsih eh .
translation.en: And they shall kill him , and the third day he shall be raised again .  And they were exceeding sorry .
And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him : and they sent him away , and his wife , and all that he had .
translation.kha: U syiem u la ai hukum ïa ki briew jong u , kumta ki la shim ïa u Abram bad ki la leit buh ïa u shabar ka ri lem bad ka tnga jong u bad baroh kat kiba u don .

translation.en: Fulfil her week , and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years .
translation.kha: To ap tad haduh ba ka taïew ka jinglehkmen shongkurim kan kut , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ka Rakhel , lada men trei na ka bynta jong nga sa hynñiew snem .
Te ka la phai dien bad ka la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u hangta ïeng ; hynrei shym kam tip ba u dei U Jisu .
translation.en: And when she had thus said , she turned herself back , and saw Jesus standing , and knew not that it was Jesus .

translation.kha: U shakri u la leit phai bad u la ïathuh ïa kane baroh ha u kynrad . jong u U kynrad u la bitar shla bad u la ong u ha shakri ‘ , To leit kloi sha ki lynti bah bad ki lynti rit jong ka nongbah , bad wallam ïa kiba duk , kiba khrew , kiba matlah , bad kiba dkoh .’
translation.en: So that servant came , and shewed his lord these things . Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant , Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city , and bring in hither the poor , and the maimed , and the halt , and the blind .

translation.kha: U Kpa u ieit ïa nga namar ba nga kloi ban aiti ïa ka la jingim , ba khnang nga lah ban ïohpdiang pat ïa ka .
translation.en: Therefore doth my Father love me , because I lay down my life , that I might take it again .

translation.kha: Pyrthei , Ko wat buhrieh ïa ki jingbakla ba la leh ïa nga ! Wat ai ba ka jingkhot jong nga ïa ka jingshisha , yn pynsngap jar !
translation.en: O earth , cover not thou my blood , and let my cry have no place .
If a man abide not in me , he is cast forth as a branch , and is withered  ; and men gather them , and cast them into the fire , and they are burned .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno u bymïaineh ha nga yn bret noh ïa u kum ka tnat bad u ïap tyrkhong ; kum ïa kita ki tnat , la lumlang bad la bret noh ha ka ding , ha kaba la thang ïa ki .

bret noh ïa la ka bad ka rupa ha ki kiba la kyntait , namar ka ksiar lymne ka rupa kan ym lah ban pynim ïa ki haba U Trai un noh ïa ka jingbitar jong u . Kin ban pyndonkam ïa ki ban pynhun ïa ka jingangnud jong ki ne ïa jong Ka ksiar ka rupa ki ïalam ïa ki ka jingleh pop .
translation.en: They shall cast their silver in the streets , and their gold shall be removed : their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the  Lord  : they shall not satisfy their souls , neither fill their bowels : because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity .
In those days the  Lord  began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria , and Pekah the son of Remaliah .
translation.kha: Ka la jia ba katba u dang long syiem ba U  Trai  u phah nyngkong ïa u Resin u syiem ka Syria bad u Pekah u syiem ka Israel ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah .

translation.en: And when they had crucified him , they parted his garments , casting lots upon them , what every man should take .
translation.kha: Nangta , ki la sahnarphna ïa u bad ki la ïabynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki , da kaba ïakynting sbai ban khmih mano ban ïoh ïa kano ka bynta jong ka jaiñ .

translation.en: And Simon Peter followed Jesus , and so did another disciple : that disciple was known unto the high priest , and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros bad uwei pat u synran ki la bud ïa U Jisu . Uta uwei u synran u la long uba la ïa-ithuh bha bad u Rangbah Lyngdoh , kumta u la leit rung lem bad U Jisu sha ka phyllaw ïing jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , katba u Petros pat u la ïeng shabar hajan ka khyrdop .

translation.en: And said , If it please the king , and if I have found favour in his sight , and the thing seem right before the king , and I be pleasing in his eyes , let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king s provinces :
translation.kha: Lada ka pynsngewbha ïa phi , ko syiem , bad lada phi sngewsynei ïa nga bad ka long kaba dei ha phi , sngewbha pynmih ka jingpynbna ban khang ïa ki hukum u Haman na kaba pyntreikam ïa ki — kito ki hukum kiba u khun jong u Hammedatha uba hiarpateng na u Agag u la ai na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ïa ki Jiw baroh ha ka hima .
u ong ha ki , Ïalam bad phi ïa ki rangbah synshar ka jong ïingbishar nga ; pynshong ïa u , Solomon u khun jong nga halor u khashor jong nga , bad synran ïa shathie u sha ka Umpohliew Gihon ,
translation.en: The king also said unto them , Take with you the servants of your lord , and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule , and bring him down to Gihon :
And ye murmured in your tents , and said , Because the  Lord  hated us , he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt , to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites , to destroy us .
translation.kha: Phi la ïakren khñium para ma phi : ‘ U  Trai  u isih ïa ngi . U la wan ïalam ïa ngi na Ijipt tang ban aiti ïa ngi ha kine ki Amor , ba kin ïoh pynïap ïa ngi .

translation.en: And it waxed great , even to the host of heaven  ; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground , and stamped upon them .
translation.kha: Ka la san khlaiñ eh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ka bneng , ïa ki khlur hi , bad ka la bret katto katne na ki sha khyndew bad ka la ïuh halor jong ki .

translation.en: And further , by these , my son , be admonished : of making many books there is no end  ; and much study is a weariness of the flesh .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , don sa kawei pat kaba phi hap ban ap khmih lynti . Ym don jingkut ïa ka jingthoh kot bad ka jingpule bniah shaba palat kan pynlwait ïa phi .
Em kynrad , , ki jubab . Ngi la ïawan kum ki mraw jong phi ban thied jingbam .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Nay , my lord , but to buy food are thy servants come .
And laid their hands on the apostles , and put them in the common prison .
translation.kha: Ki la kem ïa ki apostol bad ki la set ha ka phatok .
Bad kumta ka U Blei ka la saphriang . Ka jingdon jong ki synran ha Jerusalem ka nang kiew bad kiew , bad bun bah ki lyngdoh ki la pdiang ïa ka jingngeit .
translation.en: And the word of God increased  ; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly  ; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith .

translation.kha: uno Kumno uno u lah ban tip kaei kaba bha ïa ngi ha kane ka jingim jong ngi lyngkot kaba bad ka bymmyntoi — ka jingim kaba ïaid kum ka syrngiew ? Kumno ngi lah ban tip aïu kan jia ha ka hadien pyrthei ba ngi la ïap ?
translation.en: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life , all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow ? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun ?
The  Lord  called thy name , A green olive tree , fair , and of goodly fruit : with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it , and the branches of it are broken .
translation.kha: Shisien nga la khot ïa ki , u dieng Olib babun sla , uba dap da ki soh ba-itynnat ; hynrei mynta , da ka jingkyrhuh kum u pyrthat ngan thang ïa ki sla jong u ha ka ding bad pynkheiñ ïa ki tnat jong u .

translation.en: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth–lehem–judah , whose name was Jesse  ; and he had eight sons : and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul .
translation.kha: U Dabid u dei u khun jong u Jesse , uba dei u nong Ephrath na Bethlehem kaba ha Judah . U Jesse u don phra ngut ki khun shynrang , bad ha ka por ba u Saul u long syiem , u la tymmen bha .
Katba ki dang don ka ha miej ban ïabam , U Jisu u la ong , Nga ong ïa phi , ba uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa nga — uba uta dang ïabam bad nga .
translation.en: And as they sat and did eat , Jesus said ,  Verily I say unto you , One of you which eateth with me shall betray me .

translation.kha: Haduh hynñiew sngi ki Syria bad ki Israel ki shong dawa la ki jaka sher dara marpyrshah kawei ïa kawei Trai’ jyrthiaw Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ki sdang ïa ka jingïaleh , bad ki Israel ki pynïap thoh ki spah Besalel ki Syria .
translation.en: And they pitched one over against the other seven days . And so it was , that in the seventh day the battle was joined : and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day .

translation.kha: U Herod u bitar shikatdei eh ïa briew jong ka bad Tyros Sidon , ki kumta la leit shi kynhun ban ïakynduh ïa u . Nyngkong ki la pynngeit ïa Blastos u , briew u uba dei khmih ïa ka ïingsyiem , ba u dei ban ïarap ïa ki . Nangta ki la leit sha u Herod bad pan ban ïasuk bad u , namar ka ri ki ka jong ka ïoh ïa ki jingbam na ka ri ka jong u syiem .
translation.en: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon : but they came with one accord to him , and , having made Blastus the king s chamberlain their friend , desired peace  ; because their country was nourished by the king s country .

translation.kha: to lade khnang ba katto katne na phi long kiba la ban ïarap ïa kawei pa kawei ka longïing jong paid Israel
translation.en: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people , and after the division of the families of the Levites .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u khublei ïakhlad bad u Jethro , bad u Jethro u leit phai pat sha ïing .
translation.en: And Moses let his father in law depart  ; and he went his way into his own land .

translation.kha: U Krist Jisu da lade hi u la ong : “ Wat sngew kyndit ia kane , namar ka por ka la jia , ha kaba kito kiba don ha ki jing tep kin ioh ia sngew ka jingpyrta jong u bad kin mih ia noh . ”
translation.en: Jesus Christ himself said : “ Do not marvel at this , because the hour is coming in which all those in the memorial tombs will hear his voice and come out . ”

translation.kha: Nangta k Moses u wallam ïa ki khun shynrang nongtem Aaron kham sha khmat bad u pynphong sopti ïa ki , u buh jingïap’ ki panpoh sawdong ïapstai Harbonah jong ki , :30 u jingkhyllong tupia ha kyntu jingiashah jong ki , kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: And Moses brought Aaron s sons , and put coats upon them , and girded them with girdles , and put bonnets upon them  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
And I said , What shall I do , Lord ? And the Lord said unto me ,  Arise , and go into Damascus  ; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do .
translation.kha: Nga la kylli , ‘ Aïu ngan leh , A Trai ?’ bad U Trai u la ong ha nga , ‘ Ïeng joit bad leit sha Damaskos , bad hangta yn sa ïathuh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la thmu na ka bynta jong me ban leh .’

translation.en: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Hynrei da ka jingaiei U Blei , ïa baroh la pynlong ka hok bad u lyngba U Khrist Jisu , uba pyllaitluid ïa ki .

Kito kiba dang sah napdeng jaitbynriew ki kin long kum u sing uba wad jingbam ha ka khlaw ha ne ka jaka bam phlang : U rung hapdeng ki langbrot , u kynrup ïa ki , bad tar lyngkhot ïa ki — bad hangta ym don jingkyrmen ban im lait .
translation.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest , as a young lion among the flocks of sheep : who , if he go through , both treadeth down , and teareth in pieces , and none can deliver .

translation.kha: Namar ba u don ki shibun kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun , masi bad bun ngut ki shakri , ki Philistia ki la bishni ïa u .
translation.en: For he had possession of flocks , and possession of herds , and great store of servants : and the Philistines envied him .
Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther , Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king s house , more than all the Jews .
translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba phan kham lait im ban ïa kiwei pat ki Jiw tang namar ba pha don ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon , and all Israel with him  ; and they encamped against it , and fought against it :
translation.kha: Nangta pat , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit na Lakhish sha Eglon , ki kerkut ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba bad ïadei ki jingainguh ïasyllok ïa kiba wanrah sha U Trai .
translation.en: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings , which he shall offer unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la jubab , U briew uba la pynkhiah ïa nga u la ong ha nga ba ngan Pynleit ïa ka jingthiah bad ban Lydda .
translation.en: He answered them , He that made me whole , the same said unto me ,  Take up thy bed , and walk .

translation.kha: U Trai u long nongkyrshan donbor jong ki , un ïasaid ïa ka kam jong phi .
translation.en: For their redeemer is mighty  ; he shall plead their cause with thee .

translation.kha: pynsan Iskah lah ban ïalap ïa itieng Khubor Babha ha Antiokh pynjhieh ki jaipdeh jngai na phi bad yn ym tasam ban leh sarong shaphang ka jingtrei ïa pruid la lah leh lypa ha ka lyngkha jong uwei Jehoïada u briew .
translation.en: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you , and not to boast in another man s line of things made ready to our hand .
Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah , the son of Habaziniah , and his brethren , and all his sons , and the whole house of the Rechabites  ;
translation.kha: Kumta nga la shim ïa ka kur Rekhab baroh kawei — u Jaasanaïah ( u khun jong uwei pat u Jeremaïah , uba dei u khun jong u Habassinaïah ) bad ïa baroh ki shynrang kiba shi para bad u bad ki khun shynrang jong u — bad wallam ïa ki sha ka Templ .

U Rehoboam synshar ha Jerusalem bad u khraw ha ka bor kum u syiem . U don sawphew wei snem mynba u long syiem , bad u synshar khathynñiew snem ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah kaba U Trai u la jied ki jaka jong ka Israel ka jaka hangno ba yn mane ïa u . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka na ka ri ki Ammon .
translation.en: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem , and reigned : for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem , the city which the  Lord  had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel , to put his name there . And his mother s name was Naamah an Ammonitess .

translation.kha: Un pynjot ïa jingjia maw jingteinam bakyntang ha Heliopolis nongïapom ha Ijipt bad un thang ïa ki templ jong ki blei ki nong Ijipt .
translation.en: He shall break also the images of Beth–shemesh , that is in the land of Egypt  ; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire .

translation.kha: jingpynmlien ïa ka met ka katne ka jingbha , ka jingpynmlien kynja ka pynmyntoi ki liang baroh , namar ka kular ïa ka ha ka mynta bad ha ka lawei .
translation.en: For bodily exercise profiteth little : but godliness is profitable unto all things , having promise of the life that now is , and of that which is to come .

translation.kha: Un uba long khraw , bad yn khot ïa u , Khun U jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . U Trai Uba U Blei un pynlong syiem ïa u , kumba u u Dabid kpa tymmen jong u , u la long ,
translation.en: He shall be great , and shall be called the Son of the Highest : and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David :
And straightway coming up out of the water , he saw the heavens opened , and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him :
translation.kha: U Jisu u tang shu mih na ka um , u la ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad U Mynsiem ba u wan hiar halor jong u kum ka paro .
U la wan sha la ka jong ka ri , ki hynrei briew jong u hi kim shym la pdiang ïa u .
translation.en: He came unto his own , and his own received him not .

translation.kha: Ha nga , ka ïingsyiem Judah ka long kaba itynnat kum ka ri Gilead , bad kum ki Lebanon ; hynrei ngan pynlong ka , jaka kynjah ha kaba yn ym don bashong .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  unto the king s house of Judah  ; Thou art Gilead unto me , and the head of Lebanon : yet surely I will make thee a wilderness , and cities which are not inhabited .
Nevertheless what saith the scripture ? Cast out the bondwoman and her son : for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman .
translation.kha: Hynrei aïu ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ? Ka ïathuh ,  Beh noh ïa ka kynthei mraw bad ïa u khun jong ka ; naba u khun jong ka kynthei mraw un ym ïoh bynta na ka jingdon jingem u kpa lem bad u khun jong ka kynthei kaba laitluid .
Wat ynda phi la pynkhlur ban bam kat ïa kaba Bered Baibyl bad tei la ki ïing kiba itynnat ban shong iphylla
translation.en: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full , and hast built goodly houses , and dwelt therein  ;
When a strong man armed keepeth his palace , his goods are in peace :
translation.kha: Haba u briew uba khlaiñ , uba la khreh ïa la ki tiar ïaleh baroh , u ap phira ïa la ka jong ka ïing , baroh ki jingdon jingem jong u ki don ha ka jingshngain .

translation.en: ( John 17 :3 ) Yes , “the world is passing away . . .  , but he that does the will of God remains forever .” —1 John 2 :17 .
translation.kha: ( Ioannis 17 :3 ) Hooid , “kata ka pyrthei kan iaid jah noh . . .  , hynrei uta uba leh ka mon jong u Blei u iaisah bymjukut .” —1 Ioannis 2 :17 .
Wat pynbna ïa ka ha lane Gath ha ki surok ka Ashkelon . Wat pynlong ïa ki kynthei Philistia ban , kmen wat ai ba ki khun kynthei jong ki bymngeit blei kin risa .
translation.en: Tell it not in Gath , publish it not in the streets of Ashkelon  ; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice , lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph .

translation.kha: U Blei u wan ha u Balaam , bad u ong , Kiei kine ki briew kiba sahmiet bad me ?
translation.en: And God came unto Balaam , and said , What men are these with thee ?
He said ,  Bring them hither to me .
translation.kha: Te wanrah ïa ki hangne ha nga ,  U Jisu u la ong .

translation.en: By faith Abraham , when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance , obeyed  ; and he went out , not knowing whither he went .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa u Abraham ban kohnguh haba U Blei u la khot ïa u ban leit sha ka ri kaba U Blei u la kular ban ai ha u . U la mihnoh na la ka ri khlem tip shano ba un leit .

translation.en: Shall not they teach thee , and tell thee , and utter words out of their heart ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ai ba ki riewstad mynbarim kin hikai ïa me , to sngap ïa kaei kaba ki don ban ong .

translation.en: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests , and they builded the sheep gate  ; they sanctified it , and set up the doors of it  ; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it , unto the tower of Hananeel .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ba la tei pat ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah . U Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad ki para lyngdoh jong u ki la tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Langbrot , ki pynkyntang ïa ka , bad pynïeng ïa ki khyrdop . Ki la pynkyntang ïa ka kynroh haduh u Mot ki Shispah bad u Mot Hananel .

translation.en: And when the governor had read the letter , he asked of what province he was . And when he understood that he was of Cilicia  ;
translation.kha: U Lyngskor u la pule ïa ka shithi bad u la kylli ïa u Paul na kano ka probins    u la wan . Haba u la tip ba u dei na Kilikia ,
Nga , U Trai , ngan pyllait im ïa baroh ki Philetos Moresheth ksiew jong u Jakob , bad kin man ka jingïaroh Tur nga .
translation.en: In the  Lord  shall all the seed of Israel be justified , and shall glory .
Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart : but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king s gate , that he stood not up , nor moved for him , he was full of indignation against Mordecai .
translation.kha: Haba u Haman u la mihnoh na ka jingkhawai u la kmen bad dap da ka jingsngewbha . Hynrei u ïohi pat ïa u Mordekai ha ka khyrdop bad um shym la ïeng lane pyn-i kano kano ka dak jong ka jingburom haba u ïaid nangta , u Haman u la bitar ïa u .
Kumta noh na ki jingmlien bajakhlia baroh bad ki jinglong bymman baroh . To pyndem ha U bad pdiang ïa ka ktien kaba u la thung ha ki dohnud jong phi , kaba ïa phi .
translation.en: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness , and receive with meekness the engrafted word , which is able to save your souls .
And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things . Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown ; but we an incorruptible .
translation.kha: Bad man uwei pa uwei u nongïamareh uba don ha ka jingshah hikai , u pyndem ha ka jinghikai kaba pyrkhing , khnang ba yn pynphong da ka pansngiat sla dieng ka bymneh ; hynrei ma ngi pat ngi ïaleh na ka bynta kata ka ban neh junom la junom .
Lada ka doh kaba la kum dei bad kaei kaei ïa kaba la ñiew bymkhuid , ym dei ban bam , hynrei ban thang noh ïa ka . Uno uno ïohkynti uba la Berakhaïah ba u long uba hamsaïa u lah ban bam ïa ka doh ,
translation.en: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten  ; it shall be burnt with fire : and as for the flesh , all that be clean shall eat thereof .

But when he was strong , his heart was lifted up to his destruction : for he transgressed against the  Lord  his God , and went into the temple of the  Lord  to burn incense upon the altar of incense .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u syiem Ussaïah u la kylla long uba khlaiñbor , u la sngewmeng noh pynban , bad kata ka ïalam sha ka jingkhyllem noh jong u . U ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u da kaba u leit rung sha ka Templ ban thang jingiwbih ha ka duwan thang jingiwbih .

translation.en: I am become a fool in glorying ; ye have compelled me : for I ought to have been commended of you : for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles , though I be nothing .
translation.kha: Nga la leh mynleh kum u bieit — hynrei phi la pynlong ïa nga ban leh kumta . Dei ma phi kiba la dei ban pynpaw ïa ka jingmynjur jong phi ïa nga . Naba wat lada ngam long ei ei , ngam shym duna ei ei na kita ki  apostol  kiba kham kyrpang jong phi .

translation.en: That I will break the Assyrian in my land , and upon my mountains tread him under foot : then shall his yoke depart from off them , and his burden depart from off their shoulders .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki nong Assyria ha ka ri Israel jong nga bad ngan kyrdem halor jong ki lumbah jong nga . Ngan pyllaitluid ïa ki briew jong nga na ka lyngkor jong ki nong Assyria bad na ki jingkit kiba ki don ban bah .

translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  is my rock , and my fortress , and my deliverer  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u nongïada jong nga , u long ka kut baskhem jong nga .
